description.zh-cn: 文化大革命（简称文革）是1966年5月16日至1976年10月6日由毛泽东发动并领导、发生在中国大陆的重大政治运动，对社会造成深远影响。期间，中央书记处等职务被撤销，国务院法制机构被取消，地方机构瘫痪，高考中断，教育与文化遗产遭严重破坏。大量人物遭受迫害，例如巴金及其家人，甚至有归国华侨被批斗。文革被后世负面评价为“十年内乱”，官方定性为“由领导者错误发动的内乱”，并全面否定其理论与实践。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution (Wen Ge), a major political movement initiated and led by Mao Zedong, took place in mainland China from May 16, 1966, to October 6, 1976, profoundly impacting society. During this period, positions such as the Central Secretariat were abolished, the State Council's legislative affairs body was canceled, local institutions were paralyzed, Gaokao was suspended, and education and cultural heritage were severely damaged. Numerous figures suffered persecution, such as Ba Jin and his family, and even returned overseas Chinese were subjected to struggle sessions. Later generations negatively evaluated the Cultural Revolution as 'ten years of civil strife,' and it was officially defined as 'internal turmoil erroneously initiated by the leadership,' with its theory and practice completely negated.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国和中国人民解放军的主要缔造者和第一代最高领导人。他曾任中国共产党中央委员会主席、中华苏维埃共和国中央执行委员会主席、中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会主席，以及红一方面军总政治委员。作为革命家、政治家和理论家，他在国共内战中确立了红军领导地位。执政期间，他签署命令组建中国人民志愿军入朝参战；推行“一边倒”外交，促进中苏、中日建交及中美关系正常化。他曾三次主持“庐山会议”等中共中央重要会议，领导了反右、大跃进和文化大革命等运动，对“文革”左倾错误负主要责任，但官方评价功绩第一，错误第二。
description.en: The principal founder and first paramount leader of the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China, and the People's Liberation Army. He served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Chairman of the Central Executive Committee of the Chinese Soviet Republic, Chairman of the Central People's Government People's Revolutionary Military Commission, and General Political Commissar of the First Front Army of the Red Army. As a revolutionary, statesman, and theorist, he established his leadership over the Red Army during the Chinese Civil War. During his rule, he signed the order to form the Chinese People's Volunteer Army and sent them to fight in Korea; he pursued a 'Lean to One Side' foreign policy, facilitating diplomatic relations with the Soviet Union and Japan, and promoting the normalization of Sino-American relations. He also presided over important CPC Central Committee meetings, including three 'Lushan Conferences.' He led movements such as the Anti-Rightist Movement, the Great Leap Forward, and the Cultural Revolution, bearing primary responsibility for the leftist errors of the Cultural Revolution, but officially, his merits are considered primary, and his mistakes secondary.

birth_place.zh-cn: 长沙府宁乡县花明楼镇炭子冲村

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一，曾领导安源路矿罢工。他是一位杰出的政治家和马克思主义理论家，曾任中华人民共和国第二任主席（国家主席）、中共中央委员会副主席，并被推选为中华全国总工会名誉主席。他曾任中共中央军委总政治部主任。早期在湖北省总工会工作，支持土地改革并推动中国人民大学建立。在1961年广州中央工作会议期间主持三北会议。七千人大会上，他批评大跃进，指出大饥荒成因，与毛泽东产生分歧。曾率中共代表团出席苏共十九大。文化大革命初期，他曾批准成立工作组，后被罢倒，罢免所有职务并被迫害致死。
description.en: A former major leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who led the Anyuan Road and Mining Strike. He was a prominent statesman and Marxist theorist, serving as Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee (1954-1959), Vice Chairman of the CPC (1956-1966), and President of the People's Republic of China (1959-1968, the second Chairman of the PRC). He was also elected Honorary Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions and served as Director of the General Political Department of the Central Military Commission of the CPC Central Committee. Early in his career, he worked at the Hubei Provincial General Labor Union, supported land reform, and promoted the establishment of Renmin University of China. During the 1961 Guangzhou Central Work Conference, he presided over the Sanbei (Three-North) meeting. At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, he criticized the Great Leap Forward, pointing out the causes of the Great Famine, which led to disagreements with Mao Zedong. He led a CPC delegation to attend the 19th Congress of the CPSU. In the early stage of the Cultural Revolution, he approved the establishment of work groups, was later purged, dismissed from all posts, and persecuted to death.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省广安市广安区协兴镇牌坊村

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的核心领导人、改革开放总设计师，第二代中央领导集体的核心人物。早年曾与孙冶方在莫斯科中山大学同学。他曾任中共中央副主席、书记处总书记、中央军委主席，中华人民共和国最高领导人（1978-1989）及副总理。他领导拨乱反正、平反冤假错案、恢复高考，推动十一届三中全会确立改革开放，提出“一国两制”，并主导废除干部终身制。他曾支持并提拔胡锦涛。晚年对八六学潮立场强硬，是六四戒严及清场主要决策者。
description.en: A Chinese statesman, core leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, chief architect of Reform and Opening-up, and the core figure of the second generation of central leadership. Early in his life, he was a classmate of Sun Yefang at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University. He served as Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, General Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, China's paramount leader (1978-1989), and Vice Premier. He led the rectification of errors, rehabilitation of unjust cases, and restoration of Gaokao; promoted the establishment of reform and opening-up at the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, proposed 'One Country, Two Systems,' and abolished lifelong tenure for cadres. He supported and promoted Hu Jintao. In his later years, he held a hardline stance on the 1986 student protests and was a key decision-maker for the June Fourth crackdown and clearance.

birth_place.zh-cn: 湖北省黄州府黄冈县回龙山镇林家大湾村

death_place.zh-cn: 蒙古人民共和国肯特省巴特瑙劳布县苏布拉嘎盆地

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物、军事家，中国人民解放军将领。曾长期任红一军团军团长、国防部部长、中共中央副主席、国务院副总理。在第二次国共内战东北战场任东北民主联军总司令。七千人大会上他公开支持毛泽东，私下对大跃进不满。文革期间，作为重要领导人之一，曾迫害贺龙，并与江青等人提出“彻底砸烂总政阎王殿”，导致总政治部瘫痪。毛泽东在中共九大确立其为接班人，但庐山会议后分歧加剧。最终在九一三事件中坠机身亡，后被认定为“林彪反革命集团”首领。
description.en: Marshal of the People's Republic of China, a politician and military strategist of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a general of the People's Liberation Army. He long served as commander of the Red First Army Group, Minister of National Defense, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and Vice Premier of the State Council. During the Chinese Civil War, he commanded the Northeast Democratic United Army in the Northeast battlefield. At the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference, he publicly supported Mao Zedong but privately expressed dissatisfaction with the Great Leap Forward. During the Cultural Revolution, as one of the key leaders, he persecuted He Long, and, along with Jiang Qing and others, called for 'smashing the palace of the King of Hell of the General Political Department,' leading to the paralysis of the General Political Department. Mao Zedong designated him as his successor at the Ninth National Congress of the CPC, but disagreements intensified after the Lushan Conference. He eventually died in a plane crash during the September 13th Incident and was later identified as the leader of the 'Lin Biao Counter-revolutionary Clique'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝江苏省淮安府山阳县驸马巷

description.zh-cn: 中共、新中国及解放军主要领导人之一。曾任南昌起义前委书记，长征中为“三人团”主要成员。建国后，历任首任国务院总理兼外交部长、全国政协主席、中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会副主席，主持组建东北边防军。1937年，他代表中国共产党上庐山与蒋介石谈判合作抗日事宜。在经济、外交、科技领域贡献卓著，促成中苏友好同盟互助条约，推动天安门纳入国徽，委托钱学森起草导弹方案。文革期间，他努力维持国家运转，保护重要文化遗产及人物，并宣布“省无联”为反革命组织。同时，他也被杨小凯的《中国向何处去》一文点名批判。
description.en: One of the principal leaders of the CCP, New China, and the PLA. He served as Secretary of the Nanchang Uprising Front Committee and was a key member of the 'Trio' during the Long March. After the founding of the PRC, he successively served as the first Premier of the State Council, Minister of Foreign Affairs, Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, and Vice Chairman of the Central People's Government People's Revolutionary Military Commission, presiding over the formation of the Northeast Border Defense Army. In 1937, he represented the Communist Party of China to negotiate with Chiang Kai-shek at Mount Lu regarding cooperation in the war against Japan. He made outstanding contributions in economic, diplomatic, and scientific fields, facilitating the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance, promoting the inclusion of Tiananmen in the national emblem, and commissioning Qian Xuesen to draft missile plans. During the Cultural Revolution, he worked to maintain state operations, protect important cultural heritage and figures, and declared the 'Shengwulian' a counter-revolutionary organization. He was also criticized by name in Yang Xiaokai's article 'Where is China Going?'

description.zh-cn: 江青是毛泽东的第四任（也是最后一任）妻子、毛岸青的继母。她曾是中国政治人物、演员、文艺理论家，原国家级副职领导人，曾任中央文化革命小组副组长及核心成员。作为文化大革命期间中国共产党的主要领导人之一，她位列“四人帮”之首，具有重要影响力。她曾与林彪等人提出“彻底砸烂总政阎王殿”，导致总政治部机关瘫痪；还公开批评宋任穷父女，并将杨小凯及其文章《中国向何处去》点名为“反革命”。
description.en: Jiang Qing was Mao Zedong's fourth (and last) wife, and the stepmother of Mao Anqing. She was a Chinese politician, actress, and literary theorist, formerly a national-level deputy leader, and served as deputy head and a core member of the Central Cultural Revolution Group. As one of the main leaders of the Chinese Communist Party during the Cultural Revolution, she was the head of the 'Gang of Four' and highly influential. She, along with Lin Biao and others, proposed 'thoroughly smashing the General Political Department's palace of the King of Hell,' which led to the paralysis of the department; she also publicly criticized Song Renqiong and his daughter, and labeled Yang Xiaokai and his article 'Where is China Going?' as 'counter-revolutionary'.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期中华人民共和国的重要政治人物，中国共产党高级领导人。作为“四人帮”核心成员，曾任上海市革委会主任、中央文革小组副组长、中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理兼中国人民解放军总政治部主任。被《“571工程”纪要》视为林彪的主要政治对手。在“林彪、江青反革命集团案”中被判处死刑，缓期两年执行。
description.en: An important political figure and a high-ranking leader of the Communist Party of China during the Cultural Revolution. As a core member of the 'Gang of Four', he served as Director of the Shanghai Revolutionary Committee, Deputy Head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, Standing Committee Member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the PLA General Political Department. He was also considered by the 'Project 571 Outline' as Lin Biao's main political rival. He was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 浙江省诸暨县直埠镇姚公埠村

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，“四人帮”成员之一。他曾任中央文革小组成员，是文革的理论旗手，并发表《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》。与张春桥等人一同被《“571工程”纪要》称为“文人力量”。作为中国文化大革命时期的重要政治人物，原国家级副职领导人，他在“林彪、江青反革命集团案”中被判处有期徒刑。
description.en: A Chinese politician and a member of the 'Gang of Four'. He served as a member of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, was a theoretical standard-bearer of the Cultural Revolution, and published 'Critique of the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office''. Along with Zhang Chunqiao and others, he was referred to as the 'literati force' in the 'Project 571 Outline'. As an important political figure during China's Cultural Revolution and a former national deputy leader, he was sentenced to imprisonment in the 'Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 吉林省长春市绿园区西新镇开源村

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市首都医科大学附属复兴医院

description.zh-cn: “四人帮”成员之一，中国政治人物。曾任中共中央副主席、中共中央政治局常委等正国级领导职务。在“林彪、江青反革命集团案”中被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: A Chinese politician and a member of the 'Gang of Four'. He served as a national-level leader, including Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and Standing Committee member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. He was sentenced to life imprisonment in the 'Lin Biao, Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques case'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东指定的接班人，在他逝世后，他与叶剑英、汪东兴等人联手策划并领导粉碎了“四人帮”，成为中华人民共和国最高领导人。作为中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，他在文化大革命结束后，曾兼任中共中央主席、国务院总理和中央军委主席，是至今唯一一位同时出任党政军三大最高领导职务的领导人。他提出了“两个凡是”的执政原则，后遭到胡耀邦等人的反对。在此期间，陈永贵曾劝说他不要让邓小平复出。
description.en: Mao Zedong's designated successor. After Mao's death, he collaborated with Ye Jianying, Wang Dongxing, and others to plan and lead the smashing of the 'Gang of Four', becoming the paramount leader of the People's Republic of China. As a Chinese politician, after the Cultural Revolution, he simultaneously served as Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, Premier of the State Council, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, making him the only leader to have held these three highest party, government, and military positions concurrently to date. He proposed the 'Two Whatevers' governing principle, which was later opposed by Hu Yaobang and others. During this period, Chen Yonggui once advised him not to allow Deng Xiaoping to return to power.

birth_place.zh-cn: 广东省嘉应直隶州雁洋

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、军事家，中华人民共和国开国元帅，中共元老之一。中国共产党和中华人民共和国创建者与缔造者之一。曾与孙冶方在莫斯科中山大学同学。长征期间任红军前敌指挥部参谋长，在张国焘与毛泽东分裂时起关键作用。历任广州市军管会主任、广州市市长，全国人大常委会委员长（行使国家元首职权）、中共中央副主席、国防部部长等职。他曾建议加强电子对抗工作。领导广东土改因政策温和受毛泽东批评。在“二月逆流”中抗争文革。在粉碎“四人帮”中起决定性作用，并提出设立台湾特别行政区构想。支持真理标准问题讨论。凌孜的父亲。
description.en: A Chinese politician and military strategist, one of the founding marshals of the People's Republic of China, and a veteran of the Communist Party of China. A key founder and creator of the CPC and PRC. A classmate of Sun Yefang at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University, he served as Chief of Staff of the Red Army's Frontline Command during the Long March, playing a crucial role in the split between Zhang Guotao and Mao Zedong. He successively served as Director of the Guangzhou Military Control Commission, Mayor of Guangzhou, Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee (exercising functions of a head of state), Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and Minister of National Defense. He suggested strengthening electronic warfare capabilities. Criticized by Mao Zedong for his moderate land reform policies in Guangdong, he resisted the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent'. He played a decisive role in the smashing of the Gang of Four, proposed establishing a special administrative region for Taiwan, and supported the discussion on the criterion of truth. He was also Ling Zi's father.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人，文化大革命时期重要人物。他曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中央警卫部队领导，直接参与并负责粉碎“四人帮”事件的具体执行，深度参与了怀仁堂事变。阎明复任中央办公厅翻译组组长后期，汪东兴是其直接上级。他也是“凡是派”的主要成员之一，支持“两个凡是”原则，并曾阻挠为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a former state-level leader, and an important figure during the Cultural Revolution. He served as Director of the General Office of the CCP Central Committee and led the Central Security Forces, directly participating in and responsible for the specific execution of smashing the 'Gang of Four' incident, including deep involvement in the Huairentang Incident. During the latter part of Yan Mingfu's tenure as head of the translation group of the General Office, Wang Dongxing was his direct superior. He was also one of the main members of the 'Whatever Faction', supporting the 'Two Whatevers' principle, and once obstructed the rehabilitation of the Case of the 61 Renegades.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一，也是一位书法家。他曾任中共驻共产国际代表团副团长、中国共产党安全和情报部长、中共中央副主席，并在1949年2月山东军区重建后担任政治委员。作为文化大革命的主要人物和关键支持者，他担任中央文革小组顾问，曾将杨小凯及其文章《中国向何处去》点名为“反革命”。他还是“四人帮”集团主犯，曾领导对陈独秀的攻击，并制造了“六十一人叛徒集团案”和“反党小说《刘志丹》案”。死后被认定为林彪、江青反革命集团主犯之一。
description.en: A former major leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and also a calligrapher. He served as deputy head of the CCP delegation to the Comintern, Minister of Public Security, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and after the re-establishment of the Shandong Military Region in February 1949, he served as its political commissar. As a key figure and supporter of the Cultural Revolution, he served as an advisor to the Central Cultural Revolution Group, and notably labeled Yang Xiaokai and his article 'Where is China Going?' as 'counter-revolutionary'. He was also a principal culprit of the 'Gang of Four' group, leading the smear campaign against Chen Duxiu and fabricating the 'Case of the 61 Renegades' and the 'Liu Zhidan Anti-Party Novel Case'. After his death, he was identified as one of the principal culprits of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary cliques.

birth_place.zh-cn: 福建省泉州市惠安县洛阳镇梅岭村
birth_place.en: Meiling Village, Luoyang Town, Hui'an County, Quanzhou, Fujian Province

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要政治人物及理论家，原国家级正职领导人。曾长期担任毛泽东的政治秘书，并辅助陶铸起草《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。在文化大革命期间，他担任中共中央政治局常委、中央文革小组组长，曾将杨小凯及其文章《中国向何处去》点名为“反革命”，并曾试图省略余秋里的名字但被毛泽东阻止。九届二中全会后被隔离审查，后被划入林彪反革命集团，也是四人帮主犯之一。
description.en: A former principal political figure and theorist of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level principal leader. He served as Mao Zedong's political secretary for a long time and assisted Tao Zhu in drafting the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'. During the Cultural Revolution, he served as a Standing Committee Member of the CPC Politburo and Head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group. He labeled Yang Xiaokai and his article 'Where is China Going?' as 'counter-revolutionary', and once attempted to omit Yu Qiuli's name, but was stopped by Mao Zedong. After the Second Plenary Session of the Ninth Central Committee, he was placed under isolation review, later classified as a member of the Lin Biao Counter-revolutionary Group, and was also a principal offender of the Gang of Four.

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市东城区北京医院

description.zh-cn: 彭真，伟大的无产阶级革命家、政治家、杰出的国务活动家、坚定的马克思主义者，我国社会主义法制的主要奠基人，党和国家的卓越领导人之一，中共八大元老之一。曾任北京市委第一书记、文化革命五人小组组长。文化大革命初期被打倒，并在“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团案”中首当其冲。复出后，曾任全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长、宪法修改委员会副主任委员。阎明复任全国人大常委会副秘书长期间，彭真是其直接上级。
description.en: Peng Zhen was a great proletarian revolutionary, politician, outstanding statesman, staunch Marxist, and a principal founder of China's socialist legal system. He was one of the eminent leaders of the Party and state, and one of the Eight Elders of the CCP. He served as the First Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee and head of the Five-Man Group for the Cultural Revolution. He was purged during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, being the primary target in the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique' case. After his rehabilitation, he served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and Deputy Chairman of the Constitution Revision Committee. When Yan Mingfu served as Deputy Secretary-General of the NPC Standing Committee, Peng Zhen was his direct superior.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清四川省顺庆府南充县
birth_place.en: Nanchong County, Shunqing Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Great Qing

death_place.zh-cn: 西德巴登-符腾堡州海德堡

description.zh-cn: 无产阶级革命家、军事家、开国大将。曾任红一军团保卫局局长，中国共产党和中华人民共和国副国级领导人之一。历任中共中央书记处书记、国务院副总理、中华人民共和国公安部首任部长、国防部副部长、解放军总参谋长等职。在文革初期被打倒，是“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团案”成员之一，被授予中国人民解放军大将军衔。
description.en: A proletarian revolutionary, military strategist, and one of China's founding Generals, Luo Ruiqing was also a sub-national leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Director of the Security Bureau of the Red First Army Group, Secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat, Vice Premier of the State Council, the first Minister of Public Security of the PRC, Deputy Minister of National Defense, and Chief of the PLA General Staff, among other posts. He was purged in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution as a member of the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique' and was awarded the rank of PLA General.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，曾任中宣部部长、国务院副总理。在文革初期被指控为“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团案”成员之一而被打倒。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, former head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. He was denounced as a member of the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique' case during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清四川省潼川府遂宁县双江镇
birth_place.en: Shuangjiang Town, Suining County, Tongchuan Prefecture, Sichuan Province, Qing Dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市中国人民解放军总医院
death_place.en: General Hospital of the People's Liberation Army, Beijing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、主要领导人之一、原国家级正职领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。他曾于1938年在延安与李富春等人合影，后接替其担任中共中央书记处办公厅主任，也曾任中共中央办公厅主任。文革初期被打倒。历任中华人民共和国主席、中共中央政治局委员、中共中央军委副主席兼秘书长，并曾任广州市革命委员会主任。他是中共八大元老之一，也是唯一一位非中共中央政治局常委担任的国家主席。他曾负责部署军队执行戒严，并以实际行动支持废除领导职务终身制。
description.en: A Chinese politician, one of the paramount leaders, former national-level state leader, and a high-ranking general of the People's Liberation Army. He was photographed with Li Fuchun and others in Yan'an in 1938, later succeeding Li as Director of the General Office of the Central Secretariat, and also served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. He was purged during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution. His career included serving as President of the People's Republic of China, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Chairman and Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission, and former Director of the Guangzhou Revolutionary Committee. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CPC and the only President of the PRC not concurrently a member of the Political Bureau Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee. He was responsible for deploying troops for martial law and actively supported the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions.

birth_place.zh-cn: 清朝湖南省湘潭县石潭镇

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市海淀区中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国人民解放军创建者与领导者之一。早年与黄公略发动平江起义。历任红三军团长、八路军副总指挥、第一野战军司令员、国防部长。作为中国人民志愿军首任司令员兼政委，指挥了包括云山战斗在内的多次重要战役，并签署《朝鲜停战协定》。1959年庐山会议上因批评大跃进遭批判，文革中被迫害致死。其错误批判后被《历史决议》否定。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Republic of China, and one of the founders and leaders of the People's Liberation Army. In his early years, he co-led the Pingjiang Uprising with Huang Gonglue. He successively served as commander of the 3rd Army Group of the Red Army, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Eighth Route Army, Commander of the First Field Army, and Minister of National Defense. As the first Commander and Political Commissar of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, he commanded numerous important campaigns, including the Battle of Unsan, and signed the Korean Armistice Agreement. In 1959, he was criticized at the Lushan Conference for opposing the Great Leap Forward, and was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution. His erroneous criticism was later negated by the 'Historical Resolution'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国工农红军与中国人民解放军的主要创始人之一。他领导了南昌起义，并担任起义军总指挥和第二十军军长。曾任红二方面军总指挥，是长征期间重要的军事领导人。建国后任中华人民共和国国务院副总理、中央军事委员会副主席，并主持修建了大田湾体育场。在文化大革命中被迫害致死。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Republic of China, and one of the principal founders of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the People's Liberation Army. He led the Nanchang Uprising, serving as the Commander-in-Chief of the insurgent forces and the Commander of the 20th Army. He also served as Commander-in-Chief of the Second Front Army, and was an important military leader during the Long March. After the founding of the PRC, he served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and presided over the construction of Datianwan Stadium. He was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，曾任中共中央政治局常委。他曾被毛泽东派往广东以激进方式推进土地改革，并在当地担任主要领导职务。后曾任中央文革小组顾问，并主持《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》的起草工作。在文化大革命中被打倒并迫害致死。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee. He was sent by Mao Zedong to Guangdong to radically advance land reform, holding major leadership positions there. Later, he served as an advisor to the Central Cultural Revolution Group and presided over the drafting of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'. He was overthrown and persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 明史学家、中国历史学家，因其剧作《海瑞罢官》在文革初期受到批判，被迫害致死。北京市副市长。
中国近现代小说家、散文家、剧作家，被广泛认为是中国近现代文学的代表人物。在文革初期因不堪迫害而投湖自尽。
中国著名翻译家，在文革初期与夫人一同自尽。

中国共产党和中华人民共和国第二代主要领导人之一，著名政治家。曾任中共中央主席，并于1982年恢复后首任中共中央总书记，也是胡锦涛的政治导师之一。文革后，他与邓小平主导“拨乱反正”，审定《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》，平反冤假错案，起草历史决议。他大力推动改革开放，支持废除干部终身制，曾批评陈永贵大寨模式“劳民伤财”。他邀请周扬在中央党校作报告，平息周扬因“异化论”受批判的风波。1986年因处理八六学潮被批评后辞职。其逝世是六四事件导火索，引发《世界经济导报》停刊事件。
description.en: One of the second generation of principal leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a prominent politician. He served as Chairman of the CPC Central Committee and was the first General Secretary after the post was reinstated in 1982, and was also one of Hu Jintao's political mentors. After the Cultural Revolution, he co-led the "Boluan Fanzheng" with Deng Xiaoping, approved "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth," redressed unjust cases, and drafted the historical resolution. He vigorously promoted reform and opening up, supporting the abolition of lifelong tenure for cadres. He criticized Chen Yonggui's Dazhai model as "wasting manpower and resources." He invited Zhou Yang to give a report at the Central Party School and quelled the criticism against Zhou over the "alienation" issue. He resigned in 1986 after being criticized for handling the 1986 student demonstrations. His death was a catalyst for the Tiananmen Square protests, sparking the shutdown of the "World Economic Herald".

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳，中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人、政治人物，中国改革派领导人。曾任国务院总理（1980年9月接替华国锋）和中共中央总书记。早期被毛泽东派往广东参与土地改革，并参与起草《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。在胡耀邦辞职后代理中共中央总书记，期间限制了“反对资产阶级自由化”运动。文革后支持改革开放。在六四事件中，因同情学生运动、反对戒严被免职并长期软禁。
description.en: Zhao Ziyang, a former major leader, political figure, and reformist leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China. He served as Premier of the State Council (succeeding Hua Guofeng in September 1980) and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee. Early in his career, he participated in land reform in Guangdong and was involved in drafting the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'. After Hu Yaobang's resignation, he acted as General Secretary, limiting the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign'. He supported reform and opening up after the Cultural Revolution. During the Tiananmen Square incident, he was dismissed and placed under long-term house arrest for sympathizing with student movements and opposing martial law.

description.zh-cn: 现任中共中央总书记、中华人民共和国主席、中央军委主席，是中国共产党第五代中央领导集体核心，也是中华人民共和国最高领导人。他是习仲勋的次子，被官方认定为习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想的主要创立者。自2012年起担任国家最高领导人，任内推动修宪取消国家主席任期限制，提出“一带一路”倡议，签署《香港国安法》，并开展反腐运动。他曾是清华大学1979届工程化学系校友。黄坤明在其福建和浙江任职期间曾与他长期共事，被视为其重要亲信。
description.en: He is a Chinese politician, serving as the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the Central Military Commission since 2012, and President of the People's Republic of China since 2013. He is the core figure of the fifth generation of central leadership and the supreme leader of the PRC. As the second son of Xi Zhongxun, he is officially recognized as the main founder of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. During his tenure, he has promoted a constitutional amendment to remove presidential term limits, proposed the 'Belt and Road' initiative, signed the Hong Kong National Security Law, and launched an anti-corruption campaign. He is an alumnus of Tsinghua University's Department of Chemical Engineering, class of 1979. Huang Kunming, who worked with him for a long time during his tenure in Fujian and Zhejiang, is regarded as one of his key confidants.

en: Member of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于1921年由陈独秀、李大钊等人创立，以列宁主义为指导。作为执政党，在国共内战胜利后建立了中华人民共和国，并曾创建中华苏维埃共和国。该党领导了南昌起义、长征、土地改革等重大历史事件，并促成西安事变后的第二次国共合作。在毛泽东领导下，曾因反对赫鲁晓夫报告导致中苏关系恶化。它是中华人民共和国的执政党，主导对法轮功的镇压，并将萧美琴列入“台独”份子制裁名单。其领导人周恩来曾在庐山与国民党谈判，毛泽东亦在此主持过重要会议。钱学森于1959年加入，早期成员有张太雷、李达、艾跃进、黄公略等，孙冶方于1924年加入。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party, founded in 1921 by Chen Duxiu, Li Dazhao, and others, is guided by Leninism. As the ruling party, it established the People's Republic of China after its victory in the Chinese Civil War, and also founded the Chinese Soviet Republic. The party led major historical events like the Nanchang Uprising, the Long March, and land reform, facilitating the Second United Front after the Xi'an Incident. Under Mao Zedong, its opposition to Khrushchev's report worsened Sino-Soviet relations. It is the ruling political party of the PRC, spearheaded the suppression of Falun Gong, and sanctioned Hsiao Bi-khim as a 'Taiwan independence' element. Its leader Zhou Enlai negotiated with the Kuomintang on Mount Lu, where Mao Zedong also presided over important meetings. Qian Xuesen joined in 1959; early members include Zhang Tailei, Li Da, Ai Yuejin, Huang Gunglue, with Sun Yefang joining in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间由青年学生组成的大规模群众运动。

location.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区钓鱼台国宾馆

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，它是中国共产党的最高领导机构之一，也是文化大革命的实际指挥和最高权力机构。它取代了中央政治局和中央书记处的职能，并表态支持全国大串连。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, it served as one of the highest leading bodies of the Chinese Communist Party, functioning as the actual command and supreme power institution of the movement. It effectively replaced the functions of the Politburo and the Secretariat, and publicly supported the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 由王洪文、张春桥、江青、姚文元四人组成的中共党内政治集团，在文化大革命后期形成并掌握重要权力。后被《历史决议》认定为在“文化大革命”期间进行反革命活动的集团之一。
description.en: A political faction within the Communist Party of China, composed of Wang Hongwen, Zhang Chunqiao, Jiang Qing, and Yao Wenyuan. It formed in the later stages of the Cultural Revolution, wielding significant power, and was later identified in the 'Historical Resolution' as one of the groups that engaged in counter-revolutionary activities during that period.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院
中华人民共和国中央人民政府
en: Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China
State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 国务院是中华人民共和国的最高国家行政机关和中央人民政府，同时也是最高国家权力机关的执行机关。其前身是1949年设立的中央人民政府政务院。作为中央人民政府，它负责规定全国行政区划，曾设立国务院外事办公室，并有国家外汇管理局等下属机构主管外汇工作。它也是国家中医药管理局的组织上级单位。国务院曾是《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》的提案方，并与中共中央联合发布通知推动全国大串连。在1998年水灾后，国务院发布通知要求停止毁林开垦、推动退耕还林，还曾批准故宫和雍和宫为全国重点文物保护单位。
description.en: The State Council is the highest state administrative organ and Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, serving as the executive body of the supreme organ of state power. Its predecessor was the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government, established in 1949. As the central government, it is responsible for stipulating national administrative divisions, once established the State Council Foreign Affairs Office, and has subordinate agencies like the State Administration of Foreign Exchange for foreign exchange management. It is also the organizational superior of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. The State Council proposed the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law' and jointly issued notices with the CCP Central Committee to promote the Great Networking movement. After the 1998 floods, it called for a halt to deforestation and promoted the 'Grain for Green' policy, and approved the Forbidden City and Yonghe Temple as National Key Cultural Relics Protection Units.

description.zh-cn: 文革前夕负责文化工作的领导小组，由彭真领导，后被撤销。中央文化革命小组的前身，由彭真担任组长。
文化大革命期间中国各地建立的临时领导机构，通常是在夺权后成立，取代了原有的地方政权如专区行政公署。杨小凯在《中国向何处去》中批判其为旧官僚专政。
description.en: Provisional organs of power established at all levels throughout China during the Cultural Revolution, usually formed after seizing power and replacing existing local authorities like the special administrative offices. Yang Xiaokai criticized them in 'Where is China Going?' as dictatorships of the old bureaucracy.

description.zh-cn: 指1950年代末期中国共产党在中国大陆推行的“社会主义建设总路线、大跃进、人民公社”三项政策和运动。这是文化大革命前的政治运动，其挫败也是文化大革命的背景之一，并被普遍认为是导致三年困难时期的直接原因。
description.en: Refers to the three policies and movements promoted by the Communist Party of China in mainland China in the late 1950s: the General Line for Socialist Construction, the Great Leap Forward, and the People's Communes. This political movement preceded the Cultural Revolution, and its failures were a contributing factor to the Cultural Revolution, also widely considered the direct cause of the Three Years of Great Famine.

en: Three Years of Great Chinese Famine

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国于1959年至1961年间因三面红旗运动而发生全国性饥荒的一段时期，部分学者也将1958年、1962年划入饥荒时期。此次大饥荒共造成中国大陆（包括陕西省）1500万至5500万人的非正常死亡，被广泛视为人类历史上规模最大的饥荒之一，并导致毛泽东退居二线。此后，李富春提出了“八字方针”以调整国民经济。
description.en: Refers to a period of nationwide famine in the People's Republic of China from 1959 to 1961, caused by the Three Red Banners movement. Some scholars also include the years 1958 and 1962 in this famine period. The Great Famine caused 15 to 55 million excess deaths in mainland China, including a significant number in Shaanxi province, and is widely regarded as one of the largest famines in human history. This famine also led to Mao Zedong's semi-retirement. Afterwards, Li Fuchun proposed the 'Eight-Character Policy' to adjust the national economy.

description.zh-cn: 1962年初，中共中央召开扩大的中央工作会议，旨在总结大跃进的经验教训，统一认识，加强团结。会议讨论通过了《关于改变农村人民公社基本核算单位问题的指示》。会上，刘少奇提出“三分天灾，七分人祸”的观点，加剧了与毛泽东的矛盾，毛泽东作了自我批评并退居二线。
description.en: In early 1962, the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged Central Work Conference, aimed at summarizing the experiences and lessons of the Great Leap Forward, unifying understanding, and strengthening unity. The conference discussed and passed the 'Directive on Changing the Basic Accounting Unit of Rural People's Communes'. At the meeting, Liu Shaoqi proposed the view of 'three parts natural disaster, seven parts man-made disaster,' which exacerbated the conflict with Mao Zedong, who then made a self-criticism and retreated to the second line of leadership.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进失败后，毛泽东为解决干部作风和经济管理等问题，于1963年起在中国城乡开展了社会主义教育运动，即“四清”运动（清政治、清经济、清组织、清思想）。该运动加剧了毛泽东与刘少奇之间的矛盾，被视为文化大革命的预演或前奏。
description.en: After the failure of the Great Leap Forward, Mao Zedong launched the Socialist Education Movement (also known as the 'Four Clean-ups' campaign – cleaning up politics, economy, organization, and ideology) in urban and rural China starting in 1963 to address issues such as cadre conduct and economic management. This movement exacerbated the conflict between Mao Zedong and Liu Shaoqi and is widely regarded as a prelude or rehearsal for the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 破除旧思想、旧文化、旧风俗、旧习惯

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国文化大革命初期，以大、中学生红卫兵为主力发起的社会运动，旨在破除旧思想、旧文化、旧风俗、旧习惯。这场运动对文物古迹和传统文化造成了巨大破坏。
description.en: A social movement during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution in the People's Republic of China, primarily carried out by Red Guards from high schools and universities, aimed at destroying the 'Four Olds': Old Ideas, Old Culture, Old Customs, and Old Habits. This movement caused immense damage to cultural relics and traditional culture.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，以学生和红卫兵为主体，在全国范围内免费交通食宿，互相串联、交流和宣传造反的社会运动。红卫兵前往北京或到各地进行“革命经验”交流。
description.en: During the early Cultural Revolution, this social movement primarily involved students and Red Guards, who traveled across the country (often to Beijing or other regions) for free accommodation and transport, to exchange 'revolutionary experiences' and promote rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月，文化大革命初期，北京的红卫兵运动进入高潮，发生大规模的批斗、抄家、暴力事件、屠杀。卞仲耘在此期间遇害。“破四旧”运动也在此阶段逐渐升级。
description.en: In August 1966, during the early stage of the Cultural Revolution, the Red Guard movement in Beijing reached its peak, marked by widespread struggle sessions, home raids, violent incidents, and mass killings. Bian Zhongyun was killed during this period. The 'Destroy the Four Olds' campaign also gradually escalated during this phase.

description.zh-cn: 上海工人造反派于1967年1月在上海夺取党政大权的事件，开启了全国范围的夺权运动，并加剧了全国范围内的派系斗争。
description.en: The January 1967 power seizure by Shanghai worker rebel factions, which initiated a nationwide power seizure movement and intensified factional struggles across the country.

description.zh-cn: 中国“文化大革命”期间，全国范围的造反派发起的一系列针对各级党政机关的夺权事件，旨在以建立“革命委员会”取代原有党政机关。
description.en: During China's 'Cultural Revolution', a series of power seizure events initiated by nationwide rebel factions targeting party and government organs at all levels, aimed at establishing 'Revolutionary Committees' to replace the original party and government organs.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间各派群众组织之间发生的大规模武装暴力冲突事件，导致全面内战状态。其中，重庆的武斗尤为激烈。
description.en: Large-scale violent conflicts that occurred during the Cultural Revolution. The struggles in Chongqing were particularly intense.

en: Attack with reasoning, defend with force

description.zh-cn: “文攻武卫”是文化大革命时期的一个口号，由江青在1967年提出。其意为用言论（文）进行攻击，用武力（武）进行保卫，实际上激化了全国范围的武斗。
description.en: One of the slogans during the Cultural Revolution, "Wen Gong Wu Wei" was proposed by Jiang Qing in 1967. It meant to attack with words (wen) and defend with force (wu), which in practice intensified violent struggles nationwide.

en: Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement

description.zh-cn: 文革期间，中华人民共和国在1960年代末至1970年代末组织了数千万知识青年被派往农村地区进行劳动，接受再教育的政治运动。这场运动导致了红卫兵运动的停止，习近平也曾参与其中。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the People's Republic of China organized a political movement from the late 1960s to the late 1970s, sending tens of millions of educated urban youth to rural areas for labor and re-education. This movement led to the cessation of the Red Guard movement, and Xi Jinping also participated.

description.zh-cn: 文革中期全国范围的政治清洗运动，造成大量冤假错案。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第九次全国代表大会
en: 9th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 在文革高潮中召开的中共全国代表大会，将林彪确立为毛泽东的接班人并写入党章。

location.zh-cn: 蒙古人民共和国温都尔汗

description.zh-cn: 1971年9月13日，中共中央副主席林彪及其家人乘坐256号三叉戟飞机，从海航五师所辖的山海关机场强行起飞，意图叛逃苏联。飞机在蒙古温都尔汗坠毁，机上人员全部遇难，标志着林彪集团的覆灭。此次政治事件对中国政局产生深远影响，梁兴初等人因此受到牵连。
description.en: On September 13, 1971, Lin Biao, Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, and his family forcibly took off from Shanhaiguan Airport, which was under the jurisdiction of the Naval Aviation 5th Division, in a Trident jet (No. 256), attempting to defect to the Soviet Union. The plane crashed in Öndörkhaan, Mongolia, killing everyone on board, marking the demise of the Lin Biao group. This political event had a profound impact on Chinese politics and implicated figures such as Liang Xingchu.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命后期，由毛泽东发动、江青等人积极推行的政治运动。名义上批判林彪和孔子，实则针对周恩来等人。

en: Criticize Deng and Counter the Right-Deviating Verdict-Reversing Wind
Criticize Deng and Counter-attack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Trend
Criticize Deng, Counter the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversing Wind
Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大革命末期由毛泽东发起的最后一次大规模政治运动，旨在批判邓小平在1975年推行的整顿政策，导致其第三次被打倒。
description.en: The last large-scale political movement of the Cultural Revolution in China, initiated by Mao Zedong to criticize the rectification policies implemented by Deng Xiaoping in 1975, which led to his third political downfall.

description.zh-cn: 1976年清明节期间，在北京天安门广场发生的，以悼念周恩来、抗议“四人帮”为主题的大规模群众自发抗议运动，后被定性为反革命事件。
description.en: A large-scale spontaneous mass protest movement that took place in Tiananmen Square, Beijing, during the Qingming Festival in 1976, centered on mourning Zhou Enlai and protesting the 'Gang of Four'. It was later characterized as a counter-revolutionary incident.

en: Arrest of the Gang of Four
Smashing of the Gang of Four

description.zh-cn: 1976年10月6日，由时任中共中央第一副主席华国锋、中共中央副主席叶剑英、中共中央办公厅主任汪东兴等人策划发动，在北京市中南海怀仁堂拘捕“四人帮”及其在北京的骨干成员的政治事件，标志着文化大革命的结束。
description.en: A political event planned by Hua Guofeng, then First Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, Ye Jianying, Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee, and Wang Dongxing, Director of the CCP General Office, to arrest the Gang of Four and their associates.

description.zh-cn: 拨乱反正，是指文化大革命结束后，由邓小平等人领导的，旨在纠正文革期间及以前“左倾”错误的思想、政治、组织、政策等一系列举措的统称。真理标准大讨论是其重要组成部分，为改革开放奠定了基础，并导致了陈永贵及其代表的政治路线的终结。《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》的通过，标志着中共在指导思想上完成了拨乱反正。
description.en: Boluan Fanzheng refers to a series of measures led by Deng Xiaoping and others after the Cultural Revolution, aimed at correcting 'leftist' errors in ideology, politics, organization, and policy during and before the Cultural Revolution. The discussion on the criterion for truth was a crucial part of it, laying the foundation for reform and opening up. This movement also led to the end of the political line represented by Chen Yonggui. The adoption of the 'Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China' marked the completion of the CPC's 'Boluan Fanzheng' in its guiding ideology.

description.zh-cn: 文革结束后，由邓小平倡导并启动，中华人民共和国于1978年12月中共十一届三中全会起推行的一项以经济建设为中心，对内改革、对外开放的社会经济政策与运动。真理标准大讨论奠定了思想基础，带来了思想解放。习仲勋是其重要的开拓者之一。期间，中国人民银行的职能发生重大转变。此政策也为后来的八六学潮提供了宏观背景。
description.en: Following the Cultural Revolution, initiated and advocated by Deng Xiaoping, this socio-economic policy and movement, focused on economic development, internal reform, and external opening, was implemented by the People's Republic of China starting in December 1978 at the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CCP. The 'Discussion on the Criterion for Truth' laid its ideological groundwork, fostering intellectual liberation. Xi Zhongxun was an important pioneer of this policy. During this period, the functions of the People's Bank of China underwent significant changes. This policy also provided the macro context for the later 1986 student demonstrations.

zh-cn: 林彪、江青反革命集团案
最高人民法院特别法庭
en: Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques
Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-Revolutionary Cliques
Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques
Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary cliques
Special Court of the Supreme People's Court
Trial of the Gang of Four and the Lin Biao Counter-Revolutionary Clique
Trial of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-Revolutionary Cliques
Trial of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民法院专门设立特别法庭，对林彪、江青两个反革命集团案的10名主犯进行公开审判。林彪集团和四人帮是文化大革命后，中华人民共和国政府对该反革命集团的官方称谓。
description.en: The Special Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China was specifically established for the public trial of the ten principal offenders from the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary cliques. The Lin Biao clique and the Gang of Four was the official designation by the PRC government for this counter-revolutionary group after the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 民主柬埔寨（红色高棉）时期，由柬埔寨红色高棉政权进行的大规模屠杀事件，受中国文革影响。
1968年5月在法国发生的一系列由学生领导的抗议活动和总罢工，工人阶级也积极参与其中。该事件受到中国文化大革命的影响，情境主义在其中扮演了重要的思想角色。
description.en: A series of student-led protests and general strikes that occurred in France in May 1968, with significant participation from the working class. The event was influenced by China's Cultural Revolution, and Situationism played a significant ideological role.

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国实际管辖的领土，不包括香港、澳门和台湾。这里是文化大革命发生的主要地点，也是亚洲东部的重要区域。柯文哲曾多次前往此地参加医学会议并传入叶克膜技术。
description.en: Refers to the territory under the actual jurisdiction of the People's Republic of China, excluding Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan. It was the main location where the Cultural Revolution took place and is also an important region in East Asia. Ko Wen-je traveled here multiple times for medical conferences and introduced ECMO technology.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会通知

description.zh-cn: 全称《中国共产党中央委员会通知》，是中共中央政治局扩大会议于1966年5月16日通过的纲领性文件，标志着文化大革命的全面发动。
description.en: Titled 'Circular of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China', this programmatic document was adopted by an enlarged meeting of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau on May 16, 1966, marking the full-scale launch of the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会关于无产阶级文化大革命的决定
en: Decision of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party on the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution
Decision of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party Concerning the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution

description.zh-cn: 简称“十六条”，是中共中央于1966年8月8日中共八届十一中全会通过的关于“文化大革命”的纲领性文件。它肯定了“破四旧”的目标，并赋予中央文革小组极大的权力。
description.en: Known as the 'Sixteen Articles', it is a programmatic document on the 'Cultural Revolution' passed by the Eleventh Plenary Session of the 8th Central Committee of the CCP on August 8, 1966. It affirmed the goal of 'Destroying the Four Olds' and granted immense power to the Central Cultural Revolution Group.

zh-cn: 评新编历史剧《海瑞罢官》
评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉
en: Commentary on the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'
On the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'
On the New Historical Play 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'

description.zh-cn: 由姚文元撰写的批判文章，被认为是文化大革命的导火索之一。

zh-cn: 关于当前学术讨论的汇报提纲

description.zh-cn: 全称《关于当前学术讨论的汇报提纲》，由彭真等人草拟，试图将对《海瑞罢官》的批判局限于学术范围，后被撤销。由彭真主持的文化革命五人小组起草的报告提纲，试图将学术批判限制在学术范围内，后遭毛泽东严厉批评。

zh-cn: 炮打司令部——我的一张大字报
en: Bombard the Headquarters — My Big-Character Poster

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东撰写，矛头直指刘少奇和邓小平。

zh-cn: 关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议
en: Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party since the Founding of the People's Republic of China
Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1981年6月27日，由中国共产党第十一届中央委员会第六次全体会议通过的历史决议，是中共中央对中华人民共和国建国以来的若干重大历史问题（特别是文化大革命）及重要历史人物（如毛泽东）作出的官方定论文件和总结评价。该决议全面否定文化大革命，并对毛泽东的功过进行了评价，认定他在文革中犯有严重错误。该决议是“拨乱反正”运动的一部分，标志着中国共产党在指导思想上的“拨乱反正”的完成。
description.en: Passed on June 27, 1981, by the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, this historical resolution is the official document from the CPC Central Committee that provides definitive conclusions and summary evaluations of major historical issues (especially the Cultural Revolution) and important historical figures (such as Mao Zedong) since the founding of the People's Republic of China. It fully repudiated the Cultural Revolution, evaluated Mao Zedong's merits and demerits, and concluded that he made serious errors during it. This resolution was part of the 'Boluan Fanzheng' movement, marking the completion of this process in terms of the Party's guiding ideology.

zh-cn: 约瑟夫·维萨里奥诺维奇·斯大林

description.zh-cn: 苏联最高领导人，长期任苏共中央总书记和苏联部长会议主席。他强烈支持金日成成为朝鲜最高领导人。其领导共产国际的政策被陈独秀视为1927年中国大革命失败主因。二战时作为同盟国“三巨头”之一，承诺对日作战，苏联出兵对日本投降影响重大。为扩大东亚影响力，他与中国签订新同盟条约并助建人民大学。其主导政策被认为是乌克兰大饥荒的直接原因。他的著作《苏联社会主义经济问题》曾被孙冶方系统性质疑。赫鲁晓夫对其的全盘否定，是中苏论战及文革的重要背景。
description.en: Soviet supreme leader, who served for a long time as General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and Chairman of the Council of Ministers. He strongly supported Kim Il-sung to become the supreme leader of North Korea. His leadership and policies regarding the Comintern were considered by Chen Duxiu as a major cause for the failure of the 1927 Chinese Revolution. During World War II, as one of the 'Big Three' Allied leaders, he promised to enter the war against Japan, and the Soviet intervention significantly impacted Japan's surrender. To expand influence in East Asia, he signed a new alliance treaty with China and helped establish Renmin University. His dominant policies are considered the direct cause of the Holodomor in Ukraine. His work 'Economic Problems of Socialism in the USSR' was systematically questioned by Sun Yefang. Khrushchev's complete repudiation of him was an important background for the Sino-Soviet split and the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 关于个人崇拜及其后果
赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上的秘密报告
en: On the Cult of Personality and Its Consequences

description.zh-cn: 由时任苏共中央第一书记赫鲁晓夫在苏联共产党第二十次代表大会上发表的演说，批判了前任领导人斯大林的个人崇拜和严重错误，开启了“去斯大林化”和“赫鲁晓夫解冻”时期。该报告对国际共产主义运动产生了深远影响，并深刻影响了毛泽东。
description.en: A speech delivered by then First Secretary of the CPSU Nikita Khrushchev at the 20th Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. The report criticized the personality cult and grave errors of his predecessor Joseph Stalin, initiating the period of 'de-Stalinization' and the 'Khrushchev Thaw.' It had a profound impact on the international communist movement, and particularly on Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命前夕对彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆等人的政治清洗运动，他们被打成“反党集团”。
description.en: A political purge against Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun on the eve of the Cultural Revolution, in which they were labeled an 'anti-Party clique'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会
中国共产党中央执行委员会
en: Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Central Executive Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会于1927年由中央执行委员会改组而来，是党的最高领导机构和中央权力机关。它通过全国代表大会选举产生中央政治局、常务委员会和总书记。该机构曾参与中日建交决策，发布大串连通知，于1947年批准公布《中国土地法大纲》，1979年为《刘志丹》案平反，2002年批准神舟五号飞行方案。此外，它还设立并管理中央外事小组及中央外事工作领导小组及其办公室。
description.en: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, restructured in 1927 from the Central Executive Committee, serves as the Party's highest leading body and central authority. It elects the Political Bureau, its Standing Committee, and the General Secretary through the National Congress. This body has participated in decision-making for Japan-China relations, issued notices regarding the Great Networking movement, approved and promulgated the 'Outline Land Law of China' in 1947, rehabilitated the 'Liu Zhidan' case in 1979, and approved the flight plan for Shenzhou 5 in 2002. Furthermore, it established and manages the Central Foreign Affairs Small Group and the Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs, along with their respective offices.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东领导的中国共产党在中华人民共和国发动的政治、经济及社会运动，旨在利用国家行政力量，通过农业和工业的平行增长，快速实现工业化和集体化，将国家从以农业为主的经济体转型成为一个现代化的共产主义社会，并试图实现超英赶美的目标。运动包括大炼钢铁、人民公社化等。期间，钱学森曾发表文章论证“亩产万斤”的可能性，对运动产生影响。然而，这场脱离现实的“跃进”最终导致了严重的经济困难、环境破坏和大饥荒，是三年困难时期的主要原因之一。
description.en: A political, economic, and social movement initiated by Mao Zedong and the Chinese Communist Party in the People's Republic of China. It aimed to rapidly industrialize and collectivize the country, transforming it from an agrarian economy into a modern communist society by utilizing state administrative power and achieving parallel growth in agriculture and industry, with the goal of surpassing the UK and US. Key components included the Great Steel Smelting and the People's Communes. During this period, Qian Xuesen published an article arguing for the possibility of '10,000 jin per mu' yields, which influenced the movement. However, this unrealistic 'Great Leap Forward' ultimately led to severe economic difficulties, environmental damage, and a great famine, being one of the main causes of the Three Years of Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 1957年至1958年在中国大陆由毛泽东发起的一场政治运动，旨在针对知识分子、党内不同意见者和民主党派，反对资产阶级右派。运动导致大批农工党党员等被划为右派。该运动对知识分子造成极大打击，破坏了民主制度，并为之后的大跃进埋下祸根。在此期间，杨文渭因受批判迫害而自杀。
description.en: A political movement launched by Mao Zedong in mainland China from 1957 to 1958, targeting intellectuals, dissidents within the party, and democratic parties, aimed at opposing bourgeois rightists. The movement resulted in a large number of members of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party, among others, being labeled as rightists. This campaign dealt a severe blow to intellectuals, undermined the democratic system, and sowed the seeds for the subsequent Great Leap Forward. During this period, Yang Wenwei committed suicide due to persecution and criticism.

description.zh-cn: 阶级斗争是马克思主义的核心概念之一，指社会阶级之间因利益对立而产生的冲突，认为人类社会的历史通过阶级间的对立和斗争实现。在中国文化大革命时期，它被视为核心理论和实践。情境主义国际曾主张将其转换为“日常生活的革命”。
description.en: Class struggle is one of Marxism's core concepts, referring to the conflict of interests between social classes, positing that human history is realized through class opposition and struggle. It was considered a core theory and practice during China's Cultural Revolution. The Situationist International advocated for its transformation into the 'revolution of everyday life'.

description.zh-cn: 中共八大元老之一，中国政治家、经济管理家，中国共产党和中华人民共和国第一、二代中央领导集体重要成员及主要领导人之一，陈元之父。他曾任重工业部部长、国务院副总理、中纪委第一书记、第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。1948年当选为中华全国总工会主席。后接替邓小平担任中共中央顾问委员会第二任主任，并主张在中共十四大后废除中顾委。他支持关于真理标准问题的讨论，在大饥荒后支持“三自一包”等经济调整政策，并以实际退休支持废除领导职务终身制。文革中被下放。六四事件中，他是保守派代表，支持对学生运动采取强硬措施，并曾推荐和保护李锐。
description.en: One of the Eight Elders of the CPC, a Chinese politician and economic administrator, an important and main member of the first and second generation central leadership collectives of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and the father of Chen Yuan. He served as Minister of Heavy Industry, Vice Premier of the State Council, First Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. In 1948, he was elected Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions. He later succeeded Deng Xiaoping as the second Director of the Central Advisory Commission and advocated for its abolition after the 14th National Congress of the CPC. He supported the discussion on the criterion of truth, and after the Great Famine, he supported economic adjustment policies such as 'Sanzi Yibao' and advocated for the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions by his own retirement. He was sent down during the Cultural Revolution. During the June Fourth Incident, he was a conservative representative, supporting strong measures against student movements, and also recommended and protected Li Rui.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东发动文革时提出的需要防止的政治趋向。
“走资本主义道路的当权派”的简称，是文革中用于攻击党政领导干部的罪名。

en: Eight Elders of the Communist Party of China
Eight Great Eminent Officials of the CCP

description.zh-cn: 指在1980年代至1990年代间，在中国共产党第一代领导集体退下后，以邓小平为首，在中华人民共和国政治决策中拥有实际最高决策权并主导中国政治的一批中国共产党元老。这批人通常被认为是八位或更多位中国共产党、中华人民共和国、中国人民解放军的元老。其中，许多人曾反对胡耀邦的改革，习仲勋也是其中之一。
description.en: Refers to a group of veteran members of the Communist Party of China who, led by Deng Xiaoping, held actual supreme decision-making power and dominated Chinese politics in the People's Republic of China during the 1980s and 1990s, after the first generation of CPC leadership stepped down. This group is often referred to as eight or more veterans of the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China, and the People's Liberation Army. Many among them opposed Hu Yaobang's reforms, and Xi Zhongxun was one of them.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间摧毁公安、检察、法院体系的口号和行动。
文革期间对毛泽东的个人崇拜达到顶峰。

zh-cn: 工人、解放军毛泽东思想宣传队
首都工人毛泽东思想宣传队
en: Worker-PLA Mao Zedong Thought Propaganda Team

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，毛泽东派遣由工农兵组成的宣传队伍，进驻学校等各单位以制止武斗、领导“斗、批、改”。1968年7月27日进驻清华大学，与学生发生冲突，引发“七·二七事件”。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Mao Zedong dispatched propaganda teams composed of workers, peasants, and soldiers to schools and other units to stop armed struggles and lead the 'Struggle-Criticism-Transformation' campaign. They entered Tsinghua University on July 27, 1968, clashed with students, triggering the 'July 27 Incident'.

zh-cn: 第四届全国人民代表大会
第四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议

description.zh-cn: 1975年1月13日至17日，第四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议在北京召开，通过了《七五宪法》。会议于1月17日选举产生了第四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会组成人员，会后全国人大常委会机关恢复办公。
description.en: The First Session of the 4th National People's Congress was held in Beijing from January 13 to 17, 1975, adopting the '75 Constitution. On January 17, members of the Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress were elected. Following the session, the administrative bodies of the NPC Standing Committee resumed operations.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1975年)
en: 1975 Constitution of the People's Republic of China
Constitution of the People's Republic of China (1975)

description.zh-cn: 简称“七五宪法”，将文革的理论和实践写入宪法。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1978年)
en: Constitution of the People's Republic of China (1978)

description.zh-cn: 简称“七八宪法”。
毛泽东思想理论体系，以毛泽东的名字命名，是中国共产党的指导思想之一，也是由毛泽东发展的马克思列宁主义理论。它由以毛泽东为主要代表的中国共产党人，总结中国长期革命和建设实践经验而形成。其活的灵魂包括实事求是、群众路线、独立自主。马克龙曾在采访中自称为“毛泽东主义者”。
description.en: Mao Zedong Thought, named after Mao Zedong, is one of the guiding ideologies of the Communist Party of China, and a variant of Marxism–Leninism developed by Mao Zedong. It was formed by Chinese Communists, with Mao Zedong as their main representative, who summarized the experiences from China's long-term revolution and construction practices. Its living soul includes seeking truth from facts, the mass line, and independence. Macron described himself as a 'Maoist' in an interview.

description.zh-cn: 指“大鸣、大放、大字报、大辩论”，文革中主要的群众斗争形式。
文化大革命期间在广西壮族自治区发生的一系列系统性大屠杀，并伴有食人事件。
description.en: A series of systematic massacres that occurred in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution, accompanied by incidents of cannibalism.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间在内蒙古自治区发生的大规模冤假错案，具体指对内蒙古人民革命党进行的大规模政治清洗和屠杀。
description.en: A large-scale case of wrongful convictions that occurred in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间在广东发生的系统性大屠杀。
文革期间在云南发生的系统性大屠杀。
以道县大屠杀为代表的文革期间湖南发生的大屠杀。
吴晗创作的历史剧，对该剧的批判成为文革的导火索。

location.zh-cn: 北京怀仁堂和京西宾馆

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，中共元老们在北京怀仁堂和京西宾馆会议上，对中央文革小组的错误做法和混乱局势进行了抵制、抗争和公开批评。这场重要的政治斗争后被诬陷为“二月逆流”。李富春和叶剑英是该事件的主要参与者。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, veteran CCP leaders resisted, protested, and openly criticized the erroneous practices and chaotic situation of the Central Cultural Revolution Group at meetings in Huairentang and the Jingxi Hotel. This significant political struggle was later framed as the 'February Countercurrent'. Li Fuchun and Ye Jianying were among its main participants.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，革命家、军事家、外交家，中华人民共和国开国元帅。他曾任红三军政治委员、新四军军长、山东军区司令员、在鲁南战役中任山东野战军司令员、华东军区及华东野战军司令员、上海市市长、国务院副总理兼外交部部长，并担任首任中央外事小组组长和国务院外事办公室主任。他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地，在“二月逆流”中反对文革，并长期担任粟裕的直接领导和政治搭档。其担任外交部长期间，曾提出“核裤论”并引发《明报》批评。
description.en: Chen Yi was one of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a revolutionary, military strategist, and diplomat, and a founding Marshal of the PRC. He served as Political Commissar of the Third Red Army, Commander of the New Fourth Army, Commander of the Shandong Military Region, Commander of the Shandong Field Army during the Lunan Campaign, Commander of the East China Military Region and East China Field Army, Mayor of Shanghai, Vice Premier of the State Council and Minister of Foreign Affairs. He was also the first leader of the Central Foreign Affairs Small Group and Director of the State Council Foreign Affairs Office. He participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base, opposed the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent', and was a long-term direct leader and political partner of Su Yu. During his tenure as Foreign Minister, his 'nuclear weapons over pants' theory drew criticism from Ming Pao.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党革命家、高级领导人，中国人民解放军高级将领，中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任红十二军政治委员、国务院副总理，并担任第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。他在“二月逆流”中反对文化大革命。
description.en: A Chinese Communist revolutionary and senior leader, a high-ranking general of the People's Liberation Army, and a politician of the People's Republic of China. He served as Political Commissar of the Twelfth Red Army, a Vice Premier of the State Council, and Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He opposed the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于1955年授予建国元勋的最高军衔。
因毛泽东将芒果转赠给工宣队而引发的对芒果的崇拜现象。

习仲勋是中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要政治人物、领导人之一，陕甘边区革命根据地、两当兵变的主要创建者和领导者之一，也是中国改革开放事业重要的开拓者。他曾任西北野战军副政委、国务院副总理等职，被列为中共八大元老之一。他以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。1962年因审阅小说《刘志丹》手稿遭受长期迫害。后任中共广东省委第一书记，建议在深圳等地建立“贸易合作区”。他是胡耀邦的朋友，并在其被迫辞职时为他辩护。他是习近平和齐桥桥的父亲。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun was a former key political figure and leader in the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He was one of the main founders and leaders of the Shaan-Gan Border Revolutionary Base Area and the Liangdang Mutiny, and an important pioneer of China's reform and opening-up. He served as Deputy Political Commissar of the Northwest Field Army and Vice Premier of the State Council, and was listed as one of the Eight Elders of the CPC. He notably supported the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions through his actual retirement. In 1962, he was persecuted for reviewing the novel 'Liu Zhidan.' Later, as First Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, he proposed 'trade cooperation zones' in Shenzhen. He was a friend of Hu Yaobang and defended him during Hu's forced resignation. He is the father of Xi Jinping and Qi Qiaoqiao.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省忻州直隶州定襄县蒋村
birth_place.en: Jiang Village, Dingxiang County, Xinzhou Prefecture, Shanxi Province

death_place.en: Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，开国元勋，原副国级领导人，邓小平主政时期的中共八大元老之一。他曾任国务院副总理、中央顾问委员会常务副主任（长期主持日常工作）、中央人民政府财政部部长、国家经委主任，并为“十人小组”负责人。作为中国共产党和中华人民共和国的第一、二、三代主要领导人之一，他曾是“六十一人叛徒集团案”主要受害者，在文化大革命中被打倒监禁。他以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制，是薄熙来和薄小莹的父亲。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party and People's Republic of China political figure, a founding father of the PRC, and a former deputy national leader. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP during Deng Xiaoping's administration. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council, Executive Deputy Director of the Central Advisory Commission (presiding over its daily work for a long time), Minister of Finance of the Central People's Government, and Director of the State Economic Commission, also heading the 'Group of Ten'. As one of the main leaders of the first, second, and third generations of the CCP and PRC, he was a principal victim of the 'Case of the 61 Renegades' and was imprisoned during the Cultural Revolution. He supported the abolition of lifelong tenure for leading positions through his own retirement, and was the father of Bo Xilai and Bo Xiaoying.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国是自1949年起由中国共产党执政的东亚社会主义国家。建国初期派遣中国人民志愿军参与朝鲜战争，1979年与美国建交。其历史包含“文革”等挫折。外交上，1970-80年代初实行“一条线、一大片”战略；曾支持北越，后与统一后的越南发生边境战争，并在黎笋时期关系紧张。它实现载人航天，1997年恢复对香港主权，成为金砖国家创始成员。其曾因台湾海峡军演、网络审查、支持俄罗斯、压制异见等引争议，将突厥斯坦伊斯兰党视为主要恐怖威胁。
description.en: The People's Republic of China is an East Asian socialist country governed by the Chinese Communist Party since 1949. In its early years, it dispatched the Chinese People's Volunteer Army to participate in the Korean War and established diplomatic relations with the US in 1979. Its history includes setbacks like the 'Cultural Revolution'. In diplomacy, it implemented the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy from the early 1970s to the early 1980s; it supported North Vietnam, later fought a border war with the reunified Vietnam, and had tense relations during Lê Duẩn's rule. It achieved human spaceflight, resumed Hong Kong sovereignty in 1997, and became a founding member of BRICS. It has also faced controversies such as military exercises in the Taiwan Strait, internet censorship, support for Russia, and suppression of dissent, and considers the Turkistan Islamic Party a major terrorist threat.

location.zh-cn: 中国大陆及台湾海峡沿岸岛屿

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党与中国共产党之间为争夺中国执政权而爆发的内战，亦称第二次国共内战，是国共内战的第二个阶段。该内战始于1945年抗日战争结束，至1950年以中国共产党取得决定性胜利、中华人民共和国成立和中华民国政府迁台告终。在此期间，中国共产党在其控制的“解放区”内推行土地改革。石双琪、吴烈曾指挥部队或率民兵支援前线，孙殿英在此战争中被解放军俘虏，于永波也作为中共军队的一员参加了此战争。
description.en: The Chinese Civil War, also known as the Second Chinese Civil War, was a conflict fought between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party of China for control of China's governing power. It was the second phase of the civil war, commencing after the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War in 1945, and concluding around 1950 with the decisive victory of the Chinese Communist Party, the establishment of the People's Republic of China, and the retreat of the Republic of China government to Taiwan. During this period, the Communist Party of China implemented land reform in its controlled 'liberated areas'. Shi Shuangqi and Wu Lie commanded troops or led militia regiments to support the front lines, Sun Dianying was captured by the People's Liberation Army during this war, and Yu Yongbo also participated as a member of the CCP's armed forces.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立典礼
中华人民共和国开国大典
en: Proclamation of the People's Republic of China
The Proclamation of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立的典礼，标志着中华人民共和国的成立。自此，中国开始建立现行的省级行政区划体系。
description.en: The ceremony marking the establishment of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, an event that marked the founding of the People's Republic of China. Following this, the current system of provincial-level administrative divisions began to be established.

description.zh-cn: 1989年4月中旬，由胡耀邦去世引发的、高校学生发起的民主示威运动，持续近两个月，广义上波及中华人民共和国全境，狭义上特指发生在北京天安门广场的示威及随后于6月4日凌晨的武力清场。清华大学有大量学生参与，并有学生在事件中伤亡。这场政治风波导致时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳被撤职，第一代团派势力遭到清洗，深刻影响了多位人物的政治立场与个人命运，八六学潮被认为是其前奏。此事件也催生了《李鹏下台嵌字诗》。
description.en: Beginning in mid-April 1989, student-led pro-democracy demonstrations, triggered by the death of Hu Yaobang, lasted nearly two months, broadly affecting the entire People's Republic of China, and specifically referring to the protests in Beijing's Tiananmen Square and the subsequent military crackdown on the morning of June 4. A large number of Tsinghua University students participated, with some killed or injured. This political turmoil led to the dismissal of then CPC General Secretary Zhao Ziyang and the purge of the first-generation Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), profoundly influencing the political stances and personal fates of many figures. The 1986 student demonstrations are considered its precursor. This event also served as the direct context for the creation of the 'Li Peng step down acrostic poem'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，78级大学生，现任中华人民共和国国务院总理。在中共二十届一中全会后成为排名第二的中共中央政治局常委。曾任中共上海市委书记、浙江省省长（蔡奇曾任其副手），以及中共江苏省委书记。吴政隆现任其国务院秘书长，此前曾任江苏省省长。据报道，他曾说服马云回国。
description.en: Chinese politician, a member of the Class of 1978, currently serving as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China. He became the second-ranked member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee after the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee. He previously served as Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, Governor of Zhejiang Province (where Cai Qi served as his deputy), and Party Secretary of Jiangsu Province. Wu Zhenglong now serves as his Secretary-General in the State Council, having previously served as Governor of Jiangsu. He reportedly persuaded Jack Ma to return to China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中国共产党高级领导人。现任全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长、中共中央政治局常委，并与蔡奇同为中央国家安全委员会副主席。曾任中共中央纪委书记、中共中央组织部部长、中共青海省委书记、中共陕西省委书记等职。与弟弟赵乐秦并称“陕西二赵”。
description.en: Chinese politician and a high-ranking leader of the Communist Party of China. He currently serves as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, and serves alongside Cai Qi as a Vice Chairman of the Central National Security Commission. His former roles include Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, Party Secretary of Qinghai Province, and Party Secretary of Shaanxi Province. He and his brother Zhao Leqin are known as the 'Two Zhaos of Shaanxi'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国主要领导人之一，中国共产党中央政治局常委。现任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席（接替汪洋），曾任中央书记处第一书记（蔡奇的前任），并担任中共二十大秘书长。他也是一名78级研究生，与何毅亭、江金权并称为习近平的文胆。
description.en: Chinese politician, one of the principal leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He is currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (succeeding Wang Yang). He previously served as First Secretary of the Central Secretariat (predecessor to Cai Qi) and Secretary-General of the 20th CPC National Congress. He was also a postgraduate student of the Class of 1978, and is known as one of Xi Jinping's key advisors, along with He Yiting and Jiang Jinquan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国首都，亦是东京都的姊妹友好都市。曾为明清两朝都城，1644年被李自成攻陷，1860年遭英法联军占领。中央军委联合参谋部和公安部交通管理局均设于此。叶剑英、华国锋、周恩来、毛泽东、范维唐等多人在此逝世；成克杰被执行死刑。屠呦呦曾在此居住工作，项子明、艾未未、魏京生、黎明等在此出生。它也是六四戒严事件主要发生地，中国科学技术大学、清华大学等知名高校均坐落于此。
description.en: The capital of the People's Republic of China and a sister city of Tokyo Metropolis. It historically served as the capital of the Ming and Qing dynasties, captured by Li Zicheng in 1644 and occupied by Anglo-French forces in 1860. It is home to the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission and the Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security. Many historical figures, including Ye Jianying, Hua Guofeng, Zhou Enlai, Mao Zedong, and Fan Weitang, passed away here; Cheng Kejie was executed. Tu Youyou resided and worked here, while Xiang Ziming, Ai Weiwei, Wei Jingsheng, and Leon Lai were born here. It was also a primary site of the June Fourth crackdown event, and is home to prestigious universities such as the University of Science and Technology of China and Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国直辖市，中国人口最多的城市，也是国家的经济、金融、贸易、航运、商业、上游制造和对外开放中心。它是新开发银行总部所在地，曾是根据《南京条约》开放的五个通商口岸之一。此外，它还是中国农工民主党前身中国国民党临时行动委员会的成立地，李克强的逝世地、向忠发被处决的地点，以及陈良宇、王家卫、陈子明和郑和（1958年生）的出生地，也是陈良宇主要政治生涯所在地。
description.en: A direct-administered municipality of the People's Republic of China and the country's most populous city, Shanghai serves as a national center for economy, finance, trade, shipping, commerce, upstream manufacturing, and opening up. It is the headquarters of the New Development Bank and was one of the five treaty ports opened under the Treaty of Nanking. Furthermore, it is notable as the founding place of the Provisional Action Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang (predecessor of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party), the site where Li Keqiang passed away and Xiang Zhongfa was executed, and the birthplace of figures like Chen Liangyu, Wong Kar-wai, Chen Ziming, and Zheng He (born 1958), as well as the main location of Chen Liangyu's political career.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市西城区人民大会堂

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家权力机关和国家立法机关，负责选举和罢免最高人民法院院长。
中华人民共和国的省级特别行政区，实行一国两制和高度自治。它与深圳相邻，是全球重要的国际金融、贸易和航运中心。这里是著名作家古龙的出生地，仓颉输入法在此地非常普及，也是四朵金花组合、叶蒨文演艺事业的主要发展和活跃地点，且邓亮洪曾在此流亡。同时，它也是潘晓颖与陈同佳的居住地，潘晓颖命案曾在此引发政治争议。
description.en: A provincial special administrative region of the People's Republic of China, practicing 'one country, two systems' and a high degree of autonomy. Bordering Shenzhen, it is a vital international financial, trade, and shipping center. It is the birthplace of renowned writer Gu Long, where the Cangjie input method is very popular, the origin and main area of activity for the Four Golden Flowers and Sally Yeh's entertainment career, and where Tang Liang Hong once lived in exile. It is also the place of residence for Poon Hiu-wing and Chan Tong-kai, where the Poon Hiu-wing murder case sparked political controversy.

description.zh-cn: 1919年5月4日发生于中国北京的爱国运动，以青年学生为主体，广泛吸引了包括朱自清、张太雷在内的公民、市民和工商人士参与。这场反帝反封建运动，形式涵盖示威、请愿、罢课、罢工及暴力对抗政府。其爆发源于巴黎和会山东问题及北洋政府外交失败。学生们尤其针对章宗祥、曹汝霖、陆宗舆等亲日官员。运动最终迫使北洋政府拒签《凡尔赛条约》并罢免亲日官员，对中国近代史影响深远，推动了新文化运动，使西学思想深入，并影响了如柯仲平等人的早期思想。
description.en: A patriotic, anti-imperialist and anti-feudal movement that took place in Beijing, China, on May 4, 1919. Primarily led by young students, it also saw broad participation from citizens, merchants, and other social strata, including notably Zhu Ziqing and Zhang Tailei. The movement encompassed demonstrations, petitions, student and worker strikes, and violent confrontations with the government. It erupted due to the Shandong question at the Paris Peace Conference and the Beiyang government's diplomatic failure. Students specifically targeted pro-Japanese officials like Zhang Zongxiang, Cao Rulin, and Lu Zongyu. The movement ultimately compelled the Beiyang government to refuse to sign the Treaty of Versailles and dismiss these pro-Japanese officials, profoundly impacting modern Chinese history, advancing the New Culture Movement, deepening the reception of Western thought, and influencing the early ideas of figures like Ke Zhongping.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党与中国共产党之间爆发的内战，是国共内战的第一阶段。它始于1927年南昌起义，标志着国共分裂后的武装冲突全面爆发。内战最终于1937年西安事变后，随着第二次国共合作的建立而结束。黄公略是中共方面的高级将领。
description.en: The civil war fought between the Kuomintang and the Chinese Communist Party, marking the first phase of the Chinese Civil War. It began with the Nanchang Uprising in 1927, signifying the full-scale outbreak of armed conflict after the KMT-CCP split. The war ultimately concluded in 1937, with the establishment of the Second United Front following the Xi'an Incident. Huang Gonglue was a senior commander on the CCP side.

zh-cn: 中华苏维埃人民共和国
中华苏维埃共和国中央执行委员会
中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府
en: Central Executive Committee of the Chinese Soviet Republic

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在第一次国共内战期间，于其革命根据地建立的苏维埃政权。该政权在苏联和共产国际的支持下，主张推翻国民政府，实现社会主义和共产主义。向忠发曾提名毛泽东担任其临时中央政府主席。
description.en: A soviet regime established by the Chinese Communist Party in its revolutionary base areas during the First KMT-CCP Civil War. With the support of the Soviet Union and the Comintern, the regime advocated for overthrowing the Nationalist Government to achieve socialism and communism. Xiang Zhongfa once nominated Mao Zedong to serve as the chairman of its provisional central government.

description.zh-cn: 第一次国共内战期间，中国共产党领导的中国工农红军主力被迫退出中央苏区，从长江以南各革命根据地向陕甘革命根据地进行的一次重要大规模战略转移。红一军团、毛泽民（负责后勤）、李富春、余秋里（随红二、六军团）、吴烈（随中央红军）等参与此次行动，中国工农红军通信学校也随军行动。其精神和形式在全国大串连中被部分红卫兵效仿。
description.en: During the First KMT-CPC Civil War, the main force of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, led by the Communist Party of China, was forced to withdraw from the Central Soviet Area, undertaking a massive strategic transfer from revolutionary bases south of the Yangtze River to the Shaan-Gan Revolutionary Base. The Red First Army Group, along with Mao Zemin (responsible for logistical supplies), Li Fuchun, Yu Qiuli (with the Second and Sixth Army Corps), and Wu Lie (with the Central Red Army), participated in this movement, and the Red Army Communication School also moved with the army. Its spirit and form were later emulated by some Red Guards during the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，中国国民党与中国共产党在西安事变后形成的第二次合作，停止内战，共同抵抗日本侵略的统一战线。
description.en: The second cooperation between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party of China during the Anti-Japanese War, formed after the Xi'an Incident, wherein they suspended the civil war and jointly resisted the Japanese invasion as a united front.

zh-cn: 国家社会主义中华劳工党党卫队

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在第二次国共内战时期的主要武装力量，由中国工农红军、八路军和新四军改编而来。后成为中华人民共和国的主要国家武装力量，建军节定于8月1日以纪念南昌起义。该部队曾计划进攻台湾，后因朝鲜战争，其部分部队改编为中国人民志愿军参战。该部队也曾执行六四戒严和清场任务，并在1998年洪灾期间成为抗洪抢险的中坚力量。倪匡年轻时曾加入其华东公安部队。
description.en: The main armed force of the Chinese Communist Party during the Second Chinese Civil War, reorganized from the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, Eighth Route Army, and New Fourth Army. It later became the primary national armed force of the People's Republic of China, with its Army Day set on August 1 to commemorate the Nanchang Uprising. This force had planned to attack Taiwan; subsequently, due to the Korean War, some of its units were reorganized as the Chinese People's Volunteer Army to participate in the conflict. The force also carried out martial law and clearing operations on June Fourth, and became the backbone of flood fighting and rescue during the 1998 floods. Ni Kuang joined its East China Public Security Force in his youth.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国土地改革法
en: Land Reform Law of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在解放区及中华人民共和国建国初期（1946-1953年），由毛泽东等高层主导，在中国大陆进行的土地所有制改革运动。1950年6月，颁布法律为全国范围的土地改革提供了法律依据，旨在废除地主阶级的土地所有制，实行农民的土地所有制，解放农村生产力，发展农业，为工业化开辟道路。该运动也导致了大量暴力事件和人口死亡，并彻底改变了中国农村的社会结构。
description.en: A land ownership reform movement conducted by the Communist Party of China in the liberated areas and in the early days of the People's Republic of China (1946-1953), led by Mao Zedong and other high-ranking officials in mainland China. In June 1950, a law was promulgated, providing the legal basis for implementing land reform nationwide. The movement aimed to abolish the landlord class's land ownership, implement peasant land ownership, liberate rural productive forces, develop agricultural production, and pave the way for industrialization. It also led to extensive violence and numerous deaths, fundamentally changing the social structure of rural China.

description.zh-cn: 1950年至1953年间在朝鲜半岛爆发的战争。它是朝鲜民主主义人民共和国与大韩民国之间的军事冲突，一方为朝鲜、中国人民志愿军，另一方为韩国、美国领导的联合国军（含美国第七舰队）。此战作为冷战时期区域性冲突，导致美国介入台湾海峡阻止解放军攻台，并持续影响战后局势。战争最终以《朝鲜停战协定》签署告终，未签订和平条约。毛泽东认为，中国此战表现赢得了苏联信任，从而获得更多援助与合作。于永波曾作为中国人民志愿军一员参与此战。
description.en: A war fought on the Korean Peninsula from 1950 to 1953. It was a military conflict between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Republic of Korea. On one side were North Korea and the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, and on the other were South Korea and a United Nations force led by the United States (including the U.S. Seventh Fleet). This conflict, a regional clash during the Cold War, led to U.S. intervention in the Taiwan Strait, preventing the PLA's plan to invade Taiwan, and continued to influence the region's post-war situation. The war ended with the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement, but no peace treaty was signed. Mao Zedong believed that China's performance in this war won the trust of the Soviet Union, leading to more aid and cooperation. Yu Yongbo participated in this war as a member of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 一个由主权国家组成的全球性国际政府间组织，于二战后成立，旨在促进国际合作、防止未来冲突。加拿大是其创始国之一，美国总统罗斯福是其关键推动者。自1971年联合国大会第2758号决议通过后，由中华人民共和国政府代表“中国”席位。慕沙希淡曾担任马来西亚驻该组织的代表。其大会多次通过决议谴责俄罗斯的入侵行为。
description.en: A global international intergovernmental organization composed of sovereign states, founded after World War II, aiming to promote international cooperation and prevent future conflicts. Canada was one of its founding members, and U.S. President Roosevelt was a key proponent. Since the passage of UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 in 1971, the 'China' seat has been represented by the government of the People's Republic of China. Musa Hitam once served as Malaysia's representative to the organization. Its General Assembly has passed multiple resolutions condemning Russia's invasion.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民是中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人，1989年至2002年中国的实际最高领导人，中共第三代中央领导集体核心。他曾任上海市委书记，六四后接任中共中央总书记、国家主席和中央军委主席，并曾担任中央国家安全工作领导小组组长。主政期间，他延续废除干部终身制，提出985工程，并在1998年特大洪水期间指挥抗洪救灾。他曾为中国科学技术大学四十周年校庆题词，并于1999年7月主导了对法轮功的全面镇压。卸任总书记和国家主席后，他仍任中央军委主席。
description.en: Jiang Zemin was a former major leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and China's paramount leader from 1989 to 2002, serving as the core figure of the CCP's third generation of central leadership. He served as Shanghai Party Secretary, and after the June Fourth incident, succeeded as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the PRC, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He also served as the leader of the Central Leading Group for National Security Affairs. During his tenure, he continued the abolition of lifelong tenure for cadres, proposed the '985 Project', and led flood relief efforts during the severe floods of 1998. He wrote an inscription for the 40th anniversary of the University of Science and Technology of China and in July 1999, he led a full-scale suppression of Falun Gong. After stepping down as General Secretary and President, he remained Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 1992年1月至2月，邓小平巡视中国南方城市（包括武昌、深圳、珠海、上海等地），并发表了一系列重要讲话，即著名的“南方谈话”。这些讲话对推动中国改革开放具有深远意义，不仅重新启动了因六四事件而停滞的改革进程，也深化了改革开放，对中国经济改革与发展产生了重要影响。
