description.en: From January to February 1992, Deng Xiaoping toured Southern Chinese cities (including Wuchang, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, and Shanghai), delivering a series of vital speeches, famously known as the 'Southern Tour speeches'. These remarks held profound significance for China's reform and opening-up, effectively restarting the stalled reform process after the Tiananmen Square incident and deepening it, thus profoundly impacting China's economic reform and development.

description.zh-cn: 负责监管国家之间贸易规则，并监督成员经济体之间执行各项贸易协定的国际组织。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization that regulates and facilitates international trade.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛，中国共产党第四代主要领导人、中央领导集体核心人物、第二代团派核心。他于2002年至2012年任中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席，系习近平前任，清华大学1965届校友。任期内，他曾任命马凯为国家发改委主任，亲临神舟五号发射，颁布《治安管理处罚法》，主持调查陈良宇，为胡耀邦平反。何毅亭曾多次陪同其外出调研。2012年，胡锦涛卸任所有党政军职务，实现“裸退”，完善了废除干部领导职务终身制的实践。
description.en: Hu Jintao, the fourth-generation paramount leader of the Communist Party of China, a core figure of its central leadership, and the core of the second-generation Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). From 2002 to 2012, he served as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He preceded Xi Jinping and is an alumnus of Tsinghua University's class of 1965. During his tenure, he appointed Ma Kai as the Director of the NDRC, personally attended the launch of Shenzhou 5, promulgated the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law,' presided over the investigation of Chen Liangyu, and rehabilitated Hu Yaobang. He Yiting accompanied him on several inspection tours. In 2012, Hu Jintao relinquished all party, government, and military positions in a 'naked retirement,' perfecting the practice of abolishing lifelong tenure for cadres.

birth_place.zh-cn: 天津市北辰区宜兴埠镇

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理。1998年洪水期间，任国家防汛抗旱总指挥部总指挥。后担任中华人民共和国国务院总理，领导抗洪与抗震救灾，并任命梁振英为香港第四任行政长官。在彭清华任香港中联办期间，他亦担任总理。任内曾与陈良宇因宏观调控政策产生矛盾，并反对薄熙来晋升。温云松之父。
description.en: A Chinese politician. He served as a member of the CPC Central Committee Politburo Standing Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. During the 1998 floods, he was Commander-in-Chief of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters. He later became Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, leading flood and earthquake relief efforts, and appointed Leung Chun-ying as the fourth Chief Executive of Hong Kong. He also served as premier during Peng Qinghua's tenure at the Hong Kong Liaison Office. During his tenure, he had conflicts with Chen Liangyu over macroeconomic control policies and opposed Bo Xilai's promotion. He is the father of Wen Yunsong.

description.zh-cn: 在北京举办的第29届夏季奥林匹克运动会。
description.en: The 29th Summer Olympic Games.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市
birth_place.en: Hefei, Anhui, People's Republic of China

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市浦东新区
death_place.en: Pudong, Shanghai, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 李克强，中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，团派主要成员。曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理，原正国级领导人。他被视为改革派学者型官员，其经济思想被称为“李克强经济学”。作为1977级大学生，曾任第十一届国务院副总理（与回良玉同任）。在国务院任职期间，曾是马凯上级并提名其为副总理。他在任总理期间推广“一带一路”倡议，被国际媒体评价为中国近代最弱势的总理之一。
description.en: Li Keqiang was a political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). He served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, a former national-level leader. Regarded as a reform-minded, scholar-type official, his economic philosophy was known as 'Likonomics'. A Class of 1977 university student, he also served as Vice Premier of the 11th State Council (alongside Hui Liangyu). During his tenure in the State Council, he was Ma Kai's superior and nominated him for Vice Premier. He promoted the 'Belt and Road' initiative during his premiership and was rated by international media as one of the weakest premiers in modern Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国政府于2013年倡议并主导的国际经济合作倡议（由习近平提出），旨在加强区域互联互通，并形成跨国经济带。
description.en: An international economic cooperation initiative proposed and led by the People's Republic of China government in 2013 (initiated by Xi Jinping), aiming to strengthen regional connectivity and form transnational economic belts.

zh-cn: 亚洲基础设施投资银行

description.zh-cn: 一个由中国倡议设立的多边开发银行，为“一带一路”等亚洲基建项目提供资金。

zh-cn: 反对逃犯条例修订草案运动
反对修订逃犯条例运动

description.zh-cn: 2019年3月至2020年期间在香港爆发的大规模社会运动，旨在反对《逃犯条例》修订草案。运动期间爆发了香港理工大学冲突，并被认为是促使中央政府订立《港区国安法》的关键背景事件。“恶俗维基”案相关人员牛腾宇曾前往香港参与此次运动。
description.en: A large-scale social movement that erupted in Hong Kong from March 2019 to 2020, primarily against the proposed amendments to the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance. During the movement, the Hong Kong Polytechnic University conflict occurred, and it is also considered a key background event that prompted the central government to enact the Hong Kong National Security Law. Niu Tengyu, a person involved in the 'Esuwiki case', also traveled to Hong Kong to participate in this movement.

zh-cn: 严重特殊传染性肺炎疫情

description.zh-cn: 由严重急性呼吸系统综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）导致的2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）所引发的全球大流行疫情，被定性为全球性重大突发公共卫生事件。在此期间，中国地方政府曾引用《治安管理处罚法》中关于“紧急状态”的条款实施疫情防控措施，故宫也于2020年初一度关闭。此外，李洪志对此发表言论，称病毒是针对中共而来，并宣称中国已有数亿人因此死亡。
description.en: A global pandemic of Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) caused by Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), designated as a major global public health emergency. During this period, local governments in China cited the 'state of emergency' clause in the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law' to implement pandemic control measures, and the Forbidden City was temporarily closed in early 2020. Additionally, Li Hongzhi commented on the pandemic, stating the virus targeted the CCP and claiming that hundreds of millions of people had died from it in China.

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国政府为应对2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行，由中国共产党主导实施的一系列严格公共卫生防控政策。据披露的录音，电影导演王家卫对此政策持批评态度。另据报道，黄坤明曾向习近平反映尽快结束该政策的紧迫性。
description.en: Refers to a series of strict public health prevention and control policies implemented by the government of the People's Republic of China, led by the Communist Party of China, in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. According to a leaked recording, film director Wong Kar-wai was critical of this policy. It is also reported that Huang Kunming conveyed the urgency of ending this policy to Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 中国国务院联防联控机制于2022年12月7日发布的进一步优化落实新冠肺炎疫情防控的十条措施，标志着清零政策的正式结束。
description.en: Ten measures for further optimizing the implementation of COVID-19 prevention and control, released by the Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism of the State Council of China on December 7, 2022, marking the official end of the zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 一个横跨东欧和北亚的联邦共和国，与中国接壤，是苏联的主要继承国，继承了其航天能力。作为金砖国家创始成员国，该国与北约东扩存在持续紧张关系。通过支持亲俄武装深度介入顿巴斯战争，并自2014年起实际控制并声称对克里米亚拥有主权，随后于2022年2月24日全面入侵乌克兰。此外，它在叙利亚内战中支持阿萨德政府，并在其政权垮台后为其提供庇护。
description.en: A federal republic spanning Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, bordering China. It is the main successor of the Soviet Union, having inherited its space capabilities. A founding member of BRICS, the country experiences persistent tensions with NATO expansion. It was deeply involved in the War in Donbas by supporting pro-Russian forces, has de facto controlled and claimed sovereignty over Crimea since 2014, and launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022. Additionally, it supported the Assad government during the Syrian Civil War and provided asylum to Assad after his regime's collapse.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚合众国是北美洲的联邦共和国，中华人民共和国驻美大使馆驻在国。在“一条线、一大片”战略中，曾被中国视为对抗苏联的重要伙伴。夏威夷州于1898年并入，1959年成为第50个州。该国曾参与一战、二战，战后为获取731部队数据赦免战争罪犯。曾支持中华民国，冷战时为苏联主要对手，领导朝鲜战争。苏联解体后成为唯一超级大国。钱学森曾在此留学工作后受迫害被驱逐。曾介入越南战争，现为乌克兰主要军援国。近年批评“一带一路”并实施技术限制。此外，据称《李鹏下台嵌字诗》由在此地的中国留学生创作。
description.en: The United States is a federal republic in North America, hosting the PRC Embassy. In the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy, it was considered by China as an important partner against the Soviet threat. Hawaii was annexed in 1898, becoming the 50th state in 1959. The country participated in WWI and WWII, and post-war granted immunity to Unit 731 war criminals for data. It supported the Republic of China, was a major rival to the Soviet Union during the Cold War, and led the Korean War. After the dissolution of the Soviet Union, it became the sole superpower. Qian Xuesen, after studying and working here, was persecuted and deported. It intervened in the Vietnam War and is now a major military aid provider to Ukraine. Recently, it criticized 'Belt and Road' and imposed tech restrictions. Additionally, it is alleged that the 'Li Peng step down acrostic poem' was composed by Chinese students in this country.

description.zh-cn: 由中国、俄罗斯等国发起的欧亚政治、经济和安全组织。
金砖国家合作机制是一个由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、伊朗、阿联酋和印度尼西亚等新兴市场国家组成的政府间国际组织，也是世界经济增长的主要动力之一。
description.en: The BRICS cooperation mechanism is an intergovernmental organization comprising emerging market countries such as Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, the United Arab Emirates, and Indonesia. It is also one of the main drivers of global economic growth.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政务院
en: Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government
State Administration Council of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的中央人民政府，是最高国家行政机关，职权相当于后来的国务院，也是中央人民政府重工业部等机构的上级机关。该政府由周恩来担任总理。
description.en: The Central People's Government, established in the early years of the People's Republic of China, served as the highest state administrative organ, with functions equivalent to the later State Council. It was also the superior body to institutions like the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry. Zhou Enlai served as its Premier.

en: Constitution of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的根本大法，历经多次修改。其中1982年版本明确将知识分子列为社会主义建设的依靠力量之一，同时也是设立浙江省人民代表大会的法源。此外，其第一百三十七条对国徽作出了规定，并确认其法律地位。
description.en: The fundamental law of the People's Republic of China, which has undergone multiple revisions. The 1982 version explicitly lists intellectuals as one of the forces to rely on for socialist construction, and it is also the legal source for the establishment of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress. Additionally, its Article 137 provides for the national emblem and confirms its legal status.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1982年)
中华人民共和国宪法（八二宪法）
en: 1982 Constitution of the People's Republic of China
Constitution of the People's Republic of China (1982)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第四部宪法，也被称为“八二宪法”，是现行宪法。该宪法的颁行加强了民族区域自治制度的建设，其第三十一条规定了设立特别行政区的法律依据。它还规定了国家主席等领导职务的任期制，正式从法律上废除了领导干部职务终身制，并规定实行初等义务教育。
description.en: The fourth constitution of the People's Republic of China, also known as the '82 Constitution', is the current constitution. It stipulated term limits for leading positions such as the President, formally abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres in law, and also stipulates the implementation of compulsory primary education.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法 (1954年)
en: 1954 Constitution of the People's Republic of China
Constitution of the People's Republic of China (1954)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第一部宪法，该法案的通过使国务院取代了原政务院的行政职能。
description.en: The first constitution of the People's Republic of China. Its adoption led to the State Council replacing the Government Administration Council's administrative functions.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国各级国家行政机关的总称。
description.en: The general term for state administrative organs at all levels in the People's Republic of China.

en: Constituent departments of the State Council
Constituent Department of the State Council
Constituent Departments of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 国务院组成部门是中华人民共和国国务院的组成机构类别，属于职能机构分类，承担国务院的基本行政管理职能。
description.en: The constituent departments of the State Council are a category of constituent bodies of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, belonging to a classification of functional bodies, and undertaking the basic administrative functions of the State Council.

en: Directly Subordinate Institution of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门之一，主管国务院某项专门业务。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for a specific specialized business.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、前领导人，曾任国务院副总理，也是一位农业政策专家。他支持“三自一包”等农业改革政策，在1962年北戴河会议上受到毛泽东批判并被降职。他也是“五马进京”事件核心人物之一。
description.en: A former leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Premier of the State Council and was an agricultural policy expert. He supported agricultural reform policies such as 'Sanzi Yibao', which led to criticism and demotion by Mao Zedong at the 1962 Beidaihe Conference. He was also one of the core figures in the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省归化城土默特塔布村
birth_place.en: Tabu Village, Guihuacheng Tumd, Shanxi Province

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫，蒙古族，是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的高级领导人、政治人物，原正国级领导人，有“蒙古王”之称。他曾任中国人民解放军开国上将、中华人民共和国副主席、全国人大常委会副委员长、国务院副总理、中共中央统战部部长等职。作为中华人民共和国历史上官阶最高的少数民族人士，他领导完成了《民族区域自治法》的制定，并曾在文革中被打倒。
description.en: Ulanhu, an ethnic Mongol, was a senior leader and politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, holding former national-level leadership positions and known as the 'Mongol King'. He was a founding General of the People's Liberation Army, serving as Vice President of the People's Republic of China, Vice Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Minister of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee. As the highest-ranking ethnic minority official in the history of the PRC, he led the formulation of the 'Law on Regional Ethnic Autonomy' and was purged during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人。他曾任国务院副总理、重工业部部长、中共中央办公厅主任，也是国家计划委员会主任（余秋里在该职位上的前任）和中共中央政治局常委。作为中国社会主义经济建设的奠基人之一，他因二月逆流事件在文化大革命期间受到迫害。
description.en: A politician of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level leader. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council, Minister of Heavy Industry, Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and was also the Director of the State Planning Commission (Yu Qiuli's predecessor in this role) and a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP Central Committee. As one of the founders of China's socialist economic construction, he was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution for his involvement in the February Countercurrent.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、原正国级领导人、中国人民解放军高级将领。1982年宪法恢复国家主席后，他于1983年至1988年担任首任中华人民共和国主席，还曾任全国政协主席，并于1981年起担任恢复后的中央外事工作领导小组组长。他是中共八大元老之一，在文化大革命中受到冲击，曾与李富春等抗争。后参与策划粉碎四人帮事件，并支持真理标准讨论。阎明复任全国政协副主席期间，他曾是阎明复的直接上级。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party and People's Republic of China politician, former national-level leader, and senior general of the People's Liberation Army. After the restoration of the presidency by the 1982 Constitution, he served as the first President of the People's Republic of China from 1983 to 1988. He also served as Chairman of the National People's Political Consultative Conference, and from 1981, he was the leader of the restored Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs. He was one of the Eight Elders of the CCP. He was purged during the Cultural Revolution and, along with Li Fuchun and others, resisted it. He later participated in the planning to crush the Gang of Four and supported the discussion on the criterion of truth. He was Yan Mingfu's direct superior when Yan served as Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省江津县吴滩乡石院子

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国人民解放军的军事家、革命家和政治家，十大元帅之一。他曾长期担任红一军团政治委员，后任北京市市长、国务院副总理、第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。他还担任过粟裕的前任代总参谋长、兼平津卫戍司令。他曾在政治运动中批判粟裕，并与李富春等人在“二月逆流”事件中抗争文化大革命。
description.en: Marshal of the People's Republic of China, a military strategist, revolutionary, and politician of the People's Liberation Army, and one of the Ten Marshals of the PRC. He served for a long period as the Political Commissar of the Red First Army Group, and later as Mayor of Beijing, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He also served as the predecessor of Su Yu as Acting Chief of the General Staff, concurrently as Commander of the Peiping-Tientsin Garrison Command. He criticized Su Yu during political movements and, along with Li Fuchun and others, resisted the Cultural Revolution in the 'February Countercurrent' incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党政治人物，曾任中共上海市委第一书记、上海市市长、国务院副总理。他曾向刘少奇建议将在押干部保释出狱。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China, he served as the First Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the CPC, Mayor of Shanghai, and Vice Premier of the State Council. He once suggested to Liu Shaoqi to bail out imprisoned cadres.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国高级领导人，中华人民共和国开国上将。文化大革命期间的重要人物，曾任北京市革委会主任、公安部部长。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army, former Minister of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党及中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级党和国家领导人。活跃于“文化大革命”中后期及“后毛泽东时代”。曾任国务院副总理、中央政法小组组长等职。他因深受毛泽东赏识和培养，在文革中后期进入中央核心。曾阻挠为六十一人叛徒集团案平反。中共十一届三中全会后在政治上受到排挤，于1980年2月辞去所有职务。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former Vice-national level leader. He was active in the late stage of the Cultural Revolution and the post-Mao era. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council, head of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Group, and other positions. Highly appreciated and cultivated by Mao Zedong, he entered the central core leadership in the late Cultural Revolution. He once obstructed the rehabilitation of the Case of the 61 Renegades. After the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CPC, he was politically marginalized and resigned from all his positions in February 1980.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华民国山西省武乡县
birth_place.en: Wuxiang County, Shanxi Province, Republic of China

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市

description.zh-cn: 中国农民及政治人物。在文化大革命期间受毛泽东提拔，成为“农业学大寨”运动的代表人物，并曾担任至中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理等副国级职务。改革开放后因其政治路线与邓小平等人的政策相抵触而被免职。
description.en: A Chinese farmer and politician. During the Cultural Revolution, he was promoted by Mao Zedong and became the representative figure of the 'In agriculture, learn from Dazhai' movement. He held high-ranking positions such as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. After the Reform and Opening-up, he was dismissed from his posts due to his political line conflicting with the policies of Deng Xiaoping and others.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，中国人民解放军开国上将，中共八大元老之一。曾担任中华人民共和国副主席，接替乌兰夫。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who succeeded Ulanhu as Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物与军事将领，曾任国务院副总理、总政治部主任、中华人民共和国国家计划委员会主任等职。1955年被授予中国人民解放军中将军衔，是著名的“独臂将军”。
description.en: A Chinese Communist Party politician and military general, he served as Vice Premier of the State Council, Director of the PLA General Political Department, and Director of the State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China. Awarded the rank of lieutenant general in 1955, he is known as the 'one-armed general'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理、国家经委常务主任、中国人口福利基金会会长，并为十人小组成员。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Vice Premier of the State Council, Executive Deputy Director of the State Economic Commission, and president of the China Population Welfare Foundation, and was a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国元帅，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的军事家、革命家、政治家。曾任红四方面军总指挥，是长征期间重要的军事领导人。历任国防部部长、国务院副总理、第四届全国人大常委会副委员长等职，并与李富春等人在“二月逆流”事件中对文化大革命进行抗争。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Republic of China, a military strategist, revolutionary, and politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Commander-in-Chief of the Fourth Front Army and was an important military leader during the Long March. He also held positions such as Minister of National Defense, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Along with Li Fuchun and others, he resisted the Cultural Revolution during the 'February Countercurrent' incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共元老，中华人民共和国政治家、外交家、军事家。曾任国务院副总理、国防部部长、中共中央军委秘书长、红一军团第一师参谋长，是习近平早期的上司。
description.en: A veteran of the CCP, and a politician, diplomat, and military strategist of the People's Republic of China. He served as Vice Premier, Minister of National Defense, Secretary-General of the CPC Central Military Commission, Chief of Staff of the First Division of the Red First Army Group, and was Xi Jinping's early superior.

description.zh-cn: 曾任国务院副总理、全国政协副主席。
description.en: Served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and Vice Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任国务院副总理、中国人民银行行长。
description.en: Chinese politician. Served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级领导人，曾任中央文革小组副组长、国务院副总理、全国政协副主席。他还接见过宋彬彬并动员她前往武汉。
description.en: A senior leader of the Communist Party of China, he served as Deputy Head of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Vice Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. He also met with Song Binbin and mobilized her to go to Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的早期领导人、杰出的无产阶级革命家。他曾任中共中央政治局常委（包括第十三届）、国务院副总理、中共中央办公厅主任，长期担任党和国家财经工作领导职务，并继任余秋里担任国家计划委员会主任。作为原正国级党和国家领导人，他被认为是保守派人物。
description.en: Yao Yilin was an early leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and an outstanding proletarian revolutionary. He served as a member of the Political Bureau Standing Committee (including the 13th), Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. He held leading positions in the Party and state's economic and financial work for a long time, succeeding Yu Qiuli as Director of the State Planning Commission. As a former national-level leader, he was considered a conservative figure.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、外交官，曾任中华人民共和国外交部部长，代表中方签署《中日联合声明》。后任第四届全国人大常委会秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician and diplomat, who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, signing the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué. Later, he served as Secretary-General of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国原正国级领导人，中共八大元老之一，中共党内改革派代表人物。他在改革开放初期在安徽推行农村改革，曾任国务院副总理、第七届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长，并于1981年起担任恢复后的中央外事工作领导小组副组长。他以实际退休行动支持废除领导职务终身制。
description.en: A former top-level leader of the CPC and PRC, one of the Eight Elders, and a key reformist. He initiated rural reforms in Anhui during the early reform era, served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 7th National People's Congress. From 1981, he also served as the deputy leader of the restored Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs. He supported the abolition of lifelong tenure through his own retirement.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国开国上将、政治人物。张灿明的兄长。曾任国防部部长、国务院副总理，并指挥一江山岛战役。他也是联名签署反对武力镇压学生示威抗议信的七名退役将军之一。此外，他曾在“批邓反击右倾翻案风”运动中被钱学森写大字报批判。
description.en: A founding general and politician of the People's Republic of China, and elder brother of Zhang Canming. He served as Minister of National Defense and Vice Premier of the State Council, commanding the Yijiangshan Islands Campaign. He was one of seven retired generals who jointly signed a letter opposing the use of force against student demonstrations. Additionally, he was criticized by Qian Xuesen in a big-character poster during the 'Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、外交家，曾任国务院副总理、外交部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician and diplomat, who served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and Minister of Foreign Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院秘书长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院秘书长、中共四川省委书记等职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary-General of the State Council and Secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the CCP.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务委员
中华人民共和国国务院国务委员
en: State Councilor of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院及其常务会议的组成人员之一，地位仅次于总理和副总理。与副总理同为国家级副职公务员、党和国家领导人。
description.en: A member of the State Council of the People's Republic of China and its standing committee, with a status second only to the Premier and Vice Premiers. They hold the rank of Deputy National Level public servant and are considered Party and State Leaders.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，曾任中国科学院副院长。他代表中国科学院向中央提出创办中国科学技术大学的申请。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Vice President of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. He submitted the application to the central government to establish the University of Science and Technology of China on behalf of CAS.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国水利电力部部长，并为十人小组成员。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power of the People's Republic of China, and a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任广州市人民委员会市长，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Mayor of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Committee, and a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，周恩来义子。曾任国务院总理、中共中央政治局常委、全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长（在成克杰担任副委员长期间）。他在任总理期间宣布开发浦东，并在六四事件期间宣布戒严令，因其强硬立场被认为是中共党内保守派的代表，并成为《李鹏下台嵌字诗》的攻击目标。他也是育才学校校友，是李小琳的父亲。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and foster son of Zhou Enlai. He served as Premier, member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP, and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (serving while Cheng Kejie was Vice Chairman). During his premiership, he announced the decision to develop Pudong and declared martial law during the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989. Due to his hardline stance during the protests, he was considered a representative figure of the conservative faction within the CCP and became the target of the 'Li Peng step down acrostic poem'. He was also an alumnus of Yucai School and is the father of Li Xiaolin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理，并担任全国人民代表大会常务委员会副委员长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理。作为已退休的前全国人大常委会委员长，他曾于1998年发起并率团对法轮功进行独立调查，结论是“法轮功于国于民，有百利而无一害”。
description.en: Chinese politician, a former national leader at the top rank (Zhengguojie), served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council. As a retired former Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, he initiated and led an independent investigation into Falun Gong in 1998, concluding that 'Falun Gong brings hundreds of benefits to the Chinese people and China, and does not have a single bad effect.'

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、外交家，曾任外交部部长、国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician and diplomat, who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治家，原正国级领导人。他曾任中共中央政治局常委、中共中央组织部部长、甘肃省委第一书记。作为中共元老，他发现并提拔了胡锦涛，其对胡的赏识是胡后来得以执掌大权的重要因素。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Minister of the CPC Central Organization Department, and First Secretary of the CCP Gansu Committee. As a veteran of the CPC, he discovered and promoted Hu Jintao, and his appreciation for Hu was a significant factor in Hu's later rise to supreme power.

zh-cn: 陈俊生 (全国政协副主席)

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国重要政治人物。他曾任国务院副总理，并兼任中国人民银行行长。随后晋升为国务院总理、中共中央政治局常委，被认为是前主要领导人之一。在上海市长、市委书记任上，他提出“开发浦东，振兴上海，服务全国，面向世界”方针。作为清华大学1951届校友，曾任经济管理学院首任院长。1998年洪水期间，他严厉斥责劣质水利工程为“豆腐渣工程”。在425上访事件中，他会见法轮功学员代表并下令释放被捕学员，事件曾暂时和平解决，但其温和立场遭江泽民拒绝。他还曾反对李长春作为其接班人。
description.en: An important political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Vice Premier of the State Council, concurrently as Governor of the People's Bank of China, and later as Premier of the State Council and a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, considered one of the former paramount leaders. During his tenure as Mayor and Party Secretary of Shanghai, he proposed the policy of 'developing Pudong, revitalizing Shanghai, serving the whole country, and facing the world'. As an alumnus of Tsinghua University (class of 1951), he served as the founding dean of its School of Economics and Management. During the 1998 floods, he famously denounced substandard water conservancy projects as 'tofu-dreg projects'. In the April 25 Appeal, he met with Falun Gong representatives and ordered the release of arrested practitioners, leading to a temporary peaceful resolution, though his conciliatory stance was later rejected by Jiang Zemin. He also opposed Li Changchun as his successor.

description.zh-cn: 李维汉与金维映之子，中国政治人物。曾任全国人大常委会副委员长、国务委员兼国家经济体制改革委员会主任。
description.en: Son of Li Weihan and Jin Weiying, a Chinese politician. He served as Vice Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, State Councilor and Minister in charge of the State Commission for Restructuring Economy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物、军事领导人，中国人民解放军上将（1988年授予），曾任中华人民共和国国防部部长。秦天与秦卫江之父。
description.en: A political figure and military leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a General of the People's Liberation Army (awarded in 1988), former Minister of National Defense of the PRC. Father of Qin Tian and Qin Weijiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，铁瑛的继任中共浙江省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Tie Ying's successor as Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长，并是黄璜的继任中共安徽省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Governor of the People's Bank of China and was the successor of Huang Huang as the Party Secretary of Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共北京市委书记，后因贪腐案被审查撤职。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Party Secretary of Beijing, who was later investigated and removed from office for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、外交家，曾任中华人民共和国国务院副总理、外交部长，并担任中央国家安全工作领导小组副组长。
description.en: Chinese politician and diplomat, served as Vice Premier of the State Council and Minister of Foreign Affairs, and also as the deputy leader of the Central Leading Group for National Security Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一。曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记、国务院秘书长。其在中央政法委书记任内，下令公安部对法轮功进行调查，并担任“中央处理法轮功问题领导小组”的历任组长之一，据称其背书了何祚庥批评法轮功的文章。此外，他于1989年在全国公安交通管理工作会议上发表讲话，并于1993年召集会议协调公安与交通部门的管理分工。他曾在莱比锡大学学习德语。
description.en: Chinese politician, and one of the former principal leaders of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China. He served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Central Political Bureau, Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, and Secretary-General of the State Council. During his tenure as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, he ordered the Ministry of Public Security to investigate Falun Gong and served as one of the leaders of the 'Central Leading Group on Dealing with Falun Gong', reportedly endorsing He Zuoxiu's articles criticizing Falun Gong. Additionally, he spoke at the National Public Security Traffic Management Work Conference in 1989 and convened a meeting in 1993 to coordinate the division of management responsibilities between public security and transport departments. He also studied German at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级正职领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理、对外贸易经济合作部部长、天津市副市长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a former national-level principal leader, who served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, and Vice Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人。曾任上海市委书记（在黄奇帆任职上海期间），中央书记处书记、国务院副总理。后升任中共中央政治局常委，并担任第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长。据报道，他曾于2013年推醒在主席台上睡着的贾庆林；1992年曾因陈良宇冲撞邓小平警卫一事，在电话中训斥陈良宇。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China and a former national-level leader. He served as Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee (during Huang Qifan's tenure in Shanghai), Secretary of the Central Secretariat, and Vice Premier. Later, he was promoted to a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress. Reports indicate he once woke up Jia Qinglin who had fallen asleep during a meeting in 2013, and in 1992, he reportedly reprimanded Chen Liangyu over the phone due to an incident involving Deng Xiaoping's security detail.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共第十四届中央委员会期间，先后任山东省委书记、中央书记处书记、国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served successively as Shandong Party Secretary, Secretary of the Central Secretariat, and Vice Premier during the term of the 14th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上将。曾任国防部部长、解放军总参谋长，参与指挥戒严部队。在中共十四届五中全会上增补为中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: A General of the People's Republic of China, he served as Minister of National Defense and Chief of the General Staff of the PLA, and participated in commanding martial law troops. He was appointed Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国维吾尔族政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician of Uyghur ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级领导人，有“中国铁娘子”之称。她曾接替李岚清任对外经济贸易部部长，并担任过国务院副总理（与回良玉同为第十届）、国务委员、卫生部部长等职。据报道，她与薄熙来交恶，并阻止其接任副总理职位。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a former Deputy State Leader, known as the "Iron Lady of China." She succeeded Li Lanqing as Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, and also served as Vice Premier of the State Council (including the 10th State Council alongside Hui Liangyu), State Councilor, and Minister of Health. She reportedly had a poor relationship with Bo Xilai and blocked his succession to the Vice Premier position.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人口福利基金会会长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the president of the China Population Welfare Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共第十四届中央委员会期间，曾任上海市市长、市委书记，并于1994年增选为中共中央政治局委员。后任第十届国务院副总理（与回良玉同任）、中共中央政治局常委。陈良宇曾担任其秘书。其因病去世后，客观上为中纪委调查上海社保案提供了契机。
description.en: A Chinese politician. During the 14th CPC Central Committee, he served as Mayor and Party Secretary of Shanghai, and was co-opted as a Politburo member in 1994. Later, he served as Vice Premier of the 10th State Council (alongside Hui Liangyu) and a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo. Chen Liangyu once served as his secretary. His death due to illness objectively provided an opportunity for the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection to investigate the Shanghai social security case.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任国家发展计划委员会主任，后由马凯在新组建的国家发改委中接任。与回良玉同为第十届国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician. He formerly served as Director of the State Development Planning Commission, a role later succeeded by Ma Kai in the newly formed NDRC. He also served as Vice Premier of the 10th State Council alongside Hui Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 回族，中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共安徽省委书记、两届国务院副总理。作为原副国级党和国家领导人，他长期在农业领域工作，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务院副总理。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Hui ethnicity and a former national leader at the vice-state level. He served as Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee and two terms as Vice Premier of the State Council. He worked extensively in the agricultural sector and was appointed as Vice Premier during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国前政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央政法委书记。他因腐败问题在反腐运动中落马，被判无期徒刑。任职期间，周本顺是其直接下属，冀文林曾长期担任其秘书。他曾作出批示要求正确引导舆论，被指意图掩盖政府干预司法。另据称，他与李长春共同主导了谷歌退出中国事件。
description.en: Former Chinese politician, member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. He fell during the anti-corruption campaign due to corruption and was sentenced to life imprisonment. During his tenure, Zhou Benshun was his direct subordinate, and Ji Wenlin served as his long-term secretary. He issued an instruction to 'correctly guide public opinion,' which was seen as an attempt to cover up government interference in the judiciary. Additionally, he allegedly co-directed the Google withdrawal incident with Li Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中华人民共和国上将。曾任中华人民共和国国防部部长（梁光烈的前任）、中央军委副主席，在神舟五号飞行期间与航天员杨利伟进行了“天地对话”。
description.en: Chinese politician and General of the People's Liberation Army. He served as the Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China (predecessor to Liang Guanglie) and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission. During the Shenzhou 5 mission, he conducted a 'space-to-ground call' with astronaut Yang Liwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交家，曾任外交部部长、国务委员。
description.en: Chinese diplomat, who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and State Councilor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾担任第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会副委员长，并曾是马凯的前任国务院秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress and was Ma Kai's predecessor as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国女性政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: A female Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairwoman of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（第十一届）。薄熙来被免职后，他接任中共重庆市委书记，与黄奇帆搭档，并公开否定“重庆模式”。其后担任全国人大常委会委员长、中央港澳工作协调小组组长，并在中共十九届二中全会上就修宪建议草案作了说明。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council (11th term). Following Bo Xilai's dismissal, he took over as Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee, partnering with then-mayor Huang Qifan, and publicly denied the existence of the 'Chongqing Model'. Subsequently, he served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and head of the Central Coordination Group for Hong Kong and Macau Affairs, and explained the draft proposal for constitutional amendments at the Second Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国副主席、北京市市长、中共中央纪律检查委员会书记。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间，他与回良玉一同担任国务院副总理。他还曾在李长春任中共广东省委书记期间担任常务副省长，并协助处理国企问题。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China, Mayor of Beijing, and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC. During the 11th National People's Congress, he served as Vice Premier of the State Council alongside Hui Liangyu. He also held the position of Executive Vice Governor during Li Changchun's tenure as Guangdong Provincial Party Secretary, assisting in handling state-owned enterprise issues.

description.zh-cn: 中国女性政治人物，团派主要成员。曾任中共中央政治局委员、中华人民共和国国务院副总理，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: A female Chinese politician and a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). She served as a member of the Politburo of the CPC and Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，中国人民解放军上将，原副国级领导人。曾任国防部部长。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员和中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a general in the People's Liberation Army, and a former leader of vice-national level. He served as Minister of National Defense, and was appointed as a State Councilor and a member of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共上海市委副书记，并在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员。此后，他接替周永康担任中共中央政法委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician. He formerly served as Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the CPC and was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress. Subsequently, he succeeded Zhou Yongkang as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国土家族政治人物、高级外交官。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为国务委员，并曾担任中央外事工作领导小组办公室主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician and senior diplomat of Tujia ethnicity. He was appointed as a State Councilor during the 11th National People's Congress and served as Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前正国级领导人，曾任中共第十八届中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（并担任推进“一带一路”建设工作领导小组首任组长），以及中共天津市委书记。在宋平顺自杀后，他向外界通报了其涉案情况。
description.en: Former high-ranking leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, served as a member of the 18th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council (and the first head of the Leading Group for Promoting the Belt and Road Initiative), and Secretary of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee. After Song Pingshun's suicide, he publicly announced details of Song's case.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，团派主要成员。他曾任中共中央政治局常委、第十三届全国政协主席、国务院副总理、中共广东省委书记、中共重庆市委书记，是薄熙来在重庆市委书记职务上的前任。他拥有中国科学技术大学在职研究生学历。
description.en: Chinese politician, a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), and a former top national leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC, Chairman of the 13th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), Vice Premier of the State Council, Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, and Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee, preceding Bo Xilai in the latter role. He holds an in-service postgraduate degree from the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，蒙古族。曾任中共中央书记处书记，国家行政学院院长（陈希的前任），并接替马凯担任国务院秘书长。
description.en: A Chinese political figure of Mongolian ethnicity. He served as Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, President of the National Academy of Governance (predecessor to Chen Xi), and succeeded Ma Kai as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，中国政治人物。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会委员，并继任梁光烈担任中华人民共和国国防部部长。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army and Chinese politician. Appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress, and succeeded Liang Guanglie as the Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国外交官及政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局委员、中央外事工作委员会办公室主任、国务委员、中华人民共和国外交部部长等职务。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat and politician of the Communist Party of China, who has served as a member of the Politburo, Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, State Councilor, and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共广西壮族自治区党委书记，后任中共中央政法委书记、中共十九届中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记。他曾是彭清华的前任，也是傅政华担任公安部副部长时的上级。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as Party Secretary of Guangxi, and later as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, a member of the Political Bureau, and a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee. He was Peng Qinghua's predecessor and also Fu Zhenghua's superior when Fu was Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市市长、代理市委书记（接替陈良宇），后任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（接替张高丽），现任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理，中共十九届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council and a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物、副国级领导人。曾担任朱小丹担任广东省省长期间的中共广东省委书记。他曾是团派主要成员，一度被视为胡锦涛的隔代接班人，但在中共二十大上失势。现任第十四届全国政协副主席、党组副书记。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, holding a sub-national leadership position. He served as the Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP while Zhu Xiaodan was Governor of Guangdong. He was a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction), once seen as Hu Jintao's designated successor, but lost power at the 20th CPC National Congress. He currently serves as the Vice Chairman and Deputy Party Secretary of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、经济学者，曾任第十九届中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、国务院金融稳定发展委员会主任。他是刘植岩之子，刘茶同父异母的兄长，也是习近平的童年朋友和亲密顾问，原国家级副职领导人。
description.en: Chinese politician and economist. He served as a member of the 19th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee. He is the son of Liu Zhiyan and the half-brother of Liu Cha, and also a childhood friend and close advisor to Xi Jinping, a former national-level deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任第二炮兵部队司令员、火箭军首任司令员，并担任国务委员、国防部部长。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, he served as Commander of the Second Artillery Force and the first Commander of the Rocket Force. He also held positions as State Councilor and Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、高级外交官，副国级领导人，77级大学生。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共中央外事工作委员会办公室主任，曾任外交部长、国务委员。
description.en: Chinese politician and senior diplomat, a member of the Class of 1977 and a sub-national leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CCP and Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, having previously served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and State Councilor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任吴政隆的前任国务院秘书长，后担任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly served as the predecessor of Wu Zhenglong as Secretary-General of the State Council, and later as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，曾任中华人民共和国公安部部长，国务委员，傅政华担任公安部副部长时的上级。
description.en: Chinese politician, Fu Zhenghua's superior when he was Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，正国级领导人，现任中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理（排名第一）、中央港澳工作领导小组组长。曾任中共中央办公厅主任（蔡奇的前任）。他也是一名78级大学生。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a national-level leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, the First-ranked Vice Premier of the State Council, and leader of the Central Leading Group on Hong Kong and Macau Affairs. He previously served as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee (predecessor to Cai Qi). He is also a member of the Class of 1978.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、中央财经委员会办公室主任、中央金融委员会办公室主任、中央金融工作委员会书记。曾任国家发展和改革委员会主任。他也是郑栅洁在厦门工作时的领导。
description.en: A Chinese politician and a national leader at vice-state level. He currently serves as a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, Director of the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission, Director of the Office of the Central Financial Commission, and Secretary of the Central Financial Work Commission. He previously served as Director of the National Development and Reform Commission and was Zheng Shanjie's superior during his time in Xiamen.

birth_place.zh-cn: 河南省信阳专区罗山县
birth_place.en: Luoshan County, Xinyang Prefecture, Henan Province

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级党和国家领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、国务院安全生产委员会主任。曾任重庆市市长，是黄奇帆的继任者、唐良智的前任。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a sub-national level party and state leader. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the Work Safety Committee of the State Council. He previously served as Mayor of Chongqing, succeeding Huang Qifan and preceding Tang Liangzhi.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, a member of the 20th Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee, and a Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中华人民共和国国务委员、国防部部长，中央军委委员，中国人民解放军陆军上将。因卷入2023年中国火箭军腐败案落马，于2024年被开除党籍和军籍。
description.en: Former State Councilor and Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China, former member of the Central Military Commission, and former General of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force. He was dismissed in connection with the 2023 corruption case in the PLA Rocket Force and was expelled from the party and military in 2024.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。现任国务委员，中共中央书记处书记，副国级领导人。曾任傅政华的继任公安部常务副部长、北京市公安局局长。
description.en: A Chinese politician. He is currently a State Councilor and a Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee (a vice-national level leader). He previously served as Fu Zhenghua's successor as Executive Vice Minister of Public Security and Director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人。现任中华人民共和国国务委员、国务院秘书长、国务院机关党组书记。曾任江苏省省长、中共江苏省委书记等职务。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, currently holding a vice-national level leadership position. He serves as a State Councilor, Secretary-General of the State Council, and Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of the State Council Organ. He previously served as Governor of Jiangsu and Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 白族
中国共产党、中华人民共和国外交官及政治人物。曾任外交部部长、国务委员，原副国级领导人。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat who served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 负责对组织进行日常管理并施行法律政策等相关活动的政府机构，是三权分立中的一部分，负责执行国家政策。
description.en: The branch of government responsible for the day-to-day management of the state and the implementation of laws and policies, one of the three branches in the separation of powers.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院负责履行国防职能的组成部门，也是中华人民共和国中央军事委员会的军事工作机关之一。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for national defense functions, and also one of the military working organs of the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军上将，现任中华人民共和国国防部部长。
description.en: An admiral in the People's Liberation Army Navy, currently the Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

description.en: The head position of the Ministry of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

Central People's Government People's Revolutionary Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的国家最高军事领导机关。在1949年至1954年间，它是中华人民共和国的最高军事领导机构。
description.en: The supreme military leading body of the People's Republic of China from 1949 to 1954.

en: Common Program of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的临时宪法，在1954年《中华人民共和国宪法》颁布前，实际上起着临时宪法的作用。
description.en: It effectively served as the interim constitution of the People's Republic of China before the promulgation of the 1954 Constitution.

Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1945年至1982年间的最高领导人职务，后被总书记职务取代。
description.en: The highest leadership position in the Communist Party of China from 1945 to 1982, later replaced by the post of General Secretary.

birth_place.zh-cn: 四川省顺庆府仪陇县马鞍镇

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市东城区北京医院

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的优秀党员、伟大的无产阶级革命家，党、国家和军队的卓越领导人之一，中国共产党、中华人民共和国及中国人民解放军的主要缔造者和创始人之一。他曾任中国工农红军总司令、红一军团总指挥，是长征期间重要的军事领导人。作为中华人民共和国元帅之首，他参与创建了井冈山革命根据地，并在南昌起义中担任第九军副军长。起义失败后，率领余部与毛泽东在井冈山会师。他还曾担任第四届全国人大常委会委员长。他曾称蔡锷影响其整个前半生。
description.en: An outstanding member of the Communist Party of China, a great proletarian revolutionary, and one of the eminent leaders of the Party, state, and military. He was one of the main founders and creators of the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China, and the People's Liberation Army. He served as Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and General Commander of the Red First Army Group, and was an important military leader during the Long March. As the foremost of the Ten Marshals of the People's Republic of China, he participated in the establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base. He also served as Deputy Commander of the 9th Army during the Nanchang Uprising. After the uprising's failure, he led the remaining troops to join forces with Mao Zedong in the Jinggang Mountains. He also served as Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He stated that Cai E influenced the entire first half of his life.

zh-cn: 第一届全国人民代表大会
第一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议
第一届全国人民代表大会第二次会议
en: First Session of the 1st National People's Congress
First Session of the First National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第一届最高国家权力机关，其任期为1954年9月至1959年4月。其第一次会议于1954年9月在北京市召开，通过了《中华人民共和国宪法》和《中华人民共和国国务院组织法》，标志着人民代表大会制度的确立，选举产生了新的国家领导机构，并成立了中华人民共和国国务院。许涤新、曾泽生等曾当选为代表。此次会议也导致了中央人民政府重工业部的结束。在任期内，于1955年7月的一次会议中，还决定对国务院所属机构进行调整。
description.en: The first highest state authority of the People's Republic of China, serving from September 1954 to April 1959. Its first session, held in Beijing in September 1954, passed the 'Constitution of the People's Republic of China' and the 'Organic Law of the State Council', marking the establishment of the system of people's congresses. It elected new state leadership bodies and established the State Council of the People's Republic of China. Xu Dixin and Zeng Zesheng were among its delegates. This session also led to the dissolution of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry. During its tenure, a meeting in July 1955 also decided to adjust the subordinate bodies of the State Council.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防委员会
en: National Defence Commission of the People's Republic of China
National Defense Commission of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1954年至1975年间中华人民共和国的最高军事领导机构，同时也是国家军事咨询议事机构。
description.en: The supreme military leading body of the People's Republic of China from 1954 to 1975.

zh-cn: 中共中央革命军事委员会
中华人民共和国中央军事委员会
中国人民革命军事委员会
中国共产党中央军事委员会
中国共产党和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会
en: Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China
Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China
Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会，通称中央军事委员会，简称中央军委、军委，是中国共产党和中华人民共和国武装力量最高军事领导机构的总称，领导全国武装力量。受中国共产党中央委员会和全国人民代表大会领导。在土地革命战争后期、抗日战争和第二次国共内战时期，是中国共产党的最高军事领导机构。1982年12月4日，通过八二宪法，成立中华人民共和国中央军事委员会。此后，中共中央军委和国家中央军委组成人员基本相同，实际上是“一个机构两块牌子”。中国人民解放军总政治部曾是其下属的四大总部之一。
description.en: The Central Military Commission (CMC), a collective term for the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China and the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China, is the supreme military leadership body of China's armed forces, commanding the nation's armed forces. It is led by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the National People's Congress. During the latter part of the Agrarian Revolutionary War, the Anti-Japanese War, and the Second Chinese Civil War, it served as the highest military leadership body of the CPC. On December 4, 1982, with the adoption of the 1982 Constitution, the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China was established. Since then, the composition of the CPC Central Military Commission and the State Central Military Commission has been largely identical, effectively operating as 'one institution, two names'. The PLA General Political Department was once one of its four general headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党军事家，中国人民解放军大将。他曾任新四军第三师师长，抗战胜利后率领该师进入东北，与山东军区部队共同组建东北人民自治军。此外，他还担任过国防部副部长、总参谋长、中纪委常务书记、中共中央军委秘书长。他是洪学智的上级，也是余秋里在中国人民解放军总后方勤务部政治委员职位上的前任。在庐山会议中，他因支持彭德怀被错误地打成反党集团成员。
description.en: A Chinese Communist military strategist and a Senior General of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Commander of the 3rd Division of the New Fourth Army, leading it into Northeast China after the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, where they jointly formed the Northeast People's Autonomous Army with troops from the Shandong Military Region. He also held positions such as Deputy Minister of National Defense, Chief of the General Staff of the PLA, Standing Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and Secretary-General of the CPC Central Military Commission. He was Hong Xuezhi's superior and Yu Qiuli's predecessor as Political Commissar of the PLA General Rear Services Department. During the Lushan Conference, he was wrongly labeled a member of an anti-Party clique for supporting Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军及中国人民解放军主要领导人之一，中华人民共和国大将。曾任红一军团第一师政治部主任、国防部副部长、中国人民解放军总政治部主任、副主任。
description.en: One of the main leaders of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the People's Liberation Army, a General of the People's Republic of China. He served as Director of the Political Department of the First Division of the Red First Army Group, Vice Minister of National Defense, and Director and Deputy Director of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国海军大将，中国人民解放军海军首任司令员。曾任国防部副部长，并于1952年上报了组建海军航空兵飞行部队的请示报告。他还曾任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Grand General of the Navy of the People's Republic of China and the first commander of the PLA Navy. He also served as Vice Minister of National Defense and submitted a report in 1952 requesting the formation of naval aviation flight units. Additionally, he was a member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，大将。曾任国防部副部长，红四方面军将领。
description.en: A senior general of the People's Liberation Army, one of the ten Grand Marshals.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，曾任国防部副部长。他曾与任弼时率领红六军团西征，并担任参谋长。
description.en: A founding general of the PLA. He, along with Ren Bishi, led the Red Sixth Army Corps on the Westward Expedition, during which Li Da served as Chief of Staff.

中华人民共和国中将，曾任国防部副部长，土家族政治人物。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Republic of China, former Vice Minister of National Defense, and a politician of Tujia ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 曾是中国人民解放军的最高军事指挥机关，负责组织领导全国武装力量的军事建设和作战指挥。它原是中央军事委员会的军事工作机关和全军军事工作的领导机关。在2015年深化国防和军队改革中被撤销，并改组为中央军委联合参谋部。
description.en: Formerly the highest military command organ of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, responsible for organizing and leading the military construction and combat command of the national armed forces. It was originally the military affairs organ of the Central Military Commission and the leading organ for the military work of the entire army. It was abolished in the 2015 reform of national defense and the military, and reorganized into the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军已撤销的最高政治工作领导机关，也是中央军事委员会的四总部之一。其职责涵盖政治思想、组织、纪律、宣传、保卫及对外联络等。该机构的历史可追溯至中国工农红军时期，曾由余秋里担任主任。2016年1月，在深化国防和军队改革中被撤销，相关职能由新成立的中央军事委员会政治工作部等部门承接。
description.en: The defunct highest political work leading organ of the People's Liberation Army (PLA), and formerly one of the four general headquarters under the Central Military Commission. Its responsibilities included political ideology, organization, discipline, propaganda, security, and foreign liaison. The organization's history can be traced back to the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army era, and Yu Qiuli once served as its director. It was abolished in January 2016 during military reforms, with its functions transferred to newly established departments such as the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission.
