en: Great Discussion on the Criterion of Truth
The discussion on the criterion of truth
The great discussion on the criterion of truth

description.zh-cn: 1978年在中国思想理论界展开的一场关于实践是检验真理的唯一标准（即真理标准问题）的大讨论。此次讨论旨在批判“两个凡是”，确立实践是检验真理的唯一标准。这是一次重要的思想解放运动，为中共十一届三中全会召开作了思想准备。
description.en: A major debate on practice being the sole criterion for testing truth (the criterion for testing truth issue) unfolded in China's ideological and theoretical circles in 1978. This debate aimed to criticize the 'Two Whatevers' and establish practice as the sole criterion for testing truth. It was an important ideological emancipation movement that laid the ideological groundwork for the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪中国死亡人数最多的一次地震。
中国政治人物，曾国藩家族后人，叶剑英的第三任妻子，叶选宁之母。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, a descendant of the Zeng Guofan family, the third wife of Ye Jianying, and the mother of Ye Xuaning.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英的配偶。
叶剑英的配偶。
叶剑英与冯华的长子，叶选宁之兄，中国政治人物。曾任广州市市长、广东省省长、全国政协常务副主席。
description.en: The eldest son of Ye Jianying and Feng Hua, older brother of Ye Xuaning, a Chinese politician. He served as the Mayor of Guangzhou, Governor of Guangdong Province, and Executive Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治与军事人物，中国共产党党员，中国人民解放军少将。他是叶剑英与曾宪植之子，被称为“独臂将军”。曾任总政联络部部长，在中共第二代高干子弟中具影响力，有“太子党的精神领袖”之称。
description.en: A political and military figure of the People's Republic of China, a member of the Communist Party of China, and a major general in the People's Liberation Army. He was the son of Ye Jianying and Zeng Xianzhi, known as the 'one-armed general'. He served as the head of the Liaison Department of the General Political Department, was influential among the second generation of high-ranking cadres' children, and was sometimes referred to as the 'spiritual leader of the princelings'.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英的三子，中国人民解放军少将，叶选宁之弟。
description.en: The third son of Ye Jianying, a major general in the People's Liberation Army, and younger brother of Ye Xuaning.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英骨灰安葬地。
由中国共产党领导的、针对中国国民党的武装起义。该起义由张太雷等人具体领导，张太雷在起义第二天身亡。
description.en: An armed uprising led by the Communist Party of China against the Kuomintang. The uprising was specifically led by Zhang Tailei and others, with Zhang Tailei being killed on the second day.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期军事及政治人物，粤系军阀的代表人物。他曾炮轰总统府，也曾与孙中山合作但之后反目。
description.en: A military and political figure in the Republic of China era, representative of the Yue clique. He once cooperated with Sun Yat-sen but later became his opponent.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党左派领袖、革命家，曾任黄埔军校党代表。
description.en: A revolutionary of the Kuomintang, served as the Party Representative of the Whampoa Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫是中国国民党早期领导人之一，中华民国大陆时期政要、诗人。他早年曾策划暗杀摄政王载沣。后任武汉国民政府主席，是国民党左派领袖，与蒋介石在分共方式上存在分歧导致宁汉分裂。四一二政变后曾与陈独秀发表联合宣言，但不久便发动七一五事变与共产党决裂。1935年11月1日，在王亚樵等人策划的刺杀中身受重伤。最终成为汪精卫政权的首脑。
description.en: Wang Jingwei, one of the early leaders of the Kuomintang, was a prominent politician and poet during the Republic of China era on the mainland. In his early years, he plotted the assassination of Prince-Regent Zaifeng. He later served as chairman of the Wuhan Nationalist Government and was a leader of the Kuomintang's left wing. His disagreements with Chiang Kai-shek over the method of purging communists led to the Nanjing-Wuhan split. After the April 12 Purge, he issued a joint declaration with Chen Duxiu, but soon launched the July 15 Incident to break with the communists. On November 1, 1935, he was severely wounded in an assassination attempt planned by Wang Yaqiao and others. Ultimately, he became the head of the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家，北伐名将，中国人民解放军创建者之一。曾任新四军军长。在南昌起义中担任前敌总指挥兼第十一军军长，是起义的主要领导人之一。
description.en: Chinese military strategist, a famous general of the Northern Expedition, and one of the founders of the People's Liberation Army. He served as the commander of the New Fourth Army, and during the Nanchang Uprising, he was the Frontline Commander-in-Chief and Commander of the 11th Army, being one of the main leaders of the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物、建筑师，曾任第64、65任内阁总理大臣。因平民出身被称为“庶民宰相”，但也因洛克希德事件等丑闻备受争议。他曾代表日方签署《中日联合声明》，也是石破二朗的朋友，曾劝说石破茂进入政界。
description.en: Japanese politician and architect who served as the 64th and 65th Prime Minister of Japan. Known as the 'commoner prime minister' for his humble origins, he was also controversial due to scandals like the Lockheed affair. He signed the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué on behalf of Japan, and was a friend of Jirō Ishiba who persuaded Shigeru Ishiba to enter politics.

birth_place.en: Futada Village, Kariwa District, Niigata Prefecture

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国全国人大常委会告台湾同胞书》是由全国人民代表大会常务委员会发表的文件，标志着中华人民共和国对台政策从“武力解放”转向“和平统一”，并宣告停止对金门等岛屿的炮击。
description.en: The 'Message to Compatriots in Taiwan' issued by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress marks a shift in the PRC's policy towards Taiwan from 'armed liberation' to 'peaceful unification', and announced the cessation of shelling of islands like Kinmen.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英的养女，中国作家、记者，曾与李泽厚一同参与六四事件期间的呼吁。
description.en: Adopted daughter of Ye Jianying, a Chinese author and journalist who joined Li Zehou in an appeal during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英的弟弟。

en: First Division of the Guangdong Army
Fourth Army of the National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军的部队之一，因在北伐战争中战功卓著而被称为“铁军”。

zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国中央革命军事委员会
中共中央革命军事委员会
en: Central Revolutionary Military Commission of the Chinese Soviet Republic

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国和土地革命战争时期中国工农红军的最高军事领导和指挥机构，负责领导全国红军的作战和建设。同时期，上海有中央军事委员会，负责后勤等。

en: Southern Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争时期设于重庆的派出机构，是其在国民党统治区的领导机关。该机构曾重视并支持育才学校，许涤新也曾在此宣传部工作。
description.en: An agency of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China established in Chongqing during the Second Sino-Japanese War, serving as its leading body in Kuomintang-controlled areas. It valued and supported Yucai School, and Xu Dixin once worked in its Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的院校。
中国第二次国共内战中，北平以和平方式易手。
中华民国陆军二级上将，晋系重要将领，曾任晋绥军将领。历任国民党华北剿匪总司令，在平津战役中率部和平改编，促成北平解放，并于第二次国共内战末期投向中国共产党。他是一位中国军事家、政治家，曾任中华人民共和国水利部、水利电力部部长。其军事生涯中曾攻击并缴械孙殿英的部队。
description.en: General (Second Class) of the Republic of China Army and an important general of the Jin clique, also serving as a general of the Jinsui Army. He was the former Commander-in-Chief of the Kuomintang's North China Bandit Suppression Headquarters. During the Pingjin Campaign, he led his troops to accept peaceful reorganization, facilitating the liberation of Beiping, and later defected to the Chinese Communist Party at the end of the Chinese Civil War. A Chinese military strategist and politician, he served as Minister of Water Resources and Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power of the People's Republic of China. Notably, he once attacked and disarmed Sun Dianying's troops during his military career.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央在华南地区的派出机构。

en: The People's Government of Guangdong Province

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省的省级国家行政机关，也是广东广播电视台的上级机构。
description.en: The provincial-level state administrative organ of Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China, and the superior organization of Guangdong Radio and Television.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省的省会、副省级市和首批沿海开放城市。这里是吴克华和张太雷的逝世地，也是亚罗号事件的发生地，在战争初期曾被英法联军攻陷并占领。
description.en: The capital of Guangdong Province, a sub-provincial city, and one of the first coastal open cities in the People's Republic of China. It is also the place of death of Wu Kehua and Zhang Tailei, and the location of the Arrow Incident, having been captured and occupied by Anglo-French forces early in the war.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事科学院
en: People's Liberation Army Academy of Military Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军全军性的军事科学研究机构。
description.en: The all-military science research institute of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 郭兴福教学法的创立者。
中国人民解放军与越南共和国军在西沙群岛发生的海战。
周恩来的出生地，位于清朝江苏省淮安府，今江苏省淮安市淮安区。
周恩来妻子，中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人，中共八大元老之一。她曾任全国政协主席，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员，后补选为副委员长。
description.en: Wife of Zhou Enlai, a political figure of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a former national-level leader. She was one of the 'Eight Immortals' of the CCP, served as Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, and was a member and later elected Vice Chairwoman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来胞弟
周恩来留法期间的女友，中国第一位留法女博士，与邓颖超共同组织天津女界爱国同志会。
南开大学，位于中国天津市，是一所著名综合性研究型大学，由教育家严修、张伯苓创办。周恩来、姚依林、孟凡利、艾跃进等曾就读于此，艾跃进亦曾在此长期任教。抗战期间，曾与北大、清华合并组建国立西南联合大学。
description.en: Nankai University, located in Tianjin, China, is a renowned comprehensive research university founded by educators Yan Xiu and Zhang Boling. Zhou Enlai, Yao Yilin, Meng Fanli, Ai Yuejin, and others studied there, with Ai Yuejin also serving as a long-term faculty member. During the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, it merged with Peking University and Tsinghua University to form the National Southwest Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党旅欧支部的早期组织，李富春曾参与建立并担任地方支部书记。
description.en: An early organization of the European branch of the Chinese Communist Party, which Li Fuchun helped establish and served as a local branch secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期组织之一。
五四运动时期在天津成立的青年学生社团。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部
中央纪委国家监委驻外交部纪检监察组
中央纪律检查委员会国家监察委员会驻外交部纪检监察组
en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China

location.zh-cn: 北京市朝阳区朝阳门南大街2号
location.en: No. 2, Chaoyangmen South Street, Chaoyang District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管外交事务的组成部门。它多次就香港民主派初选案等事件表态，支持香港警方的行动并反对外国干涉。该机构内部设有中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会和中华人民共和国国家监察委员会派驻的纪检监察机构，负责对其进行纪律检查和监督。
description.en: The component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for foreign affairs. It has repeatedly commented on incidents such as the Hong Kong pro-democracy primaries case, supporting the actions of the Hong Kong police and opposing foreign interference. Within the department, there is a disciplinary and supervisory agency dispatched by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC and the National Supervisory Commission of the PRC, responsible for its discipline inspection and oversight.

description.zh-cn: 林彪的妻子，林立果、林立衡之母，曾任中共第九届中央政治局委员，林彪反革命集团案主犯之一，在九一三事件中坠机身亡。
description.en: Wife of Lin Biao, mother of Lin Liheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将。曾是洪学智在东北民主联军第六纵队司令员的继任者。后任总参谋长、广州军区司令。他是林彪反革命集团案主犯之一，因林彪事件被撤职，并曾支持韦国清镇压“4·22”派。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army. He was the successor to Hong Xuezhi as commander of the 6th Column of the Northeast Democratic United Army. Later, he served as Chief of the General Staff and Commander of the Guangzhou Military Region. He was one of the principal culprits in the Lin Biao anti-revolutionary clique case, dismissed due to the Lin Biao incident, and also supported Wei Guoqing in suppressing the 'April 22' faction.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任空军司令员。林彪反革命集团主犯之一。
description.en: An Air Force General of the People's Liberation Army, once served as Commander of the Air Force. One of the main culprits of the Lin Biao counter-revolutionary clique.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军中将，林彪反革命集团主要成员之一，曾任海军政治委员。
description.en: A Navy Vice Admiral of the People's Liberation Army, one of the main culprits of the Lin Biao counter-revolutionary clique.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将。作为林彪集团主要成员，他曾任总后勤部部长，并是林彪反革命集团主犯之一。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army. As a key member of the Lin Biao group, he once served as the Minister of the General Logistics Department and was one of the principal culprits of the Lin Biao anti-revolutionary clique.

description.zh-cn: 关于工业、农业、交通运输业和国防现代化的国家战略目标。
旨在解决朝鲜半岛和印度支那问题的国际会议，会议决定以北纬17度线为界暂时分割越南。
description.en: An international conference to resolve issues in the Korean Peninsula and Indochina, which decided to temporarily partition Vietnam at the 17th parallel.

description.zh-cn: 中国妇女运动的先驱，觉悟社成员。
中国共产党创始人之一，哲学家、政治活动家，介绍朱德入党。后为农工党党员，在反右运动中被划为右派。
description.en: One of the founders of the Communist Party of China, a philosopher and political activist. Later, he became a member of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party and was labeled a rightist during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，革命烈士，在四一二事件后的搜捕中被杀害。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Communist Party of China, who was killed in the roundups following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期领导人之一，曾负责情报保卫工作，并担任中共中央特科负责人。1931年被捕后叛变，投靠国民党，导致包括向忠发在内的大量中共地下党员被捕。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), who was responsible for intelligence and security work and served as the head of the CCP's special service (Teke). After being arrested in 1931, he defected to the Kuomintang, leading to the arrest of many underground CCP members, including Xiang Zhongfa.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人，曾任中共中央政治局主席、中共中央总书记。因出身工人阶级而被共产国际提拔，但实际领导权多由周恩来、李立三等人掌握。1931年在上海被国民政府逮捕后迅速叛变并被处决。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), serving as Chairman of the CCP Central Politburo and General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee. He was promoted by the Comintern due to his working-class background, but actual leadership was often held by others like Zhou Enlai and Li Lisan. After his arrest by the Nationalist government in Shanghai in 1931, he quickly defected and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人。他曾任中共驻共产国际代表团团长，后被共产国际派遣回国，逐渐取代向忠发成为中共实际领导人，并在向忠发死后代理总书记。他被认为是“左”倾教条主义的代表，国际派人物，二十八个半布尔什维克之一，也是瞿秋白的政治对手。其宗派主义和肃反扩大化错误导致孙冶方受到处分。1938年，他与康生等人领导了对陈独秀的抹黑攻击，指控其为“汉奸”。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party. He served as the head of the CCP delegation to the Comintern, and after being sent back to China by the Comintern, he gradually replaced Xiang Zhongfa as the de facto leader of the CCP, and later served as acting General Secretary after Xiang's death. He was considered a representative of 'left' dogmatism, a figure of the International Faction, one of the '28 and a half Bolsheviks', and a political opponent of Qu Qiubai. His factionalism and expansion of purges led to Sun Yefang being disciplined. In 1938, he, along with Kang Sheng and others, led the smear campaign against Chen Duxiu, accusing him of being a 'traitor'.

zh-cn: 理查德·米尔豪斯·尼克松

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，曾任美国副总统，并在1960年总统选举中作为共和党候选人与肯尼迪竞争，后成为美国第37任总统。他于1972年访华，与毛泽东会晤，推动了中美关系正常化，并为中日建交创造了条件。此次访问导致中阿关系破裂，并于1973年在白宫会见了田中角荣。
description.en: American politician, served as Vice President, and competed with Kennedy as a Republican candidate in the 1960 presidential election, later becoming the 37th President of the United States. His 1972 visit to China, including a meeting with Mao Zedong, promoted the normalization of Sino-US relations and created conditions for the establishment of Sino-Japanese diplomatic relations. This visit led to the breakdown of Sino-Albanian relations, and in 1973, he met with Kakuei Tanaka at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 美国外交家、政治家及国际关系专家，曾任美国国家安全顾问、国务卿及美国总统特使。1973年，他作为特使会见毛泽东，毛泽东首次向其提出了“一条线”的外交战略。他还曾对薄熙来主政时期的重庆发展持正面评价，并拜访过少林寺。
description.en: An American diplomat, political scientist, and international relations expert, who served as United States National Security Advisor, Secretary of State, and U.S. Presidential Envoy. In 1973, as an envoy, he met with Mao Zedong, who first proposed the 'one line' diplomatic strategy to him. He also once held a positive view of Chongqing's development during Bo Xilai's era and visited the Shaolin Temple.

zh-cn: 第二届全国人民代表大会
第三届全国人民代表大会
中华人民共和国第三届全国人民代表大会
en: 3rd National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家权力机关的第三届会议，时传祥曾当选为该届代表。
description.en: The third session of the highest state authority of the People's Republic of China, to which Shi Chuanxiang was elected as a deputy.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军是中华人民共和国在朝鲜战争中派遣并支援朝鲜的武装力量总称。名义上以“志愿”军队参战，实际上是以中国人民解放军完整建制参加战斗，是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army was the common name for the armed forces dispatched by the People's Republic of China during the Korean War to aid North Korea. While nominally participating as a 'volunteer' army, it was in fact a fully-fledged unit of the People's Liberation Army and a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 彭德怀的出生地。
彭德怀的第二任妻子。
彭德怀的侄女。
湘军，是晚清时期由曾国藩组建的湖南地方武装，其活动延续至民国初年，是清朝镇压太平天国的主要军事力量。黄公略曾于1916年加入此部队。
description.en: The Xiang Army was a regional army from Hunan organized by Zeng Guofan during the late Qing Dynasty. Its operations extended into the early Republic of China period, serving as the primary military force for the Qing dynasty in suppressing the Taiping Rebellion. Huang Gonglue joined this force in 1916.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军高级将领，曾任红三军军长，中国人民解放军军事家之一。1931年9月战斗牺牲。
description.en: A senior commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Commander of the Third Red Army, and recognized as one of the PLA's militarists. Died in battle in September 1931.

description.zh-cn: 湖南督军。中华民国军事将领。
中国共产党党员，对彭德怀早期思想有影响。
彭德怀在湘军时的师长。
中国军事人物，鲁涤平在湖南省政府主席职位上的前任。
description.en: A Chinese military figure, predecessor of Lu Diping as the Chairman of Hunan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 1928年由彭德怀、黄公略等人领导的武装起义，起义后建立了红五军。
description.en: A military uprising led by Peng Dehuai, Huang Gonglue and others in 1928, which led to the formation of the Red 5th Army.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第四军 (红一方面军)
en: Fourth Red Army of the First Front Army
Fourth Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army

description.zh-cn: 由朱德和毛泽东的部队在井冈山会师后组成的红军主力部队之一。
description.en: A Red Army unit formed after the rendezvous of Zhu De's and Mao Zedong's forces at Jinggangshan.

description.zh-cn: 井冈山地方武装首领，后加入红军。1930年被彭德怀杀害。
description.en: A local armed leader in the Jinggang Mountains who later joined the Red Army. He was killed by Peng Dehuai in 1930.

description.zh-cn: 井冈山地方武装首领，后加入红军。1930年被彭德怀杀害。
description.en: A local armed leader in the Jinggang Mountains who later joined the Red Army. He was killed by Peng Dehuai in 1930.

description.zh-cn: 长江局代表。
国民革命军第18师师长，在第一次江西剿共战争期间为鲁涤平的下属。
description.en: Commander of the 18th Division of the National Revolutionary Army, a subordinate of Lu Diping during the First Jiangxi Encirclement Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领。
中国人民解放军大将，红十五军团的指挥官。
description.en: A Senior General of the People's Liberation Army and commander of the 15th Army Group of the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，长期负责中共情报保卫和特务工作，曾任中共中央社会部部长。
description.en: A senior general of the Chinese Communist Party, long responsible for intelligence and secret service work, who served as the head of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领。
中国工农红军和八路军高级将领。曾任红一军团参谋长、代理军团长，后任八路军副参谋长。
description.en: A senior general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the Eighth Route Army. He served as Chief of Staff and acting Commander of the Red First Army Group, and later as Deputy Chief of Staff of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将、国民革命军将领，黄埔军校第一期毕业，是蒋介石最信任的将领之一。早年曾是王亚樵的门生。他曾参与东征、北伐、长征期间对红军的围堵、抗日战争和国共内战，号称“西北王”。
description.en: A first-class general of the Republic of China Army and National Revolutionary Army, a graduate of the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy, and one of Chiang Kai-shek's most trusted generals. In his early years, he was a student of Wang Yaqiao. He participated in the Eastern Expedition, Northern Expedition, the encirclement and blocking of the Red Army during the Long March, the Second Sino-Japanese War, and the Chinese Civil War, known as the 'King of the Northwest'.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清浙江省宁波府镇海县
birth_place.en: Zhenhai County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, Qing dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省台北市
death_place.en: Taipei, Taiwan Province, Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，国军整编第29军军长，在宜川战役中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China who was killed in action during the Yichuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领，青海王。
曾任新疆警备总司令，第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Former Commander-in-Chief of Xinjiang Garrison, and Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期，负责中国西北地区军政事务的领导机构，也是该区域的最高行政机关。
description.en: The leading military and political body, and also the highest administrative organ, for China's Northwest Greater Administrative Region in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军新疆军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾设的六大军区之一。
朝鲜外务相。
美国陆军五星上将、菲律宾陆军元帅，曾任美国陆军参谋长、联合国军总司令、驻日盟军总司令，代表同盟国接受日本投降并主导了战后对日本的占领。在莱特湾海战期间，第七舰队归其指挥的西南太平洋方面军管辖。1949年曾邀请孙立人至东京会谈，表示美国将支持其防卫台湾。
description.en: An American five-star general and Field Marshal of the Philippine Army, who was Chief of Staff of the United States Army, Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command, and Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers. He accepted Japan's surrender on behalf of the Allies and led the post-war occupation of Japan. During the Battle of Leyte Gulf, the Seventh Fleet was under the command of his Southwest Pacific Area. In 1949, he invited Sun Li-jen to Tokyo for talks, stating that the United States would support him in defending Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与杨开慧的长子，毛岸青之兄，任彭德怀秘书，在朝鲜战争中阵亡。
description.en: The eldest son of Mao Zedong and Yang Kaihui, older brother of Mao Anqing, and secretary to Peng Dehuai, who was killed in action during the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的创立者和第一代最高领导人，被尊为“共和国永远的主席”，曾任朝鲜总理。他曾是游击队派首领。在朝鲜战争期间，他担任朝鲜人民军最高司令官，并签署了《朝鲜停战协定》。1950年代，他在国内对延安派以及“去斯大林化”的支持者进行了政治清洗。他也是金正日的父亲，金正哲的祖父。
description.en: Founder and first supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, honored as the 'Eternal President of the Republic', and also served as Premier of North Korea. He was a leader of the Guerrilla faction. During the Korean War, he served as the Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army and signed the Korean Armistice Agreement. In the 1950s, he conducted political purges domestically against the Yan'an faction and supporters of de-Stalinization. He was also the father of Kim Jong-il and grandfather of Kim Jong-chul.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民志愿军副司令员、代司令员、司令员。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, he served as Deputy Commander, Acting Commander, and Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军元帅、中华人民共和国元帅、中国共产党军事家、政治家，中国人民解放军和中华人民共和国的创建者与领导人之一。他曾任红一军团政治部主任、中国人民解放军总政治部主任、中央人民政府最高人民检察署检察长。在抗日战争和第二次国共内战期间，他组建并领导山东军区，对中共在山东乃至全国的军事胜利起到了关键作用。
description.en: A Marshal of the People's Liberation Army and the People's Republic of China, a Chinese Communist military leader and politician, and one of the founders and leaders of the People's Liberation Army and the People's Republic of China. He served as Director of the Political Department of the Red First Army Group, Director of the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army, and Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the Central People's Government. During the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Chinese Civil War, he founded and led the Shandong Military Region, playing a crucial role in the CCP's military victories in Shandong and across the country.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，曾任中共湖南省委第一书记。因在庐山会议上支持彭德怀，被错误地打成反党集团成员。他还是姚依林的入党介绍人。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China and former First Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Committee of the CPC. He was wrongly branded a member of an anti-Party group for supporting Peng Dehuai at the Lushan Conference. He also introduced Yao Yilin to the party.

description.zh-cn: 北京地质学院红卫兵造反派。
红卫兵头目。

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·拉祖瓦耶夫
弗拉基米尔·尼古拉耶维奇·拉祖瓦耶夫

birth_place.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国库尔斯克省阿列克谢耶夫卡村

description.zh-cn: 苏联军事将领、外交官，陆军中将军衔。曾参与俄国内战、苏芬战争、第二次世界大战和朝鲜战争。苏德战争期间历任多个方面军及集团军要职，朝鲜战争期间任苏联驻朝鲜特命全权大使兼朝鲜人民军总顾问。
description.en: Soviet military leader and diplomat with the rank of Lieutenant General. Participated in the Russian Civil War, Winter War, World War II, and the Korean War. Held key positions in various fronts and armies during the Soviet-German War, and served as the Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the USSR to North Korea and Chief Military Advisor to the Korean People's Army during the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 徐向前的儿子。
中国政治人物，山西省立国民师范学校校友，中国工农红军及中国人民解放军高级将领，曾指高岗在热河土改中推行极左路线。
description.en: Chinese politician, alumnus of Shanxi Provincial National Normal School, a senior general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the People's Liberation Army, who once accused Gao Gang of implementing an ultra-left policy in the land reform of Rehe.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥，中华民国军事将领及政治人物，西北军领袖，民国军阀。早年曾是直系将领，在第二次直奉战争中接受奉系贿赂，倒戈发动甲子政变（即北京政变），导致直系战败并将溥仪逐出紫禁城。因其部队被称为“基督将军”。他曾创办西北军第二军官学校，并作为反蒋联军副总司令之一，在中原大战中与阎锡山联合反蒋。其部下石友三曾火烧少林寺。孙殿英曾依附于其名下。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang, a military general and political figure in the Republic of China, leader of the Guominjun (Northwest Army), and a warlord. Early in his career, he was a general of the Zhili clique. During the Second Zhili-Fengtian War, he accepted a heavy bribe from the Fengtian clique, defected, and launched the Beijing Coup, leading to the Zhili clique's defeat and the expulsion of Puyi from the Forbidden City. He was known as the 'Christian General' for his troops. He founded the Northwest Army Second Military Officers' School and served as one of the deputy commanders-in-chief of the anti-Chiang coalition, allying with Yan Xishan against Chiang Kai-shek in the Central Plains War. His subordinate Shi Yousan once set fire to the Shaolin Temple. Sun Dianying briefly aligned with him.

description.zh-cn: 红四方面军早期领导人，后被张国焘杀害。
红四方面军政治委员，西路军政委，同时也是长征期间重要的政治领导人之一。
description.en: Political Commissar of the Fourth Front Army and the Western Route Army, and an important political leader during the Long March.

zh-cn: 山西省立国民师范学校

description.zh-cn: 徐向前、薄一波早年就读的师范学校。
description.en: The normal school that Xu Xiangqian and Bo Yibo attended in their early years.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第四方面军
en: Fourth Front Army of the Red Army
Fourth Front Army of the Chinese Red Army

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军主力部队之一。由张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩领导，其中徐向前是主要军事领导人，长征时期由张国焘领导。
description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. It was led by Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao. Xu Xiangqian was one of its main military leaders, and it was led by Zhang Guotao during the Long March.

en: Alumni Association of Huangpu Military Academy

description.zh-cn: 由黄埔军校校友组成的联谊组织，宋希濂曾任副会长。
description.en: An organization composed of alumni of the Whampoa Military Academy, where Song Xilian served as vice president.

description.zh-cn: 中国山西省忻州市下辖的县，是李力安的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Xinzhou, Shanxi province, China, and the birthplace of Li Li'an.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代著名的军事院校，朱德曾就读于此。叶剑英也曾于1917年在此学习，并于1920年毕业。
description.en: A famous modern military academy in China, where Zhu De once studied. Ye Jianying also studied here from 1917 and graduated in 1920.

zh-cn: 格奥尔格·奥古斯特·哥廷根大学

description.zh-cn: 位于德国哥廷根的公立研究型大学，朱德曾在此留学。
description.en: A public research university in Göttingen, Germany.

description.zh-cn: 朱德的原配夫人
朱德的第三位妻子
朱德的第五位妻子
中国政治人物，朱德的第六任妻子，中国妇女解放运动的领导人。曾任全国妇联主席，第七届全国政协妇女青年委员会主任，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, the sixth wife of Zhu De, and a leader of the women's liberation movement in China. She served as the Chairwoman of the All-China Women's Federation, the Director of the Women and Youth Committee of the 7th CPPCC National Committee, and a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 朱德的女儿，曾任北京师范大学俄语系教授。
description.en: The daughter of Zhu De, a former professor in the Russian Department at Beijing Normal University.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会
中共中央纪律检查委员会
十三届中央纪律检查委员会
en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Chinese Communist Party
Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党最高纪律检查机关。该机构负责对薄熙来、陈良宇、周本顺、成克杰等事件立案调查，并据报道是推动香港修订《逃犯条例》的真正倡议者。
description.en: The highest internal disciplinary body of the Communist Party of China. It is responsible for investigating incidents involving figures like Bo Xilai, Chen Liangyu, Zhou Benshun, and Cheng Kejie, and was reportedly the true initiator behind Hong Kong's push to amend the extradition law.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命是一场全国性资产阶级民主革命，推翻了清朝统治，建立了中华民国。革命始于1911年武昌起义，促使清宣统帝退位。北洋军阀袁世凯利用军事实力攫取革命果实，摄政王载沣顺应潮流辞职。此次革命由邵玉轩斥巨资资助，鲁涤平也曾参与其中。革命后，梁思成随家人从日本回国。
description.en: The Xinhai Revolution was a nationwide bourgeois democratic revolution that overthrew the Qing dynasty and established the Republic of China. It began with the Wuchang Uprising in 1911, leading to the abdication of Emperor Xuantong. Warlord Yuan Shikai exploited his military power to seize the revolution's fruits, and Prince-Regent Zaifeng resigned in response to the changing times. The revolution received significant funding from Shao Yuxuan, and Lu Diping also participated. After the revolution, Liang Sicheng returned to China from Japan with his family.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，曾提拔朱德，曾为范石生的上级，后被唐继尧击败身亡。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army, formerly Fan Shisheng's superior, who was later defeated and killed by Tang Jiyao.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党左派领导人，中国农工民主党创始人之一。
description.en: A leader of the Kuomintang (KMT) left wing, and one of the founders of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 川军将领
国民革命军高级将领，中国军事及政治人物。他是朱德的老同学，亦是鲁涤平在江西省政府主席职位上的前任。
description.en: A senior general of the National Revolutionary Army, and a Chinese military and political figure. He was an old classmate of Zhu De and also the predecessor of Lu Diping as the Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，滇军著名将领，朱德的故旧。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and a notable commander in the Yunnan Army.

description.zh-cn: 1928年1月，由朱德、陈毅等率领南昌起义余部在湖南南部发动的系列武装起义。
description.en: A series of armed uprisings launched in southern Hunan in January 1928, led by Zhu De, Chen Yi, and others with the remaining forces of the Nanchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 朱德和毛泽东在红四军建军原则和领导方式上的分歧
中华民国军事人物、军阀，曾为冯玉祥部下，国民革命军将领。1928年，他曾纵火焚烧少林寺，造成严重破坏。张作霖死后，张学成曾投靠于他。在中原大战中，他加入反蒋联军并任第四方面军指挥官，后在该战役中失败。
description.en: A military figure and warlord of the Republic of China, formerly a subordinate of Feng Yuxiang and a general of the National Revolutionary Army. In 1928, he set fire to the Shaolin Temple, causing severe damage. After Zhang Zuolin's death, Zhang Xuecheng once defected to him. During the Central Plains War, he joined the anti-Chiang coalition as the commander of the 4th Front Army and was later defeated in the war.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军陆军二级上将，中华民国军事将领。赵家骧曾在其麾下任职。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China, holding the rank of Second-rank General in the National Revolutionary Army. Zhao Jiaxiang served under him.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，中国共产党在根据地内展开的生产自救运动，李富春是组织者之一。
description.en: A self-help production campaign launched by the Chinese Communist Party in its base areas during the Second Sino-Japanese War, which Li Fuchun helped organize.

description.zh-cn: 建国初期中国共产党在党政机关和工商界开展的政治运动
澳大利亚联邦总理

birth_place.en: Wugang Prefecture, Baoqing Fu, Hunan Province

description.zh-cn: 清末民初著名政治家、军事家，东京振武学校校友。他曾是梁启超在时务学堂的学生，也是护国运动（护国战争）的主要组织者和领导者，发动战争反对袁世凯称帝。他被誉为“护国大将军”，曾幸免于袁世凯派遣的刺客暗杀。他与黄兴是同乡和友人，为黄兴写下挽联，后亦同葬于岳麓山。
description.en: A famous politician and military strategist of the late Qing and early Republic of China periods, and an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. He was a student of Liang Qichao at the Academy of Current Affairs, and a key organizer and leader of the National Protection War, launched against Yuan Shikai's attempt to restore monarchy. Hailed as the 'Great General of National Protection', he survived an assassination attempt by assassins sent by Yuan Shikai. He was a fellow townsman and friend of Huang Xing, wrote a funeral couplet for him, and was later buried alongside him on Yuelu Mountain.

description.zh-cn: 林彪与叶群之子，中华人民共和国文化大革命时期政治人物。曾任解放军空军司令部办公室副主任兼作战部副部长，是《“571工程”纪要》的主要策划者。
description.en: Son of Lin Biao and Ye Qun, a political figure during China's Cultural Revolution. He served as Deputy Director of the Air Force Command Headquarters Office and Deputy Minister of the Combat Department, and was the main planner of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林彪与叶群之女，林立果的姐姐，《空军报》副总编。
description.en: Chinese political figure, daughter of Lin Biao and Ye Qun.

description.zh-cn: 林彪的女儿。
林彪的前妻。
林彪的堂兄，中共早期领导人。
林彪的堂兄，中共早期领导人。
中国清朝武官，本籍福建厦门。曾任台湾镇总兵，在1862年的戴潮春事件中的斗六门战役殉职。
description.en: A military official of the Qing Dynasty from Xiamen, Fujian. He served as the Taiwan Town General and was killed in the Battle of Douliumen during the Dai Chaochun Incident in 1862.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，曾任越南民主共和国政府总理。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician who served as the Prime Minister of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南民主共和国国防部长。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第四野战军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在第二次国共内战时期的主力部队之一，由东北野战军改称。
description.en: One of the main forces of the People's Liberation Army during the Second Chinese Civil War, renamed from the Northeast Field Army.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十八集团军第115师
en: 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army

description.zh-cn: 八路军主力师之一，由红一方面军主力和陕南红七十四师改编而成。抗日战争期间，由林彪、罗荣桓等人率领进入山东，其部队成为组建山东军区的基础。该师曾在陆房战斗中被日军包围。
description.en: One of the main divisions of the Eighth Route Army, reorganized from the main force of the First Front Army of the Red Army and the 74th Red Division of Southern Shaanxi. During the Second Sino-Japanese War, it was led by figures like Lin Biao and Luo Ronghuan into Shandong, and its troops became the foundation for the establishment of the Shandong Military Region. This division was once surrounded by the Japanese army in the Lufang Battle.

zh-cn: 中国人民抗日军事政治大学
中国人民抗日军政大学
中国人民抗日红军大学
抗日军政大学第七分校
en: Chinese People's Anti-Japanese Military and Political University

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学的前身之一。该校源于中国工农红军大学，于中国工农红军时期为培养中高级军事政治干部而设立。1936年6月更名为中国人民抗日红军大学，1937年初再更名为抗日军政大学。作为中国共产党在抗日战争时期创办的学校，其主要任务是培养军事和政治干部。余秋里曾在此学习。
description.en: One of the predecessors of the PLA National Defense University. The school originated from the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army University, established during the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army period to train middle and senior military and political cadres. It was renamed the Chinese People's Anti-Japanese Red Army University in June 1936, and further renamed the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University in early 1937. Founded by the Communist Party of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War, its primary mission was to train military and political cadres. Yu Qiuli once studied here.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第九届中央委员会第二次全体会议
en: Second Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 在庐山召开的中共中央全会，林彪、陈伯达等人与毛泽东在设立国家主席等问题上发生严重分歧。此次会议标志着毛泽东和林彪关系公开破裂并迅速恶化，也成为陈伯达政治生涯的转折点。
description.en: A plenary session of the CPC Central Committee held in Lushan, where Lin Biao, Chen Boda, and others had serious disagreements with Mao Zedong on issues such as the establishment of the state chairmanship. This meeting marked the public breakdown and rapid deterioration of relations between Mao Zedong and Lin Biao, and also became a turning point in Chen Boda's political career.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间八路军首次集中较大兵力对日军的一次成功伏击战。
特指文革期间对毛泽东的个人崇拜。

en: Constitution of the Chinese Communist Party
Constitution of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的根本法规，规定其组织架构和行为准则。1982年修订的章程还明确了中央顾问委员会的设立、地位和职能。
description.en: The fundamental regulations of the Communist Party of China, which stipulates its organizational structure and code of conduct. The constitution revised in 1982 also clarified the establishment, status, and functions of the Central Advisory Commission.

zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（苏联）是列宁和布尔什维克党建立的联邦制社会主义国家，1922年至1991年间存在于欧亚大陆北部。作为20世纪共产主义超级大国，是联合国创始会员国及安理会常任理事国。苏联领导社会主义阵营，在冷战时期与美国对峙。它对早期中国共产党及国共关系有重要影响，曾支持中国共产党建立中华苏维埃共和国，并在二战中作为同盟国对中国提供援助、对日宣战。国共内战后，与中华人民共和国结盟，但在中苏交恶后，被中国视为主要安全威胁，并成为“一条线、一大片”战略的主要针对对象。苏联是首个实现载人航天的国家，切尔诺贝利核事故发生时，乌克兰是其加盟共和国之一。黎笋执政期间，它是越南战争中北越的主要支持者。
description.en: The Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR) was a federal socialist state established by Lenin and the Bolshevik Party, existing from 1922 to 1991 in Northern Eurasia. As a 20th-century communist superpower, it was a founding member of the United Nations and a permanent member of the Security Council. The USSR led the socialist bloc, confronting the United States during the Cold War. It significantly influenced the early Communist Party of China and KMT-CPC relations, supported the establishment of the Chinese Soviet Republic, and as an Allied member during WWII, aided China and declared war on Japan. After the Chinese Civil War, it allied with the People's Republic of China. However, after the Sino-Soviet split, it was regarded by China as a major security threat and became the primary target of the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy. The USSR was the first country to achieve human spaceflight, and Ukraine was one of its constituent republics at the time of the Chernobyl disaster. During Lê Duẩn's rule, it was a key supporter of North Vietnam during the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的第一任妻子。
description.en: The first wife of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济的女儿，毛泽东的第一任妻子，毛岸英、毛岸青、毛岸龙的母亲，毛新宇的祖母。
description.en: Daughter of Yang Changji, the first wife of Mao Zedong, mother of Mao Anying, Mao Anqing, and Mao Anlong, and grandmother of Mao Xinyu.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的第三任妻子，曾任第五届全国政协委员。
description.en: The third wife of Mao Zedong, who served as a member of the Fifth National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东和毛泽民的父亲，与毛宁之父毛贻发同属贻字辈。
description.en: Father of Mao Zedong and Mao Zemin, and belongs to the same 'Yi' generation as Mao Ning's father, Mao Yifa.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东和毛泽民的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Mao Zedong and Mao Zemin.

death_place.zh-cn: 北京市中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与杨开慧的次子，中国共产党党员，毛新宇之父。他曾任中共中央宣传部马列著作编译室俄文翻译，翻译出版了多部马列著作及政治理论书籍。晚年患有精神疾病。
description.en: Second son of Mao Zedong and Yang Kaihui, a member of the Chinese Communist Party, and father of Mao Xinyu. He served as a Russian translator in the Compilation and Translation Bureau of Marxist-Leninist Works of the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee, translating and publishing multiple works of Marxism-Leninism and political theory books. He suffered from mental illness in his later years.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与杨开慧三子，毛岸青之弟。
description.en: The third son of Mao Zedong and Yang Kaihui, and younger brother of Mao Anqing.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与贺子珍的女儿，江青继女，李讷的姐姐。
中国文化大革命时期政治人物，毛泽东与江青的女儿，毛岸青的异母姊妹。
中国共产党财经干部、政治人物，毛泽东之弟、毛远新之父。他曾化名周彬在新疆工作，后被新疆军阀盛世才杀害。
description.en: A financial cadre of the Communist Party of China and a politician. He was the younger brother of Mao Zedong and the father of Mao Yuanxin. He worked in Xinjiang under the alias Zhou Bin and was later killed by the Xinjiang warlord Sheng Shicai.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东和毛泽民的弟弟。
description.en: Younger brother of Mao Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代教育家、伦理学家。他曾留学日本、英国，归国后任教于湖南省立第一师范学校、北京大学等多所学校，是毛泽东的教员及杨开慧的父亲。对毛泽东、蔡和森等学生有深刻影响。
description.en: A modern Chinese educator and ethicist. He studied in Japan and the United Kingdom. After returning to China, he taught at several normal schools in Hunan, including Hunan First Normal School, and at Peking University. He was Mao Zedong's teacher and Yang Kaihui's father, profoundly influencing students like Mao Zedong and Cai Hesen.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家和教育家，毛泽东在湖南省立第一师范学校的教员，被誉为“延安五老”之一。
毛泽东在湖南省立第一师范学校的教员。
中国共产主义的先驱，中国共产党的主要创始人之一、早期主要领导人。他曾安排毛泽东在北京大学图书馆工作，并于北京发起中国共产党早期组织，张太雷于1920年10月加入该组织。1927年4月28日在北京被张作霖下令绞刑处决。
description.en: A pioneer of Chinese communism and one of the main founders and early key leaders of the Chinese Communist Party. He arranged for Mao Zedong to work at the Peking University Library and initiated the early CPC organization in Beijing, which Zhang Tailei joined in October 1920. He was executed by hanging in Beijing on April 28, 1927, under the orders of Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人。他曾任新四军副军长兼政委、中共苏区中央分局书记，是新四军的创建人和主要领导人之一。早期曾在湖北省总工会担任向忠发的副手。他还曾安排护送瞿秋白转移，并在战略问题上与叶挺存在分歧。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party. He served as the Deputy Commander and Political Commissar of the New Fourth Army, and Secretary of the CPC Central Bureau in Soviet Areas, being one of the founders and principal leaders of the New Fourth Army. Earlier, he served as Xiang Zhongfa's deputy at the Hubei Provincial General Labor Union. He also arranged the transfer of Qu Qiubai and had disagreements with Ye Ting on strategic issues.

description.zh-cn: 印度首任总理。
北京大学的图书馆。
1927年，中国共产党由毛泽东在湘赣边界领导的一次武装起义。
description.en: An armed uprising led by Mao Zedong and the Chinese Communist Party in 1927 in the Hunan-Jiangxi border region.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的哲学著作。
毛泽东的哲学著作。
毛泽东关于中国革命道路的著作。
毛泽东为纪念中国共产党成立二十八周年而写的文章。

zh-cn: 中央人民政府最高人民检察署

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的国家最高检察机关，是中华人民共和国最高人民检察院的前身。
罗荣桓的次子，中国人民解放军中将，曾任第二炮兵副政治委员。
中国人民解放军开国上将，曾任红一军团第一师政治委员。他也是罗荣桓的亲家。
description.en: A founding general of the People's Liberation Army, he served as Political Commissar of the First Division of the Red First Army Group. He was also a relative by marriage of Luo Ronghuan.

description.zh-cn: 山东大学、中国海洋大学的前身之一。
中国工农红军第四军第九次党代表大会。

zh-cn: 国民革命军第八路军山东军区
国民革命军第十八集团军山东军区
en: Shandong Column of the Eighth Route Army

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争至第二次国共内战时期中国共产党在山东设立的军事组织，是华北四大根据地之一。其部队为第四野战军和第三野战军的建立奠定了重要基础。该番号于1947年2月撤销，1949年2月重建，至1955年改编为济南军区。
description.en: A military organization established by the Communist Party of China in Shandong during the Second Sino-Japanese War and the second Chinese Civil War. It was one of the four major bases in North China. Its troops laid an important foundation for the establishment of the Fourth and Third Field Armies. The designation was abolished in February 1947, re-established in February 1949, and reorganized into the Jinan Military Region in 1955.

en: Shandong Sub-bureau of the CPC Central Committee
Shandong Sub-bureau of the CCP Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，中共中央在山东设立的领导机构，作为其在山东地区的派出机构。
description.en: During the Anti-Japanese War, it served as the leadership body established by the CCP Central Committee in Shandong and its dispatched agency in the region.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共中央在东北地区的派出机构，它曾是中国共产党在西满地区及辽东省的领导机构，李富春曾任其书记。
description.en: As a branch of the CPC Central Committee in Northeast China, it served as the leading body of the Chinese Communist Party in the West Manchuria region and Liaodong Province, where Li Fuchun once served as its secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在东北地区设立的军事组织，是第二次国共内战时期的大军区之一，李富春曾任其副政委。
description.en: A military organization established by the People's Liberation Army in Northeast China. It functioned as one of the major military regions during the Second Chinese Civil War, and Li Fuchun served as its deputy political commissar.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央在华中地区的派出机构。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府 (1949年—1954年)
中华人民共和国中央人民政府
中华人民共和国中央人民政府 (1949年－1954年)
en: Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China (1949–1954)

description.zh-cn: 1949年至1954年间，作为中华人民共和国成立初期的中央政府，它是行使国家政权的最高机关，同时也是最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The central government in the early days of the People's Republic of China (1949-1954), it served as both the highest organ of state power and the highest state administrative organ.

description.zh-cn: 他是中国人民解放军、中国工农红军及八路军高级将领。曾任红一军团第二师师长、八路军115师代师长兼343旅旅长，并参与指挥陆房战斗。他也是洪学智在东北民主联军第六纵队司令员职位上的前任。
description.en: He was a senior general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, and the Eighth Route Army. He served as Commander of the Second Division of the Red First Army Group, acting commander of the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army, and commander of the 343rd Brigade, participating in the command of the Lufang Battle. He was also the predecessor to Hong Xuezhi as commander of the 6th Column of the Northeast Democratic United Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，曾任八路军686团团长。
description.en: A Founding General of the People's Liberation Army, who served as Commander of the 686th Regiment of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将。曾任红一军团第十五师政治委员、空军首任政治委员、中国人民解放军总政治部主任。他在军委扩大会议上逮捕了钟伟。
description.en: A founding general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Political Commissar of the Fifteenth Division of the Red First Army Group, the first political commissar of the Air Force, and Director of the PLA General Political Department. He arrested Zhong Wei during an enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级干部，中国政治人物。曾任中共中央华东局副书记、中共山东省政府主席并兼任山东省司法厅首任厅长。
description.en: A senior cadre of the Communist Party of China and a Chinese politician. He served as the Deputy Secretary of the CPC Central China Bureau, Chairman of the Shandong Provincial Government, and concurrently as the first Director of the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 八路军将领。
中国人民解放军开国中将。曾任第38军军长、成都军区司令员，在朝鲜战争中指挥的第38军有“万岁军”之称。
description.en: A founding lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army of China. He served as the commander of the 38th Army and the Chengdu Military Region, and the 38th Army he commanded in the Korean War was known as the 'Long Live Army'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领。
原国民革命军将领，曾于1943年1月率部投靠汪精卫国民政府。后任国民党整编第九十六军军长，并在济南战役中率部起义，投诚中共。
description.en: A former general of the National Revolutionary Army, who defected with his troops to the Wang Jingwei regime in January 1943. Later, he served as commander of the Kuomintang's Reorganized 96th Army, and during the Jinan Campaign, he led his troops in an uprising and defected to the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 原伪军将领，后率部反正。
聂荣臻元配夫人
聂荣臻夫人
聂荣臻女儿，中国人民解放军中将
聂荣臻女婿，中国人民解放军上将，中国工程院院士，曾任国防科工委主任。
description.en: An academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, former Director of the Commission for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 位于苏联，是培养马克思主义理论干部的高等院校。王稼祥曾在此深造。

法国，全称法兰西共和国，位于西欧，实行半总统制。其君主头衔自腓力二世时期由“法兰克国王”变更为“法兰西国王”。法国曾于19-20世纪中期殖民越南，并在加拿大和上海设立殖民地与租界，在亚历山大三世统治后期与俄罗斯帝国关系密切。该国率先参与利比亚军事干预，并与加拿大同为法语国家及地区国际组织成员。法国政府曾授予巩俐“艺术与文学勋章”司令勋位，同时也是《哲学的贫困》的出版地之一。2025年，其法院就霍姆斯市爆炸案对巴沙尔·阿萨德发出逮捕令。
description.en: France, officially the French Republic, located in Western Europe, operates under a semi-presidential system. Its monarchical title changed from "King of the Franks" to "King of France" during the reign of Philip II. From the mid-19th to mid-20th century, France colonized Vietnam and established colonies and concessions in Canada and Shanghai, and developed a close relationship with the Russian Empire during the later reign of Alexander III. The country took a leading role in the military intervention in Libya and is a member of the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie alongside Canada. The French government awarded Gong Li the rank of Commander of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres. It is also one of the publication places of 'The Poverty of Philosophy'. In 2025, its courts issued an arrest warrant for Bashar al-Assad in connection with the bombing of Homs.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在解放战争时期设立的一级军区，也是曾设的七大军区之一。
description.en: A first-level military region established by the People's Liberation Army during the Chinese Civil War, and also one of the seven former military regions.

description.zh-cn: 聂荣臻的家乡
位于西北欧的联邦君主立宪制国家，欧盟和北约的创始成员国之一，也是协约国成员国之一。该国是富通集团总部所在地，也是《哲学的贫困》的出版地之一。
description.en: A federal constitutional monarchy in Northwest Europe, it is one of the founding members of the EU and NATO, and also a member state of the Entente Powers. It is also home to the Fortis Group headquarters and one of the places where 'The Poverty of Philosophy' was published.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，曾任中央政治局常委，后被向忠发和李立三排挤出中央领导核心。他也是杨昌济的学生。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party, who served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee before being pushed out of the central leadership by Xiang Zhongfa and Li Lisan. He was also a student of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期妇女运动领导人
1926年发生于广州的政治事件，导致国共合作关系出现裂痕，宋希濂因此事件脱离中国共产党。
description.en: A political incident in Guangzhou in 1926 that caused a rift in the KMT-CPC cooperation, leading Song Xilian to leave the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 由蒋中正在上海发动的针对中国共产党的武力清党行动，导致国共两党正式决裂，并成为第一次国共内战的导火索之一。
description.en: A violent purge of Chinese Communist Party members in Shanghai, initiated by Chiang Kai-shek, which led to the formal split between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party, and served as one of the catalysts for the First Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 红一方面军在陕西省直罗镇的一场战役，红一军团参与其中。
description.en: A battle fought by the First Front Army of the Red Army in Zhiluo Town, Shaanxi Province, in which the Red First Army Group participated.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，时任关东军高级参谋，甲级战犯。他是九一八事变和建立满洲国的主要策划者之一。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army, Senior Staff Officer of the Kwantung Army, and a Class A war criminal. He was one of the chief masterminds of the Mukden Incident and the establishment of Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军中将，在黄土岭战斗中被八路军击毙。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the Imperial Japanese Army who was killed in action by the Eighth Route Army at the Battle of Huangtuling.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
第二次国共内战期间的战役。
中国人民解放军少将
中华人民共和国开国上将，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的卓越领导人、政治人物，中共八大元老之一。他曾任中共中央组织部部长、中顾委副主任、中共安徽省委书记、安徽省政府主席，并率部进入云南。他是宋彬彬之父。
description.en: A founding general of the People's Liberation Army, an outstanding leader and political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and one of the Eight Elders of the CCP. He served as Head of the Organization Department of the CCP Central Committee, Vice Director of the Central Advisory Commission, Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee, and Chairman of the Anhui Provincial Government, and also led troops into Yunnan. He was the father of Song Binbin.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森是中国杰出的空气动力学家、系统科学家，工程控制论创始人之一。他曾是美国空军上校，为中美两国的火箭、导弹和航天计划都做出了重大贡献。作为中国载人航天奠基人、“两弹一星”功勋奖章获得者，他被誉为“中国航天之父”和“火箭之王”。钱学森还是中国科学院及中国工程院院士，曾任中国科学技术协会第三届主席、中国科学技术大学创办人之一，并担任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席。张纯如曾为其撰写传记《中国导弹之父——钱学森之谜》。
description.en: Qian Xuesen was a distinguished Chinese aerodynamicist and systems scientist, and one of the founders of engineering cybernetics. He once served as a colonel in the U.S. Army Air Forces, making significant contributions to the rocket, missile, and space programs of both China and the United States. As a foundational figure of China's manned space program and a recipient of the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' Meritorious Award, he is celebrated as the 'Father of Chinese Aerospace' and the 'King of Rocketry'. Qian was also an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering, served as the third chairman of the China Association for Science and Technology, was one of the founders of the University of Science and Technology of China, and held the position of Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. Iris Chang wrote his biography 'Thread of the Silkworm'.

death_place.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 中国核工业的开创者之一
中国人民解放军中将
中国人民解放军中将
中国人民解放军中将，总参四部首任部长。
description.en: A Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army, and the first head of the Fourth Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
1957年10月，中苏签订关于苏联援助中国发展核武器及导弹技术的协定，内容包括提供原子能、导弹等多方面的援助。
description.en: An agreement signed in October 1957 between China and the Soviet Union concerning Soviet assistance to China for the development of nuclear weapons and missile technology, including atomic energy, missiles, and other areas.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，杨成武、余立金、傅崇碧三人在1968年3月被指“阴谋夺权”而遭免职的政治事件。
description.en: A political incident during the Cultural Revolution where Yang Chengwu, Yu Lijin, and Fu Chongbi were accused of 'conspiring to seize power' and were dismissed from their posts.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共北京市委第一书记
曾任北京军区司令员
董必武曾就读的大学。
中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员，中国文联原党组成员、书记处书记，第十届、第十一届全国政协委员，董必武与何连芝之女。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a member of the Communist Party of China, former party group member and secretary of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles, a member of the 10th and 11th National Committee of the CPPCC, and the daughter of Dong Biwu.

description.zh-cn: 清末，由孙中山等领导，兴中会、华兴会、光复会等革命团体于1905年在日本东京合并成立的革命政党。公推孙中山为总理，黄兴任执行部庶务。它是中国近代第一个全国性的革命政党。邵玉轩、王亚樵等曾是其会员。在保路运动中，同盟会采取“借保路之名，行革命之实”的策略，暗中推动运动向武装起义发展。
description.en: During the late Qing dynasty, it was a revolutionary political party formed in Tokyo, Japan, in 1905, led by Sun Yat-sen and others, through the merger of revolutionary groups such as the Xingzhonghui, Huaxinghui, and Guangfuhui. Sun Yat-sen was elected Premier, and Huang Xing served as the head of the executive department. It was the first national revolutionary party in modern China. Members included Shao Yuxuan and Wang Yaqiao. During the Railway Protection Movement, the Tongmenghui adopted a strategy of 'using the cause of railway protection to advance the reality of revolution,' secretly pushing the movement towards armed uprising.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第七届中央委员会
en: 7th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第七次全国代表大会选举产生的中央委员会。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第九届中央委员会
中共第九届中央候补委员
en: 9th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
9th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十届中央委员会
中国共产党第十届中央委员会第三次全体会议
en: 10th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
10th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第十次全国代表大会选举产生的中央委员会。在其任期内，召开了中国共产党第十届中央委员会第三次全体会议，会议通过了《关于恢复邓小平同志职务的决议》。
description.en: The Central Committee elected by the 10th National Congress of the Communist Party of China. During its tenure, the 3rd Plenary Session of the 10th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party was held, which passed the 'Resolution on Restoring Comrade Deng Xiaoping's Posts'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央监察委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1955年至1969年间的纪律检查机关。
中国共产党创始人之一，中共一大代表。他也是中国共产党早期领导人，曾与毛泽民一同在新疆工作并最终被杀害。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China and one of its founders, a delegate to the First National Congress of the CCP. He worked with Mao Zemin in Xinjiang and was killed alongside him.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期组织之一。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会
en: 1st National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
1st National Congress of the Communist Party of China

location.zh-cn: 上海法租界; 嘉兴南湖

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的第一次全国代表大会，张太雷参与了会议的筹备工作。
description.en: The first national congress of the Communist Party of China. Zhang Tailei participated in the preparatory work for the congress.

zh-cn: 中国国民党湖北省党部

description.zh-cn: 20世纪20年代在苏联莫斯科创办的、以孙中山名字命名的大学。它为中国革命培养干部，邓小平、王稼祥、杨尚昆、董必武、孙冶方等许多重要人物曾在此学习或任教。
description.en: A university founded in Moscow, Soviet Union, in the 1920s, named after Sun Yat-sen. It served as a training ground for cadres of the Chinese revolution, and notable figures like Deng Xiaoping, Wang Jiaxiang, Yang Shangkun, Dong Biwu, and Sun Yefang studied or taught there.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会党校
en: Central Party School of the Chinese Communist Party
Central Party School of the Communist Party of China
Party School of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会直属的干部培训学校，是中国共产党培养党的高中级领导干部和马克思主义理论干部的最高学府。薄一波曾在此学习，何毅亭曾任常务副校长。2018年改革后，该校加挂国家行政学院牌子。
description.en: A cadre training school directly under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, serving as the highest academy for training high- and middle-ranking party officials and Marxist theorists. Bo Yibo once studied here, and He Yiting served as Executive Vice President. After the 2018 reform, it also adopted the nameplate of the Chinese Academy of Governance.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国人口福利基金会会长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the president of the China Population Welfare Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党军事家、军事领导人，中国人民解放军大将。他曾任山东军区副司令员（鲁南战役期间），并在1949年2月山东军区重建后，担任首任司令员。
description.en: A Chinese Communist military strategist and leader, and a Senior General of the People's Liberation Army. He served as the deputy commander of the Shandong Military Region during the Lunan Campaign, and later became its first commander after its re-establishment in February 1949.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期领导人，中国政治人物。他曾参与陕北肃反，期间逮捕习仲勋；并在阎家洼子会议上批判高岗。后历任天津铁路管理局局长，中华人民共和国铁道部副部长，国家经济委员会副主任，中央顾问委员会委员等职。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party and a Chinese politician. He participated in the Shaanbei Purge, during which he arrested Xi Zhongxun, and criticized Gao Gang at the Yanjiapozi meeting. Later, he served consecutively as Director of the Tianjin Railway Administration Bureau, Vice Minister of Railways of the People's Republic of China, Vice Chairman of the State Economic Commission, and a member of the Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军高级将领，陕甘边革命根据地的主要创建者之一。1936年4月战斗牺牲。小说《刘志丹》即是为纪念他而创作。
description.en: A high-ranking commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and one of the main founders of the Shaanxi-Gansu Border Revolutionary Base. The novel 'Liu Zhidan' was written in his memory.

death_place.en: Sanjiao Town, Zhongyang County, Shanxi Province

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
抗日战争及第二次国共内战时期，由中国共产党领导的位于陕西、甘肃、宁夏三省交界地区的革命根据地。
description.en: A revolutionary base area led by the Communist Party of China, located at the junction of Shaanxi, Gansu, and Ningxia provinces, during the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府内务部和中华人民共和国内务部部长。他也是中共五老之一。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Minister of Internal Affairs for both the Central People's Government and the People's Republic of China. He was also one of the Five Elders of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 联合国的创始条约，确立了联合国及其主要机构的宗旨、原则和组织框架。
description.en: The foundational treaty of the United Nations, establishing the purposes, principles, and organizational framework of the UN and its principal organs.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，孙冶方的叔伯兄弟，曾与孙冶方合办《中国农村》杂志，并发起成立孙冶方经济学基金会。
description.en: A Chinese economist, Sun Yefang's cousin. He co-founded the magazine 'China's Rural Areas' with Sun Yefang and initiated the establishment of the Sun Yefang Economic Science Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立前，中共在华北地区设立的最高行政机关，也是中华人民共和国中央人民政府的前身之一。
description.en: The highest administrative body established by the CCP in North China before the founding of the People's Republic of China, and one of the predecessors of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 政务院财政经济委员会
中央人民政府政务院财政经济委员会
en: Finance and Economics Committee of the State Administration Council

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府政务院下设的负责指导国家财政经济工作的机构。它于1949年由中央财经委员会更名而来，是中华人民共和国成立初期的重要经济领导机构，李富春曾任其副主任。
description.en: An agency under the State Administration Council of the Central People's Government, responsible for guiding the state's financial and economic work. Renamed from the Central Financial and Economic Commission in 1949, it was a key economic leadership body in the early days of the People's Republic of China, with Li Fuchun notably serving as its vice director.

zh-cn: 政务院政治法律委员会

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府政务院的下属机构，负责指导公安、司法等工作。
description.en: A subordinate body of the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government, responsible for guiding public security, judicial, and other related work.

description.zh-cn: 董必武儿媳之父，中国政治人物，曾任黑龙江省省长。杨易辰担任副省长时，曾是其下属。
description.en: Father-in-law of Dong Biwu's daughter-in-law. Chinese politician who served as Governor of Heilongjiang Province. Yang Yichen served as his subordinate when he was Vice Governor.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将。曾任沈阳军区司令员、中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员，并担任中国人民解放军总政治部主任。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Commander of the Shenyang Military Region, Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University, and also as Director of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 宋庆龄之弟，中华民国政治家、外交家、金融家。他曾任财政部长，创建税警总团，并赏识孙立人。1931年7月23日，王亚樵的铁血锄奸团曾在上海北火车站策划刺杀他，但他幸免于难，其秘书唐腴庐被误杀。
description.en: Brother of Soong Ching-ling, a Chinese statesman, diplomat, and financier. He served as Minister of Finance, founded the Salt Revenue Police, and appreciated Sun Li-jen. On July 23, 1931, Wang Yaqiao's Iron and Blood Elimination Group plotted to assassinate him at Shanghai North Railway Station; he survived, but his secretary Tang Yulu was mistakenly killed.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期湖南军政人物，鲁涤平曾追随他加入孙中山阵营。
description.en: A military and political figure in Hunan during the Republican era, whom Lu Diping followed to join Sun Yat-sen's camp.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期青年运动领导人之一，同时也是华中师范大学著名校友。他于1931年4月被捕并牺牲。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the youth movement of the Communist Party of China and a famous alumnus of Central China Normal University. He was arrested and sacrificed in April 1931.

description.zh-cn: 贺龙的出生地。
贺龙的配偶。
贺龙的配偶，后离婚。
贺龙与蹇先任之女，中国人民解放军少将。
贺龙与薛明之子，中国人民解放军海军中将。
国民革命军的一个军级单位。

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十八集团军第120师

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军第十八集团军（八路军）的三个主力师之一
抗日战争期间的战役。
抗日战争期间的战斗。
第二次国共内战期间的战役。
解放战争时期，中国人民解放军开展的一系列政治、军事和思想教育整训运动。该运动由余秋里在358旅开展的“诉苦三查”运动发展而来。
description.en: A series of political, military, and ideological education and rectification movements carried out by the People's Liberation Army during the Chinese Civil War. This movement evolved from the 'Speak Bitterness and Three Checks' campaign initiated by Yu Qiuli in the 358th Brigade.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间的战役。
中华人民共和国为解放西藏而进行的战役。
西藏地方政府与中央人民政府达成协议，实现和平解放。
中国共产党早期领导人。1931年作战牺牲
中国乒乓球运动员、教练员。

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央顾问委员会
十三届中央顾问委员会
en: Central Advisory Commission of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于1982年至1992年设立的中央组织机构，是一个过渡性特殊机构。其宗旨是解决中央领导机构新老交替、安置年事已高的中央领导干部，并推动废除领导干部职务终身制。该机构也承担对党中央的政治辅助和咨询职责。期间，薄一波曾任常务副主任，余秋里曾任常务委员，孙冶方曾任委员。
description.en: Established by the Communist Party of China from 1982 to 1992, this central organizational body served as a transitional special institution. Its primary purpose was to manage the succession of leadership, accommodate senior cadres, and promote the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading officials. It also provided political auxiliary and advisory functions to the Party Central Committee. During its operation, Bo Yibo served as Executive Deputy Director, Yu Qiuli as a standing committee member, and Sun Yefang as a member.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的第一任妻子。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期党员，曾为邓小平（第二任妻子）、李维汉的妻子。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的第三任妻子。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's third wife.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的长子。中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任全国政协副主席，残疾人权益倡导者。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的次女。陈希的前任中国科学技术协会党组书记。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's second daughter.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的三女。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's third daughter.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的次子。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's second son.

zh-cn: 废除干部领导职务终身制
en: Abolition of the lifetime tenure system for leading cadres
Abolition of lifelong tenure for leading cadres

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国于1980年代推行的一项政治制度改革，旨在终结领导干部职务终身制，建立任期制和退休制度。为实现这一目标，还设立了中央顾问委员会作为过渡性机构，以取代事实上的终身任职。
description.en: A political system reform initiated by the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China in the 1980s. It aimed to end the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres and establish term limits and a retirement system. To achieve this goal, the Central Advisory Commission was also established as a transitional body to replace de facto lifelong tenure.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国计划生育
en: Family planning in the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的人口控制政策。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国义务教育
中华人民共和国义务教育法
en: Compulsory Education Law of the People's Republic of China
Compulsory education in the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 根据宪法制定的法律，旨在保障适龄儿童、少年接受义务教育的权利，保证义务教育的实施，提高全民族素质。该法规定所有适龄儿童、青少年必须接受九年教育，是中华人民共和国的一项重要教育政策。
description.en: A law formulated in accordance with the Constitution to protect the right of school-age children and adolescents to receive compulsory education, ensure its implementation, and improve the quality of the entire nation. This law requires all school-age children and adolescents to receive nine years of education and is a significant educational policy in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平为解决香港、澳门及台湾问题提出的构想，后成为中华人民共和国处理香港和澳门问题的基本国策。倪匡曾表示从不相信此政策。
description.en: A concept proposed by Deng Xiaoping to resolve the issues of Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, which later became the basic state policy of the People's Republic of China for Hong Kong and Macau. Ni Kuang once stated that he never believed in this policy.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的高技术研究发展计划。
深圳是中华人民共和国广东省的计划单列市（副省级市），中国四大一线城市之一、粤港澳大湾区的中心城市之一，也是中国首个经济特区和改革开放的窗口。它现已成为全国性经济中心、国际科技创新中心和对外开放门户，同时也是华商银行的注册地。该市政府部门已将DeepSeek接入政务服务系统。
description.en: Shenzhen is a sub-provincial city with separate planning status in Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China, and is one of China's four first-tier cities, a central city in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. It is also China's first special economic zone and a window for reform and opening up. Shenzhen has become a national economic center, an international technology and innovation hub, and a gateway for foreign relations. It is also the place of registration for Hua Shang Bank, and its government departments have integrated DeepSeek into their public service systems.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省
location.en: Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，第39任美国总统。在其任内，发生了伊朗人质危机，并宣布与中华人民共和国建交。
description.en: American politician, the 39th President of the United States. During his term, the Iran hostage crisis occurred, and he announced the establishment of diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，美国第38任总统，是美国历史上唯一没有经过选举而产生的总统。
description.en: American politician, the 38th President of the United States, and the only person to have served as president without being elected.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡建国总理、政治家。他曾建议中共停止对外输出革命，并在新加坡与马来西亚合并及分离时期担任关键政治角色。在1997年大选后，他控告邓亮洪诽谤。他是李显龙的父亲。
description.en: Founding Prime Minister and politician of Singapore. He advised the CCP to stop exporting revolution and played a key political role during Singapore's merger with and separation from Malaysia. After the 1997 general election, he sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation. He is also known as the father of Lee Hsien Loong.

zh-cn: 社会主义市场经济体制

description.zh-cn: 由邓小平提出的经济体制模式，旨在社会主义制度下发展市场经济，是中国经济体制改革的重要方向。孙冶方是其早期倡导者之一。
description.en: An economic system model proposed by Deng Xiaoping, aiming to develop a market economy under the socialist system. It represents an important direction for China's economic system reform, with Sun Yefang being one of its early advocates.

description.zh-cn: 法国汽车制造商，邓小平早年曾在此做工。

en: Secretary-General of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记（中央书记处负责人）职务的前身之一。邓小平曾担任此职，负责处理中共中央日常事务。
description.en: One of the predecessors to the position of General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee (head of the Central Secretariat). This position was held by Deng Xiaoping and was responsible for handling the daily affairs of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 陈云的夫人，曾在五七干校因张贴大字报揭发江青而被开除党籍和隔离审查。
description.en: Wife of Chen Yun. She was expelled from the party and placed in isolation for investigation after posting a big-character poster exposing Jiang Qing at a May Seventh Cadre School.

description.zh-cn: 陈云长子，中国政治人物，原副国级领导人。曾任中国人民银行副行长、党组副书记，长期担任国家开发银行行长及董事长，并曾任第十二届全国政协副主席。
description.en: The eldest son of Chen Yun, a Chinese politician and former national-deputy level leader. He served as Vice Governor and Deputy Party Secretary of the People's Bank of China, later as the long-term President and Chairman of China Development Bank, and also a Vice Chairman of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 陈云三女
中华民国陆军中将，曾任国民革命军第五军军长、陆军第二兵团司令、徐州剿匪总司令部副总司令，在淮海战役中被俘。他与赵家骧关系甚好。在缅甸战役撤退和东北剿共期间，他与孙立人因战略意见不合而产生矛盾，最终导致孙被调离东北战场。
description.en: A Lieutenant General of the Republic of China Army. He served as the commander of the 5th Corps, the 2nd Army Group, and the deputy commander of the Xuzhou Bandit Suppression General Headquarters, and was captured during the Huaihai Campaign. He had a good relationship with Zhao Jiaxiang. During the retreat in the Burma Campaign and the campaign against Communists in the Northeast, he had conflicts with Sun Li-jen over strategic differences, which ultimately led to Sun's transfer from the Northeast battlefield.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代著名作家、思想家、设计师、革命家，新文化运动领袖之一。他曾任职于教育部，提议将《永乐大典》残本交由京师图书馆收藏以加强保护。在文学创作方面，陈独秀曾多次催促他在《新青年》上发表小说，对其起到重要推动作用。他也是瞿秋白在左翼文化运动中的战友，并在“两个口号”论争中与周扬等人对立，称其为“工头”、“奴隶总管”。
description.en: A renowned modern Chinese writer, thinker, designer, and revolutionary, and one of the leaders of the New Culture Movement. He served at the Ministry of Education and proposed transferring the remaining volumes of the Yongle Encyclopedia to the Capital Library for better preservation. In his literary creation, Chen Duxiu repeatedly urged him to publish novels in 'New Youth', playing a crucial role in its promotion. He was also a comrade-in-arms of Qu Qiubai in the left-wing cultural movement and opposed Zhou Yang and others in the "Two Slogans" debate, calling them "foremen" and "slave masters".

description.zh-cn: 中国的一家著名出版机构，陈云早年曾在此当学徒。
description.en: A famous publishing institution in China where Chen Yun was an apprentice in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期在上海为稳定金融市场而采取的经济斗争。
中华人民共和国成立后，中国共产党内发生的第一次高层政治斗争，导致高岗、饶漱石等高级官员被清洗。
description.en: The first high-level political struggle within the Communist Party of China after the founding of the PRC, which led to the purge of high-ranking officials including Gao Gang and Rao Shushi.

description.zh-cn: 中国在计划经济时期对粮食等主要农产品实行的统一收购和销售政策。在大跃进期间，基于虚报的产量进行高额征购，导致农民口粮、种子粮被收缴，是饥荒的重要制度性原因。
description.en: A policy of unified purchase and sale of major agricultural products such as grain during China's planned economy era. During the Great Leap Forward, high procurement quotas based on inflated production figures led to the confiscation of farmers' food rations and seeds, which was a significant institutional cause of the famine.

description.zh-cn: 上海市的行政管理机构。在中华民国时期，它是上海市的行政管理机构。在中华人民共和国成立后，其职能演变为上海市的最高国家行政机关，例如陈良宇曾任该机构的市长及常务副市长。
description.en: The administrative body of Shanghai Municipality. During the Republic of China era, it served as its administrative management agency. After the establishment of the People's Republic of China, its role evolved into the highest state administrative organ of Shanghai, with figures like Chen Liangyu having served as its Mayor and Executive Vice Mayor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，李小林的前任中国人民对外友好协会会长。
description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor of Li Xiaolin as the President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries.

description.zh-cn: 陈毅元帅之子，粟裕女儿粟惠宁的丈夫。
description.en: Son of Marshal Chen Yi and husband of Su Huining, daughter of Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期在北京和里昂设立的一所大学。
description.en: A university established in Beijing and Lyon during the Republican era.

description.zh-cn: 中共地方指挥官，在长征前夕救了胡耀邦的命。
description.en: A local communist commander who saved Hu Yaobang's life before the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军将领
壮族政治人物，中国人民解放军上将。他曾任广西自治区主席、广西壮族自治区革命委员会主任、第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。他曾任中国人民解放军总政治部主任（系余秋里的前任）。他同时被认为是广西大屠杀的主要组织者。
description.en: A Zhuang ethnic politician and a general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Chairman of the Guangxi Autonomous Region, Director of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Revolutionary Committee, and Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He also served as Director of the PLA General Political Department (predecessor to Yu Qiuli). He was considered a primary organizer of the Guangxi Massacre.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，因作战勇猛而被称为“王疯子”。他是小说《亮剑》主角李云龙的原型之一。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, known as 'Madman Wang' for his fierceness in battle. He is one of the prototypes for Li Yunlong, the protagonist of the novel 'Drawing Sword'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期为稳定物价而采取的经济斗争。
中国政治人物，曾任张家口市公安局局长、天津市公安局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Zhangjiakou Public Security Bureau and Tianjin Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级理论家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国外交官，曾任国务院港澳事务办公室主任。
description.en: Chinese diplomat who served as the Director of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代女作家、革命活动家
中华人民共和国外交部直属的唯一一所培养外交外事、国际问题研究和涉外经济、法律复合型人才的文科外语类高等学校，被誉为“中国外交官的摇篮”。
description.en: The only institution of higher learning under the direct administration of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, which specializes in cultivating versatile talents for diplomatic and foreign affairs, international studies, and foreign-related economics and law. It is known as the 'cradle of Chinese diplomats'.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任中央文革小组副组长。
中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国共产党高级理论家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国共产党高级理论家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
中国历史学家、考古学家，曾任中央文革小组成员。
曾任《光明日报》总编辑，中央文革小组成员。
曾任北京市委文教书记，中央文革小组成员。中国人民大学前党委书记，为学校复校奔走。
曾任吉林省委文教书记，中央文革小组成员。
曾任西南局宣传部长，中央文革小组成员。
中国国家领导人进行外事活动的重要场所，也是中央文革小组的办公地点。
文化大革命期间负责组织和宣传工作的机构，部分取代了中央文革小组的功能。
由中华人民共和国公安部管理的监狱，位于北京市昌平区，主要关押最高级别政治犯。著名经济学家孙冶方曾在文革期间在此被囚禁7年。
description.en: A maximum-security prison located in Changping District, Beijing, managed by the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China. It primarily detains high-ranking political prisoners. Economist Sun Yefang was imprisoned here for 7 years during the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 首都中学红卫兵联合行动委员会

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期北京的一个红卫兵组织，主要由高干子弟组成，后因反对中央文革小组被打压。魏京生是其成员之一。
description.en: A Red Guard organization in Beijing during the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, of which Wei Jingsheng was a member.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间发布的一份文件，规定了对“反革命”行为的镇压措施。
中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任北京卫戍区司令员。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十一届中央委员会
en: 11th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
11th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
6th Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CCP

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1977年至1982年间的中央领导机构。其第五次全体会议于1980年2月决定重新设立中央书记处。第十一届中央委员会第六次全体会议于1981年6月27日一致通过了《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》，华国锋在此次会议上辞去了中共中央主席和军委主席职务。
description.en: The central leading body of the Communist Party of China from 1977 to 1982. Its Fifth Plenary Session in February 1980 decided to re-establish the Central Secretariat. The Sixth Plenary Session of its 11th Central Committee unanimously passed the 'Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China' on June 27, 1981, and Hua Guofeng resigned as Chairman of the CCP Central Committee and Chairman of the Central Military Commission at this session.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将。曾任中国人民志愿军第40军军长，在云山战斗中表现突出。文革期间任解放军副总参谋长。
description.en: Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army. He served as the commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army's 40th Corps, notably during the Battle of Unsan. During the Cultural Revolution, he served as Deputy Chief of the General Staff of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期中国国民党高级将领，曾任湖南、江西、浙江三省主席。他也是刘少奇母亲的侄子。
description.en: A high-ranking general of the Kuomintang during the Republic of China era, who served as the chairman of Hunan, Jiangxi, and Zhejiang provinces. He was also the nephew of Liu Shaoqi's mother.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期政治人物，教育家、书法家。他是刘少奇母亲的侄子，也是鲁涤平的弟弟。
description.en: A political figure during the Republic of China era, an educator, and a calligrapher. He was the nephew of Liu Shaoqi's mother and the younger brother of Lu Diping.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期湖南军阀，湘系军阀的领导人之一，曾任湖南省省长。他还是东京振武学校校友，并在湘鄂战争期间担任鲁涤平的指挥官。
description.en: A Hunan warlord during the Republican era, one of the leaders of the Hunan clique, who also served as Hunan Governor. He was an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō and served as Lu Diping's commander during the Hunan-Hubei War.

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大革命期间的一起重大政治案件，旨在打击以刘少奇为首的中共领导人，亦是一起重大冤假错案。
description.en: A major political case during the Cultural Revolution in China, aimed at targeting CPC leaders headed by Liu Shaoqi, which was also a significant case of injustice, falsehood, and error.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局常委扩大会议，讨论经济调整问题。
文化大革命期间，他曾是清华大学的学生领袖，担任清华大学井冈山兵团的第一把手，也是北京红卫兵“五大领袖”之一。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, he was a student leader at Tsinghua University, served as the head of the Tsinghua University Jinggangshan Corps, and was also one of the "Five Great Leaders" of Beijing Red Guards.

description.zh-cn: 康生第二任妻子，曾任康生办公室主任，第四、五届全国人大常委会委员，中共九、十、十一届中央委员。
description.en: Kangsheng's second wife, former director of Kangsheng's office, member of the Standing Committee of the 4th and 5th National People's Congress, and member of the 9th, 10th, and 11th Central Committees of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 康生与陈宜之子，曾任中共杭州市委书记。

en: East China Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
East China Bureau of the CCP
East China Bureau of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党台湾省工作委员会的上级机构。
description.en: The superior body of the Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China.

location.zh-cn: 山东省济南市历下区省府前街1号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省的省级人民政府，作为该省的最高国家行政机关。其前身之一是1945年由中国共产党成立的山东省政府。该政府也是莱芜市人民政府的业务上级单位。
description.en: The provincial people's government of Shandong Province, People's Republic of China, serves as the highest provincial-level state administrative organ. One of its predecessors was the Shandong Provincial Government established by the Communist Party of China in 1945. It also serves as the administrative superior of the Laiwu Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 一所位于中国北京市的综合性研究型全国重点大学，以人文社会科学为主，直属于中华人民共和国教育部。马凯曾在此获得经济学硕士学位。该校与莱比锡大学合作共建了莱比锡大学孔子学院。
description.en: A comprehensive research-oriented national key university located in Beijing, China, primarily focused on humanities and social sciences, and directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. Ma Kai obtained his Master's degree in Economics here. The university also collaborated with the University of Leipzig to establish the Confucius Institute at the University of Leipzig.

en: Nine Commentaries on the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 1963年至1964年间，中国共产党为回应苏联共产党的《公开信》而发表的九篇评论文章，标志着中苏论战的顶峰。
description.en: A series of nine articles published by the CCP between 1963 and 1964 in response to the CPSU's "Open Letter", marking the peak of the Sino-Soviet polemics.

description.zh-cn: 1962年在中国共产党内部发生的一场政治迫害事件，小说《刘志丹》被定性为反党小说，导致包括习仲勋在内的大量干部被迫害，被认为是“文化大革命”的先声。
