description.en: A political persecution incident within the Communist Party of China in 1962, where the novel 'Liu Zhidan' was labeled an anti-Party novel, leading to the persecution of numerous officials including Xi Zhongxun. It is considered a precursor to the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人。后叛变，曾指控康生叛变，最终被康生下令枪决。
中国左翼作家、政治人物，长期负责中共情报及文化战线工作，是高级领导人。中华人民共和国成立后曾任上海市副市长，并接收了由吴石提供、吴仲禧转交的情报。1955年因内奸罪被捕，1982年获得平反。
description.en: Chinese left-wing writer and politician, a senior leader who was long in charge of the CCP's intelligence and cultural fronts. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, he served as the deputy mayor of Shanghai, and received intelligence provided by Wu Shi and transferred by Wu Zhongxi. He was arrested in 1955 on charges of being a traitor and was rehabilitated in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，曾领导情报保卫工作，在黑茶山空难中遇难。
中国作家，小说《刘志丹》的作者，刘景范的妻子。因创作该小说而在“反党小说《刘志丹》案”中受到长期迫害。
description.en: Chinese writer, author of the novel 'Liu Zhidan', and wife of Liu Jingfan. She was persecuted for a long time during the 'Anti-Party Novel Liu Zhidan Case' for writing the novel.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原云南省委书记，曾任西南军政委员会交通部部长、铁道部副部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as Minister of Transport of the Southwest Military and Administrative Committee and Vice Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中华人民共和国外交部副部长。
毛泽东晚年英文翻译。
教育家，曾任南京大学校长。
曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: Former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任毛泽东的秘书。参与了《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》的起草，并起草了《关于改变农村人民公社基本核算单位问题的指示》。
description.en: Chinese politician, former secretary to Mao Zedong. Participated in the drafting of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes' and drafted the 'Directive on Changing the Basic Accounting Unit of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 中国文艺理论家、文学翻译家、文艺活动家。
中国共产党中央委员会的理论刊物，曾发表《生产价格论》一文并批判孙冶方。
description.en: A theoretical journal of the Communist Party of China, which published the article 'On the Price of Production' and criticized Sun Yefang.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家科学技术方面的最高学术机构，同时是全国自然科学与高新技术综合研究发展中心，以及中国科学技术大学的创办及主管单位。该院原有的地震研究部门在国家地震局组建时曾进行调整。
description.en: The highest academic institution in science and technology of the People's Republic of China, serving as the national comprehensive research and development center for natural sciences and high technology, and also the founder and governing body of the University of Science and Technology of China. When the National Earthquake Administration was formed, earthquake research departments formerly under this academy were reorganized.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家计划委员会
en: State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾存在的宏观经济调控和计划部门，负责制定和管理国民经济计划。该机构存在于1952年至1998年间，自1954年起作为国务院组成部门。李富春、余秋里等曾长期担任其主任及其他领导职务。
description.en: A former macroeconomic regulation and planning department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for formulating and managing national economic plans. It existed from 1952 to 1998, serving as a component department of the State Council since 1954. Li Fuchun, Yu Qiuli, and others served as its director and other leadership positions for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 曾是中山大学的前身，现为位于中国广州市的一所综合性研究型大学。
description.en: Formerly the predecessor of Sun Yat-sen University, it is now a major research university in Guangzhou, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在延安时期创办的第一所具有社会教育性质的大学，同时也是一所兼具统一战线性质的干部学校，是中国人民大学的前身之一。
description.en: The first social education-oriented university established by the Communist Party of China during the Yan'an period. It also served as a cadre school with a united front nature and is one of the predecessors of Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会直属事业单位，是《人民日报》的出版单位。
description.en: A public institution directly under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and the publisher of the People's Daily.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期的一种理论，强调家庭出身决定个人政治立场，在老红卫兵中广泛宣扬，核心口号是“老子英雄儿好汉，老子反动儿混蛋”。杨小凯曾因反对该理论而参加造反派。
description.en: A theory from the early Cultural Revolution, widely promoted by the Old Red Guards, emphasizing that one's family background determines their political stance. Its core slogan was 'If the father is a hero, the son is a good man; if the father is a reactionary, the son is a bastard'. Yang Xiaokai joined the rebel faction in opposition to this theory.

zh-cn: 中央人民政府最高人民法院

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的最高审判机关。

zh-cn: 中央人民政府国家计划委员会
en: State Planning Commission of the Central People's Government

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期，是负责全国经济计划工作的中央人民政府部门，与政务院平级。该机构后来改为中华人民共和国国家计划委员会。
description.en: In the early days of the People's Republic of China, it was a central government department responsible for national economic planning, on the same level as the Government Administration Council. This institution was later reorganized as the State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国主席令
en: Order of the President of China

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国主席发布的法令。
中华民国大陆时期滇系军阀领导人、滇军将领，长期主政云南，曾任云南省政府主席，有“云南王”之称。汪精卫曾试图寻求其支持但未获成功。
description.en: A leader of the Yunnan clique and a military general during the mainland period of the Republic of China, he governed Yunnan for a long time, served as its provincial government chairman, and was known as the 'King of Yunnan'. Wang Jingwei unsuccessfully sought his support.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任铁道部副部长，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, formerly served as Vice Minister of Railways and as a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 时任115师司令部参谋处长，在陈光师长下到一线指挥时，临时负起战役全盘指挥之责。
description.en: Chief of Staff of the 115th Division Headquarters at the time. When Commander Chen Guang went to the front line, he temporarily assumed overall command of the battle.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原东北军将领，后加入八路军，成为中国人民解放军上将。曾任铁道部副部长、部长，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员，为十人小组成员。
description.en: Chinese politician and former general of the Northeastern Army who later joined the Eighth Route Army, becoming a General in the People's Liberation Army of China. He served as Vice Minister of Railways and Minister of Railways, was a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 中国藏族政治人物。曾任第四届全国人大常委会副委员长，并领导完成了《民族区域自治法》的制定。
description.en: A Chinese Tibetan politician. He served as Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and led the formulation of the Law on Regional Ethnic Autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，中国现代后勤工作的开拓者。曾任中国人民解放军总后勤部部长、中共中央军委副秘书长、全国政协副主席。他是唯一一位在1955年和1988年两次被授予上将军衔的将领。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army (PLA) and a pioneer of China's modern logistics work. He served as the head of the PLA General Logistics Department, Deputy Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission, and Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. He is the only general to have been awarded the rank of Shang Jiang (General) twice, in 1955 and 1988.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，张又侠之父。
时任西藏军区司令员，战争期间任西藏军区前线指挥所司令员。
第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将。曾任红四军参谋长、红一军团参谋长。第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army. Served as Chief of Staff of the Fourth Red Army and the Red First Army Group. Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 原国民党第一兵团司令，1949年与程潜共同起义。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任红一军团第十五师师长，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army, served as Commander of the Fifteenth Division of the Red First Army Group, and was a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事人物，最高军衔为中国人民解放军中将。曾于长春围困战中率部起义，后参与抗美援朝战争。是解放军开国将领中少数未加入中国共产党党籍者之一。
description.en: A Chinese military figure with the highest rank of Lieutenant General in the People's Liberation Army. He led his troops to defect during the Siege of Changchun and later participated in the Korean War. He was one of the few founding generals of the PLA who never joined the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，抗日战争时期曾与余秋里搭档，分别担任120师第3支队支队长和政治委员。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who partnered with Yu Qiuli during the Second Sino-Japanese War as commander and political commissar of the 3rd Detachment of the 120th Division, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将。曾任第五兵团司令员，其部队在西南战役中俘虏了宋希濂；后任中国人民志愿军第三副司令员、参谋长及最后一任司令员。他与杨成武、杨得志并称“三杨”，是胡耀邦的表哥。
description.en: A founding general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as commander of the 5th Army Group, whose troops captured Song Xilian during the Southwest Campaign; later he was the Third Deputy Commander, Chief of Staff, and the last Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army. He was known as one of the 'Three Yangs' along with Yang Chengwu and Yang Dezhi, and was a cousin of Hu Yaobang.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，赵家骧曾在其麾下任职。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China, under whom Zhao Jiaxiang served.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，中国政治人物。曾任红一军团供给部长，后任国防工业委员会副主任，并为十人小组成员。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army and a Chinese politician. He served as Supply Minister of the Red First Army Group, later as Deputy Director of the National Defense Industry Committee, and was a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期川军将领，曾任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A Sichuan army general during the Republic of China era, he also served as a member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共云南省委第一书记。他因不同意小说《刘志丹》出版，并向康生报告，成为引发此案的关键人物之一。
description.en: Then First Secretary of the CCP Yunnan Provincial Committee. He became one of the key figures in triggering the case by disagreeing with the publication of the novel 'Liu Zhidan' and reporting it to Kang Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军上将，曾任中共上海市委第一书记
中国人民解放军上将，曾任石油工业部部长，并在总后方勤务部政委职位上接替余秋里，也曾任红一军团第一师师长。此外，他还担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A General of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Minister of Petroleum Industry, succeeded Yu Qiuli as Political Commissar of the General Rear Services Department, and also served as Commander of the First Division of the Red First Army Group. Additionally, he was a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，曾在一场战斗中与钟伟因是否撤退发生冲突。
description.en: A founding general of the People's Liberation Army, who had a conflict with Zhong Wei over whether to retreat during a battle.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中华人民共和国地质矿产部部长
中国政治人物，曾任第三机械工业部长，为十人小组成员。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of the Third Ministry of Machine Building, and a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将。1929年参加中国工农红军，曾参与长征、抗日战争、辽沈战役等。中华人民共和国成立后，历任多地军区司令员。文化大革命期间曾遭迫害。逝世后，其骨灰遵遗愿撒在辽宁塔山战场。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army. He joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in 1929 and participated in the Long March, the Second Sino-Japanese War, and the Liaoshen Campaign. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, he served as commander of several military regions. He was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution. After his death, his ashes were scattered on the Tashan battlefield in Liaoning in accordance with his last wishes.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人、工人运动领袖。他曾是杨昌济的学生，并与张太雷一同加入中共早期组织，积极开展工人运动。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China and a key figure in the labor movement. He was a student of Yang Changji and joined the early CPC organization with Zhang Tailei, actively engaging in labor movements.

description.zh-cn: 新四军政治部主任，在皖南事变突围时阵亡。
中国工农红军早期将领，曾任红一军团参谋长。
description.en: An early general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Chief of Staff of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国江西省的县级市，是李安泽的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city in Jiangxi Province, China, and the birthplace of Li Anze.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红一军团政治部主任。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Director of the Political Department of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 曾代理中国人民银行行长。
description.en: Former Acting Governor of the People's Bank of China.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二方面军
en: Second Front Army of the Chinese Red Army

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军主力部队之一，由红二军团和红六军团会合后组成，由贺龙、任弼时领导。
description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, formed by the merger of the Second and Sixth Army Corps, led by He Long and Ren Bishi.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军高级将领，曾任红三军参谋长。
description.en: A senior commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Chief of Staff of the Third Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级干部。因对小说《刘志丹》提出修改意见，被打成“习贾刘反党集团”成员，后被迫害致死。
description.en: A senior cadre of the Communist Party of China. He was labeled a member of the 'Xi-Jia-Liu Anti-Party Clique' for offering suggestions on the novel 'Liu Zhidan' and was later persecuted to death.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争和国共内战时期建立的政府。它根据国共协议，由中华苏维埃共和国中央政府西北办事处改制而成，并作为行政机构隶属于国民政府行政院。
description.en: A government established by the Communist Party of China during the Anti-Japanese War and the Chinese Civil War. It was reorganized from the Northwest Office of the Central Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic according to the KMT-CPC agreement and functioned as an administrative body subordinate to the Executive Yuan of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国正国级领导人，现任中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处排名第一的书记、中央办公厅主任、中央和国家机关工委书记。他被认为是闽江新军的主要成员和习近平的重要亲信。其政治生涯早期曾任中共三明市委副书记。1999年，他与黄坤明一同调往浙江省任职，并曾在黄坤明担任杭州市委书记期间任其副手。
description.en: A national-level leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, First Secretary of the Central Secretariat, Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Secretary of the Central and State Organs Work Committee. He is considered a key member of the Minjiang New Army and a close confidant of Xi Jinping. Early in his political career, he served as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee. In 1999, he was transferred to Zhejiang Province along with Huang Kunming, and later served as his deputy during Huang Kunming's tenure as Hangzhou Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。现任中共中央政治局常委、中央纪委书记。曾任中共广东省委书记、中共十九届中央政治局委员、中共上海市委组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician. Currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. He previously served as Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee, and head of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1921年中共一大前在中国各地及海外成立的共产主义小组
中国第一个共产主义小组，在各地建党活动中起联络中心作用，是中国共产党的前身组织之一。

zh-cn: 伟大的十月社会主义革命

description.zh-cn: 由列宁领导的布尔什维克发动的革命，推翻了俄国临时政府。
description.en: A revolution led by Lenin's Bolsheviks that overthrew the Russian Provisional Government.

zh-cn: 中国特色社会主义理论体系
有中国特色的社会主义
en: Theory of socialism with Chinese characteristics

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党根据本国国情，将马克思主义基本原理与中国具体实际相结合而形成的政治经济理论，也是中国共产党和中华人民共和国的官方意识形态及国策。
description.en: A political and economic theory formulated by the Communist Party of China by adapting the basic principles of Marxism to the specific conditions of China.

zh-cn: 俄国共产党（布尔什维克）
en: Communist Party of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（苏联）的唯一执政党，将列宁主义纳入其官方学说。赫鲁晓夫曾在该党第二十次代表大会上发表秘密报告。1991年八一九事件失败后，被俄罗斯总统叶利钦宣布为非法组织。
description.en: The sole ruling political party of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (Soviet Union), which incorporated Leninism into its official doctrine. Khrushchev delivered his Secret Speech at its 20th Congress. After the failure of the 1991 August Coup, it was declared an illegal organization by Russian President Boris Yeltsin.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的机关报。该报在大跃进期间进行了大量宣传报道，并曾发表社论支持红卫兵的串连活动。1977年10月22日，它发表文章正式向全国宣布恢复高考。此外，该报还刊发了周扬关于“人道主义”和“异化”问题的报告，引发巨大争议。其海外版在1991年刊登了《李鹏下台嵌字诗》。钦本立曾于1951年至1956年在此任职。
description.en: The official newspaper of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. It extensively reported during the Great Leap Forward and published editorials supporting the networking activities of the Red Guards. On October 22, 1977, it formally announced the restoration of the Gaokao. It also published Zhou Yang's controversial report on "humanitarianism" and "alienation." Its overseas edition published the 'Li Peng step down acrostic poem' in 1991. Qin Benli worked here from 1951 to 1956.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，曾任中共宁夏回族自治区党委书记。此外，他还曾担任吴政隆的前任江苏省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, member of the 20th Central Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China, and formerly served as the Communist Party Secretary of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Additionally, he was the predecessor of Wu Zhenglong as Governor of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人。曾担任中共中央党校（国家行政学院）常务副校（院）长，接替何毅亭。现任中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a national-level leader. He formerly served as the Executive Vice President of the Central Party School (National Academy of Governance), succeeding He Yiting. He is currently a member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee, a secretary of the Central Secretariat, and the head of the CCP Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记。曾任中央国安办常务副主任、国家安全部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently a member of the Politburo and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, formerly served as Executive Deputy Director of the Office of the Central National Security Commission and Minister of State Security.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共中央书记处书记，中华人民共和国国家监察委员会主任，中华人民共和国总监察官。

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会办公厅
en: General Office of the Chinese Communist Party
General Office of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的综合办事机构，负责日常文书、会务、安保、机要、通讯等工作，并为中共中央和中央直属机关提供服务。李富春曾任其主任，何毅亭曾在此工作。
description.en: The working body of the CPC Central Committee, responsible for daily clerical work, meeting arrangements, security, confidential matters, communications, etc. Li Fuchun once served as its director, and He Yiting also worked there.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会组织部
en: Organization Department of the Chinese Communist Party
Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee
Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Organization Department of the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee
Organization Department of the Communist Party of China Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的职能部门，负责党组织建设、干部队伍建设和人才工作。在抗日战争时期，李富春曾任其副部长。该部门于1979年为小说《刘志丹》案平反。自2018年起，统一管理中央机构编制委员会办公室与公务员工作。
description.en: A functional department of the CPC Central Committee, responsible for party organization building, cadre team development, and talent work. Li Fuchun served as its deputy head during the Second Sino-Japanese War. In 1979, the department rehabilitated the 'Liu Zhidan' novel case. Since 2018, it has centrally managed the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission and civil service affairs.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会宣传部
中国共产党中央宣传部
en: Publicity Department of the Chinese Communist Party
Propaganda Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会主管意识形态方面工作的综合职能部门，也是中国共产党的宣传与意识形态管理机构。该部门加挂国务院新闻办公室牌子。它曾指示工人出版社创作一部关于刘志丹的小说，并据报道在《穹顶之下》发布数日后下令全面封杀该片。
description.en: The comprehensive functional department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China in charge of ideological and propaganda work, which also carries the nameplate of the State Council Information Office. It instructed the Workers' Publishing House to create a novel about Liu Zhidan, and reportedly ordered a complete ban on 'Under the Dome' several days after its release.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会统一战线工作部
中共中央统一战线工作部
en: United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee
United Front Work Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会主管统一战线工作的职能部门。
description.en: A functional department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China responsible for united front work.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会政法委员会
中国共产党中央政法委员会
en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission
Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的直属机构，负责领导和管理全国政法工作。该机构曾牵头成立联合调查组，对陕西千亿矿权案卷宗丢失等问题进行调查；佘孟孝曾在此任副秘书长。
description.en: An agency directly under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for leading and managing political and legal affairs nationwide. It once led a joint investigation team to investigate issues like the missing case files in the 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case'; She Mengxiao also served as its Deputy Secretary-General.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会政策研究室
中共中央书记处研究室
国务院农村发展研究中心
en: Policy Research Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
Research Office of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的最高智囊机构，何毅亭曾长期在此任职并担任常务副主任。
description.en: The top think tank of the CPC Central Committee, where He Yiting served for a long time and held the position of Executive Deputy Director.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第六届中央委员会
en: 6th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中共七届一中全会选出的五位中央书记处书记，即毛泽东、朱德、刘少奇、周恩来、任弼时的合称。他们是中国共产党第一代领导集体的核心，地位等同于后来的政治局常委。
description.en: The five secretaries of the Central Secretariat elected at the first plenary session of the 7th Central Committee of the CPC, namely Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai, and Ren Bishi. They were the core of the first generation of collective leadership of the Communist Party of China, and their status was equivalent to that of later Politburo Standing Committee members.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家、政治家、外交家，中国工人运动领导人。曾任中联部部长、国务院外事办公室副主任。作为中国共产党和中华人民共和国的重要政治人物，他曾是国家级副职领导人。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary, politician, diplomat, and leader of the Chinese workers' movement. He served as head of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee and Deputy Director of the State Council Foreign Affairs Office. A significant political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, he was a former national-level deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共上海市委第一书记
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的早期领导人之一。曾任中共上海市委第一书记、中共中央政法委员会书记。他曾向薄一波和宋任穷转达陈云关于中共十四大后不再设立中顾委的意见，并曾向胡耀邦举荐李源潮。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as the First Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission. He once relayed Chen Yun's opinion to Bo Yibo and Song Renqiong regarding the non-establishment of the Central Advisory Commission after the 14th National Congress of the CPC, and also recommended Li Yuanchao to Hu Yaobang.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治家，原正国级领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记、天津市市长。在六四事件中，他因反对实施戒严并支持赵紫阳而被免职。复出后曾任电子工业部部长、全国政协副主席等职务。他曾赏识李瑞环。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former national-level leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee and a secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC. He was dismissed from his party leadership positions for sympathizing with the student movement and supporting Zhao Ziyang during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. After his political comeback, he served as Minister of Electronics Industry and Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间担任全国人大常委会副委员长和会议秘书长，并曾任中华全国总工会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee and Secretary-General of the sessions of the 11th National People's Congress, and also served as Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共上海市委书记、中共中央书记处书记。在六四事件中与阎明复一同被免职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former secretary of the CPC Central Secretariat. He was dismissed along with Yan Mingfu during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。曾任中共中央书记处书记、中共中央统战部部长、全国政协副主席等职。因在六四事件中的表现被撤职，后复出任民政部副部长，并长期从事慈善事业。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a former deputy state leader. He served as a secretary of the Central Secretariat of the CPC and head of the United Front Work Department. He was dismissed for his actions during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, later returned to politics as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs, and was long involved in philanthropy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、第八届和第九届全国政协主席、天津市市长。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former paramount-level Party and state leader. He served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Chairman of the 8th and 9th National Committees of the CPPCC, and Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人之一，中国政治人物。曾任中共中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记、中共中央宣传部部长，长期负责意识形态工作，并是李长春的前任中央精神文明建设指导委员会主任。
description.en: A former high-ranking leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a Chinese politician. He served as a member of the Politburo, a secretary of the Secretariat, and head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, with long-term responsibility for ideological work. He was also Li Changchun's predecessor as Director of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization.

description.zh-cn: 他是杨尚昆的胞弟，中国人民解放军上将。作为一位中国政治人物，他曾任中共中央军委秘书长兼总政治部主任。他接替余秋里任总政治部主任，后由于永波继任。他还是中共第十四届中央政治局委员。在任总政治部主任期间，他曾参与指挥戒严部队。
description.en: He was the younger brother of Yang Shangkun, a general (shangjiang) of the People's Liberation Army, and a Chinese politician. He served as Secretary-General of the CPC Central Military Commission and Director of the General Political Department. He succeeded Yu Qiuli as Director of the General Political Department and was later succeeded by Yu Yongbo. He was also a member of the 14th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee. During his tenure as Director of the General Political Department, he participated in commanding the martial law troops.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级正职领导人。曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央纪律检查委员会书记、中组部副部长，以及中华全国总工会主席。
description.en: A political figure of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a former state-level top leader. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, Deputy Head of the Organization Department, and Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，在中共十四届五中全会上增补为中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Senior general of the People's Liberation Army, who was appointed Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中华人民共和国副主席（胡锦涛任内），并兼任中共中央党校校长。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP Central Committee, Vice President of the People's Republic of China (during Hu Jintao's tenure), and concurrently as President of the Central Party School of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人。曾任中央书记处书记、中共中央党校校长（陈希的前任）。他曾是李长春在中央精神文明建设指导委员会的副手，后接替其主任职务。据称他也是向谷歌施压的主要协调人。
description.en: A Chinese politician, former national-level Party and state leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as Secretary of the Central Secretariat and President of the Central Party School of the CPC (predecessor to Chen Xi). He was also Li Changchun's deputy on the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization and later succeeded him as director. He was allegedly the main coordinator of pressure on Google.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级领导人。曾任第十七届中共中央政治局常委、中央纪律检查委员会书记、中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, formerly a national-level leader. He served as a member of the 17th Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, and head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

zh-cn: 王刚 (中国全国政协原副主席)

death_place.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 徐才厚，中国人民解放军上将，曾任中共中央政治局委员、中央军事委员会副主席（于第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命）。他曾是中国人民解放军前主要领导人之一，原副国级领导人，并接替于永波担任总政治部主任。后因严重违纪违法问题被调查，2014年被开除军籍，在反腐运动中落马。
description.en: Xu Caihou, a general of the People's Liberation Army, served as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission (appointed during the 11th National People's Congress). He was one of the former key leaders of the PLA, a former vice-national level leader, and succeeded Yu Yongbo as the Director of the General Political Department. Later, he was investigated for serious violations of discipline and law, had his military rank revoked in 2014, and fell during the anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级党和国家领导人。他是团派主要成员。曾任中共江苏省委书记（回良玉的继任者），并担任中共中央组织部部长、中央书记处书记、中共中央政治局委员及中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a former Deputy-national level Party and state leader. He was a key member of the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). He served as Party Secretary of Jiangsu Province (succeeding Hui Liangyu), and also held positions such as head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, secretary of the Central Secretariat, member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, and Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 原中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央办公厅主任、中共中央书记处书记、全国政协副主席、中央统战部部长，是胡锦涛的首席助理。作为令狐路线的弟弟，他在反腐运动中落马，并被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一。
description.en: Former Chinese political figure, who served as Director of the CCP General Office and a chief aide to Hu Jintao. As the younger brother of Linghu Luxian, he fell during the anti-corruption campaign and was also implicated in the downfall of Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，黄坤明的前任中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Huang Kunming's predecessor as the Minister of the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共十九届中央政治局常委、全国人大常委会委员长、中央办公厅主任、中央国家安全委员会办公室主任。其职业生涯中，曾涉及胡锦涛二十大离场事件。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Director of the General Office of the Central Committee, and Director of the Office of the Central National Security Commission. He was involved in the incident where Hu Jintao was escorted out of the 20th National Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共海南省委书记、海南省人大常委会主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, formerly served as Secretary of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the CPC and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共浙江省委书记（为夏宝龙前任），并曾担任浙江省人大常委会主任、中央书记处书记。其任省委书记期间，蔡奇曾任中共浙江省委组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee (predecessor to Xia Baolong), Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, and a secretary of the Central Secretariat. During his tenure as Party Secretary, Cai Qi served as the head of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee Organization Department.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会
中共二十届中央委员会
en: 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区府右街12号
location.en: No. 12 Fuyou Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会选举产生的中央委员会，是中国共产党在2022年至2027年的最高领导机关，王抗平为候补委员。
description.en: The central leadership body elected by the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, serving as the highest leading body from 2022 to 2027. Wang Kangping serves as an alternate member of this committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、力学工程师及航天领域专家。他曾任中国航天科技集团公司总经理、广东省人民政府省长（接替朱小丹），现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记，是出身航天科技集团的省委书记之一。
description.en: A politician, mechanical engineer, and aerospace expert of the People's Republic of China. He previously served as General Manager of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation and Governor of Guangdong Provincial People's Government (succeeding Zhu Xiaodan). He is currently a member of the 20th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Party Secretary of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, and is one of the provincial Party secretaries who originated from the aerospace technology group.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物及环境科学家。曾任中华人民共和国环境保护部部长（在《穹顶之下》发布后曾对其公开表示赞赏）、北京市市长。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician and environmental scientist. He served as Minister of Environmental Protection (publicly praising 'Under the Dome' upon its release) and Mayor of Beijing. He is currently a member of the 20th CPC Central Committee Politburo and Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中共第十九届中央政治局委员、重庆市委书记，在唐良智担任重庆市市长期间，其为袁家军的前任。现任中共第二十届中央政治局委员、天津市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as a member of the Political Bureau of the 19th CPC Central Committee and as Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee. During Tang Liangzhi's tenure as Mayor of Chongqing, Chen Min'er was the predecessor of Yuan Jiajun. He is currently a member of the Political Bureau of the 20th CPC Central Committee and the Party Secretary of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物及空间技术专家，副国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、中共重庆市委书记。曾担任神舟五号任务载人飞船系统总指挥。在浙江省曾担任要职，包括省人大常委会主任、省人民政府省长及省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a space technology expert, holding a vice-national level leadership position. Currently a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Chongqing Municipality. He also served as Commander-in-Chief of the manned spacecraft system for the Shenzhou 5 mission. He held various key positions in Zhejiang Province, including Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, Governor of the People's Government of Zhejiang Province, and Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级党和国家领导人。现任中共中央政治局委员、中共广东省委书记。曾任中共十九届中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，中共中央宣传部部长，以及杭州市委书记。其被认为是习近平派系“闽江新军”的主要成员之一。
description.en: A politician of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a sub-national level party and state leader. Currently serving as a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Guangdong Province. He previously served as a member of the Political Bureau and a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee, Minister of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, and Party Secretary of Hangzhou. He is considered one of the main members of the Xi Jinping faction known as the 'Minjiang New Army'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党全国代表大会
en: National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的最高领导机关，每五年举行一次，负责选举中央委员会等机构。
description.en: The highest leading body of the Communist Party of China, held every five years, responsible for electing bodies such as the Central Committee.

en: Central Bureau of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会后设立的中央领导机构，是中国共产党中央委员会的前身机构之一。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第五次全国代表大会
中国共产党第五届中央委员会
en: 5th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
5th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
5th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 1927年中国共产党在武汉召开的全国代表大会，决定设立中国共产党中央委员会，并在会后设立了中共中央政治局。向忠发在此次会议上当选为中共中央委员，进入中央领导层。
description.en: The National Congress of the CCP held in Wuhan in 1927, which decided to establish the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and subsequently established the Political Bureau of the Central Committee. Xiang Zhongfa was elected to the CCP Central Committee at this meeting, entering the central leadership.

description.zh-cn: 在政党内部实行民主原则和制度，是现代政党制度的重要组成部分。此原则由列宁提出，后被斯大林进一步发展，并成为中国共产党的根本组织原则。
description.en: Refers to the implementation of democratic principles and systems within a political party, an important component of modern political party systems. This principle was proposed by Lenin, later further developed by Stalin, and became the fundamental organizational principle of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记
en: General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the CCP
General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记一职，其职能与权力在不同历史时期有所演变。该职务最早设立于1925年，作为党的最高领导人，负责召集政治局会议并主持中央书记处工作，直至1945年被中央委员会主席取代。1982年恢复设立后，总书记再次成为中国共产党最高领导人。然而，在1956年至1966年及1980年至1982年间，中央书记处曾设立同名领导职务，其主要职责是处理中央书记处日常运作，并非党的最高负责人，与恢复后的最高领导人职务性质不同。
description.en: The role and power of the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China have evolved across different historical periods. First established in 1925, this position served as the Party's supreme leader, responsible for convening Politburo meetings and presiding over the Central Secretariat, until it was replaced by the Chairman of the Central Committee in 1945. Re-established in 1982, the General Secretary again became the supreme leader of the CPC. However, between 1956-1966 and 1980-1982, a similarly titled leadership position existed within the Central Secretariat, primarily responsible for managing its daily operations. This role was not the Party's top leader and differed in nature from the supreme leader position re-established later.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
First Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the CPC

description.zh-cn: 会议审议通过了《中共中央政治局关于加强和维护党中央集中统一领导的若干规定》，并选举产生了中共第十九届中央领导机构及其负责人。会后，马凯卸任中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: The meeting deliberated and adopted the 'Regulations of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee on Strengthening and Upholding the Centralized and Unified Leadership of the CPC Central Committee', and elected the central leading bodies and their leaders of the 19th CPC Central Committee. After the meeting, Ma Kai stepped down as a member of the CPC Central Politburo.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十七次全国代表大会
en: 17th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于2007年10月在北京召开的全国代表大会。自此次会议起，中央政治局不再设置候补委员职位。
description.en: The national congress of the Communist Party of China held in Beijing in October 2007.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
1st Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 选举产生了中共第二十届中央领导机构（包括中央政治局及其常务委员会）及其负责人。
description.en: Elected the 20th central leading bodies of the CPC and their leaders.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中共第二十届中央政治局委员，北京市委书记，接替蔡奇担任此职。
description.en: Chinese politician, Member of the 20th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, and Party Secretary of Beijing, succeeding Cai Qi in this post.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原副国级领导人，曾任中共第十六届中央政治局委员、上海市委书记、上海市市长。他主政上海期间推动了多项重大工程建设和经济发展。2006年因涉及上海社保基金案（即陈良宇事件）被免职，2008年被判处有期徒刑18年。
description.en: Chinese politician and former state-level vice leader. He served as a member of the 16th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee, and Mayor of Shanghai. During his tenure in Shanghai, he promoted several major engineering projects and economic development. He was dismissed in 2006 for his involvement in the Shanghai social security fund case (also known as the Chen Liangyu incident) and was sentenced to 18 years in prison in 2008.

zh-cn: 陈良宇受贿、滥用职权案
陈良宇同志严重违纪问题

description.zh-cn: 指2006年上海市爆发的政治事件。事件中，部分政府官员被中央指控违规动用、挪用社会保障基金进行投资活动。该事件牵扯出大量政治、经济和法律问题，涉及贪污腐败，最终导致时任中共中央政治局委员、上海市委书记陈良宇被停止政治局委员职务，并被免职、查办和判刑。
description.en: Refers to the political incident that broke out in Shanghai in 2006. Some government officials were accused by the central government of illegally using and misappropriating social security funds for investment activities. This event triggered numerous political, economic, and legal issues, involving corruption, and ultimately led to the suspension of Chen Liangyu, then a member of the Politburo and Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, from his Politburo membership, followed by his dismissal, investigation, and sentencing.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的二子，77级大学生。中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任大连市市长、辽宁省省长、商务部部长、中共重庆市委书记、中共中央政治局委员。他被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一，亦是习近平的政治对手。在重庆任市委书记期间，黄奇帆曾任市长。2013年，因受贿、贪污、滥用职权罪被判处无期徒刑。他曾是谷开来之夫，其前妻为李雪峰之女。
description.en: Bo Yibo's second son, a member of the Class of 1977. A former Chinese politician, he served as Mayor of Dalian, Governor of Liaoning, Minister of Commerce, Party Secretary of Chongqing, and a member of the Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party. He was implicated in the downfall of Chen Liangyu and considered a political rival of Xi Jinping. During his tenure as Party Secretary of Chongqing, Huang Qifan served as mayor. In 2013, he was sentenced to life imprisonment for bribery, corruption, and abuse of power. He was the husband of Gu Kailai, and his ex-wife is the daughter of Li Xuefeng.

zh-cn: 薄熙来受贿、贪污、滥用职权案

description.zh-cn: 因王立军事件引发的，导致原中共中央政治局委员薄熙来被免职、调查、判刑等一系列政治事件。
中国政治人物，曾任中共中央政治局委员、中共重庆市委书记。在黄奇帆任市长期间，他担任中共重庆市委书记，是原国家级副职领导人。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Chongqing. He served as the Party Secretary of Chongqing during Huang Qifan's tenure as mayor, and was a former national-level deputy leader.

zh-cn: 中国共产党国务院党组
en: Leading Party Members Group of the State Council

zh-cn: 中国共产党中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会党组
en: Leading Party Members Group of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会
en: 19th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于2017年10月召开的全国代表大会，选举产生了第十九届中央委员会。此次大会将习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想写入《中国共产党章程》。会后，习近平人马在中央政治局处于主导地位，团派势力大为削弱。
description.en: The National Congress of the Communist Party of China held in October 2017. It elected the 19th Central Committee and wrote Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era into the Constitution of the Communist Party of China. Following the event, Xi Jinping's allies gained a dominant position in the Politburo, while the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction) saw its influence significantly weakened.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会
en: 20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于2022年10月召开的全国代表大会。大会选举产生了第二十届中央委员会和中央纪律检查委员会，会后多位团派高层未进入新一届中央委员会，显示团派政治影响力下降。大会闭幕会上，胡锦涛被意外带离会场。
description.en: The National Congress of the Communist Party of China, held in October 2022, elected the 20th Central Committee and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Subsequently, several high-level Tuanpai leaders did not enter the new Central Committee, indicating a decline in the faction's political influence. During the closing ceremony, Hu Jintao was unexpectedly escorted out of the hall.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期重要领导人之一。他是瞿秋白的同学，并介绍其加入中国共产党；曾出席共产国际第三次代表大会，并担任共产国际代表鲍罗廷的翻译。他也是广州起义的主要策划者和领导人，并在起义中身亡。
description.en: One of the early important leaders of the Chinese Communist Party. He was a classmate of Qu Qiubai and introduced him to the party. He attended the 3rd World Congress of the Comintern and served as a translator for Comintern representative Mikhail Borodin. He was also a key planner and leader of the Guangzhou Uprising, during which he was killed.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人
中国共产党早期领导人
中国共产党早期领导人
中国共产党早期领导人
中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物，原正国级领导人，中国人民解放军高级将领，上将军衔。他曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央军委副主席、中央军委副秘书长，参与指挥戒严部队，并参与编写《三大纪律八项注意》歌词。他是刘超英的父亲。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, formerly a national-level leader and a senior general in the People's Liberation Army, holding the rank of general. He served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Chairman, and Deputy Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission. He participated in commanding martial law troops and in writing the lyrics for the song 'Three Rules of Discipline and Eight Points for Attention'. He is the father of Liu Chaoying.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央纪委书记，接替尉健行。
中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原正国级党和国家领导人。他曾任北京市市长、市委书记，并担任第十、十一届全国政协主席，以及第十六、十七届中共中央政治局常委。他曾代表中共中央为巴金送别。
description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former state-level leader. He served as Mayor and Party Secretary of Beijing, Chairman of the 10th and 11th National Committees of the CPPCC, and a member of the 16th and 17th Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP. He also paid final respects to Ba Jin on behalf of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国前主要领导人，曾任中共中央政治局常委、中央文明委主任，主管意识形态工作。他在主政河南期间，因推行“血浆经济”而导致艾滋病大规模爆发而备受争议。
description.en: A former senior leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, who served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP Central Committee and director of the Central Spiritual Civilization Development Commission, in charge of ideology. He is controversial for the large-scale AIDS outbreak caused by the promotion of a 'plasma economy' during his tenure in Henan.

description.zh-cn: 黄敬与范瑾的三子，俞强声之弟，中国共产党和中华人民共和国前正国级领导人。曾任中国共产党第十八届中央政治局常委，以及中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会主席（继任贾庆林），中共上海市委书记、中共湖北省委书记、建设部部长等职务。
description.en: Third son of Huang Jing and Fan Jin, younger brother of Yu Qiangsheng, and a former national-level leader of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as a member of the 18th CPC Politburo Standing Committee, Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (succeeding Jia Qinglin), Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, Secretary of the CPC Hubei Provincial Committee, and Minister of Construction.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代海军将领，曾任北洋水师康济号练习舰管带。他参与了甲午战后海军的重建工作，并曾代理国务总理。
description.en: A modern Chinese naval admiral, he served as captain of the Beiyang Fleet's training ship Kangji. He participated in the reconstruction of the navy after the First Sino-Japanese War and later served as Acting Premier.

description.zh-cn: 时任抗日军政大学校长。中国政治家，曾任中央人民政府重工业部副部长、代部长。
description.en: Served as President of the Anti-Japanese Military and Political University. Chinese politician, formerly Vice Minister and Acting Minister of the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government.

zh-cn: 第一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会
第一届全国人大常委会
en: Standing Committee of the 1st National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一届全国人民代表大会的常设机关。于1957年10月22日通过《治安管理处罚条例》。
description.en: The permanent body of the 1st National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China. It passed the 'Regulations on Administrative Penalties for Public Security' on October 22, 1957.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民政府的决策机构。
中华人民共和国的根本政治制度。
毛泽东的出生地。

zh-cn: 中国人民保卫儿童全国委员会
en: National Committee for the Protection of Children of China

description.zh-cn: 中国近代革命家、政治家、社会活动家、画家，中国国民党左派的杰出代表，妇女运动的领袖。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary, politician, social activist, and artist, an outstanding representative of the left wing of the Kuomintang, and a leader of the women's movement.

description.zh-cn: 曾任山西省委书记。在文化大革命期间，他与陈永贵结成政治同盟，共同组织造反派“总站派”。
description.en: Former Secretary of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee. During the Cultural Revolution, he formed a political alliance with Chen Yonggui, and they jointly organized the rebel faction 'Zongzhanpai'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
无党派人士，中国政治人物，鲁涤平在浙江省政府主席职位上的前任。
description.en: A non-partisan figure and Chinese politician, predecessor of Lu Diping as the Chairman of Zhejiang Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期党员，建议成立中央军事委员会。
中国政治活动家，曾建议将党的中央军事委员会改为国家机构。

description.en: One of the functional departments of the Central Military Commission, responsible for the planning, procurement, R&D, and testing of military equipment.

description.en: A modern Chinese writer, publisher, translator, and anarchist. He served as Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC and Chairman of the China Writers Association.

中国国民党于1927年4月12日由蒋介石发动的一场政治清洗运动，持续至1928年。旨在清除其党内中国共产党党员及左派势力，并最终导致第一次国共合作破裂，以及陈独秀的下台。
description.en: A political purge initiated by the Kuomintang on April 12, 1927, led by Chiang Kai-shek, and extending through 1928. It aimed at eliminating Chinese Communist Party members and left-wing elements, resulting in the breakdown of the First United Front and the downfall of Chen Duxiu.

zh-cn: 中国国民党革命委员会中央委员会
en: Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党革命委员会的中央领导机构，也是中华人民共和国的民主党派之一。
description.en: The central leading body of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang, and one of the democratic parties in the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国国民党革命委员会 (南昌起义)
中国国民党革命委员会
en: Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang
Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang (Nanchang Uprising)

description.zh-cn: 南昌起义当天，以国民党左派名义在南昌成立的革命政权机构。
description.en: A revolutionary government body established in Nanchang on the day of the Nanchang Uprising, under the name of the Kuomintang's left wing.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和国家领导人、社会活动家，曾任第四届全国人大常委会委员。他长期负责中共的对外联络、统战、侨务、港澳等工作，是对外工作领导人之一。曾任新华社主管，其批评使得左派报章停止了对《明报》的论战。他在被提名为国家副主席候选人后突然逝世。
description.en: A leader of the Communist Party of China and the state, and a social activist. He served as a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. He was long responsible for the CPC's external liaison, united front work, overseas Chinese affairs, and Hong Kong and Macao affairs, and was a prominent leader in foreign affairs. He also served as the head of Xinhua News Agency, and his criticism led leftist newspapers to cease their polemics against Ming Pao. He died suddenly after being nominated as a candidate for Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 中央研究院副院长兼总干事，中国民权保障同盟执行委员兼秘书长，被军统特务刺杀。
中国近代革命家、政治家、教育家、翻译家。曾于莱比锡大学学习哲学、心理学和艺术史。他曾任中华民国首任教育总长、北京大学校长、中央研究院首任院长。在北大倡导“思想自由，兼容并包”，开“学术”与“自由”之风。作为新文化运动重要领导者，他为五四运动培养思想动力，并曾以辞职抗议政府镇压。毛泽东誉其为“学界泰斗、人世楷模”。
description.en: A modern Chinese revolutionary, politician, educator, and translator. He studied philosophy, psychology, and art history at the University of Leipzig. He served as the first Minister of Education of the Republic of China, President of Peking University, and the first President of Academia Sinica. At Peking University, he advocated for 'freedom of thought and inclusiveness,' fostering a spirit of 'academics' and 'freedom.' As a key leader of the New Culture Movement, he cultivated intellectual momentum for the May Fourth Movement and protested government suppression by resigning. Mao Zedong praised him as a 'titan of the academic world and a model for all.'

description.zh-cn: 越南革命家、政治家，越南共产党和越南民主共和国的缔造者和主要领导人。他是越南独立同盟会的创办者，曾任越南劳动党中央委员会主席。黎笋在其之下担任第二位领导人。
description.en: A Vietnamese revolutionary and politician, founder and key leader of the Communist Party of Vietnam and the Democratic Republic of Vietnam. He was the founder of the Việt Minh and served as Chairman of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Vietnam. Lê Duẩn served as the second-in-command under him.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家，震旦学院及复旦大学的创办人。
description.en: A Chinese educator, founder of Aurora University and Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国国民党内部的秘密政治团体，由黄埔军校毕业生组成，又称蓝衣社。
description.en: A secret political group within the Kuomintang, formed by graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, also known as the Blue Shirts Society.

中国共产党官方认定的一个在“文化大革命”期间存在的“反革命集团”，是对林彪、陈伯达及其部分追随者的官方称谓。该政治帮派组织被指控与江青反革命集团勾结，试图夺取最高权力并策划暗杀毛泽东。
description.en: An 'anti-revolutionary clique' officially identified by the Communist Party of China as existing during the 'Cultural Revolution'. It is the official designation for Lin Biao, Chen Boda, and some of their followers. This political faction was accused of colluding with the Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary clique, attempting to seize supreme power, and plotting to assassinate Mao Zedong.

中国人民解放军南京军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾在中国东部设立的大军区之一。
description.en: One of the former major military regions of the People's Liberation Army, located in eastern China.

中国共产党上海市第十一届委员会

Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.en: The leading body of the Communist Party of China in Shanghai. Chen Liangyu served here for a long time as Deputy Secretary and Secretary.

中华人民共和国政治人物，李先念的女儿，刘亚洲的妻子。曾任第十二届全国政协常委、中国人民对外友好协会会长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former member of the Standing Committee of the 12th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries. She is the daughter of Li Xiannian and the wife of Liu Yazhou.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖北省红安县
birth_place.en: Hong'an County, Hubei, People's Republic of China

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国财政部
en: Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，主管国家财政收支、财税政策等事务。在文化大革命期间曾与中国人民银行合并，同时也是国家开发银行的创始机构及主要股东之一。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for national fiscal revenue and expenditure, fiscal and taxation policies, etc. It was merged with the People's Bank of China during the Cultural Revolution, and is also one of the founding institutions and major shareholders of China Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军上将，作家，曾任国防大学政治委员。系李先念女婿，李小林之夫。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army Air Force, writer, and former Political Commissar of the PLA National Defence University. He is also the son-in-law of Li Xiannian and husband of Li Xiaolin.

description.zh-cn: 1927年11月13日，中国共产党在湖北省黄安、麻城两县领导的农民武装起义。
description.en: An armed peasant uprising led by the Communist Party of China in Huang'an and Macheng counties, Hubei province, on November 13, 1927.

en: Campaign of the North China Plain Pocket

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战初期，中原军区主力部队在国民党军的包围下，向外线突围的战略军事行动。
description.en: A military operation in the early stage of the Chinese Civil War where the troops of the Central Plains Military Region broke out from the encirclement of the Nationalist army.

en: People's Liberation Army at the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and massacre

description.zh-cn: 1989年发生在中国北京的政治风波，期间中国政府动用军队镇压天安门广场的抗议活动。1989年6月3日晚至4日凌晨，中国人民解放军对示威学生进行了武力清场。此次流血事件广泛传播，使得东欧各国军队在面对民众示威时无力继续镇压，从而促成了东欧的和平演变。
description.en: Political turmoil occurred in Beijing, China in 1989, during which the Chinese government used military force to suppress the Tiananmen Square protests. From the night of June 3rd to the early morning of June 4th, 1989, the People's Liberation Army conducted a violent clearance operation against demonstrating students. The widely reported bloodshed of this incident made Eastern European armies reluctant to suppress public demonstrations, thus facilitating peaceful transitions in Eastern Europe.

description.zh-cn: 江青的出生地。

中国电影表演艺术家。2005年被中国电影表演艺术学会评为中国电影百年百位优秀演员之一。他曾是江青在济南学戏时的老同学，并在上海帮助过她。
description.en: A Chinese film performing artist. In 2005, he was named one of the 100 Excellent Actors in 100 Years of Chinese Cinema by the China Film Performance Art Academy. He was Jiang Qing's old classmate from her opera studies in Jinan and helped her in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 中国剧作家，曾帮助过江青。
江青（蓝苹）曾加入的电影公司。
时任中共中央宣传部干部，受理江青恢复党籍申请。
中国政治人物、中共官员，曾任广州市人民委员会市长。江青申请恢复党籍时，与其关系密切。
description.en: Chinese politician and CCP official, formerly Mayor of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Committee. He was closely associated with Jiang Qing during her application for party membership reinstatement.

description.en: A former department under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for cultural and artistic affairs. It granted special approval for Gong Li's admission to the Central Academy of Drama in 1985, and was merged into the newly formed Ministry of Culture and Tourism in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 一部1950年上映，并在1950年代初遭到大规模政治批判的中国电影。
江青等人借引进彩色电视生产线发起的政治事件。
江青等人借国产远洋货轮“风庆轮”的报道发起的政治事件。
中国政治人物，毛泽东的侄子，毛泽民与朱旦华之子。在毛泽东晚年期间曾任中共中央政治局联络员，是文化大革命时期的重要人物，曾作为江青的政治盟友和四人帮的支持者，后一同被捕。
description.en: Chinese politician, Mao Zedong's nephew, and son of Mao Zemin and Zhu Danhua. He served as a liaison for the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau during Mao Zedong's later years. A key figure during the Cultural Revolution, he was an ally of Jiang Qing and a supporter of the Gang of Four, and was later arrested with them.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京市的公墓，是江青（化名李云鹤）和吴石的安葬地。
description.en: A cemetery in Beijing, serving as the burial place for Jiang Qing (alias Li Yunhe) and Wu Shi.

description.en: One of the founders of the Shanghai Workers' Revolutionary Rebel General Headquarters, and a former member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任上海市革命委员会副主任、中共上海市委书记。文革期间是王洪文的政治盟友，文革后被判刑。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Revolutionary Committee and Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee. He was a political ally of Wang Hongwen during the Cultural Revolution and was sentenced after its end.

description.zh-cn: 林彪集团成员、亲信之一，林立果的心腹。曾任中国人民解放军空军第四军政委。后被王洪文和许世友诱捕。
description.en: A member and close confidant of the Lin Biao faction, and a key associate of Lin Liguo. He served as the political commissar of the Fourth Army of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Air Force and was later entrapped and arrested by Wang Hongwen and Xu Shiyou.

description.zh-cn: 前文化部副部长，与王洪文一同被关押。
