description.zh-cn: 康生出生地
由孙中山创立，中华民国创建政党，曾于1928-1949年在中国大陆执政。期间与中共决裂，参与国共内战，主导对中华苏维埃共和国的军事行动等。战败后迁台，是台湾（中华民国）主要政党，为泛蓝阵营核心，参与“蓝白合作”。2000年败于陈水扁，结束其在台55年执政。近期在2024年立委选举中支持蔡壁如参选台中市第一选举区。
description.en: Founded by Sun Yat-sen, it is the founding political party of the Republic of China, and ruled mainland China from 1928 to 1949. During this period, it broke with the Chinese Communist Party, participated in the Chinese Civil War, and led military actions against the Chinese Soviet Republic, among other actions. After its defeat, it relocated to Taiwan, and is a major political party in Taiwan (Republic of China), forming the core of the Pan-Blue Coalition and participating in the 'Blue-White Cooperation'. It was defeated by Chen Shui-bian in 2000, ending its 55-year rule in Taiwan. Recently, it supported Tsai Pi-ru's candidacy in Taichung's 1st constituency during the 2024 legislative election.

description.zh-cn: 由中国国民党于1924年在广州组建，是中华民国国民政府的军队，也是中国国民党在1947年行宪前的主要武装力量。自1925年至1947年，其作为中华民国的国民军队。在蒋介石领导下发动北伐，推翻北洋政府，统一中国。黄公略曾于北伐期间在此服役。长征期间，其部队围剿追击红军，刘志丹、黄公略因此身亡。其留守部队曾在庐山与日军进行了长达九个月的保卫战。1948年后，其改组为中华民国国军。孙殿英曾被收编并担任军长。
description.en: Founded by the Kuomintang (KMT) in Guangzhou in 1924, it served as the army of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China and was the main military force of the Kuomintang before the implementation of the constitution in 1947. From 1925 to 1947, it functioned as the national army of the Republic of China. Under Chiang Kai-shek's leadership, it launched the Northern Expedition, overthrowing the Beiyang Government and unifying China. Huang Gonglue served within its ranks during the Northern Expedition. During the Long March, its forces encircled and pursued the Red Army, leading to the deaths of Liu Zhidan and Huang Gonglue. Its garrison forces fought a nine-month defensive battle against the Japanese army on Mount Lu. After 1948, it was reorganized into the Republic of China Armed Forces. Sun Dianying's forces were also incorporated, and he served as an army commander.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十八集团军

description.zh-cn: 中国国民革命军第八路军的简称。它是抗日战争时期中国共产党领导的主要武装力量之一，由中国工农红军主力改编而成。该部曾与孙殿英部保持良好关系，余秋里等重要人物也曾在此担任多个政治职务。
description.en: Abbreviated as the Eighth Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army, it was one of the main armed forces led by the Communist Party of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War, formed from the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. The unit maintained a good relationship with Sun Dianying's troops, and important figures like Yu Qiuli held various political positions within it.

description.zh-cn: 一场由蔡锷、唐继尧等人在云南发起的军事运动，旨在反对袁世凯称帝。梁启超是主要策划者之一。这场内战最终迫使袁世凯取消帝制，主要力量来自蔡锷等人组织的军队。
description.en: A military movement and civil war initiated in Yunnan by Cai E, Tang Jiyao, and others, aimed at opposing Yuan Shikai's attempt to declare himself emperor. Liang Qichao was one of its main planners. This movement ultimately forced Yuan Shikai to abolish the monarchy, with its primary forces organized by Cai E.

description.zh-cn: 1927年8月1日，中国共产党为反击国民党清党，以国民党左派名义在江西南昌发动武装起义。此事件标志着中国共产党独立领导武装斗争和创建军队的开端，也是第一次国共内战的开始。8月1日后来被定为中国人民解放军建军节。
description.en: On August 1, 1927, the Chinese Communist Party launched an armed uprising in Nanchang, Jiangxi, under the banner of the Kuomintang's left wing, in response to the Kuomintang's purge. This event marked the beginning of the CPC's independent leadership of armed struggle and army building, and also the start of the First Chinese Civil War. August 1 was later designated as the Army Day of the People's Liberation Army.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十八集团军第129师
en: 129th Division of the Eighteenth Army Group of the National Revolutionary Army
129th Division of the Eighteenth Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army
129th Division of the Eighth Route Army

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期八路军的主力师之一，由刘伯承任师长，邓小平任政委，李达任参谋长。
description.en: One of the main divisions of the Eighth Route Army during the Second Sino-Japanese War, with Liu Bocheng as commander, Deng Xiaoping as political commissar, and Li Da as chief of staff.

description.zh-cn: 1913年，由孙中山等国民党人发动的、旨在反对袁世凯独裁统治的武装革命。该革命因宋教仁遇刺案而爆发，其中黄兴曾任江苏讨袁军总司令。
description.en: An armed revolution launched in 1913 by Sun Yat-sen and other Kuomintang members, aimed at opposing Yuan Shikai's autocratic rule. It broke out following the assassination of Song Jiaoren, with Huang Xing serving as the commander-in-chief of the Jiangsu anti-Yuan army.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命的伟大先行者，中华民国国父、开国元勋。他是中华民国、中国国民党和中国同盟会的缔造者，曾被公推为同盟会总理。他曾是兴中会领袖，领导反清运动，支持自立军起义。其五权宪法理论是监察院创设学理根据。张勋复辟后，他于广州发表《讨逆宣言》，呼吁国会议员南下，发动护法运动。他曾与奉系、皖系组成反直三角同盟，肯定和支持五四运动。
description.en: A great pioneer of China's modern democratic revolution, the Founding Father and a founding father of the Republic of China. He was the founder of the Republic of China, the Kuomintang, and the Tongmenghui, and was elected as the Premier of the Tongmenghui. He was also the leader of the Revive China Society, led the anti-Qing movement, and supported the Self-Support Army Uprising. His Five-Power Constitution theory served as the theoretical basis for the establishment of the Control Yuan. After Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration attempt, he issued the 'Declaration Against Restoration' in Guangzhou, called on parliament members to move south, and launched the Constitutional Protection Movement. He once formed an anti-Zhili triangular alliance with the Fengtian and Anhui cliques, affirmed and supported the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山于1914年在日本成立的革命政党，是中国国民党的前身之一，主要目的是反对袁世凯的统治。
description.en: A revolutionary political party founded by Sun Yat-sen in Japan in 1914, one of the predecessors of the Kuomintang, primarily to oppose the rule of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期成员、活动家，刘伯承的入党介绍人之一，杨尚昆的四哥，著名烈士。
description.en: An early member and activist of the Communist Party of China, one of Liu Bocheng's introducers to the Party, the fourth older brother of Yang Shangkun, and a renowned martyr.

description.zh-cn: 川军将领
1929年，中华民国与苏联因中东铁路权益问题爆发武装冲突。冲突源于中华民国东北当局试图收回中东铁路。
description.en: An armed conflict in 1929 between the Republic of China and the Soviet Union over the control of the Chinese Eastern Railway, stemming from the Republic of China's Northeastern authorities' attempt to reclaim the railway.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争胜利后，中国国民党与中国共产党在重庆进行的一次重要和平谈判。
第二次国共内战初期，由国民党、共产党和美国三方代表组成的军事调停机构。
description.en: A military mediation body composed of representatives from the Kuomintang, the Communist Party, and the United States during the early stages of the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战末期，中国人民解放军发起旨在渡过长江、解放南京及华东地区的关键战役，最终成功渡江。
description.en: A key military campaign launched by the People's Liberation Army during the late stage of the Chinese Civil War, aimed at crossing the Yangtze River and liberating Nanjing and East China, which ultimately succeeded.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国江苏省省会，王近山病逝于此。
description.en: The capital of Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China, where Wang Jinshan passed away.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总医院

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆、彭德怀逝世的地点。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十次全国代表大会
en: 10th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在文化大革命期间召开的全国代表大会。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任中央军事委员会副主席、中国人民解放军国防大学校长、政治委员。他曾是洪学智在总后勤部部长的前任，也长期与粟裕共事。他是张海阳的父亲。
description.en: A general (Shangjiang) of the People's Liberation Army (PLA). He served as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, President and Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University. He was the predecessor to Hong Xuezhi as head of the General Logistics Department, and also worked with Su Yu for a long time. He is the father of Zhang Haiyang.

description.zh-cn: 中国话剧导演、演员，周恩来和邓颖超的养女。
中华人民共和国在20世纪60至70年代进行的核武器、导弹与人造卫星工程，旨在研制原子弹、氢弹和人造地球卫星。钱学森在其中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: The nuclear weapons, missile, and artificial satellite program carried out by the People's Republic of China in the 1960s and 1970s, aimed at developing atomic bombs, hydrogen bombs, and artificial earth satellites. Qian Xuesen played a crucial role in it.

description.zh-cn: 第一届亚非会议。
中美两国乒乓球队互访，开启两国关系正常化进程。

en: 1972 visit by Richard Nixon to China

description.zh-cn: 1972年2月，时任美国总统理查德·尼克松对中华人民共和国进行国事访问。此次历史性访问标志着中美关系破冰，是两国关系正常化的重要一步，也是中美关系史上的一个转折点。它也为中日关系正常化创造了条件。访问期间，双方签署了《上海公报》。
description.en: In February 1972, then-U.S. President Richard Nixon made a historic state visit to the People's Republic of China. This visit marked a breakthrough in Sino-U.S. relations, an important step towards the normalization of relations, and a turning point in the history of Sino-U.S. relations. It also created conditions for the normalization of Sino-Japanese relations. During the visit, the Shanghai Communiqué was signed.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会副主席
en: Vice Chairman of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会设立的副职领导人职位，存在于1956年至1982年间，仅次于中共中央主席。此处的节点代表该职位群体。
description.en: A deputy leadership position of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, established from 1956 to 1982, and second only to the Chairman of the CPC Central Committee. This node represents the group of individuals holding this position.

zh-cn: 首都医科大学附属复兴医院

description.zh-cn: 王洪文去世的医院。
文化大革命期间上海的政治事件。
毛泽东在长沙批评“四人帮”的一系列谈话。
中国政治人物，曾任中共云南省委书记、西南军政委员会公安部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly served as Secretary of the CPC Yunnan Provincial Committee and Minister of Public Security of the Southwest Military and Administrative Committee.

en: War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争是20世纪30至40年代，中华民国抵抗大日本帝国全面侵略的战争。九一八事变被视为其开端，全面抗战始于1937年七七事变，蒋介石在庐山发表的演讲标志着全面抗战的开始。这场战争持续至1945年，是第二次世界大战的重要组成部分，也是日本放弃1940年东京奥运会主办权的主要原因。战争期间，国民政府迁都重庆，成为中国战时首都；清华大学、北大、南开组成西南联合大学；陕甘边根据地是其出发地之一。
description.en: The Sino-Japanese War, from the 1930s to 1940s, was a full-scale conflict where the Republic of China resisted a comprehensive invasion by the Empire of Japan. The Mukden Incident is considered its beginning. The full-scale resistance started with the Marco Polo Bridge Incident in 1937, and Chiang Kai-shek's speech at Lushan marked its commencement. Lasting until 1945, this war was a crucial part of World War II and the primary reason Japan relinquished its right to host the 1940 Tokyo Olympics. During the war, the Nationalist Government moved its capital to Chongqing as China's wartime capital; Tsinghua, Peking, and Nankai Universities formed the National Southwestern Associated University; and the Shaan-Gan-Bian Base Area was one of its starting points.

location.zh-cn: 山东省肥城市陆房地区

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争期间，八路军第115师在山东省肥城县陆房地区与日伪军发生的一场突围战斗。
description.en: A breakout battle during the Second Sino-Japanese War between the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army and Japanese and puppet troops in the Lufang area of Feicheng County, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 侵华日军少佐。
中华民国军事将领。

zh-cn: 第三次讨伐吴化文部战役

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石（1887-1975），中华民国政治家、军事家、中国国民党总裁，长期担任中华民国最高领导人。曾任黄埔军校校长、国民政府主席、中华民国总统等职。执政期间，他主张“攘外应先安内”，领导国民革命军“围剿”红军，主导1927年“四一二清党”及镇压二二八事件。国民政府定庐山为夏都后，他常在此处理国事，并于1937年发表抗日演讲。1936年西安事变后，长期软禁张学良。他曾下令军统缉拿并刺杀王亚樵，亦谴责文化大革命中的红卫兵运动。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek (1887-1975) was a Chinese politician, military strategist, and Director-General of the Kuomintang, who served as the long-term supreme leader of the Republic of China. He held positions such as Commandant of the Whampoa Military Academy, Chairman of the Nationalist Government, and President of the Republic of China. During his rule, he advocated 'first internal pacification, then external resistance,' led the National Revolutionary Army's 'encirclement' campaigns against the Red Army, and orchestrated the 1927 April 12th Purge and suppressed the February 28 Incident. After the Nationalist Government designated Mount Lu as the summer capital, he often handled state affairs there and delivered a speech announcing resistance against Japan in 1937. Following the 1936 Xi'an Incident, he placed Zhang Xueliang under long-term house arrest. He also ordered the Juntong to capture and assassinate Wang Yaqiao, and condemned the Red Guard movement during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1912年在中国大陆建立的共和制国家。1912年至1949年间，作为中国的执政政权统治中国大陆，并曾是中东路事件的一方。1949年第二次国共内战失利后，其政府迁至台湾，实际控制台湾、澎湖、金门、马祖等岛屿，其统治区域亦称“台湾地区”或“自由地区”，与中华人民共和国存在主权争议。该政权在1971年前曾代表中国在联合国的席位，一度被艾森豪威尔政府承认为代表全中国的唯一合法政府。在美国与中华人民共和国建交前，其驻美大使馆为中国在美国的外交代表机构。它也是中国文化大学的所在地。
description.en: A republic established on the Chinese mainland in 1912. From 1912 to 1949, it ruled mainland China as the governing regime and was a party in the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929. After its defeat in the Second Chinese Civil War in 1949, its government relocated to Taiwan, actually controlling Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu islands. Its effective jurisdiction is also referred to as the 'Taiwan Area' or 'Free Area', and it has sovereignty disputes with the People's Republic of China. This regime held China's seat in the United Nations until 1971 and was once recognized by the Eisenhower administration as the sole legitimate government of all China. Before the United States established diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China, its embassy in the U.S. was the diplomatic mission of China in the United States. It is also the country where Chinese Culture University is located.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省级特别行政区，实行一国两制和高度自治。仓颉输入法在此地非常普及。
description.en: A special administrative region of the People's Republic of China where the Cangjie input method is very popular.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪20年代，中国国民党与中国共产党之间的首次合作，旨在统一中国。合作因1927年国民党清党而破裂。
description.en: The first alliance between the Kuomintang and the Chinese Communist Party in the 1920s, aimed at unifying China. The alliance collapsed in 1927 due to the KMT's party purge.

description.zh-cn: 2022年在中国大陆多地发生的、反对动态清零政策的全国性抗议活动。
description.en: Protests against the Chinese government's zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国务院副总理。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 与战争、军队等相关的事务
中国政治家和军事家，中华民国陆军一级上将。曾任国民党长沙绥靖公署主任兼湖南省政府主席，东京振武学校校友。1949年率部起义。
description.en: A Chinese politician and military strategist, General (first class) of the Republic of China Army. He served as the Director of the Kuomintang Changsha Pacification Commissioner's Office and Chairman of the Hunan Provincial Government, and was an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. In 1949, he led his troops in an uprising.

description.zh-cn: 由中华民国实际控制的岛屿群，位于台湾海峡西侧，靠近中国大陆。此处亦是赵家骧的逝世地。
description.en: An island group controlled by the Republic of China, located on the west side of the Taiwan Strait, close to mainland China. It is also the place of death of Zhao Jiaxiang.

description.zh-cn: 金门群岛中的一个岛屿
中国共产党领导下的广泛政治联盟，联合各民主党派、人民团体、各族各界人士的政治联盟。

zh-cn: 中华民国南京国民政府
en: Nationalist Government of the Republic of China
Nationalist government of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 国民政府由中国国民党建立，是中华民国训政时期的中央政府与最高行政机关。最初成立于广州，北伐后取代北洋政府。四一二事件后，蒋介石等人在南京成立国民政府，与武汉政府对立并复合。南京国民政府（1928-1948）由蒋中正领导，推行行政改革，1931年处决邓演达。期间，将中华苏维埃共和国视为叛乱并多次围剿。东北易帜后，改编奉系军阀为东北军。定都南京后，将庐山设为“夏都”。抗日战争期间，迁都重庆作为战时首都。二二八事件后，改组台湾省级行政机关。因未追究孙殿英盗陵责任而与溥仪决裂。
description.en: The Nationalist Government, established by the Kuomintang, served as the central government and supreme administrative organ of the Republic of China during its period of political tutelage. Initially founded in Guangzhou, it replaced the Beiyang government after the Northern Expedition. Following the April 12th Incident, Chiang Kai-shek and others established the Nanjing Nationalist Government, which initially opposed and later reconciled with the Wuhan Government. The Nanjing Nationalist Government (1928-1948), led by Chiang Kai-shek, implemented administrative reforms and executed Deng Yanda in 1931. During this period, it regarded the Chinese Soviet Republic as a rebellion and launched multiple military encirclement campaigns against it. After the Northeast Flag Replacement, it reorganized the Fengtian warlords into the Northeastern Army. After establishing its capital in Nanjing, it designated Mount Lu as the 'Summer Capital'. During the Anti-Japanese War, it relocated its capital to Chongqing as the wartime capital. Following the 228 Incident, it reorganized Taiwan's provincial administrative body. It broke with Puyi due to its failure to prosecute Sun Dianying for the tomb robbery.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家、政治家，国民党高级将领，中华民国陆军二级上将。他曾任新疆省主席，并释放了被盛世才关押的部分中共党员。在一·二八事变中率第五军增援十九路军。后任京沪警备司令，在虹桥机场事件中下令格杀闯入机场的日军。
description.en: A Chinese military strategist and politician, a high-ranking general of the Kuomintang, and a Second-Class General of the Republic of China Army. He served as the Chairman of Xinjiang Province and released some of the CCP members imprisoned by Sheng Shicai. He led the Fifth Army to reinforce the 19th Route Army during the January 28 Incident. Later, as the commander of the Jinghu Garrison, he ordered the killing of Japanese soldiers who broke into the airport during the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的政党之一。

en: Constitution of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的根本大法。
中华人民共和国的国家权力机关。
中国共产党领导下的、中华人民共和国的群众性社会组织。作为一种社会组织形式，安徽省妇女联合会即属于此类组织。
description.en: Mass organizations under the leadership of the Communist Party of China in the People's Republic of China. As a form of social organization, the Anhui Provincial Women's Federation, for instance, belongs to this type.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家、政治家、国民党将领。他曾是中国国民党革命委员会的主要创始人和领导人。他曾在广州主持会议决定“清共”，引发广州四一五事件；也曾发动福建事变，并为躲避军统追杀的王亚樵提供了庇护。
description.en: A Chinese military strategist, politician, and Kuomintang general. He was a principal founder and leader of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang. He presided over a meeting in Guangzhou that decided to "purge the communists," leading to the Guangzhou April 15th Incident. He also launched the Fujian Incident and later provided refuge for Wang Yaqiao, who was fleeing from Juntong assassins.

description.zh-cn: 该地位于东亚，曾于甲午战争后依据《马关条约》割让予大日本帝国，由明治天皇统治。现由中华民国有效管辖，是潘晓颖命案的司法管辖区之一。吴石曾在此从事地下工作并被处决。这里也是新加坡“星光部队”的训练地点、神舟五号部分植物种子的来源地、仓颉输入法的发源地及中国文化大学所在地。1996年总统选举期间，中国大陆曾对其外海发射导弹，引发台海危机。
description.en: Located in East Asia, this area was ceded to the Empire of Japan after the First Sino-Japanese War under the Treaty of Shimonoseki, with Emperor Meiji as its ruler. It is currently under the effective jurisdiction of the Republic of China and is one of the jurisdictions involved in the Poon Hiu-wing murder case. Wu Shi conducted underground activities here and was eventually executed. It also serves as the training location for Singapore's 'Starlight' military units, is the origin of some plant seeds carried aboard the Shenzhou 5 spacecraft, the birthplace of the Cangjie input method, and the location of Chinese Culture University. During its 1996 presidential election, mainland China's missile launches off its coast triggered the Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 香港主权由英国移交给中华人民共和国，中华人民共和国恢复行使主权的历史事件。
description.en: The historical event marking the transfer of sovereignty over Hong Kong from the United Kingdom to the People's Republic of China and the resumption of China's exercise of sovereignty.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国恢复对澳门行使主权的事件。

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会澳门地区委员

description.zh-cn: 全国政协在澳门地区的委员。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军驻香港部队
en: People's Liberation Army Hong Kong Garrison

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国派驻香港特别行政区的武装力量

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军驻澳门部队

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国派驻澳门特别行政区的武装力量

zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会香港特别行政区基本法委员会

description.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会的工作机构

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国立法法
en: Legislation Law of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 规范中华人民共和国立法活动的法律
将全国人大改革为两院制议会的提议
对缺乏实际权力的立法机关的贬称
中共在延安时期进行的思想和政治运动，后期由康生发动了抓“特务”的政治运动。
description.en: A thought and political movement conducted by the CCP during the Yan'an period. In its later stages, a political campaign to identify and arrest 'spies' was initiated by Kang Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 北伐战争是由中国国民党领导、广州国民政府（国民革命军）发起，旨在推翻北洋军阀统治、统一中国的军事行动。反奉战争削弱了吴佩孚在华中的力量，为北伐创造了有利条件。李富春、鲁涤平（任军长）和黄公略曾参与其中。
description.en: The Northern Expedition was a military campaign led by the Kuomintang and launched by the Guangzhou Nationalist Government (National Revolutionary Army), aimed at overthrowing the Beiyang warlord rule and unifying China. The Anti-Fengtian War weakened Wu Peifu's forces in Central China, creating favorable conditions for the expedition. Li Fuchun, Lu Diping (as an army commander), and Huang Gonglue participated in it.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，担任沈阳市副市长，亦是叶剑英的配偶。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, serving as the Vice Mayor of Shenyang, and also Ye Jianying's spouse.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英提出的关于台湾回归、实现和平统一的九条方针政策。
中华民国政治人物，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A political figure of the Republic of China, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第一方面军
en: First Front Army of the Red Army
First Front Army of the Chinese Red Army
First Front Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的主力部队之一，即红一方面军，由红一军团和红三军团合编而成。该部队由中共中央直接领导，进行了长征，最终抵达陕甘边根据地。吴烈曾在此担任警卫并随其长征。
description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, also known as the First Front Army. It was formed by the combination of the First and Third Red Army Corps. This unit was directly led by the Central Committee of the CCP, undertook the Long March, and ultimately arrived at the Shaan-Gan-Bian Base Area. Wu Lie served as a guard in this unit and participated in the Long March with it.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家、军事家、陆军一级上将，国民党高级将领。曾任中华民国副总统、行政院院长、第十一师师长，并主政东北。他组织的“九人小组”调查报告导致孙立人被软禁，并于1943年参观育才学校。其亲信石祖黄、车蕃如曾先后担任第一快速纵队司令。他也是赵家骧的上级。
description.en: A politician, military leader, and first-class general of the Republic of China Army, also a high-ranking Kuomintang general. He served as Vice President, Premier, and commander of the 11th Division, and once governed Northeast China. His confidants, Shi Zuhuang and Che Fanru, successively served as commanders of the First Fast Column. The investigation report from his 'nine-person group' notably led to Sun Li-jen's house arrest. He also visited Yucai School in 1943, giving a positive evaluation, and was Zhao Jiaxiang's superior.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国将领。
中华民国将领。
中华民国将领，宁夏军阀。
中华民国军事将领，冯玉祥国民军麾下“五虎将”之一，曾任河北省政府主席。1926年4月9日，他派兵包围执政府，将段祺瑞赶走。
description.en: A general in the Republic of China, one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' under Feng Yuxiang's Guominjun, and former chairman of the Hebei Provincial Government. On April 9, 1926, he dispatched troops to surround the executive government and drove out Duan Qirui.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军上将，国民革命军第四军军长，北伐名将。曾是叶挺的上级。
description.en: A General of the Republic of China Army, commander of the Fourth Army of the National Revolutionary Army, and a famous general of the Northern Expedition. He was also Ye Ting's superior.

description.zh-cn: 革命家，朱德的挚友
滇系军阀首领，曾长期统治云南，并创办了建国军军士队。他与蔡锷等人共同发动重九起义和护国战争。他还是东京振武学校校友。
description.en: The leader of the Yunnan warlord clique, he ruled Yunnan for an extended period and founded the National Construction Army's NCO team. Along with Cai E and others, he launched the Double Ninth Uprising and the National Protection War. He was also an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领
北伐战争中由叶挺领导的、以共产党员为骨干的国民革命军部队。
中国政治人物。

zh-cn: 尼基塔·谢尔盖耶维奇·赫鲁晓夫

birth_place.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国库尔斯克省

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，斯大林逝世后的主要领导人。他曾任苏联共产党中央委员会第一书记和苏联部长会议主席。在苏共二十大上发表“秘密报告”，批判斯大林个人崇拜，推行“去斯大林化”和“赫鲁晓夫解冻”政策。作为苏联部长会议主席，他成为冷战时期肯尼迪的主要对手，尤其在古巴导弹危机期间。他曾主导将克里米亚划归乌克兰。其对斯大林的批判影响了毛泽东发动文革的决策，导致中苏关系恶化。
description.en: A Soviet statesman and the primary leader of the Soviet Union after Stalin's death. He served as the First Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and Chairman of the Council of Ministers. At the 20th Party Congress, he delivered the 'Secret Speech,' denouncing Stalin's cult of personality and initiating policies of de-Stalinization and the Khrushchev Thaw. As Chairman of the Council of Ministers, he was Kennedy's main adversary during the Cold War, especially during the Cuban Missile Crisis. He also led the transfer of Crimea to Ukraine. His criticism of Stalin influenced Mao Zedong's decision to launch the Cultural Revolution, leading to the deterioration of Sino-Soviet relations.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党元老和早期主要领导人之一。他曾被推举为南京国民政府主席，其亲信刘庐隐据称收买了王亚樵执行暗杀任务。
description.en: A veteran and one of the early and principal leaders of the Kuomintang (KMT). He was appointed as the chairman of the Nanjing Nationalist Government, and his confidant Liu Luyin allegedly hired Wang Yaqiao for assassination missions.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东关于抗日战争的军事理论著作。
抗日战争期间晋察冀军区部队在河北涞源的黄土岭地区对日军的一场战斗，击毙了日军中将阿部规秀。
description.en: A battle during the Second Sino-Japanese War fought by the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region forces against the Japanese army in the Huangtuling area of Laiyuan, Hebei, where Japanese Lieutenant General Abe Norihide was killed.

description.zh-cn: 护法运动是由孙中山等人为维护《中华民国临时约法》而发起，旨在反对北洋军阀统治的系列政治军事斗争。段祺瑞在平定张勋复辟后拒绝恢复国会和约法，是护法运动的直接导火索。
description.en: The Constitutional Protection Movement was a series of political and military struggles initiated by Sun Yat-sen and others to protect the Provisional Constitution of the Republic of China and oppose the rule of Beiyang warlords. Duan Qirui's refusal to restore the parliament and constitution after suppressing Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration attempt was the direct trigger for the movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行首任行长。
description.en: The first Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山长子，中华民国政治家，毕业于伯克利。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen's eldest son, a politician of the Republic of China, and an alumnus of Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫国民政府的重要人物，在汪精卫死后继任其领导职务。
description.en: A key figure in the Wang Jingwei regime who succeeded Wang Jingwei as its leader after his death.

description.zh-cn: 指在中国共产党看来，崇拜西方资本主义国家制度、否定社会主义的思潮。
陈云提出的经济理论，主张计划经济为主，市场调节为辅，强调市场经济应在国家计划的指导下进行，即著名的“鸟应关在笼子里”理论。
description.en: An economic theory proposed by Chen Yun, advocating for a planned economy as the primary mode with market regulation as supplementary. It emphasizes that the market economy should operate under the guidance of state planning, famously summarized by the 'bird in a cage' metaphor.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军上将，参与审判吴石案，后因替吴石等人陈情而受处分。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Army who participated in the trial of the Wu Shi case and was later disciplined for pleading for clemency.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军高级将领，整编第七十四师师长，在孟良崮战役中阵亡
description.en: A high-ranking general of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China, commander of the Reorganized 74th Division, who was killed in the Menglianggu Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 曾任青海省委第一书记，中央文革小组成员。
康生首任妻子。
中华民国陆军一级上将，曾任中国陆军总司令，代表中国接受日本投降。他也是东京振武学校校友。抗战胜利后，他下令炸毁了位于南京的汪精卫墓。
description.en: A first-class general of the Republic of China Army, he served as the Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Army and represented China in accepting Japan's surrender. He was also an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. After the victory in the Anti-Japanese War, he ordered the destruction of Wang Jingwei's tomb in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山创立，1949年并入华北大学，成为中国人民大学的组成来源。

en: Ministry of National Defense (Republic of China)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的国防事务主管机关，隶属于行政院，负责统辖中华民国国军，管辖中正国防干部预备学校，并作为国防部保密局的上级单位。
description.en: The defense affairs authority of the Republic of China, subordinate to the Executive Yuan, responsible for commanding the Republic of China Armed Forces, having jurisdiction over the Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School, and serving as the superior authority to the Bureau of Secrecy of the Ministry of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 中国农工民主党创始人之一，曾在反右运动中被划为右派。
description.en: One of the founders of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party, he was labeled a rightist during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国云南省主席，后宣布起义。
description.en: Then Chairman of Yunnan Province of the Republic of China, who later declared an uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中共党员，在新疆被捕后叛变。
description.en: A CCP member who defected after being arrested in Xinjiang.

en: Government of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的中央行政机构，由中国国民党领导。在1949年前曾统治中国大陆，早期（1913年10月10日至1928年12月29日）主要由北洋军阀掌控，为建国初期中央政府。蒋介石领导时期，曾与苏联签署《中苏友好同盟条约》。1948年行宪后，因国共内战战败迁往台湾。1949年后，作为退守台湾的执政当局，负责侦破并瓦解了中共台湾省工委组织。在《中日联合声明》中，日本承认中华人民共和国政府为中国唯一合法政府，间接否定了其合法性。
description.en: The central administrative organ of the Republic of China, led by the Kuomintang. It governed mainland China until 1949. Its early central government (Oct 10, 1913 – Dec 29, 1928) was primarily controlled by Beiyang warlords. Under Chiang Kai-shek, it signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance. After its 1948 constitutional rule and defeat in the Chinese Civil War, it relocated to Taiwan. There, post-1949, it dismantled the CPC Taiwan Provincial Work Committee. The Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué later implicitly denied its legitimacy by recognizing the PRC as China's sole legal government.

description.zh-cn: 日本的一个政党。
description.en: A political party in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党内左派理论家、保守派代表人物，曾任中共中央书记处书记、中宣部部长。
description.en: A representative of the conservative (leftist) faction within the Chinese Communist Party, who served as head of the Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国高级将领，十九路军的创建者之一，福建事变的主要领导人之一。
description.en: A high-ranking general of the Republic of China, one of the founders of the 19th Route Army, and a key leader of the Fujian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 宋庆龄之妹，蒋中正（蒋介石）的第二任妻子，前中华民国第一夫人。她在蒋与毛福梅离婚后迎娶，并曾在西安事变后保护张学良。在李登辉担任总统初期，她曾试图干预其对军队高层的人事安排。
description.en: Sister of Soong Ching-ling, she was the second wife of Chiang Kai-shek (Jiang Zhongzheng) and former First Lady of the Republic of China. She married Chiang after his divorce from Mao Fumei and protected Zhang Xueliang after the Xi'an Incident. During the early days of Lee Teng-hui's presidency, she attempted to interfere with his personnel arrangements for the military high command.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正长子，毛福梅之子。中华民国政治人物及军事将领，曾任第6、7任总统、行政院院长和国防部总政治作战部主任。在台期间，他逐步掌控情治系统，构陷孙立人致其兵权被拔。在其总统任内，宣布解除戒严，开启台湾民主化进程。他还批评孔祥熙为“大资产阶级”，并指示将三所军事预备学校合并。逝世后，继任者李登辉解除了报禁。
description.en: Eldest son of Chiang Kai-shek and Mao Fumei. A political and military leader of the Republic of China, he served as its 6th and 7th President, Premier of the Executive Yuan, and Director of the General Political Warfare Department of the Ministry of National Defense. During his time in Taiwan, he gradually gained control over the intelligence system and framed Sun Li-jen, leading to the removal of his military power. As president, he announced the lifting of martial law, initiating Taiwan's democratization process. He also criticized H. H. Kung as a 'big bourgeois' and directed the merger of three military preparatory schools. After his death, his successor Lee Teng-hui lifted the press ban.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山原配夫人。
江青的第二任丈夫，影评人。
中国共产党在延安创办的综合性艺术院校。
原中华人民共和国绥远省的最高行政机关。
乌兰夫长子，曾任全国人大常委会副委员长、内蒙古自治区主席。
description.en: Eldest son of Ulanhu, former Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and Chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫的孙女，布赫之女，曾任内蒙古自治区政府主席。
description.en: Ulanhu's granddaughter, Buhe's daughter, former Chairwoman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党革命家、军事家、外交家，中国人民解放军高级将领。曾任红一军团第三师政治委员，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A Chinese Communist revolutionary, military strategist, and diplomat, a senior general of the People's Liberation Army. He notably served as Political Commissar of the Third Division of the Red First Army Group and was a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，在黑茶山空难中遇难。
description.en: One of the early leaders of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在中国共产党领导下，蒙旗保安队发动的，反对日本侵略和国民党政府的武装暴动。
description.en: An armed uprising launched by the Mongolian Banner Security Forces (蒙旗保安队), under the leadership of the Communist Party of China, against Japanese aggression and the Kuomintang government.

zh-cn: 国民革命军新编第三师

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期国民革命军的一支部队。
内蒙古人民共和国临时政府主席。
description.en: Chairman of the Provisional Government of the Inner Mongolian People's Republic.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治运动联合会
en: Federation of the Inner Mongolia Autonomy Movement

description.zh-cn: 由乌兰夫组织成立的推动内蒙古自治的统一领导机构。
description.en: An organization established by Ulanhu to promote the autonomy of Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 为内蒙古培养军事和政治干部的学校。
中华人民共和国成立前，在中国共产党领导下成立的第一个省级少数民族自治政府。
description.en: The first provincial-level minority autonomous government established under the leadership of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古人民解放军的前身。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军内蒙古军区
en: Inner Mongolia Military Region of the PLA

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在内蒙古自治区的军事领导机构。

zh-cn: 中央人民政府民族事务委员会

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府政务院下设的负责民族事务的机构。
中华人民共和国成立初期的大行政区之一华北区的最高行政管理机关。
中共中央在内蒙古的派出机构。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家民族事务委员会
en: State Ethnic Affairs Commission of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院下属的民族事务管理部门。
description.en: The department under the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for ethnic affairs.

zh-cn: 中国共产党内蒙古自治区委员会
en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Regional Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在内蒙古自治区的领导机关。
description.en: The leadership body of the Communist Party of China in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民委员会

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区的人民政府。
位于内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市的一所综合性大学。

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议内蒙古自治区委员会
en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Regional Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在内蒙古自治区的省级地方组织。
description.en: The provincial-level local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫的堂兄。
乌兰夫的儿子，曾任包头市市长、山西省副省长。
乌兰夫的女儿，曾任内蒙古自治区卫生厅厅长。
乌兰夫的女儿，新华社记者。
乌兰夫的堂侄女，曾任内蒙古自治区政协副主席。
乌兰夫的堂侄女婿，曾任中共内蒙古自治区纪委书记。
乌兰夫的妹夫，曾任内蒙古自治区政府主席。
乌兰夫的内堂弟，云丽文的堂弟，曾任内蒙古自治区政府主席。
乌兰夫的出生地，位于今内蒙古自治区土默特左旗一带。该地历史上也是一个蒙古部落及行政区域，其辖地于1914年被划归绥远特别区。
description.en: A Mongol tribe and administrative area whose territory was incorporated into the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国陕西省渭南市下辖的一个县，同时也是习仲勋的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Weinan City, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, and also the birthplace of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋的第一任妻子。
description.en: Ex-wife of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，中共元老习仲勋的第二任妻子。她是习近平和齐桥桥的母亲，也是习明泽的祖母。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China and the second wife of the CCP elder Xi Zhongxun. She is the mother of Xi Jinping and Qi Qiaoqiao, and the grandmother of Xi Mingze.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋与郝明珠之子，齐桥桥的同父异母哥哥，中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: Son of Xi Zhongxun and Hao Mingzhu, half-brother of Qi Qiaoqiao, a politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 她是中共元老习仲勋与齐心的长女，中共中央总书记习近平的姐姐，张燕南的母亲。她是一位企业家，曾任北京中民信房地产开发有限公司董事长，也是邓家贵的妻子。她拥有香港身份证和加拿大永久居留权。
description.en: She is the eldest daughter of CCP elder Xi Zhongxun and Qi Xin, the elder sister of CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping, and the mother of Zhang Yannan. She is a businesswoman, formerly chairperson of Beijing Zhongminxin Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., and wife of Deng Jiagui. She holds a Hong Kong identity card and permanent residency in Canada.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋与齐心的次子，习近平和齐桥桥的弟弟，曾任国际节能环保协会会长。
description.en: Second son of Xi Zhongxun and Qi Xin, younger brother of Xi Jinping and Qi Qiaoqiao, former president of the International Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Association.

description.en: The permanent body of the 7th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, which passed the Law of the People's Republic of China on the National Emblem at its 18th session.

description.en: The title of the supreme leader of the Communist Party of China during a specific historical period, specifically referring to the supreme leader of its Central Committee. The General Secretary of the Central Committee during 1956-1967 and 1980-1982 did not fall into this category.

description.zh-cn: 张闻天的第二任妻子，中国政治人物。曾任中华人民共和国外交部部长助理等职。
中国共产党官员、外交官，曾任中共中央上海局书记，与吴石会面。

en: People's commune movement in rural areas

description.zh-cn: 人民公社是大跃进时期（1958-1983年）在中国农村推行的一种政社合一的社会基层组织形式。它是1958年将农业生产合作社合并而成的运动，作为农业集体化的高级阶段和社会改造运动，是“三面红旗”之一。其建立进一步剥夺了农民对土地的权利；同时，公共食堂制度的推行导致粮食浪费，平均主义的分配方式打击了农民的生产积极性，成为三年困难时期的重要成因。该社会运动《历史决议》对其作出了否定性评价。
description.en: The People's Commune was a grassroots social organization that integrated government administration and economic management, implemented in rural China during the Great Leap Forward (1958-1983). It was a movement initiated in 1958 to merge agricultural producers' cooperatives, serving as an advanced stage of agricultural collectivization and a social transformation movement, identified as one of the 'Three Red Flags'. Its establishment further deprived peasants of their rights to the land; meanwhile, the implementation of the public canteen system led to food waste, and the egalitarian distribution method dampened farmers' production enthusiasm, becoming a significant cause of the Three Years of Great Famine. This social movement was negatively assessed by the 'Historical Resolution'.

彭真长女
彭真长子

作为1949年中华人民共和国成立前北平市的行政管理机关，此后成为中华人民共和国北京市的省级行政机关及最高地方国家行政机关。北京体育大学曾由其与国家体委双重领导，贾庆林也曾担任其市长。
description.en: Serving as the administrative body of Beiping City before the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949, it subsequently became the provincial-level administrative body and highest local state administrative organ for Beijing, People's Republic of China. Beijing Sport University was once under its dual leadership with the State Sports Commission, and Jia Qinglin also served as its mayor.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在北京市的领导机关，由中国共产党北京市代表大会选举产生，并在代表大会闭会期间，执行中国共产党中央委员会的指示和北京市代表大会的决议，领导北京市的党务工作。其前身可追溯至1921年设立的中共北京地方委员会，历史上曾多次更名和改组，文化大革命期间曾被北京市革命委员会取代。北京体育大学的党组织关系隶属于该委员会，贾庆林曾任其书记。
description.en: The leading body of the Communist Party of China in Beijing, elected by the Beijing Municipal Congress of the CPC. During the recess of the Congress, it implements the directives of the CPC Central Committee and the resolutions of the Beijing Municipal Congress, and leads the party's work in Beijing. Its predecessor can be traced back to the CPC Beijing Local Committee established in 1921, and it has been renamed and reorganized multiple times throughout history, having been replaced by the Beijing Revolutionary Committee during the Cultural Revolution. The party organization of Beijing Sport University is affiliated with this committee, and Jia Qinglin served as its secretary.

description.en: The primary criminal law of the People's Republic of China, which defines crimes, criminal responsibility, and penalties. This law and its amendments serve as the basis for the trial and verdict of cases, especially concerning the determination of the age of criminal responsibility.

description.en: The law of the People's Republic of China regarding criminal procedure. It was amended during the fifth session of the 11th NPC.

description.en: One of the units of the National Revolutionary Army. Li Fuchun served as its Deputy Party Representative and Director of the Political Department, while Lu Diping served as its deputy commander and commander.

description.en: One of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. Peng Dehuai commanded this force, and Li Fuchun served as its political commissar. It later merged with the Red First Army Group to form the First Front Army of the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期，于1949年设立，是管辖东北地区的最高行政机关。李富春曾任其副主席。
description.en: The highest administrative body in Northeast China established in 1949 during the early years of the People's Republic of China. Li Fuchun once served as its vice chairman.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府重工业部是中华人民共和国成立初期的工业主管部门，也是中央人民政府政务院的组成部门，根据1949年《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》设立。李富春曾任其部长。它主管钢铁、有色金属、机器、船舶、兵器、航空、化学和建筑材料工业等工作。该部门于1954年9月撤销，作为中华人民共和国重工业部的前身，由中华人民共和国重工业部接替。
description.en: The Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government was an industrial administration department in the early days of the People's Republic of China and a component department of the Government Administration Council, established in accordance with the 1949 Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China. Li Fuchun served as its minister. It was responsible for industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, machinery, shipbuilding, ordnance, aviation, chemicals, and building materials. The department was dissolved in September 1954, as the predecessor to the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China, and was succeeded by the Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，中共中央为纠正大跃进错误、调整国民经济而提出“调整、巩固、充实、提高”方针，该方针由李富春具体提出。
description.en: In 1961, the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China proposed the policy of 'readjustment, consolidation, reinforcement, and improvement' to correct the errors of the Great Leap Forward and adjust the national economy. This policy was specifically put forward by Li Fuchun.
