description.en: The decision-making, deliberative, and coordinating body of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China that leads financial and economic work. It is the core leadership and decision-making department for the economy of the People's Republic of China. It was reorganized from the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 1927年8月7日，中国共产党在汉口召开紧急会议。会议纠正了陈独秀的右倾机会主义，确立了土地革命和武装反抗国民党反动派的总方针。会上，张太雷同陈独秀路线进行了斗争并被选为中央临时政治局候补委员，向忠发也被选为临时中央政治局委员。
description.en: On August 7, 1927, the Communist Party of China held an emergency meeting in Hankou. The meeting corrected Chen Duxiu's right-leaning opportunism and established the general policy of land revolution and armed resistance against the Kuomintang reactionaries. At the meeting, Zhang Tailei fought against Chen Duxiu's line and was elected as an alternate member of the provisional Politburo, while Xiang Zhongfa was elected as a member of the temporary Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市下辖的县，是李维汉和杨昌济的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Changsha City, Hunan Province, and the birthplace of Li Weihan and Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 莫斯科是苏联及现今俄罗斯的首都。著名的《中苏友好同盟互助条约》在此地的克里姆林宫签署。此外，它还是东京都的姊妹友好都市。
description.en: Moscow is the capital of the Soviet Union and present-day Russia. The renowned Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance was signed here at the Kremlin. Additionally, it is a sister city of Tokyo Metropolis.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期，由光绪帝领导，康有为、梁启超等维新派人士推动的政治改革运动（史称戊戌变法），旨在学习西方，推动清朝政治、经济、军事的现代化改革。此运动于1898年9月21日被慈禧太后发动的戊戌政变终止，光绪帝亦因此被软禁，并导致维新派转向更激进的武装斗争。
description.en: A political reform movement initiated in the late Qing dynasty by the Guangxu Emperor and reform-minded figures like Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao. It aimed to modernize China by learning from the West and reforming its political, economic, and military systems. The movement was terminated on September 21, 1898, by the Wuxu Coup launched by Empress Dowager Cixi, leading to the emperor's house arrest and pushing the reformists towards more radical armed struggle.

description.zh-cn: 日本是历史悠久的东亚岛国。明治维新后快速现代化，大日本帝国时期曾为中国学习西方文化的重要中介。北洋政府时期，日本干预中国局势、支持军阀，策划皇姑屯事件刺杀张作霖，并于1932年在中国东北扶植建立了满洲国。抗日战争（二战）期间，日本作为中国敌国，与中国发生虹桥事件、淞沪会战等冲突，战略轰炸重庆，占领马来亚和海南岛，并袭击珍珠港。冷战时期，日本曾被“一条线、一大片”战略构想列为联合抗苏的对象之一。1972年与中国建交，目前与中国在钓鱼岛有主权争议。
description.en: Japan is a historically rich East Asian island country. It rapidly modernized after the Meiji Restoration, and during the Empire of Japan period, served as an important intermediary for China to learn Western culture. During the Beiyang government period, Japan intervened in China's affairs, supported warlords, orchestrated the Huanggutun Incident to assassinate Zhang Zuolin, and in 1932 established the puppet state of Manchukuo in Northeast China. During the Anti-Japanese War (WWII), Japan, as an enemy of China, clashed in incidents like the Hongqiao Incident and the Battle of Shanghai, strategically bombed Chongqing, occupied Malaya and Hainan Island, and attacked Pearl Harbor in 1941. During the Cold War, Japan was listed as one of the targets for a united front against the Soviet Union in the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategic concept. It established diplomatic relations with China in 1972 and currently has sovereignty disputes with China over the Diaoyu/Senkaku Islands.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命家、军事家，中华民国开国元勋。辛亥革命时期，与孙中山并称“孙黄”。他是华兴会的创始人兼会长，中国同盟会的创建者之一，亦是宋教仁挚友。曾任军政府战时总司令、陆军总长。
description.en: A Chinese modern democratic revolutionary and military leader, and a founding father of the Republic of China. During the Xinhai Revolution, he and Sun Yat-sen were often referred to as 'Sun-Huang'. He was the founder and president of the Huaxing Society, one of the creators of the Tongmenghui, and a close friend of Song Jiaoren. He served as wartime commander-in-chief and Minister of War for the military government.

birth_place.zh-cn: 湖南省常德府桃源县仙瑞乡上坊村湘冲
birth_place.en: Xiangchong, Shangfang Village, Xianrui Township, Taoyuan County, Changde Prefecture, Hunan Province

death_place.zh-cn: 江苏省沪海道上海县闸北区沪宁铁路医院
death_place.en: Huning Railway Hospital, Zhabei District, Shanghai County, Huhai Dao, Jiangsu Province

description.zh-cn: 中国近代民主革命家，中华民国初期首位倡导责任内阁制的政治家，华兴会和同盟会主要领导人，国民党主要筹建人及代理理事长，华中师范大学校友。1913年3月20日，他在上海北站遇刺，并于22日逝世。此事件即著名的“宋教仁遇刺案”，被视为二次革命的直接导火索。
description.en: A Chinese modern democratic revolutionary, the first politician to advocate for a cabinet responsibility system in the early Republic of China, a key leader of the Huaxinghui and the Tongmenghui, a principal founder and acting chairman of the Kuomintang, and an alumnus of Central China Normal University. On March 20, 1913, he was assassinated at Shanghai North Railway Station and died on the 22nd. This incident, known as the 'Song Jiaoren Assassination Case', was the direct trigger for the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初官员。曾任吉林省巡抚，后支持张勋复辟，并被任命为民政部尚书。
林伯渠堂兄。

zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府 (1912年－1913年)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国建国初期（1912年至1928年），以京兆地方（北京）为首都的中央政府。始于1912年袁世凯就任临时大总统，后由北洋军阀各派系控制，因其主要官员多出身北洋军阀而得名。在张勋复辟期间，其在北京的统治曾短暂中断。作为协约国成员，于1914年设立绥远特别区。五四运动期间，其在巴黎和会上的外交失败和对内镇压学生引发全国性抗议。
description.en: The central government of the Republic of China in its early days (1912-1928), with its capital in Jingzhao (Beijing). It began with Yuan Shikai's inauguration as Provisional President in 1912 and was later controlled by various factions of the Beiyang Warlords, from whom its key officials predominantly came. Its rule in Beijing was briefly interrupted during Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration. As a member of the Entente Powers, it established the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1914. During the May Fourth Movement, its diplomatic failures at the Paris Peace Conference and its suppression of students sparked nationwide protests.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学共同创办人。
description.en: Co-founder of Tamkang University.

zh-cn: 中国国民党中央执行委员会农民运动讲习所

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期培养农民运动干部的机构。
description.en: An early institution of the Communist Party of China for training cadres for the peasant movement.

description.zh-cn: 一套中文的拉丁字母拼音方案。
中华民国抗日战争时期至行宪前夕，国民政府的最高民意咨询机关，同时也是一个准议会机关。徐旭生曾任第二至四届参政员。
description.en: The highest advisory body on public opinion and a quasi-parliamentary institution of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China during the Anti-Japanese War period until the eve of constitutional implementation. Xu Xusheng served as a member from the second to the fourth sessions.

description.zh-cn: 林伯渠之子。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第七届中央政治局
en: 7th Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 1931年发生于江西宁都县的国民革命军第26路军起义事件，李达参与此次起义后加入中国工农红军。
description.en: An uprising of the 26th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army in Ningdu, Jiangxi in 1931. Li Da participated in this uprising and subsequently joined the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 苏区中央局召开的会议，撤销了毛泽东的军权。
抗日战争时期八路军的军事院校。

zh-cn: 中苏友好同盟互助条约
中华人民共和国苏维埃社会主义共和国联邦友好同盟互助条约
en: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国和苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟于1950年缔结的双边条约，旨在提供同盟、集体安全、援助与合作。该条约取代了1945年的《中苏友好同盟条约》，是毛泽东“一边倒”外交政策的体现。
description.en: A bilateral treaty concluded in 1950 between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics, providing for alliance, collective security, assistance, and cooperation. It replaced the 1945 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance and was a manifestation of Mao Zedong's "Lean to One Side" foreign policy.

description.zh-cn: 对1962年王稼祥等人对外政策建议的概括，后遭到批判。
王稼祥的第三任妻子。
粟裕的妻子，原名詹永珠，曾为新四军战士。
description.en: Wife of Su Yu, original name Zhan Yongzhu, a former soldier of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕长子，中国人民解放军中将，曾任北京军区副司令员。
description.en: Eldest son of Su Yu, a lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, and former deputy commander of the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役前夕发生的一场战役，其战后局势促使解放军筹划鲁南战役。
description.en: A battle that occurred on the eve of the Lunan Campaign; its aftermath prompted the PLA to plan the Lunan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，华东野战军在山东蒙阴孟良崮地区对国民革命军整编第七十四师进行的进攻作战。
description.en: An offensive operation conducted by the East China Field Army against the KMT's Reorganized 74th Division in the Menglianggu area of Mengyin, Shandong, during the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间在河南东部地区进行的一场大规模战役。
description.en: A large-scale campaign fought in eastern Henan during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战末期的一场战役，中国人民解放军攻占上海，并控制上海全境。
description.en: A campaign in the late stage of the Chinese Civil War, which resulted in the Chinese People's Liberation Army taking control of the entire Shanghai area.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、军事领导人。曾任中华人民共和国最高人民检察院检察长、第四届全国人大常委会副委员长，并于鲁南战役时任华中军区司令员。
description.en: Chinese political figure and military leader. He served as Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate and Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and also as the commander of the Central China Military Region during the Lunan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府内政部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Minister of Internal Affairs of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领，时任整编第二十六师师长，在鲁南战役中被俘。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army, serving as the commander of the Reorganized 26th Division at the time, captured during the Lunan Campaign.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军华东野战军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三野战军的前身，是第二次国共内战时期由山东野战军与华中野战军合并组建的主力部队之一。该部队由陈毅任司令员兼政委，粟裕任副司令员，后正式改称第三野战军。
description.en: The predecessor of the Third Field Army of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, it was one of the main forces formed during the Second Chinese Civil War by the merger of the Shandong Field Army and the Central China Field Army. This unit was led by Chen Yi as commander and political commissar, and Su Yu as deputy commander, and was later officially renamed the Third Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，蔡廷锴的外甥，国民革命军第十九路军将领。其兵团在豫东战役中被围歼。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, nephew of Cai Tingkai, and a commander in the 19th Route Army. His army group was surrounded and annihilated in the Eastern Henan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军陆军上将，第七兵团司令官。在徐蚌会战碾庄战役中兵败自杀。
description.en: A General of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China and commander of the 7th Army Group, who was defeated and committed suicide in the Nianzhuang battle of the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军高级将领，济南战役中被俘。
金门防卫司令部司令，赵家骧的上级。
description.en: Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command and Zhao Jiaxiang's superior.

death_place.zh-cn: 河南省永城市陈官庄乡

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，抗战期间曾任新编第二十二师师长与第五军军长，参与昆仑关战役与滇西缅北战役。国共内战期间任第二兵团司令，在徐蚌会战中阵亡。
description.en: A Lieutenant General of the Republic of China Army, posthumously promoted to General. He served as the commander of the New 22nd Division and the 5th Corps during the Second Sino-Japanese War, participating in the Battle of Kunlun Pass and the Battle of Northern Burma and Western Yunnan. During the Chinese Civil War, he commanded the 2nd Army Group and was killed in action during the Huaihai Campaign.

en: Party and State Leaders of the People's Republic of China
Party and state leaders of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治术语，指在中国共产党、中华人民共和国、中国人民解放军以及中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会中，担任特定领导职务及级别的高级领导人的统称。这些职务通常分为国家级正职和国家级副职。成克杰和巴金（曾任全国政协副主席）都曾位列其中。
description.en: A political term in the People's Republic of China, referring to high-level leaders holding specific leadership positions and ranks within the Communist Party of China, the People's Republic of China, the People's Liberation Army, and the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. These positions are usually divided into national-level full and deputy ranks. Cheng Kejie and Ba Jin (who served as Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee) were both once among them.

zh-cn: 中国共产党集体领导制度
en: Collective leadership system of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的组织原则和领导制度，旨在防止个人专断。
description.en: An organizational and leadership principle of the CPC aimed at preventing personal autocracy.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府下属的财政主管机构，成立于新中国成立初期，薄一波为首任部长。
description.en: The financial authority under the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, established in the early days of the New China, with Bo Yibo as its first minister.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的长女。
description.en: Bo Yibo's eldest daughter.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波的长子。
description.en: Bo Yibo's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学者，薄一波与胡明的三女。曾任北京大学历史系副教授，研究方向为隋唐考古、石窟艺术等。
description.en: A Chinese historian, the third daughter of Bo Yibo and Hu Ming. She was an associate professor in the History Department of Peking University, specializing in Sui and Tang archaeology, grotto art, etc.

zh-cn: 山西省牺牲救国同盟会

description.zh-cn: 全称山西牺牲救国同盟会，是抗日战争时期在山西成立的，由薄一波创建的群众抗日团体，也是一个抗日民族统一战线组织。
description.en: The full name is the Shanxi Sacrifice for National Salvation Alliance. It was an anti-Japanese national united front organization established in Shanxi during the Second Sino-Japanese War, founded by Bo Yibo.

zh-cn: 山西国民兵军官教导团

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间由薄一波组建的山西新军部队。
description.en: A unit of the Shanxi New Army organized by Bo Yibo during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期在晋东南地区建立的抗日根据地军事组织。
description.en: A military organization of the anti-Japanese base area established in the southeastern Shanxi area during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，中国共产党和中华人民共和国的领导人之一，曾任中共中央组织部部长，是“六十一人叛徒集团案”的主要受害者。
description.en: Chinese politician, one of the leaders of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, former Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, and a main victim of the 'Case of the 61 Renegades'.

description.zh-cn: 1947年由中共中央批准公布的土地改革纲领性文件，规定废除封建剥削的土地制度，实行耕者有其田。
description.en: A programmatic document on land reform approved and promulgated by the CPC Central Committee in 1947, which stipulated the abolition of the feudal exploitative land system and the implementation of 'land to the tiller'.

description.zh-cn: 一份旨在纠正“大跃进”中工业领域“左”倾错误的政策文件。
description.en: A policy document aimed at correcting the 'leftist' errors in the industrial sector during the Great Leap Forward.

zh-cn: 国务院财政经济委员会

description.zh-cn: 1979年至1980年间存在的国务院下属机构，后被中央财政经济领导小组取代。
description.en: A subordinate body of the State Council that existed from 1979 to 1980, later replaced by the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1986年底，中国各地高校学生发起了一系列大规模示威游行，旨在争取民主选举、新闻自由等权利。运动始于中国科学技术大学学生对人大代表选举的抗议，是中华人民共和国民主运动的一部分，对后续政治事件产生了深远影响，并成为导致胡耀邦下台的导火索。
description.en: At the end of 1986, university students across mainland China initiated a series of large-scale demonstrations, aiming to demand rights such as democratic elections and freedom of the press. The movement began with protests by students at the University of Science and Technology of China regarding local People's Congress elections, was part of the Chinese democracy movement, had a profound impact on subsequent political events, and became the catalyst for Hu Yaobang's removal from office.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山西省临猗县
birth_place.en: Linyi County, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国律师，前中共中央政治局委员薄熙来之妻。因谋杀尼尔·海伍德犯故意杀人罪被判处死刑，缓期二年执行，后减为无期徒刑，目前在燕城监狱服刑。
description.en: A Chinese lawyer and the wife of former Politburo member Bo Xilai. She was convicted of intentional homicide and received a suspended death sentence, which was later commuted to life imprisonment. She is currently serving her sentence at Yancheng Prison.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，一二·九运动的领导者和发动人之一，谷开来之父。
description.en: A major general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, one of the initiators of the December 9th Movement, and the father of Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与第一任妻子李丹宇之子，商人。
description.en: Son of Bo Xilai and Li Danyu, a businessman.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与薄谷开来之子，薄一波之孙，投资人、律师。他曾与陈晓丹交往。
description.en: Son of Bo Xilai and Bo Gu Kailai, grandson of Bo Yibo. He is an investor and lawyer, and once dated Chen Xiaodan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，在余秋里卸任后以军管会主任身份接管石油工业部。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army who took over the Ministry of Petroleum Industry as the director of the military control committee after Yu Qiuli left office.

en: Central South Bureau of the Communist Party of China
Central and Southern Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省。其部分区域由中华民国实际控制。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China. Parts of its territory are actually controlled by the Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军广东省军区
中国共产党浙江省委员会
en: Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在浙江省的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，铁瑛的前任中共浙江省委书记和浙江省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Tie Ying's predecessor as Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国江西省西南部
location.en: Southwestern Jiangxi Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 位于中国江西省西南部的一座山脉，地处湘赣边界的罗霄山脉中段。它曾是中国共产党创建的第一个农村革命根据地，因此被称为“革命摇篮”。
description.en: A mountain range in southwestern Jiangxi Province, China, in the middle section of the Luoxiao Mountains on the border of Hunan and Jiangxi. It was the site of the first rural revolutionary base established by the Communist Party of China, thus known as the 'cradle of the revolution'.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军及新四军高级将领，曾代理红十二军军长、担任第一师师长。
description.en: A senior commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the New Fourth Army, served as acting Commander of the Twelfth Red Army and Commander of the First Division.

en: The People's Government of Zhejiang Province

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国浙江省的省级国家行政机关。
description.en: The provincial-level state administrative organ of Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军浙江省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在浙江省设立的军队一级组织，属省级军区。
description.en: A first-level military organization established by the People's Liberation Army in Zhejiang Province, categorized as a provincial military district.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省的省级行政机关。
description.en: The provincial-level administrative organ of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期华东大区的最高行政机关，同时也是该大区的军政领导机构。
description.en: The highest administrative organ of the East China Greater Administrative Region in the early days of the People's Republic of China, and also its regional military and political leadership body.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第十二军

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的一支部队，是组建红一军团的初始部队之一。
description.en: A unit of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, one of the initial units that formed the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会曾设立的负责农村工作的部门，后在党政分开的背景下被撤销。
description.en: A department formerly established by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for rural work, which was later abolished in the context of the separation of party and government.

zh-cn: 生产资料所有制的社会主义改造
生产资料私有制的社会主义改造

description.zh-cn: 在土地改革运动后，中国共产党在中国大陆推行的将农民土地所有权转变为集体所有制的政治运动。
description.en: A political movement launched by the CCP in mainland China after the Land Reform Movement to transform peasant land ownership into collective ownership.

description.zh-cn: 新四军第四支队司令员，后被叶挺下令处决。

en: Central and Southern Military and Administrative Committee
Central and Southern Military and Political Committee

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期中南大区的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative organ of the Central South Greater Administrative Region in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1952年9月，中共中央将五个大行政区的地方局书记调入北京，以削弱地方权力，加强中央集权的重大政治事件。
description.en: A major political event in September 1952, where the Central Committee of the CCP transferred the secretaries of the five great administrative regions to Beijing to weaken local power and strengthen central authority.

description.zh-cn: 邓颖超的父亲，清朝武官。
中国妇女运动的先驱，与邓颖超共同组织天津女界爱国同志会。
中共早期活动家，与周恩来、邓颖超共同组织觉悟社。
中国著名妇产科医生，第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A renowned Chinese obstetrician and gynecologist, and a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥的夫人，曾任中华人民共和国卫生部部长。
抗日战争时期成立的救助难童的组织。
中国共产党早期女领导人之一。

zh-cn: 中国人民对外友好协会
en: Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国从事民间外交工作的全国性人民团体。
中华人民共和国从事人口与计划生育领域及人口福利事业的全国性公募非营利性社会团体，由国家卫生健康委员会主管。
description.en: A public non-profit social organization in the People's Republic of China engaged in population and family planning as well as population welfare, supervised by the National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国农工民主党中央委员会主席，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Former Chairman of the Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party, and a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅的三弟。中国政治人物，曾任第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Lu Xun's third brother. A Chinese political figure who served as Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国理论物理学家、流体力学家、中国科学院院士。他曾在莱比锡大学海森堡教授的指导下工作，并担任过中国科学技术协会第二届主席。
description.en: A Chinese theoretical physicist and fluid dynamicist, and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. He worked under the guidance of Professor Heisenberg at the University of Leipzig and served as the second chairman of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国书法家
中国现代作家、教育家、文学出版家和社会活动家，与朱自清是文学上的长期伙伴。
description.en: A modern Chinese writer, educator, literary publisher, and social activist, and a long-term literary partner of Zhu Ziqing.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院院士，曾任全国政协副主席、第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, formerly Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, and Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国数学家，中国科学院院士，中国解析数论、矩阵几何学、典型群、自守函数论与多元复变函数论等多方面研究的创始人和开拓者，中国科学技术大学的创办人之一。曾任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: A Chinese mathematician and academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. He was a pioneer and founder in various research areas, including analytic number theory, matrix geometry, classical groups, theory of automorphic functions, and functions of several complex variables in China. He was also one of the founders of the University of Science and Technology of China and served as a Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 郭沫若在日本的同居妻子
郭沫若的第三任妻子
郭沫若与于立群之子

en: Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民政府时期的最高军事统帅机关，军统局的上级单位。
description.en: The supreme military command organ of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国最高学术研究机关。
description.en: The national academy of the Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国文学艺术界联合会
en: China Federation of Literary and Art Circles

description.zh-cn: 由中国全国性文学艺术家协会、各省、自治区、直辖市文学艺术界联合会和全国性的产业文学艺术工作者联合会组成的人民团体。
description.en: A people's organization composed of national associations of writers and artists, federations of literary and art circles of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and national industrial federations of literary and art workers.

en: University of Science and Technology of China

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市
location.en: Hefei, Anhui Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国科学技术大学，简称中国科大，是隶属于中国科学院的一所公立研究型大学，位于安徽省合肥市。该校是“双一流A类”和原“985工程”、“211工程”重点建设大学，理工科实力位居全国前列。学校于1958年在北京创办，后于文革期间迁至合肥。科大曾是1986年学生游行抗议地方人大代表选举问题的策源地，陈子明曾在此就读研究生。此外，科大讯飞由与该校相关的“讯飞信息科技有限公司”整体变更设立。
description.en: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), a public research university affiliated with the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), is located in Hefei, Anhui Province. It is designated as a Double First Class University (Class A) and a former Project 985 and Project 211 key university, ranking among the top in science and engineering nationwide. The university was founded in Beijing in 1958 and later relocated to Hefei during the Cultural Revolution. USTC was the origin of the 1986 student demonstrations protesting local People's Congress deputy elections. Chen Ziming pursued his postgraduate studies here. Additionally, iFlytek was established through the overall transformation of 'Xunfei Information Technology Co., Ltd.', a company with ties to the university.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代文学史上一个重要的文学团体。
description.en: An important literary group in the history of modern Chinese literature.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国全国性的史学学术团体，徐旭生曾任常务理事。
description.en: A national historical academic society in the People's Republic of China, where Xu Xusheng served as a standing council member.

description.zh-cn: 教育家，大连大学创始人之一，大连大学首任校长。
中国唐代伟大的浪漫主义诗人、官员，被后人誉为“诗仙”，与杜甫并称“李杜”。他曾与高适、杜甫等友人同游，并多次游览庐山，留下了《望庐山瀑布》等不朽诗篇。
description.en: Li Bai was a great romantic poet and official of the Tang dynasty in China, revered as the 'Immortal Poet' (Shixian) and known with Du Fu as 'Li Du'. He once traveled with friends such as Gao Shi and Du Fu, and visited Mount Lu multiple times, leaving behind immortal poems such as 'Viewing the Waterfall at Lushan'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代伟大的现实主义诗人，世称“诗圣”、“诗史”。他与李白齐名，并称为“李杜”，也与高适是好友。其作品对白居易的讽谕诗创作有重要影响。
description.en: A great realist poet of the Tang Dynasty, known as the 'Poet-Sage' and 'Poet-Historian'. He was renowned for his friendship with Li Bai, together they were called 'Li Du', and was also a good friend of Gao Shi. His works significantly influenced Bai Juyi's satirical poetry.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年，由陈独秀、胡适、鲁迅、钱玄同、蔡元培等受西方教育者发起，是一场反对旧传统、提倡“民主”与“科学”的思想启蒙、文化革新与文学革命运动。它旨在“反传统、反孔教、反文言”，并为五四运动准备了思想基础，在运动后得到推广但也有分化。
description.en: Initiated by Western-educated figures such as Chen Duxiu, Hu Shi, Lu Xun, Qian Xuantong, and Cai Yuanpei in the early Republic of China, this movement was an intellectual enlightenment, cultural renewal, and literary revolution against old traditions, promoting 'democracy' and 'science'. It aimed to 'oppose tradition, Confucianism, and classical Chinese', laid the ideological foundation for the May Fourth Movement, and was further popularized but also saw divisions afterwards.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石之父，曾任江西省人民委员会副省长。
中共早期党员，后叛变，在汪精卫政权特务总部工作，是潘汉年会见汪精卫的唯一见证人。
description.en: An early member of the CPC who later defected and worked for the secret service headquarters of the Wang Jingwei regime. He was the sole witness to the meeting between Pan Hannian and Wang Jingwei.

description.zh-cn: 高岗的前妻。
高岗的第二任妻子。
位于陕西省榆林市的一所中学。
中国工农红军高级将领，陕甘边革命根据地创建者之一。
抗日战争时期八路军留守陕甘宁边区的部队。
中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
中国大型钢铁企业集团，是位于辽宁鞍山的特大型钢铁联合企业，也是“156项重点工程”之一。
description.en: A large Chinese steel enterprise group, it is a super-large iron and steel complex located in Anshan, Liaoning, and also one of the '156 Key Projects'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
中国政治人物，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一。
中国经济学家，被认为是高岗的“五虎上将”之一，也曾是陈元的导师。他与孙冶方等人力主实行社会主义市场经济体制。
description.en: Chinese economist, considered one of Gao Gang's "Five Tiger Generals" and a mentor to Chen Yuan. He also, along with Sun Yefang and others, strongly advocated for the implementation of a socialist market economic system.

description.zh-cn: 曾任陕甘宁边区政府民政厅厅长，建议杨芝芳与高岗离婚。
壮族，中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级党和国家领导人。曾任广西壮族自治区人民政府主席、全国人大常委会副委员长。2000年因受贿罪被判处并执行死刑。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Zhuang ethnicity, and a former deputy national-level party and state leader. He served as the Chairman of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. In 2000, he was sentenced to death and executed for bribery.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央委员，曾任赵紫阳的政治秘书（兼中共中央政治体制改革研究室主任）。六四事件后被判刑，是中国异见人士，《零八宪章》的首批签署者之一。
description.en: Former member of the CPC Central Committee, political secretary to Zhao Ziyang (also serving as Director of the CPC Central Research Office for Political System Reform). Sentenced after the Tiananmen Square incident, he was a Chinese dissident and one of the first signatories of Charter 08.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府和日本国政府联合声明
en: Joint Communiqué of the Government of Japan and the Government of the People's Republic of China
Normalization of relations between Japan and China

description.zh-cn: 指1972年日本与中华人民共和国建立正式外交关系的历史进程，期间两国政府于1972年9月29日签署了恢复邦交的联合声明，由田中角荣首相任内实现。
description.en: Refers to the historical process of establishing formal diplomatic relations between Japan and the People's Republic of China in 1972. During this process, the governments of both countries signed a joint statement on September 29, 1972, to restore diplomatic ties, achieved during Prime Minister Kakuei Tanaka's term.

zh-cn: 中华民国陆军军官学校
中国国民党陆军军官学校
国民革命军黄埔军官学校

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军军官学校，由中国国民党创办，是中华民国创建的第一所现代军事学校，主要培养陆军军官。它作为中华民国国民政府的军事学校，是黄埔军校的后继。该校是中华民国时期的著名军事学校，黄公略曾在此高级班学习。同时，它也是中华民国国军的军官学校，以及中正国防干部预备学校毕业生的主要升学管道之一。
description.en: The Republic of China Army Officer Academy, founded by the Kuomintang, was the first modern military academy established in the Republic of China, primarily training army officers. It was a famous military academy during the Republic of China era, where Huang Gonglue studied in the advanced class. As a military academy of the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China, it was also a successor to the Whampoa Military Academy. Additionally, it serves as a military academy of the R.O.C. Armed Forces and one of the main further education pathways for graduates of Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School.

zh-cn: 列昂尼德·伊里奇·勃列日涅夫

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，1964年发动政变推翻赫鲁晓夫，成为苏联最高领导人，曾任苏共中央总书记。其统治时期终止了“去斯大林化”，并部分恢复了对斯大林的正面评价。执政后期苏联经济陷入停滞，被毛泽东和霍查认为是“没有赫鲁晓夫的赫鲁晓夫主义”。
description.en: A Soviet politician who overthrew Khrushchev in a 1964 coup to become the paramount leader of the Soviet Union, serving as General Secretary of the CPSU. His rule terminated de-Stalinization and partially restored a positive assessment of Stalin. The Soviet economy stagnated in its later period, and his rule was considered 'Khrushchevism without Khrushchev' by Mao Zedong and Enver Hoxha.

description.zh-cn: 苏联元帅，曾任苏联国防部长。
description.en: A Marshal of the Soviet Union who served as Minister of Defence of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来外祖父。
中国共产党早期领导人之一，陈独秀的长子。他曾任中共广东区委书记、江苏省委书记及中共第五届中央政治局候补委员。在四一二事件后的搜捕中被杀害。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party and the eldest son of Chen Duxiu. He served as Secretary of the CCP Guangdong Regional Committee, Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee, and an alternate member of the 5th Politburo of the CCP Central Committee. He was killed in the roundups following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史上的学者、政治活动家。他曾任北洋政府教育总长、中央文史研究馆馆长，是华兴会共同创始人之一。他曾与陈独秀合作办刊并在其被审判时出庭辩护，亦是杨昌济的好友。他还曾帮助金韫颖联系上毛泽东。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and political activist in modern history. He served as Minister of Education in the Beiyang government and as director of the Central Research Institute of Culture and History. He was one of the co-founders of the Huaxinghui. He collaborated with Chen Duxiu on publications and defended him in court when he was tried. He was also a good friend of Yang Changji and helped Jin Yunying contact Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上由满族建立的大一统王朝，亦为中国最后一个帝制王朝。初期沿用锦衣卫制度，后改为銮仪卫。它镇压太平天国，参战第二次鸦片战争。雍和宫的建立与改建均在此完成。牡丹社事件后，开始积极治理台湾。洋务运动期间筹建现代化海军，甲午战争后编练新军。日俄战争在其领土进行，末期铁路国有政策引发保路运动。载沣是其实际统治者之一。1898年将香港新界租借予英国。1917年张勋复辟时曾短暂恢复帝制，溥仪为皇帝，仅维持12天。
description.en: The last unified imperial dynasty in Chinese history, established by the Manchu people. It initially adopted the Jinyiwei system, later changing to the Luan Yi Wei (Imperial Guard of Honor). It suppressed the Taiping Rebellion and participated in the Second Opium War. The construction and conversion of the Yonghe Temple were completed during this dynasty. After the Mudan Incident, it began to actively govern Taiwan. During the Self-Strengthening Movement, it established a modern navy, and after the First Sino-Japanese War, it began training the New Army. The Russo-Japanese War was fought on its territory, and in its later period, the railway nationalization policy triggered the Railway Protection Movement. Zaifeng was one of its de facto rulers. In 1898, it leased the New Territories of Hong Kong to Great Britain. In the 1917 Zhang Xun Restoration, the imperial system was briefly restored with Puyi as emperor, but it only lasted for 12 days.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一个府。
description.en: An ancient prefecture in China.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳的妻子。
赵紫阳次子。
description.en: Second son of Zhao Ziyang.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳之女，中国嘉德国际拍卖有限公司总经理。
description.en: Daughter of Zhao Ziyang, General Manager of China Guardian Auctions.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳曾就读的中学。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院总理
en: Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府（国务院）的首长，是中国的政府首脑。它负责领导中华人民共和国国务院，作为中央人民政府的最高领导人。李克强曾于2013年至2023年担任此职务。
description.en: The head of the Central People's Government (State Council) of the People's Republic of China, serving as China's head of government. It is responsible for leading the State Council and acts as the highest leader of the Central People's Government. Li Keqiang held this position from 2013 to 2023.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会的副职领导人。

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席
en: Vice Chairperson of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
Vice Chairperson of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席，属国家级副职党和国家领导人。
description.en: Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, a state-level deputy leader position.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院副总理
en: Vice Premier of the State Council
Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院副总理，是国务院的副首长、副职负责人之一，亦是最高行政首长之一。其职责是协助总理工作，位列党和国家领导人，职务为国家级副职公务员。作为国务院常务会议的重要组成人员，这是国务院的领导职位之一。例如，李克强曾于2008年至2013年担任排名第一的副总理，余秋里和薄一波都曾担任此职。
description.en: The Vice Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China is one of the deputy heads and chief officials of the State Council, and among the highest administrative leaders. Their responsibilities include assisting the Premier and serving as an important member of the State Council's executive meetings. Ranked among Party and state leaders, they hold the position of a national deputy-level civil servant. It is a leading position within the State Council. For example, Li Keqiang served as the first-ranking Vice Premier from 2008 to 2013, and Yu Qiuli and Bo Yibo also held this position.

en: History of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 政治体制改革，1980年代由邓小平、胡耀邦、赵紫阳等人推动的政治改革尝试。
1987年初在中国大陆开展的一场政治运动，由中共党内保守派在八六学潮后发起。该运动旨在批判和反对被认为是资产阶级自由化的思想、言论和行为、西方的政治和思想影响，以及崇拜西方资本主义国家“民主”、“自由”、否定社会主义的政治思潮。运动导致多名知识分子和官员受到处分。
description.en: A political campaign initiated by CCP conservatives in early 1987 in mainland China, following the 1986 student demonstrations. It aimed at criticizing and opposing ideas, speeches, and behaviors deemed 'bourgeois liberalization', specifically targeting Western political and ideological influences, and tendencies to worship Western capitalist 'democracy' and 'freedom' while negating socialism. The campaign resulted in the punishment of several intellectuals and officials.

description.zh-cn: 美国第40任总统。他对苏联采取强硬立场，推行“雷根主义”以推回共产主义，并在任期末期与戈尔巴乔夫合作结束冷战。其政府发布了《八一七公报》和《六项保证》。他在就职典礼后几分钟，伊朗人质被释放。任内还取消了撤出驻韩美军的计划，强化了韩美同盟。
description.en: The 40th President of the United States. He took a hardline stance against the Soviet Union, implementing the 'Reagan Doctrine' to roll back communism, and later worked with Gorbachev to end the Cold War. His administration issued the August 17th Communiqué and the Six Assurances. His inauguration coincided with the release of the Iran hostages. During his term, he also canceled plans to withdraw U.S. troops from South Korea and strengthened the ROK-U.S. alliance.

zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·谢尔盖耶维奇·戈尔巴乔夫

description.zh-cn: 苏联末任最高领导人，曾任苏联共产党中央委员会总书记。其推行的“经济改革”和“开放政策”最终导致冷战结束和苏联解体。他在切尔诺贝利事故后领导了苏联的应对工作，并曾表示这次事故可能是导致苏联解体的真正原因。在其“开放政策”时期，于1989年首次在苏联国内公开发表了赫鲁晓夫秘密报告的全文。他曾于六四事件期间访华。
description.en: The last supreme leader of the Soviet Union and General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. His policies of 'economic reform' and 'openness' ultimately led to the end of the Cold War and the dissolution of the Soviet Union. He led the Soviet response to the Chernobyl disaster, later stating that the accident might have been the true cause of the dissolution. During his 'openness' period, he first publicly released the full text of Khrushchev's Secret Speech within the USSR in 1989. He also visited China during the Tiananmen Square protests.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十三届中央委员会第四次全体会议
en: Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Fourth Plenary Session of the 13th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 此次中国共产党的重要会议，审议并通过了关于赵紫阳等人在“六四事件”中所犯错误的报告，并因此免去其党内一切领导职务；同时，江泽民被选举为新任中共中央总书记。此外，阎明复、胡启立、芮杏文也在此次会议上被免去中央书记处书记职务。
description.en: This important meeting of the Chinese Communist Party reviewed and approved the report on the errors committed by Zhao Ziyang and others in the 'Tiananmen Square Incident', consequently removing him from all leadership positions within the Party; concurrently, Jiang Zemin was elected as the new General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. Additionally, Yan Mingfu, Hu Qili, and Rui Xingwen were also dismissed from their posts as secretaries of the Central Secretariat at this meeting.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆出生地
杨尚昆的妻子，参加了二万五千里长征的女红军，曾任中央戏剧学院党委书记、副院长。
description.en: Wife of Yang Shangkun, a female Red Army soldier who participated in the Long March. She served as Party Secretary and Vice President of the Central Academy of Drama.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆次子，著名摄影家，现任中国宋庆龄基金会副主席。
description.en: Second son of Yang Shangkun, a renowned photographer, currently serving as Vice Chairman of the China Soong Ching Ling Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国南部沿海的省级行政区，其部分区域由中华民国实际控制。习仲勋曾在此主政期间创建经济特区。它是徐发淦的籍贯地，河源市位于其境内；同时，也是杨竞衡的出生地。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative division located on the southern coast of the People's Republic of China, with parts of its territory actually controlled by the Republic of China. Xi Zhongxun once governed here and established special economic zones. It is Xu Fagan's ancestral home, with Heyuan City situated within its borders; it is also the birthplace of Yang Jingheng.

zh-cn: 广东省广州市革命委员会

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间广州市的最高权力机关，行使原市委、市人大、市人委的职权。
description.en: The highest authority in Guangzhou during the Cultural Revolution, exercising the powers of the former Municipal Party Committee, Municipal People's Congress, and Municipal People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统，全斗焕的同学、政治盟友及继任者。两人曾共同成立“一心会”，并在双十二政变中合作。他曾与金泳三、金钟泌三党合并，后在金泳三执政期间因腐败被起诉定罪，并最终获得赦免。
description.en: Former President of South Korea, a classmate, political ally, and successor to Chun Doo-hwan. They co-founded the 'Hana-hoe' and collaborated in the Coup d'état of December Twelfth. He later merged his party with those of Kim Young-sam and Kim Jong-pil, and was prosecuted and convicted for corruption during Kim Young-sam's presidency, eventually receiving a pardon.

description.zh-cn: 日本第125代天皇，现为上皇。德仁天皇的父亲。
description.en: The 125th Emperor of Japan, currently the Emperor Emeritus. Father of Emperor Naruhito.

description.zh-cn: 指中共十四大前，杨尚昆、杨白冰兄弟被指意图夺取军权，最终被邓小平解除军权的政治事件。
description.en: Refers to the political incident before the 14th National Congress of the CPC, where brothers Yang Shangkun and Yang Baibing were accused of attempting to seize military power, ultimately leading to their removal from military authority by Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 1998年夏季，中国长江、嫩江、松花江等江河流域发生特大洪水灾害，影响广泛，持续时间长，造成4150人死亡，直接经济损失达2551亿元，是中国历史上最重大的水灾之一。中国政府为应对灾情，组织了大规模抗洪抢险行动，动员大量军人、武警和民众，成为当年的全国性重大事件。
description.en: A catastrophic flood occurred in the summer of 1998 across major river basins in China, including the Yangtze, Nen, and Songhua rivers. This wide-ranging and long-lasting disaster caused 4,150 deaths and direct economic losses of 255.1 billion RMB, making it one of the most severe floods in the history of the People's Republic of China. In response, the Chinese government organized a massive flood fighting and rescue campaign, mobilizing a vast number of soldiers, armed police, and civilians, which became a major national event that year.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆二妹。
胡耀邦长子，曾任中共中央统战部副部长。
胡耀邦次子，曾任香港华润集团常务董事。

en: Rehabilitation of unjust, false, and wrongful cases
Reversing Unjust, False, and Wrongful Verdicts

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，中国共产党对在历次政治运动中受迫害的干部和群众进行平反昭雪的政治行动。
description.en: After the end of the Cultural Revolution, a political action by the Communist Party of China to rehabilitate cadres and masses who were persecuted in previous political movements.

description.zh-cn: 指胡耀邦在1987年1月16日中共中央政治局扩大会议上辞去中共中央总书记职务的事件。该事件是八六学潮最直接的政治后果。
description.en: Refers to the event on January 16, 1987, when Hu Yaobang resigned from his position as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee at an enlarged Politburo meeting. This event was the most direct political consequence of the 1986 student demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 1989年4月15日，前中共中央总书记胡耀邦因心脏病逝世，引发了大规模的公众悼念活动。这些活动最终演变为1989年天安门广场抗议（六四事件的导火索）。
description.en: On April 15, 1989, Hu Yaobang, former General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, passed away due to heart disease, sparking large-scale public mourning activities. These activities ultimately evolved into the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests (the fuse of the June Fourth Incident).

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾与张启龙一同率部南下河南。
description.en: Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army, who once led troops south to Henan with Zhang Qilong.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家，曾任北京大学校长。他开除了指出农村饿死人情况的学生黄立众。
description.en: Chinese educator who served as the President of Peking University. He expelled the student Huang Lizhong for pointing out the starvation deaths in rural areas.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。
description.en: Chinese politician.

zh-cn: 中国共产党陕西省委员会
en: Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在陕西省的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物

zh-cn: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准
实践是检验真理的标准
en: Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth

description.zh-cn: 1978年5月11日，由胡福明撰写并发表于《光明日报》的评论文章，在中国思想解放运动中，引发了全国范围关于真理标准问题的大讨论。
description.en: On May 11, 1978, a commentary article written by Hu Fuming and published in Guangming Daily, during China's ideological emancipation movement, triggered a nationwide discussion on the criterion of truth.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，南京大学教授，《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文的主要作者。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and professor at Nanjing University, the main author of the article "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth".

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任东北人民政府工业部部长、中央人民政府重工业部部长（1952年8月起）、冶金工业部长。他还是“十人小组”成员。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as Minister of Industry of the Northeast People's Government, Minister of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government (from August 1952), and Minister of Metallurgical Industry. He was also a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 中国上海历史上曾有的一个县。中华民国时期，它曾是江苏省下辖的一个县，后成为上海市的一部分。这里是乔石、向忠发的出生地，也是黄兴的逝世地。该县部分区域于1992年被划入新成立的浦东新区。
description.en: A former county in the history of Shanghai, China. During the Republic of China era, it was a county under Jiangsu Province, later becoming part of Shanghai Municipality. It is known as the birthplace of Qiao Shi and Xiang Zhongfa, and the place where Huang Xing died. Part of its area was merged into the newly established Pudong New Area in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省的工人组织，向忠发曾任委员长。
description.en: A workers' organization in Hubei Province, where Xiang Zhongfa once served as chairman.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期由张之洞创办的军工企业。
description.en: A military-industrial enterprise founded by Zhang Zhidong during the late Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期工人运动领袖，向忠发的入党介绍人，一位革命活动家。
description.en: An early labor movement leader and revolutionary activist of the Chinese Communist Party, who introduced Xiang Zhongfa to the party.

zh-cn: 中共湖北区执行委员会

description.zh-cn: 国民党重要政治人物，CC系领导人之一，曾与顾顺章一同策划并逮捕了向忠发。
description.en: An important political figure in the Kuomintang and one of the leaders of the CC Clique, who, along with Gu Shunzhang, planned and arrested Xiang Zhongfa.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事及政治人物。曾任淞沪警备司令，在接到蒋介石命令后下令处决向忠发。后继任鲁涤平，担任江西省政府主席。
description.en: A Chinese military and political figure. He served as the commander of the Shanghai Garrison and ordered the execution of Xiang Zhongfa after receiving orders from Chiang Kai-shek. Later, he succeeded Lu Diping as the Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 瞿秋白之母
瞿秋白的第二任妻子，上海大学学生。
杨之华与沈剑龙的女儿，瞿秋白的继女。
瞿秋白的二弟
瞿秋白的四弟
瞿秋白的六弟
瞿秋白就读的中学
瞿秋白学习英文的学校
中华苏维埃共和国的最高学府
中国共产党早期领导人，曾任中国共产主义同盟总书记之一，后领导多数派改组为中国革命共产党。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party, he served as one of the General Secretaries of the Communist League of China, and later led the majority faction to reorganize into the Chinese Revolutionary Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，蒋介石嫡系重要将领，抗日名将，黄埔军校第一期毕业。曾任第十一集团军总司令等职。他曾是瞿秋白在上海大学的学生，后负责羁押并执行对瞿秋白的枪决。1949年在国共内战中被俘，1959年获特赦。晚年移居美国，致力于中国和平统一。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, a key general loyal to Chiang Kai-shek, a famous anti-Japanese war hero, and a graduate of the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy. He served as the commander of the 11th Army Group. He was a student of Qu Qiubai at Shanghai University and later responsible for detaining and executing Qu Qiubai. He was captured in the Chinese Civil War in 1949 and was granted amnesty in 1959. In his later years, he moved to the United States and dedicated himself to the peaceful reunification of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军上将，中国国民党高级将领，曾任驻闽绥署主任。他被蒋中正指派负责审判吴石案，后因替吴石等人陈情而受处分。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Army and a senior Kuomintang general, he once served as the Director of the Fujian Pacification Headquarters. He was appointed by Chiang Kai-shek to preside over the trial of the Wu Shi case, and was later disciplined for pleading for clemency for Wu Shi and others.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀的第二任妻子，高晓岚的妹妹。
description.en: Chen Duxiu's second wife, sister of Gao Xiaolan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人，陈独秀次子，陈延年之弟。于1928年被国民政府杀害。
description.en: An early leader of the Chinese Communist Party, the second son of Chen Duxiu, and the younger brother of Chen Yannian. He was killed by the Nationalist Government in 1928.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀之子，陈延年的弟弟。
description.en: Son of Chen Duxiu, younger brother of Chen Yannian.

description.zh-cn: 位于杭州的书院，是浙江大学的前身。陈独秀曾于1897年在此学习。
description.en: An academy located in Hangzhou, it is the predecessor of Zhejiang University. Chen Duxiu studied here in 1897.

description.zh-cn: 日本东京的顶尖私立大学，由大隈重信创立。包括宋教仁、陈独秀在内的诸多著名人物曾在此留学。
description.en: A top private university in Tokyo, Japan, founded by Ōkuma Shigenobu. Many famous figures, including Song Jiaoren and Chen Duxiu, studied here.

description.zh-cn: 北京大学是中国近代第一所国立综合性大学，也是中国顶尖的综合性高等学府。其在中华民国时期具有重要地位，位于北京市，是新文化运动和五四运动的中心。陈独秀曾任文科学长，杨昌济曾担任伦理学教授。1917年，接收了北洋大学法科。李克强、林立果、徐旭生、罗豪才、黄立众、张文勋、朱自清、李泽厚、项子明等诸多知名人士曾在此就读、学习或长期担任领导职务。
description.en: Peking University was the first national comprehensive university in modern China and a top comprehensive institution of higher learning. It held significant status during the Republic of China period, located in Beijing, and was the center of the New Culture Movement and the May Fourth Movement. Chen Duxiu served as Dean of its School of Letters, and Yang Changji served as a professor of ethics. In 1917, it absorbed the law department of Peiyang University. Many notable figures, including Li Keqiang, Lin Liguo, Xu Xusheng, Luo Haocai, Huang Lizhong, Zhang Wenxun, Zhu Ziqing, Li Zehou, and Xiang Ziming, studied or held long-term leadership positions here.

description.zh-cn: 由陈独秀、彭述之等人创建的中国早期托洛茨基主义组织，也是参与合并组建中国共产主义同盟的托洛茨基主义组织之一。
description.en: An early Chinese Trotskyist organization founded by Chen Duxiu, Peng Shuzhi, and others. It was also one of the Trotskyist organizations that merged to form the Communist League of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党左派反对派
en: Left Opposition of the Communist Party of China
Left Opposition of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上的一个托洛茨基主义政党，由陈独秀等人于1931年在上海成立。1948年分裂解散。
description.en: A Trotskyist political party in Chinese history, founded in Shanghai in 1931 by Chen Duxiu and others. It split and dissolved in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 由陈独秀创办的月刊，是20世纪初期中国的一份革命杂志，也是新文化运动开始的标志和主要阵地之一，曾刊登毛泽东的《体育之研究》。
description.en: A monthly magazine founded by Chen Duxiu in early 20th century China. It was a revolutionary publication, marking the beginning and serving as a main platform for the New Culture Movement, and famously published Mao Zedong's 'A Study of Physical Education'.

description.zh-cn: 由列夫·托洛茨基发展的一种马克思主义理论，与斯大林主义对立。陈独秀在被开除出中共后接受了此思想。
description.en: A Marxist theory developed by Leon Trotsky, opposed to Stalinism. Chen Duxiu embraced this ideology after being expelled from the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代著名学者、思想家、文学家、哲学家，新文化运动的领袖之一。他曾与陈独秀是亲密战友，但后来因政治理念不同而产生分歧，他认为五四运动是新文化运动中的一次“政治干扰”，导致其从文化转向政治并分化。此外，他还精辟总结了庐山的三大文化史迹：慧远的东林、朱熹的白鹿洞和西方的牯岭。
description.en: A prominent modern Chinese scholar, thinker, literary figure, and philosopher, and a leader of the New Culture Movement. He was a close ally of Chen Duxiu, but later diverged due to different political ideologies, believing the May Fourth Movement was a 'political interference' that caused the New Culture Movement to shift from cultural to political and to divide. Additionally, he succinctly summarized the three major cultural historical landmarks of Mount Lu: Huiyuan's Donglin, Zhu Xi's White Deer Grotto, and the Western-influenced Guling.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际，即第三国际，是一个由弗拉基米尔·列宁于1919年3月创立，总部设于苏联莫斯科的国际共产主义组织。它是一个共产党和共产主义组织的国际联合体，旨在推动世界革命。该组织对中国共产党早期活动有巨大影响，曾提供支援和指导，支持向忠发成为中共最高领导人，并就南昌起义发出指示。张太雷曾担任其东方局中国科书记。它还支持中国共产党建立中华苏维埃共和国，其在华活动被国民党右派视为苏联赤化中国的证据。共产国际于1943年6月10日解散。
description.en: The Communist International (Comintern), also known as the Third International, was an international communist organization and a federation of communist parties. Founded in March 1919 under Vladimir Lenin's leadership, it was headquartered in Moscow, Soviet Union, and aimed to promote world revolution. Comintern significantly influenced the early Chinese Communist Party, offering support and guidance, backing Xiang Zhongfa as a top leader, and issuing directives for the Nanchang Uprising. Zhang Tailei served as the secretary of its China Section of the Far Eastern Bureau. It also supported the establishment of the Chinese Soviet Republic, and its activities in China were seen by the KMT right-wing as evidence of a Soviet plot. The organization was dissolved on June 10, 1943.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代散文家、文学理论家、评论家、诗人、翻译家、思想家，鲁迅的胞弟，曾高度评价朱自清的散文。在文革“破四旧”期间遭到批斗和抄家。
description.en: A modern Chinese essayist, literary theorist, critic, poet, translator, and thinker; the younger brother of Lu Xun. He highly praised Zhu Ziqing's prose. During the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement of the Cultural Revolution, he was persecuted and his house was raided.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的一个省。绥远特别区成立前，其下辖的归绥道被划出。
description.en: A province during the Republic of China era. Before the establishment of the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region, its subordinate Guisui Circuit was separated from it.

description.zh-cn: 中国山西省的一个县，是黑茶山空难的发生地，叶挺的遇难地，也是马凯的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shanxi Province, China, where the Heichashan air crash occurred, Ye Ting died, and Ma Kai was born.

description.zh-cn: 博古之弟，香港华润集团创办人
中国共产党在国统区公开发行的第一张大型机关报，许涤新曾任其编委会委员和党总支书记。
description.en: The first major official newspaper publicly circulated by the Communist Party of China in Kuomintang-controlled areas. Xu Dixin served as a member of its editorial board and secretary of its Party general branch.

en: 1946 United States Air Force C-47 Crash at Yan'an

description.zh-cn: 1946年4月8日，一架美军C-46运输机在山西兴县黑茶山失事，机上人员包括叶挺、王若飞、博古、邓发等全部遇难。
在长征期间，曾有两个不同的领导小组被称为“三人团”。其中，一个在长征初期负责军事决策，由博古、周恩来、李德组成。另一个则在1935年3月左右成立，负责军事指挥，成员为周恩来、毛泽东、王稼祥。
清朝时期位于安徽省的行政区划，王明的出生地。
武汉大学经济与管理学院的前身，王明曾在此学习。

zh-cn: 中央人民政府法制委员会

description.zh-cn: 该机构设立于1949年，是中华人民共和国中央人民政府政务院下设的机构。作为国务院法制办公室的前身机构之一，它负责研究、草拟与审议各种法规草案。
description.en: Established in 1949, this agency was subordinate to the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China. As one of the predecessor bodies of the State Council Legislative Affairs Office, it was responsible for researching, drafting, and reviewing various draft laws and regulations.

description.zh-cn: 中共早期党员，在莫斯科中山大学与王明对立。
中共早期党员，曾任中共上海沪东区委书记。
中共驻共产国际代表团以中共和苏维埃政府名义发表的关于建立抗日民族统一战线的文件。
乔石的儿子
乔石的岳父，曾为陈布雷的机要秘书。
国民党元老，乔石妻子翁郁文的舅舅
乔石的儿媳，蒋小明的妻子
位于加拿大萨斯喀彻温省里贾纳的公立大学，曾授予乔石名誉法学博士学位。
位于中国上海市的一所综合性大学，也是同济大学及华中科技大学同济医学院的源头。
description.en: A comprehensive university located in Shanghai, China, and the origin of Tongji University and Tongji Medical College of Huazhong University of Science and Technology.

zh-cn: 第八届全国人民代表大会常务委员会
第八届全国人大常委会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第八届最高国家权力机关的常设机关。
由学生发起的社会运动，李力安早年曾参加。
description.en: A social movement initiated by students, in which Li Li'an participated in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国刑法中曾有的一项刑事罪名，后被废除。
中华人民共和国刑法中曾有的刑事罪名，后被废除。
一项已被中华人民共和国废除的刑事罪名
中国曾有的一项法律制度，后已被中华人民共和国废除。
中华人民共和国天津市下辖的市辖区，李瑞环的出生地。
description.en: A municipal district of Tianjin, China, and the birthplace of Li Ruihuan.

zh-cn: 天津市人民政府直属事业单位

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国天津市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Tianjin Municipality, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党天津市委员会
en: Tianjin Municipal Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Tianjin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在天津市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 由李瑞环在天津主政期间兴建，旨在缓解天津市民吃水难问题的重大民生工程。
由李瑞环创办的助学基金会。
description.en: A student aid foundation established by Li Ruihuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任北京市常务副市长，与李瑞环同为劳动模范出身的官员，是李瑞环的好友。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the executive vice mayor of Beijing. Like Li Ruihuan, he was a model worker who became an official and was a good friend of Li's.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军广州军区
en: Guangzhou Military Region of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾在中国南方设立的大军区之一。
description.en: One of the former major military regions of the People's Liberation Army, located in southern China.

description.zh-cn: 许世友长子
许世友三子，曾任江苏省军区司令员

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河南省郑州市登封市嵩山

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河南省嵩山的一座佛教寺庙，是汉传佛教的禅宗祖庭，因其历代武僧研创的少林功夫而闻名于世。现为世界文化遗产、国家5A级旅游景区。
description.en: A Buddhist monastery in Mount Song, Henan Province, China. It is the main temple of the Zen school of Chinese Buddhism and is world-renowned for its connection to Shaolin Kung Fu. It is a World Heritage Site and a National 5A-level tourist attraction.

description.zh-cn: 时任陆军第54军军长，战争期间任丁盛指挥所总指挥。

description.zh-cn: 清华大学，简称清华，其前身为清政府于1909年为统筹考核庚子赔款留学生而设立的机构，1911年演变为清华学堂。位于北京市海淀区清华园，是中国顶尖的公立大学，因园林得名。作为“双一流A类”和原“985工程”、“211工程”重点建设大学，清华培养了众多杰出人才，其建筑系师生曾主导中华人民共和国国徽的设计。大学后由原大陆校长梅贻琦在台湾新竹复校。
description.en: Tsinghua University, or Tsinghua, originated in 1909 as an institution by the Qing government to manage Boxer Indemnity students, evolving into Tsinghua School in 1911. Located in Tsinghua Garden, Haidian District, Beijing, it is a top public university in China, named after the garden. As a 'Double First-Class' university and a former 'Project 985' and 'Project 211' institution, Tsinghua has nurtured many talents, and its Department of Architecture faculty and students led the design of the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China. The university was later re-established in Hsinchu, Taiwan, by its former mainland president Mei Yi-chi.

It is a quasi-military organization responsible for economic development and border defense in Xinjiang. This organization is the same entity as the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, operating under a 'corps-enterprise unified' management system, using this name in the field of economic construction. It also carries the nameplate of 'China Xinjian Group Corporation' and has separate planning status.

description.zh-cn: 多伦多是加拿大安大略省的首府，加拿大最大的城市，位于安大略湖西北岸，是大多伦多地区的核心。其前身约克镇由约翰·格雷夫·锡姆科于1793年建立，并作为上加拿大的首府。1834年3月6日，约克镇升级为多伦多市，并成立了市政管理机构。现今的市政府是在1998年由大多伦多市下属的六个行政区合并而成。这座城市以其多元文化而闻名。
description.en: Toronto is the capital city of the Canadian province of Ontario and the largest city in Canada, located on the northwestern shore of Lake Ontario, serving as the core of the Greater Toronto Area. Its predecessor, the Town of York, was founded in 1793 by John Graves Simcoe and served as the capital of Upper Canada. On March 6, 1834, it was incorporated as the City of Toronto, establishing its municipal government. The current city government was formed in 1998 through the amalgamation of six municipalities of the former Metropolitan Toronto. The city is known for its multiculturalism.

In his early years, he was a subordinate of Wang Yaqiao, later planning and successfully assassinating Wang Yaqiao under Chiang Kai-shek's orders.

description.zh-cn: 美国记者，因其在中国革命期间的著作而闻名。他被认为是第一个采访中共领导人毛泽东的西方记者，其著作《红星照耀中国》（又名《西行漫记》）记录了中国共产主义运动。他被中方视为“中国人民的老朋友”。
description.en: American journalist known for his books and articles on Communism in China and the Chinese Communist revolution. He is best known for his book, Red Star Over China, an account of the Chinese Communist movement. He is considered one of the 'old friends of the Chinese people'.

description.zh-cn: 英籍华裔作家，其著作《毛泽东：鲜为人知的故事》引发争议。

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市市长、海峡两岸关系协会会长，多次举荐江泽民。
美国政治人物，曾任第42任美国总统，是乔治·沃克·布什的前任，也是美国历史上第二位被众议院弹劾的总统。他曾在金泳三执政期间就第一次朝核危机与金泳三合作，并在1996年台湾海峡导弹危机期间下令第七舰队航母战斗群进入台湾附近海域。1998年访华前，中国政府曾将魏京生流放到美国。刘超英曾由钟育瀚介绍与其会面。
description.en: American politician and the 42nd President of the United States, a predecessor to George W. Bush, and the second president in U.S. history to be impeached by the House of Representatives. He collaborated with Kim Young-sam on issues such as the First North Korean nuclear crisis during Kim's presidency, and during the 1996 Taiwan Strait missile crisis, he ordered Seventh Fleet carrier strike groups into the waters near Taiwan. Before his 1998 visit to China, the Chinese government exiled Wei Jingsheng to the U.S. Liu Chaoying was introduced to him by Johnny Chung.

He has served as an inspector of the Shanghai Municipal Construction and Management Commission, director of the Shanghai Urban Development Information Research Center, and an inspector of the Shanghai Municipal Urban-Rural Construction and Transportation Commission.

description.zh-cn: 上海交通大学、西安交通大学等校的前身。历史上的交通大学，其电讯工程相关专业于1956年并入组建电子科技大学。徐懋德（1938年至1942年）和钱学森（本科）都曾就读于该大学。
description.en: The predecessor of universities like Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Xi'an Jiao Tong University. Historically, its telecommunication engineering related majors merged into the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China in 1956. Both Xu Maode (1938-1942) and Qian Xuesen (undergraduate) were alumni of this university.

description.zh-cn: 一份由钦本立创办并担任总编辑的上海报纸，以其自由派立场著称。该报因计划在1989年刊载纪念胡耀邦的文章及报道八九学运，而被时任上海市委书记江泽民下令停刊。
description.en: A Shanghai-based newspaper founded and edited by Qin Benli, known for its liberal stance. It was shut down in 1989 by then Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Secretary Jiang Zemin for planning to publish an article commemorating Hu Yaobang and for its reports on the 1989 student movement.

description.zh-cn: 由李洪志于1992年在中国吉林省传出的一种精神修炼系统及气功修炼法，以“真、善、忍”为核心原则。它是一个身心修炼及信仰体系，并作为一个气功修炼团体，在1990年代于中国广泛传播。自1999年7月起，在中国大陆遭到中华人民共和国政府的镇压和取缔。
description.en: A spiritual practice and qigong cultivation method, founded by Li Hongzhi in Jilin Province, China, in May 1992. It is based on the core principles of 'Truthfulness, Compassion, Forbearance' and functions as a mind-body cultivation system and a qigong practice group. The practice spread widely in China in the 1990s but has been suppressed and outlawed by the Government of the People's Republic of China since July 1999.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府于2000年起制定的一项旨在提升西部地区经济和社会发展的政策。
description.en: A policy initiated by the government of the People's Republic of China in 2000 to promote economic and social development in its western regions.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国教育部原为建设若干所世界一流大学和一批国际知名高水平研究型大学而实施的教育计划。

中国共产党元老宋任穷之女，文化大革命期间北京师范大学女附中的红卫兵领袖。她因给毛泽东佩戴红卫兵袖章并被赐名“要武”而闻名全国，也因其所在学校副校长卞仲耘在“红八月”期间被打死而引发关注。后移居美国成为地质学者，晚年就文革行为道歉但引发争议。
description.en: Daughter of Chinese Communist Party veteran Song Renqiong, and a prominent Red Guard leader at the Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School during the Cultural Revolution. She became nationally famous for putting a Red Guard armband on Mao Zedong and being given the name 'Yaowu', and was also known for the death of the school's vice-principal Bian Zhongyun during Beijing's 'Red August'. She later moved to the United States, becoming a geologist, and in her later years apologized for her Cultural Revolution actions, sparking controversy.

description.zh-cn: 由德国思想家卡尔·马克思和弗里德里希·恩格斯共同创立的社会、政治和经济理论体系。它涵盖哲学、政治经济学和社会主义等领域，以历史唯物主义、辩证法和对资本主义的批判为核心。巴枯宁是马克思主义及其无产阶级专政思想的著名批评者之一。陈延年于1921年后转向信奉此主义。
description.en: A social, political, and economic theoretical system co-founded by German thinkers Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. It covers philosophy, political economy, and socialism, centered on historical materialism, dialectics, and a critique of capitalism. Bakunin was a prominent critic of Marxism and its idea of the dictatorship of the proletariat. Chen Yannian turned to this ideology after 1921.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，在河北东部地区由中国共产党领导的抗日武装起义。

description.zh-cn: 20世纪初中国学生赴法国学习和工作的运动，杨昌济曾为此运动筹措经费。
description.en: A movement in the early 20th century for Chinese students to study and work in France, for which Yang Changji helped raise funds.

中美就解决美国向台出售武器问题的公告

description.zh-cn: 中美三个联合公报，是中华人民共和国与美国政府间签署的三份重要外交文件，也是指导两国关系的基础性文件。其中，第一个公报，即《上海公报》，于尼克松访华期间在上海签署，由周恩来与尼克松共同发表，开启了中美关系正常化的进程。第三个公报旨在解决美国对台军售问题。
description.en: The Three Joint Communiqués are three important diplomatic documents signed by the governments of the People's Republic of China and the United States, serving as foundational guidelines for their relations. The first of these, the Shanghai Communiqué, was signed in Shanghai during Nixon's visit to China, co-issued by Zhou Enlai and Nixon, initiating the process of normalizing Sino-US relations. The third communiqué aimed to resolve the issue of U.S. arms sales to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 位于法国巴黎，是欧洲最古老的大学之一。其成立在1200年获得了腓力二世的正式批准。徐旭生曾在此留学学习哲学。
description.en: Located in Paris, France, it is one of the oldest universities in Europe. Its establishment was formally approved by Philip II in 1200. Xu Xusheng once studied philosophy here.

description.en: A Chinese Yue opera actress and a National First-class Actress, specializing in the Dan (female) role. She was mentored by Jin Caifeng.

description.zh-cn: 日本东京的一所预科军事学校。其前身机构由日高藤吉郎和河村隆实创办（始于1886年），旨在为有志报考陆军士官学校的青年提供培训。1903年7月起，该校专为中国陆军留学生开办，由日本陆军参谋本部支持。陈独秀曾于此学习陆军科。其毕业生对中国近代历史产生了重要影响。
description.en: A preparatory military school in Tokyo, Japan. Its predecessor institution was founded by Hidaka Tōkichirō and Kawamura Takami (starting from 1886) to train young men aspiring to enter the Army Academy. From July 1903, the school was specifically established for Chinese army students abroad, supported by the Japanese Army General Staff. Chen Duxiu studied military science here, and its graduates significantly influenced modern Chinese history.

location.zh-cn: 四川 (成都), 湖北, 湖南, 广东

description.zh-cn: 清末（1911年），清政府宣布“铁路干线国有政策”，将已告商办的川汉、粤汉铁路路权收归“国有”，引发一场大规模群众运动，尤以四川民众反对最为激烈，史称四川保路运动。运动期间，四川总督赵尔丰下令枪杀请愿群众，造成三十二人死亡的惨案，使运动由和平请愿转向武装斗争，成为辛亥革命的导火索，并为武昌起义创造了条件，加速了清朝灭亡。
description.en: In the late Qing dynasty (1911), the Qing government's announcement of the 'Policy of Nationalizing Trunk Railways', by nationalizing the commercially operated Sichuan-Hankou and Guangdong-Hankou railway rights, triggered a large-scale mass movement, with the most intense opposition coming from the people of Sichuan, known as the Sichuan Railway Protection Movement. During the movement, Sichuan Viceroy Zhao Erfeng ordered Qing soldiers to shoot at the protesting crowd, causing a tragedy with thirty-two deaths. This turned the movement from peaceful petition to armed struggle, becoming a catalyst for the Xinhai Revolution, creating conditions for the Wuchang Uprising, and accelerating the downfall of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 同盟会会员。1911年9月25日，他与吴玉章共同领导了荣县独立。
description.en: A member of the Tongmenghui. On September 25, 1911, he, along with Wu Yuzhang, led the independence of Rong County.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代教育家、社会活动家，中国国民党元老之一。曾任国立北平师范大学校长，为徐旭生的前任。

description.en: An agency of the People's Republic of China responsible for language and script work, operating jointly with the Ministry of Education. It is a nameplate externally retained by the Ministry of Education, with its establishment stipulated by the 'Law of the People's Republic of China on the Standard Spoken and Written Chinese Language'.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平提出的四项政治原则，不仅成为当时思想解放和言论自由的界限，也被《历史决议》确认为全党和全国人民团结的共同政治基础。
description.en: The Four Cardinal Principles proposed by Deng Xiaoping not only became the boundary for ideological emancipation and freedom of speech at the time but were also affirmed in the 'Historical Resolution' as the common political foundation for the unity of the entire Party and the people of the whole country.

description.en: The Shanghai International Settlement was one of the three foreign concessions in modern China and one of the two in Shanghai. It was the earliest established, longest-existing, largest in area, and had the largest administrative body, possessing independent judicial and administrative powers. As the most fully developed concession, it was also the birthplace of Soong Ching-ling.

description.en: A politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a former deputy national leader, currently serving as the executive deputy head of the Central Leading Group on Hong Kong and Macao Affairs, Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Work Office of the CPC Central Committee, and Director of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council.

description.en: Zhejiang University is a comprehensive research university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. It was formed in 1998 by the merger of the former Zhejiang University, Zhejiang Medical University, Zhejiang Agricultural University, and Hangzhou University. As a top public research university, its notable alumni include Xi Mingze; many founding members of High-Flyer Quant also graduated from here.

明朝开国皇帝，明太祖，年号洪武。他设立锦衣卫，废除丞相制度，通过胡惟庸案等政治清洗大大加强皇权，并推行海禁政策。其建立的分封藩王制度，虽旨在巩固朱氏统治，却为靖难之役埋下伏笔。他娶孝慈高皇后马氏，并在其去世后誓言不再立后。他是朱镕基的祖先，明宣宗的曾祖父，朱高煦的祖父。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, known as Emperor Taizu, with the reign title Hongwu. He established the Jinyiwei, abolished the chancellery system, and significantly strengthened imperial power through political purges like the Hu Weiyong case. He also implemented the Haijin policy. The system of enfeoffing princes he established, though intended to consolidate the Zhu family's rule, inadvertently set the stage for the later Jingnan Campaign. He married Empress Ma, Empress Xiaocigao, and vowed not to establish another empress after her death. He was an ancestor of Zhu Rongji, the great-grandfather of Emperor Xuande, and the grandfather of Zhu Gaoxu.

description.en: The State Council of China has undergone several institutional reforms. In 2008, the First Session of the 11th National People's Congress approved a reform plan, establishing the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. In 2018, the First Session of the 13th National People's Congress approved another institutional reform plan, forming the National Health Commission (managing the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine), reorganizing the Ministry of Justice, and abolishing the State Council Legislative Affairs Office. In 2023, the State Council initiated further reforms, mainly adjusting the responsibilities and branch structure of the People's Bank of China.

香港政治人物，曾任第五届香港特别行政区行政长官。任内推动《逃犯条例》修订草案，引发反修例运动及理工大学冲突。她还签署了《香港国安法》实施的法律公告，并因损害香港自治而受到美国制裁。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, former Chief Executive of the fifth term of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. During her tenure, she promoted the amendment bill of the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance, which led to the anti-extradition bill movement and the PolyU conflict. She also signed the legal notice for the implementation of the Hong Kong National Security Law and was sanctioned by the United States for undermining Hong Kong's autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 香港报纸。
香港已解散的民主派政党，在运动初期发起静坐等抗议活动。
香港资深大律师，香港大律师公会前主席。
中国政治人物，中共十九届中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记。曾任中共上海市委常委，中国纪检监察学院院长，前中华人民共和国国家监察委员会主任，首位拥有总监察官头衔的国家监察委员会主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, who served as a member of the Political Bureau and a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee. He also previously served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, President of the China Academy of Discipline Inspection and Supervision, and former Director of the National Supervisory Commission, being the first to hold the title of Chief Supervisor for the National Supervisory Commission.

zh-cn: 中央巡视工作领导小组
en: Central Leading Group for Inspection Work

description.zh-cn: 中共中央的议事协调机构，负责领导党内的巡视工作。
description.en: A coordinating body of the CPC Central Committee responsible for leading the party's inspection work.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共北京市委书记。

zh-cn: 中国共产党海南省委员会
en: Hainan Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Hainan Provincial Committee of the CPC
Hainan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在海南省的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Hainan Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国哲学社会科学研究的最高学术机构和综合研究中心。许涤新曾任副院长，孙冶方曾任其顾问；杨小凯于1982年在此获得硕士学位。
description.en: The highest academic institution and comprehensive research center for philosophy and social sciences in the People's Republic of China. Xu Dixin served as its vice president, and Sun Yefang as a consultant; Yang Xiaokai obtained his master's degree here in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 国际奥委会主席
中国人民解放军上将，曾任中共中央政治局委员、中央军事委员会副主席。在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军委副主席，后在反腐运动中落马。他是郭伯权的胞兄。
description.en: A general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, he was a former Politburo member and Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission. He was appointed as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission during the 11th National People's Congress, later falling during the anti-corruption campaign. He is the elder brother of Guo Boquan.

description.zh-cn: 原中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原国家级副职领导人。曾任中共青海、甘肃、江西三省省委书记，第十二届全国政协副主席。2017年，因犯受贿罪、滥用职权罪、巨额财产来源不明罪，被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: A former politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, and a former deputy national leader. He served as the Party Committee Secretary of Qinghai, Gansu, and Jiangxi provinces, and as a Vice Chairman of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC. In 2017, he was sentenced to life imprisonment for bribery, abuse of power, and possessing a huge amount of property from unknown sources.

zh-cn: 中央国家安全工作领导小组
中央外事工作领导小组
en: Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs
Central Leading Group for National Security Affairs

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会负责外事工作的议事协调机构，于1981年恢复设立。2000年9月，其下设的中央外事办公室成立，与中央外事工作领导小组合署办公，该办公室名义于2014年中央国家安全委员会成立后不再保留。该机构是中央国家安全委员会的前身机构之一。2018年3月，该机构由中央外事工作领导小组改组为中央外事工作委员会，负责外事工作决策和统筹协调。
description.en: The deliberation and coordination body of the CPC Central Committee responsible for foreign affairs, re-established in 1981. In September 2000, its subordinate Central Foreign Affairs Office was established, working jointly with the Central Foreign Affairs Leading Group; the title of this office was no longer retained after the establishment of the Central National Security Commission in 2014. This body is one of the predecessor institutions to the Central National Security Commission. In March 2018, it was reorganized from the Central Foreign Affairs Leading Group into the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, responsible for decision-making and overall coordination in foreign affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国统一的红十字组织，是从事人道主义工作的社会救助团体。
description.en: The unified Red Cross organization of the People's Republic of China, a social relief group engaged in humanitarian work.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆企业家，阿里巴巴集团、淘宝网、支付宝的创始人，蚂蚁集团实际控制人
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, founder of Alibaba Group.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，第20任大韩民国总统。他于2024年12月3日宣布全国戒严，引发政治危机，最终遭国会弹劾下台并被逮捕。
description.en: A South Korean politician who served as the 20th President of the Republic of Korea. He declared martial law on December 3, 2024, sparking a political crisis that led to his impeachment and arrest.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，大韩民国第19任总统。他曾在2017年共同民主党总统初选中击败李在明，并于2018年与金正恩共同签署了《板门店宣言》。
description.en: A South Korean politician who served as the 19th President of the Republic of Korea. He defeated Lee Jae-myung in the 2017 Democratic Party presidential primary and co-signed the Panmunjom Declaration with Kim Jong-un in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾总统

en: Death and state funeral of Elizabeth II
The Old Regime and the Revolution

description.zh-cn: 中国传媒工作者、前中国中央电视台主持人，于2018年底曝光陕西千亿矿权案二审卷宗在最高人民法院丢失，引发舆论风暴。
description.en: A Chinese media worker and former host of China Central Television who, in late 2018, exposed the disappearance of the second-instance case files of the 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case' from the Supreme People's Court, sparking a public outcry.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治学家、政治经济学家、作家，以其著作《历史之终结及最后一人》而闻名。
description.en: American political scientist, political economist, and writer, best known for his book 'The End of History and the Last Man'.

description.zh-cn: 以色列总理

zh-cn: 杰尼斯·瓦连京诺维奇·曼图罗夫

birth_place.zh-cn: 苏联俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国摩尔曼斯克

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，自2012年起担任俄罗斯联邦工业和贸易部长，后兼任副总理、第一副总理。
description.en: Russian politician, who has served as the Minister of Industry and Trade of the Russian Federation since 2012, and later also as Deputy Prime Minister and First Deputy Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯副总理。

en: Shanghai Municipal Party School of the CPC

zh-cn: 上海市科学技术委员会
中国共产党中央委员会总书记办公室
en: Office of the General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party
