en: Work Committee for the Organs Directly Under the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的派出机构，负责领导中共中央直属机关党的工作。
description.en: An agency dispatched by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for leading the party work of the organs directly under the CPC Central Committee.

en: State visit by Xi Jinping to the United States

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国女高音歌唱家、歌剧表演艺术家、国家一级歌唱演员，金铁霖的学生，也是中国培养的第一位民族声乐硕士研究生。她曾任全国政协委员、解放军艺术学院院长，是中共中央总书记习近平的妻子。
description.en: Chinese soprano, folk singer, opera performing artist, and national first-class singer. She was a student of Jin Tielin and the first person in China to receive a master's degree in ethnic vocal music. She served as a member of the National Committee of the CPPCC and the president of the PLA Academy of Art. She is also the wife of Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 中国前驻英国大使柯华之女，习近平的第一任妻子。
description.en: First wife of Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会总书记习近平与歌唱家彭丽媛的独生女，同时也是齐桥桥的侄女。
description.en: The only daughter of Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and his wife, singer Peng Liyuan. She is also the niece of Qi Qiaoqiao.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国福建省福州市
birth_place.en: Fuzhou, Fujian, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的一所干部子弟学校，齐桥桥曾在此就读小学。
description.en: A school for children of cadres in Beijing, where Qi Qiaoqiao attended primary school.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共河北省委书记。
中国政治人物，曾任中共中央组织部部长、中国科学技术协会党组书记，中共十九届中央政治局委员、中央书记处书记，原副国级党和国家领导人，习近平在清华大学的室友。
description.en: A Chinese politician, formerly served as the Head of the Organization Department of the CCP Central Committee, the Party Group Secretary of the China Association for Science and Technology, a member of the Political Bureau and a secretary of the Secretariat of the 19th CPC Central Committee. He was a former state leader at vice-national level and Xi Jinping's roommate at Tsinghua University.

zh-cn: 小约瑟夫·罗比内特·拜登

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，第46任暨现任美国总统。他在2020年总统选举中击败唐纳德·特朗普。
description.en: American politician, the 46th and current President of the United States, who defeated Donald Trump in the 2020 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、法学家、前总统。曾任中国国民党主席、台北市市长、法务部部长等职务。他于1998年台北市长选举中击败寻求连任的陈水扁，并于2008年接替陈水扁当选总统。在任期间，吴敦义曾担任行政院院长及副总统。他于2015年追授张纯如褒扬令，称魏京生为“民主先锋”，并在蒋方良告别式上为其灵柩覆盖党旗。2024年总统选举蓝白合协商中，他担任见证人，促成政党协商会议。
description.en: A politician, jurist, and former President of the Republic of China. He served as Chairman of the Kuomintang, Mayor of Taipei, and Minister of Justice, among other roles. He defeated the incumbent Chen Shui-bian in the 1998 Taipei mayoral election and succeeded him as president in 2008. During his presidency, Wu Den-yih served as Premier and Vice President. He posthumously awarded a presidential citation to Iris Chang in 2015, calling Wei Jingsheng a 'pioneer of democracy', and covered Jiang Fangliang's coffin with the party flag at her funeral. In the 2024 presidential election's Blue-White Cooperation negotiations, he acted as a witness, facilitating a party negotiation meeting.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，前中国共产党中央委员会总书记胡锦涛的夫人，曾任北京市城乡规划委员会副主任。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, wife of former General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee Hu Jintao, and former deputy director of the Beijing Municipal Commission of Urban Planning.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央总书记胡锦涛与刘永清之子，现任中华人民共和国民政部副部长。
description.en: Son of former CCP General Secretary Hu Jintao and Liu Yongqing, currently serving as Vice Minister of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党西藏自治区委员会
en: Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

zh-cn: 中国共产党贵州省委员会
en: Guizhou Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Guizhou Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

zh-cn: 胡锦涛领导下的自由主义黄金时代

description.zh-cn: 指胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记、温家宝担任国务院总理时期的中华人民共和国中央领导集体。该届政府被认为需要打击削弱江泽民派系。
description.en: Refers to the central leadership of the People's Republic of China during the period when Hu Jintao was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee and Wen Jiabao was the Premier of the State Council. This administration was seen as needing to weaken the Jiang Zemin faction.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛提出的社会经济发展理念，旨在减少社会不平等和冲突。
description.en: A socioeconomic concept introduced by Hu Jintao, aiming to reduce social inequality and conflict.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任卫生部部长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Minister of Health.

description.zh-cn: 2008年5月12日发生于中国四川省的特大地震，是中华人民共和国成立以来破坏力最大的地震，也是唐山大地震后伤亡最惨重的一次。此次地震对都江堰及二王庙造成损害，绵阳市是重灾区之一。大量校舍倒塌引发社会广泛质疑，促使艾未未发起公民调查。习明泽曾前往灾区担任志愿者。地震后，香港理工大学与四川大学共建了灾后重建与管理学院。
description.en: A catastrophic earthquake occurred in Sichuan Province, China, on May 12, 2008. It was the most destructive and casualty-ridden earthquake since the Tangshan earthquake and the founding of the People's Republic of China. The event caused damage to Dujiangyan and the Erwang Temple, with Mianyang being one of the hardest-hit areas. The collapse of numerous school buildings led to widespread public questioning, prompting Ai Weiwei to initiate a citizens' investigation. Xi Mingze served as a volunteer in the disaster area. After the earthquake, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Sichuan University jointly established the Institute for Disaster Management and Reconstruction.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，连震东之子。曾任行政院院长（接替郝柏村）、李登辉的副总统、中国国民党主席，并代表国民党参选2000年总统选举。2005年与胡锦涛举行了历史性会面。他与钱复等人并称“四公子”。曾出席蒋方良告别式。在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》中，其角色原型为“陆中华”，剧中描述其与“钟主谕”（原型宋楚瑜）不和。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China, son of Lien Chen-tung. He served as Premier of the Executive Yuan (succeeding Hau Pei-tsun), Vice President under Lee Teng-hui, and Chairman of the Kuomintang. He also represented the KMT in the 2000 presidential election. In 2005, he held a historic meeting with Hu Jintao. He is known as one of the 'Four Princes' along with Fredrick Chien and others. He attended Jiang Fangliang's funeral. In the TV series 'Island Nation 2', his prototype character 'Lu Zhong-hua' is depicted as being at odds with 'Zhong Zhu-yu' (prototype James Soong).

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，亲民党创党主席及现任党主席，曾任台湾省省长。他毕业于伯克利大学。2000年因未获国民党提名，脱党参选总统选举，导致泛蓝选票分裂。他曾与李登辉一同提拔吴敦义，后在2012年总统选举中成为吴敦义的竞争对手。在《国际桥牌社2》中，其角色原型为“钟主谕”，剧中描述其与“陆中华”（原型连战）不和。
description.en: A Republic of China politician, founding and current chairman of the People First Party, and former governor of Taiwan Province. He graduated from Berkeley University. In 2000, after failing to secure the KMT's nomination, he ran as an independent in the presidential election, which led to a split in the pan-blue vote. He once promoted Wu Den-yih alongside Lee Teng-hui, later becoming Wu's rival in the 2012 presidential election. In the TV series 'Island Nation 2', his prototype character is 'Zhong Zhu-yu', depicted as being at odds with 'Lu Zhong-hua' (prototype Lien Chan).

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛的著作选集
山西省忻州市下辖的县，薄一波的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province, and the birthplace of Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，阎锡山晋绥军在山西发动的一场意图消灭中国共产党领导的山西新军的大规模武装冲突。
description.en: A large-scale armed conflict during the Second Sino-Japanese War, launched by Yan Xishan's Jin-Sui Army in Shanxi at the end of 1939 against the Communist-led Shanxi New Army, with the aim to eliminate them.

description.zh-cn: 指国家在非常时期采取的一种紧急措施。在1989年六四事件前夕，北京实施了戒严。
description.en: An emergency measure taken by a state in extraordinary times. Martial law was imposed in Beijing on the eve of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳的出生地。
中英两国政府（中华人民共和国与英国）为解决香港前途问题而签署并共同发表的联合声明。
description.en: A joint declaration by the People's Republic of China and the United Kingdom on the question of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 1988年中国尝试进行的价格体系改革，因引发通货膨胀和抢购潮而受挫。
中国共产党内部主张并推动改革开放的政治派别，其主张包括深化市场化和政治体制改革。
许世友的出生地，位于今河南省信阳市新县
清末民初，由袁世凯建立的现代化中国军队，正式名称为新建陆军（亦称新军），是中国第一支近代化陆军，也是清末至民初的中国国防军。民国成立后，该军队成为北洋政府的主要军事力量。袁世凯死后，其内部迅速分裂为各大军阀派系，是北洋军阀势力的基础和前身。
description.en: A modern Chinese army and national defense force, formally known as the Newly Created Army (also referred to as the New Army), established by Yuan Shikai in the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic of China. It was China's first modernized army. After the establishment of the Republic, it became the main military force of the Beiyang Government. Following Yuan Shikai's death, it rapidly fractured into various warlord factions, forming the basis and predecessor of the Beiyang warlords' power.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期投降日军的国民党将领
温家宝曾就读的中学
温家宝的本科与硕士毕业院校
温家宝父亲
温家宝的夫人，温云松之母。中国珠宝玉石专家，曾任中国珠宝协会副主席、国家珠宝玉石质量监督检验中心主任等职。
description.en: Wife of Wen Jiabao and mother of Wen Yunsong. She is a Chinese jewelry and jade expert, and has served as vice chairman of the Gems & Jewelry Trade Association of China and director of the National Gemstone Testing Center.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院前总理温家宝之子，中国商人和企业家，曾创立优创科技有限公司和新天域资本公司，并曾担任中国卫星通信集团董事长。
description.en: Son of Wen Jiabao, former Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, a Chinese businessman and entrepreneur who founded Unihub Global Network and New Horizon Capital, and formerly served as the chairman of China Satcom.

description.zh-cn: 温家宝与张培莉之女，温云松之妹。曾在雷曼兄弟公司和瑞士信贷第一波士顿银行任职。
description.en: Daughter of Wen Jiabao and Zhang Peili, and sister of Wen Yunsong. She has worked at Lehman Brothers and Credit Suisse First Boston.

description.zh-cn: 为应对2008年国际金融危机而推出的经济刺激计划

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国地质矿产部
中华人民共和国地质部
en: Ministry of Geology of the People's Republic of China
Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 指2012年2月6日至7日，时任重庆市副市长兼公安局局长王立军私自进入美国驻成都总领事馆滞留。该事件引发了一系列政治风波，直接导致了薄熙来的倒台和重庆模式的终结。
description.en: Refers to the incident on February 6-7, 2012, when then Vice Mayor of Chongqing and police chief Wang Lijun secretly entered and stayed at the U.S. Consulate General in Chengdu. This event triggered a series of political turmoil, directly leading to the downfall of Bo Xilai and the end of the Chongqing Model.

description.zh-cn: 现任俄罗斯联邦总统，曾任俄罗斯总理。他批准并签署了接纳克里米亚加入俄罗斯的条约，并在顿巴斯战争及2022年2月24日对乌克兰发动的全面入侵（亦称“特别军事行动”）中扮演关键决策角色。他是首位拜访少林寺的外国元首。在任期间，安倍晋三曾多次与其会面，试图解决南千岛群岛（日称北方四岛）领土争议并签订和平条约，两人建立了深厚的个人情谊。此外，他还公开表达对唐纳德·特朗普的支持，魏京生赞同其“为保护本民族不再遭受种族清洗”的说法。
description.en: Current President of the Russian Federation and former Prime Minister of Russia. He approved and signed the treaty to admit Crimea into Russia, and played a key decision-making role in the War in Donbas and the full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022 (also known as a 'special military operation'). He was the first foreign head of state to visit the Shaolin Temple. During his tenure, Shinzo Abe met with him multiple times in an attempt to resolve the Southern Kuril Islands territorial dispute and sign a peace treaty, developing a strong personal rapport. Furthermore, he has also publicly expressed support for Donald Trump, and Wei Jingsheng agreed with his justification of 'protecting his people from ethnic cleansing'.

description.zh-cn: 印度前总理
德国政治家，德国前总理。她是德国首位女总理，曾于莱比锡大学学习物理学。
description.en: A German politician and former Chancellor of Germany. She was Germany's first female Chancellor and studied physics at the University of Leipzig.

zh-cn: 奇平诺顿的卡梅伦男爵戴维·威廉·唐纳德·卡梅伦
en: David William Donald Cameron, Baron Cameron of Chipping Norton
The Rt Hon. The Lord Cameron of Chipping Norton

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，曾任英国首相，现任外交大臣。他曾任命马尔 Malcolm Rifkind 为情报和安全委员会主席。
description.en: British politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and is currently the Foreign Secretary. He appointed Malcolm Rifkind as Chairman of the Intelligence and Security Committee.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建设部
en: Ministry of Construction of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经的组成部门，主管建设行政事务。后已撤销，并改为中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for construction administration. It was later revoked and succeeded by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国青岛市的市级行政机关。
description.en: The municipal-level administrative organ of Qingdao, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声之母，黄敬的妻子。中华人民共和国新闻工作者，中国共产党官员，曾任北京市政协主席、北京市副市长、北京日报社社长。
description.en: A Chinese journalist and an official of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 原国防科委主任，俞正声的岳父。
黄敬与范瑾的长子，俞正声的大哥，原中华人民共和国国家安全部北美情报司司长，1986年叛逃美国。
description.en: Eldest son of Huang Jing and Fan Jin. He was the eldest brother of Yu Zhengsheng, and formerly served as the Director of the North American Intelligence Division of the Ministry of State Security of the People's Republic of China, defecting to the United States in 1986.

description.zh-cn: 黄敬与范瑾的次子，俞正声的二哥，中华人民共和国经济学家、官员，曾任全国人大法工委研究室主任。
description.en: Second son of Huang Jing and Fan Jin.

description.zh-cn: 黄敬与范瑾的次女，俞正声的二妹。曾任北京市经济和信息化委员会副主任。
description.en: Second daughter of Huang Jing and Fan Jin, and second younger sister of Yu Zhengsheng. She formerly served as Deputy Director of Beijing Municipal Commission of Economy and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 俞正声、俞强声的曾祖父，晚清进士，晚清、民国时期政治、教育及文学界人物。
俞正声的堂叔祖，曾任中华民国国防部长。金门炮战时在场但幸免于难。
description.en: Granduncle of Yu Zhengsheng, formerly Minister of National Defense of the Republic of China. He was present during the shelling of Kinmen (Second Taiwan Strait Crisis) but survived.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国与蒋方良唯一的女儿，蒋中正唯一的孙女，蒋孝武的姐姐。俞正声的堂婶。
description.en: Daughter of Chiang Ching-kuo, older sister of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 北京市的一所著名中学，林立果、马凯曾就读于此，马凯还曾在此任教。
description.en: A renowned high school in Beijing, China, where Lin Liguo and Ma Kai once studied, and Ma Kai later taught.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学
中国人民解放军军事工程学院
中国人民解放军国防科学技术大学
中国人民解放军第四政治干部学校
解放军第四政治干部学校

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学，一所中央军事委员会直属的综合性大学，位于中国湖南省长沙市。其前身是中国人民解放军军事工程学院（简称“哈军工”），始建于1953年，早期位于哈尔滨（1953-1966），后于1970年主体内迁长沙并更名。作为解放军唯一一所“985工程”和“211工程”重点建设的顶尖军事院校，毛远新曾在此就读；刘超英曾学习电子计算机软件专业；于永波则在其前身解放军第四政治干部学校学习。
description.en: The National University of Defense Technology of the People's Liberation Army is a comprehensive university directly under the Central Military Commission, located in Changsha, Hunan, China. Its predecessor was the PLA Military Institute of Engineering (commonly known as 'Harbin Military Engineering Institute'), founded in 1953, initially located in Harbin (1953-1966). Its main body relocated to Changsha and was renamed in 1970. As the only top military academy of the PLA designated under Project 985 and Project 211, Mao Yuanxin once studied here; Liu Chaoying studied computer software; and Yu Yongbo studied at its predecessor, the 4th PLA Political Cadre School.

zh-cn: 中国残疾人福利基金会

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性公募基金会
前中华人民共和国铁道部部长。
刘志军的胞弟。
越南华裔女商人，因与包括杜世成在内的多名高官有染并涉及腐败案件而知名。
description.en: A Vietnamese-born Chinese businesswoman known for her involvement in corruption cases and relationships with several high-ranking officials, including Du Shicheng.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共山东省委副书记、青岛市委书记、青岛市市长等职务。因腐败犯罪被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Deputy Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPC, Secretary of the Qingdao Municipal Committee of the CPC, and Mayor of Qingdao. He was later sentenced to life imprisonment for corruption.

zh-cn: 浙江万里职业技术学院
浙江农业大学宁波分校
浙江农村技术师范专科学校

description.zh-cn: 位于中国浙江省宁波市的一所全日制普通高等院校。
description.en: A full-time ordinary institution of higher learning located in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, China.

zh-cn: 香港官立高级工业学院

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学，位于香港九龙红磡，是一所公立应用研究型大学。其历史可追溯至1937年成立的香港官立高级工业学院。该学院是香港首所由政府资助、提供专上程度工科教育的院校，并于1947年更名，作为香港理工大学的前身继续发展。著名导演王家卫曾在此修读平面设计专业。
description.en: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, Hong Kong, is a public, application-oriented research university. Its history dates back to the Government Trade School, established in 1937, which was the first government-funded institution in Hong Kong to provide post-secondary engineering education. In 1947, it was renamed, continuing its development as a predecessor of the university. Renowned director Wong Kar-wai once studied graphic design here.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省的政务服务平台，旨在提供“互联网+政务服务”。
description.en: The government service platform of Zhejiang Province, aimed at providing 'Internet + government services'.

zh-cn: 长江三角洲区域一体化发展
en: Strategy for Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta
Integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在促进上海、江苏、浙江、安徽一体化发展的中国国家战略。
description.en: A national strategy of China aimed at promoting the integrated development of Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央决策议事协调机构
德国总理

zh-cn: 艾曼纽·尚-米歇尔·弗雷德里克·马克宏

description.zh-cn: 法国政治人物，现任法国总统和安道尔大公。曾任法国经济、产业更新和信息技术部长。他于2016年成立“共和国前进！”政党，并在2017年和2022年连续两次赢得总统选举。任职总统期间，他曾任命塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼为总理。
description.en: French politician, the current President of France and Co-Prince of Andorra. He previously served as Minister of the Economy, Industry and Digital Affairs. He founded the political party La République En Marche! in 2016 and won the presidential elections in both 2017 and 2022. During his presidency, he appointed Sébastien Lecornu as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在提高水稻产量的农业科研项目，通过杂交技术培育出了具有杂种优势的水稻品种，能显著提高产量。
description.en: An agricultural research project aimed at increasing rice yields, which involved breeding rice varieties through hybridization techniques that exhibit heterosis, leading to significantly higher yields.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正的父亲。
蒋中正的母亲。
蒋中正的原配夫人，蒋经国的生母，蒋方良的婆婆。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek's original wife, Chiang Ching-kuo's biological mother, and Jiang Fangliang's mother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正的妾，蒋纬国养母。
蒋中正的妾。
中华民国陆军二级上将、政治人物。他是蒋中正的养子（次子），蒋孝武的叔父。曾任三军大学校长，并为朱邦复发明的输入法命名为“仓颉输入法”。他还曾师从于汪伏生。
description.en: A General in the Republic of China Army and political figure. He was the adopted second son of Chiang Kai-shek and uncle of Chiang Hsiao-wu. He also served as a former president of the Armed Forces University, named the input method invented by Chu Bong-Foo as the 'Cangjie input method', and was tutored by Wang Fusheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国同盟会元老、重要成员，同盟会中部总会的筹建者之一，中华民国早期政治人物。他派遣蒋介石刺杀了光复会领袖陶成章。部分观点认为他也是刺杀宋教仁的嫌疑人之一。
description.en: A veteran and important member of the Tongmenghui, one of the founders of its Central China Branch, and an early political figure in the Republic of China. He dispatched Chiang Kai-shek to assassinate Guangfuhui leader Tao Chengzhang. Some theories also suggest he was a suspect in the assassination of Song Jiaoren.

description.zh-cn: 光复会领导人之一。因反对孙中山，要求改选同盟会总理，后被陈其美派蒋介石刺杀。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Guangfuhui. He opposed Sun Yat-sen and demanded a re-election for the premier of the Tongmenghui. He was later assassinated by Chiang Kai-shek under the orders of Chen Qimei.

description.zh-cn: 二战时期美国陆军将领，盟军亚洲战区参谋长，曾派驻中国。

zh-cn: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福

description.zh-cn: 美国第32任总统，也是美国历史上唯一连任超过两届的总统。他在大萧条期间推行罗斯福新政，领导国家走出困境。在第二次世界大战期间，他作为同盟国的关键领导人，于珍珠港事件后发表《国耻演说》，领导美国对日宣战。他与西奥多·罗斯福是堂兄弟。
description.en: The 32nd President of the United States, and the only president to serve more than two terms. He implemented the New Deal during the Great Depression, leading the country out of its difficulties. During World War II, as a key leader of the Allies, he delivered the famous "Day of Infamy" speech after the Pearl Harbor attack and led the U.S. to declare war on Japan. He was a fifth cousin of Theodore Roosevelt.

death_place.zh-cn: 沃姆斯普林斯 (佐治亚州)

zh-cn: 温斯顿·雷欧纳德·斯宾塞·邱吉尔

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家、演说家、军官、历史学家、作家与画家，曾两度担任英国首相，领导英国赢得第二次世界大战。在二战期间，他曾与斯大林讨论过教宗的立场。
description.en: British statesman, orator, officer, historian, writer, and artist who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom twice, leading Britain to victory in the Second World War. During World War II, he also discussed the Pope's position with Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 1930年5月至11月，蒋中正与阎锡山、冯玉祥、李宗仁等地方军阀在河南、山东、安徽等地爆发了一场大规模内战，也是北伐后中国境内最大的内战。此战中，张学良率东北军主力入关支持蒋介石，导致东北防务空虚，为九一八事变创造了条件。石友三在此战中失败。
description.en: From May to November 1930, a large-scale civil war erupted in China, primarily in Henan, Shandong, and Anhui, involving Chiang Kai-shek against regional warlords such as Yan Xishan, Feng Yuxiang, and Li Zongren. This was also the largest civil war in China after the Northern Expedition. During this conflict, Zhang Xueliang led the main force of the Northeastern Army into Shanhai Pass to support Chiang Kai-shek, which left the Northeast's defenses vulnerable and created conditions for the Mukden Incident. Shi Yousan suffered defeat in this war.

description.zh-cn: 由中华民国在台湾地区发起的文化运动，旨在反制中国大陆的“破四旧”运动。
description.en: A cultural movement initiated by the Republic of China in the Taiwan area to counter the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党史专家，曾任毛泽东政治秘书，是中共党内自由派的代表人物。他曾与女儿李南央共同向于光远保荐杨小凯。
description.en: An expert on the history of the Communist Party of China, a former political secretary to Mao Zedong, and a representative of the liberal faction within the CPC. He, along with his daughter Li Nanyang, once recommended Yang Xiaokai to Yu Guangyuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, once served as the head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任甘肃省省长。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former Governor of Gansu Province.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会委员
en: Member of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的成员。
中华人民共和国政府在中国中西部地区的13个省、自治区进行的一场以战备为指导思想的大规模国防、科技、工业和交通基本设施建设。
description.en: A large-scale construction of national defense, science and technology, industrial, and transportation infrastructure guided by war preparedness, carried out by the government of the People's Republic of China in 13 provinces and autonomous regions in central and western China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国环境保护部
en: Ministry of Environmental Protection of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，曾负责中国环境保护工作。该机构是福建省生态环境厅的业务上级机构。其时任部长陈吉宁曾对纪录片《穹顶之下》表示赞赏。
description.en: A component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, formerly responsible for environmental protection work in China. It serves as the professional superior of the Fujian Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment. Its minister at the time, Chen Jining, once expressed appreciation for the documentary 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的高级领导人、政治人物。曾任建筑工程部部长、农业机械部长，并为十人小组成员。
description.en: A senior leader and politician of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He served as the Minister of Building Engineering and the Minister of Agricultural Machinery, and was a member of the 'Group of Ten'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任天津市市长。
中国教育家，重庆市育才中学校的创办人及首任校长。
description.en: Chinese educator, founder and first principal of Chongqing Yucai Secondary School.

description.zh-cn: 1959年庐山会议后，中国共产党在党内开展了一场政治运动。该运动旨在批判党内对大跃进持怀疑和反对意见的干部，其中错误地批判了彭德怀等人。它阻碍了大跃进错误的及时纠正，打断了纠正“左”倾错误的进程，是造成三年困难时期的主要原因之一。
description.en: After the 1959 Lushan Conference, the Communist Party of China launched a political movement within the party. This movement aimed to criticize cadres who were skeptical of or opposed to the Great Leap Forward, wrongly criticizing Peng Dehuai and others. It hindered the timely correction of the Great Leap Forward's errors, interrupted the process of rectifying 'Left' errors, and was one of the main causes of the Three Years of Great Famine.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国电力工业部
en: Ministry of Electric Power Industry of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经存在的组成部门，主管全国电力工业。李小琳曾在此任职。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the national electric power industry. Li Xiaolin once worked here.

description.zh-cn: 周永康长子。
周永康次子。
中国江苏省历史上的一个县，现已撤销。
description.en: A former county in Jiangsu Province, China, which has since been abolished.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国土资源部
en: Ministry of Land and Resources of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 已撤销的中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，后整合为中华人民共和国自然资源部。

zh-cn: 中国共产党四川省委员会
en: Sichuan Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Sichuan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在四川省的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府维护社会稳定的政治任务，在周永康主政政法委期间被强化。
指在中国政坛中，以石油系统出身的官员所形成的非正式政治派系。
中国共产党内的一个非正式政治派系，以江泽民为核心。其成员多与前中共中央总书记江泽民有直接或间接的联系，主要从上海市的领导岗位提升至中央高层。陈良宇被视为该派系的重要成员。据博讯新闻称，该派系曾与温家宝存在权力斗争。
description.en: An informal political faction within the Communist Party of China, with Jiang Zemin as its core. Its members often have direct or indirect ties to former CCP General Secretary Jiang Zemin and were frequently promoted to central leadership from positions in Shanghai. Chen Liangyu was considered a key member of this faction. According to Boxun News, it was engaged in a power struggle with Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 外界对周永康、薄熙来、徐才厚、令计划四人政治同盟的称呼。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国石油工业部
en: Ministry of Petroleum Industry of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国曾经设立的国务院组成部门，负责石油工业。余秋里是其主要领导人之一，领导了大庆油田的开发。该部门现已撤销。
description.en: A former component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the petroleum industry. Yu Qiuli was one of its main leaders and directed the development of the Daqing Oil Field. The department has since been abolished.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代民族工商业者的杰出代表、政治家，被誉为“红色资本家”。曾任中华人民共和国副主席，并担任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: An outstanding representative of modern national industrialists and businessmen in China, and a politician, known as a 'Red Capitalist'. He served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China and was a member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军铁道兵
en: Railway Corps of the Chinese People's Liberation Army

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农垦部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国曾设立的负责国营农场和移民开垦事务的部门。
description.en: A former ministry of the People's Republic of China responsible for state farms and land reclamation by migrants.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁之女。
description.en: Daughter of Ye Xuaning.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国辽宁省的省级国家行政机关，是沈阳市人民政府的业务上级。
description.en: The provincial-level state administrative organ of Liaoning Province, People's Republic of China, and the operational superior of the Shenyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省延安市延川县的一个村庄，习近平曾在此插队。
甘肃省下辖的县，两当兵变的发生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Gansu Province, where the Liangdang Mutiny occurred.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共上海市委常委
中国政治人物，在孟凡利就任深圳市委书记的干部会议上宣读中央决定。
description.en: Chinese politician, announced the central government's decision at the cadre meeting for Meng Fanli's appointment as Shenzhen Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 韩国民主运动领袖、政治家，韩国第14任总统，也是韩国民主化后的首位文人总统。他曾是韩国国会历史上任期最长的议员之一，也是最年轻当选的议员。在全斗焕执政期间曾被软禁。其执政期间致力于消除腐败，并将包括全斗焕在内的两位前总统推上法庭并判刑（后特赦全斗焕），但其任期后期因亚洲金融危机和亲属腐败丑闻而备受争议。
description.en: A leader of the South Korean democracy movement and politician, the 14th President of South Korea, and the first civilian president after democratization. He was one of the longest-serving members in the National Assembly and the youngest ever elected. He was placed under house arrest during Chun Doo-hwan's rule. During his presidency, he focused on eradicating corruption and brought two former presidents, including Chun Doo-hwan, to justice and sentencing (later pardoning Chun). However, his later term was marred by the Asian financial crisis and family corruption scandals.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任北京市市长（贾庆林前任），后因涉及陈希同案被调离。此外，他还是第十届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as Mayor of Beijing (predecessor to Jia Qinglin) and was later transferred due to his involvement in the Chen Xitong case. He also served as Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 10th CPPCC National Committee.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国监察部
en: Ministry of Supervision of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，负责行政监察。
中华人民共和国黑龙江省哈尔滨市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Harbin City, Heilongjiang Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在哈尔滨市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading body of the Communist Party of China in Harbin City.

birth_place.zh-cn: 山西省五台县东冶镇槐荫村
birth_place.en: Huaiyin Village, Dongye Town, Wutai County, Shanxi Province

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任中共哈尔滨市委书记、中国共产党黑龙江省委员会书记（杨易辰的继任者）、中共中央组织部副部长、中国共产党中央顾问委员会秘书长以及当代中国研究所所长。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China. He served as Secretary of the CPC Harbin Municipal Committee, Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee (successor to Yang Yichen), Deputy Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, Secretary-General of the CPC Central Advisory Commission, and Director of the Institute of Contemporary China Studies.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共哈尔滨市委第一书记，是李力安的继任者。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as the First Secretary of the CPC Harbin Municipal Committee, succeeding Li Li'an.

zh-cn: 华东师范大学第一附属中学
en: No.1 High School Affiliated to East China Normal University

description.zh-cn: 位于中国辽宁省大连市的一所公立大学，是大连理工大学的前身。它是中华人民共和国教育部直属的全国重点大学，同时也是“双一流A类”、“985工程”、“211工程”重点建设大学。
description.en: A public university located in Dalian, Liaoning, China, formerly Dalian University of Technology. It is a national key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, and also a key construction university of 'Double First-Class A', 'Project 985', and 'Project 211'.

description.zh-cn: 原辽宁省副省长，后因腐败被查处。
原公安部副部长，后因腐败被查处。
中华人民共和国湖北省下辖的县，是刘超英的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Hubei Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Liu Chaoying.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中校，曾任总参情报部五局副局长，中国航天国际控股有限公司经理。她是中央军事委员会副主席刘华清的女儿，也是1996年美国竞选财务丑闻的主要人物之一，并曾卷入赖昌星案。
description.en: A Lieutenant Colonel in the People's Liberation Army, former deputy director of the fifth bureau of the General Staff Intelligence Department, and manager of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd. She is the daughter of Liu Huaqing, former Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission. She was a key figure in the 1996 United States campaign finance controversy and was also implicated in the Lai Changxing case.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二十五军
en: 25th Army of the Chinese Red Army

description.zh-cn: 作为“北上抗日第二先遣队”，独立进行长征并最先到达陕北的红军部队。
description.en: As the 'Second Vanguard Detachment to Resist Japan in the North', it was the Red Army unit that independently undertook its own Long March and was the first to arrive in northern Shaanxi.

en: Three Rules of Discipline and Eight Points for Attention

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的军纪和行为准则，最初由毛泽东在1927年提出，内容在后续几年中逐步完善。其同名歌曲也广为流传。
description.en: The military discipline and code of conduct for the People's Liberation Army, first proposed by Mao Zedong in 1927 and gradually refined in subsequent years. A song of the same name is also widely known.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任红15军团政治部秘书长，参与编写《三大纪律八项注意》歌词。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who served as Secretary-General of the Political Department of the 15th Red Army Corps and participated in writing the lyrics for the song 'Three Rules of Discipline and Eight Points for Attention'.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战末期，中国人民解放军在西南地区对中华民国国军发起的大规模战役，宋希濂在此战役中被俘。
description.en: A large-scale campaign launched by the People's Liberation Army against the Republic of China Armed Forces in Southwest China at the end of the Second Chinese Civil War, during which Song Xilian was captured.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军大连舰艇学院
中国人民解放军北部战区海军
中国人民解放军海军北海舰队

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军三大舰队之一，现为中国人民解放军北部战区海军，亦称“中国人民解放军海军北海舰队”。
description.en: One of the three major fleets of the People's Liberation Army Navy, now known as the PLA Northern Theater Command Navy, also referred to as the North Sea Fleet of the PLA Navy.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第六机械工业部
中国航空母舰建造计划
中国共产党第十四届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: First Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 选举产生新一届中央领导机构。
description.en: Elected the new central leadership.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，刘超英的前夫。
description.en: Chinese politician and the ex-husband of Liu Chaoying.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的一支部队，黄公略于1930年调任该军军长。
description.en: A unit of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, to which Huang Gonglue was appointed commander in 1930.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二十二军

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军红一军团主力部队之一。
description.en: One of the main forces of the First Army Group of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕之女，陈毅之子陈小鲁的妻子。
description.en: Daughter of Su Yu and wife of Chen Xiaolu, son of Chen Yi.

description.zh-cn: 中国前驻英国大使

zh-cn: 大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国

description.zh-cn: 英国是位于西欧的岛屿主权国家，由英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰及北爱尔兰组成。近代，曾与清朝签订《南京条约》，并在鸦片战争后管治香港（1841-1997），包括新界（1898-1997）。第一次世界大战中，英国是协约国成员，其情报机构40号室曾破译齐默尔曼电报。军阀割据时期，曾支持直系军阀，并通过《日英同盟》成为日本盟友。第二次世界大战期间，英国是同盟国主要成员，与苏联、中华民国结盟，在东非击败意大利。孙立人曾在仁安羌之战中解救被围英军。作为加拿大前宗主国，两国在英联邦框架下保持密切关系。
description.en: The United Kingdom is a sovereign island state in Western Europe, comprising England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland. In modern times, it signed the Treaty of Nanking with the Qing dynasty and administered Hong Kong (1841-1997), including the New Territories (1898-1997), after the Opium War. During World War I, the UK was a member of the Allied Powers, and its intelligence agency, Room 40, deciphered the Zimmermann Telegram. During the Warlord Era, it supported the Zhili clique and became an ally of Japan through the Anglo-Japanese Alliance. In World War II, the UK was a principal member of the Allied Powers, allied with the Soviet Union and the Republic of China, and defeated Italy in East Africa. Sun Li-jen rescued besieged British troops in the Battle of Yenangyaung. As Canada's former colonial power, the two nations maintain close relations within the Commonwealth framework.

description.zh-cn: 中国最早实行对外开放政策的经济特区之一，也是林向荣的本籍地。
description.en: One of the first Special Economic Zones in China to implement the policy of opening up to the outside world, and also the native place of Lin Xiangrong.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共福建省委书记、甘肃省省长。蔡奇在其任职期间曾担任其秘书。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former Party Secretary of Fujian and Governor of Gansu Province. Cai Qi served as his secretary during his tenure.

zh-cn: 中国共产党福建省委员会
en: Fujian Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Fujian Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在福建省的领导机关。贾庆林曾任其书记。
description.en: The leading organ of the Chinese Communist Party in Fujian Province. Jia Qinglin served as its secretary.

location.zh-cn: 北京市大兴区西红门镇

description.zh-cn: 2017年11月18日发生于北京市大兴区西红门镇的一起重大火灾事故，造成19人死亡、8人受伤。该事件直接促使北京市领导层发起为期40天的安全隐患大排查大清理大整治专项行动。
description.en: A major fire incident that occurred on November 18, 2017, in Xihongmen Town, Daxing District, Beijing, resulting in 19 deaths and 8 injuries. The event directly prompted Beijing's leadership to launch a 40-day special campaign for large-scale investigation, clearance, and rectification of safety hazards.

description.zh-cn: 第十一届全国政协委员，中华孔子学会副会长，北京电影制片厂原导演。
中华人民共和国陕西省下辖的地级市，国家历史文化名城。它曾是中国共产党在1930年代的革命根据地，延安派成员曾在此活动。此外，这里也是林立衡的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China, and a national historical and cultural city. It served as a revolutionary base for the Chinese Communist Party in the 1930s, where members of the Yan'an faction were active. It is also the birthplace of Lin Liheng.

zh-cn: 北京师范大学附属实验中学
北京师范大学附属女子中学
en: Experimental High School Attached to Beijing Normal University
The Experimental High School Attached to Beijing Normal University
The High School Affiliated to Beijing Normal University

description.zh-cn: 宋彬彬就读的中学，也是卞仲耘遇难的地点。
description.en: The middle school that Song Binbin attended and the location where Bian Zhongyun was killed.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未曾于1978年入读的中国高等艺术教育院校。
description.en: An institution of higher art education in China where Ai Weiwei enrolled in 1978.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议第十一届全国委员会委员名单
中国人民政治协商会议第十一届全国委员会
第十一届全国政协委员
第十一届全国政协常务委员
en: 11th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议第十一届全国委员会会议，任期从2008年3月至2013年3月，包含其常务委员会的成员。
description.en: The 11th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, with a term from March 2008 to March 2013, which includes members of its Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，北洋军阀奉系首领。曾任中华民国陆海军大元帅、北洋政府末任国家元首。在张勋复辟事件中，他一方面被复辟朝廷任命为奉天巡抚和东三省总督，另一方面又作为北洋政府讨逆军指挥官之一参与平叛，体现了其在乱局中的投机立场。他与蒋介石协议驱逐共产国际势力，搜查苏联使馆并处决李大钊等共产党人。他非常信任和重用杨宇霆。作为张学良之父，他后在皇姑屯事件中被日军刺杀身亡。
description.en: A prominent military and political figure of the Republic of China and a leader of the Fengtian clique of the Beiyang Warlords. He served as Grand Marshal of the Army and Navy of the Republic of China and was the last head of state of the Beiyang Government. During the Zhang Xun Restoration, he was simultaneously appointed Governor of Fengtian and Governor-General of the Three Eastern Provinces by the restored Qing court, and participated in suppressing the rebellion as one of the commanders of the Beiyang Government's anti-restoration army, demonstrating his opportunistic stance amidst the chaos. He agreed with Chiang Kai-shek to expel Comintern influence, raided the Soviet embassy, and executed Li Dazhao and other communists. He highly trusted and valued Yang Yuting. As the father of Zhang Xueliang, he was later assassinated by the Japanese army in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国富商于文斗之女，张学良的原配妻子。在张学良的人生中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: Daughter of Chinese businessman Yu Wendou and the original wife of Zhang Xueliang. She played a significant role in Zhang Xueliang's life.

description.zh-cn: 张学良的夫人之一。
张学良的秘书和情妇，后成为其第二任妻子，长期陪伴其幽禁生活。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang's secretary and mistress, later his second wife, accompanying him throughout his long period of house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖原配妻子，张学良之母。
张学良的二弟。
张学良的四弟，早年即参加中国共产党，后成为中国人民解放军少将。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang's fourth younger brother, who joined the Communist Party of China in his early years and later became a Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 张学良的五弟。
中国军事人物，张作孚之子，张作霖之侄，张学良的堂弟。曾于奉天讲武堂和日本陆军大学学习。初在奉系军队任职，后投靠石友三，中原大战失败后又在九一八事变后投靠日军，被任命为东北自卫军总司令，最终因其投靠日本的国仇家恨而被张学良下令剿杀。
description.en: A Chinese military figure, son of Zhang Zuofu, nephew of Zhang Zuolin, and cousin of Zhang Xueliang. He studied at the Fengtian Military Academy and the Imperial Japanese Army Academy. He initially served in the Fengtian clique army, later defected to Shi Yousan, and after the defeat in the Central Plains War, he defected to the Japanese army after the Mukden Incident. He was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Self-Defense Army and was eventually killed on Zhang Xueliang's orders due to his collaboration with the Japanese, which was seen as a national betrayal.

description.zh-cn: 张学良与于凤至的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Zhang Xueliang and Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 张学良与于凤至的次子。
description.en: The second son of Zhang Xueliang and Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 张学良与于凤至的三子。
description.en: The third son of Zhang Xueliang and Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 张学良四子。
张学良与于凤至的长女。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Zhang Xueliang and Yu Fengzhi.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期位于奉天（今沈阳）的军事院校。张学成、张学良曾于1919年同期在此就读，赵家骧也毕业于此。
description.en: A military academy from the Republic of China era on the mainland, located in Fengtian (modern-day Shenyang). Zhang Xuecheng and Zhang Xueliang were classmates here in 1919, and Zhao Jiaxiang also graduated from it.

description.zh-cn: 奉系将领，张学良的恩师与挚友。1925年11月，因遭杨宇霆排挤等原因，在冯玉祥支持下起兵反奉，反对张作霖。兵败后被处决。
description.en: A Fengtian clique general, and a mentor and close friend of Zhang Xueliang. In November 1925, due to being sidelined by Yang Yuting and other reasons, he launched a rebellion against the Fengtian clique and Zhang Zuolin with Feng Yuxiang's support. He was defeated and executed.

death_place.zh-cn: 奉天省奉天市 (中华民国)
death_place.en: Fengtian City, Fengtian Province (Republic of China)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋军阀执政时期奉系军阀重要将领，有“智囊”、“小诸葛”之称。曾任奉军总参谋长、江苏省督办等职，且是东京振武学校校友。后因权力斗争，被奉系领袖张学良处决。
description.en: An important general of the Fengtian clique during the Beiyang government era of the Republic of China, known as the 'mastermind' and 'little Zhuge'. He served as Chief of Staff of the Fengtian Army and Governor of Jiangsu Province, and was an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. He was later executed by Fengtian clique leader Zhang Xueliang due to a power struggle.

description.zh-cn: 奉系军阀高级官员，中华民国政治人物，曾任黑龙江省政府主席。后与杨宇霆一同被张学良处决。
description.en: A high-ranking official of the Fengtian clique and a political figure of the Republic of China. He served as the chairman of the Heilongjiang provincial government. He was later executed along with Yang Yuting by Zhang Xueliang.

description.zh-cn: 1928年6月4日，日本关东军在沈阳皇姑屯策划并实施了一起针对奉系军阀首领张作霖的暗杀爆炸事件，导致其死亡。此事件是九一八事变的重要背景。
description.en: On June 4, 1928, the Japanese Kwantung Army orchestrated and carried out an assassination bombing in Huanggutun, Shenyang, targeting Fengtian clique warlord leader Zhang Zuolin, which resulted in his death. This incident was a significant precursor to the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 该部队是大日本帝国陆军的一支重要部队，于1919年至1945年驻扎在中国东北地区（满洲）。它策划并执行了皇姑屯事件、九一八事变，扶植满洲国。其下属包括臭名昭著的731部队（防疫给水部）。该部队最终在苏联发动的“八月风暴”攻势下投降。
description.en: A major army group of the Imperial Japanese Army, stationed in Northeast China (Manchuria) from 1919 to 1945. It planned and executed the Huanggutun Incident and the Mukden Incident, and established the puppet state of Manchukuo. The infamous Unit 731 (Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department) was one of its subordinate units. The army ultimately surrendered following the Soviet 'August Storm' offensive.

description.zh-cn: 指1928年12月29日，统治中国东北的奉系将领张学良宣布东北地区服从国民政府，并将北洋政府的五色旗更换为国民政府的青天白日满地红旗的事件。此举标志着北伐战争的结束、北洋政府的终结和中国在名义上的统一。杨宇霆对此表示坚决反对，日本也因此表示不满。
description.en: Refers to the event on December 29, 1928, when Zhang Xueliang, the leader of the Fengtian clique ruling Northeast China, announced the region's allegiance to the Nationalist Government and replaced the Beiyang government's Five-Colored Flag with the Nationalist Government's Blue Sky, White Sun, and Wholly Red Earth flag. This marked the end of the Northern Expedition, the Beiyang government, and the nominal unification of China. Yang Yuting was firmly opposed to this, and Japan also expressed dissatisfaction.

description.zh-cn: 1931年9月18日，日本关东军在中国东北蓄意制造并发动侵华战争，进攻沈阳并侵占东北全境。此事件标志着日本帝国主义侵华的开端，被视为十四年抗战的开始。东北军在中原大战后入关导致关外防务空虚，加之其在中东路事件中的溃败，在一定程度上促成了此次军事入侵。
description.en: On September 18, 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army deliberately launched an invasion in Northeast China, attacking Shenyang and occupying the entire region. This incident marked the beginning of Japanese imperialist aggression in China and is considered the start of the Fourteen-Year War of Resistance Against Japan. The Northeast Army's entry into the region south of the Great Wall after the Central Plains War left Manchuria defensively vulnerable, and its defeat in the Sino-Soviet conflict (Chinese Eastern Railway Incident) partly contributed to this military invasion.

zh-cn: 国民革命军东北边防军

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军东北边防军，原为奉系军阀张作霖、张学良父子统帅的军队。1928年东北易帜后被国民政府改编，是中华民国时期驻扎于中国东北地区的主要军事力量，主要由张学良领导。该军队曾是中东路事件中与苏军作战的主力。九一八事变后，其部队退入关内，最终在西安事变后被分化瓦解。
description.en: The Northeastern Border Defense Army of the National Revolutionary Army was originally the army commanded by the Fengtian clique warlords Zhang Zuolin and his son Zhang Xueliang. After the Northeast Flag Replacement in 1928, it was reorganized by the Nationalist Government. It was a primary military force based in Northeast China during the Republic of China era, primarily led by Zhang Xueliang. The army was the main force that fought against the Soviet army in the Sino-Soviet conflict (Sino-Eastern Railway Incident). After the Mukden Incident, its troops withdrew inside the Shanhai Pass and were eventually disintegrated after the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 奉系军阀是民国军阀时期的主要派系，属于北洋军阀系统，以张作霖为首。该集团以奉天省为中心，先后由张作霖及其子张学良领导，杨宇霆是其重要将领。他们曾参与讨伐张勋复辟的行动，并长期控制中国东北地区，曾受日本支持。1928年东北易帜后，该派系改称东北军。
description.en: The Fengtian warlord clique was a major faction during the Warlord Era of the Republic of China, belonging to the Beiyang warlord system, led by Zhang Zuolin. Centered in Fengtian Province, the group was successively led by Zhang Zuolin and his son Zhang Xueliang, with Yang Yuting as a key general. They participated in the campaign against Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration and long controlled Northeast China, with Japanese support. After the Northeast Flag Replacement in 1928, the faction was renamed the Northeastern Army.

description.zh-cn: 夏威夷州的首府及最大都市。
description.en: The capital and largest city of the state of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 溥杰的前妻。
贝尼托·墨索里尼的女儿。

death_place.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾台北市北投区台北荣民总医院

description.zh-cn: 中华民国农业经济学家与政治人物，曾任中华民国第七、八、九任总统及中国国民党主席。他是中华民国首位台湾籍与首位公民直选产生的国家元首。任内推动“宁静革命”，展开全面的民主化改革，被誉为“台湾民主之父”和民主化重要推手。他于1991年宣布结束动员戡乱时期。其政治立场从青年时期加入中国共产党，到成为国民党主流派，卸任后成为台湾本土派精神领袖。他提出的“两国论”和“中华民国在台湾”等概念，深刻影响了台湾政治走向及两岸关系。
description.en: A Taiwanese agricultural economist and politician, he served as the 7th, 8th, and 9th President of the Republic of China and Chairman of the Kuomintang. He was the first native Taiwanese and the first popularly elected head of state in the ROC. During his tenure, he promoted the 'Quiet Revolution' and comprehensive democratic reforms, earning him the titles 'Father of Taiwan's Democracy' and a key figure in democratization. In 1991, he announced the end of the Temporary Provisions Effective During the Period of Communist Rebellion. His political stance evolved from joining the Chinese Communist Party in his youth to becoming a mainstream figure within the KMT, and eventually becoming the spiritual leader of Taiwan's localization movement after leaving office. He proposed concepts such as the 'two-state theory' and 'Republic of China in Taiwan,' profoundly influencing Taiwan's political direction and cross-strait relations.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总装备部

General Armaments Department of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 曾是中国人民解放军的四大总部之一，也是中央军事委员会主管全军装备工作的最高统率机关。该机关负责解放军的武器装备工作。已于2016年军事改革中被撤销，后被中央军委装备发展部取代。
description.en: Formerly one of the four general headquarters of the PLA, it was the supreme command organ under the Central Military Commission responsible for the entire military's equipment work. It was abolished during the 2016 military reforms and later replaced by the Equipment Development Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 张又侠之兄，原中国长城工业公司总裁、研究员。

description.en: A former group army corps of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force, previously under the Chengdu Military Region.

中国人民解放军第13集团军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军已撤销的集团军番号，原隶属于成都军区。该集团军曾是解放军陆军下属单位，王西欣曾在此长期服役并担任军长。
description.en: A former group army of the People's Liberation Army, previously under the Chengdu Military Region. This group army was once a unit under the PLA Ground Force, where Wang Xixin served for a long time and held the position of corps commander.

description.en: One of the seven former military regions of the People's Liberation Army, it was primarily responsible for the defense of the capital, Beijing. Wu Lie concurrently served as its deputy political commissar. After the 2016 military reform, some of its units were reassigned to the newly formed Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军第二炮兵部队政治委员、成都军区政治委员等职。其父为原中央军委副主席张震上将。
description.en: A general (shangjiang) of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) of China, who served as Political Commissar of the PLA Second Artillery Force and the Chengdu Military Region. His father is Zhang Zhen, a former Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 李克强之姊。
北京大学法学教授，李克强在北大学习期间的导师。
description.en: A professor of law at Peking University and Li Keqiang's mentor during his studies there.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，北京大学经济学教授，曾任北京大学光华管理学院院长。他是李克强的博士生导师，也是李源潮的硕士导师。
description.en: A Chinese economist and professor of economics at Peking University, he also served as the former dean of the Guanghua School of Management at Peking University. He was Li Keqiang's doctoral advisor and Li Yuanchao's master's thesis advisor.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市下辖的市辖区，是中国的国家级新区、综合配套改革试验区和社会主义现代化建设引领区。

美国政治人物，第44任美国总统，乔治·沃克·布什的继任者。他出生于夏威夷，其政府曾否决“刘晓波广场”决议案，也曾对夏威夷州通过同性婚姻法案表示赞赏。
description.en: American politician, the 44th President of the United States, and successor to George W. Bush. Born in Hawaii, his administration vetoed the 'Liu Xiaobo Plaza' resolution and he praised Hawaii's passage of the same-sex marriage bill.

description.zh-cn: 四川省的一个县，吴玉章的出生地。

晚清时期由清政府部分官员推动的自强运动，以“师夷长技以制夷”、“自强”、“求富”为口号。旨在引进西方军事装备、机器生产和科学技术，以维护清朝统治，是清朝晚期的一场现代化运动。奕䜣是其主要发起者和领导者之一。第二次鸦片战争的失败是其直接诱因之一。
description.en: A self-strengthening movement in the late Qing dynasty, promoted by some government officials under the slogans 'Learn the barbarians' superior technology in order to control them,' 'self-strengthening,' and 'seeking wealth.' It aimed to introduce Western military equipment, machine production, and scientific technology to maintain Qing rule, and was a modernization movement in the late Qing. Yixin was one of its primary initiators and leaders. The defeat in the Second Opium War was one of its direct triggers.

description.zh-cn: 四川大学最早的前身机构，现为中华人民共和国教育部直属的全国重点大学，一所综合性研究型大学，国家“双一流”、“985工程”、“211工程”重点建设高校。位于中国四川省成都市，曾与香港理工大学合作成立灾后重建与管理学院。
description.en: Sichuan University, originally one of the earliest predecessor institutions, is now a national key comprehensive research university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, and a key institution under the 'Double First-Class', '985 Project', and '211 Project'. Located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China, it once collaborated with The Hong Kong Polytechnic University to establish the Institute for Disaster Management and Reconstruction.

description.en: A university located in Tianjin, co-founded by the People's Government of Hebei Province, the People's Government of Tianjin Municipality, and the Ministry of Education. It is also Jia Qinglin's alma mater.

description.zh-cn: 中国山东省下辖地级市，范丞丞的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Shandong Province, China, and the birthplace of Fan Chengcheng.

description.zh-cn: 发生于1990年代，中华人民共和国建国以来最大的经济犯罪案件之一。核心人物为赖昌星。该案爆发时，贾庆林正在福建省任职，因此引发了关于他是否涉案的争议。
description.en: One of the biggest economic crime cases since the founding of the People's Republic of China, which occurred in the 1990s. The central figure was Lai Changxing. When the case broke out, Jia Qinglin was serving in Fujian Province, sparking controversy over his potential involvement.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人，厦门远华特大走私案主犯。他曾声称与贾庆林有过来往。
description.en: Chinese businessman and the main culprit in the massive Xiamen Yuanhua smuggling case. He claimed to have had dealings with Jia Qinglin.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于香港的华语电视台。曾专访贾庆林的妻子林幼芳，她在采访中否认了与远华案的关联。
description.en: A Chinese-language television network headquartered in Hong Kong. It conducted an exclusive interview with Jia Qinglin's wife, Lin Youfang, in which she denied any connection to the Yuanhua case.

description.en: A Chinese multinational conglomerate founded by Wang Jianlin, headquartered in Beijing. Its business interests cover multiple fields including commercial property, culture, finance, and information technology. Reportedly, Jia Qinglin's family holds its shares.

description.zh-cn: 贾庆林的女儿，李伯潭的妻子，李紫丹的母亲。

description.en: Jia Qinglin's son-in-law, Chairman of Beijing Zhaode Real Estate.

description.zh-cn: 贾庆林的外孙女，毕业于斯坦福大学。曾因参加巴黎成人礼和涉及巴拿马文件泄漏事件而受到媒体关注。
description.en: Jia Qinglin's granddaughter, a graduate of Stanford University. She received media attention for participating in the Bal des débutantes in Paris and for her involvement in the Panama Papers leak.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州斯坦福的私立研究型大学。Google的两位创始人曾在此攻读博士并开始研究项目。该校在学术和体育上与伯克利大学、南加州大学均有竞争关系。张孝骞也曾在此进行研究。
description.en: A private research university located in Stanford, California, USA. The two founders of Google pursued their Ph.D. studies and started their research projects here. The university has academic and athletic rivalries with both the University of California, Berkeley, and the University of Southern California. Zhang Xiaoqian also conducted research here.

description.zh-cn: 贾庆林的长子。
description.en: Jia Qinglin's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 贾庆林的兄弟。
description.en: Jia Qinglin's brother.

description.zh-cn: 2016年发生的一批大规模全球性机密文件泄露事件，揭示了多国政要、名人及全球权贵如何利用离岸公司进行避税等财务操作。文件中提及了贾庆林的外孙女李紫丹、李小琳及其丈夫等重要人物。
description.en: A massive global leak of confidential documents occurred in 2016, revealing how politicians, celebrities, and global elites from multiple countries used offshore companies for tax avoidance and other financial operations. The documents named key figures such as Jia Qinglin's granddaughter Li Zidan, and Li Xiaolin and her husband.

description.en: A public university in Palmerston North, New Zealand, with campuses in Wellington and Auckland. It is named in memory of former New Zealand Prime Minister William Ferguson Massey.

description.zh-cn: 金正日，朝鲜民主主义人民共和国第二代最高领导人，金日成长子，金平一同父异母兄。他是金正哲、金正恩、金与正、金正男和金雪松的父亲。其出生地存在争议，苏联解密文件称其于1941年出生于苏联哈巴罗夫斯克附近的维亚茨科耶军营，而朝鲜官方则声称其于1942年出生于两江道三池渊郡的白头山密营。他曾任朝鲜劳动党总书记，被追封为“朝鲜劳动党永远的总书记”。任内曾与韩国总统卢武铉举行首脑会谈。
description.en: Kim Jong Il, the second supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, the eldest son of Kim Il-sung, and the half-brother of Kim Pyong-il. He is the father of Kim Jong-chul, Kim Jong-un, Kim Yo-jong, Kim Jong-nam, and Kim Sol-song. His birthplace is disputed; declassified Soviet documents state he was born in 1941 in a military camp in Vyatskoye near Khabarovsk, USSR, while North Korean official sources claim he was born in 1942 in a secret camp on Mount Paektu in Samjiyon County, Ryanggang Province. He served as General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and was posthumously honored as 'Eternal General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea'. During his tenure, he held a summit meeting with South Korean President Roh Moo-hyun.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国音乐家、歌唱家、声乐教育家，满族人。曾任中国音乐学院教授、院长，中国音乐家协会副主席。他曾是宋祖英的老师，黎明也曾跟他学习乐理和发声技巧。
description.en: A Chinese musician, singer, and vocal educator of Manchu ethnicity. He served as a professor and later President of the China Conservatory of Music, and Vice Chairman of the Chinese Musicians' Association. He was the teacher of Song Zuying, and Leon Lai also learned music theory and vocal techniques from him.

description.zh-cn: 联合国的专门机构，负责国际公共卫生事务，是国际公共卫生领域的领导者。

description.en: The first university in the United States, founded by Puritans, it is a private Ivy League research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts. The university repeatedly proposed merging with MIT and awarded Wong Kar-wai an honorary Doctor of Arts. Xi Mingze also attended the university, earning a Bachelor of Arts degree and pursuing graduate studies there.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国教育部
en: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管教育事业和语言文字工作的组成部门，负责全国教育事业和语言文字工作。它主管华中科技大学、厦门大学、清华大学等高校，并于1952年决定创办北京体育大学（时称中央体育学院）。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for overseeing the country's education sector and language-related work. It supervises universities such as Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Xiamen University, and Tsinghua University. In 1952, it also decided to establish Beijing Sport University (then Central Institute of Physical Culture).

zh-cn: 中国2010年上海世界博览会

description.zh-cn: 2010年世界博览会。
description.en: The 2010 World Expo.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，曾任法国总统。
description.en: A French politician who served as President of France.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第四任及第七任首相，被称为“马来西亚现代化之父”。慕沙希淡在其第一个任期内担任副首相。他曾是安华的政治导师，后成为其主要政治对手，在1998年将其革职；两人后来在2018年结盟推翻国阵政府，但联盟因2020年政治危机而破裂。其提出的“多媒体超级走廊”启发了马云。他对“一带一路”的态度从初期的批评和重新谈判转变为后期的支持。
description.en: Fourth and seventh Prime Minister of Malaysia, known as the "Father of Modernization of Malaysia". Musa Hitam served as his Deputy Prime Minister during his first term. He was once Anwar's political mentor before becoming his main political rival, dismissing him in 1998; the two later allied in 2018 to overthrow the Barisan Nasional government, but the alliance collapsed during the 2020 political crisis. His 'Multimedia Super Corridor' initiative inspired Jack Ma. His stance on the 'Belt and Road' initiative evolved from initial criticism and renegotiation to later support.

description.zh-cn: 原中国人民解放军将领、海军上将，曾任中共中央军事委员会委员、中华人民共和国中央军事委员会委员、中央军委政治工作部主任。2024年起因涉嫌严重违纪违法被调查，后被开除党籍军籍。
description.en: Former general and admiral of the People's Liberation Army Navy, who served as a member of the Central Military Commission and Director of the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission. He was investigated for suspected serious violations of discipline and law starting in 2024, and was later expelled from the Party and the military.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领。曾任中共上海市委常委。
中国人民解放军高级将领。
中国人民解放军高级将领。
中国人民解放军陆军上将。曾任中国人民解放军中部战区陆军副司令员、西部战区司令员，现任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: General of the PLA Ground Force. He served as the deputy commander of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force and commander of the Western Theater Command, and is currently the Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领。
中国人民解放军高级将领。
中国人民解放军高级将领。
何卫东的祖籍地。

中国人民解放军南京军区军政干部学校
中国人民解放军南京陆军指挥学院
中国人民解放军南京高级步兵学校
中国人民解放军南京高级陆军学校
中国人民解放军总高级步兵学校
华东军区军事政治大学

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军的军事院校，是培养陆军指挥人才、合成军队军官的中级指挥院校，曾归中国人民解放军总参谋部建制。王西欣曾在此获得本科学历。
description.en: A military academy of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force. It is an intermediate command academy for training army command talents and officers of combined arms, once under the establishment of the PLA General Staff Department. Wang Xixin obtained his bachelor's degree here.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军合成第九十一旅
en: 91st Motorized Infantry Division (People's Republic of China)

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七十三集团军
中国人民解放军第三十一军
中国人民解放军陆军第三十一集团军
en: 31st Group Army of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军的一个集团军，2017年改革后番号改为第七十三集团军。
description.en: A group army of the PLA Ground Force, which was redesignated as the 73rd Group Army after the 2017 reforms.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军合成第八十六旅
en: 86th Motorized Infantry Division (People's Republic of China)

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军江苏省军区
中国人民解放军上海警备区
中国人民解放军西部战区陆军
第十三届全国人民代表大会
十三届全国人大一次会议
第十三届全国人大代表
en: First Session of the 13th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第十三届国家最高权力机关。
description.en: The 13th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期成员、高层领导人，中华人民共和国政治人物，一二·九运动的组织和指挥者之一。俞强声之父，范瑾的丈夫。曾任中华人民共和国首任天津市市长、第一任第一机械工业部部长，并曾与江青同居。
description.en: An early member and high-ranking leader of the Communist Party of China, a politician of the People's Republic of China, and one of the organizers and commanders of the December 9th Movement. He was the father of Yu Qiangsheng and husband of Fan Jin. He served as the first mayor of Tianjin and the first minister of the First Ministry of Machine Building, and once cohabited with Jiang Qing.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育部直属的综合性全国重点大学，是世界一流大学建设高校（A类）、985工程、211工程重点建设高校。该校历史悠久，可追溯至多个前身，且有机构于1951年与之合校。
曾任交通部陇海铁路局局长。俞强声祖父。
原中共天津地委副书记、行署专员，在三反五反运动中因贪污罪被处决。
明朝的京师地区，即今北京市，是于谦的逝世地。在清代，它作为北京地区的行政区划名称。
description.en: The capital region of the Ming Dynasty, now Beijing, was the place where Yu Qian died. It also served as the administrative name for the Beijing area during the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 潜伏于美国中央情报局的中华人民共和国间谍。
中国商人，湖北人，企业家。他是齐桥桥的第二任丈夫，习近平的姐夫，习明泽的姑父。其个人信息曾在“恶俗维基”案中被泄露。
description.en: Chinese businessman and entrepreneur from Hubei. He is the second husband of Qi Qiaoqiao, brother-in-law of Xi Jinping, and uncle of Xi Mingze. His personal information was previously leaked in the 'Esuwiki case'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国福建省的省会，下辖的地级市，国家区域中心城市，位于福建省东部的闽江下游。它是福建省的政治、经济、文化、交通中心，也是习明泽和黄贤模的出生地。
description.en: The capital and a prefecture-level city under the jurisdiction of Fujian Province, People's Republic of China. It is a national regional central city, located in the lower reaches of the Min River in eastern Fujian Province. It serves as the province's political, economic, cultural, and transportation center, and is also the birthplace of Xi Mingze and Huang Xianmo.

description.zh-cn: 习明泽曾就读的幼儿园。
description.en: The kindergarten that Xi Mingze once attended.

description.zh-cn: 习明泽曾就读的初中及高中。
description.en: The middle and high school that Xi Mingze once attended.

description.zh-cn: “恶俗维基”案主犯。该案涉及的恶俗维基是一个引发争议的信息分享网站，曾泄露包括习近平女儿习明泽等在内的中国高层公职人员及其家属的个人信息。他因主导泄露这些信息被重判14年，该网站相关人员也因此被判刑。
description.en: The main person implicated in the 'Esuwiki case'. EsuWiki, a controversial information-sharing website involved in the case, leaked personal information of high-level Chinese public officials and their families, including Xi Jinping's daughter, Xi Mingze. He was sentenced to 14 years in prison for his role in leaking this information, and other related personnel of the website were also sentenced.

zh-cn: 伦敦大学布鲁内尔学院

description.zh-cn: 位于英国伦敦的一所世界顶尖公立研究型大学。
description.en: A world-leading public research university located in London, United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党、中华人民共和国政治人物。现任中共上海市委副书记，上海市人民政府市长、党组书记。曾任夏宝龙担任浙江省省长时的常务副省长，山东省省长、杭州市委书记等职。是刘鹤的妹夫。
description.en: A political figure in the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China. He is currently the Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee and Mayor of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government. He previously served as Executive Vice Governor when Xia Baolong was Governor of Zhejiang, Governor of Shandong, and Secretary of the CPC Hangzhou Municipal Committee, among other positions. He is the brother-in-law of Liu He.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国江苏省苏州市
birth_place.en: Suzhou, Jiangsu, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，陈吉宁的继任北京市市长。
中国政治人物，陈吉宁的前任中华人民共和国环境保护部部长。
中国政治人物，曾任清华大学党委书记，现任中共中央宣传部常务副部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, previously served as Secretary of the Party Committee of Tsinghua University, and currently serves as the Executive Deputy Head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任清华大学党委书记。
中国物理学家、教育家，曾任清华大学校长。自2012年2月起担任清华大学高等研究院院长，同时也是该院教员。
description.en: A Chinese physicist and educator, former president of Tsinghua University. He has served as the Dean of the Institute for Advanced Study at Tsinghua University since February 2012 and is also a faculty member.

description.zh-cn: 中国化学家，曾任清华大学校长，现任清华大学党委书记。
description.en: A Chinese chemist, former President of Tsinghua University, and currently serving as the Communist Party Secretary of Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 中国工程院院士，环境工程专家。

zh-cn: 柴静雾霾调查：穹顶之下 同呼吸 共命运

description.zh-cn: 由媒体人柴静于2015年2月底推出的一部关于中国空气污染的调查纪录片。该片最初在官方媒体平台播出后，引发了社会巨大反响，但很快遭到中共中央宣传部全面封杀。
description.en: An investigative documentary about air pollution in China, released by journalist Chai Jing in late February 2015. After its initial broadcast on official media platforms, it sparked widespread public discussion but was soon completely banned by the Propaganda Department of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国记者、主持人、独立媒体人，也是《穹顶之下》纪录片的制作人、主讲人和调查记者。
description.en: Chinese journalist and media personality, who produced, hosted, and conducted the investigation for the documentary 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 国际奥林匹克委员会主席。
description.en: President of the International Olympic Committee.

zh-cn: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦

description.zh-cn: 巴西左翼政治家，巴西劳工党创始成员，曾于2003年至2010年担任巴西第35任总统，并于2023年起再次担任第39任总统。他是巴西历史上第一位工人出身的总统。2010年，他曾与巴沙尔·阿萨德会面。
description.en: A Brazilian left-wing politician and founding member of the Workers' Party, who served as the 35th President of Brazil from 2003 to 2010 and began his term as the 39th President in 2023. He is the first working-class president in Brazilian history. In 2010, he met with Bashar al-Assad.

description.zh-cn: 委内瑞拉总统。
美国国会参议院多数党领袖。
新加坡政治人物，现任新加坡国务资政。他曾于2004年至2024年担任新加坡总理，并于同期担任人民行动党秘书长。他是何晶的丈夫。
description.en: Singaporean politician, current Senior Minister of Singapore. He served as Prime Minister of Singapore from 2004 to 2024 and concurrently as Secretary-General of the People's Action Party. He is the husband of Ho Ching.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁的妻子，在陈水扁的政治生涯中扮演重要角色。因车祸导致下半身瘫痪，后亦因多起弊案被判刑。
description.en: Wife of Chen Shui-bian, who played a significant role in his political career. She became paralyzed from the waist down after a car accident and was later convicted in multiple corruption cases.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁与吴淑珍的女儿。
description.en: The daughter of Chen Shui-bian and Wu Shu-chen.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁与吴淑珍的儿子。
description.en: The son of Chen Shui-bian and Wu Shu-chen.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁的弟弟
中华民国（台湾）主要政党之一，于1986年戒严时期由党外运动人士创立。陈水扁为其创始党员，并曾多次担任党主席，代表该党当选中华民国总统。萧美琴亦为其党员。该党于2000年首次取得执政权，目前是卓荣泰内阁的执政党。作为泛绿阵营的代表，它是蓝白合作的主要政治对手，并曾支持罢免泛蓝公职人员。此外，该党主张修宪废除考试院及监察院。
description.en: One of the major political parties in the Republic of China (Taiwan), founded by Tangwai movement activists in 1986 during the martial law period. Chen Shui-bian was a founding member, served as its chairman multiple times, and was elected President of the Republic of China as its candidate. Hsiao Bi-khim is also a member. The party first came to power in 2000 and is currently the ruling party of the Cho Jung-tai cabinet. As the representative of the Pan-Green Coalition, it is the primary political opponent of the Blue-White Cooperation, and has supported the recall of Pan-Blue public officials. Furthermore, the party advocates for constitutional amendments to abolish the Examination Yuan and the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政党，于2019年成立。陈水扁曾被该党列为不分区立委候选人，但遭中选会取消资格。该党在2020年选举失利后解散。
description.en: A Taiwanese political party founded in 2019. Chen Shui-bian was listed as its non-constituency legislative candidate but was disqualified by the Central Election Commission. The party dissolved after failing in the 2020 election.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台北市的顶尖国立研究型大学，前身为台北帝国大学。张纯如的父母张绍进和张盈盈曾在此学习或任教；陈明通在此获得学士、硕士和博士学位并长期任教；吴敦义毕业于其历史学系；陈水扁亦在此获得法学士学位。
description.en: A top national research university located in Taipei, Taiwan, formerly known as Taihoku Imperial University. Iris Chang's parents, Chang Shao-chin and Chang Ying-ying, studied or taught here. Chen Ming-tong received his bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees and served as a long-term faculty member. Wu Den-yih graduated from its Department of History, and Chen Shui-bian also obtained his Bachelor of Laws degree from here.

description.zh-cn: 1979年12月10日，台湾高雄市发生了一场重大警民冲突事件。该事件发生于戒严时期，由施明德担任总指挥。事件后，中华民国政府对党外运动人士进行了大规模逮捕和审判。在此次审判中，陈水扁作为辩护律师团成员参与，成为其投身政坛的重要契机。此次事件对台湾之后的民主化进程有重要影响。
description.en: On December 10, 1979, a major police-citizen conflict occurred in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. This incident took place during the martial law period and was led by Shih Ming-teh as general commander. Following the event, the Republic of China government conducted mass arrests and trials of Tangwai movement activists. In these trials, Chen Shui-bian participated as a member of the defense counsel, which became a significant opportunity for him to enter politics. This event had a significant impact on Taiwan's subsequent democratization process.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，党外运动的代表人物之一。他的政见演说启发了陈水扁弃商从法，他也是美丽岛事件的主要被告之一，后支持陈水扁参选总统。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and a representative figure of the Tangwai movement. His political speeches inspired Chen Shui-bian to switch from business to law. He was one of the main defendants in the Kaohsiung Incident and later supported Chen Shui-bian's presidential campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院院长。在陈明通首次担任陆委会主委期间，是其上司。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as Premier of the Executive Yuan. He was Chen Ming-tong's superior during Chen's first term as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，民主进步党创党党员之一。曾任行政院长、民主进步党主席。他曾与江鹏坚角逐台北市长提名，后为其辩护；并在1998年高雄市长选举中击败寻求连任的吴敦义。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China and one of the founding members of the Democratic Progressive Party. He has served as Premier and Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party. He once competed with Chiang Peng-chien for the Taipei mayoral nomination and later defended him; and defeated Wu Den-yih, who was seeking re-election, in the 1998 Kaohsiung mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾两度担任行政院院长、民主进步党主席，是陈明通在两届陆委会主委任内的上司。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served two terms as Premier of the Executive Yuan. He was Chen Ming-tong's superior during both of Chen's tenures as Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

en: President of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国家元首的官职，统率全国陆海空军。例如，陈水扁于2000年至2008年担任第10、11任总统。
description.en: The official position of the head of state of the Republic of China, commanding the national army, navy, and air force. For example, Chen Shui-bian served as the 10th and 11th president from 2000 to 2008.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，于陈水扁总统任内担任副总统。她曾出席蒋方良告别式并致意。
description.en: An ROC politician who served as Vice President during Chen Shui-bian's presidency. She once attended Jiang Fangliang's funeral to pay respects.

en: Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党的最高领导人职位。
description.en: The highest leadership position in the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台北市的最高行政首长。陈水扁于1994年至1998年担任第一届民选市长。
description.en: The chief executive of Taipei City, Republic of China. Chen Shui-bian served as the first directly elected mayor from 1994 to 1998.

en: Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China
Legislator of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国（台湾）的最高立法机关，由其成员组成。现负责对监察委员人事案行使同意权，并在第十一届立法院中，蓝白两党合作成为主导议事运作的关键力量。此外，它曾通过决议要求中国停止镇压法轮功，并谴责强摘法轮功等良心犯器官的行为。
description.en: The highest legislative body of the Republic of China (Taiwan), functioning as a unicameral legislature composed of its members. It currently holds the power to approve nominations for the Control Yuan, and in the 11th Legislative Yuan, the Blue-White cooperation has become a key force dominating legislative operations. Additionally, it has passed resolutions demanding that China stop the suppression of Falun Gong and condemning the forced organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners and other prisoners of conscience.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台北市的最高立法机关台北市议会的成员。
description.en: Members of the Taipei City Council, the highest legislative body in Taipei, Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台北市市长。
中华民国政治人物、媒体人，新党的共同创始人之一。
description.en: A politician and media person of the Republic of China, one of the co-founders of the New Party.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领、政治人物。曾任中国国民党副主席、行政院院长、国防部部长、参谋总长、中华民国陆军一级上将。李登辉任命其为国防部长，实际上削弱了其军权。他曾在蒋方良告别式上为其灵柩覆盖国旗。在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》中，其角色原型为“楚长青”，描述其与李登辉掌权后的国民党理念不合。
description.en: A military general and political figure of the Republic of China. He served as Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang, Premier of the Executive Yuan, Minister of National Defense, Chief of the General Staff, and a First Class General of the Republic of China Army. Lee Teng-hui appointed him Minister of National Defense, a move that effectively diminished his military power. He covered Jiang Fangliang's coffin with the national flag at her funeral. In the TV series 'Island Nation 2', his prototype character 'Chu Chang-qing' is depicted as having ideological differences with the KMT under Lee Teng-hui's leadership.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国（台湾）政治人物。曾任民主进步党主席、桃园县县长，后被监察院弹劾。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan). He formerly served as the Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party and the Magistrate of Taoyuan County, and was later impeached by the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国空军一级上将，曾任陈水扁总统任内首位行政院院长，后因核四存废争议辞职。
description.en: A General of the Air Force, ROCAF, who served as the first Premier under President Chen Shui-bian. He later resigned over disputes concerning the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任行政院院长、民主进步党主席。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who has served as Premier of the Republic of China and Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 2004年总统大选前一天，候选人陈水扁与吕秀莲在台南市扫街时发生的枪击事件，事件对选举结果造成争议性影响。
description.en: A shooting incident that occurred on the eve of the 2004 presidential election, targeting candidates Chen Shui-bian and Annette Lu during a campaign rally in Tainan. The event controversially impacted the election results.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁提出的政治主张，认为台湾与中国是两个互不隶属的主权独立国家。他在总统任内积极推动此概念。
description.en: A political proposition put forward by Chen Shui-bian, asserting that Taiwan and China are two mutually independent sovereign states. He actively promoted this concept during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 一项政治与社会运动，主张将中华民国的称谓改为台湾。
国家统一委员会的简称。
国家统一纲领的简称。
台湾革命家、政治家和作家，曾任民主进步党主席，被誉为“台湾曼德拉”。他曾于2001年与访问台湾的魏京生会晤，陈明通也曾参加其有关两岸原则的记者会。此外，他还曾指控江鹏坚为调查局卧底，并于2006年发起百万人民反贪倒扁运动。
description.en: A Taiwanese revolutionary, politician, and writer, former chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party, known as 'Taiwan's Mandela'. He met with Wei Jingsheng during his visit to Taiwan in 2001, and Chen Ming-tong also attended his press conference regarding cross-strait principles. Additionally, he once accused Chiang Peng-chien of being an undercover agent for the Investigation Bureau and initiated the 'Million Voices Against Corruption, President Chen Must Go' movement in 2006.

zh-cn: 百万人民反贪倒扁运动
en: Million Voices Against Corruption, President Chen Must Go

description.zh-cn: 由前民进党主席施明德发起的政治运动，诉求总统陈水扁因弊案下台。
description.en: A political movement initiated by former DPP chairman Shih Ming-teh, demanding President Chen Shui-bian's resignation over corruption scandals.

description.zh-cn: 台湾华人诺贝尔化学奖得主，曾任中央研究院院长，毕业于伯克利。
description.en: Chinese Nobel laureate in Chemistry, an alumnus of Berkeley.

一件涉及陈水扁在总统任内，被控收受贿赂协助特定企业收购土地并纳入科学园区的贪污案件，为此案陈水扁遭判刑定谳。
description.en: A corruption case in which Chen Shui-bian, during his presidency, was accused of accepting bribes to help a specific company acquire land and have it included in a science park. Chen was convicted and sentenced for this case.

description.en: A municipality directly under the Central Government of the People's Republic of China. It is the birthplace of Xia Baolong, Ai Yuejin, and Wei Heling, and the place of death of Ai Yuejin and Ruan Shiyi. Zhang Xuecheng fled here after Shi Yousan's forces were defeated in the Central Plains War. Li Ruihuan served as a long-term leader here.

一所位于北京的高等学校，于1965年由外交学院分出建立。俞强声曾在此就读。
description.en: A higher education institution located in Beijing, established in 1965 after splitting from China Foreign Affairs University. Yu Qiangsheng was one of its alumni.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政院的已裁撤机关。
中华民国政治人物、法学学者、教授与律师，民主进步党籍。曾任中华民国第14、15任总统、行政院大陆委员会主任委员、民主进步党主席等职务。在总统任内，她任命萧美琴为国家安全会议咨询委员及驻美代表；并谴责香港民主派初选大搜捕，指出北京当局彻底毁弃了“五十年不变”的承诺。她曾是陈明通在国家安全局、大陆委员会任职期间的上司，并获李登辉公开支持参选。
description.en: A politician, legal scholar, professor, and lawyer from the Republic of China (Taiwan), affiliated with the Democratic Progressive Party. She served as the 14th and 15th President of the Republic of China, Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council, and Chairperson of the Democratic Progressive Party. During her presidency, she appointed Hsiao Bi-khim as an advisor to the National Security Council and Representative to the United States. She also condemned the mass arrests in Hong Kong's pro-democracy primaries, stating that Beijing authorities had completely abandoned their 'fifty years unchanged' promise. She was Chen Ming-tong's superior during his tenure at the National Security Bureau and Mainland Affairs Council, and was publicly endorsed by Lee Teng-hui for her candidacy.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国、台湾政治人物。曾任中华民国副总统、行政院大陆委员会主任委员。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China (Taiwan). Former Vice President of the Republic of China and former Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任中华民国副总统、行政院院长、中国国民党主席等职。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, who has served as Vice President of the Republic of China, Premier of the Executive Yuan, and Chairman of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍。曾任立法院院长、副院长、立法委员、中国国民党副主席等职，是中华民国宪政史上最资深的立法委员，也是国会全面改选后任期最长的立法院院长。在蒋方良告别式上为其灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and member of the Kuomintang. He served as President of the Legislative Yuan, Vice President, Legislator, and Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang. He is the most senior legislator in the constitutional history of the Republic of China and the longest-serving President of the Legislative Yuan since its full reelection. He also covered Jiang Fangliang's coffin with the party flag at her funeral.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一所私立大学。
2014年发生在台湾立法院，由台湾大学生与公民团体共同发起的社会运动，旨在抗议《海峡两岸服务贸易协议》审查程序并反对两岸经济整合。
description.en: A social movement initiated by Taiwanese university students and civic groups, occupying the Legislative Yuan to protest the review process of the Cross-Strait Service Trade Agreement.

汪精卫的妻子，汪精卫国民政府内部“公馆派”的核心人物。
description.en: Wang Jingwei's wife and the central figure of the 'Mansion Clique' within the Wang Jingwei regime.
