description.en: A famous private university in Tokyo, Japan, where Song Jiaoren studied.

birth_place.zh-cn: 京师顺天府太平湖醇亲王府南府

description.zh-cn: 清朝末期政治人物，道光帝之孙，醇亲王奕𫍽第五子，光绪帝异母弟，宣统帝溥仪生父。他曾担任监国摄政王，辅佐幼帝宣统帝，是清朝末年设立的这一职位的主要执行者，也是清朝最后一位实际统治者。
description.en: A political figure in the late Qing dynasty, grandson of the Daoguang Emperor, fifth son of Yixuan, Prince Chun, half-brother of the Guangxu Emperor, and biological father of the Xuantong Emperor (Puyi). He served as Prince-Regent, assisting the young Xuantong Emperor in a position established in the late Qing dynasty, and was the last de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty.

en: Reorganized National Government of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 这是中国抗日战争时期由汪精卫在日本扶植下成立的亲日傀儡政权，首都设于南京。它被普遍认为是与大日本帝国合作的伪政府。孙殿英投降日军后曾在此政权中任职。该政权曾力邀梅兰芳演出但遭拒绝。
description.en: Established by Wang Jingwei and fostered by Japan during the Second Sino-Japanese War, this pro-Japanese puppet government had its capital in Nanjing. It was widely regarded as a collaborationist regime that cooperated with the Empire of Japan. Sun Dianying held positions in this regime after surrendering to the Japanese army. It famously invited Mei Lanfang to perform, which he refused.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国指1868年至1947年的日本。明治维新后，为扩张势力，它发动牡丹社事件，推行帝国主义扩张。甲午战争击败清朝，割占台湾、澎湖，赢得日俄战争。其关东军支持奉系军阀（有冲突），并于1931年发动九一八事变占领中国东北。作为一战协约国和二战轴心国（偷袭珍珠港），它侵略中国（中日战争主要参战方，参与淞沪会战，扶植汪伪政权及满洲国）、香港、新加坡及越南。为防其复兴，《中苏友好同盟互助条约》曾以此为目标。
description.en: The Empire of Japan refers to Japan from 1868 to 1947. After the Meiji Restoration, to expand its influence, it launched the Taiwan Expedition and pursued imperialist expansion. It defeated the Qing dynasty in the First Sino-Japanese War, annexing Taiwan and Penghu, and won the Russo-Japanese War. Its Kwantung Army supported the Fengtian clique (with conflicts), and in 1931, launched the Mukden Incident to occupy Northeast China. As an Entente Power in WWI and an Axis power in WWII (attacking Pearl Harbor), it invaded China (a major combatant in the Sino-Japanese War, participating in the Battle of Shanghai, and supporting the Wang Jingwei regime and Manchukuo), Hong Kong, Singapore, and Vietnam. To prevent its resurgence, the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance aimed at this goal.

description.zh-cn: 日本首相

description.zh-cn: 1927年7月15日，汪精卫领导的武汉国民政府决定与中国共产党决裂的事件。该事件导致第一次国共合作全面破裂，并直接促成了中共发动南昌起义。
description.en: The event on July 15, 1927, when the Wuhan Nationalist Government led by Wang Jingwei decided to break with the Chinese Communist Party. This incident led to the complete collapse of the First United Front and directly prompted the CCP to launch the Nanchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。早年是中国共产党早期领导人及中共一大代表，后转为中国国民党官员，抗日战争时期成为汪精卫政权的主要领导人之一。战后被国民政府判处死刑，后减为无期徒刑，病死于狱中。
description.en: Chinese politician. He was an early leader of the Chinese Communist Party and a delegate to the 1st National Congress of the CCP. Later, he became a Kuomintang official and one of the main leaders of the Wang Jingwei regime during the Anti-Japanese War. After the war, he was sentenced to death by the Nationalist Government, which was later commuted to life imprisonment. He died in prison from illness.

description.zh-cn: 中国记者、编辑，蒙古族。曾担任上海《世界经济导报》总编辑。1989年，因计划刊载纪念胡耀邦的文章，被江泽民解除职务，报社停刊，并被长期软禁直至去世。
description.en: A Chinese journalist and editor of Mongol ethnicity, he served as the editor-in-chief of Shanghai's 'World Economic Herald'. In 1989, due to his plan to publish an article commemorating Hu Yaobang, he was dismissed from his post by Jiang Zemin, the newspaper was shut down, and he was subsequently placed under long-term house arrest until his death.

description.zh-cn: 1995年至1996年间发生的台海危机。起因是美国总统克林顿允许时任中华民国总统李登辉访问美国，中华人民共和国随后进行了一系列大规模导弹演习。这些军事行动影响了1996年中华民国总统选举，并成为电视剧《国际桥牌社2》的故事背景之一。
description.en: The Taiwan Strait Crisis occurred between 1995 and 1996. It was triggered by U.S. President Clinton allowing then-President of the Republic of China Lee Teng-hui to visit the United States, followed by the People's Republic of China conducting a series of large-scale missile exercises. These military actions influenced the 1996 Republic of China presidential election and served as one of the story backdrops for the TV series 'Island Nation 2'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任机械工业部部长、国家发展计划委员会副主任、重庆市市长。吴政隆曾担任其秘书。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as Minister of Machine-Building Industry, Vice Chairman of the State Development Planning Commission, and Mayor of Chongqing. Wu Zhenglong once served as his secretary.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国湖南省的县级行政区。是刘锦棠的出生地和逝世地，也是黄公略的出生地。
description.en: A county-level administrative region in Hunan Province, China. It is the birthplace and death place of Liu Jintang, and also the birthplace of Huang Gonglue.

description.en: An institution of higher education in Beijing, China, where Chen Ziming studied and was later expelled.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管化学工业的部门，于1956年在原重工业部化学工业管理局基础上组建，存在至1970年。同年，该部与煤炭工业部、石油工业部合并，成立了新的国务院组成部门（即燃化部），该机构于1975年被撤销。
description.en: A department under the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for the chemical industry, established in 1956 based on the former Chemical Industry Administration of the Ministry of Heavy Industry, and existed until 1970. In the same year, this department merged with the Ministry of Coal Industry and the Ministry of Petroleum Industry to form a new constituent department of the State Council (namely, the Ministry of Fuel and Chemical Industries), which was abolished in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东于1976年9月9日逝世。他的逝世导致中共党内出现权力真空，是粉碎‘四人帮’事件的直接导火索，也是文化大革命结束的关键事件之一。
description.en: Mao Zedong passed away on September 9, 1976. His death led to a power vacuum within the CCP, serving as a direct catalyst for the downfall of the 'Gang of Four' and one of the key events marking the end of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 越南社会主义共和国是位于东南亚中南半岛东端的社会主义国家，由越南共产党一党专政。它是1976年南北统一后的越南国名，黎笋是其主要缔造者和领导人之一。该国与中华人民共和国在南海诸岛存在主权争议，并于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
description.en: The Socialist Republic of Vietnam is a socialist state located at the eastern edge of the Indochinese Peninsula in Southeast Asia, under the single-party rule of the Communist Party of Vietnam. It is the official name of Vietnam after the reunification of North and South in 1976, and Lê Duẩn was one of its main founders and leaders. The country has sovereignty disputes with the People's Republic of China over the South China Sea Islands and became a BRICS partner in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 时任昆明军区副司令员

birth_place.zh-cn: 法属印度支那广治省肇丰县
birth_place.en: Triệu Phong District, Quảng Trị Province, French Indochina

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党、越南民主共和国和越南社会主义共和国的主要缔造者和领导人之一。曾任越共中央总书记、中央军委书记。在胡志明去世后，他成为北越的最高领导人，并主导了越南的统一。其亲苏反华的立场导致了中越关系的紧张。
description.en: One of the main founders and leaders of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the Democratic Republic of Vietnam, and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. He served as the General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Military Commission. After Ho Chi Minh's death, he became the paramount leader of North Vietnam and led the country's reunification. His pro-Soviet and anti-Chinese stance led to tense Sino-Vietnamese relations.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，胡志明的继任者，曾任越南民主共和国国家主席，后任越南社会主义共和国主席。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician, successor to Hồ Chí Minh, who served as the President of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam and later as the President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

这场战争始于1978年，由黎笋下令越南军队入侵柬埔寨并推翻红色高棉政权。
description.en: This war began in 1978 when Lê Duẩn ordered Vietnamese troops to invade Cambodia and overthrow the Khmer Rouge regime.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾在中国西南部设立的大军区。
description.en: A former military region of the People's Liberation Army in southwestern China.

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党是越南的执政党。其前身是1951年由印度支那共产党改组成立的越南劳动党。越南劳动党于1951年至1976年间在越南民主共和国（北越）执政。1976年，越南劳动党改名为越南共产党。此后，作为越南唯一的执政党，它直接掌控着越南行政、立法、司法各个部门的机构。
description.en: The Communist Party of Vietnam is the ruling party of Vietnam. Its predecessor was the Workers' Party of Vietnam, formed in 1951 from the reorganization of the Indochinese Communist Party. The Workers' Party of Vietnam ruled the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam) from 1951 to 1976. In 1976, it was renamed the Communist Party of Vietnam. Since then, as Vietnam's sole ruling party, it has directly controlled the executive, legislative, and judicial branches of government.

zh-cn: 越南共产党中央军事委员会
en: Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of Vietnam

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党的最高军事决策机构，同时也是越南实际上的最高军事领导机构。
description.en: The highest military decision-making body of the Communist Party of Vietnam, and also Vietnam's de facto highest military leadership body.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨的极左派政党及共产主义政权，在1975年至1979年间执政，建立了民主柬埔寨政权，后被越南军队推翻。这一时期通称为民主柬埔寨时期。该政权因仇视宗教的政策，杀害了大量占族穆斯林。中国领导人陈永贵曾访问并赞赏其共产主义实践。
description.en: A far-left political party and communist regime in Cambodia, which ruled from 1975 to 1979, establishing the Democratic Kampuchea regime before being overthrown by the Vietnamese army. This period is commonly referred to as Democratic Kampuchea. Due to its policy of hostility towards religion, the regime killed a large number of Cham Muslims. Chinese leader Chen Yonggui once visited the regime and expressed appreciation for its communist practices.

zh-cn: 2019年逃犯及刑事事宜相互法律协助法例（修订）条例草案
en: Fugitive Offenders and Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2019

description.zh-cn: 由香港政府以潘晓颖命案为由提出的法律修订草案，旨在容许将香港的犯罪嫌疑人引渡（或称移交）至中国大陆、澳门及台湾等地受审。该草案是反修例运动的直接导火索，引发了大规模的反对运动。
description.en: A legislative amendment bill proposed by the Hong Kong government, citing the Poon Hiu-wing murder case, aiming to allow the extradition (or transfer) of criminal suspects from Hong Kong to mainland China, Macau, and Taiwan for trial. This bill was the direct trigger of the anti-extradition bill movement and sparked massive opposition.

en: Government of Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国香港特别行政区的行政机关。
description.en: The executive authorities of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 香港民主派组织，是反修例运动期间多次大规模游行的主要组织者。
潘晓颖，香港居民，是2018年2月17日香港青年陈同佳在台湾台北市杀害女友一案的受害者。此案因港台缺乏司法互助协议，引发巨大政治争议，并成为香港政府修订《逃犯条例》的最初原因。
description.en: Poon Hiu-wing, a Hong Kong resident, was the victim of a murder case on February 17, 2018, when Hong Kong youth Chan Tong-kai murdered his girlfriend in Taipei, Taiwan. Due to the lack of a judicial assistance agreement between Hong Kong and Taiwan, this case sparked significant political controversy and became the initial reason for the Hong Kong government to propose amendments to the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance.

description.zh-cn: 示威者提出的五项核心政治诉求。
香港的立法机关，负责审议《逃犯条例》修订草案。
description.en: The legislature of Hong Kong, responsible for deliberating the extradition bill amendment.

description.zh-cn: 反修例运动中的标志性事件，大批白衣人袭击市民，警方被质疑与黑社会合谋。
香港特别行政区的警察部门，也是香港六个主要纪律部队之一。在2019年香港理工大学冲突中，该部队围困并攻入校园。
description.en: The police department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, and one of the six major disciplinary services in Hong Kong. It besieged and entered the campus during the 2019 Hong Kong Polytechnic University conflict.

description.zh-cn: 港府引用《紧急情况规例条例》制定的法规，禁止在公众集会中蒙面。

en: Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act

description.zh-cn: 美国的一项联邦法律，由美国国会通过，要求美国政府制裁负责侵犯香港基本人权的中国及香港官员。香港理工大学冲突等事件加速了该法案的通过。
description.en: A U.S. federal law requiring the U.S. government to sanction Chinese and Hong Kong officials responsible for human rights violations in Hong Kong. Events like the siege of PolyU accelerated its passage.

en: Government of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高国家行政机关和中央政府，于1949年成立。作为执政当局，是“一带一路”倡议的发起和主导者，也是《中日联合声明》的签署方。其互联网内容审查要求与谷歌公司冲突，并对谷歌中国执法。自1999年7月起，在时任中共中央总书记江泽民的命令下，对法轮功发起了全面的镇压运动。1985年曾委任司徒华为基本法起草委员会委员，但在六四事件后双方关系破裂。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ and central government of the People's Republic of China, established in 1949. As the ruling authority, it initiated and leads the 'Belt and Road' initiative and is a signatory to the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué. Its internet content censorship requirements conflicted with Google, leading to enforcement actions against Google China. Since July 1999, under the order of then-CCP General Secretary Jiang Zemin, it launched a comprehensive suppression campaign against Falun Gong. In 1985, it appointed Szeto Wah to the Basic Law Drafting Committee, but their relationship broke down after the Tiananmen Square incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本第124代天皇，德仁天皇的祖父。他是大日本帝国在二战期间的国家元首与军队最高统帅，并在战争末期做出接受《波茨坦宣言》、结束战争的最终决定，通过“玉音放送”向全国宣布投降。他也是田中角荣担任首相时的在位天皇。
description.en: The 124th Emperor of Japan and grandfather of Emperor Naruhito. He reigned as the head of state and supreme commander of the military of the Empire of Japan during World War II, making the final decision to accept the Potsdam Declaration and end the war, and announcing the surrender to the nation via the Gyokuon-hōsō. He also reigned during Kakuei Tanaka's tenure as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 此事件标志着中国全面抗日战争的开始。事变后，许涤新得以获释，同时上海的事态日益紧张。该事件也导致阮士怡中断了在北京大学工学院的学业。
description.en: This event marked the beginning of the full-scale Second Sino-Japanese War. After the incident, Xu Dixin was released, and tensions in Shanghai escalated. It also led Ruan Shiyi to abandon his studies at the College of Engineering, Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，1932年由大日本帝国关东军在中国东北地区扶植建立的傀儡政权，存在至1945年。回良玉于1944年出生于此。
description.en: Following the Mukden Incident, a puppet state was established by the Kwantung Army of the Empire of Japan in Northeast China in 1932, existing until 1945. Hui Liangyu was born here in 1944.

description.zh-cn: 爱新觉罗·溥仪，清朝末代皇帝，也是中国历史上最后一位皇帝。由慈禧太后临终前指定继位，于1912年逊位。在张勋复辟事件中，于1917年7月1日被拥立短暂复辟，但12天后再次退位。1924年被冯玉祥逐出紫禁城，后被关东军扶植为满洲国执政与皇帝，成为满洲国唯一一位君主。他是金韫颖的兄长。
description.en: Aisin-Gioro Puyi, the last emperor of the Qing dynasty and the last emperor of China. Designated by Empress Dowager Cixi on her deathbed, he abdicated in 1912. During the Zhang Xun Restoration, he was briefly restored to the throne on July 1, 1917, but abdicated again 12 days later. He was expelled from the Forbidden City by Feng Yuxiang in 1924 and later installed by the Kwantung Army as the emperor of Manchukuo, becoming its sole monarch. He was also the elder brother of Jin Yunying.

description.zh-cn: 一场1939年至1945年爆发的全球性军事冲突，主要由轴心国与同盟国之间进行。珍珠港事件是重要转折点，标志太平洋战争全面爆发。美国在罗斯福领导下加入同盟国，艾森豪威尔任盟军欧洲最高指挥官。伯克利实验室和麻省理工学院在原子弹研发等军事科研中发挥重要作用。加拿大对德宣战参战。拉脱维亚先后被苏联和纳粹德国占领。日本占领马来亚后投降，标志亚洲战场的结束。战后香港岛人口剧增，发展加速。期间，莱比锡大学建筑和藏书遭空袭严重破坏。
description.en: A global military conflict from 1939 to 1945, primarily between the Axis and Allied powers. The attack on Pearl Harbor was a major turning point, marking the full-scale outbreak of the Pacific War. The United States, led by Roosevelt, joined the Allies, with Eisenhower as the Supreme Commander in Europe. Berkeley Lab and MIT played significant roles in military scientific research, including atomic bomb development. Canada declared war on Germany and participated. Latvia was successively occupied by the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany. Japan occupied Malaya and later surrendered, marking the end of its Asian theatre. Post-war, Hong Kong Island experienced a population surge and accelerated development. During this period, the University of Leipzig's buildings and book collections were severely damaged by air raids.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争中首场大型会战，也是规模最大、战斗最激烈的战役之一，发生于上海。虹桥机场事件是其导火线之一。战后上海沦陷。
description.en: The first major battle of the Second Sino-Japanese War, and one of its largest and most intense, which took place in Shanghai. It was triggered in part by the Hongqiao Airport Incident. After the battle, Shanghai fell to Japanese forces.

description.zh-cn: 侵华日军于1937年12月13日攻占中国南京后制造的大规模屠杀、强奸以及纵火、抢劫等战争罪行与反人类罪行。张纯如的著作使其在西方世界广为人知。
description.en: A mass murder and war rape committed by Japanese troops against the residents of Nanjing, then the capital of China, during the Second Sino-Japanese War. Iris Chang's book brought widespread awareness of it to the Western world.

description.zh-cn: 旧日本帝国陆军大将，曾指挥日军进攻并占领庐山。他后来担任日本中国派遣军总司令官，代表日本在中国战区投降。
description.en: A general in the former Imperial Japanese Army, he commanded the Japanese forces that attacked and occupied Mount Lu. He later served as the Commander-in-chief of the Japan Expeditionary Army in China, representing Japan in its surrender in the China Theater.

description.zh-cn: 标志着第二次世界大战和中国抗日战争的结束。此次事件直接导致了汪精卫国民政府的终结，并使梅兰芳得以重返舞台。
description.en: The event marking the end of World War II and the Second Sino-Japanese War. It directly led to the collapse of the Wang Jingwei regime and enabled Mei Lanfang to return to the stage.

zh-cn: 广岛与长崎原子弹爆炸
广岛和长崎的原子弹袭击
en: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki

description.zh-cn: 美国对日本广岛和长崎投下原子弹，加速了日本的投降。
苏联对日宣战并进攻中国东北的军事行动。
徐州会战中的重要战役，是抗战初期中国军队取得的一次重大胜利。
中华民国军事将领，国民革命军陆军二级上将。在枣宜会战中阵亡，是二战中同盟国牺牲的最高级别将领之一。
武汉会战后，日军为控制长江交通线、打击国军战力而发动的战役。

zh-cn: 第二次世界大战中国战区受降仪式
en: Surrender ceremony of the Second Sino-Japanese War

description.zh-cn: 中国战区接受日本投降的正式仪式。
中国国民党部分中央执行委员、中央监察委员和候补中央执行委员在北京西山碧云寺召开的会议，旨在反对容共政策。
中国国民党内主张清党、反共的政治派别，是四一二事件的发动方。
description.en: The political faction within the Kuomintang that advocated for purging communists and opposed communism, which initiated the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 苏联及共产国际派驻中国的顾问，也是共产国际代表，时任国民党中央执行委员会最高顾问。张太雷曾担任其翻译。他被国民党右派视为赤化中国的阴谋策划者，在四一二事件后被驱逐。
description.en: An advisor sent by the Soviet Union and the Comintern to China, also a Comintern representative, who was serving as the supreme advisor to the Kuomintang Central Executive Committee. Zhang Tailei served as his translator. He was seen by the KMT right-wing as a conspirator for the communization of China and was expelled after the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，淡江英语专科学校共同创办人及首任董事长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, co-founder and first chairman of Tamkang English Junior College.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代政治家、教育家、书法家。曾任国民党中央监察委员，提出发动“护党救国”运动，并强烈谴责汪精卫的容共态度。
description.en: A modern Chinese politician, educator, and calligrapher. He was also a member of the KMT Central Supervisory Committee, proposing the "Protect the Party, Save the Nation" movement and strongly condemning Wang Jingwei's accommodating stance towards communists.

description.zh-cn: 黄埔军校内由反共派组成的组织。
中国国民党中的一个政治派别，中国农工民主党的早期党员多来自于此。
description.en: A political faction within the Kuomintang, from which many early members of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party came.

zh-cn: 谷歌退出中国大陆事件
en: Withdrawal of Google from mainland China

description.zh-cn: 2010年，Google公司因遭受网络攻击及内容审查问题，与中国政府出现分歧。最终，Google决定关闭中国大陆的网页搜索服务（google.cn），停止服务审查，并将其转至香港的google.com.hk。据称此事件由李长春和周永康主导。
description.en: In 2010, Google faced a dispute with the Chinese government due to cyberattacks and content censorship issues. Consequently, Google decided to close its mainland China search services (google.cn), stop censoring search results, and redirect them to google.com.hk in Hong Kong. The event was allegedly directed by Li Changchun and Zhou Yongkang.

location.zh-cn: 美国加利福尼亚州山景城

description.zh-cn: 总部位于美国加利福尼亚州山景城的跨国科技公司，是Alphabet的子公司，专注于互联网相关服务和产品。其业务涵盖互联网广告、搜索、云计算、软件和硬件等领域。该公司也是谷歌中国的母公司。
description.en: An American multinational technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It is a subsidiary of Alphabet Inc., specializing in Internet-related services and products, including online advertising technologies, search, cloud computing, software, and hardware. It is also the parent company of Google China.

description.zh-cn: Google公司在中华人民共和国的运营实体，曾运营google.cn。其搜索服务于2010年停止运营并转至香港。
description.en: The operating entity of Google in the People's Republic of China. Its search services ceased operations and were redirected to Hong Kong in 2010.

description.zh-cn: Google公司在香港的运营实体及分支机构。自2010年谷歌退出中国大陆后，谷歌中国将其网页搜索等服务重定向至Google香港，由其承接简体中文搜索业务，并为中国大陆用户提供未经审查的搜索服务。
description.en: Google's operating entity and branch in Hong Kong. After Google's withdrawal from mainland China in 2010, Google China redirected its web search and other services to Google Hong Kong, which has since provided uncensored search services to mainland China users.

description.zh-cn: 一次针对Google及其他二十余家美国公司的网络攻击，是谷歌退出中国事件的直接导火索之一。
曾任Google首席执行官及执行董事长。作为Google首席执行官时，他对退出中国市场持不赞同态度。
description.en: Former CEO and Executive Chairman of Google. As Google CEO, he disapproved of the company's withdrawal from the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: Google联合创始人，曾在斯坦福大学攻读博士学位。他坚决反对内容审查，支持退出中国市场。
description.en: Co-founder of Google, who was a Ph.D. student at Stanford University. He firmly opposed content censorship and supported withdrawing from the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于北京的中国跨国科技公司，专注于互联网相关服务、产品及人工智能。作为中国主要的搜索引擎公司和科技巨头，它曾是Google在中国的主要竞争对手。其搜索引擎曾将特定词语（如“温云松”）设为敏感词并限制搜索结果。此外，该公司还与奇虎360在不正当竞争、商标侵权、违反Robots协议等领域发生过多次法律诉讼。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology company headquartered in Beijing, specializing in Internet-related services and products, and artificial intelligence. As a major search engine and technology giant in China, it was once Google's main competitor. Its search engine once designated specific terms (such as 'Wen Yunsong') as sensitive and restricted search results. Additionally, the company has been involved in multiple legal disputes with Qihoo 360 regarding unfair competition, trademark infringement, and violation of the Robots Exclusion Standard.

en: Federal government of the United States
Government of the United States of America

description.zh-cn: 美国的国家政府，由美国宪法建立并负责管辖美国。作为中央政府，其对台政策以《台湾关系法》、《中美三个联合公报》和《六项保证》等文件为基础，实行“一中政策”。
description.en: The national government of the United States, established by the U.S. Constitution, governs the country. As the central government, its Taiwan policy is based on documents such as the Taiwan Relations Act, the Three Joint Communiqués, and the Six Assurances, implementing a 'One China Policy'.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，前第一夫人，芭芭拉·布什的继任者。她曾出任美国国务卿，并就谷歌事件要求中国政府作出解释。2016年美国总统选举中，她作为民主党候选人与唐纳德·特朗普竞争。
description.en: American politician and former First Lady of the United States, successor to Barbara Bush. She served as US Secretary of State and demanded an explanation from the Chinese government regarding the Google incident. In the 2016 US presidential election, she ran as the Democratic nominee against Donald Trump.

description.zh-cn: Google为重返中国市场而秘密研发的自我审查版搜寻App项目。
2009年6月，中国官方媒体和监管机构谴责谷歌中国传播淫秽色情信息，并对其进行处罚的事件。
description.en: In June 2009, Chinese state media and regulatory bodies condemned Google China for disseminating obscene and pornographic information and penalized the company.

description.zh-cn: 雅虎公司是美国的一家互联网服务公司，曾是Google的竞争对手，也与其有过合作关系。其在中国的业务分支，曾于2004年由周鸿祎担任总裁。
description.en: Yahoo! Inc. is an American internet service company, a former competitor and partner of Google. Its Chinese business arm was led by Zhou Hongyi as president in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 由马云创立的中国跨国科技公司，专注于电子商务、零售、互联网和技术。该公司是无界传媒的投资方之一，并在事件后提出将无界传媒清盘。此外，它于2013年入股新浪微博，并与新浪有战略合作关系。同时，它还与香港理工大学联合成立了科研中心。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology company founded by Jack Ma, specializing in e-commerce, retail, Internet, and technology. It was one of the investors in Wujie Media and proposed to liquidate the company after the incident. In addition, it invested in Sina Weibo in 2013 and has a strategic partnership with Sina. It has also established a joint research center with The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于美国的跨国科技公司，由比尔·盖茨和保罗·艾伦创立。它是OpenAI的主要投资者之一，曾与朱邦复合作开发中文视窗系统（但合作最终破裂）。此外，该公司还与清华大学及华盛顿大学合作创建了全球创新学院。
description.en: A US-based multinational technology company founded by Bill Gates and Paul Allen. It is a major investor in OpenAI and once collaborated with Chu Bong-Foo on developing a Chinese Windows system (though the partnership eventually fell apart). Additionally, the company co-founded the Global Innovation eXchange with Tsinghua University and the University of Washington.

description.zh-cn: 美国商人及投资者，曾于2000年至2014年担任微软首席执行官。
description.en: American businessman and investor who served as the chief executive officer of Microsoft from 2000 to 2014.

zh-cn: 中央苏区第四次反围剿战争
en: Fourth encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet

description.zh-cn: 国共内战期间在江西省中南部发生的一次战役。

location.zh-cn: 中国大陆、台湾海峡、中缅边境
location.en: Mainland China, Taiwan Strait, China–Burma border

description.zh-cn: 20世纪中国爆发的规模最大、影响最深远的内战，主要由中国国民党与中国共产党之间展开，分为两个阶段，是中国现代史的重大转折点。
description.en: The largest and most influential civil war in 20th-century China, fought between the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Communist Party of China (CPC), divided into two main phases, marking a major turning point in modern Chinese history.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军红三师师长，在南丰战斗中阵亡。
国民革命军第59师师长，被俘。

zh-cn: 中央苏区第五次反围剿战争
en: Fifth encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet

description.zh-cn: 国民政府对中共中央苏区发动的第五次军事围剿，其失利是红军开始长征的直接原因。
description.en: The fifth encirclement campaign launched by the Nationalist Government against the Central Soviet Area of the CCP, the failure of which was the direct cause for the start of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国与大日本帝国签订的停战协定。
美国政治人物，在唐纳德·特朗普的第二任期内担任第50任美国副总统。
description.en: American politician serving as the 50th Vice President of the United States during Donald Trump's second term.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，共和党籍，自2023年10月25日起担任美国众议院议长。
description.en: American politician and member of the Republican Party, serving as the Speaker of the United States House of Representatives since October 25, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 美国法学家、律师。

location.zh-cn: 美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区国会山庄
location.en: United States Capitol, Washington, D.C., United States

description.zh-cn: 美国国会的两院之一，为美国的下议院。其席位分配以各州人口数为基准，总数固定为435名投票议员。
description.en: One of the two chambers of the United States Congress, serving as the lower house. Seats are apportioned among the states by population, with the total number of voting representatives fixed at 435.

en: Supreme Court of the United States

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦司法机构的最高级别法院。
美国两大主要政党之一，通常被认为是保守派政党。
description.en: One of the two major political parties in the United States, generally considered the conservative party.

description.zh-cn: 美国两大主要政党之一。罗斯福和约翰·F·肯尼迪都曾是其党员，并在夏威夷州具有传统政治优势。
description.en: One of the two major political parties in the United States. Both Roosevelt and John F. Kennedy belonged to it, and it traditionally holds a political advantage in the state of Hawaii.

zh-cn: 大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国
en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
the empire on which the sun never sets

description.zh-cn: 由英国统治的全球帝国，是历史上最大的帝国，在1921年达到巅峰。它在鸦片战争中作为主要西方列强，与清朝进行了两次战争，其中是发动第二次鸦片战争的主要国家之一。它也是新加坡（1824-1963年）、马来亚、砂拉越和北婆罗洲等地的宗主国。作为第二次世界大战的同盟国之一，汪精卫国民政府于1943年对其宣战。
description.en: A global empire ruled by the United Kingdom, and the largest empire in history, which reached its peak in 1921. It was the main Western power in the Opium Wars, fighting against the Qing dynasty in both conflicts, and was one of the main countries that initiated the Second Opium War. It also served as the sovereign state of Singapore (1824-1963), Malaya, Sarawak, and North Borneo. As one of the Allied powers in World War II, the Wang Jingwei regime declared war against it in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 北美十三殖民地为反抗英国统治、争取民族独立而爆发的革命战争。此战发生在七年战争结束后12年，英国为弥补战争开销对殖民地增税是主要原因。法国的介入增加了巨大的财政压力，成为法国大革命的诱因之一。
description.en: A revolutionary war fought by the Thirteen North American Colonies against British rule to gain national independence. This conflict erupted 12 years after the Seven Years' War, largely due to Britain's imposition of new taxes on the colonies to cover war expenses. France's intervention significantly increased its financial burden, becoming one of the triggers for the French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后，以美国为首的西方阵营与以苏联为首的东方阵营（及其各自盟友）之间，围绕地缘政治展开的紧张对峙和政治、军事对抗，持续了近半个世纪。美国总统艾森豪威尔的任期是冷战的关键时期。
description.en: A period of geopolitical tension and political and military confrontation lasting nearly half a century after World War II. It primarily occurred between the Western Bloc, led by the United States, and the Eastern Bloc, led by the Soviet Union and their respective allies. Eisenhower's presidency was a key period of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 2001年9月11日，基地组织在美国本土发动了一系列自杀式恐怖袭击事件，导致了伊斯兰恐惧症的弥漫。
description.en: A series of four coordinated suicide terrorist attacks launched by the Islamic terrorist group al-Qaeda against the United States on September 11, 2001, which led to the spread of Islamophobia.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国纽约曼哈顿下城的建筑群，在九一一袭击事件中倒塌。
美国第16任总统，在美国内战期间领导联邦取得胜利，并颁布《解放黑人奴隶宣言》。
description.en: The 16th President of the United States, who led the Union to victory in the American Civil War and issued the Emancipation Proclamation.

description.zh-cn: 由美国南部11个蓄奴州为维护奴隶制度而脱离联邦后建立的国家。
description.en: A nation established by 11 southern slave states that seceded from the Union to preserve the institution of slavery.

description.zh-cn: 美国于1861年至1865年发生的内战，是美国历史上规模最大、最惨烈的内战。交战双方为北方的联邦阵营与南方的邦联阵营，最终以联邦获胜、奴隶制度被废除告终。
description.en: The American Civil War, fought from 1861 to 1865, was the largest and most devastating civil war in U.S. history. It pitted the northern Union against the southern Confederacy, ultimately resulting in a Union victory and the abolition of slavery.

description.zh-cn: 美国牧师、社会运动家、民权运动领袖。
一场旨在为非裔美国人争取平等权利、结束美国种族隔离和歧视的社会运动。肯尼迪总统在其任内对该运动表示支持，并采取了若干干预措施。
description.en: A social movement aimed at securing equal rights for African Americans and ending racial segregation and discrimination in the United States. President Kennedy supported the movement and intervened with several measures during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，苏联首任名义上的国家元首。

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·乌里扬诺夫
弗拉基米尔·伊里奇·列宁

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯共产主义革命家、政治家、政治理论家和思想家，苏维埃俄国和苏联的主要缔造者和首任政府首脑，也是共产国际的创始人。其领导下的红军曾在克里米亚建立塔夫里苏维埃社会主义共和国。其思想影响了中国共产党早期的民族政策。其兄亚历山大·乌里扬诺夫因刺杀沙皇被处决。
description.en: Russian communist revolutionary, politician, political theorist, and thinker. He was the main founder and first head of government of Soviet Russia and the Soviet Union, and the founder of the Communist International. Under his leadership, the Red Army established the Taurida Soviet Socialist Republic in Crimea. His thought influenced the early ethnic policy of the Chinese Communist Party. His brother, Aleksandr Ulyanov, was executed for an assassination attempt on the Tsar.

description.zh-cn: 苏联末任政府首脑。

zh-cn: 俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国
俄罗斯苏维埃社会主义联邦共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国和最大加盟共和国，在1954年前管辖克里米亚州。
description.en: A founding and the largest constituent republic of the Soviet Union, which administered the Crimean Oblast before 1954.

zh-cn: 白俄罗斯苏维埃社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国。

zh-cn: 乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 作为苏联的创始成员国之一，它自1954年起管辖克里米亚州，也是切尔诺贝利核电站的所在地。1991年苏联解体后，该国独立并更名为乌克兰。
description.en: A founding constituent republic of the Soviet Union, it administered the Crimean Oblast from 1954 onwards and was the location of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant. It became the independent state of Ukraine after the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.

zh-cn: 外高加索社会主义联邦苏维埃共和国
外高加索苏维埃社会主义联邦共和国

description.zh-cn: 苏联的创始成员国。

en: Treaty on the Creation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
Declaration of the Creation of the USSR

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟解体，指苏联于1990年代初至1991年12月26日期间停止存在并分裂为多个主权国家的过程。最终在1991年12月26日，苏联最高苏维埃宣布苏联停止存在。此事件标志着冷战的结束，并导致列宁主义影响力下降。时任苏共总书记戈尔巴乔夫曾认为，切尔诺贝利事故是苏联解体的原因之一。
description.en: The dissolution of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics refers to the process from the early 1990s to December 26, 1991, when the Soviet Union ceased to exist and split into multiple sovereign states. On December 26, 1991, the Supreme Soviet formally announced the USSR's cessation. This event marked the end of the Cold War and led to a decline in the influence of Leninism. Then-General Secretary Mikhail Gorbachev suggested that the Chernobyl disaster was one of the causes of the Soviet Union's collapse.

description.zh-cn: 1933年至1945年，由阿道夫·希特勒和纳粹党统治的德国。作为第二次世界大战的欧洲轴心国，它是法西斯意大利和日本的主要盟友，也是加拿大的敌对国。1941年12月11日，在珍珠港事件后对美国宣战。该政权在战争初期曾与中国有军事合作，但于1941年承认汪精卫国民政府，并在二战期间占领了比利时和拉脱维亚。在此期间，莱比锡大学被允许继续授课。
description.en: Germany between 1933 and 1945, governed by Adolf Hitler and the Nazi Party. As a European Axis power in World War II, it was a primary ally of Fascist Italy and Japan, and an adversary of Canada. It declared war on the United States on December 11, 1941, following the attack on Pearl Harbor. The regime had military cooperation with China in the early stage of the war but recognized the Wang Jingwei regime in 1941, and occupied Belgium and Latvia during WWII. During this period, the University of Leipzig was permitted to continue teaching.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，勃列日涅夫之后的苏联最高领导人。
苏联政治家，安德罗波夫之后的苏联最高领导人。
1991年，苏联共产党内的保守派为阻止戈尔巴乔夫下放权力及国家解体而发动的一场未遂政变。其失败加速了苏联的解体。
description.en: An unsuccessful coup attempt in 1991 by hardliners within the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, launched to prevent Mikhail Gorbachev from devolving power and the dissolution of the state. Its failure accelerated the collapse of the Soviet Union.

en: State Committee on the State of Emergency

description.zh-cn: 由苏共党内保守派组成，为发动八一九事件而成立。
由俄罗斯、白俄罗斯、乌克兰三国领导人签署，宣布苏联停止存在并成立独立国家联合体的协议。

zh-cn: 斯坦尼斯拉夫·舒什克维奇

description.zh-cn: 白俄罗斯政治家，签署《别洛韦日协议》者之一。
乌克兰政治人物。曾于1990年至1991年出任末任乌克兰最高苏维埃主席，1991年至1994年担任首任乌克兰总统，也是《别洛韦日协议》签署者之一。
description.en: Ukrainian politician. He served as the last Chairman of the Supreme Soviet of Ukraine from 1990 to 1991 and as the first President of Ukraine from 1991 to 1994, and was one of the signatories of the Belovezha Accords.

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会于1971年通过的关于“恢复中华人民共和国在联合国组织中的合法权利问题”的决议，承认中华人民共和国政府是中国在联合国的唯一合法代表，并驱逐了中华民国的代表。此事件也是中日建交的背景之一。
description.en: A resolution passed by the United Nations General Assembly in 1971, concerning the 'Restoration of the People's Republic of China's lawful rights in the United Nations Organization', recognized the Government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legitimate representative of China to the United Nations and expelled the representatives of the Republic of China. This event also served as part of the background for the establishment of Sino-Japanese diplomatic relations.

en: University of Science and Technology Beijing

nodes.id: BAIDU:中央西藏工作协调小组

zh-cn: 中央西藏工作协调小组

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的父亲。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's father.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，曾任英国首相。她曾与邓小平就香港前途问题进行谈判；马尔康·芮夫金曾在其内阁中担任苏格兰事务大臣。
description.en: British stateswoman who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. She negotiated with Deng Xiaoping on the future of Hong Kong; Malcolm Rifkind served as Secretary of State for Scotland in her cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 这是一所位于湖南的师范学校。毛泽东青年时期曾在此求学，著名哲学家李泽厚也曾在此就读。杨昌济曾在此任教。
description.en: This is a normal school located in Hunan. Mao Zedong studied here in his youth, and the renowned philosopher Li Zehou also attended. Yang Changji once taught here.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军合成第一一六旅
中国工农红军第二十六军
en: 116th Mechanized Infantry Division (People's Republic of China)

description.zh-cn: 该部队起源于中国工农红军，后作为中国人民志愿军第39军的师级单位，参与了云山战斗。
description.en: This unit originated from the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army. It later served as a division-level unit of the PVA 39th Corps and participated in the Battle of Unsan.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七十九集团军
中国人民解放军第39集团军
中国工农红军第十五军团
en: 15th Army Group of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army
15th Army Group of the Red Army
39th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 该组织曾是中国工农红军主力部队之一，由红25军和陕北、陕甘红军合编而成，并由徐海东指挥。后来，作为中国人民志愿军的主力部队之一，它在云山战斗中担任主攻。
description.en: This organization was one of the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, formed by the merger of the 25th Red Army and the Red Army units from Northern Shaanxi and Shaanxi-Gansu, and commanded by Xu Haidong. Later, as one of the main forces of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, it served as the main attacking force in the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共辽宁省委书记。据报道，他对时任省长薄熙来在辽宁的施政不满，两人关系不睦。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Party Secretary of Liaoning Province. He was reportedly dissatisfied with Bo Xilai's governance in Liaoning.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国商务部
en: Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管商业经济和贸易的组成部门。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for commercial economy and trade.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国大连市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Dalian City, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 重庆打黑除恶专项行动

description.zh-cn: 由时任重庆市委书记薄熙来和王立军主导，在重庆发起的一场大规模打击有组织犯罪和腐败的运动。该运动在提升治安的同时，也因其法律程序问题而备受争议。
description.en: A large-scale campaign against organized crime and corruption in Chongqing, led by then-Chongqing Party Secretary Bo Xilai and Wang Lijun. While it improved public security, the campaign was controversial due to its legal process issues.

zh-cn: 薄谷开来、张晓军故意杀人案

location.zh-cn: 重庆南山丽景度假酒店

description.zh-cn: 英国商人尼尔·海伍德于2011年11月13日在重庆南山丽景度假酒店被杀害。尸体于11月14日被发现。后经调查，此为他杀刑事案件，嫌疑人为薄谷开来及薄熙来家庭佣工张晓军（男性）。张晓军系薄家勤务人员，且是谷开来谋杀尼尔·海伍德的同案犯。此案随后进行了对谷开来、张晓军故意杀害尼尔·伍德的司法审判。
description.en: An orderly of the Bo family and an accomplice in Gu Kailai's murder of Neil Heywood.

zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国

description.zh-cn: 位于东亚朝鲜半岛北部的社会主义国家，由朝鲜劳动党实行一党专政。该国是朝鲜战争的主要参战方，其军队是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一。1953年，该国授予曾泽生一级国旗勋章。此外，该国还被韩方指控为仰光爆炸事件的主谋，近期被指控向俄罗斯提供武器及派遣士兵参与战争。
description.en: A socialist state located in the northern part of the Korean Peninsula in East Asia, where the Workers' Party of Korea exercises one-party rule. It was a main belligerent in the Korean War, and its army was one of the signatories of the Korean Armistice Agreement. In 1953, it awarded Zeng Zesheng the First Class Order of the National Flag. Additionally, the country has been accused by South Korea of masterminding the Rangoon bombing and recently of supplying weapons and sending soldiers to participate in the war on Russia's side.

description.zh-cn: 位于东亚朝鲜半岛南部的共和制国家，通称韩国。朝鲜战争主要参战方之一，但因时任总统李承晚的反对，未签署《朝鲜停战协定》。李在明于2025年6月4日就任第21任总统。其多个政府部门、学校及应用商店已屏蔽或下架DeepSeek。
description.en: A republican country located in the southern part of the Korean Peninsula in East Asia, commonly known as South Korea. It was a main belligerent in the Korean War, but did not sign the Korean Armistice Agreement due to the opposition of then-President Syngman Rhee. Lee Jae-myung was inaugurated as its 21st President on June 4, 2025. Several of its government departments, schools, and app stores have blocked or removed DeepSeek.

description.zh-cn: 根据联合国安理会决议成立，由美国领导的多国部队，在朝鲜战争中支援大韩民国并与中国人民志愿军作战。该司令部是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一，并在非军事区南部驻军。
description.en: A multinational military force established under a UN Security Council resolution and led by the United States, supporting South Korea and fighting against the Chinese People's Volunteer Army during the Korean War. The command is a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement and garrisoned in the southern part of the DMZ.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家、政治家，大韩民国首任总统、首任国会议长。他曾因反对以三八线为界停战而拒绝在《朝鲜停战协定》上签字。
description.en: A Korean independence activist and politician, the first President of the Republic of Korea and the first Speaker of the National Assembly. He refused to sign the Korean Armistice Agreement due to his opposition to a ceasefire along the 38th parallel.

description.zh-cn: 美国第33任总统。曾任罗斯福的最后一任副总统，在其逝世后接任总统。他批准对日本使用原子弹并接受其投降。朝鲜战争爆发后，他下令第七舰队进入台湾海峡，实行台湾海峡中立化政策。
description.en: 33rd President of the United States. He served as Roosevelt's final Vice President and succeeded him as President upon Roosevelt's death. He authorized the use of atomic bombs against Japan and accepted its surrender. After the outbreak of the Korean War, he ordered the Seventh Fleet into the Taiwan Strait to implement the Taiwan Strait Neutralization policy.

zh-cn: 德怀特·大卫·艾森豪威尔

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军五星上将、军事家、政治家，亦是美国第34任总统。第二次世界大战期间，他担任盟军在欧洲的最高指挥官。在总统任内，他批准了将赫鲁晓夫秘密报告的文稿披露给媒体的行动，并于1958年签署了阿拉斯加建州法令。
description.en: An American five-star general, military strategist, and statesman, who also served as the 34th President of the United States. During World War II, he was the Supreme Commander of the Allied Expeditionary Force in Europe. As president, he approved the action to disclose the text of Khrushchev's Secret Speech to the media, and in 1958, he signed the Alaska Statehood Act.

description.zh-cn: 接替沃尔顿·沃克任美国第八集团军司令，后接替道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟任联合国军总司令。
朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的武装力量，是朝鲜战争的主要参战方和《朝鲜停战协定》的签署方之一，并在非军事区北部驻军。
description.en: The armed forces of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a main belligerent in the Korean War, a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement, and garrisoned in the northern part of the DMZ.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的武装力量，是朝鲜战争的主要参战方，但未在《朝鲜停战协定》上签字。其部分单位驻扎在非军事区南部。在2024年戒严期间，其部分单位被动员部署至国会及其他关键地点。
description.en: The armed forces of the Republic of Korea, a main belligerent in the Korean War, but not a signatory to the Korean Armistice Agreement. Its units are stationed in the southern part of the DMZ. During the 2024 martial law, some of its units were mobilized and deployed to the National Assembly and other key locations.

zh-cn: 关于朝鲜军事停战的协定
朝鲜人民军最高司令官及中国人民志愿军司令员一方与联合国军总司令另一方关于朝鲜军事停战的协定
en: Agreement Between the Commander-in-Chief, United Nations Command, on the One Hand, and the Supreme Commander of the Korean People’s Army and the Commander of the Chinese People’s Volunteers, on the Other Hand, Concerning a Military Armistice in Korea

description.zh-cn: 这份旨在停止朝鲜战争交战双方敌对军事行为的军事协定，由中国人民志愿军、朝鲜人民军和联合国军于1953年7月27日在板门店签署。该协定结束了朝鲜战争的战斗，建立了朝韩非军事区，并至今仍是维持朝鲜半岛停火状态的唯一法律依据。
description.en: This military agreement, aimed at ceasing hostile military actions between the belligerents of the Korean War, was signed by the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, the Korean People's Army, and the United Nations Command on July 27, 1953, in Panmunjom. The agreement ended the fighting of the Korean War, established the Korean Demilitarized Zone, and remains the sole legal basis for maintaining the ceasefire on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝韩非军事区内的共同警备区，是《朝鲜停战协定》的签署地点。
description.en: The Joint Security Area within the Korean Demilitarized Zone, and the location where the Korean Armistice Agreement was signed.

description.zh-cn: 二战后美苏在朝鲜半岛划分受降范围的军事分界线，后来成为朝韩之间的事实边界。
description.en: The military demarcation line used by the US and USSR to divide their zones of occupation on the Korean Peninsula after WWII, which later became the de facto border between North and South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争第二次战役中在东线发生的一场决定性战役。
description.en: A decisive battle on the eastern front during the Second Phase Offensive of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 抗美援朝战争（朝鲜战争）后期的一场著名战役，以其惨烈程度而闻名，王近山曾参与指挥。
description.en: A famous battle in the later stages of the Korean War, known for its intensity and brutality, and commanded by Wang Jinshan.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争最后一次大规模战役，由中国人民志愿军主要针对韩国军队发动。
description.en: The last large-scale battle of the Korean War, launched by the Chinese People's Volunteer Army primarily against the South Korean army.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军旗下的远洋舰队之一，隶属于美国印太司令部旗下的美国太平洋舰队。司令部设在日本横须贺港，是目前美国最大的海外前线投送部队，曾在朝鲜战争、越南战争和台湾海峡危机中扮演关键角色。
description.en: One of the forward-deployed naval forces of the United States Navy, subordinate to the United States Pacific Fleet, which is part of the United States Indo-Pacific Command. Headquartered at Yokosuka, Japan, it is the largest of the U.S. Navy's forward-deployed fleets and has played a key role in the Korean War, Vietnam War, and Taiwan Strait crises.

description.zh-cn: 美国国会通过的法案，以回应中国实施《香港国安法》。
中国抗日战争中的一场重要战役。
description.en: A major battle during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战的战区之一，以日本为首的轴心国和以美国为首的同盟国在太平洋及其周边地区进行的战争。其地理范围涵盖东亚、东南亚、太平洋、印度洋和大洋洲，是二战地理上规模最大的战场。战争期间，日本政府加强了对地方的管制，促成了《东京都制》的实施。第七舰队在此期间成立。
description.en: One of the theaters of World War II, fought in the Pacific and its surrounding areas between the Japan-led Axis powers and the US-led Allied powers. Its geographical scope included East Asia, Southeast Asia, the Pacific Ocean, the Indian Ocean, and Oceania, making it the largest theater of war geographically in WWII. During the war, the Japanese government increased its control over local autonomy, which contributed to the implementation of the Tokyo Metropolis System. The Seventh Fleet was also established during this period.

description.zh-cn: 日本在华北扶植的傀儡政权。
冀东防共自治政府委员长。
中华民国临时政府领导人，中华民国时期政治人物，曾任财政总长。
description.en: A political figure during the Republic of China period, who served as the leader of the Provisional Government and as Minister of Finance.

zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府 (1937年—1940年)
中华民国临时政府 (1937年－1940年)
en: Provisional Government of the Republic of China (1937–1940)

description.zh-cn: 日本在华北扶植的早期傀儡政权之一，后并入汪精卫国民政府。
description.en: One of the early puppet states established by Japan in North China, later merged into the Wang Jingwei regime.

en: Reformed Government of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 日本在华中扶植的早期傀儡政权之一，后并入汪精卫国民政府。
description.en: One of the early puppet states established by Japan in Central China, later merged into the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国维新政府行政院长。
蒙古军政府总裁。
日本在内蒙古扶植的傀儡政权。
由陈嘉庚创立，参与中国抗日战争的海外华侨组织。
由美国飞行员组成的志愿航空队，协助中国抗战。
美国陆军航空队退役飞行员，飞虎队创始人。
苏联派遣至中国协助抗战的航空部队与军事顾问。
由美、英、中三国（同盟国）于1945年发表的对日最后通牒，要求日本无条件投降，否则将面临“迅速且完全的毁灭”。这份公告详细规定了日本投降的条款。在后来的《中日联合声明》中，日本政府曾表示坚持遵循该公告第八条的立场。
description.en: An ultimatum (declaration) issued by the United States, United Kingdom, and China (Allied Powers) in 1945, demanding Japan's unconditional surrender under threat of 'prompt and utter destruction'. This declaration detailed the terms for Japan's surrender. Later, in the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué, the Japanese government affirmed its adherence to Article 8 of this declaration.

description.zh-cn: 中、美、英三国元首发表，要求日本归还窃取于中国的领土。
1971年3月，由林立果及其“联合舰队”成员策划撰写的武装政变计划草稿，旨在推翻毛泽东统治并暗杀毛泽东。该计划后被指控为林彪反党集团所为。
description.en: A draft armed coup plan, formulated by Lin Liguo and his 'United Fleet' members in March 1971, aimed at overthrowing and assassinating Mao Zedong. This plan was later alleged to have been masterminded by the Lin Biao anti-party clique.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国海军的主力作战部队，由山本五十六指挥，其下属的第一航空舰队执行了偷袭珍珠港任务。
description.en: The main operational component of the Imperial Japanese Navy, commanded by Isoroku Yamamoto. Its subordinate First Air Fleet carried out the mission to attack Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 由林彪集团成员控制的机构。
负责中共中央领导人警卫工作的部队，代号为中共中央警卫团。
256号三叉戟飞机驾驶员。
中共解放军空军党委办公室处长，林立果“联合舰队”成员。
时任中国人民解放军空军司令部办公室副主任，林立果“联合舰队”成员，也是《“571工程”纪要》的共同密谋者。
description.en: Then Deputy Director of the Office of the PLA Air Force Command, a member of Lin Liguo's "United Fleet" and a co-conspirator of the "Project 571 Outline".

description.zh-cn: 林彪的亲信之一，曾任解放军南京军区空军政委，是林立果“联合舰队”成员。
description.en: One of Lin Biao's confidants, he served as Political Commissar of the Nanjing Military Region Air Force of the People's Liberation Army and was a member of Lin Liguo's 'United Fleet'.

description.zh-cn: 林彪办公室警卫秘书。
负责审查林陈反党集团的机构。

zh-cn: 江油未成年人欺凌事件

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市江油市

description.zh-cn: 一宗因未成年人欺凌案及后续警方处理引发大规模警民冲突的群体性事件。

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市代管的县级市。
description.en: A county-level city administered by Mianyang City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省下辖的地级市，位于四川省北部，是全省第二大城市、中国重要的国防科研和电子工业生产基地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city under the jurisdiction of Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, located in the northern part of Sichuan. It is the second-largest city in the province and an important national defense research and electronics industry base in China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国西南地区的一个省份。
description.en: A province in Southwest China.

zh-cn: 公安机关 (中华人民共和国)

description.zh-cn: 它是中国的警察部门，作为县人民政府的常设组成部门，负责公共安全事务。
description.en: It is a police department in China, serving as a permanent component department of the County People's Government, responsible for public security affairs.

zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家武装力量的组成部分，由中央军事委员会领导，负责国内安全保卫。它还是中国人民武装警察部队第一机动总队的上级指挥机构。在1998年洪灾期间，与解放军一同大量参与了抗洪抢险任务。
description.en: A component of the armed forces of the People's Republic of China. It is under the command of the Central Military Commission, responsible for internal security, and serves as the superior command structure for the PAP First Mobile Corps. Along with the People's Liberation Army, it was heavily involved in flood fighting and rescue missions during the 1998 floods.

description.zh-cn: 指发生在中国未成年学生中，在校园内外学生间的欺凌、骚扰行为。本案受害者长期遭受此种行为，被认为是导致悲剧的重要背景因素。
description.en: Refers to bullying and harassment among underage students in China, both inside and outside of school. The victim in this case was a long-term target of such behavior, which is considered a significant contributing factor to the tragedy.

zh-cn: 河北邯郸初中生被害案
邯郸初中生杀人埋尸案
en: Handan junior high school student murder case

location.zh-cn: 中国河北省邯郸市肥乡区北高镇张庄村
location.en: Zhangzhuang Village, Beigao Town, Feixiang District, Handan, Hebei, China

description.zh-cn: 2024年3月10日发生于中国河北省邯郸市的一宗涉及三名未成年人合谋杀害一名同学的刑事案件。该案因涉及校园霸凌、留守儿童及低龄未成年人犯罪等问题而引发社会广泛关注。
description.en: A criminal case that occurred on March 10, 2024, in Handan, Hebei, China, involving three minors who conspired to murder a classmate. The case drew widespread public attention due to its connection with issues such as school bullying, left-behind children, and juvenile delinquency.

nodes.id: BAIDU:防范中小学生欺凌专项治理行动工作方案

zh-cn: 防范中小学生欺凌专项治理行动工作方案
中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法
en: Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一部法律，主要规管违反治安管理但尚不构成刑事处罚的行为。其前身为《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚条例》。
description.en: A law of the People's Republic of China that primarily regulates acts that violate public security administration but do not constitute criminal offenses. Its predecessor was the 'Regulations on Administrative Penalties for Public Security of the People's Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 新浪于2009年推出的微博客服务网站，是中国访问量最大的网站之一。该平台曾完全封锁与“温云松”相关的微博。
description.en: A microblogging service launched by Sina in 2009, it is one of the most visited websites in China. The platform once completely blocked posts related to 'Wen Yunsong'.

description.zh-cn: 中国记者，曾获世界新闻自由奖
中国维权律师、美国天主教大学访问学者

zh-cn: 2023年12月河南宁陵初中生坠楼事件
2025年陕西蒲城职校学生坠楼事件

description.zh-cn: 粉碎四人帮后在全国范围内开展的政治运动，旨在清查与四人帮有关的人和事。
中国政治人物。曾任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任、中共四川省委书记（彭清华前任），现任中华全国总工会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician. He previously served as Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission and Party Secretary of Sichuan (Peng Qinghua's predecessor), and is currently the Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

en: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 苏联的最高国家权力机关。
孙中山提出的宪法理论，该理论将政府权力分为行政、立法、司法、考试、监察五权。
description.en: A constitutional theory proposed by Sun Yat-sen, which divides government power into five branches: executive, legislative, judicial, examination, and control.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国武装力量
en: Armed Forces of the People's Republic of China
Military of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的武装力量，包括中国人民解放军、中国人民武装警察部队和民兵。
中国共产党早期党员。

zh-cn: 国民政府军事委员会调查统计局
军事委员会调查统计局

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民政府的主要情报机关之一，最初负责谍报、暗杀等工作，由戴笠长期负责。在蒋介石的命令下，该组织曾追捕并刺杀了王亚樵。该机构于1946年7月1日由军统局改组为国防部保密局，并在1949年后迁往台湾。1955年，国防部保密局再次改组，继续作为情报机构运作至1985年7月1日。
description.en: One of the main intelligence agencies of the Republic of China's Nationalist Government, initially responsible for espionage and assassination, long headed by Dai Li. Under Chiang Kai-shek's orders, it was involved in the pursuit and assassination of Wang Yaqiao. The agency was reorganized from the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics (Juntong) into the Bureau of Secrecy of the Ministry of National Defense on July 1, 1946, relocating to Taiwan after 1949. It was further reorganized in 1955, continuing intelligence operations until July 1, 1985.

description.zh-cn: 戴笠的继任者，先后掌管军统局、保密局、情报局。
中华民国国防部主要的情报搜集单位，由国防部情报局与国防部特种情报室合并而成。
description.en: The primary intelligence gathering agency of the Ministry of National Defense of the Republic of China.

en: Chief of the General Staff (Republic of China)
General Staff Headquarters of the Nationalist Government

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国防部是执行指挥中华民国国军的特设机关，国军军令系统的最高单位，国防部部长的军令幕僚及三军联合作战指挥机构，也是国防部军事情报局的上级单位。其下设参谋本部，其首长为中华民国国军的最高军职。
description.en: The Ministry of National Defense of the Republic of China is a special agency responsible for commanding the R.O.C. Armed Forces. It serves as the highest unit in the military command system, the chief military staff for the Minister of National Defense, the joint operations command center for the three services, and the superior agency to the Military Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense. Under its structure, the General Staff Headquarters exists, and its head holds the highest military position in the R.O.C. Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 上海市参议会会长，被军统特务刺杀。
1955年发生于台湾的政治案件。中华民国政府指控时任总统府参军长的孙立人及其部属郭廷亮等人意图发动兵变。此案最终导致孙立人被革职并长期软禁，其众多亲信部属亦遭牵连入狱。后被证实为一宗冤案。
description.en: A political case that occurred in Taiwan in 1955. The Republic of China government accused the then Presidential Chief of Staff Sun Li-jen and his subordinate Guo Tingliang of plotting a mutiny. The case resulted in Sun's dismissal and long-term house arrest, with many of his close associates also implicated and imprisoned. It was later proven to be a miscarriage of justice.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，抗日战争时期少数非黄埔军校出身的留美军官。因在仁安羌之战中以少胜多解救英军而获“东方隆美尔”之称。第二次国共内战期间，在东北战场与林彪部队作战，后因与上级杜聿明不和被调离。迁台后负责训练新军，后因孙立人兵变案被诬陷，其部属曾涉匪谍案遭调查，监察院报告认为其罪名莫须有，但仍遭蒋中正软禁长达33年。
description.en: A Second Class General of the Republic of China Army, and one of the few US-educated, non-Whampoa Military Academy officers during the Second Sino-Japanese War. He was nicknamed the 'Rommel of the East' for rescuing British forces against the odds in the Battle of Yenangyaung. During the Chinese Civil War, he fought against Lin Biao's forces in the Northeast but was later transferred due to conflicts with his superior Du Yuming. After moving to Taiwan, he was responsible for training new troops. However, he was implicated in the Sun Li-jen incident, framed for charges, and his subordinates were involved in a spy case. Although a Control Yuan investigation report deemed the charges unfounded, he was nevertheless placed under house arrest by Chiang Kai-shek for 33 years.

description.zh-cn: 指台湾作家刘宜良在美国遭枪杀的政治谋杀事件，因其笔名为“江南”而得名。此案牵涉到台湾的情报机构，并对蒋氏家族的声誉造成重创。
description.en: Refers to the political assassination of Taiwanese writer Henry Liu in the United States. The case implicated Taiwan's intelligence agencies and severely damaged the reputation of the Chiang family.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华裔作家，笔名“江南”，因撰写《蒋经国传》而在美国遭台湾情报人员买凶杀害。
description.en: A Chinese-American writer, pen name 'Chiang Nan', who was assassinated in the U.S. by killers hired by Taiwanese intelligence personnel for writing a biography of Chiang Ching-kuo.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国海军二级上将，曾任国防部情报局局长，因江南案下台并被捕入狱。
description.en: An admiral in the Republic of China Navy, former director of the Military Intelligence Bureau, who was arrested and imprisoned, and subsequently stepped down due to the Henry Liu case.

description.zh-cn: 台湾黑帮首领，受情报局特训并派遣，执行了对刘宜良的暗杀。
中日战争期间军统局与美国情报体系合作成立的机构。
中华民国情报官员。军统局处长出身，后被蒋经国扶植，接替毛人凤成为保密局局长。他曾任国防部情报局局长，并策划了海威行动。
description.en: An intelligence official of the Republic of China, who served as the director of the Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense and planned Operation Hai Wei.

description.zh-cn: 军统早期成员，国民政府迁台后负责整顿情治系统。
中国共产党的领导制度。
新民主主义革命是中国共产党领导的资产阶级民主革命。毛泽东认为其在半殖民地半封建国家分为新民主主义和社会主义两个阶段，并将五四运动定性为开端。井冈山革命根据地的建立，开辟了“农村包围城市，武装夺取政权”的道路。
description.en: The New Democratic Revolution was a bourgeois-democratic revolution led by the Communist Party of China. Mao Zedong's theory posited that in semi-colonial, semi-feudal countries, it was divided into New Democratic and Socialist stages, characterizing the May Fourth Movement as its beginning. The establishment of the Jinggangshan Revolutionary Base opened the path of 'encircling the cities from the countryside and seizing power by armed force'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十八届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: 18th Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party
First Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 在此次会议上，习近平当选为中国共产党中央委员会总书记，马凯当选为中央政治局委员。
description.en: At this meeting, Xi Jinping was elected as the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, and Ma Kai was elected as a member of the Politburo.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十八届中央委员会第六次全体会议
en: Sixth plenary session of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军北部战区陆军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军北部战区下辖的陆军部分

en: 3rd Division of the New Fourth Army

description.zh-cn: 由黄克诚领导的新四军下属部队，是中国人民解放军陆军第七十九集团军的前身之一。抗战胜利后，该师3.5万余人进入东北，成为组建东北人民自治军的重要力量。
description.en: A unit of the New Fourth Army led by Huang Kecheng, and one of the predecessors of the 79th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force. After the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, over 35,000 personnel from this division entered the Northeast, becoming a significant force in the formation of the Northeast People's Autonomous Army.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争胜利后，由进入中国东北的山东军区主力和新四军第三师等部队组建。它是中国共产党在解放战争（第二次国共内战）时期于东北地区组建的武装力量，是中国人民解放军的主力部队之一。作为东北民主联军、东北野战军及第四野战军的前身，该部队曾镇压通化事件，后改称东北人民解放军，最终改编为第四野战军。
description.en: Formed after the victory of the Second Sino-Japanese War from the main forces of the Shandong Military Region and the 3rd Division of the New Fourth Army that entered Northeast China. It was an armed force established by the Communist Party of China in Northeast China during the Chinese Civil War, and one of the main forces of the People's Liberation Army. As the predecessor of the Northeast Democratic United Army, the Northeast Field Army, and the Fourth Field Army, this force suppressed the Tonghua Incident, was later renamed the Northeast People's Liberation Army, and eventually reorganized into the Fourth Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，在云山战斗期间担任中国人民志愿军第39军军长。
description.en: Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army, who served as the commander of the PVA 39th Corps during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任中国人民解放军中部战区陆军司令员。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the commander of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任第79集团军军长、国防大学联合作战学院院长、中部战区副司令员等职。2022年晋升中将，2023年降为少将。
description.en: A general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, who has served as commander of the 79th Group Army, president of the Joint Operations College of the National Defense University, and deputy commander of the Central Theater Command. He was promoted to lieutenant general in 2022 and demoted to major general.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国湖南省的县，是鲁涤平的出生地。
description.en: A county in Hunan Province, China, the birthplace of Lu Diping.

description.zh-cn: 中国浙江省下辖的地级市，谢群英的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Zhejiang Province, China, and the birthplace of Xie Qunying.

description.zh-cn: 朱德的出生地。

description.en: A municipal district of Meizhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China, and the ancestral home of Xu Fagan and Wu Xiaoguang.

中华民国陆海军大元帅大本营
en: Army and Navy Marshal stronghold of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民政府的前身机构，由孙中山成立。
指依据《中华民国宪法》选举总统并成立宪政政府的事件，标志着国民政府时期结束。
四一二事件后，国民党内部分裂，形成以蒋介石为首的南京国民政府与以汪精卫为首的武汉国民政府对立的政治局面。
description.en: The political split following the April 12th Incident, where the Nanjing-based Nationalist Government led by Chiang Kai-shek opposed the Wuhan-based Nationalist Government led by Wang Jingwei.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山所著，作为国民政府建立之理论依据的文件。
法轮功的创始人、精神领袖。其出生日期存在争议：中国政府称其出生于1952年7月7日，而李洪志本人则称实际生日为1951年5月13日，系文革期间错误登记。他于1992年5月首次在中国公开传授法轮功。1998年获得美国永久居民身份，并在1999年法轮功遭中国政府镇压后，定居美国。
description.en: Founder and spiritual leader of Falun Gong. His birth date is disputed: the Chinese government claims he was born on July 7, 1952, while Li Hongzhi himself states his actual birthday is May 13, 1951, due to a registration error during the Cultural Revolution. He first publicly taught Falun Gong in China in May 1992. He obtained permanent residency in the United States in 1998, and after Falun Gong was suppressed by the Chinese government in 1999, he settled in the U.S.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一个省份，是法轮功的发源地。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China, and the place of origin for Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 由时任中共中央总书记江泽民发起，中华人民共和国政府自1999年7月20日起在中国大陆范围内对法轮功展开的全国性镇压运动，手段包括宣传、监禁、酷刑、强制思想改造及被指控的活摘器官等。
description.en: A nationwide suppression campaign against Falun Gong within mainland China, initiated by then-CCP General Secretary Jiang Zemin and carried out by the government of the People's Republic of China since July 20, 1999. Methods include propaganda, imprisonment, torture, forced ideological conversion, and alleged live organ harvesting.

description.zh-cn: 1999年4月25日，逾万名法轮功学员到北京中南海旁的国家信访局和平上访，要求释放被天津公安抓捕的学员，并争取合法的炼功环境。该事件被江泽民视为对中共政权的挑战，成为其决定镇压的导火索。
description.en: On April 25, 1999, over 10,000 Falun Gong practitioners peacefully gathered at the National Public Complaints and Proposals Administration office near Zhongnanhai in Beijing, demanding the release of practitioners arrested by Tianjin police and seeking a legal environment for their practice. The event was viewed by Jiang Zemin as a challenge to the CCP's authority and became a catalyst for his decision to launch the suppression.

description.zh-cn: 涉及缓慢运动、冥想和控制呼吸等运动，在20世纪80-90年代在中国盛行。
2001年1月23日，中国官方媒体报道有五人在天安门广场自焚，并称他们是法轮功学员。该事件成为中国政府宣传战的转折点，用来在国内外将法轮功描绘成危险的“邪教”，并为镇压提供理由。法轮功方面则指控该事件为政府导演的骗局。
description.en: On January 23, 2001, Chinese state media reported that five people self-immolated on Tiananmen Square, claiming they were Falun Gong practitioners. The incident became a turning point in the Chinese government's propaganda war, used to portray Falun Gong domestically and internationally as a dangerous 'cult' and to justify the suppression. Falun Gong sources have alleged the incident was a staged hoax by the government.

description.zh-cn: 由法轮功学员创办的媒体，是大纪元传媒集团的子公司。因发表《九评共产党》社论而知名，并引发了退党运动。在西方被广泛认为是政治上极右翼的媒体实体。
description.en: A media outlet founded by Falun Gong practitioners, a subsidiary of the Epoch Media Group. It is known for publishing the editorial series 'Nine Commentaries on the Communist Party' and initiating the Tuidang movement. It is widely considered a far-right political media entity in the West.

en: Nine Commentaries on the Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 由《大纪元时报》发表的系列社论，对共产主义和中国共产党的历史与意识形态进行批判，称中共本质上是邪教，并引发了“退党运动”。
description.en: A series of editorials published by The Epoch Times that criticizes the history and ideology of Communism and the Chinese Communist Party, labeling the CCP as an evil cult and sparking the 'Tuidang movement'.

description.zh-cn: 由《九评共产党》引发的，鼓励中国公民声明退出中国共产党及其附属组织（共青团、少先队）的运动。
description.en: A movement sparked by the 'Nine Commentaries on the Communist Party' that encourages Chinese citizens to declare their withdrawal from the Chinese Communist Party and its affiliated organizations (the Communist Youth League and the Young Pioneers).

description.zh-cn: 1985年由中国官方成立的组织，负责监督和管理气功运动。法轮功研究会曾是其直属分会，但在1996年因拒绝成立党支部等要求而主动退出。
description.en: An official organization established in 1985 to supervise and manage the qigong movement. The Falun Gong Research Society was once its direct branch but voluntarily withdrew in 1996 after refusing requirements such as establishing a CCP branch.

description.zh-cn: 美国的立法机构，由参议院和众议院组成。曾通过多项决议，要求中国政府停止镇压法轮功，并谴责强摘法轮功学员器官的行为。其议员还曾提出将中国驻华盛顿大使馆外的街道改名为“李文亮广场”。
description.en: The legislature of the United States, composed of the Senate and the House of Representatives. It has passed multiple resolutions calling on the Chinese government to stop the persecution of Falun Gong and condemning the practice of organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners. Its members also proposed renaming the street outside the Chinese embassy in Washington to 'Li Wenliang Plaza'.

description.zh-cn: 神韵艺术团是一家2006年在美国纽约成立的表演艺术团体，由海外法轮功学员创办。公司以中国古典舞和传统音乐为特色，旨在复兴中华传统文化。其演出内容常包含对法轮功在中国受迫害的描绘。李洪志担任其艺术总监。
description.en: Shen Yun Performing Arts is a performing arts company established in New York, USA, in 2006, founded by overseas Falun Gong practitioners. The company specializes in classical Chinese dance and traditional music, aiming to revive traditional Chinese culture. Its performances often include depictions of the persecution of Falun Gong in China. Li Hongzhi serves as its Artistic Director.

zh-cn: 对中国共产党摘取法轮功学员及良心犯器官的指控
en: Forced organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners in China
Allegations of organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners and prisoners of conscience in China

description.zh-cn: 一系列指控，称中华人民共和国政府，特别是其军方和政法委系统，大规模系统性地活体摘取法轮功学员及其他良心犯的器官用于移植手术并牟利。这些指控和相关报导已引起联合国、美国国会、欧洲议会等国际组织的广泛关注和调查。
description.en: A series of allegations claiming that the government of the People's Republic of China, particularly its military and political-legal commission systems, has engaged in large-scale, systematic live organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners and other prisoners of conscience for transplantation surgery and profit. These allegations and related reports have drawn extensive attention and investigation from international bodies such as the United Nations, the U.S. Congress, and the European Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 中国维权律师
美国政治家，曾任中央情报局局长和国务卿。在其2020年题为《共产中国与自由世界的未来》的演讲中提及魏京生，并对维基解密持敌对态度。2021年，他与时任驻美代表的萧美琴在双橡园会晤。他曾对香港民主派初选大搜捕表示愤慨，并促请当局释放被捕人士。
description.en: An American politician who served as Director of the Central Intelligence Agency and Secretary of State. In his 2020 speech titled 'Communist China and the Free World's Future,' he mentioned Wei Jingsheng and held a hostile stance against WikiLeaks. In 2021, he met with then-Representative Hsiao Bi-khim at Twin Oaks. As Secretary of State, he also expressed outrage at the Hong Kong pro-democracy primaries mass arrests and urged the authorities to release the arrested individuals.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个亲中共政治团体，被指控多次对法轮功学员实施暴力和语言攻击。其秘书长张秀叶等人被台北地检署起诉，指控其收取中共资金在台发展组织并执行攻击法轮功成员等任务。
description.en: A pro-CCP political group in Taiwan, accused of repeatedly carrying out violent and verbal attacks against Falun Gong practitioners. Its secretary-general, Zhang Xiuye, and others were indicted by the Taipei District Prosecutors Office for allegedly receiving funds from the CCP to develop organizations in Taiwan and execute tasks such as attacking Falun Gong members.

description.zh-cn: 香港一个亲北京团体，被指多次对在街头活动的法轮功团体进行暴力骚扰、威胁和闹场。
description.en: A pro-Beijing group in Hong Kong, accused of repeatedly engaging in violent harassment, threats, and disruptions against Falun Gong groups conducting activities on the streets.

description.zh-cn: 日本第126代天皇，年号为“令和”。为上皇明仁与上皇后美智子的长子，也是石破茂担任内阁总理大臣期间的国家元首。
description.en: The 126th Emperor of Japan, his reign name is 'Reiwa'. He is the eldest son of Emperor Emeritus Akihito and Empress Emerita Michiko, and the head of state during Shigeru Ishiba's tenure as Prime Minister.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日本东京都千代田区皇居宫内厅医院
birth_place.en: Imperial Household Agency Hospital, Tokyo Imperial Palace, Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，曾任第102-103任内阁总理大臣及自由民主党总裁，历任防卫大臣、农林水产大臣、自由民主党干事长等要职。现任日本内阁总理大臣。其领导的内阁在2025年3月表示《中日联合声明》不具有法律约束力。
description.en: Japanese politician who served as the 102nd and 103rd Prime Minister of Japan and President of the Liberal Democratic Party, holding key posts including Minister of Defense, Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, and LDP Secretary-General. He is the current Prime Minister of Japan, and his cabinet stated in March 2025 that the Sino-Japanese Joint Communiqué is not legally binding.

description.zh-cn: 日本众议院议长
日本国会的下议院。安倍晋三自1993年起连续十次当选众议院议员，直至2022年任内去世。
description.en: The lower house of the National Diet of Japan. Shinzo Abe was elected to the House of Representatives for ten consecutive terms from 1993 until his death in office in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 日本参议院议长
日本国会的上议院
日本最高裁判所长官，于2024年8月16日就任。
description.en: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Japan, assumed office on August 16, 2024.

location.zh-cn: 东京都千代田区隼町4番2号

description.zh-cn: 日本的最高法院及最高司法机关，根据《日本国宪法》设立，拥有对法律的最终解释权和违宪审查权。
description.en: The highest court and supreme judicial body in Japan, established under the Constitution of Japan, with ultimate judicial authority to interpret the law and conduct constitutional review.

zh-cn: 神日本磐余彦火火出见天皇

description.zh-cn: 传说中日本的初代天皇
日本飞鸟时代豪族苏我氏的头目
日本飞鸟时代豪族
日本第38代天皇（天智天皇）
日本飞鸟时代豪族
中大兄皇子和中臣镰足暗杀苏我入鹿的政变事件
镰仓幕府首任征夷大将军
由成吉思汗于13世纪建立的横跨欧亚大陆的帝国，它是元朝的前身，后灭亡金朝与南宋，并西征灭亡了阿拔斯王朝。蒙哥是其第四位大汗。
description.en: An empire founded by Genghis Khan in the 13th century, which spanned across Eurasia and was a predecessor to the Yuan Dynasty. It led to the fall of the Jin Dynasty and Southern Song Dynasty, and its westward expansion led to the fall of the Abbasid Caliphate. Möngke was its fourth Great Khan.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代末期、安土桃山时代的武将、战国大名，江户幕府第一代征夷大将军。
description.en: A warlord and daimyō of the late Sengoku and Azuchi-Momoyama periods of Japan, and the first shōgun of the Edo shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 由德川家康建立的日本最后一个幕府，也是日本历史上最后一个武家政权和封建军事政府。其统治中心位于江户，在戊辰战争后被推翻，并于1868年被明治新政府取代。著名思想家福泽谕吉曾受雇于幕府从事翻译工作，并随其使节团出访欧美。
description.en: Founded by Tokugawa Ieyasu, it was the last shogunate of Japan, and also the last samurai and feudal military government in Japanese history. Its center of power was located in Edo. It was overthrown after the Boshin War and was replaced by the Meiji government in 1868. The renowned thinker Fukuzawa Yukichi was employed by the shogunate as a translator and accompanied its missions to Europe and America.

description.zh-cn: 由丰臣秀吉建立的武家政权
美国海军准将，率领黑船舰队迫使日本开港
美国海军准将马休·佩里率舰队强迫日本开放港口，被广泛认为是明治维新的开端之一。
description.en: The event where U.S. Navy Commodore Matthew C. Perry compelled Japan to open its ports, widely considered one of the starting points of the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 指日本在19世纪后期、幕末至明治时代初期间推行的一系列政治、经济和社会近代化改革运动。旨在使日本现代化，摆脱并终结封建制度，建立现代国家。福泽谕吉是该运动重要的思想推动者之一。维新后武士的失业问题亦成为征韩论的背景之一。
description.en: A series of political, economic, and social modernization reforms implemented in Japan in the late 19th century, from the end of the Edo period to the beginning of the Meiji period. These reforms aimed at modernizing the country, abolishing its feudal system, and establishing a modern state. Fukuzawa Yukichi was a key intellectual promoter of this movement, and the resulting unemployment of the samurai class was one of the background factors for the Seikanron.

location.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛、辽东半岛、山东、威海、黄海、澎湖

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争，是1894年至1895年间清朝（大清帝国）与大日本帝国之间因朝鲜问题爆发的一场大规模战争。此战以清朝惨败告终，北洋水师全军覆没。日本获胜后，获得了台湾和澎湖群岛的主权。中国的惨败极大地刺激了知识分子，促使他们更积极地向西方学习。福泽谕吉曾将其描述为“文野之战”，日本的战争赔款还用于建立京都帝国大学。
description.en: The First Sino-Japanese War was a major conflict that erupted between the Qing dynasty (Qing Empire) of China and the Empire of Japan between 1894 and 1895, primarily over the issue of Korea. It ended in a decisive defeat for the Qing, with the Beiyang Fleet being annihilated. Following Japan's victory, it acquired sovereignty over Taiwan and the Penghu Islands. China's devastating defeat profoundly stimulated Chinese intellectuals to more actively learn from the West. Fukuzawa Yukichi described it as a 'war between civilization and barbarism', and Japan's war indemnity was also used to establish Kyoto Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战时的军事同盟，由德国、意大利、日本等国组成。

zh-cn: 同盟国 (第二次世界大战)

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战中对抗轴心国的国家联盟。通过“火炬行动”和“诺曼底登陆”等军事行动，最终击败了德国、解放了法国，并要求日本无条件投降。其战俘也是731部队人体实验的受害者。
description.en: The alliance of countries that fought against the Axis powers in World War II. Through military operations such as Operation Torch and the Normandy landings, they ultimately defeated Germany, liberated France, and demanded Japan's unconditional surrender. Its prisoners of war were also victims of Unit 731's human experiments.

description.zh-cn: 1941年12月7日，大日本帝国海军对美国夏威夷领地珍珠港海军基地发动突袭，标志着太平洋战争爆发，美国由此加入第二次世界大战，是二战的重要转折点。
description.en: On December 7, 1941, the Imperial Japanese Navy launched a surprise attack on the U.S. naval base at Pearl Harbor in the Territory of Hawaii. This marked the outbreak of the Pacific War, leading the United States to join World War II, and was a significant turning point in the war.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三是日本自由民主党籍政治人物，曾任第90、96、97、98任内阁总理大臣，是日本宪政史上在任时间最长的首相。他以推行“安倍经济学”、强化美日同盟、主导《跨太平洋伙伴全面进步协定》而闻名。曾于2012年自民党总裁选举中击败石破茂，并任命其为自民党干事长。他也是南加州大学校友。2022年7月8日，他在奈良市进行选举演说时遇刺身亡。
description.en: Shinzo Abe was a Japanese politician of the Liberal Democratic Party, who served as the 90th, 96th, 97th, and 98th Prime Minister of Japan, becoming the longest-serving prime minister in Japanese constitutional history. He was known for his 'Abenomics' economic policies, strengthening the U.S.-Japan alliance, and leading the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership. He defeated Shigeru Ishiba in the 2012 LDP presidential election and later appointed him as LDP Secretary-General. An alumnus of the University of Southern California, he was assassinated on July 8, 2022, while delivering a campaign speech in Nara.

description.zh-cn: 2022年7月8日，日本前内阁总理大臣安倍晋三在奈良市进行选举演说时遭枪击身亡的事件。该事件对日本社会造成巨大冲击。
description.en: The event on July 8, 2022, in which former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe was shot and killed while delivering a campaign speech in Nara. The incident sent shockwaves through Japanese society.

description.zh-cn: 由东斯拉夫人建立的第一个东斯拉夫国家

俄罗斯帝国，存在于1721年至1917年间，是俄罗斯历史上的一个帝国。作为七年战争的主要参战国，它起初与奥地利和法国结盟对抗普鲁士，但在1762年彼得三世即位后倒戈与普鲁士结盟，其继任者叶卡捷琳娜二世随后退出战争。帝国曾在北美拥有殖民地（俄属北美），并于1867年将阿拉斯加出售给美国。它曾于1783年吞并克里米亚汗国，并参与克里米亚战争及日俄战争（战败）。在第二次鸦片战争中，通过《北京条约》攫取中国北方大片领土。它还参与瓜分波兰立陶宛联邦，长期统治立陶宛，并曾与清朝就伊犁问题进行交涉。林则徐曾警惕其威胁。巴枯宁出生时，作为当时的执政政权，曾没收其财产并对其进行长期监禁和流放。同时，它也是协约国的主要成员国之一，但于1917年退出战争。
description.en: The Russian Empire, an empire in Russian history, existed from 1721 to 1917. As a major participant in the Seven Years' War, it initially allied with Austria and France against Prussia. In 1762, after Peter III ascended the throne, Russia switched sides to ally with Prussia, and his successor Catherine the Great later withdrew from the war. It held colonies in North America (Russian America) and sold Alaska to the United States in 1867. The empire annexed the Crimean Khanate in 1783, participated in the Crimean War and the Russo-Japanese War (where it was defeated). During the Second Opium War, it acquired vast territories in northern China through the Convention of Peking. It also participated in the partitions of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and ruled over Lithuania for a long period. It negotiated with the Qing Dynasty over the Ili issue. Lin Zexu was wary of its growing threat. As the ruling power during Bakunin's birth, the imperial authorities confiscated his property and subjected him to long-term imprisonment and exile due to his revolutionary activities. It was also one of the main member states of the Entente Powers, but withdrew from the war in 1917.
