description.en: The supreme commander of the armed forces of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 指与广东省有任职背景或与习仲勋主政广东有关联的官员群体。亦可指民国时期的军阀派系，主要势力范围在广东地区，受苏联支持。
description.en: Refers to a group of officials with a background in Guangdong or connected to Xi Zhongxun's governance in Guangdong. It can also refer to a warlord clique during the Republican era, with its main sphere of influence in the Guangdong region, supported by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市市长（龚正的前任）和中共上海市委副书记。现任中华人民共和国最高人民检察院党组书记、检察长。他曾公开表态，强调对符合条件的未成年人严重犯罪要依法追究刑事责任。
description.en: Chinese politician. He previously served as Mayor of Shanghai (Gong Zheng's predecessor) and Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee. Currently, he is the Party Secretary and Prosecutor General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China. He has publicly stated that minors who commit serious crimes and meet the criteria should be held criminally responsible according to the law.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，现任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员。此前曾为陆军中将，并担任中央军事委员会办公厅主任。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, currently serving as the Political Commissar of the PLA National Defence University. He previously held the rank of lieutenant general and also served as the Director of the General Office of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，曾任司法部部长（傅政华的继任）、江西省政协主席，也曾担任郑栅洁的前任中共浙江省委专职副书记和中共宁波市委书记。2024年因严重违纪违法被查处。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Minister of Justice (succeeding Fu Zhenghua), Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial CPPCC, and previously as Zheng Shanjie's predecessor as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial CPC Committee and Secretary of the Ningbo Municipal CPC Committee. He was investigated in 2024 for severe disciplinary violations.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯的叔父及嗣父。
袁世凯的长子，曾积极推动其父称帝。
description.en: Yuan Shikai's eldest son, who actively encouraged his father to become emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清末淮军将领，袁世凯早期的提携者。
description.en: A Huai Army general in the late Qing dynasty and an early patron of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初及北洋政府时期政治家，袁世凯的盟友。他曾任中华民国国务卿，并于1918年至1922年间担任中华民国大总统，也曾出任东三省总督。
description.en: A politician during the late Qing Dynasty and Beiyang Government era, and an ally of Yuan Shikai. He served as Secretary of State and President of the Republic of China (1918-1922), and also as Governor-General of the Three Northeastern Provinces.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣、政治家和军事家，满洲正白旗人。他是保守派代表，慈禧太后的心腹。从袁世凯处获悉维新派计划后，协助慈禧发动戊戌政变。他是载沣的岳父，也是溥仪的外祖父。
description.en: A prominent minister, statesman, and military leader in the late Qing dynasty, a Manchu of the Plain White Banner. He was a powerful conservative and a confidant of Empress Dowager Cixi. After learning of the reformists' plans from Yuan Shikai, he assisted Cixi in launching the Wuxu Coup. He was the father-in-law of Zaifeng and the maternal grandfather of Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 晚清维新派领袖、政治家和思想家，梁启超的老师。他是戊戌变法的主要策划者和领导者之一。变法失败后流亡海外，组织保皇会，主张君主立宪，并曾试图将儒家改造为国教（孔教）。他亦曾为自立军起义募集资金。后期，他积极参与策划张勋复辟，并在复辟后被任命为弼德院副院长，被视为“新十三太保”之一。
description.en: A leader of the late Qing reformists, a politician and thinker, and Liang Qichao's teacher. He was a key planner and leader of the Hundred Days' Reform. After the reform failed, he lived in exile, organized the Baohuang Hui (Protect the Emperor Society), advocated for a constitutional monarchy, and attempted to establish Confucianism as the state religion (the Confucian Church). He also raised funds for the Self-Support Army Uprising. In his later years, he actively participated in planning Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration and was appointed Vice President of the Bideyuan (Council of Eldest Statesmen) after the restoration, being regarded as one of the 'New Thirteen Protectors'.

description.zh-cn: 清末维新派政治家、思想家，戊戌变法核心人物之一，亦是戊戌六君子之一。其思想深远，影响了杨昌济等人。他曾于南京记录下当地父老对湘军暴行的“犹深愤恨”的情形。
description.en: A reformist politician and thinker of the late Qing Dynasty, a key figure in the Hundred Days' Reform, and one of the 'Six Gentlemen of the Wuxu Reform'. His ideas profoundly influenced figures like Yang Changji. He once visited Nanjing and recorded local elders' 'deep hatred' for the atrocities committed by the Xiang Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家。曾任军政府鄂军都督、大元帅，中华民国临时副总统、第一任副总统，后继任第二、三任大总统。在总统任期内，因府院之争免去段祺瑞总理职务，后召张勋入京调停，反被其逼迫解散国会并推翻，导致总统职位倒台。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Military Governor of Hubei and Grand Marshal. He was the Provisional Vice President and the first Vice President of the Republic of China, subsequently becoming the second and third President. During his presidency, a dispute between the government and parliament led him to dismiss Premier Duan Qirui. His subsequent invitation to Zhang Xun for mediation resulted in Zhang Xun forcing the dissolution of parliament and his overthrow, leading to the collapse of his presidential term.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治家、军事人物，北洋军阀皖系首领。曾是袁世凯手下重要将领，历任参谋总长、国务总理。在赵秉钧辞职后曾代理国务总理。甲子政变后，被张作霖和冯玉祥推举为中华民国临时执政。他在北洋政府时期发挥重要作用，因在清帝退位、抵制洪宪帝制和讨伐张勋复辟中的贡献，被誉为“三造共和”。
description.en: A Chinese politician and military figure, leader of the Anhui clique. He was an important general under Yuan Shikai, serving as Chief of the General Staff and Premier. He also served as acting Premier after Zhao Bingjun's resignation. After the Beijing Coup, he was installed as the Provisional Chief Executive of the Republic of China by Zhang Zuolin and Feng Yuxiang. He played a significant role during the Beiyang Government period, and is known for his contributions in forcing the Qing emperor's abdication, resisting the Hongxian Monarchy, and suppressing the Manchu Restoration, earning him the moniker 'the three-time creator of the Republic'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，袁世凯手下重要将领，“北洋三杰”之一，北洋军阀直系首领。曾任中华民国北洋政府副总统，后通电反对张勋复辟，并在南京就任代理总统。
description.en: A Chinese general, one of the 'Three Distinguished of Beiyang', and a prominent leader of the Zhili clique. He served as Vice President of the Beiyang Government of the Republic of China, and later opposed Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration via telegram, subsequently assuming the acting presidency in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代政治活动家，筹安会发起人，积极推动袁世凯称帝。
description.en: A Chinese politician active in the late Qing and early Republican periods, founder of the Chou'anhui, who actively promoted Yuan Shikai's monarchical ambitions.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝的皇后，宣统帝（溥仪）的嗣母，慈禧太后的侄女。她是清朝最后一位实际掌权者。宣统年间与载沣共同作为最高统治者，拥有重大事件的最终决定权，垂帘听政，并最终代表宣统帝颁布退位诏书。
description.en: The empress consort of the Guangxu Emperor, adoptive mother of the Xuantong Emperor, and a niece of Empress Dowager Cixi. She was the last de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty. During the Xuantong era, she served as co-supreme ruler with Zaifeng, holding the final decision-making power on major events, and ultimately issued the abdication edict on behalf of the Xuantong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年由袁世凯在小站编练的现代化新式陆军。该军原名定武军，由袁世凯在小站练兵时对其改编而成，后改称新建陆军，是北洋军的直接前身。
description.en: A modernized army established by Yuan Shikai at Xiaozhan in the late Qing Dynasty. Originally known as the Dingwu Army, it was reorganized by Yuan Shikai during the Xiaozhan training period, and later renamed the Newly Created Army. It served as the direct predecessor of the Beiyang Army.

en: Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening

description.zh-cn: 清末维新派在北京成立的政治团体，旨在推动变法维新。
description.en: A political group founded by reformists in Beijing during the late Qing dynasty to promote political reform and modernization.

description.zh-cn: 由宋教仁主导，将中国同盟会改组并联合其他党派而成的政党，在1913年国会选举中获胜，成为第一大党。
description.en: A political party led by Song Jiaoren, formed by reorganizing the Tongmenghui and uniting with other parties, which won the 1913 parliamentary election.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯发起复辟帝制，建立中华帝国的政治运动。这是一个由袁世凯筹备建立的君主立宪制国家，年号洪宪，旨在取代中华民国。此举引发护国运动，最终被迫取消并以失败告终。
description.en: A political movement initiated by Yuan Shikai to restore the monarchy and establish the Empire of China. This constitutional monarchy, with the era name Hongxian, was intended to replace the Republic of China. The short-lived endeavor triggered the National Protection War, leading to its forced abolition and ultimate failure.

description.zh-cn: 由杨度等人发起，旨在为袁世凯称帝制造舆论和理论支持的政治团体。时任司法总长的章宗祥曾否定其违法性。
description.en: A political group initiated by Yang Du and others, aimed at creating public opinion and theoretical support for Yuan Shikai's enthronement. Zhang Zongxiang, then Minister of Justice, denied its illegality.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪末在中国北方兴起的一场以“扶清灭洋”为口号的武装排外运动。该运动得到部分清朝官员（如毓贤）的支持，最终导致了八国联军入侵中国。
description.en: An armed anti-foreign uprising in Northern China at the end of the 19th century under the slogan 'Support the Qing, exterminate the foreigners.' The movement received support from some Qing officials, such as Yuxian, and ultimately led to the invasion of China by the Eight-Nation Alliance.

en: Mutual Defense Pact of the Southeastern Provinces

description.zh-cn: 清末八国联军侵华（义和团运动）期间，中国东南各省督抚违抗清廷命令，与列强私下达成和平协议，旨在避免与列强开战并维护辖区和平稳定。这是一场重要的政治运动。
description.en: During the late Qing Dynasty's Boxer Rebellion, which involved the Eight-Nation Alliance invasion, governors of southeastern Chinese provinces defied imperial orders to declare war on foreign powers. They instead privately negotiated agreements to avoid conflict and maintain peace and stability within their jurisdictions. This was a significant political movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期设置的特别行政区，大致范围为今北京市，是杨昌济的逝世地。
description.en: A special administrative region established during the Beiyang Government of the Republic of China, roughly corresponding to present-day Beijing. It is the place of Yang Changji's death.

description.zh-cn: 马云的妻子，在杭州师范学院读书时与马云相识。
description.en: Jack Ma's wife, whom he met while studying at Hangzhou Normal College.

description.zh-cn: 马云与张瑛的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Jack Ma and Zhang Ying.

description.zh-cn: 马云的父亲，浙江省一家戏剧协会负责人。
description.en: Jack Ma's father, head of a drama association in Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 马云的母亲。
description.en: Jack Ma's mother.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国浙江省杭州市的一所公立高等院校，也是马云的母校。
description.en: A public higher education institution in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, and Jack Ma's alma mater.

description.zh-cn: 由马云创立的中国在线购物平台。
description.en: A Chinese online shopping platform founded by Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 由马云创立的中国第三方移动和在线支付平台。
description.en: A Chinese third-party mobile and online payment platform founded by Jack Ma.

zh-cn: 浙江蚂蚁小微金融服务集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团的关联公司，旗下拥有中国最大的数字支付平台支付宝。
description.en: An affiliate company of Alibaba Group, which owns Alipay, China's largest digital payment platform.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国浙江省杭州市的一所大学，马云曾在此从事英语教学工作。
description.en: A university in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, where Jack Ma once worked as an English teacher.

zh-cn: 中国银行保险监督管理委员会
中国银行业监督管理委员会
en: China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院直属事业单位，负责统一监督管理银行业和保险业。
description.en: An agency of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, authorized to supervise the banking and insurance industries.

zh-cn: 中国证券监督管理委员会

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区金融大街19号富凯大厦A座

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院直属事业单位，作为金融监管机构，负责证券、期货市场的监督管理。
description.en: A direct institution under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the supervision and management of the securities and futures markets.

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区金融大街30号
location.en: No. 30, Jinrong Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局是中华人民共和国国务院主管外汇和国际收支工作的国家局，由中国人民银行管理。它负责国家外汇收支、买卖、借贷、转移以及国际间的结算、外汇汇率和外汇市场的管理。
description.en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) is an administrative agency under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, managed by the People's Bank of China. It is responsible for managing the country's foreign exchange balance of payments, buying and selling, lending, transfers, international settlements, exchange rates, and the foreign exchange market.

description.zh-cn: 国际功夫巨星、动作演员、佛教徒、慈善家、企业家。他与马云联合创办太极禅苑，并共同出演电影《功守道》。
description.en: International kung fu star, action actor, Buddhist, philanthropist, and entrepreneur. He co-founded Taijizen with Jack Ma and co-starred with him in the film 'Gong Shou Dao'.

description.zh-cn: 由马云和李连杰联合创办，旨在推广太极文化。
description.en: Co-founded by Jack Ma and Jet Li to promote Tai Chi culture.

description.zh-cn: 一家中国电子商务公司，与新浪于2017年签署“京浪计划”战略合作，同时也是阿里巴巴集团在中国电子商务领域的主要竞争对手之一。
description.en: A Chinese e-commerce company that signed the 'Jing-Lang Plan' strategic cooperation with Sina in 2017, and is also one of Alibaba Group's main competitors in the Chinese e-commerce sector.

description.zh-cn: 中国浙江省省会，历史悠久。曾是南宋都城，民族英雄岳飞遇害及安葬于此。唐代诗人白居易曾任刺史，政绩卓著，修筑西湖堤防，疏浚六井。同时，这里也是现代商业巨头马云的出生地，以及阿里巴巴集团的总部所在地，也是波士顿的友好城市之一。
description.en: The capital of Zhejiang Province, China, with a rich history. It once served as the capital of the Southern Song Dynasty and is the site where national hero Yue Fei was martyred and buried. During the Tang Dynasty, the poet Bai Juyi served as its prefect, achieving remarkable success in constructing the West Lake embankment and dredging the Six Wells. Furthermore, it is also the birthplace of modern business magnate Jack Ma and the headquarters of Alibaba Group, and is one of Boston's sister cities.

zh-cn: 加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校
加利福尼亚大学柏克莱分校

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州伯克利市的世界著名公立研究型大学，是加利福尼亚大学系统的创始大学。
description.en: A world-renowned public research university located in Berkeley, California, USA, and the founding campus of the University of California system.

location.zh-cn: 帕萨迪纳 (加利福尼亚州)

description.zh-cn: 钱学森获得博士学位的大学，并曾在此任教及领导研究中心。
description.en: The university where Qian Xuesen received his Ph.D., taught, and directed a research center.

description.zh-cn: 位于加州理工学院的美国宇航研发机构，钱学森是其主要创建者之一。
description.en: An American aerospace research and development laboratory at Caltech, of which Qian Xuesen was a major founder.

location.zh-cn: 美国马萨诸塞州剑桥市

description.zh-cn: 位于美国马萨诸塞州剑桥市的私立研究型大学，成立于1861年，以其在物理科学和工程学的教育和研究而闻名。这里曾是钱学森获得理学硕士学位并任教的地方，宋彬彬也于1989年在此获得地球化学博士学位。
description.en: A private research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA, founded in 1861, renowned for its education and research in the physical sciences and engineering. Qian Xuesen received his Master of Science degree here and later taught, and Song Binbin obtained her PhD in geochemistry here in 1989.

zh-cn: 中国科学院力学研究所
en: Institute of Mechanics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院下属的力学研究机构。由钱学森回国后与钱伟长、郭永怀等共同创建，并担任首任所长。
description.en: An institute under the Chinese Academy of Sciences specializing in mechanics research. It was co-founded by Qian Xuesen, Qian Weichang, Guo Yonghuai, and others after Qian Xuesen's return to China, with Qian Xuesen serving as its first director.

description.zh-cn: 中国声乐家，钱学森的夫人。
description.en: Chinese vocalist, wife of Qian Xuesen.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森之女，儿科医生。
匈牙利裔美国工程师和物理学家，是空气动力学领域的权威。他曾是钱学森在加州理工学院的博士导师。
description.en: Hungarian-American engineer and physicist, an authority in the field of aerodynamics. He was Qian Xuesen's doctoral advisor at Caltech.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理学家，钱学森在加州理工学院指导的博士生。
description.en: Chinese physicist, who was Qian Xuesen's doctoral student at Caltech.

description.zh-cn: 教育家和文史专家，钱学森之父。
空气动力学教授，钱学森在清华大学的导师。
德国火箭科学家。
美国海军部次长。
中华民国军事教育家、中国近代军事理论家。他是著名科学家钱学森夫人蒋英的父亲，也是蔡锷的同庚与莫逆之交。
description.en: A military educator and modern military theorist of the Republic of China. He was the father of Jiang Ying, wife of the renowned scientist Qian Xuesen, and also a peer and close friend of Cai E.

description.zh-cn: 香港著名武侠小说作家、《明报》创办人，与倪匡、黄沾、蔡澜并列为“香港四大才子”。他也是倪匡的好友，曾鼓励倪匡创作《卫斯理系列》。在其封笔后，还曾亲自为旗下的《明报》向古龙邀稿《陆小凤系列》。
description.en: A renowned Hong Kong wuxia novelist and founder of Ming Pao. He is known as one of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong' along with Ni Kuang, James Wong and Chua Lam. He was also a close friend of Ni Kuang and encouraged him to create the 'Wisely Series'. After he stopped writing novels, he personally invited Gu Long to write the 'Lu Xiaofeng Series' for his newspaper, Ming Pao.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河北省保定市下辖的一个县，是齐心的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Baoding City, Hebei Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Qi Xin.

zh-cn: 抗日军政大学第一分校
en: First Branch of the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University
First Branch School of the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University

description.zh-cn: 中国人民抗日军事政治大学在晋东南地区设立的分校，简称“抗大”。
description.en: A branch of the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University established in the southeast of Shanxi province, also known as 'Kangda'.

zh-cn: 北平市立第一女子中学

description.zh-cn: 北京市的一所重点中学。
description.en: A key middle school in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 齐安安的丈夫。
description.en: Qi An'an's husband.

description.zh-cn: 齐心的父亲，曾任国民革命军军法处长、县长等职，并在冯玉祥和傅作义的部队任职。
description.en: Qi Xin's father, who served as Director of the Military Justice Department of the National Revolutionary Army and county magistrate, and also served in the forces of Feng Yuxiang and Fu Zuoyi.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅的原配妻子。
鲁迅的伴侣，鲁迅的学生。
鲁迅与许广平之子。
鲁迅的父亲。
鲁迅的母亲。
鲁迅的祖父。
鲁迅的私塾老师。
寿镜吾开设的私塾，鲁迅曾在此就读。
清末新式学堂。
中国画家，鲁迅在南京矿路学堂的同学。
位于日本东京的教育机构，专为中国留学生创办并提供教育。陈独秀、杨昌济和黄兴曾在此留学。
description.en: An educational institution in Tokyo, Japan, specifically founded for and providing education to Chinese students. Chen Duxiu, Yang Changji, and Huang Xing once studied here.

description.en: A revolutionary organization in the late Qing Dynasty. Shao Yuxuan had secret dealings with it. It merged into the Tongmenghui in 1905 but later withdrew due to disagreements with Sun Yat-sen.

description.en: The highest administrative body for national education affairs during the Nationalist Government period of the Republic of China. Peiyang University was under its direct jurisdiction from 1912, and it led the university's departmental restructuring in 1917. This body also approved the upgrade of Chinese Culture College to Chinese Culture University in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代作家、文学评论家、文化活动家和社会活动家，曾任中国作家协会主席（巴金的前任）。

description.zh-cn: 四通利方公司（SRSNet）于1993年由四通集团公司、王志东和严援朝在北京中关村共同创办。1998年，该公司与华渊资讯合并，共同组建新浪（Sina）。新浪作为一家服务中国大陆及全球华人社群的中文网络内容提供商，与腾讯、搜狐和网易并称中国四大门户网站之一。2007年，新浪与谷歌达成战略合作关系。
description.en: SRSNet, a Chinese software company, was co-founded in Zhongguancun, Beijing, in 1993 by Stone Group, Wang Zhidong, and Yan Yuanchao. In 1998, it merged with Sinanet to form Sina. Sina became a Chinese online media company serving China and the global Chinese communities, recognized as one of the four major portal websites in China, alongside Tencent, Sohu, and NetEase. In 2007, Sina formed a strategic partnership with Google.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国民政部部长。

胡锦涛二十大离场事件
en: Hu Jintao incident at the 20th CCP National Congress
Hu Jintao's departure from the 20th CCP National Congress

description.zh-cn: 中共二十大闭幕会上，前中共中央总书记胡锦涛被工作人员从主席台带离会场。此事件被外界广泛解读为团派失势的象征性时刻。
description.en: The incident where former CPC General Secretary Hu Jintao was escorted off the rostrum by staff during the closing session of the 20th CPC National Congress. It was widely interpreted as a symbolic moment of the Tuanpai's loss of power.

description.zh-cn: 明朝是中国历史上继元朝之后的大一统王朝，也是最后一个由汉族统治的帝制王朝。由朱元璋建立，马皇后为其首位皇后。其间改行中书省为承宣布政使司。明成祖时期，北京故宫开始建造并作为其后的主要皇宫。嘉靖大地震也发生于该朝代统治期间。李成梁曾为其效力。该王朝最终于1644年被李自成所灭。
description.en: The Ming Dynasty was a unified imperial dynasty in Chinese history, following the Yuan Dynasty, and the last imperial dynasty ruled by Han Chinese. Founded by Zhu Yuanzhang, with Empress Ma as its first empress, it reformed the Central Secretariat into the Provincial Administration Commission. During the reign of the Yongle Emperor, the Forbidden City in Beijing was built and became the main imperial palace. The Jiajing Great Earthquake also occurred during its rule. Li Chengliang once served this regime. The dynasty was eventually overthrown by Li Zicheng in 1644.

description.zh-cn: 由忽必烈建立的中国历史上由蒙古族建立的大一统王朝，追尊蒙哥为宪宗桓肃皇帝。其设立行中书省作为一级地方行政区划，官场上使用空印文书的习惯做法被明朝沿用，并最终引发了空印案。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty founded by Kublai Khan, and established by the Mongols, which posthumously honored Möngke as Emperor Xianzong Huansu. The bureaucratic practice of using empty-sealed documents, inherited from the Yuan, led to the Empty Seal Case in the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元末红巾军领袖之一，朱元璋早期的上司，马皇后的养父。
description.en: A leader of the Red Turban Rebellion during the late Yuan dynasty, Zhu Yuanzhang's early superior, and the adoptive father of Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋的原配妻子和皇后，郭子兴的养女，朱高煦之祖母。她以贤惠、仁慈、节俭著称，在朱元璋早年困难时期给予支持，成为皇后後仍保持简朴。她常劝谏朱元璋，挽救多位大臣性命，同时不干预朝政，限制外戚势力。她深受后人敬仰，死后朱元璋誓言不再立后。
description.en: The primary consort and empress of Zhu Yuanzhang, the Hongwu Emperor. She was the adoptive daughter of Guo Zixing and grandmother of Zhu Gaoxu. Renowned for her kindness, wisdom, and frugality, she supported Zhu Yuanzhang during his early difficult years and maintained a simple lifestyle even after becoming empress. She often advised the emperor, saving the lives of several ministers. She refrained from interfering in court politics and limiting the power of imperial relatives, earning deep respect from later generations. After her death, the Hongwu Emperor vowed never to create another empress.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初的群雄之一，汉政权建立者
元末明初的群雄之一，吴政权建立者
明朝开国军事统帅，位列开国“六王”之首，封中山武宁王，曾封魏国公。他率军攻陷元大都，是朱高煦之外祖父。他对胡惟庸极为厌恶，并向朱元璋密报其奸行。
description.en: A founding military marshal of the Ming Dynasty, ranked first among the six founding 'kings', enfeoffed as Prince of Zhongshan and once as Duke of Wei. He led his army to capture Yuan Dadu and was the maternal grandfather of Zhu Gaoxu. He deeply disliked Hu Weiyong and secretly reported his misconduct to the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国名将。体貌奇伟，勇力绝伦，猿臂善射，统军有方。官至中书平章军国重事，兼太子少保。曾封郑国公、鄂国公。北伐中原时暴卒军中，追封开平王，谥号忠武。
description.en: Founding general of the Ming Dynasty. Known for his exceptional bravery and military skill. He held high positions such as Grand Marshal and Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince, and was enfeoffed as the Duke of E. He died suddenly during the northern expedition against the Yuan and was posthumously created Prince of Kaiping with the posthumous name Zhongwu.

birth_place.zh-cn: 河南江北等处行中书省安丰路濠州怀远县
birth_place.en: Huaiyuan County, Haozhou, Anfeng Circuit, Henan Jiangbei Xingsheng

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国功臣，韩国公，曾任左丞相。后在胡惟庸案中受牵连被杀。
description.en: A founding father of the Ming dynasty, Duke of Han, and former Left Chancellor. He was later implicated and executed in the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国功臣、政治家、文学家。据《明史》记载，他被胡惟庸下毒害死。
description.en: A founding father, statesman, and literary figure of the Ming dynasty. According to the History of Ming, he was poisoned to death by Hu Weiyong.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸，明朝初年的宰相，同时也是明朝最后一任中书省丞相。他是胡惟庸案的核心人物，最终被朱元璋以谋反罪名诛杀。
description.en: Hu Weiyong was a chancellor in the early Ming dynasty and the last Chancellor of the Central Secretariat. He was the central figure in the Case of Hu Weiyong and was eventually executed by the Hongwu Emperor on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领、凉国公。后被指控谋反，引发蓝玉案，成为该案核心人物。此谋反案由锦衣卫办理，是著名的诏狱之一。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty and Duke of Liang. He was later accused of treason, sparking the Lan Yu case and becoming its central figure. This treason case was one of the famous imperial prison cases handled by the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋嫡长子，洪武元年被立为皇太子，是明朝开国皇太子。他也是建文帝朱允炆之父。正史记载其为马皇后所生，但亦有异说。
description.en: The eldest son and heir apparent of Emperor Taizu, Zhu Yuanzhang, and the first crown prince of the Ming dynasty, designated in the first year of the Hongwu era. He was also the father of Emperor Jianwen, Zhu Yunwen. Official histories record him as the son of Empress Ma, though conflicting accounts exist.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第二位皇帝明惠宗朱允炆，朱元璋之孙，年号“建文”。在位期间，于洪武三十一年（1398年）追尊祖母马皇后。后在靖难之役中被其叔朱棣击败。
description.en: The second emperor of the Ming dynasty, Ming Huizong Zhu Yunwen, a grandson of Zhu Yuanzhang, reigned under the era name 'Jianwen'. During his reign, he honored his grandmother Empress Ma with a posthumous title in the 31st year of the Hongwu era (1398). He was later defeated by his uncle Zhu Di in the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一第四子，明太祖朱元璋之父，追尊为仁祖淳皇帝。
description.en: The fourth son of Zhu Chuyi and father of Zhu Yuanzhang, the Hongwu Emperor. He was posthumously honored as Ren Zu Chun Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋之母，追尊为淳皇后
明朝设立的军政特务机构，直接向皇帝负责，掌管侍卫、巡查、缉捕、刑狱等事宜。其前身为亲军都尉府及仪鸾司，于洪武十五年（1382年）改制而成。清初被改为銮仪卫，南明政权的锦衣卫则延续至1661年咒水之难后才正式终结。
description.en: A military and secret police organization of the Ming Dynasty, directly responsible to the emperor, in charge of bodyguards, patrols, arrests, and prisons. It was reorganized from the Imperial Guard's Commander's Office and the Imperial Standard Guard in 1382. It was renamed the Imperial Guard of Honor (Luan Yi Wei) in the early Qing Dynasty, while the Southern Ming regime's Jinyiwei officially ended after the Cursed Water Incident in 1661.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年的中央最高行政机构，由丞相领导。胡惟庸案后被废除。
description.en: The central highest administrative body in the early Ming dynasty, led by the chancellors. It was abolished after the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋在位期间社会生产逐渐恢复和发展的时期

en: Four Major Cases of the early Ming dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明朝洪武年间，明太祖朱元璋为整顿吏治、清除功臣、加强中央集权而策划的四起重大政治案件，包括空印案、郭桓案、胡惟庸案和蓝玉案。
description.en: Four major political cases during the Hongwu era of the Ming Dynasty, initiated by Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang) to consolidate power, purge officials and meritorious subjects, and centralize authority. They include the Empty Seal Case, the Case of Guo Huan, the Case of Hu Weiyong, and the Case of Lan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第四子，明朝第三位皇帝，明成祖。原为燕王，通过靖难之役从其侄建文帝手中夺取皇位，年号永乐。他下令编纂《永乐大典》，并恢复加强了锦衣卫的权力。关于其生母，正史记载为马皇后，但有史料称其生母为䂵妃。他是朱高煦之父。
description.en: The fourth son of the Hongwu Emperor and the third Emperor of the Ming Dynasty, known as the Yongle Emperor. He seized the throne from his nephew, the Jianwen Emperor, through the Jingnan Campaign. He commissioned the compilation of the Yongle Encyclopedia and restored and strengthened the power of the Jinyiwei. His parentage is disputed; while official histories record Empress Ma as his mother, some historical sources claim he was born to Consort Gong. He was the father of Zhu Gaoxu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，德庆侯
明朝开国将领，颖国公
明朝开国将领，宋国公
元末红巾军起义领袖之一，史称小明王，后称帝，国号宋。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Red Turban Rebellion in the late Yuan Dynasty, known as Xiaoming King (小明王), who later proclaimed himself emperor of the Song state.

中央国家安全工作领导小组办公室
中央外事工作领导小组办公室
en: Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission
Foreign Affairs Office of the State Council
Office of the Central Leading Group for National Security Affairs

description.zh-cn: 该机构是中国共产党中央委员会负责统筹外交政策、外事管理和维护海洋权益工作的办事机构，也是中央外事工作委员会的办事机构。其历史可追溯至中华人民共和国国务院下设的外事机构，该机构曾两度设立（1958-1970年；1988-1998年），并于1998年改组为中央外事办公室。此中央外事办公室在2000年9月至2014年期间曾兼任中央国家安全工作领导小组的办事机构，后于2014年更名为中央国家安全委员会办公室。现机构于2018年由中央外事办公室改组而来。
description.en: This body is the administrative office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for coordinating foreign policy, foreign affairs management, and safeguarding maritime rights and interests, and also serves as the office for the Central Foreign Affairs Commission. Its history can be traced back to a foreign affairs body under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, which was established twice (1958-1970; 1988-1998) and reorganized into the Central Foreign Affairs Office in 1998. This Central Foreign Affairs Office also functioned as the working body of the Central National Security Leading Group from September 2000 to 2014, and was later renamed the Office of the Central National Security Commission in 2014. The current entity was reorganized from the Central Foreign Affairs Office in 2018.

zh-cn: 中共中央台湾工作办公室
国务院台湾事务办公室
en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council
Taiwan Work Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国负责处理台湾事务的政府机构。与中共中央台湾工作办公室为“一个机构两块牌子”。曾点名抨击并制裁萧美琴。
description.en: An administrative agency under the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for Taiwan-related affairs. It shares the same office with the Taiwan Work Office of the CCP Central Committee. The agency has publicly criticized and sanctioned Hsiao Bi-khim.

description.zh-cn: 该国位于西亚阿拉伯半岛，是一个君主专制国家，政教合一，以石油经济为支柱。其建立由瓦哈比派与绍德家族的联盟促成，并定瓦哈比派为国教。该国曾被邀请加入金砖国家，后暂缓申请。在阿拉伯之春后的地区冲突中扮演重要角色，如军事干预也门，并曾被指控支持阿米尼示威。
description.en: This monarchical absolute state, located on the Arabian Peninsula in Western Asia, integrates religion and politics and relies on an oil-based economy. Its establishment was facilitated by the alliance between the Wahhabi movement and the House of Saud, which it adopted as its state religion. The country was invited to join BRICS but later postponed its application. It has played a significant role in regional conflicts following the Arab Spring, such as its military intervention in Yemen, and was previously accused of supporting the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的政教合一伊斯兰共和国。毛泽东曾将其提及为联合抗苏的对象之一。2024年加入金砖国家，被指控向俄罗斯提供无人机和弹道导弹，同时也是马赫萨·阿米尼示威的发生地。
description.en: A theocratic Islamic republic in Western Asia. It was mentioned by Mao Zedong as a target for a united front against the Soviet Union. The country joined BRICS in 2024, is accused of supplying drones and ballistic missiles to Russia, and was the site of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统拜登任期内，中美两国高层首次举行的面对面会谈。
description.en: The first face-to-face meeting between high-level officials from China and the United States during President Joe Biden's term.

description.en: Chinese politician, cousin of Fang Zhimin, and stepfather of Mao Yuanxin.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间因反对个人崇拜和“四人帮”而被处决的政治人物。
description.en: A political figure executed during the Cultural Revolution for opposing the personality cult and the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期新疆省的统治者，下令处决了毛泽民、陈潭秋、林基路等人。
description.en: Ruler of Xinjiang Province during the Republic of China era, who ordered the execution of Mao Zemin, Chen Tanqiu, Lin Jilu, and others.

description.zh-cn: 毛远新的出生地，现为乌鲁木齐。
description.en: Mao Yuanxin's birthplace, now known as Ürümqi.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间辽宁省的权力机构。
description.en: The governing body of Liaoning Province during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京的学校，毛远新曾在此就读。
description.en: A school in Beijing, China, where Mao Yuanxin studied.

description.zh-cn: 1975年在中国辽宁省海城县发生的一次7.3级强烈地震，因成功预报而大幅减少了伤亡。
description.en: A magnitude 7.3 earthquake that occurred in Haicheng, Liaoning Province, China in 1975, with casualties significantly reduced due to a successful prediction.

description.zh-cn: 令计划的妻子。
中国政治人物，曾任山西省政协副主席，是令计划的兄长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Vice Chairman of the Shanxi Provincial Political Consultative Conference, and elder brother of Ling Jihua.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线的弟弟，曾将其在汇金立方的股份转给外甥女（令狐路线之女）王玲。
description.en: Younger brother of Linghu Luxian, who transferred his shares in Huijin Lifang to his niece Wang Ling (daughter of Linghu Luxian).

description.zh-cn: 中国医生，令计划的三姐，令狐野的女儿。高中毕业后曾作为知识青年下乡。她是五兄弟姊妹中唯一保留令狐姓者。
description.en: Chinese doctor, the third elder sister of Ling Jihua and daughter of Linghu Ye. She was a sent-down youth after high school graduation. She is the only one of the five siblings to retain the original surname Linghu.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线的兄长。
description.en: Elder brother of Linghu Luxian.

description.zh-cn: 令狐路线、令方针、令政策、令计划、令完成的父亲。
description.en: Father of Linghu Luxian, Ling Fangzhen, Ling Zhengce, Ling Jihua, and Ling Wancheng.

en: Hunan College of Finance and Economics

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国教育部直属的综合性全国重点大学，双一流、985工程重点建设大学。周本顺的母校之一，在此获得工学硕士和管理学博士学位。
description.en: A comprehensive national key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, part of the Double First-Class and Project 985 initiatives. It is also one of Zhou Benshun's alma maters, where he obtained a Master of Engineering and a Ph.D. in Management.

description.zh-cn: 神秘政商联盟组织
前中国中央电视台记者、主播，后因涉郭振玺案被判刑六年，现为投资人。
description.en: Former China Central Television reporter and anchor, later sentenced to six years in prison for his involvement in the Guo Zhenxi case, now an investor.

description.zh-cn: 中共四川省委原副书记
中共中央办公厅秘书局原局长
令狐路线的丈夫，原山西省运城市副市长，后被免职。
description.en: Husband of Linghu Luxian, former deputy mayor of Yuncheng, Shanxi, who was later dismissed from his post.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共太原市委书记，后因腐败问题落马。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Party Secretary of Taiyuan and was later dismissed due to corruption.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国科学技术协会党组书记。
description.en: Formerly served as the Party Group Secretary of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党长治市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former secretary of the CPC Changzhi Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党朔州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former secretary of the CPC Shuozhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第9位皇帝，也是在位时间最长者，在位44年。他开创了开元盛世，但后期因怠政和用人不当，导致安史之乱爆发，并在战乱中退位为太上皇，使唐朝由盛转衰。他是唐肃宗之父，曾征召李白入京任翰林供奉。于天宝初年下诏追封庄周为“南华真人”，并将其著作《庄子》称为《南华经》。他与杨贵妃的爱情故事是《长恨歌》的主题。此外，他在高适逃难途中对其进行了提拔。
description.en: The 9th and longest-reigning emperor of the Tang Dynasty, ruling for 44 years. He initiated the prosperous Kaiyuan Era, but his later negligence and poor appointments led to the An-Shi Rebellion, during which he abdicated and became Taishang Huang, marking the Tang Dynasty's decline from its peak. He was the father of Emperor Suzong, once summoned Li Bai to the capital to serve as Hanlin academician. In the early Tianbao era, he issued an edict to posthumously honor Zhuang Zhou as 'Nanhua Zhenren' and named his work 'Zhuangzi' as the 'Nanhua Jing'. His love story with Yang Guifei is the theme of the 'Song of Everlasting Regret'. He also promoted Gao Shi while fleeing from the rebels.

description.zh-cn: 唐代著名山水田园派诗人，李白的好友。其诗风对李白有所启发，亦是李白敬慕的对象。
description.en: A famous landscape and pastoral poet of the Tang dynasty and a close friend of Li Bai. His poetic style influenced Li Bai, and he was also admired by Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝著名边塞诗人、官员，与岑参并称“高岑”，曾与李白、杜甫交游。他早年生活困顿，后在安史之乱中抓住机遇，获得唐玄宗、唐肃宗赏识，仕途亨通，官至剑南节度使、刑部侍郎，封渤海县侯。其诗作风格雄浑，反映民间疾苦与边塞战争。
description.en: A famous frontier poet and official of the Tang Dynasty, often mentioned together with Cen Shen as 'Gao-Cen', and known for his association with Li Bai and Du Fu. After a difficult early life, he seized opportunities during the An Lushan Rebellion, winning the appreciation of Emperors Xuanzong and Suzong. His official career flourished, reaching positions such as Military Governor of Jiannan and Vice Minister of Justice, and he was ennobled as the Marquis of Bohai County. His poetry is known for its majestic style, reflecting the hardships of the common people and the realities of frontier warfare.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗第十六子，封永王。安史之乱期间，奉命都督江南。他曾招揽李白入幕。后永王在江南起兵，发动叛乱，最终被高适等人讨伐并兵败身亡。
description.en: The 16th son of Emperor Xuanzong, ennobled as the Prince of Yong. During the An Lushan Rebellion, he was ordered to oversee Jiangnan. He once recruited Li Bai into his staff. Later, the Prince of Yong raised an army in Jiangnan, launched a rebellion, and was eventually defeated and killed by forces including those led by Gao Shi.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝著名宦官，本名冯元一。他深得唐玄宗宠信，官至骠骑大将军，封齐国公。一生对玄宗忠心耿耿。据说曾因被李白冒犯而排挤他。然而，在李辅国掌权后，他被构陷并流放。
description.en: A renowned eunuch during the Tang dynasty, whose original name was Feng Yuanyi. He was deeply trusted by Emperor Xuanzong, rose to the rank of Grand General of Cavalry, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Qi. Throughout his life, he remained loyal to Emperor Xuanzong. It is said that he once ostracized Li Bai for offending him. However, after Li Fuguo came to power, he was framed and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗的贵妃，深受宠爱，是中国古代四大美女之一，也是文学作品《长恨歌》的主角。安史之乱爆发后，她在马嵬驿兵变中被玄宗赐死。有传闻称她曾因高力士中伤而排斥李白。
description.en: A beloved consort of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, she was one of the Four Beauties of ancient China and a central figure in the literary work 'Song of Everlasting Regret'. After the outbreak of the An-Shi Rebellion, she was forced to commit suicide by Emperor Xuanzong during the Mawei Mutiny. Rumors suggest she rejected Li Bai due to the slanders of Gao Lishi.

description.zh-cn: 唐代诗人、书法家、官员，曾任秘书监。他非常欣赏李白的才华，称其为“谪仙人”，并向唐玄宗推荐李白。
description.en: A Tang dynasty poet and calligrapher who served as Supervisor of the Palace Library. He greatly admired Li Bai's talent, calling him a 'banished immortal,' and recommended him to Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 唐代道士，曾与李白交游。一说他曾向唐玄宗推荐李白，促使李白被征召。
description.en: A Daoist priest of the Tang dynasty who associated with Li Bai. One account suggests he recommended Li Bai to Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗的同母妹妹，爱好文艺与道教。曾推荐李白入宫，李白也曾做过其门客。
description.en: The full sister of Emperor Xuanzong, with interests in arts and Daoism. She recommended Li Bai to the court, and he once served as her guest-retainer.

description.zh-cn: 李白的第一任妻子，前宰相许圉师的孙女。
李白的最后一任妻子，前宰相宗楚客的后人。
李白的儿子。
description.en: The son of Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相，李白妻子宗氏的先人。
李白的族叔，唐代书法家、官员。李白晚年投靠并受其照拂，他协助整理并编纂了李白的诗稿，最终集结成《草堂集》。
description.en: A Tang dynasty calligrapher, official, and a clan uncle of Li Bai. In his later years, Li Bai sought refuge with him and entrusted him with his manuscripts, which Li Yangbing compiled into the 'Caotang Ji' (Grass Hut Collection).

description.zh-cn: 唐朝名将，在平定安史之乱中做出巨大贡献，是唐肃宗反攻的核心军事将领。传说他曾受李白救助，后为获罪的李白求情。
description.en: A famous general of the Tang Dynasty, he made significant contributions to quelling the An Lushan Rebellion and was a core military commander in Emperor Suzong's counter-offensive. Legend has it that he was once rescued by Li Bai and later interceded for the disgraced poet.

description.zh-cn: 南朝诗人，李白最敬慕的诗人之一。
唐代道教上清派一代宗师。他曾称赞年轻的李白有“仙风道骨”，对李白有重要影响。
description.en: A patriarch of the Shangqing school of Daoism during the Tang dynasty. He famously praised the young Li Bai for having an 'immortal's air and Daoist bones,' exerting a significant influence on him.

description.zh-cn: 东晋政治家，李白终身仰慕的历史人物之一。
安史之乱是唐朝于755年至763年由安禄山与史思明发动的一场大规模政治叛乱，被视为唐朝由盛转衰的关键转折点。它深刻影响了当时的社会文化，包括诗人李白的晚年生活。这场动乱也促使时为太子的李亨在灵武自行登基。
description.en: The An Lushan Rebellion was a large-scale political rebellion launched by An Lushan and Shi Siming in the Tang Dynasty from 755 to 763. It is considered a crucial turning point marking the dynasty's decline from its peak. It profoundly impacted the society and culture of the time, including the later life of the poet Li Bai. The turmoil also prompted the then-Crown Prince Li Heng to ascend the throne independently in Lingwu.

description.zh-cn: 翰林院是中国古代的学术与官僚储备机构。其历史悠久，在唐朝时期曾作为宫廷机构，著名诗人李白在此担任翰林供奉。至清朝，它发展为重要的学术和秘书机构，如年羹尧在康熙三十九年考中进士后曾在此任职。方孝孺也曾担任侍讲、学士等职。该机构也曾长期收藏《永乐大典》副本。
description.en: The Hanlin Academy was an academic and administrative institution in imperial China with a long history. During the Tang Dynasty, it served as a court institution, where the renowned poet Li Bai held the position of Hanlin Academician. In the Qing Dynasty, it evolved into an important academic and secretariat body, with figures like Nian Gengyao serving there after becoming a Jinshi in 1700. Fang Xiaoru also served there as a lecturer and academician. The institution also long housed the duplicate manuscript of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 起源于中国的本土民族宗教，以“道”为最高信仰，深受道家思想影响，后将庄周尊为南华真人。历史上有众多信徒，如李白笃信道教，热切向往神仙不死；明世宗亦笃信道教，追求长生不老，为此大兴土木、修设斋醮，耗费巨大。
description.en: An indigenous Chinese religion, deeply influenced by Taoist philosophy, revering 'Tao' as the supreme belief and later Zhuang Zhou as Nanhua Zhenren. Historically, it attracted numerous followers; for example, Li Bai devoutly believed in Taoism, yearning for immortality, and Emperor Shizong also pursued immortality, which led to extensive construction and elaborate rituals, incurring enormous costs.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇的儿子。
description.en: Chen Liangyu's son.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇的三弟。
description.en: Chen Liangyu's third younger brother.

zh-cn: 天津市第二中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 审判陈良宇案件的法院，于2008年4月11日以受贿罪、滥用职权罪判处陈良宇有期徒刑18年。
description.en: The court that tried Chen Liangyu's case, sentencing him to 18 years in prison on April 11, 2008, for bribery and abuse of power.

zh-cn: 上海大学市北附属中学
中国人民解放军联勤保障部队工程大学
中国人民解放军后勤工程学院

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇的母校，他在此学习建筑工程专业。
description.en: Chen Liangyu's alma mater, where he studied architectural engineering.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国的大学。陈良宇曾于1992年作为上海市级储备干部在此进修公共政策。
description.en: A university in the United Kingdom. Chen Liangyu studied public policy here in 1992 as a reserve cadre from Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 中国官员，曾任上海市劳动和社会保障局局长，因陈良宇事件被判刑。
description.en: Chinese official, former Director of the Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Labor and Social Security, who was sentenced in the Chen Liangyu incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人，上海社保案的核心人物，通过违规借贷上海社保基金迅速积累财富。
description.en: Chinese businessman and central figure in the Shanghai social security fund case, who rapidly accumulated wealth through illegal loans from the fund.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人。

en: Retreat of the government of the Republic of China to Taiwan
Relocation of the Government of the Republic of China to Taiwan
Relocation of the government of the Republic of China to Taiwan
Retreat of the Republic of China to Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战末期，中华民国政府将中央政府机构迁往台湾台北市的历史事件。
description.en: The historical event at the end of the Second Chinese Civil War where the government of the Republic of China relocated its central government agencies to Taipei City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 美国军事家、政治家、外交家，曾任美国陆军参谋长，并曾作为美国特使调停国共冲突。
description.en: An American soldier, statesman, and diplomat, who served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army, and also as an American envoy who mediated the KMT-CCP conflict.

en: Three Great Campaigns of the Wanli Emperor

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，中国人民解放军与中华民国国军之间的三次决定性战役，即辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役，是国共内战的战略决战。
description.en: Three decisive campaigns between the People's Liberation Army and the Republic of China Armed Forces during the Second Chinese Civil War, consisting of the Liaoshen, Huaihai, and Pingjin Campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的国家武装力量。其前身为1925年至1947年间的国民革命军。1947年行宪后，改组为新的国家武装力量。此后，曾与第七舰队合作，例如在1955年的大陈岛撤退行动中，以及1958年的八二三炮战中获得护航补给。
description.en: The national armed forces of the Republic of China. Its predecessor was the National Revolutionary Army from 1925 to 1947. After the constitution was enacted in 1947, it was reorganized into the new national armed forces. Subsequently, it cooperated with the Seventh Fleet, for instance, during the 1955 Dachen Islands evacuation, and receiving escort for supplies during the 1958 Second Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 由首批入选985工程的九所高校组成的高校联盟。

zh-cn: 世界一流大学和一流学科建设

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国自2015年开始实施的高等教育政策，旨在建设世界一流大学和一流学科，提升中国高等教育综合实力和国际竞争力。
description.en: A higher education policy of the People's Republic of China initiated in 2015, aiming to build world-class universities and first-class disciplines, and enhance China's overall higher education strength and international competitiveness.

zh-cn: 优势学科创新平台项目

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国“985工程”的延伸，旨在重点建设一批优势学科领域的创新平台。
description.en: An extension of China's Project 985, aimed at building innovation platforms in advantageous discipline fields.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华人民共和国教育部部长。
位于中国南京市的著名高等学府，也是南京工业大学的源头之一。其工学院于1952年参与组建南京工学院。董健曾在此求学、任教并担任副校长。
description.en: A prestigious institution of higher education located in Nanjing, China, and one of the origins of Nanjing Tech University. Its College of Engineering participated in the formation of Nanjing Institute of Technology in 1952. Dong Jian studied, taught, and served as vice president here.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国教育部直属的综合性全国重点研究型大学，位于中国上海市。与南加州大学有合作关系，也是慎海雄的母校之一。
description.en: A comprehensive national key research university directly under China's Ministry of Education, located in Shanghai. It maintains a partnership with the University of Southern California and is also one of Shen Haixiong's alma maters.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国西安的著名高等学府，是周鸿祎的母校。
description.en: A renowned institution of higher learning in Xi'an, China, and the alma mater of Zhou Hongyi.

en: Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市的公立大学，由中华人民共和国工业和信息化部直属。作为一所'双一流A类'、原'985工程'和'211工程'重点建设的全国重点大学，该校以航空航天工程和技术为特色，是一所顶尖研究型大学。张庆伟曾在此获得管理学博士学位。
description.en: A public university located in Beijing, China, directly under the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China. As a national key university designated under 'Double First-Class A', former 'Project 985', and 'Project 211' initiatives, it is a top research university specializing in aeronautics and astronautics engineering and technology. Zhang Qingwei obtained his Doctor of Management degree here.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市的公立大学，由中华人民共和国工业和信息化部直属。温云松在此获得工科学位；项昌乐在此获得学士、硕士和博士学位，并曾担任党委常务副书记等职务。
description.en: A public university in Beijing, China, directly affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People's Republic of China. Wen Yunsong obtained his engineering degree here; Xiang Changle obtained his bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees here, and previously served as Executive Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一所著名综合性大学，是中华人民共和国教育部直属的全国重点大学，位于中国北京，是“双一流A类”、“985工程”、“211工程”重点建设大学。它是北京师范大学的前身之一，其体育系是1953年成立中央体育学院（北京体育大学前身）的基础。徐旭生曾任校长，徐发淦、何毅亭（在此获得历史学学士和硕士学位）是其校友。
description.en: A renowned comprehensive university in Beijing, China, and a national key university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. It is designated as a 'Double First-Class A', 'Project 985', and 'Project 211' university. It is one of the predecessors of Beijing Normal University, and its Department of Physical Education formed the basis for the establishment of the Central Institute of Physical Culture (predecessor of Beijing Sport University) in 1953. Xu Xusheng served as its chancellor, and Xu Fagan and He Yiting (who obtained his bachelor's and master's degrees in history) are alumni.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市的一所综合性高等院校，以民族类学科为特色，是国家“双一流”建设高校。
description.en: A comprehensive university in Beijing, China, characterized by ethnic studies disciplines and designated as a Double First Class University.

description.zh-cn: 中国著名高等学府，中华人民共和国教育部直属全国重点大学。其前身为1895年成立的国立北洋工学院（初名北洋大学堂）。徐懋德曾在此长期任教，钟登华也曾在此获得硕士和博士学位并担任校长等职务。
description.en: A renowned higher education institution in China and a National Key University directly under the administration of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China. Its predecessor was the National Peiyang Technical Institute (initially Peiyang University), founded in 1895. Xu Maode taught here for a long time, and Zhong Denghua also obtained his master's and doctoral degrees here and held positions such as President.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国辽宁省沈阳市的著名高等学府，一所以工科为主的综合性大学。阎明复曾在此就读。抗日战争期间，该校为避战火曾内迁至四川三台。
description.en: A renowned comprehensive university with a focus on engineering, located in Shenyang, Liaoning, China. Yan Mingfu was a student here. During the Second Sino-Japanese War, it temporarily relocated to Santai, Sichuan to avoid conflict.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军前少将，曾任陆军第三十八集团军军长。因在六四事件中拒绝执行戒严命令，被撤职并判刑。
description.en: A former Major General of the People's Liberation Army and former Commander of the 38th Group Army. He was dismissed and sentenced for refusing to enforce martial law orders during the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件受害者，在六部口被坦克碾压致双腿截肢。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第八十二集团军
中国人民解放军第38集团军
中国人民解放军陆军第三十八集团军
en: 38th Army of the People's Liberation Army
38th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军的一支精锐集团军，因在朝鲜战争中的出色表现被誉为“万岁军”。该部队是作为中国人民志愿军的参战部队之一，参与了第一次战役。现隶属于中部战区陆军，此前曾隶属北京军区，并作为参与戒严行动的部队之一，在1989年六四事件中由徐勤先指挥。王西欣曾任该集团军军长。
description.en: An elite group army of the PLA Ground Force, acclaimed as the 'Long Live Army' for its outstanding performance in the Korean War. As one of the participating units of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, it took part in the First Phase Offensive. It is currently affiliated with the Central Theater Command Ground Force, having previously been part of the Beijing Military Region. The unit was also involved in martial law operations and was commanded by Xu Qinxian during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. Wang Xixin also served as its corps commander.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京市中心，是八九民运学生示威集会的核心地点及最终清场所在地。
位于北京西长安街，戒严部队进城时与示威者发生激烈流血冲突的地点之一。
位于北京西长安街，清场后学生撤离途中发生坦克碾压学生事件的地点。

zh-cn: 必须旗帜鲜明地反对动乱

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》于1989年4月26日头版发表的社论，将学生运动定性为“动乱”，激化了学生与政府的矛盾。

zh-cn: 北京高校学生自治联合会

description.zh-cn: 在1989年天安门学生运动（六四事件）期间，由北京各高校学生组成的自治联合组织。
description.en: An autonomous joint organization formed by students from various universities in Beijing during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests (also known as the June Fourth Incident).

description.zh-cn: 社会运动人士、历史学者、中国持不同政见者，1989年六四事件学生领袖之一。事件后流亡美国，曾称魏京生为“民主斗士”。关于其狱中证词，陈子明曾指其作出不实，但王丹也曾公开称陈子明为友人并关心其病情。
description.en: A social activist, historian, and Chinese dissident, and one of the student leaders of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. After the event, he went into exile in the United States, and once called Wei Jingsheng a 'democracy fighter'. Regarding his testimony in prison, Chen Ziming accused him of giving false testimony, but Wang Dan also publicly referred to Chen Ziming as a friend and expressed concern for his illness.

description.zh-cn: 维吾尔族异见人士，八九学运（六四事件）的学生领袖之一。六四事件后被中华人民共和国政府通缉，经“黄雀行动”营救逃离中国大陆，后流亡并定居台湾，现为政治评论家。
description.en: A Uyghur dissident and a student leader of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests. After the June 4th incident, he was placed on the most-wanted list by the government of the People's Republic of China. He was later rescued and escaped from mainland China through 'Operation Yellowbird', went into exile, and settled in Taiwan, where he is now a political commentator.

description.zh-cn: 中国1989年六四事件学生运动领袖之一，也是天安门广场绝食行动发起人之一。六四事件后，她经“黄雀行动”营救逃离中国大陆。她还是一位人权活动家、企业高管，并是封从德前妻。
description.en: A student leader in the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and one of the initiators of the hunger strike in Tiananmen Square. After the June Fourth Incident, she was rescued and escaped from mainland China through 'Operation Yellowbird'. She is also a human rights activist, a business executive, and the ex-wife of Feng Congde.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国作家、社会活动家、文艺评论家、人权活动家、持不同政见者。他曾是77级大学生，参与六四事件，是《零八宪章》主要起草人之一，并于2010年获得诺贝尔和平奖。魏京生曾批评将诺贝尔奖授予他的决定。
description.en: A Chinese writer, social activist, literary critic, human rights activist, and dissident. He was a member of the Class of 1977, participated in the Tiananmen Square protests, was a principal drafter of Charter 08, and was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2010. Wei Jingsheng criticized the decision to award him the Nobel Prize.

description.zh-cn: 指1989年底至1990年前后，东欧和中欧的社会主义国家中发生的急剧政治变革。在此期间，反对派推翻了共产党和工人党政权，导致其相继倒台。这场变革最终以苏联解体告终，标志着冷战的结束，也是六四事件的国际背景之一。
description.en: Refers to the dramatic political changes that occurred in socialist countries of Eastern and Central Europe from late 1989 to around 1990. During this period, opposition movements overthrew Communist and workers' party regimes, leading to their successive collapses. This transformation ultimately concluded with the dissolution of the Soviet Union, marking the end of the Cold War, and was also an international backdrop to the Tiananmen Square incident.

description.zh-cn: 造反派是文化大革命期间响应毛泽东“造反有理”号召，并向当权派夺权的群众组织的统称。作为主要政治派系之一，它与保皇派/保守派对立，是后期红卫兵运动的主流。杨小凯曾因反对血统论而加入造反派。
description.en: The 'Rebel Faction' (Zaofanpai) was a general term for mass organizations during the Cultural Revolution that responded to Mao Zedong's call 'to rebel is justified' and seized power from the establishment. As one of the main political factions, it opposed the Royalist/conservative factions and became the mainstream of the later Red Guard movement. Yang Xiaokai once joined the Rebel Faction because he opposed the 'bloodline theory'.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间支持各地原有党政军领导的群众组织派别。
文化大革命时期的政治派系，主张维护当时的官僚体制，与造反派、极左派对立。
description.en: A political faction during the Cultural Revolution that advocated for maintaining the existing bureaucratic system and was opposed to the Rebel and Ultra-Left factions.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军广西军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在中国广西壮族自治区的军事机构。
description.en: The military organization of the People's Liberation Army in the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的五个自治区之一。
description.en: One of the five autonomous regions of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 广西壮族自治区革命委员会

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央办公厅副主任兼秘书局局长，被认为是习近平的贴身秘书。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央纪律检查委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会的纪律检查机关。
description.en: The discipline inspection body of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 共青团派是中国共产党内的一个政治派系，其成员大多有中国共产主义青年团的任职背景。该派系由胡耀邦奠定基础，在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记期间达到顶峰，后在习近平执政时期逐渐被边缘化。
description.en: A political faction within the Communist Party of China, whose members largely have a background of service in the Communist Youth League of China. The faction's foundation was laid by Hu Yaobang, reached its peak during Hu Jintao's tenure as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, and was marginalized during Xi Jinping's administration.

zh-cn: 山东省济南市中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 负责一审审判薄熙来案的法院。
description.en: The court that conducted the first-instance trial of the Bo Xilai case.

zh-cn: 中国光大集团股份公司

description.zh-cn: 中国维吾尔族政治人物，曾任第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Uyghur ethnicity, who served as Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公务员体系中第七级别的行政级别之一，与县长、区长、市属委办局长等职务对应。
description.en: One of the administrative ranks at the seventh level for civil servants in the People's Republic of China, corresponding to positions such as county magistrate, district mayor, and director of municipal commissions.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公务员
中华人民共和国公务员法
en: Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China
Civil servant of the People's Republic of China
Civil servants of the People's Republic of China
Civil service of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的国家公务员制度，根据《中华人民共和国公务员法》定义，是指依法履行公职、纳入国家行政编制、由国家财政负担工资福利的工作人员。该法是规范公务员管理的主要法律依据。
description.en: The national civil service system of the People's Republic of China, defined by the 'Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China', refers to personnel who perform public duties in accordance with the law, are included in the state administrative establishment, and whose salaries and benefits are borne by the state finance. This law serves as the main legal basis for regulating civil service management.

en: County-level administrative divisions of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的行政区划单位，其行政地位与“县”相同，管辖乡级行政区。
description.en: An administrative division unit in the People's Republic of China with an administrative status equivalent to a county, which administers township-level divisions.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国行政区划中介于省级和县级之间的行政层级。
description.en: The administrative level between the provincial and county levels in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 公务员等级，高于县处级正职
中华人民共和国公务员体系中最高级别的领导干部。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业农村部
en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，主管农业与农村事务。
农业农村部直属事业单位，首长高配副部长级。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国文化和旅游部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，主管文化和旅游事务。
一所位于北京紫禁城内的博物馆，是文化和旅游部直属事业单位，首长高配副部长级。任万平曾在此担任副院长。
description.en: A museum located within Beijing's Forbidden City, directly affiliated with the Ministry of Culture and Tourism. Its highest-ranking official holds a vice-ministerial level, and Ren Wanping previously served as its deputy director.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京天安门广场东侧的综合性博物馆，收藏有神舟五号返回舱。它是文化和旅游部直属事业单位，首长高配副部长级。
description.en: A comprehensive museum located on the east side of Tiananmen Square in Beijing, China, which houses the Shenzhou 5 return capsule. It is a directly affiliated institution of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, with its head ranked as a Vice Minister.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海的证券交易所，由中国证监会管理的事业单位，理事长高配副部长级。
description.en: A stock exchange located in Shanghai, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆主要证券交易所之一，由中国证监会管理，理事长高配副部长级。它为证券集中交易提供平台。科大讯飞曾于2008年在此上市。
description.en: One of the major stock exchanges in mainland China, managed by the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) with its chairman holding a vice-ministerial rank. It provides a platform for centralized securities trading. iFlytek was listed here in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 与中国烟草总公司实行“一个机构两块牌子”的制度，既承担烟草行业行政管理职能，又承接卷烟生产销售任务，属于中央行政企业。
description.en: Operates under the 'one institution with two names' system with China National Tobacco Corporation, undertaking both administrative management functions for the tobacco industry and production and sales tasks for cigarettes, and is a central administrative enterprise.

description.zh-cn: 中央行政企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。
中央行政企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。

zh-cn: 中国投资有限责任公司
中国国家外汇投资公司
en: China National Foreign Exchange Investment Company

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。

zh-cn: 国家开发银行股份有限公司

location.zh-cn: 中国北京市西城区复兴门内大街18号
location.en: 18 Fuxingmen Inner Street, Xicheng District, Beijing, China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的开发性金融机构及政策性银行，同时也是中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。它是中国最大的债券银行、最大的对外投融资合作银行，也是全球最大的政策性银行。
description.en: A development finance institution and policy bank in the People's Republic of China, also a central financial enterprise, enjoying vice-ministerial political and economic treatment. It is the country's largest bond-issuing bank, largest foreign investment and financing cooperation bank, and the world's largest policy bank.

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区复兴门内大街30号
location.en: No. 30, Fuxingmennei Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，直属中华人民共和国国务院领导的国有政策性银行，旨在支持中国的对外贸易和“走出去”战略。享受副部级政治经济待遇。
description.en: A central financial enterprise and a state-owned policy bank directly under the leadership of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, aimed at supporting China's foreign trade and 'Go Global' strategy. It enjoys vice-ministerial political and economic treatment.

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。

en: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China

description.zh-cn: 中国工商银行于1984年成立，承办了原由中国人民银行承担的工商信贷和储蓄业务。它是一家大型国有商业银行，中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇，同时也是中国工商银行（亚洲）的母公司。
description.en: Established in 1984, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China took over the industrial and commercial credit and savings business originally handled by the People's Bank of China. It is a large state-owned commercial bank and a central financial enterprise enjoying vice-ministerial political and economic treatment. It is also the parent company of ICBC (Asia).

zh-cn: 中国农业银行股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。
中国的国有商业银行之一。民国时期曾是主要商业银行，后被国民政府增资控股，成为中央金融企业，享有副部级政治经济待遇。在国家外汇管理局成立初期，曾与其合署办公，同时承担外汇管理和经营职能。高迎欣曾于2015年至2018年担任该行副行长。
description.en: One of the state-owned commercial banks in China. It was a major commercial bank during the Republic of China period, later controlled by the Nationalist Government through increased capital, becoming a central financial enterprise and enjoying vice-ministerial political and economic treatment. In the early days of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, it shared offices with it, concurrently undertaking both foreign exchange management and business functions. Gao Yingxin served as its Vice President from 2015 to 2018.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央金融企业，是中国六大国有商业银行之一，享受副部级政治经济待遇。
description.en: As a central financial enterprise, it is one of China's six major state-owned commercial banks, enjoying vice-ministerial political and economic treatment.

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。
中华人民共和国一家大型国有保险公司，属于中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。
description.en: A large state-owned insurance company in the People's Republic of China, classified as a central financial enterprise and enjoying vice-ministerial level political and economic treatment.

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。同时也是负责接手工银亚洲寿险业务的公司之一。
description.en: One of the companies that took over the life insurance business of ICBC (Asia).

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。

zh-cn: 中国出口信用保险公司

description.zh-cn: 中央金融企业，享受副部级政治经济待遇。
中华人民共和国的国有独资公司，由中央人民政府直接管理。作为国有重要骨干企业，其行政级别为副部级央企。
description.en: A state-owned wholly-owned company of the People's Republic of China, directly managed by the central government. As a key backbone state-owned enterprise, its administrative level is vice-ministerial.

zh-cn: 中国航天科技集团公司
en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

description.zh-cn: 中国国有特大型高科技企业集团，国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企），是中国主要的空间技术公司之一，也是中国卫星通信集团的母公司。张庆伟曾担任该集团的副总经理和总经理。
description.en: A state-owned mega high-tech enterprise group in China, a key state-owned backbone enterprise (vice-ministerial level central enterprise), and one of China's main space technology companies. It is also the parent company of China Satcom. Zhang Qingwei served as Deputy General Manager and General Manager of the group.

zh-cn: 中国航天科工集团公司
en: China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation

description.zh-cn: 国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。

zh-cn: 中国航空工业集团公司
中国航空工业集团有限公司
en: Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 中国一家主要航空制造公司，也是国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。
description.en: A major Chinese aerospace and defense conglomerate.

zh-cn: 中国船舶集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 由中国船舶工业集团有限公司与中国船舶重工集团有限公司于2019年合并而成的特大型国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。
description.en: A super-large state-owned key enterprise (vice-ministerial level central enterprise) formed by the merger of China State Shipbuilding Industry Corporation and China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation in 2019.

zh-cn: 中国兵器工业集团有限公司
中国北方工业集团有限公司
en: China North Industries Group Corporation Limited

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国一家主要从事军事装备研发、生产、制造的特大型中央企业。作为国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企），它同时也是中国最大的武器装备制造集团。
description.en: A super-large central state-owned enterprise in the People's Republic of China, primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and manufacturing of military equipment. As an important state-owned backbone enterprise (vice-ministerial level central enterprise), it is also China's largest manufacturer of weaponry.

zh-cn: 中国兵器装备集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国一家主要从事军事装备研发、生产、制造的特大型中央国有骨干企业（副部级央企），持有中国北方工业有限公司部分股份。
description.en: A super-large, vice-ministerial level central state-owned key enterprise in the People's Republic of China, primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and manufacturing of military equipment, which also holds a portion of shares in Norinco.

description.zh-cn: 国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。
国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。

zh-cn: 中国融通资产管理集团

description.zh-cn: 国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。

zh-cn: 中国石油天然气集团公司

description.zh-cn: 中国大型国有石油和天然气公司，国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企），在《穹顶之下》中被点名批评。其高层工程师随后撰文反驳片中观点。
description.en: A major state-owned oil and gas corporation in China, which was criticized by name in 'Under the Dome'. Its senior engineer later wrote an article refuting the film's claims.

zh-cn: 中国石油化工集团公司

description.zh-cn: 中国大型国有石油化工企业集团，国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。在《穹顶之下》中被点名批评，被指阻碍环保政策。
description.en: A major state-owned petrochemical conglomerate in China, also a key backbone enterprise (vice-ministerial central enterprise). It was criticized by name in 'Under the Dome' for allegedly obstructing environmental policies.

description.zh-cn: 国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企），是中国最大的海上石油和天然气生产商。
description.en: A state-owned key backbone enterprise (vice-ministerial central enterprise) and China's largest offshore oil and gas producer.

zh-cn: 国家石油天然气管网集团
国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 国家管网公司是由中石油、中石化、中海油等公司的管网资产重组成立的国有重要骨干企业（副部级央企）。
description.en: The National Pipeline Company, a state-owned key backbone enterprise (vice-ministerial level central enterprise), was established through the restructuring of pipeline assets from companies including CNPC, Sinopec, and CNOOC.

description.en: Hong Kong politician and a state-level deputy leader. He is currently the Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC. He was elected as the fourth Chief Executive of Hong Kong in the 2012 election and previously served as the Convenor of the Non-official Members of the Executive Council of Hong Kong. He is a key figure in Lew Mon-hung's political life, with their relationship shifting from close allies to public adversaries. He is an alumnus of King's College.

He formerly served as the Executive Deputy Head of the Organization Department of the CCP Central Committee and is currently a Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级党和国家领导人。中国致公党党员，医学博士。曾任安徽省副省长、中华人民共和国卫生部副部长、全国政协副秘书长等职，现任第十四届全国政协副主席、中国致公党中央委员会主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a national deputy leader. Member of the China Zhi Gong Party, Doctor of Medicine. He has served as Vice Governor of Anhui Province, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Health of the People's Republic of China, and Deputy Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee. He is currently a Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC and Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物
中华人民共和国政治人物，副国级领导人。现任全国政协副主席、民盟中央常务副主席。同时担任清华大学土木水利学院水利水电工程系博士生导师，以及华东师范大学河口海岸学国家重点实验室学术委员会主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a national leader. He currently serves as the Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and the Executive Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League. He is also a doctoral supervisor in the Department of Hydraulic and Hydroelectric Engineering, School of Civil and Hydraulic Engineering, Tsinghua University, and the Chairman of the Academic Committee of the State Key Laboratory of Estuarine and Coastal Research at East China Normal University.

description.en: Senior general of the People's Liberation Army, who was appointed a member of the Central Military Commission at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任邓小平秘书、总政治部副主任，在中共十四届五中全会上增补为中央军事委员会委员。

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会委员。

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国人民解放军上将。他曾任中央军事委员会委员、中国人民解放军总政治部主任、总装备部部长。他还是中国载人航天工程总指挥，并宣布了神舟五号发射成功与任务圆满完成。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China and a General (Shang Jiang) of the People's Liberation Army. He served as a member of the Central Military Commission, Director of the PLA General Political Department, and Director of the PLA General Armaments Department. He was also Commander-in-Chief of the China Manned Space Program, announcing the successful launch and completion of the Shenzhou 5 mission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领、政治人物。曾任中国人民解放军总参谋长（接替梁光烈），并于第十一届全国人民代表大会期间被任命为中央军事委员会委员。此外，他还曾担任南京军区司令员。
description.en: A high-ranking general and politician in the People's Liberation Army. He served as the Chief of the PLA General Staff, succeeding Liang Guanglie. During the 11th National People's Congress, he was appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission. He also previously served as Commander of the Nanjing Military Region.

中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: A general of the PLAAF, who served as President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 清朝奠基者，后金开国皇帝，后被追尊为清太祖。他是塔克世与宣皇后的长子。他统一女真各部，并在与明朝的战争中屡获胜利。但在宁远之战中被袁崇焕击败并负伤，不久后去世。
description.en: The founder of the Qing dynasty and the Later Jin dynasty, posthumously honored as Emperor Taizu of Qing. He was the eldest son of Taksi and Empress Xuan. He unified the Jurchen tribes and achieved numerous victories in wars against the Ming Dynasty. However, he was defeated and wounded by Yuan Chonghuan at the Battle of Ningyuan, dying shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 由女真族首领努尔哈赤于1616年建立的政权，是清朝的前身。在其存续期间，后金是明朝在辽东地区的主要军事威胁，与明朝展开了长期的军事对抗，尤其是在明熹宗在位时期。
description.en: A khanate established by the Jurchen leader Nurhaci in 1616, the predecessor to the Qing dynasty. During its existence, the Later Jin was the primary military threat to the Ming dynasty in the Liaodong region, engaging in long-term military conflict, especially during the reign of the Tianqi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤第八子，后金第二位大汗，清朝的开国皇帝。他继续对明朝的战争，并于1629年发动己巳之变，绕道蒙古攻入明朝内地。此外，他还是多尔衮的异母兄。
description.en: Nurhaci's eighth son, the second Khan of the Later Jin, and the founding emperor of the Qing Dynasty. He continued the war against the Ming, launching the Jisi Incident in 1629 by bypassing Ming defenses via Mongolia to attack the Ming heartland. Additionally, he was Dorgon's half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 明末农民起义军领袖，大顺政权的建立者与大顺皇帝。他率军攻入北京导致明朝灭亡，并曾将锦衣卫改名为龙衣卫。但随后在一片石之战中被清吴联军击败。其军队被认为是焚毁《永乐大典》正本的可能原因之一。
description.en: Leader of the peasant rebellion in the late Ming dynasty, founder and emperor of the Dashun regime. He led his army to capture Beijing, causing the fall of the Ming dynasty, and once renamed the Jinyiwei to Longyiwei (Dragon-Clad Guard). However, he was later defeated by the Qing-Wu allied forces at the Battle of Shanhai Pass. His army is also considered a possible cause for the destruction of the original manuscript of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 由李自成在明末民变中建立的农民政权。
description.en: A peasant regime established by Li Zicheng during the late Ming peasant rebellions.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初军事家、政治家。曾任辽东总兵，手握关宁铁骑，于一片石之战中投降多尔衮，引清兵入关，被封为平西王。晚年发动三藩之乱，建立吴周政权，自称皇帝。
description.en: A military general and politician in the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. He served as a late Ming general, commanding the Guan-Ning Army in the Liaodong region. During the Battle of Shanhai Pass, he surrendered to Dorgon, allowing Qing forces to enter the pass, and was subsequently enfeoffed as the Prince of Pacifying the West. In his later years, he initiated the Revolt of the Three Feudatories and established the Wu Zhou dynasty, declaring himself emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年宗室，杰出的政治家和军事家。他是努尔哈赤第十四子，清太宗皇太极之弟，顺治帝时期的皇父摄政王、权臣。曾在一片石之战中率领清军主力入关，是清朝入关初期的实际统治者和奠基者之一。他唯一的亲生女儿。
description.en: An imperial prince in the early Qing dynasty, an outstanding statesman and military strategist. He was the 14th son of Nurhaci and brother of Hong Taiji. During the Shunzhi Emperor's reign, he served as the Huangfu Regent and a powerful minister. He led the main Qing forces into the pass during the Battle of Shanhai Pass, becoming one of the de facto rulers and founders in the early period of Qing entry into China. He had an only biological daughter.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第四位皇帝，清朝入关后的第二位皇帝。年号康熙，庙号清圣祖。他是在位61年的中国历史上在位时间最长的皇帝。在位期间平定三藩、攻取台湾、驱逐沙俄，开启康雍乾盛世。他是孝庄太皇太后之孙，雍正帝之父，隆科多的表兄。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Qing dynasty and the second to rule over China proper. His reign title was Kangxi, and his temple name was Shengzu. His 61-year reign makes him the longest-reigning emperor in Chinese history. During his tenure, he suppressed the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, conquered Taiwan, and expelled Tsarist Russia, thus initiating the High Qing era. He was the grandson of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang, father of the Yongzheng Emperor, and cousin of Longkodo.

location.zh-cn: 华南地区、陕西、甘肃、蒙古察哈尔部

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙初年，由吴三桂、耿精忠、尚之信等平西、靖南、平南三藩发动，结合海内外反清势力的大规模叛乱战争。
description.en: During the early years of the Kangxi Emperor's reign in the Qing dynasty, a large-scale rebellion and war was launched by the Three Feudatories (Princes Wu Sangui, Geng Jingzhong, and Shang Zhixin), combining anti-Qing forces from both within China and abroad.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝第五位皇帝，清世宗，年号雍正。他是康熙帝第四子，乾隆帝之父，孝圣宪皇后的丈夫，胤祥的异母兄。雍和宫曾是其登基前的府邸。他在位期间，曾下令重建少林寺山门、重修千佛殿。因中国礼仪之争引发的矛盾，他还实行禁教政策，中断了明末清初的西学东渐进程。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Qing Dynasty, Emperor Shizong, with the reign name Yongzheng. He was the fourth son of the Kangxi Emperor, father of the Qianlong Emperor, husband of Empress Xiaoshengxian, and half-brother of Yinxiang. The Yonghe Temple was his residence before he ascended the throne. During his reign, he ordered the rebuilding of the Shaolin Temple's mountain gate and the renovation of the Thousand Buddha Hall. Due to conflicts arising from the Chinese Rites controversy, he also implemented a policy of prohibiting Christianity, which interrupted the process of West-to-East knowledge transfer in the late Ming and early Qing periods.

description.zh-cn: 由雍正帝设立，是清朝中后期发挥作用的中央最高决策机构。
description.en: Established by Emperor Yongzheng, it was the supreme central decision-making body that played a role in the middle and late Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝第六位皇帝，年号乾隆，庙号清高宗。他是雍正帝第四子，在位六十年，禅位后又以太上皇身份掌实权近四年，成为中国历史上掌权最长、最长寿的皇帝。其统治期间清朝国力达顶峰，史称“康雍乾盛世”。他曾开四库馆、大规模增改紫禁城，亲临少林寺留下诗词匾额，并为多尔衮平反。然而，晚期他因大兴文字狱及吏治腐败而备受争议。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Qing dynasty, known by his reign name Qianlong and temple name Gaozong. He was the fourth son of the Yongzheng Emperor. He reigned for 60 years, and after abdicating, wielded de facto power for nearly four more years as Emperor Emeritus, making him the longest-reigning and longest-living emperor in Chinese history. During his rule, the Qing dynasty reached its zenith, a period known as the 'High Qing era'. He initiated the Siku Quanshu project, extensively renovated and expanded the Forbidden City, personally visited the Shaolin Temple leaving poems and calligraphic plaques, and posthumously rehabilitated Dorgon. However, he is controversial for promoting literary inquisitions and political corruption in his later years.

death_place.en: Hall of Mental Cultivation, Forbidden City

description.zh-cn: 清朝乾隆年间编修的中国历史上规模最大的丛书，其编纂过程中从《永乐大典》中辑佚了大量古籍。
description.en: The largest collection of books in Chinese history, compiled during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty. A significant number of lost ancient books were recovered from the Yongle Encyclopedia for its compilation.

description.zh-cn: 1840年至1842年清朝与大英帝国之间的一场侵略战争，战争的导火线是清政府的禁烟运动，其中著名的事件是虎门销烟。战争以中国失败并赔款割地告终，签订了中国近代史上第一个不平等条约《南京条约》。
description.en: A war fought between the Qing dynasty and the British Empire from 1840 to 1842. The conflict was triggered by the Qing government's campaign against the British opium trade, which culminated in the destruction of opium at Humen. The war concluded with a Chinese defeat and the signing of the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在第一次鸦片战争战败后与英国签订的条约，是中国近代史上第一个不平等条约。条约内容包括割让香港岛、开放五个通商口岸及赔款等。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Qing dynasty and the United Kingdom after the Qing's defeat in the First Opium War. It was the first of the unequal treaties in modern Chinese history. Its terms included the cession of Hong Kong Island, the opening of five treaty ports, and reparations.

description.zh-cn: 清末拜上帝会创始人，太平天国运动的领袖及太平天国的建立者和天王。他与冯云山是同乡，共同创立了拜上帝会和太平天国。其子为洪天贵福。
description.en: Founder of the God Worshipping Society in the late Qing Dynasty, leader of the Taiping Rebellion, and the founder and Heavenly King of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. He was a fellow townsman of Feng Yunshan, with whom he co-founded the God Worshipping Society and the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. His son was Hong Tianguifu.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国是由洪秀全在清朝后期建立的农民起义政权，与清朝对峙并进行了长达14年的战争。其军事力量在天京城破时，城中守军约有万余人。
description.en: The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom was a rebel state established by Hong Xiuquan during the late Qing Dynasty, which engaged in a 14-year war with the Qing government. Its military force numbered around 10,000 defenders when Tianjing fell.

description.zh-cn: 晚清时期政治家、战略家、理学家、文学家，中兴四大名臣之一，湘军的创立者和统帅。他曾向清廷奏报攻克金陵战果时，称杀敌十万余，有学者认为此为夸大战功。
description.en: A Chinese statesman, military general, Confucian scholar, and writer of the late Qing dynasty, and one of the Four Great Ministers of the Restoration. He was the founder and commander of the Xiang Army. In his report to the Qing court on the capture of Jinling, he claimed to have killed over 100,000 enemies, a figure some scholars believe to be an exaggeration.

description.zh-cn: 晚清皇室成员及实际最高统治者，咸丰帝贵妃，同治帝生母，光绪帝名义上的母亲。她与奕䜣在辛酉政变中结盟独揽大权。执政期间，指定溥仪继位并任命载沣为摄政王，1875年创设北洋水师，并迫害维新派致梁启超流亡。在义和团运动期间，受保守派亲王影响起用排外的毓贤，后向多国宣战，引发八国联军之役，其权威在东南互保事件中受到挑战。其陵墓后被孙殿英盗掘。
description.en: A female royal member and the de facto supreme ruler in the late Qing dynasty. She was the noble consort of the Xianfeng Emperor, biological mother of the Tongzhi Emperor, and nominal mother of Emperor Guangxu. She allied with Yixin in the Xinyou Coup, consolidating power. During her rule, she appointed Puyi as successor and Zaifeng as Prince-Regent, established the Beiyang Fleet in 1875, and persecuted reformists, leading to Liang Qichao's exile. During the Boxer Movement, influenced by conservative princes, she reappointed the xenophobic Yuxian, subsequently declaring war on multiple foreign powers, which led to the invasion by the Eight-Nation Alliance, and her authority was severely challenged by the Mutual Protection of Southeast China. Her tomb was later looted by Sun Dianying.

description.zh-cn: 为镇压义和团运动而侵华的八国军事联盟。攻陷天津、北京后，在与清廷的议和中，坚决要求严惩毓贤等主战派官员。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance that invaded China to suppress the Boxer Movement. After capturing Tianjin and Beijing, they insisted on severely punishing hawkish officials like Yuxian during peace negotiations with the Qing court.

description.zh-cn: 指中华民国在中国大陆的统治时期。该时期的国民政府于1943年与英国签订新约，废除了《南京条约》中的部分不平等条款。
description.en: Refers to the period when the Republic of China governed mainland China. The Nationalist Government of this period signed a new treaty with the UK in 1943, abolishing some of the unequal clauses in the Treaty of Nanking.

It operates under two names with the Cyberspace Administration of China, and is responsible for internet content censorship and regulation in China. As an internet content regulator in China, it guided the Beijing Cyberspace Administration to summon and order Sina to rectify its practices in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 中央机构编制委员会办公室，是中国共产党中央机构编制委员会的常设办事机构，正部级中共中央办事机构。负责全国行政管理体制和机构改革以及机构编制的日常管理工作。其历史可追溯至1988年组建，当时与国务院机构改革办公室一个机构两块牌子；自1991年起，正式成为既是中共中央的机构，又是国务院的机构。该机构还曾对“一个机构两块牌子”的含义做出过政策解释。
description.en: The Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission is the permanent working body of the Central Institutional Organization Commission of the Communist Party of China, functioning as a ministerial-level working body of the CPC Central Committee. It is responsible for the daily management of the national administrative system and institutional reform, as well as institutional organization. Its history can be traced back to its establishment in 1988, when it operated under the arrangement of 'one institution, two names' with the State Council Office for Institutional Reform. Since 1991, it has officially served as an institution of both the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. It has also provided policy explanations for the meaning of 'one institution with two names'.

description.en: A Central People's Government agency established in Hong Kong under the National Security Law, also serving as a dispatch agency of the CPC Central Committee. It is responsible for supervising, guiding, coordinating, and supporting the HKSAR in fulfilling its duties to safeguard national security, and can exercise jurisdiction directly in specific situations.
