After the 2018 reform, its responsibilities were integrated into the Party School of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, with its nameplate retained externally, effectively operating as one institution with two names alongside the Central Party School. He Yiting served as its Executive Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 1949年9月27日由中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议通过，是中华人民共和国成立初期的临时宪法性文件。该文件规定了中央人民政府的组织结构，其中第十八条特别规定设立中央人民政府重工业部。
description.en: A provisional constitutional document passed on September 27, 1949, by the First Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in the early days of the People's Republic of China. It stipulated the organizational structure of the Central People's Government, with Article 18 specifically mandating the establishment of the Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的早期部队之一，前身为红六军。黄公略于1930年6月起任该军军长，吴烈也于同年加入该部队。
description.en: One of the early units of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, formerly the Red 6th Army. Huang Gonglue served as its commander from June 1930, and Wu Lie also joined the unit in the same year.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾代理红三军政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as acting Political Commissar of the Third Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军早期杰出将领，曾任红十二军军长。
description.en: An outstanding early general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Commander of the Twelfth Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的一支部队，由平江起义部队改编而成。该部队曾由彭德怀领导，黄公略任副军长。在袁文才、王佐被杀害后，该部队被迫撤出井冈山。
description.en: A unit of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, formed from the troops of the Pingjiang Uprising. This unit was led by Peng Dehuai, with Huang Gonglue serving as its deputy commander. After the killing of Yuan Wencai and Wang Zuo, the unit was forced to withdraw from the Jinggang Mountains.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第十六军
中央苏区第一次反围剿战争
中国共产党第一次反围剿战争

description.zh-cn: 国民政府对中央苏区中国工农红军发动的第一次大规模军事围剿。鲁涤平担任主力指挥官，黄公略率红三军参战。此次行动最终以失败告终。
description.en: The first large-scale military encirclement campaign launched by the Nationalist Government against the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in the Central Soviet Area. Lu Diping served as the main commander, and Huang Gonglue led the Red 3rd Army to participate. This campaign ultimately ended in failure.

It also took over the daily regulatory responsibilities for financial holding companies and relevant financial consumer protection duties from the People's Bank of China.

It is responsible for supervising the People's Liberation Army and the People's Armed Police Force, serving as the disciplinary inspection organ of the Communist Party of China and a state supervisory organ.

en: Government Offices Administration of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 湖南省是彭帅的出生地。作为中国的一个省份，它下辖多个地级市，其中曾有地级市在1983年短暂管辖县级娄底市。
description.en: Hunan Province is the birthplace of Peng Shuai. As a Chinese province, it administers various prefecture-level cities, one of which briefly had jurisdiction over the county-level Loudi City in 1983.

description.zh-cn: 中国四川省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Sichuan Province, China.

en: Government of the Republic of China in Guangzhou

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山于1921年在广州成立的护法政府，以对抗北洋政府。
1922年，陈炯明部下在广州发动兵变，炮轰总统府，反对孙中山，导致孙中山离开广州。
description.en: A mutiny launched by Chen Jiongming in Guangzhou in 1922 against Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 一种联邦主义政治主张，与孙中山的武力统一主张相对立。
中国近代外交家、法学家，曾代理国务总理，并担任民军议和全权总代表。
description.en: A modern Chinese diplomat and jurist who served as Acting Premier and also as the Plenipotentiary for peace talks between the civil and military forces.

description.zh-cn: 政治家、外交家，官立山东大学堂首任校长。曾任中华民国第一任内阁总理，章宗祥曾作为其随从参加南北议和。后因赵秉钧奉袁世凯之命发起的反唐运动而被迫辞职。
description.en: Politician and diplomat, and the first principal of the Official Shandong University. He served as the first Premier of the Republic of China, and Zhang Zongxiang attended the North-South peace negotiations as his attendant. He was later forced to resign due to the anti-Tang movement initiated by Zhao Bingjun under Yuan Shikai's orders.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事家，中华民国时期将领，东京振武学校校友。他参与发起护国战争，并担任护国军第二军总司令，与蔡锷、唐继尧并称“护国三杰”。
description.en: A Chinese military strategist and general during the Republic of China era, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. He participated in launching the National Protection War and served as the commander of the Second Army, known as one of the 'Three Heroes of National Protection' along with Cai E and Tang Jiyao.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国外交家、书法家。
description.en: A diplomat and calligrapher of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，北洋军阀皖系的代表人物。他也是中华民国大陆时期浙江军阀，曾在与江苏军阀齐燮元的斗争中得到王亚樵的支持。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China and a representative of the Anhui clique of the Beiyang Warlords. He was also a Zhejiang warlord during the Republic of China era, who received support from Wang Yaqiao in his struggle against Jiangsu warlord Qi Xieyuan.

description.zh-cn: 旧桂系首领

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清广东省广州府新会县潮居都茶坑乡
birth_place.en: Chakeng, Xinhui, Guangzhou, Guangdong, Great Qing

death_place.zh-cn: 中华民国北平协和医院
death_place.en: Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Beiping, Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国近代思想家、政治家、教育家、史学家、文学家。作为戊戌变法领袖之一，他是清末民初中国知识界与政界领军人物。他曾任自立军副总指挥，负责海外募款，倡导君主立宪。后反对袁世凯称帝，并在张勋复辟时担任讨逆军参谋。曾是蔡锷的老师和政治盟友。他于1914年在清华演讲中提出“自强不息，厚德载物”，后被定为校训。作为巴黎和会中国代表团顾问，他通报外交困境，是五四运动爆发的信息源头。他还是清华国学研究院四大导师之一，梁思成之父，晚年专注于文化教育与学术研究，对西学东渐贡献巨大。
description.en: A prominent Chinese thinker, politician, educator, historian, and writer. As one of the leaders of the Hundred Days' Reform, he was a leading figure in China's intellectual and political circles during the late Qing Dynasty and early Republic. He served as the deputy commander of the Self-Support Army, responsible for overseas fundraising, and advocated constitutional monarchy. He later opposed Yuan Shikai's imperial ambitions and served as a staff officer in the Anti-Restoration Army during Zhang Xun's attempt to restore the Qing monarchy. He was Cai E's teacher and political ally. In his 1914 speech at Tsinghua, he proposed the phrase 'Self-discipline and Social Commitment,' which was later adopted as the university motto. As an advisor to the Chinese delegation at the Paris Peace Conference, his report on diplomatic difficulties became the informational source for the May Fourth Movement's outbreak. He was also one of the four great tutors at the Tsinghua Institute of Chinese Studies and the father of Liang Sicheng. In his later years, he focused on cultural education and academic research, making significant contributions to the dissemination of Western knowledge.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人，首任中央纪律检查机关负责人。
1934年由中共六届五中全会决定成立，取代中央审查委员会。
因台风暴雨导致的严重水库溃坝灾难，其根本原因与大跃进时期水利工程质量问题有关。
陕西省安康市发生的特大洪灾，其成因与大跃进时期修建的丹江口水库有关。
大跃进时期为追求钢产量而发动的群众性炼钢运动。
大跃进时期出现的虚报、夸大生产成果的社会风气。
一位台湾省专卖局缉私组查缉员。1947年2月27日，在查缉私烟并引发的圆环缉烟事件中，他因不当行为用手枪枪柄殴打烟贩林江迈，致其头部流血昏迷。此流血冲突直接导致了二二八事件。该查缉员后被判无罪。
description.en: An agent of the Taiwan Provincial Monopoly Bureau's Anti-smuggling Group. On February 27, 1947, during the Roundabout Cigarette Incident, which arose from his anti-contraband cigarette operation, he struck vendor Lin Jiang-mai on the head with his pistol butt due to improper conduct, causing her to bleed and fall unconscious. This violent conflict directly led to the February 28 Incident. The agent was later acquitted.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后，中华民国政府在台湾设立的最高统治机构，由陈仪担任行政长官。在二二八事件中，其卫兵向抗议民众开枪，激化了冲突。

description.zh-cn: 指台湾从以往中国国民党一党专政的非民主政体成功转型为自由民主国家的政治进程，主要以民间社会运动及体制内的政治改革为主。

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省形式上的最高行政机关。二二八事件后取代台湾省行政长官公署。傅兆林曾在此任职。该机构于1998年虚级化后，功能与业务大幅缩减并转移，成为行政院的派出机关。2018年7月1日起实施“去任务化”，预算归零，业务与员额由中央政府相关部会承接，实质解散。
description.en: The de jure highest administrative organ of Taiwan Province, Republic of China. It replaced the Taiwan Province Administrative Executive Office after the 228 Incident. Fu Zhaolin once worked here. After being streamlined in 1998, its functions and operations were significantly reduced and transferred, becoming a dispatched agency of the Executive Yuan. From July 1, 2018, it was 'de-tasked', its budget was zeroed out, and its duties and staff were taken over by relevant central government ministries, effectively dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，洋务派和清流派的主要代表人物。他历任山西巡抚、两广总督、湖广总督、军机大臣等职，官至体仁阁大学士。在湖广总督任内，他选送学生入成城学校学习军事，并曾推荐黄兴入武昌两湖书院读书。他倡导“中学为体，西学为用”，创办了汉阳铁厂等近代工业和教育机构。曾镇压自立军起义，是东南互保的核心人物之一。与曾国藩、李鸿章、左宗棠并称“晚清四大名臣”，曾建议慈禧太后给予载沣“摄政王”的封号。
description.en: A prominent official of the late Qing dynasty, a key representative of the Westernization Movement and the Qingliu school. He held various high-ranking positions including Governor of Shanxi, Viceroy of Liangguang, Viceroy of Huguang, and Grand Councilor, eventually rising to the rank of Grand Secretary of the Tiren Cabinet. During his tenure as Viceroy of Huguang, he selected students to study military science at Seijō Gakkō in 1898, and also recommended Huang Xing to study at the Lianghu Academy in Wuchang. Advocating 'Chinese learning as the essence, Western learning for practical use', he founded a series of modern industrial and educational institutions such as the Hanyang Iron Works. He suppressed the Self-Strengthening Army Uprising and was one of the key figures in the Mutual Protection of Southeast China. Known as one of the 'Four Great Officials of the Late Qing' alongside Zeng Guofan, Li Hongzhang, and Zuo Zongtang, he once suggested to Empress Dowager Cixi that Zaifeng be given the title of 'Prince-Regent'.

清朝第十一位皇帝，也是入关后的第九位。他是奕𫍽第二子，载沣的异母兄。由慈禧太后指定，被过继给咸丰帝，并于1875年登基，继承同治帝皇位。在位期间，他施行新政，主导戊戌变法，批准创办山东大学堂和北洋大学堂。甲午战争失败后，他下旨撤销海军衙门和北洋水师编制。戊戌政变失败后，他被慈禧太后软禁。自立军起义曾以营救他并建立君主立宪制为目标。
description.en: The eleventh emperor of the Qing dynasty, and the ninth after its entry into Shanhai Pass. He was the second son of Yixuan and the elder half-brother of Zaifeng. Designated by Empress Dowager Cixi, he was adopted by Emperor Xianfeng and ascended the throne in 1875, succeeding Emperor Tongzhi. During his reign, he implemented New Policies, led the Hundred Days' Reform, and approved the establishment of Shandong University and Peiyang University. After the defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War, he issued an edict to abolish the Admiralty and the Beiyang Fleet. Following the failure of the Wuxu Coup, he was placed under house arrest by Empress Dowager Cixi. The Self-Support Army Uprising aimed to rescue him and establish a constitutional monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪末发生于中国清朝的一场以“扶清灭洋”为口号的农民运动，亦指随后导致的八国联军侵华事件。这场武装冲突对孔祥熙的早年生活造成了冲击。事变后，清廷派载沣赴德国为德国公使被杀一事道歉。
description.en: An armed conflict and peasant movement that occurred in late 19th century Qing China, commonly known by the slogan 'Support the Qing, exterminate the foreigners.' It also refers to the subsequent invasion by the Eight-Nation Alliance. This conflict significantly impacted H. H. Kung's early life. Following the incident, Zaifeng was dispatched to Germany to apologize for the killing of the German minister.

description.zh-cn: 数学家，中科院院士

孔子，中国春秋末期鲁国的思想家、政治家、教育家、哲学家，儒家学派的创始人与主要代表人物。传统上被认为撰写了《十翼》（易传），其言行被弟子及再传弟子记录并编纂成《论语》。他曾称赞晏婴，并受到庄子借盗跖之口的批评。其思想和相关文物在“破四旧”中被视为攻击目标。明嘉靖九年（1530年），明世宗将其尊号由“大成至圣文宣王”改为“至圣先师”。
description.en: Confucius, a philosopher, politician, educator, and thinker from the late Spring and Autumn period in the State of Lu, is regarded as the founder and principal representative of the Confucian school of thought. He is traditionally credited with writing the 'Ten Wings' (Yizhuan), and his words and deeds were recorded and compiled into the 'Analects' by his disciples and their successors. He once praised Yan Ying and was criticized by Zhuangzi through the character Robber Zhi. His ideas and related cultural relics were targeted during the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement. In the 9th year of Jiajing (1530), Emperor Shizong of the Ming Dynasty changed his honorific title from 'Greatly Accomplished, Ultimate Sage, King of Culture' to 'Ultimate Sage, First Teacher'.

Established in 1949, it is responsible for defending the capital Beijing. Since 2016, it has been subordinate to the PLA Ground Force Headquarters and receives direct command from the Central Military Commission. Its main responsibilities include safeguarding the capital's security during peacetime, and during wartime, covering the transfer or evacuation of central government organs, defending against foreign enemies, counter-terrorism, and riot control. description.en: A direct-administered municipality, national central city, and megacity of the People's Republic of China. Located in southwestern China and the upper reaches of the Yangtze River, it is a crucial strategic point for the Western Development. With a recorded history of over 3000 years, it is the birthplace of Bashu culture. It served as the wartime capital of the Republic of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War. In 1997, it was re-established as a direct-administered municipality due to the needs of the Three Gorges Project. It gained widespread attention as the place where the 'Chongqing Model' was implemented, and is also the ancestral home of Ai Yuejin. Additionally, the China Development Bank, led by Chen Yuan, approved substantial loans to the city.

法兰克王国是由日耳曼部落建立的中世纪欧洲王国。其国王丕平献土创立了教宗国。在法国君主腓力二世之前，法国国王一直使用“法兰克国王”头衔。
description.en: The Kingdom of the Franks was a medieval European kingdom established by a Germanic tribe. Its king, Pepin, donated land to establish the Papal States. Before the French monarch Philip II, French kings consistently used the title 'King of the Franks'.

description.zh-cn: 一个存在于中世纪至近代早期的君主制国家，最初由瓦卢瓦王朝统治，是百年战争中的主要参战方之一。它也参与了七年战争，与奥地利、俄国结盟对抗普鲁士和英国。七年战争战败后，失去了大量海外殖民地，国力受损。玛丽·安托瓦内特是其末代王后。
description.en: A monarchy in Western Europe that existed from the Middle Ages to the early modern period, initially ruled by the House of Valois. It was one of the main belligerents in the Hundred Years' War and also participated in the Seven Years' War, allied with Austria and Russia against Prussia and Great Britain. After its defeat in the Seven Years' War, it lost vast overseas colonies and its national power was weakened. Marie Antoinette was its last queen consort.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国是一个自962年建立，延续至1806年的欧洲国家。它以德意志民族为主体，版图横跨中欧与南欧。其皇帝被视为古罗马帝国的合法继承者和西方基督教世界的世俗领袖。作为中世纪欧洲的政治实体，它曾与英格兰结盟在布汶战役中对抗法国。在经历了三十年战争和拿破仑战争的削弱后，帝国于1806年解体。
description.en: The Holy Roman Empire was a European state that existed from 962 to 1806. Predominantly German, its territory spanned Central and Southern Europe. Its emperors were regarded as the legitimate successors to the ancient Roman Empire and the secular leaders of Western Christendom. As a political entity in medieval Europe, it allied with England against France in the Battle of Bouvines. After being weakened by the Thirty Years' War and the Napoleonic Wars, the empire was dissolved in 1806.

description.zh-cn: 对金雀花王朝在12世纪和13世纪统治的领地的统称，包括英格兰和法国西部的大片地区。在布汶战役中与神圣罗马帝国结盟。
description.en: A collective term for the realms of the Plantagenets during the 12th and 13th centuries, including England and large parts of western France. It allied with the Holy Roman Empire in the Battle of Bouvines.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争中的主要参战方之一，由金雀花王朝及后来的兰开斯特王朝统治。
description.en: One of the main belligerents in the Hundred Years' War, ruled by the House of Plantagenet and later the House of Lancaster.

description.zh-cn: 1337年至1453年间英格兰王国与法兰西王国发生的一系列军事冲突，最终以法国胜利告终，英格兰丧失除加来外的大陆领土。
description.en: A series of military conflicts between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of France from 1337 to 1453. It resulted in a French victory, with England losing its continental territories except for Calais.

location.zh-cn: 欧洲、北美、中美洲、西非海岸、印度及菲律宾
location.en: Europe, North America, Central America, the West African coast, India, and the Philippines

description.zh-cn: 一场由当时西方主要强国参与的全球性军事冲突，战争影响覆盖欧洲、北美、中美洲、西非海岸、印度及菲律宾，被认为是第一次“世界大战”。其结果导致法国将其几乎所有的北美殖民地让予英国。法国因参战导致国库空虚，成为法国大革命的远因之一。
description.en: A global military conflict involving all of the major European great powers of the time. The war spanned Europe, North America, Central America, the West African coast, India, and the Philippines, and has been described as the first 'world war'. It resulted in France ceding almost all of its North American colonies to Great Britain. France's participation also led to an empty treasury, becoming one of the long-term causes of the French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 法国波旁王朝的最后一任国王。在法国大革命期间，他因八月十日事件被国民立法议会暂停职务，并随后被国民公会审判并处决。
description.en: The last King of France of the House of Bourbon. During the French Revolution, he was suspended from his duties by the Legislative Assembly after the Insurrection of 10 August 1792, and subsequently tried and executed by the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 法国的一段深刻社会激进与政治动荡时期，它推翻了法国君主制，建立了共和国，并最终促成了拿破仑·波拿巴的崛起。这场变革对法国历史以及全欧洲都产生了深刻而深远的影响。
description.en: A period of profound social and political upheaval in France that led to the overthrow of the French monarchy, the establishment of a republic, and ultimately culminated in the rise of Napoleon Bonaparte. This transformative period had a lasting and profound impact on French history and on Europe as a whole.

en: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen

description.zh-cn: 于1792年9月22日由国民公会宣告成立的共和国政体，取代了法兰西王国。
description.en: The republic proclaimed by the National Convention on September 22, 1792, which replaced the Kingdom of France.

description.zh-cn: 法国军事家、政治家，法兰西第一帝国的缔造者和皇帝。他在法国大革命中崛起，尤其在葡月13日事件中镇压叛乱，为其政治生涯奠定基础。通过拿破仑战争等军事行动和政治决策，他极大地改变了欧洲政治格局，并直接导致了神圣罗马帝国的解体。
description.en: French military strategist and statesman, founder and emperor of the First French Empire. He rose to prominence during the French Revolution, notably suppressing the 13 Vendémiaire rebellion, which laid the foundation for his political career. Through military campaigns like the Napoleonic Wars and political decisions, he profoundly reshaped the European political landscape and directly led to the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第二共和国的唯一一位总统和法兰西第二帝国的唯一一位皇帝。他曾以“教会的保护者”名义派兵保护罗马，阻止意大利王国占领（即教宗国）。
description.en: The only president of the French Second Republic and the only emperor of the Second French Empire. He protected Rome with French troops in his capacity as 'protector of the Church', preventing its capture by the Kingdom of Italy (i.e., the Papal States).

description.zh-cn: 由拿破仑三世统治的法国政权。该政权曾出兵保护教宗国免受意大利王国吞并，并与大英帝国结盟，联合发动第二次鸦片战争以对抗清朝。
description.en: The French regime ruled by Napoleon III. It allied with the British Empire and jointly launched the Second Opium War against the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国与法兰西第二帝国之间的战争，是德国统一战争的最后一场，其结果是德意志帝国的建立。这场战争也导致法国从罗马撤军，为意大利王国吞并罗马创造了条件。
description.en: The final of the German unification wars, fought between the Kingdom of Prussia and the Second French Empire, which resulted in the creation of the German Empire. It also led to the French withdrawal from Rome, creating conditions for the Kingdom of Italy to annex Rome.

description.zh-cn: 1870年至1940年间的法国共和政府，是协约国的主要成员国之一。在第二次世界大战中被纳粹德国击败后解体。
description.en: The republican government of France from 1870 to 1940, it was one of the main member states of the Entente Powers. It collapsed after the defeat by Nazi Germany in World War II.

location.zh-cn: 欧洲、亚洲、非洲、大西洋、太平洋

description.zh-cn: 一场1914年至1918年发生的全球性军事冲突，始于欧洲，萨拉热窝事件是其直接导火索。齐默尔曼电报的曝光促使美国于1917年参战。战争导致的民生灾难是德国十一月革命的诱因之一。中国作为战胜国虽参加巴黎和会，但山东问题处理不公引发了五四运动。此战还导致了奥斯曼帝国的瓦解。
description.en: A global military conflict (1914-1918) originating in Europe, directly triggered by the Sarajevo incident. The disclosure of the Zimmermann Telegram prompted the United States to join the war in 1917. The resulting social and economic hardships were a cause of the German November Revolution. Although China participated in the Paris Peace Conference as a victorious nation, the unfair handling of the Shandong Problem led to the May Fourth Movement. This war also led to the collapse of the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的同盟国成员，曾占领比利时并在1918年发动克里米亚行动占领半岛。其通过齐默尔曼电报试图与墨西哥结盟对抗美国。
description.en: A member of the Central Powers in World War I, it occupied Belgium and launched the Crimean Operation in 1918 to occupy the peninsula. It attempted to form an alliance with Mexico against the United States via the Zimmermann Telegram.

zh-cn: 夏尔·安德烈·约瑟夫·马里·戴高乐
en: Charles André Joseph Marie de Gaulle

description.zh-cn: 法国军事家、政治家，第二次世界大战期间领导自由法国运动，战后成为法兰西第五共和国的创建者和首任总统。
description.en: French general and statesman who led the Free French Forces during World War II. He later founded the French Fifth Republic in 1958 and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 1949年5月23日在美、英、法三国占领区成立。作为欧盟创始成员国之一，其国家主导的工业发展模式和强权政策曾成为明治日本效仿的对象。近期，德国政府批评伊朗政权镇压示威，并呼吁欧盟对伊朗实施进一步制裁。
description.en: Established on 23 May 1949 in the zones occupied by the United States, the United Kingdom, and France. As one of the founding members of the EU, its state-led industrial development model and strong-arm policies became a model for Meiji Japan. Recently, the German government criticized the Iranian regime for suppressing protests and called on the EU to impose further sanctions on Iran.

description.zh-cn: 法国军事将领、政治家及法国元帅。第一次世界大战中因凡尔登战役的胜利而成为民族英雄，但在第二次世界大战期间领导与纳粹德国合作的维希法国政府，战后被判叛国罪。
description.en: A French general, politician, and Marshal of France. He became a national hero for his victory at the Battle of Verdun in World War I, but led the collaborationist Vichy France regime with Nazi Germany during World War II, for which he was convicted of treason.

location.zh-cn: 维希 (事实), 巴黎 (法定), 西格马林根 (流亡)
location.en: Vichy (de facto), Paris (de jure), Sigmaringen (in exile)

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，由菲利普·贝当领导的法国国家政权。它最初在法国未被德军占领的南部地区成立，名义上中立，但与纳粹德国合作，并于1942年后被德国完全控制。
description.en: During World War II, this French state was led by Philippe Pétain. Initially established in the southern, unoccupied zone of France, it was officially neutral but collaborated with Nazi Germany and became fully controlled by Germany after 1942.

description.zh-cn: 由夏尔·戴高乐在伦敦建立的流亡政府，致力于抵抗德国占领和维希政权，并在解放法国中发挥了关键作用。
description.en: A government-in-exile established in London by Charles de Gaulle, dedicated to resisting the German occupation and the Vichy regime, and playing a key role in the liberation of France.

description.zh-cn: 一个由欧洲和北美国家组成的国际军事联盟，旨在实现集体防御和防务合作。它包括2个北美国家和30个欧洲国家，加拿大是其创始国之一，拉脱维亚于2004年加入。俄罗斯对其东扩的担忧是发动战争的宣称理由之一。
description.en: An international military alliance formed by European and North American countries, aiming for collective defense and cooperation. It comprises 2 North American and 30 European states, with Canada as one of its founding members and Latvia joining in 2004. Russia's concerns about its eastward expansion were one of the stated reasons for the war.

description.zh-cn: 法国前总统，任内推动法国重返北约军事指挥结构。
美国及其盟友于2003年3月以伊拉克拥有大规模杀伤性武器为由发动军事行动，推翻了萨达姆政权。这场冲突导致伊拉克什叶派地位持续上升。在此期间，加拿大拒绝加入美方行动，巴沙尔·阿萨德也对此表示坚决反对。
description.en: In March 2003, the United States and its allies launched a military operation, citing Iraq's possession of weapons of mass destruction, which led to the overthrow of Saddam Hussein's regime. This conflict resulted in the continued rise in status for Shia Muslims in Iraq. During this period, Canada declined to join the U.S. efforts, and Bashar al-Assad also strongly opposed the campaign.

en: French aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle

description.zh-cn: 位于法国巴黎战神广场的铁制镂空塔，为巴黎城市地标及法国文化象征之一，曾为世界最高人造建筑。
description.en: A wrought-iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is a cultural icon of France and one of the most recognizable structures in the world. It was the world's tallest man-made structure upon its completion.

zh-cn: 国立广东高等师范学校

description.zh-cn: 中山大学的源流学校之一。
中山大学的源流学校之一。

zh-cn: 广东公立农业专门学校

description.zh-cn: 中山大学的源流学校之一。
1952年院系调整中，其文理院系与中山大学合并。
2001年与中山大学合并。
位于中国广东省广州市的一所高等农业院校，是华南农业大学的前身之一。
description.en: An institution of higher agricultural education located in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, one of the predecessors of South China Agricultural University.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史学家、教育家，曾在国民参政会上揭发孔祥熙贪腐，并曾任国立台湾大学校长。
description.en: Chinese historian and educator who exposed H. H. Kung's corruption at the People's Political Council and was a former president of National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省深圳市的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊长子，原为皇太子，在玄武门之变中被李世民所杀。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Gaozu of Tang and the original crown prince, killed by Li Shimin during the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

description.zh-cn: 2000年与中南工业大学、长沙铁道学院合并组建为中南大学。
description.en: In 2000, it merged with Central South University of Technology and Changsha Railway University to form Central South University.

zh-cn: 湖南公立工业专门学校

description.zh-cn: 这是一所中国高等医学院校，是湖南医科大学的前身。它后来成为中南大学下属的医学院。该校是郭兆贵的母校，张孝骞曾在此学习、任教并担任院长，郭兆贵也曾担任教授和博士生导师。
description.en: This is a Chinese higher medical college, the predecessor of Hunan Medical University. It later became the medical school affiliated with Central South University. It is Guo Zhaogui's alma mater. Zhang Xiaoqian studied, taught, and served as its president, and Guo Zhaogui also served as a professor and doctoral supervisor here.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国卫生部
en: Ministry of Health of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国国务院主管卫生工作的组成部门，2013年撤销，其职能整合入国家卫生和计划生育委员会。
description.en: The former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China in charge of health work, which was abolished in 2013, with its functions integrated into the National Health and Family Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家
中国企业家
病毒学与微生物学家
中国内科医学家、医学教育家及中国消化病学的奠基人。
description.en: Chinese internist, medical educator, and founder of Chinese gastroenterology.

en: Tianjin University of Science and Technology

zh-cn: 天津大学佐治亚理工深圳学院
en: Georgia Tech Shenzhen Institute, Tianjin University

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任同济大学党委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Party Secretary of Tongji University.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期政治家、外交家、法学家。他作为北洋大学堂首批毕业生，获钦字第壹号考凭，并曾任国务总理。
description.en: A politician, diplomat, and jurist during the Republic of China period. As one of the first graduates of Beiyang University, he received the 'Qin Zi Di Yi Hao Kao Ping' (Imperial Examination Certificate No. 1) and served as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中国诗人
中国工程教育家，曾任国立北洋工学院院长。
动力机械工程专家，中国工程院院士，接替钟登华担任天津大学校长。
description.en: Expert in power machinery engineering, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and president of Tianjin University, succeeding Zhong Denghua.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，曾任陕西巡抚、两江总督。后在保路运动激化后，被清廷任命为署理四川总督，率湖北新军入川镇压。他曾是东南互保的支持者，并创办了暨南学堂。1911年11月27日，他在资中县被哗变的部下所杀。
description.en: A late Qing official, who served as Governor of Shaanxi and Governor-General of Liangjiang. Later, after the escalation of the Railway Protection Movement, he was appointed acting Governor-General of Sichuan by the Qing court and led the Hubei New Army into Sichuan for suppression. He was a supporter of the Mutual Protection of Southeast China and founded Jinan School. On November 27, 1911, he was killed by his mutinous subordinates in Zizhong County.

en: Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院负责侨务工作的办事机构。
description.en: An administrative office of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for overseas Chinese affairs.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上海市军事管制委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国儒家经典之一。
儒家重要经典之一，是中国春秋时期的思想家孔子及其弟子言行为主的言论汇编。内容涉及治国理念、人伦关系、个人道德规范等。
description.en: One of the most important classics of Confucianism, a compilation of speeches, sayings, and deeds primarily of the philosopher Confucius and his disciples, from the Spring and Autumn period of China. It covers topics such as governance, human relations, and personal moral standards.

description.zh-cn: 中国男子短跑运动员，暨南大学体育学院院长。

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市

description.zh-cn: 美国圣公会创办的教会大学，1952年院系调整中主要院系并入华东师范大学。

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市

description.zh-cn: 1952年在中国大陆仿照苏联模式进行的高等院校调整，对华东师范大学的建立和发展有重要影响。
中国教育家，华东师范大学首任校长。
中国教育家、哲学家，文化大革命后华东师范大学首位校长。
中国工程院院士，华东师范大学现任校长。
美国圣公会主教，圣约翰大学创办人。
中国田径运动员，奥运会冠军，华东师范大学校友。

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市

description.zh-cn: 由华东师范大学和纽约大学合作创办的中美合作国际化大学。
华东师范大学原校长，上海纽约大学首任校长。
桥梁工程与结构力学专家，同济大学前校长、名誉校长。
中国共产党党员，水利和水电专家及政治人物，曾任国家级副职领导人。历任中共第十至第十四届中央委员，第七、八、九届全国政协副主席，第八届全国政协妇青和法制委员会主任，中华人民共和国水利部、水利电力部部长，中国工程院院士，及第六届中国红十字会会长。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China, an expert in water conservancy and hydropower, and a political figure. She served as a national-level deputy leader, a member of the 10th to 14th Central Committees of the CCP, Vice Chairperson of the 7th, 8th, and 9th National Committees of the CPPCC, Director of the Women, Youth and Legal Affairs Committee of the 8th CPPCC National Committee, Minister of Water Resources and Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power, Academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and the 6th President of the Red Cross Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 前身为重庆土木建筑学院，原建筑老八校之一，2000年并入重庆大学。
数学家。
中华人民共和国教育官员、理学博士、教授兼博士生导师。曾任重庆大学校长、浙江大学校长及北京大学校长。此外，他还曾担任中国社会科学院马克思主义研究院副院长。
description.en: An education official of the People's Republic of China, holding a Doctor of Science degree, a professor, and a doctoral advisor. He formerly served as the President of Chongqing University, Zhejiang University, and Peking University. Additionally, he also served as the Deputy Director of the Academy of Marxism, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，华为技术有限公司创始人、集团总裁。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, founder and president of Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 画家、艺术家。
重庆大学研究生院副院长、化学化工学院教授、博士生导师。
重庆大学化学化工学院本科生。
原由重庆大学管理的独立学院。
清朝官员，首任管理大学堂事务大臣。
美国传教士，京师大学堂首任西学总教习。
中国清朝末年设立的第一所新式学校，1902年并入京师大学堂。
中国近代启蒙思想家、翻译家，曾任京师大学堂译书局总办、北京大学校署理校长。他翻译了《天演论》等西方学术名著，系统地将进化论、自由主义等西方思想引入中国。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and translator of the late Qing period, most famous for introducing Western ideas, including Darwin's 'survival of the fittest', to China in the late 19th century.

zh-cn: 国立北京大学 (汪精卫国民政府)

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，日伪政府在北京大学原址上成立的大学。
中国政治人物，原北京大学哲学系党总支书记。她因贴出“全国第一张马列主义的大字报”而成为文革时期的风云人物。该大字报被全国播出后，引发了外地造反者奔赴北京的热潮，是全国大串连的缘起之一。
description.en: A Chinese political figure and former Party Secretary of Peking University's Philosophy Department. She rose to prominence during the Cultural Revolution by posting 'the first Marxist-Leninist big-character poster' in China. After her poster was broadcast nationwide, it triggered a wave of rebels heading to Beijing, becoming one of the origins of the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国药物化学家，中国中医科学院终身研究员兼首席研究员，青蒿素和双氢青蒿素的发现者，北京大学医学院校友。因其在抗疟药方面的贡献，于2015年获得诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: A Chinese pharmaceutical chemist, lifetime researcher and chief researcher at the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, and the discoverer of artemisinin and dihydroartemisinin. An alumna of Peking University Medical School. She was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2015 for her contributions to antimalarial drugs.

description.zh-cn: 华裔物理学家、诺贝尔物理学奖得主。因提出弱相互作用中宇称不守恒理论而与李政道共同获得1957年诺贝尔物理学奖。他也是国立西南联合大学校友和中国科学院院士。自1997年6月清华大学高等研究中心成立起即担任名誉主任（后为名誉院长），同时也是该院教员。
description.en: A Chinese physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics. He, along with Tsung-Dao Lee, received the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1957 for their work on parity non-conservation in weak interaction. He is also an alumnus of National Southwestern Associated University and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. Since June 1997, he has served as the Honorary Director (later Honorary Dean) of the Institute for Advanced Study at Tsinghua University and is also a faculty member.

description.zh-cn: 新东方教育集团创始人，北京大学校友。
中国企业家，百度公司创始人、董事长兼首席执行官，北京大学校友。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Baidu.

description.zh-cn: 由北京大学于1986年投资创办的大型控股集团公司，现已发展为中国综合性企业集团。周鸿祎在创立奇虎360之前曾在此就职。平安人寿参与了其重整投资。
description.en: A large holding group company founded by Peking University in 1986, it has now developed into a Chinese conglomerate. Zhou Hongyi worked here before founding Qihoo 360. Ping An Life Insurance participated in its restructuring investment.

description.zh-cn: 物理学家，现任北京大学校长。
现任北京大学党委书记。
南京大学校长。
南京大学前校长。
华裔物理学家，被誉为“物理学第一夫人”，毕业于伯克利大学。她设计的吴氏实验验证了弱相互作用中的宇称不守恒。
description.en: Chinese-American physicist, known as the 'First Lady of Physics' and an alumna of Berkeley. Her Wu experiment provided experimental proof for parity non-conservation in weak interactions.

description.zh-cn: 音乐家、美术教育家、书法家、戏剧活动家。
教育家，南京高等师范学校首任校长，曾聘请释弘一任教。

zh-cn: 五二零“反饥饿、反内战、反迫害”学运

description.zh-cn: 由国立中央大学和金陵大学学生发起的学生运动。
位于美国马里兰州巴尔的摩的私立研究型大学。伍德罗·威尔逊在此获得哲学博士学位，张纯如在此获得文学硕士学位，张孝骞也曾在此进行研究。
description.en: A private research university in Baltimore, Maryland, where Woodrow Wilson earned his Ph.D., Iris Chang obtained her Master of Arts degree, and Zhang Xiaoqian once conducted research.

description.zh-cn: 由北京大学农学院、清华大学农学院和华北大学农学院合并而成，为中国农业大学的前身之一。
中国农业大学的前身之一。1952年成立时名为北京机械化农业学院，1953年更名为北京农业机械化学院，1985年更名为北京农业工程大学。
中国农业大学的历史源头，中国现代农业高等教育的起源地。

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业部
en: Ministry of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾主管农业与农村经济发展的组成部门，现已演变为中华人民共和国农业农村部。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for agriculture and rural economic development, now evolved into the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

birth_place.zh-cn: 江西省赣县梅林镇桃源村
birth_place.en: Taoyuan Village, Meilin Town, Gan County, Jiangxi Province

description.zh-cn: 中国水利工程学家，中国工程院院士。曾任天津大学校长、中华人民共和国教育部副部长，现任中国农业大学党委书记。
description.en: Chinese hydraulic engineering scientist and academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. He previously served as President of Tianjin University, Vice Minister of the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China, and is currently the Party Secretary of China Agricultural University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国烟台市的市级行政机关。
description.en: The municipal-level administrative organ of Yantai, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀将领，曾任北洋政府教育总长、交通部长。
1924年秋，发生于中国北京政府内部直系军阀与奉系军阀之间的第二次战争。因冯玉祥倒戈，奉系取得全胜。战后，杨宇霆被任命为江苏军务督办。
description.en: The Second Zhili–Fengtian War, which took place in the autumn of 1924 within the Beiyang government of China between the Zhili and Fengtian cliques. The Fengtian clique achieved a complete victory due to Feng Yuxiang's defection. After the war, Yang Yuting was appointed as the military governor of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 文学家、小说家、散文家和考古学专家。
散文家、学者、文学批评家、翻译家。
胚胎学家，中国科学院学部委员，第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Embryologist, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 核物理学家，中国科学院院士，第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Nuclear physicist, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国工程院院士。
《环球时报》记者
苏联外交官。
中华民国政治人物，曾任新北市市长，现任中国国民党主席。他曾为国民党总统候选人，并领导国民党采取“以罢制罢”策略，推动罢免民进党籍公职人员。在2024年选举前，积极推动蓝白合作，并参与了君悦会谈。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, former Mayor of New Taipei City, and the current Chairman of the Kuomintang. He was also a KMT presidential candidate, led the KMT to adopt a 'recall for recall' strategy, promoting the recall of DPP public officials. Prior to the 2024 election, he actively promoted the Blue-White Cooperation and participated in the Grand Hyatt meeting.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府在1930年代对日军侵华和共产党活动采取的政策。
台湾政治人物，曾任中国国民党主席。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former Chairman of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 一种机构编制方式，指一个机构拥有两个或以上名称，并以这些名称对外开展工作，但只形成同一个法人实体。这种形式下，同一机构在不同场合或因不同需要使用不同名称，但实质上是同一组人员和职能。例如，国家外汇管理局与中国银行在成立初期即为此种关系。
description.en: An institutional arrangement in the People's Republic of China where one institution operates under two or more names, conducting work under these names, but forming only a single legal entity. Under this arrangement, the same institution uses different names for different occasions or needs, but essentially consists of the same staff and functions. For example, this described the relationship between the State Administration of Foreign Exchange and the Bank of China in its early period.

zh-cn: 上海市文物管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 上海市人民政府组成部门，负责文化和旅游工作。该机构加挂上海市文物局、上海市广播电视局牌子，并对外保留上海市文物管理委员会牌子。
description.en: A component department of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government responsible for culture and tourism. It also operates under the names of Shanghai Municipal Cultural Heritage Bureau and Shanghai Municipal Radio and Television Bureau, and externally retains the nameplate of Shanghai Municipal Cultural Heritage Management Committee.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人力资源和社会保障部
人力资源和社会保障部
en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security
Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，现为国家外国专家局的载体机构。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, which currently hosts the State Administration of Foreign Experts Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国自然资源部管理的国家局。2018年机构改革后，加挂“国家公园管理局”牌子。
description.en: A national bureau administered by the Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China. After the 2018 institutional reform, it added the 'National Park Administration' nameplate.

nodes.id: BAIDU:中华人民共和国国际湿地公约履约办公室

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国际湿地公约履约办公室
中华人民共和国交通运输部
en: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门，负责交通运输工作。李小琳的兄长李小鹏现任该部部长。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for transportation. Li Xiaolin's brother, Li Xiaopeng, is the current minister.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国新闻出版总署
中华人民共和国国家新闻出版总署
en: General Administration of Press and Publication

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国国务院直属机构，负责新闻出版事业。曾与国家版权局为“一个机构两块牌子”，2013年撤销。
description.en: Formerly a direct subordinate agency of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for press and publication affairs. It operated as 'one institution with two names' with the National Copyright Administration and was abolished in 2013.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家版权局
en: National Copyright Administration of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 原与国家新闻出版总署为“一个机构两块牌子”，现加挂在中共中央宣传部。
description.en: Formerly operated as 'one institution with two names' with the General Administration of Press and Publication, now an added nameplate to the Publicity Department of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一个全国性体育社会团体，曾在北京体育大学建校初期进行业务指导。
description.en: A national sports organization in China that provided professional guidance to Beijing Sport University in its early days.

nodes.id: BAIDU:党和国家领导制度的改革

zh-cn: 党和国家领导制度的改革
en: On the Reform of the System of Party and State Leadership

description.zh-cn: 邓小平于1980年8月18日发表的谈话，提倡党政分开。
description.en: A speech delivered by Deng Xiaoping on August 18, 1980, advocating for the separation of party and government.

description.zh-cn: 一项政治体制改革方针，旨在分离中国共产党和政府的职能。该方针的推行导致一些与政府部门对应的党务机构被撤销。
description.en: A policy for political system reform aimed at separating the functions of the Communist Party of China and the government. Its implementation led to the abolition of some Party departments that corresponded to government ministries.

zh-cn: 中共中央对外宣传办公室

location.zh-cn: 北京市东城区朝阳门内大街225号
location.en: 225 Chaoyangmen Inner Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院下属的办事机构，是中共中央宣传部对外加挂的牌子。该机构由中央对外宣传小组于1993年改组而来，并对外使用“国务院新闻办公室”名称，负责对外新闻发布和国际传播工作。其于2014年并入中共中央宣传部。
description.en: An agency under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, which was reorganized from the Central Leading Group for Foreign Propaganda in 1993. It externally used the name 'State Council Information Office' and also served as the external name for the Publicity Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, responsible for foreign-related press releases and international communication. The agency was merged into the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee in 2014.

nodes.id: BAIDU:天津经济技术开发区管理委员会

zh-cn: 天津经济技术开发区管理委员会
天津经济技术开发区管委会
en: Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area Administrative Committee

description.zh-cn: 天津经济技术开发区的行政管理机关。
description.en: The administrative management body of the Tianjin Economic-Technological Development Area.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国自然资源部
en: Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，对外保留国家海洋局的牌子，主管国家的自然资源。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, which externally retains the nameplate of the State Oceanic Administration and is responsible for the country's natural resources.

description.zh-cn: 2018年机构改革后，其职责整合进自然资源部，作为对外保留的牌子。
description.en: After the 2018 institutional reform, its responsibilities were integrated into the Ministry of Natural Resources, and its name is retained as an external nameplate.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管核工业的行政机关，对外由工业和信息化部保留牌子。
description.en: An administrative agency of the State Council of the People's Republic of China in charge of the nuclear industry. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology retains its nameplate for external affairs.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家通用语言文字法
en: Law of the People's Republic of China on the Standard Spoken and Written Chinese Language

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国法律，规定了国家语言文字工作的管理部门。
description.en: A law of the People's Republic of China that specifies the administrative department for the national language work.

zh-cn: 国家标准化管理委员会
国家认证认可监督管理委员会
中华人民共和国生态环境部
en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China

zh-cn: 外语教学与研究出版社
en: Foreign Language Teaching and Research Press

description.zh-cn: 位于江西省南昌市的医学院校，将江西省妇幼保健院调整为其直属附属医院。
description.en: A medical college in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province, which adjusted the Jiangxi Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital to be its directly affiliated hospital.

description.zh-cn: 位于江西省的医疗机构，后调整为南昌医学院直属附属医院，并增加“南昌医学院附属妇幼保健院”为第二名称。
description.en: A medical institution in Jiangxi Province, later adjusted to be a directly affiliated hospital of Nanchang Medical College and added 'Affiliated Maternal and Child Health Hospital of Nanchang Medical College' as its second name.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、政治经济学家、社会学家、历史学家、政治理论家、记者、共产主义者及革命家，马克思主义的创始人之一。他著有《哲学的贫困》，并在第一国际中与巴枯宁存在严重分歧并最终将其开除。莱比锡大学曾于1953年至1991年以其名字命名。
description.en: A German philosopher, political economist, sociologist, historian, political theorist, journalist, communist, and revolutionary, and one of the founders of Marxism. He authored 'The Poverty of Philosophy', had serious disagreements with Bakunin in the First International, and eventually had him expelled. The University of Leipzig was named after him from 1953 to 1991.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、社会科学家、记者、商人、政治思想家和社会主义者。他与马克思共同发展出共产主义理论，是马克思最亲密的朋友和长期合作伙伴。
description.en: German philosopher, social scientist, journalist, businessman, political thinker, and socialist. He co-developed communist theory with Marx and was his closest friend and long-term collaborator.

description.zh-cn: 由弗拉基米尔·列宁提出的一种政治经济理论，主张建立由革命先锋队领导的无产阶级专政。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十四次全国代表大会
en: 14th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
14th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 此次大会选举产生了中国共产党第十四届中央委员会。同时，大会通过决议，同意不再设立中央顾问委员会，标志着该机构正式走入历史。
description.en: This congress elected the 14th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. Additionally, the congress passed a resolution agreeing to abolish the Central Advisory Commission, marking the official end of the institution.

description.zh-cn: 一种经济体制，其生产、资源分配和消费等决策，均由中央政府或权威机构事先计划。其高度集中的模式曾被东欧各国采用，但导致了体制僵化、经济衰退和生活水平低下，成为东欧剧变的内因之一。
description.en: An economic system in which production, resource allocation, and consumption decisions are planned in advance by the central government or authoritative bodies. Its highly centralized model was adopted by Eastern European countries, but it led to systemic rigidity, economic recession, and low living standards, becoming one of the internal causes of the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 一种经济系统，其中商品和服务的价格是由供求双方的公开市场和消费者自愿设定的。

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十八届中央委员会第三次全体会议
en: Third plenary session of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 一种联系人与神祇或超自然、神圣存在的文化体系，或以热情和坚定地信念而坚持信仰的原则或理论体系。
description.en: A cultural system that connects humanity to supernatural or sacred entities, or a system of principles or theories held with ardor and faith.

description.zh-cn: 梵蒂冈城是位于意大利首都罗马市区内的内陆城邦，由天主教会最高权力机构圣座（即罗马教廷）直接统治，为世界领土面积最小的国家。
description.en: An independent city-state and enclave located within Rome, Italy. The Vatican City State is ruled by the Pope, the bishop of Rome and head of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家宗教事务局局长。
一种社会经济体系和政治意识形态，列宁主义的目标是通过暴力革命和无产阶级专政来实现。
description.en: A socio-economic system and political ideology.

description.zh-cn: 中共十三大提出并系统阐述的关于中国社会主义发展阶段的理论，邓小平理论认为中国将长期处于社会主义初级阶段。
description.en: A theory about the developmental stage of socialism in China, proposed and systematically elaborated at the 13th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 收录邓小平主要主张和理论的文集。
一种以生产资料私有制为基础的社会经济体系。它是列宁主义革命和马克思异化论所批判的对象，也受到了情境主义国际的系统性批判。
description.en: A socioeconomic system based on private ownership of the means of production. It is the object of Leninist revolution and critique in Marx's theory of alienation, and was also systematically critiqued by the Situationist International.

description.zh-cn: 政治学家
毛派人士，教授
托洛茨基主义组织
一种政治哲学，建立于马克思列宁主义之上，认为毛主义是马克思列宁主义的更高阶段。
description.en: A political philosophy that builds upon Marxism-Leninism and considers Maoism to be its higher stage.

zh-cn: 国际主义共产主义倾向

description.zh-cn: 左翼共产主义组织
列宁主义的一项核心原则，主张由一个高度纪律性、紧密集中并由“先锋队”成员组成的共产党，来领导无产阶级革命。
description.en: A principle of Leninism which advocates for a communist party composed of a small, centralized, and disciplined group of 'vanguard' members to lead the proletarian revolution.

description.zh-cn: 马克思主义理论中的一个概念，也是列宁主义的核心理论之一。它指在从资本主义到共产主义的过渡时期，由无产阶级掌握国家政权。巴枯宁对此持强烈反对态度，预言它将变成对无产阶级的专政。
description.en: A concept in Marxist theory and a core theory of Leninism, referring to the proletariat holding state power during the transitional period from capitalism to communism. Bakunin was strongly opposed to it, predicting it would become a dictatorship over the proletariat.

description.zh-cn: 由卡尔·马克思和弗里德里希·恩格斯为共产主义者同盟起草的纲领性文件，系统阐述了马克思主义的核心思想，并影响了列宁主义的革命领导理论。
description.en: A programmatic document drafted by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels for the Communist League, which systematically elaborates the core ideas of Marxism and influenced the revolutionary leadership theory of Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 由尤里·马尔托夫领导的俄国社会民主工党的一个派系，被列宁主义革命政权镇压。
description.en: A faction of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party led by Yuli Martov.

description.zh-cn: 俄国政党，被列宁主义革命政权镇压。
从社会革命党中分裂出的左翼派系，后被列宁主义革命政权镇压。
布尔什维克红军与反布尔什维克的白军之间的多方战争。
description.en: A multi-party war between the Bolshevik Red Army and the anti-Bolshevik White Army.

description.zh-cn: 马克思主义理论家和革命家，对列宁主义持批判态度。她是斯巴达克同盟和德国共产党的领导人之一，在斯巴达克同盟起义被镇压后遇害。
description.en: A Marxist theorist and revolutionary, known for her critical stance on Leninism. She was one of the leaders of the Spartacus League and the Communist Party of Germany, and was killed after the Spartacist uprising was suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 一种革命理论，罗莎·卢森堡认为其影响了列宁。
列宁认为实现社会主义的唯一途径。
第二国际的马克思主义理论家，与列宁在革命策略上存在重大分歧。
斯大林统治下苏联的政治经济理论和实践，被一些人认为与列宁本人的思想有本质区别。
老布尔什维克革命家，将“列宁主义”一词用于表示“先锋队革命”，共产国际的第一任主席。
description.en: Old Bolshevik revolutionary and the first head of the Communist International.

description.zh-cn: 一种革命理论，主张在落后国家将民主革命不断转变为社会主义革命，并扩展为世界革命。

zh-cn: 列夫·达维多维奇·托洛茨基

description.zh-cn: 俄国及苏联马克思主义革命家、政治理论家，共产国际的创始人之一，亦是“不断革命论”的主要倡导者。他的建议曾促成了中国各托派组织的统一。
description.en: Russian and Soviet Marxist revolutionary and theorist, one of the founders of the Communist International, and a main advocate of the 'theory of permanent revolution'. His suggestions promoted the unification of Chinese Trotskyist organizations.

description.zh-cn: 列宁发表的纲领性文件，标志其立场转向不断革命论。
斯大林提出的理论，主张可以在一个国家内建成社会主义。

zh-cn: 尼古拉·车尔尼雪夫斯基

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯革命民主主义者，其文化思想被列宁所推崇。
俄罗斯革命家和马克思主义理论家，是俄国马克思主义的奠基人之一，被称为“俄国马克思主义之父”，其文化思想被列宁所推崇。
description.en: Russian revolutionary and Marxist theoretician, known as the 'father of Russian Marxism'.

zh-cn: 帝国主义是资本主义的最高阶段
en: Imperialism, the Highest Stage of Capitalism

description.zh-cn: 列宁的重要著作，是列宁主义的核心理论之一。

zh-cn: 家庭、私有制和国家的起源
en: The Origin of the Family, Private Property and the State

description.zh-cn: 弗里德里希·恩格斯的一部关于家庭、社会和国家的著作。
一系列旨在定义、建立和实现性别平等的政治、经济、个人和社会权利的社会理论、政治运动和意识形态。
一个将马克思主义与女性主义相结合的哲学变体。

zh-cn: 南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国
南斯拉夫联邦人民共和国

description.zh-cn: 由铁托领导的社会主义国家，因其独特的社会主义自治制度而被苏联和中国指责为修正主义。
description.en: A socialist state led by Tito, accused of revisionism by the Soviet Union and China for its unique system of socialist self-management.

zh-cn: 菲德尔·亚历杭德罗·卡斯特罗·鲁斯

description.zh-cn: 古巴革命家和共产主义领导人，在肯尼迪任期内担任古巴总理，是猪湾事件和古巴导弹危机中的核心人物。
description.en: Cuban revolutionary and communist leader who served as Prime Minister of Cuba during Kennedy's presidency, a central figure in the Bay of Pigs Invasion and the Cuban Missile Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利裔英国哲学家。
奥地利裔英国经济学家、政治哲学家，奥地利经济学派的代表人物。
奥地利经济学派的杰出学者。
土耳其裔美国经济学家。
法国工运人士
法国革命马克思主义社会主义者，卡尔·马克思的女婿。

zh-cn: 严重急性呼吸系统综合症

description.zh-cn: 中国民主运动人士
前赵紫阳智囊、中国宪政学者、法学家
由弗拉基米尔·列宁领导的俄国社会民主工党的一个派别，后来成为苏联共产党。
description.en: A faction of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party led by Vladimir Lenin, which later became the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治、经济和社会思想体系。五四运动促进了马克思主义在中国的传播，为中国共产党的成立创造了条件。
description.en: A political, economic, and social ideological system. The May Fourth Movement facilitated the spread of Marxism in China, creating conditions for the establishment of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的官方意识形态，由金日成于1955年提出，用以打击延安派和苏联派。
description.en: The official state ideology of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, proposed by Kim Il-sung in 1955 to counter the Yan'an and Soviet factions.

zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国政府

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的中央行政机关。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
东南亚国家。曾在1961年接受中国的稻种援助。此外，该国警方成功抓获湄公河惨案主犯糯康并将其移交中国，并参与了后续的四国执法安全合作。
description.en: A Southeast Asian country. It received rice seed aid from China in 1961. Its police also successfully apprehended Naw Kham, the mastermind of the Mekong River massacre, extradited him to China, and participated in subsequent four-nation law enforcement and security cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 指台湾、澎湖、金门、马祖及中华民国政府现行统治权所及之其他地区，作为在台湾地区的政治实体，此为海峡两岸关系中的常用法律与政治术语。
description.en: Refers to Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu, and other areas under the effective control of the Government of the Republic of China, functioning as a political entity in the Taiwan region; a common legal and political term in Cross-Strait relations.

description.zh-cn: 反对修正主义的马克思主义思潮。
一种反修正主义的马克思列宁主义变种，在1970年代后期由于中阿决裂后恩维尔·霍查与毛主义的分歧而出现。
description.en: An anti-revisionist Marxist-Leninist variant that emerged in the late 1970s due to the split between Enver Hoxha and Maoism after the Sino-Albanian split.

description.zh-cn: 由托洛茨基领导的共产国际内部派别，其建议促成了中国各托派组织的统一。
description.en: A faction within the Comintern led by Leon Trotsky, whose suggestions promoted the unification of Chinese Trotskyist organizations.

en: Great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation
Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党提出的政治口号和目标。

description.en: Governor of Gansu Province, who wrote an article highly praising Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era.

description.en: Hong Kong journalist and adjunct professor in the History Department of the Chinese University of Hong Kong, who has commented on Xi Jinping Thought.

Theory of continuing the revolution under the dictatorship of the proletariat

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东晚年提出的关于在社会主义社会中防止资本主义复辟的理论，是文化大革命的理论基础。该理论后被中共官方排除出毛泽东思想的定义。
description.en: A theory proposed by Mao Zedong in his later years regarding the prevention of capitalist restoration in a socialist society, which formed the theoretical basis for the Cultural Revolution. This theory was later officially excluded from the definition of Mao Zedong Thought by the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东提出的关于国际关系格局的理论。
description.en: A theory about the pattern of international relations proposed by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔巴尼亚社会主义人民共和国的执政党。
description.en: The ruling and sole legal party of the Socialist People's Republic of Albania.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔巴尼亚前最高领导人恩维尔·霍查撰写的一本理论著作，被认为是霍查最重要的作品，标志着霍查主义的最终形成。
description.en: A theoretical book written by former Albanian leader Enver Hoxha, considered his most important work, which marks the final formation of Hoxhaism.

一个毛派国际组织，旨在团结世界各地的马列毛主义政党和组织。
description.en: An international Maoist organization that aimed to unite Marxist-Leninist-Maoist parties and organizations around the world.

13th National Congress of the Communist Party of China

location.en: Great Hall of the People, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 于1987年10月25日至11月1日在北京召开的中国共产党第十三次全国代表大会。大会系统阐述了社会主义初级阶段理论，制定了党在该阶段的基本路线，并提出建立国家公务员制度。
description.en: The 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of China was held in Beijing from October 25 to November 1, 1987. The congress systematically elaborated the theory of the primary stage of socialism, formulated the party's basic line for this stage, and proposed the establishment of a national civil service system.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国纽约州伊萨卡的私立研究型大学。
description.en: A private research university in Ithaca, New York, USA.

北京市政协主席。

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议北京市委员会（简称北京市政协），是中国人民政治协商会议在北京市的地方组织，也是北京市的政治协商机构。管浩鸣是其委员之一。
description.en: The Beijing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC Beijing Committee) is the local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Beijing, and also serves as Beijing's political advisory body. Peter Koon is one of its members.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第四位皇帝，他撕毁了绍兴和议，并发动了大规模的南侵，最终在采石之战中失败。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Jin dynasty. He tore up the Shaoxing Treaty and launched a large-scale invasion of the south, which ended in defeat at the Battle of Caishi.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈（元世祖），蒙古帝国第五位大汗、元朝开国皇帝。他是成吉思汗之孙，拖雷与唆鲁禾帖尼的第四子。在位期间统一中国，推行汉化政策并完善官制。他曾下令焚毁《道藏》，追赠丘处机封号，并命令福裕住持少林寺。晚年因对外战争失利及亲人相继去世，为元朝的衰退埋下伏笔。
description.en: Kublai (Emperor Shizu of Yuan), the fifth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire and the founding emperor of the Yuan Dynasty. He was a grandson of Genghis Khan and the fourth son of Tolui and Sorghaghtani Beki. During his reign, he unified China, implemented sinicization policies, and perfected the official system. He ordered the burning of the Daozang, posthumously granted a title to Qiu Chuji, and appointed Fuyu as the abbot of the Shaolin Temple. His later years were marked by failures in foreign military campaigns and the successive deaths of close family members, which laid the groundwork for the decline of the Yuan Dynasty.

en: Great Plague in the late Ming dynasty

birth_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
birth_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府万岁山
death_place.en: Wansui Hill, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明朝末代皇帝，明光宗第五子，明熹宗异母弟，年号“崇祯”。即位后铲除了魏忠贤阉党。在位期间，内忧外患，民变不断，后金政权虎视眈眈。其多疑性格和急躁决策导致多次政治军事失误，包括受后金反间计影响冤杀袁崇焕。1644年，李自成攻破北京，他于煤山自缢殉国，明朝灭亡。
description.en: The last emperor of the Ming Dynasty in China, the fifth son of the Taichang Emperor (Ming Guangzong) and the younger half-brother of the Tianqi Emperor (Ming Xizong). His reign name was "Chongzhen". After ascending the throne, he eliminated the eunuch faction led by Wei Zhongxian. His reign was plagued by internal rebellions and external threats from the Later Jin regime. His suspicious nature and hasty decisions led to multiple political and military blunders, including the wrongful execution of Yuan Chonghuan under the influence of a Later Jin deception stratagem. In 1644, after Li Zicheng's rebel forces captured Beijing, he committed suicide at Meishan, leading to the fall of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1856年至1860年间，大英帝国与法兰西第二帝国以亚罗号事件及广西西林教案为借口，联合入侵大清国的战争，被视为第一次鸦片战争的延续。
description.en: A war from 1856 to 1860, in which the British Empire and the Second French Empire, using the Arrow Incident and the Xilin teaching case as pretexts, jointly invaded the Qing dynasty. It is considered a continuation of the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京西北郊的清代大型皇家园林，被誉为“万园之园”，咸丰帝出生地，在第二次鸦片战争中被英法联军抢掠并焚毁。
description.en: A large imperial garden complex of the Qing Dynasty in the northwestern suburbs of Beijing, known as the 'Garden of Gardens,' the birthplace of the Xianfeng Emperor, which was looted and burned down by Anglo-French forces during the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 他是梁启超与李蕙仙之子，林徽因的丈夫。作为著名建筑学家、建筑史学家、城市规划师、教育家以及清华大学建筑系教授，他毕业于宾夕法尼亚大学。梁思成一生致力于中国古代建筑和文化遗产的保护与研究，曾任中央研究院院士、中国科学院学部委员，创办了东北大学和清华大学的建筑系，并领导了中华人民共和国国徽的设计工作。
description.en: Son of Liang Qichao and Li Huixian, and husband of Lin Huiyin. He was a renowned Chinese architect, architectural historian, urban planner, and educator, as well as a professor at the Department of Architecture at Tsinghua University. An alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania, Liang Sicheng dedicated his life to the preservation and study of ancient Chinese architecture and cultural heritage. He served as an academician of Academia Sinica and the Chinese Academy of Sciences, founded the architecture departments at Northeastern and Tsinghua Universities, and led the design work of the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国城市规划师，与梁思成共同提出《梁陈方案》。
description.en: A Chinese urban planner who co-authored the Liang-Chen Proposal with Liang Sicheng.

zh-cn: 关于中央人民政府行政中心位置的建议

description.zh-cn: 由梁思成和陈占祥于1950年提出的一份关于北京城市规划的建议，主张保护北京古城，在西郊建设新的行政中心。该方案未被采纳。
description.en: A proposal for Beijing's urban planning submitted by Liang Sicheng and Chen Zhanxiang in 1950, advocating for the preservation of the old city of Beijing and the construction of a new administrative center in the western suburbs. The proposal was not adopted.

description.zh-cn: 北京市辖区，北京城市副中心所在地，也是北京市的政府驻地。
description.en: A district of Beijing, home to Beijing's sub-center, and also the seat of government of Beijing.

zh-cn: 北京中轴线——中国理想都城秩序的杰作

description.zh-cn: 自元大都、明清北京城以来北京城东西对称布局建筑物的对称轴。
此地曾是元朝的首都，是北京城的前身之一。明代建造紫禁城时，选址于元大都皇宫的南面，并参考了其城市中轴线。之后也曾作为明朝的首都，并是明宣宗的出生地。
description.en: This place was once the capital of the Yuan dynasty and one of the predecessors of Beijing. When the Forbidden City was built during the Ming dynasty, its location was chosen to the south of the Yuan Dadu imperial palace, referencing its central urban axis. It later also served as the capital of the Ming dynasty and was the birthplace of Emperor Xuande of Ming.

description.zh-cn: 海南省，简称“琼”，是中国设立的经济特区，也是中华人民共和国的省级行政区。它是中国最南端、唯一全境位于热带的省份，也是总面积和海洋面积最大的省份。1988年由广东省海南行政区析出设立。其部分区域由中华民国、越南、菲律宾和马来西亚实际控制。
description.en: Hainan Province, abbreviated as 'Qiong', is a special economic zone established by China and a provincial-level administrative division of the People's Republic of China. It is China's southernmost and only province located entirely in the tropics, and also the largest by total and maritime area. It was established in 1988, separated from the Hainan Administrative Region of Guangdong Province. Parts of its territory are actually controlled by the Republic of China, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Malaysia.

zh-cn: 台湾省 (中华人民共和国)
en: Taiwan Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国法理上的省，绝大部分区域由中华民国实际控制。
description.en: A de jure province of the People's Republic of China, with most of its territory actually controlled by the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建国初期设立的最高级别一级行政区划单位，后被撤销。
description.en: A highest-level administrative region established in the early days of the People's Republic of China, which was later abolished.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共南京市委书记（吴政隆前任），现任上海市人大常委会主任、党组书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, formerly served as the Party Secretary of Nanjing (predecessor of Wu Zhenglong), and currently serves as the Chairwoman and Party Group Secretary of the Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在上海市的地方组织。

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京条约》，上海于1843年正式对外开放，成为通商口岸，开启了其近代化进程。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Nanking, Shanghai was officially opened to foreign trade in 1843, becoming a treaty port and beginning its process of modernization.

description.zh-cn: 近代外国在上海设立的拥有独立司法、行政权力的地区。
清朝与英国签订的关于上海租界的章程。
天主教会的主要男修会之一。在明末清初的西学东渐中扮演关键角色，派遣利玛窦等传教士来华，并于17世纪开始将《易经》引介至欧洲。
description.en: One of the main male religious orders of the Catholic Church. Its members, called Jesuits, played a key role in the first phase of West-to-East knowledge transfer by sending missionaries like Matteo Ricci to China, and began introducing the I Ching to Europe in the 17th century.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，洋务运动的领袖之一。他创建并统帅淮军和北洋水师，曾任北洋大臣和直隶总督。与曾国藩、张之洞、左宗棠并称“晚清四大名臣”。赵秉钧曾在他手下任职。
description.en: A prominent official in the late Qing dynasty and a leader of the Westernization Movement. He founded and commanded the Huai Army and the Beiyang Fleet, and served as the Minister of Beiyang and Viceroy of Zhili. He was known as one of the 'Four Great Officials of the Late Qing' alongside Zeng Guofan, Zhang Zhidong, and Zuo Zongtang. Zhao Bingjun once served under him.

description.zh-cn: 上海首家华人新式学堂。
旨在解决城市粮农副食品供应问题的工程。
战国四公子之一。
中华民国的空军部队。
description.en: The aerial warfare branch of the Republic of China Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 时任长春市长
清朝于雍正七年（1729年）设立的县，位于今湖南省，治所在裴家河。1914年1月因与江西省安福县同名而改名为临澧县。
清朝的直隶州。
中华人民共和国的省份，井冈山位于其西南部。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China, where the Jinggang Mountains are located in the southwest.

description.zh-cn: 中国设立的第一个经济特区，作为改革开放的试验田，为深圳的早期高速发展提供了政策支持。
description.en: The first Special Economic Zone established in China, serving as a pilot area for reform and opening-up, providing policy support for Shenzhen's early rapid development.

description.zh-cn: 这是一个中国古代行政区划，深圳市的前身。它于东晋咸和六年（331年）始设，历史上长期存在，并曾长期管辖香港岛。
description.en: This ancient administrative division in China, the predecessor of Shenzhen, was first established in 331 AD during the Eastern Jin Dynasty. It existed for a long period and had long-term jurisdiction over Hong Kong Island.

en: Refugee wave from the People's Republic of China to British Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 指在1950年代至1970年代末，大批中国大陆居民因政治、经济等原因，经由深圳等地非法越境进入英属香港的群众性偷渡事件。该事件是冷战时期历时最长、人数最多的群体性逃亡事件，被认为是促成深圳经济特区建立的原因之一。
description.en: Refers to the mass illegal border crossings of mainland Chinese residents, primarily through Shenzhen, into British Hong Kong from the 1950s to the late 1970s due to political and economic reasons. This event was the longest and largest group escape during the Cold War, and is considered one of the reasons for the establishment of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone.

description.zh-cn: 招商局集团原常务副董事长，蛇口工业区和招商银行、平安保险等企业的创办者，是深圳经济特区早期的重要开拓者。
description.en: Former executive vice chairman of China Merchants Group, founder of Shekou Industrial Zone and enterprises like China Merchants Bank and Ping An Insurance, and a key pioneer in the early days of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一家完全由企业法人持股的股份制商业银行。
description.en: The first joint-stock commercial bank in the People's Republic of China wholly owned by corporate legal entities.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一家由企业创办的商业保险机构，也是中国第一家股份制保险企业，同时也是一个中国综合金融服务集团。郑建源曾通过其控股公司持有该公司大量股份。
description.en: The first commercial insurance institution in the People's Republic of China established by an enterprise, and also the first joint-stock insurance company in China. It is an integrated financial services group, in which Zheng Jianyuan once held a large number of shares through his holding companies.

zh-cn: 中国特色社会主义先行示范区
en: Pilot Demonstration Area of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics

description.zh-cn: 中共中央、国务院支持深圳建设的示范区，承担在制度创新、扩大开放等方面先行先试的重要使命。
description.en: A demonstration area supported by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council for Shenzhen to build, undertaking the important mission of piloting institutional innovation and expanding opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 深圳光明新区红坳村发生的大规模土石崩塌事故，造成73人死亡，是重大的生产安全事故，导致巨大人员伤亡和财产损失。
description.en: A large-scale landslide and debris flow accident occurred in Hong'ao Village, Guangming New District, Shenzhen, resulting in 73 deaths. It was a major industrial safety accident, causing significant casualties and property damage.

zh-cn: 深圳经济特区建立40周年庆祝大会
en: 40th Anniversary of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。现任中共广东省委副书记，广东省人民政府省长、中共深圳市委书记。中共第二十届中央委员。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China. He is currently the Deputy Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP, Governor of Guangdong Province, and Secretary of the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CCP. He is a member of the 20th Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任深圳市人大常委会主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress.

description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Shenzhen.

description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as the Chairwoman of the Shenzhen Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.en: The state power organ of Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝是由杨坚建立的中国朝代，历史上承南北朝，下启唐朝。它结束了长期的分裂局面，重新统一了中国，并建立了科举考试体系。该朝代还开始将“省”用于中央政府的一级行政机关。
description.en: The Sui dynasty, founded by Yang Jian, was a Chinese dynasty that succeeded the Northern and Southern dynasties and preceded the Tang dynasty. It ended a long period of division, reunifying China, and established the imperial examination system. This dynasty also began using 'province' as a first-level administrative division of the central government.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝中央政府的一级行政机关之一。
元朝设立的一级地方行政区划，省制的前身。
明朝的一级行政区单位，俗称“行省”。
清朝第六位皇帝清高宗弘历。其在位期间，“省”作为行政区划名称获得官方认可，年号是清朝使用时间最长的年号，并曾下诏为袁崇焕平反，肯定其作为明朝忠臣的功绩。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor, the sixth emperor of the Qing dynasty. During his reign, 'province' was officially recognized as an administrative division, his era name was the longest-used in the Qing dynasty, and an imperial edict was issued to posthumously rehabilitate Yuan Chonghuan, affirming his merits as a loyal official of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官修典籍，其《舆地考》中使用“省”作为各地区名称。
中华民国的一级行政区单位。
中华民国北洋政府时期的行政区划，位于省与县之间，后被国民政府废除。
抗战胜利后国民政府将中国东北地区重新划分省区的方案。
在美国海军协助下，中华民国将大陈岛军民撤至台湾的行动。
description.en: The operation by the Republic of China, with the assistance of the U.S. Navy, to evacuate military personnel and civilians from the Dachen Islands to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，民主进步党籍。现任中华民国总统及民主进步党主席。他曾与萧美琴搭档参选2024年总统选举，并击败柯文哲等人成功当选。此前，他曾任中华民国行政院院长（任期内宣布省级机关“去任务化”），也曾任台南市市长（后被监察院弹劾）。他曾称赞吴敦义为最有能力的行政院院长，并在大罢免运动期间表态支持，呼吁民进党与公民同行。
description.en: A politician in the Republic of China, affiliated with the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP). He currently serves as the President of the Republic of China and Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party. He ran with Hsiao Bi-khim in the 2024 presidential election, defeating Ko Wen-je and others to successfully win the presidency. Previously, he served as Premier of the Executive Yuan (during his tenure, he announced the 'de-tasking' of provincial agencies), and also as Mayor of Tainan (later impeached by the Control Yuan). He once praised Wu Den-yih as a highly capable Premier and expressed support for the Great Recall movement, calling on the DPP to stand with citizens.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省的最高民意机关（议会机关），曾于1980年选举林荣三为增额监察委员。该机构于2018年起去任务化，实质解散。
description.en: The highest representative body (parliamentary body) of Taiwan Province, Republic of China. It elected Lin Rong-san as an incremental Control Yuan Member in 1980. The institution was de-tasked and effectively dissolved starting from 2018.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国福建省的行政机关，2018年起去任务化，实质解散。
法国大革命前的行政区划。
法国大革命后设立的行政单位，取代了旧的行省。

description.zh-cn: 中华民国有关国家发展的最高主管机关。2018年接管了原台湾省政府的剩余业务与人员。
description.en: The highest authority for national development in the Republic of China. In 2018, it took over the remaining duties and personnel of the former Taiwan Provincial Government.

陕西等处承宣布政使司

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一个省级行政区，位于中国中部偏北地区，是内陆省份。为与邻省山西区别，在西方语言中常作“Shaanxi”。历史上，明朝时曾是嘉靖大地震的震中和重灾区。
description.en: An inland provincial-level administrative region of the People's Republic of China, located in the north-central part of the country. To distinguish it from the neighboring province of Shanxi in Hanyu Pinyin, its name is often transliterated as 'Shaanxi' in Western languages. Historically, during the Ming dynasty, it was the epicenter and most heavily affected area of the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 商朝帝王
商周时期的方国
晋公子
春秋时期部族
秦国将帅
魏国是中国战国时期的诸侯国，属战国七雄之一。姬姓，魏氏。自前403年魏文侯被周威烈王册封为侯，至前225年为秦国所灭。其领土约包括现时山西南部、河南北部和陕西、河北的部分地区。
description.en: The State of Wei was a prominent vassal state during the Warring States period of China, and one of the Seven Warring States. Bearing the surname Ji and the clan name Wei, it existed from 403 BC, when Marquess Wen of Wei was enfeoffed by King Weilie of Zhou, until its conquest by the state of Qin in 225 BC. Its territory roughly covered parts of modern-day southern Shanxi, northern Henan, Shaanxi, and Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝将军
中国古代北方的游牧民族政权，活跃于欧亚草原。他们与西汉长期发生战争，李广利最终投降于此。后来，他们与新朝的关系恶化。
description.en: An ancient nomadic regime from northern China, active across the Eurasian Steppe. They engaged in prolonged conflict with the Western Han, and Li Guangli eventually surrendered to them. Later, their relationship with the Xin Dynasty deteriorated.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上的一个重要朝代，承五代十国、下启元朝，分为北宋与南宋。971年，宋朝军队攻灭南汉。
description.en: An important era in Chinese history, following the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period and preceding the Yuan dynasty, it was divided into Northern Song and Southern Song. In 971, the Song army conquered the Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 与北宋同时期由党项族建立的政权，是宋神宗时期北宋在西部的主要军事对手。该政权后被蒙古所灭。
description.en: A state established by the Tangut people, coexisting with the Northern Song dynasty. It was the primary military adversary of the Northern Song in the west during Emperor Shenzong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 第25任香港总督，任内推行十年建屋计划等重要政策，促成了新界的大规模发展。他还曾担任香港理工学院首任荣誉监督，并于1976年为学院首期扩建校舍揭幕。
description.en: The 25th Governor of Hong Kong, who implemented major policies such as the Ten-year Housing Programme, leading to the large-scale development of the New Territories. He also served as the first Honorary Supervisor of the Hong Kong Polytechnic and inaugurated its first phase of campus extension in 1976.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国香港特别行政区基本法
en: Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区的宪制性文件。
1860年，清政府与英、法、俄签订了一系列条约。其中，与英法签订的条约结束了第二次鸦片战争，确认了《天津条约》的效力并增加了割让九龙半岛等条款。此后，俄国又以“调停有功”为由，迫使清政府签订条约，承认《瑷珲条约》并将乌苏里江以东约40万平方公里的土地划归俄国。
description.en: In 1860, the Qing government signed a series of treaties. Those with Britain and France concluded the Second Opium War, ratifying the Treaty of Tientsin and adding new clauses, including the cession of the Kowloon Peninsula. Subsequently, Russia, under the pretext of 'meritorious mediation,' compelled the Qing government to sign a treaty that confirmed the Treaty of Aigun and ceded approximately 400,000 square kilometers of territory east of the Ussuri River to Russia.

en: Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory
The Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory

description.zh-cn: 1898年由英国与清朝在北京签订的条约，内容为租借新界99年。
description.en: A treaty signed in Beijing in 1898 between the United Kingdom and the Qing dynasty, leasing the New Territories for 99 years.

description.zh-cn: 香港岛是香港三大地域之一，根据《南京条约》，清政府于1842年将其割让给英国。它是香港开埠时最早发展的地区，现为香港的政治、经济、金融和商业中心。岛上最高峰为太平山。
description.en: Hong Kong Island is one of the three main regions of Hong Kong. It was ceded to the United Kingdom by the Qing government in 1842 under the Treaty of Nanking. As the earliest developed area during Hong Kong's founding, it now serves as the city's political, economic, financial, and commercial center. Its highest point is Victoria Peak.

description.zh-cn: 香港三大地域之一，与中国大陆深圳市接壤，占香港陆地总面积接近90%。根据1898年《展拓香港界址专条》由英国向清朝租借，为期99年。
description.en: One of the three main regions of Hong Kong, bordering mainland China's Shenzhen, and accounting for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total land area. It was leased by Britain from the Qing dynasty for 99 years under the 1898 Convention for the Extension of Hong Kong Territory.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，现任第六届香港特别行政区行政长官兼国家安全委员会主席及香港理工大学校监。他是香港首位纪律部队出身的行政长官。曾任警务处副处长、保安局副局长、保安局局长及政务司司长等职。任保安局局长期间，他曾形容民主派初选为“歹毒的计划”，并支持警方拘捕行动。因参与镇压反对逃犯条例修订草案运动示威，被美国制裁。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, current Sixth-term Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, Chairman of the Committee for Safeguarding National Security, and Chancellor of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. He is the first Chief Executive from a disciplined services background in Hong Kong's history. He previously served as Deputy Commissioner of Police, Under Secretary for Security, Secretary for Security, and Chief Secretary for Administration. While Secretary for Security, he described the pro-democracy primaries as a 'vicious plot' and supported police arrest operations. He was sanctioned by the United States for his role in suppressing protests during the anti-extradition bill movement.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区基本法第二十三条
香港基本法第二十三条
en: Article 23 of the Hong Kong Basic Law

description.zh-cn: 《香港特别行政区基本法》中关于国家安全的条文，规定香港特别行政区应自行立法禁止七种危害国家安全行为。其立法工作曾在香港引发巨大争议。
description.en: A provision in the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region concerning national security, which requires the region to enact its own laws to prohibit seven types of acts that endanger national security. Its legislative process caused significant controversy in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区为履行《基本法》第二十三条规定的宪制责任，就危害国家安全的行为所制定的法律条文。
description.en: A piece of legislation enacted by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region to fulfill its constitutional duty under Article 23 of the Basic Law, targeting acts that endanger national security.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第七届立法机关。
description.en: The 7th term of the legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

中华人民共和国为解决台湾问题而提出的统一后政治构想，尚未设立。
指自第二次国共内战后，中国大陆与台湾分治的政治局面及其衍生问题，涉及与台湾政治地位相关的复杂地缘政治议题。
description.en: Refers to the political situation of divided rule between mainland China and Taiwan since the Chinese Civil War, and the complex geopolitical issues concerning Taiwan's political status.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰华裔商人，曾向朝鲜政府建议设立新义州特别行政区并被任命为首任行政长官。
朝鲜设立的特别行政区，旨在模仿“一国两制”模式，但改革未能如期完成。
中华民国大陆时期设立并已撤销的特别行政区，后改为察哈尔省。该区接收了原归绥道下辖的兴和道。
description.en: A former special region during the mainland period of the Republic of China, which took over the Xinghe Circuit formerly under the Guisui Circuit.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期已撤销的特别行政区。于1914年由北洋政府设立，1928年被国民政府改制为绥远省。

description.en: American politician who served as a U.S. Senator from Massachusetts and as Secretary of State. He ran as the Democratic candidate against George W. Bush in the 2004 presidential election. Liu Chaoying attended a meeting organized by him.

description.en: A type of provincial-level administrative division in the People's Republic of China, directly administered by the central government, with county-level divisions as its subordinate units.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省级行政区，沈阳市是其省会。李克强曾担任该省省委书记，杨彬曾作为全国人大代表代表该地区，也是丰晓敏的籍贯所在省份。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative division of the People's Republic of China, with Shenyang as its capital. Li Keqiang once served as its Provincial Party Secretary, Yang Bin represented this region as a deputy to the National People's Congress, and it is also the province of Feng Xiaomin's ancestral home.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国东北部的一个省级行政区。丰晓敏曾任该地区的全国人大代表。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative region in Northeast China. Feng Xiaomin served as a delegate to the National People's Congress for this region.
