description.en: A unit of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army established in western Fujian, which once joined the sequence of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军高级将领，曾任红一军团参谋长、第二师师长。
description.en: A senior commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Chief of Staff of the Red First Army Group and Commander of the Second Division.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党高级干部，曾任红一军团政治部主任。
description.en: A senior cadre of the Communist Party of China, served as Director of the Political Department of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任红一军团政治部主任。
description.en: A senior commander of the People's Liberation Army, served as Director of the Political Department of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红一军团第一师政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Political Commissar of the First Division of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红一军团第一师政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Political Commissar of the First Division of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红一军团第二师政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Political Commissar of the Second Division of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红一军团第三师师长。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Commander of the Third Division of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红一军团第三师政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Political Commissar of the Third Division of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任红一军团第一师参谋长。
description.en: A Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army, served as Chief of Staff of the First Division of the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省吴起县的一个镇，是长征的落脚点之一。
description.en: A town in Wuqi County, Shaanxi Province, one of the destinations of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任红十三团政委。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, served as Political Commissar of the 13th Red Regiment.

description.zh-cn: 中国的第二长河。在嘉靖大地震期间因山体滑坡堵塞而出现逆流和河水澄清的现象。
description.en: The second-longest river in China. During the Jiajing Great Earthquake, landslides caused it to be blocked, leading to backflow and the phenomenon of its water becoming clear.

description.zh-cn: 红一方面军东渡黄河进攻山西阎锡山部的战役，红一军团作为东征军一部分参与。
description.en: A campaign where the First Front Army of the Red Army crossed the Yellow River to attack Yan Xishan's forces in Shanxi, with the Red First Army Group participating as part of the eastern expedition force.

description.zh-cn: 甘肃省白银市下辖县，是红军三大主力会师地点，标志长征结束。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Baiyin City, Gansu Province, where the three main forces of the Red Army joined, marking the end of the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 八路军115师下辖旅，由红一军团改编而成。
description.en: A brigade under the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army, reorganized from the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军及八路军高级将领，曾任343旅副旅长。
description.en: A senior commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and the Eighth Route Army, served as Deputy Commander of the 343rd Brigade.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，现任清华大学校长。
description.en: A Chinese scholar, currently serving as the President of Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，由清华大学、北京大学、南开大学在长沙联合组建的临时大学，后迁至昆明并更名为国立西南联合大学。
description.en: A provisional university formed in Changsha during the Second Sino-Japanese War by Tsinghua University, Peking University, and Nankai University. It later relocated to Kunming and was renamed National Southwestern Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家，长期担任清华大学校长，被誉为“清华永远的校长”。抗战期间主持西南联大校务，1956年在台湾新竹主持国立清华大学复校。
description.en: A Chinese educator who served as the president of Tsinghua University for a long period and is revered as 'Tsinghua's permanent president'. He presided over the National Southwestern Associated University during the war and led the re-establishment of National Tsing Hua University in Hsinchu, Taiwan, in 1956.

en: Central Academy of Arts and Design

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国轻工业部直属高等学府，1999年并入清华大学，成为清华大学美术学院。
description.en: Formerly a higher education institution directly under the Ministry of Light Industry of the PRC. In 1999, it merged into Tsinghua University to become the Academy of Arts & Design.

description.zh-cn: 张孝骞长期工作和任教的医学院，曾担任副校长等职务。
description.en: The medical school where Zhang Xiaoqian worked and taught for a long time, holding positions such as vice president.

zh-cn: 清华大学五道口金融学院
中国人民银行研究生部
en: Graduate School of the People's Bank of China

description.zh-cn: 原隶属于中国人民银行的研究生培养机构，2012年并入清华大学，成立清华大学五道口金融学院。
description.en: A graduate training institution formerly affiliated with the People's Bank of China. In 2012, it merged into Tsinghua University to become the PBC School of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 美国另类投资管理公司，于2013年捐助成立清华大学苏世民书院。
description.en: An American alternative investment management company that donated to establish the Schwarzman College at Tsinghua University in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 美国黑石集团董事长
由美国黑石集团捐助成立的研究生院，旨在培养未来的世界领导者。
description.en: A graduate college founded with a donation from The Blackstone Group, aimed at cultivating future world leaders.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第九位皇帝，道光帝第四子，孝全成皇后的独子。他也是孝钦显皇后的夫君，光绪帝的伯父及嗣父，奕䜣的异母兄。咸丰帝在位期间，面对太平天国起事，并经历了第二次鸦片战争，英法联军攻入北京后他逃往承德避暑山庄，并于次年病逝。他是中国历史上最后一位掌握实际统治权的皇帝。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Qing dynasty, the fourth son of the Daoguang Emperor, and the only son of Empress Xiaoquancheng. He was also the husband of Empress Xiaocingxian, uncle and adoptive father of the Guangxu Emperor, and Yixin's elder half-brother. During his reign, Emperor Xianfeng faced the Taiping Rebellion and the Second Opium War. After Anglo-French forces entered Beijing, he fled to the Chengde Mountain Resort and died there the following year. He was the last emperor in Chinese history to hold actual ruling power.

description.zh-cn: 国立清华大学首任校长
清华大学于1925年成立的研究机构，聘请梁启超、王国维、陈寅恪、赵元任为四大导师，旨在研究中国传统文化。
description.en: A research institution established by Tsinghua University in 1925, which appointed Liang Qichao, Wang Guowei, Chen Yinke, and Zhao Yuanren as the 'Four Great Tutors' to study traditional Chinese culture.

description.zh-cn: 由清华大学、美国华盛顿大学和微软公司合作创建的教育科研平台，是中国大学第一次到美国办学。
description.en: An educational and research platform co-founded by Tsinghua University, the University of Washington, and Microsoft. It marks the first time a Chinese university has established a physical campus in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国华盛顿州西雅图的公立研究型大学，与清华大学及微软公司合作创建了全球创新学院。
description.en: A public research university in Seattle, Washington, USA. It co-founded the Global Innovation eXchange with Tsinghua University and Microsoft.

description.zh-cn: 华人计算机科学家，2000年图灵奖得主，现任清华大学人工智能学院院长、交叉信息研究院院长。
description.en: A Chinese computer scientist, winner of the 2000 Turing Award, and the current Dean of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Dean of the Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学附属中学，是文化大革命时期红卫兵运动的发源地。
description.en: The High School Affiliated to Tsinghua University, which was the birthplace of the Red Guard movement during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学的标志性建筑之一
文化大革命期间清华大学的学生造反派组织，与“四一四派”对立，是百日大武斗的主要参与方之一。
description.en: A student rebel faction organization at Tsinghua University during the Cultural Revolution, opposed to the '414 Faction' and one of the main participants in the Hundred-Day War.

description.zh-cn: 1968年清华大学两派红卫兵组织之间发生的大规模武装冲突，是北京最为严重的武斗事件，造成重大人员伤亡和财产损失。
description.en: A large-scale armed conflict in 1968 between two Red Guard factions at Tsinghua University. It was the most severe armed struggle in Beijing, resulting in significant casualties and property damage.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国少将、中将，曾任北京军区参谋长。因其战功卓著和鲜明个性而被称为“传奇人物”。
description.en: Founding Major General and Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army, former Chief of Staff of the Beijing Military Region. Known as a 'legendary figure' for his outstanding military achievements and distinctive personality.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国辽宁省鞍山市下辖的县级市。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Anshan, Liaoning province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军合成第十一师
en: 11th Motorized Infantry Division (People's Republic of China)
4th Column of the Eighth Route Army

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争期间，中国人民志愿军与联合国军在云山郡附近发生的一场战斗，是中国人民志愿军第一次战役的一部分，也是中美两国军队在朝鲜战场上的首次交锋。
description.en: A battle fought between the Chinese People's Volunteer Army and United Nations forces near Unsan County during the Korean War. It was part of the Chinese First Phase Offensive and marked the first direct combat engagement between Chinese and U.S. forces in Korea.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军的一支师级部队，在云山战斗中遭受了严重损失。
description.en: A division-level unit of the United States Army that suffered heavy losses in the Battle of Unsan.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国法官法

description.zh-cn: 规定中华人民共和国最高人民法院院长是中华人民共和国首席大法官的法律。

zh-cn: 第四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会
第四届全国人大常委会
en: Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第四届全国人民代表大会的常设机关，于1975年1月至1978年3月期间履行职责。
description.en: The standing body of the 4th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, which performed its duties from January 1975 to March 1978.

zh-cn: 第六届全国人民代表大会
第六届全国人民代表大会第一次会议
en: First Session of the 6th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中国第六届国家最高权力机关（全国人民代表大会）于1983年6月6日至21日在北京召开了第一次会议。会后，全国人大常委会办公厅下设机构进行了改组。
description.en: The first session of China's Sixth Highest State Authority (National People's Congress) was held in Beijing from June 6 to 21, 1983. Subsequently, the departments under the General Office of the NPC Standing Committee were reorganized.

zh-cn: 第八届全国人民代表大会
第八届全国人民代表大会第一次会议

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第八届最高国家权力机关。其于1993年3月首次召开会议，决定撤销能源部，再次组建煤炭工业部。在其第三次会议上通过了《中华人民共和国中国人民银行法》，第五次会议于1997年批准设立重庆直辖市。
description.en: The 8th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China. Its inaugural session was held in March 1993, where it decided to abolish the Ministry of Energy and re-establish the Ministry of Coal Industry. Its third session passed the 'Law of the People's Republic of China on the People's Bank of China', and its fifth session in 1997 approved the establishment of Chongqing as a direct-administered municipality.

zh-cn: 第九届全国人民代表大会
第九届全国人民代表大会第一次会议
en: First Session of the 9th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于1998年至2003年间的最高国家权力机关。该届人大第一次会议于1998年3月召开，选举成克杰为全国人大常委会副委员长，并批准了国务院机构改革方案，决定不再保留煤炭工业部。
description.en: The highest organ of state power in the People's Republic of China from 1998 to 2003. Its first session, held in March 1998, elected Cheng Kejie as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, and approved the State Council's institutional reform plan, deciding not to retain the Ministry of Coal Industry.

zh-cn: 第十届全国人民代表大会
第十届全国人民代表大会第一次会议

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第十届最高国家权力机关。在其2003年3月会议期间，决定任命回良玉为国务院副总理。
description.en: The 10th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, the highest organ of state power. During its session in March 2003, the decision was made to appoint Hui Liangyu as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在第十一届全国人民代表大会期间当选为中华人民共和国最高人民法院院长。
description.en: Chinese politician, elected as President of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China during the 11th National People's Congress.

zh-cn: 第十一届全国人民代表大会
中华人民共和国第十一届全国人民代表大会
第十一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第六届国家最高权力机关（全国人民代表大会），任期从2008年3月至2013年3月。在此期间，2008年3月5日至18日召开了会议，通过了关于国务院机构改革方案的决定，并批准组建工业和信息化部。
description.en: The 11th term of the highest state authority in the People's Republic of China (National People's Congress), with a term from March 2008 to March 2013. During this period, a session was held from March 5 to 18, 2008, which passed the decision on the institutional reform plan of the State Council and approved the establishment of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

zh-cn: 第十二届全国人民代表大会
第十二届全国人民代表大会第一次会议
en: First Session of the 12th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第十二届国家最高权力机关。
description.en: The 12th session of the highest state organ of power in the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 第十四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议
第十四届全国人民代表大会
en: First session of the 14th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 2023年举行的中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会会议，会议通过的国务院机构改革方案决定将科技部部分职责划入工业和信息化部。
description.en: A session of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China held in 2023. The State Council institutional reform plan passed at the meeting decided to transfer some responsibilities from the Ministry of Science and Technology to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

zh-cn: 中央人民政府委员会第一次会议

en: United Nations Conference on International Organization

nodes.id: BAIDU:中华人民共和国监察官法

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国监察官法
四川省成都市石室中学

description.zh-cn: 位于四川省成都市的省级一级示范性普通高中，宣称历史可追溯至西汉的文翁石室。
西汉蜀郡太守，创办了中国最早的地方官办学堂“文翁石室”。
西汉第六位皇帝，汉武帝之父。他与其父汉文帝共同开创了“文景之治”，并在位期间平定了“七国之乱”。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Western Han dynasty and father of Emperor Wu. He, along with his father Emperor Wen, presided over the 'Rule of Wen and Jing' and suppressed the 'Rebellion of the Seven States' during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 西汉第七位皇帝，庙号“世宗”，谥号“孝武皇帝”。在其统治期间批准修建白渠，推行“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”，使儒家思想成为官方意识形态，并尊《周易》为儒家“五经”之一。他征服多个百越王国。因宠幸李夫人而提拔其兄李延年、李广利，后又因李夫人去世及李广利投降而将李氏家族诛灭。晚年多病猜忌，引发巫蛊之祸，错杀太子刘据，逼死皇后卫子夫。为防止其子刘弗陵（汉昭帝）即位后主少母壮、外戚专权，他下令处死了刘弗陵的生母赵婕妤，后对错杀太子刘据深感后悔。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Western Han dynasty, with the temple name 'Shizong' and posthumous name 'Xiaowu Emperor'. During his reign, he approved the construction of the Bai Canal, implemented 'dismissing the hundred schools of thought and exclusively revering Confucianism' as state ideology, and revered the I Ching as one of the Confucian 'Five Classics'. He conquered several Baiyue kingdoms. He favored Empress Li, promoting her brothers Li Yannian and Li Guangli, but later exterminated the Li clan after her death and Li Guangli's surrender. In his later years, plagued by illness and paranoia, he instigated the Witchcraft Delusion, wrongly executing Crown Prince Liu Ju and forcing Empress Wei Zifu to commit suicide. To prevent his son Liu Fuling (Emperor Zhao) from being dominated by a powerful empress dowager, he ordered the execution of Liu Fuling's mother, Zhao Jieyu. He later deeply regretted the wrongful execution of Crown Prince Liu Ju.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的地理划分，汉代十三州之一，也是汉代至唐代的一个行政区划。此处置为其政府机构。
description.en: A geographical division in ancient China, one of the thirteen provinces of the Han dynasty. It was also an administrative division from the Han to Tang dynasties, and this refers to its government agency.

description.zh-cn: 明末农民起义领袖之一，大西政权的建立者，自称大西皇帝。
description.en: A leader of the peasant rebellions in the late Ming Dynasty and the founder of the Daxi regime.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间四川按察使。
清末四川总督，于1899年开始选派留学生入成城学校学习。
description.en: Viceroy of Sichuan in the late Qing Dynasty who began sending students to Seijō Gakkō in 1899.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代第一家官办钢铁企业，也是当时亚洲最大的钢铁厂。
description.en: China's first government-run iron and steel enterprise and the largest in Asia at the time.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央特别行动科

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1927年至1935年间存在的秘密情报和政治保卫机关。其情报科为国防科技大学外国语学院的最早源头。
description.en: The secret intelligence and political security agency of the Chinese Communist Party that existed from 1927 to 1935. Its intelligence section is the earliest origin of the College of Foreign Languages, National University of Defense Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中共党员，因向忠发叛变供出其所在的机要处地址而被捕。
description.en: A CCP member who was arrested after Xiang Zhongfa betrayed the location of the secretarial office where he was.

en: Civil service of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 曾是中国负责国家公务员管理的机构，2018年并入中共中央组织部，对外保留牌子。
description.en: Formerly the agency in charge of China's national civil service management, it was merged into the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee in 2018 but retains its nameplate for external affairs.

en: Civil service of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国录用公务员的全国性统一公开考试制度。
description.en: The national unified public examination system for recruiting civil servants in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝创立的中国古代通过考试选拔官员的制度，由隋文帝开创先河，打破了世族对官职的垄断，对后世选官制度影响深远。
description.en: A system for selecting officials through examinations, pioneered by Emperor Wen of Sui in the Sui dynasty, which broke the aristocratic monopoly on official positions and had a profound impact on later official selection systems.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平提出的干部队伍“革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化”的方针。
description.en: The policy proposed by Deng Xiaoping for the cadre corps to become 'more revolutionary, younger, better educated, and more professional'.

en: Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants

description.zh-cn: 1993年由国务院公布，初步建立中华人民共和国公务员制度的法规，后被《中华人民共和国公务员法》废止。
description.en: A regulation promulgated by the State Council in 1993 that initially established the civil service system of the People's Republic of China, later repealed by the 'Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China'.

zh-cn: 第十届全国人民代表大会常务委员会
第十届全国人大常委会
en: Standing Committee of the 10th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第十届全国人民代表大会的常设机关。于2005年8月28日通过了《中华人民共和国治安管理处罚法》，并制定了2005年版《中华人民共和国公务员法》。
description.en: The permanent body of the 10th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China. It passed the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China' on August 28, 2005, and enacted the 2005 version of the 'Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China'.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人事部
en: Ministry of Personnel of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经的组成部门，负责国家人事行政管理工作。1988年版的人事部曾承担国家机构编制委员会办公室的工作。张汉夫曾在此担任副部长。后与劳动和社会保障部合并，组建人力资源和社会保障部。
description.en: Formerly a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for national personnel administration. The 1988 version of the Ministry of Personnel also undertook the work of the Office of the National Commission for Institutional Organization. Zhang Hanfu served as its Vice Minister. It later merged with the Ministry of Labor and Social Security to form the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security.

zh-cn: 第十二届全国人民代表大会常务委员会
全国人大内务司法委员会
en: Standing Committee of the 12th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 第十二届全国人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The permanent body of the 12th National People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公职人员政务处分法

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝刘启的皇后，汉武帝刘彻之母。
description.en: The empress of Emperor Jing of Han, Liu Qi, and the mother of Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝与卫子夫的嫡长子，皇位法定继承人（原太子）。在巫蛊之祸中，因被江充等人诬陷，无法自辩而被迫起兵，兵败后自缢而死。他是汉昭帝的异母兄。
description.en: The legitimate eldest son of Emperor Wu of Han and Empress Wei Zifu, and the legal heir to the throne (originally the crown prince). During the Witchcraft Disaster, he was framed by Jiang Chong and others. Unable to defend himself, he was forced to rebel. After the rebellion failed, he committed suicide by hanging. He was the half-brother of Emperor Zhao of Han.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝刘彻的第二任皇后，戾太子刘据的生母。她在巫蛊之祸中支持儿子起兵，兵败后交出皇后玉玺自缢身亡。
description.en: The second empress of Emperor Wu of Han, Liu Che, and the mother of Crown Prince Liu Ju. She supported her son's rebellion during the Witchcraft Delusion and committed suicide after its failure.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝的第一任皇后，后因巫蛊被废。
西汉汉武帝的宠妃，汉昭帝刘弗陵的生母。因其手握玉钩的传说，被称为“钩弋夫人”。汉武帝为防止“子幼母壮”外戚专权，在立刘弗陵为太子后将其赐死。
description.en: A favored consort of Emperor Wu of Han during the Western Han dynasty and the mother of Emperor Zhao of Han (Liu Fuling). She was known as 'Lady Gouyi' due to a legend about a jade hook in her hand. Emperor Wu had her executed after making Liu Fuling the crown prince, to prevent a powerful maternal clan from dominating a young emperor.

description.zh-cn: 汉昭帝，西汉第八位皇帝，汉武帝幼子，其母为赵婕妤。巫蛊之祸后，因年长皇子多已离世或失势，他被立为太子并继位。即位后，追封其母为皇太后，并为其修建云陵。
description.en: Emperor Zhao, the eighth emperor of the Western Han dynasty, was the youngest son of Emperor Wu and Zhao Jieyu. After the Witchcraft Delusion, with elder princes either dead or out of favor, he was made Crown Prince and ascended the throne. Upon his ascension, he posthumously honored his mother as Empress Dowager and had the Yunling Mausoleum built for her.

description.zh-cn: 西汉权臣，霍去病异母弟。在巫蛊之祸中未受牵连，后成为汉武帝的托孤之臣，辅佐汉昭帝，并在昭帝死后拥立汉宣帝，掌握朝政大权。
description.en: A powerful statesman of the Western Han and half-brother of Huo Qubing. He remained unscathed by the Witchcraft Delusion and became one of the regents appointed by Emperor Wu. He assisted Emperor Zhao and later enthroned Emperor Xuan, holding significant power.

description.zh-cn: 西汉儒家学者，建议“罢黜百家，表彰六经”。
西汉大臣，建议推行推恩令。
汉武帝宠臣，因得罪太子刘据，担心其继位后对自己不利，遂制造巫蛊之祸，诬陷太子。后被太子起兵所杀。
description.en: A favored official of Emperor Wu of Han. Fearing retaliation after Crown Prince Liu Ju's ascension, he fabricated the witchcraft accusations, instigating the disaster. He was killed by the prince's forces during the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 西汉史学家，因李陵案受宫刑。其著作《史记》不仅首次记载了“庐山”之名，还详述了荆轲刺秦的故事、庄子的生平，并高度评价晏婴，表达了对他的仰慕。
description.en: A historian of the Western Han dynasty, he suffered castration due to the Li Ling case. His work, 'Records of the Grand Historian', not only contains the first written record of the name 'Lushan', but also details the story of Jing Ke's assassination attempt, the life of Zhuangzi, and highly praises Yan Ying, expressing admiration for him.

description.zh-cn: 西汉将领，兵败投降匈奴。
西汉音乐家，汉武帝宠臣。
汉朝是中国历史上继秦朝之后的大一统王朝，分为西汉和东汉。王莽曾在此担任要职并篡位。此期间，汉朝官员收集、总结法家学说，使其成为治国基础，同时《周易》也被尊为“五经”之一。
description.en: The Han dynasty, a major unified dynasty in Chinese history, succeeded the Qin dynasty and was divided into Western Han and Eastern Han. Wang Mang held important positions and usurped the throne during this period. Han officials collected and summarized Legalist doctrines, making them the foundation for governance, and the I Ching was also revered as one of the 'Five Classics'.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝设立的宫中决策中枢，用以削弱相权。
中国古代的国立最高学府。
西汉征和二年（前91年）发生在汉武帝晚年的一场政治动乱，被称为巫蛊之祸。因太子刘据被江充等人诬陷以巫蛊诅咒汉武帝，被迫起兵诛杀江充，反被汉武帝认为是谋反，派兵镇压。最终太子兵败自杀，皇后卫子夫自尽，前后罹难者达数万人，对汉朝政治影响深远。
description.en: The Witchcraft Incident (巫蛊之祸), a major political turmoil, occurred in 91 BC during the late reign of Emperor Wu of Han in the Western Han Dynasty. It was triggered by accusations from Jiang Chong and others that Crown Prince Liu Ju was using witchcraft to curse the emperor. Liu Ju was forced to raise an army to execute Jiang Chong but was subsequently deemed a rebel by Emperor Wu, who sent troops to suppress him. This ultimately led to the Crown Prince's defeat and suicide, Empress Wei Zifu's suicide, and the deaths of tens of thousands of people, with profound and far-reaching political consequences for the Han Dynasty.

en: Dismiss the Hundred Schools of Thought, Revere only Confucianism
Dismissing the Hundred Schools of Thought, Reverencing Only Confucianism

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝采纳董仲舒建议实行的文化政策，确立了儒家思想在中国的主导地位，从而提升了《论语》等儒家经典的地位。
description.en: A cultural policy implemented during the reign of Emperor Wu of Han that established the dominance of Confucianism in China, thereby elevating the status of Confucian classics like the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝为削弱诸侯王势力而颁布的法令。
汉武帝晚年颁布的一份重要诏书，反思其过去穷兵黩武的政策，宣布停止对外征伐，转向休养生息，富国安民。
description.en: An important edict issued by Emperor Wu in his later years, reflecting on his past militaristic policies. He announced a shift from foreign conquests to policies focused on recuperation and enriching the populace.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝第三位皇帝，也是清朝入关后的第一位皇帝。他是皇太极第九子，康熙帝之父，孝庄太皇太后之子，多尔衮的侄子。其在位期间，启动了对李自成焚毁的紫禁城的重建工作。
description.en: The third emperor of the Qing dynasty and the first to rule after entering the Central Plains via Shanhai Pass. He was the ninth son of Hong Taiji, father of Emperor Kangxi, son of Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang, and Dorgon's nephew. During his reign, he initiated the reconstruction of the Forbidden City which had been burned by Li Zicheng.

description.zh-cn: 顺治帝妃，康熙帝生母。
清朝初年权臣，康熙帝早期的辅政大臣之一。
description.en: A powerful minister in the early Qing dynasty, one of the four regents during the early reign of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 郑成功在台湾建立的奉明朝为正朔的政权，后被清朝所灭。
description.en: A regime established by Koxinga in Taiwan that recognized the legitimacy of the Ming dynasty, later conquered by the Qing.

description.zh-cn: 准噶尔汗国可汗，曾与康熙帝作战。
description.en: Khan of the Dzungar Khanate, who fought against the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 德国耶稣会传教士，与顺治帝建立了私人友谊。
蒙古科尔沁部人，清朝初期的女政治家。清太宗皇太极之妃，顺治帝生母，康熙帝之祖母。她先后辅佐皇太极、顺治帝、康熙帝，对清初政治稳定和发展有重要影响，是清朝入关后的政权奠基人之一。据传她曾在劝降洪承畴的过程中发挥重要作用。野史传说其曾下嫁多尔衮。
description.en: A female politician from the Khorchin Mongol tribe in the early Qing dynasty. She was a consort of Hong Taiji, the mother of the Shunzhi Emperor, and the grandmother of the Kangxi Emperor. She successively assisted Hong Taiji, the Shunzhi Emperor, and the Kangxi Emperor, playing a significant role in the political stability and development of the early Qing dynasty. She was one of the key founders of the Qing regime after entering the Shanhai Pass, and it is said that she played an important role in persuading Hong Chengchou to surrender. Unofficial histories also allege that she married Dorgon.

description.zh-cn: 清朝将领，率军攻取台湾，结束明郑时期。
description.en: A Qing dynasty admiral who led the conquest of Taiwan, ending the Kingdom of Tungning.

description.zh-cn: 明郑王朝末代君主。
description.en: The last ruler of the Kingdom of Tungning.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣会传教士
清朝火器专家
17世纪至18世纪天主教会关于中国传统礼仪问题的争论
罗马教廷是天主教会的最高权力机构，对梵蒂冈城邦拥有直接统治权，在国际法上是主权实体。
description.en: The supreme body of government of the Catholic Church, which is a sovereign entity under international law.

description.zh-cn: 由孔子创立的中国古代思想学派，是一个包含哲学、伦理、政治的中国思想体系。它强调仁、义、礼、智、信等核心价值观，以《论语》为核心经典之一。战国时期的荀子是其重要代表人物。庄子曾对其“以仁义撄人之心”的观点持批评态度。
description.en: A school of thought in ancient China founded by Confucius, it is a Chinese system of philosophical, ethical, and political thought. It emphasizes core values like benevolence, righteousness, propriety, wisdom, and trustworthiness, with The Analects as one of its core classic texts. Xunzi was a major representative during the Warring States period. Zhuangzi was critical of its concept of 'binding people's hearts with benevolence and righteousness'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，康熙帝的嫡次子，清代唯一一位在皇帝生前被公开册立的皇太子，后两度被废黜。死后被雍正帝追封为和硕理密亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the legitimate second son of the Kangxi Emperor, and the only crown prince to be publicly proclaimed during an emperor's lifetime in the Qing dynasty. He was later twice deposed. Posthumously granted the title of Prince Limi of the First Rank by the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝的第一任皇后，胤礽的生母。
description.en: The first empress consort of the Kangxi Emperor and the birth mother of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝皇贵妃，雍正帝生母。
description.en: An Imperial Noble Consort of the Kangxi Emperor and the birth mother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国辽宁省，是于永波的出生地，现为瓦房店市。
description.en: Located in Liaoning Province, China, it is the birthplace of Yu Yongbo, now known as Wafangdian City.

description.zh-cn: 徐才厚的妻子
徐才厚的女儿

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防大学
中国人民解放军军事政治大学
en: People's Liberation Army National Defense University
National Defense University of PLA China

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的最高军事学府，是中央军委副战区级直属单位。该校于1986年1月15日由军事学院、后勤学院、政治学院合并成立，并于2017年进行了新调整组建。历史上，中国人民解放军曾于1969年由四校合并组建类似机构，但于1977年撤销。王抗平为该校校友，王西欣曾在此学习并获得硕士学位，后担任副校长。
description.en: The highest military academy of the People's Liberation Army, a deputy theater-grade unit directly under the Central Military Commission. It was established on January 15, 1986, by merging the Military Academy, Logistics Academy, and Political Academy, and underwent a new restructuring in 2017. Historically, a similar institution was formed in 1969 by the merger of four academies, but it was disbanded in 1977. Wang Kangping is an alumnus, and Wang Xixin studied here, obtained a master's degree, and later served as its vice president.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军济南军区
en: Jinan Military Region of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军已撤销的七大军区之一，前身为1955年由山东军区改编而来。该大军区曾设在中国山东省济南市。2016年军改后，其部分部队被划归新成立的中部战区陆军。
description.en: One of the seven former major military regions of the People's Liberation Army. It was reorganized in 1955 from the Shandong Military Region and was located in Jinan, Shandong Province, China. After the 2016 military reform, some of its units were reassigned to the newly formed Central Theater Command Ground Force.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七十八集团军
中国人民解放军陆军第十六集团军

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军的集团军之一。
description.en: An army group of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾任总政治部副主任、中央军委纪委书记
原中国人民解放军总后勤部副部长，中将军衔。因贪腐问题被中央军委纪委和中央纪委联合调查。
description.en: Former Deputy Minister of the PLA General Logistics Department, holding the rank of Lieutenant General. He was jointly investigated by the CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 原济南军区政治部主任
美国政治人物，曾在乔治·沃克·布什总统任内接替拉姆斯菲尔德担任国防部长。他于2007年与时任防卫大臣的石破茂会面。
description.en: American politician who served as Secretary of Defense during the presidency of George W. Bush, succeeding Donald Rumsfeld. He met with Shigeru Ishiba, then Minister of Defense, in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 国际笔会下属的分会之一，旨在维护中文作家的言论和出版自由。
description.en: A chapter of PEN International, dedicated to defending the freedom of expression and publication for Chinese-language writers.

description.zh-cn: 网刊
一份由中国知识分子、维权人士、异见人士等各界人士于2008年发起的宣言，旨在促进中国民主化、改善人权状况，并提出建立中华联邦共和国的构想。
description.en: A declaration initiated in 2008 by Chinese intellectuals, rights activists, dissidents, and others from various sectors, aiming to promote democratization and improve human rights in China, and proposing the establishment of a Federal Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国民主运动

description.zh-cn: 一系列在中华人民共和国境内发生的，旨在推动政治民主化、保障公民权利的社会政治运动。八六学潮是其重要组成部分，魏京生是其中的代表人物之一。
description.en: A series of socio-political movements within the People's Republic of China, aimed at promoting political democratization and the protection of civil rights. The 1986 student demonstrations are an important part of this movement, and Wei Jingsheng is one of its representative figures.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市人民政府下属的公安机关。该机构曾负责调查和拘押艾未未，其人员曾在成都殴打艾未未，并主导了2011年将其秘密关押81天的行动。
description.en: The public security organ under the Beijing Municipal People's Government of the People's Republic of China. This agency was responsible for investigating and detaining Ai Weiwei. Its officers assaulted Ai in Chengdu and led the operation to secretly detain him for 81 days in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 授予刘晓波的诺贝尔和平奖，以表彰其为中国基本人权所进行的长期、非暴力的斗争。此举使《零八宪章》广为人知。
description.en: The Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Liu Xiaobo for his long and non-violent struggle for fundamental human rights in China. This award brought widespread attention to Charter 08.

zh-cn: 中国医科大学附属第一医院
en: First Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University
The First Hospital of China Medical University

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波父亲，东北师范大学教师
刘晓波母亲
刘晓波二兄
刘晓波四弟
中国哲学家、美学家、思想史学家。曾任中国社会科学院研究员，被认为是1980年代中国大陆“新启蒙运动”的代表人物之一，是“美学热”启蒙思潮的引领者。因六四事件后受到批判，于1992年移居美国。
description.en: A Chinese philosopher, aesthetician, and intellectual historian. He was a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and is considered a key figure in the 'New Enlightenment' movement of the 1980s in mainland China, leading the 'aesthetics fever'. After being criticized following the Tiananmen Square incident, he moved to the United States in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 捷克剧作家、思想家、政治家，天鹅绒革命的思想领袖之一，曾任捷克斯洛伐克及捷克共和国总统。
description.en: A Czech playwright, thinker, and politician, one of the intellectual leaders of the Velvet Revolution, who served as president of Czechoslovakia and the Czech Republic.

description.zh-cn: 现任的第十四世达赖喇嘛，藏传佛教格鲁派的重要领袖，曾于1954年在雍和宫法轮殿讲经。
description.en: The current and 14th Dalai Lama, an important leader of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism, who preached in the Hall of the Wheel of the Law at Yonghe Temple in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 中国社会活动家及政治犯，因在西单民主墙发表大字报批评邓小平独裁而长期入狱，后流亡美国。
description.en: A Chinese social activist and political prisoner, imprisoned for a long time for criticizing Deng Xiaoping's dictatorship on the Xidan Democracy Wall, and later exiled to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 缅甸政治家，1990年萨哈罗夫奖获得者。魏京生曾于2009年呼吁缅甸当局将其释放。
description.en: A Burmese politician and recipient of the 1990 Sakharov Prize. Wei Jingsheng called for her release by the Myanmar authorities in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 数学家，曾任清华大学与西南联合大学数学系主任。
杨振宁的原配妻子，杜聿明长女。
杨振宁的第二任妻子。
物理学家。
物理学家。
理论物理学家，被誉为“氢弹之父”。
美国理论物理学家，曾任普林斯顿高等研究院院长，并在伯克利任教期间领导了曼哈顿计划。
description.en: American theoretical physicist who led the Manhattan Project while a professor at Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 一项基础科学原理，指出在弱相互作用中，物理系统在镜像变换下其行为会有所不同。该理论由李政道和杨振宁于1956年提出。
description.en: A fundamental scientific principle stating that the behavior of a physical system can be different from its mirror image in weak interactions. The theory was proposed by Tsung-Dao Lee and Chen-Ning Yang in 1956.

description.zh-cn: 由杨振宁和罗伯特·米尔斯提出的非阿贝尔规范理论，是粒子物理学标准模型的基础。
物理学家，杨振宁的学生，杨-米尔斯理论的共同提出者。
核物理学家，中国原子弹研制的关键人物。

zh-cn: 杨振宁理论物理研究所
en: C. N. Yang Institute for Theoretical Physics

location.zh-cn: 纽约州立大学石溪分校

zh-cn: 清华大学高等研究中心
en: Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University
Center for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University
Institute For Advanced Study, Tsinghua University

location.zh-cn: 中国北京市海淀区清华大学科学馆

description.zh-cn: 清华大学下属的基础科学研究实体，原名清华大学高等研究中心，于1997年6月成立。
description.en: An entity for basic science research affiliated with Tsinghua University, formerly known as the Tsinghua University Center for Advanced Study, established in June 1997.

description.zh-cn: 英国物理学家、天文学家和数学家。
杨振宁的出生地。
中国物理学家。
物理学家。
明朝第四位皇帝，明成祖朱棣长子，明宣宗之父，朱高煦之兄。他即位后赦免了建文朝诸臣的家属。
description.en: The fourth Emperor of the Ming dynasty, eldest son of the Yongle Emperor, father of Emperor Xuande, and elder brother of Zhu Gaoxu. After ascending the throne, he pardoned the families of the officials from the Jianwen court.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖朱棣的皇后，明仁宗朱高炽、朱高煦之母，明宣宗之祖母，明朝开国功臣、中山王徐达之女。
description.en: Empress of the Yongle Emperor Zhu Di, mother of the Hongxi Emperor and Zhu Gaoxu, and daughter of the Ming Dynasty founding general Xu Da.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年，建文帝在位期间，燕王朱棣与建文帝因削藩政策及皇位之争爆发内战。最终，燕王朱棣获胜，夺取皇位，即位为明成祖。
description.en: In the early Ming Dynasty, during the reign of the Jianwen Emperor, a civil war erupted between Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan, and the Jianwen Emperor, caused by the policy of reducing the power of imperial princes and a struggle for the throne. Ultimately, Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan, emerged victorious, seized the throne, and ascended as the Yongle Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝学者、官员、内阁首辅。曾任《永乐大典》首任主编（总裁官），并与李景隆等人一同重修《明太祖实录》。后被锦衣卫指挥使纪纲害死。
description.en: A Ming dynasty scholar, official, and Grand Secretary. He served as the first chief editor of the Yongle Encyclopedia and was involved in revising the Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu of Ming with Li Jinglong. He was later killed by Ji Gang, the commander of the Jinyiwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代最大的类书，由明成祖朱棣下令编纂，收录了明初之前各种学科的文献资料。
description.en: The largest leishu (a type of reference book) in ancient China, commissioned by the Yongle Emperor of the Ming dynasty. It collected a vast amount of literature and knowledge from before the early Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝航海家、外交家、宦官，受宣宗命令进行第七次下西洋。

en: Zheng He's voyages to the Western Oceans

description.zh-cn: 明朝永乐至宣德年间的一系列远洋航海活动。
description.en: A series of maritime expeditions during the Yongle and Xuande reigns of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的特务与秘密警察机构，由宦官掌管。魏忠贤在天启年间总督东厂，大肆缉捕迫害异己。
description.en: A spy agency of the Ming dynasty, controlled by eunuchs. Wei Zhongxian commanded the Eastern Depot during the Tianqi era, using it to arrest and persecute his opponents.

description.zh-cn: 明朝政治家、高僧，法名道衍。他是明成祖朱棣发动靖难之役的主要策划者和谋士，功勋卓著，曾劝说朱棣不要杀害方孝孺。他还在《永乐大典》重修时担任监修。
description.en: A Ming dynasty statesman and Buddhist monk, also known by his dharma name Daoyan. He was the chief strategist and advisor who planned the Jingnan Campaign for Zhu Di, making significant contributions, and notably advised Zhu Di not to execute Fang Xiaoru. He also served as a supervisor for the revision of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

birth_place.zh-cn: 元朝江浙等处行中书省台州路宁海县
birth_place.en: Ninghai County, Taizhou Lu, Jiangzhe Province, Yuan Dynasty

death_place.en: Yingtian Prefecture, South Zhili, Ming Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明代大臣、学者、文学家、儒学大师、思想家。建文帝时期翰林院侍讲、重臣。他参与组织削藩，其著作《叶郑传》和《先府君行状》记载了空印案，并曾请求诛杀李景隆。靖难之变后，因拒绝为朱棣草拟即位诏书并拒绝合作，被处极刑，据传遭诛十族。
description.en: A Ming dynasty minister, scholar, writer, renowned Confucian master, and thinker. He served as a Hanlin Academy lecturer and key advisor to the Jianwen Emperor. He was involved in the policy of reducing the power of imperial princes. His works, 'Biography of Ye and Zheng' and 'Conduct of My Late Father', documented the Empty Seal Case, and he once requested the execution of Li Jinglong. After the Jingnan Campaign, he was executed for refusing to draft the enthronement edict for Zhu Di and for his broader refusal to cooperate, and it is said that his ten degrees of kinship were exterminated.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝时期的兵部尚书，曾极力反对任命李景隆为大将军，并与黄子澄一同主张削藩。靖难之役后，被朱棣视为“奸臣”之首并处死。
description.en: Minister of War during the Jianwen Emperor's reign, he strongly opposed the appointment of Li Jinglong as Grand General, and along with Huang Zicheng, advocated for the policy to reduce the power of princes. After the Jingnan Campaign, he was labeled a 'treacherous official' by Zhu Di and executed.

description.zh-cn: 他是建文帝时期的太常寺卿，与齐泰同为削藩政策的主要倡议者。他曾推荐李景隆为大将军。在靖难之役后，他被朱棣视为“奸臣”之首并处死。
description.en: He was the Grand Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices during the Jianwen Emperor's reign. Along with Qi Tai, he was a major advocate for the policy of reducing princely power. He once recommended Li Jinglong as Grand General. After the Jingnan Campaign, he was labeled a 'treacherous official' by Zhu Di and executed.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆，明朝开国功臣李文忠之子，袭封曹国公。作为明朝初期将领，在靖难之役中，初期任建文帝方主帅，后接替耿炳文担任总帅，指挥中央军主力，屡败于燕王朱棣。最终在燕军兵临城下时，于南京打开金川门投降。永乐年间被削爵圈禁，并于永乐末年去世。
description.en: Li Jinglong, son of Li Wenzhong, a founding duke of the Ming Dynasty, inherited the title Duke of Cao. As an early Ming general, during the Jingnan Campaign, he initially served as the chief commander for the Jianwen Emperor's forces. He later took over command from Geng Bingwen, leading the central army's main forces, but suffered repeated defeats against Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan. Ultimately, with the Yan army at the city gates, he surrendered in Nanjing by opening the Jinchuan Gate. During the Yongle era, he was stripped of his title, placed under house arrest, and passed away towards the end of the Yongle reign.

description.en: The second son of the Yongle Emperor Zhu Di of the Ming Dynasty, and brother of the Hongxi Emperor. He was first enfeoffed as the Prince of Gaoyang, and later as the Prince of Han. He was executed by the Xuande Emperor after his failed rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖朱棣三子，明仁宗朱高炽之弟，封赵简王。
description.en: Third son of the Yongle Emperor, brother of the Hongxi Emperor.

日本关东军高级参谋，皇姑屯事件的具体策划制定者。
1927年6月18日由张作霖在北京成立的军政府，张作霖自任海陆军大元帅。
description.en: A military government established in Beijing by Zhang Zuolin on June 18, 1927, with Zhang assuming the title of Grand Marshal of the Army and Navy.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初政治人物，曾任东三省总督。
北洋政府将领，曾任奉天将军。
1925年10月至1926年4月期间，中国直系、国民军、奉系等军阀势力之间爆发的内战。
description.en: A civil war in China between October 1925 and April 1926, involving warlord factions such as the Zhili clique, the Guominjun, and the Fengtian clique.

奉系军阀将领，张作霖的结拜兄弟。
奉系军阀将领，张作霖的结拜兄弟，满洲国第二任国务总理大臣。
中华民国军政人物，奉系军阀核心人物之一。他是张作霖的结拜兄弟。曾任吉林督军、吉林省政府主席等职。皇姑屯事件后，他拥立张学良继位，并推动东北易帜。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China, a key figure in the Fengtian clique, and Zhang Zuolin's sworn brother. He served as the Military Governor of Jilin and Chairman of the Jilin Provincial Government. After the Huanggutun Incident, he supported Zhang Xueliang as the successor and promoted the Northeast Flag Replacement.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大清盛京将军辖区锦州府义县

description.zh-cn: 1922年，直系军阀与奉系军阀为争夺中国北京政府控制权而爆发战争。战前，张作霖曾召回杨宇霆委以重任。最终，奉系失败告终。
description.en: In 1922, a war broke out between the Zhili and Fengtian cliques for control of China's Beijing government. Before the war, Zhang Zuolin recalled Yang Yuting to Fengtian and gave him significant responsibilities. The war ended in the defeat of the Fengtian clique.

美籍华人传媒工作者、政评家和作家，政治立场偏向极右派，拥护保守主义并支持美国共和党，反对中国共产党及共产主义。他曾撰文高度评价魏京生。
description.en: A Chinese-American media professional, political commentator, and writer with far-right political leanings. He supports conservatism and the US Republican Party, and opposes the Chinese Communist Party and communism. He once wrote an article highly praising Wei Jingsheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国1989年六四事件学生运动领袖之一。事件后遭通缉并流亡海外，先后在法国、美国求学和居住。现为网络“六四档案”、“孙文学校”创办人，柴玲前夫。
description.en: One of the student leaders of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests in China. He became a wanted fugitive after the event and went into exile, studying and residing in France and the United States. He is the founder of the 'June 4th Archive' website and the 'Sun Yat-sen School' online, and the ex-husband of Chai Ling.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任入境事务处处长、廉政专员及保安局局长。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, former Director of Immigration, Commissioner of the ICAC, and Secretary for Security.

description.zh-cn: 香港民主派政治人物，被誉为香港民主派元老及精神领袖。他曾任教师、小学校长，后投身社会运动及政治，创立香港教育专业人员协会、香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会（支联会）及香港民主同盟。他也是支联会创会主席，并据其称协助吾尔开希逃亡。
description.en: A Hong Kong pro-democracy politician, regarded as a patriarch and spiritual leader of the Hong Kong pro-democracy camp. He was a teacher and primary school principal before dedicating himself to social and political movements. He founded the Hong Kong Professional Teachers' Union, the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China (HKA), and the United Democrats of Hong Kong. He was also the founding chairman of the HKA and claimed to have assisted in Wu'erkaixi's escape.

description.zh-cn: 位于吉林省长春市，是以培养飞行人才为主的综合性高等军事院校，隶属中国人民解放军空军。其历史可追溯至由东北人民解放军航空学校于1949年5月更名而来的机构。学校于2004年6月9日由多所院校合并组建。其前身院校包括：1993年由空军第一飞行基础学校（该校前身为1986年由空军第一航空预备学校更名而来的机构，后于1993年升格为空军长春飞行学院）升格而来的机构；1992年10月由空军第二航空技术专科学校（该校前身为1986年由空军第二航空机务学校升格而来，并于1992年升格为空军第二航空学院）升格而成的机构；以及1986年6月更名并持续至2004年合并组建的空军第七航空学校（该校源于1949年由牡丹江航校定名，并于1952年1月更名为空军第七航空学校，活跃于1949年12月20日-1952年1月）。此外，由空军第十三航空学校于1986年7月升格而来的某机构，也于2012年4月并入空军航空大学。2017年在深化国防和军队改革中，学校进行了调整重组。
description.en: Located in Changchun, Jilin Province, it is a comprehensive higher military institution mainly for training flight personnel, affiliated with the PLA Air Force. Its history can be traced back to an institution renamed from the Northeast People's Liberation Army Aviation School in May 1949. The university itself was initially formed on June 9, 2004, by the merger of several institutions. Its predecessor institutions include: an institution upgraded in 1993 from the Air Force First Flight Basic School (which originated from the Air Force First Aviation Preparatory School, renamed in 1986, and later upgraded to Air Force Changchun Flight College in 1993); an institution upgraded from the Air Force Second Aeronautical Technical College in October 1992 (this college was upgraded from the Air Force Second Aeronautical and Mechanical School in 1986 and further upgraded to the Air Force Second Aviation College in 1992); and the Air Force Seventh Aviation School (which originated from the Mudanjiang Aviation School in 1949, was renamed the Air Force Seventh Aviation School in January 1952, active from December 20, 1949, to January 1952, and was later renamed in June 1986 and continued until the 2004 merger). Additionally, an institution upgraded from the Air Force Thirteenth Aviation School in July 1986 was merged into the Air Force Aviation University in April 2012. It was further reorganized in 2017 during the reform of national defense and the military.

孝钦显皇后之母。
清朝第十位皇帝，孝钦显皇后（慈禧太后）与咸丰帝的独子，光绪帝的堂兄。其年号“同治”意为两宫太后与恭亲王奕䜣共同治理国家。
description.en: The tenth emperor of the Qing dynasty, the only son of Empress Dowager Xiaocin Xian (Cixi) and the Xianfeng Emperor. He was also the cousin of the Guangxu Emperor. His reign title 'Tongzhi' implied joint rule by the two empress dowagers and Prince Gong Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝的皇后，同治年间的两宫皇太后之一。她与慈禧太后一同垂帘听政，是奕䜣的重要政治盟友。
description.en: Empress consort of the Xianfeng Emperor and one of the two empress dowagers during the Tongzhi era. She co-reigned with Empress Dowager Cixi and was an important political ally of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 清朝晚期皇室宗室，著名的改革家、政治家、军事家、外交家和洋务派领袖。道光帝第六子，咸丰帝异母弟。他曾任总理衙门首席大臣、领班军机大臣等要职，是同治朝及光绪朝前期朝廷的最高掌权者之一，也是洋务运动的主要发起者和领导者。此外，他曾被任命为全权钦差大臣，负责与英法联军进行谈判并签订《北京条约》，并在辛酉政变中与慈禧合作，但后来被罢免。
description.en: A prince of the Manchu Aisin Gioro clan, an important statesman, reformer, military strategist, diplomat, and a key leader of the Self-Strengthening Movement during the late Qing dynasty. He was the sixth son of the Daoguang Emperor and the younger half-brother of the Xianfeng Emperor. He served as the head of the Zongli Yamen and Grand Councilor, making him one of the most powerful figures during the Tongzhi and early Guangxu eras. He was also appointed as imperial commissioner with plenipotentiary powers to negotiate with the Anglo-French forces and sign the Convention of Peking. Furthermore, he collaborated with Empress Dowager Cixi during the Xinyou Coup but was later dismissed.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝临终前任命的辅佐同治帝的八位大臣，以载垣、端华、肃顺为首。他们在辛酉政变中被推翻。
description.en: A group of eight officials appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor on his deathbed to assist the young Tongzhi Emperor, led by Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and Sushun. They were overthrown in the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后联合恭亲王奕䜣发动的宫廷政变，夺取了实际统治权。

birth_place.zh-cn: 永城县, 归德府, 河南省

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期军阀，因于1928年盗掘清东陵中的乾隆裕陵和慈禧定东陵而臭名昭著。其政治生涯中多次转换阵营，曾先后依附于直系、国民军、奉系、国民革命军、日军，并于1943年4月被俘后投靠汪精卫政权。最终在国共内战中被中国人民解放军俘虏，后于战俘营中死亡。
description.en: A warlord during the Republic of China era, notorious for looting the Yuling Mausoleum of Qianlong and the Dingdongling of Cixi in the Eastern Qing Tombs in 1928. Throughout his political career, he switched allegiances multiple times, aligning successively with the Zhili clique, Guominjun, Fengtian clique, National Revolutionary Army, and the Japanese Army. After being captured in April 1943, he defected to the Wang Jingwei regime. He was eventually captured by the People's Liberation Army during the Chinese Civil War and died in a prisoner-of-war camp.

description.zh-cn: 庚子国变后，清政府推行的一系列改革措施。
清末，由清政府主导的君主立宪准备活动，同时也是一场政治改革运动，其发生受到了日本以君主立宪政体战胜专制俄国的鼓舞。在此期间，也涌现出主张君主立宪的政治派别，他们在四川发动和领导了保路运动，并力图将其控制在和平抗议的范围内。
description.en: In the late Qing Dynasty, China saw a government-led preparatory movement for a constitutional monarchy, a political reform greatly encouraged by Japan's victory as a constitutional monarchy over the autocratic Russian Empire. Concurrently, political factions advocating constitutional monarchy emerged, notably initiating and leading the Railway Protection Movement in Sichuan, striving to keep it within peaceful protest bounds.

description.zh-cn: 顾命八大臣之首，在辛酉政变中被奕䜣等人定罪处死。
description.en: Leader of the Eight Regent Ministers, who was convicted and executed by Yixin and his allies during the Xinyou Coup.

zh-cn: 孝敬宪皇后乌拉那拉氏

description.zh-cn: 清朝雍正帝的嫡妻，正宫皇后，出身于满洲正黄旗乌拉那拉氏，是内大臣费扬古之女。
description.en: Empress Xiaojingxian was the empress consort of the Yongzheng Emperor of the Qing dynasty. She was from the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner Ulanara clan and the daughter of Fiyanggū, an Inner Court Minister.

description.zh-cn: 清朝皇太后，雍正帝的皇贵妃，乾隆帝的生母。
description.en: Empress Dowager of the Qing Dynasty, an imperial noble consort of the Yongzheng Emperor, and the biological mother of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，康熙帝第八子，雍正帝异母弟，也是其政治对手。因参与九子夺嫡，被雍正帝圈禁，改名阿其那，后在禁所病故。人称“八贤王”。他曾获清朝亲王爵位。
description.en: An imperial prince of the Qing dynasty, the eighth son of the Kangxi Emperor and a half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor. Due to his involvement in the nine sons' succession struggle, he was imprisoned by the Yongzheng Emperor, forced to change his name to Akina, and later died in confinement. He was known as the 'Eighth Virtuous Prince'. He once held a princely title of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第九子，雍正帝的政治对手。
description.en: The ninth son of the Kangxi Emperor and a political rival of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第十四子，雍正帝同母弟。
description.en: The fourteenth son of the Kangxi Emperor, a full brother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，康熙帝第十三子，雍正帝异母弟、得力助手。他是第一代怡亲王，也是清朝有史以来第九位铁帽子王，第一位因功受封的铁帽子王。雍正帝即位后改名允祥，逝世后获准改回原名，谥号“贤”。
description.en: An imperial prince of the Qing dynasty, the 13th son of the Kangxi Emperor and a half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor, and a key assistant to him. He was the first Prince Yi, the 9th iron-cap prince in Qing history, and the first to be granted the title for merit. He changed his name to Yunxiang after the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, and was allowed to revert to his original name posthumously. His posthumous name was 'Xian'.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第三子。
康熙帝第十子。
雍正帝第三子，后被过继给允禩。
description.en: The third son of the Yongzheng Emperor, later adopted into Yinsi's lineage.

description.zh-cn: 清朝将领，雍正时期重臣，后被雍正帝赐死。
description.en: An important official during the Yongzheng era of the Qing Dynasty, later forced to commit suicide by the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙、雍正两朝重臣，佟国维之子，康熙帝表弟，孝懿仁皇后之弟，雍正帝舅舅。
description.en: An important official during the Kangxi and Yongzheng eras of the Qing Dynasty, son of Tung-gowei, cousin of the Kangxi Emperor, younger brother of Empress Xiaoyiren, and uncle of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝雍正、乾隆时期的重要政治家、首席军机大臣、大学士，也是雍正帝遗命的辅政大臣之一。
description.en: An important statesman, chief Grand Councillor, and Grand Secretary during the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns of the Qing Dynasty, he was also one of the regents appointed by the Yongzheng Emperor's will.

description.zh-cn: 清初学者，其著作在雍正年间引发文字狱。
清朝一种官员向皇帝直接汇报的制度，由雍正帝完善并强化。
清朝的一项重要税制改革。
清朝的一项财政改革措施。
清朝在西南少数民族地区推行的政治改革。

en: List of Qing ambans in Tibet

description.zh-cn: 清朝中央政府派驻西藏的代表官员职位。

en: Succession struggle of the nine princes

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙末年，九位皇子争夺皇位的历史事件。
description.en: A historical event during the late Kangxi era of the Qing dynasty where nine of his sons vied for the throne.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市东城区
location.en: Dongcheng District, Beijing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 位于北京中轴线中心的宫殿建筑群，是中国明清两代二十四位皇帝的皇家宫殿。始建于1406年，1420年落成，是世界上现存规模最大、最完整的宫殿建筑。孝庄太皇太后曾在此长期居住并逝世，雍正帝即位后也曾迁入此地。现为故宫博物院所在地。
description.en: The palace complex at the center of Beijing's central axis served as the imperial palace for 24 emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Construction started in 1406 and was completed in 1420, making it the world's largest and most complete palace complex. Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang resided here for a long time and passed away, and the Yongzheng Emperor also moved here after ascending the throne. It now houses the Palace Museum.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝，唐高宗李治与武则天之幼子，唐玄宗李隆基之父，李显和安定公主之弟。他曾两次登基、两次禅位，是唐朝第五位和第九位皇帝。
description.en: An emperor of the Tang dynasty, the youngest son of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi and Empress Wu Zetian, father of Emperor Xuanzong Li Longji, and younger brother of Li Xian and Princess Anding. He ascended the throne twice and abdicated twice, serving as the fifth and ninth emperor of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐睿宗的妃子，唐玄宗的生母。她后被武则天秘密杀害。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Ruizong and the birth mother of Emperor Xuanzong. She was later secretly killed by Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上唯一获正史承认的女性皇帝，武周开国君主。唐玄宗的祖母，安定公主之母，曾为唐高宗昭仪。她将洛阳命名为“神都”，相传曾因牡丹不从其令而将其贬至洛阳。
description.en: The only female emperor in Chinese history recognized by official history, and the founding monarch of the Wu Zhou dynasty. She was the grandmother of Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, mother of Princess Anding, and once Emperor Gaozong's Zhaoyi. She named Luoyang 'Shendu' (Divine Capital), and legend has it that she exiled the peony to Luoyang for disobeying her command.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相，杨贵妃的堂兄。与安禄山不和，是安史之乱的导火索之一，后在马嵬驿兵变中被杀。
description.en: Chancellor of the Tang Dynasty and cousin of Imperial Consort Yang. His conflict with An Lushan was a major catalyst for the rebellion, and he was killed during the Mawei Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝三镇节度使，安史之乱的主要发动者，建立大燕政权。张九龄曾预见其野心并奏请唐玄宗将其处死，但未被采纳。他最终被其子安庆绪所杀。
description.en: A military governor of three regions in the Tang Dynasty, the primary initiator of the An Lushan Rebellion, and founder of the Yan state. Zhang Jiuling once foresaw his ambition and requested Emperor Xuanzong of Tang to execute him, but this advice was not adopted. He was eventually killed by his son, An Qingxu.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱期间，唐玄宗出逃途中，护送的禁军士兵（由将领陈玄礼率领）发动兵变。此次兵变导致宰相杨国忠被杀，杨贵妃被赐死。事件后，太子李亨与唐玄宗分道扬镳，为李亨在灵武自行即位创造了条件。
description.en: During the An Lushan Rebellion, imperial guards (led by general Chen Xuanli) escorting Emperor Xuanzong during his flight launched a mutiny. This mutiny resulted in the execution of Chancellor Yang Guozhong and the forced suicide of Imperial Consort Yang. After the event, Crown Prince Li Heng separated from Emperor Xuanzong, creating the conditions for Li Heng's own enthronement in Lingwu.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗李亨，唐朝第七位皇帝，唐玄宗李隆基第三子，唐代宗李豫之父。他在安史之乱中即位于灵州，指挥唐军反攻并收复两京，平定叛乱。曾与高适商讨平定李璘叛乱的计策并重用高适。他重用宦官李辅国，宠信张皇后，导致朝廷内部纷争，最终在李辅国针对张皇后的宫廷政变中受惊吓而驾崩。
description.en: Tang Suzong Li Heng, the seventh emperor of the Tang Dynasty, the third son of Emperor Xuanzong Li Longji, and father of Emperor Daizong (Li Yu). He ascended the throne in Lingzhou during the An-Shi Rebellion, directing the Tang army's counterattack, recapturing the two capitals, and suppressing the rebellion. He consulted with Gao Shi on strategies to quell Li Lin's rebellion and placed great trust in him. His heavy reliance on the eunuch Li Fuguo and favor towards Empress Zhang led to internal court conflicts, and he ultimately died of shock during a palace coup initiated by Li Fuguo against the empress.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗统治前期出现的治世，是唐朝的极盛时期，最终因安史之乱而终结。
description.en: The golden age of the Tang Dynasty during the early reign of Emperor Xuanzong, which came to an end with the An Lushan Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗第十八子，杨贵妃前夫。
唐朝公主，唐高宗李治与武则天的小女儿，唐玄宗的姑姑，安定公主的同胞妹妹。她与李隆基（即唐玄宗）之间存在政治斗争，在玄宗即位初期权倾朝野。因不满当时身为太子的李隆基，她曾试图劝说其流产子嗣李亨（即后来的唐肃宗）。最终，她在与玄宗的政治斗争中失败被赐死。
description.en: A princess of the Tang dynasty, the youngest daughter of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi and Empress Wu Zetian, an aunt of Emperor Xuanzong, and a full sister of Princess Anding. She was involved in a political struggle with Li Longji (who later became Emperor Xuanzong), holding immense power during the early years of his reign. Dissatisfied with Li Longji when he was the crown prince, she once attempted to persuade him to abort his son, Li Heng (who later became Emperor Suzong). Ultimately, she was defeated in the political struggle against Xuanzong and was forced to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 唐中宗李显的第二任皇后，她企图效法武则天临朝称制，后在唐隆政变中被李隆基所杀。
description.en: Second Empress of Emperor Zhongzong Li Xian of Tang. She attempted to emulate Wu Zetian and rule as regent, but was killed by Li Longji during the Tanglong Coup.

description.zh-cn: 由李隆基与太平公主联手发动的宫廷政变，旨在铲除企图称帝的韦皇后及其党羽，并拥立唐睿宗复辟。
description.en: A court coup launched jointly by Li Longji and Princess Taiping, aimed at eliminating Empress Wei and her faction who were attempting to usurp the throne, and reinstating Emperor Ruizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗宠妃，谗害太子李瑛等人。
唐玄宗第二子，曾为太子，后被武惠妃谗言所害。
唐玄宗时期宰相，以“口蜜腹剑”的权术著称。他为巩固权位，支持寿王李瑁，与被立为太子的李亨为敌并多次构陷。此外，他还建议重用胡人将领，间接促使安禄山势力坐大，为安史之乱埋下隐患。史载，高适中第后，仅被其授予县尉一职，可见其排挤贤才、专权弄势的手段。
description.en: A chancellor during Emperor Xuanzong's reign, known for his 'sweet words and treacherous heart' (口蜜腹剑). To consolidate his power, he supported Prince Li Mao of Shou, making him an enemy of the designated crown prince Li Heng, whom he repeatedly attempted to frame. Furthermore, he advocated for the heavy use of non-Han generals, which indirectly led to An Lushan's growing influence and laid the groundwork for the An Lushan Rebellion. Historical records show that after Gao Shi passed the examination, he was only appointed to the minor post of county sheriff, demonstrating his methods of sidelining talented individuals and monopolizing power.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝，由李渊建立，是中国历史上的一个重要朝代，被视为黄金时代之一。其初期，涿郡被复名为幽州。此朝代不仅孕育了著名诗人白居易，也是安定公主生活的时代背景。房玄龄在此期间担任宰相等重要职务。唐朝与吐蕃帝国同时期存在，两者间既有战争也有和亲。然而，安史之乱导致其国力由盛转衰，唐昭宗为其晚期皇帝。
description.en: The Tang Dynasty, founded by Li Yuan, was an important period in Chinese history and is considered one of its golden ages. In its early period, Zhuo Commandery was renamed back to You Province. This dynasty not only nurtured the renowned poet Bai Juyi but also served as the historical backdrop for Princess Anding's life. Fang Xuanling held important positions such as chancellor during this era. The Tang Dynasty coexisted with the Tibetan Empire, engaging in both warfare and marriage alliances. However, its national power declined from its peak due to the An Lushan Rebellion, with Emperor Zhaozong being one of its late rulers.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗的妃嫔，唐肃宗的生母，被追尊为皇太后。
description.en: A concubine of Emperor Xuanzong and the biological mother of Emperor Suzong. She was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝、西汉以及东汉末年的首都。作为西汉首都，它曾是巫蛊之祸中太子与丞相军队激战的主要地点。在唐朝，唐昭宗曾多次被迫离开此地。在东汉末年，它曾被李傕、郭汜等人攻占。
description.en: The capital of the Tang, Western Han, and late Eastern Han dynasties. As the Western Han capital, it was the main site of fierce battles between the Crown Prince's and the Chancellor's forces during the Witchcraft Delusion. During the Tang dynasty, Emperor Zhaozong was forced to leave the city multiple times. In the late Eastern Han dynasty, it was captured by Li Jue, Guo Si, and others.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思的妻子，出身于普鲁士贵族家庭。
description.en: The wife of Karl Marx, from a Prussian aristocratic family.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思的母亲，出身于荷兰一个富裕的商人家庭。
description.en: Karl Marx's mother, from a wealthy Dutch merchant family.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思的长女。
卡尔·马克思的次女。
卡尔·马克思的幼女。

zh-cn: 路德维希·冯·威斯特华伦

description.zh-cn: 燕妮·马克思的父亲，卡尔·马克思的岳父。
卡尔·马克思的政治经济学批判著作。
description.en: A foundational theoretical text in materialist philosophy, economics and politics by Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 位于普鲁士王国的城市，卡尔·马克思的出生地。
description.en: A city in the Kingdom of Prussia, the birthplace of Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 英国首都及最大都市，英格兰首府，也是东京都的姊妹友好都市。由罗马人于公元43年建立，现为世界领先的全球城市之一，在艺术、商业、教育、金融、媒体、旅游和交通方面具有显著地位。这里也是马克思长期流亡、进行研究和最终逝世的地方。
description.en: The capital and largest city of the United Kingdom and England, and a sister city of Tokyo Metropolis. Founded by the Romans in 43 AD, it is now one of the world's leading global cities, with significant influence in arts, commerce, education, finance, media, tourism, and transport. It is also the place where Marx lived in exile for a long time, conducted his research, and eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1835年至1836年就读的大学。
description.en: The university Marx attended from 1835 to 1836.

description.zh-cn: 位于德国柏林的公立研究型大学。马克思曾于1836年至1841年在此就读，并深受黑格尔哲学的影响。
description.en: A public research university in Berlin, Germany. Karl Marx attended this university from 1836 to 1841, during which he was deeply influenced by Hegelian philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 1841年授予马克思哲学博士学位的大学。
description.en: The university that awarded Marx his PhD in Philosophy in 1841.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪德国的一个激进的哲学思潮和知识分子团体，从左翼视角批判当时的社会、政治与宗教体制，并对黑格尔的哲学进行激进解读。马克思和巴枯宁早期都曾是其中一员。
description.en: A radical philosophical movement and intellectual group in 19th-century Germany that criticized the social, political, and religious institutions of their time from a left-wing perspective, and radically interpreted Hegel's philosophy. Marx and Bakunin were early members.

zh-cn: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家，德国古典哲学的集大成者。其哲学思想对马克思和巴枯宁产生了深远影响。他曾是路德维希·费尔巴哈在柏林的导师。在其《哲学史讲演录》中，他对孔子及《论语》持负面评价，认为其内容是“毫无出色之处的东西”，是常识道德。
description.en: A German philosopher and a major figure in German classical philosophy. His philosophical ideas profoundly influenced both Marx and Bakunin. He was also Ludwig Feuerbach's teacher in Berlin. In his 'Lectures on the History of Philosophy', he expressed a negative view of Confucius and the Analects, considering its content to be 'something without anything outstanding' and common-sense morality.

description.zh-cn: 由正义者同盟改组而成的国际无产阶级政党，委托马克思和恩格斯起草了《共产党宣言》。
description.en: An international proletarian political party reorganized from the League of the Just, which commissioned Marx and Engels to write The Communist Manifesto.

description.zh-cn: 即第一国际，一个旨在联合各国工人阶级及各种左翼社会主义、共产主义和无政府主义政治团体和工会组织的国际组织。马克思是其创始人和核心领导人之一。巴枯宁于1868年加入，后因与马克思派的斗争于1872年被开除。
description.en: Also known as the First International, an international organization aiming to unite the working classes of various countries and a variety of different left-wing socialist, communist and anarchist political groups and trade union organizations. Marx was a founder and one of its key leaders. Bakunin joined in 1868 and was expelled in 1872 due to his conflict with the Marxist faction.

zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇·巴枯宁

description.zh-cn: 俄国思想家、革命家、社会主义者和无政府主义理论家。他在第一国际中与马克思展开了激烈斗争，并被认为是无政府主义最具影响力的人物之一，是集体无政府主义理论的主要创立者。
description.en: Russian thinker, revolutionary, socialist, and anarchist theorist. He engaged in a fierce struggle with Marx within the First International, and is considered one of the most influential figures in anarchism and the main founder of the theory of collectivist anarchism.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家，青年黑格尔派的领导人物之一，马克思早期的朋友，后成为其批判对象。
description.en: German philosopher and one of the leaders of the Young Hegelians. He was an early friend of Marx who later became a target of his criticism.

description.zh-cn: 科隆的激进派报刊，马克思曾于1842年担任其主编，后被普鲁士政府查禁。
description.en: A radical newspaper in Cologne, where Marx served as editor in 1842 before it was banned by the Prussian government.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国，18世纪在神圣罗马帝国内崛起为强权，与奥地利争夺德意志地区领导权。七年战争中，它作为主要参战国之一，与英国结盟，在腓特烈大帝领导下对抗法奥俄同盟，战后进一步崛起为欧洲强权。19世纪时作为德意志邦国，也是马克思的出生地。
description.en: The Kingdom of Prussia emerged as a major power within the Holy Roman Empire in the 18th century, contending with Austria for leadership in the German region. As a major participant in the Seven Years' War, it allied with Great Britain and, under Frederick the Great, fought against the Franco-Austrian-Russian coalition, further rising as a European power after the war. In the 19th century, it was a German kingdom and Marx's birthplace.

description.zh-cn: 激进左翼报刊。
德国社会活动家。
共产主义者同盟的前身。
马克思与恩格斯合作撰写的第一部著作，批判了青年黑格尔派的代表人物布鲁诺·鲍威尔。
description.en: The first collaborative work by Marx and Engels, criticizing Bruno Bauer, a leading figure of the Young Hegelians.

description.zh-cn: 法国内政部长。

zh-cn: 路德维希·安德烈亚斯·冯·费尔巴哈

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、人类学家，青年黑格尔派成员。他是一位形而上学唯物主义和世俗人文主义者，其唯物主义和宗教批判思想对青年马克思和弗里德里希·恩格斯产生了重要影响。尽管马克思后来在《关于费尔巴哈的提纲》中对其进行了批判。
description.en: German philosopher and anthropologist, a member of the Young Hegelians. He was a metaphysical materialist and secular humanist whose materialist and religious critique significantly influenced the young Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Marx later criticized him in 'Theses on Feuerbach'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思于1847年出版的著作，旨在回应和批判皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东的《贫困的哲学》。
description.en: A book published by Marx in 1847, intended as a response and critique to Pierre-Joseph Proudhon's 'The Philosophy of Poverty'.

description.zh-cn: 法国社会主义者、政治家、哲学家、经济学家，第一位自称“无政府主义者”。他的思想在马克思的《哲学的贫困》中受到批判，但也对巴枯宁产生了巨大影响。
description.en: French socialist, politician, philosopher, economist, and the first person to call himself an 'anarchist'. His ideas were criticized by Marx in 'The Poverty of Philosophy' and had a great influence on Bakunin.

zh-cn: 新莱茵报：民主派机关报

description.zh-cn: 美国报纸，马克思在1852年至1862年间担任其欧洲通讯员。
description.en: An American newspaper for which Marx served as a European correspondent from 1852 to 1862.

description.zh-cn: 1871年巴黎市民发动的起义，建立了短暂的工人阶级政权，马克思在《法兰西内战》中为其正名。
description.en: An uprising by the citizens of Paris in 1871 that established a short-lived working-class government, which Marx defended in 'The Civil War in France'.

description.zh-cn: 马克思为第一国际撰写的小册子，分析并支持了1871年的巴黎公社运动。
description.en: A pamphlet written by Marx for the First International, analyzing and supporting the Paris Commune of 1871.

description.zh-cn: 德国社会民主党创始人。
德国社会民主党领袖。
德国工人运动活动家。
18世纪苏格兰古典政治经济学家和哲学家，被誉为“经济学之父”或“资本主义之父”。其自由市场经济理论影响深远，曾启迪福泽谕吉等思想家。
description.en: An 18th-century Scottish classical political economist and philosopher, hailed as 'The Father of Economics' or 'The Father of Capitalism'. His free-market economic theories had a profound influence, inspiring thinkers like Fukuzawa Yukichi.

description.zh-cn: 明末民变首领。
明末民变首领。
明末民变领袖，闯王，李自成舅父。
明末清初的政治人物和军事将领。原为明朝崇祯年间的兵部尚书、蓟辽总督，在松锦之战中兵败被俘后投降清朝，成为清朝首位汉人大学士，对清朝巩固统治贡献甚多。
description.en: A political and military figure of the late Ming and early Qing dynasties. Originally the Minister of War and Viceroy of Jiliao during the Chongzhen era of the Ming dynasty, he surrendered to the Qing dynasty after being defeated and captured in the Battle of Songjin. He became the first Han Chinese Grand Secretary of the Qing dynasty and contributed significantly to the consolidation of Qing rule.

description.zh-cn: 明末将领。
明朝兵部尚书。

description.en: A minister of the late Ming Dynasty who served as Grand Secretary of the East Cabinet and Supreme Commander, responsible for suppressing peasant rebellions.

description.en: Qing Dynasty Prince Su, the eldest son of Hong Taiji, who contended with Dorgon for the throne and was later persecuted by him.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初将领。
明朝灭亡后，由明朝宗室在南方建立的抵抗清朝的政权，后被清朝所灭。
description.en: Regimes established by Ming imperial family members in southern China after the fall of the Ming dynasty, resisting the Qing and eventually conquered by them.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任香港特别行政区行政长官。他曾在司徒华逝世后发表悼词，赞扬其热爱中国及香港，致力推动民主发展。刘梦熊曾批评其施政水平为“三流政客”。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician who served as the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. He delivered a eulogy after Szeto Wah's death, praising his love for China and Hong Kong and his dedication to promoting democratic development. Additionally, Lew Mon-hung criticized his governance as that of a 'third-rate politician'.

description.en: Hong Kong businessman and politician, the first Chief Executive of the HKSAR.

description.en: The predecessor of King's College was established in 1857, renamed Saiyingpun School in 1872, and then renamed King's College in 1922. Currently, King's College is a prestigious government-run boys' secondary school in Mid-Levels West, Hong Kong. Its Bonham Road campus is the oldest surviving government school building in Hong Kong and has been declared a statutory monument.

description.en: A Hong Kong businessman and political figure, former member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC and a member of Leung Chun-ying's election office. He was an early staunch supporter of Leung Chun-ying but later had a falling out and became a sharp critic.

description.zh-cn: 香港传媒人
香港江湖人物，曾出席“流浮山小桃园饭局”，与刘梦熊等梁振英竞选团队成员会面。

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，时任梁振英竞选办公室要员，曾与刘梦熊一同出席“流浮山小桃园饭局”。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician and a key member of Leung Chun-ying's campaign office at the time, who attended the 'Lau Fau Shan Small Peach Garden dinner' with Lew Mon-hung.

description.zh-cn: 载沣的元配嫡福晋，大学士荣禄之女，溥仪和溥杰的生母。
description.en: The primary consort of Zaifeng, daughter of the Grand Secretary Ronglu, and the biological mother of Puyi and Pujie.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初军阀，中华民国初期定武军统帅。曾于1917年策划并领导丁巳复辟，率兵进入北京拥立清废帝溥仪，但迅速失败。
description.en: A warlord in the late Qing and early Republic of China, and commander of the Dingwu Army. In 1917, he planned and led the Ding-si Restoration, leading troops into Beijing to restore the deposed emperor Puyi, but failed quickly.

description.zh-cn: 由冯玉祥发动的军事政变，推翻了直系军阀控制的时任大总统曹锟政府，并导致溥仪被逐出紫禁城。
description.en: A military coup launched by Feng Yuxiang that overthrew the Zhili clique-controlled government of then-President Cao Kun, and led to Puyi's expulsion from the Forbidden City.

description.zh-cn: 苏联在二战末期对日本展开的军事行动，在满洲国发起并迅速击溃关东军，直接导致了满洲国的覆灭，并与原子弹轰炸共同成为促使日本投降的“双重震撼”。
description.en: A military operation launched by the Soviet Union against Japan at the end of World War II, initiated in Manchukuo and swiftly defeating the Kwantung Army, which directly led to Manchukuo's collapse and, along with the atomic bombings, created a 'double shock' that led to Japan's surrender.

description.zh-cn: 1918年至1946年间苏联的武装力量。
description.en: The armed forces of the Soviet Union from 1918 to 1946.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国辽宁省抚顺市的监狱，曾用以关押满洲国、第二次国共内战和中日战争的战犯，包括溥仪。
description.en: A prison in Fushun, Liaoning, China, used to incarcerate war criminals from Manchukuo, the Second Chinese Civil War, and the Second Sino-Japanese War, including Puyi.

description.en: The primary consort and empress of Puyi, the last emperor of the Qing Dynasty, and also the empress of Manchukuo, and elder sister of Runqi.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末代皇帝溥仪的淑妃，后与溥仪离婚。她是中国历史上唯一一位担任过教职的皇妃，也曾任第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: The Shu Fei (Consort Shu) of Puyi, the last emperor of the Qing Dynasty, whom she later divorced. She is the only imperial consort in Chinese history to have worked as a schoolteacher, and also served as a member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

载沣次子，溥仪之弟，曾与润麒一同赴日本学习军事。
description.en: The second son of Zaifeng and Puyi's younger brother, who went to Japan with Runqi to study military affairs.

description.zh-cn: 清代醇亲王奕𫍽及其子载沣的府邸，是光绪帝和载沣的出生地。
description.en: The mansion of Prince Chun Yixuan and his son Zaifeng in the Qing dynasty, and also the birthplace of Emperor Guangxu and Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交官，曾任溥仪的英文教师，并为金韫颖取英文名。
description.en: A British diplomat, who served as Puyi's English tutor, and gave Jin Yunying her English name.

description.zh-cn: 指1928年孙殿英以军事演习为名盗掘清东陵中慈禧太后和乾隆皇帝陵墓的事件。清东陵是位于河北省遵化市的清朝皇家陵寝，乾隆帝和慈禧太后的陵墓在此被孙殿英盗掘。此事震惊中外，并直接导致溥仪与国民政府决裂。
description.en: This refers to the 1928 incident where Sun Dianying, under the pretext of military exercises, looted the tombs of Empress Dowager Cixi and the Qianlong Emperor in the Eastern Qing Tombs. The Eastern Qing Combs are a Qing Dynasty royal mausoleum complex located in Zunhua, Hebei, where the tombs of Emperor Qianlong and Empress Dowager Cixi were looted by Sun Dianying. This event shocked China and the world, and directly led to Puyi's break with the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，甲级战犯。他是九一八事变策划者之一，长期在中国从事特务活动，并负责将溥仪带至东北。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army, a Class A war criminal. He was one of the planners of the Mukden Incident, instrumental in Japanese espionage activities in China for a long time, and responsible for bringing Puyi to Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦政府负责外交事务的行政部门，等同于世界各国的“外交部”。其前身是美国第一个联邦外交机构，成立于1789年7月21日，至同年9月15日被国务院取代。该部门曾邀请张孝骞赴美考察讲学。
description.en: The federal executive department of the United States responsible for foreign policy and international relations, equivalent to the foreign ministry of other countries. Its predecessor was the first federal foreign affairs agency of the United States, established on July 21, 1789, and superseded by the Department of State on September 15, 1789. This department also invited Zhang Xiaoqian to the United States for an academic tour.

中华人民共和国成立初期，由中国共产党领导的一场大规模政治运动，旨在肃清“反革命分子”。朱自清长子朱迈先在此运动中被处决。
description.en: A large-scale political movement led by the Communist Party of China in the early days of the People's Republic of China, aimed at eliminating 'counter-revolutionaries'. Zhu Ziqing's eldest son, Zhu Maixian, was executed during this campaign.

description.zh-cn: 一份在香港发行的中文报纸，由查良镛（金庸）和沈宝新于1959年创办。该报曾报道蒲城县学生坠亡及抗议事件，并连载了倪匡的著名小说《卫斯理系列》。
description.en: A Chinese-language newspaper published in Hong Kong, founded in 1959 by Louis Cha (Jin Yong) and Shen Pao Sing. It is known for reporting on the student's death and subsequent protests in Pucheng County, and for serializing Ni Kuang's famous 'Wisely Series' novels.

香港企业家，与查良镛共同提出“双查方案”。

description.zh-cn: 由查良镛和查济民提出的关于香港政治体制发展的保守方案，曾引发巨大争议。
description.en: A conservative proposal on Hong Kong's political development put forward by Louis Cha and Cha Chi-ming, which sparked significant controversy.

description.zh-cn: 本名倪聪，香港作家、编剧、评论家、演员，与金庸、黄沾、蔡澜并列为“香港四大才子”。他是亦舒的胞兄，也是古龙的莫逆之交。其作品以科幻小说《卫斯理系列》最为人所知，并以其鲜明的反共政治立场而闻名。
description.en: Ni Kuang, born Ni Cong, was a Hong Kong writer, screenwriter, critic, and actor, known as one of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong', alongside Jin Yong, Wong Jim, and Chua Lam. He was the elder brother of Yi Shu and a very close friend of Gu Long. His works are best known for the science fiction series 'Wisely Series', and he was also famous for his outspoken anti-communist political stance.

description.en: A Chinese politician and military general of the Republic of China, a core figure and one of the three leaders of the New Guangxi clique. He succeeded Lu Diping as the Chairman of Zhejiang Provincial Government and led troops to encircle and suppress the Nanchang Uprising forces in the Chaoshan area.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期桂系军阀。
description.en: A warlord of the Guangxi clique during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代画家、美术教育家
国民大会曾是中华民国最高政权机关之一，现已停止运作。其成员的职称与该机构密切相关，例如徐旭生曾当选第一届国民大会代表。1997年，国民大会通过宪法增修条文，为台湾省虚级化提供了法源依据。
description.en: The National Assembly was formerly one of the supreme organs of state power in the Republic of China and has since ceased operation. The titles of its members were closely related to the institution; for example, Xu Xusheng was elected as a delegate to the First National Assembly. In 1997, the National Assembly passed additional articles of the Constitution, which provided the legal basis for the streamlining of Taiwan Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝时期位于今山东省的一个重要诸侯国，以“礼义之邦”著称。其定都曲阜长达八百余年，也是孔子和子路的家乡。
description.en: A major vassal state during the Zhou dynasty of ancient China, located in modern-day Shandong province. It was known as the 'State of Rites and Propriety' and had its capital at Qufu for over 800 years, also being the homeland of Confucius and Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 曲阜位于中国山东省南部，是济宁市代管的县级市，亦是儒家学派创始人孔子的故乡。在隋代至1986年间，它曾是一个重要的行政区划名称。
description.en: Qufu, located in southern Shandong province, China, is a county-level city administered by Jining, and the hometown of Confucius, the founder of Confucianism. From the Sui dynasty until 1986, it was an important administrative division name.

description.zh-cn: 孔子的父亲，陬邑大夫。
孔子的母亲。
孔子的妻子。
孔子的儿子。
description.en: Son of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 孔子的孙子。
中国先秦时期的思想家，道家学派的创始人，《道德经》的作者。被道教奉为道祖、教主，其思想对庄周产生了深远影响。
description.en: A pre-Qin Chinese thinker and founder of the Taoist school of thought, he authored the 'Tao Te Ching'. Revered by Taoism as the Ancestor of Tao and its patriarch, his ideas profoundly influenced Zhuang Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 春秋后期齐国外交家、思想家，曾任齐国相国。他历仕齐灵公、齐后庄公、齐景公三朝，辅政长达五十余年，以节俭、谦恭、机敏、善辩著称。其墓位于今山东省淄博市齐都镇永顺村东南。
description.en: A diplomat and thinker of the State of Qi in the late Spring and Autumn period, he once served as Chancellor of Qi. He assisted three dukes—Ling, Zhuang II, and Jing—for over 50 years, known for his frugality, humility, intelligence, and eloquence. His tomb is located southeast of Yongshun Village, Qidu Town, Zibo City, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国君主，晏婴长期辅佐他，并多次对其进行劝谏。
description.en: Duke Jing of Qi, a ruler of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period, whom Yan Ying served for a long time and frequently advised.

description.zh-cn: 鲁国大夫，传说被孔子诛杀。
齐国大夫。
卫灵公的夫人，蒯聩的嫡母。蒯聩曾因谋害她而获罪。
description.en: The wife of Duke Ling of Wei and the formal mother of Kuai Kui. Kuai Kui was incriminated for plotting against her.

description.zh-cn: 卫国君主，蒯聩之父。
description.en: The ruler of the State of Wei, father of Kuai Kui.

description.zh-cn: 宋国司马。
楚国令尹。
春秋时期鲁国君主。
description.en: The Duke of the State of Lu during the Spring and Autumn period.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期鲁国人，孔子最得意的弟子，位列孔门十哲和七十二贤之首，后世尊称为“复圣”。
description.en: A native of the State of Lu during the Spring and Autumn period, he was Confucius's most favored disciple, ranked first among the Ten Wise Ones of Confucianism and the Seventy-two Disciples. He is posthumously honored as the 'Continuator Sage'.

description.zh-cn: 孔子著名弟子，孔门十哲之一。以其勇武、忠诚、信守承诺而著称。曾任卫国蒲邑宰、大夫孔悝的家臣，在卫国内乱中为救孔悝而殉职。
description.en: A prominent disciple of Confucius and one of the Ten Philosophers of the Confucian school. Known for his bravery, loyalty, and trustworthiness. He served as the governor of Pu in the state of Wei and as a retainer to the grand master Kong Kui, and died during a coup in Wei while trying to save his lord.

description.zh-cn: 孔子著名弟子，孔门十哲之一，与子路是同学。
description.en: A famous disciple of Confucius, one of the Ten Wise Ones of Confucianism, and a fellow student of Zi Lu.

description.zh-cn: 孔子弟子。
忽必烈之孙，皇太子真金之子，元朝第二位皇帝。在忽必烈死后，由伯颜等大臣拥立继位。
description.en: Grandson of Kublai Khan and son of Crown Prince Zhenjin, he was the second emperor of the Yuan dynasty. He was enthroned with the support of ministers like Bayan after Kublai's death.

description.zh-cn: 孔子在鲁国实施的旨在削弱三桓势力的政治军事行动。
春秋时期鲁国的三家贵族，长期掌控鲁国政权。
周朝时期的诸侯国，以陈县为首都。
description.en: A vassal state during the Zhou Dynasty, with Chen County as its capital.

description.zh-cn: 李锐的第二任妻子。
description.en: The second wife of Li Rui.

description.zh-cn: 李锐之女，她是一位传记作家、机械工程师，也是斯坦福大学胡佛研究所客座研究员。她曾与父亲一起向于光远保荐了杨小凯。
description.en: Daughter of Li Rui, she is a biographer, mechanical engineer, and visiting fellow at the Hoover Institution, Stanford University. She and her father once recommended Yang Xiaokai to Yu Guangyuan.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国水利电力部
en: Ministry of Water Resources and Electric Power of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 曾是中华人民共和国国务院负责水利和电力工业的组成部门。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for water conservancy and the electric power industry.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家。曾任中顾委委员、中国社会科学院副院长，并曾为陈元的导师。他与孙冶方等人一道，力主实行社会主义市场经济体制，并发起成立孙冶方经济学基金会。他还破格推荐杨小凯考入中国社会科学院经济研究所。
description.en: Chinese economist. He served as a member of the Central Advisory Commission and former vice president of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, and was a mentor to Chen Yuan. Along with Sun Yefang and others, he strongly advocated for the implementation of a socialist market economic system and initiated the establishment of the Sun Yefang Economic Science Foundation. He also made an exception to recommend Yang Xiaokai for admission to the Institute of Economics at CASS.

description.zh-cn: 中国农村改革的核心人物之一，曾任中顾委委员。

zh-cn: 胡佛研究所图书档案馆

description.zh-cn: 位于美国斯坦福大学的公共政策智库和研究机构。
description.en: A public policy think tank and research institution located at Stanford University in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省岳阳市下辖的县。
