description.en: A county under the administration of Yueyang City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东长子毛岸英的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Mao Zedong's eldest son, Mao Anying.

description.zh-cn: 国民党高级将领，中华民国军事及政治人物。他曾是鲁涤平的下属，后成为其政治对手，并接替其湖南省政府主席职位。此人还因在国民党“清党”行动中的表现而闻名。
description.en: A senior Kuomintang general and Chinese military and political figure of the Republic of China. He was once Lu Diping's subordinate, later becoming his political rival and succeeding him as the Chairman of Hunan Provincial Government. He is also known for his role in the Kuomintang purges.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央特别行动科工作人员，中共特别党员，牧师。曾受党组织委托照顾毛岸英、毛岸青兄弟。
description.en: A staff member of the Central Special Action Section of the Communist Party of China, a special CPC member, and a pastor. He was entrusted by the party organization to take care of the brothers Mao Anying and Mao Anqing.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，东北抗日义勇军领导人之一。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and one of the leaders of the Northeast Anti-Japanese Volunteer Armies.

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会社会部

description.zh-cn: 劳动英雄。
李家超的妻子，据报道持有英国国籍。
description.en: Spouse of John Lee Ka-chiu, reported to hold British nationality.

description.zh-cn: 李家超的长子，银行家，据报道持有英国国籍。
description.en: The elder son of John Lee Ka-chiu, a banker, reported to hold British nationality.

description.zh-cn: 李家超的幼子，曾投身银行界，后在中国内地开设幼儿园，据报道持有英国国籍。
description.en: The younger son of John Lee Ka-chiu, previously worked in the banking industry and later opened a kindergarten in Mainland China, reported to hold British nationality.

description.zh-cn: 保安局的前身为1941年4月设立并专责香港防务的机构，1973年5月由防卫科改称而来。现为香港特别行政区政府的决策局之一，负责维持公共秩序、出入境、海关、监狱、禁毒、纪律部队及内部保安等事务。曾提出《逃犯条例》修订草案，并曾点名批评《明报》刊登的评论文章。
description.en: The Security Bureau's predecessor was established in April 1941, responsible for Hong Kong's defense, and was renamed from the Defence Branch in May 1973. It is now one of the policy bureaus of the Hong Kong SAR government, responsible for public order, immigration, customs, prisons, drug control, disciplined services, and internal security. It previously proposed the extradition bill amendment and publicly criticized a commentary published in Ming Pao.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任入境事务处处长、保安局副局长及保安局局长。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, former Director of Immigration, Under Secretary for Security, and Secretary for Security.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区候选人资格审查委员会
香港特别行政区维护国家安全委员会
en: Committee for Safeguarding National Security of Hong Kong
Committee for Safeguarding National Security of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description.zh-cn: 根据《香港国安法》由香港特区政府成立的机构，负责香港特区维护国家安全事务，由行政长官担任主席。
description.en: An body established by the HKSAR Government under the National Security Law, responsible for national security affairs in the HKSAR and chaired by the Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 由时任美国总统特朗普签署的行政命令，旨在应对香港局势，并授权对相关中国内地及香港官员实施制裁。
description.en: An executive order signed by then-U.S. President Trump concerning the situation in Hong Kong, authorizing sanctions against relevant mainland China and Hong Kong officials.

en: United States Department of the Treasury

description.zh-cn: 美国的联邦行政部门，负责管理美国联邦政府的财政事务，并执行对损害香港自治的中港官员的制裁。
description.en: An executive department of the U.S. federal government, responsible for managing its financial affairs and for implementing sanctions against Chinese and Hong Kong officials who undermine Hong Kong's autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 源自美国的全球最大视频分享网站，于2006年被Google收购，现为Google子公司。
description.en: The world's largest video-sharing website, acquired by Google in 2006.

zh-cn: 2022年香港特别行政区行政长官选举

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区举行的第六届行政长官选举，李家超是唯一的候选人并以超过99%的支持票当选。
description.en: The sixth Chief Executive election held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, where John Lee was the sole candidate and was elected with over 99% of the support votes.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲联盟的立法机构，同时是其下议院和唯一直接民选机构。该机构曾于1996年授予魏京生萨哈罗夫奖，并在2023年将萨哈罗夫奖追授给玛莎·阿米尼和“女性、生命、自由”运动，同时通过决议谴责伊朗政府。
description.en: The legislative body of the European Union, also its lower house and the only directly elected institution. It awarded the Sakharov Prize to Wei Jingsheng in 1996, and posthumously awarded the 2023 Sakharov Prize to Mahsa Amini and the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement, while also passing a resolution condemning the Iranian government.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的一所天主教男子中学，由耶稣会主办。
description.en: A Catholic all-boys secondary school in Hong Kong, run by the Society of Jesus.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚的一所公立大学。
description.en: A public university in Australia.

description.zh-cn: 泰国总理
乌克兰外交部长
新加坡籍律师，现任世界知识产权组织总干事及国际植物新品种保护联盟秘书长。曾任新加坡知识产权局负责人和新加坡政府贸易律师。
description.en: Singaporean lawyer, current Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization and Secretary-General of the International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants. Formerly served as the head of the Intellectual Property Office of Singapore and a trade lawyer for the Singaporean government.

description.zh-cn: 《体坛周报》记者及篮球评论员
中国主持人
中华人民共和国的国家电视台，2018年并入新组建的中央广播电视总台。崔永元和芮成钢都曾在此工作，该台也播出了王林清的电视认罪画面。
description.en: China's national television broadcaster. In 2018, it was merged into the newly established China Media Group. Cui Yongyuan and Rui Chenggang formerly worked here, and the station also broadcasted Wang Linqing's televised confession.

zh-cn: 中华全国新闻工作者协会

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党领导的、中国新闻界唯一的全国性人民团体。
description.en: The sole national people's organization in the Chinese journalism industry, led by the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 柴静的自传性作品
西班牙的一座城市，是波士顿的友好城市之一。
description.en: A city in Spain, one of Boston's sister cities.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文之父，商人。

en: London School of Economics and Political Science

description.zh-cn: 由时任中华民国总统李登辉于1999年提出的关于海峡两岸关系的论述，认为中华民国与中华人民共和国是两个对等的国家。
description.en: A discourse on cross-strait relations proposed by then-President Lee Teng-hui in 1999, positing that the Republic of China and the People's Republic of China are two equal states.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国有关海峡两岸关系事务的主管机关，成立于1991年1月，专责统筹处理涉及中国大陆与港澳地区之政务。该机构的前身是行政院于1988年8月以任务编组方式成立，负责协调各主管机关处理两岸事务的机构。
description.en: The competent authority of the Republic of China (Taiwan) for cross-strait affairs, established in January 1991, responsible for coordinating and handling government affairs involving Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Macau. Its predecessor was a task force established by the Executive Yuan in August 1988, responsible for coordinating cross-strait affairs among various government agencies.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国及台湾政治人物，中国国民党籍。他现任立法院院长，曾任高雄市市长。其当选受益于民众党在第二轮投票中的弃权。他曾公开对罢免泛蓝阵营的行动表示反对，并发表过被认为影射其政策的“禽兽说”。在担任台北农产运销公司总经理期间，因2016年菜价高涨事件被段宜康指控为“菜虫”，引发激烈争论。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and member of the Kuomintang. He is the incumbent President of the Legislative Yuan, a position he attained with the Taiwan People's Party's abstention in the second round of voting. He previously served as the mayor of Kaohsiung. He publicly expressed opposition to recall efforts targeting the Pan-Blue camp and once made a "beast" comment, widely seen as an allusion to his policies. While serving as the general manager of the Taipei Agricultural Products Marketing Corporation, he was accused of being a 'vegetable worm' (profiteer) during the 2016 vegetable price hike, leading to a heated dispute.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任中华民国副总统。

zh-cn: 国家安全会议 (中华民国)
动员戡乱时期国家安全会议

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统决定国家安全有关大政方针之咨询机关。
一个描述1992年两岸两会香港会谈中就“一个中国”原则达成的共识的政治术语，其核心是“一个中国，各自表述”。
description.en: A political term describing the outcome of the 1992 cross-strait talks, its core being 'One China, with respective interpretations'.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾的中华民国首都及直辖市。这里是古龙逝世的地点，潘晓颖命案的案发地点，也是叶蒨文的出生地，中国文化大学校本部所在地，同时也是吴石进行情报工作并被捕之处。
description.en: A direct-controlled municipality and the capital of the Republic of China, located in Taiwan. It is the place where Gu Long passed away, the location of the Poon Hiu-wing murder case, the birthplace of Sally Yeh, the main campus of Chinese Culture University, and also where Wu Shi conducted intelligence work and was arrested.

description.zh-cn: 前立陶宛总统。
欧盟执委会副主席兼联盟外交与安全政策高级代表。
俄罗斯国防部长。
中国山东省下辖的地级市，为吴梦起的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Shandong Province, China, and the birthplace of Wu Mengqi.

zh-cn: 俄罗斯总参谋部军事学院
苏联总参谋部军事学院
en: Military Academy of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Russia
Military Academy of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the USSR

zh-cn: 中国共产党厦门市委员会
厦门市军事管制委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在厦门市的地方组织。在文化大革命期间，它曾是一个军事管制机构，并在厦门市革命委员会成立前行使权力。
description.en: The local organization of the Communist Party of China in Xiamen City. During the Cultural Revolution, it served as a military control commission and exercised power before the establishment of the Xiamen Municipal Revolutionary Committee.

zh-cn: 厦门市人民代表大会常务委员会

description.zh-cn: 厦门市人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing body of the Xiamen Municipal People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议天津市委员会
en: Tianjin Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在天津市的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Tianjin.

nodes.id: BAIDU:中国共产党泉州市委员会

zh-cn: 中国共产党泉州市委员会

location.zh-cn: 北京市东城区雍和宫大街

description.zh-cn: 雍和宫位于北京市，是一座藏传佛教格鲁派寺院。最初为清朝雍正皇帝的府邸，后改为寺院。占地66000平方米，是北京最大的藏传佛教寺院。值得一提的是，这里也是乾隆帝的出生地。
description.en: Yonghegong Lamasery, located in Beijing, is a Tibetan Buddhist monastery of the Gelug school. It was originally the residence of the Yongzheng Emperor of the Qing Dynasty and was later converted into a monastery. Covering an area of 66,000 square meters, it is the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Beijing. Notably, it is also the birthplace of Emperor Qianlong.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝逝世地。
清朝第七位皇帝，乾隆帝第十五子，其母为孝仪纯皇后，道光帝的父亲。他也是清军入关后的第五位皇帝。在位期间，他赐死了和珅，并多次对丰绅殷德进行惩罚和任命。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Qing dynasty, 15th son of the Qianlong Emperor, and father of the Daoguang Emperor. His mother was Empress Xiaoyichun. He was also the fifth emperor after the Qing conquest. During his reign, he ordered the death of Heshen and repeatedly punished and appointed Fengshen Yinde.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝的嫡妻（第一任皇后）。
description.en: The first empress consort of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝乾隆帝第二任皇后
乾隆帝的皇贵妃，嘉庆帝的生母，后被追赠为皇后。
description.en: An imperial noble consort of the Qianlong Emperor, the biological mother of the Jiaqing Emperor, and was posthumously honored as an empress.

description.zh-cn: 庄亲王，雍正帝遗命的辅政大臣之一。
果亲王，雍正帝遗命的辅政大臣之一。
清朝康熙、雍正、乾隆三朝重臣，曾任军机大臣、大学士，雍正帝遗命辅政大臣之一。
description.en: A high-ranking official who served the Kangxi, Yongzheng, and Qianlong emperors. He served as a Grand Councillor and Grand Secretary, and was one of the regents appointed by Emperor Yongzheng's will.

description.zh-cn: 雍正时期，统治者为打击政治异己而发动的、迫害知识分子的政治运动，属于中国古代因言论或著作对文人进行政治迫害的事件。此类政治迫害在清朝乾隆时期达到顶峰。
description.en: A political campaign launched by rulers during the Yongzheng era to suppress political dissent and persecute intellectuals. It falls under the category of political persecutions against scholars for their writings in ancient China, a phenomenon that peaked during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty.

zh-cn: 第一代马戛尔尼伯爵乔治·马戛尔尼

description.zh-cn: 英国外交官，马加尔尼使团的领导者。他于1793年率领使团访华，并与乾隆帝会面。
description.en: A British diplomat and the leader of the Macartney Embassy. He led the mission to China in 1793 and met with the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝中期名将、重臣。
清朝中期名将、重臣。
东晋书法家。
东晋书法家王献之的作品。
乾隆帝皇二子，被密立为皇太子。
乾隆帝皇长子。
乾隆帝在位时期十次重大军事行动的总称。
铁法矿务局纪委书记
铁法市公安局副局长
重庆市人民政府下设主管全市公安工作的职能部门。
description.en: The functional department under the Chongqing Municipal People's Government responsible for public security work throughout the city.

description.zh-cn: 原重庆市公安局常务局长、副局长、司法局局长，在薄熙来发起的“打黑”运动中被查处并判处死刑。
description.en: Former Executive Deputy Director, Deputy Director of the Chongqing Public Security Bureau, and Director of the Justice Bureau, who was investigated and sentenced to death during the 'strike black' campaign initiated by Bo Xilai.

en: Consulate General of the United States, Chengdu

description.zh-cn: 美国曾在中国成都设立的总领事馆，于2020年7月被中国政府要求关闭，作为对美国关闭中国驻休斯敦总领事馆的报复措施。
description.en: The former Consulate General of the United States in Chengdu, China, which was ordered to close by the Chinese government in July 2020 in retaliation for the U.S. closure of the Chinese Consulate General in Houston.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重庆市的最高地方行政机关。
description.en: The highest local administrative organ of Chongqing, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军军医大学

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、经济学者。他曾任中共重庆市委副书记、重庆市人民政府市长，并在薄熙来主政重庆期间长期担任市长一职。他还是全国人大财经委员会副主任委员。在重庆任内，因其在经济发展和房价控制方面的表现而知名，是重庆经济发展的重要人物。
description.en: A Chinese politician and economist. He served as Deputy Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China and Mayor of Chongqing for a long time during Bo Xilai's tenure. He also held the position of Vice Chairman of the Finance and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress. During his time in Chongqing, he was known for his performance in economic development and housing price control, and was a key figure in the city's economic progress.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共重庆市委常委兼政法委书记
时任重庆市公安局副局长。
1929年10月29日发生在美国的股票市场崩溃事件，被认为是引发大萧条的开端和标志。
美国推行的贸易保护主义法案，提高了关税，被认为加剧了全球贸易崩溃和大萧条。
美国总统富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福为应对大萧条而实施的一系列经济政策。
description.en: A series of economic programs enacted by Roosevelt in response to the Great Depression.

description.zh-cn: 一种货币制度，其僵化被认为是导致大萧条蔓延的原因之一。
由约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯提出的经济理论，主张政府干预以刺激经济。
一种经济理论，认为货币供给是影响经济活动的最主要因素。
一种经济学派，对大萧条的成因有其独特的解释。
纳粹主义是德国纳粹党的极权主义意识形态，在大萧条和复仇主义情绪的推动下兴起，最终导致了魏玛共和国的倒台。它具体表现为与纳粹党相关的意识形态和实践。
description.en: Nazism is the totalitarian ideology of the Nazi Party in Germany. It emerged, fueled by the Great Depression and revanchist sentiments, leading to the downfall of the Weimar Republic. It was specifically manifested as the ideology and practices associated with the Nazi Party.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大是一个位于北美洲北部的联邦制、君主立宪制及议会制国家，亦是英联邦和法语国家及地区国际组织的成员。知名艺人叶蒨文幼时随家人移民并持有其国籍。近期，加拿大政府谴责伊朗镇压示威，并对伊朗道德警察及其他官员实施了制裁。
description.en: Canada is a federal, constitutional monarchy and parliamentary country located in northern North America, and is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations and the Organisation internationale de la Francophonie. Famous artist Sally Yeh immigrated here with her family as a child and holds its citizenship. Recently, its government condemned Iran's crackdown on protests and imposed sanctions on Iran's morality police and other officials.

description.zh-cn: 大洋洲国家。其联邦政府于2021年废除了维多利亚州与中国签订的“一带一路”协议。邓亮洪曾在此寻求政治庇护。
description.en: An Oceanian country. Its federal government abolished the "Belt and Road" agreement signed by Victoria with China in 2021. Tang Liang Hong once sought political asylum here.

description.zh-cn: 美国的中央银行系统，在威尔逊总统任内通过《联邦储备法案》而建立。
description.en: The central banking system of the United States, created during the presidency of Woodrow Wilson with the enactment of the Federal Reserve Act.

zh-cn: 国家社会主义德国工人党
国家社会主义德意志劳工党

description.zh-cn: 美国第31任总统，在大萧条开始时就任，并在1932年选举中被罗斯福击败。
description.en: 31st President of the United States, defeated by Roosevelt in the 1932 election.

description.zh-cn: 英国经济学家，凯恩斯主义的创始人。
美国经济学家、统计学家，货币主义的代表人物，芝加哥经济学派的领军人物，1976年诺贝尔经济学奖得主。
description.en: An American economist and statistician, a leading figure of monetarism, a leader of the Chicago school of economics, and the 1976 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences laureate.

description.zh-cn: 日本大藏大臣，采取凯恩斯主义政策使日本较早摆脱萧条。
奥地利裔德国政治人物，纳粹党领袖，1933年至1945年间担任德国总理和元首。作为第二次世界大战的发动者和墨索里尼在二战中的主要盟友，其崛起与大萧条密切相关。1944年盟军接近巴黎时，他曾下令摧毁埃菲尔铁塔及城市。
description.en: Austrian-born German politician and leader of the Nazi Party, who served as Chancellor and Führer of Germany from 1933 to 1945. As the initiator of World War II and Mussolini's main ally, his rise was closely linked to the Great Depression. In 1944, as the Allies approached Paris, he ordered the destruction of the Eiffel Tower and the city.

description.zh-cn: 美国经济学家，提出了债务紧缩理论。
奥地利经济学派代表人物，著有《美国大萧条》。
18世纪欧洲的思想解放运动，其思想助长了法国大革命的阶级意识。
法国大革命在此会议中爆发。
在拿破仑战争之前的一系列欧洲冲突，神圣罗马帝国卷入其中，开始了其最终的衰落。
description.en: A series of European conflicts preceding the Napoleonic Wars, in which the Holy Roman Empire became involved, beginning its final decline.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间，由罗伯斯庇尔领导的雅各宾派（山岳派）主导的专制统治时期。以救国委员会和治安委员会为核心，通过革命法庭等机构对“革命的敌人”进行大规模镇压和处决。
description.en: During the French Revolution, this was a period of despotic rule led by Robespierre and the Jacobins (Montagnards). Centered around the Committee of Public Safety and the Committee of General Security, it conducted mass suppression and executions of 'enemies of the revolution' through institutions like the Revolutionary Tribunal.

description.zh-cn: 由拿破仑统治下的法国及其盟国与其他欧洲国家之间的一系列战争，最终导致了神圣罗马帝国的崩溃。
description.en: A series of wars between France under Napoleon and its allies against other European nations, which ultimately led to the collapse of the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 旧制度下法国社会中除教士和贵族外的其他所有人，主要是平民和资产阶级。
第三等级代表在网球场宣誓，国民议会将续存至法国宪法建立为止。
由第三等级自行成立的议会，后改称国民制宪议会。
法国大革命的标志性事件。
指法国大革命前的社会和政治制度，以君主专制和封建等级为特征。
路易十六时期的法国财政总监。

zh-cn: 马克西米连·罗伯斯比尔
马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期山岳派及雅各宾派的领袖，救国委员会的核心成员，雅各宾专政的主要推动者，最终在热月政变中被推翻并处决。
description.en: A leader of the Montagnards and Jacobins during the French Revolution, a key member of the Committee of Public Safety, and the main driver of the Reign of Terror. He was ultimately overthrown and executed in the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 反对罗伯斯庇尔独裁的国民公会成员组成的政治派别。
在国民公会解散后成立的行政机构，掌握法兰西第一共和国的行政权力。
description.en: The executive body established after the dissolution of the National Convention, which held the executive power of the French First Republic.

zh-cn: 玛丽-安东妮‧约瑟芬‧珍妮‧德‧哈布斯堡-洛林
en: Maria Antonia Josepha Johanna von Habsburg-Lothringen

description.zh-cn: 奥地利女大公，路易十六的王后，通过婚姻成为法国和纳瓦拉的末代王后。她在法国大革命期间被推翻，并被革命法庭判处叛国罪，最终被送上断头台。
description.en: Archduchess of Austria who became the last Queen of France and Navarre through her marriage to Louis XVI. She was overthrown during the French Revolution, convicted of high treason by the Revolutionary Tribunal, and executed by guillotine.

description.zh-cn: 统治法国的君主王朝，在法国大革命中被推翻。
法国大革命时期由普选产生的一院制国会，它取代了国民立法议会，掌握立法与行政权力，并宣告了法兰西第一共和国的成立。
description.en: The unicameral assembly during the French Revolution, elected by universal suffrage. It replaced the National Legislative Assembly, held both legislative and executive powers, and proclaimed the French First Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间的政治派别，代表工商业资产阶级利益。作为国民公会内的右翼政治派别，与山岳派对立，后在1793年6月2日的暴动中被清除出国民公会。
description.en: A political faction during the French Revolution, representing the interests of the industrial and commercial bourgeoisie. It was a right-wing faction within the National Convention, opposed to the Montagnards, and subsequently purged from the Convention in the insurrection of June 2, 1793.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的政治家。最初是山岳派的创始领袖之一，后转变为温和派（丹东派）的代表人物。最终被救国委员会视为威胁而处决。
description.en: A politician during the French Revolution. Initially one of the founding leaders of the Montagnards, he later became a representative figure of the moderate faction (Dantonists). He was eventually executed by the Committee of Public Safety as a threat.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期政治家，埃贝尔派领袖，后被罗伯斯庇尔处决。
国民公会内部发动的政变，推翻了罗伯斯庇尔及其政治盟友的统治，结束了雅各宾专政。
description.en: A coup d'état within the National Convention that overthrew the rule of Robespierre and his political allies, ending the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑·波拿巴发动的政变，结束了督政府的统治，标志着法国大革命的结束。
欧洲君主制国家为对抗法国大革命及拿破仑而组成的军事同盟。
由梁启超提出的政治概念，指有虚位君主的共和政体，类似于君主立宪制。
description.en: A political concept proposed by Liang Qichao, referring to a republican form of government with a nominal monarch, similar to a constitutional monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党内部对改革开放持保留或反对态度的政治派别。在八六学潮后，该派系将学潮归咎于胡耀邦的纵容，并成功施压使其下台。
description.en: A political faction within the Communist Party of China. After the 1986 student demonstrations, this faction blamed the protests on Hu Yaobang's leniency and successfully pressured him into resigning.

description.zh-cn: 由萨丁尼亚王国主导成立，完成了意大利统一，并于1870年攻占罗马，终结了教宗国。在第一次世界大战中，于1915年加入协约国。在墨索里尼统治时期（1922-1943），该国成为第二次世界大战的欧洲轴心国，是日本的盟友。于1941年承认汪精卫国民政府，并在珍珠港事件后于1941年12月11日对美国宣战。
description.en: The state founded under the leadership of the Kingdom of Sardinia that completed the unification of Italy and ended the Papal States by capturing Rome in 1870. It joined the Entente Powers in 1915 during World War I. Under Mussolini's rule (1922-1943), it became a European Axis power in World War II and an ally of Japan. It recognized the Wang Jingwei regime in 1941 and declared war on the United States on December 11, 1941, following the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 意大利政治家、记者，国家法西斯党领袖，法西斯主义创始人。他于1922年至1943年担任意大利王国首相，期间代表意大利王国签署了《拉特兰条约》，并于1943年至1945年担任意大利社会共和国的国家元首。
description.en: Italian politician and journalist who founded and led the National Fascist Party. He was Prime Minister of Italy from 1922 to 1943, during which he signed the Lateran Treaty on behalf of Italy, and Duce of the Italian Social Republic from 1943 to 1945.

zh-cn: 莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约

description.zh-cn: 德国与苏联签署的互不侵犯条约，秘密划分了在东欧的势力范围。
轴心国入侵苏联的军事行动代号。
第二次世界大战期间苏联与纳粹德国及其盟国之间发生的战争。
description.en: The war between the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany and its allies during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 由协约国与德国签订，正式结束第一次世界大战的和平条约。条约内容不仅包含建立国际联盟和对德国施加的严厉条款，其中关于山东问题的条款也引发了中国的五四运动。
description.en: The most important peace treaty signed between the Allied Powers and Germany that officially brought World War I to an end. It included the covenant for the League of Nations, and its clauses concerning the Shandong Problem also triggered the May Fourth Movement in China.

description.zh-cn: 德国、意大利和日本签署的军事同盟条约。
西班牙国民军领袖，后成为西班牙独裁者。
德国并吞奥地利的事件。
1918年至1992年间存在的中欧国家。
description.en: A Central European country that existed from 1918 to 1992.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国及其合作者针对约六百万欧洲犹太人的种族灭绝。
由中国政府出资成立，为“一带一路”相关项目提供融资支持的基金。

zh-cn: 推进“一带一路”建设工作领导小组
国家推进“一带一路”建设工作领导小组
en: Belt and Road Construction Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 为推进“一带一路”建设而成立的中国国家级议事协调机构。
“一带一路”的枢纽和旗舰项目，涉及中国与巴基斯坦之间的一系列大型工程计划。
一种对“一带一路”倡议的批评性观点，认为中国通过提供巨额贷款使受援国陷入债务危机，以获取其战略资产或政治影响力。
印度是位于南亚印度次大陆上的国家，是世界人口第一大国和世界第五大经济体。该国拥有核武器，并被视为潜在的超级大国之一。印度与中华人民共和国存在边界争议，并因中巴经济走廊穿越其主权争议地区，多次反对“一带一路”倡议。印度也是金砖国家创始成员国。
description.en: India is a country in South Asia on the Indian subcontinent, the world's most populous country and the fifth-largest economy. It is a recognized nuclear-weapon state and considered one of the potential superpowers. India has border disputes with the People's Republic of China and has repeatedly opposed the 'Belt and Road' Initiative due to the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor passing through its disputed territories. India is also a founding member of BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲国家，欧盟创始成员国之一，梵蒂冈城邦位于其首都罗马市内。曾是七国集团中首个加入“一带一路”倡议的国家，但于2023年宣布退出。
description.en: A European country and an EU founding member, within whose capital, Rome, Vatican City is located. It was the first G7 country to join the 'Belt and Road Initiative', but announced its withdrawal in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 东南亚国家。与中华人民共和国在南海诸岛存在主权争议。该国于2023年10月宣布退出“一带一路”倡议。此外，2002年李鹏访问前夕，当地华侨曾刊登《李鹏下台嵌字诗》以示“欢迎”。
description.en: A Southeast Asian country. It has sovereignty disputes with the People's Republic of China over the South China Sea Islands and announced its withdrawal from the 'Belt and Road' initiative in October 2023. Additionally, in 2002, on the eve of Li Peng's visit, local overseas Chinese published the 'Li Peng step down acrostic poem' as a form of 'welcome'.

description.zh-cn: 由中国公司承建的马来西亚铁路项目，是“一带一路”倡议的一部分，曾被马哈迪政府要求重新谈判。

zh-cn: 吉隆坡—新加坡高速铁路

description.zh-cn: 连接马来西亚吉隆坡和新加坡的高速铁路项目，曾被马哈迪政府宣布取消后又推迟。
美国企业家、投资者、软件工程师、慈善家。他与保罗·艾伦共同创建微软公司，曾任董事长、CEO和首席软件设计师。他也是“一带一路”计划的明确支持者，并将屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖列为2015年的好消息之一。
description.en: American entrepreneur, investor, software engineer, and philanthropist. He co-founded Microsoft Corporation with Paul Allen, serving as its chairman, CEO, and chief software architect. He is also a clear supporter of the 'Belt and Road' initiative and listed Tu Youyou's Nobel Prize win as one of the good news stories of 2015.

description.zh-cn: 连接中国、吉尔吉斯斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦的铁路项目，被视为共建“一带一路”的旗舰工程。

en: Imperial Edict of the Abdication of the Qing Emperor
Imperial Edict of the Abdication of the Xuantong Emperor

description.zh-cn: 由隆裕太后代表宣统帝溥仪颁布，标志着清朝的正式灭亡和中国帝制的结束。
description.en: Issued by Empress Dowager Longyu on behalf of the Xuantong Emperor Puyi, marking the official end of the Qing dynasty and imperial rule in China.

description.zh-cn: 由孙中山于1894年创立的中国近代第一个革命团体。其部分成员及力量曾支持自立军起义，后与其他革命团体合并成立中国同盟会。
description.en: The first modern Chinese revolutionary group, founded by Sun Yat-sen in 1894. Some of its members and forces supported the Self-Support Army Uprising, and it later merged with other revolutionary groups to form the Tongmenghui.

zh-cn: 中华民国军政府鄂军都督府
中华民国政府湖北都督府

description.zh-cn: 清末大臣，曾任四川总督。在保路运动中，他采取强硬镇压手段，于1911年9月7日诱捕运动领袖并下令开枪，制造“成都血案”，激化了矛盾。
description.en: A late Qing official who served as the Viceroy of Sichuan. During the Railway Protection Movement, he adopted harsh repressive measures, arresting its leaders and ordering troops to fire on protesters on September 7, 1911, creating the 'Chengdu Massacre' and escalating the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 民国初年，由清朝宗室、满蒙贵族及遗老组成的政治团体。他们主张君主立宪，并试图恢复清朝统治以反对共和，是张勋复辟的策划和支持力量。
description.en: In the early years of the Republic of China, this political group was formed by members of the Qing imperial clan, Manchu-Mongol nobility, and former Qing officials. They advocated for a constitutional monarchy, attempted to restore Qing rule, opposed republicanism, and were the planners and supporters of Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration.

description.zh-cn: 清末宗社党领袖之一，东京振武学校校友。他被革命党人彭家珍刺杀，有观点认为袁世凯是幕后策划者。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Royalist Party in the late Qing Dynasty and an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. He was assassinated by the revolutionary Peng Jiazhen, with some believing Yuan Shikai was the mastermind.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命期间，南方革命政府与北方清政府之间的和平谈判。章宗祥作为唐绍仪的随从参与其中。
description.en: Peace negotiations between the southern revolutionary government and the northern Qing government during the Xinhai Revolution. Zhang Zongxiang participated as an attendant to Tang Shaoyi.

en: Provisional Constitution of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的第一部宪法性质的法律，确立了内阁制。
description.en: The first constitutional law of the Republic of China, which established a cabinet system.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的军事同盟，主要由法国、英国、俄罗斯帝国、美国等国组成。

zh-cn: 同盟国 (第一次世界大战)

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战期间，与协约国对敌的军事同盟，主要由德意志帝国、奥匈帝国、奥斯曼帝国等国组成。
description.en: A military alliance during World War I that fought against the Entente Powers, primarily consisting of the German Empire, Austria-Hungary, and the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 一个由土耳其人建立的帝国，其扩张促进了伊斯兰教的传播，也是最后一个哈里发国。它也是同盟国的主要成员国之一。
description.en: An empire founded by Turkish tribes whose expansion facilitated the spread of Islam and which was the last caliphate. It was also one of the main member states of the Central Powers.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国是一个存在于1867年至1918年间的中欧二元君主国，由奥地利帝国和匈牙利王国组成，也是同盟国的主要成员国之一。弗朗茨·斐迪南是其皇储，梅耶林惨案发生于该国。
description.en: Austria-Hungary was a dual monarchy in Central Europe from 1867 to 1918, consisting of the Austrian Empire and the Kingdom of Hungary, and was one of the main member states of the Central Powers. Franz Ferdinand was its heir presumptive, and the Mayerling incident took place there.

zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公及其妻子苏菲·霍特科遇刺案
en: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria and Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg

description.zh-cn: 指奥匈帝国皇储弗朗茨·斐迪南大公夫妇在萨拉热窝被刺杀的事件，此事件成为第一次世界大战的导火线。
description.en: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, and his wife in Sarajevo. This event was the immediate cause of World War I.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·路德维希大公的长子，在其父放弃继承权后成为奥匈帝国推定继承人，后于萨拉热窝被刺杀，引发第一次世界大战。
description.en: The eldest son of Archduke Karl Ludwig. He became the heir presumptive to the Austro-Hungarian throne after his father renounced his rights. His assassination in Sarajevo triggered World War I.

description.zh-cn: 青年波斯尼亚成员、塞尔维亚民族主义者，于1914年6月28日在萨拉热窝刺杀了弗朗茨·斐迪南大公及其妻子苏菲，引发了萨拉热窝事件。
description.en: A member of Young Bosnia and a Serbian nationalist, who assassinated Archduke Franz Ferdinand and his wife Sophie on June 28, 1914, in Sarajevo, triggering the Sarajevo incident.

description.zh-cn: 协约国成员国之一。
description.en: A member state of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 德国在第一次世界大战期间采取的军事策略，即潜艇可以攻击任何驶往敌国的商船、油轮或客轮。该策略计划于1917年2月1日开始实施。它最终促使美国参战，齐默尔曼电报也是在此背景下发出，旨在应对美国可能因此参战的情况。
description.en: A type of naval warfare adopted by Germany during World War I, where submarines would sink vessels such as freighters, tankers, or passenger ships traveling to enemy nations without warning. This military strategy was planned to commence on February 1, 1917. It became a key factor in the United States' decision to enter the war, with the Zimmermann Telegram being sent in this context to prepare for potential U.S. involvement.

description.zh-cn: 德国外交部于1917年1月17日发出的秘密外交通信，提议德意志帝国与墨西哥在美国对德宣战的情况下结成军事同盟。该电报被英国情报机关截获并破译，其内容的曝光是促使美国加入第一次世界大战的关键因素之一。
description.en: A secret diplomatic communication issued by the German Foreign Office on January 17, 1917, proposing a military alliance between the German Empire and Mexico in the event that the United States entered World War I against Germany. The telegram was intercepted and deciphered by British intelligence, and its public disclosure was one of the key factors that led to the United States' entry into the war.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国在第一次世界大战末期发生的一系列事件，导致霍亨索伦王朝被推翻，并建立了魏玛共和国。
description.en: A series of events in the German Empire at the end of World War I, which resulted in the overthrow of the House of Hohenzollern and the establishment of the Weimar Republic.

description.zh-cn: 标志第一次世界大战结束的停战协定。由于国内爆发革命，德国被迫接受严苛的停火条件。
description.en: The armistice that marked the end of World War I. Germany was forced to accept harsh ceasefire terms due to the revolution within the country.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战结束后，战胜国为解决战争遗留问题及奠定战后和平而召开的会议。会上制定了《凡尔赛条约》并筹建了国际联盟，其关于山东问题的决议直接引发了中国的五四运动。
description.en: A conference convened by the victorious Allied Powers after World War I to address issues arising from the war and establish post-war peace. It resulted in the Treaty of Versailles and the creation of the League of Nations, and its resolution on the Shandong Problem directly triggered the May Fourth Movement in China.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战后成立的国际组织，旨在维护世界和平，不承认满洲国的合法性。由伍德罗·威尔逊大力倡导，但美国最终未能加入。中国曾就九一八事变向其提出申诉，但该组织未能有效制止日本的侵略。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization founded as a result of the Paris Peace Conference after World War I, aiming to maintain world peace and not recognize the legitimacy of Manchukuo. It was strongly advocated for by Woodrow Wilson, though the United States never joined. China appealed to it regarding the Mukden Incident, but it failed to effectively stop Japanese aggression.

description.zh-cn: 同盟国的主要成员国之一。
description.en: One of the main member states of the Allies.

location.zh-cn: 苏联乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国普里皮亚特

description.zh-cn: 1986年4月26日发生在苏联乌克兰普里皮亚季市切尔诺贝利核电站的核反应堆破损事故，是历史上最严重的核电事故，被国际核事件分级表评为最高的第七级事件。
description.en: A catastrophic nuclear accident that occurred on 26 April 1986 at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant in Pripyat, Ukrainian SSR, Soviet Union. It is the worst nuclear power plant accident in history and is one of only two nuclear energy accidents rated at seven—the maximum severity—on the International Nuclear Event Scale.

zh-cn: 兹比格涅夫·布热津斯基

description.zh-cn: 美国战略家，认为美国在苏联解体中发挥了核心作用。
冷战期间美苏两国在军事力量上的竞赛。
苏联于1979年对阿富汗的军事入侵所引发的战争，此次入侵导致了缓和政策的终结和新冷战的开始。
description.en: The war triggered by the Soviet Union's military invasion of Afghanistan in 1979, which led to the end of détente and the beginning of a new phase of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 前苏联加盟共和国，于1990年3月11日率先宣布独立。
时任苏联副总统，八一九事件的主要领导者。
由部分前苏联共和国组成的区域性国际组织，旨在取代旧苏联的架构。
description.en: A regional intergovernmental organization composed of some post-Soviet republics, aimed at replacing the old Soviet structure.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯总理，与叶利钦共同推行“休克疗法”。
苏联解体后俄罗斯实行的一种激进经济改革政策。
时任南疆军区司令员，战争期间任康西瓦前线指挥所司令员。
时任印度国防部长。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军南疆军区
中国人民解放军陆军第八十三集团军
中国人民解放军陆军第五十四集团军
en: 54th Group Army of the PLA Ground Force
54th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 曾是中国人民解放军中部战区陆军下辖的集团军之一，后改编为第八十三集团军。
description.en: Formerly one of the group armies under the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force, it was later reorganized into the 83rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 1959年在西藏地区发生的武装冲突事件。
description.en: An armed conflict that occurred in the Tibet region in 1959.

description.zh-cn: 1962年冷战时期在美国、苏联与古巴之间爆发的一场极其严重的政治、军事危机。肯尼迪总统曾就此咨询艾森豪威尔。
description.en: A major confrontation in 1962 that brought the United States and the Soviet Union close to war over the presence of Soviet nuclear-armed missiles in Cuba. President Kennedy consulted Eisenhower during the crisis.

zh-cn: 约翰·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪

description.zh-cn: 第35任美国总统，1961年至1963年任职，任内处理了古巴导弹危机等重大事件，1963年11月22日在达拉斯遇刺身亡。
description.en: The 35th President of the United States, serving from 1961 until his assassination in 1963. His presidency included handling major events like the Cuban Missile Crisis. He was assassinated on November 22, 1963, in Dallas.

birth_place.zh-cn: 布鲁克莱恩 (马萨诸塞州)

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家安全部
en: Ministry of State Security of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管国家安全的组成部门，参与联合颁布了《人民警察选升警衔的暂行办法》。
description.en: A component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China in charge of national security, which participated in the joint promulgation of the 'Interim Measures for the Selection and Promotion of People's Police Ranks'.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华人民共和国国家安全部副部长。
时任重庆市公安局技术侦察总队总队长、渝北区公安分局局长。

zh-cn: 王立军徇私枉法、叛逃、滥用职权、受贿案

description.zh-cn: 对王立军徇私枉法、叛逃、滥用职权、受贿案的司法审判。

zh-cn: 郭维国、李阳、王鹏飞、王智徇私枉法案
郭维国、李阳、王鹏飞、王智案

description.zh-cn: 对郭维国等四名重庆警官在海伍德死亡案中徇私枉法的司法审判。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任火箭军司令员。

zh-cn: 美国空军中国航空航天研究所
中国人民解放军军事检察院

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的最高检察机关。
description.en: The highest procuratorial organ of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军少将，曾任火箭军装备部部长。
中国人民解放军海军中将，曾任南部战区副司令员兼南部战区海军司令员。
description.en: A vice admiral of the People's Liberation Army Navy, who formerly served as Deputy Commander of the Southern Theater Command and Commander of the Southern Theater Command Navy.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央军委装备发展部副部长。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央军委装备发展部副部长。
中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任空军司令员。
中国人民解放军火箭军中将，曾任火箭军副司令员。
中国人民解放军陆军上将，曾任火箭军政治委员。
曾任中国航天科技集团董事长。
曾任中国兵器工业集团董事长。
曾任中国运载火箭技术研究院院长、长征七号运载火箭总指挥。
中国人民解放军火箭军中将。

zh-cn: 中国运载火箭技术研究院
中华人民共和国航空航天工业部第一研究院
航天工业部第一研究院
en: China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology

description.zh-cn: 该机构是中国航天科技集团下属单位，也是中国运载火箭技术研究院的前身之一。张庆伟曾在此任职副院长，沈辛荪则担任过党委书记和院长。
description.en: This organization is an entity under the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC), and also one of the predecessors of the China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology (CALT). Zhang Qingwei once served as Deputy Director here, while Shen Xinsun held positions as Party Secretary and President.

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党及其领导的中华人民共和国提出的政治目标与军事行动计划，旨在结束中华民国在台湾的统治，实现中国统一。该计划包含“武力统一”和“和平统一”两种策略。
description.en: A political goal and military action plan proposed by the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, aiming to end the rule of the Republic of China in Taiwan and achieve Chinese unification. The plan includes both 'armed unification' and 'peaceful unification' strategies.

zh-cn: 中共十八大后的反腐败
中共十八大以来的反腐败工作
en: Anti-corruption campaign since the 18th CCP National Congress

description.zh-cn: 自2012年中共十八大以来，由习近平领导的中国共产党发起的一系列反腐败行动。该运动导致多位团派高级官员被查处。
description.en: A series of anti-corruption campaigns initiated by the Communist Party of China under the leadership of Xi Jinping since the 18th National Congress in 2012. This movement led to the investigation and removal of several high-ranking officials from the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction).

description.zh-cn: 位于青藏高原与四川盆地之间的地震断裂带，是汶川大地震的主要成因。
地球主要构造板块之一，其向欧亚板块的持续推挤是龙门山断层活动和汶川地震的根本原因。
地球主要构造板块之一。

zh-cn: 卧龙国家级自然保护区
中国大熊猫保护研究中心

description.zh-cn: 位于都江堰玉垒山麓，是为纪念李冰父子而修建的祀庙。在汶川大地震中全部垮塌后重建。
description.en: Located at the foot of Mount Yulei in Dujiangyan, it is a temple built to commemorate Li Bing and his son. It was rebuilt after completely collapsing in the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省的省级国家行政机关。
description.en: The provincial-level state administrative organ of Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆艺术家、社会活动家及异见人士，诗人艾青之子，活跃于建筑、艺术、影像和社会文化评论领域。他曾因调查川震遇难学生名单，其志愿者屡受地方政府扣留。
description.en: A Chinese contemporary artist, activist, and dissident. He is the son of poet Ai Qing and is active in the fields of architecture, art, film, and social and cultural criticism. He is notable for his investigation into the student casualties of the Sichuan earthquake, a process during which his volunteers were repeatedly detained by local authorities.

description.zh-cn: 中国异见人士，因帮助四川大地震死难者家长调查被判刑。
四川作家、维权人士，因致力于调查灾区学校豆腐渣工程并搜集川震遇难学生名单而被判刑。艾未未曾为其出庭作证。
description.en: Sichuanese writer and human rights activist, who was sentenced to prison for his dedication to investigating shoddy school construction in disaster areas and collecting lists of student victims of the Sichuan earthquake. Ai Weiwei testified in court for him.

description.zh-cn: 为悼念汶川大地震遇难者，中国首次为普通民众死难者设立的全国性哀悼活动。
汶川地震形成的最危险的堰塞湖。
时任四川省省长，于2012年宣布灾后重建完成。
1894年朝鲜爆发的农民起义，成为甲午战争的直接导火索。
朝鲜王朝是朝鲜半岛历史上的一个由李成桂建立的统一王朝，也是朝鲜半岛最后一个统一王朝，统治时间为1392年至1897年。它最初亲明，后在丁卯战争中被迫与后金结盟。作为当时朝鲜半岛的统治政权，它名义上是清朝的藩属国，也是战争爆发的核心争端地区。在征韩论时期，它采取锁国政策，并被福泽谕吉在《脱亚论》中视为应与之“绝交”的“恶友”。
description.en: The Joseon Dynasty was a unified dynasty in the history of the Korean Peninsula, founded by Yi Seong-gye, and also its last unified dynasty, ruling from 1392 to 1897. It was initially pro-Ming but was forced into an alliance with the Later Jin after the First Manchu invasion of Korea. As the ruling power on the Korean peninsula at that time, it was nominally a vassal state of the Qing dynasty and a core disputed area for the outbreak of war. During the Seikanron debate, it adopted a policy of isolationism and was regarded by Fukuzawa Yukichi in 'Datsu-A Ron' as a 'bad friend' with whom Japan should break ties.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与日本在甲午战争后签订的不平等条约。该条约迫使中国割让台湾等领土，支付巨额赔款，并丧失多项主权，同时规定重庆成为向日本开放的内陆通商口岸之一。
description.en: An unequal treaty signed between the Qing dynasty and Japan after the First Sino-Japanese War. This treaty forced China to cede territories (including Taiwan), pay huge indemnities, and lose much of its sovereignty. It also stipulated that Chongqing would become one of the inland treaty ports opened to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝建立的现代化海军舰队，于1888年12月17日在威海卫刘公岛正式成立。作为清朝新式海军四支舰队中规模最大、投资最巨者，其实力曾号称亚洲第一。然而，由于多种原因，这支舰队在1894年的甲午战争中全军覆没。
description.en: A modernized naval fleet of the Qing dynasty, officially established on December 17, 1888, at Liugong Island, Weihaiwei. It was the largest and most invested of the four modern fleets of the Qing Navy, once acclaimed as the most powerful in Asia. However, due to various reasons, the fleet was annihilated in the First Sino-Japanese War in 1894.

description.zh-cn: 俄国、德国、法国联合干涉，迫使日本将《马关条约》中割占的辽东半岛归还给中国的事件。
日军在占领旅顺后对城内军民进行的大规模屠杀。
清朝海军将领，北洋水师提督。在甲午战争威海卫之战中兵败后，为国服鸦片自尽殉国。
description.en: A naval officer of the Qing dynasty and the Admiral of the Beiyang Fleet. After being defeated in the Battle of Weihaiwei during the First Sino-Japanese War, he committed suicide by taking opium.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日本山城国京都中山忠能邸

death_place.zh-cn: 东京府东京市明治宫殿

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇是日本第122代天皇，大日本帝国的第一代大元帅。其在位期间，日本从一个孤立的封建国家转变为工业化的世界强国，史称明治维新。作为国家元首，他积极推动军事扩张，名义上是甲午战争和日俄战争期间日军的最高指挥官。他在1889年2月11日签署并公布了《大日本帝国宪法》，对日本的现代化进程具有深远影响。
description.en: Emperor Meiji, the 122nd Emperor of Japan and the first Grand Marshal of the Empire of Japan. During his reign, Japan transformed from an isolated feudal state into an industrialized world power, a period known as the Meiji Restoration. As head of state, he actively promoted military expansion and was the nominal supreme commander of the Japanese military during the First Sino-Japanese War and the Russo-Japanese War. He signed and promulgated the Constitution of the Empire of Japan on February 11, 1889, profoundly impacting Japan's modernization process.

description.zh-cn: 日本近代政治家，明治维新元老，曾四次担任日本内阁总理大臣（亦是首任）。他曾于甲午战争期间担任日本首相，并任首任统监府统监。戊戌政变后，他帮助梁启超成功逃亡至日本。
description.en: Japanese modern politician and Meiji Restoration elder, who served four terms as Prime Minister of Japan (also the first). He served as Prime Minister during the First Sino-Japanese War and was the first Resident-General of Korea. After the Wuxu Coup, he helped Liang Qichao successfully escape to Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，指挥第二军攻陷旅顺并发动旅顺大屠杀。
清朝醇亲王，道光帝第七子，载沣与光绪帝之父。曾负责海军事务，为迎合慈禧太后而挪用海军军费。
description.en: Prince Chun of the Qing Dynasty, the seventh son of the Daoguang Emperor, and the father of Zaifeng and the Guangxu Emperor. He was in charge of naval affairs and misappropriated naval funds to please Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，官至户部尚书、军机大臣，光绪帝的老师。他曾奏准暂停海军购买外洋枪炮船只，被认为是李鸿章的政敌，并阻挠北洋水师的经费拨款。他反对洋务运动，并与奕䜣一同在甲申易枢中被贬，二人政见不合。
description.en: A prominent statesman in the late Qing dynasty, who served as Minister of Revenue and Grand Councilor, and was a tutor to the Guangxu Emperor. He approved the suspension of navy purchases of foreign cannons and ships, was considered a political rival of Li Hongzhang, and obstructed funding for the Beiyang Fleet. He opposed the Self-Strengthening Movement and was demoted along with Yixin in the Jiashen Purge, which highlighted their political differences.

description.zh-cn: 东学党首领，领导了东学党起义。
甲午战争期间，清朝北洋水师与日本联合舰队在黄海大东沟海域进行了一场决定性的大规模海战。此战中，北洋水师损失惨重。
description.en: A decisive, large-scale naval battle during the First Sino-Japanese War between the Qing's Beiyang Fleet and the Japanese Combined Fleet in the Yellow Sea off the mouth of the Yalu River. The Beiyang Fleet suffered heavy losses in this battle.

zh-cn: 海峡两岸服务贸易协议

description.zh-cn: 由海峡两岸关系协会与海峡交流基金会签署的服务贸易协定，旨在开放两岸服务业市场。该协议在立法院的审查争议是太阳花学运的直接导火索。
description.en: A service trade agreement signed by ARATS and SEF, aimed at opening up the service industry markets across the Taiwan Strait. Its controversial review in the Legislative Yuan was the direct trigger of the Sunflower Student Movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍立法委员，曾在国民党立委初选中击败李庆华。在立法院联席会议上宣布《海峡两岸服务贸易协议》视为已审查，直接引发了占领行动。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China who defeated Lee Ching-hua in a KMT legislative primary.

description.zh-cn: 2014年在台湾发生的一场学生与公民运动，是太阳花学运的开端与核心事件，期间示威者占领了立法院议场。
description.en: A student and civic movement in Taiwan in 2014, during which protesters occupied the legislative chamber.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政院院长，下令强制驱离占领行政院的群众。
太阳花学运期间，部分抗议群众转而占领行政院，后遭警方强制驱离。
负责执行驱离占领行政院群众任务的警察机关。
太阳花学运期间发起的大规模集会游行，主办单位宣称有数十万人参与。

zh-cn: 两岸协议监督条例草案

description.zh-cn: 为规范未来两岸协议的签订与审查程序、建立监督两岸协议的法律机制而提出的法律草案，是太阳花学运的核心诉求之一。
description.en: A proposed bill to regulate the signing and review process of future cross-strait agreements, one of the core demands of the Sunflower Student Movement.

zh-cn: 2014年中华民国地方公职人员选举

description.zh-cn: 俗称“九合一选举”，中国国民党在此次选举中遭遇重大挫败，被认为与太阳花学运有关。

zh-cn: 2016年中华民国总统副总统及立法委员选举

description.zh-cn: 此次选举中，民主进步党获得胜利，实现首次完全执政，其结果被认为受到太阳花学运影响。
台湾政党，由林昶佐等人于2015年创立，是受太阳花学运影响而出现的“第三势力”政党。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan, founded in 2015 by Freddy Lim and others, emerging as a 'third force' influenced by the Sunflower Student Movement.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，太阳花学运主要的学生领袖之一。
太阳花学运主要的学生领袖之一。
中华民国政治人物、律师、法律学者。太阳花学运的主要人物与决策核心成员之一。曾为时代力量党员，在2016年立法委员选举中击败李庆华。现任台湾民众党主席、立法委员，并担任立法院党团总召。他曾发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，参与罢免民进党籍民意代表，并在蔡正元的罢免答辩书中被点名批评，后对《公职人员选举罢免法》修正案表示支持。他曾提出修宪废除监察院案。
description.en: A politician, lawyer, and legal scholar of the Republic of China. One of the key figures and core decision-makers of the Sunflower Student Movement. He was formerly a member of the New Power Party and defeated Lee Ching-hua in the 2016 legislative election. He is currently serving as Chairman of the Taiwan People's Party, a Legislative Yuan member, and the caucus convener of the Legislative Yuan party group. He initiated the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign, participating in the recall of DPP representatives. He was also singled out for criticism in Tsai Cheng-yuan's defense statement for the recall and later supported the amendment to the 'Public Officials Election and Recall Act'. He has proposed a constitutional amendment to abolish the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 由多个公民团体组成的联盟，是发起太阳花学运的主要组织之一。
由各校学运社团组成的学生团体，是发起太阳花学运的主要组织之一。
太阳花学运核心人物之一，因被控在占领行政院事件中煽惑他人犯罪而受审。
中华民国的二级普通法院之一，院本部位于台北市，组织上直属司法院，审级上以最高法院为上级审法院。设有台中、台南、高雄、花莲四所分院。负责审理太阳花学运相关案件。
description.en: One of the second-instance general courts of the Republic of China, headquartered in Taipei. It is organizationally under the direct jurisdiction of the Judicial Yuan and its appellate court is the Supreme Court. It has four branches in Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, and Hualien. It is responsible for handling cases related to the Sunflower Student Movement.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文政府首任行政院院长，其内阁上任后撤回对126名占领行政院行动者的刑事告诉。

zh-cn: 真天命太平天国天朝九门御林云师前导副军师殿后军南王七千岁

description.zh-cn: 太平天国南王，拜上帝会的始创人之一，洪秀全最早的支持者。他制定了太平天国初期的官制、礼制和军制，在太平天国的发展中起到关键作用，被认为是太平天国的第一智囊。1852年在全州蓑衣渡被清军炮火击中身亡。
description.en: South King of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, one of the founders of the God Worshipping Society, and the earliest supporter of Hong Xiuquan. He formulated the early official system, ritual system, and military system of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, playing a key role in its development and is considered its foremost strategist. He was killed by Qing army cannon fire at Suoyi Ferry, Quanzhou in 1852.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国东王，早期核心领袖。他原为烧炭工，后由冯云山发展加入拜上帝会并获提拔，掌握军政实权。最终在天京事变中被杀。
description.en: East King of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and an early core leader. Originally a charcoal burner, he was later recruited into the God Worshipping Society by Feng Yunshan and promoted, gaining significant military and political power. He was ultimately killed during the Tianjing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国早期核心领袖之一，被封为西王。由冯云山发展加入拜上帝会并提拔。
description.en: One of the early core leaders of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, he was appointed West King. He was recruited into the God Worshipping Society and promoted by Feng Yunshan.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国早期核心领袖、北王，由冯云山引入并提拔。他发动了天京事变。
description.en: An early core leader and North King of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. Introduced and promoted by Feng Yunshan, he later launched the Tianjing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国早期核心领袖，被封为翼王。由冯云山引入并提拔，后因天京事变及洪秀全猜忌而出走。
description.en: An early core leader of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, he was enfeoffed as the Yi King. Introduced and promoted by Feng Yunshan, he later left due to the Tianjing Incident and Hong Xiuquan's suspicion.

description.zh-cn: 洪秀全长子，太平天国第二代领袖、末代君主，称幼天王。天京城破时由李秀成带其突围。
description.en: Hong Xiuquan's eldest son, the second-generation leader and last monarch of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, known as the Young Heavenly King. He was led by Li Xiucheng to break out of the siege when Tianjing fell.

description.zh-cn: 由洪秀全和冯云山于1843年创立的秘密宗教组织，是太平天国运动的前身。
description.en: A secret religious organization that preceded the Taiping Rebellion, founded by Hong Xiuquan and Feng Yunshan in 1843.

description.zh-cn: 太平天国运动的开端。
太平天国领导集团的内部冲突，即1856年发生在其首都天京的事件。此次冲突导致大量人员被杀，是太平天国由盛转衰的转折点。
description.en: An internal conflict among the leadership of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom that occurred in its capital, Tianjing, in 1856. The event resulted in a large number of deaths and marked the turning point from the zenith to the decline of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 清朝军队围攻太平天国首都天京（南京）的战役，是太平天国战争的最后一战。此战以湘军攻破天京告终，标志着太平天国运动的失败。
description.en: The siege of Tianjing (Nanjing), the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, by Qing forces, was the last major battle of the Taiping Rebellion. It concluded with the Xiang Army breaking through and capturing Tianjing, marking the failure of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom movement.

description.zh-cn: 由李鸿章建立的晚清地方武装，曾参与镇压太平天国，其旧部也成为北洋新军军官的来源之一。
description.en: A regional army in the late Qing Dynasty, established by Li Hongzhang, which participated in suppressing the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom. Its former members were also one of the sources of officers for the Beiyang New Army.

description.zh-cn: 由梁发编写的基督教布道书，对洪秀全创立拜上帝会产生重要影响。
基督徒，《劝世良言》的作者。
晚清时期活跃于华北的农民起义武装，后期与太平军残部合并。
description.en: A peasant rebel army active in North China during the late Qing Dynasty, later merging with remnants of the Taiping Army.

description.zh-cn: 洪秀全族弟，太平天国后期重要领导人，被封为干王、军师。
石达开余部将领，被认为是最后一支覆灭的太平军。

en: Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜日治时期，在朝鲜半岛成立的流亡政府，于1919年至1948年间在中国上海设立。王亚樵曾与其负责人安昌浩合作，共同策划了虹口公园爆炸案。
description.en: An exile government of the Korean Peninsula during the Japanese colonial period, established in Shanghai, China, active from 1919 to 1948. Wang Yaqiao collaborated with its leader, Ahn Changho, to plan the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 韩国军事将领、政治家、前总统和军事独裁者。他通过五一六军事政变上台，全斗焕在政变中积极支持他并成为其亲信。他还是金泳三的政治生涯早期主要政治对手，以及1968年青瓦台事件的暗杀目标。
description.en: Former South Korean president, military general, politician, and dictator. He came to power through the May 16 coup, with Chun Doo-hwan actively supporting him and becoming his confidant. He was also a major political opponent of Kim Young-sam during the early part of Kim's career and the target of the 1968 Blue House raid assassination attempt.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日治朝鲜庆尚南道陜川郡
birth_place.en: Hapcheon County, South Gyeongsang Province, Japanese Korea

death_place.zh-cn: 韩国首尔西大门区延禧洞
death_place.en: Yeonhui-dong, Seodaemun District, Seoul, South Korea

description.zh-cn: 韩国陆军退役上将，大韩民国第11、12任总统、军事独裁者。他通过双十二政变上台，发动5·17政变扩大权力，实行新军人权威主义的独裁统治，任内镇压光州民主化运动。执政期间，韩国经济保持良好发展。其宣布的戒严是2024年戒严事件的重要历史参照。卸任后，他因镇压光州事件和贪污罪被判处无期徒刑，后获时任总统金泳三特赦。
description.en: A retired Republic of Korea Army general, who served as the 11th and 12th President of South Korea and was a military dictator. He seized power through the Coup d'état of December Twelfth, further consolidated it with the May 17 coup, and established an authoritarian 'New Military' regime, during which he suppressed the Gwangju Uprising. Under his rule, South Korea's economy maintained strong growth. His declaration of martial law serves as a key historical precedent for the 2024 martial law event. After leaving office, he was sentenced to life in prison for his role in the Gwangju massacre and for corruption, but was later pardoned by then-President Kim Young-sam.

description.zh-cn: 韩国民主运动领袖，大韩民国前总统。作为金泳三的继任者，他曾推行“阳光政策”。其政治生涯中与金泳三、金钟泌并称“三金”，既是竞争对手也是合作伙伴。在全斗焕执政期间，他曾被逮捕入狱，后于1997年作为候任总统，同意金泳三赦免全斗焕。
description.en: A leader of the South Korean democracy movement and former President of the Republic of Korea. As Kim Young-sam's successor, he implemented the 'Sunshine Policy'. In his political career, he was known as one of the 'Three Kims' along with Kim Young-sam and Kim Jong-pil, acting as both rivals and partners. During Chun Doo-hwan's rule, he was arrested and imprisoned, later, as president-elect in 1997, he consented to Kim Young-sam's pardon of Chun.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国第16任总统。他延续对朝友好政策，于2007年步行穿过军事分界线访问朝鲜。在2003年清华大学的演讲中，他曾提及黎明是在韩国家喻户晓的艺人，其演讲也影响了李在明成为人权律师。
description.en: The 16th President of the Republic of Korea. He continued the friendly policy towards North Korea, walking across the Military Demarcation Line in 2007 to visit the country. In a 2003 speech at Tsinghua University, he mentioned Leon Lai as a household name in South Korea, and his speeches also influenced Lee Jae-myung to become a human rights lawyer.

description.zh-cn: 韩国史上首位女性总统，因崔顺实事件被弹劾下台。她在任期间，曾与城南市长李在明在政策上多有摩擦。
description.en: First female president in South Korean history. She was impeached and removed from office due to the Choi Soon-sil scandal. During her tenure, she had numerous policy conflicts with Lee Jae-myung when he was Mayor of Seongnam.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大韩民国庆尚北道安东市
birth_place.en: Andong, North Gyeongsang Province, Republic of Korea

description.zh-cn: 韩国进步派政治人物及律师，现任韩国总统。曾任京畿道知事、城南市市长、共同民主党代表、韩国国会议员。
description.en: A South Korean progressive politician and lawyer, currently serving as the President of South Korea. Formerly served as the Governor of Gyeonggi Province, Mayor of Seongnam, leader of the Democratic Party, and a member of the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 金正日之子，朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的第三代最高领导人。现任朝鲜劳动党总书记和国务委员会委员长。他是金正哲的同母弟弟，并取代其兄成为接班人。曾于2018年与文在寅共同签署《板门店宣言》，并与唐纳德·特朗普举行多次首脑会晤。
description.en: Son of Kim Jong-il, the third supreme leader of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. He currently serves as the General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission. He is the full younger brother of Kim Jong-chul and replaced his brother as the successor. He co-signed the Panmunjom Declaration with Moon Jae-in in 2018 and held multiple summits with Donald Trump.

description.zh-cn: 由朴正熙发动的军事政变，导致国会被解散，第三共和国建立。全斗焕在此次政变中积极支持朴正熙，为其政治生涯的开端。
description.en: A military coup led by Park Chung-hee, which resulted in the dissolution of the National Assembly and the establishment of the Third Republic. Chun Doo-hwan's active support for Park during this coup marked the beginning of his political career.

description.zh-cn: 1980年5月在韩国光州爆发的民主化运动，遭到全斗焕派遣的军队血腥镇压。
description.en: A pro-democracy movement that erupted in Gwangju, South Korea, in May 1980, which was brutally suppressed by troops dispatched by Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 1987年6月在韩国爆发的全国性民主运动，迫使全斗焕政府接受了总统直选制等民主化要求。
description.en: A nationwide pro-democracy movement in South Korea in June 1987, which forced the Chun Doo-hwan government to accept democratic reforms, including direct presidential elections.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚独裁统治时期。
四一九革命后建立的民主政府。
韩国现行的宪政体制，始于1987年的民主化改宪，该改宪是六月民主运动的成果。自此建立的民主政府延续至今。
description.en: The current constitutional system of South Korea began with the democratic constitutional reforms of 1987, which were the outcome of the June Democratic Movement. The democratic government established since then continues to this day.

en: National Assembly of the Republic of Korea

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的最高立法机关，是韩国三权分立宪政体制中的重要组成部分。在2024年戒严期间，国会议员集会并通过决议，成功废除了戒严令。李在明曾为国会议员。
description.en: The supreme legislative body of the Republic of Korea, an important component of the country's constitutional system of separation of powers. During the 2024 martial law, its members convened and passed a resolution to successfully nullify the martial law decree. Lee Jae-myung was a member of the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国宪法裁判机构。
涉及前总统朴槿惠及其亲信崔顺实的政治丑闻，导致朴槿惠被弹劾。李在明在此事件后因积极发声而支持率大涨。
description.en: A political scandal involving former President Park Geun-hye and her confidante Choi Soon-sil, which led to Park's impeachment. Lee Jae-myung's approval ratings surged after he actively spoke out on the issue.

description.zh-cn: 指韩国经济高速发展的时期。
2024年12月3日晚间，时任韩国总统尹锡悦宣布紧急戒严。该戒严在约6小时后被国会决议废除，引发了严重的政治危机。李在明在此事件中扮演了关键的反对角色。
description.en: On the night of December 3, 2024, then-South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol declared an emergency martial law. It was nullified by a National Assembly resolution about 6 hours later, sparking a severe political crisis. Lee Jae-myung played a key opposition role in this event.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国国务总理。
韩国政治人物，现任韩国国会议长。2024年戒严期间，他召集国会会议，并宣布废除戒严令的决议获通过。
description.en: South Korean politician and current Speaker of the National Assembly. During the 2024 martial law, he convened a session of the National Assembly and announced the passage of the resolution to nullify it.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国大法院院长。
大韩民国宪法法院院长。
大韩民国的最高法院，也是其最高司法机构。1997年，该法院在终审判决中判处全斗焕无期徒刑。
description.en: The Supreme Court of the Republic of Korea, and its highest judicial body. In 1997, the court sentenced Chun Doo-hwan to life imprisonment in its final verdict.

zh-cn: 弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔

description.zh-cn: 德国政治人物，现任德国联邦总统。
德国政治人物，德国候任总理。
冷战期间位于中欧的社会主义国家，由苏联占领区成立，曾是东方集团的成员。在东欧剧变中经历政治动荡，最终于1990年10月3日并入联邦德国，实现了两德统一。
description.en: A socialist state in Central Europe during the Cold War, established from the Soviet occupation zone and a member of the Eastern Bloc. It experienced political upheaval during the Revolutions of 1989 and was ultimately incorporated into the Federal Republic of Germany on October 3, 1990, achieving German reunification.

description.zh-cn: 指德意志民主共和国（东德）并入德意志联邦共和国（西德）的事件，是东欧剧变中的标志性成果之一。
description.en: The event of the German Democratic Republic (East Germany) acceding to the Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany), one of the landmark outcomes of the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 德国政治家、外交家，曾任普鲁士王国首相，德意志帝国首任首相（总理）。因其“铁血政策”被称为“铁血宰相”，通过一系列战争主导了德意志的统一。在位期间，沙皇亚历山大三世对其产生了反感。
description.en: A German statesman and diplomat, Minister President of Prussia, and the first Chancellor of the German Empire. Known as the 'Iron Chancellor' for his 'iron and blood' policy, he orchestrated the unification of Germany through a series of wars. During his tenure, Alexander III developed an aversion towards him.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士国王及德意志帝国第一任皇帝。亚历山大三世对其产生反感。
description.en: King of Prussia and the first German Emperor, towards whom Alexander III developed an aversion.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪欧洲的基督教改革运动，始于1517年由马丁·路德在德意志地区发起，旨在改革天主教会的教义和实践。这场运动是整个欧洲宗教改革的核心部分，最终导致了新教的诞生，并使神圣罗马帝国在宗教上分裂。
description.en: A Christian reform movement in Europe in the 16th century, initiated by Martin Luther in the German territories starting in 1517. It aimed at reforming the doctrines and practices of the Catholic Church, forming the core of the broader European Reformation. This movement ultimately led to the birth of Protestantism and caused the Holy Roman Empire to split religiously.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪德国神学家、神学教授兼天主教神父，是宗教改革的主要发起人之一。他撰写《九十五条论纲》批判赎罪券，引发了德意志宗教改革运动。他还曾批判《古兰经》。
description.en: A 16th-century German theologian, professor of theology, and Catholic priest, he was one of the main initiators of the Protestant Reformation. He wrote the 'Ninety-five Theses' criticizing indulgences, which sparked the German Reformation. He also criticized the Quran.

zh-cn: 关于赎罪券的意义及效果的见解
en: Disputation on the Power and Efficacy of Indulgences

description.zh-cn: 由马丁·路德撰写的辩论提纲，主要针对当时天主教会滥发赎罪券的问题。该文件的发表被认为是德意志宗教改革的开端。
description.en: A list of propositions for an academic disputation written by Martin Luther, primarily targeting the issue of the sale of indulgences by the Catholic Church. Its publication is considered the beginning of the German Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 全球最大的基督教教会，也是基督宗教的主要分支之一，由罗马主教（即教宗）领导。历史上的宗教改革运动曾主要针对当时天主教会的腐败和教义问题。
description.en: The largest Christian church and one of its major branches, led by the Bishop of Rome (the Pope). Historically, the Protestant Reformation primarily targeted the corruption and doctrinal issues of the Catholic Church at that time.

zh-cn: 奥托一世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 德意志国王，首位神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
1989年11月9日，东德政府宣布开放柏林墙及边境。这是东欧剧变和冷战结束的关键事件，直接促成了两德统一。
description.en: On November 9, 1989, the East German government announced the opening of the Berlin Wall and its borders. This was a pivotal event in the Revolutions of 1989 and the end of the Cold War, directly leading to German reunification.

description.zh-cn: 西德首任联邦总理。
德国主要政党之一。
德国政党。在十一月革命后成为执政党，领导了魏玛共和国的建立，并镇压了更激进的左翼起义。
description.en: A German political party. It became the ruling party after the November Revolution, led the establishment of the Weimar Republic, and suppressed more radical left-wing uprisings.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾担任第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会副委员长兼秘书长，并曾任中华全国总工会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as a Vice Chairman and concurrently Secretary-General of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress, and also as Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 张高丽的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Zhang Gaoli.

zh-cn: 彭帅指控张高丽性丑闻事件

description.zh-cn: 彭帅在微博发文指控前中国国务院副总理张高丽性侵的事件。
description.en: The event where Peng Shuai accused former Chinese Vice Premier Zhang Gaoli of sexual assault in a Weibo post.

nodes.id: BAIDU:第24届冬奥会工作领导小组

zh-cn: 第24届冬奥会工作领导小组

description.zh-cn: 李富春和蔡畅的独生女。
description.en: The only daughter of Li Fuchun and Cai Chang.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖南长沙的一所中学，是张孝骞和李富春的母校。
description.en: A secondary school located in Changsha, Hunan, which is the alma mater of Zhang Xiaoqian and Li Fuchun.

en: Primary Consort of Prince Chun the Virtuous

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后之妹，光绪帝生母。
光绪帝的妃嫔。
光绪帝的妃嫔，珍妃之姐。清室退位后，她曾训斥载沣之妻瓜尔佳氏，致其自尽。
description.en: A consort of the Guangxu Emperor and the elder sister of Consort Zhen. After the abdication of the Qing court, she scolded Zaifeng's wife, Gūwalgiya, which led to her suicide.

description.zh-cn: 由光绪帝于1898年颁布，标志戊戌变法开始的诏书。
清朝第八位皇帝，庙号宣宗，孝全成皇后的丈夫，光绪帝和载沣的祖父，咸丰帝之父。其在位期间爆发了第一次鸦片战争。在鸦片问题上，他最初支持林则徐的严禁政策并下令终止鸦片贸易，但在战争爆发后态度转变，将林则徐革职。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Qing dynasty, with the temple name Xuanzong, husband of Empress Xiaoquancheng, grandfather of Guangxu and Zaifeng, and father of Xianfeng. During his reign, the First Opium War broke out. On the opium issue, he initially supported Lin Zexu's strict prohibition policy and ordered the termination of the opium trade, but changed his stance after the war's outbreak, leading to Lin Zexu's dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 王洪文的妻子，上海棉纺织十七厂工人。
赵乐际之父，曾任《青海日报》副总编、陕西人民教育出版社社长。
description.en: Father of Zhao Leji, he served as the deputy editor-in-chief of Qinghai Daily and the director of Shaanxi People's Education Press.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党成都市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Chengdu Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 成都市人民代表大会常务委员会主任
中国政治人物，现任中国人民政治协商会议成都市委员会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Chairman of the Chengdu Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

zh-cn: 中国共产党成都市委员会
en: Chengdu Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在成都市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading body of the Communist Party of China in Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 中国成都市的行政管理机关。
description.en: The administrative body of Chengdu, China.

nodes.id: BAIDU:成都市人民代表大会常务委员会

zh-cn: 成都市人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Chengdu Municipal People's Congress

nodes.id: BAIDU:中国人民政治协商会议成都市委员会

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议成都市委员会
en: Chengdu Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国蜀郡郡守，主持修建了都江堰。
description.en: The governor of Shu Commandery in the State of Qin during the Warring States period, who presided over the construction of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代建设并使用至今的大型水利工程，位于四川省都江堰市城西。由鱼嘴、飞沙堰、宝瓶口等主体工程构成，主要作用是引水灌溉和防洪。
description.en: A large-scale hydraulic engineering project built in ancient China and still in use today, located west of Dujiangyan City, Sichuan Province. It consists of main structures such as the Yuzui, Feishayan, and Baopingkou, with its primary functions being water diversion for irrigation and flood control.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉开国皇帝，刘禅之父。他被张松视为可以取代刘璋的明主，并在张松的协助下进入益州，最终夺取了该地。
description.en: Founding emperor of Shu Han, father of Liu Shan. He was seen by Zhang Song as a worthy ruler to replace Liu Zhang, and with Zhang Song's assistance, he entered Yi Province and eventually seized control of it.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉是中国历史上三国时期西南方的国家之一，由刘备建立，国号为“汉”。在《三国演义》中，作者以蜀汉为中心，体现了“尊刘反曹”的倾向。
description.en: Shu Han was one of the three major states that competed for supremacy over China in the Three Kingdoms period, located in southwestern China, founded by Liu Bei with the official state name of 'Han'. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', the narrative centers on Shu Han, reflecting a pro-Liu, anti-Cao bias.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏后期名将。因建立灭蜀奇功，官至太尉。后遭钟会、卫瓘诬陷谋反而被杀。
description.en: A prominent military general of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period. He reached the rank of Grand Marshal for his decisive role in the conquest of Shu Han. He was later falsely accused of rebellion by Zhong Hui and Wei Guan and killed.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的大规模移民运动。
民国时期川军将领，四川省主席。

zh-cn: 联合国教育、科学及文化组织

description.zh-cn: 联合国专门机构之一，旨在通过教育、科学和文化促进国际合作。该组织于1996年将庐山列为世界文化遗产，并于2002年批准其为首批世界地质公园。巩俐于2000年被任命为该组织的“促进和平艺术家”。
description.en: A specialized agency of the United Nations, aiming to promote international cooperation through education, science, and culture. The organization inscribed Mount Lu as a World Heritage Site in 1996 and approved it as one of the first Global Geoparks in 2002. Gong Li was appointed as an 'Artist for Peace' by the organization in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任重庆市副书记，现任重庆市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, formerly Deputy Secretary of Chongqing, currently the Mayor of Chongqing.

zh-cn: 重庆市人民代表大会常务委员会
中国人民政治协商会议重庆市委员会
en: Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议重庆市委员会。
description.en: The Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 南宋第三位皇帝，赵德芳的七世孙。他即位前曾藩封于恭州（今重庆），即位后认为此地是“双重喜庆”之地，遂将其升格并赐名“重庆”。
description.en: The third emperor of the Southern Song dynasty and a seventh-generation descendant of Zhao Defang. Before his accession, he was enfeoffed in Gongzhou (present-day Chongqing). Upon ascending the throne, he viewed it as a 'double celebration', elevating its status and renaming it 'Chongqing'.

description.zh-cn: 南宋第二位皇帝，宋高宗养子。他由高宗选为继承人，使宋朝皇位重归太祖一脉，是宋太祖七世孙（赵德芳六世孙）。即位后为岳飞平反，致力于恢复中原，也是宋光宗赵惇之父。
description.en: The second emperor of the Southern Song dynasty and adopted son of Emperor Gaozong. He was chosen by Gaozong as his successor, thereby returning the imperial throne to Taizu's lineage. He was a seventh-generation descendant of Emperor Taizu (and a sixth-generation descendant of Zhao Defang). After ascending the throne, he rehabilitated Yue Fei, was dedicated to recovering the northern territories, and was also the father of Emperor Guangzong (Zhao Dun).

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国政治家。灭巴国后屯兵江州，修筑江州城，为史载重庆建城之始。
description.en: A politician of the Qin state during the Warring States period. After conquering the state of Ba, he stationed troops in Jiangzhou and built the city wall, marking the recorded beginning of Chongqing's city construction.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，由日本对作为中国战时首都的重庆进行的长期战略轰炸。
description.en: The long-term strategic bombing of Chongqing, China's wartime capital, by Japan during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间在重庆发生的保皇派与造反派之间的大规模武装冲突，对城市造成了严重破坏。
description.en: Large-scale armed conflicts between the Royalist and Rebel factions in Chongqing during the Cultural Revolution, causing severe damage to the city.

description.zh-cn: 位于重庆市渝中区，是1949年后重庆修建的第一个大型体育场馆，也是中国第一座现代意义上的综合体育场。
description.en: Located in Yuzhong District, Chongqing, it was the first large-scale stadium built in Chongqing after 1949 and the first modern comprehensive stadium in China.

zh-cn: 广东省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Guangdong Provincial People's Congress

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议广东省委员会
en: Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在广东省的地方组织，即中国人民政治协商会议广东省委员会。该委员会通常以简称指代。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Guangdong Province. It is the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and it is commonly referred to by an abbreviation.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期秦国君主，秦朝开国皇帝，中国历史上首位完成华夏大一统并称皇帝的君主，秦昭襄王的曾孙。他统一六国，建立了秦朝。在位期间，他识破郑国疲秦之计后，仍坚持完成郑国渠修建。他曾极为赞赏韩非著作，下令实施“焚书坑儒”，导致《论语》等经典几近失传。他也是荆轲的刺杀目标。
description.en: Ruler of the State of Qin during the late Warring States period, the founding emperor of the Qin Dynasty, and the first monarch in Chinese history to complete unification and be titled 'Emperor'. He was the great-grandson of King Zhaoxiang of Qin. He unified the six states and established the Qin Dynasty. During his reign, after uncovering Han's plot to exhaust Qin, he still proceeded with and completed the construction of the Zheng Guo Canal. He greatly admired Han Fei's writings and ordered the 'Burning of books and burying of scholars', which nearly led to the loss of classics like the Analects. He was also the target of Jing Ke's assassination attempt.

description.zh-cn: 南越国创建者，原为秦朝将领。
description.en: Founder of the Nanyue kingdom, originally a general of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由秦朝将领赵佗在岭南地区建立的政权，领有今日广东、广西、海南及越南北部。
description.en: A kingdom founded by the Qin general Zhao Tuo in the Lingnan region, covering present-day Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, and northern Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 唐代政治家、诗人，唐代第一位由岭南书生进身的宰相。他以直言敢谏著称，曾提拔王维等人，并预见到安禄山的野心。后因李林甫等人排挤而被罢相。其诗作《感遇》、《望月怀远》等为传世名篇。
清朝乾隆时期开始施行的对外贸易政策，限定外国商船只能在广州进行贸易。
19世纪中叶，清朝与英国及法国等西方列强之间发生两场冲突，即第一次鸦片战争（1840-1842年）和第二次鸦片战争。其中，第一次鸦片战争是大清帝国与英国之间的战争，直接导致香港岛被割让。清政府战败后，刺激其推行洋务运动，并开启了第二阶段的西学东渐。
description.en: A series of two conflicts occurred between the Qing dynasty and Western powers (primarily Britain and France) in the mid-19th century: the First Opium War (1840-1842) and the Second Opium War. The First Opium War, a conflict between the Qing Empire and the United Kingdom, directly led to the cession of Hong Kong Island. The Qing government's defeat stimulated the launch of the Self-Strengthening Movement, initiating the second phase of the West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任广州市市长、中国共产党广州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Mayor of Guangzhou and Secretary of the Guangzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 广州市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
中国政治人物，现任广州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Mayor of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议广州市委员会主席。

zh-cn: 中国共产党广州市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在广州市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Guangzhou City.

zh-cn: 广州市人民代表大会常务委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省广州市的地方国家权力机关，其日常工作由常设机关负责。
description.en: The local state power organ of Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. Its daily affairs are handled by its standing body.

location.zh-cn: 广州市越秀区府前路1号
location.en: No. 1 Fuqian Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省广州市的地方国家行政机关。1955年2月至1968年2月间曾改称广州市人民委员会，文化大革命期间职权由广州市革命委员会行使，1981年9月恢复广州市人民政府名称至今。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. It was renamed the Guangzhou Municipal People's Committee between February 1955 and February 1968. During the Cultural Revolution, its powers were exercised by the Guangzhou Revolutionary Committee. The name Guangzhou Municipal People's Government was restored in September 1981.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议广州市委员会

description.zh-cn: 唐末民变领袖，大齐政权皇帝。
description.en: Leader of a major rebellion in the late Tang dynasty and emperor of the Qi dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 南汉开国皇帝，史称南汉高祖。于917年在番禺称帝，建立“大越”，次年改国号为“大汉”。
description.en: The founding emperor of Southern Han, known posthumously as Emperor Gaozu of Southern Han. He proclaimed himself emperor in Panyu in 917, establishing the state of 'Great Yue', which he renamed 'Great Han' the following year.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的政权之一，位于现广东、广西、海南、香港、澳门以及越南北部，后于971年被北宋所灭。
description.en: One of the states during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, located in modern-day Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hong Kong, Macau, and northern Vietnam. It was conquered by the Northern Song dynasty in 971.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省下辖的地级市，位于广东省南部，是粤港澳大湾区和珠江—西江经济带的重要节点城市。佛山是国家历史文化名城，历史上是中国的四大名镇之一，曾有古称，现为全国重要的制造业基地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in the south of Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. It is an important hub in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and the Pearl River-Xijiang Economic Belt. Foshan is a National Famous Historical and Cultural City, historically one of the four famous towns in China, once had an ancient name, and is now a major manufacturing base in the country.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南共产党中央委员会总书记、越南共产党中央军事委员会书记。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam and Secretary of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南社会主义共和国主席。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南政府总理。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the Prime Minister of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越南国会主席。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the Chairman of the National Assembly of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治家，现任越共中央书记处常务书记。
description.en: Vietnamese politician, currently serving as the Permanent Member of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西殖民帝国在东南亚的殖民地联邦，包括现今的越南、柬埔寨和老挝。1897年后，其将越南尊人府纳入直接管理，殖民当局曾两次逮捕黎笋。
description.en: A colonial federation of the French colonial empire in Southeast Asia, which included modern-day Vietnam, Cambodia, and Laos. After 1897, it brought the Vietnamese Tôn Nhơn Phủ under its direct administration, and its colonial authorities arrested Lê Duẩn twice.

description.zh-cn: 一个由胡志明等人于1941年创办的越南革命和民族独立运动组织，旨在反对法国和日本的殖民统治。
description.en: A Vietnamese revolutionary and national independence movement organization founded by Hồ Chí Minh and others in 1941, aiming to oppose French and Japanese colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月，由胡志明领导的越南独立同盟会（越盟）在越南发动的起义，旨在从法国和日本的统治下夺取政权并宣布独立。
description.en: An uprising launched by the Việt Minh, led by Hồ Chí Minh, in August 1945 across Vietnam to seize power from French and Japanese rule and declare independence.

description.zh-cn: 由胡志明于1945年宣布成立的东南亚社会主义国家，通常被称为“北越”。它于1945年至1976年存在，是越南统一前位于北方的共产主义国家。曾是越南战争中的一方，并向中国请求抗疟药物援助。黎笋是其主要领导人之一。1976年，它与越南南方共和国合并，统一为越南社会主义共和国。
description.en: A socialist state in Southeast Asia proclaimed by Hồ Chí Minh in 1945, commonly known as 'North Vietnam'. It existed from 1945 to 1976 as a communist state in the northern part of Vietnam before reunification. It was a party in the Vietnam War and requested antimalarial drug assistance from China. Lê Duẩn was one of its key leaders. In 1976, it merged with the Republic of South Vietnam to form the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 第一次印度支那战争中的决定性战役，越南民主共和国军队在此击败法军。
description.en: The decisive battle of the First Indochina War, where the forces of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam defeated the French.

description.zh-cn: 1955年由吴廷琰建立，通称南越。该国于1955年至1975年间存在，在越南战争中与美国结盟，对抗北越。
description.en: Established by Ngô Đình Diệm in 1955, commonly known as South Vietnam. It existed from 1955 to 1975, allied with the United States against North Vietnam during the Vietnam War.

description.zh-cn: 一个在1949年至1955年间存在的国家，是越南共和国的前身，通常被称为“南越”。
description.en: A state that existed from 1949 to 1955, the predecessor to the Republic of Vietnam, commonly known as 'South Vietnam'.

description.zh-cn: 越南共和国（南越）首任总统。于1963年死于一场军事政变，该政变得到了肯尼迪政府的默许。
description.en: The first president of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam), who was assassinated in a 1963 military coup tacitly approved by the Kennedy administration.

description.zh-cn: 指标志着越南战争结束的北越军队攻陷南越首都西贡事件，该事件直接促成了越南的统一。
description.en: Refers to the event where North Vietnamese forces captured Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, marking the end of the Vietnam War and leading directly to the reunification of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党于1986年开始推行的经济改革政策，旨在建立社会主义市场经济。
description.en: An economic reform policy initiated by the Communist Party of Vietnam in 1986, aimed at establishing a socialist-oriented market economy.

en: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea

zh-cn: 越南共产党中央书记处
en: Central Secretariat of the Communist Party of Vietnam
Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党的中央机构之一，负责处理日常党务。
description.en: One of the central bodies of the Communist Party of Vietnam, responsible for handling daily party affairs.

description.zh-cn: 前越南共产党中央委员会总书记、越南社会主义共和国主席。
越南国防部长。
前越南共产党中央委员会总书记。
前越南社会主义共和国主席。
前越南政府总理。
越南阮朝末代皇帝，曾为越南帝国君主，后担任越南国国家元首。
description.en: The last emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty of Vietnam, formerly the monarch of the Empire of Vietnam, later serving as the head of state of the State of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 阮朝建立者，安南国王，国号被嘉庆帝改为“越南”。
越南历史上最后一个君主制王朝。
description.en: The last imperial dynasty of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国的创建者及首任皇帝（大汗），后被元朝追尊为元太祖，是蒙哥的祖父。
description.en: The founder and first Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, and the grandfather of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 元朝初年重要谋臣，金莲川幕府核心人物，曾劝说忽必烈定国号为“大元”。
中国古典文献之一，古代中国用于推演未来吉凶祸福的卜筮书。自汉代开始被尊奉为“五经”之一，其中心思想是用阴阳符号构成的六十四卦象代表世间万物的运行状态。同时，它也是元朝国号“大元”的出处。
description.en: One of the Chinese classic texts, an ancient Chinese divination text used to predict future fortunes. It has been revered as one of the 'Five Classics' since the Han Dynasty. Its central idea is to use the 64 hexagrams, composed of yin and yang symbols, to represent the state of all things in the world. Additionally, it is the source of the Yuan dynasty's name 'Dayuan'.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈汗颁布的确立“大元”国号的诏书。
南宋是中国历史上的一个朝代，由宋高宗赵构建立，是北宋的延续，也是中国南方的汉人政权。其重要将领有韩世忠。该政权在蒙哥在位期间曾遭受大规模进攻，最终被元朝所灭。
description.en: The Southern Song was a Han Chinese dynasty in southern China, a continuation of the Northern Song, founded by Emperor Gaozong (Zhao Gou). Key general Han Shizhong served this dynasty. It faced large-scale invasions during Möngke's reign and was ultimately conquered by the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元朝被明朝取代后，蒙古皇族退居漠北（蒙古高原）所建立的政权。
description.en: The regime established by the Mongol royal family after they retreated to the Mongolian Plateau following the replacement of the Yuan dynasty by the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由女真族建立的统治中国北方和东北地区的封建王朝，后被蒙古帝国所灭。
description.en: A feudal dynasty established by the Jurchen people that ruled northern and northeastern China.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗的第四子，蒙哥、元世祖忽必烈、旭烈兀、阿里不哥的父亲。他曾任大蒙古国监国，后被追尊为元睿宗。
description.en: The fourth son of Genghis Khan, and the father of Möngke, Kublai, Hulagu, and Ariq Böke. He served as the regent of the Mongol Empire and was posthumously honored as Emperor Ruizong of Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国第四任大汗，拖雷长子，忽必烈长兄，元朝追尊为宪宗桓肃皇帝。他在位期间任命忽必烈总领漠南汉地事务，并继续发动对南宋、大理、西亚等地的征服战争。最终在征伐南宋的钓鱼城之战中去世，其逝世引发了帝国的内乱与分裂。
description.en: The fourth Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, the eldest son of Tolui and elder brother of Kublai, posthumously honored as Emperor Xianzong Huansu by the Yuan Dynasty. During his reign, he appointed Kublai to oversee affairs in North China and continued to launch wars of conquest against the Southern Song, Dali, and West Asia. He eventually died during the Battle of Diaoyu Fortress while invading the Southern Song, and his death triggered internal strife and the division of the empire.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古皇族，成吉思汗之孙，拖雷与唆鲁禾帖尼的幼子。在兄长蒙哥汗去世后，与四哥忽必烈争夺汗位，引发拖雷家族内战，最终兵败被俘，不久后去世。
description.en: A Mongol prince, grandson of Genghis Khan, and the youngest son of Tolui and Sorghaghtani Beki. After the death of his brother Möngke Khan, he contended for the throne with his fourth brother Kublai, leading to the Toluid Civil War. He was ultimately defeated, captured, and died shortly after.
