description.zh-cn: 1260年至1264年间，拖雷的两个儿子忽必烈与阿里不哥为争夺蒙古帝国大汗之位而爆发的内战。战争以忽必烈胜利告终，但也导致了蒙古帝国走向分裂。
description.en: A civil war fought between two of Tolui's sons, Kublai and Ariq Böke, from 1260 to 1264 for the title of Great Khan of the Mongol Empire. The war ended in Kublai's victory but led to the division of the Mongol Empire.

description.zh-cn: 元朝末年爆发的大规模民变，直接导致元朝覆灭。
元军与南宋军队的最后决战，元朝在此战中彻底消灭南宋流亡政权，标志着南宋的灭亡。
明朝将领徐达领导的旨在推翻元朝统治的军事行动。
蒙古帝国第二任大汗，成吉思汗第三子和继承人，蒙哥的养父。
description.en: The second Great Khan of the Mongol Empire, third son and successor of Genghis Khan, and the adoptive father of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国时期大臣，元朝初年的重要政治家。曾劝谏窝阔台汗在汉地实行汉法，并奉成吉思汗之命记录其与丘处机的对话。
description.en: A minister during the Mongol Empire and an important statesman in the early Yuan dynasty. He advised Ogedei Khan to implement Han laws in Han territories and was ordered by Genghis Khan to record his conversations with Qiu Chuji.

description.zh-cn: 元朝最后一位皇帝，后退居漠北，成为北元开国皇帝。
description.en: The last emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋战国时期的哲学思想流派，以老子和庄子为主要代表人物，是道教的思想渊源之一。
description.en: A school of philosophical thought from China's Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, with Laozi and Zhuangzi as its main representatives. It is also one of the ideological origins of Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 太平道的开创者之一。
东汉末年的道教派别，由张角、于吉等人创立。
五斗米道的创立者，被尊为天师。

en: Way of the Five Pecks of Rice

description.zh-cn: 早期道教组织，由张道陵创立。
太平道的创立者，东汉末年黄巾起义的首领。在《三国演义》中，他被描绘为从南华老仙处获得《太平要术》。
description.en: Founder of the Way of Great Peace (Taiping Dao) and leader of the Yellow Turban Rebellion at the end of the Eastern Han Dynasty. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is depicted as having received the 'Essential Techniques for the Age of Great Peace' from the Old Immortal of Southern Hua.

description.zh-cn: 佛教是一种源于古印度的世界性宗教和哲学体系，对中国文化产生了深远影响。它影响了中国古代思想家如皇侃，并与道教长期互动论争。唐代宗等帝王曾笃信佛教，李白也对佛教有深入了解，自称“青莲居士”，常在诗歌中运用佛教典故和思想。此外，据传在松赞干布时期，佛教通过与泥婆罗（尼泊尔）和唐朝的联姻首次传入吐蕃。
description.en: Buddhism is a world religion and philosophical system originating from ancient India, which has had a profound impact on Chinese culture. It influenced ancient Chinese thinkers like Huang Kan, and engaged in long-term interaction and debate with Taoism. Emperors such as Daizong of Tang devoutly followed Buddhism, and Li Bai also had a deep understanding of it, calling himself the 'Blue Lotus Layman' and often using Buddhist allusions and ideas in his poetry. Furthermore, it is traditionally believed that during the reign of Songtsen Gampo, Buddhism was first introduced to Tibet through his marriages with princesses from Licchavi (Nepal) and the Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的一次大规模民变，刘备在此期间起兵。
由汉光武帝刘秀建立的中国朝代，是汉朝的延续，定都洛阳。它是三国的前身。其末期许贡、孙策等人物活跃，周瑜名义上为其臣子，曹昂在此期间生活并被举为孝廉。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty established by Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu), it was a continuation of the Han dynasty with its capital at Luoyang. It was the predecessor of the Three Kingdoms. During its late period, figures like Xu Gong and Sun Ce were active, Zhou Yu was nominally its subject, and Cao Ang lived during this period and was nominated as Xiaolian.

description.zh-cn: 北魏道士，吸收佛教思想改革道教。
中国南北朝时期的北方王朝之一，其采纳并实行了“子贵母死”制度。
description.en: One of the Northern Dynasties during the Northern and Southern dynasties period in China, which adopted and implemented the 'Heir Apparent's Mother is Executed' system.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第二位皇帝，在玄武门之变后即位。其为秦王时曾招揽房玄龄为重要谋士。在位期间，他开创了“贞观之治”，使唐朝国力强盛，并被尊为“天可汗”，推崇道教。他最初拒绝了松赞干布的和亲请求，但在松州之战后同意将文成公主嫁给他。他还因少林寺十三棍僧助唐有功而对其进行封赏，是李泰之父。
description.en: The second emperor of the Tang Dynasty, he ascended to the throne after the Xuanwu Gate Incident. As the Prince of Qin, he recruited Fang Xuanling as a key advisor. During his reign, he initiated the 'Reign of Zhenguan', which led to a powerful and prosperous Tang Dynasty. He was honored as the 'Tian Kehan' and promoted Taoism. He initially refused Songtsen Gampo's marriage proposal but later agreed to marry Princess Wencheng to him after the Battle of Songzhou. He also rewarded the Shaolin Temple's thirteen cudgel monks for their assistance and was the father of Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 全真道掌教，改革道教戒律，曾与成吉思汗会面。
金元时期兴起的道教宗派，由王重阳创立。
全真道的创始人。
记述老子到西域、天竺教化胡人的道教经典，在佛道之争中被判为伪经并遭焚毁。
description.en: A Taoist scripture that promotes the 'Laozi huahu' theory.

description.zh-cn: 道教经籍的总集。
中国历史上三次由帝王发动的的灭佛事件。
北宋第八位皇帝，宋高宗之父。他是一位艺术家，自创“瘦金书”字体。笃信道教，自称“教主道君皇帝”，并追封庄周为微妙元通真君。在位期间，他追封赵元佐为汉王，并将赵德芳的追封爵位由楚王改为秦王。后因靖康之变被俘，客死异乡。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Northern Song dynasty and father of Emperor Gaozong. He was an artist who created the "Slender Gold" calligraphy style. A devout Daoist, he proclaimed himself "Jiaozhu Daojun Emperor" and posthumously honored Zhuang Zhou as Weimiao Yuantong Zhenjun. During his reign, he posthumously re-ennobled Zhao Yuanzuo as the Prince of Han and changed Zhao Defang's posthumous title from Prince of Chu to Prince of Qin. He was later captured during the Jingkang incident and died in captivity.

description.zh-cn: 全真道掌教，丘处机弟子。他曾随丘处机西行，撰写《长春真人西游记》，并与佛教发生激烈冲突。
description.en: As a leader of Quanzhen Dao and a disciple of Qiu Chuji, he accompanied Qiu Chuji on his journey to the west, wrote 'Travels of the Perfect Man Changchun to the West', and had intense conflicts with Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 元代曹洞宗禅师，被元世祖忽必烈任命为少林寺住持，开创了少林寺的辉煌时代。
description.en: A Caodong school Zen master of the Yuan dynasty who was appointed abbot of the Shaolin Temple by Kublai Khan, ushering in a glorious era for the monastery.

description.zh-cn: 西晋天师道祭酒，撰写《老子化胡经》。
description.en: A Celestial Master libationer of the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西晋大乘佛教高僧。
一种认为老子西出函谷关后，到天竺教化胡人、成为佛陀的观点，是佛道之争的核心议题之一。
description.en: A doctrine claiming that Laozi went to India after passing through Hangu Pass and converted the 'barbarians', becoming the Buddha.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋时期思想家，道家学派和道教的创始人。其主要作品《道德经》是道家思想的核心著作。
description.en: A Chinese philosopher of the Spring and Autumn period, founder of philosophical Taoism and religious Taoism. His major work, the Tao Te Ching, is the core text of Taoist thought.

description.zh-cn: 庄子，中国战国中期思想家、哲学家、文学家，道家学派的代表人物，被道教奉为祖师，其著作《南华经》为重要经典。在古典小说《三国演义》中，他被神化为虚构人物南华真人，将《太平要术》传授给张角。
description.en: Zhuangzi, a philosopher, writer, and a representative figure of Taoism in mid-Warring States China, is revered as an ancestor by Taoists, with his work 'Nanhua Jing' being a significant classic. In the classic novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is deified as the fictional character True Man of Southern Hua, who bestowed the 'Essential Techniques for the Age of Great Peace' upon Zhang Jiao.

description.zh-cn: 指儒教、道教、佛教三家思想的融合与调和。
三国时期曹魏的著名诗人和文学家，曹操与卞氏嫡出之第三子。在其作品《辩道论》中批驳道教神仙说。
description.en: A famous poet and writer of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period, the third son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian.

en: Jim O'Neill, Baron O'Neill of Gatley

description.zh-cn: 前高盛首席经济师，于2001年首次提出“金砖四国”概念。
description.en: Former Goldman Sachs chief economist who first coined the term "BRIC" in 2001.

description.zh-cn: 巴西联邦共和国，南美洲最大的国家，金砖国家创始成员国。
description.en: The Federative Republic of Brazil, the largest country in South America, and a founding member of BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 于2011年正式加入金砖国家的成员国。
description.en: A member state that officially joined BRICS in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 在南非约翰内斯堡举行的第十五次金砖国家峰会，会上宣布邀请六个新成员国加入。
description.en: The 15th BRICS summit held in Johannesburg, South Africa, where six new member countries were invited to join.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕因饥荒曾前往避难的国家。
description.en: The country where Abraham took refuge during a famine.

zh-cn: 衣索比亚联邦民主共和国

description.zh-cn: 位于非洲之角的主权国家，是全球人口最多的内陆国家，亦为人口第二多的非洲国家。于2024年加入金砖国家。
description.en: A sovereign state in the Horn of Africa, it is the world's most populous landlocked country and the second-most populous country in Africa. It joined BRICS in 2024.

description.zh-cn: 于2024年加入金砖国家的成员国，并于2014年将“东伊运”列入恐怖主义组织名单。
description.en: Joined BRICS in 2024 and listed ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 曾受邀加入金砖国家，但在新政府上台后撤回了申请。
description.en: Was invited to join BRICS, but withdrew its application after a new government came to power.

description.zh-cn: 阿根廷总统，其上台后撤回了阿根廷加入金砖国家的申请。
description.en: President of Argentina who, after taking office, withdrew Argentina's application to join BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 东南亚国家，马来西亚的邻国。在马来西亚成立初期曾因领土问题发生冲突。于2025年成为金砖国家的正式成员。
description.en: A Southeast Asian country neighboring Malaysia. It had conflicts with Malaysia over territorial issues during the latter's early years. It will officially become a member of BRICS in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 该国位于东南亚，是一个联邦制、议会民主制、选举君主制和君主立宪制国家。它由前马来亚联合邦、北婆罗洲、砂拉越及新加坡于1963年9月16日所组成。新加坡曾于1963年至1965年间加入其联邦，成为新加坡州。目前，该国与中华人民共和国在南海诸岛存在主权争议，并预计于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
description.en: It is a federal parliamentary elective constitutional monarchy located in Southeast Asia. It was formed on 16 September 1963 by the merger of the existing Federation of Malaya, North Borneo, Sarawak, and Singapore. Singapore was a state within this federation from 1963 to 1965. Currently, the country has sovereignty disputes with the People's Republic of China over the South China Sea Islands, and is expected to become a BRICS partner in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
东欧国家，允许俄罗斯利用其领土对乌克兰发动攻击，被视为俄罗斯的盟友。于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
description.en: An Eastern European country that has allowed Russia to use its territory to launch attacks on Ukraine, considered an ally of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
于2025年成为金砖伙伴国。
第六届金砖国家峰会，会上宣布成立新开发银行。
由金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）成立的多边开发银行，总部设在中国上海。
description.en: A multilateral development bank established by the BRICS states (Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa), headquartered in Shanghai, China.

description.zh-cn: 印度现任总理。
南非现任总统。
埃及现任总统。
埃塞俄比亚政治家，自2018年起担任埃塞俄比亚总理。他因结束与邻国厄立特里亚长达20年的战争而获得2019年诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: An Ethiopian politician serving as the Prime Minister of Ethiopia since 2018. He was awarded the 2019 Nobel Peace Prize for his work in ending the 20-year-long war with neighboring Eritrea.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗现任总统。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬
穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·萨丹·阿勒纳哈扬

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国第三任总统、阿布扎比统治者。他是阿联酋首任总统扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬的第三子。
description.en: The third president of the United Arab Emirates and ruler of Abu Dhabi. He is the third son of Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, the first president of the UAE.

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚现任总统。
梵蒂冈城邦的前身，是在756年由“丕平献土”事件后成立的政教合一主权国家，其领土曾广及意大利半岛中部。
description.en: The predecessor to the Vatican City State, a sovereign theocratic state established in 756 after the 'Donation of Pepin', which once controlled large territories in central Italy.

description.zh-cn: 由意大利王国与圣座为解决“罗马问题”而签订的条约，正式确立并承认梵蒂冈城邦为主权国家。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Kingdom of Italy and the Holy See to resolve the 'Roman Question', which recognized Vatican City as a sovereign state.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会第259任教宗。他是庇护十二世的前任，曾将庇护十二世擢升为枢机，并代表圣座签署了《拉特兰条约》。
description.en: The 259th Pope of the Catholic Church. He was the predecessor of Pius XII, elevated Pius XII to the cardinalate, and signed the Lateran Treaty on behalf of the Holy See.

description.zh-cn: 法兰克国王丕平将意大利中部的大片领土（包括罗马城及其周围区域）赠予教宗的历史事件，奠定了教宗国的基础。
description.en: A historical event in which Pepin, King of the Franks, granted the Pope large territories in central Italy.

description.zh-cn: 法兰克王国国王，将罗马城及其周围区域赠予教宗，史称“丕平献土”，奠定了教宗国的基础。
description.en: King of the Franks, who donated the city of Rome and its surrounding areas to the Pope, known as the 'Donation of Pepin', laying the foundation for the Papal States.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪在意大利半岛发生的政治及社会运动，旨在结束各国林立及外国势力干预，将意大利半岛的各个国家统一为一个国家，最终导致了教宗国的终结。
description.en: The 19th-century political and social movement that resulted in the consolidation of different states of the Italian Peninsula into a single state, the Kingdom of Italy.

description.zh-cn: 意大利统一运动的领导者。

zh-cn: 罗伯特·方济各·普雷沃斯特

description.zh-cn: 梵蒂冈城国国家元首（教宗）。
梵蒂冈城国政府主席。

zh-cn: 恩仁·玛利亚·若瑟·若望·派契利

death_place.zh-cn: 梵蒂冈冈多菲堡宗座宫
death_place.en: Apostolic Palace of Castel Gandolfo, Vatican City

description.zh-cn: 天主教会第260任教宗，原名恩仁·玛利亚·若瑟·若望·派契利。曾任驻巴伐利亚大使、驻普鲁士大使、国务枢机卿和总务枢机。2009年12月19日获列为可敬者。其教宗任期与第二次世界大战重叠。
description.en: The 260th Pope of the Catholic Church, born Eugenio Maria Giuseppe Giovanni Pacelli. He previously served as Apostolic Nuncio to Bavaria, Apostolic Nuncio to Prussia, Cardinal Secretary of State, and Camerlengo of the Holy Roman Church. He was proclaimed Venerable on 19 December 2009. His pontificate coincided with World War II.

description.zh-cn: 罗马是意大利首都，曾是辉煌的罗马帝国中心。使徒保罗在此被囚禁并殉道，也是教宗庇护十二世的出生地。此外，它还是日本东京都的姊妹友好都市。
description.en: Rome is the capital of Italy and was once the center of the glorious Roman Empire. The Apostle Paul was imprisoned and martyred here, and it is also the birthplace of Pope Pius XII. Furthermore, it is a sister city of Tokyo Metropolis in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 圣座的行政机构，同时也是天主教会的中央政府，它协助教宗处理整个天主教会的事务。其对来华传教政策的改变（中国礼仪之争）导致清朝禁教，中断了第一阶段的西学东渐。
description.en: The administrative apparatus of the Holy See, also serving as the central government of the Catholic Church, it assists the Pope in governing its affairs. Its change in policy regarding Chinese rites led to the Qing dynasty's prohibition of Christianity, interrupting the first phase of the West-to-East knowledge transfer.

description.zh-cn: 罗马教廷中综理圣座行政并掌理教宗枢密事务的机构。
圣座国务枢机卿。
比利时第七任国王。
比利时政治人物，比利时首相。
19世纪的欧洲国家，由今荷兰、比利时、卢森堡组成。
导致南尼德兰（主要是现代比利时）从荷兰联合王国独立的革命。
欧洲联盟的前身之一。
比利时第二任国王，刚果自由邦的私人所有者，同时也是斯蒂芬妮公主的父亲。
description.en: Second King of the Belgians, private owner of the Congo Free State, and father of Princess Stéphanie.

description.zh-cn: 利奥波德二世的私人领地，位于中非。
比利时在非洲的殖民地。
比利时在非洲的殖民地。
比利时第六任国王，于2013年退位。
比利时政治人物，曾任比利时首相。
比利时首位女首相。

zh-cn: 伊拉克和沙姆伊斯兰国
伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国
en: Islamic State of Iraq and al-Sham
Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant

description.zh-cn: 趁阿拉伯之春造成的地区动荡而崛起的极端恐怖组织，曾控制叙利亚和伊拉克的大片区域。
description.en: An extremist terrorist organization that rose to prominence amid the regional instability caused by the Arab Spring, once controlling large areas of Syria and Iraq.

description.zh-cn: 比利时首都。卡尔·马克思曾在此流亡并出版了《哲学的贫困》。
description.en: The capital of Belgium. Karl Marx lived here in exile and published 'The Poverty of Philosophy'.

description.zh-cn: 比利时第一任国王。
比利时漫画家，《丁丁历险记》的作者。
比利时漫画家埃尔热创作的系列漫画作品。
欧盟的行政及执行机构。
欧盟的司法机构。
欧洲理事会主席
德国政治家，现任欧洲联盟执行委员会主席。
description.en: A German politician who is the current President of the European Commission.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲议会议长
欧洲联盟的前身之一。
法律上独立于欧盟的国际组织，但在欧洲共同体的管辖范围内。
由欧洲煤钢共同体、欧洲经济共同体和欧洲原子能共同体合并而成，是欧盟的前身。
时任法国外交部长
英国退出欧洲联盟的政治进程。
description.en: The political process of the United Kingdom's withdrawal from the European Union.

en: 2016 United Kingdom European Union membership referendum

description.zh-cn: 位于欧洲西北部的构成国，是荷兰王国的主要组成部分，也是欧盟创始成员国之一。该欧洲国家曾于1641年从葡萄牙手中夺取马六甲。
description.en: A constituent country located in Northwestern Europe, the main component of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, and a founding member of the EU. This European country captured Malacca from the Portuguese in 1641.

description.zh-cn: 欧盟创始成员国之一
乌克兰政治家，现任乌克兰总统。他在2022年俄罗斯全面入侵后，领导乌克兰进行抵抗。
description.en: Ukrainian politician and current President of Ukraine. He has led the country's defense against the 2022 full-scale Russian invasion.

description.zh-cn: 一个欧盟成员国，位于中欧和东南欧的交汇处。
description.en: An EU member state, located at the crossroads of Central and Southeast Europe.

zh-cn: 基尔·罗德尼·斯塔默爵士
en: The Rt Hon. Sir Keir Starmer

description.zh-cn: 英国工党籍政治人物、御用大律师，现任英国首相及工党党魁。他自2015年起担任霍本和圣潘克拉斯选区的国会议员。
description.en: A British Labour politician and King's Counsel, currently serving as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Labour Party. He has been the Member of Parliament for Holborn and St Pancras since 2015.

description.zh-cn: 英国的最高立法机关。
七年战争中的主要参战国，与普鲁士结盟对抗法国及其盟友。战争的最大赢家，获得了法国在北美和印度的大量殖民地，成为世界霸主。
description.en: A major participant in the Seven Years' War, allied with Prussia against France and its allies. The war's biggest victor, gaining vast French colonies in North America and India, and becoming the dominant world power.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽二世的父亲，英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王。由于其天主教信仰和亲法政策，他在1688年的光荣革命中被废黜并流亡法国。
description.en: Father of Mary II, and King of England, Scotland, and Ireland. Due to his Catholic faith and pro-French policies, he was deposed in the Glorious Revolution of 1688 and exiled to France.

description.zh-cn: 1688年发生于英格兰的一场政变，导致信奉天主教的国王詹姆斯二世被废黜，其信奉新教的女儿玛丽二世和女婿威廉三世共同登基。
description.en: A coup that took place in England in 1688, leading to the deposition of the Catholic King James II and the accession of his Protestant daughter Mary II and her husband William III.

description.zh-cn: 奥兰治亲王，通过与妻子玛丽二世的婚姻，在1688年光荣革命后成为英格兰、苏格兰及爱尔兰国王。他领导了反法的大同盟战争。
description.en: Prince of Orange who, through his marriage to Mary II, became King of England, Scotland, and Ireland after the Glorious Revolution of 1688. He led the Grand Alliance against France.

birth_place.zh-cn: 英格兰伦敦圣詹姆斯宫

description.zh-cn: 英国斯图亚特王朝女王。在其父詹姆斯二世因光荣革命被废黜后，她与丈夫兼表兄威廉三世于1689年共同即位，成为英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰的女王。统治期间，她签署了限制王权的《权利法案》。当威廉在海外参与军事战役时，她独立执政，展现出强大果决的统治能力。
description.en: Queen of England, Scotland, and Ireland from the House of Stuart. Following the deposition of her father, James II, in the Glorious Revolution, she and her husband and cousin, William III, ascended the throne jointly in 1689. During her reign, she signed the Bill of Rights, which limited royal power. When William was engaged in military campaigns abroad, she governed alone, proving to be a strong and decisive ruler.

description.zh-cn: 英国的中右翼政党，马尔康·芮夫金是其成员。
description.en: A centre-right political party in the United Kingdom, of which Malcolm Rifkind is a member.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，被广泛誉为自由主义之父和早期启蒙运动思想家。
一种哲学理论，认为知识仅来自或主要来自感官经验。
英国博物学家、地质学家和生物学家，以其对进化科学的贡献而闻名。
研究生命的自然科学。
英国摇滚乐队，被广泛认为是有史以来最有影响力的乐队。
乌克兰现任总理
乌克兰最高拉达主席
乌克兰的最高立法机关，即一院制议会。
description.en: The supreme legislative body of Ukraine, its unicameral parliament.

zh-cn: 克里米亚转交苏维埃乌克兰

description.zh-cn: 于2014年2月在乌克兰爆发的革命，是广场起义的最终阶段。它导致时任总统维克多·亚努科维奇被罢免，并重组新政府。此事件直接引发了后续的俄乌战争。
description.en: A revolution that took place in Ukraine in February 2014, marking the final phase of the Euromaidan protests. It led to the ousting of then-President Viktor Yanukovych and the formation of a new government. This event directly triggered the subsequent Russo-Ukrainian War.

zh-cn: 维克多·费奥多罗维奇·亚努科维奇

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰前总统。因在2013年拒绝与欧盟签订联合协议，引发了2014年的迈丹革命（广场起义），最终被罢免并逃往俄罗斯。
description.en: Former President of Ukraine. His refusal to sign an association agreement with the EU in 2013 triggered the Euromaidan Revolution, leading to his ousting in 2014 and flight to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗长子术赤之子，金帐汗国的建立者，是推举蒙哥称汗的关键人物。
description.en: Son of Jochi, the eldest son of Genghis Khan, founder of the Golden Horde, and a key figure in the election of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰的首都和最大城市。
description.en: The capital and largest city of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 1932年至1933年间在苏联乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国发生的大规模饥荒，造成数百万乌克兰人死亡，被许多国家认为是种族清洗。
description.en: A man-made famine in the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic from 1932 to 1933 that killed millions of Ukrainians, considered a genocide by many countries.

location.zh-cn: 乌克兰东部顿巴斯地区

description.zh-cn: 在乌克兰东部顿巴斯地区，于2014年2月至2022年2月间爆发的武装冲突，本质上是一场混合战争。冲突双方为乌克兰政府军与俄罗斯支持的亲俄武装（包括顿涅茨克、卢甘斯克分离主义势力），最终升级为2022年俄罗斯对乌克兰的全面入侵。
description.en: An armed conflict, essentially a hybrid war, broke out in the Donbas region of eastern Ukraine from February 2014 to February 2022. It involved clashes between Ukrainian government forces and Russia-backed pro-Russian forces (including separatists from Donetsk and Luhansk), eventually escalating into the 2022 full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期，大总统府与国务院之间的权力斗争，史称府院之争。黎元洪与段祺瑞是早期核心人物，后期主要发生在冯国璋与段祺瑞之间。1917年，围绕是否参加第一次世界大战，大总统府（黎元洪）与国务院（段祺瑞）的政治争端激化。此次争端直接导致段祺瑞被免职和张勋入京，并为张勋复辟创造了条件。
description.en: The power struggle between the Presidential Palace and the State Council during the Beiyang government period of the Republic of China, known as the 'Government-Presidential Dispute'. Li Yuanhong and Duan Qirui were key figures in the early phase, with the struggle later primarily involving Feng Guozhang and Duan Qirui. In 1917, the political dispute between the Presidential Palace (Li Yuanhong) and the State Council (Duan Qirui) intensified over whether to participate in World War I. This dispute directly led to Duan Qirui's dismissal and Zhang Xun's entry into Beijing, creating conditions for Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration.

description.zh-cn: 由前清遗臣张勋等人于1917年7月1日发动的、旨在恢复清朝统治的未遂政变。张勋率军进入北京，拥立清朝逊位皇帝溥仪复辟。该事件仅持续十二天，最终被段祺瑞组织的讨逆军迅速平定。这是中华民国军阀割据时期的一次重要政治事件。
description.en: An unsuccessful coup launched on July 1, 1917, by former Qing loyalist Zhang Xun and others, aiming to restore Qing rule. Zhang Xun led troops into Beijing to enthrone the abdicated Qing emperor Puyi. The event lasted only twelve days, ending in failure and quickly suppressed by the punitive army organized by Duan Qirui. This was a significant political event during the Warlord Era of the Republic of China.

en: Republic of China declaration of war on Germany

description.zh-cn: 1917年中华民国国会讨论的是否对德意志帝国宣战的议案。
中华民国军事将领，直系军阀首领之一，曾任中华民国第五任大总统。他在甲子政变中被冯玉祥软禁。
description.en: A Chinese warlord, leader of the Zhili clique, and the fifth President of the Republic of China. He was imprisoned by Feng Yuxiang during the Beijing Coup.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国早期最重要的军阀势力之一，由袁世凯培植的北洋新军主要将领组成。该军事政治集团在民国初年控制北洋政府。袁世凯死后于1916年分裂为多个派系，形成军阀割据局面。
description.en: A military-political group that controlled the Beiyang government in the early Republic of China. It was one of the most important warlord factions, composed of the main generals of the Beiyang New Army cultivated by Yuan Shikai. After Yuan's death in 1916, it split into several cliques, leading to a period of warlordism.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期，以段祺瑞为首的北洋军阀主要派系。受日本支持，是组织讨逆军、平定张勋复辟的核心力量。
description.en: During the Beiyang government era of the Republic of China, it was a major Beiyang warlord faction led by Duan Qirui. Supported by Japan, it was the core force in organizing the anti-restoration army and quelling Zhang Xun's restoration.

description.zh-cn: 北洋军阀的主要派系之一，由冯国璋领导，以冯国璋、曹锟、吴佩孚为主要代表。该派系受英美两国支持，曾参与讨伐张勋复辟的行动。孙殿英早年曾加入该派系。
description.en: One of the main factions of the Beiyang Warlords, led by Feng Guozhang and primarily represented by Feng Guozhang, Cao Kun, and Wu Peifu. This faction was supported by the United Kingdom and the United States, participated in the campaign against Zhang Xun's restoration, and Sun Dianying joined it in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年的国都，位于今江苏省南京市。在靖难之役最后阶段被燕军攻陷。
description.en: The capital of the early Ming Dynasty, located in present-day Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province. It was captured by the Yan army in the final stage of the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 明初四大案之一，明太祖朱元璋诛杀宰相胡惟庸，并株连众多功臣宿将的重大政治事件。胡惟庸被指控谋反，导致数万人被处死。此案后，朱元璋废除了丞相制度。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the early Ming dynasty. It refers to the major political event where the Hongwu Emperor (Zhu Yuanzhang) executed Chancellor Hu Weiyong and implicated numerous meritorious officials. Hu Weiyong was accused of treason, leading to the execution of tens of thousands of people. Following this case, Zhu Yuanzhang abolished the chancellorship.

description.zh-cn: 明初四大案之一，大将军蓝玉被指控谋反，超过一万五千人被株连。
description.en: One of the Four Major Cases of the Early Ming Dynasty. General Lan Yu was accused of treason, resulting in the implication and execution of over 15,000 people.

description.zh-cn: 古代中国辅佐君主处理政务的最高官职。
description.en: The highest official position in ancient China, assisting the monarch in handling government affairs.

description.zh-cn: 明朝与瓦剌在土木堡发生的一场战役。此战中明英宗被俘，直接导致朱祁钰被拥立为帝，并成为明朝由盛转衰的转折点之一。
description.en: A military conflict between the Ming Dynasty and the Oirats at Tumu Fortress. Emperor Yingzong was captured in this battle, directly leading to Zhu Qiyu being enthroned, and it is considered a turning point from prosperity to decline for the Ming Dynasty.

birth_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
birth_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

death_place.zh-cn: 大明北直隶顺天府紫禁城
death_place.en: Forbidden City, Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, Ming Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗长子，明朝第六位和第八位皇帝，景泰帝的异母兄长，年号正统和天顺。其在位期间，经历土木堡之变被俘，后发动“夺门之变”复辟。并在孙太后去世后，恢复了胡善祥的皇后名号，最终废除了宫妃殉葬制度。
description.en: The Zhengtong and Tianshun Emperor (personal name Zhu Qizhen) was the sixth and eighth emperor of the Ming dynasty, the eldest son of the Xuande Emperor, and the elder half-brother of the Jingtai Emperor. During his reign, he was captured in the Tumu Crisis, later restored to the throne through the Duomen Coup. After the death of Empress Dowager Sun, he posthumously restored Hu Shanxiang's title of Empress, and eventually abolished the system of concubine burial.

description.zh-cn: 明朝宦官，在英宗首次在位期间专权，怂恿英宗亲征导致土木堡之变，并在此役中被杀。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch who monopolized power during Emperor Yingzong's first reign. He instigated the emperor to personally lead the expedition that resulted in the Tumu Crisis, where he was killed.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古族的一支，在土木堡之变中俘虏了明英宗。
description.en: A group of Mongol tribes that captured Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 瓦剌太师，在土木堡之变中俘虏明英宗，后率军围攻北京并将其送还明朝。
description.en: The Taishi of the Oirats who captured Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis, later besieged Beijing, and eventually returned him to the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝名臣，官至兵部尚书、太子太傅。在土木堡之变后拥立朱祁钰（景泰帝）为帝，并领导北京保卫战取得胜利。后在夺门之变后被明英宗以谋逆罪杀害。
description.en: A famous official of the Ming dynasty, serving as Minister of War and Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince. He supported Zhu Qiyu (the Jingtai Emperor)'s ascension to the throne after the Tumu Crisis and led the Defense of Beijing to victory. He was later executed for treason by Emperor Yingzong after the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第七位皇帝（1449年-1457年在位），明宣宗朱瞻基次子，明英宗朱祁镇异母弟。因土木堡之变中兄长被俘而即位，后在夺门之变中被复辟的兄长废黜。
description.en: The Jingtai Emperor (personal name Zhu Qiyu) was the seventh emperor of the Ming dynasty, reigning from 1449 to 1457. He was the second son of the Xuande Emperor and the younger half-brother of the Zhengtong Emperor. He ascended the throne after his brother was captured in the Tumu Crisis, and was later deposed by his brother in the Duomen Coup.

description.zh-cn: 土木堡之变后，于谦领导明军成功抗击并抵御了瓦剌对北京的入侵。
description.en: Following the Tumu Crisis, the Ming army, led by Yu Qian, successfully defended Beijing against the Oirat invasion.

description.zh-cn: 明代宗景泰八年（1457年），曹吉祥、石亨、徐有贞等人趁景泰帝病重，发动宫廷军事政变，拥立被软禁的太上皇朱祁镇（明英宗）复辟，成功夺回皇位，景泰帝被废。
description.en: A military and palace coup launched in 1457 (the 8th year of Emperor Jingtai's reign) by Cao Jixiang, Shi Heng, Xu Youzhen, and others. Taking advantage of Emperor Jingtai's illness, they restored the imprisoned Emperor Emeritus Zhu Qizhen (Emperor Yingzong) to the throne, successfully retaking the imperial power, and Emperor Jingtai was deposed.

description.zh-cn: 明朝万历前期内阁首辅，著名改革家，万历初年改革的推行者。曾任明神宗帝师、明穆宗顾命大臣。其在位期间，曾对李成梁杀降冒功的行为有所偏袒。
description.en: Grand Secretary during the early Wanli era of the Ming Dynasty, a renowned reformer, and a promoter of reforms in the early Wanli period. He served as the imperial tutor to Emperor Shenzong and a regent minister appointed by Emperor Muzong. During his tenure, he showed favoritism towards Li Chengliang regarding his misconduct of killing surrendered enemies to claim merits.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗在位前十年，在张居正的辅佐下，明朝出现的短暂中兴局面。
明穆宗第三子，明朝第十三位皇帝，明代在位时间最长的皇帝，明光宗之父。其遗骸于1966年8月被红卫兵焚毁。
description.en: The third son of Emperor Muzong of Ming, the 13th and longest-reigning emperor of the Ming Dynasty, and father of Emperor Guangzong of Ming. His remains were burned by Red Guards in August 1966.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗在位中后期，长期不理朝政的现象。
后金与明朝的战略决战，以后金大胜告终。
中国明朝末期宦官，天启年间权倾朝野，人称“九千岁”。他掌控朝政，与客氏结盟，拉拢齐楚浙党组成阉党，残酷打击东林党人。其党羽曾与袁崇焕在辽东事务上产生摩擦。崇祯帝即位后，他被清算，最终畏罪自杀，尸身被凌迟。
description.en: A Chinese eunuch who lived in the late Ming dynasty. Known as the 'Nine Thousand Years', he held immense power during the Tianqi era and controlled the court. He formed a political alliance with Madam Ke and created the 'Eunuch Party' by aligning with officials from the Qi, Chu, and Zhe factions, brutally persecuting the Donglin Party. His associates clashed with Yuan Chonghuan over Liaodong affairs. He was purged after the Chongzhen Emperor ascended the throne, eventually committing suicide to avoid capture, and his corpse was subjected to lingchi.

description.zh-cn: 天启年间，以宦官魏忠贤为首的政治集团，成员包括依附于他的宦官和部分朝臣。该集团在天启朝后期把持朝政，与东林党进行了激烈的党争，排斥和迫害东林党人，造成了严重的政治腐败。
description.en: During the Tianqi era, a political faction led by the eunuch Wei Zhongxian, comprising loyal eunuchs and court officials, emerged. This group controlled the government in the late Tianqi reign, engaging in a fierce power struggle with the Donglin Party, persecuting its members, and causing severe political corruption.

description.zh-cn: 晚明时期的一个士大夫政治集团，主张开放言路、澄清吏治、改良朝政。在天启朝早期，他们曾一度“众正盈朝”，后遭到魏忠贤为首的阉党残酷镇压。
description.en: A political faction of scholar-officials in the late Ming dynasty, advocating for open criticism, clean governance, and political reform. They held significant influence in the early Tianqi era, leading to a period described as 'all righteous officials filling the court', but were later brutally suppressed by the Eunuch Faction led by Wei Zhongxian.

description.zh-cn: 儒家哲学流派
罗马教宗
根据《凡尔登条约》从法兰克王国分裂出的国家，为神圣罗马帝国的前身。
中世纪欧洲神圣罗马帝国皇帝与罗马教廷之间关于主教叙任权的斗争。

zh-cn: 亨利四世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，叙任权斗争中的关键人物。
罗马教宗，推动克吕尼改革，与亨利四世发生冲突。
神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利五世与教宗和主教们达成的协议，结束了叙任权斗争。

zh-cn: 腓特烈二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 霍亨斯陶芬王朝的神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
神圣罗马帝国史上没有一位国王能得到普遍认可的时期，导致诸侯权力扩大。
欧洲历史上一次大规模的国际战争，主要在德意志地区进行，对当地经济和人口造成了巨大破坏。它削弱了哈布斯堡家族的实力，并标志着神圣罗马帝国衰落的开端。
description.en: A large-scale international war in European history, primarily fought in the German lands, which caused immense economic and demographic devastation. It weakened the power of the House of Habsburg and marked the beginning of the decline of the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 结束三十年战争的一系列和约，确立了神圣罗马帝国内诸侯的主权。
神圣罗马帝国的主要邦国，哈布斯堡王朝的核心领地。著名的玛丽·安托瓦内特即出身于此。
description.en: A major state within the Holy Roman Empire and the heartland of the Habsburg monarchy, it was Marie Antoinette's country of origin.

description.zh-cn: 由拿破仑一世在德意志地区组建的亲法邦联，是法兰西第一帝国的卫星国。其成员脱离了神圣罗马帝国，也是神圣罗马帝国解体的直接原因之一。
description.en: A pro-French confederation established by Napoleon I in the German region, serving as a satellite state of the First French Empire. Its members seceded from the Holy Roman Empire, and its formation was also one of the direct causes of the Holy Roman Empire's dissolution.

zh-cn: 弗朗茨二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡-洛林王朝成员，神圣罗马帝国末任皇帝。为应对拿破仑称帝，他创立奥地利皇位并成为首任奥地利皇帝（弗朗茨一世）。1806年奥斯特里茨战役战败后，他于8月6日宣布解散神圣罗马帝国。
description.en: A member of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine and the last Holy Roman Emperor. In response to Napoleon crowning himself emperor, he founded the Austrian imperial title and became the first Emperor of Austria (as Francis I). After the defeat at the Battle of Austerlitz, he announced the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire on August 6, 1806.

en: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国正式灭亡的事件。
法兰克王国国王，800年被加冕为“罗马人的皇帝”。
为查理曼加冕的罗马教宗。
奥地利帝国是神圣罗马皇帝弗朗茨二世于1804年建立的国家，一个19世纪中欧的多民族帝国。曾判处被从萨克森引渡的巴枯宁死刑。
description.en: The Austrian Empire, established in 1804 by Holy Roman Emperor Francis II, was a multinational empire in Central Europe during the 19th century. It once sentenced Bakunin, who was extradited from Saxony, to death.

zh-cn: 查理五世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡王朝的君主，同时统治神圣罗马帝国和西班牙帝国。作为神圣罗马帝国皇帝，他在宗教改革期间持反对立场，镇压改革势力并宣布马丁·路德为异端。
description.en: A Habsburg monarch who ruled both the Holy Roman Empire and the Spanish Empire. As Holy Roman Emperor, he opposed the Protestant Reformation, suppressed reformist forces, and declared Martin Luther a heretic.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗第二任最高领袖。他将阿米尼示威定性为“暴乱”，并指责其由美国及以色列策划。
description.en: The second Supreme Leader of Iran, who characterized the Mahsa Amini protests as 'riots' and accused the United States and Israel of planning them.

description.zh-cn: 现任伊朗第一副总统。

zh-cn: 穆罕默德-巴盖尔·加利巴夫

description.zh-cn: 现任伊斯兰议会议长。
伊朗伊斯兰共和国的最高立法机构。
导致巴列维王朝覆亡、伊朗伊斯兰共和国成立的革命。
统治伊朗的最后一个王朝。
伊朗伊斯兰革命的政治和精神领袖，伊朗伊斯兰共和国的创始人和第一任最高领袖。
description.en: The political and spiritual leader of the Iranian Revolution, the founder and first Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

location.en: Embassy of the United States, Tehran

description.zh-cn: 1979年伊朗革命后，伊朗穆斯林群众占领美国驻伊朗大使馆，扣留66名美国外交官和平民长达444天，引发一场危机。
description.en: A crisis following the 1979 Iranian Revolution where 66 American diplomats and civilians were held hostage for 444 days after the U.S. Embassy in Tehran was seized.

description.zh-cn: 巴列维王朝的创始人。
1951年当选的伊朗改革派首相，后于1953年在美国和英国支持的政变中被推翻。
description.en: The reformist Prime Minister of Iran elected in 1951, who was overthrown in a 1953 coup backed by the United States and the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 由美国中央情报局策划的推翻伊朗首相摩萨台的政变。
巴列维国王推行的一系列农业与工业改革。
伊朗与伊拉克之间长达8年的边境战争。
伊拉克共和国。
前伊拉克总统，曾发动两伊战争，其政权在美国发动的伊拉克战争中被推翻。
description.en: Former President of Iraq, whose regime was overthrown in the U.S.-led Iraq War.

birth_place.zh-cn: 美国康涅狄格州纽黑文市

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，第43任总统。他是芭芭拉·布什与乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什的儿子，其父也曾担任总统。他在九一一袭击事件后获得了创纪录的90%支持率。有学者认为，其政府解放了伊拉克的什叶派多数，促成了什叶派的复兴。2008年，他曾在白宫会见魏京生等五名中国异议人士。
description.en: American politician and the 43rd President of the United States. He is the son of Barbara Bush and George H. W. Bush, whose father also served as president. He achieved a record 90% approval rating following the September 11 attacks. Some scholars believe his administration liberated the Shia majority in Iraq, contributing to a Shia revival. In 2008, he met with Wei Jingsheng and four other Chinese dissidents at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 指参与伊朗核问题谈判的六个世界大国，包括联合国安理会五个常任理事国（中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国、美国）以及德国。
曾任伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队圣城旅指挥官。
22岁的伊朗库尔德族女子玛莎·阿米尼因“违反着装规范”被指导巡逻队逮捕后于医院死亡。她的死是引发全国性阿米尼示威的直接导火索。
description.en: Mahsa Amini, a 22-year-old Iranian Kurdish woman, died in a hospital after being arrested by the Guidance Patrol for an 'improper hijab.' Her death was the direct trigger for the nationwide Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 自2022年9月16日以来在伊朗爆发的大规模示威运动，由玛莎·阿米尼之死引发，抗议强制佩戴头巾及伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府的统治。
description.en: A series of large-scale protests that began in Iran on September 16, 2022, sparked by the death of Mahsa Amini, protesting against the compulsory hijab and the rule of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 以色列国。在军事上与新加坡关系紧密，曾派遣军官指导新加坡军队的建立。同时，伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊曾指责以色列与美国共同策划阿米尼示威，而以色列总理则批评伊朗政权为“杀人政府”。
description.en: Israel. It has close military ties with Singapore, having dispatched officers to guide the establishment of the Singaporean army. Concurrently, Iran's Supreme Leader Khamenei accused Israel of co-planning the Amini protests with the United States, while the Israeli Prime Minister criticized the Iranian regime as a 'murderous regime'.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国的武装部队之一，负责维护伊斯兰教义和国内秩序。其总司令侯赛因·萨拉米曾警告示威者，并指控沙特阿拉伯支持示威。
description.en: One of the armed forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran, responsible for maintaining Islamic doctrines and domestic order. Its commander, Hossein Salami, has warned protesters and accused Saudi Arabia of supporting the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 负责选举、监督、罢免伊朗最高领袖的机构。

en: Armed Forces of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 国际联盟李顿调查团就九一八事变发表的调查报告。报告谴责了日本的行为，并指出满洲国并非独立运动产物，但主张承认日本在东北的特殊地位。
description.en: The investigation report on the Mukden Incident published by the League of Nations' Lytton Commission. It condemned Japan's actions, concluded that Manchukuo was not a product of an independence movement, but advocated for recognizing Japan's special status in Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 满洲国首任国务总理大臣。
日本陆军中将，时任关东军作战主任参谋，是九一八事变的主要策划者之一。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the Imperial Japanese Army who was the Operations Staff Officer of the Kwantung Army and one of the chief masterminds of the Mukden Incident.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室成员，曾任吉林省代理长官。他向日本投降并推动建立满洲国，后成为满洲国政治人物。他也是东京振武学校的校友。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial family, he served as the acting governor of Jilin Province. He surrendered to Japan and promoted the establishment of Manchukuo, later becoming a political figure in Manchukuo. He was also an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 满洲国成立前的过渡政权机构。
日本与满洲国签订的条约，规定日本承认满洲国并拥有驻军权，确立了日本对满洲国的控制。
溥仪于1945年8月18日宣读的诏书，宣告满洲国终结。

zh-cn: 阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·阿卜杜拉赫曼·本·费萨尔·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 现代沙乌地阿拉伯王国的开国君主。

zh-cn: 萨勒曼·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第七任国王。
沙乌地阿拉伯王储兼首相。
伊斯兰教是一种以《古兰经》为核心，圣训为辅助的亚伯拉罕一神教。它是世界三大宗教之一，也是沙烏地阿拉伯的国教。
description.en: Islam is an Abrahamic monotheistic religion centered on the Quran and supplemented by the Hadith. It is one of the three major world religions and the state religion of Saudi Arabia.

description.zh-cn: 逊尼派伊斯兰教内的伊斯兰复兴主义和原教旨主义运动，由穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜发起。其信徒自称“一神论者”，教义极端保守。该运动是沙特阿拉伯奉行的官方意识形态和国教，属逊尼派一支。
description.en: An Islamic revivalist and fundamentalist movement within Sunni Islam, founded by Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab. Its followers refer to themselves as 'Muwahhidun' (Unitarians) and hold ultraconservative doctrines. It is the official state ideology and state religion adopted by Saudi Arabia, belonging to a branch of Sunni Islam.

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地新闻工作者及异议人士。
沙乌地阿拉伯前王储。

zh-cn: 沙特·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第二任国王。

zh-cn: 费萨尔·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒沙特

description.zh-cn: 沙乌地阿拉伯第三任国王。
伊斯兰教的第二大教派，与逊尼派并称。其追随者认为穆罕默德的女婿阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜是其正统继承人。该教派占穆斯林总数的10%至20%，被瓦哈比派视为异端，在沙乌地阿拉伯是少数派并受到压制。
description.en: The second-largest branch of Islam, alongside Sunni Islam. Comprising 10% to 20% of all Muslims, its adherents believe that Prophet Muhammad's son-in-law, Ali ibn Abi Talib, was his rightful successor. It is considered heretical by Wahhabism, is a minority in Saudi Arabia, and is suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 该亚洲国家是突厥斯坦伊斯兰党的创始地之一，并曾作为该组织的反对者，参与对其的打击行动。它也曾被毛泽东在阐述“一条线”战略时提及，作为联合抗苏的对象之一。
description.en: This Asian country was one of the founding locations of the Turkistan Islamic Party, and as an opponent of the group, participated in operations against it. It was also mentioned by Mao Zedong when explaining the 'one line' strategy, as one of the targets for a united front against the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教中最重要的经典，被认为是真主安拉的启示，通过天使加百列传授给先知穆罕默德。内容涉及伊斯兰教的基本信仰、先知故事、伦理法律、历史事件等。它不仅是伊斯兰教的核心宗教文本，也被沙特阿拉伯等国视为最高宪法。
description.en: The most important scripture in Islam, believed to be a revelation from God (Allah), transmitted through the angel Gabriel to the Prophet Muhammad. Its content covers the fundamental beliefs of Islam, stories of prophets, ethical and legal issues, historical events, and more. It is not only the core religious text of Islam but also regarded as the supreme constitution in countries like Saudi Arabia.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的法律体系，其主要法源是《古兰经》和《圣训》。它是沙乌地阿拉伯国家行事的法律依据。
description.en: The legal system of Islam, with its primary sources being the Quran and the Hadith. It serves as the legal basis for the actions of the state of Saudi Arabia.

zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜
穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜·瓦哈布
穆罕默德·伊本·阿布杜勒·瓦哈比

description.zh-cn: 18世纪在沙特阿拉伯推动赛莱菲复兴运动的伊斯兰学者，瓦哈比派的创始人。
description.en: An 18th-century Islamic scholar in Saudi Arabia who promoted the Salafi revival movement; the founder of Wahhabism.

description.zh-cn: 德拉伊耶的部落酋长，绍德家族的领袖，与穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜合作建立了第一个沙特国家。
description.en: The tribal chief of Diriyah and leader of the House of Saud, who collaborated with Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab to establish the first Saudi state.

description.zh-cn: 原中共中央军委办公室主任。
原上海申能集团副总经理。曾任黄菊秘书，因涉嫌向陈良宇通风报信及受贿而在陈良宇事件中被捕。
description.en: Former Deputy General Manager of Shanghai Shenneng Group and former secretary to Huang Ju. He was arrested during the Chen Liangyu incident for allegedly tipping off Chen Liangyu and accepting bribes.

description.zh-cn: 原中共中央警卫局局长。
原中共中央警卫局局长。
原上海光明食品集团公司董事长。

en: Death and state funeral of Jiang Zemin

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上继五代十国之后的朝代，与南宋合称宋朝。其为宋朝的前半期，首都为东京开封府。
description.en: A dynasty in Chinese history following the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Together with the Southern Song, it forms the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋开国皇帝，史称宋太祖，是一位杰出的政治家和军事家。他曾任后周殿前都点检，通过陈桥兵变建立宋朝。他策划了“杯酒释兵权”以加强中央集权，并下令征讨南汉。他是宋太宗的兄长，赵德芳与赵德昭的父亲。其驾崩与“烛影斧声”疑案有关。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, known as Emperor Taizu of Song, he was an outstanding statesman and military general. Formerly Supreme Commander of the Palace Guard of Later Zhou, he established the Song dynasty through the Chenqiao Mutiny. He orchestrated the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' to centralize power and ordered the conquest of Southern Han. He was the elder brother of Emperor Taizong and father of Zhao Defang and Zhao Dezhao. His death is associated with the historical mystery of the "candlelight and axe shadow".

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤部下在陈桥驿发动兵变，拥立其为皇帝，建立宋朝。
description.en: A mutiny launched by Zhao Kuangyin's subordinates at Chen Bridge Post, which led to his enthronement and the founding of the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的最后一个朝代。
description.en: The last dynasty of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 后周最后一位皇帝，被迫禅位予赵匡胤。
宋太祖为加强中央集权，解除禁军将领及地方藩镇兵权的政治事件。其核心是以和平方式，通过一场酒宴，劝告并解除了石守信等高级将领的兵权。
description.en: A political event initiated by Emperor Taizu of Song to consolidate central authority by relieving the military power of imperial army generals and local warlords. At its core, it involved peacefully persuading high-ranking generals, such as Shi Shouxin, to relinquish their commands during a banquet.

description.zh-cn: 北宋初年开国将领，后周时期与赵匡胤结为义兄弟。宋朝建立后，参与平定潞州、扬州等战役，后在“杯酒释兵权”事件中被解除兵权。据称其为人“贪婪无厌”，信奉佛教。
description.en: An accomplished general in the early Northern Song dynasty. He became a sworn brother of Zhao Kuangyin during the Later Zhou period. After the founding of the Song dynasty, he participated in campaigns to pacify Luzhou and Yangzhou, and was later relieved of his military command in the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' incident. He was reportedly known for being 'insatiably greedy' and was a devout Buddhist.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第二位皇帝，宋太祖赵匡胤之弟，赵元佐与宋真宗之父。其继位因“烛影斧声”疑案而充满争议，被广泛怀疑谋杀兄长篡位，并与侄子赵德昭、赵德芳的早逝有关。在位期间，他结束了五代十国的分裂局面，但两次伐辽均告失败。
description.en: The second emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, younger brother of Emperor Taizu of Song (Zhao Kuangyin), and father of Zhao Yuanzuo and Emperor Zhenzong. His accession to the throne was controversial due to the 'candlelight and axe shadow' mystery, leading to widespread suspicion that he murdered his brother to usurp the throne and was involved in the early deaths of his nephews Zhao Dezhao and Zhao Defang. During his reign, he ended the fragmentation of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, but failed in two campaigns against the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 据称是宋太祖之母昭宪太后（即杜太后）口授、赵普记录的遗命，内容为兄终弟及，规定了宋朝初期的皇位继承顺序。它为宋太宗的继位提供了合法性依据，但其真实性历来备受争议。
description.en: An alleged testament dictated by Empress Dowager Du (Zhaoxian), mother of Emperor Taizu, and recorded by Zhao Pu. It stipulated that the imperial throne should pass from elder brother to younger brother, establishing the succession order in the early Song dynasty. This provided a basis of legitimacy for Emperor Taizong's succession, but its authenticity has been highly disputed.

description.zh-cn: 金朝攻破北宋首都东京开封府，俘虏宋徽宗、宋钦宗二帝，导致北宋灭亡的历史事件。
description.en: A historical event in which the Jin dynasty conquered the Northern Song capital, Tokyo, and captured Emperors Huizong and Qinzong, leading to the fall of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末代皇帝，宋徽宗长子，宋高宗之兄。与宋徽宗一同于靖康之变被俘。
description.en: The last emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, the eldest son of Emperor Huizong. Captured along with his father during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 南宋开国皇帝，史称宋高宗，是宋徽宗第九子、宋钦宗之弟。他在位三十五年后禅让，成为中国历史上在位时间最长的太上皇。在位期间，曾于苗刘兵变中被逼退位，后由韩世忠等人平乱而复位。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Southern Song dynasty, known historically as Emperor Gaozong, was the ninth son of Emperor Huizong of Song and the brother of Emperor Qinzong of Song. After reigning for 35 years, he abdicated and became the longest-reigning Taishang Huang (retired emperor) in Chinese history. During his reign, he was forced to abdicate during the Miao-Liu Mutiny but was later restored to the throne after the rebellion was quelled by generals including Han Shizhong.

description.zh-cn: 岳飞是南宋抗金名将、民族英雄，中兴四将之一，主战派的代表人物。他在绍兴和议达成前夕，被宋高宗以“莫须有”的罪名处死。
description.en: Yue Fei, a national hero and one of the 'Four Generals of ZTE,' was a distinguished military general of the Southern Song dynasty and a leading figure of the pro-war faction. He famously led forces against the Jin dynasty and was executed by Emperor Gaozong on 'groundless' charges just before the Shaoxing Peace Treaty was finalized.

description.zh-cn: 南宋宰相，宋金和议的主要推动者。他被广泛认为是策划岳飞冤案的主谋，并曾试图陷害韩世忠。
description.en: A chancellor of the Southern Song dynasty who was a major proponent of the peace treaty with the Jin dynasty. He is widely considered the mastermind behind the wrongful execution of Yue Fei and had also attempted to frame Han Shizhong.

description.zh-cn: 这是南宋与金朝之间签订的和平协议。它由秦桧主导，协议规定南宋向金朝称臣、割地、赔款，以此换取了以淮水-大散关为界、南北对峙的局面，以及宋高宗生母韦太后的归还。此次和议也导致了主战派将领如韩世忠和岳飞的兵权被解除。
description.en: This peace treaty was signed between the Southern Song and Jin dynasties, led by Qin Hui. Under its terms, the Southern Song agreed to become a vassal state, cede territory, and pay tribute. In return, it secured a stalemate along the Huai River-Dasanguan Pass as the border, and the return of Emperor Gaozong's mother, Empress Wei. The accord also led to the dismissal of military power from pro-war generals, including Han Shizhong and Yue Fei.

description.zh-cn: 南宋末年丞相，在厓山海战后背负幼主宋帝昺投海殉国。
南宋最后一位皇帝。
北宋著名政治家、文学家、思想家、改革家，唐宋八大家之一。在宋神宗支持下推行熙宁变法，其思想被称为“荆公新学”。
description.en: A famous politician, writer, thinker, and reformer of the Northern Song dynasty, and one of the Eight Great Prose Masters of the Tang and Song. He implemented the Xining Reforms with the support of Emperor Shenzong, and his thought is known as the 'Jinggong New Learning'.

description.zh-cn: 由宋神宗任用王安石主持的，旨在富国强兵的一系列社会经济改革运动。该变法引发了朝廷内部守旧派与改革派长期的政治斗争。
description.en: A series of socio-economic reforms aimed at enriching the state and strengthening the military, initiated by Emperor Shenzong and led by Wang Anshi. The reforms led to long-term political struggles between conservative and reformist factions at court.

description.zh-cn: 北宋政治家、史学家。作为守旧派领袖，他激烈反对王安石变法，并对荆轲刺秦的行为持批判态度。
description.en: A politician and historian of the Northern Song dynasty. As the leader of the conservative faction, he vehemently opposed the Wang Anshi Reforms and held a critical view of Jing Ke's assassination attempt.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第六位皇帝，宋徽宗之父。在位期间，因对北宋积贫积弱的状况深感忧心，启用王安石推行熙宁变法，并对外发动熙河开边，意图富国强兵，但变法引发了剧烈的新旧党争，对外军事行动也遭遇永乐城之战的惨败。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, father of Emperor Huizong. During his reign, concerned about the state's poverty and weakness, he appointed Wang Anshi to implement the Xining Reforms and launched the Xihe Expansion campaign, aiming to enrich the state and strengthen its military. However, the reforms triggered intense factional struggles, and his foreign military campaigns suffered a disastrous defeat at the Battle of Yongle City.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰政治人物，现任北大西洋公约组织秘书长。
挪威政治人物，曾任北大西洋公约组织秘书长。
建立北大西洋公约组织的条约。

zh-cn: 友好合作互助条约组织
en: Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance

description.zh-cn: 由苏联领导的东欧社会主义阵营国家组成的军事同盟，在冷战中与北约对峙。于1991年7月1日正式解散。
description.en: A military alliance of Eastern Bloc socialist countries led by the Soviet Union, which confronted NATO during the Cold War. It was formally dissolved on July 1, 1991.

description.zh-cn: 北约军事总部。
指南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国分裂为多个独立国家的过程，是东欧剧变的结果之一，并引发了南斯拉夫内战。
description.en: The process of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia breaking up into multiple independent states. It was one of the results of the Revolutions of 1989 and led to the Yugoslav Wars.

description.zh-cn: 北约领导的驻阿富汗维和部队。
对朱利安·阿桑奇发起性侵犯指控调查的国家，该调查后被撤销。它也是第一个承认北越并与其建交的西方国家。
description.en: The country that initiated a sexual assault investigation against Julian Assange, which was later dropped. It was also the first Western country to recognize and establish diplomatic relations with North Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲国家，曾于1511年攻占马六甲，开启了欧洲在马来半岛的殖民统治。
description.en: A European country that captured Malacca in 1511, beginning European colonial rule in the Malay Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 西亚国家，被毛泽东在阐述“一条线”战略时提及，作为联合抗苏的对象之一。该国于2017年将“东伊运”列入恐怖主义名单。
description.en: A West Asian country, mentioned by Mao Zedong when explaining the 'one line' strategy as one of the targets for a united front against the Soviet Union. This country listed ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 东欧国家。1989年，匈牙利开始拆除其部分边境设防，允许东德居民流入西德，加剧了东德内部的不稳定，间接推动了柏林墙的倒塌。
description.en: An Eastern European country. In 1989, Hungary began dismantling parts of its border fortifications, allowing East German residents to flow into West Germany, which exacerbated instability within East Germany and indirectly contributed to the fall of the Berlin Wall.

description.zh-cn: 位于波罗的海东岸的欧洲东北部国家，是波罗的海国家之一。现为欧盟和北约成员国。
description.en: A country in Northeastern Europe on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea, one of the Baltic states. Currently a member of the EU and NATO.

zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 欧洲国家。在1960年代初中苏交恶期间，接受了中国大量的粮食和经济援助。
description.en: A European country. During the Sino-Soviet split in the early 1960s, it received substantial food and economic aid from China.

location.zh-cn: 美国纽约市联合国总部
location.en: Headquarters of the United Nations, New York City, USA

description.zh-cn: 联合国六个主要机构之一，负有维持国际和平与安全的责任，也是唯一有权采取强制行动的联合国机构。它曾通过决议授权北约采取军事行动，通过第84号决议授权组建联合国军，并于2002年将“东伊运”列入恐怖组织名单。
description.en: One of the six principal organs of the United Nations, charged with ensuring international peace and security. It is also the only UN body with the authority to issue binding resolutions to member states. It has authorized NATO military actions through resolutions, authorized the formation of the United Nations Command through Resolution 84, and listed ETIM as a terrorist organization in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 利比亚前领导人。2011年北约军事干预导致其政权在第一次利比亚内战中被推翻并被杀，结束了长达42年的统治。
description.en: Former leader of Libya. His regime was overthrown and he was killed during the First Libyan Civil War in 2011, following NATO military intervention, which ended his 42-year rule.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的执政党。
description.en: The ruling party of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 二战后苏联在朝鲜半岛北部设立的军事管理机构。

zh-cn: 北朝鲜临时人民委员会
en: Provisional People's Committee of North Korea

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国成立前的临时最高行政机关。
朝鲜劳动党成立初期的内部派系，成员大多为曾在中国延安参与革命的朝鲜人。这个亲华派系后来被金日成清洗。
description.en: An internal faction of the early Workers' Party of Korea, whose members were mostly Koreans who participated in the revolution in Yan'an, China. This pro-China faction was later purged by Kim Il-sung.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党早期的派系之一，成员主要为苏籍朝鲜人，是党内的亲苏联力量。
description.en: One of the early factions of the Workers' Party of Korea, mainly composed of Soviet Koreans, and a pro-Soviet force within the party.

description.zh-cn: 1956年8月在朝鲜劳动党内部发生的一场政治斗争，导致延安派和苏联派成员遭到大规模清洗。
description.en: A political struggle within the Workers' Party of Korea in August 1956, which led to a large-scale purge of members of the Yan'an and Soviet factions.

description.zh-cn: 前韩国情报部长。
横贯朝鲜半岛，作为朝鲜民主主义人民共和国与大韩民国边界的缓冲区。此区域依据1953年朝鲜战争结束后签署的《朝鲜停战协定》设立。
description.en: A strip of land running across the Korean Peninsula, serving as a buffer zone between the Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Republic of Korea. It was established in accordance with the Korean Armistice Agreement signed after the Korean War in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国政治及军事人物，前朝鲜党和国家领导干部，曾一度被视为朝鲜实际上的“二号人物”。他曾任国家体育指导委员会首任委员长，是金正恩的姑父。
description.en: A political and military figure in the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, a former high-ranking official of the Workers' Party and the state, once considered the de facto 'second-in-command' of North Korea. He served as the first Chairman of the State Physical Culture and Sports Guidance Commission and was Kim Jong Un's uncle by marriage.

birth_place.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国江原道川内郡

death_place.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国平壤市

zh-cn: 俄朝全面战略伙伴关系条约
en: North Korean–Russian Treaty on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership

description.zh-cn: 1990年代朝鲜发生的大规模饥荒。

zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党中央军事委员会
en: Central Military Commission of the Workers' Party of Korea

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党的最高军事决策机构。
Google联合创始人，曾在斯坦福大学攻读博士学位。2011年至2015年担任Google首席执行官。
description.en: Co-founder of Google, who was a Ph.D. student at Stanford University. He served as the CEO of Google from 2011 to 2015.

description.zh-cn: Google于2015年重组后成立的控股母公司，总部位于美国。
description.en: The holding parent company established after Google's restructuring in 2015, headquartered in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 自2015年起担任Google的首席执行官。
description.en: CEO of Google since 2015.

description.zh-cn: 一款由Google主导开发并持续更新的移动设备操作系统，于2005年被Google公司收购。
description.en: A mobile operating system primarily developed and continuously updated by Google, acquired by Google in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 网络出版与广告商，为Google子公司。
一家电信设备制造商，曾于2011年被Google收购。
description.en: A telecommunications equipment manufacturer that was acquired by Google in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 美国消费电子产品和健身公司，为Alphabet子公司。
Sun Microsystems的联合创始人，Google项目最早的投资者之一。
description.en: Co-founder of Sun Microsystems and one of the earliest investors in the Google project.

description.zh-cn: 美国风险投资公司，Google的早期投资者。
美国风险投资公司，Google的早期投资者。
中华人民共和国政府在其管辖互联网内部建立的多套网络审查系统的总称，常被称为“互联网边界审查系统”，用于监控和过滤互联网内容。该系统曾导致“温云松”等词成为网络搜索的敏感词，并多次对Google的服务进行屏蔽。
description.en: The general term for multiple internet censorship systems established by the People's Republic of China within its jurisdiction to monitor and filter internet content. Often referred to as the 'Internet Boundary Censorship System,' the system has made terms like 'Wen Yunsong' sensitive for web searches and has blocked Google's services on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: Google公司的首位雇员。
由孙正义领导的日本跨国企业集团，是新天域资本公司的长期投资者。
description.en: A Japanese multinational conglomerate led by Masayoshi Son, which is a long-term investor in New Horizon Capital.

description.zh-cn: 人形机器人公司。
江青的第一任丈夫。
瞿秋白之父
瞿秋白的第一任妻子。
杨之华前夫，瞿独伊生父。
瞿秋白被捕后在狱中所写的自传性文章。
中国历史学家。
法国哲学家。
俄国作家、思想家。
瞿秋白之妹
瞿秋白之弟
前中共中央组织部秘书长。
description.en: Former secretary-general of the CCP Central Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 涟水县是中国江苏省淮安市代管的县。其前身是公元前117年设置的古县，位于今涟水县境内。
description.en: Lianshui County is a county administered by Huai'an City in Jiangsu Province, China. Its predecessor was an ancient county established in 117 BC, located in the area of present-day Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮的妻子，中央音乐学院教授、音乐教育系首任系主任。
description.en: Wife of Li Yuanchao, a professor at the Central Conservatory of Music and the first head of its Department of Music Education.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮的儿子，曾留学于耶鲁大学。
description.en: Son of Li Yuanchao, studied at Yale University.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮的父亲，曾任上海市副市长。
description.en: Father of Li Yuanchao, former Vice Mayor of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮的母亲，苏北妇女运动先驱。
description.en: Mother of Li Yuanchao, a pioneer of the women's movement in northern Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海市的一所著名中学。
description.en: A renowned high school located in Shanghai, China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党南京市委员会
en: Nanjing Municipal Committee of the Chinese Communist Party

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在南京市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 2007年太湖夏季暴发的大规模蓝藻污染事件，导致无锡市自来水出现严重水质问题。
description.en: A large-scale blue-green algae bloom in Lake Tai in the summer of 2007, which caused severe water quality problems in Wuxi's tap water.

en: The Strategic Choice for China’s Prosperity

description.zh-cn: 由厉以宁、孟晓苏、李克强、李源潮合著的经济学著作。
description.en: An economics book co-authored by Li Yining, Meng Xiaosu, Li Keqiang, and Li Yuanchao.

description.zh-cn: 指1644年（甲申年）李自成攻入北京，崇祯帝自缢，明朝灭亡的历史事件。
description.en: Refers to the historical events of 1644 (the Jiashen year), when Li Zicheng captured Beijing, the Chongzhen Emperor committed suicide, and the Ming dynasty fell.

description.zh-cn: 大顺军重要将领，封汝侯，在一片石之战中负伤。
description.en: A key general of the Dashun army, wounded in the Battle of Shanhai Pass.

description.zh-cn: 李自成侄子，大顺将领，封滋侯。
李自成三弟，大顺第二任皇帝。
李自成第三任妻子，大顺皇后。
李自成第一任妻子。
明朝末年将领，督师。
大顺天佑殿大学士。
郭沫若发表的文章，讨论李自成失败的原因。
党项首领，西夏奠基者。
蒋纬国生母，日本护士
蒋纬国之子
蒋纬国第一任妻子
蒋纬国第二任妻子
大日本帝国东京府东部的一个市，成立于1889年，1943年与东京府合并改制为东京都。其辖区范围相当于现今的东京都区部。此地是诺贝尔物理学奖得主汤川秀树的出生地，亦是该时期日本的首都。
description.en: A city in the eastern part of Tokyo Prefecture, Empire of Japan, established in 1889. It merged with Tokyo Prefecture to form Tokyo Metropolis in 1943, with its administrative area equivalent to the present-day special wards of Tokyo. It was the birthplace of Nobel laureate Hideki Yukawa and the capital of Japan during its existence.

location.zh-cn: 中华民国台北市北投区
location.en: Beitou District, Taipei, Republic of China

en: University of the German Federal Armed Forces

zh-cn: 美国陆军指挥参谋学院
en: United States Army Command and General Staff College

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军军事院校。
中华民国国军的陆上武装部队。
description.en: The ground branch of the Republic of China Armed Forces.

zh-cn: 国防部联合后勤司令部

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军方最高的军事教育学府，位于台湾。朱邦复曾在此机构以无给职身份发展中文通讯系统，期间发明了仓颉输入法。
description.en: A military academy in Taiwan and the highest military educational institution of the Republic of China Armed Forces. Chu Bong-Foo developed a Chinese communication system as an unpaid staff member here, during which he invented the Cangjie input method.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统的幕僚机关。
由朱邦复于1976年创制的一种中文输入法，其初版名为“形意检字法”，目前是香港及澳门最常用的输入法之一。其商业衍生版本简化了拆码规则以提升输入速度，并被目前中文电脑输入最快速纪录保持者所使用。
description.en: A Chinese input method created by Chu Bong-Foo in 1976, originally named 'Glyph-meaning Indexing Method'. It is one of the most common input methods in Hong Kong and Macau. Commercial derivatives of Cangjie have simplified decomposition rules to increase input speed, with one such variant being used by the current record holder for the fastest Chinese computer typing.

description.zh-cn: 台湾发明家，被誉为“中文电脑之父”，是仓颉输入法的发明人。
description.en: A Taiwanese inventor known as the 'Father of Chinese Computing' and the creator of the Cangjie input method.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗第三子，明朝第十三位皇帝
description.en: Third son of the Jiajing Emperor, the 13th emperor of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗长子，明朝第十五位皇帝。他是明熹宗和崇祯帝的父亲。在位仅一个月后，即因红丸案暴毙。
description.en: Eldest son of Emperor Shenzong, he was the 15th emperor of the Ming dynasty and father of the Tianqi and Chongzhen Emperors. His reign lasted only one month before he died suddenly due to the 'Red Pills Case'.

zh-cn: 慈圣宣文明肃贞寿端献恭熹皇太后
慈圣宣文明肃贞寿端献皇太后

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗的皇后，明神宗之母，明光宗的祖母。
明神宗的皇后。
明神宗皇贵妃，明光宗生母。

zh-cn: 恭恪惠荣和靖皇贵妃郑氏

description.zh-cn: 明神宗宠妃，朱常洵之母。

en: Three Great Campaigns of the Wanli Emperor

description.zh-cn: 万历中期进行的三次大规模军事行动：宁夏之役、朝鲜之役、播州之役。

en: Succession dispute of the Wanli era

description.zh-cn: 围绕册立皇太子问题，明神宗与大臣之间长达十余年的政治争执。
明神宗在位期间为增加内帑而向各地征收矿税的措施及其引发的社会问题。
意大利耶稣会传教士、学者，天主教在中国传教的开拓者之一，也是第一位阅读中国文学并对汉字有深入了解的西方人。
description.en: An Italian Jesuit priest and one of the founding figures of the Jesuit China missions. He is considered a Servant of God by the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 指近代西方学术思想向中国传播的历史过程，通常分为明末清初和清末民初两个主要阶段。
description.en: The historical process of the introduction of Western academic thought into China, generally divided into two main phases: the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, and the late Qing dynasty and early Republican era.

description.zh-cn: 万历初年司礼监掌印太监，与张居正合作。
明朝内阁首辅、明穆宗顾命大臣。在明神宗即位之初被冯保和张居正排挤。此外，他还曾被任命为《永乐大典》重录工作的总校官。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty and a regent appointed by Emperor Muzong. He was later pushed out by Feng Bao and Zhang Juzheng at the beginning of Emperor Shenzong's reign. Additionally, he was appointed as the general proofreader for the project to create a duplicate copy of the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗第三子，郑贵妃所生，明光宗异母弟，是国本之争的核心人物之一。
日本战国时代末期至安土桃山时代的武将、天下人，发动了侵略朝鲜的战争。
明神宗及其两位皇后的陵寝。
拖雷的正妻，蒙哥、忽必烈、旭烈兀、阿里不哥的生母。她被尊称为“四帝之母”，并在推举蒙哥称汗的过程中起到了关键作用。
description.en: The chief wife of Tolui and the mother of Möngke, Kublai, Hulagu, and Ariq Böke. She is revered as the 'Mother of Four Emperors' and played a key role in the enthronement of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古皇族，拖雷与唆鲁禾帖尼的第六子，蒙哥和忽必烈的弟弟。他建立了伊儿汗国，领导了第三次蒙古西征，并在拖雷家族内战中支持忽必烈。
description.en: A Mongol prince, the sixth son of Tolui and Sorghaghtani Beki, and the younger brother of Möngke and Kublai Khan. He founded the Ilkhanate, led the third Mongol invasion of the West, and supported Kublai during the Toluid Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈次子，皇太子。
忽必烈在即位前招揽汉人人才组建的幕僚班子。
元世祖忽必烈两次派军入侵日本的战争，均以失败告终。
description.en: Two invasions of Japan launched by Kublai Khan, Emperor Shizu of the Yuan dynasty, both ending in failure.

description.zh-cn: 元朝将领，在厓山海战中击败南宋海军。
连接中国南北的重要水道，元朝时期重修并全线贯通。
元朝科学家、天文学家、水利专家，主持开凿通惠河。
京杭大运河的北段，连接元大都与通州，由郭守敬主持开凿。
南宋末年权相。
元朝初年儒臣，金莲川幕府成员，曾上《班师议》劝忽必烈回师争位。
倪匡的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 香港女星，倪匡的儿媳，亦舒的侄媳，倪震的妻子。
description.en: Hong Kong celebrity, daughter-in-law of Ni Kuang, niece-in-law of Yi Shu, and wife of Joe Nieh.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡和亦舒的胞兄，中国化工专家。
description.en: Elder brother of Ni Kuang and Yi Shu, a Chinese chemical engineering expert.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡的胞妹，华裔加拿大籍香港文艺小说作家，原籍浙江镇海。其作品的女主角多为自爱自强的都市女性，影响了众多中文读者。
description.en: Younger sister of Ni Kuang, a Chinese-Canadian Hong Kong romance novelist, with ancestral roots in Zhenhai, Zhejiang. The heroines in her works are mostly self-respecting and strong-willed urban women, influencing numerous Chinese readers.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡和亦舒的胞弟，新加坡工程领域专家。
description.en: Younger brother of Ni Kuang and Yi Shu, an engineering expert in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 香港中文大学的创办成员书院之一，同时也是倪匡曾进修新闻系的香港高等教育机构。
description.en: One of the founding colleges of The Chinese University of Hong Kong, and also a Hong Kong higher education institution where Ni Kuang studied in the Department of Journalism.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡在1951年曾在此受训三个月。
description.en: Ni Kuang received three months of training here in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 香港著名音乐人、词曲作家、作家，与倪匡、金庸、蔡澜并称“香港四大才子”。他曾在黎明走音事件后公开表示其为可造之才。
description.en: A renowned Hong Kong musician, songwriter, and writer, known as one of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong' along with Ni Kuang, Jin Yong and Chua Lam. He publicly stated that Leon Lai had great potential after an incident where Lai sang off-key.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡及香港的作家、美食家、主持人。他与倪匡、金庸、黄沾并列为“香港四大才子”，同时也是倪匡的好友。
description.en: A Singaporean and Hong Kong writer, food critic, and television host. He is known as one of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong' alongside Ni Kuang, Jin Yong, and James Wong, and was also a close friend of Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 金庸的武侠小说，倪匡曾为其代笔部分章节。
description.en: A wuxia novel by Jin Yong, for which Ni Kuang ghostwrote several chapters.

description.zh-cn: 原名熊耀华，台湾著名武侠小说家。籍贯江西省南昌市，出生于香港，后定居台湾。他以独特风格开创了武侠小说新时代，创作了《楚留香传奇》、《绝代双骄》、《多情剑客无情剑》等多部脍炙人口的作品，并屡次被改编为影视剧。与倪匡相交甚笃。
description.en: Originally named Xiong Yaohua, he was a renowned Taiwanese wuxia novelist. His ancestral home was Nanchang, Jiangxi; he was born in Hong Kong and later settled in Taiwan. With his unique style, he pioneered a new era for wuxia novels, authoring many popular works such as 'The Legend of Chu Liuxiang', 'Juedai Shuangjiao', and 'Sentimental Swordsman, Ruthless Sword', which have been frequently adapted into films and television series. He was also a very close friend of Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 香港导演。
description.en: Hong Kong film director.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡创作的一部具寓言性的科幻小说，描述一个东方城市因其优点尽失而灭亡，倪匡坦言该城市就是指香港。
description.en: An allegorical science fiction novel by Ni Kuang describing the demise of an Eastern city that loses all its advantages. Ni Kuang stated that the city represents Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤与宋太宗赵光义的父亲，被追尊为宣祖昭武皇帝。
description.en: Father of Emperor Taizu (Zhao Kuangyin) and Emperor Taizong (Zhao Guangyi) of Song, posthumously honored as Emperor Xuanzu Zhaowu.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤、宋太宗赵炅之母。据称“金匮之盟”源于她的遗命。
description.en: Mother of Emperor Taizu Zhao Kuangyin and Emperor Taizong Zhao Jiong. The 'Pledge of the Golden Casket' is said to have originated from her deathbed testament.

description.zh-cn: 后周开国皇帝。
description.en: Founding emperor of the Later Zhou dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋初年宰相，宋太祖的重要谋臣。
description.en: A chancellor in the early Northern Song dynasty and a key advisor to Emperor Taizu of Song.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的十国之一。
description.en: One of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的十国之一。
description.en: One of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的十国之一，由李昪建立，历三主，共三十九年。曾与南汉为友好邻邦。
description.en: One of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, founded by Li Bian, lasting three rulers for a total of thirty-nine years. It was once a friendly neighboring state to Southern Han.

en: Shadow of the candle and sound of the axe

description.zh-cn: 指宋太祖赵匡胤猝死，其弟赵光义（后来的宋太宗）随即即位的历史疑案。该事件使宋太宗继位的合法性备受质疑，后世多怀疑他弑兄篡位。
description.en: Refers to the historical mystery surrounding the sudden death of Emperor Taizu of Song and the immediate succession of his brother Zhao Guangyi (later Emperor Taizong). This event cast doubt on the legitimacy of Emperor Taizong's succession, with many later historians suspecting he committed fratricide to usurp the throne.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的政权之一，也是最后一个被北宋所灭的割据政权。
description.en: One of the regimes during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, and the last separatist regime to be conquered by the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 后周昭义节度使，在宋朝建立后起兵反叛。
description.en: The military governor of Zhaoyi under the Later Zhou, who rebelled after the founding of the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 后周淮南节度使，在宋朝建立后据扬州反叛。
description.en: The military governor of Huainan under the Later Zhou, who rebelled in Yangzhou after the founding of the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤的四弟，宋太宗之弟。他是金匮之盟中预定的皇位继承人之一，并被封为秦王。后被宋太宗贬黜至死，其死导致赵元佐精神失常。
description.en: The fourth younger brother of Emperor Taizu Zhao Kuangyin and Emperor Taizong. He was one of the designated successors in the Pledge of the Golden Casket and was created the Prince of Qin. Later demoted by Emperor Taizong and died in exile, his death led to Zhao Yuanzuo's mental breakdown.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤次子，赵德芳的异母兄。在宋太宗时期被迫自杀。
description.en: The second son of Emperor Taizu of Song (Zhao Kuangyin), and the half-brother of Zhao Defang. He was forced to commit suicide during the reign of Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤的第四子，母亲为孝明王皇后。其三叔宋太宗继位后，他被封为兴元尹，但英年早逝，死因被广泛认为与宋太宗有关。其后代包括宋孝宗、宋光宗、宋宁宗。在《包公案》、《杨家将》等文学作品中，他常被误认为是“八贤王”的原型。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Taizu of Song (Zhao Kuangyin), his mother was Empress Xiaoming. After his third uncle, Emperor Taizong, ascended the throne, he was appointed Governor of Xingyuan but died young. His death is widely believed to be related to Emperor Taizong. His descendants include Emperor Xiaozong, Emperor Guangzong, and Emperor Ningzong. In literary works like "Case Files of Bao Gong" and "Generals of the Yang Family," he is often mistaken as the prototype for the "Eighth Virtuous Prince".

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤元配妻子，追封为皇后。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin's first wife, posthumously honored as empress.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤的第二位皇后，赵德芳的生母。
description.en: Emperor Taizu of Song (Zhao Kuangyin)'s second empress and the biological mother of Zhao Defang.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖赵匡胤的第三位皇后。太祖驾崩时，她曾试图传位给赵德芳，但未成功。
description.en: The third empress of Emperor Taizu of Song (Zhao Kuangyin). When Emperor Taizu died, she attempted to have Zhao Defang succeed the throne, but was unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 南唐末代君主，中国历史上首屈一指的词人，后人誉为“千古词帝”。他是小周后与大周后的丈夫。曾受宋太祖之命劝说南汉归降。被北宋俘虏后，曾获封第一个封号，宋太宗即位后改封其爵位。
description.en: The last ruler of the Southern Tang, a famous poet, and the husband of Lesser Empress Zhou and Great Empress Zhou. He was instructed by Emperor Taizu of Song to persuade Southern Han to submit. After being captured by the Northern Song, he received an initial title, which was later changed by Emperor Taizong of Song.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇的第四任妻子，刘允真和刘涛之母。
description.en: The fourth wife of Liu Shaoqi, and the mother of Liu Yunzhen and Liu Tao.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，高级工程师。曾任浙江省副书记兼省长，现任国家发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, and a senior engineer. He previously served as Deputy Secretary and Governor of Zhejiang Province, and is currently the Director of the National Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任浙江省委副书记、省长（郑栅洁的继任），浙江省人大常委会主任，以及烟台市委书记（孟凡利的继任）。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as former Deputy Secretary and Governor of Zhejiang Province (succeeding Zheng Shanjie), Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, and Party Secretary of Yantai (succeeding Meng Fanli).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任浙江省人民政府省长、中共浙江省委书记、浙江省人大常委会主任、新疆生产建设兵团政治委员等职。他曾是夏宝龙担任浙江省委书记时的副手及继任者，也是袁家军的前任。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China. He served as Governor of Zhejiang Provincial People's Government, Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the CCP, Director of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, and Political Commissar of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. He was Xia Baolong's deputy and successor as Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, and also Yuan Jiajun's predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任浙江省委书记、省人大常委会主任，以及江西省人民政府省长。此前，他接替袁家军担任浙江省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, who formerly served as Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, and Governor of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Government. He previously succeeded Yuan Jiajun as Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee.

en: Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress
zh-cn: 浙江省人民代表大会常务委员会

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing body of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。曾任袁家军的继任浙江省常务副省长，现任中国共产党海南省委员会书记、海南省人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China. Formerly served as the successor to Yuan Jiajun as Executive Vice Governor of Zhejiang Province, currently serving as Secretary of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，张庆伟的前任中共湖南省委书记。他出身于航天科技集团。
description.en: A Chinese politician and Zhang Qingwei's predecessor as Secretary of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee. He previously worked at China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC).

zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区人民政府
en: People's Government of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 香港传媒人、电影监制与主持人，是传媒界翘楚，对将港产片推广至国际影坛有重大贡献。同时，她也是著名的电影制片人，以及导演徐克的前妻。
description.en: A prominent Hong Kong media personality, film producer, and host, who has made significant contributions to promoting Hong Kong cinema internationally. She is also known as a film producer and the ex-wife of director Tsui Hark.

description.zh-cn: 由徐克和施南生创办的电影制作公司。
作为香港首间免费无线电视台，它也是香港主要的电视台之一。著名导演王家卫于1980年曾进入其导演训练班并担任制作助理。黎明演艺生涯早期曾签约于此，后因故被雪藏。
description.en: As Hong Kong's first free-to-air television station, it is also one of the major television stations in Hong Kong. Renowned director Wong Kar-wai joined its director training program in 1980 and later worked as a production assistant. Leon Lai was signed to the station in his early career and was later put on hold due to certain incidents.

description.zh-cn: 香港已倒闭的电视台。
description.en: A defunct television station in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港政界及传媒人。
香港电影导演及制片人。
中国影视公司
中国导演、摄影师、演员，中国“第五代导演”代表人物之一。作为77级大学生，他曾与巩俐有过长期的电影合作和个人情感关系。
description.en: Chinese director, cinematographer, and actor, and a representative figure of China's 'Fifth Generation directors'. A member of the Class of 1977, he had a long-term professional collaboration and personal relationship with Gong Li.

description.zh-cn: 香港导演，曾执导张国荣主演的电影《英雄本色》。他曾表示在自己落魄时，张国荣总是伸出援手资助他。
description.en: A Hong Kong director who directed Leslie Cheung in the film 'A Better Tomorrow'. He mentioned that when he was down and out, Cheung always extended a helping hand to support him financially.

description.zh-cn: 香港女歌手及演员，出生于台湾。她在1980年代至1990年代是香港乐坛的天后级歌手，曾连续四年夺得十大劲歌金曲“最受欢迎女歌星”奖，并于2011年获得香港乐坛最高荣誉金针奖。
description.en: A Hong Kong female singer and actress, born in Taiwan. A diva-level singer in the Hong Kong music scene from the 1980s to the 1990s, she won the 'Most Popular Female Singer' award at the JSG Awards for four consecutive years and received the Golden Needle Award, the highest honor in the Hong Kong music industry, in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 中央办公厅北戴河管理处内部招待所服务员，李讷的第一任丈夫。
李讷的第二任丈夫，曾任昆明军区怒江军分区参谋长。
李讷与徐宁的儿子。
曾任新华社代社长、全军文革小组成员。
毛泽东的卫士长。
成吉思汗的父亲，蒙古乞颜部首领。
成吉思汗的母亲。
成吉思汗的正妻。
成吉思汗的长子。
成吉思汗的次子。
成吉思汗的同父异母兄弟。
成吉思汗的安答（结拜兄弟）和后来的主要对手。
克烈部首领，成吉思汗早期的保护者和盟友，后成为对手。
成吉思汗麾下大将，被称为“四犬”之一。
位于中亚的突厥-波斯王朝，后被蒙古所灭。
由契丹人耶律大石建立的位于中亚的王朝，后被蒙古兼并。
蒙古高原的部落之一，与成吉思汗家族有世仇。
蒙古高原的部落之一，曾掳走成吉思汗之妻孛儿帖。
蒙古高原西部的强大部落，成吉思汗统一蒙古过程中的主要对手之一。
萨满，曾支持成吉思汗，后因试图离间皇室而被处死。

en: Mongol conquest of the Jin dynasty

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国对金朝的征服战争。
蒙古帝国对西夏的最后一战。

en: Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国对花剌子模王朝的征服战争。
蒙古国的一个省，被认为是成吉思汗的出生地。
陈独秀原配妻子，陈延年和陈乔年的母亲。
description.en: Original wife of Chen Duxiu, mother of Chen Yannian and Chen Qiaonian.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀的第三任妻子（伴侣）。
description.en: Chen Duxiu's third wife (partner).

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀之女，陈延年的姐妹。
description.en: Daughter of Chen Duxiu, sister of Chen Yannian.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀养女
由岳飞率领的南宋军队
南宋将领，参与诬陷岳飞
南宋大臣，弹劾并主审岳飞
岳飞率领岳家军对金朝进行的一系列军事进攻
岳飞之父
岳飞之弟
岳飞长子，与其父一同被害
岳飞次子
岳飞三子
岳飞之孙，岳霖之子
岳飞的出生地
北宋末、南宋初抗金名将。他曾力劝康王赵构即位并收复失地，亦是岳飞的上级。
description.en: A famous military general who resisted the Jin invasion during the late Northern Song and early Southern Song. He urged Prince Kang (Zhao Gou) to ascend the throne and recover lost territories, and was also a superior of Yue Fei.

description.zh-cn: 岳飞的武艺师傅
原为乱匪悍将，后归顺岳飞成为岳家军猛将
南宋初期湖东路乱匪首领
南宋抗金名将，主战派将领，曾为岳飞鸣不平。他官至太傅、枢密使，封咸安郡王，追封蕲王，谥“忠武”，与岳飞、张俊、刘光世合称“中兴四将”。后为达成和议被解除兵权。
description.en: A prominent military general of the Southern Song dynasty and a leading pro-war minister, renowned for resisting the Jin invasion. He once spoke up for Yue Fei. He held high-ranking positions such as Grand Tutor and Commissioner of Military Affairs, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xian'an, and posthumously titled Prince of Qi with the posthumous name “Zhongwu.” He was also one of the “Four Generals of Zhongxing” along with Yue Fei, Zhang Jun, and Liu Guangshi. Later, he was stripped of his military command to facilitate peace negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 金朝扶植的伪齐政权皇帝
金朝扶植的傀儡政权，又称“伪齐”
南宋初期的军队番号之一
南宋初期的军队番号之一，由神武副军升格而来
该地点是中华人民共和国吉林省下辖的县级市。它是李洪志和马俊清的出生地。
description.en: This location is a county-level city under the administration of Jilin Province, People's Republic of China. It is the birthplace of Li Hongzhi and Ma Junqing.

description.zh-cn: 法轮功总部，李洪志的居住地。
description.en: Headquarters of Falun Gong and residence of Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪80年代至90年代，中国在文化大革命和改革开放之后，兴起了一股大众性的气功流行潮和健身运动。这股气功热潮为后来的法轮功传播提供了社会背景。
description.en: During the 1980s and 1990s, after the Cultural Revolution and amid the Reform and Opening-up period, China experienced a widespread qigong craze and mass fitness movement. This wave of qigong provided the social context for the later spread of Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 一个促进全球警务合作和犯罪控制的国际组织。该组织曾拒绝中国政府就通缉李洪志一事提供合作的请求。
description.en: An international organization that facilitates worldwide police cooperation and crime control. It once rejected the Chinese government's request for cooperation regarding the wanted notice for Li Hongzhi.

description.zh-cn: 2019冠状病毒病在中国大陆的流行情况。
description.en: The outbreak of COVID-19 in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 由柯文哲于2019年创立的台湾政党。该党在大罢免运动中与中国国民党合作，发起“扫除绿卫兵”行动。2023年曾与国民党商谈“蓝白合”共同竞选总统，但最终破局。
description.en: A Taiwanese political party founded by Ko Wen-je in 2019. The party collaborated with the Kuomintang in the Great Recall movement, launching the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign. In 2023, it negotiated with the KMT for a 'Blue-White Coalition' joint presidential ticket, which ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 台湾外科医师、政治人物。他是台湾民众党创党人及现任党主席，并代表该党参选2024年中华民国总统选举。曾任台北市市长、国立台湾大学医学院教授、台大医院器官移植小组负责人。他曾对陈水扁的健康问题发表看法，指出陈水扁最初是装病。后因爱滋器官移植事件辞职。
description.en: A Taiwanese surgeon and politician. He is the founder and current chairman of the Taiwan People's Party, representing the party in the 2024 ROC presidential election. He has served as the Mayor of Taipei, a professor at the National Taiwan University College of Medicine, and the head of the organ transplant team at NTU Hospital. He publicly commented on Chen Shui-bian's health issues, stating Chen was initially feigning illness. He later resigned due to the AIDS organ transplant incident.

description.zh-cn: 指台北市京华城购物中心原址改建案，因容积率变更引发图利争议及司法调查案件。该案指控柯文哲在台北市长任内图利京华城集团，导致柯文哲被羁押及起诉。
description.en: Refers to the redevelopment case of the former Core Pacific City shopping center site in Taipei, which sparked controversy and judicial investigation over changes in the floor area ratio, leading to allegations of illicit gains. The case accuses Ko Wen-je of illicitly benefiting Core Pacific Group during his tenure as Taipei Mayor, resulting in his detention and indictment.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、护理师，台湾民众党籍。她代表民众党参选2024年立委选举，并获得国民党籍台中市长卢秀燕的支持。
description.en: A politician and nurse from the Republic of China, and a member of the Taiwan People's Party (TPP). She ran as a TPP candidate in the 2024 legislative election and received support from KMT's Taichung Mayor Lu Hsiu-yen.

description.zh-cn: 日本创办的第一所现代大学，位于日本东京的国立综合性研究型大学，是公认的日本最高学府。章宗祥曾在此就读法科。作为日本顶尖学府，该校曾向731部队派出了至少6名医学专家。
description.en: The first modern university established in Japan, a national comprehensive research university located in Tokyo, Japan, and widely regarded as the country's most prestigious academic institution. Zhang Zongxiang studied in the Faculty of Law here. As a top Japanese university, it dispatched at least six medical experts to Unit 731.

description.zh-cn: 台湾网络名人、企业家，与黄国昌共同举办多场社会运动。

zh-cn: 「拒绝红色媒体、守护台湾民主」游行

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾为罢免运动目标。
台湾政治团体，曾发动对黄国昌的罢免案。
中华民国政治人物，曾连任七届立法委员。他曾是黄国昌2016年立委选举的竞争对手。因在立委任内诈领助理费而被以贪污罪起诉，后潜逃并被通缉。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, and Huang Kuo-chang's opponent in the 2016 legislative election. He served seven consecutive terms as a legislator, but was later indicted for corruption for fraudulently claiming assistant fees during his tenure and subsequently became a fugitive.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍。他是傅兆林之子，徐榛蔚的丈夫。曾任花莲县县长，因其政治作风被称为“花莲王”，并涉及多起司法案件。在2020年立法委员选举中击败寻求连任的萧美琴。现任花莲县选举区立法委员、中国国民党立法院党团总召集人，并担任中国国民党中央委员会政策委员会执行长。他曾是大罢免运动中罢免泛蓝阵营的指标性人物之一。
