description.en: A politician of the Republic of China and a member of the Kuomintang. He is the son of Fu Zhaolin and husband of Hsu Chen-wei. He previously served as Hualien County Magistrate, known as the 'King of Hualien' for his political style, and has been involved in multiple legal cases. He defeated Hsiao Bi-khim in the 2020 legislative election. He currently serves as a legislator for the Hualien County constituency, the caucus convener for the KMT in the Legislative Yuan, and the Executive Director of the KMT Policy Committee. He was also one of the iconic targets of the recall effort against the Pan-Blue camp.

zh-cn: 中国国民党立法院党团

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党在立法院的议会党团。
description.en: The parliamentary group of the Kuomintang in the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，时代力量籍，时任时代力量党主席。
中华民国政治人物。在2007年民进党党内初选中击败萧美琴。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician. He defeated Hsiao Bi-khim in the 2007 DPP primary.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物。
台湾政治人物、律师，党外运动重要人物，美丽岛事件受刑人之一。曾任第八届民主进步党主席。因其在反核运动中的形象，也被称为“斗笠人”。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and lawyer, a prominent figure in the Tangwai movement, and one of the defendants in the Kaohsiung Incident. He served as the 8th Chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party. Due to his image in the anti-nuclear movement, he is also known as the 'Douli Man'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾人权工作者，时任民间司法改革基金会执行长。
明仁宗朱高炽的皇后，明宣宗朱瞻基的母亲，明英宗的祖母。她曾与孙太后一同册立钱氏为皇后，并怜悯保护被废的胡善祥。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Renzong Zhu Gaochi, mother of Emperor Xuanzong Zhu Zhanji, and grandmother of Emperor Yingzong. She, along with Empress Dowager Sun, selected Lady Qian to be the empress, and also pitied and protected the deposed Empress Hu Shanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国明朝第五位皇帝，明仁宗朱高炽长子，明英宗和景泰帝之父，胡善祥的丈夫，朱高煦之侄。他平定了叔父朱高煦的叛乱，并非常器重于谦。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Ming Dynasty in China, eldest son of the Hongxi Emperor Zhu Gaochi, father of Emperor Yingzong and the Jingtai Emperor, husband of Hu Shanxiang, and nephew of Zhu Gaoxu. He suppressed the rebellion of his uncle Zhu Gaoxu and highly valued Yu Qian.

description.zh-cn: 明仁宗和明宣宗统治时期，政治清明、经济发展的盛世。
description.en: A period of stability and prosperity during the reigns of the Hongxi and Xuande emperors.

description.zh-cn: 明朝重臣，历仕建文、永乐、洪熙、宣德四朝。
description.en: An important official of the Ming dynasty, serving four emperors.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因劝谏触怒明仁宗而下狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned for admonishing the Hongxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因劝谏触怒明仁宗而下狱。
description.en: A Ming dynasty official who was imprisoned for admonishing the Hongxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅大臣，辅佐明宣宗。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的妃嫔，宋徽宗的生母，被追尊为皇后。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Shenzong and the biological mother of Emperor Huizong, posthumously honored as an empress.

description.zh-cn: 北宋第七位皇帝，宋神宗的第六子和继任者，宋徽宗之兄。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Northern Song dynasty, the sixth son and successor of Emperor Shenzong, and elder brother of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的皇后，在宋哲宗去世后，支持宋徽宗继位。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Shenzong who supported Emperor Huizong's succession after Emperor Zhezong's death.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，曾反对宋徽宗继位。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty who opposed Emperor Huizong's succession.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，宋徽宗时期“六贼”之一，被认为是导致北宋灭亡的奸臣。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty, one of the "Six Traitors" during Emperor Huizong's reign, considered a corrupt official who contributed to the fall of the dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年宦官、将领。他是宋徽宗时期“六贼”之一。在韩世忠早年立功时，童贯曾黜其功不录。
description.en: A eunuch and general of the late Northern Song dynasty. He was one of the "Six Traitors" during Emperor Huizong's reign. He once dismissed and refused to record Han Shizhong's merits early in Han's career.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第二位皇帝，发动靖康之变，俘虏了宋徽宗和宋钦宗。
description.en: The second emperor of the Jin dynasty, who launched the Jingkang Incident and captured Emperor Huizong and Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年宋江领导的农民起义。
description.en: A peasant rebellion led by Song Jiang at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年方腊领导的农民起义。
description.en: A peasant rebellion led by Fang La at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 北宋与金朝为联合夹击辽朝而订立的盟约。
description.en: An alliance formed between the Northern Song and Jin dynasties to jointly attack the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由契丹族建立的统治中国北方的封建王朝，与北宋长期对峙。
description.en: A feudal dynasty established by the Khitan people that ruled northern China and was a long-term rival of the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年东京的著名艺伎，与宋徽宗有交往。
description.en: A famous courtesan in Tokyo during the late Northern Song dynasty, who had a relationship with Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋著名词人，传说与宋徽宗为李师师争风吃醋。
description.en: A famous poet of the Northern Song dynasty, rumored to have been a rival of Emperor Huizong for the affection of Li Shishi.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的原配皇后，宋钦宗的生母。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's first empress consort and the biological mother of Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的继室皇后，靖康之变被俘。
description.en: Emperor Huizong's second empress consort, captured during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗的妃嫔，宋高宗的生母。靖康之难中被俘虏至金国，后根据绍兴和议的条款被送回南宋。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Huizong and the biological mother of Emperor Gaozong. She was captured and taken to the Jin dynasty during the Jingkang incident and was later returned to the Southern Song as part of the Shaoxing Treaty.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第三位皇帝，为改善与南宋关系，追封宋徽宗为天水郡王。
description.en: The third emperor of the Jin dynasty who posthumously honored Emperor Huizong as Prince of Tianshui Commandery to improve relations with the Southern Song.

description.zh-cn: 刘备之父
蜀汉第二位也是最后一位皇帝，刘备之子，通常被称为“后主”。在位期间，由托孤大臣诸葛亮和李严辅佐。
description.en: The second and last emperor of Shu Han, son of Liu Bei, often referred to as the 'Last Ruler'. During his reign, he was assisted by the regents Zhuge Liang and Li Yan.

description.zh-cn: 刘备三子，封为梁王、安平王
中国东汉末年至三国时代蜀汉的将领，刘备的养子。
description.en: A general of Shu Han during the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period of China, the adopted son of Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的正室夫人，麋竺之妹
孙权的妹妹，刘备的继室夫人，曾试图将刘禅带往东吴。
description.en: Sister of Sun Quan and wife of Liu Bei, who attempted to take Liu Shan to Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 刘备的继室夫人，吴懿之妹
刘备的妾室，刘禅的生母。
description.en: A concubine of Liu Bei and the biological mother of Liu Shan.

birth_place.en: Yangdu County, Langya Commandery, Eastern Han

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉丞相，刘备的主要辅佐大臣，受刘备托孤辅佐刘禅。他是一位杰出的政治家、军事家、发明家及散文家，也是诸葛瑾之弟，诸葛乔的养父。他曾于228年征集兵丁守护都江堰，并设立专职堰官进行管理。同时，他也是诸葛亮北伐系列战争的发起者和总指挥。
description.en: Chancellor of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, he served as Liu Bei's chief advisor and regent for Liu Shan as entrusted by Liu Bei. He was an outstanding statesman, military strategist, inventor, and writer, also the younger brother of Zhuge Jin and the adoptive father of Zhuge Qiao. In 228, he conscripted soldiers to guard Dujiangyan and established specialized weir officials for its management. He was also the initiator and supreme commander of the Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将，刘备的义弟兼主要部将之一。他曾在樊城之战中击败并俘虏于禁，并与鲁肃就荆州问题进行谈判。其忠义勇武的形象在《三国演义》中被塑造为威猛刚毅、义重如山，并受后世推崇。他逐渐被神化，尊称为“关公”，被誉为“武圣”，与“文圣”孔子齐名。
description.en: A famous general of Shu Han from the late Eastern Han to the Three Kingdoms period, Liu Bei's sworn brother and one of his key commanders. He defeated and captured Yu Jin at the Battle of Fancheng, and once negotiated with Lu Su regarding the Jing Province issue. His image of loyalty, righteousness, and martial prowess was depicted in 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' as mighty, resolute, and unwavering, earning him later generations' reverence. He was gradually deified, honorifically called 'Lord Guan', and acclaimed as the 'Saint of War', on par with Confucius, the 'Saint of Culture'.

birth_place.en: Xie County, Hedong Commandery, Eastern Han

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将，刘备的义弟，刘禅的岳父，五虎上将之一。
description.en: A military general serving under the warlord Liu Bei in the late Eastern Han dynasty and the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period of China, and the father-in-law of Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉的著名将领，官至征南将军。他曾在长坂坡保护刘禅。
description.en: A renowned military general of the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, who held the rank of General Who Conquers the South. He famously protected Liu Shan at Changban.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年权臣，曹魏政权的奠基者。他曾参与讨伐董卓的关东联军，并在兵败后迎汉献帝至许都，消灭李傕势力。他是孙刘联盟的主要对抗目标，曹昂、曹丕之父，曹叡之祖父。于禁曾长期为其效力。曾因态度傲慢未能招揽张松，也曾被许贡提及孙策对他构成威胁。他曾短暂收留关羽并对其礼遇有加。在《三国演义》中，他被塑造成一位“宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我”的奸雄。
description.en: A powerful minister of the late Eastern Han dynasty and the founder of the state of Cao Wei. He participated in the coalition against Dong Zhuo, and after being defeated, he welcomed Emperor Xian to Xudu and eliminated Li Jue's faction. He was the primary adversary of the Sun-Liu alliance, father of Cao Ang and Cao Pi, and grandfather of Cao Rui. Yu Jin served him for a long time. His arrogant attitude prevented him from recruiting Zhang Song, and Sun Ce viewed him as a threat, as mentioned by Xu Gong. He briefly took Guan Yu into his service and treated him with great respect. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is portrayed as a cunning and ambitious tyrant who famously declared, 'I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me.'

description.zh-cn: 孙策之弟，三国时期孙吴开国皇帝，六朝开拓者之首。他后期与刘备集团决裂，派军袭取荆州并最终导致关羽败亡。
description.en: Younger brother of Sun Ce, founding emperor of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period, and the first pioneer of the Six Dynasties. He later broke his alliance with Liu Bei's faction, dispatched troops to seize Jing Province, ultimately leading to Guan Yu's defeat and death.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名将及割据军阀，以武勇著称。他先后为丁原、董卓的部将。被董卓招揽后，他杀害丁原并成为董卓义子。后因与董卓侍婢私通且遭其羞辱，与王允合谋刺杀董卓。刺董后，他曾为袁绍效力，后被李傕、郭汜联军击败，逃离长安后转而割据徐州。
description.en: A famous general and warlord of the late Eastern Han dynasty, known for his martial prowess. He initially served under Ding Yuan. After being recruited by Dong Zhuo, he assassinated Ding Yuan and became Dong Zhuo's adopted son. Later, due to an affair with Dong Zhuo's maid and being humiliated by him, he conspired with Wang Yun to assassinate Dong Zhuo. After the assassination, he briefly served Yuan Shao, but was defeated by the allied forces of Li Jue and Guo Si. He then fled Chang'an and carved out his own territory in Xu Province.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀，四世三公出身，袁熙之父。因反对董卓废立皇帝而逃离洛阳，后成为关东联军盟主，共同讨伐董卓。
description.en: A warlord of the late Eastern Han dynasty, from a prestigious family of high-ranking officials, and father of Yuan Xi. He fled Luoyang after opposing Dong Zhuo's decision to depose the emperor and later became the leader of the coalition of warlords that campaigned against Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀，势力曾进入扬州，击败割据江东的周氏兄弟。孙策、鲁肃与周瑜都曾短暂效力于其麾下。
description.en: A warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty. His forces once entered Yang Province, defeating the Zhou brothers who controlled Jiangdong. Sun Ce, Lu Su, and Zhou Yu all briefly served under him.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年荆州牧，其去世引发了曹操南下及赤壁之战，也是李严的早期主君。
description.en: The governor of Jing Province in the late Eastern Han dynasty, whose death triggered Cao Cao's southern campaign and the Battle of Red Cliffs, and was an early lord of Li Yan.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年益州牧。他为抵御张鲁和曹操，听从张松建议迎刘备入蜀。在此之前曾任用李严。后因发现张松密谋而将其处死，并与刘备交战。
description.en: Warlord and governor of Yi Province during the late Eastern Han dynasty. To counter threats from Zhang Lu and Cao Cao, he invited Liu Bei into his territory on Zhang Song's advice. Prior to Liu Bei's arrival, he had employed Li Yan. He later executed Zhang Song upon discovering his conspiracy and subsequently went to war with Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀
东汉末年徐州牧
东汉最后一位皇帝，先后被董卓、李傕、郭汜、曹操等人挟持控制。许贡曾上表于他，意图调走孙策。
description.en: The last emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, who was held hostage and controlled successively by warlords such as Dong Zhuo, Li Jue, Guo Si, and Cao Cao. Xu Gong once submitted a memorial to him, proposing to transfer Sun Ce away.

description.zh-cn: 孙权、刘备联军在长江赤壁一带大破曹操大军的战役，是三国时期著名的以少胜多的战役，奠定了三国鼎立的基础。
description.en: A decisive naval battle in the winter of 208 at the end of the Han dynasty, where the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei decisively defeated the numerically superior forces of Cao Cao.

en: Liu Bei's takeover of Yi Province

description.zh-cn: 刘备夺取益州的战役
刘备从曹操手中夺取汉中的战役
关羽北伐曹操的战役，期间孙权偷袭荆州，导致关羽败亡。
刘备为关羽报仇并意图夺回荆州而讨伐东吴的战役。此战以蜀汉惨败告终。
description.en: A campaign launched by Liu Bei against Eastern Wu to avenge Guan Yu and reclaim Jingzhou. The battle resulted in a disastrous defeat for Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮向刘备陈述的“三分天下”的战略规划。
蜀汉重臣，与诸葛亮同为刘备的托孤大臣。在第四次北伐时因运粮不力，后又试图推卸责任而被废为庶人。
description.en: A high-ranking official of Shu Han, appointed as a regent by Liu Bei along with Zhuge Liang. He was dismissed from office and demoted to a commoner for failing to deliver supplies during the fourth Northern Expedition and attempting to cover up his mistake.

description.zh-cn: 原为刘璋部下，后与张松一同策划并协助刘备夺取益州，成为刘备的谋士。在取益州和汉中时多有贡献，是蜀汉重要谋士。他曾与李严等人共同制定《蜀科》。
description.en: Originally a subordinate of Liu Zhang, he later conspired with Zhang Song to assist Liu Bei in taking control of Yi Province, becoming Liu Bei's strategist. He made significant contributions during the campaigns to take Yi Province and Hanzhong, and was an important advisor to Shu Han. He also co-authored the 'Code of Shu' with Li Yan and others.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的属下，后献图于刘备，促成刘备入蜀。
东汉末年大儒，刘备的老师。
汉献帝的岳父，衣带诏事件的主谋。
唐太宗李世民的第九子，嫡三子，李泰的胞弟。李承干被废后，被立为皇太子，后继位为唐高宗，成为唐朝第三位皇帝，也是安定公主的父亲。
description.en: The ninth son of Emperor Taizong Li Shimin and his third legitimate son, full brother of Li Tai. After Li Chengqian's deposition, he was made crown prince and later succeeded the throne as Emperor Gaozong, becoming the third emperor of the Tang dynasty and the father of Princess Anding.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗李治第五子，武则天长子。
唐高宗第六子，章怀太子，李显之兄。
唐中宗，唐朝皇子，曾两次在位，是唐朝第四位和第六位皇帝，也是安定公主的同胞弟弟。
description.en: Emperor Zhongzong of Tang, a prince of the Tang dynasty, who reigned twice as the fourth and sixth emperor. He was also a full brother of Princess Anding.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗的原配皇后，在安定公主死后被诬陷并废黜。
description.en: The first empress consort of Emperor Gaozong, who was framed and deposed after the death of Princess Anding.

description.zh-cn: 武则天建立的朝代。
description.en: A dynasty established by Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 导致武则天退位，唐中宗复辟的政变。
唐朝、武周时期宰相，神龙政变策划者之一。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武则天的男宠。
武则天的男宠。
唐中宗嫡长子，懿德太子。
唐中宗第七女。
唐朝、武周时期的著名宰相。
description.en: A famous chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武则天之侄。
description.en: Nephew of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 武则天之侄。
清朝道光帝的第三位嫡妻，即位后所立的第二位皇后，咸丰帝的生母。
description.en: The third principal consort of the Daoguang Emperor of the Qing Dynasty, the second empress established after his enthronement, and the birth mother of the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝道光年间的军机大臣，被认为是鸦片战争期间主和派的代表人物之一，与林则徐政见相左，并对其进行排挤。
description.en: A Grand Councilor during the Daoguang era of the Qing dynasty, considered a leading figure of the peace faction during the Opium War. He opposed Lin Zexu's policies and worked to undermine him.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室、大臣。他被道光帝任命为钦差大臣，代表清政府与英国议和，并最终签署了《南京条约》。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan and a minister. Appointed Imperial Commissioner by the Daoguang Emperor, he represented the Qing government in peace talks with Britain and eventually signed the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 清朝后期政治家、思想家、文学家和学者，以在广东发起的禁烟运动及虎门销烟而闻名，是第一次鸦片战争中的关键人物。他主张了解和学习西方技术，被认为是中国近代“开眼看世界的第一人”。
description.en: A prominent Chinese scholar and official of the late Qing dynasty, best known for his role in the First Opium War and the destruction of opium at Humen. He was a proponent of learning from Western technology and is considered the 'first person to open his eyes to the world' in modern China.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝次子，早夭。

en: Princess Rongshou of the First Rank

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣长女，慈禧太后养女。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Yixin and the adopted daughter of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝开国皇帝，唐太宗李世民之父。隋末时于晋阳起兵，攻入长安，废隋恭帝杨侑后称帝。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Tang dynasty and the father of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin. He rebelled in Jinyang during the late Sui, captured Chang'an, and proclaimed himself emperor after deposing Emperor Gong Yang You.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊的皇后，唐太宗李世民之母。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Gaozu of Tang and mother of Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊四子，与李建成结盟，在玄武门之变中被李世民所杀。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Gaozu of Tang, allied with Li Jiancheng, and was killed by Li Shimin's forces during the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

description.zh-cn: 由时任秦王的李世民在长安太极宫玄武门发动的一场宫廷政变。他通过杀死兄长李建成和四弟李元吉，确立了其皇位继承权。房玄龄是此次事件的重要策划者之一。
description.en: A palace coup launched by Li Shimin, then Prince of Qin, at Xuanwu Gate of the Taiji Palace in Chang'an. He secured his succession to the throne by killing his elder brother Li Jiancheng and younger brother Li Yuanji. Fang Xuanling was a key planner of the incident.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民的皇后，李泰的母亲。她以贤德著称，曾召见房玄龄之妻卢氏，劝其接受太宗为房玄龄所赐的美人，以示贤明。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Taizong Li Shimin and mother of Li Tai. Known for her virtue and wisdom, she once summoned Fang Xuanling's wife, Lady Lu, to persuade her to accept the concubines gifted to Fang Xuanling by Emperor Taizong, demonstrating her sagacity.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗在位期间出现的政治清明、经济复苏、文化繁荣的治世局面。
description.en: A period of political stability, economic recovery, and cultural prosperity during Emperor Taizong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 李渊、李世民父子在晋阳发动的反隋起义，为唐朝的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: An anti-Sui uprising launched by Li Yuan and his son Li Shimin in Jinyang, which laid the foundation for the establishment of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋末群雄之一，建立夏国，后在虎牢之战中被李世民击败并俘虏。
description.en: A warlord during the late Sui dynasty who established the state of Xia, later defeated and captured by Li Shimin at the Battle of Hulao.

description.zh-cn: 隋末唐初的群雄之一。他在洛阳废隋恭帝杨侗自立，建立郑国。虎牢之战后投降唐朝。
description.en: One of the warlords during the late Sui and early Tang dynasties. He deposed Emperor Gong Yang Tong in Luoyang, established himself as emperor, and founded the state of Zheng. After the Battle of Hulao, he surrendered to the Tang.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝统一战争中的决定性战役，李世民在此一举击败窦建德与王世充两大势力。
description.en: A decisive battle in the Tang unification wars, where Li Shimin defeated the forces of Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong.

description.zh-cn: 位于蒙古高原的游牧汗国，是突厥汗国分裂后形成的主要部分之一。其与隋朝时而战争时而臣服，隋末时曾支持地方割据势力，是唐朝初年的主要外部威胁，后被唐太宗所灭。
description.en: A nomadic khaganate on the Mongolian Plateau, and one of the main parts formed after the split of the Turkic Khaganate. It engaged in both conflict and vassalage with the Sui dynasty, and supported local warlords at the end of the Sui dynasty. It became a major external threat to the early Tang dynasty, later conquered by Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝作为中亚和北亚各民族的国际同盟之主的称号，始于唐太宗。
description.en: A title for the Tang emperor as the head of an international alliance of various peoples in Central and North Asia, starting with Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的著名谏臣和宰相，以直言敢谏著称。
description.en: A renowned chancellor and advisor during Emperor Taizong's reign, famous for his forthright remonstrance.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝初年名相、凌烟阁二十四功臣之一，也是唐太宗时期的主要谋士和宰相。他以善于谋略著称，与杜如晦并称“房谋杜断”。
description.en: A prominent chancellor of the early Tang dynasty and one of the 24 meritorious officials of Lingyan Pavilion. He also served as a key advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong, known for his strategic planning and often mentioned with Du Ruhui as 'Fang's schemes and Du's judgment'.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗时期的主要谋士和宰相，与房玄龄并称“房谋杜断”。
description.en: A key advisor and chancellor to Emperor Taizong, known for his decisive judgment.

description.zh-cn: 高句丽末期军事独裁者，其政变及对外扩张行为引发了唐朝的军事干预。
description.en: A military dictator of late Goguryeo whose coup and expansionist policies led to military intervention by the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝鲜半岛北部的古代王国，曾与隋朝和唐朝发生多次大规模战争，亦与新朝关系恶化。
description.en: An ancient kingdom on the Korean Peninsula that engaged in prolonged warfare with the Tang and Sui dynasties, and also had deteriorating relations with the Xin Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗嫡长子，原为皇太子，后因与李泰争储并图谋不轨而被废。
description.en: The eldest son of Emperor Taizong and original crown prince, who was deposed after plotting rebellion due to his rivalry with Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗第四子，深得宠爱，与太子李承干争夺储位，后被贬。
description.en: The fourth son of Emperor Taizong, highly favored by his father, who vied for the crown prince position with Li Chengqian and was later demoted.

birth_place.zh-cn: 墨竹工卡亚伦哲堆园降巴明久林
birth_place.en: Jampa Mingyur Ling, in Yarbnön Tötsal, Meldro Gungkar

death_place.en: Zalmo Gang, in Phenpo, Tibetan Empire

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃雅鲁王朝第33任赞普，吐蕃帝国的建立者。在位期间，他大幅扩张版图，定都拉萨，并确立政治、军事、经济及法律制度。通过与泥婆罗和唐朝的联姻，引入先进技术与文化，推动了吐蕃社会的发展。藏传佛教中被认为是观世音菩萨的化身。
description.en: The 33rd Tsenpo of the Yarlung dynasty of Tibet and the founder of the Tibetan Empire. During his reign, he significantly expanded the empire's territory, established the capital at Lhasa, and set up political, military, economic, and legal systems. Through marriage alliances with Licchavi (Nepal) and the Tang Dynasty, he introduced advanced technology and culture, promoting the development of Tibetan society. He is considered an incarnation of Avalokiteshvara in Tibetan Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宗室之女，松赞干布的妻子。她入藏带来了释迦牟尼像、经书、以及先进的科学、医学和历法知识，极大地促进了唐朝与吐蕃的文化交流。在藏传佛教中被认为是绿度母的化身。
description.en: A member of the Tang Dynasty's imperial clan and a wife of Songtsen Gampo. Her arrival in Tibet brought a statue of Shakyamuni, scriptures, and advanced knowledge in science, medicine, and calendrical systems, greatly promoting cultural exchange between the Tang and Tibet. In Tibetan Buddhism, she is considered an incarnation of Green Tara.

description.zh-cn: 青藏高原上的一个帝国，与唐朝同期，双方时战时和。其趁安史之乱占领了唐朝的西域和河西走廊；唐朝名将高适在任剑南节度使期间曾与其交战。双方也曾通过和亲维持关系。
description.en: An empire on the Tibetan Plateau, contemporary with the Tang Dynasty, which experienced periods of both war and peace with Tang. It took advantage of the An Lushan Rebellion to occupy Tang's Western Regions and Hexi Corridor. The famous Tang general Gao Shi also fought against it during his tenure as military governor of Jiannan. Both sides also maintained relations through marriage alliances.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆帝的原配妻子、第一任皇后，也是道光帝的生母。
description.en: The original wife and first empress of the Jiaqing Emperor, and the birth mother of the Daoguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆帝的第二位皇后，道光帝的养母。
description.en: The second empress of the Jiaqing Emperor and the adoptive mother of the Daoguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆帝皇长子，早夭。
清朝乾隆时期的权臣，丰绅殷德的父亲，后被嘉庆帝赐死。
description.en: A powerful official during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty, father of Fengshen Yinde, who was later forced to commit suicide by the Jiaqing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆年间爆发的大规模白莲教起义。
清朝中期的民间宗教秘密结社，曾发动大规模起义。其平定后的大赦使丰绅殷德一度复爵。
description.en: A syncretic religious and political movement in the mid-Qing dynasty that launched a major rebellion. The amnesty following its suppression led to the temporary restoration of Fengshen Yinde's title.

description.zh-cn: 川楚教乱首领之一。
天理教徒攻入紫禁城事件。
清代中期由白莲教演化出的一个民间宗教。1813年，其教徒在林清的带领下发动起义并攻打了紫禁城。
description.en: A folk religious sect in the mid-Qing dynasty that evolved from the White Lotus. In 1813, its followers, led by Lin Qing, launched an uprising and attacked the Forbidden City.

description.zh-cn: 天理教首领，癸酉之变的发动者。
时任两广总督，因处理英国入侵澳门事件不力被免职。
指清朝嘉庆、道光年间的社会矛盾激化、国势由盛转衰的时期。
毛岸青的妻子，毛新宇的母亲。中国人民解放军少将，曾任中国军事科学院军事百科研究部副部长、中国摄影家协会主席。
description.en: Wife of Mao Anqing and mother of Mao Xinyu. A major general in the People's Liberation Army, she served as deputy director of the Military Encyclopedia Research Department of the Chinese Academy of Military Sciences and former chairwoman of the China Photographers Association.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东唯一的嫡孙，毛岸青与邵华之子。他是一位中国军事研究员，也是中国人民解放军少将。
description.en: The only known grandson of Mao Zedong, son of Mao Anqing and Shao Hua. He is a Chinese military researcher and a Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与贺子珍的长女，毛岸青异母姊妹。失散后于1973年被找到。
毛岸英之妻刘思齐和毛岸青之妻邵华的母亲，毛新宇的外祖母。
曾任毛泽东、周恩来、朱德等领导人的俄文翻译。
20世纪30年代由中共地下党在上海创办的幼稚园，用于收养中共烈士和领导人的子女。
description.en: A kindergarten founded by the CCP underground in Shanghai in the 1930s to care for the children of CCP martyrs and leaders.

zh-cn: 金山安全软件有限公司

description.zh-cn: 一家中国软件公司。曾于2008年与谷歌联合发布免费的《谷歌金山词霸合作版》。该公司还曾因商业诋毁和不正当竞争，与奇虎360及其董事长周鸿祎发生过多次激烈的法律纠纷。
description.en: A Chinese software company. In 2008, it jointly released the free 'Google-Kingsoft PowerWord Cooperative Edition' with Google. The company also had numerous intense legal conflicts with Qihoo 360 and its chairman Zhou Hongyi over commercial defamation and unfair competition.

description.zh-cn: 金山软件创始人之一，雷军在金山软件的同事。
description.en: One of the founders of Kingsoft, colleague of Lei Jun at Kingsoft.

description.zh-cn: 美国跨国科技公司。
description.en: American multinational technology company.

nodes.id: BAIDU:北京小米支付技术有限公司

zh-cn: 北京小米支付技术有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任吉林省省长，是马俊清的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Governor of Jilin Province, and predecessor of Ma Junqing.

zh-cn: 天津市第一中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 北京市下的一个行政区，此处指其政府机构。
曾任重庆市公安局局长。
曾任重庆市副市长。
中国政治人物，曾任中国证券监督管理委员会主席。在中共十九届四中全会上被追认留党察看二年的处分。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Chairman of the China Securities Regulatory Commission. His punishment of being placed on probation within the Party for two years was confirmed at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: “牵手”果蔬汁品牌创办人。

location.zh-cn: 美国密苏里州克雷夫科尔

description.zh-cn: 一家美国农业生物技术公司，曾是全球转基因种子的领先生产商。2018年被拜耳公司收购。
description.en: An American agricultural biotechnology corporation that was a leading producer of genetically engineered seeds. It was acquired by Bayer in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 林彪父亲
钦差大臣林则徐在广东虎门集中销毁了收缴的鸦片。此事激化了中英矛盾，成为第一次鸦片战争的导火索。
description.en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu publicly destroyed confiscated opium in Humen, Guangdong. This historic event intensified Sino-British tensions and served as the direct trigger for the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 发生于新疆地区由张格尔领导的叛乱。
道光帝的皇贵妃，奕䜣的生母，咸丰帝的养母。
description.en: An Imperial Noble Consort of the Daoguang Emperor, the birth mother of Yixin, and the adoptive mother of the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末期满洲贵族、大臣。在鸦片战争期间持主和态度，与林则徐政见不合，后接替林则徐任两广总督，与英方签订《穿鼻草约》。
description.en: A Manchu nobleman and minister of the late Qing dynasty. He held a pro-peace stance during the Opium War, clashing with Lin Zexu. He later succeeded Lin as the Governor-General of Liangguang and signed the Convention of Chuanbi with the British.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗朱瞻基的第二位皇后、明英宗的生母。她原为贵妃，在胡善祥被废后成为皇后。在土木堡之变后，她任命当时为郕王的朱祁钰为监国。
description.en: The second empress consort of the Xuande Emperor (Zhu Zhanji) and the birth mother of Emperor Yingzong. She was originally a noble consort and became empress after Hu Shanxiang was deposed. Following the Tumu Crisis, she appointed Zhu Qiyu, then Prince of Cheng, as regent.

description.zh-cn: 明朝第九位皇帝，明英宗与孝肃皇后之子。他原为太子，曾被景泰帝废黜，后复位并即位为帝。即位后，他恢复了叔叔景泰帝的帝号，并为于谦平反。他亦是明世宗之祖父。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Ming dynasty, son of Emperor Yingzong and Empress Xiaosu. He was originally the crown prince, deposed by the Jingtai Emperor, but later reinstated and ascended the throne. Upon his ascension, he restored his uncle's imperial title and rehabilitated Yu Qian. He was also the grandfather of the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的护卫将军，在土木堡之变中杀死王振后战死。
description.en: Emperor Yingzong's guard general, who killed Wang Zhen during the Tumu Crisis and died in battle.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，夺门之变主谋之一。复辟后把持朝政，后因图谋叛乱被清算。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty general and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. After the restoration, he controlled the court but was later purged for plotting a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，时任左副都御史，夺门之变的主要策划者之一。他力主杀害于谦，事后被清算流放。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official, serving as the Left Vice Censor-in-Chief at the time, and one of the main planners of the Duomen Coup. He strongly advocated for the execution of Yu Qian, and was later purged and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 明朝宦官，夺门之变主谋之一。复辟后与石亨把持朝政，后因发动曹石之变被凌迟处死。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty eunuch and one of the masterminds of the Duomen Coup. He controlled the court with Shi Heng after the restoration and was later executed by slow slicing for launching the Cao-Shi Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗朱祁镇的嫡后。在土木堡之变后，因思念被俘的丈夫而日夜哭泣，导致一腿残疾、一目失明。明英宗复辟后，不顾其无子且伤残，坚持册立其为皇后。逝世后，在大学士李贤、彭时等人的力争下，得以与英宗合葬于明裕陵。
description.en: The empress consort of Emperor Yingzong of Ming. After the Tumu Crisis, she cried day and night for her captured husband, which resulted in a crippled leg and blindness in one eye. After Emperor Yingzong's restoration, he insisted on reinstating her as empress despite her being childless and disabled. After her death, thanks to the efforts of grand secretaries like Li Xian and Peng Shi, she was buried with Emperor Yingzong in the Yuling Mausoleum.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗的贵妃，明宪宗的生母。在儿子即位后被尊为皇太后，曾阻挠孝庄睿皇后与英宗合葬。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Yingzong and the birth mother of Emperor Xianzong. She was honored as Empress Dowager after her son's accession and attempted to prevent Empress Xiaozhuangrui from being buried with Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 明朝大学士，曾任明英宗天顺朝内阁首辅。他成功劝谏明英宗赦免汪皇后殉葬，并就钱、周二后并尊问题据理力争，最终确保孝庄睿皇后（钱皇后）能与英宗合葬。他还曾建议明英宗恢复胡善祥的皇后名号。
description.en: A Grand Secretary of the Ming dynasty, serving as the Senior Grand Secretary during the Tianshun era of Emperor Yingzong's reign. He successfully persuaded Emperor Yingzong to spare Empress Wang from being sacrificed, and argued forcefully on the issue of co-equal status for Empresses Dowager Qian and Zhou, ultimately ensuring Empress Xiaozhuangrui (Empress Qian) was buried with Emperor Yingzong. He also advised Emperor Yingzong to restore Hu Shanxiang's title of Empress.

description.zh-cn: 由曹吉祥和石亨策划的旨在刺杀明英宗的未遂政变。
description.en: An attempted coup planned by Cao Jixiang and Shi Heng to assassinate Emperor Yingzong of Ming.

description.zh-cn: 秦国国君，秦始皇的父亲。原在赵国作为人质，后在吕不韦的帮助下返回秦国并最终继位。他也是中国史上第一位被追尊为太上皇的人。
description.en: King of the state of Qin and the father of Qin Shi Huang. He was originally a hostage in the state of Zhao and later returned to Qin and ascended the throne with the help of Lü Buwei. He was also the first person in Chinese history to be posthumously honored as an Emperor Emeritus (Taishang Huang).

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的母亲，秦庄襄王之妻。原为吕不韦的姬妾。
description.en: The wife of King Zhuangxiang of Qin and the mother of Qin Shi Huang. She was originally a concubine of Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国末期卫国商人，后成为秦国相国（丞相）及政治家，对秦始皇亲政前有重要影响，并被秦始皇尊为“仲父”。传说他可能为秦始皇生父，并曾将嫪毐引荐给赵太后。他广招门客编撰《吕氏春秋》，是先秦杂家的代表人物之一，对秦王政统一六国的事业有重大贡献。
description.en: A merchant from the state of Wei during the late Warring States period, who later became the Chancellor and a politician of the state of Qin. He was influential during Qin Shi Huang's early reign and honored as 'Second Father' by him. He is also rumored to be Qin Shi Huang's biological father. He gathered scholars to compile the 'Lüshi Chunqiu' and is a representative figure of the Miscellaneous School of thought, making significant contributions to Qin's unification of the six states.

description.zh-cn: 战国末年秦国人物，秦始皇之母赵姬的面首。后因发动叛乱失败被车裂处死。
description.en: Lover of Queen Dowager Zhao, later executed for rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇长子，原定的皇位继承人。
description.en: The eldest son and original heir of Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇幼子，秦朝第二位皇帝。
description.en: The youngest son of Qin Shi Huang and the second emperor of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的异母弟，后叛秦降赵。
description.en: Half-brother of Qin Shi Huang, who later defected to Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝丞相、文学家、书法家，法家代表人物，韩非的同学。在秦始皇焚书坑儒时，他将《周易》列为医术占卜之书，使其免于被毁。
description.en: Chancellor of the Qin dynasty, a key Legalist figure, a writer, calligrapher, and a fellow student of Han Fei. During Emperor Qin Shi Huang's 'burning of books and burying of scholars', he classified the I Ching as a book of medicine and divination, thus sparing it from destruction.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝宦官，中车府令，与李斯合谋发动沙丘之变，后陷害李斯。
description.en: A powerful eunuch of the Qin dynasty and a key conspirator in the Sand Dune Coup.

description.zh-cn: 秦国将领，秦灭六国战争中的主要将领之一。
description.en: A leading general of the state of Qin during the wars of unification.

description.zh-cn: 中国先秦时期战国末期韩国法家思想家，法家思想的代表人物与集大成者。他著有《韩非子》一书。曾多次上书韩桓惠王，要求推行法治以图富强。他曾援引《老子》的思想，后为李斯的同学，但最终被李斯所害。
description.en: A representative and synthesizer of Legalist thought from the State of Han during China's pre-Qin period (late Warring States period). He authored 'Han Feizi', and repeatedly submitted memorials to King Huanhui of Han, advocating for the rule of law to strengthen the state. He also cited the ideas of Laozi. A fellow student of Li Si, he was ultimately executed by him.

description.zh-cn: 他是楚考烈王之子，同时也是秦昭襄王的外孙，其母是嫁给楚考烈王的秦国公主。他曾任秦国丞相，并以秦国公子身份奉命平定嫪毐之乱，后叛秦归楚。
description.en: Son of King Kaolie of Chu and grandson of King Zhaoxiang of Qin, his mother was a Qin princess who married King Kaolie. He served as Chancellor of Qin, was honored as a Prince of Qin, and was ordered to suppress the Lao Ai rebellion, before rebelling and returning to Chu.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期刺客，受燕太子丹之托刺杀秦王失败。
description.en: An assassin of the late Warring States period, known for his failed attempt to assassinate Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝开国功臣，出身于韩国贵族，其祖父与父亲曾五代相韩。曾策划博浪沙行刺秦始皇，后为汉初三杰之一。汉初，曾作为大臣为吕后出谋划策，保住太子刘盈的地位。
description.en: A founding father of the Han Dynasty, who came from the nobility of the State of Han, and whose grandfather and father served as chancellors to five generations of Han rulers. He plotted an assassination attempt on Qin Shi Huang at Bolangsha and later became a key strategist for the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 燕王喜的太子，派遣荆轲刺杀秦王。
description.en: Crown Prince of Yan who dispatched Jing Ke to assassinate the King of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的诸侯国，战国七雄之一。后通过商鞅变法富国强兵，最终统一六国建立秦朝。在战国时期，李冰曾担任蜀郡郡守。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty in China, and one of the Seven Warring States. It became wealthy and powerful through Shang Yang's reforms, eventually unifying the other six states and establishing the Qin Dynasty. During the Warring States period, Li Bing served as the governor of Shu Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上第一个大一统的中央集权制封建王朝。它始置丞相一职。秦朝平定百越后，今天的新界被纳入其版图。
description.en: The first unified, centralized feudal imperial dynasty in Chinese history. It established the position of Chancellor. After the Qin conquered the Baiyue peoples, the area of the modern New Territories was incorporated into its territory.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时代的诸侯国，姬姓韩氏，由三家分晋而来。作为战国七雄之一，它是第一个被秦国所灭的国家，也是著名思想家韩非的母国。为消耗秦国国力，延缓其东征步伐，它曾派遣水工郑国赴秦游说修建水渠。
description.en: A vassal state during the Warring States period in China, of the Ji family name and Han clan, originated from the Partition of Jin. As one of the Seven Warring States, it was the first to be conquered by the State of Qin and was the home state of the famous philosopher Han Fei. To drain the resources of the State of Qin and slow its eastward expansion, it once dispatched the hydraulic engineer Zheng Guo to persuade Qin to build a canal.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时期的诸侯国，战国七雄之一，由三家分晋而来。同时也是荀子的出生地。
description.en: A state during the Warring States period of China, one of the Seven Warring States, which originated from the Partition of Jin. It was also the birthplace of Xunzi.

description.zh-cn: 周朝时期位于长江中游地区的诸侯国，也是战国七雄之一。著名思想家荀子曾在此任兰陵令并终老。
description.en: A state located in the middle Yangtze River region during the Zhou dynasty, it was also one of the seven major states of the Warring States period. The renowned philosopher Xunzi once served as the magistrate of Lanling here and spent his final years.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的诸侯国，也是战国七雄之一。其政权曾被田和篡夺。著名思想家荀子亦曾在此地的稷下学宫研习并担任祭酒。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou Dynasty in China and one of the Seven Warring States. Its political power was once usurped by Tian He. The renowned philosopher Xunzi also studied and served as libationer at the Jixia Academy located here.

description.zh-cn: 古代中国南方和越南北部的各部落的统称。
description.en: A collective term for various tribes inhabiting Southern China and Northern Vietnam in ancient times.

en: Burning of books and burying of scholars

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇于公元前213年至212年推行的极端政治行动，旨在统一思想、压制异见与摧残文化。此举导致焚毁大量书籍，特别是儒家经典，并坑杀“犯禁者四百六十余人”。《周易》因被视为占卜书籍而幸免。
description.en: An extreme political action implemented by Qin Shi Huang from 213 to 212 BC, aimed at unifying thought, suppressing dissent, and destroying culture. It led to the burning of numerous books, especially Confucian classics, and the burying alive of over 460 'violators'. The I Ching was spared because it was considered a divination book.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇死后，赵高、李斯等人伪造遗诏，拥立胡亥即位的政治事件。
description.en: A political conspiracy after Qin Shi Huang's death where Zhao Gao and Li Si forged the imperial will to enthrone Huhai.

description.zh-cn: 为抵御北方游牧民族而修筑的军事防御工程。
description.en: A series of fortifications built for military defense against northern nomadic peoples.

en: Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇的陵墓，位于今陕西省西安市临潼区。
description.en: The mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang, located in Lintong District, Xi'an, Shaanxi province.

description.zh-cn: 山西省晋中市下辖的县
位于荷兰首都阿姆斯特丹的综合性研究型大学。
中国法学家，北京大学法学院教授。

zh-cn: 中国共产党宁夏回族自治区委员会
中共宁夏回族自治区党委
en: Ningxia Hui Autonomous Regional Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Ningxia Hui Autonomous Regional Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在宁夏回族自治区的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，团派官员，曾任中共江苏省委书记。其后未达退休年龄即被调离实权岗位。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China and an official from the Tuanpai (Youth League Faction). He served as Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee and was later transferred from his position of power before reaching the standard retirement age.

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥的丈夫，数学家
description.en: Carrie Lam's husband, mathematician

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥幼子
description.en: Carrie Lam's younger son

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥的母亲
description.en: Carrie Lam's mother

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥的兄长
description.en: Carrie Lam's elder brother

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府决策局
description.en: A policy bureau of the Government of Hong Kong

en: Fifth Administration of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第五届政府

description.zh-cn: 由行政长官林郑月娥领导的香港政府，因潘晓颖命案提出《逃犯条例》修订草案。
description.en: The Hong Kong government led by Chief Executive Carrie Lam, which proposed the extradition bill amendment in response to the Poon Hiu-wing murder case.

description.zh-cn: 国际非政府组织，致力于倡导新闻自由。
description.en: An international non-governmental organization that advocates for freedom of the press.

description.zh-cn: 前香港民政事务局局长
description.en: Former Hong Kong Secretary for Home Affairs

description.zh-cn: 位于中国陕西省咸阳市，是郭伯权的出生地。
description.en: A county in Xianyang, Shaanxi Province, China, and the birthplace of Guo Boquan.

description.zh-cn: 郭伯雄之子，中国人民解放军少将，郭伯权的侄子。
description.en: The son of Guo Boxiong, a major general in the Chinese People's Liberation Army, and the nephew of Guo Boquan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任陕西省民政厅厅长。他是中国共产党中央军事委员会前副主席郭伯雄的胞弟。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former director of the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Civil Affairs. He is the younger brother of Guo Boxiong, former Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第四十七集团军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军的一个集团军，现已撤销。
description.en: A former group army of the PLA Ground Force, which has now been disbanded.

description.zh-cn: 郭伯雄之妻。
郭伯雄之女。

en: National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team/Coordination Center of China
National Computer Network and Information Security Management Center
zh-cn: 国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心

description.zh-cn: 中国的国家级互联网应急中心，原由工业和信息化部管理，2018年后由中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室管理。
description.en: The national-level Internet emergency response center of China, formerly managed by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and managed by the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission since 2018.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国计算机信息网络国际联网管理暂行规定

description.zh-cn: 中国工程院院士，被认为是防火长城的首要设计师。
description.en: An academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, considered to be the principal designer of the Great Firewall.

description.zh-cn: 美国科技公司，曾是中盈优创的合作伙伴。
description.en: An American technology company that was a partner of Unihub.

description.zh-cn: 中国人权活动家，曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见。
description.en: A Chinese human rights activist, who was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng.

zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京朝阳区酒仙桥路6号院（电子城国际电子总部）2号楼
location.en: Building 2, No. 6 Jiuxianqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆的一家主营安全相关的互联网公司，由周鸿祎和齐向东于2005年9月成立。旗下产品有360安全卫士、360杀毒、360搜索等。该公司曾与多家中国互联网公司发生商业纠纷和诉讼。
description.en: A mainland Chinese internet company focusing on security-related products, founded by Zhou Hongyi and Qi Xiangdong in September 2005. Its products include 360 Safeguard, 360 Total Security, 360 Search, and more. The company has been involved in business disputes and lawsuits with several other Chinese internet companies.

description.zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司的联合创始人，曾任公司总裁。毕业于长春邮电学院。
description.en: Co-founder of Qihoo 360, formerly served as the company's President. Graduated from Changchun University of Posts and Telecommunications.

en: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences
zh-cn: 中国科学院信息工程研究所

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党中央委员会机关报《人民日报》社主办与出版的国际新闻报刊。该报在艾未未被捕后发表多篇社评对其进行批评，并对《零八宪章》持负面评价。
description.en: An international news tabloid published by the People's Daily, the official newspaper of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. It published multiple editorials criticizing Ai Weiwei after his arrest and holds a negative view of Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 中国异议人士，“拆墙运动”发起者。
description.en: Chinese dissident, founder of the 'Tear Down the Wall Movement'.

description.zh-cn: Google提供的电子邮件服务。
description.en: Email service provided by Google.

description.zh-cn: 一种用于匿名通信的自由及开放源代码软件。
description.en: Free and open-source software for enabling anonymous communication.

description.zh-cn: 美国社交媒体集团。
description.en: An American social media conglomerate.

description.zh-cn: 美国社交网络及微博客服务的公司。
description.en: An American social network and microblogging service company.

description.zh-cn: 监测中国互联网审查的组织。
description.en: An organization that monitors internet censorship in China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在动员戡乱时期（台湾白色恐怖时期）的主要情治单位之一。负责执行戒严、镇压异议人士，曾两度拘捕并讯问李登辉。
description.en: One of the main intelligence agencies of the Republic of China during the Period of Mobilization for the Suppression of Communist Rebellion (White Terror period). It was responsible for enforcing martial law, suppressing dissidents, and notably arrested and interrogated Lee Teng-hui on two occasions.

description.zh-cn: 由时任台湾省政府主席陈诚颁布，宣告在台湾全境实施戒严，是白色恐怖时期的开端。
description.en: Proclaimed by then-Taiwan Provincial Governor Chen Cheng, it declared martial law throughout Taiwan, marking the beginning of the White Terror period.

en: Act for the Punishment of Rebellion

description.zh-cn: 白色恐怖时期的“特别刑法”，扩张了犯罪构成要件，成为政府整肃异己的法律工具。
description.en: A "special criminal law" during the White Terror period that expanded the elements of crime, becoming a legal tool for the government to purge dissidents.

en: Statute for the Purge of Spies during the Period of National Mobilization for the Suppression of Communist Rebellion
zh-cn: 戡乱时期检肃匪谍条例

description.zh-cn: 白色恐怖时期的法律之一，废止时间被视为白色恐怖时期的结束点之一。
description.en: One of the laws during the White Terror period; its abolition is considered one of the end points of the period.

description.zh-cn: 发生于台东泰源监狱的政治犯武装起义事件，参与者多为台湾独立运动人士。
description.en: An armed uprising of political prisoners at Taiyuan Prison in Taitung, primarily involving Taiwan independence movement activists.

description.zh-cn: 泰源事件的参与者之一，后被枪决。
description.en: One of the participants in the Taiyuan Incident, later executed.

description.zh-cn: 泰源事件的参与者之一，后被枪决。
description.en: One of the participants in the Taiyuan Incident, later executed.

description.zh-cn: 美国的“红色恐慌”浪潮，又称麦卡锡主义，是20世纪50年代初在美国发生的一系列反共政治迫害行为。它以在缺乏适当证据的情况下，指控支持左派的个人与团体不忠、颠覆或叛国为特点。此运动与台湾的白色恐怖相呼应，著名科学家钱学森是其受害者之一。时任总统艾森豪威尔曾暗中反对麦卡锡主义。
description.en: The "Red Scare" wave in the United States, also known as McCarthyism, was a series of anti-communist political persecutions that occurred in the U.S. in the early 1950s. It was characterized by making accusations of disloyalty, subversion, or treason against individuals and groups supportive of the left, often without proper evidence. This movement echoed Taiwan's White Terror, with prominent scientist Qian Xuesen being among its victims. President Eisenhower covertly opposed McCarthyism.

en: Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Taiwan Provincial Work Committee of the Communist Party of China
zh-cn: 中国共产党台湾省工作委员会
中共台湾省工作委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于1946年至1952年在台湾成立的省级地下组织。在白色恐怖时期，它作为主要镇压目标之一，领导了学生工作委员会等下属机构。该组织最终于1950年代被国民党政府破获。
description.en: A provincial-level underground organization established by the Communist Party of China in Taiwan from 1946 to 1952. During the White Terror, it was a primary target of suppression and led subordinate bodies such as the Student Work Committee. The organization was eventually dismantled by the Kuomintang government in the 1950s.

description.zh-cn: 时任基隆中学校长，因《光明报》事件被捕并枪决。
description.en: Then-principal of Keelung High School, arrested and executed in connection with the Guangming Daily Incident.

description.zh-cn: 国立清华大学历史研究所硕士生，在“独立台湾会事件”中被调查局拘提，引发社会抗议。
description.en: A master's student at National Tsing Hua University's Institute of History, whose arrest by the Investigation Bureau in the "Independent Taiwan Association Incident" triggered social protests.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的司法调查机关，在白色恐怖后期依然扮演执行政治侦防的角色。
description.en: The judicial investigation agency of the Republic of China, which continued to play a role in political investigation and prevention in the later stages of the White Terror.

zh-cn: 中华民国促进转型正义委员会

description.zh-cn: 依据《促进转型正义条例》成立的独立机关，负责推动转型正义，包括对白色恐怖时期的不法判决进行平反。
description.en: An independent commission established under the Act on Promoting Transitional Justice, responsible for advancing transitional justice, including overturning unjust verdicts from the White Terror period.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿。
description.en: U.S. Secretary of State at the time.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，金门防卫司令部副司令官，在金门炮战中与赵家骧一同殉职。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Armed Forces and Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, killed in action alongside Zhao Jiaxiang during the Second Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，后追晋为陆军二级上将。曾任金门防卫司令部副司令官，在八二三砲战（金门炮战）中殉职。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the Republic of China Army, posthumously promoted to the rank of full general. He served as Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command and was killed in action during the 1958 Taiwan Strait Crisis (also known as the Kinmen Artillery Duel).

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国军将领，金门防卫司令部副司令官。在金门炮战中与赵家骧一同殉职，壮烈阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Republic of China Armed Forces and Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command. He was killed in action alongside Zhao Jiaxiang during the Kinmen Artillery Duel (Second Taiwan Strait Crisis).

description.zh-cn: 中东地区的一场政治危机，被认为是毛泽东决定炮击金门以牵制美军的原因之一。

en: Mutual Defense Treaty between the United States and the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1954年，美国与中华民国在华盛顿签署的军事防御同盟条约，由艾森豪威尔政府推动签订。该条约签订于冷战时期，促成了美军协防台湾司令部的成立，并于1980年因美国与中华人民共和国建交而终止。
description.en: A mutual defense alliance treaty signed in Washington in 1954 between the United States and the Republic of China, promoted by the Eisenhower administration. Signed during the Cold War, it led to the establishment of the U.S. Taiwan Defense Command and was terminated in 1980 following the establishment of diplomatic relations between the U.S. and the People's Republic of China.

nodes.id: BAIDU:中华人民共和国国防部告台湾同胞书

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国防部告台湾同胞书

description.zh-cn: 美国提供给中华民国国军的203毫米自走炮，在炮战中发挥重要作用。
美国提供给中华民国空军的空对空导弹，在台海空战中首次使用。
世界女子职业网球的管理组织。在此事件中，该组织公开声援彭帅，并暂停了在中国的赛事。
description.en: The governing body of women's professional tennis. In this incident, the organization publicly supported Peng Shuai and suspended its tournaments in China.

description.zh-cn: 国际女子网球协会（WTA）主席，代表WTA就彭帅事件多次发表声明，表达关切并要求调查。
description.en: Chairman of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA), who issued multiple statements on behalf of the WTA regarding the Peng Shuai incident, expressing concern and demanding an investigation.

description.zh-cn: 该组织在此事件中与彭帅进行视频通话，并称其安全无虞，但其做法被外界批评为帮助中国政府掩盖真相。
description.en: In this incident, the organization held video calls with Peng Shuai and claimed she was safe, but its actions were criticized by outsiders for helping the Chinese government cover up the truth.

description.zh-cn: 1929年2月，新桂系将领胡宗铎以国民党武汉政治分会名义免去鲁涤平湖南省主席职务并收缴其部队武装的政治事件，该事件是蒋桂战争的直接导火索。
description.en: In February 1929, the political incident where New Guangxi clique general Hu Zongduo, in the name of the Wuhan Political Council of the KMT, dismissed Lu Diping as Chairman of Hunan and disarmed his troops. This event was the direct trigger for the Chiang-Gui War.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任北洋政府交通总长。因被指为亲日派卖国贼，在五四运动中成为学生的主要攻击目标之一，其住宅赵家楼被烧，后被免职。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the Minister of Communications in the Beiyang government at the time. Accused of being a pro-Japanese traitor, he became a primary target for students during the May Fourth Movement, his residence at Zhaojialou was burned, and he was subsequently dismissed from office.

birth_place.en: Wucheng County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang Province

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、外交官。清末留学日本，归国后在清廷任职。民国成立后，历任大理院院长、司法总长、驻日公使等职。因在巴黎和会上的对日让步态度，在五四运动中被学生指为亲日派卖国贼，在曹汝霖住宅内遭殴打，后被免职。此后退出政界，转入实业界，抗战期间曾任华北政务委员会咨询委员。
description.en: A politician and diplomat of the Republic of China. He studied in Japan in the late Qing Dynasty and held various positions in the Qing court upon his return. After the establishment of the Republic, he served as President of the Supreme Court, Minister of Justice, and Minister to Japan. Due to his conciliatory stance towards Japan at the Paris Peace Conference, he was accused by students during the May Fourth Movement of being a pro-Japanese traitor, was beaten at Cao Rulin's residence, and subsequently dismissed from office. He later retired from politics and entered the business world, and during the Second Sino-Japanese War, he served as an advisory committee member of the North China Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任货币局总裁。因被指为亲日派卖国贼，与曹汝霖、章宗祥一同成为五四运动的主要攻击目标，后被免职。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the President of the Currency Bureau at the time. Accused of being a pro-Japanese traitor, along with Cao Rulin and Zhang Zongxiang, he became a primary target of the May Fourth Movement and was subsequently dismissed from office.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动期间由钱能训担任代理国务总理的北洋政府内阁。因运动引发的全国性压力而被迫解散。
description.en: The Beiyang government cabinet with Qian Nengxun as acting Premier during the May Fourth Movement. It was forced to dissolve due to nationwide pressure sparked by the movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，国民外交协会理事。他在《晨报》上发表文章《外交警报敬告国民》，披露巴黎和会外交失败的消息，对点燃五四运动起了关键作用。学者，林徽因之父。
description.en: Chinese politician, scholar, and a director of the National Diplomatic Association. He was the father of Lin Huiyin. His article 'Diplomatic Warning to Our Countrymen' published in the 'Morning Post' revealed the news of the diplomatic failure at the Paris Peace Conference, playing a key role in igniting the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动的扩大阶段，因6月3日北京学生遭大规模逮捕而引发。以上海工商界的罢市和工人的罢工为标志，运动中心从北京转移到上海，参与阶层从学生扩大到工商界和工人阶级。
description.en: An expanded phase of the May Fourth Movement, triggered by the mass arrest of Beijing students on June 3. Marked by strikes by Shanghai's business community and workers, the movement's center shifted from Beijing to Shanghai, and participation expanded from students to the business and working classes.

description.zh-cn: 由九个一战战胜国召开的国际会议。在美国调停下，会议促成中日签订《解决山东悬案条约》，使山东问题得到比较圆满的解决。
description.en: An international conference convened by nine victorious nations of World War I. Under US mediation, the conference facilitated the signing of the 'Sino-Japanese Treaty for the Settlement of the Shandong Question', leading to a relatively satisfactory resolution of the Shandong Problem.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾任国务总理，并在五四运动时期代理国务总理。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Premier, and acted as Premier during the May Fourth Movement period.

description.zh-cn: 淞沪会战的直接导火索，两名日本军人在上海虹桥机场被中国守卫击毙。
淞沪会战末期的一场著名战斗，以八百壮士的英勇抵抗而闻名。
为淞沪会战编组的日军主要作战部队之一。
为增援淞沪战场而在杭州湾登陆的日军部队。
淞沪会战日军上海派遣军司令官，后任中支那方面军司令。

en: Alexander Ernst Alfred Hermann Freiherr von Falkenhausen
zh-cn: 亚历山大·恩斯特·阿尔弗雷德·赫尔曼·冯·法肯豪森

birth_place.zh-cn: 德意志帝国西里西亚省布卢门塔尔

death_place.zh-cn: 德意志联邦共和国莱茵兰-普法尔茨拿骚

description.zh-cn: 德国陆军将领，最高军阶为步兵上将。他曾担任德国驻中华民国军事顾问团团长，为国军提供作战指导。二战期间，他还曾是德国占领下比利时和法国北部的军政府司令官。
description.en: A German army general, reaching the rank of General of the Infantry. He served as the head of the German military mission to the Republic of China, providing operational guidance to the National Revolutionary Army. During World War II, he also served as the military governor of German-occupied Belgium and Northern France.

description.zh-cn: 日军第10军司令官。
国军团附，率领八百壮士坚守四行仓库。
客家人，国民革命军少校，毕业于黄埔军校第六期。曾任国军第583团第3营营长。在淞沪会战中，他率全营官兵坚守宝山县城，壮烈殉国，阵亡后被追授为陆军少将。
description.en: A Hakka Chinese military officer, a major in the National Revolutionary Army, and a graduate of the sixth term of the Whampoa Military Academy. He served as the commander of the 3rd Battalion, 583rd Regiment of the National Revolutionary Army. During the Battle of Shanghai, he led his entire battalion in the resolute defense of Baoshan County, where he was killed in action. He was posthumously promoted to Major General.

description.zh-cn: 国军第88师第264旅少将旅长，淞沪会战国军牺牲的第一位高级将领。
国军第67军军长，在掩护上海守军撤退时牺牲。
上海租界青帮大老、商人、政治人物，与黄金荣、张啸林并称“上海滩三大亨”。作为青帮头目及上海地方领袖，他在四一二事件中组织力量协助国民党清党，并利用其关系配合国军作战计划，在闸北秘密修建掩体。其势力曾与王亚樵的斧头帮发生冲突。
description.en: Du Yuesheng was a prominent Green Gang boss, businessman, and political figure in the Shanghai International Settlement, known as one of "Shanghai's Big Three" alongside Huang Jinrong and Zhang Xiaolin. As a Green Gang leader and local Shanghai figure, he organized forces to assist the Kuomintang (KMT) in the party purge during the April 12th Incident, and also utilized his connections to cooperate with KMT military plans, secretly constructing bunkers in Zhabei. His forces also clashed with Wang Yaqiao's Axe Gang.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期存在多支武装力量。其中一支由杨虎城领导，主体为国民革命军第十七路军；另有由冯玉祥领导的军阀派系，受苏联支持。
description.en: During the Republican era, there were multiple armed forces. One was led by Yang Hucheng, primarily the 17th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army; another was a warlord clique led by Feng Yuxiang, supported by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的西安市，西安事变的发生地。
国民党中央委员，在西安事变中遇难。
中华人民共和国政治人物。现任中共福建省委书记、福建省人大常委会主任、中共二十届中央委员。曾任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China. He is the current Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Fujian Provincial People's Congress, and a member of the 20th Central Committee of the CCP. He previously served as Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国浙江省台州专区天台县
birth_place.en: Tiantai County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任福建省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Governor of Fujian Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任福建省政协主席
description.en: Chinese politician, current Chairman of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 战国时期越国君主
description.en: Monarch of the state of Yue during the Warring States period

description.zh-cn: 闽越国第一任君主，闽越王，在福州冶山一带的冶城建都。
description.en: The first king of Minyue Kingdom, who established his capital at Yecheng in the area of Yeshan, Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 闽越国宗室、繇王
description.en: A member of the Minyue royal family, King Yao

description.zh-cn: 闽越国末代君主，自称武帝
description.en: The last ruler of Minyue Kingdom, self-proclaimed Emperor Wu

description.zh-cn: 唐朝设立的军区长官职称，其设立始出现“福建”之名
五代十国时期闽国建立者。
description.en: Founder of the Min Kingdom during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的十国之一，定都福州。
description.en: One of the Ten Kingdoms during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, with its capital in Fuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝的行政区划
description.en: An administrative division of the Song dynasty

description.zh-cn: 晚清洋务运动时期创办的近代军事工业，主要从事现代舰船的建造。
description.en: A modern military industry founded during the Self-Strengthening Movement in the late Qing dynasty, primarily engaged in building modern warships.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第十九路军

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军的一支部队，因参与一·二八事变（淞沪抗战）而闻名，期间抵抗日军并得到王亚樵的积极配合，也参与了福建事变。
description.en: A unit of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China, famous for its participation in the January 28 Incident (Shanghai War of 1932) where it resisted Japanese forces with active cooperation from Wang Yaqiao, and also for its involvement in the Fujian Incident.

en: People's Revolutionary Government of the Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华共和国人民革命政府

description.zh-cn: 由国民革命军第十九路军于1933年在福建发动“闽变”（反蒋事变）期间建立的政权，定都福州，后被中央军镇压。
description.en: A regime established by the 19th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army during the Fujian Rebellion (an anti-Chiang incident) in Fujian in 1933. It had its capital in Fuzhou and was later suppressed by the Central Army.

description.zh-cn: 连接江西鹰潭和福建厦门的铁路线
description.en: A railway line connecting Yingtan in Jiangxi and Xiamen in Fujian

description.zh-cn: 悉达多·乔达摩的出生地。
古印度的一种血统论社会等级制度。
古印度反对婆罗门教的各种新思潮的总称。
古印度王朝，其君主阿育王大力推广佛教。
佛教教团的第一次分裂，导致上座部与大众部的形成。
上座部佛教，是佛教两大现存分支之一，也是现存最古老的佛教宗派，主要流传于斯里兰卡和东南亚地区。其教义以巴利三藏为基础。
description.en: Theravada Buddhism, one of the two major existing branches of Buddhism and the oldest surviving Buddhist school, is primarily prevalent in Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia, with its teachings based on the Pāli Canon.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教是佛教三大主要现存分支之一，指以成佛为目标而修行的菩萨乘。其思想约在公元1世纪开始在印度流行，后成为北传佛教的主体，主要流传于东亚和西藏地区。
description.en: Mahāyāna Buddhism is one of the three main existing branches of Buddhism, referring to the Bodhisattva vehicle practiced by those who aim to achieve Buddhahood. Its teachings began to spread in India around the 1st century CE, later becoming the primary form of Northern Buddhism, predominantly prevalent in East Asia and Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 南北朝时代南梁开国皇帝，庙号高祖。他原为南齐宗室，后篡齐建梁，建立南梁王朝，在位近48年。晚年笃信佛教，大力扶持佛教发展，并推动汉传佛教素食传统。后因侯景之乱被囚禁饿死。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Southern Liang dynasty during the Northern and Southern dynasties period, with the temple name Gaozu. He was originally a member of the Southern Qi imperial clan, later usurped Qi to establish the Southern Liang dynasty, and reigned for nearly 48 years. In his later years, he became a devout Buddhist, vigorously supported the development of Buddhism, and promoted the vegetarian tradition of Chinese Buddhism. He was later imprisoned and starved to death during the Hou Jing Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教核心经典之一，影响了梁武帝推行僧侣素食。
印度佛教僧侣，被尊为中国禅宗的初祖，亦是禅宗西天二十八祖。他在少林寺传授禅修，使少林寺成为禅宗祖庭。
description.en: An Indian Buddhist monk, revered as the first patriarch of Zen Buddhism in China and the 28th patriarch of Zen in India. He taught Zen meditation at the Shaolin Temple, establishing it as the ancestral temple of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 汉传佛教的一个主要宗派，由菩提达摩传入中国。
唐代文学家、思想家、政治家，因上《谏迎佛骨表》而著名，持反对佛教立场。
东晋时期高僧，在庐山东林寺创立佛教净土宗，被尊为净土宗初祖。
description.en: An eminent monk of the Eastern Jin Dynasty, he founded the Pure Land school of Buddhism at Donglin Temple on Mount Lu and is revered as its first patriarch.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝开国皇帝，史称汉高祖。他击败项羽，统一中国，奠定西汉王朝，并建立了涿郡。他也是刘盈（汉惠帝）、鲁元公主之父，同时是刘秀的九世祖。
description.en: The founder and first emperor of the Han dynasty, known as Emperor Gaozu of Han. He defeated Xiang Yu in the Chu–Han Contention, unifying China, establishing the Western Han dynasty, and founding Zhuo Commandery. He was the father of Liu Ying (Emperor Hui) and Princess Yuan of Lu, and also the ninth-generation ancestor of Liu Xiu.

description.zh-cn: 王莽是西汉末年的政治人物、外戚及权臣。他曾任大司马，后篡夺西汉政权，建立新朝，成为新朝的开国皇帝和唯一一位皇帝。其改革失败导致天下大乱，最终被起义军推翻。
description.en: Wang Mang was a political figure, consort kin, and powerful minister in the late Western Han dynasty. He served as Grand Marshal, later usurped the Western Han regime, established the Xin dynasty, and became its founding and sole emperor. His failed reforms led to widespread chaos, and he was eventually overthrown by rebel forces.

description.zh-cn: 王莽建立的中国朝代，取代西汉，介于西汉与东汉之间。因改革失败及天灾人祸，最终被农民起义推翻。
description.en: A dynasty established by Wang Mang that replaced the Western Han. It was eventually overthrown by peasant uprisings due to failed reforms and natural disasters.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏的开国皇帝。他是曹操与卞氏的嫡长子，曹昂的异母弟。他接受汉献帝禅让，结束东汉，称帝后追尊曹昂为王。他还将于禁从东吴接回，却用壁画羞辱于禁，致其病逝。
description.en: The founding emperor of the state of Cao Wei. He was the eldest son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian, and the half-brother of Cao Ang. He accepted the abdication of Emperor Xian of Han, ending the Eastern Han Dynasty, and posthumously honored Cao Ang as a king after ascending to the throne. He also received Yu Jin back from Eastern Wu, but humiliated him with a mural, which led to his death from illness.

description.zh-cn: 秦末义军领袖之一，西楚霸王，后在楚汉战争中败给刘邦。许贡在给汉献帝的上表中曾将孙策与他相提并论。
description.en: Leader of the anti-Qin rebellion, Hegemon-King of Western Chu. He was later defeated by Liu Bang in the Chu-Han Contention. Xu Gong once compared Sun Ce to him in his memorial to Emperor Xian.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝灭亡后，项羽与刘邦之间为争夺统治权而进行的一场大规模战争，最终以刘邦胜利告终。
description.en: A large-scale war between Xiang Yu and Liu Bang for supremacy after the fall of the Qin dynasty, which ended with Liu Bang's victory.

description.zh-cn: 楚汉战争的最后一场决定性战役，刘邦在此战中击败项羽，奠定了汉朝建立的基础。
description.en: The final and decisive battle of the Chu-Han Contention, where Liu Bang defeated Xiang Yu, laying the foundation for the establishment of the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦的皇后，汉惠帝刘盈和鲁元公主的母亲。刘邦死后，她临朝称制，掌握汉朝实权。其专权对后世影响深远，是汉武帝决定处死钩弋夫人的重要原因之一。
description.en: The empress consort of Emperor Gaozu of Han (Liu Bang), and the mother of Emperor Hui (Liu Ying) and Princess Yuan of Lu. After Liu Bang's death, she ruled as empress dowager and regent, holding de facto power over the Han dynasty. Her usurpation of power had a profound influence on later generations, serving as a significant reason for Emperor Wu's decision to execute Lady Gouyi.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝第二位皇帝，汉高祖刘邦与皇后吕雉之子，鲁元公主的弟弟。他在位期间，推行黄老学说，注重国家的休养生息和无为而治。
description.en: The second emperor of the Han Dynasty, son of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and Empress Lü Zhi, and younger brother of Princess Yuan of Lu. During his reign, he promoted Huang-Lao philosophy, focusing on national recuperation and governance through inaction.

description.zh-cn: 西汉开国功臣，汉初杰出的军事家，与张良、萧何并称“汉初三杰”，与彭越、英布并称“汉初三大名将”，被后人誉为“兵仙”、“国士无双”。他军事才能卓著，是楚汉战争中的重要将领。后因功高震主被猜忌，先被刘邦用陈平之计擒获，最终被吕后处死。
description.en: A founding general and outstanding military strategist of the Western Han dynasty, he was a key figure and one of the 'Three Heroes of the early Han dynasty' during the Chu-Han Contention. Renowned as a 'military immortal' and 'peerless national scholar' for his exceptional military talent, he was later captured by Liu Bang using Chen Ping's strategy and ultimately executed by Empress Lü due to suspicion arising from his great achievements.

description.zh-cn: 西汉第五位皇帝，汉高祖刘邦第四子，鲁元公主异母弟。在诸吕之乱平定后，由陈平、周勃等大臣拥立为帝。他与其子汉景帝共同开创了“文景之治”的盛世。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Western Han dynasty, fourth son of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu. He was enthroned by ministers including Chen Ping and Zhou Bo after the Lü Clan Disturbance was quashed. Along with his son Emperor Jing, he initiated the prosperous 'Rule of Wen and Jing'.

description.zh-cn: 西汉汉文帝和汉景帝统治时期出现的政治安定、经济发展的盛世。
description.en: A golden age of political stability and economic prosperity during the reigns of Emperor Wen and Emperor Jing of the Western Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝时期，以吴王刘濞为首的七个刘姓诸侯王发动的武装叛乱，旨在反对中央的削藩政策。
description.en: An armed rebellion during the reign of Emperor Jing of Han, led by Liu Pi, the King of Wu, and six other vassal kings of the Liu clan, in opposition to the central government's policy of reducing the size of fiefdoms.

description.zh-cn: 西汉政治家，向汉景帝提议削藩，是七国之乱的导火索之一。
description.en: A statesman of the Western Han dynasty who proposed the reduction of vassal states to Emperor Jing, which was one of the triggers for the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 西汉外交家，两次出使西域，开辟丝绸之路。
古代连接东西方的商贸路线，以东汉首都洛阳为东方起点。
description.en: An ancient network of trade routes connecting the East and West, with its eastern starting point in Luoyang, the capital of the Eastern Han dynasty.

en: Ministry of Radio, Film, and Television of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广播电影电视部
中华人民共和国广电部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经的组成部门，负责管理广播、电影、电视等事业。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for managing broadcasting, film, and television industries.

nodes.id: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

zh-cn: 深化党和国家机构改革方案
en: Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions
Plan for Deepening Reform of Party and State Institutions

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月由中共中央印发的关于党和国家机构改革的文件。主要内容包括组建中央广播电视总台、将中央财经领导小组等机构改为委员会，并将国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心的管理权由工信部划转至中央网信办等。
description.en: A document on the reform of party and state institutions issued by the CCP Central Committee in March 2018. It included the establishment of China Media Group (CMG), transformed the Central Leading Group for Financial and Economic Affairs and other bodies into commissions, and transferred the management of the National Computer Network and Information Security Management Center from the MIIT to the Cyberspace Administration of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国际广播电台

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的国家对外广播电台，原为中华人民共和国国家广播电台，于2018年并入中央广播电视总台。
description.en: The national external radio broadcaster of the People's Republic of China. Formerly known as the National Radio of the People's Republic of China, it was merged into China Media Group in 2018.

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区复兴门外大街2号
location.en: No. 2, Fuxingmenwai Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 中央人民广播电台是中华人民共和国的国家广播电台。它曾由北平新华广播电台改名而来，作为其前身之一。它曾独立运行，后于2018年并入中央广播电视总台，成为其下属机构。
description.en: China National Radio is the national radio station of the People's Republic of China. It was renamed from Beiping Xinhua Radio Station, serving as one of its predecessors. It operated independently and was later merged into China Media Group in 2018, becoming subordinate to it.

description.zh-cn: 中央广播电视总台下属的国际电视通讯机构，2018年作为主体之一整合组建中央广播电视总台。
慎海雄的前任中国中央电视台台长。

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国浙江省湖州市吴兴区

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、记者。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军新闻传播中心广播电视部
中国中央电视台国防军事频道
