zh-cn: 中国农业电影电视中心
中国中央电视台农业农村频道

description.zh-cn: 描述在政治光谱中立场极左的团体或个人。
被视为极左派的一种意识形态。
与新左派相关的社会运动。
情境主义国际的创始人，著有《景观社会》。
description.en: The founder of the Situationist International and author of 'The Society of the Spectacle'.

description.zh-cn: 一个由先锋派艺术家、知识分子和政治理论家组成的左翼国际组织，被归类为“Ultragauche”（比一般极左更左）的思潮。它成立于1957年，解散于1972年，对欧洲现当代先锋艺术和激进哲学话语有极其重要影响。
description.en: A left-wing international organization of avant-garde artists, intellectuals, and political theorists, classified as 'Ultragauche' (further left than the general far-left). Active from 1957 to 1972, it had a significant impact on contemporary European avant-garde art and radical philosophical discourse.

description.zh-cn: 美国的共产主义政党，被John George和Laird Wilcox视为极左派政党。该党曾于1944年被其总书记厄尔·白劳德解散，后于1945年重建。
description.en: A communist political party in the United States, considered an extreme-left party by John George and Laird Wilcox. It was dissolved in 1944 by its General Secretary Earl Browder and re-established in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 被John George和Laird Wilcox视为美国的极左派政党。
被John George和Laird Wilcox视为美国的极左派政党。
被John George和Laird Wilcox视为美国的极左派政党。
法国极左派团体。

en: Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia
zh-cn: 捷克和摩拉维亚共产党

description.zh-cn: 被路克·马奇归类为欧洲极左派政党。
被路克·马奇归类为欧洲极左派政党。
被路克·马奇归类为欧洲极左派政党。
被路克·马奇归类为欧洲极左派政党。
文化大革命中的一个政治派别，与保皇派对立。杨小凯曾是其代表人物，并在《中国向何处去》中系统阐述了其主张。
description.en: A political faction during the Cultural Revolution, opposed to the Royalist faction. Yang Xiaokai was a representative figure who systematically elaborated its views in 'Where is China Going?'.

zh-cn: 毛泽东第一次接见红卫兵
en: Mao Zedong's meeting with Red Guards
Mao Zedong's reception of Red Guards
Mao Zedong's reception of the Red Guards

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月18日，毛泽东首次在北京天安门广场接见红卫兵。在这次活动中，宋彬彬为毛泽东戴上了红卫兵袖章。此后至11月，他连续八次接见来自全国各地的红卫兵，极大地推动了红卫兵运动的发展，并激发了各类红卫兵派系的形成与分化。
description.en: On August 18, 1966, Mao Zedong received Red Guards for the first time in Tiananmen Square, Beijing. During this event, Song Binbin put a Red Guard armband on Mao Zedong. Subsequently, until November, he met with Red Guards from across the country eight times, which greatly promoted the development of the Red Guard movement and spurred the formation and differentiation of various Red Guard factions.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治学者、民运人士、持不同政见者及社会运动人士。他曾因六四事件被捕入狱，被称为六四事件的“幕后黑手”。
description.en: Chinese political scientist, pro-democracy activist, dissident, and social activist. He was imprisoned for his involvement in the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and was labeled a 'black hand' behind the event.

description.zh-cn: 中国左派学者。
description.en: Chinese leftist scholar.

description.zh-cn: 指1927年至1949年间在中国发生的系列武装冲突，主要为中国国民党与中国共产党之间的斗争。
description.en: Refers to a series of armed conflicts in China between 1927 and 1949, primarily between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 清华大学附属中学红卫兵

description.zh-cn: 中国最早的红卫兵组织之一。

zh-cn: 毛主席给清华附中红卫兵的一封信

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东写给清华附中红卫兵的信件，表达了对他们“造反”行动的支持。
文革时期对《人民日报》、《解放军报》和《红旗》杂志的合称，是当时中共中央的主要宣传工具。

zh-cn: 北京红卫兵造反派五大领袖

description.zh-cn: 文革期间北京红卫兵造反派的五位主要负责人，包括聂元梓、蒯大富、谭厚兰、韩爱晶和王大宾。

en: Cleansing of the Three Types of People

description.zh-cn: 文革结束后的一场政治清理运动，旨在清除与林彪、四人帮集团有关的“三种人”。
隋炀帝之孙，李渊攻入长安后被拥立为帝，后禅位于李渊。
description.en: Grandson of Emperor Yang of Sui. He was enthroned by Li Yuan after the capture of Chang'an and later abdicated the throne to him.

en: Rebellions at the end of the Sui dynasty

description.zh-cn: 隋朝末年由于隋炀帝的暴政，特别是东征高句丽的巨大消耗，引发的全国性大规模民变和割据，最终导致隋朝灭亡。
description.en: Widespread rebellions and warlordism across China in the late Sui dynasty, caused by the tyranny of Emperor Yang, especially the immense costs of the Goguryeo campaigns, which ultimately led to the collapse of the Sui dynasty.

birth_place.en: Dangshan County, Song Prefecture, Tang Dynasty

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期后梁的开国皇帝。原为唐末参与黄巢起事的将领，后归降唐朝，官至宣武军节度使，逐渐控制朝政。907年篡唐自立，建立后梁。后为其子朱友珪所弑。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Later Liang dynasty during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. He was originally a general in the Huang Chao Rebellion in the late Tang dynasty, later surrendering to the Tang and rising to the position of military governor (jiedushi) of the Xuanwu Army, gradually seizing control of the imperial court. In 907, he usurped the Tang throne and established the Later Liang. He was later assassinated by his son, Zhu Yougui.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝末代皇帝，唐昭宗第九子。在昭宗被杀后，被朱温拥立为傀儡皇帝，后被禅位并遭杀害。
description.en: The last emperor of the Tang dynasty, the ninth son of Emperor Zhaozong. He was installed as a puppet emperor by Zhu Wen after his father's assassination, and was later forced to abdicate and subsequently murdered.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国中的第一个朝代，由朱温建立。
description.en: The first of the Five Dynasties during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, founded by Zhu Wen.

en: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period

description.zh-cn: 唐朝灭亡后中国历史上的一个时期。
唐朝末年由黄巢领导的一场大规模民变，严重动摇了唐朝的统治基础。
description.en: A major rebellion during the late Tang dynasty led by Huang Chao, which severely weakened the Tang regime.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝倒数第二位皇帝，唐懿宗第七子，唐僖宗的弟弟。在位期间，他试图削除藩镇与宦官势力，但后期反被军阀挟制，最终被朱温所杀。
description.en: The second to last emperor of the Tang dynasty, the seventh son of Emperor Yizong and younger brother of Emperor Xizong. During his reign, he attempted to eliminate the power of military governors (fanzhen) and eunuchs, but was later controlled by warlords and ultimately killed by Zhu Wen.

description.zh-cn: 莫斯科大公和首位俄罗斯沙皇。
description.en: Grand Prince of Moscow and the first Tsar of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，由刘少奇、邓小平主导派出，旨在指导并控制各单位运动发展的组织。后因被毛泽东批评而撤销。
description.en: In the early stage of the Cultural Revolution, organizations were primarily dispatched by Liu Shaoqi and Deng Xiaoping to guide and control the development of the movement in various units. They were later criticized by Mao Zedong and abolished.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期，对五类“阶级敌人”（地主、富农、反革命分子、坏分子、右派分子）的统称，也是红卫兵运动的主要打击对象。
description.en: A collective term during the Cultural Revolution for five types of "class enemies" (landlords, rich peasants, counter-revolutionaries, bad elements, and rightists), who were also the main targets of the Red Guard movement.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中被视为“资产阶级”并受到打击的社会群体。
description.en: A social group that was regarded as 'bourgeoisie' and subjected to persecution during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家，北京师范大学女子附属中学党总支书记兼副校长。在1966年“红八月”期间，被该校红卫兵学生批斗殴打致死，是北京市首位在文革中被打死的教育工作者。其丈夫是历史学者王晶垚。
description.en: A Chinese educator, Party Branch Secretary and Vice Principal of the Beijing Normal University Affiliated Girls' Middle School. During the 'Red August' of 1966, she was beaten to death by her Red Guard students during a struggle session, becoming the first educator killed in Beijing during the Cultural Revolution. Her husband was historian Wang Jingyao.

nodes.id: BAIDU:批判资产阶级反动路线

zh-cn: 批判资产阶级反动路线

description.zh-cn: 1966年10月由毛泽东发动的政治运动，将斗争矛头引向党政领导“当权派”。
日本第123代天皇，明治天皇的儿子和继任者。
description.en: The 123rd Emperor of Japan, son and successor of Emperor Meiji.

description.zh-cn: 一场日本内战，由倒幕派击败德川幕府，为明治维新铺平了道路。
日本江户时代的一个藩，位于九州西南部，是推翻德川幕府、推动明治维新的核心力量之一。
description.en: A domain of Japan during the Edo period, located in southwestern Kyūshū, which played a central role in the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代的一个藩，位于本州岛最西部。在幕末时期，它与萨摩藩结成萨长同盟，是倒幕运动的核心力量之一。
description.en: A feudal domain of Japan during the Edo period, located at the westernmost tip of Honshu. During the Bakumatsu period, it formed the Satcho Alliance with the Satsuma Domain and was one of the core forces in the movement to overthrow the Tokugawa shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国正式吞并大韩帝国的事件。
朝鲜王朝末期的国号，作为其延续。1910年因《日韩合并条约》被日本吞并而灭亡。
description.en: The name of the state of the late Joseon dynasty, as its continuation. It was extinguished in 1910 by the Japan-Korea Annexation Treaty due to annexation by Japan.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军和海军的统称，自1930年代起逐渐控制国家政治，推行军国主义。
现行日本宪法，于1946年11月3日公布，1947年5月3日施行。该宪法取代了《大日本帝国宪法》，正式结束了大日本帝国时期。
description.en: The current constitution of Japan, promulgated on November 3, 1946, and put into effect on May 3, 1947. It replaced the Constitution of the Empire of Japan and officially ended the Empire of Japan era.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜独立运动家，于1909年刺杀了伊藤博文。
description.en: A Korean independence activist who assassinated Itō Hirobumi in 1909.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军大将、政治家，第四十任内阁总理大臣，太平洋战争期间担任日本首相，是日本军国主义的代表人物。1943年在东京会见汪精卫。
description.en: A general of the Imperial Japanese Army and politician, he served as the 40th Prime Minister of Japan during the Pacific War and was a representative figure of Japanese militarism. He met with Wang Jingwei in Tokyo in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 上海青帮头目，是“上海滩三大亨”之一。其势力曾与王亚樵的斧头帮发生冲突。
description.en: A leader of the Green Gang in Shanghai and one of the "Three Tycoons of Shanghai". His forces once clashed with Wang Yaqiao's Axe Gang.

description.zh-cn: 上海青帮头目，“上海滩三大亨”之一，后与日本合作。
中国共产党早期工人运动领袖，时任上海总工会委员长，在四一二事件中被杀害。
description.en: The chairman of the Shanghai General Labor Union at the time, who was killed during the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国清末民初的秘密社会组织，其中在上海的分支于四一二事件中协助国民党右派攻击工人纠察队。
description.en: A secret society in Shanghai that assisted the KMT right-wing in attacking the workers' pickets during the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 杜月笙之子，生母孙佩豪。
杜月笙三房太太。
京剧老生演员，杜月笙五房太太，曾与梅兰芳有过一段未获家族承认的婚姻关系。
description.en: A Peking Opera Laosheng actress, Du Yuesheng's fifth wife, who had a relationship with Mei Lanfang that was not recognized by his family.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀的妻子，李显龙的母亲。
description.en: Wife of Lee Kuan Yew, mother of Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙的第一任妻子。
description.en: First wife of Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡华人，新加坡前总理李显龙的第二任妻子、前第一夫人。她曾长期担任淡马锡控股的执行董事及首席执行长，该公司是新天域资本公司的长期投资者。现为清华大学经济管理学院顾问委员会委员。
description.en: A Singaporean Chinese businesswoman, the second wife of former Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong, and former First Lady of Singapore. She served for many years as the Executive Director and CEO of Temasek Holdings, which is a long-term investor in New Horizon Capital. She is currently a member of the advisory board of the Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙的妹妹。
description.en: Sister of Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡商人，李光耀之子，李显龙之弟。
description.en: A Singaporean businessman, son of Lee Kuan Yew and younger brother of Lee Hsien Loong.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙与黄名扬的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Lee Hsien Loong and Wong Ming Yang.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙与黄名扬的儿子。
description.en: Son of Lee Hsien Loong and Wong Ming Yang.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙与何晶的儿子。
description.en: Son of Lee Hsien Loong and Ho Ching.

description.zh-cn: 李显龙与何晶的儿子。
description.en: Son of Lee Hsien Loong and Ho Ching.

description.zh-cn: 位于东南亚的岛国和城邦，前英国殖民地。曾于1963年至1965年短暂加入马来西亚联邦，后于1965年独立建国。该地亦是邵维铭的出生地及主要活动地。巩俐于2008年成为其公民。
description.en: An island country and city-state in Southeast Asia. Formerly a British colony, it briefly joined the Federation of Malaysia from 1963 to 1965 before becoming an independent nation in 1965. It is also the birthplace and main place of activity for Shao Vee-Meng. Gong Li became a citizen in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的军事力量，与台湾和以色列有紧密的军事合作关系。
description.en: The military forces of Singapore, which have close military cooperation with Taiwan and Israel.

description.zh-cn: 军衔
description.en: Military rank

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的执政党，由李光耀等人于1954年创立。该党自1959年新加坡自治以来长期掌权，在与马来西亚联邦政府的政治较量中扮演核心角色，并奉行保守主义、经济自由主义和实用主义等意识形态。
description.en: The ruling political party of Singapore, founded in 1954 by Lee Kuan Yew and others. It has been in power since Singapore's self-governance in 1959, played a central role in the political struggle with the Malaysian federal government, and adheres to ideologies such as conservatism, economic liberalism, and pragmatism.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的政府首脑。人民行动党历任秘书长均担任此职务。
description.en: The head of government of Singapore. The Secretaries-General of the People's Action Party have concurrently held this position.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，曾任新加坡第二任总理，并于1992年至2004年担任人民行动党秘书长。他还在1997年大选后控告邓亮洪诽谤。
description.en: Singaporean politician who served as the second Prime Minister of Singapore and as the Secretary-General of the People's Action Party from 1992 to 2004. He also sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation after the 1997 general election.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，现任新加坡总理及人民行动党秘书长。
description.en: Singaporean politician, the current Prime Minister of Singapore and Secretary-General of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华人民共和国外交部副部长。
description.en: Then Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 旨在建立一个独立于中国的，以台湾为领土的主权国家的政治运动。
description.en: A political movement aimed at establishing a sovereign state with Taiwan as its territory, independent from China.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国外交部部长。
description.en: Then Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨首相。
description.en: Prime Minister of Cambodia.

zh-cn: 一个马来西亚发展有限公司丑闻
一个马来西亚有限公司丑闻

description.zh-cn: 涉及一个马来西亚发展有限公司（1MDB）的大型贪腐、贿赂和洗钱丑闻。
description.en: A major corruption, bribery, and money laundering scandal involving 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB).

description.zh-cn: 新加坡异议分子。
description.en: Singaporean dissident.

description.zh-cn: 宣德元年（1426年），明宣宗叔父汉王朱高煦趁北京地震之机，在自己的封地乐安州发动的叛乱。此叛乱很快被明宣宗御驾亲征平定。
description.en: A rebellion launched in 1426 by Zhu Gaoxu, Prince of Han (uncle of Emperor Xuande), in his fief of Le'an Prefecture, taking advantage of an earthquake in Beijing. It was quickly suppressed by the Xuande Emperor who personally led the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁大学士，辅佐明宣宗。在平定高煦之乱时，力劝明宣宗御驾亲征。
description.en: A Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty who strongly advised the Xuande Emperor to personally lead the campaign to suppress Zhu Gaoxu's rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗设立的教导宦官读书的机构。
安南后黎朝的建立者，曾反叛明朝。
明代蒙古部落，曾骚扰明朝边疆。
紫禁城内廷后三宫之一，明宣宗、明穆宗逝世地。
明宣宗朱瞻基的原配皇后，后被废为道姑，道号静慈仙师。明英宗时恢复皇后名誉，追谥为恭让诚顺康穆静慈章皇后。
description.en: The first empress consort of the Xuande Emperor of the Ming Dynasty. She was later deposed and forced to become a Daoist nun with the title 'Jingci Xianshi'. Her title of empress was posthumously restored by Emperor Yingzong.

description.zh-cn: 明宣宗妃嫔，为宣宗殉葬。
温斯顿·丘吉尔的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Winston Churchill.

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·丘吉尔的父亲，曾任英国财政大臣。
description.en: Father of Winston Churchill, served as Chancellor of the Exchequer.

description.zh-cn: 英国前首相，因推行绥靖政策而闻名。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, known for his policy of appeasement.

description.zh-cn: 英国工党政治家，曾任丘吉尔的副首相，后接替其成为首相。
description.en: British Labour politician who served as Churchill's Deputy Prime Minister and later succeeded him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 英国的一个主要政党，后与社会民主党合并为自由民主党。
description.en: A major political party in the United Kingdom, later merged with the Social Democratic Party to form the Liberal Democrats.

description.zh-cn: 二战时期的英国国王。
description.en: King of the United Kingdom during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 前英国女王，在丘吉尔第二次首相任期内登基。她同时也是前加拿大女王，曾御准《1982年加拿大法令》。此外，她于1960年授予香港赛马会“皇家”称号。
description.en: Former Queen of the United Kingdom, who ascended to the throne during Churchill's second term as Prime Minister. She was also the former Queen of Canada and gave Royal Assent to the Canada Act 1982. Additionally, she granted the 'Royal' title to The Hong Kong Jockey Club in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，曾任丘吉尔的副首相，后接替其成为首相。
description.en: British politician who served as Churchill's Deputy Prime Minister and later succeeded him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战期间，协约国为夺取达达尼尔海峡而发动的战役，以失败告终。
description.en: A campaign of the First World War that took place on the Gallipoli peninsula, launched by the Allies to seize the Dardanelles, which ended in failure.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间纳粹德国对英国发动的大规模空战。
description.en: A large-scale air campaign waged by the German Air Force against the United Kingdom during World War II.

zh-cn: 桑赫斯特皇家军事学院
桑德赫斯特皇家军事学院

description.zh-cn: 英国陆军的军官训练中心。
description.en: The British Army's initial officer training centre.

location.zh-cn: 英国牛津郡伍德斯托克

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的最高行政官职。该职位在胡惟庸案后被朱元璋废除。
description.en: The highest administrative office in ancient China. The position was abolished by the Hongwu Emperor after the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏是三国时期的北方政权之一，由曹丕建立，其基础由曹操奠定。于禁曾是其重要将领。曹魏最终接受了蜀汉皇帝刘禅的投降。
description.en: Cao Wei was one of the northern states during the Three Kingdoms period, founded by Cao Pi, with its foundations laid by Cao Cao. Yu Jin was one of its prominent generals. It eventually accepted the surrender of Liu Shan, emperor of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期由孙权建立的政权之一，其基础由孙策奠定，位于江东地区。
description.en: One of the three major states that competed for supremacy over China in the Three Kingdoms period, founded by Sun Quan, with its foundation laid by Sun Ce, and located in the Jiangdong region.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮之父，东汉末年为泰山郡丞。
description.en: Father of Zhuge Liang, served as the assistant magistrate of Taishan Commandery during the late Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年名士，诸葛亮岳父。
description.en: A scholar of the late Eastern Han dynasty, father-in-law of Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期东吴官员，诸葛亮之兄，诸葛乔的生父。
description.en: An official of Eastern Wu during the Three Kingdoms period, the elder brother of Zhuge Liang, and the biological father of Zhuge Qiao.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮之弟，仕于蜀汉。
description.en: Younger brother of Zhuge Liang, served in Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮长子，蜀汉大臣、将领。
description.en: Eldest son of Zhuge Liang, a minister and general of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉官员，字伯松，原字仲慎。原为诸葛瑾的次子，后被诸葛亮收为养子。
description.en: An official of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. His courtesy name was Bosong, originally Zhongshen. He was originally the second son of Zhuge Jin and was later adopted by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮叔父，曾在袁术和刘表麾下。
description.en: Uncle of Zhuge Liang, served under Yuan Shu and Liu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮好友，曾向刘备举荐诸葛亮。
description.en: Friend of Zhuge Liang, recommended Zhuge Liang to Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮好友。
description.en: Friend of Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 刘备重要谋士，与诸葛亮齐名，号称“凤雏”。
description.en: An important advisor to Liu Bei, as famous as Zhuge Liang, known as the 'Fledgling Phoenix'.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在夷陵之战失败后，于永安病危时将儿子刘禅托付给诸葛亮、李严等人的事件。
description.en: After his defeat at the Battle of Yiling, the dying Liu Bei entrusted his son Liu Shan to the care of Zhuge Liang and Li Yan.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮为平定南中地区的叛乱而发动的军事行动。
description.en: A military campaign launched by Zhuge Liang to pacify the rebellions in the Nanzhong region.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期南中地区的首领。
description.en: A local leader in the Nanzhong region during the Three Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期，蜀汉丞相诸葛亮为实现“兴复汉室，还于旧都”的目标，于228年至234年间对曹魏发动的五次军事行动。这些北伐战争最终未能改变汉魏在汉中对峙的格局。
description.en: During the Three Kingdoms period, Zhuge Liang, chancellor of Shu Han, launched five military campaigns against Cao Wei between 228 and 234, aiming to "restore the Han dynasty and return to the old capital." These northern expeditions ultimately failed to alter the stalemate between Shu Han and Cao Wei in Hanzhong.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮在第一次北伐前写给后主刘禅的奏章，表达了其忠诚、北伐的决心，并陈述了出师的原因和对内政的安排。
description.en: A memorial written by Zhuge Liang to Emperor Liu Shan before his first Northern Expedition, expressing his loyalty and determination for the campaign, and outlining his reasons for the expedition and arrangements for domestic affairs.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉参军。在街亭之战中因违背诸葛亮部署导致大败，后被诸葛亮处斩。
description.en: A military advisor of Shu Han, executed by Zhuge Liang after his defeat at the Battle of Jieting due to disobeying orders.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的太傅、政治家、军事家、权臣，西晋的奠基人。诸葛亮北伐时的主要对手，高平陵之变后掌控曹魏大权。
description.en: A strategist, politician, and regent of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period of China, and the founder of the Jin dynasty. He was also the primary adversary of Zhuge Liang during the Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 他原为袁绍部将，官渡之战后投降曹操，成为曹魏“五子良将”之一。作为曹魏名将，在街亭之战中大败马谡，后在第四次北伐中追击蜀军时中埋伏而死。
description.en: Originally a general under Yuan Shao, he surrendered to Cao Cao after the Battle of Guandu, becoming one of the Five Great Generals of Cao Wei. As a renowned general, he defeated Ma Su at the Battle of Jieting. He was later ambushed and killed while pursuing Shu forces during the fourth Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉大司马。作为蜀汉重臣，他也是诸葛亮指定的继承人之一。
description.en: Grand Marshal of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. As a key official of Shu Han, he was also one of the successors designated by Zhuge Liang.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉重臣，与蒋琬、董允等人同为诸葛亮指定的继承人，共同执政。
description.en: A key minister of Shu Han, designated by Zhuge Liang as a successor along with Jiang Wan and Dong Yun to manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 位于今陕西省宝鸡市岐山县，渭水南岸的台地。此处是诸葛亮第五次（亦是最后一次）北伐时，与司马懿对峙并最终病逝的地方。
description.en: Located on a plateau on the south bank of the Wei River, in modern-day Qishan County, Baoji, Shaanxi. This is the place where Zhuge Liang confronted Sima Yi during his fifth (and final) Northern Expedition, and eventually passed away.

description.zh-cn: 秦国公子，奉命平定嫪毐之乱。
清朝初年宗室、将领，努尔哈赤之侄，与多尔衮同为顺治帝的辅政王。
description.en: An early Qing Dynasty imperial family member and general, a nephew of Nurhaci, who served as co-regent for the Shunzhi Emperor alongside Dorgon.

description.zh-cn: 顺治帝皇贵妃，追封皇后，其死对顺治帝打击甚大。
第五世达赖喇嘛，西藏格鲁派领袖，建立了甘丹颇章政权。
description.en: The 5th Dalai Lama, leader of the Tibetan Gelug school, who established the Ganden Phodrang government.

en: Deliberative Council of Princes and Ministers

description.zh-cn: 清朝前期最具影响力的决策机构。
一种由天花病毒引起的烈性传染病。

location.zh-cn: 山海关一片石（今九门口）

description.zh-cn: 1644年5月，清、关宁联军与李自成大顺军在山海关附近（一片石）进行的关键决战。清朝在此役中取得决定性胜利，为清军入关并最终统一中国铺平了道路。
description.en: A key battle fought in 1644 near Shanhai Pass between the allied forces of the Qing dynasty and the Guan-Ning Army against the Dashun army. The victory paved the way for the Qing to enter the pass and eventually unify China.

description.zh-cn: 由顺治帝设立，由汉族宦官掌控的内廷机构。
清朝初期的皇宫，顺治帝出生地。

Central Political and Legal Cadre School
North China Public Security Cadre School
Senior Police Officer College of the Ministry of Public Security

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公安部直属的公安警察院校，被誉为“共和国高级警官的摇篮”，是中国公安系统最高学府。
description.en: A police academy directly under the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China, known as the 'cradle of the Republic's senior police officers', it is the highest educational institution in China's public security system.

description.zh-cn: 2013年在福建省厦门市发生的一起公交车纵火案件
中国政治人物，原河南省公安厅厅长
中华人民共和国公务员体系和中国共产党、国家领导人职务级别中的一个等级，仅次于国家级正职。罗豪才曾因担任全国政协副主席而位列其中。陈良宇在担任中共中央政治局委员后也达到此级别。
description.en: A rank in the civil service system and one of the leadership position levels in the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, second only to the national-level principal position. Luo Haocai held this rank as Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, and Chen Liangyu also reached this level after becoming a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民警察警衔体系的最高等级
中国政治人物，时任河南省省长

zh-cn: 军事委员会别动忠义救国军
苏浙行动委员会别働队

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵，中国同盟会会员，中华民国大陆时期著名刺客。他于1921年在上海组织“斧头帮”（曾与黄金荣、杜月笙等争夺地盘）和“铁血锄奸团”，策划并实施了针对徐国梁、宋子文、汪精卫及多名日本军政要员的暗杀行动。他还在1931年在庐山策划了对蒋介石的未遂刺杀。最终在广西梧州被军统特务刺杀身亡。
description.en: Wang Yaqiao, a member of the Tongmenghui and a famous assassin during the Republic of China era. In 1921, he organized the 'Axe Gang' (which competed for territory with local powers like Huang Jinrong and Du Yuesheng) and the 'Iron and Blood Elimination Group' in Shanghai, planning and executing assassinations against figures such as Xu Guoliang, T. V. Soong, Wang Jingwei, and several Japanese military and political officials. He also planned a failed assassination attempt on Chiang Kai-shek at Mount Lu in 1931. He was eventually assassinated by Juntong agents in Wuzhou, Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军中校

zh-cn: 1946年中国空军222号专机南京空难

description.zh-cn: 军统北平站站长
军统总务处处长
贺子珍之父。
贺子珍之兄，中国政治人物，曾任福建省环境保护领导小组组长。
description.en: Brother of He Zizhen, Chinese political figure, former head of the Fujian Provincial Environmental Protection Leading Group.

description.zh-cn: 贺子珍之妹，毛泽覃之妻。
美国记者、作家和社会活动家，以报道中国革命而闻名，与斯诺、斯特朗并称“3S”。
description.en: American journalist, writer, and social activist, known for her reporting on the Chinese Revolution. Grouped with Snow and Strong as the '3S'.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国江西省九江市的著名山脉，是世界文化遗产、世界地质公园和国家5A级旅游景区。以其秀丽的自然风光和深厚的文化、政治历史内涵而闻名，曾是中华民国政府的“夏都”和多次中共中央重要会议的举办地。
description.en: A famous mountain in Jiujiang, Jiangxi, China, designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, a Global Geopark, and a National 5A Tourist Attraction. Known for its scenic beauty and profound cultural and political history, it served as the 'summer capital' of the Republic of China and the venue for several important CPC Central Committee meetings.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上继西周之后的朝代。
description.en: The second half of the Zhou dynasty of ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期函谷关关令，请老子著《道德经》。
description.en: The guardian of the Hangu Pass during the Spring and Autumn period who asked Laozi to write the Tao Te Ching.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国初期思想家。
description.en: A Chinese philosopher during the early Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 老子之父。曾任周定王时期的御史大夫，后被唐玄宗隔代追尊为“先天太上皇”。
description.en: Laozi's father. He served as Censor-in-chief during the reign of King Ding of Zhou and was posthumously honored by Emperor Xuanzong of Tang as 'Xiantian Taishang Huang' (Primordial Grand Emperor) across generations.

description.zh-cn: 老子之母。
description.en: Laozi's mother.

description.zh-cn: 老子之子。
description.en: Laozi's son.

description.zh-cn: 道教的最高神祇。
description.en: The highest deities in the Taoist pantheon.

description.zh-cn: 毛新宇的第一任妻子。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事科学院战争研究院

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议北京市西城区委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国数学家、教育家和政治人物，曾任北京大学校长。
中华人民共和国军事将领，中国人民解放军少将。曾任中国军事科学院历史研究部研究员，是毛新宇的博士导师。
description.en: A military general of the People's Republic of China and a major general in the People's Liberation Army. He once served as a researcher in the Military History Department of the PLA Academy of Military Science, and was Mao Xinyu's doctoral supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 毛新宇的外祖父。
富兰克林·罗斯福的妻子，美国第一夫人。
description.en: Wife of Franklin D. Roosevelt and First Lady of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国第28任总统，进步主义时代的领袖人物，其政治理念被称为“威尔逊主义”。他曾是学者、普林斯顿大学校长和新泽西州州长，并任命罗斯福为海军助理部长。他领导美国参加第一次世界大战，并倡导建立国际联盟。
description.en: The 28th President of the United States, a leader of the Progressive Era, whose political philosophy is known as 'Wilsonianism'. He was an academic, President of Princeton University, and Governor of New Jersey, and he appointed Roosevelt as Assistant Secretary of the Navy. He led the United States into World War I and advocated for the formation of the League of Nations.

description.zh-cn: 罗斯福前两任的副总统。
description.en: Roosevelt's Vice President for his first two terms.

description.zh-cn: 罗斯福的第三任副总统，曾任农业部长。
description.en: Roosevelt's third-term Vice President and former Secretary of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 富兰克林·罗斯福的父亲。
description.en: Father of Franklin D. Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 富兰克林·罗斯福的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Franklin D. Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 埃莉诺·罗斯福的社交秘书，与富兰克林·罗斯福有婚外情。
description.en: Social secretary to Eleanor Roosevelt and had an affair with Franklin D. Roosevelt.

en: List of presidents of the United States

description.zh-cn: 美国国家元首和政府首脑的职位。
description.en: The office of the head of state and head of government of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 允许美国向盟国提供军事物资的法案。
description.en: A program under which the United States supplied Allied nations with war material.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战末期，美、英、苏三国（罗斯福、丘吉尔、斯大林）首脑举行会议，商讨战后世界秩序。会议中，苏联秘密承诺在德国投降后对日作战，同时达成的协议规定了苏联在远东的利益，为1945年《中苏友好同盟条约》的签订奠定了基础。
description.en: A conference held by the heads of government of the US, UK, and Soviet Union (Roosevelt, Churchill, and Stalin) near the end of World War II to discuss the post-war reorganization of the world. During the conference, the USSR secretly committed to entering the war against Japan after Germany's surrender. The agreements also defined Soviet interests in the Far East, laying the groundwork for the 1945 Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.

description.en: The nineteenth son of Emperor Taizu Zhu Yuanzhang, he was enfeoffed as the Prince of Gu. During the Jingnan Campaign, he and Li Jinglong together opened the Jinchuan Gate to surrender to Prince Yan Zhu Di.

description.en: The fifth son of Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang), he was created Prince Ding of Zhou and served as Left Zongren of the Zongrenfu during the Ming Dynasty. Official histories record him as the son of Empress Ma. He was later deposed as a commoner during Emperor Jianwen's reign; during this period, he was arrested by Li Jinglong, and later accused Li Jinglong during the Yongle era.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第十二子，在建文帝削藩时自焚而死。

description.en: The first emperor of the Southern Ming dynasty. He rehabilitated Emperor Jianwen and granted him temple and posthumous names. He also posthumously honored Emperor Jingtai with the temple name 'Daizong', and granted Fang Xiaoru the title of Grand Preceptor and the posthumous name 'Wenzheng'.

description.en: Taiwanese businessman and former civil servant. He served as an engineer in the Department of Construction and a director of the Housing and Urban Development Bureau of the Taiwan Provincial Government. He later entered business as the chairman of Kai Chu Group and Mao Kai Company, and also served as chairman of the De Fa Charitable Foundation. His son is the politician Fu Kun-chi. He received a suspended sentence in 2010 for violating company law during the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

description.en: Tamkang University is a private comprehensive university located in Tamsui District, New Taipei City. It was founded in 1950 by Ju Zheng, Zou Lu, Zhang Ming, and Chang Chien-pang as 'Tamkang English Junior College'. It was renamed 'Tamkang College of Arts and Sciences' in 1958 and elevated to university status in 1980. It currently has three campuses: Tamsui, Taipei, and Lanyang. The famous writer Gu Long once studied here when the university was known as Tamkang English College.

description.zh-cn: 2025年间在中华民国发生的一场大规模政治及社会运动，旨在罢免各地民选公职人员，主要对象涵盖中国国民党与民主进步党的立法委员及地方首长（例如针对傅崐萁的罢免运动）。最终，所有进入投票阶段的罢免案均以不通过告终。
description.en: A large-scale political and social movement in the Republic of China (Taiwan) during 2025, aiming to recall elected public officials across the country, primarily targeting legislators and local government heads from both the Kuomintang (KMT) and the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), such as the recall movement against Fu Kun-chi. Ultimately, all recall proposals that proceeded to a vote failed.

description.en: The highest supervisory agency of the Republic of China, is one of the highest state organs defined by the Constitution of the Republic of China under its Five-Power Constitution. Its powers include monitoring, auditing, impeaching, and censuring government officials.

description.en: The 'Shaanxi Hundred-Billion-Yuan Mining Rights Case' refers to the long-term litigation from 2006 to 2019 between Kailai Energy Investment Co., Ltd. and the Xi'an Institute of Geology and Mineral Exploration over a cooperative exploration contract for coal resources worth hundreds of billions of yuan. The case garnered widespread public attention due to the disappearance of case files at the Supreme People's Court and judicial interference by multiple high-ranking officials. The legal representative of Kailai Energy Investment Co., Ltd., a key party in this case, engaged in over a decade of litigation and whistleblowing concerning it.

唐代文学家、诗人，中唐最具代表性的诗人之一。他文章精切，擅长诗歌创作，代表作有《长恨歌》。白居易倡导新乐府运动，其诗歌作品平易近人，流传甚广。他曾被贬为江州司马，期间在庐山修建草堂并撰写《庐山草堂记》。
description.en: A Tang dynasty writer and poet, and one of the most representative poets of the mid-Tang period. Bai Juyi was known for his incisive prose and exceptional skill in poetry, with 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow' as a representative work. He advocated the New Yuefu movement, and his poetry is noted for its accessibility and widespread popularity. During his exile as the Sima of Jiangzhou, he built a thatched cottage on Mount Lu and authored 'Record of the Thatched Cottage on Mount Lu'.

description.zh-cn: 白居易创作的长篇叙事诗，描述了唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情悲剧，是其流传最广的作品之一。
description.en: A long narrative poem by Bai Juyi depicting the tragic love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei. It is one of his most widely circulated works.

In November 1925, he formed the Five-Province Allied Army in Nanjing and rose against the Fengtian clique, being one of the initiators of the Anti-Fengtian War.
