description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州的城市，是理查德·尼克松的出生地。
description.en: A city in California, USA, the birthplace of Richard Nixon.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，时任并州刺史，为吕布的旧主。在洛阳与董卓对峙时，被其义子吕布所杀。
description.en: An official of the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as the Inspector of Bing Province and was Lü Bu's original master. During a standoff with Dong Zhuo in Luoyang, he was killed by his adopted son Lü Bu.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀及权臣，原为凉州将领，受大将军何进征召率兵入京，趁乱夺取中央政权，废黜汉少帝，另立汉献帝，自封相国，独揽大权。他官至太师，是李傕、郭汜等人的原主帅。其统治残暴，乱政导致许靖等人逃离京城，并引发关东诸侯讨伐。最终被司徒王允和义子吕布合谋刺杀。
description.en: A warlord and powerful minister in the late Eastern Han dynasty. Originally a general from Liang Province, he was summoned to the capital by General-in-Chief He Jin, where he seized central power amidst the chaos, deposing Emperor Shao and installing Emperor Xian, proclaiming himself Chancellor and monopolizing authority. He served as Grand Tutor and was the original commander of figures like Li Jue and Guo Si. His tyrannical rule and misgovernment caused people like Xu Jing to flee the capital and provoked a crusade by a coalition of warlords. He was ultimately assassinated in a plot by Minister over the Masses Wang Yun and his adopted son Lü Bu.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，官至司徒。不满董卓专权，设计反间计，联合吕布成功刺杀了董卓。董卓死后，未能妥善处理其凉州旧部，导致李傕、郭汜反攻长安，最终兵败被杀。
description.en: An official of the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as Minister over the Masses. Dissatisfied with Dong Zhuo's tyranny, he devised a plot and successfully assassinated Dong Zhuo in collaboration with Lü Bu. After Dong Zhuo's death, his mishandling of Dong's former subordinates led to a counterattack on Chang'an by Li Jue and Guo Si, resulting in his defeat and death.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀，曾收留吕布。
吕布的主要谋士。
吕布麾下名将，统领“陷阵营”。
吕布麾下将领，后投降曹操，成为曹魏名将。
东汉末年的群雄之一，出自凉州军阀，是继董卓之后的权臣。他原为董卓部将，董卓死后，采纳贾诩之策，与郭汜等人合兵击败吕布并攻陷长安，杀死王允，把持朝政数年。其人性格勇猛诡谲，善于用兵，有辩才。官至大司马、车骑将军、司隶校尉，爵位为池阳侯。
description.en: A warlord from Liang Province during the late Eastern Han dynasty, and a powerful minister who succeeded Dong Zhuo. Originally a subordinate of Dong Zhuo, after Dong Zhuo's death, he accepted Jia Xu's advice and, along with Guo Si and others, attacked and captured Chang'an, defeated Lu Bu, killed Wang Yun, and controlled the imperial court for several years. He was known for his ferocity, cunning, and military skill, as well as his eloquence. He held high offices including Grand Marshal, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Colonel-Director of Retainers, and was enfeoffed as the Marquis of Chiyang.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年董卓的部将。董卓死后，与李傕等人攻入长安，把持朝政，并挟持汉献帝。后与李傕争权反目，互相攻击，最终被部将伍习所杀。
description.en: A general under the warlord Dong Zhuo during the late Eastern Han dynasty. After Dong Zhuo's death, he joined forces with Li Jue and others to attack Chang'an, controlling the imperial court and holding Emperor Xian hostage. He later had a falling out with Li Jue, fighting for power and attacking each other, and was eventually killed by his subordinate Wu Xi.

description.zh-cn: 吕布部将，后于下邳之战中反叛。
吕布部将，后于下邳之战中反叛。
吕布部将，后于下邳之战中反叛。
吕布部将，受袁术怂恿反叛吕布。
郝萌部将，在郝萌反叛时倒戈。
徐州名士，陈登之父，曾挑拨吕布与袁术的关系。
徐州名士，陈珪之子，作为曹操的内应共同对付吕布。
吕布之女，姓名未载于史书。
吕布所获封的爵位。
唐高宗同母妹。
唐高宗长子。
唐高宗的宫人，燕王李忠的母亲。
唐高宗第四子。
武则天的姐姐。
武则天的外甥女，武顺的女儿。
唐高宗在位初期的治世。
唐高宗时期的御医。
唐朝初年宰相、外戚，长孙皇后之兄。他曾在玄武门之变中与房玄龄等人并功第一，并在储位之争中支持立晋王李治为太子。
description.en: An early Tang dynasty chancellor and imperial relative, brother of Empress Zhangsun. He was ranked first in merit, along with Fang Xuanling and others, for his role in the Xuanwu Gate Incident, and later supported establishing Prince Jin (Li Zhi) as the crown prince during the succession struggle.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝大臣、书法家，官至谏议大夫。他反对立李泰为太子，并为李泰出资修建的《伊阙佛龛碑》书写碑文。
description.en: A minister and calligrapher of the Tang dynasty. He opposed making Li Tai the crown prince and wrote the calligraphy for the 'Stele of the Yique Buddha Niche' sponsored by Li Tai.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗时期宰相。
丹增嘉措的父亲。
description.en: Father of Tenzin Gyatso.

description.zh-cn: 丹增嘉措的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Tenzin Gyatso.

description.zh-cn: 第十三世达赖喇嘛，丹增嘉措的前世。
description.en: The 13th Dalai Lama, predecessor of Tenzin Gyatso.

description.zh-cn: 西藏流亡政府。
description.en: Tibetan government-in-exile.

zh-cn: 西藏自治区筹备委员会

description.zh-cn: 为建立西藏自治区而设立的筹备机构。
description.en: A preparatory body established for the creation of the Tibet Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 1912年至1951年西藏的武装力量。
description.en: The armed forces of Tibet from 1912 to 1951.

en: Seventeen Point Agreement for the Peaceful Liberation of Tibet
zh-cn: 中央人民政府和西藏地方政府关于和平解放西藏办法的协议

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府与西藏地方政府签订的关于西藏和平解放的协议。
description.en: The agreement signed by the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China and the local government of Tibet regarding the peaceful liberation of Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的一次大规模内部安全行动，逮捕了多名左翼政治人物。
description.en: A major internal security operation in Singapore that saw the arrest of many left-wing political figures.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡左翼政治家和工会领袖，人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: Singaporean left-wing politician and trade union leader, one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

en: Tunku Abdul Rahman Putra Al-Haj ibni Almarhum Sultan Abdul Hamid Halim Shah
zh-cn: 东姑阿都拉曼不大拉·聂尼阿鲁马空苏丹阿都哈密·哈林沙

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第一任首相，巫统前领导人。他被尊称为马来西亚“国父”。在其任期内，他下令将新加坡州自马来西亚联邦中除名。他的接班人为敦阿都拉萨。
description.en: First Prime Minister of Malaysia and former leader of UMNO. He is revered as the "Father of Malaysia". During his tenure, he ordered the removal of the State of Singapore from the Federation of Malaysia. He was succeeded by Tun Abdul Razak.

description.zh-cn: 曾存在于新加坡的海外第一所华文大学，后与新加坡大学合并为新加坡国立大学。邓亮洪是其校友。
description.en: The first Chinese-language university outside of China, located in Singapore. It later merged with the University of Singapore to form the National University of Singapore. Tang Liang Hong is an alumnus.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的一项法律，授权政府在未经审判的情况下拘留被认为对国家安全构成威胁的个人。
description.en: A Singaporean law that allows for detention without trial for individuals deemed a threat to national security.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡前国会议员，未经审判被拘留和限制长达32年。
description.en: Former Singaporean Member of Parliament who was detained and restricted for 32 years without trial.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治人物、律师，曾是反对党领袖。
description.en: Singaporean politician, lawyer, and former opposition leader.

description.zh-cn: 海峡两岸自1949年分立后，官方授权的民间机构领导人首次举行的会谈。
description.en: The first meeting between the heads of officially authorized non-governmental organizations from both sides of the Taiwan Strait since 1949.

zh-cn: 剑桥大学菲茨威廉学院

description.zh-cn: 淡马锡控股是一家总部位于新加坡的国际投资公司，曾由何晶主掌。它作为新加坡国有控股公司，也是新天域资本公司的长期投资者。
description.en: Temasek Holdings is an international investment company headquartered in Singapore, formerly headed by Ho Ching. As a Singaporean state-owned holding company, it is also a long-term investor in New Horizon Capital.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、学者，民主进步党籍。曾任台中市市长，现任外交部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, scholar, and current Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的政策研究机构。

zh-cn: 2019年台中市第五选举区立法委员缺额补选

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物。
台湾政治人物，现任卓荣泰内阁劳动部部长。
description.en: Minister of Labor in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 台湾时事评论员。
中华民国陆军少将，中正国防干部预备学校75年班（中八期）校友。现为台湾政治人物及军事评论员。
description.en: A Major General of the R.O.C. Army and an alumnus of the class of 1986 (8th class) of Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School. He is currently a Taiwanese politician and military commentator.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新闻媒体人。
台湾政治人物、政治幕僚、政治评论人、节目主持人。
台湾男艺人、主持人，以发掘周杰伦进入乐坛而闻名。他也是一位政治人物，现任立法委员。
description.en: Taiwanese male artist and host, known for discovering Jay Chou and bringing him into the music industry. He is also a politician and currently serves as a legislator.

zh-cn: 劳动部公务员霸凌轻生案

description.zh-cn: 导致时任劳动部部长何佩珊辞职的事件。
description.en: An event that led to the resignation of the then-Minister of Labor, Ho Pei-shan.

description.zh-cn: 周慧敏的丈夫，亦舒的侄子，作家倪匡之子。
description.en: Yi Shu's nephew, son of Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手，Raidas组合主音，周慧敏前男友。
周慧敏曾就读的小学。
周慧敏曾就读的中学。
香港特别行政区政府商务及经济发展局辖下的部门，是香港广播史上的首家广播机构，也是香港唯一的公共广播机构。
description.en: A department under the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government. It is the first broadcasting station in Hong Kong's broadcasting history and the only public service broadcaster in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港的媒体创作及管理人，曾赏识周慧敏。
香港电台监制，曾鼓励周慧敏参赛。
香港电台监制，曾鼓励周慧敏参赛。
香港歌手，曾与周慧敏合作主持节目及合唱歌曲。
周慧敏走红时期签约的唱片公司。
周慧敏在台湾签约的唱片公司。

death_place.zh-cn: 香港中环香港文华东方酒店
death_place.en: Mandarin Oriental, Hong Kong, Central, Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港男歌手、演员、词曲作家，粤语流行音乐高峰时期的代表人物及亚洲顶级巨星、华人流行文化指标。他在音乐和电影领域均取得辉煌成就。他曾为周慧敏作曲，并公开赞赏黎明，于1993年为其颁发“最受欢迎男歌星”奖项。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer, actor, and songwriter, a representative figure during the golden age of Cantopop, and a top Asian superstar and icon of Chinese popular culture. He achieved immense success in both music and film. He composed music for Vivian Chow, publicly praised Leon Lai, and presented him with the 'Most Popular Male Singer' award in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 台湾歌手及音乐制作人，曾与周慧敏合唱《流言》。
香港歌手及演员，周慧敏的好友，其演唱会创作总监。
古巨基的妻子，周慧敏的经纪人。
中国近现代著名建筑师、作家、诗人、建筑学家，中国历史上第一位女建筑学者。她曾是宾夕法尼亚大学校友，后任清华大学建筑系教授，并担任中华人民共和国国徽设计小组的主要成员。她也是梁思成的第一任妻子。
description.en: Famous modern Chinese architect, writer, poet, and the first female architect in Chinese history. An alumna of the University of Pennsylvania, she later became a professor at the Department of Architecture at Tsinghua University and a key member of the design group for the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China. She was also the first wife of Liang Sicheng.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国纽约市曼哈顿的世界顶级私立研究型大学。该校曾向流亡美国的魏京生提供支持（后于2001年中止），汤川秀树曾在此担任客座教授。罗豪才曾在此进修，萧美琴在此获得政治学硕士学位。
description.en: A world-class private research university in Manhattan, New York City, United States. It provided support to Wei Jingsheng after his exile to the U.S. (terminated in 2001), and Hideki Yukawa served as a visiting professor. Luo Haocai pursued advanced studies here, and Hsiao Bi-khim earned her Master's degree in Political Science.

description.zh-cn: 道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟的父亲，美国陆军中将
description.en: Father of Douglas MacArthur, United States Army lieutenant general

description.zh-cn: 美国远征军司令
description.en: Commander of the American Expeditionary Forces

description.zh-cn: 美国第一所军事学校，位于纽约州西点。
description.en: The first military academy in the United States, located in West Point, New York.

en: Chief of Staff of the United States Army

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军军职最高的职位
description.en: The highest-ranking military office in the United States Army

en: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
zh-cn: 联合国军最高司令官总司令部

description.zh-cn: 二战后负责占领日本的盟军指挥机构，简称GHQ/SCAP。在麦克阿瑟将军领导下，该机构在《日本国宪法》的制定和修改过程中发挥了重要主导作用。
description.en: The Allied command structure responsible for the occupation of Japan after World War II, also known as GHQ/SCAP. Under General MacArthur, it played a significant and leading role in the drafting and revision of the Constitution of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 一战退伍老兵在华盛顿进行的请愿示威活动
description.en: A protest march by World War I veterans in Washington, D.C.

zh-cn: 杜鲁门总统解职道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟

description.zh-cn: 杜鲁门总统因政策分歧解除麦克阿瑟在远东所有职务的事件
description.en: The event where President Truman relieved MacArthur of all his commands in the Far East due to policy disagreements

description.zh-cn: 明朝第九位皇帝，于弘治九年为宋濂平反。
description.en: The ninth emperor of the Ming dynasty, who rehabilitated Song Lian in the ninth year of the Hongzhi era.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗时期的贤臣。
description.en: A capable minister during the reign of the Chenghua Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明朝大学士，明宪宗时期贤臣，与李贤一同力争钱、周二后并尊。
description.en: A Grand Secretary of the Ming dynasty and a capable minister during the reign of the Chenghua Emperor. He, along with Li Xian, argued for the co-equal status of Empresses Dowager Qian and Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗的宠妃，比宪宗年长17岁。
description.en: The favorite consort of the Chenghua Emperor, 17 years his senior.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗设立的特务机构。
description.en: A secret service agency established by the Chenghua Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝的独子，曾取代朱见深为太子，被立为太子后次年夭折。
description.en: The only son of the Jingtai Emperor, who briefly replaced Zhu Jianshen as crown prince and died prematurely the year after being made crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗时期的一名中官，善于以诙谐幽默的方式进谏。
description.en: A court official during the Chenghua era, skilled in offering remonstrance through humor.

description.zh-cn: 弹劾汪直的御史。
description.en: An imperial censor who impeached Wang Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 成化年间发生在荆襄地区的流民起义。
description.en: A refugee rebellion in the Jingxiang area during the Chenghua era.

description.zh-cn: 郧阳民变首领之一。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，受命平定郧阳民变。
description.en: A Ming dynasty general tasked with suppressing the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 明代女真三大部之一，后发展为后金及清朝。
description.en: One of the three major Jurchen groups during the Ming dynasty, which later evolved into the Later Jin and Qing dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗淑妃，明孝宗生母。
明宪宗第四子，明世宗的生父，被追尊为“睿宗献皇帝”。
description.en: Fourth son of Emperor Xianzong, biological father of Emperor Shizong, posthumously honored as 'Emperor Ruizong Xian'.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗贵妃，明睿宗朱祐杬生母。
同治帝的皇后。
奕䜣长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的继室，曹丕、曹彰、曹植、曹熊的生母。
description.en: The formal wife of Cao Cao and mother of Cao Pi, Cao Zhang, Cao Zhi, and Cao Xiong.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的长子，生母为刘夫人，由嫡母丁夫人抚养成人。二十岁时举为孝廉。后在曹操征伐张绣的宛城之战中，为救父亲而阵亡。他是曹丕与曹植的异母兄。
description.en: The eldest son of Cao Cao. His birth mother was Lady Liu, and he was raised by his adoptive mother, Lady Ding. At the age of twenty, he was nominated as Xiaolian. He was killed in the Battle of Wancheng while saving his father during the campaign against Zhang Xiu. He was the half-brother of Cao Pi and Cao Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 魏明帝，曹魏第二位皇帝，曹丕与文昭甄皇后之子，亦是曹昂的侄子。他在位期间（诸葛亮北伐期间）成功防御吴、蜀的多次攻伐，平定公孙渊叛乱，并改谥曹昂为丰愍王。
description.en: Emperor Ming of Wei, the second emperor of Cao Wei, was the son of Cao Pi and Empress Zhen, and the nephew of Cao Ang. During his reign, which coincided with Zhuge Liang's Northern Expeditions, he successfully defended against multiple invasions from Wu and Shu, suppressed Gongsun Yuan's rebellion, and posthumously honored Cao Ang as King Min of Feng.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏文帝曹丕的妻妾，魏明帝曹叡的生母，原为袁熙之妻。
曹魏时期创立的，并成为魏晋南北朝时期主要的官员选拔制度，后被隋文帝废除。
description.en: An official selection system established during the Cao Wei period, which became the primary system for selecting officials during the Wei, Jin, Northern and Southern dynasties, and was later abolished by Emperor Wen of Sui.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏宗室名将，官至大司马、大将军。他受曹丕遗诏辅佐曹叡，并在诸葛亮北伐前期担任曹魏方的总指挥。
description.en: A famous general of the Cao Wei imperial clan, he rose to Grand Marshal and General-in-Chief. Entrusted by Cao Pi's will to assist Cao Rui, he served as the overall commander of the Wei forces during the early stages of Zhuge Liang's Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏宗室名将，托孤大臣之一。
东汉末年至三国时期曹魏重要将领，曹操的堂弟。因其吝啬曾得罪曹丕，一度被下狱免官，后得卞太后求情赦免。官至骠骑将军，死后谥为恭侯。
description.en: An important general of Cao Wei during the late Eastern Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period, and a cousin of Cao Cao. Due to his stinginess, he offended Cao Pi and was once imprisoned and dismissed from office, but was later pardoned after Empress Dowager Bian interceded. He reached the rank of General of Chariots and Cavalry and was posthumously honored as Marquis Gong.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏官员，曹植派系的核心人物。
曹魏将领。
曹魏官员，因劝谏曹丕被处死。
曹丕所著的文学批评专论作品。
曹操与卞氏的次子。
description.en: The second son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian.

description.zh-cn: 曹操与卞氏的幼子。
description.en: The youngest son of Cao Cao and Lady Bian.

description.zh-cn: 曹昂的同母弟，早逝。
description.en: The full younger brother of Cao Ang, who died young.

description.zh-cn: 魏凤和的前任中国人民解放军第二炮兵部队参谋长。
魏凤和的继任中国人民解放军第二炮兵部队参谋长。
中国人民解放军上将，曾任中国人民解放军副总参谋长（魏凤和的继任者之一），后任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: General of the PLA, formerly Deputy Chief of the PLA General Staff (one of Wei Fenghe's successors), and later Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军指挥学院

description.zh-cn: 关羽长子，跟随父亲征战，在临沮与关羽一同被东吴军所杀。
description.en: Guan Yu's eldest son, who fought alongside his father. He was killed along with Guan Yu at Linju by the forces of Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 关羽次子。
袁绍麾下武将。
曹操从弟，曹魏重要将领。
东汉末年至三国时期曹魏将领，五子良将之一。以坚毅稳重著称，早年战功赫赫，但在樊城之战中因水灾被困而投降关羽，后归魏被曹丕羞辱而病逝。
description.en: A military general serving under the warlord Cao Cao during the late Eastern Han dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period of China. He was one of the Five Elite Generals of Cao Wei. Known for his steadfastness and composure, he had significant military achievements in his early career, but surrendered to Guan Yu during the Battle of Fancheng after being trapped by a flood. He later died of illness and shame after being humiliated by Cao Pi upon his return to Wei.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年孙吴势力的重要将领。他接替鲁肃的职务，并提出了袭取荆州的计划，且成功执行。在《三国演义》中，他设计袭取荆州，最终导致关羽败亡。
description.en: An important general serving under Sun Quan in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He succeeded Lu Su's position, proposed and successfully executed the plan to seize Jing Province. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', he is depicted as devising the plan to seize Jing Province, ultimately leading to Guan Yu's defeat and death.

en: Lü Meng's invasion of Jing Province

description.zh-cn: 东吴将领，潘璋司马。
中国东汉末年至三国时代的将领，曾先后效力于刘璋、刘备和曹魏。
description.en: A general during the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period of China, who served successively under Liu Zhang, Liu Bei, and Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 孙吴（东吴）名将、政治家。他曾巧妙利用谦卑言辞麻痹关羽，为吕蒙袭取荆州创造条件。后在夷陵之战中担任大都督，以火攻击败刘备大军。
description.en: A famous general and statesman of Sun Wu (Eastern Wu). He famously utilized humble words to lull Guan Yu into a false sense of security, creating the conditions for Lü Meng's surprise attack to seize Jing Province. Later, he served as the commander-in-chief in the Battle of Yiling, where he defeated Liu Bei's army using a fire attack.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉将领，后投降东吴。
蜀汉南郡太守，后投降东吴。
中国东汉末年至三国时代曹魏的著名将领。
description.en: A famous general of Cao Wei during the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period of China.

description.zh-cn: 庞德之子。
东汉末年孙吴势力的将领、战略家及外交家，为孙权策划了“榻上策”，并接替周瑜掌管军队，积极主张并维护孙刘联盟以共同对抗曹操。
description.en: A general, strategist, and diplomat serving under Sun Quan in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He devised the 'Tashang Ce' strategy for Sun Quan, succeeded Zhou Yu as a military commander, and was a key advocate for the Sun-Liu alliance against Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 秦宜禄前妻，后为曹操所纳。
吕布部将。
金正日的第四任妻子，在日朝鲜人。她归国后成为万寿台艺术团舞蹈演员，是金正哲、金正恩和金与正的母亲。
description.en: Considered the fourth wife of Kim Jong-il, she was a Zainichi Korean who returned to North Korea and became a dancer for the Mansudae Art Troupe. She is the mother of Kim Jong-chol, Kim Jong-un, and Kim Yo-jong.

description.zh-cn: 金正日的长子，金正哲的异母哥哥。他曾被视为继承人，后失势并于马来西亚遇刺身亡。
description.en: The eldest son of Kim Jong-il and the elder half-brother of Kim Jong-chul. He was once considered his successor, but later fell from favor and was assassinated in Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜女演员，被视为金正日的第二任妻子，金正男之母。
description.en: A North Korean actress, considered the second wife of Kim Jong-il and the mother of Kim Jong-nam.

en: National Defence Commission of North Korea
zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国国防委员会

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国曾经的国家主权的最高军事领导机关和国防管理机关。
description.en: The former highest military leadership and national defense management body of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，曾任第87-89任内阁总理大臣。他是安倍晋三在政坛的重要提携者，曾任命安倍为内阁官房长官，并支持其接任首相。此外，石破茂也在其内阁中首次入阁，担任防卫厅长官。
description.en: A Japanese politician who served as the 87th-89th Prime Minister of Japan. He was a key mentor to Shinzo Abe in politics, appointing him as Chief Cabinet Secretary and supporting him as his successor. Additionally, Shigeru Ishiba first entered his cabinet as Director General of the Defense Agency.

description.zh-cn: 1997年由金正日发动的为期4年的清洗运动。
description.en: A four-year purge campaign initiated by Kim Jong-il in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛分裂后，朝鲜最高领导人金正日与韩国总统金大中在平壤举行的首次会晤。
description.en: The first summit between North Korean supreme leader Kim Jong-il and South Korean president Kim Dae-jung in Pyongyang after the division of the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜于2006年10月进行的第一次核试验。
description.en: North Korea's first nuclear test conducted in October 2006.

description.zh-cn: 1983年全斗焕访问缅甸期间发生的针对其的炸弹袭击事件，韩方认为是朝鲜所为。
description.en: A bombing attack targeting Chun Doo-hwan during his visit to Burma in 1983, which the South Korean side attributed to North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 一起由朝鲜特工制造的针对大韩航空858号班机的炸弹恐怖袭击事件。
description.en: A bombing terrorist attack on Korean Air Flight 858, carried out by North Korean agents.

description.zh-cn: 韩国著名女演员，曾被朝鲜特工绑架至朝鲜。
description.en: A famous South Korean actress who was abducted to North Korea by its agents.

location.zh-cn: 苏联哈巴罗夫斯克边疆区

description.zh-cn: 位于俄罗斯哈巴罗夫斯克边疆区的村庄，根据苏联记录，是金正日的出生地。
description.en: A village in Khabarovsk Krai, Russia, which according to Soviet records is the birthplace of Kim Jong-il.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇的皇后，德仁天皇的祖母。
description.en: The empress consort of Emperor Shōwa, grandmother of Emperor Naruhito.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇的次子。
description.en: Second son of Emperor Shōwa.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，曾任学习院院长，对裕仁进行教育。
description.en: An Imperial Japanese Army general who served as the director of the Gakushūin Peer's School and educated Hirohito.

description.zh-cn: 日本海军元帅，曾任东宫御学问所总裁，对裕仁进行教育。
description.en: A fleet admiral in the Imperial Japanese Navy who served as the president of the Tōgū Gogakumonsho and educated Hirohito.

description.zh-cn: 日本社会主义者，在虎之门事件中试图行刺摄政的裕仁。
description.en: A Japanese socialist who attempted to assassinate Prince Regent Hirohito in the Toranomon Incident.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜独立运动家，在樱田门事件中试图行刺裕仁。
description.en: A Korean independence activist who attempted to assassinate Emperor Hirohito in the Sakuradamon Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇族，陆军大将，南京大屠杀时的上海派遣军司令。
description.en: A member of the Japanese imperial family and an Imperial Japanese Army general, commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army during the Nanjing Massacre.

description.zh-cn: 英国国王，裕仁1921年访欧时曾与其会面。
description.en: King of the United Kingdom, met with Hirohito during his European tour in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 靖国神社宫司，在其任内决定合祀甲级战犯。
description.en: The head priest of Yasukuni Shrine who decided to enshrine Class-A war criminals.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国在1871年至1945年期间的主要陆上武装力量，关东军是其下属部队之一。
description.en: The main ground force of the Empire of Japan from 1871 to 1945, with the Kwantung Army being one of its subordinate units.

description.zh-cn: 日本帝国海军，是大日本帝国的海军武装力量。在甲午战争中击败北洋水师，并策划执行了偷袭珍珠港的行动。
description.en: The Imperial Japanese Navy was the naval armed force of the Empire of Japan. It defeated the Beiyang Fleet in the First Sino-Japanese War and later planned and executed the attack on Pearl Harbor.

zh-cn: 关东军防疫给水部本部

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军关东军防疫给水部本部的通称号，由石井四郎领导。该部队在抗日战争和第二次世界大战期间，从事生物战、细菌战和人体试验，对包括中国人、苏联人、朝鲜人及同盟国战俘在内的活人进行惨无人道的实验，犯下严重的战争罪和危害人类罪。
description.en: The codename for the headquarters of the Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department of the Kwantung Army of the Imperial Japanese Army, led by Shirō Ishii. During the Second Sino-Japanese War and World War II, this unit engaged in biological warfare, bacteriological warfare, and human experimentation, conducting inhumane experiments on living subjects including Chinese, Soviets, Koreans, and Allied prisoners of war, committing severe war crimes and crimes against humanity.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军中的政治派系，发动了二二六兵变但失败。
description.en: A political faction in the Imperial Japanese Army which launched the failed February 26 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国陆军中的政治派系，在二二六兵变后掌握实权。
description.en: A political faction in the Imperial Japanese Army which gained control after the February 26 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本的贵族学校，裕仁曾在此就读。
description.en: A Japanese educational institution for the nobility, where Hirohito studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本东京的神社，供奉自明治维新以来为日本战死的军人及军属。
description.en: A Shinto shrine in Tokyo, Japan, dedicated to those who died in service of Japan from the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 由部分日本陆军省军官发动的未遂政变，企图阻止天皇宣布投降，但最终失败。
description.en: An attempted coup d'état by officers of the Japanese Ministry of War to prevent the Emperor from announcing the surrender, which ultimately failed.

en: Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇于1945年8月15日向日本国民广播的停战诏书，由其亲自宣读，宣布日本接受《波茨坦宣言》并结束战争。此次广播被称为“玉音放送”。
description.en: The rescript read by Emperor Hirohito on August 15, 1945, announcing Japan's surrender, its acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration, and the end of the war. The radio broadcast of this rescript is known as the Gyokuon-hōsō.

description.zh-cn: 昭和天皇于1946年1月1日发表的诏书，否定了天皇作为“现人神”的地位。
description.en: An imperial rescript issued by Emperor Shōwa on January 1, 1946, in which he formally renounced his divine status.

description.zh-cn: 清朝内阁大学士之一，为正一品。
清朝辅佐皇帝处理军国大政的最高核心官员职位。
description.en: The highest-ranking core official position in the Qing dynasty, assisting the emperor in handling major military and state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 清朝掌管皇帝禁卫的最高级武官。
和珅之父。
和珅的外祖父。
和珅之弟。
和珅之妻。
清朝乾隆及嘉庆时期人物，满洲正红旗人，权臣和珅的长子。其妻为乾隆帝幼女固伦和孝公主。他的一生经历了父亲倒台后的荣辱沉浮。
description.en: A figure during the Qianlong and Jiaqing eras of the Qing dynasty, a member of the Manchu Plain Red Banner, and the eldest son of the powerful official Heshen. His wife was Princess Gurun Hexiao, the youngest daughter of the Qianlong Emperor. His life was marked by fluctuations in fortune after his father's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 清朝公主，乾隆帝的第十女，丰绅殷德之妻。
description.en: A Qing dynasty princess, the tenth daughter of the Qianlong Emperor, and the wife of Fengshen Yinde.

description.zh-cn: 清朝负责保卫皇帝和皇宫的官职。
清朝御史，曾多次挑战和珅。
清朝大臣，曾多次挑战和珅。
位于北京的王府，原为和珅的府邸。
庆郡王，和珅府邸后被转赐给他。
清朝六部中户部的最高长官。
清朝吏部最高长官，掌管全国文职官吏的任免、考核、升降、调动等。
description.en: The highest official of the Ministry of Personnel in the Qing Dynasty, responsible for the appointment, assessment, promotion, demotion, and transfer of civil officials nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，冯氏（和珅嫡妻）的祖父。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official and the grandfather of Lady Feng (Heshen's primary wife).

nodes.id: BAIDU:“不忘初心、牢记使命”主题教育

zh-cn: “不忘初心、牢记使命”主题教育

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党开展的主题教育活动。
胡志明的父亲，曾考中举人、副榜，担任过阮朝官员。
胡志明的姐姐。
据研究指，其为胡志明在广州结婚的妻子，但越南政府不承认。
据研究指，其为胡志明在1950年代的情妇。
据研究指，其为胡志明的情妇之一。

en: French Section of the Workers' International

description.zh-cn: 即法国社会党，胡志明于1918年加入。
胡志明是该党的创始人之一。
胡志明于1925年在广州创立的越南革命组织，黎笋于1928年加入。
description.en: A Vietnamese revolutionary organization founded by Ho Chi Minh in Guangzhou in 1925, which Lê Duẩn joined in 1928.

en: Declaration of independence of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam

description.zh-cn: 由胡志明于1945年9月2日在河内巴亭广场宣读的文件，宣告越南民主共和国的成立。
description.en: A document read by Hồ Chí Minh on September 2, 1945, at Ba Đình Square, Hanoi, proclaiming the establishment of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政治家，曾长期担任苏联部长会议主席。他与勃列日涅夫等人共同发动政变推翻了赫鲁晓夫，并出席了胡志明的葬礼。
description.en: A Soviet statesman who served for a long time as the Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the Soviet Union. He, along with Brezhnev and others, staged a coup to overthrow Khrushchev, and also attended Ho Chi Minh's funeral.

description.zh-cn: 胡志明倡导的革命理论与思想体系。
胡志明的出生地所在省份。
越南首都，胡志明的逝世地。
曹操之父，曹腾养子
东汉宦官，曹操的养祖父
东汉末年军阀。曾一度投降曹操，后因曹操纳其婶母而发动叛乱，在宛城之战中击败曹操。
description.en: A warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He initially surrendered to Cao Cao but later rebelled after Cao Cao took his aunt as a concubine, defeating Cao Cao's forces at the Battle of Wancheng.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的政治家、战略家，曹操的主要谋臣之一。
指东汉末年，由袁绍、曹操等关东地区的州牧和太守组成的联军，共同讨伐控制朝廷的权臣董卓的战争。
description.en: Refers to the punitive expedition in the late Eastern Han dynasty, launched by a coalition of regional governors and administrators (such as Yuan Shao and Cao Cao) from east of Hangu Pass, against the powerful official Dong Zhuo who controlled the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年“三大战役”之一，是曹操与袁绍之间的一场战略决战。
description.en: One of the 'Three Great Battles' of the late Eastern Han, a decisive strategic battle between Cao Cao and Yuan Shao.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职，三公之一。
description.en: An ancient Chinese official title, one of the Three Ducal Ministers.

description.zh-cn: 曹操麾下精锐部队
曹魏将领，曹操的从兄弟
三国时期蜀汉的将领，赵云的长子。他继承了父亲的爵位，官至虎贲中郎督。
description.en: A military general of the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, and the eldest son of Zhao Yun. He inherited his father's title and served as a Commandant of the Tiger Guards (Huben Zhonglang Du).

description.zh-cn: 三国时期蜀汉的将领，征南将军赵云的次子。他担任牙门将，在跟随姜维北伐期间于沓中战死。
description.en: A military general of the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, and the second son of General Who Conquers the South, Zhao Yun. He served as a Gate General (Yamen Jiang) and was killed in action at Tazhong while following Jiang Wei on the northern expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 曹操麾下将领，赵云同乡。
汉末桂阳太守。
中国东汉末年至三国时代蜀汉的著名将领，时任征西将军。
description.en: A famous general of Shu Han during the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period of China. He held the title of General Who Conquers the West at the time.

description.zh-cn: 中国东汉末年，刘备势力的蜀汉将领，赵云的部下。
description.en: A general serving under the warlord Liu Bei during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China, and a subordinate of Zhao Yun.

description.zh-cn: 曹操追击刘备的战役，张飞据水断桥。
刘表次子，在刘表去世后继承职位，并向南下的曹操投降。
description.en: The younger son of Liu Biao, who succeeded his father and later surrendered to Cao Cao during his southern campaign.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲的妻子，现任台北市立联合医院和平妇幼院区中正门诊部主任。
description.en: Wife of Ko Wen-je, currently the director of the Zhongzheng Clinic at the Heping Fuyou Branch of Taipei City Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 柯美兰与柯文哲的父亲，曾为新竹市东园国小教师。
description.en: The father of Ko Mei-lan and Ko Wen-je, and a former teacher at Dongyuan Elementary School in Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲的母亲，退休公务员。
description.en: Mother of Ko Wen-je, a retired civil servant.

description.zh-cn: 台湾眼科医师、政治人物，台湾民众党籍。现任台大医院新竹医院医师、国立清华大学合聘教授。她是柯文哲的胞妹。
description.en: A Taiwanese ophthalmologist and politician, member of the Taiwan People's Party. She is currently a physician at National Taiwan University Hospital Hsinchu Branch and an adjunct professor at National Tsing Hua University. She is the younger sister of Ko Wen-je.

en: National Taiwan University College of Medicine
College of Medicine, National Taiwan University

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学的医学院，是台大医院的管理机构。它也是柯文哲的母校及曾任教之处。
description.en: The medical school of National Taiwan University, which serves as the administrative body for the National Taiwan University Hospital. It is also Ko Wen-je's alma mater and former workplace.

en: National Taiwan University Hospital Bei-Hu Branch
National Taiwan University Hospital Hsin-Chu Branch
National Taiwan University Hospital Jinshan Branch
National Taiwan University Hospital, Cancer Center Branch
zh-cn: 国立台湾大学医学院附设医院
台北帝国大学医学部附属医院
国立台湾大学医学院第一附属医院
国立台湾大学医学院附属医院
国立台湾大学医学院附设医院北护分院
国立台湾大学医学院附设医院新竹分院
国立台湾大学医学院附设医院新竹台大分院
国立台湾大学医学院附设医院癌医中心分院
国立台湾大学医学院附设医院金山分院
国立台湾大学医学院附设癌医中心医院
新竹州新竹市新竹医院
行政院卫生署新竹医院

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学的附属医院，是台湾第一所提供西式医疗服务的教学医院，被视为最具指标意义的医院。其在大安区设有癌症专科分院（前身为国军八一七医院，2018年成立），在新北市金山区及新竹县市均设有分院。其中新竹院区（由原新竹医院、竹东医院及生医分院整并而成），其前身之一的原新竹医院创建于1896年7月，曾是署立医院，于2011年7月1日改隶台大医院。林荣三在此逝世。
description.en: The affiliated hospital of National Taiwan University, it is the first teaching hospital in Taiwan to provide Western medical services and is considered the most iconic hospital in Taiwan. It has a specialized cancer branch in Da'an District (formerly the ROC Armed Forces 817 Hospital, established in 2018), and other branches in Jinshan District, New Taipei City, and Hsinchu County and City. The Hsinchu branch (formed by the consolidation of the original Hsinchu Hospital, Zhudong Hospital, and Biomedical Branch) has roots in the original Hsinchu Hospital, founded in July 1896 as a former Department of Health hospital, which became affiliated with NTU Hospital on July 1, 2011. Lin Rong-san passed away here.

zh-cn: 2014年中华民国直辖市长及县市长选举

en: Results of the 2018 Taiwanese magistrate/mayor elections
zh-cn: 2018年中华民国直辖市长及县市长选举
中华民国第十六任总统副总统选举

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第十六任总统、副总统选举。此次选举前，蓝白两党曾就候选人整合进行多轮协商，但最终破局。柯文哲作为台湾民众党候选人参选。民主进步党候选人赖清德在此次选举中胜选，并由萧美琴与其搭档成功当选副总统。
description.en: The 16th presidential and vice-presidential election of the Republic of China. Prior to this election, the Blue and White parties held multiple rounds of negotiations on candidate integration, but ultimately failed. Ko Wen-je ran as the Taiwan People's Party candidate. Democratic Progressive Party candidate Lai Ching-te won the election, with Hsiao Bi-khim as his running mate successfully elected Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，现任台北市市长，是柯文哲的继任者。他曾任律师和立法委员，并毕业于宾夕法尼亚大学。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, currently serving as the Mayor of Taipei, succeeding Ko Wen-je. He is also a lawyer and former legislator, and an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲被指2024总统大选政治献金申报不实而遭调查起诉的案件。

zh-cn: 台大医院失误移植爱滋病患器官案

description.zh-cn: 2011年台湾发生的医疗事故，台大医院将一名HIV感染者的器官移植给五名病患。柯文哲因此事件受到惩处，并称此事件是其决定参选的主因。
description.en: A medical incident in Taiwan in 2011, where National Taiwan University Hospital transplanted organs from an HIV-positive donor to five patients. Ko Wen-je was disciplined for this incident and stated it was the main reason for his decision to run for office.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，中国国民党副主席，前中华民国副总统连战之子。他曾在枪击案后由柯文哲的医疗团队救治，后在2014年台北市长选举中与柯文哲成为竞争对手。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang, and son of former Republic of China Vice President Lien Chan. He was treated by Ko Wen-je's medical team after a shooting incident and later became Ko's opponent in the 2014 Taipei mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 胡志强的妻子，曾因车祸重伤，在柯文哲建议下使用叶克膜成功获救。
description.en: Wife of Jason Hu, who was successfully treated with ECMO at Ko Wen-je's suggestion after suffering severe injuries in a car accident.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，前台中市市长。
美国作家，在其著作《屠杀》中指控柯文哲涉及器官活摘事件并称其为骗子。
description.en: An American author who, in his book 'The Slaughter,' accused Ko Wen-je of being involved in organ harvesting and called him a liar.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲提出的两岸关系论述。
柯文哲提出的两岸关系论述。
中华民国台湾省的市，位于台湾西北部，为新竹都会区的中心城市。因九降风强盛而被称为“风城”，是全球高科技代工产业的重镇。
description.en: A city in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, located in the northwestern part of Taiwan. It is the central city of the Hsinchu metropolitan area. Known as the "Windy City" due to strong seasonal winds, it is a major hub for the global high-tech contract manufacturing industry.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，台湾民众党籍，在2024年总统选举中担任柯文哲的副总统候选人。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician from the Taiwan People's Party who was Ko Wen-je's vice-presidential running mate in the 2024 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍，现任新北市市长，曾代表该党参选2024年中华民国总统选举。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, a member of the Kuomintang (KMT), current Mayor of New Taipei City, who previously represented the party in the 2024 Republic of China presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 台湾企业家，鸿海科技集团创办人。他通过永龄健康基金会捐赠兴建台大癌医中心医院；曾寻求代表国民党或独立参选2024年总统，并参与了君悦会谈的在野整合协商。
description.en: A Taiwanese entrepreneur and founder of Foxconn Technology Group. He donated to build the NTU Cancer Center Hospital through the YongLin Healthcare Foundation; he also sought to run for president in 2024, either representing the KMT or as an independent, and participated in the opposition integration negotiations at the Grand Hyatt meeting.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍。现任台北市议会议员、流浪动物之家基金会董事长，曾任国中教师及篮球运动员。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China and a member of the Kuomintang. He is currently a member of the Taipei City Council and chairman of the Stray Animals Home Foundation. He was formerly a junior high school teacher and a basketball player.

description.zh-cn: 项羽的妻子。
项羽的主要谋士，被项羽尊为“亚父”。
description.en: A key advisor to Xiang Yu, who honored him as 'Second Father'.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末年将领，受命于秦二世，率军镇压陈胜、吴广的起义。后投降项羽，被封为雍王。
description.en: A general at the end of the Qin Dynasty, who was ordered by Qin Er Shi to lead an army to suppress the uprising of Chen Sheng and Wu Guang. He later surrendered to Xiang Yu and was enfeoffed as King Yong.

description.zh-cn: 项羽率领数万楚军，大破秦军四十万主力的战役。
项羽在鸿门宴请刘邦。这次宴会的意图是刺杀刘邦，期间发生了一系列事件。
项羽的堂弟。
项羽的叔父，在鸿门宴上保护了刘邦。
项羽自刎之地。
楚后怀王任命的上将军，后被项羽所杀。
汉高祖刘邦的父亲。他是中国历史上唯一未曾为帝王却获尊为太上皇的人。
description.en: Father of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang. He is the only person in Chinese history to be honored as Taishang Huang (Emperor Emeritus) without ever having been an emperor himself.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦的庶长子，被封为齐王，谥号悼惠，故称齐悼惠王。他是刘盈和鲁元公主的异母兄。
description.en: The eldest illegitimate son of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang. He was enfeoffed as the King of Qi and given the posthumous title 'Dao Hui', thus known as King Dao Hui of Qi. He was the half-brother of Liu Ying and Princess Yuan of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦的宠妃，赵王刘如意之母。刘邦死后，遭吕后残害，被制成“人彘”。
description.en: A favored consort of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang, and the mother of Liu Ruyi, the Prince of Zhao. After Liu Bang's death, she was brutally mutilated by Empress Lü Zhi and turned into a 'human swine'.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖刘邦第三子，其母为戚夫人。他被封为赵王，是鲁元公主和刘盈的异母弟。因刘邦宠爱，曾差点取代太子位，后被吕后毒杀。
description.en: The third son of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and Concubine Qi. He was enfeoffed as the King of Zhao and was the half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu and Liu Ying. Due to Liu Bang's favor, he nearly replaced the crown prince, but was later poisoned to death by Empress Lü Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦的妃嫔，汉文帝刘恒之母。
汉朝公主，汉高祖刘邦与皇后吕雉的长女，刘盈的同母姐姐。
description.en: A princess of the Han Dynasty, the eldest daughter of Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang and Empress Lü Zhi, and the full sister of Liu Ying.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦的同乡，早期曾背叛刘邦投靠魏国。
西汉开国功臣，刘邦的连襟，娶吕后之妹吕媭为妻。他曾主张发兵攻打匈奴。晚年因被人诬陷，刘邦曾命陈平将其处死，但陈平将其生擒带回，使其幸免于难。
description.en: A founding general of the Western Han dynasty, Liu Bang's brother-in-law, and husband to Lü Xu, the younger sister of Empress Lü. He advocated for sending troops to attack the Xiongnu. In his later years, falsely accused, Liu Bang ordered Chen Ping to execute him; however, Chen Ping captured him alive and brought him back, thus saving his life.

description.zh-cn: 中国封建社会的最高统治者称号。
description.en: The supreme ruler of Imperial China.

en: Uprisings at the end of the Qin dynasty

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末年各地反抗秦朝统治的起义。
中国古代统治者与周边民族或国家之间实行的一种政治联姻政策，尤其在汉朝时期与匈奴等周边民族之间尤为盛行。
description.en: A historical policy of political marriage alliance practiced between ancient Chinese rulers and neighboring peoples or states, particularly prevalent during the Han Dynasty with the Xiongnu and other surrounding ethnic groups.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦斩白蛇后，部下认为其有天命的事件。
刘邦与群臣杀白马立下的誓约，规定非刘氏不得为王。
公元前200年，汉高祖刘邦被匈奴围困于平城白登山的事件。刘邦后采用陈平的计策得以解围。
description.en: An event in 200 BC where Emperor Gaozu of Han (Liu Bang) was besieged by the Xiongnu at Baideng, near Pingcheng. Liu Bang later escaped by using a strategy devised by Chen Ping.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦进入关中后与当地父老约定的三条法律。
约瑟夫·斯大林的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Joseph Stalin.

zh-cn: 娜杰日达·谢尔盖耶芙娜·阿利卢耶娃

description.zh-cn: 苏联最高领导人约瑟夫·斯大林的第二任妻子。
description.en: The second wife of Soviet leader Joseph Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 约瑟夫·斯大林的长子。
description.en: Eldest son of Joseph Stalin.

zh-cn: 斯韦特兰娜·阿利卢耶娃

description.zh-cn: 斯大林与娜杰日达·阿利卢耶娃的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Joseph Stalin and Nadezhda Alliluyeva.

description.zh-cn: 老布尔什维克，曾与斯大林结盟，后被清洗。
description.en: Old Bolshevik, once allied with Stalin, later purged.

description.zh-cn: 布尔什维克革命家，共产国际的创始人之一，曾任共产国际执行委员会主席。作为共产国际领导人，他在中共六大上对向忠发表示赞同。作为一名老布尔什维克，他曾与斯大林结盟，后被清洗。
description.en: Bolshevik revolutionary, one of the founders of the Communist International, and a former Chairman of its Executive Committee. As a Comintern leader, he expressed approval of Xiang Zhongfa at the 6th National Congress of the CCP. As an Old Bolshevik, he was once allied with Stalin but was later purged.

description.zh-cn: 苏联秘密警察头子，被怀疑谋杀了斯大林。
description.en: Head of the Soviet secret police, suspected of murdering Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 苏联推行的一项将个体农户合并为集体农庄的政策。
description.en: A policy pursued in the Soviet Union to consolidate individual landholdings and labour into collective farms.

description.zh-cn: 列宁在晚年口授的一系列文件，其中批评了斯大林的个性和能力，并建议将其从总书记职位上调离。赫鲁晓夫在秘密报告中引用了此文件。
description.en: A series of documents dictated by Lenin in his later years, which criticized Stalin's personality and abilities and recommended his removal from the post of General Secretary. Khrushchev cited this document in his Secret Speech.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大及其秘密报告后，在苏联及东欧集团国家发起的一系列政治改革。这些改革旨在否定斯大林的个人崇拜、政治和意识形态影响，并最终清除斯大林主义。
description.en: A series of political reforms initiated by Khrushchev in the Soviet Union and Eastern Bloc countries after the 20th Congress of the CPSU and his Secret Speech. These reforms aimed to repudiate Stalin's personality cult, political and ideological influence, and ultimately eradicate Stalinism.

en: Council of Ministers of the Soviet Union

description.zh-cn: 十月革命后成立的苏维埃俄国和苏联的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest executive authority of Soviet Russia and the Soviet Union after the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 苏联在苏德战争期间的最高权力机关。
description.en: The supreme authority in the Soviet Union during the German-Soviet War.

description.zh-cn: 刘基次子。
明朝初期官员。
description.en: An official in the early Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝初年官员，曾任右丞相，在胡惟庸案前夕被朱元璋赐死。
description.en: An official in the early Ming dynasty who served as Right Chancellor and was ordered to commit suicide by the Hongwu Emperor on the eve of the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 南宋抗金将领，刘基的先人。
元末明初的政治家、文学家、史学家、大儒，被朱元璋誉为“开国文臣之首”，是方孝孺的老师。他因孙子宋慎牵连进胡惟庸案受株连，虽曾因马皇后求情获赦，最终仍被贬死于四川夔州。
description.en: A politician, writer, historian, and prominent Confucian scholar of the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties, hailed by Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang as the 'head of the founding civil officials', and the teacher of Fang Xiaoru. He was implicated in the Hu Weiyong case due to his grandson Song Shen. Although initially pardoned through Empress Ma's intercession, he was eventually exiled and died in Kuizhou, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代的大名，丰臣秀吉的主君，战国三杰之一。
织田信长的家臣，发动本能寺之变。
明智光秀于京都本能寺突袭并逼迫织田信长自杀的事件。
丰臣秀吉为织田信长复仇而与明智光秀进行的决战。
织田家的重臣，在信长死后与丰臣秀吉争夺主导权。
丰臣秀吉击败柴田胜家的关键战役。
织田信长三子，与柴田胜家结盟对抗丰臣秀吉。
日本古代职官，等同于摄政，是公家的最高职位。
日本古代太政官的最高官职。
日本公卿，丰臣秀吉的犹父。
丰臣秀吉的外甥与养子，曾任关白，后被秀吉赐死。
丰臣秀吉的嫡子。
丰臣秀吉的侧室，丰臣秀赖的生母。
丰臣秀吉的正室。
日本战国时代著名的茶道宗师，后被丰臣秀吉赐死。
丰臣秀吉为加强兵农分离而推行的政策。
丰臣秀吉为确立税制而推行的全国性土地丈量与调查。
丰臣秀吉的生父。
丰臣秀吉的生母。
中华民国政治人物。

zh-cn: 台北帝国大学附属农林专门部
台湾总督府农林专门学校
台湾总督府台中农林专门学校
台湾总督府台中高等农林学校
台湾总督府台北高等农林学校
台湾总督府高等农林学校
台湾省立台中农业专科学校

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台中市南区的国立研究型综合大学，起源于1919年日治时期创办的台湾总督府农林专门学校。该校以农业科学、兽医学及生命科学等领域见长。
description.en: A national research university located in the South District of Taichung, Taiwan. It originated from the Agricultural and Forestry Vocational School of the Governor-General of Taiwan, founded in 1919 during the Japanese rule period. The university is renowned for its strengths in agricultural science, veterinary medicine, and life sciences.

location.zh-cn: 中华民国台北市士林区阳明山
location.en: Yangmingshan, Shilin District, Taipei City, Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台北市士林区阳明山的一所私立综合大学，由张其昀于1962年创办。其校舍以中国宫殿式建筑风格为特色。
description.en: A private comprehensive university located on Yangmingshan in Shilin District, Taipei, Taiwan, founded in 1962 by Chang Chi-yun. Its campus is known for its traditional Chinese palace-style architecture.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党内的一个派系。
王世坚的外祖父，台湾文化协会重要成员。

death_place.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学附设医院

description.zh-cn: 台湾人权律师与政治人物，民主进步党创党元老及首任党主席，曾任中华民国立法委员、监察委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese human rights lawyer and politician, a founding member and the first chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party, who served as a member of the Legislative Yuan and Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，包含国民党主席连战、亲民党主席宋楚瑜、新党主席郁慕明在内的泛蓝领袖陆续访问中国大陆，此后泛蓝大幅降低反共色彩。
description.en: In 2005, Pan-Blue leaders including KMT Chairman Lien Chan, PFP Chairman James Soong, and New Party Chairman Yok Mu-ming visited mainland China in succession. Afterward, the Pan-Blue Coalition significantly reduced its anti-communist rhetoric.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as a legislator.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国作家、历史学家、政治评论人、政治人物。
明穆宗之父，明朝第十一位皇帝，年号嘉靖。他下令重录《永乐大典》以制作副本，并于嘉靖十七年（1538年）再次为马皇后追上尊谥。在其统治期间，发生了著名的嘉靖大地震。此外，他还改称子路为“先贤仲子”。在位前期锐意改革，史称“嘉靖中兴”，但后期崇信道教、荒怠朝政，导致严嵩专权、吏治腐败。
description.en: Father of Muzong, the 11th emperor of the Ming dynasty, known as the Jiajing Emperor. He ordered the creation of a duplicate manuscript copy of the Yongle Encyclopedia and, in the 17th year of the Jiajing era (1538), further extended Empress Ma's posthumous title. The devastating Jiajing Great Earthquake occurred during his reign. He also changed Zi Lu's title to 'Former Worthy, Master Zhong'. In his early reign, he was dedicated to reforms, a period known as the 'Jiajing Restoration'. However, in his later years, he became obsessed with Taoism, neglected state affairs, leading to the dominance of Yan Song and widespread corruption.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗皇贵妃，明穆宗生母
description.en: Imperial consort of the Jiajing Emperor and biological mother of the Longqing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗之兄。
明穆宗之弟。

zh-cn: 孝懿贞惠顺哲恭仁俪天襄圣庄皇后

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗元配妻子，裕王妃。
明穆宗继后。
明穆宗长子。
明穆宗第四子。
明朝内阁首辅，在明世宗驾崩后主持大局
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty, managed state affairs after the Jiajing Emperor's death.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅。
明穆宗顾命大臣。
明穆宗统治时期出现的承平时期。
明朝隆庆年间，明穆宗宣布调整海禁政策，允许民间私人远贩东西二洋。
description.en: During the Longqing reign of the Ming Dynasty, Emperor Muzong announced an adjustment to the Haijin policy, allowing private trade with the East and West Oceans.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖朝面临的北方蒙古与东南倭寇的双重边患问题
description.en: The dual border threats faced during the Jiajing reign from the northern Mongols and the southeastern Wokou pirates.

description.zh-cn: 明朝与蒙古俺答汗达成和平协议，允许其纳贡互市的事件。
弗拉基米尔·列宁的父亲。
description.en: Father of Vladimir Lenin.

zh-cn: 玛丽亚·亚历山德罗芙娜·乌里扬诺娃

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·列宁的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Vladimir Lenin.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·列宁的哥哥，因参与刺杀沙皇亚历山大三世的计划而被处决。
description.en: Vladimir Lenin's older brother, executed for his part in a plot to assassinate Tsar Alexander III.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国沙皇。
description.en: Tsar of the Russian Empire.

zh-cn: 娜杰日达·克鲁普斯卡娅

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯布尔什维克革命家，弗拉基米尔·列宁的妻子。
description.en: Russian Bolshevik revolutionary and wife of Vladimir Lenin.

description.zh-cn: 社会革命党成员，因试图刺杀列宁而被处决。
description.en: Member of the Socialist Revolutionary Party, executed for attempting to assassinate Lenin.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯的革命社会主义政党，后分裂为布尔什维克和孟什维克。
description.en: A revolutionary socialist political party in Russia that later split into Bolshevik and Menshevik factions.

description.zh-cn: 推翻沙皇尼古拉二世统治并导致俄国临时政府成立的革命。
description.en: The revolution that overthrew Tsar Nicholas II and resulted in the formation of the Russian Provisional Government.

清代晚期官员、军事家，晚清中兴名臣之一，湘军重要首领。其治兵言论被蔡锷辑录成书。
description.en: An official and military strategist of the late Qing dynasty, one of the famous officials of the late Qing Restoration, and an important leader of the Xiang Army. His military management sayings were compiled into a book by Cai E.

description.zh-cn: 清代经世派主要代表人物，曾任两江总督。
中亚浩罕汗国军事领袖，19世纪入侵并盘踞新疆。
同治陕甘回变的主要首领之一。
清末红顶商人。
左宗棠之父。
陶澍之子，左宗棠女婿。
左宗棠长女。
清朝的九位最高级的封疆大吏之一，总管陕西和甘肃的军民政务。
19世纪80年代，大清帝国与法兰西第三共和国因争夺越南宗主权而爆发的战争。清军的败退成为甲申易枢的导火索，慈禧太后借此罢免了奕䜣。
description.en: A war in the 1880s between the Qing Empire and the Third French Republic over suzerainty in Vietnam. The defeat of the Qing army became the trigger for the Jiashen Purge, which Empress Dowager Cixi used to dismiss Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 清廷内部关于国家防务战略的争论，以李鸿章为首的海防派主张优先发展海军，以左宗棠为首的塞防派主张收复新疆。
清朝钦差大臣崇厚与俄国于1879年签订的有关归还伊犁地区的条约，因损害中国主权过多而未被清政府批准。
晚清大臣，曾出使俄国谈判伊犁问题并签订《里瓦几亚条约》，此条约引发了争议。
description.en: A minister of the late Qing Dynasty who negotiated the Ili problem and signed the Treaty of Livadia, which caused controversy.

description.zh-cn: 曾国藩长子，清末著名外交家，曾纪鸿之兄，与俄国重新谈判并签订《伊犁条约》。
description.en: A diplomat of the Qing dynasty, the eldest son of Zeng Guofan, and the elder brother of Zeng Jihong.

description.zh-cn: 清朝钦差大臣崇厚与俄罗斯帝国于1881年签订的关于交还伊犁地区的条约，因损害中国权益而未被批准。
description.en: A treaty signed between Qing envoy Chonghou and the Russian Empire in 1881 regarding the return of the Ili region, but it was not ratified due to its infringement on Chinese interests.

description.zh-cn: 1884年正式建立的清朝省份。
晚清时期湘军将领，新疆建省后首任巡抚。他曾参与平定太平天国和陕甘回变，并作为主要军事指挥官之一随左宗棠收复新疆。
description.en: A general of the Xiang Army during the late Qing Dynasty and the first governor of Xinjiang after its establishment as a province. He participated in suppressing the Taiping Rebellion and the Dungan Revolt, and, as one of the main military commanders, recovered Xinjiang with Zuo Zongtang.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋次子，受封秦愍王，是明朝第一任宗人府宗人令。正史记载其为马皇后所生，但亦有异说。
description.en: The second son of Emperor Hongwu of the Ming Dynasty, he was created Prince Min of Qin and served as the first Zongren Ling of the Zongrenfu in the Ming Dynasty. Official histories record him as the son of Empress Ma, though conflicting accounts exist.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋三子，封晋恭王，曾任明朝宗人府左宗正。正史记载为马皇后所生，但亦有异说。
description.en: The third son of Emperor Hongwu of the Ming Dynasty, created Prince Gong of Jin, and once served as Left Zongzheng of the Zongrenfu. Official histories record him as the son of Empress Ma, though conflicting accounts exist.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋与马皇后所生长女。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Zhu Yuanzhang and Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋与马皇后所生的第四女。
description.en: The fourth daughter of the Hongwu Emperor and Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 明朝追尊皇帝，明太祖朱元璋的祖父。
description.en: A posthumously honored emperor of the Ming Dynasty, grandfather of Zhu Yuanzhang, the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一的次子。
description.en: The second son of Zhu Chuyi.

description.zh-cn: 明朝追尊皇帝，朱初一之父，朱元璋的曾祖父。
description.en: A posthumously honored emperor of the Ming Dynasty, father of Zhu Chuyi and great-grandfather of Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 朱四九的配偶，朱初一之母。
description.en: Spouse of Zhu Sijiu and mother of Zhu Chuyi.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国女画家，满洲正红旗人，著名作家老舍的妻子。
description.en: A female painter of the People's Republic of China, of Manchu Plain Red Banner origin, and the wife of the renowned writer Lao She.

description.zh-cn: 作家，曾与老舍同居。
老舍与胡絜青的儿子，原中国现代文学馆馆长。
description.en: The son of Lao She and Hu Jieqing, former curator of the Museum of Modern Chinese Literature.

description.zh-cn: 老舍的长女，北京老舍纪念馆馆长。
老舍的次女，北京第二外国语学院教授。
老舍的三女。
老舍的父亲，护军营军人，于八国联军侵华时战死。
存在于1864年至1952年的教会大学，位于山东济南。
description.en: A Christian university that existed from 1864 to 1952, located in Jinan, Shandong.

zh-cn: 中华全国文艺界抗敌协会
en: All-China Resistance Association of Writers and Artists

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党领导的中国各民族作家自愿结合的专业性人民团体，吴梦起于1980年加入。
description.en: A professional people's organization voluntarily formed by writers of all ethnic groups in China under the leadership of the Communist Party of China. Wu Mengqi became a member in 1980.

zh-cn: 人民艺术家 (中华人民共和国)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国授予文艺界人士的荣誉称号。
中国现代诗人、作家、红学家，与朱自清共同创办《诗》月刊。
description.en: A modern Chinese poet, writer, and redologist, who co-founded the 'Poetry' monthly with Zhu Ziqing.

description.zh-cn: 1955年发生的一场全国性政治运动，将文艺理论家胡风及其支持者打成“反革命集团”。周扬是此案的主要领导者之一。
description.en: A nationwide political campaign in 1955 that labeled literary theorist Hu Feng and his supporters a "counter-revolutionary clique." Zhou Yang was one of the main leaders of this case.

description.zh-cn: 日本第121代天皇，明治天皇的父亲。
description.en: The 121st Emperor of Japan, father of Emperor Meiji.

description.zh-cn: 孝明天皇的典侍，明治天皇的生母。
description.en: A lady-in-waiting (Tenshi) of Emperor Kōmei and the birth mother of Emperor Meiji.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇的皇后。
description.en: The wife and empress consort of Emperor Meiji.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇的典侍，大正天皇的生母。
description.en: A lady-in-waiting (Tenshi) of Emperor Meiji and the birth mother of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 江户幕府第15代将军，也是末代将军，将政权交还给明治天皇。
description.en: The 15th and last shogun of the Tokugawa shogunate, who returned political power to Emperor Meiji.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末至明治时代的皇族、政治家、军人，曾任总裁、左大臣等要职。
description.en: An imperial prince, politician, and military officer from the late Edo to Meiji periods in Japan, who served in key positions such as President and Minister of the Left.

description.zh-cn: 日本公卿、明治时期的政治家。曾任辅相、右大臣、太政大臣等职。
description.en: A Japanese court noble and politician of the Meiji period. He served in positions such as Junior Chancellor, Minister of the Right, and Chancellor of the Realm.

description.zh-cn: 标志着江户幕府统治结束的事件。

en: Constitution of the Empire of Japan

description.zh-cn: 日本首部依近现代君主立宪体系制定的宪制性文件，公布于1889年2月11日，自1890年11月29日起施行，至1947年被《日本国宪法》取代。其特色为采用二元制君主立宪制，天皇的政治地位高于三权分立的国家机关。
description.en: The first constitutional document of Japan based on a modern constitutional monarchy system, promulgated on February 11, 1889, effective from November 29, 1890, until it was replaced by the Constitution of Japan in 1947. It was characterized by a dualistic constitutional monarchy, placing the Emperor's political status above the state organs of the separation of powers.

description.zh-cn: 日本古都、前首都，别名洛阳。其古代都城平安京的格局仿照唐朝洛阳城建立，同时也是明治天皇的出生地。该城市也是波士顿的友好城市之一。有说法称梁思成曾建议盟军在轰炸日本时保护该城市，但此说法存在争议。
description.en: An ancient and former capital of Japan, also known as Rakuyō (洛阳). Its ancient capital, Heian-kyō, was modeled after Luoyang of the Tang dynasty, and it is also the birthplace of Emperor Meiji. The city is also one of Boston's sister cities. It is said that Liang Sicheng suggested the Allied forces protect the city during the bombing of Japan, but this claim is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 日本的首都，位于日本关东地方，狭义上指东京都区部，亦可指东京都或东京都会区。自明治维新后，明治天皇将皇室从京都迁至此地并更名为东京，使其成为日本事实上的首都。东京是全球规模最大的都会区之一，也是梁思成的出生地。
description.en: The capital of Japan, located in the Kantō region. In a narrow sense, it refers to the special wards of Tokyo, but can also refer to the Tokyo Metropolis or the Greater Tokyo Area. After the Meiji Restoration, Emperor Meiji moved the imperial court from Kyoto to this city and renamed it Tokyo, making it the de facto capital of Japan. Tokyo is one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world and also the birthplace of Liang Sicheng.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国与大韩帝国签订的条约，正式将朝鲜半岛并入日本版图。
description.en: A treaty signed between the Empire of Japan and the Korean Empire, officially annexing the Korean Peninsula into Japanese territory.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任中共辽宁省委书记。

曾任中央广播电视总台副台长、中央人民广播电台台长。
description.en: Former Deputy Director of China Media Group and Director of China National Radio.

en: State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家新闻出版广电总局
中华人民共和国国家新闻出版广播电影电视总局
国家新闻出版广电总局

description.zh-cn: 批准广东广播电视台组建方案的机构，于2018年撤销。
description.en: The organization that approved the establishment plan for Guangdong Radio and Television, and was abolished in 2018.

en: China Economic Information Service Holdings Limited

description.zh-cn: 慎海雄的前任中共广东省委宣传部部长。
慎海雄的继任中共广东省委宣传部部长。
中国残疾人事业的全国性组织
北京市中学
中国在改革开放初期，1980年代成立的一家公司。其部分资产后转入中国华能集团。
description.en: A company established in China in the 1980s, during the early period of reform and opening up. Some of its assets were later transferred to China Huaneng Group.

description.zh-cn: 邓朴方出生地
他曾任中国人民解放军空军政治部副主任，是“联合舰队”成员。同时，他也担任空军司令部办公室处长，并执笔起草了著名的《“571工程”纪要》。
description.en: He served as Deputy Director of the Political Department of the PLA Air Force and was a member of the 'United Fleet'. He also held the position of Division Chief of the Office of the PLA Air Force Command and was the drafter of the notable 'Project 571 Outline'.

description.zh-cn: 曾任空四军政治部秘书处副处长，“联合舰队”成员，也是《“571工程”纪要》的共同密谋者。
description.en: Served as deputy head of the secretariat of the Political Department of the 4th Air Force, a member of the 'United Fleet', and a co-conspirator of the 'Project 571 Outline'.

description.zh-cn: 林立果的未婚妻。

zh-cn: 2019年金门县选举区立法委员缺额补选

description.zh-cn: 陈玉珍的姐姐。
陈玉珍的弟弟，金门县议员。

zh-cn: 中国国民党中央委员会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Central Committee of the Kuomintang

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、政治学者，民主进步党籍。曾两度担任行政院大陆委员会主任委员，并曾任中华民国国家安全局局长、国立台湾大学国家发展研究所教授等职。因指导多位学生的硕士论文涉嫌抄袭而引发争议。
description.en: A politician and political scientist from the Republic of China (Taiwan), and a member of the Democratic Progressive Party. He has served as the Minister of the Mainland Affairs Council twice, and also as Director-General of the National Security Bureau and a professor at the Graduate Institute of Development Studies at National Taiwan University. He became controversial after several master's theses he supervised were found to involve plagiarism.

description.zh-cn: 2021年台湾政治剧集，为《国际桥牌社》之第二季，剧情聚焦1994年至1996年间，以1996年中华民国总统选举和台湾海峡飞弹危机为故事背景展开。
description.en: A 2021 Taiwanese political drama series, the second season of 'Island Nation', focusing on the period from 1994 to 1996, set against the backdrop of the 1996 ROC presidential election and the Taiwan Strait Crisis.

zh-cn: 第十一届立法委员选举

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年将领，曾任长沙太守。孙策与孙权的父亲，追谥孙吴武烈皇帝。
description.en: A military general in the late Eastern Han dynasty, who served as Administrator of Changsha. He was the father of Sun Ce and Sun Quan, and was posthumously honored as Emperor Wulie of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 孙坚的妻子，孙策与孙权的母亲，孙吴武烈皇后。
description.en: Wife of Sun Jian, mother of Sun Ce and Sun Quan, Empress Wulie of Sun Wu.

description.zh-cn: 孙权长兄，东汉末年军阀，为孙吴基业的奠基者之一。他在统一江东过程中与许贡发生冲突并最终处死了许贡，后遭许贡门客刺杀身亡。
description.en: An elder brother of Sun Quan, a warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty and one of the founders of the state of Eastern Wu. He clashed with Xu Gong during his conquest of Jiangdong, eventually executing him, and was later assassinated by Xu Gong's retainers.

description.zh-cn: 孙权之子，孙吴第二位皇帝。
东汉末年荆州牧刘表属下将领，曾任江夏太守，对孙坚之死负有责任。
description.en: A general under Liu Biao in the late Eastern Han dynasty, formerly served as Prefect of Jiangxia, and was responsible for the death of Sun Jian.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年孙吴阵营杰出的军事家、战略家、政治家与音乐家，孙吴重要将领，赤壁之战的主要指挥官。他也是一位名将，与孙策为总角之交。
description.en: A famous general in the late Eastern Han dynasty, a close friend and key general of Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 孙权三子，曾被立为太子，后在南鲁党争中被废。
孙权四子，封鲁王，在南鲁党争中被赐死。
孙权为报父仇，率军攻打江夏太守黄祖的战役。
孙权的出生地，今江苏省徐州市睢宁县北郊。

en: Premier of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政院的最高首长，1928年后取代国务总理成为政府首脑。
description.en: The head of the Executive Yuan of the Republic of China, who replaced the Premier of the State Council as the head of government after 1928.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府的首长。
description.en: The head of the Taiwan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国外交部的首长职位。
description.en: The head of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院院长。在任台湾行政院长期间，他为古龙的墓碑题字“英才早凋”。
description.en: The then Premier of the Republic of China, who inscribed 'A brilliant talent passed away too soon' on Gu Long's tombstone.

Minister of Transportation and Communications of the Republic of China

连战的妻子。
中华民国政治人物，连战之父，曾任内政部部长。

description.zh-cn: 连战的母亲。
连战的祖父，台湾历史学家。

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第九任总统、副总统选举，也是中华民国首次在台湾、澎湖、金门、马祖举行之总统公民直选。该事件是电视剧《国际桥牌社2》的故事背景之一。
description.en: The ninth presidential and vice-presidential election of the Republic of China, and the first direct presidential election held in Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu. This event is one of the story backdrops for the TV series 'Island Nation 2'.

description.zh-cn: 唐中宗李显的元配妻子。
韦皇后之父。
唐朝宰相。
唐中宗李显和韦皇后的女儿。

芮成钢的姐姐。
负责调查芮成钢案的检察机关。
对芮成钢案进行判决的法院。

导致多名央视人员被调查的政治运动。
美国政治人物、外交官，曾任美国驻华大使。
description.en: An American politician and diplomat who served as the United States Ambassador to China.

description.zh-cn: 中国前职业篮球运动员，曾效力于NBA休斯顿火箭队，与特雷西·麦克格雷迪组成“姚麦组合”。被誉为中国男篮“三大中锋”之一，也是中国男篮巅峰时期的代表人物。
description.en: Chinese former professional basketball player who played for the NBA Houston Rockets and formed the 'Yao-Mac' duo with Tracy McGrady. He is known as one of the 'Three Great Centers' of Chinese men's basketball and a representative figure of its peak era.

description.zh-cn: 一个总部设在中国的非官方、非营利性国际组织。
description.en: A non-governmental and non-profit international organization headquartered in China.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室、高级官员
刺客
高宗武与陶希圣揭发《汪日密约》的事件
西汉开国功臣，官至太尉、丞相。他与陈平等人发动诛吕安刘政变，拥立汉文帝。
description.en: A founding general of the Western Han dynasty, who served as Grand Marshal and Chancellor. Along with Chen Ping, he quashed the Lü Clan Disturbance and enthroned Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 吕后死后，以陈平、周勃为首的汉初功臣集团与刘氏皇族联合，发起政变，铲除吕氏外戚势力。此次政治事件由陈平与周勃共同策划并执行，期间汉惠帝的所有儿子均被杀害。
description.en: After the death of Empress Lü Zhi, the meritorious officials from the early Han dynasty, led by Chen Ping and Zhou Bo, allied with the Liu imperial clan to launch a coup, eliminating the Lü consort kin's power. This political event was jointly planned and executed by Chen Ping and Zhou Bo, during which all of Emperor Hui's sons were killed.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦第七子，鲁元公主和汉文帝的异母弟，淮南王。他因谋反被废，在流放途中绝食而死。
description.en: The seventh son of Liu Bang, half-brother of Princess Yuan of Lu and Emperor Wen, and King of Huainan. He was later deposed for treason and starved himself to death during exile.

description.zh-cn: 济北王，汉文帝时期起兵反叛，兵败自杀。
description.en: King of Jibei, who rebelled during Emperor Wen's reign and committed suicide after being defeated.

description.zh-cn: 原为汉朝宦官，后投降匈奴，成为单于的谋士，对汉朝构成威胁。

description.zh-cn: 明朝第十六位皇帝，明光宗朱常洛长子，崇祯帝之兄。年号天启。在位初期，他任用东林党人，朝政一度清明，并启用了孙承宗、袁崇焕等将领在辽东对抗后金。后期，宦官魏忠贤专权，导致朝政败坏。他本人爱好木工及漆器，有“木匠皇帝”之称。
description.en: The sixteenth emperor of the Ming Dynasty, eldest son of Emperor Guangzong Zhu Changluo, and elder brother of the Chongzhen Emperor. His era name was Tianqi. In the early part of his reign, he employed officials from the Donglin Party, leading to a brief period of political clarity, and appointed generals like Sun Chengzong and Yuan Chonghuan to counter the Later Jin in Liaodong. In the later part, the eunuch Wei Zhongxian usurped power, resulting in widespread corruption. He was personally fond of carpentry and lacquerware, earning him the nickname 'the Carpenter Emperor'.

Later, his discord with Governor Wang Huazhen led to the defeat at Guangning, and he was eventually framed and executed by Wei Zhongxian's faction.

description.zh-cn: 249年2月5日，司马懿父子趁曹爽陪曹芳离洛阳至高平陵祭陵之际，发动政变，控制京师洛阳，最终铲除曹爽及其党羽。此次事件使司马氏独揽曹魏大权，为西晋的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: On February 5, 249, Sima Yi and his sons launched a coup d'état in Luoyang. While Cao Shuang accompanied Emperor Cao Fang to pay respects at the Gaoping Tombs, Sima Yi seized control of the capital, ultimately eliminating Cao Shuang and his faction. This event enabled the Sima clan to monopolize power in Cao Wei, laying the foundation for the Western Jin dynasty.

洛阳，中华人民共和国河南省下辖的地级市，是河洛文化和华夏文明的重要发祥地。历史上曾有十三个正统朝代建都于此，是中国历史上建都最早、朝代最多、历时最长的城市之一。它曾是曹魏与西晋的都城，刘禅投降后居住于此。作为唐朝的东都，白居易晚年多在此居住并最终逝世，唐昭宗曾被朱温强迫迁都至此并最终在此被杀。此外，它还是唐代宗的出生地。
description.en: Luoyang, a prefecture-level city in Henan Province, People's Republic of China, is an important cradle of Heluo culture and Chinese civilization. Historically, thirteen orthodox dynasties established their capital here, making it one of the cities with the earliest, most numerous, and longest-reigning capitals in Chinese history. It served as the capital of Cao Wei and Western Jin, where Liu Shan resided after his surrender. As the Eastern Capital of the Tang dynasty, Bai Juyi spent most of his later years here and eventually passed away, and Emperor Zhaozong was forcibly relocated here by Zhu Wen and ultimately assassinated. Furthermore, it was the birthplace of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐睿宗的结发妻子。
唐睿宗嫡长子。
唐玄宗李隆基为巩固皇权，发动政变，消灭了权势强大的太平公主及其党羽。
description.en: A coup launched by Emperor Xuanzong to consolidate his power by eliminating the influential Princess Taiping and her faction.

description.zh-cn: 东亚君主制国家给予退位皇帝或当朝皇帝在世父亲的头衔。
努尔哈赤的父亲，中国明朝后期女真建州左卫领袖。曾为建州右卫都指挥使王杲的部下，后归顺明朝，官至建州左卫指挥使。1583年，在明将李成梁攻打阿台的战斗中，与父亲觉昌安一同被明军所杀。1636年被皇太极追尊为福王，1648年被顺治帝追谥为宣皇帝，庙号显祖。
description.en: Father of Nurhaci, a Jurchen leader of the Jianzhou Left Guard during the late Ming Dynasty in China. He was once a subordinate of Wang Gao, commander of the Jianzhou Right Guard, but later submitted to the Ming Dynasty and was promoted to Commander of the Jianzhou Left Guard. In 1583, he was killed along with his father Giocangga by Ming forces during General Li Chengliang's attack on Atai's fortress. In 1636, he was posthumously honored as Prince Fu by Hong Taiji, and in 1648, he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xuan with the temple name Xianzhu by the Shunzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世的嫡夫人，喜塔腊氏。努尔哈赤、舒尔哈齐、雅尔哈齐、沾河姑的生母。后被追尊为宣皇后。
description.en: Taksi's primary consort, of the Hitara clan. She was the birth mother of Nurhaci, Šurhaci, Yarhaci, and Zhanhegu. She was posthumously honored as Empress Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤的祖父，塔克世之父。在明军的一次攻击中与儿子塔克世一同被杀，后被追尊为清景祖。
description.en: Grandfather of Nurhaci and father of Taksi. He was killed along with his son Taksi during an attack by Ming forces and was later posthumously honored as Qing Jingzu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝后期将领，镇守辽东三十年，官至辽东总兵、太傅，封宁远伯。其早期对努尔哈赤和女真采取的政策，深刻影响了后金的崛起。
description.en: A general in the late Ming Dynasty, he guarded Liaodong for thirty years, holding positions such as Liaodong Commander-in-chief and Grand Tutor, and was ennobled as Earl of Ningyuan. His early policies towards Nurhaci and the Jurchens significantly influenced the rise of the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 该人物被描述为建州女真苏克苏浒部图伦城主，努尔哈赤早期主要仇敌。同时，也有记载称其为明朝将领，在攻破古埒城后杀害了塔克世和觉昌安。
description.en: This figure is described as the lord of Tulun city of the Suksuhu tribe of Jianzhou Jurchen, a major early enemy of Nurhaci. Additionally, they are recorded as a Ming Dynasty general who killed Taksi and Giocangga after conquering Gure city.

description.zh-cn: 塔克世的第三子，努尔哈赤同母弟，被封为和硕庄亲王。他后来与其兄长决裂，并被囚禁。
description.en: The third son of Taksi and a full brother of Nurhaci, he was granted the title of Prince Zhuang of the First Rank. He later broke with his elder brother and was imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤长子，曾被立为继承人，后被处死。
努尔哈赤于1618年发布的讨明檄文，标志着对明朝的公开反叛。
description.en: A manifesto issued by Nurhaci in 1618, declaring war against the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝与后金在宁远城下的一次重要战役。袁崇焕率领明军使用红衣大炮成功击退努尔哈赤的进攻，是明军对后金的首次重大胜利，也是努尔哈赤亲征的唯一败绩，未能攻克由袁崇焕镇守的宁远城。努尔哈赤在此战后不久去世。
description.en: A major battle between Ming and Later Jin forces at Ningyuan. The Ming army, led by Yuan Chonghuan, successfully repelled Nurhaci's attack using Hongyipao cannons, marking the first significant Ming victory against the Later Jin, and Nurhaci's only defeat in person, failing to capture Ningyuan defended by Yuan Chonghuan. Nurhaci died shortly after this battle.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年著名政治及军事人物，官至兵部尚书兼蓟辽督师。他构筑了“关宁锦防线”，在宁远之战、宁锦之战中多次击败后金军队。为自保曾上疏颂扬魏忠贤，但最终仍被其排挤去职。后因己巳之变中护卫不力及擅杀毛文龙等罪名，被崇祯帝以反间计为由判处凌迟，后于清乾隆年间获得平反。
description.en: A renowned political and military figure in the late Ming Dynasty, who served as Minister of War and Viceroy of Jiliao. He constructed the 'Guan-Ning-Jin Defense Line' and repeatedly defeated the Later Jin forces in the battles of Ningyuan and Ningjin. He once praised Wei Zhongxian to protect himself but was eventually dismissed by him. He was later executed by lingchi by the Chongzhen Emperor, who fell for a deception stratagem, on charges including failing to protect the capital during the Jisi Incident and unlawfully executing Mao Wenlong. He was posthumously rehabilitated during the Qianlong era of the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤创建的军政合一、兵民合一的社会组织形式。
description.en: A system of military and social organization created by Nurhaci, integrating civil and military functions, and unifying soldiers and civilians.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤于1599年下令创制，基于蒙古文字，用于拼写满语的文字。
description.en: A Manchu script based on the Mongolian alphabet, created under the order of Nurhaci in 1599.

description.zh-cn: 1900年八国联军时期，唐才常组织了“自立会”和“自立军”。其中，“自立会”的前身由唐才常在东亚同文会支持下秘密组织；“自立军”的前身为“正气会”。“自立军”是由自立会及各方力量组成的武装部队，作为起义的核心力量，策划在长江中下游数省同时起事。此次武装起义旨在推翻慈禧太后、支持光绪帝亲政并建立君主立宪政府，后因计划泄露及内部资金问题而迅速失败。
description.en: During the Boxer Rebellion in 1900, Tang Caichang organized the 'Self-Reliance Society' and the 'Self-Reliance Army'. The predecessor of the 'Self-Reliance Society' was secretly organized by Tang Caichang with the support of the East Asian Common Culture Society; the 'Self-Reliance Army's' predecessor was the 'Zhengqi Hui'. The 'Self-Reliance Army' was an armed force composed of the Self-Reliance Society and other factions, serving as the core force for the planned uprising across several provinces along the middle and lower Yangtze River. This uprising aimed to overthrow Empress Dowager Cixi, support the Guangxu Emperor's rule, and establish a constitutional monarchy, but quickly failed due to leaked plans and internal financial issues.

description.zh-cn: 护国战争期间，由南方独立各省在广东肇庆成立的、对抗北洋政府的护国军政府。梁启超任抚军兼政务委员长。
description.en: During the National Protection War, it was the military government of the National Protection Army established in Zhaoqing, Guangdong by the southern independent provinces to oppose the Beiyang government. Liang Qichao served as its Commander and Chairman of the Government Affairs Council.

description.zh-cn: 一个涵盖中国所有民族的政治与国族概念，由梁启超于清末首次提出。该概念对现代中国民族主义的形成产生了深远影响。
description.en: A political and national-ethnic concept encompassing all ethnic groups in China, first proposed by Liang Qichao in the late Qing Dynasty. This concept has had a profound impact on the formation of modern Chinese nationalism.

Founded by Mou Tsung-tsan, former vice president of California State University, Los Angeles, it is known for its American-style campus and liberal academic atmosphere. It was the first national university established in Taiwan's democratic era after the lifting of martial law and the end of the Period of Mobilization for the Suppression of Communist Rebellion.

The emblem was promulgated by the Central People's Government on September 20, 1950.

Its predecessors include the propaganda department during the Kuomintang's mainland period, and the department established after the 1950 reform, responsible for propaganda and cultural control. In 1972, this organization was reorganized from the 'Fourth Group' and continued until 2000, serving as an important predecessor of the current Cultural and Communications Committee. Additionally, he expressed support for the amendment to the 'Public Officials Election and Recall Act', which was prompted by the Tsai Cheng-yuan recall case.

description.en: Originally a general of Cao Wei, he surrendered to Shu Han during the first Northern Expedition and was highly regarded by Zhuge Liang, becoming his military successor. He was a prominent general of the state of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period, primarily active in its later period, who led multiple northern expeditions against the rival state of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉大臣，劝说刘禅投降。
description.en: An official of Shu Han who persuaded Liu Shan to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏末期权臣，西晋的奠基者。他是司马懿的次子，司马师之弟，司马炎之父。
description.en: A powerful regent in the late Cao Wei period and the founder of the Western Jin dynasty. He was the second son of Sima Yi, younger brother of Sima Shi, and father of Sima Yan.

description.zh-cn: 由司马炎建立的中国朝代，取代曹魏并最终统一三国，结束了长期的战乱。该朝代在永嘉之乱后被前赵所灭。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty founded by Sima Yan, which succeeded Cao Wei and ultimately unified the Three Kingdoms, ending a long period of warfare. It was overthrown by the Former Zhao after the Yongjia Disturbance.

description.zh-cn: 汉赵开国皇帝，追谥刘禅为孝怀皇帝。
description.en: The founding emperor of Han-Zhao who posthumously honored Liu Shan as Emperor Xiaohuai.

description.zh-cn: 刘禅的第二位皇后，张飞次女。
description.en: Liu Shan's second empress, the younger daughter of Zhang Fei.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉灭亡后，曹魏将领钟会于264年在成都发动的叛乱，最终失败被杀。
description.en: A rebellion launched by Cao Wei general Zhong Hui in Chengdu (former Shu territory) in 264 after the fall of Shu Han, which ultimately failed and led to his death.

description.zh-cn: 刘禅之子，在蜀汉亡国当日自杀。
description.en: Son of Liu Shan, who committed suicide on the day Shu Han fell.

description.zh-cn: 刘禅第六子，继承安乐公爵位。
description.en: The sixth son of Liu Shan, who inherited the title of Duke of Anle.

After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, she donated half a month's salary to support the reconstruction of National Dong Hwa University. In the same year's legislative election, she publicly supported Taiwan People's Party (TPP) candidate Tsai Pi-ju, a move seen as a model for Blue-White cooperation.

It is positioned as an 'Action and Innovation AI Cabinet' and operates as a minority government in the 11th Legislative Yuan. Following the failure of the Great Recall movement, the cabinet underwent a partial reshuffle.

婉容的后母。
皇后婉容的弟弟，金韫颖的丈夫。1945年在逃亡途中失踪。
description.en: The younger brother of Empress Wanrong and the husband of Jin Yunying. He went missing during an escape in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 中国末代皇帝溥仪的三妹，爱新觉罗氏。满洲国覆灭后生活困顿，后经章士钊上报，获毛泽东批示，成为北京市东城区政协委员，生活得以改善。
description.en: The third younger sister of Puyi, the last emperor of China, of the Aisin-Gioro clan. She faced hardship after the fall of Manchukuo, but her situation improved after Zhang Shizhao reported her case, leading to an instruction from Mao Zedong that made her a member of the Dongcheng District CPPCC Committee in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 满洲国间谍。
日本陆军中将，溥仪的御用挂。
指1912年至1924年间，退位后的清朝皇室成员根据《清室优待条件》继续居住在紫禁城后半部，并保留皇帝尊号和原有宫廷体制的时期。
清朝管理皇室、宗室事务的机构。它曾负责雍和宫的改建工程，文绣的父亲端恭曾在此任职。
description.en: The institution in the Qing dynasty responsible for managing the affairs of the imperial household and clan. It once oversaw the reconstruction of the Yonghe Temple, and Wenxiu's father, Duangong, served in this department.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国吉林省的城市。
三国时期曹魏后期权臣，官至大将军。他是司马懿与张春华的长子，司马昭的兄长，以及西晋开国君主晋武帝司马炎的伯父。
description.en: A powerful official and regent in the late Cao Wei period during the Three Kingdoms era, who held the office of Grand General. He was the eldest son of Sima Yi and Zhang Chunhua, the elder brother of Sima Zhao, and the uncle of Sima Yan, the founding emperor of the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西晋的开国皇帝，司马昭之子。他篡夺曹魏政权，后灭亡东吴，统一中国。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Western Jin dynasty and son of Sima Zhao. He usurped the Cao Wei throne and later conquered Eastern Wu, unifying China.

description.zh-cn: 司马懿的正妻，司马师、司马昭、司马干的母亲，追谥为宣穆皇后。
description.en: The primary wife of Sima Yi, mother of Sima Shi, Sima Zhao, and Sima Gan, posthumously honored as Empress Xuanmu.

description.zh-cn: 西晋宗室，司马懿第四子，八王之乱中的八王之一。
description.en: A member of the imperial clan of the Western Jin dynasty, the fourth son of Sima Yi, one of the eight princes in the War of the Eight Princes.

description.zh-cn: 西晋宗室，司马懿与张春华的第三子，司马师之弟。他曾被授予西晋五等爵位制中的伯爵。性格乖僻，但在八王之乱中得以远害全身。
description.en: A member of the imperial clan of the Western Jin dynasty, the third son of Sima Yi and Zhang Chunhua, and younger brother of Sima Shi. He was granted the title of count in the five-rank nobility system of the Western Jin. He had an eccentric personality but managed to survive the War of the Eight Princes unscathed.

description.zh-cn: 西晋宗室，司马懿第九子，八王之乱中的八王之一，曾篡位称帝。
description.en: A member of the imperial clan of the Western Jin dynasty, the ninth son of Sima Yi, one of the eight princes in the War of the Eight Princes who briefly usurped the throne.

description.zh-cn: 司马懿与张春华之女。
description.en: Daughter of Sima Yi and Zhang Chunhua.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军的精锐机械化部队之一，在抗日战争和国共内战中战功显赫。
description.en: One of the elite mechanized units of the National Revolutionary Army, distinguished in both the Second Sino-Japanese War and the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在第二次世界大战期间为支援英国军队在缅甸殖民地对抗日本，以及保卫中国西南大后方而建立的出国作战部队。
第二次国共内战期间在吉林四平发生的一场战役。孙立人指挥新一军在三日内攻克四平，击败林彪所率的东北民主联军。
description.en: A battle that took place in Siping, Jilin, during the second phase of the Chinese Civil War. Sun Li-jen commanded the New First Army to capture Siping within three days, defeating the Northeast Democratic United Army led by Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 清代八旗之一，由皇帝亲自统领的上三旗之首。文绣家族隶属于此旗。雍正元年（1723年），年羹尧曾被抬入汉军镶黄旗。

历仕孙坚、孙策、孙权三代的老将。
description.en: An old general who served three generations: Sun Jian, Sun Ce, and Sun Quan.

description.zh-cn: 中国文学史上第一部长篇历史演义章回小说，由罗贯中根据《三国志》及《三国志平话》等史书和话本改编创作，为中国古典四大名著之一。
description.en: The first full-length historical episodic novel in Chinese literature, written by Luo Guanzhong and adapted from historical records like 'Records of the Three Kingdoms' and storybooks like 'Sanguozhi Pinghua'. It is one of the Four Great Classical Novels of Chinese literature.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初小说家，普遍认为是中国古典小说《三国演义》的作者。
description.en: A novelist from the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties, widely considered the author of the classical Chinese novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，曾任扬州刺史，后被孙策击败。
description.en: The Inspector of Yang Province during the Eastern Han dynasty, defeated by Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年吴郡一带的山贼头领。他曾被孙策击败，后又接纳了同样被孙策击败的许贡。
description.en: A bandit leader in the Wu Commandery area during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He was once defeated by Sun Ce, and later sheltered Xu Gong who had also been defeated by Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期曹魏的官员。他曾任会稽太守，被孙策击败，也曾是于禁的上司并向曹操推荐了他。
description.en: An official from the late Eastern Han dynasty to Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period. He served as the Administrator of Kuaiji Commandery, was defeated by Sun Ce, and also served as Yu Jin's superior, recommending him to Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年庐江太守，曾为袁术部下，后被孙策用计击败。
description.en: The Administrator of Lujiang Commandery in the late Eastern Han dynasty, defeated by Sun Ce through strategy.

一种亚伯拉罕一神教，其经典和传统与《古兰经》有相似之处。它是世界三大宗教之一。
description.en: An Abrahamic monotheistic religion whose scriptures and traditions have similarities with the Quran. It is one of the world's three major religions.

description.zh-cn: 传教士，曾教导洪秀全但拒绝为其施洗。
冯云山和洪秀全的出生地，位于清朝广东省，现属广州市花都区。
description.en: The birthplace of Feng Yunshan and Hong Xiuquan, located in Guangdong Province during the Qing Dynasty, now part of Huadu District, Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 基督教的中心人物，保罗宣称直接从他获得启示并为其传播福音。在肉身上，他也被认为是亚伯拉罕的后裔。
description.en: The central figure of Christianity, from whom Paul claimed to have received his revelation and for whom he spread the gospel. Physically, he is also considered a descendant of Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕诸教所信仰的独一神。
description.en: The one God worshiped in the Abrahamic religions.

en: Land System of the Heavenly Dynasty
