description.en: The core classics of Confucianism compiled by Zhu Xi, including the Great Learning, the Doctrine of the Mean, the Analects, and Mencius.

description.zh-cn: 晚清重臣，湘军重要将领，曾国藩之弟，叶选宁的外高祖父。他以在天京之役中指挥湘军攻克南京而闻名。尽管下达了“禁杀良民、掳妇女”的禁令，但对城破后军队的大规模屠杀和抢掠负有直接责任。关于其在此役中“获资数千万”的传闻广为流传，但有学者考证认为此说不实。
description.en: An important official and key general of the Xiang Army in the late Qing Dynasty, younger brother of Zeng Guofan, and the great-great-grandfather of Ye Xuaning. He is known for commanding the Xiang Army's capture of Nanjing in the Battle of Tianjing. Although he issued orders prohibiting the killing of civilians and abduction of women, he bears direct responsibility for the large-scale massacre and looting by his troops after the city fell. Rumors that he amassed a fortune of 'tens of millions' from this campaign are widespread, though some scholars argue this is untrue.

description.en: Empress of the Hongzhi Emperor, mother of the Zhengde Emperor, she decided that Zhu Houcong should succeed the throne.

description.en: One of the highest-ranking local officials in the Qing Dynasty, governing modern-day Hebei, Beijing, and Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 1864年7月，曾国荃率领的湘军在攻克太平天国首都天京（南京）后，对城内军民进行的大规模屠杀、抢掠和焚烧事件。该事件持续三天三夜，造成大量人员死亡，死亡人数有多种说法，从约2.5万至二三十万不等。
description.en: A large-scale massacre, looting, and arson committed by the Xiang Army led by Zeng Guoquan against the soldiers and civilians in Tianjing (Nanjing) after capturing the capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom in July 1864. The event lasted for three days and nights, causing a massive number of deaths, with estimates ranging from about 25,000 to 200,000-300,000.

description.zh-cn: 1955年中华人民共和国授予的军衔等级。

description.zh-cn: 张学友的哥哥。

description.en: A Hong Kong singer and actress, and a close friend of Jacky Cheung and Leslie Cheung.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员。他是张学友的密友及电影合作伙伴，也曾多次与王家卫合作，并表示拍其电影后演技进步。
description.en: A Hong Kong actor, a close friend and film collaborator of Jacky Cheung. He has also frequently collaborated with Wong Kar-wai, stating that his acting improved after working on his films.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手及演员，“四大天王”之一。
description.en: Hong Kong singer and actor, one of the "Four Heavenly Kings".

description.zh-cn: 香港男歌手及演员，1990年代被誉为“香港四大天王”之一。他出生于北京，年幼时移民香港。在音乐上以情歌和开创性电子舞曲闻名；影视方面，凭《三更之回家》获金马奖最佳男主角。他长期投身慈善公益，曾任联合国儿童基金会国际青年特使，并获香港特别行政区政府颁授银紫荆星章。他曾拜金铁霖为师。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer and actor, known as one of the "Four Heavenly Kings" of Hong Kong in the 1990s. Born in Beijing, he immigrated to Hong Kong as a child. He is renowned for his love ballads and pioneering electronic dance music, and won the Golden Horse Award for Best Actor for "Three: Going Home". A long-time philanthropist, he served as a UNICEF International Young Envoy and was awarded the Silver Bauhinia Star by the HKSAR Government. He once studied under Jin Tielin.

description.zh-cn: 香港男歌手、演员，其演艺生涯始于1980年代，是1990年代香港乐坛“四大天王”之一，亦为动感艺人的代表之一。
description.en: A Hong Kong male singer, dancer, and actor, whose performing career began in the 1980s. He is known as one of the 'Four Heavenly Kings' of the Hong Kong music scene in the 1990s, and a representative of dynamic artists.

description.zh-cn: 香港金牌经理人，曾在张学友出道早期栽培他。
description.en: Hong Kong talent manager who nurtured Jacky Cheung in his early career.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市

description.zh-cn: 香港导演、监制、编剧，以文艺爱情片见长，多次夺得香港电影金像奖并四度角逐坎城影展金棕榈奖，是首位拿下坎城影展最佳导演奖的华人导演。
description.en: A Hong Kong film director, producer, and screenwriter, known for his art-house romance films. He is a multiple Hong Kong Film Award winner, a four-time Palme d'Or nominee at the Cannes Film Festival, and the first Chinese director to win the Best Director Award at Cannes.

description.zh-cn: 香港艺人、演员，同时是张学友的契爸（干爹）和黎明的谊父。
description.en: A Hong Kong artist and actor, godfather to Jacky Cheung and Leon Lai.

description.en: Taiwanese actor and stuntman, a friend of Jacky Cheung.

description.en: Hong Kong singer, considered one of Jacky Cheung's successors.

description.en: An international record label. Jacky Cheung signed with it in 1984. Leon Lai was signed from 1989 to 1998, establishing his status as a Heavenly King during this period.

description.zh-cn: 唱片公司，张学友目前的唱片及经纪公司。
description.en: Record label, Jacky Cheung's current label and management company.

description.zh-cn: 唱片公司，张学友曾于2000年至2015年签约。
description.en: Record label which Jacky Cheung was signed to from 2000 to 2015.

description.zh-cn: 1992年香港媒体册封的四位最受欢迎男歌手的称号，成员包括张学友、刘德华、郭富城、黎明。
description.en: A title given by Hong Kong media in 1992 to the four most popular male singers, including Jacky Cheung, Andy Lau, Aaron Kwok, and Leon Lai.

description.zh-cn: 1988年上映的香港电影，是王家卫执导的第一部电影。张学友凭借此片获得香港电影金像奖最佳男配角。
description.en: A 1988 Hong Kong film, the directorial debut of Wong Kar-wai. Jacky Cheung won the Hong Kong Film Award for Best Supporting Actor for this film.

description.zh-cn: 徐克执导的电影，张学友凭借此片获得台湾电影金马奖最佳男配角。
description.en: A film directed by Tsui Hark, for which Jacky Cheung won the Golden Horse Award for Best Supporting Actor.

description.zh-cn: 由张学友策划、导演、担任艺术总监并主演的原创现代音乐剧。该剧分为粤语和国语两个版本，在亚洲多地巡演，是华人音乐剧历史上演出场次最多的音乐剧。
description.en: An original modern musical created, directed by, and starring Jacky Cheung, who also served as its artistic director. It has both Cantonese and Mandarin versions and has toured in multiple locations in Asia, becoming the most performed musical in the history of Chinese musical theatre.

description.en: A major pigment merchant and industrialist in Shanghai during the late Qing Dynasty and the Republic of China, and the father of Run Run Shaw. He was the 32nd-generation direct descendant of Shao Kangjie of the Northern Song Dynasty. He secretly associated with the Guangfuhui and Tongmenghui and financially supported the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 上海电影实业家，邵玉轩的长子，邵逸夫的长兄，天一影片公司的创办人。
description.en: A Shanghai film industrialist, the eldest son of Shao Yuxuan and Run Run Shaw's elder brother, and the founder of Tianyi Film Company.

description.zh-cn: 邵逸夫二哥，邵玉轩的二子。
description.en: Run Run Shaw's second elder brother, and the second son of Shao Yuxuan.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡企业家，邵玉轩的三子。他也是邵逸夫的三哥，以及邵维铭的伯父及养父。
description.en: A Singaporean entrepreneur and the third son of Shao Yuxuan. He is also Run Run Shaw's third elder brother, and the uncle and adoptive father of Shao Vee-Meng.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡华人企业家及慈善家，主营地产业和百货业，是香港影视大亨邵逸夫的长子。
description.en: A Singaporean Chinese entrepreneur and philanthropist, primarily involved in real estate and department stores, and the eldest son of Hong Kong film mogul Run Run Shaw.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影公司。该公司于1976年将古龙的《流星‧蝴蝶‧剑》和《天涯‧明月‧刀》改编成电影，开创了武侠电影的高峰和古龙的电影时代。
description.en: A Hong Kong film studio. In 1976, its film adaptations of Gu Long's novels 'Meteor, Butterfly, Sword' and 'Tianya, Mingyue, Dao' initiated a peak in wuxia films and marked the beginning of the Gu Long movie era.

description.zh-cn: 电视广播有限公司创办人之一及首任主席
description.en: Co-founder and first chairman of Television Broadcasts Limited

description.en: Co-founder of Television Broadcasts Limited

description.en: Zhenhai District, Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, located in present-day Ningbo City, is the birthplace of Hu Zongnan and Shao Yuxuan. Historically, this area was an administrative division within Ningbo Prefecture.

description.en: An international science award founded by Run Run Shaw

description.en: Hong Kong businessman

description.zh-cn: 香港行政人员，曾任电视广播有限公司行政主席
description.en: Hong Kong executive, former Executive Chairman of Television Broadcasts Limited

description.zh-cn: 宋朝第三位皇帝，宋太宗第三子，赵元佐同母弟，在位25年。其统治前期社会经济繁荣，史称“咸平之治”；后期则热衷于封禅和天书等道教活动，并加封子路为“河内公”。
description.en: The third emperor of the Song Dynasty, the third son of Emperor Taizong, and the full younger brother of Zhao Yuanzuo. He reigned for 25 years, with his early reign seeing a period of prosperity known as the 'Reign of Xianping'. Later, he became devoted to Daoist activities like the Feng and Shan sacrifices and the 'Heavenly Books', and also granted Zi Lu the title 'Duke of Henei'.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝宗室，宋太宗长子，宋真宗同母兄。他曾被宋太宗属意为太子，后因同情叔父赵廷美，并因赵廷美之死而精神失常，被废为庶人。太宗驾崩后，王继恩等曾企图拥立他为帝。宋真宗即位后，其爵位得以恢复。
description.en: A member of the imperial clan of the Song dynasty, the eldest son of Emperor Taizong and full elder brother of Emperor Zhenzong. He was once considered the heir apparent by Emperor Taizong. However, after sympathizing with his uncle Zhao Tingmei and experiencing a mental breakdown following Zhao Tingmei's death, he was demoted to a commoner. After Emperor Taizong's death, Wang Ji'en and others attempted to enthrone him. Upon Emperor Zhenzong's ascension, his noble rank was restored.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗夫人，宋真宗和赵元佐的生母
description.en: Consort of Emperor Taizong of Song, birth mother of Emperor Zhenzong and Zhao Yuanzuo

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的割据政权，位于现今福建地区，后归降北宋。
description.en: A separatist regime during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, located in modern-day Fujian, which later surrendered to the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 五代十国时期的割据政权之一，位于现今江浙地区，后纳土归降北宋。
description.en: One of the separatist regimes during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, located in the modern Jiangsu-Zhejiang area, which later surrendered its territory to the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 北宋为统一中国、结束五代十国分裂局面而进行的一系列战争。其中包括消灭南汉的战役。
description.en: A series of wars waged by the Northern Song dynasty to unify China and end the fragmentation of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. This included the campaign to conquer Southern Han.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上由契丹族建立的朝代，与北宋长期对峙。
description.en: A dynasty in Chinese history established by the Khitan people, which had a long-standing confrontation with the Northern Song.

description.zh-cn: 辽国将领，在高粱河之战中击败宋军并射伤宋太宗。
description.en: A general of the Liao dynasty who defeated the Song army and wounded Emperor Taizong at the Battle of Gaoliang River.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗时期，宋军为统一交趾（越南）而发动的战役，最终以失败告终。
description.en: A battle during Emperor Taizong's reign, launched by the Song army to unify Jiaozhi (Vietnam), which ultimately ended in failure.

description.zh-cn: 北宋将领，在雍熙北伐中兵败被俘，绝食而死。
description.en: A general of the Northern Song dynasty who was defeated and captured during the Yongxi Northern Expedition and died on a hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相。在宋太宗驾崩后，他识破并挫败了王继恩等人废立太子的阴谋，确保了宋真宗的顺利继位。
description.en: A prime minister of the Northern Song. After Emperor Taizong's death, he saw through and foiled the plot by Wang Ji'en and others to depose the crown prince, ensuring Emperor Zhenzong's smooth succession.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝宦官。宋太祖驾崩后，他未遵宋皇后之命召赵德芳，反将遗诏交予晋王赵光义，助其继位。宋太宗驾崩时，他又意图联合李昌龄、胡旦废黜太子赵恒，改立赵元佐为帝。
description.en: A eunuch of the Song dynasty. After Emperor Taizu's death, he disobeyed Empress Song's order to summon Zhao Defang and instead brought the edict to Prince of Jin (Zhao Guangyi), helping him ascend the throne. Upon Emperor Taizong's death, he again attempted to conspire with Li Changling and Hu Dan to depose Crown Prince Zhao Heng and install Zhao Yuanzuo as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相

description.zh-cn: 北宋统一战争中消灭南唐的战役。
南唐末主李煜的第二任皇后，大周后（周娥皇）的妹妹。
description.en: The second empress of Li Yu, the last ruler of the Southern Tang, and the younger sister of the Great Empress Zhou (Zhou Ehuang).

description.zh-cn: 南唐及北宋官员、文学家。
南唐官员。
南唐官员。
南唐末主李煜的第一任皇后，小周后的姐姐。
description.en: The first empress of Li Yu, the last ruler of the Southern Tang, and the elder sister of Lesser Empress Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 李煜与周娥皇（大周后）之子。
description.en: Son of Li Yu and Zhou Ehuang (Great Empress Zhou).

description.zh-cn: 李煜与周娥皇（大周后）之子。
description.en: Son of Li Yu and Zhou Ehuang (Great Empress Zhou).

description.zh-cn: 位于今山东省菏泽市定陶区，是戚夫人的出生地。
秦汉之际的儒士，曾任太子太傅，力保刘盈太子之位，后为汉朝制定宗庙礼仪。
description.en: A Confucian scholar during the Qin-Han transition. He served as the Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince, strongly advocated for Liu Ying's status, and later established the ritual system for the Han Dynasty's ancestral temples.

description.zh-cn: 戚夫人的父亲。
戚夫人被虐杀并弃尸的地方。
前中共中央党校党建教研部教授，因严厉批判习近平及中国共产党，被开除党籍并取消退休待遇，成为习近平的著名批评者。她被视为党内的自由派学者，现居美国。
description.en: A former professor at the Party Building Teaching and Research Department of the Central Party School of the Chinese Communist Party, who was expelled from the party and had her retirement benefits canceled for severely criticizing Xi Jinping and the CCP. She is considered a liberal scholar within the party and currently resides in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 自2018年起，由美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发起的，在中华人民共和国与美利坚合众国之间发生的一系列贸易冲突。
description.en: A series of trade conflicts between the People's Republic of China and the United States, initiated by U.S. President Donald Trump starting in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民骨灰撒入之处。
吴三桂之父，明朝锦州总兵。曾被李自成扣押作为人质，后在一片石之战（山海关之战）后被杀。
description.en: Father of Wu Sangui, a Jinzhou commander in the Ming Dynasty. He was held hostage by Li Zicheng and executed after the Battle of Shanhai Pass.

description.zh-cn: 明末将领，关宁军核心人物之一，吴三桂的舅父。他长期跟随袁崇焕镇守辽东，袁崇焕被捕后曾率兵哗变，后被劝回。后在松锦之战中，他举锦州城投降清朝。
description.en: A late Ming general, a key figure in the Guanning Army, and uncle of Wu Sangui. He defended Liaodong alongside Yuan Chonghuan for many years. After Yuan's arrest, he led a mutiny but was later persuaded to return. He later surrendered the city of Jinzhou to the Qing during the Battle of Songjin.

description.zh-cn: 吴三桂的皇后。
明末清初名妓，吴三桂的爱妾。
吴应熊之子，吴三桂之孙。
吴三桂之孙，吴周第二位皇帝。
三藩之乱期间由吴三桂建立的政权。
南明最后一位皇帝。
description.en: The last emperor of the Southern Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝云南巡抚。
清朝公主，吴应熊之妻。
唐朝、武周时期宰相。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 武周时期酷吏。
description.en: A secret police official of the Wu Zhou dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝、武周时期宰相。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang and Wu Zhou dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员、画家。
description.en: An official and painter of the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰之子。
description.en: Son of Di Renjie.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰的出生地。
description.en: Birthplace of Di Renjie.

description.zh-cn: 文昭甄皇后的父亲，曾任上蔡令。
东汉末年文学家，建安七子之一。
东汉末年文学家，建安七子之一。
毛福梅之父。
毛福梅的二哥。

zh-cn: 法因娜·伊帕季耶芙娜·瓦赫列娃

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国之妻，白俄罗斯裔中华民国第一夫人。本名法因娜·伊帕季耶芙娜·瓦赫列娃，出生于俄罗斯帝国奥尔沙。1935年与蒋经国在苏联结婚，后随夫返回中国。1978年至1988年间任中华民国第一夫人，生活低调，鲜少公开露面。
description.en: Wife of Chiang Ching-kuo and Belarusian-born First Lady of the Republic of China. Her original name was Faina Ipatyevna Vakhreva, born in Orsha, Russian Empire. She married Chiang Ching-kuo in the Soviet Union in 1935 and later returned to China with him. She served as the First Lady of the Republic of China from 1978 to 1988, maintaining a low profile with few public appearances.

death_place.zh-cn: 中华民国台北市北投区台北荣民总医院
death_place.en: Taipei Veterans General Hospital, Beitou District, Taipei, Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国长子，蒋孝章和蒋孝武的哥哥。
description.en: Eldest son of Chiang Ching-kuo, older brother of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代思想家、哲学家、教育家，战国时期儒家代表人物，与庄周大约同时代。他曾评价晏婴以其君显。
description.en: An ancient Chinese thinker, philosopher, and educator, a representative of Confucianism during the Warring States period, and a contemporary of Zhuang Zhou. He once commented that Yan Ying made his lord illustrious.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝时期的诸侯国。它是庄周（庄子）的故国和出生地，他曾在此短暂担任漆园吏。同时，这里也是晏婴的祖籍地。
description.en: A vassal state during the Zhou Dynasty in China. It was the home state and birthplace of Zhuang Zhou (Zhuangzi), where he briefly served as the Clerk of the Lacquer Garden. It was also the ancestral home of Yan Ying.

description.zh-cn: 庄周曾担任小吏的地方。
description.en: A place where Zhuang Zhou once served as a minor official.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期魏国君主，魏武侯之子，魏国第三位君主，与庄周同时代。在位期间将国都从安邑迁至大梁，致力于经济发展。但在桂陵、马陵之战中两败于齐国，国势由盛转衰。
description.en: Ruler of the State of Wei during the Warring States period, the third monarch of Wei, son of Marquess Wu of Wei, and a contemporary of Zhuang Zhou. During his reign, he moved the capital from Anyi to Daliang and focused on economic development. However, Wei suffered two major defeats against the state of Qi in the battles of Guiling and Maling, leading to the decline of its national power.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期齐国君主，与庄周同时代。
description.en: Ruler of the State of Qi during the Warring States period, a contemporary of Zhuang Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期名家代表人物，庄周的好友。
description.en: A representative of the School of Names during the Warring States period, a good friend of Zhuang Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期楚国君主，曾派人邀请庄子出任楚国宰相，但遭到拒绝。
description.en: Ruler of the State of Chu during the Warring States period, who once sent envoys to invite Zhuangzi to be the prime minister of Chu, but was rejected.

description.zh-cn: 道家经典，为庄周及其后学所著，后被唐玄宗封为《南华经》。
description.en: A classic text of Taoism, authored by Zhuang Zhou and his followers, later titled 'Nanhua Jing' by Emperor Xuanzong of Tang.

description.zh-cn: 法家是中国历史上提倡以法制国的思想学派，也是中国古代诸子百家之一。其思想起源于春秋战国时期，由韩非集大成，主张以“法”、“术”、“势”治国。庄子曾反对其以法律治国的主张。
description.en: Legalism is a school of thought in Chinese history that advocated for governing by law, and is also one of the Hundred Schools of Thought in ancient China. Its ideas originated during the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods, were synthesized by Han Fei, and advocated governing by 'law', 'technique', and 'power'. Its advocacy of rule by law was opposed by Zhuangzi.

description.zh-cn: 晋代学者，曾注释《庄子》，可能对现存版本进行过删减。
description.en: A scholar of the Jin Dynasty who commented on the Zhuangzi and may have abridged the extant version.

description.zh-cn: 华语电影女演员，拥有新加坡国籍。被誉为“第五代导演的电影缪斯”，是首位主演影片包揽欧洲三大影展最高奖的女演员，并曾担任多个国际A类电影节的评委会主席。
description.en: A Chinese-born Singaporean actress. Hailed as the 'muse of the Fifth Generation directors', she is the first actress to star in films that have won the top awards at all three major European film festivals and has served as the jury president for several Class-A international film festivals.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋与肖华的女儿，电影导演
description.en: Daughter of Zhang Yimou and Xiao Hua, film director

description.en: The opening ceremony of the 2008 Beijing Olympics

description.zh-cn: 2022年北京冬奥会的开幕式
description.en: The opening ceremony of the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics

description.en: Japanese actor

description.zh-cn: 中国电影制片人
description.en: Chinese film producer

description.zh-cn: 中国电影公司
description.en: Chinese film company

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一项基本国策，其主要内容为限制已婚夫妇的生育数量。
description.en: A basic national policy of the People's Republic of China, its main content being the limitation of the number of children for married couples.

description.zh-cn: 少将
开国少将

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总后勤部
中国人民解放军总后方勤务部
en: General Logistics Department of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总后勤部的前身之一，负责军队的后勤保障工作。其职能曾包括作为中央军事委员会的后勤工作机关。魏京生之父魏梓林和余秋里（曾任政治委员）等均曾在此任职。
description.en: A predecessor of the PLA General Logistics Department, this organization was responsible for the military's logistics support. Its functions historically included serving as a logistics work organ of the Central Military Commission. Individuals such as Wei Jingsheng's father, Wei Zilin, and Yu Qiuli (who served as Political Commissar) once worked here.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第一野战军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在解放战争时期的主力部队之一，余秋里曾在此任职。
description.en: One of the main forces of the People's Liberation Army during the Chinese Civil War, where Yu Qiuli held a position.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争和第二次国共内战期间的一支武装力量
陕西省的一个县
文化大革命结束后，以华国锋、汪东兴等人为代表的中共党内政治派别，坚持“两个凡是”原则，即“凡是毛主席作出的决策，我们都坚决维护；凡是毛主席的指示，我们都始终不渝地遵循”。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution, this political faction within the CCP, led by figures like Hua Guofeng and Wang Dongxing, adhered to the 'Two Whatevers' principle. They advocated: "We will resolutely uphold whatever policy decisions Chairman Mao made, and unswervingly follow whatever instructions Chairman Mao gave."

zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会办公厅警卫局
en: Central Guard Bureau of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 负责保卫党和国家主要领导人安全的机构，在中央军委联合参谋部内设机构中列出。
description.en: An agency responsible for the security of major party and state leaders, listed as an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张飞之妻，夏侯渊侄女。
中国东汉末年曹操麾下的重要将领。
description.en: An important general serving under Cao Cao during the late Eastern Han dynasty of China.

description.zh-cn: 张飞长子。
张飞次子。
东汉末年下邳相，被张飞所杀。
东汉末年刘璋麾下巴郡太守。
张飞帐下将领，后刺杀张飞。
张飞帐下将领，后刺杀张飞。
蜀汉官员。他曾看不起张飞，并与李严等人共同制定了《蜀科》。
description.en: An official of Shu Han. He once looked down upon Zhang Fei and co-authored the 'Code of Shu' with Li Yan and others.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期蜀汉名将。
张飞的出生地，位于今河北省涿州市。
张飞的逝世地，位于今四川省阆中市。
对勇将的赞誉性泛称。
description.en: An epithet for exceptionally valiant generals.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第一夫人。
description.en: First Lady of Malaysia.

zh-cn: 英皇爱德华七世医学院
en: King Edward VII College of Medicine

description.zh-cn: 新加坡国立大学的前身之一。
description.en: A predecessor of the National University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡国立大学是新加坡的第一所高等学府，一所世界级顶尖公立研究型大学。其历史悠久，可追溯至1928年成立的前身机构。1980年，该大学与南洋大学合并，形成现今的新加坡国立大学。知名校友包括邓亮洪。
description.en: The National University of Singapore is Singapore's first institution of higher learning and a world-class top public research university. Its rich history dates back to a predecessor institution founded in 1928. In 1980, it was formed through the merger with Nanyang University. Notable alumni include Tang Liang Hong.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的主要政党之一，国民阵线的核心成员，长期主张“马来人优先”政策。慕沙希淡于1971年重新加入该党并曾担任副主席。安华曾任该党署理主席，但在1998年被开除。2022年后，该党与安华领导的希望联盟组成联合政府，成为执政联盟成员。在新加坡处于马来西亚联邦期间，该党曾与人民行动党存在政治对立。
description.en: One of Malaysia's major political parties and a core member of the Barisan Nasional coalition, it has long advocated a "Malay pre-eminence" policy. Musa Hitam rejoined the party in 1971 and later served as deputy president. Anwar also served as its Deputy President but was expelled in 1998. After 2022, it formed a unity government with the Anwar-led Pakatan Harapan, becoming a member of the ruling coalition. During the period when Singapore was part of the Malaysian Federation, the party had a political rivalry with the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 由人民公正党、民主行动党、国家诚信党等组成的马来西亚政治联盟。安华为该联盟主席，并在2018年和2022年领导该联盟参与大选。该联盟在2018年大选中获胜，实现了马来西亚首次政党轮替。
description.en: A Malaysian political coalition comprising parties such as the People's Justice Party (PKR), the Democratic Action Party (DAP), and the National Trust Party (Amanah). Anwar serves as its chairman, leading the coalition in the 2018 and 2022 general elections. It won the 2018 general election, leading to Malaysia's first-ever change in government.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的一个政党联盟。它自1973年成立以来长期执政，直至2018年大选落败。慕沙希淡曾是其成员。
description.en: A political coalition in Malaysia. It was the long-ruling coalition from its inception in 1973 until its defeat in the 2018 general election. Musa Hitam was a member.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第二任首相，在五一三事件后推行了新经济政策，并接替东姑阿都拉曼成为巫统领导人。
description.en: The second Prime Minister of Malaysia, who implemented the New Economic Policy after the 13 May incident and succeeded Tunku Abdul Rahman as the leader of UMNO.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第八任首相，在2020年政治危机后上台。
description.en: The eighth Prime Minister of Malaysia, who came to power after the 2020 political crisis.

birth_place.zh-cn: 马来亚联邦槟城威南县双溪峇甲
birth_place.en: Sungai Bakap, South Seberang Perai, Penang, Malayan Union

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，现任马来西亚第10任首相兼财政部长。曾任副首相、多届部长及国会反对党领袖。他因与时任首相马哈迪的政治斗争而在1998年被革职，并引发了“烈火莫熄”改革运动。他曾两度因鸡奸案入狱，后在2018年获得特赦，并于2022年领导希望联盟在悬峙议会中组建联合政府，出任首相。
description.en: Malaysian politician, currently the 10th Prime Minister of Malaysia and Minister of Finance. He previously served as Deputy Prime Minister, various ministerial posts, and Leader of the Opposition. His dismissal in 1998 by then-Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad sparked the "Reformasi" movement. He was imprisoned twice on sodomy charges before receiving a royal pardon in 2018. In 2022, he led the Pakatan Harapan coalition to form a unity government after a hung parliament and became Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，安华·依布拉欣的妻子。在安华入狱期间，她创立并领导人民公正党，是烈火莫熄运动的核心人物，并曾担任马来西亚首位女性副首相。
description.en: Malaysian politician and the wife of Anwar Ibrahim. During Anwar's imprisonment, she founded and led the People's Justice Party (PKR), becoming a central figure in the Reformasi movement. She also served as Malaysia's first female Deputy Prime Minister.

birth_place.zh-cn: 新山, 柔佛, 马来联邦

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，曾担任马来西亚第五任副首相、马来西亚驻联合国代表及森那美主席。
description.en: A Malaysian politician who served as the 5th Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia, Malaysian Representative to the United Nations, and Chairman of Sime Darby.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，接替慕沙希淡担任马来西亚第六任副首相。
description.en: A Malaysian politician who succeeded Musa Hitam as the 6th Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The head of government position in Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政府的第二高职位，慕沙希淡于1981年至1986年担任此职务。
description.en: The second highest office in the Malaysian government, a position held by Musa Hitam from 1981 to 1986.

zh-cn: 马来西亚投资、贸易及工业部长
en: Minister of Investment, Trade and Industry (Malaysia)

description.zh-cn: 一个由120个发展中国家组成的论坛，它们在冷战期间不正式与任何主要大国集团结盟，也不反对任何主要大国集团。
description.en: A forum of 120 developing world states that are not formally aligned with or against any major power bloc.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第14届全国大选，导致了自独立以来首次的政党轮替。
description.en: The 14th Malaysian general election, which resulted in the first change of government since independence.

description.zh-cn: 始于2020年2月的一系列政治事件，包括马哈迪辞去首相职务以及阿兹敏阿里率领议员退出公正党，最终导致希望联盟政府垮台。此次危机使安华的首相之路再度受阻。
description.en: A series of political events starting in February 2020, including Mahathir's resignation as Prime Minister and the defection of MPs led by Azmin Ali, which resulted in the collapse of the Pakatan Harapan government. The crisis further delayed Anwar's path to the premiership.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗的生母，被追尊为皇太后。
description.en: The biological mother of Emperor Shizong, posthumously honored as Empress Dowager.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅，拥立明世宗继位，但在“大礼议”事件中与明世宗发生严重冲突并最终致仕。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty who supported Emperor Shizong's ascension to the throne, but had a major conflict with him during the 'Great Rites Controversy' and was eventually forced to retire.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅，在大礼议事件中支持明世宗
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty, supported the Jiajing Emperor during the Great Rites Controversy.

description.zh-cn: 明朝内阁首辅，在明世宗怠政期间专权二十年，以贪赃枉法、残害忠良而闻名。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty who held power for two decades during Emperor Shizong's neglect of state affairs, known for his corruption, abuse of power, and persecution of loyal officials.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，以刚直不阿著称，曾上《治安疏》直谏明世宗，险些被处死。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official known for his integrity and uprightness. He was famous for his direct admonishment of Emperor Shizong through the 'Memorial on Peace and Order', an act which nearly led to his execution.

description.zh-cn: 明朝著名将领，以抗击倭寇闻名。他曾与少林僧人研究武术，并尤其在福建平定倭寇。
description.en: A famous general of the Ming Dynasty, renowned for fighting against Wokou pirates. He collaborated with Shaolin monks to study martial arts, and notably suppressed Wokou in Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 明朝著名将领，与戚继光齐名，以抗击倭寇闻名。
description.en: A famous Ming Dynasty general, as renowned as Qi Jiguang, known for his fight against the Wokou pirates.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古土默特部首领。嘉靖年间多次寇边，并给予了第三世达赖喇嘛“达赖喇嘛”的尊号。
description.en: Leader of the Tümed Mongols. He frequently raided the Ming border during the Jiajing era and bestowed the title 'Dalai Lama' upon the 3rd Dalai Lama.

description.zh-cn: 明朝太医，在壬寅宫变后用“虎狼之药”救活了明世宗。
description.en: An imperial physician of the Ming Dynasty who revived Emperor Shizong with potent medicine after the Renyin Palace Incident.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖初年，明世宗为追尊其生父为皇帝而与杨廷和等朝臣发生的政治冲突，最终以明世宗的胜利告终，期间廷杖致死多名大臣。
description.en: A political conflict in the early Jiajing era between Emperor Shizong and court officials led by Yang Tinghe over posthumously honoring his biological father as emperor. It ended with the emperor's victory and resulted in the death of several ministers by caning.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖二十一年，由于明世宗暴虐，数名宫女试图将其缢杀的事件。明世宗虽幸免于难，但事后移居西苑，长期不上朝。
description.en: An event in the 21st year of the Jiajing era where several palace maids attempted to strangle the abusive Emperor Shizong. Although he survived, he moved to the West Park and ceased holding court for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗统治前期的改革与整顿时期
description.en: A period of reform and consolidation during the early reign of the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 发生于明朝嘉靖三十四年的一场特大地震，是中国历史上破坏力最强的地震之一，也是世界有历史纪录的地震中死亡人数最多的地震，据记载造成约83万人死亡。
description.en: A catastrophic earthquake that occurred in the 34th year of the Jiajing reign of the Ming dynasty. It is one of the most destructive earthquakes in Chinese history and the deadliest earthquake on record, reportedly causing the deaths of approximately 830,000 people.

description.zh-cn: 倭寇是指元末明初至16世纪，活跃于朝鲜、中国沿海及南洋的武装海商集团的泛称。这些集团从13世纪开始侵扰沿海地区。前期倭寇以日本人为主，后期（又称“假倭”）则以汉人为主，成员构成多元，亦包含朝鲜人、马来人、葡萄牙人等。少林僧人曾参与对抗倭寇的战斗。
description.en: Wokou refers to the general term for armed maritime merchant groups active along the coasts of Korea, China, and the South China Sea from the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties to the 16th century. These groups began raiding coastal areas in the 13th century. Early Wokou were predominantly Japanese, while later Wokou (also known as 'Jiawo' or 'fake Wokou') were mainly Han Chinese, with a diverse composition that also included Koreans, Malays, Portuguese, etc. Shaolin monks participated in battles against the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 明代湖广省地名，今湖北钟祥
description.en: A place in Huguang province during the Ming dynasty, now Zhongxiang, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 莫言和晏婴的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Mo Yan and Yan Ying.

description.zh-cn: 莫言的祖母
description.en: Mo Yan's paternal grandmother

zh-cn: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯

description.zh-cn: 一种文学流派
description.en: A literary genre

description.zh-cn: 一种文学风格
description.en: A literary style

zh-cn: 中国非物质文化遗产保护中心
en: China Intangible Cultural Heritage Protection Center

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家级的艺术科研、创作和教育机构，同时负责中国非物质文化遗产的保护工作。
description.en: A national-level institution in the People's Republic of China for artistic research, creation, and education, also responsible for the protection of China's intangible cultural heritage.

description.zh-cn: 日本小说家，1968年诺贝尔文学奖得主，毕业于东京帝国大学。
description.en: A Japanese novelist, winner of the 1968 Nobel Prize in Literature, who graduated from Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 中国记者，《环球时报》前主编。他曾对《治安管理处罚法》2023年修订草案中关于“伤害中华民族感情”的条款提出批评，认为应进行细化。
description.en: Chinese journalist and former editor-in-chief of the Global Times. He criticized the clause about 'hurting the feelings of the Chinese nation' in the 2023 draft amendment to the 'Public Security Administration Punishments Law', suggesting it should be more specific.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军的航空作战部门，钱学森曾在此被授予上校军衔。
description.en: The aerial warfare service component of the United States Army, where Qian Xuesen was granted the rank of Colonel.

description.zh-cn: 负责美国联邦执法的部门，对阿桑奇提起诉讼并最终达成认罪协议。
description.en: The US federal executive department responsible for the enforcement of federal law, which prosecuted Assange and eventually reached a plea deal.

description.zh-cn: 中国空气动力学家，两弹一星元勋，与钱学森共同创建中国科学院力学研究所。
description.en: Chinese aerodynamicist, a key contributor to China's 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' project, and co-founder of the Institute of Mechanics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences with Qian Xuesen.

description.zh-cn: 一份美国国会报告，声称中华人民共和国从美国窃取了核武器技术。张纯如曾公开反驳其中的错误。
description.en: A U.S. congressional report that alleged the People's Republic of China had stolen nuclear weapons technology from the United States. Iris Chang publicly rebutted errors within it.

death_place.zh-cn: 加利福尼亚州洛思加图斯

description.zh-cn: 美籍华裔历史学家、社会活动家、作家，以其关于南京大屠杀的著作《南京暴行：被遗忘的大屠杀》而闻名。
description.en: A Chinese-American historian, activist, and author, best known for her book 'The Rape of Nanking: The Forgotten Holocaust of World War II'.

description.zh-cn: 俞大维之子，蒋孝章的丈夫。曾代妻回台湾参与蒋方良的治丧事宜。
description.en: Son of Yu Dawei, husband of Chiang Hsiao-chang. He once returned to Taiwan on behalf of his wife to attend Jiang Fangliang's funeral affairs.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国与蒋方良的次子，蒋孝章之弟。曾任中华民国驻新加坡及日本代表。因江南案被外放，后于预定接任华视董事长前一日猝逝。
description.en: The second son of Chiang Ching-kuo and Faina Vakhreva (Chiang Fang-liang), and younger brother of Chiang Hsiao-chang. He served as the Republic of China's representative to Singapore and Japan, was posted abroad following the Henry Liu case, and died suddenly the day before he was scheduled to take over as chairman of CTS.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国三子，蒋孝武的弟弟。
description.en: Third son of Chiang Ching-kuo, younger brother of Chiang Hsiao-wu.

zh-cn: 台北市立第一女子高级中学

description.zh-cn: 蒋肇聪之父。
王采玉之父。
宋高宗唯一的亲生儿子，在苗刘兵变中被拥立为帝，但不久后因受惊吓而夭折。
description.en: Emperor Gaozong's only biological son. He was briefly enthroned during the Miao-Liu Mutiny but died shortly after from fright.

description.zh-cn: 南宋初年宰相，坚决主张抗金的主战派代表人物，后因受主和派排挤而被罢免。
description.en: A chancellor in the early Southern Song dynasty, a prominent representative of the pro-war faction who strongly advocated for resisting the Jin invasion, but was later dismissed due to being sidelined by the pro-peace faction.

description.zh-cn: 南宋初年宰相、将领，主张抗金。在平定苗刘兵变时与韩世忠合作，后因与秦桧不和而被罢免。
description.en: A chancellor and general in the early Southern Song dynasty who advocated for resistance against the Jin. He collaborated with Han Shizhong in suppressing the Miao-Liu Mutiny, but was later dismissed due to conflicts with Qin Hui.

description.zh-cn: 金朝著名将领、宗室，金朝对南宋战争的主要指挥官，多次率军侵宋。他曾在黄天荡之战中被韩世忠以少数兵力围困，并在绍兴和议中坚持要求处死岳飞。
description.en: A prominent Jurchen general and imperial prince of the Jin dynasty, and a chief commander in the wars against the Southern Song, leading multiple invasions. He was besieged by Han Shizhong's smaller force during the Battle of Huangtiandang and insisted on Yue Fei's execution as a precondition for the Shaoxing Treaty.

description.zh-cn: 南宋初年，禁军将领苗傅和刘正彦发动兵变，一度迫使宋高宗退位，并拥立其年幼的儿子赵旉为帝。此次兵变后被韩世忠、张浚等人平定。
description.en: In the early Southern Song dynasty, imperial guard commanders Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan initiated a mutiny, briefly forcing Emperor Gaozong to abdicate and enthroning his infant son Zhao Fu. The mutiny was later suppressed by Han Shizhong, Zhang Jun, and others.

en: List of emperors of the Song dynasty

description.zh-cn: 宋朝的君主职位。
今河南省开封市。曾先后作为后梁和北宋的都城。后梁时期，朱温在此称帝并最终被杀。北宋时期，作为京畿行政区，其府尹一职常由亲王或储君担任，地位显赫。
description.en: Now Kaifeng City, Henan Province. It served as the capital for both the Later Liang and Northern Song dynasties. During the Later Liang period, Zhu Wen proclaimed himself emperor here and was eventually killed. In the Northern Song Dynasty, as the capital prefecture, the position of its governor (Yin) was often held by princes or the crown prince, indicating its high status.

description.zh-cn: 南宋首都，今浙江省杭州市。
宋高宗登基之地，今河南省商丘市。
宋高宗的妃嫔，皇子赵旉的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Gaozong and the birth mother of Prince Zhao Fu.

zh-cn: 加利福尼亚多明尼克大学

description.zh-cn: 台湾独派政党。
description.en: A pro-independence political party in Taiwan.

en: Human Rights Promotion Committee of the Legislative Yuan

description.zh-cn: 中华民国立法院下设的委员会。
description.en: A committee under the Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，由支联会发起，旨在营救被中国政府通缉的中国大陆民主运动人士的秘密行动。
description.en: A clandestine operation initiated by the Hong Kong Alliance to rescue mainland Chinese pro-democracy activists wanted by the Chinese government after the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 一个由六四事件后流亡海外的民运人士创建的政治组织。
description.en: A political organization founded by pro-democracy activists exiled after the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治学家、社会活动家，曾与李泽厚一同参与六四事件期间的呼吁。
description.en: A Chinese political scientist and social activist who joined Li Zehou in an appeal during the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台中市市长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former mayor of Taichung.

en: Public Security Police Force of Macau

description.zh-cn: 负责香港出入境管制的纪律部队。
description.en: The disciplinary service responsible for immigration control in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 江绵恒的儿子，博裕资本创办人。

zh-cn: 中国科学院半导体研究所
en: Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh-cn: 中国科学院上海微系统与信息技术研究所
en: Shanghai Institute of Metallurgy, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的第一次载人航天飞行任务，由航天员杨利伟执行。张庆伟作为中国载人航天工程副总指挥负责统筹其发射任务。该任务的成功标志着中国成为世界上第三个独立掌握载人航天技术的国家。
description.en: The first human spaceflight mission of the People's Republic of China, conducted by astronaut Yang Liwei. Zhang Qingwei, as Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the China Manned Space Program, was responsible for coordinating its launch. Its success marked China as the third country in the world to independently possess human spaceflight technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国的月球探测计划，香港理工大学参与研发了该计划所使用的太空仪器。
description.en: China's lunar exploration program, for which The Hong Kong Polytechnic University participated in developing space instruments.

en: Shanghai Branch, Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 美国跨国投资银行与金融服务公司，曾因温云松身份敏感而拒绝其求职申请。
description.en: An American multinational investment bank and financial services company that once rejected Wen Yunsong's job application due to his sensitive background.

en: Takming University of Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，台北市议员。
中华民国政治人物，台北市议员。
中华民国政治人物，曾任台北市政府观光传播局局长。
中华民国政治人物。
中华民国政治人物，时任台南市市长。
中华人民共和国湖北省的省级国家行政机关。
description.en: The provincial-level state administrative organ of Hubei Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 忠诚不绝对就是绝对不忠诚

description.zh-cn: 李鸿忠提出的政治论述，用以表达对习近平的绝对忠诚。
日本的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The head of government position in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 指19世纪末日本长州藩私自派遣到英国留学的五位藩士。
description.en: Refers to five samurai from the Chōshū Domain of western Japan who were secretly dispatched to study in Great Britain in the late 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 日本在大韩帝国设立的统治机构。
description.en: A governing body established by Japan in the Korean Empire.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代末期思想家吉田松阴主持的私塾。
description.en: A private school run by the thinker Yoshida Shōin during the late Edo period in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的思想家、教育家、兵学者，长州藩士。木户孝允的老师。
description.en: A Japanese thinker, educator, and military strategist of the Bakumatsu period from the Chōshū Domain. He was Kido Takayoshi's teacher.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期长州藩的武士与尊王攘夷志士。
description.en: A samurai from the Chōshū Domain and a loyalist activist during the Bakumatsu period in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时代的政治家、企业家，长州五杰之一。
description.en: A statesman and entrepreneur of the Meiji era in Japan, one of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末至明治初期的武士、政治家，位阶勋等为赠从一位勋一等。他是尊王攘夷派中心人物，与西乡隆盛、大久保利通并称为“维新三杰”，在明治政府中扮演了关键角色。曾作为岩仓使节团成员，归国后反对征韩论。
description.en: A Japanese samurai and statesman active from the late Bakumatsu period to the early Meiji era, posthumously awarded the rank of Senior First Rank and Grand Cordon of the Order of the Rising Sun. A central figure in the Sonnō jōi movement, he is known as one of the 'Three Great Nobles of the Restoration' along with Saigō Takamori and Ōkubo Toshimichi, playing a key role in the Meiji government. He was also a member of the Iwakura Mission, and upon his return, he opposed the Seikanron.

birth_place.zh-cn: 日本萨摩藩鹿儿岛城下

description.zh-cn: 日本武士、明治维新时期的政治家，与西乡隆盛及木户孝允并称维新三杰，也是明治政府的核心领导人。曾任明治政府内务卿。他曾是岩仓使节团成员，归国后反对征韩论。作为全权大臣前往清朝进行交涉，最终签订了《北京专约》。
description.en: A Japanese samurai and statesman of the Meiji Restoration period, one of the Three Great Nobles of the Restoration, and a core leader of the Meiji government. He also served as the Home Minister of the Meiji government. He was a member of the Iwakura Mission, opposing the Seikanron upon his return, and acted as a plenipotentiary ambassador to the Qing court for negotiations, signing the Peking Agreement.

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·科科夫佐夫

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国财政大臣。
description.en: Finance Minister of the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 李斯的出生地，位于今河南省。
秦朝首都，李斯的逝世地点。
战国时期儒家代表人物、大师，韩非与李斯的老师。他提倡性恶论，其学生韩非和李斯后来成为法家重要人物。
description.en: A Confucian master and representative during the Warring States period, and the teacher of Han Fei and Li Si. He advocated the theory of evil human nature, with his students Han Fei and Li Si later becoming important figures in Legalism.

en: Six states east of the mountain

description.zh-cn: 战国末期秦国东方的六个主要诸侯国。
李斯为劝谏秦王政取消驱逐客卿的命令而作。
秦朝官职，掌管司法。
战国末期，秦国为统一中国，发动一系列旨在消灭其他六个主要诸侯国的战争，陆续兼并韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐六国。郑国渠的修建为秦国提供了强大的经济和后勤支持。
description.en: In the late Warring States period, the State of Qin launched a series of wars aimed at eliminating the other six major states and unifying China, successively annexing Han, Zhao, Wei, Chu, Yan, and Qi. The construction of the Zheng Guo Canal provided strong economic and logistical support for Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝丞相，主张实行分封制。
中央集权的行政区划制度。
封建制度是一种将土地和人民分封给王室成员和功臣的政治制度。在日本江户时代，亦存在等级森严的社会制度，福泽谕吉对此持批判和反对态度。
description.en: Feudalism is a political system where land and people are granted to royal family members and meritorious officials. In Japan's Edo period, a rigid hierarchical social system also existed, which was criticized and opposed by Fukuzawa Yukichi.

description.zh-cn: 齐人，秦朝博士，主张实行分封制。
李斯长子，三川郡守。
秦朝时期的郡，李由曾任该郡郡守。
台湾艺人
中华民国政治人物

zh-cn: 健康幼稚园火烧车事件

description.zh-cn: 前促进转型正义委员会副主委

zh-cn: 内政部警政署刑事警察局

description.zh-cn: 现任新北市副市长

zh-cn: 2022年中华民国直辖市长及县市长选举

description.zh-cn: 韩国宰相，历相韩釐王与韩桓惠王两代，为张开地之子、张良之父。
description.en: Chancellor of the State of Han, serving two generations of monarchs: King Xi and King Huanhui. He was the son of Zhang Kaidi and the father of Zhang Liang.

description.zh-cn: 韩国宰相，历相韩昭侯、韩宣惠王与韩襄王三代，为张良的祖父。
description.en: Chancellor of the State of Han, serving three generations of monarchs: Marquis Zhao, King Xuanhui, and King Xiang. He was the grandfather of Zhang Liang.

description.zh-cn: 张良长子。
西汉，作为汉朝的前半期，是中国历史上继秦朝之后的一个大一统王朝，与东汉合称两汉。由汉高祖刘邦建立，历经210年。其间，巫蛊之祸是王朝由盛转衰的转折点之一，李延年及其家族在此期间经历了兴衰，最终被王莽篡位所取代。
description.en: The Western Han Dynasty, the earlier period of the Han Dynasty, was a unified dynasty in Chinese history that succeeded the Qin Dynasty. It is collectively known as the Han dynasty along with the Eastern Han. Founded by Emperor Gaozu Liu Bang, it lasted for 210 years. During this period, the Witchcraft Delusion marked one of its turning points from prosperity to decline, and the Li family, including Li Yannian, experienced their rise and fall. The dynasty was ultimately usurped by Wang Mang.

description.zh-cn: 秦末汉初的隐士，传说曾授予张良兵书。
古代兵书，相传为黄石公授予张良。
战国时期韩国公子，后被项梁立为韩王。
刘邦的谋士。
秦末汉初的四位著名隐士：东园公、甪里先生、绮里季、夏黄公。应太子刘盈之请，出山辅佐，帮助其稳固了太子地位。
description.en: Four famous hermits of the late Qin and early Han dynasties: Dongyuan Gong, Luli Xiansheng, Qili Ji, and Xia Huang Gong. At the request of Crown Prince Liu Ying, they came out of seclusion to support him, helping to solidify his status.

description.zh-cn: 东汉第十二位皇帝。
东汉末年外戚，官至大将军。为铲除宦官势力，征召董卓等地方将领率兵入京，但计划泄露，反被宦官所杀，其举动间接导致了董卓乱政。
description.en: A relative of the empress and General-in-Chief during the late Eastern Han dynasty. To eliminate the influence of the eunuchs, he summoned regional warlords, including Dong Zhuo, to the capital with their armies. His plan was leaked, and he was assassinated by the eunuchs, an act that indirectly led to Dong Zhuo's rise to power.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年操纵朝政的十二位宦官。
东汉第十三位皇帝，汉灵帝之子。即位后不久，被入京的董卓废为弘农王，后遭董卓毒杀。
description.en: The 13th emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty, son of Emperor Ling. Shortly after his accession, he was deposed by Dong Zhuo, who had entered the capital, and demoted to the Prince of Hongnong. He was later poisoned to death by Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 董卓的谋士，官至博士。曾任弘农王刘辩的郎中令，并奉董卓之命毒杀了刘辩。
description.en: An advisor to Dong Zhuo who held the rank of Erudite. He served as the Prefect of the Gentlemen of the Household to Liu Bian, the Prince of Hongnong, and poisoned him under Dong Zhuo's orders.

description.zh-cn: 董卓部将。董卓死后受王允派遣迎击李傕，兵败战死。他曾于荥阳击败曹操。
description.en: A general under Dong Zhuo. After Dong Zhuo's death, he was dispatched by Wang Yun to intercept Li Jue but was defeated and killed in battle. He once defeated Cao Cao at Xingyang.

description.zh-cn: 董卓之弟。
东汉末年董卓的女婿。他曾派遣李傕与朱俊交战。
description.en: Son-in-law of Dong Zhuo during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He once dispatched Li Jue to fight against Zhu Jun.

description.zh-cn: 董卓的部将，为孙坚所杀。
唐高祖李渊长子，原皇太子
隋朝第二位皇帝，隋文帝杨坚次子。他废黜兄长杨勇后继承皇位。在位期间，下令营建东都洛阳（始于605年），并兴建大运河（开凿永济渠），东征高句丽，还将幽州改名为涿郡。这些举措最终引发隋末民变。
description.en: The second emperor of the Sui dynasty and second son of Emperor Wen Yang Jian. He succeeded to the throne after deposing his elder brother Yang Yong. During his reign, he ordered the construction of the eastern capital Luoyang (starting in 605), oversaw the construction of the Grand Canal (including the Yongji Canal), launched eastern expeditions against Goguryeo, and renamed You Province to Zhuo Commandery. These actions ultimately led to widespread rebellions at the end of the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚的皇后，北周八大柱国之一独孤信之女，也是李渊的姨母。她深度参与政治决策。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Wen of Sui (Yang Jian), daughter of Dugu Xin, one of the Eight Pillar Generals of Northern Zhou, and aunt of Li Yuan. She was deeply involved in political decision-making.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝的开国皇帝，统一了分裂长达近三百年的中国，开创了开皇之治。他在位期间进行了一系列改革，包括创立五省六部制和科举制度。他还恢复了少林寺并赐予土地，使其发展壮大。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Sui dynasty, who reunified China after nearly three centuries of division and initiated the Kaihuang Era of prosperity. During his reign, he implemented a series of reforms, including the establishment of the Five Departments and Six Ministries system and the imperial examination system. He also restored the Shaolin Temple and granted it land, contributing to its growth.

description.zh-cn: 唐高祖李渊之母
唐高祖李渊之父
隋朝太原郡丞
隋朝武牙郎将
突厥可汗
位于蒙古高原的古代游牧帝国
隋朝将领，在江都发动兵变，弑杀隋炀帝，后自立为帝，国号许。
description.en: A Sui dynasty general who launched a coup in Jiangdu, assassinated Emperor Yang, and later declared himself emperor of the state of Xu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝为消灭隋末割据势力、统一全国而进行的一系列战争
西魏八大柱国之一
中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国国家安全部部长。
中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国国家安全部部长。
中共中央纪委和中华人民共和国国家监察委员会的直属事业单位。
description.en: An institution directly under the CCDI and the National Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学界、法律界的全国性群众性学术团体，是中国共产党领导下的人民团体。佘孟孝曾任常务副会长、党组书记，罗豪才也曾任副会长。
description.en: A national mass and academic organization for China's legal and academic circles, it is a people's organization under the leadership of the Communist Party of China. She Mengxiao served as its executive vice president and party group secretary, and Luo Haocai also served as vice president.

description.zh-cn: 由菩提达摩传入中国的大乘佛教宗派。
中国禅宗二祖，是菩提达摩的弟子，从其处继承了禅法。
description.en: The Second Patriarch of Chan Buddhism in China, a disciple of Bodhidharma, from whom he inherited the Dharma.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩的弟子，据传记录了达摩的言行。
description.en: A disciple of Bodhidharma, said to have recorded his teachings.

zh-cn: 菩提达磨大师略辨大乘入道四行观

description.zh-cn: 相传为达摩口述，昙林记录的禅宗理论著作。
菩提达摩的逝世地。
菩提达摩的出生地之一。
根据《洛阳伽蓝记》记载，菩提达摩来自波斯。
中国南北朝时期的南朝第三个朝代，由梁武帝萧衍建立。
description.en: The third of the Southern Dynasties in China during the Northern and Southern dynasties period, founded by Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教经典，早期禅宗（楞伽宗）所依持的重要经典。
早期禅宗的一个流派，因重视《楞伽经》而得名。
唐朝禅宗高僧，被后世尊为北宗禅的创始人。
位于广州的千年古刹，相传为达摩所建。
广州的古寺，内有达摩“洗钵泉”遗迹。
中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任武汉市市长、成都市市长、中共成都市委书记、中共重庆市委副书记、重庆市人民政府市长。现任安徽省政协主席、党组书记。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, he has served as Mayor of Wuhan, Mayor of Chengdu, Secretary of the CPC Chengdu Municipal Committee, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee, and Mayor of the Chongqing Municipal People's Government. He is currently the Chairman and Party Group Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，夏宝龙担任浙江省省长时的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, predecessor to Xia Baolong as Governor of Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国浙江省绍兴市下辖的县级市。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province, China.

zh-cn: 贵州省人民代表大会常务委员会
第十三届全国人民代表大会代表名单
第十三届全国人大代表
en: List of deputies to the 13th National People's Congress
Deputy to the 13th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第十三届全国人民代表大会的代表，是最高国家权力机关的组成人员。
description.en: Deputies to the 13th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, who are members of the highest organ of state power.

en: Office of the Chairman of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 为中央军事委员会主席服务的办事机构。

zh-cn: 中共中央办公厅调研室
en: Research Department of the General Office of the Chinese Communist Party
Research Office of the General Office of the CCP Central Committee

zh-cn: 中央军事委员会改革和编制办公室
中央军委改革和编制办公室
en: Office for Reform and Organizational Structure
Office for Reform and Organizational Structure of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，现任中央军委办公厅主任。
中国人民解放军中将，曾任中央警卫局局长、中央军委主席办公室主任。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军中将
中国人民解放军空军中将
en: People's Liberation Army Air Force Lieutenant General

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军现行军衔制度中的主要军衔之一，适用于副大军区职（副战区级）、正军职、副军职军官，包括空军在内的各军兵种均设此衔。
description.en: One of the primary military ranks in the current rank system of the People's Liberation Army, applicable to officers at the deputy theater command level, corps leader level, and deputy corps leader level. This rank is established in all services and branches, including the Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领。曾任山西省革命委员会主任、山西省委第一书记。他与陈永贵存在政治斗争，曾试图攻击陈的历史问题，但因毛泽东支持陈而未果。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as Director of the Shanxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee and First Secretary of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee. He had political conflicts with Chen Yonggui and attempted to attack him based on Chen's historical issues, but failed due to Mao Zedong's support for Chen.

description.zh-cn: 大寨大队原党支部书记，陈永贵的前任。
柬埔寨共产党（红色高棉）总书记，民主柬埔寨最高领导人。他曾访问大寨，并接待了回访柬埔寨的陈永贵。
description.en: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Kampuchea (Khmer Rouge) and the paramount leader of Democratic Kampuchea. He visited Dazhai and hosted Chen Yonggui during his return visit to Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间山西省的权力机构，陈永贵曾担任副主任。
description.en: The power organ of Shanxi Province during the Cultural Revolution, where Chen Yonggui served as Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，日本当局在占领区建立的组织，旨在促进亚洲团结和发展。
description.en: A Japanese organization established by authorities in occupied territories during the Anti-Japanese War, aimed at promoting Asian unity and development.

description.zh-cn: 位于山西省昔阳县的村庄，在毛泽东时代作为“农业学大寨”运动的全国典型。
一项由毛泽东发起的政治运动，号召全国农村学习山西省昔阳县大寨村的生产模式和奋斗精神。陈永贵是该运动的核心人物。
description.en: A political movement initiated by Mao Zedong, calling on all rural areas in China to learn from the production model and struggling spirit of Dazhai Village in Xiyang County, Shanxi Province. Chen Yonggui was the central figure of this movement.

description.zh-cn: 文革时期的一项极左政策，旨在取消农民的自留地和家庭副业。
段祺瑞和范瑾的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Duan Qirui and Fan Jin.

description.zh-cn: 王安石的母亲，抚州金溪人，王益的续弦。
description.en: Mother of Wang Anshi, from Jinxi, Fuzhou, and the second wife of Wang Yi.

description.zh-cn: 清末由李鸿章在天津创办的军事院校，是中国近代第一所陆军军官学校。
description.en: A military academy founded in Tianjin by Li Hongzhang during the late Qing dynasty, it was the first modern army officer school in China.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士王国及后来的德意志帝国的总参谋部军事学院，是19世纪末德国重要的军事教育机构。
description.en: The military staff college of the Prussian Army and later the German Imperial Army, a significant military educational institution in Germany during the late 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀与皖系军阀之间为争夺北京政府统治权而爆发的战争。
description.en: A war fought between the Zhili and Anhui cliques for control of the Beiyang government.

zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府 (段祺瑞)

description.zh-cn: 1924年甲子政变后，由段祺瑞在北京成立的政府，段祺瑞任“临时执政”。
description.en: The government established in Beijing by Duan Qirui after the 1924 Beijing Coup, in which he served as the 'Provisional Chief Executive'.

description.zh-cn: 1926年3月18日，北京学生和市民在抗议八国最后通牒的请愿游行中，遭段祺瑞执政府卫队开枪镇压，造成大量伤亡。
description.en: On March 18, 1926, Beijing students and citizens, during a petitioning protest against the Eight-Nation Ultimatum, were fired upon and suppressed by guards of Duan Qirui's government, resulting in numerous casualties.

description.zh-cn: 由段祺瑞等四十六名北洋军将领联名发出，要求清帝退位、实行共和的电报。
description.en: A telegram jointly issued by 46 Beiyang Army generals led by Duan Qirui, demanding the abdication of the Qing emperor and the establishment of a republic.

description.zh-cn: 他是北洋皖系军阀的骨干人物，段祺瑞的得力干将、主要谋士和心腹。曾任奉军副司令。据称，他曾代表段祺瑞假意同意张勋复辟，以借机推翻黎元洪。后因与杨宇霆关系亲近而引起张作霖不满。
description.en: He was a core figure in the Beiyang Anhui warlord clique, serving as Duan Qirui's chief subordinate, principal strategist, and confidant. He also served as a deputy commander of the Fengtian Army. It is said that he, on behalf of Duan Qirui, pretended to agree to Zhang Xun's restoration in order to use the opportunity to overthrow Li Yuanhong. Later, his close relationship with Yang Yuting caused dissatisfaction from Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 皖系军阀为操控国会选举而成立的政治团体，因在北京安福胡同开会而得名。
description.en: A political organization formed by the Anhui clique to manipulate parliamentary elections, named after its meeting place on Anfu Hutong in Beijing.

en: Premier of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期的政府首脑，为中华民国国务院的首长。1914年至1916年间曾被袁世凯改设为“国务卿”。1928年6月国民政府统一中国后，该职位被行政院院长取代。
description.en: The head of government during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, leading the State Council. The title was changed to 'Secretary of State' (国务卿) by Yuan Shikai between 1914 and 1916. After the nominal unification of China by the Nationalist Government in June 1928, the position was replaced by the President of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 2013年9月发生在中华民国的政治事件，涉及总统马英九与立法院长王金平之间的权力斗争。
description.en: A political incident in Taiwan in September 2013, involving a power struggle between President Ma Ying-jeou and Legislative Yuan President Wang Jin-pyng.

en: Special Investigation Division of the Supreme Prosecutors Office
zh-cn: 最高法院检察署特别侦查组

description.zh-cn: 中华民国最高法院检察署内设立的特别检察官机构，负责侦办总统、副总统及五院院长等层级的贪渎与重大经济犯罪。
description.en: A special prosecutor's office established within the Supreme Prosecutors Office of the Republic of China, responsible for investigating corruption and major economic crimes involving high-level officials such as the President, Vice President, and heads of the five Yuans.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，民主进步党籍，现任立法委员，并担任民主进步党立法院党团总召集人。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, a member of the Democratic Progressive Party, a current member of the Legislative Yuan, and convener of the Democratic Progressive Party caucus in the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任法务部部长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国检察官，曾任台湾高等法院检察署检察长。
description.en: A prosecutor in the Republic of China who served as the Head Prosecutor of the Taiwan High Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任立法院秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Secretary-General of the Legislative Yuan.

en: National Tainan First Senior High School
zh-cn: 国立台南第一高级中学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台南市的著名高级中学。
description.en: A renowned senior high school located in Tainan, Taiwan.

location.zh-cn: 日治台湾高雄州冈山郡
location.en: Okayama District, Takao Prefecture, Japanese Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾高雄州冈山郡的一个行政区，今高雄市路竹区。
description.en: An administrative division of Okayama District, Takao Prefecture during the Japanese rule of Taiwan, now Luzhu District, Kaohsiung City.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝诗人，白居易的挚友，二人并称“元白”，共同倡导新乐府运动。
description.en: A Tang dynasty poet and a close friend of Bai Juyi. They were collectively known as 'Yuan Bai' and jointly advocated for the New Yuefu Movement.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝文学家、哲学家、诗人，白居易晚年在洛阳的挚友。二人唱和甚多，被时人并称为“刘白”。
description.en: A Tang dynasty writer, philosopher, and poet, and a close friend of Bai Juyi in his later years in Luoyang. They often exchanged poems and were known as 'Liu Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第十一位皇帝。白居易因直言进谏曾令其不快，后将白居易贬为江州司马。
description.en: The 11th emperor of the Tang dynasty. He was displeased by Bai Juyi's direct remonstrations and later demoted him to the position of Sima of Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝第十六位皇帝，曾褒奖白居易为“诗仙”。
description.en: The 16th emperor of the Tang dynasty, who praised Bai Juyi as the 'Poet Immortal'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代诗人、名士。在白居易初到长安时，他因欣赏其诗才而大加赞赏，并为之延誉，使其声名大振。
description.en: A Tang dynasty poet and famous scholar. Upon Bai Juyi's initial arrival in Chang'an, he greatly admired his poetic talent and helped promote his reputation, making him widely known.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相，曾在唐宪宗面前为白居易的直言敢谏辩护。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang dynasty who defended Bai Juyi's outspokenness to Emperor Xianzong.

description.zh-cn: 唐代文学家，白居易的弟弟。
description.en: A Tang dynasty writer, and the younger brother of Bai Juyi.

description.zh-cn: 由白居易、元稹等人倡导的唐代诗歌革新运动，主张“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”，强调诗歌的社会功能、现实意义和讽谕作用。
description.en: A poetic reform movement in the Tang dynasty advocated by Bai Juyi, Yuan Zhen, and others. It promoted the idea that 'prose should be written for the times, and poetry for current events,' emphasizing the social function, realistic significance, and satirical function of poetry.

description.zh-cn: 河南省，中国的一个省份。它是唐代诗人白居易的出生地。历史上，战国时期韩国的都城亦位于此地（今新郑市）。
description.en: Henan Province, a province in China. It is the birthplace of the Tang dynasty poet Bai Juyi. Historically, the capital of the State of Han during the Warring States period was also located here (present-day Xinzheng City).

description.zh-cn: 白居易创作的著名长篇叙事诗，记叙了作者在被贬谪江州途中与一位琵琶女的相遇。
description.en: A famous long narrative poem by Bai Juyi, recounting his encounter with a pipa player while he was demoted and on his way to Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 白居易的个人诗文集，由其本人编辑，好友元稹作序。元稹亦在其离任杭州时协助收集编纂而成。
description.en: Bai Juyi's personal collection of poems and writings, edited by himself, with a preface by his friend Yuan Zhen. Yuan Zhen also assisted in collecting and compiling it when Bai Juyi left his post in Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 古龙与郑月霞的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Gu Long and Zheng Yuexia.

description.zh-cn: 台湾演员。1980年，在北投吟松阁因敬酒纠纷引发了吟松阁事件，其友人刺伤古龙，导致古龙健康状况急剧恶化。
description.en: A Taiwanese actor. In 1980, a dispute over a toast at the Yinsong Pavilion in Beitou led to the Yinsong Pavilion Incident, where his associates stabbed Gu Long, causing a severe decline in Gu Long's health.

description.zh-cn: 台湾知名黑社会组织，传闻古龙在离家出走后曾短暂加入。
description.en: A well-known triad in Taiwan, which Gu Long was rumored to have briefly joined after running away from home.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一家主要报纸，曾是《自由时报》的主要竞争对手。它曾连载古龙的小说《天涯‧明月‧刀》，但因理念前卫而中途停止刊载。
description.en: A major newspaper in Taiwan, formerly a main competitor of the Liberty Times. It serialized Gu Long's novel 'Tianya, Mingyue, Dao' but prematurely ended its publication due to its avant-garde concepts.

description.zh-cn: 古龙的武侠小说，因理念较为前卫，在《中国时报》连载时被腰斩。
description.en: A wuxia novel by Gu Long. Its serialization in the China Times was prematurely ended due to its avant-garde concepts.

description.zh-cn: 古龙的武侠小说，创作上向日本时代小说《宫本武藏》取经，探索武道。
description.en: A wuxia novel by Gu Long, which drew inspiration from the Japanese historical novel 'Miyamoto Musashi' to explore the way of martial arts.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军成员，曾参加长征，是王健林的父亲，也是王思聪的祖父。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army who participated in the Long March, and is the father of Wang Jianlin and the paternal grandfather of Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 中国商人和社交媒体名人，王健林之子。
description.en: Chinese businessman and social media personality, son of Wang Jianlin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省已撤销的专区。
description.en: A former administrative division in Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第七综合训练基地
中国人民解放军大连陆军学院

description.zh-cn: 曾位于中国辽宁省大连市的一所军事院校。
description.en: A former military academy located in Dalian, Liaoning, China.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国的连锁电影院，曾为全球最大的连锁影院。
description.en: An American movie theater chain, formerly the largest in the world.

description.zh-cn: 大连万达集团旗下的文化产业公司。
description.en: The cultural industry subsidiary of Dalian Wanda Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一家房地产开发公司。
description.en: A real estate developer in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一家房地产开发公司。
description.en: A real estate developer in China.

zh-cn: 大连万达实德足球俱乐部队

description.zh-cn: 由王健林成立的足球俱乐部，后被实德集团收购。
description.en: A football club founded by Wang Jianlin, later acquired by Shide Group.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的足球运动管理机构。
description.en: The governing body for football in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝妃嫔，允禩的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Kangxi Emperor and the biological mother of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 允禩的嫡福晋，安亲王岳乐的外孙女。
description.en: The primary consort of Yinsi, granddaughter of Prince An Yue Le.

description.zh-cn: 允禩之子，曾被雍正帝改名为菩萨保。
description.en: Son of Yinsi, his name was once changed to Pusabao by the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室爵位，低于亲王、郡王，高于贝子。
description.en: A noble title for imperial clansmen in the Qing dynasty, ranking below a Prince and a Junwang, but above a Beizi.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙、雍正、乾隆三朝重臣。
description.en: An influential minister during the Kangxi, Yongzheng, and Qianlong reigns of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝掌管蒙古、西藏等少数民族及边疆事务的中央机构，也曾兼管雍和宫的具体事务。
description.en: The central government agency of the Qing Dynasty responsible for managing affairs of ethnic minorities such as the Mongols and Tibetans, and frontier affairs. It also oversaw the specific affairs of the Yonghe Temple.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官署，六部之一，掌管全国屯田、水利、土木、工程、交通、官办工业等。
description.en: One of the six ministries in ancient Chinese government, in charge of public works, water conservancy, construction, transportation, and state-run industries.

description.zh-cn: 宗人府是中国明清时期管理皇家宗室事务的机构，负责宗族名册、记录宗室成员信息并处理其请求、奖惩事宜。在越南阮朝，亦设有类似的宗室管理机构，其职能与中国宗人府相近，曾为避绍治帝名讳而改名。
description.en: Zongrenfu was an institution in Ming and Qing dynasty China that managed imperial clan affairs, responsible for genealogical records, recording clan members' information, and handling their requests and punishments. A similar imperial clan affairs agency also existed in the Nguyễn dynasty in Vietnam, with functions akin to its Chinese counterpart, and was renamed to avoid Emperor Thiệu Trị's naming taboo.

description.zh-cn: 清代八旗之一，下五旗之一。
description.en: One of the Eight Banners of the Qing Dynasty, one of the Lower Five Banners.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，安亲王，努尔哈赤之孙。
description.en: An imperial clansman of the Qing dynasty, Prince An, and a grandson of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第九女。
description.en: The ninth daughter of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝妃嫔，皇长子胤禔的生母，曾抚养允禩。
description.en: A consort of the Kangxi Emperor, biological mother of the first prince Yinzhi, and she raised Yinsi in his childhood.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝皇长子，与皇太子胤礽关系紧张。
description.en: The eldest son of the Kangxi Emperor, who had a tense relationship with Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 清代学者、书法家，曾任允禩的侍读。
description.en: A scholar and calligrapher of the Qing dynasty, who once served as an attendant-reader to Yinsi.

en: Changchun University of Science and Technology

zh-cn: 辽宁省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 辽宁省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The permanent body of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress.

en: Work Safety Committee of the State Council
zh-cn: 国务院安全生产委员会
国务院三峡工程建设委员会
广东梅大高速路面塌方灾害

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来担任中共重庆市委书记期间，在重庆推行的一系列政治、经济和社会政策的总称。其特点是强调国家干预、社会公平和宣扬红色文化。
description.en: A term for the series of political, economic, and social policies implemented by Bo Xilai in Chongqing during his tenure as the secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee, characterized by an emphasis on state intervention, social equity, and the promotion of 'red culture'.

description.zh-cn: 一家位于辽宁的保健品公司，曾在薄熙来担任商务部长期间获得直销牌照，后因欺诈问题引发蚁力神事件。
description.en: A health products company in Liaoning that obtained a direct selling license while Bo Xilai was Minister of Commerce, and was later involved in the Yilishen incident due to fraud.

description.zh-cn: 醇亲王奕𫍽的侧福晋，载沣、载洵、载涛的生母。
description.en: A secondary consort of Yixuan, Prince Chun, and the biological mother of Zaifeng, Zaixun, and Zaitao.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义标志着辛亥革命的开端。保路运动爆发后，清廷调派湖北新军入川镇压，致使武昌防务空虚，为起义成功创造了决定性条件。此次起义直接导致清朝覆灭、载沣摄政体制瓦解，并引发中国各地响应，最终推翻清朝统治。起义爆发后，黄兴赶赴前线被推为战时总司令。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising marked the beginning of the Xinhai Revolution. Following the outbreak of the Railway Protection Movement, the Qing court dispatched the Hubei New Army to Sichuan for suppression, leaving Wuchang's defenses vulnerable and creating a decisive condition for the success of the uprising. This uprising directly led to the fall of the Qing dynasty, the collapse of Zaifeng's regency, and sparked responses across China, ultimately overthrowing the Qing rule. After the uprising, Huang Xing went to the front line and was appointed commander-in-chief.

description.zh-cn: 载沣第四子。
description.en: The fourth son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年的国家银行，其发行的兑换券上印有摄政王载沣的肖像。
description.en: The state bank of the late Qing dynasty, which issued banknotes featuring the portrait of Prince-Regent Zaifeng.

zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院

location.zh-cn: 上海市长宁区虹桥路1200号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国上海市的一所中级人民法院，于1995年7月1日在原上海市中级人民法院“撤一建二”的基础上建立。
description.en: An intermediate people's court in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, established on July 1, 1995, based on the division of the former Shanghai Intermediate People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国报纸。它于1956年6月5日首次向全世界公开发表了赫鲁晓夫秘密报告的全文。此外，该报在2017年的一篇报道中对科大讯飞的技术提出了潜在的伦理担忧。
description.en: An American newspaper. It first published the full text of Khrushchev's Secret Speech to the world on June 5, 1956. Additionally, in a 2017 report, it raised potential ethical concerns about iFlytek's technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国前国家副主席曾庆红之子。
description.en: Son of former Chinese Vice President Zeng Qinghong.

description.zh-cn: 山东省泰安市下辖的县级市，陆房战斗的具体发生地。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Tai'an, Shandong, and the specific location of the Lufang Battle.

zh-cn: 华夏人寿保险股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 加拿大多伦多的一个地区。
description.en: A district in Toronto, Canada.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王之子，秦庄襄王之父。曾短暂担任秦国国君，在位时间极短。
description.en: Son of King Zhaoxiang of Qin and father of King Zhuangxiang of Qin. He briefly served as the king of Qin, but his reign was extremely short.

description.zh-cn: 秦孝文王的正夫人，无子，后收养异人（秦庄襄王）为义子。
description.en: The primary consort of King Xiaowen of Qin. Being childless, she adopted Yiren (King Zhuangxiang of Qin) as her son.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时期秦国国君，秦孝文王之父，在位长达五十六年。他以任用名臣、富国强兵而著称，为秦始皇统一六国奠定了坚实基础。
description.en: King of the state of Qin during the Warring States period of China, father of King Xiaowen of Qin. He reigned for fifty-six years and was known for appointing capable ministers, enriching the state, and strengthening the military, which laid a solid foundation for the unification of China by Qin Shi Huang.

description.zh-cn: 东周国末代君主，后被吕不韦所杀。
description.en: The last ruler of the state of Eastern Zhou, who was killed by Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上周朝的一个姬姓诸侯国。它是吕不韦的出生地，也是子路曾在此地为官并最终殉职的地方。
description.en: A Ji family name vassal state during the Zhou dynasty in Chinese history. It was the birthplace of Lü Buwei, and also where Zi Lu once served as an official and ultimately died.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时期从周王室分裂出的一个小国，后被秦国所灭。
description.en: A small state that split from the Zhou royal house during the Warring States period, later conquered by the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代思想流派，以“兼儒墨，合名法”为特点，吕不韦是其代表人物。
description.en: An ancient Chinese school of thought characterized by 'combining Confucianism and Mohism, integrating the School of Names and Legalism'. Lü Buwei is its representative figure.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋战国时期各种学术流派的总称。
description.en: A collective term for the various academic schools of thought during the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职，为百官之长。
description.en: An official position in ancient China, the head of all civil officials.

description.zh-cn: 郑国渠是中国战国时期由水利学家郑国为秦国在今陕西省修筑的大型水利灌溉工程。最初由韩国提出，意图消耗秦国国力。然而，该工程建成后反而极大地增强了秦国的农业生产和经济实力，促进农业发展，为秦国统一六国奠定了坚实基础。
description.en: The Zheng Guo Canal is a large-scale hydraulic irrigation project built for the State of Qin by hydraulic engineer Zheng Guo in present-day Shaanxi province during China's Warring States period. It was initially proposed by the State of Han with the aim of draining Qin's resources. However, its completion greatly enhanced Qin's agricultural production and economic strength, promoting agricultural development and laying a solid foundation for Qin's unification of the six states.

en: Master Lü's Spring and Autumn Annals

description.zh-cn: 由秦国相邦吕不韦主持，集合其门客共同编撰的一部古代类百科全书式的著作，是杂家思想的代表作。
description.en: An ancient Chinese encyclopedic text compiled under the patronage of Lü Buwei, Chancellor of Qin, by his scholarly retainers. It is a representative work of the Miscellaneous School of thought.

description.zh-cn: 秦国设立的一个郡，位于今四川省境内。
description.en: A commandery established by the State of Qin, located in present-day Sichuan Province.

en: China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家中医药管理局直属的集科研、医疗、教学为一体的综合性中医药研究机构。屠呦呦于此工作。
description.en: A comprehensive research institution for Chinese medicine directly under the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine of the People's Republic of China, integrating scientific research, medical care, and teaching. Tu Youyou works here.

description.zh-cn: 位于浙江省宁波市的中学，屠呦呦曾于此就读。
description.en: A high school located in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, where Tu Youyou once studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于浙江省宁波市的中学，屠呦呦于1951年于此毕业。
description.en: A high school located in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province, from which Tu Youyou graduated in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 一种从黄花蒿中提取的倍半萜内酯化合物，由屠呦呦及其团队发现。它具有高效的抗疟作用，是现代抗疟药物的基础，主要用于治疗疟疾。
description.en: A sesquiterpene lactone isolated from Artemisia annua, discovered by Tu Youyou and her team. It possesses potent antimalarial properties, forms the basis for modern antimalarial drugs, and is primarily used to treat malaria.

description.zh-cn: 作为一种由屠呦呦及其团队发现的抗疟药（青蒿素）的还原产物，它是青蒿素在体内的活性代谢物，也是合成其他高效衍生物（如蒿甲醚和青蒿琥酯）的重要中间体。
description.en: It is a reduction product of artemisinin, an antimalarial drug discovered by Tu Youyou and her team. It serves as artemisinin's active metabolite in vivo and is a key intermediate for synthesizing other potent derivatives like artemether and artesunate.

description.zh-cn: 一个中华人民共和国国家秘密军事医学研究项目，旨在研发治疗抗氯喹疟疾的药物。屠呦呦是该项目研究组的组长，并在此期间最终成功发现了青蒿素。
description.en: A top-secret military medical research project of the People's Republic of China, aimed at developing a treatment for chloroquine-resistant malaria. Tu Youyou was the head of the project's research group and ultimately discovered artemisinin during this period.

description.zh-cn: 中国东晋时期的医学家、炼丹家，著有《肘后备急方》，其著作启发了屠呦呦发现青蒿素的方法。
description.en: A medical scholar and alchemist of the Eastern Jin dynasty in China, author of 'The Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies', whose work inspired Tu Youyou's method for discovering artemisinin.

en: A Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies

description.zh-cn: 中国东晋时期葛洪编撰的古代中医典籍，其中关于青蒿治疟的记载启发了屠呦呦的低温提取方法。
description.en: An ancient Chinese medical text compiled by Ge Hong during the Eastern Jin dynasty. Its description of using sweet wormwood to treat malaria inspired Tu Youyou's low-temperature extraction method.

description.zh-cn: 中药学家，曾是屠呦呦在中医研究院的老师和同事。
description.en: A pharmacognosist who was Tu Youyou's teacher and colleague at the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 美国最高学术荣誉团体之一，由科学家和工程师组成，致力于为国家提供科学、技术和医学方面的独立、客观的建议。
description.en: One of the highest academic honors in the United States, composed of scientists and engineers, dedicated to providing independent, objective advice to the nation on matters related to science, technology, and medicine.

description.zh-cn: 中国财政金融家，屠呦呦的舅舅。
description.en: A Chinese financier and banker, and Tu Youyou's maternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国财政部国库司首任司长，屠呦呦的外祖父。
description.en: The first Director of the National Treasury Department of the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of China, and Tu Youyou's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 清朝武官，湄云舰管带，屠呦呦的曾祖父。
description.en: A military officer of the Qing Dynasty, commander of the warship Meiyun, and Tu Youyou's great-grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第七位皇帝嘉庆帝的年号。
description.en: The era name of the Jiaqing Emperor, the seventh emperor of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 意大利籍耶稣会传教士、画家，曾为清朝宫廷画师。
description.en: An Italian Jesuit brother and missionary in China, where he served as an artist at the imperial court of three emperors.

description.zh-cn: 清朝军机大臣，是林则徐的坚定支持者。在林则徐被革职后，他力荐复用林则徐未果，最终以尸谏方式自缢身亡。
description.en: A Grand Councilor of the Qing dynasty and a staunch supporter of Lin Zexu. After Lin's dismissal, he strongly recommended his reinstatement but failed, ultimately committing suicide as a form of remonstrance.

description.zh-cn: 清代思想家、史学家。他是林则徐的好友，并受其委托，将《四洲志》等资料编成《海国图志》。该书详细介绍了西方各国的历史地理和科技，主张“师夷长技以制夷”，对晚清思想界影响深远。
description.en: A Chinese scholar, historian, and thinker of the Qing dynasty. He was a friend of Lin Zexu and was commissioned by him to compile the 'Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms' (Haiguo Tuzhi) from materials like the 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents.' This work introduced the history, geography, and technology of Western nations and advocated for 'learning from the barbarians' advanced technology to counter them,' profoundly influencing late Qing thought.

description.zh-cn: 第一次鸦片战争期间的英国驻华商务总监，同时也是英国皇家海军军官。他在禁烟运动中与林则徐直接对抗，代表英方参与战争初期的军事行动和谈判，并于1841年率军占领香港岛。
description.en: The British Chief Superintendent of Trade in China and a Royal Navy officer during the First Opium War. He directly confronted Lin Zexu during the anti-opium campaign, represented the British side in early military actions and negotiations, and led the occupation of Hong Kong Island in 1841.

description.zh-cn: 英国怡和洋行的创始人之一，是当时中国最大的鸦片商人之一。在林则徐禁烟期间，他是主要的对抗者，并返回英国游说政府对华出兵。
description.en: Co-founder of the British trading firm Jardine, Matheson & Co., and one of the largest opium traders in China at the time. He was a primary opponent during Lin Zexu's anti-opium campaign and returned to Britain to lobby the government for military action against China.

description.zh-cn: 英国宝顺洋行的鸦片商人，与威廉·渣甸同为林则徐禁烟运动的主要抵制者。
description.en: An opium trader from the British firm Dent & Co., who, along with William Jardine, was a major opponent of Lin Zexu's anti-opium campaign.

description.zh-cn: 清朝广东水师提督，积极配合林则徐的禁烟和海防工作。在第一次鸦片战争的虎门之战中，他率军奋力抵抗，最终壮烈殉国。
description.en: The admiral of the Guangdong Fleet of the Qing dynasty, who actively cooperated with Lin Zexu in opium prohibition and coastal defense. He valiantly led his troops in the Battle of Humen during the First Opium War and died in action.

en: Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms

description.zh-cn: 由魏源在林则徐《四洲志》的基础上编撰而成，旨在“师夷长技以制夷”。这部著作介绍世界地理、历史和西方科技，对晚清的洋务运动和日本的明治维新产生了重要影响。
description.en: Compiled by Wei Yuan based on Lin Zexu's 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents,' it aimed to 'learn from the barbarians to defeat the barbarians.' This treatise introduces world geography, history, and Western technology, and significantly influenced the Self-Strengthening Movement in the late Qing Dynasty and the Meiji Restoration in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在广州禁烟期间，组织人员翻译英国人休·慕瑞的《地理百科全书》而成的书籍，是中国近代第一部相对完整、系统的世界地理志。后成为魏源编撰《海国图志》的基础。
description.en: A book compiled under Lin Zexu's direction in Guangzhou, consisting of translations from Hugh Murray's 'Cyclopaedia of Geography'. It was the first systematic world geography gazetteer in modern China and later became the basis for Wei Yuan's 'Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝由皇帝亲自派遣，代表皇帝行使权力、处理特定事务的临时性高级官员。
description.en: A temporary high-ranking official in the Qing dynasty, dispatched by the emperor to handle specific matters with imperial authority.

description.zh-cn: 清朝地方最高级官吏之一，总管广东和广西两省的军民政务。
description.en: One of the highest-ranking local officials in the Qing dynasty, responsible for the military and civil affairs of Guangdong and Guangxi provinces.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙与宋霭龄的次女，是“飞狗事件”的核心人物。
description.en: The second daughter of H. H. Kung and Soong Ai-ling, and the central figure in the 'Flying Dog Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电视制片人，宋祖英的丈夫。
description.en: Chinese television producer, husband of Song Zuying.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，宋祖英的妹妹。
description.en: Chinese actress, younger sister of Song Zuying.

location.zh-cn: 湖南省湘西土家族苗族自治州

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Song Zuying.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军政治工作部文工团

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军的文艺团体。
description.en: The cultural troupe of the People's Liberation Army Navy of China.

zh-cn: 第九届全国人民代表大会代表名单

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第九届全国人民代表大会的代表身份。
description.en: The status of a deputy to the 9th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 何塞·普拉西多·多明哥·恩比尔

description.zh-cn: 西班牙男高音歌唱家。
description.en: Spanish operatic tenor.

description.zh-cn: 香港及台湾创作男歌手、音乐制作人及演员。1990年代最具影响力的华语歌手之一，有「国民歌王」、「台湾四大天王」、香港「天王杀手」之誉。
description.en: Hong Kong and Taiwanese singer-songwriter, music producer, and actor. One of the most influential Mandopop singers of the 1990s, known as the 'National King of Songs', one of the 'Four Heavenly Kings of Taiwan', and the 'Heavenly King Killer' in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦是一位台湾流行歌手、音乐人、词曲作家、演员、导演及制作人，对华语乐坛产生重大影响，被誉为“华语流行天王”。2024年花莲地震后，他与妻子昆凌共同捐款支持国立东华大学重建。他的父亲曾任教于新北市立芦洲国民中学。
description.en: Jay Chou is a Taiwanese pop singer, musician, songwriter, actor, director, and producer, known as the 'King of Mandopop' for his significant impact on the Mandopop music scene. After the 2024 Hualien earthquake, he and his wife Hannah Quinlivan jointly donated to support the reconstruction of National Dong Hwa University. His father was a former biology teacher at Luzhou Junior High School.

description.zh-cn: 中国电视节目主持人、媒体人、企业家。
description.en: Chinese television host, media personality, and entrepreneur.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国银行家，曾任中国银行总经理，反对孔祥熙的财政政策。
description.en: Chinese banker who served as the general manager of the Bank of China and opposed H. H. Kung's financial policies.

description.zh-cn: 中国女记者，曾任《新民报》采访部主任，报道了引发争议的“飞狗事件”。
description.en: Chinese female journalist, served as the director of the interview department of 'Xin Min Bao', and reported on the controversial 'Flying Dog Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国掌管财政、税收、关务、国有财产等事务的最高机构，其政府部长负责监督国库、确定财政政策和管理政府预算。
description.en: The ministry of the Republic of China that governs revenue, taxation, customs, and national property. Its government minister is responsible for supervising the treasury, determining fiscal policy, and managing the government budget.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的中央银行。
description.en: The central bank of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期的主要商业银行之一，后被国民政府增资控股。
