description.en: A counteroffensive launched by Ukraine in the latter half of 2022, which culminated in the liberation of Kherson city and the west bank of the Dnipro River.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰于2023年6月再次发起的大规模反攻，但收效甚微。
description.en: A large-scale counteroffensive launched again by Ukraine in June 2023, which had limited success.

zh-cn: 乌克兰亲欧盟示威运动

description.zh-cn: 2013年底至2014年初，乌克兰爆发一系列大规模亲欧盟抗议活动。起因是时任总统亚努科维奇政府暂停与欧盟签署联合协议。抗议活动最终升级为尊严革命，并导致亲俄总统亚努科维奇下台。该运动也成为后续乌克兰危机和顿巴斯战争的导火索。
description.en: From late 2013 to early 2014, a series of large-scale pro-EU protests erupted in Ukraine. The cause was the then-President Yanukovych government's decision to suspend the signing of an association agreement with the European Union. The protests ultimately escalated into the Revolution of Dignity and led to the ousting of pro-Russian President Yanukovych. This movement also became a trigger for the subsequent Ukrainian crisis and the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰而导致的难民潮，是自二战以来欧洲最大的难民危机。
description.en: The refugee outflow caused by the Russian invasion of Ukraine, representing the largest refugee crisis in Europe since World War II.

zh-cn: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的战争罪行
en: War crimes in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯军队在入侵乌克兰期间被指控犯下的一系列战争罪行，包括屠杀、酷刑、绑架儿童和使用违禁武器等。
description.en: A series of war crimes allegedly committed by Russian forces during the invasion of Ukraine, including massacres, torture, child abductions, and the use of prohibited weapons.

zh-cn: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役 (2022年—2024年)

description.zh-cn: 围绕顿涅茨克州阿夫迪伊夫卡市的长期战役，最终以俄罗斯占领该市告终。
description.en: A prolonged battle for the city of Avdiivka in Donetsk Oblast, which concluded with its capture by Russian forces.

zh-cn: 北哈尔科夫州战役 (2024年至今)
en: Northern Kharkiv front of the Russo-Ukrainian war
Northern Kharkiv front of the Russo-Ukrainian War

description.zh-cn: 2024年5月，俄罗斯在哈尔科夫州发动的新一轮攻势。
description.en: A new offensive launched by Russia in Kharkiv Oblast in May 2024.

description.zh-cn: 2024年8月，乌克兰军队对俄罗斯境内的库尔斯克州发动的攻势。
description.en: An offensive launched by Ukrainian forces into Russia's Kursk Oblast in August 2024.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州的一个由10所公立大学组成的大学行政系统，伯克利分校是其创始大学。
description.en: A university administrative system composed of 10 public universities, located in the U.S. state of California, with UC Berkeley as its founding campus.

description.zh-cn: 由美国和加拿大顶尖研究型大学组成的协会。
description.en: An association of leading research universities in the United States and Canada.

zh-cn: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室

description.zh-cn: 隶属于美国能源部的国家实验室，由加州大学伯克利分校管理。
description.en: A U.S. national laboratory that conducts scientific research on behalf of the Department of Energy, managed by the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，由美国陆军领导的研发第一颗原子弹的计划，伯克利的科学家和实验室深度参与其中。
description.en: A research and development project during World War II that produced the first nuclear weapons, led by the United States Army and with deep involvement from Berkeley scientists and laboratories.

description.zh-cn: 1964年由伯克利学生发起的学生抗议运动，在美国社会产生了深远影响。
description.en: A student protest movement initiated by Berkeley students in 1964 that had a profound impact on American society.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家，在伯克利发明了回旋加速器，并以此为基础发现了多种化学元素。
description.en: American physicist who invented the cyclotron at Berkeley, leading to the discovery of numerous chemical elements.

description.zh-cn: 一种粒子加速器，由欧内斯特·劳伦斯在伯克利发明。
description.en: A type of particle accelerator invented by Ernest Lawrence at Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 第97号化学元素，以伯克利来命名。
description.en: The chemical element with atomic number 97, named after Berkeley.

zh-cn: 戴维斯加利福尼亚大学

description.zh-cn: 加州大学系统中的一所分校，起源于伯克利设立的“大学农场”。
description.en: A campus in the University of California system that originated as the 'University Farm' established by Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 加州大学伯克利分校的第一任校长。
description.en: The first Chancellor of the University of California, Berkeley.

zh-cn: 美国国家数学科学研究所

description.zh-cn: 在伯克利校园内建立的数学研究机构，陈省身为首任主任。
description.en: A mathematical research institute established on the Berkeley campus, with Shiing-Shen Chern as its first director.

description.zh-cn: 华裔诺贝尔物理学奖得主，毕业于伯克利。
description.en: Chinese-American Nobel laureate in Physics, an alumnus of Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 华裔菲尔兹奖得主，毕业于伯克利。
description.en: Chinese-American Fields Medalist, an alumnus of Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 华裔美国教育家，曾任加州大学伯克利分校校长。
description.en: Chinese-American educator who served as Chancellor of the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 被指为蒲城县职业教育中心副校长，在抗议活动中遭到示威者围殴。
description.en: Alleged to be the vice principal of Pucheng County Vocational Education Center, who was beaten by protesters during the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 在蒲城县的抗议活动中维持秩序并与示威者发生冲突的执法力量。
description.en: Law enforcement forces that maintained order and clashed with protesters during the protests in Pucheng County.

description.zh-cn: 报道了蒲城县抗议事件平息后情况的广播电台。
description.en: A radio station that reported on the situation in Pucheng County after the protests subsided.

zh-cn: 上海特别市临时市政府

description.zh-cn: 1927年上海工人第三次武装起义后成立的临时政权，在四一二事件中被蒋介石下令解散。
description.en: A provisional government established after the third armed workers' uprising in Shanghai in 1927, which was ordered to be dissolved by Chiang Kai-shek during the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 由中国共产党领导的上海工人组织，在四一二事件中被解散。
description.en: A Shanghai workers' organization led by the Chinese Communist Party, which was dissolved during the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 青帮领袖，策划并执行清党的主要人物之一，负责联络杜月笙。
description.en: A leader of the Green Gang and a key figure in planning and executing the party purge, responsible for liaising with Du Yuesheng.

description.zh-cn: 国民党党代表，于1927年3月6日枪杀陈赞贤。
description.en: A KMT party representative who shot and killed Chen Zanxian on March 6, 1927.

description.zh-cn: 江西省总工会副委员长、赣州总工会委员长，于1927年3月6日被倪弼枪杀。
description.en: Vice-chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial General Labor Union and chairman of the Ganzhou General Labor Union, who was shot and killed by Ni Bi on March 6, 1927.

description.zh-cn: 继四一二事件后，在广州发生的大规模搜捕和处决共产党员及支持者的事件。
description.en: An event of mass arrests and executions of communists and their supporters in Guangzhou, following the April 12th Incident.

description.zh-cn: 美利坚合众国开国元勋之一，宾夕法尼亚大学的创建者。
description.en: One of the Founding Fathers of the United States and the founder of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 世界上第一台全数字电子计算机，由宾夕法尼亚大学工程学院于1946年设计完成。
description.en: The first fully digital electronic computer in the world, designed by the School of Engineering at the University of Pennsylvania and completed in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 由美国东北部地区的八所私立大学组成的体育赛事联盟，现已引申为美国顶尖学府的代名词。
description.en: An athletic conference composed of eight private universities in the Northeastern United States, now also commonly refers to these universities as a group of elite colleges.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪至19世纪初，苏格兰在思想、科学与文化领域取得辉煌成就的时期。
description.en: The period in 18th- and early 19th-century Scotland characterized by an outpouring of intellectual, scientific, and cultural accomplishments.

zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学沃顿商学院
en: Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania

description.zh-cn: 宾夕法尼亚大学下属的商学院。
description.en: The business school of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 投资家、慈善家，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Investor and philanthropist, an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 律师、台湾立法委员，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Lawyer and legislator in Taiwan; an alumna of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 前任美国驻华大使、前犹他州州长，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: Former U.S. Ambassador to China and former Governor of Utah; an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 美国语言学家、哲学家、认知科学家、历史学家、社会评论家和政治活动家，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。
description.en: An American linguist, philosopher, cognitive scientist, historian, social critic, and political activist; an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania.

description.zh-cn: 著名美籍华裔建筑师，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。他设计了中华人民共和国驻美国大使馆新馆。
description.en: Renowned Chinese-American architect and an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania. He designed the new building for the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 台裔经济学家、香港中文大学教授，宾夕法尼亚大学校友。他曾试图在电视节目中揭发张荣坤的资金问题并遭到封杀；亦曾批评孟山都控制中国大豆市场，并指控其贿赂官员。
description.en: Taiwanese-born economist and professor at the Chinese University of Hong Kong; an alumnus of the University of Pennsylvania. He attempted to expose Zhang Rongkun's financial issues on a TV program but was censored, and also criticized Monsanto for controlling China's soybean market, accusing it of bribing officials.

description.zh-cn: 中国著名物理学家，宾大历史上第一位中国女博士，中国半导体科学事业开拓者之一。
description.en: Renowned Chinese physicist, the first Chinese female Ph.D. in the history of the University of Pennsylvania, and one of the pioneers of China's semiconductor science.

description.zh-cn: 1978年至1979年间，在北京西单墙上张贴大字报，宣传不同政见，支持“求是派”，要求民主和自由的民主运动。魏京生是其中的重要成员。
description.en: A democratic movement that took place from 1978 to 1979, where big-character posters advocating different political views, democracy, and freedom were posted on the Xidan Wall in Beijing, supporting the "Pragmatist Faction." Wei Jingsheng was a key member of this movement.

zh-cn: 第五个现代化：民主及其他

description.zh-cn: 魏京生于1978年12月5日在西单民主墙张贴的大字报，宣扬民主主义，认为政治民主化是中国现代化的前提。
description.en: A big-character poster written by Wei Jingsheng and posted on the Xidan Democracy Wall on December 5, 1978, advocating for democracy and arguing that political democratization is a prerequisite for China's modernization.

en: Sakharov Prize for Freedom of Thought

description.zh-cn: 由欧洲议会颁发的人权奖项，以苏联科学家和持不同政见者安德烈·萨哈罗夫的名字命名。2023年，该奖项被追授给玛莎·阿米尼及“女性、生命、自由”运动。
description.en: A human rights prize awarded by the European Parliament, named after Soviet scientist and dissident Andrei Sakharov. In 2023, it was posthumously awarded to Mahsa Amini and the 'Woman, Life, Freedom' movement.

description.zh-cn: 美国的一个非营利组织，旨在促进全球民主。
description.en: A U.S. non-profit organization aimed at promoting democracy worldwide.

zh-cn: 中国人民大学附属中学
en: High School Affiliated to Renmin University of China

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的一所中学，魏京生曾在此就读。
description.en: A middle school in Beijing where Wei Jingsheng studied.

description.zh-cn: 魏京生在1973年退伍后被分配工作的单位，担任电工。
description.en: The workplace where Wei Jingsheng was assigned to work as an electrician after being discharged from the army in 1973.

description.zh-cn: 由魏京生等人创办的民运杂志。
description.en: A pro-democracy magazine founded by Wei Jingsheng and others.

description.zh-cn: 关于西藏政治地位的争议，魏京生曾于1992年致信邓小平阐述自己对此问题的看法。
description.en: The political dispute over the status of Tibet. Wei Jingsheng wrote a letter to Deng Xiaoping in 1992 explaining his views on the issue.

description.zh-cn: 美国国务院官员，曾任主管民主、人权和劳工事务的助理国务卿，于1994年2月在北京与魏京生会面。
description.en: A U.S. State Department official who served as Assistant Secretary of State for Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, and met with Wei Jingsheng in Beijing in February 1994.

zh-cn: 北京市第一中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市的中级人民法院之一。该法院审理了魏京生案，并于1995年以“阴谋颠覆政府罪”判处其有期徒刑14年。此外，它还在一审中判处成克杰死刑。
description.en: One of the intermediate people's courts in Beijing, People's Republic of China. This court tried Wei Jingsheng's case, sentencing him to 14 years in prison for 'conspiring to subvert the government' in 1995. It also sentenced Cheng Kejie to death in the first instance.

description.zh-cn: 维吾尔族人权活动家，世界维吾尔代表大会前主席。她曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见，并否认新疆存在东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动组织。
description.en: A Uyghur human rights activist and former president of the World Uyghur Congress. She was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng, and has denied the existence of the ETIM organization in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者和活动家，曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and activist, who was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华人牧师，曾与魏京生一同被美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会见。
description.en: A Chinese American pastor, who was met by U.S. President George W. Bush along with Wei Jingsheng.

zh-cn: 共产中国与自由世界的未来
en: Communist China and the Free World's Future

description.zh-cn: 美国国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥于2020年7月23日发表的演讲，其中提及了魏京生和王丹。
description.en: A speech delivered by U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo on July 23, 2020, in which he mentioned Wei Jingsheng and Wang Dan.

description.zh-cn: 英国不列颠东印度公司雇员，在新加坡建立交易站和殖民地，被视为现代新加坡的开埠者。
description.en: An employee of the British East India Company who established a trading post and colony in Singapore, considered the founder of modern Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的立法机构，通过修宪将新加坡驱逐出联邦。
description.en: The legislative body of Malaysia, which expelled Singapore from the federation through a constitutional amendment.

description.zh-cn: 现任新加坡总统，兼任新加坡国立大学校监。
description.en: The current President of Singapore, who also serves as the Chancellor of the National University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡现任国会议长。
description.en: The current Speaker of the Parliament of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡现任首席大法官。
description.en: The current Chief Justice of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡游泳运动员，为新加坡赢得史上首枚奥运金牌。
description.en: A Singaporean swimmer who won Singapore's first-ever Olympic gold medal.

description.zh-cn: 美国游泳运动员，在2016年奥运会男子100米蝶泳决赛中与另外两位选手并列第二，负于约瑟·斯库林。
description.en: An American swimmer who tied for second place with two other competitors in the men's 100m butterfly final at the 2016 Olympics, losing to Joseph Schooling.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡羽毛球运动员，为新加坡获得首枚羽毛球世锦赛金牌。
description.en: A Singaporean badminton player who won Singapore's first-ever badminton world championship gold medal.

description.zh-cn: 古蜀国君主。有说法认为他“决玉垒山以除水害”，开凿了宝瓶口，是都江堰的早期建设者。
description.en: A king of the ancient Shu kingdom. According to some accounts, he 'cut through Mount Yulei to eliminate water hazards' by excavating the Baopingkou, making him an early builder of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职，为一个郡的最高行政长官。
description.en: An official title in ancient China, the highest administrative officer of a commandery.

description.zh-cn: 位于四川盆地西部，是都江堰工程的主要灌溉区域，被称为“天府之国”。
description.en: Located in the western part of the Sichuan Basin, it is the main irrigation area of the Dujiangyan project, known as the 'Land of Abundance'.

description.zh-cn: 元朝四川肃政谦访使，于1335年主持大修，首次引入铁石结构改造都江堰。
description.en: A Surveillance Commissioner of Sichuan during the Yuan dynasty who, in 1335, presided over a major overhaul and first introduced an iron-and-stone structure to renovate Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期四川省水利局长，于1936年主持都江堰大修，采用近代设计施工方法和水泥等新材料，奠定了现代鱼嘴的基础。
description.en: Director of the Sichuan Provincial Water Conservancy Bureau during the Republic of China era who, in 1936, presided over a major overhaul of Dujiangyan using modern design, construction methods, and new materials like cement, laying the foundation for the modern Yuzui.

description.zh-cn: 1933年发生于岷江上游的地震，导致的山体滑坡形成堰塞湖，其后溃坝形成的洪水将都江堰堰首建筑全部冲毁。
description.en: An earthquake that occurred in the upper reaches of the Min River in 1933, causing landslides that formed a barrier lake. The subsequent dam failure unleashed a flood that completely destroyed the headworks of Dujiangyan.

description.zh-cn: 1981年四川发生的特大洪水，导致都江堰灌区的水利设施受到不同程度的破坏。
description.en: A major flood in Sichuan in 1981 that caused varying degrees of damage to the water conservancy facilities in the Dujiangyan irrigation area.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家，在1979至1980年间参观都江堰后深受震撼，立志要像李冰父子那样，为后世子孙的幸福贡献力量。
description.en: An economist who, after visiting Dujiangyan between 1979 and 1980, was profoundly moved and vowed to contribute to the happiness of future generations, just like Li Bing and his son.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣，隆科多之父，康熙帝舅父。
description.en: A minister of the Qing Dynasty, father of Longkodo, and maternal uncle of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，佟国维之父，隆科多之祖父。
description.en: An official of the Qing Dynasty, father of Tung-gowei, and grandfather of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，隆科多伯父。
description.en: An official of the Qing Dynasty, paternal uncle of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝第三任皇后，佟国维之女，隆科多之姊。
description.en: The third empress of the Kangxi Emperor, daughter of Tung-gowei, and elder sister of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝皇贵妃，隆科多之姊。
description.en: Imperial Noble Consort of the Kangxi Emperor, elder sister of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 满洲八大姓之一。
description.en: One of the eight great Manchu clans.

description.zh-cn: 清朝负责京师卫戍、警备和治安的官职，俗称九门提督。
description.en: An official position in the Qing Dynasty responsible for the garrison, security, and public order of the capital, commonly known as the Commander of the Nine Gates.

description.zh-cn: 清朝负责皇室仪仗、车驾等事务的机构。其前身是锦衣卫，专责此类皇室事宜。
description.en: An institution in the Qing Dynasty responsible for imperial ceremonies, carriages, and related affairs. It was renamed from the Jinyiwei and was exclusively in charge of such imperial matters.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，隆科多堂兄弟。
description.en: An official of the Qing Dynasty, cousin of Longkodo.

description.zh-cn: 计算机科学家，姚期智的妻子。
description.en: Computer scientist, spouse of Andrew Yao.

zh-cn: 清华大学交叉信息研究院
en: Institute for Interdisciplinary Information Sciences, Tsinghua University
American Academy of Arts and Sciences

description.zh-cn: 香港的一所公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 东亚的一个民族，中国的主体民族，也是世界上人口最多的民族。
description.en: An ethnic group in East Asia, the dominant ethnic group in China, and the largest ethnic group in the world.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政院副院长。
description.en: Vice Premier of the Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁的前任内阁。
description.en: The predecessor cabinet to the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁首任交通部部长，后因婚外情丑闻辞职。
description.en: The first Minister of Transportation in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet, who later resigned due to an extramarital affair scandal.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁首任教育部政务次长，后因性平案泄密辞职。
description.en: The first Political Deputy Minister of Education in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet, who resigned due to leaking information in a gender equity case.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁经济部部长。
description.en: Minister of Economic Affairs in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁卫生福利部部长。
description.en: Minister of Health and Welfare in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 卓荣泰内阁交通部部长。
description.en: Minister of Transportation and Communications in the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 张学良时期的警务处长，奉命处决了杨宇霆和常荫槐。
description.en: Chief of Police Affairs under Zhang Xueliang, who was ordered to execute Yang Yuting and Chang Yinhuai.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，曾与孙传芳联手在江苏袭击奉军，迫使杨宇霆撤退。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who, along with Sun Chuanfang, attacked the Fengtian army in Jiangsu, forcing Yang Yuting to retreat.

description.zh-cn: 直系将领，于1918年被徐树铮枪杀。
description.en: A general of the Zhili clique who was shot dead by Xu Shuzheng in 1918.

description.zh-cn: 杨宇霆长子。
description.en: Eldest son of Yang Yuting.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国辽宁省沈阳市的县，是杨易辰和杨宇霆的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, China, and the birthplace of Yang Yichen and Yang Yuting.

description.zh-cn: 美国人类学家，其理论认为宗教相当于人文社科中的一门包罗万象的“生存之道”。
description.en: American anthropologist who theorized that religion is an all-encompassing 'way of life' within the humanities and social sciences.

description.zh-cn: 一个通常带有贬义的词汇，用于指代某些被认为是偏离主流、具有潜在危害性的新兴宗教或信仰团体。现代宗教学术界倾向于使用中性的“新兴宗教”一词。
description.en: A pejorative term for what is perceived as a deviant or dangerous new religious movement. Modern religious studies scholarship prefers the neutral term 'new religious movement'.

description.zh-cn: 古罗马哲学家，其对拉丁语“religio”的词源学解释影响了后世对宗教概念的理解。
description.en: Ancient Roman philosopher whose etymological explanation of the Latin word 'religio' influenced later understanding of the concept of religion.

description.zh-cn: 中国哲学家、哲学史家。他曾指出翻译词“宗教”在中文中有其特定意义，不能与所有带“教”字的词汇混淆。他也是李泽厚在北京大学的老师，并且是华中师范大学的校友。
description.en: A Chinese philosopher and historian of philosophy. He pointed out that the translated term 'religion' has a specific meaning in Chinese and should not be confused with all words containing the character '教'. He was also Li Zehou's teacher at Peking University and an alumnus of Central China Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 现代知名僧人，将“宗教”定义为“尊崇的教化”。
description.en: Well-known modern monk who defined 'religion' as 'revered teachings'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾僧人，法鼓山创办人，认为“有所宗而以为教者，即为宗教”。
description.en: Taiwanese monk, founder of Dharma Drum Mountain, who defined religion as 'that which has a principle and is taken as a teaching'.

description.zh-cn: 由释圣严法师创立的台湾佛教组织。
description.en: A Taiwanese Buddhist organization founded by Master Sheng-yen.

description.zh-cn: 英国考古学家、人类学家，提出万物有灵论作为宗教起源的理论。
description.en: British archaeologist and anthropologist who proposed animism as a theory for the origin of religion.

description.zh-cn: 一种宗教起源理论，认为原始人基于对梦境、呼吸等现象的观察，产生了万物皆有灵魂（Anima）的概念。
description.en: A theory of the origin of religion suggesting that primitive humans, based on observations of phenomena like dreams and breath, developed the concept that all things possess a soul (Anima).

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰社会人类学家，提出巫术论，认为人类精神发展经历了从巫术到宗教再到科学的阶段。
description.en: Scottish social anthropologist who proposed the magic theory, arguing that human intellectual development progresses from magic through religion to science.

description.zh-cn: 一种准宗教现象，认为通过特定行为（如接触律或相似律）可以控制自然。在弗雷泽的理论中，巫术是宗教的前身。
description.en: A quasi-religious phenomenon based on the belief that nature can be controlled through specific actions (e.g., law of contact or similarity). In Frazer's theory, magic is the precursor to religion.

description.zh-cn: 一种系统性的知识体系，通过可检验的解释和对宇宙的预测来建立和组织知识。在弗雷泽的理论中，科学是继宗教之后的人类精神发展阶段。
description.en: A systematic enterprise that builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the universe. In Frazer's theory, science is the stage of human intellectual development that follows religion.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、东方学家，提出“语言疾病学说”来解释神话和宗教的起源。
description.en: German philologist and Orientalist who proposed the 'disease of language' theory to explain the origin of myth and religion.

description.zh-cn: 英国人类学家，功能论的提出者之一，认为宗教旨在满足个体的心理需求。
description.en: British anthropologist, a proponent of functionalism, who argued that religion serves to satisfy individual psychological needs.

description.zh-cn: 一种社会学和人类学理论，认为宗教等社会制度的存在是为了满足个体或社会的特定需求（如心理慰藉、社会团结）。
description.en: A sociological and anthropological theory which holds that social institutions like religion exist to fulfill specific needs of individuals or society (e.g., psychological comfort, social cohesion).

description.zh-cn: 法国人类学家，提出神话结构学说，认为神话反映了人类心灵的共同结构。
description.en: French anthropologist who developed structural anthropology, arguing that myths reflect the common structures of the human mind.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家、逻辑学家，对宗教持批判态度，从逻辑和科学角度对有神论提出质疑。
description.en: British philosopher and logician who was a prominent critic of religion, questioning theism from logical and scientific perspectives.

description.zh-cn: 在一神论宗教中被认为是至高无上的、宇宙的创造者和统治者的存在。
description.en: The supreme being, creator, and principal object of faith in monotheistic religions.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，著名的理性有神论者，认为宇宙的高度秩序性为一神论提供了证据。
description.en: British philosopher and a leading proponent of theistic arguments, who argues that the high degree of order in the universe provides evidence for theism.

description.zh-cn: 相信只存在一个神或至高无上存在的宗教或哲学信仰。
description.en: The belief in one god or in the oneness of God.

description.zh-cn: 德裔美国神学家、哲学家，主张宗教与科学有本质区别，寻求的真理在不同意域（分离论）。
description.en: German-American theologian and philosopher who argued that religion and science are fundamentally different, seeking truth in different domains (separation theory).

zh-cn: 弗里德里希·施莱尔马赫

description.zh-cn: 德国神学家、哲学家，宗教情感论的代表人物，认为宗教的本质是“对无限者的情感”和“绝对的依存感”。
description.en: German theologian and philosopher, a key figure in religious emotionalism, who defined the essence of religion as a 'feeling for the infinite' and a 'feeling of absolute dependence'.

description.zh-cn: 德国神学家，认为宗教的核心是对“神圣者”（the Numinous）的体验，这种体验包含敬畏与向往的交织情感。
description.en: German theologian who argued that the core of religion is the experience of 'the Numinous', an experience characterized by a mixture of awe (mysterium tremendum) and fascination (fascinans).

description.zh-cn: 法国数学家、物理学家、哲学家，提出了著名的“帕斯卡的赌注”，是宗教意志论的先驱。
description.en: French mathematician, physicist, and philosopher who formulated the famous 'Pascal's Wager', a precursor to religious voluntarism.

description.zh-cn: 美国哲学家、心理学家，宗教意志论的重要发展者，认为在证据不足的情况下，人有权基于实践和意志的理由去选择信仰。
description.en: American philosopher and psychologist, a key developer of religious voluntarism, who argued that one has the right to believe based on practical and volitional grounds when evidence is insufficient.

description.zh-cn: 将儒家思想体系视为一种宗教信仰的观点或运动，强调其祭祀、礼仪和教义等宗教性元素。
description.en: The view or movement that treats the Confucian system of thought as a religion, emphasizing its religious elements such as rituals, ceremonies, and doctrines.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳的幼子，梅派艺术的传人。
description.en: The youngest son of Mei Lanfang and an heir to the Mei School of Peking Opera.

description.zh-cn: 中国画家，曾教梅兰芳画工虫。
description.en: A Chinese painter who taught Mei Lanfang how to paint insects.

description.zh-cn: 戏曲理论家，梅兰芳的良师益友，介绍梅兰芳与齐白石相识。
description.en: An opera theorist, a good teacher and helpful friend to Mei Lanfang, who introduced Mei to Qi Baishi.

en: Four Great Dan of Peking Opera

description.zh-cn: 民国时期京剧四个旦角行当的代表演员的合称，包括梅兰芳、程砚秋、尚小云、荀慧生。
description.en: A collective name for four representative Dan role actors of Peking Opera during the Republican era, including Mei Lanfang, Cheng Yanqiu, Shang Xiaoyun, and Xun Huisheng.

description.zh-cn: 京剧“四大名旦”之一，梅兰芳的学生。
description.en: One of the "Four Great Dan" of Peking Opera and a student of Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 京剧“四大名旦”之一。
description.en: One of the "Four Great Dan" of Peking Opera.

description.zh-cn: 京剧“四大名旦”之一。
description.en: One of the "Four Great Dan" of Peking Opera.

description.zh-cn: 窝阔台的皇后，负责抚育蒙哥长大。
description.en: A queen of Ögedei Khan, responsible for raising Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 拔都的弟弟，率军护送并支持蒙哥召开忽里台登基。
description.en: Younger brother of Batu Khan, who led an army to escort and support Möngke's enthronement at the Kurultai.

description.zh-cn: 贵由的皇后，在贵由死后临朝称制，反对蒙哥继位，后被处死。
description.en: Wife of Güyük Khan, who acted as regent after his death, opposed Möngke's succession, and was later executed.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国第二次向西方的远征，蒙哥参与其中并建立了战功。
description.en: The second Mongol invasion of the West, in which Möngke participated and achieved military merit.

description.zh-cn: 钦察部落首领，在第二次蒙古西征中被蒙哥活捉。
description.en: A leader of the Kipchaks, captured alive by Möngke during the second Mongol invasion of the West.

description.zh-cn: 位于今中国云南地区的政权，被忽必烈奉蒙哥之命所灭。
description.en: A kingdom located in modern-day Yunnan, China, which was conquered by Kublai under Möngke's orders.

description.zh-cn: 大理国末代国王，投降蒙古后被任命为大理总管。
description.en: The last king of the Dali Kingdom, who surrendered to the Mongols and was appointed as the General Administrator of Dali.

description.zh-cn: 由旭烈兀领导的蒙古帝国第三次西征，征服了西亚大片地区，建立了伊儿汗国。
description.en: The third Mongol invasion of the West, led by Hulagu, which conquered large parts of West Asia and established the Ilkhanate.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的伊斯兰教派国家，于1256年被旭烈兀西征军所灭。
description.en: An Islamic sectarian state in West Asia, destroyed by Hulagu's army in 1256.

description.zh-cn: 位于叙利亚地区的王朝，于1260年被旭烈兀西征军所灭。
description.en: A dynasty in the region of Syria, destroyed by Hulagu's army in 1260.

description.zh-cn: 南宋与蒙古在钓鱼城的一场关键战役，蒙古大汗蒙哥在此战中身亡。
description.en: A key battle between the Southern Song and the Mongols at Diaoyu Fortress, where the Great Khan Möngke died in action.

description.zh-cn: 法国传教士，受路易九世派遣出使蒙古，并觐见了蒙哥汗。
description.en: A French missionary sent by Louis IX on a mission to the Mongol Empire, where he had an audience with Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王，派遣传教士卢布鲁克出使蒙古。
description.en: King of France who dispatched the missionary William of Rubruck on a mission to the Mongols.

description.zh-cn: 小亚美尼亚国王，归附蒙古帝国，曾亲自前往哈拉和林觐见蒙哥。
description.en: King of Armenian Cilicia, who submitted to the Mongol Empire and personally traveled to Karakorum for an audience with Möngke.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的大皇后，弘吉剌部人。
description.en: The chief empress of Möngke Khan, from the Onggirat tribe.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的长子，由忽都台皇后所生。
description.en: The eldest son of Möngke Khan, born to Empress Qutuqtai.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的次子。
description.en: The second son of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的三子，由忽都台皇后所生。
description.en: The third son of Möngke Khan, born to Empress Qutuqtai.

description.zh-cn: 蒙哥的四子。
description.en: The fourth son of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军少将，2022年4月起担任第七十三集团军军长。
description.en: A major general in the PLA Ground Force, serving as the commander of the 73rd Group Army since April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任华东野战军第13纵队司令员和改编后的第三十一军首任军长。
description.en: PLA general who served as the commander of the 13th Column of the East China Field Army and the first commander of the reorganized 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任华东野战军第13纵队政治委员。
description.en: PLA general who served as the political commissar of the 13th Column of the East China Field Army.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三野战军
en: Third Field Army of the Chinese People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在第二次国共内战末期和中华人民共和国初期（1949年2月至1950年8月）的主力部队之一，由华东野战军改编而成。其下属的第十兵团曾辖有第三十一军。
description.en: One of the main forces of the People's Liberation Army during the late Chinese Civil War and the early PRC (February 1949 to August 1950). It was reorganized from the East China Field Army, and its 10th Army Group included the 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军攻占漳州和厦门地区的战役，第三十一军是主力之一。
description.en: The campaign for the PLA to capture the Zhangzhou and Xiamen areas, where the 31st Corps was one of the main forces.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任第三十一军政治委员。
description.en: PLA general who served as the political commissar of the 31st Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，毕业于六盘水师范学院。曾任新组建的第七十三集团军首任军长，现任中国人民解放军南部战区副司令员兼南部战区陆军司令员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army (PLA), graduated from Liupanshui Normal University. He previously served as the first commander of the newly formed 73rd Group Army, and currently serves as the Deputy Commander of the PLA Southern Theater Command and Commander of the Southern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军少将，担任新组建的第七十三集团军首任政治委员。
description.en: A major general in the PLA Ground Force, serving as the first political commissar of the newly formed 73rd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任陆军第三十一集团军军长。
description.en: PLA general who served as the commander of the 31st Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 由朱利安·阿桑奇于2006年创立的揭密网站，专门发布匿名来源和网络泄露的文档。
description.en: A whistle-blowing website founded by Julian Assange in 2006, which publishes news leaks and classified media provided by anonymous sources.

description.zh-cn: 美国活动家、告密者，前美国陆军情报分析员。因向维基解密泄露大量机密文件而被定罪，并因此引起国际关注。
description.en: American activist and whistleblower, a former United States Army intelligence analyst. She was convicted for disclosing a large volume of classified documents to WikiLeaks, which garnered international attention.

description.zh-cn: 曾向朱利安·阿桑奇提供政治庇护，允许其在其驻英国大使馆居住了近七年，后又撤销庇护。
description.en: Granted political asylum to Julian Assange, allowing him to reside in its embassy in the UK for nearly seven years, before revoking it.

description.zh-cn: 厄瓜多尔政治家，曾任厄瓜多尔总统。在其任内，厄瓜多尔撤销了对朱利安·阿桑奇的政治庇护。
description.en: Ecuadorian politician who served as the President of Ecuador. During his term, Ecuador revoked Julian Assange's political asylum.

description.zh-cn: 负责大伦敦地区（除伦敦城外）执法的英国警察机构，由伦敦市长通过市长警务和犯罪问题办公室进行监督。该机构曾两次逮捕朱利H·阿桑奇。
description.en: The UK police force responsible for law enforcement in Greater London, excluding the City of London. It is overseen by the Mayor of London through the Mayor's Office for Policing and Crime. This agency notably arrested Julian Assange on two occasions.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦法律，美国政府据此对朱利安·阿桑奇提出多项指控。
description.en: A United States federal law under which the U.S. government brought multiple charges against Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 律师，朱利安·阿桑奇的妻子。
description.en: A lawyer and the wife of Julian Assange.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚的一所公立研究型大学，朱利安·阿桑奇曾在此学习物理与数学。
description.en: A public research university in Australia where Julian Assange studied physics and mathematics.

description.zh-cn: 一个中国高空气球飞越北美上空，被美国击落。此事件导致美国国务卿布林肯取消访华行程，进一步加剧了双边关系的紧张。
description.en: A Chinese high-altitude balloon flew over North America and was shot down by the United States. The incident led to U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken's cancellation of his trip to China, further escalating bilateral tensions.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国和美利坚合众国关于建立外交关系的联合公报
en: Joint Communiqué on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations

description.zh-cn: 中美三个联合公报中的第二个，宣布两国自1979年1月1日起正式建立大使级外交关系。
description.en: The second of the three US-China Joint Communiqués, announcing the formal establishment of ambassadorial-level diplomatic relations between the two countries as of January 1, 1979.

zh-cn: 巴拉克·奥巴马政府的东亚外交政策
en: East Asian foreign policy of the Obama administration
East Asian foreign policy of the Barack Obama administration

description.zh-cn: 美国奥巴马政府提出的外交战略，旨在将美国的战略重心转向亚太地区，以应对中国经济和军事力量的持续增加。
description.en: A foreign policy strategy proposed by the Obama administration to shift America's strategic focus to the Asia-Pacific region in response to the continued growth of China's economic and military power.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家，金九的前任大韩民国临时政府主席。
description.en: Korean independence activist, predecessor of Kim Gu as the President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家，曾担任大韩民国临时政府主席，并劝说金九出任国务领。
description.en: Korean independence activist who served as President of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea and persuaded Kim Gu to take the position of State Councillor.

description.zh-cn: 金九的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Kim Gu.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的首都，是东京都的姊妹友好都市，也是金九逝世的城市。
description.en: The capital of the Republic of Korea, a sister city of Tokyo Metropolis, and the city where Kim Gu died.

description.zh-cn: 金九等人于1928年成立的韩国独立运动政党，后于1940年与其他党派合并重组。
description.en: A Korean independence movement political party founded by Kim Gu and others in 1928, which later merged and reorganized with other parties in 1940.

zh-cn: 驻朝鲜美国陆军司令部军政厅
en: United States Army Military Government in Korea

description.zh-cn: 二战后在朝鲜半岛南部实行军事统治的美国机构，不支持大韩民国临时政府，并扶持李承晚政权。
description.en: The American agency that exercised military rule in the southern Korean Peninsula after World War II, did not support the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, and backed the Syngman Rhee regime.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛19世纪的宗教运动组织，金九于1893年加入。
description.en: A 19th-century religious movement organization on the Korean Peninsula, which Kim Gu joined in 1893.

description.zh-cn: 由金九在九一八事变后成立的敢死队，旨在通过暗杀等手段打击日本侵略者。
description.en: A secret organization founded by Kim Gu after the Mukden Incident, aimed at fighting against Japanese invaders through methods such as assassination.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜独立运动家，韩人爱国团成员。在与王亚樵合作的上海虹口公园爆炸案中，他负责在现场执行投弹任务，成功炸死多名日军高级将领。
description.en: A Korean independence activist and member of the Korean Patriotic Corps. In collaboration with Wang Yaqiao, he was responsible for throwing the bomb at the scene of the Shanghai Hongkou Park bombing, successfully killing several high-ranking Japanese military officials.

description.zh-cn: 1932年4月29日，由王亚樵策划、尹奉吉执行的一次针对日本军政要员的炸弹袭击事件，导致多名日方高官死伤。
description.en: On April 29, 1932, a bomb attack targeting Japanese military and political officials, planned by Wang Yaqiao and executed by Yun Bong-gil, resulted in the death or injury of several high-ranking Japanese officials.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，时任上海派遣军司令，在虹口公园爆炸案中身受重伤，后不治身亡。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army and commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, who was severely wounded in the Hongkou Park bombing and later died from his injuries.

description.zh-cn: 日本驻沪居民团行政委员长，在虹口公园爆炸案中当场被炸死。
description.en: The administrative chairman of the Japanese Residents' Association in Shanghai, who was killed instantly in the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 韩国独立运动家，其遗骸与李奉昌、尹奉吉一同被金九运回国安葬。
description.en: A Korean independence activist whose remains were returned to Korea for burial by Kim Gu, along with those of Lee Bong-chang and Yun Bong-gil.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影公司，施南生在80年代在此工作，并创造了港产片的黄金时代。
description.en: A Hong Kong film company where Nansun Shi worked in the 1980s, contributing to the golden age of Hong Kong cinema.

description.zh-cn: 香港一家收费电视台，施南生曾协助其开创。
description.en: A pay television station in Hong Kong which Nansun Shi helped to establish.

description.zh-cn: 一家收费电视公司，施南生曾协助其开创业务。
description.en: A pay television company whose business Nansun Shi helped to establish.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的学校，施南生的小学及中学母校。
description.en: A school in Hong Kong, which is the primary and secondary school alma mater of Nansun Shi.

description.zh-cn: 在该届颁奖典礼上，施南生获颁终身成就奖。
description.en: At this awards ceremony, Nansun Shi was awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award.

description.zh-cn: 台湾电影女演员。她曾为施南生颁发第43届香港电影金像奖终身成就奖。据一种说法，张国荣“哥哥”的绰号起源于与她合作《白发魔女传》时，两人互称“哥哥”和“姐姐”。
description.en: A Taiwanese actress. She presented the Lifetime Achievement Award to Nansun Shi at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards. According to one account, Leslie Cheung's nickname 'Gor Gor' (哥哥, older brother) originated when they worked together on 'The Bride with White Hair', and they addressed each other as 'brother' and 'sister'.

description.zh-cn: 在该届影展上，施南生获得金摄影奖。
description.en: At this film festival, Nansun Shi received the Berlinale Camera award.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新竹市的最高行政首长职位。
description.en: The chief executive position of Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新竹市议会的民意代表职位。
description.en: The position of a representative in the Hsinchu City Council, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 指控时任新竹市市长林智坚在国立台湾大学和中华大学的硕士论文涉嫌抄袭，并最终被认定为抄袭的学术争议事件。此事件导致林智坚的双硕士学位皆被撤销，引发其退出2022年桃园市长选举，并使其指导教授陈明通受到调查。
description.en: Refers to an academic controversy and political incident where then-Hsinchu Mayor Lin Chih-chien's master's theses from National Taiwan University and Chung Hua University were accused and subsequently confirmed to be plagiarized. This led to the revocation of both his master's degrees, his withdrawal from the 2022 Taoyuan mayoral election, and an investigation into his advisor, Chen Ming-tong.

description.zh-cn: 存在两所不同的私立大学。一所位于台湾新竹市，林智坚曾在此获得学士学位，但其硕士学位后因抄袭被撤销。另一所私立大学于1912年创立于武昌，并于1952年院系调整时并入华中高等师范学校（今华中师范大学）。
description.en: There are two distinct private universities. One is located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, where Lin Chih-chien obtained his bachelor's degree, though his master's degree was later revoked due to plagiarism. The other private university was founded in Wuchang in 1912 and was merged into Central China Higher Normal School (now Central China Normal University) during the 1952 higher education reorganization.

description.zh-cn: 台湾棒球选手，在新竹棒球场开幕赛中因场地问题严重受伤，导致其赛季报销。
description.en: A Taiwanese baseball player who suffered a severe, season-ending injury during the inaugural game at the Hsinchu Baseball Stadium due to poor field conditions.

description.zh-cn: 三立电视董事长，于2024年延揽林智坚至旗下永兴资本公司担任总经理。
description.en: Chairman of Sanlih E-Television. In 2024, he recruited Lin Chih-chien to serve as the general manager of its subsidiary, Yong-Xing Capital.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一家主要电视台，其董事长为张荣华。
description.en: A major television station in Taiwan, chaired by Chang Jung-hua.

zh-cn: 台湾省立竹东高级中学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹县竹东镇的一所高级中学，为林智坚的母校。
description.en: A senior high school located in Zhudong Township, Hsinchu County, Taiwan. It is Lin Chih-chien's alma mater.

zh-cn: 新竹市立培英国民中学
en: Hsinchu Pei Ying Junior High School

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市的一所国民中学，为林智坚的母校。
description.en: A junior high school in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, and Lin Chih-chien's alma mater.

zh-cn: 新竹市东区东园国民小学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市东区的一所国民小学，为林智坚的母校之一。
description.en: An elementary school in East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan, one of Lin Chih-chien's alma maters.

zh-cn: 新竹市北区民富国民小学
新竹县新竹市民富国民小学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市北区的一所国民小学，为林智坚的母校之一。
description.en: An elementary school in North District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan, one of Lin Chih-chien's alma maters.

description.zh-cn: 台湾北部的一个直辖市，林智坚曾被提名为该市市长候选人。
description.en: A special municipality in northern Taiwan for which Lin Chih-chien was nominated as a mayoral candidate.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的理论著作，在延安整风运动中被指定为学习文件，并被认为是毛泽东主义（毛泽东思想）最重要的基础理论著作。
description.en: A theoretical work by Mao Zedong, designated as a study document during the Yan'an Rectification Movement and considered the most important foundational theoretical work of Maoism (Mao Zedong Thought).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长，现任中国人民银行行长、党委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, and current Governor and Party Committee Secretary of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长兼国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Administrator of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局副局长，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, formerly Deputy Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, and currently Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。他曾任国家外汇管理局副局长，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China. He previously served as Deputy Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange and currently serves as Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中国人民银行副行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中央纪委国家监委驻中国人民银行纪检监察组组长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as the head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission stationed at the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行的前身之一，1948年与华北银行、西北农民银行合并组建中国人民银行。
description.en: One of the predecessors of the People's Bank of China, which merged with Huabei Bank and Northwest Farmers Bank in 1948 to form the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河北省的省会。中国人民银行于1948年在此成立，同时也是中国人民解放军中部战区陆军的机关驻地。
description.en: The capital of Hebei Province, People's Republic of China. The People's Bank of China was established here in 1948, and it also serves as the headquarters of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

zh-cn: 中国银行业监督管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国国务院直属正部级事业单位，于2003年成立，承接了中国人民银行对银行业的部分监管职能，负责监管银行业金融机构。2018年，该机构的职能并入国家金融监督管理总局。
description.en: Formerly a ministerial-level public institution directly under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, established in 2003. It took over some of the regulatory functions of the People's Bank of China and was responsible for regulating banking financial institutions. In 2018, its functions were merged into the National Administration of Financial Regulation.

zh-cn: 国务院金融稳定发展委员会
en: State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee

description.zh-cn: 原国务院统筹协调金融稳定和改革发展重大问题的议事协调机构。其办公室曾设在中国人民银行，于2023年改革后不再保留，职责划入中央金融委员会办公室。
description.en: The former deliberative and coordinating body of the State Council for coordinating major issues of financial stability, reform, and development. Its office was once located in the People's Bank of China. It was dissolved after the 2023 reform, and its responsibilities were transferred to the Office of the Central Financial Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民银行行长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国经济学家和政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长及中国人民银行行长。
description.en: Chinese economist and politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange and Governor of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 首任民选花莲县县长。
description.en: The first democratically elected Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，首位中国国民党籍花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, the first Kuomintang Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，首位外省籍及军职出身的花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, the first Magistrate of Hualien County from mainland China and with a military background.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾两度担任花莲县县长并担任台湾省政府委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served twice as the Magistrate of Hualien County and as a member of the Taiwan Provincial Government council.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任花莲县县长及台湾肥料董事长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Magistrate of Hualien County and Chairman of Taiwan Fertilizer.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, served as the Magistrate of Hualien County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，任内因病逝世的花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, served as the Magistrate of Hualien County and passed away in office.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾以台湾省政府主席身份兼任代理花莲县县长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, served as the acting Magistrate of Hualien County concurrently while being the Chairman of the Taiwan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 唐代的一种官职，多为有才艺者担任，侍奉于皇帝左右。
description.en: An official title in the Tang dynasty, often held by talented individuals who served the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首五言绝句，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A five-character quatrain written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首乐府诗，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A yuefu poem written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首乐府诗，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A yuefu poem written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

en: Leaving Baidi Town Early in the Morning

description.zh-cn: 李白创作的一首七言绝句，是其代表作之一。
description.en: A seven-character quatrain written by Li Bai, one of his most representative works.

description.zh-cn: 唐代的一个州，位于今四川省境内，是李白的成长地。
description.en: A prefecture in the Tang dynasty, located in modern-day Sichuan province, where Li Bai grew up.

description.zh-cn: 唐代绵州下辖的一个县，今属四川省江油市。该县被认为是李白的出生地之一。
description.en: A county under Mian Prefecture in the Tang dynasty, now part of Jiangyou, Sichuan Province. It is considered one of Li Bai's possible birthplaces.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国西南的古代国家，后被汉朝所灭。
description.en: An ancient state in southwestern China, which was later extinguished by the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐代益州长史，曾称赞年轻的李白“天才英丽，下笔不休”。
description.en: The governor of Yizhou in the Tang dynasty, who praised the young Li Bai for his 'brilliant talent and ceaseless writing'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代名士，与李白等人隐居于徂徕山，并称为“竹溪六逸”。
description.en: A renowned scholar of the Tang dynasty who, along with Li Bai and others, lived in seclusion on Mount Culai. They were known as the 'Six Idlers of the Bamboo Brook'.

description.zh-cn: 李白诗文集，其早期版本由李阳冰编订。
description.en: The collection of Li Bai's poems and writings, with an early version compiled by Li Yangbing.

description.zh-cn: 海外华侨社团，中国致公党的前身。
description.en: An overseas Chinese society, the predecessor of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国致公党第4至6届中央委员会主席。在反右运动中被划为右派，后在文革期间被迫害致死。
description.en: Served as the Chairman of the 4th to 6th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party. He was labeled a rightist during the Anti-Rightist Campaign and was persecuted to death during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国致公党第7、8届中央委员会主席。
description.en: Served as the Chairman of the 7th and 8th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国致公党第9、10届中央委员会主席，是罗豪才的前任。他也是一位印尼华侨。
description.en: A Chinese politician, he served as the Chairman of the 9th and 10th Central Committees of the China Zhi Gong Party, and was a predecessor to Luo Haocai. He was also an Indonesian overseas Chinese.

description.zh-cn: 祖籍福建安溪的新加坡归国华侨，中国共产党党员，中华人民共和国法学家、教育家、社会活动家及政治人物。曾任国家级副职领导人，是中国现代行政法学的开拓者与奠基人。他还担任过中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会副主席、中国致公党中央委员会主席、中华人民共和国最高人民法院副院长等职务。
description.en: Luo Haocai was a returned overseas Chinese from Singapore with ancestral roots in Anxi, Fujian. He was a member of the Communist Party of China, a jurist, educator, social activist, and political figure of the People's Republic of China. He served as a deputy national leader and is recognized as a pioneer and founder of modern administrative law in China. His prominent roles included Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party, and Vice President of the Supreme People's Court of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军为统一广东根据地对陈炯明部队发动的两次军事行动。在此期间，陈炯明军队被击败，导致中国致公党总部迁至香港。
description.en: Two military campaigns launched by the National Revolutionary Army against Chen Jiongming's forces to unify the Guangdong base. During these campaigns, Chen Jiongming's army was defeated, leading to the relocation of the China Zhi Gong Party headquarters to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 清代的一个历史悠久的民间秘密社会组织，以反清复明为宗旨，并与中国致公党的源流有关。
description.en: A historical secret fraternal organization from the Qing dynasty, aiming to 'overthrow the Qing and restore the Ming', and with ties to the origins of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 清代长江流域的民间秘密社团，参与了自立军起义。
description.en: A secret society active in the Yangtze River basin during the Qing Dynasty, which participated in the Self-Support Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党中央副主席，四川省副省长。
description.en: Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party and Vice Governor of Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 曾任天津市副市长，致公党党员。
description.en: Former Vice Mayor of Tianjin and a member of the China Zhi Gong Party.

zh-cn: 中国致公党中央委员会
en: Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党的最高执行机关。
description.en: The highest executive body of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党代表，参加了中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议。
description.en: A representative of the China Zhi Gong Party who attended the first plenary session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国致公党的成立地点。
description.en: The founding location of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 反右运动期间被划定的政治标签，指代被认为是反对共产党和中国社会主义制度的个人或群体。
description.en: A political label designated during the Anti-Rightist Campaign, referring to individuals or groups considered to be opposing the Communist Party and the socialist system in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，在反右运动中被划为右派。
description.en: A Chinese economist who was labeled a rightist during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 一种政党制度，指国内只存在唯一一个执政党。反右运动后，中国共产党实质性一党专政的局面得到巩固。
description.en: A type of party system in which a single political party forms the government. After the Anti-Rightist Campaign, the de facto one-party dictatorship of the CPC was consolidated.

description.zh-cn: 指国家权力集中于一人之手的政治局面。反右运动后，毛泽东的个人权威达到顶峰，形成一人独裁的局面。
description.en: A political situation where state power is concentrated in the hands of one person. After the Anti-Rightist Campaign, Mao Zedong's personal authority reached its peak, leading to a one-man dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党提出的促进艺术发展和科学进步的方针，鼓励知识分子发表意见，后被认为是引诱批评者暴露以便打击的“阳谋”。
description.en: A policy promoted by the CPC to encourage the development of arts and sciences by allowing free expression of different views, later considered a stratagem to entice critics to reveal themselves for subsequent persecution.

description.zh-cn: 1956年10月，匈牙利人民共和国爆发了全国性反苏革命，是波匈事件的组成部分之一。此次事件使毛泽东对政权稳固感到担忧，并影响了他对“鸣放”运动的态度。
description.en: In October 1956, a nationwide anti-Soviet revolution erupted in the Hungarian People's Republic, forming part of the broader Polish and Hungarian incidents. This event prompted Mao Zedong to express concern over the stability of his regime and influenced his approach to the Hundred Flowers Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东撰写的党内指示，分析了当时“鸣放”中的政治动向，为即将开始的反右运动提供了理论准备。
description.en: An internal party directive written by Mao Zedong, analyzing the political trends during the "Blooming and Contending" period and providing theoretical preparation for the impending Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 1930年下半年起，中国共产党在中央苏区内部发动的肃清所谓“AB团”的政治运动，造成大量党员和干部被错杀。
description.en: A political purge launched by the Chinese Communist Party within the Central Soviet Area starting in the second half of 1930 to eliminate the so-called "AB League", resulting in the wrongful execution of numerous party members and cadres.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二十军

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的一支部队，因发动富田事变，最终被缴械整肃，番号被取消。
description.en: A unit of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, which was disarmed and purged, and its designation cancelled, after launching the Futian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 指对错案进行纠正，恢复受害者名誉的政治行为。此处特指为富田事变相关人员恢复名誉的努力。
description.en: Refers to the political act of correcting a wrongful case and rehabilitating the reputation of the victims. Specifically refers to the efforts to rehabilitate those involved in the Futian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 红二十军政委，在部队被缴械后遭处决。
description.en: Political Commissar of the Red 20th Army, executed after the unit was disarmed.

zh-cn: 历史与阶级意识：关于马克思主义辩证法的研究
黑格尔主义的马克思主义
en: Geschichte und Klassenbewußtsein. Studien über marxistische Dialektik
History and Class Consciousness: Studies in Marxist Dialectics

description.zh-cn: 匈牙利马克思主义哲学家卢卡奇·格奥尔格的主要著作，收录了他在1919年至1922年间撰写的8篇论文，被认为是西方马克思主义的奠基之作之一。
description.en: A major work by the Hungarian Marxist philosopher György Lukács, compiling eight essays written between 1919 and 1922, and is considered one of the foundational texts of Western Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 匈牙利马克思主义哲学家，《历史与阶级意识》的作者，被认为是西方马克思主义的创始人之一。
description.en: Hungarian Marxist philosopher, author of 'History and Class Consciousness', and considered one of the founders of Western Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 弗里德里希·恩格斯提出的一套理论，试图将马克思主义的辩证法应用于自然科学。
description.en: A theory proposed by Friedrich Engels attempting to apply Marxist dialectics to natural science.

description.zh-cn: 一个社会学概念，指在资本主义社会中，人与人之间的社会关系被转化为物与物之间的关系，从而掩盖了社会关系的本质。
description.en: A sociological concept where social relations between people in a capitalist society are transformed into relations between things, thereby obscuring the true nature of these social relations.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪20年代以来在西欧和中欧发展起来的一种马克思主义思潮，强调马克思主义的哲学和文化层面。
description.en: A current of Marxist theory that arose from Western and Central Europe in the aftermath of the 1917 October Revolution, emphasizing the philosophical and cultural dimensions of Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 马克思主义理论中的一个社会阶级，指在资本主义社会中不占有生产资料，靠出卖劳动力为生的雇佣工人阶级。
description.en: A social class in Marxist theory, referring to the wage-earning workers in a capitalist society who do not own the means of production and live by selling their labor power.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任佛山市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Foshan Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，蒙古族，现任佛山市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician of Mongol ethnicity, currently serving as the Mayor of the Foshan Municipal People's Government.

zh-cn: 中国共产党佛山市委员会
en: Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在佛山市的地方组织，是佛山市的领导核心。
description.en: The local organization of the Communist Party of China in Foshan, serving as the city's leadership core.

zh-cn: 佛山市人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of Foshan Municipal People's Congress
Standing Committee of the Foshan Municipal People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 佛山市人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing body of the Foshan Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 佛山市的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of Foshan City.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, formerly served as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 明朝佛山乡绅，曾组织“忠义营”镇压黄萧养起义。
description.en: A local gentry of Foshan during the Ming dynasty, who organized the 'Zhongyi Camp' to suppress the Huang Xiaoyang uprising.

description.zh-cn: 清朝咸丰年间太平天国将领，曾在佛山建立根据地，并以此围攻广州。
description.en: A Taiping Rebellion general during the Xianfeng era of the Qing dynasty, who established a base in Foshan and used it to besiege Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于佛山顺德的中国跨国科技集团和家电制造商。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology group and home appliance manufacturer headquartered in Shunde, Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于佛山顺德的中国房地产开发公司，平安人寿保险是其股东之一。
description.en: A Chinese real estate development company headquartered in Shunde, Foshan, with Ping An Life Insurance as one of its shareholders.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于佛山的中国调味品生产和销售公司。
description.en: A Chinese condiment production and sales company headquartered in Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 美国企业家，与比尔·盖茨共同创办了微软公司。
description.en: American business magnate who co-founded Microsoft Corporation with Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 美国慈善家，比尔·盖茨的前妻，比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会的联合创始人。
description.en: American philanthropist, former wife of Bill Gates, and co-founder of the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 美国律师，比尔·盖茨的父亲。
description.en: American attorney and father of Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 美国商界女性，曾任银行董事，是比尔·盖茨的母亲。
description.en: American businesswoman who served on a bank's board of directors, and was the mother of Bill Gates.

zh-cn: 比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会

description.zh-cn: 由比尔·盖茨和梅琳达·盖茨夫妇创办的美国私人基金会，是全球最大的私人基金会之一。
description.en: An American private foundation founded by Bill and Melinda Gates, one of the largest private foundations in the world.

description.zh-cn: 印度裔美国商业高管，自2014年起担任微软首席执行官。
description.en: Indian-American business executive who has been the chief executive officer of Microsoft since 2014.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国集团控股公司。
description.en: An American multinational conglomerate holding company.

description.zh-cn: 美国华盛顿州的一座城市，是比尔·盖茨的出生地。
description.en: A city in the U.S. state of Washington, the birthplace of Bill Gates.

description.zh-cn: 国际商业机器公司，是一家美国跨国科技和咨询公司。
description.en: International Business Machines Corporation, an American multinational technology and consulting company.

description.zh-cn: 微软公司为个人电脑开发的磁盘操作系统，是公司早期成功的关键。
description.en: A disk operating system for personal computers developed by Microsoft, which was key to the company's early success.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国科技公司，设计、开发和销售消费电子产品、计算机软件和在线服务。它曾与微软在操作系统图形用户界面上存在竞争和法律纠纷。
description.en: An American multinational technology company that designs, develops, and sells consumer electronics, computer software, and online services. It also had competition and legal disputes with Microsoft over graphical user interfaces for its operating systems.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人、投资者和慈善家，长实集团创办人。他与比尔·盖茨共同投资了一家食品科技公司，并在2012年香港行政长官选举中提名唐英年。
description.en: Hong Kong business magnate, investor, philanthropist, and founder of Cheung Kong Group. He co-invested in a food technology company with Bill Gates and nominated Henry Tang in the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election.

description.zh-cn: 一家由比尔·盖茨担任董事长的核能公司，致力于开发一种名为行波反应堆的新型核反应堆。
description.en: A nuclear energy company chaired by Bill Gates, focused on developing a new class of nuclear reactor called the traveling wave reactor.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚学者，评价中国特色社会主义是资本主义和威权主义的结合。
description.en: A Slovenian scholar who described socialism with Chinese characteristics as a combination of capitalism and authoritarianism.

zh-cn: 为人民服务—共产主义联盟

description.zh-cn: 马列毛主义组织，认为中国是社会帝国主义国家。
description.en: A Marxist-Leninist-Maoist organization that considers China a social-imperialist country.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，受汪东兴指示组织撰写了提出“两个凡是”的社论《学好文件抓住纲》。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who, under the instruction of Wang Dongxing, organized the writing of the editorial 'Study the Documents Well and Grasp the Key Link', which proposed the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 清朝管园大臣，在英法联军劫掠圆明园时投福海自尽。
法国传教士，曾为清朝宫廷服务，参与设计圆明园西洋楼。
法国传教士、画家，曾为清朝宫廷服务，参与设计圆明园西洋楼。
位于英国伦敦的皇家植物园，其建造曾参考中国造园理论。

zh-cn: 威尔士亲王弗雷德里克
弗雷德里克 (威尔士亲王)

description.en: English architect, landscape architect, painter and furniture designer.

zh-cn: 圆明园十二生肖兽首铜像

description.zh-cn: 圆明园海晏堂前“水力钟”喷泉的十二生肖人身兽首铜像，在第二次鸦片战争中被掠夺后流失海外。
位于北京的清代皇家园林。其修缮工程曾挪用了海军衙门的部分经费。
description.en: A royal garden of the Qing dynasty located in Beijing. Part of the funds from the Admiralty was diverted for its renovation.

description.zh-cn: 香港的免费无线电视台。著名艺人沈殿霞曾长期在此工作，该台也是“四朵金花”组合的经纪公司。郭富城于1984年加入其舞蹈组，后成为艺员，并于1996年离开。
description.en: A free-to-air television broadcaster in Hong Kong. Famous artist Lydia Shum worked here for a long time, and it also served as the management agency for the 'Four Golden Flowers' group. Aaron Kwok joined its dance troupe in 1984, later became an actor, and left in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大城市，沈殿霞安葬于此，该市设立“肥肥日”以纪念她。
description.en: A city in Canada where Lydia Shum is buried. The city established "Fei Fei Day" in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 张春桥的妻子，毕业于燕京大学新闻系。1973年与张春桥离婚，但1998年后继续共同生活。
description.en: Zhang Chunqiao's wife, a graduate of the Journalism Department of Yenching University. She divorced Zhang in 1973 but resumed living with him after 1998.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民政府
en: People's Government of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region
People's Government of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国省级行政区内蒙古自治区的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, a provincial-level administrative region of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，蒙古族，接替布小林出任内蒙古自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Mongol ethnicity, who succeeded Bu Xiaolin as Chairwoman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，在布小林担任内蒙古自治区主席初期任中国共产党内蒙古自治区委员会书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Secretary of the CCP Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee during the early part of Bu Xiaolin's tenure as Chairwoman of Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，在布小林担任内蒙古自治区主席期间任中国共产党内蒙古自治区委员会书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Secretary of the CCP Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee during Bu Xiaolin's tenure as Chairwoman of Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 中国内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市下辖的一个旗，是布小林的出生地。
description.en: A banner under the administration of Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China. It is the birthplace of Bu Xiaolin.

en: President of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国（1912年—1949年）的国家元首职位，尤其指中华民国北洋政府时期的国家元首。
description.en: The head of state position of the Republic of China (1912–1949), specifically referring to the head of state during its Beiyang Government period.

description.zh-cn: 清末由李鸿章创办的近代海军学校，旨在为北洋水师培养海军人才。
description.en: A modern naval academy founded by Li Hongzhang in the late Qing dynasty to train naval personnel for the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 1917年由段祺瑞在天津马厂誓师成立的军队，旨在讨伐张勋复辟，并迅速集结击败了定武军。
description.en: An army formed by Duan Qirui at Machang, Tianjin in 1917, aimed at suppressing Zhang Xun's restoration attempt, which quickly assembled and defeated the Dingwu Army.

description.zh-cn: 民国军阀时期直系军阀和奉系军阀为争夺北京政府控制权而进行的战争。第一次直奉战争后，大总统徐世昌被驱逐。
description.en: Wars fought between the Zhili and Fengtian cliques for control of the Beiyang government during the Warlord Era. After the First Zhili–Fengtian War, President Xu Shichang was ousted.

zh-cn: 美国参议院外交委员会
en: United States Senate Committee on Foreign Relations

description.zh-cn: 美国参议院的常设委员会。
description.en: A standing committee of the United States Senate.

zh-cn: 美国参议院司法委员会
en: United States Senate Committee on the Judiciary

description.zh-cn: 美国参议院的常设委员会。

description.en: The foreign policy of the Soviet Union during the Brezhnev era, which claimed that the Soviet Union could intervene with military force when the socialist regime of a Warsaw Pact member was threatened.

description.zh-cn: 由美国总统罗纳德·里根提出的战略防御计划，旨在建立太空导弹防御系统，对苏联构成了巨大的经济和军事压力。
description.en: A strategic defense plan proposed by U.S. President Ronald Reagan, aimed at creating a space-based missile defense system, which placed immense economic and military pressure on the Soviet Union.

description.en: A period of relative liberalization in the Soviet Union's political, social, and cultural spheres under Khrushchev after Stalin's death, closely associated with the Secret Speech.

description.en: Refers to the speculative bubble involving internet companies around the year 2000. Its burst had a severe impact on many tech companies, including NetEase.

description.en: An American electronic stock exchange. NetEase was listed here in 2000, and Sina was also listed here from 2000 to 2021.

description.en: A massively multiplayer online role-playing game created by Blizzard Entertainment. Its operating license in mainland China was transferred from The9 to NetEase in 2009.

description.en: The former cross-border e-commerce platform of NetEase, later acquired by Alibaba Group and renamed Kaola Haigou.

description.zh-cn: 网易公司推出的音乐服务产品，获得了阿里巴巴集团的投资。

description.en: The censorship and control of internet content by the government of the People's Republic of China, actions which led to the deletion of several review and documentary videos published by NetEase News.

zh-cn: 福建省文学艺术界联合会

description.en: A people's organization under the leadership of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, composed of the Fujian Provincial Literary and Artists' Association, districted city federations of literary and art circles, and provincial-level industrial federations of literary and art workers.

en: Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government

description.en: The predecessor of the Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was established by the People's Revolutionary Military Commission, responsible for unifying the management of railways in the liberated areas from January to October 1949. After the establishment of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China on October 1, 1949, it became a constituent department, continuing to manage the national railways until September 1954.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任华北人民政府交通部部长、铁道部副部长。

description.en: A central government department in the early days of the People's Republic of China, established in August 1952 by splitting from the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government. description.en: A county in Hebei Province, China, and the birthplace of Shi Shuangqi.

description.zh-cn: 顺平县的旧称，完县，位于中国河北省，石双琪曾在此地任县委书记。
description.en: The former name of Shunping County, Wan County, located in Hebei Province, China, where Shi Shuangqi once served as the County Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河北省，由新城县发展而来。
description.en: A city in Hebei Province, China, which evolved from Xincheng County.

description.zh-cn: 中国河北省的一个县。其历史悠久，曾是汉代涿郡的治所，为今天河北省涿州市的前身。在近现代，石双琪曾在此地担任县委第二书记。
description.en: A county in Hebei Province, China. It has a long history, having served as the seat of Zhuo Commandery during the Han Dynasty and is the predecessor of modern Zhuozhou, Hebei Province. In more recent times, Shi Shuangqi served as the Second County Party Secretary here.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河北省，石双琪曾在此地任县委第一书记。
description.en: A county in Hebei Province, China, where Shi Shuangqi served as the First County Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河北省，石双琪曾在此地担任市长并最终逝世。
description.en: A city in Hebei Province, China, where Shi Shuangqi served as mayor and eventually passed away.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替石双琪担任保定市人民政府市长。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who succeeded Shi Shuangqi as Mayor of the Baoding Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、医生。曾任第十二届全国人民代表大会解放军代表、空军总医院院长。
description.en: A politician and doctor of the People's Republic of China. He has served as a PLA deputy to the 12th National People's Congress and president of the PLA Air Force General Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代末期的大名，长州藩第13代藩主。他对木户孝允有深厚的信赖，并赐予其“木户”姓氏。
description.en: A daimyō of the late Edo period, the 13th lord of the Chōshū Domain. He had deep trust in Kido Takayoshi and granted him the surname 'Kido'.

description.zh-cn: 原为京都艺妓，名为几松。在幕末动乱时期多次帮助木户孝允，后成为其妻子。
description.en: Originally a geisha in Kyoto named Ikumatsu. She helped Kido Takayoshi multiple times during the turbulent Bakumatsu period and later became his wife.

description.zh-cn: 指德川幕府，日本江户时代的统治机构。在幕末时期与尊王攘夷派对立。
description.en: Refers to the Tokugawa shogunate, the ruling body of Japan during the Edo period. It was opposed by the Sonnō jōi faction during the Bakumatsu period.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的土佐藩乡士，在促成萨长同盟中扮演了关键角色。
description.en: A low-ranking samurai from the Tosa Domain during the Bakumatsu period who played a crucial role in brokering the Satchō Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期，萨摩藩和长州藩为了共同对抗德川幕府而结成的军事政治同盟。木户孝允是长州藩的代表。
description.en: A military and political alliance formed between the Satsuma and Chōshū domains during the Bakumatsu period to combine their efforts against the Tokugawa shogunate. Kido Takayoshi was the representative for the Chōshū Domain.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇在1868年发布的明治维新基本方针。木户孝允对其草案进行了重要修改，并促成了宣誓仪式的举行。
description.en: A statement of the basic policies of the Meiji Restoration, promulgated by Emperor Meiji in 1868. Kido Takayoshi made significant revisions to its draft and promoted the idea of a formal oath-taking ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，曾支持征韩论。明治六年政变后下野，成为自由民权运动的领袖之一，并联名上书提交了《民选议院设立建议书》。
description.en: A Japanese politician of the Meiji period, initially a supporter of Seikanron. After resigning following the Meiji Six Year Coup, he became a key leader of the Freedom and People's Rights Movement, co-signing and submitting the 'Memorial on the Establishment of a Popularly Elected Assembly'.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的佐贺藩士，明治时代的政治家，维新十杰之一，也是征韩论的支持者。
description.en: A samurai of the Saga Domain during the late Edo period, a statesman of the Meiji era, one of the Ten Great Nobles of the Restoration, and a supporter of the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，征韩论的支持者之一。
description.en: A Japanese statesman of the Meiji period and a supporter of the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治家，征韩论的支持者之一。
description.en: A Japanese statesman of the Meiji period and a supporter of the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 由不满明治政府的士族发动的叛乱，其起因与明治六年政变有关。
description.en: A rebellion by discontented samurai against the Meiji government, linked to the aftermath of the Meiji Six Year Coup.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时期的政治和社会运动，其起点与明治六年政变中下野的官员有关，旨在批判藩阀政治，要求设立民选议会和制定宪法。
description.en: A political and social movement in Meiji Japan, whose origins are connected to the officials who resigned during the Meiji Six Year Coup. It aimed to criticize the hanbatsu government and demanded the establishment of a popularly elected assembly and a constitution.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中神功皇后征服朝鲜半岛的传说，为“征韩论”一词的来源。
description.en: A legendary conquest of the Korean peninsula by Empress Jingū in Japanese mythology, which is the origin of the term 'Seikanron'.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的政治口号和运动，其关于日本对朝鲜半岛支配权的主张为征韩论提供了思想背景。
description.en: A political slogan and movement in late-Edo period Japan whose claims of Japanese sovereignty over the Korean peninsula provided an ideological background for the Seikanron.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市宝山区区长、陈良宇秘书，因陈良宇事件被判刑。
description.en: Chinese politician, former District Mayor of Baoshan, Shanghai, and secretary to Chen Liangyu, who was sentenced in the Chen Liangyu incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国官员，曾任国家统计局局长，因卷入陈良宇事件被调查判刑。
description.en: Chinese official, former Director of the National Bureau of Statistics, who was investigated and sentenced for his involvement in the Chen Liangyu incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共第四代领导人上台后推行的经济政策，旨在防止经济过热。陈良宇对此政策进行了抵制。
description.en: Economic policies implemented by the fourth generation of CCP leaders to prevent economic overheating. Chen Liangyu resisted these policies.

description.zh-cn: 王云鹏的出生地，位于中国吉林省。
description.en: The birthplace of Wang Yunpeng, located in Jilin Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国材料科学家，曾任北京航空航天大学校长，是王云鹏的前任。
description.en: A Chinese material scientist who served as the President of Beihang University and was the predecessor of Wang Yunpeng.

description.en: Chinese educator, Han ethnicity, member of the Communist Party of China. She is the current president of Hefei Preschool Education College. Her main research field is graph theory and network optimization.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省下辖的县级市，由安庆市代管。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Anqing City, in Anhui Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国安徽省安庆市的一所省属师范大学。
description.en: A provincial normal university located in Anqing, Anhui Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国安徽省芜湖市的一所省属重点大学，陈中于1978年毕业于此。
description.en: A provincial key university located in Wuhu, Anhui Province, China, from which Chen Zhong graduated in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国安徽省合肥市的一所公办全日制普通高等专科学校。
description.en: A public full-time ordinary higher vocational college located in Hefei, Anhui Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 由美国数学学会出版的期刊和在线数据库，包含了数学、统计学和理论计算机科学领域的文献摘要和评论。
description.en: A journal and online database published by the American Mathematical Society that contains summaries and reviews of literature in mathematics, statistics, and theoretical computer science.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Hunan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党纪律处分，指开除党籍、开除公职。
description.en: A disciplinary action by the Communist Party of China, referring to expulsion from the Party and removal from public office.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共宁远县委书记。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Secretary of the CCP Ningyuan County Committee.

description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Qiqihar, Heilongjiang province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Jin Xiaoyun.

description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国南宋理学家、思想家、教育家。他将《论语》与《大学》、《孟子》、《中庸》合为“四书”，并撰写《论语集注》，极大地提升了《论语》的地位。其著作《周易本义》亦是后世研究《周易》的重要版本。他还重建并主持白鹿洞书院，使其成为理学传播的重要中心。
description.en: A Neo-Confucian scholar, thinker, and educator of the Southern Song dynasty. He grouped the Analects with the Great Learning, Mencius, and the Doctrine of the Mean to form the 'Four Books' and wrote the 'Collected Commentaries on the Analects', greatly elevating its status. His work 'Zhouyi benyi' is an important version for later studies of the I Ching. He also rebuilt and presided over the White Deer Grotto Academy, making it a key center for the dissemination of Neo-Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的官员、玄学家和学者。他主持编纂了《论语集解》，是曹爽的亲信。
description.en: An official, Xuanxue scholar, and scholar of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period. He led the compilation of the 'Collected Explanations of the Analects' and was a close associate of Cao Shuang.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的经学大师，他以张侯论为底本，参考《齐论》、《古论》，作《论语注》，定下了《论语》的今本。
description.en: A great master of classics in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He used Zhang's Analects as a basis, referencing the Qi Analects and Gu Analects, to create his 'Commentary on the Analects', which established the modern text of the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 南北朝时期的学者，受佛教影响编成了《论语义疏》。
description.en: A scholar during the Southern and Northern Dynasties who, influenced by Buddhism, compiled the 'Subcommentary on the Analects'.

description.zh-cn: 北宋理学家，义理派易学代表人物。他高度评价《论语》，认为其意味深长，并著有《伊川易传》。
description.en: A Neo-Confucian philosopher of the Northern Song dynasty and a representative of the Yili school. He highly praised the Analects, believing it to be profoundly meaningful, and authored the 'Yichuan Yizhuan'.

description.zh-cn: 日本第15代天皇，据传王仁曾向其献上《论语》注疏。
description.en: The 15th Emperor of Japan, to whom Wani is said to have presented commentaries on the Analects.

en: Tomb of the Marquis of Haihun

description.zh-cn: 位于江西南昌的西汉墓葬，出土了失传1800年的《论语》〈齐论〉竹简，具有重大的考古价值。
description.en: A Western Han dynasty tomb located in Nanchang, Jiangxi, where bamboo slips of the 'Qi Analects' (lost for 1800 years) were unearthed, holding significant archaeological value.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾的金融控股公司。
description.en: A financial holding company located in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾高雄市造船业的旗舰企业之一，目前为民间最大的造船厂。
description.en: One of the flagship enterprises in the shipbuilding industry in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, and currently the largest private shipyard.
