description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任水利电力部副部长、党组成员，中国电力企业联合会理事长、党组书记，是第八届、第九届全国人大代表。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Minister and Party Group Member of the Ministry of Water Resources and Electric Power, Chairman and Party Group Secretary of the China Electricity Council, and a delegate to the 8th and 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。曾任中华人民共和国公安部党委委员、反恐专员（副部长级），兼任国家禁毒委员会办公室主任。因侦破湄公河惨案而知名，后因涉嫌严重违纪违法被查处。
description.en: Chinese politician. He served as a former committee member of the Party Committee and Counter-Terrorism Commissioner (Vice-Ministerial level) of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China, and concurrently as the Director of the Office of the National Narcotics Control Commission. Known for solving the Mekong River Massacre case, he was later investigated for serious violations of discipline and law.

zh-cn: 国家禁毒委员会办公室
en: Office of National Narcotics Control Commission

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的议事协调机构，负责组织、协调、指导全国的禁毒工作。其办事机构设在公安部。
description.en: A deliberative and coordinating body of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for organizing, coordinating, and guiding national anti-drug efforts. Its working body is located within the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 缅甸籍毒枭，糯康集团首领，湄公河惨案主犯。2012年被捕并移交中国审判，2013年被执行死刑。
description.en: A Burmese drug lord and leader of the Naw Kham gang, the mastermind of the Mekong River massacre. He was arrested in 2012, extradited to China for trial, and executed in 2013.

en: Li Wei (vice minister of public security)

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任公安部副部长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替刘跃进担任公安部反恐专员。
description.en: A Chinese politician who succeeded Liu Yuejin as the Counter-Terrorism Commissioner of the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。他曾接替刘跃进担任国家禁毒委员会办公室主任，曾任陕西省公安厅厅长。现任中华人民共和国公安部党委委员、副部长，国家禁毒委员会副主任，并持有副总警监警衔。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China. He previously succeeded Liu Yuejin as the Director of the Office of the National Narcotics Control Commission and served as the Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Public Security. He is currently a member of the Party Committee and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China, Deputy Director of the National Narcotics Control Commission, and holds the police rank of Deputy Commissioner General.

zh-cn: 中央纪委国家监委网站
en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的最高纪律检查机关和中华人民共和国的最高国家监察机关。
description.en: The highest internal-control institution of the Chinese Communist Party and the highest supervisory organ of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民警察警衔体系中的高级警衔，对应副部级官员。
description.en: A high-ranking police rank in the People's Police of the People's Republic of China, corresponding to vice-ministerial level officials.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任甘肃省人大常委会主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国甘肃省的最高国家行政机关。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of Gansu Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 甘肃省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 甘肃省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing body of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress.

zh-cn: 政权是由枪杆子中取得的
en: Political power grows out of the barrel of a gun

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在八七会议上提出的著名论断，意指政权需依靠军事手段获取与稳固。
description.en: A famous thesis proposed by Mao Zedong at the August 7th Conference, meaning that political power needs to be obtained and consolidated through military means.

description.zh-cn: 指一个国家或地区的政治统治权力及其执行机构。
description.en: Refers to the political ruling power and its executive bodies in a country or region.

description.zh-cn: 中国湖北省武汉市的一部分，历史上曾为独立的汉口市。这里也是著名哲学家李泽厚的出生地。
description.en: A part of Wuhan, Hubei province, China, historically an independent city. It is also the birthplace of the renowned philosopher Li Zehou.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期成员，因组织秋收起义与毛泽东一同被开除临时政治局候补委员。
description.en: An early member of the Communist Party of China, who was dismissed as an alternate member of the Provisional Politburo along with Mao Zedong for organizing the Autumn Harvest Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，第十三届全国人民代表大会吉林地区代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, and a delegate from the Jilin region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国吉林省长春市代管的县级市，是王艳凤的籍贯地，也是回良玉的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Changchun City, Jilin Province, People's Republic of China. It is Wang Yanfeng's ancestral home and also Hui Liangyu's birthplace.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任中国科学技术协会常委、党组成员、书记处书记，是第十一届全国政协委员。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China and a member of the Chinese Communist Party. He served as a Standing Committee member, Party Leadership Group member, and Secretary of the Secretariat of the China Association for Science and Technology, and was a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Anhui Province, People's Republic of China.

description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee.

description.en: A Chinese politician. He served as Vice Chairman of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC and Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.en: A military figure of the People's Republic of China, holding the rank of Major General in the People's Liberation Army. He formerly served as the commander of the Yunnan Military District.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任人力资源和社会保障部部长、中央机构编制委员会办公室主任，是张肖南的弟弟。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Minister of Human Resources and Social Security and Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission, and the younger brother of Zhang Xiaonan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国公安部副部长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 管理中国武术运动的全国性社会团体。
description.en: A national social organization that manages Wushu sports in China.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平的连襟，在三反运动中被错误批判后自杀。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping's brother-in-law, who committed suicide after being wrongly criticized during the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 冠生园创始人，在五反运动中被迫害跳楼自杀。
description.en: Founder of Guan Sheng Yuan, who was persecuted and committed suicide by jumping from a building during the Five-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 由冼冠生创办的著名食品企业。
description.en: A famous food company founded by Xian Guansheng.

description.zh-cn: 原中共天津地委书记，因在三反运动中被揭发严重贪污，与张子善一同被处决。
description.en: Former secretary of the Tianjin Prefectural Committee of the CPC, who was executed along with Zhang Zishan for serious corruption exposed during the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 三反运动期间揭露的中共高级干部刘青山、张子善的重大贪污案件。
description.en: A major corruption case involving senior CPC cadres Liu Qingshan and Zhang Zishan, exposed during the Three-anti campaign.

description.zh-cn: 上海商业储蓄银行的创办者，在三反五反运动后拒绝返回大陆，定居台湾。
description.en: Founder of the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank, who refused to return to the mainland after the Three-anti and Five-anti campaigns and settled in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员。曾任第十三届全国人民代表大会河北地区代表，现任河北建设集团董事长。
description.en: A Chinese politician, of Han ethnicity, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as a deputy from the Hebei region to the 13th National People's Congress and is the chairman of Hebei Construction Group.

description.zh-cn: 中国著名的话剧院。
description.en: A renowned drama theatre in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国河北省衡水市下辖的县级市。
description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Hengshui City, Hebei Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国电影家组成的全国性人民团体，是中国文学艺术界联合会的团体会员。魏鹤龄是其会员。
description.en: A national-level people's organization composed of filmmakers in the People's Republic of China, and a group member of the China Federation of Literary and Art Circles. Wei Heling was a member.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期国民公会内的激进左翼政治派别，罗伯斯庇尔是其主要成员之一。该派别与吉伦特派对立，在清除吉伦特派后主导国民公会并建立了雅各宾专政，最终在热月政变中失败。
description.en: A radical left-wing political faction within the National Convention during the French Revolution, with Robespierre as a leading member. Opposed to the Girondins, they dominated the Convention and initiated the Reign of Terror after purging their rivals, ultimately being defeated in the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人的主要成员，在国民公会中率先攻击罗伯斯庇尔，引发了热月政变。
description.en: A leading member of the Thermidorians who initiated the attack on Robespierre in the National Convention, sparking the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人的主要成员，在热月政变期间被国民公会任命为部队指挥官，负责逮捕罗伯斯庇尔及其支持者。
description.en: A leading member of the Thermidorians, appointed as commander of troops by the National Convention during the Thermidorian Reaction, responsible for arresting Robespierre and his supporters.

description.zh-cn: 热月党人的主要成员，在策划推翻罗伯斯庇尔的阴谋中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: A leading member of the Thermidorians who played a significant role in plotting the overthrow of Robespierre.

zh-cn: 路易·安托万·德·圣茹斯特
安东万·路易·德·圣茹斯特

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的山岳派领袖，救国委员会成员，罗伯斯庇尔的亲密盟友，在热月政变后与罗伯斯庇尔一同被处决。
description.en: A Montagnard leader during the French Revolution, member of the Committee of Public Safety, and a close ally of Robespierre. He was executed alongside him after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎国民卫队指挥官，罗伯斯庇尔的支持者，在热月政变中试图抵抗但失败，后被处决。
description.en: Commander of the Parisian National Guard and a supporter of Robespierre. He attempted to resist during the Thermidorian Reaction but failed and was subsequently executed.

description.zh-cn: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔的弟弟，在热月政变后一同被捕并被处决。
description.en: The younger brother of Maximilien Robespierre, arrested and executed with him after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 罗伯斯庇尔的盟友，在热月政变后被处决。
description.en: An ally of Robespierre who was executed after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期巴黎的市政府，在推动革命激进化过程中扮演了重要角色，包括策划了1793年5月31日至6月2日的暴动。在热月政变中，它支持罗伯斯庇尔但最终失败，大量成员被处决。
description.en: The municipal government of Paris during the French Revolution, which played an important role in radicalizing the revolution, including organizing the insurrection of May 31 - June 2, 1793. During the Thermidorian Reaction, it supported Robespierre but was ultimately defeated, with many of its members executed.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会主席之一，在热月政变中攻击罗伯斯庇尔，但后来也被流放。
description.en: One of the presidents of the National Convention, who attacked Robespierre during the Thermidorian Reaction but was later exiled.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期最著名和最有影响力的政治派别，以其激进主义和推动恐怖统治而闻名。
description.en: The most famous and influential political faction during the French Revolution, known for its radicalism and for instigating the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 由欧洲多个君主制国家组成的反对法兰西第一共和国的军事同盟，在雅各宾专政时期被法军击败并逐出法国。
description.en: A military alliance of several European monarchies against the French First Republic, which was defeated and driven out of France by French forces during the Jacobin Dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变后发生的一段时期，期间雅各宾派和激进分子遭到热月党人及其支持者的报复性屠杀和镇压。
description.en: A period following the Thermidorian Reaction, during which Jacobins and radicals were subjected to retaliatory massacres and suppression by the Thermidorians and their supporters.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间巴黎的激进下层民众，最初是雅各宾派的有力支持者，但在第一次白色恐怖期间遭到镇压。
description.en: The radical lower-class populace of Paris during the French Revolution, who were initially strong supporters of the Jacobins but were suppressed during the First White Terror.

description.zh-cn: 雅各宾派在恐怖统治时期颁布的一项控制商品价格和工资的法令，在热月政变后被废除。
description.en: A law enacted by the Jacobins during the Reign of Terror to control commodity prices and wages, which was abolished after the Thermidorian Reaction.

description.zh-cn: 由拿破仑·波拿巴指挥的军队镇压了巴黎保皇党人反对国民公会的叛乱。此次事件巩固了热月党人的统治，并确保了向督政府的平稳过渡。
description.en: A revolt led by royalists against the National Convention in Paris was suppressed by troops commanded by Napoleon Bonaparte. This event consolidated the rule of the Thermidorians and ensured a smooth transition to the Directory.

description.zh-cn: 路易十六与玛丽·安托瓦内特的次子。法国大革命期间，他被囚禁，其狱卒安托万·西蒙是罗伯斯庇尔的支持者。在他父亲路易十六被处决后，他被保皇派承认为法兰西国王，但最终在囚禁中早逝。
description.en: The second son of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette. He was imprisoned during the French Revolution, and his jailer, Antoine Simon, was a supporter of Robespierre. After his father Louis XVI's execution, he was recognized by royalists as King of France, but ultimately died young in captivity.

description.zh-cn: 谢文华的出生地，位于安徽省。
description.en: Xie Wenhua's birthplace, located in Anhui Province.

description.en: A specialized agency of the United Nations that leads international efforts to defeat hunger. Gong Li was appointed as a Goodwill Ambassador for the organization in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 联合国的专门机构之一，负责协调全球范围内的环保活动。巩俐于2008年被任命为“全球环境保护大使”。
description.en: A specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for coordinating environmental activities globally. Gong Li was appointed as a Global Environment Ambassador in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 世界三大国际电影节之一。巩俐于2002年担任其第59届评委会主席。
description.en: One of the three major international film festivals. Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for its 59th edition in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 世界三大国际电影节之一。巩俐于1997年担任其第50届评委会成员。
description.en: One of the three major international film festivals. Gong Li served as a member of the jury for its 50th edition in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 国际A类电影节之一。巩俐于2003年担任其第16届评委会主席。
description.en: One of the Class-A international film festivals. Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for its 16th edition in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 国际A类电影节之一。巩俐于2014年担任其第17届评委会主席。
description.en: One of the Class-A international film festivals. Gong Li served as the President of the Jury for its 17th edition in 2014.

description.en: The law that stipulates the establishment, organization, functions, and working system of the people's courts of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在中国大陆，该词指与物质文明并列的一种文明理论及政策，旨在培养有理想、有道德、有文化、有纪律的社会主义公民，提高整个中华民族的思想道德素质和科学文化素质。
description.en: In mainland China, this term refers to a theory and policy of civilization that is juxtaposed with material civilization. It aims to cultivate socialist citizens with ideals, morality, culture, and discipline, and to improve the ideological, moral, scientific, and cultural qualities of the entire Chinese nation.

description.zh-cn: 一种以提高受教育者诸方面素质为目标的教育理论、政策和教育模式，强调人的思想道德素质、能力培养、个性发展、身体健康和心理健康教育，是精神文明建设的组成部分。
description.en: An educational theory, policy, and model aimed at improving all aspects of the educated, emphasizing moral qualities, ability cultivation, personal development, and physical and mental health, and is a component of spiritual civilization construction.

description.zh-cn: 一种旨在培养公民爱国情感的教育活动，是精神文明建设的组成部分。
description.en: An educational activity aimed at cultivating citizens' patriotic feelings, which is a component of spiritual civilization construction.

zh-cn: 中央精神文明建设办公室
中央精神文明建设指导委员会办公室
en: Office of the Central Spiritual Civilization Construction Steering Commission

description.zh-cn: 中央精神文明建设指导委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The administrative office of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization.

description.zh-cn: 中国上古传说中黄帝的史官，被认为是汉字的发明者。
description.en: A legendary historian of the Yellow Emperor in ancient China, regarded as the inventor of Chinese characters.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间编纂的汉字字典，朱邦复曾参考此字典改良仓颉输入法。
description.en: A Chinese character dictionary compiled during the Kangxi era of the Qing Dynasty, which Chu Bong-Foo referenced to improve the Cangjie input method.

description.zh-cn: 指将电脑软硬件及相关技术进行中文语言本地化的过程。
description.en: The process of localizing computer hardware, software, and related technologies for the Chinese language.

description.zh-cn: 由朱邦复构思的一套用以统一处理汉字形、音、义、码、序、辨等问题的综合系统，仓颉输入法是其中的一部分。
description.en: A comprehensive system conceived by Chu Bong-Foo to uniformly handle issues related to the form, sound, meaning, code, order, and distinction of Chinese characters, of which the Cangjie input method is a part.

description.zh-cn: 由微软公司开发的操作系统系列，其内置的仓颉输入法成为主流版本之一。
description.en: An operating system series developed by Microsoft, whose built-in Cangjie input method has become one of the mainstream versions.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的财团法人机构，1990年与朱邦复合作开发微软中文视窗系统3.0。
description.en: A Taiwanese foundation that collaborated with Chu Bong-Foo in 1990 to develop Microsoft Chinese Windows 3.0.

description.zh-cn: 由沈红莲设计的汉字检字法，常被称为“第六代”仓颉，但与第三、五代差异较大，更像一款衍生输入法。
description.en: A character indexing method designed by Shen Honglian, often referred to as the 'sixth generation' Cangjie, but it differs significantly from the third and fifth generations, resembling more of a derivative input method.

description.zh-cn: 由麦志洪自1987年起开发的仓颉输入法衍生版本，旨在提高输入速度。
description.en: A derivative of the Cangjie input method developed by Mak Chi-hung since 1987, aimed at increasing input speed.

description.zh-cn: 一套中文处理系统，快速仓颉输入法最初是在此系统中开发的。
description.en: A Chinese processing system where the Quick Cangjie input method was originally developed.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院秘书长
en: Secretary-General of the State Council of the People's Republic of China

description.en: A constituent position of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, assisting the Premier in handling the daily work of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国福建省宁德市霞浦县下辖的一个镇，杜星垣的出生地。
description.en: A town under the jurisdiction of Xiapu County, Ningde City, Fujian Province, China, and the birthplace of Du Xingyuan.

description.zh-cn: 杜星垣曾就读的中学，现名为霞浦一中。
description.en: The middle school that Du Xingyuan attended, now known as Xiapu No. 1 Middle School.

zh-cn: 中国共产党国务院机关党组

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，原中华全国归国华侨联合会副主席，第七届、第八届全国政协委员。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Vice Chairman of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, and a member of the 7th and 8th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 印度城市，徐发淦的出生地。
description.en: A city in India, birthplace of Xu Fagan.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国君主，韩桓惠王之父。
description.en: King of the State of Han during the Warring States period, father of King Huanhui of Han.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国上党郡太守，因不愿执行将上党割让给秦国的命令而被韩桓惠王罢免。
description.en: The governor of Shangdang Commandery in the State of Han during the Warring States period. He was dismissed by King Huanhui of Han for refusing to carry out the order to cede Shangdang to the State of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国相国，获封应侯。他曾向秦昭襄王献“远交近攻”之策。韩桓惠王为求和曾向其许诺割让上党。
description.en: The prime minister of the State of Qin during the Warring States period, enfeoffed as Marquis of Ying. He proposed the strategy of 'allying with distant states while attacking nearby ones' to King Zhaoxiang of Qin. King Huanhui of Han also once promised to cede Shangdang to him in exchange for peace.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期韩国上党郡太守，接替靳黈后，不愿降秦而率领当地军民归顺赵国，直接引发了长平之战。
description.en: The governor of Shangdang Commandery in the State of Han during the Warring States period. After succeeding Jin Tou, he refused to surrender to Qin and led the local army and people to align with the State of Zhao, directly triggering the Battle of Changping.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期赵国名将，在长平之战初期率领赵军抵抗秦军。
description.en: A renowned general of the State of Zhao during the Warring States period, who led the Zhao army against the Qin forces in the early stages of the Battle of Changping.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军南京市军事管制委员会
en: Chinese People's Liberation Army Nanjing Municipal Military Control Commission

description.zh-cn: 南京市在军事管制期间的最高权力机关，先后于1949年和1967年两次成立。
description.en: The highest authority in Nanjing during the period of military control, established twice in 1949 and 1967.

description.zh-cn: 一种由军队接管民事政权的特殊状态，通常在战争或紧急情况下实施。
description.en: A special state in which the military takes over civil power, usually implemented during war or emergencies.

description.zh-cn: 南京市的最高国家行政机关，其职能机构存在于1955年至1968年间。
description.en: The highest state administrative organ of Nanjing City, which functioned as the government body from 1955 to 1968.

description.en: A joint declaration signed in 2018 by South Korean President Moon Jae-in and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un during the Inter-Korean Summit. description.en: A former higher education institution under the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation.

description.zh-cn: 负责保卫朝鲜最高领导人及其家人、高级官员和国家重要设施的军事单位。
description.en: A military unit responsible for the security of North Korea's supreme leader, his family, high-ranking officials, and important state facilities.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜人民军的最高军事指挥机关。
description.en: The supreme military command organ of the Korean People's Army.

location.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的首都和最大城市，也是金正哲的出生地。
description.en: The capital and largest city of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, and the birthplace of Kim Jong-chul.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华民国湖北省汉口市

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省佛山市三水区
death_place.en: Sanshui District, Foshan, Guangdong, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆男演员，因外形酷似毛泽东而成为著名的特型演员，在84部影视作品中扮演毛泽东。
description.en: A mainland Chinese actor, famous as a look-alike actor for portraying Mao Zedong in 84 film and television productions.

en: Chairman Mao en route to Anyuan

description.zh-cn: 一幅描绘青年毛泽东的著名油画，在文化大革命期间广为流传。
description.en: A famous oil painting depicting a young Mao Zedong, which was widely distributed during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国剧作家，曾任解放军艺术学院院长。
description.en: A Chinese playwright who once served as the president of the PLA Academy of Art.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军文化艺术中心电影电视制作部

description.zh-cn: 中国唯一的军队电影制片厂。
description.en: The only military film studio in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员，副总警监警衔。原中国人民武装警察部队将领，长期在公安边防部队任职，现任中国人民警察大学党委书记。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, of Han ethnicity, a member of the Communist Party of China, holding the police rank of Deputy Commissioner General. He is a former general of the People's Armed Police, served for a long term in the Public Security Border Troops, and currently serves as the Party Secretary of the China People's Police University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公安部直属的公安警察院校之一。
description.en: One of the police academies directly under the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

en: Border Control Department of the Ministry of Public Security
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公安部边防管理局

description.zh-cn: 田喜荣的出生地。
description.en: Birthplace of Tian Xirong.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任朔州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former mayor of the Shuozhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任朔州市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former mayor of the Shuozhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党朔州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former secretary of the CPC Shuozhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国福建省下辖地级市，是郑栅洁的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Fujian Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Zheng Shanjie.

en: Fujian Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China
zh-cn: 中国共产党福建省纪律检查委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在福建省的纪律检查机关。
description.en: The discipline inspection agency of the Communist Party of China in Fujian Province.

zh-cn: 国务院学位委员会第七届学科评议组
国务院学位委员会第二届学科评议组
国务院学位委员会第五届学科评议组
国务院学位委员会第六届学科评议组
en: Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 是中华人民共和国国务院设立的直属机构，负责领导全国学位工作。该机构也是国务院学位委员会的学术评议机构之一，著名经济学家孙冶方曾任其评议组成员。
description.en: It is a direct subordinate institution established by the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for leading national academic degree work. It also serves as one of the academic review bodies of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council, and the renowned economist Sun Yefang once served as a member of its review group.

description.zh-cn: 李国璋的家乡和出生地。
description.en: The hometown and birthplace of Li Guozhang.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华民国江苏省苏州市吴县
birth_place.en: Wu County, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, Republic of China

death_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国天津市

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，战后赴台协助建立中共台湾省工委学工委并担任书记，因光明报案爆发后返回中国大陆，在天津大学任教直至退休。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party who went to Taiwan after the war to help establish the Student Work Committee of the CPC Taiwan Provincial Working Committee and served as its secretary. He returned to mainland China after the outbreak of the Guangming Daily incident and taught at Tianjin University until his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省苏州市下辖的县，为徐懋德的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, and the birthplace of Xu Maode.

description.zh-cn: 徐懋德的师长，对其思想左倾产生重要影响，并介绍其加入新四军。
description.en: Xu Maode's teacher who had a significant leftist influence on him and introduced him to the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 中共地下党员，受徐懋德派遣成立外围组织“新民主同志会”。
description.en: An underground member of the CCP, dispatched by Xu Maode to establish the peripheral organization 'New Democratic Comrades Association'.

description.zh-cn: 该组织于1947年由李登辉等青年组建，最初为一个左派团体，后被中国共产党吸收，成为一个由陈炳基在徐懋德指示下成立的中共外围组织，旨在吸收台湾青年。
description.en: The organization was formed in 1947 by youths including Lee Teng-hui, initially as a leftist group. It was later absorbed by the Chinese Communist Party, becoming a peripheral organization of the CCP established by Chen Bingji under Xu Maode's instructions, aimed at recruiting Taiwanese youth.

description.zh-cn: 被吸收加入新民主同志会的人员之一。
description.en: One of the individuals recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 被吸收加入新民主同志会的人员之一。
description.en: One of the individuals recruited into the New Democratic Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 中共地下党员，在徐懋德潜返大陆后接替其领导学工委，后在光明报案中被捕。
description.en: An underground member of the CCP who took over the leadership of the Student Work Committee after Xu Maode fled to the mainland, and was later arrested in the Guangming Daily incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共党员，在师范大学发展组织。徐懋德在潜返大陆前曾告知其危险。
description.en: A CCP member who developed the organization at National Taiwan Normal University. Xu Maode warned him of the danger before fleeing to the mainland.

description.zh-cn: 中共地下党员，在光明报案中与李水井一同被捕。
description.en: An underground member of the CCP, arrested along with Li Shuijing in the Guangming Daily incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本设于关东州的军政机构，其陆军部于1919年独立为关东军。
description.en: A military and administrative body established by Japan in the Kwantung Leased Territory. Its army department became the independent Kwantung Army in 1919.

description.zh-cn: 1939年，日本关东军与苏联红军及蒙古军队在满蒙边界诺门罕地区爆发大规模未宣战的边境冲突。关东军在此战中惨败，731部队也首次使用了细菌武器。
description.en: In 1939, a large-scale undeclared border conflict erupted between the Japanese Kwantung Army, the Soviet Red Army, and Mongolian forces in the Nomonhan region on the Manchu-Mongolian border. The Kwantung Army suffered a decisive defeat, and Unit 731 deployed bacteriological weapons for the first time during this battle.

zh-cn: 格奥尔基·康斯坦丁诺维奇·朱可夫

description.zh-cn: 苏联军事将领，在诺门罕战役中指挥苏联远东军击败了关东军。
description.en: A Soviet military general who commanded the Soviet Far East Army to defeat the Kwantung Army in the Battles of Nomonhan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军军官。曾任第九师团长，在虹口公园爆炸案中受伤。后晋升为大将，并担任关东军司令官，但因诺门罕战役失败被撤职。
description.en: An officer in the Imperial Japanese Army. He served as commander of the 9th Division and was injured in the Hongkou Park bombing. He was later promoted to general and became commander of the Kwantung Army, but was dismissed following the defeat in the Battles of Nomonhan.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军大将，关东军最后一任总司令，于1945年8月19日向苏军投降。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Japanese Army and the last commander of the Kwantung Army, who surrendered to the Soviet forces on August 19, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 1946年2月，由原关东军125师团残部联合国民党发起的武装暴动，被东北民主联军镇压。
description.en: An armed rebellion launched in February 1946 by remnants of the former Kwantung Army's 125th Division in alliance with the Kuomintang, which was suppressed by the Northeast Democratic United Army.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯去世后，中国陷入的分裂时期，期间国家由各地北洋军将领分裂成的军阀势力所控制。
description.en: A period of division in China following the death of Yuan Shikai, during which the country was controlled by warlord factions that emerged from the fragmentation of the Beiyang Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国吉林省延边朝鲜族自治州下辖的县级市，同时也是杨小凯的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture, Jilin Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Yang Xiaokai.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共延边朝鲜族自治州委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Party Secretary of Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替姜治莹担任中共延边朝鲜族自治州委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Jiang Zhiying as Party Secretary of Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共吉林省委政法委员会书记，是马俊清的继任者。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee and successor of Ma Junqing.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替姜治莹担任中共吉林省委政法委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Jiang Zhiying as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共吉林省委统战部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former head of the United Front Work Department of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替姜治莹担任中共吉林省委统战部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Jiang Zhiying as head of the United Front Work Department of the Jilin Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替姜治莹担任中共白城市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Jiang Zhiying as Party Secretary of Baicheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任长春市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Mayor of Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任长春市人民政府市长，接替姜治莹。因2018年长春长生疫苗事件被要求引咎辞职。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as Mayor of Changchun Municipal People's Government, succeeding Jiang Zhiying. He was asked to resign in 2018 due to the Changsheng vaccine scandal.

description.zh-cn: 中国人口、资源与环境经济学家，吉林大学教授、博士生导师、校友及前副校长。他也是中国共产党党员，并曾担任国务院学位委员会学科评议组成员、中国人口学会副会长、中国高等教育学会常务理事。
description.en: A Chinese economist specializing in population, resources, and environmental economics. He is a professor, doctoral supervisor, alumnus, and former vice president of Jilin University. He is also a member of the Communist Party of China and has served as a member of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council's disciplinary review group, vice president of the China Population Association, and an executive council member of the China Association of Higher Education.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共嘉峪关市委书记，甘肃省人大常委会秘书长、副主任，第十届全国人大代表。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary of the CPC Jiayuguan Municipal Committee, Secretary-General and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress, and a deputy to the 10th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张开勋的出生地。
description.en: Birthplace of Zhang Kaixun.

zh-cn: 中国共产党嘉峪关市委员会

en: Law on the Protection of Minors of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国未成年人保护法

description.zh-cn: 为保护未成年人的身心健康，保障未成年人的合法权益，促进未成年人在品德、智力、体质等方面全面发展而制定的法律。
description.en: A law enacted to protect the physical and mental health of minors, safeguard their legitimate rights and interests, and promote their all-round development in morality, intelligence, and physique.

en: Labour Law of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国劳动法

description.zh-cn: 为保护劳动者的合法权益，调整劳动关系，建立和维护适应社会主义市场经济的劳动制度，促进经济发展和社会进步而制定的法律。
description.en: A law enacted to protect the legitimate rights and interests of laborers, adjust labor relations, establish and maintain a labor system adapted to the socialist market economy, and promote economic development and social progress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府对农村义务教育阶段贫困家庭学生免除学杂费、书本费，并补助寄宿生生活费的一项政策。
description.en: A policy of the Chinese government to exempt students from poor rural families in the compulsory education stage from tuition and textbook fees, and to provide subsidies for boarding students' living expenses.

en: Literacy education in the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国扫盲教育

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后在全国范围内开展的旨在消除文盲的群众性运动。
description.en: A mass movement launched nationwide after the founding of the People's Republic of China aimed at eliminating illiteracy.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史上第一个以大总统令公布、实施、并影响全国的学制，又称“1922年学制”或“新学制”。
description.en: The first educational system in modern Chinese history to be promulgated by presidential decree, implemented, and influential nationwide, also known as the '1922 system' or the 'New School System'.

description.zh-cn: 一种教育阶段的划分方式，指小学六年、初中三年的学制。
description.en: A way of dividing educational stages, referring to a system of six years of primary school and three years of junior high school.

description.zh-cn: 一种以应付考试为主要目的的教育方式，教学内容和进度紧密围绕考试大纲，忽视学生的全面发展。
description.en: An educational approach primarily aimed at preparing for exams, where teaching content and pace closely follow the exam syllabus, often neglecting the all-round development of students.

zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市中级人民法院

location.zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市洛阳新区
location.en: Luoyang New Area, Luoyang City, Henan Province

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河南省设立在洛阳市的中级人民法院。
description.en: The Intermediate People's Court of the People's Republic of China established in Luoyang City, Henan Province.

zh-cn: 中国共产党洛阳市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在洛阳市的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Communist Party of China in Luoyang City.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国设立在地区、地级市、自治州、盟以及直辖市的法院。它们是四级法院体系中的第二级人民法院，也是地方审判机关中承上启下的重要环节。
description.en: Courts established in prefectures, prefecture-level cities, autonomous prefectures, leagues, and municipalities directly under the Central Government in the People's Republic of China. They are the second level of people's courts in the four-level court system, serving as a crucial link connecting higher and lower local judicial organs.

description.zh-cn: 河南省洛阳市中级人民法院法官，因审理“河南种子案”而知名。
description.en: A judge of the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province, known for presiding over the 'Henan Seed Case'.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国种子法

description.zh-cn: 河南省的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The local organ of state power in Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 2003年5月，洛阳市中级人民法院审理的一起民事案件。审判长李慧娟因认定《河南省农作物种子管理条例》的部分条款抵触《中华人民共和国种子法》而无效，引发了司法与立法的冲突。
description.en: A civil case tried by the Luoyang Intermediate People's Court in May 2003. The presiding judge, Li Huijuan, ruled that some provisions of the 'Henan Provincial Regulations on the Administration of Crop Seeds' were invalid because they conflicted with the 'Seed Law of the People's Republic of China', which triggered a conflict between the judiciary and the legislature.

zh-cn: 栾川男子扇打老师事件

description.zh-cn: 一起因学生殴打20年前的班主任而引发的寻衅滋事案。
description.en: A case of 'picking quarrels and provoking trouble' arising from a student beating his class teacher from 20 years ago.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖北省武汉市的一所中学。
description.en: A secondary school located in Wuhan, Hubei.

en: General Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC
General Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部办公厅

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部内设的综合性行政管理机构。
description.en: A comprehensive administrative management body within the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国在丹麦王国设立的外交代表机构。
description.en: The diplomatic mission of the People's Republic of China in the Kingdom of Denmark.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国在波兰共和国设立的外交代表机构。
description.en: The diplomatic mission of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Jiangsu Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 习近平提出的政治理论，指中国特色社会主义道路自信、理论自信、制度自信、文化自信。
description.en: A political theory proposed by Xi Jinping, referring to confidence in the path, theory, system, and culture of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 习近平提出的政治要求，指政治意识、大局意识、核心意识、看齐意识。
description.en: A political requirement proposed by Xi Jinping, referring to consciousness of politics, the bigger picture, the core, and alignment.

description.zh-cn: 习近平提出的政治要求，指坚决维护习近平总书记党中央的核心、全党的核心地位，坚决维护党中央权威和集中统一领导。
description.en: A political requirement proposed by Xi Jinping, referring to resolutely upholding General Secretary Xi Jinping's core position on the Party Central Committee and in the Party as a whole, and resolutely upholding the Party Central Committee's authority and its centralized, unified leadership.

description.zh-cn: 2016年5月在北京发生的一起备受争议的民众死亡事件，雷洋在被警方拘捕过程中死亡，该事件引发了公众对执法权的广泛质疑。
description.en: A controversial death incident that occurred in Beijing in May 2016, where Lei Yang died during police custody, sparking widespread public questioning of law enforcement powers.

description.zh-cn: 一种选举方式，候选人名额多于应选名额。中共十三大首次采用此方式选举中央委员会等机构。
description.en: An election method where the number of candidates is greater than the number of positions to be filled. The 13th CPC National Congress used this method for the first time to elect bodies like the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军中将，曾任中国人民解放军南部战区海军司令员、海军副司令员、北部战区海军参谋长，以及辽宁号航空母舰首位航母编队司令员。
description.en: A vice admiral of the People's Liberation Army Navy of China, who has served as commander of the Southern Theater Command Navy, deputy commander of the Navy, chief of staff of the Northern Theater Command Navy, and the first commander of the Liaoning aircraft carrier formation.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任中共中央政治局候补委员、全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese politician, then an alternate member of the Politburo and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 壮族中国政治人物，成克杰的前任广西壮族自治区主席。
description.en: A Zhuang Chinese politician and the predecessor of Cheng Kejie as the Chairman of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中共内蒙古自治区党委第一书记，是周惠的前任。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, who served as the First Secretary of the CPC Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee and was Zhou Hui's predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，回族，曾任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: Chinese politician of Hui ethnicity, who served as Chairman of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，原东北人民政府工业部副部长，1952年8月起任中央人民政府重工业部副部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Minister of Industry of the Northeast People's Government, appointed Vice Minister of the Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry in August 1952.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，满族。
description.en: Chinese politician, of Manchu ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，黄璜的前任中共宁夏回族自治区党委书记。

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物。

description.en: The personality cult surrounding Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 京东集团的创始人。
description.en: Founder of JD.com.

description.zh-cn: 中国一家跨国企业控股公司，是世界上最大的视频游戏供应商，业务涵盖社交媒体、娱乐、人工智能和技术等。作为中国互联网巨头，曾因“360隐私保护器”和“扣扣保镖”与奇虎360爆发著名的“3Q大战”，双方就商业诋毁、不正当竞争等问题多次对簿公堂。
description.en: A Chinese multinational technology and entertainment conglomerate and holding company, which is the world's largest video game provider, with businesses spanning social media, entertainment, artificial intelligence, and technology. As a prominent Chinese internet giant, it famously engaged in the '3Q War' with Qihoo 360, sparked by the '360 Privacy Protector' and 'KouKou Bodyguard' software, leading to multiple lawsuits between the parties concerning commercial defamation and unfair competition.

description.zh-cn: 腾讯公司总裁及执行董事，1990年香港中学会考9优状元。毕业于英皇书院。
description.en: President and Executive Director of Tencent. He was a 9A scholar in the 1990 HKCEE. He is an alumnus of King's College.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国零售企业，总部设在阿肯色州本顿维，为世界上最大的公司。

description.zh-cn: 中国B2C电子商务网站，后被京东从沃尔玛收购。
description.en: A Chinese B2C e-commerce website, later acquired by JD.com from Walmart.

zh-cn: 京东数字科技控股有限公司

description.zh-cn: 原为京东集团的金融部门，后被剥离独立运营。
description.en: Formerly the financial arm of JD.com, later spun off to operate independently.

description.zh-cn: 中国网络名人、投资人，刘强东的妻子。
description.en: Chinese internet celebrity, investor, and wife of Liu Qiangdong.

description.zh-cn: 中国脱口秀演员。
description.en: A Chinese stand-up comedian.

description.zh-cn: 指一种备受争议的“早上9点上班，晚上9点下班，每周工作6天”工作制度，常见于中国大陆部分互联网公司。马云曾对此发表争议性言论。
description.en: Refers to a controversial work system of '9 a.m. to 9 p.m., 6 days a week', common in some mainland Chinese internet companies. Jack Ma made controversial remarks about it.

description.zh-cn: 中国财富和资产管理服务提供商。
description.en: A Chinese wealth and asset management service provider.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海市的专门人民法院，管辖上海市辖区内相关金融民商事案件和金融行政案件。
description.en: A specialized court in Shanghai, China, with jurisdiction over relevant financial civil, commercial, and administrative cases within Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰西南部的一个郡，约翰·洛克的出生地。
description.en: A county in South West England, birthplace of John Locke.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰东部的一个郡，约翰·洛克的逝世地。
description.en: A county in the East of England, where John Locke died.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦的一所著名公学，约翰·洛克曾在此就读。
description.en: A famous public school in London, where John Locke studied.

description.zh-cn: 英国的國家科學院，是英国的科学学会。约翰·洛克、亚当·斯密（1773年当选）均曾是其院士。汤川秀树于1963年当选为其外籍会士。
description.en: The national academy of sciences of the United Kingdom, a learned society for science. John Locke and Adam Smith (elected in 1773) were fellows. Hideki Yukawa was elected a Foreign Member in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治哲学家，其独裁主义政治哲学受到约翰·洛克的批评。
description.en: An English political philosopher whose authoritarian political philosophy was criticized by John Locke.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王，洛克曾因被怀疑涉嫌刺杀他的阴谋而流亡。
description.en: King of England, Scotland, and Ireland. Locke was exiled due to suspicion of involvement in a plot to assassinate him.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·洛克最重要的政治论文之一，提出了政府正当性的理论，并反驳了君权神授说。
description.en: One of John Locke's most important political essays, which proposed a theory of legitimate government and refuted the divine right of kings.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治理论家，主张君权神授，其理论被洛克在《政府论》中驳斥。
description.en: An English political theorist who advocated for the divine right of kings, a theory refuted by Locke in his 'Two Treatises of Government'.

description.zh-cn: 英国物理学家、数学家，曾与约翰·洛克讨论各种议题。
description.en: An English physicist and mathematician who discussed various topics with John Locke.

description.zh-cn: 法国启蒙运动时期的思想家、哲学家，深受约翰·洛克著作的影响，亚当·斯密在欧陆游历期间曾与他会面。
description.en: A French Enlightenment writer and philosopher, greatly influenced by the works of John Locke, and whom Adam Smith met during his travels on the continent.

description.zh-cn: 日内瓦哲学家、作家和作曲家，其著作受到约翰·洛克影响，政治哲学深刻推动了启蒙运动、法国大革命以及现代政治、经济和教育思想的发展。
description.en: A Genevan philosopher, writer, and composer whose works were influenced by John Locke, and whose political philosophy significantly impacted the Enlightenment, French Revolution, and modern political, economic, and educational thought.

en: Founding Fathers of the United States

description.zh-cn: 指签署《美国独立宣言》和《美国宪法》的政治领导人，他们的思想受到约翰·洛克理论的影响。
description.en: The political leaders who signed the Declaration of Independence or the United States Constitution, whose ideas were influenced by John Locke's theories.

description.zh-cn: 北美十三州宣告脱离大不列颠王国独立的文件，受到洛克的古典共和主义和自由主义观念影响。
description.en: The document in which the Thirteen Colonies declared their independence from Great Britain, influenced by Locke's concepts of classical republicanism and liberalism.

description.zh-cn: 法国哲学家，其著作启发了约翰·洛克的兴趣，但洛克反对其天赋观念理论。
description.en: A French philosopher whose writings sparked John Locke's interest, though Locke disagreed with his theory of innate ideas.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·洛克的哲学著作，提出了心灵是一块“白板”的假设，是英国经验主义的代表作。
description.en: A major philosophical work by John Locke, proposing the hypothesis that the mind is a 'tabula rasa' (blank slate), and a key text of British empiricism.

description.zh-cn: 一种意识形态和政治哲学，约翰·洛克被认为是其奠基者。
description.en: An ideology and political philosophy, of which John Locke is considered a founder.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪末北美十三殖民地脱离大英帝国，创建美国的革命。洛克的理论激励了这场革命。
description.en: The revolution in the late 18th century in which the Thirteen Colonies in North America broke away from the British Empire to create the United States. Locke's theories inspired this revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英国历史上的一个政党，洛克的雇主沙夫茨伯里伯爵是其创始人之一，洛克的政治思想深受其影响。
description.en: A historical political party in England. Locke's patron, the Earl of Shaftesbury, was one of its founders, and Locke's political thought was greatly influenced by it.

In 2018, they collectively retired from active service and were transferred to the Ministry of Emergency Management as complete units.

description.en: Chinese fiscal economist. He was labeled a 'rightist' during the Anti-Rightist Movement in 1957 and worked in the Daliang Mountains in Sichuan in 1960. He received the State Council Special Government Allowance in 1993 and the Lifetime Achievement Award for Chinese Fiscal Theory Research from the China Fiscal Society in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史上首位留学美国的学生，被誉为“中国留学生之父”。他积极推动并促成了清政府派遣幼童赴美留学计划。回国后，他支持维新与革命，在上海“中国议会”上被选为议长，并是自立军起义的重要策划者之一。
description.en: The first Chinese student to study in the United States, he is known as the 'Father of Chinese students studying abroad.' He actively promoted and was instrumental in the establishment of the Qing government's plan to send young students to the U.S. for study. After returning to China, he supported both reform and revolution, was elected chairman of the 'China Congress' in Shanghai, and was a key planner of the Self-Support Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 清政府在1872年至1875年间先后派遣的四批共一百二十名赴美国留学的幼童。这是中国最早的官派留学活动。

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末年农民起义的领袖之一，与吴广一同发动大泽乡起义，后建立张楚政权并自立为王。
description.en: One of the leaders of the peasant uprising at the end of the Qin Dynasty, who launched the Dazexiang Uprising with Wu Guang and later established the Zhangchu regime, declaring himself king.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝末年农民起义的领袖之一，与陈胜一同发动大泽乡起义。
description.en: One of the leaders of the peasant uprising at the end of the Qin Dynasty, who launched the Dazexiang Uprising with Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 陈胜麾下的将军，曾率军西击秦朝，一度逼近咸阳。
description.en: A general under Chen Sheng who led an army to attack the Qin dynasty from the west, once approaching the capital Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 吴广的部将，后杀害吴广。
description.en: A subordinate general of Wu Guang, who later killed him.

description.zh-cn: 陈胜的部下，在陈胜死后组织“苍头军”重夺陈县，为陈胜报仇。
description.en: A subordinate of Chen Sheng who, after Chen's death, organized the 'Cangtou Army' to recapture Chen County and avenge Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 原楚国贵族，被吕臣拥立为王，重建张楚政权。
description.en: A former noble of the State of Chu, who was installed as king by Lü Chen to re-establish the Zhangchu regime.

description.zh-cn: 西汉开国功臣，官至太尉、丞相。曾与周勃一同诋毁陈平。
description.en: A founding general of the Western Han dynasty who served as Grand Marshal and Chancellor. He once slandered Chen Ping along with Zhou Bo.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖十一年所设置的诸侯国。
description.en: A vassal kingdom established in the eleventh year of Emperor Gaozu of Han's reign.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝的监察区之一。
description.en: One of the inspectorate regions of the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明末政治人物。崇祯四年进士，曾任辉县知县、兵部主事、湖广佥事等职。后擢为河南巡抚，未及上任，因张献忠攻破襄阳而不屈殉国。
description.en: A political figure of the late Ming Dynasty. After passing the imperial examination in 1631, he served in various roles including Magistrate of Huixian, Secretary in the Ministry of War, and Surveillance Commissioner in Huguang. He was later promoted to Governor of Henan, but was killed by Zhang Xianzhong's forces in Xiangyang before he could assume office.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，任推官，在张献忠攻破襄阳时殉职。
description.en: An official of the Ming Dynasty with the rank of Tuiguan (Judge), who died in the line of duty when Xiangyang fell to Zhang Xianzhong.

description.zh-cn: 明末时期由农民组成的起义武装力量的泛称。
description.en: A general term for the rebel armed forces composed of peasants during the late Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝山西潞安府下辖的一个县，是张克俭的籍贯所在地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Lu'an Prefecture, Shanxi, during the Ming Dynasty, and the ancestral home of Zhang Kejian.

description.zh-cn: 明朝湖广地区的军事重镇，张克俭等人在此地被张献忠杀害。
description.en: A key military stronghold in the Huguang region during the Ming Dynasty, where Zhang Kejian and others were killed by Zhang Xianzhong.

description.zh-cn: 明朝河南省下辖的一个县，张克俭曾在此地任知县。
description.en: A county in Henan Province during the Ming Dynasty, where Zhang Kejian once served as magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 位于河北省的一个县。明朝时期，农民军曾在此地与明军交战。后来，军阀孙殿英被俘后，在此地的战俘营中死亡。
description.en: A county located in Hebei Province. During the Ming Dynasty, peasant rebels clashed with Ming forces here. Later, warlord Sun Dianying died in a prisoner-of-war camp here after his capture.

description.en: The administrative body of an Administrative Inspectorate Area during the period of the Republic of China on the mainland, and the predecessor of the Special Administrative Office.

description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, a member of the Communist Party of China, and a deputy representing the Jiangsu region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 秦末魏国宗室，被陈胜部将周巿立为魏王。
description.en: A member of the royal family of the Wei state during the late Qin dynasty, installed as the King of Wei by Zhou Shi, a general under Chen Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 项羽麾下重要将领之一，后因陈平的反间计而被项羽猜忌。
description.en: One of Xiang Yu's key generals, who later fell under Xiang Yu's suspicion due to Chen Ping's plot to sow discord.

description.zh-cn: 吕后之妹，樊哙之妻。因陈平曾奉命捉拿樊哙而记恨陈平，并向吕后进谗言。
description.en: The younger sister of Empress Lü and wife of Fan Kuai. She held a grudge against Chen Ping for his role in arresting Fan Kuai and slandered him to Empress Lü.

description.zh-cn: 西汉初年大臣，官至右丞相。曾因反对吕后封诸吕为王而被罢免。
description.en: A minister in the early Western Han dynasty who served as Chancellor of the Right. He was dismissed for opposing Empress Lü's decision to ennoble members of the Lü clan as kings.

description.zh-cn: 陈平的哥哥。在陈平年少时耕田供养其读书。
description.en: Chen Ping's elder brother. He farmed to support Chen Ping's studies during their youth.

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局和新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府双重领导的事业单位，承担新疆维吾尔自治区行政区域内防震减灾工作的政府行政管理职能。
description.en: A public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the People's Government of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, responsible for the administrative management of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction within the administrative area of Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院直属事业单位，原名国家地震局，主管全国防震减灾工作。
description.en: A public institution directly under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, formerly known as the State Seismological Bureau, in charge of nationwide earthquake prevention and disaster reduction.

description.zh-cn: 苏联军事将领、苏联元帅。他曾任苏联远东军区司令，并作为红旗远东特别集团军司令指挥苏军在中东路事件中作战。
description.en: A Soviet military commander and Marshal of the Soviet Union. He served as commander of the Soviet Far Eastern Military District and, as commander of the Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army, led Soviet forces in the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，与范石生、朱德等人为云南陆军讲武堂同学并结为兄弟。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army, a classmate and sworn brother of Fan Shisheng, Zhu De, and others at the Yunnan Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，与范石生、朱德等人结为兄弟。后在范石生军内任前敌总指挥时被刺杀。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army and a sworn brother of Fan Shisheng, Zhu De, and others. He was later assassinated while serving as the frontline commander in Fan Shisheng's army.

description.zh-cn: 1911年10月30日（农历九月初九），蔡锷等人在昆明发动武装起义，旨在响应武昌起义。
description.en: On October 30, 1911 (the ninth day of the ninth lunar month), Cai E and others launched an armed uprising in Kunming, in response to the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期以云南籍军人为主组成的地方军队。
description.en: A regional army in the Republic of China era, primarily composed of soldiers from Yunnan.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，曾维护与顾品珍发生矛盾的范石生。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army who defended Fan Shisheng during his conflict with Gu Pinzhen.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，顾品珍死后任副总司令，曾与范石生一同主张讨伐陈炯明。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army. After Gu Pinzhen's death, he served as deputy commander-in-chief and, along with Fan Shisheng, advocated for a punitive expedition against Chen Jiongming.

en: 16th Army of the National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 由范石生部改编而成的国民革命军部队。
description.en: A unit of the National Revolutionary Army formed by reorganizing Fan Shisheng's troops.

description.zh-cn: 1928年4月，朱德、陈毅率领的南昌起义余部及湘南农军与毛泽东率领的秋收起义部队在井冈山的会合。
description.en: The meeting of the remaining forces of the Nanchang Uprising led by Zhu De and Chen Yi and the Hunan peasants' army with the Autumn Harvest Uprising troops led by Mao Zedong in the Jinggang Mountains in April 1928.

en: National Security Bureau of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国最重要的情报机关，隶属于国家安全会议，负责国家安全及情报、特种勤务等工作。
description.en: The principal intelligence agency of the Republic of China (Taiwan), responsible for national security, intelligence gathering, and special services.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物、外交官，接任陈明通担任国家安全局局长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and diplomat who succeeded Chen Ming-tong as Director-General of the National Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国官员，曾任中共中央台湾工作办公室副主任，曾与陈明通在台北会谈中就两岸认同问题进行辩论。
description.en: An official of the People's Republic of China who served as Deputy Director of the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council. He debated with Chen Ming-tong on cross-strait identity issues during the Taipei talks.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任桃园市市长。他是陈明通指导的硕士生，后因论文抄袭被国立台湾大学撤销学位。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the mayor of Taoyuan. He was a master's student supervised by Chen Ming-tong, but his degree was later revoked by National Taiwan University due to plagiarism.

description.zh-cn: 张邦英的出生地，现为铜川市耀州区。
description.en: The birthplace of Zhang Bangying, now Yaozhou District, Tongchuan City.

zh-cn: 九三学社黑龙江省委员会

description.zh-cn: 九三学社在黑龙江省的地方组织，行政级别为正厅级。
description.en: The local organization of the Jiusan Society in Heilongjiang Province, with a departmental-level administrative ranking.

description.zh-cn: 九三学社的中央领导机构。
description.en: The central leading body of the Jiusan Society.

description.zh-cn: 历史上由阿拉伯人建立的哈里发国家。
description.en: Caliphates established by Arabs in history.

description.zh-cn: 元朝第五位皇帝。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代官职，为礼部副长官。
description.en: An ancient Chinese official position, the deputy head of the Ministry of Rites.

description.zh-cn: 元代地方长官官职。
description.en: An official title for a local governor in the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初诗人。
description.en: Poet of the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 元朝末年，由汉族人为主的全国性大规模反元起事。
description.en: A series of nationwide uprisings, primarily by Han Chinese, against the Yuan dynasty in its final years.

zh-cn: 乡村建设育才学院专修科
四川省重庆市育才中学
四川省重庆第二十中学
重庆市第二十初级中学
重庆市第十三初级中学

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重庆市九龙坡区谢家湾正街92号
location.en: No. 92, Xiejiawan Main Street, Jiulongpo District, Chongqing, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 位于中国重庆市的中学，由教育家陶行知于1939年创办，是重庆市教育委员会直属重点中学。
description.en: A secondary school in Chongqing, China, founded by educator Tao Xingzhi in 1939. It is a key secondary school directly under the Chongqing Municipal Education Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾应邀到育才学校演讲。
description.en: A political figure of the Republic of China who was invited to give a speech at Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 中国记者、政治家和出版家，曾应邀到育才学校演讲。
description.en: A Chinese journalist, politician, and publisher who was invited to give a speech at Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 中国音乐家，曾在育才学校担任音乐组组长。
description.en: Chinese musician who served as the head of the music group at Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 中国版画家，曾在育才学校担任绘画组组长，并设计了第一代校徽。
description.en: Chinese printmaker who served as the head of the painting group at Yucai School and designed its first emblem.

description.zh-cn: 中国舞蹈家，曾在育才学校担任舞蹈组组长。
description.en: Chinese dancer who served as the head of the dance group at Yucai School.

description.zh-cn: 重庆市人民政府的组成部门，主管全市教育事业和语言文字工作。
description.en: A component department of the Chongqing Municipal People's Government, responsible for the city's education and language work.

description.zh-cn: 曾在1947年至1948年间主持重庆育才学校工作。
description.en: Presided over the work of Chongqing Yucai School from 1947 to 1948.

description.zh-cn: 重庆市育才中学校现任校长。
description.en: The current principal of Chongqing Yucai Secondary School.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 热河省下辖的县级行政单位。在政治语境中，指其政府机构。
description.en: A county-level administrative unit under Rehe Province. In a political context, it refers to its government body.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国和中华人民共和国初期的省份。在政治语境中，指其政府机构。
description.en: A province during the Republic of China and the early People's Republic of China. In a political context, it refers to its government body.

description.zh-cn: 中国材料力学领域专家，中国科学院院士，美国国家工程院外籍院士。曾任北京大学工学院教授，现任北京理工大学副校长。
description.en: A Chinese expert in materials mechanics, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and a foreign member of the US National Academy of Engineering. He was a professor at the College of Engineering of Peking University and currently serves as the Vice President of Beijing Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 江西省的政府驻地（省会）。
description.en: The seat of government (provincial capital) of Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 一门研究材料在各种外力作用下产生的应变和应力，以及刚度和强度的学科。
description.en: A discipline that studies the strain and stress generated in materials under various external forces, as well as their stiffness and strength.

zh-cn: 马里兰大学学院市分校
深圳-北理工-莫斯科大学

description.zh-cn: 指在获得博士学位后，于高等院校或研究机构中进行限期性研究工作的人员职位。
description.en: Refers to a position for individuals who conduct limited-term research at a university or research institute after obtaining a doctoral degree.

description.zh-cn: 美国的一个州，其政府曾授予张孝骞医学博士学位。
description.en: A state in the United States whose government awarded Zhang Xiaoqian a Doctor of Medicine degree.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家级医学科学研究机构，张孝骞曾任副院长。
description.en: The national-level medical research institution of the People's Republic of China, where Zhang Xiaoqian served as vice president.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，2012年香港特别行政区行政长官选举候选人。时任民主党主席及立法会议员。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, candidate in the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election. At the time, he was the chairman of the Democratic Party and a member of the Legislative Council.

description.zh-cn: 2012年香港特首选举期间，梁振英竞选阵营成员（包括刘梦熊）在流浮山与乡绅及江湖人物郭永鸿（上海仔）举行了一次争议性会面。此次会面旨在为梁振英拉票，并引发了对“黑金政治”的疑虑。
description.en: During the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election, members of Leung Chun-ying's campaign team (including Lew Mon-hung) held a controversial meeting in Lau Fau Shan with rural leaders and triad figure Kwok Wing-hung ("Shanghai Tsai"). This meeting, aimed at canvassing votes for Leung, raised concerns about "black-gold politics".

description.zh-cn: 指2012年香港行政长官选举期间，候选人唐英年位于九龙塘的大宅被揭发有大型僭建地库，引发诚信争议。
description.en: Refers to the controversy during the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election where candidate Henry Tang's mansion in Kowloon Tong was discovered to have a large illegal basement, sparking a debate over his integrity.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，曾任保安局局长，因基本法23条立法争议而辞职。现任新民党主席及行政会议召集人，曾考虑参选2012年香港行政长官选举，并提议增加赛马会足球博彩收入税。
description.en: Hong Kong politician, former Secretary for Security who resigned due to controversy over the Basic Law Article 23 legislation. She is currently the Chairwoman of the New People's Party and Convenor of the Executive Council. She had considered running for the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election and proposed increasing the football betting tax on the Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 香港亲建制派政党，主要代表工商界利益。
description.en: A pro-establishment political party in Hong Kong, primarily representing business and professional interests.

description.zh-cn: 一项政治诉求，旨在争取在2012年实现香港行政长官和立法会全体议员由普选产生。该建议未被中央政府接纳。
description.en: A political demand aimed at achieving universal suffrage for both the Hong Kong Chief Executive and all members of the Legislative Council in 2012. The proposal was not accepted by the Central Government.

description.zh-cn: 香港民间人权阵线自1997年起每年7月1日（香港特别行政区成立纪念日）举办游行活动。其中，2003年的游行主要为反对基本法23条立法。2012年7月1日，民间人权阵线再次主办游行，主要诉求之一是要求新上任的行政长官梁振英下台。
description.en: The Civil Human Rights Front has organized marches annually in Hong Kong on July 1st (HKSAR Establishment Day) since 1997. The 2003 march primarily protested against the Basic Law Article 23 legislation. On July 1, 2012, the Front again organized a protest, with one of its main demands being the resignation of the newly inaugurated Chief Executive, Leung Chun-ying.

description.zh-cn: 负责选举香港特别行政区行政长官的选举团体。
description.en: The electoral college responsible for electing the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

zh-cn: 2007年香港特别行政区行政长官选举

description.zh-cn: 2012年香港特首选举之前的上一届选举。
description.en: The election preceding the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election.

zh-cn: 2017年香港特别行政区行政长官选举

description.zh-cn: 2012年香港特首选举之后的下一届选举。
description.en: The election following the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election.

description.zh-cn: 汤川秀树成长、长期工作和逝世的城市。
description.en: The city where Hideki Yukawa grew up, worked for a long time, and passed away.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本大阪府的国立大学。汤川秀树曾在此任教并获得博士学位。
description.en: A national university in Osaka Prefecture, Japan. Hideki Yukawa taught and received his doctorate here.

description.zh-cn: 日本物理学家和电气工程学家，曾任大阪帝国大学理学部主任教授，帮助汤川秀树获得在该校的教职。
description.en: A Japanese physicist and electrical engineer, who was the head professor of the Faculty of Science at Osaka Imperial University and helped Hideki Yukawa get a teaching position there.

description.zh-cn: 一种强相互作用的基本粒子，其存在由汤川秀树的理论所预言。
description.en: A type of subatomic particle that participates in the strong interaction, whose existence was predicted by Hideki Yukawa's theory.

description.zh-cn: 英国物理学家，因在宇宙线中发现π介子而获得1950年诺贝尔物理学奖，他的发现证实了汤川秀树的理论。
description.en: A British physicist who was awarded the 1950 Nobel Prize in Physics for his discovery of the pion (pi-meson) in cosmic rays, a discovery that confirmed Hideki Yukawa's theory.

description.zh-cn: 一种介子，由塞西尔·鲍威尔于1947年发现，证实了汤川秀树的理论。
description.en: A type of meson discovered by Cecil Powell in 1947, confirming Hideki Yukawa's theory.

description.zh-cn: 诺贝尔奖的奖项之一，旨在奖励在物理学领域做出最重要发现或发明的个人。汤川秀树于1949年获得该奖项。
description.en: One of the Nobel Prizes, awarded to those who have made the most important discoveries or inventions in the field of physics. Hideki Yukawa received this award in 1949.

zh-cn: 京都大学基础物理学研究所

description.zh-cn: 隶属于京都大学的理论物理学研究机构，汤川秀树是其首任所长。
description.en: A research institute for theoretical physics affiliated with Kyoto University, of which Hideki Yukawa was the first director.

description.zh-cn: 一份由罗素和爱因斯坦起草，呼吁世界各国领导人通过和平方式解决国际冲突的反核战争宣言，汤川秀树是签署人之一。
description.en: A manifesto drafted by Bertrand Russell and Albert Einstein calling on world leaders to resolve international conflicts peacefully, which warned of the dangers of nuclear weapons. Hideki Yukawa was one of its signatories.

description.zh-cn: 日本物理学家，被称为“日本近代物理学之父”，是汤川秀树的博士导师。
description.en: A Japanese physicist known as the 'father of modern physics in Japan', and was Hideki Yukawa's doctoral advisor.

description.zh-cn: 日本天体物理学家，汤川秀树的博士生。
description.en: A Japanese astrophysicist and a doctoral student of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 日本理论物理学家，汤川秀树的博士生。
description.en: A Japanese theoretical physicist and a doctoral student of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 日本中国文学研究者，是汤川秀树的弟弟。
description.en: A Japanese researcher of Chinese literature and the younger brother of Hideki Yukawa.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，曾任安徽省残疾人联合会理事长、安徽省人大常委会社会建设工作委员会副主任等职务。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, who has served as Chairwoman of the Anhui Provincial Disabled Persons' Federation and Deputy Director of the Social Construction Work Committee of the Standing Committee of the Anhui Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省妇女儿童工作者组成的人民团体，是中华全国妇女联合会的地方组织，接受中国共产党安徽省委员会的领导。
description.en: A people's organization composed of women and children workers in Anhui Province, People's Republic of China. It is a local organization of the All-China Women's Federation and is under the leadership of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国仪器仪表与传感专家，回族，南京大学党委常委、副校长，中国科学院院士。
description.en: A Chinese expert in instrumentation and sensors, of Hui ethnicity, currently serving as a member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee and Vice President of Nanjing University, and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省合肥市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Hefei City, Anhui Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国电子信息科技领域内非营利性的全国性学术团体。
description.en: A non-profit, national academic organization in the field of electronic information science and technology in China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河南省妇女儿童工作者组成的人民团体，是中华全国妇女联合会的地方组织。
description.en: A people's organization composed of women and children workers in Henan Province, People's Republic of China. It is the local organization of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 国民党左派将领，曾任陕西省建设厅长。
description.en: A left-wing Kuomintang general, who served as the Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Construction Department.

en: Thousand-li leap to the Dabie Mountains

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，晋冀鲁豫野战军主力部队的一次战略性进攻行动。
description.en: A strategic offensive operation by the main force of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army during the second phase of the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 南京市人民政府下属的公安机关。
description.en: The public security organ under the Nanjing Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间山东省的权力机关，取代了山东省人民委员会。
description.en: The organ of power in Shandong Province during the Cultural Revolution, which replaced the Shandong Provincial People's Committee.

en: Shandong University of Political Science and Law

description.zh-cn: 山东省人民政府在1955年3月至1968年期间的名称。
description.en: The name of the Shandong Provincial People's Government from March 1955 to 1968.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军山东省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在山东省设立的军事机构。
description.en: A military organization of the People's Liberation Army established in Shandong Province.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国劳动人事部
en: Ministry of Labour and Personnel of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1982年由国家劳动总局、国家人事局、国务院科技干部局、国家编制委员会合并组建，负责管理全国机构编制工作。
description.en: Formed in 1982 by the merger of the State Bureau of Labour, the State Bureau of Personnel, the State Council Bureau of Scientific and Technological Cadres, and the State Commission for Institutional Organization, it was responsible for managing national institutional organization work.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央机构编制委员会办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the Office of the Central Institutional Organization Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国山东省的一个县，是李淦的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shandong Province, China, and the birthplace of Li Gan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议湖北省委员会
en: Hubei Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在湖北省的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初期的行政区划，原隶属于山西省，1914年被划入新成立的绥远特别区。
description.en: An administrative division in the early Republic of China, originally under Shanxi Province, which was incorporated into the newly established Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初期的行政区划，原属归绥道，后被划归察哈尔特别区。
description.en: An administrative division in the early Republic of China, originally part of Guisui Circuit, later assigned to Chahar Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的一个省份，由绥远特别区于1928年改制而来。在中华民国初期，绥远地区曾是绥远特别区，设有最高军事及行政长官职位，负责管辖该地区。
description.en: A province during the Republic of China era, transformed from the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1928. In the early Republic of China, the Suiyuan area, as the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region, had the highest military and administrative position responsible for its governance.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古历史上的一个盟，其所属各旗于1914年被划归绥远特别区。
description.en: A historical league in Inner Mongolia, whose banners were incorporated into the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古历史上的一个盟，其所属各旗于1914年被划归绥远特别区。
description.en: A historical league in Inner Mongolia, whose banners were incorporated into the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 1914年7月在绥远特别区内设立的行政区划。
description.en: An administrative division established within the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region in July 1914.

description.zh-cn: 曾是绥远特别区的首府，现为内蒙古自治区的政府驻地（首府）。
description.en: Formerly the capital of the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region, it is now the seat of government (regional capital) of Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一个自治区，其现今地域包含了原绥远特别区的大部分。
description.en: An autonomous region of the People's Republic of China, whose current territory includes most of the former Suiyuan Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期的一种行政区划概念，绥远特别区即为此类型。
description.en: An administrative division concept during the mainland period of the Republic of China, of which the Suiyuan Special Administrative Region was an example.

description.zh-cn: 项昌乐的出生地，隶属于安徽省六安市。
description.en: The birthplace of Xiang Changle, a county under the jurisdiction of Lu'an City, Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，项昌乐的前任中国共产党大连理工大学委员会书记。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, the predecessor of Xiang Changle as the Party Secretary of the Dalian University of Technology Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Party Secretary and Vice President of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region High People's Court, and a Grand Justice of the second rank.

description.zh-cn: 位于涟水县的连镇铁路上的一个车站。
description.en: A station on the Lianyungang-Zhenjiang High-Speed Railway located in Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 涟水县下辖镇。
description.en: A town under the jurisdiction of Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 位于江苏省涟水县高沟镇的酿酒企业，为上市公司。
description.en: A publicly listed brewing company located in Gaogou Town, Lianshui County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 位于涟水县的全日制民办高等院校。
description.en: A full-time private higher vocational college located in Lianshui County.

description.zh-cn: 位于涟水县的寺庙，始建于唐初。
description.en: A temple in Lianshui County, first built in the early Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝末年封州刺史，为南汉的建立奠定了基础。其子刘隐、刘䶮相继继承其势力。
description.en: The prefect of Feng Prefecture in the late Tang dynasty who laid the foundation for the Southern Han state. His sons Liu Yin and Liu Yan succeeded his power.

description.zh-cn: 唐末五代十国时期清海军节度使，南汉建立者刘䶮之兄，为南汉的建立奠定基础。
description.en: Military governor (Jiedushi) of the Qinghaijun Circuit during the late Tang and Five Dynasties period. He was the elder brother of Liu Yan, the founder of Southern Han, and laid the groundwork for the state's establishment.

description.zh-cn: 南汉第二位皇帝，史称殇帝，继承其父刘䶮的皇位，后被其弟刘晟所杀。
description.en: The second emperor of Southern Han, known posthumously as Emperor Shang. He succeeded his father Liu Yan and was later killed by his younger brother Liu Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 南汉末代皇帝，史称后主。
description.en: The last emperor of Southern Han, known as the 'Last Ruler' (Houzhu).

description.zh-cn: 越南吴朝的开创者。他于937年击败南汉军队，在交州建立吴朝。
description.en: Founder of the Ngô dynasty in Vietnam. He defeated the Southern Han army in 937 and established his dynasty in Jiaozhou.

description.zh-cn: 由吴权在击败南汉军队后建立的越南王朝。
description.en: A Vietnamese dynasty established by Ngô Quyền after defeating the Southern Han army.

description.zh-cn: 南汉高祖刘䶮之子，被封为交王，在领兵进攻吴权时兵败阵亡。
description.en: Son of Emperor Gaozu of Southern Han, Liu Yan. He was titled Prince of Jiao and was killed in battle while leading an army against Ngô Quyền.

description.zh-cn: 南汉交州属将，在杀死主管官员后向南汉求救以对抗吴权。
description.en: A general in Jiaozhou under Southern Han. After killing the chief official, he requested aid from Southern Han to fight against Ngô Quyền.

description.zh-cn: 北宋开国名将，曾被赵匡胤任命为都总管，率军攻灭南汉。后奉宋太宗之命，参与灭北汉和雍熙北伐。
description.en: A founding general of the Northern Song dynasty. He was appointed by Zhao Kuangyin as the commander-in-chief, leading the army to conquer Southern Han. Later, under the orders of Emperor Taizong, he participated in the conquest of Northern Han and the Yongxi Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 南汉将领。成功抵御宋军后，遭诬陷谋反并被后主刘𬬮赐死。
description.en: A general of Southern Han. After successfully repelling the Song army, he was falsely accused of treason and put to death by the Last Ruler Liu Chang.

description.zh-cn: 南汉将领，在宋军进攻时见南汉大势已去，遂投降宋朝。
description.en: A general of Southern Han who surrendered to the Song army during their invasion, seeing that the Southern Han was doomed.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝开国功臣，继萧何后为相国，全面继承萧何的政策，世称“萧规曹随”。
description.en: A founding minister of the Han Dynasty. He succeeded Xiao He as chancellor and continued all of Xiao He's policies, an approach known as 'Cao following Xiao's rules'.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇时期制定的禁止民间私藏儒家典籍及诸子百家著作的法令。
description.en: A law enacted during the reign of Qin Shi Huang that prohibited private ownership of Confucian classics and the writings of the Hundred Schools of Thought.

description.zh-cn: 汉惠帝刘盈之子，汉朝第三位皇帝。因其母被吕后所杀，长大后出怨言，被吕后废黜并杀害。
description.en: Son of Emperor Hui of Han, Liu Ying, and the third emperor of the Han Dynasty. After his mother was killed by Empress Lü Zhi, he expressed resentment upon growing up and was subsequently deposed and killed by her.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝将领，以信守承诺闻名。曾反对樊哙攻打匈奴的提议。
description.en: A general of the Han Dynasty, famous for keeping his promises. He opposed Fan Kuai's proposal to attack the Xiongnu.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重工业部
en: Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾设置的一个组成部门，负责管理重工业。该部门于1954年9月根据《国务院组织法》成立，接替原中央人民政府重工业部的相关工作。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for managing heavy industry. It was established in September 1954 in accordance with the Organic Law of the State Council, succeeding the work of the former Central People's Government Ministry of Heavy Industry.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建筑材料工业部

description.zh-cn: 1956年在原重工业部建筑材料工业管理局的基础上组建的国务院组成部门。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council formed in 1956 based on the former Building Materials Industry Administration of the Ministry of Heavy Industry.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾设置的一个组成部门，负责管理轻工业。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for managing light industry.

zh-cn: 中央人民政府第二机械工业部
中华人民共和国第二机械工业部 (1954–1958)

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月从中央人民政府重工业部分设出的部门，主管国防工业，并接管了原重工业部的兵工总局。
description.en: A department established in August 1952 by splitting from the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the Central People's Government, responsible for the defense industry and taking over the former Ordnance Administration.

zh-cn: 中国有色金属工业总公司

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国重工业部下属机构，负责管理有色金属工业。
description.en: A former subordinate body of the Ministry of Heavy Industry of the People's Republic of China, responsible for managing the non-ferrous metals industry.

zh-cn: 苏联援助中国大陆的156个项目

description.zh-cn: 中国“一五”计划时期，苏联援助中国建设的156项重点工业项目。
description.en: A set of 156 key industrial projects constructed in China with Soviet assistance during the First Five-Year Plan period.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖北武汉的特大型钢铁联合企业，是“156项重点工程”之一。
description.en: A major iron and steel complex in Wuhan, Hubei, and one of the '156 Key Projects'.

description.zh-cn: 位于内蒙古包头的特大型钢铁联合企业，是“156项重点工程”之一。
description.en: A major iron and steel complex in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, and one of the '156 Key Projects'.

description.zh-cn: 无锡市人民政府主管无锡市全市公共安全工作的职能部门，是无锡市区域内人民警察的领导和指挥机关。
description.en: The functional department of the Wuxi Municipal People's Government in charge of public security throughout Wuxi city, and the leadership and command organ for the people's police within the Wuxi area.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省无锡市的市级国家行政机关。
description.en: The municipal-level state administrative organ of Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province.

description.en: The functional department under the Jiangsu Provincial People's Government in charge of public security work throughout the province, and the leadership and command organ for the people's police in Jiangsu.

description.en: Chairman of Sinopec Group.

description.en: A joint-stock company established solely by Sinopec Group.

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国中央人民政府或其委托的国有资产监督管理机构行使出资人职责的国有企业。
description.en: State-owned enterprises supervised by the central government of the People's Republic of China or its authorized state-owned assets supervision and administration agencies.

description.zh-cn: 指国家单独出资、由国务院或者地方人民政府授权本级人民政府国有资产监督管理机构履行出资人职责的有限责任公司。
description.en: A limited liability company solely funded by the state, with the state-owned assets supervision and administration commission at the same level of government authorized by the State Council or local people's government to perform the duties of the investor.

description.en: An independent company established by Sinopec Group by registering its refining and chemical engineering business.

description.en: A company established by Sinopec Group responsible for petroleum engineering and technical services.
