description.en: Chemist, father of Fredrick Chien. He served as the 5th President of National Taiwan University, Academician and President of Academia Sinica, and Chairman of the Atomic Energy Council of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 水利学家，曾任国立台湾大学第6任校长。
土木工程学家，曾任国立台湾大学第7任校长。
经济学家，曾任国立台湾大学第8任校长。
医学家，曾任国立台湾大学第9任校长。
电机学家，曾任国立台湾大学第10任校长。
医学家，中央研究院院士，曾任国立台湾大学第11任校长。
中国音乐家，刘半农之弟。
description.en: A Chinese musician, younger brother of Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 曾与刘半农共同编辑《江阴杂志》。
description.en: Co-edited the 'Jiangyin Magazine' with Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 由刘半农与李家瑞合著的关于俗字研究的著作。
description.en: A work on the study of popular characters co-authored by Liu Bannong and Li Jiarui.

description.zh-cn: 与刘半农合著《宋元以来俗字谱》的学者。
description.en: A scholar who co-authored 'A譜 of Popular Characters since the Song and Yuan Dynasties' with Liu Bannong.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，中华人民共和国政治人物。因在脱贫攻坚战中作出突出贡献，被授予“全国脱贫攻坚先进个人”荣誉称号。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China and a political figure in the People's Republic of China. He was awarded the honorary title of 'National Advanced Individual in Poverty Alleviation' for his outstanding contributions to the poverty alleviation campaign.

description.zh-cn: 江西省赣州市赣县区下辖的乡镇级行政单位。
description.en: A township-level administrative unit under Ganxian District, Ganzhou, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 江西省赣州市赣县区下辖的乡镇级行政单位。
description.en: A township-level administrative unit under Ganxian District, Ganzhou, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 江西省赣州市赣县区下辖的乡镇级行政单位。
description.en: A township-level administrative unit under Ganxian District, Ganzhou, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰诗人，伦敦大学学院的创办人之一。
description.en: Scottish poet and a co-founder of University College London.

en: Henry Brougham, 1st Baron Brougham and Vaux
zh-cn: 第一代布鲁厄姆和沃克斯男爵亨利·布鲁厄姆

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰律师，伦敦大学学院的创办人之一。
description.en: Scottish lawyer and a co-founder of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 英国哲学家，其教育理念深刻影响了伦敦大学学院的创办者，被誉为“伦大教父”。
description.en: English philosopher whose educational ideas deeply influenced the founders of University College London, earning him the title of its 'spiritual father'.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国伦敦的研究型大学，与伦敦大学学院同为伦敦大学的始创成员学院，两校间存在历史悠久的竞争关系。
description.en: A research university in London, England. It is a founding constituent college of the University of London along with UCL, and has a long-standing rivalry with it.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利外交官，曾对伦敦大学学院的建立表示反对。
description.en: Austrian diplomat who expressed opposition to the establishment of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 耶鲁大学的医学院，与伦敦大学学院签订了两校史上最具规模的合作项目。
description.en: The medical school of Yale University, which has signed the largest collaborative project in the history of both universities with University College London.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于荷兰阿姆斯特丹的全球性信息分析公司，与伦敦大学学院合作开办了大数据研究中心。
description.en: A global information analytics business headquartered in Amsterdam, which co-founded the Big Data Institute with University College London.

zh-cn: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔
亚历山大·格拉汉姆·贝尔

description.zh-cn: 首个电话专利持有者，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: Holder of the first patent for the telephone and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 去氧核糖核酸发现者及诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主之一，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: Co-discoverer of the structure of the DNA molecule and Nobel laureate in Physiology or Medicine, and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: “光纤之父”及诺贝尔物理学奖得主，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: 'Father of Fiber Optics' and Nobel laureate in Physics, and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 英国摇滚乐队，所有成员均为伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: British rock band, all members of which are alumni of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 电影导演，伦敦大学学院校友。
description.en: Film director and an alumnus of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 英国皇室成员，担任伦敦大学学院校监。
description.en: Member of the British royal family, serving as the Chancellor of University College London.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于伦敦的生物医学研究慈善基金会，弗朗西斯·克里克研究院的共同创办者之一。
description.en: A London-based charitable foundation focused on biomedical research, and a co-founder of the Francis Crick Institute.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚南澳大利亚州的首府，伦敦大学学院在此设有能源学院。
description.en: The capital city of South Australia, Australia, where UCL has a campus for its School of Energy and Resources.

description.zh-cn: 卡塔尔的首都，伦敦大学学院在此设有考古与博物馆学院。
description.en: The capital city of Qatar, where UCL has a campus for archaeology and museum studies.

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃军事家和革命家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Soviet military commander and revolutionary, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

zh-cn: 格里戈里·彼得罗夫斯基

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰苏维埃政治家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Ukrainian Soviet politician, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

zh-cn: 亚历山大·切尔维亚科夫

description.zh-cn: 白俄罗斯苏维埃政治家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Byelorussian Soviet politician, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

description.zh-cn: 格鲁吉亚革命家和苏维埃政治家，《苏联成立条约》的签署人之一。
description.en: Georgian revolutionary and Soviet politician, one of the signatories of the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR.

zh-cn: 第一次全联盟苏维埃代表大会

description.zh-cn: 1922年12月30日通过《苏联成立条约》和《苏联成立宣言》的会议。
description.en: The congress that approved the Treaty on the Creation of the USSR and the Declaration of the Creation of the USSR on December 30, 1922.

description.zh-cn: 靖难之役中的一场关键战役，李景隆率领的南军在此被朱棣的燕军击溃。
description.en: A key battle in the Jingnan Campaign where the southern army led by Li Jinglong was routed by Zhu Di's Yan army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任内蒙古自治区政协副主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Vice Chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区下辖的一个旗，是邬宝恒的出生地。
description.en: A banner under the jurisdiction of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, and the birthplace of Wu Baoheng.

zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国政府
en: Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的执政当局，是阿米尼示威的主要抗议对象。
description.en: The ruling authority of Iran, the main target of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的道德警察，负责监督公众执行头巾令等伊斯兰教着装规范。因逮捕并导致玛莎·阿米尼死亡而受到广泛谴责。
description.en: The morality police of Iran, responsible for enforcing Islamic dress codes such as the hijab. Widely condemned for arresting Mahsa Amini, which led to her death.

description.zh-cn: 始于2017年的伊朗女性抗议运动，反对强制佩戴头巾，被视为阿米尼示威的前身和组成部分。
description.en: A protest movement by women in Iran against the compulsory hijab, which started in 2017. It is considered a precursor and a component of the Mahsa Amini protests.

description.zh-cn: 阿米尼示威中最为流传的口号，代表了示威的核心诉求。该运动与玛莎·阿米尼被追授2023年萨哈罗夫奖。
description.en: The most popular slogan in the Mahsa Amini protests, representing the core demands of the movement. The movement, along with Mahsa Amini, was posthumously awarded the 2023 Sakharov Prize.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗律师、前法官、人权活动家，2003年诺贝尔和平奖得主。她表示阿米尼示威的目标是推翻政权。
description.en: An Iranian lawyer, former judge, and human rights activist, who won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2003. She stated that the goal of the Amini protests is to overthrow the regime.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的国家足球队。在2022年世界杯期间，球员通过不唱国歌等方式表达对阿米尼示威的支持。
description.en: The national football team of Iran. During the 2022 World Cup, players expressed their support for the Mahsa Amini protests by not singing the national anthem.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗前国脚，因在社交媒体上声援阿米尼示威而被捕。
description.en: A former player of the Iran national football team who was arrested for supporting the Mahsa Amini protests on social media.

zh-cn: 联合国经济及社会理事会
en: United Nations Economic and Social Council

description.zh-cn: 联合国主要机构之一，于2022年12月14日投票决定将伊朗从联合国妇女地位委员会中除名，以回应伊朗政府对示威的镇压。
description.en: One of the principal organs of the United Nations, which voted on December 14, 2022, to remove Iran from the Commission on the Status of Women in response to the government's crackdown on protests.

zh-cn: 联合国妇女地位委员会
en: United Nations Commission on the Status of Women
UN Commission on the Status of Women

description.zh-cn: 联合国经社理事会下的一个职司委员会，伊朗因镇压阿米尼示威于2022年被取消其成员资格。
description.en: A functional commission of the UN Economic and Social Council. Iran's membership was revoked in 2022 due to its suppression of the Mahsa Amini protests.

zh-cn: 伊朗情报与国家安全部

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的情报机构，指控并逮捕了报道玛莎·阿米尼之死的两名女记者，称她们是外国间谍。
description.en: The intelligence agency of Iran, which accused and arrested two female journalists who reported on the death of Mahsa Amini, branding them as foreign agents.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗女记者，因报道玛莎·阿米尼之死而被伊朗情报部逮捕，并被指控为外国间谍。
description.en: An Iranian female journalist who was arrested by the Ministry of Intelligence and accused of being a foreign agent for her reporting on the death of Mahsa Amini.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗女记者，因报道玛莎·阿米尼之死而被伊朗情报部逮捕，并被指控为外国间碟。
description.en: An Iranian female journalist who was arrested by the Ministry of Intelligence and accused of being a foreign agent for her reporting on the death of Mahsa Amini.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队总司令，认为示威背后有来自沙特阿拉伯的支持。
description.en: Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, who believed that Saudi Arabia was behind the protests.

description.zh-cn: 联合国下属机构，于2022年11月通过决议，谴责伊朗镇压示威者，并成立调查团调查伊朗当局的行为。
description.en: A United Nations body that passed a resolution in November 2022 condemning Iran's crackdown on protesters and establishing a fact-finding mission to investigate the authorities' actions.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人权活动家，因“为伊朗受压迫的女性而战、为促进所有人的人权及自由而战”而获得2023年诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: An Iranian human rights activist who was awarded the 2023 Nobel Peace Prize 'for her fight against the oppression of women in Iran and her fight to promote human rights and freedom for all'.

description.zh-cn: 此次选举中，强硬保守派候选人易卜拉欣·莱希当选伊朗总统。
description.en: In this election, the hardline conservative candidate Ebrahim Raisi was elected President of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 德国足球俱乐部，其球迷在比赛中展示横幅，声援阿米尼示威并悼念遇难者萨丽娜·伊斯梅尔扎德。
description.en: A German football club whose fans displayed a banner during a match to show solidarity with the Mahsa Amini protests and to mourn the victim Sarina Esmailzadeh.

description.zh-cn: 美国足球的管理机构。在2022年世界杯期间，该协会为支持伊朗示威者，在社交媒体上发布了不含伊朗国徽的伊朗国旗图片。
description.en: The governing body of soccer in the United States. During the 2022 World Cup, it posted an image of the Iranian flag without the national emblem on social media to support protesters in Iran.

description.zh-cn: 为纪念法国大革命100周年而举办的世界博览会，埃菲尔铁塔是为此而建的主要建筑。
description.en: A world's fair held in Paris to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution, for which the Eiffel Tower was built as the main attraction.

description.zh-cn: 1853年纽约万国工业博览会上的木结构观景塔，是埃菲尔铁塔的灵感来源之一。
description.en: A wooden observation tower at the 1853 New York World's Fair, which served as an inspiration for the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎是法国的首都。其市政府是埃菲尔铁塔的所有者，也是东京都的姊妹友好都市。卡尔·马克思曾在此流亡并出版了《哲学的贫困》。
description.en: Paris is the capital of France. Its municipal government owns the Eiffel Tower, and it is also a sister city of Tokyo Metropolis. Karl Marx lived here in exile and published 'The Poverty of Philosophy'.

description.zh-cn: 法国作家，是反对建造埃菲尔铁塔的艺术家之一，据说他每天在塔的餐厅用餐，因为那是巴黎唯一看不到塔的地方。
description.en: A French writer who was among the artists protesting the Eiffel Tower. He is said to have eaten lunch in the tower's restaurant every day because it was the only place in Paris where he could not see it.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的一场关键战役，埃菲尔铁塔的无线电发射机通过干扰德军通讯，为盟军胜利作出了贡献。
description.en: A pivotal battle of World War I in which the radio transmitter in the Eiffel Tower contributed to the Allied victory by jamming German communications.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利裁缝，在测试自制降落伞时从埃菲尔铁塔第一层跳下身亡。
description.en: An Austrian tailor who died after jumping from the first level of the Eiffel Tower to test his homemade parachute design.

description.zh-cn: 二战期间巴黎的德国军事总督，他违抗了希特勒摧毁巴黎的命令，从而保全了埃菲尔铁塔。
description.en: The German military governor of Paris during World War II, who disobeyed Hitler's order to destroy the city, thereby saving the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 美国电梯公司，为埃菲尔铁塔安装了通往第二层的具有挑战性的电梯。
description.en: An American elevator company that installed the challenging elevators to the second floor of the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 由联合国教科文组织世界遗产委员会评选出的对全人类具有突出普遍价值的地点。
description.en: A landmark or area selected by the UNESCO World Heritage Committee as having cultural, historical, scientific or other form of significance, which is legally protected by international treaties.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国黑潭的观光塔，其设计灵感来源于埃菲尔铁塔。
description.en: A tourist attraction in Blackpool, England, inspired by the Eiffel Tower.

description.zh-cn: 一座未完工的铁塔，旨在超越埃菲尔铁塔，后被拆除。
description.en: An unfinished iron tower designed to surpass the Eiffel Tower, which was later demolished.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第一代领导集体

description.zh-cn: 对中国共产党第八届中央委员会七名政治局常委毛泽东、刘少奇、周恩来、朱德、陈云、林彪和邓小平的合称，被视为中国共产党第一代领导集体。
description.en: A collective term for the seven members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the 8th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China: Mao Zedong, Liu Shaoqi, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, Chen Yun, Lin Biao, and Deng Xiaoping, regarded as the first generation of collective leadership of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The working body of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的中央权力机关。
description.en: The central authority of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年至1975年间中华人民共和国的最高军事领导机构。
description.en: The supreme military leading body of the People's Republic of China from 1954 to 1975.

description.zh-cn: 指20世纪80年代中国由邓小平和陈云共同主导的政治格局。
description.en: Refers to the political landscape in China during the 1980s, co-dominated by Deng Xiaoping and Chen Yun.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，《零八宪章》的主要起草人之一。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and one of the main drafters of Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克反体制运动的象征性文件。
description.en: A symbolic document of the anti-regime movement in Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 《零八宪章》中提出的用于解决两岸及民族问题的政治构想。
description.en: A political concept proposed in Charter 08 to resolve cross-strait and ethnic issues.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国刑法中的一项罪名，常用于惩处异见人士。刘晓波因《零八宪章》被以此罪名判刑。
description.en: A crime under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, often used to punish dissidents. Liu Xiaobo was sentenced on this charge for his involvement with Charter 08.

description.zh-cn: 台湾党外运动时期及1979年民主运动中的重要政治刊物，其成员为美丽岛事件的核心人物。一些评论员认为其对《零八宪章》有影响。
description.en: An important political magazine during Taiwan's Tangwai movement and 1979 democracy movement, whose members were central figures in the Kaohsiung Incident. Some commentators believe it influenced Charter 08.

en: University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海的高等学府，前身为上海机械学院。
description.en: An institution of higher education in Shanghai, China, formerly known as Shanghai Institute of Mechanical Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京市西城区的金融中心区，其规划蓝图由陈元主持制定。
description.en: A financial center in Xicheng District, Beijing, whose planning blueprint was developed under the leadership of Chen Yuan.

zh-cn: 国立中兴大学附属高级中学
en: The Affiliated Senior High School of National Chung Hsing University

description.zh-cn: 原为国立大里高级中学，于2014年2月1日改隶国立中兴大学。
description.en: Formerly National Dali Senior High School, it became affiliated with National Chung Hsing University on February 1, 2014.

zh-cn: 国立中兴大学附属台中高级农业职业学校
en: The Affiliated Taichung Agricultural Senior High School of National Chung Hsing University

description.zh-cn: 原为国立台中高级农业职业学校，于2014年2月1日改隶国立中兴大学。
description.en: Formerly National Taichung Agricultural Senior High School, it became affiliated with National Chung Hsing University on February 1, 2014.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省立中兴大学首任校长，中央研究院院士。
description.en: The first president of Taiwan Provincial Chung Hsing University and an academician of Academia Sinica.

description.zh-cn: 省立中兴大学第二任校长。
description.en: The second president of Provincial Chung Hsing University.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个大学联盟系统，旨在整合国立大学资源，国立中兴大学为其成员之一。
description.en: A university alliance system in Taiwan aimed at integrating resources of national universities. National Chung Hsing University is one of its members.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个大学联盟系统，国立中兴大学为其成员之一。
description.en: A university alliance system in Taiwan, of which National Chung Hsing University is a member.

zh-cn: 发展国际一流大学及顶尖研究中心计划

description.zh-cn: 台湾教育部于2005年启动的一项高等教育计划，旨在提升顶尖大学的国际竞争力。
description.en: A higher education project launched by the Ministry of Education of Taiwan in 2005, aimed at enhancing the international competitiveness of top universities.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的国立大学，与国立中兴大学等校共同参与“正兴城湾杯”校际竞赛。
description.en: A national university in Taiwan that participates in the 'Jheng-Sing-Cheng-Wan Cup' intercollegiate competition with National Chung Hsing University and other institutions.

description.zh-cn: 研究行政法律规范及其发展规律的法律科学，罗豪才是中国现代该领域的开拓者与奠基人。
description.en: The legal science that studies administrative legal norms and their developmental patterns. Luo Haocai is a pioneer and founder of this field in modern China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国广东省广州市的一所中学，罗豪才曾在此就读。
description.en: A middle school in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China, where Luo Haocai once studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国江苏省无锡市的一所中学，罗豪才曾在此就读。
description.en: A middle school in Wuxi, Jiangsu, China, where Luo Haocai once studied.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家、政治人物。他与罗豪才等人于1990年代初率先提出“现代行政法的平衡理论”，曾任国务院法制办公室党组书记、副主任。
description.en: Chinese jurist and politician. He, along with Luo Haocai and others, pioneered the 'balance theory of modern administrative law' in the early 1990s, and served as former Party Secretary and Deputy Director of the State Council Legislative Affairs Office.

description.zh-cn: 古代不列颠爱西尼部落的女王，曾率领部落反抗罗马帝国的统治，并在公元61年攻陷并焚毁了伦蒂尼恩（伦敦）。
description.en: Queen of the ancient British Iceni tribe, who led an uprising against the occupying forces of the Roman Empire and sacked and burned Londinium (London) in 61 AD.

description.zh-cn: 西撒克逊国王，于886年从维京人手中夺回伦敦并进行了重建。
description.en: King of the West Saxons, who recaptured and rebuilt London from the Vikings in 886 AD.

description.zh-cn: 诺曼底公爵，在1066年征服英格兰后成为英格兰国王。他在伦敦建造了伦敦塔以震慑当地居民。
description.en: Duke of Normandy who became King of England after conquering it in 1066. He built the Tower of London to intimidate the local inhabitants.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦市中心泰晤士河北岸的历史城堡，由威廉一世在1066年诺曼征服后开始兴建，是伦敦的世界遗产之一。
description.en: A historic castle located on the north bank of the River Thames in central London. Its construction was initiated by William the Conqueror after the Norman Conquest of 1066. It is one of London's World Heritage Sites.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，于1097年开始兴建威斯敏斯特厅，该建筑后来成为威斯敏斯特宫的基础。
description.en: King of England who began the construction of Westminster Hall in 1097, which became the basis of the Palace of Westminster.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦泰晤士河畔，是英国国会的所在地。其基础建筑威斯敏斯特厅由威廉二世于1097年开始兴建。
description.en: Located on the banks of the River Thames in London, it is the meeting place of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. Its foundational structure, Westminster Hall, was initiated by William II in 1097.

description.zh-cn: 1666年发生在伦敦的一场大火灾，摧毁了城内大量的木质建筑，之后由罗伯特·胡克等人主导了重建工作。
description.en: A major conflagration that swept through London in 1666, destroying a large number of the city's wooden buildings. Reconstruction was later led by individuals such as Robert Hooke.

description.zh-cn: 1665年至1666年间在英国发生的大规模腺鼠疫疫情，导致近10万伦敦人死亡，占当时人口的五分之一。
description.en: A massive outbreak of bubonic plague in England from 1665 to 1666, which killed nearly 100,000 Londoners, a fifth of the city's population at the time.

description.zh-cn: 英国科学家，在1666年伦敦大火后主导了城市的重建工作。
description.en: An English scientist who played a leading role in the reconstruction of London after the Great Fire of 1666.

description.zh-cn: 1952年发生在伦敦的一场严重空气污染事件，最终促使英国议会通过了《1956年空气清净法案》。
description.en: A severe air pollution event that occurred in London in 1952, which ultimately led to the passage of the Clean Air Act 1956.

description.zh-cn: 英国国会为应对1952年伦敦烟雾事件而通过的一项法案，旨在解决空气污染问题。
description.en: An Act of the Parliament of the United Kingdom passed in response to the Great Smog of London in 1952, aimed at tackling air pollution.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间纳粹德国空军对伦敦进行的一系列大规模轰炸，导致超过3万名伦敦人死亡，并摧毁了大量建筑。
description.en: A sustained strategic bombing campaign against London by Nazi Germany's air force during World War II, resulting in over 30,000 civilian deaths and the destruction of numerous buildings.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国的空军，在第二次世界大战期间对伦敦实施了大规模的轰炸，即“伦敦大轰炸”。
description.en: The aerial warfare branch of Nazi Germany, which carried out a massive bombing campaign against London during World War II, known as 'The Blitz'.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰的一个行政区和大区，由32个伦敦自治市镇和伦敦城组成。其行政管理由大伦敦政府负责。
description.en: An administrative area and region of England, consisting of 32 London boroughs and the City of London. Its administration is handled by the Greater London Authority.

description.zh-cn: 负责大伦敦地区战略性管理的最高层级地方政府，由选举产生的伦敦市长和伦敦议会组成。
description.en: The top-tier local government responsible for the strategic administration of Greater London, composed of the elected Mayor of London and the London Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治家，现任伦敦市长。
description.en: A British politician serving as the current Mayor of London.

description.zh-cn: 大伦敦政府的行政首长，负责大伦敦地区的战略管理。现任市长是萨迪克·汗。
description.en: The executive head of the Greater London Authority, responsible for the strategic governance of Greater London. The current mayor is Sadiq Khan.

description.zh-cn: 大伦敦政府的一部分，负责监督伦敦市长的决策，并有权批准或否决市长的年度预算提案。
description.en: Part of the Greater London Authority that scrutinises the activities of the Mayor of London and has the power to approve or reject the mayor's annual budget proposals.

description.zh-cn: 维多利亚时代的英国作家，其作品深刻描绘了当时的伦敦社会，塑造了维多利亚时代早期伦敦的经典形象。
description.en: A Victorian-era English writer whose works vividly depicted London society, shaping the classic image of early Victorian London.

description.zh-cn: 英国剧作家、诗人和演员，被广泛认为是英语世界最伟大的作家和世界上最杰出的戏剧家。他曾在伦敦生活和工作了很长时间。
description.en: An English playwright, poet, and actor, widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language and the world's pre-eminent dramatist. He lived and worked in London for a significant period.

description.zh-cn: 文绣的祖父，官至吏部尚书。
description.en: Grandfather of Wenxiu, who served as the Minister of Personnel.

description.zh-cn: 文绣的母亲，端恭的继配。
description.en: Mother of Wenxiu and the second wife of Duangong.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市的著名中学。文绣离婚后曾在此化名傅玉芳担任国文与国画教师，陈子明曾在此就读。
description.en: A well-known middle school in Beijing, China. After her divorce, Wenxiu taught Chinese literature and painting here under the alias Fu Yufang, and Chen Ziming also studied here.

description.zh-cn: 文绣于1947年曾在此报社担任校对。
description.en: A newspaper where Wenxiu worked as a proofreader in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任溥仪的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Puyi during his divorce case with Wenxiu.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任溥仪的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Puyi during his divorce case with Wenxiu.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任文绣的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Wenxiu during her divorce case with Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任文绣的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Wenxiu during her divorce case with Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 律师，在文绣与溥仪的离婚案中担任文绣的代理律师之一。
description.en: A lawyer who represented Wenxiu during her divorce case with Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国辽宁省下辖的地级市，是盛斌的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Liaoning Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Sheng Bin.

zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦军队综合军事学院
en: Combined Arms Academy of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦武装力量的一所高等军事教育机构。
description.en: A higher military educational institution of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第二十三集团军
中国人民解放军黑龙江省军区

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院与中央军事委员会的议事协调机构，负责组织领导全国的国防动员工作。
description.en: A deliberative and coordinating body of the State Council and the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China, responsible for organizing and leading the nation's defense mobilization efforts.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任沈阳军区副司令员，后由盛斌接任。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army, former Deputy Commander of the Shenyang Military Region, succeeded by Sheng Bin.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任黑龙江省军区司令员，后由盛斌接任。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army, former Commander of the Heilongjiang Military District, succeeded by Sheng Bin.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，接替盛斌担任黑龙江省军区司令员。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army who succeeded Sheng Bin as the Commander of the Heilongjiang Military District.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任国家国防动员委员会秘书长（后由盛斌接任）和中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, former Secretary-General of the National Defense Mobilization Committee (succeeded by Sheng Bin), and former Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领，封泰宁侯，曾主持营建北京紫禁城。
description.en: A general of the Ming dynasty, enfeoffed as Marquis of Taining, who oversaw the construction of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，官至工部侍郎，曾主持营建北京紫禁城。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as Vice Minister of Works and oversaw the construction of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，官至刑部侍郎，曾主持营建北京紫禁城。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as Vice Minister of Justice and oversaw the construction of the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 原成立于北京，后因国共内战，部分文物随国民政府迁至台湾。现为台湾最具规模的博物馆。
description.en: Originally established in Beijing, a portion of its collection was moved to Taiwan with the Nationalist government due to the Chinese Civil War. It is now the largest museum in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，现任拉脱维亚总统。
description.en: Latvian politician, the current President of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚共和国的国家元首职位。
description.en: The position of the head of state of the Republic of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，现任拉脱维亚总理。
description.en: Latvian politician, the current Prime Minister of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚共和国的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The position of the head of government of the Republic of Latvia.

zh-cn: 1991年拉脱维亚独立和民主化公投

description.zh-cn: 导致拉脱维亚于1991年8月21日正式恢复独立的公民投票事件。
description.en: A referendum event that led to the formal restoration of Latvia's independence on August 21, 1991.

description.zh-cn: 13世纪初通过武力征服拉脱维亚地区并强迫当地居民改信基督教的德意志十字军组织。
description.en: A German crusading order that conquered the territory of Latvia in the early 13th century and forced the local population to convert to Christianity.

zh-cn: 拉脱维亚苏维埃社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚被苏联吞并后成立的加盟共和国。
description.en: The constituent republic established after Latvia was annexed by the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国在波罗的海国家和白俄罗斯部分地区建立的占领区行政单位。
description.en: The civilian occupation regime established by Nazi Germany in the Baltic states and parts of Belarus.

description.zh-cn: 促进波罗的海国家（包括拉脱维亚）从苏联独立的非暴力运动。
description.en: A non-violent movement that led to the restoration of independence for the Baltic states, including Latvia, from the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚共和国的立法机构。
description.en: The legislative body of the Republic of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，曾任拉脱维亚总统。
description.en: Latvian politician who served as the President of Latvia.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚独立后产生的一种特殊的法律地位，主要适用于苏联时期移居的非拉脱维亚族人及其后代。
description.en: A unique legal status in Latvia that emerged after its independence, primarily applying to non-ethnic Latvians who migrated during the Soviet era and their descendants.

description.zh-cn: 拉脱维亚政治人物，曾任拉脱维亚总统，签署法令停止给予新生儿非公民身份。
description.en: Latvian politician who served as President of Latvia and signed a law to stop granting non-citizen status to newborns.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议德宏傣族景颇族自治州委员会

location.zh-cn: 德宏傣族景颇族自治州芒市斑色路3号
location.en: No. 3 Banse Road, Mangshi, Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州的政治协商会议组织。
description.en: The political consultative conference organization of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党德宏傣族景颇族自治州委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在德宏傣族景颇族自治州的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Chinese Communist Party in Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 云南省德宏傣族景颇族自治州下辖的县级市，是该州州府所在地。
description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Dehong Dai and Jingpo Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, and the seat of the prefecture's government.

description.zh-cn: 白族，曾任保山专区各族各界人民代表会议协商委员会副主席。
description.en: Of Bai ethnicity, served as a vice-chairman of the Consultative Committee of the People's Representative Conference of all Ethnic Groups and Circles in Baoshan Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 傣族，曾任保山专区各族各界人民代表会议协商委员会副主席。
description.en: Of Dai ethnicity, served as a vice-chairman of the Consultative Committee of the People's Representative Conference of all Ethnic Groups and Circles in Baoshan Prefecture.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海南省军区
en: Hainan Provincial Military District of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在中国海南省设立的军区。
description.en: A military district of the People's Liberation Army established in Hainan Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 辽沈战役中的一场关键性阻击战，由吴克华指挥的第四纵队负责执行。
description.en: A crucial blocking action during the Liaoshen Campaign, executed by the 4th Column commanded by Wu Kehua.

en: Sweep Away All Cow Demons and Snake Spirits

description.zh-cn: 1966年6月1日《人民日报》发表的社论，首次明确提出“破四旧”的概念。
description.en: An editorial published in the People's Daily on June 1, 1966, which first explicitly proposed the concept of 'Destroying the Four Olds'.

en: Temple and Cemetery of Confucius and the Kong Family Mansion in Qufu

description.zh-cn: 位于山东曲阜的孔子及其家族的纪念性建筑群，在“破四旧”运动中遭到严重损毁。
description.en: A complex of commemorative buildings for Confucius and his family in Qufu, Shandong, which was severely damaged during the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement.

description.zh-cn: 位于山东省曲阜市的一所师范大学，其红卫兵参与了对“三孔”的破坏。
description.en: A normal university in Qufu, Shandong Province, whose Red Guards participated in the destruction of the 'Three Confucian sites'.

zh-cn: 关于无产阶级文化大革命中保护文物图书的几点意见

description.zh-cn: 1967年5月14日由中共中央下发的文件，要求各地国家权力机关保护文物。
description.en: A document issued by the Central Committee of the CCP on May 14, 1967, requiring local state power organs to protect cultural relics.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝时期的宦官，与江充勾结陷害太子刘据。在江充死后向汉武帝谎报太子谋反，事后被汉武帝下令烧死。
description.en: A eunuch serving Emperor Wu of Han who colluded with Jiang Chong to frame Crown Prince Liu Ju. After Jiang Chong's death, he falsely reported to the emperor that the prince was committing treason. He was later burned to death by the emperor's order.

description.zh-cn: 西汉丞相，卫子夫姐夫。其子公孙敬声被捕后，为赎子罪抓获朱安世，反被朱安世诬告以巫蛊诅咒武帝，导致父子均死于狱中，家族被牵连。
description.en: Chancellor of the Western Han and brother-in-law of Empress Wei Zifu. He was falsely accused of witchcraft by Zhu Anshi, leading to his death in prison and the implication of his family.

description.zh-cn: 公孙贺之子，因贪污被捕，后被朱安世诬告与阳石公主私通并以巫蛊诅咒武帝，死于狱中。
description.en: Son of Gongsun He. He was arrested for corruption and later accused by Zhu Anshi of having an affair with Princess Yangshi and using witchcraft, leading to his death in prison.

description.zh-cn: 汉阳陵游侠，被公孙贺抓捕后，出于报复上书诬告公孙父子，是巫蛊之祸的导火索之一。
description.en: A vigilante from Yangling. After being captured by Gongsun He, he retaliated by falsely accusing Gongsun and his son, becoming one of the triggers for the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝之女，在巫蛊之祸中被指控与公孙敬声私通，后被处死。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Wu of Han. She was accused of having an affair with Gongsun Jingsheng during the Witchcraft Delusion and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝与卫子夫之女，在巫蛊之祸中受公孙贺案牵连被处死。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Wu of Han and Empress Wei Zifu. She was implicated in the Gongsun He case during the Witchcraft Delusion and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 西汉大司马大将军，卫子夫之弟。他在巫蛊之祸前去世，他的死使太子刘据失去了重要的政治支持。
description.en: Grand Marshal of the Western Han, and brother of Empress Wei Zifu. His death before the Witchcraft Delusion deprived Crown Prince Liu Ju of crucial political support.

description.zh-cn: 卫青长子，长平侯。在巫蛊之祸中受公孙贺案牵连被处死。
description.en: Eldest son of Wei Qing. He was implicated in the Gongsun He case during the Witchcraft Delusion and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 太子少傅。在刘据无法自辩时，劝说其起兵诛杀奸臣。
description.en: Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince. He advised Liu Ju to take up arms against the treacherous officials when the prince had no other way to defend himself.

description.zh-cn: 护北军使者。在巫蛊之祸中，他接到太子的调兵符节但选择闭门不出，持观望态度，后被汉武帝以“坐观成败，有二心”为由腰斩。
description.en: Supervisor of the Northern Army. During the Witchcraft Delusion, he received the Crown Prince's orders to mobilize troops but refused, adopting a wait-and-see attitude. He was later executed by Emperor Wu for his inaction and perceived disloyalty.

description.zh-cn: 司直。在太子兵败后，放其从城门逃走，后被汉武帝以“坐观成败，有贰心”为由腰斩。
description.en: Director of Justice. After the Crown Prince's defeat, he allowed him to escape through the city gates. He was later executed by Emperor Wu for perceived disloyalty.

description.zh-cn: 李广利，西汉将领，李延年与李夫人的兄弟，官至贰师将军。他曾远征大宛。在亲家刘屈牦因巫蛊案被杀后，他在前线仓促出击匈奴，兵败投降。最终他被匈奴所杀，并导致其家族被灭。
description.en: Li Guangli, a general of the Western Han dynasty, was the brother of Li Yannian and Empress Li, and held the title of General Ershi. He once led an expedition against Dayuan. After his relative by marriage, Liu Qumao, was executed in a witchcraft case, he hastily attacked the Xiongnu, was defeated, and surrendered. He was eventually killed by the Xiongnu, leading to the extermination of his clan.

description.zh-cn: 太子刘据之孙，刘进之子。巫蛊之祸中唯一的幸存者，尚在襁褓中即下狱，后被霍光等人拥立为帝，是为汉宣帝。
description.en: Grandson of Crown Prince Liu Ju and son of Liu Jin. He was the sole survivor of his family in the Witchcraft Delusion, imprisoned as an infant. He was later enthroned as Emperor Xuan by Huo Guang and others.

description.zh-cn: 皇太子刘据的妾室，在巫蛊之祸中被处死。
description.en: A consort of Crown Prince Liu Ju, executed during the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 皇太孙刘进之妻，汉宣帝刘病已之母，在巫蛊之祸中被处死。
description.en: Wife of Imperial Grandson Liu Jin and mother of Emperor Xuan (Liu Bingyi). She was executed during the Witchcraft Delusion.

description.zh-cn: 西汉官员。巫蛊之祸时任狱吏，暗中保护抚养了尚在襁褓中的刘病已。后向霍光提议立刘病已为帝。
description.en: A Western Han official. As a prison official during the Witchcraft Delusion, he secretly protected and raised the infant Liu Bingyi. He later proposed to Huo Guang that Liu Bingyi should be made emperor.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国浙江省温州专区瑞安县
birth_place.en: Ruian County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国的政治人物，正国级领导人。现任中共中央政治局常委，中华人民共和国国务院总理、党组书记，是李克强的继任者。
description.en: A politician of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, and a national-level leader. Currently a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CCP Central Committee, Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, and Secretary of its Party Leadership Group, succeeding Li Keqiang.

zh-cn: 中央应对新型冠状病毒感染疫情工作领导小组
中央应对新型冠状病毒感染肺炎疫情工作领导小组
en: Central Leading Group for Novel Coronavirus Prevention and Control

description.zh-cn: 为应对2019冠状病毒病疫情而设立的中央领导机构，由李克强担任组长。
description.en: A central leading group established to respond to the COVID-19 pandemic, headed by Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司联合创始人兼董事长。毕业于西安交通大学，曾就职于方正集团，并于2004年任雅虎中国总裁。
description.en: Co-founder and Chairman of Qihoo 360. A graduate of Xi'an Jiaotong University, he previously worked at Founder Group and served as the President of Yahoo! China in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 微软公司在中国的分支机构。曾与奇虎360合作，为中国Windows用户提供安全及升级服务。
description.en: The Chinese branch of Microsoft Corporation. It partnered with Qihoo 360 to provide security and upgrade services for Windows users in China.

description.zh-cn: 一套由美国商务部管理的法规，用于控制特定商品和技术的出口。奇虎360于2020年被列入该条例的实体清单。
description.en: A set of regulations administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce to control the export of certain goods and technologies. Qihoo 360 was added to its Entity List in 2020.

zh-cn: 艺进娱辉科技投资公司

description.zh-cn: 中国信息安全公司，曾与奇虎360因不正当竞争问题发生法律诉讼。
description.en: A Chinese information security company that was involved in a lawsuit with Qihoo 360 over unfair competition.

description.zh-cn: 因奇虎360官网发表的文章对其构成侵权而起诉该公司，并获胜诉。
description.en: Sued Qihoo 360 for infringement due to articles published on its official website and won the case.

description.zh-cn: 金山网络CEO。因其在社交媒体上对奇虎360的抨击言论，被奇虎360以商业信誉诋毁为由起诉。
description.en: CEO of Kingsoft Network. He was sued by Qihoo 360 for commercial defamation over his critical remarks about the company on social media.

description.zh-cn: 三六零安全科技股份有限公司高管，曾任副总裁。
description.en: An executive at Qihoo 360, previously served as Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 丘处机的弟子，随其西行，后成为全真教第六任掌教。
description.en: A disciple of Qiu Chuji who accompanied him on his journey to the west and later became the sixth leader of the Quanzhen School.

en: Seven True Disciples of the North

description.zh-cn: 全真教创始人王重阳的七位主要弟子。
description.en: The seven primary disciples of Wang Chongyang, founder of the Quanzhen School.

description.zh-cn: 全真教的主要支派之一，尊丘处机为祖师。
description.en: One of the main branches of the Quanzhen School, which reveres Qiu Chuji as its patriarch.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第五位皇帝，曾召见丘处机。
description.en: The fifth emperor of the Jin dynasty, who once summoned Qiu Chuji for an audience.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第六位皇帝，曾对丘处机及其道观予以支持。
description.en: The sixth emperor of the Jin dynasty, who supported Qiu Chuji and his Taoist temple.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第七位皇帝，曾召见丘处机。
description.en: The seventh emperor of the Jin dynasty, who once summoned Qiu Chuji for an audience.

description.zh-cn: 金朝第八位皇帝，曾因丘处机协助安抚民众而赐予封号。
description.en: The eighth emperor of the Jin dynasty, who bestowed a title upon Qiu Chuji for his assistance in pacifying the populace.

description.zh-cn: 南宋第四位皇帝。他曾派人邀请丘处机但被拒绝。此外，他也是赵德芳的八世孙。
description.en: The fourth emperor of the Southern Song dynasty. He sent envoys to invite Qiu Chuji but was declined. Additionally, he was an eighth-generation descendant of Zhao Defang.

description.zh-cn: 成吉思汗派遣的使者，负责邀请并护送丘处机西行。
description.en: An envoy sent by Genghis Khan, responsible for inviting and escorting Qiu Chuji on his journey west.

en: Travels to the West of Qiu Chang Chun
The Travels of the Perfect Man Changchun to the West

description.zh-cn: 由丘处机弟子李志常根据西行见闻所撰写的记述。
description.en: A record written by Qiu Chuji's disciple Li Zhichang based on his experiences during the journey to the west.

description.zh-cn: 元朝第三位皇帝，曾加封丘处机封号。
description.en: The third emperor of the Yuan dynasty, who granted an additional title to Qiu Chuji.

description.zh-cn: 全真教第四任掌教，丘处机的前任。
description.en: The fourth leader of the Quanzhen School, and Qiu Chuji's predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 金朝将领，曾请求丘处机协助安抚民众。
description.en: A general of the Jin dynasty who requested Qiu Chuji's assistance in pacifying the populace.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的著名道观，原名天长观。1227年成吉思汗赐名长春宫，并由丘处机掌管。丘处机在此羽化。
description.en: A famous Taoist temple in Beijing, originally named Tianchang Guan. In 1227, Genghis Khan renamed it Changchun Palace and placed it under the authority of Qiu Chuji, who passed away there.

description.zh-cn: 音乐制作人，《雪狼湖》的音乐总监和监制。
description.en: A music producer who served as the music director and producer for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡音乐人，《雪狼湖》的音乐总监和谱曲人。
description.en: A Singaporean musician who served as the music director and composer for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐人，《雪狼湖》的音乐总监和指挥。
description.en: A Hong Kong musician who served as the music director and conductor for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 音乐制作人，《雪狼湖》的监制、音乐总监和指挥。
description.en: A music producer who served as the producer, music director, and conductor for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港作家，《雪狼湖》音乐剧的原著小说作者。
description.en: A Hong Kong writer, author of the original novel on which the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake' is based.

description.zh-cn: 张学友于1997年发行的粤语专辑，收录了音乐剧《雪狼湖》的主要歌曲，在音乐剧公演前推出。
description.en: A Cantonese album by Jacky Cheung released in 1997, featuring the main songs from the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake', released before the musical's premiere.

description.zh-cn: 《雪狼湖》音乐剧的主要赞助商。
description.en: The main sponsor of the musical 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手、演员，在《雪狼湖》香港首演版本中饰演女主角宁静雪。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer and actress, who played the female lead Ning Jingxue in the Hong Kong premiere version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员、歌手，在《雪狼湖》新加坡版饰演宁静雪，国语版饰演宁玉凤。
description.en: A Hong Kong actress and singer, who played Ning Jingxue in the Singapore version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake' and Ning Yufeng in the Mandarin version.

description.zh-cn: 张学友于1996年与香港管弦乐团合作举办的系列音乐会。
description.en: A series of concerts held in 1996 by Jacky Cheung in collaboration with the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra.

description.zh-cn: 香港的管弦乐团，曾于1996年与张学友合作演出。
description.en: An orchestra in Hong Kong that collaborated with Jacky Cheung for a performance in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影美术指导及服装设计师，《雪狼湖》的美术总监和导演。
description.en: A Hong Kong film art director and costume designer who served as the art director and director for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐人，《雪狼湖》的谱曲人、填词人及改编者。
description.en: A Hong Kong musician who was a composer, lyricist, and adapter for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影编剧及导演，《雪狼湖》的改编者。
description.en: A Hong Kong film screenwriter and director who was an adapter for 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡歌手、演员，在《雪狼湖》中饰演宁玉凤。
description.en: A Singaporean singer and actress who played Ning Yufeng in 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 美国籍台湾歌手、演员，在《雪狼湖》国语版中饰演宁静雪。
description.en: An American-Taiwanese singer and actress who played Ning Jingxue in the Mandarin version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 中国歌手，在《雪狼湖》国语版中饰演宁静雪。
description.en: A Chinese singer who played Ning Jingxue in the Mandarin version of 'Snow.Wolf.Lake'.

description.zh-cn: 由王思聪创立的私募股权投资公司。
description.en: A private equity investment company founded by Wang Sicong.

description.en: A video live streaming website founded by Wang Sicong, which went bankrupt in 2019.

en: Shanghai Banana Plan Cultural Development Co., Ltd.

description.en: A talent agency founded by Wang Sicong.

description.en: An e-sports club acquired and restructured by Wang Sicong.
