description.en: A lieutenant general of the PLA, who served as Political Commissar of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，籍贯山东掖县。担任辽宁五一八内燃机配件有限公司董事长兼总经理，并当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China with an ancestral home in Yexian, Shandong. He serves as the Chairman and General Manager of Liaoning 518 Internal Combustion Engine Parts Co., Ltd., and was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杨彬的籍贯地，位于山东省。
description.en: Yang Bin's ancestral home, located in Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 日本在上海的军事单位，参与了虹桥机场事件及淞沪会战。
description.en: A Japanese military unit in Shanghai involved in the Hongqiao Airport Incident and the Battle of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海的军用机场，是虹桥机场事件的发生地。
description.en: A military airport in Shanghai, China, and the site of the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1932年，日本军队在中国上海挑起的军事冲突，蔡廷锴率领的十九路军进行了坚决抵抗。冲突结束后，中日双方签订了《淞沪停战协定》。
description.en: A military conflict instigated by the Japanese army in Shanghai, China in 1932, where the 19th Route Army led by Cai Tingkai offered determined resistance. After the conflict, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 一·二八事变后中日签订的停战协定，划定上海为非武装区，限制了中国军队的活动。
description.en: A ceasefire agreement signed by China and Japan after the January 28 Incident, which designated Shanghai as a demilitarized zone and restricted Chinese military activities.

description.zh-cn: 中国军官，时任保安团总团长，在虹桥机场事件中向张治中报告情况。
description.en: A Chinese military officer, then commander-in-chief of the Security Regiment, who reported the situation to Zhang Zhizhong during the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本在上海的外交代表机构，参与了虹桥机场事件的交涉。
description.en: The diplomatic representative body of Japan in Shanghai, involved in the negotiations of the Hongqiao Airport Incident.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命后，以邓小平为代表的政治派别，主张实事求是、解放思想，推动拨乱反正和改革开放。
description.en: A political faction represented by Deng Xiaoping after the Cultural Revolution, advocating for seeking truth from facts, emancipating the mind, and promoting Boluan Fanzheng and Reform and Opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 指始于1970年代末、贯穿整个1980年代的中国大陆思想解放运动。该运动被视为继五四运动后的第二次启蒙，以真理标准大讨论为起点，李泽厚是其代表人物之一。
description.en: Refers to the ideological emancipation movement in mainland China that began in the late 1970s and lasted through the 1980s. It is considered the second enlightenment after the May Fourth Movement and started with the Truth Criterion Discussion. Li Zehou was one of its representative figures.

description.zh-cn: 美国地质学家、物理学家和教育家，麻省理工学院的创始人。
description.en: American geologist, physicist, and educator, the founder of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 美国教育家，曾任哈佛大学校长，在任期间曾六次建议将麻省理工学院并入哈佛大学。
description.en: American academic who served as president of Harvard University and, during his tenure, proposed merging MIT with Harvard six times.

description.zh-cn: 美国发明家和企业家，伊士曼柯达公司的创始人，曾向麻省理工学院提供巨额匿名捐款。
description.en: American inventor and entrepreneur who founded the Eastman Kodak Company and provided large anonymous donations to MIT.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家，1930年至1948年担任麻省理工学院校长，期间推动了课程改革。
description.en: American physicist who served as President of MIT from 1930 to 1948, during which he pushed for curriculum reform.

description.zh-cn: 一种利用无线电波探测目标的遥感技术，麻省理工学院放射实验室在二战期间对其发展做出了关键贡献。
description.en: A remote sensing technology that uses radio waves to detect objects, whose development was critically advanced by the MIT Radiation Laboratory during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 英国计算机科学家，万维网的发明者，在麻省理工学院建立了万维网联盟。
description.en: British computer scientist, inventor of the World Wide Web, who founded the World Wide Web Consortium at MIT.

description.zh-cn: 负责制定万维网主要标准的国际标准组织，由蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在麻省理工学院创立。
description.en: The main international standards organization for the World Wide Web, founded at MIT by Tim Berners-Lee.

description.zh-cn: 2013年4月15日，美国波士顿马拉松赛终点线附近发生恐怖袭击事件。三天后，嫌犯在逃窜中射杀了麻省理工学院警卫肖恩·科利尔。
description.en: On April 15, 2013, a terrorist attack occurred near the finish line of the Boston Marathon in Boston, USA. Three days later, the suspects, during their escape, shot and killed MIT police officer Sean Collier.

description.zh-cn: 加纳外交家，曾任第七任联合国秘书长，麻省理工学院校友。
description.en: A Ghanaian diplomat who served as the seventh Secretary-General of the United Nations, and an alumnus of MIT.

description.zh-cn: 美国前宇航员、工程师，曾参与阿波罗11号任务，是第二位踏上月球的人。他拥有麻省理工学院的博士学位。
description.en: American former astronaut and engineer. He was part of the Apollo 11 mission and the second person to walk on the Moon. He holds a doctorate from MIT.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家和企业家，因共同发明集成电路而被誉为“硅谷市长”，英特尔公司的联合创始人，麻省理工学院校友。
description.en: American physicist and entrepreneur nicknamed 'the Mayor of Silicon Valley' for co-inventing the integrated circuit. He was a co-founder of Intel Corporation and an alumnus of MIT.

en: List of Bose home audio products

description.zh-cn: 一家以生产高端音响设备闻名的美国制造公司，由麻省理工学院校友及教授Amar Bose创办。
description.en: An American manufacturing company known for high-end audio equipment, founded by MIT alumnus and professor Amar Bose.

description.zh-cn: 美国神经科学家，曾担任麻省理工学院第16任校长，是该校第一位女校长。
description.en: American neuroscientist who served as the 16th president of MIT, becoming the first woman to hold the position.

location.zh-cn: 中国广东省潮州市湘桥区西荣路48号

description.zh-cn: 潮州广播电视台，是中华人民共和国广东省潮州市的市级广播电视媒体。它于2004年由潮州人民广播电台及潮州电视台合并成立。潮州电视台作为其前身之一，主要在1987年至2004年间提供电视服务。
description.en: Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station is a municipal-level radio and television media outlet in Chaozhou, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. It was formed in 2004 by the merger of Chaozhou People's Radio Station and Chaozhou Television Station. Chaozhou Television Station, as one of its predecessors, primarily provided television services from 1987 to 2004.

zh-cn: 南方广播影视传媒集团

description.zh-cn: 中国内地第一个由省、市、县广播电视系统企事业单位联合组成的全省性事业集团，也是潮州广播电视台的上级单位。该集团于2014年整合并入广东广播电视台。
description.en: The first provincial-level business group in mainland China formed by the joint venture of radio and television enterprises and institutions from provincial, municipal, and county levels, and also the parent organization of Chaozhou Broadcast Television Station. This group was integrated into Guangdong Radio and Television in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 中国的国家网络电视播出机构，也是中国中央电视台的官方网站。
description.en: China's national web-based television broadcaster, also serving as the official website of China Central Television.

description.zh-cn: 中国广东省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guangdong Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国广东省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guangdong Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省潮州市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Chaozhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第二次全体会议
en: Second Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 讨论研究修改宪法部分内容的建议。
description.en: Discussed and studied proposals for amending parts of the Constitution.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第三次全体会议
en: Third Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了关于深化党和国家机构改革的决定和方案。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the decision and plan on deepening the reform of Party and state institutions.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第四次全体会议
en: Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了关于坚持和完善中国特色社会主义制度、推进国家治理体系和治理能力现代化若干重大问题的决定。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the Decision on Some Major Issues Concerning How to Uphold and Improve the System of Socialism with Chinese Characteristics and Advance the Modernization of China's System and Capacity for Governance.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共十九届四中全会上被递补为中央委员。
description.en: A Chinese politician who was made a full member of the Central Committee at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国工程技术专家，在中共十九届四中全会上被递补为中央委员。
description.en: A Chinese engineering expert who was made a full member of the Central Committee at the Fourth Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第五次全体会议
en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于制定国民经济和社会发展第十四个五年规划和2035年远景目标的建议》。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Proposals of the CPC Central Committee for Formulating the 14th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第六次全体会议
en: Sixth plenary session of the 19th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 审议通过了《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议》和《关于召开党的第二十次全国代表大会的决议》。
description.en: Reviewed and adopted the 'Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party over the Past Century' and the 'Resolution on the Convening of the 20th National Congress of the Party'.

zh-cn: 关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议
中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议
en: Resolution on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party over the Past Century
Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party over the Past Century

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党通过的第三个历史决议，总结了党的百年历史。
description.en: The third historical resolution passed by the Communist Party of China, summarizing the party's century-long history.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第七次全体会议
en: Seventh plenary session of the 19th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
Seventh Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 决定中国共产党第二十次全国代表大会于2022年10月16日在北京召开。
description.en: Decided that the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China would be convened in Beijing on October 16, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 中国白族作家、文艺理论家，曾任云南大学中文系系主任。
description.en: A Chinese writer and literary theorist of Bai ethnicity, formerly the head of the Department of Chinese at Yunnan University.

description.zh-cn: 由商鞅在秦国推行的政治和经济改革，是秦国能统一六国的重要原因。
description.en: Political and economic reforms implemented by Shang Yang in the State of Qin, a key reason for Qin's ability to unify the six states.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期的史学家和思想家，首次将法家思想的流派命名为“法家”。
description.en: A historian and thinker of the Western Han Dynasty who first named the school of Legalist thought as 'Legalism'.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国政治家，辅佐齐桓公，其改革被一些学者认为是法家的起源。
description.en: A statesman of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period who assisted Duke Huan of Qi. His reforms are considered by some scholars to be the origin of Legalism.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期齐国国君，春秋五霸之首，在管仲辅佐下称霸。
description.en: The ruler of the State of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period, the first of the Five Hegemons, who achieved hegemony with the assistance of Guan Zhong.

description.zh-cn: 南开大学历史系教授，认为法家思想与法西斯主义有相通之处。
description.en: A professor of history at Nankai University who believed there were parallels between Legalist thought and fascism.

properties.period: 春秋末期 - 战国初期

description.zh-cn: 孔子弟子，孔门十哲之一，在晋国西河办学，培养出李悝、吴起等法家代表人物。
description.en: A disciple of Confucius and one of the Ten Wise Ones of the Confucian School. He established a school in Xihe of the Jin state, where he educated future Legalist representatives like Li Kui and Wu Qi.

description.zh-cn: 战国初期军事家、政治家、改革家，法家代表人物。曾师从子夏和曾申，后仕于魏国，任西河郡守，为魏国夺取并守卫了河西之地。
description.en: A military strategist, statesman, and reformer of the early Warring States period, and a representative of Legalism. He studied under Zixia and Zeng Shen, later serving the state of Wei as the governor of Xihe Commandery, successfully capturing and defending the Hexi region for Wei.

description.zh-cn: 中国诗人，曾任中国作家协会副主席、西北艺术学院院长等职务。
description.en: Chinese poet, who served as vice chairman of the China Writers Association and president of the Northwest Art College.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国云南省，是柯仲平的出生地。
description.en: A county in Yunnan Province, China, and the birthplace of Ke Zhongping.

en: Xi'an Middle School of Shaanxi Province

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期的云南省，是曾泽生的出生地所在省份。
description.en: Yunnan Province during the Qing Dynasty, the province where Zeng Zesheng was born.

description.zh-cn: 位于云南省的县，是曾泽生的出生地。
description.en: A county in Yunnan Province, the birthplace of Zeng Zesheng.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第五十军
中国人民解放军第五十军
en: 50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army
60th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 原为龙云的滇系部队，后在长春围困战中由军长曾泽生率领起义，并被改编为中国人民解放军第五十军。
description.en: Originally a unit of Long Yun's Yunnan clique, it defected under the leadership of its commander Zeng Zesheng during the Siege of Changchun and was reorganized into the 50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第五十军首任政治部主任。
description.en: The first Director of the Political Department of the 50th Corps of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 抗美援朝战争期间的一次战役，在此次战役中，曾泽生麾下的陈屏率部率先攻入汉城。
description.en: A campaign during the Korean War, in which Chen Ping, under Zeng Zesheng's command, led his troops to be the first to enter Seoul.

description.zh-cn: 授予在解放战争时期参加革命战争有功而无重大过失的人员的勋章。曾泽生于1955年荣获一级解放勋章。
description.en: A medal awarded to personnel who participated in the War of Liberation with meritorious service and without major faults. Zeng Zesheng was awarded the First Class Order of Liberation in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的勋章。曾泽生于1953年获朝鲜授予一级国旗勋章。
description.en: An order of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. Zeng Zesheng was awarded the First Class Order of the National Flag by North Korea in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，吴政隆的继任中共江苏省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, successor to Wu Zhenglong as the Party Secretary of Jiangsu.

zh-cn: 中国共产党江苏省纪律检查委员会
南京市 (中华人民共和国直辖市)

description.zh-cn: 中国江西省吉安市下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Ji'an, Jiangxi, China.

description.zh-cn: 在美国洛杉矶举办的第23届夏季奥林匹克运动会。
description.en: The 23rd Summer Olympic Games held in Los Angeles, United States.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国（台湾）在国际体育赛事中使用的名称。
description.en: The name used by the Republic of China (Taiwan) in international sporting events.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆对台湾的广播电台。
description.en: A radio station from mainland China broadcasting to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 魏国后期的都城，位于今河南省开封市。魏惠王时期为躲避秦国威胁而迁都于此。
description.en: The later capital of the state of Wei, located in modern-day Kaifeng, Henan Province. King Hui moved the capital here to evade the threat from the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 魏国前期的都城，位于今山西省夏县境内。
description.en: The early capital of the state of Wei, located in modern-day Xia County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国战国时期的诸侯国，战国七雄之一。由田氏取代姜姓齐国而建立。
description.en: A state during the Warring States period of China and one of the Seven Warring States. It was established by the Tian clan, which replaced the ruling House of Jiang in the original state of Qi.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期齐国与魏国之间的一场战役，齐国运用孙膑“围魏救赵”的战术取得胜利。
description.en: A battle between the states of Qi and Wei during the Warring States period. Qi achieved victory by employing Sun Bin's strategy of 'besieging Wei to rescue Zhao'.

description.zh-cn: 魏国末代君主，魏景湣王之子。于公元前225年被秦国所灭。
description.en: The last king of the state of Wei, son of King Jingmin of Wei. He was overthrown when Wei was conquered by Qin in 225 BC.

description.zh-cn: 魏安禧王之弟，战国四公子之一。曾施计窃符救赵，并于公元前247年率五国联军大败秦军，但后遭魏王猜忌，郁郁而终。
description.en: Younger brother of King Anxi of Wei and one of the Four Lords of the Warring States. He famously stole a military tally to rescue the state of Zhao and led a five-state coalition to a major victory against Qin in 247 BC, but was later sidelined due to the king's suspicion and died in frustration.

description.zh-cn: 魏国君主，信陵君之兄。在其任内，魏国国力已衰，曾拜信陵君为上将军抗秦，但后又因猜忌而疏远他。
description.en: Monarch of the state of Wei and elder brother of Lord Xinling. During his reign, Wei was in decline. He appointed Lord Xinling as commander-in-chief to resist Qin but later grew suspicious and alienated him.

description.zh-cn: 秦国将领，曾率军攻打魏国，后被信陵君率领的五国联军击败。
description.en: A general from the state of Qin who led an invasion of Wei but was defeated by a five-state coalition army led by Lord Xinling.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期魏国将领，受魏文侯之命攻灭中山国。
description.en: A general of the state of Wei during the Warring States period, who was commissioned by Marquess Wen of Wei to conquer the state of Zhongshan.

description.zh-cn: 晋国大夫，因战功被晋献公封于魏地，立为“魏氏”，是魏国的始祖。
description.en: A grand master of the state of Jin. For his military achievements, he was enfeoffed in the land of Wei by Duke Xian of Jin, establishing the 'Wei clan' and becoming the progenitor of the future state of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 晋国六卿之一，由毕万所立，后发展为战国七雄之一的魏国。
description.en: One of the Six Ministerial Clans of the state of Jin, founded by Bi Wan, which later evolved into the state of Wei, one of the Seven Warring States.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期晋国君主，将魏地封给毕万，使其建立魏氏。
description.en: A ruler of the state of Jin during the Spring and Autumn period who enfeoffed Bi Wan with the land of Wei, allowing him to establish the Wei clan.

description.zh-cn: 魏国第二位君主，魏文侯之子。
description.en: The second monarch of the state of Wei, son of Marquess Wen of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 魏国君主，魏惠王之子。
description.en: A monarch of the state of Wei, son of King Hui of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 魏国倒数第二位君主，魏王假之父。
description.en: The penultimate king of the state of Wei, father of King Jia of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 元末古文大家，宋濂的老师之一。
description.en: A master of classical prose in the late Yuan dynasty, and one of Song Lian's teachers.

description.zh-cn: 元末学者，宋濂的老师之一。
description.en: A scholar of the late Yuan dynasty and one of Song Lian's teachers.

description.zh-cn: 元末学者，宋濂的老师之一。
description.en: A scholar of the late Yuan dynasty and one of Song Lian's teachers.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋第十一子，封蜀王。因仰慕宋濂，将其转葬于华阳。
description.en: The eleventh son of Emperor Taizu of Ming, Zhu Yuanzhang, enfeoffed as the Prince of Shu. He admired Song Lian and had his tomb relocated to Huayang.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国功臣，政治家、文学家，与宋濂、高启并称“明初诗文三大家”。
description.en: A founding father of the Ming dynasty, a politician and writer, known as one of the 'Three Masters of Poetry and Prose of the Early Ming' along with Song Lian and Gao Qi.

description.zh-cn: 《二十四史》之一，由宋濂、王祎主修，记载元朝历史的纪传体史书。
description.en: One of the Twenty-Four Histories, primarily compiled by Song Lian and Wang Yi, it is an annalistic-biographical history of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国浙江省金华市下辖的一个县，同时也是宋濂的籍贯所在地。
description.en: A county under the administration of Jinhua City, in Zhejiang Province, China, and also Song Lian's ancestral home.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂因胡惟庸案被流放的地点。
description.en: The location where Song Lian was exiled due to the Hu Weiyong case.

zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会办公厅联络局
全国人大常委会办公厅联络局

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区前门西大街1号全国人大机关办公楼
location.en: No. 1 Qianmen West Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会办公厅的内设机构，行政级别为正司局级。
description.en: An internal department of the General Office of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, with a departmental-bureau level administrative rank.

zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会办公厅
全国人大常委会办公厅
en: General Office of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The administrative body of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

zh-cn: 玛丽亚·特蕾西亚 (奥地利)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡王朝的统治者，奥地利女大公、匈牙利和波希米亚女王，并通过婚姻成为神圣罗马帝国皇后。她策划了“外交革命”，与法国和俄国结盟，旨在从普鲁士手中收复西里西亚。她是玛丽·安托瓦内特的母亲。
description.en: Ruler of the Habsburg dominions, Archduchess of Austria, Queen of Hungary and Bohemia, and Holy Roman Empress by marriage. She orchestrated the 'Diplomatic Revolution,' forming an alliance with France and Russia with the goal of retaking Silesia from Prussia. She was the mother of Marie Antoinette.

zh-cn: 弗朗茨一世 (神圣罗马帝国)
法兰兹一世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝及托斯卡纳大公，通过与玛丽亚·特蕾莎的婚姻，他是哈布斯堡-洛林王朝的创始人。他是玛丽·安托瓦内特的父亲。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor and Grand Duke of Tuscany, founder of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine through his marriage to Maria Theresa. He was the father of Marie Antoinette.

description.zh-cn: 一宗涉及诈骗珠宝商购买昂贵钻石项链的宫廷丑闻。尽管玛丽·安托瓦内特并未涉案，但这起事件严重损害了她的声誉。
description.en: A court scandal involving a scheme to defraud jewelers of the price of an expensive diamond necklace. Although Marie Antoinette was not involved, the incident severely damaged her reputation.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王，路易十六的祖父。他促成了玛丽·安托瓦内特与路易十六的婚姻。
description.en: King of France and grandfather of Louis XVI. He arranged the marriage between Marie Antoinette and Louis XVI.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王路易十五的最后一位情妇，在宫廷中与玛丽·安托瓦内特关系紧张。
description.en: The last official mistress of King Louis XV of France, who had a tense relationship with Marie Antoinette at court.

zh-cn: 汉斯·阿克塞尔·冯·费尔森

description.zh-cn: 瑞典伯爵、外交官和军官，被认为是玛丽·安托瓦内特的密友和情人，并策划了王室的出逃计划。
description.en: A Swedish count, diplomat, and officer, believed to be a close friend and lover of Marie Antoinette, who organized the royal family's flight to Varennes.

zh-cn: 约瑟夫二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，玛丽·安托瓦内特的兄长。他曾访问法国，试图解决妹妹婚姻中的问题并巩固法奥同盟。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor and brother of Marie Antoinette. He visited France to address issues in his sister's marriage and to strengthen the Franco-Austrian alliance.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间，国王路易十六、王后玛丽·安托瓦内特及其家人试图逃离巴黎但失败的事件。此事严重损害了君主制在民众中的信誉。
description.en: A failed attempt by King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette, and their family to escape from Paris during the French Revolution. The event severely damaged the credibility of the monarchy among the populace.

en: Honoré Gabriel Riqueti, comte de Mirabeau

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命初期的领袖人物，主张君主立宪制。他曾秘密与玛丽·安托瓦内特合作，试图调和君主制与革命。
description.en: A leader in the early stages of the French Revolution who advocated for a constitutional monarchy. He secretly collaborated with Marie Antoinette to try to reconcile the monarchy with the revolution.

en: Gilbert du Motier, Marquis de Lafayette

description.zh-cn: 法国贵族和军官，在美国独立战争和法国大革命中扮演了关键角色。他担任国民自卫军总司令，负责监护被软禁的王室，与玛丽·安托瓦内特关系复杂。
description.en: A French aristocrat and military officer who played a key role in the American Revolutionary War and the French Revolution. As commander of the National Guard, he was responsible for the custody of the royal family and had a complex relationship with Marie Antoinette.

description.zh-cn: 由普鲁士和奥地利军队指挥官布伦瑞克公爵发布的宣言，威胁称如果法国王室受到伤害，将摧毁巴黎。此宣言激化了革命情绪。
description.en: A proclamation issued by the Duke of Brunswick, commander of the allied Prussian and Austrian army, threatening the destruction of Paris if the French royal family were harmed. The manifesto radicalized the revolution.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命的关键事件之一，武装革命者攻占杜乐丽宫，导致法国君主制的垮台。
description.en: A defining event of the French Revolution, where armed revolutionaries stormed the Tuileries Palace, leading to the collapse of the French monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 一种在法国大革命期间被广泛用于执行死刑的装置，玛丽·安托瓦内特在此装置上被处决。
description.en: A device widely used for executions during the French Revolution, on which Marie Antoinette was executed.

description.zh-cn: 在法国大革命恐怖统治时期，实际上的法国执政机构，由罗伯斯比尔主导，预先决定了对玛丽·安托瓦内特的审判结果。
description.en: The de facto executive government of France during the Reign of Terror, dominated by Robespierre, which predetermined the outcome of Marie Antoinette's trial.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命中的温和派政治家，在王室逃亡失败后护送他们返回巴黎，并试图与玛丽·安托瓦内特合作建立君主立宪制。
description.en: A moderate politician during the French Revolution who escorted the royal family back to Paris after their failed flight and attempted to work with Marie Antoinette to establish a constitutional monarchy.

zh-cn: 法兰西王国长公主玛丽-泰蕾兹

description.zh-cn: 路易十六和玛丽·安托瓦内特的长女，也是他们四个孩子中唯一活到成年的。
description.en: The eldest child of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette, and the only one of their four children to survive to adulthood.

zh-cn: 路易-约瑟夫 (法国王太子)
法国王太子路易-约瑟夫

description.zh-cn: 路易十六和玛丽·安托瓦内特的长子，法国王太子，因肺结核早逝。
description.en: The eldest son and Dauphin of France of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette, who died young from tuberculosis.

zh-cn: 法兰西王国公主苏菲·海伦·碧雅翠丝

description.zh-cn: 路易十六和玛丽·安托瓦内特的小女儿，在婴儿时期夭折。
description.en: The youngest daughter of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette, who died in infancy.

description.zh-cn: 日本科学家，山中伸弥在奈良先端科学技术大学院大学的博士班学生，与山中伸弥共同开创了诱导性多功能干细胞（iPS细胞）研究。
description.en: A Japanese scientist who was Shinya Yamanaka's doctoral student at the Nara Institute of Science and Technology and co-pioneered the research on induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells) with him.

description.zh-cn: 英国发育生物学家，因发现成熟细胞可被重写成多功能细胞与山中伸弥同获2012年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。其早期研究为iPS细胞的发现奠定了基础。
description.en: A British developmental biologist who shared the 2012 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Shinya Yamanaka for the discovery that mature cells can be reprogrammed to become pluripotent. His early research laid the groundwork for the discovery of iPS cells.

description.zh-cn: 日本免疫学家，曾任大阪大学校长。他支持了山中伸弥的早期研究，帮助其获得完成iPS细胞奠基性研究的经费。
description.en: A Japanese immunologist and former president of Osaka University. He supported Shinya Yamanaka's early research, helping him secure funding to complete the foundational work on iPS cells.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本兵库县神户市的国立大学，是山中伸弥获得医学士学位的母校。
description.en: A national university in Kobe, Hyogo, Japan, and the alma mater where Shinya Yamanaka received his M.D.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本大阪府大阪市的公立大学，是山中伸弥获得医学博士学位的母校。
description.en: A public university in Osaka, Osaka Prefecture, Japan, and the alma mater where Shinya Yamanaka received his Ph.D. in Medicine.

zh-cn: 奈良先端科学技术大学院大学
en: Nara Institute of Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 位于日本奈良县生驹市的国立大学法人。山中伸弥曾在此担任副教授，并开始iPS细胞研究。
description.en: A national university corporation located in Ikoma, Nara, Japan. Shinya Yamanaka served as an associate professor here and began his iPS cell research.

description.zh-cn: 一种由体细胞经过重编程技术得到的多能干细胞。该技术由山中伸弥团队于2006年首次成功实现，为再生医学开辟了新的可能性，并避免了使用胚胎干细胞的伦理争议。
description.en: A type of pluripotent stem cell generated from somatic cells through reprogramming techniques. This technology was first successfully achieved by Shinya Yamanaka's team in 2006, opening up new possibilities in regenerative medicine and avoiding the ethical controversies associated with embryonic stem cells.

description.zh-cn: 梵蒂冈的科学学院，旨在促进数学、物理和自然科学的进步以及相关认识论问题的研究。
description.en: The scientific academy of the Vatican City, established to promote the progress of the mathematical, physical, and natural sciences and the study of related epistemological problems.

description.zh-cn: 日本文部科学省的特别机关，旨在表彰在学术上取得卓越成就的科学家，并为日本的学术发展提供支持。
description.en: A special organization under the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology of Japan, established to honor scientists with outstanding academic achievements and to support the advancement of science in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 军衔等级。
description.en: A military rank.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西共和国的国家元首职位。
description.en: The position of the head of state of the French Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治人物，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的前任法国总统。
description.en: French politician, predecessor to Emmanuel Macron as President of France.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治人物，曾在其总理任内任命埃马纽埃尔·马克龙为经济部长。
description.en: French politician who, as Prime Minister, appointed Emmanuel Macron as Minister of Economy.

zh-cn: 经济产业更新和信息技术部
en: Ministry of the Economy and Finance (France)

description.zh-cn: 法国政府部门之一，负责制定和实施国家的经济、金融、财政和税务政策。
description.en: A ministry of the Government of France, responsible for the nation's economic, financial, fiscal, and tax policy.

description.zh-cn: 法国的一个中间派自由主义政党，由埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于2016年4月创立。塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼于2017年加入。
description.en: A centrist and liberal political party in France, founded by Emmanuel Macron in April 2016. Sébastien Lecornu joined in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 2017年举行的法国总统选举，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在该次选举中首次当选总统。
description.en: The 2017 presidential election in France, in which Emmanuel Macron was first elected president.

zh-cn: 布丽吉特·玛丽-克洛德·托涅

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的妻子，曾是他在高中时期的老师。
description.en: The wife of Emmanuel Macron, who was formerly his high school teacher.

description.zh-cn: 法国的一个社会民主主义政党，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙曾是其党员。
description.en: A social-democratic political party in France, of which Emmanuel Macron was a former member.

description.zh-cn: 2022年举行的法国总统选举，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在该次选举中成功连任。
description.en: The 2022 presidential election in France, in which Emmanuel Macron won re-election.

description.zh-cn: 法国北部城市，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的出生地。
description.en: A city in northern France, the birthplace of Emmanuel Macron.

description.zh-cn: 位于法国巴黎的公立大学，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在此获得哲学高等深入研究文凭。
description.en: A public university in Paris, France, where Emmanuel Macron obtained a DEA degree in Philosophy.

description.zh-cn: 法国著名的高等教育机构，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在此获得公共行政硕士学位。
description.en: A prestigious higher education institution in France, where Emmanuel Macron obtained a Master's degree in Public Administration.

description.zh-cn: 法国培养高级公务员的顶尖学府，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在此获得高级公务员资格。
description.en: A top French graduate school for senior civil servants, from which Emmanuel Macron graduated.

description.zh-cn: 法国哲学家，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙曾担任其助理。
description.en: A French philosopher for whom Emmanuel Macron worked as an assistant.

description.zh-cn: 法国经济学家及战略分析家，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙曾在他领导的委员会中担任副书记。
description.en: A French economist and strategic analyst, in whose commission Emmanuel Macron served as a deputy rapporteur.

description.zh-cn: 一家跨国投资银行和金融服务公司，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙曾在此担任投资银行家。
description.en: A multinational investment bank and financial services company where Emmanuel Macron worked as an investment banker.

description.zh-cn: 一场始于2018年11月的抗议运动，最初旨在反对马克龙政府提高燃油税的计划。
description.en: A protest movement that began in November 2018, initially to protest against the Macron government's plan to raise fuel taxes.

zh-cn: 法国教师遭遇极端分子斩首案件

description.zh-cn: 一名法国教师因在课堂上展示穆罕默德漫画而被伊斯兰极端分子斩首的事件。该事件促使马克龙发表强硬的反伊斯兰激进主义言论。
description.en: The beheading of a French teacher by an Islamic extremist for showing cartoons of Muhammad in class. The incident prompted Macron to make strong remarks against Islamic radicalism.

en: Strategic autonomy for the European Union

description.zh-cn: 欧盟的一项政策目标，旨在增强其独立行动的能力。马克龙是该理念的主要倡导者之一。
description.en: A policy goal of the European Union to enhance its capacity to act autonomously. Macron is one of its main proponents.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平提出的著名经济理论，强调实用主义。马克龙曾引用此论。
description.en: A famous economic theory emphasizing pragmatism, proposed by Deng Xiaoping. Macron quoted this theory.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会34名创会会员之一，并于1892年至1926年间担任马会主席。
description.en: One of the 34 founding members of The Hong Kong Jockey Club, and served as its chairman from 1892 to 1926.

description.zh-cn: 1918年2月26日在香港跑马地马场发生的一场严重火灾。
description.en: A catastrophic fire that occurred on 26 February 1918 at the Happy Valley Racecourse in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港总督，在其授意下，香港赛马会于1927年开始吸纳华裔会员。他还主持了英皇书院般咸道校舍的开幕典礼。
description.en: Governor of Hong Kong. Under his initiative, The Hong Kong Jockey Club began to admit Chinese members in 1927. He also presided over the opening ceremony of the King's College Bonham Road campus.

description.zh-cn: 香港著名买办，为香港赛马会于1927年吸纳的首批华裔会员之一。
description.en: A prominent Hong Kong comprador, one of the first Chinese members admitted to The Hong Kong Jockey Club in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 澳门的赛马机构，已于2024年停业。
description.en: The horse racing organization in Macau, which ceased operations in 2024.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，香港赛马会董事局主席。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician and Chairman of the Board of Stewards of The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会行政总裁。
description.en: Chief Executive Officer of The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港新界的赛马场，由香港赛马会营运。
description.en: A racecourse located in the New Territories of Hong Kong, operated by The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国广东省广州市从化区的马匹训练设施及赛马场，由香港赛马会营运。
description.en: A horse training facility and racecourse in Conghua District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, China, operated by The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 香港的合法奖券游戏，由香港赛马会主办。
description.en: A legal lottery game in Hong Kong, operated by The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会提供的合法足球赛事博彩服务。
description.en: A legal football betting service provided by The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

en: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 香港的一所公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in Hong Kong.

zh-cn: 赛马会动物医学及生命科学院
en: Jockey Club College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences

description.zh-cn: 香港城市大学下的一个学院，由香港赛马会慈善信托基金捐款支持。
description.en: A college within the City University of Hong Kong, supported by a donation from The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦义的妻子。
description.en: Spouse of Wu Den-yih.

description.zh-cn: 高雄市的最高行政首长职位。
description.en: The highest administrative chief position in Kaohsiung City.

en: List of county magistrates of Nantou

zh-cn: 2020年中华民国总统副总统及立法委员选举

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的一次全国性选举，国民党的失利导致时任党主席吴敦义引咎辞职。
description.en: A national election in the Republic of China, the Kuomintang's defeat led to the resignation of then-chairman Wu Den-yih.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治及商界人物，因其子未被吴敦义任命为副市长而与其交恶，并创造了“白贼义”这一绰号。
description.en: A Taiwanese political and business figure who had a falling out with Wu Den-yih after his son was not appointed deputy mayor, coining the nickname 'Liar Yi'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾苗栗县竹南镇大埔里因征地引发的抗争事件。时任行政院长吴敦义的承诺被指跳票，使其声誉受损。
description.en: A protest event in Dapu, Zhunan, Miaoli County, Taiwan, caused by land expropriation. Then-Premier Wu Den-yih's promises were allegedly broken, damaging his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 台湾地方闻人，曾与吴敦义夫妇同游峇里岛而引发争议。
description.en: A local figure in Taiwan who caused controversy by traveling to Bali with Wu Den-yih and his wife.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾南投县的镇，是吴敦义的出生地。
description.en: A township in Nantou County, Taiwan, and the birthplace of Wu Den-yih.

description.zh-cn: 二二八事件后国民政府在台湾进行的绥靖、整肃和镇压行动，吴敦义之父吴奚在此期间被捕入狱。
description.en: A pacification, purge, and suppression campaign conducted by the Nationalist government in Taiwan after the February 28 Incident. Wu Den-yih's father, Wu Hsi, was arrested and imprisoned during this period.

description.zh-cn: 重创台湾的台风，引发的救灾争议导致时任行政院长刘兆玄内阁总辞，由吴敦义接任。
description.en: A typhoon that severely impacted Taiwan. The controversy over disaster relief led to the resignation of the cabinet of then-Premier Liu Chao-shiuan, with Wu Den-yih taking over.

description.zh-cn: 由刘兆玄担任行政院院长期间的中华民国行政院团队。因八八水灾救灾不力总辞。
description.en: The Executive Yuan team of the Republic of China during Liu Chao-shiuan's tenure as Premier. The cabinet resigned en masse due to criticism of its handling of Typhoon Morakot relief efforts.

description.zh-cn: 中国航天科技集团的下属公司，刘超英曾在此担任经理。
description.en: A subsidiary of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, where Liu Chaoying served as a manager.

中国人民解放军总参谋部情报部

Intelligence Department of the General Staff Department of the People's Liberation Army

description.zh-cn: 原中国人民解放军总参谋部下属的情报机构，现为中央军委联合参谋部内设机构。
description.en: Formerly an intelligence agency under the General Staff Department of the People's Liberation Army, it is now an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 一起指控中华人民共和国政府试图影响1996年美国联邦选举的政治丑闻。
description.en: A political scandal alleging that the government of the People's Republic of China attempted to influence the 1996 United States federal elections.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华裔企业家，1996年美国竞选财务丑闻中的关键人物，与刘超英有业务往来并向民主党全国委员会捐款。
description.en: A Chinese-American entrepreneur and a key figure in the 1996 United States campaign finance controversy, who had business dealings with Liu Chaoying and made donations to the Democratic National Committee.

en: United States Securities and Exchange Commission

description.zh-cn: 美国的证券业监督管理机构。
description.en: The securities industry regulatory agency in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军高级将领，曾任总参情报部领导。据钟育瀚称，姬胜德曾表示愿意提供资金影响美国选举。
description.en: A senior general of the People's Liberation Army and former head of the General Staff Intelligence Department. According to Johnny Chung, Ji Shengde offered funds to influence the U.S. elections.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学校董会主席。
description.en: Chairman of the Council of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学现任校长。
description.en: The current President of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工学院前院长及香港理工大学前校长。
description.en: Former Director of the Hong Kong Polytechnic and former President of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学前校长。
description.en: Former President of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

en: Chinese Manufacturers' Association of Hong Kong
The Chinese Manufacturers' Association of Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港工业界组织，于1956年捐款一百万元支持香港工业专门学院兴建红磡本部校舍。
description.en: An industrial association in Hong Kong that donated one million HKD in 1956 to support the construction of the Hong Kong Technical College's main campus in Hung Hom.

description.zh-cn: 前香港总督，于1957年为香港工业专门学院红磡本部校舍揭幕。
description.en: Former Governor of Hong Kong who inaugurated the main campus of the Hong Kong Technical College in Hung Hom in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 英属香港的立法机关，于1994年11月25日通过《香港理工大学条例》，使香港理工学院正式获得大学名衔；于1997年香港主权移交后被临时立法会取代。
description.en: The legislature of British Hong Kong, which passed The Hong Kong Polytechnic University Ordinance on November 25, 1994, granting the Hong Kong Polytechnic official university status; it was replaced by the Provisional Legislative Council after the handover of Hong Kong in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 中国的火星探测计划，香港理工大学参与研发了该计划所使用的太空仪器。
description.en: China's Mars exploration program, for which The Hong Kong Polytechnic University participated in developing space instruments.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲的政府间航天组织，香港理工大学为其火星快车任务研发了“岩芯取样器”。
description.en: An intergovernmental space organization in Europe, for whose Mars Express mission The Hong Kong Polytechnic University developed a 'rock corer'.

en: Roscosmos State Corporation for Space Activities

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯的航天机构，香港理工大学为其太空计划提供了设备。
description.en: The space agency of Russia, to whose space programs The Hong Kong Polytechnic University has provided equipment.

en: 2019 Hong Kong Polytechnic University campus conflict
Siege of the Hong Kong Polytechnic University

description.zh-cn: 在2019年“反修例运动”期间，示威者与香港警方在香港理工大学校园及周边地区爆发的严重警民冲突。警方对校园进行了长达十余天的围困。
description.en: A major confrontation between protesters and the Hong Kong Police Force that occurred at and around the campus of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University during the 2019 anti-extradition bill protests. The police besieged the campus for over ten days.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的中心人物和先知，被穆斯林尊为真主的最后一位先知，被称为“众先知的封印”，并接收了《古兰经》的启示。他被认为是亚伯拉罕之子以实玛利的后裔。
description.en: The central figure and prophet of Islam, revered by Muslims as the final prophet of God and known as the 'Seal of the Prophets', who received the revelations of the Quran. He is considered a descendant of Abraham's son Ishmael.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教信仰的唯一神，被认为是《古兰经》的启示来源。
description.en: The one and only God in Islam, believed to be the source of the Quran's revelations.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教中的天使，负责将真主的启示传达给先知穆罕默德。
description.en: An angel in Islam who delivered God's revelations to the Prophet Muhammad.

description.zh-cn: 指伊斯兰教先知穆罕默德的同伴，他们在穆罕默德在世时负责记录启示，并在他逝世后编纂了《古兰经》。
description.en: The companions of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, who were responsible for recording the revelations during his lifetime and compiling the Quran after his death.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯曼是伊斯兰教的第三任正统哈里发。他下令制订了被称为“奥斯曼本”的《古兰经》范本，该范本被认为是当今《古兰经》的原型。奥斯曼于656年在麦地那被暴徒杀害。
description.en: Uthman was the third of the Rashidun Caliphs. He ordered the creation of a standard version of the Quran, known as the 'Uthmanic recension', which is considered the prototype of the Quran today. Uthman was assassinated in Medina in 656.

description.zh-cn: 对《古兰经》的注释和诠释，是伊斯兰教重要的传统学科之一。
description.en: Commentary and exegesis of the Quran, one of the most important traditional Islamic disciplines.

description.zh-cn: 位于沙特阿拉伯麦加附近的一个山洞，根据伊斯兰教传说，穆罕默德在此首次获得《古兰经》的启示。
description.en: A cave near Mecca, Saudi Arabia, where according to Islamic tradition, Muhammad received his first revelation of the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的首任哈里发，也是四大哈里发之一。他在穆罕默德逝世后，下令收集《古兰经》成册。
description.en: The first Caliph of Islam and one of the Four Rightly Guided Caliphs. He ordered the collection of the Quran into a book after the death of Muhammad.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德的堂弟和女婿，伊斯兰教第四任哈里发（正统哈里发时期），被什叶派认为是第一代伊玛目和穆罕默德的正统继承人。根据什叶派说法，他在穆罕默德逝世后不久编制了一个《古兰经》的完整版本。
description.en: Cousin and son-in-law of Muhammad, the fourth Caliph of Islam (during the Rashidun Caliphate), considered by Shia Muslims as the first Imam and the rightful successor to Muhammad. According to Shia tradition, he compiled a complete version of the Quran shortly after Muhammad's death.

description.zh-cn: 埃及国王，在1923年要求开罗的学者编制“标准版”的《古兰经》。
description.en: King of Egypt who in 1923 requested scholars in Cairo to compile a 'standard edition' of the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 位于埃及开罗的一所著名伊斯兰大学，其学者在1924年出版了影响深远的《古兰经》开罗标准版。
description.en: A prestigious Islamic university in Cairo, Egypt, whose scholars published the influential 1924 Cairo standard edition of the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 藏于英国伯明翰大学图书馆的《古兰经》残卷，放射性碳定年法检测显示其年代可能在568年至645年之间，是现存最古老的《古兰经》手稿之一。
description.en: Quran fragments held at the University of Birmingham Library in England. Radiocarbon dating suggests they date from between 568 and 645 AD, making them one of the oldest Quranic manuscripts in existence.

description.zh-cn: 基督教对《塔纳赫》的称呼，是犹太教和基督教的核心经典之一。《古兰经》与其记载的主要故事有相同之处。
description.en: The Christian term for the Tanakh, a core scripture of Judaism and Christianity. The Quran shares some of its main narratives.

description.zh-cn: 基督教的核心经典，记载了耶稣及其门徒的言行。《古兰经》与其记载的主要故事有相同之处。
description.en: The core scripture of Christianity, recording the life and teachings of Jesus and his apostles. The Quran shares some of its main narratives.

description.zh-cn: 自称先知者，其军队在叶麻默战役中杀害了许多穆罕默德的同伴。
description.en: A self-proclaimed prophet whose forces killed many companions of Muhammad in the Battle of Yamama.

description.zh-cn: 首位翻译《古兰经》的人，他在7世纪时将《开端章》译成波斯语。
description.en: The first person to translate the Quran, who translated the first chapter (Al-Fatiha) into Persian in the 7th century.

description.zh-cn: 《古兰经》的第一章，在日常礼拜及其他场合上会被反复诵读。
description.en: The first chapter of the Quran, which is repeatedly recited in daily prayers and other occasions.

description.zh-cn: 南宋军队在采石（今安徽马鞍山）击败金帝完颜亮南侵大军的关键战役，阻止了金朝的征服企图。
description.en: A pivotal battle where the Southern Song army defeated the invading forces of Jin emperor Wanyan Liang at Caishi (modern Ma'anshan, Anhui), thwarting the Jin conquest attempt.

description.zh-cn: 中国建筑集团有限公司的前身机构之一。1982年，其企事业管理职能连同直属单位合并组建为中国建筑工程总公司。
description.en: A predecessor organization of China State Construction Engineering Corporation. In 1982, its enterprise management functions and directly affiliated units were merged to form China State Construction Engineering Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 为发展中国家资本项目提供贷款的国际金融机构。

description.zh-cn: 中央人民广播电台的前身之一。它最初为延安新华广播电台，后迁至陕北并改名为陕北新华广播电台。1949年3月25日迁至北平并再次更名。
description.en: One of the predecessors of China National Radio. It was originally Yan'an Xinhua Radio Station, later relocated to Northern Shaanxi and renamed Northern Shaanxi Xinhua Radio Station. On March 25, 1949, it moved to Beiping and was renamed again.

description.en: The radio station of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省曾经存在的县，于2010年12月25日与台中市（省辖市）合并改制为直辖市台中市。
description.en: A former county in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, which merged with Taichung City (a provincial city) on December 25, 2010, to become the special municipality of Taichung.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，末任台中县县长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, the last Magistrate of Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台中州的最高行政长官。
description.en: The chief administrator of Taichū Prefecture during the period of Japanese rule.

description.zh-cn: 台湾日治时期的一个行政区划，为战后台中县的前身。
description.en: An administrative division during the period of Japanese rule in Taiwan, the predecessor of the post-war Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在台湾于1950年开始实施的政治制度，允许地方居民直接选举行政首长。
description.en: A political system implemented in Taiwan by the Republic of China starting in 1950, allowing local residents to directly elect their chief executives.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省曾存在的省辖市，在与台中县合并前，是傅崐萁的出生地。
description.en: A former provincial city in Taiwan Province, Republic of China, which was the birthplace of Fu Kun-chi, before its merger with Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台中县县长，台中黑派始祖。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Magistrate of Taichung County and was the founder of the Taichung Black Faction.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任台中县县长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Magistrate of Taichung County.

description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Magistrate of Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，首位民进党籍台中县县长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, the first DPP Magistrate of Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾日治时期的一个行政区划，台中州的前身之一。
description.en: An administrative division during the period of Japanese rule in Taiwan, one of the predecessors of Taichū Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉重要将领，在诸葛亮死后与长史杨仪发生权力斗争，兵败被杀。
description.en: A prominent general of Shu Han. After Zhuge Liang's death, he was involved in a power struggle with chief clerk Yang Yi, which led to his defeat and death.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉长史，在诸葛亮死后负责指挥撤军事宜，与魏延不和并最终导致魏延被杀。
description.en: Chief clerk of Shu Han, responsible for orchestrating the retreat after Zhuge Liang's death. He had a long-standing feud with Wei Yan, which ultimately led to Wei Yan's death.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉将领，在魏延与杨仪的冲突中，奉命斩杀了魏延。
description.en: A general of Shu Han who, during the conflict between Wei Yan and Yang Yi, was ordered to execute Wei Yan.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领，在追击第二次北伐撤退的蜀军时被斩杀。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei who was killed while pursuing the retreating Shu army during the second Northern Expedition.

zh-cn: 合肥之战#第五次战役（合肥新城之战）

description.zh-cn: 234年，东吴响应蜀汉第五次北伐而对曹魏合肥新城发动的战役。
description.en: In 234, Eastern Wu launched a campaign against Cao Wei's fortress of Hefei Xincheng in coordination with Shu Han's fifth Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领，以在陈仓之围中成功抵御诸葛亮大军的进攻而闻名。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei, famous for successfully defending the fortress of Chencang against Zhuge Liang's army during a siege.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮第二次北伐时对曹魏陈仓城的围攻战。
description.en: The siege of the Cao Wei fortress of Chencang by Zhuge Liang during his second Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 泰国的陆上武装部队。其第三军区第7步兵师的9名军人参与了湄公河惨案。
description.en: The land component of the Royal Thai Armed Forces. Nine soldiers from its 7th Infantry Division, 3rd Army Area, were involved in the Mekong River massacre.

description.zh-cn: 湄公河惨案主犯糯康的国籍国。惨案实施者之一翁蔑在该国向政府投降后被移交中国，该国也参与了后续的四国执法安全合作。
description.en: The home country of Naw Kham, the mastermind of the Mekong River massacre. Weng Mie, one of the perpetrators, was handed over to China after surrendering to the government in Myanmar. The country also participated in the subsequent four-nation law enforcement and security cooperation.

zh-cn: 云南省昆明市中级人民法院
en: Kunming Intermediate People's Court of Yunnan Province

description.zh-cn: 对湄公河惨案主犯进行一审并判处糯康等四人死刑的法院。
description.en: The court that conducted the first-instance trial for the main culprits of the Mekong River massacre and sentenced Naw Kham and three others to death.

description.zh-cn: 时任泰国总理。
description.en: Then-Prime Minister of Thailand.

description.zh-cn: 糯康集团2号人物，湄公河惨案主犯之一。2013年于中国昆明被执行死刑。
description.en: The second-in-command of Naw Kham's gang and one of the main culprits in the Mekong River massacre. He was executed in Kunming, China in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 糯康集团成员，湄公河惨案主犯之一。2013年于中国昆明被执行死刑。
description.en: A member of Naw Kham's gang and one of the main culprits in the Mekong River massacre. He was executed in Kunming, China in 2013.

He was a key figure in proposing the establishment of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.en: A member of the Central Committee of the Communist League of China, who later led the minority faction to reorganize into the Internationalist Workers Party of China.

description.en: A representative of the Trotskyist faction who came to Shanghai in 1935. At a representative conference he presided over, the 'Chinese Communist Left Opposition' was renamed the 'Communist League of China'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国拉萨海关副关长。

description.en: A treaty signed between the Qing dynasty and the British Empire concerning Sikkim and Tibet, which stipulated the opening of Yadong as a trade port.

description.zh-cn: 中国春秋末期工匠和发明家，被尊为中国工匠的始祖。

description.zh-cn: 孔子嫡系长支世代居住的府第，有“天下第一家”之称。
description.en: The historical residence of the direct descendants of Confucius, known as the "Number One Family Under Heaven".

description.zh-cn: 孔子及其家族的墓地，是世界上延时最久、规模最大的家族墓地。

description.en: American film director, producer, and screenwriter, famous for creating the Star Wars franchise. A notable alumnus and major donor to the University of Southern California.

description.en: A public research university in Los Angeles, California, and a traditional rival of the University of Southern California in both academics and sports.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国印第安纳州的私立研究型大学，与南加州大学在美式足球领域有激烈的竞争关系。
description.en: A private research university in Indiana, United States, known for its intense football rivalry with the University of Southern California.

description.zh-cn: 美国工程师、企业家，高通公司联合创始人。南加州大学维特比工程学院以其名字命名，以纪念其捐赠。

description.en: An American multinational semiconductor and telecommunications equipment company.

description.zh-cn: 科进系统公司创始人，曾向南加州大学电机系进行巨额捐赠。
description.en: Founder of Cogent Inc., who made a substantial donation to the USC Department of Electrical Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 美国宇航员、试飞员，是第一位踏上月球的人类。南加州大学校友。
description.en: American astronaut and test pilot, and the first person to walk on the Moon. Alumnus of the University of Southern California.

description.zh-cn: 藏传佛教的一个主要派别，由宗喀巴在15世纪创立。雍和宫是其重要的寺院之一。
description.en: A major school of Tibetan Buddhism, founded by Je Tsongkhapa in the 15th century. The Yonghe Temple is one of its important monasteries.

description.zh-cn: 藏传佛教格鲁派的重要活佛之一，曾在雍正年间居住于雍和宫。
description.en: One of the important living Buddhas (Khutukhtus) of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism, who resided in the Yonghe Temple during the Yongzheng era.

description.zh-cn: 第七世达赖喇嘛，藏传佛教格鲁派领袖。他曾向清廷进贡用于雕刻雍和宫弥勒佛站像的白檀木。
description.en: The 7th Dalai Lama, a leader of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism. He presented the white sandalwood used to carve the Maitreya Buddha statue in Yonghe Temple as tribute to the Qing court.

description.zh-cn: 北京市负责文物保护工作的政府机构，于1995年将雍和宫注册为博物馆。

description.en: The agency responsible for Mongolian and Tibetan affairs during the Beiyang government period, which was in charge of the administration of the Yonghe Temple.

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性佛教组织，曾于1956年任命噶拉藏为雍和宫住持。

description.en: The presence of chemicals, particulate matter, or biological molecules in the air that cause harm or discomfort to humans or other living organisms. It is the central issue explored in the documentary 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 上海的一家财经报纸，其一名员工因泄露中宣部封杀《穹顶之下》的指令而遭停职。
description.en: A Shanghai-based financial newspaper, an employee of which was suspended for leaking the Propaganda Department's directive to ban 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 燕国游侠，向太子丹推荐了荆轲，后为表明自己严守秘密而自刎。
description.en: A knight-errant of the State of Yan who recommended Jing Ke to Crown Prince Dan. He later committed suicide to prove his discretion.

description.zh-cn: 原秦国将领，后逃亡至燕国。为助荆轲成事，自刎献出首级。
description.en: A former general of the State of Qin who fled to the State of Yan. To help Jing Ke's mission succeed, he committed suicide and offered his head.

description.zh-cn: 燕国人，擅长击筑，是荆轲的知己。
description.en: A native of the State of Yan, skilled at playing the zhu (a string instrument), and a close friend of Jing Ke.

description.zh-cn: 燕国勇士，被指定为荆轲刺秦的副手。
description.en: A warrior from the State of Yan, appointed as Jing Ke's deputy in the assassination mission.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政的侍医，在荆轲行刺时用药囊投掷荆轲，为秦王争取了时间。
description.en: King Zheng of Qin's court physician. During Jing Ke's assassination attempt, he threw his medicine bag at Jing Ke, buying time for the king.

description.zh-cn: 战国末年剑术家，曾与荆轲论剑，二人不欢而散。
description.en: A swordsman from the late Warring States period who once discussed swordsmanship with Jing Ke, leading to a disagreement.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期人物，曾在邯郸与荆轲发生争执。
description.en: A figure from the Warring States period who had a dispute with Jing Ke in Handan.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期卫国君主。荆轲曾游说他但未被任用。
description.en: The ruler of the State of Wei during the Warring States period. Jing Ke once tried to advise him but was not employed.

description.zh-cn: 唐代诗人，其作品《于易水送人》与荆轲的典故相关。
description.en: A poet of the Tang dynasty whose work 'Seeing a Friend Off at the Yi River' alludes to the story of Jing Ke.

description.zh-cn: 中国周朝的一个诸侯国，为抵抗秦国而策划了刺秦行动。
description.en: A vassal state of the Zhou dynasty in China, which planned the assassination of the King of Qin to resist annexation.

zh-cn: 史记·卷八十六·刺客列传·第二十六

description.zh-cn: 由西汉史学家司马迁撰写的中国第一部纪传体通史。它记载了包括荆轲和庄子在内的诸多历史人物事迹，其中《老庄申韩列传》收录了庄子事迹，也是记载荆轲事迹的主要文献来源之一。
description.en: Written by the Western Han dynasty historian Sima Qian and completed around 94 BC, this is the first biographical general history of China. It records the deeds of numerous historical figures, including Jing Ke and Zhuangzi. Its 'Biographies of Laozi, Zhuangzi, Shen Buhai, and Han Fei' section details Zhuangzi's story, and it is also one of the main literary sources for Jing Ke's story.

description.zh-cn: 秦国在战国末期的将领。
description.en: A general of the State of Qin during the late Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 美国商人和电视名人，唐纳德·特朗普的长子。

description.zh-cn: 美国商人，唐纳德·特朗普的次子。

description.en: The 60th U.S. presidential election, in which Donald Trump defeated Kamala Harris.

description.en: American lawyer known for his role as a prosecutor during McCarthyism, who later became Donald Trump's personal lawyer and mentor.

description.zh-cn: 一项多边自由贸易协定，美国在特朗普上任后退出。

description.en: A violent protest on January 6, 2021, by supporters of then-President Donald Trump to overturn the 2020 presidential election results. The event led to Trump's second impeachment and his ban from several social media platforms.

description.en: A resolution adopted by the UN General Assembly which affirmed the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Ukraine within its internationally recognized borders, and underscored the invalidity of the 2014 Crimean referendum.
