description.en: A Chinese human rights lawyer who served as the defense attorney for Ilham Tohti.

description.zh-cn: 中国维吾尔族政治人物，曾任新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: A Uyghur politician in China who served as the Chairman of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region.

zh-cn: 乌鲁木齐七·五暴力事件

location.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市

description.zh-cn: 2009年7月5日在新疆乌鲁木齐市爆发的持续数日的骚乱事件。
description.en: A series of riots that broke out on July 5, 2009, in Ürümqi, the capital city of the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、民族问题学者。
description.en: A Chinese writer and scholar on ethnic issues.

description.zh-cn: 一个旨在保护言论自由和促进文学发展的美国非营利组织。
description.en: An American non-profit organization aimed at protecting free expression and promoting literature.

zh-cn: 芭芭拉·戈德史密斯自由写作奖
en: PEN/Barbara Goldsmith Freedom to Write Award

description.zh-cn: 由美国笔会颁发的奖项，旨在表彰那些为言论自由而勇敢抗争的作家。
description.en: An award given by PEN America to honor writers who have courageously fought for freedom of expression.

description.zh-cn: 一个全球性的非政府组织，致力于促进人权。
description.en: A global non-governmental organization focused on human rights.

zh-cn: 美国国会及行政当局中国委员会

description.zh-cn: 美国国会的一个独立委员会，负责监督中国的人权和法治状况。
description.en: An independent commission of the United States Congress that monitors human rights and the rule of law in China.

description.zh-cn: 指1928年6月国民政府通过北伐战争，在名义上结束了北洋军阀的统治，实现了中国的统一。
description.en: Refers to the nominal unification of China in June 1928 by the Nationalist Government through the Northern Expedition, ending the rule of the Beiyang warlords.

description.zh-cn: 描述台湾海峡两岸政治、军事状态的术语。
description.en: A term describing the political and military situation across the Taiwan Strait.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东首次提出的以和平方式统一台湾的方针，是“解放台湾”运动中的一种策略。
description.en: A policy first proposed by Mao Zedong to unify Taiwan by peaceful means, serving as a strategy within the broader 'Liberation of Taiwan' movement.

en: Never promise to renounce the use of force
Not renouncing the use of force

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国对台政策的一部分，保留使用军事手段解决台湾问题的选项。
description.en: A component of the PRC's Taiwan policy, reserving the option to use military means to resolve the Taiwan issue.

en: One Country, Two Systems Taiwan Plan

description.zh-cn: 由习近平提出的，旨在探索“一国两制”在台湾具体实现形式的政治倡议。
description.en: A political initiative proposed by Xi Jinping aimed at exploring the specific forms for realizing 'one country, two systems' in Taiwan.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军绕台湾岛巡航

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军机、军舰在台湾岛周边进行的常态化军事巡航行动。
description.en: Regular military patrol operations conducted by PLA aircraft and warships around the island of Taiwan.

zh-cn: 1995年李登辉总统康乃尔大学之行
en: Lee Teng-hui's 1995 visit to Cornell University

description.zh-cn: 1995年，时任中华民国总统李登辉访问其母校美国康乃尔大学，成为首位访问美国的中华民国现任元首。此行引发了北京的强烈反应，导致了第三次台湾海峡飞弹危机。该事件亦是电视剧《国际桥牌社2》的剧情重点。
description.en: In 1995, then-ROC President Lee Teng-hui visited his alma mater, Cornell University in the United States, becoming the first incumbent ROC head of state to do so. This trip provoked a strong reaction from Beijing, leading to the Third Taiwan Strait Missile Crisis. The event is also a key plot point in the TV series 'Island Nation 2'.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉于1995年访问康乃尔大学时提出的国家定位论述，强调中华民国的主权范围在台湾。
description.en: A national identity discourse proposed by Lee Teng-hui during his visit to Cornell University in 1995, emphasizing that the sovereignty of the Republic of China is on Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 前中国人民解放军少将。因不满六四事件中军队镇压学生，他成为台湾间谍。在1996年台湾海峡导弹危机期间，他向台湾提供了关键情报，指出解放军发射的导弹为空包弹，后因身份暴露被处决。其在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》中的角色原型为“游建军”。
description.en: A former Major General of the People's Liberation Army. Dissatisfied with the military's suppression of students during the Tiananmen Square protests, he became a spy for Taiwan. During the 1996 Taiwan Strait Missile Crisis, he provided crucial intelligence to Taiwan, revealing that the missiles fired by the PLA were duds. He was later executed after his identity was exposed. His prototype character in the TV series 'Island Nation 2' is 'You Jian-jun'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会通过的一部关于台湾问题的法律，为“非和平方式”统一台湾提供了法理依据。
description.en: A law concerning the Taiwan issue passed by the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China, providing a legal basis for unifying Taiwan through 'non-peaceful means'.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军退役上将，曾任美国印太司令部司令。
description.en: A retired four-star admiral in the United States Navy who last served as the commander of United States Indo-Pacific Command.

description.zh-cn: 美国外交官，现任中央情报局局长。
description.en: An American diplomat serving as the director of the Central Intelligence Agency.

zh-cn: 约翰·克里斯托弗·阿奎利诺

description.zh-cn: 美国海军上将，现任美国印太司令部司令。
description.en: A United States Navy admiral who is the current commander of the United States Indo-Pacific Command.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，曾任防卫副大臣。
description.en: A Japanese politician who has served as the State Minister of Defense.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，曾任日本首相和副首相。他在2008年自民党总裁选举中击败石破茂，后任命其为农林水产大臣。
description.en: A Japanese politician who has served as Prime Minister and Deputy Prime Minister of Japan. He defeated Shigeru Ishiba in the 2008 LDP presidential election and later appointed him as Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，安倍晋三的弟弟。他出生时姓安倍，后被过继给舅舅岸信和而改姓。曾担任防卫大臣。
description.en: A Japanese politician and the younger brother of Shinzo Abe. Born with the surname Abe, he was adopted by his maternal uncle Kishi Nobukazu and took the Kishi surname. He has served as the Minister of Defense.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军上将，现任美国印太司令部司令。
description.en: A United States Navy admiral who is the current commander of the United States Indo-Pacific Command.

en: Center for Strategic and International Studies

description.zh-cn: 位于美国华盛顿特区的智库，于2023年发布了关于台海战争的兵棋推演报告。
description.en: A think tank based in Washington, D.C., which published a wargame report on a Taiwan Strait conflict in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共中央台湾工作办公室发言人。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office of the Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军退役少将，军事评论员。
description.en: A retired major general of the People's Liberation Army and a military commentator.

description.zh-cn: 一种统一模式的设想，指在统一后的台湾实行与中国大陆相同的社会制度。
description.en: A proposed model for unification, suggesting that after unification, Taiwan would adopt the same social system as mainland China.

zh-cn: 台湾有事就是日本有事
en: A Taiwan contingency is a Japan contingency

description.zh-cn: 由前日本首相安倍晋三提出的论述，强调台湾的安全与日本的国家安全密切相关。
description.en: A discourse proposed by former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe, emphasizing that Taiwan's security is closely linked to Japan's national security.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的江西省最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative body of Jiangxi Province during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的湖南省最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative body of Hunan Province during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 新桂系将领，主导了免去鲁涤平湖南省主席职务的行动。
description.en: A general of the New Guangxi clique who led the action to remove Lu Diping from his position as Chairman of Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军第50师师长，在第一次江西剿共战争期间为鲁涤平的下属。
description.en: Commander of the 50th Division of the National Revolutionary Army, a subordinate of Lu Diping during the First Jiangxi Encirclement Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领。在南昌起义部队南下途中，率部在会昌等地进行追击和阻击。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China. During the southward march of the Nanchang Uprising forces, he led his troops to pursue and intercept them in places like Huichang.

description.zh-cn: 中国平安保险的创始人及现任董事长。
description.en: Founder and current chairman of Ping An Insurance.

zh-cn: 深圳市投资控股有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中国平安保险的股东之一。
description.en: A shareholder of Ping An Insurance.

description.zh-cn: 曾是中国平安保险的主要股东，于2012年出售全部股权。
description.en: A former major shareholder of Ping An Insurance, which sold all its shares in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 泰国企业集团，于2012年收购汇丰持有的中国平安股权，成为其最大股东之一。
description.en: A Thai conglomerate that acquired HSBC's stake in Ping An Insurance in 2012, becoming one of its largest shareholders.

description.zh-cn: 一家曾在中国经营的银行，后被平安保险收购并与平安银行合并。
description.en: A former bank in China, later acquired by Ping An Insurance and merged with Ping An Bank.

description.zh-cn: 中国平安保险旗下的商业银行，由原深圳发展银行和原平安银行合并而成。
description.en: A commercial bank under Ping An Insurance, formed by the merger of the former Shenzhen Development Bank and the former Ping An Bank.

description.zh-cn: 南非健康保险公司，平安健康险的战略投资者。
description.en: A South African health insurance company and a strategic investor in Ping An Health Insurance.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦的标志性建筑，于2013年被中国平安收购。
description.en: An iconic building in London, acquired by Ping An Insurance in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 中国汽车互联网平台，于2016年被平安收购成为其最大股东。
description.en: A Chinese automotive internet platform, of which Ping An became the largest shareholder after an acquisition in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 一家大型科技投资基金，曾投资平安好医生及平安医保科技。
description.en: A large technology investment fund that has invested in Ping An Good Doctor and Ping An HealthKonnect.

description.zh-cn: 一起引发社会关注的交通事故及后续法律纠纷，肇事者在中国平安投保。
description.en: A traffic accident and subsequent legal dispute that drew public attention, where the perpetrator was insured by Ping An.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任新余市市长、中共新余市委书记、江西省发展和改革委员会主任等职。因与原江西省委书记苏荣关系密切，于2014年8月被纪委调查。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as Mayor of Xinyu, Secretary of the CPC Xinyu Municipal Committee, and Director of the Jiangxi Provincial Development and Reform Commission. He was investigated by the disciplinary commission in August 2014 due to his close relationship with former Jiangxi Provincial Party Secretary Su Rong.

zh-cn: 中国共产党江西省纪律检查委员会
en: CPC Jiangxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection
Jiangxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在江西省的纪律检查机关。
description.en: The provincial-level discipline inspection agency of the Communist Party of China in Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员。历任安徽省环保局审计处长、办公室主任，亳州市委常委、秘书长、宣传部长，安徽省委副秘书长、督查室主任，安徽省政府法制办公室主任、副秘书长、办公厅主任，安徽省政协常委、港澳台侨和外事委员会主任。现任安徽省环保联合会主席。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He has served as Director of the Audit Division and Director of the Office of the Anhui Provincial Environmental Protection Bureau; Standing Committee Member, Secretary-General, and Director of the Propaganda Department of the Bozhou Municipal Party Committee; Deputy Secretary-General and Director of the Supervision Office of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee; Director of the Legislative Affairs Office, Deputy Secretary-General, and Director of the General Office of the Anhui Provincial Government; and Standing Committee Member and Director of the Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, Overseas Chinese and Foreign Affairs Committee of the Anhui Provincial Political Consultative Conference. He is currently the Chairman of the Anhui Provincial Environmental Protection Federation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国安徽省阜阳市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Fuyang City, Anhui Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 秦国君主，秦昭襄王之父。
description.en: Monarch of the State of Qin, father of King Zhaoxiang of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦惠文王之妾，秦昭襄王之母。秦昭襄王即位初期曾代为摄政。
description.en: A consort of King Huiwen of Qin and the mother of King Zhaoxiang of Qin. She served as regent during the early years of King Zhaoxiang's reign.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王之妾，秦孝文王之母。
description.en: A consort of King Zhaoxiang of Qin and the mother of King Xiaowen of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of King Zhaoxiang of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦国大臣，宣太后之弟。在秦昭襄王时期手握重权。
description.en: A minister of the State of Qin and the younger brother of Queen Dowager Xuan. He held significant power during the reign of King Zhaoxiang.

description.zh-cn: 秦国大臣，曾为秦昭襄王处理政务，后出奔齐国。
description.en: A minister of the State of Qin who once handled state affairs for King Zhaoxiang, but later fled to the State of Qi.

description.zh-cn: 秦惠文王之子，秦昭襄王之兄弟。因争夺王位失败而发动叛乱，后被镇压。
description.en: A son of King Huiwen of Qin and a brother of King Zhaoxiang. He launched a rebellion after failing to secure the throne, which was subsequently suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 秦国将领，曾奉秦昭襄王之命平定蜀地叛乱。
description.en: A general of the State of Qin who was ordered by King Zhaoxiang to suppress a rebellion in the Shu region.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王之弟，被封为蜀侯，后反叛秦国。
description.en: Younger brother of King Zhaoxiang of Qin, enfeoffed as the Marquis of Shu, who later rebelled against Qin.

description.zh-cn: 齐国贵族及政治家，曾短暂担任秦国宰相，后逃离秦国并联合韩、魏攻秦。
description.en: A nobleman and statesman from the State of Qi who briefly served as Chancellor of Qin before escaping and leading an alliance with Han and Wei against Qin.

description.zh-cn: 由齐国孟尝君联合韩国、魏国攻打秦国的一场战役，联军攻破了函谷关。
description.en: A battle initiated by Lord Mengchang of Qi in alliance with Han and Wei against the State of Qin, resulting in the breach of Hangu Pass by the allied forces.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期齐国君主。曾拒绝秦昭襄王的“东帝”尊号，并组织合纵攻秦。
description.en: Monarch of the State of Qi during the Warring States period. He refused the title of 'Eastern Emperor' from King Zhaoxiang of Qin and organized an alliance to attack Qin.

description.zh-cn: 赵国大臣，以“完璧归赵”的事迹闻名，成功阻止秦昭襄王骗取和氏璧。
description.en: A minister of the State of Zhao, famous for the story of 'returning the jade intact to Zhao,' in which he successfully thwarted King Zhaoxiang's attempt to deceitfully acquire the He Shi Bi jade.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期位于中原的小国，于前255年被秦国所灭。
description.en: A small state in the Central Plains during the Warring States period, annexed by the State of Qin in 255 BC.

description.zh-cn: 楚国君主，曾娶秦昭襄王之女。
description.en: Monarch of the State of Chu, who married a daughter of King Zhaoxiang of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦的母亲，曾是林口国中美术老师。
description.en: Jay Chou's mother, a former art teacher at Linkou Junior High School.

description.zh-cn: 音乐人，阿尔发音乐前总监，与周杰伦、方文山共同创办杰威尔音乐。
description.en: Musician, former general manager of Alfa Music, and co-founder of JVR Music with Jay Chou and Vincent Fang.

description.zh-cn: 台湾词作家，周杰伦的长期音乐合作伙伴及杰威尔音乐的共同创办人。
description.en: Taiwanese lyricist, Jay Chou's long-term musical partner, and co-founder of JVR Music.

description.zh-cn: 台湾女歌手。
description.en: Taiwanese female singer.

description.zh-cn: 台湾男歌手。
description.en: Taiwanese male singer.

description.zh-cn: 台湾乐团五月天的主唱。
description.en: Lead vocalist of the Taiwanese band Mayday.

description.zh-cn: 台湾男歌手。
description.en: Taiwanese male singer.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新闻主播、艺人。
description.en: Taiwanese news anchor and artist.

description.zh-cn: 台湾女歌手。
description.en: Taiwanese female singer.

description.zh-cn: 台湾男艺人，周杰伦的好友。
description.en: Taiwanese male artist and a close friend of Jay Chou.

zh-cn: 新北市私立淡江高级中学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新北市淡水区的私立高级中学，为周杰伦的母校。
description.en: A private high school in Tamsui District, New Taipei City, Taiwan, and Jay Chou's alma mater.

description.zh-cn: 台湾唱片公司，由吴宗宪创立，是周杰伦出道的公司。
description.en: A Taiwanese record label founded by Jacky Wu, where Jay Chou started his career.

description.zh-cn: 由周杰伦、方文山、杨峻荣共同创办的唱片和经纪公司。
description.en: A record label and management company co-founded by Jay Chou, Vincent Fang, and Yang Jun-rong.

description.zh-cn: 一支台湾的电子竞技职业队伍，前身为台北暗杀星（TPA），后由周杰伦取得经营权并更名。
description.en: A Taiwanese professional esports team, formerly known as Taipei Assassins (TPA), which was acquired and renamed by Jay Chou.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Jay Chou.

description.zh-cn: 张学友的音乐专辑，对周杰伦早期的音乐生涯产生了重要影响。
description.en: A music album by Jacky Cheung that had a significant influence on Jay Chou's early music career.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦创作并卖出的第一首歌曲，由江蕙演唱，也是他与方文山首次合作的知名作品。
description.en: The first song composed and sold by Jay Chou, performed by Jody Chiang. It is also his first well-known collaboration with Vincent Fang.

description.zh-cn: 一部2005年的电影，是周杰伦参演的首部电影，他饰演主角藤原拓海。
description.en: A 2005 film that marked Jay Chou's acting debut, in which he played the lead role of Takumi Fujiwara.

description.zh-cn: 一部2006年的电影，周杰伦在其中饰演二王子元杰。
description.en: A 2006 film in which Jay Chou played the role of Prince Yuan Jie.

description.zh-cn: 一部2007年的电影，是周杰伦第一部自编自导自演的作品。
description.en: A 2007 film which was Jay Chou's directorial debut, which he also wrote and starred in.

description.zh-cn: 美国以720万美元从俄罗斯帝国购买阿拉斯加的交易。此次收购最初被一些美国人批评为“西华德的蠢事”。
description.en: The transaction in which the United States acquired Alaska from the Russian Empire for $7.2 million. The acquisition was initially criticized by some Americans as 'Seward's Folly'.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿，主导并完成了阿拉斯加的购买交易。
description.en: The U.S. Secretary of State at the time, who led and completed the Alaska Purchase.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国在北美洲的殖民地，其统治随着阿拉斯加被出售给美国而结束。
description.en: The colonial possessions of the Russian Empire in North America, whose rule ended with the sale of Alaska to the United States.

zh-cn: 格里戈里·伊万诺维奇·舍利霍夫

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国海事毛皮贸易家，参与创办俄美公司，并与阿瓦乌克大屠杀有关。
description.en: A Russian maritime fur trader who was involved in founding the Russian-American Company and was connected to the Awa'uq Massacre.

zh-cn: 尼古拉·彼得罗维奇·列扎诺夫

description.zh-cn: 与格里戈里·舍利霍夫共同创办了俄美公司。
description.en: Co-founded the Russian-American Company with Grigory Shelikhov.

description.zh-cn: 由格里戈里·舍利霍夫和尼古拉·列扎诺夫创办的半官方性质的殖民贸易公司，在俄属北美进行贸易活动。
description.en: A semi-official colonial trading company founded by Grigory Shelikhov and Nikolai Rezanov, which conducted trade activities in Russian America.

description.zh-cn: 由超过300座火山岛屿组成的群岛链，在二战期间部分岛屿曾被日军占领。
description.en: A chain of more than 300 volcanic islands, some of which were occupied by Japanese forces during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉斯加在1912年至1959年间作为美国建制领地的政治实体，直到其正式成为一个州。
description.en: The political entity of Alaska as an incorporated territory of the United States from 1912 to 1959, until it was admitted to the Union as a state.

description.zh-cn: 1964年发生在阿拉斯加的一场矩震级达9.2的强烈地震，造成133人死亡，并对沿海地区造成严重破坏。
description.en: A powerful earthquake with a moment magnitude of 9.2 that occurred in Alaska in 1964, causing 133 deaths and severe damage to coastal areas.

description.zh-cn: 为应对1968年普拉德霍湾油田的发现而修建的输油管道系统，于1977年完工，成为阿拉斯加经济的重要支柱。
description.en: An oil transportation system built in response to the 1968 discovery of oil in Prudhoe Bay, completed in 1977, which became a vital pillar of Alaska's economy.

description.zh-cn: 现任阿拉斯加州州长，共和党成员。
description.en: The current Governor of Alaska, a member of the Republican Party.

description.zh-cn: 代表阿拉斯加州的美国参议员，共和党成员。
description.en: A United States Senator representing Alaska, a member of the Republican Party.

zh-cn: 丹·沙利文 (美国政治人物)

description.zh-cn: 代表阿拉斯加州的美国参议员，共和党成员。
description.en: A United States Senator representing Alaska, a member of the Republican Party.

description.zh-cn: 赵元佐之子。
description.en: Son of Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 赵元佐之子。
description.en: Son of Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 南宋名臣，赵元佐的七世孙。
description.en: A famous minister of the Southern Song dynasty and the seventh-generation descendant of Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 指没有官爵的平民，是中国古代一种社会身份等级。
description.en: Refers to a commoner without official rank or title, a social status in ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 中国作物栽培学与耕作学家、农业教育家，曾任沈阳农业大学校长、教授、博士生导师，以及中国农学会理事。
description.en: A Chinese expert in crop cultivation and tillage, and an agricultural educator. He served as president, professor, and doctoral supervisor at Shenyang Agricultural University, and was a council member of the Chinese Association of Agricultural Science Societies.

description.zh-cn: 顾慰连之父。
description.en: Father of Gu Weilian.

zh-cn: 台湾省政府功能业务与组织调整
en: Functional and Organizational Restructuring of the Taiwan Provincial Government

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在简化地方政府层级的政治改革，导致台湾省政府被“虚级化”，丧失地方自治功能。
description.en: A political reform aimed at simplifying local government tiers, which led to the 'streamlining' of the Taiwan Provincial Government and the loss of its local self-government functions.

description.zh-cn: 一个政治团体，其支持者曾于2014年占领台湾省政府大楼。
description.en: A political group whose supporters occupied the Taiwan Provincial Government building in 2014.

zh-cn: 国家发展委员会档案管理局
en: National Archives Administration, National Development Council

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国家发展委员会的附属机关，负责国家档案管理。
description.en: An affiliated agency of the National Development Council of the Republic of China, responsible for national archives management.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国法理上的一个省，其实际管辖范围在多次行政区划调整后已大幅缩小，并于1998年虚级化。
description.en: A de jure province of the Republic of China. Its actual jurisdiction has been significantly reduced after multiple administrative division adjustments and was streamlined in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾南投市，曾是台湾省政府的驻地。
description.en: Located in Nantou City, Taiwan, it was formerly the seat of the Taiwan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 现为行政院办公地点，在1945年至1956年间曾是台湾省行政长官公署及台湾省政府的办公厅舍。
description.en: Currently the office of the Executive Yuan, it served as the office building for the Taiwan Provincial Administrative Executive Office and the Taiwan Provincial Government from 1945 to 1956.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国国家发展委员会主任委员，于2018年宣布台湾省政府去任务化。
description.en: Then-Minister of the National Development Council of the Republic of China, who announced the de-tasking of the Taiwan Provincial Government in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府首长的职衔之一，于1994年至1998年间由民选产生。
description.en: A title for the head of the Taiwan Provincial Government, who was popularly elected between 1994 and 1998.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、前记者，曾任中共云南省委宣传部副部长等职务。因其开通实名微博与网民互动而被称为'网红官员'，后因涉嫌违纪违法被查。
description.en: A Chinese political figure and former journalist who served as Deputy Director of the Propaganda Department of the Yunnan Provincial Committee of the CCP. He became known as an 'internet celebrity official' for opening a real-name Weibo account to interact with netizens, and was later investigated for suspected violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 指2009年发生在云南省晋宁县看守所的嫌疑人死亡事件，因警方声称其死于“躲猫猫”游戏而引发巨大争议和网络关注。
description.en: Refers to the death of a suspect in a detention center in Jinning County, Yunnan Province in 2009, which sparked significant controversy and online attention after police claimed he died during a game of 'hide-and-seek' (duo maomao).

description.zh-cn: 赵国宗室，赵武灵王叔父。与李兑一同平定沙丘之乱，杀死了公子章，并围困饿死了赵武灵王。
description.en: A member of the Zhao royal clan and uncle of King Wuling of Zhao. Together with Li Dui, he suppressed the Shaqiu Rebellion, killed Gongzi Zhang, and besieged and starved King Wuling of Zhao to death.

description.zh-cn: 赵国将领。与赵成一同平定沙丘之乱，杀死了公子章，并围困饿死了赵武灵王。
description.en: A general of the State of Zhao. Together with Zhao Cheng, he suppressed the Shaqiu Rebellion, killed Gongzi Zhang, and besieged and starved King Wuling of Zhao to death.

description.zh-cn: 赵武灵王的宠妃，赵惠文王之母。
description.en: A favored concubine of King Wuling of Zhao and the mother of King Huiwen of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 公子章的宰相，与其一同发动沙丘之乱。
description.en: The chancellor of Gongzi Zhang, who launched the Shaqiu Rebellion with him.

description.zh-cn: 时任日本侵华军第十二军司令官，策划并指挥了对泰西山区的扫荡围攻，引发陆房战斗。
description.en: Commander of the 12th Army of the Japanese invasion forces in China at the time, who planned and commanded the mopping-up and encirclement campaign against the Taixi mountainous area, leading to the Lufang Battle.

description.zh-cn: 驻山东的日本侵华军部队，陆房战斗中日军的主力。
description.en: The Japanese invasion forces stationed in Shandong, and the main Japanese force in the Lufang Battle.

description.zh-cn: 指在中国抗日战争期间，由投靠日本的中国人组成的、协助日军作战的军事及准军事组织。
description.en: Refers to military and paramilitary organizations composed of Chinese collaborators who assisted the Japanese army during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 时任686团团长，在陆房战斗中亲自到一线指挥作战。
description.en: Commander of the 686th Regiment at the time, who personally commanded operations on the front line during the Lufang Battle.

description.zh-cn: 时任686团政委，在陆房战斗中负责指挥所并参与制定突围计划。
description.en: Political Commissar of the 686th Regiment at the time, who was in charge of the command post and participated in planning the breakout during the Lufang Battle.

description.zh-cn: 时任一一五师政治部保卫部代理部长，带领一部分部队突围。
description.en: Acting Director of the Security Department of the 115th Division's Political Department, who led a portion of the troops in the breakout.

description.zh-cn: 时任一一五师政治部民运部部长，带领师部直属队和六八六团一部分突围。
description.en: Director of the Mass Movement Department of the 115th Division's Political Department, who led the division's direct subordinates and a part of the 686th Regiment in the breakout.

description.zh-cn: 为纪念陆房战斗而设立的遗址。
description.en: A memorial site established to commemorate the Lufang Battle.

description.zh-cn: 赵德芳长子，母亲是焦氏。官至怀州防御使，封高平郡公。
description.en: The eldest son of Zhao Defang and Lady Jiao. He served as the Defense Commissioner of Huaizhou and was ennobled as Duke of Gaoping Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 赵德芳次子，母亲是焦氏。官至节度使兼侍中，封英国公。他是宋孝宗、宋光宗、宋宁宗的直系祖先。
description.en: The second son of Zhao Defang and Lady Jiao. He held the positions of Military Governor (Jiedushi) and Palace Attendant (Shizhong), and was ennobled as Duke of Ying. He is a direct ancestor of Emperors Xiaozong, Guangzong, and Ningzong.

description.zh-cn: 赵德芳三子，母亲是卫国夫人符氏。官至蔡州防御使，封南康郡公。
description.en: The third son of Zhao Defang and Lady Fu of Wei State. He served as the Defense Commissioner of Caizhou and was ennobled as Duke of Nankang Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗第八子，时人称之为“八大王”。他被认为是文学与民间传说中“八贤王”形象的真实原型，而这一虚构角色常被误与赵德芳联系起来。
description.en: The eighth son of Emperor Taizong, known by his contemporaries as the "Eighth Great Prince." He is considered the true prototype for the "Eighth Virtuous Prince" in literature and folklore, a fictional character often mistakenly associated with Zhao Defang.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝地方行政区划，为“道”一级。
description.en: A circuit-level administrative division in the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代职官名，在唐、宋时期为宰相职务的名称之一。
description.en: An official title in ancient China, serving as one of the titles for the Grand Chancellor during the Tang and Song dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代职官名，为三公之一，通常主管全国军事。
description.en: An official title in ancient China, one of the Three Excellencies, typically in charge of the nation's military affairs.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝采纳齐泰、黄子澄等大臣的建议，旨在削弱各地藩王势力的国策。此政策操之过急，激化了中央与藩王的矛盾，成为靖难之役的直接导火索。
description.en: A state policy adopted by the Jianwen Emperor, on the advice of ministers like Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng, aimed at weakening the power of regional princes. Its hasty implementation intensified conflicts between the central government and the princes, directly triggering the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 靖难之役结束后，明成祖对忠于建文帝的臣子进行的大规模政治清洗和屠杀事件，其中方孝孺被诛十族最为惨烈。
description.en: A large-scale political purge and massacre of officials loyal to the Jianwen Emperor, carried out by the Yongle Emperor after the Jingnan Campaign. The execution of Fang Xiaoru and the alleged extermination of his ten degrees of kinship is the most notorious case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝大臣。在靖难之役期间坚守济南，多次击退燕军围攻，智勇双全。兵败被俘后，因忠于建文帝、不屈于朱棣而被处死。
description.en: A minister of the Ming Dynasty. During the Jingnan Campaign, he staunchly defended Jinan and repelled several sieges by the Yan army. After being captured, he remained loyal to the Jianwen Emperor and was executed for his defiance of Zhu Di.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖第十七子，初封宁王，藩地大宁，拥有精锐的朵颜三卫骑兵。在靖难之役中被朱棣胁迫，其军队被吞并。
description.en: The 17th son of the Hongwu Emperor, initially the Prince of Ning with his fief at Daning. He commanded the elite Doyan Guard cavalry. During the Jingnan Campaign, he was coerced by Zhu Di, and his forces were absorbed.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖朱棣的重要将领，被朱棣视为“良将”。在靖难之役的东昌之战中为救朱棣而战死。
description.en: A key general under Zhu Di, regarded by him as a 'great general'. He was killed in action during the Battle of Dongchang while rescuing Zhu Di.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋为其后世子孙所制定的家法。其中“朝无正臣，内有奸恶，则亲王训兵待命”的条文，被朱棣用作发动靖难之役的法理依据。
description.en: The ancestral instructions established by the Hongwu Emperor for his descendants. A clause stating that a prince could raise troops if there were treacherous officials at court was used by Zhu Di as the legal justification for launching the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 靖难之役中的一场重要战役。建文帝的将领盛庸在此大败燕军，是中央军取得的首次大捷，燕军大将张玉在此战中阵亡。
description.en: A major battle during the Jingnan Campaign. The Jianwen Emperor's general Sheng Yong inflicted a major defeat on the Yan army, marking the first significant victory for the imperial forces. The Yan general Zhang Yu was killed in this battle.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代思想学派，在《韩非子》中受到批判。
description.en: An ancient Chinese school of thought, criticized in 'Han Feizi'.

description.zh-cn: 源自《韩非子·难一》的成语，比喻言语或行事前后无法呼应，互相抵触。
description.en: An idiom originating from 'Han Feizi, Nan Yi', used to describe words or actions that are inconsistent and mutually conflicting.

description.zh-cn: 和珅的嫡妻，丰绅殷德的生母，英廉的孙女。
description.en: The primary wife of Heshen, biological mother of Fengshen Yinde, and granddaughter of Yinglian.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝的妃子，固伦和孝公主的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Qianlong Emperor and the biological mother of Princess Gurun Hexiao.

description.zh-cn: 固伦和孝公主府的长史，曾诬告丰绅殷德谋反。
description.en: The chief of staff in Princess Gurun Hexiao's household, who once falsely accused Fengshen Yinde of treason.

description.zh-cn: 满洲八大姓氏之一，是丰绅殷德所属的氏族。
description.en: One of the eight great Manchu clans, to which Fengshen Yinde belonged.

description.zh-cn: 齐心的弟弟。
description.en: Qi Xin's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 钱复之兄，曾任中华民国中央银行副总裁、财政部部长等职。
description.en: Brother of Fredrick Chien, served as Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of China, Minister of Finance, and other positions.

description.zh-cn: 钱复之兄，中央研究院院士，美国国家科学院、工程院、医学院三院院士。
description.en: Brother of Fredrick Chien, an academician of Academia Sinica and a member of the National Academy of Sciences, National Academy of Engineering, and National Academy of Medicine in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 钱复的妻子。
description.en: Spouse of Fredrick Chien.

description.zh-cn: 钱复的儿子。
description.en: Son of Fredrick Chien.

description.zh-cn: 钱复的长孙，美国演员。
description.en: Eldest grandson of Fredrick Chien, an American actor.

zh-cn: 行政院经济建设委员会
en: Council for Economic Planning and Development
Coordination Council for North American Affairs

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在美国的代表机构，后更名为驻美国台北经济文化代表处。
description.en: The representative office of the Republic of China in the United States, later renamed the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，陈诚之子，曾任国防部部长、监察院院长，与钱复等人并称“四公子”。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, son of Chen Cheng. He served as Minister of National Defense and President of the Control Yuan, and is known as one of the 'Four Princes' along with Fredrick Chien and others.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国农业经济学家，曾任农村复兴联合委员会主委。他曾在李登辉遭警备总部调查后，将其以农业问题专家身份介绍给蒋经国。
description.en: An agricultural economist of the Republic of China who served as Chairman of the Joint Commission on Rural Reconstruction. After Lee Teng-hui was investigated by the Taiwan Garrison Command, he introduced him to Chiang Ching-kuo as an agricultural expert.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国学者、教育家，沈宗瀚之子，曾任清华大学校长，与钱复等人并称“四公子”。
description.en: A scholar and educator of the Republic of China, son of Shen Tsung-han. He served as President of National Tsing Hua University and is known as one of the 'Four Princes' along with Fredrick Chien and others.

description.zh-cn: 对20世纪80年代台湾政坛四位中国国民党籍第二代政治人物的并称，指钱复、陈履安、连战、沈君山。
description.en: A collective term for four second-generation Kuomintang politicians in Taiwan's political scene in the 1980s: Fredrick Chien, Chen Li-an, Lien Chan, and Shen Chun-shan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，淞沪会战时任第九十八师师长。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, who served as the commander of the 98th Division during the Battle of Shanghai.

zh-cn: 著名抗日英烈、英雄群体名录
著名抗日英烈和英雄群体名录
en: List of Famous Anti-Japanese Martyrs and Heroic Groups

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国民政部公布的，旨在表彰抗日战争中牺牲的英烈和英雄群体的名单。
description.en: A list published by the Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China to commend the martyrs and heroic groups who sacrificed their lives in the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 上海市的市辖区，姚子青在淞沪会战中于此地阵亡。
description.en: A municipal district of Shanghai, where Yao Ziqing was killed in action during the Battle of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省梅州市下辖的县，是姚子青的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Meizhou City, Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Yao Ziqing.

en: 18th Army of the National Revolutionary Army

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军的部队之一，第九十八师的上级单位。
description.en: One of the units of the National Revolutionary Army, the superior unit of the 98th Division.

zh-cn: 哈利法·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国第二任总统，穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬的同父异母兄弟及前任。
description.en: The second president of the United Arab Emirates, and the half-brother and predecessor of Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

location.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国阿布扎比酋长国
location.en: Emirate of Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

description.zh-cn: 巴基斯坦女性教育活动家，诺贝尔和平奖得主。
description.en: Pakistani female education activist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，弘晓次子，第三代怡亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the second son of Hongxiao, and the third Prince Yi.

description.zh-cn: 清代八旗之一。
description.en: One of the Eight Banners of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，康熙帝第二十一子，封慎靖郡王。与弘晓有诗歌往来。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the 21st son of the Kangxi Emperor, created Prince Shenjing of the Second Rank. He exchanged poetry with Hongxiao.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，康熙帝之孙，雍正帝养子，封果恭郡王。与弘晓有诗歌往来。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, grandson of the Kangxi Emperor, adopted son of the Yongzheng Emperor, created Prince Guogong of the Second Rank. He exchanged poetry with Hongxiao.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，镶红旗人，努尔哈赤的后代。与弘晓有诗歌往来。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan from the Bordered Red Banner, a descendant of Nurhaci. He exchanged poetry with Hongxiao.

description.zh-cn: 中国古典长篇章回小说，又名《红楼梦》。弘晓曾收藏其早期手抄本之一的“己卯本”。
description.en: A classical Chinese novel, also known as 'Dream of the Red Chamber'. Hongxiao was a collector of one of its early manuscripts, the 'Jimao manuscript'.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代政治人物，中国共产党党员。曾任卢氏县副县长，在1957年反右派斗争中被迫害致死。
description.en: A modern Chinese political figure and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as the deputy magistrate of Lushi County and was persecuted to death during the Anti-Rightist Campaign in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 中共卢氏县地下县委负责人，在抗日战争期间介绍杨文渭加入中国共产党。
description.en: Head of the underground Lushi County Committee of the Communist Party of China, who introduced Yang Wenwei to the party during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 河南省三门峡市下辖县，杨文渭的出生地及主要工作地点。
description.en: A county under the administration of Sanmenxia City, Henan Province. It was the birthplace and primary place of work for Yang Wenwei.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教中以成佛救度无量众生为目标的修行方式。
description.en: The path of a bodhisattva in Mahayana Buddhism, which aims for enlightenment to benefit all sentient beings.

description.zh-cn: 佛教的创始人，被佛教徒尊为佛陀。
description.en: The founder of Buddhism, revered by Buddhists as a Buddha.

description.zh-cn: 指佛教在佛陀灭度后至大乘佛教兴起前，因教义和戒律上的分歧而分裂成的各个部派。
description.en: The various schools into which the Buddhist monastic sangha split in the centuries following the Buddha's death, due to disagreements on points of doctrine and vinaya.

description.zh-cn: 佛教核心概念，指一切现象（法）都没有独立的、永恒的实体或自性。大乘佛教对此有特有观点。
description.en: A key Buddhist concept referring to the absence of an independent, permanent entity or self-nature in all phenomena (dharmas). Mahayana Buddhism has a specific perspective on this.

description.zh-cn: 佛教三乘之一，指通过听闻佛法、修行四圣谛而证得阿罗汉果、了脱生死的修行道路。
description.en: One of the three yānas in Buddhism. It is the path that meets the goals of an Arhat, who achieves liberation after listening to the teachings of a Buddha.

description.zh-cn: 佛教三乘之一，指在无佛出世的时代，通过独自观察十二因缘等法而悟道，证得辟支佛果的修行道路。
description.en: One of the three yānas in Buddhism. It is the path of those who attain enlightenment on their own, without teachers, in an age where the Buddhist teachings are lost.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教对声闻乘和缘觉乘的称呼，有时被认为带有贬义。现代学术界及佛教界多使用“上座部佛教”或“尼柯耶佛教”等称呼。
description.en: A term coined by Mahāyāna Buddhists to classify the path of the Śrāvakas and Pratyekabuddhas. It is sometimes considered pejorative. Modern scholarship and the Buddhist community often use terms like 'Theravada Buddhism' or 'Nikāya Buddhism' instead.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教的一个分支，接受密续作为主要修行内容，流行于西藏、蒙古等地。
description.en: A branch of Mahayana Buddhism that incorporates tantric practices as its main method of cultivation, prevalent in Tibet, Mongolia, and other regions.

description.zh-cn: 金刚乘佛教所依据的一类文献，包含特定的修行方法和仪轨。
description.en: A class of literature on which Vajrayana Buddhism is based, containing specific practices and rituals.

description.zh-cn: 佛教传播路线之一，主要指经由中亚传播至中国、朝鲜半岛、日本、越南等地的佛教，以大乘教法为主。
description.en: One of the transmission routes of Buddhism, primarily referring to the Buddhism that spread through Central Asia to China, the Korean Peninsula, Japan, Vietnam, etc., mainly consisting of Mahayana teachings.

description.zh-cn: 北传佛教的一个主要分支，在东亚文化圈具有深远影响。
description.en: A major branch of Northern Buddhism with profound influence in the East Asian cultural sphere.

description.zh-cn: 形成于西藏的佛教流派，是北传佛教和金刚乘的重要组成部分。
description.en: A school of Buddhism that formed in Tibet, an important component of Northern Buddhism and Vajrayana.

description.zh-cn: 起源于并曾在印度次大陆发展的佛教。
description.en: Buddhism that originated and developed on the Indian subcontinent.

description.zh-cn: 一个国际性的佛教组织，旨在促进佛教徒之间的团结与合作。
description.en: An international Buddhist organization aimed at promoting unity and cooperation among Buddhists.

description.zh-cn: 早期佛教经典的集合，相当于南传佛教的《尼柯耶》。汉译本分为《杂阿含经》、《中阿含经》、《长阿含经》和《增一阿含经》。
description.en: A collection of early Buddhist scriptures, corresponding to the Nikāyas of the Pāli Canon. The Chinese translations are divided into the Saṃyukta, Madhyama, Dīrgha, and Ekottara Āgamas.

description.zh-cn: 上座部佛教的标准圣典集，以巴利语写成。
description.en: The standard collection of scriptures in the Theravada Buddhist tradition, as preserved in the Pāli language.

description.zh-cn: 近现代台湾佛教思想家、学者，对汉传佛教及印度佛教历史有深入研究。
description.en: A modern Taiwanese Buddhist thinker and scholar known for his in-depth research on the history of Chinese and Indian Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 印度大乘佛教哲学家，中观学派的创始人，被誉为“第二佛陀”。
description.en: An Indian Mahāyāna Buddhist philosopher and founder of the Madhyamaka school, often referred to as the 'Second Buddha'.

description.zh-cn: 由龙树创立的大乘佛教哲学流派，核心思想是“中道”和“空性”。
description.en: A Mahāyāna Buddhist school of philosophy founded by Nāgārjuna, centered on the concepts of the 'Middle Way' and 'emptiness' (śūnyatā).

description.zh-cn: 部派佛教时期从上座部分化出的一大部派，主张“三世实有，法体恒存”。
description.en: A major school that branched off from the Sthavira nikāya during the period of Nikāya Buddhism, known for its doctrine that 'all dharmas exist in the past, present, and future'.

description.zh-cn: 部派佛教时期的一个重要部派，主张对法进行分别、辨析。南传上座部佛教是其分支之一。
description.en: An important school during the period of Nikāya Buddhism that emphasized analysis (vibhajja) of dharmas. The Southern Theravada school is one of its descendants.

description.zh-cn: 从说一切有部分化出的部派，主张“唯经是量”，不承认论藏的权威性。
description.en: A school that split from the Sarvāstivāda, holding that the sūtras alone were the authoritative source of doctrine, rejecting the authority of the Abhidharma.

description.zh-cn: 印度大乘佛教高僧，与其弟世亲共同创立了瑜伽行唯识学派。
description.en: An eminent Indian Mahāyāna Buddhist monk who, along with his brother Vasubandhu, founded the Yogācāra school.

description.zh-cn: 印度大乘佛教高僧，与其兄无著共同创立了瑜伽行唯识学派。
description.en: An eminent Indian Mahāyāna Buddhist monk who, along with his brother Asanga, founded the Yogācāra school.

description.zh-cn: 由无著、世亲创立的大乘佛教哲学流派，核心思想是“万法唯识”和“阿赖耶识”。
description.en: A Mahāyāna Buddhist school of philosophy founded by Asanga and Vasubandhu, centered on the concepts of 'consciousness-only' (cittamātra) and the 'storehouse consciousness' (ālayavijñāna).

description.zh-cn: 瑜伽行唯识学派的核心论典，系统地阐述了瑜伽行的修行次第和境界。
description.en: The foundational text of the Yogācāra school, systematically explaining the stages and realms of yogic practice.

description.zh-cn: 古代印度孔雀王朝的君主，在位期间大力推广佛教，对佛教的传播有巨大贡献。
description.en: A monarch of the Mauryan Empire in ancient India who actively promoted Buddhism during his reign, making significant contributions to its spread.

description.zh-cn: 古印度的一种宗教，为印度教的前身，强调吠陀天启、祭祀万能和婆罗门至上。
description.en: An ancient Indian religion, the predecessor of Hinduism, which emphasized the divine revelation of the Vedas, the power of sacrifice, and the supremacy of the Brahmin caste.

description.zh-cn: 部派佛教时期从上座部分化出的部派之一，其戒律对汉传佛教影响深远。
description.en: One of the schools that branched off from the Sthavira nikāya during the Nikāya period; its Vinaya had a profound influence on Chinese Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 印度的一种宗教思潮和实践体系，强调通过特定的仪式、咒语和瑜伽来获得解脱，对后期的印度佛教（密宗）产生影响。
description.en: An Indian religious trend and system of practice that emphasizes achieving liberation through specific rituals, mantras, and yoga, influencing later Indian Buddhism (Tantrayana).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国在公务员制度建立前长期实行的人事管理体系下的公职人员称谓。
description.en: The term for public officials under the long-standing personnel management system in the People's Republic of China before the establishment of the civil service system.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的国家武装性质的治安行政力量和刑事司法力量，其职务序列在公务员制度改革中被多次调整。
description.en: The state's armed public security administrative and criminal justice force of the People's Republic of China, whose job sequence has been adjusted multiple times during civil service system reforms.

zh-cn: 中国社会科学院欧洲研究所
en: Institute of European Studies, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences

description.zh-cn: 拥有《明报》的上市公司。
description.en: The listed company that owns Ming Pao.

zh-cn: 港九各界同胞反对港英迫害斗争委员会

description.zh-cn: “港九各界同胞反对港英迫害斗争委员会”的简称，是六七暴动的领导组织。
description.en: The short name for the "Committee of Hong Kong and Kowloon Compatriots for the Struggle Against British Hong Kong Persecution," the leading organization of the 1967 riots.

description.zh-cn: 香港作家，曾在《明报》撰写专栏，并发表文章严厉批评时任特首董建华。
description.en: A Hong Kong writer who had a column in Ming Pao and published an article severely criticizing then-Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》记者，1993年在北京进行采访活动时被捕，后被判刑。
description.en: A Ming Pao journalist who was arrested in 1993 while reporting in Beijing and subsequently sentenced to prison.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》前总编辑，2014年遭人持刀袭击受重伤。
description.en: Former chief editor of Ming Pao who was seriously injured in a knife attack in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》前总编辑刘进图遭两名骑摩托车男子持刀袭击，身中六刀，事件引起社会广泛关注。
description.en: Former Ming Pao chief editor Kevin Lau was attacked by two men on a motorcycle and stabbed six times, an incident that drew widespread public concern.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治漫画家，其在《明报》连载40年的专栏于2023年被停刊。
description.en: A Hong Kong political cartoonist whose column in Ming Pao, which ran for 40 years, was suspended in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府部门，曾多次点名批评《尊子漫画》。
description.en: A bureau of the HKSAR Government that publicly criticized Zunzi's cartoons on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 香港商业电台节目主持人，在六七暴动期间因谴责左派暴力而被杀害。
description.en: A Commercial Radio Hong Kong host who was assassinated during the 1967 riots for denouncing leftist violence.

description.zh-cn: 香港的新闻工作者工会组织。
description.en: A trade union for journalists in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》前执行总编辑，笔名安裕，2016年被解雇。
description.en: Former executive chief editor of Ming Pao, pen name On Yu, who was dismissed in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 香港时事评论员，其在《明报》的专栏在被港府多次批评后于2022年底停刊。他也是前香港电台节目主持人，于2021年被解雇。
description.en: A Hong Kong current affairs commentator whose column in Ming Pao was discontinued in late 2022 after repeated criticism from the Hong Kong government. He was also a former RTHK program host, dismissed in 2021.

description.zh-cn: 香港中文大学的学生刊物，其刊登的“情色问卷”曾引发社会争议，《明报》因转载其内容而被送检。
description.en: A student publication of The Chinese University of Hong Kong. Its publication of a 'sexuality survey' caused public controversy, and Ming Pao was referred to a tribunal for reprinting its content.

description.zh-cn: 香港司法机构之一，负责裁定物品是否属于淫亵或不雅。曾将转载“情色问卷”的《明报》评为不雅。
description.en: A tribunal within the Hong Kong Judiciary responsible for classifying articles as obscene or indecent. It once rated an issue of Ming Pao that reprinted a 'sexuality survey' as indecent.

description.zh-cn: 香港的法院之一。在司法覆核案中裁定淫亵物品审裁处对《明报》的评级违例。
description.en: One of the courts in Hong Kong. It ruled in a judicial review case that the Obscene Articles Tribunal's classification of Ming Pao was unlawful.

Later promoted to General, he is currently serving as a Deputy Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 14th CPPCC National Committee.
