description.zh-cn: 周朝初年政治家，与周公旦划分领地，实行分陕而治。
description.en: An early statesman of the Zhou Dynasty who, along with the Duke of Zhou, divided the territory for governance, known as 'Governing from Each Side of Shan'.

description.zh-cn: 周朝初年，周公旦与召公奭以陕原为界划分治理区域的历史事件，陕西得名于此。
description.en: A historical event in the early Zhou Dynasty where the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao divided their administrative territories at Shan Yuan, from which the name Shaanxi is derived.

description.zh-cn: 古代民族，曾攻破西周都城镐京，杀死周幽王。
description.en: An ancient ethnic group that sacked the Western Zhou capital Haojing and killed King You of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 西周第十二代君主，也是最后一代君主，被犬戎所杀。
description.en: The twelfth and last king of the Western Zhou Dynasty, killed by the Quanrong.

description.zh-cn: 秦国君主，因护送周平王东迁有功而被封为诸侯。
description.en: Ruler of the Qin state, who was enfeoffed as a feudal lord for his merit in escorting King Ping of Zhou eastward.

description.zh-cn: 东周第一代君主，在秦襄公护送下东迁雒邑。
description.en: The first king of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty, who moved the capital to Luoyi under the escort of Duke Xiang of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 前赵皇帝，攻破长安，俘虏晋愍帝，导致西晋灭亡。
description.en: Emperor of Former Zhao, who captured Chang'an and Emperor Min of Jin, leading to the fall of the Western Jin Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西晋最后一位皇帝，被前赵将领刘曜俘虏。
description.en: The last emperor of the Western Jin Dynasty, captured by the Former Zhao general Liu Yao.

description.zh-cn: 十六国之一，由匈奴人刘渊建立。其军队攻破长安，灭亡西晋。
description.en: One of the Sixteen Kingdoms, founded by the Xiongnu Liu Yuan. Its forces captured Chang'an and destroyed the Western Jin Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 后秦开国皇帝，擒杀前秦天王苻坚。
description.en: The founding emperor of the Later Qin dynasty, who captured and killed Fu Jian, the ruler of Former Qin.

description.zh-cn: 前秦天王，在淝水之战中大败，后被姚苌擒杀。
description.en: Ruler of Former Qin, who was decisively defeated at the Battle of Fei River and later captured and killed by Yao Chang.

description.zh-cn: 十六国之一，由羌族贵族姚苌建立。
description.en: One of the Sixteen Kingdoms, founded by the Qiang nobleman Yao Chang.

description.zh-cn: 东晋与前秦之间的一场决定性战役，前秦大败，国力开始下降。
description.en: A decisive battle between the Eastern Jin and Former Qin. The defeat of Former Qin led to its decline.

description.zh-cn: 十六国之一，由氐族建立，在淝水之战后衰落。
description.en: One of the Sixteen Kingdoms, founded by the Di people, which declined after the Battle of Fei River.

description.zh-cn: 西魏权臣，后取代西魏建立北周。
description.en: A powerful official of the Western Wei who later replaced it by founding the Northern Zhou dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国南北朝时期的北方王朝之一，后被北周取代。
description.en: One of the Northern Dynasties during China's Northern and Southern dynasties period, later replaced by the Northern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的公立大学，曾授予王家卫荣誉社会科学博士学位。
description.en: A public university in Hong Kong that awarded Wong Kar-wai an honorary Doctor of Social Science.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫曾就读的香港中学。
description.en: A secondary school in Hong Kong that Wong Kar-wai attended.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫的妻子、制片人和出品人。曾任电视广播有限公司节目监制，被王家卫称为其“缪斯女神”。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai's wife, producer, and presenter. She was a former program producer at TVB and is described by Wong Kar-wai as his 'muse'.

description.zh-cn: 香港媒体人，曾任香港无线电视节目部经理，是王家卫的恩师。
description.en: A Hong Kong media personality and former manager of the programming department at TVB, considered a mentor by Wong Kar-wai.

description.zh-cn: 在此期间，有两部电影值得关注。其中一部香港电影于1990年上映，王家卫凭此片首次获得香港电影金像奖及金马奖最佳导演。另一部电影于1991年上映，张国荣凭借此片获得第十届香港电影金像奖最佳男主角。
description.en: During this period, two films are notable. A Hong Kong film released in 1990 earned Wong Kar-wai his first Best Director awards at the Hong Kong Film Awards and Golden Horse Awards. Another film released in 1991 saw Leslie Cheung win Best Actor at the 10th Hong Kong Film Awards.

description.zh-cn: 香港导演、编剧，与王家卫合伙开设泽东电影公司。
description.en: A Hong Kong director and screenwriter who co-founded Jet Tone Films with Wong Kar-wai.

description.zh-cn: 1997年举办的电影节，王家卫凭《春光乍泄》获最佳导演奖。
description.en: The 1997 edition of the film festival where Wong Kar-wai won the Best Director Award for 'Happy Together'.

description.zh-cn: 1997年上映的香港电影，为王家卫赢得第50届坎城影展最佳导演奖。
description.en: A 1997 Hong Kong film that earned Wong Kar-wai the Best Director Award at the 50th Cannes Film Festival.

description.zh-cn: 2006年举办的电影节，王家卫担任该届评审团主席。
description.en: The 2006 edition of the film festival where Wong Kar-wai served as the President of the Jury.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚裔香港电影摄影师，与王家卫、张叔平并称“铁三角”，长期合作。
description.en: An Australian-Hong Kong cinematographer, known for his long-term collaboration with Wong Kar-wai and William Chang, forming the 'iron triangle'.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影美术指导及服装设计师，与王家卫、杜可风并称“铁三角”，长期合作。
description.en: A Hong Kong art director and costume designer, known for his long-term collaboration with Wong Kar-wai and Christopher Doyle, forming the 'iron triangle'.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员，多次与王家卫合作，并表示拍其电影后演技进步。
description.en: A Hong Kong actress who has frequently collaborated with Wong Kar-wai and stated that her acting improved after working on his films.

description.zh-cn: 中国演员，曾与王家卫合作，并表示拍其电影后演技进步。
description.en: A Chinese actress who has collaborated with Wong Kar-wai and stated that her acting improved after working on his films.

description.zh-cn: 《繁花》电视剧编剧，指控王家卫侵犯其著作权。
description.en: Screenwriter for the TV series 'Blossoms Shanghai' who accused Wong Kar-wai of copyright infringement.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫执导的电视剧，于2023年播出。该剧引发了与编剧程骏年的署名权争议。
description.en: A television series directed by Wong Kar-wai, broadcast in 2023. The series led to a copyright dispute with screenwriter Cheng Junnian.

description.zh-cn: 《繁花》电视剧的联合导演。在一段录音中，她和王家卫等人一同批评了中国共产党的政策。
description.en: Co-director of the TV series 'Blossoms Shanghai'. In a recording, she, along with Wong Kar-wai and others, criticized the policies of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西共和国的政府，曾授予王家卫法国荣誉军团勋章。
description.en: The government of the French Republic, which awarded Wong Kar-wai the Legion of Honour.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Executive Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任安徽省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Secretary-General of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期设立的省级行政区，后与皖南人民行政公署合并成立安徽省。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative region established in the early days of the People's Republic of China, later merged with the South Anhui People's Administrative Office to form Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期设立的省级行政区，后与皖北人民行政公署合并成立安徽省。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative region established in the early days of the People's Republic of China, later merged with the North Anhui People's Administrative Office to form Anhui Province.

zh-cn: 安徽省人民政府国有资产监督管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替马凯担任国家发改委主任。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who succeeded Ma Kai as Director of the NDRC.

description.zh-cn: 原安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Former Vice Governor of Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国人民解放军少将，中国共产党党员。曾任海南省军区政治委员、中共海南省委常委，是第十一届全国人民代表大会解放军代表。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, a major general in the People's Liberation Army, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as the political commissar of the Hainan Military District, a member of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the CCP, and was a delegate of the PLA to the 11th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国商用飞机有限责任公司董事长。
description.en: Chairman of the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China, Ltd.

zh-cn: 上海国盛（集团）有限公司

description.zh-cn: 代表上海市人民政府出资的国有独资企业。
description.en: A wholly state-owned enterprise that makes investments on behalf of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国一家主要化工企业。
description.en: A major Chinese chemical conglomerate.

zh-cn: 上海飞机制造有限公司
中国商飞总装制造中心

description.zh-cn: 中国商用飞机有限责任公司下属的总装制造中心。
description.en: The final assembly and manufacturing center of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 一家在香港提供飞机工程及维修服务的公司。
description.en: A company providing aircraft engineering and maintenance services in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 天津市的政府驻地。
description.en: The seat of government of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 重庆市的政府驻地。
description.en: The seat of government of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 贵州省的政府驻地（省会）。
description.en: The seat of government (provincial capital) of Guizhou.

description.zh-cn: 甘肃省的政府驻地（省会）。
description.en: The seat of government (provincial capital) of Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的省。
description.en: A province of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的自治区。
description.en: An autonomous region of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区的政府驻地（首府）。
description.en: The seat of government (regional capital) of Ningxia.

en: Central and Western District, Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区的政府总部所在地。
description.en: The location of the Central Government Offices of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 澳门特别行政区的政府总部所在地。
description.en: The location of the Government Head Office of the Macao Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 1999年主权移交前的澳门。
description.en: Macau before the transfer of sovereignty in 1999.

description.zh-cn: 与中华人民共和国存在边界争议的国家。
description.en: A country with border disputes with the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共靖州苗族侗族自治县委书记、中共怀化市委常委兼宣传部部长，后因严重违纪违法被查处。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who served as the Party Secretary of Jingzhou Miao and Dong Autonomous County and a Standing Committee Member and Head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Huaihua Municipal Committee. He was later investigated for serious violations of discipline and law.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军东部战区军事法院
中国人民解放军南京军区军事法院

description.zh-cn: 隶属于中国人民解放军东部战区，是中国人民解放军中级军事法院之一。其前身机构属于“大单位军事法院”体系。
description.en: An intermediate military court of the People's Liberation Army, subordinate to the PLA Eastern Theater Command. Its predecessor institutions belonged to the "major unit military court" system.

zh-cn: 中央军事委员会政法委员会
en: Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 作为中央军事委员会的职能部门之一，该机构在深化国防和军队改革中成立，承接了原总政治部的军事保卫、审判、检察等职责，负责领导和管理全军政法工作。
description.en: As one of the functional departments of the Central Military Commission, this organization was established during the deepening of national defense and military reform. It inherited responsibilities such as military security, trial, and procuratorial duties from the former General Political Department, and is responsible for leading and managing the political and legal affairs of the entire military.

zh-cn: 查理斯三世和卡米拉的加冕礼
查尔斯三世和卡蜜拉王后加冕礼
en: Coronation of Charles III and Camilla

description.zh-cn: 英国国王查尔斯三世和卡米拉王后的加冕仪式，韩正作为习近平的特别代表出席。
description.en: The coronation ceremony of King Charles III and Queen Camilla of the United Kingdom, which Han Zheng attended as a special representative of Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 现任英国王后。
description.en: The reigning Queen of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网有限公司董事长。
description.en: Chairman of State Grid Corporation of China.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国能源基础设施公司，将其智利资产Chilquinta Energia出售给了国家电网公司。
description.en: An American energy infrastructure company that sold its Chilean asset, Chilquinta Energia, to State Grid Corporation of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网于2013年收购了其在澳大利亚的子公司资产。
description.en: State Grid acquired assets of its Australian subsidiary in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军联勤保障部队第九八〇医院

description.zh-cn: 位于延安的一所医院，黄树则曾在此担任医务主任、儿科主任及院长。
description.en: A hospital in Yan'an where Huang Shuze served as Medical Director, Head of Pediatrics, and President.

description.zh-cn: 负责中共中央高级领导干部健康保健工作的机构，黄树则曾是其委员。
description.en: An organization responsible for the health care of senior leaders of the CPC Central Committee, of which Huang Shuze was a member.

description.zh-cn: 据信于公元前1500年左右入侵印度并创立了种姓制度的古代民族。
description.en: An ancient people believed to have invaded India around 1500 BCE and established the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 印度的原住民之一，在雅利安人入侵后被征服。
description.en: One of the aboriginal peoples of India, who were conquered after the Aryan invasion.

description.zh-cn: 由大雄创立的宗教，与佛教类似，也宣扬众生平等并反对种姓制度。
description.en: A religion founded by Mahavira, which, similar to Buddhism, also preaches the equality of all living beings and opposes the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 英国在印度次大陆的殖民统治时期。在此期间，西方的平权思想对印度的种姓制度产生了巨大冲击。
description.en: The period of British colonial rule on the Indian subcontinent. During this time, Western ideas of equal rights had a significant impact on India's caste system.

description.zh-cn: 印度于1947年获得独立，此后种姓制度被正式从法律上废除。
description.en: India gained independence in 1947, after which the caste system was officially abolished by law.

description.zh-cn: 印度独立后制定的宪法，其中第15条和第17条明文规定禁止种姓歧视并废除“不可接触制”。
description.en: The constitution enacted after India's independence, which explicitly prohibits caste-based discrimination and abolishes "untouchability" in Articles 15 and 17.

description.zh-cn: 印度种姓制度中最高等的瓦尔那，传统上为祭司和学者，是整个阶序的核心。
description.en: The highest varna in the Indian caste system, traditionally comprising priests and scholars, and forming the core of the social hierarchy.

description.zh-cn: 印度种姓制度中的次等瓦尔那，传统上为战士和统治者，掌握政治与军事权力。
description.en: The second varna in the Indian caste system, traditionally comprising warriors and rulers, holding political and military power.

description.zh-cn: 印度种姓制度中第三等的瓦尔那，传统上为农人、牧人及商人。
description.en: The third varna in the Indian caste system, traditionally comprising farmers, herdsmen, and merchants.

description.zh-cn: 印度种姓制度中最低等的瓦尔那，传统上为奴仆，负责提供各种服务。
description.en: The lowest varna in the Indian caste system, traditionally comprising servants who provided various services.

description.zh-cn: 被排除在四个瓦尔那之外的群体，被视为“不可触碰”，传统上从事被认为不洁净的工作。
description.en: A group excluded from the four varnas, considered "untouchable," and traditionally engaged in occupations deemed impure.

description.zh-cn: 一部重要的早期婆罗门教经典，其中对瓦尔那分类架构有主要阐述。
description.en: An important early Brahmanical text that contains major expositions on the Varna classification framework.

description.zh-cn: 耆那教的创始人，同样反对任何形式的种姓结构。
description.en: The founder of Jainism, who also opposed any form of caste structure.

description.zh-cn: 印度教改革者，相信印度教无种姓制度容身之地。
description.en: A Hindu reformer who believed there was no place for the caste system in Hinduism.

description.zh-cn: 台湾作家，黄春明的次子，于2003年自杀身亡。
description.en: Taiwanese writer and the second son of Huang Chunming, who committed suicide in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 台湾编剧、导演、作家，曾为多部改编自黄春明小说的电影担任编剧。
description.en: Taiwanese screenwriter, director, and writer who scripted several film adaptations of Huang Chunming's novels.

description.zh-cn: 台湾电影导演，台湾电影新浪潮的代表人物之一，曾执导改编自黄春明小说的电影《儿子的大玩偶》。
description.en: A leading figure in Taiwan New Wave cinema, this Taiwanese film director directed 'The Sandwich Man,' a film based on Huang Chunming's novel.

description.zh-cn: 国立成功大学台湾文学系副教授，因在黄春明演讲中抗议其未使用台语文创作而引发“台语文事件”，并对黄春明提起公然侮辱诉讼。
description.en: An associate professor in the Department of Taiwanese Literature at National Cheng Kung University, who initiated the 'Taiwanese Language Incident' by protesting Huang Chunming's use of Mandarin in his writing during a lecture, which led to him filing a public insult lawsuit against Huang.

description.zh-cn: 连接台北与宜兰的高速公路，黄春明曾因环保原因反对其兴建。
description.en: An expressway connecting Taipei and Yilan, the construction of which was opposed by Huang Chunming on environmental grounds.

description.zh-cn: 一种着重于描绘乡土社会和人民生活的文学运动，黄春明是其代表作家之一。
description.en: A literary movement focusing on the depiction of rural society and the lives of its people, of which Huang Chunming is a representative author.

description.zh-cn: 清朝康熙年间重臣，作为清政府全权代表领侍卫内大臣，参与了《尼布楚条约》的谈判和签订。
description.en: An influential minister during the Kangxi era of the Qing dynasty. As the Plenipotentiary Representative and Minister of the Imperial Guard of the Qing government, he participated in the negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯沙皇国陆军大将、伯爵，作为俄国全权代表，与清朝代表签订了《尼布楚条约》。
description.en: A General and Count of the Tsardom of Russia. As the Plenipotentiary Representative of Russia, he signed the Treaty of Nerchinsk with the Qing representatives.

description.zh-cn: 17世纪末俄罗斯沙皇，与彼得一世共治。《尼布楚条约》是在其治下由俄方代表签订的。
description.en: Tsar of Russia in the late 17th century, co-ruling with Peter the Great. The Treaty of Nerchinsk was signed by the Russian representatives during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 调整国家之间关系的法律原则和规则的总称。《尼布楚条约》的谈判和签订被认为是中国首次应用国际法原则处理对外关系。
description.en: The set of legal principles and rules governing relations between states. The negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk is considered to be China's first application of international law principles in foreign relations.

description.zh-cn: 葡萄牙籍耶稣会传教士，服务于康熙朝。作为清方代表团成员，在《尼布楚条约》谈判中担任翻译。
description.en: A Portuguese Jesuit missionary who served in the court of the Kangxi Emperor. As a member of the Qing delegation, he served as an interpreter during the negotiations for the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 法国籍耶稣会传教士，服务于康熙朝。作为清方代表团成员，在《尼布楚条约》谈判中担任翻译。
description.en: A French Jesuit missionary who served in the court of the Kangxi Emperor. As a member of the Qing delegation, he served as an interpreter during the negotiations for the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 俄国自16世纪末期开始的对西伯利亚地区的长期扩张和殖民过程。这一过程导致俄国势力抵达远东，并与清朝产生直接接触和冲突。
description.en: The long-term process of Russian expansion and colonization of the Siberian region, starting from the late 16th century. This process brought Russian power to the Far East, leading to direct contact and conflict with the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝将军，受康熙帝派遣，于1685年率军攻入雅克萨，是雅克萨之战中的清军主要指挥官之一。
description.en: A Qing dynasty general, dispatched by the Kangxi Emperor, who led troops to capture Yaksa in 1685. He was one of the main commanders of the Qing forces in the Battle of Yaksa.

location.zh-cn: 俄罗斯外贝加尔边疆区

description.zh-cn: 位于俄罗斯西伯利亚地区的城市，是1689年《尼布楚条约》的签订地点。
description.en: A city in Siberia, Russia, which was the signing place of the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689.

description.zh-cn: 位于俄罗斯远东地区的一条山脉。《尼布楚条约》将其确立为中俄两国的一段边界。
description.en: A mountain range in the Russian Far East. The Treaty of Nerchinsk established it as a segment of the border between China and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 中俄界河，为黑龙江上游。《尼布楚条约》将其确立为中俄两国的一段边界。
description.en: A border river between China and Russia, and the upper course of the Heilongjiang (Amur River). The Treaty of Nerchinsk established it as a segment of the border between the two countries.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, Vice-Chairperson of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, Vice-Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, Vice-Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, Vice-Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, Vice-Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, Vice-Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港新九龙的地区，是杜琪峰的出生地。
description.en: An area in New Kowloon, Hong Kong, and the birthplace of Johnnie To.

description.zh-cn: 香港资深戏剧教育家、导演、演员。他录取了杜琪峰进入无线电视艺员训练班。
description.en: A veteran Hong Kong drama educator, director, and actor. He admitted Johnnie To to the TVB artist training program.

description.zh-cn: 香港著名导演，是杜琪峰在电视台时期的导师。
description.en: A renowned Hong Kong director who was a mentor to Johnnie To during his time at the television station.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员，他推荐杜琪峰执导了其首部电影。
description.en: A Hong Kong actor who recommended Johnnie To to direct his first film.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影编剧、导演、监制，与杜琪峰共同创立了银河映像。
description.en: A Hong Kong screenwriter, director, and producer who co-founded Milkyway Image with Johnnie To.

description.zh-cn: 由杜琪峰和韦家辉于1996年组成的香港电影制作公司，以制作具个人风格的电影而著称。
description.en: A Hong Kong film production company founded by Johnnie To and Wai Ka-fai in 1996, known for producing films with a distinctive personal style.

description.zh-cn: 香港武侠电影导演，杜琪峰对其推崇备至。
description.en: A Hong Kong martial arts film director highly admired by Johnnie To.

description.zh-cn: 香港电影导演，其首部挂名执导的电影《天若有情》大部分场面由监制杜琪峰实际执导。
description.en: A Hong Kong film director whose debut credited film 'A Moment of Romance' was mostly directed by its producer, Johnnie To.

zh-cn: 肌萎缩性脊髓侧索硬化症

description.zh-cn: 一种运动神经元疾病，李志绥在其回忆录中称毛泽东患有此病。
description.en: A motor neuron disease that Li Zhisui claimed in his memoir that Mao Zedong suffered from.

description.zh-cn: 一种急性、严重的心脏病。1976年6月初，毛泽东突患此病。
description.en: An acute and severe heart condition. Mao Zedong suffered a sudden myocardial infarction in early June 1976.

zh-cn: 告全党全军全国各族人民书
en: Message to the Whole Party, the Whole Army and the People of All Nationalities Throughout the Country

description.zh-cn: 由中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、中央军委联合发布的，宣告毛泽东逝世的讣告。
description.en: The official obituary announcing the death of Mao Zedong, jointly issued by the CPC Central Committee, the NPC Standing Committee, the State Council, and the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东提出的关于国际关系格局的理论，将世界划分为三个部分。
description.en: A theory on the structure of international relations proposed by Mao Zedong, which divides the world into three parts.

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国与阿尔巴尼亚社会主义人民共和国在20世纪70年代末关系恶化并最终破裂的事件，其中一个导火索是中国与美国改善关系。
description.en: Refers to the deterioration and eventual breakdown of relations between the People's Republic of China and the People's Socialist Republic of Albania in the late 1970s, one of the triggers being the improvement of Sino-US relations.

description.zh-cn: 南斯拉夫革命家、政治家，南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国的缔造者和最高领导人。在其领导下，南斯拉夫曾被苏联和中国指责为“现代修正主义”。
description.en: Yugoslav revolutionary and statesman, the founder and paramount leader of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. Under his leadership, Yugoslavia was accused of 'modern revisionism' by the Soviet Union and China.

zh-cn: 南斯拉夫共产主义者联盟

description.zh-cn: 南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国的执政党，于1990年因内部分歧而崩溃，为南斯拉夫解体铺平了道路。
description.en: The ruling party of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, which collapsed in 1990 due to internal divisions, paving the way for the breakup of Yugoslavia.

description.zh-cn: 位于安徽省芜湖市的一所省属普通高等医学专科院校。
description.en: A provincial public medical college located in Wuhu, Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚的一所公立研究型大学。
description.en: An Australian public research university.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京市的一所公立医科大学。
description.en: A public medical university in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国中医药科技工作者和管理工作者及相关单位自愿结成的全国性、学术性、非营利性法人社会团体。
description.en: A national, academic, non-profit corporate social organization voluntarily formed by TCM science and technology workers, management personnel, and related units in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国医师行业的最高奖项。
description.en: The highest award in the Chinese physician industry.

description.zh-cn: 由执业医师、执业助理医师及单位会员自愿组成的全国性、行业性、非营利性社会团体。
description.en: A national, professional, non-profit social organization voluntarily formed by licensed physicians, licensed assistant physicians, and institutional members.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆医学科技工作者自愿组成并依法登记的学术性、非营利性社会组织。
description.en: An academic, non-profit social organization voluntarily formed and legally registered by medical science and technology workers in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 现任藏人行政中央的政治领导人，担任司政一职。
description.en: The current political leader of the Central Tibetan Administration, holding the position of Sikyong.

description.zh-cn: 于2011年当选为藏人行政中央的领导人，成为首位噶伦赤巴，并从第十四世达赖喇嘛手中接管了所有政治权力。他也是第一位被称为西藏司政的民选首长。
description.en: Elected as the leader of the Central Tibetan Administration in 2011, becoming the first Kalon Tripa to assume all political powers from the 14th Dalai Lama. He was also the first elected head to be known as the Sikyong.

location.zh-cn: 印度喜马偕尔邦坎格拉县

description.zh-cn: 印度的一座城市，是藏人行政中央的总部所在地。
description.en: A city in India that serves as the headquarters of the Central Tibetan Administration.

en: Parliament of the Central Tibetan Administration

description.zh-cn: 藏人行政中央的立法机构，于1960年建立，其成员由民选产生。该议会通过了将政治领袖头衔从“噶伦赤巴”改为“司政”的修正案。
description.en: The legislative body of the Central Tibetan Administration, established in 1960 with democratically elected members. This parliament passed the amendment to change the title of the political leader from 'Kalon Tripa' to 'Sikyong'.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治原则，指政治权力和宗教权力相分离。第十四世达赖喇嘛于2011年移交全部政治权力，被视为在藏人行政中央实现了这一原则。
description.en: A political principle referring to the separation of political and religious powers. The 14th Dalai Lama's transfer of all political power in 2011 is considered the implementation of this principle within the Central Tibetan Administration.

description.zh-cn: 藏人行政中央的首席部长职位，自2001年起通过直接选举产生。2012年，该职称被正式修订为“西藏司政”。洛桑森格是最后一位担任此职位者。
description.en: The position of the chief minister of the Central Tibetan Administration, elected directly since 2001. In 2012, this title was officially revised to 'Sikyong'. Lobsang Sangay was the last person to hold this title.

description.zh-cn: 藏人行政中央的政治领袖职位，由“噶伦赤巴”修订而来，意为“政治领袖”。
description.en: The position of the political leader of the Central Tibetan Administration, revised from 'Kalon Tripa', meaning 'Political Leader'.

description.zh-cn: 由美国国会于2020年12月通过的法案，该法案承认藏人行政中央是反映全世界西藏人民愿望的合法机构。
description.en: An act passed by the United States Congress in December 2020, which recognizes the Central Tibetan Administration as the legitimate institution reflecting the aspirations of Tibetan people worldwide.

description.zh-cn: 藏人行政中央的代表，曾多次与中华人民共和国政府代表就西藏问题进行商谈。
description.en: A representative of the Central Tibetan Administration who engaged in multiple rounds of negotiations on the Tibet issue with representatives of the People's Republic of China government.

description.zh-cn: 指2008年3月在西藏发生的骚乱事件。该事件后，藏人行政中央与中华人民共和国政府方面进行了数次会面商谈。
description.en: Refers to the unrest that occurred in Tibet in March 2008. Following this event, several meetings and talks were held between the Central Tibetan Administration and the government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗时期，北宋为收复燕云十六地对辽朝发起的一场大规模军事行动，最终以失败告终。杨业在此次战役中阵亡。
description.en: A large-scale military campaign launched by the Northern Song dynasty under Emperor Taizong against the Liao dynasty to recover the Sixteen Prefectures, which ultimately ended in failure. Yang Ye was killed in this campaign.

description.zh-cn: 杨业之子，北宋将领，亦是“杨家将”中的重要人物。
description.en: Son of Yang Ye, a general of the Northern Song dynasty and a key figure in the 'Generals of the Yang Family'.

description.zh-cn: 杨延昭之子，杨业之孙，北宋将领。
description.en: Son of Yang Yanzhao and grandson of Yang Ye, a general of the Northern Song dynasty.

en: The Generals of the Yang Family

description.zh-cn: 指杨业及其子孙三代抗辽保卫宋朝的军事家族，是中国历史和文学传说中的著名群体。
description.en: Refers to the military family of Yang Ye and his descendants for three generations who resisted the Liao dynasty to defend the Song dynasty, a famous group in Chinese history and literary legend.

description.zh-cn: 辽国应州马步军都指挥使，在与杨业的战斗中被生擒。
description.en: The Commander of the Infantry and Cavalry of Yingzhou of the Liao dynasty, who was captured alive in a battle against Yang Ye.

description.zh-cn: 北宋监军，在雍熙北伐中反对杨业的正确战略，强令其出战，并在战败后率先逃跑，是导致杨业牺牲的主要责任人之一。
description.en: A military supervisor of the Northern Song dynasty. During the Yongxi Northern Expedition, he opposed Yang Ye's sound strategy, forced him into battle, and was the first to flee after the defeat, making him one of the main individuals responsible for Yang Ye's death.

description.zh-cn: 北宋监军，在雍熙北伐中与王侁一同赞成与辽军决战的错误提议，对杨业的失败负有责任。
description.en: A military supervisor of the Northern Song dynasty. During the Yongxi Northern Expedition, he, along with Wang Shen, supported the flawed proposal for a decisive battle with the Liao forces, bearing responsibility for Yang Ye's defeat.

description.zh-cn: 辽国将领，在雍熙北伐期间担任山西诸路兵马都统，设计包围并击败了杨业的部队。
description.en: A general of the Liao dynasty who served as the commander of the Shanxi circuit during the Yongxi Northern Expedition. He devised a plan to encircle and defeat Yang Ye's forces.

description.zh-cn: 辽国将领，在陈家谷之战中受耶律斜轸之命设伏，参与击败杨业。
description.en: A general of the Liao dynasty who, under the orders of Yelü Xiezhen, set up an ambush during the Battle of Chenjiagu and participated in the defeat of Yang Ye.

description.zh-cn: 辽国右皮室详稳，在陈家谷之战中射中并俘虏了杨业。
description.en: A Liao military officer who shot and captured Yang Ye during the Battle of Chenjiagu.

description.zh-cn: 杨业的弟弟或从弟。
description.en: The younger brother or cousin of Yang Ye.

description.zh-cn: 杨业的妻子。正史未载其名，清代方志称其为府州折氏，折德扆之女。
description.en: Wife of Yang Ye. Her name is not recorded in official histories; Qing dynasty gazetteers state she was from the She family of Fuzhou, daughter of She Deyi.

description.zh-cn: 北宋政治家、文学家、史学家，唐宋八大家之一。他曾高度评价杨业、杨延昭父子的功绩与名望，并多次举荐王安石。
description.en: A politician, writer, and historian of the Northern Song dynasty, and one of the Eight Great Prose Masters of the Tang and Song. He highly praised the achievements and reputation of Yang Ye and his son Yang Yanzhao, and recommended Wang Anshi on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗时期的僧人，因罪大恶极被明孝宗下令斩杀。
description.en: A monk during the Chenghua Emperor's reign who was executed by order of the Hongzhi Emperor for his heinous crimes.

description.zh-cn: 明朝太学生。因上书力谏明孝宗停止建造棕棚，后被授官。
description.en: An Imperial University student of the Ming Dynasty. He was appointed as an official after submitting a memorial strongly advising the Hongzhi Emperor to halt the construction of a palm pavilion.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期对蒙古各部的称呼。弘治年间曾大举入侵明朝边境。
description.en: A term used during the Ming Dynasty to refer to various Mongol tribes. They launched a major invasion of the Ming border during the Hongzhi era.

description.zh-cn: 儒家经典之一，记述了周朝的官僚系统和社会制度，是王莽改制的主要思想来源和理论依据。
description.en: One of the Confucian classics, which describes the bureaucratic system and social structure of the Zhou dynasty. It served as the main ideological source and theoretical basis for Wang Mang's reforms.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年，刘秀率领的绿林军在昆阳以少胜多，击溃王邑、王寻率领的新朝主力军队（亦称王莽主力军）。此战从根本上动摇了新朝的统治，是推翻新朝的关键性战役。
description.en: A pivotal battle at the end of the Xin dynasty. The Lülin army, led by Liu Xiu, achieved an outnumbered victory at Kunyang, defeating the main forces of the Xin dynasty led by Wang Yi and Wang Xun (also known as Wang Mang's main army). This battle fundamentally shattered the rule of the Xin dynasty and was crucial in its overthrow.

description.zh-cn: 西汉皇族后裔，在新朝末年被绿林军拥立为皇帝，建立更始政权（玄汉）。统治期间，因猜忌杀害刘秀之兄刘𬙂。最终因统治无能，其政权被赤眉军推翻并被杀。
description.en: A descendant of the Western Han imperial family. At the end of the Xin dynasty, he was installed as emperor by the Lülin army, establishing the Gengshi regime (also known as Xuan Han). During his rule, due to suspicion, he had Liu Xiu's brother, Liu Yan, killed. Ultimately, due to his incompetent rule, his regime was overthrown by the Chimei (Red Eyebrows) army, and he was subsequently killed.

description.zh-cn: 新朝灭亡后，由绿林军拥立刘玄建立的政权。该政权未能稳定局势，最终被赤眉军所灭。
description.en: A regime established by the Lülin army with Liu Xuan as emperor after the fall of the Xin dynasty. It failed to stabilize the situation and was eventually destroyed by the Chimei (Red Eyebrows) army.

description.zh-cn: 新朝大司徒，与王邑共同率领新朝主力军队参与昆阳之战，并在战败后身亡。
description.en: Grand Minister over the Masses of the Xin dynasty. He co-commanded the main Xin army with Wang Yi in the Battle of Kunyang and was killed in action after their defeat.

description.zh-cn: 新朝大司空，王莽的心腹之一。他作为统帅之一参与了昆阳之战，战败后逃脱，但最终在长安城破时与王莽一同战死。
description.en: Grand Minister of Works and a close confidant of Wang Mang. He was one of the commanders in the Battle of Kunyang. After the defeat, he escaped but was ultimately killed alongside Wang Mang when Chang'an fell.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年在青徐地区爆发的另一支大规模农民起义军，因士卒皆将眉毛染红而得名。他们推翻了更始政权，拥立刘盆子为帝，但最终被刘秀击败。
description.en: Another major peasant rebel army that emerged in the Qing-Xu region during the late Xin dynasty, named for the red paint they used on their eyebrows. They overthrew the Gengshi regime and installed Liu Penzi as emperor, but were ultimately defeated by Liu Xiu.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年赤眉军的建立者和主要领导人。
description.en: The founder and main leader of the Chimei (Red Eyebrows) army during the late Xin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 西汉皇族后裔，被赤眉军拥立为傀儡皇帝。在赤眉军被刘秀击败后投降。
description.en: A descendant of the Western Han imperial family who was installed as a puppet emperor by the Chimei (Red Eyebrows) army. He surrendered after the Chimei army was defeated by Liu Xiu.

description.zh-cn: 汉代一种将儒家经学与神学、阴阳五行学说相结合的思潮，认为天命会转移，王朝应当禅让。王莽利用谶纬学说制造舆论，为其篡汉提供了理论依据和合法性支持。
description.en: An ideology during the Han dynasty that combined Confucian classics with theology and the theory of Yin-Yang and the Five Elements. It held that the Mandate of Heaven could be transferred and that dynasties should abdicate to the worthy. Wang Mang used Chenwei to create public opinion, providing a theoretical basis and legitimacy for his usurpation.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀的兄长，新朝末年舂陵兵的领导人之一。因在攻克宛城和昆阳之战中功高震主，引起更始帝刘玄的猜忌而被杀害。
description.en: The elder brother of Liu Xiu and one of the leaders of the Chongling troops in the late Xin dynasty. He was killed by Emperor Gengshi (Liu Xuan) out of jealousy for his great achievements in capturing Wancheng and in the Battle of Kunyang.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年的地方官员，后在蜀地（今四川）割据称帝，国号“成家”，最终被东汉光武帝刘秀所灭。
description.en: A local official in the late Xin dynasty who later established a secessionist state in Shu (modern Sichuan), declaring himself emperor of the 'Chengjia' dynasty. He was eventually defeated and killed by Emperor Guangwu of the Eastern Han, Liu Xiu.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年由公孙述在蜀地建立的割据政权。
description.en: A secessionist state established by Gongsun Shu in the Shu region during the late Xin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 指用秦统一前的战国文字书写的儒家经典。王莽和刘歆等人大力提倡，并为之设立博士官，使其在学术上得以和今文经抗衡。
description.en: Refers to the Confucian classics written in the pre-Qin Warring States script. Wang Mang, Liu Xin, and others vigorously promoted them, establishing official academic positions for their study, allowing them to rival the New Text Classics.

description.zh-cn: 西汉末年至新朝的儒学大师和目录学家，古文经学派的主要倡导者，也是王莽的重要参谋之一。
description.en: A Confucian scholar and bibliographer from the late Western Han to the Xin dynasty. He was a leading advocate for the Old Text School of Confucianism and a key advisor to Wang Mang.

description.zh-cn: 由于伊朗伊斯兰革命导致石油产量下降而引发的全球石油危机。
description.en: A global oil crisis caused by a drop in oil production due to the Iranian Islamic Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 巴列维王朝统治下的伊朗国号，在伊斯兰革命中被推翻。
description.en: The official name of Iran under the Pahlavi dynasty, overthrown in the Islamic Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 巴列维王朝时期的伊朗国家情报和安全组织，以严刑拷打和镇压异己而闻名。
description.en: The national intelligence and security organization of Iran during the Pahlavi dynasty, known for torture and suppression of dissent.

description.zh-cn: 由霍梅尼在伊斯兰革命期间成立的机构，旨在管理国家并为建立新政府做准备。
description.en: A body formed by Khomeini during the Islamic Revolution to manage the country and prepare for the establishment of a new government.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗政治家，巴列维王朝的最后一任总理。
description.en: An Iranian politician who served as the last Prime Minister under the Pahlavi dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 由霍梅尼阐述的什叶派政治理论，主张在伊玛目隐遁期间，国家应由最具资格的伊斯兰教法学家（法基赫）监护和统治。该理论是伊朗伊斯兰共和国的宪法基础。
description.en: A Shia political theory elaborated by Khomeini, which holds that during the occultation of the Imam, the state should be governed under the guardianship of the most qualified Islamic jurist (Faqih). It is the constitutional basis of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的什叶派圣城，是革命早期抗议活动的重要地点。
description.en: A holy city for Shia Islam in Iran, and a key site of early protests during the revolution.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的共产主义政党，在革命初期支持霍梅尼，后遭到镇压。
description.en: A communist party in Iran that initially supported Khomeini but was later suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 一个结合了伊斯兰教和马克思主义思想的伊朗左翼武装反对派组织。
description.en: An Iranian left-wing armed opposition group that combines Islamic and Marxist ideologies.

zh-cn: 伊朗人民敢死游击队组织
en: Organization of Iranian People's Fedai Guerrillas

description.zh-cn: 伊朗的马克思列宁主义游击队组织，在革命后与伊斯兰政府对立。
description.en: A Marxist-Leninist guerrilla organization in Iran that opposed the Islamic government after the revolution.

en: Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China
zh-cn: 香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会

description.zh-cn: 为回应1989年中国大陆学生运动而成立的香港政治组织，由司徒华创立并长期担任主席，其纲领包括“结束一党专政”。
description.en: A Hong Kong political organization established in response to the 1989 student movement in mainland China. It was founded by Szeto Wah, who served as its chairman for many years. Its platform included 'ending one-party dictatorship'.

zh-cn: 香港教育专业人员协会

description.zh-cn: 香港的教师工会，司徒华是其创会会长。
description.en: A teachers' union in Hong Kong, of which Szeto Wah was the founding president.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华的红颜知己，因身患顽疾而与司徒华分手。司徒华为思念她而终身未婚。
description.en: Szeto Wah's close female friend, who broke up with him due to a serious illness. Szeto Wah remained unmarried for life in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物。因在2012年政改方案上与民主党立场存在分歧，于2010年6月退出民主党。
description.en: A Hong Kong politician. He withdrew from the Democratic Party in June 2010 due to disagreements over the party's stance on the 2012 political reform package.

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚帝国的末代皇帝，在位期间被意大利入侵而流亡，二战后复位，最终于1974年被军事政变推翻。
description.en: The last emperor of the Ethiopian Empire, he was exiled during the Italian invasion, restored to the throne after World War II, and was eventually overthrown by a military coup in 1974.

zh-cn: 门格斯图·海尔·马里亚姆

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚军官和政治家，领导“德尔格”军政府，在1977年至1991年间统治埃塞俄比亚。
description.en: An Ethiopian soldier and politician who was the leader of the Derg military junta that ruled Ethiopia from 1977 to 1991.

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚政治家，曾任埃塞俄比亚过渡政府总统，后长期担任总理直至去世。
description.en: An Ethiopian politician who served as President of the Transitional Government of Ethiopia and later as Prime Minister until his death.

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚政治家，现任埃塞俄比亚总统。
description.en: An Ethiopian politician, the current President of Ethiopia.

description.zh-cn: 1974年推翻埃塞俄比亚帝国后成立的军事政府，由门格斯图领导。
description.en: The military junta that ruled Ethiopia after overthrowing the Ethiopian Empire in 1974, led by Mengistu Haile Mariam.

zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚的一个政治联盟，于1991年推翻德尔格政权后长期执政，后改组为繁荣党。
description.en: A political coalition in Ethiopia that ruled the country after overthrowing the Derg regime in 1991, later reorganized into the Prosperity Party.

description.zh-cn: 由埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线改组而成的执政党。
description.en: The ruling political party in Ethiopia, formed from the reorganization of the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front.

description.zh-cn: 位于非洲之角的国家，曾与埃塞俄比亚组成联邦，后于1993年独立。
description.en: A country in the Horn of Africa, formerly in a federation with Ethiopia, which became independent in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚提格雷州的政党和前叛乱组织，曾是埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线的核心力量，后与联邦政府爆发提格雷战争。
description.en: A political party and former rebel group in the Tigray Region of Ethiopia. It was the core of the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front and later engaged in the Tigray War against the federal government.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪末至20世纪初对埃塞俄比亚进行殖民侵略的欧洲国家。
description.en: A European state that engaged in colonial aggression against Ethiopia in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

description.zh-cn: 一场推翻埃塞俄比亚末代皇帝海尔·塞拉西一世的军事政变，导致德尔格军政府上台。
description.en: A military coup that overthrew the last Ethiopian emperor, Haile Selassie I, leading to the rise of the Derg military junta.

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚联邦政府与提格雷人民解放阵线之间爆发的武装冲突。
description.en: An armed conflict between the federal government of Ethiopia and the Tigray People's Liberation Front.

zh-cn: 第一次意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争
第一次意大利埃塞俄比亚战争
第一次意大利衣索比亚战争

description.zh-cn: 意大利王国对埃塞俄比亚帝国的侵略战争，以埃塞俄比亚获胜、维护国家独立告终。
description.en: A war of aggression by the Kingdom of Italy against the Ethiopian Empire, which ended with an Ethiopian victory, preserving the country's independence.

description.zh-cn: 德尔格军政府与多个反政府武装组织之间的长期冲突，最终导致德尔格政权被推翻。
description.en: A prolonged conflict between the Derg military junta and various anti-government armed groups, which ultimately led to the overthrow of the Derg regime.

description.zh-cn: 厄立特里亚为争取脱离埃塞俄比亚独立而进行的长期武装斗争。
description.en: A long armed struggle fought by Eritreans for independence from Ethiopia.

zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚联邦

description.zh-cn: 根据联合国决议成立的联邦国家，将前意大利殖民地厄立特里亚与埃塞俄比亚帝国联合起来。
description.en: A federal state established by a UN resolution, uniting the former Italian colony of Eritrea with the Ethiopian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 在德尔格政权被推翻后，由埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线组建的临时政府。
description.en: The provisional government established by the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front after the overthrow of the Derg regime.

description.zh-cn: 白俄罗斯总统。
description.en: President of Belarus.

description.zh-cn: 哈佛大学社会科学教授，曾证实习明泽已返回中国。
description.en: A professor of social sciences at Harvard University who once confirmed that Xi Mingze had returned to China.

description.zh-cn: 在顿巴斯战争中与乌克兰政府军作战的、由俄罗斯支持的武装力量，包括顿涅茨克人民共和国和卢甘斯克人民共和国的部队。
description.en: Russian-backed armed forces that fought against the Ukrainian government in the War in Donbas, including troops from the Donetsk People's Republic and the Luhansk People's Republic.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰商人、政治人物。他在2014年总统选举中获胜，成为尊严革命后的第一任民选总统，并在顿巴斯战争初期担任乌克兰总统。
description.en: Ukrainian businessman and politician. He won the 2014 presidential election, becoming the first popularly elected president after the Revolution of Dignity, and served as President of Ukraine during the initial phase of the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 2014年9月签署的旨在停止顿巴斯战争的协议，但未能完全实现停火。
description.en: An agreement signed in September 2014 to halt the war in Donbas, which failed to achieve a complete ceasefire.

description.zh-cn: 2015年2月签署的旨在执行明斯克协议的一系列措施，但冲突仍持续不断。
description.en: A package of measures signed in February 2015 to implement the Minsk Protocol, but the conflict continued.

en: Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)

description.zh-cn: 2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰期间，在乌克兰东部地区展开的军事攻势。
description.en: The military offensive in the eastern region of Ukraine during the 2022 full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine.

zh-cn: 亚历山大·弗拉基米罗维奇·扎哈尔琴科

description.zh-cn: 顿涅茨克人民共和国前领导人，2018年被暗杀。
description.en: Former leader of the Donetsk People's Republic, assassinated in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 卢甘斯克人民共和国前领导人，2017年因内斗辞职。
description.en: Former leader of the Luhansk People's Republic, who resigned in 2017 due to internal power struggles.

description.zh-cn: 卢甘斯克人民共和国领导人，在2017年政变后上台。
description.en: Leader of the Luhansk People's Republic, who came to power after the 2017 coup.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯政治家，普京的著名批评者。在准备一份关于俄罗斯参与顿巴斯战争的报告时被暗杀。
description.en: Russian politician and a prominent critic of Vladimir Putin. He was assassinated while preparing a report on Russia's involvement in the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 2015年2月27日，俄罗斯政治家鲍里斯·涅姆佐夫在莫斯科市中心被枪杀的事件。
description.en: The event on February 27, 2015, in which Russian politician Boris Nemtsov was shot and killed in central Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 汉光武帝刘秀的第二任皇后，为人仁爱孝顺、恭俭。刘秀年轻时便倾心于她，曾有“娶妻当得阴丽华”的感叹。
description.en: The second empress of Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu), known for her benevolence, filial piety, and frugality. Liu Xiu was infatuated with her in his youth, famously remarking, 'If I am to marry, it must be Yin Lihua'.

description.zh-cn: 汉光武帝刘秀的第一任皇后，后被废。
description.en: The first empress of Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu), who was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 汉光武帝刘秀与郭圣通所生之子，东汉第一位太子，后被废。
description.en: The son of Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu) and Guo Shengtong, and the first crown prince of the Eastern Han, who was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 汉光武帝刘秀的父亲，曾任南顿县令。
description.en: Father of Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu), who served as the magistrate of Nanton County.

description.zh-cn: 汉光武帝刘秀的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Emperor Guangwu of Han (Liu Xiu).

description.zh-cn: 位于古代日本九州北部的一个国家，曾向东汉朝贡并获赐金印。
description.en: A state in northern Kyushu, ancient Japan, which paid tribute to the Eastern Han dynasty and was granted a gold seal.

description.zh-cn: 汉代的中枢决策机构，在东汉时期权力扩大，成为皇帝发号施令的执行机构。
description.en: A central decision-making body in the Han dynasty, whose power was expanded during the Eastern Han to become the executive agency for imperial edicts.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代最高官职的合称，通常指司徒、司马、司空。在东汉时期权力被削弱。
description.en: A collective term for the highest official positions in ancient China, usually referring to the Minister over the Masses, Minister of War, and Minister of Works. Their power was weakened during the Eastern Han dynasty.

en: Twenty-second Amendment to the United States Constitution
zh-cn: 美国宪法第二十二修正案

description.zh-cn: 规定总统每届任期4年，连选连任不得多于2次。
description.en: Limits the president to two four-year terms in office.

description.zh-cn: 选举美国总统和副总统的程序，每四年举行一次。
description.en: The process for electing the President and Vice President of the United States, held every four years.

description.zh-cn: 根据美国宪法设立，负责选举美国总统和副总统的机构。
description.en: The body established by the U.S. Constitution for the purpose of electing the president and vice president of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统的休假地。
description.en: A country retreat for the President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国第6任总统，其父约翰·亚当斯是美国第2任总统。
description.en: The 6th President of the United States, son of the 2nd President, John Adams.

description.zh-cn: 美国第23任总统，其祖父是第9任总统威廉·亨利·哈里森。
description.en: The 23rd President of the United States, and the grandson of the 9th President, William Henry Harrison.

description.zh-cn: 美国第17任总统，是美国历史上首位被众议院弹劾的总统。
description.en: The 17th President of the United States, and the first to be impeached by the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国山东省的县。
description.en: A county in Shandong Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 八路军115师的下属部队。
description.en: A subordinate unit of the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 淡江英语专科学校共同创办人及首任校长。
description.en: Co-founder and first president of Tamkang English Junior College.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学共同创办人，曾任校长与董事长。
description.en: Co-founder of Tamkang University, served as president and chairman.

description.zh-cn: 曾任淡江文理学院及淡江大学董事长。
description.en: Served as chairman of Tamkang College of Arts and Sciences and Tamkang University.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学创办人张建邦的长女，曾任淡江大学校长，现任董事长。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Tamkang University co-founder Chang Chien-pang, served as president and is the current chairwoman of Tamkang University.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学创办人居正的次子，曾任淡江英语专科学校校长。
description.en: The second son of Tamkang University co-founder Ju Zheng, served as president of Tamkang English Junior College.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学资讯工程学系教授，现任淡江大学校长。
description.en: Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Information Engineering at Tamkang University, and the current president of the university.

description.zh-cn: 台湾知名水彩画家，设计了淡江大学的校徽。
description.en: A renowned Taiwanese watercolor artist who designed the emblem of Tamkang University.

description.zh-cn: 台湾校园民歌运动的催生者之一，淡江大学数学系校友。校内设有其纪念碑。
description.en: One of the pioneers of the Taiwanese campus folk song movement and an alumnus of the Department of Mathematics at Tamkang University. A monument in his memory is located on campus.

description.zh-cn: 台湾雕塑家，为淡江大学创作了李双泽纪念碑、海豚吉祥物里程碑及五虎碑等多件雕塑作品。
description.en: A Taiwanese sculptor who created several sculptures for Tamkang University, including the Li Shuang-ze Memorial, the Dolphin Mascot Milestone, and the Five Tigers Monument.

description.zh-cn: 台湾作家、诗人、画家与艺术评论家，为淡江大学李双泽纪念碑题字。
description.en: A Taiwanese writer, poet, painter, and art critic who wrote the inscription for the Li Shuang-ze Memorial at Tamkang University.

en: Excellent Long-Established University Consortium of Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 台湾的私立大学交流联盟，淡江大学为其成员之一。
description.en: An alliance for academic exchange among private universities in Taiwan, of which Tamkang University is a member.

description.zh-cn: 由七所台湾大专院校合组的研究中心，淡江大学为其成员之一。
description.en: A research center formed by a consortium of seven Taiwanese universities, of which Tamkang University is a member.

en: National Tsing Hua University Scientific Research Industrialization Platform of Five Universities Alliance

description.zh-cn: 台湾的大学学术联盟，淡江大学为其成员之一。
description.en: An academic alliance of universities in Taiwan, of which Tamkang University is a member.

description.zh-cn: 跨国大学联盟，淡江大学为其成员之一。
description.en: A transnational university alliance, of which Tamkang University is a member.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于联合国教科文组织的全球性高等教育协会，淡江大学为其成员。
description.en: A global association of higher education institutions based at UNESCO, of which Tamkang University is a member.

description.zh-cn: 于2017年在台北市举办的国际综合性体育赛事。
description.en: An international multi-sport event held in Taipei in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 来自中华人民共和国的留学生，曾参选淡江大学学生会会长，引发争议。
description.en: An exchange student from the People's Republic of China who ran for the presidency of the Tamkang University Student Association, causing controversy.

zh-cn: 2014年淡江大学学生会正副会长补选争议

description.zh-cn: 指2014年因中国大陆籍留学生蔡博艺参选淡江大学学生会会长而引发的一系列争议事件。
description.en: Refers to a series of controversial events in 2014 arising from the candidacy of mainland Chinese student Cai Boyi for the presidency of the Tamkang University Student Association.

description.en: Lieutenant General of the PLA Air Force, current Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委联合参谋部直属单位。
description.en: A directly subordinate unit of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.en: Lieutenant General of the PLA, former Assistant to the Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.en: Lieutenant General of the PLA, former Assistant to the Chief and Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.
