description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部参谋长助理。
description.en: Major General of the PLA, former Assistant to the Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部参谋长助理。
description.en: Major General of the PLA, former Assistant to the Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军上将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: Admiral of the PLA Navy, former Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军上将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: General of the PLA Air Force, former Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军前上将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长，后因涉嫌受贿被查。
description.en: Former General of the PLA, served as Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC, later investigated for bribery.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: General of the PLA, former Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军中将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: Lieutenant General of the PLA Rocket Force, former Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军中将，曾任中央军委联合参谋部副参谋长。
description.en: Lieutenant General of the PLA Rocket Force, former Deputy Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the CMC.

description.zh-cn: 明清战争期间的一场决定性战役。清军在多尔衮等人的指挥下获胜，明军主帅洪承畴被俘。此役为清军之后入关奠定了基础。
description.en: A decisive battle during the Ming-Qing transition. The Qing forces, commanded by Dorgon and others, achieved victory, capturing the Ming commander Hong Chengchou. This battle paved the way for the Qing's subsequent conquest of China.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，时任兵部尚书，因催促洪承畴出战，被认为是导致松锦之战失败的原因之一。
description.en: A late Ming official, then Minister of War, who is considered one of the reasons for the defeat in the Battle of Songjin due to his urging of Hong Chengchou to attack.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，被兵部尚书陈新甲派去监督和催促洪承畴进军。
description.en: A late Ming official sent by Minister of War Chen Xinjia to supervise and urge Hong Chengchou to advance.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，被兵部尚书陈新甲派去监督和催促洪承畴进军。
description.en: A late Ming official sent by Minister of War Chen Xinjia to supervise and urge Hong Chengchou to advance.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年重臣，受皇太极派遣成功劝降洪承畴。
description.en: An important minister in the early Qing dynasty who was dispatched by Hong Taiji and successfully persuaded Hong Chengchou to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，兵败被俘后拒绝洪承畴的劝降，并当面斥责他，后被杀害。
description.en: A late Ming official who, after being defeated and captured, refused to surrender when persuaded by Hong Chengchou, rebuked him to his face, and was later executed.

description.zh-cn: 明末抗清人士，被俘后以洪承畴“殉国”之事反讽羞辱洪承畴，后被杀害。
description.en: A late Ming anti-Qing figure who, after being captured, sarcastically shamed Hong Chengchou by referring to his supposed 'martyrdom', and was later executed.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，被清廷扣留后拒绝洪承畴的说降，称其为“鬼”。
description.en: A late Ming official who, after being detained by the Qing court, refused Hong Chengchou's persuasion to surrender, calling him a 'ghost'.

description.zh-cn: 明末学者、官员，被俘后作对联讽刺洪承畴，后被杀害。
description.en: A late Ming scholar and official who, after being captured, wrote a couplet satirizing Hong Chengchou and was later executed.

description.zh-cn: 明末诗人、抗清志士，年仅十七岁被捕，当庭斥责洪承畴，后被杀害。
description.en: A late Ming poet and anti-Qing patriot who was arrested at the age of seventeen, denounced Hong Chengchou in court, and was later executed.

description.zh-cn: 明朝兴国公，拒绝薙发归顺，临死前大骂洪承畴。
description.en: Duke Xingguo of the Ming dynasty, who refused to adopt the queue hairstyle and surrender, and cursed Hong Chengchou before his death.

description.zh-cn: 明朝高级军事职务，负责蓟州、辽东等地的防务。
description.en: A high-ranking military position in the Ming dynasty, responsible for the defense of Jizhou, Liaodong, and other areas.

description.zh-cn: 明清时期的内阁高级官员，为事实上的宰相。
description.en: A high-ranking official of the Grand Secretariat during the Ming and Qing dynasties, serving as a de facto chancellor.

en: Biographies of Twice-Serving Ministers of the Ming Period

description.zh-cn: 清朝乾隆年间由国史馆编纂的史书，记录了明末降清官员的传记，洪承畴被列为甲篇之首。
description.en: A historical book compiled by the State Historiographer's Office during the Qianlong era of the Qing dynasty, recording the biographies of Ming officials who surrendered to the Qing. Hong Chengchou was listed at the top of Volume A.

en: Police Ranks of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民警察警衔

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民警察的警衔体系。
description.en: The rank system for the People's Police of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国警衔体系中的一个等级，是晋升为三级警监的必要条件之一。
description.en: A rank in the Chinese police rank system, and a prerequisite for promotion to Third Level Police Supervisor.

en: People's Police of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民警察

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的国家警察力量。
description.en: The national police force of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国警衔体系中的一个高级警衔，等级高于二级警监。
description.en: A high-ranking police rank in the Chinese police rank system, senior to the Second Level Police Supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，担任沈阳市市长、中共沈阳市委副书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, serving as the Mayor of Shenyang and Deputy Secretary of the Shenyang Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国辽宁省沈阳市下辖的市辖区，沈阳市人民政府所在地。
description.en: A municipal district of Shenyang, Liaoning, People's Republic of China, where the Shenyang Municipal People's Government is located.

description.zh-cn: 沈阳市人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: A constituent department of the Shenyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 沈阳市人民政府的直属机构。
description.en: An agency directly under the Shenyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任辽宁省人民政府副省长、沈阳市人民政府市长、沈阳市人大常委会主任。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Governor of Liaoning Province, Mayor of Shenyang Municipal People's Government, and Director of the Standing Committee of the Shenyang Municipal People's Congress.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省
location.en: Hunan Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 湖南省的一个县，是张荣茂的家乡。
description.en: A county in Hunan Province, the hometown of Zhang Rongmao.

description.zh-cn: 镇嵩军将领，孙殿英曾为其部下。
description.en: A general of the Zhensong Army, under whom Sun Dianying once served.

description.zh-cn: 直鲁联军将领，孙殿英曾为其手下师长。
description.en: A general of the Zhili-Shandong United Army, under whom Sun Dianying served as a division commander.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领，被孙殿英诱降，后与孙产生矛盾。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army who was induced by Sun Dianying to surrender, and later had conflicts with him.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英之子。
description.en: Son of Sun Dianying.

description.zh-cn: 民国军阀势力之一，孙殿英曾短暂投降并加入该部队。
description.en: A warlord force in the Republic of China, which Sun Dianying briefly surrendered to and joined.

description.zh-cn: 1933年日本侵略中国热河省的战役，孙殿英奉命率部参战，与日军激战后战败。
description.en: A 1933 battle resulting from the Japanese invasion of China's Rehe Province. Sun Dianying was ordered to participate and was defeated after fierce fighting with the Japanese army.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，孙殿英试图进入宁夏、青海地区，遭到当地马步芳、马步青、马鸿逵、马鸿宾等“四马”势力的联合武力抵抗并最终战败的事件。
description.en: In 1934, Sun Dianying attempted to enter the Ningxia and Qinghai regions but was met with united armed resistance from the local 'Four Mas' (Ma Bufang, Ma Buqing, Ma Hongkui, Ma Hongbin) and was ultimately defeated.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相、文学家。他曾劝说唐玄宗保住当时尚在腹中的唐肃宗。此外，他与张九龄为同姓宗亲，多次举荐张九龄，是张九龄重要的政治盟友和知己。
description.en: A chancellor and writer of the Tang Dynasty. He persuaded Emperor Xuanzong to save the unborn Emperor Suzong. He was also a kinsman and an important political ally and confidant of Zhang Jiuling, whom he repeatedly recommended.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗为太子时的正妃。因其兄韦坚被李林甫诬陷，被迫与肃宗离异，出家为尼。
description.en: The principal consort of Emperor Suzong when he was the crown prince. Due to her brother Wei Jian being framed by Li Linfu, she was forced to divorce Suzong and become a nun.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗的皇后。在肃宗病重时图谋杀害太子李豫，改立越王李系，但因宦官李辅国发动政变而被杀。
description.en: The empress of Emperor Suzong. When Suzong was critically ill, she conspired to kill Crown Prince Li Yu and replace him with the Prince of Yue, Li Xi, but was killed in a coup initiated by the eunuch Li Fuguo.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝名将，在安史之乱中与郭子仪齐名，是唐肃宗反攻的核心军事将领。
description.en: A famous general of the Tang Dynasty, renowned alongside Guo Ziyi during the An-Shi Rebellion. He was a core military commander in Emperor Suzong's counter-offensive.

description.zh-cn: 一个突厥汗国，在安史之乱期间与唐肃宗结盟，派遣骑兵帮助唐军收复两京。
description.en: A Turkic khaganate that allied with Emperor Suzong during the An-Shi Rebellion, dispatching cavalry to help the Tang army recapture the two capitals.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宦官，李辅国的亲信。奉李辅国之命率军入宫杀死了张皇后和越王李系。
description.en: A eunuch of the Tang Dynasty and a confidant of Li Fuguo. Under Li Fuguo's orders, he led troops into the palace and killed Empress Zhang and the Prince of Yue, Li Xi.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗的陵墓。
description.en: The mausoleum of Emperor Suzong of Tang.

description.zh-cn: 一起发生在中国浙江省杭州市淳安县千岛湖的抢劫杀人案，造成24名台湾游客死亡，事件处理过程引发台湾方面强烈不满，严重影响两岸关系。该事件是电视剧《国际桥牌社2》的剧情原型之一。
description.en: A robbery and murder case that occurred in Qiandao Lake, Chun'an County, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, resulting in the deaths of 24 Taiwanese tourists. The handling of the incident caused strong dissatisfaction in Taiwan and severely affected cross-strait relations. This event is one of the story prototypes in the TV series 'Island Nation 2'.

description.zh-cn: 一本预言海峡两岸将在1995年农历闰八月爆发战争的书籍。在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》中，其原型为《1995正九月》一书。
description.en: A book that predicted a war across the Taiwan Strait in the intercalary eighth month of the 1995 lunar calendar. Its prototype in the TV series 'Island Nation 2' is the book '1995 Zheng Jiuyue'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾黑道分子和政治人物，曾任屏东县议会议长，因枪杀钟源峰而闻名。在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》中，其角色原型为“周定荣”。
description.en: A Taiwanese gangster and politician who served as the Speaker of the Pingtung County Council, known for the murder of Chung Yuan-feng. His prototype character in the TV series 'Island Nation 2' is 'Zhou Ding-rong'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾摇滚乐团，为电视剧《国际桥牌社2》谱写并演唱主题曲《同岛一命》。
description.en: A Taiwanese rock band that composed and performed the theme song 'Common Fate' for the TV series 'Island Nation 2'.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民检察院现任检察长。
description.en: The current Procurator-General of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国大检察官

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国检察官的衔级之一。
description.en: One of the ranks for procurators in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 行使国家检察权的机关，是国家的法律监督机关。
description.en: Organs that exercise the state's procuratorial power and serve as the state's legal supervision organs.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 吕伟红的出生地，位于山东省。
description.en: Birthplace of Lü Weihong, located in Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，吕伟红的前任海关总署人事教育司司长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, predecessor of Lü Weihong as Director of the Personnel and Education Department of the General Administration of Customs.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，幻方量化和深度求索的创始人及首席执行官。
description.en: Chinese entrepreneur, founder and CEO of High-Flyer Quant and DeepSeek.

description.zh-cn: 一家由梁文锋等人于2015年创办的中资对冲基金，也是深度求索的母公司。
description.en: A Chinese hedge fund founded by Liang Wenfeng and others in 2015, and the parent company of DeepSeek.

location.zh-cn: 美国加利福尼亚州旧金山

description.zh-cn: 美国人工智能研究实验室，开发了ChatGPT和GPT-4等著名模型。
description.en: An American artificial intelligence research laboratory that developed famous models such as ChatGPT and GPT-4.

description.zh-cn: 中国网络安全公司，曾分析针对DeepSeek的网络攻击事件。
description.en: A Chinese cybersecurity company that analyzed the cyberattack event against DeepSeek.

description.zh-cn: 总部位于纽约的网络安全公司，曾发现与DeepSeek相关的数据库存在安全漏洞。
description.en: A New York-based cybersecurity company that discovered a security vulnerability in a database related to DeepSeek.

description.zh-cn: 美国企业家，OpenAI的首席执行官。
description.en: American entrepreneur, CEO of OpenAI.

description.zh-cn: 由深度求索于2025年1月20日发布的开源推理模型，其性能被认为可与OpenAI o1正式版相当。
description.en: An open-source reasoning model released by DeepSeek on January 20, 2025, with performance considered comparable to the official version of OpenAI o1.

description.zh-cn: 由腾讯公司开发的聊天机器人应用。
description.en: A chatbot application developed by Tencent.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国人工智能公司，其首席执行官对DeepSeek获取芯片的合规性提出质疑。
description.en: An American AI company whose CEO questioned the compliance of DeepSeek's chip acquisition.

description.zh-cn: Scale AI的首席执行官，曾公开批评DeepSeek可能违反了美国芯片出口管制规定。
description.en: CEO of Scale AI, who publicly criticized DeepSeek for potentially violating US chip export control regulations.

description.zh-cn: 美国跨国科技公司，全球领先的图形处理器和人工智能芯片制造商。
description.en: An American multinational technology company and a leading global manufacturer of graphics processing units and artificial intelligence chips.

description.zh-cn: 由深度求索于2024年12月26日发布的开源模型。
description.en: An open-source model released by DeepSeek on December 26, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 美国企业家，英伟达公司（NVIDIA）的共同创办人暨首席执行官。
description.en: American entrepreneur, co-founder and CEO of NVIDIA.

description.zh-cn: 一份全球知名的跨学科科学期刊。
description.en: A world-renowned interdisciplinary scientific journal.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦政府行政部门之一，负责国防事务。
description.en: An executive department of the U.S. federal government responsible for national defense.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，曾任国务院外事办公室主任、中央外事办公室主任、中央外事工作领导小组办公室主任和中央国家安全工作领导小组办公室主任。
description.en: Chinese diplomat, former Director of the State Council Foreign Affairs Office, Director of the Central Foreign Affairs Office, Director of the Office of the Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs, and Director of the Office of the Central Leading Group for National Security Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，现任中央国家安全委员会办公室副主任。
description.en: Chinese diplomat, currently Deputy Director of the Office of the Central National Security Commission.

description.zh-cn: 一项由吴健雄及其合作者进行的物理学实验，该实验验证了弱相互作用中宇称不守恒的理论。
description.en: A physics experiment conducted by Chien-Shiung Wu and her collaborators, which verified the theory of parity non-conservation in weak interactions.

description.zh-cn: 意大利裔美国物理学家，以在核反应堆方面的工作而闻名，曾是李政道的博士导师。
description.en: An Italian-American physicist known for his work on nuclear reactors, who was Tsung-Dao Lee's doctoral advisor.

description.zh-cn: 李政道的长子，历史学家。
description.en: Tsung-Dao Lee's elder son, a historian.

description.zh-cn: 李政道的幼子，化学家。
description.en: Tsung-Dao Lee's younger son, a chemist.

description.zh-cn: 由马来西亚前首相马哈迪·莫哈末推动的一项计划，旨在促进该国的科技发展。
description.en: An initiative promoted by former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad to foster technological development in the country.

description.zh-cn: 中国江西萍乡的一位气功师，马云曾前往拜访，引发社会关注。
description.en: A qigong master from Pingxiang, Jiangxi, China, whom Jack Ma visited, drawing public attention.

description.zh-cn: 蚂蚁集团董事长，曾与马云一同被中国金融监管机构约谈。
description.en: Chairman of Ant Group, who was summoned for a regulatory meeting by Chinese financial regulators along with Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 时任蚂蚁集团总裁，曾与马云一同被中国金融监管机构约谈。
description.en: Then-CEO of Ant Group, who was summoned for a regulatory meeting by Chinese financial regulators along with Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 腾讯公司主要创办人之一，与马云在中国互联网行业并称为“二马”，是主要的竞争对手。
description.en: Co-founder of Tencent, known together with Jack Ma as the 'Two Mas' in China's internet industry, and a major competitor.

description.zh-cn: 司马昭次子，过继给司马师为嗣子。
description.en: The second son of Sima Zhao, adopted by Sima Shi as his heir.

description.zh-cn: 司马师的第一任妻子，夏侯尚之女。
description.en: The first wife of Sima Shi, daughter of Xiahou Shang.

description.zh-cn: 司马师的第三任妻子。
description.en: The third wife of Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 司马师的第二任妻子，吴质之女。
description.en: The second wife of Sima Shi, daughter of Wu Zhi.

description.zh-cn: 252年冬，孙吴与曹魏在东兴（今安徽省含山县）的一场战役，吴军在诸葛恪的指挥下获胜。
description.en: A battle between Eastern Wu and Cao Wei at Dongxing (present-day Hanshan County, Anhui) in the winter of 252, where the Wu forces under the command of Zhuge Ke were victorious.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏官员，任中书令，因图谋废黜司马师而被杀。
description.en: An official of Cao Wei who served as Prefect of the Masters of Writing, executed for plotting to depose Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏官员，任光禄大夫，因图谋废黜司马师而被杀。
description.en: An official of Cao Wei who served as Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, executed for plotting to depose Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏官员与玄学家，因李丰、张缉谋立其为大将军而受牵连被杀。
description.en: An official and Xuanxue scholar of Cao Wei, implicated and executed because Li Feng and Zhang Ji planned to make him Grand General.

en: Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin's Rebellion

description.zh-cn: 255年，曹魏将领毌丘俭与文钦在寿春起兵反对司马师擅行废立的叛乱。
description.en: In 255, Cao Wei generals Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin launched a rebellion in Shouchun against Sima Shi's usurpation of power.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领，因反对司马师而起兵，兵败被杀。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei who rebelled against Sima Shi and was defeated and killed.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领，与毌丘俭一同起兵反对司马师，兵败后投奔东吴。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei who rebelled against Sima Shi alongside Guanqiu Jian and later defected to Eastern Wu after their defeat.

description.zh-cn: 文钦之子，以勇猛著称。其率兵袭营导致司马师病情加重而死。
description.en: Son of Wen Qin, known for his bravery. His raid on Sima Shi's camp worsened Sima Shi's illness, leading to his death.

description.zh-cn: 由司马炎取代曹魏建立的中国朝代。
description.en: A Chinese dynasty founded by Sima Yan, replacing the Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一个郡，位于今河南省北部。
description.en: An ancient commandery in China, located in the northern part of modern-day Henan province.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的高级军事将领职位。
description.en: A high-ranking military position in ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 两当兵变的参与者。
description.en: A participant in the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 两当兵变的参与者。
description.en: A participant in the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 受中共陕西省委派遣开展兵运工作，并参与组织发动两当兵变。
description.en: Dispatched by the Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the CCP to carry out military movement work and participated in organizing and launching the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 受中共陕西省委派遣到杨虎城部队开展兵运工作。
description.en: Dispatched by the Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the CCP to Yang Hucheng's troops to carry out military movement work.

description.zh-cn: 两当兵变的组织者和发动者之一。
description.en: One of the organizers and launchers of the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 两当兵变的组织者和发动者之一，后任中国工农红军陕甘游击队第五支队支队长。
description.en: One of the organizers and launchers of the Liangdang Mutiny, later served as the commander of the Fifth Detachment of the Shaanxi-Gansu Guerrilla Force of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省咸阳市下辖县，中国工农红军陕甘游击队第五支队在此地被打散。
description.en: A county under Xianyang, Shaanxi Province, where the Fifth Detachment of the Shaanxi-Gansu Guerrilla Force of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army was dispersed.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛政治人物，2019年当选为立陶宛总统。
description.en: A Lithuanian politician who was elected President of Lithuania in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛政治人物，在2020年议会选举后被任命为总理。
description.en: A Lithuanian politician appointed as Prime Minister following the 2020 parliamentary election.

zh-cn: 绍柳斯·斯克韦尔内利斯
萨利乌斯·思科威尔内里

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛政治人物，曾任立陶宛总理，现任立陶宛议会议长。
description.en: A Lithuanian politician who previously served as the Prime Minister of Lithuania and currently serves as the Speaker of the Seimas.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛共和国的立法机关。
description.en: The legislative branch of the Republic of Lithuania.

description.zh-cn: 统一立陶宛并接受加冕的首位国王，建立了立陶宛王国。
description.en: The first King of Lithuania, who united the country and was crowned, establishing the Kingdom of Lithuania.

description.zh-cn: 由明道加斯于1253年建立的王国，是立陶宛国家的早期形式。
description.en: A kingdom established by Mindaugas in 1253, an early form of the Lithuanian state.

description.zh-cn: 中世纪晚期至近代早期的欧洲国家，14世纪时曾是欧洲领土最大的国家。
description.en: A European state from the late Middle Ages to the early modern period, which was the largest country in Europe in the 14th century.

description.zh-cn: 由波兰王国和立陶宛大公国组成的共主邦联，是17至18世纪欧洲最大、人口最多的国家之一。
description.en: A dualistic state of Poland and Lithuania, one of the largest and most populous countries of 17th- and 18th-century Europe.

description.zh-cn: 18世纪末期，俄罗斯、普鲁士和奥地利三国对波兰立陶宛联邦领土进行的三次瓜分，最终导致联邦灭亡。
description.en: Three partitions of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth that took place towards the end of the 18th century and ended the existence of the state, carried out by the Russian Empire, the Kingdom of Prussia, and Habsburg Austria.

zh-cn: 苏联占领波罗的海国家

description.zh-cn: 苏联在1940年至1991年间对波罗的海三国（立陶宛、拉脱维亚、爱沙尼亚）的军事占领和吞并。
description.en: The military occupation and annexation of the three Baltic states (Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia) by the Soviet Union from 1940 to 1991.

description.zh-cn: 1918年2月16日由立陶宛国民大会签署的文件，宣布立陶宛恢复独立。
description.en: The document signed by the Council of Lithuania on February 16, 1918, declaring the restoration of an independent Lithuania.

en: Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania

description.zh-cn: 1990年3月11日由立陶宛最高委员会签署的法案，宣布恢复立陶宛的独立国家地位，使其成为第一个脱离苏联的加盟共和国。
description.en: The act signed on March 11, 1990, by the Supreme Council of Lithuania, declaring the restoration of Lithuania's independent statehood, making it the first Soviet republic to break away.

description.zh-cn: 在1944年至1953年间为反抗苏联占领而进行武装斗争的立陶宛抵抗组织。
description.en: Lithuanian resistance fighters who waged a guerrilla war against the Soviet occupation from 1944 to 1953.

description.zh-cn: 一场由立陶宛、拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚三国约200万民众手牵手组成的和平示威活动，抗议苏联占领并争取独立。
description.en: A peaceful political demonstration where approximately two million people from Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia joined hands to protest the Soviet occupation and seek independence.

description.zh-cn: 1991年1月，苏联军队试图武力推翻宣布独立的立陶宛政府，导致平民伤亡的事件。
description.en: In January 1991, Soviet military forces attempted to overthrow the newly independent Lithuanian government by force, resulting in civilian casualties.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，纳粹德国及其合作者在立陶宛境内对犹太人进行的种族灭绝行动，导致该国绝大多数犹太人被杀害。
description.en: The genocide of Jews in Lithuania during World War II by Nazi Germany and its collaborators, which resulted in the murder of the vast majority of the country's Jewish population.

description.zh-cn: 1569年波兰王国和立陶宛大公国签署的条约，建立了波兰立陶宛联邦。
description.en: An act signed in 1569 by the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania that created the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，法兰西第三共和国的创始人之一，在普法战争期间宣布成立国防政府。
description.en: French statesman, one of the founders of the French Third Republic, who proclaimed the Government of National Defense during the Franco-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家和历史学家，法兰西第三共和国的第一任总统。
description.en: French politician and historian who served as the first president of the French Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军和政治家，在镇压巴黎公社后当选为法兰西第三共和国的第二任总统。
description.en: French general and politician who, after suppressing the Paris Commune, was elected as the second President of the French Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军和政治家，其政治运动（布朗热主义）在1889年引发了一场威胁到法兰西第三共和国的政治危机。
description.en: French general and politician whose political movement, Boulangism, instigated a political crisis in 1889 that threatened the Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 一场重大的政治丑闻，涉及对犹太裔炮兵军官阿尔弗雷德·德雷福斯的叛国罪错判，深刻地分裂了法国社会。
description.en: A major political scandal involving the wrongful conviction for treason of Alfred Dreyfus, a Jewish artillery officer, which deeply divided French society.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔萨斯犹太后裔的法国炮兵军官，德雷福斯事件的核心人物。
description.en: A French artillery officer of Alsatian Jewish descent who was the central figure in the Dreyfus affair.

en: 1905 French law on the Separation of the Churches and the State

description.zh-cn: 1905年12月颁布的法律，正式将法国的教会与国家分离，废除了1801年教务专约。
description.en: A law passed in December 1905 that officially separated church and state in France, abrogating the Concordat of 1801.

description.zh-cn: 法国和俄罗斯帝国于1892年缔结的军事协定，也是法国为孤立德国而建立的外交体系的一部分。
description.en: A military agreement concluded between France and the Russian Empire in 1892, which was part of France's diplomatic system to isolate Germany.

description.zh-cn: 法国和英国之间的一系列协议，标志着两国间间歇性冲突的结束，并为对抗德国的三国协约奠定了基础。
description.en: A series of agreements signed between the United Kingdom and the French Republic, marking the end of intermittent conflict between the two nations and paving the way for the Triple Entente against Germany.

description.zh-cn: 法国左翼政党的联盟，包括法国共产党、社会党和激进党，于1936年赢得选举。
description.en: An alliance of left-wing movements in France, including the French Communist Party, the Socialist Party, and the Radical Party, which won the 1936 elections.

description.zh-cn: 法国社会主义政治家，三度担任法国总理，是人民阵线政府的领导人。
description.en: A French socialist politician who served as Prime Minister of France three times and was the leader of the Popular Front government.

description.zh-cn: 一种剧毒化合物，俗称砒霜。2008年的科学检测证实，光绪帝死于急性砒霜中毒。
description.en: A highly toxic compound, commonly known as arsenic. Scientific tests in 2008 confirmed that the Guangxu Emperor died from acute arsenic poisoning.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后最宠信的太监。在光绪帝死因的猜测中，他被认为是可能的凶手之一。
description.en: The most trusted eunuch of Empress Dowager Cixi. He is considered one of the possible culprits in the speculations surrounding the cause of the Guangxu Emperor's death.

description.zh-cn: 清末皇族、重臣，曾任总理海军事务衙门会办大臣。有传闻称他曾引荐医生为光绪帝开具有害药方，是毒害光绪帝的嫌疑人之一。
description.en: A member of the imperial family and an influential statesman in the late Qing dynasty. He served as a co-administrator of the Admiralty. It was rumored that he introduced a doctor who prescribed a harmful medication for the Guangxu Emperor, making him one of the suspects in the emperor's poisoning.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，法学博士，中国共产党党员。曾任上海长宁区委常委、副区长，现任中共上海市静安区委副书记、区长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Doctor of Law, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He formerly served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Changning District Committee and Deputy District Mayor in Shanghai. He is currently the Deputy Secretary of the Jing'an District Committee and District Mayor of Shanghai.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区监察委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国在内蒙古自治区的省级地方国家监察机关，与中国共产党内蒙古自治区纪律检查委员会合署办公。
description.en: The provincial-level local state supervisory organ of the People's Republic of China in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, co-located with the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产党内蒙古自治区纪律检查委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在内蒙古自治区的纪律检查机关，与内蒙古自治区监察委员会合署办公。
description.en: The discipline inspection agency of the Communist Party of China in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, co-located with the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Supervisory Commission.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民代表大会
en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Regional People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The local state power organ of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民代表大会常务委员会
内蒙古自治区人大常委会
en: Standing Committee of the People's Congress of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing committee of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 现任柬埔寨国王。
description.en: The current King of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 现任柬埔寨首相，洪森之子。
description.en: The current Prime Minister of Cambodia, son of Hun Sen.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨国会的上议院。
description.en: The upper house of the Parliament of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨国会的下议院，是柬埔寨全国最高权力机构和立法机构。
description.en: The lower house of the Parliament of Cambodia, it is the country's supreme power and legislative body.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨的立法机关。
description.en: The legislative body of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨的执政党，长期主导该国政坛。
description.en: The ruling party of Cambodia, which has long dominated the country's political scene.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨在1953年独立后建立的君主制国家，于1970年被政变推翻。
description.en: The monarchy established in Cambodia after its independence in 1953, which was overthrown by a coup in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨将军，于1970年发动政变，成立高棉共和国。
description.en: A Cambodian general who launched a coup in 1970 and established the Khmer Republic.

description.zh-cn: 由龙诺将军发动的政变，废黜了西哈努克亲王，结束了君主制，建立了高棉共和国。
description.en: A coup launched by General Lon Nol, which deposed Prince Sihanouk, ended the monarchy, and established the Khmer Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1970年政变后成立的亲美政权，于1975年被红色高棉推翻。
description.en: A pro-American regime established after the 1970 coup, which was overthrown by the Khmer Rouge in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨的主要反对党，于2017年被最高法院解散。
description.en: The main opposition party in Cambodia, which was dissolved by the Supreme Court in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 前泰国首相，与洪森关系密切。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of Thailand, who has a close relationship with Hun Sen.

description.zh-cn: 东南亚地区的政府间组织，柬埔寨是其成员国之一。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization in Southeast Asia, of which Cambodia is a member state.

description.zh-cn: 指朝鲜民主主义人民共和国开发核武器而引发的国际外交和安全问题。
description.en: Refers to the international diplomatic and security issues arising from the Democratic People's Republic of Korea's development of nuclear weapons.

description.zh-cn: 美国与朝鲜于1994年签署的关于朝鲜核问题的协议，其未能得到执行导致了第二次朝核危机。
description.en: An agreement signed in 1994 between the United States and North Korea regarding the North Korean nuclear issue, the failure of which led to the second nuclear crisis.

en: Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons

description.zh-cn: 旨在防止核武器和武器技术扩散、促进和平利用核能的国际条约。
description.en: An international treaty whose objective is to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons and weapons technology, and to promote cooperation in the peaceful uses of nuclear energy.

description.zh-cn: 位于澳门的银行，因被美国指控为朝鲜洗钱而受到制裁，成为六方会谈的争议焦点之一。
description.en: A Macau-based bank that was sanctioned by the United States for alleged money laundering for North Korea, becoming a point of contention in the Six-Party Talks.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜首次进行的地下核试验，导致联合国安理会通过制裁决议。
description.en: North Korea's first underground nuclear test, which led to the adoption of a sanctions resolution by the UN Security Council.

zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会第1718号决议

description.zh-cn: 针对2006年朝鲜核试验通过的决议，对朝鲜实施了多项制裁。
description.en: A resolution adopted in response to the 2006 North Korean nuclear test, imposing various sanctions on North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统，其对朝鲜的强硬政策被认为是导致局势恶化的因素之一。
description.en: Former President of South Korea, whose hardline policy towards North Korea is considered a factor in the deterioration of the situation.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜于2009年发射的试验通信卫星，此次发射引发国际社会谴责，并直接导致朝鲜宣布退出六方会谈。
description.en: An experimental communications satellite launched by North Korea in 2009. The launch drew international condemnation and directly led to North Korea's announcement of its withdrawal from the Six-Party Talks.

description.zh-cn: 时任日本外相，于2018年宣布对六方会谈弃核失败的原委展开调查。
description.en: Then Foreign Minister of Japan, who announced in 2018 an investigation into the reasons for the failure of the Six-Party Talks to achieve denuclearization.

description.zh-cn: 金庸的第二任妻子，新闻工作者，协助金庸创办《明报》。
description.en: Jin Yong's second wife, a journalist who assisted him in founding Ming Pao.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人，于1993年从金庸手中购入明报集团。
description.en: A Hong Kong businessman who acquired the Ming Pao Group from Jin Yong in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国浙江省，是金庸的出生地。
description.en: Located in Zhejiang Province, China, it is the birthplace of Jin Yong.

description.zh-cn: 中国土家族诗人，中国共产党党员。曾任中国作家协会名誉委员，西藏自治区文学艺术界联合会、西藏自治区作家协会副主席。
description.en: A Chinese poet of the Tujia ethnic group and a member of the Communist Party of China. He formerly served as an honorary member of the China Writers Association, and vice-chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Federation of Literary and Art Circles and the Tibet Autonomous Region Writers Association.

en: Tibet Autonomous Region Federation of Literary and Art Circles
zh-cn: 西藏自治区文学艺术界联合会

description.zh-cn: 西藏自治区的文学艺术组织，汪承栋曾任其副主席。
description.en: A literary and art organization in the Tibet Autonomous Region, where Wang Chengdong served as vice-chairman.

zh-cn: 中央军事委员会审计署
en: Audit Office of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 中央军事委员会的审计监督机构，负责对军队及武警部队的经济活动进行审计监督。
description.en: The audit and supervision body of the Central Military Commission, responsible for auditing the economic activities of the military and armed police forces.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国商务部党组成员、副部长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, currently serving as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Commerce.

zh-cn: 阿布杜拉加克·阿布巴卡尔·简加拉尼

description.zh-cn: 阿布沙耶夫的创始人。曾是教师，在沙特学习伊斯兰神学，于利比亚接受军事训练，并参与过阿富汗的“圣战”。
description.en: Founder of Abu Sayyaf. He was a former teacher, studied Islamic theology in Saudi Arabia, received military training in Libya, and participated in the 'jihad' in Afghanistan.

description.zh-cn: 2000年4月23日，阿布沙耶夫在马来西亚西巴丹岛将21名多国游客劫持到菲律宾的事件。
description.en: An incident on April 23, 2000, where Abu Sayyaf kidnapped 21 multinational tourists from Sipadan Island, Malaysia, and took them to the Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 2017年5月23日，阿布沙耶夫与毛特组织占领菲律宾棉兰老岛马拉维地区的事件。
description.en: An event on May 23, 2017, where Abu Sayyaf and the Maute group occupied the Marawi area on Mindanao island, Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾的一个伊斯兰恐怖组织，与阿布沙耶夫结盟并共同参与了马拉维危机。
description.en: An Islamic terrorist group in the Philippines, allied with Abu Sayyaf and jointly participated in the Battle of Marawi.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾摩洛人分离主义组织，与阿布沙耶夫为敌对关系。
description.en: A Moro separatist organization in the Philippines, which is hostile to Abu Sayyaf.

description.zh-cn: 从摩洛民族解放阵线分裂出的摩洛人分离主义组织，与阿布沙耶夫为敌对关系。
description.en: A Moro separatist organization that split from the Moro National Liberation Front, and is hostile to Abu Sayyaf.

description.zh-cn: 在马来西亚沙巴州被阿布沙耶夫成员劫持并杀害的台湾游客。
description.en: A Taiwanese tourist who was kidnapped and killed by Abu Sayyaf members in Sabah, Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 2016年9月2日，阿布沙耶夫在菲律宾达沃市一夜市制造的炸弹爆炸事件，造成多人伤亡。
description.en: A bombing incident carried out by Abu Sayyaf at a night market in Davao City, Philippines on September 2, 2016, resulting in multiple casualties.

description.zh-cn: 付国豪大学毕业后曾在此工作。
description.en: A news website where Fu Guohao worked after graduating from university.

description.zh-cn: 2019年8月13日，付国豪在香港国际机场被反对逃犯条例修订草案运动的示威者捆绑围殴的事件。
description.en: On August 13, 2019, Fu Guohao was tied up and assaulted by protesters of the Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement at Hong Kong International Airport.

zh-cn: 中央研究院历史语言研究所

description.zh-cn: 中华民国中央研究院下属历史学、语言学、考古学、人类学学术研究机构。
description.en: An academic research institution for history, linguistics, archaeology, and anthropology under the Academia Sinica of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第一位状元，曾官至兵部尚书、武英殿大学士。
description.en: The first Zhuangyuan (top scholar) of the Qing Dynasty, who served as Minister of War and Grand Secretary of the Wuying Hall.

description.zh-cn: 发生于台湾大学和台湾省立师范学院的学生运动，遭到国民政府镇压。
description.en: A student movement at National Taiwan University and Taiwan Provincial Normal College that was suppressed by the Nationalist government.

description.zh-cn: 中国山东省的一个历史行政区划，傅斯年出生地。
description.en: A historical administrative division in Shandong Province, China, and the birthplace of Fu Ssu-nien.

description.zh-cn: 中国工程地质与灾害地质专家，长安大学教授。2019年当选为中国科学院院士。
description.en: An expert in engineering geology and disaster geology, a professor at Chang'an University. Elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖北省黄冈市下辖的县级市，是彭建兵的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Huanggang City, Hubei Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Peng Jianbing.

en: Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国设立的科学技术方面的最高学术称号，为终身荣誉。
description.en: The highest academic title in science and technology established by the People's Republic of China, a lifelong honor.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国军事人物，中国人民解放军少将，曾任陕西省军区政治委员、第八届全国人大代表。
description.en: A military figure of the People's Republic of China, a major general of the People's Liberation Army, former political commissar of the Shaanxi Military District, and a delegate to the 8th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Hunan Province.

en: Delegate to the 8th National People's Congress
zh-cn: 第八届全国人民代表大会代表名单

description.zh-cn: 在1993年至1998年期间，作为中华人民共和国最高国家权力机关成员的代表群体。
description.en: The group of representatives who were members of the highest state power organ of the People's Republic of China from 1993 to 1998.

description.zh-cn: 中国神话传说中“三皇五帝”的“三皇”，是夏朝以前的传说帝王。秦始皇在创造“皇帝”称号时，声称自己的德行兼备三皇。
description.en: The 'Three Sovereigns' of the 'Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors' in Chinese mythology, legendary rulers before the Xia Dynasty. When creating the title 'Emperor', Qin Shi Huang claimed his virtues encompassed those of the Three Sovereigns.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国的统治者。其头衔如“Imperator”和“Caesar”是西方“皇帝”一词的词源，近代汉语中的“皇帝”也用以对译这些称号。
description.en: The rulers of the Roman Empire. Their titles, such as 'Imperator' and 'Caesar', are the etymological sources of the Western word 'Emperor', and the modern Chinese term '皇帝' is used to translate these titles.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国分裂后的东部帝国，其君主一直自视为罗马皇帝的合法继承者，直到1453年被奥斯曼帝国所灭。
description.en: The eastern part of the Roman Empire after its division, whose monarchs always considered themselves the legitimate successors of the Roman emperors until its conquest by the Ottoman Empire in 1453.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕府时期的实际军事和政治统治者，其权力在天皇之上，使天皇成为名义上的君主。
description.en: The de facto military and political ruler of Japan during the shogunate period, whose authority surpassed that of the Emperor, reducing the Emperor to a nominal monarch.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代末期，德川幕府第15代将军德川庆喜将政权交还给明治天皇的政治事件，标志着幕府统治的结束和天皇权力的复兴。
description.en: A political event in the late Edo period of Japan where the 15th Shogun of the Tokugawa Shogunate, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, returned political power to Emperor Meiji, marking the end of the shogunate's rule and the revival of imperial authority.

description.zh-cn: 中国帝制时期中央政权的最高统治者，自秦始皇始，至1912年溥仪退位终。
description.en: The supreme ruler of the central government during China's imperial period, from the first emperor Qin Shi Huang until the abdication of Puyi in 1912.

description.zh-cn: 英国君主在印度殖民统治时期使用的头衔，始于维多利亚女王，终于乔治六世，因印度独立而废除。
description.en: A title used by the British monarch during the colonial rule of India, starting with Queen Victoria and ending with George VI, abolished upon India's independence.

description.zh-cn: 大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国女王，1877年加冕为首任印度女皇。她批准了《南京条约》。
description.en: Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, crowned as the first Empress of India in 1877. She approved the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 拜占庭帝国女皇帝，通过废黜其子君士坦丁六世而掌权。她的统治被西欧视为皇位空缺，成为教宗为查理曼加冕的理由之一。
description.en: Byzantine empress who came to power by deposing her son Constantine VI. Her rule was seen in Western Europe as a vacancy on the imperial throne, providing one of the justifications for the Pope to crown Charlemagne.

description.zh-cn: 拜占庭皇帝，被其母伊琳娜废黜并致盲。
description.en: Byzantine emperor, who was deposed and blinded by his mother, Irene.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的前任广东省政协主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's predecessor as Chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的后任广东省常务副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's successor as Executive Vice Governor of Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的后任北京市常务副市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's successor as Executive Vice Mayor of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的前任北京市委教育工委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Kqing's predecessor as Secretary of the Education Work Committee of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的后任北京市委教育工委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's successor as Secretary of the Education Work Committee of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的前任中共北京市大兴区委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's predecessor as Secretary of the CPC Beijing Daxing District Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的后任中共北京市大兴区委书记及北京市大兴区人民政府区长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's successor as Secretary of the CPC Beijing Daxing District Committee and as Mayor of the Daxing District People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，林克庆的前任北京市大兴区人民政府区长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Lin Keqing's predecessor as Mayor of the Daxing District People's Government in Beijing.

death_place.zh-cn: 上海市长宁区江苏路284弄安定坊5号
death_place.en: No. 5, Anding Fang, Lane 284, Jiangsu Road, Changning District, Shanghai

description.zh-cn: 傅雷的妻子，在文化大革命期间与丈夫一同遭受迫害，并共同自缢身亡。
description.en: Wife of Fu Lei, she was persecuted alongside her husband during the Cultural Revolution and they committed suicide together.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷的长子，世界著名的钢琴家。1958年在波兰留学期间移居英国，此举在当时被中国大陆视为叛逃，给其父傅雷带来了巨大的政治压力。
description.en: The elder son of Fu Lei, a world-renowned pianist. He moved to the United Kingdom in 1958 while studying in Poland, an act that was considered defection by mainland China at the time and brought immense political pressure on his father, Fu Lei.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷的次子，英语教师。其整理并出版的《傅雷家书》产生了深远的社会影响。
description.en: The younger son of Fu Lei, an English teacher. He compiled and published 'Fu Lei's Family Letters', which has had a profound social impact.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷与其子傅聪、傅敏的往来家信，后由傅敏整理出版，内容体现了傅雷对儿子的严格教育与深厚父爱，影响深远。
description.en: A collection of correspondence between Fu Lei and his sons Fu Cong and Fu Min. Later compiled and published by Fu Min, the letters reflect Fu Lei's strict upbringing and deep paternal love, and have had a lasting impact.

description.zh-cn: 法国著名作家，傅雷在巴黎留学时深受其影响，并翻译了他的多部著作，如《约翰·克里斯朵夫》。
description.en: A famous French writer who greatly influenced Fu Lei during his studies in Paris. Fu Lei translated many of his works, such as 'Jean-Christophe'.

description.zh-cn: 法国著名作家，傅雷翻译了他的多部名著，如《高老头》和《欧也妮·葛朗台》。
description.en: A famous French writer. Fu Lei translated many of his masterpieces, such as 'Père Goriot' and 'Eugénie Grandet'.

description.zh-cn: 法国作家罗曼·罗兰创作的长篇小说，由傅雷翻译成中文，是其重要的翻译作品之一。
description.en: A novel by French writer Romain Rolland, translated into Chinese by Fu Lei, which is one of his most important translated works.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海的一所艺术学校，傅雷于1931年回国后在此任教，担任办公室主任并教授美术史和法文。
description.en: An art school in Shanghai where Fu Lei taught after returning to China in 1931, serving as the office director and teaching art history and French.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西共和国派驻中华人民共和国的外交代表机构。于2009年设立了“傅雷翻译出版奖”。
description.en: The diplomatic mission of the French Republic to the People's Republic of China. It established the 'Fu Lei Translation and Publishing Award' in 2009.

en: Fu Lei Translation and Publishing Award

description.zh-cn: 由法国驻华大使馆设立的奖项，旨在促进法语文学在中国的翻译和传播，因纪念翻译家傅雷而得名。
description.en: An award established by the French Embassy in China to promote the translation and dissemination of French literature in China, named in memory of the translator Fu Lei.

zh-cn: 中华民国抗日战争时期国立中学
黑龙江省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在俄国二月革命后成立，取代沙皇专制政府的临时政权，后在十月革命中被推翻。
description.en: The provisional government established after the February Revolution in Russia to replace the tsarist autocracy, which was later overthrown in the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1917年俄国革命期间在彼得格勒成立的工人和士兵代表苏维埃，在十月革命中发挥了核心作用。
description.en: A soviet of workers' and soldiers' deputies established in Petrograd during the Russian Revolution of 1917, which played a central role in the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 统治俄罗斯帝国的最后一个王朝，在1917年二月革命中被推翻。
description.en: The last imperial dynasty to rule Russia, overthrown in the February Revolution of 1917.

en: Military Revolutionary Committee of the Petrograd Soviet
zh-cn: 彼得格勒军事革命委员会

description.zh-cn: 由彼得格勒苏维埃建立的军事机构，在托洛茨基领导下，是十月革命武装起义的实际组织和指挥中心。
description.en: A military body established by the Petrograd Soviet, which, under the leadership of Trotsky, was the de facto organizing and command center of the armed uprising in the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 俄国内战期间，反对布尔什维克政权的各种松散政治军事力量的统称。其残余部队曾于中东路事件中协助中华民国作战。
description.en: A collective term for the various loose anti-communist political and military forces that opposed the Bolshevik regime during the Russian Civil War. Remnant forces later assisted the Republic of China in the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929.

description.zh-cn: 1917年7月在彼得格勒发生的大规模反政府示威，虽然被临时政府镇压，但加剧了政治危机。
description.en: A period of large-scale anti-government demonstrations in Petrograd in July 1917, which, although suppressed by the Provisional Government, exacerbated the political crisis.

description.zh-cn: 俄军总司令拉夫尔·科尔尼洛夫将军试图发动政变，但以失败告终。此事件削弱了临时政府，增强了布尔什维克的势力。
description.en: An attempted coup by the Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Army, General Lavr Kornilov, which ultimately failed. The event weakened the Provisional Government and strengthened the Bolsheviks.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国将军，曾任俄军总司令，在1917年发动了未遂的科尔尼洛夫事件。
description.en: A general in the Imperial Russian Army, who served as Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Army and launched the unsuccessful Kornilov affair in 1917.

description.zh-cn: 1917年选举产生的俄罗斯制宪机构，在1918年1月召开后不久即被布尔什维克政府强行解散。
description.en: A constitutional body elected in 1917 to form a constitution for Russia, which was forcibly dissolved by the Bolshevik government shortly after it convened in January 1918.

zh-cn: 全俄肃清反革命及怠工非常委员会

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃俄国成立的第一个国家安全机构，以执行红色恐怖和镇压反革命活动而闻名。
description.en: The first state security organization of Soviet Russia, known for implementing the Red Terror and suppressing counter-revolutionary activities.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯海军上将、极地探险家，俄国内战期间白军运动的领导人之一，自称俄罗斯最高统治者。
description.en: A Russian naval admiral, polar explorer, and one of the leaders of the White movement during the Russian Civil War, who proclaimed himself the Supreme Ruler of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 俄国作家和社会主义现实主义文学的创始人，曾对布尔什维克解散立宪会议的行为提出批评。
description.en: A Russian writer and founder of socialist realism literature, who criticized the Bolsheviks for dissolving the Constituent Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯波罗的海舰队的巡洋舰，其在十月革命期间向冬宫发射空炮，被视为革命开始的信号。
description.en: A cruiser of the Russian Baltic Fleet, whose blank shot fired at the Winter Palace during the October Revolution is considered the signal for the start of the revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家语言文字工作委员会党组成员、纪检组长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, who served as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Discipline Inspection Team Leader of the State Language Work Committee.

description.zh-cn: 国际武打巨星李小龙的弟弟，森森的前夫。
description.en: The younger brother of international martial arts superstar Bruce Lee and the ex-husband of Sum Sum.

description.zh-cn: 香港艺人，森森的胞妹。
description.en: A Hong Kong artist and the younger sister of Sum Sum.

description.zh-cn: 森森与前夫李振辉的儿子。
description.en: The son of Sum Sum and her ex-husband Robert Lee.

description.zh-cn: 由丽的映声于1966年开办的第一届艺员训练班。
description.en: The first artist training class launched by Rediffusion Television in 1966.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手，与森森同为丽的映声第一届艺员训练班的毕业生。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer and a fellow graduate with Sum Sum from the first Rediffusion Television artist training class.

description.zh-cn: 香港艺人，“四乐士”乐队成员之一。
description.en: A Hong Kong artist and a member of the band 'The Four Lads'.

description.zh-cn: 香港演员，曾与森森及斑斑有过恋情。
description.en: A Hong Kong actor who was romantically involved with both Sum Sum and Ban Ban.

description.zh-cn: 香港艺人，是森森的好友，并撮合了森森与王宗德的婚姻。
description.en: A Hong Kong artist, a good friend of Sum Sum, who acted as a matchmaker for her marriage to Wang Zongde.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治思想家，因撰写《出身论》挑战血统论而在文革期间被迫害。戚本禹曾宣布《出身论》为“大毒草”。
description.en: A Chinese political thinker persecuted during the Cultural Revolution for writing 'On Family Background' which challenged the theory of bloodline. Qi Benyu declared 'On Family Background' a 'great poisonous weed'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东的私人医生，著有《毛泽东私人医生回忆录》，该书后来受到戚本禹的批判。
description.en: Mao Zedong's personal physician, author of 'The Private Life of Chairman Mao', which was later criticized by Qi Benyu.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海市的大型公共图书馆。戚本禹出狱后曾在此担任图书管理员直至退休。
description.en: A large public library located in Shanghai. After his release from prison, Qi Benyu worked here as a librarian until his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 位于香港的出版社，出版了《戚本禹回忆录》。
description.en: A publishing house based in Hong Kong that published 'Memoirs of Qi Benyu'.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的一个行政区，是戚本禹的出生地。
description.en: An administrative region during the Republic of China period, and the birthplace of Qi Benyu.

description.zh-cn: 由遇罗克撰写的挑战血统论的文章。1967年被戚本禹宣布为“大毒草”。
description.en: An article written by Yu Luoke challenging the theory of bloodline. It was declared a 'great poisonous weed' by Qi Benyu in 1967.

en: The Private Life of Chairman Mao
zh-cn: 毛泽东私人医生回忆录

description.zh-cn: 由毛泽东前私人医生李志绥撰写的回忆录。戚本禹曾撰文批判此书。
description.en: A memoir written by Mao Zedong's former personal physician, Li Zhisui. Qi Benyu wrote articles criticizing this book.

description.zh-cn: 戚本禹本人的回忆录，于其去世同月在香港出版。
description.en: The memoir of Qi Benyu himself, published in Hong Kong in the same month as his death.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国军事人物，中国人民解放军少将。曾任中华人民共和国化学工业部政治部主任，中国科学院行政管理局党委书记、局长。
description.en: A military figure of the People's Republic of China and a major general of the People's Liberation Army. He served as the Director of the Political Department of the Ministry of Chemical Industry and as the Party Secretary and Director of the Administrative Bureau of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

en: Administrative Bureau of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院的下属行政管理机构。
description.en: The subordinate administrative body of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队浙江省总队

description.zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队的省级总队，是副军级单位，隶属于武警总部。其主要执行治安维持、民防警卫、处突维稳等任务。
description.en: A provincial corps of the People's Armed Police, it is a deputy corps-level unit subordinate to the PAP Headquarters. Its main tasks include maintaining public order, civil defense, and stability maintenance.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队浙江省总队政治委员，武警大校警衔。
description.en: Political Commissar of the People's Armed Police Zhejiang Provincial Corps, holding the rank of PAP Senior Colonel.

en: Zhejiang Provincial Department of Public Security

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民政府下设主管全省公安工作的职能部门。
description.en: The functional department of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Government responsible for public security work throughout the province.

description.en: Chinese politician.

description.zh-cn: 北洋水师将领，致远号巡洋舰管带。在1894年黄海海战中，率舰冲向敌舰时，不幸被鱼雷击中，与全舰官兵一同壮烈殉国。
description.en: An officer of the Beiyang Fleet and captain of the cruiser Zhiyuan. In the Battle of the Yalu River in 1894, he was killed in action along with his crew when his ship was struck by a torpedo while charging at an enemy vessel.

description.zh-cn: 北洋水师将领，经远号装甲巡洋舰管带。在1894年黄海海战中阵亡。
description.en: An officer of the Beiyang Fleet and captain of the armored cruiser Jingyuan. He was killed in action during the Battle of the Yalu River in 1894.

description.zh-cn: 位于福州的中国近代第一所海军学校，为北洋水师培养了大量核心指挥官。
description.en: Located in Fuzhou, it was the first modern naval academy in China and trained a large number of core commanders for the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 北洋水师右翼总兵，定远号管带。在威海卫之战中自尽。
description.en: Right Wing Commander of the Beiyang Fleet and captain of the Dingyuan. He committed suicide during the Battle of Weihaiwei.

description.zh-cn: 北洋水师中军左副将，济远号管带。在黄海海战中被指控临阵脱逃而被处死。
description.en: An officer of the Beiyang Fleet and captain of the Jiyuan. He was executed for allegedly deserting during the Battle of the Yalu River.

zh-cn: 格林威治皇家海军学院
皇家海军学院 (格林威治)

description.zh-cn: 英国皇家海军的一所历史悠久的军官培训机构，多位北洋水师高级军官曾在此留学或实习。
description.en: A historic officer training establishment of the Royal Navy in the United Kingdom, where several senior officers of the Beiyang Fleet studied or interned.

description.zh-cn: 北洋水师中军右副将，靖远号管带。甲午战后参与海军重建工作。
description.en: An officer of the Beiyang Fleet and captain of the Jingyuan. He participated in the reconstruction of the navy after the First Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 清朝建立的四支现代化海军之一，1909年并入巡洋舰队和巡江舰队。
description.en: One of the four modern fleets established by the Qing dynasty, merged into the Cruiser Fleet and River Patrol Fleet in 1909.

description.zh-cn: 清朝建立的四支现代化海军之一，1909年并入巡洋舰队和巡江舰队。
description.en: One of the four modern fleets established by the Qing dynasty, merged into the Cruiser Fleet and River Patrol Fleet in 1909.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国山东省日照市下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Rizhao City, Shandong Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省的国家法律监督机关。
description.en: The state's legal supervisory organ in Shandong Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任青岛市市长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former mayor of Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任青岛市市长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former mayor of Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 孙立人的旧部属。1955年，他被指控为匪谍并预谋发动兵变，此案即“郭廷亮匪谍案”，并直接引爆了“孙立人兵变案”，导致孙立人被长期软禁。
description.en: A former subordinate of Sun Li-jen. In 1955, he was accused of being a Communist spy and plotting a mutiny. This case, known as the 'Guo Tingliang spy case,' directly triggered the 'Sun Li-jen incident,' leading to Sun's long-term house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 美国军事家、政治家。其在国共内战期间的调停导致国军在东北停止追击，阻止了孙立人部队攻取哈尔滨。
description.en: An American soldier and statesman. His mediation during the Chinese Civil War led to a ceasefire in the Northeast, halting the advance of Sun Li-jen's troops on Harbin.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将。在蒋经国逝世后，时任国防部长的他下令解除了对孙立人长达33年的软禁。
description.en: A four-star general of the Republic of China Army. After the death of Chiang Ching-kuo, as Minister of National Defense, he ordered the lifting of Sun Li-jen's 33-year-long house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 孙立人之父，清末举人，曾任山东高等审判厅厅长等职。
description.en: Father of Sun Li-jen, a Juren in the late Qing Dynasty, who served as the president of the Shandong High Court.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战缅甸战役中的一场战斗。孙立人率领的中国远征军新三十八师以不足一团的兵力，击溃数倍于己的日军，成功解救了被围的七千余名英军，此役为孙立人赢得国际声誉。
description.en: A battle during the Burma Campaign of World War II. The New 38th Division of the Chinese Expeditionary Force, led by Sun Li-jen, with less than a regiment, defeated a numerically superior Japanese force and successfully rescued over 7,000 besieged British troops, earning Sun international acclaim.

zh-cn: 国民革命军陆军新编第一军
国民革命军新编第一军

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军在第二次中日战争末期和第二次国共内战时期的一支主力部队，由中国驻印军改编而成，孙立人曾长期担任该军军长。
description.en: A main force of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China during the late Second Sino-Japanese War and the Chinese Civil War. It was reorganized from the Chinese Army in India, and Sun Li-jen served as its commander for a long period.

zh-cn: 国民革命军陆军新编第三十八师

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民革命军的一支部队，前身为财政部缉私总队。在孙立人担任师长期间，于缅甸战场屡建奇功，尤其以仁安羌大捷闻名。
description.en: A unit of the National Revolutionary Army of the Republic of China, formerly the Salt Gabelle's armed force. Under the command of Sun Li-jen, it achieved remarkable successes on the Burma battlefield, especially famous for the victory at Yenangyaung.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国的公立大学。孙立人于1925年获得该校土木工程学士学位。
description.en: A public university in the United States. Sun Li-jen obtained a bachelor's degree in civil engineering from this university in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国的著名军事院校。孙立人于1927年获得该校文学士学位。
description.en: A renowned military college in the United States. Sun Li-jen obtained a Bachelor of Arts degree from this institute in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 中国新闻工作者，现任中华全国新闻工作者协会党组书记、副主席，曾任新华通讯社副社长、党组成员。
description.en: Chinese journalist, current Party Group Secretary and Vice Chairman of the All-China Journalists Association, and former Vice President and Party Group member of Xinhua News Agency.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华全国新闻工作者协会党组书记。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former Party Group Secretary of the All-China Journalists Association.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一所新闻专业高等教育机构。
description.en: An institution of higher education for journalism in China.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄睿皇后之父，官至中军都督府都督同知。
description.en: Father of Empress Xiaozhuangrui, who served as a commander-in-chief in the Chief Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 孝庄睿皇后之祖父，官至指挥使。
description.en: Grandfather of Empress Xiaozhuangrui, who served as a commander.

description.zh-cn: 明十三陵之一，是明英宗朱祁镇和孝庄睿皇后、孝肃皇后的合葬陵寝。
description.en: One of the Ming Tombs, the joint mausoleum of Emperor Yingzong Zhu Qizhen, Empress Xiaozhuangrui, and Empress Xiaosu.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗之子，明宪宗的异母弟，称受过钱太后的“抚育深恩”。
description.en: A son of Emperor Yingzong and half-brother of Emperor Xianzong, who claimed to have received 'deep nurturing grace' from Empress Dowager Qian.

description.zh-cn: 今江苏省连云港市，为孝庄睿皇后的出身地。
description.en: Modern-day Lianyungang, Jiangsu Province, the birthplace of Empress Xiaozhuangrui.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的最高军事机构之一。
description.en: One of the highest military bodies in the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国傈僳族政治人物。曾任中共怒江傈僳族自治州委书记、云南省人民政府副省长、党组成员。现任中共海南省委常委，组织部部长，兼省委教育工委书记。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Lisu ethnicity. He has served as Secretary of the CPC Nujiang Lisu Autonomous Prefecture Committee, and Vice Governor of Yunnan Province. He is currently a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee, Head of the Organization Department, and concurrently Secretary of the Education Work Committee of the Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 云南省楚雄彝族自治州下辖的县，纳云德的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Chuxiong Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, and the birthplace of Na Yunde.

description.zh-cn: 南宋抗金女将，韩世忠之妻。曾在黄天荡之战中亲自擂鼓助战，传为佳话。
description.en: A female general of the Southern Song dynasty and wife of Han Shizhong, famous for beating a war drum to direct the army during the Battle of Huangtiandang.

description.zh-cn: 南宋将领，与刘正彦共同发动苗刘兵变，后被韩世忠等将领平定。
description.en: A Southern Song general who, along with Liu Zhengyan, launched the Miao-Liu Mutiny, which was later suppressed by generals including Han Shizhong.

description.zh-cn: 南宋将领，与苗傅共同发动苗刘兵变，后被韩世忠擒获。
description.en: A Southern Song general who, along with Miao Fu, launched the Miao-Liu Mutiny. He was later captured by Han Shizhong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋末年农民起义领袖，其起义被宋军镇压，方腊本人被韩世忠擒获。
description.en: Leader of a peasant uprising during the late Northern Song dynasty. His rebellion was suppressed by the Song army, and he was personally captured by Han Shizhong.

description.zh-cn: 南宋与金朝之间的一场著名战役。韩世忠率领八千宋军在黄天荡围困金兀术的十万大军长达四十八天。
description.en: A famous battle between the Southern Song and Jin dynasties. Han Shizhong led 8,000 Song troops to besiege Jin Wuzhu's 100,000-strong army at Huangtiandang for 48 days.

description.zh-cn: 中国陕西省下辖的一个县，是韩世忠和张汉夫的出生地。
description.en: A county in Shaanxi Province, China, and the birthplace of Han Shizhong and Zhang Hanfu.

description.zh-cn: 在马克思主义内部，指对卡尔·马克思提出的一系列理论做出“修正”的一种思潮和流派，通常被正统马克思主义者认为违背了基本原则。
description.en: Within Marxism, refers to a trend of thought and school that 'revises' the theories proposed by Karl Marx, often considered by orthodox Marxists as a betrayal of fundamental principles.

description.zh-cn: 德国修正主义理论家，德国社会民主党领袖，第一批修正马克思主义基本原则的社会主义者。
description.en: German revisionist theorist, leader of the Social Democratic Party of Germany, and one of the first socialists to revise the fundamental principles of Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 苏联与南斯拉夫之间的冲突，期间苏联共产党指责南斯拉夫为“现代修正主义”。
description.en: A conflict between the Soviet Union and Yugoslavia, during which the Communist Party of the Soviet Union accused Yugoslavia of 'modern revisionism'.

description.zh-cn: 前美国共产党总书记，因宣扬“进步资本主义”思想（白劳德主义）并解散美国共产党而被开除出党。
description.en: Former General Secretary of the Communist Party USA, who was expelled for promoting the idea of 'progressive capitalism' (Browderism) and dissolving the party.

description.zh-cn: 美国共产党领导人，激烈反对白劳德主义，并领导重建了美国共产党。
description.en: A leader of the Communist Party USA, who vehemently opposed Browderism and led the re-establishment of the party.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国海关总署设在天津的直属海关。
description.en: A directly subordinate customs office of the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China located in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国重庆市下的一个市辖区。
description.en: A district under the jurisdiction of Chongqing, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国四川省成都市的大学。
description.en: A university located in Chengdu, Sichuan, China.

zh-cn: 四川省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 四川省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The permanent body of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，王少雄的前任中共四川省委宣传部部长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, Wang Shaoxiong's predecessor as Minister of the Propaganda Department of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，曾任南京兵部尚书，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as the Minister of War in Nanjing. He died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，曾任南京光禄寺卿，在嘉靖大地震中与妻子一同遇难。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as the Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments in Nanjing. He and his wife died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝郎中，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: A Bureau Director (Langzhong) of the Ming dynasty who died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝员外，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: A Bureau Vice Director (Yuanwai) of the Ming dynasty who died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝主事，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: A Section Chief (Zhushi) of the Ming dynasty who died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝进士，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: A Jinshi degree holder of the Ming dynasty who died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝御史，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: An Investigating Censor (Yushi) of the Ming dynasty who died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，曾任南京国子监祭酒，在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty who served as the Chancellor of the National University in Nanjing. He died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 位于陕西省西安市的唐代佛塔，在嘉靖大地震中受损。
description.en: A Buddhist pagoda from the Tang dynasty located in Xi'an, Shaanxi, which was damaged during the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 唐高宗李治与武则天的合葬陵墓，其陵园在嘉靖大地震中被完全毁掉。
description.en: The joint tomb of Emperor Gaozong of Tang and his wife Wu Zetian. Its mausoleum park was completely destroyed in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 黄河的最大支流。嘉靖大地震曾导致其河道向北移动约五公里。此外，著名的郑国渠引泾水最终也注入该河流。
description.en: The largest tributary of the Yellow River. The Jiajing Great Earthquake once caused its course to shift about five kilometers northward. Additionally, the water diverted by the famous Zheng Guo Canal from the Jing River eventually flows into this river.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，时任户部左侍郎，在嘉靖大地震后被朝廷派往灾区赈灾。
description.en: An official of the Ming dynasty serving as the Left Vice Minister of Revenue, who was dispatched by the imperial court to the disaster area for relief efforts after the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝人物，作为嘉靖大地震的亲历者，留下了关于地震的详细文字记录。
description.en: A figure from the Ming dynasty who, as an eyewitness to the Jiajing Great Earthquake, left detailed written records of the event.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗的妾室，唐代宗的生母。
description.en: A concubine of Emperor Suzong and the birth mother of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝皇帝，唐代宗的长子和继任者。
description.en: Emperor of the Tang Dynasty, the eldest son and successor of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宗室，曾被吐蕃在占领长安期间立为皇帝。
description.en: A member of the Tang imperial clan who was installed as emperor by the Tibetan Empire during their occupation of Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗时期的宰相，信奉佛教。
description.en: A chancellor during the reign of Emperor Daizong, who was also a Buddhist.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗时期的宰相，笃信佛教。
description.en: A chancellor during the reign of Emperor Daizong, who was a devout Buddhist.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗时期的宰相，信奉佛教。
description.en: A chancellor during the reign of Emperor Daizong, who was also a Buddhist.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗的贵妃，生韩王李迥、华阳公主，深受代宗专宠。死后追谥为贞懿皇后。
description.en: A Noble Consort of Emperor Daizong, mother of Prince Li Jiong and Princess Huayang. She was deeply favored by the emperor and was posthumously honored as Empress Zhenyi.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗的妾室，唐德宗的生母。在安史之乱中失踪，后被遥尊为皇太后，追谥睿真皇后。
description.en: A concubine of Emperor Daizong and the mother of Emperor Dezong. She went missing during the An Lushan Rebellion and was later honored in absentia as Empress Dowager and posthumously as Empress Ruizhen.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗为广平郡王时的元配嫡妻，生郑王李邈、召王李偲。
description.en: The primary consort of Emperor Daizong when he was the Prince of Guangping. She was the mother of Prince Li Miao and Prince Li Si.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗之子，封韩王。
description.en: Son of Emperor Daizong, titled Prince of Han.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗第五女，后出家为道士。
description.en: The fifth daughter of Emperor Daizong, who later became a Daoist priestess.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗次子，封郑王，后追赠为昭靖太子。
description.en: The second son of Emperor Daizong, titled Prince of Zheng, and later posthumously honored as Crown Prince Zhaojing.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗的贵妃，升平公主的生母。
description.en: A Noble Consort of Emperor Daizong, mother of Princess Shengping.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗之女，下嫁郭暧。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Daizong, married to Guo Ai.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝将领郭子仪之子，娶唐代宗女升平公主为妻。
description.en: Son of the Tang general Guo Ziyi, married Princess Shengping, daughter of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗之子，后被唐肃宗养为子。
description.en: Son of Emperor Daizong, who was later adopted by Emperor Suzong.

location.zh-cn: 北京市西城区阜外大街45号院
location.en: No. 45 Fuwai Street, Xicheng District, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 根据国家国土资源调查规划，负责开展地质矿产勘探等工作的国务院部委管理的事业单位，由中华人民共和国自然资源部管理。
description.en: A public institution managed by a ministry-level department of the State Council, responsible for geological and mineral exploration according to national land and resource survey plans, managed by the Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期的国家地质调查机构，是中国地质调查局的前身之一。
description.en: The national geological survey agency during the period of the Republic of China on the mainland, one of the predecessors of the China Geological Survey.

zh-cn: 中国地质工作计划指导委员会

description.zh-cn: 英国工党政治人物，现任英国副首相。
description.en: A British Labour politician serving as Deputy Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 英国工党政治人物，现任外交、联邦和发展事务大臣。
description.en: A British Labour politician serving as Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 英国工党的最高领导人职位。
description.en: The most senior politician within the Labour Party in the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，基尔·斯塔默的前任工党党魁。
description.en: A British politician who was Keir Starmer's predecessor as Leader of the Labour Party.

description.zh-cn: 领导英国官方反对党的政治家职位。
description.en: The politician who leads the Official Opposition in the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 英国保守党政治人物，前任英国首相。
description.en: A British Conservative politician who previously served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 英国保守党政治人物，前任英国首相。
description.en: A British Conservative politician who previously served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

en: Member of Parliament of the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 在英国下议院代表选民的人。
description.en: A person who represents their constituents in the House of Commons of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 英国工党政治人物、律师，曾任英格兰及威尔斯检察总长。
description.en: A British Labour politician and lawyer who served as Attorney General for England and Wales.

description.zh-cn: 英国伦敦市中心的一个地区。
description.en: A district of Central London, England.

description.zh-cn: 这是一所位于英国利兹的公立研究型大学。著名艺人张国荣曾在此攻读纺织系，后因父亲中风而辍学。
description.en: This is a public research university located in Leeds, United Kingdom. The renowned artist Leslie Cheung once studied textile management here before dropping out due to his father's stroke.

zh-cn: 牛津大学圣艾德蒙学堂

description.zh-cn: 牛津大学的一个组成学院。
description.en: A constituent college of the University of Oxford.

description.zh-cn: 2024年7月4日举行的一次英国下议院选举，工党在这次选举中取得压倒性胜利。
description.en: An election for the UK House of Commons held on 4 July 2024, which resulted in a landslide victory for the Labour Party.

description.zh-cn: 英国工党第一任党魁，基尔·斯塔默的名字来源。
description.en: The first parliamentary leader of the Labour Party, and the namesake of Keir Starmer.

description.zh-cn: 英国音乐家，基尔·斯塔默的同学。
description.en: A British musician who was a schoolmate of Keir Starmer.

description.zh-cn: 一本激进杂志，基尔·斯塔默曾担任其编辑。
description.en: A radical magazine for which Keir Starmer served as an editor.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰和威尔士的主要公共检察机关。
description.en: The principal public prosecuting agency for conducting criminal prosecutions in England and Wales.

description.zh-cn: 英国的一个自由主义政党。
description.en: A liberal political party in the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 英国保守党政治人物。
description.en: A British Conservative politician.

description.zh-cn: 2011年8月在英国发生的一系列骚乱、抢劫和纵火事件。
description.en: A series of riots, looting, and arson that occurred in England in August 2011.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，曾因妨碍司法公正罪被起诉。
description.en: A British politician who was prosecuted for perverting the course of justice.

zh-cn: 吉米·萨维尔性虐待丑闻

description.zh-cn: 关于英国电视名人吉米·萨维尔性虐待行为的公众丑闻。
description.en: A public scandal concerning the sexual abuse committed by British television personality Jimmy Savile.

description.zh-cn: 英国工党政治人物，现任大曼彻斯特市长。
description.en: A British Labour politician serving as the Mayor of Greater Manchester.

description.zh-cn: 一系列关于在2019冠状病毒病疫情封锁期间英国政府官员举办派对的政治丑闻。
description.en: A series of political scandals about parties held by UK government officials during COVID-19 lockdowns.

description.zh-cn: 由鲍里斯·约翰逊领导的英国政府。
description.en: The government of the United Kingdom led by Boris Johnson.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大政治人物，第23任加拿大总理。
description.en: A Canadian politician serving as the 23rd Prime Minister of Canada.

description.zh-cn: 一项将寻求庇护者送往卢旺达处理其申请的英国移民政策。
description.en: A UK immigration policy to send asylum seekers to Rwanda to have their claims processed.
