description.en: The XIII Olympic Winter Games, held in Lake Placid, United States.

description.zh-cn: 在南斯拉夫萨拉热窝举办的第十四届冬季奥林匹克运动会。
description.en: The XIV Olympic Winter Games, held in Sarajevo, Yugoslavia.

description.zh-cn: 台湾人权律师与政治人物，时代力量的创党人之一，曾任党主席及立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese human rights lawyer and politician, one of the founders of the New Power Party. He has served as party chairman and legislator.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第九届立法委员选举。时代力量在此次选举中首次参选即获得5个席次，成为国会第三大党。
description.en: The 9th legislative election in the Republic of China. The New Power Party won 5 seats in its first-ever participation, becoming the third-largest party in the legislature.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第十届立法委员选举。在此次选举中，时代力量席次降至3席，退居国会第四大党；蔡壁如当选为不分区立法委员。
description.en: The 10th legislative election in the Republic of China. In this election, the New Power Party's seats were reduced to 3, making it the fourth-largest party in the legislature; Tsai Pi-ru was elected as a legislator-at-large.

zh-cn: 2022年中华民国地方公职人员选举

description.zh-cn: 时代力量在此次地方选举中遭遇重大挫败，议员席次大幅减少。
description.en: The New Power Party suffered a major setback in these local elections, with a significant reduction in the number of councilor seats.

description.zh-cn: 指自2019年起，时代力量因内部路线分歧、领导风格争议等问题，导致多位创党成员和民选公职人员陆续退党的系列事件，严重影响了该党的政治实力与社会形象。
description.en: Refers to a series of events starting in 2019 where the New Power Party faced the successive departures of several founding members and elected officials due to internal disagreements on political direction, leadership style, and other issues. This crisis severely impacted the party's political strength and public image.

description.zh-cn: 洪仲丘事件当事人洪仲丘的姐姐，时代力量创党时期的重要成员及前立法委员，后于2019年退出时代力量。
description.en: The sister of Hung Chung-chiu, the victim in the Hung Chung-chiu incident. She was a key member of the New Power Party during its founding period and a former legislator, who later left the party in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治学者与政治人物，曾任时代力量党主席及立法委员，后因卷入SOGO经营权收贿案于2020年退出时代力量。
description.en: A Taiwanese political scientist and politician who served as chairman and legislator for the New Power Party. He left the party in 2020 after being implicated in the SOGO bribery case.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，其在1497年派遣的探险队标志着大英帝国海外扩张的开端。
description.en: King of England, whose commissioning of an expedition in 1497 marked the beginning of the British Empire's overseas expansion.

description.zh-cn: 意大利航海家，受英格兰国王亨利七世委托，于1497年抵达北美洲，其航行为大英帝国的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: An Italian navigator who, under the commission of King Henry VII of England, reached North America in 1497, laying the groundwork for the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 英国在北美洲的殖民地，通过美国独立战争脱离英国统治，成为美国的基础。
description.en: British colonies in North America that separated from British rule through the American Revolutionary War and formed the basis of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 北元皇帝，元天元帝。1388年被阿里不哥后裔也速迭尔杀害，北元亡。
description.en: An emperor of the Northern Yuan, also known as Uskhal Khan. He was killed in 1388 by Yesüder, a descendant of Ariq Böke, leading to the fall of the Northern Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥的后裔，被认为是北元时期的卓里克图汗。他于1388年杀害北元皇帝脱古思帖木儿（天元帝），篡夺汗位并废除大元国号。
description.en: A descendant of Ariq Böke, believed to be Zorigthu Khan of the Northern Yuan. He assassinated the Northern Yuan emperor Tögüs Temür in 1388, usurped the throne, and abolished the 'Great Yuan' state title.

description.zh-cn: 一部最初在“超级大本营”论坛连载的中国网络漫画，后被改编为动画。作品以动物拟人化的方式，从中华人民共和国政府的立场出发，描绘了中国近现代史以及相关的国际关系。
description.en: A Chinese webcomic, later adapted into an animation, that was first serialized on the 'Super Camp' forum. It depicts the modern history of China and related international relations from the perspective of the government of the People's Republic of China, using anthropomorphic animals.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军政治工作部文工团
中国人民解放军陆军政治工作部文工团电视艺术中心

description.zh-cn: 参与制作《那年那兔那些事儿》第四、五季动画的机构。其加入帮助解决了动画播出时遇到的困难。
description.en: An organization involved in the production of the fourth and fifth seasons of the 'Year Hare Affair' animation. Its participation helped resolve difficulties encountered during the broadcast.

zh-cn: 四川省卫生健康委员会
四川省卫生健康宣教中心

description.zh-cn: 中国四川省的卫生健康主管机构。其下属的宣教中心曾联合制作《那年那兔那些事儿》抗疫特别篇。
description.en: The health authority of Sichuan Province, China. Its health education center co-produced the anti-epidemic special episode of 'Year Hare Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 美国高空侦察机。其在古巴上空拍摄的照片首次证实了苏联导弹基地的存在，从而引发了危机的公开阶段。
description.en: A high-altitude American reconnaissance aircraft. Photographs taken by a U-2 over Cuba provided the first confirmation of Soviet missile sites, thereby triggering the public phase of the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 美国空军少校飞行员，在古巴导弹危机期间驾驶U-2侦察机在古巴上空执行任务时被击落身亡，是危机中唯一因敌对火力而丧生的人员。
description.en: A U.S. Air Force Major and pilot who was shot down and killed while flying a U-2 reconnaissance mission over Cuba during the crisis, being the only combat casualty of the event.

description.zh-cn: 苏联海军军官，在古巴导弹危机期间作为B-59潜艇上的舰队参谋长，否决了发射核鱼雷的决定，从而避免了可能的核战争。
description.en: A Soviet Navy officer who, as chief of staff of the flotilla and second-in-command of submarine B-59 during the crisis, refused to authorize the launch of a nuclear torpedo, thereby preventing a likely nuclear war.

zh-cn: 阿纳托利·费奥多罗维奇·多勃雷宁

description.zh-cn: 时任苏联驻美国大使，在危机期间作为与罗伯特·肯尼迪进行秘密谈判的关键渠道。
description.en: The Soviet Ambassador to the United States at the time, who served as a critical channel for secret negotiations with Robert F. Kennedy during the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 苏联总参谋部军官，同时为美国和英国提供情报。他泄露的关于“阿纳德尔行动”的情报对肯尼迪政府的决策起到了关键作用。
description.en: A Soviet GRU officer who served as a double agent for the United States and the United Kingdom. His intelligence on Operation Anadyr was crucial to the Kennedy administration's decision-making.

description.zh-cn: 为避免类似古巴导弹危机的事件再次升级失控，在华盛顿和莫斯科之间建立的直接通讯线路。
description.en: A direct communication link established between Washington D.C. and Moscow to prevent future crises like the Cuban Missile Crisis from escalating out of control.

description.zh-cn: 美国部署在意大利和土耳其的中程弹道导弹。此次部署被苏联视为重大威胁，是其决定在古巴部署导弹的直接导火索。
description.en: An American medium-range ballistic missile deployed in Italy and Turkey. This deployment was seen by the Soviet Union as a major threat and was the direct catalyst for its decision to place missiles in Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 日本传说中的第二代天皇，神武天皇的第三皇子。
description.en: The legendary second Emperor of Japan, the third son of Emperor Jimmu.

zh-cn: 彦波潋武鸬鹚草葺不合尊

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的父亲。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, father of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的母亲，也是其父亲的姨母。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, mother of Emperor Jimmu and also his father's maternal aunt.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，事代主神之女，神武天皇的皇后。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, daughter of Kotoshironushi, and Empress of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的妃子。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, a consort of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的长兄，在神武东征中战死。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the eldest brother of Emperor Jimmu, who died in battle during the Eastern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的二哥，在神武东征中投海自尽。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the second older brother of Emperor Jimmu, who died by entering the sea during the Eastern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的三哥，在神武东征中投海自尽。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the third older brother of Emperor Jimmu, who died by entering the sea during the Eastern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的长子，企图谋害弟弟而被绥靖天皇杀死。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the eldest son of Emperor Jimmu, who attempted to murder his younger brothers and was killed by Emperor Suizei.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的第二皇子。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the second son of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 传说中由神武天皇建立的日本第一个统一王朝。
description.en: The first unified dynasty of Japan, said to have been founded by Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇从日向国出发，向东征服大和地区的军事行动，是其建立大和朝廷的关键事件。
description.en: Emperor Jimmu's military campaign from Hyūga Province to conquer the Yamato region in the east, a key event leading to the establishment of the Yamato court.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，大和地区的土豪，抵抗神武天皇东征，后被栉玉饶速日命所杀。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, a local chieftain in the Yamato region who resisted Emperor Jimmu's eastern expedition and was later killed by Nigihayahi-no-mikoto.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，原为长髓彦所侍奉，后归顺神武天皇。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, initially served by Nagasunehiko, who later submitted to Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝方士，奉秦始皇之命出海寻找长生不老药。有一种说法认为他就是日本的神武天皇。
description.en: A court sorcerer of the Qin Dynasty, sent by Qin Shi Huang to seek the elixir of life. One theory suggests he was the same person as Japan's Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的祖父。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the grandfather of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，神武天皇的祖母，海童之大女。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the grandmother of Emperor Jimmu, the elder daughter of the sea god Watatsumi.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的神祇，媛蹈鞴五十铃媛命的父亲。
description.en: A deity in Japanese mythology, father of Himetataraisuzuhime-no-mikoto.

description.zh-cn: 日本神话中的人物，火折尊的兄长，吾平津媛的父亲。
description.en: A figure in Japanese mythology, the elder brother of Hoori and father of Ahiratsuhime.

description.zh-cn: 日本古代的令制国之一，位于现在的宫崎县。传说是神武天皇的出生地及其东征的起点。
description.en: An old province of Japan, now part of Miyazaki Prefecture. It is the legendary birthplace of Emperor Jimmu and the starting point of his eastern expedition.

description.zh-cn: 传说中神武天皇即位的皇居，以及其驾崩的地点。位于今奈良县橿原市。
description.en: The legendary palace where Emperor Jimmu ascended to the throne and later died. Located in modern-day Kashihara, Nara Prefecture.

en: List of mainland Chinese schools reopened in Taiwan

description.zh-cn: 指1949年后，原在中国大陆的学校随中华民国政府迁台后重新建立的过程。中央警官学校于1954年在台湾复校。
description.en: Refers to the process of re-establishing schools in Taiwan after they relocated with the government of the Republic of China from mainland China after 1949. The Central Police Officer Academy was re-established in Taiwan in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，黄埔军校2期毕业，曾任中央警官学校第二任校长。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, a graduate of the 2nd class of the Whampoa Military Academy, and served as the second President of the Central Police Officer Academy.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国警官，中央警官学校正科51期毕业，现任中央警察大学校长。
description.en: A police officer of the Republic of China, a graduate of the 51st class of the Central Police Officer Academy, and the current President of Central Police University.

description.zh-cn: 日本第50代天皇，将首都从长冈京迁至平安京（京都）。
description.en: The 50th emperor of Japan, who moved the capital from Nagaoka-kyō to Heian-kyō (Kyoto).

description.zh-cn: 日本历史上的一个武家政权。因其设在京都，使得京都的政治色彩一度复苏。
description.en: A feudal military government in the history of Japan. Because it was based in Kyoto, the city's political character was revived.

description.zh-cn: 一场开启了日本战国时代的内战，期间京都几乎被完全烧毁。
description.en: A civil war that initiated the Sengoku period in Japan, during which Kyoto was almost completely destroyed by fire.

description.zh-cn: 日本历史上的一个时期，始于应仁之乱。
description.en: A period in Japanese history that began with the Ōnin War.

description.zh-cn: 日本的一个地方行政区，于明治维新后设立，管辖京都市。
description.en: A local administrative division of Japan, established after the Meiji Restoration, which has jurisdiction over Kyoto City.

description.zh-cn: 与《南德意志报》合作，组织全球媒体整理并公布“巴拿马文件”的调查记者组织。
description.en: An organization of investigative journalists that collaborated with Süddeutsche Zeitung to organize global media outlets to analyze and publish the Panama Papers.

description.zh-cn: 最初从匿名来源接收到“巴拿马文件”的德国报纸。
description.en: The German newspaper that initially received the Panama Papers from an anonymous source.

description.zh-cn: 于2015年向《南德意志报》提供“巴拿马文件”的匿名告密者。
description.en: The anonymous whistleblower who provided the Panama Papers to Süddeutsche Zeitung in 2015.

zh-cn: 西格门迪尔·达维兹·京勒伊格松
西格蒙杜尔·古恩劳格松
西格蒙杜尔·戴维·贡劳格松

description.zh-cn: 冰岛前总理，因“巴拿马文件”揭露其未申报的离岸公司利益而引发抗议并辞职。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of Iceland who resigned following protests sparked by the Panama Papers' revelation of his undeclared interests in an offshore company.

description.zh-cn: 巴基斯坦前总理，因“巴拿马文件”揭露其家族拥有离岸公司而接受调查，最终被法院裁定不再符合担任公职的资格并辞职。
description.en: Former Prime Minister of Pakistan who was investigated after the Panama Papers revealed his family's offshore companies, ultimately leading to his disqualification from public office by the court and his resignation.

en: List of Prime Ministers of Iceland

description.zh-cn: 冰岛的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The position of the head of government of Iceland.

description.zh-cn: 列宁提出的理论，认为帝国主义是资本主义的最高和最后阶段，并在此基础上论证了社会主义革命在个别国家首先胜利的可能性。
description.en: A theory developed by Lenin, which posits that imperialism is the highest and final stage of capitalism, and on this basis argues for the possibility of socialist revolution succeeding first in individual countries.

description.zh-cn: 以共产主义为信仰的政党。根据列宁主义，共产党是工人阶级的先锋队，是实现和领导无产阶级专政的唯一政党。
description.en: A political party that adheres to communism. According to Leninism, the Communist Party is the vanguard of the working class and the sole party to achieve and lead the dictatorship of the proletariat.

description.zh-cn: 古巴政治家，菲德尔·卡斯特罗的弟弟，曾任古巴共产党中央委员会第一书记、古巴国务委员会主席等职务。
description.en: Cuban politician, brother of Fidel Castro, who served as the First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and President of the Council of State of Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 古巴独裁者，其政权于1959年被菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导的古巴革命推翻。
description.en: Cuban dictator whose regime was overthrown by the Cuban Revolution led by Fidel Castro in 1959.

zh-cn: 奥斯瓦尔多·多尔蒂科斯·托拉多

description.zh-cn: 古巴政治家，曾任古巴总统。
description.en: Cuban politician who served as President of Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗的父亲。
description.en: Father of Fidel Castro.

description.zh-cn: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗的第一任妻子。
description.en: First wife of Fidel Castro.

zh-cn: 纳塔莉亚·雷韦尔塔·克鲁斯

description.zh-cn: 古巴社会名流，曾是菲德尔·卡斯特罗的情人。
description.en: Cuban socialite who was a lover of Fidel Castro.

description.zh-cn: 古巴的执政党。
description.en: The ruling political party in Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 古巴的国家权力机构。
description.en: A state body of Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 由菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导的革命组织，旨在推翻古巴独裁者富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔。
description.en: A revolutionary organization led by Fidel Castro to overthrow the Cuban dictator Fulgencio Batista.

description.zh-cn: 古巴共和国的武装力量。
description.en: The armed forces of the Republic of Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 位于古巴哈瓦那的一所公立大学。
description.en: A public university located in Havana, Cuba.

zh-cn: 伯利恒耶稣会预备学校

description.zh-cn: 古巴的一个民粹主义政党，菲德尔·卡斯特罗早年曾加入该党。
description.en: A Cuban populist political party that Fidel Castro joined in his early years.

zh-cn: 暗杀菲德尔·卡斯特罗事件
en: CIA assassination attempts on Fidel Castro

description.zh-cn: 指美国中央情报局等机构针对菲德尔·卡斯特罗策划的一系列暗杀行动，据称共计638次。
description.en: Refers to a series of assassination plots against Fidel Castro, reportedly totaling 638, primarily orchestrated by the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency.

description.zh-cn: 古巴奥尔金省的一个村庄，是菲德尔·卡斯特罗的出生地。
description.en: A village in Holguín Province, Cuba, and the birthplace of Fidel Castro.

description.zh-cn: 古巴的首都和最大城市。
description.en: The capital and largest city of Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国创建的军事院校，通称黄埔军校。
description.en: A military academy established by the Republic of China, commonly known as the Whampoa Military Academy.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第七十四军
国民革命军整编第七十四师

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军的精锐部队之一，由王耀武等人创立，因战功卓著在抗日战争中被称为“抗日铁军”。
description.en: One of the elite units of the National Revolutionary Army, founded by Wang Yaowu and others. It was known as the 'Anti-Japanese Iron Army' for its outstanding military achievements during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，王耀武在国民革命军第七十四军的前任军长。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and Wang Yaowu's predecessor as the commander of the 74th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，王耀武在国民革命军第七十四军的继任军长。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and Wang Yaowu's successor as the commander of the 74th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期山东省的最高行政长官职位。
description.en: The highest administrative post in Shandong Province during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军高级将领，红十军团副军团长兼红19师师长。
description.en: A senior commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, deputy commander of the 10th Army Group and commander of the 19th Division.

description.zh-cn: 中国剧作家，中国戏剧家协会理事，中国作家协会全国委员会委员，曾获中国电影金鸡奖最佳编剧。
description.en: Chinese playwright, council member of the China Theatre Association, member of the National Committee of the China Writers Association, and winner of the Golden Rooster Award for Best Screenplay.

zh-cn: 中华全国戏剧工作者协会

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国戏剧家组成的全国性人民团体，是中国戏剧家协会的前身。魏鹤龄曾是其第一届全国委员会的成员。
description.en: A national-level people's organization composed of dramatists in the People's Republic of China, and the predecessor of the China Theatre Association. Wei Heling was a member of its first national committee.

en: Principal organs of the United Nations

description.zh-cn: 根据《联合国宪章》设立的联合国六个主要机关。
description.en: The six main bodies of the United Nations established by the UN Charter.

zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会常任理事国
en: Permanent members of the United Nations Security Council

description.zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会中拥有否决权的五个常任席位，包括中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国和美国。
description.en: The five permanent seats on the UN Security Council with veto power, held by China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

description.zh-cn: 联合国秘书处的首长，是联合国的“首席行政长官”。
description.en: The head of the United Nations Secretariat, acting as the 'chief administrative officer' of the Organisation.

description.zh-cn: 联合国的六个主要机构之一，是联合国的主要审议、决策和代表机构。
description.en: One of the six principal organs of the United Nations, serving as the main deliberative, policymaking, and representative organ of the UN.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手、演员及音乐创作人，叶蒨文的丈夫、粤语及声乐老师。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer, actor, and music composer. He is the husband, Cantonese tutor, and vocal coach of Sally Yeh.

description.zh-cn: 香港歌手及演员，林子祥的儿子，叶蒨文的继子。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer and actor, son of George Lam and stepson of Sally Yeh.

description.zh-cn: 第一届国民大会江苏省代表，叶蒨文的外公。
description.en: A representative for Jiangsu Province in the first National Assembly, and Sally Yeh's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 前华纳音乐(香港)总经理，林子祥的前妻。她安排林子祥担任叶蒨文的粤语老师，开启了叶蒨文在香港的歌唱事业。
description.en: Former general manager of Warner Music Hong Kong and ex-wife of George Lam. She arranged for Lam to become Sally Yeh's Cantonese tutor, which launched Yeh's singing career in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 台湾歌手及演员，叶蒨文的初恋对象。
description.en: A Taiwanese singer and actor, who was Sally Yeh's first love.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民歌音乐家，曾指导叶蒨文灌录其首张国语专辑。
description.en: A Taiwanese folk musician who guided Sally Yeh in recording her debut Mandarin album.

description.zh-cn: 香港导演，他引荐叶蒨文与林子祥合作，开启了她在香港发展的契机。
description.en: A Hong Kong director who recommended Sally Yeh to collaborate with George Lam, creating an opportunity for her development in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文在1984年至1998年间签约的唱片公司，是其事业巅峰期的主要合作方。
description.en: The record label Sally Yeh was signed to from 1984 to 1998, serving as her main partner during the peak of her career.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文的粤语专辑及其同名主打歌。该歌曲风靡全港，为她赢得了包括“金曲金奖”在内的多个乐坛大奖，将其歌唱事业推向高峰。
description.en: Sally Yeh's Cantonese album and its title track. The song became immensely popular throughout Hong Kong, winning her numerous music awards, including the 'Gold Song Gold Award', and propelling her singing career to its peak.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文的国语歌曲，在两岸三地广为流传，使她在台湾及整个华语市场大受欢迎，奠定了其天后地位。
description.en: A Mandarin song by Sally Yeh that became widely popular across the Greater China region, making her immensely popular in Taiwan and the broader Chinese-speaking market and establishing her status as a diva.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文于2002年复出时签约的唱片公司。
description.en: The record label Sally Yeh signed with upon her comeback in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 内喀尔喀蒙古首领，曾多次与李成梁作战，后被李成梁部将击杀。
description.en: A leader of the Inner Khalkha Mongols who repeatedly fought against Li Chengliang and was eventually killed by Li's subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 叶赫部首领，后被李成梁设计斩杀。
description.en: A leader of the Yehe tribe, who was later killed in a plot by Li Chengliang.

description.zh-cn: 叶赫部首领，与清佳努一同被李成梁设计斩杀。
description.en: A leader of the Yehe tribe, killed alongside Qingjianu in a plot by Li Chengliang.

description.zh-cn: 明朝万历年间内阁首辅，曾力荐李成梁复起镇守辽东。
description.en: Grand Secretary of the Ming Dynasty during the Wanli era, who strongly recommended Li Chengliang's reappointment to guard Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，曾弹劾李成梁对努尔哈赤的姑息政策。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official who impeached Li Chengliang for his policy of appeasement towards Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 李成梁长子，明朝著名将领。
description.en: Eldest son of Li Chengliang and a famous general of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 李成梁之父，世袭铁岭卫指挥佥事。
description.en: Father of Li Chengliang, who held the hereditary title of Commander of Tieling Guard.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家，曾任清华学校校长。
description.en: A Chinese educator who served as the president of Tsinghua College.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家和教育家，曾任清华大学校长兼党委书记。他提出“为祖国健康工作五十年”的口号，并对清华大学的发展有重要影响。
description.en: A Chinese politician and educator, who served as President and Party Secretary of Tsinghua University. He proposed the slogan 'Work healthily for the motherland for fifty years' and had a significant impact on the university's development.

description.zh-cn: 俄国文学评论家、思想家、革命民主主义者。巴枯宁在莫斯科时期的朋友。
description.en: Russian literary critic, thinker, and revolutionary democrat. A friend of Bakunin during his time in Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 一个由巴枯宁及其追随者在被开除出第一国际后于1872年成立的无政府主义国际组织。
description.en: An anarchist international organization founded in 1872 by Bakunin and his followers after their expulsion from the First International.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪的一个德意志邦国。1849年，巴枯宁在德累斯顿起义失败后被萨克森当局逮捕并判处死刑。
description.en: A German state in the 19th century. In 1849, after the failure of the Dresden uprising, Bakunin was arrested by the Saxon authorities and sentenced to death.

description.zh-cn: 一种革命性的无政府主义学说，主张废除国家和生产资料的私有制，并代之以生产者自己的集体所有制和控制。巴枯宁是该理论的主要创立者。
description.en: A revolutionary anarchist doctrine that advocates the abolition of the state and private ownership of the means of production, replacing them with collective ownership and control by the producers themselves. Bakunin was the main founder of this theory.

description.zh-cn: 俄国作家屠格涅夫创作的小说，其主人公形象的原型是米哈伊尔·巴枯宁。
description.en: A novel by Russian writer Ivan Turgenev, whose protagonist was based on Mikhail Bakunin.

description.zh-cn: 瑞士的首都，米哈伊尔·巴枯宁于此地逝世。
description.en: The capital of Switzerland, where Mikhail Bakunin passed away.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个左翼政党，属于泛蓝阵营。
description.en: A left-wing political party in Taiwan, belonging to the Pan-Blue Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个政党，属于泛蓝阵营。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan, belonging to the Pan-Blue Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，新党元老，最早发明“泛蓝”一词。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, a veteran of the New Party, credited with coining the term 'Pan-Blue'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，原属新党，在媒体上大力宣传“泛蓝”一词使其普及。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, formerly of the New Party, who popularized the term 'Pan-Blue' in the media.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，原为国民党中常委，后脱党创立民国党。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former KMT Central Standing Committee member, who later left the party to found the Minkuotang.

description.zh-cn: 由徐欣莹于2015年创立的政党，后于2019年并入国会政党联盟。
description.en: A political party founded by Hsu Hsin-ying in 2015, which later merged into the Congress Party Alliance in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政坛中与民主进步党意识型态相近的各种团体之总称，为泛蓝的主要政治对手。
description.en: A general term for various groups in Taiwanese politics that are ideologically aligned with the Democratic Progressive Party. It is the main political rival of the Pan-Blue Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，文化大革命期间曾任黑龙江省革命委员会主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Director of the Heilongjiang Provincial Revolutionary Committee during the Cultural Revolution.

zh-cn: 关于人民解放军坚决支持革命左派群众的决定

description.zh-cn: 1967年1月由中共中央、国务院、中央军委、中央文革小组联合发出的文件，要求军队支持“革命左派”，标志着军队正式介入地方文革。
description.en: A document jointly issued in January 1967 by the CPC Central Committee, the State Council, the Central Military Commission, and the Cultural Revolution Group, which ordered the army to support the 'revolutionary leftists', marking the formal intervention of the military in the local Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，军队执行的“支左、支工、支农、军管、军训”任务的简称。
description.en: An abbreviation for the tasks undertaken by the military during the Cultural Revolution: 'support the left, support industry, support agriculture, military control, and military training'.

description.zh-cn: 指非汉族群在文化、社会等方面被汉族同化的过程。在蒙古帝国时期，忽必烈推行汉化政策，而阿里不哥则对此表示反对。
description.en: The process by which non-Han Chinese societies come under the influence of Han Chinese culture and societal norms. During the Mongol Empire, Kublai Khan promoted Sinicization policies, which were opposed by Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 大蒙古国的首都，蒙哥汗在位时由阿里不哥驻守。
description.en: The capital of the Mongol Empire, where Ariq Böke was stationed during the reign of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古及一些突厥语族的政治和军事议事会。1260年，蒙古本土贵族在此推举阿里不哥为大汗。
description.en: A political and military council of Mongol and some Turkic peoples. In 1260, the Mongol nobility in the homeland elected Ariq Böke as the Great Khan in a kurultai.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥之子。
description.en: Son of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥之子。
description.en: Son of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥之子。
description.en: Son of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥的玄孙，曾被拥立为伊儿汗。
description.en: Great-great-grandson of Ariq Böke, who was once enthroned as the Ilkhan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army.

zh-cn: 中央军委装备发展部办公厅
中国人民解放军总装备部司令部

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总装备部的下属部门。
description.en: A subordinate department of the PLA General Armaments Department.

zh-cn: 以制裁反制美国敌人法案
en: Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act

description.zh-cn: 一部美国联邦法律，对伊朗、朝鲜和俄罗斯实施制裁。
description.en: A United States federal law that imposed sanctions on Iran, North Korea, and Russia.

en: Special Red Banner Far Eastern Army

description.zh-cn: 苏联为应对中东路事件而专门成立的集团军，由瓦西里·布柳赫尔指挥。
description.en: An army group specially formed by the Soviet Union to deal with the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929, commanded by Vasily Blyukher.

description.zh-cn: 1929年12月20日由中苏代表签订的议定书，结束了中东路事件，恢复了苏联在中东路的权益。
description.en: A protocol signed by Chinese and Soviet representatives on December 20, 1929, which ended the Sino-Soviet conflict and restored Soviet rights on the Chinese Eastern Railway.

description.zh-cn: 位于黑龙江和乌苏里江交汇处的岛屿，在中东路事件后被苏联完全占领。
description.en: An island at the confluence of the Heilongjiang and Ussuri rivers, which was fully occupied by the Soviet Union after the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党领导的、河北省工商界组成的统战性、经济性、民间性的人民团体和商会组织。
description.en: A united front, economic, and non-governmental people's organization and chamber of commerce composed of members from Hebei's industrial and commercial circles, under the leadership of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 一种组织分类，河北省工商业联合会属于此类组织。
description.en: A classification of organization to which the Hebei Federation of Industry and Commerce belongs.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，王安石在扬州任职时的上司，后反对青苗法。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty, Wang Anshi's superior during his tenure in Yangzhou, and later an opponent of the Green Sprouts Law.

description.zh-cn: 北宋散文家，“三苏”之一，认为王安石“不近人情”，并作《辨奸论》攻击他。
description.en: A prose writer of the Northern Song dynasty, one of the 'Three Sus', who considered Wang Anshi 'inhumane' and attacked him in his essay 'Discerning the Traitorous'.

description.zh-cn: 新党核心人物，王安石变法的重要助手，后与王安石决裂。
description.en: A key figure in the reformist faction and an important assistant to Wang Anshi during the reforms, who later broke with Wang.

description.zh-cn: 宋代副宰相的官称。
description.en: The official title for the vice-chancellor in the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 王安石长子，文学家，临川三王之一。其早逝对王安石打击甚大。
description.en: The eldest son of Wang Anshi, a writer and one of the 'Three Wangs of Linchuan'. His premature death was a great blow to Wang Anshi.

description.zh-cn: 熙宁变法中的一项核心财经政策，由政府在青黄不接时向农民提供贷款，秋后收取本息。
description.en: A key financial policy of the Xining Reforms, where the government provided loans to farmers during the lean season, to be repaid with interest after the autumn harvest.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，在新旧党争中支持王安石，并曾请求神宗复用王安石为相。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song dynasty who supported Wang Anshi during the New-Old Party Disputes and once requested Emperor Shenzong to reappoint Wang Anshi as chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 北宋御史中丞，上疏弹劾王安石“奸诈十事”，是变法初期的主要反对者之一。
description.en: Censor-in-chief of the Northern Song dynasty who impeached Wang Anshi on 'ten counts of treachery', one of the main opponents in the early stages of the reforms.

description.zh-cn: 因熙宁变法引发的，以王安石为首的新党与以司马光为首的旧党之间长期的政治斗争。
description.en: The long-term political struggle between the reformist faction led by Wang Anshi and the conservative faction led by Sima Guang, triggered by the Xining Reforms.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: Singaporean politician, one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: Singaporean politician, one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，人民行动党的创始成员和首任主席。
description.en: Singaporean politician, a founding member and the first Chairman of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡和马来西亚政治家，人民行动党的创始成员之一，后将马来西亚的人民行动党改组为民主行动党。
description.en: Singaporean and Malaysian politician, a founding member of the People's Action Party, who later reorganized the Malaysian branch of PAP into the Democratic Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，人民行动党的创始成员和第一届中央委员之一。
description.en: Singaporean politician, a founding member and one of the first Central Executive Committee members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，人民行动党的创始成员和第一届中央委员之一。
description.en: Singaporean politician, a founding member and one of the first Central Executive Committee members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，现任人民行动党助理秘书长。
description.en: Singaporean politician, the current Assistant Secretary-General of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 一个由世界各国社会党、社会民主党和工党组成的国际政党组织。人民行动党曾是其成员，后于1976年被驱逐。
description.en: An international organization of social democratic, socialist, and labour parties from around the world. The People's Action Party was a member until its expulsion in 1976.

zh-cn: 新加坡退出马来西亚联邦

description.zh-cn: 1965年8月9日，新加坡因政治分歧退出马来西亚联邦，成为独立共和国。
description.en: On August 9, 1965, Singapore separated from the Federation of Malaysia due to political differences and became an independent republic.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政党，由蒂凡那于1966年将原人民行动党在马来西亚的组织改组而成。
description.en: A Malaysian political party formed in 1966 by C. V. Devan Nair through the reorganization of the former Malaysian branch of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 荷兰的社会民主主义政党。1976年，该党动议将人民行动党逐出社会党国际。
description.en: A social-democratic political party in the Netherlands. In 1976, the party initiated a motion to expel the People's Action Party from the Socialist International.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政府的独立反贪机构，负责调查和预防腐败行为。
description.en: An independent anti-corruption agency of the Singapore Government responsible for investigating and preventing corruption.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，曾于1981年至1993年担任人民行动党主席。
description.en: Singaporean politician who served as the Chairman of the People's Action Party from 1981 to 1993.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，曾于1993年至2004年担任人民行动党主席，并曾出任新加坡总统。
description.en: Singaporean politician who served as the Chairman of the People's Action Party from 1993 to 2004 and as President of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，曾于2011年至2018年担任人民行动党主席。
description.en: Singaporean politician who served as the Chairman of the People's Action Party from 2011 to 2018.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡政治家，曾于1957年短暂担任人民行动党秘书长。
description.en: Singaporean politician who briefly served as the Secretary-General of the People's Action Party in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 人民行动党的青年组织。
description.en: The youth wing of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共吉林省委副书记、吉林省人大常委会副主任。

en: United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway

description.en: A Roman general and statesman in the late Roman Republic. He was appointed perpetual dictator by the Senate, and his concentration of power symbolized the end of the Republican system.

description.en: The first Roman emperor, who was granted the title 'Augustus' in 27 BC, marking the beginning of the Roman Empire.

description.en: The decisive confrontation of the Final War of the Roman Republic, where Octavian defeated the combined forces of Mark Antony and Cleopatra VII.

description.zh-cn: 罗马共和国末期的政治家和将军，在亚克兴角战役中被屋大维击败。

description.zh-cn: 埃及托勒密王国的最后一任女王，在亚克兴角战役中与马克·安东尼一同被屋大维击败。
description.en: The last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, defeated alongside Mark Antony by Octavian at the Battle of Actium.

description.zh-cn: 位于埃及的古希腊王国，在屋大维击败克娄巴特拉七世后被罗马吞并。
description.en: A Hellenistic kingdom based in ancient Egypt, which was annexed by Rome after Octavian's victory over Cleopatra VII.

description.zh-cn: 古罗马的审议机构。在帝国初期，它授予屋大维“奥古斯都”称号，象征着帝国的开始。
description.en: The deliberative body of ancient Rome. In the early empire, it granted Octavian the title 'Augustus', symbolizing the beginning of the empire.

description.zh-cn: 罗马皇帝的护卫部队，在公元41年拥立克劳狄一世为帝，对皇位继承有重要影响力。
description.en: The personal bodyguards of the Roman emperors, who played a significant role in imperial succession, such as proclaiming Claudius as emperor in 41 AD.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国第四位皇帝，在卡利古拉被刺后由罗马禁卫军拥立。
description.en: The fourth Roman emperor, proclaimed emperor by the Praetorian Guard after the assassination of Caligula.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国弗拉维王朝的第二位皇帝，是维斯帕先的继位者，图密善的兄长。
description.en: The second Roman emperor of the Flavian dynasty, successor to Vespasian and elder brother of Domitian.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国弗拉维王朝的最后一位皇帝，继其兄提图斯之后即位。
description.en: The last Roman emperor of the Flavian dynasty, who succeeded his elder brother Titus.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国“五贤帝”之首，由元老院推举为皇帝。
description.en: The first of the 'Five Good Emperors' of the Roman Empire, chosen by the Senate.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国塞维鲁王朝的最后一位皇帝，其于公元235年被刺杀身亡导致了三世纪危机。
description.en: The last Roman emperor of the Severan dynasty. His assassination in 235 AD led to the Crisis of the Third Century.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国的一段时期，其特点是持续的内战、外族入侵、经济崩溃和瘟疫，始于皇帝亚历山大·塞维鲁被刺。
description.en: A period in the Roman Empire characterized by constant civil wars, foreign invasions, economic collapse, and plague, beginning with the assassination of Emperor Alexander Severus.

description.zh-cn: 罗马皇帝，他的统治结束了三世纪危机，并创立了四帝共治制度。
description.en: A Roman emperor whose reign brought an end to the Crisis of the Third Century and who established the Tetrarchy.

description.zh-cn: 由戴克里先创立的罗马帝国政府制度，将帝国分为由四位皇帝共同统治的区域。
description.en: A system of government in the Roman Empire established by Diocletian, dividing the empire into territories ruled by four co-emperors.

description.zh-cn: 由君士坦丁大帝在古城拜占庭的基础上建立，自330年起成为罗马帝国（后来的东罗马帝国）的首都。
description.en: Founded by Constantine the Great on the site of the ancient city of Byzantium, it became the capital of the Roman Empire (and later the Eastern Roman Empire) from 330 AD.

description.zh-cn: 古代波斯的帝国，长期与罗马帝国在东部边境抗衡。
description.en: An ancient Persian empire that was a long-standing rival to the Roman Empire on its eastern frontier.

zh-cn: 弗拉维乌斯·奥古斯都·霍诺留

description.zh-cn: 狄奥多西一世之子，395年帝国分裂后成为西罗马帝国的第一位皇帝。
description.en: Son of Theodosius I, who became the first emperor of the Western Roman Empire after the division of the empire in 395.

description.zh-cn: 狄奥多西一世之子，395年帝国分裂后成为东罗马帝国的第一位皇帝。
description.en: Son of Theodosius I, who became the first emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire after the division of the empire in 395.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国在395年分裂后西部的一半，其灭亡通常以476年最后一位皇帝被废黜为标志。
description.en: The western half of the Roman Empire after its division in 395, its fall is conventionally dated to 476 with the deposition of its last emperor.

description.zh-cn: 日耳曼军事领袖，于476年废黜了西罗马帝国最后一位皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都。
description.en: A Germanic military leader who deposed the last Western Roman Emperor, Romulus Augustulus, in 476.

description.zh-cn: 西罗马帝国的最后一位皇帝，于476年被奥多亚塞废黜。
description.en: The last emperor of the Western Roman Empire, who was deposed by Odoacer in 476.

description.zh-cn: 东罗马帝国的最后一位皇帝，在1453年君士坦丁堡陷落时战死。
description.en: The last emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire, who died in battle during the Fall of Constantinople in 1453.

description.zh-cn: 一次由西欧封建主和威尼斯组织的军事行动，最终导致1204年对君士坦丁堡的洗劫，严重削弱了东罗马帝国。
description.en: A military expedition organized by Western European feudal lords and Venice, which culminated in the sack of Constantinople in 1204, severely weakening the Eastern Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 罗马诗人，因其作品《爱的艺术》违反了屋大维的政策而被流放。
description.en: A Roman poet who was exiled for his work 'Ars Amatoria', which conflicted with the policies of Augustus.

description.zh-cn: 罗马斯多葛派哲学家、政治家和剧作家，曾担任皇帝尼禄的老师。
description.en: A Roman Stoic philosopher, statesman, and dramatist who served as a tutor to Emperor Nero.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国朱里亚·克劳狄王朝的最后一位皇帝，其老师是哲学家塞涅卡。传统上认为他在位期间下令处死了使徒保罗。
description.en: The last Roman emperor of the Julio-Claudian dynasty, whose tutor was the philosopher Seneca. According to tradition, he ordered the execution of the Apostle Paul.

description.zh-cn: 日耳曼部落之一，于公元410年入侵并洗劫了罗马城。
description.en: A Germanic tribe that invaded and sacked the city of Rome in 410 AD.

description.zh-cn: 日耳曼部落之一，于公元455年入侵并洗劫了罗马城。
description.en: A Germanic tribe that invaded and sacked the city of Rome in 455 AD.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，郑亲王，肃顺与端华之父。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, Prince Zheng, and the father of Sushun and Duanhua.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣，文渊阁大学士。因戊午科场案被肃顺坚持处斩。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official and Grand Secretary of the Wenyuan Pavilion. He was executed at the insistence of Sushun due to the 1858 imperial examination scandal.

description.zh-cn: 清代郑亲王的府邸，位于北京，是肃顺的出生地。
description.en: The mansion of Prince Zheng in the Qing dynasty, located in Beijing. It is the birthplace of Sushun.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的十字路口，在清代是主要的死刑行刑场，肃顺在此地被斩首。
description.en: An intersection in Beijing that served as the primary execution ground during the Qing dynasty. Sushun was beheaded here.

description.zh-cn: 指皇太后在朝堂上，于皇帝宝座后方隔着帘子，代年幼的皇帝处理国政的制度。慈禧太后意图实行此制度，但遭到肃顺的强烈反对。
description.en: A system where an empress dowager would attend to state affairs on behalf of a young emperor from behind a curtain in the throne room. Empress Dowager Cixi intended to implement this system but faced strong opposition from Sushun.

description.zh-cn: 中国妇产科学家，曾任上海医科大学教授、博士生导师，为中国共产党党员。
description.en: Chinese obstetrician and gynecologist, former professor and doctoral supervisor at Shanghai Medical University, and a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 香港航业巨头，董建华之父。
description.en: Hong Kong shipping magnate, father of Tung Chee-hwa.

description.zh-cn: 董建华之母。
description.en: Mother of Tung Chee-hwa.

zh-cn: 香港大学民意调查风波

description.zh-cn: 六七暴动期间任斗委会主任。
description.en: Served as the director of the Struggle Committee during the 1967 Hong Kong riots.

description.zh-cn: 香港首位华人布政司及首任政务司司长。
description.en: The first ethnic Chinese Chief Secretary of Hong Kong and the first Chief Secretary for Administration.

description.zh-cn: 由董浩云创立的航运公司，曾由董建华继承。
description.en: A shipping company founded by Tung Hao-yung, later inherited by Tung Chee-hwa.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建国初期针对知识分子进行的政治运动。
description.en: A political campaign targeting intellectuals in the early years of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一次全国人口普查
en: First National Population Census of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于1953年进行的首次全国性人口普查。
description.en: The first national census conducted by the People's Republic of China in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省的一个县，现为县级市嵊州市。
description.en: A county in Zhejiang Province, now the county-level city of Shengzhou.

description.zh-cn: 由卢作孚创办的中国轮船公司。
description.en: A Chinese shipping company founded by Lu Zuofu.

description.zh-cn: 1934年由卢作孚在北碚建成，是四川境内最早的铁路。
description.en: Built in Beibei by Lu Zuofu in 1934, it was the earliest railway in Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 位于重庆市北碚区的一所师范大学，2005年与西南农业大学合并组建西南大学。
description.en: A normal university located in Beibei District, Chongqing, which merged with Southwest Agricultural University in 2005 to form Southwest University.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期负责全国陆军军政的中央机构。
description.en: The central institution responsible for the national army's military administration during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，交通系首领，曾任国务总理。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, leader of the Communications Clique, who served as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期的内阁机构。1914年至1916年间曾被改为政事堂。
description.en: The cabinet body during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China. It was replaced by the 'Hall of State Affairs' (政事堂) between 1914 and 1916.

description.zh-cn: 1919年中华民国北洋政府宣布废除外蒙古自治的事件。
description.en: The event in 1919 when the Beiyang government of the Republic of China announced the abolition of Outer Mongolia's autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期军事家，冯玉祥部下。
description.en: A military figure in the Republic of China, a subordinate of Feng Yuxiang.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮三子。
description.en: Third son of Xu Shuzheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党濮阳市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Puyang Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任濮阳市人民政府市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Mayor of the Puyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 950年，郭威在澶州（今濮阳）被军士拥立为帝，建立后周的历史事件。
description.en: A historical event in 950 where Guo Wei was acclaimed emperor by his troops in Chanzhou (modern Puyang), leading to the establishment of the Later Zhou dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期设立的一个省级行政区，1952年被撤销。
description.en: A former province established in the early years of the People's Republic of China, abolished in 1952.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期设立的专区，1954年被撤销。
description.en: A former prefecture established in the early years of the People's Republic of China, abolished in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 原安阳专区，1983年被撤销。
description.en: Formerly Anyang Prefecture, it was abolished in 1983.

description.zh-cn: 濮阳市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Puyang City.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国河南省东北部的一个县，隶属于濮阳市。
description.en: A county in the northeast of Henan Province, China, under the administration of Puyang City.

description.zh-cn: 建筑师，负责中国文化大学的校园建设规划，设计了包括大成馆、大仁馆、大义馆、大典馆在内的多座中国宫殿式建筑。
description.en: An architect responsible for the campus construction planning of Chinese Culture University, who designed several Chinese palace-style buildings including Dacheng Hall, Daren Hall, Dayi Hall, and Dadian Hall.

description.zh-cn: 南京工业大学的源头之一，其化学工程系是南京化工学院的直接前身。
description.en: One of the origins of Nanjing Tech University. Its Chemical Engineering Department was the direct predecessor of Nanjing Institute of Chemical Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大学的第二任董事长。
description.en: The second Chairman of the Board of Trustees of Chinese Culture University.

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大学现任校长。
description.en: The current President of Chinese Culture University.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的人寿保险公司，长期赞助中国文化大学女子篮球队，使其成为国泰人寿女子篮球队的幼队体系。
description.en: A life insurance company in Taiwan that has long sponsored the women's basketball team of Chinese Culture University, making it a youth team system for the Cathay Life Women's Basketball Team.

zh-cn: 台北市私立华冈艺术学校

description.zh-cn: 一所位于台北市的纯艺术技术型高中，为中国文化大学“华冈学园”的组成部分之一。
description.en: A technical high school for the fine arts located in Taipei, which is part of the 'Hwa Kang School Garden' of Chinese Culture University.

description.zh-cn: 一个学术研究机构，与中国文化大学、华冈学会、华冈兴业基金会合称为“华冈学园”。
description.en: An academic research institution which, together with Chinese Culture University, the Hwa Kang Society, and the Hwa Kang Enterprise Foundation, is collectively known as the 'Hwa Kang School Garden'.

zh-cn: 中国文化大学推广教育部

description.zh-cn: 由张其昀于1972年创设的基金会，旨在以学术推动实业，以兴业奖助兴学。与中国文化大学、华冈学会、中华学术院合称为“华冈学园”。
description.en: A foundation established by Chang Chi-yun in 1972, aiming to promote industry through academia and support education through enterprise. It is collectively known as the 'Hwa Kang School Garden' along with Chinese Culture University, the Hwa Kang Society, and the Chung-Hwa Academy.

description.zh-cn: 台北市的一个市辖区，中国文化大学校本部所在地。
description.en: A district in Taipei City, where the main campus of Chinese Culture University is located.

description.zh-cn: 位于台北市的一座山，中国文化大学校本部所在地。
description.en: A mountain in Taipei City, where the main campus of Chinese Culture University is located.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国监察院的副首长职位。
description.en: The position of the deputy head of the Control Yuan of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，林荣三的前任监察院副院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, predecessor of Lin Rong-san as Vice President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，林荣三的继任监察院副院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, successor of Lin Rong-san as Vice President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾在林荣三担任监察院副院长及监察委员期间担任监察院院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, who served as President of the Control Yuan during Lin Rong-san's tenure as Vice President and Member of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾在林荣三担任监察委员期间担任监察院院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, who served as President of the Control Yuan during Lin Rong-san's tenure as a Control Yuan Member.

description.zh-cn: 由林荣三创办的企业集团，业务横跨地产、金融、传媒等领域。
description.en: An enterprise group founded by Lin Rong-san, with businesses spanning real estate, finance, and media.

description.zh-cn: 日治台湾台北州新庄郡的行政区，为林荣三的出生地，今为新北市芦洲区。
description.en: An administrative division of Shinjō District, Taihoku Prefecture during the Japanese rule of Taiwan. It is the birthplace of Lin Rong-san, now known as Luzhou District, New Taipei City.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三之父。
description.en: Father of Lin Rong-san.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的大哥，宏国集团创办人。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's eldest brother, founder of the Hung Kuo Group.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的二哥，宏泰集团创办人。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's second elder brother, founder of the Hung Tai Group.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的姪子，林堉琪之长子，曾任宏国建设副董事长、台北101董事长兼总经理。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's nephew, eldest son of Lin Yu-chi. He served as Vice Chairman of Hung Kuo Construction and Chairman & General Manager of Taipei 101.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的外甥，曾任台北市议员。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's nephew, former member of the Taipei City Council.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的外甥，曾任立法委员。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's nephew, former member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的么子，现任珑山林企业董事长。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's youngest son, current Chairman of Longsanlin Enterprise.

zh-cn: 台北市开南高级中等学校
台北市私立开南高级商工职业学校
开南高级商工职业学校

description.zh-cn: 位于台北市的职业学校，林荣三的母校。
description.en: A vocational school in Taipei City, the alma mater of Lin Rong-san.

description.zh-cn: 台湾北部的商帮之一，林荣三是其重要成员。
description.en: One of the business cliques in northern Taiwan, of which Lin Rong-san was a key member.

description.zh-cn: 由林荣三、林堉琪、林堉璘三兄弟共同创立的建设公司。
description.en: A construction company co-founded by the three brothers: Lin Rong-san, Lin Yu-chi, and Lin Yu-lin.

description.zh-cn: 由林荣三二哥林堉璘创办的企业集团。
description.en: An enterprise group founded by Lin Rong-san's second elder brother, Lin Yu-lin.

zh-cn: 新北市芦洲区芦洲国民小学

description.zh-cn: 位于新北市芦洲区的小学，林荣三的母校。
description.en: An elementary school in Luzhou District, New Taipei City, the alma mater of Lin Rong-san.

description.zh-cn: 三重帮大老，曾任台北县长，将林荣三引入政坛。
description.en: A key figure in the Sanchong Gang and former Taipei County Magistrate, who introduced Lin Rong-san to politics.

description.zh-cn: 台湾戒严时期的报纸出版限制政策，于1988年解除。
description.en: The newspaper publishing restriction policy during Taiwan's martial law period, which was lifted in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 由林荣三于1990年参与设立的银行。
description.en: A bank that Lin Rong-san participated in establishing in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国文职勋章，陈水扁曾授予林荣三二等卿云勋章。
description.en: A civilian order of the Republic of China. Chen Shui-bian awarded Lin Rong-san the Order of Propitious Clouds with Grand Cordon.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国文职勋章，林荣三曾获颁二等景星勋章。
description.en: A civilian order of the Republic of China. Lin Rong-san was awarded the Order of Brilliant Star with Grand Cordon.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的姐夫，林满的丈夫，陈宏昌之父。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's brother-in-law, husband of Lin Man, father of Chen Hung-chang.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的大嫂，林堉琪的妻子。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's sister-in-law, wife of Lin Yu-chi.

description.zh-cn: 前国民大会议长，林谢罕见之弟。
description.en: Former Speaker of the National Assembly, younger brother of Lin Hsieh Han-chien.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的姪子，林堉琪之次子，曾任中华奥林匹克委员会主席。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's nephew, second son of Lin Yu-chi, former President of the Chinese Taipei Olympic Committee.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期汉朝与西部羌族部落之间旷日持久的系列军事冲突。董卓在这些战争中崛起，积累了军事经验和力量。
description.en: A series of protracted military conflicts between the Han dynasty and the Qiang tribes in the west during the Eastern Han period. Dong Zhuo rose to prominence during these wars, accumulating military experience and power.

description.zh-cn: 东汉名将，曾任护匈奴中郎将。董卓早期曾在其麾下担任军司马，参与讨伐羌人。
description.en: A famous general of the Eastern Han dynasty who served as the Protector of the Xiongnu. Dong Zhuo served under him as a major in his early career, participating in campaigns against the Qiang people.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民保险公司董事长兼总经理。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, former Chairman and General Manager of the People's Insurance Company of China.

description.zh-cn: 1895年至1946年间存在于马来半岛的英国保护国联邦，是慕沙希淡的出生地。
description.en: A federation of British protectorates in the Malay Peninsula from 1895 to 1946, and the birthplace of Musa Hitam.

zh-cn: 阿末沙 (马来西亚最高元首)

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第七任最高元首，是慕沙希淡担任副首相期间的国家元首之一。
description.en: The 7th Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia, one of the heads of state during Musa Hitam's tenure as Deputy Prime Minister.

description.en: The State Council Legislative Affairs Office was an administrative office of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for government legal affairs and assisting the Premier. It was established twice (1954-1959, 1986-1998) as a predecessor body. From March 1998, it operated as a ministerial-level office. description.en: A former editor at China Central Television and the second wife of Zhou Yongkang, a former member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party. In 2016, she was sentenced to nine years in prison for bribery and accepting bribes by using influence.

description.zh-cn: 在三党不过半的国会格局下，民众党的投票意向成为关键。最终民众党在第二轮投票弃权，使得国民党籍的韩国瑜当选院长。
description.en: In a hung parliament, the TPP's voting decision became crucial. Ultimately, the TPP abstained in the second round, leading to the election of KMT's Han Kuo-yu as speaker.

description.zh-cn: 由国民党主席朱立伦号召的游行，旨在抗议检调就罢免案连署对国民党进行的调查，民众党主席黄国昌亦出席声援。
description.en: A protest rally called by KMT Chairman Eric Chu to protest the prosecutorial investigation into the KMT over recall petition signatures, which was also attended by TPP Chairman Huang Kuo-chang in support.

description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the KMT. In the 2024 Keelung legislative election, he was successfully elected after the TPP yielded the race, marking a successful case of Blue-White cooperation.

description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，张庆伟的前任中共黑龙江省委书记。
description.en: A Chinese politician, Zhang Qingwei's predecessor as Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，曾任云贵总督，在重九起义中被蔡锷逮捕。中华民国初年，他成为政治人物，并曾任国务总理。
description.en: A late Qing official, he served as the Viceroy of Yungui and was arrested by Cai E during the Double Ninth Uprising. In the early Republic of China, he became a political figure and served as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 民国初年北京八大胡同名妓。蔡锷曾假装迷恋她以麻痹袁世凯的监视。
description.en: A famous courtesan in Beijing's Bada hutong during the early Republic. Cai E pretended to be infatuated with her to mislead Yuan Shikai's surveillance.

description.zh-cn: 由蔡锷于1911年辑录曾国藩、胡林翼治兵言论而成的军事著作。
description.en: A military work compiled by Cai E in 1911, consisting of sayings on military management by Zeng Guofan and Hu Linyi.

description.zh-cn: 清代湖南省宝庆府下辖的一个州，是蔡锷的出生地。
description.en: A prefecture under Baoqing Fu, Hunan Province, during the Qing dynasty, and the birthplace of Cai E.

description.zh-cn: 蔡锷与潘蕙英的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Cai E and Pan Huiying.

description.zh-cn: 滇军将领，在蔡锷任四川督军但因病无法视事时，代行其职务。
description.en: A general of the Yunnan Army who acted on behalf of Cai E when Cai was appointed Military Governor of Sichuan but was too ill to perform his duties.

description.zh-cn: 中国同盟会成员，曾与蔡锷、唐继尧在昆明发动重九起义。中华民国时期政治家，曾被黎元洪任命为代理国务总理，但未获承认。
description.en: A member of the Tongmenghui, he launched the Double Ninth Uprising in Kunming along with Cai E and Tang Jiyao. He was a politician during the Republic of China period, who was appointed Acting Premier by Li Yuanhong but was not recognized.

description.zh-cn: 明光宗的妃嫔，崇祯帝的庶母，曾抚养年幼的崇祯帝。她还曾在明熹宗即位之初占据乾清宫，意图垂帘听政，引发著名的“移宫案”。
description.en: A consort of the Taichang Emperor and a surrogate mother to the Chongzhen Emperor, who raised him in his youth. She also famously occupied the Qianqing Palace upon the Tianqi Emperor's accession, attempting to rule as regent, which led to the 'Palace Removal Case'.

description.zh-cn: 明光宗的妃嫔，崇祯帝的庶母，曾抚养崇祯帝至成人。
description.en: A consort of the Taichang Emperor and a surrogate mother to the Chongzhen Emperor, who raised him to adulthood.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝的皇后，明朝灭亡时奉崇祯帝之命自尽。
description.en: The empress of the Chongzhen Emperor, who committed suicide at his command upon the fall of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝的嫡长子，明朝太子。北京城陷后下落不明。
description.en: The eldest son and crown prince of the Chongzhen Emperor. His whereabouts became unknown after the fall of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝的贵妃。明朝灭亡时奉命自缢未死，被崇祯帝砍伤，后由清廷赡养。
description.en: A noble consort of the Chongzhen Emperor. During the fall of the Ming, she survived a suicide attempt ordered by the emperor and was subsequently wounded by him. She was later cared for by the Qing court.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝的女儿。明朝灭亡时被崇祯帝砍断手臂，但幸存下来。
description.en: A daughter of the Chongzhen Emperor. Her arm was severed by her father during the fall of the Ming dynasty, but she survived.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝的女儿，明朝灭亡时被崇祯帝亲手杀死。
description.en: A daughter of the Chongzhen Emperor, who was killed by her father during the fall of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明末司礼监秉笔太监，在崇祯帝自缢后，随之殉国。
description.en: A directorate of ceremonial scribe eunuch in the late Ming dynasty who committed suicide after the Chongzhen Emperor hanged himself.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京的皇家园林，明代时称万岁山。崇祯帝在此自缢殉国。
description.en: A royal park in Beijing, known as Wansui Hill during the Ming dynasty. It is the site where the Chongzhen Emperor committed suicide by hanging.

It was one of the participating units of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, with one of its divisions participating in the attack east of Unsan during the First Phase Offensive. Yu Yongbo served for a long time in this unit as its political commissar.

description.en: South Korean politician who served as Minister of Justice and had intense conflicts with then-Prosecutor General Yoon Suk Yeol.

description.zh-cn: 韩国政治人物，曾任法务部长，因涉嫌以权谋私而受到尹锡悦领导的检方调查。
description.en: South Korean politician who served as Minister of Justice and was investigated by the prosecution led by Yoon Suk Yeol on suspicion of abuse of power.

description.en: South Korean politician who merged his campaign with Yoon Suk Yeol to form a single candidacy in the 2022 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国举行的第20届总统选举，尹锡悦以微弱优势击败李在明当选。
description.en: The 20th presidential election held in South Korea, where Yoon Suk Yeol was elected after defeating Lee Jae-myung by a narrow margin.

description.zh-cn: 韩国检察机关的最高职位。
description.en: The highest position in the South Korean prosecution service.

description.zh-cn: 韩国的法院之一，曾于1996年一审判处全斗焕死刑，并审理了尹锡悦内乱案，签发了逮捕令。
description.en: One of the courts in South Korea, which initially sentenced Chun Doo-hwan to death in 1996, and also tried Yoon Suk Yeol's sedition case, issuing arrest warrants.

description.zh-cn: 韩国司法机关因戒严事件对时任及前任总统尹锡悦采取的逮捕行动。尹锡悦于2025年1月15日首次被捕，成为韩国宪政史上首位被捕的现任总统。后于同年7月10日再次被捕。
description.en: Arrest actions taken by South Korean judicial authorities against then and former President Yoon Suk Yeol in connection with the martial law incident. Yoon was first arrested on January 15, 2025, becoming the first sitting president in South Korean constitutional history to be arrested. He was arrested again on July 10 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，曾在安倍内阁中担任外务大臣等职。他现任日本第100、101任内阁总理大臣。安倍晋三去世后，他决定为其举行国葬。他也是石破茂的前任内阁总理大臣和自由民主党总裁。
description.en: A Japanese politician who served as Minister for Foreign Affairs in the Abe cabinet. He is currently the 100th and 101st Prime Minister of Japan. After Shinzo Abe's death, he decided to hold a state funeral for him. He also served as Shigeru Ishiba's predecessor as Prime Minister of Japan and President of the Liberal Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国新疆军阀，曾任新疆省政府主席及新疆边防督办，于1933年新疆四一二政变中被驱逐。
description.en: A warlord in Xinjiang, Republic of China. He served as the Chairman of the Xinjiang Provincial Government and Xinjiang Border Defense Commissioner, and was ousted in the 1933 Xinjiang coup.

description.zh-cn: 1933年4月12日在新疆省会迪化发生的军事政变，导致省主席金树仁下台，为盛世才掌控新疆权力铺平了道路。
description.en: A military coup that took place in Dihua, the capital of Xinjiang Province, on April 12, 1933, which led to the downfall of Governor Jin Shuren and paved the way for Sheng Shicai to seize power in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国新疆军阀，曾任伊犁屯垦使，后与马仲英结成反盛联盟，兵败自杀。
description.en: A warlord in Xinjiang, Republic of China, who served as the Yili Reclamation Commissioner. He later formed an anti-Sheng alliance with Ma Zhongying and committed suicide after being defeated.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争末期，日军在河南、湖南和广西三省发起的大规模攻势。国民政府军队在此次会战中的失利，促使盛世才再次考虑投靠苏联。
description.en: A series of major battles launched by the Imperial Japanese Army in Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi provinces near the end of the Second Sino-Japanese War. The defeat of the Nationalist government forces in this campaign prompted Sheng Shicai to reconsider defecting back to the Soviet Union.

description.en: The 6th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, where Chen Zaidao served as Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 西汉音乐家、外戚。他是汉武帝宠妃李夫人的哥哥，贰师将军李广利的弟弟。因犯律受腐刑，后因其妹受宠而得势，官至协律都尉。李夫人去世后失宠，最终与弟弟李季一同被处决灭族。
description.en: A musician and imperial relative by marriage during the Western Han dynasty. He was the brother of Empress Li, a favorite consort of Emperor Wu of Han, and the brother of General Li Guangli. He was castrated for committing a crime but later rose to power as the Commander of Music due to his sister's favor. After Empress Li's death, he fell from grace and was eventually executed along with his younger brother Li Ji and their clan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在河南省设立的军事机构，陈再道曾任司令员。
description.en: A military organization established by the People's Liberation Army in Henan Province, where Chen Zaidao served as commander.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党理论家，中央文革小组成员。在七·二〇事件中遭到“百万雄师”群众组织围攻。
description.en: A theorist of the Communist Party of China and a member of the Central Cultural Revolution Group. He was besieged by the "Million Heroes" mass organization during the Wuhan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，时任武汉军区政治委员，在七·二〇事件后与陈再道一同被打倒。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, who was the political commissar of the Wuhan Military Region at the time. He was purged along with Chen Zaidao after the Wuhan Incident.

description.en: A mass organization in Wuhan during the Cultural Revolution, which besieged central delegation members Xie Fuzhi, Wang Li, and others during the Wuhan Incident.

description.en: An abbreviation for "Severe Crackdown on Criminal Activities" launched in mainland China from 1983, it was a large-scale campaign to improve public security.

description.en: A Chinese-American chemist, the founding Dean of the School of Physical Science and Technology at ShanghaiTech University, and a professor at the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 上海科技大学创业与管理学院助理院长。

description.zh-cn: 美国结构生物学家，上海科技大学iHuman研究所所长。
description.en: American structural biologist, Director of the iHuman Institute at ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 数学家，上海科技大学数学科学研究所创始所长。
description.en: Mathematician, founding Director of the Institute of Mathematical Sciences at ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 中国哲学家，上海科技大学人文科学研究院院长。
description.en: Chinese philosopher, Dean of the Institute of Humanities at ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理化学家和纳米科技专家，曾任中国科学院院长。
description.en: A Chinese physical chemist and nanoscientist, former President of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 共产主义是一项起源于十九世纪西欧工人运动的社会政治运动，旨在建立共产主义社会。它在全球范围内表现为共产主义政党和社会运动。赫鲁晓夫的秘密报告曾在此运动中引发思想混乱和分裂，如导致了中苏交恶。
description.en: Communism is a socio-political movement that originated from the 19th-century workers' movement in Western Europe, aiming to establish a communist society. It manifests globally as communist parties and social movements. Khrushchev's Secret Speech caused ideological confusion and schisms within this movement, notably leading to the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 罗莎·卢森堡的马克思主义理论，反对列宁主义的威权主义思想。
description.en: The Marxist theory of Rosa Luxemburg, which opposes the authoritarian ideas of Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 一本旨在记录共产主义政权下政治迫害和屠杀的书籍。
description.en: A book that aims to document political persecutions and mass killings under communist regimes.

description.zh-cn: 由黎智英创办的服装零售品牌。
description.en: A clothing retail brand founded by Jimmy Lai.

description.en: Hong Kong media professional who has succeeded Jimmy Lai as the chairman of Next Digital on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英的长子。
description.en: The eldest son of Jimmy Lai.

description.zh-cn: 香港新闻主播，黎智英次子黎耀恩的妻子。
description.en: Hong Kong news anchor, wife of Jimmy Lai's second son, Lai Yiu-yan.

description.zh-cn: 中国官方媒体用于批评四位香港民主派人士的称呼，黎智英被指为其中之首。
description.en: A term used by Chinese state media to criticize four Hong Kong pro-democracy figures, with Jimmy Lai identified as its leader.

description.zh-cn: 天主教香港教区荣休主教，曾接受黎智英的捐款用于教会工作。
description.en: Bishop Emeritus of the Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong, who received donations from Jimmy Lai for church work.

description.zh-cn: 美国前副国防部长，曾与黎智英在香港会面。
description.en: Former U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense who met with Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong.

zh-cn: 「煞停警黑乱港 落实五大诉求」集会

description.zh-cn: 2019年8月18日在香港维多利亚公园举行的集会，黎智英因参与此未经批准的集结而被判刑。
description.en: A rally held at Victoria Park in Hong Kong on August 18, 2019. Jimmy Lai was sentenced for participating in this unauthorized assembly.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月1日在中国国庆日期间香港发生的游行示威活动，黎智英因参与此未经批准的集结而被判刑。
description.en: Protests and demonstrations that took place in Hong Kong on China's National Day, October 1, 2019. Jimmy Lai was sentenced for participating in this unauthorized assembly.

description.zh-cn: 每年在香港维多利亚公园举行的纪念六四事件的烛光晚会。黎智英因参与2020年未经批准的集会而被判刑。
description.en: An annual candlelight vigil held in Victoria Park, Hong Kong, to commemorate the Tiananmen Square protests. Jimmy Lai was sentenced for participating in the unauthorized 2020 assembly.

description.zh-cn: 壹传媒集团行政总监，与黎智英一同因欺诈罪被定罪。
description.en: Administrative director of Next Digital, convicted of fraud alongside Jimmy Lai.

description.zh-cn: 开滦矿务局，中国历史悠久的大型煤炭企业，位于中国河北省唐山市，曾是“学大庆，赶开滦”运动中的榜样之一。
description.en: Kailuan Mining Administration, a large, long-established coal enterprise located in Tangshan, Hebei Province, China. It was once one of the models in the 'Learn from Daqing, Catch up with Kailuan' movement.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期在河北省东部地区由中国共产党领导的抗日武装力量。
description.en: An anti-Japanese armed force led by the Communist Party of China in the eastern Hebei region during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 江油市下辖的镇，据称为李白的故乡。
description.en: A town under the jurisdiction of Jiangyou City, claimed to be the hometown of Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任河南省委书记，在汶川地震后推动了对江油的援建工作。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Party Secretary of Henan Province and promoted the reconstruction aid efforts for Jiangyou after the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 位于江油市窦圌山的寺庙，为全国重点文物保护单位，在汶川地震中严重受损。
description.en: A temple located on Douyi Mountain in Jiangyou City, a national key cultural relics protection unit, which was severely damaged in the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 位于江油市青莲镇的李白故居，在汶川地震中严重受损。
description.en: The former residence of Li Bai located in Qinglian Town, Jiangyou City, which was severely damaged in the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 国际红十字与红新月运动的成员，在汶川地震后对江油市进行了援助。
description.en: A member of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement that provided aid to Jiangyou City after the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 一个国际性的佛教组织，在汶川地震后捐款重建江油的学校。
description.en: An international Buddhist organization that donated funds to rebuild a school in Jiangyou after the Wenchuan earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾政治人物，前总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特之女，于2022年当选为菲律宾副总统。
description.en: A Filipino politician, daughter of former president Rodrigo Duterte, who was elected Vice President of the Philippines in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾政治人物，2016年至2022年担任菲律宾总统，任内发起了大规模的“毒品战争”。
description.en: A Filipino politician who served as the President of the Philippines from 2016 to 2022, known for initiating a large-scale "war on drugs".

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾前总统及独裁者，于1972年宣布戒严，实行独裁统治，后在1986年的人民力量革命中被推翻。
description.en: Former President and dictator of the Philippines who declared martial law in 1972, ruling as a dictator until he was overthrown in the 1986 People Power Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾的国家元首、政府首脑兼武装部队总司令。
description.en: The head of state, head of government, and commander-in-chief of the armed forces of the Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾的第二高行政官员。
description.en: The second-highest executive official of the Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪的西班牙国王，菲律宾国名即以其名字命名。
description.en: A 16th-century King of Spain, after whom the Philippines is named.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾人民为争取民族独立、推翻西班牙殖民统治而进行的革命。
description.en: A revolution by the people of the Philippines to gain independence from Spanish colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 在菲律宾革命后建立的亚洲第一个共和国，后因美菲战争而瓦解。
description.en: The first republic in Asia, established after the Philippine Revolution, which was later dissolved due to the Philippine-American War.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾革命领袖，菲律宾第一共和国总统。
description.en: A Filipino revolutionary leader and the first president of the First Philippine Republic.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾革命家，领导了反西班牙的起义，但后被埃米利奥·阿奎纳多篡夺领导权并杀害。
description.en: A Filipino revolutionary who led the uprising against Spain, but was later ousted and executed by Emilio Aguinaldo's faction.

description.zh-cn: 美国为确立对菲律宾的殖民统治而发动的战争，导致菲律宾第一共和国瓦解。
description.en: A war initiated by the United States to establish colonial rule over the Philippines, leading to the collapse of the First Philippine Republic.

description.zh-cn: 美国殖民统治下的菲律宾自治政府，是菲律宾独立的过渡时期。
description.en: The administrative body that governed the Philippines during the American colonial period, as a transitional phase to full independence.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，日本在菲律宾建立的傀儡政权。
description.en: A puppet state established in the Philippines by Japan during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 美国与菲律宾签署的条约，正式承认菲律宾共和国为独立国家。
description.en: A treaty signed by the United States and the Philippines that formally recognized the Republic of the Philippines as an independent nation.

zh-cn: 费迪南德·马科斯统治下的戒严令

description.zh-cn: 1972年，费迪南德·马科斯总统宣布在菲律宾实行戒严，开始其独裁统治，期间伴随着政治压迫和新闻审查。
description.en: In 1972, President Ferdinand Marcos declared martial law in the Philippines, beginning his dictatorial rule characterized by political oppression and press censorship.

description.zh-cn: 一场非暴力群众示威运动，导致独裁者费迪南德·马科斯下台。
description.en: A series of nonviolent mass demonstrations that led to the downfall of dictator Ferdinand Marcos.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾政治人物，已故反对派领袖小贝尼格诺·阿基诺的遗孀。在1986年人民力量革命后成为菲律宾总统。
description.en: A Filipino politician and the widow of assassinated opposition leader Benigno Aquino Jr. She became president of the Philippines after the 1986 People Power Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾反对党领袖，费迪南德·马科斯的头号政敌，于1983年在马尼拉国际机场遇刺身亡。
description.en: A Filipino opposition leader and the chief political rival of Ferdinand Marcos, who was assassinated at Manila International Airport in 1983.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾前总统费迪南德·马科斯的妻子，被指控与丈夫共同贪污及挪用巨额公款。
description.en: The wife of former Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos, accused of corruption and embezzling vast sums of public funds with her husband.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾政治人物，柯拉蓉·艾奎诺与小贝尼格诺·阿基诺之子，于2010年至2016年担任菲律宾总统。
description.en: A Filipino politician, son of Corazon Aquino and Benigno Aquino Jr., who served as the President of the Philippines from 2010 to 2016.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾前总统，因腐败指控在2001年的人民力量革命中下台。
description.en: Former President of the Philippines who was ousted in the 2001 People Power Revolution due to corruption allegations.

description.zh-cn: 一场大规模街头抗议活动，导致时任总统约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达下台。
description.en: A series of large-scale street protests that led to the ousting of then-President Joseph Estrada.

description.zh-cn: 由总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特发起的打击贩毒产业的行动，因其法外处决行为而备受争议。
description.en: A campaign against the drug trade initiated by President Rodrigo Duterte, which has been controversial due to its extrajudicial killings.

description.zh-cn: 此次选举中，小费迪南德·马科斯当选为总统，萨拉·杜特尔特当选为副总统。
description.en: In this election, Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was elected president and Sara Duterte was elected vice president.

description.zh-cn: 中国魏晋南北朝时期的世家大族门阀。
description.en: The powerful and aristocratic clans in China during the Wei, Jin, and Southern and Northern Dynasties.

en: Cao Pi's invasions of Eastern Wu

description.zh-cn: 曹丕在位期间三次对孙吴发动的军事行动，均未成功。
description.en: Three unsuccessful military campaigns launched by Cao Pi against Sun Wu during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，现任巫统主席。在安华内阁中被任命为副首相。
description.en: Malaysian politician, current President of UMNO. Appointed as Deputy Prime Minister in Anwar's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的一个政党，于2003年与国民公正党合并，组成人民公正党。
description.en: A political party in Malaysia that merged with the National Justice Party in 2003 to form the People's Justice Party.

description.zh-cn: 安华·依布拉欣的母校之一，他在1974年至1975年监禁期间在此修读文学硕士。
description.en: One of Anwar Ibrahim's alma maters, where he studied for a Master of Arts during his imprisonment from 1974 to 1975.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的最高法院。该法院在2004年推翻了对安华的第一次鸡奸罪判决，但在2015年维持了对他的第二次鸡奸罪判决。
description.en: The highest court in Malaysia. It overturned Anwar's first sodomy conviction in 2004 but upheld his second sodomy conviction in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第15届全国大选，选举结果出现悬峙议会，经过数日协商，安华最终获任命为首相。
description.en: The 15th Malaysian general election, which resulted in a hung parliament. After several days of negotiations, Anwar was eventually appointed Prime Minister.

location.zh-cn: 马来亚联邦槟城威南县
location.en: South Seberang Perai District, Penang, Federation of Malaya

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，中华民国国民政府划分的战区之一。
description.en: One of the war zones designated by the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 新四军副官，在皖南事变后杀害了项英和周子昆。
description.en: An adjutant in the New Fourth Army who murdered Xiang Ying and Zhou Zikun after the Southern Anhui Incident.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Shen Congwen.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文的次子。
description.en: The second son of Shen Congwen.

description.zh-cn: 湘西护国联军将领，沈从文的早期上级和支持者。
description.en: A general of the Xiangxi National Protection Army, and an early superior and supporter of Shen Congwen.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代作家，与沈从文、丁玲共同创办红黑出版社。
description.en: A modern Chinese writer who co-founded the Honghei Publishing House with Shen Congwen and Ding Ling.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代一所大学，位于上海。
description.en: A university in modern China, located in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代小说家，沈从文在西南联大的学生。
description.en: A modern Chinese novelist who was a student of Shen Congwen at Southwest Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 中国国学大师，曾在西南联大反对提升沈从文为教授。
description.en: A master of Chinese traditional studies who opposed Shen Congwen's promotion to professor at Southwest Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代诗人、翻译家，笔名穆旦。曾批评引荐沈从文到西南联大任教一事。
description.en: A modern Chinese poet and translator, pen name Mu Dan. He criticized the recommendation of Shen Congwen to teach at Southwest Associated University.

en: Institute of History, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
zh-cn: 中国社会科学院古代史研究所
中国社会科学院历史研究所

description.zh-cn: 中国社会科学院下属的研究机构，专注于中国历史研究。
description.en: A research institution under the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, focusing on Chinese history research.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典汉学家，诺贝尔文学奖终身评审委员，高度评价沈从文并支持其获得诺贝尔奖。
description.en: A Swedish sinologist and a lifelong member of the Nobel Prize Committee for Literature, who highly praised Shen Congwen and supported his candidacy for the Nobel Prize.

description.zh-cn: 清代湖南省的一个行政区划，为沈从文的出生地。
description.en: An administrative division in Hunan Province during the Qing Dynasty, and the birthplace of Shen Congwen.

description.zh-cn: 与沈从文相识的文人。
description.en: A man of letters acquainted with Shen Congwen.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文的岳父，张兆和的父亲。
description.en: Shen Congwen's father-in-law, Zhang Zhaohe's father.

description.zh-cn: 张兆和的姐姐，沈从文的大姨子。
description.en: Zhang Zhaohe's elder sister, Shen Congwen's sister-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 张兆和的姐姐，沈从文的大姨子。
description.en: Zhang Zhaohe's elder sister, Shen Congwen's sister-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 张兆和的妹妹，沈从文的小姨子。
description.en: Zhang Zhaohe's younger sister, Shen Congwen's sister-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文的襟兄弟（妻子的姐妹的丈夫）。
description.en: Shen Congwen's brother-in-law (husband of his wife's sister).

description.zh-cn: 沈从文的襟兄弟（妻子的姐妹的丈夫）。
description.en: Shen Congwen's brother-in-law (husband of his wife's sister).

description.zh-cn: 沈从文的襟兄弟（妻子的姐妹的丈夫）。
description.en: Shen Congwen's brother-in-law (husband of his wife's sister).

en: A Study of Ancient Chinese Costume

description.zh-cn: 沈从文在中止文学创作后，转入历史文物研究的主要学术著作，于1981年出版。
description.en: The main academic work of Shen Congwen after he stopped literary creation and turned to historical and cultural relics research, published in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 1927年11月17日，张发奎与黄琪翔在广州发动的政变，驱逐了桂系势力。此事件导致广州城防空虚，为中共发动广州起义提供了时机。
description.en: A coup launched by Zhang Fakui and Huang Qixiang in Guangzhou on November 17, 1927, to expel the Guangxi clique's influence. This event left Guangzhou's defenses vulnerable, providing an opportunity for the CCP to launch the Guangzhou Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员。复旦大学化学系分析化学专业毕业。曾任中共江苏句容县委副书记、县长，镇江市副市长、市长、市委书记、市人大常委会主任，江苏省人大常委会副主任等职。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a member of the Communist Party of China. Graduated from the Department of Chemistry at Fudan University with a major in Analytical Chemistry. He has held various positions including Deputy Secretary of the CPC Jurong County Committee and County Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Mayor, Party Secretary, and Director of the Standing Committee of the Municipal People's Congress of Zhenjiang City, and Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

nodes.id: BAIDU:中国共产党镇江市委员会

zh-cn: 中国共产党镇江市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在江苏省镇江市的地方组织。
description.en: The local organization of the Communist Party of China in Zhenjiang City, Jiangsu Province.

zh-cn: 江苏省人民代表大会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省人民代表大会的常设机关。
description.en: The standing committee of the People's Congress of Jiangsu Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，方之焯在中共镇江市委书记职位上的继任者。
description.en: A Chinese politician, successor to Fang Zhizhuo as Party Secretary of Zhenjiang.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚政治人物，担任克罗地亚总统。
description.en: Croatian politician, serving as the President of Croatia.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚政治人物，担任克罗地亚总理。
description.en: Croatian politician, serving as the Prime Minister of Croatia.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚共和国的一院制立法机关。
description.en: The unicameral legislature of the Republic of Croatia.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚历史上的第一位国王，于925年将两个公国统一为克罗地亚王国。
description.en: The first king of Croatia, who united two duchies into the Kingdom of Croatia in 925.

zh-cn: 克罗埃西亚王国 (中世纪)
斐迪南一世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡王朝的奥地利国王，1527年被克罗地亚议会推选为克罗地亚国王。
description.en: King of Austria from the House of Habsburg, elected as King of Croatia by the Croatian Parliament in 1527.

zh-cn: 克罗埃西亚联合哈布斯堡帝国
克罗地亚社会主义共和国
克罗埃西亚社会主义共和国

description.zh-cn: 南斯拉夫社会主义联邦共和国的加盟共和国之一。
description.en: One of the constituent republics of the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.

zh-cn: 塞尔维亚人、克罗埃西亚人和斯洛维尼亚人王国

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间由轴心国在南斯拉夫境内扶植的傀儡政权。
description.en: A puppet state of Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy during World War II.

zh-cn: 南斯拉夫人民解放军和游击队

description.zh-cn: 由约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托领导的第二次世界大战期间在南斯拉夫抵抗轴心国占领的共产党多民族反抗军。
description.en: The communist-led multi-ethnic resistance force against the Axis powers in occupied Yugoslavia during World War II, led by Josip Broz Tito.

zh-cn: 塞尔维亚克拉伊纳共和国

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚独立战争期间，克罗地亚境内的塞尔维亚人自行宣布成立的国家，未获国际承认。
description.en: A self-proclaimed state within Croatia, declared during the Croatian War of Independence by local Serbs, which was not internationally recognized.

description.zh-cn: 1995年11月在美国俄亥俄州代顿市达成的和平协议，结束了波斯尼亚战争及克罗地亚独立战争的部分战事。
description.en: A peace agreement reached in Dayton, Ohio, in November 1995, which ended the Bosnian War and parts of the Croatian War of Independence.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚政治家，克罗地亚独立后的第一任总统。
description.en: Croatian politician and the first President of Croatia after its independence.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚政治家，曾任克罗地亚总统。
description.en: Croatian politician who served as the President of Croatia.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚法西斯组织乌斯塔沙的创始人和领导人，二战期间克罗地亚独立国的领导人。
