description.en: Founder and leader of the Croatian fascist organization Ustaše and the leader of the Independent State of Croatia during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 由安特·帕韦利奇建立的克罗地亚法西斯、极端民族主义组织。
description.en: A Croatian fascist, ultranationalist organization founded by Ante Pavelić.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，金雀花王朝成员。因对法兰西王位的继承权主张而引发了百年战争。
description.en: King of England and a member of the House of Plantagenet. His claim to the French throne triggered the Hundred Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，瓦卢瓦王朝的开创者。他继承王位导致了与英王爱德华三世的冲突。
description.en: King of France and the founder of the House of Valois. His accession to the throne led to conflict with King Edward III of England.

description.zh-cn: 卡佩王朝最后一位国王，他的去世且无男性直系继承人，引发了法兰西的王位继承危机，成为百年战争的导火索。
description.en: The last king of the direct House of Capet. His death without a direct male heir caused a succession crisis in France, which became a catalyst for the Hundred Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，在普瓦捷战役中被英军俘虏。
description.en: King of France, captured by the English at the Battle of Poitiers.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，以其战略才能著称，在位期间收复了大量被英格兰占领的领土。
description.en: King of France, known for his strategic abilities, who recovered much of the territory lost to England during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，因患有精神疾病导致其统治期间法国陷入内战，并被迫签订《特鲁瓦条约》。
description.en: King of France, whose mental illness led to civil war in France during his reign and forced him to sign the Treaty of Troyes.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，在贞德的帮助下加冕并最终领导法国赢得百年战争的胜利。
description.en: King of France, who, with the help of Joan of Arc, was crowned and ultimately led France to victory in the Hundred Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西民族英雄，在百年战争后期带领法军取得关键胜利，扭转了战局，后被英格兰方面以异端罪名处死。
description.en: A national heroine of France who led the French army to key victories in the later stages of the Hundred Years' War, turning the tide of the conflict, before being executed for heresy by the English.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰兰开斯特王朝国王，在阿金库尔战役中取得决定性胜利，并通过《特鲁瓦条约》成为法国王位继承人。
description.en: King of England of the House of Lancaster, who won a decisive victory at the Battle of Agincourt and became heir to the French throne through the Treaty of Troyes.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，亨利五世之子，在其统治期间，英格兰在百年战争中最终战败。
description.en: King of England, son of Henry V, during whose reign England was ultimately defeated in the Hundred Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 英王爱德华三世的长子，杰出的军事指挥官，在普瓦捷战役中大败法军并俘虏法王约翰二世。
description.en: The eldest son of King Edward III of England, an outstanding military commander who defeated the French army and captured King John II at the Battle of Poitiers.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西的强大封国，在百年战争中曾是英格兰的重要盟友，后于1435年转向支持法兰西。
description.en: A powerful vassal state of France, which was an important ally of England during the Hundred Years' War before switching its allegiance to France in 1435.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争中的关键战役，英王亨利五世率领的英军以少胜多，重创法军。
description.en: A key battle in the Hundred Years' War where the English army, led by King Henry V, achieved a major victory against a numerically superior French army.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争早期英军的重大胜利，由黑太子爱德华指挥，法王约翰二世在此战中被俘。
description.en: A major English victory in the early phase of the Hundred Years' War, commanded by Edward the Black Prince, where King John II of France was captured.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争中的一场重要战役，英格兰长弓手在此战中展现了巨大优势，击败了法军。
description.en: An important battle in the Hundred Years' War where English longbowmen demonstrated their significant advantage, defeating the French army.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争的转折点，圣女贞德率领法军成功解除英军对奥尔良的包围。
description.en: The turning point of the Hundred Years' War, where Joan of Arc led the French army to successfully lift the English siege of Orléans.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争的最后一场主要战役，法军凭借火炮优势取得决定性胜利，标志着战争的结束。
description.en: The final major battle of the Hundred Years' War, where the French army achieved a decisive victory with its artillery superiority, marking the end of the war.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰与法兰西签订的条约，剥夺了王太子查理的继承权，并立英王亨利五世为法国王位继承人。
description.en: A treaty signed between England and France that disinherited the Dauphin Charles and made King Henry V of England the heir to the French throne.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争第一阶段结束后签订的和平条约，英格兰获得法兰西西南部大片领土的合法统治权。
description.en: A peace treaty signed after the first phase of the Hundred Years' War, granting England legal sovereignty over large areas in southwestern France.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西杰出的军事指挥官，在查理五世时期通过游击战术为法国收复了大量失地。
description.en: An outstanding French military commander who, during the reign of Charles V, recovered vast amounts of lost territory for France through guerrilla tactics.

description.zh-cn: 勃艮第公爵，因密谋刺杀奥尔良公爵路易而引发了法国的内战，后与英格兰结盟。
description.en: Duke of Burgundy, who triggered a civil war in France by orchestrating the assassination of Louis, Duke of Orléans, and later allied with England.

description.zh-cn: 法王查理六世之弟，在与勃艮第公爵的权力斗争中被刺杀，引发了阿马尼亚克派与勃艮第派内战。
description.en: Brother of King Charles VI of France, who was assassinated during a power struggle with the Duke of Burgundy, sparking the Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War.

zh-cn: 阿马尼亚克派与勃艮第派内战

description.zh-cn: 法兰西王国的一场内战，发生在奥尔良派（后称阿马尼亚克派）与勃艮第派之间，严重削弱了法国的实力，为英格兰的入侵创造了条件。
description.en: A civil war in the Kingdom of France between the Orléanist (later Armagnac) and Burgundian factions, which severely weakened France and created an opportunity for the English invasion.

description.zh-cn: 法王查理六世的女儿，根据《特鲁瓦条约》嫁给英王亨利五世，是亨利六世的母亲。
description.en: Daughter of King Charles VI of France, who married King Henry V of England according to the Treaty of Troyes and was the mother of Henry VI.

zh-cn: 第一代什鲁斯伯里伯爵约翰·塔尔博特

description.zh-cn: 百年战争末期著名的英格兰军事将领，在卡斯蒂永战役中战死。
description.en: A renowned English military commander in the later stages of the Hundred Years' War, who was killed at the Battle of Castillon.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，开国少将。曾任军事调处执行部中共代表、北海舰队政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army and a founding major general. He served as a CCP representative in the Military Mediation Executive Department and as the Political Commissar of the North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 中国江西省的一个县，是易耀彩的出生地。
description.en: A county in Jiangxi Province, China, the birthplace of Yi Yaocai.

description.zh-cn: 中国河北省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Hebei Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，在北海舰队政治委员职务上由易耀彩接任。
description.en: A general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, succeeded by Yi Yaocai as the Political Commissar of the North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，接替易耀彩担任北海舰队政治委员。
description.en: A general of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, who succeeded Yi Yaocai as the Political Commissar of the North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 在自家住宅旁围观圆环缉烟事件时，被查缉员傅学通开枪误杀的20岁市民。
description.en: A 20-year-old citizen who was watching the Roundabout Cigarette Incident from near his home and was accidentally shot and killed by agent Fu Xue-tong.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省政府曾设立的机构，负责烟、酒等专卖事务。其下属人员在圆环缉烟事件中的执法行为是二二八事件的导火索。
description.en: An agency established by the Taiwan Provincial Government of the Republic of China, responsible for monopoly control over items like tobacco and alcohol. The law enforcement actions of its personnel in the Roundabout Cigarette Incident triggered the February 28 Incident.

zh-cn: 台湾省行政长官公署卫兵开枪事件

description.zh-cn: 在圆环缉烟事件后，抗议民众集结于行政长官公署前请愿，公署卫兵无差别开枪射杀民众，造成多人死伤，是激化二二八事件的关键。
description.en: Following the Roundabout Cigarette Incident, protesters gathered in front of the Administrative Executive Office. Guards at the office indiscriminately fired upon the crowd, killing and injuring many, which critically escalated the February 28 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的最高审判机关，在圆环缉烟事件的审判中，将傅学通的死刑判决改为十年徒刑。
description.en: The highest judicial body of the Republic of China. In the trial related to the Roundabout Cigarette Incident, it commuted Fu Xue-tong's death sentence to a ten-year prison term.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任最高人民检察院副检察长、党组副书记，一级大检察官。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Procurator-General and Deputy Party Group Secretary of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and a Grand Procurator of the First Rank.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省聊城市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Liaocheng City, Shandong Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国青海省的一所广播电视大学。
description.en: A radio and television university located in Qinghai Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国青海省的省级检察机关。
description.en: The provincial-level procuratorial organ of Qinghai Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民检察院副检察长
最高人民检察院副检察长
en: Deputy Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民检察院的副职领导职务。
description.en: The deputy leadership position of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本东京的著名私立大学，章宗祥在此获得法学士学位。
description.en: A famous private university in Tokyo, Japan, where Zhang Zongxiang obtained his Bachelor of Laws degree.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北京政府时期的最高审判机关。章宗祥于1912年至1914年担任院长。
description.en: The supreme judicial body during the Beiyang government period of the Republic of China. Zhang Zongxiang served as its president from 1912 to 1914.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾是东京振武学校校友。他后来成为华北政务委员会委员长，并邀请章宗祥出任该委员会的咨询委员。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China and an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. He later became the chairman of the North China Political Council and invited Zhang Zongxiang to serve as an advisory committee member of the council.

description.zh-cn: 中国法学家，曾与章宗祥共同翻译日本刑法，并接替章宗祥担任大理院院长。
description.en: A Chinese jurist who co-translated the Japanese criminal code with Zhang Zongxiang and succeeded him as the President of the Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞政府向日本寺内正毅内阁进行的一系列借款，以中国的多种权益作为抵押。时任驻日公使的章宗祥是主要交涉人之一。
description.en: A series of loans from the Terauchi Masatake cabinet of Japan to the Duan Qirui government, secured by various Chinese interests. Zhang Zongxiang, then Minister to Japan, was one of the main negotiators.

description.zh-cn: 日本企业家、政治说客，作为日本首相寺内正毅的非正式代表，与章宗祥等人谈判并促成了“西原借款”。
description.en: A Japanese entrepreneur and political lobbyist who, as an informal representative of Japanese Prime Minister Terauchi Masatake, negotiated with Zhang Zongxiang and others to facilitate the 'Nishihara Loans'.

description.zh-cn: 对前苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林的个人崇拜现象，是赫鲁晓夫秘密报告批判的核心内容之一。
description.en: The personality cult of former Soviet leader Joseph Stalin, which was a central theme of criticism in Khrushchev's Secret Speech.

zh-cn: 以色列情报及特别行动局

description.zh-cn: 以色列的情报机构，从波兰华沙获得了赫鲁晓夫秘密报告的完整演讲稿，并将其转交美国。
description.en: The national intelligence agency of Israel, which obtained a complete copy of Khrushchev's Secret Speech from Warsaw, Poland, and passed it to the United States.

zh-cn: 苏联共产党中央政治局
en: Politburo of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Presidium of the Central Committee of the CPSU

description.zh-cn: 苏联共产党的最高决策机构之一，同意了赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上作关于个人崇拜报告的提议。
description.en: One of the highest decision-making bodies of the CPSU, which agreed to Khrushchev's proposal to deliver a report on the cult of personality at the 20th Party Congress.

description.zh-cn: 苏联共产党官员，领导一个专门委员会调查斯大林时期的政治迫害案件，并负责起草了赫鲁晓夫秘密报告的初稿。
description.en: A CPSU official who led a special commission to investigate cases of political persecution during the Stalin era and was responsible for drafting the initial version of Khrushchev's Secret Speech.

description.zh-cn: 时任波兰统一工人党第一书记，在参加苏共二十大期间，因读到赫鲁晓夫的秘密报告后遭受强烈刺激，突发心脏病猝死。
description.en: Then First Secretary of the Polish United Workers' Party, who suffered a fatal heart attack in Moscow during the 20th CPSU Congress after being severely shocked by reading Khrushchev's Secret Speech.

en: Communist Party of the Russian Federation

description.zh-cn: 苏联解体后在俄罗斯成立的共产党，自认为是苏联共产党的继承者。
description.en: A communist party in Russia established after the dissolution of the Soviet Union, considering itself the successor to the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间晋察冀野战军发起的一场战役。
description.en: A campaign launched by the Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei Field Army during the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，国民革命军第三军军长，在清风店战役中被俘。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army and commander of the 3rd Corps of the National Revolutionary Army, captured in the Qingfengdian Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 对中国人民解放军三位杨姓高级将领杨得志、杨勇、杨成武的合称。
description.en: A collective term for three senior generals of the People's Liberation Army with the surname Yang: Yang Dezhi, Yang Yong, and Yang Chengwu.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武之子，曾任中国人民解放军空军副司令员，中将军衔。
description.en: Son of Yang Chengwu, former deputy commander of the People's Liberation Army Air Force with the rank of lieutenant general.

description.zh-cn: 1917年1月17日发出齐默尔曼电报的德国政府机构。
description.en: The German government agency that issued the Zimmermann Telegram on January 17, 1917.

description.zh-cn: 时任德国外交国务秘书，齐默尔曼电报的发出者。他在1917年3月3日公开承认电报的真实性。
description.en: The German State Secretary for Foreign Affairs at the time and the issuer of the Zimmermann Telegram. He publicly admitted the telegram's authenticity on March 3, 1917.

description.zh-cn: 英国海军部的情报机关，成功截获并破译了齐默尔曼电报。
description.en: An intelligence agency of the British Admiralty that successfully intercepted and deciphered the Zimmermann Telegram.

zh-cn: 美国加入第一次世界大战
en: American entry into World War I

description.zh-cn: 齐默尔曼电报的曝光是促使美国公众支持参战并最终对德宣战的关键事件。
description.en: The disclosure of the Zimmermann Telegram was a key event that prompted American public support for entering the war and ultimately declaring war on Germany.

description.zh-cn: 齐默尔曼电报发往墨西哥的发出地点。
description.en: The location from which the Zimmermann Telegram was dispatched to Mexico.

description.zh-cn: 德国在齐默尔曼电报中承诺帮助墨西哥收复的美国领土之一。
description.en: One of the U.S. territories that Germany promised to help Mexico reconquer in the Zimmermann Telegram.

description.zh-cn: 德国在齐默尔曼电报中承诺帮助墨西哥收复的美国领土之一。
description.en: One of the U.S. territories that Germany promised to help Mexico reconquer in the Zimmermann Telegram.

description.zh-cn: 德国在齐默尔曼电报中承诺帮助墨西哥收复的美国领土之一。
description.en: One of the U.S. territories that Germany promised to help Mexico reconquer in the Zimmermann Telegram.

zh-cn: 尼德迈尔-亨蒂格探险队

description.zh-cn: 一次前往阿富汗的德国任务，其失败导致成员威廉·瓦斯穆斯遗弃了密码本，使得英国能够破译齐默尔曼电报。
description.en: A German mission to Afghanistan whose failure led to member Wilhelm Wassmuss abandoning a codebook, which enabled the British to decipher the Zimmermann Telegram.

description.zh-cn: 时任墨西哥总统，在评估了德国的提议后，于1917年4月14日正式拒绝了齐默尔曼电报中的结盟计划。
description.en: The President of Mexico at the time, who, after evaluating Germany's proposal, formally rejected the alliance plan in the Zimmermann Telegram on April 14, 1917.

description.zh-cn: 墨西哥当时正陷入的内战，导致政局不稳，是墨西哥拒绝德国提议的重要原因之一。
description.en: The civil war in which Mexico was embroiled at the time, which led to political instability and was a significant reason for Mexico's rejection of the German proposal.

description.zh-cn: 其对跨大西洋航线的控制使得德国无法向墨西哥提供有效的军事援助，这是墨西哥拒绝结盟提议的考量之一。
description.en: Its control of the transatlantic shipping routes made it impossible for Germany to provide effective military aid to Mexico, which was a consideration in Mexico's rejection of the alliance proposal.

description.zh-cn: 日本国会的上议院，1947年随著《日本国宪法》的施行而成立，前身为贵族院。因其具有对国家政策再检视、反应多样民意、防止立法草率等特质，有“良识之府”的称呼。
description.en: The upper house of the National Diet of Japan, established on May 20, 1947, with the enforcement of the Constitution of Japan, succeeding the House of Peers. It is known as the "House of Good Sense" for its role in re-examining national policy, reflecting diverse public opinion, and preventing hasty legislation.

description.zh-cn: 日本的最高国家权力机关与唯一立法机关，由众议院和参议院构成。
description.en: The supreme organ of state power and sole law-making organ of Japan, consisting of the House of Representatives and the House of Councillors.

description.zh-cn: 日本帝国议会的上议院，是参议院的前身。
description.en: The upper house of the Imperial Diet of Japan, the predecessor to the House of Councillors.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，参议院副议长。
description.en: Japanese politician, Vice-Speaker of the House of Councillors.

en: The Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan (2020)

description.zh-cn: 日本的一个主要在野党。
description.en: A major opposition party in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本法学家、政治家，在二战后宪法制定过程中主张两院制。
description.en: Japanese jurist and statesman who advocated for a bicameral system during the post-WWII constitution drafting process.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，日本共产党委员长。
description.en: Japanese politician, Chairman of the Japanese Communist Party.

zh-cn: 天津市住房公积金管理中心
天津市住房资金管理中心

location.zh-cn: 天津市和平区大沽北路115号
location.en: 115 Dagu North Road, Heping District, Tianjin

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国天津市人民政府直属事业单位，主管天津市住房公积金的归集、使用和管理。
description.en: A public institution directly under the Tianjin Municipal People's Government, responsible for the collection, use, and management of the housing provident fund in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任扬州市人民政府市长、扬州市政协主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Mayor of the Yangzhou Municipal People's Government and former Chairman of the Yangzhou CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 任正非的前妻，任平和孟晚舟的母亲。
description.en: Ren Zhengfei's ex-wife, mother of Ren Ping and Meng Wanzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中国山东省德州市下辖县，是时传祥的出生地。
description.en: A county under the administration of Dezhou City, Shandong Province, China, and the birthplace of Shi Chuanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国授予劳动者的最高荣誉称号，时传祥于1959年获得此称号。
description.en: The highest honorary title for laborers in the People's Republic of China, which Shi Chuanxiang received in 1959.

description.zh-cn: 时传祥的子女，曾担任北京市使馆清洁队垃圾分拣工。
description.en: A child of Shi Chuanxiang, who worked as a garbage sorter for the Beijing Embassy Cleaning Team.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期著名的海商与海盗，后期倭寇集团的重要人物。
description.en: A famous sea merchant and pirate during the Ming Dynasty, and a key figure in the later Wokou groups.

description.zh-cn: 日本封建时代对一个较大地域领主的称谓。
description.en: A title for powerful Japanese feudal lords who ruled most of Japan from their vast, hereditary land holdings.

description.zh-cn: 存在于10世纪至14世纪的朝鲜半岛王朝。
description.en: A Korean dynasty that existed from the 10th to the 14th century on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 日本江户时代的一个藩，位于现在的长崎县。
description.en: A feudal domain in Japan during the Edo period, located in modern-day Nagasaki Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 日本历史上介于镰仓时代与室町时代之间的战乱时期。
description.en: A period of civil war in Japanese history between the Kamakura and Muromachi periods.

description.zh-cn: 日本南北朝时代的南朝皇族，后醍醐天皇之子，曾因讨伐倭寇有功而被明朝封为“日本国王”。
description.en: A prince of the Southern Court during Japan's Nanboku-chō period, son of Emperor Go-Daigo. He was enfeoffed as 'King of Japan' by the Ming Dynasty for his merits in suppressing the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 日本第96代天皇，南北朝时代南朝的开创者。
description.en: The 96th emperor of Japan and the founder of the Southern Court during the Nanboku-chō period.

description.zh-cn: 日本室町幕府第三代将军，曾讨伐倭寇并受明朝册封为“日本国王”。
description.en: The third shogun of the Ashikaga shogunate of Japan, who suppressed the Wokou and was enfeoffed as 'King of Japan' by the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜王朝的开国君主，因讨伐倭寇有功而获得巨大声望和势力。
description.en: The founding monarch of the Joseon Dynasty, who gained great prestige and power for his merits in suppressing the Wokou.

en: Japan–China trade in the Muromachi period

description.zh-cn: 日本室町时代与中国明朝之间进行的官方贸易，其盛行是前期倭寇式微的原因之一。
description.en: The official trade conducted between Japan's Muromachi period and China's Ming Dynasty, the prevalence of which was one of the reasons for the decline of the early Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 明朝嘉靖二年，日本两个朝贡使团在宁波为争夺贸易勘合的合法性而引发的武装冲突事件，此后明朝中断了一切贸易。
description.en: An armed conflict in Ningbo in 1523 during the Ming Dynasty, sparked by two Japanese tribute missions vying for the legitimacy of trade tallies. Afterward, the Ming court suspended all trade.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代九州的大名，被认为是16世纪后期倭寇行动的实质总指挥。
description.en: A daimyō in Kyushu during Japan's Warring States period, considered the de facto commander of Wokou activities in the late 16th century.

description.zh-cn: 关于此人，存在两段独立描述：其一是明朝官员，曾总督数省军务，主持抗倭战争；其二是华中剿匪指挥部情报科科长，在吴石指示下向吴仲禧提供情报。
description.en: Regarding this person, two distinct descriptions exist: one as an official of the Ming Dynasty who served as supreme commander of several provinces and directed the war against the Wokou; the other as the head of the intelligence section of the Central China Bandit Suppression Command, who provided intelligence to Wu Zhongxi under Wu Shi's instruction.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，曾任浙江巡抚，力主严行海禁以杜绝倭寇。
description.en: An official of the Ming Dynasty who served as the governor of Zhejiang and strongly advocated for the strict enforcement of the Haijin to eliminate the Wokou threat.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜王朝对日本对马岛的军事远征，旨在清剿作为倭寇基地的岛屿。
description.en: A military expedition by the Joseon Dynasty against Japan's Tsushima Island, aimed at clearing the island which served as a Wokou base.

description.zh-cn: 由明代将领戚继光所著的兵书，详细描述了倭寇的装备、战法等。
description.en: A military manual written by the Ming Dynasty general Qi Jiguang, which details the equipment, tactics, and other aspects of the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年海盗，被视为倭寇的一员，曾为开发台湾的先驱。
description.en: A pirate in the late Ming Dynasty, considered a member of the Wokou, and a pioneer in the development of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期著名的海盗，被视为倭寇的一员。
description.en: A famous pirate during the Ming Dynasty, considered a member of the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年著名的海商、军事家和政治人物，早期曾为海盗，被视为倭寇的一员。
description.en: A famous sea merchant, military strategist, and politician in the late Ming Dynasty. In his early years, he was a pirate and considered a member of the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 倭寇头目，在朝鲜半岛活动。
description.en: A Wokou leader active on the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代平户的大名，与倭寇活动有关。
description.en: A daimyō of Hirado during Japan's Warring States period, associated with Wokou activities.

description.zh-cn: 明朝末年著名的海商与海盗，被视为倭寇的一员。
description.en: A famous sea merchant and pirate in the late Ming Dynasty, considered a member of the Wokou.

zh-cn: 中华民国宪法增修条文
en: Additional Articles of the Constitution of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 为应对两岸分治现实而对《中华民国宪法》进行的增修，在法律上定义了“自由地区”与“大陆地区”的概念。
description.en: Amendments to the Constitution of the Republic of China made to address the reality of cross-strait division, legally defining the concepts of 'Free Area' and 'Mainland Area'.

zh-cn: 台湾地区与大陆地区人民关系条例
en: Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area

description.zh-cn: 规范台湾地区与大陆地区人民往来及处理衍生法律事件的中华民国法律。
description.en: A law of the Republic of China that governs the interactions between people of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area and handles related legal matters.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大前国会议员、亚太司司长，与大卫·麦塔斯共同撰写了关于中国政府活摘法轮功学员器官的调查报告（乔高-麦塔斯调查报告）。
description.en: A former Canadian Member of Parliament and Secretary of State for Asia-Pacific, who co-authored an investigative report (the Kilgour-Matas report) with David Matas on allegations of organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners by the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大人权律师，与大卫·乔高共同撰写了关于中国政府活摘法轮功学员器官的调查报告（乔高-麦塔斯调查报告）。
description.en: A Canadian international human rights lawyer who co-authored an investigative report (the Kilgour-Matas report) with David Kilgour on allegations of organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners by the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 由大卫·乔高和大卫·麦塔斯撰写的调查报告，旨在调查关于中国共产党摘取法轮功学员器官的指控。报告结论认为指控可信，并提供了多种间接证据。
description.en: An investigative report authored by David Kilgour and David Matas to examine the allegations of organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners by the CCP. The report concluded that the allegations were credible and provided various forms of indirect evidence.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区第四届政府

description.zh-cn: 由行政长官梁振英领导的香港特别行政区政府。刘梦熊在与梁振英反目后，对此届政府持强烈批评态度。
description.en: The government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region led by Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying. After his falling out with Leung, Lew Mon-hung became a strong critic of this administration.

description.zh-cn: 香港的独立反贪机构，负责调查与东方明珠石油相关的案件，并拘捕了刘梦熊。
description.en: Hong Kong's independent anti-corruption agency, which investigated the Pearl Oriental Oil case and arrested Lew Mon-hung.

description.zh-cn: 时任香港廉政专员，在东方明珠案调查期间，曾收到刘梦熊要求终止调查的信件。
description.en: The then Commissioner of the Hong Kong ICAC, who received letters from Lew Mon-hung demanding the termination of the investigation into the Pearl Oriental case.

zh-cn: 华南师范大学附属中学
en: Affiliated High School of South China Normal University

description.zh-cn: 上市公司东方明珠石油主席，与刘梦熊一同因涉嫌行贿受贿被廉政公署拘捕。
description.en: Chairman of the listed company Pearl Oriental Oil, who was arrested by the ICAC along with Lew Mon-hung on suspicion of bribery.

description.zh-cn: 香港上市公司，刘梦熊曾任其副主席。该公司的一项石油业务投资引发了廉政公署的调查，并导致刘梦熊被捕及定罪。
description.en: A Hong Kong listed company where Lew Mon-hung served as vice-chairman. An investment in an oil business by the company triggered an ICAC investigation, leading to Lew's arrest and conviction.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆维权人士，“结石宝宝之家”发起人，为三聚氰胺毒奶粉事件受害儿童维权。刘梦熊曾公开声援他。
description.en: A mainland Chinese rights activist and founder of 'Kidney Stone Babies Home,' advocating for child victims of the melamine-tainted milk scandal. Lew Mon-hung publicly supported him.

description.zh-cn: 北京大学教授，曾发表辱骂港人的言论，刘梦熊对此予以批评。
description.en: A professor at Peking University whose derogatory remarks about Hong Kong people were criticized by Lew Mon-hung.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，时任中共天津市委书记，于1993年任内逝世。
description.en: Chinese politician, then Party Secretary of Tianjin, who died in office in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共十四届五中全会上由候补中央委员递补为中央委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, who was promoted from alternate member to full member of the Central Committee at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，回族，在中共十四届五中全会上由候补中央委员递补为中央委员。
description.en: Chinese politician of Hui ethnicity, who was promoted from alternate member to full member of the Central Committee at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共十四届六中全会上由候补中央委员递补为中央委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, who was promoted from alternate member to full member of the Central Committee at the Sixth Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在中共十四届七中全会上由候补中央委员递补为中央委员。
description.en: Chinese politician, who was promoted from alternate member to full member of the Central Committee at the Seventh Plenary Session of the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共湖北省委常委、组织部部长，湖北省政协副主席。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, former member of the Standing Committee and Director of the Organization Department of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, and former Vice Chairman of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖北省孝感市下辖的市辖区。
description.en: A district under the administration of Xiaogan City, Hubei Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华民国第一配偶列表
en: First Lady of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统配偶的头衔。
description.en: The title of the spouse of the President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国人物，蒋方良的前任中华民国第一夫人。
description.en: A figure in the Republic of China, Jiang Fangliang's predecessor as the First Lady of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国前总统李登辉的妻子，来自淡水郡的大地主家庭。她接替蒋方良成为中华民国第一夫人。
description.en: The wife of former ROC President Lee Teng-hui, from a prominent landowning family in Tamsui District. She succeeded Jiang Fangliang as the First Lady of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 白俄罗斯维捷布斯克州的一座城市，蒋方良的出生地。
description.en: A city in Vitebsk Region, Belarus, the birthplace of Jiang Fangliang.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统对国家或社会有贡献的国民及其事迹所给予的公开表扬。
description.en: A public commendation issued by the President of the Republic of China to citizens for their contributions to the nation or society.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党籍政治人物，曾任行政院文化建设委员会主任委员。在蒋方良告别式上为其灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: A KMT politician who served as Minister of the Council for Cultural Affairs. She covered Jiang Fangliang's coffin with the party flag at her funeral.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党籍政治人物，曾任海峡交流基金会董事长。在蒋方良告别式上为其灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: A KMT politician who served as Chairman of the Straits Exchange Foundation. He covered Jiang Fangliang's coffin with the party flag at her funeral.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党籍政治人物，曾任台湾省政府主席。在蒋方良告别式上为其灵柩覆盖国旗。
description.en: A KMT politician who served as Governor of Taiwan Province. He covered Jiang Fangliang's coffin with the national flag at her funeral.

description.zh-cn: 湘军将领，刘锦棠的叔父，在金积战役中阵亡。
description.en: A general of the Xiang Army, uncle of Liu Jintang, who was killed in the Battle of Jinji.

description.zh-cn: 晚清八旗将领，与刘锦棠一同参与收复新疆之战。
description.en: A Manchu general of the late Qing Dynasty who participated in the recovery of Xinjiang alongside Liu Jintang.

description.zh-cn: 陕甘回变领袖之一，后投降被刘锦棠处死。
description.en: A leader of the Dungan Revolt, who surrendered and was later executed by Liu Jintang.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在新疆建省后设立的最高地方行政长官职位。
description.en: The highest local administrative post established by the Qing Dynasty after Xinjiang became a province.

description.zh-cn: 清朝的一种贵族爵位。
description.en: A title of nobility in the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝中央机构兵部的副长官。
description.en: The deputy head of the Ministry of War in the central government of the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在新疆地区设立的最高军政长官。
description.en: The highest military and administrative official stationed in the Xinjiang region by the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝同治年间在中国西北地区爆发的一场大规模回民动乱。
description.en: A large-scale rebellion by the Hui people in Northwestern China during the Tongzhi era of the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年由左宗棠率领，旨在收复被阿古柏侵占的新疆地区的军事行动。
description.en: A military campaign in the late Qing Dynasty led by Zuo Zongtang to recover Xinjiang from the occupation of Yaqub Beg.

description.zh-cn: 早期基督教最具影响力的传教士和第一代领导人之一，被誉为‘外邦人的使徒’。他原名扫罗，曾是法利赛人并迫害基督徒，后在前往大马士革途中归信基督。他撰写了《新约圣经》中大部分书信，对基督教神学发展影响深远。
description.en: One of the most influential missionaries and first-generation leaders of early Christianity, known as the 'Apostle to the Gentiles'. Originally named Saul, he was a Pharisee who persecuted Christians before converting to Christ on the road to Damascus. He authored a significant portion of the New Testament epistles, profoundly influencing Christian theology.

description.zh-cn: 指从耶稣事工开始到公元325年第一次尼西亚公会议之间的基督教历史时期。保罗是此时期最关键的传教士和神学家。
description.en: Refers to the period of Christian history from the ministry of Jesus to the First Council of Nicaea in 325 AD. Paul was the most crucial missionary and theologian of this period.

description.zh-cn: 古犹太教的一个派别，强调严格遵守律法。保罗在归信基督前曾是其中一员。
description.en: A faction of ancient Judaism that emphasized strict observance of the law. Paul was a member before his conversion to Christianity.

description.zh-cn: 以色列十二支派之一，保罗出身于此支派。
description.en: One of the Twelve Tribes of Israel, from which Paul descended.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣的兄弟，耶路撒冷教会的领袖，曾与彼得一同接纳保罗。
description.en: Brother of Jesus and a leader of the Jerusalem church, who, along with Peter, accepted Paul.

description.zh-cn: 早期基督徒，保罗初期的传教伙伴，后因约翰·马可之事与保罗分离。
description.en: An early Christian and Paul's initial missionary partner, who later separated from Paul over a dispute concerning John Mark.

description.zh-cn: 古代基督教五大宗主教区之一，传统上认为保罗是其首位主教。
description.en: One of the five major patriarchates of ancient Christianity, which traditionally regards Paul as its first bishop.

description.zh-cn: 新约圣经中由使徒保罗写给各个早期基督教会或个人的信件的统称。
description.en: The collection of letters in the New Testament written by the Apostle Paul to various early Christian communities or individuals.

description.zh-cn: 基督教的经典文献，其中约三分之一的内容由保罗撰写。
description.en: The canonical scriptures of Christianity, approximately one-third of which was authored by Paul.

description.zh-cn: 塞浦路斯的一位法术师，因试图阻止保罗传教而被其暂时弄瞎。
description.en: A sorcerer in Cyprus who was temporarily blinded by Paul for opposing his preaching.

en: Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls

description.zh-cn: 位于罗马的一座天主教宗座圣殿，据信是为纪念使徒保罗殉道而建，并存放其骸骨。
description.en: A papal major basilica in Rome, believed to be built over the burial place of Saint Paul and to house his remains.

description.zh-cn: 一部中世纪反基督教的犹太文献，其中将保罗描绘为耶稣的反对者。
description.en: A medieval anti-Christian Jewish text which portrays Paul as an antagonist to Jesus.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京的贵族学校，范丞丞曾在此就读。
description.en: An elite school located in Beijing, China, where Fan Chengcheng once studied.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国的学校，范丞丞曾在此就读。
description.en: A school in the United States where Fan Chengcheng once studied.

description.zh-cn: 中国的艺人经纪公司。
description.en: A Chinese artist management company.

description.zh-cn: 中国偶像男团竞演养成类真人秀节目，范丞丞通过该节目出道。
description.en: A Chinese boy group survival reality show through which Fan Chengcheng debuted.

description.zh-cn: 通过爱奇艺选秀节目《偶像练习生》成立的中国男子限定团体。
description.en: A limited-time Chinese boy band formed through the iQIYI survival show "Idol Producer".

description.zh-cn: 乐华娱乐旗下的中国男子偶像团体。
description.en: A Chinese boy band under Yuehua Entertainment.

zh-cn: 北京市海淀区人民法院

description.zh-cn: 中国男歌手及音乐创作人。
description.en: Chinese male singer and music creator.

description.zh-cn: 中国说唱歌手。
description.en: Chinese rapper.

description.zh-cn: 中国说唱歌手。
description.en: Chinese rapper.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国山西省昔阳县的村庄，是陈永贵的家乡，也是“农业学大寨”运动的样板。
description.en: A village in Xiyang County, Shanxi Province, China, which is the hometown of Chen Yonggui and the model for the 'In agriculture, learn from Dazhai' movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国会计学家，曾任中央财政金融学院教授，中国会计学会顾问。
description.en: Chinese accountant, former professor at the Central Institute of Finance and Banking, and advisor to the Accounting Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性会计学术团体。
description.en: A national academic accounting organization in China.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪初中国青年赴海外半工半读的运动，陈延年曾参与其中。
description.en: A movement in the early 20th century for young Chinese people to study abroad while working part-time, in which Chen Yannian participated.

zh-cn: 中国共产党广东区执行委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在广东地区的早期组织，陈延年曾任书记。
description.en: An early organization of the Chinese Communist Party in the Guangdong region, where Chen Yannian served as secretary.

description.zh-cn: 1925年至1926年间在中国广州和英属香港发生的大规模罢工事件，陈延年是组织者之一。
description.en: A massive strike that took place in Guangzhou, China, and British Hong Kong from 1925 to 1926, which Chen Yannian helped organize.

description.zh-cn: 流经上海的河流，陈延年遇害后尸体被抛入此江。
description.en: A river flowing through Shanghai, into which Chen Yannian's body was thrown after his execution.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海的陵园，安葬有陈延年、陈乔年兄弟的衣冠冢。
description.en: A cemetery in Shanghai that houses the cenotaphs of the brothers Chen Yannian and Chen Qiaonian.

zh-cn: 中国共产党常宁市委员会
中国共产党常宁县委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在湖南省衡阳市常宁市的领导机关，前身是中国共产党常宁县委员会。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Changning, Hengyang, Hunan Province. Its predecessor was the Changning County Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 常宁市的国家行政机关。
description.en: The state administrative organ of Changning City.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，首任中共常宁县委书记。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, the first Party Secretary of Changning County Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共常宁市委书记。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, formerly served as the Party Secretary of Changning Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共常宁市委书记。
description.en: A Chinese political figure, formerly served as the Party Secretary of Changning Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 印度政治家，现任印度总统。
description.en: An Indian politician, the current President of India.

description.zh-cn: 印度的最高立法机关，实行两院制，包括联邦院和人民院。
description.en: The supreme legislative body of India, which is a bicameral legislature consisting of the Rajya Sabha (Council of States) and the Lok Sabha (House of the People).

description.zh-cn: 印度议会的上议院。
description.en: The upper house of the Parliament of India.

description.zh-cn: 印度议会的下议院。
description.en: The lower house of the Parliament of India.

description.zh-cn: 印度在1947年独立后至1950年成立共和国前作为英联邦内的一个独立自治领的国家实体。
description.en: The state entity of India as an independent dominion within the British Commonwealth after its independence in 1947 until the establishment of the republic in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 英国提出的关于英属印度独立的最后方案，核心内容是印巴分治。
description.en: The final plan proposed by the British for the independence of British India, the core of which was the partition of India and Pakistan.

description.zh-cn: 曾是位于喜马拉雅山脉的独立王国，1950年成为印度的保护国，并于1975年被印度正式吞并。
description.en: A former independent kingdom in the Himalayas, it became a protectorate of India in 1950 and was formally annexed by India in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 印度通过军事行动从葡萄牙手中夺取果阿地区控制权的事件。
description.en: The event in which India took control of the Goa region from Portugal through military action.

description.zh-cn: 印度与巴基斯坦之间的第三次大规模战争，印度的胜利直接促成了东巴基斯坦独立为孟加拉国。
description.en: The third major war between India and Pakistan. India's victory directly led to the independence of East Pakistan as Bangladesh.

description.zh-cn: 位于南亚的国家，原为巴基斯坦的东部地区（东巴基斯坦），在1971年印巴战争后独立。
description.en: A country in South Asia, formerly the eastern region of Pakistan (East Pakistan), which became independent after the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.

description.zh-cn: 印度政府针对锡克教分离主义分子的军事行动，该事件引发了广泛冲突并最终导致时任总理英迪拉·甘地被其锡克教保镖刺杀。
description.en: A military operation by the Indian government against Sikh separatists. The event triggered widespread conflict and ultimately led to the assassination of then-Prime Minister Indira Gandhi by her Sikh bodyguards.

description.zh-cn: 印度政治家，曾任印度总理，在金庙事件后遇刺身亡。
description.en: An Indian politician who served as Prime Minister of India and was assassinated after Operation Blue Star.

description.zh-cn: 印度的政府首脑，掌握实际行政权力。
description.en: The head of government of India, who holds real executive power.

description.zh-cn: 由美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度组成的战略对话机制，印度的参与被视为其应对中国影响力的举措。
description.en: A strategic dialogue mechanism composed of the United States, Japan, Australia, and India. India's participation is seen as a move to counter Chinese influence.

description.zh-cn: 印度共和国的整体军事组织，包括陆军、海军和空军。
description.en: The overall military organization of the Republic of India, including the Army, Navy, and Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 印度武装部队的海上分支，是世界第五大海军。
description.en: The naval branch of the Indian Armed Forces, it is the fifth largest navy in the world.

description.zh-cn: 印度武装部队的空中分支。
description.en: The air arm of the Indian Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 负责印度国家安全和武装部队的政府部门。
description.en: The government ministry responsible for national security and the armed forces of India.

description.zh-cn: 印度的海上执法和搜救机构，由印度国防部指挥。
description.en: A maritime law enforcement and search and rescue agency of India, commanded by the Ministry of Defence.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十六届中央委员会第四次全体会议
en: Fourth Plenary Session of the 16th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党的一次中央委员会全体会议，会上首次正式提出“构建社会主义和谐社会”的概念。
description.en: A plenary session of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China where the concept of 'building a socialist harmonious society' was formally proposed for the first time.

en: Euphemisms for Internet censorship in China

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆网民创造的网络用语，为“和谐”的谐音，用以讽刺中国网络审查制度。
description.en: An internet slang term created by mainland Chinese netizens, a homophone for 'harmony' (和谐), used to satirize the internet censorship system in China.

zh-cn: 整治互联网低俗之风专项行动
en: Special Campaign to Rectify Low-Taste Content on the Internet

description.zh-cn: 中国政府为创造“和谐社会”而进行的一系列互联网内容整治行动。
description.en: A series of internet content regulation campaigns conducted by the Chinese government to create a 'Harmonious Society'.

description.zh-cn: 中国网民创作的虚拟动物形象，用以讽刺政府的互联网审查行动。
description.en: A fictional creature created by Chinese netizens to satirize government internet censorship campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 美国第25任总统，在任内被无政府主义者刺杀身亡。
description.en: The 25th President of the United States, who was assassinated in office by an anarchist.

description.zh-cn: 导致时任美国总统威廉·麦金莱死亡的刺杀事件，副总统西奥多·罗斯福因此继任总统。
description.en: The assassination event that led to the death of U.S. President William McKinley, resulting in Vice President Theodore Roosevelt succeeding to the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 刺杀美国总统威廉·麦金莱的无政府主义者。
description.en: The anarchist who assassinated U.S. President William McKinley.

description.zh-cn: 位于中美洲国家巴拿马的穿洋运河，连接太平洋与大西洋。西奥多·罗斯福总统任内是其建设的关键时期。
description.en: A man-made waterway in Panama that connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Pacific Ocean. The presidency of Theodore Roosevelt was a key period for its construction.

description.zh-cn: 1912年由西奥多·罗斯福创建的美国第三方政党，旨在支持其竞选总统。
description.en: An American third party created by Theodore Roosevelt in 1912 to support his presidential campaign.

description.zh-cn: 美国商人和慈善家，西奥多·罗斯福总统的父亲。
description.en: American businessman and philanthropist, father of President Theodore Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 西奥多·罗斯福的第二任妻子。
description.en: Theodore Roosevelt's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军军官及历史学家，其海权理论深刻影响了西奥多·罗斯福。
description.en: American naval officer and historian whose sea power theories strongly influenced Theodore Roosevelt.

description.zh-cn: 由西奥多·罗斯福在美西战争期间组建和指挥的部队，俗称“莽骑兵”。
description.en: A unit commanded by Theodore Roosevelt during the Spanish–American War, popularly known as the "Rough Riders".

description.zh-cn: 明朝的末代皇帝。
description.en: The last emperor of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 缅甸东吁王朝国王，将永历帝献给吴三桂。
description.en: King of the Toungoo dynasty of Burma, who handed over the Yongli Emperor to Wu Sangui.

description.zh-cn: 明末清初诗人、学者，因创作讽刺吴三桂的《圆圆曲》而闻名。
description.en: A poet and scholar of the late Ming and early Qing dynasties, famous for writing "The Song of Yuanyuan," which satirized Wu Sangui.

description.zh-cn: 1964年为庆祝中华人民共和国成立十五周年而创作演出的大型音乐舞蹈史诗，纪录和歌颂了中国人民在中国共产党和毛泽东领导下的革命斗争历史。
description.en: A large-scale musical and dance epic created and performed in 1964 to celebrate the 15th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, documenting and eulogizing the history of the Chinese people's revolutionary struggle under the leadership of the Communist Party of China and Mao Zedong.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军政治工作部文工团
中国人民解放军空军政治部文工团

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军的文艺团体，创作了《革命历史歌曲表演唱》。
description.en: The cultural troupe of the People's Liberation Army Air Force, which created 'Revolutionary History Song Performance'.

description.zh-cn: 中国女高音歌唱家，在音乐舞蹈史诗《东方红》中担任《农友歌》的领唱。
description.en: A Chinese soprano who performed as the lead singer for the song 'Song of the Peasant Friends' in the musical and dance epic 'The East Is Red'.

description.zh-cn: 中国女高音歌唱家，在音乐舞蹈史诗《东方红》中独唱《南泥湾》。
description.en: A Chinese soprano who performed the solo 'Nanniwan' in the musical and dance epic 'The East Is Red'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中共元老及解放军高级将领何长工之子。曾任共青团中央书记处书记、国家旅游局局长、第十一届及第十二届全国政协常务委员。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, and the son of He Changgong, a veteran of the Communist Party of China and a senior general of the People's Liberation Army. He has served as Secretary of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, Director of the National Tourism Administration, and a Standing Committee member of the 11th and 12th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国湖南省岳阳市下辖县，是何光𬀩的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Yueyang City, Hunan Province, China, and the birthplace of He Guangwei.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家旅游局

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经的直属机构，负责管理旅游业。
description.en: A former agency directly under the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for managing the tourism industry.

description.zh-cn: 电影投资人，何光𬀩之子，何长工之孙。
description.en: Film investor, son of He Guangwei, and grandson of He Changgong.

description.zh-cn: 何刚的妻子。因在社交媒体发布其于故宫闭馆日驾车进入的照片而引发“女子开车进故宫事件”，造成广泛社会争议。
description.en: Wife of He Gang. She caused widespread social controversy by posting photos on social media of her driving into the Forbidden City on a closing day, leading to the 'woman driving into the Forbidden City' incident.

description.zh-cn: 指高露在社交媒体上发布其于故宫闭馆日开奔驰车进入的照片，引发公众舆论争议的事件。
description.en: Refers to the incident in which Gao Lu posted photos on social media of her driving a Mercedes-Benz into the Forbidden City on a closing day, sparking public controversy.

description.zh-cn: 忠旺集团创始人。其妻子Wang Zhijie名下的一处房产与“女子开车进故宫事件”的主角高露有关联。
description.en: Founder of Zhongwang Group. A property under his wife Wang Zhijie's name is associated with Gao Lu, the protagonist of the 'woman driving into the Forbidden City' incident.

description.zh-cn: 由刘忠田创办的公司。
description.en: A company founded by Liu Zhongtian.

description.zh-cn: 1973年12月，为防止军区司令员形成私人势力，中共中央军委对八大军区司令员进行了调动。
description.en: In December 1973, the CPC Central Military Commission transferred the commanders of eight major military regions to prevent them from forming personal power bases.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在抗日战争时期创建的第一个敌后抗日根据地。
description.en: The first anti-Japanese base area established by the Communist Party of China behind enemy lines during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战时期中国人民解放军在华中地区的军事组织。中华人民共和国成立初期，该组织被设立为军区，后改称中南军区。
description.en: A military organization of the People's Liberation Army in the Central China region during the Second Chinese Civil War. In the early days of the People's Republic of China, it was established as a military region and later renamed the Central South Military Region.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军天津警备区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在天津市设立的军队一级组织，隶属中央军委国防动员部和中共天津市委。
description.en: A primary-level military organization established by the PLA in Tianjin, subordinate to the National Defense Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission and the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军山西省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在山西省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Shanxi Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军吉林省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在吉林省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Jilin Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军河南省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在河南省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Henan Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军福建省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在福建省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Fujian Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军安徽省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在安徽省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Anhui Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军江西省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在江西省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Jiangxi Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军四川省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在四川省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Sichuan Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军贵州省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在贵州省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Guizhou Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军重庆警备区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在重庆市设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Chongqing.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军甘肃省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在甘肃省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Gansu Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军青海省军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在青海省设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in Qinghai Province.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军宁夏军区

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在宁夏回族自治区设立的军队组织。
description.en: A military organization of the PLA established in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 南唐的都城，今为中国江苏省南京市。
description.en: The capital of the Southern Tang, now modern-day Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 北宋的都城，今为中国河南省开封市。
description.en: The capital of the Northern Song, now modern-day Kaifeng, Henan Province, China.

zh-cn: 让-雅克·雷吉斯·德·康巴塞雷斯

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，执政府时期担任第二执政。
description.en: A French statesman who served as the Second Consul during the Consulate.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，执政府时期担任第三执政。
description.en: A French statesman who served as the Third Consul during the Consulate.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间的君主立宪制政体，在八月十日事件后被推翻。
description.en: The constitutional monarchy regime during the French Revolution, which was overthrown after the Insurrection of 10 August 1792.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命中的一段时期，由救国委员会主导，对共和国的敌人进行大规模处决。
description.en: A period during the French Revolution, led by the Committee of Public Safety, characterized by mass executions of enemies of the Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在热月政变后，由国民公会制定并通过的法兰西第一共和国宪法，该宪法建立了督政府体制。
description.en: The constitution of the French First Republic, drafted and passed by the National Convention after the Thermidorian Reaction, which established the Directory system.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第一共和国的宪法，确立了执政府体制，并授予拿破仑·波拿巴作为第一执政的巨大权力。
description.en: A constitution of the French First Republic that established the Consulate system and granted immense power to Napoleon Bonaparte as First Consul.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第一共和国的宪法，将政府权力赋予一位世袭皇帝，从而建立了法兰西第一帝国。
description.en: A constitution of the French First Republic that vested government power in a hereditary emperor, thereby establishing the First French Empire.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的立法机关。它位于君主立宪制法兰西王国和国民公会之间，是国民公会的前身。八月十日事件后，该议会颁布法令召开了国民公会。
description.en: The legislature of France during the French Revolution. It was positioned between the constitutional Kingdom of France and the National Convention, and was the latter's predecessor. After the Insurrection of 10 August 1792, this assembly decreed the convening of the National Convention.

zh-cn: 不伦瑞克公爵卡尔·威廉·斐迪南
卡尔·威廉·斐迪南 (不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔)
en: Charles William Ferdinand, Duke of Brunswick

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士陆军元帅，普奥联军将军，曾发表《布伦瑞克宣言》威胁巴黎。
description.en: A Prussian field marshal and general of the Austro-Prussian army who issued the Brunswick Manifesto threatening Paris.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命期间发生的一系列针对囚犯的大屠杀事件。
description.en: A series of mass killings of prisoners that took place during the French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 由山岳派主导的国民公会颁布的民主宪法，引入了普选制。但因战争被推迟实施，最终从未生效。
description.en: A democratic constitution ratified by the Montagnard-dominated National Convention, which introduced universal suffrage. Its implementation was postponed due to war and it never came into effect.

zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔-约瑟夫·西哀士

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的理论家和政治家，雾月政变后成为临时执政官。
description.en: A theorist and politician during the French Revolution who became a provisional consul after the Coup of 18 Brumaire.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，雾月政变后成为临时执政官。
description.en: A French politician who became a provisional consul after the Coup of 18 Brumaire.

description.zh-cn: 法国的中央银行，成立于执政府时期。
description.en: The central bank of France, founded during the Consulate period.

description.zh-cn: 罗马天主教会教宗，与拿破仑谈判并签署了《1801年教务专约》。
description.en: Pope of the Roman Catholic Church who negotiated and signed the Concordat of 1801 with Napoleon.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑·波拿巴与教宗庇护七世签订的协议，旨在恢复天主教在法国的地位。
description.en: An agreement between Napoleon Bonaparte and Pope Pius VII, seeking to restore the status of the Catholic Church in France.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第一共和国的宪法，授予拿破仑终身执政官地位并增加了参议院的权力。
description.en: A constitution of the French First Republic that granted Napoleon the position of Consul for Life and increased the power of the Sénat conservateur.

description.zh-cn: 执政府时期设立的议事机构之一，负责在法案通过前对其进行评议。
description.en: One of the deliberative bodies established during the Consulate, responsible for discussing legislative drafts before their passage.

description.zh-cn: 一种化工原料，因能造成蛋白质含量虚高的检测结果而被不法分子添加到食品中，长期摄入会对泌尿系统造成严重损害。
description.en: An industrial chemical illegally added to food products to give the appearance of higher protein content. Long-term ingestion can cause severe damage to the urinary system.

description.zh-cn: 三鹿集团原董事长兼总经理，在毒奶粉事件中因生产、销售伪劣产品罪被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Former chairwoman and general manager of Sanlu Group, sentenced to life imprisonment for the crime of producing and selling substandard products during the milk scandal.

zh-cn: 恒天然合作社集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 新西兰的一家跨国乳制品公司，曾是三鹿集团的最大海外股东。其向新西兰政府的通报最终促使中国中央政府介入调查该事件。
description.en: A New Zealand multinational dairy co-operative that was the largest foreign shareholder in Sanlu Group. Its reporting of the issue to the New Zealand government ultimately prompted the Chinese central government to intervene and investigate the incident.

zh-cn: 国家质量监督检验检疫总局
中华人民共和国国家质量监督检验检疫总局
en: General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 原负责中国质量、计量、出入境商品检验、出入境卫生检疫、出入境动植物检疫和认证认可、标准化等工作的国家机关。该事件后，其局长李长江引咎辞职，并取消了食品业的国家免检制度。
description.en: The former state agency responsible for quality, metrology, entry-exit commodity inspection, health quarantine, animal and plant quarantine, certification, accreditation, and standardization in China. Following the scandal, its director Li Changjiang resigned, and the national inspection-exempt status for food products was abolished.

description.zh-cn: 泛指在中国生产制造的商品及其产业体系。2008年的毒奶粉事件严重打击了其在全球的商品信誉。
description.en: A general term for goods and industrial systems manufactured in China. Its global reputation was severely damaged by the 2008 tainted milk scandal.

description.zh-cn: 《东方早报》记者，其报道《甘肃14婴儿同患肾病，疑因喝“三鹿”奶粉所致》是国内最早直接点名三鹿的媒体报道之一，对揭露事件起到关键作用。
description.en: A journalist for the Oriental Morning Post whose report, "14 Gansu infants suffer from the same kidney disease, suspected to be caused by drinking 'Sanlu' milk powder," was one of the first media reports in China to directly name Sanlu, playing a key role in exposing the scandal.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰君主立宪制下的国家元首职位，由英国君主兼任。
description.en: The head of state position under New Zealand's constitutional monarchy, held by the monarch of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰君主在该国的代表职位。
description.en: The representative of the Monarch of New Zealand in the country.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The head of government position in New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 指性别相同的两人间的婚姻关系。
description.en: Refers to a marriage between two people of the same sex.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰毛利人的传统表演艺术，尤以战舞闻名。
description.en: A traditional performance art of the Māori people of New Zealand, particularly famous as a war dance.

en: New Zealand national rugby union team

description.zh-cn: 代表新西兰参加国际联合式橄榄球比赛的男子国家队，以赛前表演哈卡舞闻名。
description.en: The men's national team representing New Zealand in international rugby union, famous for performing the Haka before matches.

description.zh-cn: 争取女性获得选举权的社会政治运动。
description.en: The socio-political movement to grant women the right to vote.

zh-cn: 中央广播电视总台春节联欢晚会
中国中央电视台春节联欢晚会

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台为庆祝农历新年于每年除夕晚间举办的综艺性文艺晚会。
description.en: A variety show produced by China Central Television (CCTV) and broadcast on the eve of Chinese New Year.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台北市的多功能体育馆。
description.en: A multi-purpose stadium in Taipei, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中国的少数民族之一。
description.en: One of the ethnic minorities in China.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚政治人物，保加利亚共和国现任总统。
description.en: Bulgarian politician, the current President of the Republic of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚政治人物，曾任保加利亚总理。
description.en: Bulgarian politician, former Prime Minister of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 由阿斯帕鲁克汗于681年建立的中世纪保加利亚国家，后于1018年被拜占庭帝国征服。
description.en: A medieval Bulgarian state founded in 681 by Khan Asparuh, which was conquered by the Byzantine Empire in 1018.

description.zh-cn: 保加尔人首领，击败拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼二世后，于680年建立了保加利亚第一帝国。
description.en: A Bulgar leader who founded the First Bulgarian Empire in 680 after defeating the Byzantine Emperor Justinian II.

description.zh-cn: 拜占庭皇帝，被阿斯帕鲁克汗击败，后者随后建立了保加利亚第一帝国。
description.en: Byzantine Emperor defeated by Khan Asparuh, who then established the First Bulgarian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚第一帝国的统治者，引入了成文法典，并在普利斯卡战役中击败了拜占庭军队。
description.en: Ruler of the First Bulgarian Empire who introduced a written code of law and defeated the Byzantine army at the Battle of Pliska.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚第一帝国的统治者，于864年皈依基督教并采用西里尔字母。
description.en: Ruler of the First Bulgarian Empire who converted to Christianity in 864 and adopted the Cyrillic alphabet.

description.zh-cn: 拜占庭皇帝，在克柳赫战役中击败保加利亚军队，并最终于1018年征服了保加利亚第一帝国。
description.en: Byzantine Emperor who defeated the Bulgarian army at the Battle of Kleidion and ultimately conquered the First Bulgarian Empire in 1018.

description.zh-cn: 由彼得四世和伊凡·阿森一世兄弟领导起义后建立的中世纪保加利亚国家，后被奥斯曼帝国征服。
description.en: A medieval Bulgarian state established after an uprising led by brothers Peter IV and Ivan Asen I, later conquered by the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚沙皇，于1185年与兄弟彼得四世共同领导起义，建立了保加利亚第二帝国。
description.en: Tsar of Bulgaria who, along with his brother Peter II, led an uprising in 1185 to establish the Second Bulgarian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 根据《柏林条约》成立的奥斯曼帝国下属的自治实体，于1908年宣布完全独立并升格为王国。
description.en: An autonomous entity under the Ottoman Empire established by the Treaty of Berlin, which declared full independence and was elevated to a kingdom in 1908.

description.zh-cn: 1878年签署的国际条约，正式承认保加利亚亲王国的自治地位。
description.en: An international treaty signed in 1878 that officially recognized the autonomous status of the Principality of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚、塞尔维亚、黑山、希腊组成的巴尔干同盟对奥斯曼帝国发动的战争。
description.en: A war waged by the Balkan League (Bulgaria, Serbia, Montenegro, Greece) against the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 因战利品分配问题，保加利亚对其前盟友塞尔维亚和希腊发动的战争，罗马尼亚和奥斯曼帝国也加入其中对抗保加利亚，导致保加利亚战败并丧失领土。
description.en: A war initiated by Bulgaria against its former allies Serbia and Greece over the division of spoils, which Romania and the Ottoman Empire also joined against Bulgaria, resulting in Bulgaria's defeat and loss of territory.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战中的军事联盟，主要成员包括德意志帝国、奥匈帝国、奥斯曼帝国和保加利亚王国。
description.en: A military alliance in World War I, primarily consisting of the German Empire, Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, and the Kingdom of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联军队进入保加利亚后，由祖国阵线发动的政变，推翻了王国政府，为成立人民共和国铺平了道路。
description.en: A coup launched by the Fatherland Front after Soviet troops entered Bulgaria, which overthrew the kingdom's government and paved the way for the establishment of a people's republic.

description.zh-cn: 二战后建立的社会主义国家，是华沙条约组织的成员和苏联的盟友，于1990年解体。
description.en: A socialist state established after World War II, a member of the Warsaw Pact and an ally of the Soviet Union, which was dissolved in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 东欧的一系列革命，导致了该地区共产主义政权的垮台，包括保加利亚。
description.en: A series of revolutions in Eastern Europe that resulted in the collapse of communist regimes in the region, including in Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 皇姑屯事件发生时的日本首相。据信他因对该事件处理不当，引起天皇不满而被迫辞职。
description.en: Prime Minister of Japan at the time of the Huanggutun Incident. It is believed that he was forced to resign due to the Emperor's dissatisfaction with his handling of the incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家，与张作霖同乘一列火车，在皇姑屯事件中受伤。
description.en: A Chinese politician who was on the same train as Zhang Zuolin and was injured in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国社交名媛、歌手，曾与叶选廉有过短暂婚姻。
description.en: A Chinese socialite and singer who had a brief marriage with Ye Xuanlian.

description.zh-cn: 香港创作歌手，Robynn & Kendy成员，叶选廉与苏丹丹之女。
description.en: A Hong Kong singer-songwriter, member of Robynn & Kendy, and daughter of Ye Xuanlian and Su Dandan.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市海淀区的一所中学。
description.en: A secondary school located in Haidian District, Beijing, China.

description.zh-cn: 2008年在山西注册成立的公司，业务涉及建筑、房地产、医疗卫生等产业。
description.en: A company registered in Shanxi in 2008, with business interests in construction, real estate, healthcare, and other industries.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国北京市房山区下辖的地区。
description.en: An area under the jurisdiction of Fangshan District, Beijing, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于北京天安门东侧，曾是明清两代皇帝祭奠祖先的家庙。
description.en: Located east of Tiananmen in Beijing, it was the imperial ancestral temple where emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties worshiped their ancestors.

zh-cn: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会
中央网络安全和信息化领导小组
国务院信息化工作办公室

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院原办事机构，2008年其职责并入新组建的工业和信息化部。
description.en: A former administrative office of the State Council of the People's Republic of China. Its responsibilities were merged into the newly formed Ministry of Industry and Information Technology in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室副主任、国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as Deputy Director of the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission and the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾兼任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who concurrently served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾兼任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who concurrently served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾兼任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who concurrently served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾兼任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who concurrently served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家互联网信息办公室专职副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as a full-time Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家互联网信息办公室专职副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as a full-time Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家互联网信息办公室专职副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as a full-time Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Deputy Director of the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Deputy Director of the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Deputy Director of the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 2023年组建的中华人民共和国国家发展和改革委员会管理的国家局，负责协调推进数据基础制度建设，统筹数据资源整合共享和开发利用等。承接了原中央网信办的“数字中国”规划和建设部门职能。
description.en: A national bureau managed by the National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China, established in 2023. It is responsible for coordinating the construction of the basic data system, and coordinating the integration, sharing, development, and utilization of data resources. It took over the functions of the former 'Digital China' planning and construction department from the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission Office.

description.zh-cn: 指日本德川幕府，在明治维新中被推翻。
description.en: Refers to the Tokugawa shogunate in Japan, which was overthrown during the Meiji Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 明治政府颁布的法令，禁止除军人和警察外的日本人带刀。
description.en: An edict issued by the Meiji government prohibiting Japanese people, other than military and police personnel, from carrying swords.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的武士、政治家，维新十杰之一。
description.en: A samurai and statesman of the late Edo period in Japan, one of the Ten Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末明治维新期的军事家、学者，维新十杰之一。
description.en: A military strategist and scholar of the late Edo and Meiji Restoration periods in Japan, one of the Ten Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末时期的长州藩士，明治时代的政治家，维新十杰之一。
description.en: A samurai of the Chōshū Domain during the late Edo period and a statesman of the Meiji era, one of the Ten Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本幕末、明治维新时期的思想家、政治家，维新十杰之一。
description.en: A thinker and statesman of the late Edo and Meiji Restoration periods in Japan, one of the Ten Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时代的政治家、技术官僚，长州五杰之一。
description.en: A statesman and technocrat of the Meiji era in Japan, one of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时代的武士、技术官僚，长州五杰之一，被称为“日本铁道之父”。
description.en: A samurai and technocrat of the Meiji era in Japan, one of the Chōshū Five, known as the 'Father of Japanese Railways'.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时代的官员，长州五杰之一。
description.en: An official of the Meiji era in Japan, one of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战前由法国、英国和俄罗斯组成的军事同盟，是协约国的前身。
description.en: A military alliance formed by France, Britain, and Russia before World War I, which was the predecessor to the Entente Powers.

zh-cn: 维托里奥·埃曼努尔·奥兰多

description.zh-cn: 意大利政治家，曾任意大利总理，是协约国“四大巨头”之一。
description.en: Italian politician who served as Prime Minister of Italy and was one of the 'Big Four' of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 协约国成员国之一。
description.en: A member state of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 协约国成员国之一。
description.en: A member state of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 协约国成员国之一。
description.en: A member state of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 协约国成员国之一。
description.en: A member state of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 协约国成员国之一。
description.en: A member state of the Entente Powers.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝的宠妃，李延年与李广利的妹妹。她的受宠使李氏家族兴盛，她的去世也成为家族衰落的开端。
description.en: A favorite consort of Emperor Wu of Han, and the sister of Li Yannian and Li Guangli. Her favor brought prosperity to the Li family, and her death marked the beginning of their decline.

en: Princess Pingyang (daughter of Emperor Jing of Han)

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝之女，汉武帝的姐姐。她向汉武帝举荐了李延年的妹妹，即后来的李夫人。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Jing of Han and elder sister of Emperor Wu of Han. She recommended Li Yannian's sister, the future Empress Li, to Emperor Wu.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一种酷刑，指对男子进行阉割。李延年曾受此刑。
description.en: A form of corporal punishment in ancient China involving the castration of a male. Li Yannian was subjected to this punishment.

description.zh-cn: 李延年的弟弟。在李夫人去世、李家失宠后，与李延年一同因罪被灭族。
description.en: Younger brother of Li Yannian. After the death of Empress Li and the Li family's fall from favor, he was executed along with Li Yannian and their clan.

description.zh-cn: 位于现今中亚费尔干纳盆地的古代国家，汉武帝曾派李广利率军远征。
description.en: An ancient state in the Fergana Valley in Central Asia, which Emperor Wu of Han dispatched Li Guangli to conquer.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家，清华大学附属中学学生，最早使用“红卫兵”作为笔名。
description.en: A Chinese writer and a student at Tsinghua University High School, who was the first to use 'Red Guard' as a pen name.

description.zh-cn: 1966年至1967年在中国爆发的流行性脑脊髓膜炎疫情，造成超过16万人死亡，其传播与红卫兵大串联有关。
description.en: An epidemic of cerebrospinal meningitis that broke out in China from 1966 to 1967, causing over 160,000 deaths. Its spread was linked to the Red Guards' Great Link-up.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军少将，战斗英雄。在1985年中越边境冲突的一次战斗中，身负重伤仍坚守阵地，因此在1986年被中央军委授予“战斗英雄”称号。2017年获习近平颁授首批“八一勋章”，2018年被中共中央、国务院授予“改革先锋”称号。历任多个军区及警备区职务，现任海南省军区政委。
description.en: Major General of the People's Liberation Army Ground Force and a combat hero. During a battle in the Sino-Vietnamese border conflicts in 1985, he held his position despite being severely wounded, for which he was awarded the title 'Combat Hero' by the Central Military Commission in 1986. In 2017, he was awarded the inaugural 'Order of August First' by Xi Jinping, and in 2018, he was honored with the title 'Reform Pioneer' by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council. He has held various positions in multiple military regions and garrison commands, and is the current political commissar of the Hainan Provincial Military District.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的军事荣典，由中央军委决定、中央军委主席授予。
description.en: A military decoration of the People's Republic of China, decided by the Central Military Commission and awarded by its chairman.

zh-cn: 改革开放杰出贡献人员

description.zh-cn: 在改革开放四十周年大会上由中共中央和国务院授予的荣誉称号。
description.en: An honorary title awarded by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council at the conference celebrating the 40th anniversary of the Reform and Opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学的前身，梁思成曾在此就读。
description.en: The predecessor of Tsinghua University, where Liang Sicheng studied.

description.zh-cn: 琉球国宫古岛一艘上缴年贡的回航船只因台风漂流至台湾，船上66人登陆后与排湾族高士佛社原住民发生冲突，其中54人被斩首杀害。此事件成为牡丹社事件的导火索。
description.en: An incident in 1871 where 54 of 66 shipwrecked Ryukyuan sailors from Miyako Island were killed by Paiwan aboriginals in southeastern Taiwan after a conflict. This event became the casus belli for the Mudan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军中将，在牡丹社事件中担任“蕃地事务局都督”，率军攻打台湾。
description.en: A Lieutenant General in the Imperial Japanese Army, who served as the 'Commissioner for the Aboriginal Territory' and commanded the expeditionary force to Taiwan during the Mudan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 牡丹社头目，在石门战役中率领族人抵抗日军，最终与其子一同战死。
description.en: The chief of the Mudan tribe, who led his people to resist the Japanese army in the Battle of Stone Gate and was killed in action along with his son.

description.zh-cn: 清朝船政大臣。在牡丹社事件期间被任命为钦差大臣，负责处理台湾海防及对日外交事务。
description.en: Qing dynasty's Minister of Shipping. During the Mudan Incident, he was appointed as the Imperial Commissioner to manage Taiwan's coastal defense and diplomatic affairs with Japan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝总理衙门大臣。他关于台湾“生番”是“化外之民”的言论，被日本作为出兵的借口。
description.en: A minister of the Qing's Zongli Yamen. His statement that Taiwan's 'raw barbarians' were 'people beyond civilization' was used by Japan as a pretext for the expedition.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治维新后的前武士阶层。因大量失业造成社会问题，日本政府为安抚其情绪，策划了出兵台湾的行动。
description.en: The former samurai class in Japan after the Meiji Restoration. Their widespread unemployment caused social problems, and the Japanese government planned the Taiwan expedition partly to placate their discontent.

description.zh-cn: 牡丹社事件后，清朝政府改变对台湾的消极治理政策，转为积极开发后山及管理原住民地区的政策。
description.en: After the Mudan Incident, the Qing government changed its passive governance policy in Taiwan to one of actively developing the eastern mountains and managing aboriginal areas.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在牡丹社事件后，为加强对台湾的统治而设立的行省。
description.en: A province established by the Qing dynasty after the Mudan Incident to strengthen its rule over Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 又称亿载金城。牡丹社事件后，沈葆桢为加强台湾海防而奏请建造的西式炮台。
description.en: Also known as Eternal Golden Castle. It is a Western-style fort whose construction was proposed by Shen Baozhen to strengthen Taiwan's coastal defense after the Mudan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 美国军事顾问，在牡丹社事件中被日本雇用，协助策划对台出兵。
description.en: An American military advisor who was hired by Japan during the Mudan Incident to help plan the expedition to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任广东省人民政府省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Governor of Guangdong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共广州市委书记、广州市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Guangzhou Municipal Committee of the CCP and Mayor of Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任广东省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Executive Vice Governor of Guangdong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任广州市市长，并接替朱小丹担任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Mayor of Guangzhou, who succeeded Zhu Xiaodan as Secretary of the Guangzhou Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共广东省委宣传部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former head of the Propaganda Department of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替朱小丹担任中共广东省委宣传部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Zhu Xiaodan as head of the Propaganda Department of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共广东省委统战部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former head of the United Front Work Department of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替朱小丹担任中共广东省委统战部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Zhu Xiaodan as head of the United Front Work Department of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替朱小丹担任中共从化县委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Zhu Xiaodan as Secretary of the Conghua County Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替朱小丹担任广东省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Zhu Xiaodan as Executive Vice Governor of Guangdong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，蒙古族，现任中共洛阳市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician of Mongol ethnicity, currently serving as the CPC Secretary of Luoyang.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期人物，奉班超之命出使大秦，是第一位到达波斯湾的中国使者，为丝绸之路的开辟做出贡献。
description.en: An individual from the Eastern Han Dynasty, sent by Ban Chao on a mission to Daqin. He was the first Chinese envoy to reach the Persian Gulf, contributing to the establishment of the Silk Road.

description.zh-cn: 隋唐时期的都城，由隋炀帝下令营建，其城市格局对日本京都等城市产生了影响。
description.en: The capital city during the Sui and Tang dynasties, built under the order of Emperor Yang of Sui. Its urban layout influenced cities such as Kyoto in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 东汉、曹魏、西晋、北魏等朝代的都城遗址，其格局影响了日本奈良的平城京。
description.en: The archaeological site of the capital city for dynasties such as the Eastern Han, Cao Wei, Western Jin, and Northern Wei. Its layout influenced Heijō-kyō in Nara, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中国史书中记载的第一个世袭制朝代，曾以斟𬩽（今洛阳二里头遗址）为都。
description.en: The first hereditary dynasty in Chinese history, which had its capital at Zhenxun (modern-day Erlitou site in Luoyang).

description.zh-cn: 西晋时期著名文学家，其作品《三都赋》曾造成“洛阳纸贵”的现象。
description.en: A famous writer of the Western Jin dynasty, whose work 'Three Capitals Rhapsody' caused the phenomenon known as 'Paper is dear in Luoyang'.

description.zh-cn: 西晋文学家左思的代表作，因广受欢迎而导致当时洛阳纸价上涨。
description.en: The representative work of the Western Jin writer Zuo Si, which was so popular that it caused the price of paper in Luoyang to rise.

description.zh-cn: 一种著名的观赏植物，被誉为“花中之王”，洛阳牡丹尤为著名。
description.en: A famous ornamental plant, known as the 'King of Flowers'. The peonies of Luoyang are particularly renowned.

description.zh-cn: 洛阳市下辖的市辖区，洛阳市人民政府驻地。
description.en: A municipal district under the jurisdiction of Luoyang City, and the seat of the Luoyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任青岛市崂山区区长及区委书记、淄博市委书记、潍坊市委书记，后任重庆市人民政府副市长。2025年10月因涉嫌严重违纪违法被查。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the district mayor and party secretary of Laoshan District in Qingdao, party secretary of Zibo, and party secretary of Weifang, before becoming the vice mayor of Chongqing Municipal People's Government. He was investigated for suspected serious violations of discipline and law in October 2025.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，江敦涛的前任中共淄博市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Jiang Duntao's predecessor as the CPC Party Secretary of Zibo.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，江敦涛的继任中共淄博市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Jiang Duntao's successor as the CPC Party Secretary of Zibo.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，江敦涛的前任中共潍坊市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Jiang Duntao's predecessor as the CPC Party Secretary of Weifang.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军中将，海军航空兵部首任司令员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the PLA Navy and the first commander of the Naval Air Force Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军少将，海军航空兵部首任政治委员之一。
description.en: A major general of the PLA Navy, one of the first political commissars of the Naval Air Force Department.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军航空兵第九十四旅

description.zh-cn: 国防部授予海军航空兵第4师第10团的荣誉称号，以表彰其在国土防空中的突出战绩。
description.en: An honorary title awarded by the Ministry of National Defense to the 10th Regiment of the Naval Aviation 4th Division for its outstanding combat record in national air defense.

description.zh-cn: 海军航空兵第9师歼-8II战斗机飞行员，在2001年中美南海撞机事件中失踪牺牲，后被追授“海空卫士”荣誉称号。
description.en: A J-8II fighter pilot of the Naval Aviation 9th Division who went missing and was killed in the 2001 Hainan Island incident, posthumously honored as the 'Guardian of Territorial Airspace and Waters'.

en: People's Liberation Army Navy Carrier-Borne Aviation Force
zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军舰载航空兵部队

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军航空兵中负责操作航空母舰舰载机的部队。
description.en: The force within the PLA Naval Air Force responsible for operating aircraft from aircraft carriers.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家和政治人物，中华全国总工会现任党组书记、副主席、书记处第一书记。
description.en: Chinese business executive and politician, current Party Group Secretary, Vice Chairman, and First Secretary of the Secretariat of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华全国总工会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as Chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 中华全国总工会直属的唯一一所普通本科高等学校。
description.en: The only regular undergraduate higher education institution directly affiliated with the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 一个国际性的工会组织。
description.en: An international federation of trade unions.

description.zh-cn: 日本现任皇后，德仁天皇的妻子。
description.en: The current Empress of Japan, wife of Emperor Naruhito.

description.zh-cn: 德仁天皇与雅子皇后的独女。
description.en: The only child of Emperor Naruhito and Empress Masako.

description.zh-cn: 牛津大学的组成学院之一，德仁天皇曾于1983年至1985年在此研究。
description.en: One of the constituent colleges of the University of Oxford, where Emperor Naruhito studied from 1983 to 1985.

description.zh-cn: 日本的国家红十字会，德仁在皇太子时期担任其名誉副总裁。
description.en: The national Red Cross society of Japan, for which Naruhito served as Honorary Vice-President during his time as Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 《社会日报》主笔，被张宗昌以“赤化”罪名处死。
description.en: Editor-in-chief of 'Social Daily', executed by Zhang Zongchang on charges of 'Bolshevization'.

zh-cn: 中国共产党青岛市委员会

description.zh-cn: 天主教会教宗，庇护十二世的继任者。
description.en: Pope of the Catholic Church, successor of Pius XII.

description.zh-cn: 位于意大利冈多菲堡的宗座宫殿，是教宗的夏日驻地，也是庇护十二世的逝世地点。
description.en: An apostolic palace in Castel Gandolfo, Italy, serving as a summer residence for the Pope, and the place of death of Pope Pius XII.

description.zh-cn: 1805年至1918年间存在的德意志国家，庇护十二世曾在此担任大使。
description.en: A German state that existed from 1805 to 1918, where Pope Pius XII served as an ambassador.

description.zh-cn: 1918年至1947年间存在的德意志国家，庇护十二世曾在此担任大使。
description.en: A German state that existed from 1918 to 1947, where Pope Pius XII served as an ambassador.

description.zh-cn: 圣座国务院的负责人，负责圣座的政治和外交活动，庇护十二世曾担任此职。
description.en: The head of the Secretariat of State of the Holy See, responsible for the political and diplomatic activities of the Holy See. Pope Pius XII held this position.

en: Camerlengo of the Holy Roman Church

description.zh-cn: 在宗座出缺期间代理教宗管理圣座的枢机，庇护十二世曾担任此职。
description.en: A cardinal who administers the Holy See during a papal vacancy. Pope Pius XII held this position.

location.zh-cn: 香港九龙牛头角复华村
