location.en: Fuk Wah Village, Ngau Tau Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong

description.zh-cn: 一所由玛利诺会士顾伦神父创办并以教宗庇护十二世命名的小学，于1979年被清拆。
description.en: A primary school founded by Maryknoll priest John A. Curran and named after Pope Pius XII, which was demolished in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 天主教香港教区主教，于1953年为庇护十二学校奠基。
description.en: Bishop of the Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong, who laid the foundation stone for the Pius XII School in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 一个天主教传教修会，在香港创办了包括庇护十二学校在内的多所学校。
description.en: A Catholic society of apostolic life for foreign missions that founded several schools in Hong Kong, including the Pius XII School.

en: Chai Wan Kok Catholic Primary School

description.zh-cn: 位于香港荃湾的一所小学，接收了部分原庇护十二学校的教职员。
description.en: A primary school in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong, which received some of the staff from the original Pius XII School.

description.zh-cn: 天主教会的香港教区，从玛利诺会接管了柴湾角天主教小学的办学权。
description.en: The diocese of the Catholic Church in Hong Kong, which took over the operation of Chai Wan Kok Catholic Primary School from Maryknoll.

description.zh-cn: 由柴湾角天主教小学上午校于2009年迁校并改名而成。
description.en: Formed in 2009 when the morning session of Chai Wan Kok Catholic Primary School relocated and was renamed.

en: Ngau Tau Kok Catholic Primary School

description.zh-cn: 由玛利诺会创办的小学，于2000年迁往乐华邨并延续为乐华天主教小学。
description.en: A primary school founded by Maryknoll, which relocated to Lok Wah Estate in 2000 and continued as Lok Wah Catholic Primary School.

description.zh-cn: 由牛头角天主教小学于2000年迁校后延续的学校，现址位于原庇护十二学校校址。
description.en: The continuation of Ngau Tau Kok Catholic Primary School after its relocation in 2000, now located on the former site of Pius XII School.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，吴烈的继任北京卫戍区司令员。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army, Wu Lie's successor as commander of the Beijing Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，王西欣在中国人民解放军陆军第三十八集团军军长职位上的前任。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army, Wang Xixin's predecessor as the Commander of the 38th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，吴烈的前任北京卫戍区司令员。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army, Wu Lie's predecessor as commander of the Beijing Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，吴烈的继任北京卫戍区政治委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army, Wu Lie's successor as political commissar of the Beijing Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的人物评论家。
description.en: A character commentator during the late Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东汉名臣，早期赏识曹操才能的人物之一。
description.en: A renowned official of the Eastern Han dynasty who was one of the first to recognize Cao Cao's talent.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的著名医学家，后因触怒曹操而被杀。
description.en: A renowned physician of the late Eastern Han dynasty, who was executed after offending Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝的王爵封号，曹操晚年受封此爵位。
description.en: A royal title of the Han dynasty, which Cao Cao was granted in his later years.

description.zh-cn: 汉献帝的皇后，因图谋铲除曹操而被废黜并杀害。
description.en: An empress of Emperor Xian of Han, who was deposed and executed for plotting against Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国全国人大代表，在两会期间建议释放“地摊经济”的活力。
description.en: A deputy to the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China who suggested unleashing the vitality of the 'stall economy' during the Two Sessions.

description.zh-cn: 腾讯公司旗下的支付平台，推出“全国小店烟火计划”支持地摊经济。
description.en: A payment platform under Tencent that launched the 'National Small Store Fireworks Plan' to support the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 中国生活服务电子商务平台，推出“春风行动”百万小店计划支持地摊经济。
description.en: A Chinese e-commerce platform for services that launched the 'Spring Breeze Action' million small store plan to support the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 中国零售企业，推出“夜逛合伙人”计划支持地摊经济。
description.en: A Chinese retail company that launched the 'Night Market Partner' program to support the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 清代湖北省武昌府下辖县，为熊秉坤的出生地。
description.en: A county under Wuchang Prefecture, Hubei Province during the Qing Dynasty, and the birthplace of Xiong Bingkun.

description.zh-cn: 清末新军的全国三十六镇之一，驻扎湖北。熊秉坤曾在此当兵，其下属的工程第八营是武昌起义主力。
description.en: One of the 36 divisions of the New Army in the late Qing Dynasty, stationed in Hubei. Xiong Bingkun served here, and its 8th Engineer Battalion was the main force of the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 湖北新军工程第八营士兵，因枪杀长官而直接引发了武昌起义。
description.en: A soldier of the 8th Engineer Battalion of the Hubei New Army whose shooting of his officer directly triggered the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，武昌起义后被熊秉坤等人推举为湖北革命军临时总指挥。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, he was acclaimed as the temporary commander-in-chief of the Hubei Revolutionary Army by Xiong Bingkun and others after the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间湖北省的权力机构。在周恩来指示下，该委员会为熊秉坤操办了丧事。
description.en: The organ of power in Hubei Province during the Cultural Revolution. Under Zhou Enlai's instructions, this committee handled Xiong Bingkun's funeral.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国防部情报局前处长，是江南案中向陈启礼下达指令的关键人物。
description.en: Former division chief of the Military Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense of the Republic of China, a key figure who delivered the orders to Chen Chi-li in the Henry Liu case.

description.zh-cn: 竹联帮总护法，与陈启礼一同赴美执行江南案，并因此案被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: The Grand Protector of the Bamboo Union, who went to the United States with Chen Chi-li to carry out the Henry Liu case and was sentenced to life imprisonment for it.

description.zh-cn: 竹联帮忠堂堂主，是江南案的三名主要执行者之一，案发后潜逃海外，最终死于美国监狱的械斗中。
description.en: Hall master of the Bamboo Union's Zhong Hall, one of the three main perpetrators of the Henry Liu case. He fled abroad after the incident and eventually died in a prison fight in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政府于1996年展开的大规模扫黑行动，陈启礼因被列为目标而遭到通缉，并因此流亡海外。
description.en: A large-scale anti-gang operation launched by the Taiwanese government in 1996. Chen Chi-li was listed as a target, leading to a warrant for his arrest and his subsequent exile.

description.zh-cn: 江南案后，台湾政府于1984年展开的首次全国性扫黑行动，陈启礼回台后在此专案中被捕。
description.en: Following the Henry Liu case, this was the first nationwide anti-gang operation launched by the Taiwanese government in 1984. Chen Chi-li was arrested under this operation upon his return to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 竹联帮创帮元老之一，也是陈启礼初入帮派时的老大。
description.en: One of the founding members of the Bamboo Union and Chen Chi-li's initial leader when he first joined the gang.

description.zh-cn: 在1995年由陈启礼亲自公开指定为竹联帮第二任帮主。
description.en: Publicly designated by Chen Chi-li as the second leader of the Bamboo Union in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 陈启礼与第二任妻子齐维莉所生的长子，为台湾知名演员。
description.en: The eldest son of Chen Chi-li and his second wife, Qi Weili. He is a well-known Taiwanese actor.

description.zh-cn: 台北市中山区的在地帮派，曾因地盘问题与竹联帮爆发“香港西餐厅事件”。
description.en: A local gang in the Zhongshan District of Taipei, which clashed with the Bamboo Union in the "Hong Kong Western Restaurant Incident" over territory disputes.

description.zh-cn: 元世祖皇太子真金的王妃，元成宗的母亲。
description.en: The principal consort of Crown Prince Zhenjin and the mother of Temür Khan (Emperor Chengzong).

description.zh-cn: 元世祖皇太子真金的长子，元成宗的长兄。
description.en: The eldest son of Crown Prince Zhenjin and the elder brother of Temür Khan (Emperor Chengzong).

description.zh-cn: 元世祖皇太子真金的次子，元成宗的二哥。
description.en: The second son of Crown Prince Zhenjin and the elder brother of Temür Khan (Emperor Chengzong).

description.zh-cn: 元朝初年的重要军事将领和政治家，统率大军攻灭南宋，并在忽必烈去世后拥立元成宗即位。
description.en: An important military general and statesman in the early Yuan dynasty. He commanded the army that conquered the Southern Song and supported the enthronement of Emperor Chengzong after Kublai Khan's death.

description.zh-cn: 元成宗的皇后。在元成宗晚年患病时，实际掌握朝政。
description.en: An empress of Temür Khan (Emperor Chengzong). She effectively controlled the court when the emperor fell ill in his later years.

description.zh-cn: 元成宗的儿子，被立为皇太子但早逝。
description.en: Son of Temür Khan (Emperor Chengzong), who was appointed Crown Prince but died prematurely.

description.zh-cn: 窝阔台汗国的实际统治者，成吉思汗之孙。他长期与忽必烈敌对，是忽必烈在中亚的主要对手。
description.en: The de facto ruler of the Ögedei Khanate and a grandson of Genghis Khan. He was a long-term adversary of Kublai Khan and his main rival in Central Asia.

description.zh-cn: 察合台汗国可汗，曾与海都联手对抗元朝，后臣服于元朝。
description.en: Khan of the Chagatai Khanate, who initially allied with Kaidu against the Yuan dynasty but later submitted to Yuan rule.

description.zh-cn: 钦察汗国（金帐汗国）可汗。
description.en: Khan of the Golden Horde.

en: Great Khan of the Mongol Empire

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国的最高统治者称号。
description.en: The title of the supreme ruler of the Mongol Empire.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第六十七集团军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾存在的一个集团军，粟戎生曾于1985年起担任其参谋长。
description.en: A former group army of the People's Liberation Army, where Su Rongsheng served as its chief of staff starting in 1985.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军第二十四集团军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军曾存在的一个集团军，粟戎生曾担任其军长。
description.en: A former group army of the People's Liberation Army, where Su Rongsheng served as its commander.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，杜青林的前任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Du Qinglin's predecessor as Secretary of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，杜青林的前任中华人民共和国农业部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Du Qinglin's predecessor as Minister of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共海南省委书记（杜青林的前任）、海南省省长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee (Du Qinglin's predecessor) and Governor of Hainan Province.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共海南省委书记（接替杜青林）、海南省人大常委会主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who formerly served as Secretary of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the CPC (succeeding Du Qinglin) and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress.

en: Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Hainan Province
Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress
zh-cn: 海南省人民代表大会常务委员会

description.zh-cn: 海南省人民代表大会的常设机关，杜青林曾任主任。
description.en: The standing body of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress, where Du Qinglin served as Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共海南省委书记，杜青林的前任海南省人大常委会主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, formerly served as Secretary of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the CPC and Du Qinglin's predecessor as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 彭真的三子。
description.en: The third son of Peng Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 彭真的养女。
description.en: The adopted daughter of Peng Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期赵国将领，赵奢之子。在长平之战中替代廉颇为主将，被白起率领的秦军击败并射杀。
description.en: A general of the State of Zhao during the Warring States period, son of Zhao She. He replaced Lian Po as commander in the Battle of Changping, where he was defeated and killed by the Qin army led by Bai Qi.

description.zh-cn: 司马错之孙，白起的副将，在杜邮与白起一同被赐死。
description.en: Grandson of Sima Cuo and Bai Qi's deputy commander. He was forced to commit suicide along with Bai Qi at Duyou.

description.zh-cn: 秦国与韩、魏联军在伊阙的一场战役。秦将白起率军大败联军，斩首二十四万，为秦国东进扫清了障碍。
description.en: A battle between the State of Qin and the allied forces of Han and Wei at Yique. The Qin general Bai Qi led his army to a decisive victory, killing 240,000 enemy soldiers and clearing the way for Qin's eastward expansion.

description.zh-cn: 秦国攻打楚国的一系列战役，白起率军攻陷楚国重镇鄢和都城郢，极大削弱了楚国国力。
description.en: A series of battles where the State of Qin attacked the State of Chu. Bai Qi led his forces to capture the key city of Yan and the capital Ying, greatly weakening Chu's power.

description.zh-cn: 9·11袭击事件后由美国国会通过的一项法案，旨在扩大执法部门在监控和调查方面的权力以打击恐怖主义。
description.en: An act passed by the U.S. Congress after the 9/11 attacks, aimed at expanding the powers of law enforcement agencies in surveillance and investigation to combat terrorism.

description.zh-cn: 1982年以色列入侵黎巴嫩的战争。本·拉登称，美国在该战争中对以色列的支持直接促使他产生袭击美国的想法。
description.en: The 1982 war in which Israel invaded Lebanon. Bin Laden claimed that U.S. support for Israel in this war directly motivated him to conceive the idea of attacking the United States.

description.zh-cn: 基地组织高级成员，被认为是9·11袭击事件的主要策划者。他于2003年在巴基斯坦被捕。
description.en: A high-ranking member of Al-Qaeda, considered the principal architect of the September 11 attacks. He was captured in Pakistan in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 美国国会的所在地，被认为是联合航空93号班机的袭击目标之一。
description.en: The seat of the United States Congress, believed to be one of the intended targets of United Airlines Flight 93.

zh-cn: 尚克斯维尔 (宾夕法尼亚州)

description.zh-cn: 美国宾夕法尼亚州的一个乡村地区，联合航空93号班机在此坠毁。
description.en: A rural area in Pennsylvania, USA, where United Airlines Flight 93 crashed.

description.zh-cn: 指在9·11事件后，以美国国家安全局为首的情报机构在全球范围内进行的大规模监视活动。
description.en: Refers to the large-scale surveillance activities conducted globally by intelligence agencies led by the U.S. National Security Agency after the 9/11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝的贵妃，满洲镶黄旗人，太师、果毅公遏必隆之女，孝昭仁皇后之妹，皇十子允䄉的生母。
description.en: A Noble Consort of the Kangxi Emperor, from the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner. She was the daughter of Grand Tutor and Duke Guoyi Ebilun, the younger sister of Empress Xiaozhaoren, and the birth mother of the emperor's tenth son, Yun'e.

description.zh-cn: 清朝初年权臣，康熙帝四大辅臣之一，后金开国五大臣之一额亦都的第十六子。
description.en: An influential official in the early Qing dynasty, one of the Four Regents of the Kangxi Emperor, and the sixteenth son of Eidu, one of the five founding ministers of the Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 后金开国大汗努尔哈赤第四女，额亦都的妻子。
description.en: The fourth daughter of Nurhaci, the founding khan of the Later Jin dynasty, and the wife of Eidu.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝的第二位皇后，辅政大臣遏必隆之女。
description.en: The second empress consort of the Kangxi Emperor, daughter of the regent Ebilun.

en: Prince Dun of the First Rank

description.zh-cn: 清朝的亲王爵位之一。
description.en: A title of nobility, specifically a Prince of the First Rank, in the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝贵族爵位，低于贝勒，高于镇国公。
description.en: A title of nobility in the Qing dynasty, ranking below a Beile and above a Duke of the State.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室爵位之一。
description.en: A title of nobility for members of the imperial clan in the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉的嫡福晋，阿巴噶右旗扎萨克多罗郡王乌尔彰噶喇普之女。
description.en: The primary consort of Yun'e, daughter of Urcenggarab, a Jasagh Doroi Junwang of the Abaga Right Banner.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉的继福晋，佐领常海之女。
description.en: The secondary consort of Yun'e, daughter of company captain Changhai.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉的媵妾，员外郎永保之女。
description.en: A concubine of Yun'e, daughter of Second class secretary Yongbao.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，第二次国共内战期间为中国共产党从事策反工作，失败后在台湾被处决。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army who engaged in defection-inducement work for the Communist Party of China during the Second Chinese Civil War and was executed in Taiwan after his mission failed.

description.zh-cn: 中国北方地区的武装匪帮的称谓。
description.en: A term for armed bandit gangs in northern China.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期响马首领，曾为徐继武的上级。
description.en: A bandit leader during the Republican era, once the superior of Xu Jiwu.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，长期担任徐继武的上级并提拔他。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China who was Xu Jiwu's long-term superior and promoted him.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事及政治人物，曾任江苏省主席，与徐继武为旧识。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China who served as the chairman of Jiangsu Province and was an old acquaintance of Xu Jiwu.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，曾为徐继武的部下，其被捕牵连到徐继武。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China who was a former subordinate of Xu Jiwu; his arrest implicated Xu Jiwu.

description.zh-cn: 1947年在无锡创办的私立大学，1952年院系调整中解散，部分院系并入南京工学院等校。
description.en: A private university founded in Wuxi in 1947. It was dissolved during the 1952 higher education restructuring, with some of its departments merged into Nanjing Institute of Technology and other institutions.

description.zh-cn: 交通运输专家，获东南大学培养的中国第一位交通学科博士学位。
description.en: An expert in transportation, he was the first person in China to receive a Ph.D. in transportation, awarded by Southeast University.

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚企业家、金融家、慈善家，东南大学校友。
description.en: Indonesian entrepreneur, financier, and philanthropist; alumnus of Southeast University.

description.zh-cn: 大赦是1954年《中华人民共和国宪法》中规定的对某一范围内的罪犯一律予以赦免的制度，自1975年宪法起被取消。
description.en: Amnesty was a system stipulated in the 1954 Constitution of the People's Republic of China for the complete pardon of a certain range of criminals, which was abolished by the 1975 Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代武将，松平氏第8代当主，德川家康之父。
description.en: A Japanese samurai of the Sengoku period, the 8th head of the Matsudaira clan, and the father of Tokugawa Ieyasu.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康之母。
description.en: The mother of Tokugawa Ieyasu.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代骏河国的大名，德川家康早年的主君。
description.en: A daimyō of Suruga Province during the Sengoku period in Japan and the early lord of Tokugawa Ieyasu.

description.zh-cn: 织田信长以少胜多，在桶狭间奇袭并击杀今川义元的著名战役，是德川家康独立的契机。
description.en: A famous battle in which Oda Nobunaga, with a much smaller force, launched a surprise attack and defeated Imagawa Yoshimoto. This event provided the opportunity for Tokugawa Ieyasu to become independent.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康与织田信长缔结的军事同盟，是战国时期维持时间最长的盟约之一。
description.en: A military alliance formed between Tokugawa Ieyasu and Oda Nobunaga, one of the longest-lasting alliances of the Sengoku period.

description.zh-cn: 织田信长死后，羽柴秀吉与德川家康、织田信雄联军之间爆发的战役。
description.en: A battle fought between the forces of Hashiba Hideyoshi and the coalition of Tokugawa Ieyasu and Oda Nobukatsu after the death of Oda Nobunaga.

description.zh-cn: 决定天下归属的战役，德川家康率领的东军战胜石田三成率领的西军，为江户幕府的建立奠定了基础。
description.en: A decisive battle that determined the fate of Japan, where the Eastern Army led by Tokugawa Ieyasu defeated the Western Army led by Ishida Mitsunari, laying the foundation for the establishment of the Edo Shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 日本安土桃山时代的武将、大名，丰臣政权的五奉行之一，关原合战中西军的领导者。
description.en: A samurai commander and daimyō of the Azuchi-Momoyama period, one of the Five Commissioners of the Toyotomi administration, and the leader of the Western Army in the Battle of Sekigahara.

description.zh-cn: 江户幕府为消灭丰臣氏而发动的战争，分为冬之阵和夏之阵，最终导致丰臣氏灭亡。
description.en: A series of battles undertaken by the Edo Shogunate to destroy the Toyotomi clan, divided into the Winter and Summer campaigns, which ultimately led to the downfall of the Toyotomi clan.

description.zh-cn: 日本第107代天皇，于1603年册封德川家康为征夷大将军。
description.en: The 107th Emperor of Japan, who appointed Tokugawa Ieyasu as Seii Taishōgun in 1603.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康第三子，江户幕府第二代将军。
description.en: The third son of Tokugawa Ieyasu and the second shogun of the Edo Shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 日本第108代天皇，于1616年任命德川家康为太政大臣。
description.en: The 108th Emperor of Japan, who appointed Tokugawa Ieyasu as Daijō-daijin in 1616.

description.zh-cn: 旧日本帝国陆军的宪兵，在二战期间活动。
description.en: The military police of the former Imperial Japanese Army, active during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产主义青年团的前身。
description.en: The predecessor of the Communist Youth League of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者、历史学家。
description.en: Chinese scholar and historian.

en: World Association of Newspapers and News Publishers

description.zh-cn: 一个代表世界各地报纸和新闻出版商的非政府组织。
description.en: A non-governmental organization representing newspapers and news publishers worldwide.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家，本名郑世平。
description.en: Chinese writer, real name Zheng Shiping.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、社会评论家。
description.en: Chinese writer and social critic.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，曾任山东省人民政府副省长，现任中央纪委国家监委驻公安部纪检监察组组长，公安部党委委员。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Han ethnicity, who previously served as the Vice Governor of the Shandong Provincial People's Government. She currently serves as the head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the CCDI and NSC in the Ministry of Public Security and is a member of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Public Security.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国家工商行政管理总局
国家工商行政管理总局
en: State Administration for Industry and Commerce

description.zh-cn: 曾是中华人民共和国国务院主管市场监督管理和行政执法工作的直属机构，现已撤销并入国家市场监督管理总局。
description.en: Formerly a direct subordinate agency of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for market supervision, administration, and administrative law enforcement. It has been dissolved and its functions merged into the State Administration for Market Regulation.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任全国人大常委会香港基本法委员会副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as a Vice Chairman of the Hong Kong Basic Law Committee of the NPC Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府公安部办公厅副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the General Office of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区筹备委员会
en: Preparatory Committee for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

description.zh-cn: 为筹备1997年香港主权移交而设立的机构。
description.en: A body established to prepare for the 1997 handover of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会副书记、政法委书记。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、南昌市委书记。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、组织部部长。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、省军区政委。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、赣州市委书记。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、宣传部部长。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、秘书长。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、省纪委书记。
中国政治人物，现任中国共产党江西省委员会常委、统战部部长。
中国共产党历史上的一个领导机构。
卫子夫、卫青等人的母亲，曾为平阳侯府中的婢女。
description.en: Mother of Wei Zifu, Wei Qing, and others. She was a servant in the household of the Marquis of Pingyang.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期将领，卫子夫的外甥，卫少儿之子。
description.en: A general of the Western Han Dynasty, nephew of Wei Zifu, and son of Wei Shao'er.

description.zh-cn: 西汉第四代平阳侯，平阳公主的丈夫。
description.en: The fourth-generation Marquis of Pingyang during the Western Han Dynasty, husband of Princess Pingyang.

description.zh-cn: 西汉将领，卫青的好友，曾解救被绑架的卫青。
description.en: A general of the Western Han Dynasty and a friend of Wei Qing, who rescued him from an abduction.

description.zh-cn: 西汉酷吏，曾负责查办陈皇后巫蛊案。
description.en: A harsh official of the Western Han Dynasty, known for investigating the witchcraft case of Empress Chen.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期地名，位于今山西临汾，是卫子夫的出生地。
description.en: A location during the Western Han Dynasty, located in modern-day Linfen, Shanxi. It is the birthplace of Wei Zifu.

description.zh-cn: 卫子夫的二姐，霍去病之母。
description.en: The second elder sister of Wei Zifu and the mother of Huo Qubing.

description.zh-cn: 一种利用巫术诅咒害人的行为。在汉武帝时期，与巫蛊相关的指控引发了严重的政治迫害，如废黜陈皇后及后来的巫蛊之祸。
description.en: A form of witchcraft used to curse and harm people. During the reign of Emperor Wu of Han, accusations related to witchcraft led to severe political persecutions, such as the deposition of Empress Chen and the later Witchcraft Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 与陈皇后勾结，暗行巫蛊之事的巫女。
description.en: A witch who colluded with Empress Chen to practice witchcraft.

en: National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention

location.zh-cn: 北京市海淀区知春路14号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院负责疾病预防、疫情防控、公共卫生应急事务的国务院部委管理的国家局，行政级别为副部级，由国家卫生健康委员会管理。
description.en: The National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention is a national bureau managed by ministries and commissions of the State Council of the People's Republic of China. It is responsible for disease prevention, epidemic control, and public health emergency affairs. It holds a vice-ministerial administrative rank and is managed by the National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物、流行病学专家，中国工程院院士。现任国家疾病预防控制局局长、国家卫生健康委员会副主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, epidemiologist, and academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. He is the current Director of the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention and Deputy Director of the National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家疾病预防控制局首任局长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the first Director of the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention.

description.zh-cn: 南京医科大学的前身，位于中国江苏省南京市的医科类高等院校。
description.en: The predecessor of Nanjing Medical University, a medical higher education institution located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 1949年在中国察哈尔省北部发生的鼠疫疫情，促使中央防疫委员会成立。
description.en: A plague outbreak in the northern Chahar Province of China in 1949, which prompted the establishment of the Central Epidemic Prevention Committee.

zh-cn: 中国疾病预防控制中心
中国疾病预防控制中心（中国预防医学科学院）
en: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention

description.zh-cn: 国家疾病预防控制局直属事业单位，实施国家级疾病预防控制与公共卫生技术管理和服务。
description.en: An institution directly under the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention, responsible for implementing national-level disease prevention and control and public health technical management and services.

description.zh-cn: 由国家疾病预防控制局主管的全国性、学术性、非营利性社会团体。
description.en: A national, academic, non-profit social organization supervised by the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention.

description.zh-cn: 孝贤纯皇后的母亲，李荣保之妻。
description.en: The mother of Empress Xiaoxianchun and the wife of Li Rongbao.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝皇七子，孝贤纯皇后所生，深得乾隆钟爱并被内定为太子，但不幸因出痘夭折。
description.en: The seventh son of the Qianlong Emperor, born to Empress Xiaoxianchun. He was deeply favored by Qianlong and internally designated as the crown prince, but unfortunately died of smallpox.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝皇三女，孝贤纯皇后所生。
description.en: The third daughter of the Qianlong Emperor, born to Empress Xiaoxianchun.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝皇三子。因在孝贤皇后丧仪期间表现不够悲伤，与皇长子永璜一同受到乾隆帝斥责，并被取消了继承皇位的资格。
description.en: The third son of the Qianlong Emperor. Along with his elder brother Yonghuang, he was reprimanded by the emperor for not showing sufficient grief during the mourning rituals for Empress Xiaoxianchun and was disqualified from the line of succession.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，时任刑部尚书。因在办理孝贤皇后册文时出现翻译错误，被乾隆帝严厉惩处。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official who served as the Minister of Justice. He was severely punished by the Qianlong Emperor for a translation error in the official documents for Empress Xiaoxianchun's funeral.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，时任礼部尚书。因在筹备孝贤皇后谥号仪式时有疏漏，被乾隆帝降级留任。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official who served as the Minister of Rites. He was demoted but kept in his post by the Qianlong Emperor for oversights in preparing the ceremony for Empress Xiaoxianchun's posthumous title.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古科尔沁部出身的额驸，固伦和敬公主的丈夫。
description.en: An efu (imperial son-in-law) from the Khorchin Mongols, husband of Princess Gulun Hejing.

description.zh-cn: 内管领，令嫔（后来的孝仪纯皇后）之父。因负责孝贤皇后祭品时出现差错而被乾隆帝处罚。
description.en: An official of the Imperial Household Department and the father of Consort Ling (later Empress Xiaoyichun). He was punished by the Qianlong Emperor for an error regarding the sacrificial offerings for Empress Xiaoxianchun.

description.zh-cn: 由黄宏生创立的消费电子产品公司。
description.en: A consumer electronics company founded by Huang Hongsheng.

description.zh-cn: 海南省的主体岛屿。
description.en: The main island of Hainan Province.

description.zh-cn: 西梁开国皇帝，庙号中宗。在西魏支持下于江陵称帝，建立西梁政权。
description.en: The founding emperor of Western Liang, with the temple name Zhongzong. He established the Western Liang regime by declaring himself emperor in Jiangling with the support of the Western Wei.

description.zh-cn: 西梁第二位皇帝，梁宣帝萧詧之子，庙号世宗。
description.en: The second emperor of Western Liang, son of Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha), with the temple name Shizong.

description.zh-cn: 西梁末代皇帝，梁明帝萧岿之子。后被隋文帝废黜，封为莒国公。
description.en: The last emperor of Western Liang, son of Emperor Ming (Xiao Kui). He was later deposed by Emperor Wen of Sui and enfeoffed as the Duke of Ju.

description.zh-cn: 梁武帝萧衍第七子，南梁第四位皇帝。在江陵被西魏所杀。
description.en: The seventh son of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, and the fourth emperor of the Liang dynasty. He was killed by the Western Wei in Jiangling.

description.zh-cn: 南梁昭明太子，梁武帝萧衍的长子，梁宣帝萧詧之父。他被其子追赠为皇帝。
description.en: Crown Prince Zhaoming of the Southern Liang dynasty, the eldest son of Emperor Wu of Liang (Xiao Yan). He was also the father of Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha) and was posthumously honored as an emperor by his son.

description.zh-cn: 南北朝时期南梁将领，其控制的长沙、武陵等地曾被西梁攻占。
description.en: A general of the Southern Liang dynasty during the Northern and Southern dynasties period, whose controlled territories including Changsha and Wuling were once captured by the Western Liang.

description.zh-cn: 梁宣帝萧詧的曾孙，在隋朝末年自立为梁帝。
description.en: The great-grandson of Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha), who declared himself Emperor of Liang during the late Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 一场基督教复兴运动，推动了普林斯顿大学等高等教育机构的建立。
description.en: A Christian revival movement that spurred the establishment of institutions of higher education, including Princeton University.

description.zh-cn: 基督新教的一个宗派，创立了普林斯顿大学的前身纽泽西学院，最初目的是培养长老。
description.en: A Protestant denomination that founded the College of New Jersey, the predecessor to Princeton University, initially to train ministers.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人，合和实业创办人及董事局主席，普林斯顿大学校友。1995年向普林斯顿大学捐款一亿美元。
description.en: Hong Kong businessman, founder and chairman of Hopewell Holdings, and an alumnus of Princeton University. He donated $100 million to Princeton University in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 美国数学家，普林斯顿大学博士，诺贝尔经济学奖得主。主要工作领域为博弈论和微分几何学，提出了纳什均衡理论。
description.en: American mathematician, Princeton Ph.D., and Nobel laureate in Economics. His main areas of work were game theory and differential geometry, and he proposed the Nash equilibrium concept.

description.zh-cn: 美国企业家，亚马逊公司创始人，普林斯顿大学校友。
description.en: American entrepreneur, founder of Amazon.com, and an alumnus of Princeton University.

description.zh-cn: 由普林斯顿大学东亚研究系在六四事件后成立，旨在收留流亡海外的中国学生和学者。
description.en: An organization founded by Princeton University's Department of East Asian Studies after the Tiananmen Square protests to support exiled Chinese students and scholars.

description.zh-cn: 美国汉学家，普林斯顿大学东亚研究系的创系元老，专长为元明史。
description.en: American sinologist and a founding father of the Department of East Asian Studies at Princeton University, specializing in Yuan and Ming history.

description.zh-cn: 英国数学家、计算机科学家、密码学家，被誉为“计算机科学与人工智能之父”。1938年在普林斯顿大学获得博士学位。
description.en: British mathematician, computer scientist, and cryptanalyst, hailed as the father of computer science and artificial intelligence. He received his Ph.D. from Princeton University in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，与黄公略、彭德怀在湘军时期结为挚友。
description.en: A commander of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, who became a close friend of Huang Gonglue and Peng Dehuai during their time in the Hunan Army.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖南的军事学校，黄公略曾于此学习。
description.en: A military academy in Hunan where Huang Gonglue studied.

zh-cn: 中央苏区第二次反围剿战争
中国共产党第二次反围剿战争
en: Second encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军对中央苏区的第二次大规模军事围剿，黄公略率部参战。
description.en: The second large-scale military encirclement campaign by the National Revolutionary Army against the Central Soviet Area, in which Huang Gonglue led his troops.

zh-cn: 中央苏区第三次反围剿战争
中国共产党第三次反围剿战争
en: Third encirclement campaign against the Jiangxi Soviet

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军对中央苏区的第三次大规模军事围剿，黄公略在此次战役中阵亡。
description.en: The third large-scale military encirclement campaign by the National Revolutionary Army against the Central Soviet Area, during which Huang Gonglue was killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略同父异母的哥哥，受蒋介石派遣劝降黄公略，后被彭德怀处死。
description.en: Huang Gonglue's half-brother, who was sent by Chiang Kai-shek to persuade Huang Gonglue to surrender and was later executed by Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Huang Gonglue.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略与刘玉英的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Huang Gonglue and Liu Yuying.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事家列表
中国人民解放军军事家

description.zh-cn: 由中共中央军委认定的36位对中国人民解放军创建与发展作出卓越贡献的高级将领。
description.en: A title for 36 senior commanders recognized by the Central Military Commission of the CCP for their outstanding contributions to the founding and development of the People's Liberation Army.

zh-cn: 100位为新中国成立作出突出贡献的英雄模范人物

description.zh-cn: 2009年为庆祝中华人民共和国成立60周年，由中国官方评选出的英雄模范人物名单。
description.en: A list of heroic and exemplary figures selected by Chinese officials in 2009 to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个环境保护组织。
description.en: An environmental protection organization in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，中国国民党籍立法委员。

description.en: The 1912 event where Tibet expelled Qing officials and troops, after which Tibet achieved de facto independence.

description.en: Wife of Hong Xuezhi, also a former Red Army soldier.

description.en: Eldest son of Hong Xuezhi, former governor of Jilin Province.

description.en: Chief of Staff of the 3rd Division of the New Fourth Army, whose position was taken over by Hong Xuezhi after he was killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 日本海军将领，时任联合舰队司令长官，是偷袭珍珠港计划的核心策划者。
description.en: A Japanese Marshal Admiral of the Navy and the commander-in-chief of the Combined Fleet, who was the mastermind behind the plan to attack Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 日本海军中将，在偷袭珍珠港行动中担任第一航空舰队司令长官，负责指挥攻击舰队。
description.en: A Japanese admiral in the Imperial Japanese Navy who served as commander of the First Air Fleet, leading the fleet that attacked Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 指1941年美国、英国、中国、荷兰对日本采取的经济制裁，特别是石油禁运，是促使日本发动太平洋战争的重要原因。
description.en: Refers to the economic sanctions, particularly the oil embargo, imposed on Japan by America, Britain, China, and the Dutch in 1941, which was a significant factor leading Japan to initiate the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军宾夕法尼亚级战舰，在珍珠港事件中被击沉，造成大量人员伤亡，其残骸成为战争纪念馆。
description.en: A Pennsylvania-class battleship of the United States Navy, sunk during the attack on Pearl Harbor with immense loss of life. Its wreck is now a war memorial.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福在珍珠港事件次日向国会发表的演说，请求对日宣战。
description.en: A speech delivered by U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt to Congress the day after the attack on Pearl Harbor, asking for a declaration of war against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军上将，在珍珠港事件时担任美国太平洋舰队总司令，事后因防守不力被解职降阶。
description.en: A U.S. Navy admiral who served as the commander-in-chief of the U.S. Pacific Fleet at the time of the attack. He was subsequently relieved of command and demoted for being unprepared.

description.zh-cn: 珍珠港事件后，美国政府针对居住在美国的日裔美国人进行的强制迁移和监禁。
description.en: The forced relocation and incarceration in concentration camps in the western interior of the country of people of Japanese ancestry who lived on the Pacific coast, which occurred after the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 由美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福签署的行政命令，授权战争部长划定军事区，并最终导致了日裔美国人的大规模拘留。
description.en: An executive order signed by U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt that authorized the Secretary of War to prescribe certain areas as military zones, ultimately leading to the mass incarceration of Japanese Americans.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在蔡奇任衢州市市长期间，曾任衢州市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Party Secretary of Quzhou while Cai Qi was the city's mayor.

description.en: The first aircraft carrier of the People's Liberation Army Navy.

description.en: A prefecture-level city in Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军的中等级别将领军衔。
description.en: A mid-level admiral rank in the People's Liberation Army Navy.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军南部战区海军的航空兵部队。
description.en: The aviation branch of the PLA Southern Theater Command Navy.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军装备的导弹驱逐舰舰级。王海曾担任该级下的重庆号导弹驱逐舰舰长。
description.en: A class of guided-missile destroyers of the People's Liberation Army Navy. Wang Hai served as the captain of the Chongqing, a ship of this class.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军少将。
description.en: A rear admiral of the People's Liberation Army Navy.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期山西省的最高行政长官职位。
description.en: The position of the highest-ranking administrative official in Shanxi Province during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国驻华公使，因不满毓贤对义和团的纵容态度，向清政府施压要求将其撤换。
description.en: The United States Minister to China at the time, who pressured the Qing government to remove Yuxian due to dissatisfaction with his tolerant attitude towards the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 1900年7月9日，在山西巡抚毓贤的命令下，46名外国传教士及其家属在太原巡抚衙门前被集体屠杀的事件，是义和团运动期间最惨烈的教案之一。
description.en: An event on July 9, 1900, where 46 foreign missionaries and their families were massacred in front of the provincial governor's yamen in Taiyuan under the order of Shanxi Governor Yuxian. It was one of the most tragic incidents against Christians during the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 意大利籍天主教方济各会会士，时任山西北境宗座代牧区主教，在太原教案中被毓贤亲手杀害。
description.en: An Italian Franciscan Catholic friar, serving as the bishop of the Apostolic Vicariate of Northern Shansi. He was personally killed by Yuxian during the Taiyuan Massacre.

description.zh-cn: 清末流行于华北的民间秘密武装团体，是义和团的前身之一。曾被时任山东按察使的毓贤镇压。
description.en: A secret armed folk society popular in Northern China during the late Qing dynasty, and one of the precursors to the Boxers. It was suppressed by Yuxian when he was the Judicial Commissioner of Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员。第十三届全国人民代表大会黑龙江地区代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, and a member of the Chinese Communist Party. She is a delegate for the Heilongjiang region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 由谷歌公司推出的一个互联网搜索引擎。
description.en: An internet search engine provided by Google.

description.zh-cn: 原中国健康教育研究所所长，曾发表公开信指责李长春在河南血祸中的责任。
description.en: Former director of the China Health Education Research Institute, who published an open letter criticizing Li Changchun's responsibility in the Henan plasma economy disaster.

description.zh-cn: 李长春的长女，中银国际执行总裁。
description.en: Li Changchun's eldest daughter, executive president of BOC International.

zh-cn: 中银国际控股有限公司

description.zh-cn: 中国银行旗下的投资银行。高迎欣曾于2004年至2005年担任其总裁兼首席运营官。
description.en: An investment bank under the Bank of China. Gao Yingxin served as its President and COO from 2004 to 2005.

description.zh-cn: 一个形容劣质、不合标准建筑工程的贬义词。该词在1998年中国水灾期间被时任总理朱镕基使用后广为人知，用以批评因质量问题而在洪水中损毁的堤坝等水利设施。
description.en: A pejorative term describing poorly constructed and substandard building projects. The term was popularized by then-Premier Zhu Rongji during the 1998 China floods to criticize water infrastructure, such as dikes, that failed due to poor quality.

description.zh-cn: 一种通过围垦湖泊来增加耕地的行为。这种做法被认为是加剧1998年中国水灾的人为因素之一，因为它破坏了湖泊的自然蓄洪能力，导致生态失衡。
description.en: The practice of reclaiming land from lakes to create arable land. This practice was identified as one of the man-made factors that exacerbated the 1998 China floods by destroying the natural flood storage capacity of lakes and causing ecological imbalance.

zh-cn: 国家防汛抗旱总指挥部
en: State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院负责组织和指挥全国防汛抗旱工作的议事协调机构。
description.en: A coordinating body of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for organizing and directing national flood control and drought relief efforts.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一项生态环境保护政策，旨在将陡坡或生态脆弱地区的耕地恢复为林地或草地。1998年水灾后，为改善水土流失问题，中华人民共和国国务院大力推动了这项工作。
description.en: An ecological conservation policy in China aimed at converting cultivated land on steep slopes or in ecologically fragile areas back into forests or grasslands. After the 1998 floods, the State Council of the PRC strongly promoted this initiative to mitigate soil erosion.

description.zh-cn: 中国东北地区的大河。1998年，松花江流域与嫩江一同遭遇了150年来最严重的特大洪水。
description.en: A major river in Northeast China. In 1998, along with the Nen River, its basin suffered the most severe flood in 150 years.

description.zh-cn: 松花江的最大支流。1998年，嫩江流域与松花江一同遭遇了150年来最严重的特大洪水。
description.en: The largest tributary of the Songhua River. In 1998, along with the Songhua River, its basin suffered the most severe flood in 150 years.

description.zh-cn: 位于吉林省的一所农业学校，回良玉早年毕业于此。
description.en: An agricultural school in Jilin Province from which Hui Liangyu graduated in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，回良玉的前任江苏省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Hui Liangyu's predecessor as Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，回良玉的前任安徽省委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, Hui Liangyu's predecessor as Anhui Provincial Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，回良玉的前任安徽省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Hui Liangyu's predecessor as Governor of Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，回良玉的前任湖北省政协主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, Hui Liangyu's predecessor as Chairman of the Hubei Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，在回良玉担任江苏省委书记期间任副书记兼省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as deputy secretary and governor while Hui Liangyu was Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 周扬的第二任妻子。
description.en: The second wife of Zhou Yang.

description.zh-cn: 曾任《人民日报》副总编辑，协助周扬撰写了关于“人道主义”和“异化”问题的报告。
description.en: Former deputy editor-in-chief of the People's Daily, who assisted Zhou Yang in drafting the report on "humanitarianism" and "alienation".

description.zh-cn: 学者，曾实际承担中宣部副部长周扬的秘书工作，并协助周扬撰写了关于“人道主义”和“异化”问题的报告。
description.en: A scholar who effectively served as secretary to Zhou Yang, then Vice Minister of the Propaganda Department, and assisted him in drafting the report on "humanitarianism" and "alienation".

description.zh-cn: 中国学者、思想家，协助周扬撰写了关于“人道主义”和“异化”问题的报告。
description.en: A Chinese scholar and thinker who assisted Zhou Yang in drafting the report on "humanitarianism" and "alienation".

description.zh-cn: 一种哲学理论和价值观，强调人的价值、尊严和权利。周扬在晚年提出马克思主义包含人道主义，引发了党内争论。
description.en: A philosophical theory and value system emphasizing human value, dignity, and rights. In his later years, Zhou Yang proposed that Marxism contains humanitarianism, which sparked controversy within the Party.

description.zh-cn: 上海市的最高审判机关。
description.en: The highest judicial organ in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 上海市的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The local organ of state power in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 上海市政府原副秘书长。
description.en: Former Deputy Secretary-General of the Shanghai Municipal Government.

zh-cn: 上海浦北路持刀杀人案
2018年上海市世界外国语小学砍人事件
en: 2018 Shanghai World Foreign Language Primary School stabbing

zh-cn: 上海市第二中级人民法院

description.en: A faction of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Kim Il-sung.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。
description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。

description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。后逃亡中国，曾向中联部提出组织力量进入朝鲜斗争但被拒绝。
description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident. He later fled to China and proposed to the International Liaison Department to organize forces to enter North Korea for struggle, but was rejected.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。
description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。
description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。
description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜延安派成员，在八月宗派事件中被打倒。
description.en: A member of the Korean Yan'an faction who was purged during the August Faction Incident.

description.zh-cn: 一种被主体思想所批判的外交和政治思想，意指侍奉和依赖大国。
description.en: A diplomatic and political ideology criticized by the Juche idea, referring to serving and relying on great powers.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜劳动党中央政治委员会委员，后被罢免。
description.en: Member of the Politburo of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, later dismissed.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民族保卫相，在1968年11月劳动党中央全会被清洗。
description.en: Minister of National Defence of North Korea, purged at the Central Committee plenum of the Workers' Party of Korea in November 1968.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民族保卫副相，在1968年11月劳动党中央全会被清洗。
description.en: Vice Minister of National Defence of North Korea, purged at the Central Committee plenum of the Workers' Party of Korea in November 1968.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜人民军总参谋长，在1968年11月劳动党中央全会被清洗。
description.en: Chief of the General Staff of the Korean People's Army, purged at the Central Committee plenum of the Workers' Party of Korea in November 1968.

description.zh-cn: 一种亲属关系称谓。
君主在生前将帝位传给继承者。
授予太上皇的前任君主（若在世）的罕见头衔。
通常是皇帝的祖母的头衔。
赵武灵王禅位后自创的头衔，地位类似太上皇。
日本退位天皇的尊号，简称上皇、院或上院。
出家为僧的日本太上天皇的尊号，简称法皇。
日本一种特殊的政治形态，由太上天皇（上皇）在幕后掌握实权进行统治。
日本首位获得“太上天皇”称号的退位天皇。
根据《天皇退位特例法》为退位后的明仁天皇设立的称号。

zh-cn: 上皇后 (天皇退位特例法)

description.zh-cn: 根据《天皇退位特例法》为退位后的皇后美智子设立的称号。
朝鲜王朝等王国给予退位国王的头衔。
朝鲜王朝时期，对非君主直系、但其子登上王位的宗室的尊称。
越南第一个太上皇。
越南陈朝首位太上皇，未曾为帝王。
越南陈朝的一位皇帝，曾担任三朝太上皇。
西汉时期的长沙王，为吴芮之子，英布的妻舅。他诱杀了逃亡中的英布。
description.en: King of Changsha during the Western Han dynasty, son of Wu Rui, and brother-in-law of Ying Bu. He lured and assassinated the fugitive Ying Bu.

description.zh-cn: 英布的部下，任淮南中大夫。因与英布产生嫌隙，逃往长安告发英布谋反。
description.en: A subordinate of Ying Bu, serving as a Grand Master of the Palace in Huainan. Due to a rift with Ying Bu, he fled to Chang'an and accused Ying Bu of plotting a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦的谋士与说客，成功说服英布背叛项羽，归降汉朝。
description.en: An advisor and lobbyist for Liu Bang who successfully persuaded Ying Bu to betray Xiang Yu and surrender to the Han.

description.zh-cn: 西楚将领，曾与龙且一同进攻反叛的英布。
description.en: A general of Western Chu who, along with Long Qie, attacked the rebellious Ying Bu.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝宗室，被封为荆王。在英布反叛时被其击败并杀害。
description.en: A member of the Han imperial clan, enfeoffed as the King of Jing. He was defeated and killed by Ying Bu during the latter's rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 原为西楚大司马，后在垓下之战前夕被诱降，反叛楚国并加入了汉军。
description.en: Originally the Grand Marshal of Western Chu, he was persuaded to surrender on the eve of the Battle of Gaixia, betraying Chu and joining the Han forces.

description.zh-cn: 原楚国令尹，在英布谋反时，为刘邦分析了英布可能采取的战略，并准确预测其会采取下策。
description.en: The former prime minister of the Chu state. When Ying Bu rebelled, he analyzed the potential strategies for Liu Bang and accurately predicted that Ying Bu would choose the worst option.

description.zh-cn: 英布的家乡，位于今安徽省六安市。
description.en: Ying Bu's hometown, located in modern-day Lu'an, Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 英布的逝世地点，位于今江西省景德镇市西南。
description.en: The place of Ying Bu's death, located southwest of modern-day Jingdezhen, Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局和山东省人民政府双重领导，以中国地震局为主的事业单位，承担山东省行政区域内防震减灾工作政府行政管理职能。
description.en: A public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the Shandong Provincial People's Government, with the former taking the primary role. It undertakes the governmental and administrative functions of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction within the administrative region of Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 1969年7月18日在渤海发生的7.4级地震，该事件直接推动了山东省地震工作机构的建立。
description.en: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake that occurred in the Bohai Sea on July 18, 1969. This event directly led to the establishment of earthquake-related work organizations in Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 以色列政治家，现任以色列总统。
description.en: An Israeli politician currently serving as the President of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 以色列首任总理，被誉为“以色列国父”。
description.en: The first Prime Minister of Israel, regarded as the 'founding father of Israel'.

description.zh-cn: 宣告以色列国正式成立的文件。
description.en: The document that formally declared the establishment of the State of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 一项政治运动，主张在以色列地建立一个属于犹太民族的家园。
description.en: A political movement that advocates for the establishment of a homeland for the Jewish people in the Land of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 现代政治锡安主义的创始人。
description.en: The founder of modern political Zionism.

en: United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会通过的关于巴勒斯坦托管地未来治理的决议，建议将其划分为一个犹太国家和一个阿拉伯国家。
description.en: A resolution passed by the UN General Assembly regarding the future governance of Mandatory Palestine, recommending its partition into a Jewish state and an Arab state.

description.zh-cn: 一个由阿拉伯国家组成的区域性国际组织。
description.en: A regional international organization of Arab states.

description.zh-cn: 以色列建国后，与其邻近的阿拉伯国家之间爆发的第一场大规模战争。
description.en: The first large-scale war fought between the newly established State of Israel and its neighboring Arab states.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的国家。
description.en: A country in Western Asia.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的国家。
description.en: A country in Western Asia.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的国家。
description.en: A country in Western Asia.

description.zh-cn: 1967年6月以色列与其邻国埃及、叙利亚和约旦之间爆发的战争。战后以色列占领了约旦河西岸、加沙地带、戈兰高地和西奈半岛。
description.en: A war fought in June 1967 between Israel and its neighbors Egypt, Syria, and Jordan. After the war, Israel occupied the West Bank, Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, and Sinai Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的内陆地区，是巴勒斯坦领土的一部分。
description.en: A landlocked territory in Western Asia, part of the Palestinian territories.

description.zh-cn: 位于地中海沿岸的巴勒斯坦飞地。
description.en: A Palestinian exclave on the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.

description.zh-cn: 位于西亚的岩石高原，国际上普遍认为是叙利亚领土，但自1967年以来被以色列占领。
description.en: A rocky plateau in Western Asia, internationally recognized as Syrian territory but occupied by Israel since 1967.

description.zh-cn: 埃及的半岛，位于亚洲和非洲之间。
description.en: A peninsula in Egypt, situated between Asia and Africa.

description.zh-cn: 1973年10月，由埃及和叙利亚领导的阿拉伯国家联盟对以色列发动的战争。
description.en: A war initiated in October 1973 by a coalition of Arab states led by Egypt and Syria against Israel.

description.zh-cn: 埃及总统萨达特和以色列总理贝京在美国总统卡特斡旋下签署的协议，为1979年的埃以和平条约奠定了基础。
description.en: Agreements signed by Egyptian President Anwar Sadat and Israeli Prime Minister Menachem Begin, brokered by US President Jimmy Carter, which led to the 1979 Egypt–Israel peace treaty.

description.zh-cn: 以色列政治家，利库德集团创始人，曾任以色列第六任总理。
description.en: An Israeli politician, founder of Likud, and the sixth Prime Minister of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 以色列与埃及签署的和平条约，结束了两国长达三十年的敌对状态。
description.en: A peace treaty signed between Israel and Egypt, ending three decades of hostility between the two countries.

description.zh-cn: 以色列政治家和将军，曾两度担任以色列总理，因推动以巴和平进程获诺贝尔和平奖，后被刺杀。
description.en: An Israeli politician and general, who served two terms as Prime Minister of Israel, won the Nobel Peace Prize for his role in the peace process, and was later assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 以色列与巴勒斯坦解放组织签署的一系列协议，旨在解决以巴冲突。
description.en: A set of agreements between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization aimed at resolving the Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

description.zh-cn: 一个旨在代表巴勒斯坦人民的政治和准军事组织。
description.en: A political and paramilitary organization founded to represent the Palestinian people.

description.zh-cn: 一名以色列极右翼激进分子，因刺杀以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾而闻名。
description.en: An Israeli far-right extremist known for assassinating Israeli Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，京汉铁路总工会江岸分会委员长，罢工领导人之一。因拒绝下令复工，在江岸站被军阀斩首。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party and chairman of the Jiang'an branch of the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union, and one of the strike leaders. He was beheaded by warlord forces at Jiang'an Station for refusing to order the workers back to work.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，律师，京汉铁路总工会法律顾问。罢工失败后被捕，后被军阀杀害于武昌。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party and a lawyer, who served as the legal advisor to the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union. He was arrested after the strike failed and was subsequently killed by warlords in Wuchang.

description.zh-cn: 时任京汉铁路局局长，配合吴佩孚镇压罢工。1951年在罢工发生地江岸站被公审枪决。
description.en: The director of the Beijing-Hankou Railway Bureau at the time, who collaborated with Wu Peifu to suppress the strike. In 1951, he was publicly tried and executed by firing squad at Jiang'an Station, the site of the strike.

description.zh-cn: 在中国共产党领导下成立的铁路工会组织，是京汉铁路工人大罢工的发起和领导者。
description.en: A railway trade union established under the leadership of the Communist Party of China, which initiated and led the Beijing-Hankou railway workers' strike.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀将领，时任湖北督军，接到吴佩孚命令后派遣军队镇压罢工，并下令杀害施洋。
description.en: A general of the Zhili clique, serving as the military governor of Hubei, who dispatched troops to suppress the strike upon receiving orders from Wu Peifu and later ordered the killing of Shi Yang.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期领导人之一，参与领导了京汉铁路工人大罢工。
description.en: An early leader of the Communist Party of China who participated in leading the Beijing-Hankou railway workers' strike.

description.zh-cn: 京汉铁路总工会委员长，罢工领导人之一。
description.en: Chairman of the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union and one of the strike leaders.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀将领，时任郑州驻军长官，奉吴佩孚之命阻止京汉铁路总工会成立大会。
description.en: A general of the Zhili clique and the commander of the Zhengzhou garrison, who was ordered by Wu Peifu to prevent the founding conference of the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union.

description.zh-cn: 京汉铁路南段的重要车站，是罢工的中心之一。林祥谦在此处被杀害，赵继贤也在此处被公审。
description.en: An important station on the southern section of the Beijing-Hankou Railway and one of the centers of the strike. Lin Xiangqian was killed here, and Zhao Jixian was also publicly tried here.

description.zh-cn: 林祥谦之弟，在军警镇压罢工时于江岸三道街被杀害。
description.en: Brother of Lin Xiangqian, who was killed at Sandao Street in Jiang'an during the suppression of the strike by military and police forces.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省人民政府的组成部门、主管陕西省教育工作的省级教育行政部门。
description.en: A component department of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Government and the provincial-level education administrative department in charge of education in Shaanxi Province.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国水产部
en: Ministry of Aquatic Products of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国在1956年至1970年间存在的国务院组成部门，负责管理国家水产事业。
description.en: A component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China that existed from 1956 to 1970, responsible for the administration of national aquatic products industry.

description.zh-cn: 中国建筑师，曾主持设计中华人民共和国水产部办公大楼。
description.en: A Chinese architect who led the design of the office building for the Ministry of Aquatic Products of the People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国内贸易部
en: Ministry of Internal Trade of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经的组成部门，负责国内贸易管理。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the administration of domestic trade.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农林部
en: Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 1970年由中华人民共和国农业部、中华人民共和国林业部、中华人民共和国农垦部、中华人民共和国水产部四部合并成立的国务院组成部门。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council formed in 1970 by the merger of the Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Forestry, Ministry of State Farms and Land Reclamation, and Ministry of Aquatic Products.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治家、社会活动家，曾任中华人民共和国水产部部长，并担任第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: A Chinese politician and social activist who served as the Minister of Aquatic Products of the People's Republic of China and as Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 清代在长春地区设立的行政机构，隶属于吉林将军，后改为长春府。
description.en: An administrative division established in the Changchun area during the Qing dynasty, subordinate to the General of Jilin, later upgraded to Changchun Fu.

description.zh-cn: 清代东北地区的军事和行政长官。
description.en: A military and administrative governor in Northeast China during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期东北大行政区的最高行政管理机关。
description.en: The highest administrative body of the Northeast Great Administrative Region in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 吉林省下辖的地级市，曾为吉林省省会。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Jilin Province, formerly the provincial capital.

description.zh-cn: 吉林省下辖的地级市，曾代管公主岭市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Jilin Province, which formerly administered Gongzhuling.

description.zh-cn: 塞尔维亚第二大城市，长春市的友好城市。
description.en: The second largest city in Serbia, and a sister city of Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 英国英格兰的城市，长春市的友好城市。
description.en: A city in England, United Kingdom, and a sister city of Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 德国下萨克森州的城市，长春市的友好城市。
description.en: A city in Lower Saxony, Germany, and a sister city of Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 孙策的部下，吕蒙的姊夫。吕蒙早年曾跟随他出征。
description.en: A subordinate of Sun Ce and the brother-in-law of Lü Meng. In his youth, Lü Meng followed him on military campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年江夏太守黄祖麾下的水军都督，在夏口之战中被吕蒙亲手斩杀。
description.en: A naval commander under Huang Zu, the Grand Administrator of Jiangxia, during the late Eastern Han Dynasty. He was personally slain by Lü Meng during the Battle of Xiakou.

description.zh-cn: 刘备麾下零陵太守，在吕蒙夺取荆南三郡时，被吕蒙用计策诱降。
description.en: The Grand Administrator of Lingling under Liu Bei. When Lü Meng seized the three southern commanderies of Jing Province, he was tricked into surrendering by Lü Meng's deceptive tactics.

description.zh-cn: 孙吴将领。吕蒙临终前曾向孙权推荐他，认为其可以担当重任。
description.en: A general of Sun Wu. Before his death, Lü Meng recommended him to Sun Quan, believing he was capable of shouldering great responsibilities.

description.zh-cn: 孙吴将领，江表十二虎臣之一。与吕蒙一同受孙权劝学而发奋读书，两人常被孙权并列称赞。
description.en: A general of Sun Wu, one of the Twelve Tiger Ministers of Jiangbiao. Along with Lü Meng, he was encouraged by Sun Quan to study diligently, and the two were often praised together by Sun Quan.

description.zh-cn: 孙吴猛将。为人粗暴好杀，曾与吕蒙有过冲突，但吕蒙仍向孙权力保其才干，最终两人和解并共事。
description.en: A valiant general of Sun Wu. He had a rough and violent temperament and once had a conflict with Lü Meng, but Lü Meng still strongly advocated for his talent to Sun Quan. They eventually reconciled and worked together.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期广东省的最高行政长官职位。
description.en: The position of the chief executive officer of Guangdong Province during the Republic of China.

en: Constitution Protection Region of Southern Fujian

description.zh-cn: 护法战争期间，陈炯明率粤军占领福建南部后建立的割据政权。
description.en: A separatist regime established by Chen Jiongming after his Guangdong Army occupied southern Fujian during the Constitutional Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 1920年旧桂系军阀与陈炯明领导的粤军之间爆发的战争，以粤军胜利告终。
description.en: A war between the Old Guangxi clique and the Guangdong Army led by Chen Jiongming in 1920, which ended in a victory for the Guangdong Army.

description.zh-cn: 一种国家结构形式，陈炯明是其信奉者，并支持中国的联省自治主张。
description.en: A form of state structure that Chen Jiongming believed in, and he supported the proposal for the Federalism of United Provinces in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家，曾是陈炯明在广东法政学堂的教员，后与陈炯明一同反袁。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary who was Chen Jiongming's instructor at the Guangdong School of Law and Politics and later joined him in opposing Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 清朝广东水师提督，在黄花岗起义期间成为陈炯明的行刺目标。
description.en: The Admiral of the Guangdong Fleet of the Qing Dynasty, who was an assassination target of Chen Jiongming during the Yellow Flower Mound Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 原陈炯明麾下粤军第二师师长，后被袁世凯收买，倒戈炮击陈炯明的都督府。
description.en: Former commander of the 2nd Division of the Guangdong Army under Chen Jiongming. He was later bribed by Yuan Shikai and turned against Chen, bombarding his governor's mansion.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期盘踞广西的军阀集团，曾与陈炯明领导的粤军多次爆发战争。
description.en: A warlord clique based in Guangxi during the Republican era, which fought several wars against the Guangdong Army led by Chen Jiongming.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山在广州成立的旨在维护《临时约法》的政府，陈炯明曾被任命为第一军总司令。后因陈炯明擅置官员等事与军政府产生不和。
description.en: A government established by Sun Yat-sen in Guangzhou to uphold the Provisional Constitution. Chen Jiongming was appointed as the Commander-in-Chief of the First Army. Later, conflicts arose between Chen and the military government over matters such as his unauthorized appointment of officials.

description.zh-cn: 1921年旧桂系军阀与陈炯明领导的粤军之间再次爆发的战争，虽粤军获胜，但士气大挫。
description.en: A war that broke out again in 1921 between the Old Guangxi clique and the Guangdong Army led by Chen Jiongming. Although the Guangdong Army won, its morale was severely damaged.

description.zh-cn: 粤军将领，陈炯明旧部。其于1922年遭暗杀，孙中山一方坚称是陈炯明所为，成为孙陈决裂的导火索之一。
description.en: A general in the Guangdong Army and a former subordinate of Chen Jiongming. His assassination in 1922, which Sun Yat-sen's side insisted was carried out by Chen, became one of the catalysts for the Sun-Chen split.

description.zh-cn: 粤军将领，曾与陈炯明联手击败桂军，后在孙陈决裂时拥护孙中山并参与讨伐陈炯明。
description.en: A general of the Guangdong Army who once allied with Chen Jiongming to defeat the Guangxi forces. After the Sun-Chen split, he supported Sun Yat-sen and participated in the campaign against Chen.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明麾下救粤军将领，其部队在第一次东征中被黄埔军校教导团击溃。
description.en: A general of the Guangdong Salvation Army under Chen Jiongming. His troops were defeated by the Whampoa Military Academy's training regiment during the First Eastern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Chen Jiongming.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，辽宁凌源人。曾任江苏省省长、中共江苏省委书记、江苏省人大常委会主任、第十三届全国政协农业和农村委员会主任。中共第十七届中央候补委员、第十八届中央委员。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity, from Lingyuan, Liaoning. He served as the Governor of Jiangsu Province, Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress, and Director of the Committee for Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC. He was an alternate member of the 17th Central Committee and a full member of the 18th Central Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国解放军少将，罗志军之父。曾任解放军总后勤部装备部副部长。
description.en: A major general of the People's Liberation Army of the People's Republic of China, father of Luo Zhijun. He served as the deputy director of the Equipment Department of the PLA General Logistics Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任南京市市长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Mayor of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任南京市市长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Mayor of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江苏省省长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Governor of Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共南京市委书记。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Secretary of the Nanjing Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国的国家通讯社。
description.en: The state news agency of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 香港的一份中文报纸。
description.en: A Chinese-language newspaper in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党广西壮族自治区委员会书记、广西壮族自治区人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Communist Party Committee of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region and the Director of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任广西壮族自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国人民政治协商会议广西壮族自治区委员会主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference Guangxi Committee.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝设立的一个行政区划，是“广西”名称的直接来源。
description.en: An administrative division established during the Song Dynasty, which is the direct source of the name 'Guangxi'.

zh-cn: 广西省 (中华人民共和国)
en: Guangxi Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的省级行政区，1958年改制为广西僮族自治区。
description.en: A provincial-level administrative region in the early days of the People's Republic of China, which was reorganized into the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in 1958.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家，曾于1929至1930年间在广西参与领导发动百色起义。
description.en: Chinese revolutionary who participated in leading the Baise Uprising in Guangxi between 1929 and 1930.

description.zh-cn: 由邓小平等人在广西领导发动的武装起义，期间创建了红七军和红八军。
description.en: An armed uprising led by Deng Xiaoping and others in Guangxi, during which the Red 7th and Red 8th Armies were created.

description.zh-cn: 侵华日军的一支部队，曾在中国抗日战争期间发动桂南会战并攻占广西。
description.en: A unit of the invading Japanese army that launched the Battle of South Guangxi and occupied Guangxi during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争期间的一场战役，日军攻占了广西。
description.en: A battle during the Second Sino-Japanese War in which the Japanese army occupied Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的广西省，是新桂系军阀的根据地。
description.en: Guangxi Province during the Republic of China era, which was the base of the New Guangxi clique.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间的一场战役，第四野战军攻克了广西。
description.en: A campaign during the Second Chinese Civil War in which the Fourth Field Army conquered Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 东晋第三位皇帝。
description.en: The third emperor of the Eastern Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市下辖的市辖区。
description.en: A municipal district under the jurisdiction of Shenzhen.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任深圳市人民政府市长，后因受贿罪被判处死缓。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Mayor of Shenzhen, who was later sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve for bribery.

zh-cn: 河南省郑州市中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任深圳市副市长，后因严重违纪并涉嫌犯罪被开除党籍并移送司法机关。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, former Vice Mayor of Shenzhen, who was later expelled from the party and transferred to judicial organs for serious disciplinary violations and suspected crimes.

description.zh-cn: 中国领先的快递物流综合服务商。
description.en: A leading integrated express logistics service provider in China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，中央军委联勤保障部队政治委员。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, Political Commissar of the Joint Logistic Support Force of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军上将，曾任南部战区政治委员。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, former Political Commissar of the Southern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省武汉市的市辖区。
description.en: A district of Wuhan City, Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 黄沾的母亲。
香港女歌手，黄沾的首任妻子。
黄沾的助手，后成为其第二任妻子。
黄沾与华娃的女儿，前无线电视主持人。
香港作曲家，与黄沾是长期音乐合作伙伴，被称为“𪸩黄配”。
香港填词人，与黄沾、郑国江并列为香港粤语流行乐坛早期的三大填词人。
香港填词人，与黄沾、卢国沾并列为香港粤语流行乐坛早期的三大填词人。
香港政治人物，新香港联盟的创办人。
中华人民共和国政治人物，彭珮云的继任国家计划生育委员会主任。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, Peng Peiyun's successor as Minister of the State Family Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2015年5月4日，时任中国国民党主席朱立伦与中共中央总书记习近平在北京的会面。
description.en: A meeting on May 4, 2015, in Beijing between then-KMT Chairman Eric Chu and CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十七届中央委员会第一次全体会议
en: 17th Politburo of the Chinese Communist Party
1st Plenary Session of the 17th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

description.zh-cn: 选举产生了新一届中共中央政治局、中央政治局常务委员会和中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Elected the new Politburo, Politburo Standing Committee, and General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江西省省长，后因徇私舞弊罪被判刑。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Governor of Jiangxi Province and was later imprisoned for favoritism and fraud.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江西省省长。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Governor of Jiangxi Province.

zh-cn: 台北大众捷运股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 负责营运台北捷运系统的公司。
description.en: The company responsible for operating the Taipei Metro system.

zh-cn: 台湾省立新竹高级中学

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾新竹市的一所高级中学。
description.en: A senior high school located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台北市的一所私立大学。
description.en: A private university located in Taipei City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李文宗的胞妹。
description.en: Younger sister of Li Wen-tsung.

description.zh-cn: 台湾台北地方法院检察署，是台湾的司法机关，负责侦办及起诉柯文哲所涉的京华城案等案件。
description.en: The Taiwan Taipei District Prosecutors Office, a judicial body in Taiwan responsible for investigating and prosecuting cases involving Ko Wen-je, such as the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 老挝政治人物，现任老挝人民革命党中央委员会总书记、老挝国家主席。
description.en: A Laotian politician, currently serving as the General Secretary of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party Central Committee and the President of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 老挝政治人物，现任老挝人民革命党中央书记处常务书记、国家副主席。
description.en: A Laotian politician, currently serving as the Permanent Secretary of the Secretariat of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and Vice President of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 老挝政治人物，现任老挝国家副主席。
description.en: A Laotian politician, currently serving as the Vice President of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 老挝政治人物，现任老挝政府总理。
description.en: A Laotian politician, currently serving as the Prime Minister of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 老挝政治人物，现任老挝国会主席。
description.en: A Laotian politician, currently serving as the President of the National Assembly of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 老挝人民民主共和国的创建者和唯一执政党。
description.en: The founding and sole ruling party of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

description.zh-cn: 老挝人民民主共和国的立法机关。
description.en: The legislative branch of the government of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

description.zh-cn: 老挝历史上第一个统一国家，由法昂于1353年建立。1707年分裂为三个王国。
description.en: The first unified state in Laotian history, founded by Fa Ngum in 1353. It split into three kingdoms in 1707.

description.zh-cn: 孟苏瓦王子，于1353年统一老挝全境，建立了澜沧王国。
description.en: A prince of Muang Sua who unified the whole territory of Laos in 1353 and founded the kingdom of Lan Xang.

description.zh-cn: 泰国的前称，历史上曾多次与老挝各王国发生战争并长期拥有宗主权。
description.en: The former name of Thailand, which historically had numerous conflicts with and long-term suzerainty over the Laotian kingdoms.

description.zh-cn: 法暹战争后法国建立的保护国，是法属印度支那的一部分。
description.en: A French protectorate established after the Franco-Siamese War, part of French Indochina.

description.zh-cn: 老挝在获得独立后建立的君主立宪制国家，1975年被巴特寮推翻。
description.en: A constitutional monarchy established after Laos gained independence, overthrown by the Pathet Lao in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 老挝的共产主义政治运动和组织，在老挝内战后掌权，建立了老挝人民民主共和国。
description.en: A communist political movement and organization in Laos that came to power after the Laotian Civil War and established the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪统治缅甸的王朝，曾入侵并使澜沧王国成为其藩属。
description.en: A dynasty that ruled Burma in the 16th century, which invaded and made the Kingdom of Lan Xang its vassal state.

description.zh-cn: 暹罗历史上的一个王朝，曾将老挝三国纳为藩属。
description.en: A kingdom in the history of Siam that made the three Laotian kingdoms its vassals.

description.zh-cn: 澜沧王国分裂后形成的三个王国之一。
description.en: One of the three kingdoms formed after the division of the Lan Xang Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 澜沧王国分裂后形成的三个王国之一。
description.en: One of the three kingdoms formed after the division of the Lan Xang Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 万象王国末代国王，曾发动反抗暹罗统治的叛乱。
description.en: The last king of the Kingdom of Vientiane, who led a rebellion against Siamese rule.

description.zh-cn: 由万象国王昭阿努发动的反抗暹罗统治的叛乱。
description.en: A rebellion against Siamese rule led by King Anouvong of Vientiane.

description.zh-cn: 1893年法国与暹罗之间的战争，战后法国在湄公河东岸建立了老挝保护国。
description.en: A war in 1893 between France and Siam, which resulted in the establishment of the French Protectorate of Laos on the east bank of the Mekong.

description.zh-cn: 老挝人民民主共和国的主要创建者和首位实际最高领导人，曾任老挝人民革命党总书记和政府总理。
description.en: The main founder and first de facto supreme leader of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, who served as General Secretary of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 老挝自1986年开始推行的经济改革政策，旨在向市场经济转型。
description.en: An economic reform policy initiated by Laos in 1986, aimed at transitioning to a market economy.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共甘肃省直属机关工作委员会书记、中共甘肃省委政法委副书记、甘肃省人大常委会副主任及中共武威地委书记。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Secretary of the Working Committee of Organs Directly Under the Gansu Provincial Committee of the CPC, Deputy Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Gansu Provincial Committee of the CPC, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress, and Secretary of the Wuwei Prefectural Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 秦汉时期的基层官吏，负责地方治安。
description.en: A low-level official during the Qin and Han dynasties, responsible for local security.

description.zh-cn: 由萧何在秦律基础上制定的汉朝主要法律。
description.en: The primary law of the Han dynasty, formulated by Xiao He based on Qin law.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝东陵侯，后归附汉朝。曾劝谏萧何自污以避刘邦猜忌。
description.en: Marquis of Dongling during the Qin dynasty who later submitted to the Han. He once advised Xiao He to tarnish his own reputation to avoid Liu Bang's suspicion.

description.zh-cn: 秦汉时期的皇家园林。
description.en: A royal garden during the Qin and Han dynasties.

description.zh-cn: 1917年俄国革命的第一个阶段，导致沙皇尼古拉二世退位和俄罗斯帝国的灭亡。
description.en: The first stage of the Russian Revolution of 1917, which led to the abdication of Tsar Nicholas II and the end of the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 由世界八个主要工业化国家组成的国际组织，俄罗斯的成员资格自2014年起被暂停。
description.en: An international organization consisting of eight major industrialized countries in the world. Russia's membership has been suspended since 2014.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙内战中支持西班牙第二共和国的派系，由多样化的左翼团体组成，包括人民阵线、共产党和社会主义者，获得了苏联和墨西哥的援助。
description.en: The faction in the Spanish Civil War that supported the Second Spanish Republic, composed of diverse left-wing groups including the Popular Front, communists, and socialists. It received aid from the Soviet Union and Mexico.

description.zh-cn: 由共产国际组织，来自世界各国的志愿者组成的军事单位，为共和派作战。
description.en: Military units organized by the Comintern, made up of volunteers from various countries who fought for the Republican faction.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙内战后由弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥建立的独裁政权。
description.en: The authoritarian regime established by Francisco Franco after the Spanish Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国兀鹰军团对西班牙巴斯克地区城市格尔尼卡进行的一次地毯式轰炸，被认为是现代战争史上首次对不设防城市的大规模空袭。
description.en: An aerial bombing of the Basque town of Guernica during the Spanish Civil War carried out by Nazi Germany's Condor Legion. It is considered one of the first raids in modern military history on a defenseless civilian population.

description.zh-cn: 由纳粹德国空军和陆军人员组成的军事单位，被派往西班牙支持国民军。
description.en: A military unit composed of personnel from the German Air Force and Army, sent to support the Nationalists in Spain.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙右翼政治领袖和财政部长，他的遇刺事件成为西班牙内战爆发的导火线。
description.en: A Spanish right-wing political leader and finance minister whose assassination served as a catalyst for the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 由西班牙共产党、马克思主义统一工人党等左翼党派组成的选举联盟，在1936年选举中获胜，是共和派的核心力量。
description.en: An electoral coalition formed by left-wing parties including the Communist Party of Spain and the Workers' Party of Marxist Unification, which won the 1936 elections and was a core force of the Republican faction.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军第六十九基地
第二炮兵合同战术训练基地

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军下属的基地单位。
description.en: A base unit subordinate to the PLA Rocket Force.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军火箭军第六十一基地

description.en: A university located in Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, China. Wu Zhenglong graduated from its predecessor, Taiyuan Institute of Machinery, in 1984.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国机械工业部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经存在的一个部门。
description.en: A former ministry of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾在吴政隆担任中共太原市委书记时任副书记兼市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Deputy Secretary and Mayor when Wu Zhenglong was the Party Secretary of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾在吴政隆担任中共南京市委书记时任副书记兼市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, who served as Deputy Secretary and Mayor when Wu Zhenglong was the Party Secretary of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军参谋本部高官，曾担任成城学校校长。
description.en: A high-ranking officer of the Japanese Army General Staff who served as the principal of Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军参谋本部高官，曾担任成城学校校长。
description.en: A high-ranking officer of the Japanese Army General Staff who served as the principal of Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军参谋本部第二部部长，曾向清政府游说军事留学的重要性，并协助创办了东京振武学校。
description.en: Director of the Second Department of the Japanese Army General Staff, who lobbied the Qing government on the importance of military studies abroad and helped establish the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 这是一个日本组织。在清朝留学生与驻日公使馆发生冲突后，出面斡旋并协助成立了东京振武学校。此外，它还支持了唐才常组织自立会及其后续的起义活动。
description.en: This Japanese organization mediated conflicts between Qing dynasty students and the legation in Japan, assisting in the establishment of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō. Additionally, it supported Tang Caichang in organizing the Self-Support Society and its subsequent uprising activities.

description.zh-cn: 清朝驻日公使，因拒绝为钮瑷等自费留学生在担保书上盖章而引发激烈对抗。
description.en: The Qing dynasty's minister to Japan, who sparked intense confrontation by refusing to stamp the guarantee documents for self-funded students like Niu Ai.

description.zh-cn: 位于东京振武学校旧址的大学。
description.en: A university located at the former site of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代史学家、政治活动家，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A modern Chinese historian and political activist, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中国现代戏剧家，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A modern Chinese dramatist, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命元勋，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A veteran of the 1911 Revolution, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事人物，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A Chinese military figure, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命武昌起义领导人之一，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: One of the leaders of the Wuchang Uprising during the 1911 Revolution, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.
