description.en: A second-class general in the army of the Republic of China, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾任国务总理并代理大总统，同时也是东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Premier and Acting President. He was also an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 奉系军阀将领，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A general of the Fengtian clique of warlords, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国及满洲国军事、政治人物，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A military and political figure of the Republic of China and Manchukuo, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代作家、诗人、翻译家，东京振武学校校友。
description.en: A modern Chinese writer, poet, and translator, an alumnus of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的法定货币，由中国人民银行发行。
description.en: The legal tender of the People's Republic of China, issued by the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统哈里·杜鲁门提出的一项外交政策，旨在遏制苏联的扩张，其提出通常被视为冷战的开始。
description.en: An American foreign policy whose stated purpose was to contain Soviet geopolitical expansion, its pronouncement is often considered the start of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 美国在冷战期间的一项地缘政治战略，旨在阻止共产主义的扩张。
description.en: A geopolitical strategic foreign policy pursued by the United States during the Cold War to prevent the spread of communism.

description.zh-cn: 美国外交官，其“长电报”阐述了围堵政策，对冷战时期的美国外交政策产生了巨大影响。
description.en: An American diplomat whose "Long Telegram" articulated the policy of containment, which became a cornerstone of US Cold War strategy.

description.zh-cn: 美国在第二次世界大战后为援助西欧国家重建而实施的计划，旨在防止共产主义势力的扩张。
description.en: An American initiative passed in 1948 for foreign aid to Western Europe after World War II, aimed at preventing the spread of communism.

description.zh-cn: 苏联切断西方盟国通往西柏林陆路交通的事件，是冷战的第一次主要危机。
description.en: The Soviet Union blocked the Western Allies' railway, road, and canal access to the sectors of Berlin under Western control, one of the first major international crises of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 美国和苏联在太空探索领域的竞争，是冷战的一个重要方面。
description.en: A competition between the United States and the Soviet Union for supremacy in space exploration, a significant aspect of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 苏联发射的第一颗人造地球卫星，其成功发射标志着太空竞赛的开始。
description.en: The first artificial Earth satellite launched by the Soviet Union. Its successful launch marked the beginning of the Space Race.

description.zh-cn: 东德政府环绕西柏林建造的边防系统，是冷战和铁幕的象征。
description.en: A guarded concrete barrier that physically and ideologically divided Berlin from 1961 to 1989, a symbol of the Cold War and the Iron Curtain.

description.zh-cn: 团结工会是由莱赫·瓦文萨领导的波兰反共社会运动和工会组织。作为东欧国家第一个独立的工会，它对波兰共产政权的垮台起到了关键作用，尤其是在1989年议会选举中击败执政党，开启了东欧剧变的序幕。
description.en: Solidarity was an anti-communist social movement and trade union in Poland led by Lech Wałęsa. As the first independent trade union in an Eastern Bloc country, it played a central role in the downfall of the Polish communist regime, notably with its victory over the ruling Polish United Workers' Party in the 1989 parliamentary elections, which initiated the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫在苏联推行的政治和经济体制改革运动。
description.en: A political and economic reform movement in the Soviet Union initiated by Mikhail Gorbachev.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫在苏联推行的政策，主张增加政府的透明度和开放性。
description.en: A policy of increased openness and transparency in government institutions and activities in the Soviet Union, introduced by Mikhail Gorbachev.

description.zh-cn: 指在艺术、文化或政治领域中具有实验性、激进性或非传统性的作品或人物。
description.en: Refers to works or people that are experimental, radical, or unorthodox with respect to art, culture, or society.

description.zh-cn: 情境主义国际提出的一个关键概念，指对现有艺术和文化元素的挪用和再创造，以颠覆其原有意义。
description.en: A key concept of the Situationist International, referring to the reuse of preexisting artistic elements in a new ensemble to subvert their original meaning.

description.zh-cn: 居伊·德波的著作，情境主义国际的核心理论之一，认为商品社会正被“景观社会”取代。
description.en: A work by Guy Debord and one of the core theories of the Situationist International, which argues that commodity society is being replaced by the 'society of the spectacle'.

description.zh-cn: 法国哲学家，其思想受情境主义国际深刻影响，成为消费社会批判理论和后现代思潮的关键人物。
description.en: A French philosopher whose thought was profoundly influenced by the Situationist International, becoming a key figure in critical theory of consumer society and postmodernism.

description.en: A diplomat of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国一类特殊的自治州的俗称，此类自治州同时管辖县级行政区和地级行政区。
description.en: A colloquial term for a special type of autonomous prefecture in the People's Republic of China that administers both county-level and prefecture-level administrative regions.

description.zh-cn: 位于广西省的历史上的一个副省级自治州。
description.en: A historical sub-provincial autonomous prefecture in Guangxi province.

description.zh-cn: 历史上的一个地级行政区，曾由桂西僮族自治州管辖。
description.en: A historical prefecture-level administrative region, once under the jurisdiction of the Guixi Zhuang Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 历史上的一个地级行政区，曾由桂西僮族自治州管辖。
description.en: A historical prefecture-level administrative region, once under the jurisdiction of the Guixi Zhuang Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国新疆维吾尔自治区下辖的自治州，是现存唯一既辖地区、又辖县市的自治州，其行政级别为副省级建制但存在争议。
description.en: An autonomous prefecture in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region of the People's Republic of China. It is the only existing autonomous prefecture that administers both prefectures and county-level cities. Its administrative level is sub-provincial but is a subject of dispute.

zh-cn: 行政区 (中华人民共和国)

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国历史上的一种行政区划单位，也称行署区，级别曾相当于省。
description.en: A type of historical administrative division unit in the People's Republic of China, also known as an administrative region, which was equivalent to a province.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省曾经设立的一个副省级行政区，管辖范围为海南岛及南海诸岛。该行政区于1988年撤销，并改设为海南省。
description.en: A former sub-provincial administrative region of Guangdong Province, PRC, which governed Hainan Island and the South China Sea Islands. It was abolished in 1988 and reconstituted as Hainan Province.

description.zh-cn: 新疆省的行政管理机关，1955年随着新疆维吾尔自治区的成立而撤销。
description.en: The administrative body of Xinjiang Province, which was dissolved in 1955 with the establishment of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

zh-cn: 李光辉 (中国人民解放军开国少将)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，国民革命军第十九路军将领，蔡廷锴的同乡。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, a commander in the 19th Route Army, and from the same hometown as Cai Tingkai.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，国民革命军第十九路军总指挥，福建事变的主要领导人之一。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China, Commander-in-Chief of the 19th Route Army, and a key leader of the Fujian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军中将，一·二八事变时任淞沪警备司令。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the Republic of China Army, who served as the commander of the Shanghai-Wusong Garrison during the January 28 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中国清朝时期广东省下辖的一个州。
description.en: A prefecture under the jurisdiction of Guangdong Province during the Qing Dynasty in China.

description.zh-cn: 为纪念习仲勋诞辰100周年而制作的6集文献纪录片，于2013年10月在中国中央电视台播出。
description.en: A 6-episode documentary produced to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Xi Zhongxun's birth, broadcast on China Central Television in October 2013.

zh-cn: 中国中央电视台综合频道

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台旗下的综合频道，播出了文献纪录片《习仲勋》。
description.en: The general channel of China Central Television, which broadcast the documentary 'Xi Zhongxun'.

zh-cn: 中国中央电视台纪录频道

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台旗下的纪录片频道，播出了文献纪录片《习仲勋》。
description.en: The documentary channel of China Central Television, which broadcast the documentary 'Xi Zhongxun'.

description.zh-cn: 在纪录片《习仲勋》播出前于中央电视台综合频道黄金剧场播出的电视剧。
description.en: A TV series that aired in the prime time slot on CCTV-1 before the documentary 'Xi Zhongxun'.

description.zh-cn: 在纪录片《习仲勋》播出后于中央电视台综合频道黄金剧场播出的电视剧。
description.en: A TV series that aired in the prime time slot on CCTV-1 after the documentary 'Xi Zhongxun'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国纺织工业部副部长，中国丝绸公司副董事长。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Textile Industry of the People's Republic of China and Vice Chairman of the China Silk Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间黑龙江省的权力机构，于1979年12月撤销。
description.en: The governing body of Heilongjiang Province during the Cultural Revolution, abolished in December 1979.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期至文化大革命前黑龙江省的行政管理机关。
description.en: The administrative organ of Heilongjiang Province from the early days of the People's Republic of China until the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，杨易辰在黑龙江省政协主席职位上的继任者。
description.en: Chinese politician, successor to Yang Yichen as Chairman of the CPPCC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

zh-cn: 中国民主促进会吉林省委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国民主促进会在吉林省的地方组织，行政级别为正厅级。
description.en: The local organization of the China Association for Promoting Democracy in Jilin Province, with a director-general level administrative ranking.

description.zh-cn: 日本曾存在的一级行政区，是东京市的上级地方行政区，于1943年与东京市合并改制为东京都。
description.en: A former first-level administrative division of Japan and the superior local government of Tokyo City. It merged with Tokyo City in 1943 to form Tokyo Metropolis.

description.zh-cn: 东京是日本的一级行政区，也是日本唯一的“都”。它由原东京府与东京市于1943年7月1日合并改制而成。其政府机构负责管辖东京的行政事务。
description.en: Tokyo is a first-level administrative division of Japan and the country's only 'metropolis'. It was formed on July 1, 1943, by the merger of the former Tokyo Prefecture and Tokyo City. Its government is responsible for the administration of Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 日本于1888年实施的关于市级行政区划的法律。
description.en: A Japanese law concerning municipal administrative divisions enacted in 1888.

description.zh-cn: 日本东京都的特别区，其范围与1943年被废除前的东京市辖区范围相同。
description.en: The special wards of Tokyo Metropolis, Japan. Their area corresponds to the administrative area of the former Tokyo City before its abolition in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，曾任东京市长。在关东大地震后出任内务大臣，并主导东京的重建工作。
description.en: A Japanese politician who served as Mayor of Tokyo. After the Great Kantō earthquake, he became Minister of Home Affairs and led the reconstruction of Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 由后藤新平在关东大地震后设立，负责东京重建工作的机构。
description.en: An agency established by Gotō Shinpei after the Great Kantō earthquake to oversee the reconstruction of Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 原定于东京市举办的夏季奥林匹克运动会，后因中国抗日战争爆发而由日本方面放弃主办权。
description.en: The Summer Olympics originally scheduled to be held in Tokyo City, which Japan later relinquished the right to host due to the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 日本著名作家，出生于东京牛込区，曾在东京帝国大学担任英文学讲师。
description.en: A renowned Japanese novelist, born in Ushigome-ku, Tokyo, who once served as an English literature lecturer at Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 日本著名短篇小说家，毕业于东京帝国大学英文科。
description.en: A famous Japanese short story writer who graduated from the English Department of Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 日本的民营铁路公司，营运了东亚第一条地铁，后与东京高速铁道合并为帝都高速度交通营团。
description.en: A private Japanese railway company that operated the first subway in East Asia. It later merged with Tokyo Rapid Transit to form the Teito Rapid Transit Authority.

description.zh-cn: 营运东京市内地铁的机构，由东京地下铁道与东京高速铁道于1941年合并而成。
description.en: The authority that operated the subway system in Tokyo City, formed by the merger of Tokyo Underground Railway and Tokyo Rapid Transit in 1941.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治天皇在位期间（1868-1912）的政府，推行了一系列现代化改革。
description.en: The government of Japan during the reign of Emperor Meiji (1868-1912), which implemented a series of modernization reforms.

description.zh-cn: 东京的旧称，自17世纪初至19世纪后半期作为德川幕府的政治中心而繁荣。
description.en: The former name of Tokyo, which flourished as the political center of the Tokugawa shogunate from the early 17th century to the late 19th century.

description.zh-cn: 东京市曾经存在的一个区，作家夏目漱石出生于此。
description.en: A former ward of Tokyo City where the novelist Natsume Sōseki was born.

description.zh-cn: 中国戏剧学家、文学史家，南京大学人文社会科学荣誉资深教授，南京大学原副校长。
description.en: Chinese drama theorist, literary historian, honorary senior professor of humanities and social sciences at Nanjing University, and former vice president of Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 董健的出生地。
description.en: Birthplace of Dong Jian.

description.zh-cn: 董健于1957年转入该系学习。
description.en: Dong Jian transferred to this department to study in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 董健在南京大学攻读硕士研究生期间的导师。
description.en: Dong Jian's supervisor during his postgraduate studies at Nanjing University.

description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, currently serving as the Commander of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the first commander of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，曾任中国人民解放军中部战区陆军司令员。
description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the commander of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.en: A lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the political commissar of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.en: A major general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the deputy political commissar of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.en: A major general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the deputy political commissar of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任中国人民解放军中部战区陆军后勤部部长。
description.en: A major general in the People's Liberation Army, served as the director of the Logistics Department of the PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 约克公爵詹姆斯（后来的詹姆斯二世）的第一任妻子，玛丽二世和安妮女王的母亲。
description.en: The first wife of James, Duke of York (later James II), and the mother of Queen Mary II and Queen Anne.

description.zh-cn: 由英格兰议会通过的宪法性文件，确立了威廉三世和玛丽二世的共治地位，限制了王权，并规定了王位继承顺序。
description.en: A constitutional document passed by the Parliament of England that established the joint rule of William III and Mary II, limited the powers of the monarchy, and set out the line of succession to the throne.

zh-cn: 第一代马尔博罗公爵约翰·丘吉尔

description.zh-cn: 英国军事家和政治家。他在光荣革命中从詹姆斯二世倒戈支持威廉三世，但后来因涉嫌支持詹姆斯二世的复辟计划而被玛丽二世撤职并短暂监禁。
description.en: An English soldier and statesman. He defected from James II to support William III during the Glorious Revolution, but was later dismissed and briefly imprisoned by Mary II on suspicion of plotting to restore James II.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰王国的立法机构。在光荣革命后，它宣布威廉和玛丽为共治君主。
description.en: The legislature of the Kingdom of England. After the Glorious Revolution, it declared William and Mary joint sovereigns.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰王国的立法机构。它承认威廉和玛丽为苏格兰的共治君主。
description.en: The legislature of the Kingdom of Scotland. It recognized William and Mary as joint sovereigns of Scotland.

description.zh-cn: 支持被废黜的国王詹姆斯二世及其后代复辟英国王位的政治运动。
description.en: A political movement dedicated to the restoration of the deposed King James II and his descendants to the thrones of Great Britain.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦的皇家宫殿，是玛丽二世的出生地。
description.en: A royal palace in London, and the birthplace of Mary II.

description.zh-cn: 位于北美维吉尼亚州的一所大学，其皇家宪章由玛丽二世于1693年颁发。
description.en: A university in Virginia, North America, which received its royal charter from Queen Mary II in 1693.

description.zh-cn: 唐代官员，曾任广州都督。他很早就赏识张九龄的才华。
唐代宰相，与李林甫结党，共同排挤张九龄。
唐代著名诗人、画家，官至尚书右丞，世称“王右丞”。他曾受张九龄提拔。
唐代官员，曾受张九龄提拔为左补阙。
唐代监察御史，由张九龄举荐。后因触怒唐玄宗被杀，此事牵连了张九龄。
张九龄的弟弟，官至岭南五府节度使。
张九龄的弟弟，官至刺史、鸿胪卿。
张九龄的元配夫人，循州司马谭诲之女。
张九龄的长子，官至右赞善大夫。
唐代韶州下辖县，为张九龄的家乡及逝世地，位于今广东省韶关市曲江区。
唐代中央机构之一，掌管国家图书典籍。
一国派驻于另一国的外交人员，负责军事合作与联系。
description.en: A diplomat sent by one country to another to handle military cooperation and liaison.

description.zh-cn: 由意大利船厂制造的微型潜艇。
description.en: A class of midget submarines built by an Italian shipyard.

description.zh-cn: 美国建造的柴电潜舰。
description.en: A class of diesel-electric submarines built by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军上将，曾任国家安全局局长，并在江南案后代理情报局局长。
description.en: A General of the Republic of China Army, former Director of the National Security Bureau, who served as acting Director of the Military Intelligence Bureau after the Henry Liu case.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国加利福尼亚州惠提尔的私立文理学院。
description.en: A private liberal arts college in Whittier, California.

description.zh-cn: 美国和苏联之间签署的军备控制条约，旨在限制反弹道导弹系统的部署。
description.en: An arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union on the limitation of the anti-ballistic missile (ABM) systems used in defending areas against ballistic missile-delivered nuclear weapons.

description.zh-cn: 负责保护人类健康和环境的美国联邦政府机构。
description.en: An agency of the U.S. federal government whose mission is to protect human and environmental health.

description.zh-cn: 美国调查记者，与鲍勃·伍德沃德一起在《华盛顿邮报》揭露了水门事件。
description.en: An American investigative journalist who, with Bob Woodward, broke the Watergate scandal for The Washington Post.

description.zh-cn: 美国调查记者，与卡尔·伯恩斯坦一起在《华盛顿邮报》揭露了水门事件。
description.en: An American investigative journalist who, with Carl Bernstein, broke the Watergate scandal for The Washington Post.

description.zh-cn: 前联邦调查局副局长，是向《华盛顿邮报》泄露水门事件信息的线人“深喉”。
description.en: A former Federal Bureau of Investigation official who was the informant known as "Deep Throat" who provided information about the Watergate scandal to The Washington Post.

description.zh-cn: 中国安徽的前检察官，因在社交媒体上批评取消国家主席任期限制而被短暂拘留。
description.en: A former prosecutor from Anhui, China, who was briefly detained for criticizing the removal of presidential term limits on social media.

description.zh-cn: 中国的问答平台。在2018年修宪期间，其移动客户端被下架整改。
description.en: A Chinese question-and-answer platform. Its mobile application was removed from app stores for rectification during the 2018 constitutional amendment period.

nodes.id: BAIDU:蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司

zh-cn: 蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司
浙江蚂蚁小微金融服务集团股份有限公司

location.zh-cn: 中国浙江省杭州市西湖区

description.zh-cn: 中国的互联网金融服务公司，起步于淘宝网的第三方支付平台“支付宝”。2020年末，其首次公开募股计划被中国政府叫停，并受到一系列强力整顿。
description.en: A Chinese internet financial services company that originated from 'Alipay', the third-party payment platform of Taobao. In late 2020, its initial public offering (IPO) was halted by the Chinese government, and it has since undergone a series of intense rectifications.

description.zh-cn: 美国汇款服务公司，蚂蚁集团曾试图收购该公司但未获批准。
description.en: An American money transfer company that Ant Group attempted to acquire but was not approved.

description.zh-cn: 芬兰的自治区，为瑞典语人口而成立。
description.en: An autonomous region of Finland, established for its Swedish-speaking population.

description.zh-cn: 新朝末年拥立孺子婴为天子的平陵人。
description.en: A person from Pingling who supported Liu Ying as emperor during the late Xin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 更始帝时期的丞相，奉命进攻并杀害了孺子婴。
description.en: Chancellor under Emperor Gengshi, who was ordered to attack and kill Ruzi Ying.

description.zh-cn: 孺子婴的妻子，王莽的孙女。
description.en: Wife of Ruzi Ying and granddaughter of Wang Mang.

description.zh-cn: 广戚侯，孺子婴的父亲。
description.en: Marquis of Guangqi, father of Ruzi Ying.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军开国上将，原中国共产党中央顾问委员会委员、中央军事委员会顾问。曾任中国人民解放军副总参谋长。
description.en: A founding general of the People's Liberation Army (PLA) of China, former member of the Central Advisory Commission of the Communist Party of China, and advisor to the Central Military Commission. He served as the Deputy Chief of the General Staff of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 中国河北省衡水市下辖的一个县，是张阳的出生地。
description.en: A county under the administration of Hengshui, Hebei, China. It is the birthplace of Zhang Yang.

description.zh-cn: 德国共产党员，共产国际派往中国的军事顾问，在第五次反围剿战争和长征初期掌握军事指挥权，后在遵义会议上被剥夺指挥权。
description.en: A German Communist Party member and military advisor sent by the Comintern to China. He held military command during the Fifth Counter-Encirclement Campaign and the early Long March, and was stripped of command at the Zunyi Conference.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第三十军

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军的部队之一。
description.en: One of the units of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 美国海军陆战队历史最悠久、规模最大的现役师。
description.en: The oldest and largest active-duty division in the United States Marine Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中将，宋时轮的继任者，担任中国人民解放军军事科学院院长。
description.en: A lieutenant general of the People's Liberation Army, successor to Song Shilun as President of the PLA Academy of Military Science.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，在伍德罗·威尔逊的两个总统任期内担任副总统。
description.en: American politician who served as the Vice President of the United States during both of Woodrow Wilson's presidential terms.

description.zh-cn: 美国第29任总统，接替伍德罗·威尔逊。他曾释放并赦免了因反战活动被威尔逊政府判刑的尤金·V·德布斯。
description.en: The 29th President of the United States, succeeding Woodrow Wilson. He released and pardoned Eugene V. Debs, who had been imprisoned by the Wilson administration for anti-war activities.

description.zh-cn: 由伍德罗·威尔逊总统签署的法案，旨在建立美国的中央银行系统——联邦储备系统，以稳定金融体系。
description.en: An act signed into law by President Woodrow Wilson that created the Federal Reserve System, the central banking system of the United States, to provide financial stability.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦政府的一个独立机构，由威尔逊总统建立，旨在通过执行反托拉斯法来促进消费者保护和消除反竞争的商业行为。
description.en: An independent agency of the U.S. federal government, established by President Wilson, with the mission of promoting consumer protection and eliminating anti-competitive business practices through the enforcement of antitrust laws.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，高级记者。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China and a senior reporter.

zh-cn: 中国人民大学新闻学院

description.zh-cn: 金朝开国功臣，侵宋主将之一，率领西路军攻破汴京，俘虏徽、钦二帝。
description.en: A founding general of the Jin dynasty and one of the main commanders in the invasion of Song. He led the western route army to capture Bianjing and seize Emperors Huizong and Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 金朝皇子、将领，侵宋主将之一，率领东路军参与了靖康之变。
description.en: A Jin dynasty prince and general, one of the main commanders in the invasion of Song, who led the eastern route army during the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 位于今黑龙江省依兰县，是金代软禁宋徽宗、宋钦宗等人的地点，宋徽宗最终在此病逝。
description.en: Located in modern-day Yilan County, Heilongjiang Province, it was the place where Emperor Huizong, Emperor Qinzong, and others were held under house arrest by the Jin dynasty. Emperor Huizong eventually died here.

description.zh-cn: 由宋徽宗赵佶独创的一种书法字体，以其瘦硬挺拔、灵动快捷的风格著称。
description.en: A style of calligraphy created by Emperor Huizong (Zhao Ji), characterized by its slender, strong, and elegant strokes.

location.zh-cn: 中华民国台北市中正区重庆南路一段122号

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统决定国防、外交、两岸关系及国家重大变故等国家安全有关之大政方针之咨询机关，于1993年法制化，直属总统。
description.en: An advisory body to the President of the Republic of China for making major policies related to national security, including defense, foreign affairs, cross-strait relations, and major national crises. It was legally institutionalized in 1993 and reports directly to the President.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任国家安全会议副秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, currently serving as a Deputy Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任国家安全会议副秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, currently serving as a Deputy Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军法官，曾任动员戡乱时期国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A ROC military judge, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council during the Period of Mobilization.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，曾任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A General of the ROC Army, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国海军二级上将，曾任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: An Admiral of the ROC Navy, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军二级上将，曾任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A General of the ROC Army, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾代理国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, served as Acting Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾代理国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, served as Acting Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国外交官，曾任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A ROC diplomat, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任国家安全会议咨询委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician, currently serving as an advisory member of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治学者，现任国家安全会议咨询委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese political scientist, currently serving as an advisory member of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际执行委员会委员。1921年6月由张太雷陪同来华，筹备中共一大，并作为代表指导中国共产党的工作，提议国共合作。
description.en: A member of the Executive Committee of the Comintern. He came to China in June 1921, accompanied by Zhang Tailei, to prepare for the 1st National Congress of the CPC. As a representative, he guided the work of the Communist Party of China and proposed the KMT-CPC cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利警察局长和政治家，曾三度担任奥地利总理。他是国际刑事警察委员会（国际刑警组织前身）的主要发起人，并担任其首任主席。
description.en: An Austrian police administrator and politician who served as Chancellor of Austria three times. He was the primary initiator of the International Criminal Police Commission (predecessor to Interpol) and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国的高级官员，党卫军上级集团领袖及警察上将。他在1940年至1942年间担任国际刑警组织主席。
description.en: A high-ranking German Nazi official, SS-Obergruppenführer and General of Police. He served as the President of Interpol from 1940 to 1942.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国党卫军的高级官员，在1942年至1943年间担任国际刑警组织主席。
description.en: A high-ranking official in the SS of Nazi Germany who served as the President of Interpol from 1942 to 1943.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国党卫军的高级官员，在1943年至1945年间担任国际刑警组织主席。他是纽伦堡审判后被处决的最高级别党卫军军官。
description.en: A high-ranking SS official in Nazi Germany who served as the President of Interpol from 1943 to 1945. He was the highest-ranking SS officer to be executed after the Nuremberg trials.

description.zh-cn: 一份由联合国大会通过的历史性文件。国际刑警组织的章程规定其行动必须本着该宣言的精神。
description.en: A historic document adopted by the United Nations General Assembly. Interpol's constitution stipulates that its actions must be in the spirit of this declaration.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰政治活动家、民族主义者。2014年，应俄罗斯当局的要求，他被列入国际刑警组织的国际通缉名单。
description.en: A Ukrainian political activist and nationalist. In 2014, he was placed on Interpol's international wanted list at the request of Russian authorities.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯联合酋长国内政部监察长，自2021年起担任国际刑警组织主席。他的当选因其国家的人权记录和针对他的酷刑指控而备受争议。
description.en: Inspector General of the UAE's Ministry of Interior, serving as President of Interpol since 2021. His election was controversial due to his country's human rights record and torture allegations against him.

en: Mongol conquest of the Song dynasty

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国（后为元朝）对南宋的征服战争，历时四十余年，最终以元朝胜利告终。
description.en: The conquest of the Southern Song dynasty by the Mongol Empire (later the Yuan dynasty), which lasted for more than forty years and ended in a Yuan victory.

description.zh-cn: 元朝将领，西夏皇族后裔，在崖门海战中率军增援张弘范。
description.en: A general of the Yuan dynasty and a descendant of the Western Xia imperial family, who reinforced Zhang Hongfan's army during the Battle of Yamen.

description.zh-cn: 南宋末年将领，与陆秀夫、文天祥并称“宋末三杰”，在崖门海战中担任宋军总指挥，战败后突围，不久后溺死。
description.en: A general in the late Southern Song dynasty, known as one of the 'Three Heroes of the Late Song' along with Lu Xiufu and Wen Tianxiang. He served as the commander-in-chief of the Song forces at the Battle of Yamen, broke through the siege after the defeat, and drowned shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 宋度宗的妃子，宋端宗赵昰和宋少帝赵昺的生母。在听闻赵昺死讯后自杀。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Duzong of Song and the biological mother of Emperor Duanzong (Zhao Shi) and Emperor Shao (Zhao Bing). She committed suicide after hearing the news of Zhao Bing's death.

description.zh-cn: 南宋末年泉州提举市舶的阿拉伯裔商人，拒绝帮助南宋行朝，后投降元朝。
description.en: An Arab merchant who served as the Superintendent of Maritime Trade in Quanzhou during the late Southern Song dynasty. He refused to help the fleeing Song court and later surrendered to the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 南宋末年丞相、文学家，在崖门海战前已被元军俘虏，并在元军船上目睹了宋军的覆灭。
description.en: A chancellor and writer of the late Southern Song dynasty. He had been captured by the Yuan forces before the Battle of Yamen and witnessed the destruction of the Song fleet from a Yuan ship.

description.zh-cn: 宋元战争中的关键战役，元军攻克襄阳和樊城后，得以长驱直入，为灭亡南宋奠定了基础。
description.en: A crucial battle in the Song-Yuan Wars. After the Yuan army captured Xiangyang and Fancheng, they were able to advance deep into Southern Song territory, laying the foundation for its eventual demise.

description.zh-cn: 南宋团练使，在崖门海战中投降元军。
description.en: A Southern Song militia commander (Tuanlianshi) who surrendered to the Yuan forces during the Battle of Yamen.

description.zh-cn: 崖门海战的发生地。
description.en: The location of the Battle of Yamen.

description.zh-cn: 中国禅宗三祖，慧可的弟子。
description.en: The third patriarch of Zen in China, a disciple of Huike.

description.zh-cn: 中国禅宗四祖，僧璨的弟子。他开始以佛寺为中心传法，使禅宗大振。
description.en: The fourth patriarch of Zen in China, a disciple of Sengcan. He began to teach Zen centered around monasteries, which greatly popularized the school.

description.zh-cn: 中国禅宗五祖，道信的弟子，东山法门的开创者。
description.en: The fifth patriarch of Zen in China, a disciple of Daoxin, and the founder of the East Mountain Teaching.

description.zh-cn: 中国禅宗六祖，弘忍的弟子。他主张“顿悟”，被尊为南宗的始祖。其思想记录在《六祖坛经》中。
description.en: The sixth patriarch of Zen in China, a disciple of Hongren. He advocated for 'sudden enlightenment' and is revered as the founder of the Southern School. His teachings are recorded in the Platform Sutra.

description.zh-cn: 牛头宗的创始人。传统上认为他是禅宗四祖道信的弟子，但此说法存疑。
description.en: Founder of the Niutou school. Traditionally considered a disciple of the fourth Zen patriarch Daoxin, but this claim is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 由牛头法融开创的禅宗分支，重视中观之学，在中国南方独立发展，后与禅宗主流融合。
description.en: A branch of Zen founded by Niutou Farong, which emphasized Madhyamaka philosophy. It developed independently in southern China before merging with the Zen mainstream.

description.zh-cn: 惠能的弟子，在洛阳的明定南北总是非大会上辩倒北宗，确立了南宗的正统地位。
description.en: A disciple of Huineng who defeated the Northern School in a debate at the Great Dharma Assembly in Luoyang, establishing the orthodoxy of the Southern School.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教般若部重要经典。自禅宗五祖弘忍起，此经成为禅宗传法的核心。
description.en: An important Mahāyāna Buddhist sūtra from the Prajñāpāramitā literature. From the fifth Zen patriarch Hongren onwards, this sutra became central to the transmission of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 禅宗五家之一，由临济义玄创立。以机锋峻烈、棒喝齐施的宗风著称。
description.en: One of the Five Houses of Zen, founded by Linji Yixuan. It is known for its harsh and abrupt teaching methods, including shouts and blows.

description.zh-cn: 禅宗五家之一，由洞山良价及其弟子曹山本寂创立。以“默照禅”为主要修行方法。少林寺现属曹洞宗。
description.en: One of the Five Houses of Zen, founded by Dongshan Liangjie and his disciple Caoshan Benji. Its primary practice method is 'silent illumination meditation'. The Shaolin Temple currently belongs to the Caodong School.

description.zh-cn: 南宋临济宗杨岐派僧人，大力提倡“话头禅”，并批评曹洞宗的“默照禅”。
description.en: A monk of the Yangqi branch of the Linji school during the Southern Song Dynasty. He strongly advocated for 'kōan-introspecting Zen' (huatou chan) and criticized the Caodong school's 'silent illumination Zen'.

description.zh-cn: 南宋曹洞宗僧人，提倡以静坐为主的“默照禅”。
description.en: A monk of the Caodong school during the Southern Song Dynasty who advocated for 'silent illumination Zen' (mozhao chan), which emphasizes seated meditation.

description.zh-cn: 由大慧宗杲提倡的禅修方法，要求修行者参究一个“话头”（如“无”字公案），以产生疑情并最终破疑开悟。
description.en: A method of Zen meditation advocated by Dahui Zonggao, which requires practitioners to investigate a 'huatou' (the critical phrase of a kōan, such as the 'mu' kōan) to generate great doubt and ultimately achieve enlightenment by breaking through it.

description.zh-cn: 由宏智正觉提倡的曹洞宗禅修方法，强调静坐中保持内心的静默与觉照。
description.en: A method of Caodong Zen meditation advocated by Hongzhi Zhengjue, emphasizing the maintenance of inner silence and clear awareness during seated meditation.

description.zh-cn: 8世纪后期在西藏举行的一场关于成佛之道的辩论，辩论双方为代表汉传禅宗顿悟法门的摩诃衍和代表印度中观学派渐修法门的莲花戒。最终摩诃衍被判为败方并被驱逐出藏。
description.en: A debate on the path to Buddhahood held in Tibet in the late 8th century. The two main participants were Moheyan, representing the Chinese Zen teaching of sudden enlightenment, and Kamalaśīla, representing the Indian Madhyamaka school's teaching of gradual cultivation. Moheyan was ultimately declared the loser and expelled from Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝禅师，北宗神秀门下普寂的传人。曾到西藏传扬禅宗顿悟法门，后在“顿渐之争”中被判为败方。
description.en: A Tang dynasty Chan master, a successor in the lineage of Puji of Shenxiu's Northern School. He traveled to Tibet to spread the Zen teaching of sudden enlightenment but was defeated in the 'Samye Debate'.

description.zh-cn: 印度佛教僧人，中观学派学者。在西藏的“顿渐之争”中，他代表渐修法门，最终战胜了代表顿悟法门的摩诃衍。
description.en: An Indian Buddhist monk and scholar of the Madhyamaka school. In the 'Samye Debate' in Tibet, he represented the gradual path to enlightenment and ultimately defeated Moheyan, who represented the sudden enlightenment approach.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃赞普，主持了“顿渐之争”辩论会，并在会后下令禁止修习顿门法。
description.en: An emperor of the Tibetan Empire who presided over the 'Samye Debate' and subsequently decreed that the practice of the 'sudden' path was to be discontinued.

description.zh-cn: 近代禅宗中兴之祖，以一身兼承禅宗五家法脉，对近代中国佛教的复兴有巨大贡献。
description.en: A modern patriarch credited with the revival of Zen. He held lineages from all five houses of Zen and made significant contributions to the revitalization of Chinese Buddhism in the modern era.

description.zh-cn: 日本佛教学者，20世纪初向西方传播禅宗思想，对禅宗在欧美的普及有重要影响。
description.en: A Japanese Buddhist scholar who introduced Zen thought to the West in the early 20th century, playing a crucial role in its popularization in Europe and America.

description.zh-cn: 唐代禅宗高僧，临济宗的创始人。
description.en: A prominent Chan master of the Tang dynasty and the founder of the Linji school.

description.zh-cn: 唐代禅宗高僧，曹洞宗的创始人之一。
description.en: A prominent Chan master of the Tang dynasty and one of the founders of the Caodong school.

description.zh-cn: 万历三大征之一，平定播州土司杨应龙叛乱的战争。
description.en: One of the Three Great Campaigns of the Wanli Era, a war to suppress the rebellion of the Bozhou tusi Yang Yinglong.

description.zh-cn: 万历三大征之一，平定宁夏地区哱拜叛乱的战争。
description.en: One of the Three Great Campaigns of the Wanli Era, a war to suppress the rebellion of Bobai in the Ningxia region.

en: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

description.zh-cn: 隶属于中国科学院的公立大学。
description.en: A public university affiliated with the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理学家，接替丁仲礼担任中国科学院大学校长。
description.en: Chinese physicist who succeeded Ding Zhongli as President of the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国地质学家，被誉为“黄土之父”。
description.en: Chinese geologist, known as the 'Father of Loess'.

en: Institute of Geology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
Institute of Geology and Geophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
zh-cn: 中国科学院地质与地球物理研究所
中国科学院地质研究所

description.zh-cn: 中国化学家，中国科学院院士。
description.en: Chinese chemist, academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国吉林省白山市下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Baishan City, Jilin Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间中华人民共和国吉林省的政权机关。
description.en: The organ of power in Jilin Province, People's Republic of China, during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 由宇文化及、司马德戡等人利用骁果军思乡情绪发动的军事政变，导致隋炀帝被杀，隋朝在江南的统治崩溃。
description.en: A military coup initiated by Yuwen Huaji, Sima Dekan, and others, exploiting the homesickness of the Xiaoguo Army. It resulted in the assassination of Emperor Yang of Sui and the collapse of Sui's rule in the Jiangnan region.

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝之侄，在江都兵变后被宇文化及拥立为傀儡皇帝，后被宇文化及毒杀。
description.en: Nephew of Emperor Yang of Sui. He was installed as a puppet emperor by Yuwen Huaji after the Jiangdu coup and was later poisoned by him.

description.zh-cn: 北周及隋朝的重要官员，宇文化及之父。他曾帮助杨广夺取皇太子之位。
description.en: An important official of the Northern Zhou and Sui dynasties, and the father of Yuwen Huaji. He helped Yang Guang to secure the position of crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及之弟，积极参与策划江都兵变，后与宇文化及一同被窦建德处死。
description.en: Younger brother of Yuwen Huaji. He actively participated in planning the Jiangdu coup and was later executed along with Yuwen Huaji by Dou Jiande.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及的异母弟，隋炀帝的女婿。在宇文化及败亡前夕离开，后投降唐朝。
description.en: Half-brother of Yuwen Huaji and son-in-law of Emperor Yang of Sui. He left before Yuwen Huaji's downfall and later surrendered to the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 隋朝虎贲郎将，江都兵变的主要策划者之一。后因图谋反叛宇文化及而被处死。
description.en: A general of the Sui dynasty and one of the main planners of the Jiangdu coup. He was later executed for plotting a rebellion against Yuwen Huaji.

description.zh-cn: 隋末瓦岗军首领，曾与洛阳的隋朝政权联合抵抗宇文化及，并将其击败。
description.en: Leader of the Wagang Army at the end of the Sui dynasty. He allied with the Sui court in Luoyang to resist Yuwen Huaji and defeated him.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宗室将领，奉命讨伐宇文化及，并将其围困于聊城。
description.en: A general from the imperial clan of the Tang dynasty. He was ordered to campaign against Yuwen Huaji and besieged him in Liaocheng.

description.zh-cn: 隋末齐郡叛军首领。他假意协助宇文化及守城，后打开城门放窦建德军队入城。
description.en: Leader of a rebel army in Qi Commandery during the late Sui dynasty. He pretended to assist Yuwen Huaji in defending the city but later opened the gates to let Dou Jiande's army in.

description.zh-cn: 隋末吴兴太守，以讨伐宇文化及为名起兵，是江东地区的割据势力之一。
description.en: Governor of Wuxing Commandery in the late Sui dynasty. He raised an army in the name of punishing Yuwen Huaji and became a warlord in the Jiangdong region.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及在毒杀杨浩后建立的短暂政权。
description.en: A short-lived state established by Yuwen Huaji after he poisoned Yang Hao.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及建立许国后使用的年号。
description.en: The era name used by Yuwen Huaji after he established the state of Xu.

description.zh-cn: 隋炀帝之女，宇文士及之妻。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Yang of Sui and wife of Yuwen Shiji.

description.zh-cn: 第一次鸦片战争期间，清朝钦差大臣琦善与英国代表义律私拟的和约草案，内容包括割让香港、赔款等，但未被双方政府承认。
description.en: During the First Opium War, a draft peace agreement privately negotiated by Qing Imperial Commissioner Qishan and British representative Charles Elliot, which included terms like the cession of Hong Kong and indemnities, but was not recognized by either government.

description.zh-cn: 紫禁城内的一座宫殿，是道光帝的出生地。
description.en: A palace within the Forbidden City, the birthplace of the Daoguang Emperor.

en: Princess Shushen of the First Rank

description.zh-cn: 废太子允礽第六女，由雍正帝抚养，为孝敬宪皇后养女之一。
description.en: The sixth daughter of the deposed Crown Prince Yunreng, raised by the Yongzheng Emperor and one of the adopted daughters of Empress Xiaojingxian.

en: Princess Duanrou of the First Rank

description.zh-cn: 庄亲王允禄长女，由雍正帝抚养，为孝敬宪皇后养女之一。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Prince Zhuang, Yunlu, raised by the Yongzheng Emperor and one of the adopted daughters of Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋的妃子，齐王朱榑和潭王朱梓的生母。根据《革除遗事》记载，她也是明成祖的生母。
description.en: A concubine of Zhu Yuanzhang, mother of Zhu Fu (Prince of Qi) and Zhu Zi (Prince of Tan). According to 'Gechu Yishi', she was also the biological mother of Emperor Chengzu.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖朱棣为报答父母之恩所建的寺庙。民间传闻该寺正殿供奉的是其生母䂵妃。
description.en: A temple built by Emperor Chengzu (Zhu Di) in gratitude to his parents. Popular legend claims that the main hall was dedicated to his biological mother, Consort Gong.

description.zh-cn: 高丽王朝使臣。其出使记录中提及燕王朱棣在七月十五日为“先太后”守忌，与马皇后忌日不符，引发了对朱棣生母的猜测。
description.en: An envoy from the Goryeo Dynasty. His records mention that Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, observed the death anniversary of the 'late empress dowager' on the 15th day of the 7th month, which does not match Empress Ma's death anniversary, fueling speculation about Zhu Di's biological mother.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代学者，对傅斯年关于明成祖生母的“胡人输血论”观点表示不满。
description.en: A modern Chinese scholar who expressed dissatisfaction with Fu Sinian's 'Hu-ren blood transfusion theory' regarding the mother of Emperor Chengzu.

description.zh-cn: 政治术语，指反对进步、历史潮流或革命的力量或派别。
description.en: A political term referring to forces or factions that oppose progress, historical trends, or revolution.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，大日本帝国宪法的主要起草人之一。
description.en: Japanese politician, one of the main drafters of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，大日本帝国宪法的主要起草人之一。
description.en: Japanese politician, one of the main drafters of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，大日本帝国宪法的主要起草人之一。
description.en: Japanese politician, one of the main drafters of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国宪法下的天皇最高咨询机关，对宪法草案进行了最终审议。
description.en: The supreme advisory body to the Emperor under the Constitution of the Empire of Japan, which conducted the final deliberations on the draft constitution.

description.zh-cn: 俄国皇太子尼古拉在日本大津市遇刺事件。该案的处理结果显示了日本作为立宪国家，确立了法治主义与司法权的独立。
description.en: An assassination attempt on Tsarevich Nicholas of Russia in Ōtsu, Japan. The handling of this case demonstrated Japan's status as a constitutional state and established the principles of rule of law and judicial independence.

description.zh-cn: 大津事件时任大审院长，他顶住政府压力，坚持要求法官依法审判，维护了司法独立。
description.en: President of the Supreme Court of Judicature during the Ōtsu Incident. He resisted government pressure and insisted that judges rule according to the law, thereby upholding judicial independence.

description.zh-cn: 日本宪法学家，“天皇机关说”的主导学者，因天皇机关说事件而被迫辞去贵族院议员职务。
description.en: A Japanese constitutional scholar and leading proponent of the 'Emperor Organ Theory', who was forced to resign from the House of Peers due to the Emperor Organ Theory Incident.

description.zh-cn: 一种宪法学说，认为国家是法人，天皇是国家的最高机关，在宪法框架下行使统治权。该学说曾是宪法学通说，后在1935年被否定。
description.en: A constitutional theory viewing the state as a legal person and the Emperor as its highest organ, exercising sovereignty within the framework of the constitution. It was once the orthodox interpretation but was repudiated in 1935.

description.zh-cn: 日本评论家，对民众未审视《大日本帝国宪法》实质就欢呼其名称的现象表示叹息。
description.en: A Japanese critic who lamented the public's celebration of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan by name without examining its substance.

description.zh-cn: 柏林大学学者，曾向赴欧洲考察的伊藤博文提供关于宪法制定的建议。
description.en: A scholar at the University of Berlin who provided advice on constitution-making to Itō Hirobumi during his European tour.

description.zh-cn: 维也纳大学学者，曾向赴欧洲考察的伊藤博文提供关于宪法制定的建议。
description.en: A scholar at the University of Vienna who provided advice on constitution-making to Itō Hirobumi during his European tour.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间提出的口号和政策，要求学生返回学校继续进行革命，客观上结束了全国大串连。
description.en: A slogan and policy proposed during the Cultural Revolution, requiring students to return to school to continue the revolution, which objectively ended the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国歌唱家，金铁霖的学生及前妻。
description.en: Chinese singer, a student and former wife of Jin Tielin.

description.zh-cn: 金铁霖的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Jin Tielin.

description.zh-cn: 金铁霖与马秋华的儿子。
description.en: Son of Jin Tielin and Ma Qiuhua.

description.zh-cn: 男高音歌唱家、声乐教育家，金铁霖在中央音乐学院的老师。
description.en: A tenor singer and vocal educator, who was Jin Tielin's teacher at the Central Conservatory of Music.

description.zh-cn: 中国音乐家，曾邀请金铁霖到中国音乐学院任教。
description.en: Chinese musician who invited Jin Tielin to teach at the China Conservatory of Music.

zh-cn: 北京市文学艺术界联合会
en: Beijing Federation of Literary and Art Circles

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教信仰的独一且无与伦比的造物主。
description.en: The one and incomparable Creator believed in by Islam.

description.zh-cn: 倭马亚王朝的创建者和第一任哈里发。
description.en: The founder and first caliph of the Umayyad Caliphate.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教早期出现的教派，因反对阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜的统治而分裂出来。
description.en: An early Islamic sect that emerged by splitting from the rule of Ali ibn Abi Talib.

description.zh-cn: 分布于柬埔寨和越南的一个民族，其中许多人信奉伊斯兰教。
description.en: An ethnic group distributed in Cambodia and Vietnam, many of whom practice Islam.

description.zh-cn: 对伊斯兰教或穆斯林的恐惧、憎恨或偏见，是一种社会现象。
description.en: Fear, hatred of, or prejudice against the religion of Islam or Muslims in general, a social phenomenon.

description.zh-cn: 一个致力于促进穆斯林国家之间全面合作的国际组织。
description.en: An international organization dedicated to promoting comprehensive cooperation among Muslim countries.

description.zh-cn: 一位早期的基督教神学家，曾撰文从神学角度批判伊斯兰教。
description.en: An early Christian theologian who wrote theological critiques of Islam.

zh-cn: 部委归口管理的国家局

description.zh-cn: 一种中华人民共和国国家级行政机构的类型，由国务院的特定部委进行业务指导和管理。国家外汇管理局属于此类机构。
description.en: A type of national administrative agency in the People's Republic of China that is under the professional guidance and administration of a specific ministry or commission of the State Council. The State Administration of Foreign Exchange is this type of agency.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，国家外汇管理局首任局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, the first Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾两次担任国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as the Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange on two separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任国家外汇管理局副局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任国家外汇管理局副局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Deputy Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局的直属企业单位。
description.en: A directly affiliated enterprise of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

zh-cn: 尤莉娅·弗拉基米罗芙娜·季莫申科

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰政治人物，曾任乌克兰总理。在尊严革命后从监狱获释。
description.en: A Ukrainian politician who served as Prime Minister of Ukraine. She was released from prison after the Revolution of Dignity.

zh-cn: 乌克兰—欧洲联盟联合协议
乌克兰－欧洲联盟联合协议

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰与欧盟之间旨在深化政治和经济关系的协议。亚努科维奇政府暂停签署此协议是广场起义的直接导火索。
description.en: An agreement between Ukraine and the European Union aimed at deepening political and economic relations. The Yanukovych government's suspension of the signing of this agreement was the direct trigger for the Euromaidan protests.

description.zh-cn: 2014年1月16日由乌克兰最高拉达通过的一系列旨在限制抗议活动的法律，此举进一步激化了社会矛盾。
description.en: A series of laws passed by the Verkhovna Rada on January 16, 2014, aimed at restricting protests, which further exacerbated social conflicts.

description.zh-cn: 尊严革命后，在乌克兰南部和东部地区爆发的一系列由亲俄分裂分子发起的示威和骚乱。
description.en: A series of demonstrations and riots initiated by pro-Russian separatists in the southern and eastern regions of Ukraine following the Revolution of Dignity.

description.zh-cn: 在尊严革命后举行的乌克兰总统选举，彼得·波罗申科在第一轮投票中即获胜。
description.en: The presidential election held in Ukraine after the Revolution of Dignity, which Petro Poroshenko won in the first round.

description.en: A radical group operating in Syria, initially formed by the 'Islamic State of Iraq' in 2011. It later broke away after disagreeing with the merger into the 'Islamic State of Iraq and al-Sham'.

description.en: An independent agency of the U.S. federal government that supports research in science and engineering. Johns Hopkins University has received substantial research funding from it for many consecutive years.

description.en: The medical school of Johns Hopkins University, it was the first medical school in the U.S. to offer graduate education and has profoundly influenced subsequent medical education institutions.

zh-cn: 布隆伯格公共卫生学院

description.en: The school of public health at Johns Hopkins University, founded in 1916 as the first school of public health in the U.S. It was renamed in 2001 to honor its major benefactor, Michael Bloomberg.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学医学院和公共卫生学院的首任院长，并出任协和医学院的创始院长。

description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Chairman of the Anhui Provincial Political Consultative Conference and Deputy Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the CCP. As the head of the Fifth Central Inspection Team, he played a key role in the investigation of Wu Changshun, the former police chief of Tianjin.

description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Director of the Tianjin Municipal Public Security Bureau. He was investigated and prosecuted for corruption. It is reported that when he was Song Pingshun's subordinate, the two cooperated tacitly to share rent-seeking opportunities.

description.zh-cn: 指慈安、慈禧两位太后在同治、光绪年间垂帘听政的政治格局，是辛酉政变的直接政治后果。
description.en: Refers to the political structure where the two Empress Dowagers, Ci'an and Cixi, ruled from behind the curtain during the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns. It was a direct political consequence of the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 时任山东道监察御史，于1861年9月14日上奏，请求两宫皇太后垂帘听政，引发了与顾命八大臣的激烈辩论。
description.en: Serving as the Supervising Censor of the Shandong Circuit at the time, he submitted a memorial on September 14, 1861, requesting the two empress dowagers to rule from behind the curtain, which sparked a fierce debate with the Eight Regents.

description.zh-cn: 由顾命八大臣为同治帝拟定的年号，在辛酉政变后被废除。
description.en: The reign title proposed by the Eight Regents for the Tongzhi Emperor, which was abolished after the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 辛酉政变后为同治帝确立的新年号，取代了“祺祥”。
description.en: The new reign title established for the Tongzhi Emperor after the Xinyou Coup, replacing 'Qixiang'.

description.en: Refers to a period of relative social stability and economic development during the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns of the Qing dynasty. The Xinyou Coup is considered the beginning of this era.

description.en: The wife of Shinzo Abe. She is known for publicly disagreeing with her husband on some political issues and was involved in controversies such as the Moritomo Gakuen scandal.
