description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三第二次执政期间推行的经济政策，以“三支箭”（大胆的货币政策、灵活的财政政策、促进民间投资的增长战略）为核心，旨在摆脱日本长期的通货紧缩和经济停滞。
description.en: The economic policies advocated by Shinzo Abe during his second term as Prime Minister, centered on the 'three arrows' of bold monetary policy, flexible fiscal policy, and a growth strategy to encourage private investment, aimed at pulling Japan out of long-term deflation and economic stagnation.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三提出的外交战略，强调与共享自由、民主、法治等普世价值的国家加强合作。
description.en: A diplomatic strategy proposed by Shinzo Abe that emphasizes strengthening cooperation with countries that share universal values such as freedom, democracy, and the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 日本与美国之间的军事与安全合作关系，是日本外交的基石。安倍晋三在其任内致力于强化这一同盟关系。
description.en: The military and security cooperation relationship between Japan and the United States, which is the cornerstone of Japanese diplomacy. Shinzo Abe was committed to strengthening this alliance during his tenure.

description.zh-cn: 刺杀日本前首相安倍晋三的嫌犯。他表示，其行凶动机是因其母亲向统一教大量捐款导致家庭破产，而他认为安倍晋三与该教会有所关联。
description.en: The suspect in the assassination of former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe. He stated that his motive was related to the Unification Church, which he blamed for his family's bankruptcy due to his mother's large donations, and he believed Abe had ties to the church.

description.zh-cn: 一个源于韩国的新兴宗教。刺杀安倍晋三的嫌犯山上彻也称，因该教会与其家庭的财务纠纷以及他认为安倍与该教会有联系，而产生恨意并实施犯罪。
description.en: A new religious movement originating from South Korea. The suspect in Shinzo Abe's assassination, Tetsuya Yamagami, cited a grudge against the church over his family's financial troubles and Abe's perceived links to it as his motive for the crime.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本东京都的一所私立大学，安倍晋三于1977年毕业于该校法学部政治学系。
description.en: A private university located in Tokyo, Japan. Shinzo Abe graduated from its Faculty of Law, Department of Political Science, in 1977.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军将领，曾任红十二军参谋长。
description.en: A general of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, served as Chief of Staff of the Twelfth Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1935年7月由红一军团改编而成的部队番号。
description.en: The designation of the unit reorganized from the Red First Army Group in July 1935.

description.zh-cn: 清高宗乾隆帝的陵墓，位于清东陵。
description.en: The mausoleum of the Qianlong Emperor, located in the Eastern Qing Tombs.

description.zh-cn: 以渤海郡为郡望的著名士族。
description.en: A prominent aristocratic clan with their ancestral home in Bohai Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宗室，曾任朔方节度大使，率军征讨契丹。高适早年曾投奔其幕府。
description.en: A member of the Tang imperial clan who served as the military commissioner of Shuofang and led campaigns against the Khitans. Gao Shi joined his staff in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝边塞诗人，与高适、王之涣、岑参合称“边塞四诗人”。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty frontier poet, known along with Gao Shi, Wang Zhihuan, and Cen Shen as one of the 'Four Frontier Poets'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝边塞诗人，与高适、王昌龄、岑参合称“边塞四诗人”。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty frontier poet, known along with Gao Shi, Wang Changling, and Cen Shen as one of the 'Four Frontier Poets'.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，时任睢阳太守，举荐高适有道科。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty official who, as the Prefect of Suiyang, recommended Gao Shi for the 'Youdao' examination.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝将领，时任淮南西道节度使，与高适、韦陟会盟讨伐李璘。
description.en: A general of the Tang Dynasty, then serving as the military governor of Huainanxi Circuit, who allied with Gao Shi and Wei Zhi to crusade against Li Lin.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，时任江东节度使，与高适、来瑱会盟讨伐李璘。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty official, then serving as the military governor of Jiangdong Circuit, who allied with Gao Shi and Lai Tian to crusade against Li Lin.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝将领，曾任西川节度使，高适曾跟随其平定段子璋叛乱。
description.en: A general of the Tang Dynasty who served as the military governor of Xichuan. Gao Shi once followed him to suppress the rebellion of Duan Zizhang.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝梓州刺史，后发动叛乱，被崔光远、高适等人平定。
description.en: The prefect of Zizhou during the Tang Dynasty who later launched a rebellion and was suppressed by forces including Cui Guangyuan and Gao Shi.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝边塞诗人，与高适并称“高岑”，亦是“边塞四诗人”之一。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty frontier poet, known together with Gao Shi as 'Gao-Cen', and also one of the 'Four Frontier Poets'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代著名琴师，高适曾为其作《别董大》一诗。
description.en: A famous zither player of the Tang Dynasty, for whom Gao Shi wrote the poem 'A Farewell to Dong Da'.

description.zh-cn: 一种研究生学位。
description.en: A postgraduate academic degree.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官，接替李小林担任中国人民对外友好协会会长。
description.en: Chinese diplomat who succeeded Li Xiaolin as the President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries.

zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国宪法大纲

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国的根本法，规定了其国家性质、政体和公民基本权利与义务。
description.en: The fundamental law of the Chinese Soviet Republic, which stipulated its state nature, political system, and the basic rights and obligations of its citizens.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党为建立抗日民族统一战线向全国发表的宣言，其中宣告“取消现在的苏维埃政府”，标志着中华苏维埃共和国的正式终结。
description.en: A declaration issued by the Communist Party of China to the nation to establish a united anti-Japanese front, which announced the 'abolition of the current Soviet government,' marking the official end of the Chinese Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国中央执行委员会的行政机关，负责处理日常政务。
description.en: The administrative body of the Central Executive Committee of the Chinese Soviet Republic, responsible for handling daily government affairs.

zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国西北联邦
en: Northwestern Federation of the Chinese Soviet Republic

description.zh-cn: 由张国焘在长征途中另立的政权，象征着当时中共的内部分裂。
description.en: A regime established separately by Zhang Guotao during the Long March, symbolizing the internal split within the CPC at the time.

description.zh-cn: 罗马教宗。在位期间是教廷权力的顶峰，他于1215年官方认可巴黎大学，并曾孤立神圣罗马皇帝奥托四世。
description.en: Pope of the Catholic Church. His pontificate represented the peak of papal power, during which he officially recognized the University of Paris in 1215 and isolated the Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎大学的第一个学院机构，由罗贝尔·德·索邦创立。
description.en: The first college of the University of Paris, founded by Robert de Sorbon.

description.zh-cn: 法国神学家，路易九世的神父，索邦学院的创始人。
description.en: French theologian, chaplain to King Louis IX, and founder of the Collège de Sorbonne.

description.zh-cn: 由拿破仑一世设立，掌管全法国教育的机构。
description.en: An institution established by Napoleon I to oversee all education in France.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的大学之一，是原巴黎大学文学院的主要继承者，于2018年与巴黎第六大学合并为索邦大学。
description.en: One of the universities established after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris, the main successor to its Faculty of Humanities. It merged with Paris VI University in 2018 to form Sorbonne University.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的大学之一，是原巴黎大学理学院的主要继承者，于2018年与巴黎第四大学合并为索邦大学。
description.en: One of the universities established after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris, the main successor to its Faculty of Science. It merged with Paris IV University in 2018 to form Sorbonne University.

description.zh-cn: 由巴黎第四大学和巴黎第六大学于2018年合并而成，继承了“索邦”的名号。
description.en: Formed in 2018 by the merger of Paris-Sorbonne University and Pierre and Marie Curie University, inheriting the 'Sorbonne' name.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的大学之一，于2019年与巴黎第七大学合并。
description.en: One of the universities established after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris, it merged with Paris Diderot University in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的大学之一，于2019年与巴黎第五大学合并。
description.en: One of the universities established after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris, it merged with Paris Descartes University in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 由巴黎第五大学和巴黎第七大学于2019年合并而成，后于2022年更名为巴黎西岱大学。
description.en: Formed in 2019 by the merger of Paris Descartes University and Paris Diderot University, later renamed Université Paris Cité in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的大学之一，后合并进入巴黎文理大学。
description.en: One of the universities established after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris, it later merged into Paris Sciences et Lettres University.

description.zh-cn: 法国一所大学与院校共同体，巴黎第九大学已合并进入该校。
description.en: A collegiate university in France, which Paris Dauphine University has merged into.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的大学之一，后加入巴黎-萨克雷大学。
description.en: One of the universities established after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris, it later joined the University of Paris-Saclay.

description.zh-cn: 法国一所大学与院校共同体，巴黎第十一大学已加入。
description.en: A collegiate university in France, which Paris-Sud University has joined.

description.zh-cn: 罗马教宗，于1231年颁布法令授予巴黎大学多项特权。
description.en: Pope of the Catholic Church who issued a papal bull in 1231 granting the University of Paris several privileges.

description.zh-cn: 波兰裔法国物理学家、化学家，巴黎大学校友，1903年诺贝尔物理奖和1911年诺贝尔化学奖得主。
description.en: Polish and naturalized-French physicist and chemist, alumna of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903 and the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1911.

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家，巴黎大学校友，1903年诺贝尔物理奖得主。
description.en: French physicist, alumnus of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1903.

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家，巴黎大学校友，1908年诺贝尔物理奖得主。
description.en: French physicist, alumnus of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1908.

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家，巴黎大学校友，1926年诺贝尔物理奖得主。
description.en: French physicist, alumnus of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1926.

zh-cn: 路易-维克多-皮埃尔-雷蒙·第七代德布罗意公爵

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家，巴黎大学校友，1929年诺贝尔物理奖得主。
description.en: French physicist, alumnus of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1929.

zh-cn: 弗雷德里克·约里奥-居里

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家，巴黎大学校友，1935年诺贝尔化学奖得主。
description.en: French physicist, alumnus of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1935.

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家，巴黎大学校友，1935年诺贝尔化学奖得主。
description.en: French physicist, alumna of the University of Paris, winner of the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1935.

description.zh-cn: 法国后现代主义哲学家，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: French post-modernist philosopher, alumnus of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 法国物理学家、数学家，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: French physicist and mathematician, alumnus of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 法国存在主义作家，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: French existentialist writer, alumna of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 华人法律学家，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: Chinese jurist, alumnus of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民主化志士、三届立法委员，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: Taiwanese democratization activist, three-term legislator, alumnus of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 中国首位女法官，香港树仁大学前校长，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: China's first female judge, former president of Hong Kong Shue Yan University, alumna of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 香港的一所私立大学。
description.en: A private university in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 大律师，香港树仁大学校监，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: Barrister, President of Hong Kong Shue Yan University, alumnus of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 教育家，国立台湾师范大学前校长，原中华民国教育部部长，巴黎大学校友。
description.en: Educator, former president of National Taiwan Normal University, former Minister of Education of the Republic of China, alumnus of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的13所大学之一。
description.en: One of the 13 universities created after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的13所大学之一。
description.en: One of the 13 universities created after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的13所大学之一。
description.en: One of the 13 universities created after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的13所大学之一。
description.en: One of the 13 universities created after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 1970年原巴黎大学拆分后成立的13所大学之一。
description.en: One of the 13 universities created after the 1970 split of the original University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 日本奈良时代的首都，位于现今奈良市市区。由元明天皇于710年自藤原京迁都于此。
description.en: The capital city of Japan during the Nara period, located in modern-day Nara. The capital was moved here from Fujiwara-kyō in 710 by Empress Genmei.

description.zh-cn: 日本第43代天皇，于710年下令将首都从藤原京迁至平城京。
description.en: The 43rd monarch of Japan, who ordered the move of the capital from Fujiwara-kyō to Heijō-kyō in 710.

description.zh-cn: 日本历史上以奈良（平城京）为首都的时代，始于元明天皇迁都至平城京的710年，终于桓武天皇迁都至平安京的794年。此期间日本深受唐朝文化影响，发展出天平文化。
description.en: A period of Japanese history centered on the capital at Nara (Heijō-kyō), beginning in 710 when Empress Genmei moved the capital to Heijō-kyō and ending in 794 when Emperor Kanmu moved it to Heian-kyō. During this period, Japan was heavily influenced by Tang dynasty China, leading to the development of Tenpyō culture.

description.zh-cn: 奈良时代的一种文化，受到唐朝文化强烈影响，并在佛教艺术与建筑方面达到高峰。
description.en: A culture of the Nara period, strongly influenced by the Tang dynasty, which reached a peak in Buddhist art and architecture.

description.zh-cn: 日本在奈良时代等时期向唐朝派出的官方使团，对日本文化，特别是天平文化的形成产生了重要影响。
description.en: Official diplomatic missions sent from Japan to Tang China during periods like the Nara period, which had a significant impact on Japanese culture, particularly the formation of Tenpyō culture.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，是南都七大寺之一，也是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A Buddhist temple complex in Nara, one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代的大名，曾在奈良建立多闻山城以控制周边区域。
description.en: A daimyō of the Sengoku period in Japan, who once built Tamon Castle in Nara to control the surrounding area.

description.zh-cn: 江户时代幕府在奈良设置的直属地方行政官职。
description.en: A local administrative post directly under the shogunate established in Nara during the Edo period.

description.zh-cn: 联合国教科文组织登录的世界遗产项目，包含奈良市内的东大寺、兴福寺、春日大社、春日山原始林、元兴寺、药师寺、唐招提寺、平城宫遗迹。
description.en: A UNESCO World Heritage Site designation that includes Tōdai-ji, Kōfuku-ji, Kasuga-taisha, Kasugayama Primeval Forest, Gangō-ji, Yakushi-ji, Tōshōdai-ji, and the Heijō Palace Site in Nara.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝赴日弘法的著名僧人，在日本建立了唐招提寺。
description.en: A renowned Chinese monk from the Tang dynasty who traveled to Japan to propagate Buddhism and founded Tōshōdai-ji temple.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，由唐朝僧人鉴真建立，是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A Buddhist temple in Nara founded by the Tang dynasty monk Jianzhen, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 在奈良时代，位于首都平城京及周边地区，受到朝廷保护的七座大型佛教寺院的总称。
description.en: A collective term for the seven great Buddhist temples in and around the capital Heijō-kyō during the Nara period that were under the protection of the Imperial Court.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，是南都七大寺之一，也是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A Buddhist temple in Nara, one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，是南都七大寺之一，也是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A Buddhist temple in Nara, one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: A Buddhist temple in Nara, one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: A Buddhist temple in Nara, one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的佛教寺院，是南都七大寺之一，也是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A Buddhist temple in Nara, one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的大型公园，于1880年由日本政府规划设立，以其野生鹿群和历史遗迹而闻名。
description.en: A large public park in Nara, established in 1880 by the Japanese government, famous for its wild deer and historical sites.

zh-cn: 奈良女子高等师范学校

description.zh-cn: 1905年由奈良师范学校的女子部独立而成，后来发展成为奈良女子大学。
description.en: Established in 1905 from the women's division of Nara Normal School, it later developed into Nara Women's University.

description.zh-cn: 位于奈良市的神社，建于8世纪奈良时代，是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A Shinto shrine in Nara, established during the Nara period in the 8th century, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 紧邻奈良市区的原始森林，被视为春日大社的神域，是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: A primeval forest adjacent to urban Nara, considered a sacred domain of Kasuga-taisha, and part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 平城京中的天皇居所和政府官厅所在地，现为其遗址，是“古都奈良的文化财”的一部分。
description.en: The site of the imperial residence and government offices in the capital city of Heijō-kyō. Its ruins are part of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' UNESCO World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 根据《三国史记》记载，新罗的创建者，被奉为始祖。
description.en: According to the Samguk Sagi, the founder of Silla, revered as its progenitor.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛南部的部落联盟，新罗的前身是其十二部落之一的斯卢。
description.en: A loose confederacy of chiefdoms in the southern Korean Peninsula, from which Silla originated as the Saro state, one of its twelve member states.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝鲜半岛南部的部落联盟，后被新罗兼并。
description.en: A confederacy of territorial polities in the southern Korean Peninsula, later annexed by Silla.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜三国之一，与新罗、高句丽长期对峙，后被唐与新罗联军所灭。
description.en: One of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, which was in a long-standing confrontation with Silla and Goguryeo, and was eventually conquered by the allied forces of Tang and Silla.

description.zh-cn: 新罗与唐朝为争夺朝鲜半岛控制权而进行的战争。
description.en: A war fought between Silla and the Tang dynasty over the control of the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 新罗统一朝鲜半岛大同江以南地区后的历史时期，社会经济繁荣发展。
description.en: The historical period after Silla unified the regions south of the Taedong River on the Korean Peninsula, characterized by prosperous social and economic development.

description.zh-cn: 新罗末期，朝鲜半岛分裂为新罗、后百济、后高句丽（后被高丽取代）三个国家的时期。
description.en: A period in the late Silla era when the Korean Peninsula was divided into three states: Silla, Later Baekje, and Later Goguryeo (later replaced by Goryeo).

description.zh-cn: 高丽王朝的建立者。
description.en: The founder of the Goryeo dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 新罗第17代君主，巩固了金氏家族对王权的控制，使王位由金氏独占。
description.en: The 17th monarch of Silla, who consolidated the Kim clan's control over the throne, making the kingship exclusive to the Kim family.

description.zh-cn: 新罗第23代君主，正式确认佛教为国教，并建立骨品制。
description.en: The 23rd monarch of Silla, who officially recognized Buddhism as the state religion and established the bone-rank system.

description.zh-cn: 新罗真骨出身的君主，即武烈王。他的即位打破了只有圣骨才能继承王位的惯例。
description.en: A monarch of Silla from the true-bone rank, also known as King Muyeol. His ascension broke the tradition that only those of the sacred-bone rank could inherit the throne.

description.zh-cn: 新罗于682年设立的儒学教育机构，用于教育贵族子弟。
description.en: A Confucian educational institution established by Silla in 682 to educate the children of aristocrats.

description.zh-cn: 统一新罗时期的君主，设立国学，加强中央集权。
description.en: A monarch of Unified Silla who established the Gukhak (national academy) and strengthened centralized power.

description.zh-cn: 新罗末期的著名学者、文学家，曾在唐朝为官，著有《桂苑笔耕集》。
description.en: A prominent scholar and writer of late Silla, who served as an official in the Tang dynasty and authored the 'Gwon Pilgyeongjip'.

description.zh-cn: 后百济的建立者。
description.en: The founder of Later Baekje.

description.zh-cn: 后三国之一，由甄萱在原百济故地建立。
description.en: One of the Later Three Kingdoms, founded by Gyeon Hwon in the former territory of Baekje.

description.zh-cn: 后高句丽的建立者。
description.en: The founder of Later Goguryeo.

description.zh-cn: 后三国之一，由弓裔在原高句丽故地建立，后被王建的高丽所取代。
description.en: One of the Later Three Kingdoms, founded by Gung Ye in the former territory of Goguryeo, later replaced by Wang Geon's Goryeo.

description.zh-cn: 新罗第24代君主，在位期间新罗国力得到很大提高，疆土大幅扩张。
description.en: The 24th monarch of Silla, during whose reign Silla's power greatly increased and its territory expanded significantly.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛上的主要河流，真兴王时期新罗夺取了其流域，获得了与中国直接交通的门户。
description.en: A major river on the Korean Peninsula. Silla seized control of its basin during the reign of King Jinheung, gaining a direct gateway to China.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝在新罗设立的羁縻统治机构。
description.en: A 'loose-rein' administrative body established by the Tang dynasty in Silla.

description.zh-cn: 新罗法兴王时期的官员，为弘扬佛法而殉教，促使佛教在新罗被正式承认。
description.en: An official during the reign of King Beopheung of Silla whose martyrdom for the propagation of Buddhism led to its official recognition in Silla.

description.zh-cn: 李克农的夫人。
description.en: Spouse of Li Kenong.

description.zh-cn: 李克农次子，原中央军委三局正师休干，总参通信部原副部长。
description.en: Second son of Li Kenong, former division-level cadre of the Third Bureau of the Central Military Commission, and former Deputy Director of the Communications Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 李克农长女，原中央党校教授、陕西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Eldest daughter of Li Kenong, former professor at the Central Party School and director of the Shaanxi Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 位于芜湖的一所教会学校，李克农曾在此就读。
description.en: A mission school in Wuhu where Li Kenong studied.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家，与李克农等组织无政府主义团体“安社”。
description.en: A Chinese writer who organized the anarchist group 'Anshe' with Li Kenong and others.

description.zh-cn: 与李克农等组织无政府主义团体“安社”。
description.en: Organized the anarchist group 'Anshe' with Li Kenong and others.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家，与李克农等组织无政府主义团体“安社”。
description.en: A Chinese writer who organized the anarchist group 'Anshe' with Li Kenong and others.

zh-cn: 八路军驻沪办事处（兼新四军驻沪办事处）旧址

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期八路军在上海设立的办事机构。
description.en: An office established by the Eighth Route Army in Shanghai during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 位于安徽省巢湖市，是李克农的出生地。
description.en: Located in Chaohu City, Anhui Province, it is the birthplace of Li Kenong.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波与第一任妻子陶力的儿子。
description.en: The son of Liu Xiaobo and his first wife, Tao Li.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波的长兄。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo's eldest brother.

description.zh-cn: 德国社会民主党政治人物，奥拉夫·朔尔茨的妻子。
description.en: German politician of the Social Democratic Party and wife of Olaf Scholz.

description.zh-cn: 德国政治人物，曾任德国总理和德国社会民主党领袖。
description.en: German politician who served as Chancellor of Germany and leader of the Social Democratic Party of Germany.

description.zh-cn: 由德国社会民主党、联盟90/绿党和自由民主党组成的德国联合政府。
description.en: The coalition government of Germany, formed by the Social Democratic Party, Alliance 90/The Greens, and the Free Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 德国政治人物，自由民主党领袖，曾在萧兹内阁中担任财政部长。
description.en: German politician, leader of the Free Democratic Party, who served as Minister of Finance in the Scholz cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 因财政预算分歧，德国总理朔尔茨解除了财长林德纳的职务，导致自由民主党退出执政联盟，引发联合政府解体。
description.en: Triggered by disagreements over the budget, German Chancellor Scholz dismissed Finance Minister Lindner, leading to the withdrawal of the Free Democratic Party from the ruling coalition and the collapse of the government.

description.zh-cn: 德国总理奥拉夫·朔尔茨在2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后发表的演讲，宣布德国军事和外交政策的根本性转变。
description.en: A speech given by German Chancellor Olaf Scholz following the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, announcing a fundamental shift in German military and foreign policy.

zh-cn: 中华民国国军退除役官兵辅导委员会
行政院国军退除役官兵辅导委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政院的部会，负责退伍军人的辅导、服务与照顾。
description.en: A ministry of the Executive Yuan of the Republic of China responsible for the guidance, service, and care of veterans.

zh-cn: 1974年中华民国陆军UH-1H直升机坠毁事故
1974年中华民国陆军UH-1H直升机坠机事件

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军在“昌平演习”期间发生的两架UH-1H直升机坠毁事故，造成多名将校伤亡。
description.en: An accident where two UH-1H helicopters of the Republic of China Army crashed during the 'Changping Exercise', resulting in casualties among several high-ranking officers.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将，曾任陆军总司令，在1974年昌平空难中受重伤。
description.en: A General of the Republic of China Army who served as Commander-in-Chief of the Army and was seriously injured in the 1974 Changping air crash.

zh-cn: 杨念祖 (台湾学政界人物)

description.zh-cn: 中华民国学者及政治人物，曾短暂担任国防部长。
description.en: A scholar and politician of the Republic of China who briefly served as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国空军二级上将（退役），曾任国防部长。
description.en: A retired General of the Republic of China Air Force who served as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳与福芝芳之子。
description.en: Son of Mei Lanfang and Fu Zhifang.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳与福芝芳之子。
description.en: Son of Mei Lanfang and Fu Zhifang.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳与福芝芳之女，梅派京剧艺术传人，主攻老生。
description.en: Daughter of Mei Lanfang and Fu Zhifang, an inheritor of the Mei School art, specializing in Laosheng roles.

description.zh-cn: 由台湾北部数所研究型大学组成的大学系统。
description.en: A university system composed of several research-oriented universities in northern Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 亚马逊公司提供的云计算服务平台。
description.en: A cloud computing services platform provided by Amazon.

zh-cn: 国立台湾海洋大学附属基隆海事高级中等学校
国立基隆高级海事职业学校
附属基隆海事高级中等学校
en: National Keelung Maritime Vocational High School

description.zh-cn: 原为国立基隆高级海事职业学校，于2020年改隶为国立台湾海洋大学的附属学校。
description.en: Formerly the National Keelung Maritime Vocational High School, it became an affiliated school of National Taiwan Ocean University in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾海洋大学前身“台湾省立海事专科学校”的首任校长。
description.en: The first president of the 'Taiwan Provincial Maritime Junior College', the predecessor of National Taiwan Ocean University.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾海洋大学前校长，历任台湾省立海事专科学校及台湾省立海洋学院时期。
description.en: Former president of National Taiwan Ocean University, serving during the periods of Taiwan Provincial Maritime Junior College and Taiwan Provincial College of Marine Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾海洋大学前校长。
description.en: Former president of National Taiwan Ocean University.

description.zh-cn: 苏联根据《德苏互不侵犯条约》的秘密协议，从东面入侵波兰，对波兰的最终战败起到了决定性作用。
description.en: The Soviet Union's invasion of Poland from the east, based on the secret protocol of the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact, which played a decisive role in Poland's final defeat.

description.zh-cn: 英法对德宣战后，在西线并未发动大规模军事进攻的时期。这导致波兰未能获得其盟友有效的军事援助，被迫独自抵抗德苏两国的入侵。
description.en: The period after Britain and France declared war on Germany, during which no major military offensives were launched on the Western Front. This resulted in Poland not receiving effective military assistance from its allies, forcing it to resist the invasions from Germany and the Soviet Union alone.

description.zh-cn: 波兰军队在战役中发动的唯一一次大规模反击，由塔德乌斯·库特雷兹巴指挥。尽管初期取得成功，但最终被德军包围歼灭，导致波军主力毁灭。
description.en: The only major counter-offensive launched by the Polish army during the campaign, commanded by Tadeusz Kutrzeba. Despite initial success, it was eventually encircled and annihilated by German forces, leading to the destruction of the main Polish forces.

description.zh-cn: 德国陆军总司令，作为作战总指挥官负责指挥入侵波兰的军事行动。
description.en: Commander-in-Chief of the German Army, who was responsible for commanding the military operations during the invasion of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 德国南方集团军司令，在波兰战役中担任主攻任务。
description.en: Commander of the German Army Group South, which served as the main attack force during the Invasion of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 德国北方集团军司令，在波兰战役中担任助攻任务。
description.en: Commander of the German Army Group North, which served as the supporting attack force during the Invasion of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 波兰元帅，在波兰战役期间担任波兰军队总司令。
description.en: Marshal of Poland and Commander-in-Chief of the Polish Armed Forces during the Invasion of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 时任德国南方集团军参谋长，参与了《白色方案》的策划，并在布楚拉战役期间与伦德施泰特共同制定了应对策略。
description.en: Chief of Staff of the German Army Group South at the time, involved in the planning of 'Case White' and co-developed the response strategy with von Rundstedt during the Battle of the Bzura.

zh-cn: 约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国外交部长，代表德国与苏联签署了《德苏互不侵犯条约》。
description.en: Minister for Foreign Affairs of Nazi Germany, who signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact on behalf of Germany.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国海关总署广东分署

location.zh-cn: 广东省广州市荔湾区沙面大街53号
location.en: 53 Shamian Street, Liwan District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国海关总署设立在广东省的派出机构，负责综合协调、协助管理、调查研究、监督审计巡视，并协调泛珠三角区域海关合作事务。
description.en: A dispatched agency of the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China established in Guangdong Province, responsible for comprehensive coordination, management assistance, investigation and research, supervision, audit, and inspection, as well as coordinating customs cooperation affairs in the Pan-Pearl River Delta region.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在促进中国泛珠三角区域内省区经济合作的机制。
description.en: A mechanism aimed at promoting economic cooperation among provinces and regions within China's Pan-Pearl River Delta region.

description.zh-cn: 香港商人，曾任亚洲电视董事局主席。在其主理期间，亚视实现了少有的盈余。
香港商人，丽新集团创办人，曾任亚洲电视永远荣誉主席。

zh-cn: 亚洲电视控股有限公司

description.zh-cn: 亚洲电视的主要股东及母公司，前身为协盛协丰。
香港政治人物，在担任商务及经济发展局局长期间，宣布亚洲电视的免费电视牌照不获续期。

zh-cn: 亚洲电视欠薪及不获续牌事件

description.zh-cn: 导致亚洲电视免费电视牌照不获续期并最终停播的一系列事件，核心问题包括持续欠薪及财政危机。
亚洲电视控股旗下公司，曾以“亚洲电视”品牌推出OTT网络电视服务，后于2022年9月7日被颁令清盘。
亚洲电视前身“丽的映声”的创办公司。
丽的电视首位华人总经理，任内大胆起用新人，制作了多档震撼性节目，对无线电视构成极大冲击。
香港影视制作人，被黄锡照提拔，与李兆熊、屠用雄并称“丽的三雄”。
中国大陆商人，曾是亚洲电视的主要投资者。其主导时期引发多宗争议，并最终因拒绝注资导致亚视陷入财政危机，他亦申请将亚视清盘。
台湾商人，旺旺集团董事长，曾于2009年入股亚洲电视。
中国大陆商人，通过中国文化传媒国际控股有限公司入主亚洲电视，是亚视免费电视时代的最后一位投资者。
国际专业服务公司，在亚洲电视停播前夕被委任为其临时清盘人。
香港的司法机构之一，负责审理香港民主派初选案。案件由三名国安法指定法官审理，不设陪审团。
description.en: One of Hong Kong's judicial institutions, responsible for hearing the Hong Kong pro-democracy primaries case. The case was heard by three designated National Security Law judges without a jury.

description.zh-cn: 香港资深电影人，于2023年2月3日出任亚洲电视有限公司之行政总裁。
1980年丽的电视创作的乡土剧，其高收视率迫使无线电视的剧集《轮流传》被腰斩。
1979年丽的电视制作的武侠电视剧，是首部由剧本改编为小说的作品，曾突破收视弱势，对竞争对手无线电视造成巨大冲击。
2001年亚洲电视推出的游戏节目，曾取得极高收视率，成功击败无线电视的《香港小姐竞选决赛》。

zh-cn: ATV焦点批评学民思潮争议

description.zh-cn: 亚洲电视时政评论节目《ATV焦点》将学民思潮及反国民教育科人士称为“破坏派”，因内容偏颇而引发大量投诉，严重损害电视台形象。

zh-cn: 亚洲电视误报江泽民逝世事件

description.zh-cn: 亚洲电视新闻部在未有官方证实下，错误报道前中共中央总书记江泽民逝世的消息，严重损害了电视台的公信力。
中国政治人物，现任中华人民共和国应急管理部部长、党委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, current Minister and Party Secretary of the Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国应急管理部管理的国家局，由原国家煤矿安全监察局更名而来。
description.en: A national bureau administered by the Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China, renamed from the former State Administration of Coal Mine Safety.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国应急管理部首任部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as the first Minister of the Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国应急管理部部长、党委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister and Party Secretary of the Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中央纪委国家监委驻应急管理部纪检监察组组长。
description.en: Chinese politician, current head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the CCDI and NSC stationed at the Ministry of Emergency Management.

description.zh-cn: 原中华人民共和国应急管理部管理的国家局，后更名为国家矿山安全监察局。
description.en: A former national bureau administered by the Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China, later renamed the National Mine Safety Administration.

description.zh-cn: 中国官员，现任国家矿山安全监察局局长，应急管理部党委委员。
description.en: Chinese official, current Director of the National Mine Safety Administration and a member of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Emergency Management.

description.zh-cn: 塞尔维亚的秘密民族主义组织，策划了萨拉热窝事件。
description.en: A secret Serbian nationalist organization that planned the Sarajevo assassination.

description.zh-cn: 一个寻求将波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那从奥匈帝国统治下解放出来，并与塞尔维亚统一的革命青年运动。萨拉热窝事件刺客的动机与该组织目标一致。
description.en: A revolutionary youth movement seeking to liberate Bosnia and Herzegovina from Austro-Hungarian rule and unite with Serbia. The motives of the Sarajevo assassins were consistent with the goals of this organization.

description.zh-cn: 一项将奥匈帝国改造为联邦国家的政治构想，得到了弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的支持。
description.en: A political proposal to transform Austria-Hungary into a federal state, supported by Archduke Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 一个由世界各国的金融情报单位（FIUs）组成的国际组织。
description.en: An international organization composed of Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) from around the world.

description.zh-cn: 内政部调查局第二任局长。
description.en: The second Director of the Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of the Interior.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾组建司法行政部调查局，并担任首任局长，被称为“调查局之父”。
description.en: Established the Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Justice Administration in Taiwan and served as its first director, known as the 'Father of the Investigation Bureau'.

description.zh-cn: 曾任法务部调查局局长及法务部部长，是首位本省籍及文人出身的调查局长。
description.en: Former Director of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau and Minister of Justice, the first Taiwanese-born and civilian director of the Investigation Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 曾任法务部调查局局长，是首位卸任后被起诉的前局长。
description.en: Former Director of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau, the first former director to be indicted after leaving office.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台中市的私立综合大学。
description.en: A private comprehensive university located in Taichung, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 曾任法务部调查局局长，后任驻捷克代表。
description.en: Former Director of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau, later served as the representative to the Czech Republic.

description.zh-cn: 曾任法务部调查局局长，是首位检察官出身的局长，后升任法务部部长。
description.en: Former Director of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau, the first director with a prosecutor background, later promoted to Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国司法院及考试院共同监督的司法官养成教育机构。
description.en: An educational institution for judicial officers in the Republic of China, jointly supervised by the Judicial Yuan and the Examination Yuan.

zh-cn: 法务部调查局资安鉴识实验室

description.zh-cn: 法务部调查局资通安全处下设的单位，为台湾首座数位鉴识实验室。
description.en: A unit under the Cyber Security Investigation Office of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau, it is Taiwan's first digital forensics laboratory.

description.zh-cn: 中国晚清至民国初年立宪派、政治人物，曾任湖北省咨议局议长，武昌起义后在湖北军政府担任要职。
description.en: A constitutionalist and political figure from the late Qing to the early Republican era in China. He served as the speaker of the Hubei Provincial Consultative Assembly and held important positions in the Hubei Military Government after the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年“预备立宪”的产物，是湖北省的准议会机构。其大楼在武昌起义后成为鄂军都督府。
description.en: A product of the 'preparatory constitutionalism' in the late Qing Dynasty, serving as a quasi-parliamentary body for Hubei Province. Its building became the headquarters of the Hubei Military Government after the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 同盟会会员，参与筹划武昌起义，并拟定了起义后临时政府的组织。
description.en: A member of the Tongmenghui who participated in the planning of the Wuchang Uprising and drafted the organization of the provisional government after the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家，参与武昌起义，并在湖北军政府担任要职。
description.en: A Chinese revolutionary who participated in the Wuchang Uprising and held important positions in the Hubei Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国革命家，参与武昌起义，并在湖北军政府担任要职。

description.zh-cn: 中国外交家、政治家，在湖北军政府担任外交部副部长。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat and politician who served as the Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs in the Hubei Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后由各独立省份派代表组成的联合议事机构，为中华民国临时政府的成立起到了重要的领导作用。
description.en: A joint deliberative body formed by representatives from independent provinces after the Wuchang Uprising, which played a significant leadership role in the establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China.

zh-cn: 辛亥革命武昌起义纪念馆
en: Museum of the Wuchang Uprising of 1911 Revolution

description.zh-cn: 位于湖北省武汉市武昌区，是为纪念辛亥革命武昌首义而建立的纪念馆，馆址为原湖北省咨议局大楼，也是中华民国军政府鄂军都督府旧址。
description.en: Located in Wuchang District, Wuhan, Hubei, it is a memorial hall established to commemorate the Wuchang Uprising of the Xinhai Revolution. Its site is the former Hubei Provincial Consultative Assembly building, which was also the former site of the Wuchang Uprising Military Government of the Republic of China.

description.en: A vassal state from the Western Zhou to the Spring and Autumn period, located around modern Wuhan, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省下辖的地级市。

description.zh-cn: 中国明朝和清朝初年设立的省，后被分拆为湖北省和湖南省。
description.en: A province established during the Ming and early Qing dynasties, later split into Hubei and Hunan provinces.

description.en: A concept introduced by then-General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee Xi Jinping in 2012, with its core goal being the 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation'.

description.en: The personal title used by Adolf Hitler in Nazi Germany, and its associated political slogan. Some analyses compare it with Xi Jinping's 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation'.

description.zh-cn: 一种强调民族利益和文化认同的意识形态。有分析认为，习近平提倡的“中华民族伟大复兴”推动了中国的民族主义情绪。
description.en: An ideology that emphasizes national interests and cultural identity. Some analyses suggest that the 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation' promoted by Xi Jinping has fueled nationalist sentiments in China.

description.en: An American public opinion polling and research organization. A 2020 survey it conducted showed that negative views of China reached historic highs in many major countries.

description.zh-cn: 指中华人民共和国在全球经济、政治和军事地位上的显著提升。在中国民众看来，西方国家对中国的负面观感升高是中国崛起的结果。
description.en: Refers to the significant increase in the People's Republic of China's global economic, political, and military standing. In the view of the Chinese public, the rise in negative Western perceptions of China is a result of China's rise.

description.zh-cn: “两弹一星”元勋之一，在文化大革命期间被造反派毒打致死。拨乱反正时期获得平反，并被追认为烈士。
description.en: One of the key contributors to the "Two Bombs, One Satellite" project, who was beaten to death by rebels during the Cultural Revolution. He was posthumously rehabilitated and recognized as a martyr during the Boluan Fanzheng period.

description.zh-cn: 中国气象学和空间物理学家，“两弹一星”元勋之一。在文化大革命期间被迫害自杀身亡，后于拨乱反正时期获得平反。
description.en: A Chinese meteorologist and space physicist, and one of the key contributors to the 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' project. He committed suicide after being persecuted during the Cultural Revolution and was posthumously rehabilitated during the Boluan Fanzheng period.

description.zh-cn: 前南京兵部尚书，与福王朱常洵一同被李自成杀害。

description.en: An ancient location where Zhang Fei planned to rendezvous with Liu Bei's main army.

description.zh-cn: 古代城池名，关羽兵败被俘之处。

It was established in 1986 by merging the Traffic Division of the Public Security Bureau of the original Ministry of Public Security and the Supervision Division of the Highway Bureau of the Ministry of Transport.

description.en: Chinese politician, currently the head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission stationed at the Central Foreign Affairs Office.

description.zh-cn: 2012年设立的中共中央议事协调机构，负责统筹协调海洋权益事务。该机构后被中央维护海洋权益工作领导小组的名义所涵盖，并于2018年3月21日被撤销，其职责并入中央外事工作委员会。
description.en: Established in 2012, this was a coordinating body under the CPC Central Committee, responsible for the overall coordination of maritime rights and interests. It was later integrated under the name 'Central Leading Group for Safeguarding Maritime Rights and Interests'. The body was abolished on March 21, 2018, and its responsibilities were merged into the Central Foreign Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国中医师，中西医结合心血管病专家，天津中医药大学第一附属医院主任医师，中国共产党党员。曾获“国医大师”称号。
description.en: A Chinese traditional medicine practitioner, an expert in integrating traditional Chinese and Western medicine for cardiovascular diseases, and a chief physician at the First Affiliated Hospital of Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine. He was a member of the Communist Party of China and was awarded the title of 'National Master of Chinese Medicine'.

description.zh-cn: 中国旧县名，位于直隶省（今河北省），是阮士怡的出生地。
description.en: A former county in China, located in Zhili Province (modern-day Hebei), the birthplace of Ruan Shiyi.

First Affiliated Hospital of Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

description.zh-cn: 位于天津市的医院，阮士怡是其建院参与者之一并长期在此担任主任医师。
description.en: A hospital in Tianjin where Ruan Shiyi participated in its founding and served as a chief physician for a long time.

zh-cn: 中国中西医结合研究会
en: China Association of the Integration of Traditional and Western Medicine

description.zh-cn: 中国全国性的中西医结合学术性社会团体。
description.en: A national academic social organization for the integration of traditional Chinese and Western medicine in China.

zh-cn: 天津市卫生健康委员会

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民政府的组成部门，负责卫生健康工作。其前身天津市卫生局曾授予阮士怡“天津市名中医”称号。
description.en: A department of the Tianjin Municipal People's Government responsible for health and wellness. Its predecessor, the Tianjin Municipal Health Bureau, awarded Ruan Shiyi the title of 'Tianjin Famous Doctor of Traditional Chinese Medicine'.

description.zh-cn: 位于天津市的医院，阮士怡曾在此担任内科住院医师。
description.en: A hospital in Tianjin where Ruan Shiyi once worked as a resident physician in internal medicine.

description.zh-cn: 毛远新与全秀凤的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Mao Yuanxin and Quan Xiufeng.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the early years of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年政治人物，曾代理国务总理。
description.en: A political figure in the early years of the Republic of China who served as Acting Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年政治人物，曾两次担任国务总理。
description.en: A political figure in the early years of the Republic of China who served as Premier on two occasions.

description.zh-cn: 1914年5月1日，袁世凯将国务院改为政事堂，直属于大总统府。1916年6月29日恢复国务院建制。
description.en: On May 1, 1914, Yuan Shikai changed the State Council to the 'Hall of State Affairs' (政事堂), directly under the Presidential Palace. The State Council was restored on June 29, 1916.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初年政治人物、北洋将领。曾代理国务总理，也是张勋复辟的骨干分子之一，被任命为步军统领。
description.en: A political figure and Beiyang general in the early years of the Republic of China. He served as Acting Premier, was also a core member of Zhang Xun's restoration, and was appointed Infantry Commander.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾两次担任国务总理。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Premier on two occasions.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期的军事家、政治家，位列北洋三杰之一。他曾担任国务总理，并且是张勋复辟的骨干分子之一，期间被任命为内阁议政大臣和参谋部大臣。
description.en: A military strategist and politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, and one of the 'Three Beiyang Heroes'. He served as Premier, and was also a key figure in Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration, during which he was appointed Minister of the Cabinet and Minister of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾代理国务总理。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Acting Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾两度出任国务总理。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served twice as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期外交家、政治家，曾多次出任国务总理。
description.en: A diplomat and politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served multiple times as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾代理国务总理，并短暂代理大总统。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Acting Premier and briefly as Acting President.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期军事家、政治家，曾任国务总理。
description.en: A military strategist and politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾代理国务总理，并摄行大总统职权。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Acting Premier and exercised the powers of the President.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国著名外交家，曾多次代理及担任国务总理。
description.en: A prominent diplomat of the Republic of China, who served multiple times as Acting and official Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期政治家，曾任国务总理。
description.en: A politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期外交家、政治家，曾代理国务总理并摄行临时执政职权。
description.en: A diplomat and politician during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Acting Premier and exercised the powers of the Provisional Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期海军将领，曾代理国务总理并摄行大总统职权。
description.en: A naval admiral during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, who served as Acting Premier and exercised the powers of the President.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国北洋政府时期的官僚派系之一，以梁士诒为首。
description.en: A bureaucratic faction during the Beiyang Government period of the Republic of China, led by Liang Shiyi.

description.zh-cn: 由斯巴达克同盟等左翼组织在柏林发动的一次武装起义，最终被魏玛政府镇压。
description.en: An armed uprising in Berlin launched by the Spartacus League and other left-wing organizations, which was ultimately suppressed by the Weimar government.

description.zh-cn: 德国右翼准军事组织，在一战后被魏玛共和国政府用来镇压左翼革命，如斯巴达克同盟起义。
description.en: Right-wing German paramilitary units that were used by the Weimar Republic government after WWI to suppress left-wing revolutions, such as the Spartacist uprising.

description.zh-cn: 德国马克思主义革命组织，在十一月革命后期发动了斯巴达克同盟起义，试图建立社会主义共和国。
description.en: A German Marxist revolutionary organization that launched the Spartacist uprising in the later stages of the November Revolution in an attempt to establish a socialist republic.

description.zh-cn: 德国海军水兵因拒绝出战而发动的兵变，被视为十一月革命的开端。
description.en: A mutiny by German sailors who refused to go into battle, considered the starting point of the November Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 曾统治普鲁士和德意志帝国的王朝，在十一月革命中被推翻。
description.en: The dynasty that once ruled Prussia and the German Empire, overthrown during the November Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 德国社会主义者，斯巴达克同盟和德国共产党的领导人之一。在斯巴达克同盟起义被镇压后遇害。
description.en: A German socialist, one of the leaders of the Spartacus League and the Communist Party of Germany. He was killed after the Spartacist uprising was suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 德国社会民主党政治家，魏玛共和国首任国防部长，他聘用自由军团镇压了斯巴达克同盟起义。
description.en: A German Social Democratic politician and the first Minister of Defence of the Weimar Republic. He hired the Freikorps to suppress the Spartacist uprising.

zh-cn: 巴伐利亚苏维埃共和国

description.zh-cn: 十一月革命期间在德国巴伐利亚建立的一个短暂的社会主义国家，后被魏玛政府军队和自由军团镇压。
description.en: A short-lived socialist state established in Bavaria, Germany, during the November Revolution, which was later suppressed by Weimar government troops and the Freikorps.

description.zh-cn: 魏玛共和国的宪法，它的通过和生效标志着魏玛共和国的正式成立。
description.en: The constitution of the Weimar Republic. Its adoption and entry into force marked the formal establishment of the republic.

description.zh-cn: 一种旨在收复失地的政治思想。德国因一战战败而产生的复仇主义情绪是纳粹主义兴起的原因之一。
description.en: A political ideology aimed at reclaiming lost territory. Revanchist sentiments in Germany after its defeat in WWI were one of the reasons for the rise of Nazism.

description.zh-cn: 德国社会民主党政治家，魏玛共和国首任总统。
description.en: A German Social Democratic politician who served as the first President of the Weimar Republic.

zh-cn: 中国电影表演艺术学会

description.zh-cn: 中国的一个专业组织，于2005年评选了“中国电影百年百位优秀演员”，魏鹤龄名列其中。
description.en: A professional organization in China that selected the '100 Excellent Actors in 100 Years of Chinese Cinema' in 2005, including Wei Heling.

zh-cn: 中国电影百年百位优秀演员
en: 100 Excellent Actors in 100 Years of Chinese Cinema

description.zh-cn: 由中国电影表演艺术学会于2005年为纪念中国电影诞生百年而评选的荣誉称号名单。
description.en: An honorary title list selected by the China Film Performance Art Academy in 2005 to commemorate the centenary of Chinese cinema.

description.zh-cn: 李在明的妻子。
description.en: The wife of Lee Jae-myung.

description.zh-cn: 位于韩国首尔的私立研究型大学，李在明在此获得法学学位。
description.en: A private research university in Seoul, South Korea, where Lee Jae-myung earned his law degree.

description.zh-cn: 韩国庆尚北道的一个市，李在明的出生地。
description.en: A city in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea, and the birthplace of Lee Jae-myung.

description.zh-cn: 韩国京畿道下辖的市，李在明曾于2010年至2018年担任该市市长。
description.en: A city in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Lee Jae-myung served as its mayor from 2010 to 2018.

description.zh-cn: 韩国人口最多的道，环绕首都首尔。李在明曾于2018年至2021年担任该道知事。
description.en: The most populous province in South Korea, surrounding the capital, Seoul. Lee Jae-myung served as its governor from 2018 to 2021.

description.zh-cn: 因尹锡悦遭弹劾而提前举行的大韩民国第21届总统选举，李在明在此次选举中获胜。
description.en: The 21st presidential election in the Republic of Korea, held early due to the impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol, in which Lee Jae-myung was victorious.

description.zh-cn: 韩国国民力量党政治人物，在2025年总统选举中败给李在明。
description.en: A politician from the People Power Party who was defeated by Lee Jae-myung in the 2025 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 前韩国短道速滑运动员。李在明担任城南市长期间解散其所属的滑冰队，间接导致其转籍至俄罗斯。
description.en: A former South Korean short track speed skater. The dissolution of his skating team during Lee Jae-myung's tenure as Mayor of Seongnam indirectly led to his change of nationality to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统朴槿惠的亲信，崔顺实事件的核心人物。
description.en: A confidante of former South Korean President Park Geun-hye and the central figure in the Choi Soon-sil scandal.

en: Supreme Prosecutors' Office of the Republic of Korea

description.zh-cn: 大韩民国的最高检察机关，曾多次对李在明提起诉讼和申请批捕。
description.en: The highest prosecution authority in the Republic of Korea, which has repeatedly filed lawsuits and sought arrest warrants for Lee Jae-myung.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣的同性伴侣，两人自幼相识，展开了长达20年的感情。在张国荣去世后，以“未亡人”身份处理其后事。
description.en: Leslie Cheung's same-sex partner. They knew each other since childhood and had a relationship that lasted for 20 years. After Cheung's death, he handled the funeral arrangements as his surviving partner.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣于2000至2001年举办的世界巡回演唱会，由他亲自担任艺术总监。其前卫的造型在当时受到香港媒体的普遍批评和嘲讽，据其经纪人陈淑芬称，这次打击是导致他患上抑郁症的最大原因。
description.en: A world concert tour held by Leslie Cheung from 2000 to 2001, for which he served as the artistic director. His avant-garde styling was widely criticized and ridiculed by the Hong Kong media at the time. According to his manager Florence Chan, this blow was the main reason for his depression.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣的父亲，香港著名的洋服裁缝，曾为好莱坞明星马龙·白兰度等人缝制服装。
description.en: Leslie Cheung's father, a famous tailor in Hong Kong who made clothes for Hollywood stars like Marlon Brando.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣的大姐，香港知名社会菁英。
description.en: Leslie Cheung's eldest sister, a well-known social elite in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港女演员，曾与张国荣短暂交往。张国荣曾在22岁时向她求婚但被拒绝。
description.en: A Hong Kong actress who had a brief relationship with Leslie Cheung. Cheung proposed to her when he was 22, but she declined.

description.zh-cn: 1993年上映的电影，由张国荣主演。该片使张国荣扬名国际影坛，获得多项国际大奖及提名。
description.en: A 1993 film starring Leslie Cheung. The film brought him international fame and earned numerous international awards and nominations.

description.zh-cn: 香港女演员。据一种说法，张国荣“哥哥”的绰号起源于1987年拍摄《倩女幽魂》时，王祖贤在片场如此称呼他。
description.en: A Hong Kong actress. According to one account, Leslie Cheung's nickname 'Gor Gor' (哥哥, older brother) originated from her addressing him this way on the set of 'A Chinese Ghost Story' in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 香港音乐人，张国荣的恩师。1982年，张国荣跟随他转投无线电视及华星唱片。
description.en: A Hong Kong musician and Leslie Cheung's mentor. In 1982, Cheung followed him to join TVB and Capital Artists.

description.zh-cn: 香港唱片公司，隶属于宝丽金唱片。张国荣于1987年转投该公司，进入其歌唱事业的巅峰时期。
description.en: A Hong Kong record label under PolyGram. Leslie Cheung signed with the company in 1987, entering the peak of his singing career.

description.zh-cn: 国际唱片公司。张国荣于1999年签约该公司，直至去世。
description.en: An international record company. Leslie Cheung signed with this company in 1999 and remained with it until his death.

description.zh-cn: 台湾总督府技师，设计了1921年重建的台大医院建筑。
description.en: An engineer of the Governor-General of Taiwan, who designed the reconstruction of the National Taiwan University Hospital building in 1921.

en: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 由郭台铭创办的跨国电子代工公司。
description.en: A multinational electronics contract manufacturing company founded by Terry Gou.

zh-cn: 国立台湾大学医学院附设医院云林分院
行政院卫生署云林医院
en: National Taiwan University Hospital Yunlin Branch

description.zh-cn: 原为台湾省立云林医院，2004年4月改制并成为国立台湾大学医学院附设医院云林分院。
description.en: Formerly Taiwan Provincial Yunlin Hospital, it was restructured in April 2004 and became a branch of National Taiwan University Hospital (NTU Hospital Yunlin Branch).

description.zh-cn: 捐赠土地以兴建财团法人北海岸金山医院。
description.en: Donated land for the construction of the North Coast Jinshan Hospital Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员，第十三届全国人民代表大会陕西省代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a member of the Communist Party of China, and a deputy from Shaanxi Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省下辖的县级市，是李文的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city in Shandong Province, People's Republic of China, and the birthplace of Li Wen.

zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区革命委员会
en: Revolutionary Committee of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间内蒙古自治区的权力机构。
description.en: The governing body of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 731部队人体实验的主要受害者群体之一。
description.en: One of the main victim groups of Unit 731's human experiments.

description.en: One of the victim groups of Unit 731's human experiments.

description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Haikou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在海口市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Haikou City.

description.zh-cn: 原为中国海南省下辖的县级市，于2002年10月16日与原地级海口市合并，成为新的地级海口市的一部分。
description.en: A former county-level city under the jurisdiction of Hainan Province, China, which was merged with the former prefecture-level Haikou City on October 16, 2002, to become part of the new prefecture-level Haikou City.

description.zh-cn: 香港十八个区议会之一，负责处理深水埗区的地区事务。
description.en: One of the 18 district councils of Hong Kong, responsible for advising on district affairs in Sham Shui Po.

description.zh-cn: 于1997年至1998年运作的香港立法机关，由中央政府筹组以取代殖民时期的立法局。
description.en: The legislature of Hong Kong that operated from 1997 to 1998, established by the Central Government to replace the colonial-era Legislative Council.

description.zh-cn: 香港十八个区议会之一，负责处理油尖旺区的地区事务。
description.en: One of the 18 district councils of Hong Kong, responsible for advising on district affairs in Yau Tsim Mong.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，泛民主派成员。
description.en: Hong Kong politician and a member of the pro-democracy camp.

en: Article 23 of the Hong Kong Basic Law

description.zh-cn: 《香港基本法》中关于国家安全的条文，要求香港特区自行立法禁止叛国等七种行为。
description.en: A provision in the Hong Kong Basic Law concerning national security, requiring the Hong Kong SAR to enact laws on its own to prohibit seven types of acts such as treason.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，泛民主派成员。
description.en: Hong Kong politician and a member of the pro-democracy camp.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，民主建港联盟成员。
description.en: Hong Kong politician and a member of the DAB.

description.zh-cn: 香港政治人物，民主党成员。
description.en: Hong Kong politician and a member of the Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府官员，曾任教育局局长。
description.en: A Hong Kong government official who served as the Secretary for Education.

zh-cn: 2020年香港立法会选举民主派初选

description.zh-cn: 香港民主派于2020年7月11日至12日举行了非官方初选，旨在协调立法会选举候选人，争取超过35个议席。此次初选后来被政府指控违反国家安全法。初选前，戴耀廷提出了“揽炒十步”政治方针，计划在民主派取得立法会多数席位后，通过否决政府财政预算案等方式迫使政府回应政治诉求。该方针后来被控方指为颠覆国家政权的计划。
description.en: An unofficial primary election was held by the Hong Kong pro-democracy camp on July 11-12, 2020, to coordinate candidates for the Legislative Council election, aiming to win over 35 seats. This primary was later accused by the government of violating the National Security Law. Prior to the primary, Benny Tai proposed a political strategy, planning that after the pro-democracy camp gained a majority in the Legislative Council, they would compel the government to respond to political demands by means such as vetoing the government's budget. This strategy was later alleged by the prosecution to be a plan to subvert state power.

description.en: A Hong Kong director who frequently collaborated with Gu Long and Ni Kuang, directing numerous film adaptations of Gu Long's novels and ushering in a golden era for Gu Long's movies.

description.zh-cn: 1952年至1989年间存在的中欧社会主义国家，是苏联的一个卫星国。
description.en: A socialist state in Central Europe that existed from 1952 to 1989, and was a satellite state of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 1949年至1989年间存在的中欧社会主义国家，是苏联的一个卫星国。
description.en: A socialist state in Central Europe that existed from 1949 to 1989, and was a satellite state of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 1956年6月在波兰波兹南市发生的民众大规模罢工和反政府示威活动，是波匈事件的组成部分之一。
description.en: Massive strikes and anti-government demonstrations by the public in the Polish city of Poznań in June 1956, which were part of the Polish and Hungarian incidents.

description.zh-cn: 1956年10月在波兰人民共和国发生的标志着“去斯大林化”的政治变革，是波匈事件的组成部分之一。
description.en: A political change in the Polish People's Republic in October 1956 that marked the beginning of de-Stalinization, and was part of the Polish and Hungarian incidents.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年至三国时期曹魏的将领，原属马超，后为曹操部将。在樊城之战中与于禁一同被击败，后被关羽俘虏，因拒不投降而被杀。
description.en: A general of Cao Wei during the late Eastern Han dynasty and Three Kingdoms period. Originally serving under Ma Chao, he later became a general for Cao Cao. During the Battle of Fancheng, he was defeated alongside Yu Jin and later captured by Guan Yu, then executed after refusing to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 汉代高级将军职位。219年，刘备称汉中王后，拜关羽为前将军。
description.en: A high-ranking general position in the Han Dynasty. In 219 AD, after Liu Bei declared himself King of Hanzhong, he appointed Guan Yu as General of the Front.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期的一个州，为兵家必争的战略要地。关羽长期负责镇守该地，最终也在此地败亡。
description.en: A province during the Eastern Han Dynasty, a strategic location coveted by all warlords. Guan Yu was in charge of its defense for a long period and was ultimately defeated and killed there.

description.zh-cn: 一家跨国传媒和信息公司。
description.en: A multinational media and information firm.

description.zh-cn: 统治神圣罗马帝国、西班牙帝国及奥地利等地的欧洲王室，是三十年战争中天主教阵营的核心力量。
description.en: A European royal house that ruled the Holy Roman Empire, the Spanish Empire, Austria, and other territories, forming the core of the Catholic camp in the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 北欧强国，在三十年战争中是反哈布斯堡联盟的主要军事力量，战后崛起为欧洲强权。
description.en: A major Northern European power that was the main military force of the anti-Habsburg coalition in the Thirty Years' War and rose as a great European power after the war.

description.zh-cn: 北欧国家，为控制波罗的海沿岸的德意志诸侯国而介入三十年战争，领导了战争的“丹麦阶段”。
description.en: A Nordic country that intervened in the Thirty Years' War to control the German states along the Baltic coast, leading the 'Danish Phase' of the war.

zh-cn: 斐迪南二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝、哈布斯堡王朝成员。其在波希米亚推行的反新教政策直接引发了三十年战争。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor and a member of the House of Habsburg. His anti-Protestant policies in Bohemia directly triggered the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典国王，卓越的军事统帅。他领导瑞典介入三十年战争，取得了一系列辉煌胜利，但在吕岑会战中阵亡。
description.en: King of Sweden and an outstanding military commander. He led Sweden's intervention in the Thirty Years' War, achieving a series of brilliant victories, but was killed in action at the Battle of Lützen.

zh-cn: 阿尔布雷希特·冯·华伦斯坦

description.zh-cn: 波希米亚贵族和军事统帅，三十年战争期间帝国军队总司令。后因功高震主被皇帝斐迪南二世下令刺杀。
description.en: A Bohemian nobleman and military commander, commander-in-chief of the imperial armies during the Thirty Years' War. He was later assassinated on the orders of Emperor Ferdinand II due to his immense power and influence.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王路易十三的首席大臣。他主导法国的外交政策，以国家利益为先，支持新教国家对抗哈布斯堡王朝。
description.en: Chief minister to King Louis XIII of France. He guided French foreign policy, prioritizing national interests by supporting Protestant states against the House of Habsburg.

description.zh-cn: 波希米亚新教徒将两名帝国钦差扔出王宫窗外，此事件是波希米亚起义的开端，也是三十年战争的直接导火索。
description.en: Bohemian Protestants threw two imperial governors out of a castle window. This event marked the beginning of the Bohemian Revolt and was the direct trigger of the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 三十年战争的第一个阶段，由波希米亚地区人民反抗哈布斯堡王朝的民族及宗教起义。
description.en: The first phase of the Thirty Years' War, an ethnic and religious uprising by the people of Bohemia against the Habsburg dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 三十年战争早期的一场决定性战役，天主教同盟军在此击败波希米亚起义军，导致波希米亚叛乱失败。
description.en: A decisive early battle in the Thirty Years' War where the Catholic League forces defeated the Bohemian rebels, leading to the failure of the Bohemian Revolt.

description.zh-cn: 三十年战争中的一场关键战役。瑞典军队获胜，但其国王及主帅古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫阵亡。
description.en: A key battle in the Thirty Years' War. The Swedish army was victorious, but its king and commander, Gustavus Adolphus, was killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 一场在三十年战争后期爆发并延续至战后的冲突，主要交战方为法国和西班牙。此战确立了法国的欧洲霸主地位。
description.en: A conflict that broke out in the later stages of the Thirty Years' War and continued after it, primarily between France and Spain. This war established France's dominance in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 由德意志天主教诸侯组成的军事联盟，在三十年战争初期是哈布斯堡皇帝的重要支持力量。
description.en: A military alliance of German Catholic states that was a crucial supporter of the Habsburg Emperor in the early stages of the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 丹麦和挪威国王。他领导丹麦介入三十年战争，开启了战争的“丹麦阶段”，但最终被帝国军队击败。
description.en: King of Denmark and Norway. He led Denmark's intervention in the Thirty Years' War, initiating the 'Danish Phase' of the war, but was ultimately defeated by the Imperial army.

description.zh-cn: 普法尔茨选帝侯，新教联盟领袖。在波希米亚起义期间被选为波希米亚国王，但在白山战役后被迫流亡，被称为“冬日国王”。
description.en: Elector Palatine and leader of the Protestant Union. He was elected King of Bohemia during the Bohemian Revolt but was forced into exile after the Battle of White Mountain, earning him the nickname 'the Winter King'.

description.zh-cn: 香港的政治派别，其成员及支持者使用“土共”、“支共”等贬称来称呼中国共产党及其支持者。
description.en: A political faction in Hong Kong whose members and supporters use derogatory terms like 'Local Commies' and 'Chinazi Commies' to refer to the Chinese Communist Party and its supporters.

description.zh-cn: 历史学者，提出“驱除马列，恢复中华”的口号，延续了蒋中正的反共思想。
description.en: A historian who proposed the slogan 'Expel Marxism-Leninism, Restore China', continuing the anti-communist thought of Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 清末新军的编制单位之一，驻扎在南京。
description.en: One of the divisions of the New Army in the late Qing Dynasty, stationed in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 由林述庆等人于1912年发起的政治团体。
description.en: A political group initiated by Lin Shuqing and others in 1912.

description.zh-cn: 清末官员，曾任宣统帝溥仪的老师（太傅）。他也是张勋复辟的参与者，曾与张勋等召开“御前会议”，并被任命为内阁议政大臣。
description.en: An official of the late Qing dynasty who served as the tutor (Grand Tutor) to Emperor Xuantong (Puyi). He was also a participant in Zhang Xun's restoration, having convened a 'Royal Conference' with Zhang Xun and others, and was appointed as a Cabinet Minister.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统蔡英文及赖清德政府时期对海峡两岸关系的论述，强调中华民国与中华人民共和国互不隶属。
description.en: A discourse on cross-strait relations during the administrations of ROC Presidents Tsai Ing-wen and Lai Ching-te, emphasizing that the Republic of China and the People's Republic of China are not subordinate to each other.

zh-cn: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安

description.zh-cn: 土耳其政治人物，现任土耳其总统。他推动了多项政策，包括更改国名、应对2016年未遂政变以及接收叙利亚难民。
description.en: A Turkish politician serving as the current President of Turkey. He has driven various policies, including the country's name change, the response to the 2016 coup attempt, and the acceptance of Syrian refugees.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其共和国的立法机构。于1922年废除奥斯曼苏丹国，并在2017年通过宪法修正案实行总统制。
description.en: The legislative body of the Republic of Turkey. It abolished the Ottoman Sultanate in 1922 and passed constitutional amendments in 2017 to implement a presidential system.

zh-cn: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克

description.zh-cn: 土耳其共和国的国父和首任总统，领导土耳其国民运动和独立战争，并推行了一系列旨在建立世俗共和国的改革。
description.en: The founding father and first President of the Republic of Turkey. He led the Turkish National Movement and the War of Independence and implemented a series of reforms to establish a secular republic.

description.zh-cn: 一份和平条约，该条约的签署使得国际社会承认新成立的土耳其共和国为奥斯曼帝国的合法继承国，并规定了希腊和土耳其的人口交换。
description.en: A peace treaty whose signing led to international recognition of the newly founded Republic of Turkey as the legal successor state of the Ottoman Empire and stipulated a population exchange between Greece and Turkey.

description.zh-cn: 由穆斯塔法·凯末尔领导的军事和政治运动，旨在反抗《色佛尔条约》的条款，并最终建立了土耳其共和国。
description.en: A military and political campaign led by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk to challenge the terms of the Treaty of Sèvres, ultimately leading to the establishment of the Republic of Turkey.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战后协约国与奥斯曼帝国签订的和平条约，旨在瓜分奥斯曼帝国，但其条款遭到土耳其国民运动的抵制。
description.en: A peace treaty signed between the Allied Powers and the Ottoman Empire after World War I, which aimed to partition the empire but was resisted by the Turkish National Movement.

description.zh-cn: 由穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克推行的一系列激进改革，旨在将奥斯曼-土耳其国家转变为一个新的世俗共和国。
description.en: A series of radical reforms implemented by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk aimed at transforming the old Ottoman-Turkish state into a new, secular republic.

description.zh-cn: 一个库尔德分离主义组织，自1984年以来一直针对土耳其政府发动叛乱，被土耳其视为恐怖组织。
description.en: A Kurdish separatist organization that has been waging an insurgency against the Turkish government since 1984 and is considered a terrorist organization by Turkey.

description.zh-cn: 由土耳其军方内部派系发动的一场未遂政变，企图推翻总统埃尔多安但以失败告终。
description.en: A failed coup d'état attempt by a faction within the Turkish Armed Forces to overthrow President Erdoğan.

zh-cn: 2019年土耳其在叙利亚东北部的攻势

description.zh-cn: 土耳其在美国从叙利亚库尔德地区撤军后发起的军事行动，旨在打击当地的库尔德民兵。
description.en: A military operation launched by Turkey after the U.S. withdrawal from Syrian Kurdish areas, aimed at targeting local Kurdish militias.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其人口最多的少数民族，与土耳其政府存在长期的矛盾和冲突。
description.en: The largest ethnic minority in Turkey, with a long history of conflict with the Turkish government.

en: Refugees of the Syrian civil war

description.zh-cn: 因叙利亚内战而流离失所的群体，土耳其是接收该群体最多的国家。
description.en: A group of people displaced by the Syrian Civil War, with Turkey being the largest host country.

zh-cn: 凯末尔·克勒奇达尔奥卢

description.zh-cn: 土耳其政治人物，曾任反对派领导人。在2023年土耳其大选中，他批评埃尔多安的难民政策，并承诺若当选将遣返所有难民。
description.en: A Turkish politician and former opposition leader. In the 2023 Turkish general election, he criticized Erdoğan's refugee policy and promised to repatriate all refugees if elected.

zh-cn: 2015年土耳其击落俄罗斯战斗机事件

description.zh-cn: 土耳其军方击落一架俄罗斯战斗机的事件，导致土俄关系大幅恶化。
description.en: An incident where the Turkish military shot down a Russian fighter jet, causing a significant deterioration in Turkey-Russia relations.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其共和国的武装力量，由陆军、海军和空军组成。曾在2015年击落俄罗斯战斗机，并在2016年发生未遂政变。
description.en: The military forces of the Republic of Turkey, consisting of the Army, Navy, and Air Force. It was involved in the 2015 shootdown of a Russian fighter jet and experienced a failed coup attempt in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 明代女真族三大部之一。
description.en: One of the three major Jurchen tribes during the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明代女真族三大部之一。
description.en: One of the three major Jurchen tribes during the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 辽金时代的部落，为完颜部附庸，建州女真的主要组成部分。
description.en: A tribal confederation during the Liao and Jin dynasties, a vassal of the Wanyan tribe, and a major component of the Jianzhou Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 建州女真的重要部落，元代为胡里改万户府，明初南迁归附明朝。
description.en: An important tribe of the Jianzhou Jurchens, known as the Huligai Wanhu Fu in the Yuan Dynasty. It migrated south and submitted to the Ming Dynasty in the early Ming period.

description.zh-cn: 建州女真的重要部落，猛哥帖木儿为其首领，元代为斡朵里万户府，明初南迁归附明朝。
description.en: An important tribe of the Jianzhou Jurchens, led by Möngke Temür. It was known as the Odoli Wanhu Fu during the Yuan Dynasty and migrated south to submit to the Ming Dynasty in the early Ming period.

description.zh-cn: 元朝设立的行中书省，管辖包括女真地区在内的中国东北部。
description.en: A province (branch secretariat) established by the Yuan Dynasty, which administered northeastern China, including the Jurchen territories.

description.zh-cn: 胡里改部酋长，明初率部归附明朝。
description.en: Chieftain of the Huligai tribe who led his people to submit to the Ming Dynasty in the early Ming period.

description.zh-cn: 斡朵里部酋长，爱新觉罗氏先祖，明初率部归附明朝。
description.en: Chieftain of the Odoli tribe, an ancestor of the Aisin Gioro clan, who led his people to submit to the Ming Dynasty in the early Ming period.

zh-cn: 努尔哈赤统一建州女真之战

description.zh-cn: 由努尔哈赤发动的一系列旨在统一建州女真各部的战争。
description.en: A series of wars launched by Nurhaci aimed at unifying the various tribes of the Jianzhou Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 建州女真八部之一。
description.en: One of the eight tribes of the Jianzhou Jurchens.

location.zh-cn: 今苏子河与浑河合流处一带
location.en: The area where the Suzi and Hun rivers converge

description.zh-cn: 建州女真八部之一。
description.en: One of the eight tribes of the Jianzhou Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 建州女真八部之一。
description.en: One of the eight tribes of the Jianzhou Jurchens.

description.zh-cn: 清朝皇室姓氏，满族的一个氏族。
description.en: The imperial clan of the Qing Dynasty, a Manchu clan.

en: Zhu Yiling, Prince Jing of Ming

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗与孝懿庄皇后的次子，早夭，被追封为靖悼王。
description.en: The second son of Emperor Muzong and Empress Xiaoyizhuang, who died in infancy and was posthumously named Prince Jingdao.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗与孝懿庄皇后的长女，早夭。
description.en: The eldest daughter of Emperor Muzong and Empress Xiaoyizhuang, who died in infancy.

description.zh-cn: 明朝北直隶顺天府下辖的州，为孝懿庄皇后出生地。
description.en: A zhou (prefecture) under Shuntian Prefecture, North Zhili, during the Ming Dynasty, and the birthplace of Empress Xiaoyizhuang.

description.zh-cn: 台湾旅日法政学者，台湾独立建国联盟成员，《台湾共和国宪法草案》的撰写者。
description.en: A Taiwanese legal and political scholar based in Japan, a member of the World United Formosans for Independence, and the author of the 'Draft Constitution of the Republic of Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾社会运动参与者，在郑南榕出殡游行期间，于总统府前自焚身亡，以示抗议。
description.en: A Taiwanese social movement participant who self-immolated in front of the Presidential Office Building during Cheng Nan-jung's funeral procession as a form of protest.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国为纪念郑南榕舍身捍卫言论自由而设立的纪念日，定于其逝世日4月7日。
description.en: A commemorative day established by the Republic of China to honor Cheng Nan-jung's sacrifice in defense of freedom of speech, observed on April 7th, the anniversary of his death.

description.zh-cn: 《自由时代周刊》的共同创办人之一，担任发行人。
description.en: One of the co-founders of Freedom Era Weekly, serving as its publisher.

en: Period of mobilization for the suppression of communist rebellion

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府在台湾实施的长期军事戒严时期，该时期的政治高压是郑南榕等党外运动人士抗争的主要背景。
description.en: A long period of martial law implemented by the ROC government in Taiwan. The political repression of this era was the primary context for the resistance of Tangwai movement activists like Cheng Nan-jung.

description.zh-cn: 台湾自由主义思想家，其著作对郑南榕产生重要影响。郑南榕在大学时期曾每周拜访当时遭软禁监视的殷海光。
description.en: A Taiwanese liberal thinker whose writings had a significant impact on Cheng Nan-jung. During his university years, Cheng visited Yin weekly while Yin was under house arrest and surveillance.

description.zh-cn: 由郑南榕等人发起的反戒严抗议活动，要求国民党政府废除长达36年的戒严令。
description.en: An anti-martial law protest initiated by Cheng Nan-jung and others, demanding the KMT government abolish the 36-year-long martial law decree.

description.zh-cn: 由郑南榕、陈永兴、李胜雄等人共同创立的团体，旨在推动二二八事件的真相调查与平反工作。
description.en: An organization co-founded by Cheng Nan-jung, Chen Yung-hsing, and Lee Sheng-hsiung, aimed at promoting the investigation and redress of the February 28 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 台湾人权运动者，与郑南榕共同创立“二二八和平日促进会”并担任会长。
description.en: A Taiwanese human rights activist who co-founded the '228 Peace Day Promotion Association' with Cheng Nan-jung and served as its president.

description.zh-cn: 台湾社会运动者，与郑南榕共同推动“台湾新国家运动”。
description.en: A Taiwanese social activist who jointly promoted the 'New Taiwan Nation Movement' with Cheng Nan-jung.

description.zh-cn: 上海报业集团在上海出版的一份综合性报纸，以知识分子为主要读者对象，以文化、人文领域为主要报道内容。
description.en: A comprehensive newspaper published by Shanghai United Media Group in Shanghai, targeting intellectuals with a focus on culture and humanities.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》的创办人之一，爱国人士。
description.en: One of the founders of Wenhui Bao, a patriot.

description.zh-cn: 中国著名报人，曾任《文汇报》社长兼总编辑。

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国在1950年代对民族资本主义工商业进行社会主义改造的政策。

description.zh-cn: 一部中国话剧，1978年在上海上演时，《文汇报》的报道使其产生了全国影响。
description.en: A Chinese play, whose national impact was generated by Wenhui Bao's reporting when it was staged in Shanghai in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 由《文汇报》创办的报刊，后并入《文汇报》成为专版。

description.zh-cn: 由《文汇报》设立的出版社。

description.zh-cn: 上海报业集团旗下的新媒体平台，整合了文汇报的客户端等资源。
