description.zh-cn: 中华民国陆军一级上将。时任总统李登辉意图将其晋升为一级上将，但遭到时任行政院长郝柏村的强烈反对与拒绝副署，此事加剧了李郝二人的矛盾。
description.en: A General of the Army in the Republic of China Army. Then-President Lee Teng-hui intended to promote him to General of the Army, but faced strong opposition and refusal to countersign from then-Premier Hau Pei-tsun, an incident that intensified the conflict between Lee and Hau.

zh-cn: 多器官功能障碍综合征

description.zh-cn: 导致郝柏村逝世的直接原因。
description.en: The direct cause of Hau Pei-tsun's death.

description.zh-cn: 万毅的配偶。
description.en: Spouse of Wan Yi.

description.zh-cn: 东北军将领，曾怀疑并关押万毅。后与日军达成密约，万毅发动“九二二锄奸”时逃脱。
description.en: A general in the Northeastern Army who suspected and imprisoned Wan Yi. He later made a secret pact with the Japanese army and escaped when Wan Yi launched the 'September 22nd Elimination of Traitors' incident.

description.zh-cn: 东北军111师师长，与万毅一同发动“九二二锄奸”，后率部投奔共产党。
description.en: Commander of the 111th Division of the Northeastern Army, who launched the 'September 22nd Elimination of Traitors' incident with Wan Yi and later led his troops to defect to the Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 东北军57军副军长，因参与同日军讲和而被万毅在“九二二锄奸”中扣押。
description.en: Deputy commander of the 57th Army of the Northeastern Army, who was detained by Wan Yi during the 'September 22nd Elimination of Traitors' incident for his involvement in peace talks with the Japanese.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾与常恩多共同发动东北军111师起义，后任万毅的副手。
description.en: A general of the PLA who, along with Chang Enduo, initiated the uprising of the 111th Division of the Northeastern Army and later served as Wan Yi's deputy.

description.zh-cn: 位于辽宁省大连市的市辖区，是万毅的出生地。
description.en: A municipal district of Dalian, Liaoning Province, and the birthplace of Wan Yi.

description.zh-cn: 位于浙江省沿海的岛屿，是1955年一江山岛战役的发生地。
description.en: An island off the coast of Zhejiang province, the site of the Battle of Yijiangshan Islands in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 一江山岛战役后由美国国会通过的法案，授权美国总统使用武力保护台湾。
description.en: A resolution passed by the U.S. Congress after the Battle of Yijiangshan Islands, authorizing the U.S. President to use force to protect Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国海军的护航驱逐舰，在一江山岛战役前夕被解放军海军鱼雷艇击沉。
description.en: A destroyer escort of the Republic of China Navy, sunk by PLA Navy torpedo boats on the eve of the Battle of Yijiangshan Islands.

zh-cn: 中央地方共建国家级博物馆

description.zh-cn: 由中华人民共和国国家文物局和财政部共同认定，中央和省级人民政府联合共建的一批地方所属重点博物馆。
description.en: A group of key local museums in the People's Republic of China, jointly designated by the National Cultural Heritage Administration and the Ministry of Finance, and co-constructed by the central and provincial governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海市的大型中国古代艺术博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A large museum of ancient Chinese art located in Shanghai, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于江苏省南京市的大型综合性历史与艺术类博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A large comprehensive museum of history and art located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖南省长沙市的大型历史艺术类博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A large museum of history and art located in Changsha, Hunan Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于河南省郑州市的综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A comprehensive museum located in Zhengzhou, Henan Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于陕西省西安市的大型现代化国家级博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A large modern national-level museum located in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于湖北省武汉市的综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A comprehensive museum located in Wuhan, Hubei Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于辽宁省沈阳市的大型综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A large comprehensive museum located in Shenyang, Liaoning Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于浙江省杭州市的综合性人文科学博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A comprehensive museum of humanities and sciences located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于重庆市的综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A comprehensive museum located in Chongqing, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

zh-cn: 首都博物馆（大运河博物馆）

description.zh-cn: 位于北京市的大型综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A large comprehensive museum located in Beijing, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于山西省太原市的综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A comprehensive museum located in Taiyuan, Shanxi Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于河北省石家庄市的省级综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A provincial comprehensive museum located in Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于山东省济南市的省级综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A provincial comprehensive museum located in Jinan, Shandong Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于广东省广州市的省级综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A provincial comprehensive museum located in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 位于四川省成都市的省级综合性博物馆，是中央地方共建国家级博物馆之一。
description.en: A provincial comprehensive museum located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, one of the national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国金融人物，汉族。现任中国民生银行董事长，曾任中国银行副行长，为第十三届全国政协委员。
description.en: A financial figure from the People's Republic of China, of Han ethnicity. He is the current chairman of China Minsheng Bank, a former vice president of Bank of China, and a member of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆第一家由民间资本设立的全国性商业银行。高迎欣自2020年起担任该行董事长。
description.en: The first national commercial bank in mainland China established by non-state-owned capital. Gao Yingxin has been its chairman since 2020.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国陕西省中部的平原，是郑国渠和白渠的主要灌溉区域。
description.en: A plain in the central part of Shaanxi Province, China, and the main irrigation area for the Zheng Guo Canal and Bai Canal.

description.zh-cn: 渭河的最大支流，郑国渠和白渠的水源。
description.en: The largest tributary of the Wei River, and the water source for the Zheng Guo Canal and Bai Canal.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时期，在汉武帝治下由白公提议修建的灌溉渠道，位于郑国渠之南，引泾水灌溉农田。
description.en: An irrigation canal built during the Western Han Dynasty under Emperor Wu, proposed by Bai Gong. It is located south of the Zheng Guo Canal and diverts water from the Jing River to irrigate farmland.

description.zh-cn: 西汉赵国中大夫，向汉武帝提议修建白渠。
description.en: A Grand Master of the Household from the state of Zhao during the Western Han Dynasty, who proposed the construction of the Bai Canal to Emperor Wu.

zh-cn: 李伟 (北京市人大常委会主任)
中国共产党永州市委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在湖南省永州市的领导机关。
description.en: The leading organ of the Communist Party of China in Yongzhou, Hunan Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党永州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党永州市委员会副书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Deputy Secretary of the Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党永州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党永州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党永州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党永州市委员会书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 明朝景泰朝内阁首辅，在夺门之变中投降，后被罢官充军。
description.en: The Senior Grand Secretary of the Cabinet during the Jingtai era of the Ming dynasty. He surrendered during the Duomen Incident and was later dismissed and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗朱祁镇复辟后使用的年号。
description.en: The era name used by Emperor Yingzong of Ming, Zhu Qizhen, after his restoration.

description.zh-cn: 明朝都督，夺门之变的主要参与者之一。
description.en: A Commander of the Ming dynasty, one of the main participants in the Duomen Incident.

description.zh-cn: 明朝太常卿，夺门之变的主要参与者之一。
description.en: The Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices of the Ming dynasty, one of the main participants in the Duomen Incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，石破茂之父。曾任建设事务次官及鸟取县知事。
description.en: Japanese politician, father of Shigeru Ishiba. He served as Vice-Minister of Construction and Governor of Tottori Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 日本的主要银行之一，石破茂在进入政界前曾在此工作。
description.en: One of the major banks in Japan, where Shigeru Ishiba worked before entering politics.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物，新进党的党首，石破茂曾因对他失望而回归自民党。
description.en: Japanese politician, leader of the New Frontier Party, with whom Shigeru Ishiba was disappointed, leading to Ishiba's return to the LDP.

description.zh-cn: 1990年代存在的日本政党，由小泽一郎领导。石破茂曾短暂加入该党。
description.en: A Japanese political party that existed in the 1990s, led by Ichirō Ozawa. Shigeru Ishiba briefly joined this party.

description.zh-cn: 日本自由民主党的党内选举，石破茂在该次选举中获胜，成为新任总裁。
description.en: An internal election of Japan's Liberal Democratic Party, in which Shigeru Ishiba won and became the new president.

description.zh-cn: 日本东京都的特别区之一，是石破茂的出生地。
description.en: A special ward of Tokyo, Japan, and the birthplace of Shigeru Ishiba.

description.zh-cn: 位于日本中国地方的县，是石破茂的成长地和政治选区。
description.en: A prefecture in the Chūgoku region of Japan, where Shigeru Ishiba grew up and which is his political constituency.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治人物。在石破茂担任自民党总裁期间任干事长。
description.en: Japanese politician. Served as Secretary-General of the LDP when Shigeru Ishiba was President.

description.zh-cn: 日本自由民主党总裁选举，石破茂在第二轮投票中败于安倍晋三。
description.en: The LDP presidential election where Shigeru Ishiba was defeated by Shinzo Abe in the second round of voting.

description.zh-cn: 日本自由民主党总裁选举，石破茂败于麻生太郎。
description.en: The LDP presidential election where Shigeru Ishiba was defeated by Tarō Asō.

description.zh-cn: 巴西极右翼政治人物，巴西第38任总统，在2022年巴西大选中被卢拉击败。
description.en: A Brazilian far-right politician who served as the 38th President of Brazil and was defeated by Lula in the 2022 Brazilian general election.

description.zh-cn: 巴西政治人物，巴西第36任总统。在卢拉首任总统期间，她曾担任其幕僚长（民政院首席部长），后接替卢拉成为总统。
description.en: A Brazilian politician who served as the 36th President of Brazil. During Lula's first presidency, she was his Chief of Staff and later succeeded him as president.

description.zh-cn: 巴西联邦法官，因在“洗车行动”腐败调查中主导对卢拉的审判并将其定罪而闻名。后在博索纳罗政府中担任司法和公共安全部长。
description.en: A Brazilian federal judge known for presiding over the trial of Lula and convicting him in the 'Operation Car Wash' corruption investigation. He later served as Minister of Justice and Public Security in the Bolsonaro administration.

description.zh-cn: 巴西的一个左翼政党，由卢拉及其他工会领袖、学者和知识分子于1980年创立。
description.en: A left-wing political party in Brazil, founded in 1980 by Lula and other trade union leaders, academics, and intellectuals.

description.zh-cn: 巴西一项自2014年开始的大规模反腐败调查，导致包括前总统卢拉在内的多名政商界人士被调查和定罪。
description.en: A massive anti-corruption investigation in Brazil that began in 2014, leading to the investigation and conviction of numerous political and business figures, including former President Lula.

description.zh-cn: 巴西的最高司法机关，拥有最终解释宪法的权力。
description.en: The highest judicial body in Brazil, with the power of final interpretation of the Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 巴西于2022年10月举行的总统选举。卢拉在该选举的第二轮投票中击败时任总统博索纳罗，赢得其第三个总统任期。
description.en: The presidential election held in Brazil in October 2022. Lula defeated the incumbent president, Jair Bolsonaro, in the second round of voting to win his third presidential term.

zh-cn: 2023年巴西三权广场遭冲击事件
2023年巴西国民议会遭冲击事件

description.zh-cn: 在卢拉就任总统后，时任前总统博索纳罗的支持者冲击了位于巴西利亚三权广场的最高法院、国会和普拉纳托宫，以表达对选举结果的不满。
description.en: Following Lula's inauguration, supporters of the former president Jair Bolsonaro stormed the Supreme Court, National Congress, and Planalto Palace in Brasília's Three Powers Plaza to protest the election results.

zh-cn: 巴西军人独裁统治时期

description.zh-cn: 指1964年至1985年期间，巴西由军政府实行独裁统治的时期。卢拉在此期间是反对军政府的工人运动的主要组织者之一。
description.en: Refers to the period from 1964 to 1985 when Brazil was under a military dictatorship. Lula was one of the main organizers of the labor movement against the military government during this time.

zh-cn: 联合国人权事务委员会

description.zh-cn: 联合国负责监督《公民权利及政治权利国际公约》落实情况的机构。该委员会认定对卢拉的起诉侵犯了其合法权利。
description.en: The UN body that monitors the implementation of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights. The committee found that the prosecution of Lula violated his legal rights.

description.zh-cn: 由港督麦理浩于1972年提出的公共房屋计划，旨在解决香港市民的居住问题，并直接推动了新界新市镇的发展。
description.en: A public housing program proposed by Governor MacLehose in 1972 to address the housing needs of Hong Kong's population, which directly drove the development of new towns in the New Territories.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府发展局辖下的部门。其前身新界拓展署于1973年成立，负责执行新界的大规模发展计划。
description.en: A department under the Development Bureau of the Hong Kong SAR Government. Its predecessor, the New Territories Development Department, was established in 1973 to implement large-scale development plans in the New Territories.

description.zh-cn: 第12任香港总督，负责接管新界，并决定了对新界的间接管治方针。
description.en: The 12th Governor of Hong Kong, who was responsible for taking over the New Territories and decided on the policy of indirect rule for the area.

description.zh-cn: 香港辅政司，其关于新界的报告影响了英国对该地区的早期管治政策。
description.en: Colonial Secretary of Hong Kong, whose report on the New Territories influenced early British governance policies in the region.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代行政区划，秦朝时管辖范围包括今天的新界地区。
description.en: An ancient administrative division in China. During the Qin dynasty, its jurisdiction included the area of the modern New Territories.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国吉林省吉林市下辖县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Jilin City, Jilin Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任吉林市市长。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, former Mayor of Jilin City.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任吉林市市长。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, former Mayor of Jilin City.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共吉林市委书记。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, former Secretary of the Jilin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共吉林市委书记。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, former Secretary of the Jilin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军上将，现任中国人民解放军信息支援部队政治委员。
description.en: A general in the PLA Ground Force, currently serving as the Political Commissar of the PLA Information Support Force.

zh-cn: 纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利80周年大会

description.zh-cn: 纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利80周年的大会，解放军信息支援部队在此次活动上首次公开亮相。
description.en: A conference commemorating the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, where the PLA Information Support Force made its first public appearance.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任总参四部副部长及部长。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who served as deputy head and later head of the Fourth Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任总参四部副部长。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who served as deputy head of the Fourth Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任总参四部政委。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who served as the Political Commissar of the Fourth Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任总参电子对抗雷达部部长。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who served as the head of the General Staff's Electronic Countermeasure and Radar Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任总参电子对抗雷达部副部长。
description.en: A general of the People's Liberation Army who served as the deputy head of the General Staff's Electronic Countermeasure and Radar Department.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国军事编制

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军的组织级别之一。
description.en: An organizational grade level within the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 中国马克思主义经济学家，原名薛萼果。曾任中国国家统计局副局长、中国科学院经济研究所所长等职。因其经济学观点在文化大革命期间入狱。
description.en: A Chinese Marxist economist, originally named Xue Eguo. He served as Deputy Director of the National Bureau of Statistics of China and Director of the Institute of Economics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. He was imprisoned during the Cultural Revolution for his economic views.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，曾指导孙冶方掌握经济研究和调查的方法。
description.en: A Chinese scholar who guided Sun Yefang in mastering methods of economic research and investigation.

en: National Bureau of Statistics of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院的直属机构，孙冶方曾任副局长。
description.en: A direct subordinate institution of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, where Sun Yefang served as deputy director.

description.zh-cn: 《红旗》杂志人员，《生产价格论》的作者之一。
description.en: A staff member of 'Red Flag' magazine and one of the authors of 'On the Price of Production'.

description.zh-cn: 《红旗》杂志人员，《生产价格论》的作者之一。
description.en: A staff member of 'Red Flag' magazine and one of the authors of 'On the Price of Production'.

description.zh-cn: 民族资本家，孙冶方的兄长。
description.en: A national capitalist and the elder brother of Sun Yefang.

zh-cn: 苏联社会主义经济问题
en: Economic Problems of Socialism in the USSR

description.zh-cn: 斯大林的经济学著作，孙冶方是第一个对其提出系统质疑的中国经济学家。
description.en: An economic work by Stalin; Sun Yefang was the first Chinese economist to systematically question it.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，发起成立孙冶方经济学基金会。
description.en: A Chinese economist who initiated the establishment of the Sun Yefang Economic Science Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中共绵阳市委书记。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Party Secretary of Mianyang.

description.zh-cn: 中国唯一的核武器研制生产单位，主体坐落于四川绵阳。
description.en: China's sole nuclear weapons research, development, and production unit, with its main body located in Mianyang, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市下辖县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Mianyang City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市下辖市辖区，绵阳市政府所在地。
description.en: A municipal district under the jurisdiction of Mianyang City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, and the seat of the Mianyang Municipal Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市下辖市辖区。
description.en: A municipal district under the jurisdiction of Mianyang City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国四川省绵阳市下辖市辖区。
description.en: A municipal district under the jurisdiction of Mianyang City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China.

en: Southwest University of Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 位于四川省绵阳市的综合性大学。

description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army, serving as the commander of the Reorganized 66th Division at the time. He was captured in the Battle of Yangshanji.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领，鲁西南战役时任国民党军增援兵团司令，战后被撤职。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army, who served as the commander of the KMT reinforcement corps during the Southwestern Shandong Campaign and was dismissed after the battle.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领，鲁西南战役后被撤职查办。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army, who was dismissed and investigated after the Southwestern Shandong Campaign.

zh-cn: 国民革命军第六十六军

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军的精锐部队之一，属陈诚土木系，在鲁西南战役羊山集战斗中被全歼。
description.en: One of the elite units of the National Revolutionary Army, part of Chen Cheng's Civil Engineering Clique, which was annihilated in the Battle of Yangshanji during the Southwestern Shandong Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间国民革命军的部队，在鲁西南战役六营集战斗中被全歼。
description.en: A unit of the National Revolutionary Army during the second Chinese Civil War, annihilated in the Battle of Liuyingji during the Southwestern Shandong Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 一种外交政策，主张国家应尽量避免与他国建立军事、政治或经济联盟和关系。第一次世界大战后美国奉行此政策，为苏日两国蚕食中国提供了机会。
description.en: A foreign policy advocating that a nation should avoid military, political, or economic alliances and relations with other countries. The United States pursued this policy after World War I, which provided an opportunity for the Soviet Union and Japan to encroach on China.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战后，成为苏联和日本瓜分和蚕食的目标地区之一。
description.en: After World War I, it became one of the target areas for division and encroachment by the Soviet Union and Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社核心成员，“十三太保”之一。
description.en: A core member of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation, one of the "Thirteen Taibao."

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社核心成员，“十三太保”之一。
description.en: A core member of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation, one of the "Thirteen Taibao."

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社核心成员，“十三太保”之一，负责别动总队，并担任革命青年同志会书记。
description.en: A core member of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation, one of the "Thirteen Taibao," responsible for the Special Action Main Squad, and served as the secretary of the Revolutionary Youth Comrades Association.

description.zh-cn: 中国传统社会中的秘密社会组织。中华民族复兴社设立忠勇救国会以影响其成员。
description.en: Secret societies in traditional Chinese society. The Revival Society of the Chinese Nation established the Loyal and Brave National Salvation Society to influence its members.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社出版的杂志之一。
description.en: One of the magazines published by the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党内部的政治派系，与中华民族复兴社发生矛盾。
description.en: A political faction within the Kuomintang that came into conflict with the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation.

en: Three Principles of the People Youth Corps

description.zh-cn: 1938年成立的组织，吸收了中华民族复兴社解散后的大部分成员。
description.en: An organization established in 1938 that absorbed most of the members of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation after its dissolution.

birth_place.zh-cn: 中国医科大学附属第四医院
birth_place.en: The Fourth Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University

description.zh-cn: 商人，前中国国务院总理李鹏的次子。曾任武警安亚技术开发公司董事长、武警水电指挥部政治部副主任，拥有上校军衔。后因卷入新国大诈骗案，移民新加坡并成为该国公民。
description.en: A businessman and the second son of former Chinese Premier Li Peng. He served as the chairman of the Armed Police Anya Technology Development Company and the deputy director of the Political Department of the Armed Police Hydropower Command, holding the rank of colonel. He later immigrated to Singapore and became a citizen after being implicated in the New Guoda fraud case.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇的妻子，香港滑冰联盟主席，新四军将领叶挺的孙女。
description.en: Wife of Li Xiaoyong, President of the Hong Kong Skating Union, and granddaughter of the New Fourth Army General Ye Ting.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇和叶小燕的女儿。
description.en: Daughter of Li Xiaoyong and Ye Xiaoyan.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺的儿子，叶小燕的父亲。
description.en: Son of Ye Ting and father of Ye Xiaoyan.

zh-cn: 中国医科大学附属第四医院
en: The Fourth Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University

description.zh-cn: 位于沈阳市的一家医院，前身为沈阳铁路局沈阳医院。是李小勇的出生地。
description.en: A hospital in Shenyang, formerly known as Shenyang Hospital of the Shenyang Railway Bureau. It is the birthplace of Li Xiaoyong.

zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队水电部队

description.zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队的一个单位。
description.en: A unit of the Chinese People's Armed Police Force.

en: Death and state funeral of Kim Il Sung

description.zh-cn: 金日成因突发心脏病逝世。据称，其病发与听闻战友赵明选上将病故后情绪激动有关。
description.en: Kim Il-sung passed away due to a sudden heart attack. His attack was reportedly triggered by emotional distress after hearing about the death of his comrade, General Cho Myong-son.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，曾在夏尔·戴高乐总统任内担任总理。
description.en: French politician who served as Prime Minister under President Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，曾在夏尔·戴高乐总统任内担任总理，后接替戴高乐成为法国总统。
description.en: French politician who served as Prime Minister under President Charles de Gaulle and later succeeded him as President of France.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，曾在夏尔·戴高乐总统任内担任总理。
description.en: French politician who served as Prime Minister under President Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，法兰西第四共和国最后一任总统，其总统职位由夏尔·戴高乐接替。
description.en: French politician and the last President of the French Fourth Republic, succeeded by Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西共和国的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The office of the head of government of the French Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，其总理职位由夏尔·戴高乐接替。
description.en: French politician who was succeeded as Prime Minister by Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐的父亲，一位拉丁语、哲学与文学教师。
description.en: Father of Charles de Gaulle, a teacher of Latin, philosophy, and literature.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军，在第一次世界大战初期指挥第五军团，戴高乐所在的第33步兵团隶属其麾下。
description.en: French general who commanded the Fifth Army at the beginning of World War I, under which de Gaulle's 33rd Infantry Regiment served.

zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·图哈切夫斯基

description.zh-cn: 苏联元帅，在第一次世界大战期间作为战俘时，曾向夏尔·戴高乐学习法语。
description.en: Marshal of the Soviet Union who, as a prisoner of war during World War I, learned French from Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐的妻子。
description.en: Wife of Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军，时任陆军参谋长，反对夏尔·戴高乐关于建立职业军的理论。
description.en: French general, then Chief of Staff of the Army, who opposed Charles de Gaulle's theory on creating a professional army.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军，反对夏尔·戴高乐关于建立独立坦克师的想法。
description.en: French general who opposed Charles de Gaulle's idea of creating independent armored divisions.

description.zh-cn: 法国政治家，时任战争部长，在保罗·雷诺的请求下同意晋升夏尔·戴高乐为上校。
description.en: French politician and Minister of War who, at the request of Paul Reynaud, agreed to promote Charles de Gaulle to colonel.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐通过英国广播公司发表的演讲，号召法国人民抵抗纳粹德国的占领。
description.en: A speech delivered by Charles de Gaulle via the BBC, calling on the French people to resist the Nazi German occupation.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军，曾受美国支持，与夏尔·戴高乐共同担任法兰西民族解放委员会主席，后被戴高乐排挤。
description.en: French general supported by the United States, who served as co-president of the French Committee of National Liberation with Charles de Gaulle before being marginalized by him.

description.zh-cn: 法国将军，在夏尔·戴高乐的领导下，其部队率先进入巴黎，参与解放巴黎的行动。
description.en: French general who, under the leadership of Charles de Gaulle, led the first Allied troops into Paris during its liberation.

description.zh-cn: 法属阿尔及利亚发生的政治危机，导致夏尔·戴高乐重新掌权并建立法兰西第五共和国。
description.en: A political crisis in French Algeria that led to Charles de Gaulle's return to power and the establishment of the French Fifth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 前法国驻日大使，夏尔·戴高乐的亲信，曾被派往台湾与蒋中正沟通法国与中华人民共和国建交事宜。
description.en: Former French ambassador to Japan and a confidant of Charles de Gaulle, who was sent to Taiwan to communicate with Chiang Kai-shek regarding France's establishment of diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 指父母皆非香港永久性居民而在香港出生的婴儿，此现象引发了社会资源分配和服务压力等争议。
description.en: Refers to infants born in Hong Kong to parents who are not permanent residents of Hong Kong, a phenomenon that has sparked controversy over the allocation of social resources and service pressures.

description.zh-cn: 一项允许中国大陆居民以个人身份访问香港和澳门的政策。
description.en: A policy allowing residents of mainland China to visit Hong Kong and Macau on an individual basis.

zh-cn: 首都各界庆祝中华人民共和国成立60周年大会
en: 60th anniversary of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 为庆祝中华人民共和国成立60周年在北京举行的大型活动，由时任北京市委书记刘淇主持。
description.en: A large-scale event held in Beijing to celebrate the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, presided over by then-Beijing Party Secretary Liu Qi.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省常州市下辖区，刘淇的出生地。
description.en: A district under the jurisdiction of Changzhou City, Jiangsu Province, and the birthplace of Liu Qi.

description.zh-cn: 著名教育家，柏林大学创办人，曾在哥廷根大学师从法学家皮特。
description.en: A renowned educator and founder of the University of Berlin, who studied under the jurist Pütter at the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 德国作家、语言学家，曾在哥廷根大学任教，因哥廷根七君子事件被驱逐。
description.en: German authors and linguists who were professors at the University of Göttingen and were expelled as part of the Göttingen Seven incident.

description.zh-cn: 德国数学家，被誉为“数学王子”，曾是哥廷根大学的学生和教授。
description.en: German mathematician, known as the 'Prince of Mathematicians', who was a student and professor at the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 德国数学家，现代数学之父，在担任哥廷根大学教授期间将哥廷根缔造成世界数学中心。
description.en: German mathematician, considered the father of modern mathematics, who, as a professor, established Göttingen as the world's leading center for mathematics.

description.zh-cn: 德国物理学家，1954年诺贝尔物理学奖得主，哥廷根大学博士、教授，后因纳粹迫害而离开。
description.en: German physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics in 1954, who was a PhD and professor at the University of Göttingen before being forced to leave due to Nazi persecution.

description.zh-cn: 德国物理学家，1925年诺贝尔物理学奖得主，哥廷根大学学生、教授，后因纳粹迫害而离开。
description.en: German physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics in 1925, who was a student and professor at the University of Göttingen before being forced to leave due to Nazi persecution.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国时期的教育部长。
description.en: Minister of Education during the Nazi Germany era.

en: Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities

description.zh-cn: 由英王乔治二世建立的独立学术机构，与哥廷根大学保持着紧密的合作关系。
description.en: An independent academic institution established by King George II of Great Britain, which maintains a close cooperative relationship with the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 德国的科研机构网络，在哥廷根设有五个研究所，与哥廷根大学有紧密合作关系。
description.en: A network of research institutes in Germany. Five institutes are located in Göttingen and collaborate closely with the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 中国语言学家、翻译家、学者，曾在哥廷根大学获得博士学位。
description.en: Chinese linguist, translator, and scholar, who obtained his PhD from the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 台湾法学家，曾任司法院院长，在哥廷根大学获得法学博士学位。
description.en: Taiwanese jurist, former President of the Judicial Yuan, who obtained a Doctor of Law degree from the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 美国金融家，摩根家族代表人物，曾在哥廷根大学学习。
description.en: American financier and a representative figure of the Morgan family, who studied at the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 日本程式设计师，SoftEther VPN的主要开发者。
description.en: Japanese programmer, the main developer of SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: 日本的一所国立大学。这里曾是师范类高等学府，杨昌济曾在此就读。此外，SoftEther VPN项目也在此进行，并赞助了VPN Gate。
description.en: A national university in Japan. It was formerly a higher normal school where Yang Changji was a student. Additionally, the SoftEther VPN project was conducted here, and it sponsors VPN Gate.

description.zh-cn: 一种在公共网络上建立加密连接的技术。
description.en: A technology that creates an encrypted connection over a public network.

description.zh-cn: 一种广泛使用的自由软件许可证。SoftEther VPN在2014年至2019年初使用此许可证。
description.en: A widely used free software license. SoftEther VPN used this license from 2014 to early 2019.

description.zh-cn: 一个由Apache软件基金会发布的自由软件许可证。SoftEther VPN自2019年1月起转为使用此许可证。
description.en: A free software license released by the Apache Software Foundation. SoftEther VPN switched to this license in January 2019.

description.zh-cn: 在使用了网络地址转换（NAT）的IP网络中建立和维持网络连接的技术。
description.en: A computer networking technique of establishing and maintaining Internet protocol connections across network address translators (NATs).

description.zh-cn: 对互联网内容的控制或压制。
description.en: The control or suppression of what can be accessed, published, or viewed on the Internet.

description.zh-cn: 一种网络数据包过滤技术，用于检查通过检查点的数据包的数据部分（也可能是头部），以定位、识别、分类、重新路由或阻止具有特定数据或代码有效负载的数据包。
description.en: A type of data processing that inspects in detail the data being sent over a computer network, and may take actions such as blocking, re-routing, or logging it accordingly.

description.zh-cn: 一种通用的计算机编程语言，用于开发SoftEther VPN。
description.en: A general-purpose computer programming language used to develop SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: 一种通用的计算机编程语言，用于开发SoftEther VPN。
description.en: A general-purpose computer programming language used to develop SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: 第二层隧道协议，一种用于支持虚拟私人网络的隧道协议，SoftEther VPN支持此协议。
description.en: Layer 2 Tunneling Protocol, a tunneling protocol used to support virtual private networks, which is supported by SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: 互联网协议安全，一个用于保护IP网络通信的协议套件，SoftEther VPN支持此协议。
description.en: A secure network protocol suite that authenticates and encrypts the packets of data sent over an Internet Protocol network, which is supported by SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: 一个用于创建加密点对点或站点到站点连接的开源虚拟私人网络（VPN）方案，SoftEther VPN支持此协议。
description.en: An open-source commercial software that implements virtual private network (VPN) techniques for creating secure point-to-point or site-to-site connections, which is supported by SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: 英国商界女性，戴维·卡梅伦的妻子。
description.en: British businesswoman and wife of David Cameron.

description.zh-cn: 英国股票经纪人，戴维·卡梅伦的父亲。
description.en: British stockbroker and father of David Cameron.

description.zh-cn: 英国伦敦西敏市的一个地区，戴维·卡梅伦的出生地。
description.en: An area in the City of Westminster, London, UK. Birthplace of David Cameron.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国伯克郡的著名独立寄宿学校，戴维·卡梅伦曾在此就读。
description.en: A famous independent boarding school in Berkshire, England, where David Cameron was educated.

zh-cn: 牛津大学布雷齐诺斯学院

description.zh-cn: 牛津大学的成员学院之一，戴维·卡梅伦的母校。
description.en: A constituent college of the University of Oxford, and David Cameron's alma mater.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，曾任财政大臣。戴维·卡梅伦曾是他的特别顾问。
description.en: British politician who served as Chancellor of the Exchequer. David Cameron was his special adviser.

description.zh-cn: 2015年举行的英国国会下议院选举。戴维·卡梅伦领导的保守党在这次选举中赢得多数席位，得以单独组建政府。
description.en: The 2015 election for the House of Commons of the United Kingdom. The Conservative Party, led by David Cameron, won a majority of seats, enabling them to form a government alone.

description.zh-cn: 英国国会的上议院。戴维·卡梅伦在2023年被册封为终身贵族后成为其成员。
description.en: The upper house of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. David Cameron became a member in 2023 after being created a life peer.

en: William IV of the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 19世纪的英国国王，戴维·卡梅伦是其直系后裔。
description.en: King of the United Kingdom in the 19th century, of whom David Cameron is a direct descendant.

description.zh-cn: 一家英国媒体公司，戴维·卡梅伦在从政前曾在此担任公共关系部门主管。
description.en: A British media company where David Cameron worked as Director of Corporate Affairs before his political career.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，前自由民主党党魁。在戴维·卡梅伦的联合政府中担任副首相。
description.en: British politician and former leader of the Liberal Democrats. Served as Deputy Prime Minister in David Cameron's coalition government.

zh-cn: 甘民乐与纪理历联合内阁

description.zh-cn: 由戴维·卡梅伦领导的保守党与尼克·克莱格领导的自由民主党于2010年至2015年组成的英国联合政府。
description.en: The coalition government of the United Kingdom from 2010 to 2015, formed by the Conservative Party led by David Cameron and the Liberal Democrats led by Nick Clegg.

en: Same-sex marriage in the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 指在英国将同性婚姻合法化的相关法律。戴维·卡梅伦推动并支持了该法案的通过。
description.en: Refers to the laws legalizing same-sex marriage in the United Kingdom. David Cameron pushed for and supported the passage of the legislation.

description.zh-cn: 印度外交部长，是戴维·卡梅伦就任外交大臣后会晤的首位外国政要。
description.en: Minister of External Affairs of India, who was the first foreign dignitary to meet David Cameron after he became Foreign Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 英国政治人物，2016年保守党党魁选举候选人。她的退选使得文翠珊自动当选。
description.en: British politician and candidate in the 2016 Conservative Party leadership election. Her withdrawal led to Theresa May being elected unopposed.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党的高级理论智囊，是“和平崛起”理论的提出者。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, a senior theoretical think tank of the Communist Party of China, and the proposer of the "Peaceful Rise" theory.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Zheng Bijian.

description.zh-cn: 由郑必坚提出的关于中国发展的理论。
description.en: A theory about China's development proposed by Zheng Bijian.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚曾就读的中学。
description.en: A secondary school that Zheng Bijian attended.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党理论家，曾与郑必坚共同起草提出“两个凡是”理论的社论。
description.en: A theorist of the Communist Party of China who co-authored the editorial proposing the "Two Whatevers" theory with Zheng Bijian.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚的继任中共中央党校常务副校长。
description.en: Zheng Bijian's successor as Executive Vice President of the Central Party School.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚的前任中日友好21世纪委员会中方首席委员。
description.en: Zheng Bijian's predecessor as the Chinese chief member of the 21st Century Committee for China-Japan Friendship.

description.zh-cn: 埃及第二任总统，不结盟运动的主要创始人之一。
description.en: The second President of Egypt and one of the main founders of the Non-Aligned Movement.

description.zh-cn: 加纳首任总统，不结盟运动的创始人之一。
description.en: The first President of Ghana and one of the founders of the Non-Aligned Movement.

description.zh-cn: 南斯拉夫首都，1961年第一次不结盟运动峰会的举办地。
description.en: Capital of Yugoslavia, host city of the first Non-Aligned Movement summit in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 冷战期间由美国领导的资本主义国家集团，与东方集团对立。
description.en: The group of capitalist countries led by the United States during the Cold War, in opposition to the Eastern Bloc.

description.zh-cn: 1979年由菲德尔·卡斯特罗总结的不结盟运动宗旨文件，强调确保成员国的独立、主权、领土完整和安全。
description.en: A document summarizing the purposes of the Non-Aligned Movement, articulated by Fidel Castro in 1979, which emphasizes ensuring the independence, sovereignty, territorial integrity, and security of its member states.

description.zh-cn: 一国获取并维持对另一国或地区的完全或部分政治控制的政策或实践，是不结盟运动反对的核心对象之一。
description.en: The policy or practice of acquiring full or partial political control over another country or area, one of the core concepts opposed by the Non-Aligned Movement.

description.zh-cn: 不结盟运动的创始成员国之一，在解体后其成员资格被暂停。
description.en: One of the founding members of the Non-Aligned Movement, whose membership was suspended after its breakup.

zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会改革
en: Reform of the United Nations Security Council

description.zh-cn: 旨在重组联合国安理会以提高其代表性和民主性的政治运动，受到不结盟运动的支持。
description.en: A political movement aimed at restructuring the UN Security Council to enhance its representativeness and democracy, supported by the Non-Aligned Movement.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年盘踞汉中的军阀。他对刘璋的威胁是刘璋邀请刘备入蜀的起因之一。
description.en: A warlord who occupied Hanzhong during the late Eastern Han dynasty. His threat to Liu Zhang was one of the reasons Liu Zhang invited Liu Bei into Shu.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的将领，以忠勇著称。在益州之战中抵抗刘备，兵败被俘后因不肯投降而被杀。
description.en: A general under Liu Zhang, known for his loyalty and bravery. He resisted Liu Bei during the Battle of Yizhou, was captured after being defeated, and executed for refusing to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的儿子，在益州之战中据守雒城抵抗刘备近一年。
description.en: Son of Liu Zhang. He defended Luocheng against Liu Bei for nearly a year during the Battle of Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的将领，白水军督。在益州之战初期被刘备设计斩杀。
description.en: A general under Liu Zhang and commander of the Baishui Army. He was tricked and executed by Liu Bei at the beginning of the Battle of Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋的将领，白水军督。在益州之战初期被刘备设计斩杀。
description.en: A general under Liu Zhang and commander of the Baishui Army. He was tricked and executed by Liu Bei at the beginning of the Battle of Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的益州牧，刘璋的父亲。
description.en: Governor of Yizhou during the late Eastern Han dynasty and the father of Liu Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 陈丕显的出生地。
description.en: Birthplace of Chen Pixian.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省的地方国家权力机关。
description.en: The local state power organ of Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，陕西省人民政府首任主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, the first Chairman of the People's Government of Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间陕西省的权力机构，取代了陕西省人民政府。
description.en: The governing body of Shaanxi Province during the Cultural Revolution, which replaced the Shaanxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任陕西省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Chinese politician, currently serving as the Executive Vice Governor of the People's Government of Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央党校的内部刊物，《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文最早于此发表。
description.en: An internal publication of the Party School of the CPC Central Committee, where 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth' was first published.

description.zh-cn: 一种哲学理论，强调思想和理论的实际效果和应用价值。其观点与《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》有相似之处。
description.en: A philosophical theory that emphasizes the practical effects and application value of ideas and theories. Its views bear similarities to 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth'.

description.zh-cn: 自拖雷家族内战开始，蒙古帝国各大汗国纷纷自治，不再臣服于大汗，帝国走向实质性分裂和解体。
description.en: Beginning with the Toluid Civil War, the various khanates of the Mongol Empire became autonomous and no longer submitted to the Great Khan, leading to the de facto division and dissolution of the empire.

description.zh-cn: 河海大学的前身，是中国第一所培养水利人才的高等学府。
中国科学院院士、中国工程院院士、墨西哥科学院外籍院士。
建国后任华东水利部副部长、水利部顾问，1955年当选为中国科学院首批院士。
中国科学院院士。
中国科学院资深院士，清华大学教授。
中国科学院资深院士，水利水电科学院高工。
中国工程院院士，长江水利委员会技术委员会主任。
中国工程院院士，河海大学双聘院士,博士生导师。
中国科学院院士、河海大学兼职博导。
曾任国家水电部副部长、能源部副部长；中国工程院院士。
中国工程院院士，教授，博导。
中国工程院院士、长江水利委员会总工程师。

现任河海大学环境学院副院长，2011年当选中国工程院院士。
新疆维吾尔自治区人大常委会原副主任。
辽宁省人大常委会原副主任。
水利部原副部长。
水利部原长江水利委员会主任（副部长级）。
南京市政协原主席。
山东省政协原副主席。
水利部原副部长、部科技委主任、民盟中央副主席。
水利部原党组成员、水利部长江水利委员会党组书记（副部长级）。
原国务院南水北调办公室主任、水利部副部长。
江苏省人民政府原副省长。
水利部原副部长。
致公党中央副主席。
原北海舰队副司令员，海军后勤部副部长，少将。
原水利部副部长。
现任水利部副部长。
现任水利部党组成员、副部长。
原湖北省副省长，十八届中央候补委员。
中共天津市委原常委，统战部部长。2017年7月10日因严重违纪受到留党察看一年、行政撤职处分，降为正厅级非领导职务。
现任中共湖南省委常委。
曾任中国国电集团公司党组书记、总经理。
湖南拓维信息集团总裁。
北魏皇帝，为了安顿印度僧人跋陀而下令修建少林寺。
description.en: An emperor of the Northern Wei dynasty who ordered the construction of the Shaolin Temple to accommodate the Indian monk Batuo.

description.zh-cn: 印度僧人，少林寺的创始住持，由北魏孝文帝为其在嵩山建寺。
description.en: An Indian monk and the founding abbot of the Shaolin Temple, for whom Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei built the monastery at Mount Song.

en: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou's persecution of Buddhism

description.zh-cn: 北周武帝发起的废佛运动，少林寺在此期间被严重毁坏。
description.en: The anti-Buddhist campaign launched by Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, during which the Shaolin Temple was severely damaged.

description.zh-cn: 北周皇帝，下令禁止佛教传播，即“建德毁佛”。
description.en: An emperor of the Northern Zhou dynasty who ordered the proscription of Buddhism, known as the Jiande Persecution of Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期接替释恒林领导少林寺保卫团，后投奔直系军阀吴佩孚，在交战中阵亡。
description.en: During the Republic of China era, he took over leadership of the Shaolin Temple's defense corps from Shi Henglin. He later joined the warlord Wu Peifu's faction and was killed in battle.

description.zh-cn: 少林寺现任住持。
description.en: The current abbot of the Shaolin Temple.

description.zh-cn: 由少林寺武僧研创和发展的武术体系。
description.en: A system of martial arts developed and refined by the warrior monks of the Shaolin Temple.

zh-cn: 登封“天地之中”历史建筑群
en: Historic Monuments of Dengfeng in 'The Centre of Heaven and Earth'

description.zh-cn: 位于河南省登封市的一系列历史建筑，被联合国教科文组织列为世界文化遗产，少林寺是其中的一部分。
description.en: A collection of historical monuments in Dengfeng, Henan Province, designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, which includes the Shaolin Temple.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党及中华人民共和国官员，曾任中共中央办公厅秘书局局长、中央机构编制委员会办公室副主任、第十一届全国人民代表大会代表等职。
description.en: An official of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, who served as Director of the Secretariat of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, Deputy Director of the State Commission Office for Public Sector Reform, and a delegate to the 11th National People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中共中央办公厅秘书局
en: Secretariat of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会办公厅内设机构。
description.en: An internal department of the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国行政管理学领域的全国性学术团体。
description.en: A national academic association in the field of public administration in China.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉的父亲，日治时期担任刑警，战后曾任两届台北县议员。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui's father, who served as a police detective during the Japanese rule period and later as a two-term Taipei County councilor.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉的兄长，二战期间作为台籍日本兵加入日本海军，在菲律宾马尼拉战役中阵亡，灵位奉于日本靖国神社。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui's elder brother. During World War II, as a Taiwanese-Japanese soldier, he joined the Imperial Japanese Navy and was killed in action during the Battle of Manila in the Philippines. His spirit tablet is enshrined at the Yasukuni Shrine in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉的独子，因鼻咽癌早逝。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui's only son, who died young from nasopharyngeal cancer.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党台北市工作委员会成员，据其所述，他曾引荐李登辉加入中国共产党。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party's Taipei City Working Committee, who claimed to have introduced Lee Teng-hui to the party.

description.zh-cn: 指李登辉总统任内进行的一系列政治改革，旨在推动台湾的民主化。
description.en: Refers to the series of political reforms carried out during President Lee Teng-hui's tenure, aimed at promoting Taiwan's democratization.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一个政党，李登辉在卸任总统后成为该党的精神领袖。
description.en: A political party in Taiwan for which Lee Teng-hui became the spiritual leader after his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 前中国人民解放军大校，与刘连昆一同向台湾提供情报，后身份暴露被处决。
description.en: A former Senior Colonel of the People's Liberation Army who, along with Liu Liankun, provided intelligence to Taiwan and was later executed after his identity was exposed.

description.zh-cn: 日本小说家，曾在1994年访问李登辉，访谈内容中李登辉提出了“生为台湾人的悲哀”的说法。
description.en: A Japanese novelist who interviewed Lee Teng-hui in 1994, during which Lee expressed the concept of 'the sorrow of being Taiwanese'.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府公安部副部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府公安部二局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Second Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府公安部三局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Third Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府公安部四局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Fourth Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中央人民政府公安部五局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Fifth Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任东北人民政府公安部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Public Security of the Northeast People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任华东军政委员会公安部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Public Security of the East China Military and Administrative Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中南军政委员会公安部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Public Security of the Central South Military and Administrative Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任华南军政委员会公安部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Public Security of the South China Military and Administrative Committee.

zh-cn: 扬帆 (上海市公安局局长)

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任上海市公安局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Shanghai Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任南京市公安局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Nanjing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民政府下属的公安机关。
description.en: The public security organ under the Tianjin Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国第一代歼击轰炸机，张庆伟是其工程组组长。
description.en: China's first generation fighter-bomber; Zhang Qingwei was the leader of its engineering group.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院主管教育事业和语言文字工作的组成部门。
description.en: A component department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China that oversees education and language-related work.

en: Criminal Investigation Police University of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国公安部直属的公安警察院校之一。
description.en: One of the police academies directly under the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任山东省人民政府副省长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, formerly serving as the Vice Governor of the Shandong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 山东省滨州市下辖的市辖区。
description.en: A district under the administration of Binzhou City, Shandong Province.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国陕西省富平县陶艺村
location.en: Taoyi Village, Fuping County, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党政治人物习仲勋的墓地，同时也是一个爱国主义教育基地。
description.en: The tomb of Xi Zhongxun, a political figure of the Communist Party of China, and also a patriotic education base.

zh-cn: 全国爱国主义教育示范基地

description.zh-cn: 由中共中央宣传部、中华人民共和国教育部等机构联合命名及管理的，用以对民众，特别是青少年进行爱国主义教育的场所的总称。
description.en: A general term for places jointly named and managed by the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, the Ministry of Education of the PRC, and other institutions, used to conduct patriotic education for the public, especially for young people.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学建筑系国徽设计小组成员。
description.en: Member of the Tsinghua University Department of Architecture National Emblem Design Group.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学建筑系国徽设计小组成员。
description.en: Member of the Tsinghua University Department of Architecture National Emblem Design Group.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学建筑系教授，负责规范和简化国徽的几何设计图稿，完成了最终的定型设计。
description.en: Professor at the Department of Architecture, Tsinghua University, who was responsible for standardizing and simplifying the geometric design of the national emblem, completing the final version.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国徽法
en: Law of the People's Republic of China on the National Emblem

description.zh-cn: 一部规范中华人民共和国国徽使用的全国性法律，于1991年通过并施行。
description.en: A national law regulating the use of the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China, passed and implemented in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 位于乌克兰普里皮亚季镇附近的核电站，由四座RBMK-1000型反应堆组成。1986年4月26日，其4号反应堆发生爆炸，引发了切尔诺贝利核事故。该电站于2000年12月完全停止运作。
description.en: A nuclear power plant near the town of Pripyat, Ukraine, consisting of four RBMK-1000 reactors. On April 26, 1986, its Unit 4 reactor exploded, causing the Chernobyl disaster. The entire plant ceased operations in December 2000.

description.zh-cn: 位于乌克兰北部的城市，邻近切尔诺贝利核电站。在1986年核事故后，约5万名居民被疏散，该市成为一座鬼城并被划入隔离区。
description.en: A city in northern Ukraine, near the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant. After the 1986 nuclear accident, its approximately 50,000 residents were evacuated, and the city became a ghost town within the Zone of Alienation.

zh-cn: 压力管式石墨慢化沸水反应炉

description.zh-cn: 苏联设计的一种石墨慢化沸水反应堆，切尔诺贝利核电站使用的反应堆类型。其设计存在严重缺陷，如高正空泡系数和控制棒设计问题，是导致1986年事故的核心技术原因。
description.en: A class of graphite-moderated nuclear power reactor designed and built by the Soviet Union, used at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant. Its design had significant flaws, such as a high positive void coefficient and control rod design issues, which were key technical causes of the 1986 disaster.

zh-cn: 亚历山大·费奥多罗维奇·阿基莫夫

description.zh-cn: 切尔诺贝利核电站4号反应堆事故当晚的值班主任。他在压力下执行了测试，并在爆炸后努力尝试给反应堆注水以控制灾难，因此受到致命剂量的辐射而牺牲。
description.en: The shift supervisor of the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant's Unit 4 on the night of the disaster. He conducted the test under pressure and, after the explosion, tried to pump water into the reactor to control the disaster, receiving a fatal dose of radiation in the process.

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·帕夫洛维奇·普拉维克

description.zh-cn: 一名苏联消防员，中尉。在切尔诺贝利核事故中，他是第一批到达现场的消防指挥官之一，因在灭火过程中受到致命剂量的辐射而牺牲，后被追授为苏联英雄。
description.en: A Soviet firefighter and lieutenant. During the Chernobyl disaster, he was one of the first fire commanders to arrive at the scene. He died from a fatal dose of radiation received while fighting the fire and was posthumously awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union.

zh-cn: 鲍里斯·叶夫多基莫维奇·谢尔比纳

description.zh-cn: 苏联部长会议副主席，被任命为负责处理切尔诺贝利事故的政府委员会负责人。他在事故现场领导了初期的抢险和疏散工作。
description.en: Deputy Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the USSR, appointed to lead the government commission managing the Chernobyl disaster. He supervised the initial crisis management and evacuation efforts at the site.

description.zh-cn: 苏联无机化学家，库尔恰托夫原子能研究所第一副所长，切尔诺贝利事故调查政府委员会的关键成员。他坚持对事故原因进行诚实的调查，并向国际原子能总署提交了报告。
description.en: A Soviet inorganic chemist, First Deputy Director of the Kurchatov Institute of Atomic Energy, and a key member of the government commission investigating the Chernobyl disaster. He insisted on an honest investigation into the causes of the accident and presented the report to the IAEA.

description.zh-cn: 切尔诺贝利核电站的反应堆值班长，是被称为“切尔诺贝利三勇士”之一。他负责为潜水任务提供照明，帮助两位工程师在黑暗的地下室中找到并打开了排水阀门。
description.en: A reactor shift supervisor at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, one of the three men known as the 'Chernobyl divers'. He was responsible for lighting during the mission, helping the two engineers locate and open the drain valves in the dark basement.

zh-cn: 切尔诺贝利核电站石棺

description.zh-cn: 1986年为覆盖切尔诺贝利核电站4号反应堆废墟而建造的巨大钢筋混凝土结构。它旨在封闭放射性物质，但由于其结构不稳和老化，后被新石棺所取代。
description.en: A massive steel and concrete structure built in 1986 to cover the ruins of Reactor 4 at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant. It was designed to contain radioactive materials, but due to its instability and aging, it was later enclosed by the New Safe Confinement.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，第四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, Vice Chairman of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
description.en: Member of the 4th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人大常委会委员。
