description.zh-cn: 法国卡佩王朝国王（1180年—1223年在位），第一位自称“法兰西国王”的君主。因其谋略与政治手腕，法国在他统治之下成为欧洲最强大的国家之一。
description.en: King of France from the House of Capet (reigned 1180–1223), the first monarch to style himself "King of France". Due to his strategy and political skill, France became one of the most powerful countries in Europe under his rule.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，腓力二世的父亲。
description.en: King of France, father of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西王后，路易七世的第三任妻子，腓力二世的母亲。
description.en: Queen of France, the third wife of Louis VII and mother of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西王后，腓力二世的第一任妻子。
description.en: Queen of France, the first wife of Philip II.

en: Ingeborg of Denmark, Queen of France

description.zh-cn: 法兰西王后，腓力二世的第二任妻子。
description.en: Queen of France, the second wife of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西王后，腓力二世的第三任妻子。
description.en: Queen of France, the third wife of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西国王，腓力二世的儿子和继承人。
description.en: King of France, son and successor of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 统治法兰西王国的一个王朝，由雨果·卡佩建立。
description.en: A dynasty that ruled the Kingdom of France, founded by Hugh Capet.

description.zh-cn: 12至15世纪统治英格兰的王朝，因在法国拥有大量领地而与卡佩王朝长期斗争。
description.en: A royal house that ruled England from the 12th to the 15th century, which was in long-term conflict with the House of Capet due to its extensive territories in France.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，金雀花王朝的创建者，与腓力二世的父亲路易七世及腓力二世本人均有冲突。
description.en: King of England, founder of the Plantagenet dynasty, who had conflicts with both Philip II and his father, Louis VII.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，亨利二世之子。曾与腓力二世一同参与第三次十字军东征，但两人关系紧张，后成为敌人。
description.en: King of England, son of Henry II. He participated in the Third Crusade with Philip II, but their relationship was tense and they later became enemies.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰国王，亨利二世幼子，理查一世的弟弟。在与腓力二世的战争中失去了金雀花王朝在法国的大部分领地。
description.en: King of England, youngest son of Henry II and brother of Richard I. He lost most of the Plantagenet dynasty's French territories in the war against Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 1214年发生于佛兰德地区的一场关键战役，腓力二世领导的法军击败了神圣罗马帝国与英格兰的联军，确立了法国在欧洲的强国地位。
description.en: A pivotal battle fought in Flanders in 1214, where the French army led by Philip II defeated the allied forces of the Holy Roman Empire and England, establishing France's position as a major power in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 法国的一个市镇，是腓力二世的出生地。
description.en: A commune in France, the birthplace of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 法国的一个市镇，是腓力二世的逝世地。
description.en: A commune in France, the place of death of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 香槟伯爵，腓力二世的舅父，在腓力二世即位初期担任摄政之一，后与腓力二世对立。
description.en: Count of Champagne, uncle of Philip II, who served as one of the regents during Philip's early reign and later opposed him.

description.zh-cn: 布卢瓦和沙特尔伯爵，腓力二世的舅父，在腓力二世即位初期担任摄政之一，后与腓力二世对立。
description.en: Count of Blois and Chartres, uncle of Philip II, who served as one of the regents during Philip's early reign and later opposed him.

description.zh-cn: 佛兰德伯爵，曾与香槟家族联合发起反对腓力二世的战争。
description.en: Count of Flanders, who allied with the House of Champagne to wage war against Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 由欧洲三位主要君主（腓力二世、理查一世、腓特烈一世）领导的旨在收复圣地的军事行动。
description.en: A military campaign led by three major European monarchs (Philip II, Richard I, Frederick I) aimed at reconquering the Holy Land.

zh-cn: 腓特烈一世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，第三次十字军东征的领袖之一。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor, one of the leaders of the Third Crusade.

description.zh-cn: 埃及和叙利亚的苏丹，阿尤布王朝的建立者，第三次十字军东征中穆斯林军队的领袖。
description.en: Sultan of Egypt and Syria and the founder of the Ayyubid dynasty, leader of the Muslim forces during the Third Crusade.

zh-cn: 亨利六世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，腓力二世在反对理查一世问题上的重要盟友。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor, an important ally of Philip II in their opposition to Richard I.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利公爵，亨利六世的封臣，在第三次十字军东征后俘虏了理查一世。
description.en: Duke of Austria, a vassal of Henry VI, who captured Richard I after the Third Crusade.

description.zh-cn: 指12世纪和13世纪法国卡佩王朝与统治英格兰的金雀花王朝之间的一系列冲突。
description.en: Refers to a series of conflicts between the French House of Capet and the English House of Plantagenet during the 12th and 13th centuries.

zh-cn: 布列塔尼公爵阿尔蒂尔一世

description.zh-cn: 布列塔尼公爵，约翰国王的侄子，对英格兰王位有继承权。曾与腓力二世结盟对抗约翰，后被约翰俘虏并杀害。
description.en: Duke of Brittany, nephew of King John, with a claim to the English throne. He allied with Philip II against John, but was later captured and killed by John.

zh-cn: 奥托四世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，与英格兰国王约翰结盟对抗腓力二世，在布汶战役中战败。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor, who allied with King John of England against Philip II and was defeated at the Battle of Bouvines.

description.zh-cn: 位于巴黎市中心的世界著名博物馆，其前身是腓力二世于约1200年建立的一座城堡。
description.en: A world-famous museum in the center of Paris, its predecessor was a castle built by Philip II around 1200.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚前总统，巴沙尔·阿萨德的父亲。他在2000年去世前，培养其子巴沙尔作为接班人。
description.en: Former President of Syria and father of Bashar al-Assad. Before his death in 2000, he groomed his son Bashar as his successor.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德的长兄，原定的总统接班人，于1994年因车祸去世。
description.en: Older brother of Bashar al-Assad and the original designated successor to the presidency, who died in a car accident in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德的妻子，前叙利亚第一夫人。
description.en: Wife of Bashar al-Assad and former First Lady of Syria.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德的弟弟，领导叙利亚共和国卫队和第四装甲部队。
description.en: Younger brother of Bashar al-Assad, who commanded the Syrian Republican Guard and the 4th Armoured Division.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德的姐姐，阿瑟夫·沙乌卡特的妻子。
description.en: Older sister of Bashar al-Assad and wife of Assef Shawkat.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德的姐夫，曾任叙利亚军队的副总参谋长。
description.en: Brother-in-law of Bashar al-Assad, who served as the deputy chief of staff of the Syrian army.

description.zh-cn: 在叙利亚内战中反对巴沙尔·阿萨德政府的政治及武装团体总称。于2024年12月推翻了阿萨德政权。
description.en: A collective term for political and armed groups opposing the government of Bashar al-Assad during the Syrian Civil War. They overthrew the Assad regime in December 2024.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚反对派于2024年11月下旬发起的一系列军事行动，迅速攻占叙利亚多个主要城市，并最终导致阿萨德政权垮台。
description.en: A series of military operations launched by the Syrian opposition in late November 2024, which rapidly captured several major Syrian cities and ultimately led to the fall of the Assad regime.

description.zh-cn: 位于叙利亚首都大马士革的一所公立大学，巴沙尔·阿萨德曾在此学习医学。
description.en: A public university in Damascus, the capital of Syria, where Bashar al-Assad studied medicine.

description.zh-cn: 位于叙利亚霍姆斯的一所军事院校，巴沙尔·阿萨德在被其父选为接班人后曾在此学习。
description.en: A military academy in Homs, Syria, where Bashar al-Assad studied after being chosen as his father's successor.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚的立法机关。曾在2000年为巴沙尔·阿萨德顺利继任总统而修改宪法。
description.en: The legislative authority of Syria. In 2000, it amended the constitution to allow for Bashar al-Assad's succession to the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚的国家元首职位。
description.en: The position of the head of state of Syria.

zh-cn: 阿拉伯复兴社会党—叙利亚地区
叙利亚阿拉伯复兴社会党
阿拉伯复兴社会党－叙利亚地区
en: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region

description.zh-cn: 一个叙利亚政党，自1963年以来一直是叙利亚的执政党，直到2024年阿萨德政权垮台。
description.en: A Syrian political party that was the ruling party of Syria from 1963 until the fall of the Assad regime in 2024.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教什叶派的一个分支，阿萨德家族所属的教派。虽然在叙利亚是少数，但在阿萨德政权时期控制着国家安全部队。
description.en: A branch of Shia Islam to which the Assad family belongs. Despite being a minority in Syria, they controlled the state security forces during the Assad regime.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚武装力量的精锐部队，在阿萨德政权时期由其弟马赫尔·阿萨德领导。
description.en: An elite unit of the Syrian Armed Forces, commanded by his brother Maher al-Assad during the Assad regime.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚在内战期间举行的一次总统选举，巴沙尔·阿萨德以88.7%的得票率成功连任，但选举的公正性受到广泛质疑。
description.en: A presidential election held in Syria during the civil war, in which Bashar al-Assad was re-elected with 88.7% of the vote. The fairness of the election was widely questioned.

description.zh-cn: 由美国总统特朗普下令，针对叙利亚政府军设施的军事打击行动，以回应汗谢洪化学武器袭击事件。
description.en: A military strike ordered by U.S. President Trump against Syrian government facilities in response to the Khan Shaykhun chemical attack.

description.zh-cn: 由阿拉伯复兴社会党统治下的叙利亚政府，由阿萨德家族长期领导，于2024年12月被推翻。
description.en: The Syrian government under the rule of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party, led for a long time by the Assad family, which was overthrown in December 2024.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚首都，巴沙尔·阿萨德的出生地及前执政中心。
description.en: The capital of Syria, birthplace and former center of power for Bashar al-Assad.

description.zh-cn: 一个统治叙利亚超过五十年的政治家族，属于阿拉维派。
description.en: A political family that ruled Syria for over fifty years, belonging to the Alawite sect.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃赞普，松赞干布的父亲。在位时征服了森波、藏蕃、尼雅尼达布等国，为吐蕃帝国的建立打下基础，后于629年被叛臣毒杀。
description.en: A Tsenpo of Tibet and the father of Songtsen Gampo. During his reign, he conquered states like Sumpa, Zhangzhung, and Nyani Dabu, laying the foundation for the Tibetan Empire. He was assassinated by rebellious ministers in 629.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布与芒妃墀江之子，早逝。
description.en: The son of Songtsen Gampo and Mongza Tricham, who died young.

description.zh-cn: 泥婆罗（尼泊尔）公主，松赞干布的妻子。她入藏时带来了释迦佛、不动明王等佛像，对佛教传入吐蕃有重要影响。在藏传佛教中被认为是白度母的化身。
description.en: A princess of Licchavi (Nepal) and a wife of Songtsen Gampo. She brought statues of Shakyamuni Buddha and Acala to Tibet, playing a significant role in the introduction of Buddhism. In Tibetan Buddhism, she is considered an incarnation of White Tara.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃君主的称号。
description.en: The title of the monarch of the Tibetan Empire.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃大贡论，在松赞干布年幼时辅政，战功赫赫。后遭另一位大臣琼波·邦色诬陷，被松赞干布下令杀死。
description.en: A Great Minister (Dàgònglùn) of the Tibetan Empire who served as regent during Songtsen Gampo's youth and had significant military achievements. He was later falsely accused by another minister, Khyungpo Pungse, and was executed by order of Songtsen Gampo.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃大臣，曾任大贡论。因嫉妒而诬陷娘·芒布杰尚囊，后又图谋杀害松赞干布，阴谋败露后自杀。
description.en: A minister of the Tibetan Empire who served as Great Minister. Out of jealousy, he framed Nyang Mangpoje Shangnang and later plotted to assassinate Songtsen Gampo. After his conspiracy was exposed, he committed suicide.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃大贡论，著名的政治家和军事家。曾出使泥婆罗和唐朝为松赞干布求亲，揭露了琼波·邦色的阴谋，并在松赞干布去世后辅佐其孙芒松芒赞。
description.en: A Great Minister of the Tibetan Empire, a renowned statesman and strategist. He served as an envoy to Licchavi and the Tang Dynasty to arrange marriages for Songtsen Gampo, exposed the plot of Khyungpo Pungse, and served as regent for Songtsen Gampo's grandson Mangsong Mangtsen after his death.

description.zh-cn: 位于青藏高原东北部的古国，曾与唐朝和亲，后被松赞干布率兵击破。
description.en: An ancient kingdom located in the northeastern Tibetan Plateau, which had a marriage alliance with the Tang Dynasty before being defeated by forces led by Songtsen Gampo.

description.zh-cn: 位于吐蕃西北部的古国，最初与吐蕃为同盟，后于642年左右被松赞干布攻灭。
description.en: An ancient kingdom in the northwest of Tibet, initially an ally of the Tibetan Empire, it was conquered by Songtsen Gampo around 642.

description.zh-cn: 位于喜马拉雅山脉南麓的古国（今尼泊尔）。松赞干布通过联姻和军事干预使其成为吐蕃的属国。
description.en: An ancient kingdom (modern-day Nepal) located in the southern foothills of the Himalayas. Songtsen Gampo made it a vassal state of the Tibetan Empire through a marriage alliance and military intervention.

description.zh-cn: 638年，松赞干布为向唐朝逼婚，亲率大军进攻唐朝松州，虽被唐军击退，但此战让唐朝认识到吐蕃的强盛，最终促成了文成公主的和亲。
description.en: In 638, to pressure the Tang Dynasty into a marriage alliance, Songtsen Gampo led a large army to attack the Tang's Songzhou. Although repelled by Tang forces, this battle demonstrated the strength of the Tibetan Empire and ultimately led to the marriage of Princess Wencheng.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝左武卫将军，在松州之战中率领先锋部队趁夜击败吐蕃军。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty general who led the vanguard to defeat the Tibetan army in a night raid during the Battle of Songzhou.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝使节，出使天竺时遭篡位者阿罗那顺袭击。他逃至吐蕃，向松赞干布借兵，成功讨伐天竺，救出使团并俘虏了阿罗那顺。
description.en: A Tang Dynasty envoy who was attacked by the usurper Arunasva during a mission to India. He escaped to Tibet, borrowed troops from Songtsen Gampo, successfully defeated the Indian forces, rescued his mission, and captured Arunasva.

description.zh-cn: 天竺摩伽陀国篡位大臣，袭击了唐朝王玄策的使团，后被王玄策率领的吐蕃和泥婆罗联军击败并俘虏。
description.en: A usurping minister of the Magadha kingdom in India who attacked the Tang envoy Wang Xuance's mission. He was later defeated and captured by a joint force of Tibetan and Licchavi troops led by Wang Xuance.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布时期的大臣，奉命前往天竺学习，参照梵文创立了藏文书写系统。
description.en: A minister during Songtsen Gampo's reign who was sent to India to study. He is credited with creating the Tibetan script based on Sanskrit.

description.zh-cn: 藏语的书写系统，由大臣吞弥桑布札在松赞干布时期参照梵文创制。
description.en: The writing system for the Tibetan language, created by the minister Thonmi Sambhota during Songtsen Gampo's reign, based on Sanskrit scripts.

description.zh-cn: 西藏的本土宗教。在佛教传入吐蕃后，与佛教之间存在竞争与融合关系。有史料称其在松赞干布时期受到压制。
description.en: The indigenous religion of Tibet. After the introduction of Buddhism, it had a relationship of both competition and syncretism with Buddhism. Some historical sources claim it was suppressed during Songtsen Gampo's reign.

description.zh-cn: 位于拉萨红山上的宫堡式建筑群，始建于松赞干布时期，据传是为迎娶文成公主而兴建。
description.en: A fortress-palace complex on Marpo Ri (Red Hill) in Lhasa. Its construction was initiated during the reign of Songtsen Gampo, reputedly to welcome Princess Wencheng.

description.zh-cn: 象雄末代国王，曾迎娶松赞干布的妹妹赞蒙赛玛噶为妃。
description.en: The last king of Zhangzhung, who married Sad-mar-kar, the sister of Songtsen Gampo.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党和中华人民共和国政治人物，原副国级领导人。曾任中共第十八届中央政治局委员、国务院副总理、国务院金融稳定发展委员会主任等职。
description.en: A political figure of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China, a former deputy national leader. He served as a member of the 18th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council, and Director of the State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee.

description.zh-cn: 马凯的女儿。
description.en: Ma Kai's daughter.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，现任立法院副院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, currently the Vice President of the Legislative Yuan.

zh-cn: 立法委员互选院长副院长办法

description.zh-cn: 规范中华民国立法院院长及副院长选举程序的法规。
description.en: Regulations governing the election procedures for the President and Vice President of the Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 明朝学士，曾弹劾胡惟庸但差点遭祸。
description.en: A scholar of the Ming Dynasty who impeached Hu Weiyong and nearly fell into disaster as a result.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代掌管宗庙祭祀礼仪的机构，胡惟庸曾在此任职。
description.en: An institution in imperial China responsible for rites and ceremonies of imperial ancestral worship, where Hu Weiyong once served.

description.zh-cn: 香港乐队组合。
description.en: A Hong Kong band.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国人民政治协商会议天津市委员会主席。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as the Chairman of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

zh-cn: 石灰窑工业特区特派员办事处

description.zh-cn: 盛茂林的出生地，中华人民共和国湖北省下辖的地级市。
description.en: The birthplace of Sheng Maolin, a prefecture-level city in Hubei Province, People's Republic of China.

zh-cn: 中国共产主义青年团湖南省委员会
中国共产党资兴市委员会
中国共产党郴州市委员会
湖南省人口和计划生育委员会
中国共产党湖南省委员会组织部
湖南省人民政府办公厅

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的前任天津市政协主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's predecessor as Chairman of the CPPCC Tianjin Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的前任中共天津市委组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's predecessor as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的继任中共天津市委组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's successor as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的前任中共山西省委组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's predecessor as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的继任中共山西省委组织部部长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's successor as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的继任中共资兴市委书记及湖南省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's successor as Secretary of the CPC Zixing Municipal Committee and as Secretary-General of the Hunan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的前任湖南省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's predecessor as Secretary-General of the Hunan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，盛茂林的继任湖南省人口和计划生育委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, Sheng Maolin's successor as Director of the Hunan Provincial Population and Family Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡报纸，曾在1992年将莱佛士书院评为新加坡最好的中学。
description.en: A Singaporean newspaper that rated Raffles Institution as the best secondary school in Singapore in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡的国家图书馆，其起源可追溯到莱佛士书院的图书馆。
description.en: The national library of Singapore, which originated from the library of Raffles Institution.

description.zh-cn: 于1923年莱佛士书院百年庆之际，与林文庆先生共同建成其图书馆。
description.en: Co-established the library of Raffles Institution with Mr. Lim Boon Keng in 1923 during its centennial celebration.

description.zh-cn: 一项新加坡教育课程，使学生可以不必参加中学会考直接进入两年制高中学习。
description.en: An educational program in Singapore that allows students to bypass the GCE 'O' Level examination and proceed directly to junior college.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚吉打州的首府。
description.en: The state capital of Kedah, Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的首都和最大城市。
description.en: The capital and largest city of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚的一个已解散的政治联盟，是国民阵线的前身。
description.en: A defunct political coalition in Malaysia, the predecessor of Barisan Nasional.

description.zh-cn: 吉打州第25任统治者，东姑阿都拉曼的父亲。
description.en: The 25th ruler of Kedah, father of Tunku Abdul Rahman.

zh-cn: 剑桥大学圣凯瑟琳学院

description.zh-cn: 英国剑桥大学的组成学院之一。
description.en: A constituent college of the University of Cambridge in the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 位于伦敦的四个律师学院之一。
description.en: One of the four Inns of Court in London.

description.zh-cn: 前马来亚共产党总书记。
description.en: Former Secretary General of the Malayan Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡首任首席部长。
description.en: The first Chief Minister of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 巫统的创始人和首任主席。
description.en: The founder and first president of UMNO.

description.zh-cn: 前马来西亚财政部长和马来西亚华人公会总会长。
description.en: Former Minister of Finance of Malaysia and president of the Malaysian Chinese Association.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在上海地区设立的地方官职，负责处理当地的行政及通商事务。
description.en: A local official position established by the Qing dynasty in the Shanghai area, responsible for handling local administrative and commercial affairs.

description.zh-cn: 英国外交官，继巴富尔后任英国驻上海领事。他推动了上海英租界的扩张，并倡议建立统一的租界市政管理机构。
description.en: A British diplomat who succeeded George Balfour as the British Consul in Shanghai. He promoted the expansion of the Shanghai British Concession and advocated for the establishment of a unified municipal administration for the concessions.

description.zh-cn: 1848年发生于上海青浦的民众与英国传教士的冲突事件，被英国领事阿礼国用作扩大英租界的借口。
description.en: A conflict between locals and British missionaries in Qingpu, Shanghai, in March 1848, which was used by British Consul Rutherford Alcock as a pretext to expand the British Concession.

description.zh-cn: 时任法国驻华公使。他最初同意英美法租界合并管理的建议，但随后撤回支持，导致法国最终未加入上海公共租界。
description.en: The French Minister to China at the time. He initially agreed to the proposal for a joint administration of the British, American, and French concessions, but later withdrew his support, leading to France not joining the Shanghai International Settlement.

description.zh-cn: 旗昌洋行大班，19世纪60年代初倡议并推动了上海英租界与美租界的合并。
description.en: The head of Russell & Co., who advocated for and promoted the merger of the Shanghai British and American concessions in the early 1860s.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国驻上海领事，19世纪60年代初倡议并推动了上海英租界与美租界的合并。
description.en: The U.S. Consul in Shanghai at the time, who advocated for and promoted the merger of the Shanghai British and American concessions in the early 1860s.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙首都，也是普拉西多·多明哥的出生地。
description.en: The capital city of Spain and the birthplace of Plácido Domingo.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国洛杉矶的歌剧公司，普拉西多·多明哥曾在此担任总监。
description.en: An opera company in Los Angeles, USA, where Plácido Domingo served as General Director.

description.zh-cn: 2019冠状病毒病在墨西哥的爆发情况，普拉西多·多明哥在此期间被确诊感染。
description.en: The outbreak of COVID-19 in Mexico, during which Plácido Domingo was diagnosed with the virus.

description.zh-cn: 1985年9月19日发生在墨西哥城的一场大地震，导致普拉西多·多明哥的多位亲人罹难。
description.en: A major earthquake that struck Mexico City on September 19, 1985, in which several of Plácido Domingo's relatives were killed.

description.zh-cn: 意大利男高音歌唱家，与多明哥、卡雷拉斯并称为世界三大男高音。
description.en: Italian operatic tenor, known as one of The Three Tenors along with Domingo and Carreras.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙男高音歌唱家，与多明哥、帕瓦罗蒂并称为世界三大男高音。
description.en: Spanish operatic tenor, known as one of The Three Tenors along with Domingo and Pavarotti.

description.zh-cn: 由帕瓦罗蒂、多明哥和卡雷拉斯于世界杯期间共同举办的一系列获得巨大成功的演唱会。
description.en: A series of hugely successful concerts given by Luciano Pavarotti, Plácido Domingo, and José Carreras during the FIFA World Cups.

description.zh-cn: 1990年在意大利举办的国际足联世界杯，首场三大男高音演唱会在此期间举行。
description.en: The FIFA World Cup held in Italy in 1990, during which the first Three Tenors concert took place.

description.zh-cn: 中国作曲家、指挥家，创作了歌剧《秦始皇》。
description.en: Chinese composer and conductor who wrote the opera 'The First Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 由谭盾作曲的歌剧，普拉西多·多明哥在其全球首演中饰演主角秦始皇。
description.en: An opera composed by Tan Dun, in which Plácido Domingo starred as the title character, Qin Shi Huang, in its world premiere.

zh-cn: 皇家马德里足球俱乐部

description.zh-cn: 位于西班牙马德里的足球俱乐部，普拉西多·多明哥是其忠实支持者。
description.en: A football club based in Madrid, Spain, of which Plácido Domingo is a staunch supporter.

description.zh-cn: 波兰人民共和国的执政党，在1989年的选举中被团结工会击败，后于1990年停止活动。
description.en: The ruling party of the Polish People's Republic, which was defeated by Solidarity in the 1989 elections and ceased its activities in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 在苏共二十大批判斯大林后，于斯大林故乡格鲁吉亚爆发的大规模示威游行，后遭苏联军队镇压。
description.en: Large-scale demonstrations that broke out in Stalin's homeland of Georgia after the 20th Congress of the CPSU criticized him, which were later suppressed by the Soviet army.

description.zh-cn: 匈牙利共产党领导人，在苏共二十大后，因苏共压力被迫下台。
description.en: Leader of the Hungarian Communist Party who was forced to step down under pressure from the CPSU after the 20th Congress.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年之父，香港纺织业商人，与前中共中央总书记江泽民关系密切。
description.en: Father of Henry Tang, a Hong Kong textile industrialist who had a close relationship with former CCP General Secretary Jiang Zemin.

zh-cn: 香港特别行政区财政司司长

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区政府中掌管财政、金融及经济的最高级官员。
description.en: The Financial Secretary is the official in the Government of Hong Kong in charge of finance, treasury, and the economy.

en: Secretary for Commerce, Industry and Technology

description.zh-cn: 前香港特别行政区政府工商及科技局的负责人。
description.en: The former head of the Commerce, Industry and Technology Bureau of the Government of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 2003年为振兴香港经济而举办的大型音乐节，但因组织混乱和账目问题引发巨大争议。
description.en: A large-scale music festival held in 2003 to revitalize Hong Kong's economy, which sparked significant controversy due to organizational chaos and accounting issues.

description.zh-cn: 前香港投资推广署署长，因维港巨星汇事件与唐英年产生争议。
description.en: Former Director-General of Investment Promotion in Hong Kong, who had a dispute with Henry Tang over the Harbour Fest event.

description.zh-cn: 负责发展及营运香港西九文化区的法定机构。
description.en: A statutory body responsible for developing and operating the West Kowloon Cultural District in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 香港总商会总裁，曾任唐英年的政务助理，被传与唐英年有婚外情。
description.en: CEO of the Hong Kong General Chamber of Commerce, former political assistant to Henry Tang, and rumored to have had an extramarital affair with him.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚政治人物，现任斯洛文尼亚总统。
description.en: Slovenian politician, the current President of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚政治人物，现任斯洛文尼亚总理。
description.en: Slovenian politician, the current Prime Minister of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚的两院制立法机构。
description.en: The bicameral legislature of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚议会的下议院。
description.en: The lower house of the Slovenian Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 1991年斯洛文尼亚宣布独立后，与试图阻止其独立的南斯拉夫人民军之间发生的短暂军事冲突。战争以斯洛文尼亚的胜利告终，确保了其独立地位。
description.en: A brief military conflict in 1991 between Slovenia and the Yugoslav People's Army, which tried to prevent its independence after the declaration. The war ended in a Slovenian victory, securing its independence.

description.zh-cn: 使用欧盟的官方货币欧元作为其唯一法定货币的欧盟成员国所组成的货币同盟。
description.en: A monetary union of European Union member states that have adopted the euro as their sole legal tender.

description.zh-cn: 一个允许成员国之间人员自由流动的区域，基于申根公约建立。
description.en: An area comprising 27 European countries that have officially abolished all passport and all other types of border control at their mutual borders.

zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人国
en: State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国崩溃后短暂成立的国家，其领土由斯洛文尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人组成，后并入塞尔维亚人、克罗埃西亚人和斯洛维尼亚人王国。
description.en: A short-lived state formed after the collapse of Austria-Hungary, composed of territories inhabited by Slovenes, Croats, and Serbs, which later merged into the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.

description.zh-cn: 两次世界大战之间的匈牙利国家。第二次世界大战期间曾兼并斯洛文尼亚部分地区。
description.en: The state of Hungary between the two World Wars. It annexed parts of Slovenia during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚的首都及最大城市。
description.en: The capital and largest city of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 连接沈阳和大连的高速公路，是中华人民共和国第一条高速公路。
description.en: The expressway connecting Shenyang and Dalian, which was the first expressway in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院为振兴东北地区经济而提出的国家战略。
description.en: A national strategy proposed by the State Council of the People's Republic of China to revitalize the economy of the Northeast region.

description.zh-cn: 中国短跑运动员，首位代表中国参加奥林匹克运动会的运动员，曾为东北大学学生。
description.en: A Chinese sprinter, the first athlete to represent China at the Olympic Games, and a former student of Northeastern University.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇之兄，东汉末年官员，曾任兖州刺史。
description.en: Older brother of Liu Yao, an official in the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as the Inspector of Yan Province.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇的伯父，东汉时期官至太尉。
description.en: Liu Yao's paternal uncle, who reached the high position of Grand Marshal (Taiwei) during the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年人物。初依附刘繇，奉命增援朱皓时却将其杀害并夺取豫章郡，后被刘繇讨伐并败亡。
description.en: A figure in the late Eastern Han dynasty. He initially aligned with Liu Yao, but when sent to reinforce Zhu Hao, he killed him and seized Yuzhang Commandery. He was subsequently attacked and defeated by Liu Yao.

description.zh-cn: 东汉名将朱俊之子。被朝廷任命为豫章太守，后被刘繇派来增援的笮融所杀。
description.en: Son of the famous Eastern Han general Zhu Jun. He was appointed by the Han court as the Grand Administrator of Yuzhang but was killed by Ze Rong, who had been sent by Liu Yao as reinforcements.

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期的十三州之一，州治原在寿春，后因战乱，刘繇在曲阿建立统治。
description.en: One of the thirteen provinces of the Eastern Han dynasty. Its capital was originally in Shouchun, but due to wartime chaos, Liu Yao established his administration in Qu'a.

description.zh-cn: 孙策的舅舅。原为袁术部下，奉命迎接刘繇，后因刘繇忌惮孙氏势力而被驱逐。
description.en: Sun Ce's maternal uncle. Originally a subordinate of Yuan Shu, he was ordered to welcome Liu Yao but was later expelled due to Liu Yao's fear of the Sun clan's growing influence.

description.zh-cn: 孙策的堂兄。原为袁术部下，与吴景一同迎接刘繇，后同被驱逐。
description.en: Sun Ce's older cousin. Originally a subordinate of Yuan Shu, he welcomed Liu Yao along with Wu Jing and was later expelled with him.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇之子。
description.en: Son of Liu Yao.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党员。曾任青岛陆军总医院护理员、空军医学院看护中士。战后赴台参与中共中央社会部台湾工作站活动，担任交通员，后在苏艺林等案中被中华民国政府判处死刑并枪决。后被中华人民共和国追认为烈士。
description.en: A member of the Communist Party of China. He served as a nursing assistant at Qingdao Army General Hospital and a nursing sergeant at the Air Force Medical College. After the war, he went to Taiwan to participate in the activities of the Taiwan Workstation of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP, serving as a courier. He was later sentenced to death and executed by the Republic of China government in the Su Yilin et al. case. He was posthumously recognized as a martyr by the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央社会部台湾工作站成员，吸收安学林加入组织。后在苏艺林等案中被判处死刑，与安学林等人一同被枪决。
description.en: A member of the Taiwan Workstation of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP, he recruited An Xuelin into the organization. He was later sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央社会部台湾工作站成员，与安学林、陈平在同一小组。后在苏艺林等案中被判处死刑，与安学林等人一同被枪决。
description.en: A member of the Taiwan Workstation of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP, he was in the same small group as An Xuelin and Chen Ping. He was later sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央社会部台湾工作站成员，负责军事情搜。后在苏艺林等案中被判处死刑，与安学林等人一同被枪决。
description.en: A member of the Taiwan Workstation of the Central Social Affairs Department of the CCP, responsible for military intelligence gathering. He was later sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国授予为国家和人民利益牺牲者的荣誉称号。安学林被追认为烈士。
description.en: An honorary title conferred by the People's Republic of China on those who sacrificed their lives for the interests of the country and the people. An Xuelin was posthumously recognized as a martyr.

description.zh-cn: 在苏艺林等案中被判处死刑，于1951年6月29日与安学林等人一同被枪决。
description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.zh-cn: 在苏艺林等案中被判处死刑，于1951年6月29日与安学林等人一同被枪决。
description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.en: Sentenced to death in the Su Yilin et al. case and executed along with An Xuelin and others on June 29, 1951.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家、政治人物，曾任中国民间商会副会长、中国泛海控股集团董事长兼总裁。
description.en: A Chinese entrepreneur and politician, formerly served as the Vice Chairman of the China Chamber of Commerce for the Private Sector, and Chairman and President of China Oceanwide Holdings Group.

zh-cn: 泛海控股股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 一家中国的综合性企业集团，业务涵盖金融、房地产、能源等领域。
description.en: A Chinese conglomerate with businesses in finance, real estate, energy, and other sectors.

description.zh-cn: 思科系统的首席执行官兼董事长。
description.en: CEO and Chairman of Cisco Systems.

description.zh-cn: 一个专门制造家用网络设备的品牌，曾于2003年被思科收购，后于2013年被出售给Belkin。
description.en: A brand of home networking equipment, which was acquired by Cisco in 2003 and later sold to Belkin in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国资安公司，于2023年被思科收购。
description.en: An American cybersecurity company, acquired by Cisco in 2023.

zh-cn: 全国公安工作信息化工程

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一个网络安全监控系统，思科被指控与其有商业合作。
description.en: A network security surveillance system in the People's Republic of China, with which Cisco is accused of having commercial cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 美国前中央情报局雇员，因在2013年泄露了美国国家安全局的棱镜计划等机密而闻名。
description.en: A former Central Intelligence Agency employee, known for leaking classified information from the National Security Agency in 2013, including details of the PRISM surveillance program.

description.zh-cn: 一个旨在促进雾计算兴趣和发展的联盟，由思科等公司和机构共同创立。
description.en: A consortium founded to promote interest and development in fog computing, co-founded by companies and institutions including Cisco.

description.zh-cn: 一家英国半导体和软件设计公司，OpenFog Consortium的创始成员之一。
description.en: A British semiconductor and software design company, one of the founding members of the OpenFog Consortium.

description.zh-cn: 时任淞沪警备司令部第二处处长，侦破了荣德生绑架案。
description.en: Then director of the Second Division of the Songhu Garrison Command, who solved the Rong Desheng kidnapping case.

description.zh-cn: 时任淞沪警备司令部警卫队长，参与了绑架荣德生的案件。
description.en: Then captain of the guard at the Songhu Garrison Command, who was involved in the kidnapping of Rong Desheng.

description.zh-cn: 指在中国近代史上，由中国人投资、经营的，使用机器进行生产的资本主义企业主阶层。
description.en: Refers to the class of capitalist entrepreneurs in modern Chinese history who invested in and operated enterprises using machinery.

description.zh-cn: 荣德生之子。
description.en: Son of Rong Desheng.

description.zh-cn: 一家在香港交易所上市的综合企业公司，荣智健曾任该公司主席。
description.en: A conglomerate company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, where Larry Yung served as chairman.

description.zh-cn: 中国浙江省宁波市下辖的一个县，是黄兴国的出生地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, China, and the birthplace of Huang Xingguo.

zh-cn: 2015年天津港危化品仓库爆炸事故

description.zh-cn: 2015年8月12日在天津港发生的特大安全事故，时任市长黄兴国表示要对此负起主要责任。
description.en: A major safety accident that occurred at the Port of Tianjin on August 12, 2015. Then-mayor Huang Xingguo stated he would take primary responsibility for the incident.

description.zh-cn: 天津市高官，曾任天津市副市长，在黄兴国之前落马。
description.en: A high-ranking official in Tianjin who served as Vice Mayor of Tianjin. He fell from power before Huang Xingguo.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任基隆市市长。
description.en: Taiwanese politician, former mayor of Keelung City.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政商界人士，曾任外贸协会董事长。
description.en: Taiwanese political and business figure, former chairman of the Taiwan External Trade Development Council.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省台州市的市辖区和市政府所在地。黄兴国主政台州时，力主将市府迁至此地。
description.en: A municipal district and the seat of the city government of Taizhou, Zhejiang. When Huang Xingguo was in charge of Taizhou, he strongly advocated for moving the city government to this location.

description.zh-cn: 东北军内部支持张学良联合中共抗日政策的年轻军官团体。在西安事变后因对和平解决方案不满而发动“二二事件”，杀害了元老派将领王以哲。
description.en: A group of young officers within the Northeastern Army who supported Zhang Xueliang's policy of uniting with the CCP to resist Japan. Dissatisfied with the peaceful resolution of the Xi'an Incident, they initiated the 'February 2nd Incident' and assassinated the veteran general Wang Yizhe.

description.zh-cn: 东北军将领，第一〇五师师长。在“二二事件”中，为替其至交王以哲报仇，处决了行刺的军官。
description.en: A general of the Northeastern Army and commander of the 105th Division. During the 'February 2nd Incident,' he executed the assassin to avenge his close friend Wang Yizhe.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军，中国共产党在1927年至1937年间领导的武装力量。曾与被调至陕甘的东北军作战。
description.en: The Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, the armed forces led by the Communist Party of China from 1927 to 1937. It fought against the Northeastern Army when the latter was transferred to Shaanxi and Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 周朝第八位君主。因秦国先祖非子善于养马，将其封于秦地，成为秦国的开端。
description.en: The eighth king of the Zhou dynasty. He enfeoffed Feizi, an ancestor of the Qin state, in the land of Qin due to his skill in horse breeding, marking the beginning of the Qin state.

description.zh-cn: 秦国始祖，因善于养马被周孝王封为附庸。
description.en: The founder of the state of Qin, who was made a vassal by King Xiao of Zhou for his expertise in horse breeding.

description.zh-cn: 周平王将都城从镐京迁至雒邑的重大历史事件，标志着西周的结束和东周的开始。
description.en: The major historical event in which King Ping of Zhou moved the capital from Haojing to Luoyi, marking the end of the Western Zhou and the beginning of the Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期秦国君主，称霸西戎，奠定了秦国作为春秋四大强国的基础。
description.en: A ruler of Qin during the Spring and Autumn period who dominated the Xirong tribes and laid the foundation for Qin to become one of the four major powers of the era.

description.zh-cn: 古代居于中国西部的民族部落统称，与秦国长期进行战争与交流。
description.en: A collective term for various ethnic tribes residing in the western regions of ancient China, who engaged in long-term warfare and exchange with the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期秦国国君，任用商鞅实行变法，使秦国国力大增，为日后统一六国奠定坚实基础。
description.en: A ruler of Qin during the Warring States period who appointed Shang Yang to carry out reforms, which greatly strengthened the state and laid a solid foundation for the future unification of the Six States.

description.zh-cn: 商朝末年帝辛的宠臣，秦国的先祖之一。在周初三监之乱后被周成王所杀。
description.en: A favored minister of King Di Xin at the end of the Shang dynasty and an ancestor of the Qin state. He was killed by King Cheng of Zhou after the Rebellion of the Three Guards.

description.zh-cn: 西周第二代君主，平定了三监之乱，并在此过程中诛杀了蜚廉。
description.en: The second king of the Western Zhou dynasty, who suppressed the Rebellion of the Three Guards and executed Fei Lian in the process.

description.zh-cn: 秦国早期君主，受周宣王之命讨伐西戎，但在战争中战死。
description.en: An early ruler of Qin who was ordered by King Xuan of Zhou to attack the Xirong but was killed in battle.

description.zh-cn: 西周第十一代君主，曾命令秦仲讨伐西戎。
description.en: The eleventh king of the Western Zhou dynasty, who once ordered Zhong of Qin to attack the Xirong.

description.zh-cn: 晋国君主，在殽之战中大败秦军。
description.en: A ruler of the State of Jin who inflicted a major defeat on the Qin army at the Battle of Yao.

description.zh-cn: 古代位于中国西北的戎狄部落国家，其王被宣太后诱杀，领土被秦国吞并。
description.en: An ancient Rong-Di tribal state in northwestern China whose king was lured to his death by Queen Dowager Xuan, after which its territory was annexed by Qin.

description.zh-cn: 晋国君主，在秦穆公的帮助下回国即位，但后来与秦国交恶，被秦军俘虏。
description.en: A ruler of the State of Jin who returned to his state and ascended the throne with the help of Duke Mu of Qin, but later had a falling out with Qin and was captured by the Qin army.

description.zh-cn: 一次由以色列国防军于乌干达恩德培国际机场策划的反劫机任务。
description.en: A counter-terrorist hostage-rescue mission carried out by commandos of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) at Entebbe Airport in Uganda.

description.zh-cn: 以色列的第二大城市。
description.en: The second most populous city in Israel.

zh-cn: 2014年乌鲁木齐火车南站暴力恐怖袭击案件

description.zh-cn: 2014年发生在中国新疆乌鲁木齐的恐怖袭击事件，发生在习近平视察新疆的最后一天，是促使当局加强治疆政策和发起“反恐人民战争”的系列事件之一。
description.en: A terrorist attack that occurred in Ürümqi, Xinjiang, China in 2014. It took place on the last day of Xi Jinping's inspection tour of Xinjiang and was one of a series of events that prompted authorities to strengthen their Xinjiang policies and launch the 'People's War on Terror'.

zh-cn: 严厉打击暴力恐怖活动专项行动
en: Strike Hard Campaign Against Violent Terrorism

description.zh-cn: 2014年起，在习近平指示下，中国当局在新疆发起的反恐运动。新疆再教育营是该运动的一部分。
description.en: A counter-terrorism campaign launched by Chinese authorities in Xinjiang starting in 2014 under the direction of Xi Jinping. The Xinjiang re-education camps are part of this campaign.

description.zh-cn: 前新疆莎车县委书记，因释放超过7000名再教育营人员等行为，被以“严重违背党中央治疆方略”等罪名双开。
description.en: Former Party Secretary of Shache (Yarkant) County in Xinjiang. He was expelled from the Party and public office for actions such as releasing over 7,000 re-education camp detainees, under charges including 'gravely contravening the Party Central Committee's strategy for governing Xinjiang'.

en: UN Human Rights Office report on Xinjiang
OHCHR Assessment of human rights concerns in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 由联合国人权事务高级专员办事处发布的关于新疆人权状况的评估报告。报告指出，中国政府在新疆的行为可能构成危害人类罪，并记录了“严重的侵犯人权行为”。
description.en: An assessment report on the human rights situation in Xinjiang published by the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights. The report stated that the actions of the Chinese government in Xinjiang may constitute crimes against humanity and documented 'serious human rights violations'.

description.zh-cn: 时任联合国人权事务高级专员，曾于2022年5月到访中国，并于同年8月发布了《联合国新疆人权报告》。
description.en: Then-UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, who visited China in May 2022 and released the 'UN Xinjiang Human Rights Report' in August of the same year.

zh-cn: 联合国人权事务高级专员办事处
en: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights

description.zh-cn: 联合国的下属机构，负责促进和保护国际法中所保障的人权。该机构发布了关于新疆人权问题的评估报告。
description.en: A department of the United Nations Secretariat that works to promote and protect human rights that are guaranteed under international law. The office published an assessment report on human rights concerns in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 由国际调查记者同盟公布的一批2017年以来的中国政府机密文件，详细介绍了新疆再教育营的运作手册。
description.en: A set of classified Chinese government documents from 2017 onwards, published by the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists, which details the operational manual of the Xinjiang re-education camps.

description.zh-cn: 一份于2020年2月曝光的137页文件，描述了新疆再教育营部分关押人员及其家庭的详细情况。
description.en: A 137-page document leaked in February 2020, which describes the detailed situations of some detainees and their families in the Xinjiang re-education camps.

description.zh-cn: 一批由黑客入侵中国警方电脑系统后获得的档案，于2022年5月被披露。文件包含了数千份文件、2万多名被捕维吾尔人的信息，以及陈全国和赵克志的内部讲话，揭示了再教育营的运作细节和高层指令。
description.en: A collection of archives obtained after hackers breached Chinese police computer systems, disclosed in May 2022. The files include thousands of documents, information on over 20,000 arrested Uyghurs, and internal speeches by Chen Quanguo and Zhao Kezhi, revealing operational details of the re-education camps and high-level directives.

description.zh-cn: 德国人类学学者，对新疆再教育营进行了深入研究，并接收和分析了被泄露的“新疆公安文件”。
description.en: German anthropologist who has conducted extensive research on the Xinjiang re-education camps and received and analyzed the leaked 'Xinjiang Police Files'.

description.zh-cn: 德国外交部长。在“新疆公安文件”披露后，她与中国外长王毅通话时呼吁中方澄清新疆人权的真相。
description.en: German Foreign Minister. After the disclosure of the 'Xinjiang Police Files', she called on China to clarify the truth about human rights in Xinjiang during a call with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi.

description.zh-cn: 维吾尔族足球运动员，据报道于2018年返乡探亲时被送入再教育营，后于2019年2月回归球场。
description.en: Uyghur football player who was reportedly sent to a re-education camp in 2018 while visiting his parents. He returned to the football field in February 2019.

description.zh-cn: 新疆大学教授，知名人类学家，研究伊斯兰圣地、民歌和民间传说。据报道于2017年底被拘留后失踪。
description.en: Professor at Xinjiang University, a renowned anthropologist who studied Islamic holy sites, folk songs, and folklore. She reportedly disappeared after being detained in late 2017.

description.zh-cn: 世界维吾尔代表大会主席，其母亲阿依罕·买买提据报道在再教育营中去世。
description.en: President of the World Uyghur Congress, whose mother, Ayhan Memet, reportedly died in a re-education camp.

description.zh-cn: 晚清经学家、文学家，帝王之学的倡导者，曾任国史馆馆长。杨度、蔡锷等人均出其门下。
description.en: A classicist and writer of the late Qing Dynasty, an advocate of 'imperial arts,' and served as the head of the National History Bureau. Yang Du, Cai E, and others were his students.

description.zh-cn: 清末负责筹备宪政的专门机构。
description.en: A special institution in the late Qing Dynasty responsible for preparing for constitutional government.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯时期设立的政治咨询机构，取代了国会的部分职能。
description.en: A political advisory body established during the Yuan Shikai period, which replaced some functions of the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛的母亲。
description.en: Mother of Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，曾任行政院副院长。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, former Vice Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，美丽岛事件受刑人之一。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, one of the defendants in the Formosa Incident.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物，姚嘉文的妻子。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China, spouse of Yao Chia-wen.

description.zh-cn: 台湾争议性宗教人物。
description.en: A controversial religious figure in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the Republic of China.

zh-cn: 台北驻日经济文化代表处

description.zh-cn: 中华民国在日本的实质大使馆。
description.en: The de facto embassy of the Republic of China in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 民主进步党内的一个派系。
description.en: A faction within the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第十二任总统、副总统选举。
description.en: The 12th presidential and vice-presidential election of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾台北市下的一个区。
description.en: A district in Taipei, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 东晋时期的权臣、军事家。他曾三次北伐，并废黜皇帝司马奕，独揽朝政，有篡位之心，但最终因谢安等人的周旋而未能实现。
description.en: A powerful minister and military general of the Eastern Jin dynasty. He conducted three northern expeditions, deposed Emperor Sima Yi, and held absolute power at court with intentions of usurping the throne, a plan ultimately thwarted by the efforts of Xie An and others.

description.zh-cn: 东晋将领，谢安之侄。他组建并统率了精锐的北府兵，在淝水之战中担任前锋，取得了决定性的胜利。
description.en: A general of the Eastern Jin dynasty and the nephew of Xie An. He formed and commanded the elite Beifu Army (Northern Garrison Army) and served as the vanguard commander in the Battle of Fei River, securing a decisive victory.

description.zh-cn: 中国历史上在西晋灭亡后，由司马氏皇族在江南建立的政权。
description.en: A dynasty in Chinese history established by the Sima imperial clan in the Jiangnan region after the fall of the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东晋时期的一支精锐军队，由谢玄在广陵地区招募和组建，是淝水之战中东晋获胜的主力。
description.en: An elite military unit of the Eastern Jin dynasty, recruited and formed by Xie Xuan in the Guangling region. It was the main force that secured victory for the Eastern Jin in the Battle of Fei River.

description.zh-cn: 东晋大臣，出身太原王氏。他与谢安一同联合，周旋于权臣桓温之间，共同维护东晋的政权稳定。
description.en: A minister of the Eastern Jin dynasty from the Taiyuan Wang clan. He allied with Xie An to maneuver against the powerful minister Huan Wen, jointly safeguarding the stability of the Eastern Jin regime.

description.zh-cn: 东晋孝武帝。在淝水之战后，因谢安功高望重而对其产生猜忌。
description.en: Emperor Xiaowu of Jin. After the Battle of Fei River, he grew suspicious of Xie An due to his immense prestige and achievements.

description.zh-cn: 南朝陈宣帝陈顼的次子，始兴王。他曾挖掘谢安的坟墓，抛弃其棺椁，以安葬自己的母亲。
description.en: The second son of Emperor Xuan of Chen, Chen Xu, and the Prince of Shixing during the Chen dynasty of the Southern Dynasties. He desecrated Xie An's tomb, discarding the coffin to bury his own mother in its place.

description.zh-cn: 东晋时期著名书法家，被誉为“书圣”。谢安曾向他学习行书。
description.en: A renowned calligrapher of the Eastern Jin dynasty, known as the 'Sage of Calligraphy'. Xie An studied running script calligraphy under him.

description.zh-cn: 古代地名，属陈郡，位于今河南省太康县，是谢安的出生地。
description.en: An ancient place name, part of Chen Commandery, located in modern-day Taikang County, Henan Province. It is the birthplace of Xie An.

description.zh-cn: 根据2013年国务院机构改革方案组建，由交通运输部管理，承担原铁道部的行政职责。
description.en: Established in 2013 under the State Council's institutional reform plan, it is managed by the Ministry of Transport and assumes the administrative functions of the former Ministry of Railways.

zh-cn: 中国铁路哈尔滨局集团

description.zh-cn: 原铁道部下属的铁路局之一。
description.en: One of the railway bureaus under the former Ministry of Railways.

description.en: One of the railway bureaus under the former Ministry of Railways.

description.en: One of the railway bureaus under the former Ministry of Railways.

description.en: Chinese politician who served as Minister of Railways.

description.en: Chinese politician who served as Minister of Railways.

description.en: Chinese politician who served as Minister of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 美国夏威夷州檀香山的市郡政府，负责主要的市政服务。
description.en: The city-county government of Honolulu, Hawaii, USA, responsible for major municipal services.

description.zh-cn: 美国歌手，在檀香山出生长大。
description.en: American singer, born and raised in Honolulu.

description.zh-cn: 韩国男子团体TOMORROW X TOGETHER成员，出生于檀香山。
description.en: Member of the South Korean boy band TOMORROW X TOGETHER, born in Honolulu.

description.zh-cn: 耶鲁大学毕业生，骷髅会的创始人。
description.en: A graduate of Yale University and the founder of Skull and Bones.

description.zh-cn: 与骷髅会关系密切的美国政治世家，是美国石油和军火商集团的代言人。
description.en: An American political family with close ties to Skull and Bones, representing the interests of American oil and arms dealer groups.

description.zh-cn: 美国著名杂志，由骷髅会成员亨利·卢斯创办。
description.en: A famous American magazine founded by Skull and Bones member Henry Luce.

description.zh-cn: 前美国驻华大使、助理国务卿，骷髅会成员。
description.en: A former U.S. Ambassador to China, Assistant Secretary of State, and a member of Skull and Bones.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司的联合创始人。
description.en: Co-founder of Baidu.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市海淀区的科技中心，百度公司在此创立。
description.en: A technology hub in Haidian District, Beijing, China, where Baidu was founded.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司于2010年1月12日遭受的严重黑客攻击，导致网站长时间无法访问。
description.en: A severe hacker attack on Baidu on January 12, 2010, which resulted in a prolonged service outage.

description.zh-cn: 中国的在线旅游信息网站，曾获百度投资，后与携程网合并。
description.en: A Chinese online travel information website that received investment from Baidu and later merged with Ctrip.

description.zh-cn: 中国的汽车制造商，与百度合作组建智能汽车公司。
description.en: A Chinese automotive manufacturer that partnered with Baidu to form a smart car company.

description.zh-cn: 由百度和吉利控股集团共同投资成立的智能汽车公司。
description.en: A smart car company jointly invested in by Baidu and Geely Holding Group.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司在日本设立的子公司，于2015年停止了在日本的搜索业务。
description.en: Baidu's subsidiary in Japan, which ceased its search engine operations in Japan in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 前索尼董事长，曾任百度独立董事。
description.en: Former chairman of Sony, who served as an independent director at Baidu.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司前首席财务官，于2007年12月在休假期间去世。
description.en: Former CFO of Baidu, who passed away during a vacation in December 2007.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司前公关副总裁，因其在社交媒体上发布的争议性言论引发公关危机并离职。
description.en: Former Vice President of Public Relations at Baidu, who resigned after a PR crisis caused by her controversial statements on social media.

description.zh-cn: 百度公司推出的社交网络服务，于2015年4月21日正式关闭。
description.en: A social networking service launched by Baidu, which was officially shut down on April 21, 2015.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，第十三届全国人民代表大会贵州省代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China and a deputy from Guizhou Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 清朝儒士，曾在严复10岁时担任其家庭教师。
description.en: A Confucian scholar of the Qing dynasty who served as Yan Fu's home tutor when Yan was 10 years old.

description.zh-cn: 清朝外交家，在严复留学英国期间与其结为忘年交。
description.en: A Qing dynasty diplomat who became a close friend of Yan Fu during his studies in the UK.

description.zh-cn: 严复等人在天津创办的报刊，宣传变法维新思想，因报道戊戌政变详情被勒令停办。
description.en: A newspaper founded by Yan Fu and others in Tianjin to promote reformist ideas, it was ordered to cease publication for reporting details of the Wuxu Coup.

description.zh-cn: 英国生物学家，其著作《进化论与伦理学》被严复翻译为《天演论》，深刻影响了中国。
description.en: An English biologist whose work 'Evolution and Ethics' was translated by Yan Fu as 'Tian Yan Lun', profoundly influencing China.

description.zh-cn: 中国明清科举考试的一种文体，被严复等维新派人士认为是禁锢思想、摧残人才的制度。
description.en: A literary style used in the imperial examinations in Ming and Qing dynasties, regarded by reformers like Yan Fu as a system that stifled thought and wasted talent.

location.en: Yangqi Village, Gaishan Town, Fuzhou City

description.zh-cn: 严复及其夫人的合葬墓，位于福建省福州市。在文化大革命期间曾遭破坏。
description.en: The joint tomb of Yan Fu and his wife, located in Fuzhou, Fujian Province. It was damaged during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 由彭明敏、谢聪敏、魏廷朝于1964年共同起草的文件，主要内容为“反攻大陆”绝对不可能，并要求制定新宪法及建立新国家。
description.en: A document drafted by Peng Ming-min, Hsieh Tsung-min, and Wei Ting-chao in 1964, which argued that 'counterattacking the mainland' was impossible and called for a new constitution and the establishment of a new state.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾与彭明敏、魏廷朝共同起草《台湾自救运动宣言》。
description.en: A Taiwanese political figure who co-authored the 'Declaration of Formosan Self-Salvation' with Peng Ming-min and Wei Ting-chao.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾与彭明敏、谢聪敏共同起草《台湾自救运动宣言》。
description.en: A Taiwanese political figure who co-authored the 'Declaration of Formosan Self-Salvation' with Peng Ming-min and Hsieh Tsung-min.

description.zh-cn: 位于加拿大蒙特利尔的大学，彭明敏于1953年在此取得国际航空法硕士学位。
description.en: A university in Montreal, Canada, from which Peng Ming-min obtained his master's degree in International Air Law in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏的父亲，医师，曾任高雄市参议会第一任议长。
description.en: Peng Ming-min's father, a physician who served as the first speaker of the Kaohsiung City Council.

description.zh-cn: 日本台独运动人士，制作假护照协助彭明敏于1970年逃离台湾。
description.en: A Japanese activist in the Taiwan independence movement who created a fake passport to help Peng Ming-min escape from Taiwan in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 前中华民国总统府资政，与彭明敏等人联名劝退蔡英文竞选连任。
description.en: Former Senior Advisor to the President of the Republic of China, who co-signed a letter with Peng Ming-min and others urging Tsai Ing-wen not to seek re-election.

description.zh-cn: 台湾基督长老教会牧师，与彭明敏等人联名劝退蔡英文竞选连任。
description.en: A pastor of the Presbyterian Church in Taiwan, who co-signed a letter with Peng Ming-min and others urging Tsai Ing-wen not to seek re-election.

en: National Highest Science and Technology Award

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆科学界的最高荣誉。屠呦呦于2017年获得2016年度该奖项。
description.en: The highest honor in the scientific community of mainland China. Tu Youyou received the 2016 award in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代诗歌开端，最早的一部诗歌总集。屠呦呦的名字源自其中“呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿”的诗句。
description.en: The earliest collection of Chinese poetry and the beginning of Chinese poetic tradition. Tu Youyou's name was inspired by the line 'Youyou the deer cry, eating the artemisia of the wild'.

description.zh-cn: 爱尔兰生物学家，因发现治疗蟠尾丝虫症的药物与大村智和屠呦呦共同获得2015年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: An Irish biologist who, along with Satoshi Ōmura and Tu Youyou, was awarded the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his discoveries concerning a novel therapy against Onchocerciasis.

description.zh-cn: 日本生物化学家，因发现治疗蟠尾丝虫症的药物与威廉·C·坎贝尔和屠呦呦共同获得2015年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: A Japanese biochemist who, along with William C. Campbell and Tu Youyou, was awarded the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his discoveries concerning a novel therapy against Onchocerciasis.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的最高荣誉勋章，屠呦呦于2019年获得该勋章。
description.en: The highest order of honor of the People's Republic of China. Tu Youyou was awarded the medal in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，曾任原国家语言文字工作委员会机关党委书记、1986年全国语言文字工作会议副秘书长。退休后专注撰写政论，批判否定中国特色社会主义的舆论。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party, he served as the Party Committee Secretary of the former State Language Commission and the Deputy Secretary-General of the 1986 National Conference on Language and Script Work. After retirement, he focused on writing political treatises, criticizing opinions that negated Socialism with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 中国金融人物，自2018年9月起担任国家开发银行董事长。
description.en: A Chinese financial figure who has served as the Chairman of China Development Bank since September 2018.

description.zh-cn: 中国金融人物，自2023年5月起担任国家开发银行行长。

description.en: A national strategy proposed in the 11th Five-Year Plan of the People's Republic of China aimed at solving the "three rural issues".

description.zh-cn: 他是杨昌济的密友，两人常讨论国事，他还曾推荐杨昌济赴英国留学。
description.en: A close friend of Yang Changji, with whom he often discussed national affairs. He also recommended Yang Changji to study in the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济的儿子。
description.en: Son of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 位于英国苏格兰的大学，杨昌济曾在此留学。
description.en: A university in Scotland, United Kingdom, where Yang Changji studied.

description.zh-cn: 清末湖南的维新派政治团体，杨昌济曾加入。
description.en: A reformist political group in Hunan during the late Qing Dynasty, which Yang Changji joined.

description.en: Chinese politician, current Vice Minister and Party Group Member of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中央纪委国家监委驻工业和信息化部纪检监察组组长、工业和信息化部党组成员。
description.en: Chinese politician, current head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission stationed at the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and a member of the Party Group of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

en: WHO Framework Convention on Tobacco Control

description.zh-cn: 针对烟草的第一个世界范围的国际公约。工业和信息化部原为该公约在中国履约的牵头部门。
description.en: The first worldwide international treaty on tobacco. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology was formerly the lead department for its implementation in China.

description.zh-cn: 由中国互联网行业及与互联网相关的企事业单位、社会组织自愿结成的全国性、行业性、非营利性社会组织。2020年前由工业和信息化部主管。
description.en: A national, industry-specific, non-profit social organization voluntarily formed by enterprises, institutions, and social organizations in China's internet industry and related fields. It was supervised by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology before 2020.

description.en: Chinese politician, member of the China Zhi Gong Party, former Vice Minister of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 中国官员，曾任国家行政学院常务副院长，其职位后由何毅亭接任。
description.en: A Chinese official who served as Executive Vice President of the National Academy of Governance, a position later succeeded by He Yiting.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任天津市政协主席，是宋平顺的前任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Chairman of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the CPPCC, and predecessor of Song Pingshun.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替宋平顺担任天津市政协主席。
description.en: Chinese politician who succeeded Song Pingshun as Chairman of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪90年代初在中国天津市发生的一起轰动一时的非法集资丑闻，与时任天津市政法系统高官宋平顺有关。
description.en: A sensational illegal fundraising scandal that occurred in Tianjin, China in the early 1990s, linked to Song Pingshun, a high-ranking official in Tianjin's political and legal system at the time.

description.zh-cn: 宋平顺的情妇，曾利用与宋平顺的关系承包政府项目以谋取利益。
description.en: Song Pingshun's mistress, who used her relationship with him to secure government contracts for profit.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中共天津市委书记。在天津流传的民谣中与宋平顺、武长顺并提。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Secretary of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee. He was mentioned alongside Song Pingshun and Wu Changshun in a popular folk rhyme in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省常德市的行政管理机关，是临澧县人民政府的业务上级机构。
description.en: The administrative organ of Changde City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China, and the functional superior of the Linli County People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任临澧县人民政府县长，后因腐败问题被判处死刑，缓期执行。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former County Mayor of the Linli County People's Government, later sentenced to death with a reprieve for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省长沙市的中级人民法院，曾一审判处李大伦死缓。
description.en: The intermediate people's court of Changsha City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China, which sentenced Li Dalun to death with a reprieve in the first instance.

description.en: A political party in Japan during the Taishō period, which Hamaguchi Osachi joined in 1915.

description.zh-cn: 日本大正时代的政党，由立宪同志会等合并而成，滨口雄幸曾任其总务委员。
description.en: A political party in Japan during the Taishō period, formed by the merger of the Rikken Dōshikai and others. Hamaguchi Osachi served as a member of its general affairs committee.

description.zh-cn: 日本昭和前期的政党，滨口雄幸是其首任总裁。
description.en: A political party in early Shōwa period Japan. Hamaguchi Osachi was its first president.

description.zh-cn: 战前日本政府的中央行政机关之一，滨口雄幸曾任内务大臣。
description.en: One of the central administrative bodies of the pre-war Japanese government. Hamaguchi Osachi served as the Home Minister.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，曾任首相。滨口雄幸在其内阁中担任过内务大臣和（部分时期）大藏大臣，并在滨口内阁辞职后接任首相。
description.en: A Japanese politician who served as Prime Minister. Hamaguchi Osachi served as Home Minister and (for a period) Finance Minister in his cabinet. He also succeeded Hamaguchi as Prime Minister after his cabinet resigned.

description.zh-cn: 战前至2001年期间日本政府掌管财政、金融、税务的中央行政机关。滨口雄幸曾在此长期任职，并担任过大藏大臣。
description.en: The central administrative body of the Japanese government responsible for finance, banking, and taxation from the pre-war era until 2001. Hamaguchi Osachi had a long career here, eventually serving as Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 日本政治家，曾任首相及宪政会总裁。滨口雄幸在其内阁中担任大藏大臣。
description.en: A Japanese politician who served as Prime Minister and President of the Kenseikai party. Hamaguchi Osachi served as Minister of Finance in his cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 限制海军军备的国际条约，滨口雄幸内阁签署此条约，引发了日本军方和右翼势力的强烈不满。
description.en: An international treaty for the limitation of naval armament. The Hamaguchi cabinet's signing of this treaty caused strong dissatisfaction among the Japanese military and right-wing groups.

description.zh-cn: 对滨口雄幸内阁的裁军和经济政策感到不满的日本政治势力，其成员策划并实施了对滨口雄幸的刺杀。
description.en: Japanese political forces dissatisfied with the Hamaguchi cabinet's disarmament and economic policies. A member of one such group planned and carried out the assassination attempt on Hamaguchi Osachi.

description.zh-cn: 发生于滨口雄幸首相任内，日本军队在台湾镇压原住民时使用生化武器，事件引发国际谴责并冲击了滨口内阁。
description.en: An incident that occurred during Hamaguchi Osachi's premiership, in which the Japanese army used chemical weapons to suppress indigenous people in Taiwan. The event drew international condemnation and impacted the Hamaguchi cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 1997年在台北市发生的一起因拔河比赛安全措施不足导致的严重意外事件。
description.en: A serious accident that occurred in Taipei City in 1997 during a tug-of-war competition due to inadequate safety measures.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，民进党扁系立法委员。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician and a pro-Chen Shui-bian faction legislator of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，属中国国民党，曾任台北县县长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Kuomintang, who served as the Magistrate of Taipei County.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，属民主进步党，曾任中常委。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician of the Democratic Progressive Party, who has served as a member of the Central Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 天主教台湾地区主教团荣休主席、天主教台北总教区荣休总主教。
description.en: Archbishop Emeritus of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Taipei and President Emeritus of the Chinese Regional Bishops' Conference in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 罗文嘉的妻子。
description.en: The wife of Luo Wen-jia.

description.zh-cn: 台湾桃园市下辖的市辖区，为罗文嘉的出生地。
description.en: A district in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, and the birthplace of Luo Wen-jia.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国有关客家事务的最高主管机关，隶属于行政院。
description.en: The highest governing body for Hakka affairs in the Republic of China, under the Executive Yuan.

zh-cn: 行政院文化建设委员会

description.zh-cn: 中华民国文化事务的最高主管机关，自2012年起接管公广集团。
description.en: The highest authority for cultural affairs in the Republic of China, which has overseen the Taiwan Broadcasting System since 2012.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中国共产党甘孜藏族自治州委员会书记。

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省济南市的市辖区。
description.en: A municipal district of Jinan, Shandong Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业农村部管理的国家局。原为单设的国务院直属机构，2023年其职责被划入农业农村部，并在农业农村部加挂牌子。
description.en: A national administration managed by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China. It was formerly a separate agency directly under the State Council, and its functions were integrated into the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs in 2023, with its nameplate retained at the ministry.

description.en: A Chinese politician, currently a member of the Party Leadership Group of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, concurrently serving as the President of the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期设立的农业主管机构，是中华人民共和国农业部的前身。
description.en: The agricultural authority established in the early days of the People's Republic of China, and the predecessor to the Ministry of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经设立的林业主管机构，曾与农业部等合并为农林部。
description.en: A former ministry of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for forestry, which was once merged with the Ministry of Agriculture and others to form the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

description.zh-cn: 由原农业部、农垦部、国家水产总局于1982年合并设立的机构，1988年被撤销并重组为农业部。

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院曾经设立的水产主管机构，后并入农牧渔业部。
description.en: A former administration of the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for aquatic products, which was later merged into the Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Fishery.
