description.zh-cn: 中国当代作家、官员，曾任中华人民共和国文化部部长、全国政协常委、全国政协文史和学习委员会主任、中国作协副主席。“人民艺术家”国家荣誉称号获得者。其作品题材广泛，尤其以意识流文学著称，并对《红楼梦》有深入研究。
description.en: A contemporary Chinese writer and official, he served as the Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China, a member of the Standing Committee of the CPPCC National Committee, Director of the Committee for Learning and Cultural and Historical Data of the CPPCC National Committee, and Vice Chairman of the China Writers Association. He is a recipient of the national honorary title 'People's Artist'. His works cover a wide range of subjects, are particularly known for stream of consciousness literature, and he has conducted in-depth research on 'Dream of the Red Chamber'.

description.zh-cn: 中国诗人、散文家、文学评论家。王蒙父亲的朋友，根据法国小说《茶花女》为王蒙取名。
description.en: Chinese poet, essayist, and literary critic. A friend of Wang Meng's father, he suggested the name 'Wang Meng' based on the protagonist of the French novel 'La Dame aux Camélias'.

description.zh-cn: 中国诗人、剧作家，曾任中华人民共和国文化部代理部长。
description.en: Chinese poet and playwright who served as the acting Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、导演、商人。
description.en: Chinese writer, director, and businessman.

description.zh-cn: 日本宗教家、作家、摄影师，国际创价学会会长。
description.en: Japanese religious leader, author, and photographer, who served as the president of the Soka Gakkai International.

description.zh-cn: 中国晚唐著名诗人。
description.en: A prominent Chinese poet of the late Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉末三国时期的郡县，位于蜀汉与曹魏边境的战略要地。
description.en: A commandery during the late Han Dynasty and Three Kingdoms period, a strategic location on the border between Shu Han and Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏的谋臣。
description.en: An advisor and official of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏官员，早年曾鄙视夏侯尚。
description.en: An official of Cao Wei who looked down on Xiahou Shang in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚的堂弟。
description.en: The cousin of Xiahou Shang.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚的女婿。
description.en: The son-in-law of Xiahou Shang.

description.zh-cn: 一本与中国共产党“党的建设”理论有关的月刊，1987年创刊于辽宁沈阳。
description.en: A monthly magazine related to the 'party building' theory of the Communist Party of China, founded in Shenyang, Liaoning in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 隶属于中共辽宁省委的杂志社，主办《党建文汇》。
description.en: A magazine agency affiliated with the Liaoning Provincial Committee of the CPC, which hosts 'Dangjian Wenhui'.

description.zh-cn: 辽宁省沈阳市的市辖区，《党建文汇》编辑部所在地。
description.en: A district of Shenyang, Liaoning, where the editorial office of 'Dangjian Wenhui' is located.

description.zh-cn: 清末淮军重要将领，台湾建省后首任巡抚。
description.en: An important general of the Huai Army in the late Qing Dynasty and the first governor of Taiwan after it became a province.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾中部的科学园区，其设立带动了台中市的产业转型。
description.en: A science park located in central Taiwan, whose establishment has driven the industrial transformation of Taichung City.

zh-cn: 台中市立台中第一高级中等学校

description.zh-cn: 位于台中市北区的市立高级中学，于1915年由中部士绅筹设创立，是第一所专为培育台湾青年所设立的学府。
description.en: A municipal senior high school located in North District, Taichung City. Founded in 1915 by gentry from central Taiwan, it was the first school established specifically to educate Taiwanese youth.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾企业家，参与筹设创立台中一中。
description.en: A Taiwanese entrepreneur during the Japanese rule period who participated in the establishment of Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾企业家，雾峰林家成员，参与筹设创立台中一中。
description.en: A Taiwanese entrepreneur during the Japanese rule period, member of the Lin family of Wufeng, who participated in the establishment of Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾企业家，板桥林家成员，参与筹设创立台中一中。
description.en: A Taiwanese entrepreneur during the Japanese rule period, member of the Lin family of Banqiao, who participated in the establishment of Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾政治家，雾峰林家成员，参与筹设创立台中一中。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician during the Japanese rule period, member of the Lin family of Wufeng, who participated in the establishment of Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期台湾清水地区士绅，参与筹设创立台中一中。
description.en: A gentry from the Qingshui area of Taiwan during the Japanese rule period who participated in the establishment of Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 中华职棒的球队之一，以台中洲际棒球场为主场。
description.en: One of the teams in the Chinese Professional Baseball League, with Taichung Intercontinental Baseball Stadium as its home field.

description.zh-cn: 位于台中市北屯区的大型国际级棒球比赛场地。
description.en: A large, international-standard baseball stadium located in Beitun District, Taichung City.

description.zh-cn: 世界性的棒球运动管理机构。
description.en: The worldwide governing body for the sport of baseball.

description.zh-cn: 于台中市举办的A2/B1级国际园艺博览会。
description.en: An A2/B1 level international horticultural exposition held in Taichung City.

description.zh-cn: 负责认证授权国际园艺博览会的国际组织。
description.en: An international organization responsible for authorizing and accrediting international horticultural expositions.

description.zh-cn: 协调和批准世界博览会的政府间国际组织。
description.en: An intergovernmental organization that coordinates and approves World's Fairs.

description.zh-cn: 原定于2019年在台中市举办的第一届东亚青年运动会，后被取消。
description.en: The first East Asian Youth Games, originally scheduled to be held in Taichung City in 2019, but was later cancelled.

zh-cn: 东亚奥林匹克委员会协会

description.zh-cn: 负责管理东亚运动会的国际体育组织。
description.en: An international sports organization responsible for managing the East Asian Games.

description.zh-cn: 一部于2011年上映的中国历史电影，是中华人民共和国政府为庆祝中国共产党建党九十周年而制作的献礼影片。
description.en: A 2011 Chinese historical film produced by the government of the People's Republic of China to celebrate the 90th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国电影导演，《建党伟业》的导演之一。
description.en: Chinese film director, one of the directors of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电影导演，《建党伟业》的导演之一。
description.en: Chinese film director, one of the directors of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

zh-cn: 中国电影股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 《建党伟业》的领衔出品方。
description.en: The leading producer of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电影导演，执导《建党伟业》的海外部分。
description.en: Chinese film director, directed the overseas segments of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电影导演，执导《建党伟业》的五四时期部分。
description.en: Chinese film director, directed the May Fourth Movement segments of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 中国电影导演，执导《建党伟业》的战争场面。
description.en: Chinese film director, directed the war scenes in 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 《建党伟业》的开机地点。
description.en: The location where filming for 'Beginning of the Great Revival' began.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，原定在《建党伟业》中饰演陶毅，但戏份被删除。
description.en: Chinese actress, was cast to play Tao Yi in 'Beginning of the Great Revival', but her scenes were deleted.

description.zh-cn: 在电影《建党伟业》中被描绘为毛泽东的恋人，但此说法受到毛新宇的质疑。
description.en: Portrayed as Mao Zedong's lover in the film 'Beginning of the Great Revival', a claim disputed by Mao Xinyu.

description.zh-cn: 李达夫人。
description.en: Wife of Li Da.

description.zh-cn: 陈公博夫人，中华民国妇女活动家。
description.en: Wife of Chen Gongbo, a women's rights activist in the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国相声演员，冯国璋曾孙。
description.en: Chinese crosstalk comedian, great-grandson of Feng Guozhang.

description.zh-cn: 五四运动天安门集会和会后游行的主要组织者之一。
description.en: One of the main organizers of the Tiananmen Square rally and subsequent parade during the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 由美国总统罗斯福提出的概念，指美国在二战中作为同盟国主要军需品供应国的角色。
description.en: A concept promoted by U.S. President Roosevelt, referring to the role of the United States as the primary supplier of materiel for the Allied powers in World War II.

zh-cn: 乌克兰民主防卫租借法案
en: Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act of 2022

description.zh-cn: 1941年《租借法案》的更新版，旨在应对2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间，加快向乌克兰提供军事物资。
description.en: An updated version of the 1941 Lend-Lease Act, designed to expedite military aid to Ukraine during the 2022 Russian invasion.

description.zh-cn: 美国在1930年代通过的一系列法案，旨在防止美国卷入外国战争，对向交战国出售武器等行为施加了严格限制。
description.en: A series of acts passed by the U.S. in the 1930s to prevent involvement in foreign wars, imposing strict restrictions on selling arms to belligerent nations.

description.zh-cn: 1940年美国与英国达成的一项协议，美国向英国提供50艘驱逐舰，以换取英国在西半球部分领土的军事基地租用权。
description.en: An agreement between the United States and the United Kingdom in 1940, in which the U.S. transferred 50 destroyers to the UK in exchange for land rights on British possessions.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治家，被罗斯福总统任命负责管理租借法案的实施。
description.en: American politician appointed by President Roosevelt to head the administration of the Lend-Lease Act.

description.zh-cn: 二战期间连接缅甸和中国云南的战略公路，美国通过《租借法案》提供的物资协助了其修补工作。
description.en: A strategic road linking Burma and Yunnan, China during WWII, whose repair was assisted by materials provided by the U.S. under the Lend-Lease Act.

description.zh-cn: 南京工业大学校长。
description.en: President of Nanjing Tech University.

en: Higher Education Innovation Capacity Enhancement Plan
zh-cn: 高等学校创新能力提升计划

description.zh-cn: 中国教育部、财政部于2011年启动的一项旨在提升高等教育质量的计划。
description.en: A program launched in 2011 by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Finance of China aimed at improving the quality of higher education.

en: Excellent Engineer Education and Training Program
zh-cn: 卓越工程师教育培养计划

description.zh-cn: 中国教育部于2010年启动的一项旨在培养高水平工程技术人才的计划。
description.en: A program launched by the Ministry of Education of China in 2010 aimed at cultivating high-level engineering and technical talents.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期成员，与周佛海共同组建了旅日共产主义小组，同时也是王一知的原配丈夫。
description.en: An early member of the Chinese Communist Party who, along with Zhou Fohai, formed the communist group in Japan. He was also Wang Yizhi's first husband.

description.zh-cn: 周佛海的第二位妻子。
description.en: The second wife of Zhou Fohai.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国大连的企业集团，曾收购大连万达足球俱乐部。
description.en: A conglomerate based in Dalian, China, which acquired the Dalian Wanda Football Club.

description.zh-cn: 中国跨国家用电器和消费电子公司。
description.en: A Chinese multinational home appliances and consumer electronics company.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗在灭北汉后，意图一举收复燕云十六州而发动的战役，宋军大败。
description.en: A battle initiated by Emperor Taizong of Song after conquering the Northern Han, in an attempt to recover the Sixteen Prefectures in one stroke, which resulted in a major defeat for the Song army.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗的皇后。太宗死后，与宦官王继恩企图立元佐为帝。
description.en: Empress of Emperor Taizong. After Taizong's death, she conspired with the eunuch Wang Ji'en to enthrone Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 清末主张君主立宪的政治派别，是自立军起义的重要参与力量。
description.en: A political faction in the late Qing Dynasty advocating for constitutional monarchy, and a key participant in the Self-Support Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 自立军前军统领，在大通率先发难，但因孤军奋战而失败。
description.en: Commander of the Self-Support Army's vanguard. He initiated the uprising in Datong but failed due to fighting alone.

description.zh-cn: 1900年7月在上海由维新派、革命党人等召开的会议，决定组织自立军发动起义。
description.en: A meeting held in Shanghai in July 1900 by reformists, revolutionaries, and others, which decided to organize the Self-Support Army to launch an uprising.

description.zh-cn: 日本浪人，积极撮合孙文与康有为合作，但因刘学询的计谋而在新加坡入狱。
description.en: A Japanese rōnin who actively tried to broker cooperation between Sun Yat-sen and Kang Youwei, but was imprisoned in Singapore due to Liu Xuexun's scheme.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间于1947年1月发生在山东省南部的一场战役，以中国人民解放军的胜利结束。
description.en: A battle that took place in southern Shandong Province in January 1947 during the Second Chinese Civil War, ending in a decisive victory for the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军将领，陈诚的亲信，曾任第一快速纵队司令官，后弃部队而走。
description.en: A general of the National Revolutionary Army, a confidant of Chen Cheng, who once served as the commander of the First Fast Column and later abandoned his troops.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗时期宠臣，明世宗即位后被处以寸斩。
description.en: A favorite official during Emperor Wuzong's reign, he was executed by slow slicing after Emperor Shizong ascended the throne.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗时期宠臣，明世宗即位后被处死。
description.en: A favorite official during Emperor Wuzong's reign, he was executed after Emperor Shizong ascended the throne.

description.zh-cn: 杨廷和之子，因在大礼议中反对明世宗，被廷杖并流放。
description.en: Son of Yang Tinghe, he opposed Emperor Shizong in the Great Rites Controversy, and was subsequently caned at court and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗妃嫔，壬寅宫变发生后被处决。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Shizong who was executed after the Renyin Palace Incident occurred.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因弹劾严嵩而惨遭杀害。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official who was brutally murdered for impeaching Yan Song.

description.zh-cn: 明朝官员，因弹劾严嵩而惨遭杀害。
description.en: A Ming Dynasty official who was brutally murdered for impeaching Yan Song.

description.zh-cn: 负责将邯郸初中生杀人案上报至最高人民检察院核准追诉的检察机关。
description.en: The procuratorial organ responsible for reporting the Handan junior high school student murder case to the Supreme People's Procuratorate for prosecution approval.

en: Amendment (XI) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China
zh-cn: 中华人民共和国刑法修正案（十一）

description.zh-cn: 对《中华人民共和国刑法》的修正案，其中规定已满十二周岁不满十四周岁的人，在犯下特定严重罪行且情节恶劣时，经最高人民检察院核准可追究其刑事责任。此规定是本案得以起诉的关键。
description.en: An amendment to the Criminal Law of the PRC, which stipulates that individuals aged between 12 and 14 who commit specific serious crimes with malicious intent can be held criminally responsible upon approval by the Supreme People's Procuratorate. This provision was key to the prosecution in this case.

description.zh-cn: 一个法律概念，指法律规定行为人对自己的犯罪行为负刑事责任所必须达到的年龄。此案因嫌疑人年龄介于12至14周岁之间，引发了关于此概念的激烈社会讨论。
description.en: A legal concept that refers to the minimum age at which a person can be held criminally responsible for their actions. This case sparked intense public debate about this concept, as the suspects were between 12 and 14 years old.

description.zh-cn: 赤色职工国际代表，1921年6月由张太雷陪同来华筹备中共一大。
description.en: A Profintern representative who came to China in June 1921, accompanied by Zhang Tailei, to prepare for the 1st National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 施存统的前妻，后与施离婚并改嫁张太雷。
description.en: Shi Cuntong's ex-wife, who later divorced him and married Zhang Tailei.

description.zh-cn: 张太雷与陆静华的二女儿。
description.en: The second daughter of Zhang Tailei and Lu Jinghua.

description.zh-cn: 张太雷的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Zhang Tailei.

description.zh-cn: 八路军的主力师之一。
description.en: One of the main divisions of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期清华大学党委书记。
description.en: Party Secretary of Tsinghua University during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，刘冰等人两次联名写信给毛泽东，揭发迟群、谢静宜问题的事件。
description.en: In 1975, Liu Bing and others co-signed two letters to Mao Zedong, exposing the problems of Chi Qun and Xie Jingyi.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任兰州大学校长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as President of Lanzhou University.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河南省洛阳市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Luoyang City, Henan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国舞蹈演员、编导。
description.en: Chinese dance actor and choreographer.

en: High School Affiliated to Nanjing Normal University
Attached High School of National Southeastern University
zh-cn: 南京师范大学附属中学

description.zh-cn: 巴金于1923年考入的学校。
description.en: The school Ba Jin was admitted to in 1923.

description.zh-cn: 由巴金和靳以于1957年共同创办的大型文学刊物。
description.en: A major literary magazine co-founded by Ba Jin and Jin Yi in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家，与巴金共同创办《收获》杂志。
description.en: A Chinese writer who co-founded the 'Harvest' magazine with Ba Jin.

description.zh-cn: 中国银行家，中国共产党党员，高级经济师。曾任中国建设银行、中国银行、中信银行董事长，现任中国建设银行党委书记、董事长。
description.en: Chinese banker, member of the Communist Party of China, and senior economist. He has served as chairman of China Construction Bank, Bank of China, and China CITIC Bank. He is currently the Party Secretary and Chairman of China Construction Bank.

zh-cn: 中国人民银行货币政策委员会
中国信达资产管理公司
亚历山大·亚历山德罗维奇·罗曼诺夫
亚历山大三世·亚历山德罗维奇

birth_place.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国圣彼得堡亚历山大皇宫
birth_place.en: Alexander Palace, Saint Petersburg, Russian Empire

death_place.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国塔夫里切斯基省

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国皇帝（1881年-1894年在位），被称为“和平缔造者”。其统治时期是俄罗斯帝国后期的繁荣时期。
description.en: Emperor of Russia (reigned 1881–1894), known as 'The Peacemaker'. His reign was a period of prosperity for the late Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国皇帝，亚历山大三世之父，被民意党人刺杀身亡。
description.en: Emperor of Russia, father of Alexander III, who was assassinated by members of Narodnaya Volya.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世的长子，俄罗斯帝国末代皇帝。
description.en: Eldest son of Alexander III, the last Emperor of Russia.

zh-cn: 玛丽亚·费奥多罗芙娜皇后 (丹麦的达格玛)
玛丽·苏菲·弗雷德里卡·达格玛

description.zh-cn: 丹麦公主，后成为俄罗斯帝国皇后，亚历山大三世的妻子。
description.en: A Danish princess who became Empress of Russia as the spouse of Alexander III.

zh-cn: 尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇皇储
尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大二世的长子，亚历山大三世的兄长。因肺结核早逝。
description.en: Eldest son of Alexander II and elder brother of Alexander III. Died young from tuberculosis.

en: Marie of Hesse and by Rhine
zh-cn: 玛丽亚·亚历山德罗芙娜皇后 (黑森-达姆施塔特的玛丽)
玛克西米莲妮·威廉明妮·奥古斯塔·苏菲·玛丽公主
黑森-达姆施塔特的玛丽

description.zh-cn: 黑森-达姆施塔特公主，亚历山大二世的妻子，亚历山大三世的母亲。
description.en: Princess of Hesse and by Rhine, spouse of Alexander II and mother of Alexander III.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪俄罗斯的革命民粹主义组织，主张通过恐怖主义活动进行政治斗争。
description.en: A 19th-century revolutionary populist organization in Russia that advocated for political struggle through terrorist activities.

description.zh-cn: 1888年10月，沙皇亚历山大三世的御用列车在哈尔科夫附近出轨。此事件被认为是导致他健康恶化并最终去世的原因之一。
description.en: In October 1888, Tsar Alexander III's imperial train derailed near Kharkiv. The incident is considered a contributing factor to the deterioration of his health and eventual death.

description.zh-cn: 位于法国巴黎的一座桥梁，为纪念法俄同盟而修建。
description.en: A bridge in Paris, France, built to commemorate the Franco-Russian Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯城市，亚历山大三世的出生地。
description.en: A Russian city, the birthplace of Alexander III.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国皇帝，亚历山大二世之父，亚历山大三世的祖父。
description.en: Emperor of Russia, father of Alexander II and grandfather of Alexander III.

zh-cn: 亚历山德拉·费奥多罗芙娜皇后 (普鲁士的夏洛特)
亚历山德拉·费奥多罗芙娜

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士公主，嫁给尼古拉一世后成为俄罗斯皇后。亚历山大二世之母，亚历山大三世的祖母。
description.en: A Prussian princess who became Empress of Russia after marrying Nicholas I. She was the mother of Alexander II and the grandmother of Alexander III.

en: China Association for International Friendly Contact

description.zh-cn: 一个从事国际和地区民间友好交流的中国社会团体。
description.en: A Chinese social organization engaged in international and regional non-governmental friendly exchanges.

zh-cn: 中央军委政治工作部联络局
中国人民解放军总政治部联络部

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总政治部下设的二级部门，负责情报和统战工作。
description.en: A second-level department under the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army, responsible for intelligence and united front work.

description.zh-cn: 王震之子，王京阳之父。
description.en: Son of Wang Zhen, father of Wang Jingyang.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，曾任总政治部联络部部长。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army, former Director of the Liaison Department of the General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 西汉末年学者，汉成帝的老师，整合〈鲁论〉与〈齐论〉，形成《张侯论》，为后世《论语》版本奠定基础。
description.en: A scholar of the late Western Han dynasty and teacher to Emperor Cheng of Han. He integrated the 'Lu Analects' and 'Qi Analects' to create the 'Marquis Zhang's Analects', laying the foundation for later versions of the text.

description.zh-cn: 百济的五经博士，于公元5世纪初将《论语》及其注疏传入日本，对日本文化产生重要影响。
description.en: A scholar of Baekje who is credited with introducing the Analects and its commentaries to Japan in the early 5th century, significantly influencing Japanese culture.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝初年名将，在玄武门之变中与房玄龄等人并功第一。
description.en: A famous general of the early Tang dynasty, who, along with Fang Xuanling and others, was ranked first in merit for his role in the Xuanwu Gate Incident.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄之父，隋朝官员，曾任泾阳县令、司隶刺史。
description.en: Father of Fang Xuanling, an official in the Sui dynasty who served as Magistrate of Jingyang County and Inspector of the Capital Province.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄次子，高阳公主的丈夫，后因谋反案被处死。
description.en: Second son of Fang Xuanling and husband of Princess Gaoyang. He was later executed in connection with a rebellion plot.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民之女，房遗爱之妻，后因谋反案被赐自尽。
description.en: Daughter of Emperor Taizong of Tang and wife of Fang Yiai. She was later ordered to commit suicide in connection with a rebellion plot.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄的嗣子，因受房遗爱谋反案牵连，被贬为铜陵尉。
description.en: The heir of Fang Xuanling, who was implicated in Fang Yiai's rebellion case and demoted to the post of Wei of Tongling.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄的妻子，以刚烈闻名。唐太宗欲赐美人给房玄龄，卢氏宁死不从，饮下“毒酒”以明志。
description.en: Fang Xuanling's wife, known for her strong will. When Emperor Taizong wanted to gift concubines to Fang Xuanling, she refused to the point of death, drinking 'poisoned wine' to show her resolve.

description.zh-cn: 中国的二十四史之一，由唐朝房玄龄等人奉敕监修。
description.en: One of the Twenty-Four Histories of China, compiled under imperial order with Fang Xuanling as the chief editor during the Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝中央机构尚书省的长官之一，为宰相之一。
description.en: One of the heads of the Department of State Affairs (Shangshu Sheng) in the Tang dynasty's central government, one of the chancellors.

en: Twenty-four meritorious officials of Lingyan Pavilion

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗为表彰功臣而命画家阎立本在凌烟阁内描绘的二十四位功臣的画像，房玄龄名列其中。
description.en: A group of twenty-four meritorious officials of the early Tang dynasty, whose portraits were commissioned by Emperor Taizong to be painted by Yan Liben in the Lingyan Pavilion to honor their contributions. Fang Xuanling was among them.

description.zh-cn: 大卫·休谟的哲学著作，亚当·斯密在牛津大学期间曾阅读此书。
description.en: A philosophical work by David Hume, which Adam Smith read during his time at Oxford.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰哲学家，在亚当·斯密辞职后接替了他在格拉斯哥大学的教授职位。
description.en: A Scottish philosopher who succeeded Adam Smith as professor at the University of Glasgow after his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利经济学家，提出了“亚当·斯密问题”。
description.en: An Austrian economist who coined the term 'das Adam Smith-Problem'.

description.zh-cn: 关于亚当·斯密在《道德情操论》中强调的“同情”与在《国富论》中强调的“私利”之间是否存在矛盾的学术争论。
description.en: The academic debate over the apparent contradiction between the emphasis on 'sympathy' in Adam Smith's 'The Theory of Moral Sentiments' and 'self-interest' in 'The Wealth of Nations'.

zh-cn: 托马斯·罗伯特·马尔萨斯

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第一共和国督政府时期的立法机构上议院，继承了国民公会的部分立法权力。
description.en: The upper house of the legislature during the French Directory period of the French First Republic, which inherited part of the legislative power of the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第一共和国督政府时期的立法机构下议院，继承了国民公会的部分立法权力。
description.en: The lower house of the legislature during the French Directory period of the French First Republic, which inherited part of the legislative power of the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期国民公会内人数最多的中间派别。
description.en: The largest centrist faction within the National Convention during the French Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 法国国王路易十六在革命广场被国民公会下令以断头台处决的事件。
description.en: The event where King Louis XVI of France was executed by guillotine in the Place de la Révolution by order of the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 由巴黎公社和无套裤汉发动的武装暴动，导致吉伦特派领袖被从国民公会中驱逐，山岳派开始掌权。
description.en: An armed insurrection initiated by the Paris Commune and the sans-culottes, which led to the purge of Girondin leaders from the National Convention and the rise to power of the Montagnards.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的女性，因同情吉伦特派而刺杀了山岳派领袖让-保尔·马拉。
description.en: A figure of the French Revolution who, out of sympathy for the Girondins, assassinated the Montagnard leader Jean-Paul Marat.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的雅各宾派领袖和记者，被视为无套裤汉的偶像，后被夏绿蒂·科黛刺杀。
description.en: A Jacobin leader and journalist during the French Revolution, considered an idol of the sans-culottes, who was later assassinated by Charlotte Corday.

description.zh-cn: 由国民公会设立的委员会，负责警察和司法监视职能，是雅各宾专政的重要机构。
description.en: A committee established by the National Convention responsible for police and judicial surveillance functions, and a key institution of the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的极左派系，主张极端激进政策，后被救国委员会镇压并处决其领袖。
description.en: A far-left faction during the French Revolution that advocated for extremely radical policies. It was later suppressed by the Committee of Public Safety, and its leaders were executed.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命时期的记者和政治家，丹东派的核心成员，与丹东一同被救国委员会处决。
description.en: A journalist and politician during the French Revolution, a core member of the Dantonists, who was executed along with Danton by the Committee of Public Safety.

description.zh-cn: 法国的工程师大学校，由国民公会于1794年创办。
description.en: A French grande école of engineering, founded in 1794 by the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 法国的精英高等教育机构，由国民公会于1794年创办。
description.en: An elite higher education institution in France, founded in 1794 by the National Convention.

en: Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales
zh-cn: 国立东方语言文明学院
法国国立东方语言文化学院

description.zh-cn: 法国专门研究世界语言和文化的大学校，由国民公会于1795年创办。
description.en: A French grande école specializing in world languages and cultures, founded in 1795 by the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 指巴黎国立高等音乐舞蹈学院的前身，由国民公会于1795年创办。
description.en: Refers to the predecessor of the Conservatoire de Paris, founded in 1795 by the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 清朝大臣，曾任两江总督、乍浦副都统。作为清政府代表之一，他签署了《南京条约》，并协助耆英参与了条约的签订。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official, formerly Governor-General of Liangjiang and Deputy Lieutenant-General of Zhapu. As one of the Qing government representatives, he signed the Treaty of Nanking and assisted Qiying in its signing.

description.zh-cn: 英国陆军少将，作为英方特命全权公使签署了《南京条约》，并成为首任香港总督。
description.en: A major general in the British Army who, as the British Plenipotentiary, signed the Treaty of Nanking and became the first Governor of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 《南京条约》规定的条款之一，要求清朝向英国商人开放广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海五个港口进行贸易。
description.en: One of the terms of the Treaty of Nanking, which required the Qing dynasty to open the five ports of Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo, and Shanghai to British merchants for trade.

zh-cn: 第四代阿伯丁伯爵乔治·汉密尔顿-戈登

description.zh-cn: 英国外交大臣，曾向璞鼎查发出撤回割地要求的训令，但未被遵从。
description.en: British Foreign Secretary who issued instructions to Henry Pottinger to withdraw the demand for territorial cession, but was not obeyed.

description.zh-cn: 一项外交特权，指一国公民在另一国境内不受当地法律管辖。英国通过《南京条约》的补充条约在中国获得了此项权利。
description.en: A diplomatic privilege where citizens of one country are exempt from the jurisdiction of local laws in another country. Britain obtained this right in China through the supplementary treaties to the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官员，时任两江总督。在吴淞战役中战败逃跑，后又在英军兵临江宁城下时乞和。他参与了《南京条约》签订前的相关活动，并最终参与了条约的签订。
description.en: A Qing dynasty official, serving as the Viceroy of Liangjiang. He was defeated and fled during the Battle of Wusong, and later pleaded for peace when British forces approached Jiangning. He participated in relevant activities leading up to and including the final signing of the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 英国皇家海军的风帆战舰，在第一次鸦片战争中作为英军旗舰。《南京条约》在此舰上签订。
description.en: A sailing ship of the line of the British Royal Navy that served as the flagship during the First Opium War. The Treaty of Nanking was signed aboard this vessel.

description.zh-cn: 清朝的行政区划，今南京市。《南京条约》在此地的江面上签订，因而得名。
description.en: An administrative division of the Qing dynasty, modern-day Nanjing. The Treaty of Nanking was signed on the river here, hence its name.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任山东省战时高级审判处处长及山东省司法厅厅长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Director of the Shandong Wartime High Court and the Director of the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国山东省的最高审判机关。
description.en: The highest judicial organ in Shandong Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任山东省司法厅厅长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Director of the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任山东省司法厅厅长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Director of the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任山东省司法厅厅长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as the Director of the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 美国民主党政治人物，现任夏威夷州州长。
description.en: American Democratic politician, current Governor of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 美国民主党政治人物，现任夏威夷州副州长。
description.en: American Democratic politician, current Lieutenant Governor of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 一个在1795年至1893年间统治夏威夷群岛的王国，后被推翻。
description.en: A kingdom that ruled the Hawaiian Islands from 1795 to 1893, before being overthrown.

description.zh-cn: 在夏威夷王国被推翻后、被美国吞并前成立的短暂共和国。
description.en: A short-lived republic established after the overthrow of the Kingdom of Hawaii and before its annexation by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 夏威夷在1898年被美国合并后成为其建制领地（准州），直到1959年正式成为一个州。
description.en: After being annexed by the United States in 1898, Hawaii became an incorporated territory until it officially became a state in 1959.

description.zh-cn: 夏威夷酋长，于1795年统一夏威夷群岛，建立夏威夷王国并自立为王。
description.en: A Hawaiian chief who unified the Hawaiian Islands in 1795, establishing the Kingdom of Hawaii and declaring himself king.

description.zh-cn: 夏威夷王国最后一位君主，于1893年被迫退位。
description.en: The last monarch of the Kingdom of Hawaii, who was forced to abdicate in 1893.

en: Overthrow of the Kingdom of Hawaii

description.zh-cn: 1893年，以美国商人和传教士为首的势力推翻了利留卡拉尼女王的统治，导致夏威夷王国终结。
description.en: In 1893, forces led by American businessmen and missionaries overthrew the rule of Queen Liliʻuokalani, leading to the end of the Kingdom of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 美国裔夏威夷政治家，曾任夏威夷共和国首任及唯一一任总统。
description.en: An American-descended Hawaiian politician who served as the first and only president of the Republic of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 美国第22和24任总统，曾在1893年反对吞并夏威夷。
description.en: The 22nd and 24th President of the United States, who opposed the annexation of Hawaii in 1893.

description.zh-cn: 位于夏威夷欧胡岛的港口，曾是美国太平洋舰队的基地。
description.en: A harbor on the island of Oahu, Hawaii, which was a base for the U.S. Pacific Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 位于太平洋中部的火山群岛，组成了夏威夷州的主体。
description.en: A volcanic archipelago in the central Pacific Ocean that forms the main body of the state of Hawaii.

location.zh-cn: 郑州市中原区中原西路233号

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河南省郑州市的市级行政管理机关。
description.en: The municipal-level administrative body of Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任郑州市市长。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, current Mayor of Zhengzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任郑州市副市长。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, current Deputy Mayor of Zhengzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，现任郑州市副市长。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, current Deputy Mayor of Zhengzhou.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任郑州市军事管制委员会主任。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, served as the Director of the Zhengzhou Military Control Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，郑州市人民民主政府首任市长。
description.en: Politician of the People's Republic of China, the first mayor of the Zhengzhou People's Democratic Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期河南省西部的一个行政管理机构。
description.en: An administrative body in the western part of Henan Province during the early years of the People's Republic of China.

en: Speaker of the United States House of Representatives

description.zh-cn: 美国众议院的主持官员，由众议院全体议员选举产生，通常是多数党的领袖。在美国总统继任顺序中位列第二，仅次于副总统。
description.en: The presiding officer of the United States House of Representatives, elected by the full House, and typically the leader of the majority party. The Speaker is second in the U.S. presidential line of succession, after the Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，共和党籍，自2023年1月3日起担任众议院多数党领袖。
description.en: American politician and member of the Republican Party, serving as the House Majority Leader since January 3, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，民主党籍，自2023年1月3日起担任众议院少数党领袖。
description.en: American politician and member of the Democratic Party, serving as the House Minority Leader since January 3, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 1787年召开会议，以解决《邦联条例》下的政府效率问题，并最终起草了《美国宪法》。
description.en: Convened in 1787 to address governmental inefficiencies under the Articles of Confederation, ultimately drafting the United States Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 美国的第一部宪法，设立了一院制国会，后因效率低下而被《美国宪法》取代。
description.en: The first constitution of the United States, which established a unicameral congress and was later replaced by the U.S. Constitution due to its inefficiency.

description.zh-cn: 1787年大陆会议期间达成的一项协议，确立了美国国会的两院制结构：众议院按人口比例分配席位，参议院各州席位平等。
description.en: An agreement reached during the 1787 Continental Congress that established the bicameral structure of the U.S. Congress: proportional representation in the House and equal representation in the Senate.

description.zh-cn: 美国19世纪区域性不和的核心问题之一，最终导致了内战并被废除。
description.en: One of the core issues of regional discord in 19th-century America, which ultimately led to the Civil War and its abolition.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在1994年中期选举中领导“共和党革命”，使共和党重夺众议院控制权。
description.en: American politician who led the "Republican Revolution" in the 1994 midterm elections, which resulted in Republicans regaining control of the House.

description.zh-cn: 指1994年美国中期选举中，共和党在纽特·金瑞契领导下，时隔40年重新获得国会参众两院的控制权。
description.en: Refers to the 1994 U.S. midterm elections where the Republican Party, led by Newt Gingrich, regained control of both the House and Senate for the first time in 40 years.

description.zh-cn: 1998年美国众议院发起的针对总统比尔·克林顿的弹劾程序。
description.en: The impeachment process initiated in 1998 by the U.S. House of Representatives against President Bill Clinton.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在保障少数族裔投票权的联邦法案，禁止为降低少数民族表决权而进行不公正的选区划分。
description.en: A federal act aimed at protecting the voting rights of minorities, which prohibits gerrymandering intended to diminish minority voting power.

description.zh-cn: 指以不公正的方式划分选区，以增加某方政治势力获胜几率的做法。
description.en: The practice of drawing electoral districts in a way that gives one political party an unfair advantage.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在1800年总统选举僵局中被众议院击败。
description.en: American politician who was defeated in the House contingent election for the presidency in 1800.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在1824年总统选举僵局中被众议院击败。
description.en: American politician who was defeated in the House contingent election for the presidency in 1824.

description.zh-cn: 指1949年中国共产党在中国内战中取得胜利，控制中国大陆，对美国政坛产生巨大冲击的事件。
description.en: Refers to the victory of the Chinese Communist Party in the Chinese Civil War in 1949, which resulted in their control of mainland China and had a significant impact on American politics.

zh-cn: 众议院非美活动调查委员会
众议院非美调查委员会

description.zh-cn: 美国众议院的一个调查委员会，在麦卡锡主义时期积极调查被指控的共产主义活动。
description.en: An investigative committee of the U.S. House of Representatives that was prominent for its anti-communist investigations during the McCarthy era.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝雇佣被怀疑与共产主义有联系的娱乐业专业人士的做法，导致数百人失业。
description.en: The practice of denying employment to entertainment industry professionals believed to be associated with communism, which resulted in hundreds losing their jobs.

description.zh-cn: 美国编剧和小说家，是“好莱坞十君子”之一，被列入好莱坞黑名单。
description.en: An American screenwriter and novelist who was one of the 'Hollywood Ten' and was placed on the Hollywood blacklist.

description.zh-cn: 美国广播记者和新闻分析家，其在《See It Now》节目中对麦卡锡的批评被认为是麦卡锡主义终结的关键。
description.en: An American broadcast journalist and news analyst whose criticism of McCarthy on his show 'See It Now' is considered a key moment in the downfall of McCarthyism.

description.zh-cn: 美国伊利诺伊州最大的城市。
description.en: The largest city in the U.S. state of Illinois.

description.zh-cn: 一个天主教托钵修会，良十四世是该会会士。
description.en: A Catholic mendicant order, of which Pope Leo XIV is a member.

en: Pontifical University of Saint Thomas Aquinas

description.zh-cn: 罗马教廷的一个部门，负责监督主教的任命。
description.en: A dicastery of the Roman Curia that oversees the appointment of bishops.

description.zh-cn: 教宗良十三世于1891年发表的通谕，被视为天主教社会思想的起点。
description.en: An encyclical issued by Pope Leo XIII in 1891, considered the starting point of Catholic social teaching.

description.zh-cn: 天主教香港教区主教、枢机。
description.en: Bishop of the Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong and a Cardinal.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，傅全有之子。曾任第1集团军副军长、南京军区副参谋长、东部战区陆军副司令员等职。
description.en: A Major General of the People's Liberation Army and the son of Fu Quanyou. He has served as Deputy Commander of the 1st Group Army, Deputy Chief of Staff of the Nanjing Military Region, and Deputy Commander of the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 山西省的一个旧县名，今为原平市的一部分。
description.en: A former county in Shanxi Province, now part of Yuanping City.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军的一个集团军，前身为南京军区部队，后隶属于东部战区陆军。
description.en: A group army of the PLA Ground Force, formerly part of the Nanjing Military Region and later subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 规定日本陆军大臣和海军大臣必须由现役大将或中将担任的制度，使得军部能对内阁进行干预。
description.en: A system requiring the Minister of the Army and Minister of the Navy to be active-duty generals or admirals, which allowed the military to exert influence over the cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 日本明治时代的非官方荣誉职位，由一群退休的资深政治家组成，是天皇的最高顾问，在决定首相人选等重大国事上拥有影响力。
description.en: An unofficial honorary position in Meiji Japan, consisting of a group of retired elder statesmen who served as the emperor's most trusted advisors and held influence over major state affairs, including the selection of the Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后，由以美国为首的同盟国对日本进行的军事占领。
description.en: The military occupation of Japan by the Allied Powers, led by the United States, following World War II.

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁的成员，由内阁总理大臣任命。
description.en: A member of the Cabinet of Japan, appointed by the Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁中的重要职位，负责领导内阁官房、协调各部门政策，并担任政府主要发言人。
description.en: A key position in the Japanese Cabinet, responsible for leading the Cabinet Secretariat, coordinating policies among ministries, and serving as the chief government spokesperson.

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁中负责外交事务的国务大臣。
description.en: The Minister of State in the Japanese Cabinet responsible for foreign affairs.

en: Minister for Internal Affairs and Communications

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁中负责国家行政组织、地方自治、资讯通信等事务的国务大臣。
description.en: The Minister of State in the Japanese Cabinet responsible for national administrative organization, local autonomy, information and communications, etc.

en: Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁中负责国土规划、交通运输、旅游业等事务的国务大臣。
description.en: The Minister of State in the Japanese Cabinet responsible for national land planning, transport, tourism, etc.

en: Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁中负责经济、产业、贸易、能源等事务的国务大臣。
description.en: The Minister of State in the Japanese Cabinet responsible for economy, industry, trade, energy, etc.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国上海市的音乐学院。
description.en: A conservatory of music located in Shanghai, China.

description.zh-cn: 曾任故宫博物院院长。在国民政府下令将留平文物菁华运往南京时，他以各种理由推延，使得这批文物最终留在了北京。
description.en: Former director of the Palace Museum. When the Nationalist government ordered the shipment of selected artifacts remaining in Beiping to Nanjing, he used various reasons to delay the process, ensuring the items ultimately remained in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 现任故宫博物院院长。
description.en: The current director of the Palace Museum.

description.zh-cn: 位于巴黎的一所公立中学。

description.en: French statesman who served as President of France from 1981 to 1995.

description.en: French politician who served as President of France from 1974 to 1981.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王之妻，末代幕府大将军德川庆喜的孙女，有栖川宫威仁亲王的外孙女。
description.en: Wife of Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito, granddaughter of the last shōgun Tokugawa Yoshinobu, and maternal granddaughter of Prince Arisugawa Takehito.

description.zh-cn: 二战期间的日本海军大臣，高松宫宣仁亲王因其主战立场而主张他辞职。
description.en: Minister of the Navy of Japan during World War II, whom Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito advocated to resign due to his pro-war stance.

description.zh-cn: 日本前首相及海军大将。二战期间是和平派，与高松宫宣仁亲王等人组成反对扩大战争联盟。
description.en: A former Prime Minister and admiral in the Imperial Japanese Navy. He was part of the peace faction during WWII and formed an alliance to oppose the expansion of the war with Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito and others.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇室的宫家之一，由大正天皇第三皇子宣仁亲王于1913年创立，以继承已断绝的旧宫家有栖川宫的祭祀。
description.en: One of the princely houses of the Imperial House of Japan, founded in 1913 by Prince Nobuhito, the third son of Emperor Taishō, to succeed the rites of the extinct Arisugawa-no-miya house.

description.zh-cn: 为大日本帝国海军培养军官的学校。高松宫宣仁亲王于1920年至1924年在此就读。
description.en: An academy established to train officers for the Imperial Japanese Navy. Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito studied here from 1920 to 1924.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国海军的参谋学院。高松宫宣仁亲王于1934年至1936年在此就读。
description.en: The staff college of the Imperial Japanese Navy. Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito studied here from 1934 to 1936.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇室的宫家之一，因继承人断绝而终结。其祭祀由新设立的高松宫继承。
description.en: One of the princely houses of the Imperial House of Japan, which became extinct due to a lack of an heir. Its rites were succeeded by the newly established Takamatsu-no-miya.

description.zh-cn: 日本皇太子的官方居所，高松宫宣仁亲王的出生地。
description.en: The official residence of the Crown Prince of Japan, and the birthplace of Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito.

description.en: Chinese politician, served as a member of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee, Deputy Director of the People's Supervisory Committee, Minister of Personnel, and Minister of Internal Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中南军政委员会委员、最高人民法院中南分院院长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a member of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee and President of the Central-South Branch of the Supreme People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中南军政委员会委员、最高人民检察署中南分署检察长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a member of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee and Procurator-General of the Central-South Branch of the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中南军政委员会委员、劳动局局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as a member and Director of the Labor Bureau of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第二机械工业部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府曾经存在的部门，负责核工业。
description.en: A former ministry of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the nuclear industry.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第三机械工业部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府曾经存在的部门，负责航空工业。
description.en: A former ministry of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the aviation industry.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第四机械工业部

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府曾经存在的部门，负责电子工业。
description.en: A former ministry of the People's Republic of China, responsible for the electronics industry.

zh-cn: 杭州电子科技大学信息工程学院

description.zh-cn: 杭州电子科技大学下设的独立学院。
description.en: An independent college affiliated with Hangzhou Dianzi University.

description.zh-cn: 中国的第一个载人航天计划，于1970年代提出。西昌卫星发射中心最初便是为该计划而选址建设的。
description.en: China's first manned space program, proposed in the 1970s. The Xichang Satellite Launch Center was originally selected and built for this project.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军将领，时任中国酒泉卫星发射中心司令员，1970年带领工作人员为714工程踏勘并最终选定冕宁为场址。
description.en: A general in the People's Liberation Army and then-commander of the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. In 1970, he led a team to survey and ultimately select Mianning as the site for Project 714.

zh-cn: 1996年长征三号乙火箭发射事故

location.zh-cn: 中国西昌卫星发射中心

description.zh-cn: 在西昌卫星发射中心发生的一次严重发射事故，长征三号乙运载火箭在发射国际通信卫星708星时失控坠毁，造成重大人员伤亡和财产损失。
description.en: A major launch accident at the Xichang Satellite Launch Center where a Long March 3B rocket went out of control and crashed while launching the Intelsat 708 satellite, causing significant casualties and property damage.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国海南省文昌市的航天发射场，由西昌卫星发射中心负责建设、管理和使用，其临海位置解决了西昌内陆发射的部分安全问题。
description.en: A space launch site located in Wenchang, Hainan Province, China. It is constructed, managed, and used by the Xichang Satellite Launch Center. Its coastal location resolves some of the safety issues associated with inland launches from Xichang.

description.zh-cn: 玻利维亚前总统。2013年12月，他专程前往西昌卫星发射中心，现场观看了玻利维亚通信卫星的发射，成为首位在中国航天发射场观看卫星发射的外国国家元首。
description.en: Former President of Bolivia. In December 2013, he traveled to the Xichang Satellite Launch Center to watch the launch of the Bolivian Communications Satellite, becoming the first foreign head of state to witness a satellite launch at a Chinese space launch site.

description.zh-cn: 巨力集团副总裁兼执行总裁，演员，黄圣依的前夫及商业伙伴。
description.en: Vice president and executive president of Juli Group, actor, and the ex-husband and business partner of Huang Shengyi.

description.zh-cn: 由周星驰创立的电影公司，曾是黄圣依的经纪公司。
description.en: A film company founded by Stephen Chow, which was formerly Huang Shengyi's management agency.

description.zh-cn: 黄圣依的父亲，曾任上海第二工业大学讲师。
description.en: Huang Shengyi's father, formerly a lecturer at Shanghai Second Polytechnic University.

description.zh-cn: 《新民晚报》创始人，黄圣依母亲邓传理的姑妈。
description.en: Founder of Xinmin Evening News and the aunt of Huang Shengyi's mother, Deng Chuanli.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，邓季惺之子，黄圣依母亲的表哥。
description.en: A Chinese economist, son of Deng Jixing, and cousin of Huang Shengyi's mother.

description.zh-cn: 2004年由周星驰执导的电影，黄圣依在片中饰演女主角，并因此一举成名。
description.en: A 2004 film directed by Stephen Chow, in which Huang Shengyi played the female lead and rose to fame.

description.zh-cn: 2007年播出的电视剧，是黄圣依的代表作之一。
description.en: A TV series broadcast in 2007, which is one of Huang Shengyi's representative works.

description.zh-cn: 2007年播出的电视剧，由黄圣依和杨子主演，成为央视八套当年的收视冠军。
description.en: A TV series aired in 2007 starring Huang Shengyi and Yang Zi, which became the ratings champion of CCTV-8 for that year.

en: The Sorcerer and the White Snake

description.zh-cn: 2011年上映的电影，由黄圣依主演，帮助其事业重回正轨。
description.en: A film released in 2011 starring Huang Shengyi, which helped get her career back on track.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆对特定时期四位新生代女演员的称呼。2009年，黄圣依与刘亦菲、杨幂、王珞丹一同获此称号。
description.en: A title given to four promising young actresses of a certain period in mainland China. In 2009, Huang Shengyi, along with Liu Yifei, Yang Mi, and Wang Luodan, was given this title.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，与黄圣依等人同被评为2009年“四小花旦”。
description.en: A Chinese actress, named as one of the 'Four Dan Actresses' of 2009 along with Huang Shengyi and others.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，与黄圣依等人同被评为2009年“四小花旦”。
description.en: A Chinese actress, named as one of the 'Four Dan Actresses' of 2009 along with Huang Shengyi and others.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，与黄圣依等人同被评为2009年“四小花旦”。
description.en: A Chinese actress, named as one of the 'Four Dan Actresses' of 2009 along with Huang Shengyi and others.

description.zh-cn: 中国大型互联网公司，2009年发起“80后新生代娱乐大明星”评选。
description.en: A major Chinese internet company that launched the 'Post-80s New Generation Entertainment Superstars' poll in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 英皇娱乐集团旗下负责中国大陆艺人管理的子公司，黄圣依于2007年签约。
description.en: A subsidiary of Emperor Entertainment Group responsible for artist management in mainland China, which Huang Shengyi signed with in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 杨子的前妻，毕业于复旦大学。
description.en: Yang Zi's ex-wife, a graduate of Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 中国茶学家、茶学教育家、茶树栽培专家，曾任安徽农学院党委书记、教授。
description.en: Chinese tea scientist, tea science educator, and tea tree cultivation expert, who served as Party Secretary and professor at Anhui Agricultural College.

description.zh-cn: 一所位于中国安徽省的农业高等院校。
description.en: An agricultural college located in Anhui Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国药理学专家，中国科学院上海药物研究所研究员。其团队研发的阿尔茨海默症新药“九期一”及其相关论文曾引发学术造假争议。
description.en: A Chinese pharmacologist and researcher at the Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences. The Alzheimer's new drug 'GV-971' developed by her team and its related papers have sparked controversy over academic fraud.

en: Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences
zh-cn: 中国科学院上海药物研究所

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院下属的药物研究机构，耿美玉在此担任研究员。
description.en: A pharmaceutical research institute under the Chinese Academy of Sciences, where Geng Meiyu works as a researcher.

description.zh-cn: 一款由耿美玉团队研发的声称用于治疗阿尔茨海默症的新药，其有效性与研究数据存在争议。
description.en: A new drug developed by Geng Meiyu's team claimed to treat Alzheimer's disease, whose efficacy and research data are controversial.

description.zh-cn: 一个供科研人员匿名评论科学研究的网站，该网站上出现了对耿美玉团队论文的质疑。
description.en: A website that allows scientists to anonymously comment on scientific research, where questions were raised about papers from Geng Meiyu's team.

description.zh-cn: 中国神经生物学家，首都医科大学校长。曾实名举报耿美玉等人论文造假。
description.en: A Chinese neurobiologist and president of Capital Medical University. He once publicly reported Geng Meiyu and others for academic fraud.

zh-cn: 曹雪涛等人论文调查事件

description.zh-cn: 一起涉及多位中国科学家的论文数据可靠性争议事件，耿美玉是主要被调查者之一。
description.en: An event involving controversies over the reliability of paper data from several Chinese scientists, in which Geng Meiyu was one of the main subjects of investigation.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，与耿美玉、裴钢一同被饶毅实名举报论文造假。
description.en: A Chinese scholar who, along with Geng Meiyu and Pei Gang, was publicly reported by Rao Yi for academic fraud.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省岳阳市临湘市的行政管理机关。
description.en: The administrative organ of Linxiang City, Yueyang City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，自2021年10月起担任临湘市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, serving as the Mayor of Linxiang since October 2021.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任临湘市市长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Mayor of Linxiang.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省岳阳市下辖的县级市。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Yueyang City, Hunan Province.

description.zh-cn: 由美国司法部及20个州份的检察长联合发起的针对微软公司的反垄断诉讼。
description.en: An antitrust lawsuit filed against Microsoft Corporation by the U.S. Department of Justice and the attorneys general of 20 states.

description.zh-cn: 中国湖南省长沙市的一家区域性股份制商业银行。
description.en: A regional joint-stock commercial bank in Changsha, Hunan Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 清朝第八位皇帝，鸦片战争时期的在位君主。

zh-cn: 第三代巴麦尊子爵亨利·坦普尔

description.zh-cn: 时任英国外交大臣，主张对华采取强硬军事行动。
清朝宗室，被道光帝任命为靖逆将军，负责广东军务。
1841年英军对虎门炮台发起的总攻，导致炮台陷落，水师提督关天培战死。
第二次广州之战后，奕山与义律订立的停战协定，内容包括清军撤离广州并支付600万银元赎城费。
英军在长江战役中攻占镇江的战斗，切断了京杭大运河漕运，直接促使清政府求和。
清朝江南提督，在吴淞战役中阵亡。
英军攻占长江门户吴淞炮台的战役，江南提督陈化成在此战中阵亡。
中国福建省福州府下辖的一个县，为吴石的出生地。
description.en: A county under Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian Province, China, and the birthplace of Wu Shi.

en: Japanese Army Artillery and Engineering School

description.zh-cn: 旧日本陆军的军事学校，吴石曾在此就读。
description.en: A military school of the former Imperial Japanese Army, where Wu Shi once studied.

zh-cn: 国民政府军事委员会委员长行营

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期国民政府在桂林设立的军事指挥机构。
description.en: A military command established in Guilin by the Nationalist Government during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争时期，中华民国国民政府划分的战区之一。
description.en: One of the war zones designated by the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 中国军事及政治人物，对吴石为共产党工作有重要影响。
description.en: A Chinese military and political figure who had a significant influence on Wu Shi's work for the Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党地下党员，在吴石的帮助下获得重要军事情报。
description.en: An underground member of the Chinese Communist Party who obtained crucial military intelligence with the help of Wu Shi.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲的祖父，曾在228事件中被捕，后病逝。
description.en: Grandfather of Ko Wen-je, who was arrested during the 228 Incident and later died of illness.

description.zh-cn: 台湾心脏外科医师，柯文哲的老师，曾任台大医院外科主任。
description.en: A Taiwanese cardiac surgeon and mentor to Ko Wen-je, who formerly served as the Director of Surgery at National Taiwan University Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 一种医疗急救设备，又称“体外膜氧合”，柯文哲是台湾引进并推广此技术的关键人物之一。
description.en: A medical emergency device, also known as Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO). Ko Wen-je was one of the key figures in introducing and promoting this technology in Taiwan.

zh-cn: 公共电视文化事业基金会

description.zh-cn: 台湾的公共电视机构，与中华电视公司共同组成台湾公共广播电视集团。
description.en: The public television service in Taiwan, which, together with the Chinese Television System, forms the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的无线电视台之一，与公共电视文化事业基金会共同组成台湾公共广播电视集团。
description.en: One of Taiwan's terrestrial television stations, which, together with the Public Television Service Foundation, forms the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 台湾公共广播电视集团旗下的电视频道，主要服务客家族群。
description.en: A television channel under the Taiwan Broadcasting System, primarily serving the Hakka ethnic group.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的少数民族语言电视台。曾为台湾公共广播电视集团成员，后改由原住民族文化事业基金会经营。
description.en: An indigenous language television station in Taiwan. It was formerly a member of the Taiwan Broadcasting System and is now operated by the Indigenous Peoples Cultural Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 曾为台湾公共广播电视集团成员的频道，主要面向海外侨胞，于2018年停止营运。
description.en: A former channel of the Taiwan Broadcasting System, primarily targeting overseas Taiwanese communities, which ceased operations in 2018.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任行政院新闻局局长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as the Director-General of the Government Information Office.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的媒体改革倡议团体，积极推动成立公共广播电视集团。
description.en: A media reform advocacy group in Taiwan that actively promoted the establishment of a public broadcasting group.

description.zh-cn: 台湾作家、电影人，曾任公广集团首任总经理。
description.en: A Taiwanese writer and filmmaker who served as the first General Manager of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 台湾影视制作人，映画传播董事长，曾任公广集团（华视）总经理。
description.en: A Taiwanese television producer, chairman of Trans-Asia Television Production, and former general manager of the Taiwan Broadcasting System (CTS).

zh-cn: 原住民族文化事业基金会

description.zh-cn: 负责经营原住民族电视台的财团法人。
description.en: The foundation responsible for operating the Indigenous Television.

description.zh-cn: 台湾公共广播电视集团旗下的国际影音串流平台与电视频道。
description.en: An international video streaming platform and television channel under the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 国立政治大学教育学系副教授，曾任公广集团董事长。
description.en: Associate professor in the Department of Education at National Chengchi University, former chairman of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学教授，首位公广集团女性董事长，并曾兼任总经理。
description.en: Professor at Tamkang University, the first female chairperson of the Taiwan Broadcasting System, and also served concurrently as general manager.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，曾任行政院新闻局长及公广集团董事长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as Director-General of the Government Information Office and chairman of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 国立政治大学广告系教授，曾代理公广集团董事长并暂兼总经理。
description.en: Professor in the Department of Advertising at National Chengchi University, served as acting chairman and interim general manager of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 资深媒体人，曾任公广集团总经理。
description.en: Veteran media professional, former general manager of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 台湾新闻主播及主持人，曾代理公广集团总经理。
description.en: A Taiwanese news anchor and host, served as acting general manager of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 韩国培养陆军军官的军事院校，全斗焕于1955年作为第11期学员毕业。
description.en: A military academy for training army officers in South Korea, from which Chun Doo-hwan graduated as a member of the 11th class in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 1979年朴正熙遇刺后，由国军保安司令全斗焕发动的军事政变，使其掌握了军政大权。
description.en: Following the assassination of Park Chung-hee in 1979, this military coup was launched by Defense Security Commander Chun Doo-hwan, allowing him to seize military and political power.

description.zh-cn: 时任韩国陆军参谋总长，在双十二政变中被全斗焕逮捕。
description.en: The then-Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea Army, who was arrested by Chun Doo-hwan during the Coup d'état of December Twelfth.

description.zh-cn: 韩国前总统，在全斗焕发动的政变后被迫辞职。
description.en: Former President of South Korea who was forced to resign after the coup launched by Chun Doo-hwan.

zh-cn: 大韩民国国军机务司令部

description.zh-cn: 韩国军队的情报和安全机构，全斗焕在担任此机构司令官期间发动政变。
description.en: The intelligence and security agency of the South Korean military. Chun Doo-hwan launched a coup while serving as its commander.

description.zh-cn: 全斗焕的夫人，韩国前第一夫人。
description.en: Wife of Chun Doo-hwan and former First Lady of South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 由全斗焕创建的韩国政党，是其执政时期的执政党。
description.en: A South Korean political party founded by Chun Doo-hwan, which served as the ruling party during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 位于韩国庆尚南道的一个郡，是全斗焕的出生地。
description.en: A county in South Gyeongsang Province, South Korea, and the birthplace of Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代后宫嫔御的一种等级称号。
description.en: A rank for imperial consorts in ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的一种政治制度，为防止外戚专权，在储君年幼时将其生母赐死。汉武帝处死钩弋夫人的事件被视为此制度的先例。
description.en: An ancient Chinese political practice of executing the mother of a young heir apparent to prevent maternal relatives from usurping power. Emperor Wu's execution of Lady Gouyi is considered a precedent for this system.

description.zh-cn: 汉昭帝为其母赵婕妤（钩弋夫人）修筑的陵墓。
description.en: The mausoleum built by Emperor Zhao of Han for his mother, Zhao Jieyu (Lady Gouyi).

description.zh-cn: 唐代道士，李白的挚友，两人交往甚密，常一同隐居、游历。
description.en: A Daoist priest of the Tang dynasty and a close friend of Li Bai. They associated closely, often living in seclusion and traveling together.

description.zh-cn: 李白的儿子。
description.en: The son of Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 高雄市的最高行政机关。
description.en: The highest administrative body of Kaohsiung City.

description.zh-cn: 高雄市的最高民意机关。
description.en: The highest legislative body of Kaohsiung City.

description.zh-cn: 明郑时期设立的行政区，范围约为今日的高雄地区。
description.en: An administrative division established during the Kingdom of Tungning, covering the area of present-day Kaohsiung.

description.zh-cn: 郑成功长子，明郑王朝第二代君主，延平王。在位期间，出兵响应吴三桂，参与三藩之乱。
description.en: Eldest son of Koxinga, the second monarch of the Kingdom of Tungning, and King of Yanping. During his reign, he sent troops to respond to Wu Sangui and participated in the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战末期，美军对高雄市的战略轰炸行动。
description.en: Strategic bombing campaign against Kaohsiung by the United States military during the late stages of World War II.

zh-cn: 2010年中华民国县市改制直辖市

description.zh-cn: 中华民国行政区划的重大调整，多个县市进行合并或升格。
description.en: A major adjustment of administrative divisions in the Republic of China, where several counties and cities were merged or upgraded.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国台湾省下的一个县，2010年与高雄市合并。
description.en: A former county of Taiwan Province, Republic of China, which merged with Kaohsiung City in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 2010年县市合并前的高雄市。
description.en: Kaohsiung City before the 2010 county-city merger.

1933年2月27日德国国会大厦发生的火灾，被纳粹党用作镇压政治异议、巩固权力的借口。
description.en: An arson attack on the Reichstag building in Berlin on 27 February 1933, used by the Nazi Party as a pretext to suppress political dissent and consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 1933年3月23日通过的魏玛宪法修正案，该法案使希特勒及其内阁能够不经国会或总统同意而颁布法律，有效地将德国转变为独裁国家。
description.en: A 1933 Weimar Constitution amendment that gave the German Cabinet—in effect, Chancellor Adolf Hitler—the power to enact laws without the involvement of the Reichstag, effectively turning Germany into a dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹政权于1934年发起的一场政治清洗行动，旨在清除冲锋队及其领导人恩斯特·罗姆，以及其他政治对手。
description.en: A political purge that took place in Nazi Germany in 1934, targeting the Sturmabteilung (SA) and its leader Ernst Röhm, as well as other political opponents.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹党早期成员，冲锋队的联合创始人及指挥官，在“长刀之夜”中被处决。
description.en: An early member of the Nazi Party, co-founder and commander of the Sturmabteilung (SA), who was executed during the Night of the Long Knives.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹党的原始准军事组织，在“长刀之夜”后其影响力被大幅削弱。
description.en: The original paramilitary wing of the Nazi Party. Its influence was greatly diminished after the Night of the Long Knives.

description.zh-cn: 在1938年德奥合并前存在的奥地利国家。
description.en: The Austrian state that existed prior to the Anschluss with Nazi Germany in 1938.

zh-cn: 捷克斯洛伐克历史 (1918年—1938年)
捷克斯洛伐克历史 (1918年–38年)

description.zh-cn: 存在于1918年至1938年间的捷克斯洛伐克国家，在《慕尼黑协定》后被迫割让苏台德地区。
description.en: The state of Czechoslovakia existing from 1918 to 1938, which was forced to cede the Sudetenland after the Munich Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战东线战场的重大战役，被认为是战争的转折点。
description.en: A major battle on the Eastern Front of World War II, widely regarded as the turning point of the war.

description.zh-cn: 1944年6月6日盟军在诺曼底的登陆行动，开辟了欧洲西线战场。
description.en: The Allied landing operations in Normandy on 6 June 1944, which opened a Western Front in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 1945年5月7日德国国防军最高统帅部签署的法律文件，标志着第二次世界大战欧洲战场的结束。
description.en: The legal document signed on May 7, 1945, by the German High Command that effected the end of World War II in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后由同盟国举行的一系列军事法庭，旨在审判纳粹德国的战争罪行。
description.en: A series of military tribunals held by the Allied forces after World War II to prosecute war crimes committed by Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹党领导下的主要准军事组织，在海因里希·希姆莱的领导下，负责执行纳粹德国的种族政策，包括犹太人大屠杀。
description.en: A major paramilitary organization under the Nazi Party. Under the command of Heinrich Himmler, it was responsible for enforcing the racial policy of Nazi Germany, including the Holocaust.

description.zh-cn: 党卫队全国领袖，纳粹德国的主要领导人之一，是犹太人大屠杀的主要策划者。
description.en: Reichsführer of the Schutzstaffel (SS) and a leading member of the Nazi Party. He was one of the main architects of the Holocaust.

description.zh-cn: 中国科技管理工作者、中国共产党党员。曾任北京图书馆副馆长，中国科学院系统科学研究所党委书记、副所长，中国数学会常务理事，中国系统工程学会常务理事。
description.en: A Chinese science and technology administrator and a member of the Communist Party of China. He served as the Deputy Director of the Beijing Library, Party Secretary and Deputy Director of the Institute of Systems Science of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and a standing council member of both the Chinese Mathematical Society and the Systems Engineering Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国的全国性系统工程学术团体，胡凡夫曾是其常务理事。
description.en: A national academic society for systems engineering in China, where Hu Fanfu was a standing council member.

description.en: A component department of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government of Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China, responsible for health and wellness. It was formed in January 2019 by integrating the former Shenzhen Municipal Health and Family Planning Commission, the Municipal Public Hospital Management Center, and other institutions.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任深圳市卫生健康委员会主任、市委卫生工委书记。

description.zh-cn: 深圳市人民政府组成部门，与市卫健委在食品安全风险监测评估、药品不良反应通报等方面存在职责分工。
description.en: A component department of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government, which has a division of responsibilities with the Municipal Health Commission regarding food safety risk monitoring and assessment, and reporting of adverse drug reactions.

description.zh-cn: 一本以“XX平安”为格式创作的书籍，因内容空洞引发中国大陆舆论争议。深圳卫健委曾模仿其文体进行健康科普。
description.en: A book written in the format of 'XX peace', which sparked public controversy in mainland China due to its empty content. The Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission once imitated its style for health education purposes.

description.zh-cn: 位于深圳市的市属公立医院。

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，实德集团与实德系的创始人。曾与薄熙来家族关系密切，后因薄熙来事件被判刑，在狱中因心肌梗死去世。
description.en: A Chinese entrepreneur, founder of Shide Group and the 'Shide system' in Chinese football. He had close ties with Bo Xilai's family, was later sentenced in the Bo Xilai case, and died of a myocardial infarction in prison.

description.zh-cn: 中国辽宁省大连市下辖的县级市，是徐明的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Dalian, Liaoning province, China. It is the birthplace of Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国沈阳市的大学。徐明曾在此就读国际贸易专业的成人教育班。
description.en: A university located in Shenyang, China. Xu Ming attended its adult education program for International Trade.

description.zh-cn: 中国女演员，据资料显示为徐明的配偶。
description.en: A Chinese actress, listed as the spouse of Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 徐明的胞兄。
description.en: The elder brother of Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 指由徐明和实德集团在中国足球联赛中建立的，通过控股或关联关系拥有多个足球俱乐部的体系。
description.en: Refers to the system established by Xu Ming and Shide Group in the Chinese football league, which owned multiple football clubs through holding or affiliated relationships.

description.zh-cn: 一家位于大连的职业足球俱乐部。2012赛季结束后，该俱乐部接收了宣告解散的大连实德足球俱乐部的资产。
description.en: A professional football club based in Dalian. After the 2012 season, the club acquired the assets of the dissolved Dalian Shide Football Club.
