description.en: Former Hong Kong champion jockey and current trainer, who was one of the first apprentices in the Jockey Club's training school established in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 指以不正当手法影响赛马结果的非法行为。香港赛马历史上曾发生多起造马案。
description.en: Refers to the illegal act of manipulating horse race outcomes through improper means. Several race-fixing scandals have occurred in the history of Hong Kong racing.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会首位华人行政总裁。
description.en: The first Chinese Chief Executive Officer of the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 英国医生，他发现了牛痘能用以预防天花，被誉为“疫苗之父”。
description.en: An English physician who discovered that cowpox could be used to prevent smallpox, known as the 'father of immunology'.

description.zh-cn: 一种含有活痘苗病毒的疫苗，用于预防天花。通过接种该疫苗，人类成功地消灭了天花。
description.en: A vaccine containing live vaccinia virus, used to prevent smallpox. Through the administration of this vaccine, humanity successfully eradicated smallpox.

description.zh-cn: 古埃及法老，其木乃伊上留有脓疱痕迹，被认为是史上已知最早的天花病人之一。
description.en: An ancient Egyptian pharaoh whose mummy bears pockmarks, considered one of the earliest known victims of smallpox.

description.zh-cn: 日本战国时代的著名大名，因幼年感染天花而导致右眼失明。
description.en: A famous daimyo of the Sengoku period in Japan, who lost his right eye due to a smallpox infection in his childhood.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国皇帝，因感染天花而去世。
description.en: Emperor of the Russian Empire, who died from smallpox.

description.zh-cn: 14世纪至16世纪的墨西哥古代文明。天花的大规模流行是导致其被西班牙征服的重要因素之一。
description.en: An ancient civilization in Mexico from the 14th to the 16th century. The widespread smallpox epidemic was a significant factor leading to its conquest by the Spanish.

description.zh-cn: 15世纪至16世纪位于南美洲的古代帝国。天花的流行严重削弱了帝国，加速了其被西班牙征服的进程。
description.en: An ancient empire in South America from the 15th to the 16th century. The spread of smallpox severely weakened the empire, accelerating its conquest by the Spanish.

description.zh-cn: 孟加拉国女童，1975年被确诊，是世界上最后一位自然感染天花病毒的病人。
description.en: A girl from Bangladesh who was diagnosed in 1975 and is known as the last person in the world to be naturally infected with the variola major virus.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中央纪委国家监委国际合作局局长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, current Director of the International Cooperation Bureau of the CCDI and NSC.

description.zh-cn: 联合国通过的旨在指导各国反腐败的法律文件。
description.en: A legally binding United Nations multilateral treaty against corruption.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任国家预防腐败局首任局长。
description.en: Chinese politician, served as the first Director of the National Bureau of Corruption Prevention.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交官、官员，曾任中央纪委国家监委国际合作局局长。
description.en: Chinese diplomat and official, former Director of the International Cooperation Bureau of the CCDI and NSC.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任监察部部长、中央纪委副书记，是中央反腐败协调小组国际追逃追赃工作办公室首任负责人。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Supervision and Deputy Secretary of the CCDI, and the first head of the International Fugitive Repatriation and Asset Recovery Office of the Central Anti-Corruption Coordination Group.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，蒋超良担任中共湖北省委书记期间的副书记兼省长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Deputy Secretary and Governor while Jiang Chaoliang was Party Secretary of Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国金融界人物，蒋超良的前任中国农业银行董事长。
description.en: A figure in China's financial sector, Jiang Chaoliang's predecessor as Chairman of the Agricultural Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物、第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。曾长期在中国移动任职，现任河北省人民政府党组成员、副省长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China and a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress. He had a long career at China Mobile and currently serves as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Governor of the Hebei Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋于1994年导演的电影，在中国大陆未获公映许可。
description.en: A 1994 film directed by Zhang Yimou, which was not approved for public release in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省无锡市下辖的市辖区，其计生局曾就超生问题对张艺谋进行调查和处罚。
description.en: A district of Wuxi, Jiangsu, China, whose family planning bureau investigated and fined Zhang Yimou for exceeding birth quotas.

description.zh-cn: 明朝锦衣卫指挥使。他在洪武二十六年（1393年）向明太祖告发蓝玉谋反，直接引发了蓝玉案。
description.en: Commander of the Jinyiwei during the Ming Dynasty. In 1393, he reported to Emperor Taizu that Lan Yu was plotting a rebellion, which directly triggered the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，封定远侯。在蓝玉案后不久被迫自尽。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty, ennobled as the Marquis of Dingyuan. He was forced to commit suicide shortly after the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝高级军事统帅职务。蓝玉于洪武二十一年（1388年）被拜为大将军，征伐北元。
description.en: A high-ranking military commander position in the Ming Dynasty. Lan Yu was appointed Grand General in 1388 to lead the expedition against the Northern Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖养子，明朝开国功臣，长期镇守云南。蓝玉曾于洪武十一年（1378年）跟随其征讨吐蕃。
description.en: The adopted son of Emperor Taizu of Ming and a founding official of the Ming Dynasty, who governed Yunnan for a long period. Lan Yu followed him on an expedition against Tibet in 1378.

description.zh-cn: 元朝降将，任建昌指挥使。洪武二十四年（1392年）在建昌起兵反明，后被蓝玉平定。
description.en: A surrendered general of the Yuan Dynasty who served as the commander of Jianchang. In 1392, he launched a rebellion against the Ming in Jianchang, which was later suppressed by Lan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，封鹤庆侯。在蓝玉案中被指为同党并遭诛杀。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty, ennobled as the Marquis of Heqing. He was accused of being an accomplice in the Lan Yu case and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，封舳舻侯。在蓝玉案中被指为同党并遭诛杀。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty, ennobled as the Marquis of Zhulu. He was accused of being an accomplice in the Lan Yu case and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，封会宁侯。因蓝玉案被株连诛杀。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty, ennobled as the Marquis of Huining. He was implicated and executed in the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，封普定侯。因蓝玉案被株连诛杀。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty, ennobled as the Marquis of Puding. He was implicated and executed in the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝开国将领，封怀远侯。因蓝玉案被株连诛杀。
description.en: A founding general of the Ming Dynasty, ennobled as the Marquis of Huaiyuan. He was implicated and executed in the Lan Yu case.

birth_place.zh-cn: 河南省固始县武庙集乡锁口村
birth_place.en: Suokou Village, Wumiaoji Township, Gushi County, Henan Province

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任湖北省副省长、中共中央顾问委员会委员。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Governor of Hubei Province and a member of the Central Advisory Commission of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 新四军在豫鄂地区的部队，夏世厚曾在此任职。
description.en: A unit of the New Fourth Army in the Henan-Hubei region, where Xia Shihou served.

zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业机械部
中华人民共和国第八机械工业部
en: Ministry of Agricultural Machinery of the People's Republic of China
Eighth Ministry of Machine Building of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院原有的一个组成部门，主管农业机械事务。1959年8月组建，1965年1月改称中华人民共和国第八机械工业部，1970年7月并入第一机械工业部。
description.en: A former constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, in charge of agricultural machinery affairs. It was established in August 1959, renamed the Eighth Ministry of Machine Building in January 1965, and merged into the First Ministry of Machine Building in July 1970.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国农业机械部军管会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician who served as the Director of the Military Control Committee of the Ministry of Agricultural Machinery of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国北京市东城区的一条街道，中华人民共和国农业机械部曾在此办公。
description.en: A street in Dongcheng District, Beijing, China, where the Ministry of Agricultural Machinery of the People's Republic of China was once located.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院组成部门，主管交通运输工作。2009年与中央人民广播电台签署战略合作协议。
description.en: A constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China, responsible for transportation. It signed a strategic cooperation agreement with China National Radio in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的一种县级行政区，通常因当地有特殊的厂矿而设立，许多特区实行政企合一的管理体制。
description.en: A type of county-level administrative division in the People's Republic of China, usually established due to the presence of special factories and mines in the area. Many special districts implemented a government-enterprise integration management system.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国现存的唯一一个特区，为大型煤矿区。
description.en: The only remaining special district in the People's Republic of China, it is a large-scale coal mining area.

description.zh-cn: 1963年撤销友谊县设立友谊特区，实行与国营友谊农场场区合一的体制，1964年恢复友谊县建制。
description.en: In 1963, Youyi County was abolished and Youyi Special District was established, implementing a unified system with the state-owned Youyi Farm. In 1964, Youyi County was re-established.

description.zh-cn: 中国黑龙江省已撤销的地区。
description.en: A former prefecture in Heilongjiang province, China.

zh-cn: 大兴安岭林区会战指挥部
大兴安岭特区人民委员会

description.zh-cn: 为开发大兴安岭林区而设立的专区级行政单位。初期名为大兴安岭特区，与黑龙江大兴安岭林业管理局实行政企合一的管理体制。1970年改名为大兴安岭地区。
description.en: A prefecture-level administrative unit established for the development of the Daxing'anling forest area. Initially named Daxing'anling Special District, it implemented a government-enterprise integration management system with the Heilongjiang Daxing'anling Forestry Administration. It was renamed Daxing'anling Prefecture in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 因大庆油田而设立的城市。1965年成立时名为安达特区，实行仿大庆油田的政企合一模式。1979年更名为大庆市。
description.en: A city established due to the Daqing Oil Field. When founded in 1965, it was named Anda Special District and adopted a government-enterprise integration model similar to the Daqing Oil Field. It was renamed Daqing City in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任石油部副部长、大庆会战指挥部指挥、安达特区工委书记，并曾任中华人民共和国煤炭工业部部长。
description.en: A Chinese politician who served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Petroleum Industry, commander of the Daqing Battle Command, Party Secretary of the Anda Special District, and also as Minister of the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1965年建立时为七台河特区，与七台河矿务局实行政企合一管理体制。1970年改称七台河市。
description.en: Established as Qitaihe Special District in 1965, it implemented a government-enterprise integration management system with the Qitaihe Mining Bureau. It was renamed Qitaihe City in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省地级市。在1964年至1971年间曾被设立为专级的铜陵特区。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Anhui Province. Between 1964 and 1971, it was established as the prefecture-level Tongling Special District.

description.zh-cn: 河南省地级市。在1964年至1969年间曾被设立为地级的平顶山特区，实行政企合一，由煤炭部和河南省双重领导。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Henan Province. Between 1964 and 1969, it was established as the prefecture-level Pingdingshan Special District, implementing government-enterprise integration under the dual leadership of the Ministry of Coal Industry and Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国湖北省已撤销的专区。
description.en: A former prefecture in Hubei province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国湖南省已撤销的专区，为现邵阳市的前身。
description.en: A former prefecture in Hunan province, China, the predecessor of the current Shaoyang City.

description.zh-cn: 为建设攀枝花工业基地和作为三线建设时期重要煤炭基地而设立的城市。1965年成立时名为攀枝花特区，实行政企合一。该特区是中国四川省攀枝花市的旧称，后更名为渡口市，1987年再更名为攀枝花市。
description.en: A city established for the construction of the Panzhihua industrial base and as an important coal base during the 'Third Front' construction period. When founded in 1965, it was named Panzhihua Special District, implementing government-enterprise integration. This special district was the former name of Panzhihua City in Sichuan province, China. It was later renamed Dukou City, and then renamed Panzhihua City in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 贵州省贵阳市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Guiyang City, Guizhou Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国贵州省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guizhou province, China.

description.zh-cn: 贵州省已撤销的县。原名六枝县，1966年更名为郎岱县，1970年并入六枝特区。
description.en: A former county in Guizhou Province. Originally named Liuzhi County, it was renamed Langdai County in 1966 and merged into Liuzhi Special District in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 为开发水城煤矿而设立的特区。1970年，原水城县并入该特区。1987年撤销，分设为钟山区和水城县。
description.en: A special district established for the development of the Shuicheng coal mine. In 1970, the original Shuicheng County was merged into this district. It was abolished in 1987 and divided into Zhongshan District and Shuicheng County.

description.zh-cn: 中国贵州省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Guizhou province, China.

description.zh-cn: 贵州省六盘水市代管的县级市。1966年设立盘县特区，1970年原盘县并入特区。1999年恢复盘县名称，2017年更名为盘州市。
description.en: A county-level city administered by Liupanshui City, Guizhou Province. Panxian Special District was established in 1966, and the original Pan County was merged into the district in 1970. The name Pan County was restored in 1999, and it was renamed Panzhou City in 2017.

zh-cn: 黔西南布依族苗族自治州
en: Qianxinan Buyei and Miao Autonomous Prefecture

description.zh-cn: 中国贵州省下辖的自治州。
description.en: An autonomous prefecture in Guizhou province, China.

description.zh-cn: 为服务贵州汞矿而设立的万山特区，与汞矿合署办公。经历撤销和恢复后，于2011年与原县级铜仁市部分乡镇合并为新的万山区。
description.en: Wanshan Special District was established to serve the Guizhou mercury mine and operated jointly with the mine. After being abolished and restored, it was merged with parts of the former county-level Tongren City in 2011 to form the new Wanshan District.

description.zh-cn: 中国贵州省已撤销的地区，为现铜仁市的前身。
description.en: A former prefecture in Guizhou province, China, the predecessor of the current Tongren City.

description.zh-cn: 中国学者，安徽师范大学教授，享受国务院政府特殊津贴专家。
description.en: A Chinese scholar, professor at Anhui Normal University, and an expert receiving the special government allowance of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中国安徽省合肥市下辖县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Hefei City, Anhui Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国安徽省下辖的地级市。
description.en: A prefecture-level city in Anhui Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 俞强声的高祖父。
description.en: Paternal great-great-grandfather of Yu Qiangsheng.

description.zh-cn: 中国企业家，联想集团创始人，被描述为倪光南的“死对头”。
description.en: A Chinese entrepreneur, founder of Lenovo Group, described as the 'nemesis' of Ni Guangnan.

description.zh-cn: 中国计算机科学家，曾声援俞慈声，并与柳传志有分歧。
description.en: A Chinese computer scientist who supported Yu Cisheng and had disagreements with Liu Chuanzhi.

zh-cn: 国家海外高层次人才引进计划

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于2008年发起的海外高层次人才引进计划，旨在围绕国家发展战略目标，重点引进在海外学习工作的高层次人才。
description.en: A high-level talent recruitment program initiated by the People's Republic of China in 2008, aimed at attracting high-level talent studying and working overseas to serve the country's development strategic goals.

description.zh-cn: 中国的社交网络与即时通讯应用。
description.en: A Chinese social networking and instant messaging application.

description.zh-cn: 原台湾国立中央大学教授，后入选“千人计划”。
description.en: A former professor at Taiwan's National Central University who was later selected for the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

zh-cn: 北京大学生命科学学院
en: Peking University School of Life Sciences

description.zh-cn: 北京大学下属的学院。
description.en: A school under Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 哈佛大学科学家，因其与“千人计划”及武汉理工大学的关系而被美国检方起诉。
description.en: A Harvard University scientist who was prosecuted by U.S. authorities for his connections to the 'Thousand Talents Program' and Wuhan University of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 前美国克利夫兰诊所雇员，“千人计划”学者，曾因未披露与该计划的关系被捕，但案件后被驳回。
description.en: A former employee of the Cleveland Clinic in the U.S. and a 'Thousand Talents Program' scholar, who was arrested for failing to disclose his relationship with the program, but the case was later dismissed.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国的著名医疗机构。
description.en: A renowned medical institution located in the United States.

en: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 日本的国立研究开发法人。
description.en: A National Research and Development Agency in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国俄亥俄州的一所公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in Ohio, United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国主要的生物医学和公共卫生研究机构。
description.en: The primary agency of the United States government responsible for biomedical and public health research.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在1953年提出的指导从新民主主义向社会主义过渡时期工作的总路线，包含了“三大改造”的内容。
description.en: The general line proposed by the Communist Party of China in 1953 to guide the work during the transition period from New Democracy to socialism, which included the 'Three Great Transformations'.

description.zh-cn: 农业合作化运动第一阶段（1949-1953）的主要组织形式。
description.en: The main organizational form during the first stage (1949-1953) of the agricultural collectivization movement.

description.zh-cn: 农业合作化运动第二阶段（1954-1955上半年）的主要组织形式。
description.en: The main organizational form during the second stage (1954-mid 1955) of the agricultural collectivization movement.

description.zh-cn: 农业合作化运动第三阶段（1955下半年-1956）的主要组织形式。
description.en: The main organizational form during the third stage (late 1955-1956) of the agricultural collectivization movement.

description.zh-cn: 河北省下辖的县级市，建明社所在地。
description.en: A county-level city under the administration of Hebei Province, where the Jianming Cooperative was located.

description.zh-cn: 由刘永福领导的武装力量，在越南北部协助清军抵抗法军。
description.en: An armed force led by Liu Yongfu that assisted the Qing army in resisting French forces in northern Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 黑旗军领袖，在越南抵抗法国侵略。
description.en: Leader of the Black Flag Army, who resisted French aggression in Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 时任法国总理，主导对越南的殖民扩张。因镇南关失利的消息而内阁倒台。
description.en: The Prime Minister of France at the time, who spearheaded colonial expansion in Vietnam. His cabinet fell following the news of the defeat at Zhennan Pass.

description.zh-cn: 法国海军将领，远东舰队司令。指挥了马江之役并攻占澎湖，后病逝于澎湖。
description.en: A French admiral and commander of the Far East Squadron. He commanded the Battle of Fuzhou and captured the Pescadores, where he later died of illness.

description.zh-cn: 法国海军军官，1883年在河内城西的纸桥之役中被黑旗军击毙，此事件是法国扩大战争规模的导火索。
description.en: A French naval officer who was killed by the Black Flag Army in the Battle of Paper Bridge near Hanoi in 1883. This event served as a catalyst for France to escalate the war.

zh-cn: 中法会订越南条约十款

description.zh-cn: 中法战争后由李鸿章和巴德诺在天津签订的条约，正式结束了战争，清朝承认法国对越南的保护权。
description.en: The treaty signed by Li Hongzhang and Jules Patenôtre in Tianjin after the Sino-French War, which formally ended the conflict and in which the Qing dynasty recognized the French protectorate over Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 法国外交官，作为法方全权公使与李鸿章签订了《中法新约》。
description.en: A French diplomat who, as the French minister plenipotentiary, signed the Treaty of Tientsin with Li Hongzhang.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争期间，英属香港的华人为支持清廷而发动的罢工行动。
description.en: A strike initiated by the Chinese population in British Hong Kong during the Sino-French War to support the Qing court.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争期间法军攻占澎湖列岛的战役，法军司令孤拔在占领后不久病逝于此。
description.en: The campaign during the Sino-French War in which French forces captured the Penghu Islands. The French commander, Amédée Courbet, died of illness here shortly after the occupation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国教育家、政治人物，陕甘宁边区政府副主席。
description.en: Chinese educator and politician, vice-chairman of the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region government.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，长期统治陕北地区。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China who ruled northern Shaanxi for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期党员和革命活动家。
description.en: An early member and revolutionary activist of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党党员，革命烈士。
description.en: A member of the Chinese Communist Party and a revolutionary martyr.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期位于北平的一所监狱，关押过许多中共党员。
description.en: A prison in Beiping during the Republic of China era, where many CCP members were incarcerated.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家重点京剧院团，邀请吴晗创作了京剧《海瑞罢官》。
description.en: A key national Beijing opera troupe in China, which invited Wu Han to create the Beijing opera 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 京剧表演艺术家，在京剧《海瑞罢官》中饰演主角海瑞。
description.en: A Beijing opera performing artist who played the leading role of Hai Rui in the opera 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 京剧表演艺术家，主演了京剧《海瑞罢官》。
description.en: A Beijing opera performing artist who starred in the opera 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 京剧表演艺术家，主演了京剧《海瑞罢官》。
description.en: A Beijing opera performing artist who starred in the opera 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 京剧琴师，在京剧《海瑞罢官》中担任琴师。
description.en: A Beijing opera musician who served as the accompanist for 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 京剧表演艺术家，因创作类似题材的戏曲《海瑞上疏》而在文革期间受到迫害。
description.en: A Beijing opera performing artist who was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution for creating a similarly themed opera, 'Hai Rui Submits a Memorial'.

zh-cn: 鲍里斯·格里戈里耶维奇·费奥多罗夫

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯经济学家和政治家，曾任联邦税务局局长。
description.en: Russian economist and politician, former head of the Federal Tax Service.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯联邦的政府首脑职位。
description.en: The head of government of the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 位于俄罗斯莫斯科的一所公立技术大学。
description.en: A public technical university in Moscow, Russia.

zh-cn: 中国国民党中央执行委员会常务委员会
en: Standing Committee of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党在特定历史时期的最高决策机构。
description.en: The highest decision-making body of the Kuomintang during specific historical periods.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，彭清华的前任香港中联办主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, Peng Qinghua's predecessor as Director of the Hong Kong Liaison Office.

zh-cn: 班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布

description.zh-cn: 藏传佛教格鲁派第十一世班禅额尔德尼。
description.en: The 11th Panchen Erdini of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任四川省政协主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Chairman of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国湖北省的一个旧县名，现为县级市大冶市。
description.en: A former county in Hubei Province, China, now the county-level city of Daye.

description.zh-cn: 阿根廷政治人物，曾表示阿根廷不会加入金砖国家。
description.en: Argentine politician who stated that Argentina would not join BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 1521年神圣罗马帝国在沃木斯召开的帝国议会，马丁·路德在此受审并拒绝撤回其主张。
description.en: An imperial diet of the Holy Roman Empire held in Worms in 1521, where Martin Luther was examined and refused to recant his views.

zh-cn: 腓特烈三世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 萨克森选侯，在沃木斯议会后保护了马丁·路德，安排其在瓦尔特堡的城堡中避难。
description.en: Elector of Saxony who protected Martin Luther after the Diet of Worms, arranging for him to take refuge in Wartburg Castle.

description.zh-cn: 《圣经·新约》中的一卷书。马丁·路德在钻研此书时领会到“因信称义”的教义，成为其神学思想的核心。
description.en: A book in the New Testament of the Bible. While studying this book, Martin Luther came to understand the doctrine of 'justification by faith', which became the core of his theological thought.

description.zh-cn: 16世纪英国的宗教改革运动，由国王亨利八世领导，使英格兰教会脱离了罗马教廷的管辖。
description.en: The 16th-century religious reform movement in England, led by King Henry VIII, which resulted in the Church of England breaking away from the authority of the papacy in Rome.

description.zh-cn: 源于英格兰宗教改革的基督教宗派，是普世圣公宗的母会。
description.en: A Christian denomination originating from the English Reformation, it is the mother church of the worldwide Anglican Communion.

description.zh-cn: 德国的一所大学，马丁·路德曾在此担任神学教授。
description.en: A university in Germany where Martin Luther served as a professor of theology.

description.zh-cn: 中国儿童文学作家，山东烟台人。
description.en: A Chinese children's literature writer from Yantai, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家协会在辽宁省的分支机构，吴梦起曾任理事。
description.en: The Liaoning branch of the China Writers Association, where Wu Mengqi served as a director.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议辽宁省委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议在辽宁省的地方委员会，吴梦起曾任第五、六届委员。
description.en: The local committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in Liaoning Province, where Wu Mengqi served as a member of the fifth and sixth committees.

zh-cn: 陈伯吹国际儿童文学奖
上海首届儿童文学园丁奖

description.zh-cn: 一项重要的中国儿童文学奖项，吴梦起的作品《老鼠看下棋》曾获此奖。
description.en: An important Chinese children's literature award. Wu Mengqi's work 'The Mouse Watching a Chess Game' won this award.

description.zh-cn: 由中国作家协会主办的儿童文学奖项，吴梦起的作品《老鼠看下棋》曾获第一届奖项。
description.en: A children's literature award sponsored by the China Writers Association. Wu Mengqi's work 'The Mouse Watching a Chess Game' won the first award.

description.zh-cn: 中国的一份儿童文学杂志，曾授予吴梦起的作品《虎牛》年度优秀作品奖。
description.en: A Chinese children's literature magazine that awarded Wu Mengqi's work 'Tiger and Ox' its annual outstanding work prize.

en: Soong Ching Ling Children's Literature Award

description.zh-cn: 以宋庆龄命名的儿童文学奖项，吴梦起的作品集《吴梦起童话选》曾获第四届二等奖。
description.en: A children's literature award named after Soong Ching-ling. Wu Mengqi's collection 'Selected Fairy Tales of Wu Mengqi' won the second prize at the fourth edition.

description.zh-cn: 韩国将军，在云山战斗期间担任韩国第1步兵师师长。
description.en: A South Korean general who commanded the ROK 1st Infantry Division during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 韩国将军，云山战斗期间联合国军指挥官之一。
description.en: A South Korean general, one of the UN commanders during the Battle of Unsan.

en: 115th Mechanized Infantry Brigade (People's Republic of China)
zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军合成第一一五旅

description.zh-cn: 隶属于中国人民志愿军第39军的师级单位，参与了云山战斗。
description.en: A division-level unit of the PVA 39th Corps that participated in the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 韩国陆军的一支师级部队，是云山战斗中首个与中国人民志愿军交战的联合国军部队。
description.en: A division-level unit of the Republic of Korea Army, it was the first UN force to engage the Chinese People's Volunteer Army in the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 位于朝鲜平安北道的一个郡，是云山战斗的发生地。
description.en: A county in North Pyongan Province, North Korea, and the location of the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与朝鲜民主主义人民共和国之间的边界。
description.en: The border between the People's Republic of China and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 位于中朝边境的河流。
description.en: A river on the border between China and North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 位于鸭绿江上的水库，是联合国军的战略目标之一。
description.en: A reservoir on the Yalu River, which was one of the strategic objectives for UN forces.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军的一支师级部队，在云山战斗期间部署于韩国第1师的左翼。
description.en: A division-level unit of the United States Army, deployed on the left flank of the ROK 1st Division during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争第一次战役中的一场战斗，中国人民志愿军在此重创韩国国军。
description.en: A battle during the First Phase Offensive of the Korean War, where the Chinese People's Volunteer Army heavily defeated ROK forces.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军上将，在云山战斗期间担任美国第8军团司令。
description.en: A general in the United States Army who commanded the Eighth United States Army during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 美国陆军在朝鲜战争中的主要地面作战司令部。
description.en: The main ground combat command of the United States Army in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争第二次战役中在西线发生的一场关键战役，导致联合国军的重大失败。
description.en: A key battle on the western front during the Second Phase Offensive of the Korean War, which resulted in a major defeat for the UN forces.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议甘肃省委员会

description.zh-cn: 广西省的一座城市，是王亚樵的遇刺身亡地点。
description.en: A city in Guangxi Province, the place where Wang Yaqiao was assassinated.

description.zh-cn: 时任淞沪上海警察厅厅长，由齐燮元任命，于1923年11月12日被王亚樵派人刺杀。
description.en: Serving as the chief of the Shanghai-Songhu Police Department, appointed by Qi Xieyuan, he was assassinated by Wang Yaqiao's men on November 12, 1923.

description.zh-cn: 即第二次直奉战争期间的江浙战争，徐国梁被刺杀是其导火索之一。
description.en: The Jiangsu-Zhejiang War during the Second Zhili-Fengtian War. The assassination of Xu Guoliang was one of its triggers.

description.zh-cn: 1931年由王亚樵组织的团体，旨在通过暗杀手段清除汉奸和政治对手，策划了刺杀宋子文等行动。
description.en: An organization formed by Wang Yaqiao in 1931, aimed at eliminating traitors and political opponents through assassination. It planned operations such as the assassination of T. V. Soong.

description.zh-cn: 日本海军装甲巡洋舰，在淞沪抗战期间被王亚樵派水手用水雷炸伤。
description.en: An armored cruiser of the Imperial Japanese Navy, which was damaged by mines deployed by sailors sent by Wang Yaqiao during the Shanghai War of 1932.

description.zh-cn: 日本海军中将，时任第三舰队司令，在虹口公园爆炸案中被炸瞎一只眼。
description.en: A vice admiral in the Imperial Japanese Navy and commander of the 3rd Fleet, who was blinded in one eye during the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵的部下。他被军统逮捕后，其妻余婉君被戴笠利用来设局诱杀王亚樵。
description.en: A subordinate of Wang Yaqiao. After his arrest by the Juntong, his wife Yu Wanjun was used by Dai Li to set a trap to assassinate Wang Yaqiao.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争中的主要参战国之一，与法国、俄国结盟，意图收复在奥地利王位继承战争中被普鲁士夺走的西里西亚。
description.en: A major participant in the Seven Years' War, allied with France and Russia, with the goal of recovering Silesia, which had been lost to Prussia in the War of the Austrian Succession.

description.zh-cn: 普鲁士国王，七年战争期间普鲁士的军事统帅。以其军事才能著称，通过入侵萨克森引发了战争的欧洲部分，并在战争后期因“勃兰登堡王室的奇迹”而扭转败局。
description.en: King of Prussia and military commander of the Prussian forces during the Seven Years' War. Known for his military genius, he initiated the European theater of the war by invading Saxony and turned the tide of the war due to the 'Miracle of the House of Brandenburg'.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯沙皇，是腓特烈大帝的狂热崇拜者。他在1762年即位后，立即与普鲁士议和并结盟，归还了俄国占领的土地，造成了“勃兰登堡王室的奇迹”。后被其妻叶卡捷琳娜二世发动政变废黜。
description.en: Tsar of Russia and an ardent admirer of Frederick the Great. Upon his accession in 1762, he immediately made peace with Prussia, returned occupied territories, and allied with it, creating the 'Miracle of the House of Brandenburg'. He was later deposed in a coup by his wife, Catherine the Great.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯女皇，彼得三世的前任。她领导俄国加入法奥同盟对抗普鲁士。她的去世是导致俄国政策戏剧性转变的关键事件。
description.en: Empress of Russia, predecessor to Peter III. She led Russia to join the Franco-Austrian alliance against Prussia. Her death was a key event that led to a dramatic shift in Russian policy.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯女皇，通过政变废黜其丈夫彼得三世后登基。她虽然扭转了丈夫的亲普鲁士政策，但最终还是选择让俄国退出七年战争。
description.en: Empress of Russia who ascended to the throne after deposing her husband, Peter III, in a coup. Although she reversed his pro-Prussian policy, she ultimately chose to withdraw Russia from the Seven Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争前夕欧洲主要国家之间同盟关系的重组。传统对手法国和奥地利结盟，而普鲁士则与英国结盟，这一系列变化最终促成了战争的爆发。
description.en: The realignment of alliances among the major European powers on the eve of the Seven Years' War. Traditional rivals France and Austria became allies, while Prussia allied with Great Britain. This shift ultimately catalyzed the outbreak of the war.

description.zh-cn: 在1756年外交革命中形成的军事同盟，主要成员包括大不列颠王国和普鲁士王国，旨在对抗法奥同盟。
description.en: A military alliance formed during the Diplomatic Revolution of 1756, its main members included the Kingdom of Great Britain and the Kingdom of Prussia, aimed at countering the Franco-Austrian Alliance.

en: Miracle of the House of Brandenburg

description.zh-cn: 指1762年俄国女皇伊丽莎白去世，亲普鲁士的彼得三世即位后，俄国从普鲁士的敌人转为盟友的戏剧性事件，它挽救了濒临崩溃的普鲁士。
description.en: Refers to the dramatic event in 1762 when Russian Empress Elizabeth died and the pro-Prussian Peter III ascended the throne, turning Russia from an enemy of Prussia into an ally. This event saved Prussia from the brink of collapse.

description.zh-cn: 结束七年战争中普鲁士、奥地利和萨克森之间冲突的和平条约。奥地利正式承认普鲁士对西里西亚的统治权。
description.en: The peace treaty that ended the conflict between Prussia, Austria, and Saxony in the Seven Years' War. Austria formally recognized Prussian sovereignty over Silesia.

description.zh-cn: 位于中欧的富庶地区，其归属权是普鲁士与奥地利之间冲突的核心。奥地利在七年战争中的主要目标就是收复该地区。
description.en: A wealthy region in Central Europe, the ownership of which was the core of the conflict between Prussia and Austria. Austria's main goal in the Seven Years' War was to recover this territory.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争的前奏，普鲁士国王腓特烈二世在这场战争中从奥地利手中夺取了西里西亚，埋下了两国再次冲突的种子。
description.en: A precursor to the Seven Years' War, in which King Frederick II of Prussia seized Silesia from Austria, sowing the seeds for future conflict between the two powers.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军战斗英雄，在执行潜伏任务时，为不暴露目标，被联合国军燃烧弹点燃后纹丝不动，直至牺牲。
description.en: A combat hero of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army who, during an ambush mission, was set on fire by a UN Command incendiary bomb but remained motionless to avoid revealing his position, burning to death.

description.zh-cn: 多伦多市的立法机构。
description.en: The legislative body of the City of Toronto.

description.zh-cn: 加拿大安大略省南部的一个大型都会区，以多伦多市为中心。
description.en: A large metropolitan area in Southern Ontario, Canada, centered on the City of Toronto.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕次子，曾在中国远洋公司任职。
description.en: Second son of Su Yu, formerly worked at China Ocean Shipping Company (COSCO).

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁早期工作的企业，他曾在此担任厂长。
description.en: The factory where Zheng Shanjie worked in his early career, where he served as its director.

en: Fujian Provincial Development and Reform Commission
zh-cn: 福建省发展和改革委员会

description.zh-cn: 福建省政府负责宏观经济调控的部门。
description.en: The department of the Fujian provincial government responsible for macroeconomic regulation and control.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，郑栅洁的前任福建省发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, Zheng Shanjie's predecessor as Director of the Fujian Provincial Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，郑栅洁的继任中共宁波市委书记。
description.en: A Chinese politician, Zheng Shanjie's successor as the Secretary of the Ningbo Municipal CPC Committee.

location.en: At the foot of the Five Elder Peaks of Mount Lu

description.zh-cn: 位于庐山五老峰下的古代教育机构，中国四大书院之首，由南宋理学家朱熹重建后成为理学研究和传播的中心。
description.en: An ancient educational institution located at the foot of Mount Lu's Five Elder Peaks, ranked first among the Four Great Academies of ancient China. It became a center for Neo-Confucian study and dissemination after being rebuilt by the Southern Song scholar Zhu Xi.

description.zh-cn: 英国传教士兼商人，于1895年租借庐山牯岭土地，将其开发为西方人的避暑地，对牯岭的现代化建设影响深远。
description.en: A British missionary and businessman who leased land in Guling, Mount Lu, in 1895 and developed it into a summer resort for Westerners, profoundly influencing Guling's modern development.

description.zh-cn: 位于庐山山顶的镇，海拔约1167米，以其西式别墅建筑群和凉爽的气候闻名，是庐山的核心景区和生活区。
description.en: A town located on the summit of Mount Lu at an elevation of about 1167 meters, known for its Western-style villa architecture and cool climate. It is the core scenic and residential area of Lushan.

description.zh-cn: 指1959年、1961年和1970年由毛泽东在庐山主持的三次中国共产党中央委员会重要会议，对中国现代政治史产生了重大影响。
description.en: Refers to three important meetings of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China held on Mount Lu in 1959, 1961, and 1970, presided over by Mao Zedong, which had a significant impact on modern Chinese political history.

description.zh-cn: 1980年上映的中国电影，全片在庐山取景。该片极大地提升了庐山的知名度，并促进了其旅游业的迅速发展。
description.en: A Chinese film released in 1980, shot entirely on location at Mount Lu. The film greatly enhanced the fame of Lushan and spurred the rapid development of its tourism industry.

description.zh-cn: 南朝时期著名道士，曾在庐山修道，对庐山道教的发展有重要贡献。
description.en: A famous Taoist of the Southern Dynasties period who practiced on Mount Lu and made significant contributions to the development of Taoism there.

description.zh-cn: 中国植物学家，于1934年共同创建了庐山植物园。
description.en: A Chinese botanist who co-founded the Lushan Botanical Garden in 1934.

description.zh-cn: 中国植物学家，于1934年共同创建了庐山植物园。
description.en: A Chinese botanist who co-founded the Lushan Botanical Garden in 1934.

description.zh-cn: 中国植物学家，于1934年共同创建了庐山植物园。
description.en: A Chinese botanist who co-founded the Lushan Botanical Garden in 1934.

zh-cn: 中国科学院庐山植物园

description.zh-cn: 中国第一座亚高山植物园，1934年由胡先骕、秦仁昌、陈封怀三位植物学家创建。
description.en: China's first subalpine botanical garden, founded in 1934 by botanists Hu Xiansu, Qin Renchang, and Chen Fenghuai.

description.zh-cn: 庐山著名岩洞景点，传为道教仙人吕洞宾修炼之所。毛泽东的诗句“天生一个仙人洞”使其名声大噪。
description.en: A famous cave attraction on Mount Lu, legendary as the cultivation site of the Taoist immortal Lü Dongbin. Its fame was greatly enhanced by Mao Zedong's poetic line 'Nature has superbly created an immortal's cave'.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾日治时期对台湾行使主权的职位，由日本天皇担任。
description.en: The position exercising sovereignty over Taiwan during the period of Japanese rule, held by the Emperor of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜半岛被大日本帝国统治的时期。
description.en: The period when the Korean Peninsula was under the rule of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记、佛山市市长。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, formerly served as the Party Secretary and Mayor of Foshan.

description.zh-cn: 明朝中期广东农民起义的领袖。
description.en: Leader of a peasant uprising in Guangdong during the mid-Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 佛山在明清时期的称谓，当时是中国四大名镇之一。
description.en: The name of Foshan during the Ming and Qing dynasties, when it was one of the four famous towns of China.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，溥仪的叔父，金韫颖的七叔。他也是张勋复辟的支持者之一。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, uncle of Puyi, and the seventh uncle of Jin Yunying. He was also one of the supporters of Zhang Xun's monarchical restoration.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院直属的具有统战性、荣誉性的文史研究机构。
description.en: A united front and honorary cultural and historical research institution directly under the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任陕西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，中国共产党党员，曾任第十三届全国人民代表大会解放军和武警部队代表。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, a member of the Communist Party of China, who served as a delegate of the People's Liberation Army and People's Armed Police Force to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国河北省秦皇岛市下辖的一个县。
description.en: A county under the administration of Qinhuangdao, Hebei, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕的妻子，以撒的母亲。
description.en: Wife of Abraham and mother of Isaac.

description.zh-cn: 撒拉的埃及使女，亚伯拉罕的妾，以实玛利的母亲。
description.en: Sarah's Egyptian handmaiden, a concubine of Abraham, and the mother of Ishmael.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕在撒拉去世后的续弦妻子。
description.en: Abraham's wife after the death of Sarah.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕与夏甲的儿子，被认为是阿拉伯人的祖先。
description.en: Son of Abraham and Hagar, considered the ancestor of the Arabs.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕与撒拉的儿子，犹太人的祖先。
description.en: Son of Abraham and Sarah, ancestor of the Jewish people.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕、拿鹤和哈兰的父亲。
description.en: Father of Abraham, Nahor, and Haran.

description.zh-cn: 哈兰的儿子，亚伯拉罕的侄子。
description.en: Son of Haran and nephew of Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 他拉的父亲，亚伯拉罕的祖父。
description.en: Father of Terah and grandfather of Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 他拉的儿子，亚伯拉罕的兄弟，罗得的父亲。
description.en: Son of Terah, brother of Abraham, and father of Lot.

description.zh-cn: 古代近东的一个地区，被上主应许给亚伯拉罕及其后裔。
description.en: A region in the ancient Near East, promised by God to Abraham and his descendants.

description.zh-cn: 古埃及君主的尊称。一位不知名的法老曾因撒拉而与亚伯拉罕产生交集。
description.en: The title of the ancient Egyptian monarchs. An unnamed pharaoh had an encounter with Abraham over Sarah.

description.zh-cn: 因罪恶滔天而被耶和华用硫磺与火毁灭的两个城市。
description.en: Two cities destroyed by Yahweh with sulfur and fire due to their great wickedness.

description.zh-cn: 领导四王联军击败迦南五王并掳走罗得的君主，后被亚伯拉罕击败。
description.en: A monarch who led a coalition of four kings to defeat five Canaanite kings and capture Lot, later defeated by Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 撒冷王，在亚伯拉罕击败基大老玛后为他祝福。
description.en: King of Salem, who blessed Abraham after his victory over Chedorlaomer.

description.zh-cn: 指以亚伯拉罕为共同先知的一神论宗教，主要包括犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教。
description.en: Refers to monotheistic religions that recognize Abraham as a common prophet, primarily including Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

description.zh-cn: 一个民族，传统上认为其始祖为亚伯拉罕的儿子以实玛利。
description.en: An ethnic group traditionally considered to have descended from Abraham's son, Ishmael.

description.zh-cn: 源于西南亚的族群，包括希伯来人和阿拉伯人，传统上均视亚伯拉罕为共同祖先。
description.en: Ethnic groups originating from Southwest Asia, including Hebrews and Arabs, who traditionally regard Abraham as their common ancestor.

description.zh-cn: 位于麦加的立方体建筑，是伊斯兰教最神圣的中心。根据伊斯兰传统，由亚伯拉罕和以实玛利共同修建。
description.en: A cubical building in Mecca, the most sacred center of Islam. According to Islamic tradition, it was built by Abraham and Ishmael.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教的重要节日，为纪念先知易卜拉欣（亚伯拉罕）忠实执行真主命令，愿意献祭自己的儿子，而后真主又用羊羔代替的事件。
description.en: An important Islamic holiday commemorating the willingness of the prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) to sacrifice his son in obedience to God's command, before God provided a lamb to sacrifice instead.

description.zh-cn: 巴哈伊信仰的创始人，声称是亚伯拉罕的后裔。
description.en: The founder of the Baháʼí Faith, who claimed to be a descendant of Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 五胡十六国时期后赵的第三位皇帝，据记载曾派人发掘秦始皇陵。
description.en: The third emperor of the Later Zhao state during the Sixteen Kingdoms period, who reportedly ordered the excavation of the Qin Mausoleum.

description.zh-cn: 考古学家，曾长期担任秦始皇陵考古队队长，对陵墓的修建时间提出了不同于传统史料的见解。
description.en: An archaeologist who served as the long-term head of the Qin Mausoleum archaeological team and proposed a construction timeline that differs from traditional historical accounts.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇陵的陪葬坑，出土了大量陶制兵马俑，是20世纪最重要的考古发现之一。
description.en: A collection of terracotta sculptures depicting the armies of Qin Shi Huang, buried with the emperor in his mausoleum. It is one of the most significant archaeological discoveries of the 20th century.

description.zh-cn: 中国考古学家，在明定陵发掘后，与郑振铎一同上书国务院，请求立即停止挖掘帝王陵墓。
description.en: A Chinese archaeologist who, along with Zheng Zhenduo, petitioned the State Council to immediately cease the excavation of imperial tombs following the excavation of the Dingling Mausoleum.

en: Major Historical and Cultural Site Protected at the National Level
zh-cn: 全国重点文物保护单位

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国对不可移动文物所核定的最高保护级别。
description.en: The highest level of protection designated for immovable cultural relics in the People's Republic of China.

description.en: Chinese diplomat, currently serving as the Director of the General Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.en: The local organization of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang in Anhui Province.

description.en: A general of the Fengtian clique in the Republic of China.

description.en: A general of the Fengtian clique in the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 由张作相于1929年创办的大学。
description.en: A university founded by Zhang Zuoxiang in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事人物，曾任吉林省政府主席。
description.en: A military figure of the Republic of China who served as the Chairman of the Jilin Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军事将领，张作相的亲戚。
description.en: A military general of the Republic of China and a relative of Zhang Zuoxiang.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍的谋士。在官渡之战中进谗言陷害张郃、高览，导致二人投降曹操。
description.en: An advisor to Yuan Shao. During the Battle of Guandu, his slander against Zhang He and Gao Lan caused them to defect to Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍的谋士兼监军。官渡之战中提出持久作战的建议未被采纳，战后被曹操俘虏并杀害。
description.en: An advisor and army supervisor under Yuan Shao. His suggestion of a protracted war strategy was ignored during the Battle of Guandu. He was captured and later killed by Cao Cao after the battle.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍的谋士。因在官渡之战前直言劝谏而被袁绍下狱，战败后被杀害。
description.en: An advisor to Yuan Shao. He was imprisoned by Yuan Shao for his blunt advice before the Battle of Guandu and was executed after Yuan's defeat.

description.zh-cn: 原为袁绍的谋士，官渡之战期间因家人被审配下狱而投奔曹操，并献计奇袭乌巢，成为曹操获胜的关键。
description.en: Originally an advisor to Yuan Shao, he defected to Cao Cao during the Battle of Guandu after his family was imprisoned by Shen Pei. He proposed the surprise attack on Wuchao, which was key to Cao Cao's victory.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍的谋士，负责统军事宜。
description.en: An advisor to Yuan Shao, responsible for military administration.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍的谋士。官渡之战后诋毁田丰，导致田丰被杀。
description.en: An advisor to Yuan Shao. After the Battle of Guandu, he slandered Tian Feng, leading to Tian Feng's execution.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍麾下大将。在延津之战中战死。
description.en: A prominent general under Yuan Shao. He was killed in action at the Battle of Yanjin.

description.zh-cn: 原为袁绍麾下大将，与张郃一同投降曹操。
description.en: Originally a general under Yuan Shao, he defected to Cao Cao along with Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍麾下大将。在乌巢之战中负责护送军粮，因曹操的奇袭而战败被杀。
description.en: A general under Yuan Shao. He was tasked with guarding the army's grain supply at Wuchao, but was defeated and killed during Cao Cao's surprise attack.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍长子。官渡之战后与弟袁尚争位，后被曹操所杀。
description.en: Eldest son of Yuan Shao. After the Battle of Guandu, he fought with his brother Yuan Shang for succession and was later killed by Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 曹操麾下大将。参与了乌巢之战的奇袭，并斩杀了淳于琼。
description.en: A prominent general under Cao Cao. He participated in the surprise attack on Wuchao and killed Chunyu Qiong.

en: Warlord contention at the end of the Eastern Han dynasty

description.zh-cn: 东汉末期，中央政权衰落，地方军阀崛起，相互征伐，形成割据局面。官渡之战是此期间的重要事件。
description.en: A period in the late Eastern Han dynasty characterized by the decline of the central government and the rise of regional warlords who fought amongst themselves for territory. The Battle of Guandu was a major event during this era.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战的前哨战，曹操军在此战中声东击西，关羽斩杀袁绍大将颜良，解白马之围。
description.en: A preliminary engagement of the Battle of Guandu, where Cao Cao's forces used a feint to lift the siege of Boma, during which Guan Yu slew Yuan Shao's general Yan Liang.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战中的一场战斗，曹操以少量骑兵击败袁绍追兵，并斩杀大将文丑。
description.en: A battle during the Guandu campaign where Cao Cao used a small cavalry force to defeat Yuan Shao's pursuing troops and killed his general Wen Chou.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战的转折点。曹操采纳许攸之计，率轻兵夜袭并焚毁袁军在乌巢的粮仓，导致袁军崩溃。
description.en: The turning point of the Battle of Guandu. Acting on Xu You's advice, Cao Cao led a small force on a night raid to burn Yuan Shao's supply depot at Wuchao, leading to the collapse of Yuan's army.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍三子。官渡之战后与兄袁谭争位，最终兵败，投奔辽东后被公孙康所杀。
description.en: The third son of Yuan Shao. After the Battle of Guandu, he fought with his brother Yuan Tan for succession, was ultimately defeated, and was killed by Gongsun Kang after fleeing to Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年辽东地区的统治者。为向曹操示好，杀害了前来投奔的袁尚。
description.en: The ruler of the Liaodong region during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He killed the fugitive Yuan Shang as a gesture of goodwill to Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期鲁国的乐官，孔子曾向他学习弹琴。
description.en: A music official in the State of Lu during the Spring and Autumn period, from whom Confucius learned to play the guqin.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期郯国国君，因其博学多才，孔子曾拜其为师。
description.en: The ruler of the State of Tan during the Spring and Autumn period. Due to his extensive knowledge, Confucius once regarded him as a teacher.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代儒家典籍，相传为孔子依据鲁国史料编修而成。
description.en: An ancient Chinese Confucian classic, said to have been compiled by Confucius based on the historical records of the State of Lu.

zh-cn: 南京大学-约翰斯·霍普金斯大学中美文化研究中心

description.zh-cn: 由南京大学和美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学共同创办的高等教育国际合作项目。
description.en: An international higher education cooperation program jointly established by Nanjing University and Johns Hopkins University.

description.en: One of the main research units of Project 523, which successfully used artemisinin to treat patients with malignant and cerebral malaria in clinical settings.

description.en: A judge and politician of the Chinese Communist Party and the People's Republic of China, who served as a state-level vice-leader, including President of the Supreme People's Court, Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, and Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.en: A historical county in Shanxi province, China, now part of Xiangfen County. Birthplace of Ren Jianxin.

en: Central Comprehensive Governance Commission for Public Security
zh-cn: 中央社会治安综合治理委员会

description.zh-cn: 曾负责协调和指导全国社会治安综合治理工作的中共中央议事协调机构。任建新曾任副主任、主任。
description.en: A former deliberation and coordination agency of the CPC Central Committee responsible for coordinating and guiding the comprehensive management of public security nationwide. Ren Jianxin served as its vice director and director.

description.zh-cn: 一个著名的京剧科班。
description.en: A famous Peking opera troupe and school.

description.zh-cn: 中国的法律专业出版社，隶属于最高人民法院。

description.en: The local organization of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, serving as the leading body for local and industrial trade unions throughout the region.
