description.zh-cn: 中国哈萨克族政治人物，伊力扎提·艾合买提江的后任新疆维吾尔自治区总工会主席。
description.en: A Chinese politician of Kazakh ethnicity, successor to Ilzat Exmetjan as the Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Federation of Trade Unions.

en: Member of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会委员名单
第十四届全国政协委员

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会的成员，根据页面分类信息，伊力扎提·艾合买提江是其中一员。
description.en: A member of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. According to page category information, Ilzat Exmetjan is a member.

zh-cn: 中国国家女子青年篮球队

description.zh-cn: 代表中国参加国际青年女子篮球比赛的国家队。
description.en: The national team that represents China in international youth women's basketball competitions.

description.zh-cn: 代表中国参加国际女子篮球比赛的国家队。
description.en: The national team that represents China in international women's basketball competitions.

description.zh-cn: 中国女子篮球运动员，与王芳在中国国家队是队友。
description.en: A Chinese female basketball player and a teammate of Wang Fang on the Chinese national team.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚篮球教练，曾任中国国家女子篮球队主教练。
description.en: An Australian basketball coach who formerly served as the head coach of the China women's national basketball team.

zh-cn: 辽宁沈阳三生飞豹篮球俱乐部

description.zh-cn: 一支中国男子篮球职业联赛（CBA）的职业篮球队，主场位于辽宁省。
description.en: A professional basketball team in the Chinese Basketball Association (CBA), based in Liaoning province.

zh-cn: 中国男子篮球职业联赛

description.zh-cn: 中国的顶级职业男子篮球联赛。
description.en: The top-tier professional men's basketball league in China.

description.zh-cn: 王芳的丈夫，原中国国家青年篮球队队员。
description.en: Husband of Wang Fang, former member of the Chinese National Youth Basketball Team.

description.zh-cn: 王芳的弟媳，蒋兴权之女，曾是辽宁女子篮球队运动员。
description.en: Sister-in-law of Wang Fang, daughter of Jiang Xingquan, and a former player for the Liaoning women's basketball team.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球教练，女儿蒋旭是王芳的弟媳。
description.en: A Chinese basketball coach, whose daughter Jiang Xu is Wang Fang's sister-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 王芳与张岩的儿子，效力于CBA辽宁男篮俱乐部。
description.en: Son of Wang Fang and Zhang Yan, plays for the Liaoning Flying Leopards in the CBA.

zh-cn: 新中国篮球运动杰出贡献奖

description.zh-cn: 为表彰中华人民共和国成立50年来为篮球运动作出杰出贡献的个人而设立的荣誉称号，获奖者共50人。
description.en: An honorary title established to recognize 50 individuals who made outstanding contributions to the sport of basketball in the first 50 years of the People's Republic of China.

en: Articles of Favorable Treatment of the Great Qing Emperor, After His Abdication

description.zh-cn: 中华民国临时政府在清帝逊位后，承诺并给予清皇室的优待条件。该条件于1924年被冯玉祥终结。
description.en: The favorable terms promised to the Qing imperial house by the Provisional Government of the Republic of China after the emperor's abdication. These terms were terminated by Feng Yuxiang in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于代善。中间曾被改为巽、康封号。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Daišan. The designation was temporarily changed to Xun and Kang.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，皇太极的二哥，第一代礼亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the second older brother of Hong Taiji, and the first Prince Li.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第二代礼亲王（时为巽亲王）。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the second Prince Li (then Prince Xun).

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第三代礼亲王（时为巽亲王），后被革爵。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the third Prince Li (then Prince Xun), later stripped of his title.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第四代礼亲王（时为康亲王）。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the fourth Prince Li (then Prince Kang).

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第五代礼亲王（时为康亲王）。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the fifth Prince Li (then Prince Kang).

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第六代礼亲王（时为康亲王）。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the sixth Prince Li (then Prince Kang).

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第七代礼亲王（时为康亲王）。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the seventh Prince Li (then Prince Kang).

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第八代礼亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the eighth Prince Li.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第九代礼亲王，后被革爵。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the ninth Prince Li, later stripped of his title.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第十代礼亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the tenth Prince Li.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第十一代礼亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the eleventh Prince Li.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第十二代礼亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the twelfth Prince Li.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，乾隆四十三年承袭睿亲王爵位。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan who inherited the title of Prince Rui in the 43rd year of the Qianlong era.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于多铎。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Dodo.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于豪格。中间曾被改为显字封号。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Hooge. The designation was temporarily changed to Xian.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于济尔哈朗。中间曾被改为简字封号。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Jirgalang. The designation was temporarily changed to Jian.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于硕塞（时为承泽亲王）。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Šose (as Prince Chengze).

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，皇太极的五子，第一代庄亲王（始封承泽亲王）。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the fifth son of Hong Taiji, and the first Prince Zhuang (initially as Prince Chengze).

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于奕䜣。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于奕𫍽。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Yixuan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝世袭罔替的王爵，俗称铁帽子王，始封于奕劻。
description.en: A hereditary princely peerage of the Qing dynasty, one of the 'iron-cap' princes, first bestowed upon Yikuang.

description.zh-cn: 清朝宗室，第二代庆亲王。
description.en: A member of the Qing imperial clan, the second Prince Qing.

zh-cn: 西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛人民武装部

description.zh-cn: 一个曾存在的县级人民武装部，受海南省军区与中共西南中沙工委双重领导，负责西沙、南沙、中沙群岛的军事守备任务，后被三沙警备区取代。
description.en: A former county-level People's Armed Forces Department under the dual leadership of the Hainan Provincial Military District and the CPC Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands Working Committee. It was responsible for the military defense of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands and was later replaced by the Sansha Garrison.

en: CPC Hainan Province Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands Working Committee
zh-cn: 中国共产党海南省西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛工作委员会

description.zh-cn: 三沙市是海南省下辖的地级市，管辖西沙群岛、中沙群岛、南沙群岛的岛礁及其海域。市内的中国共产党派出机构与办事处合署办公，负责当地党务管理。
description.en: Sansha City is a prefecture-level city under Hainan Province, administering the islands, reefs, and waters of the Xisha, Zhongsha, and Nansha Islands. Within the city, the dispatched agency of the Communist Party of China operates jointly with the administrative office, responsible for local party affairs management.

en: Hainan Province Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands Office
zh-cn: 海南省西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛办事处
广东省西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛办事处
西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛办事处

description.zh-cn: 曾是管辖西沙、南沙、中沙群岛及其周边海域的县级党政机关，负责行使主权与管辖权。最初为广东省人民政府的派出机构，后委托海南行政区领导。最终该机构被撤销，并在其基础上设立了三沙市。
description.en: It was a county-level party and government organ administering the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands and their surrounding waters, responsible for exercising sovereignty and jurisdiction. Initially a dispatched agency of the People's Government of Guangdong Province, it was later placed under the leadership of the Hainan Administrative Region. The agency was eventually abolished and Sansha City was established on its basis.

en: Sansha Garrison of the People's Liberation Army
zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海南省三沙警备区

description.zh-cn: 在西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛人民武装部的基础上组建的警备区。
description.en: A garrison established on the basis of the People's Armed Forces Department of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands.

description.zh-cn: 清朝末年官员，时任山西巡抚，在太原起义中被革命军所杀。
description.en: An official in the late Qing dynasty, serving as the governor of Shanxi, who was killed by revolutionary forces during the Taiyuan Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 绥远抗战期间，傅作义部对日伪军的一次重要胜利。
description.en: An important victory for Fu Zuoyi's troops against Japanese and collaborationist forces during the Suiyuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任中国共产党厦门市委员会书记。
description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as the Secretary of the CPC Xiamen Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，现任厦门市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: A Chinese politician, currently serving as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Xiamen Municipal People's Congress.

zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议厦门市委员会

description.zh-cn: 明朝将领。
description.en: A general of the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期小刀会领袖。
description.en: A leader of the Small Swords Society during the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期小刀会领袖。
description.en: A leader of the Small Swords Society during the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国女指挥家。
description.en: A Chinese female conductor.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗的妃嫔，宋哲宗的生母。
description.en: A consort of Emperor Shenzong and the biological mother of Emperor Zhezong.

description.zh-cn: 北宋政治家，在宋哲宗亲政后受重用，支持恢复新法。
description.en: A politician of the Northern Song Dynasty who was heavily relied upon by Emperor Zhezong after he assumed personal rule, and supported the revival of the New Policies.

description.zh-cn: 北宋文学家、政治家，苏轼之弟，旧党核心人物之一，在哲宗亲政后被贬谪至岭南。
description.en: A writer and politician of the Northern Song Dynasty, younger brother of Su Shi, and a key figure in the conservative faction who was exiled to Lingnan after Emperor Zhezong assumed personal rule.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗的第一位皇后，由宣仁太后所立，后在绍圣年间因巫蛊案被废。
description.en: The first empress of Emperor Zhezong, chosen by Empress Dowager Xuanren. She was later deposed during the Shaosheng era due to accusations of witchcraft.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗的第二位皇后，在孟皇后被废后受册立。
description.en: The second empress of Emperor Zhezong, who was instated after Empress Meng was deposed.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗之子，母为昭怀皇后刘氏，出生两月后夭折，追封为献愍太子。
description.en: Son of Emperor Zhezong and Empress Zhaohuai (Liu), who died two months after birth and was posthumously named Crown Prince Xianmin.

description.zh-cn: 北宋宰相，在宋神宗病危时建议立赵煦为太子。
description.en: A chancellor of the Northern Song Dynasty who suggested establishing Zhao Xu as the crown prince when Emperor Shenzong was critically ill.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗的陵墓，位于今河南巩义市。其石刻雕像具有很高的艺术价值，但在历史上曾遭刘齐政权和元朝的盗掘。
description.en: The mausoleum of Emperor Zhezong, located in modern-day Gongyi, Henan. Its stone sculptures are of high artistic value, but the tomb was historically looted by the Qi regime and during the Yuan Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中国南方五岭以南地区的概称，在宋代常作为官员贬谪之地。
description.en: A geographical area referring to the lands south of the Nanling Mountains in Southern China, often used as a place of exile for officials during the Song Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期楚国名将，项羽的祖父。
description.en: A famous general of the Chu state during the late Warring States period, and the grandfather of Xiang Yu.

description.zh-cn: 楚国地名，位于今江苏省宿迁市，是项羽的出生地。
description.en: A location in the state of Chu, located in modern-day Suqian, Jiangsu Province. It is the birthplace of Xiang Yu.

description.zh-cn: 秦朝的皇宫，位于首都咸阳。
description.en: The imperial palace of the Qin dynasty, located in the capital city of Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 由法兰西第四共和国创建的政治实体，用以取代旧的法兰西殖民帝国。越南国曾是其构成国。
description.en: A political entity created by the French Fourth Republic to replace the old French colonial empire. The State of Vietnam was one of its constituent states.

description.zh-cn: 由吴廷琰组织的公民投票，旨在决定南越的未来政体。投票结果导致保大帝被废黜，越南共和国成立。选举过程被广泛认为存在严重舞弊。
description.en: A referendum organized by Ngô Đình Diệm to determine the future political system of South Vietnam. The result led to the deposition of Bảo Đại and the establishment of the Republic of Vietnam. The election process is widely considered to have been fraudulent.

description.zh-cn: 在越南国正式成立前存在的过渡政府，由阮文春领导。
description.en: A transitional government that existed before the formal establishment of the State of Vietnam, led by Nguyễn Văn Xuân.

description.zh-cn: 越南国的国防力量，由保大帝根据《爱丽舍协定》建立，由阮文馨将军指挥。
description.en: The defense force of the State of Vietnam, established by Emperor Bảo Đại under the Élysée Accords and commanded by General Nguyễn Văn Hinh.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治人物，曾任越南临时中央政府总理。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician who served as the Prime Minister of the Provisional Central Government of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治人物，曾于1950年短暂担任越南国总理。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician who briefly served as the Prime Minister of the State of Vietnam in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治人物，于1950年至1952年担任越南国总理。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician who served as the Prime Minister of the State of Vietnam from 1950 to 1952.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治人物，于1952年至1953年担任越南国总理。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician who served as the Prime Minister of the State of Vietnam from 1952 to 1953.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治人物，于1954年短暂担任越南国总理。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician who briefly served as the Prime Minister of the State of Vietnam in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 越南政治人物，吴廷琰的弟弟和首席政治顾问。在1955年公民投票中积极支持其兄。
description.en: A Vietnamese politician, younger brother and chief political advisor to Ngô Đình Diệm. He actively supported his brother in the 1955 referendum.

description.zh-cn: 法国总统与保大帝签署的协定，允许越南国建立自己的军队，即越南国军。
description.en: An agreement signed by the President of France and Emperor Bảo Đại, which allowed the State of Vietnam to create its own army, the Vietnamese National Army.

description.zh-cn: 越南国军的第一任总指挥官。
description.en: The first commander-in-chief of the Vietnamese National Army.

description.zh-cn: 越南国的一种特殊行政区划，由保大帝直接管辖，主要包含少数民族地区。
description.en: A special administrative division within the State of Vietnam, directly administered by Emperor Bảo Đại, primarily consisting of ethnic minority areas.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜政治人物，曾任金日成综合大学校长，被认为是主体思想理论的主要构建者和体系化者。后叛逃至韩国。
description.en: A North Korean politician, former president of Kim Il-sung University, considered the main architect and systematizer of the Juche Idea theory. He later defected to South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 由金正日于1982年以个人名义出版的论文，被认为是主体思想核心理论的完成之作。
description.en: A treatise published by Kim Jong-il in his personal capacity in 1982, considered to have completed the core theory of the Juche Idea.

zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国社会主义宪法
朝鲜民主主义人民共和国宪法

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国的根本法。1972年修订的宪法将主体思想规定为国家活动的指导指针。
description.en: The fundamental law of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The 1972 revised constitution stipulated the Juche Idea as the guiding principle for state activities.

description.zh-cn: 韩国社会活动家，曾在20世纪80年代在韩国传播主体思想，但后来转变为该思想的批评者。
description.en: A South Korean social activist who disseminated the Juche Idea in South Korea during the 1980s but later became a critic of the ideology.

description.zh-cn: 前德国统一社会党总书记和东德领导人，与金日成私交甚密，后在东欧剧变中下台。
description.en: Former General Secretary of the Socialist Unity Party of Germany and leader of East Germany, who had a close personal relationship with Kim Il-sung and was ousted during the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 前罗马尼亚共产党中央委员会总书记和罗马尼亚领导人，与金日成私交甚密，后在东欧剧变中被处决。
description.en: Former General Secretary of the Romanian Communist Party and leader of Romania, who had a close personal relationship with Kim Il-sung and was executed during the Romanian Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜在第一个五年计划期间发起的一场社会主义建设运动，被朝鲜官方认为是主体思想的第一次实践运用。
description.en: A state-sponsored socialist construction movement during North Korea's first Five-Year Plan, officially considered the first practical application of the Juche Idea.

description.zh-cn: 1992年海协会与海基会在香港举行的事务性商谈，会中关于“一个中国”原则的讨论成为“九二共识”的历史基础。
description.en: Working-level talks held in Hong Kong in 1992 between ARATS and SEF. The discussions regarding the 'One China' principle became the historical basis for the '1992 Consensus'.

description.zh-cn: 一项政治论述，指海峡两岸双方均坚持“一个中国”的原则，但对“一个中国”的涵义认知不同，可以各自表述。此为中国国民党对“九二共识”的核心诠释，但未获中华人民共和国方面承认。
description.en: A political concept suggesting that both sides of the Taiwan Strait adhere to the 'One China' principle, but have different interpretations of its meaning, which they can state respectively. This is the Kuomintang's core interpretation of the '1992 Consensus', but it is not acknowledged by the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 由蔡英文于2011年提出的政治主张，旨在取代“九二共识”，作为与中国大陆进行谈判的新基础。
description.en: A political proposal put forward by Tsai Ing-wen in 2011, intended to replace the '1992 Consensus' as a new basis for negotiations with mainland China.

zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区工商业联合会
宁夏回族自治区工商联

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党领导的、宁夏回族自治区工商界组成的统战性、经济性、民间性的人民团体和商会组织。
description.en: A united front, economic, and non-governmental people's organization and chamber of commerce led by the Communist Party of China, composed of members from the industrial and commercial circles of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省的地方国家权力机关，是江苏省监察委员会的组织上级单位。
description.en: The local state power organ of Jiangsu Province, and the organizational superior of the Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江苏省监察委员会主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江苏省监察委员会副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江苏省监察委员会副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任江苏省监察委员会副主任。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Deputy Director of the Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的载人航天计划。
description.en: The manned spaceflight program of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替许达哲担任国家国防科技工业局局长等职务。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who succeeded Xu Dazhe as Director of the State Administration for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense and in other roles.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，接替许达哲担任中国航天科技集团公司董事长。
description.en: A Chinese political figure who succeeded Xu Dazhe as Chairman of the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中国航天领域人物，接替许达哲担任中国航天科工集团公司总经理。
description.en: A figure in China's aerospace sector who succeeded Xu Dazhe as General Manager of the China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府于1994年实施的一项财税体制改革，旨在调整中央与地方政府的税收分配，缓解中央财政困难，并推动财政体制从计划经济向市场经济转型。
description.en: A fiscal and taxation system reform implemented by the Chinese government in 1994, aimed at adjusting the tax distribution between central and local governments, alleviating the central government's financial difficulties, and promoting the transition of the fiscal system from a planned economy to a market economy.

description.zh-cn: 地方政府依赖出让土地使用权的收入来维持财政支出的模式。
description.en: A model where local governments rely on revenue from leasing land-use rights to sustain fiscal expenditures.

description.zh-cn: 国家中央级别的行政管理机关，此处特指分税制改革中与地方政府相对应的概念。
description.en: The central-level administrative organ of a state, specifically referring to the concept corresponding to local governments in the context of the tax-sharing system reform.

description.zh-cn: 中国经济学家，其与王绍光合著的《中国国家能力报告》对1994年分税制改革的实行起到了重要的推动作用。
description.en: A Chinese economist whose co-authored work with Wang Shaoguang, 'Report on China's State Capacity', played a significant role in promoting the implementation of the 1994 tax-sharing system reform.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治学者，其与胡鞍钢合著的《中国国家能力报告》对1994年分税制改革的实行起到了重要的推动作用。
description.en: A Chinese political scientist whose co-authored work with Hu Angang, 'Report on China's State Capacity', played a significant role in promoting the implementation of the 1994 tax-sharing system reform.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任财政部部长。在2000年左右与时任税务总局局长金人庆在政府收入占GDP比重问题上存在分歧。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Minister of Finance. Around the year 2000, he had a disagreement with then-Director of the State Administration of Taxation, Jin Renqing, over the issue of the ratio of government revenue to GDP.

description.zh-cn: 国家地方级别的行政管理机关，此处特指分税制改革中与中央政府相对应的概念。
description.en: The local-level administrative organs of a state, specifically referring to the concept corresponding to the central government in the context of the tax-sharing system reform.

zh-cn: 中国1998年城镇住房制度改革

description.zh-cn: 1998年在中国推行的城镇住房制度改革，旨在将住房分配从福利体系转向市场化体系。
description.en: The urban housing system reform promoted in China in 1998, aimed at shifting housing allocation from a welfare system to a market-based system.

description.zh-cn: 瓦良格人首领，留里克王朝的奠基人，建立了罗斯汗国。
description.en: A Varangian chieftain who founded the Rurik dynasty and established the Rus' Khaganate.

description.zh-cn: 留里克的继任者，于882年占领基辅并迁都于此，正式建立了基辅罗斯。
description.en: Successor to Rurik, he captured Kyiv in 882 and moved the capital there, formally establishing Kievan Rus'.

zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔一世·斯维亚托斯拉维奇

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯大公，在他的统治下，基辅罗斯迎来了黄金时期，并于988年接受基督教为国教。
description.en: Grand Prince of Kiev, under whose reign Kievan Rus' entered its golden age and adopted Christianity in 988.

zh-cn: 雅罗斯拉夫一世·弗拉基米罗维奇

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔大帝之子，基辅罗斯大公。他在位期间创立了东斯拉夫法典（罗斯法典），并维持了国家的统一。
description.en: Son of Vladimir the Great and Grand Prince of Kiev. During his reign, he established the first East Slavic law code (Russkaya Pravda) and maintained the unity of the state.

description.zh-cn: 由弗拉基米尔大帝于988年开启的，将东正教定为基辅罗斯国教的进程。
description.en: The process initiated by Vladimir the Great in 988 to establish Orthodox Christianity as the state religion of Kievan Rus'.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯在智者雅罗斯拉夫统治时期创立的法典。
description.en: The law code of Kievan Rus' established during the reign of Yaroslav the Wise.

description.zh-cn: 由瓦良格人留里克建立的，统治基辅罗斯及后续莫斯科公国的王朝。
description.en: A dynasty founded by the Varangian Rurik, which ruled Kievan Rus' and the subsequent Grand Duchy of Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 一个位于东欧的9世纪政体，是基辅罗斯的前身之一。
description.en: A 9th-century polity in Eastern Europe, considered a predecessor to Kievan Rus'.

description.zh-cn: 罗斯诸公与钦察人联军首次与蒙古侦察部队交战并被彻底击败的战役。
description.en: The battle where the allied forces of Rus' principalities and the Cumans first encountered and were decisively defeated by a Mongol reconnaissance force.

description.zh-cn: 一个突厥游牧民族，曾是基辅罗斯的敌人，但在迦勒迦河之战中与其结盟对抗蒙古。
description.en: A Turkic nomadic people, who were sometimes enemies of Kievan Rus' but allied with them against the Mongols at the Battle of the Kalka River.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国成吉思汗手下的大将之一，参与了对基辅罗斯的早期侦查。
description.en: One of Genghis Khan's leading generals in the Mongol Empire, who participated in the early reconnaissance of Kievan Rus'.

zh-cn: 雅罗斯拉夫二世·弗谢沃洛多维奇

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔大公，在基辅罗斯灭亡后被拔都立为傀儡，用以稳定罗斯诸公。
description.en: Grand Prince of Vladimir, who was made a puppet ruler by Batu Khan after the fall of Kievan Rus' to stabilize the remaining Rus' princes.

description.zh-cn: 诺夫哥罗德大公，在蒙古入侵时期，通过在涅瓦河之战和楚德湖战役中取得胜利，保卫了罗斯的西北边疆。
description.en: Grand Prince of Novgorod who defended the northwestern frontiers of Rus' during the Mongol invasion by winning the Battle of the Neva and the Battle on the Ice.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯时期的一个重要公国，在蒙古入侵后保持了事实上的独立。
description.en: A prominent principality during the Kievan Rus' period that maintained de facto independence after the Mongol invasion.

description.zh-cn: 由亚历山大·涅夫斯基领导的诺夫哥罗德军队击败瑞典军队的战役。
description.en: A battle where the Novgorodian army led by Alexander Nevsky defeated the Swedish army.

description.zh-cn: 由亚历山大·涅夫斯基领导的诺夫哥罗德军队击败条顿骑士团的战役。
description.en: A battle where the Novgorodian army led by Alexander Nevsky defeated the Teutonic Knights.

description.zh-cn: 波兰国王，曾以其女婿斯维亚托波尔克一世的名义入侵基辅罗斯。
description.en: King of Poland who invaded Kievan Rus' in the name of his son-in-law, Sviatopolk I.

zh-cn: 斯维亚托波尔克一世·弗拉基米罗维奇

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯王公，波列斯瓦夫大帝的女婿。
description.en: Prince of Kievan Rus', son-in-law of Bolesław I the Brave.

zh-cn: 亨利二世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝，曾与智者雅罗斯拉夫联合夹击波兰。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor who allied with Yaroslav the Wise to attack Poland from two sides.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯王公，于1169年攻陷基辅，并将首都迁至弗拉基米尔。
description.en: Prince of Kievan Rus' who sacked Kyiv in 1169 and moved the capital to Vladimir.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯城市，在安德烈·博戈柳布斯基统治时期曾短暂成为基辅罗斯的首都。
description.en: A city in Russia that briefly became the capital of Kievan Rus' during the reign of Andrey Bogolyubsky.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党创始人之一，早期中国工人运动领袖。
description.en: One of the founders of the Communist Party of China and an early leader of the Chinese workers' movement.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党创始人之一，与王尽美共同在山东地区开展早期革命活动。
description.en: One of the founders of the Communist Party of China, who co-organized early revolutionary activities in Shandong with Wang Jinmei.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美长子，曾任吉林省军区副司令员。
description.en: The eldest son of Wang Jinmei, who served as the deputy commander of the Jilin Provincial Military District.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美次子，曾任上海市交通工作委员会党委副书记。
description.en: The second son of Wang Jinmei, who served as the deputy party secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Transportation Work Committee.

description.zh-cn: 介绍王乃征加入中国共产党的两人之一。
description.en: One of the two individuals who introduced Wang Naizheng to the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 介绍王乃征加入中国共产党的两人之一。
description.en: One of the two individuals who introduced Wang Naizheng to the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美之孙，王乃征之子。
description.en: Grandson of Wang Jinmei and son of Wang Naizheng.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美之孙女，王乃征之女，儿科医师。
description.en: Granddaughter of Wang Jinmei and daughter of Wang Naizheng, a pediatrician.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美之孙/孙女，王乃恩之子/女。
description.en: Grandchild of Wang Jinmei and child of Wang Nai'en.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美之孙女，王乃恩之女，解放军第二军医大学长征医院教授。
description.en: Granddaughter of Wang Jinmei and daughter of Wang Nai'en, a professor at Changzheng Hospital, Second Military Medical University.

zh-cn: 山东省立第一师范学校

description.zh-cn: 位于济南的一所师范学校，王尽美曾在此就读。
description.en: A normal school in Jinan where Wang Jinmei studied.

zh-cn: 北京大学马克思学说研究会

description.zh-cn: 中国最早的马克思主义研究团体之一，王尽美是其外埠会员。
description.en: One of the earliest Marxist research groups in China, of which Wang Jinmei was a non-local member.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党早期地方组织之一，由王尽美和邓恩铭发起创建。
description.en: One of the early local organizations of the Communist Party of China, initiated and established by Wang Jinmei and Deng Enming.

zh-cn: 中共山东区执行委员会
中共山东地方执行委员会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在山东的地方领导机构，王尽美曾任书记。
description.en: The local leading body of the Communist Party of China in Shandong, where Wang Jinmei served as secretary.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第二次全国代表大会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第二次全国代表大会，王尽美出席了会议。
description.en: The Second National Congress of the Communist Party of China, which Wang Jinmei attended.

zh-cn: 中国国民党第一次全国代表大会

description.zh-cn: 标志第一次国共合作正式形成的重要会议，王尽美赴广州参加。
description.en: An important conference marking the formal establishment of the First United Front, which Wang Jinmei attended in Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 一种慢性传染病，王尽美因罹患此病而英年早逝。
description.en: A chronic infectious disease that led to the early death of Wang Jinmei.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国陕西省榆林市下辖县，是慕绥新的籍贯地。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Yulin City, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China. It is the ancestral home of Mu Suixin.

zh-cn: 辽宁省大连市中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 位于中国辽宁省大连市的司法审判机关，该法院一审判处慕绥新死刑缓期执行。
description.en: A judicial trial organ located in Dalian City, Liaoning Province, China. This court sentenced Mu Suixin to death with a reprieve in the first instance.

description.zh-cn: 一种刑事罪名，指国家工作人员利用职务上的便利，索取他人财物，或者非法收受他人财物，为他人谋取利益的行为。
description.en: A criminal offense where a state functionary takes advantage of their position to demand or illegally accept property from others in exchange for providing benefits.

description.zh-cn: 一种刑事罪名，指国家工作人员的财产或者支出明显超过合法收入，差额巨大，本人不能说明其来源是合法的行为。
description.en: A criminal offense where a state functionary's assets or expenditures significantly exceed their lawful income, and they cannot account for the source of the vast difference.

description.zh-cn: 一组以失控的细胞生长为特征的疾病，慕绥新因患此病去世。
description.en: A group of diseases characterized by uncontrolled cell growth. Mu Suixin died from this disease.

description.zh-cn: 原沈阳市副市长，因腐败问题被调查，其案件是慕马案的开端并牵涉出慕绥新。
description.en: Former deputy mayor of Shenyang, who was investigated for corruption. His case initiated the Mu-Ma case and implicated Mu Suixin.

description.zh-cn: 慕绥新长女慕洋的公公，因涉嫌转移慕绥新案赃款被通缉并抓获。
description.en: The father-in-law of Mu Suixin's eldest daughter, Mu Yang. He was wanted and arrested for allegedly transferring illicit funds from Mu Suixin's case.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国浙江省下辖的地级市，是李琦、罗桂芝夫妇被抓获的地点。
description.en: A prefecture-level city under the jurisdiction of Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China. It is the location where Li Qi and Luo Guizhi were captured.

description.zh-cn: 辽宁省历史上的一个县，慕绥新曾在此任职。
description.en: A historical county in Liaoning Province where Mu Suixin once held office.

description.zh-cn: 指可与常春藤盟校媲美的美国顶尖公立大学。
description.en: A term referring to top public universities in the United States capable of providing a collegiate experience comparable to that of the Ivy League.

description.zh-cn: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的五个学院之一。
description.en: One of the five colleges at the University of California, Santa Barbara.

description.zh-cn: 美籍华裔科学家，加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校校长。
description.en: A Chinese-American scientist, chancellor of the University of California, Santa Barbara.

description.zh-cn: 华裔美国数学家，麦克阿瑟天才奖得主。
description.en: A Chinese-American mathematician and MacArthur Fellow.

description.zh-cn: 华裔美国数学家。
description.en: A Chinese-American mathematician.

description.zh-cn: 日裔美国电子工程学家，2014年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。
description.en: A Japanese-American electronic engineer and Nobel laureate in Physics 2014.

description.zh-cn: 美国理论物理学家，2004年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。
description.en: An American theoretical physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics 2004.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家、化学家，2000年诺贝尔化学奖得主。
description.en: An American physicist, chemist, and Nobel laureate in Chemistry 2000.

description.zh-cn: 美国理论物理学家，1998年诺贝尔化学奖得主。
description.en: An American theoretical physicist and Nobel laureate in Chemistry 1998.

description.zh-cn: 物理学家，加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校诺贝尔奖得主。
description.en: Physicist, Nobel laureate at UC Santa Barbara.

description.zh-cn: 物理学家，加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校诺贝尔奖得主。
description.en: Physicist, Nobel laureate at UC Santa Barbara.

description.zh-cn: 挪威经济学家，2004年诺贝尔经济学奖得主。
description.en: A Norwegian economist and Nobel laureate in Economic Sciences 2004.

description.zh-cn: 德国物理学家，2000年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。
description.en: A German-American physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics 2000.

description.zh-cn: 美国物理学家，1972年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。
description.en: An American physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics 1972.

description.zh-cn: 美国分子生物学家，约翰霍普金斯大学教授，2009年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主。
description.en: An American molecular biologist, professor at Johns Hopkins University, and Nobel laureate in Physiology or Medicine 2009.

description.zh-cn: 美国水下考古学家，因发现泰坦尼克号沉船而闻名。
description.en: An American underwater archaeologist known for the discovery of the wreck of the Titanic.

description.zh-cn: 美国演员和制片人，奥斯卡最佳男主角奖得主。
description.en: An American actor and producer, winner of the Academy Award for Best Actor.

description.zh-cn: 美国演员，奥斯卡最佳女主角奖得主。
description.en: An American actress, winner of the Academy Award for Best Actress.

description.zh-cn: 美国国家航空航天局宇航员，首位进行太空漫步的华裔宇航员。
description.en: A NASA astronaut, the first Chinese-American to perform a spacewalk.

description.zh-cn: 中国化学家，复旦大学教授，中国科学院院士。
description.en: A Chinese chemist, professor at Fudan University, and academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 物理学家，斯坦福大学副教授。
description.en: A physicist and associate professor at Stanford University.

en: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
zh-cn: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校

description.zh-cn: 位于美国北卡罗来纳州教堂山的公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国新罕布什尔州汉诺威的私立常春藤盟校研究型大学。
description.en: A private Ivy League research university in Hanover, New Hampshire, United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国天体物理学家，加州大学伯克利分校天文学教授。
description.en: An American astrophysicist and professor of astronomy at the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 日本大型跨国综合性电子技术企业集团。
description.en: A major Japanese multinational electronics corporation.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典跨国家居用品零售企业。
description.en: A Swedish multinational conglomerate that designs and sells ready-to-assemble furniture, kitchen appliances and home accessories.

zh-cn: 圣巴巴拉 (加利福尼亚州)

description.zh-cn: 金正日的第一任妻子。
description.en: Kim Jong-il's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 金正日的继任妻子，1974年与其结婚。
description.en: Kim Jong-il's successive wife, married in 1974.

description.zh-cn: 金正日的继任妻子，曾担任其技术书记。
description.en: Kim Jong-il's successive wife, formerly his technical secretary.

description.zh-cn: 由日本首相小泉纯一郎和朝鲜国防委员会委员长金正日签署的宣言，旨在实现两国关系正常化。
description.en: A declaration signed by Japanese Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi and North Korean National Defence Commission Chairman Kim Jong-il, aiming to normalize relations between the two countries.

en: North Korean abductions of Japanese citizens
zh-cn: 北朝鲜绑架日本人问题

description.zh-cn: 指朝鲜于1970年代末至1980年代初，多次在日本以及欧洲绑架日本人的事件。
description.en: A series of events in the late 1970s and early 1980s where North Korea abducted Japanese citizens from Japan and Europe.

description.zh-cn: 位于黄海京畿湾的韩国岛屿，2010年遭到朝鲜炮击。
description.en: A South Korean island group in the Gyeonggi Bay of the Yellow Sea, shelled by North Korea in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜官方宣布金正日于2011年12月17日因心肌梗死去世的事件。
description.en: The event of North Korea's official announcement that Kim Jong-il died of a heart attack on December 17, 2011.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省推行的一项旨在简化行政审批流程、提高政府服务效率的改革。
description.en: A reform promoted by Zhejiang Province aimed at simplifying administrative approval processes and improving the efficiency of government services.

description.zh-cn: 美国的一家电动汽车及清洁能源公司。
description.en: An American electric vehicle and clean energy company.

description.zh-cn: 中国浙江省温州市下辖的一个县级市。
description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Wenzhou, Zhejiang Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任中央军委国防动员部办公厅主任。
description.en: A major general in the People's Liberation Army, former Director of the General Office of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军少将，曾任中央军委国防动员部办公厅主任及国家国防动员委员会综合办公室副主任。

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军广州市军事管制委员会

description.zh-cn: 1949年中国人民解放军进驻广州后成立的临时权力机构，负责接管旧政权。
description.en: A temporary authority established after the Chinese People's Liberation Army entered Guangzhou in 1949, responsible for taking over the old regime.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国大陆时期广州市的地方政权机关。
description.en: The local government authority of Guangzhou during the period of the Republic of China on the mainland.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立初期的一级行政区。
description.en: A first-level administrative division in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 广州市人民政府主要机关驻地建筑。
description.en: The main office building of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government.

zh-cn: 中国共产党第十九届中央委员会候补委员列表
中国共产党第十九届中央委员会候补委员
第十九届中央委员会候补委员

description.zh-cn: 代表中国共产党第十九届中央委员会的候补委员群体。
description.en: Represents the group of alternate members of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

zh-cn: 中国舰船研究设计中心

description.zh-cn: 又称701研究所或武汉船舶设计研究所，主要从事舰船研究设计。
description.en: Also known as the 701 Research Institute or Wuhan Ship Design Institute, primarily engaged in ship research and design.

description.zh-cn: 中国舰船设计工程师，吴晓光的前任，曾任中国舰船研究设计中心所长。
description.en: A Chinese ship design engineer and the predecessor of Wu Xiaoguang, who served as the director of the China Ship Research & Design Center.

zh-cn: 中国船舶重工集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 曾为中国特大型国有企业，于2019年与中国船舶工业集团有限公司合并组建中国船舶集团。
description.en: Formerly a large state-owned enterprise in China, it merged with China State Shipbuilding Industry Corporation in 2019 to form China State Shipbuilding Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 清朝靖南王，三藩之一，后响应吴三桂起兵反清。
清朝平南王尚可喜长子，后发动兵变囚父，参与三藩之乱。
清朝平南王，三藩之一，三藩之乱初期忠于清廷。
清朝陕甘提督，吴三桂义子，在三藩之乱中起兵响应。
蒙古察哈尔部亲王，趁三藩之乱起兵反清。
清朝将领，在平定三藩之乱中担任抚远大将军，平定察哈尔和陕西叛乱。
清朝驻广西将军，三藩之乱中响应吴三桂，后被吴将刺杀。
清朝陕西经略，被发动兵变的王辅臣杀害。
清朝福建总督，被耿精忠囚禁，后在耿精忠降清前被杀害。
吴三桂从孙，吴周将领。
蒙古部落之一，其首领布尔尼在三藩之乱时起兵反清。
荀子的弟子，最能传承其学问与学说。
description.en: A disciple of Xunzi, considered the one who best inherited his teachings and theories.

description.zh-cn: 荀子认为的儒学正宗传人。
description.en: Considered by Xunzi to be the orthodox successor of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 西汉末年宫廷史官，曾整理荀子著作，编撰成《孙卿书》。
description.en: A court historian of the late Western Han Dynasty who compiled Xunzi's writings into the book 'Sun Qing Shu'.

description.zh-cn: 唐代学者，于818年校勘与注解《孙卿书》，并重新命名为《荀子》。
description.en: A Tang dynasty scholar who, in 818, collated and annotated the 'Sun Qing Shu' and renamed it 'Xunzi'.

description.zh-cn: 战国时期齐国设立的学术机构，荀子曾在此研习并三度担任祭酒。
description.en: An academic institution established by the State of Qi during the Warring States period, where Xunzi studied and served as libationer three times.

description.zh-cn: 楚国的一个县，荀子曾在此担任县令并终老。
description.en: A county in the State of Chu where Xunzi served as magistrate and spent his final years.

en: Theory that human nature is evil

description.zh-cn: 荀子提出的核心哲学思想，认为人性本恶，善是后天人为教化的结果。此观点与孟子的性善论相对立。
description.en: The core philosophical idea proposed by Xunzi, which holds that human nature is inherently evil and that goodness is the result of acquired education and effort. This view stands in opposition to Mencius's theory of inherent goodness.

en: Theory that human nature is good

description.zh-cn: 孟子提出的核心哲学思想，认为人性本善。此观点与荀子的性恶论相对立。
description.en: The core philosophical idea proposed by Mencius, which holds that human nature is inherently good. This view stands in opposition to Xunzi's theory of evil nature.

description.zh-cn: 荀子著作的合集。最初由西汉刘向整理编定为《孙卿书》，唐代杨倞作注后改名为《荀子》。
description.en: A collection of Xunzi's writings. It was first compiled by Liu Xiang of the Western Han into the 'Sun Qing Shu' and later renamed 'Xunzi' by Yang Liang of the Tang Dynasty, who also added commentaries.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治意识形态和自由主义的分支，倡导公民自由和政治自由，并以有限政府和自由市场为代表。
description.en: A political ideology and a branch of liberalism that advocates civil liberties under the rule of law with an emphasis on economic freedom.

description.zh-cn: 经济学中的一个基本概念，描述市场中商品或服务的可用性（供给）与对其的渴望（需求）之间的关系。
description.en: A fundamental concept in economics that describes the relationship between the availability of a commodity or service (supply) and the desire for it (demand).

description.zh-cn: 一个经济学思想流派，主张市场通过供求关系达到均衡，是现代西方经济学中主张自由市场的主要学派之一。
description.en: A school of economic thought that argues markets reach equilibrium through supply and demand, and is one of the main schools advocating for free markets in modern Western economics.

description.zh-cn: 英国经济学家，新古典经济学派的创始人之一，对供求关系理论有重要贡献。
description.en: An English economist, one of the founders of neoclassical economics, who made significant contributions to the theory of supply and demand.

description.zh-cn: 19世纪70年代经济学思想的一场重要变革，引入了边际效用理论。
description.en: An important paradigm shift in economic thought in the 1870s that introduced the theory of marginal utility.

description.zh-cn: 指市场无法有效率地分配商品和劳务的情况。
description.en: A situation in which the allocation of goods and services by a free market is not efficient.

description.zh-cn: 一种经济学理论，提倡最大限度地限制政府在经济事务中的干预。
description.en: An economic theory that advocates for minimal governmental intervention in economic affairs.

description.zh-cn: 政府向个人或法人征收的强制性财政贡献。
description.en: A compulsory financial charge or some other type of levy imposed upon a taxpayer by a governmental organization.

description.zh-cn: 一种政治哲学，主张废除国家，由自由市场提供所有服务，包括法律和国防。
description.en: A political philosophy that advocates the elimination of the state in favor of individual sovereignty in a free market.

description.zh-cn: 指美国总统罗纳德·里根在1980年代推行的保守主义政治经济政策，其特点是广泛减税、减少政府开支、放松管制等。
description.en: Refers to the conservative political and economic policies promoted by U.S. President Ronald Reagan during the 1980s, characterized by widespread tax cuts, reduced government spending, and deregulation.

description.zh-cn: 一个允许买卖双方进行商品、服务和信息交换的系统、制度、程序、社会关系或基础设施。
description.en: A system, institution, procedure, social relation or infrastructure whereby parties engage in exchange of goods, services, and information.

description.zh-cn: 指19世纪和20世纪欧洲大陆的一系列哲学传统。
description.en: Refers to a set of 19th- and 20th-century philosophical traditions from mainland Europe.

description.zh-cn: 哲学的分支，研究存在、同一性、时空、因果关系等基本概念。
description.en: The branch of philosophy that examines the fundamental nature of reality, including the relationship between mind and matter, between substance and attribute, and between potentiality and actuality.

description.zh-cn: 指生产者或供应商之间旨在限制竞争、控制价格的正式协议。
description.en: A formal agreement among competing firms to control prices or limit competition.

description.zh-cn: 指大量资产和资本由于经济或政治原因从一个国家流出。
description.en: Occurs when assets or money rapidly flow out of a country, due to an event of economic or political consequence.

description.zh-cn: 一种结合了私有制和公有制，既包含市场经济又包含计划经济特征的经济体系。
description.en: An economic system blending elements of market economies with elements of planned economies, free markets with state interventionism, or private enterprise with public enterprise.

description.zh-cn: 一种市场结构，其中许多公司销售相似但不完全相同的产品。
description.en: A type of imperfect competition such that many producers sell products that are differentiated from one another and hence are not perfect substitutes.

description.zh-cn: 一种对自由市场能够解决大多数经济和社会问题的强烈信念，常带有贬义。
description.en: A term, often used pejoratively, to describe a strong belief that free markets can solve most economic and social problems.

description.zh-cn: 指社会中个人或群体之间财富分配不均的现象。
description.en: The unequal distribution of assets among residents of a society.

description.zh-cn: 美国哲学家、心理学家和教育改革家，对自由放任主义的社会后果提出过批评。
description.en: An American philosopher, psychologist, and educational reformer who criticized the social consequences of laissez-faire.

description.zh-cn: 台湾台中市的市辖区，林隆璇的出生地。
description.en: A district of Taichung City, Taiwan, and the birthplace of Kevin Lin.

description.zh-cn: 台湾男歌手，林隆璇的儿子。
description.en: Taiwanese male singer, son of Kevin Lin.

description.zh-cn: 台湾的一家音乐制作及唱片公司。
description.en: A Taiwanese music production and record company.

description.zh-cn: 亚洲一家大型娱乐集团。
description.en: A major entertainment group in Asia.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台南市永康区的私立科技大学。
description.en: A private university of technology in Yongkang District, Tainan, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国内政部所属机关，负责兵役及替代役等相关事务。
description.en: An agency of the Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of China, responsible for military conscription and alternative service affairs.

description.zh-cn: 位于台湾台北市中正区的艺文表演场所。
description.en: An arts and performance venue in Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan.

en: 11th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
zh-cn: 中国共产党第十一次全国代表大会

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年军阀，曾任庐江太守。与曹操有旧交，后在孙策的打击下转而归降曹操，任平虏将军。因其日渐骄慢，数次犯法，并有诽谤和图谋不轨的行为，最终被李申成检举而伏法。其原配妻子为王宋。
description.en: A warlord in the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as the Grand Administrator of Lujiang. He was an old acquaintance of Cao Cao. After being defeated by Sun Ce, he surrendered to Cao Cao and was appointed General Who Pacifies Caitiffs. Due to his growing arrogance, repeated violations of the law, slander, and plotting treason, he was eventually reported by Li Shencheng and executed.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的郡级行政区划，位于今山东省东南部。
description.en: An ancient commandery-level administrative division in China, located in the southeastern part of modern-day Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的郡级行政区划。
description.en: An ancient commandery-level administrative division in China.

description.zh-cn: 刘勋的原配妻子，因无子而被刘勋休弃。
description.en: Liu Xun's first wife, who was divorced by him for not bearing a son.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年官员，曾任庐江太守，后被孙策攻打。
description.en: An official in the late Eastern Han dynasty who served as the Grand Administrator of Lujiang and was later attacked by Sun Ce.

description.zh-cn: 袁术的从弟。袁术败亡后，率其部曲投奔刘勋。
description.en: Yuan Shu's younger cousin. After Yuan Shu's defeat and death, he led his troops to seek refuge with Liu Xun.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代的郡级行政区划。
description.en: An ancient commandery-level administrative division in China.

description.zh-cn: 袁术帐下长史。
description.en: Chief Clerk under the warlord Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 袁术帐下大将军。
description.en: Grand General under the warlord Yuan Shu.

en: Sun Ce's conquest of Lujiang against Liu Xun

description.zh-cn: 建安四年（199年），孙策设计并成功袭击刘勋，夺取庐江郡的战役。
description.en: In 199 AD (the 4th year of Jian'an), it was a battle in which Sun Ce devised a plan and successfully ambushed Liu Xun, seizing control of Lujiang Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 三国时期曹魏的战略家和政治家。在投奔曹操前，曾短暂在刘勋帐下。
description.en: A strategist and politician of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period. He briefly served under Liu Xun before joining Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 刘勋的侄子。
description.en: Liu Xun's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 新竹市的地方自治行政机关。
description.en: The local self-governing administrative body of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 清代竹堑文人、进士，于1827年呈请兴建新城获准。
description.en: A scholar and Jinshi from Zhucian during the Qing Dynasty, who successfully petitioned for the construction of a new city wall in 1827.

description.zh-cn: 清代淡水抚民同知，负责擘划与监造淡水厅城。
description.en: The Tamsui Subprefectural Magistrate during the Qing Dynasty, responsible for planning and supervising the construction of the Tamsui Ting city wall.

description.zh-cn: 清代淡水厅的城池，位于今日台湾新竹市中心。
description.en: The city wall of Tamsui Ting during the Qing Dynasty, located in the center of modern-day Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物，在林智坚辞职后曾代理新竹市市长。
description.en: A Taiwanese politician who served as acting mayor of Hsinchu City after Lin Chih-chien's resignation.

zh-cn: 查理六世 (神圣罗马帝国)

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马皇帝，哈布斯堡王朝的最后一位男性统治者。由于没有男性继承人，其长女玛丽亚·特蕾西娅的继位引发了奥地利王位继承战争。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor and the last male ruler of the House of Habsburg. Lacking a male heir, the succession of his eldest daughter, Maria Theresa, sparked the War of the Austrian Succession.

description.zh-cn: 哈布斯堡-洛林王朝的末代皇储及后来的家族首领。他于1961年宣布放弃对奥地利帝位的要求，并曾作为德国代表担任欧洲议会议员。
description.en: The last Crown Prince of the Habsburg-Lorraine dynasty and later head of the family. He renounced his claim to the Austrian throne in 1961 and later served as a Member of the European Parliament for Germany.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年的一支农民起义军队。
description.en: A peasant rebel army during the late Eastern Han Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年黄巾军将领。
description.en: A general of the Yellow Turban Army during the late Eastern Han Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 刘表从子，以骁勇著称。
description.en: A nephew of Liu Biao, known for his valor.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈之子，官至越骑校尉。
description.en: Son of Taishi Ci, who served as a Yueqi Xiaowei (Colonel of Yueqi Cavalry).

description.zh-cn: 东汉时期东莱郡下辖县，今山东省龙口市。
description.en: A county under Donglai Commandery during the Eastern Han dynasty, located in modern-day Longkou, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代县名，位于今江西省。
description.en: An ancient county in China, located in modern Jiangxi province.

zh-cn: 上海国际集团有限公司

description.zh-cn: 上海市属国有独资企业，是上海浦东发展银行的最大股东。
description.en: A state-owned sole proprietorship under the Shanghai municipal government, and the largest shareholder of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 原上海浦东发展银行成都分行行长，因违规发放贷款案被处以终身禁入银行业的处罚。
description.en: Former head of the Chengdu branch of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank, who was banned from the banking industry for life due to a case of illicit lending.

description.zh-cn: 原上海浦东发展银行成都九眼桥支行行长，因违规发放贷款案被处以终身禁入银行业的处罚。
description.en: Former head of the Chengdu Jiuyanqiao sub-branch of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank, who was banned from the banking industry for life due to a case of illicit lending.

description.zh-cn: 2019年3月在中国四川省凉山州木里县发生的森林火灾，造成包括多名消防员在内的严重伤亡。浦发银行曾因不当使用此次事件进行广告宣传而引发争议。
description.en: A forest fire that occurred in Muli County, Liangshan Prefecture, Sichuan Province, China in March 2019, resulting in serious casualties including multiple firefighters. SPD Bank was involved in a controversy for inappropriately using this event in an advertisement.

description.zh-cn: 上海浦东发展银行的全资子公司。
description.en: A wholly-owned subsidiary of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank.

en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Shanghai Municipal Government
zh-cn: 上海市国有资产监督管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 上海市人民政府的特设机构，作为市级国有资产的出资人代表。其通过上海国际集团有限公司控股上海浦东发展银行。
description.en: A special commission of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government, representing the municipal government as an investor in state-owned assets. It controls Shanghai Pudong Development Bank through Shanghai International Group Co., Ltd.

zh-cn: 中国证券金融股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 上海浦东发展银行的股东之一。
description.en: One of the shareholders of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 明朝负责传递朝廷公文的机构。
description.en: An institution in the Ming dynasty responsible for transmitting official documents.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第十二届大选。在此次选举中，由阿都拉·阿末·巴达威领导的国民阵线首次失去三分之二的国会绝对多数议席，导致他面临党内压力并提早卸任。
description.en: The 12th Malaysian general election. In this election, the Barisan Nasional coalition led by Abdullah Ahmad Badawi lost its two-thirds supermajority in parliament for the first time, leading to internal party pressure and his early resignation.

description.zh-cn: 在此次选举中，由阿都拉·阿末·巴达威领导的国民阵线取得了压倒性胜利，赢得了90%的国会议席。
description.en: In this election, the Barisan Nasional coalition led by Abdullah Ahmad Badawi won a landslide victory, securing 90% of the parliamentary seats.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚政治人物，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的女婿。
description.en: A Malaysian politician and the son-in-law of Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威与恩顿·玛末的女儿，凯里·嘉马鲁丁的妻子。
description.en: The daughter of Abdullah Ahmad Badawi and Endon Mahmood, and the wife of Khairy Jamaluddin.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的第一任妻子。
description.en: The first wife of Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 1987年的马来民族统一机构党内选举。阿都拉·阿末·巴达威在此次选举中参与了挑战时任主席马哈迪的B队，虽成功保住副主席职位，但其部长职位随后被撤除。
description.en: The 1987 United Malays National Organisation party election. Abdullah Ahmad Badawi participated in 'Team B' which challenged the incumbent president Mahathir. Although he successfully defended his vice-president post, his ministerial position was subsequently revoked.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第十二任最高元首。阿都拉·阿末·巴达威在其任期内担任首相。
description.en: The 12th Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia. Abdullah Ahmad Badawi served as Prime Minister during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚第十三任最高元首。阿都拉·阿末·巴达威在其任期内担任首相，并由他授予“敦”头衔。
description.en: The 13th Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia. Abdullah Ahmad Badawi served as Prime Minister during his reign and was conferred the title of 'Tun' by him.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚伊斯兰党主席，曾评价阿都拉·阿末·巴达威为“弱势首相”。
description.en: President of the Malaysian Islamic Party (PAS), who once described Abdullah Ahmad Badawi as a 'weak Prime Minister'.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚干净及公正选举联盟。该组织在2007年成功号召万人大集会，导致时任首相阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的支持率跌至历史新低。
description.en: The Coalition for Clean and Fair Elections in Malaysia. The organization successfully mobilized a mass rally in 2007, which led to a record-low approval rating for then-Prime Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚兴都权益行动委员会。该组织在2007年成功号召万人大集会，导致时任首相阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的支持率跌至历史新低。
description.en: The Hindu Rights Action Force in Malaysia. The organization successfully mobilized a mass rally in 2007, which led to a record-low approval rating for then-Prime Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 位于上海的大学，是交通大学的前身之一，陆定一于此毕业。

description.zh-cn: 陆定一的第一任妻子，革命烈士，在闽西游击战中牺牲。
description.en: Lu Dingyi's first wife, a revolutionary martyr who was killed during the guerrilla war in Western Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一的第二任妻子，曾长期向叶群等人写匿名信，引发政治风波。
description.en: Lu Dingyi's second wife, who wrote anonymous letters to Ye Qun and others over a long period, causing a political scandal.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一与严慰冰的长子，曾任中国防卫科技学院副院长。
description.en: The eldest son of Lu Dingyi and Yan Weibing, former vice president of China Institute of Defense Technology.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一与严慰冰的次子。

description.zh-cn: 陆定一与严慰冰的女儿。

description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China, who served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the CCP, Vice Governor of the Hubei Provincial People's Government, and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 河北省下辖的县级市，为王瑞生的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city under the jurisdiction of Hebei Province, and the birthplace of Wang Ruisheng.

description.en: A Russian politician and former Vice President of Russia who opposed Yeltsin during the 1993 constitutional crisis.

description.en: Wife of Boris Yeltsin and former First Lady of Russia.

description.en: A Russian higher education institution in Yekaterinburg, the alma mater of Boris Yeltsin.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在齐齐哈尔地区设置的军事及行政官职。
description.en: A military and administrative official post established in the Qiqihar area during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在呼伦贝尔地区设置的军事及行政官职。
description.en: A military and administrative official post established in the Hulunbuir area during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期掌管一省民政、财政等事务的高级官员。
description.en: A high-ranking official in charge of civil and financial affairs of a province during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝时期黑龙江省的最高行政长官。
description.en: The highest administrative official of Heilongjiang Province during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国初期黑龙江省的民政事务长官。
description.en: The head of civil affairs of Heilongjiang Province during the early Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初政治人物。
description.en: A political figure in the late Qing dynasty and the early Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期政治及军事人物。
description.en: A political and military figure during the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 东汉末年益州牧刘焉之子，穆皇后的第一任丈夫。
description.en: Son of Liu Yan, Governor of Yi Province, during the late Eastern Han dynasty. He was the first husband of Empress Mu.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉将领，穆皇后之兄。
description.en: A general of Shu Han and the older brother of Empress Mu.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代地名，位于今河南省开封市附近。
description.en: An ancient Chinese commandery located near modern-day Kaifeng, Henan.

description.zh-cn: 汉朝时设立的刺史部，大致范围在今天的四川盆地。
description.en: A province established during the Han Dynasty, roughly corresponding to the modern Sichuan Basin.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉官员，因怀疑其妻与后主刘禅有染而被处死。
description.en: An official of Shu Han who was executed after suspecting his wife of having an affair with the emperor Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 位于中国成都市，是纪念蜀汉丞相诸葛亮的祠堂，刘备的陵寝惠陵也位于此。
description.en: Located in Chengdu, China, it is a shrine dedicated to Zhuge Liang, the chancellor of Shu Han. The tomb of Liu Bei, Huiling, is also located here.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋的年号，亦指其统治时期。
description.en: The era name of Emperor Hongwu (Zhu Yuanzhang) of the Ming Dynasty, also referring to his reign.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期北平地区的省级行政机构。其官员李彧被怀疑与郭桓案有关。
description.en: The provincial administrative body for the Beiping region during the Ming Dynasty. Its official, Li Yu, was suspected of being involved in the Guo Huan Case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝北平承宣布政使司官员，在郭桓案中被怀疑与郭桓勾结舞弊而被处死。
description.en: An official of the Beiping Provincial Administration Commission during the Ming Dynasty, suspected of colluding with Guo Huan in the Guo Huan Case and subsequently executed.

description.zh-cn: 明朝时期负责一省司法、刑狱和官吏监察的机构。
description.en: An institution in the Ming Dynasty responsible for judicial, penal, and official surveillance matters within a province.

description.zh-cn: 明朝御史，与丁廷举一同告发郭桓贪污，引发郭桓案。后被朱元璋以“妄指平民”等罪名处死。
description.en: An imperial censor of the Ming Dynasty who, along with Ding Tingju, accused Guo Huan of corruption, triggering the Guo Huan Case. He was later executed by Zhu Yuanzhang on charges such as 'falsely accusing commoners'.

description.zh-cn: 明朝户部官员，郭桓案的同案犯，被指控贪污并被处死。
description.en: An official of the Ministry of Revenue during the Ming Dynasty, implicated as an accomplice in the Guo Huan Case, accused of corruption and executed.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的一个行政区划，郭桓被指控私吞其赋税。
description.en: An administrative division during the Ming Dynasty whose taxes Guo Huan was accused of embezzling.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的一个行政区划，郭桓被指控私吞其赋税。
description.en: An administrative division during the Ming Dynasty whose taxes Guo Huan was accused of embezzling.

description.zh-cn: 明朝礼部尚书，因郭桓案被牵连处死。
description.en: Minister of Rites of the Ming Dynasty, who was implicated and executed in the Guo Huan Case.

description.zh-cn: 明朝工部侍郎，因郭桓案被牵连处死。
description.en: Vice Minister of Works of the Ming Dynasty, who was implicated and executed in the Guo Huan Case.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋亲自编写的一系列法律文书和训诫，其中记录了对郭桓案的看法。
description.en: A series of legal documents and admonitions personally compiled by Zhu Yuanzhang, which recorded his views on the Guo Huan Case.

description.zh-cn: 中文数字的一种写法，通常用于凭证和票据上，以防止篡改。郭桓案后，为防范贪污，其在财务记录上的应用得到推广。
description.en: A form of Chinese numerals typically used on documents and bills to prevent alteration. After the Guo Huan Case, its use in financial records was promoted to prevent corruption.

description.zh-cn: 六部之一，主管全国刑罚、法律、审核。其尚书王惠迪在郭桓案中被杀。
description.en: One of the Six Ministries, responsible for national punishments, laws, and judicial review. Its Minister, Wang Huidi, was killed in the Guo Huan Case.

description.zh-cn: 爱新觉罗宗室，清末立宪派大臣、宗社党首领，积极推动清末军事改革。辛亥革命期间，因组织宗社党反对清帝逊位，被同盟会成员彭家珍刺杀身亡。
description.en: An Aisin-Gioro clan member, a constitutionalist minister and leader of the Royalist Party in the late Qing Dynasty, who actively promoted military reforms. During the Xinhai Revolution, he was assassinated by Peng Jiazhen, a member of the Tongmenghui, for organizing the Royalist Party to oppose the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 同盟会京津分会成员，辛亥革命期间以自杀式袭击刺杀了宗社党首领良弼。
description.en: A member of the Beijing-Tianjin branch of the Tongmenghui, who assassinated Liangbi, the leader of the Royalist Party, in a suicide attack during the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中国同盟会在北京和天津的分支机构，策划并执行了对良弼的刺杀行动。
description.en: The Beijing and Tianjin branch of the Tongmenghui, which planned and executed the assassination of Liangbi.

description.zh-cn: 清末为拱卫京师而建立的新式军队。
description.en: A modern-style army established in the late Qing dynasty to guard the capital.

description.zh-cn: 日本驻清朝公使，曾授予良弼三等旭日勋章。
description.en: Japanese Minister to the Qing dynasty who awarded Liangbi the Order of the Rising Sun, 3rd Class.

description.zh-cn: 1974年在葡萄牙发生的一场军事政变，导致了“新国家”法西斯政权的倒台和葡萄牙的民主化。
description.en: A military coup in Portugal in 1974 which led to the fall of the Estado Novo authoritarian regime and the restoration of democracy.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省监察委员会是中华人民共和国浙江省的国家监察机关，与中国共产党浙江省纪律检查委员会合署办公。该机构于2017年1月22日成立，作为国家监察体制改革的一部分，整合了此前相关机构的职能并撤销了其前身机构。

Established on January 22, 2017, as part of the national supervision system reform, it integrated the functions of previous related bodies and abolished its predecessors.
