description.zh-cn: 浙江省监察委员会委员。
description.en: Member of the Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，担任波士顿市长。
description.en: American politician, serving as the mayor of Boston.

description.zh-cn: 位于英格兰林肯郡的一个港口城镇，美国城市波士顿以此命名。
description.en: A port town in Lincolnshire, England, after which the city of Boston, USA, was named.

description.zh-cn: 位于波士顿的一所公立学校，是美国第一所公立学校。
description.en: A public school in Boston, and the first public school in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国革命前夕发生在波士顿的标志性事件，英军士兵向平民开火。
description.en: A pivotal event before the American Revolution where British soldiers fired on civilians in Boston.

description.zh-cn: 美国革命前夕发生在波士顿的政治抗议活动，殖民者将英国东印度公司的茶叶倒入港口。
description.en: A political protest in Boston before the American Revolution, where colonists dumped tea from the British East India Company into the harbor.

description.zh-cn: 在美国政治中具有重要影响力的爱尔兰裔美国家族，在波士顿政治中扮演重要角色。
description.en: An Irish-American family prominent in American politics, playing a significant role in Boston politics.

description.zh-cn: 一家总部位于波士顿的个人护理产品公司，现为宝洁公司所有。
description.en: A personal care products company headquartered in Boston, now owned by Procter & Gamble.

description.zh-cn: 一家美国跨国消费品公司。
description.en: An American multinational consumer goods corporation.

description.zh-cn: 一支位于波士顿的美国职业棒球大联盟球队。
description.en: An American professional baseball team based in Boston.

description.zh-cn: 法国的一座城市，是波士顿的友好城市之一。
description.en: A city in France, one of Boston's sister cities.

zh-cn: 腓特烈一世 (萨克森选侯)

description.zh-cn: 韦廷王朝的边伯侯爵及萨克森选帝侯，与弟弟威廉二世共同创建了莱比锡大学。
description.en: Margrave of Meissen and Elector of Saxony from the House of Wettin, who co-founded the University of Leipzig with his brother William II.

description.zh-cn: 位于布拉格的大学。1409年该校的分裂促使德国师生返回故乡，从而推动了莱比锡大学的建立。
description.en: A university in Prague. A division within the university in 1409 prompted German teachers and students to return to their homeland, leading to the establishment of the University of Leipzig.

zh-cn: 对立教宗亚历山大五世

description.zh-cn: 天主教会教宗，于1409年9月9日正式认可莱比锡大学的成立。
description.en: Pope of the Catholic Church who officially recognized the establishment of the University of Leipzig on September 9, 1409.

en: Office of Chinese Language Council International
zh-cn: 教育部中外语言交流合作中心
国家汉语国际推广领导小组办公室

description.zh-cn: 中国教育部下属机构，负责在全球范围内推广汉语和中国文化。该机构与莱比锡大学签署协议，合作建设莱比锡大学孔子学院。
description.en: An institution under the Ministry of Education of China, responsible for promoting the Chinese language and culture worldwide. It signed an agreement with the University of Leipzig to co-establish the Confucius Institute at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 德国心理学家，实验心理学的创始人。1879年，他在担任莱比锡大学哲学教授时建立了世界上第一个心理学实验室。
description.en: A German psychologist and the founder of experimental psychology. In 1879, while a professor of philosophy at the University of Leipzig, he established the world's first psychology laboratory.

description.zh-cn: 德国诗人、剧作家、小说家、思想家，曾于莱比锡大学学习法学和诗歌学。
description.en: A German poet, playwright, novelist, and thinker who studied law and poetics at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 德国哲学家、文化评论家、作曲家、诗人，曾于莱比锡大学学习古典语言学。
description.en: A German philosopher, cultural critic, composer, and poet who studied classical philology at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 德国物理学家，1932年诺贝尔物理学奖获得者，曾任莱比锡大学理论物理学教授。
description.en: A German physicist and Nobel laureate in Physics in 1932, who served as a professor of theoretical physics at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交家，曾任中国驻德意志联邦共和国大使。曾在莱比锡大学学习德语。
description.en: A Chinese diplomat who served as the Chinese Ambassador to the Federal Republic of Germany. He studied German at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 华裔数学家，代数几何领域代表人物之一，于1936年获得莱比锡大学数学博士学位。
description.en: A Chinese-American mathematician, a key figure in algebraic geometry, who received his PhD in mathematics from the University of Leipzig in 1936.

zh-cn: 斯凡特·奥古斯特·阿伦尼乌斯

description.zh-cn: 瑞典化学家，1903年诺贝尔化学奖获得者，曾在莱比锡大学担任威廉·奥斯特瓦尔德的助教。
description.en: A Swedish chemist and Nobel laureate in Chemistry in 1903, who served as an assistant to Wilhelm Ostwald at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 德国化学家，1909年诺贝尔化学奖获得者，曾任莱比锡大学物理化学教授。
description.en: A German chemist and Nobel laureate in Chemistry in 1909, who served as a professor of physical chemistry at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 指第二次世界大战末期确立的国际关系格局，以美苏两级对峙为特征。东欧剧变使其解体。
description.en: Refers to the international relations structure established at the end of World War II, characterized by the bipolar confrontation between the US and the USSR. It disintegrated with the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 波兰政治家，团结工会的创始人和领导人，后成为波兰首位民选总统。
description.en: Polish politician, founder and leader of the Solidarity trade union, who later became the first democratically elected president of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 1989年在罗马尼亚发生的暴力革命，推翻了齐奥塞斯库的独裁统治，并将其夫妇处决。
description.en: A violent revolution in Romania in 1989 that overthrew the dictatorial rule of Nicolae Ceaușescu and led to the execution of him and his wife.

description.zh-cn: 罗马尼亚社会主义共和国的执政党，在1989年革命后其政权正式消亡。
description.en: The ruling party of the Socialist Republic of Romania, whose regime officially ended after the 1989 revolution.

description.zh-cn: 指南也门与北也门统一为也门共和国的事件。受东欧剧变及苏联撤军影响，实行社会主义的南也门最终寻求统一。
description.en: The event of the unification of South Yemen and North Yemen into the Republic of Yemen. Influenced by the Revolutions of 1989 and the Soviet withdrawal, the socialist South Yemen eventually sought unification.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任西藏自治区革命委员会副主任，西藏自治区人民政府第一副主席。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as the vice-chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Revolutionary Committee and the first vice-chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region People's Government.

zh-cn: 西藏自治区革命委员会

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间西藏自治区的最高权力机构。
description.en: The highest organ of power in the Tibet Autonomous Region during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，汉族，中国共产党党员。曾任中共鞍山市委常委、秘书长、鞍山市副市长、鞍山市人大常委会主任，以及第十三届全国人民代表大会辽宁地区代表。
description.en: A Chinese politician, of Han ethnicity, and a member of the Communist Party of China. He has served as a member of the Standing Committee and Secretary-General of the CPC Anshan Municipal Committee, Deputy Mayor of Anshan, Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Anshan People's Congress, and a delegate for the Liaoning region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 由陈可辛执导，黎明主演的经典香港电影。黎明在片中饰演的黎小军一角深入人心，该片被视为其演艺事业的重要分水岭，使其演技获得广泛认可。
description.en: A classic Hong Kong film directed by Peter Chan and starring Leon Lai. His portrayal of the character Lai Siu-kwan was highly acclaimed, and the film is considered a major turning point in his acting career, earning him widespread recognition for his performance.

description.zh-cn: 一部恐怖片，由陈可辛监制，黎明主演。黎明凭此片获得了第39届金马奖最佳男主角。
description.en: A horror film produced by Peter Chan and starring Leon Lai. Lai won the Best Leading Actor award at the 39th Golden Horse Awards for his role in this film.

description.zh-cn: 黎明于1991年成立的官方歌迷会，是全球唯一获得他授权的歌迷组织。
description.en: The official fan club of Leon Lai, established in 1991. It is the only fan organization globally authorized by him.

description.zh-cn: 黎明于2014年开始执导的电影，他同时参与了剧本创作和演员选角等幕后工作。
description.en: A film directed by Leon Lai starting from 2014, for which he also participated in behind-the-scenes work such as screenwriting and casting.

description.zh-cn: 由都梁所著的长篇小说。
description.en: A novel written by Du Liang.

description.zh-cn: 小说《亮剑》中的主角，其人物原型之一是王近山。
description.en: The protagonist of the novel 'Drawing Sword', partially based on Wang Jinshan.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，铁瑛的继任浙江省政协主席。
description.en: Chinese politician, Tie Ying's successor as Chairman of the Zhejiang Provincial CPPCC.

zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队上海市总队

description.zh-cn: 曾是中华人民共和国上海市的公安部队。
description.en: Formerly the public security force of Shanghai, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国湖南省娄底市的地方国家行政机关。
description.en: The local state administrative organ of Loudi City, Hunan Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省曾存在的地区级行政单位，由涟源地区更名而来，后被地级娄底市取代。
description.en: A former prefecture-level administrative division in Hunan Province, renamed from Lianyuan Prefecture and later replaced by the prefecture-level Loudi City.

location.zh-cn: 福建省福州市福飞南路138号

description.zh-cn: 福建省生态环境厅，前身是成立于2009年8月的福建省环境保护厅，是福建省人民政府的组成部门，主管全省环境保护工作。2018年10月10日，福建省环境保护厅重组为福建省生态环境厅并沿用现名。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment, formerly the Fujian Provincial Department of Environmental Protection established in August 2009, is a component department of the Fujian Provincial People's Government, responsible for ecological and environmental protection across the province. On October 10, 2018, the Fujian Provincial Department of Environmental Protection was reorganized into the Fujian Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment and adopted its current name.

zh-cn: 福建省人民政府办公厅

description.zh-cn: 福建省人民政府的综合办事机构。
description.en: The general administrative office of the Fujian Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任福建省环境保护厅厅长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former Director of the Fujian Provincial Environmental Protection Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任福建省环境保护厅厅长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former Director of the Fujian Provincial Environmental Protection Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任福建省生态环境厅厅长。
description.en: Chinese political figure, former Director of the Fujian Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队第一机动总队的首任司令员，武警少将警衔。
description.en: The first commander of the People's Armed Police First Mobile Corps, holding the rank of Major General in the PAP.

zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队交通部队

description.zh-cn: 原武警部队的一个警种，2017年改革中被撤销，人员并入新组建的机动总队。
description.en: A former branch of the PAP, which was disbanded during the 2017 reform, with its personnel merged into the newly formed mobile corps.

en: People's Armed Police Second Mobile Corps
zh-cn: 中国人民武装警察部队第二机动总队

description.zh-cn: 与第一机动总队同期组建的武警机动力量。
description.en: A PAP mobile force established at the same time as the First Mobile Corps.

location.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省广州市
location.en: Guangzhou, Guangdong, People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 广东广播电视台是中华人民共和国广东省的省级广播电视大型综合传媒机构，实行企业化运作的正厅级事业单位。它由原南方广播影视传媒集团、广东人民广播电台（前身为广州市播音台）、广东电视台（成立于1959年，前身为广州电视台）、南方电视台、广东省广播电视技术中心整合组建而成，成立于2014年4月23日。
description.en: Guangdong Radio and Television is a provincial-level large-scale comprehensive media organization in Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. Operating as a department-level public institution with a corporate model, it was established on April 23, 2014. It was formed by the integration of several entities, including the former Southern Media Corporation, Guangdong People's Radio (formerly Guangzhou Broadcasting Station), Guangdong Television (established in 1959, formerly Guangzhou Television Station), Southern Television, and Guangdong Provincial Radio and Television Technology Center.

description.zh-cn: 由广东经济电视台和广东有线广播电视台重整而成的电视台，于2014年整合并入广东广播电视台。
description.en: A television station formed by the reorganization of Guangdong Economic Television and Guangdong Cable Radio and Television. It was integrated into Guangdong Radio and Television in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 全国首家商业电视媒体，后与广东有线广播电视台重整为南方电视台。
description.en: The first commercial television media in China, later reorganized with Guangdong Cable Radio and Television to form Southern Television.

description.zh-cn: 于1994年开播的有线电视台，后与广东经济电视台重整为南方电视台。
description.en: A cable television station launched in 1994, later reorganized with Guangdong Economic Television to form Southern Television.

description.zh-cn: 管辖广东广播电视台旗下经济科教频道和股市广播的媒体集团。
description.en: A media group that has jurisdiction over the Economy, Science & Education Channel and the Stock Market Radio of Guangdong Radio and Television.

zh-cn: 广东广播电视台经济科教频道

description.zh-cn: 广东广播电视台旗下的电视频道，前身为广东经济电视台，现由南方财经全媒体集团管辖。
description.en: A television channel under Guangdong Radio and Television, formerly Guangdong Economic Television, now under the jurisdiction of Southern Finance Omnimedia Corp.

description.zh-cn: 泛指香港地区的电视台。其节目竞争促使广东电视台在1988年进行改革。
description.en: A general term for television stations in Hong Kong. Competition from their programs prompted Guangdong Television to undergo reforms in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 广东电视台的前身，筹建时隶属于广东电台，1979年改称广东电视台。
description.en: The predecessor of Guangdong Television, it was subordinate to Guangdong Radio during its preparatory phase and was renamed Guangdong Television in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 国际篮球联合会在亚洲区的分支机构，负责管理亚洲区的篮球事务。
description.en: A zone of FIBA that manages basketball in Asia.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员和教练，曾担任中国国家男子篮球队主教练。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player and coach, who has served as the head coach of the China men's national basketball team.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员，中国男篮“三大中锋”之一，曾因与中国篮协的矛盾短暂离开国家队。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player, one of the 'Three Great Centers'. He briefly left the national team due to conflicts with the Chinese Basketball Association.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员和教练，是中国男篮“黄金一代”成员，后担任国家队主教练。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player and coach. He was a member of the 'Golden Generation' and later became the head coach of the national team.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员和教练，曾担任中国男篮蓝队及合并后国家队的主教练。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player and coach, who served as the head coach of the China national blue team and the unified national team.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员，在2019年世界杯对阵波兰的比赛中因关键失误而备受批评。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player who received widespread criticism for a crucial turnover in the 2019 World Cup match against Poland.

description.zh-cn: 在中国举办的国际篮球赛事，中国队在该赛事中表现不佳，未能直接获得奥运会资格。
description.en: An international basketball tournament held in China, where the Chinese team performed poorly and failed to directly qualify for the Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 国际篮球赛事，中国男篮在该赛事中表现不佳，错失2024年巴黎奥运会资格。
description.en: An international basketball tournament where the Chinese men's national team performed poorly, failing to qualify for the 2024 Paris Olympics.

en: South Korea men's national basketball team

description.zh-cn: 代表韩国参加国际篮球比赛的队伍，是中国男篮在亚洲的主要竞争对手之一。
description.en: The national basketball team representing South Korea, one of the main rivals of the Chinese team in Asia.

description.zh-cn: 代表伊朗参加国际篮球比赛的队伍，是中国男篮在亚洲的主要竞争对手之一。
description.en: The national basketball team representing Iran, one of the main rivals of the Chinese team in Asia.

en: Chinese Taipei men's national basketball team
zh-cn: 中华台北男子篮球代表队

description.zh-cn: 代表中华台北参加国际篮球比赛的队伍。
description.en: The national basketball team representing Chinese Taipei in international competitions.

description.zh-cn: 代表波兰参加国际篮球比赛的队伍。
description.en: The national basketball team representing Poland in international competitions.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员，在2019年世界杯后遭到中国中央电视台的点名批评。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player who was singled out for criticism by China Central Television after the 2019 World Cup.

description.zh-cn: 中国篮球运动员，在2019年世界杯后遭到中国中央电视台的点名批评。
description.en: A Chinese basketball player who was singled out for criticism by China Central Television after the 2019 World Cup.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中华人民共和国文化部副部长、中国艺术研究院院长。
description.en: A political figure in the People's Republic of China, who served as Vice Minister of Culture and President of the Chinese National Academy of Arts.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一长子，被追封为寿春王。
description.en: The eldest son of Zhu Chuyi, posthumously granted the title of Prince of Shouchun.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省的县级市，为朱初一的出生地。
description.en: A county-level city in Jiangsu Province, China, and the birthplace of Zhu Chuyi.

description.zh-cn: 中国江苏省的县，朱初一的迁居地，明祖陵所在地。
description.en: A county in Jiangsu Province, China, where Zhu Chuyi relocated and where the Ming Zuling Mausoleum is located.

description.zh-cn: 明朝皇帝朱元璋为其祖父、曾祖、高祖修建的陵墓。
description.en: The mausoleum built by the Ming emperor Zhu Yuanzhang for his grandfather, great-grandfather, and great-great-grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗即位之初，其父明光宗的李选侍占据乾清宫意图干政，被东林党大臣合力逼迫移出宫殿的政治事件。
description.en: A political incident at the beginning of the Tianqi Emperor's reign, where his father's consort, Li, occupied the Qianqing Palace to interfere in politics, but was forced to move out by Donglin Party officials.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，任辽东巡抚。与经略熊廷弼不和，轻敌冒进，导致广宁兵败，辽东尽失，后下狱论死。
description.en: A late Ming official who served as the Governor of Liaodong. His conflict with Military Commissioner Xiong Tingbi and his underestimation of the enemy led to the defeat at Guangning and the loss of Liaodong. He was subsequently imprisoned and sentenced to death.

description.zh-cn: 天启六年发生在北京王恭厂火药库的一场神秘大爆炸，造成严重伤亡。此事件对当时的政治局势产生了巨大冲击，明熹宗为此下罪己诏。
description.en: A mysterious and catastrophic explosion that occurred at the Wang Gongchang Armory in Beijing in 1626, causing massive casualties. The event had a significant political impact, prompting the Tianqi Emperor to issue an edict of self-blame.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗第三子，母皇贵妃任氏。在王恭厂大爆炸中受惊吓而死。
description.en: The third son of the Tianqi Emperor, his mother was Imperial Noble Consort Ren. He died from shock during the Wang Gongchang Explosion.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗的妃嫔，献怀太子朱慈炅的生母。
description.en: A consort of the Tianqi Emperor and the birth mother of Crown Prince Xianhuai, Zhu Cijiong.

description.zh-cn: 明末官员，天启朝尚书。曾向病重的明熹宗进献“灵露饮”，熹宗服用后病情加剧。
description.en: A late Ming official who served as a minister during the Tianqi era. He presented the 'Immortal Dew Drink' to the ailing emperor, whose condition worsened after consuming it.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与准噶尔汗国之间的一场战役。战前康熙帝患病，太子胤礽侍疾时表现冷漠，成为父子关系破裂的开端。
description.en: A battle between the Qing dynasty and the Dzungar Khanate. Before the battle, the Kangxi Emperor fell ill, and Crown Prince Yunreng's indifferent attitude while attending to him marked the beginning of the rift in their father-son relationship.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国戏剧家、政治人物，中共十二大、十三大代表。
description.en: A dramatist and political figure of the People's Republic of China, and a delegate to the 12th and 13th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 俞百巍之父。
description.en: Father of Yu Baiwei.

description.zh-cn: 黔剧剧目。
description.en: A Qian opera play.

description.zh-cn: 冯国璋的心腹。据称，他代表冯国璋假意同意张勋复辟，并用重金买走了各省督军签名的黄缎子。被视为“新十三太保”之一。
张勋的秘书长，张勋复辟的核心参与者，被任命为内阁阁丞，亦被视为“新十三太保”之一。
北洋官僚，袁世凯的表兄弟。积极参与张勋复辟，被任命为内阁议政大臣和度支部尚书，被时人称为“双料帝制犯”和“新十三太保”之一。
北洋将领。积极参与张勋复辟，被任命为陆军部尚书，被时人称为“双料帝制犯”和“新十三太保”之一。
清末官员，张勋复辟的骨干分子，被任命为内阁议政大臣，亦被视为“新十三太保”之一。
清末学者、官员，张勋复辟的骨干分子，被任命为法部尚书，亦被视为“新十三太保”之一。
张勋复辟期间成立的内阁政府，是复辟政权的执行机构。
中华民国大陆时期的一段时期，国家四分五裂，各地由大小军阀以武力控制。张勋复辟是该时期内的一起标志性事件。
清末民初外交家，张勋复辟的参与者，被任命为内阁议政大臣和外务部尚书。
清末官员，张勋复辟的参与者，被任命为内阁议政大臣。
民国时期军阀，在张勋复辟期间被任命为江西巡抚。
清末学者，张勋复辟的积极参与者，曾劝说黎元洪“奉还大政”，被视为“新十三太保”之一。
清末状元，张勋复辟的参与者，被视为“新十三太保”之一。
中华人民共和国政治人物，曾任中共江西省纪委副书记、江西省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: A politician of the People's Republic of China, who served as Deputy Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CCP and Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国江西省抚州市下辖的县。
description.en: A county under the jurisdiction of Fuzhou City, Jiangxi Province, People's Republic of China.

en: Jiangxi University of Science and Technology

description.zh-cn: 位于江西省赣州市的大学，前身为江西冶金学院。
description.en: A university located in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, formerly known as the Jiangxi Institute of Metallurgy.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫时期提出的一系列改革思想和政策，包括“公开化”和“民主化”。这些改革虽然旨在振兴苏联，但客观上放松了中央控制，激发了民族主义和分离主义情绪，成为苏联解体的催化剂。
description.en: A series of reformist ideas and policies proposed during the Gorbachev era, including 'Glasnost' and 'Democratization'. Although aimed at revitalizing the Soviet Union, these reforms objectively loosened central control, spurred nationalist and separatist sentiments, and acted as a catalyst for the dissolution of the USSR.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，曾任德克萨斯州州长，在1994年选举中被乔治·沃克·布什击败。
description.en: American politician who served as Governor of Texas and was defeated by George W. Bush in the 1994 election.

description.zh-cn: 美国政治人物，在乔治·沃克·布什担任德州州长期间任副州长，后接任州长。
description.en: American politician who served as Lieutenant Governor under George W. Bush in Texas and later succeeded him as governor.

description.zh-cn: 美国康涅狄格州的一座城市，是乔治·沃克·布什的出生地。
description.en: A city in Connecticut, USA, and the birthplace of George W. Bush.

zh-cn: 德克萨斯州空军国民警卫队

description.zh-cn: 美国德克萨斯州的空中民兵，是美国空军的预备役部队。
description.en: The air militia of the State of Texas, and a reserve component of the United States Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 美国第55届总统选举，乔治·沃克·布什成功连任。
description.en: The 55th U.S. presidential election, in which George W. Bush was successfully re-elected.

description.zh-cn: 美国第54届总统选举，乔治·沃克·布什当选总统。
description.en: The 54th U.S. presidential election, in which George W. Bush was elected president.

description.zh-cn: 美国共和党政治顾问，曾担任乔治·沃克·布什的总统顾问。
description.en: American Republican political consultant who served as a presidential advisor to George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 美国最高法院对2000年总统选举佛罗里达州计票争议的裁决，该裁决使乔治·沃克·布什当选总统。
description.en: The U.S. Supreme Court ruling on the Florida vote recount controversy in the 2000 presidential election, which resulted in George W. Bush becoming president.

description.zh-cn: 由乔治·沃克·布什政府推动的教育改革法案。
description.en: An education reform act promoted by the George W. Bush administration.

description.zh-cn: 一项旨在减缓全球变暖的国际协议，布什政府退出了该协议。
description.en: An international treaty aimed at curbing global warming, from which the Bush administration withdrew.

description.zh-cn: 巴勒斯坦民族权力机构主席，曾与乔治·沃克·布什会面。
description.en: President of the Palestinian National Authority who met with George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 伊拉克记者，曾在记者会上向乔治·沃克·布什扔鞋以示抗议。
description.en: An Iraqi journalist who threw his shoes at George W. Bush during a press conference in protest.

description.zh-cn: 美国前首席大法官，曾主持乔治·沃克·布什的连任就职典礼。
description.en: Former Chief Justice of the United States who administered the oath of office for George W. Bush's second inauguration.

description.zh-cn: 华国锋和韩芝俊的长子，已退休的中国人民解放军空军将军。
description.en: Eldest son of Hua Guofeng and Han Zhijun, a retired general of the PLA Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，曾任剑南道巡察大使，举荐了李义府。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official who served as the Inspecting Commissioner of Jiannan Circuit and recommended Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝中央政府三省之一，负责审议诏敕。
description.en: One of the Three Departments of the central government in the Tang dynasty, responsible for reviewing edicts and memorials.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，曾极力荐举李义府。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official who strongly recommended Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，曾极力荐举李义府。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official who strongly recommended Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，时任太子司议郎，与李义府文名齐名。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official who served as Remonstrator for the Crown Prince and was as famous for his literary talent as Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝大理丞，与李义府勾结释放女囚，事败后自杀。
description.en: An Assistant Minister of Justice in the Tang dynasty who colluded with Li Yifu to release a female prisoner. He committed suicide after the plot was exposed.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝御史，曾上书弹劾李义府，反被其仗势贬逐出京。
description.en: A Censor in the Tang dynasty who submitted a memorial to impeach Li Yifu but was instead exiled from the capital by Li's power.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝司刑太常伯（刑部尚书），负责审理李义府一案。
description.en: A Tang dynasty Minister of Justice (Sixing Taichangbo) who was responsible for trying Li Yifu's case.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝初年名将、宰相，时任司空，负责监审李义府一案。
description.en: A famous general and chancellor of the early Tang dynasty who served as Minister of Works and supervised the trial of Li Yifu's case.

description.zh-cn: 唐代州名，治所在今四川西昌。李义府被流放于此并在此去世。
description.en: A prefecture in the Tang dynasty, with its seat in modern-day Xichang, Sichuan. Li Yifu was exiled to and died in this place.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝宰相，与李义府同为支持武则天为后的官员，后一同被追赠官爵。
description.en: A chancellor of the Tang dynasty who, along with Li Yifu, supported Wu Zetian's ascension to empress and was later posthumously honored alongside him.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，与李义府同为支持武则天为后的官员，后一同被追赠官爵。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official who, along with Li Yifu, supported Wu Zetian's ascension to empress and was later posthumously honored alongside him.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，与李义府同为支持武则天为后的官员，后一同被追赠官爵。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official who, along with Li Yifu, supported Wu Zetian's ascension to empress and was later posthumously honored alongside him.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，李义府之子。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official, son of Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，李义府之子。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official, son of Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝官员，李义府之子。
description.en: A Tang dynasty official, son of Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝将领，李义府之子。
description.en: A Tang dynasty general, son of Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 武周时期官员，李义府之子。
description.en: An official during the Wu Zhou period, son of Li Yifu.

description.zh-cn: 中国政治人物，曾任第三机械工业部革委会主任、部长，后因牵连四人帮被免职。
description.en: Chinese politician, former Director of the Revolutionary Committee and Minister of the Third Ministry of Machine Building, later dismissed due to his involvement with the Gang of Four.

zh-cn: 中国人民解放军北京军区空军

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军空军在北京军区的领导指挥机关。
description.en: The leading command organ of the People's Liberation Army Air Force in the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 东周国王，周威烈王之父。
description.en: King of the Eastern Zhou dynasty, father of King Weilie of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 东周国王，周威烈王之子。
description.en: King of the Eastern Zhou dynasty, son of King Weilie of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 春秋末期晋国执政大臣。
description.en: A ruling minister of the State of Jin during the late Spring and Autumn period.

description.zh-cn: 由司马光主编的一部中国编年体史书，记事始于三家分晋。
description.en: A pioneering reference work in Chinese historiography, published in the form of a chronicle and edited by Sima Guang, which begins its account with the Partition of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 东周国王，周考王之父。
description.en: King of the Eastern Zhou dynasty, father of King Kao of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 东周国王，周贞定王之父。
description.en: King of the Eastern Zhou dynasty, father of King Zhending of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏曾就读的教会学校。
description.en: A missionary school that Fang Zhimin attended.

description.zh-cn: 由方志敏、黄道、邵式平等人领导的农民暴动。
description.en: A peasant uprising led by Fang Zhimin, Huang Dao, Shao Shiping, and others.

description.zh-cn: 由方志敏创建的革命根据地。
description.en: A revolutionary base area established by Fang Zhimin.

description.zh-cn: 中国瓷上肖像画创始人，在红十军攻占景德镇时被杀。
description.en: The founder of Chinese porcelain portrait painting, who was killed when the Red Tenth Army captured Jingdezhen.

description.zh-cn: 其左倾方针曾遭到方志敏的抵制。
description.en: His leftist policies were resisted by Fang Zhimin.

zh-cn: 中国工农红军第十军团

description.zh-cn: 由红七军团和红十军于1934年11月合编而成，方志敏任军政委员会主席。
description.en: Formed in November 1934 by the merger of the Red Seventh Army Corps and the Red Tenth Army, with Fang Zhimin as the chairman of its military and political committee.

description.zh-cn: 导致红十军团战败，方志敏等人被俘的关键战役。
description.en: A key battle that led to the defeat of the Red Tenth Army Corps and the capture of Fang Zhimin and others.

description.zh-cn: 红十军团军团长，因优柔寡断错失突围良机，后与方志敏一同被俘并被处决。
description.en: Commander of the Red Tenth Army Corps, whose indecisiveness led to missing opportunities to break out. He was later captured and executed along with Fang Zhimin.

description.zh-cn: 美国传教士，于1934年12月被红十军团第十九师处决。
description.en: An American missionary executed by the 19th Division of the Red Tenth Army Corps in December 1934.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏在狱中写下的遗稿之一。
description.en: One of the manuscripts written by Fang Zhimin in prison.

en: Guangdong Provincial Association for Science and Technology

location.zh-cn: 广州市越秀区连新路171号广东科学馆西楼
location.en: West Building, Guangdong Science Hall, No. 171 Lianxin Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国广东省科学技术工作者组成的专业性人民团体，是中国科学技术协会的地方组织，受中国共产党广东省委员会的领导。其前身为广东省科普协会和广东省科联。
description.en: A professional people's organization composed of science and technology workers in Guangdong Province, People's Republic of China. It is a local organization of the China Association for Science and Technology and is led by the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China. Its predecessors were the Guangdong Provincial Popular Science Association and the Guangdong Provincial Federation of Scientific Societies.

zh-cn: 李阳 (重庆市刑警总队前总队长)

description.zh-cn: 时任重庆市公安局刑警总队总队长，因在海伍德死亡案中徇私枉法而被判刑。
description.en: Then head of the Criminal Police Corps of the Chongqing Public Security Bureau, sentenced for bending the law for personal gain in the Neil Heywood murder case.

description.zh-cn: 时任重庆市公安局沙坪坝区分局常务副局长，因在海伍德死亡案中徇私枉法而被判刑。
description.en: Then Executive Deputy Director of the Shapingba District Branch of the Chongqing Public Security Bureau, sentenced for bending the law for personal gain in the Neil Heywood murder case.

description.zh-cn: 重庆市政府官员，曾与谷开来一同要求医院出具王立军的虚假精神疾病诊断证明。
description.en: A Chongqing government official who, along with Gu Kailai, requested a hospital to issue a fraudulent medical certificate of mental illness for Wang Lijun.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政治人物，第十三届全国人民代表大会湖北省代表。
description.en: A political figure of the People's Republic of China and a deputy from Hubei Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 北宋建筑师，曾任将作监少监，奉命编著了《营造法式》。
description.en: A Northern Song dynasty architect who served as the Vice Director of the Directorate for Palace Buildings and was ordered to compile the 'Yingzao Fashi'.

description.zh-cn: 中国古代掌管宫室、宗庙、城郭等土木建筑工程的机构，李诫曾在此任职。
description.en: An ancient Chinese government agency in charge of civil engineering and construction projects such as palaces, temples, and city walls, where Li Jie once served.

description.zh-cn: 宋代地方行政机构，治所在今苏州。其提举王唤曾重刊《营造法式》。
description.en: A local administrative body during the Song dynasty, with its seat in modern-day Suzhou. Its official Wang Huan republished the 'Yingzao Fashi'.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代著名藏书家、刻书家，于1925年刊印了精美的仿宋陶湘本《营造法式》。
description.en: A famous modern Chinese bibliophile and publisher who printed the exquisite facsimile Song edition of 'Yingzao Fashi' in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 中国近代古建筑学家，中国营造学社文献部主任，受朱启钤委托对《营造法式》进行校对，并参与校勘陶湘本。
description.en: A modern Chinese architectural historian and the director of the documentation department of the Society for the Study of Chinese Architecture. He was commissioned by Zhu Qiqian to collate the 'Yingzao Fashi' and participated in the proofreading of Tao Xiang's edition.

description.zh-cn: 清朝官方于乾隆十二年（1734年）颁布的建筑工程规范，其“斗口制”代替了《营造法式》中的“材份制”。
description.en: An architectural engineering standard promulgated by the Qing government in 1734. Its 'doukou' modular system replaced the 'cai-fen' system from the 'Yingzao Fashi'.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆女婿，中国保利集团公司党委副书记、董事。
description.en: Son-in-law of Yang Shangkun, Deputy Party Secretary and Director of China Poly Group Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间设立的全军性领导机构，叶群曾任成员、副组长。
description.en: A military-wide leading body established during the Cultural Revolution, where Ye Qun served as a member and deputy leader.

description.zh-cn: 中国作家、民间文艺学家，原籍江西铅山。
description.en: Chinese writer and folklorist, with ancestral roots in Qianshan, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 余未人的原籍。
description.en: Ancestral home of Yu Weiren.

zh-cn: 贵州省文学艺术界联合会

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党贵州省委员会领导下的，由贵州省文学艺术家协会、各市、州文学艺术界联合会和全省性的产业文学艺术工作者联合会组成的人民团体。
description.en: A people's organization under the leadership of the Guizhou Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, composed of the Guizhou Provincial Association of Literary and Art Workers, municipal and prefectural federations of literary and art circles, and province-wide industrial federations of literary and art workers.

description.zh-cn: 陶勇的出生地。
description.en: The birthplace of Tao Yong.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中国人民解放军渡江战役期间，英国皇家海军远东舰队紫石英号护卫舰与中国人民解放军发生的军事冲突。当时陶勇指挥了对英舰的炮击。
description.en: A military conflict between the British Royal Navy frigate HMS Amethyst and the Chinese People's Liberation Army during the PLA's Yangtze River Crossing Campaign in 1949. Tao Yong commanded the shelling of the British ship at the time.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军将领，陶勇接替他担任东海舰队司令员。
description.en: A naval commander of the PLA. Tao Yong succeeded him as the commander of the East Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海警备区司令员，在陶勇去世当天上午曾与其谈论营救陈丕显事宜。
description.en: Then commander of the Shanghai Garrison Command, who on the morning of Tao Yong's death discussed the rescue of Chen Pixian with him.

description.zh-cn: 美国亚利桑那州的一座城市。
description.en: A city in the state of Arizona, United States.

en: Embassy of the United States, Beijing

description.zh-cn: 美国在中国设立的外交代表机构。
description.en: The diplomatic mission of the United States in China.

zh-cn: 中国科学院近代物理研究所

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院下属的物理学研究机构。
description.en: A physics research institute under the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 中国物理学史家、思想家、社会活动家。
description.en: A Chinese historian of physics, thinker, and social activist.

zh-cn: 中国科学院北京天文台

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院国家天文台的前身之一。
description.en: A predecessor of the National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 位于美国亚利桑那州图森市的一所公立研究型大学。
description.en: A public research university in Tucson, Arizona, United States.

description.zh-cn: 方励之的长子。
description.en: Fang Lizhi's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 国民党元老，陈济棠的重要政治盟友和提携者，在陈济棠掌握广东军政大权过程中起到关键作用。
description.en: A veteran of the Kuomintang and a key political ally and patron of Chen Jitang, playing a crucial role in Chen's rise to military and political power in Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 陈济棠手下的空军司令。在两广事变中率领飞机投奔南京，对陈济棠的失败造成了重要影响。
description.en: Commander of Chen Jitang's air force. During the Liangguang Incident, he led his planes to defect to Nanjing, playing a significant role in Chen's defeat.

description.zh-cn: 清末民初在广东设立的军事学校，陈济棠于1912年考入该校步兵科学习。
description.en: A military school established in Guangdong during the late Qing and early Republican era. Chen Jitang enrolled in its infantry department in 1912.

description.zh-cn: 由陈济棠于战后在广州创办的教育机构，后迁至香港。
description.en: An educational institution founded by Chen Jitang in Guangzhou after the war, which later relocated to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 陈济棠的出生地，位于当时的广东省，现属广西壮族自治区防城港市。
description.en: Chen Jitang's birthplace, located in what was then Guangdong Province, now part of Fangchenggang City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 由陈济棠之子陈树柏于1994年在美国硅谷创办的大学。
description.en: A university founded in 1994 in Silicon Valley, USA, by Chen Shubai, the son of Chen Jitang.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国时期的广东省政府，陈济棠曾担任其主席。

由时任中共中央主席毛泽东发动和领导了无产阶级文化大革命。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution was initiated and led by then-CCP Chairman Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 《五一六通知》的发布被视为文化大革命全面发动的标志。
description.en: The issuance of the 'May 16 Notification' is considered the symbol of the full-scale launch of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 该文的发表被视为文革的导火索。
发表《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》一文，该文被认为是文革的导火索。
在七千人大会上（1962年），刘少奇对大跃进的批评引起毛泽东的不满，成为两人后续政治斗争的伏笔。此后，刘少奇与毛泽东在国家治理和阶级斗争等问题上分歧日益严重。在四清运动问题上（1965年），双方分歧加剧，毛泽东下决心在政治上打倒刘少奇。在文化大革命期间，刘少奇被毛泽东作为“党内头号走资派”和“资产阶级司令部”的主要代表进行批判和打倒，并最终被迫害致死。
在文化大革命中，刘少奇被错误地打成“叛徒、内奸、工贼”和“党内头号走资本主义道路的当权派”，其政治局常委排名下降，后被撤销一切职务并开除党籍，遭到残酷迫害，最终含冤去世。文革期间，数十万红卫兵曾包围中南海，试图抓出时任国家主席刘少奇。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Liu Shaoqi was wrongly branded as a 'traitor, renegade, and scab' and 'the top capitalist roader in the Party'. His ranking in the Politburo Standing Committee declined, he was subsequently stripped of all his posts, expelled from the Party, subjected to brutal persecution, and ultimately died with an unredressed grievance. During the Cultural Revolution, hundreds of thousands of Red Guards once surrounded Zhongnanhai, attempting to seize the then-State Chairman Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，邓小平作为“党内第二号走资派”被打倒，被撤销一切职务。他的“猫论”被列为罪状之一，并被下放至江西劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Deng Xiaoping was overthrown as the 'No. 2 capitalist roader in the Party' and stripped of all his posts. His 'cat theory' was listed as one of his 'crimes', and he was sent to Jiangxi for manual labor.

description.zh-cn: 协助毛泽东发动文革
文革结束后领导“拨乱反正”，并通过《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》全面否定文化大革命。
该决议公开全盘否定文革，称其为“给党、国家和各族人民带来严重灾难的内乱”，并在理论与实践上作出了全面否定。
description.en: The resolution openly and comprehensively negated the Cultural Revolution, describing it as 'internal turmoil that brought severe disaster to the Party, the state, and people of all ethnic groups,' and completely negated it in both theory and practice.

description.zh-cn: 怀仁堂政变（粉碎“四人帮”）标志着文化大革命的正式结束。
description.en: The Huairentang Coup (the smashing of the 'Gang of Four') marked the official end of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东逝世后，时任中共中央第一副主席华国锋作为主要领导者，与叶剑英、汪东兴等人共同决策并策划实施了逮捕“四人帮”的行动，即“粉碎四人帮”政变。
description.en: After Mao Zedong's death, Hua Guofeng, then the First Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Committee and a key leader, co-decided, planned, and implemented the operation to arrest the 'Gang of Four' with Ye Jianying, Wang Dongxing, and others. This event is known as the 'Smashing of the Gang of Four' coup.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东逝世后，叶剑英作为主要领导者之一，与华国锋、汪东兴等人达成一致，支持并参与决策，并联手策划实施了逮捕“四人帮”的行动，即史称的“粉碎四人帮”政变。
description.en: After Mao Zedong's death, Ye Jianying, as one of the main leaders, reached an agreement with Hua Guofeng, Wang Dongxing and others, supported and participated in the decision-making, and jointly planned and implemented the arrest of the 'Gang of Four,' an event often referred to as the 'smashing of the Gang of Four' coup.

description.zh-cn: 与华国锋、叶剑英等人发动政变“粉碎四人帮”，作为决策人之一，并以中央警卫部队（8341部队）领导身份，支持并执行了逮捕行动。
红卫兵是文化大革命时期的产物，作为该运动中的一个特殊群体而出现，其运动由文革催生。
description.en: The Red Guards were a product of the Cultural Revolution, emerging as a special group within the movement that was instigated by the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵是“破四旧”运动的主要执行者，在全国范围内破坏了大量文物古迹和传统文化象征。
description.en: The Red Guards were the main executors of the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement, destroying a large number of cultural relics, historical sites, and symbols of traditional culture nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 上海“一月风暴”的爆发，标志着夺权运动在全国范围内大规模展开。
description.en: The outbreak of the 'January Storm' in Shanghai marked the beginning of the nationwide expansion of the Seizure of Power movement.

description.zh-cn: 与姚文元赴上海支持王洪文夺权。
王洪文作为上海工人造反派领袖，领导“工总司”等造反派组织夺取了中共上海市委的权力。
江青提出“文攻武卫”口号，激化了武斗。
提出“文攻武卫”口号。
毛泽东发出指示“知识青年到农村去，接受贫下中农的再教育，很有必要”，开启了大规模的上山下乡运动。
description.en: Mao Zedong issued the directive 'It is highly necessary for educated youth to go to the countryside to be re-educated by the poor and lower-middle peasants,' initiating the large-scale Down to the Countryside Movement.

description.zh-cn: “批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动旨在批判并打倒邓小平，最终导致其第三次下台。
description.en: The 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' movement aimed to criticize and overthrow Deng Xiaoping, ultimately leading to his third downfall.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在中共十一届三中全会后成为实际最高领导人，开启并主导了改革开放政策，并被官方评价为“改革开放的总设计师”。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping is officially acclaimed as the 'Chief Architect of Reform and Opening-up'.

description.zh-cn: 提出并领导了“拨乱反正”，平反冤假错案。

江青是政治团体“四人帮”的核心成员，该集团也被称为“江青集团”。
description.en: Jiang Qing was a core member of the 'Gang of Four', and the group was also known as the 'Jiang Qing Clique'.

description.zh-cn: 林彪在文化大革命期间制造的第一起内部陷害案件。
事件后，华国锋在中共中央政治局紧急会议上被推举为中共中央主席、中央军委主席，成为最高领导人。

文化大革命期间，陈云受到迫害，家被红卫兵抄家，并被下放到江西的工厂劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Chen Yun was persecuted, his home was raided by Red Guards, and he was sent down to work in a factory in Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 该会议的召开标志着改革开放的正式开始。
在其第六次全体会议上一致通过了《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》。
description.en: Unanimously passed the 'Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China' at its Sixth Plenary Session.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命初期，倡导对毛泽东的个人崇拜，称“毛主席的话句句是真理”
指示江青等人策划发表该文

description.en: Mao Zedong met with Red Guards multiple times at Tiananmen, replying to support the rebellion movement of Tsinghua Affiliated High School Red Guards, and expressing support and encouragement for the Red Guard movement and 'Destroy the Four Olds', thereby promoting the Red Guard movement.

在党章中被确立为毛泽东的接班人

description.zh-cn: 在中共九大上，林彪被确立为毛泽东的“亲密战友和接班人”，其地位被写入党章，同时他也是毛泽东的副手。
在会上接替华国锋出任中共中央主席。
四人帮在文化大革命期间（1966-1976）是批斗邓小平的主要政治力量。邓小平在1975年复出后曾进行全面整顿，与四人帮发生激烈权力斗争，因“评《水浒》运动”等事件被打击。1976年，四人帮发动“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动，最终导致邓小平第三次下台。
description.en: The Gang of Four was the main political force criticizing Deng Xiaoping during the Cultural Revolution and launched the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversal Trend' campaign in 1976, leading to Deng's third downfall.

description.zh-cn: 群众运动中包含支持邓小平的声音。
中国共产党在第二次国共内战胜利后建立了中华人民共和国。
五四运动促进了马克思主义在中国的传播，为中国共产党的成立创造了条件。毛泽东曾指出，这场运动在思想和干部方面为1921年中国共产党的成立奠定了基础。
description.en: The May Fourth Movement promoted the spread of Marxism in China and created conditions for the establishment of the Communist Party of China. Mao Zedong once pointed out that this movement laid the foundation for the establishment of the Communist Party of China in 1921 in terms of ideology and cadres.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战以中国共产党取得决定性胜利而告终，直接导致了中华人民共和国的成立。
description.en: The decisive victory of the Communist Party of China in the Second Chinese Civil War directly led to the establishment of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 中央政治局主席; 中央委员会主席

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东是中国共产党的创始成员之一和长期领导人。
毛泽东在开国大典上宣告中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立。
中华人民共和国政府在建国初期发动了土地改革运动以巩固政权。
中华人民共和国派遣中国人民志愿军参加朝鲜战争。
中国共产党发动了大跃进运动，试图快速发展经济。
邓小平通过南方谈话（南巡讲话），重新推动了因六四事件而放缓的改革开放进程，再次强调其重要性，并促进了中国新一轮的经济发展。
在江泽民领导下，中华人民共和国于2001年加入世界贸易组织。
在胡锦涛和温家宝领导下，中华人民共和国在北京成功举办了2008年夏季奥运会。
习近平于2013年9月和10月出访中亚和东南亚时，首次提出了“一带一路”国际合作倡议，即共同建设“丝绸之路经济带”和“21世纪海上丝绸之路”的重大倡议。
在习近平主导下，中华人民共和国牵头成立了亚洲基础设施投资银行。
通过颁布《港版国安法》，中华人民共和国政府平息了香港的反对逃犯条例修订草案运动。
为应对新冠疫情，中华人民共和国政府实施了严格的清零政策。
“新十条”的发布标志着清零政策的正式结束。
习近平自2012年11月15日起担任中共中央总书记，在中共十八届一中全会上当选。
李强自2023年3月起担任中华人民共和国国务院总理。
在习近平担任浙江省委书记期间，李强曾任其秘书长。2022年中共二十大后，李强进入中央政治局常委会，被视为习近平的亲信。2023年3月11日起，李强担任国务院总理。根据党和国家领导人排名，中共中央总书记习近平的排名高于国务院总理李强。
description.en: Li Qiang served as Xi's chief of staff when Xi was the Party Secretary of Zhejiang. After the 20th CPC National Congress in 2022, Li Qiang entered the Politburo Standing Committee, where he is regarded as Xi's close associate. Since March 11, 2023, Li Qiang has served as Premier of the State Council. In terms of leadership hierarchy, General Secretary Xi Jinping ranks above Premier Li Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 自习近平于2012年11月15日担任中共中央总书记以来，赵乐际先后担任中组部部长、中纪委书记和全国人大委员长。根据党和国家领导人排名，中共中央总书记习近平的排名高于全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际。
根据党和国家领导人排名，中共中央总书记习近平的排名高于王沪宁（全国政协主席）。此层级关系自两人于2017年10月25日均成为中共中央政治局常委后持续存在，王沪宁于2023年3月担任全国政协主席后，此排名差异更为明确。
中华人民共和国是上海合作组织的创始成员国和主导国之一。
中华人民共和国是金砖国家合作机制的创始成员国。
description.en: China is a founding member of BRICS.

position.zh-cn: 安全理事会常任理事国

description.zh-cn: 1971年，中华人民共和国取代中华民国获得在联合国中的中国席位。

1954年宪法使国务院取代了原政务院的行政职能
国务院根据《中华人民共和国宪法》行使职权和开展工作
第一、二、三、四届国务院总理

position.en: Vice Premier of the State Council

From April 27, 1959, to October 31, 1968, Liu Shaoqi served as President of the People's Republic of China, with Mao Zedong as the paramount leader during this period.

According to Qiu Huizuo's memoirs, his alignment with Jiang Qing led to Lin Biao's dissatisfaction, which was a key factor in his downfall during the Yang-Yu-Fu incident.

description.zh-cn: 中共九大后，林彪集团与张春桥等人的矛盾激化。在1970年庐山会议（中共九届二中全会）上，林彪等人联合陈伯达试图打倒张春桥，双方陷入权力斗争。随后，在1971年《“571工程”纪要》的策划中，林彪集团将张春桥为首的“文人力量”视为主要政治对手，认为其可能取代林彪的接班人地位。
description.en: After the 9th National Congress of the CPC, the conflict between Lin Biao's faction and Zhang Chunqiao's group intensified. At the Lushan Conference (Second Plenary Session of the 9th CPC Central Committee) in August-September 1970, Lin Biao and others, together with Chen Boda, implicitly criticized and attempted to overthrow Zhang Chunqiao, leading to a power struggle. Subsequently, in the planning of the 'Project 571 Outline' in 1971, Lin Biao's faction regarded the 'literati force' led by Zhang Chunqiao as a major political rival, believing it might replace Lin Biao as successor.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东于1949年至1954年担任中央人民政府委员会主席，该委员会是当时的集体国家元首。1954年9月27日起，他担任第一届中华人民共和国主席，并兼任中央人民政府人民革命军事委员会主席。在此期间（至1959年），他作为中国主要领导人，在朝鲜战争时期决策派遣中国人民志愿军参战。
description.en: From 1949 to 1954, Mao Zedong served as the Chairman of the Central People's Government Council, which was the collective head of state at the time. From September 27, 1954, he served as the first President of the People's Republic of China and concurrently as Chairman of the People's Revolutionary Military Commission of the Central People's Government. During this period (until 1959), as a key leader of China, he made the decision to dispatch the Chinese People's Volunteers to participate in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平作为中共第二代领导核心和赵紫阳的政治导师，对赵紫阳及其领导下的工作拥有最高决策权。赵紫阳曾长期在其领导下担任重要职务，包括中共中央总书记。在赵紫阳担任总书记期间（从1987年1月开始），中共中央政治局常委会的重大问题均需请示邓小平，实际最高决策权在于邓小平。此外，自1987年11月至1989年6月，赵紫阳还曾担任中共中央军委第一副主席，在此期间邓小平任军委主席。最终，赵紫阳因在六四事件中的表现被邓小平撤职。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping, as the second-generation core leader of the CPC and Zhao Ziyang's political mentor, held ultimate decision-making power over Zhao and the work under his leadership. Zhao Ziyang held important positions under Deng for a long time, including General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee. During Zhao Ziyang's tenure as General Secretary (starting from January 1987), major issues of the Politburo Standing Committee had to be submitted to Deng Xiaoping for instruction, indicating that the ultimate decision-making power resided with Deng. Furthermore, from November 1987 to June 1989, Zhao Ziyang also served as the First Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the CPC, during which Deng Xiaoping was the Chairman. Ultimately, Zhao Ziyang was removed from office by Deng Xiaoping due to his actions during the June Fourth Incident.

description.zh-cn: 因反对王明的“左”倾路线，邓小平在1933年遭到批判和第一次下台。

在“高岗饶漱石事件”中，邓小平参与揭露和处理高岗的反党联盟问题。

在文化大革命中，邓小平被列为“党内第二号走资本主义道路的当权派”，与刘少奇一同被打倒和批判。
邓小平首次正式提出“一国两制”构想（一个国家，两种制度），旨在解决香港、澳门及台湾问题，并将其应用于香港问题的解决。

description.zh-cn: 1933年考入开封的省立初级中学（今开封高中）。
作为国务院总理和中共中央总书记，赵紫阳是中国经济体制改革的实际组织者和领导者，大力发展市场经济并积极推进政治体制改革。
description.en: As Premier and General Secretary, Zhao Ziyang was the de facto organizer and leader of China's economic system reform, vigorously developing a market economy and actively promoting political system reform.

description.zh-cn: 积极提出并设计政治体制改革方案，推进改革开放深化。
时任代理总书记赵紫阳在1987年5月13日的讲话中，宣布“资产阶级自由化思潮泛滥的情况已经扭转”，并批评了运动扩大化的倾向。此举旨在使“反对资产阶级自由化”的破坏减低到最小限度，并策略性地尽快结束该运动，事实上标志着该运动的结束。
description.en: In his speech on May 13, 1987, acting General Secretary Zhao Ziyang declared that 'the tide of bourgeois liberalization has been turned' and criticized the tendency to broaden the campaign, effectively ending it.

description.zh-cn: 赵紫阳在会见戈尔巴乔夫时透露“重要问题上还需要他（邓小平）掌舵”，邓小平认为此举是将责任推给他，标志着二人分裂。此后，赵紫阳因在如何处理六四事件上与邓小平产生根本分歧，且同情事件中的学生，最终被邓小平决定撤销党内一切职务，导致其政治生涯终结。
在此期间，胡耀邦担任中共中央主席。
两人在经济政策和特别是六四事件处理上存在严重分歧。在中共中央政治局常委会上，双方就如何处理学生运动针锋相对，李鹏主张强硬，赵紫阳主张对话。李鹏是导致赵紫阳下台的关键人物之一。
江泽民接替赵紫阳成为总书记，并延续了对赵紫阳的软禁。
陈云作为党内保守派的代表人物，与改革派领袖赵紫阳在治国理念和改革方针上存在分歧和政治斗争。陈云等人曾反对赵紫阳担任总书记。
description.en: Chen Yun, a representative of the party's conservative faction, had disagreements with Zhao Ziyang on governance philosophy and reform policies.

description.zh-cn: 与保守派理论家邓力群争夺总书记职位，并最终撤销了邓力群控制的书记处研究室。
赵紫阳与万里同为改革派代表。两人分别在四川和安徽推行农村改革，遥相呼应，民间有“要吃粮找紫阳，要吃米找万里”的说法，是改革派的重要盟友。
description.en: They implemented rural reforms in Sichuan and Anhui respectively, supporting each other's efforts. A popular saying was 'Turn to Ziyang for grain, turn to Wan Li for rice.' They were important allies in the reformist faction.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国总理对美国进行为期一周的访问，与美国总统里根会晤。
description.en: Met during a week-long visit to the United States as Premier of China.

Hu Yaobang strongly opposed the 'Two Whatevers' and was a key figure in supporting Deng Xiaoping's rise to power. Ultimately, Hu Yaobang succeeded Hua Guofeng as party chairman.

毛泽东曾多次对周恩来表达不满。1952年，毛泽东因不满周恩来在政务院的权力过大和其经济政策，通过“五马进京”事件引入高岗等人以制衡其权力。1958年，毛泽东又因周恩来提出反“冒进”的主张而对其进行严厉批评。
description.en: Mao Zedong frequently expressed dissatisfaction with Zhou Enlai. In 1952, unhappy with Zhou Enlai's excessive power in the Government Administration Council and his economic policies, Mao used the 'Five Horses Enter Beijing' incident to bring in figures like Gao Gang to counterbalance his power. In 1958, Mao Zedong again severely criticized Zhou Enlai for proposing the 'anti-rash advance' policy.

description.zh-cn: 在主政天津期间，李瑞环主持兴建了引滦入津工程以缓解市民吃水难问题。
description.en: During his tenure in Tianjin, Li Ruihuan presided over the construction of the Luan River Diversion Project to alleviate the city's water shortage problem.

description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, the actions of Li Ruihuan and Qiao Shi to protect intellectuals within their authority caused strong dissatisfaction from conservatives like Jiang Zemin and Li Peng.

description.en: With Liu Bing's approval, Xi Jinping began his studies at Tsinghua University in 1975. He studied in the Department of Chemical Engineering, majoring in Basic Organic Synthesis, and was an alumnus of the Department of Chemical Engineering, class of 1979. Later, he studied in the part-time graduate class of Marxism Theory and Ideological and Political Education in the School of Humanities and Social Sciences.

position.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国副主席，中央军事委员会副主席，中共中央政治局常委

description.en: During his university years, he met and became close friends with Chen Xi, who was his roommate in the chemical engineering department.

在新加坡举行两岸领导人会面。在北京举行第二次会面（习马二会）。
作为中国国家副主席，习近平曾于2011年8月和2012年2月与时任美国副总统拜登会面。2023年11月，在亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会上，习近平以国家主席身份与美国总统拜登会谈，否认存在2027年或2035年攻台计划。
description.en: As China's then-Vice President, Xi Jinping met with then-US Vice President Joe Biden in August 2011 and February 2012. In November 2023, at the APEC Summit in the US, Xi Jinping, as President, held talks with US President Joe Biden, denying the existence of plans to attack Taiwan in 2027 or 2035.

description.zh-cn: 作为应对2019冠状病毒病疫情的核心政策，动态清零政策由习近平多次指示坚持并亲自部署。尤其是在2022年3月上海疫情爆发后，习近平拒绝专家和地方官员放宽隔离的建议，坚持强制执行清零政策。2022年5月5日，他在中共中央政治局常务委员会会议上进一步强调必须坚持动态清零，同一切歪曲、怀疑、否定中国防疫方针政策的言行作斗争。
description.en: As a core policy in response to the COVID-19 pandemic, the dynamic zero-COVID policy was repeatedly instructed and personally deployed by Xi Jinping. Particularly after the Shanghai outbreak in March 2022, Xi Jinping rejected suggestions from experts and local officials to ease quarantine measures and insisted on enforcing the zero-COVID policy. On May 5, 2022, he further emphasized at a meeting of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau that dynamic zero-COVID must be adhered to, and a struggle must be waged against all words and deeds that distort, doubt, or deny China's epidemic prevention policies.

description.zh-cn: 据路透社等媒体报道，香港政府修订《逃犯条例》是在中共中央纪委的倡议下提出的，目的是为了获得将被香港嫌疑人移送至中国内地审讯的法律依据。
description.en: Reports, including one by Reuters, suggest that the amendment to the Fugitive Offenders Ordinance by the Hong Kong government was initiated by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection (CCDI), with the aim of gaining legal leverage to transfer suspects from Hong Kong to mainland China for trial.

description.zh-cn: 因不信任中国大陆的司法制度，反对修例。
在立法会中支持政府的修例工作。
在香港立法会就《逃犯条例》修订草案的议程和委员会主席人选发生激烈冲突。
会同行政会议引用《紧急情况规例条例》制定《禁止蒙面规例》。
为应对反修例运动，中央绕过香港立法程序，于2020年6月30日表决通过了《中华人民共和国香港特别行政区维护国家安全法》。
description.en: In response to the anti-extradition movement, the central government bypassed Hong Kong's legislative procedures and passed the Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on June 30, 2020.

description.zh-cn: 因应反修例运动，美国通过了《香港人权与民主法案》。
公开表态支持林郑月娥领导的特区政府止暴制乱。
在北京人民大会堂会见到京述职的林郑月娥。
会见林郑月娥，表示支持其政府和警队。
特朗普称曾要求习近平不要派解放军到香港，并警告暴力镇压会威胁到贸易协议。
中国抗日战争的主要交战双方。
九一八事变被视为“十四年抗战”的起点，揭开了日本侵华的序幕。
description.en: The Mukden Incident is considered the beginning of the Fourteen-Year War of Resistance.

description.zh-cn: 引发中日全面战争，是“八年抗战”的起点。七七事变标志着中国抗日战争的全面爆发。

position.zh-cn: 军事委员会委员长、领导人、总司令
position.en: Chairman of the Military Commission, Leader, Commander-in-chief

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正是南京国民政府的领导人。作为中国战区的最高统帅，他领导国民政府进行抗战。他还在中原大战中担任其军队的总司令。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was the leader of the Nanjing Nationalist Government. As the supreme commander of the China war zone, he led the Nationalist Government in the War of Resistance. He also served as the commander-in-chief of its army during the Central Plains War.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军是国民政府的官方武装力量。
作为大日本帝国的国家元首和军队最高统帅。
九一八事变后，大日本帝国在占领中国东北地区后，策划并扶植日本关东军建立的傀儡政权满洲国。
description.en: After the September 18th Incident, the Empire of Japan occupied Northeast China, then planned and supported the Japanese Kwantung Army in establishing the puppet state of Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 作为满洲国的傀儡元首，受日本控制。
脱离重庆国民政府，投靠日本并合作。
日本军队在占领南京后，对中国平民和战俘进行了大规模的屠杀和暴行，并对其部队在城内的暴行采取默许乃至纵容的态度。
description.en: After capturing Nanjing, Japanese troops carried out a large-scale massacre and atrocities against Chinese civilians and prisoners of war.

description.zh-cn: 根据国共合作协议，红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军（后改称第十八集团军）。
美国为加速战争结束，在日本投下原子弹。
苏联根据《雅尔塔协定》对日宣战，进攻中国东北。
美国对广岛和长崎投下原子弹，对日本政府造成巨大冲击，是促使其决定投降的关键因素之一。
description.en: The atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki by the United States shocked the Japanese government and were one of the key factors that pushed it to decide to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 苏联出兵彻底摧毁了日本关东军，断绝了日本最后的希望。
在南京举行的第二次世界大战中国战区受降仪式上，冈村宁次代表日本向何应钦投降。
会议通过决议，要求加入中国国民党的共产党员一律退出国民党。

七一五事变中武汉国民政府与中共决裂，导致第一次国共合作全面破裂，直接促使中共中央决定发动武装起义。
description.en: The split between the Wuhan Nationalist Government and the CCP during the July 15 Incident led to the complete collapse of the First United Front, directly prompting the CCP Central Committee to decide to launch an armed uprising.

description.zh-cn: 以国民党左派名义参与南昌起义。
南昌起义是针对中国国民党清党行为的武装反抗，旨在夺取政权。
description.en: The Nanchang Uprising was an armed resistance against the Kuomintang's party purge, aimed at seizing political power.

position.zh-cn: 代理前敌总指挥兼第十一军军长

description.zh-cn: 叶挺与周恩来、贺龙等人共同领导了南昌起义。他率领国民革命军第十一军部队参加起义，并担任代理前敌总指挥。
description.en: Ye Ting, along with Zhou Enlai, He Long, and others, jointly led the Nanchang Uprising. He commanded the troops of the 11th Army of the National Revolutionary Army to participate in the uprising, serving as the acting Frontline Commander-in-Chief.

description.zh-cn: 作为国民党右派领袖，是南昌起义的主要目标之一。
其领导的武汉国民政府与中共决裂（七一五事变），成为起义的对立方。
共产国际在起义前向中共中央发电报，指示“如毫无胜利机会，则可不举行暴动”，对发动起义持保留和反对态度。
description.en: Before the uprising, the Comintern sent a telegram to the CCP Central Committee, instructing that "if there is no chance of victory, the uprising should not be held," expressing reservations and opposition to launching the insurrection.

description.zh-cn: 张国焘作为中共中央代表，在起义前夕传达共产国际指示，主张慎重行事并反对立即发动起义。然而，他的这一主张最终未被采纳。
description.en: As the CCP Central Committee representative, Zhang Guotao conveyed Comintern instructions on the eve of the uprising, advocating for caution and opposing the immediate launch of the insurrection. However, his advocacy was ultimately not adopted.

description.zh-cn: 未到场参与。

During this period, they experienced the Fourth Encirclement Campaign against the Central Soviet Area, and the National Revolutionary Army continuously encircled and pursued the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army during the Long March (October 1934 to October 1936).

description.zh-cn: 作为中国共产党的领袖，毛泽东领导建立了中华人民共和国，是其主要缔造者。
description.en: As the leader of the Chinese Communist Party, Mao Zedong led the establishment of the People's Republic of China.

description.en: Then-Vice Premier Wu Yi reportedly had a poor relationship with Bo Xilai and, in 2007, used her 'bare retirement' as leverage to prevent him from succeeding her as Vice Premier.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来任辽宁省长期间，时任中共辽宁省委书记闻世震据报曾批评薄熙来“开发的中国城市像欧洲，农村像非洲”，并在2004年薄离开辽宁后举行宴会庆祝。
description.en: While Bo Xilai served as Governor of Liaoning, then-Party Secretary Wen Shizhen reportedly criticized him, saying 'the developed Chinese cities resemble Europe, while the countryside resembles Africa,' and held a banquet to celebrate Bo's departure from Liaoning in 2004.

As Bo Xilai's capable subordinate, Wang Lijun was the main implementer of the 'strike black' campaign in Chongqing, responsible for the specific execution of the movement.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来在主政重庆期间主导并发起了重庆“打黑除恶”专项行动。
description.en: During his tenure in Chongqing, Bo Xilai initiated and led the Chongqing 'strike black and eradicate evil' special campaign.

description.zh-cn: 王立军进入美国驻成都总领事馆引爆了政治丑闻，该事件是导致薄熙来政治生涯终结的直接原因，并直接导致其于2012年3月15日被免去中共重庆市委书记职务。
description.en: Wang Lijun's entry into the U.S. Consulate in Chengdu ignited a political scandal, which directly led to Bo Xilai's downfall and his removal from the post of Chongqing Party Secretary on March 15, 2012.

description.en: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea and the Republic of Korea were the main belligerent states in the Korean War. After the armistice, they technically remain in a state of war. Recently, Kim Jong Un has declared that inter-Korean relations are those of two hostile states, belligerent states.

During the Central Plains War, from September 9 to November 4, 1930, a government opposing the Nanjing Nationalist Government was established. description.en: The 610 Office was a permanent body whose primary responsibility was to coordinate various government agencies in carrying out the suppression of Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 自1996年起即开始推动对法轮功的负面宣传和调查，是镇压中的关键人物，并担任中央处理法轮功问题领导小组组长。

In April 1999, he published an article in 'Tianjin Science and Technology' magazine titled 'I Do Not Approve of Qigong for Teenagers,' again criticizing Falun Gong as 'pseudoscience.' This action directly triggered the April 25 Appeal.

description.zh-cn: 其发表在《天津科技》的文章是425上访事件的直接导火索。

description.en: During the Huairen Hall Incident, Wang Dongxing, then Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, dispatched personnel to arrest Mao Yuanxin and put him under 'protective review'.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共中央负责人，在决定是否拘捕毛远新等人的会议上，最终决定并批准了行动。
向毛泽东传达邓小平对文革的态度，并主持了批评邓小平的会议，成为发动该运动的导火索之一。

李阳冰是李白的族叔。
description.en: Li Yangbing was Li Bai's clan uncle.

description.zh-cn: 李白约在724年出蜀东游，在襄阳与孟浩然相识并成为好友。
description.en: Around 724, Li Bai embarked on an eastern tour from Shu, where he met Meng Haoran in Xiangyang and they became friends.

description.zh-cn: 入京时与秘书监贺知章见面，贺知章赞其为“谪仙人”。
获唐玄宗征召入京，担任翰林供奉，成为宫廷诗人。
根据一种说法，李白是受道士吴筠的推荐而被唐玄宗征召入京。
description.en: According to one account, Li Bai was recommended by the Daoist priest Wu Yun, which led to his being summoned to the capital by Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 玉真公主是推荐李白入宫的关键人物之一，李白因此获唐玄宗征召。
description.en: Princess Yuzhen was one of the key figures who recommended Li Bai to the court, and Li Bai was consequently summoned by Emperor Xuanzong.

description.zh-cn: 据说李白酒后曾醉令高力士为其脱靴，冒犯了高力士。高力士因此向杨贵妃进谗言中伤李白，导致李白被排挤。
description.en: According to legend, Li Bai, while drunk, ordered Gao Lishi to remove his boots, which offended the eunuch. Gao subsequently slandered Li Bai to Yang Guifei, leading to the poet's ostracism.

description.zh-cn: 因高力士的中伤，指出李白曾用自杀的赵飞燕比喻她，杨贵妃也开始排斥李白。
description.en: Influenced by Gao Lishi's slander, which pointed out that Li Bai had compared her to the suicidal Zhao Feiyan, Yang Guifei also began to ostracize Li Bai.

description.zh-cn: 756年末，永王李璘率水军东下，李白应聘加入其幕府。后因李璘兵败，李白受牵连下狱。
description.en: At the end of 756, when Prince Yong Li Lin led his naval forces east, Li Bai accepted an invitation to join his staff. Later, due to Li Lin's defeat, Li Bai was implicated and imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 根据传说，郭子仪为报答李白早年的救助之恩，在李白因永王案获罪时，以自己的官爵为李白求情，使其免于死刑，改判流放夜郎。
description.en: According to legend, to repay Li Bai for saving him in his youth, Guo Ziyi interceded on Li Bai's behalf when he was convicted in the Prince of Yong case, offering his own official rank to save him from execution, resulting in the sentence being commuted to exile in Yelang.

description.zh-cn: 李白最敬慕的诗人，其诗风对李白有深刻影响。
道教宗师司马承祯曾称赞年轻的李白有“仙风道骨”，对李白产生了重要影响，李白作《大鹏遇希有鸟赋》以纪念此事。
description.en: The Daoist master Sima Chengzhen once praised the young Li Bai for having an 'immortal's air and Daoist bones,' which had a significant influence on him. Li Bai wrote the 'Rhapsody on the Great Peng Bird Meeting the Xiyou Bird' to commemorate this event.

description.zh-cn: 李白终身仰慕东晋名相谢安，将其视为政治理想的楷模。
因陈良宇事件被开除党籍
陈良宇任中央政治局委员、上海市委书记期间，胡锦涛为中共中央总书记。
陈良宇任上海市委书记期间，江泽民为时任中共中央总书记。

陈良宇被视为江泽民派系（上海帮）的重要成员。
description.en: Chen Liangyu was considered a key member of the Jiang Zemin faction (Shanghai clique).

description.zh-cn: 作为上海社保局长，受陈良宇指示委托张荣坤投资社保基金。
陈良宇在上海主政期间，谋划上海获得2010年世界博览会的主办权并努力推动相关筹办工作。
description.en: During his tenure in Shanghai, Chen Liangyu planned for the city to win the bid for the 2010 World Expo and actively promoted the related preparatory work.

description.zh-cn: 对陈良宇进行立案审查，最终导致其被免职。
天津市第二中级人民法院对陈良宇案进行审理，以受贿罪、滥用职权罪判处其有期徒刑18年。
description.en: The Tianjin No. 2 Intermediate People's Court tried Chen Liangyu and sentenced him to 18 years in prison for bribery and abuse of power.

description.zh-cn: 被指是操盘整倒陈良宇的人之一。
在上海西郊宾馆与负责保卫邓小平的警卫发生冲撞，间接惊扰了邓小平。
在东北地区阻挠国民政府军队接收，为中共进入东北创造条件。
由于在第二次国共内战中失利，中华民国政府被迫迁往台湾。
description.en: Due to its defeat in the Second Chinese Civil War, the government of the Republic of China was forced to retreat to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在东北、华东和华北发动了辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役，取得决定性胜利，奠定了在内战中的绝对军事优势。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army launched the Liaoshen, Huaihai, and Pingjin Campaigns in Northeast, East China, and North China. These three decisive strategic victories established an absolute military advantage in the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 在平津战役中率领其部队接受中国共产党的和平改编，促成北平和平解放。
在第二次国共内战中作为敌对双方的武装力量进行交战。
蒋中正发动的清党事件，是第一次国共合作破裂和内战爆发的导火索之一，也是第一次国共内战全面爆发的标志性事件。
description.en: The party purge initiated by Chiang Kai-shek was one of the catalysts for the breakdown of the First United Front and the outbreak of the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 1979年1月1日，全国人大常委会发布了《告台湾同胞书》。
description.en: On January 1, 1979, the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress issued the 'Message to Compatriots in Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 该文件的发表以及中华人民共和国国防部停止炮击金门的声明，标志着国共内战的军事冲突阶段基本结束。
description.en: The publication of this document and the PRC Ministry of National Defense's announcement to cease shelling Kinmen marked the essential end of the military conflict phase of the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 宣布动员戡乱时期结束，不再视中共为叛乱团体。

新冠疫情引发的经济衰退被认为是自1930年代的大萧条以来最大的衰退。
声称新冠病毒为人造，并在开发艾滋病疫苗时从武汉病毒研究所意外泄露。
公布文件显示，COVID-19病毒很可能源自武汉病毒研究所的实验室泄漏。
在社交平台X上指控美国国际开发署使用美国纳税人的资金支持武汉病毒研究所的研究。
被埃隆·马斯克指控资助武汉病毒研究所用于研究“蝙蝠冠状病毒突变”。
据报道，通过美国生态健康联盟向武汉病毒研究所提供资金用于研究。
被多方指控为病毒的可能来源地（实验室泄漏）。

对中共控制的中央苏区发动第五次围剿。
由于在第五次围剿战争中失利，中国工农红军被迫开始长征进行战略转移。
description.en: Due to the defeat in the Fifth Encirclement Campaign, the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army was forced to begin the Long March as a strategic retreat.

description.zh-cn: 在西安事变中与杨虎城共同扣押蒋介石，要求其停止内战，联共抗日。
西安事变的和平解决促成了第二次国共合作和抗日民族统一战线的形成，从而结束了第一次国共内战。
description.en: The peaceful resolution of the Xi'an Incident led to the Second United Front and the formation of an anti-Japanese national united front, thus ending the First Chinese Civil War.

“三面红旗”（社会主义建设总路线、大跃进、人民公社）的施政方针是导致三年困难时期的直接和根本原因。
description.en: The 'Three Red Banners' policy (General Line for Socialist Construction, Great Leap Forward, People's Communes) was the direct and fundamental cause of the Three Years of Difficult Period.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进运动中的高指标、瞎指挥、浮夸风和“共产风”等“左”倾政策失误与资源错配，直接导致了1958-1962年的大饥荒，即三年困难时期。官方决议指出，“大跃进”的错误是造成严重困难的主要原因之一。
description.en: The 'Left' errors, including high targets, blind commandism, boastful exaggeration, and the 'communist wind,' as well as policy missteps and resource misallocation during the Great Leap Forward movement, directly led to the Great Famine of 1958-1962, also known as the Three Years of Difficult Period. Official resolutions state that the errors of the 'Great Leap Forward' were one of the main causes of the severe difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 人民公社制度、‘共产风’以及公共食堂制度的兴起，破坏了农业生产，导致粮食过度消耗和浪费，严重挫伤农民生产积极性，是造成大饥荒的重要原因之一。
description.en: The rise of the People's Commune system, the 'Communist wind', and the public canteen system damaged agricultural production, led to excessive grain consumption and waste, severely dampened peasants' production enthusiasm, and was one of the important causes of the Great Famine.

description.zh-cn: 官方决议将“反右倾”的错误列为造成严重困难的主要原因之一，它打断了纠正左倾错误的进程。该运动导致无人敢讲真话，使得大跃进的错误政策未能及时纠正，进一步加剧了饥荒。
打麻雀运动导致生态失衡，害虫数量激增，进而引发粮食严重欠收，加剧了饥荒。
description.en: The Sparrow Eradication Campaign led to ecological imbalance and a surge in pest populations, resulting in severe crop failure and thus exacerbating the famine.

description.zh-cn: 中苏关系恶化后，苏联政府撕毁合同、撤走专家，对中国的经济造成了冲击，被官方认为是加剧经济困难的因素之一。
description.en: After the deterioration of Sino-Soviet relations, the Soviet government tore up contracts and withdrew its experts, which impacted China's economy and was officially considered a factor that exacerbated the economic difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东决定将麻雀列为“四害”之一，并号召消灭麻雀。
为了总结大跃进的经验教训和应对严重的经济困难，中共中央于1962年初召开了七千人大会。
description.en: To summarize the experiences and lessons of the Great Leap Forward and address the severe economic difficulties, the CPC Central Committee convened the Seven Thousand Cadres Conference in early 1962.

description.zh-cn: 七千人大会后，刘少奇主持中央具体事务，负责经济调整工作。
1956年，周恩来等人提出反“冒进”，暂时遏制了后来发展为“大跃进”的经济建设冒进趋势。
拟订了《关于对在京高级干部和高级知识分子在副食品供应方面给予照顾问题的报告》，推动了特供体制的建立。
对高级干部以下级别的其他干部，也供应定量的白糖和黄豆，扩大了特供范围。
时任信阳地委书记路宪文，通过禁止农民逃荒、封锁消息等高压政策，直接导致并加剧了信阳地区的大规模饥荒和死亡，即著名的信阳事件。
description.en: Lu Xianwen, then Party Secretary of Xinyang Prefecture, through high-pressure policies such as banning peasants from fleeing and suppressing information, directly caused and exacerbated the mass starvation and death in the Xinyang region, known as the Xinyang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央军委主席和实际最高领导人，决定采取果断行动，批准并下令实施戒严和清场。
在中共中央政治局常委会上反对实施戒严，并表示准备辞职。
此次会议通过报告，撤销了赵紫阳担任的中共中央总书记、中央政治局常委、中央政治局委员、中央军委第一副主席等所有职务。
description.en: The plenum passed a report that removed Zhao Ziyang from his posts as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Politburo Standing Committee member, Politburo member, and First Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 该社论将学生运动定性为“动乱”，代表了政府的强硬立场，旨在制止抗议。
作为学生运动的主要组织者，领导了罢课、游行和广场占领行动。
作为国家武装力量，执行了进入北京市区并对天安门广场进行清场的命令。
作为第38集团军军长，徐勤先在接到执行戒严命令后，以“口头命令我无法执行，需要书面命令”为由拒绝在调兵令上签字，从而拒绝率部入京执行戒严令。
description.en: As commander of the 38th Group Army, Xu Qinxian, after receiving the order to enforce martial law, refused to sign the troop deployment order and thus refused to lead his troops into Beijing to enforce martial law, stating, "I cannot execute a verbal order, a written order is required."

description.zh-cn: 事件后，中国的经济改革放缓，政治体制改革陷入停滞。
作为广西最高领导人，被认为是屠杀的主要组织者。
包括毛泽东、林彪和周恩来在内的中央最高领导层批准了动用军队对“4.22”造反派进行武力镇压。
该布告意图制止武斗，但在广西被“联指”派反利用，作为继续进行屠杀的借口。
代表第十九届中央委员会向二十大作报告。
选举产生中国共产党第二十届中央委员会。
description.en: Elected the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 大会选举产生了第二十届中央纪律检查委员会。
会议在北京人民大会堂召开。
宪法修正案删除了国家主席的连任限制，为习近平在二十大后继续连任铺平了道路。
在中共二十大闭幕会上，胡锦涛被习近平指示的工作人员带离会场。
description.en: At the closing session of the 20th CPC National Congress, Hu Jintao was escorted out of the venue by staff members acting on instructions from Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十大闭幕会上，将文件从胡锦涛面前抽走，并出手阻拦其查看文件。
在胡锦涛二十大离场事件中，出手阻拦胡锦涛查看文件。
作为习近平的贴身秘书执行了将胡锦涛带离会场的指令。
在胡锦涛二十大离场事件中，将意欲起身搀扶胡锦涛的栗战书拉坐回其座位。
两人在浙江共事时建立了密切的互信关系，被媒体认为是习近平的亲信。

description.zh-cn: 皇太极于1636年5月15日在盛京称帝，将国号由“金”改为“大清”，正式建立清朝。
description.en: On May 15, 1636, Hong Taiji proclaimed himself emperor in Shengjing, changing the state name from 'Jin' to 'Great Qing' and formally establishing the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 率清军入关，为清初实际统治者。
原为明朝将领，于一片石战役前归降清朝，引清兵入关。
作为三藩之一发动三藩之乱反清。
通过明清战争取代明朝。
在一片石之战中，清军击败李自成的大顺军，双方为敌对作战方。
description.en: In the Battle of Shanhai Pass, the Qing army and the Dashun army were opposing combatants.

description.zh-cn: 历经康雍乾三朝，最终平定准噶尔。
康熙帝在位期间，坚决主张撤藩，并领导清军历时九年平定了三藩之乱，巩固了清朝的统治。
description.en: During his reign, the Kangxi Emperor resolutely pushed for the abolition of the feudatories and, leading Qing forces, successfully suppressed the Revolt of the Three Feudatories after a nine-year war, thereby consolidating the Qing dynasty's rule.

description.zh-cn: 设立军机处以加强皇权。
下令开设四库全书馆，编纂《四库全书》，并批准了从《永乐大典》中辑佚的方案。
description.en: Ordered the establishment of the Siku Quanshu project, the compilation of the Siku Quanshu, and approved the plan to recover lost texts from the Yongle Encyclopedia.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次鸦片战争中战败。
第一次鸦片战争以清朝失败告终，直接导致《南京条约》的签订。
description.en: The First Opium War ended in the defeat of the Qing dynasty, directly leading to the signing of the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 洪秀全是太平天国的建立者，自称天王。
清朝镇压了太平天国运动。这场大规模的反清运动严重动摇了清朝的统治。
description.en: The Qing dynasty suppressed the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom Movement. This large-scale anti-Qing movement severely shook the Qing dynasty's rule.

description.zh-cn: 曾国藩为镇压太平天国而组建湘军，并担任最高统帅。

description.zh-cn: 作为地方团练协助清军作战。

在甲午战争中击败清朝，并通过《马关条约》割占台湾、澎湖，并迫使清朝放弃对朝鲜的宗主权。
description.en: Defeated the Qing dynasty in the First Sino-Japanese War and, through the Treaty of Shimonoseki, took control of Taiwan and Penghu, and forced the Qing to renounce its suzerainty over Korea.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义引发了辛亥革命，革命促使南方各省纷纷宣布独立。最终，清朝统治被推翻，清帝退位。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising sparked the Xinhai Revolution, which prompted southern provinces to declare independence. Ultimately, the Qing dynasty's rule was overthrown, leading to the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.en: On July 10, 1940, the French Parliament decided to transfer power to Marshal Philippe Pétain, establishing the Vichy regime. description.en: On November 5, 1914, during a speech titled 'Junzi' at Tsinghua University, the classical phrases 'Tian Xing Jian, Jun Zi Yi Zi Qiang Bu Xi' and 'Di Shi Kun, Jun Zi Yi Hou De Zai Wu' that he quoted were later adopted as the university motto.

description.en: Xiang Zhongfa participated in and organized the Jinghan Railway Strike.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际出于加强领导层工人成分的考虑，支持并提拔向忠发成为中共最高领导人。
description.en: The Comintern, seeking to strengthen the working-class composition of the leadership, supported and promoted Xiang Zhongfa to become the top leader of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在苏联接见了向忠发，并对其表示重视，使其受到共产国际关注，为他后来的政治崛起和成为总书记铺平了道路。
description.en: Stalin received Xiang Zhongfa in the Soviet Union and showed appreciation for him, which brought him to the attention of the Comintern and paved the way for his later political rise and becoming General Secretary.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央常委、秘书长兼组织部长
position.en: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee, Secretary-General, and Head of the Organization Department

description.zh-cn: 周恩来在向忠发担任总书记期间，作为中共中央常委、秘书长兼组织部长，名义上是其下属。但实际上，周恩来是中共的核心领导者之一，承担了大部分实际工作，而向忠发仅是名义上的党内领袖。
description.en: During Xiang Zhongfa's tenure as General Secretary, Zhou Enlai served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, Secretary-General, and Head of the Organization Department, nominally his subordinate. However, Zhou Enlai was actually one of the CCP's core leaders, undertaking most of the practical work, while Xiang Zhongfa was merely the nominal party leader.

description.zh-cn: 在李立三提议下，向忠发主持会议通过决议，取消了蔡和森的中央政治局委员、常委及宣传部长职务。之后，李立三递补了蔡和森的政治局常委职位。
description.en: At Li Lisan's suggestion, Xiang Zhongfa presided over a meeting that passed a resolution to remove Cai Hesen from his positions as a member of the Politburo, its Standing Committee, and Head of the Propaganda Department. Subsequently, Li Lisan filled Cai Hesen's position on the Politburo Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 顾顺章于1931年4月被捕叛变，供出向忠发体貌特征等关键信息，并协助国民党特务抓捕向忠发。其提供的情报最终导致向忠发于6月22日被捕。
description.en: Gu Shunzhang was arrested and defected in April 1931, providing crucial information such as Xiang Zhongfa's physical characteristics, and assisting KMT agents in his arrest. The intelligence he provided ultimately led to Xiang Zhongfa's capture on June 22.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东感念向忠发的知遇之恩，在此后几十年间从未公开批评过他。
国民政府特务于1931年6月22日逮捕向忠发，并于24日将其处决。
description.en: Nationalist Government agents arrested Xiang Zhongfa on June 22, 1931, and executed him on the 24th.

description.zh-cn: 向忠发被捕后随即叛变，供出了陈琮英的住址，导致其被捕。
description.en: Xiang Zhongfa defected immediately after his arrest and revealed Chen Congying's address, leading to her capture.

description.zh-cn: 叛变后供出中共中央机要一处地址，导致其被捕。
作为当时中央特科负责人，参与事件处理，并认同向忠发叛变的结论。
根据《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，中共中央组织部统一管理公务员工作。
国家公务员局原为公务员管理的全国性机关，2018年并入中共中央组织部。
公务员通过国家公务员考试进行录用。
古代的科举考试体系被认为是现代国家公务员考试的雏形。
description.en: The ancient imperial examination system is considered the prototype of the modern national civil service examination.

description.zh-cn: 1950年，中央人民政府政务院试行了从总理到勤杂工的25级工资制。这是对国家工作人员薪酬体系进行系统管理的早期探索。
description.en: In 1950, the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government trialed a 25-grade salary system, covering roles from premier to janitor. This was an early exploration into the systematic management of the remuneration system for state personnel.

description.zh-cn: 干部队伍的“革命化、年轻化、知识化、专业化”方针是根据邓小平的指示提出的。
description.en: The policy for the cadre corps to become 'more revolutionary, younger, better educated, and more professional' was proposed based on instructions from Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 干部四化方针推动了公务员制度向年轻化、专业化方向改革。
中共中央作出《关于建立老干部退休制度的决定》，推动了公务员退休制度的建立。
1987年，中共十三大正式提出建立国家公务员制度，并提出了干部人事制度改革。
description.en: In 1987, the 13th National Congress of the CPC formally proposed the establishment of a national civil service system and the reform of the cadre personnel system.

description.zh-cn: 1993年8月，国务院签发了《国家公务员暂行条例》。
description.en: In August 1993, the State Council issued the 'Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants'.

description.zh-cn: 《国家公务员暂行条例》的施行标志着中国公务员制度的初步建立。
description.en: The implementation of the 'Interim Regulations on National Civil Servants' marked the initial establishment of China's civil service system.

description.zh-cn: 2005年4月27日，第十届全国人大常委会第十五次会议通过了《中华人民共和国公务员法》，并于2006年1月1日施行。
description.en: On April 27, 2005, the 15th session of the Standing Committee of the 10th National People's Congress passed the 'Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China', which came into effect on January 1, 2006.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央组织部作为中国共产党主管干部工作的职能部门，对全国公务员工作进行统一管理。曾与人事部联合下发《公务员奖励规定（试行）》，建立了公务员奖励荣誉制度。
description.en: The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, as the functional department of the Chinese Communist Party in charge of cadre affairs, exercises unified management over the national civil service. It once jointly issued the "Provisions on Civil Servant Awards (Trial)" with the Ministry of Personnel, establishing a system of awards and honors for civil servants.

description.zh-cn: 与中共中央组织部联合下发《公务员奖励规定（试行）》，建立了公务员奖励荣誉制度。
根据2018年《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，国家公务员局被并入中共中央组织部，并对外保留国家公务员局牌子。
description.en: According to the 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions' in 2018, the National Civil Service Administration was merged into the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, while retaining its nameplate for external affairs.

description.zh-cn: 修改公务员法，推行公务员职务与职级并行制度。
该法规定了包括公务员在内的公职人员的违法行为及相应处分。

description.en: Emperor Wu of Han adopted Dong Zhongshu's suggestion of 'dismissing the hundred schools and glorifying the six classics', and implemented the policy of 'exclusively revering Confucianism'.

description.zh-cn: 采纳主父偃的建议，颁行推恩令以削弱诸侯王势力。
汉武帝改变和亲政策，对匈奴发动长期战争。
太子刘据被迫起兵反抗，兵败自杀。
在太子刘据兵败后，皇后卫子夫为免受辱，交出皇后玉玺后自缢身亡。
description.en: After the defeat of her son, Crown Prince Liu Ju, Empress Wei Zifu committed suicide to avoid humiliation.

description.zh-cn: 诬告太子刘据行巫蛊之术，引发巫蛊之祸。
汉武帝为防止“子幼母壮”外戚专权，在立刘弗陵为太子后，借故处死了赵婕妤（钩弋夫人）。
description.en: To prevent a situation of a 'young ruler and a strong mother' and the usurpation of power by maternal relatives, Emperor Wu executed Zhao Jieyu (Lady Gouyi) on a pretext after making Liu Fuling the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 受汉武帝遗诏，以大司马、大将军身份辅佐年幼的汉昭帝。
根据《佞幸列传》，李延年“与上卧起，甚贵幸”。

description.en: She enthroned and diligently nurtured the Kangxi Emperor, serving as his political mentor, assisting him in overthrowing Oboi's faction and suppressing the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, laying the foundation for the High Qing era.

description.zh-cn: 率领水师攻克澎湖，迫使郑克塽归降

康熙帝曾两次废黜皇太子允礽（胤礽）之位。第一次发生于1708年9月18日，他将其幽禁于咸安宫，此次废黜是引发“九子夺嫡”的重要事件。第二次废黜发生于1712年10月27日，原因是有指控称胤礽结党营私。
description.en: The Kangxi Emperor twice deposed Crown Prince Yunreng (Yinreng). The first deposition occurred on September 18, 1708, when Yunreng was confined to Xian'an Palace; this event significantly sparked the 'Nine Sons Seize the Throne.' The second deposition, on October 27, 1712, was due to accusations of Yunreng forming cliques for selfish purposes.

description.en: As one of the initiators and main drafters of Charter 08, participated in its revision and became one of the first signatories.

description.zh-cn: 毕生致力于宣传及参与中国民主运动。
致力于终结中国共产党的一党专政。
因参与六四事件被捕入狱。
多次被关押，包括监视居住、劳动教养，及最终因《零八宪章》被逮捕并判刑。
向其颁发2010年诺贝尔和平奖。
长期监禁，导致其成为唯一从获奖至辞世未能恢复完全人身自由的诺贝尔奖得主。
发表《选择的批判——与李泽厚对话》等作品，对其思想文化进行批判。
推荐刘晓波为2010年诺贝尔和平奖人选。
对刘晓波被判刑发表公开声明表示支持。
批评刘晓波对中国政府采取合作态度，并在其获得诺贝尔和平奖后，批评该奖项授予刘晓波的决定。
description.en: Criticized Liu Xiaobo for his cooperative attitude towards the Chinese government, and after he was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, criticized the decision to grant him the award.

description.zh-cn: 对孙中山持负面评价，认为其政治遗产是暴力革命和党国独裁体制。
在访华会见习近平时，表示对刘晓波情况的关注。

description.en: Pushed for and actively participated in the establishment of the Tsinghua University Center for Advanced Study (the predecessor of the Institute), playing a key role in its founding and serving as its first Honorary Director.

description.zh-cn: 朱高炽是明成祖长子。
description.en: Zhu Gaochi was the eldest son of Zhu Di.

description.zh-cn: 朱高煦是明成祖次子。
