在约翰·F·甘迺迪政府学院修读。
在文化大革命期间以知识青年身分在吉林省洮南县瓦房公社插队。
刘植岩在“文化大革命”开始后被“打倒”，遭受残酷批斗，后跳楼自杀。
2013年任副主任、党组成员，2014年任党组副书记。
在美国白宫共同签署中美第一阶段经贸协议。
会见访华的美国财政部长耶伦。
在世界经济论坛致辞时表示“现在有人说中国要搞计划经济，这是根本不可能的”。
韩信在秦末加入项梁的起义军。
项梁战死后，韩信归属于项羽，但未被重用。
韩信离开项羽投奔刘邦后，成为项羽的主要敌手。
韩信因犯军法当斩，夏侯婴认为其是壮士而释放了他，并向刘邦推荐。
萧何月下追韩信，并说服刘邦拜韩信为大将军。
采纳萧何建议，登坛拜将，任命韩信为大将军。
在潍水之战中，韩信水淹齐楚联军，斩杀楚将龙且。
刘邦在统一天下后，为巩固皇权，开始铲除异姓王，韩信是主要目标之一。
刘邦采纳陈平的计策，以伪游云梦为名，在陈县擒获了前来谒见的楚王韩信，趁机夺取其兵权，并将其从楚王贬为淮阴侯。
description.en: Liu Bang adopted Chen Ping's strategy, pretending to tour the Yunmeng Marsh, and captured Han Xin, the King of Chu, when he came to pay his respects at Chen County. Han Xin was later demoted to Marquis of Huaiyin.

description.zh-cn: 与吕后合谋，诱骗韩信至长乐宫，导致其被杀害。
向刘邦献计，以伪游云梦之计擒获韩信。
金亨稷是金日成的父亲。
康盘石是金日成的母亲。
获大尉军衔。
第二次世界大战结束后，苏联支持金日成在朝鲜半岛北部建立政权。
斯大林强烈支持金日成成为朝鲜最高领导人，并同意其武力统一朝鲜的计划，提供军事援助。
description.en: Stalin strongly supported Kim Il-sung to become the supreme leader of North Korea, agreed to his plan for the armed unification of Korea, and provided military assistance.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜战争中，中国人民志愿军入朝参战，支援朝鲜。
金日成以“美国间谍”的罪名处决了其竞争对手李承烨。
金日成以“美国间谍”的罪名处决了其竞争对手朴宪永。
金日成清洗了以许嘉谊为代表的亲苏派。
赫鲁晓夫反对斯大林个人崇拜后，金日成指责其为“社会主义背信者”。
金日成与韩方会谈后，双方发表《南北共同声明》。
在朝鲜核问题背景下，卡特访问平壤与金日成会面。
通过卡特访朝，邀请金日成访问汉城举行首脑会议。
李承晚与金日成为政治对手，曾公开指责金日成是苏联扶持的傀儡。
天宝四年（745年），杨氏被册封为贵妃，成为唐玄宗晚年最宠爱的妃子。直至756年在马嵬驿被赐死。
description.en: In the 4th year of Tianbao (745), Yang was conferred the title of Guifei, becoming Emperor Xuanzong's most beloved consort in his later years. She was eventually granted death at Mawei Station in 756.

description.zh-cn: 杨贵妃丧父后被叔父杨玄璬收养。
安史之乱爆发后，唐玄宗在逃亡途中，随驾禁军在马嵬驿发生哗变。
在马嵬坡，龙武大将军陈玄礼率随驾禁军逼宫，请求处死杨国忠和杨贵妃，从而发动了马嵬驿兵变。
description.en: At Mawei Post, General Chen Xuanli led his troops to surround the imperial entourage, demanding the execution of Yang Guozhong and Imperial Consort Yang, thereby initiating the mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 在马嵬驿兵变中，唐玄宗为平息军怨、自保社稷，被迫下令赐死杨贵妃。
description.en: During the Mawei Post Mutiny, Emperor Xuanzong, compelled to appease military resentment and secure his own safety, was forced to order Yang Guifei's execution.

description.zh-cn: 高力士劝说唐玄宗赐死杨贵妃，并奉命将其缢死。
韩国夫人是杨贵妃的大姐。
虢国夫人是杨贵妃的三姐。
秦国夫人是杨贵妃的八姐。
白居易创作了长篇叙事诗《长恨歌》。
description.en: Bai Juyi authored the long narrative poem 'Song of Everlasting Regret'.

description.zh-cn: 白先勇是白崇禧的第五子。
第三期毕业
白崇禧在第一届国民大会上赞成罢免李宗仁副总统职，并在李宗仁旅美期间致电斥责，二人关系破裂。
担任国民革命军副总参谋长，指挥军队取得多次胜利。
在北伐战争中多次击溃孙传芳的部队。
在蒋桂战争、中原大战、两广事变中与蒋介石对立。在国共内战末期，电呈蒋介石主张“与共党谋和”，促其下野。
在北伐战争、抗日战争及国民政府迁台后，担任蒋中正下属职务。
指挥多场大战，如台儿庄战役、武汉会战、昆仑关战役等，并提出“以空间换时间”的持久战战略。
在会议上当场纠正柯远芬“宁可枉杀九十九个”的言论。
在赴台宣慰后的报告中严厉批评陈仪，并建议处分。
张轸率部起义，白崇禧部对其进行截击。
指挥桂系军队在此战役中对解放军进行反击并获胜。
蒋经国派人检查白崇禧的住所，显示其在台受到严密监控。
谷正文回忆曾策划在白崇禧的补药中动手脚，导致其死亡。
在1968年美国总统选举中击败汉弗莱。
description.en: Defeated Humphrey in the 1968 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在1972年美国总统选举中以压倒性优势击败麦戈文。
description.en: Defeated McGovern in a landslide in the 1972 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 作为美国总统对中华人民共和国进行历史性访问。
description.en: As President of the United States, made a historic visit to the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 与苏联等共产主义国家实施缓和政策，签订了SALT I和反弹道导弹条约。
description.en: Implemented the policy of détente with communist nations like the Soviet Union, signing the SALT I and Anti-Ballistic Missile treaties.

description.zh-cn: 访问莫斯科，与苏联领导人勃列日涅夫等人会面，展开激烈谈判。
description.en: Visited Moscow and met with Soviet leader Brezhnev and others for intense negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 水门事件的不断发酵导致尼克松失去政治支持，最终迫使他辞去总统职务。
description.en: The unfolding Watergate scandal caused Nixon to lose political support, ultimately forcing him to resign from the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松辞职后，福特总统宣布给予其全面、自由且绝对的赦免。
description.en: After Nixon's resignation, President Ford granted him a full, free, and absolute pardon.

description.zh-cn: 作为众议院非美活动委员会成员，以调查阿尔杰·希斯间谍案而引起全国性关注，并坚信希斯是苏联间谍。
description.en: As a member of the House Un-American Activities Committee, he gained national attention for investigating the Alger Hiss spy case, believing Hiss was a Soviet spy.

position.en: National Security Advisor, Secretary of State

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松政府中担任关键外交职务。
description.en: Held key foreign policy positions in the Nixon administration.

description.zh-cn: 越战是尼克松总统任期内的主要挑战，他推行“越南化”政策以逐步撤军，但战争和国内反战运动给其政府带来巨大压力。
description.en: The Vietnam War was a major challenge of Nixon's presidency; he pursued "Vietnamization" to withdraw troops, but the war and domestic anti-war movements placed immense pressure on his administration.

description.zh-cn: 招揽吕布，唆使其杀害旧主丁原，并收其为义子。
description.en: He recruited Lü Bu, instigated him to kill his former master Ding Yuan, and adopted him as his son.

description.zh-cn: 受董卓招揽和唆使，杀害了自己的旧主丁原。
description.en: Instigated and recruited by Dong Zhuo, he assassinated his former master Ding Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 董卓与吕布誓为父子，吕布为董卓养子。
与王允合谋，亲手刺杀了董卓。
description.en: Conspiring with Wang Yun, he personally assassinated Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 董卓死后，李傕与郭汜等董卓旧部联军攻入长安，击败吕布，迫使其逃离长安。
description.en: After Dong Zhuo's death, Li Jue, Guo Si, and other former subordinates of Dong Zhuo formed a coalition, attacked Chang'an, defeated Lü Bu, and forced him to flee Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 董卓死后，郭汜与李傕等董卓旧部联军击败吕布，迫使其逃离长安。
因袁术不满，改投张杨。
离开张杨后，转投袁绍并为其效力。
因吕布恃功自傲，袁绍假意送行，实则派人刺杀，但被吕布识破逃脱。
怂恿吕布部将郝萌起兵造反。
在郝萌反叛时，倒戈对抗郝萌并斩其一臂。
挑拨吕布与袁术的关系，导致吕布与袁术终断盟约。
成功与曹操联络，作为曹操的内应以讨伐吕布。
曹操于下邳之战中击败吕布，并将其缢杀。
description.en: Cao Cao defeated Lü Bu in the Battle of Xiapi and had him hanged.

description.zh-cn: 在白门楼劝说曹操处死吕布，称其为反复无常之人。
于下邳之战中与宋宪、魏续一同反叛，缚陈宫、高顺投降曹操。
于下邳之战中与侯成、魏续一同反叛，缚陈宫、高顺投降曹操。
于下邳之战中与侯成、宋宪一同反叛，缚陈宫、高顺投降曹操。
吕布麾下名将。
吕布被封为温侯。
吕布在东汉末年担任的官职。
李治是长孙皇后的第三子。
同母兄弟关系。
同母兄弟关系。
同母兄妹关系。
王皇后是唐高宗李治的元配皇后，后被废。
description.en: Empress Wang was the first wife of Emperor Gaozong Li Zhi, and was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 李治的妃嫔，后被废。
李显是李治的第七子。
唐睿宗李旦是唐高宗李治和武则天的幼子，亦是其第八子。
李弘是李治的第五子。
李贤是李治的第六子。
李忠是李治的长子。
李素节是李治的第四子。
王皇后于永徽六年十月被废，后被武则天处死。
萧淑妃于永徽六年十月被废，后被武则天处死。
王皇后为打击萧淑妃，将武则天纳入后宫。
贺兰氏后被武则天所杀。
武顺是武则天的姐姐。
李治在位初年励精图治，开创了永徽之治。

position.zh-cn: 知尚书及门下二省事、太尉同中书门下三品

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。

position.zh-cn: 中书令、吏部尚书同中书门下三品、尚书右仆射

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。

position.zh-cn: 中书侍郎参知政事、中书令、吏部尚书同中书门下三品、右相

description.zh-cn: 在唐高宗朝担任宰相。
发动昌都战役，向昌都进军。
description.en: Launched the Battle of Chamdo, advancing on Chamdo.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在昌都战役中击败藏军。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army defeated the Tibetan Army in the Battle of Chamdo.

description.zh-cn: 中情局西藏项目向藏人行政中央及相关武装活动提供资金支持，以对抗中国政府。
description.en: The CIA's Tibet program provided financial support to the Central Tibetan Administration and related armed activities to oppose the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，挪威诺贝尔委员会授予丹增嘉措诺贝尔和平奖，部分原因是为了对中国政府施加压力。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests, the Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to Tenzin Gyatso, partly to exert pressure on the Chinese government.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀是人民行动党的主要创始成员之一。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew was one of the main founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 吴作栋在李光耀担任总理期间任副总理，后接任总理。
description.en: Goh Chok Tong served as Deputy Prime Minister under Lee Kuan Yew before succeeding him as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀在吴作栋担任总理期间任国务资政。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew served as Senior Minister in the cabinet during Goh Chok Tong's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀带领新加坡政府，配合马来亚及英国殖民政府发起“冷藏行动”，拘捕了大量左翼人士。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew led the Singapore government, in cooperation with Malayan and British colonial authorities, to launch Operation Coldstore, arresting numerous left-wing figures.

description.zh-cn: 林清祥在冷藏行动中被逮捕关押。
description.en: Lim Chin Siong was arrested and detained during Operation Coldstore.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，行动党内以李光耀为首的“反共分子”与以林清祥为代表的“亲共分子”决裂。
description.en: In 1961, the anti-communist faction led by Lee Kuan Yew split with the pro-communist faction represented by Lim Chin Siong within the PAP.

description.zh-cn: 在新马合并后，李光耀与东姑阿都拉曼在多项政策上产生严重分歧，最终导致新加坡被逐出马来西亚。
description.en: After the merger of Singapore and Malaya, Lee Kuan Yew had serious disagreements with Tunku Abdul Rahman on multiple policies, leading to Singapore's expulsion from Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀对邓小平十分尊重，两人在1978年首次会面后建立了良好关系。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew held Deng Xiaoping in high regard, and the two established a good relationship after their first meeting in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀于1976年首次访华，会晤了毛泽东。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew met Mao Zedong during his first visit to China in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀与时任中华民国总统蒋经国私交甚笃，此深厚友谊是促成新加坡军队移至台湾训练的重要原因之一。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew had a very good personal relationship with then-President of the Republic of China, Chiang Ching-kuo. This close personal friendship was one of the key reasons for facilitating the training of Singaporean troops in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀与李登辉的交往从密切转向分歧，李光耀后来指责李登辉。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew's relationship with Lee Teng-hui shifted from close to divergent, with Lee Kuan Yew later criticizing him.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀政府推行以英语为第一语言的教育政策，最终导致以华文教学的南洋大学在1980年关闭。
description.en: The Lee Kuan Yew government's policy of promoting English as the first language led to the closure of the Chinese-medium Nanyang University in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀政府使用《内部安全法令》将谢太宝未经审判监禁与软禁长达32年。
description.en: The Lee Kuan Yew government used the Internal Security Act to imprison and place Chia Thye Poh under restriction for 32 years without trial.

description.zh-cn: 1996年，李光耀以诽谤罪起诉反对党领袖邓亮洪，迫使其潜逃出国。1997年大选后，李光耀与时任总理吴作栋等共11人再次一同控告邓亮洪诽谤。
description.en: In 1996, Lee Kuan Yew sued opposition leader Tang Liang Hong for defamation, forcing him to flee the country. After the 1997 general election, Lee Kuan Yew, along with then-Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong and 9 others, again sued Tang Liang Hong for defamation.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪在其文章中提到他经常与李光耀交锋，是政治上的对手。
description.en: In his writings, Mahathir mentioned that he often crossed swords with Lee Kuan Yew, indicating a political rivalry.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀促成了两岸历史性的辜汪会谈在新加坡举行。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew facilitated the historic Wang-Koo summit between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait to be held in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 王义川担任民进党政策委员会执行长期间，赖清德为党主席。
王义川担任台中市政府交通局局长期间，林佳龙为台中市市长。
在2019年台中市第五选举区立法委员缺额补选中击败王义川，使其未能当选。
宣布对王义川及其家属实施惩戒。
宣布对黄世聪及其家属实施惩戒。
宣布对于北辰及其家属实施惩戒。
宣布对刘宝杰及其家属实施惩戒。
宣布对李正皓及其家属实施惩戒。
因手机信令资料争议事件，在立法院质询时公开告发王义川。
二人在92年分手，96年复合，直至2009年结婚。
出道时曾拍拖，后因性格不合分手。
小四至小六就读。
参加业余唱片骑师大赛获亚军后加入。
赏识并邀请周慧敏参与电影演出，后推荐其到唱片公司试音。
鼓励周慧敏参加香港电台主办的业余唱片骑师大赛。
鼓励周慧敏参加香港电台主办的业余唱片骑师大赛。
加盟台湾福茂唱片，开拓国语市场。
为周慧敏的热播代表作《如果你知我苦衷》作曲。
与林隆璇合唱国语歌曲《流言》。
好友关系，古巨基曾担任其演唱会创作总监。
徐志摩在英国剑桥大学期间遇到林徽因，并产生爱慕之情。
徐志摩拜梁启超为师。
劝阻其与陆小曼的恋情，并在他们的婚礼上当众训斥。
徐志摩搭乘的飞机在济南附近坠毁，导致其罹难。
在胡佛总统任期内担任美国陆军参谋长。
description.en: Served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army during President Hoover's term.

description.zh-cn: 在罗斯福总统任期内担任美国陆军参谋长和二战指挥官。
description.en: Served as Chief of Staff of the United States Army and a commander in World War II during President Roosevelt's term.

description.zh-cn: 在韩战战略上与杜鲁门总统存在严重分歧，并公然反对其政策，最终导致被解职。
description.en: Had serious disagreements with President Truman over Korean War strategy, openly opposing his policies, which led to his dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 1903年以第一名的成绩毕业于西点军校。
description.en: Graduated first in his class from West Point in 1903.

description.zh-cn: 担任西点军校校长并推行了一系列改革。
description.en: Served as Superintendent of West Point and implemented a series of reforms.

description.zh-cn: 在胡佛总统命令下，指挥军队暴力驱逐了在华盛顿抗议的退伍军人。
description.en: Under President Hoover's orders, he commanded troops to forcibly disperse protesting veterans in Washington.

description.zh-cn: 不顾高层普遍反对，坚决策划并执行了仁川登陆，扭转了韩战局势。
description.en: Despite widespread opposition from high command, he planned and executed the Incheon Landing, turning the tide of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军入朝作战，在清川江战役和长津湖战役中击败了麦克阿瑟指挥的联合国军，迫使其大规模撤退。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army entered the Korean War and defeated the UN forces under MacArthur's command in the Battle of the Ch'ongch'on River and the Battle of Chosin Reservoir, forcing a major retreat.

description.zh-cn: 杜鲁门总统解除了麦克阿瑟在远东的所有职务，结束了他的军事生涯。
description.en: President Truman relieved MacArthur of all his commands in the Far East, ending his military career.

description.zh-cn: 作为驻日盟军总司令，主导了日本的战后民主化和非军事化改革。
description.en: As Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, he led the post-war democratization and demilitarization reforms of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 曾长期担任麦克阿瑟的副官；1935年，随麦克阿瑟来到菲律宾，担任菲律宾政府军事顾问。
description.en: Served as MacArthur's aide for an extended period; in 1935, he accompanied MacArthur to the Philippines to serve as a military advisor to the Philippine government.

description.zh-cn: 接任第8军团司令，在麦克阿瑟指挥下作战，后接替其联合国军总司令职务。
description.en: Took command of the Eighth Army, fighting under MacArthur's overall command, and later succeeded him as UN Commander.

description.zh-cn: 在一战期间，麦克阿瑟因越级抗议而得罪了远征军司令潘兴，由此结怨。
description.en: During World War I, MacArthur offended AEF Commander Pershing by protesting over his head, creating a lasting enmity.

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗极度宠信比他年长17岁的万贵妃，万贵妃去世后，宪宗因悲伤过度而病逝。
description.en: The Chenghua Emperor was extremely infatuated with Imperial Noble Consort Wan, who was 17 years his senior. After her death, the emperor fell ill from grief and died soon after.

description.zh-cn: 土木堡之变中明英宗被俘，导致朱见深被立为太子。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was captured in the Tumu Crisis, Zhu Jianshen was made the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 景泰三年（1452年），朱祁钰废黜了时为太子的朱见深（后来的明宪宗），将其废为沂王，并改立自己的儿子朱见济为太子。
description.en: In the third year of the Jingtai era (1452), Emperor Zhu Qiyu deposed the then Crown Prince Zhu Jianshen (later the Chenghua Emperor), demoting him to Prince of Yi, and appointed his own son, Zhu Jianji, as the new crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 成化二年，下诏为于谦平反昭雪，恢复其官职并赐祭。
description.en: Upon ascending the throne, he posthumously rehabilitated Yu Qian.

description.zh-cn: 任用李贤为内阁首辅等贤臣。
description.en: Appointed capable ministers like Li Xian, who served as Grand Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 设立西厂以加强特务统治。
description.en: Established the Western Depot to strengthen secret police rule.

description.zh-cn: 将汪直调离京城，并解散西厂。
description.en: Transferred Wang Zhi out of the capital and disbanded the Western Depot.

description.zh-cn: 在房县大石厂立黄旗起义，为郧阳民变的首领之一。
description.en: Raised a yellow banner and started an uprising at Dashi Factory in Fang County, becoming one of the leaders of the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 受明宪宗派遣，讨伐并平定了郧阳民变。
description.en: Dispatched by the Chenghua Emperor, he campaigned against and suppressed the Yunyang refugee rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 处处制约同治帝，使其一生未获实权。
辛酉政变后，载淳的年号由“祺祥”改为“同治”，其母慈禧太后与嫡母慈安太后开始垂帘听政。
同治帝在位期间，清朝剿灭了太平天国运动。
引导同治帝微服出宫寻花问柳，被野史及部分史学家认为是导致其早逝的元凶。
引导同治帝微服出宫寻花问柳。
据正史记载，同治帝死于天花。
据民间传说及部分野史记载，同治帝死于梅毒。
曹丕是曹操和武宣卞皇后的嫡长子。
曹丕是曹操和武宣卞皇后的嫡长子。
曹叡是曹丕与文昭甄皇后所生之子。
曹叡是曹丕与文昭甄皇后所生之子。
建安九年（204年），冀州邺城被曹操攻破，甄氏被曹丕所纳。
曹丕是曹昂的异母弟。
description.en: Cao Pi was Cao Ang's younger half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 同父母兄弟
同父母兄弟
同父母兄弟
异母兄弟
曹丕迫使汉献帝禅让，建立曹魏。
曹丕逼迫汉献帝禅位。

position.zh-cn: 五官中郎将、副丞相、魏王、丞相

description.zh-cn: 在篡汉前，曹丕是东汉的臣子。
与曹植争夺世子之位，曹丕即位后不仅对其实行政治迫害，甚至屡次欲杀害曹植。
description.en: Became rivals over the succession, Cao Pi repeatedly attempted to kill Cao Zhi after ascending the throne.

description.zh-cn: 因丁仪是曹植派系成员，在称帝后将其全族处刑。
因甄氏失意有怨言，曹丕大怒，于黄初二年（221年）六月遣使赐死甄氏。
孙权拒绝派儿子为人质并拒绝向曹魏称臣后，曹丕发动多次伐吴战争，双方走向敌对。
采纳陈群建议，实行九品中正制作为新的选官制度。
曹丕因年少时向曹洪借钱和借绢被拒而心怀怨恨。称帝后，罗织罪名将曹洪下狱并削爵为民。
description.en: Cao Pi held a grudge against Cao Hong for refusing to lend him money and silk in his youth. After becoming emperor, he fabricated charges to imprison Cao Hong and strip him of his title.

description.zh-cn: 因夏侯尚宠爱妾侍，曹丕下令处死其妾，导致夏侯尚精神衰弱至死。
因鲍勋多次忠谏，曹丕恼怒并找理由将其处死。
曹丕撰写了《典论》。
曹丕的重臣，并被任命为托孤大臣辅佐魏明帝曹叡。
曹丕的重臣。曹丕临终时，令司马懿为辅政大臣之一，并被任命为托孤大臣辅佐魏明帝曹叡。

position.zh-cn: 尚书、督军、御史中丞、侍中、尚书右仆射

description.zh-cn: 2024年6月27日被开除党籍。
魏凤和在李克强担任总理期间任国务委员兼国防部长。
魏凤和在习近平担任军委主席期间任中央军委委员、国务委员、国防部长。
提名魏凤和为国务委员和国防部部长。
决定给予魏凤和开除军籍处分，取消其火箭军上将军衔。
与刘备、关羽、张飞情同手足，恩若兄弟，并称“万人敌”。
刘备被击败后，关羽短暂归降曹操，为其效力后离开。
在白马之战中，于万军之中斩杀颜良。
赤壁之战后参与围攻江陵的曹仁，后于219年发起樊城之战攻击曹仁。
在樊城之战中，水淹七军并俘虏于禁。
因荆州归属问题产生矛盾，最终孙权派吕蒙袭取荆州，并由其部将捕杀关羽。
策划并执行了袭取荆州、击败关羽的计划。
在临沮捕杀了败走麦城的关羽。
关羽长子，与关羽一同被斩于临沮。
关羽次子。
蜀汉灭亡后，为报父仇，尽杀关氏一族。
关羽请求支援樊城时，刘封以“山郡初附，未可动摇”为由拒绝出兵。
关羽请求支援樊城时，孟达以“山郡初附，未可动摇”为由拒绝出兵。
以谦逊言辞麻痹关羽，使其放松对东吴的戒备，为吕蒙袭取荆州创造了条件。
因与关羽有嫌隙，在吕蒙袭取荆州时投降。
因与关羽有嫌隙，在吕蒙袭取荆州时投降。
在樊城之战中，徐晃率军增援并击败关羽。
关羽身在曹营时与张辽交好。
为解决荆州归属争端，鲁肃邀请关羽在益阳进行“单刀赴会”谈判。
description.en: To resolve the dispute over the ownership of Jing Province, Lu Su invited Guan Yu to a negotiation in Yiyang, known as the 'Meeting with a single broadsword'.

description.zh-cn: 关羽在此战中水淹七军，威震华夏，一度使曹操考虑迁都。
曹操拒绝了关羽娶杜夫人的请求，并自己纳其为妾，令关羽心生不安。
杜夫人为秦宜禄前妻。
自1977年起，金正日与被视为其第四任妻子的高容姬同居，直至其2004年逝世。她是金正哲、金正恩和金与正的母亲。
description.en: Starting in 1977, Kim Jong-il cohabited with Ko Yong-hui, considered his fourth wife, until her death in 2004. She was the mother of Kim Jong-chol, Kim Jong-un, and Kim Yo-jong.

description.zh-cn: 根据苏联方面的记录，金正日于1941年2月16日在苏联哈巴罗夫斯克附近的维亚茨科耶军营出生。此说法与朝鲜官方公布的不同，存在争议。
description.en: According to Soviet records, Kim Jong-il was born on February 16, 1941, in a military camp in Vyatskoye near Khabarovsk, Soviet Union. This claim is disputed and differs from the official North Korean account.

position.zh-cn: 总书记、中央政治局常务委员、中央军事委员会委员长
position.en: General Secretary, Member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau, Chairman of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1961年加入朝鲜劳动党，逐步晋升。他于1997年10月8日至2011年12月17日担任朝鲜劳动党总书记，最终掌握包括总书记在内的党内最高职务。
description.en: Kim Jong-il joined the Workers' Party of Korea in 1961 and was gradually promoted. He served as General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea from October 8, 1997, to December 17, 2011, eventually holding the highest party positions, including General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1990年至1993年任朝鲜国防委员会第一副委员长，并自1993年起担任委员长，直至2011年逝世。
description.en: Kim Jong-il served as First Vice Chairman of the National Defence Commission of North Korea from 1990 to 1993, and as Chairman from 1993 until his death in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1997年发动了“深化组事件”清洗运动。
description.en: Kim Jong-il initiated the 'Deepening Group Incident' purge in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 2000年7月，金正日与首次访问朝鲜的俄罗斯总统普京举行会谈，恢复了因苏联与韩国建交而中断的俄朝关系。
description.en: In July 2000, Kim Jong-il held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin during his first visit to North Korea, restoring Russia-North Korea relations that had been suspended after the Soviet Union established diplomatic ties with South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金正日曾多次应时任中共中央总书记、中国国家主席江泽民的邀请对中国进行非正式访问。
description.en: Kim Jong-il made several unofficial visits to China at the invitation of then-CPC General Secretary and Chinese President Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 金正日曾多次应时任中共中央总书记、中国国家主席胡锦涛的邀请对中国进行非正式访问。
description.en: Kim Jong-il made several unofficial visits to China at the invitation of then-CPC General Secretary and Chinese President Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 2002年9月，金正日与时任日本首相小泉纯一郎会晤，签署《日朝平壤宣言》，并首次承认绑架日本人问题且就此道歉。
description.en: In September 2002, Kim Jong-il met with then-Japanese Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi, signed the Japan-North Korea Pyongyang Declaration, and for the first time admitted to and apologized for the abduction of Japanese citizens.

description.zh-cn: 克林顿访问朝鲜协调释放美国记者事宜。
description.en: Clinton visited North Korea to coordinate the release of American journalists.

description.zh-cn: 在小布什任内，朝美关系陷入了僵局和对立。小布什总统曾公开批评金正日无心治国，不管老百姓死活。
description.en: During George W. Bush's presidency, US-North Korea relations reached a stalemate and were confrontational. President Bush also publicly criticized Kim Jong-il for neglecting his country and not caring about the welfare of his people.

description.zh-cn: 金正男因2001年持假护照访问日本而失宠，丧失继承可能性，后有传闻称其曾遭金正日、金正恩父子暗杀。
description.en: Kim Jong-nam fell out of favor after a 2001 incident involving a fake passport to visit Japan, losing the possibility of succession. It was later rumored he was targeted for assassination by Kim Jong-il and Kim Jong-un.

description.zh-cn: 根据脱北者说法，金正日策划或指挥了1983年旨在刺杀韩国总统全斗焕的仰光爆炸事件。
description.en: According to defectors, Kim Jong-il planned or directed the 1983 Rangoon bombing, which aimed to assassinate South Korean President Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 根据脱北者说法，金正日策划或指挥了1987年的大韩航空858号班机空难。
description.en: According to defectors, Kim Jong-il planned or directed the bombing of Korean Air Flight 858 in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 仰光爆炸事件是一次针对韩国总统全斗焕的未遂刺杀。
description.en: The Rangoon bombing was an unsuccessful assassination attempt against South Korean President Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 裕仁是大正天皇的长子。
description.en: Hirohito was the eldest son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇是明治天皇的第三子。
description.en: Emperor Taishō was the son of Emperor Meiji.

description.zh-cn: 乃木希典作为学习院院长，对裕仁进行了“质实刚健”的尚武教育。
description.en: As the director of Gakushūin, Nogi Maresuke educated Hirohito with a focus on martial spirit and robustness.

description.zh-cn: 在虎之门事件中试图行刺摄政的裕仁。
description.en: Attempted to assassinate Prince Regent Hirohito in the Toranomon Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在樱田门事件中试图行刺裕仁。
description.en: Attempted to assassinate Emperor Hirohito in the Sakuradamon Incident.

description.zh-cn: 容忍关东军的行动并授权了对锦州的空袭。
description.en: Tolerated the Kwantung Army's actions and authorized the bombing of Jinzhou.

description.zh-cn: 批准出兵中国的决议，并下令歼灭北京、天津的中国军队。
description.en: Approved the resolution to dispatch troops to China and ordered the annihilation of Chinese forces in Beijing and Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 作为上海派遣军司令，颁布了“杀掉全部俘获人员”的命令。
description.en: As commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, he issued an order to 'kill all captives'.

description.zh-cn: 因朝香宫鸠彦王攻克南京的“战绩”对其大加赞赏并予以褒奖。
description.en: Highly praised and rewarded Prince Asaka for his 'war achievements' in capturing Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 据称731部队是奉天皇敕令建立的。
description.en: Unit 731 was reportedly established by imperial decree from the Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 下令镇压二二六兵变，导致皇道派被肃清。
description.en: Ordered the suppression of the February 26 Incident, leading to the purge of the Kōdōha faction.

description.zh-cn: 镇压皇道派发动的二二六兵变，使统制派获胜并掌握军部实权。
description.en: The suppression of the Kōdōha-led February 26 Incident allowed the Tōseiha faction to win and control the military.

description.zh-cn: 在最高战争指导会议上做出接受波茨坦公告的决定，并发布终战诏书。
description.en: Made the decision to accept the Potsdam Declaration in the Supreme Council for the Direction of the War and issued the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War.

description.zh-cn: 新宪法规定天皇为国家与国民的象征，使其变为虚位元首。
description.en: The new constitution defined the Emperor as the symbol of the state and the unity of the people, making him a constitutional monarch.

description.zh-cn: 因松平永芳决定在靖国神社合祀甲级战犯，昭和天皇感到不悦并从此停止参拜。
description.en: Emperor Shōwa was displeased with Matsudaira Nagayoshi's decision to enshrine Class-A war criminals at Yasukuni Shrine and stopped visiting thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 和珅是乾隆帝时期的权臣，深受其宠信。
乾隆帝驾崩后，嘉庆帝迅速宣布和珅二十条大罪，下旨抄家并赐其自尽。
和珅是伍弥泰的外孙。
作为御史，钱沣向和珅发起了多次挑战。
作为大臣，刘墉向和珅发起了多次挑战。
和珅当权二十余年，公然勒索纳贿，排斥异己，致使吏治败坏。
和珅是英廉的女婿。
王沪宁成为时任复旦大学政治学教研室主任王邦佐培养的对象。
王沪宁是肖佳灵当时的博士指导导师。
接替王沪宁担任主任。
阮生辉是胡志明的父亲。
阮氏清是胡志明的姐姐。
据研究显示，胡志明于1920年代在广州与曾雪明结婚。
据研究指，1950年代农氏春成为胡志明的情妇。
据研究指，阮氏明开是胡志明的情妇之一。
1925年在广州创立越南青年革命同志会。
在香港整合成立越南共产党。
胡志明在香港被港英政府逮捕并关押于域多利监狱。
化名胡光，参加中国共产党，学习革命经验。
胡志明在广西被中国国民党的地方政府逮捕并监禁了13个月。
作为越南独立同盟会主席，领导了八月革命。
胡志明代表临时政府在河内巴亭广场发表了《独立宣言》。
description.en: Hồ Chí Minh delivered the Declaration of Independence on behalf of the provisional government at Ba Đình Square in Hanoi.

description.zh-cn: 作为北越领导人，领导了意图统一越南的越南战争。
在越南战争中，胡志明领导的北越与支持南越的美国为敌对关系。
在法越战争期间，胡志明领导的越南民主共和国与法国为敌对关系。
两人有着深厚的友谊。
两人有着深厚的友谊。
两人有着深厚的友谊。
两人有着深厚的友谊。
胡志明在1966年会见周恩来和邓小平。
胡志明在1966年会见周恩来和邓小平。
在胡志明的葬礼上，中苏双方代表团拒绝见面。
柯西金在参加完胡志明葬礼回国途中，路过北京，于首都国际机场与周恩来举行了秘密的短促会晤，此举使因珍宝岛事件而极度紧张的中苏关系稍有缓和。
description.en: After attending Ho Chi Minh's funeral, Kosygin made a stopover in Beijing and held a secret meeting with Zhou Enlai at the airport, slightly easing the extremely tense Sino-Soviet relations caused by the Zhenbao Island incident.

description.zh-cn: 胡志明思想是他所倡导的革命理论与思想体系。
曹嵩是宦官曹腾的养子。
description.en: Cao Song was the adopted son of the eunuch Cao Teng.

description.zh-cn: 曹操的父亲曹嵩是夏侯惇的叔父，二人为从父兄弟关系。
孙权与曹操是三国时期的主要竞争对手，双方在赤壁、合肥、濡须等地多次交战。
description.en: Sun Quan and Cao Cao were major rivals during the Three Kingdoms period, engaging in numerous battles at locations like Red Cliffs, Hefei, and Ruxu.

description.zh-cn: 曹操于己吾率先举义，是反董卓联盟的发起者之一。
曹操被任命为骑都尉，前往颍川郡镇压黄巾军。
诱降黄巾军三十余万后，选取其中精锐组建青州兵。
刘备与孙权组成联军，在赤壁之战中抗击曹操。
孙权与刘备组成联军，在赤壁之战中抗击曹操。
曹操在汉中之战中被刘备击败，无功而返，失去了对汉中的控制。
曹操统一了中国北方，为之后其子曹丕建立曹魏政权奠定了坚实的基础。
description.en: Cao Cao unified northern China, laying a solid foundation for his son Cao Pi to establish the state of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 张绣发动叛乱袭击曹操，导致曹昂阵亡。
陶谦攻打兖州东部泰山郡，其部下杀害了曹操的父亲曹嵩。
description.en: Tao Qian attacked the eastern part of Yanzhou's Taishan Commandery, and his subordinates killed Cao Cao's father Cao Song.

description.zh-cn: 在诸葛亮北伐期间，受其指挥作为疑军行动。
在长坂坡之战中，从曹操大军中救出刘禅母子，使其幸免于难。
description.en: Protected Liu Shan and his mother at the Battle of Changban, ensuring their survival.

description.zh-cn: 在长坂坡之战中，保护甘夫人脱险。
在汉中之战中，黄忠出击逾期未归，赵云率数十骑出营接应，并从曹操大军的包围中救出黄忠。
description.en: During the Battle of Hanzhong, when Huang Zhong did not return from a sortie on time, Zhao Yun led dozens of cavalry out of the camp to provide support and rescued Huang Zhong from the encirclement of Cao Cao's main army.

description.zh-cn: 在汉中之战中，张著作战受伤，赵云驰马返回营地接应并成功救出张著。
description.en: During the Battle of Hanzhong, Zhang Zhu was wounded in combat, and Zhao Yun rode back to the camp to reinforce and successfully rescue him.

description.zh-cn: 在博望坡生擒夏侯兰后，向刘备推荐其担任军正。
刘备平定益州后，劝说刘备将田宅房产归还百姓以安民心，并被采纳。
在汉中之战后，称赞赵云“子龙一身都是胆也”，提升了其军中威望。
奉诸葛亮之命，截江阻止孙夫人将刘禅带往东吴，成功夺回刘禅。
description.en: Following Zhuge Liang's order, intercepted Lady Sun and prevented her from taking Liu Shan to Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝了赵范将其寡嫂许配给自己的提议。
在博望坡之战中生擒时为敌将的夏侯兰。
率领常山郡义军反叛袁绍，投奔公孙瓒。
在箕谷作为疑军与曹真率领的魏国大军作战。
刘备与赵云感情深厚，曾同床眠卧。
向曹操请降，导致刘备仓促南逃，最终引发长坂坡之战。
柯美兰是柯文哲的妹妹。
description.en: Ko Mei-lan is Ko Wen-je's younger sister.

position.zh-cn: 外科部住院医师、外科加护病房主任、创伤医学部主任
position.en: Surgical Resident, Director of Surgical ICU, Director of Department of Traumatology

description.zh-cn: 曾任外科部住院医师、外科加护病房主任、创伤医学部主任。其中，器官移植小组负责人任职至2011年8月。于2023年2月1日提前退休。
description.en: Served as resident in the Department of Surgery, director of the surgical intensive care unit, and director of the Department of Traumatology. Additionally, served as head of the organ transplant team until August 2011. Retired early on February 1, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲于2019年8月6日创立台湾民众党，并担任首任党主席。
description.en: Ko Wen-je founded the Taiwan People's Party on August 6, 2019, and served as its first chairman.

description.zh-cn: 被指2024总统大选政治献金申报不实，涉及不当资金往来，遭检方调查并起诉。
description.en: Accused of false declarations and improper financial dealings in his 2024 presidential election political contributions, leading to investigation and prosecution.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城案与政治献金案对柯文哲展开调查、起诉并声请羁押。
description.en: Investigated, prosecuted, and requested the detention of Ko Wen-je in connection with the Core Pacific City and political donation cases.

description.zh-cn: 接替郝龙斌担任台北市市长。
description.en: Succeeded Hau Lung-pin as the Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 接替柯文哲担任台北市市长。
description.en: Succeeded Ko Wen-je as the Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年台北市长选举中，民进党决议不提名候选人，支持无党籍的柯文哲。
description.en: In the 2014 Taipei mayoral election, the DPP decided not to nominate its own candidate and instead supported the independent Ko Wen-je.

description.zh-cn: 在1994年至2000年间，他曾担任陈水扁竞选台北市长及总统时的医界后援会干部及召集人。后于2012年6月，柯文哲担任陈水扁民间医疗小组召集人，并发起连署，希望法务部能让陈水扁保外就医。
description.en: From 1994 to 2000, he served as a cadre and convener of the medical community support group for Chen Shui-bian's campaigns for Taipei Mayor and President. Later, starting in June 2012, Ko Wen-je also served as the convener of a civilian medical team for Chen Shui-bian, initiating a petition for his release on medical parole.

description.zh-cn: 因其负责的器官移植团队发生爱滋病患者器官移植失误，被监察院弹劾并受公惩会降级改叙处分。
description.en: Was impeached by the Control Yuan and received a demotion from the Public Functionary Disciplinary Sanction Commission due to an incident where his organ transplant team mistakenly used organs from an HIV-positive donor.

description.zh-cn: 在其著作《屠杀》中文版的记者会上，指控柯文哲在器官活摘事件担任中间人，并称其为骗子。
description.en: At a press conference for the Chinese edition of his book 'The Slaughter', accused Ko Wen-je of acting as a middleman in organ harvesting and called him a liar.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年中华民国总统选举中搭档参选正副总统。
description.en: Partnered as running mates for the 2024 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲与侯友宜在2024年总统选举中为竞争对手，此前双方就“蓝白合”进行谈判但最终破局。
description.en: Ko Wen-je and Hou Yu-ih were competitors in the 2024 presidential election, following the breakdown of negotiations for a KMT-TPP coalition.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲与赖清德在2024年总统选举中为竞争对手。
description.en: Ko Wen-je and Lai Ching-te were competitors in the 2024 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 为商讨2024总统大选“蓝白合”进行会谈，但最终破局。
description.en: Held talks to discuss a KMT-TPP coalition for the 2024 presidential election, which ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 向台北地检署告发柯文哲在京华城案中涉嫌图利。
description.en: Reported Ko Wen-je to the Taipei District Prosecutors Office for alleged influence-peddling in the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 虞姬是项羽的妻子。
项羽分封天下，自立为“西楚霸王”。
项梁是项羽的叔父，抚养项羽长大。
范增是项羽的主要谋士，被尊为“亚父”。
项羽因不信任范增，导致其离开。
项羽在巨鹿之战中大破章邯率领的秦军主力，迫使其投降。
章邯在巨鹿之战后率部投降项羽。
韩信曾在项羽帐下任执戟郎，因不受重用而离开。
韩信离开项羽后投奔刘邦，并被重用。
英布早期为项羽麾下将领。
英布后期叛楚归汉，成为项羽的敌人。
项羽设下鸿门宴，意图铲除刘邦。
在鸿门宴上，项庄奉范增之命借舞剑刺杀刘邦，即“项庄舞剑，意在沛公”。
在鸿门宴上，项伯起身保护刘邦，使其免于被项庄刺杀。
章邯在定陶之战中击败并杀死项梁。
文革期间，宋庆龄父母的坟墓被红卫兵毁坏，其本人也身心受到巨大伤害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the graves of Soong Ching-ling's parents were destroyed by Red Guards, and she herself suffered great physical and mental harm.

description.zh-cn: 因国家主席及副主席职务被废止，宋庆龄改任全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Due to the abolition of the positions of State Chairman and Vice Chairman, Soong Ching-ling was reassigned to be Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在宋庆龄临终前，王光美询问其是否愿意加入中国共产党，促成了她入党。
description.en: Shortly before Soong Ching-ling's death, Wang Guangmei asked if she was willing to join the CCP, which led to her admission.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦是刘太公的儿子。
description.en: Liu Bang is the son of Liu Taigong.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦是刘媪的儿子。
description.en: Liu Bang is the son of Liu Ao.

description.zh-cn: 元配
description.en: Principal wife

description.zh-cn: 戚夫人是刘如意的生母。
雍齿曾占据丰邑反叛刘邦，归降魏国。刘邦承认雍齿是其生平最痛恨的人，因雍齿曾多次羞辱他。
刘邦曾率部投奔项梁，成为其下属。
张良加入刘邦部队，成为其重要谋士，协助其建立汉朝。
刘邦在秦末民变中起兵反秦，为其后来的事业奠定了基础。
刘邦起兵反秦，并率先攻入关中，接受秦王子婴投降，灭亡秦朝。
在鸿门宴上，刘邦成功化解了项羽的杀机，得以保全性命。
白登之围后，刘邦采纳娄敬建议，开启了与匈奴的和亲政策。
白登之围的军事失利直接促使汉朝对匈奴采取和亲政策。
刘邦进入关中后，为了安抚民心，宣布废除秦朝苛法，约法三章。
为巩固刘氏江山，刘邦与群臣杀白马为盟，立下“非刘氏而王者，天下共击之”的誓言。
晚年宠爱戚夫人，多次想废黜太子刘盈，改立其子刘如意为太子。
刘邦死后，吕雉将戚夫人囚禁，后砍断其手脚，挖去眼睛，熏聋耳朵，灌了哑药，扔到厕所之中，称其为“人彘”。
description.en: After Liu Bang's death, Empress Lü imprisoned Consort Qi, later had her limbs cut off, eyes gouged out, ears deafened, forced her to drink a mute potion, and threw her into a latrine, calling her the 'human swine'.

description.zh-cn: 临终前因担心樊哙帮助吕氏作乱，下令陈平、周勃将其斩杀，后因刘邦驾崩而未执行。
叶卡捷琳娜·格拉泽是约瑟夫·斯大林的母亲。
斯大林在列宁去世后与托洛茨基展开权力斗争，最终将托洛茨基驱逐并派人将其暗杀。
description.en: After Lenin's death, Stalin engaged in a power struggle with Trotsky, eventually exiling and assassinating him.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在与托洛茨基的斗争中曾与加米涅夫结盟，后将其作为“新反对派”清除。
description.en: Stalin allied with Kamenev against Trotsky, but later eliminated him as part of the 'New Opposition'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在与托洛茨基的斗争中曾与季诺维也夫结盟，后将其作为“新反对派”清除。
description.en: Stalin allied with Zinoviev against Trotsky, but later eliminated him as part of the 'New Opposition'.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林在清除“左派”后，将支持新经济政策的布哈林作为右倾投降主义集团清除。
description.en: After eliminating the 'Left Opposition', Stalin purged Bukharin, who supported the NEP, as a 'Right Deviation'.

description.zh-cn: 列宁在遗嘱中批评斯大林太粗暴并滥用职权，建议将其从总书记职位上调离。
description.en: In his testament, Lenin criticized Stalin for being too rude and abusing his power, recommending his removal from the post of General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林强制推行农业集体化政策以解决粮食短缺问题并消灭富农阶级。
description.en: Stalin forced the policy of agricultural collectivization to solve grain shortages and eliminate the kulak class.

description.zh-cn: 强制集体化和过高的粮食征购导致了大规模饥荒。
description.en: Forced collectivization and excessive grain procurement led to a massive famine.

description.zh-cn: 以基洛夫被刺杀为契机，斯大林发动了对党、政、军的大规模清洗。
description.en: Using the assassination of Kirov as a pretext, Stalin launched a large-scale purge of the party, government, and military.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基及其支持者是斯大林大清洗的主要目标之一。
description.en: Trotsky and his supporters were one of the main targets of Stalin's Great Purge.

description.zh-cn: 签订《苏德互不侵犯条约》，形成暂时性合作关系。
description.en: Signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, forming a temporary cooperative relationship.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国入侵苏联后，双方成为战争中的主要对手。
description.en: After Nazi Germany invaded the Soviet Union, the two became major adversaries in the war.

description.zh-cn: 该条约使德国得以入侵波兰而无后顾之忧，从而引发了第二次世界大战。
description.en: The pact allowed Germany to invade Poland without fear of a two-front war, triggering World War II.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，斯大林在东欧扶植社会主义阵营，形成了东方集团。
description.en: After WWII, Stalin fostered a socialist bloc in Eastern Europe, forming the Eastern Bloc.

description.zh-cn: 作为东方集团的领导人，斯大林与西方国家展开对峙，形成冷战格局。
description.en: As the leader of the Eastern Bloc, Stalin engaged in a standoff with Western countries, leading to the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 该条约正式确立了中苏之间的同盟关系。
description.en: This treaty formally established the alliance between China and the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 该条约正式确立了中苏之间的同盟关系。
description.en: This treaty formally established the alliance between China and the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上发表秘密报告，全面批判斯大林，掀起去斯大林化运动。
description.en: Khrushchev delivered a secret speech at the 20th Congress of the CPSU, criticizing Stalin and launching the de-Stalinization campaign.

description.zh-cn: 这份报告是去斯大林化运动的开端。
description.en: This speech marked the beginning of the de-Stalinization campaign.

description.zh-cn: 该运动旨在清除斯大林的个人崇拜和政治影响。
description.en: The campaign aimed to dismantle Stalin's cult of personality and political influence.

description.zh-cn: 被怀疑在斯大林中风后故意延误治疗，甚至下毒谋杀斯大林。
description.en: Suspected of intentionally delaying medical treatment or even poisoning Stalin after his stroke.

description.zh-cn: 以其谋略辅佐朱元璋开创明朝。

position.zh-cn: 高安县丞、江浙儒学副提举

description.zh-cn: 刘基考中元朝进士后曾担任数个官职，后皆弃官。
刘基是南宋抗金将领刘光世的后人。
因刘基不顾李善长求情而处死李彬，二人开始不和。
胡惟庸对与刘基的旧怨怀恨在心，后在刘基病重时派医生医治，刘基服药后病情加重，疑似被其毒害。
据《明史》记载，朱元璋派胡惟庸带医生探视生病的刘基（刘伯温），胡惟庸趁机下毒。刘基服药后病情加重，终至死亡。
description.en: According to the History of Ming, the Hongwu Emperor (Zhu Yuanzhang) sent Hu Weiyong with a doctor to visit the ailing Liu Ji (Liu Bowen). Hu Weiyong took the opportunity to poison him. After taking the medicine, Liu Ji's condition worsened, eventually leading to his death.

description.zh-cn: 刘基主张诛杀作乱的方国珍，方国珍因此畏惧并贿赂京中权贵以求自保。
在归隐青田期间著《郁离子》一书以明志。
在鄱阳湖之战中，刘基向朱元璋献计，最终击败陈友谅。
刘基认为韩林儿出身牧童，不应尊奉，并向朱元璋陈述天命所在。
杨宪平日待刘基很好。
刘基反对朱元璋任命杨宪为丞相，认为其“有相才无相器”。
刘基反对朱元璋任命汪广洋为丞相，认为其气量比杨宪更狭窄。
刘基反对朱元璋任命胡惟庸为丞相，比喻他可能会“偾辕”（弄翻车）。
刘璟当面称明成祖为“殿下”，并直言其“逃不得一‘篡’字”，后被捕入狱并自缢身亡。
刘光世是南宋的抗金将领。
与宋濂并称为“明初诗文三大家”。朱元璋攻下浙东后，同时听闻刘基和宋濂等人的名声并进行招聘。
丰臣秀吉最初以仆人身份侍奉织田信长，后因才干而发迹。
织田信长于本能寺之变中殒命。
明智光秀发动本能寺之变，背叛织田信长。
在本能寺之变后，丰臣秀吉于山崎之战中击败叛臣明智光秀。
为给织田信长报仇，率军与明智军展开决战。
在清洲会议后成为政治对手，并于贱岳之战中击败柴田胜家。
织田信孝与柴田胜家结盟对抗秀吉，失败后被迫自杀。
在小牧长久手之战中与德川家康对立。
德川家康最终臣服于丰臣秀吉。
为实现称霸亚洲的野心，发动了对朝鲜的侵略战争。
命令茶人千利休切腹自尽。
实行刀狩令以加强兵农分离政策。
实行太阁检地以确立税制。
高台院是丰臣秀吉的正室。
淀殿是丰臣秀吉的侧室。
养子关系
description.en: Adopted son

description.zh-cn: 近卫前久认丰臣秀吉为犹子（养子）。
description.en: Adopted son

description.zh-cn: 曾任第6届及第11届立法委员。
在民进党党内立法委员初选中击败时任立委何志伟，获得提名并最终当选。
王世坚是张荣宗的外孙。
因《自立晚报》转让问题发生争议，互相指控欺骗。
带领群众抗议连战进行和平之旅，引发冲突。
指控许博允为倒扁运动的“密使”，后被许博允控告诽谤并败诉。
在百万人民倒扁运动期间多次批评施明德，并因指控其收受豪宅而被判诽谤。
抗议马英九特别费案一审无罪判决。
公开表达支持并到场声援占领立法院的学生。
在太阳花学运期间与张安乐率领之群众对峙。
在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，以“柯黑”著称，频繁在市议会质询并批评柯文哲。
批评姚文智“失格、没品兼缺德”，后被姚文智控告并败诉。
在姚文智辞去立委参选市长后，明确表态民进党应自提人选参加补选，拒绝与柯文哲合作。
在政论节目上因武汉包机返台事件发生激烈言语冲突。
在市议会质询时赠送蒋中正肖像等礼物，以表达政治立场和进行监督。
在台北市议会就北农菜价问题与时任总经理的韩国瑜爆发激烈辩论。
多次以打赌方式（如高空弹跳、跳海）表达对蔡英文选举的支持或庆祝其当选。
张玮津承认曾配合王世坚伪造录音以掩盖绯闻，后又翻供，引发争议。
指控陈由豪赠与施明德豪宅。
指控洪智坤收受远雄企业团不当价金，后被洪智坤控告诽谤并败诉。
指控远雄企业团给予洪智坤不当价金。
在立法院就李敖神州文化之旅等议题发生激烈言语冲突。
因其政治立场而怒批张玮珊“为敌国助威”、应该被“斩立决”。
明穆宗是明世宗朱厚熜的第三子。
description.en: The Muzong Emperor was the third son of the Jiajing Emperor, Zhu Houcong.

description.zh-cn: 朱载𡓝为明穆宗之兄。
朱载圳为明穆宗之弟。
景王朱载圳图谋夺取储君之位，与时为裕王的明穆宗形成对立关系。
孝懿庄皇后李氏为明穆宗作为裕王时的元配王妃。
孝安皇后陈氏为明穆宗的继妃，后册为皇后。
孝定皇太后李氏为明穆宗的皇贵妃，明神宗的生母。
重用徐阶为内阁首辅。
采纳张居正的建议，并于临终前托以为顾命大臣。
临终前托以为顾命大臣。
即位后推行一系列新政，纠正其父弊政。
宣布废除海禁，实行隆庆开关。
采纳建议与蒙古俺答议和，促成俺答封贡。
致力于解决困扰朝局多年的“北虏南倭”问题。
亚历山大·乌里扬诺夫加入了计划暗杀沙皇亚历山大三世的革命组织。
description.en: Aleksandr Ulyanov joined a revolutionary group that planned to assassinate Tsar Alexander III.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大·乌里扬诺夫因参与刺杀沙皇的阴谋而被绞刑处死。
description.en: Aleksandr Ulyanov was executed by hanging for his role in the assassination plot against the Tsar.

description.zh-cn: 列宁的思想体系根基于马克思主义。
description.en: Lenin's ideological system is rooted in Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 在1903年俄国社会民主工党第二次代表大会上，列宁领导的派系成为布尔什维克。
description.en: At the Second Congress of the RSDLP in 1903, Lenin's faction emerged as the Bolsheviks.

description.zh-cn: 在俄国社会民主工党第二次代表大会上，党分裂为布尔什维克和孟什维克两个敌对派系。
description.en: The party split into two rival factions, the Bolsheviks and Mensheviks, at the Second Congress of the RSDLP.

description.zh-cn: 二月革命推翻了沙皇并建立了俄国临时政府。
description.en: The February Revolution overthrew the Tsar and established the Russian Provisional Government.

description.zh-cn: 列宁返回俄罗斯后，领导发动了十月革命。
description.en: After returning to Russia, Lenin led the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 社会革命党成员范妮·卡普兰试图刺杀列宁，致其重伤。
description.en: Socialist Revolutionary Party member Fanny Kaplan attempted to assassinate Lenin, severely wounding him.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·列宁领导成立了共产国际，并规划召开了第一次代表大会，以推动世界革命。
description.en: Vladimir Lenin led the founding of the Communist International, planning and convening its First Congress to promote world revolution.

description.zh-cn: 列宁向中央政治局提出新经济政策，以恢复内战后凋敝的经济。
description.en: Lenin proposed the New Economic Policy to the Politburo to revive the economy after the Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 列宁是苏联的主要缔造者，并在其成立后成为首位政府主席。
description.en: Lenin was the main founder of the Soviet Union and became its first head of government upon its creation.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基被任命组建和领导工农红军。
description.en: Trotsky was appointed to organize and lead the Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 封从德与柴玲于1988年结婚，1990年离婚。
description.en: Feng Congde and Chai Ling were married in 1988 and divorced in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 作为激进学生领袖，号召学生发起绝食，激化了矛盾。
学运被镇压后，柴玲受到中国政府通缉并流亡海外。
将柴玲列入21名被通缉的学生领袖名单。
与丈夫罗伯特·马金共同创办。
该纪录片通过选择性剪辑柴玲的采访，对其公众形象造成了严重的负面影响和争议。
柴玲以损害名誉和商标侵权为由，起诉了由韩倞制作的纪录片《天安门》。
联名发表公开信并亲自撰文《为柴玲辩护》以声援柴玲，反驳《天安门》纪录片对她的负面描述。
通过成立“女童之声”组织，反对中国残酷的一孩政策。
因被柴玲开除职务而对其提起侵犯人权与宗教自由的诉讼。
柴玲于2014年发布公开信，指控远志明在1990年强暴了自己。
作为中共强硬派代表，李鹏在六四天安门事件中采取强硬立场，支持并推动了对学生示威活动的武力清场。
description.en: As a representative of the CCP's hardliners, Li Peng adopted a hardline stance during the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, supporting and promoting the military crackdown on student demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 柴玲代表的激进学生被指阻挠和破坏了赵紫阳为代表的改革派化解矛盾的努力。
六四事件后，江泽民取代赵紫阳，被中共元老选为新任中共中央总书记。
习仲勋被视为邓小平主政时期的中共八大元老之一。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun was considered one of the Eight Great Eminent Officials of the CPC during Deng Xiaoping's leadership.

description.zh-cn: 丘吉尔学院是剑桥大学的学院之一。
网传傅晓田在《锵锵三人行》节目中痛斥窦文涛，导致其未再被节目组邀请。
网传傅晓田在《锵锵三人行》节目中痛斥马家辉，导致其未再被节目组邀请。
作为《风云对话》节目主持人进行采访。
作为《风云对话》节目主持人进行采访。

description.zh-cn: 韩国在建国后不久便与中华民国政府建立外交关系。
description.en: South Korea established diplomatic relations with the government of the Republic of China shortly after its founding.

description.zh-cn: 执政时期，韩国和中华人民共和国处在互不承认的敌对状态，并在朝鲜战争中直接对抗。
description.en: During his rule, South Korea and the People's Republic of China were in a state of mutual non-recognition and hostility, directly confronting each other in the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚政府划定“李承晚线”，在独岛等问题上与日本关系紧张，直至其下台也未能建交。
description.en: The Syngman Rhee government established the "Syngman Rhee Line," leading to tense relations with Japan over issues like the Liancourt Rocks (Dokdo/Takeshima), and diplomatic relations were not established before he was overthrown.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚流亡后，张勉政府拒绝他回国。
description.en: After Syngman Rhee went into exile, the Chang Myon government refused to allow him to return to the country.

description.zh-cn: 李承晚流亡后，朴正熙军政府拒绝他回国。
description.en: After Syngman Rhee went into exile, the Park Chung-hee military government refused to allow him to return to the country.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争爆发后，李承晚将军队作战指挥权交给以美国为首的联合国军总司令。
description.en: After the Korean War broke out, Syngman Rhee handed over the operational command of his army to the commander of the UN forces, which were led by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 二战结束后，李承晚乘坐美国专机返回韩国，并在美国支持下建立政府。
description.en: After World War II, Syngman Rhee returned to Korea on a US plane and established his government with American support.

description.zh-cn: 在长春围城战役中，东北人民解放军作为进攻方与防守方中华民国国军对立。
description.en: During the Siege of Changchun, the Northeast People's Liberation Army (attacker) was in conflict with the Republic of China Armed Forces (defender).

description.zh-cn: 萧劲光是长春围城的前线指挥官，服从于东北人民解放军总司令林彪的指挥。
description.en: Xiao Jinguang was the frontline commander of the siege, subordinate to Lin Biao, the commander of the Northeast People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 郑洞国任东北剿匪总司令部副总司令，总司令为卫立煌。
description.en: Zheng Dongguo served as Deputy Commander of the Northeast Bandit Suppression Headquarters, under Commander-in-Chief Wei Lihuang.

description.zh-cn: 卫立煌由蒋介石任命为东北剿匪总司令部总司令。
description.en: Wei Lihuang was appointed by Chiang Kai-shek as the Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Bandit Suppression Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 锦州被解放军攻占后，东北国军陆路退路被切断，战场形势剧变，促使曾泽生下决心率部起义。
description.en: After the PLA captured Jinzhou, the KMT's land retreat route was cut off, drastically changing the battlefield situation and prompting Zeng Zesheng to defect with his troops.

description.zh-cn: 因文化大革命，大学期间基本上没有人上课了。
因军队裁减，任正非决定转业，结束了11年的部队生活。
离开华为创立港湾网络公司，与华为形成竞争关系，并从华为挖人。
因与任平、郑宝用的矛盾，李一男被调离中央研究部。
原国家级副职领导人。
在文化大革命期间受到冲击。蔡畅称，若李富春能看到“四人帮”被打倒会非常高兴。
在文化大革命期间受到冲击。
文革期间受到冲击。
蔡畅参加了长征，是长征中年龄最大的女红军。
明光宗朱常洛与朱常洵是同父异母的兄弟。
因明神宗称朱常洛为“都人子”而大怒，斥责皇帝“你也是宫人所生”，此事促使朱常洛最终被立为太子。
description.en: She became furious when the Wanli Emperor referred to Zhu Changluo as 'son of a palace maid.' She then rebuked the emperor, reminding him, 'you were also born of a palace maid.' This incident contributed to Zhu Changluo's eventual installation as crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 因其子朱常洵深得明神宗宠爱，郑贵妃时刻想为朱常洵争夺储君之位，与太子朱常洛对立。
国本之争的核心是明神宗意图废长立幼，使得朱常洛的太子地位长期不稳固。
郑贵妃手下的宦官指使刺客发动了梃击案，企图刺杀朱常洛。
在梃击案中，刺客持木梃闯入太子朱常洛所居的慈庆宫，意图行刺。
在明光宗纵欲过度后，向其进献春药，加剧了其病情。
向明光宗进献“红丸”，明光宗服用后于次日暴毙。
明光宗因服用李可灼的“红丸”而暴毙，此事件被称为红丸案。
明熹宗朱由校是明光宗的长子。
明熹宗朱由校的生母是才人王氏（孝和王太后）。
崇祯帝朱由检是明光宗朱常洛的第五子。
description.en: The Chongzhen Emperor, Zhu Youjian, was the fifth son of the Taichang Emperor, Zhu Changluo.

description.zh-cn: 明思宗朱由检（崇祯帝）的生母是淑女刘氏，追谥孝纯皇太后。
description.en: Ming Sizong Zhu Youjian (the Chongzhen Emperor)'s biological mother was Lady Liu, posthumously honored as Empress Dowager Xiaochun.

description.zh-cn: 万历二十九年（1601年）十月被册立为皇太子。
明光宗在位时间仅一月。
即位后，下令由内帑调拨银两发给辽东经略熊廷弼以犒赏边防将士。
将明光宗安葬于明庆陵。
祖孙关系
建安中期，袁绍为次子袁熙娶甄氏为妻。
受曹丕遗诏辅佐曹叡。
受曹丕遗诏辅佐曹叡，后在魏明帝（曹叡）朝中担任重要将领，并负责抵抗蜀汉北伐。曹叡临终时，托孤于司马懿和曹爽。
受曹丕遗诏辅佐曹叡。
受曹丕遗诏辅佐曹叡。
曹叡在位期间指挥军队成功防御了孙权的多次攻伐。
曹叡在位期间指挥军队成功防御了诸葛亮的五次北伐。
下令司马懿讨伐在辽东叛乱的公孙渊。
司马懿率军征讨辽东，攻破襄平，诛杀公孙渊及其党羽。
与陈群等人一同制定《魏律》。
与魏明帝曹叡一同制定《魏律》。
临终前托孤，任命曹爽为大将军，与司马懿共同辅佐曹芳。
临终前托孤，任命司马懿与曹爽共同辅佐曹芳。
司马懿发动高平陵之变，旨在铲除曹爽势力，夺取了曹魏的政权。此举亦是其在曹魏地位上升，权力不断积累的最终体现。
description.en: Sima Yi launched the Incident at Gaoping Tombs to eliminate Cao Shuang's faction and seize control of Cao Wei. This event was a culmination of his rising status and accumulating power within Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 曹爽及其党羽在政变中被司马懿诛杀。
两人在共同辅政期间权力斗争激烈，最终司马懿通过高平陵之变消灭了曹爽。
养子。235年被曹叡立为齐王，239年继位。
曹叡为平原王时，与卫臻私交甚好。
同胞兄弟
同胞兄弟
异母兄弟
因崔氏衣着过于华美而将其赐死。
description.en: Ordered her death because her clothing was too extravagant.

description.zh-cn: 丁廙等人在曹操面前夸奖曹植，拥护其为太子。
文本记载曹植与邢颙交恶。
曹植原被任命支援曹仁，但因酗酒无法履行使命，使曹操失望，最终与太子之位失之交臂。
曹丕称帝后，曹植被监国谒者灌均监视。
奉曹丕之命监视曹植。
因朝臣警告，终明帝一朝，曹植未得重用。
导致魏明帝倚重司马懿以拒蜀汉北伐军的挑战。
李正皓是草协联盟发起人。
国民党中常会以“以不实言论造谣污蔑国民党提名总统及立委参选同志”为由开除李正皓党籍。
鼎力支持李正皓参选立法委员。
鼎力支持李正皓参选立法委员。
与民主进步党合作，加入“民主大联盟”参选立法委员。
与卓冠廷共同发起“抢救王义川大兵”行动。
与李正皓共同发起“抢救王义川大兵”行动。
该行动的目标是让民进党的政党票增加，最终使王义川当选立法委员。
政治上的紧密盟友，有多次协同政治行动。
在傅崐萁卸任、徐榛蔚上任前代理县长职务。
反对中央的前瞻基础建设计划。
支持前瞻计划应增加对花莲交通的预算。
在立法院就理想大地弊案及荣亮公司土地交易问题对徐榛蔚提出质疑。
在议会质询时，指控徐榛蔚及其家族企业涉嫌洗钱。
在傅崐萁担任县长期间，花莲县政府的官方出版物及活动多次为时任“县长夫人”的徐榛蔚进行宣传，被外界质疑公器私用为其选举铺路。
作为2022年县长选举的竞争对手，指控徐榛蔚在参加丰年祭时迟到并要求自己离场。
在地震慰问金发放现场，时任立委的徐榛蔚与县长傅崐萁一同发放，引发公器私用、为选举造势的批评。
妻子的四叔
因军人组阁、体制外军事会议、人事任命等问题与时任总统李登辉产生权力斗争，后因理念不合退党参选。在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》中，其角色原型“楚长青”被描述为与黎清波（原型李登辉）掌权后的中国国家党背道而驰，反映了此段真实历史事件。
description.en: Engaged in a power struggle with then-President Lee Teng-hui over issues such as military cabinet appointments, extra-constitutional military meetings, and personnel decisions, eventually leaving the party to run for office due to ideological differences. This historical conflict is also depicted in the TV series 'Island Nation 2', where his prototype character 'Chu Chang-qing' is portrayed as being at odds with the KMT under the leadership of 'Li Qing-bo' (prototype Lee Teng-hui).

description.zh-cn: 李登辉任命郝柏村为行政院长，目的之一是瓦解“李焕与郝柏村的结盟”。
郑南榕生前常以政论文字抨击“军头郝柏村”强人干政。
搭档参选1996年中华民国总统选举。
坚定反对“台独”，曾表示“在任何情况下我都不接受台独，这是我的良心。”
被认为在其行政院长任内推动促成了全民健保的实施。
在行政院院会中指示，六轻是政府核定的重大经建计划，一定要建。
指责太阳花学运是“政变”、“暴动”。
在立法院质询郝柏村召开“体制外军事会议”，侵犯总统统帅权。
发起“反军人干政大游行”，反对郝柏村出任行政院长。
支持林洋港与郝柏村搭档参选1996年总统选举。
代表山地原住民选举区
加入该党团运作
积极主张要求日本政府将台湾原住民阵亡祖灵迁出靖国神社，并多次前往抗议。
向日本法院提出控告小泉纯一郎首相参拜靖国神社违宪。
接见高金素梅，称赞其为台湾原住民进行的斗争。
以“反靖国神社代表”之身分参加活动。
白韵琹为白先勇的堂姑。
白先勇的家系先祖可追溯自元朝进士伯笃鲁丁。
肄业于水利及海洋工程学系。
与同学欧阳子、陈若曦、王文兴、李欧梵、刘绍铭等人共同创办。
共同创办《现代文学》杂志。
共同创办《现代文学》杂志。
共同创办《现代文学》杂志。
共同创办《现代文学》杂志。
白先勇自认影响他一生最重要的小说。
高度评价白先勇，称其为“当代中国短篇小说家中的奇才”。
少年时随国府迁台，其著作亦带有不少国府迁台前后的时代色彩。
颁赠二等景星勋章以表彰其贡献。
对其推广、保存及传承不遗余力，制作了《青春版牡丹亭》等作品。
幼年时观看梅兰芳的昆曲演出，自此触发了对昆曲的热爱。
发表文章并撰写多部传记，为父亲白崇禧立传。
双打搭档，被称为“海峡组合”，曾共同赢得温网和法网女双冠军。
description.en: Doubles partner, known as the 'Cross-Strait Combination', won Wimbledon and French Open women's doubles titles together.

description.zh-cn: 因训练计划、参赛奖金等问题产生矛盾。
description.en: Had conflicts over issues such as training plans and prize money.

description.zh-cn: 彭帅称与张高丽曾维持长达10多年的婚外情和不伦恋关系。
description.en: Peng Shuai claimed to have had an extramarital affair and an intermittent relationship with Zhang Gaoli for over 10 years.

description.zh-cn: 彭帅的指控被视为中国#MeToo运动的一部分，并且是首次触及最高层级的政治人物。
description.en: Peng Shuai's allegation is considered part of the #MeToo movement in China and the first to involve a top-level political figure.

description.zh-cn: 代表中国队参加2016年夏季奥林匹克运动会。
description.en: Represented China at the 2016 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 2016年夏季奥林匹克运动会女子双打搭档。
description.en: Women's doubles partner at the 2016 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 李弘是其同母兄长。
太平公主是其同母妹妹。
刘皇后是唐睿宗的结发之妻，正室。
窦德妃是唐睿宗的妾室。
李宪是唐睿宗的长子。
作为傀儡皇帝，政事决于太后武则天。
禅让帝位予母亲武则天。
迫少帝李重茂逊位。
再度禅让于李隆基。
禅位后自称“太上皇”，但仍实掌朝廷大权。
太平公主在先天政变中图谋废黜玄宗失败，被赐死家中。
description.en: Princess Taiping's plot to depose Xuanzong failed during the Xiantian Coup, and she was forced to commit suicide at home.

description.zh-cn: 为巩固皇权，唐玄宗发动先天政变，彻底清除了太平公主的势力。
description.en: To consolidate his imperial power, Emperor Xuanzong launched the Xiantian Coup, completely eliminating the influence of Princess Taiping.

description.zh-cn: 使睿宗不得不彻底放权。
生于长安蓬莱宫含凉殿。
塔克世为觉昌安第四子。
description.en: Taksi was the fourth son of Giocangga.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤的祖父觉昌安在攻打古勒城时，于涉及明军的混战中被杀害。此事件成为努尔哈赤反明的原因之一。
description.en: Nurhaci's grandfather, Giocangga, was killed during a melee involving Ming forces while attacking Gule City. This event became one of Nurhaci's reasons for rebelling against the Ming.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤少年时曾被辽东总兵李成梁收养，成为其麾下侍从。
李成梁在杀死努尔哈赤之父后对其进行补偿，并在晚年采取姑息纵容政策，对其“保奏给官”、“弃地以饵之”，同时打击其他女真、蒙古势力。这些客观上为努尔哈赤的崛起创造了条件，助长了建州女真势力的壮大。
description.en: After killing Nurhaci's father, Li Chengliang compensated him and later adopted a policy of appeasement, recommending him for official positions and ceding territory to him. Concurrently, he suppressed other Jurchen and Mongolian forces. These actions objectively created conditions for Nurhaci's rise and fostered the growth of the Jianzhou Jurchen power.

description.zh-cn: 舒尔哈齐是努尔哈赤的同母弟。
description.en: Šurhaci was a full brother of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 因权力斗争，努尔哈赤将舒尔哈齐圈禁，两年后舒尔哈齐死于禁所。
因权力斗争，努尔哈赤将长子褚英囚禁，后将其处死。
努尔哈赤视尼堪外兰为杀父祖的仇人之一，在起兵后将其追杀。
努尔哈赤发布“七大恨”作为伐明的檄文，标志着与明朝公开决裂。
努尔哈赤在宁远之战中被袁崇焕击败，这是他军事生涯中唯一一次攻城失败。他可能因此役受伤，并于数月后去世。
description.en: Nurhaci was defeated by Yuan Chonghuan in the Battle of Ningyuan, his only known failure in a siege during his military career. He was possibly wounded in this battle and died a few months later.

description.zh-cn: 袁崇焕在宁远之战中指挥明军击败了努尔哈赤的进攻。
努尔哈赤创建了八旗制度。该制度整合了女真部民，成为其政权的军事和社会基础，也是一个强大的军政组织。
description.en: Nurhaci established the Eight Banners system. This system integrated the Jurchen people, serving as the military and social foundation of his regime and forming a powerful military-political organization.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤下令学者额尔德尼和噶盖以蒙古文字为基础创制满文。
description.en: Nurhaci ordered the scholars Erdeni and Gagai to create the Manchu script based on the Mongolian alphabet.

description.zh-cn: 满文是在蒙古字母的基础上创制的。
夺门之变后，于谦作为景泰帝的忠臣，被石亨等人诬陷，以谋逆罪下狱处死。
description.en: After the 'Duomen Coup', Yu Qian, as a loyal minister to the Jingtai Emperor, was framed by Shi Heng and others, imprisoned and executed on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 听信徐有贞等人谗言，下令将于谦处以死刑。
因畏惧和嫉妒于谦，在夺门之变后诬陷并导致其死亡。
与张𫐄等人因故一直怨恨于谦，参与了夺门之变后的陷害。
也先率领的瓦剌大军在京师保卫战中战败，被迫撤退。
土木堡之变后京师告急，于谦临危受命，升任兵部尚书，总管军务。
率领瓦剌军队击败明军，并俘虏了明英宗。
于谦在明代宗（景泰帝）朱祁钰时期担任兵部尚书，深受倚重。在夺门之变后，因其忠诚被杀害。
description.en: Yu Qian served as the Minister of War during the reign of Emperor Daizong (Jingtai Emperor) Zhu Qiyu, and was deeply trusted. After the Duomen Incident, he was killed due to his loyalty.

description.zh-cn: 因于谦在平定朱高煦之乱中表现出色而器重他。
于谦之子于冕在成化年间上疏为父鸣冤，促使朝廷为于谦平反。
1890年，梁启超拜康有为为师，成为其学生和维新变法运动中的主要助手。
description.en: In 1890, Liang Qichao became Kang Youwei's student and his main assistant in the reform movement.

description.zh-cn: 青年时期与康有为合作进行戊戌变法，共同推动维新运动。
因张勋复辟事件政见不合，康有为支持复辟，梁启超协助段祺瑞讨伐，师生关系破裂。
梁启超与老师康有为作为维新派核心人物，共同策划、领导并推动了戊戌变法。
description.en: As core figures of the reformists, Liang Qichao and his teacher Kang Youwei jointly planned, led, and promoted the Hundred Days' Reform.

description.zh-cn: 在日本横滨创办《清议报》，宣传维新思想。
担任勤王起义的总指挥，但起义最终失败。

description.en: Zhang Zhidong, then Viceroy of Huguang, surrounded and arrested uprising leaders including Tang Caichang in Hankou, executing them the next day and completely crushing the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 梁启超是护国运动的主要策划者，撰写檄文《异哉所谓国体问题者》，并与蔡锷等人密谋，反对袁世凯称帝。他在幕后指挥了此次起义。
description.en: Liang Qichao was a key planner of the National Protection War, writing the manifesto 'How Strange is the So-called National Polity Problem!' and conspiring with Cai E and others to oppose Yuan Shikai's imperial ambitions. He directed the uprising from behind the scenes.

description.zh-cn: 发表《异哉所谓国体问题者》，公开反对帝制，并参与策划护国战争。
梁启超在袁世凯筹划复辟帝制时与其决裂，并策划发动护国运动进行讨伐，成为其主要政治对手。
description.en: Liang Qichao broke with Yuan Shikai when Yuan planned to restore the monarchy and became his main political opponent by planning and launching the National Protection War against him.

description.zh-cn: 张勋复辟当晚，梁启超即请段祺瑞起兵讨伐，并亲自参与组织讨逆军，起草讨伐通电。
description.en: On the night of the Zhang Xun Restoration, Liang Qichao immediately urged Duan Qirui to launch a punitive expedition, personally participated in organizing the army, and drafted the punitive telegram.

description.zh-cn: 梁启超在《新民丛报》上首次提出“中华民族”这一概念，对现代中国国家认同的构建起到了奠基性作用。
description.en: Liang Qichao first proposed the concept of 'Zhonghua Minzu' (the Chinese Nation) in his 'Xinmin Congbao', playing a foundational role in the construction of modern Chinese national identity.

Later, in his defense statement for the recall case, Tsai Cheng-yuan further accused Huang Kuo-chang of being biased and argued that he should not be beyond supervision.

description.en: Jiang Wei detested the eunuch Huang Hao's abuse of power and once petitioned Liu Shan to execute him. After learning this, Huang Hao also plotted to depose Jiang Wei. Consequently, fearing Huang Hao's power, Jiang Wei led his troops to garrison outside to protect himself.

description.en: After surrendering to Cao Wei, Liu Shan was relocated to Luoyang and lived under the control of Sima Zhao, the de facto ruler of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 建立汉赵政权后，追谥刘禅为“孝怀皇帝”，提升了刘禅的历史声誉。

在天津居住期间，溥仪明显偏爱皇后婉容而冷落淑妃文绣，导致两人关系不和，经常发生冲突。文绣长期处于抑郁苦闷中，这成为她最终决定离婚的重要原因之一。
description.en: During their residence in Tianjin, Puyi's clear preference for Empress Wanrong and neglect of Consort Wenxiu led to disharmony and frequent conflicts between them. Wenxiu suffered from long-term depression, which became a significant reason for her eventual decision to divorce.

description.zh-cn: 姚明出生于上海市徐汇区。

description.en: Yao Ming and Ye Li held their wedding on August 6, 2007.

description.zh-cn: 姚明于2018年7月9日从上海交通大学毕业。
description.en: Yao Ming graduated from Shanghai Jiao Tong University on July 9, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 姚明于1997-2002年作为球员效力于上海大鲨鱼队，并于2009年收购该俱乐部成为老板。
description.en: Yao Ming played for the Shanghai Sharks from 1997-2002 and acquired the club to become its owner in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 姚明于2013年当选为第十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: Yao Ming was elected as a member of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 姚明在2002年NBA选秀中被休斯敦火箭队以第一顺位选中，开启其NBA生涯。
description.en: Yao Ming was selected by the Houston Rockets with the first overall pick in the 2002 NBA draft, starting his NBA career.

description.zh-cn: 评论员查尔斯·巴克利公开质疑姚明的能力，打赌说如果姚明在新秀赛季中单场得分超过19分，他就“亲吻肯尼·史密斯的臀部”。
description.en: Commentator Charles Barkley publicly doubted Yao Ming's ability, betting he would "kiss Kenny Smith's ass" if Yao scored more than 19 points in a single game during his rookie season.

description.zh-cn: 姚明与沙奎尔·奥尼尔在NBA赛场上是备受关注的竞争对手，他们的对决被称为“姚鲨对决”。
description.en: Yao Ming and Shaquille O'Neal were high-profile rivals on the NBA court, with their matchups dubbed the "Yao-Shaq showdown".

description.zh-cn: 特雷西·麦克格雷迪于2004年加入休斯敦火箭队，与姚明组成著名的“姚麦组合”，作为球队的核心搭档。
description.en: Tracy McGrady joined the Houston Rockets in 2004, forming the famous 'Yao-Mac combo' with Yao Ming as the team's core duo.

description.zh-cn: 作为火箭队主教练，杰夫·范甘迪注重培养姚明的进攻能力。
description.en: As the head coach of the Rockets, Jeff Van Gundy focused on developing Yao Ming's offensive skills.

description.zh-cn: 在姚明宣布退役时，时任NBA总裁大卫·斯特恩发表声明，称赞姚明为中美两国的球迷架起了一座非凡的桥梁。
description.en: When Yao Ming announced his retirement, then-NBA Commissioner David Stern issued a statement praising Yao for building an extraordinary bridge between fans in China and the United States.

description.en: During the Long March, Ye Jianying learned that Zhang Guotao refused to follow the CCP Central Committee's northward policy and attempted to split the Red Army. He immediately reported this to Mao Zedong, thwarting Zhang's plan.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，叶剑英因在“二月逆流”案中反对中央文革小组的错误做法而遭到围攻批斗，并一度被剥夺工作。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ye Jianying was besieged and criticized for opposing the erroneous practices of the Central Cultural Revolution Group in the 'February Countercurrent' case, and was temporarily stripped of his duties.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间与四人帮发生多次冲突，并最终策划粉碎四人帮。
多次向华国锋提议请邓小平重新出来工作，并在邓小平复出后予以高度评价和支持。

明孝宗通过励精图治、整肃朝纲、改革弊政，开创了“弘治中兴”的局面。

description.zh-cn: 曾纪鸿为曾国藩三子。
description.en: Zeng Jihong was Zeng Guofan's third son.

description.en: Li Hongzhang became a student of Zeng Guofan, establishing a teacher-student relationship.

description.zh-cn: 与曾国藩依靠外国人在上海创办。

description.zh-cn: 因处理天津教案屈从洋人而遭到舆论谴责，声誉大受影响，甚至被称为“曾国贼”。
description.en: His handling of the Tianjin Massacre by yielding to foreigners led to public condemnation, severely damaging his reputation, and he was even called 'Zeng the traitor'.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正对曾国藩顶礼膜拜，认为其为人之道足为师资，并将其著作作为教科书。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek deeply admired Zeng Guofan, considering his principles a model to learn from, and used his writings as textbooks.

description.zh-cn: 青年时代的毛泽东表示独服曾国藩，晚年也称其为地主阶级最厉害的人物。
description.en: In his youth, Mao Zedong expressed his admiration solely for Zeng Guofan, and in his later years, he called him the most formidable figure of the landlord class.

description.zh-cn: 作为湘军的最高统帅，对屠城负有责任。
description.en: As the supreme commander of the Xiang Army, he was responsible for the massacre.

description.zh-cn: 称其为屠杀同胞，媚满媚外的“汉奸刽子手”。

description.en: Jacky Cheung and May Lo met in 1986 while filming "Devoted to You" and married in London in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 张学智是张学友的哥哥。
description.en: Zhang Xuezhi is Jacky Cheung's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 因张学智于1993年在澳门豪赌欠下巨债后失踪，张学友代为偿还后两人决裂。
description.en: The relationship soured after Zhang Xuezhi disappeared in 1993 with huge gambling debts in Macau, which Jacky Cheung paid off.

description.zh-cn: 张学友获得首届十八区业余歌唱大赛冠军，从而进入歌坛。
description.en: Jacky Cheung won the first 18-District Amateur Singing Contest, which launched his career in the music industry.

description.zh-cn: 张学友于1999-2000年及2015年至今为环球唱片旗下歌手，环球唱片也是其经纪公司。
description.en: Jacky Cheung was an artist under Universal Music from 1999-2000 and from 2015 to the present. Universal Music is also his management company.

description.zh-cn: 出道后的张学友被陈自强看重，并在影坛刻意栽培。两人于1990年代中期结束经理人合约。
description.en: After his debut, Jacky Cheung was scouted by Willie Chan, who cultivated his film career. They ended their management contract in the mid-1990s.

description.zh-cn: 1992年与刘德华、黎明、郭富城被香港媒体获封为“四大天王”。
description.en: In 1992, he was named one of the "Four Heavenly Kings" by the Hong Kong media, along with Andy Lau, Leon Lai, and Aaron Kwok.

description.zh-cn: 张学友凭借在电影《旺角卡门》中的表演获得第8届香港电影金像奖最佳男配角，其演技开始受到瞩目。
description.en: Jacky Cheung's performance in "As Tears Go By" earned him the Best Supporting Actor award at the 8th Hong Kong Film Awards, bringing his acting skills to prominence.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫执导的《旺角卡门》让张学友的演技受到瞩目，此后张学友成为王家卫的御用演员之一。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai's direction in "As Tears Go By" brought attention to Jacky Cheung's acting, and he subsequently became one of Wong's regular actors.

description.zh-cn: 张学友参与策划、导演并主演了原创音乐剧《雪狼湖》。
description.en: Jacky Cheung was involved in the planning, directing, and starring of the original musical "Snow.Wolf.Lake".

description.zh-cn: 由于HKRIA与TVB的版税纠纷，作为环球唱片旗下歌手的张学友的歌曲被禁止出现在TVB的媒介中，对其宣传造成困难。
description.en: Due to the copyright dispute between HKRIA and TVB, Jacky Cheung's songs, as an artist under Universal Music, were banned from TVB media, causing difficulties for his promotion.

description.zh-cn: 张学友是梅艳芳的挚友，在她逝世后，其兄透露张学友曾秘密垫付其大部分医药费。
description.en: Jacky Cheung was a close friend of Anita Mui. After her death, her brother revealed that Cheung had secretly paid for most of her medical expenses.

description.zh-cn: 两人在1990年代早期合作多部经典港产片，配合默契，日后成为密友。
description.en: The two collaborated on several classic Hong Kong films in the early 1990s, had great chemistry, and later became close friends.

description.zh-cn: 陈奕迅被外界认为是张学友的接班人，张学友曾称赞其应为“E神”。
description.en: Eason Chan is considered by the public to be Jacky Cheung's successor. Cheung once praised him as the "E-God" (Eason).

description.zh-cn: 胡枫是张学友的契爸（干爹）。
description.en: Wu Fung is Jacky Cheung's godfather.

description.en: Run Run Shaw served as the Managing Director while Harold Lee was the Chairman of Television Broadcasts Limited.

description.zh-cn: 邹文怀离开邵氏另立嘉禾电影，成为邵氏的主要竞争对手。
description.en: Raymond Chow left Shaw Brothers to establish Golden Harvest, becoming a major competitor to Shaw.

description.zh-cn: 邵逸夫因认为李小龙片酬要求过高而拒绝合作，导致李小龙转投竞争对手嘉禾。
description.en: Run Run Shaw rejected a collaboration with Bruce Lee due to his high salary demands, leading Lee to join rival Golden Harvest.

description.zh-cn: 战争波及东南亚，邵氏兄弟的电影事业大受打击。
description.en: The war spread to Southeast Asia, and the Shaw brothers' film business was severely impacted.

description.zh-cn: 捐出1.1亿港元为香港中文大学兴建逸夫书院。
description.en: Donated HK$110 million to The Chinese University of Hong Kong to build Shaw College.

description.zh-cn: 册封邵逸夫为下级勋位爵士。
description.en: Knighted Run Run Shaw as a Knight Bachelor.

description.en: In consortium with Charles Chan and others, acquired the 26% stake in TVB held by Shaw Brothers, leading to Shaw's complete withdrawal from TVB's operations.

description.en: Leung Nai-pang succeeded Run Run Shaw as the Executive Chairman of TVB.

description.en: He entered the palace to record Empress Dowager Du's last will and signed the sworn document.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国四年（979年），赵德昭被宋太宗逼迫自杀。
description.en: In 979, Zhao Dezhao was forced to commit suicide by Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗将其弟赵廷美贬黜至房州，不久后赵廷美死于谪所。
description.en: Emperor Taizong demoted his younger brother Zhao Tingmei to Fangzhou, where he died shortly after.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国三年（978年），宋太宗迫使清源军（平海军）纳土归降。
description.en: In 978, Emperor Taizong forced the Qingyuan Jiedushi (Pinghai Army) to surrender its territory.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗率军灭亡北汉，结束了五代十国的分裂局面。
description.en: Emperor Taizong led his army to conquer the Northern Han, ending the fragmentation of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗通过迫使平海军和吴越归降，以及灭亡北汉，完成了北宋的统一战争，结束了藩镇割据的局面。
description.en: Emperor Taizong completed the unification wars of the Northern Song by forcing the surrender of the Pinghai Jiedushi and Wuyue and conquering the Northern Han, thereby ending the era of warlordism.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗曾两次率军北伐辽国（契丹），均以失败告终。
description.en: Emperor Taizong twice led military campaigns against the Liao dynasty (Khitan), both ending in failure.

description.zh-cn: 在高粱河之战中，耶律休哥射伤宋太宗大腿，宋太宗的死因是箭伤复发。
description.en: During the Battle of Gaoliang River, Yelü Xiuge wounded Emperor Taizong in the thigh with an arrow; the emperor's later death was caused by the recurrence of this wound.

description.zh-cn: 在白藤江之战中，宋军先胜后败，统一交趾（越南）的计划失败。
description.en: In the Battle of Bạch Đằng River (981), the Song army initially won but was ultimately defeated, and the plan to unify Jiaozhi (Vietnam) failed.

description.zh-cn: 在宋太宗驾崩后，吕端及时识破并挫败了王继恩的政变阴谋，确保了太子赵恒（宋真宗）的顺利即位。
description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, Lü Duan promptly saw through and thwarted Wang Ji'en's coup plot, thus ensuring Crown Prince Zhao Heng (Emperor Zhenzong)'s smooth accession.

description.zh-cn: 在宋太宗驾崩后，企图立赵元佐为帝，阻碍宋真宗即位
description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, he attempted to install Zhao Yuanzuo as emperor, obstructing Emperor Zhenzong's accession.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗去世后，宦官王继恩与李皇后企图拥立太宗长子赵元佐为帝。
description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, the eunuch Wang Ji'en and Empress Li attempted to enthrone Emperor Taizong's eldest son, Zhao Yuanzuo.

拒绝李煜合作抗宋的请求，并将李煜的信件交给宋朝。
