description.en: It is believed that Zhao Guangyi ordered Li Yu to be poisoned with 'qianji' poison because of his poem 'Yu Meiren', which contained phrases like 'How can I bear to recall my lost homeland under the bright moon', expressing nostalgia for his lost kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗赵光义在李煜被俘后，多次强奸小周后，给她带来了巨大的身心痛苦。
description.en: After Li Yu was captured, Emperor Taizong of Song, Zhao Guangyi, repeatedly raped Lesser Empress Zhou, causing her immense physical and mental suffering.

description.zh-cn: 奉命探视李煜。
李煜向徐铉表示后悔当初错杀潘佑。
李煜向徐铉表示后悔当初错杀李平。
据《百家姓考略》载，戚夫人是戚鳃的女儿。
为吕后出谋划策，帮助她保住了其子刘盈的太子之位。
担任太子太傅时，引证古今事例，以死相争，力保刘盈的太子之位。
description.en: While serving as the Grand Tutor to the Crown Prince, he cited historical and contemporary examples and fought fiercely, even at the risk of his own life, to protect Liu Ying's position as crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 作为知识青年被下放到陕西延川县梁家河大队插队。
description.en: As an educated youth, was sent to Liangjiahe Brigade, Yanchuan County, Shaanxi to work in the countryside.

description.zh-cn: 接替胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记和中共中央军委主席。
description.en: Succeeded Hu Jintao as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee and Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 李锐对习近平学历的真实性持怀疑态度，并批评其刚愎自用。
description.en: Li Rui was skeptical of the authenticity of Xi Jinping's academic qualifications and criticized him for being obstinate.

description.zh-cn: 蔡霞公开严厉批判中共中央总书记习近平，称其为“黑帮老大”，导致她被开除党籍。
description.en: Cai Xia publicly and severely criticized CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping, calling him a 'mafia boss', which led to her expulsion from the party.

description.zh-cn: 中美贸易战对习近平任内的中美关系和经济造成冲击。
description.en: The China-U.S. trade war impacted Sino-U.S. relations and the economy during Xi Jinping's term.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民在文化大革命期间受到冲击，停职并在五七干校劳动。
“杨家将事件”中，杨尚昆、杨白冰兄弟被指一度架空江泽民的军权。
“杨家将事件”中，杨尚昆、杨白冰兄弟被指一度架空江泽民的军权。
时任中华民国总统李登辉访问美国康奈尔大学，此举被北京视为推动“两国论”，从而引发了第三次台湾海峡危机。
两人在上海和中央共事期间相处融洽，建立了密切的合作关系。
遵照其生前遗愿，江泽民的骨灰在上海长江入海口撒入江海。
吴襄是吴三桂的父亲。
吴三桂是祖大寿的外甥。
吴三桂于1644年投降清朝，并引领清军进入山海关与李自成军交战。
吴三桂以“大明天下都招讨兵马大元帅”之名义举兵反清，发动三藩之乱。
吴三桂从缅甸获得永历帝，并于昆明将其绞杀。
吴三桂因云南巡抚朱国治频繁催问撤藩行期并严密监视，遂处决朱国治，起兵反清。
description.en: Wu Sangui executed Yunnan Governor Zhu Guozhi and rebelled against the Qing dynasty because Zhu Guozhi frequently pressed him about the departure date for his withdrawal from the fiefdom and closely monitored him.

description.zh-cn: 李自成率领的大顺军攻入北京，导致崇祯帝自缢。
李自成在北京俘虏了吴三桂的父亲吴襄，并在其后一片石之战战败后将其处死。
description.en: Li Zicheng captured Wu Sangui's father, Wu Xiang, in Beijing, and subsequently ordered his execution after being defeated in the Battle of Shanhai Pass.

description.zh-cn: 因吴三桂反叛，康熙帝下令将作为人质的吴应熊及其子吴世霖绞死。
李自成占领北京后，其手下大将刘宗敏掳走了陈圆圆。
狄光嗣是狄仁杰的儿子。
description.en: Di Guangsi was Di Renjie's son.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰出生于并州阳曲县。
description.en: Di Renjie was born in Yangqu County, Bingzhou.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在唐高宗时期担任官员。
description.en: Di Renjie served as an official during the reign of Emperor Gaozong of Tang.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在武则天时期担任宰相。
description.en: Di Renjie served as chancellor during the reign of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 阎立本发现狄仁杰的才能并推荐了他。
description.en: Yan Liben discovered Di Renjie's talent and recommended him.

description.zh-cn: 武承嗣勾结来俊臣诬陷狄仁杰谋反，使其下狱。
description.en: Wu Chengsi colluded with Lai Junchen to falsely accuse Di Renjie of rebellion, leading to his imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 来俊臣诬陷狄仁杰谋反，将其逮捕下狱。
description.en: Lai Junchen framed Di Renjie for rebellion and had him arrested and imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 劝说武则天顺应民心，还政于庐陵王李显，使李唐得以维系。
description.en: Persuaded Wu Zetian to follow the will of the people and restore power to Li Xian, Prince of Luling, thus preserving the Tang lineage.

description.zh-cn: 娄师德在狄仁杰未入相时曾经举荐他。
description.en: Lou Shide recommended Di Renjie before he became chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在当上宰相后，因不知娄师德曾举荐自己而排挤他。
description.en: After becoming chancellor, unaware that Lou Shide had recommended him, Di Renjie sidelined him.

description.zh-cn: 狄仁杰在武则天时代的贡献为后来的开元盛世奠定了基础。
description.en: Di Renjie's contributions during the Wu Zetian era laid the foundation for the subsequent Kaiyuan Flourishing Age.

description.zh-cn: 举荐了张柬之等数十位干练的官员。
description.en: Recommended dozens of capable officials, including Zhang Jianzhi.

description.zh-cn: 举荐了姚崇等数十位干练的官员。
description.en: Recommended dozens of capable officials, including Yao Chong.

description.zh-cn: 追封狄仁杰为梁国公。
description.en: Posthumously ennobled Di Renjie as the Duke of Liang.

description.zh-cn: 上谏劝阻武则天停止建造耗资巨大的浮屠大像。
description.en: Advised Wu Zetian to stop the costly construction of a giant Buddha statue.

description.zh-cn: 郭贵嫔受宠后，向曹丕进谗言陷害甄氏，导致甄氏被赐死。
曹操在200年官渡之战中与袁绍决战。此后，曹操继续进攻，并于204年攻破袁绍根据地邺城，最终消灭了袁氏集团。
description.en: Cao Cao fought a decisive battle with Yuan Shao at the Battle of Guandu in 200. Following this, Cao Cao continued his offensive and captured Yuan Shao's base camp, Ye City, in 204, eventually eliminating the Yuan clan.

description.zh-cn: 曹操率军攻破邺城，导致袁熙与妻子甄氏分离。
即位后追尊其母为文昭皇后，并为其改葬、立庙祭祀。
写信以“武王伐纣，以妲己赐周公”的故事讽刺曹操将甄氏赐予其子曹丕的行为。
曹丕命夫人甄氏出拜宾客时，刘桢平视甄夫人，不合当时礼法，后因此获罪。
婚后对毛福梅并无好感，感情不睦，曾对她进行殴打。
毛福梅为蒋经国之母。
毛鼎和为毛福梅之父。
毛懋卿是毛福梅的二哥。
蒋中正视其为妾，但在1927年登报声明与其脱离关系。
蒋中正视其为妾，但在1927年登报声明与其脱离关系。
毛福梅是浙江省奉化县人。
在一次空袭中，被日本军机炸死于蒋家老宅丰镐房外。
文化大革命期间，毛福梅的墓被掘开，遗骸被毁。
文化大革命期间，王采玉的墓被掘开，遗骸被毁。
庄子的思想继承和发展了老子的思想，其学说要本归于老子之言。
description.en: Zhuangzi's thought inherited and developed Laozi's thought; his doctrine is fundamentally based on Laozi's words.

description.zh-cn: 庄周与孟子是同时代的人物。
description.en: Zhuangzi and Mencius were contemporaries.

description.zh-cn: 庄子为宋国蒙人，曾在宋国蒙地担任管理漆园的小官。
description.en: Zhuangzi was a native of Meng in the state of Song, and once served as a minor official in charge of the lacquer garden there.

description.zh-cn: 于天宝初年下诏，追封庄周为南华真人。
description.en: In the early Tianbao era, he issued an edict to posthumously honor Zhuang Zhou as Nanhua Zhenren.

description.zh-cn: 追封庄周为“微妙元通真君”。
description.en: Posthumously honored Zhuang Zhou as 'Weimiao Yuantong Zhenjun'.

description.zh-cn: 庄子与魏惠王（梁惠王）生活在同一时代。
description.en: Zhuangzi was a contemporary of King Hui of Wei (also known as King Hui of Liang).

description.zh-cn: 庄周与齐宣王是同时代的人物。
description.en: Zhuangzi and King Xuan of Qi were contemporaries.

description.zh-cn: 庄子与名家代表人物惠施是好友。
description.en: Zhuangzi was a good friend of Hui Shi, a representative of the School of Names.

description.zh-cn: 楚威王曾派遣使者，携带重金聘请庄子担任楚国的宰相。
description.en: King Wei of Chu once sent messengers with generous gifts to invite Zhuangzi to serve as the prime minister of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 庄子以“宁为泥中嬉戏的活乌龟，也不愿为庙堂之上的死龟壳”为由，拒绝了楚威王的出仕邀请。
description.en: Zhuangzi refused King Wei of Chu's offer of office, stating he would rather be a live tortoise dragging its tail in the mud than a dead tortoise shell revered in the ancestral temple.

description.zh-cn: 庄子创作了《庄子》一书，阐述其哲学思想。该书是庄子及其后学所著的道家典籍。
description.en: Zhuangzi authored the book 'Zhuangzi' to expound his philosophical ideas. It is a Taoist classic written by Zhuangzi and his followers.

description.zh-cn: 反对法家以严刑峻法治国的理念。
description.en: Opposed the Legalist philosophy of governing the state through harsh laws and punishments.

description.zh-cn: 晋代学者郭象为《庄子》作注，并可能对原书的篇目进行了删减，形成了现今流传的33篇版本。
description.en: The Jin Dynasty scholar Guo Xiang wrote a commentary on the 'Zhuangzi' and may have abridged the original text, resulting in the 33-chapter version that is extant today.

description.zh-cn: 巩俐与张艺谋因拍摄《红高粱》相识相恋，曾有过长达八年的恋情并合作了多部电影，后于1995年分手。
description.en: Gong Li and Zhang Yimou met and fell in love during the filming of 'Red Sorghum'. They had an eight-year romantic relationship, collaborated on several films, and broke up in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 因拍摄《千里走单骑》结下友谊。
description.en: Became friends during the filming of 'Riding Alone for Thousands of Miles'.

description.zh-cn: 在《金陵十三钗》后，与合作16年的制片人张伟平因“矛盾”终止了合作。
description.en: After 'The Flowers of War', he terminated his 16-year collaboration with producer Zhang Weiping due to 'contradictions'.

description.zh-cn: 因与妻子陈婷在婚前育有三名子女，违反了计划生育政策，被媒体曝光后，于2014年被征收社会抚养费共计748万余元。
description.en: He violated the family planning policy by having three children with his wife Chen Ting before marriage. After being exposed by the media, he was fined a total of over 7.48 million RMB in social support fees in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 长子
跟随毛泽东参加秋收起义。
在长征途中举荐起用张宗逊。
在大同集宁战役中，张宗逊率部与傅作义部交战后惨败。
在西北野战军和第一野战军期间，担任司令员彭德怀的副手。
张宗逊在文化大革命期间遭受迫害，被冠以“罗瑞卿的同伙、彭德怀的黑干将、贺龙的心腹”等罪名。
毛泽东向黄永胜询问张宗逊去向，促使其被任命为济南军区副司令员。
介绍张宗逊与杜芳结婚。
长期兼任中央警卫局局长，负责党主席毛泽东的警卫安全，是毛泽东的亲信。
汪东兴在文化大革命开始后逐步受到重用，权力在文革中后期快速提升。
邓小平等中共元老在权力斗争中获胜，导致坚持“两个凡是”的汪东兴失势并被迫辞去领导职务。
邓小平等中共元老在权力斗争中获胜，导致坚持“两个凡是”的汪东兴失势并被迫辞去领导职务。
在十一届三中全会前，汪东兴在会上受到严肃批评，被免除中共中央办公厅主任职务，其失势为案件平反扫清了障碍。
description.en: Before the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, Wang Dongxing was severely criticized at the meeting and removed from his post as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee. His loss of power cleared the obstacles for the rehabilitation of the cases.

description.zh-cn: 作为“凡是派”的主要领导人之一，支持“两个凡是”的主张。
在中共十一届三中全会上，他联合陈云、胡耀邦等人批评“两个凡是”是“极左路线错误”。此举推动了“实践是检验真理的唯一标准”的讨论，最终取代了“凡是派”的领导地位。
description.en: At the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee, he, along with Chen Yun and Hu Yaobang, criticized the 'Two Whatevers' as a 'far-left line error'. This move promoted the discussion on 'Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth', ultimately replacing the leadership position of the 'Whatever Faction'.

description.zh-cn: 负责整个南巡的安全工作，在主要地点具体安排保卫任务，挫败了林彪集团的暗杀计划。
在1971年毛泽东南巡期间负责安保工作，挫败了林彪集团的暗杀毛泽东计划。
汪东兴接替杨尚昆担任中共中央办公厅主任。
姚依林接替汪东兴担任中共中央办公厅主任。
夏侯氏在200年被张飞所得，成为其妻。
张苞是张飞的长子。
张绍是张飞的次子。
夏侯氏是夏侯渊的侄女。
吕布袭取下邳，与刘备、张飞交战。
张飞与下邳相曹豹不和，后将其杀死。
在长坂坡之战中，张飞率二十骑据水断桥，阻挡了曹操的追兵。
张飞在攻打益州时生擒严颜，因钦佩其气节而释放并待为上宾。
张飞在巴西之战中击败张郃。
在下辨之战中，张飞所部被曹洪击败。
张达作为张飞的帐下将领，与范彊一同刺杀了张飞。
刘巴看不起出身武人的张飞，不愿与其交谈。
在汉中之战期间，刘备分遣张飞、马超、吴兰等攻取武都。
毕业于其前身爱德华七世医药学院。
description.en: Graduated from its predecessor, the King Edward VII College of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 因在五一三事件后公开批评时任首相东姑阿都拉曼而被巫统开除。
description.en: Expelled from UMNO for openly criticizing then-Prime Minister Tunku Abdul Rahman after the 13 May incident.

description.zh-cn: 在胡先翁担任首相期间，马哈迪是其副手。
description.en: Mahathir was Hussein Onn's deputy during his premiership.

description.zh-cn: 1998年亚洲金融危机期间，马哈迪因政策分歧革除了安华的副首相职务，两人关系破裂并成为长期的政治对手。他们曾在2018年短暂结盟，但在2020年政治危机后关系再度破裂。
description.en: During the 1998 Asian financial crisis, Mahathir dismissed Anwar as Deputy Prime Minister over policy differences, leading to a breakdown in their relationship and making them long-term political rivals. They formed a brief alliance in 2018 but their relationship broke down again after the 2020 political crisis.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪退休后，开始批评他亲自挑选的继任者阿都拉·巴达威的政策。
description.en: After retiring, Mahathir began to criticize the policies of his handpicked successor, Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 因一个马来西亚发展有限公司丑闻（1MDB）而成为纳吉的激烈批评者，并领导反对派推翻其政府。
description.en: Became a fierce critic of Najib over the 1MDB scandal and led the opposition to overthrow his government.

description.zh-cn: 一个马来西亚有限公司（1MDB）丑闻曝光后，时任首相纳吉·阿都拉萨的声誉和政治生涯受到重创，并最终被定罪。该丑闻也是导致纳吉政府在2018年大选中失败的关键因素。
description.en: After the 1MDB scandal was exposed, the reputation and political career of then-Prime Minister Najib Razak were severely damaged, and he was eventually convicted. The scandal was also a key factor in the defeat of Najib Razak's government in the 2018 general election.

description.zh-cn: 在2020年政治危机中，慕尤丁领导土著团结党退出希望联盟，导致马哈迪政府垮台，两人关系破裂。
description.en: During the 2020 political crisis, Muhyiddin led Bersatu out of Pakatan Harapan, causing the collapse of Mahathir's government and the breakdown of their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年退出巫统后，马哈迪与慕尤丁等人共同创立了土著团结党。
description.en: After leaving UMNO in 2016, Mahathir co-founded Bersatu with Muhyiddin Yassin and others.

description.zh-cn: 在被土著团结党开除党籍后，马哈迪于2020年8月宣布成立新政党“祖国斗士党”。
description.en: After being expelled from Bersatu, Mahathir announced the formation of a new party, Pejuang, in August 2020.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪宣布创立祖国行动联盟以参加第15届全国大选。
description.en: Mahathir announced the establishment of Gerakan Tanah Air to contest in the 15th general election.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪监督了汽车制造商宝腾的成立，这是一个马来西亚政府与三菱的合资企业。
description.en: Mahathir oversaw the establishment of car manufacturer Proton, a joint venture between the Malaysian government and Mitsubishi.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪于1982年初宣布“向东学习”政策，即向日本和韩国学习现代化模式。
description.en: In early 1982, Mahathir announced the "Look East Policy", learning from the modernization models of Japan and South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪于1991年宣布了“2020年宏愿”，目标是让马来西亚在30年内成为发达国家。
description.en: In 1991, Mahathir announced "Wawasan 2020", with the goal of making Malaysia a developed nation within 30 years.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪领导的希望联盟在选举中获胜，使其再次出任首相。
description.en: The Pakatan Harapan coalition led by Mahathir won the election, allowing him to become Prime Minister again.

description.zh-cn: 该政治危机导致马哈迪辞去首相职务，其领导的希望联盟政府垮台。
description.en: The political crisis led to Mahathir's resignation as Prime Minister and the collapse of his Pakatan Harapan government.

description.zh-cn: 两人在担任首相期间多次会面解决双边问题，关系复杂，既有合作也有纠纷。
description.en: The two met multiple times during their premierships to resolve bilateral issues; their relationship was complex, involving both cooperation and disputes.

description.zh-cn: 习近平与马哈迪通话，马哈迪对新冠肺炎疫情表示慰问，习近平称马哈迪为“中国人民的老朋友”。
description.en: Xi Jinping and Mahathir had a phone call where Mahathir expressed sympathy regarding the COVID-19 pandemic, and Xi referred to Mahathir as an "old friend of the Chinese people".

description.zh-cn: 朱祐杬是明孝宗的异母弟，明世宗是明孝宗之侄。
description.en: Zhu Youyuan was the half-brother of the Hongzhi Emperor, making the Jiajing Emperor the nephew of the Hongzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗驾崩后，时任内阁首辅的杨廷和与皇太后议定，拥立朱厚熜入京继皇帝位。
description.en: After Emperor Wuzong's death, Grand Secretary Yang Tinghe, in consultation with the Empress Dowager, arranged for Zhu Houcong to be brought to Beijing to succeed to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗驾崩后，与杨廷和共同议定由朱厚熜入继大统。
description.en: After the death of the Zhengde Emperor, she and Yang Tinghe arranged for Zhu Houcong to succeed to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗坚持追尊自己的生父兴献王为“皇帝”，此举引发了长达三年半的“大礼议”之争。
description.en: Emperor Shizong insisted on posthumously honoring his biological father, the Prince of Xing, as 'Emperor', which triggered the three-and-a-half-year 'Great Rites Controversy'.

description.zh-cn: 率领群臣反对明世宗追尊生父，要求明世宗改以明孝宗为父。
description.en: Led court officials in opposition, demanding that the Jiajing Emperor adopt the Hongzhi Emperor as his father.

description.zh-cn: 上疏支持明世宗追尊生父，成为议礼派核心人物。
description.en: Submitted memorials supporting the emperor's position, becoming a core figure in the pro-rites faction.

description.zh-cn: 在位前期进行改革，锐意图治，革除先朝蠹政，史称嘉靖中兴。
description.en: In his early reign, he carried out reforms, was determined to govern well, and eliminated the corrupt policies of the previous reign, which historians call the Jiajing Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 笃信道教，好长生不老之术，每年不断修设斋醮，并在西苑修仙。
description.en: He was a devout believer in Taoism, sought immortality, held numerous Taoist ceremonies annually, and practiced self-cultivation in the West Park.

description.zh-cn: 1542年，数名宫女因不堪忍受虐待，在壬寅宫变中试图缢杀明世宗，致其险些丧命。事后，明世宗移居西苑，此后长期不上朝。
description.en: In October 1542, unable to bear his abuse, several palace maids attempted to strangle Emperor Shizong during the Renyin Palace Incident, nearly causing his death. Afterwards, he moved to the West Park and ceased holding court for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 在壬寅宫变后，太医许绅使用‘虎狼之药’救活了明世宗。
description.en: After the Renyin Palace Incident, the imperial physician Xu Shen used potent medicine to revive the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗在位中后期开始荒政，深居西苑不上朝，将政令皆交由严嵩父子打理，使其专权近二十年，并导致贪赃枉法。
description.en: In the middle and late stages of his reign, the Jiajing Emperor neglected his duties, residing in the West Park and not attending court. He delegated all government affairs to Yan Song and his son, allowing them to monopolize power for nearly 20 years and leading to widespread corruption.

description.zh-cn: 地震造成巨大人员伤亡与财产损失，明朝从国库调拨大量资金用于救灾，导致国库连续两年亏空，对国力和财政状况造成了负面影响。
description.en: The earthquake caused massive casualties and property losses. The Ming dynasty allocated large sums from the state treasury for disaster relief, leading to a deficit for two consecutive years and negatively impacting the state's power and financial situation.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖朝期间，北方蒙古寇边与东南倭寇侵扰导致边事废弛，对国家安全构成严重威胁。
description.en: During the Jiajing era, border raids by northern Mongols and incursions by southeastern Wokou pirates led to a decline in border defenses, posing a serious threat to national security.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖年间多次率领蒙古鞑靼部落寇边。
description.en: Led Mongol Tatar tribes to raid the border multiple times during the Jiajing era.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖年间侵扰中国东南沿海，造成严重破坏。
description.en: Raided the southeastern coast of China during the Jiajing era, causing severe destruction.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖年间，戚继光两度入闽，率军肃清倭寇，保卫了东南沿海地区。
description.en: During the Jiajing reign, Qi Jiguang entered Fujian twice, leading his army to eliminate Wokou pirates and defend the southeastern coastal regions.

description.zh-cn: 率领军队肃清倭寇，保卫了东南沿海地区。
description.en: Led troops to eliminate the Wokou pirates, defending the southeastern coastal regions.

description.zh-cn: 在明世宗驾崩后，请裕王（后来的明穆宗）入宫主持丧礼，确保了权力平稳交接。
description.en: After the death of the Jiajing Emperor, he invited Prince Yu (later the Longqing Emperor) to preside over the funeral rites, ensuring a smooth transition of power.

description.zh-cn: 莫言出生于山东省高密县
北京师范大学与鲁迅文学院联合培养
莫言称受到《雪国》启发，创建了自己的文学王国“高密东北乡”。
莫言获得2012年诺贝尔文学奖。
因文化大革命在小学五年级时辍学。
张艺谋导演了多部由莫言小说改编的电影。
发文为莫言辩护，认为起诉莫言是一场闹剧。
批评莫言支持审查制度，并称其获奖是一场“灾难”。
批评莫言没有公开呼吁释放刘晓波。
批评莫言“胆子小，奉迎、讨好体制”，且“语言粗糙”。
被授予美国陆军航空军上校军衔。
在麦卡锡主义盛行期间，钱学森因被怀疑与共产党有牵连而受到美国政府的迫害，最终被驱逐出境。
description.en: During the McCarthy era, Qian Xuesen was persecuted by the U.S. government on suspicion of communist ties, eventually leading to his deportation.

description.zh-cn: 联邦调查局指控钱学森在入籍申请中隐瞒其共产党外围组织活动，导致其机密工作许可被吊销。
description.en: The FBI accused Qian Xuesen of concealing his activities in communist front organizations on his naturalization application, leading to the revocation of his security clearance.

description.zh-cn: 美国司法部将钱学森拘留并最终将其驱逐出境。
description.en: The U.S. Department of Justice detained Qian Xuesen and eventually deported him.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森为中华人民共和国的火箭、导弹和航天计划做出了重大贡献。
description.en: Qian Xuesen made significant contributions to the People's Republic of China's rocket, missile, and space programs.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森是加州理工学院喷气推进实验室的主要创建者之一，为美国的火箭和航天计划做出了重大贡献。
description.en: Qian Xuesen was one of the main founders of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory at Caltech and made significant contributions to the U.S. rocket and space programs.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，周恩来下令保护了钱学森，使其免受冲击。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhou Enlai ordered the protection of Qian Xuesen, shielding him from persecution.

description.zh-cn: 在“批邓反击右倾翻案风”运动中，发表大字报批判上司张爱萍。
description.en: During the 'Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' campaign, published a big-character poster criticizing his superior Zhang Aiping.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森因支持人体特异功能研究，与持反对意见的于光远发生激烈争论。
1999年的美国国会考克斯报告声称钱学森为“间谍”。
description.en: The 1999 U.S. Congressional Cox Report alleged that Qian Xuesen was a 'spy'.

description.zh-cn: 钱学森的传记作者张纯如对考克斯报告中称其为“间谍”的指控予以驳斥。
description.en: Qian Xuesen's biographer, Iris Chang, refuted the Cox Report's accusation that he was a 'spy'.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国为蒋孝章之父。
蒋方良为蒋孝章之母。
1957年赴美留学后与俞扬和陷入热恋，于1960年8月结婚。
蒋孝文为蒋孝章之兄。
蒋孝武为蒋孝章之弟。
蒋孝勇为蒋孝章之弟。
因俞扬和为有妇之夫，反对女儿蒋孝章与其恋爱及婚事。
因其子俞扬和与蒋孝章相恋，蒋经国曾十分恼火，并向俞大维发飙。
俞大维为俞扬和之父。
据传与蒋家三兄弟关系不和。
据传与蒋家三兄弟关系不和。
据传与蒋家三兄弟关系不和。
耐心说服调解，使蒋经国接受蒋孝章与俞扬和的婚事。
蒋斯千为蒋肇聪之父。
王有则为王采玉之父。
宋高宗是宋徽宗的第九子。
description.en: Emperor Gaozong was the ninth son of Emperor Huizong.

description.zh-cn: 显仁皇后韦氏是宋高宗的生母。
description.en: Emperor Gaozong's birth mother was Empress Xianren, née Wei.

description.zh-cn: 宋高宗是宋钦宗的弟弟。
description.en: Emperor Gaozong was the younger brother of Emperor Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 赵旉是宋高宗唯一的亲生儿子。
description.en: Zhao Fu was the only biological son of Emperor Gaozong.

description.zh-cn: 宋孝宗是宋高宗的养子和皇位继承人。
description.en: Emperor Xiaozong was the adopted son and heir of Emperor Gaozong.

description.zh-cn: 宋高宗在位初期重用主战派将领岳飞。
宋高宗为与金人缔结和约而重用主和派秦桧。
金朝将领兀术向秦桧提出“必杀飞，始可和”作为议和的条件。
为推行与金朝议和的政策，宋高宗罢免了坚决主张抗金的宰相李纲。
description.en: To pursue a policy of peace negotiations with the Jin dynasty, Emperor Gaozong dismissed Chancellor Li Gang, a staunch advocate for resistance.

description.zh-cn: 宋高宗罢免主战派大臣张浚。
在达成绍兴和议前夕，宋高宗解除了包括韩世忠在内的主战派大将的兵权。
description.en: On the eve of the Treaty of Shaoxing, Emperor Gaozong stripped pro-war generals, including Han Shizhong, of their military command.

description.zh-cn: 宋高宗主导并最终与金朝达成了绍兴和议，以称臣纳贡换取和平。
description.en: Emperor Gaozong initiated and concluded the Treaty of Shaoxing with the Jin dynasty, securing peace by accepting vassal status and paying tribute.

description.zh-cn: 金朝与南宋长期处于军事对峙状态。
在靖康之难中，宋钦宗被金兵俘虏北上。
description.en: During the Jingkang incident, Emperor Qinzong was captured by Jin forces and taken north.

description.zh-cn: 靖康之难后，北宋皇室被俘，赵构作为少数幸免的皇子，成为仅存的希望，南下即位，建立南宋。
description.en: After the Jingkang Incident, with the Northern Song imperial family captured, Zhao Gou, as one of the few surviving princes and the sole hope, was able to ascend the throne in the south and establish the Southern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 因禁军将领不满，爆发苗刘兵变，迫使宋高宗禅让皇位于皇子赵旉。
description.en: The Miao-Liu Mutiny erupted due to dissatisfaction among imperial guard generals, forcing Emperor Gaozong to abdicate the throne to his son, Zhao Fu.

description.zh-cn: 赵旉在苗刘兵变中受到惊吓，不久后病逝。
description.en: Zhao Fu was frightened during the Miao-Liu Mutiny and died of illness shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要学生领袖，组织并领导了八九学运，并在其中发挥了重要作用，例如发起绝食抗议。
description.en: As a key student leader, he organized and led the 1989 student movement, playing an important role and initiating hunger strikes.

description.zh-cn: 在与时任国务院总理李鹏的会面中，吾尔开希打断其发言，双方立场对立。
description.en: During a meeting with then-Premier Li Peng, Wu'erkaixi interrupted his speech, highlighting their opposing stances.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，吾尔开希被通缉并开始流亡生涯。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests, Wu'erkaixi was put on a wanted list and began his life in exile.

description.zh-cn: 将吾尔开希列为21名高自联头头和骨干之一进行通缉。
description.en: Listed Wu'erkaixi as one of the 21 key leaders and core members of the 'Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation' on its wanted list.

description.zh-cn: “黄雀行动”成功营救了民运领袖吾尔开希，协助其经香港逃离中国大陆，并逃亡至法国。
description.en: Operation Yellowbird successfully rescued pro-democracy leader Wu'erkaixi, assisting him in escaping from mainland China via Hong Kong to France.

description.zh-cn: 据司徒华本人称，他曾帮助吾尔开希通过“黄雀行动”逃亡。
description.en: According to Szeto Wah, he helped Wu'erkaixi flee through 'Operation Yellowbird'.

description.zh-cn: 与严家其等人共同创立“民主中国阵线”。
description.en: Co-founded the Federation for a Democratic China with Yan Jiaqi and others.

description.zh-cn: 与吾尔开希等人共同创立“民主中国阵线”。
description.en: Co-founded the Federation for a Democratic China with Wu'erkaixi and others.

description.zh-cn: 时任台中市长张温鹰欢迎吾尔开希入籍台中市，并亲自颁发中华民国国民身份证。
description.en: Then-Taichung Mayor Chang Wen-ying welcomed Wu'erkaixi's naturalization in Taichung and personally issued him a Republic of China National Identity Card.

description.zh-cn: 曾批评时任总统陈水扁“宛如共产党”。
description.en: Criticized then-President Chen Shui-bian as being 'like the Communist Party'.

description.zh-cn: 曾批评时任总统马英九帮共产党说话。
description.en: Criticized then-President Ma Ying-jeou for speaking on behalf of the Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 吾尔开希试图进入澳门向中国内地自首时，被澳门治安警察局根据《内部保安纲要法》拒绝入境。
description.en: Wu'erkaixi was denied entry into Macau by the Public Security Police Force of Macau under the Internal Security Framework Law when attempting to enter and surrender to mainland Chinese authorities.

description.zh-cn: 吾尔开希多次被香港入境处拒绝入境或遣返。2011年欲赴港参加司徒华丧礼被拒；2013年在香港转机时试图自首被遣返台湾。
description.en: Wu'erkaixi was denied entry or deported by the Hong Kong Immigration Department on multiple occasions. In 2011, he was denied entry when trying to attend Szeto Wah's funeral; in 2013, he was deported to Taiwan after attempting to surrender during a transit in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 到太阳花学运现场声援学生，发表讲话并给予勉励。
description.en: Visited the site of the Sunflower Student Movement to support and encourage the students, and delivered a speech.

description.zh-cn: 在台北的声援晚会到场声援香港的占领行动。
description.en: Attended a support rally in Taipei to show solidarity with the Occupy movement in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 解散高自联。
description.en: Dissolved the Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation.

description.zh-cn: 在学运期间，因主张从天安门广场东移等广场策略问题与柴玲等激进派产生争执，而被学运组织进一步边缘化。
description.en: During the student movement, he had disputes with radical members like Chai Ling over square strategy issues, such as advocating for moving the protest east from Tiananmen Square, which led to his further marginalization by the student movement organization.

description.zh-cn: 江泽慧是江绵恒的姑姑。
杨雄在江绵恒创办的上海联和投资有限公司担任首任总经理，江绵恒为董事长。
description.en: Yang Xiong was the first general manager of Shanghai Alliance Investment Ltd., founded by Jiang Mianheng, who was the chairman.

description.zh-cn: 陪同曾庆红参观上海韩天衡美术馆。
description.en: Accompanied Zeng Qinghong on a visit to the Han Tianheng Art Museum in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 与韩正一同陪同曾庆红参观上海韩天衡美术馆。
description.en: Together with Han Zheng, accompanied Zeng Qinghong on a visit to the Han Tianheng Art Museum in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 陪同吴邦国视察上海工博会中国科学院展区。
description.en: Accompanied Wu Bangguo to inspect the Chinese Academy of Sciences exhibition area at the Shanghai Industry Fair.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，两人关系密切。
description.en: Reportedly had a close relationship.

description.zh-cn: 投资了由令完成担任总经理的“九州在线”公司。
description.en: Invested in the company 'Jiu Zhou Zai Xian', where Ling Wancheng was the general manager.

description.zh-cn: 陈晓丹是陈元的女儿。
description.en: Chen Xiaodan is the daughter of Chen Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 在帕米拉咨询公司之后任职。
作为名媛参加了2006年的舞会。
曾任国家开发银行董事长
description.en: Former Chairman of China Development Bank

description.zh-cn: 2025年1月19日当选中央委员。
接受台中市市长卢秀燕邀请出任台中市政府有给职顾问。
因硕士学位遭撤销而辞职。
在蔡壁如辞去立法委员后，递补其悬缺。
在成为民众党不分区立委候选人后，向台大医院申请退休。

position.zh-cn: 竞选办公室核心幕僚、市长办公室主任
position.en: Core campaign staff, Director of the Mayor's Office

description.zh-cn: 被视为柯文哲的“第一心腹”和贯彻“柯氏管理精神”的关键人物。
被外界视为柯文哲的“第一心腹”。

degree.zh-cn: 资讯管理系硕士在职专班

description.zh-cn: 其硕士学位后因论文违反学术伦理被撤销。
经学伦会审理，认定蔡壁如的硕士论文违反学术伦理，撤销其硕士学位。
指出蔡壁如的硕士论文部分内容与其脸书发文雷同，并曾公开纠正蔡壁如将2亿台币误认为高于6,000万美元的错误。
在2024年台中市第一选举区立法委员选举中，礼让并支持蔡壁如。
在2024年中华民国立法委员选举中，于台中市第一选举区竞争立法委员席位。
在府内会议上就“牛仔裤案”等事宜多次严厉检讨观传局，被认为是逼走时任局长简余晏的最后一根稻草。
批评蔡壁如关于“年轻人只会跟风挺绿”的言论。
作为中共中央政治局委员和地方主要领导，在以习近平为核心的党中央领导下工作。多次公开表态拥护“习核心”。
description.en: As a member of the Politburo and a key regional leader, he works under the party central committee with Xi Jinping at its core. He has publicly expressed support for 'Xi Core' on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 2007年11月任省委副书记，2010年12月升任省委书记。
2003年6月任市委副书记，2005年3月升任市委书记。
在李铁映任中共辽宁省委书记和电子工业部部长期间担任其秘书。
description.en: Served as secretary to Li Tieying when he was Party Secretary of Liaoning Province and Minister of Electronics Industry.

description.zh-cn: 在电子工业部任职时，李鸿忠为黄丽满的直接下属。
description.en: When working in the Ministry of Electronics Industry, Li Hongzhong was a direct subordinate of Huang Liman.

description.zh-cn: 据信为李鸿忠的主要提拔者。
description.en: Believed to be the main promoter of Li Hongzhong.

description.zh-cn: 联署致全国人大的公开信，要求弹劾李鸿忠。
description.en: Co-signed an open letter to the National People's Congress demanding the impeachment of Li Hongzhong.

description.zh-cn: 联署致全国人大的公开信，要求弹劾李鸿忠。
description.en: Co-signed an open letter to the National People's Congress demanding the impeachment of Li Hongzhong.

description.zh-cn: 时任总理温家宝批评李鸿忠在防汛工作汇报中“信口开河”。
description.en: Then-Premier Wen Jiabao criticized Li Hongzhong for 'making irresponsible remarks' in a flood control work report.

description.zh-cn: 刊文批评李鸿忠是“政治变色龙”和投机分子。
description.en: Published an article criticizing Li Hongzhong as a 'political chameleon' and an opportunist.

relationships.target: CDT:忠诚不绝对就是绝对不忠诚

description.zh-cn: 李鸿忠在署名文章中提出此论述，以表达对习近平的忠诚。
《京华时报》是《人民日报》集团下属的报纸。
description.en: The Beijing Times is a newspaper under the People's Daily Group.

description.zh-cn: 作为大日本帝国的首相，向天皇负责。
description.en: As Prime Minister of the Empire of Japan, was responsible to the Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 是甲午中日战争的主要策划和发动者。
description.en: Was a main planner and instigator of the First Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 代表日本与清朝代表李鸿章签订《马关条约》。
description.en: Represented Japan in signing the Treaty of Shimonoseki with Qing representative Li Hongzhang.

description.zh-cn: 在松下村塾受教于吉田松阴。
description.en: Studied under Yoshida Shōin at Shōka Sonjuku.

description.zh-cn: 共同参与尊皇攘夷运动，并在功山寺举兵等事件中合作。
description.en: Participated together in the Sonnō jōi movement and collaborated in events like the Kōzan-ji Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 同为长州五杰，一同留学并长期共事。
description.en: Both were members of the Chōshū Five, studied abroad together, and worked together for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 明治维新成功后，在木户孝允的领导下负责处理外交事务。
description.en: After the success of the Meiji Restoration, he was responsible for foreign affairs under the leadership of Kido Takayoshi.

description.zh-cn: 明治维新成功后，在大久保利通的领导下负责处理外交事务。
description.en: After the success of the Meiji Restoration, he was responsible for foreign affairs under the leadership of Ōkubo Toshimichi.

description.zh-cn: 伊藤博文受命考察欧洲宪政后，领导了《大日本帝国宪法》的起草工作，并在其私人别墅中完成了草案的修改，被誉为“明治宪法之父”。
description.en: After being ordered to study European constitutionalism, Itō Hirobumi led the drafting of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan and completed revisions to the draft at his private villa. He is known as the "Father of the Meiji Constitution".

description.zh-cn: 在清廷戊戌变法时前往北京访问，面见光绪皇帝和康有为，提供改革方针。
description.en: Visited Beijing during the Qing court's Hundred Days' Reform, met with the Guangxu Emperor and Kang Youwei, and provided reform guidelines.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌政变后参与救援被捕的黄遵宪。
description.en: Participated in the rescue of the arrested Huang Zunxian after the 1898 Coup.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌政变后协助康有为逃往日本。
description.en: Assisted Kang Youwei in escaping to Japan after the 1898 Coup.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌政变后，梁启超在日本前首相伊藤博文的协助下成功逃往日本。
description.en: After the Wuxu Coup (1898 Coup), Liang Qichao successfully escaped to Japan with the assistance of former Japanese Prime Minister Itō Hirobumi.

description.zh-cn: 创立立宪政友会并自任总裁。
description.en: Founded the Rikken Seiyūkai and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 迫使大韩帝国签订《第三次日韩协约》，将大韩帝国变为日本的保护国。
description.en: Forced the Korean Empire to sign the Japan–Korea Treaty of 1907, making it a protectorate of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 该条约使大韩帝国沦为日本的保护国，丧失了内政与外交自主权。
description.en: This treaty reduced the Korean Empire to a Japanese protectorate, stripping it of its internal and diplomatic autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 反对立刻合并大韩帝国，属于日本政坛的温和派。
description.en: Opposed the immediate annexation of the Korean Empire, representing the moderate faction in Japanese politics.

description.zh-cn: 在哈尔滨与俄国财政大臣科科夫佐夫商谈。
description.en: Met with Russian Finance Minister Kokovtsov in Harbin for negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 实施了对伊藤博文的刺杀。
description.en: Carried out the assassination of Itō Hirobumi.

description.zh-cn: 伊藤博文的死使得日本国内主张立刻合并的强硬派势力抬头，加速了吞并朝鲜的进程。
description.en: The death of Itō Hirobumi strengthened the hardline faction in Japan that advocated for immediate annexation, accelerating the process of annexing Korea.

description.zh-cn: 韩非与李斯一同师从荀子。韩非的思想深受老师荀子影响，尤其是在尊君思想方面。
description.en: Han Fei, along with Li Si, studied under Xunzi. Han Fei's thought was deeply influenced by his teacher Xunzi, especially regarding the concept of revering the monarch.

description.zh-cn: 李斯初到秦国时，担任吕不韦的舍人。
在拥立胡亥为帝后，李斯继续担任丞相。
李斯劝说秦王政攻灭东方六国，并在统一事业中贡献良多。
上《谏逐客书》成功说服秦王政废除驱逐客卿的命令。
李斯因嫉妒韩非的才华，向秦王政进谗言，导致韩非下狱，并最终在狱中将其毒死。
description.en: Out of jealousy of Han Fei's talent, Li Si slandered him to King Zheng of Qin, leading to Han Fei's imprisonment and eventual death by poison in jail.

description.zh-cn: 秦统一后，丞相王绾建议秦始皇分封诸子为王。
博士淳于越以古为据，劝谏秦始皇实行分封。
李斯反对分封制，认为分封是导致战乱的根源。
李斯主张在全国推行郡县制以加强中央集权，该建议被秦始皇采纳。
为压制反对郡县制的言论，李斯建议秦始皇焚烧《诗》、《书》、百家语，以统一思想。
在秦始皇死后，赵高威逼利诱李斯参与伪造遗诏的沙丘之变。
李斯与赵高合谋，伪造秦始皇遗诏，拥立胡亥为帝。
赵高与李斯合谋，伪造秦始皇遗诏，拥立胡亥为帝。
李斯与赵高合谋，伪造遗诏，以不孝罪名赐死扶苏。
赵高与李斯合谋，伪造遗诏，以不孝罪名赐死扶苏。
赵高在独揽朝政后，进谗言诬陷李斯谋反，并主导了对李斯的审判和处决。
秦二世胡亥听信赵高谗言，下令将李斯处以五刑并腰斩，诛灭三族。
李由是李斯的长子。
在秦末战争中，李由被项羽杀死。
李斯在秦统一后担任丞相。
李斯因《谏逐客书》被秦王政赏识后，官至廷尉。
因参与2024年中华民国总统选举，由副市长刘和然于2023年9月23日至2024年1月14日代理职务。

position.zh-cn: 刑事警察大队分队长、侦查员、组长、副大队长、大队长

description.zh-cn: 历任多个职务，期间曾调任内政部警政署刑事警察局。
侯友宜是林郁智（纳豆）的表舅。
时任中山分局刑事组长，带队到《自由时代周刊》杂志社执行对郑南榕的拘捕，导致郑南榕自焚身亡。
在2018年新北市市长选举中，侯友宜击败了民主进步党籍的对手苏贞昌。
侯友宜代表中国国民党参选总统，但未能胜选。
中国国民党征召侯友宜参选2024年中华民国总统选举。
金溥聪出任侯友宜2024总统竞选办公室执行长。
侯友宜在此案中的角色引发刑求争议，对他造成负面影响。
时任促转会副主委的张天钦在内部会议中点名侯友宜是转型正义最恶劣的例子，并计划进行“操作”。
因郑南榕事件，叶菊兰批评侯友宜是“平庸的邪恶”。
因郑南榕事件，赖清德对侯友宜提出批评。
时任警政署长，启动“祥和专案”对运动进行监控。
陈进兴闯入南非武官官邸，挟持人质，引发此事件。
在南非武官挟持事件中，侯友宜进入官邸与陈进兴沟通。
在南非武官挟持事件中，陈进兴指名与谢长廷谈判。
在侯友宜请假参选总统期间，副市长刘和然代理市长职务。
张良是张平之子。
description.en: Zhang Liang was the son of Zhang Ping.

description.zh-cn: 张平是张开地之子。
description.en: Zhang Ping was the son of Zhang Kaidi.

description.zh-cn: 秦国于公元前230年灭亡韩国。
为替韩国复仇，在博浪沙伏击行刺秦始皇，但未成功。
曾帮助杀人后逃亡的项伯躲避秦廷的拘捕。
在下邳圯桥上赠予张良《太公兵法》。
张良通过研读《太公兵法》，成为杰出的谋士。
游说项梁拥立韩国公子韩成为韩王，以复兴韩国。
在韩成被立为韩王后，张良跟随并辅佐他，被封为韩国司徒。
在鸿门宴事件中，通过项伯斡旋并召来樊哙，帮助刘邦化解了被项羽攻击的危机；此外，建议刘邦首先封赏其最痛恨的雍齿，以此安定群臣之心，化解了潜在的造反危机；并与陈平一同主张撕毁鸿沟条约，立即攻击项羽，最终取得楚汉相争的胜利。
在鸿门宴上，应张良请求闯入宴席，斥责项羽，打断了项庄的刺杀企图，保护了刘邦。
因疑心韩成与刘邦勾结，先是阻止其就藩，后于公元前206年将其诛杀。
坚决反对郦食其建议刘邦分封六国后裔的计划，认为此举会引发后患。
应张良之策，并受太子刘盈之请出山辅佐。他们的出现使刘邦认识到太子羽翼已成，难以动摇，最终放弃了废黜太子的想法，从而稳固了刘盈的继承人地位。
description.en: At Zhang Liang's suggestion and Crown Prince Liu Ying's invitation, they emerged from seclusion to assist him. Their presence made Emperor Liu Bang realize that the prince's support was strong and unshakeable, leading him to abandon the idea of deposing the crown prince, thereby solidifying Liu Ying's position as heir.

description.zh-cn: 韩信与张良、萧何并称为“汉初三杰”。
为诛杀宦官，何进下令征召时任并州牧的董卓率兵进京（洛阳）。此举虽旨在加强自身力量以铲除宦官，却也为董卓控制中央政权创造了契机。
description.en: In order to eliminate the eunuchs, He Jin ordered Dong Zhuo, then Inspector of Bing Province, to lead his army to the capital (Luoyang). While this move was intended to strengthen He Jin's own power to eradicate the eunuchs, it also created the opportunity for Dong Zhuo to seize control of the central government.

description.zh-cn: 在董卓军进洛阳前，处死了何进。
入京掌控大权后，废黜汉少帝刘辩为弘农王，后命李儒将其毒杀。
description.en: After entering the capital and seizing power, he deposed Emperor Shao Liu Bian as Prince of Hongnong, and later ordered Li Ru to poison him.

description.zh-cn: 奉董卓之命，用毒酒杀害了已被废为弘农王的刘辩。
description.en: Under Dong Zhuo's orders, he poisoned Liu Bian, the deposed Prince of Hongnong.

description.zh-cn: 废黜汉少帝后，拥立年幼的陈留王刘协为帝，即汉献帝，以便于控制朝政。
description.en: After deposing Emperor Shao, he installed the young Prince of Chenliu, Liu Xie, as emperor (Emperor Xian) to facilitate his control over the court.

description.zh-cn: 关东诸侯以讨伐董卓为名起兵，其组成的联军对董卓的统治构成了严重军事威胁，迫使其放弃洛阳，迁都长安。
description.en: The Guandong warlords raised armies in the name of punishing Dong Zhuo. Their coalition army posed a serious military threat to Dong Zhuo's rule, forcing him to abandon Luoyang and move the capital to Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 作为关东联军的主要发起者和盟主之一。
为躲避关东联军的锋芒，胁迫汉献帝迁都至长安。
王允不满董卓的暴政，密谋策划了针对董卓的刺杀行动，并联合吕布将其诛杀。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Dong Zhuo's tyranny, Wang Yun secretly planned an assassination against Dong Zhuo and united with Lu Bu to execute him.

description.zh-cn: 李傕攻陷长安后，杀害了与吕布合谋刺杀董卓的王允，并族灭其三族。
description.en: After capturing Chang'an, Li Jue executed Wang Yun, who had conspired with Lu Bu to assassinate Dong Zhuo, and exterminated his entire clan.

description.zh-cn: 董卓死后，与李傕一同率兵攻入长安，杀害了王允。
兴平二年（195年），李傕与郭汜因权力争斗及妻妾挑拨而反目，率兵相互攻击，交战数月，死伤数以万计。
description.en: In 195, Li Jue and Guo Si turned against each other due to power struggles and incitement from their wives. They led their troops into mutual conflict, fighting for several months with tens of thousands of casualties.

description.zh-cn: 曹操是讨伐董卓的发起人之一，并参与了联军。在联军解散后，曾独自追击董卓军但被徐荣击败。
description.en: Cao Cao was one of the initiators of the campaign against Dong Zhuo and participated in the coalition. After the coalition disbanded, he pursued Dong Zhuo's army alone but was defeated by Xu Rong.

description.zh-cn: 徐荣在讨伐董卓之战的荥阳（汴水）战斗中，击败了追击董卓的曹操军队。
description.en: During the Battle of Xingyang (Bian River) in the campaign against Dong Zhuo, Xu Rong defeated Cao Cao's army who were pursuing Dong Zhuo.

description.zh-cn: 在讨董之战中斩杀了董卓的都督华雄。
董卓掌控朝政后自封的最高官职。
李渊于晋阳起兵反隋，最终取代隋朝。
强逼隋恭帝杨侑禅让皇位。

position.zh-cn: 尚书令、丞相、太原郡留守

description.zh-cn: 在起兵前，李渊曾担任隋朝的多个重要官职。
玄武门之变后，李渊被迫将皇位禅让给李世民，退居太上皇。
在玄武门之变中诛杀太子李建成。
在玄武门之变中诛杀齐王李元吉。
与太子李建成在继承权问题上明争暗斗。

于晋阳县正式起兵反隋。
起兵时杀害了郡丞王威。
起兵时杀害了武牙郎将高君雅。
向李渊提供500骑兵以助其进攻大兴城。
宇文化及在江都发动兵变，弑杀隋炀帝杨广。
description.en: Yuwen Huaji launched a coup in Jiangdu and assassinated Emperor Yang of Sui, Yang Guang.

description.zh-cn: 称帝后，李渊开始著手消灭其他诸侯、军阀，展开唐朝统一战争。
禅位给李世民后，退位为太上皇。
陈文清被广泛认为是习近平派系其中一员。

position.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记

description.zh-cn: 在以习近平为总书记的中共中央领导集体中担任职务。
在李克强担任总理的国务院中担任国家安全部部长。
被视为习近平的亲信之一。
主持召开中央政法委全体会议，强调“要坚决依法打击敌对势力渗透破坏活动，坚决依法打击扰乱社会秩序的违法犯罪行为，切实维护社会大局稳定”。
接替郭声琨出任中共中央政法委书记。
国家安全部部长职务由陈一新接任。
中国纪检监察学院院长职务由杨晓渡接任。
根据传统说法，此论为达摩口述亲传。
description.en: According to tradition, this treatise was orally transmitted by Bodhidharma.

description.zh-cn: 昙林记录了达摩口述的教法，形成了《二入四行论》。
description.en: Tanlin recorded the teachings orally transmitted by Bodhidharma, forming the 'Two Entrances and Four Practices'.

description.zh-cn: 禅宗祖师菩提达摩来华后，曾至金陵与梁武帝会谈。双方因理念不合而话不投机，最终达摩离开。
description.en: After Zen patriarch Bodhidharma came to China, he met with Emperor Wu of Liang in Jinling. However, due to fundamental philosophical disagreements, they could not concur, and Bodhidharma ultimately departed.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩在嵩山少林寺面壁九年，被称为“壁观婆罗门”。
description.en: Bodhidharma faced a wall in meditation for nine years at the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song, and was called the 'Wall-gazing Brahmin'.

description.zh-cn: 根据Infobox信息，达摩属于楞伽宗。
description.en: According to the infobox, Bodhidharma belonged to the Lankavatara school.

description.zh-cn: 从达摩至神秀皆重视《楞伽经》，被称为楞伽师。
description.en: From Bodhidharma to Shenxiu, all valued the Lankavatara Sutra and were known as Lankavatara masters.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩以四卷本《楞伽经》传授徒众。
description.en: Bodhidharma used the four-fascicle Lankavatara Sutra to teach his disciples.

description.zh-cn: 梁武帝萧衍是南朝梁的开国皇帝，在位时间近48年。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Liang (Xiao Yan) was the founding emperor of the Liang dynasty, reigning for nearly 48 years.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩乘船初到中国时，在南越地区（今广州）登陆。
description.en: When Bodhidharma first arrived in China by boat, he landed in the Nanyue region (present-day Guangzhou).

description.zh-cn: 相传华林寺（初名“西来庵”）为达摩所建。
description.en: It is said that Hualin Temple (originally named 'Xilai Abbey') was founded by Bodhidharma.

description.zh-cn: 光孝寺内有达摩“洗钵泉”遗迹。
description.en: Guangxiao Temple contains a relic known as Bodhidharma's 'bowl-washing spring'.

description.zh-cn: 张工在陈敏尔担任天津市委书记期间任副书记兼市长。
接替李鸿忠出任中共天津市委书记。
接替孙政才担任重庆市委书记。
接替陈敏尔担任重庆市委书记。

陈敏尔担任常务副省长时，夏宝龙为省长。

被外界广泛认为是之江新军主要成员之一。
习近平当选中央政治局常委后，钟绍军随同进入中央并担任此职。
晋升少将军衔。
晋升中将军衔。

方永祥接替钟绍军出任中央军事委员会办公厅主任。

服务于中央军委主席习近平。
服务于中央军委主席胡锦涛。
自1973年当选为中共中央政治局委员起，成为副国级领导人。
抗日战争期间，被推选为大寨村日组织“维持会”代表，后加入“兴亚会”。
毛泽东于1964年发出了“农业学大寨”的号召，推动了该运动在全国范围内的开展。
description.en: In 1964, Mao Zedong issued the call to 'learn from Dazhai in agriculture,' promoting the movement nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东号召“农业学大寨”，并在文化大革命期间肯定和提拔陈永贵，使其进入中共中央领导层。
description.en: Mao Zedong launched the 'In agriculture, learn from Dazhai' campaign and affirmed and promoted Chen Yonggui during the Cultural Revolution, enabling him to enter the central leadership of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵在文化大革命期间获得毛泽东的肯定，政治地位迅速提升，最终进入中共中央领导层。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Chen Yonggui gained Mao Zedong's approval, and his political status rose rapidly, eventually entering the central leadership of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 1967年，周恩来在接见陈永贵时授意他可以组织自己的红卫兵，在政治上支持了陈永贵。
description.en: In 1967, when meeting with Chen Yonggui, Zhou Enlai suggested that he could organize his own Red Guards, providing him with political support.

description.zh-cn: 时任山西一把手的谢振华与陈永贵在农业政策上存在分歧，并试图以陈永贵的历史问题为借口将其整下台。然而，因毛泽东支持陈永贵，谢振华未能成功，最终被调离山西。
description.en: Xie Zhenhua, then the top leader in Shanxi, had disagreements with Chen Yonggui on agricultural policy and attempted to bring him down using his historical issues as a pretext. However, due to Mao Zedong's support for Chen, Xie Zhenhua was unsuccessful and was eventually transferred out of Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 拨乱反正运动否定了文化大革命时期的极左路线，导致以陈永贵为代表的“大寨模式”终结及其本人被迫辞职。
description.en: The Boluan Fanzheng movement negated the ultra-left line of the Cultural Revolution, leading to the end of the 'Dazhai model' represented by Chen Yonggui and his forced resignation.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放推行的新政策与陈永贵坚持的集体化路线根本对立，导致其政治生涯的结束。
description.en: The new policies implemented by the Reform and Opening-up were fundamentally opposed to the collectivization line that Chen Yonggui adhered to, leading to the end of his political career.

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵曾劝说华国锋不要让邓小平复出。在邓小平复出后，陈永贵极力反对其改革开放政策，并当面质问邓小平是否还执行毛主席路线，此举被邓小平驳斥。
description.en: Chen Yonggui advised Hua Guofeng not to rehabilitate Deng Xiaoping. After Deng's return, Chen strongly opposed his Reform and Opening-up policies and publicly questioned whether Deng was still following Chairman Mao's revolutionary line, an action that was refuted by Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 1977年9月，波尔布特访华期间参观大寨。同年12月，陈永贵回访柬埔寨，波尔布特陪同其访问。
description.en: In September 1977, Pol Pot visited Dazhai during his visit to China. In December of the same year, Chen Yonggui paid a return visit to Cambodia, accompanied by Pol Pot.

description.zh-cn: 在访问柬埔寨后，公开赞扬红色高棉实现了共产主义。
红色高棉在其统治期间推行极端政策，导致了大屠杀的发生。
因胡耀邦批评大寨模式是“劳民伤财”，陈永贵辱骂胡耀邦为“狗日的”和“胡乱邦”。
description.en: After Hu Yaobang criticized the Dazhai model as 'wasting manpower and resources,' Chen Yonggui insulted him, calling him a 'son of a bitch' and 'Hu Luanbang' (Hu the reckless).

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵在全国推行“割资本主义尾巴”的左倾政策。
陈永贵于1952年接替贾进才出任大寨大队支部书记。
1885年考入炮兵科一期，1887年以最优等毕业。
description.en: Enrolled in the first class of the artillery department in 1885 and graduated with top honors in 1887.

description.zh-cn: 1889年春抵达柏林，在普鲁士军官学校学习军事理论与操练。
description.en: Arrived in Berlin in the spring of 1889 to study military theory and practice at a Prussian military school.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯在天津小站练兵时，段祺瑞主管砲兵。
description.en: When Yuan Shikai was training the New Army at Xiaozhan, Tianjin, Duan Qirui was in charge of the artillery.

description.zh-cn: 《共和之电》向隆裕太后施压，是促成清帝退位的关键文件之一。
description.en: The 'Telegram for the Republic' pressured Empress Dowager Longyu and was a key document in bringing about the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞联名发布《共和之电》并以武力威胁，向隆裕太后逼宫，促使其下诏清帝退位。
description.en: Duan Qirui co-signed the 'Telegram for the Republic' and used military threats to pressure Empress Dowager Longyu into issuing the abdication edict for the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 《共和之电》由徐树铮起草。
description.en: The 'Telegram for the Republic' was drafted by Xu Shuzheng.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞表示不拥护袁世凯推行的洪宪帝制。
description.en: Duan Qirui expressed his non-support for the Hongxian Monarchy promoted by Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞在梁启超等人支持下，于天津马厂誓师组织讨逆军，迅速击败张勋，平定了复辟。此后，段祺瑞于7月14日复任国务总理。
description.en: With the support of Liang Qichao and others, Duan Qirui rallied his troops at Tianjin's Machang, formed a punitive army, and quickly defeated Zhang Xun, quelling the Manchu Restoration. Subsequently, Duan Qirui was reappointed Premier of the State Council on July 14.

description.zh-cn: 两人对于以何种方式统一中国意见相左，发生第二次府院之争。
description.en: The two had conflicting views on how to unify China, leading to the second 'Mansion-Courtyard Rivalry'.

description.zh-cn: 皖军在直皖战争中战败，皖系势力被瓦解，段祺瑞因此失势下野。
description.en: The Anhui clique's army was defeated in the Zhili-Anhui War, leading to the collapse of its power and forcing Duan Qirui to step down from office.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥发动甲子政变，推翻了大总统曹锟。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang launched the Beijing Coup, overthrowing President Cao Kun.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥发动甲子政变（1924年10月）后，邀请段祺瑞出山。随后冯玉祥与张作霖会晤，共同推举段祺瑞担任中华民国临时执政。
description.en: After launching the Beijing Coup (October 1924), Feng Yuxiang invited Duan Qirui to come out of retirement. Subsequently, after meeting with Zhang Zuolin, Feng and Zhang jointly recommended Duan Qirui to serve as the Provisional Chief Executive of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 惨案的发生导致段祺瑞执政府众叛亲离，并最终于同年4月下野。
description.en: The massacre caused Duan Qirui's government to lose all support, leading to his downfall in April of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 1926年4月9日，冯玉祥部将鹿钟麟率兵包围执政府，将临时执政段祺瑞驱逐入东交民巷，迫使其下野，结束了其统治。
description.en: On April 9, 1926, Lu Zhonglin, a general under Feng Yuxiang, led his troops to surround the executive government, forcing Provisional Chief Executive Duan Qirui into the Legation Quarter, making him step down and ending his rule.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变前，日本关东军特务机关长土肥原贤二多次在天津秘密会晤段祺瑞等人，欲扶植其为代理人。
description.en: Before the Mukden Incident, Kenji Doihara, head of the Kwantung Army's special service, secretly met with Duan Qirui and others in Tianjin multiple times, intending to install him as a Japanese puppet.

description.zh-cn: 为防止段祺瑞被日本人利用，蒋介石邀请其南下上海定居。
description.en: To prevent Duan Qirui from being used by the Japanese, Chiang Kai-shek invited him to move south and reside in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在冯玉祥发动甲子政变后，段祺瑞出山成立中华民国临时政府。
description.en: After Feng Yuxiang launched the Beijing Coup, Duan Qirui came out of retirement to establish the Provisional Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1902年，徐树铮投奔段祺瑞并担任其记室，后成为其重要幕僚和亲信。
description.en: In 1902, Xu Shuzheng joined Duan Qirui as his secretary and later became his key advisor and confidant.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞为推行“武力统一”政策，派兵镇压孙中山倡导的护法运动。
description.en: To implement his policy of 'unification by force', Duan Qirui dispatched troops to suppress the Constitutional Protection Movement advocated by Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞主张武力统一，与领导护法运动的孙中山在政治和军事上对立。
description.en: Duan Qirui advocated for military unification, placing him in political and military opposition to Sun Yat-sen, who led the Constitutional Protection Movement.

description.zh-cn: 王金平出生于日治台湾高雄州冈山郡路竹庄。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng was born in Luzhu Zhuang, Okayama District, Takao Prefecture, Japanese Taiwan.

degree.en: Junior and Senior High School graduate

description.zh-cn: 王金平毕业于台湾省立台南第一中学（今国立台南第一高级中学）初中部及高中部。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng graduated from the junior and senior high school departments of Taiwan Provincial Tainan First Senior High School (now National Tainan First Senior High School).

description.zh-cn: 王金平考入台湾省立师范学院（今国立台湾师范大学）数学系并毕业。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng was admitted to and graduated from the Department of Mathematics at Taiwan Provincial Normal College (now National Taiwan Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 王金平于2000年被选为中国国民党副主席。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng was elected as the Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang in 2000.

description.zh-cn: 特侦组指控王金平为立法委员柯建铭的司法案件进行关说，引发九月政争。
description.en: The Special Investigation Division accused Wang Jin-pyng of improper lobbying in a judicial case involving legislator Ker Chien-ming, triggering the September Strife.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统兼国民党主席的马英九召开记者会严厉批判王金平，并推动国民党考纪会撤销其党籍，是九月政争的主要推手。
description.en: Then-President and KMT Chairman Ma Ying-jeou held press conferences to severely criticize Wang Jin-pyng and pushed the KMT's Discipline Committee to revoke his party membership, acting as the main driver of the September Strife.

description.zh-cn: 在九月政争期间，王金平被国民党考纪会决议撤销党籍，面临失去不分区立委及立法院长资格的危机。后经司法诉讼及国民党新任主席朱立伦停止诉讼，才确认党籍。
description.en: During the September Strife, the KMT Discipline Committee resolved to revoke Wang Jin-pyng's party membership, facing the crisis of losing his legislator-at-large status and his position as President of the Legislative Yuan. His membership was only confirmed after legal proceedings and the new KMT Chairman Eric Chu's decision to drop the lawsuit.

description.zh-cn: 因被指控在王金平的关说案中涉入，曾勇夫被迫请辞法务部部长。
description.en: Tseng Yung-fu was forced to resign as Minister of Justice due to his alleged involvement in the lobbying case concerning Wang Jin-pyng.

description.zh-cn: 国民党新任主席朱立伦宣布停止对王金平党籍案的诉讼，确认其保有党籍。
description.en: The new KMT chairman, Eric Chu, announced the cessation of the lawsuit concerning Wang Jin-pyng's party membership, confirming that he retained his membership.

description.zh-cn: 为回应太阳花学运，立法院长王金平承诺在《两岸协议监督条例》完成立法前，不召集《服贸协议》的相关党团协商会议，实际上搁置了该协议。
description.en: In response to the Sunflower Student Movement, Legislative Yuan President Wang Jin-pyng promised not to convene party caucus negotiations on the Service Trade Agreement until the Cross-Strait Agreement Supervisory Bill was enacted, effectively shelving the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 为结束太阳花学运，王金平承诺优先处理《两岸协议监督条例》的立法，将其作为审查《服贸协议》的前提条件。
description.en: To end the Sunflower Student Movement, Wang Jin-pyng promised to prioritize the legislation of the Cross-Strait Agreement Supervisory Bill as a precondition for reviewing the Service Trade Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 林锡山长期担任立法院秘书长，是时任立法院院长王金平的幕僚长。
description.en: Lin Hsi-shan served for a long time as the Secretary-General of the Legislative Yuan, acting as the chief of staff to then-President of the Legislative Yuan Wang Jin-pyng.

position.en: Vice President of the Legislative Yuan

description.zh-cn: 王金平在刘松藩担任立法院院长期间，任立法院副院长。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng served as the Vice President of the Legislative Yuan while Liu Sung-pan was the President.

description.zh-cn: 王金平在连战担任中国国民党主席期间，任副主席。
description.en: Wang Jin-pyng served as Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang while Lien Chan was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 白行简是白居易的弟弟。
description.en: Bai Xingjian is Bai Juyi's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 白居易与元稹订交后，成为终身挚友。他们文学见解相似，齐名并称“元白”，共同倡导新乐府运动。
description.en: After becoming friends, Bai Juyi and Yuan Zhen formed a lifelong friendship. They shared similar literary views, were equally famous as 'Yuan-Bai,' and jointly advocated for the New Yuefu Movement.

description.zh-cn: 白居易晚年与刘禹锡交好，时常一同游览、唱和诗作，并称“刘白”。
description.en: In his later years, Bai Juyi was good friends with Liu Yuxi. They often traveled together and exchanged poems, and were known as 'Liu Bai'.

description.zh-cn: 在白居易早年拜访时，顾况对其诗篇大加赞赏并为之延誉，使其声名大振。
description.en: When Bai Juyi visited him in his early years, Gu Kuang highly praised his poems and helped promote his reputation, making him famous.

description.zh-cn: 当唐宪宗对白居易的直言感到不快时，李绛为白居易辩护，认为这是其忠心的表现。
description.en: When Emperor Xianzong was displeased with Bai Juyi's directness, Li Jiang defended Bai Juyi, arguing it was a sign of his loyalty.

description.zh-cn: 815年，宰相武元衡遇刺后，白居易上表主张严缉凶手。因其越职言事且被诽谤，唐宪宗遂将其贬为江州司马。
description.en: In 815, after Chancellor Wu Yuanheng was assassinated, Bai Juyi submitted a memorial urging a strict investigation. Deemed to have overstepped his authority and also slandered, Emperor Xianzong consequently demoted him to Sima of Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 曾褒白居易为“诗仙”，并在其去世后作吊唁诗，评价其一生。
description.en: He praised Bai Juyi as the 'Poet Immortal' and wrote a eulogy poem after his death, summarizing his life.

description.zh-cn: 白居易是新乐府运动的主要倡导者，主张“文章合为时而著，歌诗合为事而作”，强调诗歌应反映社会现实。
description.en: Bai Juyi was a major proponent of the New Yuefu Movement, advocating that 'essays should be written for the times, and poems should be created for events', emphasizing that poetry should reflect social reality.

description.zh-cn: 白居易在江州司马任上创作了长篇叙事诗《琵琶行》。
description.en: Bai Juyi authored the long narrative poem 'The Pipa Player' while serving as Sima of Jiangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 亲自编辑了自己的文集《白氏长庆集》。
description.en: Personally edited his own literary collection, 'Collected Works of Bai Juyi'.

description.zh-cn: 在白居易离任杭州时，元稹要求他交出全部作品，亲自编纂成《白氏长庆集》，并为此书作序。
description.en: When Bai Juyi was leaving his post in Hangzhou, Yuan Zhen asked him to hand over all his works, personally compiled them into the 'Bai's Changqing Collection', and wrote the preface for it.

description.zh-cn: 《长恨歌》是关于唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情故事。
description.en: The 'Song of Everlasting Regret' is about the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.

description.zh-cn: 《长恨歌》是关于唐玄宗与杨贵妃的爱情故事。
description.en: The 'Song of Everlasting Regret' is about the love story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.

description.zh-cn: 郑小龙是古龙与郑月霞的儿子。
description.en: Zheng Xiaolong is the son of Gu Long and Zheng Yuexia.

description.zh-cn: 1957年秋，古龙考入淡江英专（淡江大学前身）夜间部英语科，大二时因谋生而辍学。
description.en: In the autumn of 1957, Gu Long was admitted to the English Department of the Evening Division at Tamkang English College (the predecessor of Tamkang University), but later dropped out during his sophomore year to make a living.

description.zh-cn: 传闻古龙在离家出走后，曾短暂加入学生帮派四海帮。
description.en: It is rumored that after running away from home, Gu Long briefly joined the student gang, the Four Seas Gang.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡代表香港《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了小说《绝代双骄》的诞生。
description.en: Representing Hong Kong's Ming Pao newspaper, Ni Kuang commissioned a manuscript from Gu Long, which led to the creation of the novel 'Juedai Shuangjiao'.

description.zh-cn: 金庸在自己封笔后，于1972年亲自为旗下的《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了《陆小凤》系列的创作，此举有世代传承的意味。
description.en: After retiring from writing, Jin Yong personally invited Gu Long in 1972 to write for his newspaper Ming Pao, which led to the creation of the 'Lu Xiaofeng Series'. This act was seen as a passing of the torch between generations.

description.zh-cn: 香港邵氏兄弟公司于1976年将古龙小说《流星·蝴蝶·剑》及《天涯‧明月‧刀》改编成电影并大获成功，开创了古龙的电影时代，使其作品声名鹊起。
description.en: In 1976, Hong Kong's Shaw Brothers Studio successfully adapted Gu Long's novels 'Meteor, Butterfly, Sword' and 'The Magic Blade' into films, initiating the Gu Long movie era and skyrocketing the popularity of his works.

description.zh-cn: 在1980年的吟松阁事件中，因古龙不愿向柯俊雄敬酒，柯的友人叶庆辉等人用刀刺伤古龙，导致其身受重伤。
description.en: During the 1980 Yinsong Pavilion incident, Gu Long was unwilling to offer a toast to Ko Chun-hsiung. As a result, Ko's associate Ye Qinghui and others stabbed and severely injured Gu Long.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，《中国时报》因认为小说《天涯‧明月‧刀》的理念过于前卫，在连载中途将其停止刊登（腰斩）。
description.en: In 1974, the China Times discontinued the serialization of the novel 'Tianya, Mingyue, Dao' midway, deeming its concepts too avant-garde.

description.zh-cn: 古龙于1938年6月7日出生于香港。
description.en: Gu Long was born in Hong Kong on June 7, 1938.

description.zh-cn: 古龙去世后，时任行政院长俞国华为其墓碑题字“英才早凋”，此举是对其文学成就的官方肯定和纪念。
description.en: After Gu Long's death, then-Premier Yu Kuo-hwa inscribed 'A brilliant talent passed away too soon' on his tombstone, an act of official recognition and commemoration of his literary achievements.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是王思聪的父亲。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is the father of Wang Sicong.

description.zh-cn: 王健林出生于四川省绵阳专区第二人民医院。
description.en: Wang Jianlin was born in the Second People's Hospital of Mianyang Prefecture, Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 1978年进入大连陆军学院学习，1979年8月毕业。
description.en: He entered the Dalian Army Academy for studies in 1978 and graduated in August 1979.

description.zh-cn: 1983年就读辽宁大学党政专修班，1986年毕业获得经济管理专业的学位。
description.en: He attended the Party and Government Cadre training class at Liaoning University from 1983, graduating in 1986 with a degree in Economic Management.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王健林是大连万达集团股份有限公司的董事长。
description.en: Wang Jianlin is the Chairman of Dalian Wanda Group.

description.zh-cn: 王健林接手大连足球队后，成立了大连万达足球俱乐部。
description.en: After taking over the Dalian football team, Wang Jianlin founded the Dalian Wanda Football Club.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，万达集团以26亿美元并购了全球第二大影院公司AMC。
description.en: In 2012, Wanda Group acquired AMC, the world's second-largest cinema chain, for $2.6 billion.

description.zh-cn: 2012年底，万达集团成立万达文化产业集团。
description.en: At the end of 2012, Wanda Group established the Wanda Cultural Industry Group.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团将13个万达文化旅游项目91%的股权以438.44亿人民币出售给融创中国。
description.en: Wanda Group sold 91% of its stake in 13 cultural tourism projects to Sunac China for 43.844 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团将旗下77家酒店项目以199.06亿人民币出售给富力地产。
description.en: Wanda Group sold 77 of its hotel projects to R&F Properties for 19.906 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 万达集团与中国足协达成战略合作，承诺三年内至少出资5亿元人民币，全面支援中国足球振兴。
description.en: Wanda Group reached a strategic partnership with the Chinese Football Association, promising to invest at least 500 million RMB over three years to fully support the revitalization of Chinese football.

description.zh-cn: 在百万大裁军的背景下，王健林从军队转业，进入地方政府工作，为其后来的商业生涯奠定了基础。
description.en: Against the backdrop of the one-million-man military reduction, Wang Jianlin transitioned from the army to local government, laying the foundation for his later business career.

description.zh-cn: 由于冠状病毒大流行，王健林的房地产和影视事业都急剧下降，导致其财富缩水并跌出富豪榜前列。
description.en: Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, Wang Jianlin's real estate and film businesses declined sharply, causing his wealth to shrink and drop him from the top ranks of the rich list.

description.zh-cn: 王义全曾是中国工农红军红四方面军成员，参加过长征。
description.en: Wang Yiquan was a member of the Fourth Front Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army and participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军进行了长征军事转移。
description.en: The Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army undertook the Long March military retreat.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是康熙帝的第八子。
description.en: Yinsi was the eighth son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允禩的生母是良妃卫氏。
description.en: Yinsi's biological mother was Consort Liang, née Wei.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，将允禩革去爵位、开除宗籍、勒令改名，并将其圈禁于宗人府，允禩最终在拘禁中病故。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor stripped Yinsi of his titles, expelled him from the imperial clan, forced him to change his name, and imprisoned him in the Imperial Clan Court, where Yinsi eventually died.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是雍正帝的异母弟。
description.en: Yinsi was the younger half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允禩在九子夺嫡中失败，未能继承皇位，并为其后来的悲惨结局埋下伏笔。
description.en: Yinsi failed in the nine sons' succession struggle, did not inherit the throne, which foreshadowed his later tragic end.

description.zh-cn: 在九子夺嫡期间，允禩是争夺储君之位的主要人物之一，与时为皇太子的胤礽形成政治对立。
description.en: During the nine sons' succession struggle, Yinsi was one of the main contenders for the position of crown prince, forming a political opposition to the then Crown Prince Yinreng.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆四十三年，乾隆帝下旨恢复允禩的原名，并将其及其子孙重新录入玉牒，恢复宗籍。
description.en: In 1778, the Qianlong Emperor issued an edict to restore Yinsi's original name and re-admit him and his descendants into the imperial genealogy, restoring their clan status.

description.zh-cn: 郭络罗氏是允禩的嫡福晋。
description.en: Guoluoluo was the primary consort of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 雍正四年正月，雍正帝下令革去郭络罗氏的福晋头衔，并将其逐回母家。
description.en: In January 1726, the Yongzheng Emperor ordered that Guoluoluo be stripped of her title as consort and sent back to her maternal home.

description.zh-cn: 弘旺是允禩的儿子。
description.en: Hongwang was the son of Yinsi.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝即位后，下令恢复弘旺的原名。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Qianlong Emperor ordered the restoration of Hongwang's original name.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝下令将获罪的皇三子弘时过继给允禩为子嗣。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor ordered his disgraced third son, Hongshi, to be adopted into Yinsi's lineage as his heir.

description.zh-cn: 康熙三十七年，17岁的允禩受封为多罗贝勒。
description.en: In 1698, the 17-year-old Yinsi was ennobled as a Duoluo Beile.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，允禩任理藩院尚书。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, Yinsi served as the Minister of the Lifan Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，允禩负责管理工部事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, Yinsi was in charge of the affairs of the Ministry of Works.

description.zh-cn: 雍正四年，允禩被削去宗籍后，发往正蓝旗卓鼐佐领下。
description.en: In 1726, after being expelled from the imperial clan, Yinsi was dispatched to the Plain Blue Banner under Zuoling Zhuo Nai.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，命允禩与允祥、马齐、隆科多四人总理事务。
description.en: After the Yongzheng Emperor's accession, he appointed Yinsi, Yunxiang, Maci, and Longkodo to jointly manage state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 郭络罗氏是安亲王岳乐的外孙女。
description.en: Guoluoluo was the maternal granddaughter of Prince An Yue Le.

description.zh-cn: 允禩幼时由惠妃抚养。
description.en: Yinsi was raised by Consort Hui during his childhood.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是胤禔的异母弟。
description.en: Yinsi was the younger half-brother of Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 康熙四十二年，康熙帝命令书法家何焯为允禩的侍读。
description.en: In 1703, the Kangxi Emperor ordered the calligrapher He Zhuo to be Yinsi's attendant-reader.

description.zh-cn: 允禩是和硕悫靖公主的异母兄。
description.en: Yinsi was the elder half-brother of Princess Heshuo Quejing.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央政治局委员，接受中共中央总书记习近平的领导。
description.en: As a member of the Politburo, he is under the leadership of CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在担任天津市市长期间，市委书记是李鸿忠。
description.en: During his tenure as Mayor of Tianjin, the Municipal Party Secretary was Li Hongzhong.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中共重庆市委副书记和重庆市市长期间，市委书记是孙政才。
description.en: During his tenure as Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Chongqing, the Municipal Party Secretary was Sun Zhengcai.

description.zh-cn: 参加哈佛大学商学院高级管理培训班的学习。
description.en: Attended the Advanced Management Program at Harvard Business School.

position.zh-cn: 副总裁，党委书记，总裁；总经理、党组副书记
position.en: Vice President, Party Secretary, President; General Manager, Deputy Party Secretary

description.zh-cn: 1996年晋升公司副总裁；1998年起兼任党委书记；2004年4月任北方工业公司总裁。2008年10月至2013年4月任总经理、党组副书记。
description.en: Promoted to Vice President in 1996; served concurrently as Party Secretary from 1998; appointed President of Norinco in April 2004. From October 2008 to April 2013, served as General Manager and Deputy Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十届一中全会上当选为中共中央政治局委员，晋升副国级。
description.en: Was elected as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, promoted to a sub-national level leader.

description.zh-cn: 在十四届全国人大一次会议上，经国务院总理李强提名，当选为国务院副总理。
description.en: At the First Session of the 14th National People's Congress, he was elected Vice Premier of the State Council upon nomination by Premier Li Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 共同担任中华人民共和国国务院副总理。
description.en: Serve together as Vice Premiers of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替陈求发担任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Chen Qiufa as Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 郝鹏接替张国清担任中共辽宁省委书记。
description.en: Hao Peng succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替王东峰担任天津市市长。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Wang Dongfeng as Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 廖国勋接替张国清担任天津市市长。
description.en: Liao Guoxun succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 张国清接替黄奇帆担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Zhang Guoqing succeeded Huang Qifan as Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 唐良智接替张国清担任重庆市市长。
description.en: Tang Liangzhi succeeded Zhang Guoqing as Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 作为国家主席习近平特别代表出席在德黑兰举行的伊朗已故总统莱希吊唁活动。
description.en: As the special representative of President Xi Jinping, attended the memorial service for the late Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi in Tehran.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来是薄一波的次子。
description.en: Bo Xilai is the second son of Bo Yibo.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来是胡明之子。
description.en: Bo Xilai is the son of Hu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来与薄谷开来于1987年结婚。
description.en: Bo Xilai and Bo Gu Kailai married in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 李望知是薄熙来与前妻李丹宇所生的长子。
description.en: Li Wangzhi is the eldest son of Bo Xilai and his ex-wife Li Danyu.

description.zh-cn: 薄瓜瓜是薄熙来与妻子薄谷开来所生的幼子。
description.en: Bo Guagua is the youngest son of Bo Xilai and his wife Bo Gu Kailai.

description.zh-cn: 对海伍德死亡案的复查揭示了薄熙来家庭的犯罪行为，成为其被立案调查的关键原因之一。
description.en: The re-investigation of the Neil Heywood death case exposed the criminal activities of Bo Xilai's family, becoming a key reason for the official investigation against him.

description.zh-cn: 文强是薄熙来“打黑”运动中的重点打击对象，最终被判处死刑。
description.en: Wen Qiang was a key target in Bo Xilai's 'strike black' campaign and was ultimately sentenced to death.

description.zh-cn: 王立军与薄熙来决裂后，进入美国领事馆，揭露了薄家的内幕，成为薄熙来的主要政治对手。
description.en: After breaking with Bo Xilai, Wang Lijun entered the U.S. consulate and exposed the Bo family's secrets, becoming Bo's primary political adversary.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，时任总理温家宝反对薄熙来晋升为副总理，并在2012年两会记者会上公开批评重庆市委，对薄熙来的倒台起到了关键作用。
description.en: Then-Premier Wen Jiabao reportedly opposed Bo Xilai's promotion to Vice Premier and played a key role in his downfall by publicly criticizing the Chongqing Municipal Committee at a 2012 press conference.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，薄熙来在重庆发起窃听行动，其监控对象包括时任中共中央总书记胡锦涛。
description.en: Bo Xilai reportedly initiated an eavesdropping operation in Chongqing, with targets including then-General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来在主政重庆期间，作为主要设计者和推动者，推行了以“唱红打黑”和注重民生为特点的“重庆模式”。
description.en: During his tenure in Chongqing, Bo Xilai, as the main architect and promoter, promoted the 'Chongqing Model', characterized by 'singing red songs and striking black' and a focus on people's livelihood.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来担任商务部长期间，中国商务部颁给蚁力神公司直销执照。
description.en: While Bo Xilai was Minister of Commerce, the Ministry of Commerce granted a direct selling license to the Yilishen company.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是醇贤亲王奕𫍽的第五子。
description.en: Zaifeng was the fifth son of Yixuan, Prince Chun the First.

description.zh-cn: 载沣的生母是奕𫍽的侧福晋刘佳氏。
description.en: Zaifeng's biological mother was Yixuan's secondary consort, Lady Liuja.

description.zh-cn: 奕𫍽是道光皇帝的第七子。
description.en: Yixuan was the seventh son of the Daoguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是光绪帝（载湉）的异母弟。
description.en: Zaifeng was the younger half-brother of the Guangxu Emperor (Zaitian).

description.zh-cn: 嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏，大学士荣禄之女，是载沣的元配妻子。
description.en: Primary Consort Gūwalgiya, daughter of Grand Secretary Ronglu, was Zaifeng's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏是大学士荣禄之女。
description.en: Primary Consort Gūwalgiya was the daughter of the Grand Secretary Ronglu.

description.zh-cn: 溥杰是载沣的次子。
description.en: Pujie was the second son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 溥任是载沣的第四子。
description.en: Puren was the fourth son of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后在临终前发布懿旨，授载沣为摄政王，监国辅佐幼帝。
description.en: Before her death, Empress Dowager Cixi issued an edict appointing Zaifeng as the Prince-Regent to govern and assist the young emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在决定光绪帝继任者时，张之洞曾与世续共同上奏，建议直接拥立载沣为帝，后又建议给予他摄政王的封号。
description.en: When deciding the successor to the Guangxu Emperor, Zhang Zhidong, along with Shixu, proposed to enthrone Zaifeng directly as emperor, and later suggested granting him the title of Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 根据慈禧太后的安排，载沣作为摄政王在遇到重大事件时，需请示隆裕太后懿旨施行。
description.en: According to Empress Dowager Cixi's arrangements, Zaifeng, as the Prince-Regent, was required to seek instructions from Empress Dowager Longyu for implementation when encountering major events.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义的爆发引发了全国性的辛亥革命，导致清廷统治动摇，载沣被迫交出权力并辞去摄政王之位。
description.en: The outbreak of the Wuchang Uprising triggered the nationwide Xinhai Revolution, shaking Qing rule and forcing Zaifeng to relinquish power and resign as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 在袁世凯的劝说下，隆裕太后命令载沣辞去监国摄政王职位。
description.en: Persuaded by Yuan Shikai, Empress Dowager Longyu ordered Zaifeng to resign from his position as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 在辛亥革命的浪潮中，载沣被迫辞去监国摄政王的职务。
description.en: In the tide of the Xinhai Revolution, Zaifeng was forced to resign from his position as Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝的实际统治者，载沣的肖像被印在1910年大清银行发行的兑换券上。
description.en: As the de facto ruler of the Qing dynasty, Zaifeng's portrait was printed on the exchange notes issued by the Ta-Ching Government Bank in 1910.

description.zh-cn: 庚子事变后，载沣被授为头等专使，赴德国为德国公使被杀一事道歉。
description.en: After the Boxer Rebellion, Zaifeng was appointed as a first-class special envoy to Germany to apologize for the killing of the German minister.

description.zh-cn: 载沣是清朝皇族成员，并担任过军机大臣、监国摄政王等要职。
description.en: Zaifeng was a member of the Qing imperial family and held important positions such as Grand Councilor and Prince-Regent.

description.zh-cn: 载沣于光绪九年（1883年）出生于北京太平湖醇亲王府。
description.en: Zaifeng was born in the Prince Chun Mansion at Taiping Lake, Beijing, in 1883 (the 9th year of the Guangxu reign).

description.zh-cn: 载沣在北京病故，并葬于北京西郊福田公墓。
description.en: Zaifeng died of illness in Beijing and was buried in the Futian Cemetery in the western suburbs of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 肖建华出生于山东省泰安地区肥城县（今肥城市）安驾庄镇夏辉村。
description.en: Xiao Jianhua was born in Xiahui Village, Anjiazhuang Town, Feicheng County (now Feicheng City), Tai'an Prefecture, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，年仅14岁的肖建华作为泰安市高考状元进入北京大学法律系就读。
description.en: In 1986, at the age of 14, Xiao Jianhua entered the Law Department of Peking University as the top scorer of the college entrance examination in Tai'an City.

description.zh-cn: 在校期间曾担任全国学联副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the All-China Students' Federation during his time at the university.

description.zh-cn: 对被告人肖建华数罪并罚，决定执行有期徒刑13年，并处罚金人民币650万元。
description.en: Sentenced the defendant Xiao Jianhua to 13 years in prison for multiple crimes and imposed a fine of RMB 6.5 million.

description.zh-cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，肖建华在六四事件期间与校方合作试图平息抗议，毕业后在北京大学的资助下经商，其财富被认为与此段经历有关。
description.en: According to The New York Times, Xiao Jianhua cooperated with the university to quell protests during the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident. He started his business with funding from Peking University after graduation, and his wealth is believed to be related to this experience.

description.zh-cn: 据《纽约时报》报道，毕业之后，肖建华在北京大学的直接资助下步入了商界。
description.en: According to The New York Times, after graduation, Xiao Jianhua entered the business world with direct funding from Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 《纽约时报》发文揭秘了肖建华和马云之间的隐秘商业联系。
description.en: The New York Times published an article revealing the secret business connections between Xiao Jianhua and Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 依法委托机构托管明天系旗下的新时代证券、国盛证券、国盛期货。
description.en: Legally entrusted institutions to take custody of New Times Securities, Guosheng Securities, and Guosheng Futures under the Tomorrow Group.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共一大代表，是中国共产党的创始人之一。
description.en: As a delegate to the First National Congress of the CCP, he was one of the founders of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 因张国焘投靠中国国民党而被开除党籍。
description.en: Expelled from the party after defecting to the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在投靠国民党后，加入军统从事反共特务活动。
description.en: After defecting to the Kuomintang, he joined the Bureau of Investigation and Statistics to engage in anti-communist secret service activities.

description.zh-cn: 长征途中，红一、四方面军会师后，张国焘与毛泽东在战略方针上产生严重分歧，张国焘坚持南下并另立“中央”，宣布开除毛泽东党籍，导致党内分裂。此后，第一军和由红三军团改编的陕甘支队被迫单独北上。1937年3月，张国焘遭到批判斗争。
description.en: During the Long March, after the rendezvous of the First and Fourth Front Armies, Zhang Guotao and Mao Zedong had serious disagreements on strategic direction. Zhang Guotao insisted on going south, established a rival 'Central Committee', and announced the expulsion of Mao Zedong from the party, leading to a split. Subsequently, the First Army and the Shaanxi-Gansu Detachment (reorganized from the Third Red Army Corps) were forced to march north alone. In March 1937, Zhang Guotao was criticized and struggled against.

description.zh-cn: 向毛泽东报告了张国焘要求武力解决分歧的密电，促使毛泽东率领中央纵队先行北上。
description.en: Reported to Mao Zedong about Zhang Guotao's secret cable demanding a forceful resolution of their differences, which prompted Mao to lead the central column north ahead of schedule.

description.zh-cn: 发动了白雀园肃反运动。
description.en: Launched the Baiqueyuan Purge.

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦在秦庄襄王元年（前249年）被任命为相邦，至秦王政十年（前237年）被罢免。
description.en: Lü Buwei was appointed Chancellor in the first year of King Zhuangxiang of Qin (-249) and was dismissed in the tenth year of King Zheng of Qin's reign (-237).

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦在赵国邯郸结识当时作为人质的嬴异人，认为其“奇货可居”，于是资助并帮助他返回秦国，通过游说华阳夫人使其被立为嫡子，最终登上王位。
description.en: In Handan, the capital of Zhao, Lü Buwei met Ying Yiren who was a hostage there. Believing him to be a 'rare commodity', Lü funded and assisted his return to Qin. By persuading Lady Huayang, he had Yiren established as the legitimate heir, ultimately enabling him to ascend the throne.

description.zh-cn: 吕不韦招揽门客，合力编撰了《吕氏春秋》。
description.en: Lü Buwei recruited scholars and retainers to collaboratively compile the 'Lüshi Chunqiu'.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王元年（前249年），吕不韦奉命灭亡东周国。
description.en: In the first year of King Zhuangxiang's reign (-249), Lü Buwei was ordered to conquer the state of Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 在灭亡东周国时，奉命诛杀东周君。
description.en: During the conquest of the Eastern Zhou, he was ordered to execute the Lord of Eastern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政十年（前237年），秦始皇下令调查并平定了嫪毐发动的叛乱，并将其诛杀。
description.en: In the tenth year of his reign (-237), Qin Shi Huang ordered an investigation and suppressed the rebellion launched by Lao Ai, subsequently having him executed.

description.zh-cn: 在平定嫪毐之乱后，秦始皇将母亲赵姬软禁，并毒杀了她与嫪毐的两个私生子。
description.en: After suppressing the Lao Ai rebellion, Qin Shi Huang placed his mother, Queen Dowager Zhao, under house arrest and poisoned her two illegitimate sons with Lao Ai.

description.zh-cn: 嫪毐集团发动叛乱，此事牵连了吕不韦，导致其被秦王政免除相邦职务。
description.en: The rebellion launched by Lao Ai's faction implicated Lü Buwei, leading to his dismissal from the post of Chancellor by King Zheng of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王（异人）被其父秦孝文王（安国君）立为子嗣。
description.en: King Zhuangxiang (Yiren) was established as the heir by his father, King Xiaowen (Lord Anguo).

description.zh-cn: 在吕不韦的游说下，无子的华阳夫人收养异人为义子，并说服安国君立其为子嗣。
description.en: Persuaded by Lü Buwei, the childless Lady Huayang adopted Yiren as her son and convinced Lord Anguo to establish him as the heir.

description.zh-cn: 秦庄襄王继位后，任命吕不韦为相邦，封为文信侯。
description.en: After ascending the throne, King Zhuangxiang appointed Lü Buwei as Chancellor and ennobled him as Marquis Wenxin.

description.zh-cn: 根据该页面的信息框，老子是影响吕不韦的人物之一。
description.en: According to the infobox on this page, Laozi was one of the figures who influenced Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 根据该页面的信息框，诸子百家是影响吕不韦的因素之一。
description.en: According to the infobox on this page, the Hundred Schools of Thought were one of the factors that influenced Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦出生于浙江宁波。
description.en: Tu Youyou was born in Ningbo, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1981年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Tu Youyou joined the Communist Party of China in 1981.

position.zh-cn: 终身研究员兼首席研究员、中药研究所青蒿素研究中心主任、博士研究生导师
position.en: Lifetime Researcher and Chief Researcher, Director of the Artemisinin Research Center at the Institute of Chinese Materia Medica, Doctoral Supervisor

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦自1955年毕业后被分配至中医研究院（中国中医科学院前身）工作至今。
description.en: Since graduating in 1955, Tu Youyou has been assigned to work at the Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine (the predecessor of the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences).

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1951年考入北京大学医学院，1955年毕业于北京医学院（后并入北京大学医学部）。
description.en: Tu Youyou was admitted to Peking University Medical College in 1951 and graduated from Beijing Medical College (later merged into Peking University Health Science Center) in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1948年进入效实中学学习。
description.en: Tu Youyou entered Xiaoshi High School to study in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于1950年转入宁波中学并于1951年毕业。
description.en: Tu Youyou transferred to Ningbo High School in 1950 and graduated in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦领导的科研小组在523项目中首次从黄花蒿中成功提取并分离出高效抗疟的青蒿素。
description.en: The research group led by Tu Youyou, as part of Project 523, was the first to successfully extract and isolate the highly effective antimalarial compound artemisinin from Artemisia annua.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦及其团队发现了抗疟药双氢青蒿素。
description.en: Tu Youyou and her team discovered the antimalarial drug dihydroartemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦在中医研究院工作初期，曾与老师楼之岑副教授一同研究中药。
description.en: In the early days of her work at the Institute of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Tu Youyou studied traditional Chinese medicine with her teacher, Associate Professor Lou Zhicen.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦于2025年当选为美国国家科学院外籍院士。
description.en: Tu Youyou was elected as a foreign associate of the U.S. National Academy of Sciences in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 523项目于1967年启动，当时毛泽东和时任中国总理周恩来指示科学家研发抗疟药物。1969年，周恩来正式组建了523项目，旨在研发抗疟药物。
description.en: Project 523 was initiated in 1967 when Mao Zedong and then Chinese Premier Zhou Enlai ordered scientists to develop antimalarial drugs. In 1969, Zhou Enlai formally established Project 523 for this purpose.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦从葛洪的《肘后备急方》中关于“青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之”的记载获得灵感，改用乙醚低温萃取，从而成功提取出青蒿素。
description.en: Tu Youyou was inspired by the record in Ge Hong's 'A Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies' which stated 'a handful of sweet wormwood, steeped in two sheng of water, wring out the juice, and drink it all'. This led her to switch to low-temperature extraction with ether, successfully extracting artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院于2017年1月9日将2016年度国家最高科学技术奖授予屠呦呦。
description.en: The State Council of the People's Republic of China awarded the 2016 State Preeminent Science and Technology Award to Tu Youyou on January 9, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国主席习近平于2019年9月17日授予屠呦呦共和国勋章。
description.en: On September 17, 2019, President of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping awarded Tu Youyou the Medal of the Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖后，时任国务院总理李克强致函表示祝贺，推动了对她的认可。
description.en: After Tu Youyou won the Nobel Prize, then-Premier Li Keqiang sent a congratulatory letter, promoting her recognition.

description.zh-cn: 微软创始人比尔·盖茨将屠呦呦获得诺贝尔奖列为“2015年6大好消息”之一，提升了其国际声誉。
description.en: Microsoft founder Bill Gates listed Tu Youyou's Nobel Prize win as one of 'The Top 6 Good-News Stories of 2015', enhancing her international reputation.

description.zh-cn: 姚庆三是屠呦呦的舅舅，屠呦呦幼年曾居住于其家中。
description.en: Yao Qingsan is Tu Youyou's maternal uncle. Tu Youyou lived in his home during her childhood.

description.zh-cn: 姚咏白是屠呦呦的外祖父。
description.en: Yao Yongbai is Tu Youyou's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 屠宗年是屠呦呦的曾祖父。
