description.en: Tu Zongnian is Tu Youyou's great-grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝是清朝的第六位皇帝，于1735年即位。他于1796年禅位，后作为太上皇继续掌握实权，执政至1799年驾崩。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor, the sixth emperor of the Qing Dynasty, ascended the throne in 1735. After abdicating in 1796, he continued to hold de facto power as Emperor Emeritus, ruling until his death in 1799.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆六十年九月三日，乾隆帝立十五子永琰（即嘉庆帝）为皇太子，并宣布次年禅让皇位。
description.en: On the third day of the ninth month of the 60th year of the Qianlong reign, the Qianlong Emperor appointed his 15th son, Yongyan (the future Jiaqing Emperor), as Crown Prince and announced his abdication for the following year.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝禅位后，全国改用嘉庆年号，但北京紫禁城内为表示尊崇，仍继续使用乾隆年号，直至乾隆帝驾崩。
description.en: After the Qianlong Emperor's abdication, the Jiaqing era name was adopted nationwide. However, out of respect, the Qianlong era name continued to be used within the Forbidden City in Beijing until the former emperor's death.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝（弘历）是雍正帝的庶子。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor (Hongli) was a son of the Yongzheng Emperor by a concubine.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝在宣布禅位的同时，下诏次年改元为嘉庆。
description.en: While announcing his abdication, the Qianlong Emperor decreed that the era name would be changed to 'Jiaqing' the following year.

description.zh-cn: 郎世宁是服务于乾隆帝的宫廷画家，创作了包括《清高宗乾隆帝朝服像》在内的许多作品。
description.en: Giuseppe Castiglione was a court painter who served the Qianlong Emperor and created many works, including the 'The Qianlong Emperor in Ceremonial Armour'.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝下定决心禁烟后，多次召见林则徐，并任命其为钦差大臣，前往广东主持禁烟事宜，对其高度信任和倚重。
description.en: After deciding to ban opium, the Daoguang Emperor summoned Lin Zexu multiple times and appointed him as the Imperial Commissioner to oversee the prohibition in Guangdong, placing great trust and reliance on him.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐的虎门销烟行动激化了中英矛盾，成为第一次鸦片战争的直接导火索。
description.en: Lin Zexu's destruction of opium at Humen intensified Sino-British conflicts and served as the direct trigger for the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 琦善与林则徐政见长期不合，在鸦片战争期间，他与穆彰阿等人向道光帝诬告林则徐，将战争责任归咎于他，并废除了林则徐的防务政策。
description.en: Qishan had long-standing political disagreements with Lin Zexu. During the Opium War, he, along with Mujaangga and others, falsely accused Lin Zexu to the Daoguang Emperor, blaming him for the war and dismantling his defense policies.

description.zh-cn: 作为朝中主和派首领，穆彰阿嫉妒并排挤林则徐，在鸦片战争后阻挠林则徐的复起。
description.en: As a leader of the peace faction in the court, Mujaangga was jealous of and marginalized Lin Zexu, obstructing his potential reinstatement after the Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 作为军机大臣，王鼎是林则徐在朝中的坚定支持者。在林则徐被贬后，他为林则徐竭力辩护，并力图使其复出，最终为之尸谏。
description.en: As a Grand Councilor, Wang Ding was a staunch supporter of Lin Zexu in the court. After Lin's demotion, he vigorously defended him and tried to secure his return to office, ultimately committing suicide in protest.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐视怡和洋行创始人威廉·渣甸为最大的鸦片商人，是其禁烟运动的主要打击对象。
description.en: Lin Zexu considered William Jardine, founder of Jardine, Matheson & Co., to be the biggest opium trader and the main target of his anti-opium campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在禁烟和鸦片战争初期，林则徐与英国驻华商务总监查理·义律进行了直接的政治和军事对抗。
description.en: During the anti-opium campaign and the early stages of the Opium War, Lin Zexu was in direct political and military confrontation with Charles Elliot, the British Chief Superintendent of Trade.

description.zh-cn: 在虎门之战中，广东水师提督关天培率军抵抗英军进攻，最终战死殉国。
description.en: In the Battle of Humen, Guangdong Fleet Admiral Guan Tianpei led his troops to resist the British attack and was killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在广州主持禁烟期间，组织翻译外国书报，其中具体主持翻译《地理百科全书》，并将其编成《四洲志》，旨在深入了解西方世界。
description.en: While overseeing the opium ban in Guangzhou, Lin Zexu organized the translation of foreign books and newspapers, specifically supervising the translation of 'A Cyclopaedia of Geography', and compiled them into the 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents', aiming to deeply understand the Western world.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在新疆期间，对俄罗斯帝国的扩张保持高度警惕，并预言其将是中国的长远祸患。
description.en: During his exile in Xinjiang, Lin Zexu was highly vigilant about the expansion of the Russian Empire and predicted it would become a long-term threat to China.

description.zh-cn: 1914年，宋霭龄和孔祥熙在日本横滨结婚。
description.en: In 1914, Soong Ai-ling and H. H. Kung married in Yokohama, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 宋霭龄是宋美龄的姐姐。
description.en: Soong Ai-ling was the elder sister of Soong Mei-ling.

description.zh-cn: 1910年毕业后任孙中山秘书，“二次革命”失败后去日本，仍任孙中山秘书。
description.en: After graduating in 1910, she served as Sun Yat-sen's secretary. After the failure of the Second Revolution, she went to Japan and continued to serve as his secretary.

description.zh-cn: “二次革命”失败后，宋霭龄随父去日本。
description.en: After the failure of the Second Revolution, Soong Ai-ling went to Japan with her father.

description.zh-cn: 孔令俊是孔祥熙的次女。
description.en: Kong Lingjun was the second daughter of H. H. Kung.

description.zh-cn: 担任宋美龄与蒋介石的媒人。
description.en: Acted as the matchmaker for Soong Mei-ling and Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 担任宋美龄与蒋介石的媒人。
description.en: Acted as the matchmaker for Soong Mei-ling and Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 根据徐家涵的说法，“连蒋介石遇事也让她三分”。
description.en: According to Xu Jiahan, 'even Chiang Kai-shek would defer to her in certain matters'.

description.zh-cn: 被《纽约时报》形容为“宋家神话的创造者，是使宋家王朝掌权的设计者”。
description.en: Described by The New York Times as 'the creator of the Soong myth and the architect of the Soong dynasty's rise to power'.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英于1992年与罗浩结婚。
description.en: Song Zuying married Luo Hao in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 宋佳玲是宋祖英的妹妹。
description.en: Song Jialing is Song Zuying's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英出生于湖南省古丈县。
description.en: Song Zuying was born in Guzhang County, Hunan Province.

degree.zh-cn: 民族声乐专业毕业，艺术学博士学位
degree.en: Graduated in Ethnic Vocal Music, Doctor of Arts degree

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英毕业于中国音乐学院民族声乐专业，并获得艺术学博士学位。
description.en: Song Zuying graduated from the China Conservatory of Music with a major in Ethnic Vocal Music and holds a Doctor of Arts degree.

description.zh-cn: 1988年10月，金铁霖在“金龙杯”全国歌手邀请赛后收宋祖英为学生，对其声乐事业产生了重要影响。
description.en: In October 1988, after the 'Golden Dragon Cup' National Singer Invitational Competition, Jin Tielin accepted Song Zuying as his student, significantly influencing her vocal career.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英于1999年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Song Zuying joined the Communist Party of China in 1999.

description.zh-cn: 2013年至2018年，宋祖英担任海政文工团团长。
description.en: From 2013 to 2018, Song Zuying served as the head of the PLA Navy Political Work Department Song and Dance Troupe.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英曾任中国音乐家协会副主席。
description.en: Song Zuying served as the Vice Chairman of the Chinese Musicians' Association.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英曾任第九届全国人大代表。
description.en: Song Zuying was a deputy to the 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英曾任第十届、十一届、十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: Song Zuying served as a member of the 10th, 11th, and 12th National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在北京奥运会闭幕式上与多明哥共同演唱了主题歌《爱的火焰》。
description.en: Co-performed the theme song 'The Flame of Love' with Plácido Domingo at the closing ceremony of the Beijing Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 在上海世博会开幕式上与成龙共同演唱歌曲。
description.en: Co-performed a song with Jackie Chan at the opening ceremony of the Shanghai Expo.

description.zh-cn: 在2011台北小巨蛋个人演唱会上与周华健同台演出。
description.en: Performed on the same stage with Wakin Chau at her 2011 solo concert at the Taipei Arena.

description.zh-cn: 在2011台北小巨蛋个人演唱会上与周杰伦同台演出。
description.en: Performed on the same stage with Jay Chou at her 2011 solo concert at the Taipei Arena.

description.zh-cn: 2007年，宋祖英接受杨澜《天下女人》节目的访问。
description.en: In 2007, Song Zuying was interviewed by Yang Lan on the program 'Her Village'.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙出生于山西省太谷县。
description.en: H. H. Kung was born in Taigu County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙于1894年从潞河书院毕业。
description.en: H. H. Kung graduated from Luhe Academy in 1894.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙于1905年毕业于欧柏林学院，后于1926年获赠名誉博士学位。
description.en: H. H. Kung graduated from Oberlin College in 1905 and was awarded an honorary doctorate in 1926.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙于1907年在耶鲁大学取得矿物学硕士学位。
description.en: H. H. Kung obtained a Master's degree in Mineralogy from Yale University in 1907.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，孔祥熙在家乡太谷县创办了铭贤学堂。
description.en: In 1907, H. H. Kung founded the Ming Hsien School in his hometown of Taigu County.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙曾先后担任行政院副院长（1933-1945）和院长（1938-1939）。
description.en: H. H. Kung served successively as Vice Premier (1933-1945) and Premier (1938-1939) of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 时任财政部长孔祥熙于1935年11月3日颁布《财政部改革币制令》，推行法币政策。
description.en: As Minister of Finance, H. H. Kung issued the 'Ministry of Finance Decree on Currency Reform' on November 3, 1935, implementing the Fapi policy.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙宣布对中国银行实行管制，要求增发股票，将控制权交给政府。
description.en: H. H. Kung announced that the government would take control of the Bank of China, requiring it to issue additional shares to transfer control to the government.

description.zh-cn: 孔祥熙宣布对交通银行实行管制，要求增发股票，将控制权交给政府。
description.en: H. H. Kung announced that the government would take control of the Bank of Communications, requiring it to issue additional shares to transfer control to the government.

description.zh-cn: 在宋子文与上海金融家矛盾加深后，蒋介石让孔祥熙接替宋子文出任财政部长。
description.en: After the conflict between T. V. Soong and Shanghai financiers intensified, Chiang Kai-shek had H. H. Kung replace Soong as Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年在国民参政会上揭发孔祥熙贪污舞弊，不久后孔被免去财政部长职位。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien exposed H. H. Kung's corruption at the People's Political Council, leading to Kung's dismissal from the post of Minister of Finance shortly thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 中国银行总经理张公权反对孔祥熙的赤字财政政策，并联合交通银行拒绝提供财力支援。
description.en: Chang Kia-ngau, general manager of the Bank of China, opposed H. H. Kung's deficit financial policy and, along with the Bank of Communications, refused to provide financial support.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国曾批评孔祥熙为“大资产阶级”。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo once criticized H. H. Kung as a 'big bourgeois'.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国曾批评宋子文为“大资产阶级”。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo once criticized T. V. Soong as a 'big bourgeois'.

description.zh-cn: 通过在新民报报道孔祥熙之女孔令俊滥用特权的“飞狗事件”，引发了公众对孔祥熙家族的强烈不满。
description.en: By reporting on the 'Flying Dog Incident', where H. H. Kung's daughter Kong Lingjun abused her privileges, in the 'Xin Min Bao', it sparked strong public dissatisfaction with the Kung family.

description.zh-cn: 土木之变中明英宗被俘，为朱祁钰（时为郕王）继位成为景泰帝提供了直接契机。
description.en: The capture of Emperor Yingzong during the Tumu Crisis provided the direct opportunity for Zhu Qiyu (then Prince of Cheng) to ascend the throne as the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在明英宗被俘后，联合其他大臣拥立郕王朱祁钰为皇帝。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong was captured, he, along with other ministers, supported the enthronement of the Prince of Cheng, Zhu Qiyu, as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗被俘后，孙太后（孝恭章皇后）首先任命朱祁钰为监国，随后批准群臣所请，立郕王朱祁钰为皇帝，是为景泰帝。
description.en: After Emperor Yingzong's capture, Empress Dowager Sun (Empress Xiaogongzhang) first appointed Zhu Qiyu as regent. She then approved the officials' request to enthrone him, the Prince of Cheng, as the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝即位后，任命于谦为兵部尚书，领导京师保卫战。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Jingtai Emperor appointed Yu Qian as the Minister of War to lead the Defense of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 明军在北京保卫战中击退了瓦剌的进攻。
description.en: The Ming army repelled the Oirat invasion during the Defense of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 即位后，恢复了叔叔景泰帝的皇帝尊号，并上谥号“恭仁康定景皇帝”。
description.en: After ascending the throne, he restored his uncle the Jingtai Emperor's imperial title and gave him the posthumous name 'Gongren Kangding Jing Huangdi'.

description.zh-cn: 南明弘光帝为景泰帝追上庙号“代宗”和更长的谥号。
description.en: The Hongguang Emperor of the Southern Ming posthumously honored the Jingtai Emperor with the temple name 'Daizong' and a longer posthumous title.

description.zh-cn: 景泰帝死后，明英宗下令唐皇贵妃为其殉葬。
description.en: After the Jingtai Emperor's death, Emperor Yingzong ordered Imperial Noble Consort Tang to be buried alive as a human sacrifice.

description.zh-cn: 成功劝谏明英宗，使被废的汪皇后免于为景泰帝殉葬。
description.en: Successfully persuaded Emperor Yingzong to spare the deposed Empress Wang from being sacrificed for the Jingtai Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡是林彪的女儿。
description.en: Lin Liheng is the daughter of Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡是叶群的女儿。
description.en: Lin Liheng is the daughter of Ye Qun.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡于1944年8月31日出生于延安。
description.en: Lin Liheng was born in Yan'an on August 31, 1944.

description.zh-cn: 1962年进入清华大学电子工程系就读。
description.en: Enrolled in the Department of Electronic Engineering at Tsinghua University in 1962.

description.zh-cn: 从清华大学转学至北京大学中文系。
description.en: Transferred from Tsinghua University to the Department of Chinese at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间担任《空军报》副总编。
description.en: Served as Deputy Editor-in-Chief of the Air Force News during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央副主席林彪在“九一三事件”中，因飞机坠毁于蒙古人民共和国温都尔汗而身亡。
description.en: Lin Biao, then Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, died in the 'September 13 Incident' when his plane crashed in Öndörkhaan, Mongolian People's Republic.

description.zh-cn: 九一三事件后，林立衡虽然告发有功，但仍需接受审查，期间曾试图自杀。
description.en: After the September 13 Incident, although Lin Liheng reported the escape plan, she was still subjected to investigation, during which she attempted suicide.

description.zh-cn: 在林立衡写信求助后，毛泽东于1974年7月31日批示解除了对她的审查。
description.en: After Lin Liheng wrote a letter asking for help, Mao Zedong issued an instruction on July 31, 1974, to lift the investigation against her.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡曾在位于郑州的汽车厂工作后，调至中国社会科学院工作。
description.en: After working in a car factory in Zhengzhou, Lin Liheng was transferred to work at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 林彪一行人乘坐的飞机在温都尔汗坠毁。
description.en: The plane carrying Lin Biao and his party crashed in Öndörkhaan.

description.zh-cn: 林立衡六岁时曾跟随父亲林彪至莫斯科养病。
description.en: At the age of six, Lin Liheng followed her father Lin Biao to Moscow for medical treatment.

description.zh-cn: 与张清林结婚后，林立衡曾在郑州的一家汽车厂工作。
description.en: After marrying Zhang Qinglin, Lin Liheng worked at a car factory in Zhengzhou.

description.zh-cn: 郭子兴曾听信谗言猜疑朱元璋。
description.en: Guo Zixing once grew suspicious of Zhu Yuanzhang due to slander.

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京太常寺志》等记载，朱棣的生母为䂵妃。
description.en: According to records such as the 'Nanjing Taichang Si Zhi', Zhu Di's biological mother was Consort Gong.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是道光帝旻宁的第六子。
description.en: Yixin was the sixth son of the Daoguang Emperor, Minning.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是孝静成皇后的亲生儿子。
description.en: Yixin was the biological son of Empress Xiao Jing Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝于1846年选择传位于皇四子奕𬣞而非更有才干的奕䜣，并采取措施暗示奕䜣争储失败。此后，又于1849年通过修建其母静贵妃的妃园寝，进一步变相宣布奕䜣在皇位继承斗争中失败。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor chose his fourth son Yizhu as successor over the more talented Yixin in 1846, and took measures to signal that Yixin's bid for the throne had failed. Later, in 1849, he implicitly announced Yixin's failure in the succession struggle by ordering the construction of a tomb for his mother, Noble Consort Jing, within the consort mausoleum.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝因奕䜣为其母请求太后封号一事感到不快，借故免去奕䜣的军机大臣等职务，导致兄弟反目。
description.en: The Xianfeng Emperor was displeased by Yixin's request for an empress dowager title for his mother and used it as a pretext to dismiss Yixin from his post as Grand Councilor, leading to their estrangement.

description.zh-cn: 在辛酉政变中，两人联合。此后，共同执政期间，慈安太后作为奕䜣的重要政治支持者，长期帮助其制衡慈禧太后的权势。慈安太后于1881年去世后，奕䜣在朝中的地位开始动摇。
description.en: They allied during the Xinyou Coup. Subsequently, throughout their joint regency, Empress Dowager Ci'an was a crucial political supporter of Yixin, consistently helping him to counterbalance the power of Empress Dowager Cixi. After Empress Dowager Ci'an's death in 1881, Yixin's position at court began to weaken.

description.zh-cn: 因奕䜣功高震主，慈禧太后对他长期猜忌，并在1865年首次尝试罢免其职务，最终于1884年通过“甲申易枢”将其彻底逐出权力核心。
description.en: Due to Yixin's significant power and achievements, Empress Dowager Cixi grew suspicious of him, first attempting to dismiss him in 1865 and eventually removing him completely from the core of power in 1884 through the 'Jiashen Coup'.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是辛酉政变的主要策划者和执行者，联合两宫皇太后推翻了顾命八大臣的统治。
description.en: Yixin was the main planner and executor of the Xinyou Coup, allying with the two Empress Dowagers to overthrow the rule of the Eight Regent Ministers.

description.zh-cn: 慈安太后与奕䜣、慈禧太后密谋，联合发动了辛酉政变。
description.en: Empress Dowager Ci'an conspired with Yixin and Empress Dowager Cixi to jointly launch the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣是洋务运动的代表人物、主要发起者及领袖，倡导并支持兴办近代军事工业和发展外交。
description.en: Yixin was a representative figure, primary initiator, and leader of the Self-Strengthening Movement, advocating for and supporting the establishment of modern military industries and the development of diplomacy.

description.zh-cn: 清廷采纳了奕䜣的建议，首次设立专门的外交机构——总理各国事务衙门，并由其担任首席大臣。
description.en: The Qing court adopted Yixin's proposal to establish the Zongli Yamen, the first dedicated foreign affairs office, with him serving as its head.

description.zh-cn: 在奕䜣等人主持下，其掌权期间积极调和斡旋，利用列强参与镇压，最终使清朝平息了太平天国运动。
description.en: Under the leadership of Yixin and others, during his time in power, he actively negotiated and maneuvered, using foreign powers to help suppress the Taiping Rebellion, which the Qing dynasty eventually quelled.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣受命与英法联军谈判议和，签署《北京条约》，结束了战争。
description.en: Yixin was ordered to negotiate peace with the Anglo-French forces, signing the Convention of Peking and ending the war.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣作为钦差大臣，代表清廷与英、法、俄等国签订了《北京条约》。
description.en: As the imperial commissioner, Yixin represented the Qing court in signing the Convention of Peking with Britain, France, and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 1869年，奕䜣下令山东巡抚丁宝祯将违制出京的慈禧心腹太监安德海就地正法，由此深为慈禧所恨。
description.en: In 1869, Yixin ordered Shandong governor Ding Baozhen to execute Cixi's trusted eunuch An Dehai for illegally leaving the capital, thereby incurring Cixi's deep hatred.

description.zh-cn: 同治帝因奕䜣劝谏其停止修治圆明园等事而痛斥他，并将其及其子撤职降级（后被两宫太后恢复）。
description.en: The Tongzhi Emperor berated Yixin for advising him to stop renovating the Old Summer Palace and other matters, and dismissed him and his son from their posts (later restored by the two empress dowagers).

description.zh-cn: 中日甲午战争爆发后，慈禧碍于危机形势再度起用奕䜣，命其担任领班军机大臣等职。
description.en: After the outbreak of the First Sino-Japanese War, Cixi reappointed Yixin due to the crisis, making him the head of the Grand Council and other positions.

description.zh-cn: 晚年的奕䜣对光绪帝意图发动的维新变法运动极力抵制、屡加阻挠。
description.en: In his later years, Yixin strongly resisted and repeatedly obstructed the reform movement that the Guangxu Emperor intended to launch.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣病逝前向光绪帝表达对翁同龢的反对之意，促使光绪帝罢黜了翁同龢。
description.en: Before his death, Yixin expressed his opposition to Weng Tonghe to the Guangxu Emperor, which prompted the emperor to dismiss Weng.

description.zh-cn: 荣寿固伦公主是奕䜣的长女。
description.en: Princess Rongshou was the eldest daughter of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 载澂是奕䜣的长子。
description.en: Zaicheng was the eldest son of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 载滢是奕䜣的次子。
description.en: Zaiying was the second son of Yixin.

description.zh-cn: 溥伟是载滢的长子，后被过继给载澂。
description.en: Puwei was the eldest son of Zaiying and was later adopted by Zaicheng.

description.zh-cn: 杨开慧是杨昌济的女儿。
description.en: Yang Kaihui is the daughter of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸英是杨开慧的长子。
description.en: Mao Anying is the eldest son of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸英是毛泽东的长子。
description.en: Mao Anying is the eldest son of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸青是杨开慧的次子。
description.en: Mao Anqing is the second son of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸青是毛泽东的次子。
description.en: Mao Anqing is the second son of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸龙是杨开慧的幼子。
description.en: Mao Anlong is the youngest son of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸龙是毛泽东的幼子。
description.en: Mao Anlong is the youngest son of Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，毛泽东在井冈山与贺子珍结婚。
description.en: In 1928, Mao Zedong married He Zizhen in the Jinggang Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 杨开慧7岁时入读长沙第四十初级小学（长沙市稻田中学前身之一）。
description.en: At the age of 7, Yang Kaihui enrolled in the 40th Primary School of Changsha (one of the predecessors of Changsha Daotian Middle School).

description.zh-cn: 1920年，杨开慧进入福湘女中学习。
description.en: In 1920, Yang Kaihui enrolled in Fuxiang Girls' Middle School.

description.zh-cn: 据传闻，蔡元培曾向何键发电报，要求保释杨开慧，但未成功。
description.en: According to rumors, Cai Yuanpei sent a telegram to He Jian requesting the release of Yang Kaihui, but was unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 1949年后，杨开慧的家乡板仓乡为纪念她而改名为开慧乡。
description.en: After 1949, Yang Kaihui's hometown, Bancang Township, was renamed Kaihui Township in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 1918年，杨昌济应蔡元培邀请任北京大学伦理学教授，直至1920年去世。
description.en: In 1918, at the invitation of Cai Yuanpei, Yang Changji became a professor of ethics at Peking University, a position he held until his death in 1920.

description.zh-cn: 为悼念杨开慧并回复李淑一而创作该词。
description.en: Authored this poem to mourn Yang Kaihui and in reply to Li Shuyi.

description.zh-cn: 李淑一于1957年春节写信给毛泽东，促使毛泽东回信并附上该词。
description.en: Li Shuyi wrote to Mao Zedong during the 1957 Spring Festival, prompting him to reply with this poem.

description.zh-cn: 李淑一是柳直荀的妻子。
description.en: Li Shuyi is the wife of Liu Zhixun.

description.zh-cn: 苗华于1969年12月参军，2025年10月17日被开除军籍。
description.en: Miao Hua joined the army in December 1969 and was expelled from the military on October 17, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 苗华于1973年9月入党，2025年10月17日被开除党籍。
description.en: Miao Hua joined the Party in September 1973 and was expelled on October 17, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 苗华接替张阳担任中央军事委员会政治工作部主任。
description.en: Miao Hua succeeded Zhang Yang as Director of the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 苗华接替刘晓江，担任中国人民解放军海军政治委员。
description.en: Miao Hua succeeded Liu Xiaojiang as Political Commissar of the PLA Navy.

description.zh-cn: 苗华卸任中国人民解放军海军政治委员，由秦生祥接任。
description.en: Miao Hua stepped down as Political Commissar of the PLA Navy and was succeeded by Qin Shengxiang.

description.zh-cn: 苗华接替到龄退休的李长才，担任兰州军区政治委员。
description.en: Miao Hua succeeded the retiring Li Changcai as Political Commissar of the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 苗华卸任兰州军区政治委员，由刘雷接任。
description.en: Miao Hua stepped down as Political Commissar of the Lanzhou Military Region and was succeeded by Liu Lei.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央研究决定对涉嫌严重违纪的苗华停职检查。
description.en: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China decided to suspend Miao Hua from his duties for investigation into suspected serious violations of discipline.

description.zh-cn: 正式免除苗华的中华人民共和国中央军事委员会委员职务。
description.en: Formally removed Miao Hua from his position as a member of the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 开除苗华党籍。
description.en: Expelled Miao Hua from the party.

description.zh-cn: 开除苗华军籍。
description.en: Expelled Miao Hua from the military.

description.zh-cn: 郝明珠是习仲勋的第一任妻子，两人于1935年结婚，1944年初冬离婚。
description.en: Hao Mingzhu was Xi Zhongxun's first wife; they married in 1935 and divorced in the early winter of 1944.

description.zh-cn: 郝明珠出生于陕西省安定县（现子长市）。
description.en: Hao Mingzhu was born in Anding County (present-day Zichang City), Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 郝明珠曾任陕西省第五届人大常委会委员。
description.en: Hao Mingzhu served as a member of the 5th Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 习和平是郝明珠的长女。
description.en: Xi Heping was the eldest daughter of Hao Mingzhu.

description.zh-cn: 习和平是习仲勋的长女。
description.en: Xi Heping was the eldest daughter of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 习正宁是郝明珠的长子。
description.en: Xi Zhengning was the eldest son of Hao Mingzhu.

description.zh-cn: 习正宁是习仲勋的长子。
description.en: Xi Zhengning was the eldest son of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 吴岱峰是郝明珠的姨父。
description.en: Wu Daifeng was Hao Mingzhu's maternal uncle-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 1948年8月21日，王光美与刘少奇于西柏坡结婚。
description.en: On August 21, 1948, Wang Guangmei married Liu Shaoqi in Xibaipo.

description.zh-cn: 王治昌是王光美的父亲。
description.en: Wang Zhichang is the father of Wang Guangmei.

degree.zh-cn: 物理学学士、物理学硕士
degree.en: Bachelor of Physics, Master of Physics

description.zh-cn: 1945年毕业于辅仁大学，获物理学学士与硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from Fu Jen University in 1945 with bachelor's and master's degrees in physics.

description.zh-cn: 1948年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争胜利前夕结识了中共辅仁大学工委领导人崔月犁。
description.en: Before the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, she got to know Cui Yueli, the leader of the CCP working committee at Fu Jen University.

description.zh-cn: 外国媒体多以“第一夫人”称呼王光美，引起毛泽东夫人江青不满。
description.en: Foreign media often referred to Wang Guangmei as the 'First Lady', which caused dissatisfaction for Mao Zedong's wife, Jiang Qing.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中，王光美遭到批斗并被投入秦城监狱，直至1978年12月恢复人身自由。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wang Guangmei was subjected to struggle sessions and imprisoned in Qincheng Prison until her personal freedom was restored in December 1978.

description.zh-cn: 1966年6月，出任清华大学工作组顾问的王光美严厉打击蒯大富，在清华掀起“反蒯运动”。
description.en: In June 1966, as an advisor to the work group at Tsinghua University, Wang Guangmei severely cracked down on Kuai Dafu, launching the 'Anti-Kuai Movement' at Tsinghua.

description.zh-cn: 策划“智擒王光美”事件，将王光美扣押，并于同年4月10日组织了对她的批斗大会。
description.en: Orchestrated the 'deceitful capture of Wang Guangmei' event, detaining her, and organized a struggle session against her on April 10 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中与江青等人力主处死王光美。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, along with Jiang Qing and others, strongly advocated for the execution of Wang Guangmei.

description.zh-cn: 在林彪、江青等人力主处死王光美时，批示“刀下留人”，使其幸免于死。
description.en: When Lin Biao, Jiang Qing, and others strongly advocated for Wang Guangmei's execution, Mao Zedong intervened with the instruction 'spare her from the blade', saving her life.

description.zh-cn: 王光美在四清运动前期，带工作队到河北桃园大队搞试点，总结出“桃园经验”。
description.en: In the early stage of the Four Cleanups Movement, Wang Guangmei led a work team to Taoyuan Brigade in Hebei to conduct a pilot project, from which she summarized the 'Taoyuan Experience'.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠改投冯玉祥的部队，并在其麾下任职多年。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong joined Feng Yuxiang's troops and served under his command for many years.

description.zh-cn: 因战事不利，张自忠恐为其直属长官石友三所害，遂率部脱离。
description.en: Due to unfavorable battle conditions, Zhang Zizhong feared he would be harmed by his direct superior Shi Yousan and thus led his troops to leave.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠在宋哲元担任军长的第二十九军中任师长。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong served as a division commander in the 29th Army, which was commanded by Song Zheyuan.

description.zh-cn: 七七事变后，张自忠归于中央政府节制，受军事委员会委员长蒋中正指挥。
description.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Zhang Zizhong came under the control of the central government and was commanded by Chiang Kai-shek, the Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠率部在南瓜店与日军激战，最终壮烈殉国。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong led his troops in a fierce battle against the Japanese army at Nanguadian and was ultimately killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠在枣宜会战期间阵亡。
description.en: Zhang Zizhong was killed in action during the Battle of Zaoyang-Yichang.

description.zh-cn: 张自忠殉国后，国民政府明令褒扬，并追晋其为陆军二级上将。
description.en: After Zhang Zizhong's death, the Nationalist Government issued a commendation and posthumously promoted him to General, Second Class of the Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国民政部追认张自忠为革命烈士。
description.en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China posthumously recognized Zhang Zizhong as a revolutionary martyr.

description.zh-cn: 在延安各界举行的追悼大会上，毛泽东为张自忠送上“尽忠报国”的挽词。
description.en: At a memorial service held in Yan'an, Mao Zedong sent a eulogy for Zhang Zizhong with the words 'Loyally serving the country'.

description.zh-cn: 在纪念抗战胜利69周年座谈会上，习近平将张自忠列为中国人民不畏强暴、以身殉国的杰出代表。
description.en: At a symposium commemorating the 69th anniversary of the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, Xi Jinping listed Zhang Zizhong as an outstanding representative of the Chinese people who defied brute force and sacrificed their lives for the country.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇于1900年5月10日与九条节子（后来的贞明皇后）结婚。
description.en: Emperor Taishō married Kujō Sadako (later Empress Teimei) on May 10, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇由其祖母中山庆子（明治天皇的生母）负责养育。
description.en: Emperor Taishō was raised by his grandmother, Nakayama Yoshiko (the biological mother of Emperor Meiji).

description.zh-cn: 秩父宫雍仁亲王是大正天皇的次子。
description.en: Prince Chichibu was the second son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王是大正天皇的三子。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu was the third son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 三笠宫崇仁亲王是大正天皇的幼子。
description.en: Prince Mikasa was the youngest son of Emperor Taishō.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇曾就读于学习院但中途退学。
description.en: Emperor Taishō attended the Gakushūin but dropped out.

description.zh-cn: 嘉仁于1912年7月30日继位为大正天皇。
description.en: Yoshihito succeeded to the throne as Emperor Taishō on July 30, 1912.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇在位期间担任帝国大元帅。
description.en: Emperor Taishō held the rank of Marshal-Admiral during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 因大正天皇健康状况不佳，皇太子裕仁于1921年开始摄政。
description.en: Due to Emperor Taishō's poor health, Crown Prince Hirohito was appointed Regent in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 大正天皇驾崩后，皇太子裕仁继位成为昭和天皇。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Taishō, Crown Prince Hirohito succeeded him as Emperor Shōwa.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，朝鲜统监伊藤博文说服当时为皇太子的嘉仁访问韩国。
description.en: In 1907, Resident-General of Korea Itō Hirobumi persuaded then-Crown Prince Yoshihito to visit Korea.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，皇太子嘉仁访问韩国，受到皇帝纯宗的迎接。
description.en: In 1907, Crown Prince Yoshihito visited Korea and was received by Emperor Sunjong.

description.zh-cn: “大正民主”时期的民主化浪潮影响到当时的日属台湾，促使林献堂等人发起台湾议会设置请愿运动。
description.en: The wave of democratization during the 'Taishō democracy' period influenced then-Japanese-ruled Taiwan, prompting figures like Lin Hsien-tang to initiate the Petition Movement for the Establishment of a Taiwanese Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 关东大地震是发生在大正天皇统治后期的重大灾难，加深了其“不幸的大正”的公众印象。
description.en: The Great Kantō earthquake was a major disaster during the later part of Emperor Taishō's reign, contributing to his public image as the 'unfortunate Taishō'.

description.zh-cn: 允礽是康熙帝的第二子。
description.en: Yunreng was the second son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允礽的生母是孝诚仁皇后。
description.en: Yunreng's birth mother was Empress Xiaochengren.

description.zh-cn: 瓜尔佳氏是允礽的嫡福晋（正室）。
description.en: Lady Guwalgiya was the primary consort of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 李佳氏是允礽的侧福晋。
description.en: Lady Ligiya was a secondary consort of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 允礽是雍正帝（胤禛）的异母兄。
description.en: Yunreng was the elder half-brother of the Yongzheng Emperor (Yinzhen).

description.zh-cn: 允礽是允禔的异母弟。
description.en: Yunreng was the younger half-brother of Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 允礽是承祜的同母弟。
description.en: Yunreng was the younger full brother of Chenghu.

description.zh-cn: 弘晳是允礽的第二子。
description.en: Hongxi was the second son of Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝在1675年6月3日册封年仅一周岁的允礽为皇太子，亲自教导并寄予厚望；后于1709年3月9日复立其为皇太子。
description.en: On June 3, 1675, the Kangxi Emperor appointed the one-year-old Yunreng as Crown Prince, personally tutoring him and having high expectations. Later, on March 9, 1709, he reinstated Yunreng as Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 允礽曾两度被立为皇太子。
description.en: Yunreng was twice appointed as Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 向允礽教授理学。
description.en: Taught Neo-Confucianism to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 奉康熙帝之命担任允礽的老师（詹事）。
description.en: Was appointed by the Kangxi Emperor to be a tutor (Supervisor of the Household) to Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 自14岁起，允礽与皇长子允禔开始了高压的竞争关系。
description.en: From the age of 14, Yunreng entered into a high-pressure, competitive relationship with the eldest prince, Yinzhi.

description.zh-cn: 因允礽在康熙帝亲征噶尔丹期间患病时“侍疾无忧色”，父子情份产生裂痕。
description.en: Because Yunreng showed 'no sign of worry while attending to the sick emperor' during Kangxi's campaign against Galdan, a rift formed in their father-son relationship.

description.zh-cn: 因避雍正帝（胤禛）的名讳，允礽的名字由“胤礽”被改为“允礽”。
description.en: To avoid the naming taboo of the Yongzheng Emperor (Yinzhen), Yunreng's name was changed from 'Yinreng' to 'Yunreng'.

description.zh-cn: 作为维新派的主要发起者和领袖，康有为策划并主导了整个戊戌变法的进程。
description.en: As the main initiator and leader of the reformist faction, Kang Youwei planned and directed the entire process of the Hundred Days' Reform.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌政变后，下令革职并通缉康有为。
description.en: After the Wuxu Coup, she ordered Kang Youwei to be dismissed from his post and be arrested.

description.zh-cn: 康有为是张勋复辟的主要同谋者之一，积极参与了拥立溥仪的行动。
description.en: Kang Youwei was one of the main conspirators in the Zhang Xun Restoration, actively participating in the effort to restore Puyi to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 康有为与孙文因刘学询策划的“日本刺客”事件反目成仇。康有为主张君主立宪，反对孙文的革命主张，视其为主要政治对手。1905年，他曾密令刺杀孙文。晚年，康有为强烈反对孙文的联俄容共政策。
description.en: Kang Youwei and Sun Yat-sen became enemies due to the 'Japanese assassin' incident plotted by Liu Xuexun. Kang Youwei advocated for constitutional monarchy, opposing Sun's revolutionary ideas and viewing him as a primary political rival. In 1905, he secretly ordered Sun's assassination. In his later years, Kang strongly opposed Sun's policy of allying with Russia and admitting communists.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌变法失败后，康有为在加拿大组织成立保皇会，以“保救大清皇帝”为名，鼓吹君主立宪。
description.en: After the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, Kang Youwei founded the Baohuanghui (Protect the Emperor Society) in Canada to advocate for constitutional monarchy under the banner of 'saving the Great Qing Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年宣统退位、中华民国成立后，康有为持续反对共和制，坚持君主立宪的保皇立场。
description.en: After the abdication of the Xuantong Emperor and the establishment of the Republic of China in 1912, Kang Youwei continuously opposed the republican system, adhering to his royalist stance of constitutional monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，康有为被视为“中国历史上最大的保皇派”，其墓地被红卫兵掘开，遗骸被掘墓鞭打并游街示众。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Kang Youwei was labeled 'the biggest royalist in Chinese history'. His tomb was desecrated by Red Guards, and his remains were exhumed, beaten, and paraded through the streets.

description.zh-cn: 1966年8月，红卫兵掘开康有为墓，将其遗骸损毁。
description.en: In August 1966, Red Guards excavated Kang Youwei's tomb and destroyed his remains.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清与胡锦涛于1970年2月结婚，两人是清华大学的同班同学。
description.en: Liu Yongqing married Hu Jintao in February 1970; they were classmates at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 胡海青是刘永清的女儿。
description.en: Hu Haiqing is the daughter of Liu Yongqing.

description.zh-cn: 胡海青是胡锦涛的女儿。
description.en: Hu Haiqing is the daughter of Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清于1959年考入清华大学水利系，1965年毕业。
description.en: Liu Yongqing was admitted to the Department of Hydraulic Engineering at Tsinghua University in 1959 and graduated in 1965.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清于1953年入读重庆市巴蜀中学校。
description.en: Liu Yongqing enrolled in Chongqing Bashu Secondary School in 1953.

position.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国第一配偶
position.en: First Spouse of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记期间，刘永清作为其夫人履行“第一配偶”的职责。
description.en: During Hu Jintao's tenure as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Liu Yongqing fulfilled the duties of the "First Spouse" as his wife.

description.zh-cn: 1982年胡锦涛调入共青团中央后，刘永清在团中央下属的中青旅担任副总经理。
description.en: After Hu Jintao was transferred to the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League in 1982, Liu Yongqing served as the deputy general manager of CYTS, a subsidiary of the league.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清1940年10月3日出生于中华民国时期的山东省。
description.en: Liu Yongqing was born on October 3, 1940, in Shandong Province during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清接替王冶坪（江泽民夫人）成为中华人民共和国第一配偶。
description.en: Liu Yongqing succeeded Wang Yeping (wife of Jiang Zemin) as the First Spouse of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 彭丽媛（习近平夫人）接替刘永清成为中华人民共和国第一配偶。
description.en: Peng Liyuan (wife of Xi Jinping) succeeded Liu Yongqing as the First Spouse of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，刘永清于1969年3月被下放到宁夏青铜峡五七干校。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Liu Yongqing was sent to the May Seventh Cadre School in Qingtongxia, Ningxia, in March 1969.

description.zh-cn: 常芝青是刘永清的舅舅。
description.en: Chang Zhiging is Liu Yongqing's maternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 常芝青与姚依林交好。
description.en: Chang Zhiging was on good terms with Yao Yilin.

description.zh-cn: 刘永清与朱琳是重庆市巴蜀中学校的校友。
description.en: Liu Yongqing and Zhu Lin were schoolmates at Chongqing Bashu Secondary School.

description.zh-cn: 朱琳是李鹏的夫人。
description.en: Zhu Lin is the wife of Li Peng.

description.zh-cn: 胡海峰现任中华人民共和国民政部副部长。
description.en: Hu Haifeng currently serves as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡海青的丈夫是茅道林。
description.en: Hu Haiqing's husband is Mao Daolin.

description.zh-cn: 2006年，刘永清与时任美国第一夫人劳拉·布什在白宫会面。
description.en: In 2006, Liu Yongqing met with then-U.S. First Lady Laura Bush at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 1998年6月25日，刘永清以胡锦涛夫人身份首次亮相，迎接时任美国总统比尔·克林顿。
description.en: On June 25, 1998, Liu Yongqing made her first public appearance as Hu Jintao's wife to welcome then-U.S. President Bill Clinton.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任杭州市委书记期间，张鸿铭任副书记兼市长。
description.en: While Gong Zheng was the Party Secretary of Hangzhou, Zhang Hongming served as the Deputy Secretary and Mayor.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任山东省省长期间，刘家义担任中共山东省委书记。
description.en: While Gong Zheng served as Governor of Shandong Province, Liu Jiayi served as the Party Secretary of the CPC Shandong Committee.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任上海市市长期间，陈吉宁担任中共上海市委书记。
description.en: While Gong Zheng serves as Mayor of Shanghai, Chen Jining is the Party Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在上海台北双城论坛上会面并握手。
description.en: Met and shook hands at the Shanghai-Taipei City Forum.

description.zh-cn: 刘鹤曾担任中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: Liu He served as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于1968年6月正式加入中国国民党。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou officially joined the Kuomintang in June 1968.

description.zh-cn: 马英九毕业于国立台湾大学法律学系法学组，获得法学学士学位。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou graduated from the Law Department of National Taiwan University with a Bachelor of Laws degree.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于1977年获得纽约大学法学硕士学位。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou obtained a Master of Laws degree from New York University in 1977.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于1981年获得哈佛大学司法学博士学位。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou obtained a Doctor of Juridical Science (S.J.D.) degree from Harvard University in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，在钱复的推荐下，马英九返回台湾担任时任总统蒋经国的英文翻译。
description.en: In 1981, under the recommendation of Fredrick Chien, Ma Ying-jeou returned to Taiwan to serve as the English translator for then-President Chiang Ching-kuo.

description.zh-cn: 2000年国民党总统选举败选后，原属李登辉派系的马英九率先向李登辉逼宫，要求其辞去党主席职务。
description.en: After the KMT's defeat in the 2000 presidential election, Ma Ying-jeou, originally part of Lee Teng-hui's faction, led the charge to force Lee to resign as party chairman.

description.zh-cn: 2007年，马英九因特别费案被起诉而辞去中国国民党主席职务。
description.en: In 2007, Ma Ying-jeou resigned as Chairman of the Kuomintang after being indicted in the special allowance fund case.

description.zh-cn: 2009年6月1日，在萨尔瓦多卸任总统的国宴上，马英九与时任美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿会面。
description.en: On June 1, 2009, at a state banquet for the outgoing president of El Salvador, Ma Ying-jeou met with then-U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton.

description.zh-cn: 马英九出席竞选总部成立大会，支持国民党2024年总统选举候选人侯友宜。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou attended the campaign headquarters establishment rally to support KMT's 2024 presidential candidate Hou Yu-ih.

description.zh-cn: 马英九作为见证人，参与并协调侯友宜与柯文哲关于2024年总统选举的政党协商。
description.en: As a witness, Ma Ying-jeou participated in and coordinated the party negotiations between Hou Yu-ih and Ko Wen-je regarding the 2024 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 马英九多次表示反对并无法接受“一国两制”方案。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou has repeatedly stated his opposition to and unacceptance of the 'one country, two systems' formula.

position.en: President of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 马英九担任第十二、十三任中华民国总统。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou served as the 12th and 13th President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 马英九曾两度担任中国国民党主席。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou served as the Chairman of the Kuomintang on two separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 马英九担任第二、三届直辖市民选台北市市长。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou served as the 2nd and 3rd popularly elected Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 在在景山学校完成小学、初中与高中学业。
description.en: Completed primary, junior high, and senior high school education at Beijing Jingshan School.

description.zh-cn: 在基本系进修并获得大专学位。
description.en: Studied in the basic department and obtained an associate degree.

description.zh-cn: 与许其亮一同担任中共中央军事委员会副主席和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Served alongside Xu Qiliang as Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission and the PRC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 与何卫东一同担任中共中央军事委员会副主席和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Has been serving alongside He Weidong as Vice Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission and the PRC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张又侠接替范长龙出任中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: Zhang Youxia succeeded Fan Changlong as Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张又侠接替常万全出任中国人民解放军总装备部部长。
description.en: Zhang Youxia succeeded Chang Wanquan as Minister of the PLA General Armament Department.

description.zh-cn: 李尚福接替张又侠，出任中央军委装备发展部部长。
description.en: Li Shangfu succeeded Zhang Youxia as Minister of the CMC Equipment Development Department.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，时任沈阳军区司令员的张又侠陪同国防部长梁光烈访问美国。
description.en: In 2012, Zhang Youxia, then Commander of the Shenyang Military Region, accompanied Minister of National Defense Liang Guanglie on a visit to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 作为连长参加1979年中越战争，并因表现出色获得晋升。
description.en: Participated in the 1979 Sino-Vietnamese War as a company commander and was promoted for his outstanding performance.

description.zh-cn: 在老山战役中担任一一九团团长，指挥部队攻占关键高地，为战役取得决定性胜利立下首功。
description.en: Served as the commander of the 119th Regiment during the Battle of Laoshan, leading his troops to capture key high grounds and playing a primary role in the decisive victory of the battle.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁与白崇禧、黄绍竑合作，统一广西全省，是新桂系的核心领导人物。
description.en: Li Zongren cooperated with Bai Chongxi and Huang Shaohong to unify the entire province of Guangxi; they were the core leaders of the New Guangxi clique.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁在1929年的蒋桂战争和1930年的中原大战中与蒋介石为敌。在1948年的副总统选举中，他违背蒋的意愿参选并击败了蒋支持的候选人孙科。
description.en: Li Zongren was an enemy of Chiang Kai-shek in the Chiang-Gui War of 1929 and the Central Plains War of 1930. In the 1948 vice presidential election, he ran against Chiang's wishes and defeated the Chiang-backed candidate, Sun Fo.

description.zh-cn: 在1948年中华民国副总统选举中，李宗仁经过四轮投票最终击败了蒋介石支持的孙科，当选为副总统。
description.en: In the 1948 Republic of China vice presidential election, Li Zongren defeated the Chiang Kai-shek-backed Sun Fo after four rounds of voting to become Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 1952年监察院通过对李宗仁的弹劾案，指其“违法失职”。此案最终导致其于1954年被国民大会罢免。
description.en: In 1952, the Control Yuan passed an impeachment case against Li Zongren for 'violation of law and dereliction of duty'. This case ultimately led to his removal by the National Assembly in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁在抗日战争期间指挥第五战区部队取得台儿庄会战的胜利，使其名震一时，极大地提升了他的声望。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Li Zongren commanded the troops of the 5th War Area to victory in the Battle of Taierzhuang, which made him famous and greatly enhanced his prestige.

description.zh-cn: 国民党在第二次国共内战中的失败，导致李宗仁作为代总统的政府垮台，并最终迫使他流亡美国。
description.en: The KMT's defeat in the Second Chinese Civil War led to the collapse of the government with Li Zongren as acting president, ultimately forcing him into exile in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来促成并具体安排了李宗仁于1965年从海外返回中国大陆，并在“文化大革命”期间对他予以保护。
description.en: Zhou Enlai facilitated and specifically arranged for Li Zongren's return from overseas to mainland China in 1965, and provided him with protection during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁在美国期间通过口述自己的生平经历，促成了《李宗仁回忆录》的诞生。
description.en: During his time in the United States, Li Zongren's oral recounting of his life experiences led to the creation of "The Memoirs of Li Tsung-jen".

description.zh-cn: 唐德刚作为历史学家，对李宗仁进行口述历史采访，并执笔记录整理成书，出版了《李宗仁回忆录》。
description.en: As a historian, T. K. Tong conducted oral history interviews with Li Zongren, and then wrote, compiled, and published "The Memoirs of Li Tsung-jen".

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁是新桂系军阀集团的首领。
description.en: Li Zongren was the leader of the New Guangxi clique warlord group.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，李宗仁担任第五战区司令长官。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Li Zongren served as the Commander-in-Chief of the 5th War Area.

description.zh-cn: 李宗仁当选为行宪后第一任中华民国副总统。
description.en: Li Zongren was elected as the first Vice President of the Republic of China under the Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋介石引退后，李宗仁以副总统身份代理总统职权。
description.en: After Chiang Kai-shek's retirement, Li Zongren, as Vice President, acted as the President.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在2002年至2007年任中共浙江省委书记期间，黄坤明先后主政湖州、嘉兴，是其下属。黄坤明被认为是习近平的重要亲信之一。
description.en: While Xi Jinping was the Party Secretary of Zhejiang from 2002 to 2007, Huang Kunming served as the head of Huzhou and Jiaxing, making him a subordinate. Huang is considered a key confidant of Xi.

description.zh-cn: 习近平出任中共中央总书记后，将黄坤明上调至中共中央宣传部任职，为黄坤明在四年后接任部长作铺垫。
description.en: After Xi Jinping became General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, he promoted Huang Kunming to a position in the Central Propaganda Department, paving the way for Huang to take over as minister four years later.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明被广泛认为是闽江新军以及习近平派系的主要成员。这主要是因为他长期在福建和浙江与习近平有共事经历。
description.en: Huang Kunming is widely regarded as a key member of both the Minjiang New Army and the Xi Jinping faction, primarily due to his long working experience with Xi Jinping in Fujian and Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，黄坤明与时任三明市市长蔡奇一同被调往浙江省任职。
description.en: In 1999, Huang Kunming, along with Cai Qi, who was then the mayor of Sanming, were both transferred to Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 在刘奇葆担任中共中央宣传部部长期间，黄坤明担任其副手。
description.en: While Liu Qibao was the Minister of the Central Propaganda Department, Huang Kunming served as his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明接替刘奇葆出任中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Huang Kunming succeeded Liu Qibao as the Minister of the Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 据《南华早报》原主编王向伟撰文称，黄坤明于2022年底向习近平反映尽快结束清零政策的紧迫性，从而间接推动了该政策的终结。
description.en: According to an article by Wang Xiangwei, former editor-in-chief of the South China Morning Post, Huang Kunming reported the urgency of ending the zero-COVID policy to Xi Jinping at the end of 2022, thereby indirectly contributing to its termination.

description.zh-cn: 1988年至1993年就读于清华大学热能工程系空调专业。
description.en: Studied in the Air Conditioning major of the Department of Thermal Engineering at Tsinghua University from 1988 to 1993.

description.zh-cn: 从清华大学毕业后，胡海清到清华同方工作。
description.en: After graduating from Tsinghua University, Hu Haiqing worked at Tsinghua Tongfang.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛曾坚决反对女儿胡海清出国留学，并在其擅自前往比利时后，勒令其回国。
description.en: Hu Jintao strongly opposed his daughter Hu Haiqing's plan to study abroad and ordered her to return to China after she went to Belgium without his permission.

description.zh-cn: 移居美国后，茅道临与妻子胡海清拒绝了岳父胡锦涛多次要求他们回国的请求。
description.en: After moving to the United States, Mao Daolin and his wife Hu Haiqing refused his father-in-law Hu Jintao's repeated requests for them to return to China.

description.zh-cn: 田凤山于2003年10月被双规。
description.en: Tian Fengshan was subjected to 'Shuanggui' in October 2003.

description.zh-cn: 尉健行将金铮反映的关于胡海清承包医院一事转告了胡锦涛。
description.en: Wei Jianxing relayed the information from Jin Zheng about Hu Haiqing's contracting of the hospital to Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成与林徽因于1928年结婚，直至1955年林徽因逝世。
description.en: Liang Sicheng married Lin Huiyin in 1928, and they remained married until her death in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成于1962年与林洙结婚，直至1972年自己逝世。
description.en: Liang Sicheng married Lin Zhu in 1962, and they remained married until his own death in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 1946年回国后创办了清华大学营建学系（建筑系）。
description.en: After returning to China in 1946, he founded the Department of Construction (Architecture) at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，梁思成被作为“反动学术权威”受到批判、抄家和迫害，最终在贫病交加中去世。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Liang Sicheng was persecuted as a 'reactionary academic authority', criticized, his home was ransacked, and he eventually died in poverty and illness.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，梁思成为躲避战乱，被迫离开北平，携全家前往西南地区。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Liang Sicheng was forced to leave Beiping and flee to the southwest with his family to escape the war.

description.zh-cn: 时任北洋政府陆军部次长金永炎的轿车撞伤了骑摩托车的梁思成，导致其右腿骨折，脊椎受伤，并最终落下残疾。
description.en: A car belonging to Jin Yongyan, then Deputy Minister of the Army of the Beiyang Government, hit Liang Sicheng on his motorcycle, causing a fracture in his right leg, spinal injuries, and leaving him with a permanent disability.

position.en: Head of the Department of Architecture at Northeastern University

description.zh-cn: 梁思成在东北大学任教时，张学良时任该校校长。
description.en: When Liang Sicheng taught at Northeastern University, Zhang Xueliang was the president of the university.

description.zh-cn: 共同提出《关于中央人民政府行政中心位置的建议》，即“梁陈方案”，旨在保护北京古城。
description.en: They jointly proposed the 'Proposal on the Location of the Central People's Government Administrative Center', known as the 'Liang-Chen Proposal', aiming to protect the ancient city of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 据称，梁思成曾建议盟军在对日本进行轰炸时保护奈良的古建筑，但此说法存在争议，缺乏直接证据支持。
description.en: It is claimed that Liang Sicheng advised the Allied forces to protect the ancient architecture of Nara during the bombing of Japan, but this claim is disputed and lacks direct supporting evidence.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义于1915年入保定陆军军官学校第5期步兵科，1918年毕业。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi entered the 5th Infantry Division of Baoding Military Academy in 1915 and graduated in 1918.

position.zh-cn: 晋军军官、第二战区北路军总司令
position.en: Jin Army Officer, Commander of the Northern Route Army of the Second War Area

description.zh-cn: 傅作义毕业后加入阎锡山领导的晋军，长期在其麾下任职，直至1938年12月出任第八战区副司令长官后摆脱其控制。
description.en: After graduation, Fu Zuoyi joined the Jin Army led by Yan Xishan and served under him for a long time, until he broke free from his control after being appointed Deputy Commander of the Eighth War Area in December 1938.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义长期在阎锡山的晋军中服役并屡立战功，从中校升至中将。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi served in Yan Xishan's Jin Army for a long time, earning numerous military merits and rising from lieutenant colonel to lieutenant general.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义指挥其部队在绥远击退了伪蒙军的进攻，取得了百灵庙大捷。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi commanded his troops to repel the attack of the puppet Mongol army in Suiyuan, achieving a major victory at Bailingmiao.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义仿照中国共产党领导的八路军的建军经验，在其部队中成立政治工作机构，并制定类似《三大纪律八项注意》的纪律。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi modeled the army-building experience of the Eighth Route Army led by the Communist Party of China, establishing political work agencies in his troops and formulating disciplines similar to the 'Three Main Rules of Discipline and Eight Points for Attention'.

description.zh-cn: 在平津战役中，傅作义的部队接连遭受失败，其嫡系部队损失惨重，最终促使其决定与中共和谈。
description.en: During the Pingjin Campaign, Fu Zuoyi's forces suffered successive defeats, with his core troops sustaining heavy losses, which ultimately prompted him to negotiate peace with the Communists.

description.zh-cn: 1947年12月，蒋介石任命傅作义为华北剿匪总司令部总司令，统一指挥华北五省军队。
description.en: In December 1947, Chiang Kai-shek appointed Fu Zuoyi as the Commander-in-Chief of the North China Bandit Suppression Headquarters, unifying the command of troops in five provinces of North China.

description.zh-cn: 傅冬是傅作义的长女。
description.en: Fu Dong is Fu Zuoyi's eldest daughter.

description.zh-cn: 傅冬作为中共地下党员，在其父傅作义身边工作，不断进行劝说，为促成北平和平解放起了重要作用。
description.en: As an underground member of the CCP, Fu Dong worked alongside her father Fu Zuoyi and continuously persuaded him, playing a crucial role in bringing about the peaceful liberation of Beiping.

description.zh-cn: 董其武是傅作义的部下，曾接替傅作义担任绥远省政府主席，并在傅作义的影响下率部起义。
description.en: Dong Qiwu was a subordinate of Fu Zuoyi, succeeded him as the Chairman of the Suiyuan Provincial Government, and led his troops in an uprising under Fu's influence.

position.zh-cn: 水利部/水利电力部部长
position.en: Minister of Water Resources / Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，傅作义长期担任水利部及后来的水利电力部部长，是时任国务院总理周恩来的下属。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Fu Zuoyi served for a long time as the Minister of Water Resources and later the Minister of Water Resources and Electric Power, subordinate to then-Premier Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发之初，周恩来将傅作义列入应予保护的干部名单中，对其进行保护。
description.en: At the beginning of the Cultural Revolution, Zhou Enlai included Fu Zuoyi in a list of cadres to be protected, thereby protecting him.

description.zh-cn: 据蒋介石日记记载，傅作义于1963年派专人带去亲笔书写的“悉贡所能”四字，向蒋介石秘密表达意向。
description.en: According to Chiang Kai-shek's diary, Fu Zuoyi sent a special messenger in 1963 with a handwritten note of four characters, 'sī gòng suǒ néng' (I will do all I can), secretly conveying his intentions to Chiang.

description.zh-cn: 傅作义的堂弟傅作恭在甘肃夹边沟农场劳动教养期间，因三年大饥荒而去世。
description.en: Fu Zuoyi's cousin, Fu Zuogong, died during the Great Famine while undergoing re-education through labor at Jiabiangou Farm in Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，傅作义作为国民党高级将领，与毛泽东领导的共产党军队为敌，并曾发表致毛泽东的公开电进行谴责。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, Fu Zuoyi, as a high-ranking Nationalist general, was an enemy of the Communist forces led by Mao Zedong and once issued a public telegram condemning him.

description.zh-cn: 宋霭龄是宋子文的大姐。
description.en: Soong Ai-ling is T. V. Soong's eldest sister.

description.zh-cn: 宋美龄是宋子文的妹妹。
description.en: Soong Mei-ling is T. V. Soong's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 宋子良是宋子文的弟弟。
description.en: Song Ziliang is T. V. Soong's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是蒋中正的妻兄（大舅子）。
description.en: T. V. Soong was Chiang Kai-shek's brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是孔祥熙的妻弟。
description.en: T. V. Soong was H. H. Kung's brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是孙中山的妻弟。
description.en: T. V. Soong was Sun Yat-sen's brother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 早年于上海圣约翰大学求学。
description.en: Studied at St. John's University in Shanghai in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 1915年于哈佛大学经济学毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Harvard University with a degree in economics in 1915.

description.zh-cn: 在哥伦比亚大学研究所就读。
description.en: Attended graduate school at Columbia University.

description.zh-cn: 1923年起，宋子文担任孙中山的英文秘书。
description.en: Beginning in 1923, T. V. Soong served as Sun Yat-sen's English Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文曾多次担任行政院副院长、代理院长及院长职务。
description.en: T. V. Soong served multiple times as Vice Premier, Acting Premier, and Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 1933年，宋子文因在军费及预算问题上与蒋介石发生激烈冲突，甚至被蒋掌掴，遂辞去财长等职务。
description.en: In 1933, T. V. Soong had a fierce conflict with Chiang Kai-shek over military spending and budget issues, was even slapped by Chiang, and subsequently resigned from his post as Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 1935年4月起，宋子文接任中国银行董事长。
description.en: From April 1935, T. V. Soong took over as the Chairman of the Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文与张学良是好友，曾在西安事变中出面调解。
description.en: T. V. Soong and Zhang Xueliang were friends, and Soong mediated during the Xi'an Incident.

description.zh-cn: 1945年，宋子文赴苏联同斯大林会谈，并签订《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: In 1945, T. V. Soong went to the Soviet Union to meet with Stalin and sign the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文代表中华民国政府签订了《中苏友好同盟条约》。
description.en: T. V. Soong signed the Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance on behalf of the government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡适在日记中评价宋子文为“如此自私自利的小人”，显示了对其个人的负面看法。
description.en: Hu Shih described T. V. Soong in his diary as 'such a selfish villain,' indicating a negative personal opinion of him.

description.zh-cn: 据称杜鲁门曾大骂宋家为“贼”，但此说法的真实性存疑。
description.en: Truman allegedly called the Soong family 'thieves,' although the authenticity of this claim is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文于1947年9月至1949年1月担任广东省政府主席。
description.en: T. V. Soong served as the Chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Government from September 1947 to January 1949.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文与时任美国总统罗斯福会谈，罗斯福表示愿意向中国提供援助。
description.en: T. V. Soong met with then-U.S. President Roosevelt, who expressed willingness to provide aid to China.

description.zh-cn: 宋子文是宋氏家族的核心成员之一。
description.en: T. V. Soong was one of the core members of the Soong family.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是唐高宗李治的女儿。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the daughter of Emperor Gaozong of Tang (Li Zhi).

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是武则天的女儿。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the daughter of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是唐中宗李显的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Emperor Zhongzong of Tang (Li Xian).

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是安定思公主的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Princess Andingsi.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是李弘的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Li Hong.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主是李贤的妹妹。
description.en: Princess Taiping was the younger sister of Li Xian.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主于681年下嫁薛绍，此段婚姻因688年薛绍被赐死而结束。
description.en: Princess Taiping married Xue Shao in 681. The marriage ended with Xue Shao's forced death in 688.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主于690年改嫁武攸暨，此段婚姻因712年武攸暨去世而结束。
description.en: Princess Taiping remarried to Wu Youji in 690. The marriage ended with Wu Youji's death in 712.

description.zh-cn: 薛崇简是太平公主的儿子。
description.en: Xue Chongjian was the son of Princess Taiping.

description.zh-cn: 薛崇简是薛绍的儿子。
description.en: Xue Chongjian was the son of Xue Shao.

description.zh-cn: 薛绍是城阳公主的儿子。
description.en: Xue Shao was the son of Princess Chengyang.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主因参与诛杀张昌宗、张易之兄弟而在神龙政变中有功。
description.en: Princess Taiping was credited for her role in the Shenlong Coup due to her participation in the execution of the Zhang brothers (Zhang Changzong and Zhang Yizhi).

description.zh-cn: 因薛绍的兄长薛𫖮参与李冲谋反，武则天下令将薛绍杖责一百，饿死狱中。
description.en: Because Xue Shao's brother, Xue Yi, participated in Li Chong's rebellion, Wu Zetian ordered Xue Shao to be caned one hundred times and starved to death in prison.

description.zh-cn: 安乐公主曾试图诬陷太平公主，两人敌对关系明显白热化。
description.en: Princess Anle once attempted to frame Princess Taiping, and their adversarial relationship became overtly intense.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主与上官婉儿一同草拟中宗遗诏，在上官婉儿被杀后，太平公主十分哀伤，并出资厚葬及搜集其文集。
description.en: Princess Taiping and Shangguan Wan'er jointly drafted Emperor Zhongzong's final edict. After Shangguan Wan'er's execution, Princess Taiping was deeply saddened, funded her grand burial, and collected her literary works.

description.zh-cn: 薛崇简是李隆基（后来的唐玄宗）的党羽，在太平公主倒台后仅被流放而得以幸免。
description.en: Xue Chongjian was a partisan of Li Longji (later Emperor Xuanzong) and was spared execution, only being exiled after Princess Taiping's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 因贺兰敏之逼奸太平公主的宫女等劣迹，武则天大怒，下令将其流放并于途中处死。
description.en: Enraged by Helan Minzhi's misdeeds, including the assault on Princess Taiping's lady-in-waiting, Wu Zetian ordered him to be exiled and executed en route.

description.zh-cn: 史书记载太平公主与崔湜有私交。
description.en: Historical records indicate that Princess Taiping had an intimate relationship with Cui Shi.

description.zh-cn: 太平公主将张昌宗进献给母亲武则天，使其成为权倾一时的男宠。
description.en: Princess Taiping introduced Zhang Changzong to her mother Wu Zetian, enabling him to become a powerful male favorite.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝刘启是汉文帝刘恒的长子。
description.en: Emperor Jing (Liu Qi) was the eldest son of Emperor Wen (Liu Heng).

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝刘启的母亲是汉文帝的窦皇后。
description.en: The mother of Emperor Jing (Liu Qi) was Empress Dou of Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 窦皇后是汉文帝的皇后。
description.en: Empress Dou was the empress of Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 吴王刘濞是七国之乱的主要发起者和领导者。
description.en: Liu Pi, the King of Wu, was the main initiator and leader of the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 楚王刘戊与吴王刘濞一同领导了七国之乱。
description.en: Liu Wu, the King of Chu, co-led the Rebellion of the Seven States with Liu Pi, the King of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 在七国之乱爆发后，汉景帝为平息叛乱，采纳袁盎等人的建议，将晁错腰斩于东市。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Rebellion of the Seven States, Emperor Jing, in an attempt to quell the rebellion, adopted the advice of Yuan Ang and others and had Chao Cuo executed by waist-chop at the East Market.

description.zh-cn: 袁盎是晁错的政敌，他向汉景帝献策诛杀晁错以平叛乱。
description.en: Yuan Ang was a political rival of Chao Cuo and advised Emperor Jing to execute Chao Cuo to suppress the rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 刘启为太子时，因与吴国太子刘贤下棋发生争执，用棋盘打死了刘贤。
description.en: When Liu Qi was the crown prince, he killed Liu Xian, the Crown Prince of Wu, by striking him with a chessboard during a dispute over a game.

description.zh-cn: 刘贤是吴王刘濞的太子。
description.en: Liu Xian was the crown prince of Liu Pi, the King of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 因其子刘贤被太子刘启打死，吴王刘濞从此怨恨刘启和朝廷。
description.en: Because his son Liu Xian was killed by Crown Prince Liu Qi, Liu Pi, the King of Wu, harbored resentment towards Liu Qi and the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝派太尉周亚夫领兵，在三个月内成功平定了七国之乱。
description.en: Emperor Jing dispatched Grand Marshal Zhou Yafu to lead troops, and he successfully suppressed the Rebellion of the Seven States within three months.

description.zh-cn: 汉景帝派大将军窦婴与太尉周亚夫一同镇压七国之乱。
description.en: Emperor Jing dispatched General-in-chief Dou Ying along with Grand Marshal Zhou Yafu to suppress the Rebellion of the Seven States.

description.zh-cn: 平定七国之乱后，周亚夫因与汉景帝意见不合而遭猜忌，后被以谋反罪下狱，绝食而死。
description.en: After suppressing the Rebellion of the Seven States, Zhou Yafu was suspected by Emperor Jing due to disagreements, later imprisoned on charges of treason, and died on a hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 前150年，汉景帝废黜太子刘荣，将其贬为临江王，后刘荣被以“侵占庙地”罪名逼迫自杀。
description.en: In 150 BCE, Emperor Jing deposed Crown Prince Liu Rong, demoting him to King of Linjiang. Liu Rong was later forced to commit suicide on the charge of 'encroaching on temple grounds'.

description.zh-cn: 刘荣是汉景帝的长子。
description.en: Liu Rong was the eldest son of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 刘荣的生母是汉景帝的妃嫔栗姬。
description.en: Liu Rong's birth mother was Consort Li, a consort of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 栗姬是汉景帝的妃嫔。
description.en: Consort Li was a consort of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝刘彻是汉景帝刘启的儿子。
description.en: Emperor Wu, Liu Che, was the son of Emperor Jing, Liu Qi.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝刘彻的生母是汉景帝的孝景皇后王娡。
description.en: The birth mother of Emperor Wu (Liu Che) was Empress Jing, Wang Zhi, consort of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 前150年四月，汉景帝立王氏为皇后。
description.en: In the fourth month of 150 BCE, Emperor Jing installed Lady Wang as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 薄皇后是汉景帝的第一位皇后，于前151年被废。
description.en: Empress Bo was the first empress of Emperor Jing and was deposed in 151 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 周亚夫在汉景帝时期先后担任太尉（前154-前149）和丞相（前150-前147）。
description.en: Zhou Yafu served Emperor Jing successively as Grand Marshal (154-149 BCE) and Chancellor (150-147 BCE).

description.zh-cn: 晁错在汉景帝时期担任御史大夫。
description.en: Chao Cuo served as Grandee Secretary during the reign of Emperor Jing.

description.zh-cn: 长沙定王刘发是汉景帝的儿子，母唐姬。
description.en: Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha, was the son of Emperor Jing and Consort Tang.

description.zh-cn: 东汉光武帝刘秀是长沙定王刘发的后裔。
description.en: Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) of the Eastern Han was a descendant of Liu Fa, King Ding of Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 中山靖王刘胜是汉景帝的儿子，母贾夫人。
description.en: Liu Sheng, King Jing of Zhongshan, was the son of Emperor Jing and Lady Jia.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉昭烈帝刘备是中山靖王刘胜的后裔。
description.en: Emperor Zhaolie (Liu Bei) of Shu Han was a descendant of Liu Sheng, King Jing of Zhongshan.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，林义雄担任郭雨新竞选立法委员团队的法律顾问。
description.en: In 1975, Lin Yi-hsiung served as the legal counsel for Kuo Yu-hsin's legislative election campaign team.

description.zh-cn: 美丽岛事件发生后，林义雄于1979年12月13日遭到政府逮捕，后被军事法庭判处12年有期徒刑。
description.en: After the Kaohsiung Incident, Lin Yi-hsiung was arrested by the government on December 13, 1979, and later sentenced to 12 years in prison by a military tribunal.

description.zh-cn: 林宅血案发生后，时任总统蒋经国同意让林义雄交保出狱以料理丧事。
description.en: After the Lin family massacre, then-President Chiang Ching-kuo agreed to release Lin Yi-hsiung on bail to handle funeral arrangements.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉总统发布特赦令，宣告林义雄等人的美丽岛事件罪刑无效。
description.en: President Lee Teng-hui issued a special pardon, declaring the criminal sentences of Lin Yi-hsiung and others from the Kaohsiung Incident null and void.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄于1986年加入民主进步党，后因理念不合于2006年退出。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung joined the Democratic Progressive Party in 1986 and later withdrew in 2006 due to ideological differences.

description.zh-cn: 因反对时任党主席许信良的修宪方向，林义雄公开批评许信良并提出“罢免许主席”行动。
description.en: Due to his opposition to the constitutional amendment direction of then-DPP Chairman Hsu Hsin-liang, Lin Yi-hsiung publicly criticized Hsu and proposed a 'Recall Chairman Hsu' campaign.

description.zh-cn: 担任党主席期间，林义雄通过《台湾前途决议文》并强势主导党内提名，为陈水扁参选并当选总统铺平了道路，促成了台湾首次政党轮替。
description.en: During his chairmanship, Lin Yi-hsiung pushed through the 'Resolution on Taiwan's Future' and strongly guided the party's nomination process, paving the way for Chen Shui-bian's candidacy and election as president, which led to Taiwan's first party alternation.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁于2000年当选总统，完成了台湾首次政党轮替。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian's election as president in 2000 completed Taiwan's first party alternation.

description.zh-cn: 在在野党压力下，陈水扁政府妥协，宣布恢复兴建龙门核能发电厂。
description.en: Under pressure from opposition parties, the Chen Shui-bian administration compromised and announced the resumption of the construction of the Lungmen Nuclear Power Plant.

description.zh-cn: 因陈水扁政府宣布恢复兴建核四，林义雄无法接受并辞去民进党首席顾问，双方关系出现裂痕。
description.en: Due to the Chen Shui-bian administration's announcement to resume construction of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant, Lin Yi-hsiung found it unacceptable and resigned as chief advisor to the DPP, leading to a rift in their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄发起“诚信立国”运动，并以绝食静坐等方式，成功推动立法院席次减半的修宪案。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung initiated the 'Build the Nation on Integrity' movement and, through methods like hunger strikes and sit-ins, successfully pushed for the constitutional amendment to halve the number of legislative seats.

description.zh-cn: 在2006年民进党主席补选中，林义雄发表公开信，呼吁有意参选总统者不宜参选党主席，此举被视为针对游锡堃。
description.en: In the 2006 DPP chairmanship by-election, Lin Yi-hsiung issued an open letter urging those with presidential ambitions not to run for party chairman, a move seen as targeting Yu Shyi-kun.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，林义雄出面劝进蔡英文参选民主进步党主席。
description.en: In 2008, Lin Yi-hsiung came forward to persuade Tsai Ing-wen to run for the chairmanship of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 林义雄的无限期禁食行动最终迫使马英九政府于2014年4月27日宣布核四一号机封存、二号机停工。
description.en: Lin Yi-hsiung's indefinite hunger strike ultimately forced the Ma Ying-jeou administration to announce on April 27, 2014, that Unit 1 of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant would be sealed and Unit 2 construction would be halted.

description.zh-cn: 太阳花学运期间，林义雄前往立法院议场外静坐声援，直至运动结束。
description.en: During the Sunflower Student Movement, Lin Yi-hsiung went to sit in protest outside the Legislative Yuan in support of the movement until it concluded.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未是诗人艾青的儿子。
description.en: Ai Weiwei is the son of the poet Ai Qing.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未是高瑛的儿子。
description.en: Ai Weiwei is the son of Gao Ying.

description.zh-cn: 路青是艾未未的配偶。
description.en: Lu Qing is the spouse of Ai Weiwei.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未于1957年5月18日出生于北京。
description.en: Ai Weiwei was born in Beijing on May 18, 1957.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未于1978年入读北京电影学院动画系。
description.en: Ai Weiwei enrolled in the Animation Department of the Beijing Film Academy in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未于1981年前往美国，后入读纽约帕森设计学院。
description.en: Ai Weiwei went to the United States in 1981 and later enrolled at Parsons School of Design in New York.

description.zh-cn: 中国当局于2011年4月3日将艾未未秘密关押81天，释放后发起“发课税案”对其进行打压，并扣押其护照直至2015年7月。
description.en: Chinese authorities secretly detained Ai Weiwei for 81 days starting April 3, 2011. After his release, they launched the 'Fake Tax Case' to suppress him and confiscated his passport until July 2015.

description.zh-cn: 2009年8月，成都公安人员在酒店殴打艾未未致其脑出血。2011年4月，北京公安主导了对艾未未的秘密关押和后续的税务案件调查。
description.en: In August 2009, Chengdu police officers assaulted Ai Weiwei in a hotel, causing a cerebral hemorrhage. In April 2011, Beijing police led his secret detention and the subsequent tax case investigation.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，时任北京市公安局局长傅政华主导了对艾未未的审讯和迫害。
description.en: According to reports, Fu Zhenghua, then director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau, led the interrogation and persecution of Ai Weiwei.

description.zh-cn: 汶川大地震中大量校舍坍塌导致学生遇难，促使艾未未发起了公民调查。
description.en: The collapse of numerous school buildings during the Wenchuan earthquake, which resulted in student casualties, prompted Ai Weiwei to launch the citizens' investigation.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未应律师邀请，作为证人前往成都为四川维权人士谭作人出庭作证。
description.en: At the invitation of a lawyer, Ai Weiwei traveled to Chengdu to appear in court as a witness for Sichuan rights activist Tan Zuoren.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未探视并采访了被迫滞留日本成田机场的维权人士冯正虎，并制作纪录片《美好生活》声援其回家。
description.en: Ai Weiwei visited and interviewed activist Feng Zhenghu, who was forced to stay at Japan's Narita Airport, and produced the documentary 'A Beautiful Life' to support his return home.

description.zh-cn: 艾未未作为艺术顾问，参与了国家体育场“鸟巢”的设计工作。
description.en: As an artistic consultant, Ai Weiwei participated in the design work for the National Stadium, the 'Bird's Nest'.

description.zh-cn: 浦志强作为发课公司的代理律师，在“发课税案”中为艾未未方提供法律辩护。
description.en: As the legal counsel for Fake Ltd., Pu Zhiqiang provided legal defense for Ai Weiwei's side in the 'Fake Tax Case'.

description.zh-cn: 自艾未未被捕后，《环球时报》发表多篇社评，如《法律不会为特立独行者弯曲》，对其进行批评。
description.en: After Ai Weiwei's arrest, the Global Times published multiple editorials criticizing him, such as 'The Law Will Not Bend for Mavericks'.

description.zh-cn: 香港《文汇报》连续发文，称艾未未“五毒俱全”，涉嫌多宗罪名。
description.en: The Hong Kong newspaper Wen Wei Po published a series of articles accusing Ai Weiwei of being 'thoroughly corrupt' and involved in multiple crimes.

description.zh-cn: 2015年9月，乐高公司以作品含政治动机为由，拒绝向艾未未出售积木。该决定在引发公众抗议后于2016年1月被撤销。
description.en: In September 2015, The Lego Group refused to sell bricks to Ai Weiwei, citing political motives in his work. The decision was reversed in January 2016 following public outcry.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥是清圣祖康熙帝的第十三子。
description.en: Yinxiang was the 13th son of the Kangxi Emperor of Qing.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥的生母是敬敏皇贵妃章佳氏。
description.en: Yinxiang's birth mother was Imperial Noble Consort Jingmin of the Janggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥（皇十三子）与雍正帝（皇四子胤禛）是康熙帝的儿子，为异母兄弟。
description.en: Yinxiang (the 13th prince) and the Yongzheng Emperor (the 4th prince Yinzhen) were sons of the Kangxi Emperor, making them half-brothers.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝即位后，极大地提拔和重用胤祥，任命其为总理事务大臣，封为和硕怡亲王，并担任首席军机大臣等要职，赐予世袭罔替的铁帽子王爵位，是雍正朝的核心支柱。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor greatly promoted and relied on Yinxiang, appointing him Grand Minister of State Affairs, creating him Prince Yi of the First Rank, and having him serve as the first Chief Grand Council Minister. He was granted the hereditary 'iron-cap' princely rank and was a core pillar of the Yongzheng administration.

description.zh-cn: 康熙四十七年（1708年）废太子事件后，康熙帝在上谕中提及“十三阿哥，朕另有处置”，将其与罪臣之子并列，显示了康熙晚年对胤祥的打压。
description.en: After the incident of deposing the crown prince in 1708 (the 47th year of the Kangxi reign), the Kangxi Emperor mentioned in an edict, 'As for the 13th Prince, I have other arrangements,' listing him alongside sons of convicted officials, indicating his suppression of Yinxiang in his later years.

position.zh-cn: 皇子、和硕怡亲王、总理事务大臣、首席军机大臣
position.en: Imperial Prince, Prince Yi of the First Rank, Grand Minister of State Affairs, Chief Grand Council Minister

description.zh-cn: 胤祥是清朝皇子，在雍正朝担任核心大臣。
description.en: Yinxiang was a Qing dynasty imperial prince and served as a core minister during the Yongzheng era.

description.zh-cn: 康熙六十一年（1722年），雍正帝即位后封胤祥为和硕怡亲王，为第一代怡亲王。
description.en: In 1722 (the 61st year of the Kangxi reign), after ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor created Yinxiang as Prince Yi of the First Rank, making him the first Prince Yi.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥去世后，其第七子弘晓于1730年承袭怡亲王爵位。
description.en: After Yinxiang's death, his seventh son Hongxiao inherited the title of Prince Yi in 1730.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥因对雍正朝的巨大贡献，获雍正帝赐予其爵位世袭罔替的恩典，成为清朝第九位铁帽子王。
description.en: Due to his immense contributions to the Yongzheng court, Yinxiang was granted the privilege of a perpetually hereditary peerage by the Yongzheng Emperor, becoming the ninth 'iron-cap' prince of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓是怡贤亲王胤祥的第七子。
description.en: Hongxiao was the seventh son of Prince Yixian, Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 和硕和惠公主是胤祥的第四女。
description.en: Princess Heshuo Hehui was the fourth daughter of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 雍正七年十二月，和硕和惠公主下嫁喀尔喀博尔济锦氏多尔济塞布腾。
description.en: In the twelfth month of the seventh year of the Yongzheng reign (1729), Princess Heshuo Hehui married Dorjisebten of the Khalkha Borjigin clan.

description.zh-cn: 桑斋多尔济是和硕和惠公主的儿子。
description.en: Sangjaidorji was the son of Princess Heshuo Hehui.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥与和硕温恪公主是同胞兄妹，生母均为敬敏皇贵妃章佳氏。
description.en: Yinxiang and Princess Heshuo Wenke were full siblings, both born to Imperial Noble Consort Jingmin of the Janggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 胤祥与和硕敦恪公主是同胞兄妹，生母均为敬敏皇贵妃章佳氏。
description.en: Yinxiang and Princess Heshuo Dunke were full siblings, both born to Imperial Noble Consort Jingmin of the Janggiya clan.

description.zh-cn: 弘晈是胤祥的第四子。
description.en: Hongjiao was the fourth son of Yinxiang.

description.zh-cn: 孙策是孙坚的长子。
description.en: Sun Ce is the eldest son of Sun Jian.

description.zh-cn: 孙策是吴夫人的儿子。
description.en: Sun Ce is the son of Lady Wu.

description.zh-cn: 孙权是孙策的二弟。
description.en: Sun Quan is Sun Ce's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 周瑜在攻克皖城后娶小桥为妻。
description.en: Zhou Yu married Xiao Qiao after conquering Wan Castle.

description.zh-cn: 孙策在父亲孙坚死后，为讨回旧部曾一度在袁术麾下效力。
description.en: After his father Sun Jian's death, Sun Ce briefly served under Yuan Shu to reclaim his father's former troops.

description.zh-cn: 袁术僭越称帝后，孙策与其断绝关系，并参与了对袁术的讨伐。
description.en: After Yuan Shu declared himself emperor, Sun Ce broke ties with him and participated in the campaign against him.

description.zh-cn: 孙策通过平定江东一系列战役，建立了自己在该地区的统治。
description.en: Through a series of battles to conquer Jiangdong, Sun Ce established his rule in the region.

description.zh-cn: 孙策在曲阿之战中击败了时任扬州刺史的刘繇，夺取了其在江东的控制权。
description.en: Sun Ce defeated Liu Yao, then Inspector of Yang Province, in the Battle of Qu'e, seizing his control over Jiangdong.

description.zh-cn: 孙策进攻会稽，击败了太守王朗，平定了会稽郡。
description.en: Sun Ce attacked Kuaiji, defeated its administrator Wang Lang, and pacified the commandery.

description.zh-cn: 孙策进攻吴郡，击败了当地贼帅严白虎。
description.en: Sun Ce attacked Wu Commandery and defeated the local bandit leader Yan Baihu.

description.zh-cn: 在襄阳之战中，孙坚遭到刘表部下黄祖的伏击而阵亡。
description.en: During the Battle of Xiangyang, Sun Jian was ambushed and killed by Huang Zu, a subordinate of Liu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 孙策用计袭击刘勋的根据地皖城，将其击败并夺取庐江郡。
description.en: Sun Ce used a strategy to attack Liu Xun's base at Wan Castle, defeating him and seizing Lujiang Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 关于许贡被孙策处死一事，存在不同记载。一说195年，孙策在由拳击败时任吴郡太守的许贡，并因忌惮其名望将其诛杀。另一说则称，197年孙策因截获许贡意图不利于自己的上表，下令将其处死。
description.en: There are different accounts regarding Xu Gong's execution by Sun Ce. One account states that in 195, Sun Ce defeated Xu Gong, then the Grand Administrator of Wu Commandery, at Youquan, and executed him fearing his reputation. Another account suggests that in 197, Sun Ce intercepted a memorial from Xu Gong that was detrimental to him, and ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 孙策被已故吴郡太守许贡的门客刺杀身亡。
description.en: Sun Ce was assassinated by the retainers of the late Wu Commandery Administrator Xu Gong.

position.en: General Who Attacks Rebels, Marquis of Wu

description.zh-cn: 因孙策讨伐袁术有功，曹操表奏朝廷授予孙策讨逆将军官职并加封为吴侯。
description.en: Due to Sun Ce's merits in the campaign against Yuan Shu, Cao Cao petitioned the court to grant Sun Ce the title of 'General Who Attacks Rebels' and ennoble him as the Marquis of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 张纮在江都为孙策分析天下大势，规划了平定江东的战略蓝图（江都对），坚定了孙策创立基业的决心。
description.en: In Jiangdu, Zhang Hong analyzed the political landscape for Sun Ce and devised a strategic blueprint for conquering Jiangdong (the Jiangdu Dialogue), solidifying Sun Ce's determination to establish his own domain.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈原为刘繇部下，在神亭岭与孙策交战。后被孙策俘获，孙策亲自为其松绑并委以重任，太史慈遂归顺。
description.en: Tai Shi Ci initially served Liu Yao and fought Sun Ce at Shenting Ridge. He was later captured by Sun Ce, who personally untied him and entrusted him with important tasks, leading to Tai Shi Ci's allegiance.

description.zh-cn: 在孙策被祖郎围困时，程普奋勇当先，策马持矛突围，保护孙策得以脱险。
description.en: When Sun Ce was besieged by Zu Lang, Cheng Pu bravely charged forward with his horse and spear, breaking through the encirclement and protecting Sun Ce to safety.

description.zh-cn: 孙权称帝后，追谥其兄孙策为长沙桓王。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Sun Quan posthumously honored his elder brother Sun Ce as Prince Huan of Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平担任第13届台北县议员。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping served as a member of the 13th Taipei County Council.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平于2002年加入国民党，2019年退党，后于2022年通过“同舟计划”重返国民党。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping joined the Kuomintang in 2002, left the party in 2019, and returned in 2022 through the 'Tongzhou Project'.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平于1993年加入新党，并代表其首次当选公职。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping joined the New Party in 1993 and was first elected to public office as its representative.

description.zh-cn: 2023年9月，国民党提名钟小平参选台北市第五选举区立法委员。
description.en: In September 2023, the Kuomintang nominated Chung Hsiao-ping to run for legislator in Taipei City's 5th electoral district.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平在2016年宣布参选国民党主席时，表示若当选将立即开除连战的党籍。
