description.en: When Chung Hsiao-ping announced his candidacy for KMT chairman in 2016, he stated that if elected, he would immediately expel Lien Chan from the party.

description.zh-cn: 在2019年国民党立法委员党内初选中，林郁方击败钟小平。
description.en: In the 2019 KMT legislative primary, Lin Yu-fang defeated Chung Hsiao-ping.

description.zh-cn: 2019年退出国民党后，曾宣布以无党籍身份参选立委，并寻求与台湾民众党合作。
description.en: After leaving the Kuomintang in 2019, he announced his intention to run for legislator as an independent and sought cooperation with the Taiwan People's Party.

description.zh-cn: 钟小平通过中国国民党发起的“同舟计划”重返该党。
description.en: Chung Hsiao-ping returned to the Kuomintang through the 'Tongzhou Project' initiated by the party.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年中华民国立法委员选举中，民主进步党候选人吴沛忆击败钟小平当选。
description.en: In the 2024 Republic of China legislative election, Democratic Progressive Party candidate Wu Pei-yi defeated Chung Hsiao-ping.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城案向台北地检署告发时任台北市长柯文哲涉嫌图利，后续引发柯文哲提出诽谤自诉，双方于2025年8月5日和解。
description.en: Accused then-Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je of illicitly benefiting from the Core Pacific City case by filing a complaint with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office, which later led to a defamation lawsuit by Ko. The two parties reached a settlement on August 5, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城案向台北地检署一并告发时任台北市副市长彭振声涉嫌图利。
description.en: Also accused then-Taipei Deputy Mayor Peng Chen-sheng of illicitly benefiting from the Core Pacific City case in a complaint filed with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 向台北地检署按铃告发京华城案，促使司法调查展开。
description.en: Initiated judicial investigation into the Core Pacific City case by filing a formal complaint with the Taipei District Prosecutors Office.

description.zh-cn: 在工程补助款案中，驳回检方上诉，使钟小平等人获判无罪定谳。
description.en: In the engineering subsidy case, the Supreme Court rejected the prosecutor's appeal, leading to the final acquittal of Chung Hsiao-ping and others.

description.zh-cn: 质疑高雄市长陈菊利用其对高雄银行的影响力，涉嫌渎职炒高台北市房价。
description.en: Accused Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chu of using her influence over the Bank of Kaohsiung for malfeasance to inflate Taipei's housing prices.

description.zh-cn: 质疑高雄银行协助高雄市长陈菊渎职。
description.en: Accused the Bank of Kaohsiung of assisting Kaohsiung Mayor Chen Chu in malfeasance.

description.zh-cn: 在2014年初，围绕康师傅TDR案，一方告发连胜文涉嫌背信。另一方因不满钟小平就此案的不实指控，对钟小平提出诽谤告诉。此后，告发方在同年4月国民党市长初选落败后，表示将全力支持连胜文。
description.en: In early 2014, regarding the Tingyi TDR case, one party accused Sean Lien of breach of trust. Another party, dissatisfied with Chung Hsiao-ping's false accusations concerning the case, filed a defamation lawsuit against Chung Hsiao-ping. Subsequently, after losing the KMT mayoral primary in April of the same year, the initial accusing party pledged full support for Sean Lien.

description.zh-cn: 发动罢免时任立法委员林昶佐，该罢免案于2022年1月9日投票但未通过。
description.en: Initiated a recall campaign against then-Legislator Freddy Lim, which failed to pass in a vote on January 9, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要发起人，推动对立法委员林昶佐的罢免案。
description.en: As a main initiator, he promoted the recall case against Legislator Freddy Lim.

description.zh-cn: 与民进党籍的陈文治一同被控在担任台北县议员期间诈领工程补助款，后经最高法院判决无罪定谳。
description.en: Was accused along with DPP member Chen Wen-chih of fraudulently obtaining engineering subsidies while serving as a Taipei County Councilor; both were later acquitted by the Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央外事工作委员会办公室主任期间，向中共中央总书记习近平汇报工作。
description.en: As Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, he reported to CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在担任国务委员期间，向时任国务院总理李克强汇报工作。
description.en: As a State Councilor, he reported to then-Premier of the State Council Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 在担任外交部长期间，向时任国务院总理温家宝汇报工作。
description.en: As Minister of Foreign Affairs, he reported to then-Premier of the State Council Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 杨洁篪在南京大学攻读博士学位时，钱乘旦是其导师。
description.en: Qian Chengdan was Yang Jiechi's supervisor when he was pursuing his doctoral degree at Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 杨洁篪与王光亚在上海外国语学院附属中学就读时是室友。
description.en: Yang Jiechi and Wang Guangya were roommates while studying at the Shanghai Foreign Language School.

description.zh-cn: 受文化大革命的影响，杨洁篪于1968年被迫中止学业。
description.en: Affected by the Cultural Revolution, Yang Jiechi was forced to drop out of school in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 1972年尼克松访华后，周恩来指示加速培养外语人才，杨洁篪因此被选中派到国外留学。
description.en: After Nixon's visit to China in 1972, Zhou Enlai instructed to accelerate the training of foreign language talents, which led to Yang Jiechi being selected to study abroad.

description.zh-cn: 根据1971年毛泽东的指示精神，中国选拔了一批学生到国外留学，杨洁篪是其中之一。
description.en: Following Mao Zedong's instructions in 1971, China selected a group of students to study abroad, and Yang Jiechi was among them.

description.zh-cn: 为杨洁篪取了“老虎杨”（Tiger Yang）的绰号。
description.en: Gave Yang Jiechi the nickname 'Tiger Yang'.

description.zh-cn: 1977年，乔治·H·W·布什访问中国时，杨洁篪担任其全程陪同翻译。
description.en: In 1977, when George H. W. Bush visited China, Yang Jiechi served as his full-time accompanying interpreter.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁与黄兴、刘揆一、陈天华、章士钊等人共同成立华兴会。
description.en: Song Jiaoren co-founded the Huaxinghui with Huang Xing, Liu Kuiyi, Chen Tianhua, Zhang Shizhao, and others.

description.zh-cn: 在华兴会中，宋教仁担任副会长，会长为黄兴。
description.en: In the Huaxinghui, Song Jiaoren served as Vice President under President Huang Xing.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁支持孙中山成立中国同盟会，并担任司法部检事长。
description.en: Song Jiaoren supported Sun Yat-sen in establishing the Tongmenghui and served as the Procurator of its Judicial Department.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁是国民党的主要筹建人，主持了同盟会的改组工作。
description.en: Song Jiaoren was the main founder of the Kuomintang, presiding over the reorganization of the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 1903年8月，宋教仁与黄兴在武昌相识，从此成为挚友。
description.en: In August 1903, Song Jiaoren and Huang Xing met in Wuchang and became close friends thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 因对孙中山处理国旗及军火购买等事宜产生误会和不满，宋教仁产生恶感，并参与了第一次倒孙高潮。
description.en: Due to misunderstandings and dissatisfaction with Sun Yat-sen's handling of the national flag and arms procurement issues, Song Jiaoren developed animosity and participated in the first wave of anti-Sun movements.

description.zh-cn: 在国民党成立大会上，唐群英因党纲中没有“男女平权”而质问宋教仁，并掌击其脸颊。
description.en: At the founding meeting of the Kuomintang, Tang Qunying questioned Song Jiaoren about the absence of 'gender equality' in the party platform and slapped his cheeks.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁倡导的责任内阁制威胁到袁世凯的统治地位。时人普遍认为，袁世凯授意或幕后策划了对国民党领袖宋教仁的暗杀，以阻止其组阁。
description.en: The cabinet responsibility system advocated by Song Jiaoren threatened Yuan Shikai's ruling position. It was widely believed at the time that Yuan Shikai ordered or masterminded the assassination of Kuomintang leader Song Jiaoren to prevent him from forming a cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务总理赵秉钧被认为是直接布置暗杀宋教仁的执行者。
description.en: Then Premier Zhao Bingjun is considered to have been the direct organizer of Song Jiaoren's assassination.

description.zh-cn: 作为赵秉钧的秘书，洪述祖通过电报“毁宋酬勋”具体安排了刺杀行动。
description.en: As Zhao Bingjun's secretary, Hong Shuzu specifically arranged the assassination through the telegram 'destroy Song for a reward'.

description.zh-cn: 受洪述祖指使，雇佣武士英在上海北站刺杀了宋教仁。
description.en: Under instructions from Hong Shuzu, he hired Wu Shiying to assassinate Song Jiaoren at Shanghai North Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 在上海北站开枪射杀宋教仁的直接凶手。
description.en: The direct assassin who shot Song Jiaoren at Shanghai North Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 部分观点（如北一辉、袁克文等）认为，由于国民党内部的权力斗争，陈其美是刺杀宋教仁的幕后主使之一。
description.en: Some theories (e.g., from Kita Ikki, Yuan Kewen) suggest that due to internal power struggles within the Kuomintang, Chen Qimei was one of the masterminds behind Song Jiaoren's assassination.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁遇刺身亡是二次革命爆发的直接导火索。
description.en: The death of Song Jiaoren after his assassination was the direct trigger for the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山以宋教仁被刺和袁世凯进行“善后大借款”为由，果断发动了以武力反对袁世凯的二次革命。
description.en: Citing the assassination of Song Jiaoren and Yuan Shikai's 'Reorganization Loan,' Sun Yat-sen decisively launched the Second Revolution to oppose Yuan Shikai by force.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁是中华民国初期第一位倡导并极力推广责任内阁制的政治家。
description.en: Song Jiaoren was the first politician in the early Republic of China to advocate for and vigorously promote the cabinet responsibility system.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯通过段祺瑞买凶，刺杀了北洋第六镇统制吴禄贞。
description.en: Yuan Shikai hired assassins through Duan Qirui to kill Wu Luzhen, the commander of the 6th Division of the Beiyang Army.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯通过汪精卫和黄复生，指使彭家珍刺杀了其政敌良弼。
description.en: Yuan Shikai, through Wang Jingwei and Huang Fusheng, instructed Peng Jiazhen to assassinate his political rival Liangbi.

description.zh-cn: 在公开斥责袁世凯刺宋后，林述庆在袁世凯秘书长梁士诒的宴席上被毒死。
description.en: After publicly denouncing Yuan Shikai for assassinating Song, Lin Shuqing was poisoned at a banquet hosted by Yuan's chief secretary Liang Shiyi.

description.zh-cn: 为替袁世凯掩盖罪证，京畿军政执法处的侦探在火车上将应桂馨刺死灭口。
description.en: To cover up evidence for Yuan Shikai, detectives from the Capital's Military and Political Law Enforcement Office assassinated Ying Guixin on a train to silence him.

description.zh-cn: 1919年，洪述祖被北洋政府大理院以杀人罪判处死刑，并执行绞刑。
description.en: In 1919, Hong Shuzu was sentenced to death for murder by the Supreme Court of the Beiyang Government and was executed by hanging.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年的军委扩大会议上，彭德怀等人将刘伯承作为军事教条主义的代表进行批判。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the Military Commission in 1958, Peng Dehuai and others criticized Liu Bocheng as a representative of military dogmatism.

description.zh-cn: 1928年底至1930年8月，刘伯承在苏联伏龙芝军事学院学习。
description.en: From late 1928 to August 1930, Liu Bocheng studied at the Frunze Military Academy in the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，刘伯承担任八路军129师师长，领导开辟晋冀鲁豫边区，并指挥了百团大战等多项重要战役。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Liu Bocheng served as the commander of the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army, led the establishment of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan border region, and commanded many important campaigns, including the Hundred Regiments Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，刘伯承担任晋冀鲁豫军区、中原军区及第二野战军司令员，指挥了上党战役、淮海战役、渡江战役等一系列决定性战役。
description.en: During the second Chinese Civil War, Liu Bocheng served as commander of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Military Region, Central Plains Military Region, and Second Field Army, commanding a series of decisive campaigns including the Shangdang Campaign, Huaihai Campaign, and Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 1951年，刘伯承受命组建中国人民解放军军事学院并担任首任院长兼政委，为解放军正规化建设做出重要贡献。
description.en: In 1951, Liu Bocheng was ordered to establish the PLA Military Academy and served as its first president and political commissar, making significant contributions to the regularization of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 倪亦方是亦舒的胞兄。
description.en: Ni Yifang is Yi Shu's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 倪亦靖是亦舒的胞弟。
description.en: Ni Yijing is Yi Shu's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 倪震是亦舒的侄子。
description.en: Joe Nieh is Yi Shu's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 周慧敏是亦舒的侄媳。
description.en: Vivian Chow is Yi Shu's niece-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 在此任职七年。
description.en: Worked here for seven years.

description.zh-cn: 于1993年移民加拿大。
description.en: Immigrated to Canada in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 亦舒的早期作品多刊于《中国学生周报》。
description.en: Yi Shu's early works were mostly published in the China Student Weekly.

description.zh-cn: 亦舒后期的作品交予香港天地图书有限公司出版。
description.en: Yi Shu's later works were published by Hong Kong's Cosmos Books Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 亦舒的科幻作品不时会看到兄长倪匡作品的角色客串出现。
description.en: Characters from her elder brother Ni Kuang's works occasionally make guest appearances in Yi Shu's science fiction works.

description.zh-cn: 袁定阳是袁隆平的三子。
description.en: Yuan Dingyang is Yuan Longping's third son.

description.zh-cn: 担任第六届至第十二届全国政协常委。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 6th to 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 担任第六届至第十一届湖南省政协副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the 6th to 11th Hunan Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 袁隆平在1960年目睹大饥荒的惨状后，深受刺激，决意研究提高粮食产量。
description.en: After witnessing the devastating effects of the Great Famine in 1960, Yuan Longping was deeply moved and resolved to research ways to increase grain production.

description.zh-cn: 在文革期间，袁隆平遭到红卫兵和群众批判，其实验稻田的育种甚至被恶意拔除。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Yuan Longping was criticized by Red Guards and the masses, and his experimental rice paddies were even maliciously uprooted.

description.zh-cn: 国家科委在读到袁隆平的论文后，发公函责成湖南省科委将其列为“保护对象”并支持其研究。
description.en: After reading Yuan Longping's paper, the State Science and Technology Commission issued an official letter instructing the Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Commission to designate him as a "protected individual" and support his research.

description.zh-cn: 李必湖是袁隆平的助手和学生。
description.en: Li Bihu was Yuan Longping's assistant and student.

description.zh-cn: 李必湖在海南试验田发现了一株关键的野生稻雄性不育株“野败”，为杂交水稻“三系法”研究带来了决定性突破。
description.en: Li Bihu discovered a crucial wild rice plant with male sterility, named "Yebai," in an experimental field in Hainan, which brought a decisive breakthrough to the "three-line system" research for hybrid rice.

description.zh-cn: 袁隆平致力于杂交水稻的研究和推广，成功培育出三系法、两系法、超级杂交稻等品种，大幅提高了水稻产量。
description.en: Yuan Longping dedicated his life to the research and promotion of hybrid rice, successfully developing varieties through the three-line system, two-line system, and creating super hybrid rice, which significantly increased rice yields.

description.zh-cn: 林巧稚是负责为袁隆平接生的医生。
description.en: Lin Qiaozhi was the doctor who delivered Yuan Longping.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次和第二次鸦片战争中，清朝与大英帝国是主要交战方。
description.en: The Qing dynasty and the British Empire were the main belligerents in the First and Second Opium Wars.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次鸦片战争中，清朝与法兰西第二帝国是交战方。
description.en: The Qing dynasty and the Second French Empire were belligerents in the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 英国东印度公司向中国走私鸦片是导致战争的根本原因之一。
description.en: The British East India Company's smuggling of opium into China was one of the root causes of the war.

description.zh-cn: 《南京条约》使中国丧失了领土主权（割让香港岛），并被迫开放通商口岸和支付巨额赔款，损害了清朝的国家利益。
description.en: The Treaty of Nanking led to China's loss of territorial sovereignty (cession of Hong Kong Island) and forced the opening of treaty ports and payment of large indemnities, harming the national interests of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京条约》，清朝将香港岛割让给大英帝国。
description.en: Under the Treaty of Nanking, the Qing dynasty ceded Hong Kong Island to the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 第二次鸦片战争的第一阶段以英法联军的胜利告终，迫使清政府签订《天津条约》。
description.en: The first phase of the Second Opium War ended with the victory of the Anglo-French forces, forcing the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Tientsin.

description.zh-cn: 第二次鸦片战争的第二阶段以英法联军占领北京告终，迫使清政府签订《北京条约》以结束战争。
description.en: The second phase of the Second Opium War concluded with the occupation of Beijing by Anglo-French forces, compelling the Qing government to sign the Convention of Peking to end the war.

description.zh-cn: 根据《北京条约》，清朝将九龙半岛割让给大英帝国。
description.en: Under the Convention of Peking, the Qing dynasty ceded the Kowloon Peninsula to the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 《中俄北京条约》将乌苏里江以东包括库页岛在内的约40万平方公里领土割让给俄国。
description.en: The Sino-Russian Convention of Peking ceded approximately 400,000 square kilometers of territory east of the Ussuri River, including Sakhalin Island, to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 通过签订《中俄北京条约》，俄罗斯帝国获得了清朝割让的外东北大片领土。
description.en: By signing the Sino-Russian Convention of Peking, the Russian Empire acquired a large swathe of territory in Outer Manchuria ceded by the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 鸦片战争的失败及随后一系列不平等条约的签订，被普遍视为中国近代“百年国耻”的开端。
description.en: The defeat in the Opium Wars and the subsequent signing of a series of unequal treaties are widely regarded as the beginning of China's modern "Century of Humiliation".

description.zh-cn: 强加给中国的一系列不平等条约是“百年国耻”时期的核心组成部分和重要象征。
description.en: The series of unequal treaties imposed on China are a core component and important symbol of the "Century of Humiliation" period.

description.zh-cn: 叶名琛在处理“亚罗号事件”时扣押了船员，这一行动被英国视为挑衅，成为发动第二次鸦片战争的借口。
description.en: Ye Mingchen's seizure of the crew during the Arrow Incident was seen as a provocation by the British and became the pretext for launching the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 亚罗号事件是英国发动第二次鸦片战争的直接借口（导火索）。
description.en: The Arrow Incident served as the direct pretext (casus belli) for the United Kingdom to launch the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 广西西林教案是法国加入第二次鸦片战争的直接借口（导火索）。
description.en: The Father Chapdelaine Incident served as the direct pretext (casus belli) for France to join the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 英法联军在攻占广州后俘虏了两广总督叶名琛，后将其押往印度加尔各答，叶名琛于次年绝食而死。
description.en: After capturing Guangzhou, the Anglo-French forces captured Viceroy Ye Mingchen and exiled him to Calcutta, India, where he died on a hunger strike the following year.

description.zh-cn: 在通州谈判破裂后，僧格林沁下令截获并监禁了以外交官巴夏礼为首的英法谈判代表团。其中多人被虐待致死。
description.en: After the breakdown of negotiations in Tongzhou, Sengge Rinchen ordered the interception and imprisonment of the Anglo-French delegation led by diplomat Harry Parkes. Many of its members died from mistreatment.

description.zh-cn: 在八里桥决战中，僧格林沁率领的清军主力被英法联军彻底击败。
description.en: In the decisive battle of Baliqiao, the main Qing army led by Sengge Rinchen was completely defeated by the Anglo-French forces.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国利用第二次鸦片战争之机，以武力强迫清政府签订《瑷珲条约》。
description.en: The Russian Empire took advantage of the Second Opium War to force the Qing government to sign the Treaty of Aigun under military threat.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国以“调停有功”为由，在战后迫使清政府签订《中俄北京条约》，攫取更多领土。
description.en: Under the pretext of its 'meritorious mediation,' the Russian Empire forced the Qing government to sign the Sino-Russian Convention of Peking after the war, seizing more territory.

description.zh-cn: 战争的惨败使清朝统治集团部分官员认识到与西方的差距，从而推动了以“师夷长技以制夷”为目标的洋务运动。
description.en: The disastrous defeat in the war made some officials in the Qing ruling clique realize the gap with the West, thereby promoting the Self-Strengthening Movement with the goal of 'learning from the barbarians to counter the barbarians'.

description.zh-cn: 为应对战后复杂的外交局势，清政府于1861年设立了总理各国事务衙门。
description.en: To handle the complex post-war diplomatic situation, the Qing government established the Zongli Yamen in 1861.

description.zh-cn: 恭亲王奕䜣作为清方全权代表，与英方代表额尔金进行谈判并签订了《中英北京条约》。
description.en: As the Qing's plenipotentiary representative, Prince Gong Yixin negotiated with the British representative Lord Elgin and signed the Sino-British Convention of Peking.

description.zh-cn: 南昌起义后，中国共产党开始建立自己的正式武装部队，即中国工农红军。
description.en: After the Nanchang Uprising, the Chinese Communist Party began to establish its own formal armed forces, the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 在三大会战中，国军主力部队遭到歼灭性打击，从而丧失了在内战中的军事优势。
description.en: In the Three Great Campaigns, the main forces of the Nationalist army suffered devastating blows, thereby losing their military superiority in the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 苏军在1946年撤离东北前，将缴获的日本关东军武器移交给林彪的东北野战军，为中共抢占东北提供了便利。
description.en: Before withdrawing from Northeast China in 1946, the Soviet Army handed over captured weapons from the Japanese Kwantung Army to Lin Biao's Northeast Field Army, facilitating the CCP's occupation of the region.

description.zh-cn: 在第五次反围剿战争中失败后，中国工农红军主力被迫展开长征进行战略转移。
description.en: After being defeated in the Fifth Encirclement Campaign, the main forces of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army were forced to embark on the Long March as a strategic retreat.

description.zh-cn: 立法院职权修法争议被视为引发大罢免运动的主要原因之一。
description.en: The controversy over the amendments to the Legislative Yuan's powers is considered one of the main causes that triggered the Great Recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 反对国会改革的青鸟运动中，开始酝酿罢免国民党籍立委的行动，为大罢免埋下伏笔。
description.en: During the Bluebird Movement against legislative reforms, actions to recall KMT legislators began to brew, setting the stage for the Great Recall.

description.zh-cn: 民进党正式投入大罢免运动，将全国各县市党部与党公职服务处转为“民主连署站”，以行动支持罢免泛蓝公职人员。
description.en: The DPP formally joined the Great Recall movement, turning its party offices and service centers nationwide into 'Democracy Petition Stations' to actively support the recall of Pan-Blue public officials.

description.zh-cn: 作为民进党主席，赖清德在全代会宣示“民进党必须与公民同行”，标志着执政党全力投入支持罢免运动。
description.en: As the chairman of the DPP, Lai Ching-te declared at the party's national congress that the 'DPP must walk with the citizens,' signaling the ruling party's full commitment to supporting the recall movement.

description.zh-cn: 为反制泛绿阵营发起的罢免，国民党采取“以罢制罢”策略，发动对民进党籍民意代表的罢免，成为大罢免潮的另一股推动力量。
description.en: To counter the recalls initiated by the Pan-Green camp, the KMT adopted a 'recall for recall' strategy, launching recalls against DPP representatives, which became another driving force in the Great Recall wave.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民众党发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，参与罢免民进党籍民意代表，以此反制泛绿阵营发起的罢免潮。
description.en: The Taiwan People's Party launched the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign, participating in the recall of DPP representatives to counter the recall wave initiated by the Pan-Green camp.

description.zh-cn: 作为国民党主席，朱立伦领导并下令推动对民进党籍立委的罢免，作为对泛绿罢免行动的反制。
description.en: As the chairman of the KMT, Eric Chu led and ordered the promotion of recalls against DPP legislators as a countermeasure to the Pan-Green camp's recall actions.

description.zh-cn: 作为民众党立法院党团总召，黄国昌发动“扫除绿卫兵”行动，并号召集会，积极参与对民进党籍民意代表的罢免。
description.en: As the caucus convener of the TPP in the Legislative Yuan, Huang Kuo-chang initiated the 'Sweep the Green Guards' campaign and called for rallies, actively participating in the recall of DPP representatives.

description.zh-cn: 大罢免运动的失败所引发的政治效应，促使了卓荣泰内阁在后续进行局部改组。
description.en: The political fallout from the failure of the Great Recall movement prompted a subsequent partial reshuffle of the Cho Jung-tai cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 西乡隆盛回到鹿儿岛统率士族，以“质问政府”为名发动西南战争，反对明治政府的改革政策。
description.en: Saigō Takamori returned to Kagoshima to lead the samurai, launching the Satsuma Rebellion under the pretext of 'questioning the government', to oppose the reform policies of the Meiji government.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉于1885年3月16日在《时事新报》上发表社论《脱亚论》，倡导日本脱离亚洲、学习西方文明。
description.en: On March 16, 1885, Fukuzawa Yukichi published the editorial 'Datsu-A Ron' in the Jiji Shinpō, advocating for Japan to leave Asia and learn from Western civilization.

description.zh-cn: 作为旧幕府代表，与新政府代表西乡隆盛谈判，促成了江户的无血开城。
description.en: As the representative of the old shogunate, he negotiated with the new government's representative, Saigō Takamori, leading to the bloodless surrender of Edo.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上发表批判斯大林的“秘密报告”，开启“去斯大林化”，引发了毛泽东等中共高层的不满，成为中苏交恶的缘起。
description.en: Khrushchev's "Secret Speech" criticizing Stalin at the 20th CPSU Congress initiated "de-Stalinization," which caused dissatisfaction among Mao Zedong and other high-level CCP leaders, becoming the origin of the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 苏联政府正式照会中国外交部，决定召回全部在华工作的1390名苏联专家，并终止了数百份经济和科技合作合同，使中苏关系走向破裂。
description.en: The Soviet government officially notified the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs of its decision to recall all 1390 Soviet experts working in China and terminated hundreds of economic and technological cooperation contracts, leading to the rupture of Sino-Soviet relations.

description.zh-cn: 在苏共二十二大上，因苏共公开批判阿尔巴尼亚，中共代表团团长周恩来当场予以驳斥，并率团提前回国以示抗议。
description.en: At the 22nd CPSU Congress, due to the CPSU's public criticism of Albania, Zhou Enlai, head of the CCP delegation, refuted it on the spot and led the delegation to return to China early in protest.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，毛泽东号召“反苏修”，中苏两国关系彻底冻结，冲突升级。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Mao Zedong called for "opposing Soviet revisionism," which completely froze Sino-Soviet relations and escalated the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 珍宝岛事件是中苏边界冲突中规模最大、最激烈的武装冲突，导致两国关系紧张到核战争边缘。
description.en: The Zhenbao Island incident was the largest and most intense armed conflict in the Sino-Soviet border dispute, pushing relations between the two countries to the brink of nuclear war.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联考虑对中国进行核打击时，时任美国总统尼克松及其政府进行了干预，向苏联表明美国不会容忍此类行为，从而阻止了潜在的核攻击。
description.en: When the Soviet Union considered a nuclear strike against China, then-U.S. President Nixon and his administration intervened, indicating to the Soviets that the U.S. would not tolerate such an action, thereby preventing a potential nuclear attack.

description.zh-cn: 面对苏联的严重军事和核威胁，毛泽东等中共领导层开始谋求与美国发展关系，最终促成了1972年的尼克松访华。
description.en: Facing severe military and nuclear threats from the Soviet Union, Mao Zedong and other CCP leaders began to seek better relations with the United States, ultimately leading to Nixon's visit to China in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 为应对苏联的扩张势头，毛泽东提出了“一条线、一大片”的外交战略构想。其中，“一条线”战略于1973年向基辛格提出，而“一大片”构想则于1974年向大平正芳提出。
description.en: To counter Soviet expansionism, Mao Zedong proposed the foreign policy strategy of "one line, one large area." The 'one line' strategy was proposed to Kissinger in 1973, while the 'one large area' concept was presented to Masayoshi Ōhira in 1974.

description.zh-cn: 在中共早期，斯大林不信任毛泽东，支持“二十八个半布尔什维克”等苏联路线的领导人，并将毛泽东排除在中央委员会之外。
description.en: In the early days of the CCP, Stalin distrusted Mao Zedong, supported leaders who followed the Soviet line, such as the "28 Bolsheviks," and excluded Mao from the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 苏联以正在谈判禁止核试验条约为由，暂缓向中国提供核武器样品和技术资料，撕毁了《中苏国防新技术协定》。
description.en: Citing ongoing negotiations for a nuclear test ban treaty, the Soviet Union suspended the provision of nuclear weapon samples and technical data to China, tearing up the 'Sino-Soviet Agreement on New Technology for National Defense'.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放带来的思想解放、对西方民主观念的接触以及对政治体制改革的讨论，为八六学潮的发生提供了重要的社会和思想背景。
description.en: The intellectual liberation, exposure to Western democratic concepts, and discussions on political system reform brought by the Reform and Opening-up provided a significant social and ideological background for the 1986 student demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国科学技术大学副校长方励之在校内的竞选演讲中，宣扬民主需要靠自己争取，其言论和公开支持极大地鼓舞了学生，推动了学潮的发生和发展。
description.en: In his campaign speech at the university, then-Vice President Fang Lizhi advocated that democracy must be fought for, which greatly inspired the students and propelled the outbreak and development of the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国作家协会副主席刘宾雁与方励之一同前往上海多所高校发表演讲，对学生思想产生影响，推动了学潮的酝酿。
description.en: Then-Vice Chairman of the Chinese Writers Association, Liu Binyan, delivered speeches at several universities in Shanghai along with Fang Lizhi, influencing student thought and contributing to the fomentation of the demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 八六学潮是改革开放时期第一次全国范围的学潮，是中华人民共和国民主运动中的一个重要事件，推动了民主思想的传播。
description.en: The 1986 student demonstrations were the first nationwide student movement during the Reform and Opening-up era, a significant event in the democracy movement of the People's Republic of China that promoted the spread of democratic ideas.

description.zh-cn: 中共保守派将学潮的爆发归咎于胡耀邦对资产阶级自由化的纵容，并向邓小平等核心领导人施压，最终促使其下台。
description.en: CCP conservatives blamed the outbreak of the student movement on Hu Yaobang's tolerance of bourgeois liberalization and pressured paramount leader Deng Xiaoping and others, ultimately leading to his ousting.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在与胡耀邦等人的谈话中严厉批评其应对学潮不力，并主持了决定胡耀邦辞职的中央政治局扩大会议，起到了决定性作用。
description.en: In a talk with Hu Yaobang and others, Deng Xiaoping severely criticized his ineffective response to the student unrest and presided over the enlarged Politburo meeting that decided Hu's resignation, playing a decisive role.

description.zh-cn: 在1987年1月16日的中共中央政治局扩大会议上，胡耀邦辞去中共中央总书记职务。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the CCP Politburo on January 16, 1987, Hu Yaobang resigned from his position as General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦辞职后，赵紫阳被一致推选为代理中共中央总书记。
description.en: Following Hu Yaobang's resignation, Zhao Ziyang was unanimously elected as the acting General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 为了肃清学潮的思想影响，中共中央在学潮平息后发起了“反对资产阶级自由化”运动。
description.en: To eliminate the ideological influence of the student movement, the CCP Central Committee launched the 'Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign' after the unrest was suppressed.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在1986年12月30日的谈话中，强调必须“旗帜鲜明地反对资产阶级自由化”，为该运动的展开奠定了基调。
description.en: In his speech on December 30, 1986, Deng Xiaoping emphasized the need to 'take a clear-cut stand against bourgeois liberalization,' setting the tone for the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，方励之被撤销中国科学技术大学副校长职务，并于1987年1月17日被开除党籍。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Fang Lizhi was removed from his post as Vice President of the University of Science and Technology of China and was expelled from the party on January 17, 1987.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，管惟炎被撤销中国科学技术大学校长职务。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Guan Weiyan was removed from his post as President of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，刘宾雁被开除党籍。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Liu Binyan was expelled from the party.

description.zh-cn: 在反对资产阶级自由化运动中，王若望被开除党籍。
description.en: During the Anti-Bourgeois Liberalization Campaign, Wang Ruowang was expelled from the party.

description.zh-cn: 八六学潮为1989年的六四事件埋下伏笔，部分学潮的参与者后来也成为六四事件的发起人和组织者。
description.en: The 1986 student demonstrations set the stage for the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, and some of its participants later became initiators and organizers of the 1989 events.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在1980年代实际主导最高决策，决定并推动了废除干部领导职务终身制这项重要的政治制度改革。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping, as the paramount leader in the 1980s, decided on and promoted the abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres, an important political system reform.

description.zh-cn: 废除干部领导职务终身制改革的重要内容之一是建立起领导干部的任期制。
description.en: A key component of the reform to abolish the lifelong tenure system was the establishment of a term limit system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 废除干部领导职务终身制改革的重要内容之一是建立起领导干部的退休制度。
description.en: A key component of the reform to abolish the lifelong tenure system was the establishment of a retirement system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 中共十二大通过新党章，规定设立中央顾问委员会，并选举产生第一届委员，从而正式建立该机构，作为废除领导干部职务终身制的过渡性机构。
description.en: The 12th CPC National Congress passed a new party constitution to establish the Central Advisory Commission and elected its first members, formally creating the institution as a transitional body for abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 中央顾问委员会作为一项过渡性制度安排，通过安置老干部，为废除领导职务终身制铺平了道路。
description.en: As a transitional institutional arrangement, the Central Advisory Commission paved the way for the abolition of the lifelong tenure system by accommodating veteran cadres.

description.zh-cn: 《八二宪法》规定国家主席等领导人“连续任职不得超过两届”，象征着领导干部职务终身制被正式废除。
description.en: The '82 Constitution stipulated that leaders such as the President 'shall serve no more than two consecutive terms,' symbolizing the formal abolition of the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛在中共十八大上卸任所有职务，实现“裸退”，被习近平称赞为“高风亮节”，此举被视为进一步完善了废除干部领导职务终身制的制度。
description.en: Hu Jintao stepped down from all positions at the 18th CPC National Congress, achieving a 'naked retirement,' which was praised by Xi Jinping as a 'noble act' and seen as a further step in perfecting the system of abolishing lifelong tenure for cadres.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央总书记、中共中央军委主席
position.en: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 在中共十八大上，习近平接替胡锦涛，成为中国共产党的主要领导人。
description.en: At the 18th CPC National Congress, Xi Jinping succeeded Hu Jintao to become the primary leader of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 取消国家主席任期限制的修宪被普遍认为是习近平为了谋求长期执政而推动的举动。
description.en: The constitutional amendment to remove the presidential term limit is widely seen as a move pushed by Xi Jinping to secure long-term rule.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案取消了国家主席的任期限制，此举被外界解读为对邓小平时代确立的废除领导干部职务终身制原则的逆转，有媒体认为干部领导职务终身制已经复辟。
description.en: This amendment removed the term limit for the President, a move interpreted by outsiders as a reversal of the principle of abolishing lifelong tenure established during the Deng Xiaoping era, with some media suggesting the lifelong system has been restored.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民在主政期间延续了废除干部领导职务终身制的政策。
description.en: During his tenure, Jiang Zemin continued the policy of abolishing the lifelong tenure system for leading cadres.

description.zh-cn: 《朴茨茅斯条约》的签订标志着日俄战争的正式结束。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Portsmouth marked the official end of the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 作为中间人斡旋日俄双方进行停战谈判并达成协议。
description.en: Acted as a mediator to facilitate peace negotiations between Japan and Russia, leading to the agreement.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国在战争中的失败和巨大消耗，加剧了国内社会矛盾，是引发1905年革命的直接导火索。
description.en: The Russian Empire's defeat and enormous costs in the war exacerbated domestic social conflicts, acting as a direct catalyst for the 1905 Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 日本以君主立宪政体战胜专制俄国，给清廷上下带来巨大震动，认为“立宪能战胜于专制”，从而推动了清末的立宪运动。
description.en: Japan, a constitutional monarchy, defeating autocratic Russia sent shockwaves through the Qing court, leading to the belief that 'constitutionalism can defeat autocracy' and thus promoting the constitutional movement in the late Qing.

description.zh-cn: 日本在日俄战争中获胜，俄国承认日本对朝鲜的指导及监督权，日本随即迫使大韩帝国签订该协约，使其成为日本的保护国。
description.en: After Japan's victory in the Russo-Japanese War, Russia recognized Japan's right to guide and supervise Korea. Japan then compelled the Korean Empire to sign this treaty, making it a Japanese protectorate.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅在观看日俄战争中中国人作俄军间谍被日军处决的幻灯片后，认识到改变国民精神的重要性，从而决定弃医从文。
description.en: After watching a slide show depicting a Chinese person being executed by the Japanese army as a Russian spy during the war, Lu Xun realized the importance of changing the national spirit and decided to abandon medicine for literature.

description.zh-cn: 俄国舰队在对马海峡海战中几乎全军覆没，使其彻底丧失扭转战局的希望，从而开始与日本进行停战谈判。
description.en: The near-total annihilation of the Russian fleet at the Battle of Tsushima destroyed Russia's hopes of turning the tide of the war, prompting it to begin peace negotiations with Japan.

description.zh-cn: 联合舰队在此战中以极小的代价取得了决定性胜利。
description.en: The Combined Fleet achieved a decisive victory in this battle with minimal losses.

description.zh-cn: 日本在甲午战争后通过《马关条约》获得辽东半岛，直接引发了俄、德、法三国的干涉。
description.en: Japan's acquisition of the Liaodong Peninsula through the Treaty of Shimonoseki after the First Sino-Japanese War directly triggered the intervention of Russia, Germany, and France.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄国的盟友，黑山公国向日本宣战，但战后被遗忘，两国在法律上的战争状态直到2006年才结束。
description.en: As an ally of Russia, the Principality of Montenegro declared war on Japan, but was forgotten after the war. The legal state of war between the two countries did not end until 2006.

description.zh-cn: 日英同盟的签订使日本在与俄国的对抗中获得了外交上的支持，使其有底气发动战争。
description.en: The signing of the Anglo-Japanese Alliance gave Japan diplomatic support in its confrontation with Russia, providing it with the confidence to start the war.

description.zh-cn: 俄军在奉天会战中战败并撤退，这是日俄战争中规模最大的一次陆战失利。
description.en: The Russian army was defeated and retreated in the Battle of Mukden, its largest land battle loss in the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 担任日俄战争时期大日本帝国的国家元首和名义上的最高统帅。
description.en: Served as the head of state and nominal commander-in-chief of the Empire of Japan during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 担任日俄战争时期俄罗斯帝国的国家元首和最高统帅。
description.en: Served as the head of state and commander-in-chief of the Russian Empire during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 在日俄战争期间担任日本海军联合舰队的司令长官。
description.en: Served as the Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese Combined Fleet during the Russo-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 清零政策是为应对2019冠状病毒病疫情而采取的一种防疫策略。
description.en: The zero-COVID policy was an epidemic prevention strategy adopted in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

description.zh-cn: 公开表示中国的清零政策不可持续。
description.en: Publicly stated that China's zero-COVID policy was unsustainable.

description.zh-cn: 公开表示不认为中国大陆推行的清零政策可以持久进行。
description.en: Publicly stated that he did not believe the zero-COVID policy pursued by mainland China was sustainable.

description.zh-cn: 公开承认变种病毒毒力减弱，表示中国疫情处于“新形势新任务”，提早宣布了清零政策开始松动。
description.en: Publicly acknowledged the weakening virulence of the virus variant, stating that China's epidemic was in a 'new situation with new tasks', thus pre-announcing the loosening of the zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 因疫情防控要求，一辆深夜违规行驶的隔离转运客车发生侧翻，导致27人死亡。
description.en: Due to epidemic control requirements, a quarantine transfer bus operating illegally late at night overturned, resulting in 27 deaths.

description.zh-cn: 据路透社报道，在执行宽松防疫措施后，习近平希望放缓开放，但李强反驳了习近平的要求，并继续推动放宽政策。
description.en: According to Reuters, after implementing relaxed epidemic measures, Xi Jinping wished to slow down the reopening, but Li Qiang rebutted his request and continued to push for policy relaxation.

description.zh-cn: 据媒体人士王向伟透露，时任中共广东省委书记黄坤明曾向习近平反映尽快结束清零政策的紧迫性，间接推动了政策终结。
description.en: According to media personality Wang Xiangwei, Huang Kunming, then Party Secretary of Guangdong, reported to Xi Jinping on the urgency of ending the zero-COVID policy, indirectly contributing to its termination.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在与欧洲理事会主席夏尔·米歇尔的会谈中，承认国内示威源于抗疫三年民众感到沮丧，并承认奥密克戎株致命性远不如德尔塔株。
description.en: During a meeting with European Council President Charles Michel, Xi Jinping acknowledged that domestic protests stemmed from public frustration after three years of pandemic response and admitted the Omicron variant was far less lethal than Delta.

description.zh-cn: 在回应谭德塞对清零政策的批评时，时任外交部发言人赵立坚警告对方“不要发表不负责任的言论”。
description.en: In response to Tedros's criticism of the zero-COVID policy, then-Foreign Ministry spokesman Zhao Lijian warned him 'not to make irresponsible remarks'.

description.zh-cn: 越南在2021年底放弃了清零政策。
description.en: Vietnam abandoned the zero-COVID policy in late 2021.

description.zh-cn: 该次会议后，以习近平为首的新一届中共中央领导集体开启了大规模的反腐败运动。
description.en: After this congress, the new CCP central leadership collective headed by Xi Jinping launched a large-scale anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中纪委是该运动的主要执行机构，负责调查党员干部的违纪违法行为。
description.en: The CCDI is the main executive body of the campaign, responsible for investigating disciplinary and legal violations by party officials.

description.zh-cn: 王岐山在2012年至2017年间担任第十八届中共中央纪律检查委员会书记。
description.en: Wang Qishan served as the Secretary of the 18th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CCP from 2012 to 2017.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局常委周永康在运动中被立案审查，成为首位因腐败问题被公开查处的正国级领导人。
description.en: Former Politburo Standing Committee member Zhou Yongkang was investigated during the campaign, becoming the first national-level leader to be publicly prosecuted for corruption.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局委员徐才厚是此次反腐运动中落马的高级将领之一。
description.en: Former Politburo member Xu Caihou was one of the high-ranking military officials purged during this anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局委员郭伯雄是此次反腐运动中落马的高级将领之一。
description.en: Former Politburo member Guo Boxiong was one of the high-ranking military officials purged during this anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央政治局委员孙政才是此次反腐运动中落马的副国级领导人之一。
description.en: Former Politburo member Sun Zhengcai was one of the vice-national level leaders purged during this anti-corruption campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中央巡视组在“中央巡视工作领导小组”的协调下开展工作并向其汇报。
description.en: The Central Inspection Teams operate under the coordination of and report to the Central Leading Group for Inspection Work.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后因仇视外国势力，从默许纵容转向公开支持义和团，并最终决定向十一国宣战，将义和团运动推向高潮。
description.en: Driven by her hostility towards foreign powers, Empress Dowager Cixi's stance shifted from tacit approval to open support for the Boxers, eventually deciding to declare war on eleven nations, thus pushing the Boxer Rebellion to its climax.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军以解救使馆和镇压拳乱为名出兵中国，击败了义和团和清军，最终导致了义和团运动的失败。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance dispatched troops to China under the pretext of rescuing the legations and suppressing the Boxers. They defeated the Boxers and Qing forces, ultimately leading to the failure of the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 义和团运动的失败直接导致清政府被迫与十一国签订《辛丑条约》，承担巨额赔款及丧失多项主权。
description.en: The failure of the Boxer Rebellion directly led to the Qing government being forced to sign the Boxer Protocol with eleven nations, incurring massive indemnities and the loss of various sovereign rights.

description.zh-cn: 清政府于1900年6月21日向十一国宣战，与八国联军进入战争状态。
description.en: The Qing government declared war on eleven nations on June 21, 1900, entering a state of war with the Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 义和团以“灭洋”为主要目标，与前来镇压的八国联军进行了直接的武装对抗。
description.en: With 'exterminating foreigners' as their main goal, the Boxers engaged in direct armed conflict with the invading Eight-Nation Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 端郡王载漪因其子立储问题遭外国公使反对而仇视洋人，极力主张利用义和团向列强开战，是清廷主战派的核心人物。
description.en: Prince Duan, Zaiyi, harbored resentment towards foreigners after they opposed his son's appointment as heir apparent. He strongly advocated for using the Boxers to wage war against the foreign powers and was a central figure in the court's pro-war faction.

description.zh-cn: 吏部尚书刚毅是朝廷中支持义和团的主要官员之一，他向慈禧太后报告“拳民忠贞，神术可用”，力主抚、用义和团。
description.en: Grand Secretary Gangyi was one of the main court officials supporting the Boxers. He reported to Empress Dowager Cixi that the 'Boxers are loyal and their divine arts can be used,' strongly advocating for appeasing and utilizing them.

description.zh-cn: 作为山东巡抚，毓贤对义和团采取纵容和招抚政策，将“义和拳”改名为“义和团”，助长了其发展势头。
description.en: As Governor of Shandong, Yuxian adopted a policy of appeasement and co-optation towards the Boxers, renaming the 'Righteous and Harmonious Fists' to 'Righteous and Harmonious Militia' (Yihetuan) and fueling their growth.

description.zh-cn: 以张之洞、刘坤一为首的东南各省督抚拒绝响应清廷支持义和团的命令，维持地方稳定，客观上限制了义和团运动的蔓延。
description.en: Led by Zhang Zhidong and Liu Kunyi, governors of the southeastern provinces refused to obey the imperial court's command to support the Boxers, maintaining regional stability and objectively limiting the spread of the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 清军神机营军官恩海在北京街头射杀了德国公使克林德。
description.en: En Hai, an officer of the Qing Manchu Banner Corps, shot and killed the German minister Clemens von Ketteler on a street in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 因许景澄反对向列强开战，主张剿灭义和团，被慈禧太后下令处死。
description.en: Xu Jingcheng was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi because he opposed declaring war on the foreign powers and advocated for the suppression of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 因袁昶反对向列强开战，主张剿灭义和团，被慈禧太后下令处死。
description.en: Yuan Chang was executed by order of Empress Dowager Cixi because he opposed declaring war on the foreign powers and advocated for the suppression of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 时任湖广总督的张之洞是“东南互保”的主要策划者之一。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong, then Viceroy of Huguang, was one of the main architects of the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China'.

description.zh-cn: 时任两江总督的刘坤一是“东南互保”的主要策划者之一。
description.en: Liu Kunyi, then Viceroy of Liangjiang, was one of the main architects of the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China'.

description.zh-cn: 时任两广总督的李鸿章参与了“东南互保”。
description.en: Li Hongzhang, then Viceroy of Liangguang, participated in the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China'.

description.zh-cn: 董福祥率领的甘军在廊坊等地与西摩尔率领的联军援军激战，成功阻击了其前进。
description.en: The Kansu Braves led by Dong Fuxiang engaged in fierce battles with the allied relief force led by Seymour at Langfang and other locations, successfully blocking their advance.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争战败后，西方列强在中国划分势力范围，加剧了社会矛盾和排外情绪，为义和团运动的兴起提供了背景。
description.en: After the defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War, Western powers carved out spheres of influence in China, exacerbating social tensions and anti-foreign sentiment, which provided the backdrop for the rise of the Boxer Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军于1900年8月14日攻入并占领北京。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance attacked and occupied Beijing on August 14, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军于1900年7月14日攻克天津城。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance captured the city of Tianjin on July 14, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 外国公使反对“己亥建储”，加深了慈禧太后对外国的仇视，成为其支持义和团的动因之一。
description.en: The opposition of foreign ministers to the 'Jihai Establishment' deepened Empress Dowager Cixi's hostility towards foreigners, becoming one of the motives for her support of the Boxers.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党领导国民革命军发动了北伐战争。
description.en: The Kuomintang led the National Revolutionary Army to launch the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 北伐战争最终瓦解了北洋军阀及其掌控的北洋政府。
description.en: The Northern Expedition ultimately dismantled the Beiyang warlords and the Beiyang government under their control.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军北伐的主要目标是消灭北洋军阀。
description.en: The main objective of the National Revolutionary Army's Northern Expedition was to eliminate the Beiyang warlords.

description.zh-cn: 被国民政府任命为国民革命军总司令，领导北伐。
description.en: Appointed by the Nationalist Government as Commander-in-Chief of the National Revolutionary Army to lead the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次国共合作期间，两党合作进行国民革命，包括北伐战争初期。
description.en: During the First United Front, the two parties cooperated in the National Revolution, including the initial phase of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 苏联向国民政府提供军事顾问、武器弹药等援助，支持其建立军队和进行北伐。
description.en: The Soviet Union provided military advisors, weapons, and ammunition to the Nationalist Government, supporting the establishment of its army and the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 东北易帜标志着国民政府在形式上完成了中国统一，象征着北伐的结束。
description.en: The Northeast Flag Replacement marked the nominal unification of China by the Nationalist Government, symbolizing the end of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府内部分裂为南京和武汉两个政府，导致北伐一度停顿。
description.en: The split of the Nationalist Government into two rival governments in Nanjing and Wuhan caused the Northern Expedition to halt temporarily.

description.zh-cn: 北伐军在湖南、湖北战场上，通过汀泗桥、贺胜桥等战役，基本消灭了吴佩孚的军事主力。
description.en: On the Hunan and Hubei battlefields, the Northern Expeditionary Army essentially eliminated the main military forces of Wu Peifu through battles like Tingsiqiao and Heshengqiao.

description.zh-cn: 北伐军在江西、福建、浙江、江苏等战场上与孙传芳军队作战，并最终将其击败。
description.en: The Northern Expeditionary Army fought and ultimately defeated Sun Chuanfang's forces on the battlefields of Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, and Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正在上海发动清党，清洗国民党内的共产党员及左派。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek initiated the party purge in Shanghai to eliminate communists and leftists within the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 清党后，蒋中正在南京另立国民政府，与武汉的国民政府对立，形成宁汉分裂局面。
description.en: After the purge, Chiang Kai-shek established a separate Nationalist Government in Nanjing, opposing the government in Wuhan and leading to the Nanjing-Wuhan split.

description.zh-cn: 在宁汉分裂期间，1927年4月17日，武汉国民政府下令开除蒋介石党籍并免去其各项职务，号召将其逮捕惩治。
description.en: During the Nanjing-Wuhan split, on April 17, 1927, the Wuhan Nationalist Government ordered the expulsion of Chiang Kai-shek from the party, dismissed him from all his posts, and called for his arrest and punishment.

description.zh-cn: 日本出兵山东制造济南惨案，对北伐的顺利进行造成了阻碍。
description.en: Japan's dispatch of troops to Shandong, which caused the Jinan Incident, obstructed the smooth progress of the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 日本军队于1928年4月出兵山东，最终在5月3日与北伐军发生冲突，制造了济南惨案。
description.en: Japanese troops were dispatched to Shandong in April 1928, eventually clashing with the Northern Expeditionary Army on May 3, creating the Jinan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在龙潭战斗中，孙传芳的部队被国民革命军决定性地击败，使其丧失了反攻南京的能力。
description.en: In the Battle of Longtan, Sun Chuanfang's forces were decisively defeated by the National Revolutionary Army, eliminating his ability to counter-attack Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 章太炎将北伐视为“叛国行为”。
description.en: Zhang Taiyan regarded the Northern Expedition as an 'act of treason'.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山一贯主张发动北伐战争以统一中国，其思想是北伐战争的理论基础和动员力量。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen consistently advocated for launching a Northern Expedition to unify China; his ideas formed the theoretical basis and mobilizing force for the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来逝世是四五天安门事件的直接导火索，群众自发悼念活动演变为大规模抗议。
事件后，邓小平被错误地认定为幕后总指挥，导致其被撤销党内外一切职务。
事件后，中共中央政治局通过决议，任命华国锋为中共中央第一副主席和国务院总理，巩固了其作为毛泽东接班人的地位。
中共中央政治局将事件定性为“反革命政治事件”，并出动民兵、公安和卫戍部队进行暴力镇压。
四五天安门事件是文化大革命后期社会矛盾激化的产物，群众借悼念周恩来表达对文革和“四人帮”的不满。
1975年11月，毛泽东在听取毛远新汇报与邓小平的矛盾后，因不能容忍邓小平系统地纠正文革错误，决心发动了“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动。
description.en: In November 1975, after hearing Mao Yuanxin's report on the conflict with Deng Xiaoping, and unable to tolerate Deng Xiaoping's systematic correction of the Cultural Revolution's errors, Mao Zedong decided to launch the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' movement.

description.zh-cn: 陈云在中央工作会议上率先提出为天安门事件平反，对最终平反起到了关键的推动作用。
经中共中央政治局常委会批准，北京市委正式宣布为四五天安门事件平反，称其是完全革命的行动。
南京的学生工人在列车上刷写标语，将悼念周恩来、反对“四人帮”的呼声传向全国，是四五运动的前奏。
《文汇报》在转发纪念雷锋的报道时，删去了周恩来的题词，并于3月25日发文影射周恩来，引发了南京事件。
作为毛泽东的联络员，毛远新向毛泽东汇报天安门广场的情况，并传达其指示。
姚文元为《人民日报》撰写了题为《天安门广场的反革命政治事件》的文章，将事件定性为反革命。
吴忠在事件期间担任北京卫戍区司令员。
中国普遍存在的校园欺凌问题是江油事件发生的社会背景，为该具体事件的爆发提供了土壤。
description.en: The widespread problem of school bullying in China served as the social context for the Jiangyou incident, creating fertile ground for this specific event to occur.

description.zh-cn: 于8月4日发布的警情通报因被民众认为对受害者伤情鉴定过轻、对施暴者处罚不足，进一步加剧了民愤，直接推动了事件从事态关注升级为大规模线下抗议。
description.en: The police report issued on August 4 was perceived by the public as downplaying the victim's injuries and insufficiently punishing the perpetrators, which further exacerbated public anger and directly pushed the event from a matter of public concern to a large-scale offline protest.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府在事件发酵后采取了信息封锁措施，包括在江油街头部署信号干扰车以及在社交媒体上进行广泛审查，以阻止相关信息的传播。
description.en: After the incident escalated, the Chinese government implemented information blockade measures, including deploying signal jamming vehicles on the streets of Jiangyou and conducting widespread censorship on social media to prevent the dissemination of related information.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 为响应中国的审查指令，该人工智能模型被设置为不提供有关江油抗议事件的任何信息，从而阻止了用户通过此渠道了解事件真相。
description.en: In response to China's censorship directives, this AI model was configured to not provide any information about the Jiangyou protests, thereby preventing users from learning about the event through this channel.

description.zh-cn: 新修订的法律增加了对校园欺凌的处置措施，并允许对情节严重的14至18岁违法人员执行拘留，旨在更有效地遏制此类行为。
description.en: The newly revised law adds measures for handling school bullying and allows for the detention of offenders aged 14 to 18 in serious cases, aiming to more effectively deter such behavior.

description.zh-cn: 作为江油事件前发生的一起类似的大规模民众抗议事件，蒲城事件为公众在面对官方处理校园相关问题不当时采取集体行动提供了参照，影响了江油事件的抗议模式。
description.en: As a similar large-scale public protest that occurred before the Jiangyou incident, the Pucheng incident provided a reference for collective public action in response to official mishandling of school-related issues, influencing the protest pattern in the Jiangyou event.

description.zh-cn: 网民借用电影《南京照相馆》中揭露暴行和对抗封锁的主题，创造出“江油照相馆”这一代称，用以在网络审查下讨论江油事件并讽刺官方行为，影响了该事件的网络话语体系。
description.en: Netizens borrowed the theme of exposing atrocities and resisting blockades from the film 'Nanjing Photo Studio' to create the code name 'Jiangyou Photo Studio', using it to discuss the Jiangyou incident under internet censorship and satirize official actions, thereby influencing the event's online discourse.

description.zh-cn: 由于江油事件发生在该运动会于邻近的成都开幕前夕，维稳的政治压力极大，这影响并可能加剧了地方政府对示威活动采取迅速而强硬的镇压手段。
description.en: Because the Jiangyou incident occurred just before the opening of the World Games in nearby Chengdu, the political pressure to maintain stability was immense, which influenced and likely intensified the local government's swift and harsh crackdown on the protests.

description.zh-cn: 指控前市长郝龙斌需要为“台智光案”负责，此举引发郝龙斌反击，从而引爆京华城案。
description.en: Accused former mayor Hau Lung-pin of being responsible for the 'Tpe-Gateway case', which provoked Hau to retaliate, thereby igniting the Core Pacific City case.

description.zh-cn: 反击柯文哲对台智光案的指控，直指柯文哲在京华城案中给予不当容积奖励，促使司法机关展开调查。
description.en: Countered Ko Wen-je's accusations regarding the Tpe-Gateway case by pointing out that Ko granted improper floor area ratio bonuses in the Core Pacific City case, prompting judicial investigation.

description.zh-cn: 在京华城案审理过程中，裁定将柯文哲羁押禁见。
description.en: During the trial of the Core Pacific City case, the court ruled to detain Ko Wen-je and prohibit visits and correspondence.

description.zh-cn: 被检方指控为京华城案向台北市议员应晓薇行贿，以换取其向市府官员游说。
description.en: Accused by prosecutors of bribing Taipei City Councilor Ying Hsiao-wei in the Core Pacific City case in exchange for her lobbying of city government officials.

description.zh-cn: 涉嫌收受沈庆京贿赂后，为京华城容积奖励一事多次召开协调会并游说市府官员。
description.en: After allegedly accepting bribes from Shen Ching-ching, she held multiple coordination meetings and lobbied city officials regarding the floor area ratio bonus for Core Pacific City.

description.zh-cn: 在柯文哲因京华城案遭羁押后，多次举办集会活动声援柯文哲，并主张其遭受司法迫害。
description.en: After Ko Wen-je was detained in the Core Pacific City case, the party held multiple rallies to support him, claiming he was a victim of judicial persecution.

description.zh-cn: 就京华城容积率认定争议提出纠正案，促使台北市政府处理此案，并于2018年发函确认容积率为560%，成为后续变更的基础。
description.en: Issued a corrective measure regarding the dispute over Core Pacific City's floor area ratio, prompting the Taipei City Government to address the case, and confirmed the ratio as 560% in a 2018 letter, which became the basis for subsequent changes.

description.zh-cn: 在市议会质询时，质疑柯文哲市府给予京华城不合理的超高容积率。
description.en: During a city council inquiry, she questioned the Ko Wen-je administration for granting an unreasonably high floor area ratio to Core Pacific City.

description.zh-cn: 在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，彭振声担任其副市长。
description.en: Peng Chen-sheng served as Deputy Mayor under Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je.

position.zh-cn: 台北市市长办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Taipei City Mayor's Office

description.zh-cn: 在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，李文宗担任其办公室主任。
description.en: Li Wen-tsung served as the Director of the Mayor's Office under Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je.

description.zh-cn: 杨忠是杨坚的父亲。
description.en: Yang Zhong was Yang Jian's father.

description.zh-cn: 吕苦桃是杨坚的母亲。
description.en: Lü Kutao was Yang Jian's mother.

description.zh-cn: 独孤伽罗是杨坚的妻子和皇后。
description.en: Dugu Qieluo was Yang Jian's wife and empress.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚篡夺北周政权，建立隋朝，改元开皇。
description.en: Yang Jian usurped the Northern Zhou regime, established the Sui dynasty, and changed the era name to Kaihuang.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚逼迫北周静帝禅位，取代北周，并屠杀了北周宇文皇族。
description.en: Yang Jian forced Emperor Jing of Northern Zhou to abdicate, replaced the Northern Zhou, and massacred the Yuwen imperial family of Northern Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚发动隋灭陈之战，攻占建康，俘虏陈后主，灭亡了陈朝。
description.en: Yang Jian launched the Sui campaign against Chen, captured Jiankang, captured Chen Shubao, and destroyed the Chen dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚废黜西梁后主萧琮，吞并了西梁政权。
description.en: Yang Jian deposed the last ruler of Western Liang, Xiao Cong, and annexed the state.

description.zh-cn: 北周宣帝驾崩后，刘昉与郑译等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政，为杨坚夺取政权创造了条件。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Xuan of Northern Zhou, Liu Fang, along with Zheng Yi and others, forged an edict to make Yang Jian regent, creating the conditions for Yang Jian to seize power.

description.zh-cn: 北周宣帝驾崩后，郑译与刘昉等人矫诏拥立杨坚辅政，为杨坚夺取政权创造了条件。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Xuan of Northern Zhou, Zheng Yi, along with Liu Fang and others, forged an edict to make Yang Jian regent, creating the conditions for Yang Jian to seize power.

description.zh-cn: 尉迟迥不满杨坚专政，在相州起兵讨伐杨坚，但最终兵败。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Yang Jian's dictatorship, Yuchi Jiong launched a rebellion against him in Xiangzhou, but was ultimately defeated.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚派兵迅速平定了尉迟迥的叛乱。
description.en: Yang Jian dispatched troops and quickly suppressed Yuchi Jiong's rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 宇文招设下鸿门宴，企图在宴会上刺杀杨坚，但未能成功。
description.en: Yuwen Zhao set up a feast with the intent to assassinate Yang Jian, but the attempt was unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚在得知宇文招的刺杀企图后，诬陷其谋反并将其及诸子诛杀。
description.en: After learning of Yuwen Zhao's assassination attempt, Yang Jian framed him for treason and had him and his sons executed.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚在位期间励精图治，通过一系列有效的政治经济改革措施，开创了政治稳定、经济繁荣的开皇之治盛世局面。
description.en: During his reign, Emperor Wen Yang Jian governed diligently and implemented a series of effective political and economic reforms, initiating the Reign of Kaihuang, a period of political stability and economic prosperity.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚即位后，废除了自魏晋以来施行的九品中正制，以改革官员选拔制度。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Yang Jian abolished the Nine-rank system that had been in place since the Wei and Jin dynasties to reform the official selection system.

description.zh-cn: 杨坚开创了科举制度的先河，规定各州每年向中央选送人才参加考试，合格者录用为官，打破了门阀对官职的垄断。
description.en: Yang Jian pioneered the Imperial Examination system, stipulating that each prefecture should recommend talents to the central government for examinations annually, with successful candidates being appointed as officials, thus breaking the monopoly of aristocratic clans on official positions.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝杨坚在废黜杨勇后，册立善于伪装的次子杨广（即隋炀帝）为太子。
description.en: After deposing Yang Yong, Emperor Wen of Sui installed his second son Yang Guang (later Emperor Yang), who was skilled at dissimulation, as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 有说法称隋文帝杨坚是被其子太子杨广所谋杀。据传，杨广在仁寿宫发动兵变，导致其父突然去世，随后杨广即位。
description.en: It is said that Emperor Wen of Sui was murdered by his son, Crown Prince Yang Guang. Allegedly, Yang Guang launched a coup at Renshou Palace, leading to his father's sudden death, after which Yang Guang ascended the throne.

description.zh-cn: 北周齐王宇文宪曾对北周武帝评价杨坚相貌非常，认为他颇为狡诈，请求尽早除掉他。
description.en: Yuwen Xian, Prince of Qi of Northern Zhou, once commented to Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou that Yang Jian had an extraordinary appearance, considered him quite cunning, and requested his early elimination.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿接替黄克诚担任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Luo Ruiqing succeeded Huang Kecheng as the Chief of the General Staff of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿被免去总参谋长职务后，由杨成武代理。
description.en: After Luo Ruiqing was dismissed from his post as Chief of the General Staff, Yang Chengwu served as the acting chief.

description.zh-cn: 谢富治接替罗瑞卿担任中华人民共和国公安部部长。
description.en: Xie Fuzhi succeeded Luo Ruiqing as the Minister of Public Security of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，因罗瑞卿事件而被批判，后跳楼负重伤，并被撤销全部职务及监护。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, he was criticized due to the Luo Ruiqing Incident, suffered severe injuries from a suicide attempt by jumping from a building, was dismissed from all his posts, and placed under surveillance.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件中，罗瑞卿被指责为“反对突出政治”、“反对林彪”，随后被调离军事工作领导岗位并受到批判。
description.en: In the Luo Ruiqing Incident, Luo was accused of 'opposing the prominence of politics' and 'opposing Lin Biao,' and was subsequently removed from his military leadership position and criticized.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委内部日渐分裂，林彪与罗瑞卿分属不同派别，最终在1965年12月的上海会议上，林彪等人对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: The Central Military Commission gradually split, with Lin Biao and Luo Ruiqing in opposing factions. This culminated in the Shanghai Conference of December 1965, where Lin Biao and others launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，叶群与林彪等人一同对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Ye Qun, along with Lin Biao and others, launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，李作鹏与林彪等人一同对罗瑞卿进行突然袭击，导致罗瑞卿事件。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Li Zuopeng, along with Lin Biao and others, launched a surprise attack on Luo Ruiqing, leading to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，贺龙、罗瑞卿为首的一派与林彪等人对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with one led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing in opposition to Lin Biao and others.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，叶剑英与林彪等人为一派，与贺龙、罗瑞卿一派对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with Ye Jianying, Lin Biao, and others in one faction opposing the faction led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，聂荣臻与林彪等人为一派，与贺龙、罗瑞卿一派对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with Nie Rongzhen, Lin Biao, and others in one faction opposing the faction led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿事件前，中央军委内部分裂为两派，杨成武与林彪等人为一派，与贺龙、罗瑞卿一派对立。
description.en: Before the Luo Ruiqing Incident, the Central Military Commission was split into two factions, with Yang Chengwu, Lin Biao, and others in one faction opposing the faction led by He Long and Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东首肯了林彪等人对罗瑞卿的攻击，导致罗瑞卿事件的发生。
description.en: Mao Zedong approved the attack on Luo Ruiqing by Lin Biao and others, which led to the Luo Ruiqing Incident.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东表示其是“听了林彪一面之辞，错整了罗瑞卿”，为罗瑞卿的平反奠定了基础。
description.en: Mao Zedong stated that he had 'wrongly purged Luo Ruiqing based on Lin Biao's one-sided account,' laying the groundwork for Luo's rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 在京西宾馆会议上，罗瑞卿被挂上“篡军反党”、“反对毛主席”、“反对毛泽东思想”而受到批判。
description.en: At the Jingxi Hotel Conference, Luo Ruiqing was criticized under the labels of 'usurping the army and opposing the Party,' 'opposing Chairman Mao,' and 'opposing Mao Zedong Thought'.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持召开中共中央政治局扩大会议，批判“彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆的‘反党错误’”，并决定停止和撤销罗瑞卿的全部职务。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over an enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, criticizing the 'anti-Party errors' of Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun, and decided to suspend and dismiss Luo Ruiqing from all his posts.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持召开中共中央政治局扩大会议，批判“彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆的‘反党错误’”。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over an enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, criticizing the 'anti-Party errors' of Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持召开中共中央政治局扩大会议，批判“彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆的‘反党错误’”。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over an enlarged meeting of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, criticizing the 'anti-Party errors' of Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun.

description.zh-cn: “文化大革命”结束后，罗瑞卿在政治上得到平反。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution ended, Luo Ruiqing was politically rehabilitated.

description.zh-cn: 《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》一文的公开发表引发了真理标准大讨论。
description.en: The public release of the article "Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth" triggered the Truth Criterion Discussion.

description.zh-cn: 促成《马克思主义的一个最基本的原则》在《解放军报》上发表，推动了“真理标准大讨论”的开展。
description.en: He facilitated the publication of 'A Most Fundamental Principle of Marxism' in the 'Liberation Army Daily', promoting the 'great discussion on the criterion of truth'.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿逝世后，邓小平前往机场迎灵，并于8月12日的追悼会上致悼词。
description.en: After Luo Ruiqing's death, Deng Xiaoping went to the airport to receive his remains and delivered the eulogy at the memorial service on August 12.

description.zh-cn: 因叶剑英就罗瑞卿跳楼一事作诗表达同情，周恩来严厉批判其“完全站到罗瑞卿一边”。
description.en: Because Ye Jianying wrote a poem expressing sympathy for Luo Ruiqing's suicide attempt, Zhou Enlai severely criticized him for 'completely siding with Luo Ruiqing'.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞是洋务派后期的主要代表人物。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong was a major representative figure of the Westernization Movement in its later stages.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞早年是清流派的健将。
description.en: In his early years, Zhang Zhidong was a stalwart of the Qingliu school.

description.zh-cn: 据说因为慈禧太后喜欢张之洞的文章，在其考中进士后破例提拔。后来又扶植他以抗衡湘军和淮军势力。
description.en: It is said that Empress Dowager Cixi appreciated Zhang Zhidong's writings and promoted him exceptionally after he passed the imperial examination. She later supported him to counterbalance the power of the Xiang and Huai armies.

description.zh-cn: 在担任湖广总督期间，张之洞创办了汉阳铁厂。
description.en: During his tenure as Viceroy of Huguang, Zhang Zhidong founded the Hanyang Ironworks.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞在武昌镇压并破获自立军起义，下令于紫阳湖畔将领导者唐才常等人斩首处决。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong suppressed and uncovered the Self-Supporting Army Uprising in Wuchang, ordering the decapitation and execution of its leader Tang Caichang and others at Ziyang Lake.

description.zh-cn: 在义和团运动期间，张之洞会同两江总督刘坤一与各国领事议订“东南互保”。两人后又于1901年联衔上奏推行新政。
description.en: During the Boxer Rebellion, Zhang Zhidong, together with Viceroy of Liangjiang Liu Kunyi, negotiated the 'Mutual Protection of Southeast China' with foreign consuls. They later jointly submitted a memorial in 1901 to implement new policies.

description.zh-cn: 文本记载张之洞对李鸿章似有成见，尤其不满其身后谥为文忠。
description.en: The text states that Zhang Zhidong seemed to hold a prejudice against Li Hongzhang, particularly being dissatisfied with Li's posthumous title 'Wenzhong'.

description.zh-cn: 1884年中法战争时，张之洞由山西巡抚升任两广总督。
description.en: During the Sino-French War in 1884, Zhang Zhidong was promoted from Governor of Shanxi to Viceroy of Liangguang.

description.zh-cn: 升任两广总督后，张之洞起用了退休老将冯子材以抵抗法军。
description.en: After being promoted to Viceroy of Liangguang, Zhang Zhidong re-employed the retired general Feng Zicai to resist the French forces.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞作为两广总督，支持并指挥了包括镇南关之役在内的对法军事行动。
description.en: As Viceroy of Liangguang, Zhang Zhidong supported and commanded military operations against the French, including the Battle of Zhennan Pass.

description.zh-cn: 1893年，时任湖广总督的张之洞奏请光绪帝创办自强学堂。
description.en: In 1893, Zhang Zhidong, then Viceroy of Huguang, petitioned the Guangxu Emperor to establish the Ziqiang Institute.

description.zh-cn: 在张之洞的奏请下，光绪帝批准创办了自强学堂。
description.en: At the request of Zhang Zhidong, the Guangxu Emperor approved the establishment of the Ziqiang Institute.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞与袁世凯、徐世昌等人都列名参加了强学会。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong, along with Yuan Shikai and Xu Shichang, was listed as a member of the Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞曾出资赞助强学会。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong provided financial sponsorship to the Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯与张之洞、徐世昌等人都列名参加了强学会。
description.en: Yuan Shikai, along with Zhang Zhidong and Xu Shichang, was listed as a member of the Society for the Study of Self-Strengthening.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞力主镇压义和团运动，并联合东南督抚实行东南自保。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong strongly advocated for the suppression of the Boxer Rebellion and joined with southeastern governors to implement the Mutual Protection of Southeast China.

description.zh-cn: 1906年12月，湖广总督张之洞派新军会剿萍浏醴起义军。
description.en: In December 1906, Viceroy of Huguang Zhang Zhidong dispatched the New Army to help suppress the Ping-Liu-Li Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后去世后，张之洞作为顾命大臣，力劝摄政王载沣不要杀袁世凯。
description.en: After the death of Empress Dowager Cixi, Zhang Zhidong, as a regent minister, strongly persuaded Prince Regent Zaifeng not to execute Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞与以康有为、梁启超为代表的激进改良派持有不同的政治主张。梁启超曾撰文批评张之洞“爱名爱身甚于爱国”。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong held different political views from the radical reformists represented by Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao. Liang Qichao once wrote an article criticizing Zhang for 'loving his reputation and himself more than his country'.

description.zh-cn: 1905年，张之洞认为留日学生风潮为革命党孙文煽动，电请各省督抚设法开导解散，以消除革命隐患。
description.en: In 1905, Zhang Zhidong believed that the student unrest among those studying in Japan was instigated by the revolutionary Sun Yat-sen, and he telegraphed provincial governors to find ways to persuade and disperse them to eliminate the threat of revolution.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞位于南皮县的原墓在文化大革命期间被毁。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong's original tomb in Nanpi County was destroyed during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 张之万是张之洞的从兄（堂兄）。
description.en: Zhang Zhiwan was Zhang Zhidong's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 张仁蠡是张之洞的幼子。
description.en: Zhang Renli was Zhang Zhidong's youngest son.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌六君子之一的杨锐是张之洞的得意弟子。
description.en: Yang Rui, one of the Six Gentlemen of the Hundred Days' Reform, was a favorite disciple of Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 辜鸿铭曾担任张之洞的幕僚。
description.en: Gu Hongming once served as an aide to Zhang Zhidong.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞曾师从古琴家黄勉之学习古琴。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong studied the guqin under the tutelage of master Huang Mianzhi.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞在光绪十五年至光绪三十三年间，曾四度出任湖广总督。
description.en: Between 1889 and 1907, Zhang Zhidong served as the Viceroy of Huguang on four separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞于光绪十年至十五年间担任两广总督。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong served as the Viceroy of Liangguang from 1884 to 1889.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞于光绪三十三年被任命为军机大臣，直至去世。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong was appointed as a Grand Councilor in 1907 and held the position until his death.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什是第41任美国总统乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什的儿子，他们是美国历史上第二对父子总统。
description.en: George W. Bush is the son of the 41st U.S. President, George H. W. Bush, making them the second father-son pair of presidents in U.S. history.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什是芭芭拉·布什的儿子。
description.en: George W. Bush is the son of Barbara Bush.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1977年11月5日与劳拉·威尔士结婚。
description.en: George W. Bush married Laura Welch on November 5, 1977.

description.zh-cn: 杰布·布什是乔治·沃克·布什的弟弟。
description.en: Jeb Bush is the younger brother of George W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1968年在耶鲁大学取得历史学学士学位。
description.en: George W. Bush received a Bachelor of Arts degree in history from Yale University in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1975年获得哈佛大学工商管理硕士学位。
description.en: George W. Bush earned a Master of Business Administration degree from Harvard University in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什是美国共和党成员，并代表该党当选州长和总统。
description.en: George W. Bush is a member of the Republican Party and was elected Governor and President as its nominee.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于1995年至2000年间担任第46任德克萨斯州州长。
description.en: George W. Bush served as the 46th Governor of Texas from 1995 to 2000.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于2001年至2009年间担任第43任美国总统。
description.en: George W. Bush served as the 43rd President of the United States from 2001 to 2009.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什接替比尔·克林顿成为美国总统。
description.en: George W. Bush succeeded Bill Clinton as President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 巴拉克·奥巴马接替乔治·沃克·布什成为美国总统。
description.en: Barack Obama succeeded George W. Bush as President of the United States.

position.en: Vice President of the United States

description.zh-cn: 迪克·切尼在乔治·沃克·布什的总统任期内担任副总统。
description.en: Dick Cheney served as Vice President during George W. Bush's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在九一一袭击事件后，乔治·沃克·布什发动了一连串反恐战争。
description.en: Following the September 11 attacks, George W. Bush launched a series of campaigns in the War on Terror.

description.zh-cn: 作为反恐战争的一部分，乔治·沃克·布什于2001年10月发动了阿富汗战争。
description.en: As part of the War on Terror, George W. Bush launched the War in Afghanistan in October 2001.

description.zh-cn: 阿富汗战争旨在推翻塔利班政权。
description.en: The War in Afghanistan was intended to overthrow the Taliban regime.

description.zh-cn: 阿富汗战争旨在铲除基地组织势力。
description.en: The War in Afghanistan was intended to eliminate the presence of al-Qaeda.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·沃克·布什于2003年3月发动了伊拉克战争。
description.en: George W. Bush launched the Iraq War in March 2003.

description.zh-cn: 伊拉克战争推翻了萨达姆·侯赛因的政权。
description.en: The Iraq War overthrew the regime of Saddam Hussein.

description.zh-cn: 2001年，乔治·沃克·布什主导帮助中国大陆进入世界贸易组织。
description.en: In 2001, George W. Bush led efforts to facilitate Mainland China's entry into the World Trade Organization.

description.zh-cn: 唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德在布什总统任内担任国防部长。
description.en: Donald Rumsfeld served as Secretary of Defense under President Bush.

description.zh-cn: 克林·鲍威尔在布什总统任内担任国务卿。
description.en: Colin Powell served as Secretary of State under President Bush.

description.zh-cn: 康多莉扎·赖斯在布什总统的第二任期内担任国务卿。
description.en: Condoleezza Rice served as Secretary of State during President Bush's second term.

description.zh-cn: 罗伯特·盖茨在布什总统任内接替拉姆斯菲尔德担任国防部长。
description.en: Robert Gates succeeded Donald Rumsfeld as Secretary of Defense under President Bush.

description.zh-cn: 2006年4月20日，布什总统与时任中国国家主席胡锦涛在白宫会面。
description.en: On April 20, 2006, President Bush met with then-Chinese President Hu Jintao at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 布什与时任英国首相托尼·布莱尔保持亲密的合作关系和感情。
description.en: Bush maintained a close cooperative and personal relationship with then-British Prime Minister Tony Blair.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫在第六届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上当选为中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Ulanhu was elected Vice President of the People's Republic of China at the First Session of the Sixth National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 王震接替乌兰夫出任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Wang Zhen succeeded Ulanhu as the Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 布赫是乌兰夫的长子。
description.en: Buhe is the eldest son of Ulanhu.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，乌兰夫进入北平蒙藏学校学习。
description.en: In 1923, Ulanhu entered the Mongolian and Tibetan School in Beiping to study.

description.zh-cn: 1925年9月，被派赴莫斯科中山大学学习。
description.en: In September 1925, he was sent to study at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University.

description.zh-cn: 在北京蒙藏学校学习期间，在李大钊、赵世炎、邓中夏等共产党人的帮助下，乌兰夫参加了马克思主义研究小组，后加入革命组织。
description.en: During his studies at the Beijing Mongolian and Tibetan School, with the help of communists like Li Dazhao, Zhao Shiyan, and Deng Zhongxia, Ulanhu joined a Marxism study group and later revolutionary organizations.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫领导组建内蒙古自治政府，并被选为主席。
description.en: Ulanhu led the formation of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Government and was elected its chairman.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫组织成立了内蒙古自治运动联合会，并出任主席。
description.en: Ulanhu organized the establishment of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Movement Federation and served as its chairman.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫成功解散了以补英达赖为首的内蒙古人民共和国临时政府。
description.en: Ulanhu successfully dissolved the Provisional Government of the Inner Mongolian People's Republic led by Buyandalai.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫成功解散了以补英达赖为首的内蒙古人民共和国临时政府。
description.en: Ulanhu successfully dissolved the Provisional Government of the Inner Mongolian People's Republic led by Buyandalai.

description.zh-cn: “文化大革命”开始后，乌兰夫因“内人党”问题被批斗，并于1966年8月被撤销党政军领导职务，软禁于北京。
description.en: After the 'Cultural Revolution' began, Ulanhu was criticized over the 'Inner Mongolian People's Party' issue. In August 1966, he was removed from his party, government, and military leadership positions and placed under house arrest in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫在文革中因“内人党”问题被批斗和撤职。
description.en: Ulanhu was persecuted and removed from office during the Cultural Revolution due to the 'Inner Mongolian People's Party' incident.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中，乌兰夫受到国务院总理周恩来的保护。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ulanhu was protected by Premier Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 根据中共中央主席毛泽东的意见，乌兰夫等13位老干部被宣布解放。
description.en: According to the opinion of CPC Chairman Mao Zedong, Ulanhu and 12 other veteran cadres were declared liberated.

description.zh-cn: 在廖承志逝世后，中共中央政治局召开扩大会议，决定由乌兰夫替补为国家副主席候选人。
description.en: After the death of Liao Chengzhi, the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee held an enlarged meeting and decided that Ulanhu would be the replacement candidate for Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆的女儿是朱济熿的正妃，因此朱济熿是李景隆的女婿。
description.en: Li Jinglong's daughter was the primary consort of Zhu Jihuang, making Zhu Jihuang his son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 李景隆奉诏担任《明太祖实录》的监修官。
description.en: Li Jinglong was ordered to serve as the supervising editor for the 'Veritable Records of Emperor Taizu of Ming'.

description.zh-cn: 担任《明太祖实录》的副监修。
担任《明太祖实录》的总裁。
因李景隆举止雍容华贵而多次瞩目于他。
信任李景隆，在耿炳文战败后任命其为大将军，北伐燕王。
在靖难之役中，作为建文帝的大将军，与燕王朱棣为敌对关系，并屡次败于朱棣。
与谷王朱橞开金川门投降，归顺燕王朱棣。
永乐二年（1404年），在周王朱橚及群臣的弹劾下，朱棣下令削去李景隆的爵位，将其全家软禁。
description.en: In 1404, following accusations by Prince of Zhou Zhu Su and other officials, Zhu Di ordered that Li Jinglong be stripped of his title and his entire family placed under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 洪武二十年随军参加进攻纳哈出的战役。
洪武三十一年（1398年）七月，李景隆奉命前往开封，将周王朱橚全家押回南京。
description.en: In July 1398, Li Jinglong was ordered to Kaifeng to arrest the Prince of Zhou, Zhu Su, and his entire family and escort them back to Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 在耿炳文战败后，黄子澄向建文帝举荐李景隆接任大将军。
description.en: After Geng Bingwen's defeat, Huang Zicheng recommended Li Jinglong to the Jianwen Emperor to take over as Grand General.

description.zh-cn: 在李景隆兵败还京后，愤怒地在朝廷上抓住李景隆，请求将他处死。
齐泰极力反对黄子澄的提议，认为李景隆不能胜任大将军一职。
description.en: Qi Tai strongly opposed Huang Zicheng's proposal, believing that Li Jinglong was not competent for the position of Grand General.

description.zh-cn: 在围攻北平时，都督瞿能几乎攻破张掖门，但李景隆因妒忌其功，命令他停止进攻，导致功败垂成。
description.en: During the siege of Beiping, Commander Qu Neng nearly breached the Zhangye Gate, but Li Jinglong, jealous of his potential success, ordered him to halt the attack, thwarting the effort.

description.zh-cn: 在燕军渡江后，请求建文帝诛杀李景隆。
1402年燕军兵临南京城下，金川门守将李景隆与谷王朱橞一同打开城门投降，迎接燕军入城。此举直接导致了建文帝政权的覆灭，李景隆是此次关键事件的核心人物。
description.en: When the Yan army reached the walls of Nanjing in 1402, Li Jinglong, the defender of Jinchuan Gate, along with Prince Gu Zhu Hui, opened the city gates and surrendered, welcoming the Yan army. This act directly led to the collapse of the Jianwen Emperor's regime, with Li Jinglong being a central figure in this pivotal event.

description.zh-cn: 燕军兵临南京城下时，谷王朱橞与李景隆一同打开金川门，迎接燕军入城。
description.en: When the Yan army reached the walls of Nanjing, Prince Gu Zhu Hui and Li Jinglong opened the Jinchuan Gate to welcome them into the city.

description.zh-cn: 永乐二年（1404年），周王朱橚揭发李景隆在建文年间收受贿赂之事，成为导致李景隆倒台的原因之一。
description.en: In 1404, the Prince of Zhou, Zhu Su, accused Li Jinglong of accepting bribes during the Jianwen era, which was one of the reasons for Li Jinglong's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 与群臣一同当廷弹劾李景隆及其弟李增枝谋逆。
与群臣一同当廷弹劾李景隆及其弟李增枝谋逆。
弹劾李景隆在家中接受守门人跪拜，行君臣之礼，大逆不道。
洪武十九年（1386年），李景隆继承其父李文忠的曹国公爵位。
