description.zh-cn: 魏国是在韩、赵、魏三家分晋的事件后建立的诸侯国之一。
description.en: The state of Wei was one of the three states established after the event of the Partition of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 魏文侯魏斯是魏国的第一代君主，被周威烈王册封为诸侯。
description.en: Wei Si, Marquess Wen of Wei, was the first monarch of the state of Wei, having been enfeoffed by King Weilie of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 魏国长期受到秦国的侵略，最终于公元前225年为秦国所灭。
description.en: The state of Wei faced prolonged aggression from the state of Qin and was ultimately conquered by Qin in 225 BC.

description.zh-cn: 秦国将军王贲于公元前225年用水计攻破魏国都城大梁，导致魏国灭亡。
description.en: In 225 BC, the Qin general Wang Ben used a water diversion tactic to capture Daliang, the capital of Wei, leading to the state's demise.

description.zh-cn: 王贲是秦国将领。
description.en: Wang Ben was a general of the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 魏惠王为躲避秦国威胁，将国都从安邑迁至大梁，此后魏国也称为梁国。
description.en: To evade the threat from the state of Qin, King Hui of Wei moved the capital from Anyi to Daliang, after which the state of Wei was also known as Liang.

description.zh-cn: 魏惠王时期，因安邑靠近秦国，魏国放弃安邑作为都城。
description.en: During the reign of King Hui of Wei, the state abandoned Anyi as its capital because of its proximity to the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 公元前353年，魏国在桂陵之战中败于齐国。
description.en: In 353 BC, the state of Wei was defeated by the state of Qi in the Battle of Guiling.

description.zh-cn: 公元前341年，魏国在马陵之战中再次败于齐国，国力受到重创。
description.en: In 341 BC, the state of Wei was again defeated by the state of Qi in the Battle of Maling, which severely damaged its national strength.

description.zh-cn: 齐国与魏国在战国中期为争夺霸权多次交战，包括桂陵之战和马陵之战。
description.en: The states of Qi and Wei fought several major battles for supremacy during the mid-Warring States period, including the Battle of Guiling and the Battle of Maling.

description.zh-cn: 信陵君魏无忌是魏安禧王的弟弟。
description.en: Lord Xinling (Wei Wuji) was the younger brother of King Anxi of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 公元前257年，信陵君施计夺取魏国兵权，解救了被秦军围困的赵国国都邯郸。
description.en: In 257 BC, Lord Xinling engineered a plan to take command of the Wei army and rescued Handan, the capital of Zhao, which was under siege by Qin forces.

description.zh-cn: 公元前247年，信陵君作为上将军，率领五国联军大败秦将蒙骜。
description.en: In 247 BC, acting as commander-in-chief, Lord Xinling led a five-state coalition army to a major victory over the Qin general Meng Ao.

description.zh-cn: 在击败秦军后，魏安禧王开始猜忌信陵君，并因秦国反间计与其失和，最终导致信陵君郁郁而终。
description.en: After the victory against Qin, King Anxi of Wei grew suspicious of Lord Xinling and, influenced by a Qin plot, fell out with him, ultimately leading to Lord Xinling's death in frustration.

description.zh-cn: 李悝受魏文侯任用进行变法，推行“尽地力之教”，巩固了魏国的经济，增强了国力。
description.en: Appointed by Marquess Wen of Wei, Li Kui carried out reforms, implementing policies to maximize agricultural productivity, which consolidated Wei's economy and strengthened its national power.

description.zh-cn: 李悝是魏文侯任命的相国，负责推行变法。
description.en: Li Kui was the chancellor appointed by Marquess Wen of Wei, responsible for implementing the reforms.

description.zh-cn: 吴起曾任魏国西河郡守，为魏国夺取并成功防卫了河西之地，抵御了秦国的进攻。
description.en: Wu Qi served as the governor of Wei's Xihe Commandery, where he captured and successfully defended the Hexi region against attacks from the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 魏国于公元前408年开始攻打中山国，并于前406年将其消灭。
description.en: The state of Wei began its campaign against the state of Zhongshan in 408 BC and conquered it in 406 BC.

description.zh-cn: 魏国将领乐羊受魏文侯之命，率军攻灭中山国。
description.en: The Wei general Yue Yang, under the command of Marquess Wen of Wei, led the army that conquered the state of Zhongshan.

description.zh-cn: 乐羊是魏文侯时期的将领。
description.en: Yue Yang was a general during the time of Marquess Wen of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 毕万被晋献公封于魏地，立为“魏氏”，是魏国的始祖。
description.en: Bi Wan was enfeoffed in the land of Wei by Duke Xian of Jin, establishing the 'Wei clan' and becoming the progenitor of the future state of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 毕万是晋献公的大夫。
description.en: Bi Wan was a grand master serving Duke Xian of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 魏武侯是魏文侯的儿子。
description.en: Marquess Wu of Wei was the son of Marquess Wen of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 魏惠王是魏武侯的儿子。
description.en: King Hui of Wei was the son of Marquess Wu of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 魏襄王是魏惠王的儿子。
description.en: King Xiang of Wei was the son of King Hui of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 魏王假是魏景湣王的儿子。
description.en: King Jia of Wei was the son of King Jingmin of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂曾受业于吴莱。
description.en: Song Lian once studied under Wu Lai.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂曾游学于柳贯门下。
description.en: Song Lian once studied under Liu Guan.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂曾游学于黄溍门下。
description.en: Song Lian once studied under Huang Jin.

description.zh-cn: 方孝孺是宋濂的学生。
description.en: Fang Xiaoru was a student of Song Lian.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂在明朝担任官职，累官至翰林学士承旨、知制诰，后于1377年以年老辞官还乡。
description.en: Song Lian held official posts in the Ming Dynasty, eventually rising to Hanlin Academy Scholar-Recitor and Drafter, before retiring in 1377 due to old age.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂奉朱元璋之命，担任《元史》的主修官。
description.en: Under the order of Zhu Yuanzhang, Song Lian served as the chief editor of the 'History of Yuan'.

description.zh-cn: 在胡惟庸案中，朱元璋本欲处死宋濂，后经皇后、太子求情，改判全家流放茂州。
description.en: In the Hu Weiyong case, Zhu Yuanzhang initially intended to execute Song Lian, but after pleas from the Empress and Crown Prince, the sentence was commuted to the exile of his entire family to Maozhou.

description.zh-cn: 宋慎是宋濂的长孙。
description.en: Song Shen was Song Lian's eldest grandson.

description.zh-cn: 宋濂出生于浙江浦江县。
description.en: Song Lian was born in Pujiang County, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 刘基称赞宋濂为“当今文章第一”。
description.en: Liu Ji praised Song Lian as 'the foremost in literature of our time'.

description.zh-cn: 蜀王朱椿因仰慕宋濂，在其死后将其转葬至华阳城东。
description.en: Out of admiration for Song Lian, Prince Zhu Chun of Shu had his tomb relocated to the east of Huayang city after his death.

description.zh-cn: 明孝宗下令为宋濂平反，追复其官职。
description.en: The Hongzhi Emperor ordered the posthumous rehabilitation of Song Lian, restoring his official titles.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗在正德年间为宋濂追谥“文宪”。
description.en: The Zhengde Emperor granted Song Lian the posthumous title 'Wenxian' during the Zhengde era.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦与邓小平共同主持了《决议》的起草工作。
description.en: Hu Yaobang, along with Deng Xiaoping, co-presided over the drafting of the 'Resolution'.

description.zh-cn: 胡乔木负责《决议》的起草小组。
description.en: Hu Qiaomu was in charge of the drafting group for the 'Resolution'.

description.zh-cn: 胡乔木负责的《决议》起草小组是在邓小平、胡耀邦的主持下进行工作的。
description.en: The drafting group for the 'Resolution', led by Hu Qiaomu, worked under the auspices of Deng Xiaoping and Hu Yaobang.

description.zh-cn: 《决议》是“拨乱反正”运动的一部分，它的诞生是为了总结历史、统一认识，以明确中国未来的发展方向。
description.en: The 'Resolution' was part of the 'Boluan Fanzheng' movement, created to summarize history, unify understanding, and clarify China's future direction of development.

description.zh-cn: 《决议》的正式通过，标志着中国共产党胜利地完成了指导思想上的“拨乱反正”。
description.en: The official adoption of the 'Resolution' marked the successful completion of the 'Boluan Fanzheng' in terms of the Communist Party of China's guiding ideology.

description.zh-cn: 《决议》对毛泽东的功过得失作出了官方评价，认为其功绩是第一位的，错误是第二位的，并指出他应为“文化大革命”负主要责任，这影响了对他的官方历史定位。
description.en: The 'Resolution' made an official evaluation of Mao Zedong's merits and demerits, concluding his merits were primary and his mistakes secondary, and pointed out his primary responsibility for the 'Cultural Revolution,' which influenced his official historical positioning.

description.zh-cn: 《决议》指出，“文化大革命”被林彪集团等反革命集团所利用。
description.en: The 'Resolution' points out that the 'Cultural Revolution' was exploited by counter-revolutionary cliques such as the Lin Biao Clique.

description.zh-cn: 《决议》指出，“文化大革命”期间，党、国家和人民遭到建国以来最严重的挫折和损失。
description.en: The 'Resolution' states that during the 'Cultural Revolution,' the Party, the state, and the people suffered the most severe setbacks and losses since the founding of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 《决议》提出并强调了“四项基本原则”，并将其定义为全党和全国人民团结的共同政治基础。
description.en: The 'Resolution' proposed and emphasized the 'Four Cardinal Principles,' defining them as the common political foundation for the unity of the entire Party and the people of the nation.

description.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会办公厅联络局是全国人民代表大会常务委员会办公厅的内设机构。
description.en: The Liaison Bureau is an internal department of the General Office of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第六届全国人民代表大会第一次会议后，全国人大常委会办公厅下设的室改名为局，政法室更名为联络局。
description.en: After the first session of the 6th National People's Congress, the offices under the General Office of the NPC Standing Committee were renamed bureaus, and the Political and Legal Office was renamed the Liaison Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 因政法室的工作由全国人大常委会法制工作委员会接手，政法室改组为联络局。
description.en: Because the work of the Political and Legal Office was taken over by the Legislative Affairs Commission of the NPC Standing Committee, the office was reorganized into the Liaison Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特与时为法国王太子的路易-奥古斯特结婚，成为法国王太子妃，后成为王后。
description.en: Marie Antoinette married Louis-Auguste, then the Dauphin of France, becoming the Dauphine and later the Queen.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特是奥地利女皇玛丽亚·特蕾莎最小的女儿。
description.en: Marie Antoinette was the youngest daughter of Empress Maria Theresa of Austria.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特是神圣罗马帝国皇帝法兰兹一世的女儿。
description.en: Marie Antoinette was the daughter of Holy Roman Emperor Francis I.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命推翻了君主制，导致玛丽·安托瓦内特被囚禁、审判并最终处决。
description.en: The French Revolution overthrew the monarchy, leading to Marie Antoinette's imprisonment, trial, and eventual execution.

description.zh-cn: 作为王太子妃，玛丽·安托瓦内特最初拒绝与国王路易十五的情妇杜巴利伯爵夫人交往，此举被视为政治失策。
description.en: As Dauphine, Marie Antoinette initially refused to acknowledge Madame du Barry, the mistress of King Louis XV, which was considered a political misstep.

description.zh-cn: 尽管玛丽·安托瓦内特并未实际参与钻石项链诈骗案，但这起丑闻严重损害了她的公众形象和声誉。
description.en: Although Marie Antoinette was not actually involved in the diamond necklace fraud, the scandal severely damaged her public image and reputation.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特被断头台处决。
description.en: Marie Antoinette was executed by the guillotine.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特与瑞典外交官汉斯·阿克塞尔·冯·费尔森伯爵之间存在极为深厚的情感联系，外界普遍认为他们是情人关系。费尔森策划了王室的瓦雷讷逃亡事件。
description.en: Marie Antoinette had a very deep emotional connection with the Swedish diplomat Count Hans Axel von Fersen, and they were widely believed to be lovers. Fersen organized the royal family's flight to Varennes.

description.zh-cn: 费尔森伯爵是策划和组织王室成员试图逃离巴黎的“瓦雷讷逃亡事件”的关键人物。
description.en: Count Fersen was the key figure in planning and organizing the royal family's attempt to escape Paris, known as the Flight to Varennes.

description.zh-cn: 失败的逃亡事件几乎摧毁了国王在人民中仅存的支持，严重损害了君主制的信誉。
description.en: The failed escape attempt nearly destroyed what little support the king still had among the people and severely damaged the credibility of the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特与米拉波伯爵秘密会面并达成协议，后者成为王室的秘密政治盟友，试图调和君主制与革命。
description.en: Marie Antoinette secretly met with the Comte de Mirabeau and reached an agreement, making him a secret political ally of the crown in an attempt to reconcile the monarchy with the revolution.

description.zh-cn: 布伦瑞克宣言威胁要摧毁巴黎，激化了巴黎民众的情绪，直接引发了导致君主制被推翻的八月十日事件。
description.en: The Brunswick Manifesto's threat to destroy Paris radicalized the Parisian populace, directly triggering the Insurrection of 10 August 1792 which led to the overthrow of the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 武装暴民攻入杜乐丽宫，迫使王室寻求立法议会庇护，此事标志着法国君主制的实际终结。
description.en: Armed mobs stormed the Tuileries Palace, forcing the royal family to seek refuge with the Legislative Assembly, an event that marked the effective end of the French monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 约瑟夫二世是玛丽·安托瓦内特的兄长。
description.en: Joseph II was the elder brother of Marie Antoinette.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽·安托瓦内特厌恶担任王室监管人的拉法叶侯爵，并于1791年11月成功阻止他当选巴黎市长。
description.en: Marie Antoinette detested the Marquis de Lafayette, who served as her custodian, and successfully blocked his election as mayor of Paris in November 1791.

description.zh-cn: 由罗伯斯比尔主导的救国委员会推动了对玛丽·安托瓦内特的审判，并预先决定了其死刑判决。
description.en: The Committee of Public Safety, led by Robespierre, pushed for the trial of Marie Antoinette and predetermined her death sentence.

description.zh-cn: 长女
description.en: Eldest daughter

description.zh-cn: 次子
description.en: Second son

description.zh-cn: 次子
description.en: Second son

description.zh-cn: 次女
description.en: Second daughter

description.zh-cn: 次女
description.en: Second daughter

description.zh-cn: 张宏是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhang Hong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张宏是中国人民解放军的军官。
description.en: Zhang Hong is an officer in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 于2017年升任少将。
description.en: Promoted to the rank of Major General in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 高桥和利是山中伸弥在奈良先端科学技术大学院大学的博士生，两人共同开始了诱导性多功能干细胞（iPS细胞）的研究。
description.en: Kazutoshi Takahashi was a doctoral student under Shinya Yamanaka at the Nara Institute of Science and Technology, where they began research on induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells) together.

description.zh-cn: 1999年至2003年在此担任副教授，后被授予荣誉教授职位。
description.en: Served as an Associate Professor from 1999 to 2003 and was later awarded the title of Honorary Professor.

description.zh-cn: 山中伸弥及其团队于2006年首次从成年小鼠的成纤维细胞中产生诱导多能干细胞(iPS细胞)，开创了这一全新的研究领域。
description.en: In 2006, Shinya Yamanaka and his team were the first to generate induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells) from adult mouse fibroblasts, pioneering this entirely new field of research.

description.zh-cn: 在岸本忠三的支持下，山中伸弥于2003年获得了政府经费，这笔资金对于他完成iPS细胞的奠基性研究至关重要。
description.en: With the support of Tadamitsu Kishimoto, Shinya Yamanaka received government funding in 2003, which was crucial for him to complete the foundational research on iPS cells.

description.zh-cn: 为推动iPS细胞研究的实用化，日本政府于2007年决定在5年内投入70亿日圆进行支持。
description.en: To promote the practical application of iPS cell research, the Japanese government decided in 2007 to provide 7 billion yen in support over five years.

description.zh-cn: 因“发现成熟细胞可被重写成多功能细胞”而授予山中伸弥2012年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: Awarded the 2012 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine to Shinya Yamanaka for the discovery that mature cells can be reprogrammed to become pluripotent.

description.zh-cn: 因“发现成熟细胞可被重写成多功能细胞”而授予约翰·格登2012年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: Awarded the 2012 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine to Sir John Gurdon for the discovery that mature cells can be reprogrammed to become pluripotent.

description.zh-cn: 因在细胞重编程领域的贡献，两人共同获得了2012年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: They were jointly awarded the 2012 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for their contributions to the field of cell reprogramming.

description.zh-cn: 刘国语是河南商水人。
description.en: Liu Guoyu is a native of Shangshui, Henan.

position.en: Researcher of the Military History Department

description.zh-cn: 刘国语担任中国人民解放军军事科学院军事历史部研究员。
description.en: Liu Guoyu served as a researcher in the Military History Department of the PLA Academy of Military Science.

description.zh-cn: 刘国语被授予少将军衔。
description.en: Liu Guoyu was awarded the rank of major general.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于2017年5月14日首次就任法国总统，并于2022年成功连任。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron first took office as President of France on May 14, 2017, and was successfully re-elected in 2022.

position.zh-cn: 经济、产业更新和信息技术部长
position.en: Minister of the Economy, Industry and Digital Affairs

description.zh-cn: 在第二瓦尔斯内阁中，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙被任命为经济、产业更新和信息技术部长。
description.en: In the Second Valls government, Emmanuel Macron was appointed Minister of the Economy, Industry and Digital Affairs.

position.zh-cn: 总统府副秘书长、经济部长
position.en: Deputy Secretary-General of the Presidency, Minister of Economy

description.zh-cn: 在弗朗索瓦·奥朗德担任总统期间，马克龙曾担任总统府副秘书长（2012-2014）和经济部长（2014-2016）。
description.en: During François Hollande's presidency, Macron served as Deputy Secretary-General of the Presidency (2012-2014) and Minister of Economy (2014-2016).

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在总理曼努埃尔·瓦尔斯领导的政府中担任经济部长。
description.en: Macron served as Minister of Economy in the government led by Prime Minister Manuel Valls.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于2016年4月6日创立了名为“共和国前进！”的政治运动，该运动后来成为复兴党。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron founded the political movement 'En Marche!' on April 6, 2016, which later became the Renaissance party.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙曾于2006年至2009年为法国社会党成员。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron was a member of the French Socialist Party from 2006 to 2009.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在2017年法国总统选举中获胜，首次当选法国总统。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron won the 2017 French presidential election, becoming the President of France for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在2022年法国总统选举中再次获胜，成功连任。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron won re-election in the 2022 French presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于2007年与比他年长24岁的前高中老师碧姬·托涅结婚。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron married Brigitte Trogneux, his former high school teacher who is 24 years his senior, in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于1977年12月21日出生于法国亚眠。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron was born in Amiens, France, on December 21, 1977.

degree.zh-cn: 高等深入研究文凭 (哲学)

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在巴黎第十大学学习哲学，并获得了高等深入研究文凭（DEA）学位。
description.en: Macron studied philosophy at Paris Nanterre University and obtained a DEA degree.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在巴黎政治学院获得了公共行政硕士学位。
description.en: Macron obtained a Master's degree in Public Administration from Sciences Po.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙于2004年毕业于国家行政学院，获得高级公务员资格。
description.en: Macron graduated from the École nationale d'administration in 2004, qualifying as a senior civil servant.

description.zh-cn: 2018年11月，民众因不满马克龙政府计划提高燃油税而发起了“黄背心运动”以示抗议。
description.en: In November 2018, the 'Yellow Vests Movement' was launched to protest against the Macron government's plan to increase fuel taxes.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在2023年4月访华后接受采访时，强调欧洲应实现战略自主，成为美中以外的第三极。
description.en: In an interview after his visit to China in April 2023, Macron emphasized that Europe should achieve strategic autonomy and become a third superpower besides the US and China.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在2017年3月接受《巴黎人报》采访时表示自己是“毛泽东主义者”。
description.en: In a March 2017 interview with Le Parisien, Macron stated he was a 'Maoist'.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在讲话中引用了邓小平的名言“不管黑猫白猫，能抓老鼠的就是好猫”。
description.en: Macron quoted Deng Xiaoping's famous saying 'It doesn't matter whether a cat is black or white, as long as it catches mice'.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在第75届联合国大会上表示，应派出国际调查团前往新疆调查中国维吾尔族人权问题。
description.en: At the 75th UN General Assembly, Macron stated that an international mission should be sent to Xinjiang to investigate the human rights situation of the Uyghurs in China.

description.zh-cn: 1999年至2001年期间，马克龙担任哲学家保罗·利科的助理。
description.en: From 1999 to 2001, Macron worked as an assistant to philosopher Paul Ricœur.

description.zh-cn: 2007年，马克龙在雅克·阿塔利领导的提高法国增长委员会中担任副书记。
description.en: In 2007, Macron served as deputy rapporteur for the Commission to Unleash French Growth, led by Jacques Attali.

description.zh-cn: 马克龙在离开公共部门后，曾到罗斯柴尔德银行担任投资银行家。
description.en: After leaving the public sector, Macron worked as an investment banker at Rothschild & Co.

description.zh-cn: 遮打是香港赛马会的34名创会会员之一。
description.en: Paul Chater was one of the 34 founding members of The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 遮打于1892年至1926年担任香港赛马会主席。
description.en: Paul Chater served as the Chairman of The Hong Kong Jockey Club from 1892 to 1926.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府批准香港赛马会独家经营香港赛马、六合彩及海外体育运动赛事博彩。
description.en: The Hong Kong Government granted The Hong Kong Jockey Club the exclusive right to operate horse racing, Mark Six lottery, and overseas sports betting in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 在香港总督金文泰的授意下，香港赛马会开始吸纳华裔会员。
description.en: Under the initiative of Governor Cecil Clementi, The Hong Kong Jockey Club began to admit Chinese members.

description.zh-cn: 成为香港赛马会首批被吸纳的华裔会员之一。
description.en: Became one of the first Chinese members admitted to The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 授予香港赛马会“皇家”称号，使其更名为“英皇御准香港赛马会”。
description.en: Granted the 'Royal' title to The Hong Kong Jockey Club, leading to its renaming as 'The Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club'.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会于1993年成立香港赛马会慈善信托基金，专责管理慈善捐款的事宜。
description.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club established The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust in 1993 to manage its charitable donations.

description.zh-cn: 因应香港即将回归中国，“英皇御准香港赛马会”于1996年7月1日改回原名“香港赛马会”。
description.en: In anticipation of Hong Kong's return to China, 'The Royal Hong Kong Jockey Club' reverted to its original name 'The Hong Kong Jockey Club' on July 1, 1996.

description.zh-cn: 于2005年签订协议，容许澳门赛马会在澳门接受香港赛马投注，直到澳门赛马会2024年停业为止。
description.en: Signed an agreement in 2005 allowing the Macau Jockey Club to accept bets on Hong Kong races in Macau, until the Macau Jockey Club ceased operations in 2024.

position.en: Chairman of the Board of Stewards

description.zh-cn: 担任香港赛马会董事局主席。
description.en: Serves as the Chairman of the Board of Stewards of The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 自2007年起担任香港赛马会行政总裁。
description.en: Has served as the Chief Executive Officer of The Hong Kong Jockey Club since 2007.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会兴建并于1978年10月7日启用沙田马场。
description.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club built and opened the Sha Tin Racecourse on October 7, 1978.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会于1975年受政府委托接受六合彩投注。
description.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club was entrusted by the government to accept Mark Six lottery bets in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会于2003年获授权接受海外足球赛事投注，即足智彩。
description.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club was authorized in 2003 to accept bets on overseas football matches, known as HKJC Football.

description.zh-cn: 于1992年创校的香港科技大学是由马会拨款兴建。
description.en: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, founded in 1992, was constructed with funding from The Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 向香港城市大学捐款五亿港元资助其动物医学及生命科学院，学院因此冠名为“赛马会动物医学及生命科学院”。
description.en: Donated HK$500 million to the City University of Hong Kong to support its College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences, which was subsequently named 'Jockey Club College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences'.

description.zh-cn: 赛马会动物医学及生命科学院是香港城市大学下的一个学院。
description.en: The Jockey Club College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences is a college within the City University of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦义与蔡令怡是夫妻关系。
description.en: Wu Den-yih and Tsai Ling-yi are married.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦义是中国国民党籍的政治人物。
description.en: Wu Den-yih is a politician affiliated with the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦义毕业于国立台湾大学历史学系。
description.en: Wu Den-yih graduated from the Department of History at National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 马英九先后任命吴敦义为行政院院长，并提名其为副总统候选人搭档参选。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou appointed Wu Den-yih as Premier and later nominated him as his Vice Presidential running mate.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国在吴敦义年轻时曾接见并赏识他，对其政治生涯早期发展有重要影响。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo met with and appreciated Wu Den-yih in his youth, significantly influencing his early political career.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统李登辉与国民党秘书长宋楚瑜一同提拔吴敦义，任命其为官派高雄市市长。
description.en: Then-President Lee Teng-hui, along with KMT Secretary-General James Soong, promoted Wu Den-yih by appointing him as the government-appointed mayor of Kaohsiung.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦义在担任高雄市长期间曾批评李登辉政府“重北轻南”，后来又指李登辉时代是国民党黑金问题最严重的阶段。
description.en: During his tenure as Kaohsiung Mayor, Wu Den-yih criticized the Lee Teng-hui administration for 'prioritizing the north over the south' and later pointed to Lee's era as the most severe period of 'black gold' politics in the KMT.

description.zh-cn: 宋楚瑜作为亲民党候选人参加2012年中华民国总统选举，与代表国民党的吴敦义（副总统候选人）为竞争对手。
description.en: As the People First Party candidate in the 2012 ROC presidential election, James Soong was a rival to the KMT's Wu Den-yih (vice presidential candidate).

description.zh-cn: 在1998年高雄市市长选举中，谢长廷代表民进党参选，并击败了寻求连任的国民党籍市长吴敦义。
description.en: In the 1998 Kaohsiung mayoral election, Frank Hsieh represented the DPP and defeated the incumbent KMT mayor Wu Den-yih, who was seeking re-election.

description.zh-cn: 莫拉克台风（八八水灾）重创台湾，因救灾表现引发民众不满，导致刘兆玄内阁总辞。
description.en: Typhoon Morakot caused severe damage in Taiwan, and public dissatisfaction with the disaster response led to the mass resignation of the Liu Chao-shiuan cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦义接替因八八水灾辞职的刘兆玄，担任行政院院长。
description.en: Wu Den-yih succeeded Liu Chao-shiuan, who resigned over Typhoon Morakot, as the Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 因国民党在2020年总统及立委选举中败选，时任党主席吴敦义宣布承担责任并辞去职务。
description.en: Due to the KMT's defeat in the 2020 presidential and legislative elections, then-Chairman Wu Den-yih announced he would take responsibility and resign from his post.

description.zh-cn: 因吴敦义未按承诺任命其子王志雄为副市长，王玉云公开痛骂吴敦义为“白贼义”，两人从此交恶。
description.en: Because Wu Den-yih did not appoint his son Wang Chih-hsiung as deputy mayor as promised, Wang Yu-yun publicly denounced Wu as 'Liar Yi', and the two became enemies.

description.zh-cn: 在2018年为韩国瑜辅选时，吴敦义使用“肥滋滋”、“大母猪”等词语暗讽陈菊的身材，引发争议。
description.en: While campaigning for Han Kuo-yu in 2018, Wu Den-yih used terms like 'fatty' and 'big sow' to allude to Chen Chu's figure, causing controversy.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政院长吴敦义曾就大埔征地案承诺原屋保留，但承诺最终跳票，强拆继续进行，使其声誉受到严重损害。
description.en: Then-Premier Wu Den-yih promised to preserve the original houses in the Dapu land expropriation case, but the promise was ultimately broken and demolitions proceeded, severely damaging his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 时任苗栗县长刘政鸿是主导大埔征地与强拆的关键人物。
description.en: Then-Miaoli County Magistrate Liu Cheng-hung was the key figure leading the land expropriation and forced demolitions in the Dapu Incident.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，吴敦义与妻子受朋友邀请，与中台湾闻人江钦良共赴峇里岛旅游。
description.en: In 2008, Wu Den-yih and his wife, at a friend's invitation, traveled to Bali with Central Taiwan figure Jiang Chin-liang.

description.zh-cn: 二二八事件之后，国民政府在台湾展开了“清乡”运动。
description.en: Following the February 28 Incident, the Nationalist government launched the 'Village-Cleaning Campaign' in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 时任台南市长赖清德曾称赞吴敦义为最有能力的行政院院长。
description.en: Then-Tainan Mayor Lai Ching-te once praised Wu Den-yih as a highly capable Premier.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Fifth Bureau

description.zh-cn: 曾任该职务。
description.en: Formerly held this position.

description.zh-cn: 两人已离异。
description.en: They are divorced.

description.zh-cn: 刘超英是1996年美国竞选财务丑闻的主要人物之一。
description.en: Liu Chaoying was one of the key figures in the 1996 United States campaign finance controversy.

description.zh-cn: 两人在1996年6月相遇，并有业务往来。
description.en: The two met in June 1996 and had business dealings.

description.zh-cn: 刘超英参加了一个由时任马萨诸塞州参议员约翰·克里组织的会议。
description.en: Liu Chaoying attended a meeting organized by then-Massachusetts Senator John Kerry.

description.zh-cn: 刘超英向钟育瀚在香港的银行账户中转账30万美元，并将其介绍给中国军事情报部门领导姬胜德。
description.en: Liu Chaoying transferred $300,000 to Johnny Chung's bank account in Hong Kong, and introduced him to Ji Shengde, the head of Chinese military intelligence.

description.zh-cn: 钟育瀚告诉联邦调查员，他向民主党全国委员会捐赠的钱中有35000美元来自中国军事情报部门。
description.en: Johnny Chung told federal investigators that $35,000 of the money he donated to the Democratic National Committee came from Chinese military intelligence.

description.zh-cn: 姬胜德表示将给钟育瀚30万美元，用于赠与美国总统和民主党。
description.en: Ji Shengde stated that he would give Johnny Chung $300,000 to be donated to the U.S. President and the Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区行政长官依法兼任香港理工大学校监。
description.en: The Chief Executive of Hong Kong serves as the Chancellor of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University by law.

description.zh-cn: 李家超是现任香港特别行政区行政长官。
description.en: John Lee is the current Chief Executive of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 林大辉是香港理工大学现任校董会主席。
description.en: Lam Tai-fai is the current Chairman of the Council of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

description.zh-cn: 于1965年在立法局会议中倡议在香港成立一所理工学院。
description.en: Advocated for the establishment of a polytechnic in Hong Kong during a Legislative Council meeting in 1965.

description.zh-cn: 捐款一百万元支持香港工业专门学院兴建红磡本部校舍。
description.en: Donated one million HKD to support the construction of the Hong Kong Technical College's main campus in Hung Hom.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任香港总督，为香港工业专门学院红磡本部校舍揭幕。
description.en: As the then Governor of Hong Kong, inaugurated the main campus of the Hong Kong Technical College in Hung Hom.

description.zh-cn: 时任港督麦理浩爵士出任香港理工学院首任荣誉监督。
description.en: The then Governor, Sir Murray MacLehose, served as the first Honorary Supervisor of the Hong Kong Polytechnic.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学与华为联合成立科研中心。
description.en: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Huawei jointly established a research center.

description.zh-cn: 为中国的探月工程研发太空仪器，包括为嫦娥三号、四号、五号和六号任务研制关键系统和装置。
description.en: Developed space instruments for China's lunar exploration program, including key systems and devices for the Chang'e-3, 4, 5, and 6 missions.

description.zh-cn: 为中国首次火星探测任务“天问一号”研制了关键仪器“落火状态监视相机”。
description.en: Developed the Mars Landing Surveillance Camera, a key instrument for China's first Mars exploration mission, Tianwen-1.

description.zh-cn: 为欧洲太空总署2003年火星快车任务研发“岩芯取样器”。
description.en: Developed the 'rock corer' for the European Space Agency's 2003 Mars Express mission.

description.zh-cn: 自1995年起为俄罗斯的太空计划提供设备，并参与2011年的中俄联合探索火星任务。
description.en: Has provided equipment for Russia's space programs since 1995 and participated in the joint Sino-Russian Mars exploration mission in 2011.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学冲突是在“反修例运动”期间发生的一次重大警民冲突。
description.en: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University conflict was a major police-civilian confrontation that occurred during the Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在香港理工大学冲突中，警方包围并攻入校园，与校内的示威者发生激烈冲突。
description.en: During the Hong Kong Polytechnic University conflict, the police besieged and stormed the campus, leading to intense clashes with protesters inside.

description.zh-cn: 冲突导致校园被长期围困、设施严重损毁，并被迫关闭。
description.en: The conflict resulted in a prolonged siege of the campus, severe damage to facilities, and a forced closure.

description.zh-cn: 香港理工大学冲突及同月发生的香港中文大学冲突，促使美国参议院快速推动通过了《香港人权与民主法案》。
description.en: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University conflict, along with the conflict at the Chinese University of Hong Kong in the same month, prompted the U.S. Senate to fast-track the passage of the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act.

description.zh-cn: 法案要求美国政府对侵犯香港人权的中港官员实施制裁。
description.en: The Act requires the U.S. government to impose sanctions on Chinese and Hong Kong officials who violate human rights in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部宣布制裁时任香港警务处处长邓炳强，因其指挥警方围困理大等行为损害香港自治。
description.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced sanctions against then-Commissioner of Police Chris Tang for undermining Hong Kong's autonomy, citing his command of the police siege of PolyU.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部宣布制裁时任香港特别行政区行政长官林郑月娥，因其损害香港自治。
description.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced sanctions against then-Chief Executive of Hong Kong Carrie Lam for undermining Hong Kong's autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 根据伊斯兰教信仰，《古兰经》是真主通过天使加百列在23年间降示给先知穆罕默德的启示。
description.en: According to Islamic belief, the Quran is the revelation from God (Allah) sent down to the Prophet Muhammad over a period of 23 years through the angel Gabriel.

description.zh-cn: 天使加百列向穆罕默德传达了真主的启示，这些启示后来被编纂成《古兰经》。
description.en: The angel Gabriel delivered God's revelations to Muhammad, which were later compiled into the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德作为先知，接收并向世人传达了《古兰经》的启示。
description.en: As the prophet, Muhammad received and conveyed the revelations of the Quran to humanity.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德的同伴们在他生前充当书记，记录下启示，并在他逝世后根据记录和记忆进行了编纂。
description.en: The companions of Muhammad acted as scribes during his lifetime, recording the revelations, and compiled them after his death based on these records and their memories.

description.zh-cn: 在穆罕默德逝世后，首任哈里发阿布·伯克尔下令收集《古兰经》的经文并编纂成册。
description.en: After the death of Muhammad, the first Caliph Abu Bakr ordered the collection of the Quranic verses and their compilation into a book.

description.zh-cn: 根据什叶派和一些逊尼派学者的说法，阿里在穆罕默德逝世后不久编制了一个按年代编排的《古兰经》完整版本。
description.en: According to Shia and some Sunni scholars, Ali compiled a complete, chronologically ordered version of the Quran shortly after Muhammad's death.

description.zh-cn: 《古兰经》是伊斯兰教法最重要和首要的法源。
description.en: The Quran is the most important and primary source of Islamic law (Sharia).

description.zh-cn: 《圣训》与《古兰经》都是制订伊斯兰教法的依据。
description.en: The Hadith, along with the Quran, serves as a basis for establishing Islamic law (Sharia).

description.zh-cn: 《古兰经》的内容与《旧约》经典记载的主要故事有相同之处。
description.en: The content of the Quran has similarities with the main stories recorded in the Old Testament.

description.zh-cn: 《古兰经》的内容与《新约》经典记载的主要故事有相同之处。
description.en: The content of the Quran has similarities with the main stories recorded in the New Testament.

description.zh-cn: 《古兰经》引申出大量的评注及诠释，这些诠释被称为“塔夫细尔”。
description.en: The Quran has given rise to a large body of commentary and exegesis, known as 'Tafsir'.

description.zh-cn: 埃及国王福阿德一世于1923年要求开罗艾资哈尔大学的学者编制一部标准版的《古兰经》，即后来的1924年开罗版。
description.en: In 1923, King Fuad I of Egypt requested scholars at Al-Azhar University in Cairo to compile a standard edition of the Quran, which became the 1924 Cairo edition.

description.zh-cn: 开罗的艾资哈尔大学学者于1924年编制并出版了《古兰经》标准版，该版本在后来的近一百年内成为权威版本。
description.en: Scholars at Al-Azhar University in Cairo compiled and published a standard edition of the Quran in 1924, which became the authoritative version for nearly the next century.

description.zh-cn: 根据伊斯兰教传说，穆罕默德在希拉山洞静修时首次获得《古兰经》的启示。
description.en: According to Islamic tradition, Muhammad received his first revelation of the Quran while meditating in the Cave of Hira.

description.zh-cn: 在叶麻默战役中，穆赛利迈的军队杀害了许多穆罕默德的同伴。
description.en: In the Battle of Yamama, the forces of Musaylimah killed many of the companions of Muhammad.

description.zh-cn: 学者亚伯拉罕·盖格尔认为，《古兰经》的许多用字、概念及典故参考了犹太教。
description.en: The scholar Abraham Geiger argued that many of the words, concepts, and narratives in the Quran were referenced from Judaism.

description.zh-cn: 波斯人萨尔曼在7世纪时将《古兰经》的第一章《开端章》翻译成波斯语，这是已知最早的《古兰经》翻译活动。
description.en: In the 7th century, Salman the Persian translated the first chapter of the Quran, Al-Fatiha, into Persian, which is the earliest known translation activity of the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 赵旉的生母是潘贤妃。
description.en: Zhao Fu's birth mother was Consort Pan.

description.zh-cn: 金将兀术致信秦桧，提出“必杀飞，始可和”，将处死岳飞作为议和的条件。
description.en: The Jin general Wuzhu sent a letter to Qin Hui, stating that peace could only be achieved if Yue Fei was executed, making it a condition for the treaty.

description.zh-cn: 为了与金朝议和，宋高宗重用了主和派的秦桧。
description.en: In order to negotiate peace with the Jin dynasty, Emperor Gaozong heavily relied on the pro-peace faction leader Qin Hui.

description.zh-cn: 金帝完颜亮撕毁了绍兴和议，并发动大规模南侵。
description.en: The Jin emperor Wanyan Liang tore up the Treaty of Shaoxing and launched a large-scale invasion of the south.

description.zh-cn: 完颜亮撕毁和议后发动的南侵，引发了采石之战。
description.en: The invasion launched by Wanyan Liang after breaking the treaty led to the Battle of Caishi.

description.zh-cn: 宋高宗以“倦勤”为由，禅让皇位给养子赵昚（宋孝宗）。
description.en: Citing 'weariness of duties', Emperor Gaozong abdicated the throne to his adopted son Zhao Shen (Emperor Xiaozong).

description.zh-cn: 清高宗乾隆帝曾作诗对宋高宗进行批判，认为他偏安一隅、屈膝求和，不配称为“中兴之主”，对其评价极低。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor of the Qing dynasty wrote poetry criticizing Emperor Gaozong, deeming him unworthy of the title 'Restoration Monarch' due to his policy of appeasement and ruling over a partial territory, holding him in very low regard.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国建筑集团有限公司董事长。
description.en: Serves as the Chairman of China State Construction Engineering Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，国家建筑工程总局的企事业管理职能连同直属单位，合并组建为中国建筑工程总公司（中国建筑集团有限公司前身）。
description.en: In 1982, the enterprise management functions and directly affiliated units of the State Administration of Building Engineering were merged to form China State Construction Engineering Corporation (the predecessor of the current company).

description.zh-cn: 经国务院批准，中国建筑工程总公司（中国建筑集团有限公司前身）于1982年6月11日正式成立。
description.en: With the approval of the State Council, China State Construction Engineering Corporation (the predecessor of the current company) was formally established on June 11, 1982.

description.zh-cn: 因在菲律宾的道路项目涉及腐败行为，被世界银行列入黑名单，并禁止参与该银行资助的项目6年。
description.en: Blacklisted by the World Bank and banned from participating in its funded projects for 6 years due to corrupt practices in a road project in the Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰背景下，因其在俄罗斯扩大业务，被乌克兰国家预防腐败局列入国际战争赞助商名单。
description.en: In the context of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, it was listed as an international sponsor of war by the Ukrainian National Agency on Corruption Prevention for expanding its business in Russia.

description.zh-cn: 中国建筑集团有限公司是一家特大型中央企业。
description.en: China State Construction Engineering Corporation is a super-large central enterprise.

description.zh-cn: 是中国建筑集团有限公司的直属企业之一（中建国际建设公司）。
description.en: Is one of the directly affiliated enterprises of China State Construction Engineering Corporation (CSCEC International Construction Company).

description.zh-cn: 是中国建筑集团有限公司的直属企业之一（中国建筑一局（集团）有限公司）。
description.en: Is one of the directly affiliated enterprises of China State Construction Engineering Corporation (China Construction First Group Corporation Limited).

description.zh-cn: 2018年，根据《深化党和国家机构改革方案》，中央人民广播电台并入新组建的中央广播电视总台。
description.en: In 2018, according to the 'Plan for Deepening the Reform of Party and State Institutions', China National Radio was merged into the newly established China Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民广播电台的前身是1940年12月30日在延安诞生的延安新华广播电台。1949年9月27日，因应北平改为北京，“北平新华广播电台”改名为“北京新华广播电台”。
description.en: The predecessor of China National Radio was the Yan'an Xinhua Radio Station, born in Yan'an on December 30, 1940. On September 27, 1949, as Beiping was renamed Beijing, 'Beiping Xinhua Radio Station' was renamed 'Beijing Xinhua Radio Station'.

description.zh-cn: 经中共中央批准，北京新华广播电台定名为“中央人民广播电台”。
description.en: With the approval of the CCP Central Committee, Beijing Xinhua Radio Station was officially named 'China National Radio'.

description.zh-cn: 1949年10月1日，北京新华广播电台在天安门广场向全国现场直播中华人民共和国开国大典实况。
description.en: On October 1, 1949, Beijing Xinhua Radio Station broadcasted the Proclamation of the People's Republic of China live from Tiananmen Square to the entire nation.

description.zh-cn: 1978年5月1日，中央人民广播电台对海外广播部分（北京广播电台）脱离中央台序列，独立分拆并成立“中华人民共和国国际广播电台”。
description.en: On May 1, 1978, the overseas broadcasting section of China National Radio (Radio Beijing) was separated and established as the independent 'China Radio International'.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，原中央电视台与中央人民广播电台、中国国际广播电台合并组建中央广播电视总台。
description.en: In 2018, the former China Central Television merged with China National Radio and China Radio International to form the China Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，原中国国际广播电台与中央电视台、中央人民广播电台合并组建中央广播电视总台。
description.en: In 2018, the former China Radio International merged with China Central Television and China National Radio to form the China Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民广播电台与QVC合作，开播电视购物频道“央广购物”。
description.en: China National Radio collaborated with QVC to launch the television shopping channel 'CNR Mall'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府指派刘存忠为首任台中县县长。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government appointed Liu Tsun-chung as the first Magistrate of Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 台中县县长是日治时期台中州知事的后继职位。
description.en: The Magistrate of Taichung County is the successor position to the Governor of Taichū Prefecture from the Japanese rule period.

description.zh-cn: 台中市市长是台中县县长职务的后继职位。
description.en: The Mayor of Taichung City is the successor position to the Magistrate of Taichung County.

description.zh-cn: 因成功抵御诸葛亮北伐，司马懿在曹魏的地位和名望逐渐上升。
description.en: Due to his successful defense against Zhuge Liang's Northern Expeditions, Sima Yi's status and prestige in Cao Wei gradually rose.

description.zh-cn: 蜀汉在夷陵之战中被东吴击败，国力大减，影响了其后北伐的实力。
description.en: Shu Han was defeated by Eastern Wu in the Battle of Yiling, which greatly weakened its national strength and affected its capabilities in the subsequent Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 平定蜀汉南方为北伐提供了稳定的后方和所需的物资。
description.en: Pacifying the southern regions of Shu Han provided a stable rear and necessary resources for the Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮通过《出师表》向后主刘禅陈述了北伐的理由和决心，获得了出师的批准。
description.en: Through the 'Chu Shi Biao', Zhuge Liang presented his reasons and determination for the Northern Expeditions to Emperor Liu Shan, gaining approval to launch the campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 作为蜀汉皇帝，刘禅下诏批准诸葛亮开始实行北伐。
description.en: As the emperor of Shu Han, Liu Shan issued an edict authorizing Zhuge Liang to commence the Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 马谡违背诸葛亮的部署，在街亭舍水上山，导致蜀军被张郃击败。
description.en: Ma Su disobeyed Zhuge Liang's orders at Jieting by camping on a hilltop away from water sources, leading to the defeat of the Shu army by Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 曹魏将领张郃在街亭之战中率军大破马谡，取得了魏军的胜利。
description.en: The Cao Wei general Zhang He led his forces to a decisive victory over Ma Su at the Battle of Jieting.

description.zh-cn: 杨仪与魏延积怨已久，在诸葛亮死后矛盾激化，发生武装冲突。
description.en: Yang Yi and Wei Yan had a long-standing feud, which escalated into armed conflict after Zhuge Liang's death.

description.zh-cn: 在杨仪与魏延的权力斗争中，马岱奉命斩杀了兵败的魏延。
description.en: In the power struggle between Yang Yi and Wei Yan, Ma Dai was ordered to execute the defeated Wei Yan.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次北伐期间，时任曹魏天水郡中郎将的姜维因被太守怀疑而无法归城，最终投降了蜀汉。
description.en: During the first Northern Expedition, Jiang Wei, then a mid-level officer in Cao Wei's Tianshui Commandery, was suspected by his superior and unable to return to his city, ultimately surrendering to Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 费祎生前对姜维的北伐有所节制。在他于253年遇刺身故后，姜维才加大了北伐的攻势。
description.en: While he was alive, Fei Yi restrained Jiang Wei's Northern Expeditions. Only after Fei Yi's assassination in 253 did Jiang Wei intensify his campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 作为曹魏皇帝，曹叡亲自坐镇长安，调兵遣将，成功抵御了诸葛亮的五次北伐。
description.en: As the emperor of Cao Wei, Cao Rui personally oversaw the defense from Chang'an, dispatching generals and troops to successfully repel all five of Zhuge Liang's Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 曹真作为曹魏大都督，指挥了对诸葛亮前三次北伐的防御。
description.en: As the grand marshal of Cao Wei, Cao Zhen commanded the defense against Zhuge Liang's first three Northern Expeditions.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次北伐撤退过程中，诸葛亮与追击的魏将王双交战，将其击破并斩杀。
description.en: During the retreat of the second Northern Expedition, Zhuge Liang engaged the pursuing Wei general Wang Shuang, defeated and killed him.

description.zh-cn: 在第五次北伐时，诸葛亮派使臣与东吴约定，希望孙权能同时攻魏以作呼应，孙权遂发动了对合肥的进攻。
description.en: During the fifth Northern Expedition, Zhuge Liang sent an envoy to coordinate with Eastern Wu, hoping Sun Quan would attack Wei simultaneously. Sun Quan then launched an attack on Hefei.

description.zh-cn: 郝昭以千余兵力坚守陈仓城，成功抵御了诸葛亮数万大军二十余日的围攻，迫使其因粮尽而退。
description.en: With just over a thousand soldiers, Hao Zhao successfully defended the fortress of Chencang against Zhuge Liang's army of tens of thousands for over twenty days, forcing them to retreat due to lack of supplies.

description.zh-cn: 9名隶属于泰国皇家陆军第三军区第7步兵师的军人与糯康集团勾结，参与了对中国商船的扫射，并试图伪造清剿毒贩的现场。
description.en: Nine soldiers from the 7th Infantry Division of the Royal Thai Army's 3rd Army Area colluded with the Naw Kham gang, participated in shooting at the Chinese cargo ships, and attempted to fake a scene of a drug bust.

description.zh-cn: 陈国英在湄公河惨案中遇害。
description.en: Chen Guoying was killed in the Mekong River massacre.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国总理温家宝与时任泰国总理英拉通电话，要求泰方加紧审理湄公河惨案，依法严惩凶手。
description.en: Then-Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao spoke by phone with then-Thai Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra, demanding that the Thai side expedite the trial of the Mekong River massacre case and severely punish the perpetrators according to law.

description.zh-cn: 老挝警方与中国专案组联手，在老挝波乔省成功抓获糯康。
description.en: Lao police, in cooperation with a Chinese special task force, successfully captured Naw Kham in Bokeo Province, Laos.

description.zh-cn: 老挝依法将湄公河惨案主犯糯康移交中国受审。
description.en: Laos extradited Naw Kham, the mastermind of the Mekong River massacre, to China for trial in accordance with the law.

description.zh-cn: 昆明市中级人民法院一审宣判主犯糯康死刑，并于2013年3月1日执行。
description.en: The Kunming Intermediate People's Court sentenced the main culprit Naw Kham to death in the first-instance trial, and the execution was carried out on March 1, 2013.

description.zh-cn: 昆明市中级人民法院一审宣判桑康·乍萨死刑，并于2013年3月1日执行。
description.en: The Kunming Intermediate People's Court sentenced Sang Kham to death in the first-instance trial, and the execution was carried out on March 1, 2013.

description.zh-cn: 昆明市中级人民法院一审宣判依莱死刑，并于2013年3月1日执行。
description.en: The Kunming Intermediate People's Court sentenced Yi Lai to death in the first-instance trial, and the execution was carried out on March 1, 2013.

description.zh-cn: 昆明市中级人民法院一审宣判扎西卡死刑，并于2013年3月1日执行。
description.en: The Kunming Intermediate People's Court sentenced Zha Xika to death in the first-instance trial, and the execution was carried out on March 1, 2013.

description.zh-cn: 芭芭拉·布什与乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布希于1945年1月6日结婚。
description.en: Barbara Bush married George H. W. Bush on January 6, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 波琳·罗宾逊·布什是芭芭拉·布什的女儿。
description.en: Pauline Robinson Bush is the daughter of Barbara Bush.

description.zh-cn: 波琳·罗宾逊·布什是乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布希的女儿。
description.en: Pauline Robinson Bush is the daughter of George H. W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 杰布·布什是芭芭拉·布什的儿子。
description.en: Jeb Bush is the son of Barbara Bush.

description.zh-cn: 杰布·布什是乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布希的儿子。
description.en: Jeb Bush is the son of George H. W. Bush.

description.zh-cn: 芭芭拉·布什接替南希·里根成为美国第一夫人。
description.en: Barbara Bush succeeded Nancy Reagan as the First Lady of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 希拉里·罗德姆·克林顿接替芭芭拉·布什成为美国第一夫人。
description.en: Hillary Rodham Clinton succeeded Barbara Bush as the First Lady of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 中国进出口银行是直属中华人民共和国国务院领导的国有政策性银行。
description.en: The Export-Import Bank of China is a state-owned policy bank under the direct leadership of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈怀宇担任中国进出口银行的董事长。
description.en: Chen Huaiyu serves as the Chairman of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 王春英担任中国进出口银行的行长。
description.en: Wang Chunying serves as the President of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 佟志广是中国进出口银行的首任董事长。
description.en: Tong Zhiguang was the first Chairman of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，时任香港华润集团总经理的佟志广产生了设立中国出口信用机构的想法。
description.en: In 1986, Tong Zhiguang, then the general manager of the Hong Kong China Resources Group, conceived the idea of establishing a Chinese export credit agency.

description.zh-cn: 1991年，佟志广到中华人民共和国对外贸易经济合作部就职。
description.en: In 1991, Tong Zhiguang began working at the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation.

description.zh-cn: 佟志广受香港出口信用保险局启发，认为有必要开设一家中华人民共和国的出口信用机构。
description.en: Inspired by the Hong Kong Export Credit Insurance Corporation, Tong Zhiguang believed it was necessary to establish an export credit agency for the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 佟志广自1986年受启发后，持续推动中国出口信用机构的建立，并于1991年到对外贸易经济合作部就职后认为此事迫在眉睫，最终促成了中国进出口银行的建立。
description.en: After being inspired in 1986, Tong Zhiguang continuously promoted the establishment of a Chinese export credit agency, believing the matter was urgent after taking office at the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation in 1991, which ultimately led to the establishment of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据《国务院关于组建中国进出口银行的通知》（国发《1994》20号），中国进出口银行正式组建。
description.en: According to the 'Notice of the State Council on the Establishment of The Export-Import Bank of China' (Guo Fa [1994] No. 20), The Export-Import Bank of China was formally established.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国财政部是中国进出口银行的组建单位之一。
description.en: The Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China was one of the founding units of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国对外贸易经济合作部是中国进出口银行的组建单位之一。
description.en: The Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Co-operation was one of the founding units of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国银行是中国进出口银行的组建单位之一。
description.en: Bank of China was one of the founding units of The Export-Import Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国进出口银行的创立是为了适应建立社会主义市场经济体制的需要。
description.en: The establishment of The Export-Import Bank of China was to meet the needs of building a socialist market economy system.

description.zh-cn: 中国进出口银行为配合国家“走出去”战略，提供对外承包工程贷款、境外投资贷款等业务。
description.en: To coordinate with the national 'Go Global' strategy, The Export-Import Bank of China provides services such as loans for overseas contracting projects and overseas investment loans.

description.zh-cn: 自1995年中华人民共和国援外体制改革起，中国进出口银行开始承办援外优惠贷款及转贷业务。
description.en: Since the reform of China's foreign aid system in 1995, The Export-Import Bank of China began to undertake concessional loans and on-lending business for foreign aid.

description.zh-cn: 交通银行与中国进出口银行签署战略合作协议，加强在银团贷款、结算代理、贸易融资等领域的合作。
description.en: Bank of Communications and The Export-Import Bank of China signed a strategic cooperation agreement to strengthen cooperation in areas such as syndicated loans, settlement agency, and trade finance.

description.zh-cn: 梧桐树投资平台有限责任公司持有中国进出口银行89.26%的股份，是其主要股东。
description.en: Wutongshu Investment Platform Co., Ltd. holds 89.26% of the shares of The Export-Import Bank of China, making it a major shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 在托洛茨基的建议下，中国的四个托派组织召开统一大会，成立了中国共产主义同盟（原名中国共产党左派反对派）。
description.en: At the suggestion of Leon Trotsky, four Trotskyist organizations in China held a unification conference and established the Communist League of China (originally named the Chinese Communist Left Opposition).

description.zh-cn: 在国际左翼反对派的建议下，中国的四个托派组织召开统一大会，成立了中国共产主义同盟（原名中国共产党左派反对派）。
description.en: At the suggestion of the International Left Opposition, four Trotskyist organizations in China held a unification conference and established the Communist League of China (originally named the Chinese Communist Left Opposition).

description.zh-cn: 彭述之曾担任中国共产主义同盟的总书记。
description.en: Peng Shuzhi served as the General Secretary of the Communist League of China.

description.zh-cn: 马玉夫因未当选中央执行委员，向淞沪警备司令部告密，导致中国共产主义同盟刚选出的中央委员会9名执委中的5名被捕，对组织造成了严重破坏。
description.en: After failing to be elected to the Central Executive Committee, Ma Yufu informed the Songhu Garrison Command, leading to the arrest of 5 of the 9 newly elected executive committee members of the Communist League of China, causing severe damage to the organization.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，根据“西安事变”中应允的“释放全部政治犯”的协议，陈独秀于1937年8月23日获释出狱。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Chen Duxiu was released from prison on August 23, 1937, in accordance with the agreement made during the 'Xi'an Incident' to 'release all political prisoners'.

description.zh-cn: 1948年9月，彭述之领导中国共产主义同盟的多数派，将其改组为中国革命共产党，并担任书记。
description.en: In September 1948, Peng Shuzhi led the majority faction of the Communist League of China to reorganize it into the Chinese Revolutionary Communist Party, and he served as its secretary.

description.zh-cn: 1949年4月，中国共产主义同盟少数派改组为中国国际主义工人党，并选举王凡西为书记。
description.en: In April 1949, the minority faction of the Communist League of China reorganized into the Internationalist Workers Party of China and elected Wang Fanxi as its secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产主义同盟由从中国共产党分裂出的托洛茨基主义者组成，其成立深受早期中共党内路线斗争的影响。
description.en: The Communist League of China was formed by Trotskyists who had split from the Communist Party of China, and its establishment was deeply influenced by the early inner-party line struggles of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 隆吐山战役后，清朝政府和大英帝国签订了《中英藏印条约》。
description.en: After the Battle of Lung-t'u-shan, the Qing government and the British Empire signed the Convention of Calcutta.

description.zh-cn: 在1888年的隆吐山战役中，清朝政府与大英帝国（英属印度）处于敌对状态。
description.en: During the Battle of Lung-t'u-shan in 1888, the Qing government and the British Empire (British India) were in a state of hostility.

description.zh-cn: 赫德任命戴乐尔为亚东关税务总司。
description.en: Robert Hart appointed F. E. Taylor as the Commissioner of Yadong Customs.

description.zh-cn: 曲阜是儒家学派创始人孔子的故乡。
description.en: Qufu is the hometown of Confucius, the founder of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 曲阜是孔子弟子颜回的故乡。
description.en: Qufu is the hometown of Yan Hui, a disciple of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 曲阜是史学家左丘明的故乡。
description.en: Qufu is the hometown of the historian Zuo Qiuming.

description.zh-cn: 曲阜是工匠鲁班的故乡。
description.en: Qufu is the hometown of the artisan Lu Ban.

description.zh-cn: 孔子是儒家学派的创始人。
description.en: Confucius is the founder of the Confucian school of thought.

description.zh-cn: 曲阜作为鲁国都城，历经了八百七十三年历史。
description.en: Qufu served as the capital of the State of Lu for 873 years.

description.zh-cn: 周武王将弟弟周公旦分封于曲阜，建立鲁国。
description.en: King Wu of Zhou enfeoffed his younger brother, the Duke of Zhou, at Qufu, establishing the State of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 周公旦是周武王的弟弟。
description.en: The Duke of Zhou was the younger brother of King Wu of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 伯禽是周公旦的儿子，替父亲领国。
description.en: Bo Qin was the son of the Duke of Zhou and ruled the state on his father's behalf.

description.zh-cn: 战国末期，鲁国被楚国灭亡。
description.en: At the end of the Warring States period, the State of Lu was conquered by the State of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，联合国教科文组织将曲阜孔庙列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: In 1994, UNESCO inscribed the Temple of Confucius in Qufu on the World Heritage List.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，联合国教科文组织将孔府列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: In 1994, UNESCO inscribed the Kong Family Mansion on the World Heritage List.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，联合国教科文组织将孔林列入世界遗产名录。
description.en: In 1994, UNESCO inscribed the Cemetery of Confucius on the World Heritage List.

description.zh-cn: 西汉时，汉高祖刘邦以祭天的仪式来祭孔子，提升了孔子的地位。
description.en: During the Western Han dynasty, Emperor Gaozu of Han honored Confucius with a ceremony typically reserved for worshipping Heaven, elevating Confucius's status.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，曲阜被中国国务院定为国家历史文化名城。
description.en: In 1982, Qufu was designated as a National Famous Historical and Cultural City by the State Council of China.

description.zh-cn: 诗人李白曾到石门寺游览并留下诗句。
description.en: The poet Li Bai visited Shimen Temple and left behind poems.

description.zh-cn: 清朝戏曲家孔尚任曾经一度居住在石门寺。
description.en: The Qing dynasty dramatist Kong Shangren once resided in Shimen Temple.

description.zh-cn: 南加州大学是域名系统的诞生地。
description.en: The University of Southern California is the birthplace of the Domain Name System.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·卢卡斯是南加州大学电影艺术学院的著名校友。
description.en: George Lucas is a famous alumnus of the USC School of Cinematic Arts.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·卢卡斯于2006年向南加州大学电影艺术学院捐赠了1.75亿美元。
description.en: George Lucas donated $175 million to the USC School of Cinematic Arts in 2006.

description.zh-cn: 南加州大学与上海交通大学合作，开设海外EMBA课程并共同成立了上海交大-南加州大学文化创意产业学院。
description.en: The University of Southern California partnered with Shanghai Jiao Tong University to offer an overseas EMBA program and jointly establish the USC-SJTU Institute of Cultural and Creative Industry.

description.zh-cn: 南加州大学与上海交通大学于2015年合作成立了上海交大-南加州大学文化创意产业学院。
description.en: The University of Southern California and Shanghai Jiao Tong University jointly founded the USC-SJTU Institute of Cultural and Creative Industry in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 上海交通大学与南加州大学于2015年合作成立了上海交大-南加州大学文化创意产业学院。
description.en: Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Southern California jointly founded the USC-SJTU Institute of Cultural and Creative Industry in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 南加州大学与洛杉矶加利福尼亚大学（UCLA）在学术和体育领域是著名的宿敌。
description.en: The University of Southern California and the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) are well-known rivals in academics and sports.

description.zh-cn: 南加州大学与圣母大学在美式足球领域存在激烈的竞争关系。
description.en: The University of Southern California has an intense football rivalry with the University of Notre Dame.

description.zh-cn: 南加州大学与史丹佛大学在体育赛事上是竞争对手。
description.en: The University of Southern California is a sports rival of Stanford University.

description.zh-cn: Andrew Viterbi及其夫人向南加州大学工程学院捐赠5200万美元，该学院因此更名为维特比工程学院以纪念他们。
description.en: Andrew Viterbi and his wife donated $52 million to the USC School of Engineering, which was renamed the Viterbi School of Engineering in their honor.

description.zh-cn: Andrew Viterbi是高通公司的联合创始人。
description.en: Andrew Viterbi is a co-founder of Qualcomm.

description.zh-cn: 谢明于2006年向南加州大学电机系捐赠了3500万美元。
description.en: Ming Hsieh donated $35 million to the USC Department of Electrical Engineering in 2006.

description.zh-cn: 第一位踏上月球的人类尼尔·阿姆斯壮是南加州大学的校友。
description.en: Neil Armstrong, the first person to walk on the Moon, is an alumnus of the University of Southern California.

description.zh-cn: 前日本首相安倍晋三是南加州大学的校友。
description.en: Former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe is an alumnus of the University of Southern California.

description.zh-cn: 电影艺术学院是南加州大学下属的专业学院之一。
description.en: The School of Cinematic Arts is one of the professional schools of the University of Southern California.

description.zh-cn: 维特比工程学院是南加州大学下属的专业学院之一。
description.en: The Viterbi School of Engineering is one of the professional schools of the University of Southern California.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝（胤禛）是康熙帝的皇四子。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor (Yinzhen) was the fourth son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，十世班禅到北京时在雍和宫法轮殿讲经布道。
description.en: In 1954, when the 10th Panchen Lama visited Beijing, he preached at the Hall of the Wheel of the Law in the Yonghe Temple.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，十四世达赖到北京时在雍和宫法轮殿讲经布道。
description.en: In 1954, when the 14th Dalai Lama visited Beijing, he preached at the Hall of the Wheel of the Law in the Yonghe Temple.

description.zh-cn: 1956年1月，中国佛教协会任命噶拉藏为雍和宫住持。
description.en: In January 1956, the Buddhist Association of China appointed Galatsang as the abbot of the Yonghe Temple.

description.zh-cn: 《穹顶之下》通过调查和演讲，呼吁公众关注中国的空气污染问题，极大地推动了该议题在社会上的讨论热度。
description.en: 'Under the Dome', through investigation and presentation, called for public attention to China's air pollution problem, significantly boosting the intensity of public discussion on the issue.

description.zh-cn: 纪录片聚焦并深入探讨了中国的空气污染现状、成因及治理困境，引发了全国性的社会反响和政策讨论。
description.en: The documentary focused on and delved into the state, causes, and governance challenges of air pollution in China, triggering a nationwide social response and policy debate.

description.zh-cn: 因一名员工泄露了中宣部关于封杀《穹顶之下》的机密通告，《第一财经日报》该员工遭到停职处理。
description.en: An employee of China Business News was suspended after leaking a confidential notice from the Propaganda Department regarding the ban on 'Under the Dome'.

description.zh-cn: 《穹顶之下》在视频中点名批评了中石油，影片发布后的第一个交易日，其股价下跌。
description.en: 'Under the Dome' criticized CNPC by name in the video. On the first trading day after the film's release, its stock price fell.

description.zh-cn: 《穹顶之下》在视频中点名批评了中石化，影片发布后的第一个交易日，其股价下跌。
description.en: 'Under the Dome' criticized Sinopec by name in the video. On the first trading day after the film's release, its stock price fell.

description.zh-cn: 雷切尔·卡森是《寂静的春天》一书的作者，该书被认为是现代环保运动的开端。
description.en: Rachel Carson is the author of the book 'Silent Spring', which is considered to have launched the modern environmental movement.

description.zh-cn: 田光向燕太子丹推荐了荆轲来执行刺秦任务。
description.en: Tian Guang recommended Jing Ke to Crown Prince Dan of Yan to carry out the assassination mission against Qin.

description.zh-cn: 燕国游侠田光结识荆轲，认为他不是平常人。
description.en: The knight-errant Tian Guang of Yan became acquainted with Jing Ke and considered him an extraordinary person.

description.zh-cn: 樊於期为帮助荆轲完成刺秦计划并报自己的家仇，毅然自刎献出首级。
description.en: To help Jing Ke complete the assassination plot and to avenge his own family, Fan Yuqi resolutely committed suicide and offered his head.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政杀害了樊於期的父母宗族，并悬赏千金邑万家要其首级。
description.en: King Zheng of Qin had Fan Yuqi's parents and clan executed and offered a bounty of a thousand catties of gold and a city of ten thousand households for his head.

description.zh-cn: 秦舞阳被指定为荆轲的副手，一同前往秦国执行刺杀任务。
description.en: Qin Wuyang was appointed as Jing Ke's deputy to travel to the State of Qin and carry out the assassination mission together.

description.zh-cn: 荆轲与擅长击筑的高渐离在燕国结为知己，经常一同饮酒悲歌。
description.en: Jing Ke and Gao Jianli, who was skilled at playing the zhu, became close friends in the State of Yan, often drinking and singing sorrowful songs together.

description.zh-cn: 荆轲在榆次与盖聂论剑，因话不投机，盖聂怒目而视，二人不欢而散。
description.en: In Yuci, Jing Ke discussed swordsmanship with Gai Nie. Due to a disagreement, Gai Nie stared at him angrily, and they parted on bad terms.

description.zh-cn: 荆轲在邯郸与鲁勾践争道，被其怒斥后默默离开。
description.en: In Handan, Jing Ke had a dispute over the right of way with Lu Goujian, who angrily rebuked him, causing Jing Ke to leave quietly.

description.zh-cn: 荆轲在秦国朝堂上图穷匕见，行刺秦王政，但未能成功。
description.en: In the Qin court, Jing Ke attempted to assassinate King Zheng of Qin when the dagger was revealed from the map scroll, but he failed.

description.zh-cn: 在刺杀失败后，秦王政反击并当场杀死了荆轲。
description.en: After the assassination attempt failed, King Zheng of Qin fought back and killed Jing Ke on the spot.

description.zh-cn: 在荆轲追击秦王时，侍医夏无且用随身的药囊投掷荆轲，延缓其行动，为秦王拔剑反击争取了时间。
description.en: As Jing Ke was chasing the king, the court physician Xia Wuju threw his medicine bag at Jing Ke, slowing him down and buying time for the king to draw his sword and counterattack.

description.zh-cn: 燕太子丹因畏惧秦国将吞并燕国，策划了刺杀秦王政的行动以求自保。
description.en: Fearing that the State of Qin would annex Yan, Crown Prince Dan of Yan planned the assassination of King Zheng of Qin as an act of self-preservation.

description.zh-cn: 秦国在灭韩、攻赵之后，即将攻打燕国，对燕国构成严重军事威胁。
description.en: After conquering Han and attacking Zhao, the State of Qin was poised to attack the State of Yan, posing a serious military threat to it.

description.zh-cn: 荆轲曾游说卫元君，但其主张未被采纳任用。
description.en: Jing Ke once tried to advise Lord Yuan of Wei, but his proposals were not accepted, and he was not employed.

description.zh-cn: 司马迁在《史记·刺客列传》中详细记载了荆轲的事迹，使其形象和故事得以流传后世。
description.en: Sima Qian recorded the deeds of Jing Ke in detail in the 'Biographies of Assassins' chapter of the 'Records of the Grand Historian', allowing his image and story to be passed down through generations.

description.zh-cn: 宋朝的司马光在《资治通鉴》中批评荆轲刺秦是“愚”和“不可谓之义”的行为。
description.en: Sima Guang of the Song dynasty criticized Jing Ke's assassination attempt in his 'Zizhi Tongjian' as 'foolish' and 'not righteous'.

description.zh-cn: 东晋诗人陶渊明创作《咏荆轲》，对荆轲的行为予以赞颂。
description.en: The Eastern Jin poet Tao Yuanming wrote 'Ode to Jing Ke', praising Jing Ke's actions.

description.zh-cn: 唐代诗人骆宾王创作《于易水送人》，诗中“昔时人已没，今日水犹寒”的诗句怀念荆轲。
description.en: The Tang dynasty poet Luo Binwang wrote 'Seeing a Friend Off at the Yi River', in which the lines 'The man of old is gone, today the water is still cold' commemorate Jing Ke.

description.zh-cn: 王翦是秦王政手下攻打赵国等地的主要将领之一。
description.en: Wang Jian was one of the main generals under King Zheng of Qin responsible for attacking states like Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 李信是秦王政手下攻打赵国等地的将领之一。
description.en: Li Xin was one of the generals under King Zheng of Qin who attacked areas such as the state of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 1917年夏，叶剑英进入云南讲武堂学习，并于1920年1月毕业。
description.en: In the summer of 1917, Ye Jianying entered the Yunnan Military Academy to study and graduated in January 1920.

description.zh-cn: 1928年冬，叶剑英赴苏联莫斯科东方大学特别班学习。
description.en: In the winter of 1928, Ye Jianying went to the Soviet Union to study in a special class at the Communist University of the Toilers of the East in Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英早年加入中国国民党，后因通电反蒋，于1927年4月后被蒋介石宣布开除党籍。
description.en: Ye Jianying joined the Kuomintang in his early years but was expelled by Chiang Kai-shek after April 1927 for publicly denouncing him.

description.zh-cn: 1927年7月，经李世安介绍、周恩来同意，叶剑英秘密加入中国共产党。
description.en: In July 1927, introduced by Li Shi'an and with the approval of Zhou Enlai, Ye Jianying secretly joined the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 林彪“九一三事件”后，叶剑英重新以军委副主席身份主持军委日常工作，回归权力核心。
description.en: After the 'September 13 Incident' involving Lin Biao, Ye Jianying returned to the core of power, resuming his role as Vice Chairman of the Military Commission and presiding over its daily work.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英担任第五届全国人大常委会委员长，在废除国家主席时期相当于国家元首。
description.en: Ye Jianying served as the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 5th National People's Congress, equivalent to the head of state during the period when the state presidency was abolished.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英于1975年1月至1978年3月担任中华人民共和国国防部部长。
description.en: Ye Jianying served as the Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China from January 1975 to March 1978.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，叶剑英在广州与曾宪植结婚。
description.en: In 1927, Ye Jianying married Zeng Xianzhi in Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 叶选平是叶剑英的长子。
description.en: Ye Xuanping is the eldest son of Ye Jianying.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁是叶剑英的次子。
description.en: Ye Xuanning is the second son of Ye Jianying.

description.zh-cn: 就读两年后转学。
description.en: Transferred after two years of study.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普赢得选举，当选美国第45任总统。
description.en: Trump won the election, becoming the 45th President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 希拉里·克林顿在总统选举中败选。
description.en: Hillary Clinton lost the presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普在总统选举中败给乔·拜登，连任失利。
description.en: Trump lost the presidential election to Joe Biden, failing to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 乔·拜登赢得选举，当选美国第46任总统。
description.en: Joe Biden won the election, becoming the 46th President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普赢得选举，当选美国第47任总统。
description.en: Trump won the election, becoming the 47th President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 签署行政命令，正式宣布美国退出跨太平洋伙伴关系协议。
description.en: Signed an executive order to formally withdraw the United States from the Trans-Pacific Partnership.

description.zh-cn: 宣布对一系列中国货物征收进口税，开启了中美贸易战。
description.en: Announced tariffs on a range of Chinese goods, initiating the China-U.S. trade war.

description.zh-cn: 因煽动国会山骚乱遭到众议院弹劾，但未被参议院定罪。
description.en: Was impeached by the House of Representatives for incitement of insurrection at the Capitol but was acquitted by the Senate.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普在“封口费”刑事案中被控的34项罪名全部成立，成为美国历史上首位被刑事定罪的前总统。
description.en: Trump was found guilty on all 34 felony charges in the "hush money" criminal case, becoming the first former U.S. president to be convicted of a crime.

description.zh-cn: 被指控煽动其支持者冲击国会大厦，以图推翻2020年总统选举结果。
description.en: Accused of inciting his supporters to storm the Capitol in an attempt to overturn the 2020 presidential election results.

description.zh-cn: 因认定特朗普在国会山骚乱期间煽动暴力，推特宣布永久封禁其个人账号。
description.en: Due to the belief that Trump incited violence during the Capitol riot, Twitter announced a permanent ban on his personal account.

description.zh-cn: 永久封禁了特朗普的个人账号，后于2022年11月由埃隆·马斯克解封。
description.en: Permanently banned Trump's personal account, which was later reinstated by Elon Musk in November 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在国会山骚乱后封禁了特朗普的账号，后于2023年1月解封。
description.en: Banned Trump's account after the Capitol riot, which was reinstated in January 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在国会山骚乱后封禁了特朗普的账号，后于2023年3月解封。
description.en: Banned Trump's account after the Capitol riot, which was reinstated in March 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在国会山骚乱后封禁了特朗普的账号，后于2023年1月解封。
description.en: Banned Trump's account after the Capitol riot, which was reinstated in January 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在美国佛罗里达州的海湖庄园举行为期两天的会晤。
description.en: Held a two-day meeting at the Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida, United States.

description.zh-cn: 特朗普多次表示希望与俄罗斯保持良好关系，普京也曾公开表达对特朗普的支持。
description.en: Trump has repeatedly expressed his desire for a good relationship with Russia, and Putin has publicly expressed support for Trump.

description.zh-cn: 考入国立台湾大学数学系，后肄业。
description.en: Admitted to the Department of Mathematics at National Taiwan University, but did not complete the degree.

description.zh-cn: 1986年在李宗盛推荐下进入滚石唱片担任制作助理，后成为旗下歌手。
description.en: In 1986, under the recommendation of Jonathan Lee, he joined Rock Records as a production assistant and later became a signed artist.

description.zh-cn: 赏识并推荐周华健进入滚石唱片。
description.en: Recognized Wakin Chau's talent and recommended him to join Rock Records.

description.zh-cn: 经由齐豫引荐，周华健结识作曲家陈扬，开始了广告歌曲的演唱生涯。
description.en: Through Chyi Yu's introduction, Wakin Chau met composer Chen Yang and began his career singing for commercials.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，新加坡音乐人黄韵仁加入周华健的制作班底。
description.en: In 2003, Singaporean musician Eric Ng joined Wakin Chau's production team.

description.zh-cn: 周华健就读广悦堂鲁班学校时，曾受其老师苏凌峰教导。
description.en: When Wakin Chau was studying at Kwong Yuet Tong Lo Pan School, he was taught by his teacher So Ling Fung.

description.zh-cn: 两人为新法书院中学同班同学。
description.en: They were classmates at New Method College.

description.zh-cn: 周华健深受许冠杰等70年代粤语歌手影响而迷上音乐。
description.en: Wakin Chau was deeply influenced by 1970s Cantonese singers like Sam Hui, which led to his passion for music.

description.zh-cn: 周华健深受温拿乐队等70年代粤语歌手影响而迷上音乐。
description.en: Wakin Chau was deeply influenced by 1970s Cantonese bands like The Wynners, which led to his passion for music.

description.zh-cn: 周华健深受罗文等70年代粤语歌手影响而迷上音乐。
description.en: Wakin Chau was deeply influenced by 1970s Cantonese singers like Roman Tam, which led to his passion for music.

description.zh-cn: 两人曾多次合作，包括合唱歌曲《别傻了》(2003)，并在央视春晚同台(2019)，任贤齐也曾担任周华健演唱会嘉宾(2016)。
description.en: They have collaborated multiple times, including the duet 'Bie Sha Le' (2003), a joint performance at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala (2019), and Richie Jen being a guest at Wakin Chau's concert (2016).

description.zh-cn: 两人曾多次合作，周华健曾为成龙电影《我是谁》制作并演唱主题曲(1997)，并担任其演唱会嘉宾。
description.en: They have collaborated multiple times. Wakin Chau produced and sang the theme song for Jackie Chan's movie 'Who Am I?' (1997) and has been a guest performer at his concerts.

description.zh-cn: 杨树安是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yang Shu'an is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 杨树安担任中国奥林匹克委员会副主席。
description.en: Yang Shu'an serves as Vice Chairman of the Chinese Olympic Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2015年12月，杨树安被任命为北京2022年冬奥会和冬残奥会组织委员会副主席。
description.en: In December 2015, Yang Shu'an was appointed as Vice Chairman of the Beijing Organising Committee for the 2022 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games.

description.zh-cn: 杨树安曾任北京2008年奥运会组织委员会副主席。
description.en: Yang Shu'an served as Vice Chairman of the Beijing Organising Committee for the Games of the XXIX Olympiad.

description.zh-cn: 杨树安于2008年11月至2017年12月期间担任国家体育总局副局长。自2014年12月起，他还担任国家体育总局党组副书记。
description.en: Yang Shu'an served as Deputy Director of the State General Administration of Sport from November 2008 to December 2017. Since December 2014, he also served as Deputy Party Secretary of the State General Administration of Sport.

description.zh-cn: 2009年至2012年，杨树安当选并担任国际乒联执行副主席。
description.en: From 2009 to 2012, Yang Shu'an was elected and served as the Executive Vice President of the International Table Tennis Federation.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，杨树安当选为第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Yang Shu'an was elected as a representative to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杨树安于2018年当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会教育科学文化卫生委员会副主任委员。
description.en: In 2018, Yang Shu'an was elected as Vice Chairman of the Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，杨树安是西安体育学院的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Yang Shu'an is an alumnus of Xi'an Sport University.

description.zh-cn: 曾天节曾任广东省政协副主席。
description.en: Zeng Tianjie once served as the Vice Chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 曾天节是第五届全国政协委员。
description.en: Zeng Tianjie was a member of the 5th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据其维基百科页面分类，曾天节是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the categories on his Wikipedia page, Zeng Tianjie was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2010年1月12日，Google公司宣布可能退出中国，并于3月23日正式将搜索服务由中国内地转至香港，标志着该事件的发生。
description.en: On January 12, 2010, Google announced its potential withdrawal from China, and on March 23, it officially redirected its search services from mainland China to Hong Kong, marking the event.

description.zh-cn: Google公司内部启动了“蜻蜓计划”，旨在为中国大陆开发一个审查版的搜索引擎，但该计划在内外压力下于同年12月被放弃。
description.en: Google initiated 'Project Dragonfly' internally to develop a censored search engine for mainland China, but the project was abandoned in December of the same year due to internal and external pressure.

description.zh-cn: 因谷歌涉嫌违反《中华人民共和国反垄断法》，国家市场监督管理总局决定对其发起立案调查。
description.en: Due to suspected violations of the Anti-Monopoly Law of the People's Republic of China, the State Administration for Market Regulation decided to launch an investigation into Google.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年NBA选秀期间，迈克尔·乔丹以退役为威胁，阻止了芝加哥公牛队交易斯科蒂·皮蓬以换取选秀权来选中特雷西·麦克格雷迪的计划。
description.en: During the 1997 NBA draft, Michael Jordan threatened to retire, preventing the Chicago Bulls from trading Scottie Pippen for a draft pick to select Tracy McGrady.

description.zh-cn: 1997年，特雷西·麦克格雷迪在NBA选秀中被多伦多猛龙队以第九顺位选中，效力至2000年。
description.en: In 1997, Tracy McGrady was selected by the Toronto Raptors with the ninth pick in the NBA draft and played for the team until 2000.

description.zh-cn: 2000年夏天，特雷西·麦克格雷迪加盟奥兰多魔术队，效力至2004年6月29日被交易。
description.en: In the summer of 2000, Tracy McGrady joined the Orlando Magic and played for them until he was traded on June 29, 2004.

description.zh-cn: 2004年6月29日，特雷西·麦克格雷迪被交易至休斯敦火箭队，效力至2010年2月19日。
description.en: On June 29, 2004, Tracy McGrady was traded to the Houston Rockets, where he played until February 19, 2010.

description.zh-cn: 2010年2月19日，特雷西·麦克格雷迪在一笔三方交易中被交易至纽约尼克斯队。
description.en: On February 19, 2010, Tracy McGrady was traded to the New York Knicks in a three-team deal.

description.zh-cn: 2010年8月10日，特雷西·麦克格雷迪以自由球员身份签约底特律活塞队。
description.en: On August 10, 2010, Tracy McGrady signed with the Detroit Pistons as a free agent.

description.zh-cn: 2011年12月8日，特雷西·麦克格雷迪以自由球员身份签约亚特兰大老鹰队。
description.en: On December 8, 2011, Tracy McGrady signed with the Atlanta Hawks as a free agent.

description.zh-cn: 2012年10月10日，特雷西·麦克格雷迪宣布加盟中国篮球职业联赛球队青岛双星。
description.en: On October 10, 2012, Tracy McGrady announced he was joining the Chinese Basketball Association team Qingdao DoubleStar.

description.zh-cn: 2013年4月16日，特雷西·麦克格雷迪与圣安东尼奥马刺队签约，并随队征战至赛季结束，随后于8月26日宣布从NBA退役。
description.en: On April 16, 2013, Tracy McGrady signed with the San Antonio Spurs and played with the team until the end of the season, subsequently announcing his retirement from the NBA on August 26.

description.zh-cn: 特雷西·麦克格雷迪是文斯·卡特的远房表亲，两人曾在多伦多猛龙队做过队友。
description.en: Tracy McGrady is a distant cousin of Vince Carter, and they were teammates on the Toronto Raptors.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐是时代力量的创始成员之一，并担任首任党主席。
description.en: Freddy Lim is one of the founding members of the New Power Party and served as its first chairman.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐曾任时代力量党主席，于2019年8月1日退党。
description.en: Freddy Lim served as the chairman of the New Power Party and left the party on August 1, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 2023年11月，时任民主进步党主席的赖清德引荐林昶佐加入民进党。2025年，已担任总统的赖清德任命林昶佐为中华民国驻芬兰代表。
description.en: In November 2023, Lai Ching-te, then chairman of the Democratic Progressive Party, recommended Freddy Lim to join the DPP. In 2025, President Lai Ching-te appointed Freddy Lim as the Representative of the Republic of China to Finland.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐于2023年11月27日正式加入民主进步党。
description.en: Freddy Lim officially joined the Democratic Progressive Party on November 27, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐自2025年7月20日起担任中华民国驻芬兰代表。
description.en: Freddy Lim has served as the Representative of the Republic of China to Finland since July 20, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐于2016年至2024年间担任第九、十届中华民国立法委员。
description.en: Freddy Lim served as a member of the 9th and 10th Legislative Yuan of the Republic of China from 2016 to 2024.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年立法委员选举中，林昶佐作为时代力量候选人击败了寻求连任的国民党籍候选人林郁方。
description.en: In the 2016 legislative election, Freddy Lim, as the New Power Party candidate, defeated the incumbent KMT candidate Lin Yu-fang.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐放弃连任后，担任吴沛忆竞选总部的主任委员，帮助其顺利当选，接棒自己的立委席位。
description.en: After giving up his re-election bid, Freddy Lim served as the campaign director for Wu Pei-yi, helping her win the election and succeed his legislative seat.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐与闪灵乐团团长叶湘怡（Doris）为夫妻关系。
description.en: Freddy Lim and Doris Yeh, the leader of the band Chthonic, are married.

description.zh-cn: 何欣纯是林昶佐的表姐。
description.en: Ho Hsin-chun is Freddy Lim's cousin.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐是闪灵乐团的创始团员。
description.en: Freddy Lim is a founding member of the band Chthonic.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐担任闪灵乐团的主唱。
description.en: Freddy Lim is the lead vocalist of the band Chthonic.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐于2010年至2014年间担任国际特赦组织台湾分会会长。
description.en: Freddy Lim served as the President of Amnesty International Taiwan from 2010 to 2014.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐与数位发展部部长唐凤为多年友人。
description.en: Freddy Lim and Minister of Digital Affairs Audrey Tang are long-time friends.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐在任内遭遇罢免案，此案对他构成政治挑战，但最终因同意票数未达门槛而未通过。
description.en: Freddy Lim faced a recall motion during his term, which posed a political challenge, but it ultimately failed to pass as the number of 'yes' votes did not meet the threshold.

description.zh-cn: 林昶佐出生于台北市城中区。
description.en: Freddy Lim was born in Chengzhong District, Taipei City.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，强卫在担任北京市委政法委书记期间，曾主持会议下令终止侦查朱令铊中毒案。
description.en: It was reported that during his tenure as Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Qiang Wei presided over a meeting and ordered the termination of the investigation into the Zhu Ling thallium poisoning case.

description.zh-cn: 2013年3月，强卫接替苏荣担任中共江西省委书记，同年4月接任江西省人大常委会主任。
description.en: In March 2013, Qiang Wei succeeded Su Rong as Party Secretary of Jiangxi, and in April of the same year, he took over as Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2016年6月，鹿心社接替强卫担任中共江西省委书记，次年1月接任江西省人大常委会主任。
description.en: In June 2016, Lu Xinshe succeeded Qiang Wei as Party Secretary of Jiangxi, and in January of the following year, he took over as Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2007年3月，强卫接替赵乐际担任中共青海省委书记，同年6月接任青海省人大常委会主任。
description.en: In March 2007, Qiang Wei succeeded Zhao Leji as Party Secretary of Qinghai, and in June of the same year, he took over as Director of the Standing Committee of the Qinghai Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2013年3月，骆惠宁接替强卫担任中共青海省委书记，同月接任青海省人大常委会主任。
description.en: In March 2013, Luo Huining succeeded Qiang Wei as Party Secretary of Qinghai, and in the same month, he took over as Director of the Standing Committee of the Qinghai Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2005年12月，强卫接替阳安江担任中共北京市纪律检查委员会书记。
