description.en: In December 2005, Qiang Wei succeeded Yang Anjiang as Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 2006年11月，马志鹏接替强卫担任中共北京市纪律检查委员会书记。
description.en: In November 2006, Ma Zhipeng succeeded Qiang Wei as Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 1996年3月，强卫接替汪统担任中共北京市委政法委员会书记。
description.en: In March 1996, Qiang Wei succeeded Wang Tong as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2002年5月，吉林接替强卫担任中共北京市委政法委员会书记；2004年4月，强卫接替吉林担任中共北京市委政法委员会书记。
description.en: In May 2002, Ji Lin succeeded Qiang Wei as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee; in April 2004, Qiang Wei succeeded Ji Lin as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2007年3月，王安顺接替强卫担任中共北京市委政法委员会书记。
description.en: In March 2007, Wang Anshun succeeded Qiang Wei as Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2001年3月，强卫接替龙新民担任中共北京市委专职副书记。此前，在1996年3月，龙新民曾接替强卫担任中共北京市委宣传部部长。
description.en: In March 2001, Qiang Wei succeeded Long Xinmin as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee. Previously, in March 1996, Long Xinmin had succeeded Qiang Wei as Minister of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2007年3月，程世峨接替强卫担任中共北京市委专职副书记。
description.en: In March 2007, Cheng Shie succeeded Qiang Wei as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1994年3月，强卫接替李志坚担任中共北京市委宣传部部长。
description.en: In March 1994, Qiang Wei succeeded Li Zhijian as Minister of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1999年3月，强卫接替张良基担任北京市公安局局长。
description.en: In March 1999, Qiang Wei succeeded Zhang Liangji as Director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 2001年8月，马振川接替强卫担任北京市公安局局长。
description.en: In August 2001, Ma Zhenchuan succeeded Qiang Wei as Director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 成克杰于1984年2月加入中国共产党，2000年4月20日被开除党籍。
description.en: Cheng Kejie joined the Communist Party of China in February 1984 and was expelled on April 20, 2000.

description.zh-cn: 因收受巨额贿赂、非法谋利，成克杰被开除中国共产党党籍。
description.en: Cheng Kejie was expelled from the Communist Party of China for accepting huge bribes and illegal profiteering.

position.zh-cn: 技术员、工程师、总工程师、副局长、局长
position.en: Technician, Engineer, Chief Engineer, Deputy Director, Director

description.zh-cn: 成克杰自1957年起在柳州铁路局（中国铁路南宁局集团前身）工作，历任多个职位，直至1986年升任广西壮族自治区副主席。
description.en: Starting in 1957, Cheng Kejie worked at the Liuzhou Railway Bureau (predecessor of China Railway Nanning Group), holding various positions until he was promoted to Vice Chairman of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in 1986.

description.zh-cn: 成克杰于1986年起担任广西壮族自治区副主席，后升任代主席、主席。
description.en: Cheng Kejie served as Vice Chairman of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region starting in 1986, and was later promoted to Acting Chairman and then Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 成克杰接替韦纯束担任广西壮族自治区人民政府主席职务。
description.en: Cheng Kejie succeeded Wei Chunshu as the Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 李兆焯接替成克杰担任广西壮族自治区人民政府主席职务。
description.en: Li Zhaozhuo succeeded Cheng Kejie as the Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 在第九届全国人大第一次会议上，成克杰当选为全国人民代表大会常务委员会副委员长。
description.en: At the first session of the 9th National People's Congress, Cheng Kejie was elected Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 成克杰担任全国人大常委会副委员长期间，李鹏是委员长。
description.en: While Cheng Kejie served as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Li Peng was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 成克杰自1998年当选全国人大常委会副委员长起，成为党和国家领导人，直至2000年被撤职。
description.en: Cheng Kejie became a Party and state leader after being elected Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress in March 1998, a position he held until his removal in April 2000.

description.zh-cn: 李平是成克杰的情妇，并伙同其收受贿赂款物合计人民币4109万余元。
description.en: Li Ping was Cheng Kejie's mistress and colluded with him to accept bribes totaling more than 41.09 million RMB.

description.zh-cn: 俞芳林在羁押期间向办案人员反映成克杰的腐败问题，直接导致了对成克杰的调查。
description.en: During his detention, Yu Fanglin reported Cheng Kejie's corruption issues to investigators, which directly led to the investigation against Cheng.

description.zh-cn: 根据线索对成克杰的腐败问题进行调查。
description.en: Investigated Cheng Kejie for corruption based on leads.

description.zh-cn: 罢免成克杰的全国人大代表职务。
description.en: Removed Cheng Kejie from his position as a deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 撤销成克杰的全国人大常委会副委员长职务。
description.en: Revoked Cheng Kejie's position as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 决定依法逮捕成克杰。
description.en: Decided to arrest Cheng Kejie in accordance with the law.

description.zh-cn: 以受贿罪一审判处成克杰死刑。
description.en: Sentenced Cheng Kejie to death for bribery in the first instance trial.

description.zh-cn: 裁定核准成克杰死刑，并于9月14日执行。
description.en: Approved the death sentence for Cheng Kejie, which was carried out on September 14.

description.zh-cn: 苏荣于1970年1月加入中国共产党，2015年2月16日被开除党籍。
description.en: Su Rong joined the Communist Party of China in January 1970 and was expelled from the party on February 16, 2015.

description.zh-cn: 在吉林大学经济管理学院国际经济系世界经济专业在职研究生学习，获经济学硕士学位。
description.en: Studied as an on-the-job postgraduate student in the World Economy major of the International Economics Department at the School of Economics and Management, Jilin University, and obtained a Master's degree in Economics.

description.zh-cn: 苏荣担任中共中央党校常务副校长期间，时任校长是曾庆红。
description.en: When Su Rong served as the Executive Vice President of the Central Party School of the CCP, the president was Zeng Qinghong.

description.zh-cn: 程丹峰是苏荣的女婿。
description.en: Cheng Danfeng is Su Rong's son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 宣布对苏荣因涉嫌严重违纪违法问题进行组织调查，并于2015年2月16日决定给予其开除党籍、开除公职处分。
description.en: Announced an organizational investigation into Su Rong for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, and on February 16, 2015, decided to expel him from the party and public office.

description.zh-cn: 依法决定对苏荣以涉嫌受贿罪立案侦查并采取强制措施。
description.en: Decided to file a case for investigation and take coercive measures against Su Rong on suspicion of bribery in accordance with the law.

description.zh-cn: 一审公开宣判，对苏荣以受贿罪、滥用职权罪、巨额财产来源不明罪判处无期徒刑。
description.en: In the first-instance public sentencing, Su Rong was sentenced to life imprisonment for bribery, abuse of power, and possessing a huge amount of property from unknown sources.

description.zh-cn: 苏荣的落马被外界视为周永康案的一部分。
description.en: Su Rong's downfall was seen by outsiders as part of the Zhou Yongkang case.

description.zh-cn: 被记者徐祥指与吴官正、汪德和是利益共同体，存在钱权交易等问题。
description.en: Accused by journalist Xu Xiang of forming a community of interests with Wu Guanzheng and Wang Dehe, involved in issues such as money-for-power transactions.

description.zh-cn: 张红兵是湖北咸宁人。
description.en: Zhang Hongbing is a native of Xianning, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 张红兵是中国共产党第二十届中央委员。
description.en: Zhang Hongbing is a member of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张红兵被广泛认为是习近平派系闽江新军的成员之一。
description.en: Zhang Hongbing is widely considered to be a member of the Xi Jinping faction's Minjiang New Army.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，张红兵接替薛君出任陆军第二十集团军政治部主任。
description.en: In 2014, Zhang Hongbing succeeded Xue Jun as Director of the Political Department of the 20th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，张红兵接替薛君出任陆军第二十集团军政治部主任。
description.en: In 2014, Zhang Hongbing succeeded Xue Jun as Director of the Political Department of the 20th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2022年1月，张红兵接替安兆庆出任中国人民武装警察部队政治委员。
description.en: In January 2022, Zhang Hongbing succeeded An Zhaoqing as the Political Commissar of the People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 2019年12月，张红兵接替廖可铎出任中国人民解放军东部战区陆军政治委员。
description.en: In December 2019, Zhang Hongbing succeeded Liao Keduo as the Political Commissar of the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 2022年1月，唐兴华接替张红兵出任中国人民解放军东部战区陆军政治委员。
description.en: In January 2022, Tang Xinghua succeeded Zhang Hongbing as the Political Commissar of the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 2019年12月，袁红刚接替张红兵出任中国人民解放军陆军第七十六集团军政治委员。
description.en: In December 2019, Yuan Honggang succeeded Zhang Hongbing as the Political Commissar of the 76th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2000年，根据中共十五届四中全会决议和修改后的《中华人民共和国公司法》，国务院通过了《国有企业监事会暂行条例》，决定向国有重点大型企业派出国有重点大型企业监事会。
description.en: In 2000, based on the resolution of the Fourth Plenary Session of the 15th CPC Central Committee and the revised Company Law of the PRC, the State Council passed the Interim Regulations on the Board of Supervisors of State-owned Enterprises and decided to dispatch the Supervisory Board for Key State-owned Large Enterprises to key state-owned large enterprises.

position.en: Dispatched agency of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 国有重点大型企业监事会是中华人民共和国国务院的派出机构。
description.en: The Supervisory Board for Key State-owned Large Enterprises was a dispatched agency of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2003年国务院国资委组建后，国有重点大型企业监事会工作交由国务院国资委负责，纳入其监管体系。
description.en: After the establishment of SASAC in 2003, the work of the Supervisory Board for Key State-owned Large Enterprises was managed by SASAC and incorporated into its regulatory system.

description.zh-cn: 该方案规定不再设立国有重点大型企业监事会。
description.en: The plan stipulated that the Supervisory Board for Key State-owned Large Enterprises would no longer be established.

description.zh-cn: 国有重点大型企业监事会的职责划入审计署。
description.en: The responsibilities of the Supervisory Board for Key State-owned Large Enterprises were transferred to the National Audit Office.

description.zh-cn: 国有重点大型企业监事会的行政级别为副部级。
description.en: The administrative level of the Supervisory Board for Key State-owned Large Enterprises was vice-ministerial level.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰亲欧盟示威运动导致亲俄总统亚努科维奇下台，其政局动荡为俄罗斯介入并吞并克里米亚创造了条件，成为引发克里米亚危机的直接诱因。
description.en: The Euromaidan movement led to the ousting of pro-Russian President Yanukovych. This political instability created conditions for Russia's intervention and annexation of Crimea, becoming a direct trigger for the Crimean crisis.

description.zh-cn: 无标识的俄罗斯部队迅速占领了克里米亚的各个战略要点，为后续的公投和吞并铺平了道路。
description.en: Unmarked Russian forces quickly occupied various strategic points in Crimea, paving the way for the subsequent referendum and annexation.

description.zh-cn: 公投结果被俄罗斯作为其吞并克里米亚的法律和民意基础。
description.en: The results of the referendum were used by Russia as the legal and popular basis for its annexation of Crimea.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄罗斯总统，普京批准并签署了接纳克里米亚共和国加入俄罗斯的条约，完成了吞并的法律程序。
description.en: As President of Russia, Putin approved and signed the treaty to admit the Republic of Crimea into Russia, completing the legal process of annexation.

description.zh-cn: 该决议申明2014年克里米亚公投无效，并呼吁各国不承认因该公投而导致的克里米亚地位改变。
description.en: The resolution affirmed the invalidity of the 2014 Crimean referendum and called on all states not to recognize any alteration of the status of Crimea on the basis of the referendum.

description.zh-cn: 七国集团发表声明，称克里米亚公投没有“法律效力”，将不承认公决结果。
description.en: The G7 issued a statement declaring that the Crimean referendum had no 'legal effect' and that they would not recognize its results.

description.zh-cn: 塞瓦斯托波尔作为联邦直辖市加入了俄罗斯联邦。
description.en: Sevastopol joined the Russian Federation as a federal city.

description.zh-cn: 塞瓦斯托波尔是克里米亚联邦管区内的两个联邦主体之一。
description.en: Sevastopol was one of the two federal subjects within the Crimean Federal District.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯黑海舰队凿沉一艘反潜舰以封锁克里米亚港口的乌克兰舰队。
description.en: The Russian Black Sea Fleet scuttled an anti-submarine ship to blockade the Ukrainian fleet in Crimean ports.

description.zh-cn: 从1945年到1954年，克里米亚州是俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国的一部分。
description.en: From 1945 to 1954, the Crimean Oblast was part of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic.

description.zh-cn: 自1954年起，克里米亚州被划入乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国管辖。
description.en: From 1954, the Crimean Oblast was transferred to the jurisdiction of the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic.

description.zh-cn: 主导了1954年将克里米亚州从俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国划归乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国的决议。
description.en: Led the 1954 decision to transfer the Crimean Oblast from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic to the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic.

description.zh-cn: 苏联解体后，克里米亚成为乌克兰的一个自治共和国。
description.en: After the dissolution of the Soviet Union, Crimea became an autonomous republic within Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 从1478年到1700年，克里米亚汗国是奥斯曼帝国的一个附庸国。
description.en: From 1478 to 1700, the Crimean Khanate was a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国于1783年正式将整个克里米亚半岛纳入版图，终结了克里米亚汗国的统治。
description.en: The Russian Empire formally annexed the entire Crimean Peninsula in 1783, ending the rule of the Crimean Khanate.

description.zh-cn: 在1854年至1856年的克里米亚战争中，俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国（及其盟友）是敌对关系。
description.en: In the Crimean War from 1854 to 1856, the Russian Empire was an enemy of the Ottoman Empire (and its allies).

description.zh-cn: 德国发动的克里米亚行动攻占了克里米亚全境，推翻了塔夫里苏维埃政权。
description.en: The German-launched Crimean Operation captured the entire territory of Crimea, overthrowing the Taurida Soviet regime.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国为占领克里米亚而发动了克里米亚行动。
description.en: The German Empire launched the Crimean Operation to occupy Crimea.

description.zh-cn: 伊力哈木·土赫提于1969年10月25日出生于新疆阿图什市。
description.en: Ilham Tohti was born in Artux, Xinjiang on October 25, 1969.

description.zh-cn: 伊力哈木·土赫提毕业于东北师范大学本科。
description.en: Ilham Tohti graduated with a bachelor's degree from Northeast Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 伊力哈木·土赫提毕业于中央民族大学经济学院研究生院。
description.en: Ilham Tohti completed his graduate studies at the School of Economics, Minzu University of China.

description.zh-cn: 伊力哈木·土赫提曾在中央民族大学担任国际结算专业的副教授，直至2014年被捕。
description.en: Ilham Tohti worked as an associate professor in international settlement at Minzu University of China until his arrest in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 伊力哈木·土赫提于2006年创办了“维吾尔在线”网站，并担任站长。
description.en: Ilham Tohti founded the website 'Uighurbiz' in 2006 and served as its webmaster.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府指控伊力哈木·土赫提从事分裂活动，并于2014年将其逮捕，后判处无期徒刑。
description.en: The Chinese government accused Ilham Tohti of engaging in separatist activities, arrested him in 2014, and later sentenced him to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府曾多次关闭由伊力哈木·土赫提创办的维吾尔在线网站。
description.en: The Chinese government repeatedly shut down the Uighurbiz website founded by Ilham Tohti.

description.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区高级人民法院于2014年11月21日二审裁定，驳回伊力哈木·土赫提的上诉，维持原判。
description.en: On November 21, 2014, the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region Higher People's Court rejected Ilham Tohti's appeal in the second instance and upheld the original verdict.

description.zh-cn: 在2009年3月的一次访问中，伊力哈木·土赫提批评时任新疆维吾尔自治区主席努尔·白克力“无能”。
description.en: In an interview in March 2009, Ilham Tohti criticized Nur Bekri, then Chairman of Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, as 'incompetent'.

description.zh-cn: 乌鲁木齐七·五事件后，时任新疆主席努尔·白克力宣称维吾尔在线网站“大肆进行煽动宣传，传播谣言”。
description.en: After the July 5 Ürümqi riots, then-Xinjiang Chairman Nur Bekri claimed that the Uighurbiz website 'engaged in extensive incitement and rumor-mongering'.

description.zh-cn: 2009年7月伊力哈木·土赫提被捕后，作家王力雄发起了《关于维吾尔学者伊力哈木·土赫提遭拘押的呼吁》以示支持。他还评论称中国政府制造了一位“维吾尔的曼德拉”。
description.en: After Ilham Tohti's arrest in July 2009, writer Wang Lixiong initiated an appeal for his release to show support. He also commented that the Chinese government had created a 'Uyghur Mandela'.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月，欧洲议会将萨哈罗夫奖授予伊力哈木·土赫提，以表彰他的人权工作。
description.en: In October 2019, the European Parliament awarded the Sakharov Prize to Ilham Tohti in recognition of his human rights work.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月1日，美国笔会宣布将2014年度芭芭拉·戈德史密斯自由写作奖授予伊力哈木·土赫提。
description.en: On April 1, 2014, PEN America announced that it awarded the 2014 PEN/Barbara Goldsmith Freedom to Write Award to Ilham Tohti.

description.zh-cn: 国际特赦组织认为伊力哈木·土赫提是“良心犯”，并要求中国当局立即无条件释放他。
description.en: Amnesty International considers Ilham Tohti a 'prisoner of conscience' and has called for his immediate and unconditional release by the Chinese authorities.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府对伊力哈木·土赫提案表达严重关切，并呼吁中国释放他。
description.en: The United States government expressed serious concern over Ilham Tohti's case and called for his release.

description.zh-cn: 2014年8月6日，欧盟发表声明关注伊力哈木·土赫提案，并敦促中国立即释放他。
description.en: On August 6, 2014, the European Union issued a statement expressing concern over Ilham Tohti's case and urged China to release him immediately.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿约翰·克里发表声明，称对伊力哈木的判决似乎是报复行为，并敦促中国释放他。
description.en: Then-U.S. Secretary of State John Kerry issued a statement saying the sentence against Ilham Tohti appeared to be in retaliation and urged China to release him.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府指控伊力哈木·土赫提利用互联网和讲堂鼓吹“新疆独立”，从事分裂活动。伊力哈木本人否认此指控，称自己主张“高度自治”。
description.en: The Chinese government accused Ilham Tohti of using the internet and his lectures to advocate for 'Xinjiang independence' and engage in separatist activities. Tohti himself denied these charges, stating he advocated for 'high-degree autonomy'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党领导中华人民共和国，意图将台湾纳入统治范围，以完成其政治目标。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party leads the People's Republic of China with the intention of bringing Taiwan under its rule to achieve its political goals.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国意图将台湾纳入其统治范围，以完成其解决台湾问题和统一中国的政治目标。
description.en: The People's Republic of China intends to bring Taiwan under its rule to complete its political objectives of resolving the Taiwan issue and unifying China.

description.zh-cn: 解放台湾被视为完成“统一中国”政治目标的一部分。
description.en: The Liberation of Taiwan is seen as part of achieving the political goal of 'unifying China'.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军是执行武力解放台湾任务的军事力量。
description.en: The People's Liberation Army is the military force tasked with carrying out the armed liberation of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 渡江战役标志着中华民国国军在内战中的溃败。
description.en: The Yangtze River Crossing Campaign marked the defeat of the Republic of China Armed Forces in the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 1950年朝鲜战争爆发，导致解放军原定的登陆台湾行动被搁置。
description.en: The outbreak of the Korean War in 1950 caused the PLA's planned landing operation in Taiwan to be postponed.

description.zh-cn: 1956年，中共中央主席毛泽东首次提出“和平解放台湾”的方针。
description.en: In 1956, CCP Central Committee Chairman Mao Zedong first proposed the policy of 'Peaceful Liberation of Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 1979年1月，中华人民共和国国防部宣布金门炮战正式结束。
description.en: In January 1979, the Ministry of National Defense of the People's Republic of China announced the official end of the Kinmen Artillery Battle.

description.zh-cn: 《告台湾同胞书》将中国的统一设定为重大任务，并将对台政策转为“和平统一”。
description.en: The 'Message to Compatriots in Taiwan' defined China's unification as a major task and shifted the policy towards Taiwan to 'peaceful unification'.

description.zh-cn: 1979年1月，邓小平在美国访问时表示不再使用“解放台湾”这个提法，体现了对台政策的转变。
description.en: In January 1979, during his visit to the United States, Deng Xiaoping stated that the term 'liberate Taiwan' would no longer be used, reflecting a shift in policy towards Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 2019年，中共中央总书记习近平依据“和平统一、一国两制”，对台湾方面提出“一国两制台湾方案”。
description.en: In 2019, CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping proposed the 'One Country, Two Systems Taiwan Plan' to Taiwan based on the principles of 'peaceful unification' and 'one country, two systems'.

description.zh-cn: 2016年民进党二度执政后，否认了马英九政府时代的“九二共识”两岸官方交流方针。
description.en: After the Democratic Progressive Party came to power for the second time in 2016, it denied the '1992 Consensus' that served as the basis for official cross-strait exchanges during the Ma Ying-jeou administration.

description.zh-cn: 2021年，蔡英文政府明确拒绝中国大陆提出的“一国两制台湾方案”。
description.en: In 2021, the Tsai Ing-wen administration explicitly rejected the 'One Country, Two Systems Taiwan Plan' proposed by mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年12月，美国政府与中华民国政府签订《中美共同防御条约》以协防台湾。
description.en: In December 1954, the U.S. Government signed the Sino-American Mutual Defense Treaty with the Government of the Republic of China to jointly defend Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉在访问康奈尔大学时，提出了“中华民国在台湾”的国家定位。
description.en: During his visit to Cornell University, Lee Teng-hui proposed the national positioning of the 'Republic of China on Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉是美国康乃尔大学的校友，并于1995年重访母校。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui is an alumnus of Cornell University and revisited his alma mater in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 为回应李登辉访美，中国人民解放军向台湾外海试射导弹并举行军事演习，引发了台湾海峡导弹危机。
description.en: In response to Lee Teng-hui's visit to the US, the People's Liberation Army test-fired missiles into the waters off Taiwan and held military exercises, triggering the Taiwan Strait Missile Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾海峡导弹危机期间，解放军的“联合九六一”演习计划被刘连昆泄露给中华民国政府，阻碍了其军事企图。
description.en: During the Taiwan Strait Missile Crisis, the PLA's 'Joint 961' exercise plan was leaked by Liu Liankun to the ROC government, thwarting its military intentions.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾海峡导弹危机期间，美国紧急调动两个航空母舰战斗群靠近台海，阻止了中国的武力攻台企图。
description.en: During the Taiwan Strait Missile Crisis, the United States urgently deployed two aircraft carrier battle groups near the Taiwan Strait, preventing China's attempt to attack Taiwan by force.

description.zh-cn: 该法为中华人民共和国以武力统一台湾提供了法理依据。
description.en: This law provides a legal basis for the People's Republic of China to unify Taiwan by force.

description.zh-cn: 美国中情局局长伯恩斯表示，根据情报，习近平已命令其军队准备在2027年之前武统台湾。
description.en: CIA Director Burns stated that according to intelligence, Xi Jinping has ordered his military to be ready to unify Taiwan by force by 2027.

description.zh-cn: 2023年4月，习近平与欧洲联盟执行委员会主席范德赖恩会面。
description.en: In April 2023, Xi Jinping met with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen.

description.zh-cn: 时任日本防卫副大臣中山泰秀质疑了多国政府自1970年代开始奉行的“一个中国”政策。
description.en: Then-State Minister of Defense of Japan Yasuhide Nakayama questioned the 'One China' policy that many governments have followed since the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 罗援撰文指出，台湾方面如不接受一国两制，可武力统一或和平统一后，实行“一国一制”。
description.en: Luo Yuan wrote that if Taiwan does not accept 'one country, two systems', 'one country, one system' could be implemented after either armed or peaceful unification.

description.zh-cn: 前日本首相安倍晋三于2021年提出了“台湾有事就是日本有事”的论述。
description.en: Former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe proposed the discourse 'A Taiwan contingency is a Japan contingency' in 2021.

description.zh-cn: 鲁涤平在辛亥革命时参与了后续各省的独立起义运动。
description.en: During the Xinhai Revolution, Lu Diping participated in the subsequent independence and uprising movements in various provinces.

description.zh-cn: 在1921年的湘鄂战争中，鲁涤平在赵恒惕的指挥下参战。
description.en: In the Hunan-Hubei War of 1921, Lu Diping fought under the command of Zhao Hengti.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，鲁涤平跟随谭延闿离开湖南，加入孙中山麾下。
description.en: In 1923, Lu Diping followed Tan Yankai, left Hunan, and joined Sun Yat-sen's command.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，鲁涤平率领部分部队到广东加入孙中山麾下。
description.en: In 1923, Lu Diping led some of his troops to Guangdong to join Sun Yat-sen's command.

description.zh-cn: 在国民党北伐中担任第二军军长代理兼右翼指挥官，后升任军长。
description.en: During the Northern Expedition, he served as the acting commander of the Second Army and commander of the right wing, and was later promoted to full commander.

description.zh-cn: 鲁涤平曾任第四集团军第一军团总指挥，隶属于第四集团军总指挥李宗仁。
description.en: Lu Diping served as the commander of the First Army Corps of the Fourth Army Group, subordinate to Li Zongren, the commander-in-chief of the Fourth Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，鲁涤平在担任湘鄂“会剿”总指挥时，将前线作战交由何键指挥。
description.en: In 1928, when Lu Diping was the commander-in-chief of the Hunan-Hubei "Encirclement and Suppression" headquarters, he delegated frontline combat command to He Jian.

description.zh-cn: 何键教唆新桂系处理鲁涤平，并最终夺得其湖南省主席职位，成为其政治对手。
description.en: He Jian instigated the New Guangxi clique to deal with Lu Diping and eventually seized his position as Chairman of Hunan, becoming his political rival.

description.zh-cn: 新桂系通过其控制的国民党武汉政治分会名义上免去了鲁涤平的职务，制造了鲁案。
description.en: The New Guangxi clique initiated the Lu Diping Incident by nominally dismissing him through the KMT's Wuhan Political Council, which they controlled.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗铎假借国民党武汉政治分会名义，主导了免去鲁涤平职务的行动。
description.en: Hu Zongduo, under the pretext of the KMT's Wuhan Political Council, led the action to dismiss Lu Diping.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁案中，鲁涤平被免去湖南省主席职务，其部队被缴械。
description.en: In the Lu Diping Incident, Lu was dismissed from his position as Chairman of Hunan and his troops were disarmed.

description.zh-cn: 鲁案的仲裁最终诱发了新桂系与蒋介石之间的蒋桂战争。
description.en: The arbitration of the Lu Diping Incident ultimately triggered the Chiang-Gui War between the New Guangxi clique and Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 张辉瓒时任国民革命军第18师师长，是鲁涤平担任第九路军总指挥时的下属。
description.en: Zhang Huizan, then commander of the 18th Division of the National Revolutionary Army, was a subordinate of Lu Diping when Lu was commander of the Ninth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 谭道源时任国民革命军第50师师长，是鲁涤平担任第九路军总指挥时的下属。
description.en: Tan Daoyuan, then commander of the 50th Division of the National Revolutionary Army, was a subordinate of Lu Diping when Lu was commander of the Ninth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 鲁涤平担任第一次江西剿共战争的主力指挥官。
description.en: Lu Diping served as the main commander of the First Jiangxi Encirclement Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次江西剿共战争中，毛泽东运用“诱敌深入”的游击战略击败了鲁涤平指挥的部队。
description.en: In the First Jiangxi Encirclement Campaign, Mao Zedong used the guerrilla strategy of "luring the enemy in deep" to defeat the troops commanded by Lu Diping.

description.zh-cn: 由于在第一次江西剿共战争中惨败，鲁涤平被撤销了南昌行营主任、第九路军总指挥等职务。
description.en: Due to the disastrous defeat in the First Jiangxi Encirclement Campaign, Lu Diping was removed from his posts, including Director of the Nanchang Field Headquarters and Commander-in-Chief of the Ninth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：鲁涤平接替张难先担任浙江省政府主席。
description.en: Succession of office: Lu Diping succeeded Zhang Nanxian as the Chairman of Zhejiang Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：鲁涤平接替朱培德担任江西省政府主席。
description.en: Succession of office: Lu Diping succeeded Zhu Peide as the Chairman of Jiangxi Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：熊式辉接替鲁涤平担任江西省政府主席。
description.en: Succession of office: Xiong Shihui succeeded Lu Diping as the Chairman of Jiangxi Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：鲁涤平接替唐生智担任湖南省政府主席。
description.en: Succession of office: Lu Diping succeeded Tang Shengzhi as the Chairman of Hunan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：何键接替鲁涤平担任湖南省政府主席。
description.en: Succession of office: He Jian succeeded Lu Diping as the Chairman of Hunan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府方面调集军队包围南昌并追击起义部队，最终导致起义在军事上失败。
description.en: The Nationalist Government mobilized troops to surround Nanchang and pursue the insurgent forces, ultimately leading to the military failure of the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来在会议上坚决反对张国焘停止起义的主张，通过激烈争论迫使张国焘服从多数，确保了起义按计划进行。
description.en: Zhou Enlai resolutely opposed Zhang Guotao's proposal to halt the uprising in a meeting, forcing Zhang to submit to the majority through heated debate and ensuring the uprising proceeded as planned.

description.zh-cn: 武汉国民政府在七一五事变中决定“和平分共”，正式与中国共产党分裂，结束了其“容共”政策。
description.en: The Wuhan Nationalist Government decided on a "peaceful split with the Communists" during the July 15 Incident, formally breaking with the Chinese Communist Party and ending its policy of tolerating Communists.

description.zh-cn: 起义当天，在南昌成立了中国国民党革命委员会，作为起义后建立的新政权机构。
description.en: On the day of the uprising, the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang was established in Nanchang as the new political authority.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东与朱德会师后，两支部队合编为中国工农红军第四军，毛泽东任党代表。
description.en: After Mao Zedong joined forces with Zhu De, their two units merged to form the Fourth Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army, with Mao as the Party Representative.

description.zh-cn: 在起义部队南下广东途中，时任第十师师长的蔡廷锴率部脱离起义队伍，削弱了起义军的力量。
description.en: During the insurgent forces' march south to Guangdong, Cai Tingkai, then commander of the 10th Division, led his troops to desert the uprising, weakening the strength of the insurgent army.

description.zh-cn: 钱大钧率领的国民政府部队在会昌等地追击和阻击南昌起义部队，给起义军造成重大损失。
description.en: The Nationalist government forces led by Qian Dajun pursued and intercepted the Nanchang Uprising troops in areas like Huichang, inflicting heavy losses on the insurgent army.

description.zh-cn: 黄绍竑率部在潮汕地区对南下的起义军进行围剿，突袭潮州，是导致起义最终失败的关键军事行动之一。
description.en: Huang Shaohong led his troops to encircle and suppress the southward-marching insurgent forces in the Chaoshan area, launching a surprise attack on Chaozhou, which was one of the key military actions leading to the final failure of the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 陈济棠指挥的粤军在粤东地区与南下的起义军交战，对起义军造成了阻碍和打击。
description.en: The Cantonese army commanded by Chen Jitang engaged the southward-marching insurgent forces in eastern Guangdong, obstructing and attacking them.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，深圳发展银行吸收平安银行并更名为平安银行股份有限公司，完成了两行合并。
description.en: In 2012, Shenzhen Development Bank absorbed Ping An Bank and was renamed Ping An Bank Co., Ltd., completing the merger of the two banks.

description.zh-cn: 李安泽与时任江西省委书记的苏荣关系密切。
description.en: Li Anze had a close relationship with Su Rong, who was then the Party Secretary of Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 张杰是安徽阜南人。
description.en: Zhang Jie is from Funan, Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 张杰是中共党员。
description.en: Zhang Jie is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张杰是安徽师范大学的校友。
description.en: Zhang Jie is an alumnus of Anhui Normal University.

position.zh-cn: 副秘书长、省委督查室主任
position.en: Deputy Secretary-General, Director of the Provincial Party Committee's Supervision Office

description.zh-cn: 张杰曾任安徽省委副秘书长、省委督查室主任。
description.en: Zhang Jie served as Deputy Secretary-General of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee and Director of the Provincial Party Committee's Supervision Office.

description.zh-cn: 张杰曾任安徽省政府副秘书长。
description.en: Zhang Jie served as Deputy Secretary-General of the Anhui Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 张杰曾任安徽省政协常委。
description.en: Zhang Jie served as a Standing Committee Member of the Anhui Provincial Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦于1933年成为中国共产党正式党员，直至去世。
description.en: Hu Yaobang became a full member of the Chinese Communist Party in 1933 and remained a member until his death.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦是邓小平的亲密盟友和门生，两人的关系始于1930年代。
description.en: Hu Yaobang was a close ally and protégé of Deng Xiaoping, with their relationship dating back to the 1930s.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平策划了胡耀邦的权力崛起，使其成为中国共产党的最高领导人之一。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping engineered Hu Yaobang's rise to power, positioning him as one of the top leaders of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在文化大革命期间清洗了胡耀邦。
description.en: Mao Zedong purged Hu Yaobang during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦的政治和经济改革使他成为多位反对自由市场和政府改革的党内元老的敌人。
description.en: Hu Yaobang's political and economic reforms made him the enemy of several powerful Party elders who opposed free-market and government reforms.

description.zh-cn: 在长征开始前，地方共产党指挥官谭余保在最后一刻介入，将胡耀邦从死刑中救下。
description.en: Before the Long March began, local communist commander Tan Yubao intervened at the last minute, saving Hu Yaobang from a death sentence.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦出生于中国湖南省浏阳县。
description.en: Hu Yaobang was born in Liuyang county, Hunan province, China.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于2005年宣布为胡耀邦平反，并举办了纪念活动，正式恢复了其声誉。
description.en: In 2005, Hu Jintao announced plans to rehabilitate Hu Yaobang, organizing commemorative events and officially restoring his image.

description.zh-cn: 昌平君是秦昭襄王的外孙。
description.en: Lord Changping was the maternal grandson of King Zhaoxiang of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 与魏冉合谋，将当时在燕国为质的公子稷迎立为秦王。
description.en: Conspired with Wei Ran to install Prince Ji, who was a hostage in the State of Yan, as the King of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 在秦武王死后诸公子争位时，支持并成功拥立异母弟公子稷为王。
description.en: After the death of King Wu of Qin, during the succession struggle among the princes, he supported and successfully enthroned his half-brother Prince Ji.

description.zh-cn: 因秦昭襄王年幼即位，宣太后以太后之位代为摄政，掌握实权。
description.en: As King Zhaoxiang ascended the throne at a young age, Queen Dowager Xuan acted as regent and held the actual power.

description.zh-cn: 在秦昭襄王继位初期协助处理政务，后因遭排挤出奔齐国。
description.en: Assisted in managing state affairs during the early reign of King Zhaoxiang but later fled to the State of Qi due to political ostracism.

description.zh-cn: 镇压了公子壮发动的叛乱。
description.en: Suppressed the rebellion launched by Prince Zhuang.

description.zh-cn: 将会盟的楚怀王扣留软禁，并逼迫其割地，楚怀王拒绝后被长期囚禁直至去世。
description.en: Detained and placed King Huai of Chu under house arrest during a meeting, attempting to force him to cede territory. After King Huai's refusal, he was imprisoned until his death.

description.zh-cn: 奉秦昭襄王之命，平定了蜀侯公子恽的叛乱。
description.en: Under the order of King Zhaoxiang of Qin, he suppressed the rebellion of Prince Yun, the Marquis of Shu.

description.zh-cn: 因听信谗言，将孟尝君囚禁并准备杀害他。
description.en: Heeding slanderous advice, he imprisoned Lord Mengchang and intended to execute him.

description.zh-cn: 齐、韩、魏联军在此次战役中击败了秦军。
description.en: The allied forces of Qi, Han, and Wei defeated the Qin army in this battle.

description.zh-cn: 逃回齐国成为宰相后，联合韩国、魏国发动了对秦国的战争。
description.en: After escaping back to Qi and becoming its chancellor, he formed an alliance with Han and Wei to launch a war against Qin.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝了秦昭襄王互尊为帝的提议，并联合六国诸侯合纵攻打秦国。
description.en: Rejected King Zhaoxiang's proposal for mutual recognition as emperors and organized a vertical alliance of six states to attack Qin.

description.zh-cn: 在秦昭襄王试图以十五座城池为诱饵骗取和氏璧时，蔺相如凭借智谋和勇气，成功将璧玉完整带回赵国。
description.en: When King Zhaoxiang of Qin attempted to deceitfully acquire the He Shi Bi jade by offering fifteen cities, Lin Xiangru, with his wisdom and courage, successfully brought the jade back to Zhao intact.

description.zh-cn: 采纳范雎的建议，废除宣太后的权力，让她退居后宫。
description.en: Adopting Fan Ju's advice, he stripped Queen Dowager Xuan of her power and had her retire to the inner palace.

description.zh-cn: 采纳范雎的建议，罢免了魏冉的相邦职务，并将其逐出咸阳。
description.en: Adopting Fan Ju's advice, he dismissed Wei Ran from his position as chancellor and expelled him from Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 作为秦军主将，秘密替换王龁指挥作战，并最终取得决定性胜利。
description.en: As the commander of the Qin army, he secretly replaced Wang He to direct the battle and ultimately achieved a decisive victory.

description.zh-cn: 长平之战后，认为秦军应休养生息，劝说秦昭襄王与赵国议和，阻止了白起乘胜灭赵的计划。
description.en: After the Battle of Changping, believing the Qin army needed rest, he persuaded King Zhaoxiang to make peace with Zhao, thus thwarting Bai Qi's plan to annihilate Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 因白起不肯领命出征，加上范雎的进言，秦昭襄王派使者赐剑命白起自刎。
description.en: Due to Bai Qi's refusal to lead a campaign and influenced by Fan Ju's words, King Zhaoxiang sent an envoy with a sword, ordering Bai Qi to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 秦国攻打并灭亡了东周王室。
description.en: The State of Qin attacked and annihilated the Eastern Zhou royal house.

description.zh-cn: 秦国灭亡了西周公国。
description.en: The State of Qin annexed the statelet of Western Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王数十年的统治，通过治军备战和富国强兵，为其曾孙秦始皇最终统一天下奠定了基础。
description.en: King Zhaoxiang's decades-long reign, through military preparation and strengthening the state, laid the foundation for his great-grandson Qin Shi Huang to eventually unify China.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王时期的持续扩张和国力增强，为后来的秦灭六国之战创造了先决条件。
description.en: The continuous expansion and strengthening of national power during King Zhaoxiang's reign created the preconditions for the subsequent Qin's wars of unification.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦是叶惠美的儿子。
description.en: Jay Chou is the son of Ye Huimei.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦高中就读于淡江中学音乐科，主修钢琴。
description.en: Jay Chou attended Tamkang High School as a music major, focusing on piano.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦出生于台湾台北县林口乡（现新北市林口区）。
description.en: Jay Chou was born in Linkou Township, Taipei County, Taiwan (now Linkou District, New Taipei City).

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦曾表示，张学友的专辑《吻别》影响了他，使他开始喜欢并专注于流行音乐。
description.en: Jay Chou stated that Jacky Cheung's album 'The Goodbye Kiss' influenced him to start liking and focusing on pop music.

description.zh-cn: 吴宗宪在选秀节目中发现了周杰伦的才华，并与其签约，发掘他进入乐坛。
description.en: Jacky Wu discovered Jay Chou's talent at a talent show, signed him, and launched his career in the music industry.

description.zh-cn: 时任阿尔发音乐总监的杨峻荣在听到周杰伦的作品后大为赞赏，并积极帮助他推出了首张个人专辑。
description.en: As the general manager of Alfa Music, Yang Jun-rong greatly admired Jay Chou's work after hearing it and actively helped him release his debut solo album.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦出道初期签约于吴宗宪的阿尔发音乐公司，直到2007年成立自己的公司杰威尔音乐。
description.en: Jay Chou was signed to Jacky Wu's Alfa Music in his early career until he founded his own company, JVR Music, in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦创作了歌曲《落雨声》，这是他第一首卖出的歌曲。
description.en: Jay Chou composed the song 'Sound of Falling Rain', which was the first song he sold.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦与方文山、杨峻荣于2007年4月共同创办了杰威尔音乐有限公司。
description.en: Jay Chou, along with Vincent Fang and Yang Jun-rong, co-founded JVR Music Ltd. in April 2007.

description.zh-cn: 方文山与周杰伦、杨峻荣于2007年4月共同创办了杰威尔音乐有限公司。
description.en: Vincent Fang, along with Jay Chou and Yang Jun-rong, co-founded JVR Music Ltd. in April 2007.

description.zh-cn: 杨峻荣与周杰伦、方文山于2007年4月共同创办了杰威尔音乐有限公司。
description.en: Yang Jun-rong, along with Jay Chou and Vincent Fang, co-founded JVR Music Ltd. in April 2007.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦邀请费玉清在歌曲《千里之外》中合唱。
description.en: Jay Chou invited Fei Yu-ching to feature on the song 'Faraway'.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦与五月天主唱阿信（陈信宏）合作演唱了单曲《说好不哭》。
description.en: Jay Chou collaborated with Mayday's lead singer Ashin (Chen Shin-hung) on the single 'Won't Cry'.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦与派伟俊合作歌曲《Six Degrees》，并共同填词。
description.en: Jay Chou collaborated with Patrick Brasca on the song 'Six Degrees', and they co-wrote the lyrics.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦在电影《头文字D》中担任男主角，并为其创作了歌曲《飘移》和《一路向北》。
description.en: Jay Chou starred in the film 'Initial D' and composed the songs 'Drifting' and 'All the Way North' for it.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦在电影《满城尽带黄金甲》中饰演元杰王子，并为其创作了歌曲《黄金甲》和《菊花台》。
description.en: Jay Chou played Prince Yuan Jie in the film 'Curse of the Golden Flower' and composed the songs 'Golden Armor' and 'Chrysanthemum Terrace' for it.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦自编自导自演了电影《不能说的·秘密》，并创作了其中的大部分音乐。
description.en: Jay Chou wrote, directed, and starred in the film 'Secret', and also composed most of its music.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，周杰伦与侯佩岑同游东京被媒体拍到，随后周杰伦承认了这段恋情。
description.en: In 2005, Jay Chou and Patty Hou were photographed together in Tokyo by the media, after which Chou confirmed their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 自2001年起，媒体多次报道周杰伦与蔡依林的“双J恋”绯闻，但周杰伦多次公开否认。
description.en: Since 2001, the media frequently reported on the rumored 'Double J' romance between Jay Chou and Jolin Tsai, but Chou publicly denied it on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 周杰伦与刘畊宏是好友，并曾有商业合作。
description.en: Jay Chou and Will Liu are close friends and have had business collaborations.

description.zh-cn: 2016年，周杰伦代表的杰艺文创公司取得电竞战队“台北暗杀星”的经营权，并将其改名为“J Team”。
description.en: In 2016, Jay Chou's company, J TEAM Creative, acquired the management rights of the esports team 'Taipei Assassins' and renamed it 'J Team'.

description.zh-cn: 在取得J Team的经营权后，周杰伦担任该战队的董事长兼荣誉队长。
description.en: After acquiring J Team, Jay Chou serves as the team's Chairman and Honorary Captain.

description.zh-cn: 克里米亚战争的爆发使俄国担心阿拉斯加殖民地被英国夺走，从而促使其考虑并最终向美国提议出售该地区。
description.en: The outbreak of the Crimean War made Russia fear that its Alaskan colony would be seized by Great Britain, prompting it to consider and eventually propose the sale of the territory to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国向美国提议出售阿拉斯加，并最终以720万美元的价格成交。
description.en: The Russian Empire proposed the sale of Alaska to the United States and eventually completed the transaction for $7.2 million.

description.zh-cn: 美国同意并完成了从俄罗斯帝国购买阿拉斯加的交易。
description.en: The United States agreed to and completed the purchase of Alaska from the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任美国国务卿，威廉·西华德是购买阿拉斯加的主要推动者和谈判者。
description.en: As the U.S. Secretary of State at the time, William H. Seward was the primary advocate and negotiator for the Alaska Purchase.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉斯加的出售标志着俄罗斯帝国在北美殖民统治的结束。
description.en: The sale of Alaska marked the end of the Russian Empire's colonial rule in North America.

description.zh-cn: 格里戈里·舍利霍夫与尼古拉·列扎诺夫共同创办了俄美公司。
description.en: Grigory Shelikhov co-founded the Russian-American Company with Nikolai Rezanov.

description.zh-cn: 尼古拉·列扎诺夫与格里戈里·舍利霍夫共同创办了俄美公司。
description.en: Nikolai Rezanov co-founded the Russian-American Company with Grigory Shelikhov.

description.zh-cn: 丽莎·穆尔科斯基是代表阿拉斯加州的美国参议员之一。
description.en: Lisa Murkowski is one of the U.S. Senators representing Alaska.

description.zh-cn: 丹·沙利文是代表阿拉斯加州的美国参议员之一。
description.en: Dan Sullivan is one of the U.S. Senators representing Alaska.

description.zh-cn: 赵元佐是宋太宗的长子。
description.en: Zhao Yuanzuo was the eldest son of Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 赵元佐是元德皇后的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Yuanzuo was the son of Empress Yuande.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国七年（982年），在秦王赵廷美被贬后，赵元佐是唯一为其申救的人。
description.en: In 982 (7th year of the Taiping Xingguo era), after the Prince of Qin, Zhao Tingmei, was demoted, Zhao Yuanzuo was the only one who tried to save him.

description.zh-cn: 雍熙二年（985年），因赵元佐酒后纵火焚烧宫廷，宋太宗下诏将其废为庶人。
description.en: In 985 (2nd year of the Yongxi era), after Zhao Yuanzuo drunkenly set fire to the palace, Emperor Taizong issued an edict demoting him to a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 宋真宗即位后，恢复了赵元佐的爵位。
description.en: After Emperor Zhenzong ascended the throne, he restored Zhao Yuanzuo's noble rank.

description.zh-cn: 赵允升是赵元佐的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Yunsheng was the son of Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 赵允言是赵元佐的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Yunyan was the son of Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 赵汝愚是赵元佐的七世孙。
description.en: Zhao Ruyu was the seventh-generation descendant of Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗时期，追改封赵元佐为汉王。
description.en: During the reign of Emperor Huizong, Zhao Yuanzuo was posthumously re-ennobled as the Prince of Han.

description.zh-cn: 顾慰连是顾毓琇的儿子。
description.en: Gu Weilian is the son of Gu Yuxiu.

description.zh-cn: 顾慰连是江苏无锡人。
description.en: Gu Weilian was a native of Wuxi, Jiangsu.

position.zh-cn: 校长, 副校长, 教授、博士生导师
position.en: President, Vice President, Professor, Doctoral Supervisor

description.zh-cn: 曾任沈阳农业大学校长、副校长、教授、博士生导师。
description.en: Served as the President, Vice President, Professor, and Doctoral Supervisor at Shenyang Agricultural University.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国农学会理事及副会长。
description.en: Served as a council member and vice president of the Chinese Association of Agricultural Science Societies.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“复旦大学校友”可知，顾慰连是复旦大学的校友。
description.en: According to the page category 'Fudan University alumni', Gu Weilian was an alumnus of Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“沈阳农学院校友”可知，顾慰连是沈阳农学院的校友。
description.en: According to the page category 'Shenyang Agricultural College alumni', Gu Weilian was an alumnus of Shenyang Agricultural College.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国共产党党员”可知，顾慰连是中国共产党员。
description.en: According to the page category 'Communist Party of China members', Gu Weilian was a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 第二届学科评议组成员
position.en: Member of the 2nd Academic Appraisal Group

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“国务院学位委员会第二届学科评议组成员”可知，顾慰连是该评议组成员。
description.en: According to the page category 'Members of the 2nd Academic Appraisal Group of the State Council Academic Degrees Committee', Gu Weilian was a member of this appraisal group.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府于1947年4月22日召开行政院会议，决议将台湾省行政长官公署改制为台湾省政府。
description.en: The Nationalist Government held an Executive Yuan Council meeting on April 22, 1947, and resolved to reorganize the Taiwan Provincial Administrative Executive Office into the Taiwan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 自1998年台湾省虚级化后，台湾省政府成为行政院的派出机关，直接隶属于行政院。
description.en: Since the streamlining of Taiwan Province in 1998, the Taiwan Provincial Government became a dispatched agency of the Executive Yuan and was directly subordinate to it.

description.zh-cn: 此项政策调整导致台湾省政府被虚级化，业务大幅缩减并丧失地方自治机关功能。
description.en: This policy adjustment led to the streamlining of the Taiwan Provincial Government, significantly reducing its operations and stripping it of its functions as a local self-governing body.

description.zh-cn: 1997年，国民大会通过宪法增修条文，为台湾省的虚级化（即台湾省政府功能业务与组织调整）提供了法律基础。
description.en: In 1997, the National Assembly passed additional articles of the Constitution, providing the legal basis for the streamlining of Taiwan Province (i.e., the Functional and Organizational Restructuring of the Taiwan Provincial Government).

description.zh-cn: 自2018年7月1日起，台湾省政府的剩余业务与员额移交给国家发展委员会，实施“去任务化”，使其运作实质上终结。
description.en: Starting July 1, 2018, the remaining duties and personnel of the Taiwan Provincial Government were handed over to the National Development Council, implementing a 'de-tasking' that effectively ended its operations.

description.zh-cn: 2014年7月7日，美国台湾政府的支持者占领了台湾省政府大楼。
description.en: On July 7, 2014, supporters of the United States Taiwan Government occupied the Taiwan Provincial Government building.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府是台湾省的最高行政机关。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government was the highest administrative organ of Taiwan Province.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府于1957年至2018年间设址于南投市中兴新村。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government was located in Zhongxing New Village, Nantou City, from 1957 to 2018.

description.zh-cn: 台湾省政府（及其前身）于1945年至1956年间在今行政院中央大楼办公。
description.en: The Taiwan Provincial Government (and its predecessor) was located in what is now the Executive Yuan Central Building from 1945 to 1956.

description.zh-cn: 陈美伶在2018年担任国家发展委员会主任委员时宣布台湾省政府去任务化。
description.en: Chen Mei-ling announced the de-tasking of the Taiwan Provincial Government in 2018 while serving as Minister of the National Development Council.

description.zh-cn: 就读于北京大学中文系。
description.en: Studied at the Department of Chinese Language and Literature, Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 伍皓在北大学生期间曾两次在中南海受到时任中共中央总书记江泽民接见。江泽民还为他起了藏名'扎西'。
description.en: During his time as a student at Peking University, Wu Hao was received twice by then-General Secretary Jiang Zemin at Zhongnanhai. Jiang also gave him the Tibetan name 'Tashi'.

description.zh-cn: 在云南晋宁“躲猫猫”事件中，时任云南省委宣传部副部长的伍皓因召集网友实地调查而知名，此举推动了事件的透明化处理。
description.en: During the 'Duo Maomao' incident in Jinning, Yunnan, Wu Hao, then Deputy Director of the Propaganda Department of the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee, gained prominence by inviting netizens to conduct an on-site investigation, which promoted a more transparent handling of the event.

description.zh-cn: 赵武灵王宠幸吴娃。
description.en: King Wuling of Zhao favored Wu Wa.

description.zh-cn: 公子章原为赵国太子，后被赵武灵王所废。
description.en: Gongzi Zhang was originally the crown prince of Zhao but was later deposed by King Wuling of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 因宠幸吴娃，赵武灵王废黜了公子章的太子之位，改立吴娃之子赵何。
description.en: Due to his favor for Wu Wa, King Wuling of Zhao deposed Gongzi Zhang as crown prince and appointed Wu Wa's son, Zhao He, instead.

description.zh-cn: 赵武灵王将王位禅让给儿子赵何，即赵惠文王。
description.en: King Wuling of Zhao abdicated the throne to his son Zhao He, who became King Huiwen of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 田不礼作为公子章的宰相，与其一同发动了沙丘之乱。
description.en: As the chancellor of Gongzi Zhang, Tian Buli launched the Shaqiu Rebellion with him.

description.zh-cn: 沙丘之乱的目标是杀死赵惠文王，但未能成功。
description.en: The goal of the Shaqiu Rebellion was to kill King Huiwen of Zhao, but it did not succeed.

description.zh-cn: 在平定沙丘之乱后，赵成与李兑在主父宫杀死了公子章。
description.en: After suppressing the Shaqiu Rebellion, Zhao Cheng and Li Dui killed Gongzi Zhang in the Lord Father's palace.

description.zh-cn: 在平定沙丘之乱后，李兑与赵成在主父宫杀死了公子章。
description.en: After suppressing the Shaqiu Rebellion, Li Dui and Zhao Cheng killed Gongzi Zhang in the Lord Father's palace.

description.zh-cn: 因害怕赵武灵王报复，赵成与李兑围困主父宫，导致赵武灵王饿死。
description.en: Fearing retaliation from King Wuling of Zhao, Zhao Cheng and Li Dui besieged the Lord Father's palace, causing King Wuling to starve to death.

description.zh-cn: 因害怕赵武灵王报复，李兑与赵成围困主父宫，导致赵武灵王饿死。
description.en: Fearing retaliation from King Wuling of Zhao, Li Dui and Zhao Cheng besieged the Lord Father's palace, causing King Wuling to starve to death.

description.zh-cn: 田不礼是公子章受封于代地时的宰相。
description.en: Tian Buli was the chancellor of Gongzi Zhang when he was enfeoffed in Dai.

description.zh-cn: 肥义是赵国宰相。
description.en: Fei Yi was the Chancellor of the State of Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 陆房战斗是中国抗日战争中的一场战斗。
description.en: The Lufang Battle was a battle during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 尾高龟藏作为日军第12军司令官，纠集部队对泰西山区进行扫荡围攻，直接引发了陆房战斗。
description.en: As the commander of the Japanese 12th Army, Odaka Kamekichi gathered troops to conduct a mopping-up and encirclement campaign against the Taixi mountainous area, directly triggering the Lufang Battle.

description.zh-cn: 在陆房战斗中，日军第12军对八路军第115师及其他部队形成了合围。
description.en: During the Lufang Battle, the Japanese 12th Army encircled the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army and other units.

description.zh-cn: 在陆房战斗中，伪军协助日军第12军对八路军第115师及其他部队形成了合围。
description.en: During the Lufang Battle, puppet troops assisted the Japanese 12th Army in encircling the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army and other units.

description.zh-cn: 在陆房战斗中，八路军第115师与日军第12军是敌对的作战方。
description.en: In the Lufang Battle, the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army and the Japanese 12th Army were opposing combatants.

description.zh-cn: 赵元俨是宋太宗第八子。
description.en: Zhao Yuanyan was the eighth son of Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 赵德芳与赵德昭为异母兄弟。
description.en: Zhao Defang and Zhao Dezhao were half-brothers.

description.zh-cn: 赵德芳是宋真宗的堂兄。
description.en: Zhao Defang was the cousin of Emperor Zhenzong.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国六年（981年）赵德芳病死，年仅二十三岁。因其兄赵德昭此前亦离奇死亡，史学家多半认为赵德芳的死因与宋太宗有直接关系。
description.en: In 981, Zhao Defang died of illness at the young age of twenty-three. As his elder brother Zhao Dezhao had also died under mysterious circumstances earlier, most historians believe Zhao Defang's death was directly related to Emperor Taizong.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖驾崩时，宋皇后命王继恩召赵德芳入宫继位，但王继恩违命去找晋王赵光义，阻碍了赵德芳继位的可能性。
description.en: When Emperor Taizu died, Empress Song ordered Wang Ji'en to summon Zhao Defang to the palace to succeed the throne, but Wang Ji'en disobeyed and went to the Prince of Jin (Zhao Guangyi) instead, thereby blocking Zhao Defang's potential accession.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖驾崩时，王继恩未遵从宋皇后召赵德芳的命令，而是拿着遗诏去找晋王赵光义，此举帮助赵光义成功继位。
description.en: When Emperor Taizu died, Wang Ji'en disobeyed Empress Song's order to summon Zhao Defang and instead took the edict to the Prince of Jin (Zhao Guangyi), an action that helped Zhao Guangyi successfully ascend the throne.

description.zh-cn: 宋太祖驾崩时，宋皇后急令内侍王继恩召赵德芳入宫，试图拥立其为新皇帝。
description.en: When Emperor Taizu died, Empress Song urgently ordered the eunuch Wang Ji'en to summon Zhao Defang to the palace, in an attempt to enthrone him as the new emperor.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗时期，将赵德芳的追封爵位由楚王改为秦王。
description.en: During the reign of Emperor Huizong, Zhao Defang's posthumous title was changed from Prince of Chu to Prince of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 赵元俨是“八贤王”这一文学形象的真实原型，但该形象在后世的评书、戏剧中常被误署名为赵德芳，导致了二者形象的混淆。
description.en: Zhao Yuanyan is the historical prototype for the literary figure of the "Eighth Virtuous Prince," but this character's name was often misattributed to Zhao Defang in later storytelling and drama, leading to a confusion of their personas.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国元年（976年），赵德芳被授予山南西道节度使。
description.en: In 976, Zhao Defang was appointed the Military Governor (Jiedushi) of Shannan West Circuit.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国元年（976年），赵德芳被授予同平章事，获得宰相之职。
description.en: In 976, Zhao Defang was granted the title of Tongpingzhangshi, effectively making him a Grand Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国三年（978年）冬，赵德芳加检校太尉。
description.en: In the winter of 978, Zhao Defang was additionally appointed Inspecting Grand Marshal.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝即位后，与齐泰、黄子澄等大臣商议，开始实行削藩政策，以削弱各地藩王的势力。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Jianwen Emperor, in consultation with ministers like Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng, began implementing a policy to reduce the power of the princes.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝急于求成的削藩政策激化了中央与藩王的矛盾，是靖难之役爆发的直接导火索。
description.en: The Jianwen Emperor's hasty policy to reduce the power of princes intensified conflicts with the central government and was the direct trigger for the Jingnan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 削藩政策对势力最强的燕王朱棣构成了直接威胁，促使其下定决心起兵反抗。
description.en: The policy of reducing feudatories posed a direct threat to Zhu Di, the most powerful prince, prompting him to launch an armed rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 靖难之役结束后，明成祖为了巩固统治，对忠于建文帝的旧臣进行了大规模清洗，史称壬午之难。
description.en: After the Jingnan Campaign, the Yongle Emperor conducted a large-scale purge of officials loyal to the Jianwen Emperor to consolidate his rule, an event known as the Renwu Purge.

description.zh-cn: 金川门守将李景隆和朱橞的投降，使得燕军兵不血刃地进入南京，标志着靖难之役以燕王朱棣的彻底胜利而告终。
description.en: The surrender of Jinchan Gate's defenders, Li Jinglong and Zhu Hui, allowed the Yan army to enter Nanjing without resistance, marking the definitive end of the Jingnan Campaign with Zhu Di's complete victory.

description.zh-cn: 朱棣援引《皇明祖训》中“朝无正臣，内有奸恶，则亲王训兵待命”的条款，为其起兵“清君侧”提供了法理依据。
description.en: Zhu Di cited the clause in the 'Huang-Ming Zuxun' that allowed a prince to raise troops against 'treacherous ministers at court' to provide a legal basis for his campaign to 'cleanse the emperor's surroundings'.

description.zh-cn: 在东昌之战中，盛庸指挥中央军大败燕军，是建文帝军队在正面战场上取得的首次重大胜利。
description.en: In the Battle of Dongchang, Sheng Yong commanded the imperial forces to a major victory over the Yan army, marking the first significant success for the Jianwen Emperor's forces in a frontal engagement.

description.zh-cn: 在济南之战中，铁铉率军民坚守城池达三个月之久，多次击退朱棣的进攻，迫使燕军最终撤围。
description.en: During the Battle of Jinan, Tie Xuan led the defense of the city for three months, repelling multiple attacks from Zhu Di and ultimately forcing the Yan army to lift the siege.

description.zh-cn: 燕军大将张玉在东昌之战中为救援被围的朱棣而力战身亡。
description.en: The Yan army's general Zhang Yu was killed in action at the Battle of Dongchang while fighting to rescue the besieged Zhu Di.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝朱允炆是懿文太子朱标的次子。
description.en: The Jianwen Emperor, Zhu Yunwen, was the second son of Crown Prince Yiwen, Zhu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 朱标是明太祖朱元璋的长子。
description.en: Zhu Biao was the eldest son of the Hongwu Emperor, Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 宁王朱权是明太祖朱元璋的第十七子。
description.en: Zhu Quan, the Prince of Ning, was the seventeenth son of the Hongwu Emperor, Zhu Yuanzhang.

description.zh-cn: 朱棣在靖难之役初期突袭大宁，胁迫宁王朱权加入其军队，并收编了其精锐的朵颜三卫骑兵，极大地增强了自身实力。
description.en: In the early stages of the Jingnan Campaign, Zhu Di raided Daning and coerced Zhu Quan, the Prince of Ning, to join his forces. He also incorporated Zhu Quan's elite Doyan Guard cavalry, significantly strengthening his own army.

description.zh-cn: 荀子是儒家的代表人物之一。
description.en: Xunzi is one of the representative figures of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 《韩非子》中的《解老》、《喩老》篇是对《道德经》的论注。
description.en: The chapters 'Jie Lao' and 'Yu Lao' in 'Han Feizi' are commentaries on the 'Tao Te Ching'.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇读到《韩非子》中的《孤愤》、《五蠹》等篇章后，表示了高度的赞赏和重视。
description.en: After reading chapters such as 'Gufen' and 'Wudu' in 'Han Feizi', Qin Shi Huang expressed great admiration and attached high importance to them.

description.zh-cn: 《韩非子》的理论旨在为君主提供富国强兵的统治思想和技术。
description.en: 'Han Feizi's' theories are intended to provide monarchs with governing ideologies and techniques for enriching the state and strengthening the army.

description.zh-cn: 《韩非子》在《显学》、《奸劫弑臣》等篇章中对儒家思想进行了批判。
description.en: 'Han Feizi' criticizes Confucian thought in chapters such as 'Xian Xue' and 'Jian Jie Shi Chen'.

description.zh-cn: 《韩非子》在《显学》等篇章中对墨家思想进行了批判。
description.en: 'Han Feizi' criticizes Mohist thought in chapters such as 'Xian Xue'.

description.zh-cn: 韩非曾向秦王上书《存韩》，希望说服秦王保存韩国。
description.en: Han Fei submitted 'Cun Han' (On Preserving Han) to the King of Qin, hoping to persuade him to spare the state of Han.

description.zh-cn: 《韩非子·难二》篇否定了孔子对周文王所作的“仁”和“智”的评价。
description.en: The 'Nan Er' chapter of 'Han Feizi' refutes Confucius's evaluation of King Wen of Zhou as being 'benevolent' and 'wise'.

description.zh-cn: 丰绅殷德是和珅的长子。
description.en: Fengshen Yinde was the eldest son of Heshen.

description.zh-cn: 丰绅殷德的生母是和珅的嫡妻冯氏。
description.en: Fengshen Yinde's biological mother was Heshen's primary wife, Lady Feng.

description.zh-cn: 丰绅殷德的正妻是乾隆帝的幼女固伦和孝公主。
description.en: Fengshen Yinde's primary wife was Princess Gurun Hexiao, the youngest daughter of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 固伦和孝公主是乾隆帝的幼女。
description.en: Princess Gurun Hexiao was the youngest daughter of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 固伦和孝公主的生母是惇妃汪氏。
description.en: The biological mother of Princess Gurun Hexiao was Consort Dun, of the Wang clan.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝是丰绅殷德的岳父。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor was Fengshen Yinde's father-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 惇妃是丰绅殷德的岳母。
description.en: Consort Dun was Fengshen Yinde's mother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 冯氏是英廉的孙女。
description.en: Lady Feng was the granddaughter of Yinglian.

description.zh-cn: 冯氏是和珅的嫡妻。
description.en: Lady Feng was the primary wife of Heshen.

description.zh-cn: 1799年，因和珅案被夺职，削夺伯爵爵位；1803年，因国服期间与侍妾行房生女属实，被削去散秩大臣职务和伯爵爵位。
description.en: In 1799, he was stripped of his position and the title of Earl due to the Heshen case; in 1803, he was stripped of his position as Grand Minister of the Imperial Household and his title of Earl because it was confirmed that he had a child with a concubine during the national mourning period.

description.zh-cn: 1806年，丰绅殷德出任头等侍卫、满洲镶蓝旗副都统，并恢复伯爵；1810年，晋公爵位。
description.en: In 1806, Fengshen Yinde was appointed as a First-Class Imperial Guard and Deputy Commander of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner, and his title of Earl was restored; in 1810, he was promoted to the rank of Duke.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆七年（1802年），清廷因平定白莲教起事后大赦天下，使得丰绅殷德得以恢复伯爵爵位。
description.en: In the seventh year of the Jiaqing era (1802), the Qing court granted a general amnesty after suppressing the White Lotus Rebellion, which allowed Fengshen Yinde to have his title of Earl restored.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆八年（1803年），奎福诬告丰绅殷德谋反及国服期间产女等事，导致后者被削去职务和爵位。
description.en: In the eighth year of the Jiaqing era (1803), Kuifu falsely accused Fengshen Yinde of treason and of having a child during a national mourning period, which led to the latter being stripped of his position and title.

description.zh-cn: 丰绅殷德出身于满洲钮祜禄氏。
description.en: Fengshen Yinde was from the Manchu Niohuru clan.

description.zh-cn: 习远平是习仲勋的儿子。
description.en: Xi Yuanping is the son of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 1952年，习仲勋与妻子齐心一同接待了访华的蒙古领导人泽登巴尔及其夫人。
description.en: In 1952, Xi Zhongxun, along with his wife Qi Xin, received the visiting Mongolian leader Yumjaagiin Tsedenbal and his wife.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，齐心在五七干校劳动7年。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Qi Xin performed manual labor at a May Seventh Cadre School for seven years.

description.zh-cn: 在齐心为丈夫复出一事求助时，时任中共中央组织部部长的胡耀邦指引她去找王震，最终促成了习仲勋的复出。
description.en: When Qi Xin sought help for her husband's political rehabilitation, Hu Yaobang, then head of the CCP's Organization Department, guided her to seek help from Wang Zhen, which ultimately led to Xi Zhongxun's return to work.

description.zh-cn: 作为知识青年，习近平在“上山下乡”运动中被下放到陕北梁家河村插队。
description.en: As an educated youth during the Down to the Countryside Movement, Xi Jinping was sent to work in Liangjiahe Village in northern Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 钱裕扬是钱复的长孙。
description.en: Justin Chien is the eldest grandson of Fredrick Chien.

description.zh-cn: 提名为钱复为监察院院长。
description.en: Nominated Fredrick Chien as President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 在郝柏村担任行政院院长期间，钱复任其内阁的外交部部长。
description.en: During Hau Pei-tsun's tenure as Premier of the Executive Yuan, Fredrick Chien served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs in his cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 在连战担任行政院院长期间，钱复任其内阁的外交部部长。
description.en: During Lien Chan's tenure as Premier of the Executive Yuan, Fredrick Chien served as the Minister of Foreign Affairs in his cabinet.

position.zh-cn: 驻美代表, 行政院经济建设委员会主任委员
position.en: Representative to the US, Chairman of the Council for Economic Planning and Development

description.zh-cn: 在俞国华担任行政院院长期间，钱复先后担任驻美代表及经建会主委。
description.en: During Yu Kuo-hwa's tenure as Premier of the Executive Yuan, Fredrick Chien served successively as Representative to the US and Chairman of the CEPD.

position.zh-cn: 行政院新闻局局长, 驻美代表
position.en: Director-General of the Government Information Office, Representative to the US

description.zh-cn: 钱复在蒋经国分别担任行政院院长和总统期间，先后出任新闻局局长和驻美代表。
description.en: Fredrick Chien served as Director-General of the GIO and Representative to the US during Chiang Ching-kuo's tenures as Premier and President, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 在一个国民党专案小组会议上提出“大陆政策的位阶要高于外交政策”的核心观点，认为国家统一纲领的基石能带来安全保证。
description.en: At a KMT task force meeting, he proposed the core view that 'mainland policy should take precedence over foreign policy,' believing that the cornerstone of the Guidelines for National Unification could provide security guarantees.

description.zh-cn: 在钱复卸任后，陈水扁提名的监察院院长人选未获得由国民党控制的立法院同意，导致监察院空转。
description.en: After Fredrick Chien's term ended, Chen Shui-bian's nominee for the President of the Control Yuan was not approved by the KMT-controlled Legislative Yuan, causing the Control Yuan to become idle.

description.zh-cn: 在2009年至2011年期间，钱复三次参与博鳌论坛并与时任中国国务院总理温家宝会面。
description.en: From 2009 to 2011, Fredrick Chien participated in the Boao Forum three times and met with then-Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 姚子青出生于广东省嘉应州平远县。
description.en: Yao Ziqing was born in Pingyuan County, Jiaying Prefecture, Guangdong Province.

degree.zh-cn: 高等教育班第一期步兵炮队毕业
degree.en: Graduated from the first term of the higher education class for infantry artillery

description.zh-cn: 1926年考入黄埔军校第六期。北伐战争结束后，转入中央陆军军官学校就读。
description.en: In 1926, he was admitted to the sixth term of the Whampoa Military Academy. After the Northern Expedition, he transferred to the Central Army Officers Academy to continue his studies.

description.zh-cn: 姚子青曾在陈诚担任师长的第十一师任见习官。
description.en: Yao Ziqing served as a trainee officer in the 11th Division when Chen Cheng was its commander.

description.zh-cn: 在淞沪会战宝山保卫战中，日军于1937年9月7日攻破宝山城，导致姚子青及全营绝大部分官兵阵亡。
description.en: During the defense of Baoshan in the Battle of Shanghai, Japanese forces breached the city on September 7, 1937, resulting in the death of Yao Ziqing and most of his battalion.

description.zh-cn: 姚子青殉国后，蒋介石致电其师长，称赞姚营“全部官兵与城共存亡，实开近世战争之创例”，并要求详报姓名以资表彰。
description.en: After Yao Ziqing's martyrdom, Chiang Kai-shek sent a telegram to his division commander, praising Yao's battalion for 'all officers and soldiers perishing with the city, truly setting a precedent in modern warfare,' and requested their names for commendation.

description.zh-cn: 1938年3月12日，毛泽东在延安的演讲中赞扬姚子青等烈士是全国人民“崇高伟大的模范”。
description.en: On March 12, 1938, in a speech in Yan'an, Mao Zedong praised martyrs like Yao Ziqing as 'lofty and great models' for the entire nation.

description.zh-cn: 1937年9月10日，中国国民党中央执行委员会向全国通电，称赞姚子青营“志气之壮，死事之烈，尤足以惊天地而泣鬼神”。
description.en: On September 10, 1937, the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang issued a national telegram praising Yao Ziqing's battalion for their 'magnificent spirit and heroic sacrifice, enough to move heaven and earth and make ghosts and gods weep.'

description.zh-cn: 2005年，国民党荣誉主席连战参观上海淞沪抗战纪念馆姚子青营牺牲处时献花，并题词“将军碧血凝青史、壮士英魂映丹心”以作纪念。
description.en: In 2005, KMT Honorary Chairman Lien Chan visited the site of Yao Ziqing's battalion's sacrifice at the Shanghai Songhu Anti-Japanese War Memorial, laid a wreath, and wrote an inscription to commemorate him: 'The general's loyal blood solidifies green history; the hero's valiant soul reflects a loyal heart.'

description.zh-cn: 国民政府军事委员会命令追授姚子青为陆军少将，并在南京为其铸造铜像。
description.en: The Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government ordered the posthumous promotion of Yao Ziqing to Major General and had a bronze statue of him cast in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，中华人民共和国民政部追认姚子青将军为革命烈士。
description.en: In 1983, the Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China posthumously recognized General Yao Ziqing as a revolutionary martyr.

description.zh-cn: 2014年9月1日，姚子青被列入中华人民共和国民政部公布的第一批300名著名抗日英烈和英雄群体名录。
description.en: On September 1, 2014, Yao Ziqing was included in the first batch of 300 famous anti-Japanese martyrs and heroic groups announced by the Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德是扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬的第三子。
description.en: Mohamed bin Zayed is the third son of Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德是哈利法·本·扎耶德的同父异母兄弟。
description.en: Mohamed bin Zayed is the half-brother of Khalifa bin Zayed.

description.zh-cn: 于1979年4月毕业于桑德赫斯特皇家军事学院。
description.en: Graduated from the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst in April 1979.

description.zh-cn: 任命穆罕默德为阿布扎比副王储。
description.en: Appointed Mohamed as the Deputy Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi.

description.zh-cn: 前往埃塞俄比亚会见总理阿比·艾哈迈德，之后阿联酋向埃塞俄比亚提供了30亿美元援助。
description.en: Visited Ethiopia to meet Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, after which the UAE provided $3 billion in aid to Ethiopia.

description.zh-cn: 击中马拉拉·优素福·扎伊的头部和颈部。
description.en: Shot Malala Yousafzai in the head and neck.

description.zh-cn: 在马拉拉被塔利班袭击后，为其安排了专属医疗服务并送往英国治疗。
description.en: Arranged for specialized medical care and transfer to the UK for Malala after she was attacked by the Taliban.

description.zh-cn: 授予穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬修交勋章光化大章。
description.en: Awarded the Grand Gwanghwa Medal of the Order of Diplomatic Service Merit to Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

description.zh-cn: 永琅是弘晓的次子。
description.en: Yonglang was the second son of Hongxiao.

description.zh-cn: 弘晈是弘晓的胞兄。
description.en: Hongjiao was the full brother of Hongxiao.

description.zh-cn: 永琅于1778年承袭其父的怡亲王爵位。
description.en: Yonglang inherited his father's title of Prince Yi in 1778.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓在乾隆年间曾担任正白旗汉军都统等职务。
description.en: Hongxiao served in positions such as Commander of the Plain White Banner Han Martial during the Qianlong era.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓于乾隆五年至八年（1740-1743）担任正白旗汉军都统。
description.en: Hongxiao served as the Commander of the Plain White Banner Han Martial from 1740 to 1743 (the 5th to 8th year of the Qianlong reign).

description.zh-cn: 弘晓与慎靖郡王允禧有诗歌往来。
description.en: Hongxiao exchanged poetry with Prince Shenjing of the Second Rank, Yunxi.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓与宗室敦诚有诗歌往来。
description.en: Hongxiao exchanged poetry with the imperial clansman Duncheng.

description.zh-cn: 弘晓曾收藏《石头记》的早期手抄本“己卯本”，该版本因藏于其怡亲王府而被称为“怡府本”，对《红楼梦》的版本流传和研究具有重要价值。
description.en: Hongxiao collected an early manuscript of 'The Story of the Stone' known as the 'Jimao manuscript'. Because it was kept in his Prince Yi Mansion, it is also called the 'Yifu manuscript', which is of great importance to the transmission and study of 'Dream of the Red Chamber'.

description.zh-cn: 杨文渭是卢氏县横涧乡七寸街人。
description.en: Yang Wenwei was a native of Qicun Street, Hengjian Township, Lushi County.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间，经赵致平介绍成为中国共产党党员。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, he became a member of the Communist Party of China through the introduction of Zhao Zhiping.

description.zh-cn: 赵致平在抗日战争期间介绍杨文渭加入中国共产党。
description.en: Zhao Zhiping introduced Yang Wenwei to join the Communist Party of China during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 在抗日战争期间结识赵致平，并与之成为好友。
description.en: He met Zhao Zhiping during the Second Sino-Japanese War and they became good friends.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，因和中共地下党员频繁联络，杨文渭被国民党当局逮捕。
description.en: In 1946, Yang Wenwei was arrested by the Kuomintang authorities for frequent contact with underground members of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右派斗争中，杨文渭遭遇残酷批斗，受到错误批判，不堪政治压力跳井身亡。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign in 1957, Yang Wenwei faced cruel struggle sessions and wrongful criticism, and unable to bear the political pressure, he committed suicide by jumping into a well.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教是指以成佛为目标而修行的菩萨乘。
description.en: Mahayana Buddhism refers to the Bodhisattva Path, which aims to achieve Buddhahood.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教将非以成佛为修行方向的声闻乘和缘觉乘称为“小乘”。
description.en: Mahayana Buddhism termed the Śrāvakayāna and Pratyekabuddhayāna, which are not oriented towards Buddhahood, as 'Hīnayāna' (Small Vehicle).

description.zh-cn: 在大乘佛教当中，接受密续作为主要修行内容的佛教派别，称为金刚乘。
description.en: Within Mahayana Buddhism, the school that accepts the Tantras as its main practice is called Vajrayāna.

description.zh-cn: 金刚乘（密宗）是大乘佛教的一个分支。它在笈多王朝时期形成，当时大乘佛教在吸收婆罗门教及新兴怛特罗密教的咒语、手印、宗教仪规和瑜伽术身体训练方法的基础上，发展出一套极富神秘主义色彩的宗教实践方式。
description.en: Vajrayāna, also known as Tantra (Mizong), is a branch of Mahayana Buddhism. It formed during the Gupta dynasty when Mahayana Buddhism absorbed mantras, mudras, religious rituals, and yogic physical training methods from Brahmanism and the emerging Tantrism, developing a highly mystical system of religious practice.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教的主要传承者，若依照佛教史上的佛法不同的传播路线来命名，是属于北传佛教这一支路线为主。
description.en: The main inheritors of Mahayana Buddhism, named according to the different transmission routes of Dharma in Buddhist history, primarily belong to the Northern Transmission route.

description.zh-cn: 北传这条传播路线若再细分，其中的汉传佛教流传于中国大陆、香港、澳门、台湾、日本、朝鲜半岛、新加坡、马来西亚、越南等地。
description.en: If the Northern Transmission route is further subdivided, Chinese Buddhism spread to Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, Japan, the Korean Peninsula, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, and other places.

description.zh-cn: 在印度佛教思想史晚期形成的秘密大乘佛教教义，则传入西藏、蒙古和俄罗斯部分地区，成为藏传佛教中的主要元素。
description.en: The doctrines of Secret Mahayana Buddhism, which formed in the late period of Indian Buddhist history, were transmitted to Tibet, Mongolia, and parts of Russia, becoming a major element in Tibetan Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 1950年召开的世界佛教徒联谊会达成共识，对南传佛教的正确称呼应当一律使用上座部佛教，而非“小乘”。
description.en: In 1950, the World Fellowship of Buddhists reached a consensus that the correct term for Southern Buddhism should be Theravada Buddhism, not 'Hīnayāna'.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教起初在部派佛教之中发展，其教理学说与大众部、说一切有部、分别说部及经量部都有著很深的关系。
description.en: Mahayana Buddhism initially developed within Nikāya Buddhism, and its doctrines have deep connections with the Mahāsāṃghika, Sarvāstivāda, Vibhajyavāda, and Sautrāntika schools.

description.zh-cn: 阿育王本人在归依佛教后，其教化行动可视为带有大乘菩萨道行者的风范，大乘教法可能在阿育王时代就已有所流行。
description.en: After converting to Buddhism, King Ashoka's actions can be seen as exemplifying the conduct of a Mahayana bodhisattva, suggesting that Mahayana teachings may have been popular during his era.

description.zh-cn: 龙树著《中论》等，建立了般若中观学派。
description.en: Nāgārjuna authored the Mūlamadhyamakakārikā and other works, establishing the Madhyamaka school of Prajñā.

description.zh-cn: 印度僧人无著、世亲，依据《瑜伽师地论》创立“唯识论”，形成瑜伽行唯识学派。
description.en: The Indian monks Asanga and Vasubandhu founded the 'Consciousness-Only' theory based on the Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra, thus forming the Yogācāra school.

description.zh-cn: 印度僧人无著、世亲，依据《瑜伽师地论》创立“唯识论”，形成瑜伽行唯识学派。
description.en: The Indian monks Asanga and Vasubandhu founded the 'Consciousness-Only' theory based on the Yogācārabhūmi-śāstra, thus forming the Yogācāra school.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教吸收婆罗门教的咒语、手印等元素，发展出密宗。
description.en: Mahayana Buddhism absorbed elements such as mantras and mudras from Brahmanism to develop Tantra.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教吸收怛特罗密教的咒语、手印等元素，发展出密宗。
description.en: Mahayana Buddhism absorbed elements such as mantras and mudras from Tantrism to develop Tantra.

description.zh-cn: 大乘佛教兴起初期，部派佛教教内的部份部派不认可绝大部份大乘佛教的来源传承，认为这些经典非释迦牟尼佛所说。
description.en: In the early stages of Mahayana Buddhism's emergence, some schools within Nikāya Buddhism did not recognize the transmission sources of most Mahayana teachings, believing these scriptures were not spoken by Shakyamuni Buddha.

description.zh-cn: “干部四化”方针的推行，使得干部选任开始注重“年轻化”及“专业化”。
description.en: The implementation of the 'Four Transformations of Cadres' policy led to an emphasis on 'youthfulness' and 'professionalism' in the selection and appointment of cadres.

description.zh-cn: 1982年2月，中共中央作出《关于建立老干部退休制度的决定》，对干部管理制度进行改革。
description.en: In February 1982, the CPC Central Committee issued the 'Decision on Establishing a Retirement System for Veteran Cadres', reforming the cadre management system.

description.zh-cn: 通过2018年的机构改革，中共中央组织部获得了对公务员工作的统一管理权，加强了其职能。
description.en: Through the 2018 institutional reform, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee gained unified management authority over civil service affairs, strengthening its functions.

description.zh-cn: 2018年12月29日，第十三届全国人大常委会第七次会议通过了对《中华人民共和国公务员法》的修订。
description.en: On December 29, 2018, the 7th session of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress passed the revision to the 'Civil Servant Law of the People's Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后，由于运动期间干部队伍正常更替中断，出现了干部年龄老化现象。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution, the normal succession of the cadre corps was interrupted during the movement, leading to an aging phenomenon among cadres.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后的平反冤假错案工作，使得大批老干部得以重返领导职位。
description.en: The work of rehabilitating unjust, false, and wrongful cases after the Cultural Revolution allowed a large number of veteran cadres to return to leadership positions.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月28日，中央全面深化改革委员会第一次会议通过了《公安机关执法勤务警员职务序列改革方案（试行）》，对人民警察职务序列进行改革。
description.en: On March 28, 2018, the first meeting of the Central Comprehensively Deepening Reforms Commission passed the 'Reform Plan for the Duty Sequence of Law Enforcement Officers in Public Security Organs (for Trial Implementation)', reforming the job sequence of the People's Police.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》由世界华文媒体所拥有。
description.en: Ming Pao is owned by Media Chinese International.

description.zh-cn: 因“核裤论”等议题，《明报》与《大公报》展开激烈笔战。
description.en: Ming Pao and Ta Kung Pao engaged in a fierce 'pen war' over issues such as the 'nuclear weapons over pants' theory.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》发表社评《要裤子不要核子》，公开反对时任中国外长陈毅提出的“当了裤子也要造核子”的言论。
description.en: Ming Pao published an editorial titled 'Pants, Not Nukes', openly opposing the statement 'We will have nuclear weapons even if we have to go without pants' made by then-Chinese Foreign Minister Chen Yi.

description.zh-cn: 批评了包括《大公报》在内的左派报章在“核裤论”论战中的表现，促使它们停止对《明报》的攻击。
description.en: He criticized the performance of leftist newspapers, including Ta Kung Pao, in the 'nuclear weapons over pants' debate, prompting them to cease their attacks on Ming Pao.

description.zh-cn: 在六七暴动期间，《明报》支持港府止暴制乱，并发表社论批评组织骚乱的斗委会。
description.en: During the 1967 riots, Ming Pao supported the Hong Kong government's efforts to quell the violence and published editorials criticizing the Struggle Committee that organized the disturbances.

description.zh-cn: 在六七暴动期间，商业电台主持人林彬因谴责左派暴力行为而被纵火杀害。
description.en: During the 1967 riots, Commercial Radio host Lam Bun was murdered in an arson attack for denouncing leftist violence.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》发表多篇社评及评论文章为“双查方案”进行辩护。
description.en: Ming Pao published multiple editorials and commentaries defending the 'Double Cha Proposal'.

description.zh-cn: 就《明报》对“双查方案”的报道手法发表声明，指责查良镛干预采访并要求其辞职。
description.en: Issued a statement regarding Ming Pao's coverage of the 'Double Cha Proposal', accusing Louis Cha of interfering with reporting and demanding his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 在《明报》专栏发表题为《下台吧 董建华》的文章，严厉抨击时任行政长官董建华的施政。
description.en: Published an article in his Ming Pao column titled 'Step Down, Tung Chee-hwa', severely criticizing the governance of then-Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa.

description.zh-cn: 以“从事非法窃取、刺探国家机密活动”为由拘捕并导致《明报》记者席扬被判刑。
description.en: Arrested Ming Pao journalist Xi Yang on charges of 'illegally stealing and prying into state secrets', leading to his imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 《明报》前总编辑刘进图遭人持刀袭击，身受重伤。
description.en: Former Ming Pao chief editor Kevin Lau was attacked with a knife, suffering serious injuries.

description.zh-cn: 点名谴责《尊子漫画》“扭曲并抹黑”政府，此举是导致其专栏被停刊的直接原因之一。
description.en: Publicly condemned Zunzi's cartoon for 'distorting and smearing' the government, which was a direct factor leading to the suspension of his column.

description.zh-cn: 在漫画内容受到政府部门多次批评后，《明报》宣布停止刊登《尊子漫画》。
description.en: After the cartoon's content was repeatedly criticized by government departments, Ming Pao announced it would cease publishing Zunzi's cartoons.

description.zh-cn: 点名批评曾志豪在《明报》发表的关于“白纸运动”的评论混淆视听。
description.en: Publicly criticized a commentary by Tsang Chi-ho published in Ming Pao regarding the 'White Paper Protests' as misleading.

description.zh-cn: 点名批评曾志豪在《明报》发表的关于“安心出行”及Google的评论偏颇，最终导致其专栏被停。
description.en: Publicly criticized a commentary by Tsang Chi-ho in Ming Pao about 'LeaveHomeSafe' and Google as biased, eventually leading to the discontinuation of his column.

description.zh-cn: 在曾志豪的评论文章多次受到政府点名批评后，《明报》停止刊登其专栏。
description.en: After Tsang Chi-ho's commentary articles were repeatedly criticized by the government, Ming Pao ceased publishing his column.

description.zh-cn: 以“节流紧缩”为由，宣布裁退执行总编辑姜国元。
description.en: Announced the dismissal of Executive Chief Editor Keung Kwok-yuen, citing the need for 'cost-cutting and retrenchment'.

description.zh-cn: 曾担任《明报》总编辑，于2014年卸任。
description.en: Served as Chief Editor of Ming Pao, stepping down in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 因转载《中大学生报》的“情色问卷”，将《明报》副刊《星期日生活》暂定评为二级不雅物品。
description.en: Temporarily classified Ming Pao's Sunday supplement as a Class II indecent article for reprinting the 'sexuality survey' from The Chinese University Student Press.

description.zh-cn: 因刊登“情色问卷”，被淫亵物品审裁处暂定评为二级不雅物品。
description.en: Was temporarily classified as a Class II indecent article by the Obscene Articles Tribunal for publishing a 'sexuality survey'.

description.zh-cn: 在《明报》提出的司法覆核案中，裁定淫亵物品审裁处早前的评级违例，推翻其决定。
description.en: In a judicial review case filed by Ming Pao, the High Court ruled that the Obscene Articles Tribunal's earlier classification was unlawful, overturning its decision.

description.zh-cn: 查良镛因对六四事件感到伤心而退出政坛。
description.en: Louis Cha withdrew from politics due to his distress over the Tiananmen Square incident.

description.zh-cn: 社会和法制委员会是在全国政协常务委员会领导下的工作机构。
description.en: The Committee for Social and Legal Affairs is a working body under the leadership of the Standing Committee of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 社会和法制委员会是在全国政协主席会议领导下的工作机构。
description.en: The Committee for Social and Legal Affairs is a working body under the leadership of the Chairperson's Council of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1998年3月16日，政协第九届全国委员会常务委员会第一次会议决定设置社会和法制委员会。
