description.en: On March 16, 1998, the first meeting of the Standing Committee of the 9th CPPCC National Committee decided to establish the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十四届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Serves as the Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 14th CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第九届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Served as Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 9th CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Served as Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 10th CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十一届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Served as Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 11th CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十二届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Served as Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 12th CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十三届全国政协社会和法制委员会主任。
description.en: Served as Director of the Committee for Social and Legal Affairs of the 13th CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 随红四方面军进行长征。
description.en: Participated in the Long March with the Fourth Front Army.

description.zh-cn: 在长征途中将险些溺亡的苏毅然救活。
description.en: Saved Su Yiran from drowning during the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 在许建国担任张家口市公安局局长期间，苏毅然任副局长。
description.en: Su Yiran served as Deputy Director while Xu Jianguo was the Director of the Zhangjiakou Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 苏毅然担任中顾委委员时，陈云为中顾委主任。
description.en: When Su Yiran was a member of the Central Advisory Commission, Chen Yun was its Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 苏毅然接替白如冰担任山东省省长（1979年12月）及中共山东省委书记（1982年12月）。
description.en: Su Yiran succeeded Bai Rubing as Governor of Shandong (December 1979) and Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee (December 1982).

description.zh-cn: 梁步庭接替苏毅然担任山东省省长（1982年12月）、中共山东省委书记（1985年6月）及山东省顾问委员会主任（1988年12月）。
description.en: Liang Buting succeeded Su Yiran as Governor of Shandong (December 1982), Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee (June 1985), and Director of the Shandong Provincial Advisory Committee (December 1988).

description.zh-cn: 苏毅然接替高克亭担任山东省顾问委员会主任。
description.en: Su Yiran succeeded Gao Keting as Director of the Shandong Provincial Advisory Committee.

description.zh-cn: 刘家义在苏毅然逝世后前往送别或以其他方式表示哀悼。
description.en: Liu Jiayi paid final respects or offered condolences in other ways after Su Yiran's death.

description.zh-cn: 杨东奇在苏毅然逝世后前往送别或以其他方式表示哀悼。
description.en: Yang Dongqi paid final respects or offered condolences in other ways after Su Yiran's death.

description.en: Zhao Zhihao paid final respects or offered condolences in other ways after Su Yiran's death.

description.en: Jiang Yikang paid final respects or offered condolences in other ways after Su Yiran's death.

description.en: Li Chunting paid final respects or offered condolences in other ways after Su Yiran's death.

description.en: Chen Guanglin paid final respects or offered condolences in other ways after Su Yiran's death.

description.zh-cn: 西角官学堂是英皇书院最早的前身。西营盘官学堂是其直接前身，并于1922年更名为英皇书院。
description.en: West Point School was the earliest predecessor of King's College. Saiyingpun School was its direct predecessor and was renamed King's College in 1922.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，时任港督司徒拔倡议成立英皇书院。
description.en: In 1920, Governor Reginald Edward Stubbs proposed the establishment of King's College.

description.zh-cn: 普乐于1917年倡议拨款兴建西营盘官学堂新校舍，该校舍后来成为英皇书院。
description.en: In 1917, Henry Pollock proposed funding for a new campus for Saiyingpun School, which later became King's College.

description.zh-cn: 何理玉于1918年再度倡议兴建西营盘官学堂新校舍，该校舍后来成为英皇书院。
description.en: In 1918, E. V. D. Parr once again advocated for the construction of a new campus for Saiyingpun School, which later became King's College.

description.zh-cn: 莫理士是英皇书院的创办人之一，并于1927年成为首任掌院。
description.en: Alfred Morris was one of the founders of King's College and became its first Headmaster in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 英皇书院是隶属于香港教育局的官立中学。
description.en: King's College is a government secondary school under the Education Bureau of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 英皇书院于1928年起改用中央书院的八年学制。
description.en: Starting from 1928, King's College adopted the eight-year academic system from The Central School.

description.zh-cn: 时任总督金文泰爵士主持了英皇书院般咸道校舍的开幕典礼。
description.en: Governor Sir Cecil Clementi presided over the opening ceremony of the King's College Bonham Road campus.

description.zh-cn: 因香港保卫战，英皇书院运作中断，校舍被征用作救护站。
description.en: Due to the Battle of Hong Kong, the operations of King's College were suspended, and its campus was used as a first-aid station.

description.zh-cn: 在香港日占时期，英皇书院校舍被日军占用为饲养军用骡马的马厩，导致学校停办。
description.en: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, the King's College campus was used by the Japanese army as a stable for military mules and horses, leading to the school's closure.

description.zh-cn: 1951至1955年，英皇书院校舍被政府用作开办伊利沙伯中学。
description.en: From 1951 to 1955, the King's College campus was used by the government to establish Queen Elizabeth School.

description.zh-cn: 罗富国师范学院附属学校曾使用英皇书院般咸道校舍授课。
description.en: The affiliated school of Northcote College of Education once used the King's College Bonham Road campus for teaching.

description.zh-cn: 葛量洪教育学院创校时曾借用英皇书院般咸道校舍礼堂。
description.en: Grantham College of Education used the hall of the King's College Bonham Road campus when it was founded.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英是英皇书院校友。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying is an alumnus of King's College.

description.zh-cn: 李福善毕业于英皇书院。
description.en: Li Fook-sean graduated from King's College.

description.zh-cn: 钟士元曾就读于英皇书院。
description.en: Chung Sze-yuen studied at King's College.

description.zh-cn: 刘炽平是英皇书院校友。
description.en: Martin Lau is an alumnus of King's College.

description.zh-cn: 林超英是英皇书院校友。
description.en: Lam Chiu-ying is an alumnus of King's College.

description.zh-cn: 莫理士于1927年成为英皇书院首任掌院。
description.en: Alfred Morris became the first Headmaster of King's College in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 国务院国资委是国务院的直属特设机构，代表国务院履行对中央企业的出资人职责。
description.en: The SASAC is a special commission directly under the State Council, exercising the responsibilities of an investor on its behalf for central enterprises.

description.zh-cn: 国家计委煤代油办公室旗下的多家“华能系”公司是1989年组建中国华能集团的基础。
description.en: Several 'Huaneng-system' companies under the State Planning Commission's Office for Coal substituting Oil formed the basis for the establishment of China Huaneng Group in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 原水电部管理的四家公司在1989年并入新成立的中国华能集团。
description.en: Four companies formerly managed by the Ministry of Water Resources and Electric Power were merged into the newly established China Huaneng Group in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 康华发展总公司旗下的康华国际易货贸易公司于1988年底转入中国华能集团。
description.en: Kanghua International Barter Trade Company, a subsidiary of Kanghua Development Corporation, was transferred to China Huaneng Group at the end of 1988.

description.zh-cn: 自1993年起，华能集团主要由电力工业部管理。
description.en: Starting from 1993, Huaneng Group was mainly managed by the Ministry of Electric Power Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1997年至2002年间，华能集团是国家电力公司的子公司。
description.en: From 1997 to 2002, Huaneng Group was a subsidiary of the State Power Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 华能国际电力开发公司是1989年中国华能集团成立时的主要子公司之一，后发展成为上市公司华能国际电力，中国华能集团有限公司是其控股公司。
description.en: Huaneng International Power Development Corporation was one of the main subsidiaries when China Huaneng Group was established in 1989. It later developed into the listed company Huaneng International Power, of which China Huaneng Group Co., Ltd. is the holding company.

description.zh-cn: 1995年，根据国务院批复，原属华能集团的华能精煤公司分立为独立的国有企业神华集团。
description.en: In 1995, with the approval of the State Council, the former Huaneng Fine Coal Corporation, which was part of Huaneng Group, was spun off to become the independent state-owned enterprise Shenhua Group.

description.zh-cn: 2002年电力体制改革后，原云南澜沧江水电开发公司划归华能集团，成为其控股子公司。
description.en: After the 2002 power system reform, the former Yunnan Lancang River Hydropower Development Co. was transferred to Huaneng Group and became its holding subsidiary.

description.zh-cn: 2005年之前，北方联合电力由内蒙古自治区人民政府控股。
description.en: Before 2005, North United Power Corporation was controlled by the People's Government of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，北方联合电力成为华能集团的子公司。
description.en: In 2005, North United Power Corporation became a subsidiary of Huaneng Group.

description.zh-cn: 2017年6月，华能集团与泰康集团签署战略合作框架协议。
description.en: In June 2017, Huaneng Group signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement with Taikang Group.

description.zh-cn: 黄琪翔是中国农工民主党（及其前身）的创始人之一。
description.en: Huang Qixiang was one of the founders of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party (and its predecessors).

description.zh-cn: 章伯钧是中国农工民主党（及其前身）的创始人之一。
description.en: Zhang Bojun was one of the founders of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party (and its predecessors).

description.zh-cn: 国民政府于南京秘密处决邓演达。
description.en: The Nationalist Government secretly executed Deng Yanda in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 1949年9月后，章伯钧入政府任交通部长。
description.en: After September 1949, Zhang Bojun joined the government as the Minister of Transport.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，黄琪翔被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Huang Qixiang was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，韩兆鹗被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Han Zhao'e was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，张申府被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Zhang Shenfu was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，黄现璠被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Huang Xianfan was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，李士豪被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Li Shihao was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，李伯球被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Li Boqiu was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，张云川被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Zhang Yunchuan was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，邓昊明被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Deng Haoming was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 在1957年反右运动中，李述中被划为右派。
description.en: During the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, Li Shuzhong was labeled a rightist.

description.zh-cn: 彭泽湘受毛泽东邀请访问延安，毛泽东连续四个晚上与其恳谈。
description.en: Peng Zexiang was invited by Mao Zedong to visit Yan'an, where Mao had sincere talks with him for four consecutive nights.

position.zh-cn: 政府委员、军事委员会参谋主任
position.en: Government Committee Member, Chief of Staff of the Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 黄琪翔为中华共和国人民革命政府十一名政府委员之一，兼任军事委员会参谋主任。
description.en: Huang Qixiang was one of the eleven government committee members of the People's Revolutionary Government of the Republic of China and concurrently served as the Chief of Staff of the Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 赵一德担任中国共产党陕西省委员会书记。
description.en: Zhao Yide serves as the Secretary of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 赵一德担任陕西省人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Zhao Yide serves as the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 赵刚担任陕西省人民政府省长。
description.en: Zhao Gang serves as the Governor of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 徐新荣担任中国人民政治协商会议陕西省委员会主席。
description.en: Xu Xinrong serves as the Chairman of the Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 周公旦与召公奭以陕原为界，划分治理区域，史称“分陕而治”。
description.en: The Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao divided their administrative territories at Shan Yuan, a historical event known as 'Governing from Each Side of Shan'.

description.zh-cn: 召公奭与周公旦以陕原为界，划分治理区域，史称“分陕而治”。
description.en: The Duke of Shao and the Duke of Zhou divided their administrative territories at Shan Yuan, a historical event known as 'Governing from Each Side of Shan'.

description.zh-cn: 公元前771年，犬戎攻破西周都城镐京，杀死了周幽王。
description.en: In 771 BC, the Quanrong sacked the Western Zhou capital Haojing and killed King You of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 秦襄公护送周平王东迁雒邑。
description.en: Duke Xiang of Qin escorted King Ping of Zhou on his eastward move to Luoyi.

description.zh-cn: 316年，前赵将领刘曜攻破长安，俘虏了晋愍帝。
description.en: In 316, the Former Zhao general Liu Yao captured Chang'an and took Emperor Min of Jin prisoner.

description.zh-cn: 前赵灭亡了西晋。
description.en: The Former Zhao dynasty overthrew the Western Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 前秦在淝水之战中大败，国力开始下降。
description.en: Former Qin was decisively defeated at the Battle of Fei River, leading to the decline of its power.

description.zh-cn: 385年，姚苌擒杀前秦天王苻坚。
description.en: In 385, Yao Chang captured and killed Fu Jian, the ruler of Former Qin.

description.zh-cn: 384年，姚苌自称万年秦王，建立后秦政权。
description.en: In 384, Yao Chang proclaimed himself King of Wannian Qin and established the Later Qin regime.

description.zh-cn: 556年，宇文泰的势力取代了西魏。
description.en: In 556, Yuwen Tai's faction replaced the Western Wei.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，中国共产党领导的军队逐步攻占陕西全境，取代了中华民国的统治。
description.en: In 1949, forces led by the Communist Party of China gradually captured the entire territory of Shaanxi, replacing the rule of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 习远平是习近平的弟弟。
description.en: Xi Yuanping is the younger brother of Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇于2002年11月在中共十六届一中全会上当选为中央政治局委员，直至2006年9月因社保案被停止职务。
description.en: Chen Liangyu was elected as a member of the Politburo at the First Plenary Session of the 16th CPC Central Committee in November 2002, and held the position until he was suspended in September 2006 due to the social security fund case.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇于1996年被任命为上海市常务副市长。随后，于2001年12月任上海市代市长，并于2002年2月正式当选市长，任职至2003年2月。
description.en: Chen Liangyu was appointed as the Executive Vice Mayor of Shanghai in 1996. Subsequently, he became acting mayor in December 2001, was formally elected mayor in February 2002, and served until February 2003.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇自2002年11月当选中共中央政治局委员后，成为国家级副职领导人，直至2006年9月被停止职务。
description.en: After being elected as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee in November 2002, Chen Liangyu became a state-level vice leader until he was suspended from his duties in September 2006.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇于1946年10月24日出生于上海市。
description.en: Chen Liangyu was born in Shanghai on October 24, 1946.

description.zh-cn: 陈维力是陈良宇的儿子。
description.en: Chen Weili is Chen Liangyu's son.

description.zh-cn: 陈良军是陈良宇的三弟。
description.en: Chen Liangjun is Chen Liangyu's third younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇于1963年至1968年在解放军后勤工程学院建筑系结构专业学习。
description.en: Chen Liangyu studied in the Structural Engineering program of the Department of Architecture at the PLA University of Logistics from 1963 to 1968.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇于1992年作为上海市级储备干部被派往英国伯明翰大学公共政策学院进修。
description.en: In 1992, Chen Liangyu was sent to the School of Public Policy at the University of Birmingham in the UK for advanced study as a reserve cadre from Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 时任总理温家宝推行的宏观调控政策与陈良宇在上海的经济发展思路产生冲突，陈良宇对此予以抵制，这被视为其遭罢黜的诱因之一，阻碍了其政治生涯。
description.en: The macroeconomic control policies promoted by then-Premier Wen Jiabao conflicted with Chen Liangyu's economic development ideas in Shanghai. Chen's resistance to these policies was seen as one of the reasons for his downfall, thus obstructing his political career.

description.zh-cn: 根据张炎夏教授的说法，令计划曾参与策划并操盘整倒陈良宇。
description.en: According to Professor Zhang Yanxia, Ling Jihua participated in planning and orchestrating the downfall of Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 有说法称，薄熙来曾与令计划联手扳倒陈良宇。
description.en: It is alleged that Bo Xilai collaborated with Ling Jihua to bring down Chen Liangyu.

description.zh-cn: 1992年初，因陈良宇无意中冲撞了邓小平在上海下榻处的警卫，时任中共上海市委书记吴邦国在电话中训斥了陈良宇。
description.en: In early 1992, after Chen Liangyu inadvertently clashed with the security detail at Deng Xiaoping's residence in Shanghai, then-Shanghai Party Secretary Wu Bangguo reprimanded Chen over the phone.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇被免职后，韩正代理其上海市委书记职务。此前，韩正接替陈良宇出任上海市市长。
description.en: After Chen Liangyu was dismissed, Han Zheng served as acting Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee. Previously, Han had succeeded Chen as Mayor of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 陈良宇被免职后，习近平在韩正短暂代理之后，正式接任了上海市委书记职务。
description.en: After Chen Liangyu was dismissed and following Han Zheng's brief acting tenure, Xi Jinping formally took over the position of Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫于1958年7月17日出生于中国上海。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai was born in Shanghai, China on July 17, 1958.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫于1976年毕业于格致书院中五年级。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai graduated from Form 5 of Kachai College in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫曾就读于香港理工学院美术设计系两年，但未毕业。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai studied in the Graphic Design department at the Hong Kong Polytechnic for two years but did not graduate.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫和陈以靳于1985年在香港结婚。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai and Esther Chan married in Hong Kong in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 陈以靳在邂逅王家卫后，建议他报名参加TVB的导演培训班。
description.en: After meeting Wong Kar-wai, Esther Chan suggested he enroll in TVB's director training program.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫称妻子陈以靳为其“缪斯女神”，其电影中极具魅力的女性角色都有她的影子。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai calls his wife Esther Chan his 'muse,' stating that the charismatic female characters in his films are all inspired by her.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫于1980年进入电视广播有限公司导演训练班，后任制作助理，于1981年离开。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai joined the director training program at TVB in 1980, later worked as a production assistant, and left in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 在无线电视任职期间，王家卫受到时任节目部经理甘国亮的垂青，获得了大量戏剧创作机会。
description.en: During his time at TVB, Wong Kar-wai was highly regarded by then-program manager Kam Kwok-leung, which gave him numerous opportunities for dramatic creation.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫视甘国亮为恩师。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai regards Kam Kwok-leung as his mentor.

description.zh-cn: 邓光荣发现了王家卫的才华，并资助他开拍了首部电影《旺角卡门》和后续的《阿飞正传》。
description.en: Alan Tang discovered Wong Kar-wai's talent and financed his debut film 'As Tears Go By' and the subsequent 'Days of Being Wild'.

description.zh-cn: 邓光荣资助王家卫开拍电影《旺角卡门》。
description.en: Alan Tang financed Wong Kar-wai's film 'As Tears Go By'.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年第50届坎城影展上，王家卫凭借电影《春光乍泄》获得最佳导演奖。
description.en: At the 50th Cannes Film Festival in 1997, Wong Kar-wai won the Best Director Award for the film 'Happy Together'.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫常与摄影师杜可风、美术指导张叔平合作，被外界称为“铁三角”。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai often collaborates with cinematographer Christopher Doyle and art director William Chang, and they are known as the 'iron triangle'.

description.zh-cn: 演员梁朝伟表示，拍过王家卫的电影后演技进步。
description.en: Actor Tony Leung Chiu-wai stated that his acting improved after working on Wong Kar-wai's films.

description.zh-cn: 演员张曼玉表示，拍过王家卫的电影后演技进步。
description.en: Actress Maggie Cheung stated that her acting improved after working on Wong Kar-wai's films.

description.zh-cn: 演员章子怡表示，拍过王家卫的电影后演技进步。
description.en: Actress Zhang Ziyi stated that her acting improved after working on Wong Kar-wai's films.

description.zh-cn: 《繁花》编剧程骏年指控王家卫侵犯其关于该剧的著作权。
description.en: Cheng Junnian, screenwriter for 'Blossoms Shanghai', accused Wong Kar-wai of infringing his copyright for the series.

description.zh-cn: 在程骏年发布的录音中，王家卫批评中国共产党处理武汉疫情的方式，并称其为“贪婪的一党制国家”。
description.en: In a recording released by Cheng Junnian, Wong Kar-wai criticized the Communist Party of China's handling of the Wuhan epidemic and referred to it as a 'greedy one-party state'.

description.zh-cn: 在程骏年发布的录音中，王家卫对中国共产党在武汉疫情期间采取的严厉防疫措施表示了批评。
description.en: In a recording released by Cheng Junnian, Wong Kar-wai expressed criticism of the strict anti-epidemic measures taken by the Communist Party of China during the Wuhan epidemic.

description.zh-cn: 王家卫与《繁花》联合导演李爽在一段录音中一同讨论中国政治。
description.en: Wong Kar-wai and 'Blossoms Shanghai' co-director Li Shuang were recorded discussing Chinese politics together.

description.zh-cn: 2006年5月21日，法国政府授予王家卫荣誉军团骑士级勋章，以表彰其对电影业的贡献。
description.en: On May 21, 2006, the French government awarded Wong Kar-wai the Knight of the Legion of Honour in recognition of his contributions to the film industry.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，法国文化及通信部授予王家卫法兰西艺术与文学勋章中最高等级的“司令勋章”。
description.en: In 2013, the French Ministry of Culture and Communication awarded Wong Kar-wai the Commander of the Ordre des Arts et des Lettres, its highest rank.

description.zh-cn: 自2021年2月起担任安徽省人民政府省长。
description.en: Serving as Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since February 2021.

description.zh-cn: 自2025年10月起担任安徽省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Serving as Executive Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since October 2025.

description.zh-cn: 自2016年9月起担任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Serving as Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since September 2016.

description.zh-cn: 自2023年1月起担任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Serving as Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since January 2023.

description.zh-cn: 自2023年1月起担任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Serving as Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since January 2023.

description.zh-cn: 自2024年5月起担任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Serving as Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since May 2024.

description.zh-cn: 自2024年5月起担任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Serving as Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since May 2024.

description.zh-cn: 自2025年7月起担任安徽省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Serving as Vice Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since July 2025.

description.zh-cn: 自2020年12月起担任安徽省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: Serving as Secretary-General of the Anhui Provincial People's Government since December 2020.

description.zh-cn: 1949年2月16日，中共中央华东局决定设立安徽省人民政府，但后于4月7日中止筹建。
description.en: On February 16, 1949, the East China Bureau of the CPC Central Committee decided to establish the Anhui Provincial People's Government, but preparations were suspended on April 7.

description.zh-cn: 1949年2月16日，中共中央华东局决定设立中共安徽省委。
description.en: On February 16, 1949, the East China Bureau of the CPC Central Committee decided to establish the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在安徽省人民政府首次筹建期间被任命为省政府主席。
description.en: Appointed as Chairman of the Provincial Government during the initial preparation for the establishment of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 担任首任中共安徽省委书记。
description.en: Served as the first Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1949年4月7日，经中央批准，安徽省人民政府中止筹建。
description.en: On April 7, 1949, with the approval of the Central Government, the preparations for the establishment of the Anhui Provincial People's Government were suspended.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月7日，皖北人民行政公署与皖南人民行政公署合并，成立安徽省人民政府。
description.en: On August 7, 1952, the North Anhui People's Administrative Office merged with the South Anhui People's Administrative Office to form the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月7日，皖南人民行政公署与皖北人民行政公署合并，成立安徽省人民政府。
description.en: On August 7, 1952, the South Anhui People's Administrative Office merged with the North Anhui People's Administrative Office to form the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月7日，中央人民政府批准撤销皖北、皖南行署，成立安徽省人民政府。
description.en: On August 7, 1952, the Central People's Government approved the dissolution of the North and South Anhui Administrative Offices and the establishment of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月7日，中央人民政府批准撤销皖北行署。
description.en: On August 7, 1952, the Central People's Government approved the dissolution of the North Anhui Administrative Office.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月7日，中央人民政府批准撤销皖南行署。
description.en: On August 7, 1952, the Central People's Government approved the dissolution of the South Anhui Administrative Office.

description.zh-cn: 1955年3月，安徽省人民政府改组为安徽省人民委员会。
description.en: In March 1955, the Anhui Provincial People's Government was reorganized into the Anhui Provincial People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1968年4月，安徽省人民委员会被安徽省革命委员会取代。
description.en: In April 1968, the Anhui Provincial People's Committee was replaced by the Anhui Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省人民政府在业务上接受中华人民共和国国务院的领导。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial People's Government is professionally subordinate to the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省人民政府在组织上接受安徽省人民代表大会的领导和监督。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial People's Government is organizationally subordinate to and supervised by the Anhui Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省人民政府在组织上接受安徽省人民代表大会常务委员会的领导和监督。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial People's Government is organizationally subordinate to and supervised by the Standing Committee of the Anhui Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省巢湖管理局为省政府派出机构，由合肥市人民政府管理。
description.en: Anhui Provincial Chaohu Lake Administration is a dispatched agency of the provincial government and is managed by the Hefei Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 刘鼎新出生于攸县鸾山镇江冲村。
description.en: Liu Dingxin was born in Jiangchong Village, Luanshan Town, You County.

description.zh-cn: 刘鼎新于1972年加入中国人民解放军。
description.en: Liu Dingxin joined the People's Liberation Army in 1972.

description.zh-cn: 刘鼎新毕业于中山大学行政管理专业。
description.en: Liu Dingxin graduated from Sun Yat-sen University with a degree in Public Administration.

description.zh-cn: 刘鼎新曾担任海南军区政治部主任，直至2007年8月。同年8月，他被任命为海南省军区政治委员。
description.en: Liu Dingxin served as the Director of the Political Department of the Hainan Military District until August 2007. In the same month, he was appointed as the Political Commissar of the Hainan Military District.

description.zh-cn: 2008年6月，刘鼎新任中共海南省委常委。
description.en: In June 2008, Liu Dingxin became a member of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 2008年起，刘鼎新担任第十一届全国人民代表大会解放军代表，任期5年。
description.en: Starting in 2008, Liu Dingxin served as a PLA delegate to the 11th National People's Congress for a five-year term.

description.zh-cn: 刘鼎新是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Liu Dingxin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘鼎新拥有中国人民解放军少将军衔。
description.en: Liu Dingxin holds the rank of Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 贺东风担任中国商用飞机有限责任公司董事长。
description.en: He Dongfeng serves as the Chairman of the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 周新民担任中国商用飞机有限责任公司总经理。
description.en: Zhou Xinmin serves as the General Manager of the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China, Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务院总理温家宝主持召开国务院常务会议，原则批准大型飞机研制重大科技专项正式立项，同意组建大型客机股份公司，从而推动了中国商飞的成立。
description.en: Then-Premier Wen Jiabao chaired an executive meeting of the State Council, which approved in principle the formal establishment of a major science and technology project for the development of large aircraft and agreed to form a large passenger aircraft joint-stock company, thus promoting the establishment of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 代表中华人民共和国国务院出资60亿元人民币，占股31.58%，参与创立中国商用飞机有限责任公司。
description.en: Representing the State Council of the People's Republic of China, invested 6 billion RMB, accounting for a 31.58% stake, to participate in the founding of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 代表上海市人民政府出资50亿元人民币，占股26.32%，参与创立中国商用飞机有限责任公司。
description.en: Representing the Shanghai Municipal People's Government, invested 5 billion RMB, accounting for a 26.32% stake, to participate in the founding of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 以资产和现金出资50亿元人民币，占股26.32%，参与创立中国商用飞机有限责任公司。
description.en: Invested 5 billion RMB in assets and cash, accounting for a 26.32% stake, to participate in the founding of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 以现金出资10亿元人民币，占股5.26%，参与创立中国商用飞机有限责任公司。
description.en: Invested 1 billion RMB in cash, accounting for a 5.26% stake, to participate in the founding of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 以现金出资10亿元人民币，占股5.26%，参与创立中国商用飞机有限责任公司。
description.en: Invested 1 billion RMB in cash, accounting for a 5.26% stake, to participate in the founding of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 以现金出资10亿元人民币，占股5.26%，参与创立中国商用飞机有限责任公司。
description.en: Invested 1 billion RMB in cash, accounting for a 5.26% stake, to participate in the founding of COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府将中国商飞列为中国人民解放军“拥有或控制”的公司，从而禁止任何美国公司或个人对其进行投资。
description.en: The U.S. government listed COMAC as a company "owned or controlled" by the People's Liberation Army, thereby prohibiting any U.S. company or individual from investing in it.

description.zh-cn: 上海飞机制造有限公司是中国商用飞机有限责任公司下辖的总装制造中心。
description.en: Shanghai Aircraft Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is the final assembly and manufacturing center under COMAC.

description.zh-cn: 上海国盛（集团）有限公司代表上海市人民政府出资。
description.en: Shanghai Guosheng (Group) Co., Ltd. makes investments on behalf of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于1954年调整行政区划，省级行政区成为最高级别行政区，取代了大行政区原有的地位。
description.en: The People's Republic of China adjusted its administrative divisions in 1954, making provincial-level divisions the highest level, replacing the former status of greater administrative areas.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院负责规定全国行政区划中省级行政区的排列顺序。
description.en: The State Council of the People's Republic of China is responsible for stipulating the order of provincial-level administrative divisions within the national administrative division system.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来曾将当时中国的三十个省级行政区名称编成一首七言诗，以便于民众记忆和了解国家的行政区划。
description.en: Zhou Enlai once compiled the names of China's thirty provincial-level administrative divisions at the time into a seven-character poem to help people memorize and understand the country's administrative divisions.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与菲律宾在南海诸岛存在领土主权争议。
description.en: The People's Republic of China and the Philippines have territorial sovereignty disputes over the South China Sea Islands.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与马来西亚在南海诸岛存在领土主权争议。
description.en: The People's Republic of China and Malaysia have territorial sovereignty disputes over the South China Sea Islands.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与印度在西藏自治区南部存在领土主权争议（中印边界问题）。
description.en: The People's Republic of China and India have a territorial sovereignty dispute in the southern part of the Tibet Autonomous Region (Sino-Indian border dispute).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与不丹在西藏自治区部分区域存在领土主权争议（中不边界争议）。
description.en: The People's Republic of China and Bhutan have a territorial sovereignty dispute in parts of the Tibet Autonomous Region (Bhutan-China border dispute).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国与日本在钓鱼岛及其附属岛屿存在领土主权争议。
description.en: The People's Republic of China and Japan have a territorial sovereignty dispute over the Diaoyu/Senkaku Islands and their surrounding islets.

description.zh-cn: 2024年5月10日，张远松因涉嫌“严重违纪违法”，接受湖南省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
description.en: On May 10, 2024, Zhang Yuansong was placed under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision for suspected 'serious violations of discipline and law'.

description.zh-cn: 2024年5月10日，张远松因涉嫌“严重违纪违法”，接受湖南省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
description.en: On May 10, 2024, Zhang Yuansong was placed under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision for suspected 'serious violations of discipline and law'.

description.zh-cn: 2024年11月2日，张远松遭到开除党籍开除公职（双开）处分，其政治生涯终结。
description.en: On November 2, 2024, Zhang Yuansong was subject to 'double expulsion' (expelled from the Party and removed from public office), ending his political career.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军东部战区军事法院的上诉法院和业务上级是中国人民解放军军事法院。
description.en: The appellate court and professional superior of the PLA Eastern Theater Command Military Court is the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军东部战区军事法院在组织上隶属于中国人民解放军东部战区。
description.en: The PLA Eastern Theater Command Military Court is organizationally subordinate to the PLA Eastern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 2015年11月，习近平以中央军委主席身份在军委改革工作会议上发表讲话。
description.en: In November 2015, Xi Jinping, as Chairman of the Central Military Commission, delivered a speech at the CMC work conference on reform.

description.zh-cn: 在军委改革工作会议上要求调整军事司法体制，按区域设置军事法院，从而推动了中国人民解放军东部战区军事法院的建立。
description.en: At the CMC work conference on reform, he called for adjusting the military judicial system and setting up military courts by region, which promoted the establishment of the PLA Eastern Theater Command Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 在军委改革工作会议上要求组建新的军委政法委。
description.en: At the CMC work conference on reform, he called for the formation of a new Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委政法委在北京举行全军军事法院、军事检察院调整组建大会，正式组建了包括东部战区军事法院在内的新军事司法机构。
description.en: The Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CMC held a conference in Beijing on the adjustment and establishment of military courts and procuratorates, officially forming new military judicial bodies including the Eastern Theater Command Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 发布《关于重新编制发布军事法院代字的通知》，将中国人民解放军东部战区军事法院正式确定为中级军事法院，法院代字为“军01”。
description.en: Issued the 'Notice on Re-compiling and Publishing the Code Words of Military Courts', which officially designated the PLA Eastern Theater Command Military Court as an intermediate military court with the court code 'Jun 01'.

description.zh-cn: 韩正接替王岐山出任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Han Zheng succeeded Wang Qishan as the Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 丁薛祥接替韩正出任排名第一的国务院副总理。
description.en: Ding Xuexiang succeeded Han Zheng as the first-ranking Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 韩正接替俞正声出任中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Han Zheng succeeded Yu Zhengsheng as the Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李强接替韩正出任中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Li Qiang succeeded Han Zheng as the Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 韩正在上海大中华橡胶厂任职期间，时任上海市长朱镕基曾前往考查，并对韩正的工作予以了肯定。
description.en: While Han Zheng was working at the Shanghai Dazhonghua Rubber Factory, then-Mayor of Shanghai Zhu Rongji inspected the factory and affirmed Han Zheng's work.

description.zh-cn: 因陈良宇被停职，韩正代理中共上海市委书记职务。
description.en: Due to Chen Liangyu's suspension, Han Zheng became the acting Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 韩正作为习近平的特别代表出席了英国国王查尔斯三世和卡米拉王后加冕仪式。
description.en: Han Zheng attended the coronation of King Charles III and Queen Camilla as a special representative of Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 韩正出席了在伦敦举行的卡米拉王后加冕仪式。
description.en: Han Zheng attended the coronation ceremony of Queen Camilla in London.

position.zh-cn: 中共上海市委代理书记
position.en: Acting Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee

description.zh-cn: 韩正代理上海市委书记期间，胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记。
description.en: While Han Zheng was the acting Party Secretary of Shanghai, Hu Jintao was the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张智刚担任国家电网有限公司的董事长。
description.en: Zhang Zhigang serves as the Chairman of State Grid Corporation of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网有限公司由其前身国家电力公司于2002年拆分重组而成。
description.en: State Grid Corporation of China was formed from the breakup and restructuring of its predecessor, the State Power Corporation of China, in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网有限公司是经中华人民共和国国务院同意进行国家授权投资的机构和国家控股公司。
description.en: State Grid Corporation of China is an institution authorized for state investment and a state-controlled holding company with the approval of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网有限公司是一家特大型中央企业。
description.en: State Grid Corporation of China is a super-large central state-owned enterprise.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网有限公司向美国Sempra Energy公司收购其智利资产Chilquinta Energia。
description.en: State Grid Corporation of China acquired the Chilean asset Chilquinta Energia from the US company Sempra Energy.

description.zh-cn: 国家电网收购新加坡能源有限公司于澳洲的子公司资产。
description.en: State Grid acquired assets of Singapore Power's subsidiaries in Australia.

description.zh-cn: 黄树则出生于天津。
description.en: Huang Shuze was born in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 黄树则于1932年进入北平大学医学院学习，并于1938年毕业。
description.en: Huang Shuze entered Peiping University Medical College in 1932 and graduated in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 黄树则在北平大学医学院学习期间参加了一二·九运动。
description.en: Huang Shuze participated in the December 9th Movement while studying at Peiping University Medical College.

description.zh-cn: 1938年，黄树则毕业后奔赴延安参加八路军。
description.en: In 1938, after graduation, Huang Shuze went to Yan'an to join the Eighth Route Army.

position.zh-cn: 医务主任、儿科主任、院长
position.en: Medical Director, Head of Pediatrics, President

description.zh-cn: 1939年起，黄树则在延安白求恩国际和平医院担任医务主任、儿科主任及院长。
description.en: Starting in 1939, Huang Shuze served as the Medical Director, Head of Pediatrics, and President of the Bethune International Peace Hospital in Yan'an.

description.zh-cn: 1943年，黄树则任毛泽东的保健医生。
description.en: In 1943, Huang Shuze became Mao Zedong's personal physician.

position.en: Deputy Minister of the Health Department

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战后，黄树则任第一野战军卫生部副部长。
description.en: After the Second Chinese Civil War, Huang Shuze served as the Deputy Minister of the Health Department of the First Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，黄树则历任北京医院院长。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Huang Shuze served as the President of Beijing Hospital.

position.en: Director of the Education Division of the Health Department

description.zh-cn: 黄树则曾担任总后勤部卫生部教育处处长。
description.en: Huang Shuze served as the Director of the Education Division of the Health Department of the General Logistics Department.

position.en: Director of the Health Care Bureau

description.zh-cn: 黄树则曾担任中华人民共和国卫生部保健局局长。
description.en: Huang Shuze served as the Director of the Health Care Bureau of the Ministry of Health of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料，黄树则曾是中央保健委员会委员。
description.en: According to records, Huang Shuze was a member of the Central Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料，黄树则曾是中华诗词学会顾问。
description.en: According to records, Huang Shuze was an advisor to the Chinese Poetry Society.

description.zh-cn: 一般认为，印度种姓制度是随雅利安人入侵印度而创立的社会制度。
description.en: It is generally believed that the caste system in India was a social institution established following the invasion of the Aryans.

description.zh-cn: 雅利安人入侵印度次大陆时，征服了当地的住民达罗毗荼人。
description.en: When the Aryans invaded the Indian subcontinent, they conquered the local inhabitants, the Dravidians.

description.zh-cn: 佛教宣称众生平等，是为了反对不平等的种姓制度而创立的宗教。
description.en: Buddhism, which proclaims the equality of all living beings, was founded as a religion to oppose the unequal caste system.

description.zh-cn: 耆那教宣称众生平等，是为了反对不平等的种姓制度而创立的宗教。
description.en: Jainism, which proclaims the equality of all living beings, was founded as a religion to oppose the unequal caste system.

description.zh-cn: 在英属印度时期，由英国人带来的西方平权思想很大程度上冲击了种姓制度。
description.en: During the British Raj, Western ideas of equal rights brought by the British significantly impacted the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 印度宪法第15条和第17条明文规定禁止种姓歧视并废除“不可接触制”，从法律上废除了种姓制度。
description.en: Articles 15 and 17 of the Indian Constitution explicitly prohibit caste-based discrimination and abolish "untouchability," legally abolishing the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 甘地曾致力于劝说印度人民放弃种姓制度。
description.en: Gandhi worked to persuade the Indian people to abandon the caste system.

description.zh-cn: 古代印度的婆罗门发展出一套称为“瓦尔那”的分类架构，作为解释并简化整个种姓制度的方式。
description.en: The Brahmins of ancient India developed a classification framework called "Varna" to explain and simplify the entire caste system.

description.zh-cn: 瓦尔那理论的内涵主要见于《摩奴法典》等早期婆罗门教经典。
description.en: The substance of the Varna theory is primarily found in early Brahmanical texts such as the Manusmriti.

description.zh-cn: 作为统治阶级，婆罗门依靠剥削包括首陀罗在内的中下阶层为生。
description.en: As a ruling class, the Brahmins lived by exploiting the middle and lower classes, including the Shudras.

description.zh-cn: 作为统治阶级，刹帝利依靠剥削包括吠舍在内的中下阶层为生。
description.en: As a ruling class, the Kshatriyas lived by exploiting the middle and lower classes, including the Vaishyas.

description.zh-cn: 作为统治阶级，刹帝利依靠剥削包括首陀罗在内的中下阶层为生。
description.en: As a ruling class, the Kshatriyas lived by exploiting the middle and lower classes, including the Shudras.

description.zh-cn: 释迦牟尼是佛教的创始人。
description.en: Gautama Buddha is the founder of Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 佛教创始人释迦牟尼在教义中公开反对任何形式的种姓结构。
description.en: The founder of Buddhism, Gautama Buddha, openly opposed any form of caste structure in his teachings.

description.zh-cn: 笩駄摩那是耆那教的创始人。
description.en: Mahavira is the founder of Jainism.

description.zh-cn: 耆那教的创始人笩駄摩那反对任何形式的种姓结构。
description.en: The founder of Jainism, Mahavira, opposed any form of caste structure.

description.zh-cn: 印度教改革者辨喜相信印度教无种姓制度容身之地。
description.en: Hindu reformer Swami Vivekananda believed there was no place for the caste system in Hinduism.

description.zh-cn: 黄春明被普遍公认为台湾当代重要的乡土小说家，其作品深刻描绘了兰阳平原的农村生活，极大地推动了乡土文学的发展。
description.en: Huang Chunming is widely regarded as a major contemporary Nativist novelist in Taiwan. His works, which vividly depict rural life on the Lanyang Plain, have significantly advanced the development of Nativist literature.

description.zh-cn: 其作品经由王贤春老师推荐给黄春明阅读，对其早期创作产生影响。
description.en: His works were recommended to Huang Chunming by his teacher Wang Xianchun, influencing his early writing.

description.zh-cn: 其作品经由王贤春老师推荐给黄春明阅读，对其早期创作产生影响。
description.en: His works were recommended to Huang Chunming by his teacher Wang Xianchun, influencing his early writing.

description.zh-cn: 其作品经由王贤春老师推荐给黄春明阅读，对其早期创作产生影响。
description.en: His works were recommended to Huang Chunming by his teacher Wang Xianchun, influencing his early writing.

description.zh-cn: 黄春明在救国团《幼狮通讯》上发表了第一篇小说《清道伕的孩子》，正式开始其写作生涯。
description.en: Huang Chunming began his official writing career by publishing his first short story, 'The Scavenger's Child,' in the China Youth Corps' 'Youth Lions Correspondence'.

description.zh-cn: 在担任联合报副刊主编期间，大力提携黄春明，使其得以进入文坛。
description.en: As the editor of the United Daily News literary supplement, she strongly supported Huang Chunming, enabling his entry into the literary world.

description.zh-cn: 侯孝贤执导了根据黄春明小说改编的三段式电影《儿子的大玩偶》中的一段。
description.en: Hou Hsiao-hsien directed one segment of the anthology film 'The Sandwich Man,' which was based on Huang Chunming's novels.

description.zh-cn: 吴念真为多部改编自黄春明小说的电影撰写剧本，包括《儿子的大玩偶》和《两个油漆匠》。
description.en: Wu Nien-jen wrote the screenplays for several films adapted from Huang Chunming's novels, including 'The Sandwich Man' and 'The Two Painters'.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学于2022年11月15日授予黄春明名誉博士学位。
description.en: National Taiwan University conferred an honorary doctorate upon Huang Chunming on November 15, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在黄春明演讲期间，蒋为文高举海报抗议其未使用台语文创作，引发激烈言语冲突，并后续提起诉讼。
description.en: During a lecture by Huang Chunming, Chiang Wei-wen held up a poster to protest his non-use of the Taiwanese language, leading to a heated verbal conflict and a subsequent lawsuit.

description.zh-cn: 在与黄春明发生“台语文事件”冲突后，蒋为文以公然侮辱罪控告黄春明。
description.en: Following the 'Taiwanese Language Incident' conflict with Huang Chunming, Chiang Wei-wen sued Huang for public insult.

description.zh-cn: 黄春明以环保为由，反对兴建苏花高速公路。
description.en: Huang Chunming opposed the construction of the Suao-Hualien Expressway on environmental grounds.

description.zh-cn: 作为签约方参与了《尼布楚条约》的谈判和签订。
description.en: Participated in the negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk as a contracting party.

description.zh-cn: 作为签约方参与了《尼布楚条约》的谈判和签订。
description.en: Participated in the negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk as a contracting party.

description.zh-cn: 雅克萨之战是《尼布楚条约》谈判的直接背景，战后双方为解决边界争端而签订此条约。
description.en: The Battle of Yaksa was the direct context for the negotiations of the Treaty of Nerchinsk; the treaty was signed after the battle to resolve the border dispute.

description.zh-cn: 于平定三藩之乱后，派遣军队进攻雅克萨，引发了雅克萨之战。
description.en: After suppressing the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, he dispatched troops to attack Yaksa, triggering the Battle of Yaksa.

description.zh-cn: 受康熙帝派遣，率军攻打雅克萨。
description.en: Was dispatched by the Kangxi Emperor to lead troops to attack Yaksa.

description.zh-cn: 俄国向西伯利亚及远东的殖民扩张，导致其与清朝产生军事接触，最终引发了雅克萨之战等冲突。
description.en: Russia's colonial expansion into Siberia and the Far East led to military contact with the Qing dynasty, eventually triggering conflicts such as the Battle of Yaksa.

description.zh-cn: 自伊凡四世时期开始，俄国加速了对西伯利亚和远东地区的殖民征服。
description.en: Since the time of Ivan IV, Russia accelerated its colonial conquest of Siberia and the Far East.

description.zh-cn: 条约的签订在一百多年内有效阻止了俄国向黑龙江中下游地区的扩张。
description.en: The signing of the treaty effectively halted Russian expansion into the middle and lower reaches of the Heilongjiang (Amur River) for over a century.

description.zh-cn: 《中俄北京条约》与《瑷珲条约》一同重新划分了中俄东部边界，完全取代了《尼布楚条约》。
description.en: The Convention of Peking, along with the Treaty of Aigun, redefined the eastern Sino-Russian border, completely replacing the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 《尼布楚条约》是中国历史上首次在国际法精神下，与欧洲国家按对等方式谈判达成的条约。
description.en: The Treaty of Nerchinsk was the first treaty in Chinese history negotiated and concluded with a European power on an equal footing, in the spirit of international law.

description.zh-cn: 耶稣会传教士在条约谈判中担任翻译并积极参与，对条约的达成起到了关键作用。
description.en: Jesuit missionaries served as interpreters and actively participated in the treaty negotiations, playing a key role in its conclusion.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝全权代表之一参与《尼布楚条约》的谈判与签订。
description.en: Participated as one of the Plenipotentiary Representatives of the Qing dynasty in the negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝全权代表之一参与《尼布楚条约》的谈判与签订。
description.en: Participated as one of the Plenipotentiary Representatives of the Qing dynasty in the negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄国全权代表参与《尼布楚条约》的谈判与签订。
description.en: Participated as the Plenipotentiary Representative of Russia in the negotiation and signing of the Treaty of Nerchinsk.

description.zh-cn: 《尼布楚条约》规定以外兴安岭为中俄国界的一部分。
description.en: The Treaty of Nerchinsk stipulated that the Stanovoy Range would serve as part of the border between China and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 《尼布楚条约》规定以额尔古纳河为中俄国界的一部分。
description.en: The Treaty of Nerchinsk stipulated that the Argun River would serve as part of the border between China and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过决定，设立全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会。
description.en: The First Session of the 13th National People's Congress passed a decision to establish the National People's Congress Social Construction Committee.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是设立全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会的法律依据。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the legal basis for the establishment of the National People's Congress Social Construction Committee.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会组织法》是全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会的组织法规。
description.en: The Organic Law of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China serves as the organizational statute for the National People's Congress Social Construction Committee.

description.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会是全国人民代表大会设立的专门委员会，向其负责。
description.en: The National People's Congress Social Construction Committee is a special committee established by and responsible to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在全国人民代表大会闭会期间，全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会受全国人民代表大会常务委员会领导。
description.en: During the recess of the National People's Congress, the Social Construction Committee is under the leadership of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杨振武担任第十四届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会主任委员。
description.en: Yang Zhenwu serves as the Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 何毅亭担任第十三届全国人民代表大会社会建设委员会主任委员。
description.en: He Yiting served as the Chairman of the Social Construction Committee of the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杜琪峰出生于香港新九龙深水埗通州街。
description.en: Johnnie To was born on Tung Chau Street, Sham Shui Po, New Kowloon, Hong Kong.

position.zh-cn: 艺员训练班学员、制作助理、编导
position.en: Artist Training Class Trainee, Production Assistant, Director

description.zh-cn: 1974年入读无线电视艺员训练班，毕业后转任幕后，从制作助理升至编导，约1979年离开。
description.en: He enrolled in the TVB artist training class in 1974, and after graduation, he worked behind the scenes, rising from production assistant to director, leaving around 1979.

description.zh-cn: 录取杜琪峰入读香港无线电视艺员训练班。
description.en: Admitted Johnnie To to the Hong Kong TVB artist training program.

description.zh-cn: 赏识杜琪峰并将其由制作助理提拔为编导，杜琪峰视其为伯乐。
description.en: Recognized Johnnie To's talent and promoted him from production assistant to director; To considers him a mentor.

description.zh-cn: 王天林赏识杜琪峰，并教导其节目制作知识，是其导师。
description.en: Wong Tin-lam appreciated Johnnie To and taught him program production knowledge, acting as his mentor.

description.zh-cn: 于1979至1980年间推荐杜琪峰执导其首部电影《碧水寒山夺命金》。
description.en: Between 1979 and 1980, he recommended Johnnie To to direct his debut film, 'The Enigmatic Case'.

description.zh-cn: 1986年受邀到新艺城拍摄电影，执导了《开心鬼撞鬼》、《八星报喜》等多部作品。
description.en: In 1986, he was invited to work at Cinema City, where he directed several films, including 'Happy Ghost III' and 'The Eighth Happiness'.

description.zh-cn: 与韦家辉于1996年共同组建了银河映像。
description.en: Co-founded Milkyway Image with Wai Ka-fai in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 与杜琪峰于1996年共同组建了银河映像。
description.en: Co-founded Milkyway Image with Johnnie To in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 2023年在柏林影展记者会上发表关于电影与极权、自由的言论，被指影射中国政府为独裁政府，引发争议并疑似遭到内地官方封杀。
description.en: In February 2023, at a press conference at the Berlin Film Festival, he made remarks about cinema, totalitarianism, and freedom, which were interpreted as implying the Chinese government is a dictatorship. This sparked controversy and led to a suspected official ban in mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 在杜琪峰于柏林影展发表争议言论后，其在新浪微博上的粉丝帐号遭到封锁。
description.en: After Johnnie To's controversial remarks at the Berlin Film Festival, his fan accounts on Sina Weibo were blocked.

description.zh-cn: 杜琪峰十分欣赏黑泽明，称其对自己影响最大，并在电影《柔道龙虎榜》片末打上“献给黑泽明”。
description.en: Johnnie To greatly admires Akira Kurosawa, stating he was his biggest influence, and dedicated his film 'Throw Down' to him.

description.zh-cn: 杜琪峰对胡金铨崇拜有加，认为其发展了亚洲文化。
description.en: Johnnie To deeply admires King Hu, believing that he developed Asian culture.

description.zh-cn: 杜琪峰与刘德华是长期合作的伙伴，刘德华经常担任其电影主角，合作作品包括《天若有情》、《暗战》、《孤男寡女》、《瘦身男女》、《盲探》等。
description.en: Johnnie To and Andy Lau are long-term collaborators, with Lau often starring in his films, including 'A Moment of Romance', 'Running on Karma', 'Needing You...', 'Love on a Diet', 'Blind Detective', and others.

description.zh-cn: 在电影《天若有情》中，陈木胜为挂名导演，而监制杜琪峰执导了大部分场面。
description.en: For the film 'A Moment of Romance', Benny Chan was the credited director, while producer Johnnie To directed most of the scenes.

description.zh-cn: 据李志绥的回忆录，毛泽东患有肌萎缩性脊髓侧索硬化症，这是其死亡的原因之一。
description.en: According to Li Zhisui's memoir, Mao Zedong suffered from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, which was one of the causes of his death.

description.zh-cn: 1976年6月初，毛泽东突患心肌梗塞，经抢救脱险，但健康状况急剧恶化。
description.en: In early June 1976, Mao Zedong suffered a sudden myocardial infarction. Although he was saved, his health deteriorated rapidly.

description.zh-cn: 台湾《中央日报》的报道称，四五天安门事件加剧了毛泽东的病情，是他的“催命符”。
description.en: According to Taiwan's Central Daily News, the Tiananmen Incident aggravated Mao Zedong's illness and was his 'death warrant'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会是联合发表《告全党全军全国各族人民书》的机构之一。
description.en: The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was one of the bodies that jointly issued the 'Message to the Whole Party, the Whole Army and the People of All Nationalities Throughout the Country'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会常务委员会是联合发表《告全党全军全国各族人民书》的机构之一。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the PRC was one of the bodies that jointly issued the 'Message to the Whole Party, the Whole Army and the People of All Nationalities Throughout the Country'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国国务院是联合发表《告全党全军全国各族人民书》的机构之一。
description.en: The State Council of the People's Republic of China was one of the bodies that jointly issued the 'Message to the Whole Party, the Whole Army and the People of All Nationalities Throughout the Country'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会是联合发表《告全党全军全国各族人民书》的机构之一。
description.en: The Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China was one of the bodies that jointly issued the 'Message to the Whole Party, the Whole Army and the People of All Nationalities Throughout the Country'.

description.zh-cn: 金日成在唁电中称毛泽东是“朝鲜人民最亲密的战友”。
description.en: In his condolence message, Kim Il Sung referred to Mao Zedong as 'the closest comrade-in-arms of the Korean people'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东领导中国在朝鲜战争期间发起抗美援朝运动，以鲜血援助了朝鲜。
description.en: Mao Zedong led China to launch the 'Resist America, Aid Korea' campaign during the Korean War, providing crucial support to North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔巴尼亚劳动党在唁电中称毛泽东为“最亲爱和最尊贵的朋友”。
description.en: In its condolence message, the Party of Labour of Albania called Mao Zedong 'their dearest and most respected friend'.

description.zh-cn: 1977年，阿尔巴尼亚劳动党开始公开批判毛泽东的三个世界理论，称其“背离马列主义”。
description.en: In 1977, the Party of Labour of Albania began to openly criticize Mao Zedong's Three Worlds Theory, calling it a 'deviation from Marxism-Leninism'.

description.zh-cn: 法国总统的唁电中提及，戴高乐将军深切敬仰毛泽东，并与他共同促成了中法两国互相接近。
description.en: The French president's condolence message mentioned that General de Gaulle deeply admired Mao Zedong and worked with him to foster closer relations between China and France.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党党报《中央日报》在头版以“祸国殃民·百死莫赎 毛匪泽东毙命”为标题报道了毛泽东的死讯。
description.en: The Kuomintang's official newspaper, Central Daily News, reported Mao Zedong's death on its front page with the headline 'A Scourge to the Nation, a Criminal Whose Death Cannot Atone for His Sins, the Bandit Mao Zedong is Dead'.

description.zh-cn: 1959年藏区骚乱失败后，第十四世达赖喇嘛（丹增嘉措）从拉萨流亡到印度。
description.en: After the failure of the 1959 Tibetan uprising, the 14th Dalai Lama (Tenzin Gyatso) fled from Lhasa into exile in India.

description.zh-cn: 1959年藏区骚乱后，第十四世达赖喇嘛流亡印度并建立了藏人行政中央。
description.en: After the 1959 Tibetan uprising, the 14th Dalai Lama went into exile in India and established the Central Tibetan Administration.

description.zh-cn: 在1959年流亡印度后，建立了藏人行政中央。
description.en: After going into exile in India in 1959, he established the Central Tibetan Administration.

description.zh-cn: 于1960年建立了西藏流亡议会。
description.en: Established the Tibetan Parliament in Exile in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 作为最高领导者，直至2011年3月14日致信西藏流亡议会，要求卸下一切政治权力。
description.en: Served as the supreme leader until March 14, 2011, when he wrote to the Tibetan Parliament in Exile requesting to relinquish all political power.

description.zh-cn: 通过卸下一切政治权力，将统治权交给民选领导人，推动并完成了藏人行政中央的政教分离。
description.en: By relinquishing all political power and handing it over to an elected leader, he promoted and completed the separation of religion and state within the Central Tibetan Administration.

description.zh-cn: 将一切政治权力移交给洛桑森格，使其成为新的政治领导人。
description.en: Transferred all political power to Lobsang Sangay, making him the new political leader.

description.zh-cn: 2011年8月8日宣誓就任噶伦赤巴，成为该职位的民选领导人。
description.en: On August 8, 2011, he was sworn in as the Kalon Tripa, becoming the elected leader for this position.

description.zh-cn: 现任西藏司政。
description.en: He is the current Sikyong.

description.zh-cn: 藏人行政中央起源于西藏噶厦政府。
description.en: The Central Tibetan Administration originated from the Kashag government of Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 1959年藏区骚乱后，中华人民共和国政府视原签订的《十七条协议》无效，原西藏地方政府（噶厦）的功能被终止。
description.en: After the 1959 Tibetan uprising, the PRC government deemed the 'Seventeen Point Agreement' invalid, terminating the functions of the original local government of Tibet (Kashag).

description.zh-cn: 1959年藏区骚乱后，中华人民共和国政府视《十七条协议》无效。
description.en: After the 1959 Tibetan uprising, the PRC government deemed the 'Seventeen Point Agreement' invalid.

description.zh-cn: 自1959年以来，中华人民共和国政府与藏人行政中央在西藏主权和治理问题上处于对立状态，尽管双方进行过多次谈判。
description.en: Since 1959, the PRC government and the Central Tibetan Administration have been in an adversarial relationship over the issues of Tibetan sovereignty and governance, despite several rounds of negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 为藏人行政中央提供了总部所在地达兰萨拉，并给予其一些协助。
description.en: Provided Dharamshala as the headquarters for the Central Tibetan Administration and offered some assistance.

description.zh-cn: 于2020年12月通过了《西藏政策及支援法案》。
description.en: Passed the 'Tibetan Policy and Support Act' in December 2020.

description.zh-cn: 该法案承认藏人行政中央是反映全世界西藏人民愿望的合法机构。
description.en: The act recognizes the Central Tibetan Administration as the legitimate institution reflecting the aspirations of Tibetan people worldwide.

description.zh-cn: 314事件后，藏人行政中央与中华人民共和国政府方面进行了数次会面商谈。
description.en: Following the March 14 incident, the Central Tibetan Administration held several meetings and talks with the government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 作为藏人行政中央的代表，与中共中央统战部部长杜青林就西藏问题进行商谈。
description.en: As a representative of the Central Tibetan Administration, he held talks on the Tibet issue with Du Qinglin, head of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共中央统战部部长，并代表中国政府与藏方代表谈判。
description.en: Served as the Minister of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee and represented the Chinese government in negotiations with Tibetan representatives.

position.zh-cn: 保卫指挥使、建雄军节度使、侍卫亲军马步军都虞候
position.en: Defense Commander, Jiedushi of Jianxiong Army, Commander of the Imperial Guard Cavalry and Infantry

description.zh-cn: 杨业早年追随北汉世祖刘崇，效力刘氏共三十年，官至建雄军节度使。
description.en: In his early years, Yang Ye followed Liu Chong, the founder of the Northern Han, and served the Liu family for a total of 30 years, rising to the rank of Jiedushi of Jianxiong Army.

description.zh-cn: 后汉建立后，杨业即追随北汉世祖刘崇。
description.en: After the establishment of the Later Han, Yang Ye followed Liu Chong, the founder of the Northern Han.

position.zh-cn: 左领军卫大将军、郑州防御使、知代州兼三交驻泊兵马部署、云州观察使
position.en: Grand General of the Left Leading Army Guard, Defense Commissioner of Zhengzhou, Administrator of Daizhou and Military Commissioner of the Sanjiao Garrison, Observation Commissioner of Yunzhou

description.zh-cn: 北汉被平定后，杨业归顺北宋，被宋太宗任命为高级将领，负责边防。
description.en: After the Northern Han was pacified, Yang Ye surrendered to the Northern Song and was appointed by Emperor Taizong as a senior general responsible for border defense.

description.zh-cn: 杨业归顺北宋后，作为将领为宋太宗效力。
description.en: After surrendering to the Northern Song, Yang Ye served Emperor Taizong as a general.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗在平定北汉后，招降了以骁勇闻名的杨业，并委以重任。
description.en: After pacifying the Northern Han, Emperor Taizong recruited Yang Ye, who was renowned for his bravery, and entrusted him with significant responsibilities.

description.zh-cn: 杨业作为北宋将领，主要负责在边境地区抵抗辽国的入侵。
description.en: As a general of the Northern Song, Yang Ye was primarily responsible for resisting the invasions of the Liao dynasty in the border regions.

description.zh-cn: 在雍熙北伐中，杨业担任云应路行营副都部署，潘美为该路军主将都部署。
description.en: During the Yongxi Northern Expedition, Yang Ye served as the Deputy Commander of the Yun-Ying Route Field Command, while Pan Mei was the Commander-in-Chief of that army.

description.zh-cn: 杨业作为降将在边境屡立战功，遭到主将潘美的嫉恨，潘美曾秘密上书告状。
description.en: As a surrendered general who repeatedly achieved military merit on the border, Yang Ye incurred the jealousy of his commander, Pan Mei, who secretly submitted a memorial to impeach him.

description.zh-cn: 在雍熙北伐的陈家谷之战中，杨业因孤军奋战、缺乏援兵而兵败被俘，最终绝食而死。
description.en: During the Battle of Chenjiagu in the Yongxi Northern Expedition, Yang Ye was defeated and captured after fighting alone without reinforcements, eventually starving himself to death.

description.zh-cn: 在陈家谷之战中，潘美得知杨业战败后，没有提供救援而是立即率兵撤退，导致杨业全军覆没。
description.en: During the Battle of Chenjiagu, upon learning of Yang Ye's defeat, Pan Mei did not provide rescue but immediately retreated with his troops, leading to the annihilation of Yang Ye's army.

description.zh-cn: 监军王侁反对杨业的稳妥作战计划，以“无敌”之名讥讽并强迫其出战，并在杨业陷入苦战时为争功而离开阵地，是导致杨业兵败身亡的主要责任人之一。
description.en: Military supervisor Wang Shen opposed Yang Ye's cautious battle plan, mocked him with his title 'Invincible' to force him into battle, and abandoned his post to claim credit while Yang Ye was in a desperate fight, making him one of the main individuals responsible for Yang Ye's death.

description.zh-cn: 监军刘文裕与王侁一同赞成与辽军进行主力决战的错误提议，对杨业的失败负有间接责任。
description.en: Military supervisor Liu Wenyu, along with Wang Shen, supported the flawed proposal for a decisive battle with the Liao forces, bearing indirect responsibility for Yang Ye's defeat.

description.zh-cn: 辽将耶律斜轸在陈家谷之战中设伏，并佯装败退，成功诱使杨业中伏，最终击败并俘虏了他。
description.en: The Liao general Yelü Xiezhen set an ambush at the Battle of Chenjiagu and feigned retreat, successfully luring Yang Ye into the trap, ultimately defeating and capturing him.

description.zh-cn: 在陈家谷，辽将耶律奚底射中杨业，使其坠马被擒。
description.en: In Chenjiagu, the Liao officer Yelü Xidi shot Yang Ye, causing him to fall from his horse and be captured.

description.zh-cn: 因杨业战死，宋太宗追究潘美的责任，将其削秩三等，贬为检校太保。
description.en: Due to Yang Ye's death in battle, Emperor Taizong held Pan Mei accountable, demoting him by three ranks to Grand Protector.

description.zh-cn: 因杨业战死，宋太宗追究王侁的责任，将其削去官籍，配隶金州。
description.en: Due to Yang Ye's death in battle, Emperor Taizong held Wang Shen accountable, stripping him of his official rank and exiling him to Jinzhou.

description.zh-cn: 在太平兴国五年三月雁门关之战中，辽国马步军都指挥使李重诲被杨业生擒。
description.en: During the Battle of Yanmen Pass in the third month of the fifth year of the Taiping Xingguo era (980), Li Chonghui, the Liao Commander of Infantry and Cavalry, was captured alive by Yang Ye.

description.zh-cn: 杨业是杨家将的第一代核心人物。
description.en: Yang Ye is the central figure of the first generation of the Yang family generals.

description.zh-cn: 杨延昭是杨家将的第二代核心人物。
description.en: Yang Yanzhao is the central figure of the second generation of the Yang family generals.

description.zh-cn: 杨文广是杨家将的第三代核心人物。
description.en: Yang Wenguang is the central figure of the third generation of the Yang family generals.

description.zh-cn: 北宋文学家欧阳修在其著作中称赞杨业、杨延昭“父子皆名将，其智勇号称无敌”，提升了其历史声望。
description.en: The Northern Song writer Ouyang Xiu praised Yang Ye and Yang Yanzhao in his works, stating 'father and son are both famous generals, their wisdom and courage are known as invincible,' which enhanced their historical reputation.

description.zh-cn: 明孝宗朱祐樘是明宪宗朱见深的第三子。
description.en: The Hongzhi Emperor Zhu Youtang was the third son of the Chenghua Emperor Zhu Jianshen.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗朱厚照是明孝宗的长子和继任者。
description.en: The Zhengde Emperor Zhu Houzhao was the eldest son and successor of the Hongzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱厚炜是明孝宗的次子，早夭。
description.en: Zhu Houwei was the second son of the Hongzhi Emperor and died in infancy.

description.zh-cn: 根据记载，万贵妃在明孝宗幼年时曾试图加害于他，导致其需被藏匿抚养。
description.en: According to records, Consort Wan attempted to harm the Hongzhi Emperor during his childhood, forcing him to be raised in hiding.

description.zh-cn: 明孝宗的身份被明宪宗知晓后，由其祖母周太后（孝肃皇后）接入宫中抚养。
description.en: After his identity was revealed to the Chenghua Emperor, the Hongzhi Emperor was brought into the palace to be raised by his grandmother, Empress Dowager Zhou (Empress Xiaosu).

description.zh-cn: 明宪宗的废后吴氏在明孝宗幼年时曾帮助哺育他，保全其生命。
description.en: The deposed Empress Wu of the Chenghua Emperor helped nurse the young Hongzhi Emperor, saving his life.

description.zh-cn: 大学士商辂等人请求明宪宗将朱祐樘立为皇太子。
description.en: Grand Secretary Shang Lu and others requested the Chenghua Emperor to establish Zhu Youtang as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 刘健是弘治朝的重臣，受到皇帝的信用。后期他也曾批评皇帝的懈怠和浪费。
description.en: Liu Jian was a key minister during the Hongzhi reign and was trusted by the emperor. In the later years, he also criticized the emperor's laxity and extravagance.

description.zh-cn: 谢迁是弘治朝的重臣，与刘健、李东阳等人共辅朝政。
description.en: Xie Qian was a key minister during the Hongzhi reign, assisting in governance alongside Liu Jian and Li Dongyang.

description.zh-cn: 李东阳是弘治朝的重臣，后期曾直言国家财政困难、民生困苦等问题。
description.en: Li Dongyang was a key minister during the Hongzhi reign who, in the later years, spoke frankly about issues such as national financial difficulties and the hardship of the people.

description.zh-cn: 刘大夏在弘治朝被委以重任，曾治理黄河，后升任兵部尚书负责军事整顿。
description.en: Liu Daxia was entrusted with significant responsibilities during the Hongzhi reign, including managing the Yellow River, and was later promoted to Minister of War to oversee military reorganization.

description.zh-cn: 明孝宗纵容外戚，曾赐予其妻弟张延龄大量田地。
description.en: The Hongzhi Emperor indulged his consort's relatives, once granting his brother-in-law Zhang Yanling a vast amount of land.

description.zh-cn: 明孝宗下令斩杀了罪大恶极的僧人继晓。
description.en: The Hongzhi Emperor ordered the execution of the monk Jixiao for his heinous crimes.

description.zh-cn: 太学生虎臣上书力谏，反对明孝宗建造万寿山棕棚的计划。
description.en: Imperial University student Hu Chen submitted a memorial to strongly advise against the Hongzhi Emperor's plan to build a palm pavilion on Wanshou Hill.

description.zh-cn: 1501年，鞑靼部落以十万骑兵入侵明朝固原、宁夏境内，对边防造成严重威胁。
description.en: In 1501, Tatar tribes invaded the Ming territories of Guyuan and Ningxia with 100,000 cavalry, posing a serious threat to the border defense.

description.zh-cn: 王莽废黜孺子婴并篡位称帝，终结了西汉211年的统治。
description.en: Wang Mang deposed Ruzi Ying and usurped the throne, ending the 211-year rule of the Western Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 王莽利用当时盛行的谶纬学说，制造符瑞和祥瑞，为其篡汉称帝提供了理论依据和合法性。
description.en: Wang Mang utilized the prevalent Chenwei theories to fabricate auspicious signs and omens, providing a theoretical basis and legitimacy for his usurpation of the Han throne.

description.zh-cn: 王莽称帝后，主导并推行了一系列全面的社会改革，史称“王莽改制”。
description.en: After becoming emperor, Wang Mang led and implemented a series of comprehensive social reforms, historically known as 'Wang Mang's reforms'.

description.zh-cn: 王莽的改革措施，如官制、土地制度等，大多是依据儒家经典《周礼》中的记载来制定的。
description.en: Most of Wang Mang's reform measures, such as the official system and land system, were formulated based on the records in the Confucian classic, the Rites of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 绿林军起义反抗新朝统治，并于23年攻入首都长安，直接导致了新朝的灭亡。
description.en: The Lülin army rebelled against the rule of the Xin dynasty and captured the capital Chang'an in 23 AD, directly causing the dynasty's collapse.

description.zh-cn: 23年10月6日，绿林军攻入长安，王莽在宫中混乱中被商人杜吴所杀。
description.en: On October 6, 23 AD, the Lülin army broke into Chang'an, and Wang Mang was killed by a merchant named Du Wu amidst the chaos in the palace.

description.zh-cn: 昆阳之战的惨败使新朝丧失了军事主力，从根本上动摇了其统治，加速了其灭亡的进程。
description.en: The disastrous defeat at the Battle of Kunyang caused the Xin dynasty to lose its main military force, fundamentally shaking its rule and accelerating its downfall.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀在昆阳之战中担任指挥，率领数千兵力击溃了王莽方面号称四十二万的新朝大军，取得了决定性胜利，为其日后建立东汉奠定了重要基础。
description.en: Liu Xiu served as a commander in the Battle of Kunyang, leading a force of several thousand to defeat Wang Mang's massive Xin dynasty army of allegedly 420,000. This decisive victory laid a crucial foundation for his eventual establishment of the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 新朝统帅之一王寻在昆阳之战中战败身亡。
description.en: Wang Xun, one of the commanders of the Xin dynasty, was defeated and killed in the Battle of Kunyang.

description.zh-cn: 新朝统帅之一王邑在昆阳之战中惨败，仅率少数人逃回洛阳。
description.en: Wang Yi, another commander of the Xin dynasty, suffered a crushing defeat at the Battle of Kunyang and fled back to Luoyang with only a few men.

description.zh-cn: 绿林军诸将共同拥立刘氏宗族的刘玄为皇帝，以“复兴汉室”为号召，建立更始政权。
description.en: The generals of the Lülin army jointly installed Liu Xuan, a member of the Liu clan, as emperor under the banner of 'reviving the Han dynasty', establishing the Gengshi regime.

description.zh-cn: 刘玄被绿林军拥立为帝，建元更始，史称更始帝或玄汉。
description.en: Liu Xuan was enthroned by the Lülin army, establishing the Gengshi era. He is known as Emperor Gengshi or his regime as Xuan Han.

description.zh-cn: 25年9月，赤眉军攻陷长安，更始帝投降后不久被杀，更始政权灭亡。
description.en: In September of 25 AD, the Chimei army captured Chang'an. Emperor Gengshi surrendered and was killed shortly after, marking the end of the Gengshi regime.

description.zh-cn: 樊崇于18年在莒县率领饥民起事，建立了赤眉军。
description.en: Fan Chong led starving peasants to rise up in Ju County in 18 AD, establishing the Chimei army.

description.zh-cn: 赤眉军为获取政治合法性，拥立汉室后裔刘盆子为皇帝。
description.en: To gain political legitimacy, the Chimei army installed Liu Penzi, a descendant of the Han imperial house, as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 27年，光武帝刘秀率军在华阴击败东归的赤眉军，接受其首领樊崇和皇帝刘盆子的投降。
description.en: In 27 AD, Emperor Guangwu (Liu Xiu) led his forces to defeat the eastward-returning Chimei army at Huayin, accepting the surrender of its leader Fan Chong and emperor Liu Penzi.

description.zh-cn: 更始帝刘玄因猜忌刘𬙂、刘秀兄弟在昆阳之战后功高震主，以违抗命令为由将刘𬙂处死。
description.en: Emperor Gengshi Liu Xuan, jealous of the Liu Yan and Liu Xiu brothers' great prestige after the Battle of Kunyang, executed Liu Yan on the pretext of disobeying orders.

description.zh-cn: 刘𬙂是刘秀的兄长。
description.en: Liu Yan was Liu Xiu's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 王莽将“匈奴单于”的称号贬为“降奴服于”，并试图分裂匈奴，这些外交失策导致匈奴与新朝关系破裂并发动叛乱。
description.en: Wang Mang demoted the title of the Xiongnu Chanyu to 'Xiangnu Fuyu' (Surrendered Slave) and attempted to divide the Xiongnu, these diplomatic blunders led to a breakdown in relations and a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 因王莽的挑衅政策，匈奴与新朝爆发了连年战争，导致边境地区民生凋敝。
description.en: Due to Wang Mang's provocative policies, the Xiongnu and the Xin dynasty engaged in years of warfare, devastating the border regions.

description.zh-cn: 王莽将高句丽国王贬为侯，并改其国名为“下句丽”，引起高句丽不满并最终反叛。
description.en: Wang Mang demoted the king of Goguryeo to a marquis and renamed the country 'Xiagouli' (Lower Goguryeo), causing resentment and eventual rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 王莽强令高句丽出兵讨伐匈奴，导致其反叛，并屡次侵扰新朝东北边境。
description.en: Wang Mang's forcible conscription of Goguryeo troops to attack the Xiongnu led to its rebellion, and it repeatedly raided the northeastern border of the Xin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 25年，公孙述在蜀地称帝，建立国号为“成家”的割据政权。
description.en: In 25 AD, Gongsun Shu declared himself emperor in the Shu region, establishing a secessionist state with the title 'Chengjia'.

description.zh-cn: 36年，东汉光武帝刘秀派兵攻克成都，灭亡了公孙述的成家政权，公孙述在战乱中死去。
description.en: In 36 AD, Emperor Guangwu of the Eastern Han, Liu Xiu, dispatched troops to capture Chengdu, destroying Gongsun Shu's Chengjia regime. Gongsun Shu died in the battle.

description.zh-cn: 新朝建立后，王莽大力提倡古文经学，并设立了相关博士官职，使古文经地位得到提升。
description.en: After establishing the Xin dynasty, Wang Mang vigorously promoted the Old Text Classics and established related academic positions, elevating their status.

description.zh-cn: 刘歆是西汉末年至新朝时期古文经学派的巨儒，他大力提倡古文经，并建议朝廷为之设立学官。
description.en: Liu Xin was a leading scholar of the Old Text School from the late Western Han to the Xin dynasty. He strongly advocated for the Old Text Classics and recommended the court to establish official positions for their study.

description.zh-cn: 刘歆是王莽的重要参谋之一，为其篡汉和改制提供了学术和理论支持。
description.en: Liu Xin was one of Wang Mang's key advisors, providing academic and theoretical support for his usurpation and reforms.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国副主席向全国人民代表大会负责，由其选举产生。
description.en: The Vice President of the People's Republic of China is responsible to and elected by the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1954年宪法首次设立了中华人民共和国副主席的职位。
description.en: The 1954 Constitution first established the post of Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1975年宪法取消了中华人民共和国副主席的职位。
description.en: The 1975 Constitution abolished the post of Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年宪法修正案废除了中华人民共和国副主席的连任限制。
description.en: The 2018 constitutional amendment removed the term limits for the Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 九一三事件后，董必武被宣布为唯一的代理主席。
description.en: After the September 13 Incident, Dong Biwu was announced as the sole acting president.

description.zh-cn: 第十四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议选举韩正为中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: The first session of the 14th National People's Congress elected Han Zheng as the Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 荣毅仁是中国民主建国会成员。
description.en: Rong Yiren was a member of the China National Democratic Construction Association.

description.zh-cn: 革命成功后，霍梅尼成为伊朗的最高领袖。
description.en: After the success of the revolution, Khomeini became the Supreme Leader of Iran.

description.zh-cn: 沙阿穆罕默德-礼萨·巴列维推行了白色革命，进行了一系列现代化改革。
description.en: Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi initiated the White Revolution, a series of modernization reforms.

description.zh-cn: 因批评沙阿，霍梅尼被巴列维政权逮捕并驱逐出境。
description.en: For criticizing the Shah, Khomeini was arrested and exiled by the Pahlavi regime.

description.zh-cn: 英国与美国共同策划了1953年伊朗政变，推翻了摩萨台政府。
description.en: The United Kingdom, along with the United States, orchestrated the 1953 Iranian coup to overthrow the Mosaddegh government.

description.zh-cn: 政变成功后，沙阿穆罕默德-礼萨·巴列维得以复位并巩固其权力。
description.en: After the successful coup, Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi was reinstated and consolidated his power.

description.zh-cn: 礼萨汗自立为沙阿，建立了巴列维王朝。
description.en: Reza Shah established himself as Shah and founded the Pahlavi dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德-礼萨·巴列维是礼萨汗的儿子。
description.en: Mohammad Reza Pahlavi was the son of Reza Shah.

description.zh-cn: 在伊朗伊斯兰革命期间，伊朗王国与伊斯兰革命委员会是冲突的两个主要对立方。
description.en: During the Iranian Islamic Revolution, the Kingdom of Iran and the Islamic Revolutionary Council were the two main opposing sides.

description.zh-cn: 革命期间，伊朗石油产业的罢工导致石油产量锐减，引发了第二次石油危机。
description.en: During the revolution, strikes in Iran's oil industry led to a sharp decline in oil production, triggering the Second Oil Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰革命后伊朗试图输出革命，被伊拉克视为威胁，是两伊战争爆发的原因之一。
description.en: After the Islamic Revolution, Iran's attempt to export the revolution was seen as a threat by Iraq, becoming one of the causes of the Iran-Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 伊拉克总统萨达姆·侯赛因认为伊朗革命后局势混乱，是推翻神权政府和重夺领土的机会，因此挥军入侵伊朗，发动了两伊战争。
description.en: Iraqi President Saddam Hussein saw the post-revolutionary chaos in Iran as an opportunity to overthrow the theocratic government and reclaim territory, leading him to invade Iran and start the Iran-Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人质危机导致美国与伊朗的外交关系中断。
description.en: The Iran hostage crisis led to the severing of diplomatic relations between the United States and Iran.

description.zh-cn: 霍梅尼成立了伊斯兰革命卫队，作为捍卫伊斯兰革命的意识形态和军事力量。
description.en: Khomeini founded the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps as an ideological and military force to defend the Islamic Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人民党在革命初期支持新政权，但在1983年因被指控为苏联从事间谍活动而遭到取缔。
description.en: The Tudeh Party supported the new regime in the early stages of the revolution but was banned in 1983 after being accused of spying for the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗人民圣战者组织在1981年与神权政府摊牌，遭到镇压后成为主要的反对派武装力量。
description.en: The People's Mojahedin Organization of Iran had a showdown with the theocratic government in 1981 and, after being suppressed, became a major armed opposition force.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件的血腥镇压使司徒华与中国共产党彻底决裂，并退出香港特别行政区基本法起草委员会。
description.en: The bloody crackdown of the Tiananmen Square incident caused Szeto Wah to completely break with the Chinese Communist Party and withdraw from the Hong Kong Basic Law Drafting Committee.

description.zh-cn: 为回应中国大陆爆发的学生民主运动（六四事件），司徒华成立了香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会。
description.en: In response to the student-led pro-democracy movement in mainland China (Tiananmen Square incident), Szeto Wah founded the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件后，司徒华成为中国共产党的坚定反对者，主张“结束一党专政”。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, Szeto Wah became a staunch opponent of the Chinese Communist Party, advocating for the 'end of one-party dictatorship'.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华是香港市民支援爱国民主运动联合会的创始人和长期主席。
description.en: Szeto Wah was the founder and long-term chairman of the Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，中华人民共和国政府委任司徒华为香港特别行政区基本法起草委员会委员。
description.en: In 1985, the government of the People's Republic of China appointed Szeto Wah as a member of the Hong Kong Basic Law Drafting Committee.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华与李柱铭等人共同创立了香港首个政党香港民主同盟。
description.en: Szeto Wah, along with Martin Lee and others, co-founded Hong Kong's first political party, the United Democrats of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华是民主党的创始成员和核心人物。
description.en: Szeto Wah was a founding member and a core figure of the Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华于1973年创立教师工会香港教育专业人员协会，并出任首任会长。
description.en: Szeto Wah founded the teachers' union, the Hong Kong Professional Teachers' Union, in 1973 and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 作为支联会主席，司徒华领导并发起了旨在营救中国大陆民运人士的“黄雀行动”。
description.en: As the chairman of the Hong Kong Alliance, Szeto Wah led and initiated 'Operation Yellowbird' to rescue pro-democracy activists from mainland China.

description.zh-cn: “黄雀行动”成功营救了民运领袖柴玲，使其逃离中国大陆。
description.en: Operation Yellowbird successfully rescued the pro-democracy leader Chai Ling, enabling her to escape from mainland China.

description.zh-cn: 时任新华社香港分社社长许家屯曾到司徒华家中，邀请他加入或组织共产党，但被司徒华拒绝。双方对此会面有不同说法。
description.en: Xu Jiatun, then director of the Xinhua News Agency Hong Kong Branch, visited Szeto Wah at his home and invited him to join or organize a communist party, but Szeto Wah refused. The two have conflicting accounts of this meeting.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华公开反对“五区公投”运动，认为社民连“居心叵测”，并影响民主党最终不参与该运动。
description.en: Szeto Wah publicly opposed the 'Five Constituencies Referendum' movement, believing the League of Social Democrats had 'ulterior motives,' and influenced the Democratic Party's eventual decision not to participate.

description.zh-cn: 因在“五区公投”问题上持相反立场，司徒华与社会民主连线关系紧张并发生公开争论。
description.en: Due to opposing stances on the 'Five Constituencies Referendum' issue, Szeto Wah had a tense relationship and public disputes with the League of Social Democrats.

description.zh-cn: 司徒华支持民主党就2012年政改方案与中联办沟通，并支持最终通过的区议会改良方案。
description.en: Szeto Wah supported the Democratic Party's communication with the Liaison Office regarding the 2012 political reform package and endorsed the finally passed District Council enhancement proposal.

description.zh-cn: 黄少容是司徒华的红颜知己，两人曾互生情愫。司徒华为思念因病去世的她而终身未婚。
description.en: Huang Shaorong was Szeto Wah's close female friend, and they had mutual affection. Szeto Wah remained unmarried for life in memory of her after she passed away from illness.

description.zh-cn: 因在2012年政改方案的投票立场上与民主党存在分歧，郑家富宣布退出民主党。
description.en: Due to disagreements with the Democratic Party's voting stance on the 2012 political reform package, Andrew Cheng announced his withdrawal from the party.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次意大利埃塞俄比亚战争中，埃塞俄比亚帝国击败意大利王国，维护了其主权独立。
