description.en: In the First Italo-Ethiopian War, the Ethiopian Empire defeated the Kingdom of Italy, preserving its sovereign independence.

description.zh-cn: 1941年，英军在二战东非战场击败意大利后，帮助海尔·塞拉西一世回到首都复位。
description.en: In 1941, after defeating Italy in the East African theatre of World War II, British forces helped Haile Selassie I return to the capital and resume his throne.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后，美国大力扶持埃塞俄比亚帝国，提供了大量军事和经济援助。
description.en: After World War II, the United States strongly supported the Ethiopian Empire, providing substantial military and economic aid.

description.zh-cn: 1962年，海尔·塞拉西一世宣布解散厄立特里亚议会，将其强行改为埃塞俄比亚的一个省，此举剥夺了厄立特里亚的自治权并引发了独立战争。
description.en: In 1962, Haile Selassie I announced the dissolution of the Eritrean parliament and forcibly turned it into a province of Ethiopia, an act that stripped Eritrea of its autonomy and sparked the war for independence.

description.zh-cn: 1974年的军事政变推翻了皇帝海尔·塞拉西一世的统治。
description.en: The 1974 military coup overthrew the rule of Emperor Haile Selassie I.

description.zh-cn: 1974年的军事政变导致德尔格军政府建立并上台执政。
description.en: The 1974 military coup led to the establishment and rise to power of the Derg military junta.

description.zh-cn: 门格斯图是德尔格军政府的实际掌权者和领导人。
description.en: Mengistu was the de facto ruler and leader of the Derg military junta.

description.zh-cn: 在埃塞俄比亚内战中，德尔格政权转向苏联阵营，并获得了大量苏联援助。
description.en: During the Ethiopian Civil War, the Derg regime turned to the Soviet bloc and received substantial Soviet aid.

description.zh-cn: 1991年5月28日，埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线的武装力量推翻了门格斯图领导的德尔格政权。
description.en: On May 28, 1991, the armed forces of the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front overthrew the Derg regime led by Mengistu.

description.zh-cn: 2019年，执政联盟埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线改组为单一政党繁荣党。
description.en: In 2019, the ruling coalition Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front was reorganized into a single party, the Prosperity Party.

description.zh-cn: 1998年至2000年间，埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚因边界争端爆发了战争。
description.en: Between 1998 and 2000, Ethiopia and Eritrea fought a war over a border dispute.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德与厄立特里亚达成和解，宣布结束两国长达数十年的敌对状态。
description.en: In 2018, Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed reached a reconciliation with Eritrea, declaring an end to the decades-long state of hostility between the two countries.

description.zh-cn: 自2020年11月起，埃塞俄比亚联邦政府与提格雷人民解放阵线之间爆发了提格雷战争。
description.en: Since November 2020, the Tigray War broke out between the Ethiopian federal government and the Tigray People's Liberation Front.

description.zh-cn: 阿比·艾哈迈德自2018年起担任埃塞俄比亚总理。
description.en: Abiy Ahmed has served as the Prime Minister of Ethiopia since 2018.

description.zh-cn: 塔耶·阿茨克·塞拉西是埃塞俄比亚现任总统。
description.en: Taye Atske Selassie is the current President of Ethiopia.

description.zh-cn: 埃塞俄比亚在2023年峰会受邀后，于2024年1月1日正式成为金砖国家成员。
description.en: After being invited at the 2023 summit, Ethiopia officially became a member of BRICS on January 1, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 彭丽媛是习近平的第二任妻子。
description.en: Peng Liyuan is the second wife of Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋是习明泽的祖父。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun is the paternal grandfather of Xi Mingze.

description.zh-cn: 齐心是习明泽的祖母。
description.en: Qi Xin is the paternal grandmother of Xi Mingze.

description.zh-cn: 为孙女习明泽取名“明泽”，意为“天下开明，泽被苍生”。
description.en: Named his granddaughter Xi Mingze, with 'Mingze' meaning 'to bring enlightenment to the world and benefit all people'.

description.zh-cn: 2010年至2014年于哈佛大学完成本科学业，2019年重新报名研究所学习。
description.en: Completed undergraduate studies at Harvard University from 2010 to 2014, and re-enrolled for graduate studies in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 汶川大地震发生后，时年16岁的习明泽以志愿者的身份前往四川绵竹市的汉旺东汽小学，参与了7天的抢救伤者、心理辅导工作。
description.en: After the Wenchuan earthquake, 16-year-old Xi Mingze went to Hanwang Dongqi Primary School in Mianzhu, Sichuan as a volunteer for 7 days, participating in rescuing the injured and providing psychological counseling.

description.zh-cn: 陪同父母参加为白俄罗斯总统卢卡申科举办的家庭晚宴，这是她首次出席有外国领导人参加的宴会场合。
description.en: Accompanied her parents to a family dinner for Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko, marking her first appearance at a banquet with a foreign leader.

description.zh-cn: 据称在习明泽于哈佛大学就读期间，美国联邦调查局加派人手对其进行暗中保护。
description.en: It is alleged that during Xi Mingze's studies at Harvard University, the Federal Bureau of Investigation assigned additional personnel to provide her with covert protection.

description.zh-cn: 恶俗维基网站上泄露了邓家贵的个人隐私信息。
description.en: The Esuwiki website leaked personal information of Deng Jiagui.

description.zh-cn: 前往香港参与反修例运动。
description.en: Traveled to Hong Kong to participate in the anti-extradition bill movement.

description.zh-cn: 在顿巴斯战争期间，乌克兰政府军与顿巴斯地区的亲俄武装力量直接交战。
description.en: During the War in Donbas, Ukrainian government forces were in direct combat with pro-Russian armed forces in the Donbas region.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯为顿巴斯地区的亲俄武装提供了军事、物资和政治支持。
description.en: Russia provided military, logistical, and political support to the pro-Russian armed forces in the Donbas region.

description.zh-cn: 始于2013年底的乌克兰政治危机是顿巴斯战争爆发的直接背景和原因。
description.en: The Ukrainian political crisis that began in late 2013 was the direct context and cause for the outbreak of the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 广场起义导致时任乌克兰总统亚努科维奇被议会解除职务并逃离乌克兰。
description.en: The Euromaidan revolution led to the ousting of then-President of Ukraine Viktor Yanukovych by the parliament and his flight from Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 在俄罗斯吞并克里米亚之后，乌克兰东部的顿巴斯地区爆发了亲俄抗议活动，并迅速演变为武装冲突。
description.en: Following the Russian annexation of Crimea, pro-Russian protests erupted in the Donbas region of eastern Ukraine, which quickly escalated into armed conflict.

description.zh-cn: 亲俄武装分子占领顿涅茨克的政府建筑后，宣布成立“顿涅茨克人民共和国”。
description.en: After occupying government buildings in Donetsk, pro-Russian militants announced the establishment of the 'Donetsk People's Republic'.

description.zh-cn: 亲俄武装分子占领卢甘斯克的安全部门大楼后，宣布成立“卢甘斯克人民共和国”。
description.en: After occupying the security service building in Luhansk, pro-Russian militants announced the establishment of the 'Luhansk People's Republic'.

description.zh-cn: 长达八年的顿巴斯战争最终升级为俄罗斯对乌克兰的全面入侵。
description.en: The eight-year-long War in Donbas ultimately escalated into a full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 2014年9月签署的《明斯克协议》旨在实现停火，暂时缓和了顿巴斯地区的武装冲突。
description.en: The Minsk Protocol, signed in September 2014, aimed to establish a ceasefire, temporarily de-escalating the armed conflict in the Donbas region.

description.zh-cn: 2015年2月签署的《新明斯克协议》是为执行停火的又一次努力，但未能完全制止冲突。
description.en: The Minsk II agreement, signed in February 2015, was another effort to implement a ceasefire but failed to completely halt the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 在顿巴斯战争初期担任乌克兰总统。
description.en: Served as the President of Ukraine during the initial phase of the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 自2019年起担任乌克兰总统，领导乌克兰应对顿巴斯战争的后期阶段及2022年的全面入侵。
description.en: Serving as President of Ukraine since 2019, leading the country through the later stages of the War in Donbas and the 2022 full-scale invasion.

description.zh-cn: 长期担任俄罗斯总统，是顿巴斯战争及后续全面入侵的关键决策者。
description.en: Long-serving President of Russia and the key decision-maker in the War in Donbas and the subsequent full-scale invasion.

description.zh-cn: 鲍里斯·涅姆佐夫在莫斯科市中心被枪杀身亡。
description.en: Boris Nemtsov was shot and killed in central Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 苏联领导人斯大林为了打压乌克兰民族思想而主导了乌克兰大饥荒。
description.en: Soviet leader Stalin orchestrated the Holodomor to suppress Ukrainian national sentiment.

position.zh-cn: 破虏大将军、武信侯、萧王
position.en: General Who Defeats the Caitiffs, Marquis of Wuxin, King of Xiao

description.zh-cn: 刘秀与兄长刘𬙂共同拥护刘玄称帝，并为其效力。后因刘玄猜忌，刘秀前往河北发展势力，最终脱离更始政权并称帝。
description.en: Liu Xiu and his brother Liu Yan supported Liu Xuan's ascension to the throne and served him. Due to Liu Xuan's suspicion, Liu Xiu went to Hebei to develop his own power base, eventually breaking away from the Gengshi regime and declaring himself emperor.

description.zh-cn: 阴丽华为刘秀的皇后。
description.en: Yin Lihua was Liu Xiu's empress.

description.zh-cn: 郭圣通为刘秀的第一任皇后，后被废黜。
description.en: Guo Shengtong was Liu Xiu's first empress and was later deposed.

description.zh-cn: 刘庄是刘秀的儿子，其母为阴丽华。
description.en: Liu Zhuang was the son of Liu Xiu, and his mother was Yin Lihua.

description.zh-cn: 刘彊是刘秀的儿子，其母为郭圣通。
description.en: Liu Qiang was the son of Liu Xiu, and his mother was Guo Shengtong.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀在统一天下的过程中，荡平了赤眉军等割据势力。
description.en: In the process of unifying the empire, Liu Xiu eliminated the Red Eyebrows and other separatist forces.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀建立东汉后，将首都定于洛阳。
description.en: After establishing the Eastern Han dynasty, Liu Xiu made Luoyang the capital.

description.zh-cn: 建武中元二年（57年），光武帝册封倭奴国，授予其“倭奴国王”金印。
description.en: In the second year of Jianwu Zhongyuan (57 AD), Emperor Guangwu enfeoffed the Kingdom of Na of Wa, granting it the gold seal of 'King of Na of Wa'.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀引南匈奴内迁入塞，安置于北方边郡。
description.en: Liu Xiu allowed the Southern Xiongnu to move inside the frontier and settled them in the northern commanderies.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀扩大尚书台的职权，使其成为皇帝发号施令的执行机构，将权力集中于皇帝一身。
description.en: Liu Xiu expanded the authority of the Shangshu Tai, making it the executive body for imperial edicts and concentrating power in the hands of the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀削弱三公权力，使三公成为虚位，将实际权力归于尚书台。
description.en: Liu Xiu weakened the power of the Three Excellencies, making them titular positions and transferring real power to the Shangshu Tai.

description.zh-cn: 刘秀是汉高祖刘邦的九世孙。
description.en: Liu Xiu was the ninth-generation descendant of Emperor Gaozu of Han, Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统通过每四年举行一次的总统选举产生。
description.en: The President of the United States is chosen through the presidential election held every four years.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统由选举人团的投票结果决定，候选人需获得至少270张选举人票才能当选。
description.en: The President of the United States is determined by the votes of the Electoral College; a candidate must receive at least 270 electoral votes to win.

description.zh-cn: 当所有总统候选人均未能获得过半数选举人票时，由美国众议院选出总统。
description.en: When no presidential candidate wins a majority of electoral votes, the U.S. House of Representatives elects the president.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·华盛顿是美国首任总统，于1789年4月30日就职。
description.en: George Washington was the first President of the United States, inaugurated on April 30, 1789.

description.zh-cn: 唐纳·川普担任美国第45任总统，并于2025年1月20日开始其第二个任期，成为第47任总统。
description.en: Donald Trump served as the 45th President of the United States and will begin his second term on January 20, 2025, as the 47th President.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案于1951年生效，规定总统连选连任不得多于两次。
description.en: This amendment, effective in 1951, stipulates that a president cannot be elected to more than two terms.

description.zh-cn: 总统可以行使否决权，否决任何获国会通过的法案。
description.en: The president can exercise the power of veto to reject any bill passed by Congress.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统每年都会前往戴维营休假。
description.en: The President of the United States vacations annually at Camp David.

description.zh-cn: 总统是国家安全委员会的主席。
description.en: The president is the chairman of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统是内阁的成员。
description.en: The President of the United States is a member of the Cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 理查德·尼克松是唯一在任内辞职的美国总统。
description.en: Richard Nixon is the only U.S. president to resign from office.

description.zh-cn: 杰拉尔德·福特是美国历史上唯一没有经过选举而产生的总统。
description.en: Gerald Ford is the only person to have served as U.S. president without being elected.

description.zh-cn: 在九一一袭击事件后，时任总统乔治·沃克·布什的支持率一度高达90%。
description.en: Following the September 11 attacks, the approval rating of then-President George W. Bush surged to a high of 90%.

description.zh-cn: 约翰·昆西·亚当斯是约翰·亚当斯的儿子，他们是美国历史上第一对父子总统。
description.en: John Quincy Adams is the son of John Adams, making them the first father-son pair of presidents in U.S. history.

description.zh-cn: 本杰明·哈里森是威廉·亨利·哈里森的孙子，他们是美国历史上唯一一对祖孙总统。
description.en: Benjamin Harrison is the grandson of William Henry Harrison, making them the only grandfather-grandson pair of presidents in U.S. history.

description.zh-cn: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福与西奥多·罗斯福是堂兄弟关系，二人都曾担任美国总统。
description.en: Franklin D. Roosevelt and Theodore Roosevelt were fifth cousins who both served as President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 安德鲁·约翰逊是美国历史上被众议院弹劾的三位总统之一。
description.en: Andrew Johnson is one of the three presidents in U.S. history to have been impeached by the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 比尔·克林顿是美国历史上被众议院弹劾的三位总统之一。
description.en: Bill Clinton is one of the three presidents in U.S. history to have been impeached by the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 唐纳·川普是美国历史上唯一被众议院弹劾两次的总统。
description.en: Donald Trump is the only president in U.S. history to have been impeached twice by the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 秦和珍出生于山东省金乡县鱼山乡秦庄村。
description.en: Qin Hezhen was born in Qin Village, Yushan Township, Jixiang County, Shandong Province.

position.en: Political Instructor of the 1st Company, 1st Battalion

description.zh-cn: 在其部队被改编后，秦和珍担任苏鲁豫支队第四大队一营一连指导员。
description.en: After his unit was reorganized, Qin Hezhen served as the political instructor of the 1st Company, 1st Battalion, 4th Brigade of the Sulu-Yu Detachment.

description.zh-cn: 苏鲁豫支队是八路军115师的下属部队。
description.en: The Sulu-Yu Detachment was a subordinate unit of the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 115师是八路军（国民革命军第十八集团军）的主力师之一。
description.en: The 115th Division was one of the main divisions of the Eighth Route Army (18th Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army).

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，担任中共中央山东分局组织部副部长、部长。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, he served as Deputy Head and then Head of the Organization Department of the Shandong Sub-bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

position.zh-cn: 委员, 组织部长, 书记
position.en: Committee Member, Head of the Organization Department, Secretary

description.zh-cn: 1956年任中共山东省第一届委员会委员，1962年任组织部长。1977年，任书记。
description.en: In 1956, he became a member of the first Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPC, and in 1962, he served as Head of the Organization Department. In 1977, he served as Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 居正与邹鲁、张鸣、张建邦等人于1950年共同创办淡江英语专科学校（淡江大学前身）。
description.en: Ju Zheng, along with Zou Lu, Zhang Ming, and Chang Chien-pang, co-founded Tamkang English Junior College (the predecessor of Tamkang University) in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 邹鲁与居正、张鸣、张建邦等人于1950年共同创办淡江英语专科学校（淡江大学前身）。
description.en: Zou Lu, along with Ju Zheng, Zhang Ming, and Chang Chien-pang, co-founded Tamkang English Junior College (the predecessor of Tamkang University) in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 张鸣与其子张建邦，及居正、邹鲁等人于1950年共同创办淡江英语专科学校（淡江大学前身）。
description.en: Zhang Ming and his son Chang Chien-pang, along with Ju Zheng and Zou Lu, co-founded Tamkang English Junior College (the predecessor of Tamkang University) in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 张建邦与其父张鸣，及居正、邹鲁等人于1950年共同创办淡江英语专科学校（淡江大学前身）。
description.en: Chang Chien-pang and his father Zhang Ming, along with Ju Zheng and Zou Lu, co-founded Tamkang English Junior College (the predecessor of Tamkang University) in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 设计了淡江大学的校徽。
description.en: Designed the emblem of Tamkang University.

description.zh-cn: 为淡江大学设计并创作了李双泽纪念碑、海豚吉祥物里程碑和五虎碑雕塑。
description.en: Designed and created the Li Shuang-ze Memorial, the Dolphin Mascot Milestone, and the Five Tigers Monument sculpture for Tamkang University.

description.zh-cn: 为淡江大学校园内的李双泽纪念碑题写碑文。
description.en: Wrote the inscription for the Li Shuang-ze Memorial on the Tamkang University campus.

description.zh-cn: 淡江大学的绍谟纪念体育馆被用作2017年夏季世界大学运动会举重比赛的主场馆。
description.en: The Shao-Mo Memorial Gymnasium at Tamkang University served as the main venue for the weightlifting events of the 2017 Summer Universiade.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，改组成立了中央军委联合参谋部。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission was reorganized and established.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，中国人民解放军总参谋部被撤销。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the General Staff Department of the Chinese People's Liberation Army was abolished.

description.zh-cn: 办公厅是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The General Office is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 政治工作局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Political Work Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 作战局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Operations Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 战略战役训练局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Strategic and Campaign Training Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 情报局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Intelligence Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 导航局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Navigation Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 信息通信局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Information and Communications Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 战场环境保障局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Battlefield Environment Support Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 军事需求局是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构。
description.en: The Military Requirements Bureau is an internal department of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 警卫局被列为中央军事委员会联合参谋部的内设机构之一。
description.en: The Guard Bureau is listed as one of the internal departments of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军第三〇五医院是中央军事委员会联合参谋部的直属单位。
description.en: The No. 305 Hospital of the PLA is a directly subordinate unit of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission.

position.zh-cn: 总督蓟辽军务兵部尚书
position.en: Viceroy of Jiliao and Minister of War

description.zh-cn: 洪承畴在明朝官至兵部尚书、蓟辽总督，在松锦之战中兵败被俘前一直为明朝服务。
description.en: Hong Chengchou served the Ming dynasty as Minister of War and Viceroy of Jiliao until his defeat and capture in the Battle of Songjin.

description.zh-cn: 洪承畴是崇祯帝手下的重臣，负责镇压农民起义和防御清军。
description.en: Hong Chengchou was a key minister under the Chongzhen Emperor, responsible for suppressing peasant rebellions and defending against the Qing army.

description.zh-cn: 在松锦之战中，洪承畴率领的明军惨败，其本人被清军俘虏，导致其明朝生涯的终结。
description.en: In the Battle of Songjin, the Ming army led by Hong Chengchou was decisively defeated, and he himself was captured by the Qing army, ending his career in the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极亲自率领清军主力驰援锦州，并制定了包围和切断明军粮道的战略，最终赢得了松锦之战的胜利。
description.en: Hong Taiji personally led the main Qing forces to reinforce Jinzhou and devised the strategy of encircling and cutting off the Ming army's supply lines, ultimately winning the Battle of Songjin.

description.zh-cn: 时任兵部尚书的陈新甲派遣张若麒等人催促洪承畴速战速决，打乱了洪承畴原定的持久战方略，是导致松锦之战失败的原因之一。
description.en: Chen Xinjia, the Minister of War, dispatched Zhang Ruoqi and others to urge Hong Chengchou for a quick battle, disrupting Hong's original strategy of protracted warfare and contributing to the defeat at the Battle of Songjin.

description.zh-cn: 洪承畴被俘后，皇太极费尽心思进行劝降，并亲自以脱下自己的貂皮大衣为他披上的方式感动了他，最终使其归降。
description.en: After Hong Chengchou was captured, Hong Taiji went to great lengths to persuade him to surrender, personally moving him by taking off his own sable coat and putting it on him, which ultimately led to his surrender.

description.zh-cn: 相传孝庄文皇后（庄妃）曾亲自探望被囚的洪承畴并劝降，在他的投降过程中起了作用。
description.en: It is said that Empress Xiaozhuangwen (Consort Zhuang) personally visited the imprisoned Hong Chengchou and persuaded him to surrender, playing a role in his defection.

description.zh-cn: 范文程受皇太极派遣劝降洪承畴，通过观察洪承畴爱惜衣物的细节，判断其并无死志，从而成功说服皇太极继续招降。
description.en: Fan Wencheng was sent by Hong Taiji to persuade Hong Chengchou. By observing the detail that Hong cherished his clothes, Fan judged that Hong had no intention of dying and thus successfully persuaded Hong Taiji to continue the effort to recruit him.

position.zh-cn: 大学士、太傅、太子太师、经略五省总督军务
position.en: Grand Secretary, Grand Tutor, Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince, Viceroy for Military Affairs over Five Provinces

description.zh-cn: 洪承畴于1642年降清，成为清朝首位汉人大学士，并担任多个要职，直至去世。
description.en: Hong Chengchou surrendered to the Qing in 1642, becoming the first Han Chinese Grand Secretary and holding various important posts until his death.

description.zh-cn: 清兵入关后，洪承畴向多尔衮献计，建议清军主力先进攻李自成的大顺军，该计策被采纳。
description.en: After the Qing army entered the Shanhai Pass, Hong Chengchou advised Dorgon to first attack Li Zicheng's Shun army, a strategy that was adopted.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯十一年，洪承畴在潼关南原大战中大破李自成军，使其仅剩十八骑兵败走商洛，是明末农民起义的低潮。
description.en: In 1638, Hong Chengchou decisively defeated Li Zicheng's army at the Battle of Tongguan Nanyuan, forcing Li to flee to Shangluo with only eighteen cavalrymen, marking a low point for the late Ming peasant rebellions.

position.zh-cn: 经略湖广、广东、广西、云南、贵州五省总督军务
position.en: Viceroy for Military Affairs over Huguang, Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, and Guizhou

description.zh-cn: 顺治十年起，洪承畴被任命为五省经略，负责征讨南明永历政权，最终平定云贵地区。
description.en: Starting in 1653, Hong Chengchou was appointed Viceroy over five provinces, responsible for the campaign against the Southern Ming's Yongli regime, ultimately pacifying the Yunnan-Guizhou region.

description.zh-cn: 洪承畴率领清军征讨南明，最终迫使永历帝（桂王）流亡缅甸。
description.en: Hong Chengchou led the Qing army's campaign against the Southern Ming, ultimately forcing the Yongli Emperor (Prince of Gui) to flee to Burma.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆年间编纂的《明季贰臣传》将洪承畴列为“贰臣”甲篇之首，对其降清行为给予了官方的负面评价。
description.en: The 'Biographies of Twice-Serving Ministers of the Ming Period', compiled during the Qianlong era, listed Hong Chengchou at the top of Volume A of 'Twice-Serving Ministers', giving an official negative assessment of his surrender to the Qing.

description.zh-cn: 金声被俘后，当面斥责洪承畴冒充已为明朝殉国的忠臣，拒绝其劝降。
description.en: After being captured, Jin Sheng rebuked Hong Chengchou to his face, accusing him of impersonating a loyal minister who had died for the Ming, and rejected his persuasion to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 在劝降金声失败后，洪承畴下令将其斩首。
description.en: After failing to persuade Jin Sheng to surrender, Hong Chengchou ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 孙兆奎被俘后，在与洪承畴对话时，以“松山殉难的督师洪公”反讽洪承畴，使其难堪。
description.en: After being captured, Sun Zhaokui sarcastically referred to Hong Chengchou as 'Viceroy Hong who died a martyr at Songshan', shaming him.

description.zh-cn: 在被孙兆奎羞辱后，洪承畴下令将其斩杀。
description.en: After being shamed by Sun Zhaokui, Hong Chengchou ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 左懋第被清廷扣留后，洪承畴前来说降，左懋第称其为“鬼”，坚称真正的洪督师已在松山死节。
description.en: When Hong Chengchou came to persuade the detained Zuo Maodi to surrender, Zuo called him a 'ghost', insisting that the real Viceroy Hong had died a martyr at Songshan.

description.zh-cn: 黄道周被俘后，为洪承畴写下对联“史笔流芳，虽未成名终可法；洪恩浩荡，不思报国反成仇”，以史可法对比，讽刺洪承畴变节。
description.en: After being captured, Huang Daozhou wrote a couplet for Hong Chengchou that contrasted him with Shi Kefa, satirizing his betrayal: 'History's brush leaves a fragrant name, though not yet famous, one can eventually be a model (Kefa); Vast is the great favor (Hong'en), yet you don't think of repaying the country, instead becoming a foe (Chengchou).'

description.zh-cn: 在保全夏完淳失败后，洪承畴下令将其斩杀。
description.en: After failing to save Xia Wanchun, Hong Chengchou ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 在王之仁拒绝薙发归顺后，洪承畴决定将其处斩。
description.en: After Wang Zhiren refused to adopt the queue hairstyle and surrender, Hong Chengchou decided to have him executed.

description.zh-cn: 傅氏是洪承畴的母亲。
description.en: Lady Fu is the mother of Hong Chengchou.

description.zh-cn: 一级警督的警衔等级低于三级警监。
description.en: The rank of First Level Police Superintendent is subordinate to Third Level Police Supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 三级警监的警衔等级低于二级警监。
description.en: The rank of Third Level Police Supervisor is subordinate to Second Level Police Supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 二级警监的警衔等级低于一级警监。
description.en: The rank of Second Level Police Supervisor is subordinate to First Level Police Supervisor.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民警察是中华人民共和国的国家警察力量。
description.en: The People's Police of the People's Republic of China is the national police force of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 沈阳市人民政府在业务上接受辽宁省人民政府的直接领导。
description.en: The Shenyang Municipal People's Government is under the direct operational leadership of the Liaoning Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 张荣茂是湖南桃源人。
description.en: Zhang Rongmao is from Taoyuan, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 张荣茂曾担任辽宁省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Zhang Rongmao served as Vice Governor of the Liaoning Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 张荣茂曾担任沈阳市人民政府市长。根据维基百科分类，他亦曾任该市副市长。
description.en: Zhang Rongmao served as Mayor of the Shenyang Municipal People's Government. According to Wikipedia categories, he also served as Vice Mayor of the city.

description.zh-cn: 张荣茂曾是第八届和第九届全国人大代表。
description.en: Zhang Rongmao was a deputy to the 8th and 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，张荣茂是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Zhang Rongmao is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，张荣茂是大连工学院的校友。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Zhang Rongmao is an alumnus of Dalian Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英自称为明末名臣孙承宗的后裔。
description.en: Sun Dianying claimed to be a descendant of Sun Chengzong, a famous official of the late Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英的军阀生涯初期为直系军阀。
description.en: In his early warlord career, Sun Dianying belonged to the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英曾加入刘镇华的镇嵩军，在憨玉琨部下任职。
description.en: Sun Dianying joined Liu Zhenhua's Zhensong Army and served under Han Yukun.

description.zh-cn: 1925年3月，憨玉琨被国民军胡景翼部击败。
description.en: In March 1925, Han Yukun was defeated by the Guominjun forces led by Hu Jingyi.

description.zh-cn: 1925年，在憨玉琨被击败后，孙殿英投降国民军，并升任师长。
description.en: In 1925, after Han Yukun's defeat, Sun Dianying surrendered to the Guominjun and was promoted to division commander.

description.zh-cn: 脱离国民军后，孙殿英成为奉系军阀张宗昌的部下。
description.en: After leaving the Guominjun, Sun Dianying became a subordinate of the Fengtian clique warlord Zhang Zongchang.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英任张宗昌部下褚玉璞手下的第五师师长。
description.en: Sun Dianying served as the commander of the 5th Division under Chu Yupu, who was a subordinate of Zhang Zongchang.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英曾多次投诚蒋介石，分别在北伐后（1928年）和日本投降后（1945年）归顺国民政府。
description.en: Sun Dianying surrendered to Chiang Kai-shek on multiple occasions, pledging allegiance to the Nationalist Government after the Northern Expedition (1928) and after the surrender of Japan (1945).

position.zh-cn: 第六军团第十二军军长
position.en: Commander of the 12th Army of the 6th Army Group

description.zh-cn: 1928年5月，孙殿英被蒋介石收编，委任为国民革命军第六军团第十二军军长。
description.en: In May 1928, Sun Dianying was incorporated into Chiang Kai-shek's forces and appointed Commander of the 12th Army of the 6th Army Group of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英盗掘了慈禧太后的陵墓。
description.en: Sun Dianying looted the tomb of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 由于国民政府未追究孙殿英盗掘清东陵的责任，导致溥仪与国民政府完全决裂。
description.en: The Nationalist Government's failure to prosecute Sun Dianying for looting the Qing tombs caused a complete break between Puyi and the government.

description.zh-cn: 1930年中原大战爆发，孙殿英依附于反蒋的冯玉祥、阎锡山阵营。
description.en: When the Central Plains War broke out in 1930, Sun Dianying aligned with the anti-Chiang camp of Feng Yuxiang and Yan Xishan.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战期间，孙殿英依附于冯玉祥和阎锡山名下。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, Sun Dianying aligned himself with Feng Yuxiang and Yan Xishan.

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战期间，孙殿英依附于冯玉祥和阎锡山名下。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, Sun Dianying aligned himself with Feng Yuxiang and Yan Xishan.

description.zh-cn: 中原大战后，孙殿英投入张学良麾下，任第四十师师长。
description.en: After the Central Plains War, Sun Dianying joined Zhang Xueliang's forces and was appointed Commander of the 40th Division.

description.zh-cn: 1933年热河战役期间，孙殿英率部与日军作战。此后直到1943年投降前，他一直作为抗日将领与日军为敌。
description.en: During the Battle of Rehe in 1933, Sun Dianying led his troops against the Japanese army. He remained an anti-Japanese general and an enemy of the Japanese until his surrender in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英试图进入宁夏、青海地区，但遭到当地“四马”势力的联合抵抗，最终战败。
description.en: Sun Dianying's attempt to enter the Ningxia and Qinghai regions was met with united resistance from the local 'Four Mas' forces, ultimately leading to his defeat.

description.zh-cn: 1934年3月，孙殿英在四马拒孙之役战败回退时，遭到傅作义的晋绥军攻击并被缴械。
description.en: In March 1934, while retreating after his defeat in the war against the Four Mas, Sun Dianying was attacked and disarmed by Fu Zuoyi's Jinsui Army.

description.zh-cn: 在傅作义缴械孙殿英后，阎锡山收编了孙殿英的部队，剥夺了其军权。
description.en: After Fu Zuoyi disarmed Sun Dianying, Yan Xishan absorbed Sun's troops and stripped him of his military command.

description.zh-cn: 据彭德怀评价，孙殿英是在抗战期间与八路军关系最好的国军将领。
description.en: According to Peng Dehuai's assessment, Sun Dianying was the KMT general who had the best relationship with the Eighth Route Army during the war of resistance.

description.zh-cn: 1939年10月15日，彭德怀到新五军驻地会见了孙殿英。
description.en: On October 15, 1939, Peng Dehuai visited the station of the New 5th Army and met with Sun Dianying.

position.zh-cn: 和平救国军司令、新五军军长兼第四方面军指挥官、豫北保安司令
position.en: Commander of the Peace and National Salvation Army, Commander of the New 5th Army and concurrent Commander of the 4th Front Army, Security Commander of Northern Henan

description.zh-cn: 投降日军后，孙殿英在汪精卫政权中担任多个军事职务。
description.en: After surrendering to the Japanese, Sun Dianying held several military positions in the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英投敌后，诱降了第二十四集团军总司令庞炳勋。
description.en: After defecting to the enemy, Sun Dianying induced Pang Bingxun, commander of the 24th Army Group, to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月日本投降，孙殿英随即再次投诚蒋介石，被任命为先遣军。
description.en: Following Japan's surrender in August 1945, Sun Dianying immediately pledged allegiance to Chiang Kai-shek again and was appointed to the 'Vanguard Army'.

description.zh-cn: 1947年5月，孙殿英在河南汤阴被刘伯承、邓小平率领的晋冀鲁豫野战军俘虏，并于同年9月死于战俘营。
description.en: In May 1947, Sun Dianying was captured in Tangyin, Henan, by the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Field Army led by Liu Bocheng and Deng Xiaoping. He died in a prisoner-of-war camp in September of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 孙殿英被俘后，刘伯承指示对其非常宽待，并批准其卫士照顾生活，甚至为其购买鸦片以缓解病痛。
description.en: After Sun Dianying was captured, Liu Bocheng instructed that he be treated with great leniency, allowing his orderly to care for him and even purchasing opium to alleviate his symptoms.

description.zh-cn: 孙天义是孙殿英的儿子。
description.en: Sun Tianyi is the son of Sun Dianying.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗李亨是唐玄宗李隆基的第三子。
description.en: Emperor Suzong Li Heng was the third son of Emperor Xuanzong Li Longji.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗李豫是唐肃宗李亨的长子。
description.en: Emperor Daizong Li Yu was the eldest son of Emperor Suzong Li Heng.

description.zh-cn: 在唐肃宗出生前，太平公主因对时为太子的唐玄宗不满，试图说服玄宗将尚在腹中的肃宗堕胎。
description.en: Before Emperor Suzong was born, Princess Taiping, dissatisfied with the then-Crown Prince Xuanzong, tried to persuade him to abort the fetus.

description.zh-cn: 在唐玄宗准备堕胎时，其幕僚张说请求玄宗收回成命，保住了唐肃宗。
description.en: When Emperor Xuanzong was preparing to induce an abortion, his advisor Zhang Yue requested him to retract the order, thus saving the future Emperor Suzong.

description.zh-cn: 李林甫曾支持寿王李瑁，因此在李亨被立为太子后，惧怕其报复并企图将其推翻。
description.en: Li Linfu had supported the Prince of Shou, Li Mao, and therefore feared retaliation from Li Heng after he was made crown prince, and attempted to overthrow him.

description.zh-cn: 韦氏是唐肃宗为太子时的正妃。
description.en: Lady Wei was the principal consort of Emperor Suzong when he was the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 张氏原为太子良娣，后成为唐肃宗的皇后。
description.en: Lady Zhang was originally a Liangdi (a rank for crown prince's consort) and later became Emperor Suzong's empress.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗即位后，组织朔方军等力量，联合回鹘进行反攻，收复了长安和洛阳，逐步控制了叛乱。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Suzong organized forces such as the Shuofang Army and allied with the Uyghurs to launch a counter-offensive, recapturing Chang'an and Luoyang and gradually bringing the rebellion under control.

description.zh-cn: 郭子仪是唐肃宗任命的将领，率领朔方军等部队平定安史之乱。
description.en: Guo Ziyi was a general appointed by Emperor Suzong, who led the Shuofang Army and other troops to suppress the An-Shi Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 李光弼是唐肃宗在平定安史之乱时倚重的主要将领之一。
description.en: Li Guangbi was one of the key generals relied upon by Emperor Suzong in suppressing the An-Shi Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 安庆绪是安禄山的儿子。
description.en: An Qingxu was the son of An Lushan.

description.zh-cn: 李辅国趁机构陷，称太上皇玄宗预谋复辟，并将其软禁于西宫。
description.en: Li Fuguo seized an opportunity to frame the Emperor Emeritus Xuanzong, claiming he was plotting a restoration, and placed him under house arrest in the Western Palace.

description.zh-cn: 宝应元年，张皇后在肃宗病重时图谋杀害太子李俶（即唐代宗），以改立越王李系。
description.en: In the first year of Baoying (762), while Emperor Suzong was critically ill, Empress Zhang plotted to kill Crown Prince Li Chu (later Emperor Daizong) to install the Prince of Yue, Li Xi, instead.

description.zh-cn: 李辅国为保护太子，发动政变，命令程元振率禁军入宫平乱，杀死了张皇后。
description.en: To protect the crown prince, Li Fuguo launched a coup, ordering Cheng Yuanzhen to lead the imperial guards into the palace to quell the conspiracy, killing Empress Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 程元振是李辅国的亲信，奉其命令率军入宫平乱。
description.en: Cheng Yuanzhen was a confidant of Li Fuguo and, under his orders, led troops into the palace to quell the conspiracy.

description.zh-cn: 程元振奉李辅国之命，率领射生军入宫平乱，杀死了张皇后。
description.en: Under Li Fuguo's orders, Cheng Yuanzhen led the Shesheng Army into the palace to quell the conspiracy, killing Empress Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 李辅国发动政变，擒杀张皇后等人，使得病重的唐肃宗受到惊吓而驾崩。
description.en: Li Fuguo launched a coup, capturing and killing Empress Zhang and others, which caused the critically ill Emperor Suzong to die of shock.

description.zh-cn: 李辅国杀死张皇后，肃宗惊死后，拥立太子李俶（即唐代宗）于肃宗灵前继位。
description.en: After Li Fuguo killed Empress Zhang and Emperor Suzong died of shock, Crown Prince Li Chu (later Emperor Daizong) was enthroned by Li Fuguo before Emperor Suzong's coffin.

description.zh-cn: 《国际桥牌社2》以台湾海峡飞弹危机作为其主要故事背景之一。
description.en: 'Island Nation 2' uses the Taiwan Strait Crisis as one of its main story backdrops.

description.zh-cn: 《国际桥牌社2》以1996年中华民国总统选举作为其主要故事背景之一。
description.en: 'Island Nation 2' uses the 1996 ROC presidential election as one of its main story backdrops.

description.zh-cn: 《国际桥牌社2》的剧情聚焦于1995年李登辉总统访问康乃尔大学等事件。
description.en: The plot of 'Island Nation 2' focuses on events including President Lee Teng-hui's 1995 visit to Cornell University.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉对康奈尔大学的访问激怒了北京，是引发台湾海峡飞弹危机的直接导火索。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui's visit to Cornell University angered Beijing and was the direct trigger for the Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉作为时任中华民国总统访问了其母校康乃尔大学。
description.en: As the incumbent President of the Republic of China, Lee Teng-hui visited his alma mater, Cornell University.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军在台湾海峡进行的军事演习意在影响1996年中华民国总统选举的结果。
description.en: The military exercises conducted by the People's Liberation Army in the Taiwan Strait were intended to influence the outcome of the 1996 ROC presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在电视剧《国际桥牌社2》的剧情中，六四事件中解放军镇压学生的行为是促使角色“游建军”（原型刘连昆）决定成为台湾内应的关键原因。
description.en: In the plot of 'Island Nation 2', the PLA's suppression of students during the Tiananmen Square protests was the key reason that motivated the character 'You Jian-jun' (prototype Liu Liankun) to become an informant for Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 刘连昆向中华民国方面提供了包括台湾海峡飞弹危机在内的关键军事情报。
description.en: Liu Liankun provided crucial military intelligence to the Republic of China, including information related to the Taiwan Strait Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 董事长乐团为电视剧《国际桥牌社2》谱写并演唱了主题曲《同岛一命》。
description.en: The Chairman band composed and performed the theme song 'Common Fate' for the TV series 'Island Nation 2'.

description.zh-cn: 贾宇是浙江省人民检察院的现任检察长。
description.en: Jia Yu is the current Procurator-General of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 贾宇的衔级为二级大检察官。
description.en: Jia Yu holds the rank of Grand Procurator of the Second Rank.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国最高人民检察院是浙江省人民检察院的业务上级机关。
description.en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China is the professional superior of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民代表大会是浙江省人民检察院的组织上级机关。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress is the organizational superior of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民代表大会常务委员会是浙江省人民检察院的组织上级机关。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress is the organizational superior of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党浙江省委员会是浙江省人民检察院的中共上级单位。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party is the CCP superior unit of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民检察院是浙江省的检察机关，属于国家的法律监督机关。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate is the procuratorial organ of Zhejiang Province and is a state legal supervision organ.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是浙江省人民检察院的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the authorizing legal source for the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国刑法》是浙江省人民检察院的授权法源。
description.en: The Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China is an authorizing legal source for the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国刑事诉讼法》是浙江省人民检察院的授权法源。
description.en: The Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China is an authorizing legal source for the Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省人民检察院使用中华人民共和国人民检察院的检徽。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate uses the emblem of the People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国工农红军第二十二军是红一军团的主力部队之一。
description.en: The 22nd Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army was one of the main forces of the First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 1930年6月，红四军前委与闽西特委联席举行汀州会议，决定将赣南特委的地方武装合编组建红二十二军。
description.en: In June 1930, the Front Committee of the Fourth Red Army and the Western Fujian Special Committee held a joint meeting in Tingzhou and decided to organize the local armed forces of the Southern Jiangxi Special Committee into the 22nd Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 红二十二军会同红三十五军进攻赣州。
description.en: The 22nd Red Army attacked Ganzhou together with the 35th Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1930年12月15日，红二十二军被划归为红十二军指挥。
description.en: On December 15, 1930, the 22nd Red Army was placed under the command of the 12th Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1933年6月，中央红军进行整军，红二十二军被改编为红一军团第三师，其番号取消。
description.en: In June 1933, the Central Red Army reorganized its forces, and the 22nd Red Army was reorganized into the 3rd Division of the First Red Army Group, and its designation was abolished.

position.en: Director of the Political Department, Member of the Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 吕伟红现任中华人民共和国海关总署政治部主任、党委委员。
description.en: Lü Weihong currently serves as the Director of the Political Department and a member of the Party Committee of the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 梁文锋是杭州深度求索人工智能基础技术研究有限公司的创始人。
description.en: Liang Wenfeng is the founder of Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 梁文锋担任深度求索的行政总裁。
description.en: Liang Wenfeng serves as the CEO of DeepSeek.

description.zh-cn: 深度求索由幻方量化创立。
description.en: DeepSeek was founded by High-Flyer Quant.

description.zh-cn: 深度求索是幻方量化创立的子公司，其财务、法务、行政等均由幻方量化支持。
description.en: DeepSeek is a subsidiary founded by High-Flyer Quant, and its finance, legal, and administrative functions are supported by High-Flyer Quant.

description.zh-cn: 梁文锋是幻方量化的创始人之一。
description.en: Liang Wenfeng is one of the founders of High-Flyer Quant.

description.zh-cn: 幻方量化的创始成员多来自浙江大学。
description.en: Many of the founding members of High-Flyer Quant are from Zhejiang University.

description.zh-cn: Wiz公司发现了一个与DeepSeek相关的数据库存在安全漏洞，并在发出警报后，DeepSeek在一个小时内保护了数据。
description.en: Wiz discovered a security vulnerability in a database related to DeepSeek, and after being alerted, DeepSeek secured the data within an hour.

description.zh-cn: OpenAI指控DeepSeek使用知识蒸馏技术复制其模型进行开发，违反了OpenAI的服务条款。
description.en: OpenAI accused DeepSeek of using knowledge distillation to replicate its models for development, which violates OpenAI's terms of service.

description.zh-cn: 作为OpenAI的大股东，微软就DeepSeek被指控使用知识蒸馏技术复制OpenAI模型一事展开调查。
description.en: As a major shareholder of OpenAI, Microsoft launched an investigation into allegations that DeepSeek used knowledge distillation to replicate OpenAI's models.

description.zh-cn: OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·阿尔特曼称DeepSeek-R1是一款令人印象深刻的模型。
description.en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman called DeepSeek-R1 an impressive model.

description.zh-cn: 文心一言于2025年2月宣布接入DeepSeek-R1模型。
description.en: Ernie Bot announced in February 2025 that it would integrate the DeepSeek-R1 model.

description.zh-cn: 腾讯元宝于2025年2月宣布接入DeepSeek-R1模型。
description.en: Tencent Yuanbao announced in February 2025 that it would integrate the DeepSeek-R1 model.

description.zh-cn: 以“防范资安风险”为由，要求在中华民国（台湾）公务机关中不得使用DeepSeek。
description.en: Citing 'cybersecurity risks,' it required that DeepSeek not be used in government agencies of the Republic of China (Taiwan).

description.zh-cn: 自2025年2月起，韩国多个政府部门、学校及应用商店以数据安全为由，相继屏蔽或下架DeepSeek。
description.en: Starting from February 2025, several South Korean government departments, schools, and app stores successively blocked or removed DeepSeek, citing data security concerns.

description.zh-cn: 禁止在政府官方设备上使用DeepSeek。
description.en: Banned the use of DeepSeek on official government devices.

description.zh-cn: 基于安全和道德考量，禁止使用DeepSeek。
description.en: Banned the use of DeepSeek based on security and ethical considerations.

description.zh-cn: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋表示，DeepSeek“绝对是 A+级的科学和 A+级的工程质量”，并对DeepSeek表示赞赏。
description.en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang stated that DeepSeek is 'definitely A+ grade science and A+ grade engineering quality,' and expressed his appreciation for DeepSeek.

description.zh-cn: 作为通讯作者，与DeepSeek团队共同在《自然》杂志上发表了题为《DeepSeek-R1透过强化学习激励大型语言模型推理》的论文，并登上该杂志封面。
description.en: As the corresponding author, along with the DeepSeek team, published a paper titled 'DeepSeek-R1: Activating Large Language Model Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning' in the journal Nature, which was featured on the cover.

description.zh-cn: 中央国家安全委员会办公室是中央国家安全委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central National Security Commission is the working body of the Central National Security Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中央国家安全委员会办公室是中共中央办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central National Security Commission is a working body of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中央国家安全委员会办公室是中共中央直属机构中的办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central National Security Commission is a working body among the institutions directly under the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，中共中央决定恢复“中央外事工作领导小组”。2000年9月，中共中央决定组建“中央国家安全工作领导小组”。
description.en: In 1981, the CPC Central Committee decided to restore the 'Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs'. In September 2000, the CCP Central Committee decided to form the 'Central National Security Leading Group'.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，中央国家安全工作领导小组办公室更名为中央国家安全委员会办公室。
description.en: In 2014, the Office of the Central National Security Leading Group was renamed the Office of the Central National Security Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2022年7月起分管日常工作（正部长级）。
description.en: Has been in charge of daily work (ministerial level) since July 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央国安办主任期间兼任中共中央书记处书记。
description.en: Concurrently served as a secretary of the CCP Central Secretariat while serving as Director of the Office of the Central National Security Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央国安办常务副主任期间兼任国家安全部部长。
description.en: Concurrently served as Minister of State Security while serving as Executive Deputy Director of the Office of the Central National Security Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在浙江大学物理系学习，后因日军进入贵州而中断学业。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Physics at Zhejiang University, but his studies were interrupted due to the Japanese invasion of Guizhou.

description.zh-cn: 在浙江大学期间，李政道师从束星北。
description.en: During his time at Zhejiang University, Tsung-Dao Lee studied under Shu Xingbei.

description.zh-cn: 在浙江大学期间，李政道师从王淦昌。
description.en: During his time at Zhejiang University, Tsung-Dao Lee studied under Wang Ganchang.

description.zh-cn: 转学至西南联合大学成为二年级生，后因抗战结束学校停办而未毕业。
description.en: Transferred to National Southwestern Associated University as a sophomore, but did not graduate as the university was dissolved after the war.

description.zh-cn: 在西南联合大学期间，李政道师从吴大猷。
description.en: During his time at National Southwestern Associated University, Tsung-Dao Lee studied under Ta-You Wu.

description.zh-cn: 在西南联合大学期间，李政道师从叶企孙。
description.en: During his time at National Southwestern Associated University, Tsung-Dao Lee studied under Ye Qisun.

description.zh-cn: 在芝加哥大学攻读博士学位期间，师从恩里科·费米。
description.en: Studied under Enrico Fermi while pursuing his Ph.D. at the University of Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 吴氏实验以确凿无疑的证据表明，在弱相互作用过程中宇称守恒定律不成立，验证了李政道和杨振宁的理论。
description.en: The Wu experiment provided conclusive evidence that parity conservation is violated in weak interactions, thus verifying the theory of Lee and Yang.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄在李政道和杨振宁的建议下，设计并领导了吴氏实验。
description.en: At the suggestion of Lee and Yang, Chien-Shiung Wu designed and led the Wu experiment.

description.zh-cn: 因对所谓的宇称不守恒定律的透彻研究，从而导致基本粒子方面的重大发现而授予李政道诺贝尔物理学奖。
description.en: Awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics to Tsung-Dao Lee for his penetrating investigation of the so-called parity laws which has led to important discoveries regarding the elementary particles.

description.zh-cn: 因对所谓的宇称不守恒定律的透彻研究，从而导致基本粒子方面的重大发现而授予杨振宁诺贝尔物理学奖。
description.en: Awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics to Chen-Ning Yang for his penetrating investigation of the so-called parity laws which has led to important discoveries regarding the elementary particles.

description.zh-cn: 李政道访问中国大陆时受到时任国务院总理周恩来的接见。
description.en: During his visit to mainland China, Tsung-Dao Lee was received by then-Premier Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 李政道再次访问中国大陆时受到时任中共中央主席毛泽东的接见。
description.en: During another visit to mainland China, Tsung-Dao Lee was received by then-CPC Chairman Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在与毛泽东会面时建议成立大学少年班，对中国的少年天才进行科学培养。
description.en: During his meeting with Mao Zedong, he suggested the establishment of a special university class for gifted youth in China for scientific training.

description.zh-cn: 同意了李政道关于成立大学少年班的建议，促成了中国科学技术大学少年班的建立。
description.en: Agreed to Tsung-Dao Lee's suggestion to establish a special university class for gifted youth, which led to the creation of the Special Class at the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 马云与张瑛为夫妻关系。
description.en: Jack Ma and Zhang Ying are husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 马雪是马云的女儿。
description.en: Ma Xue is the daughter of Jack Ma.

description.zh-cn: 马云是马来法的儿子。
description.en: Jack Ma is the son of Ma Laifa.

description.zh-cn: 马云是崔文彩的儿子。
description.en: Jack Ma is the son of Cui Wencai.

description.zh-cn: 马云出生于浙江省杭州市。
description.en: Jack Ma was born in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

position.zh-cn: 英语教师、外事办公室主任
position.en: English Teacher, Director of Foreign Affairs Office

description.zh-cn: 马云毕业后在杭州电子工业学院（现杭州电子科技大学）从事英语教学工作，后调任外事办公室主任，于1995年辞职。
description.en: After graduation, Jack Ma worked as an English teacher at Hangzhou Institute of Electronic Engineering (now Hangzhou Dianzi University), was later appointed Director of the Foreign Affairs Office, and resigned in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 马云是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Jack Ma is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，马云辞去公职，创办了阿里巴巴网站。
description.en: In 1999, Jack Ma resigned from his public post and founded the Alibaba website.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，马云秘密成立了淘宝网。
description.en: In 2003, Jack Ma secretly founded Taobao.

description.zh-cn: 2004年，马云创立了独立的第三方电子支付平台支付宝。
description.en: In 2004, Jack Ma founded the independent third-party electronic payment platform Alipay.

description.zh-cn: 马云曾长期担任阿里巴巴集团董事局主席，直至2019年9月10日卸任。
description.en: Jack Ma served as the Executive Chairman of Alibaba Group for a long period until he stepped down on September 10, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 马云表示，他在1997年看到时任马来西亚首相马哈迪提出的“多媒体超级走廊”想法后，受到了启发，最终创立了阿里巴巴集团。
description.en: Jack Ma stated that after seeing the 'Multimedia Super Corridor' idea proposed by then-Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad in 1997, he was inspired to eventually found Alibaba Group.

description.zh-cn: 2018年6月，马云访问马来西亚并与时任首相马哈迪会面。
description.en: In June 2018, Jack Ma visited Malaysia and met with then-Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.

description.zh-cn: 据《经济学人》报道，时任国务院总理李强说服马云于2023年3月回国。
description.en: According to The Economist, then-Premier Li Qiang persuaded Jack Ma to return to China in March 2023.

description.zh-cn: 马云与李连杰联合创办了太极禅苑。
description.en: Jack Ma and Jet Li co-founded Taijizen.

description.zh-cn: 李连杰与马云联合创办了太极禅苑。
description.en: Jet Li and Jack Ma co-founded Taijizen.

description.zh-cn: 2011年，马云在未获董事会通过的情况下，决定终止支付宝与阿里巴巴集团之间的协议控制关系，对集团投资者造成冲击。
description.en: In 2011, without board approval, Jack Ma decided to terminate the VIE control agreement between Alipay and Alibaba Group, which impacted the group's investors.

description.zh-cn: 2019年4月，马云在内部交流中肯定996工作制，称其为“修来的福报”，引发社会广泛争议。
description.en: In April 2019, Jack Ma endorsed the 996 work culture in an internal meeting, calling it a 'huge blessing', which sparked widespread public controversy.

description.zh-cn: 马云曾拜访气功师王林，照片曝光后引发网络热议。
description.en: Jack Ma once visited qigong master Wang Lin, and photos of the visit sparked heated discussion online.

description.zh-cn: 马云与腾讯创始人马化腾在中国互联网行业并称为“二马”，是主要的商业竞争对手。
description.en: Jack Ma and Tencent founder Ma Huateng are known as the 'Two Mas' in China's internet industry and are major business competitors.

description.zh-cn: 司马师是司马懿的长子。
description.en: Sima Shi was the eldest son of Sima Yi.

description.zh-cn: 司马师是张春华的长子。
description.en: Sima Shi was the eldest son of Zhang Chunhua.

description.zh-cn: 司马师是司马昭的兄长。
description.en: Sima Shi was the elder brother of Sima Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 司马师无子，其弟司马昭命次子司马攸过继给司马师为嗣子。
description.en: Sima Shi had no sons, so his brother Sima Zhao ordered his second son, Sima You, to be adopted by Sima Shi as his heir.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯徽是司马师的第一任妻子。
description.en: Xiahou Hui was the first wife of Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 根据《晋书》记载，司马师因忌惮夏侯徽的曹魏宗室外甥女身份而将其毒杀。
description.en: According to the Book of Jin, Sima Shi poisoned Xiahou Hui because he was wary of her background as a niece of the Cao Wei imperial clan.

description.zh-cn: 羊徽瑜是司马师的第三任妻子。
description.en: Yang Huiyu was the third wife of Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 吴氏是司马师的第二任妻子。
description.en: Wu Shi was the second wife of Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 司马师因参与高平陵之变有功，被封为长平乡侯，加封卫将军，开始掌握大权。
description.en: For his merits in the Incident at Gaoping Tombs, Sima Shi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Changpingxiang, granted the title of General of the Guards, and began to consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 司马师参与高平陵之变，推翻并处死了时任大将军的曹爽。
description.en: Sima Shi participated in the Incident at Gaoping Tombs, overthrowing and executing the then Grand General Cao Shuang.

description.zh-cn: 在东兴之战中，诸葛恪率领的吴军击败了司马师派遣的魏军。
description.en: In the Battle of Dongxing, the Wu forces led by Zhuge Ke defeated the Wei forces dispatched by Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 在合肥新城之战中，司马师派遣的军队成功防御并击退了诸葛恪率领的吴军的围攻。
description.en: In the siege of Hefei Xincheng, forces dispatched by Sima Shi successfully defended and repelled the siege by Wu forces led by Zhuge Ke.

description.zh-cn: 李丰图谋废黜司马师，事情败露后被司马师灭族。
description.en: Li Feng plotted to depose Sima Shi; after the plot was exposed, his clan was exterminated by Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 张缉图谋废黜司马师，事情败露后被司马师灭族。
description.en: Zhang Ji plotted to depose Sima Shi; after the plot was exposed, his clan was exterminated by Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯玄因李丰、张缉谋立其为大将军而受牵连，被司马师处死。
description.en: Xiahou Xuan was implicated because Li Feng and Zhang Ji planned to make him Grand General, and was executed by Sima Shi.

description.zh-cn: 司马师以郭太后的名义废黜了皇帝曹芳。
description.en: Sima Shi deposed Emperor Cao Fang in the name of Empress Dowager Guo.

description.zh-cn: 废黜曹芳后，司马师拥立高贵乡公曹髦为新皇帝。
description.en: After deposing Cao Fang, Sima Shi installed Cao Mao, the Duke of Gaoguixiang, as the new emperor.

description.zh-cn: 司马师亲自率军平定了毌丘俭与文钦在寿春发动的叛乱。
description.en: Sima Shi personally led the army to suppress the rebellion launched by Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin in Shouchun.

description.zh-cn: 文鸯率兵袭营，导致司马师在惊吓中眼瘤破裂，病情加重，不久后去世。
description.en: Wen Yang led a raid on the camp, which caused Sima Shi's eye tumor to rupture from shock, worsening his condition and leading to his death shortly after.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾在司马师掌权期间（251-255）担任汝南太守、兖州刺史等职。在平定毌丘俭文钦之乱（255年）时，邓艾受司马师指令，率军至乐嘉县诱敌。
description.en: During Sima Shi's regency (251-255), Deng Ai served as Administrator of Runan, Inspector of Yan Province, and other positions. In 255, during the suppression of Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin's Rebellion, Deng Ai was ordered by Sima Shi to lead troops to Lejia County to lure the enemy.

description.zh-cn: 司马师在曹叡执政期间开始其仕途，官至散骑常侍。
description.en: Sima Shi began his official career during the reign of Cao Rui, serving as a Gentleman Attendant at the Palace Gate.

description.zh-cn: 司马师年轻时与夏侯玄、何晏等人齐名。
description.en: In his youth, Sima Shi was equally famous as Xiahou Xuan and He Yan.

description.zh-cn: 司马师年轻时与夏侯玄、何晏等人齐名。
description.en: In his youth, Sima Shi was equally famous as Xiahou Xuan and He Yan.

description.zh-cn: 参与组织和发动两当兵变。
description.en: Participated in organizing and launching the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 参与组织和发动两当兵变。
description.en: Participated in organizing and launching the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 参与组织和发动两当兵变。
description.en: Participated in organizing and launching the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 两当兵变是在中国共产党的领导下发生的。
description.en: The Liangdang Mutiny occurred under the leadership of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 秘密派遣习仲勋到杨虎城第十七路军开展兵运工作，为两当兵变做准备。
description.en: Secretly dispatched Xi Zhongxun to Yang Hucheng's 17th Route Army to carry out military movement work in preparation for the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 秘密派遣李特生到杨虎城第十七路军开展兵运工作，为两当兵变做准备。
description.en: Secretly dispatched Li Tesheng to Yang Hucheng's 17th Route Army to carry out military movement work in preparation for the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 秘密派遣李秉荣到杨虎城第十七路军开展兵运工作。
description.en: Secretly dispatched Li Bingrong to Yang Hucheng's 17th Route Army to carry out military movement work.

description.zh-cn: 在两当兵变前夕，与刘书林等人合影纪念。
description.en: Took a commemorative photo with Liu Shulin and others on the eve of the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 在两当兵变前夕，与刘尚志等人合影纪念。
description.en: Took a commemorative photo with Liu Shangzhi and others on the eve of the Liangdang Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达于2019年上任成为立陶宛总统。
description.en: Gitanas Nausėda took office as the President of Lithuania in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 在2020年立陶宛议会选举后，因格丽达·希莫尼特上任成为总理。
description.en: Following the 2020 Lithuanian parliamentary election, Ingrida Šimonytė took office as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 绍柳斯·斯克韦尔内利斯于2024年上任成为立陶宛议会议长。
description.en: Saulius Skvernelis took office as the Speaker of the Seimas in 2024.

description.zh-cn: 明道加斯统一了立陶宛，并于1253年接受加冕，建立了立陶宛王国。
description.en: Mindaugas united Lithuania and was crowned in 1253, establishing the Kingdom of Lithuania.

description.zh-cn: 《卢布林联合》的签署确立了波兰立陶宛联邦的建立。
description.en: The signing of the Union of Lublin established the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯、普鲁士及奥地利对波兰立陶宛联邦的三次瓜分，最终导致联邦于1795年灭亡。
description.en: The three partitions of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth by Russia, Prussia, and Austria led to the final demise of the state in 1795.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯帝国参与了对波兰立陶宛联邦的瓜分，吞并了其大部分领土。
description.en: The Russian Empire participated in the partitions of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, annexing most of its territory.

description.zh-cn: 该法案的签署宣告了现代立陶宛共和国的独立。
description.en: The signing of this act declared the independence of the modern Republic of Lithuania.

description.zh-cn: 苏联于1940年占领并吞并立陶宛，中断了其独立国家的地位，直至1990年立陶宛宣布恢复独立。
description.en: The Soviet Union occupied and annexed Lithuania in 1940, interrupting its status as an independent state until Lithuania declared its restored independence in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 该法案的签署宣告了立陶宛脱离苏联，恢复独立国家地位。
description.en: The signing of this act declared Lithuania's secession from the Soviet Union and the restoration of its independent statehood.

description.zh-cn: 作为一场大规模的反苏和平示威，“波罗的海之路”极大地推动了立陶宛恢复独立的进程。
description.en: As a massive anti-Soviet peaceful demonstration, the Baltic Way significantly pushed forward the process of restoring Lithuania's independence.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛游击队为反抗苏联的占领而进行了长达近十年的武装斗争。
description.en: The Lithuanian partisans waged an armed struggle against the Soviet occupation for nearly a decade.

description.zh-cn: 苏联军队试图通过军事行动推翻新独立的立陶宛政府，但未能成功。
description.en: Soviet military forces attempted to overthrow the newly independent government of Lithuania through military action, but failed.

description.zh-cn: 冰岛是第一个承认立陶宛于1990年恢复独立的国家，为立陶宛的独立提供了国际支持。
description.en: Iceland was the first country to recognize Lithuania's restored independence in 1990, providing international support for its independence.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛于2004年5月1日正式成为欧洲联盟的成员国。
description.en: Lithuania officially became a member state of the European Union on May 1, 2004.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛于2004年3月29日正式加入北大西洋公约组织。
description.en: Lithuania officially joined the North Atlantic Treaty Organization on March 29, 2004.

description.zh-cn: 自2021年起，由于立陶宛采取“亲台疏中”政策，包括允许设立驻立陶宛台湾代表处和认定新疆存在种族灭绝，两国关系急剧恶化。
description.en: Since 2021, due to Lithuania's 'pro-Taiwan, distant-from-China' policy, including allowing the establishment of the Taiwanese Representative Office and recognizing the genocide in Xinjiang, relations between the two countries have deteriorated sharply.

description.zh-cn: 自2021年起，立陶宛与台湾的关系显著增进，包括互赠防疫物资以及互设代表处。
description.en: Since 2021, relations between Lithuania and Taiwan have significantly improved, including mutual donations of anti-pandemic supplies and the establishment of representative offices.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战德国占领期间，纳粹德国及其合作者在立陶宛境内系统性地屠杀犹太人。
description.en: During the German occupation in World War II, Nazi Germany and its collaborators systematically murdered Jews within Lithuania.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛犹太人大屠杀导致该国91%至95%的犹太人遇害。
description.en: The Holocaust in Lithuania resulted in the murder of 91% to 95% of the country's Jewish population.

description.zh-cn: 1870年9月4日，在拿破仑三世于色当战役被俘后，莱昂·甘必大领导的巴黎代表宣布成立临时国防政府，开启了第三共和国。
description.en: On September 4, 1870, after Napoleon III was captured at the Battle of Sedan, Paris deputies led by Léon Gambetta proclaimed a provisional Government of National Defense, beginning the Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第三共和国是在法兰西第二帝国于普法战争中崩溃后建立的。
description.en: The French Third Republic was established following the collapse of the Second French Empire in the Franco-Prussian War.

description.zh-cn: 1940年的法国战役导致法国被纳粹德国击败，直接促成了法兰西第三共和国的终结。
description.en: The Battle of France in 1940 led to France's defeat by Nazi Germany, directly causing the end of the French Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 维希法国的成立标志着法兰西第三共和国的正式终结，菲利普·贝当被授予全部权力。
description.en: The establishment of Vichy France marked the official end of the Third Republic, with full powers granted to Philippe Pétain.

description.zh-cn: 阿道夫·梯也尔是法兰西第三共和国的首任总统。
description.en: Adolphe Thiers was the first President of the French Third Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1871年5月，阿道夫·梯也尔领导的政府血腥镇压了巴黎公社。
description.en: In May 1871, the government led by Adolphe Thiers brutally suppressed the Paris Commune.

description.zh-cn: 在帕特里斯·麦克马洪的指挥下，法国正规军在“血腥周”期间摧毁了巴黎公社。
description.en: Under the command of Patrice de MacMahon, the French regular army succeeded in crushing the Paris Commune during the 'Bloody Week'.

description.zh-cn: 帕特里斯·麦克马洪于1873年5月当选为共和国总统，任期至1879年1月。
description.en: Patrice de MacMahon was elected President of the Republic in May 1873 and served until January 1879.

description.zh-cn: 1898年1月，作家埃米尔·左拉发表了一封措辞激烈的公开信为德雷福斯辩护，向政府施加压力，要求重新审理此案。
description.en: In January 1898, writer Émile Zola published a strongly worded open letter in defense of Dreyfus, pressuring the government to reopen the case.

description.zh-cn: 该法律正式将教会与国家分离，所有教堂财产被没收，宗教人员不再由国家支付工资，严重打击了天主教会的地位。
description.en: This law officially separated church and state, confiscated all church property, and stopped state payment of clerical salaries, severely impacting the position of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 为了孤立德国，法国于1894年与俄罗斯帝国缔结了法俄同盟，这一军事联盟成为法国外交政策的基石。
description.en: To isolate Germany, France entered into the Franco-Russian Alliance with the Russian Empire in 1894, a military alliance that became a cornerstone of French foreign policy.

description.zh-cn: 1904年，法国与英国签署了《英法协约》，结束了两国长期的紧张关系，建立了一种非正式的联盟以对抗德国。
description.en: In 1904, France signed the Entente Cordiale with Great Britain, ending a long period of tension and establishing an informal alliance against Germany.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·克列孟梭自1917年起领导联合政府，以其坚定的决心推动法国赢得第一次世界大战的胜利。
description.en: From 1917, Georges Clemenceau led a coalition government, pushing France towards victory in World War I with his strong determination.

description.zh-cn: 莱昂·布鲁姆是1936年成立的人民阵线政府的总理。
description.en: Léon Blum was the Prime Minister of the Popular Front government formed in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 由于总理莱昂·布鲁姆拒绝按照共产党的要求积极干预西班牙内战，人民阵线联盟最终分崩离析。
description.en: The Popular Front coalition eventually fell apart due to Prime Minister Léon Blum's refusal to actively intervene in the Spanish Civil War as demanded by the Communists.

description.zh-cn: 在1940年法国沦陷后，夏尔·戴高乐将军发出了“6月18日呼吁”，号召法国人继续抵抗，并建立了自由法国流亡政府。
description.en: After the fall of France in 1940, General Charles de Gaulle issued the Appeal of 18 June, calling on the French to continue the fight and establishing the Free French government-in-exile.

description.zh-cn: 醇贤亲王嫡妃是光绪帝的生母。
description.en: Wanzhen was the biological mother of the Guangxu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 瑾妃是光绪帝的妃嫔。
description.en: Consort Jin was a consort of the Guangxu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在同治帝去世后，与慈安太后共同决定选择载湉（光绪帝）继位。
description.en: After the death of the Tongzhi Emperor, she and Empress Dowager Ci'an jointly decided to choose Zaitian (the Guangxu Emperor) to succeed the throne.

description.zh-cn: 在同治帝去世后，与慈禧太后共同决定选择载湉（光绪帝）继位。
description.en: After the death of the Tongzhi Emperor, she and Empress Dowager Cixi jointly decided to choose Zaitian (the Guangxu Emperor) to succeed the throne.

description.zh-cn: 戊戌政变后，光绪帝被剥夺实权，并被软禁于中南海瀛台直至去世。
description.en: After the 1898 Coup, the Guangxu Emperor was stripped of real power and placed under house arrest at Yingtai in Zhongnanhai until his death.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌变法期间，光绪帝起用康有为推行新政。
description.en: During the Hundred Days' Reform, the Guangxu Emperor appointed Kang Youwei to implement new policies.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌变法期间，光绪帝起用梁启超等维新派人士推行新政。
description.en: During the Hundred Days' Reform, the Guangxu Emperor appointed reformists like Liang Qichao to implement new policies.

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌变法关键时刻，袁世凯向荣禄告密，导致慈禧太后发动政变，光绪帝的变法计划失败。
description.en: At a critical moment during the Hundred Days' Reform, Yuan Shikai informed on the reformers to Ronglu, leading Empress Dowager Cixi to launch a coup and causing the failure of the Guangxu Emperor's reform plans.

description.zh-cn: 根据2008年的科学检测，光绪帝的遗体中含有高浓度的三氧化二砷（砒霜），证实其死于急性中毒。
description.en: According to scientific tests in 2008, the remains of the Guangxu Emperor contained high concentrations of arsenic trioxide, confirming that he died of acute poisoning.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝出生于北京太平湖醇亲王府。
description.en: The Guangxu Emperor was born at the Prince Chun Mansion by Taiping Lake in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 光绪帝于1875年至1908年间担任清朝皇帝。
description.en: The Guangxu Emperor served as the emperor of the Qing dynasty from 1875 to 1908.

description.zh-cn: 翟磊是山东潍坊人。
description.en: Zhai Lei is a native of Weifang, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 翟磊是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhai Lei is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区监察委员会与中国共产党内蒙古自治区纪律检查委员会合署办公。
description.en: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Supervisory Commission is co-located and works together with the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区监察委员会的业务上级是中华人民共和国国家监察委员会。
description.en: The professional superior of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Supervisory Commission is the National Supervisory Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区监察委员会由内蒙古自治区人民代表大会产生，并对它负责、受它监督。
description.en: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Supervisory Commission is created by, responsible to, and supervised by the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 内蒙古自治区监察委员会对内蒙古自治区人民代表大会常务委员会负责、并受其监督。
description.en: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Supervisory Commission is responsible to and supervised by the Standing Committee of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 由于与中共内蒙古自治区纪委合署办公，内蒙古自治区监察委员会在党内关系上接受中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会的领导。
description.en: Due to its co-location with the Inner Mongolia Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CCP, the Inner Mongolia Supervisory Commission accepts the leadership of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China in terms of party relations.

description.zh-cn: 洪玛奈是洪森的儿子，其接任首相被视为“家族独裁”的延续。
description.en: Hun Manet is the son of Hun Sen, and his succession as prime minister is seen as a continuation of a 'family dictatorship'.

description.zh-cn: 诺罗敦·西哈莫尼是柬埔寨现任国王和终身国家元首。
description.en: Norodom Sihamoni is the current King and lifetime head of state of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 洪玛奈是柬埔寨现任政府首脑（首相）。
description.en: Hun Manet is the current head of government (Prime Minister) of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 洪森是柬埔寨参议院现任议长。
description.en: Hun Sen is the current President of the Senate of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 参议院是柬埔寨国会的上议院。
description.en: The Senate is the upper house of the Parliament of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 国民议会是柬埔寨国会的下议院。
description.en: The National Assembly is the lower house of the Parliament of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨与中国关系密切，奉行亲中外交政策，中国是其最大援助国。
description.en: Cambodia maintains close relations with China, pursues a pro-China foreign policy, and China is its largest aid provider.

description.zh-cn: 洪森奉行亲中的外交政策。
description.en: Hun Sen pursues a pro-China foreign policy.

description.zh-cn: 因柏威夏寺主权争议等问题，柬埔寨与泰国的关系紧张，并曾多次爆发小规模战事。
description.en: Due to issues such as the sovereignty dispute over the Preah Vihear Temple, relations between Cambodia and Thailand are tense, and small-scale military conflicts have broken out multiple times.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨是东南亚国家联盟的成员国。
description.en: Cambodia is a member state of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.

description.zh-cn: 龙诺于1970年3月18日发动政变。
description.en: Lon Nol launched a coup d'état on March 18, 1970.

description.zh-cn: 1970年政变废止了君主制，推翻了柬埔寨第一王国。
description.en: The 1970 coup abolished the monarchy, overthrowing the first Kingdom of Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 1970年政变后成立了高棉共和国。
description.en: The Khmer Republic was established after the 1970 coup.

description.zh-cn: 1975年4月17日，红色高棉攻占金边，推翻了高棉共和国。
description.en: On April 17, 1975, the Khmer Rouge captured Phnom Penh, overthrowing the Khmer Republic.

description.zh-cn: 红色高棉在1975年建立了民主柬埔寨政权。
description.en: The Khmer Rouge established the Democratic Kampuchea regime in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 波尔布特是柬埔寨共产党总书记，领导红色高棉。
description.en: Pol Pot was the General Secretary of the Communist Party of Kampuchea and led the Khmer Rouge.

description.zh-cn: 诺罗敦·施汉诺在红色高棉掌权后归国，但迅速遭到软禁。
description.en: Norodom Sihanouk returned to the country after the Khmer Rouge took power but was quickly placed under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月，越南出兵柬埔寨，发动了柬越战争。
description.en: In December 1978, Vietnam sent troops into Cambodia, launching the Cambodian-Vietnamese War.

description.zh-cn: 柬越战争最终于1979年1月7日攻陷金边，终结了红色高棉政权。
description.en: The Cambodian-Vietnamese War culminated in the capture of Phnom Penh on January 7, 1979, ending the Khmer Rouge regime.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨人民共和国被视为越南的卫星国，直至1989年越南撤军。
description.en: The People's Republic of Kampuchea was considered a satellite state of Vietnam until the Vietnamese withdrawal in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 2017年11月，柬埔寨最高法院裁定解散主要反对党柬埔寨救国党。
description.en: In November 2017, the Supreme Court of Cambodia ruled to dissolve the main opposition party, the Cambodia National Rescue Party.

description.zh-cn: 洪森与前泰国首相塔信关系密切，并曾于2009至2010年间聘任其为经济顾问。
description.en: Hun Sen had a close relationship with former Thai Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra and appointed him as an economic advisor between 2009 and 2010.

description.zh-cn: 《朝美核框架协议》未能得到执行，导致美朝关系破裂，并直接引发了第二次朝核危机。
description.en: The failure to implement the Agreed Framework led to the breakdown of US-DPRK relations and directly triggered the Second North Korean nuclear crisis.

description.zh-cn: 2003年1月10日，朝鲜宣布退出《不扩散核武器条约》。
description.en: On January 10, 2003, North Korea announced its withdrawal from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons.

description.zh-cn: 应美国请求，中国政府决定出面斡旋，并主办了旨在解决朝鲜核问题的三方及后续的六方会谈。
description.en: At the request of the United States, the Chinese government decided to mediate and hosted the three-party and subsequent six-party talks aimed at resolving the North Korean nuclear issue.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部指责澳门汇业银行替朝鲜洗钱并实施制裁，冻结了朝鲜在该行的资金，对六方会谈进程造成了严重阻碍。
description.en: The U.S. Treasury Department accused Banco Delta Asia of money laundering for North Korea and imposed sanctions, freezing North Korean funds in the bank, which severely hampered the Six-Party Talks process.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜于2006年10月9日进行的首次核试验，促使联合国安理会于10月14日一致通过第1718号决议，对朝鲜进行制裁。
description.en: North Korea's first nuclear test on October 9, 2006, prompted the UN Security Council to unanimously adopt Resolution 1718 on October 14, imposing sanctions on North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜发射“光明星2号”卫星后，联合国安理会通过主席声明予以谴责，朝鲜随后于4月14日宣布退出六方会谈。
description.en: After North Korea launched the 'Kwangmyŏngsŏng-2' satellite, the UN Security Council issued a presidential statement condemning it, and North Korea subsequently announced its withdrawal from the Six-Party Talks on April 14.

description.zh-cn: 金正恩是金正日的第三子，并在其父去世后成为朝鲜最高领导人。
description.en: Kim Jong-un is the third son of Kim Jong-il and became the supreme leader of North Korea after his father's death.

description.zh-cn: 金庸于1948年与杜冶芬结婚，后于1953年离婚。
description.en: Jin Yong married Du Yefen in 1948, and they divorced in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 金庸于1956年与朱玫结婚，育有二子二女，后于1976年离婚。
description.en: Jin Yong married Zhu Mei in 1956, with whom he had two sons and two daughters, and they divorced in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 金庸于1976年与朱玫离婚后，与林乐怡结婚，直至其逝世。
description.en: After divorcing Zhu Mei in 1976, Jin Yong married Lin Leyi, and they remained married until his death.

description.zh-cn: 金庸于1924年3月10日出生于浙江省海宁县。
description.en: Jin Yong was born in Haining County, Zhejiang Province on March 10, 1924.

description.zh-cn: 1937年日本入侵华南，金庸的母亲徐禄在举家逃难途中不幸病逝。
description.en: In 1937, during the Japanese invasion of Southern China, Jin Yong's mother, Xu Lu, died of illness while the family was fleeing.

description.zh-cn: 金庸因对校内国民党员行为不满而向校方投诉，反被退学。
description.en: Jin Yong was expelled after complaining to the school authorities about the behavior of KMT student members.

description.zh-cn: 1946年赴上海东吴大学法学院插班修习国际法课程，1948年毕业。
description.en: Enrolled in the Soochow University School of Law in Shanghai in 1946 to study international law, and graduated in 1948.

degree.zh-cn: 历史学哲学硕士、哲学博士

description.zh-cn: 2005年起在剑桥大学深造，先后取得历史学硕士及博士学位。
description.en: Pursued advanced studies at the University of Cambridge from 2005, obtaining both an MPhil and a PhD in History.

description.zh-cn: 1959年，金庸与沈宝新合资创办《明报》。
description.en: In 1959, Jin Yong co-founded Ming Pao with Shen Pao Sing.

description.zh-cn: 1959年，沈宝新与金庸合资创办《明报》。
description.en: In 1959, Shen Pao Sing co-founded Ming Pao with Jin Yong.

description.zh-cn: 朱玫以其新闻从业经验协助丈夫金庸创办《明报》。
description.en: Zhu Mei used her journalistic experience to assist her husband Jin Yong in founding Ming Pao.

description.zh-cn: 金庸在《新晚报》工作期间与同事梁羽生相识为友。
description.en: Jin Yong befriended his colleague Liang Yusheng while working at the New Evening Post.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，金庸在北京与时任中华人民共和国领导人邓小平会谈，成为首位获邓小平单独接见的香港人。
description.en: In 1981, Jin Yong met with then-PRC leader Deng Xiaoping in Beijing, becoming the first person from Hong Kong to be granted a private audience by Deng.

description.zh-cn: 1984年，金庸访问中国大陆时与时任中共中央总书记胡耀邦会谈。
description.en: In 1984, during his visit to mainland China, Jin Yong met with then-CPC General Secretary Hu Yaobang.

position.zh-cn: 委员、政治体制起草小组港方负责人
position.en: Member, Hong Kong Co-convenor of the Political Structure Sub-group

description.zh-cn: 1985年，金庸成为香港基本法起草委员会委员，后因六四事件于1989年辞职。
description.en: In 1985, Jin Yong became a member of the Hong Kong Basic Law Drafting Committee, but he resigned in 1989 following the Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，金庸与查济民共同提出了关于香港政制发展的“双查方案”。
description.en: In 1988, Jin Yong and Cha Chi-ming jointly proposed the 'Cha-Cha proposal' regarding Hong Kong's political system development.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，查济民与金庸（查良镛）共同提出了关于香港政制发展的“双查方案”。
description.en: In 1988, Cha Chi-ming and Jin Yong (Cha Leung-yung) jointly proposed the 'Cha-Cha proposal' regarding Hong Kong's political system development.

description.zh-cn: 1993年两会期间，金庸赴北京访问并获时任中共中央总书记江泽民接见。
description.en: During the Two Sessions in 1993, Jin Yong visited Beijing and was received by then-CPC General Secretary Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 金庸于1993年将明报集团售予于品海，并宣布全面退休。
description.en: In 1993, Jin Yong sold the Ming Pao Group to Yu Pun-hoi and announced his full retirement.

description.zh-cn: 蔡澜是金庸的好友，两人同被列为“香港四大才子”。
description.en: Chua Lam was a good friend of Jin Yong, and they were both known as one of the 'Four Great Talents of Hong Kong'.

description.zh-cn: 汪承栋是湖南永顺人。
description.en: Wang Chengdong was from Yongshun, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 汪承栋曾担任中国作家协会名誉委员。
description.en: Wang Chengdong served as an honorary committee member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 汪承栋曾担任西藏自治区文学艺术界联合会副主席。
description.en: Wang Chengdong served as the vice-chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类“中国共产党党员”，汪承栋是该党成员。
description.en: According to the category 'Communist Party of China members', Wang Chengdong was a member of the party.

description.zh-cn: 1990年2月13日，江泽民为第二炮兵部队题词：“加强战略导弹部队建设，保卫祖国安全，维护世界和平。”
description.en: On February 13, 1990, Jiang Zemin wrote an inscription for the Second Artillery Corps: 'Strengthen the construction of the strategic missile force, defend the security of the motherland, and maintain world peace.'

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛评价第二炮兵部队是“党中央、中央军委直接使用的战略部队，是我国战略威慑的核心力量”。
description.en: Hu Jintao described the Second Artillery Corps as 'a strategic force directly used by the Party Central Committee and the Central Military Commission, and the core force of our country's strategic deterrence'.

description.zh-cn: 时任火箭军副司令员刘光斌被中央军委纪委调查人员带走进行调查。
description.en: Then-deputy commander of the Rocket Force Liu Guangbin was taken away for investigation by personnel from the CMC Discipline Inspection Commission.

description.zh-cn: 前火箭军副司令员张振中被中央军委纪委调查人员带走进行调查。
description.en: Former deputy commander of the Rocket Force Zhang Zhenzhong was taken away for investigation by personnel from the CMC Discipline Inspection Commission.

description.zh-cn: 因原司令员李玉超在腐败案中落马，王厚斌被任命为新任火箭军司令员。
description.en: Following the downfall of former commander Li Yuchao in the corruption case, Wang Houbin was appointed as the new commander of the Rocket Force.

description.zh-cn: 因火箭军高层在腐败案中被清洗，徐西盛被任命为新任火箭军政治委员。
description.en: Following the purge of the Rocket Force's high command in the corruption case, Xu Xisheng was appointed as the new political commissar of the Rocket Force.

description.zh-cn: 鄢东是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yan Dong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Deputy Director-General of the Department of Personnel

description.zh-cn: 鄢东曾担任中华人民共和国商务部人事司副司长。
description.en: Yan Dong previously served as the Deputy Director-General of the Department of Personnel of the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2022年5月至2025年2月，鄢东担任中国人民对外友好协会副会长。
description.en: From May 2022 to February 2025, Yan Dong served as the Vice President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries.

description.zh-cn: 阿布杜拉加克·阿布巴卡尔·简加拉尼于1991年创立了阿布沙耶夫组织。
description.en: Abdurajak Abubakar Janjalani founded the Abu Sayyaf group in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 1998年12月18日，菲律宾警方向阿布沙耶夫组织发动猛攻，击毙了阿布杜拉加克。
description.en: On December 18, 1998, the Philippine police launched a fierce attack on the Abu Sayyaf organization, killing Abdurajak.

description.zh-cn: 苏联入侵阿富汗期间，简加拉尼奔赴阿富汗，加入了所谓的“圣战”行列。
description.en: During the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, Janjalani went to Afghanistan and joined the so-called 'jihad'.

description.zh-cn: 2014年7月23日，阿布沙耶夫宣誓效忠于伊斯兰国，正式名称更改为伊斯兰国东亚省。
description.en: On July 23, 2014, Abu Sayyaf pledged allegiance to the Islamic State, and its official name was changed to Islamic State - East Asia Province.

description.zh-cn: 阿布沙耶夫以前是基地组织的盟友。
description.en: Abu Sayyaf was formerly an ally of Al-Qaeda.

description.zh-cn: 阿布沙耶夫于2000年4月23日在马来西亚西巴丹岛制造了绑架事件。
description.en: Abu Sayyaf carried out the kidnapping incident on Sipadan Island, Malaysia on April 23, 2000.

description.zh-cn: 在2001年5月道斯帕尔马斯绑架事件后，时任总统雅罗育派政府军向阿布沙耶夫的藏身之所发动了大规模的军事进攻。
description.en: After the Dos Palmas kidnapping incident in May 2001, then-President Arroyo sent government troops to launch a large-scale military offensive against Abu Sayyaf's hideout.

description.zh-cn: 2013年11月15日，阿布沙耶夫成员劫持并杀害了台湾游客许立民。
description.en: On November 15, 2013, members of Abu Sayyaf kidnapped and killed Taiwanese tourist Hsu Li-min.

description.zh-cn: 阿布沙耶夫于2016年9月2日在达沃市一夜市引爆炸弹，制造了爆炸事件。
