description.en: Abu Sayyaf detonated a bomb at a night market in Davao City on September 2, 2016, causing the bombing incident.

description.zh-cn: 2017年5月23日，阿布沙耶夫与毛特组织一起占领了马拉维地区，引发了马拉维危机。
description.en: On May 23, 2017, Abu Sayyaf, along with the Maute group, occupied the Marawi region, triggering the Battle of Marawi.

description.zh-cn: 2017年5月23日，毛特组织与阿布沙耶夫一起占领了马拉维地区，引发了马拉维危机。
description.en: On May 23, 2017, the Maute group, along with Abu Sayyaf, occupied the Marawi region, triggering the Battle of Marawi.

description.zh-cn: 付国豪出生于天津市。
description.en: Fu Guohao was born in Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 付国豪大学四年级时在《天津日报》实习。
description.en: Fu Guohao interned at Tianjin Daily during his fourth year of university.

description.zh-cn: 大学毕业后，付国豪在北京世华万向资讯公司（多维新闻网）负责香港与台湾新闻的编辑工作两年。
description.en: After graduating from university, Fu Guohao worked as an editor for Hong Kong and Taiwan news at Duowei News (Beijing Shihua Wanxiang Information Co.) for two years.

position.en: Editor-in-Chief of Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan Channel

description.zh-cn: 付国豪在环球网工作，并兼任港澳台频道主编。
description.en: Fu Guohao worked at huanqiu.com and also served as the editor-in-chief of its Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan channel.

description.zh-cn: 付国豪在《环球时报》任职期间，胡锡进是其总编辑。
description.en: While Fu Guohao worked at the Global Times, Hu Xijin was his editor-in-chief.

description.zh-cn: 在反对逃犯条例修订草案运动期间，示威者在香港国际机场发起了集会，并导致了付国豪遇袭事件的发生。
description.en: During the Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement, protesters held a rally at Hong Kong International Airport, which led to the assault on Fu Guohao.

description.zh-cn: 付国豪在香港国际机场被示威者袭击和殴打。
description.en: Fu Guohao was assaulted and beaten by protesters at Hong Kong International Airport.

description.zh-cn: 环球时报召开香港报导表彰会，授予付国豪人民币10万元的最高奖。
description.en: The Global Times held a commendation meeting for its Hong Kong coverage and awarded Fu Guohao the highest prize of 100,000 RMB.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年积极筹划并负责创建了中央研究院历史语言研究所。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien actively planned and was responsible for the establishment of the Institute of History and Philology at Academia Sinica.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年担任五四运动中学生游行队伍的总指挥。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien served as the general commander of the student parade during the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 发表《这个样子的宋子文非走开不可》等文章，痛批时任行政院长宋子文发国难财，将其逼下台。
description.en: He published articles such as 'This kind of T.V. Soong must go', criticizing then-Premier T. V. Soong for war profiteering and forcing him to resign.

description.zh-cn: 与罗家伦、毛子水等人一同组织新潮社，是五四运动时期的著名学生领袖。
description.en: Together with Luo Jialun, Mao Zishui, and others, he organized the Xinchao She (New Tide Society) and was a prominent student leader during the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 胡适称傅斯年为其“最好的诤友和保护人”。
description.en: Hu Shih called Fu Ssu-nien his 'best critic and protector'.

description.zh-cn: 访问延安期间，傅斯年与毛泽东进行了一次单独的长谈。
description.en: During his visit to Yan'an, Fu Ssu-nien had a long, private conversation with Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在延安与毛泽东长谈后，傅斯年认为毛的作风纯粹是专制愚民，是“宋江”之流，这坚定了他反共的立场。
description.en: After a long conversation with Mao Zedong in Yan'an, Fu Ssu-nien concluded that Mao's style was purely autocratic and aimed at keeping the people ignorant, likening him to 'Song Jiang'. This solidified his anti-communist stance.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年是民国时期著名的反共学者，认为中共是“祖传的流寇”，其作风反自由、反民主，并发表多篇文章阐述反共立场。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien was a well-known anti-communist scholar during the Republican era. He considered the CCP to be 'hereditary roving bandits' with an anti-liberal and anti-democratic style, and he published numerous articles explaining his anti-communist position.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年同样反对苏联，认为苏联既没有自由也没有平等，是集人类文明罪恶之大成的国家，主张反共必反苏。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien also opposed the Soviet Union, believing it lacked both freedom and equality and was the epitome of the evils of human civilization. He advocated that anti-communism must also be anti-Soviet.

description.zh-cn: 傅以渐是傅斯年的七世祖。
description.en: Fu Yijian was Fu Ssu-nien's seventh-generation ancestor.

description.zh-cn: 时任台湾省政府主席陈诚致电傅斯年，敦促其速来台湾出任国立台湾大学校长，共负巨艰。
description.en: Then-Governor of Taiwan Province Chen Cheng telegraphed Fu Ssu-nien, urging him to come to Taiwan quickly to take up the presidency of National Taiwan University and share the great difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 在与陈诚商讨后，傅斯年同意肃清台大和师范学院的“匪谍”，但提出了“不能流血”等三个条件，影响了事件的处理方式。
description.en: After discussions with Chen Cheng, Fu Ssu-nien agreed to purge the 'communist spies' from NTU and the Normal College but stipulated three conditions, including 'no bloodshed', which influenced how the incident was handled.

description.zh-cn: 在四六事件期间，傅斯年向时任台湾警备总司令彭孟缉提出请求，在驱离学生时不能流血，否则要与其拚命。
description.en: During the April Sixth Incident, Fu Ssu-nien made a request to then-commander of the Taiwan Garrison Command, Peng Meng-chi, stating that there should be no bloodshed when dispersing the students, or he would 'fight him to the death'.

description.zh-cn: 受蔡元培推荐，傅斯年于1920年出洋留学。
description.en: On the recommendation of Cai Yuanpei, Fu Ssu-nien went abroad to study in 1920.

description.zh-cn: 傅斯年曾因美金公债案之事写信给蒋介石，事后蒋介石亲自请他吃饭进行讨论。
description.en: Fu Ssu-nien wrote a letter to Chiang Kai-shek regarding the US Dollar Bond case, after which Chiang personally invited him to a meal for discussion.

description.zh-cn: 彭建兵是湖北麻城人。
description.en: Peng Jianbing is from Macheng, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 彭建兵于1978年毕业于武汉地质学院，获工学学士学位。
description.en: Peng Jianbing graduated from Wuhan College of Geology in 1978 with a Bachelor of Engineering degree.

description.zh-cn: 彭建兵于1999年毕业于西安工程学院，获博士学位。
description.en: Peng Jianbing graduated from Xi'an Engineering College in 1999 with a doctoral degree.

description.zh-cn: 彭建兵是长安大学的教授。
description.en: Peng Jianbing is a professor at Chang'an University.

description.zh-cn: 彭建兵于2019年当选为中国科学院院士。
description.en: Peng Jianbing was elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，彭建兵是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Peng Jianbing is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 雷星平是湖南邵阳人。
description.en: Lei Xingping is a native of Shaoyang, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 雷星平是中华人民共和国的军事人物。
description.en: Lei Xingping is a military figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 雷星平拥有中国人民解放军少将军衔。
description.en: Lei Xingping holds the rank of Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 雷星平曾任陕西省军区政治委员。
description.en: Lei Xingping formerly served as the Political Commissar of the Shaanxi Military District.

description.zh-cn: 雷星平是第八届全国人民代表大会的代表。
description.en: Lei Xingping was a delegate to the 8th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据其维基百科分类，雷星平是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to his Wikipedia category, Lei Xingping is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇在统一中国后，创造了“皇帝”这一称号，自称“始皇帝”。
description.en: After unifying China, Qin Shi Huang created the title of 'Emperor' and called himself the 'First Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 秦始皇认为自己“德兼三皇”，因此将“皇”字纳入新的君主称号中。
description.en: Qin Shi Huang believed his virtues encompassed those of the 'Three Sovereigns' (San Huang), and thus incorporated the character 'Huang' into the new monarchical title.

description.zh-cn: 近代汉语中，“皇帝”一词被用来对译欧洲语言中源自罗马皇帝称号的词语，如“Emperor”。
description.en: In modern Chinese, the word '皇帝' is used to translate terms in European languages derived from the titles of Roman emperors, such as 'Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 1453年，奥斯曼帝国攻陷君士坦丁堡，灭亡了拜占庭帝国。
description.en: In 1453, the Ottoman Empire conquered Constantinople, bringing an end to the Byzantine Empire.

description.zh-cn: 大政奉还事件标志着幕府统治的结束，使天皇重新掌握国家实际权力，势力得以复兴。
description.en: The Restoration of Imperial Rule marked the end of the shogunate's rule, allowing the Emperor to regain actual state power and reviving imperial authority.

description.zh-cn: 溥仪是中国最后一位皇帝，他的退位结束了中国的帝制。
description.en: Puyi was the last emperor of China, and his abdication ended the Chinese imperial system.

description.zh-cn: 查理曼是首位获得“罗马人的皇帝”称号的西欧君主，被视为神圣罗马皇帝的前身。
description.en: Charlemagne was the first Western European monarch to receive the title 'Emperor of the Romans' and is considered a predecessor to the Holy Roman Emperors.

description.zh-cn: 维多利亚女王是第一位获得“印度女皇”头衔的英国君主。
description.en: Queen Victoria was the first British monarch to hold the title 'Empress of India'.

description.zh-cn: 印度于1947年独立后，英国君主的“印度皇帝”头衔于1948年被正式废除。
description.en: After India gained independence in 1947, the British monarch's title 'Emperor of India' was formally abolished in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 伊琳娜篡夺了其子君士坦丁六世的皇位，并将其废黜。
description.en: Irene usurped the throne from her son Constantine VI and deposed him.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替王荣 (1958年)担任中国人民政治协商会议广东省委员会主席。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Wang Rong (born 1958) as Chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 在林克庆担任广州市委书记期间，郭永航任副书记兼市长。
description.en: While Lin Keqing served as Secretary of the CPC Guangzhou Municipal Committee, Guo Yonghang was the Deputy Secretary and Mayor.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替张硕辅担任中国共产党广州市委员会书记。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Zhang Shuofu as Secretary of the CPC Guangzhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 郭永航接替林克庆担任中国共产党广州市委员会书记。
description.en: Guo Yonghang succeeded Lin Keqing as Secretary of the CPC Guangzhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆担任广东省常务副省长期间，省长为马兴瑞。
description.en: While Lin Keqing served as Executive Vice Governor of Guangdong, the governor was Ma Xingrui.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替林少春担任广东省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Lin Shaochun as Executive Vice Governor of Guangdong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆担任北京市常务副市长期间，市长为陈吉宁。
description.en: While Lin Keqing served as Executive Vice Mayor of Beijing, the mayor was Chen Jining.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替张工 (1961年)担任北京市人民政府常务副市长。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Zhang Gong (born 1961) as Executive Vice Mayor of Beijing Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 崔述强接替林克庆担任北京市人民政府常务副市长。
description.en: Cui Shuqiang succeeded Lin Keqing as Executive Vice Mayor of Beijing Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆担任北京市委教育工委书记期间，时任北京市委书记为郭金龙。
description.en: While Lin Keqing served as Secretary of the Education Work Committee, the Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee was Guo Jinlong.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆担任北京市委教育工委书记期间，时任北京市委书记为蔡奇。
description.en: While Lin Keqing served as Secretary of the Education Work Committee, the Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee was Cai Qi.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替苟仲文担任中国共产党北京市委员会教育工作委员会书记。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Gou Zhongwen as Secretary of the Education Work Committee of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王宁 (1960年)接替林克庆担任中国共产党北京市委员会教育工作委员会书记。
description.en: Wang Ning (born 1960) succeeded Lin Keqing as Secretary of the Education Work Committee of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替沈宝昌 (1952年)担任中国共产党北京市大兴区委员会书记。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Shen Baochang (born 1952) as Secretary of the CPC Beijing Daxing District Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李长友接替林克庆担任中国共产党北京市大兴区委员会书记。
description.en: Li Changyou succeeded Lin Keqing as Secretary of the CPC Beijing Daxing District Committee.

description.zh-cn: 林克庆接替王惠民 (1955年)担任北京市大兴区人民政府区长。
description.en: Lin Keqing succeeded Wang Huimin (born 1955) as Mayor of the Daxing District People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷与朱梅馥于1932年结婚，直至1966年9月3日共同自杀身亡。
description.en: Fu Lei and Zhu Meifu were married in 1932 and remained so until their joint suicide on September 3, 1966.

description.zh-cn: 傅聪是傅雷的长子。
description.en: Fu Cong is the elder son of Fu Lei.

description.zh-cn: 傅聪是朱梅馥的长子。
description.en: Fu Cong is the elder son of Zhu Meifu.

description.zh-cn: 傅敏是傅雷的次子。
description.en: Fu Min is the younger son of Fu Lei.

description.zh-cn: 傅敏是朱梅馥的次子。
description.en: Fu Min is the younger son of Zhu Meifu.

description.zh-cn: 傅聪与傅敏是兄弟关系。
description.en: Fu Cong and Fu Min are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命初期，傅雷遭受红卫兵的残酷迫害和凌辱，最终导致他与妻子一同自杀。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, Fu Lei was subjected to brutal persecution and humiliation by the Red Guards, which ultimately led him and his wife to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命初期，朱梅馥与丈夫傅雷一同遭受红卫兵的残酷迫害和凌辱，最终共同自杀。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, Zhu Meifu, along with her husband Fu Lei, was subjected to brutal persecution and humiliation by the Red Guards, which ultimately led them to commit suicide together.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵对傅雷进行了连续四天三夜的抄家和批斗，包括罚跪、戴高帽等凌辱，并搜出所谓“反党罪证”，是导致其自杀的直接原因。
description.en: The Red Guards ransacked Fu Lei's home and subjected him to struggle sessions for four days and three nights, including humiliations like forced kneeling and wearing a dunce cap. They found so-called 'anti-Party evidence,' which were the direct cause of his suicide.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷在1958年的“反右补课”中被划为“右派分子”，遭受政治迫害。
description.en: Fu Lei was labeled a 'Rightist' during the 1958 'make-up' session of the Anti-Rightist Campaign and was politically persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷在1958年被划为右派，直到1961年9月才被“摘帽”。
description.en: Fu Lei was designated a Rightist in 1958 and the label was not removed until September 1961.

description.zh-cn: 时任上海最高领导的柯庆施推翻了下级“可划可不划”的意见，拍板将傅雷定为“右派”。
description.en: Ke Qingshi, then the top leader in Shanghai, overruled his subordinates' opinion that Fu Lei was a borderline case and made the final decision to label him a 'Rightist'.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷于1928年至1931年在巴黎大学留学，学习艺术理论。
description.en: Fu Lei studied art theory at the University of Paris from 1928 to 1931.

description.zh-cn: 傅敏整理并促成了《傅雷家书》的出版。
description.en: Fu Min compiled and facilitated the publication of 'Fu Lei's Family Letters'.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷在巴黎留学期间开始受罗曼·罗兰影响，热爱音乐，并翻译其作品。
description.en: During his studies in Paris starting in 1928, Fu Lei was influenced by Romain Rolland, developed a love for music, and translated his works.

description.zh-cn: 傅雷翻译了罗曼·罗兰的名著《约翰·克里斯朵夫》，该译本影响深远。
description.en: Fu Lei translated Romain Rolland's masterpiece 'Jean-Christophe', and his translation has been highly influential.

position.zh-cn: 校办公室主任、美术史及法文教师
position.en: Office Director, Art History and French Language Teacher

description.zh-cn: 1931年回国后，傅雷在上海美术专科学校任教。
description.en: After returning to China in 1931, Fu Lei taught at the Shanghai Art School.

description.zh-cn: 法国驻华大使馆于2009年设立了“傅雷翻译出版奖”。
description.en: The French Embassy in China established the 'Fu Lei Translation and Publishing Award' in 2009.

description.zh-cn: “傅雷翻译出版奖”为纪念傅雷而设立并以其名字命名。
description.en: The 'Fu Lei Translation and Publishing Award' was established in memory of Fu Lei and is named after him.

description.zh-cn: 就读于外国语言文学系。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Foreign Languages and Literatures.

description.zh-cn: 因高饶事件被诬陷为“五虎大将”之一，并被降职。
description.en: Was framed as one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' in the Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Affair and was demoted.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间受到迫害。
description.en: Was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在“高饶事件”中被一同诬陷为“五虎大将”之一。
description.en: Was framed together with Zhao Dezun as one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' in the 'Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 在“高饶事件”中被一同诬陷为“五虎大将”之一。
description.en: Was framed together with Zhao Dezun as one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' in the 'Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 在“高饶事件”中被一同诬陷为“五虎大将”之一。
description.en: Was framed together with Zhao Dezun as one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' in the 'Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 在“高饶事件”中被一同诬陷为“五虎大将”之一。
description.en: Was framed together with Zhao Dezun as one of the 'Five Tiger Generals' in the 'Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 十月革命推翻了以克伦斯基为领导的俄国临时政府。
description.en: The October Revolution overthrew the Russian Provisional Government led by Kerensky.

description.zh-cn: 十月革命后，反对布尔什维克的势力组成白军与苏维埃政权对抗，俄国内战随即爆发。
description.en: After the October Revolution, anti-Bolshevik forces formed the White Army to fight against the Soviet regime, and the Russian Civil War broke out.

description.zh-cn: 布尔什维克是十月革命的主要领导和推动力量。
description.en: The Bolsheviks were the main leading and driving force of the October Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 二月革命推翻了沙皇专制，随后建立了俄国临时政府。
description.en: The February Revolution overthrew the Tsarist autocracy and subsequently established the Russian Provisional Government.

description.zh-cn: 二月革命导致了沙皇尼古拉二世退位，罗曼诺夫王朝实质灭亡。
description.en: The February Revolution led to the abdication of Tsar Nicholas II, effectively ending the Romanov dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 彼得格勒军事革命委员会是十月革命武装起义的直接组织和指挥机构。
description.en: The Petrograd Military Revolutionary Committee was the direct organizing and command body of the October Revolution armed uprising.

description.zh-cn: 彼得格勒军事革命委员会由彼得格勒苏维埃建立，并受其领导。
description.en: The Petrograd Military Revolutionary Committee was established by and subordinate to the Petrograd Soviet.

description.zh-cn: 科尔尼洛夫事件失败后，布尔什维克党在苏维埃的支持度显著提高，壮大了其势力。
description.en: After the failure of the Kornilov affair, the Bolshevik Party's support in the Soviets increased significantly, strengthening its power.

description.zh-cn: 拉夫尔·科尔尼洛夫将军发动了旨在推翻临时政府的军事政变，即科尔尼洛夫事件。
description.en: General Lavr Kornilov launched a military coup aimed at overthrowing the Provisional Government, known as the Kornilov affair.

description.zh-cn: 布尔什维克政府在立宪会议召开一天后，以其拒绝通过苏维埃法令为由，强行解散了立宪会议。
description.en: One day after the Constituent Assembly convened, the Bolshevik government forcibly dissolved it on the grounds that it refused to pass Soviet decrees.

description.zh-cn: 一月剧变即布尔什维克强行解散立宪会议的事件。
description.en: The January Turmoil was the event of the forcible dissolution of the Constituent Assembly by the Bolsheviks.

description.zh-cn: 全俄肃清反革命及怠工非常委员会（契卡）秘密处决了尼古拉二世及其家人。
description.en: The All-Russian Extraordinary Commission for Combating Counter-Revolution and Sabotage (Cheka) secretly executed Nicholas II and his family.

description.zh-cn: 苏维埃政府于1918年1月15日颁布法令，建立了红军。
description.en: The Soviet government issued a decree on January 15, 1918, establishing the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 在俄国内战期间，白军与红军是主要的敌对交战方。
description.en: During the Russian Civil War, the White Army and the Red Army were the main opposing belligerents.

description.zh-cn: 取得内战胜利后，布尔什维克领导的苏维埃俄国与其他苏维埃共和国联合建立了苏联。
description.en: After winning the civil war, the Bolshevik-led Soviet Russia, along with other Soviet republics, established the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 十月革命的胜利和马克思主义的传播对中国共产党的建立产生了深远影响。毛泽东曾评价：'十月革命一声炮响，为我们送来马克思主义'。
description.en: The victory of the October Revolution and the spread of Marxism had a profound impact on the establishment of the Chinese Communist Party. Mao Zedong once commented: 'The salvoes of the October Revolution brought us Marxism-Leninism.'

description.zh-cn: 高尔基撰文《1月9日与1月5日》，谴责布尔什维克强行解散立宪会议的行为。
description.en: Gorky wrote the article 'January 9th and January 5th', condemning the Bolsheviks' forcible dissolution of the Constituent Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 阿芙乐尔号巡洋舰于1917年11月7日晚9时45分向冬宫发射空炮，作为布尔什维克开始总攻的信号。
description.en: The cruiser Aurora fired a blank shot at the Winter Palace at 9:45 PM on November 7, 1917, serving as the signal for the Bolsheviks to begin their final assault.

position.en: Member of the Party Leadership Group, Head of the Discipline Inspection Group

description.zh-cn: 陈乃华曾担任国家语委党组成员、纪检组长。
description.en: Chen Naihua served as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Head of the Discipline Inspection Group of the State Language Commission.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本和分类，陈乃华是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the text and categories, Chen Naihua is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 森森于1951年6月23日出生于香港。
description.en: Sum Sum was born in Hong Kong on June 23, 1951.

description.zh-cn: 森森与李振辉于1977年12月结婚，1983年离婚。
description.en: Sum Sum and Robert Lee were married in December 1977 and divorced in 1983.

description.zh-cn: 李嘉豪是森森与前夫李振辉于1980年在香港所生的儿子。
description.en: Li Jiahao is the son of Sum Sum and her ex-husband Robert Lee, born in Hong Kong in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 李嘉豪是李振辉与前妻森森于1980年在香港所生的儿子。
description.en: Li Jiahao is the son of Robert Lee and his ex-wife Sum Sum, born in Hong Kong in 1980.

description.zh-cn: 森森是斑斑的胞姐。
description.en: Sum Sum is Ban Ban's older sister.

description.zh-cn: 森森毕业于救恩学校小学部。
description.en: Sum Sum graduated from the primary school section of Kau Yan School.

description.zh-cn: 森森是新法书院的校友。
description.en: Sum Sum is an alumna of New Method College.

description.zh-cn: 森森于1966年至1970年间为丽的映声的合约艺人。
description.en: Sum Sum was a contract artist for Rediffusion Television from 1966 to 1970.

description.zh-cn: 森森于1970年至1983年间为无线电视的合约艺人。
description.en: Sum Sum was a contract artist for TVB from 1970 to 1983.

description.zh-cn: 1967年秋，蔡和平赏识赢得“香港歌后”荣衔的森森，并邀请她加入无线电视《欢乐今宵》节目，推动了她的演艺事业发展。
description.en: In the autumn of 1967, Robert Chua appreciated Sum Sum after she won the 'Hong Kong Song Queen' title and invited her to join TVB's 'Enjoy Yourself Tonight', which boosted her career in the entertainment industry.

description.zh-cn: 1972年，森森曾得到李小龙的截拳道指点，构成了一种非正式的师徒关系。
description.en: In 1972, Sum Sum received instruction in Jeet Kune Do from Bruce Lee, forming an informal student-teacher relationship.

description.zh-cn: 森森曾与罗石青有过一段情，罗于1992年7月26日因病自杀。
description.en: Sum Sum had a past relationship with Lo Sek-ching, who committed suicide due to illness on July 26, 1992.

description.zh-cn: 斑斑曾与罗石青有过一段情，罗于1992年7月26日因病自杀。
description.en: Ban Ban had a past relationship with Lo Sek-ching, who committed suicide due to illness on July 26, 1992.

description.zh-cn: 李司棋是森森的好友，并撮合了她与王宗德的婚姻。
description.en: Louise Lee is a good friend of Sum Sum and acted as a matchmaker for her marriage to Wang Zongde.

description.zh-cn: 1949年加入中国共产党，后被开除党籍。
description.en: Joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1949 and was later expelled.

description.zh-cn: 1986年出狱后在上海图书馆收藏部当图书管理员，至1990年代初退休。
description.en: After his release from prison in 1986, he worked as a librarian in the collection department of the Shanghai Library until his retirement in the early 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年的整风运动中，戚本禹等人因向上级反映问题，被借反右运动之机批判为“反党”。
description.en: During the 1958 rectification movement, Qi Benyu and others were criticized as 'anti-Party' under the pretext of the Anti-Rightist Campaign for reporting issues to their superiors.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中解救了被批判的戚本禹，并对其后来发表的史学文章大加赞赏，称其为“要接班”的“坚定的人”。
description.en: Rescued the criticized Qi Benyu during the Anti-Rightist Campaign and highly praised his later historical articles, calling him a 'steadfast person' who should 'take over'.

description.zh-cn: 戚本禹发表《为革命而研究历史》一文，批评翦伯赞的历史主义观点是“超阶级”、“纯客观”的资产阶级观点。
description.en: Qi Benyu published 'Studying History for the Revolution', criticizing Jian Bozan's historicist views as 'supra-class' and 'purely objective' bourgeois viewpoints.

description.zh-cn: 戚本禹是《五一六通知》的起草人之一。
description.en: Qi Benyu was one of the drafters of the 'May 16 Notification'.

description.zh-cn: 戚本禹发表文章《爱国主义还是卖国主义？——评历史影片〈清宫秘史〉》，开启了对时任国家主席刘少奇的公开不点名批判。
description.en: Qi Benyu published 'Patriotism or National Betrayal? — A Critique of the Historical Film The Secret History of the Qing Court', which initiated public, unnamed criticism of then-State Chairman Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 遇罗克是《出身论》的作者。
description.en: Yu Luoke is the author of 'On Family Background'.

description.zh-cn: 戚本禹宣布遇罗克所写的《出身论》是“大毒草”，导致遇罗克进一步受到政治迫害。
description.en: Qi Benyu declared 'On Family Background' written by Yu Luoke to be a 'great poisonous weed', leading to further political persecution of Yu Luoke.

description.zh-cn: 七·二〇事件后，周恩来向毛泽东进言解决王力、关锋、戚本禹的问题，最终导致戚本禹于1968年1月被隔离审查。
description.en: After the Wuhan Incident, Zhou Enlai advised Mao Zedong to address the issue of Wang Li, Guan Feng, and Qi Benyu, which ultimately led to Qi Benyu being placed in isolation for investigation in January 1968.

description.zh-cn: 七·二〇事件后，周恩来向毛泽东进言解决王力、关锋、戚本禹的问题，最终导致关锋被隔离审查。
description.en: After the Wuhan Incident, Zhou Enlai advised Mao Zedong to address the issue of Wang Li, Guan Feng, and Qi Benyu, which ultimately led to Guan Feng being placed in isolation for investigation.

description.zh-cn: 以反革命宣传煽动罪、诬告陷害罪、聚众打砸抢罪判处戚本禹有期徒刑18年。
description.en: Sentenced Qi Benyu to 18 years in prison for counter-revolutionary propaganda and incitement, false accusation, and organizing violent mass destruction.

description.zh-cn: 李志绥是《毛泽东私人医生回忆录》的作者。
description.en: Li Zhisui is the author of 'The Private Life of Chairman Mao'.

description.zh-cn: 1996年，戚本禹在接受访谈时批判了李志绥的《毛泽东私人医生回忆录》。
description.en: In 1996, Qi Benyu criticized Li Zhisui's 'The Private Life of Chairman Mao' in an interview.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，戚本禹在接受采访时表达了对中共中央总书记习近平的支持。
description.en: In 2014, Qi Benyu expressed his support for CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping in an interview.

description.zh-cn: 戚本禹因胃癌于2016年4月20日在上海去世。
description.en: Qi Benyu died of stomach cancer in Shanghai on April 20, 2016.

description.zh-cn: 该出版社在戚本禹去世当月出版了其回忆录。
description.en: This publishing house published Qi Benyu's memoir in the same month of his death.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国中央人民政府成立后，设立了中央人民政府外交部。
description.en: After the establishment of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Central People's Government was created.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月，第一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过了《中华人民共和国国务院组织法》，促使中央人民政府外交部改组为中华人民共和国外交部。
description.en: In September 1954, the first session of the 1st National People's Congress passed the 'Organic Law of the State Council of the PRC', which led to the reorganization of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Central People's Government into the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the PRC.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中国亚洲经济发展协会

description.zh-cn: 根据国家改革意见，原由外交部主管的中国亚洲经济发展协会与外交部分离，不再设置业务主管单位。
description.en: According to national reform guidelines, the China-Asia Economic Development Association, formerly supervised by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was decoupled from the ministry, and its business supervisory unit was eliminated.

description.zh-cn: 张向善出生于山东鄄城。
description.en: Zhang Xiangshan was born in Juancheng, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 张向善是中华人民共和国的一位军事人物。
description.en: Zhang Xiangshan was a military figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张向善是中国人民解放军的少将。
description.en: Zhang Xiangshan was a Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 张向善曾任中华人民共和国化学工业部政治部主任。
description.en: Zhang Xiangshan once served as the Director of the Political Department of the Ministry of Chemical Industry of the People's Republic of China.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中国科学院行政管理局

description.zh-cn: 张向善曾任中国科学院行政管理局党委书记、局长。
description.en: Zhang Xiangshan once served as the Party Secretary and Director of the Administrative Bureau of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，张向善是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia page categories, Zhang Xiangshan was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 担任中国人民武装警察部队浙江省总队政治委员。
description.en: Serves as the Political Commissar of the People's Armed Police Zhejiang Provincial Corps.

description.zh-cn: 自1983年2月起隶属于武警总部。2017年改革后，改为直接受武警总部领导。
description.en: Subordinate to the PAP Headquarters since February 1983. After the 2017 reform, it was placed under the direct leadership of the PAP Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 1983年至2017年间，武警浙江省总队同时隶属于浙江省公安厅建制。
description.en: Between 1983 and 2017, the PAP Zhejiang Provincial Corps was also subordinate to the Zhejiang Provincial Department of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年改革前，武警浙江省总队接受武警总部和浙江省人民政府的双重领导。
description.en: Before the 2017 reform, the PAP Zhejiang Provincial Corps was under the dual leadership of the PAP Headquarters and the Zhejiang Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 2018年1月31日，赵乐秦当选为广西壮族自治区人大常委会副主任，直至2023年1月18日卸任。
description.en: On January 31, 2018, Zhao Leqin was elected as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, a position he held until January 18, 2023.

position.en: Party Group Member, Assistant to the General Manager

description.zh-cn: 挂职锻炼。
description.en: Temporary position for training.

description.zh-cn: 在公路工程系公路工程专业学习。
description.en: Studied in the Highway Engineering program of the Department of Highway Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 于1984年12月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in December 1984.

description.zh-cn: 赵乐秦出生于青海省西宁市。
description.en: Zhao Leqin was born in Xining, Qinghai Province.

description.zh-cn: 赵乐秦是赵喜民的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Leqin is the son of Zhao Ximin.

description.zh-cn: 赵乐秦是赵乐际的弟弟，两人并称为“陕西二赵”。
description.en: Zhao Leqin is the younger brother of Zhao Leji. They are known as the 'Two Zhaos of Shaanxi'.

description.zh-cn: 赵乐际是赵喜民的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Leji is the son of Zhao Ximin.

description.zh-cn: 赵喜民早年曾留学苏联。
description.en: Zhao Ximin studied in the Soviet Union in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 中共第十八届中央政治局委员、中央组织部部长。
description.en: Member of the 18th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and Head of the Organization Department.

description.zh-cn: 中共第十九届中央纪委书记。
description.en: Secretary of the 19th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 赵乐秦担任中共桂林市委书记期间，周家斌是其副手。
description.en: While Zhao Leqin served as Secretary of the CPC Guilin Municipal Committee, Zhou Jiabin was his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：赵乐秦接替刘君担任中国共产党桂林市委员会书记。
description.en: Succession of office: Zhao Leqin succeeded Liu Jun as the Secretary of the Guilin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：周家斌接替赵乐秦担任中国共产党桂林市委员会书记。
description.en: Succession of office: Zhou Jiabin succeeded Zhao Leqin as the Secretary of the Guilin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：赵乐秦接替崔智友担任中国共产党崇左市委员会书记。
description.en: Succession of office: Zhao Leqin succeeded Cui Zhiyou as the Secretary of the Chongzuo Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：黄克接替赵乐秦担任中国共产党崇左市委员会书记。
description.en: Succession of office: Huang Ke succeeded Zhao Leqin as the Secretary of the Chongzuo Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：赵乐秦接替李达球担任中国共产党贺州市委员会书记。
description.en: Succession of office: Zhao Leqin succeeded Li Daqiu as the Secretary of the Hezhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：彭晓春接替赵乐秦担任中国共产党贺州市委员会书记。
description.en: Succession of office: Peng Xiaochun succeeded Zhao Leqin as the Secretary of the Hezhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：胡润泽接替赵乐秦担任汉中市人民政府市长。
description.en: Succession of office: Hu Runze succeeded Zhao Leqin as the Mayor of Hanzhong Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 谕令李鸿章创设北洋水师。
description.en: Ordered Li Hongzhang to establish the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 丁汝昌是北洋水师的最高指挥官。
description.en: Ding Ruchang was the commander-in-chief of the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 翁同龢是李鸿章的政敌。
description.en: Weng Tonghe was a political rival of Li Hongzhang.

description.zh-cn: 在甲午战争中，日本海军重创并最终击败了北洋水师。
description.en: During the First Sino-Japanese War, the Imperial Japanese Navy severely damaged and ultimately defeated the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 邓世昌在黄海海战中壮烈殉国。
description.en: Deng Shichang died heroically in the Battle of the Yalu River.

description.zh-cn: 林永升在黄海海战中阵亡。
description.en: Lin Yongsheng was killed in action during the Battle of the Yalu River.

description.zh-cn: 丁汝昌在威海卫之战兵败后自尽。
description.en: Ding Ruchang committed suicide after the defeat in the Battle of Weihaiwei.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争失败后，光绪帝下旨撤销北洋海军的编制。
description.en: After the defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War, the Guangxu Emperor issued an edict to abolish the Beiyang Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 臧坤是山东五莲人。
description.en: Zang Kun was a native of Wulian, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 臧坤于1986年6月至1993年7月期间担任山东省人民检察院检察长。
description.en: Zang Kun served as the Procurator-General of the Shandong Provincial People's Procuratorate from June 1986 to July 1993.

description.zh-cn: 臧坤是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zang Kun was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 臧坤接替李秉政出任青岛市人民政府市长。
description.en: Zang Kun succeeded Li Bingzheng as the Mayor of Qingdao Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 郭松年接替臧坤出任青岛市人民政府市长。
description.en: Guo Songnian succeeded Zang Kun as the Mayor of Qingdao Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 孙立人于1914年考取清华学校庚子赔款留美预科，1923年毕业。
description.en: Sun Li-jen was admitted to the Tsinghua School's Gengzi Indemnity Scholarship Program in 1914 and graduated in 1923.

degree.en: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering

description.zh-cn: 孙立人于1925年获得普渡大学土木工程学学士学位。
description.en: Sun Li-jen received a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Purdue University in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 孙立人于1927年获得弗吉尼亚军事学院文学士学位。
description.en: Sun Li-jen received a Bachelor of Arts from the Virginia Military Institute in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 时任财政部长宋子文赏识孙立人，孙的军旅生涯即始于宋所创建的财政部税警总团。
description.en: Then-Minister of Finance T. V. Soong appreciated Sun Li-jen, and Sun's military career began in the Salt Revenue Police force founded by Soong.

description.zh-cn: 孙立人指挥其新编第三十八师以一个团的兵力，击退数倍日军，成功解救了被围困的英军。
description.en: Sun Li-jen commanded his New 38th Division, with the force of one regiment, to repel a numerically superior Japanese force and successfully rescued the besieged British troops.

description.zh-cn: 此战的胜利为孙立人赢得了崇高的国际声誉，被誉为“东方隆美尔”，并获英美两国授勋。
description.en: The victory in this battle earned Sun Li-jen high international prestige, the nickname 'Rommel of the East,' and decorations from both the United Kingdom and the United States.

description.zh-cn: 在仁安羌之战中，孙立人率部解救了超过7000名被日军围困的英军士兵。
description.en: In the Battle of Yenangyaung, Sun Li-jen led his troops to rescue over 7,000 British soldiers besieged by the Japanese army.

description.zh-cn: 在缅甸战役撤退路线和东北作战指挥上，孙立人与杜聿明均有严重分歧，将帅不和，关系交恶。
description.en: Sun Li-jen and Du Yuming had serious disagreements on the retreat route during the Burma Campaign and on command in the Northeast China, leading to a hostile relationship between the two generals.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次四平战役中，孙立人指挥新一军仅用三天就攻克四平，击败了林彪所率领的东北民主联军。
description.en: In the Second Battle of Siping, Sun Li-jen commanded the New First Army to capture Siping in just three days, defeating the Northeast Democratic United Army led by Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 马歇尔奉命调停国共冲突，其促成的停战令阻止了孙立人率部继续向哈尔滨追击林彪部队。
description.en: George Marshall's mediation of the KMT-CCP conflict resulted in a ceasefire order that stopped Sun Li-jen's troops from pursuing Lin Biao's forces towards Harbin.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正指控孙立人及其部属涉嫌兵变，并成立九人委员会进行调查，最终导致孙立人被革职软禁。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek accused Sun Li-jen and his subordinates of plotting a mutiny, established a nine-member committee to investigate, and ultimately caused Sun to be dismissed and placed under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国认为孙立人威胁其父权力，向蒋中正构陷孙，主张拔除其兵权，是导致孙立人被整肃的关键人物。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo believed Sun Li-jen threatened his father's power and framed Sun to Chiang Kai-shek, advocating for the removal of his military authority, making him a key figure in Sun's purge.

description.zh-cn: 麦克阿瑟曾邀请孙立人至东京会谈，并表示美国将全力支持他承担防卫台湾的责任。
description.en: Douglas MacArthur invited Sun Li-jen to Tokyo for talks and stated that the United States would fully support him in taking responsibility for the defense of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 美国军方高度评价孙立人，并曾考虑支持他取代蒋中正，这层关系也加深了蒋对孙的猜忌，间接导致其政治生涯的终结。
description.en: The U.S. military held Sun Li-jen in high regard and once considered supporting him to replace Chiang Kai-shek. This relationship deepened Chiang's suspicion of Sun, indirectly leading to the end of his political career.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国逝世后，时任国防部长郑为元亲自下令，解除了对孙立人长达33年的软禁。
description.en: After the death of Chiang Ching-kuo, then-Minister of National Defense Cheng Wei-yuan personally ordered the lifting of Sun Li-jen's 33-year-long house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 在孙立人逝世后，时任总统李登辉颁发总统褒扬令，以表彰其一生的功勋。
description.en: After Sun Li-jen's death, then-President Lee Teng-hui issued a presidential citation to honor his lifetime achievements.

description.zh-cn: 郭廷亮是孙立人的旧部属及联络官，其被指控为匪谍是孙立人兵变案的导火索。
description.en: Guo Tingliang was a former subordinate and liaison officer of Sun Li-jen. His accusation as a Communist spy was the trigger for the Sun Li-jen incident.

description.zh-cn: 根据中国政府网2022年7月8日发布的国务院任免国家工作人员通知，刘思扬被免去新华通讯社副社长职务。
description.en: According to the State Council's notice on appointments and removals of state staff issued on the official website of the Chinese government on July 8, 2022, Liu Siyang was removed from the position of Vice President of Xinhua News Agency.

description.zh-cn: 朱见潾称钱太后对他有“抚育深恩”。
description.en: Zhu Jianlin claimed that Empress Dowager Qian had shown him 'deep nurturing grace'.

description.zh-cn: 在土木堡之变中俘虏了明英宗。
description.en: Captured Emperor Yingzong in the Tumu Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 据理力争，确保了钱氏与周氏同尊为皇太后，并在钱太后逝后坚持其必须依英宗遗诏合葬裕陵。
description.en: Argued on the basis of principle to ensure both Lady Qian and Lady Zhou were honored as Empress Dowagers, and after Empress Dowager Qian's death, insisted that she must be buried with Emperor Yingzong in the Yuling Mausoleum according to his will.

description.zh-cn: 与李贤一同据理力争，确保了钱氏与周氏同尊为皇太后。
description.en: Together with Li Xian, argued on the basis of principle to ensure both Lady Qian and Lady Zhou were honored as Empress Dowagers.

description.zh-cn: 在英宗被幽禁南宫期间，时为景泰帝皇后的汪氏对钱皇后多有照拂。
description.en: During Emperor Yingzong's house arrest in the Southern Palace, Empress Wang, then the empress of the Jingtai Emperor, often looked after Empress Qian.

description.zh-cn: 与张太皇太后一同册立钱氏为皇后。
description.en: Together with Grand Empress Dowager Zhang, she selected Lady Qian to be the Empress.

description.zh-cn: 逝世后祔葬于裕陵。
description.en: Was buried in the Yuling Mausoleum after her death.

description.zh-cn: 纳云德是云南武定人。
description.en: Na Yunde is from Wuding, Yunnan.

position.en: Vice Governor, Member of the Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 纳云德于2023年1月当选为云南省人民政府副省长，直至2024年8月调离。
description.en: Na Yunde was elected Vice Governor of the People's Government of Yunnan Province in January 2023 and served until his transfer in August 2024.

description.zh-cn: 自2024年8月26日起，纳云德出任中共海南省委常委。
description.en: Since August 26, 2024, Na Yunde has served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 纳云德接替李四明出任怒江傈僳族自治州人民政府州长。
description.en: Na Yunde succeeded Li Siming as the Governor of the People's Government of Nujiang Lisu Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 李文辉接替纳云德出任怒江傈僳族自治州人民政府州长。
description.en: Li Wenhui succeeded Na Yunde as the Governor of the People's Government of Nujiang Lisu Autonomous Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 纳云德接替童志云出任中国共产党怒江傈僳族自治州委员会书记。
description.en: Na Yunde succeeded Tong Zhiyun as the Secretary of the Nujiang Lisu Autonomous Prefecture Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 纳云德接替冯忠华出任中国共产党海南省委员会组织部部长。
description.en: Na Yunde succeeded Feng Zhonghua as the Head of the Organization Department of the Hainan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，纳云德是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the categories on his Wikipedia page, Na Yunde is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 太傅、镇南·武安·宁国军节度使、枢密使
position.en: Grand Tutor, Military Commissioner of Zhennan, Wu'an, and Ningguo Armies, Commissioner of Military Affairs

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠是南宋的杰出将领，为保卫南宋政权立下赫赫战功。
description.en: Han Shizhong was an outstanding general of the Southern Song dynasty who made significant military contributions to defend the regime.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠是南宋主战派将领，其军事生涯主要致力于抵抗金朝的入侵。
description.en: Han Shizhong was a leading general of the pro-war faction in the Southern Song, and his military career was primarily dedicated to resisting the invasion of the Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 梁氏在韩世忠元配白氏死后成为其正妻。
description.en: Lady Liang became Han Shizhong's formal wife after the death of his first wife, Lady Bai.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠是宋高宗赵构麾下的重要将领。
description.en: Han Shizhong was a key general serving under Emperor Gaozong of Song (Zhao Gou).

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠参与平定苗刘兵变，使被逼退位的宋高宗得以复位。
description.en: Han Shizhong participated in quelling the Miao-Liu Mutiny, which enabled the restoration of Emperor Gaozong, who had been forced to abdicate.

description.zh-cn: 在秦桧图谋陷害韩世忠时，宋高宗因念其救驾之功而保全了他。
description.en: When Qin Hui plotted to frame Han Shizhong, Emperor Gaozong protected him, citing his merit in saving the emperor during the mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠加入勤王队伍，与张浚等人合力平定了苗刘兵变。
description.en: Han Shizhong joined the loyalist forces and, together with Zhang Jun and others, suppressed the Miao-Liu Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 平定苗刘兵变后，韩世忠因其“忠勇”而获得宋高宗的极大信任和丰厚赏赐，地位得到提升。
description.en: After suppressing the Miao-Liu Mutiny, Han Shizhong earned great trust and generous rewards from Emperor Gaozong for his 'loyalty and bravery', leading to an elevation of his status.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠作为勤王将领，与发动兵变的苗傅处于敌对阵营。
description.en: As a loyalist general, Han Shizhong was in the opposing camp to Miao Fu, who initiated the mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠在浦城击败兵变叛军，并擒获了其首领之一刘正彦。
description.en: Han Shizhong defeated the mutinous rebels at Pucheng and captured one of their leaders, Liu Zhengyan.

description.zh-cn: 在黄天荡之战中，韩世忠率八千人围困了完颜宗弼（金兀术）率领的十万金军长达四十八天。
description.en: During the Battle of Huangtiandang, Han Shizhong led 8,000 men to besiege the 100,000 Jin troops led by Wanyan Zongbi (Wuzhu) for 48 days.

description.zh-cn: 在黄天荡之战中，梁红玉亲自擂鼓助战，极大地鼓舞了宋军士气。
description.en: During the Battle of Huangtiandang, Liang Hongyu personally beat a war drum to rally the troops, greatly boosting the morale of the Song army.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠反对与金和议，与主和派的秦桧政见不合。在岳飞冤案发生后，韩世忠曾当面闯入秦桧府邸质问其“莫须有”三字何以服天下。
description.en: Han Shizhong opposed the peace treaty with the Jin, clashing politically with the pro-peace faction leader Qin Hui. After Yue Fei was unjustly executed, Han Shizhong confronted Qin Hui at his residence, questioning how the words 'perhaps there is' could justify the execution to the world.

description.zh-cn: 秦桧曾试图清洗抗金力量，其首要目标为韩世忠，他逮捕韩的部下逼其诬告韩世忠谋反，但因宋高宗的保全而未果。
description.en: Qin Hui attempted to purge anti-Jin forces, initially targeting Han Shizhong. He arrested Han's subordinate and tried to coerce him into falsely accusing Han of treason, but the plot failed due to Emperor Gaozong's protection.

description.zh-cn: 绍兴和议签订后，南宋朝廷开始解除主战派将领的兵权，韩世忠被罢免枢密使之职，被迫解甲归田。
description.en: After the signing of the Shaoxing Peace Accord, the Southern Song court began to strip military power from pro-war generals. Han Shizhong was dismissed from his post as Commissioner of Military Affairs and forced into retirement.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠在征讨方腊起义时，潜入其巢穴，擒获了起义领袖方腊。
description.en: During the campaign against the Fang La rebellion, Han Shizhong infiltrated the rebel's lair and captured its leader, Fang La.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠早年与西夏作战立功，但宣抚使童贯黜其功不录。
description.en: In his early years, Han Shizhong achieved merit in battle against the Western Xia, but Commissioner Tong Guan dismissed his achievements and did not record them.

description.zh-cn: 韩世忠至平江府与礼部侍郎张浚会面，二人相约共同平定苗刘兵变。
description.en: Han Shizhong went to Pingjiang Prefecture to meet Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Jun, and the two agreed to jointly suppress the Miao-Liu Mutiny.

description.zh-cn: 修正主义通过修改马克思主义的基础原理，被其反对者认为是对马克思主义的违背。
description.en: By modifying the fundamental principles of Marxism, revisionism is considered a betrayal of Marxism by its opponents.

description.zh-cn: 爱德华·伯恩施坦是早期修正主义的主要理论家和代表人物。
description.en: Eduard Bernstein was a leading theorist and representative figure of early revisionism.

description.zh-cn: 列宁是第二国际中反对修正主义的代表人物之一，领导了对修正主义的理论斗争。
description.en: Lenin was one of the key figures in the Second International who opposed revisionism and led the theoretical struggle against it.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫推行的去斯大林化政策是中国共产党批判苏联走上修正主义道路并与之交恶的主要原因之一。
description.en: The De-Stalinization policy promoted by Khrushchev was one of the main reasons for the Communist Party of China to criticize the Soviet Union for taking a revisionist path, leading to the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东领导下的中国共产党猛烈批判赫鲁晓夫及其修正主义政策，反对其对斯大林的批判，指责苏共搞“修正主义”，最终导致中苏交恶。
description.en: Under Mao Zedong's leadership, the Communist Party of China fiercely criticized Khrushchev and his revisionist policies, opposing his critique of Stalin and accusing the CPSU of 'revisionism,' which ultimately led to the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 随着中阿决裂，原先的盟友关系破裂，阿尔巴尼亚劳动党开始批判中国共产党和毛泽东思想为修正主义。
description.en: Following the Sino-Albanian split, the former alliance broke down, and the Party of Labour of Albania began to criticize the Communist Party of China and Mao Zedong Thought as revisionist.

description.zh-cn: 自1948年苏南交恶开始，斯大林领导下的苏共强烈批判铁托领导下的南斯拉夫为“现代修正主义”。
description.en: Beginning with the Soviet-Yugoslav split in 1948, the CPSU under Stalin's leadership strongly criticized Tito's Yugoslavia as 'modern revisionism'.

description.zh-cn: 1944年，美国共产党总书记厄尔·白劳德宣布解散美国共产党。
description.en: In 1944, Earl Browder, General Secretary of the Communist Party USA, announced the dissolution of the party.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·Z·福斯特激烈反对白劳德的举动，并领导重建了美国共产党，解除了白劳德的职务并于1946年将其开除出党。
description.en: William Z. Foster vehemently opposed Browder's actions, led the re-establishment of the Communist Party USA, removed Browder from his position, and expelled him from the party in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 1964年10月，勃列日涅夫伙同他人发动政变，将赫鲁晓夫赶下台并取而代之。
description.en: In October 1964, Brezhnev, along with others, staged a coup that ousted Khrushchev from power and replaced him.

description.zh-cn: 龚正接替应勇出任中共上海市委副书记，后任上海市市长。
description.en: Gong Zheng succeeded Ying Yong as Deputy Party Secretary of Shanghai and later as Mayor of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 龚正接替郭树清出任山东省省长。
description.en: Gong Zheng succeeded Guo Shuqing as Governor of Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 龚正卸任山东省省长后，由李干杰接任。
description.en: After Gong Zheng stepped down as Governor of Shandong, Li Ganjie took over the position.

description.zh-cn: 龚正接替黄坤明出任杭州市委书记。
description.en: Gong Zheng succeeded Huang Kunming as Party Secretary of Hangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 龚正卸任杭州市委书记后，由赵一德接任。
description.en: After Gong Zheng stepped down as Party Secretary of Hangzhou, Zhao Yide took over the position.

description.zh-cn: 龚正担任浙江省副省长期间，吕祖善为省长。
description.en: While Gong Zheng was Vice Governor of Zhejiang, Lü Zushan was the Governor.

description.zh-cn: 在职攻读财政学专业博士学位。
description.en: Pursued a doctorate in Finance as an on-the-job student.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于水文系水文地质及工程地质专业。
description.en: Graduated with a major in Hydrogeology and Engineering Geology from the Department of Hydrology.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于世界经济专业。
description.en: Graduated with a major in World Economy.

description.zh-cn: 王少雄接替柳斌杰担任中国共产党四川省委员会宣传部部长职务。
description.en: Wang Shaoxiong succeeded Liu Binjie as the Minister of the Propaganda Department of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王少雄在担任中国共产党四川省委员会宣传部部长后，由黄新初接任其职务。
description.en: After Wang Shaoxiong served as the Minister of the Propaganda Department of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, he was succeeded by Huang Xinchu.

description.zh-cn: 时任前南京兵部尚书的韩邦奇在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Han Bangqi, the former Minister of War in Nanjing, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 时任南京光禄寺卿的马理在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Ma Li, the Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments in Nanjing, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝郎中薛祖学在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Xue Zuxue, a Bureau Director of the Ming dynasty, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝员外贺承光在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: He Chengguang, a Bureau Vice Director of the Ming dynasty, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝主事王尚礼在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Wang Shangli, a Section Chief of the Ming dynasty, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝进士白大用在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Bai Dayong, a Jinshi degree holder of the Ming dynasty, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明朝御史杨九泽在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Yang Jiuze, an Investigating Censor of the Ming dynasty, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 时任南京国子监祭酒的王维桢在嘉靖大地震中遇难。
description.en: Wang Weizhen, the Chancellor of the National University in Nanjing, died in the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 地震导致渭河改道，向北移动了大约五公里。
description.en: The earthquake caused the Wei River to change its course, shifting it northward by about five kilometers.

description.zh-cn: 地震引发的滑坡堵塞了黄河，导致河水逆流，并出现了河水澄清三日的现象。
description.en: Landslides triggered by the earthquake blocked the Yellow River, causing it to flow backward and its water to become clear for three days.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省是嘉靖大地震的震中所在地及受灾最严重的地区。
description.en: Shaanxi Province was the location of the epicenter and the most severely affected area of the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 山西省是嘉靖大地震的受灾区之一。
description.en: Shanxi Province was one of the areas affected by the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 河南省是嘉靖大地震的受灾区之一。
description.en: Henan Province was one of the areas affected by the Jiajing Great Earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗朱厚熜是明朝的第十二位皇帝。
description.en: The Jiajing Emperor Zhu Houcong was the 12th emperor of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 地震因发生于其在位期间（嘉靖年号）而通常被称为“嘉靖大地震”。
description.en: The earthquake is commonly named the 'Jiajing Great Earthquake' because it occurred during his reign (the Jiajing era).

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖三十五年二月，明朝朝廷派遣时任户部左侍郎的邹守愚抵达灾区进行赈灾。
description.en: In the second month of the 35th year of Jiajing (1556), the Ming imperial court dispatched Zou Shouyu, then the Left Vice Minister of Revenue, to the disaster area to carry out relief efforts.

description.zh-cn: 在奉命赈灾时，邹守愚担任户部左侍郎。
description.en: When ordered to conduct disaster relief, Zou Shouyu served as the Left Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗的生母是唐肃宗的妾室吴氏（章敬皇后）。
description.en: Emperor Daizong's birth mother was Emperor Suzong's concubine, Lady Wu (Empress Zhangjing).

description.zh-cn: 唐德宗李适是唐代宗的长子。
description.en: Emperor Dezong (Li Shi) was the eldest son of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐德宗李适的生母是睿真皇后沈氏。
description.en: The birth mother of Emperor Dezong (Li Shi) was Empress Ruizhen (Lady Shen).

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗于开元十四年十月十三日（726年11月11日）生于东都洛阳上阳宫。
description.en: Emperor Daizong was born on November 11, 726, at Shangyang Palace in the eastern capital, Luoyang.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗去世后，由其长子太子李适继位，是为唐德宗。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Daizong, his eldest son, Crown Prince Li Shi, succeeded to the throne as Emperor Dezong.

description.zh-cn: 在安史之乱中，当时仍为广平王的李俶以兵马元帅名义收复了洛阳、长安两京。
description.en: During the An Lushan Rebellion, Li Chu, then Prince of Guangping, served as marshal and recovered the two capitals, Luoyang and Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃侵扰唐朝，并于广德元年（763年）占领首都长安十五日。
description.en: The Tibetan Empire harassed the Tang Dynasty and occupied its capital, Chang'an, for fifteen days in 763.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃于广德元年（763年）占领首都长安十五日。
description.en: The Tibetan Empire occupied the capital, Chang'an, for fifteen days in 763.

description.zh-cn: 吐蕃在占领长安期间，拥立李承宏为皇帝。
description.en: During their occupation of Chang'an, the Tibetan Empire installed Li Chenghong as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在唐代宗统治时期，回鹘不断向唐朝进行勒索。
description.en: During the reign of Emperor Daizong, the Uyghur Khaganate constantly extorted the Tang court.

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗在位期间，唐朝面临着严重的藩镇割据问题。
description.en: During his reign, Emperor Daizong faced the serious problem of powerful and autonomous military governors (fanzhen).

description.zh-cn: 唐代宗笃信佛教，曾下令在五台山建造金阁寺，耗资巨大。
description.en: Emperor Daizong was a devout Buddhist and ordered the construction of the Golden Pavilion Temple on Mount Wutai at great expense.

description.zh-cn: 贞懿皇后独孤氏为唐代宗的贵妃，获得专宠。
description.en: Empress Zhenyi (Lady Dugu) was a Noble Consort of Emperor Daizong and was exclusively favored by him.

description.zh-cn: 睿真皇后沈氏在唐代宗为广平王时被赐予他为妾。
description.en: Empress Ruizhen (Lady Shen) was given to Emperor Daizong as a concubine when he was the Prince of Guangping.

description.zh-cn: 崔氏是唐代宗为广平郡王时的元配嫡妻。
description.en: Lady Cui was the primary consort of Emperor Daizong when he was the Prince of Guangping.

description.zh-cn: 崔贵妃是唐代宗的妃嫔。
description.en: Noble Consort Cui was a consort of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱期间，睿真皇后未能跟从出逃，落入安禄山之手，后于战乱中失踪。
description.en: During the An Lushan Rebellion, Empress Ruizhen was unable to escape, fell into the hands of An Lushan, and later disappeared amidst the chaos of war.

description.zh-cn: 李傀是唐代宗的儿子。
description.en: Li Kui was a son of Emperor Daizong.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗将自己的孙子、唐代宗的儿子李傀养为自己的儿子。
description.en: Emperor Suzong adopted his grandson, Li Kui (son of Emperor Daizong), as his own son.

description.zh-cn: 中国地质调查局由中华人民共和国自然资源部管理。
description.en: The China Geological Survey is managed by the Ministry of Natural Resources of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国地质调查局的业务上级是中华人民共和国国务院。
description.en: The business superior of the China Geological Survey is the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，在中华人民共和国国土资源部下实施地质勘查体制改革，组建了中国地质调查局。
description.en: In 1999, the reform of the geological exploration system was implemented under the Ministry of Land and Resources, and the China Geological Survey was established.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，在中华人民共和国地质矿产部的基础上组建了中华人民共和国国土资源部。
description.en: In 1998, the Ministry of Land and Resources of the People's Republic of China was formed on the basis of the Ministry of Geology and Mineral Resources.

description.zh-cn: 中国地质科学院是中国地质调查局的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences is a directly affiliated public institution of the China Geological Survey.

description.zh-cn: 广州海洋地质调查局是中国地质调查局的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Guangzhou Marine Geological Survey is a directly affiliated public institution of the China Geological Survey.

position.en: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 基尔·斯塔默作为英国首相，向作为国家元首的查尔斯三世国王负责。
description.en: As Prime Minister, Keir Starmer is formally subordinate to King Charles III, the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 任命基尔·斯塔默为皇家检控署的新负责人，出任刑事检控专员。
description.en: Appointed Keir Starmer as the new head of the Crown Prosecution Service, becoming Director of Public Prosecutions.

description.zh-cn: 16岁时加入工党青年社会主义者组织，成为工党成员。
description.en: Joined the Labour Party Young Socialists at age 16, becoming a member of the Labour Party.

description.zh-cn: 基尔·斯塔默领导工党在2024年英国大选中获胜，成为英国首相。
description.en: Keir Starmer led the Labour Party to victory in the 2024 general election, becoming Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 2024年英国大选结束了保守党连续14年的执政。
description.en: The 2024 general election ended 14 years of Conservative Party rule.

description.zh-cn: 在赖盖特文法学校是同学。
description.en: Were schoolmates at Reigate Grammar School.

description.zh-cn: 曾参与反伊拉克战争游行。
description.en: Participated in marches against the Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 因斯塔默反对废除《人权法》而建议解雇他。
description.en: Suggested Starmer should be dismissed for his opposition to repealing the Human Rights Act.

description.zh-cn: 作为刑事检控专员，决定快速起诉骚乱者以控制局势。
description.en: As Director of Public Prosecutions, decided on rapid prosecutions of rioters to control the situation.

description.zh-cn: 作为刑事检控专员，宣布以妨碍司法公正罪起诉克里斯·休恩。
description.en: As Director of Public Prosecutions, announced the prosecution of Chris Huhne for perverting the course of justice.

description.zh-cn: 该丑闻促使斯塔默作为刑事检控专员，宣布改进性虐待调查的处理方式。
description.en: The scandal prompted Starmer, as Director of Public Prosecutions, to announce improvements in the handling of sexual abuse investigations.

description.zh-cn: 在克罗地亚-塞尔维亚种族屠杀案中，作为律师团队的一员代表克罗地亚出庭。
description.en: As part of the legal team, represented Croatia in the Croatia–Serbia genocide case.

description.zh-cn: 在2015年工党党魁竞选中支持安迪·伯纳姆。
description.en: Supported Andy Burnham in the 2015 Labour Party leadership election.

description.zh-cn: 作为影子脱欧事务大臣，成功施压要求特蕾莎·梅政府公布其脱欧计划。
description.en: As Shadow Brexit Secretary, successfully pressured Theresa May's government to publish its Brexit plan.

description.zh-cn: 派对门丑闻促使斯塔默对约翰逊政府提出更多批评，并要求约翰逊辞职。
description.en: The Partygate scandal prompted Starmer to increase his criticism of the Johnson government and call for Johnson's resignation.

description.zh-cn: 在斯塔默当选首相后向他表示祝贺。
description.en: Congratulated Starmer on his election as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 就任首相后宣布取消卢旺达庇护计划。
description.en: Announced the cancellation of the Rwanda asylum plan upon becoming Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 作为内政大臣，着手建立边境安全司令部以打击人口走私。
description.en: As Home Secretary, initiated the establishment of the Border Security Command to combat people smuggling.

description.zh-cn: 绍斯波特持刀袭击事件引发了全国范围的骚乱。
description.en: The Southport stabbing incident triggered nationwide riots.

description.zh-cn: 孟庆丰在担任中华人民共和国公安部副部长期间担任猎狐行动小组组长。
description.en: Meng Qingfeng served as the leader of the Fox Hunt operation team while he was the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中正国防干部预备学校隶属于中华民国国防部。
description.en: The Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School is subordinate to the Ministry of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，时任行政院院长蒋经国指示将陆军、海军、空军三所预备学校合并为中正国防干部预备学校。
description.en: In 1975, then Premier Chiang Ching-kuo directed the merger of the Army, Navy, and Air Force preparatory schools into the Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School.

description.zh-cn: 中正国防干部预备学校以蒋中正的名字“中正”命名，其校歌也提及要实践其遗训。
description.en: The Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School is named after Chiang Kai-shek ('Chung Cheng'), and its school anthem mentions the need to practice his last testament.

description.zh-cn: 李喜明于2018年调查奶茶斗殴事件时担任参谋总长。
description.en: Lee Hsi-ming was the Chief of the General Staff in 2018 when he investigated the milk tea brawl incident.

description.zh-cn: 68年班／中一期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1979 / 1st Class

description.zh-cn: 68年班／中一期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1979 / 1st Class

description.zh-cn: 69年班／中二期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1980 / 2nd Class

description.zh-cn: 69年班／中二期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1980 / 2nd Class

description.zh-cn: 70年班／中三期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1981 / 3rd Class

description.zh-cn: 70年班／中三期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1981 / 3rd Class

description.zh-cn: 72年班／中五期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1983 / 5th Class

description.zh-cn: 72年班／中五期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1983 / 5th Class

description.zh-cn: 知名艺人校友
description.en: Famous artist alumnus

description.zh-cn: 74年班／中七期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1985 / 7th Class

description.zh-cn: 75年班／中八期校友
description.en: Alumnus of the Class of 1986 / 8th Class

description.zh-cn: 台北松山机场的民用部分“台北国际航空站”由交通部民用航空局管理。
description.en: The civilian part of Taipei Songshan Airport, 'Taipei International Airport', is managed by the Civil Aeronautics Administration.

description.zh-cn: 台北松山机场的军用部分“空军松山基地”隶属于中华民国空军。
description.en: The military part of Taipei Songshan Airport, 'Songshan Air Force Base', is subordinate to the Republic of China Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 台湾总督府于1936年设立了台北松山机场，当时称为“台北飞行场”。
description.en: The Governor-General of Taiwan established Taipei Songshan Airport in 1936, then known as 'Taihoku Airfield'.

description.zh-cn: 台湾桃园国际机场是中华民国政府在1970年代推动的十大建设之一。
description.en: Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport was one of the Ten Major Construction Projects promoted by the ROC government in the 1970s.

description.zh-cn: 1979年桃园国际机场启用后，松山机场的国际航线业务转移至桃园机场，其角色转为以服务国内航班为主。
description.en: After the opening of Taoyuan International Airport in 1979, Songshan Airport's international route services were transferred to Taoyuan, and its role shifted to primarily serving domestic flights.

description.zh-cn: 马英九政府上台后，将松山机场重新定位为首都商务机场，并重启国际与两岸航线。
description.en: After the Ma Ying-jeou administration came to power, it repositioned Songshan Airport as a capital business airport and reopened international and cross-strait routes.

description.zh-cn: 李应元在2002年参选台北市长时曾提出废除松山机场的政见。
description.en: In his 2002 campaign for Taipei Mayor, Lee Ying-yuan proposed the closure of Songshan Airport.

description.zh-cn: 姚文智在2014年参与台北市长初选时再次提出废除松山机场的政见，并在复兴航空空难后重申此主张。
description.en: Pasuya Yao reiterated his proposal to close Songshan Airport during his 2014 Taipei mayoral primary campaign, and re-emphasized this position after the TransAsia Airways crash.

description.zh-cn: 罗淑蕾在复兴航空235号班机空难后，指松山机场是世界上最危险的机场之一，应予以淘汰或迁移。
description.en: After the TransAsia Airways Flight 235 crash, Lo Shu-lei described Songshan Airport as one of the world's most dangerous airports and called for it to be decommissioned or relocated.

description.zh-cn: 台北市长柯文哲曾表示计划于2020年将松山机场废除。
description.en: Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je had expressed plans to close Songshan Airport by 2020.

description.zh-cn: 复兴航空235号班机空难发生后，姚文智再次强调松山机场非迁不可。
description.en: After the crash of TransAsia Airways Flight 235, Pasuya Yao reiterated his call that Songshan Airport must be relocated.

description.zh-cn: 此次空难严重打击了复兴航空的声誉和营运，是其最终于2016年停业的原因之一。
description.en: This air disaster severely damaged the reputation and operations of TransAsia Airways, contributing to its eventual shutdown in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 中华航空206号班机在进场台北松山机场的过程中发生空难。
description.en: China Airlines Flight 206 crashed during its approach to Taipei Songshan Airport.

description.zh-cn: 申不害在郑国被韩国所灭前，曾担任郑国的低阶官吏。
description.en: Before the State of Zheng was annexed by the State of Han, Shen Buhai served as a low-ranking official in Zheng.

description.zh-cn: 申不害出生于郑国京邑。
description.en: Shen Buhai was born in Jingyi, the capital of the State of Zheng.

description.zh-cn: 韩昭侯赏识申不害的学说，任命其为宰相。
description.en: Marquis Zhao of Han appreciated Shen Buhai's theories and appointed him as chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 申不害在韩国担任宰相近二十年。
description.en: Shen Buhai served as the chancellor of the State of Han for nearly twenty years.

description.zh-cn: 申不害是法家中“术”派的代表人物。
description.en: Shen Buhai is the representative figure of the 'Shu' (administrative methods) school within Legalism.

description.zh-cn: 商鞅是法家中“法”派的代表人物。
description.en: Shang Yang is a representative figure of the 'Fa' (law) school within Legalism.

description.zh-cn: 法家是先秦诸子百家中的一个重要流派。
description.en: Legalism is an important school of thought among the pre-Qin Hundred Schools of Thought.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼于1986年6月11日出生于法国欧博讷。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu was born in Eaubonne, France on June 11, 1986.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼毕业于巴黎先贤祠-阿萨斯大学。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu is an alumnus of Panthéon-Assas University.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼自2017年起为复兴党（前身为共和国前进！）成员。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu has been a member of Renaissance (formerly La République En Marche!) since 2017.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼于2015年至2017年间为共和党成员。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu was a member of The Republicans from 2015 to 2017.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼于2002年至2015年间为人民运动联盟成员。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu was a member of the Union for a Popular Movement from 2002 to 2015.

description.zh-cn: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙首次任命塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼为总理。在勒科尔尼短暂辞职后，马克龙总统又再次任命他为总理。
description.en: President Emmanuel Macron first appointed Sébastien Lecornu as Prime Minister. Following Lecornu's brief resignation, Macron reappointed him to the post.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼作为法国总理，向总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙负责。
description.en: As Prime Minister of France, Sébastien Lecornu is responsible to President Emmanuel Macron.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼接替弗朗索瓦·贝鲁出任法国总理。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu succeeded François Bayrou as Prime Minister of France.

description.zh-cn: 在伊丽莎白·博尔内担任总理期间，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼担任国防部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu served as Minister of the Armed Forces during Élisabeth Borne's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在加布里埃尔·阿塔尔担任总理期间，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼担任国防部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu served as Minister of the Armed Forces during Gabriel Attal's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在米歇尔·巴尼耶担任总理期间，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼担任国防部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu served as Minister of the Armed Forces during Michel Barnier's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 在弗朗索瓦·贝鲁担任总理期间，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼担任国防部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu served as Minister of the Armed Forces during François Bayrou's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼接替弗洛朗丝·帕利出任法国国防部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu succeeded Florence Parly as Minister of the Armed Forces of France.

description.zh-cn: 2025年9月9日，布鲁诺·勒梅尔接替塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼出任法国国防部长。随后，于2025年10月7日，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼再次接替布鲁诺·勒梅尔，出任法国国防部长。
description.en: On September 9, 2025, Bruno Le Maire succeeded Sébastien Lecornu as Minister of the Armed Forces of France. Subsequently, on October 7, 2025, Sébastien Lecornu once again succeeded Bruno Le Maire to become Minister of the Armed Forces of France.

description.zh-cn: 卡特琳·沃特兰接替塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼出任法国国防部长。
description.en: Catherine Vautrin succeeded Sébastien Lecornu as Minister of the Armed Forces of France.

description.zh-cn: 在让·卡斯泰担任总理期间，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼担任海外部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu served as Minister of Overseas France during Jean Castex's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 娅埃尔·布朗-皮韦接替塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼出任法国海外部长。
description.en: Yaël Braun-Pivet succeeded Sébastien Lecornu as Minister of Overseas France.

position.zh-cn: 领土发展部长、法国生态转型与国土协调部国务卿
position.en: Minister of Territorial Development, Secretary of State to the Minister for the Ecological and Inclusive Transition

description.zh-cn: 在爱德华·菲利普担任总理期间，塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼先后担任生态部国务卿和领土发展部长。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu served as Secretary of State for Ecology and later as Minister of Territorial Development during Édouard Philippe's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 法国国民议会未通过针对总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼的不信任案，使其得以继续任职。
description.en: The French National Assembly did not pass the motion of no confidence against Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu, allowing him to remain in office.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾民主化前，中国国民党长期实行一党专政及威权主义统治，压制了民主发展。
description.en: Before Taiwan's democratization, the Kuomintang implemented a long-term one-party authoritarian rule, suppressing democratic development.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民主国于乙未战争期间为反抗日本接管而成立。
description.en: The Republic of Formosa was established during the 1895 war to resist the Japanese takeover.

description.zh-cn: 日治时期，日本的大正民主风潮兴起，民主与平等思想再度进入台湾，成为台湾民主运动的早期起源。
description.en: During the Japanese rule period, the Taishō Democracy movement in Japan brought ideas of democracy and equality to Taiwan, becoming an early origin of Taiwan's democracy movement.

description.zh-cn: 台湾议会设置请愿运动的诉求最终未获得日本帝国议会的采纳。
description.en: The demands of the Petition Movement for the Establishment of a Taiwanese Parliament were ultimately not adopted by the Imperial Diet of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 因第二次国共内战，中华民国政府迁台后转为动员戡乱体制下的高压统治，迟滞了民主化发展。
description.en: Due to the Chinese Civil War, the government of the Republic of China shifted to a high-pressure rule under the mobilization system after moving to Taiwan, which delayed democratic development.

description.zh-cn: 党外运动等民主派人士的持续抗争，是推动台湾民主化的重要民间力量。
description.en: The continuous protests by pro-democracy figures such as those in the Tangwai movement were a significant civil force driving Taiwan's democratization.

description.zh-cn: 长达38年的戒严令是威权统治时期的法律基础，其造成的白色恐怖使得台湾民主化发展十分迟缓。
description.en: The 38-year-long martial law was the legal basis for the authoritarian rule, and the resulting White Terror made the development of Taiwan's democratization very slow.

description.zh-cn: 美丽岛事件后，中华民国政府大举逮捕党外运动人士，对该运动造成严重打击。
description.en: After the Kaohsiung Incident, the government of the Republic of China arrested a large number of Tangwai movement figures, dealing a severe blow to the movement.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国宣布解严，并开放党禁、报禁，开启了台湾民主化的滥觞。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo's announcement of the lifting of martial law and the opening up of party and press bans initiated the beginning of Taiwan's democratization.

description.zh-cn: 在李登辉政府执政下，台湾在1990年代展开了全面性的民主化改革，完成了总统直选与国会全面改选等关键成就。
description.en: Under the administration of the Lee Teng-hui government, Taiwan underwent comprehensive democratic reforms in the 1990s, achieving key milestones such as direct presidential elections and full parliamentary re-elections.

description.zh-cn: 野百合学运要求政府进行民主化改革，是推动1990年代政治改革的重要事件。
description.en: The Wild Lily student movement demanded democratic reforms from the government and was a significant event that pushed for political reforms in the 1990s.

description.zh-cn: 国是会议邀集并整合了国内各方对于民主化政治改革的意见，为后续改革凝聚了共识。
description.en: The National Affairs Conference gathered and integrated opinions from various domestic parties on political reforms for democratization, building consensus for subsequent reforms.

description.zh-cn: 此次选举实现了首次政党轮替，使民主进步党首次执政。
description.en: This election resulted in the first transfer of power between political parties, bringing the Democratic Progressive Party to power for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 此次选举结束了中国国民党自1948年行宪起长达52年的执政。
description.en: This election ended the Kuomintang's 52-year rule since the implementation of the Constitution in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 太阳花学运期间，示威人士占领立法院议场，使其议事停摆。
description.en: During the Sunflower Student Movement, protesters occupied the chamber of the Legislative Yuan, bringing its proceedings to a halt.

description.zh-cn: 锺伟是湖南平江人。
description.en: Zhong Wei was a native of Pingjiang, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 1929年加入中国共产主义青年团。
description.en: Joined the Communist Youth League of China in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 1929年参加中国工农红军。
description.en: Joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in 1929.

description.zh-cn: 1931年转为中国共产党党员。
description.en: Became a member of the Communist Party of China in 1931.

position.zh-cn: 连指导员，团政委，师政治部主任
position.en: Company Political Instructor, Regiment Political Commissar, Division Political Department Director

description.zh-cn: 曾在彭德怀的红三军团担任连指导员，团政委，师政治部主任等职。
description.en: Served in Peng Dehuai's 3rd Red Army Group as a company political instructor, regiment political commissar, and division political department director.

description.zh-cn: 锺伟曾在彭德怀指挥的红三军团任职。
description.en: Zhong Wei served in the 3rd Red Army Group commanded by Peng Dehuai.

position.zh-cn: 连指导员，团政委，师政治部主任
position.en: Company Political Instructor, Regiment Political Commissar, Division Political Department Director

description.zh-cn: 曾在徐海东的红十五军团担任连指导员，团政委，师政治部主任等职。
description.en: Served in Xu Haidong's 15th Red Army Group as a company political instructor, regiment political commissar, and division political department director.

description.zh-cn: 锺伟曾在徐海东指挥的红十五军团任职。
description.en: Zhong Wei served in the 15th Red Army Group commanded by Xu Haidong.

description.zh-cn: 锺伟参加了长征。
description.en: Zhong Wei participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战中，担任东北野战军第二纵队第五师师长、第十二纵队司令等职务。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, he served as the commander of the 5th Division of the 2nd Column and commander of the 12th Column of the Northeast Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 锺伟在东北野战军时期于林彪麾下任职。
description.en: Zhong Wei served under Lin Biao during his time in the Northeast Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 锺伟指挥的第四十九军第一四六师在青树坪战役中被中华民国国军击败。
description.en: The 146th Division of the 49th Army, commanded by Zhong Wei, was defeated by the National Revolutionary Army in the Battle of Qingshuping.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，中华人民共和国授予锺伟少将军衔以及二级八一勋章、二级独立自由勋章、一级解放勋章。
description.en: In 1955, the People's Republic of China awarded Zhong Wei the rank of Major General, as well as the Second Class Order of August 1, the Second Class Order of Independence and Freedom, and the First Class Order of Liberation.

description.zh-cn: 1955年被授予少将军衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Major General in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 在1959年庐山会议后的军委扩大会议上，锺伟公开站出来为彭德怀辩护，反驳吴法宪等人的攻击。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission after the Lushan Conference in 1959, Zhong Wei publicly stood up to defend Peng Dehuai, refuting the attacks from Wu Faxian and others.

description.zh-cn: 在1959年军委扩大会议上揭发彭德怀身背“血债”。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission in 1959, he accused Peng Dehuai of having a 'blood debt'.

description.zh-cn: 在1959年军委扩大会议上，林彪插话支持对彭德怀的攻击。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission in 1959, Lin Biao interjected to support the attacks on Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 在军委扩大会议上，因锺伟力挺彭德怀，萧华当场下令将其带上手铐并隔离审查。
description.en: At the enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission, after Zhong Wei defended Peng Dehuai, Xiao Hua ordered him to be handcuffed and placed in solitary confinement on the spot.

description.zh-cn: 在军委扩大会议事件后，锺伟被撤销领导职务，下放到安徽省农业厅任副厅长。
description.en: After the incident at the enlarged CMC meeting, Zhong Wei was removed from his leadership position and demoted to Deputy Director of the Anhui Provincial Department of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间，锺伟受到严重迫害，曾被造反派装入麻袋殴打并投入江中，后侥幸存活。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhong Wei was severely persecuted. He was once put into a sack, beaten, and thrown into a river by a rebel faction, but he managed to survive.

description.zh-cn: 1980年12月24日，中央军委为锺伟平反。
description.en: On December 24, 1980, the Central Military Commission rehabilitated Zhong Wei.

description.zh-cn: 1982年8月，总政治部批准给予锺伟大军区副职待遇离休。
description.en: In August 1982, the General Political Department approved Zhong Wei's retirement with the benefits of a deputy-commander of a major military region.

description.zh-cn: 在一次战斗中，部队陷入埋伏，时任兵团副司令的陈伯钧主张撤退，但军长钟伟坚决反对，并拔枪顶住陈伯钧，阻止其下令撤退。
description.en: During a battle where their troops were ambushed, Chen Bojun, then deputy commander of the army group, advocated for a retreat. However, Army Commander Zhong Wei strongly opposed it, preventing the retreat order by drawing his pistol on Chen Bojun.

description.zh-cn: 朱自清出生于江苏省东海县。
description.en: Zhu Ziqing was born in Donghai County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 朱物华是朱自清的二弟。
description.en: Zhu Wuhua is Zhu Ziqing's second younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 朱迈先是朱自清的长子。
description.en: Zhu Maixian is Zhu Ziqing's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 1916年考入国立北京大学预科，1917年升入哲学系，1920年毕业。
description.en: Admitted to the preparatory school of National Peking University in 1916, entered the Department of Philosophy in 1917, and graduated in 1920.

description.zh-cn: 留学英国，在伦敦大学进修语言学和英国文学。
description.en: Studied abroad in the UK, pursuing advanced studies in linguistics and English literature at the University of London.

position.zh-cn: 中国文学系教授兼系主任
position.en: Professor and Head of the Department of Chinese Literature

description.zh-cn: 1925年到清华学校任教，后该校改名为国立清华大学。
description.en: Began teaching at Tsinghua School in 1925, which was later renamed National Tsinghua University.

position.en: Head of the Department of Chinese Literature

description.zh-cn: 1938年到昆明，任国立西南联合大学中国文学系主任。
description.en: Went to Kunming in 1938 to serve as the Head of the Department of Chinese Literature at National Southwest Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 为温州中学撰写校歌，其中名句“英奇匡国，作圣启蒙”成为该校校训。
description.en: Wrote the school song for Wenzhou High School, in which the famous line 'Cultivate talents to serve the nation, educate people to enlighten the future' became the school's motto.

description.zh-cn: 朱自清在五四运动期间上街游行，并受其影响开始写作新诗。
description.en: During the May Fourth Movement, Zhu Ziqing participated in street demonstrations and was inspired to start writing modern poetry.

description.zh-cn: 两人是晨光社的顾问，共同创办了《诗》月刊，并合著了《国文教学》等书，是文学上的长期伙伴。
description.en: They were advisors to the Morning Light Society, co-founded the 'Poetry' monthly, and co-authored books such as 'Teaching Chinese Language and Literature', making them long-term literary partners.

description.zh-cn: 与俞平伯、叶圣陶、刘延陵等人共同创办《诗》月刊。
description.en: Co-founded the 'Poetry' monthly with Yu Pingbo, Ye Shengtao, Liu Yanling, and others.

description.zh-cn: 朱自清长子朱迈先在1951年的镇反运动中被处决。
description.en: Zhu Ziqing's eldest son, Zhu Maixian, was executed during the Campaign to Suppress Counterrevolutionaries in 1951.

description.zh-cn: 根据毛泽东在《别了，司徒雷登》中的描述，闻一多拍案而起，横眉怒对国民党的手枪，宁可倒下去，不愿屈服。
description.en: According to Mao Zedong's description in 'Farewell, Leighton Stuart', Wen Yiduo stood up defiantly against the Kuomintang's guns, preferring death to submission.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，华硕将代工业务分割出去，成立了和硕联合科技。
description.en: In 2008, ASUS spun off its OEM/ODM business to establish Pegatron.

description.zh-cn: 该事件是一起广受关注的消费者维权及法律纠纷，对华硕的品牌声誉造成了负面冲击。
description.en: This incident was a widely publicized consumer rights and legal dispute that negatively impacted ASUS's brand reputation.

description.zh-cn: 在中国大陆网民压力下，华硕取消了旗下ROG品牌与Hololive的合作直播工商活动。
description.en: Under pressure from mainland Chinese netizens, ASUS canceled a promotional livestream collaboration between its ROG brand and Hololive.

description.zh-cn: 由于俄乌战争引发的复合性挑战，华硕对俄罗斯市场的出货已停滞。
description.en: Due to complex challenges arising from the Russo-Ukrainian War, ASUS's shipments to the Russian market have been halted.

description.zh-cn: 乌克兰副总理公开致信华硕董事长施崇棠，呼吁其暂停在俄罗斯的业务，对华硕的决策产生影响。
description.en: The Deputy Prime Minister of Ukraine publicly sent a letter to ASUS Chairman Jonney Shih, urging the company to suspend its business in Russia, which influenced ASUS's decision-making.

description.zh-cn: 1978年2月进入中央民族学院汉语言文学系学习，1982年大学毕业。
description.en: Enrolled in the Department of Chinese Language and Literature at the Central Institute for Nationalities in February 1978 and graduated in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 在会议上，咸辉被递补为中国共产党第十八届中央委员会委员。
description.en: At the meeting, Xian Hui was promoted to a full member of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

position.en: Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 作为全国政协副主席，咸辉在主席王沪宁的领导下工作。
description.en: As a Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee, Xian Hui works under the leadership of Chairman Wang Huning.

position.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席
position.en: Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 咸辉担任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席期间，时任自治区党委书记是李建华。
description.en: During Xian Hui's tenure as Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, Li Jianhua was the Party Secretary of the autonomous region.

position.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席
position.en: Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 咸辉担任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席期间，时任自治区党委书记是石泰峰。
description.en: During Xian Hui's tenure as Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, Shi Taifeng was the Party Secretary of the autonomous region.

position.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席
position.en: Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 咸辉担任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席期间，时任自治区党委书记是梁言顺。
