description.en: During Xian Hui's tenure as Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, Liang Yanshun was the Party Secretary of the autonomous region.

description.zh-cn: 咸辉接替刘慧出任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: Xian Hui succeeded Liu Hui as Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 张雨浦接替咸辉出任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: Zhang Yupu succeeded Xian Hui as Chairperson of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 咸辉接替罗笑虎出任甘肃省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Xian Hui succeeded Luo Xiaohu as Executive Vice Governor of Gansu Province.

description.zh-cn: 虞海燕接替咸辉出任甘肃省人民政府常务副省长。
description.en: Yu Haiyan succeeded Xian Hui as Executive Vice Governor of Gansu Province.

description.zh-cn: 1636年，皇太极在盛京称帝，改国号为大清。
description.en: In 1636, Hong Taiji proclaimed himself emperor in Shengjing and changed the state's name to Great Qing.

description.zh-cn: 吴三桂为对抗李自成而归降清军，引清兵入山海关，使清朝得以入主中原。
description.en: To resist Li Zicheng, Wu Sangui surrendered to the Qing army and allowed them through the Shanhai Pass, enabling the Qing to conquer central China.

description.zh-cn: 清军入关后，于一片石战役击败李自成的大顺军，并最终将其剿灭。
description.en: After entering the Shanhai Pass, the Qing army defeated Li Zicheng's Dashun forces at the Battle of Shanhai Pass and eventually destroyed the regime.

description.zh-cn: 1683年，清朝派施琅率水师攻占台湾，明郑灭亡。
description.en: In 1683, the Qing dynasty dispatched Shi Lang with a naval force to conquer Taiwan, leading to the fall of the Kingdom of Tungning.

description.zh-cn: 曾国藩创建和统帅的湘军是平定太平天国运动的主要军事力量。
description.en: The Xiang Army, created and commanded by Zeng Guofan, was the main military force that suppressed the Taiping Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争的失败使清朝国际地位大为降低，并被迫签订《马关条约》，割让台湾及澎湖。
description.en: The defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War greatly diminished the Qing dynasty's international standing and forced it to sign the Treaty of Shimonoseki, ceding Taiwan and Penghu.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军占领北京，迫使清廷签订《辛丑条约》，加深了中国的半殖民地化。
description.en: The Eight-Nation Alliance occupied Beijing, forcing the Qing court to sign the Boxer Protocol, which deepened China's semi-colonial status.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义的爆发标志着辛亥革命的开始。
description.en: The outbreak of the Wuchang Uprising marked the beginning of the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 张勋于1917年发动政变，拥立溥仪复辟，试图恢复清朝统治，但以失败告终。
description.en: In 1917, Zhang Xun launched a coup to restore Puyi to the throne in an attempt to revive the Qing dynasty, but it ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 什叶派与逊尼派是伊斯兰教两大主要教派，但他们之间不时爆发严重的暴力冲突。什叶派在历史上屡受多数派的逊尼派打压。
description.en: Shia and Sunni are the two main branches of Islam, but severe violent conflicts often erupt between them. Historically, the Shia have been frequently suppressed by the majority Sunni.

description.zh-cn: 法蒂玛是先知穆罕默德的女儿。
description.en: Fatimah is the daughter of the Prophet Muhammad.

description.zh-cn: 阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜迎娶了穆罕默德的女儿法蒂玛。
description.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib married Muhammad's daughter, Fatimah.

description.zh-cn: 什叶派相信穆罕默德指定了他的女婿阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜作为他的继承人，并认为只有阿里的后裔才能成为伊玛目。
description.en: Shias believe that Muhammad appointed his son-in-law Ali ibn Abi Talib as his successor and that only Ali's descendants can be Imams.

description.zh-cn: 什叶派拒绝承认阿里之前第一位哈里发阿布·伯克尔的合法统治地位。
description.en: Shia Islam rejects the legitimate rule of the first Caliph, Abu Bakr, who preceded Ali.

description.zh-cn: 什叶派拒绝承认阿里之前第二位哈里发欧麦尔·本·赫塔卜的合法统治地位。
description.en: Shia Islam rejects the legitimate rule of the second Caliph, Umar ibn al-Khattab, who preceded Ali.

description.zh-cn: 什叶派拒绝承认阿里之前第三位哈里发奥斯曼·本·阿凡的合法统治地位。
description.en: Shia Islam rejects the legitimate rule of the third Caliph, Uthman ibn Affan, who preceded Ali.

description.zh-cn: 哈桑是阿里的儿子。
description.en: Hasan is the son of Ali.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因是阿里的儿子。
description.en: Husayn is the son of Ali.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因是哈桑的弟弟。
description.en: Husayn is the younger brother of Hasan.

description.zh-cn: 侯赛因·本·阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜在卡尔巴拉战役中被杀害，成为什叶派的殉道者。
description.en: Husayn ibn Ali was killed in the Battle of Karbala, becoming a martyr for the Shia.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯玛仪一世在1501年自称为沙阿，创立了萨非王朝。
description.en: Ismail I declared himself Shah in 1501 and founded the Safavid dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 萨非王朝通过强迫民众改信等手段，把伊朗变成以什叶派穆斯林为多数的地区。
description.en: The Safavid dynasty transformed Iran into a predominantly Shia Muslim region through means such as forced conversion.

description.zh-cn: 什叶派于969年占领埃及，建立了法蒂玛王朝。
description.en: Shia forces conquered Egypt in 969 and established the Fatimid dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 自伊拉克战争后，逊尼派国家忧虑什叶派有崛起的迹象，什叶派的地位持续上升。
description.en: Since the Iraq War, Sunni states have been concerned about the rise of Shia influence, and the status of the Shia has continued to rise.

description.zh-cn: 学者瓦利·纳斯尔认为，布什政府解放了伊拉克的什叶派多数，襄助什叶派强势复兴。
description.en: Scholar Vali Nasr argues that the Bush administration liberated the Shia majority in Iraq, aiding a powerful Shia revival.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳是李鹏的长女。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is the eldest daughter of Li Peng.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳是朱琳的女儿。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is the daughter of Zhu Lin.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳是李小鹏的姐姐。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is the elder sister of Li Xiaopeng.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳是李小勇的姐姐。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is the elder sister of Li Xiaoyong.

description.zh-cn: 赵君陶是李小琳的祖母。
description.en: Zhao Juntao is Li Xiaolin's paternal grandmother.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳于1961年6月1日出生于辽宁省沈阳市。
description.en: Li Xiaolin was born in Shenyang, Liaoning Province on June 1, 1961.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳曾就读于华北电力大学职工大专。
description.en: Li Xiaolin attended the staff college program at North China Electric Power University.

degree.zh-cn: 电力系统及自动化专业工学硕士
degree.en: Master of Engineering in Power System and its Automation

description.zh-cn: 李小琳于1988年从清华大学毕业，获得工学硕士学位。
description.en: Li Xiaolin graduated from Tsinghua University in 1988 with a Master of Engineering degree.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳曾在电力工业部华北电业管理局担任技术员和工程师。
description.en: Li Xiaolin worked as a technician and engineer at the North China Electric Power Administration Bureau under the Ministry of Electric Power Industry.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Economic and Trade Division, International Department

description.zh-cn: 1986年，李小琳调任国家能源部（国家能源局前身）任国际司经贸处副处长。
description.en: In 1986, Li Xiaolin was transferred to the Ministry of Energy (predecessor of the National Energy Administration) to serve as Deputy Director of the Economic and Trade Division in the International Department.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，李小琳出任中国电力投资集团公司常务副总经理。此前她曾于1996年担任公司总经理助理。
description.en: In 1998, Li Xiaolin became the Executive Vice General Manager of China Power Investment Corporation. She had previously served as an assistant to the general manager since 1996.

description.zh-cn: 自2008年起，李小琳兼任中国电力国际发展有限公司董事长。
description.en: Since 2008, Li Xiaolin has also served as the Chairman of China Power International Development Limited.

position.en: Deputy General Manager, Party Leadership Group Member

description.zh-cn: 李小琳于2015年7月调任中国大唐集团，担任副总经理和党组成员，直至2018年5月退休。
description.en: Li Xiaolin was transferred to China Datang Corporation in July 2015, serving as Deputy General Manager and a member of the Party Leadership Group until her retirement in May 2018.

description.zh-cn: 李小琳曾担任第十一届、十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: Li Xiaolin served as a member of the 11th and 12th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 据《亚洲周刊》报道，在时任海南省副省长冀文林的协助下，李小琳获批海南博鳌乐城的五幅土地。
description.en: According to Yazhou Zhoukan, with the assistance of then-Vice Governor of Hainan, Ji Wenlin, Li Xiaolin was granted five plots of land in Boao Lecheng, Hainan.

description.zh-cn: 冀文林曾长期担任周永康的秘书。
description.en: Ji Wenlin served as Zhou Yongkang's secretary for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 巴拿马文件泄露事件显示，李小琳与其丈夫刘智源在欧洲列支敦斯登成立基金，并为一家英属维尔京群岛公司的单一股东。
description.en: The Panama Papers leak revealed that Li Xiaolin and her husband Liu Zhiyuan established a foundation in Liechtenstein, which was the sole shareholder of a company in the British Virgin Islands.

description.zh-cn: 《亚洲周刊》刊发调查报道，指李小琳在冀文林协助下，以离岸公司获批价值逾百亿人民币的海南土地。
description.en: Yazhou Zhoukan published an investigative report alleging that Li Xiaolin, with the assistance of Ji Wenlin, obtained land in Hainan worth over ten billion RMB through an offshore company.

description.zh-cn: 英国《每日电讯报》报道称，李小琳卷入外资进入中国保险业的交易。
description.en: The British newspaper The Daily Telegraph reported that Li Xiaolin was involved in transactions concerning foreign investment in China's insurance industry.

description.zh-cn: 李小鹏现任中华人民共和国交通运输部部长。
description.en: Li Xiaopeng is the current Minister of Transport of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李小鹏曾任山西省省长。
description.en: Li Xiaopeng previously served as the Governor of Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 时任四川总督赵尔丰镇压保路运动民众，造成“成都血案”。
description.en: Zhao Erfeng, then Viceroy of Sichuan, suppressed the participants of the Railway Protection Movement, causing the 'Chengdu Bloodbath'.

description.zh-cn: 刘湘在蒋介石支持下，与刘文辉爆发战争并获胜，成为四川最大的实力派。
description.en: With the support of Chiang Kai-shek, Liu Xiang fought a war against Liu Wenhui and won, becoming the most powerful figure in Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 唐代大诗人杜甫曾旅居成都，其故居杜甫草堂成为成都重要的文化地标。
description.en: The great Tang Dynasty poet Du Fu once lived in Chengdu, and his former residence, the Du Fu Thatched Cottage, has become an important cultural landmark in the city.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖是中华民国军政府的缔造者，并于1927年6月16日在北京建立该政府。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin was the founder of the Military Government of the Republic of China, establishing it in Beijing on June 16, 1927.

position.zh-cn: 中华民国军政府陆海军大元帅
position.en: Grand Marshal of the Army and Navy of the Military Government of the Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 张作霖就任大元帅，行使大总统职权，是安国军政府的最高领导人。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin assumed the position of Grand Marshal, exercising presidential powers as the supreme leader of the Anguojun Government.

description.zh-cn: 潘复于1927年6月20日出任安国军政府的国务总理。
description.en: Pan Fu was appointed Premier of the State Council of the Anguojun Government on June 20, 1927.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖在皇姑屯事件中遇刺身亡，直接导致安国军政府瓦解。
description.en: The assassination of Zhang Zuolin in the Huanggutun incident directly led to the collapse of the Anguojun Government.

description.zh-cn: 国民革命军的北伐行动最终击败了安国军，并推翻了其所代表的北洋政府。
description.en: The Northern Expedition of the National Revolutionary Army ultimately defeated the Anguojun and overthrew the Beiyang government it represented.

description.zh-cn: 在北伐战争期间，安国军与国民革命军是敌对的军事力量。
description.en: During the Northern Expedition, the Anguojun and the National Revolutionary Army were opposing military forces.

description.zh-cn: 在龙潭战斗中，国民革命军打败了由孙传芳率领的安国军，导致安国军北撤。
description.en: In the Battle of Longtan, the National Revolutionary Army defeated the Anguojun led by Sun Chuanfang, forcing the Anguojun to retreat north.

description.zh-cn: 龙潭战斗的胜利奠定了南京国民政府的基业。
description.en: The victory in the Battle of Longtan secured the foundation of the Nanjing Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 孙传芳与张宗昌等人带头“劝进”，推举张作霖为安国军总司令。
description.en: Sun Chuanfang, along with Zhang Zongchang and others, took the lead in 'persuading' Zhang Zuolin to become the commander-in-chief of the Anguojun.

description.zh-cn: 张宗昌与孙传芳等人带头“劝进”，推举张作霖为安国军总司令。
description.en: Zhang Zongchang, along with Sun Chuanfang and others, took the lead in 'persuading' Zhang Zuolin to become the commander-in-chief of the Anguojun.

description.zh-cn: 在马英九担任总统期间，金溥聪获聘为总统府资政。
description.en: During Ma Ying-jeou's presidency, King Pu-tsung was appointed as a Senior Advisor to the President.

description.zh-cn: 因对壹传媒电视新闻尺度的歧见而拆伙。
description.en: Parted ways due to disagreements over the standards for Next Media's television news.

description.zh-cn: 金溥聪与史亚平为外交特考同梯受训人员。
description.en: King Pu-tsung and Shih Yea-ping were in the same training cohort for the diplomatic service examination.

description.zh-cn: 金溥聪作为国安会秘书长处理张显耀涉嫌泄密案，并调任其职务。
description.en: As Secretary-General of the National Security Council, King Pu-tsung handled the suspected leak case involving Chang Hsien-yao and reassigned him.

description.zh-cn: 因冯光远发表关于金溥聪与马英九有“特殊性关系”的言论，金溥聪对冯光远提起长达数年的诽谤诉讼。
description.en: King Pu-tsung filed a multi-year defamation lawsuit against Feng Kuang-yuan over Feng's remarks about a "special relationship" between King and Ma Ying-jeou.

description.zh-cn: 王拓在记者会上引用检举信，指控金溥聪勾结检察官企图构陷民进党籍总统候选人谢长廷。
description.en: In a press conference, Wang Tuo cited a whistleblower letter to accuse King Pu-tsung of colluding with prosecutors to frame DPP presidential candidate Frank Hsieh.

description.zh-cn: 康裕成在记者会上引用检举信，指控金溥聪勾结检察官企图构陷民进党籍总统候选人谢长廷。
description.en: In a press conference, Kang Yu-cheng cited a whistleblower letter to accuse King Pu-tsung of colluding with prosecutors to frame DPP presidential candidate Frank Hsieh.

description.zh-cn: 颜圣冠在记者会上引用检举信，指控金溥聪勾结检察官企图构陷民进党籍总统候选人谢长廷。
description.en: In a press conference, Yen Sheng-kuan cited a whistleblower letter to accuse King Pu-tsung of colluding with prosecutors to frame DPP presidential candidate Frank Hsieh.

description.zh-cn: 在关于是否处罚走路吸烟的立法争议中，时任卫生署长杨志良公开表达支持金溥聪的立场。
description.en: During the legislative controversy over penalizing smoking while walking, then-Minister of Health Yang Chih-liang publicly expressed support for King Pu-tsung's position.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年总统大选中，金溥聪作为马英九的竞选操盘手，主导了对蔡英文宇昌案的攻击。
description.en: In the 2012 presidential election, King Pu-tsung, as Ma Ying-jeou's campaign manager, led the attacks on Tsai Ing-wen regarding the Yu Chang case.

description.zh-cn: 杨秋兴在2010年五都选举中参选大高雄市长，争取蓝军选票，对国民党的总得票数造成影响。
description.en: Yang Chiu-hsing's candidacy for mayor of Greater Kaohsiung in the 2010 five-municipality elections appealed to pan-blue voters, impacting the Kuomintang's overall vote count.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨是赵宏博的教练。
description.en: Yao Bin was the coach of Zhao Hongbo.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨是庞清的教练。
description.en: Yao Bin was the coach of Pang Qing.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨是张丹的教练。
description.en: Yao Bin was the coach of Zhang Dan.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨是张昊的教练。
description.en: Yao Bin was the coach of Zhang Hao.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨是张悦的教练。
description.en: Yao Bin was the coach of Zhang Yue.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨参加了1980年冬季奥林匹克运动会花样滑冰比赛。
description.en: Yao Bin participated in the figure skating competition at the 1980 Winter Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨参加了1984年冬季奥林匹克运动会花样滑冰比赛。
description.en: Yao Bin participated in the figure skating competition at the 1984 Winter Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，姚滨当选第十一届全国政协委员，代表体育界，分入第四十三组。
description.en: In 2008, Yao Bin was elected as a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC, representing the sports sector in group 43.

description.zh-cn: 姚滨是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yao Bin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 林峰正是时代力量的共同发起人之一，于2015年1月25日参与举办创党成立大会。
description.en: Lin Feng-cheng was one of the co-initiators of the New Power Party, participating in its founding meeting on January 25, 2015.

description.zh-cn: 邱显智是时代力量的共同发起人之一，他曾是洪仲丘案的义务律师。
description.en: Chiu Hsien-chih was one of the co-initiators of the New Power Party. He was a volunteer lawyer in the Hung Chung-chiu case.

description.zh-cn: 马英九政府时期的多项政策（如“和中政策”）及社会事件（如大埔案、洪仲丘案）引发广泛社会不满，为时代力量等新兴政党的崛起提供了机遇。
description.en: Various policies (such as the 'China-friendly policy') and social incidents (like the Dapu incident, Hung Chung-chiu case) during the Ma Ying-jeou administration caused widespread public discontent, providing an opportunity for the rise of new political parties like the New Power Party.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年立委选举中，民主进步党与时代力量合作，于部分选区礼让，协助时代力量首次进入国会。
description.en: In the 2016 legislative election, the Democratic Progressive Party cooperated with the New Power Party, yielding in some constituencies to help the NPP enter the legislature for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 自2017年《劳动基准法》修法争议起，时代力量在多项议题上与执政的民进党立场对立，双方关系恶化，从合作转为竞争和对抗。
description.en: Starting with the controversy over the Labor Standards Act amendment in 2017, the New Power Party took opposing stances to the ruling DPP on multiple issues, causing their relationship to deteriorate from cooperation to competition and confrontation.

description.zh-cn: 时代力量自创党起就将中国国民党视为主要政治对手，其目标之一是削弱国民党在立法院的势力，并期望取而代之成为台湾主要的本土政党之一。
description.en: Since its founding, the New Power Party has regarded the Kuomintang as its main political adversary, with one of its goals being to weaken the KMT's power in the legislature and to eventually replace it as a major local political party in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 时代力量在2016年立委选举中首次参选即获得5席，成为立法院第三大党，成功进入国会体制。
description.en: In its debut in the 2016 legislative election, the New Power Party won 5 seats, becoming the third-largest party in the Legislative Yuan and successfully entering the parliamentary system.

description.zh-cn: 时代力量在2024年立委选举中区域及不分区立委全数落选，政党票亦未过门槛，导致其完全失去国会席次，面临严峻的生存挑战。
description.en: In the 2024 legislative election, the New Power Party failed to win any district or party-list seats, and its party vote share did not meet the threshold, resulting in a complete loss of its parliamentary presence and facing severe existential challenges.

description.zh-cn: 自2019年起，因路线分歧导致多位核心成员及民选公职人员退党，严重削弱了时代力量的政治实力和公众形象。
description.en: Starting from 2019, disagreements over the party's direction led to the departure of several core members and elected officials, severely weakening the New Power Party's political strength and public image.

description.zh-cn: 创党核心人物黄国昌于2023年11月16日宣布退出时代力量并加入台湾民众党，引发党内“昌派”退党潮，对时代力量在2024年选举前的整合造成重创。
description.en: Core founder Huang Kuo-chang announced on November 16, 2023, that he was leaving the New Power Party to join the Taiwan People's Party, triggering an exodus of his supporters within the party and severely damaging the NPP's unity before the 2024 election.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年地方选举大败后，王婉谕于2023年2月当选为时代力量党主席，负责领导党的改革与重建工作。
description.en: Following the party's major defeat in the 2022 local elections, Wang Wan-yu was elected as the chairperson of the New Power Party in February 2023, responsible for leading its reform and rebuilding efforts.

description.zh-cn: 委托乔瓦尼·卡博特率领探险队，发现一条经北大西洋通往亚洲的航线。
description.en: Commissioned John Cabot to lead an expedition to find a route to Asia via the North Atlantic.

description.zh-cn: 于1497年抵达纽芬兰海岸，其航行标志着大英帝国的开端。
description.en: His arrival on the coast of Newfoundland in 1497 marked the beginning of the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次百年战争期间，英国与法国为争夺欧洲及海外霸权进行了长期的斗争。
description.en: During the Second Hundred Years' War, Britain and France engaged in a prolonged struggle for European and overseas hegemony.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争的胜利使英国从法国手中夺取了加拿大和印度，成为世界上最强大的海上势力。
description.en: Victory in the Seven Years' War allowed Britain to seize Canada and India from France, becoming the world's most powerful maritime force.

description.zh-cn: 美国独立战争导致英国丧失了其在北美的十三殖民地。
description.en: The American Revolutionary War resulted in the loss of Britain's Thirteen Colonies in North America.

description.zh-cn: 英国在拿破仑战争中最终获胜，确立了其作为无可置疑的世界第一强国的地位。
description.en: Britain's ultimate victory in the Napoleonic Wars established its status as the undisputed world's leading power.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战的巨大开销严重削弱了英国的经济实力，动摇了其维持庞大帝国的财政基础。
description.en: The immense financial cost of World War I severely weakened Britain's economy, undermining the fiscal foundation for maintaining its vast empire.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战导致英国国力严重衰退，加速了大英帝国的瓦解。
description.en: World War II caused a severe decline in British national power, accelerating the dissolution of the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 印度于1947年独立，使大英帝国失去了其最重要的殖民地，并引发了全球范围内的去殖民化浪潮。
description.en: India's independence in 1947 caused the British Empire to lose its most important colony and triggered a global wave of decolonization.

description.zh-cn: 在苏伊士运河危机期间，美国通过经济制裁等手段施压，迫使英法撤军，正式取代英国成为新的世界霸主。
description.en: During the Suez Crisis, the United States exerted pressure through economic sanctions and other means, forcing British and French withdrawal and formally replacing Britain as the new world hegemon.

description.zh-cn: 在1783年美国独立战争结束前，十三殖民地是大英帝国在北美的主要领土。
description.en: Before the end of the American Revolutionary War in 1783, the Thirteen Colonies were a major territory of the British Empire in North America.

description.zh-cn: 维多利亚女王在位期间是大英帝国的鼎盛时期。
description.en: The reign of Queen Victoria was the zenith of the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 伊丽莎白二世是大英帝国存续期间的末代君主，见证了帝国的解体。
description.en: Elizabeth II was the last reigning monarch during the existence of the British Empire and witnessed its dissolution.

description.zh-cn: 元朝对南宋发动了长期的征服战争，最终在1279年的厓山海战后彻底消灭了南宋的抵抗力量，统一了中国。
description.en: The Yuan dynasty launched a long war of conquest against the Southern Song dynasty, ultimately extinguishing its resistance after the Battle of Yamen in 1279 and unifying China.

description.zh-cn: 率领明朝军队攻陷元大都，导致元廷退居漠北。
description.en: Led the Ming army to capture the Yuan capital Dadu, causing the Yuan court to retreat to the northern steppes.

description.zh-cn: 1234年，蒙古帝国联合南宋攻灭金朝。
description.en: In 1234, the Mongol Empire, allied with the Southern Song, conquered the Jin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1227年，成吉思汗率军攻灭西夏。
description.en: In 1227, Genghis Khan led his army to conquer the Western Xia.

description.zh-cn: 在厓山海战中率领元军击败南宋军队，导致南宋灭亡。
description.en: Led the Yuan forces to defeat the Southern Song army in the Battle of Yamen, resulting in the fall of the Southern Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在厓山海战战败后，为免被俘受辱，背着年幼的宋帝赵昺投海自尽，导致其死亡。
description.en: After the defeat at the Battle of Yamen, to avoid capture and humiliation, he committed suicide by jumping into the sea with the young Emperor Zhao Bing, causing his death.

description.zh-cn: 在捕鱼儿海战役中率领明军击溃北元主力，使其国势大衰。
description.en: Led the Ming army to defeat the main force of the Northern Yuan at the Battle of Buir Lake, severely weakening its power.

description.zh-cn: 杀害北元皇帝脱古思帖木儿，篡夺汗位，并废除大元国号，导致北元灭亡。
description.en: Assassinated the Northern Yuan emperor Tögüs Temür, usurped the throne, abolished the 'Great Yuan' state title, leading to the fall of the Northern Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 《那年那兔那些事儿》中代表中华民国的“秃子”形象，其来源是蒋中正的光头发型。
description.en: The 'Baldy' character representing the Republic of China in 'Year Hare Affair' was inspired by Chiang Kai-shek's bald hairstyle.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争是《那年那兔那些事儿》中描绘的重要历史事件之一。
description.en: The Korean War is one of the major historical events depicted in 'Year Hare Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 中国共青团中央的官方微博曾发文推荐《那年那兔那些事儿》动画版。
description.en: The official Weibo account of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League of China once posted to recommend the animated version of 'Year Hare Affair'.

description.zh-cn: 该机构作为制作方之一参与了《那年那兔那些事儿》第四季和第五季动画的制作，其加入帮助解决了动画播出时遇到的困难。
description.en: This organization participated as a producer in the fourth and fifth seasons of the 'Year Hare Affair' animation, and its involvement helped resolve difficulties encountered during broadcast.

description.zh-cn: 在一部特别篇动画中，《那年那兔那些事儿》将香港反修例运动的示威者描绘为“蟑螂”的负面形象。
description.en: In a special animated episode, 'Year Hare Affair' depicted the protesters of the Hong Kong Anti-Extradition Law Amendment Bill Movement with the negative image of 'cockroaches'.

description.zh-cn: 其下属的宣教中心联合制作了《那年那兔那些事儿－－抗疫的故事》特别篇，以宣传抗疫和疫苗接种。
description.en: Its affiliated education center co-produced the special episode 'Year Hare Affair -- The Story of Fighting the Epidemic' to promote anti-pandemic efforts and vaccination.

description.zh-cn: 联合制作了《那年那兔那些事儿－－我的父辈》特别篇，为电影《我和我的父辈》作宣传。
description.en: Co-produced the special episode 'Year Hare Affair -- My Forefathers' to promote the film 'My Country, My Parents'.

description.zh-cn: 古巴导弹危机是冷战期间美苏两个超级大国全球对抗的直接产物和高潮。
description.en: The Cuban Missile Crisis was a direct result and climax of the global confrontation between the two superpowers, the US and the USSR, during the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 在美国对古巴实施禁运后，苏联成为古巴的主要经济和军事盟友，并应古巴请求部署了核导弹。
description.en: After the United States imposed an embargo on Cuba, the Soviet Union became its main economic and military ally, deploying nuclear missiles at Cuba's request.

description.zh-cn: 自卡斯特罗政府倒向苏联阵营并与美国断交后，两国关系持续敌对，美国策划了猪猡湾事件并对古巴实施封锁。
description.en: Since the Castro government aligned with the Soviet bloc and broke diplomatic ties with the US, the relationship has been hostile, with the US planning the Bay of Pigs Invasion and imposing a blockade on Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 美国在土耳其和意大利部署PGM-19朱庇特弹道导弹，对苏联构成了严重的核威慑，直接促使赫鲁晓夫采取在古巴部署导弹的反制措施。
description.en: The U.S. deployment of PGM-19 Jupiter ballistic missiles in Turkey and Italy posed a significant nuclear threat to the Soviet Union, directly prompting Khrushchev to take countervailing measures by deploying missiles in Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 失败的猪猡湾事件使卡斯特罗政权感到美国的严重威胁，从而促使其完全倒向并向苏联寻求军事保护。
description.en: The failed Bay of Pigs Invasion made the Castro regime feel severely threatened by the United States, pushing it to fully align with and seek military protection from the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 1962年10月14日，美国U-2侦察机拍摄到苏联在古巴部署中程导弹的照片，证实了导弹的存在，从而触发了为期13天的危机对峙阶段。
description.en: On October 14, 1962, a U.S. U-2 reconnaissance aircraft captured photographic evidence of Soviet medium-range missiles in Cuba, confirming their presence and triggering the 13-day crisis standoff.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪总统于1962年10月22日宣布对古巴实行海军“隔离”（即封锁），以阻止苏联向古巴运送更多进攻性武器。
description.en: President Kennedy announced a naval "quarantine" (blockade) of Cuba on October 22, 1962, to prevent the Soviet Union from delivering more offensive weapons to the island.

description.zh-cn: 1962年10月27日，在古巴的苏联防空部队发射导弹击落了鲁道夫·安德森少校驾驶的U-2侦察机，导致其死亡。
description.en: On October 27, 1962, Soviet air defense units in Cuba fired a surface-to-air missile that shot down the U-2 reconnaissance plane piloted by Major Rudolf Anderson, killing him.

description.zh-cn: 在美军使用深水炸弹逼迫苏联B-59潜艇上浮时，阿尔希波夫作为艇上高级军官否决了发射核鱼雷的提议，避免了危机急剧升级为核战争。
description.en: When U.S. forces used depth charges to force the Soviet submarine B-59 to surface, Arkhipov, as a senior officer on board, vetoed the proposal to launch a nuclear torpedo, preventing the crisis from escalating into a nuclear war.

description.zh-cn: 在危机最紧张的时刻，罗伯特·肯尼迪与苏联大使多勃雷宁进行了秘密会谈，传达了美方愿意秘密撤除土耳其导弹以换取苏联撤出古巴导弹的协议，为危机的和平解决铺平了道路。
description.en: At the height of the crisis, Robert F. Kennedy held a secret meeting with Soviet Ambassador Dobrynin, conveying the U.S. proposal to secretly remove missiles from Turkey in exchange for the Soviet withdrawal of missiles from Cuba, paving the way for a peaceful resolution.

description.zh-cn: 1962年10月28日，赫鲁晓夫通过莫斯科电台宣布，同意拆除在古巴的导弹并将其运回苏联，从而结束了这场危机。
description.en: On October 28, 1962, Khrushchev announced via Radio Moscow that he had agreed to dismantle the missiles in Cuba and return them to the Soviet Union, thus ending the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 危机凸显了超级大国之间直接、快速沟通渠道的缺失。作为其后果之一，美苏两国于1963年建立了“热线”，以在未来危机中进行直接沟通。
description.en: The crisis highlighted the lack of a direct and rapid communication channel between the superpowers. As a result, the Moscow–Washington hotline was established in 1963 to facilitate direct communication in future crises.

description.zh-cn: 作为危机解决方案的一部分，美国承诺不再入侵古巴。这一保证加强了菲德尔·卡斯特罗政权的地位和安全。
description.en: As part of the resolution to the crisis, the United States pledged not to invade Cuba. This guarantee strengthened the position and security of Fidel Castro's regime.

description.zh-cn: 由于其间谍活动暴露，奥列格·潘科夫斯基于1962年10月22日被克格勃逮捕，后被判处死刑并于1963年执行。
description.en: Due to the exposure of his espionage activities, Oleg Penkovsky was arrested by the KGB on October 22, 1962, and was later sentenced to death and executed in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 在危机讨论中，空军上将柯蒂斯·勒迈等军方强硬派主张立即对古巴进行空袭和军事入侵，反对肯尼迪总统倾向的封锁和外交谈判方案。
description.en: During the crisis deliberations, military hawks like Air Force General Curtis LeMay advocated for immediate airstrikes and a military invasion of Cuba, opposing President Kennedy's preferred options of a blockade and diplomatic negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇是彦波潋武鸬鹚草葺不合尊的第四子。
description.en: Emperor Jimmu is the fourth son of Ugayafukiaezu.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇是玉依姬的儿子。
description.en: Emperor Jimmu is the son of Tamayori-hime.

description.zh-cn: 鸬鹚草葺不合尊是火折尊（彦火火出见尊）的儿子。
description.en: Ugayafukiaezu is the son of Hoori (Hikohohodemi no Mikoto).

description.zh-cn: 鸬鹚草葺不合尊是丰玉姬的儿子。
description.en: Ugayafukiaezu is the son of Toyotama-hime.

description.zh-cn: 彦五濑命是神武天皇的兄长。
description.en: Itsuse-no-mikoto is the elder brother of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 稻饭命是神武天皇的兄长。
description.en: Inai-no-mikoto is the elder brother of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 三毛入野命是神武天皇的兄长。
description.en: Mikeirino-no-mikoto is the elder brother of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇于庚申年九月廿四日娶媛蹈鞴五十铃媛命为正妃，后立为皇后。
description.en: Emperor Jimmu married Himetataraisuzuhime-no-mikoto as his principal wife in the year Gengshen and later made her Empress.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇纳吾平津媛为妃。
description.en: Emperor Jimmu took Ahiratsuhime as a consort.

description.zh-cn: 手研耳命是神武天皇的第一皇子。
description.en: Tagishimimi is the first son of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 手研耳命是吾平津媛的儿子。
description.en: Tagishimimi is the son of Ahiratsuhime.

description.zh-cn: 神八井耳命是神武天皇的第二皇子。
description.en: Kamuyai-mimi-no-mikoto is the second son of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 绥靖天皇是神武天皇的第三皇子。
description.en: Emperor Suizei is the third son of Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 媛蹈鞴五十铃媛命是事代主神之女。
description.en: Himetataraisuzuhime-no-mikoto is the daughter of Kotoshironushi.

description.zh-cn: 吾平津媛是火阑降命之女。
description.en: Ahiratsuhime is the daughter of Hoderi.

description.zh-cn: 火阑降命是火折尊的兄长。
description.en: Hoderi is the elder brother of Hoori.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇于甲寅年（时年四十五岁）与诸皇兄、子商讨并率军东征。
description.en: In the year Jia-yin (at age 45), Emperor Jimmu discussed with his brothers and sons and led the eastern expedition.

description.zh-cn: 长髓彦率兵迎战东征的神武天皇。
description.en: Nagasunehiko led troops to fight against Emperor Jimmu during his eastern expedition.

description.zh-cn: 在与长髓彦的激战中，皇兄彦五濑命中流矢，后因此伤势过重而死。
description.en: During a fierce battle with Nagasunehiko, Emperor Jimmu's elder brother Itsuse-no-mikoto was hit by a stray arrow and later died from his wounds.

description.zh-cn: 栉玉饶速日命因长髓彦凶残不改，将其杀死。
description.en: Because Nagasunehiko remained ferocious and unchanged, Nigihayahi-no-mikoto killed him.

description.zh-cn: 栉玉饶速日命在杀死长髓彦后，追随神武天皇。
description.en: After killing Nagasunehiko, Nigihayahi-no-mikoto followed Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇于神武天皇元年正月初一日（辛酉年）在橿原宫即位，建立大和朝廷。
description.en: On the first day of the first month of the first year of his reign (year of Shinyu), Emperor Jimmu ascended to the throne at Kashihara Palace, establishing the Yamato court.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇三十二年，天皇立皇子神渟名川耳尊（绥靖天皇）为皇太子。
description.en: In the 32nd year of his reign, Emperor Jimmu appointed his son, Prince Kamu-nunakawa-mimi (Emperor Suizei), as the Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 手研耳命图谋加害两位弟弟，被神渟名川耳尊（绥靖天皇）杀死。
description.en: Tagishimimi plotted to harm his two younger brothers and was killed by Kamu-nunakawa-mimi (Emperor Suizei).

description.zh-cn: 徐福是秦朝方士，被秦始皇派遣出海寻找长生不老药。
description.en: Xu Fu was a court sorcerer of the Qin Dynasty, dispatched by Emperor Qin Shi Huang to search for the elixir of life.

description.zh-cn: 有一种学说认为，前往日本的徐福就是后来的神武天皇。
description.en: One theory suggests that Xu Fu, who traveled to Japan, later became Emperor Jimmu.

description.zh-cn: 神武天皇诞生于日向国。
description.en: Emperor Jimmu was born in Hyūga Province.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府为统一全国警官教育，合并内政部警官高等学校及浙江省警官学校，成立中央警官学校（中央警察大学前身）。
description.en: The Nationalist Government founded the Central Police Officer Academy (predecessor of Central Police University) by merging the Police Officer High School of the Ministry of the Interior and the Zhejiang Provincial Police Officer School to unify police officer education nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 中央警察大学是中华民国内政部所属的中央三级机构。
description.en: Central Police University is a third-level central agency subordinate to the Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争全面爆发后，中央警官学校校本部随中央政府西迁至重庆。
description.en: After the full-scale outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, the main campus of the Central Police Officer Academy moved west to Chongqing with the central government.

description.zh-cn: 由于国民政府在第二次国共内战中失利，中央警官学校迁台后于1950年1月奉令停办。
description.en: Due to the defeat of the Nationalist Government in the Chinese Civil War, the Central Police Officer Academy was ordered to cease operations in January 1950 after relocating to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中央警官学校于1954年5月奉准在台复校。
description.en: The Central Police Officer Academy was approved to be re-established in Taiwan in May 1954.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央警官学校首任校长。
description.en: Served as the first President of the Central Police Officer Academy.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央警官学校校长。
description.en: Served as the President of the Central Police Officer Academy.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央警察大学第十七任校长。
description.en: Served as the 17th President of Central Police University.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于中央警官学校正科45期。
description.en: Graduated from the 45th regular class of the Central Police Officer Academy.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央警察大学现任校长。
description.en: Serves as the current President of Central Police University.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于中央警官学校正科51期。
description.en: Graduated from the 51st regular class of the Central Police Officer Academy.

description.zh-cn: 中央警官学校于1936年在南京创立，并在抗战胜利后于1945年迁回南京，直至1949年。
description.en: The Central Police Officer Academy was founded in Nanjing in 1936, moved back to Nanjing after the victory of the war in 1945, and remained there until 1949.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，中央警官学校西迁至重庆。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Central Police Officer Academy relocated west to Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 中央警官学校于1977年8月迁校至桃园校区现址。
description.en: The Central Police Officer Academy relocated to its current campus in Taoyuan in August 1977.

description.zh-cn: 应仁之乱的爆发开启了日本的战国时代。
description.en: The outbreak of the Ōnin War marked the beginning of the Sengoku period in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 匿名告密者“John Doe”于2015年向《南德意志报》提供了“巴拿马文件”。
description.en: The anonymous whistleblower 'John Doe' provided the Panama Papers to Süddeutsche Zeitung in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 《南德意志报》在收到文件后，与国际调查记者同盟分享并合作进行调查分析。
description.en: After receiving the documents, Süddeutsche Zeitung shared them with the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists and collaborated on the investigation and analysis.

description.zh-cn: 国际调查记者同盟组织了全球72个国家与地区的116个媒体组织，对“巴拿马文件”进行了一年的整理分析，并于2016年4月3日公布了初步结果。
description.en: The ICIJ organized 116 media organizations from 72 countries and regions to analyze the Panama Papers for a year, publishing the initial findings on April 3, 2016.

description.zh-cn: “巴拿马文件”的泄露揭露了莫萨克·冯赛卡律师行的内部运作和客户信息，对其声誉和业务造成了沉重打击。
description.en: The leak of the Panama Papers exposed the internal operations and client information of Mossack Fonseca, dealing a severe blow to its reputation and business.

description.zh-cn: 文件揭露西格蒙杜尔·戴维·贡劳格松拥有未申报的离岸公司利益，引发了冰岛大规模民众抗议，最终迫使其于2016年4月5日辞去总理职务。
description.en: The papers revealed that Sigmundur Davíð Gunnlaugsson had undeclared interests in an offshore company, sparking mass protests in Iceland that forced his resignation as Prime Minister on April 5, 2016.

description.zh-cn: 文件揭露纳瓦兹·谢里夫的子女拥有离岸公司，导致其接受调查，并于2017年7月28日被巴基斯坦终审法院裁定不再符合担任公职的资格，随后辞去总理职务。
description.en: The papers revealed that Nawaz Sharif's children owned offshore companies, leading to an investigation and his disqualification from public office by Pakistan's Supreme Court on July 28, 2017, after which he resigned as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 胡德华是胡耀邦的三子。
description.en: Hu Dehua is the third son of Hu Yaobang.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府在“巴拿马文件”曝光后，在网络上对相关关键词进行了屏蔽和审查，并删除了相关报道和讨论。
description.en: After the Panama Papers were exposed, the Chinese government blocked and censored related keywords online, and deleted relevant reports and discussions.

position.en: Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

description.zh-cn: 洪磊在外交部例行记者会上代表中国官方回应“巴拿马文件”事件。
description.en: Hong Lei responded to the Panama Papers incident on behalf of the Chinese government at a regular press conference of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 王毅时任中国外交部长。
description.en: Wang Yi was the Chinese Minister of Foreign Affairs at the time.

description.zh-cn: 西格蒙杜尔·戴维·贡劳格松担任冰岛总理，后因“巴拿马文件”事件辞职。
description.en: Sigmundur Davíð Gunnlaugsson served as Prime Minister of Iceland before resigning due to the Panama Papers affair.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·列宁是列宁主义的创始人，他提出了一系列构成该思想体系的政治理论。
description.en: Vladimir Lenin is the founder of Leninism, proposing a series of political theories that constitute this ideology.

description.zh-cn: 列宁主义被认为是马克思主义在帝国主义和无产阶级革命时代的补充和发展。
description.en: Leninism is considered a supplement and development of Marxism in the era of imperialism and proletarian revolution.

description.zh-cn: 列宁主义的革命领导理论基于《共产党宣言》中关于共产党是工人阶级最先进部分的论述。
description.en: The theory of revolutionary leadership in Leninism is based on the Communist Manifesto's description of the Communist Party as the most advanced section of the working class.

description.zh-cn: 在建立社会主义生产方式的过程中，苏维埃革命政权镇压了包括孟什维克在内的政治反对派。
description.en: During the process of establishing the socialist mode of production, the Soviet revolutionary regime suppressed political opponents, including the Mensheviks.

description.zh-cn: 在建立社会主义生产方式的过程中，苏维埃革命政权镇压了包括社会革命党在内的政治反对派。
description.en: During the process of establishing the socialist mode of production, the Soviet revolutionary regime suppressed political opponents, including the Socialist Revolutionary Party.

description.zh-cn: 在建立社会主义生产方式的过程中，苏维埃革命政权镇压了包括左翼社会革命党在内的政治反对派。
description.en: During the process of establishing the socialist mode of production, the Soviet revolutionary regime suppressed political opponents, including the Left Socialist-Revolutionaries.

description.zh-cn: 孟什维克是俄国社会民主工党中的一个主要派系。
description.en: The Mensheviks were a major faction within the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国是苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟中的核心共和国。
description.en: The Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic was the core republic of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.

description.zh-cn: 根据罗莎·卢森堡的观点，列宁的革命思想受到了布朗基主义的影响。
description.en: According to Rosa Luxemburg, Lenin's revolutionary thought was influenced by Blanquism.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林将列宁的思想进行改进和发展，形成了斯大林主义和马克思列宁主义理论体系。
description.en: Stalin improved and developed Lenin's ideas, forming the systems of Stalinism and Marxism-Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 在沙俄政府垮台后，列宁的立场转向不断革命论，与托洛茨基的观点达成一致，并发表了《四月提纲》。
description.en: After the fall of the Tsarist government, Lenin's position shifted towards permanent revolution, aligning with Trotsky's views and leading to the publication of the April Theses.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林将马克思主义和列宁主义系统化，创立了作为苏联官方意识形态的马克思列宁主义。
description.en: Stalin systematized Marxism and Leninism, creating Marxism-Leninism as the official ideology of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 无产阶级专政旨在对资产阶级实行专政，以保卫无产阶级政权。
description.en: The dictatorship of the proletariat aims to exercise dictatorship over the bourgeoisie to defend the proletarian regime.

description.zh-cn: 根据列宁主义理论，无产阶级专政必须由共产党来领导。
description.en: According to Leninist theory, the dictatorship of the proletariat must be led by the Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: “列宁主义”一词于1922年左右被使用后，便正式被纳入苏联共产党的词汇和学说中。
description.en: After the term "Leninism" came into use around 1922, it was formally incorporated into the vocabulary and doctrine of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 关系以离婚告终。
description.en: The relationship ended in divorce.

description.zh-cn: 劳尔·卡斯特罗长期担任菲德尔·卡斯特罗的副手，任古巴共产党中央委员会第二书记、国务委员会第一副主席等职，并最终接替其职务。
description.en: Raúl Castro long served as Fidel Castro's deputy, holding positions such as Second Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Cuba and First Vice President of the Council of State, eventually succeeding him.

description.zh-cn: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗是社会主义古巴的主要缔造者。
description.en: Fidel Castro was a primary founder of socialist Cuba.

description.zh-cn: 切·格瓦拉在七二六运动和古巴革命中是菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导下的重要指挥官。
description.en: Che Guevara was a key commander under Fidel Castro's leadership during the 26th of July Movement and the Cuban Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 古巴革命的胜利导致富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔的独裁政权垮台。
description.en: The victory of the Cuban Revolution led to the collapse of Fulgencio Batista's dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 美国中央情报局策划并支持了猪湾事件，试图推翻卡斯特罗政权。
description.en: The U.S. Central Intelligence Agency planned and supported the Bay of Pigs Invasion in an attempt to overthrow the Castro regime.

description.zh-cn: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导的古巴军队击败了入侵者，成功挫败了猪湾事件。
description.en: Cuban forces led by Fidel Castro defeated the invaders, successfully thwarting the Bay of Pigs Invasion.

description.zh-cn: 中央情报局策划了一系列针对菲德尔·卡斯特罗的暗杀行动。
description.en: The CIA orchestrated a series of assassination attempts against Fidel Castro.

description.zh-cn: 针对菲德尔·卡斯特罗的多次暗杀企图均未成功。
description.en: Multiple assassination attempts against Fidel Castro were unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 在中苏关系恶化时期，菲德尔·卡斯特罗曾公开嘲讽对毛泽东的个人崇拜。
description.en: During the Sino-Soviet split, Fidel Castro publicly mocked the personality cult surrounding Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 王耀武是国民革命军第七十四军的创设人之一。
description.en: Wang Yaowu was one of the founders of the 74th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 1937年淞沪会战时，王耀武所部隶属于俞济时指挥的第74军。1939年6月，王耀武接替俞济时任军长。
description.en: During the Battle of Shanghai in 1937, Wang Yaowu's troops were subordinate to the 74th Corps commanded by Yu Jishi. In June 1939, Wang Yaowu succeeded Yu Jishi as the corps commander.

description.zh-cn: 施中诚于1944年3月接替王耀武担任国民革命军第七十四军军长。
description.en: Shi Zhongcheng succeeded Wang Yaowu as the commander of the 74th Corps of the National Revolutionary Army in March 1944.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，王耀武于济南战役中兵败被俘。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, Wang Yaowu was defeated and captured in the Jinan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，王耀武因其历史问题时常被批斗，并于1968年病逝。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, Wang Yaowu was frequently subjected to struggle sessions due to his past, and he passed away from illness in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 在谭家桥战斗中，王耀武率部以优势兵力围攻寻淮洲部，致使其伤重阵亡。
description.en: In the Battle of Tanjiabridge, Wang Yaowu led his troops with superior forces to besiege Xun Huaizhou's unit, causing his death from severe wounds.

description.zh-cn: 1944年12月中国战区陆军总司令部成立，何应钦为总司令，王耀武时任的第四方面军为其下辖单位之一。
description.en: In December 1944, the Chinese Army General Headquarters was established with He Yingqin as the Commander-in-Chief. The 4th Front Army, commanded by Wang Yaowu at the time, was one of the units under its jurisdiction.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石十分喜爱并信任王耀武，将其视为心腹爱将，并特许其自行决定团以上人事调度。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was very fond of and trusted Wang Yaowu, regarding him as a confidant and beloved general, and granted him special permission to independently decide on personnel arrangements at the regiment level and above.

description.zh-cn: 莱芜战役中国民党军队的惨败，使得王耀武在山东的军事形势转为被动和不利。
description.en: The disastrous defeat of the Nationalist forces in the Laiwu Campaign turned the military situation in Shandong into a passive and unfavorable one for Wang Yaowu.

description.zh-cn: 在莱芜战役期间，李仙洲作为前敌总指挥，在王耀武的指挥序列下。
description.en: During the Laiwu Campaign, Li Xianzhou, as the front-line commander, was under Wang Yaowu's command structure.

description.zh-cn: 莱芜战役中，李仙洲拒不执行王耀武的撤退命令，导致麾下部队被全歼，对王耀武的山东战局造成重大打击。
description.en: In the Laiwu Campaign, Li Xianzhou's refusal to follow Wang Yaowu's retreat order led to the annihilation of his troops, dealing a major blow to Wang Yaowu's military situation in Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 在济南战役中，王耀武所率部队被击败，其本人被俘。
description.en: In the Jinan Campaign, the troops led by Wang Yaowu were defeated, and he himself was captured.

description.zh-cn: 在济南战役中击败并俘虏了王耀武。
description.en: Defeated and captured Wang Yaowu in the Jinan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 王耀武被俘后，毛泽东通过罗瑞卿转告他，肯定其抗日功劳并鼓励其改造。
description.en: After Wang Yaowu was captured, Mao Zedong had Luo Ruiqing convey a message to him, affirming his contributions in the Anti-Japanese War and encouraging him to reform.

description.zh-cn: 王耀武在军界长袖善舞，对戴笠更是全力周旋，以维系良好关系。
description.en: Wang Yaowu was skilled at networking in military circles and made great efforts to maintain a good relationship with Dai Li.

description.zh-cn: 经周恩来介绍，王耀武与吴伯伦结婚。
description.en: Through Zhou Enlai's introduction, Wang Yaowu married Wu Bolun.

description.zh-cn: 在得知王耀武被俘后家中并无余财，只有准备退役后回乡耕田用的两台拖拉机时，陈毅感叹唏嘘不已。
description.en: Upon learning that after Wang Yaowu's capture, his home had no surplus wealth except for two tractors intended for farming after retirement, Chen Yi sighed with emotion.

description.zh-cn: 宗福先是江苏常熟人。
description.en: Zong Fuxian is from Changshu, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 宗福先是中国戏剧家协会理事，并曾任第四届理事会理事。
description.en: Zong Fuxian is a council member of the China Theatre Association and served on its 4th Council.

description.zh-cn: 宗福先是中国作家协会全国委员会委员，并曾任第四、六、七、八、九届全国委员会委员。
description.en: Zong Fuxian is a member of the National Committee of the China Writers Association and served on the 4th, 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th National Committees.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，宗福先是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to page category information, Zong Fuxian is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会是联合国的六大主要机构之一。
description.en: The United Nations Security Council is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会是联合国的六大主要机构之一。
description.en: The United Nations Security Council is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 《联合国宪章》规定了联合国安全理事会的职权，使其负有维持国际和平与安全的责任。
description.en: The Charter of the United Nations defines the powers of the Security Council, charging it with the responsibility for maintaining international peace and security.

description.zh-cn: 该决议通过后，中华民国政府的代表被逐出联合国，失去了其在联合国及安理会的席位。
description.en: Following the adoption of this resolution, the representatives of the Government of the Republic of China were expelled from the United Nations, losing its seat in the UN and the Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 时任俄罗斯总统的叶利钦致信联合国秘书长，通知其俄罗斯联邦继承苏联在安理会及联合国所有其他机关的成员资格。
description.en: Then-President of Russia, Boris Yeltsin, sent a letter to the UN Secretary-General informing him that the Russian Federation was succeeding the Soviet Union's membership in the Security Council and all other UN organs.

description.zh-cn: 独立国家联合体的成员国支持俄罗斯联邦继承苏联在联合国安全理事会的席位。
description.en: The member states of the Commonwealth of Independent States supported the Russian Federation's succession to the Soviet Union's seat on the UN Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会规定其成员国必须有代表常驻联合国，以便随时召开会议。这一规定吸取了国际联盟因无法快速应对危机而失败的教训。
description.en: The United Nations Security Council requires its member states to have permanent representatives at the UN to enable meetings to be convened at any time. This rule was learned from the failures of the League of Nations, which was unable to respond quickly to crises.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会与联合国大会共同选举国际法院的法官。
description.en: The UN Security Council, together with the UN General Assembly, elects the judges of the International Court of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 联合国安全理事会通过了第1973号决议，决定对第一次利比亚内战进行介入。
description.en: The UN Security Council passed Resolution 1973, deciding to intervene in the First Libyan Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文与林子祥于1996年7月17日结婚。
description.en: Sally Yeh and George Lam married on July 17, 1996.

description.zh-cn: 1980年代初，林子祥担任叶蒨文的粤语和声乐老师。
description.en: In the early 1980s, George Lam served as Sally Yeh's Cantonese and vocal coach.

description.zh-cn: 费翔是叶蒨文的初恋对象，两人于1980年初相恋，但恋情因费翔母亲反对而告终。
description.en: Kris Phillips was Sally Yeh's first love. They fell in love in early 1980, but the relationship ended due to opposition from Phillips' mother.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文于1961年9月30日出生于台湾台北市。
description.en: Sally Yeh was born in Taipei, Taiwan on September 30, 1961.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文幼时随家人移民加拿大，并持有该国国籍。
description.en: Sally Yeh immigrated to Canada with her family as a child and holds Canadian citizenship.

description.zh-cn: 叶蒨文出生于台湾，持有中华民国国籍。
description.en: Sally Yeh was born in Taiwan and holds Republic of China citizenship.

description.zh-cn: 袁其烱是叶蒨文的外公。
description.en: Yuan Qijiong is Sally Yeh's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 林德信是林子祥的儿子。
description.en: Alex Lam is the son of George Lam.

description.zh-cn: 吴正元是林子祥的前妻，两人于1994年离婚。
description.en: Ng Ching-Yuen is George Lam's ex-wife; they divorced in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 时任华纳音乐(香港)总经理的吴正元安排其丈夫林子祥担任叶蒨文的粤语和声乐老师，开启了叶蒨文在香港的歌唱事业。
description.en: As the general manager of Warner Music Hong Kong, Ng Ching-Yuen arranged for her husband George Lam to be Sally Yeh's Cantonese and vocal coach, which launched Yeh's singing career in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 1980年，李泰祥指导叶蒨文灌录其首张国语专辑《春天的浮雕》，帮助其作为歌手出道。
description.en: In 1980, Li Tai-hsiang guided Sally Yeh in recording her debut Mandarin album 'Spring's Relief Sculpture', helping her debut as a singer.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，杨凡引荐叶蒨文与林子祥合唱歌曲《重逢》，开启了她在香港发展的契机。
description.en: In 1983, Yonfan introduced Sally Yeh to collaborate with George Lam on the song 'Reunion', creating an opportunity for her career development in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 林子祥为叶蒨文创作了其首支粤语歌曲《零时十分》，并担任其多张专辑的监制，对她在香港乐坛的成功起到了关键推动作用。
description.en: George Lam composed Sally Yeh's first Cantonese song 'Ten Past Midnight' and served as the producer for several of her albums, playing a key role in her success in the Hong Kong music industry.

description.zh-cn: 此歌曲风靡全港，为叶蒨文赢得了包括十大劲歌金曲“金曲金奖”在内的12项乐坛大奖，将其歌唱事业推向全新高峰。
description.en: This song became immensely popular throughout Hong Kong, winning Sally Yeh 12 music awards, including the JSG Gold Song Gold Award, and propelling her singing career to a new peak.

description.zh-cn: 此曲随电视剧《京城四少》播出后在两岸三地广为流传，使叶蒨文在台湾及整个华语市场声名大噪，奠定了其华语歌坛天后级的地位。
description.en: Following its broadcast with the TV series 'The Four Brothers of Peking', this song became widely popular across the Greater China region, greatly boosting Sally Yeh's fame in Taiwan and the broader Chinese-speaking market, and establishing her status as a diva in the Mandopop scene.

description.zh-cn: 导演贾樟柯表示叶蒨文的歌曲对他而言是一个时代的象征，并将其歌曲《珍重》用于电影《山河故人》中以表达情感。
description.en: Director Jia Zhangke stated that Sally Yeh's songs symbolize an era for him and used her song 'Treasure' in his film 'Mountains May Depart' to express emotion.

description.zh-cn: 李成梁出生于辽宁铁岭。
description.en: Li Chengliang was born in Tieling, Liaoning.

description.zh-cn: 李成梁是明朝后期的重要将领。
description.en: Li Chengliang was an important general in the late Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1583年2月，李成梁再度发兵攻打阿台所在的古勒寨，阿台中箭身亡。
description.en: In February 1583, Li Chengliang once again attacked Gure Fortress where Atai was located, and Atai was killed by an arrow.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤之父塔克世在李成梁1583年进攻阿台的战斗中身亡，据称此为李成梁与尼堪外兰故意为之。
description.en: Nurhaci's father, Taksi, was killed during Li Chengliang's attack on Atai in 1583. It is alleged that this was an intentional act by Li Chengliang and Nikan Wailan.

description.zh-cn: 1582年3月，李成梁派遣部将在镇夷堡击杀蒙古首领速把亥。
description.en: In March 1582, Li Chengliang dispatched his subordinate to kill the Mongol leader Subohai at Zhenyi Fortress.

description.zh-cn: 1583年12月，李成梁与巡抚李松合谋斩杀叶赫部首领清佳努。
description.en: In December 1583, Li Chengliang conspired with Governor Li Song to kill Qingjianu, a leader of the Yehe tribe.

description.zh-cn: 1583年12月，李成梁与巡抚李松合谋斩杀叶赫部首领杨吉努。
description.en: In December 1583, Li Chengliang conspired with Governor Li Song to kill Yangjinu, a leader of the Yehe tribe.

description.zh-cn: 因父亲塔克世在李成梁的战斗中被杀，努尔哈赤视李成梁为不共戴天之仇，此事成为后金叛明“七大恨”之一。
description.en: Due to his father Taksi's death in a battle involving Li Chengliang, Nurhaci considered Li an irreconcilable enemy. This incident became one of the 'Seven Great Grievances' for the Later Jin's rebellion against the Ming.

description.zh-cn: 努尔哈赤于1618年以“七大恨”为由，正式对明朝宣战。
description.en: In 1618, Nurhaci formally declared war on the Ming Dynasty, citing the 'Seven Great Grievances'.

description.zh-cn: 1601年，大学士沈一贯力荐已被罢官的李成梁复起，再镇辽东。
description.en: In 1601, Grand Secretary Shen Yiguan strongly recommended the dismissed Li Chengliang to be reappointed to guard Liaodong.

description.zh-cn: 熊廷弼在接手辽东防务后，严厉批评李成梁晚年的弃地等政策，并上疏弹劾，指出其罪可至死。
description.en: After taking over the defense of Liaodong, Xiong Tingbi severely criticized Li Chengliang's late-career policies, such as abandoning territory, and impeached him, stating his crimes were punishable by death.

description.zh-cn: 宋一韩等廷臣曾弹劾李成梁对努尔哈赤的姑息政策。
description.en: Court officials like Song Yihan impeached Li Chengliang for his policy of appeasement towards Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏是中华人民共和国教育部部长，清华大学的主管官员之一。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng is the Minister of Education of the People's Republic of China and one of the officials in charge of Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 李路明自2023年12月起担任清华大学校长。
description.en: Li Luming has been serving as the President of Tsinghua University since December 2023.

description.zh-cn: 邱勇曾任清华大学校长（2015-2022），后任党委书记。
description.en: Qiu Yong served as President of Tsinghua University (2015-2022) and later became the Party Committee Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 清政府外务部与学部上奏设立“游美学务处”并附设“肄业馆”。
description.en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Education of the Qing government proposed the establishment of the 'Office for Students to the USA' and its attached preparatory school.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，清华大学、北京大学、南开大学南迁长沙，组建了国立长沙临时大学。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Tsinghua University, Peking University, and Nankai University moved south to Changsha to form the National Changsha Provisional University.

description.zh-cn: 1952年的高校院系调整导致清华大学的文、法、理、农、航天等多个院系被迁出，使其从综合性大学转变为多科性工业大学，阻碍了其综合性发展。
description.en: The 1952 reorganization of higher education led to the relocation of many departments from Tsinghua University, including humanities, law, science, agriculture, and aeronautics, transforming it from a comprehensive university into a polytechnic one, thus hindering its comprehensive development.

description.zh-cn: 黑石集团捐助成立清华大学苏世民书院及奖学金。
description.en: The Blackstone Group donated to establish Schwarzman College and its scholarship program at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 梅贻琦长期担任国立清华大学校长，对学校建设贡献巨大。
description.en: Mei Yiqi served as the president of National Tsing Hua University for a long period, making significant contributions to the university's development.

description.zh-cn: 蒯大富是清华大学井冈山兵团的领导者。
description.en: Kuai Dafu was the leader of the Jinggangshan Corps of Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件中，清华大学有学生死伤，学校教学活动中断，随后进行了长期的清查清理工作。
description.en: During the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, Tsinghua University students were killed and injured, academic activities were interrupted, and a long-term period of investigation and cleanup followed.

description.zh-cn: 在莫斯科学习哲学期间，巴枯宁与别林斯基等人结为友人。
description.en: During his philosophy studies in Moscow, Bakunin befriended Vissarion Belinsky and others.

description.zh-cn: 巴枯宁系统学习了德国观念论哲学，并逐渐深受黑格尔影响，还翻译了他的著作。
description.en: Bakunin systematically studied German Idealist philosophy and became increasingly influenced by Hegel, also translating his works.

description.zh-cn: 1844年巴枯宁在巴黎结识了普鲁东，后者对他产生了巨大影响。
description.en: In 1844, Bakunin met Proudhon in Paris, who greatly impressed and influenced him.

description.zh-cn: 在1872年海牙大会后，马克思因认为巴枯宁在国际工人协会内组建秘密组织而将他开除出协会。
description.en: After the Hague Congress of 1872, Marx had Bakunin expelled from the International, accusing him of forming a secret society within it.

description.zh-cn: 因其激进倾向，俄国政府命令其归国，遭拒后没收其财产。后被引渡回俄国，先后囚禁于彼得保罗要塞和什利谢利堡要塞，并于1857年被流放至西伯利亚。
description.en: Due to his radicalism, the Russian government ordered him to return, and confiscated his property upon refusal. He was later extradited to Russia, imprisoned in the Peter and Paul Fortress and Shlisselburg Fortress, and exiled to Siberia in 1857.

description.zh-cn: 1849年在开姆尼茨被捕后，被萨克森王国当局判处死刑，后减为无期徒刑并于1850年6月引渡至奥地利。
description.en: After being captured in Chemnitz in 1849, he was condemned to death by the government of Saxony. The sentence was later commuted to life imprisonment, and he was handed over to the Austrian authorities in June 1850.

description.zh-cn: 从萨克森引渡后，被奥地利当局再次判处死刑，后减为无期徒刑并于1851年5月引渡至俄罗斯。
description.en: After being extradited from Saxony, he received another death sentence from the Austrian authorities, which was also commuted to life imprisonment. He was finally handed over to Russian authorities in May 1851.

description.zh-cn: 巴枯宁曾参与1848年在捷克布拉格的叛乱。
description.en: Bakunin participated in the 1848 insurrection in Prague, Czech lands.

description.zh-cn: 屠格涅夫是小说《罗亭》的作者。
description.en: Turgenev is the author of the novel 'Rudin'.

description.zh-cn: 俄国作家屠格涅夫以其朋友巴枯宁为原型创作了小说《罗亭》。
description.en: Russian writer Ivan Turgenev used his friend Bakunin as the prototype for the protagonist of his novel 'Rudin'.

description.zh-cn: 巴枯宁于1840年在柏林结识屠格涅夫，两人成为朋友。
description.en: Bakunin met Turgenev in Berlin in 1840, and they became friends.

description.zh-cn: 巴枯宁与赫尔岑是朋友，曾向其借钱，并在伦敦一同为《钟》杂志撰稿。
description.en: Bakunin and Herzen were friends; Bakunin borrowed money from him, and they collaborated on the journal 'Kolokol' (The Bell) in London.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党是泛蓝阵营的核心政党。
description.en: The Kuomintang is the core party of the Pan-Blue Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 亲民党是泛蓝阵营的成员党之一。
description.en: The People First Party is one of the member parties of the Pan-Blue Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 新党是泛蓝阵营的成员党之一。
description.en: The New Party is one of the member parties of the Pan-Blue Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 泛蓝的主要竞争对手为泛绿。
description.en: The main competitor of the Pan-Blue Coalition is the Pan-Green Coalition.

description.zh-cn: 在媒体上大力宣传“泛蓝”一词，使其广为接受使用。
description.en: Strongly promoted the term 'Pan-Blue' in the media, leading to its widespread acceptance and use.

description.zh-cn: 该次选举后，台湾政坛开始使用“泛蓝”一词来指代国民党及其意识形态相近的盟友。
description.en: After this election, the term 'Pan-Blue' began to be used in Taiwanese politics to refer to the KMT and its ideologically similar allies.

description.zh-cn: 原为中国国民党内的次级团体，后于1994年脱离国民党。
description.en: Originally a sub-group within the Kuomintang, it split from the party in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 新国民党连线脱离国民党后，成立了新党。
description.en: After splitting from the Kuomintang, the New Kuomintang Alliance founded the New Party.

description.zh-cn: 于2015年宣布脱离国民党并建立民国党。
description.en: Announced her departure from the KMT and established the Minkuotang in 2015.

description.zh-cn: 此次及后续泛蓝领袖对中国大陆的访问，使得泛蓝阵营大幅降低反共色彩，并转而主张两岸关系和平发展。
description.en: This and subsequent visits by Pan-Blue leaders to mainland China led the coalition to significantly tone down its anti-communist stance and instead advocate for peaceful development of cross-strait relations.

description.zh-cn: 作为亲民党主席，是2005年陆续访问中国大陆的泛蓝领袖之一。
description.en: As chairman of the People First Party, he was one of the Pan-Blue leaders who visited mainland China in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 作为新党主席，是2005年陆续访问中国大陆的泛蓝领袖之一。
description.en: As chairman of the New Party, he was one of the Pan-Blue leaders who visited mainland China in 2005.

description.zh-cn: 与台湾民众党进行总统选举整合协商，但最终破局。
description.en: Engaged in negotiations with the Taiwan People's Party for a joint presidential ticket, but the talks ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 与中国国民党进行总统选举整合协商，但最终破局。
description.en: Engaged in negotiations with the Kuomintang for a joint presidential ticket, but the talks ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 为进行“蓝白合”总统选举整合进行谈判，但最终破局。
description.en: Met to negotiate a 'Blue-White Coalition' for a joint presidential ticket, but the talks ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 夺权运动是文化大革命期间发生的一系列事件。
description.en: The Seizure of Power movement was a series of events that occurred during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在夺权运动过程中，各地建立了“革命委员会”以代替原先的党政机关。
description.en: During the Seizure of Power movement, 'Revolutionary Committees' were established in various places to replace the original party and government organs.

description.zh-cn: 夺权斗争给社会各方面带来严重损失，据官方数据，社会总产值1967年比上年下降9.9%、1968年比上年再降4.7%。
description.en: The power seizure struggles brought severe losses to all aspects of society. According to official data, the gross social product decreased by 9.9% in 1967 compared to the previous year, and by another 4.7% in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 一月风暴事件发生在上海。
description.en: The January Storm event took place in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央是《关于人民解放军坚决支持革命左派群众的决定》的联合发布方之一。
description.en: The CPC Central Committee was one of the joint issuers of the 'Decision on the People's Liberation Army's Resolute Support for the Revolutionary Leftist Masses'.

description.zh-cn: 国务院是《关于人民解放军坚决支持革命左派群众的决定》的联合发布方之一。
description.en: The State Council was one of the joint issuers of the 'Decision on the People's Liberation Army's Resolute Support for the Revolutionary Leftist Masses'.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委是《关于人民解放军坚决支持革命左派群众的决定》的联合发布方之一。
description.en: The Central Military Commission was one of the joint issuers of the 'Decision on the People's Liberation Army's Resolute Support for the Revolutionary Leftist Masses'.

description.zh-cn: 中央文革小组是《关于人民解放军坚决支持革命左派群众的决定》的联合发布方之一。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution Group was one of the joint issuers of the 'Decision on the People's Liberation Army's Resolute Support for the Revolutionary Leftist Masses'.

description.zh-cn: 该决定命令军队正式介入地方文革，支持革命左派群众。
description.en: This decision ordered the military to formally intervene in the local Cultural Revolution and support the revolutionary leftist masses.

description.zh-cn: 1967年3月，中央军委发出了关于“三支两军”任务的决定。
description.en: In March 1967, the Central Military Commission issued a decision regarding the 'Three Supports and Two Militaries' tasks.

description.zh-cn: “三支两军”任务以“支左”为中心，即支持地方的“革命左派”（造反派）。
description.en: The 'Three Supports and Two Militaries' tasks were centered on 'supporting the left,' which meant supporting the local 'revolutionary leftists' (rebel factions).

description.zh-cn: 在夺权运动中，林彪集团支持的造反派在各地乘机膨胀。
description.en: During the Seizure of Power movement, the rebel factions supported by the Lin Biao Clique took the opportunity to expand in various places.

description.zh-cn: 在夺权运动中，中央文革小组支持造反派红卫兵，以打击党内的“走资派”，这些造反派红卫兵在各地乘机膨胀。
description.en: During the Seizure of Power movement, the Central Cultural Revolution Group supported the rebel Red Guards to attack the 'capitalist roaders' within the party, and these factions took the opportunity to expand in various places.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥是唆鲁禾帖尼的儿子。
description.en: Ariq Böke was the son of Sorghaghtani Beki.

description.zh-cn: 元宪宗蒙哥是唆鲁禾帖尼的儿子。
description.en: Möngke Khan was the son of Sorghaghtani Beki.

description.zh-cn: 元世祖忽必烈是拖雷的第四子。
description.en: Kublai Khan was the fourth son of Tolui.

description.zh-cn: 旭烈兀是唆鲁禾帖尼的儿子。
description.en: Hulagu Khan was the son of Sorghaghtani Beki.

description.zh-cn: 唆鲁禾帖尼是拖雷的正妻。
description.en: Sorghaghtani Beki was the principal wife of Tolui.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥是元宪宗蒙哥的弟弟。
description.en: Ariq Böke was the younger brother of Möngke Khan.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥是旭烈兀的弟弟。
description.en: Ariq Böke was the younger brother of Hulagu Khan.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈在内战中击败并俘虏了阿里不哥，阿里不哥于两年后去世，可能被忽必烈毒杀。
description.en: Kublai Khan defeated and captured Ariq Böke in the civil war. Ariq Böke died two years later, possibly poisoned by Kublai.

description.zh-cn: 1260年4月，阿里不哥在哈拉和林被蒙古本土贵族通过库力台大会推举为大蒙古国大汗。
description.en: In April 1260, Ariq Böke was elected as the Great Khan of the Mongol Empire by the Mongol nobility in a Kurultai held in Karakorum.

description.zh-cn: 阿里不哥素来反对其兄长忽必烈的汉化政策。
description.en: Ariq Böke had long opposed his brother Kublai's Sinicization policies.

description.zh-cn: 忽必烈推行汉化政策，这成为其与阿里不哥矛盾的焦点之一。
description.en: Kublai Khan promoted Sinicization policies, which became one of the focal points of his conflict with Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 药木忽儿是阿里不哥的儿子。
description.en: Yomuqur was a son of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 明里帖木儿是阿里不哥的儿子。
description.en: Melik-temür was a son of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 乃剌忽不花是阿里不哥的儿子。
description.en: Nairiqu-buqa was a son of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 阿儿巴是阿里不哥的玄孙。
description.en: Arpa Ke'un was a great-great-grandson of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 阿儿巴曾短暂地被拥立为伊儿汗。
description.en: Arpa Ke'un was briefly enthroned as the Ilkhan.

description.zh-cn: 也速迭尔是阿里不哥的后裔。
description.en: Yesüder was a descendant of Ariq Böke.

description.zh-cn: 天元帝是北元的皇帝。
description.en: Tögüs Temür was an emperor of the Northern Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 国务委员是中华人民共和国国务院的组成人员。
description.en: The State Councilor is a member of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国务委员是国务院常务会议的组成人员。
description.en: The State Councilor is a member of the Standing Committee of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务委员作为国务院组成人员，是国务院全体会议的成员。
description.en: As a member of the State Council, the State Councilor is a member of the Plenary Meeting of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务委员的人选，由国务院总理提名。
description.en: Candidates for State Councilor are nominated by the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国务委员的人选，经全国人民代表大会投票决定。
description.en: Candidates for State Councilor are decided by a vote of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 国务委员由国家主席根据全国人大会议的决定任命。
description.en: State Councilors are appointed by the President of the People's Republic of China based on the decision of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李尚福出生于四川省成都市。
description.en: Li Shangfu was born in Chengdu, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 1982年毕业于中国人民解放军国防科技大学。
description.en: Graduated from the National University of Defense Technology in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 李尚福是重庆大学的校友。
description.en: Li Shangfu is an alumnus of Chongqing University.

description.zh-cn: 李尚福是李绍珠的儿子。
description.en: Li Shangfu is the son of Li Shaozhu.

description.zh-cn: 李尚福接替魏凤和出任国防部部长。
description.en: Li Shangfu succeeded Wei Fenghe as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 在李尚福被免职后，董军接任国防部部长职务。
description.en: After Li Shangfu was removed from office, Dong Jun succeeded him as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 李尚福接替尚宏出任总装备部司令部参谋长。
description.en: Li Shangfu succeeded Shang Hong as Chief of Staff of the PLA General Armaments Department Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 张学良下令以武力强行收回中东铁路，直接引发了中东路事件。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang ordered the forceful takeover of the Chinese Eastern Railway, directly triggering the Sino-Soviet conflict.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正支持张学良对苏联采取强硬立场，并承诺中央政府将提供军事和财政援助。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek supported Zhang Xueliang's hardline stance against the Soviet Union and promised military and financial aid from the central government.

description.zh-cn: 因中东铁路权益问题爆发武装冲突，并一度断绝外交关系。
description.en: Engaged in an armed conflict over the rights of the Chinese Eastern Railway and temporarily severed diplomatic relations.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华民国的盟友，俄国白军参与了对抗苏联的战斗。
description.en: As an ally of the Republic of China, the White Russian Army participated in the fighting against the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 东北军是由张学良统帅的地方军队。
description.en: The Northeastern Army was the regional military force commanded by Zhang Xueliang.

description.zh-cn: 该议定书的签订恢复了苏联在中东铁路的全部权益。
description.en: The signing of this protocol restored all of the Soviet Union's rights and interests on the Chinese Eastern Railway.

description.zh-cn: 南京国民政府不承认由地方代表蔡运升签署的《伯力议定书》，认为其超越权限。
description.en: The Nanjing Nationalist Government refused to recognize the Khabarovsk Protocol signed by local representative Cai Yunsheng, deeming it to have exceeded his authority.

description.zh-cn: 中东路事件后，苏联军队继续占领了整个黑瞎子岛。
description.en: After the Sino-Soviet conflict, Soviet troops continued to occupy the entire Bolshoy Ussuriysky Island (Heixiazi Island).

description.zh-cn: 东北军在中东路事件中的迅速溃败，暴露了其军事上的虚弱，坚定了日本关东军发动侵略的决心。
description.en: The rapid collapse of the Northeastern Army in the Sino-Soviet conflict exposed its military weakness, strengthening the Japanese Kwantung Army's resolve to launch an invasion.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框内容，中华全国工商业联合会是河北省工商业联合会的上级机构。
description.en: According to the infobox, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce is the superior organization of the Hebei Federation of Industry and Commerce.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框内容，中国共产党河北省委员会是河北省工商业联合会的中共上级单位。
description.en: According to the infobox, the Hebei Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China is the superior CPC unit of the Hebei Federation of Industry and Commerce.

description.zh-cn: 河北省工商业联合会是由中国共产党领导的组织。
description.en: The Hebei Federation of Industry and Commerce is an organization led by the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王雱是王安石的长子。
description.en: Wang Pang is the eldest son of Wang Anshi.

description.zh-cn: 蔡卞在治平年间王安石居于江宁时，成为其学生。
description.en: Cai Bian became Wang Anshi's student when Wang was living in Jiangning during the Zhiping era.

description.zh-cn: 蔡卞娶王安石次女为妻，是王安石的女婿。
description.en: Cai Bian married Wang Anshi's second daughter, becoming his son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 欧阳修赏识王安石的才华，并多次向朝廷举荐他。
description.en: Ouyang Xiu appreciated Wang Anshi's talent and recommended him to the court on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 熙宁变法的推行引发了朝廷内部新旧两派的激烈冲突。
description.en: The implementation of the Xining Reforms triggered intense conflicts between the new and old factions within the court.

description.zh-cn: 韩琦上疏反对王安石推行的青苗法，两人政见不合。
description.en: Han Qi submitted a memorial opposing the Green Sprouts Law implemented by Wang Anshi, and the two had political disagreements.

description.zh-cn: 熙宁三年二月，韩琦上奏反对青苗法的实施，认为其违背了“抑兼并、济困乏”的初衷。
description.en: In the second month of the third year of Xining (1070), Han Qi submitted a memorial opposing the implementation of the Green Sprouts Law, arguing that it contradicted the original intention of 'suppressing annexation and aiding the needy'.

description.zh-cn: 苏洵认为王安石“不近人情”，并在王安石母丧时作《辨奸论》攻击他。
description.en: Su Xun considered Wang Anshi 'inhumane' and attacked him by writing 'Discerning the Traitorous' during the mourning period for Wang's mother.

description.zh-cn: 吕惠卿原是王安石的得力助手，后因权力之争与王安石决裂，成为政敌。
description.en: Lu Huiqing was originally Wang Anshi's capable assistant, but later broke with him over power struggles and became a political enemy.

position.en: Joint Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery

description.zh-cn: 王安石两次被任命为宰相。
description.en: Wang Anshi was appointed chancellor twice.

description.zh-cn: 熙宁二年二月，王安石被任命为参知政事，开始推行变法。
description.en: In the second month of the second year of Xining (1069), Wang Anshi was appointed Associate Manager of Affairs and began to implement the reforms.

description.zh-cn: 王安石支持王韶收复河湟的计划，并帮助其获得朝廷任命，推动熙河开边。
description.en: Wang Anshi supported Wang Shao's plan to recapture the Hehuang region and helped him obtain a court appointment, promoting the Xihe campaign.

description.zh-cn: 王韶向神宗上《平戎三策》，是熙河开边的主要提议者和执行者。
description.en: Wang Shao submitted the 'Three Strategies for Pacifying the Barbarians' to Emperor Shenzong, and was the main proposer and executor of the Xihe campaign.

description.zh-cn: 作为宰相，王安石是熙河开边政策的重要支持者和推动者。
description.en: As chancellor, Wang Anshi was a key supporter and promoter of the Xihe campaign policy.

description.zh-cn: 在王安石任参知政事四个月后，时任御史中丞的吕诲上疏弹劾王安石“奸诈十事”。
description.en: Four months after Wang Anshi's appointment as Associate Manager of Affairs, Censor-in-chief Lü Hui submitted a memorial impeaching Wang Anshi on 'ten counts of treachery'.

description.zh-cn: 林清祥是人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: Lim Chin Siong was one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 拉惹勒南是人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: S. Rajaratnam was one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 吴庆瑞是人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: Goh Keng Swee was one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 杜进才是人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: Toh Chin Chye was one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 蒂凡那是人民行动党的创始成员之一。
description.en: C. V. Devan Nair was one of the founding members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 方水双是人民行动党的创始成员和第一届中央委员之一。
description.en: Fong Swee Suan was one of the founding members and first Central Executive Committee members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 李玉成是人民行动党的创始成员和第一届中央委员之一。
description.en: Lee Gek Seng was one of the founding members and first Central Executive Committee members of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 人民行动党青年团是人民行动党的青年组织。
description.en: The Young PAP is the youth wing of the People's Action Party.

description.zh-cn: 人民行动党自成立起即为社会党国际成员，直至1976年被开除。
description.en: The People's Action Party was a member of the Socialist International from its founding until its expulsion in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 在英国工党和荷兰工党的动议下，社会党国际于1976年将人民行动党开除，原因是不认同其高压统治方式和右倾政策。
description.en: At the initiative of the British Labour Party and the Dutch Labour Party, the Socialist International expelled the People's Action Party in 1976 due to disagreement with its authoritarian rule and right-leaning policies.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡独立后，蒂凡那于1966年3月18日将原人民行动党在马来西亚的组织改组为民主行动党。
description.en: After Singapore's independence, C. V. Devan Nair reorganized the former Malaysian branch of the People's Action Party into the Democratic Action Party on March 18, 1966.

description.zh-cn: 人民行动党在新加坡独立后实行强烈的反共政策，并与马来西亚合作清剿马来亚共产党。
description.en: After Singapore's independence, the People's Action Party implemented a strong anti-communist policy and cooperated with Malaysia to suppress the Malayan Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清出生于吉林公主岭。
description.en: Ma Junqing was born in Gongzhuling, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清毕业于吉林大学经济管理专业，获研究生学历和经济学博士学位。
description.en: Ma Junqing graduated from Jilin University with a major in Economic Management, holding a postgraduate degree and a Ph.D. in Economics.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清于1976年3月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Ma Junqing joined the Communist Party of China in March 1976.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月19日，马俊清当选为吉林省人民代表大会常务委员会副主任。
description.en: On January 19, 2017, Ma Junqing was elected as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jilin Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清与竺延风在吉林省政界有多重交集。2012年，竺延风是马俊清担任吉林省人民政府常务副省长一职上的前任。2015年，马俊清则接替竺延风出任中国共产党吉林省委员会专职副书记。
description.en: Ma Junqing and Zhu Yanfeng had multiple intersections in Jilin provincial politics. In 2012, Zhu Yanfeng was Ma Junqing's predecessor as Executive Vice Governor of the Jilin Provincial People's Government. In 2015, Ma Junqing succeeded Zhu Yanfeng as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 高广滨曾两次接替马俊清。2000年12月，高广滨接替马俊清出任松原市人民政府市长。2017年2月，高广滨接替马俊清出任中国共产党吉林省委员会专职副书记。
description.en: Gao Guangbin succeeded Ma Junqing twice. In December 2000, Gao Guangbin succeeded Ma Junqing as the Mayor of the Songyuan Municipal People's Government. In February 2017, Gao Guangbin succeeded Ma Junqing as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清接替李申学出任中国共产党吉林省委员会秘书长。
description.en: Ma Junqing succeeded Li Shenxue as the Secretary-General of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 房俐接替马俊清出任中国共产党吉林省委员会秘书长。
description.en: Fang Li succeeded Ma Junqing as the Secretary-General of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清接替邓凯出任中国共产党吉林省委员会宣传部部长。
description.en: Ma Junqing succeeded Deng Kai as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 荀凤栖接替马俊清出任中国共产党吉林省委员会宣传部部长；此前，马俊清接替荀凤栖出任中国共产党四平市委员会书记。
description.en: Xun Fengqi succeeded Ma Junqing as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the CCP; previously, Ma Junqing had succeeded Xun Fengqi as the Secretary of the Siping Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 张元富接替马俊清出任中国共产党四平市委员会书记。
description.en: Zhang Yuanfu succeeded Ma Junqing as the Secretary of the Siping Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清接替矫正中出任吉林省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: Ma Junqing succeeded Jiao Zhengzhong as the Secretary-General of the Jilin Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 刘润璞接替马俊清出任吉林省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: Liu Runpu succeeded Ma Junqing as the Secretary-General of the Jilin Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 马俊清接替王儒林出任中国共产主义青年团吉林省委员会书记。
description.en: Ma Junqing succeeded Wang Rulin as the Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League of China.

description.zh-cn: 金振吉接替马俊清出任中国共产主义青年团吉林省委员会书记。
description.en: Jin Zhenji succeeded Ma Junqing as the Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明于1952年1月8日出生于上海。
description.en: Chen Ziming was born in Shanghai on January 8, 1952.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明于2014年10月21日因胰腺癌在北京逝世。
description.en: Chen Ziming died of pancreatic cancer in Beijing on October 21, 2014.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明积极参加了七八十年代的多次民主运动。
description.en: Chen Ziming actively participated in multiple democracy movements in the 1970s and 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 1968年在北京八中初中毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Beijing No. 8 Middle School in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 1968年至1974年，陈子明在内蒙古阿巴嘎旗插队六年。
description.en: From 1968 to 1974, Chen Ziming worked as a sent-down youth in Abag Banner, Inner Mongolia for six years.

description.zh-cn: 1974年作为工农兵学员就读于北京化工学院，1976年被开除学籍。
description.en: Enrolled in Beijing Institute of Chemical Technology as a Worker-Peasant-Soldier student in 1974 and was expelled in 1976.

description.zh-cn: 因被发现在信件中批评时政，陈子明于1976年4月2日被北京化工学院开除学籍。
description.en: Chen Ziming was expelled from Beijing Institute of Chemical Technology on April 2, 1976, after being discovered criticizing politics in his letters.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明于1976年4月2日被开除共青团团籍。
description.en: Chen Ziming was expelled from the Communist Youth League of China on April 2, 1976.

description.zh-cn: 1978年，陈子明参与了北京的西单民主墙运动。
description.en: In 1978, Chen Ziming participated in the Democracy Wall movement in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，陈子明担任《北京之春》杂志的编辑。
description.en: In 1979, Chen Ziming served as an editor for the 'Beijing Spring' magazine.

description.zh-cn: 1980年考入中国科学技术大学研究生院学习分子生物学专业。
description.en: In 1980, Chen Ziming was admitted to the Graduate School of the University of Science and Technology of China to study molecular biology.

position.zh-cn: 研究生院研究生会主席
position.en: Chairman of the Graduate Student Union

description.zh-cn: 在中国科学技术大学就读期间，陈子明担任该校研究生院的研究生会主席。
description.en: While studying at the University of Science and Technology of China, Chen Ziming served as the chairman of the graduate student union of its graduate school.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明与王军涛在民主运动中长期合作，共同参与竞选、创办企业和研究所。
