description.en: Chen Ziming and Wang Juntao had a long-term collaboration in the democracy movement, jointly participating in elections, and founding enterprises and research institutes.

description.zh-cn: 1980年末，陈子明与胡平等一同当选北京市海淀区人大代表。2014年陈子明抵美治病时，胡平前往机场迎接。
description.en: In late 1980, Chen Ziming, Hu Ping, and others were elected as deputies to the Haidian District People's Congress in Beijing. In 2014, when Chen Ziming arrived in the US for medical treatment, Hu Ping went to the airport to greet him.

description.zh-cn: 1988年3月，陈子明担任《经济学周报》的总经理。
description.en: In March 1988, Chen Ziming became the general manager of Economics Weekly.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明与何家栋在《经济学周报》共事，并于2004年共同创办“改造与建设”网站。
description.en: Chen Ziming worked with He Jiadong at Economics Weekly and they co-founded the website 'Gaizao Yu Jianshe' in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，陈子明被指为“幕后黑手”而受到通缉，并于1991年被判处13年有期徒刑。
description.en: After the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, Chen Ziming was labeled a 'black hand', wanted by the authorities, and sentenced to 13 years in prison in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 根据陈子明在1992年出版的书籍，他指控王丹在狱中为近五百人作证时，对他作出的三个证言均有记忆错误，是违心之言。
description.en: According to a book published by Chen Ziming in 1992, he accused Wang Dan of giving three factually incorrect and insincere testimonies against him while testifying against nearly 500 people in prison.

description.zh-cn: 2013年12月20日，王丹在其社交媒体上透露其友人陈子明患癌症晚期并已住院治疗。
description.en: On December 20, 2013, Wang Dan revealed on his social media that his friend Chen Ziming was in the late stage of cancer and had been hospitalized for treatment.

description.zh-cn: 1997年1月，将陈子明选为第十一届杰出民主人士。
description.en: In January 1997, Chen Ziming was selected as the 11th recipient of the Outstanding Democrat award.

description.zh-cn: 2014年1月18日，陈子明抵达美国波士顿接受癌症治疗。
description.en: On January 18, 2014, Chen Ziming arrived in Boston, USA, to receive cancer treatment.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明于1991年获颁国际新闻自由奖。
description.en: Chen Ziming was awarded the International Press Freedom Award in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 陈子明于2013年获得独立中文笔会自由写作奖。
description.en: Chen Ziming received the Freedom to Write Award from the Independent Chinese PEN Center in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Ni Runfeng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰曾任长虹电器股份有限公司董事长兼总经理，于2004年辞去所有职务。
description.en: Ni Runfeng served as the chairman and general manager of Changhong Electric Co., Ltd., and resigned from all positions in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰于1944年2月出生于山东荣成。
description.en: Ni Runfeng was born in Rongcheng, Shandong in February 1944.

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰于1967年毕业于大连理工大学机械制造专业。
description.en: Ni Runfeng graduated from Dalian University of Technology in 1967 with a major in Mechanical Manufacturing.

description.zh-cn: 在倪润峰的领导之下，长虹获得全国首批、四川省第一家一级企业称号，被誉为“中国的松下”。
description.en: Under the leadership of Ni Runfeng, Changhong became one of the first national-level and the first Grade-A enterprise in Sichuan Province, and was hailed as the 'Matsushita of China'.

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰从长虹离职后曾任四川省政府顾问。
description.en: After leaving Changhong, Ni Runfeng served as an advisor to the Sichuan Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 2018年12月，中国共产党授予倪润峰改革先锋称号。
description.en: In December 2018, the Communist Party of China awarded Ni Runfeng the title of Reform Pioneer.

description.zh-cn: 2018年12月，中华人民共和国国务院授予倪润峰改革先锋称号。
description.en: In December 2018, the State Council of the People's Republic of China awarded Ni Runfeng the title of Reform Pioneer.

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰是第八届全国人大代表。
description.en: Ni Runfeng was a deputy to the 8th National People's Congress.

position.en: Member of the Standing Committee of the 10th National Committee

description.zh-cn: 倪润峰是第十届全国政协常委。
description.en: Ni Runfeng was a member of the Standing Committee of the 10th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 应瑞典要求，以涉嫌性犯罪为由对阿桑奇发出红色通报级别的国际逮捕令。
description.en: At the request of Sweden, issued a Red Notice international arrest warrant for Assange on suspicion of sexual offenses.

description.zh-cn: 向阿桑奇提供政治庇护，使其在厄瓜多尔驻英国大使馆居住了近七年。
description.en: Granted political asylum to Assange, allowing him to reside in the Embassy of Ecuador in the UK for nearly seven years.

description.zh-cn: 撤销对阿桑奇的政治庇护，并允许伦敦警察进入其驻英大使馆将阿桑奇逮捕。
description.en: Revoked Assange's political asylum and permitted London police to enter its UK embassy to arrest him.

description.zh-cn: 因维基解密公布机密文件而对阿桑奇展开刑事调查，并根据《间谍法》提出指控，长期寻求将其引渡，最终达成认罪协议。
description.en: Initiated a criminal investigation against Assange for publishing classified documents, charged him under the Espionage Act, sought his extradition for years, and ultimately reached a plea deal.

description.zh-cn: 与阿桑奇达成认罪协议，使其在承认一项违反间谍法的罪名后获释并返回澳大利亚。
description.en: Reached a plea deal with Assange, allowing him to be released and return to Australia after pleading guilty to one charge under the Espionage Act.

description.zh-cn: 担任英国内政大臣期间，批准将阿桑奇引渡至美国的命令。
description.en: During her tenure as UK Home Secretary, approved the order to extradite Assange to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 针对“国际颠覆者”的黑客活动展开调查，并于1991年逮捕了阿桑奇。他最终在1996年承认25项指控并被罚款。
description.en: Investigated the hacking activities of the 'International Subversives', leading to Assange's arrest in 1991. He eventually pleaded guilty to 25 charges in 1996 and was fined.

description.zh-cn: 学习编程、数学和物理学，但未完成学位。
description.en: Studied programming, mathematics, and physics, but did not complete a degree.

description.zh-cn: 担任中央情报局局长时，称维基解密是“非国家敌对情报机构”。
description.en: As Director of the CIA, he called WikiLeaks a 'non-state hostile intelligence service'.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本信息，王兆是四川自贡人。
description.en: According to the text, Wang Zhao is a native of Zigong, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 王兆是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Zhao is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，王兆当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会四川地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Wang Zhao was elected as a deputy from the Sichuan region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在楚汉战争中获胜后，刘邦于前202年2月28日称帝，建立汉朝。
description.en: After winning the Chu-Han Contention, Liu Bang proclaimed himself emperor on February 28, 202 BCE, and established the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦联合其他诸侯发动了垓下之战，并取得了最终胜利。
description.en: Liu Bang initiated the Battle of Gaixia in coalition with other feudal lords and achieved the final victory.

description.zh-cn: 董仲舒向汉武帝建议实行“罢黜百家，独尊儒术”的政策。
description.en: Dong Zhongshu advised Emperor Wu of Han to implement the policy of 'Dismissing the Hundred Schools of Thought and exclusively revering Confucianism'.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝改变了汉初对匈奴的和亲政策，发动了一系列大规模军事战役打击匈奴。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Han changed the early Han policy of appeasement towards the Xiongnu and launched a series of large-scale military campaigns against them.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝时期的汉匈战争使匈奴遭受重创，远徙漠北，保障了汉朝北方的安全。
description.en: The Han-Xiongnu War during Emperor Wu's reign inflicted heavy losses on the Xiongnu, forcing them to migrate far north of the Gobi Desert and securing the northern frontier of the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 司马迁撰写了中国第一部纪传体通史《史记》，其中包含关于庄子的传记。
description.en: Sima Qian authored the 'Records of the Grand Historian' (Shiji), the first comprehensive history of China written in a biographical style, which includes a biography of Zhuangzi.

description.zh-cn: 福建省人民检察院是中华人民共和国最高人民检察院的业务下级单位。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial People's Procuratorate is professionally subordinate to the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 福建省人民检察院是福建省人民代表大会的组织下级单位。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial People's Procuratorate is organizationally subordinate to the Fujian Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 福建省人民检察院是福建省人民代表大会常务委员会的组织下级单位。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial People's Procuratorate is organizationally subordinate to the Standing Committee of the Fujian Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 福建省人民检察院受中国共产党福建省委员会领导。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial People's Procuratorate is led by the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡接替亚伊尔·拉皮德成为以色列总理。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu succeeded Yair Lapid as Prime Minister of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡接替埃胡德·奥尔默特成为以色列总理。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu succeeded Ehud Olmert as Prime Minister of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡在1996年大选中击败并接替时任总理希蒙·佩雷斯。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu defeated and succeeded incumbent Prime Minister Shimon Peres in the 1996 election.

description.zh-cn: 埃胡德·巴拉克在1999年大选中击败并接替本雅明·内塔尼亚胡成为以色列总理。
description.en: Ehud Barak defeated and succeeded Benjamin Netanyahu as Prime Minister of Israel in the 1999 election.

description.zh-cn: 约纳坦·内塔尼亚胡是本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的长兄。
description.en: Yonatan Netanyahu was Benjamin Netanyahu's older brother.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡不信任巴勒斯坦解放组织领导人亚西尔·阿拉法特，并在和平进程中对他采取强硬立场。
description.en: Netanyahu distrusted PLO leader Yasser Arafat and took a hardline stance against him in the peace process.

position.en: Minister of Foreign Affairs, Minister of Finance

description.zh-cn: 在沙龙政府中先后担任外交部长和财政部长。
description.en: Served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and later Minister of Finance in Sharon's government.

description.zh-cn: 自特朗普政府上任后，美以关系明显好转，特朗普采取了亲以色列的立场。
description.en: Since the Trump administration took office, US-Israel relations significantly improved, with Trump adopting a pro-Israel stance.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡被指与奥巴马政府关系欠佳，双方在两国方案及以色列定居点问题上存在分歧。
description.en: Netanyahu reportedly had a poor relationship with the Obama administration, with disagreements on the two-state solution and Israeli settlements.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡政府于2023年1月公布了司法改革方案。
description.en: The Netanyahu government unveiled the judicial reform plan in January 2023.

description.zh-cn: 司法改革方案引发了广泛的批评和连串示威活动。
description.en: The judicial reform plan sparked widespread criticism and a series of protest movements.

description.zh-cn: 哈马斯等武装组织于2023年10月对以色列发动突然袭击，引发了战争。
description.en: Hamas and other militant groups launched a surprise attack on Israel in October 2023, triggering the war.

description.zh-cn: 为应对战争，内塔尼亚胡与各党紧急成立了战时内阁。
description.en: In response to the war, Netanyahu and various parties formed an emergency war cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 国际刑事法院检察官卡里姆·艾哈迈德汗申请对内塔尼亚胡等人的逮捕令。
description.en: ICC Prosecutor Karim Ahmad Khan applied for arrest warrants for Netanyahu and others.

description.zh-cn: 国际刑事法院于2024年11月21日正式签发对内塔尼亚胡和加兰特的逮捕令。
description.en: The ICC formally issued arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant on November 21, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡反对与伊朗和解，并指控其支持恐怖主义活动。
description.en: Netanyahu opposes reconciliation with Iran and accuses it of supporting terrorist activities.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡在美国国会发表演讲，公开批评并试图阻止美国与伊朗达成核协议。
description.en: Netanyahu delivered a speech to the U.S. Congress, publicly criticizing and attempting to block the nuclear deal with Iran.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国众议院议长约翰·博纳邀请内塔尼亚胡到美国国会就伊朗核协议发表演讲。
description.en: Then-Speaker of the House John Boehner invited Netanyahu to address the U.S. Congress regarding the Iran nuclear deal.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡不信任巴勒斯坦民族权力机构，并对其采取强硬态度。
description.en: Netanyahu distrusts the Palestinian National Authority and adopts a hardline stance towards it.

description.zh-cn: 内塔尼亚胡与政治对手本尼·甘茨同意组建联合政府。
description.en: Netanyahu and his political rival Benny Gantz agreed to form a unity government.

description.zh-cn: 由于与阿维格多·利伯曼领导的以色列是我们的家园党在服兵役问题上无法达成一致，内塔尼亚胡在2019年4月选举后组阁失败。
description.en: Netanyahu failed to form a coalition after the April 2019 election due to disagreements with Avigdor Lieberman's Yisrael Beiteinu party over the issue of military conscription.

description.zh-cn: 彼得大帝将国号改为俄罗斯帝国，结束了俄罗斯沙皇国的历史。
description.en: Peter the Great changed the state's name to the Russian Empire, ending the history of the Tsardom of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯沙皇国由莫斯科公国发展而来。
description.en: The Tsardom of Russia developed from the Grand Duchy of Moscow.

description.zh-cn: 伊凡三世与拜占庭末代公主索菲娅·巴列奥略成婚，此举加强了莫斯科作为拜占庭继承者的地位。
description.en: Ivan III married the last Byzantine princess, Sophia Palaiologina, a move that strengthened Moscow's claim as the successor to Byzantium.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯沙皇国（莫斯科朝廷）引入了拜占庭的词汇、礼仪、官员头衔和标志（如双头鹰），并以“第三罗马”自居。
description.en: The Tsardom of Russia (the Moscow court) adopted Byzantine vocabulary, ceremonies, official titles, and symbols (like the double-headed eagle), considering itself the 'Third Rome'.

description.zh-cn: 君士坦丁堡的陷落被认为是俄罗斯沙皇宣称自己是罗马与拜占庭帝国合法继承者、莫斯科是“第三罗马”的契机。
description.en: The Fall of Constantinople was seen as the opportune moment for the Russian Tsar to claim to be the legitimate successor to the Roman and Byzantine Empires, and Moscow as the 'Third Rome'.

description.zh-cn: 混乱时期是俄罗斯沙皇国的一段政治危机、社会动荡和外敌入侵时期，严重削弱了国家。
description.en: The Time of Troubles was a period of political crisis, social upheaval, and foreign invasion for the Tsardom of Russia, which severely weakened the state.

description.zh-cn: 波兰国王齐格蒙特三世支持了自称是季米特里的伪德米特里一世。
description.en: King Sigismund III of Poland supported False Dmitry I, who claimed to be Dmitry.

description.zh-cn: 1605年，在伪德米特里一世夺取政权的过程中，鲍里斯·戈东诺夫的儿子费奥多尔二世被杀。
description.en: In 1605, during False Dmitry I's seizure of power, Feodor II, the son of Boris Godunov, was killed.

description.zh-cn: 1613年，全俄罗斯缙绅会议宣布立米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫为沙皇，结束了混乱时期。
description.en: In 1613, the Zemsky Sobor proclaimed Michael Romanov as Tsar, ending the Time of Troubles.

description.zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫的即位开启了罗曼诺夫王朝的统治。
description.en: The accession of Michael Romanov marked the beginning of the Romanov dynasty's rule.

description.zh-cn: 《佩列亚斯拉夫条约》的签订导致了俄罗斯与波兰之间为争夺乌克兰控制权的战争。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Pereyaslav led to the Russo-Polish War over control of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 在俄波战争（1654-1667）中，俄罗斯沙皇国击败了波兰。
description.en: The Tsardom of Russia defeated Poland in the Russo-Polish War (1654-1667).

description.zh-cn: 1581年，商人斯特罗加诺夫家族招聘哥萨克领袖叶尔马克，资助其向西伯利亚进攻。
description.en: In 1581, the merchant Stroganov family hired the Cossack leader Yermak, financing his expedition into Siberia.

description.zh-cn: 叶尔马克率领的哥萨克队伍打败了西伯利亚汗国，为俄罗斯征服西伯利亚打开了通道。
description.en: Yermak's Cossack forces defeated the Khanate of Sibir, opening the way for the Russian conquest of Siberia.

description.zh-cn: 根据《尼布楚条约》，清朝（中国）收复了黑龙江以南的领土。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Nerchinsk, the Qing dynasty (China) regained territory south of the Amur River.

description.zh-cn: 根据《尼布楚条约》，贝加尔湖以东地区划归俄罗斯所有。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Nerchinsk, the territory east of Lake Baikal was ceded to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 袁盎起初为吕禄的舍人。
description.en: Yuan Ang initially served as a retainer for Lü Lu.

position.en: Palace Gentleman, Commander of the Gentlemen of the Palace, Commandant, Chancellor of a kingdom

description.zh-cn: 袁盎在西汉朝廷中担任过郎中、中郎将、陇西都尉、齐国国相、吴国国相、楚国国相等多个职位。
description.en: Yuan Ang held multiple positions in the Western Han court, including Palace Gentleman, Commander of the Gentlemen of the Palace, Commandant of Longxi, Chancellor of the Kingdom of Qi, Chancellor of the Kingdom of Wu, and Chancellor of the Kingdom of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 向汉文帝进谏，批评周勃身为功臣而骄横，导致汉文帝对周勃态度变得严肃，周勃因此收敛。
description.en: He advised Emperor Wen, criticizing Zhou Bo for being arrogant despite his merits, which led the emperor to treat Zhou Bo more sternly, causing Zhou Bo to restrain his behavior.

description.zh-cn: 因袁盎在汉文帝面前批评自己，周勃对袁盎心生怨恨。
description.en: Zhou Bo resented Yuan Ang for criticizing him in front of Emperor Wen.

description.zh-cn: 在周勃被诬告谋反入狱后，袁盎是唯一出面为他澄清辩护的大臣。
description.en: After Zhou Bo was falsely accused of rebellion and imprisoned, Yuan Ang was the only high-ranking official to speak out and defend his innocence.

description.zh-cn: 周勃出狱后，感念袁盎的帮助，两人结为挚友。
description.en: After being released from prison, Zhou Bo was grateful for Yuan Ang's help, and the two became close friends.

description.zh-cn: 为母报仇，杀死了辟阳侯审食其。
description.en: To avenge his mother, he killed Shen Shiqi, the Marquis of Piyang.

description.zh-cn: 为维护皇后作为正室的尊严，阻止了汉文帝的爱妾慎夫人与帝后同席而坐。
description.en: To uphold the dignity of the empress as the principal wife, he prevented Emperor Wen's favored concubine, Lady Shen, from sitting at the same level as the emperor and empress.

description.zh-cn: 在理解袁盎维护礼法的用意后，赐给袁盎金五十斤。
description.en: After understanding Yuan Ang's intention to uphold the proper rites, she rewarded him with fifty catties of gold.

description.zh-cn: 在霸陵劝阻汉文帝从陡坡策马而下的冒险行为，强调君主不应心存侥幸。
description.en: At Baling, he dissuaded Emperor Wen from the risky act of riding his carriage down a steep slope, emphasizing that a wise ruler should not take unnecessary risks.

description.zh-cn: 弹劾袁盎曾收受吴王刘濞的贿赂，导致袁盎被景帝废为庶人。
description.en: He impeached Yuan Ang for allegedly accepting bribes from Liu Pi, the King of Wu, which led to Emperor Jing demoting Yuan Ang to a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 帮助被废为庶人的袁盎获得了面见汉景帝的机会，以劝说景帝。
description.en: He helped Yuan Ang, who had been demoted to a commoner, to get an audience with Emperor Jing to persuade him.

description.zh-cn: 在七国之乱时，力劝汉景帝处死晁错以平息叛乱。
description.en: During the Rebellion of the Seven States, he strongly urged Emperor Jing to execute Chao Cuo in order to quell the rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 反对汉景帝立其弟梁王刘武为皇储。
description.en: He opposed Emperor Jing's intention to make his younger brother, Liu Wu, the King of Liang, the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 袁盎与当代著名游侠剧孟有交往。
description.en: Yuan Ang associated with the famous contemporary knight-errant Ju Meng.

description.zh-cn: 袁盎与当代著名游侠季心有交往。
description.en: Yuan Ang associated with the famous contemporary knight-errant Ji Xin.

description.zh-cn: 盗掘了袁盎的墓。
description.en: He robbed the tomb of Yuan Ang.

description.zh-cn: 刘延东是刘瑞龙的女儿。
description.en: Liu Yandong is the daughter of Liu Ruilong.

description.zh-cn: 刘延东是江彤的女儿。
description.en: Liu Yandong is the daughter of Jiang Tong.

description.zh-cn: 刘延东与杨元惺是夫妻关系。
description.en: Liu Yandong and Yang Yuanxing are spouses.

description.zh-cn: 刘延宁是刘延东的姐姐。
description.en: Liu Yanning is Liu Yandong's elder sister.

description.zh-cn: 刘延申是刘延东的弟弟。
description.en: Liu Yanshen is Liu Yandong's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 杨元惺是杨显东的儿子。
description.en: Yang Yuanxing is the son of Yang Xiandong.

description.zh-cn: 刘延东于1945年11月出生于江苏淮安。
description.en: Liu Yandong was born in Huai'an, Jiangsu in November 1945.

description.zh-cn: 1964年考入清华大学化学工程系学习。
description.en: Enrolled in the Department of Chemical Engineering at Tsinghua University in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央统战部副部长期间，获得中国人民大学硕士学位。
description.en: Obtained a master's degree from Renmin University of China while serving as Deputy Head of the United Front Work Department.

degree.zh-cn: 法学博士（政治学理论专业）

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央统战部副部长期间，获得吉林大学法学博士学位。
description.en: Obtained a Doctor of Law degree from Jilin University while serving as Deputy Head of the United Front Work Department.

description.zh-cn: 杨元惺毕业于中国人民解放军通讯工程学院（现西安电子科技大学）。
description.en: Yang Yuanxing graduated from the PLA Institute of Telecommunication Engineering (now Xidian University).

description.zh-cn: 于1964年7月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in July 1964.

position.en: Secretary of the Secretariat, Executive Secretary

description.zh-cn: 历任中国共产主义青年团中央书记处书记（1982年12月－1991年3月）、常务书记（1988年5月－1991年3月）。
description.en: Served as Secretary (December 1982 - March 1991) and Executive Secretary (May 1988 - March 1991) of the Secretariat of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League of China.
Served as Vice Chairperson (April 1983 - April 1985) and Chairperson (April 1985 - December 1991) of the All-China Youth Federation.

description.zh-cn: 历任中共中央统战部副秘书长（1991年3月－1991年9月）、副部长（1991年9月－2002年12月）、部长（2002年12月－2007年12月）。
description.en: Served as Deputy Secretary-General (March 1991 - September 1991), Deputy Head (September 1991 - December 2002), and Head (December 2002 - December 2007) of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 曾任第十七届、十八届中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the 17th and 18th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

position.en: Vice Premier of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 在李克强担任国务院总理期间，刘延东任其副手。
description.en: While Li Keqiang was Premier of the State Council, Liu Yandong served as his deputy.

position.en: Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记期间，刘延东是其中央政治局的成员。
description.en: While Hu Jintao was General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Liu Yandong was a member of its Politburo.

position.en: Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 在习近平担任中共中央总书记期间，刘延东是其中央政治局的成员。
description.en: While Xi Jinping was General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Liu Yandong was a member of its Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 在共青团中央工作期间，与时任团中央负责人的胡锦涛、王兆国、宋德福共事。
description.en: During her tenure at the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, she worked with Hu Jintao, Wang Zhaoguo, and Song Defu, who were then leaders of the league.

description.zh-cn: 在共青团中央工作期间，与时任团中央负责人的胡锦涛、王兆国、宋德福共事。后来，刘延东接替王兆国出任中共中央统战部部长。
description.en: During her tenure at the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, she worked with Hu Jintao, Wang Zhaoguo, and Song Defu. Later, Liu Yandong succeeded Wang Zhaoguo as head of the United Front Work Department.

description.zh-cn: 在共青团中央工作期间，与时任团中央负责人的胡锦涛、王兆国、宋德福共事。
description.en: During her tenure at the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, she worked with Hu Jintao, Wang Zhaoguo, and Song Defu, who were then leaders of the league.

description.zh-cn: 刘延东卸任中共中央统战部部长，由杜青林接任。
description.en: Liu Yandong stepped down as head of the United Front Work Department, and was succeeded by Du Qinglin.

description.zh-cn: 刘延东卸任国务院副总理，由孙春兰等人接任其分管领域。
description.en: Liu Yandong stepped down as Vice Premier of the State Council, and her areas of responsibility were taken over by Sun Chunlan and others.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯向刘延东授予友谊勋章。
description.en: Russia awarded the Order of Friendship to Liu Yandong.

description.zh-cn: 杨元惺是何鸿燊的密友。
description.en: Yang Yuanxing is a close friend of Stanley Ho.

description.zh-cn: 周凯旋是李嘉诚的密友。
description.en: Solina Chau is a close friend of Li Ka-shing.

description.zh-cn: 冯琦与周凯旋共同创办了TOM集团。
description.en: Feng Qi co-founded TOM Group with Solina Chau.

description.zh-cn: 周凯旋与冯琦共同创办了TOM集团。
description.en: Solina Chau co-founded TOM Group with Feng Qi.

description.zh-cn: 靖难之变后，将年仅2岁的朱文圭废为庶人并长期囚禁于凤阳。
description.en: After the Jingnan campaign, he deposed the two-year-old Zhu Wengui to commoner status and imprisoned him in Fengyang for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 以“不能匡正建文帝”为由将朱允熥废为庶人，并囚禁于凤阳。
description.en: Deposed Zhu Yuntong to commoner status and imprisoned him in Fengyang on the grounds that he 'failed to correct the Jianwen Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 在建文帝失踪后，私下为其发丧，上谥号“孝愍皇帝”，庙号“神宗”。
description.en: After the Jianwen Emperor's disappearance, he privately held a funeral for him and conferred the posthumous title 'Xiaomin Huangdi' and the temple name 'Shenzong'.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔十六世·古斯塔夫是现任瑞典国王。
description.en: Carl XVI Gustaf is the current King of Sweden.

description.zh-cn: 乌尔夫·克里斯特松是瑞典的现任首相。
description.en: Ulf Kristersson is the current Prime Minister of Sweden.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典于1995年1月1日加入欧洲联盟。
description.en: Sweden joined the European Union on January 1, 1995.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典于2024年3月7日正式加入北大西洋公约组织。
description.en: Sweden officially joined the North Atlantic Treaty Organization on March 7, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典是卡尔马联合的成员国之一，该联合还包括丹麦和挪威。
description.en: Sweden was one of the member states of the Kalmar Union, which also included Denmark and Norway.

description.zh-cn: 丹麦是卡尔马联合的成员国之一。
description.en: Denmark was one of the member states of the Kalmar Union.

description.zh-cn: 挪威是卡尔马联合的成员国之一。
description.en: Norway was one of the member states of the Kalmar Union.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典与挪威组成由瑞典主导的瑞典-挪威联合王国。
description.en: Sweden and Norway formed the United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway, led by Sweden.

description.zh-cn: 根据基尔条约，挪威被割让给瑞典，两国组成瑞典-挪威联合王国。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Kiel, Norway was ceded to Sweden, and the two countries formed the United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway.

description.zh-cn: 1521年，瑞典国王古斯塔夫一世再次建立王权，领导瑞典从卡尔马联合中独立。
description.en: In 1521, King Gustav I of Sweden re-established royal power and led Sweden's independence from the Kalmar Union.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典在大北方战争中战败，被俄罗斯帝国取代其在欧洲的强国地位。
description.en: Sweden was defeated in the Great Northern War and was replaced by the Russian Empire as a great power in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 1809年芬兰战争中瑞典战败，被迫将芬兰割让给俄国。
description.en: In the Finnish War of 1809, Sweden was defeated and forced to cede Finland to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑战争结束后，根据基尔条约丹麦将挪威割予瑞典，促成了瑞典-挪威联合王国的建立。
description.en: After the Napoleonic Wars, Denmark ceded Norway to Sweden according to the Treaty of Kiel, which led to the formation of the United Kingdoms of Sweden and Norway.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，瑞典在纳粹德国占领挪威后，给予德国军事通行权以及铁矿资源。
description.en: During World War II, after Nazi Germany occupied Norway, Sweden granted Germany military passage rights and provided iron ore resources.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典是1912年夏季奥林匹克运动会的主办国。
description.en: Sweden was the host country for the 1912 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典是1958年世界杯足球赛的主办国。
description.en: Sweden was the host country for the 1958 FIFA World Cup.

description.zh-cn: 1810年，卡尔十三世收法国元帅伯纳多特（即后来的卡尔十四世·约翰）为养子。
description.en: In 1810, Charles XIII adopted French Marshal Bernadotte (later Charles XIV John) as his son.

description.zh-cn: 17世纪时瑞典在三十年战争中获得许多欧陆领土，使其跃升成为欧洲强国。
description.en: In the 17th century, Sweden gained many continental territories in the Thirty Years' War, which elevated it to the status of a European great power.

description.zh-cn: 从1150年代起，瑞典占领芬兰，芬兰成为瑞典本土一部分，直到1809年芬兰战争后被割让给俄国。
description.en: From the 1150s, Sweden occupied Finland, and Finland became part of Sweden proper until it was ceded to Russia after the Finnish War in 1809.

description.zh-cn: 根据基尔条约，丹麦被迫将挪威割让给瑞典，从而失去了对挪威的统治。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Kiel, Denmark was forced to cede Norway to Sweden, thereby losing its rule over Norway.

description.zh-cn: 凯撒成为终身独裁官，象征着共和制的结束。
description.en: Caesar becoming dictator for life symbolized the end of the Republican system.

description.zh-cn: 屋大维成为奥古斯都，象征着罗马帝国的开端。
description.en: Octavian becoming Augustus symbolized the beginning of the Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 屋大维在亚克兴角战役中击败对手，为他掌握最高权力铺平了道路。
description.en: Octavian's victory at the Battle of Actium over his rivals paved the way for him to assume supreme power.

description.zh-cn: 在亚克兴角战役中击败马克·安东尼。
description.en: Defeated Mark Antony at the Battle of Actium.

description.zh-cn: 在亚克兴角战役中击败克娄巴特拉七世。
description.en: Defeated Cleopatra VII at the Battle of Actium.

description.zh-cn: 在亚克兴角战役胜利后，吞并了埃及的托勒密王国。
description.en: Annexed the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt after the victory at the Battle of Actium.

description.zh-cn: 授予屋大维君权及“奥古斯都”头衔。
description.en: Granted Octavian imperial power and the title of 'Augustus'.

description.zh-cn: 在卡利古拉被刺杀后，架空元老院，拥立克劳狄一世为帝。
description.en: After the assassination of Caligula, they bypassed the Senate and proclaimed Claudius as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 图密善是提图斯的弟弟，并继其兄之位成为皇帝。
description.en: Domitian was the younger brother of Titus and succeeded him as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在图密善被刺杀后，元老院推举涅尔瓦为皇帝。
description.en: After the assassination of Domitian, the Senate chose Nerva as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 戴克里先的统治使帝国全面恢复稳定，从而结束了三世纪危机。
description.en: The reign of Diocletian brought full stability back to the empire, thus ending the Crisis of the Third Century.

description.zh-cn: 在内战中击败其他共治皇帝，成为帝国的唯一统治者，从而结束了四帝共治制度。
description.en: Defeated the other co-emperors in civil wars to become the sole ruler of the empire, thereby ending the Tetrarchy system.

description.zh-cn: 迁都至拜占庭，并以自己的名字将其命名为君士坦丁堡。
description.en: Moved the capital to Byzantium and renamed it Constantinople after himself.

description.zh-cn: 罗马帝国与其东面的萨珊王朝长期互相抗衡，纷争持续了一个世纪。
description.en: The Roman Empire and the Sasanian Empire to its east were long-standing rivals, with conflicts lasting for a century.

description.zh-cn: 作为最后一位统治统一罗马帝国的皇帝，他去世后，帝国最终分裂为西罗马帝国和东罗马帝国。
description.en: As the last emperor to rule a unified Roman Empire, after his death, the empire was permanently divided into the Western and Eastern Roman Empires.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉维乌斯·奥古斯都·霍诺留是狄奥多西一世的儿子。
description.en: Flavius Augustus Honorius was the son of Theodosius I.

description.zh-cn: 阿卡狄奥斯是狄奥多西一世的儿子。
description.en: Arcadius was the son of Theodosius I.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉维乌斯·奥古斯都·霍诺留与阿卡狄奥斯是兄弟。
description.en: Flavius Augustus Honorius and Arcadius were brothers.

description.zh-cn: 于公元410年入侵并洗劫了帝国首都罗马城。
description.en: Invaded and sacked the imperial capital, the city of Rome, in 410 AD.

description.zh-cn: 于公元455年入侵并洗劫了帝国首都罗马城。
description.en: Invaded and sacked the imperial capital, the city of Rome, in 455 AD.

description.zh-cn: 废黜了西罗马帝国最后一位皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都。
description.en: Deposed Romulus Augustulus, the last emperor of the Western Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 其废黜末代皇帝的行为象征着西罗马帝国的终结。
description.en: His deposition of the last emperor symbolized the end of the Western Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 该事件标志着东罗马帝国的灭亡。
description.en: This event marked the end of the Eastern Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 东罗马帝国末代皇帝君士坦丁十一世在此事件中战死。
description.en: The last emperor of the Eastern Roman Empire, Constantine XI, was killed in battle during this event.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯曼帝国军队攻陷了君士坦丁堡。
description.en: The army of the Ottoman Empire captured Constantinople.

description.zh-cn: 十字军占领并洗劫了君士坦丁堡，并瓜分了帝国领土，导致帝国力量再也未能恢复。
description.en: The Crusaders captured and sacked Constantinople, and partitioned the empire's territory, after which the empire never recovered its former strength.

description.zh-cn: 因奥维德的作品违反了其“澄清风俗”的政策，而将其判处流放。
description.en: Exiled Ovid because his work violated his policy of 'purifying customs'.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺是郑慎亲王乌尔恭阿的第六子。
description.en: Sushun was the sixth son of Prince Zheng Shen, Ulgungga.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺是端华的弟弟。
description.en: Sushun was the younger brother of Duanhua.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺是郑献亲王济尔哈朗的七世孙。
description.en: Sushun was a seventh-generation descendant of Prince Zheng Xian, Jirgalang.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺是咸丰帝任命的顾命八大臣之一，并且是其中的核心人物。
description.en: Sushun was one of the eight regents appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor and a key figure among them.

description.zh-cn: 端华是咸丰帝任命的顾命八大臣之一。
description.en: Duanhua was one of the eight regents appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 载垣是咸丰帝任命的顾命八大臣之一。
description.en: Zaiyuan was one of the eight regents appointed by the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在政变中，肃顺于密云被捕，后被斩首于菜市口，政治生涯终结。
description.en: During the coup, Sushun was arrested in Miyun and later beheaded at Caishikou, ending his political career.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后意图垂帘听政，遭到肃顺的严厉反对，视其为政敌，最终发动政变将其处死。
description.en: Empress Dowager Cixi's desire to rule from behind the curtain was strongly opposed by Sushun, who she viewed as a political enemy, ultimately leading to his execution in a coup.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺在对外政策上主战，反对恭亲王奕䜣主和，两人政见不合。后奕䜣联合两宫太后发动政变，将肃顺处死。
description.en: Sushun advocated for war in foreign policy, opposing Prince Gong's preference for peace, creating political disagreement. Later, Yixin allied with the two empress dowagers to launch a coup and execute Sushun.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺于嘉庆二十一年（1816年）出生于郑亲王府。
description.en: Sushun was born in the Prince Zheng's Mansion in 1816 (the 21st year of the Jiaqing era).

description.zh-cn: 在戊午科场案中，肃顺坚持将主考官、大学士柏葰处以斩立决。
description.en: In the 1858 imperial examination scandal, Sushun insisted on the immediate execution of the chief examiner, Grand Secretary Bojun.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺赏识曾国藩的才干，并向咸丰帝建议任用其为两江总督以应对太平军。
description.en: Sushun appreciated Zeng Guofan's talents and recommended to the Xianfeng Emperor that he be appointed Viceroy of Liangjiang to deal with the Taiping army.

description.zh-cn: 在讨论人事时，肃顺认为胡林翼在湖北的治理卓有成效，不应调动，从而稳固了其在湖北的地位。
description.en: When discussing personnel appointments, Sushun argued that Hu Linyi was highly effective in governing Hubei and should not be transferred, thus solidifying his position there.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺重视汉族人才，提拔重用了包括左宗棠在内的一批汉族官员。
description.en: Sushun valued Han Chinese talent and promoted and heavily utilized a group of Han officials, including Zuo Zongtang.

description.zh-cn: 耆英之子庆锡申诉，其父是被肃顺构陷而死。
description.en: Qiying's son Qingxi claimed that his father was framed by Sushun, leading to his death.

description.zh-cn: 祺祥之变后，慈禧太后开始实行垂帘听政，成为晚清的实际统治者。
description.en: After the Xinyou Coup, Empress Dowager Cixi began to rule from behind the curtain, becoming the de facto ruler of the late Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺严厉反对两宫太后垂帘听政的意图。
description.en: Sushun strongly opposed the intention of the two empress dowagers to rule from behind the curtain.

description.zh-cn: 肃顺曾担任户部满尚书。
description.en: Sushun served as the Manchu Minister of Revenue.

description.zh-cn: 钟绍军当选为中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会代表及主席团成员。
description.en: Zhong Shaojun was elected as a delegate and a member of the presidium of the 19th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party.

position.zh-cn: 中央军委主席办公室主任
position.en: Director of the Office of the Chairman of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 吴志铭担任时任中央军委主席胡锦涛的办公室主任。
description.en: Wu Zhiming served as the Director of the Office for the then-CMC Chairman Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 张惜阴出生于江苏无锡。
description.en: Zhang Xiyin was born in Wuxi, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 张惜阴曾任上海医科大学教授、博士生导师。
description.en: Zhang Xiyin served as a professor and doctoral supervisor at Shanghai Medical University.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，张惜阴是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Zhang Xiyin was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，东方海外遭遇财务危机，获中华人民共和国政府透过霍英东注资而得以渡过难关。
description.en: In 1986, Orient Overseas faced a financial crisis and was bailed out with an investment from the PRC government through Henry Fok.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，霍英东向遭遇财务危机的东方海外注资，助其渡过难关。
description.en: In 1986, Henry Fok injected capital into the financially troubled Orient Overseas, helping it survive the crisis.

description.zh-cn: 1992年10月，时任香港总督彭定康委任董建华为香港行政局非官守议员，使其踏足政界。
description.en: In October 1992, then-Governor Chris Patten appointed Tung Chee-hwa as an unofficial member of the Executive Council, marking his entry into politics.

description.zh-cn: 1996年1月，在香港特区筹委会成立时，时任中共中央总书记江泽民仅与董建华一人握手，此举被普遍解读为“钦点”其为首任行政长官。
description.en: In January 1996, at the establishment of the HKSAR Preparatory Committee, then-General Secretary of the CPC Jiang Zemin shook hands only with Tung Chee-hwa, an act widely interpreted as an official endorsement for him to become the first Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务院总理李鹏签署国务院令，任命董建华为香港首任行政长官。
description.en: Then-Premier Li Peng signed a State Council order appointing Tung Chee-hwa as the first Chief Executive of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 在1996年香港特别行政区行政长官选举中，董建华为吴光正的竞争对手并最终获胜。
description.en: In the 1996 Hong Kong Chief Executive election, Tung Chee-hwa was a competitor to Peter Woo and ultimately won.

description.zh-cn: 在1996年香港特别行政区行政长官选举中，董建华为李福善的竞争对手并最终获胜。
description.en: In the 1996 Hong Kong Chief Executive election, Tung Chee-hwa was a competitor to Li Fook-sin and ultimately won.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务院总理朱镕基委任董建华为第二任香港行政长官。
description.en: Then-Premier Zhu Rongji appointed Tung Chee-hwa for his second term as Chief Executive of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 董建华辞职后，由时任政务司司长曾荫权接任行政长官。
description.en: After Tung Chee-hwa's resignation, then-Chief Secretary for Administration Donald Tsang succeeded him as Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 陈智思接替董建华出任团结香港基金会主席。
description.en: Bernard Chan succeeded Tung Chee-hwa as the Chairman of the Our Hong Kong Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 董建华在1997年施政报告中宣布了“八万五建屋计划”。
description.en: Tung Chee-hwa announced the '85,000 housing units policy' in his 1997 policy address.

description.zh-cn: 亚洲金融风暴爆发后，楼价急跌，导致“八万五建屋计划”事实上无法推行，并于1998年后不再被提起。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Asian financial crisis, property prices plummeted, making the '85,000 housing units policy' effectively untenable, and it was no longer mentioned after 1998.

description.zh-cn: 在港大民调风波中，路祥安在董建华的力保下得以留任。
description.en: During the HKU polling controversy, Andrew Lo retained his position with Tung Chee-hwa's strong support.

description.zh-cn: 董建华与时任政务司司长陈方安生在治港政策上存在分歧，坊间普遍传言二人不和。陈方安生最终因无法说服董建华放弃推行高官问责制而提早辞职。
description.en: Tung Chee-hwa and then-Chief Secretary for Administration Anson Chan had disagreements on Hong Kong's governance policies, and it was widely rumored that they were at odds. Chan eventually resigned early due to her inability to persuade Tung to abandon the implementation of the Principal Officials Accountability System.

description.zh-cn: 董建华在其第二届任期开始时推行高官问责制。
description.en: Tung Chee-hwa implemented the Principal Officials Accountability System at the beginning of his second term.

description.zh-cn: 董建华政府于2002年试图就《基本法》第23条进行立法，但在巨大争议下于2003年撤回草案。
description.en: The Tung administration attempted to legislate Article 23 of the Basic Law in 2002, but withdrew the bill in 2003 amid significant controversy.

description.zh-cn: 超过50万市民上街游行反对23条立法，最终迫使政府搁置并撤回该法案。
description.en: Over 500,000 citizens marched to protest the Article 23 legislation, ultimately forcing the government to shelve and withdraw the bill.

description.zh-cn: 游行中的一个主要诉求是要求董建华下台，严重打击了其管治威信。
description.en: A major demand of the protest was for Tung Chee-hwa to step down, which severely undermined his governing authority.

description.zh-cn: 时任国家主席胡锦涛在澳门公开要求董建华及其团队“总结经验、查找不足”，被外界广泛视为对其表现不满的信号，成为其最终辞职的催化剂。
description.en: Then-President Hu Jintao publicly asked Tung Chee-hwa and his team to 'summarize experiences and find shortcomings' in Macau, which was widely seen as a signal of dissatisfaction with his performance and a catalyst for his eventual resignation.

description.zh-cn: 董建华政府在未经公开招标的情况下，将数码港项目批给李泽楷的盈科拓展，引发官商勾结的争议。
description.en: The Tung administration awarded the Cyberport project to Richard Li's PCCW without a public tender, sparking controversy over alleged government-business collusion.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初出生于浙江嵊县。
description.en: Ma Yinchu was born in Sheng County, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初于1903年考入天津北洋大学学习矿冶专业。
description.en: Ma Yinchu was admitted to Peiyang University in Tianjin in 1903 to study metallurgy.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初于1910年获得耶鲁大学经济学硕士学位。
description.en: Ma Yinchu obtained a master's degree in economics from Yale University in 1910.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初于1914年获得哥伦比亚大学经济学博士学位。
description.en: Ma Yinchu obtained a Ph.D. in economics from Columbia University in 1914.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初获得博士学位后，在纽约大学研究会计及统计学。
description.en: After receiving his Ph.D., Ma Yinchu conducted research in accounting and statistics at New York University.

description.zh-cn: 时任北京大学校长的蔡元培招聘马寅初回国出任北京大学经济学教授。
description.en: Cai Yuanpei, then president of Peking University, recruited Ma Yinchu to return to China and serve as a professor of economics at the university.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初公开支持俄国十月革命，和李大钊成为好友。
description.en: Ma Yinchu publicly supported the October Revolution in Russia and became good friends with Li Dazhao.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变后，马寅初发表文章批判蒋介石的“不抵抗政策”和“攘外安内”政策。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, Ma Yinchu published articles criticizing Chiang Kai-shek's policy of non-resistance and his policy of 'internal pacification before external resistance'.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初在立法院会议上激烈责难财政部长孔祥熙的金融政策。
description.en: Ma Yinchu fiercely criticized Finance Minister H. H. Kung's financial policies during a Legislative Yuan session.

description.zh-cn: 因猛烈谴责国民党政府，马寅初于1941年12月被当局逮捕，先后拘禁在贵州息烽集中营及江西上饶集中营，直至1942年8月获释。
description.en: Due to his strong condemnation of the Kuomintang government, Ma Yinchu was arrested by the authorities in December 1941 and detained successively in the Xifeng and Shangrao concentration camps until his release in August 1942.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国建国初期，马寅初推动了对知识分子的“思想改造运动”。
description.en: In the early days of the People's Republic of China, Ma Yinchu promoted the 'Thought Reform Movement' targeting intellectuals.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初推动了1953年的中华人民共和国第一次全国人口普查。
description.en: Ma Yinchu promoted the first national population census of the People's Republic of China in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初的《新人口论》遭到毛泽东的反对，随后马寅初遭到批判。
description.en: Ma Yinchu's "New Population Theory" was opposed by Mao Zedong, leading to subsequent criticism of Ma.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初的《新人口论》遭到康生的反对，随后马寅初遭到批判。
description.en: Ma Yinchu's "New Population Theory" was opposed by Kang Sheng, leading to subsequent criticism of Ma.

description.zh-cn: 自1957年反右运动起，马寅初及其《新人口论》逐渐遭到全国性的批判，并于1960年被迫辞去北京大学校长职务。
description.en: Starting from the Anti-Rightist Campaign in 1957, Ma Yinchu and his "New Population Theory" were subjected to nationwide criticism, forcing him to resign as president of Peking University in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央组织部长的胡耀邦在审阅马寅初的材料后，推动了为马寅初平反的工作。
description.en: Hu Yaobang, then head of the CCP Central Committee's Organization Department, reviewed Ma Yinchu's case files and promoted his political rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央于1979年批复同意为马寅初平反，恢复其名誉。
description.en: In 1979, the Central Committee of the CCP approved the decision to rehabilitate Ma Yinchu and restore his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 1972年，马寅初患直肠癌，经周恩来总理批示，得以进行手术治疗。
description.en: In 1972, Ma Yinchu was diagnosed with rectal cancer and received surgical treatment following the approval of Premier Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇于1954年主持召开中央第一次人口与计划生育座谈会，并表示党赞成节育。
description.en: In 1954, Liu Shaoqi presided over the first central symposium on population and family planning, stating that the Party approved of birth control.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东于1956年主持制订《全国农业发展纲要》，提倡有计划地生育。
description.en: In 1956, Mao Zedong presided over the formulation of the National Program for Agricultural Development, which advocated for planned childbirth.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初是中国计划生育政策的最早倡导者之一。
description.en: Ma Yinchu was one of the earliest advocates for China's family planning policy.

position.zh-cn: 教授、教务长、校长、名誉校长
position.en: Professor, Dean of Studies, President, Honorary President

description.zh-cn: 马寅初自1915年起在北京大学任教，后担任教务长。1951年至1960年任北京大学校长，1979年被任命为名誉校长。
description.en: Ma Yinchu began teaching at Peking University in 1915 and later served as Dean of Studies. He was the President of Peking University from 1951 to 1960 and was appointed Honorary President in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 马寅初于1949年8月被任命为浙江大学校长，任职至1951年。
description.en: Ma Yinchu was appointed President of Zhejiang University in August 1949 and served until 1951.

description.zh-cn: 1981年2月中国人口学会成立，马寅初被推举为名誉会长。
description.en: When the China Population Association was established in February 1981, Ma Yinchu was elected as its Honorary President.

description.zh-cn: 卢作孚是民生轮船公司的创始人。
description.en: Lu Zuofu was the founder of the Minsheng Shipping Company.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，卢作孚在北碚建成了四川境内最早的北川铁路。
description.en: In 1934, Lu Zuofu completed the construction of the Beichuan Railway in Beibei, which was the earliest railway in Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，北碚区成为陪都重庆的迁建区，接纳了众多内迁的机构和名人如林语堂、梁实秋等，被称为“陪都的陪都”，对其发展和历史地位产生了深远影响。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Beibei District became a relocation area for the wartime capital Chongqing, hosting numerous relocated institutions and famous individuals such as Lin Yutang and Liang Shiqiu. It was known as the 'accompanying capital's accompanying capital,' which profoundly influenced its development and historical status.

description.zh-cn: 刘伯承时任西南军政委员会主席。
description.en: Liu Bocheng was serving as the Chairman of the Southwest Military and Administrative Committee.

description.zh-cn: 于2005年7月与西南农业大学合并组建为西南大学。
description.en: In July 2005, it merged with Southwest Agricultural University to form Southwest University.

description.zh-cn: 于2005年7月与西南师范大学合并组建为西南大学。
description.en: In July 2005, it merged with Southwest China Normal University to form Southwest University.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮出生于江苏省徐州府萧县官桥镇醴泉村，今属安徽。
description.en: Xu Shuzheng was born in Liquan Village, Guanqiao Town, Xiao County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Jiangsu Province, which is now part of Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 1905年被段祺瑞送到日本，1908年入学士官学校步兵科第七期，次年毕业。
description.en: Sent to Japan by Duan Qirui in 1905, he enrolled in the 7th class of the Infantry Department at the Army Officers' School in 1908 and graduated the following year.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮是北洋皖系军阀将领。
description.en: Xu Shuzheng was a general of the Anhui clique of the Beiyang warlords.

description.zh-cn: 《共和之电》以武力威胁，迫使隆裕太后同意宣统退位。
description.en: The 'Telegram of the Republic' used military threat to compel Empress Dowager Longyu to agree to the abdication of the Xuantong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 因常对黎元洪蛮横无理，并与总统府交恶，酿成府院之争。
description.en: His frequent arrogant and unreasonable behavior towards Li Yuanhong and his conflict with the Presidential Palace led to the 'Dispute between the Palace and the Cabinet'.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮策动张勋以辫军驱逐黎元洪，拥立宣统帝复辟。
description.en: Xu Shuzheng instigated Zhang Xun to use the 'Queue Army' to expel Li Yuanhong and restore the Xuantong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 主张武力统一中国，消灭陆荣廷、孙中山的南方护法军。
description.en: Advocated for the military unification of China and the elimination of the southern Constitutional Protection Army led by Lu Rongting and Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 幕后策划督军团对冯国璋施加压力，并组织安福俱乐部，阻止其连任总统。
description.en: He masterminded pressure on Feng Guozhang from the military governors' group and organized the Anfu Club to prevent Feng's re-election as president.

description.zh-cn: 率西北边防军进入外蒙古，以武力胁迫外蒙古王公派在1919年11月17日宣布撤销自治。
description.en: He led the Northwest Frontier Army into Outer Mongolia and used military force to compel the Outer Mongolian nobility to declare the cancellation of autonomy on November 17, 1919.

description.zh-cn: 因徐树铮成功促成外蒙撤治而电贺，对其做出极高评价。1921年计划联合段祺瑞、张作霖组成三角同盟时，徐树铮代表段祺瑞与孙中山会谈。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen sent a congratulatory telegram to Xu Shuzheng for his success in bringing about the cancellation of Outer Mongolia's autonomy and praised him highly. When planning to form a triangular alliance with Duan Qirui and Zhang Zuolin in 1921, Xu Shuzheng represented Duan in talks with Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 直皖战争皖系战败后，徐树铮被指控为“十大祸首”之最而遭通缉，被迫逃亡。
description.en: After the Anhui clique was defeated in the Zhili-Anhui War, Xu Shuzheng was accused of being the foremost of the 'ten great culprits', a warrant was issued for his arrest, and he was forced to flee.

description.zh-cn: 奉冯玉祥之命，在廊坊车站绑架并杀害了徐树铮。
description.en: Under Feng Yuxiang's orders, he kidnapped and killed Xu Shuzheng at Langfang Railway Station.

description.zh-cn: 张之江是冯玉祥的部下。
description.en: Zhang Zhijiang was a subordinate of Feng Yuxiang.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮假借参加第一次世界大战的名义，向日本借款，编练参战军，为其在直皖战争中积累了军事资本。
description.en: Under the pretext of participating in World War I, Xu Shuzheng borrowed money from Japan to train the 'War Participation Army', accumulating military capital for the Zhili-Anhui War.

description.zh-cn: 徐树铮假借参加第一次世界大战的名义，向日本借得巨款，编练参战军。
description.en: Under the pretext of participating in World War I, Xu Shuzheng borrowed a large sum of money from Japan to train the 'War Participation Army'.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯曾评价徐树铮：“又铮其人，亦有小才，如循正轨，可期远到。但傲岸自是，开罪于人特多”。
description.en: Yuan Shikai once commented on Xu Shuzheng: 'Youzheng is a man of some talent. If he follows the right path, he can go far. But he is arrogant and self-righteous, offending many people'.

description.zh-cn: 徐道隣是徐树铮的三子。
description.en: Xu Daolin is the third son of Xu Shuzheng.

description.zh-cn: 1004年，辽国军队兵临澶州与北宋交战，战败后求和，双方的敌对状态以《澶渊之盟》的签订而告终。
description.en: In 1004, the Liao army besieged Chanzhou and fought against the Northern Song. After being defeated, they sued for peace, ending the state of hostility with the signing of the Treaty of Chanyuan.

description.zh-cn: 《澶渊之盟》的签订，促使北宋与辽国进入了长达百余年的和平时期。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Chanyuan pushed the Northern Song and the Liao dynasty into a period of peace that lasted for over a century.

description.zh-cn: 《澶渊之盟》的签订，促使辽国与北宋进入了长达百余年的和平时期。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Chanyuan pushed the Liao dynasty and the Northern Song into a period of peace that lasted for over a century.

description.zh-cn: 1983年9月1日，中华人民共和国国务院批准设立地级濮阳市。
description.en: On September 1, 1983, the State Council of the People's Republic of China approved the establishment of the prefecture-level city of Puyang.

description.zh-cn: 根据记载，仓颉是今南乐县吴村人。
description.en: According to records, Cangjie was from Wucun, in modern-day Nanle County.

description.zh-cn: 仓颉是黄帝时期造字的史官。
description.en: Cangjie was the historian official of the Yellow Emperor who invented Chinese characters.

description.zh-cn: 张其昀是中国文化大学的创办人。
description.en: Chang Chi-yun is the founder of Chinese Culture University.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统蒋中正致函建议将学校原拟校名“远东大学”更名为“中国文化学院”，此建议被创办人张其昀采纳。
description.en: Then-President Chiang Kai-shek sent a letter suggesting that the university's proposed name 'Far East University' be changed to 'Chinese Culture College', a suggestion that was adopted by founder Chang Chi-yun.

description.zh-cn: 张其昀曾担任中华民国教育部部长。
description.en: Chang Chi-yun served as the Minister of Education of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张其昀曾在国立中央大学任教。
description.en: Chang Chi-yun once taught at National Central University.

description.zh-cn: 卢毓骏教授负责中国文化大学的校园建设规划，将华冈学园打造成中国建筑的博物馆，其设计深刻影响了校园的建筑风格和特色。
description.en: Professor Lu Yu-jun was responsible for the campus construction planning of Chinese Culture University, shaping the Hwa Kang campus into a museum of Chinese architecture. His designs profoundly influenced the campus's architectural style and characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 张其昀担任中国文化大学创校至1984年的董事长。
description.en: Chang Chi-yun served as the Chairman of the Board of Chinese Culture University from its founding until 1984.

description.zh-cn: 张镜湖自1984年至2019年担任中国文化大学董事长。
description.en: Chang Ching-hu served as the Chairman of the Board of Chinese Culture University from 1984 to 2019.

description.zh-cn: 王子奇自2022年起担任中国文化大学校长。
description.en: Wang Tzu-chi has been serving as the President of Chinese Culture University since 2022.

description.zh-cn: 吴清基为中国文化大学第19届董事会成员。
description.en: Wu Ching-ji is a member of the 19th Board of Trustees of Chinese Culture University.

description.zh-cn: 国泰人寿赞助中国文化大学女子篮球队，使其成为国泰人寿女篮的幼队体系，促进了其发展。
description.en: Cathay Life Insurance sponsors the women's basketball team of Chinese Culture University, making it a youth team system for the Cathay Life Women's Basketball Team and promoting its development.

description.zh-cn: 在107学年度UBA公开女一级6晋4决赛中，中国文化大学败给世新大学，中止了连霸纪录，两校在女子篮球项目上形成竞争关系。
description.en: In the UBA Women's Open Division 1 quarter-finals of the 107th academic year, Chinese Culture University was defeated by Shih Hsin University, ending its championship streak. The two universities have a rivalry in women's basketball.

description.zh-cn: 华冈艺术学校是中国文化大学“华冈学园”的组成部分，是其附属的教育机构。
description.en: Hwa Kang Arts School is part of the 'Hwa Kang School Garden' of Chinese Culture University and is its affiliated educational institution.

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大学与中华学术院等机构合称为“华冈学园”，共同致力于文化与学术发展。
description.en: Chinese Culture University and Chung-Hwa Academy, along with other institutions, are collectively known as the 'Hwa Kang School Garden', jointly dedicated to cultural and academic development.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三接替马空群担任监察院副院长。
description.en: Lin Rong-san succeeded Ma Kung-chun as Vice President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 郑水枝接替林荣三担任监察院副院长。
description.en: Cheng Shui-chih succeeded Lin Rong-san as Vice President of the Control Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三担任监察院副院长期间，黄尊秋为监察院院长。
description.en: While Lin Rong-san served as Vice President of the Control Yuan, Huang Tsun-chiu was the President.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三是联邦集团的创办人。
description.en: Lin Rong-san is the founder of the Federal Group.

description.zh-cn: 林鸿明是林荣三的姪子。
description.en: Lin Hung-ming is Lin Rong-san's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 陈政忠是林荣三的外甥。
description.en: Chen Cheng-chung is Lin Rong-san's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 陈宏昌是林荣三的外甥。
description.en: Chen Hung-chang is Lin Rong-san's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 1964年于高级部毕业。
description.en: Graduated from the senior division in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 授予林荣三名誉法学博士学位。
description.en: Awarded an honorary Doctor of Laws degree to Lin Rong-san.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三被视为时任总统李登辉在商界的强力支持者。
description.en: Lin Rong-san was considered a strong supporter of then-President Lee Teng-hui in the business community.

description.zh-cn: 聘请林荣三为总统府国策顾问。
description.en: Appointed Lin Rong-san as a National Policy Advisor to the President.

description.zh-cn: 2000年后开始支持民主进步党。
description.en: Began supporting the Democratic Progressive Party after 2000.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三是三重帮重要成员。
description.en: Lin Rong-san was a key member of the Sanchong Gang.

description.zh-cn: 林荣三的联邦集团收购了《自强日报》，并将其改名为《自由日报》（后为《自由时报》），林荣三自任创办人。
description.en: Lin Rong-san's Federal Group acquired the Ziqiang Daily and renamed it the Liberty Daily (later Liberty Times), with Lin serving as its founder.

description.zh-cn: 与兄长林堉琪、林堉璘共同创立。
description.en: Co-founded with his brothers Lin Yu-chi and Lin Yu-lin.

description.zh-cn: 与弟弟林堉璘、林荣三共同创立。
description.en: Co-founded with his younger brothers Lin Yu-lin and Lin Rong-san.

description.zh-cn: 与兄长林堉琪、弟弟林荣三共同创立。
description.en: Co-founded with his elder brother Lin Yu-chi and younger brother Lin Rong-san.

description.zh-cn: 介绍并鼓励林荣三参选立法委员。
description.en: Introduced and encouraged Lin Rong-san to run for legislator.

description.zh-cn: 在1975年立法委员选举中互为竞争对手。
description.en: Were competitors in the 1975 legislative election.

description.zh-cn: 选举林荣三为增额监察委员。
description.en: Elected Lin Rong-san as an incremental Control Yuan Member.

description.zh-cn: 《自由时报》在李登辉执政时期成为旗帜鲜明的“拥李派”，全面支援以李登辉为首的当权派。
description.en: During Lee Teng-hui's presidency, the Liberty Times became a staunch 'pro-Lee faction', fully supporting the ruling faction led by Lee.

description.zh-cn: 出资参与设立联邦银行。
description.en: Invested in and participated in the establishment of Union Bank of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 《联合报》长年抨击李登辉。
description.en: The United Daily News criticized Lee Teng-hui for many years.

description.zh-cn: 于2000年4月12日批准授予林荣三二等景星勋章，并于2008年5月13日授予其二等卿云勋章。
description.en: On April 12, 2000, Lin Rong-san was approved for the Order of Brilliant Star with Grand Cordon, and on May 13, 2008, he was awarded the Order of Propitious Clouds with Grand Cordon.

description.zh-cn: 董卓长期参与汉羌战争，在此过程中崛起，积累了军事经验和部队，为其日后成为军阀奠定了基础。
description.en: Dong Zhuo's long-term participation in the Han-Qiang Wars allowed him to rise in prominence, gain military experience, and build up his forces, laying the foundation for his future as a warlord.

description.zh-cn: 董卓早期在护匈奴中郎将张奂部下担任军司马，参与讨伐汉阳羌人。
description.en: In his early career, Dong Zhuo served as a Major under Zhang Huan, the Protector of the Xiongnu, participating in the campaign against the Qiang people of Hanyang.

description.zh-cn: 吕布在杀死丁原后，成为董卓的义子和核心将领，直至他与王允合谋刺杀董卓。
description.en: After killing Ding Yuan, Lü Bu became Dong Zhuo's adopted son and key general until he conspired with Wang Yun to assassinate him.

description.zh-cn: 李裕民是吉林敦化人。
description.en: Li Yumin is from Dunhua, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 李裕民曾任中国人民保险公司董事长兼总经理。
description.en: Li Yumin served as the Chairman and General Manager of the People's Insurance Company of China.

description.zh-cn: 李裕民是第八届全国政协委员。
description.en: Li Yumin was a member of the 8th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类，李裕民是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page categories, Li Yumin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 李裕民是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Li Yumin is a political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1971年重新加入巫统，后成为联盟的国会副党鞭，并于1978年当选为巫统副主席。
description.en: Rejoined UMNO in 1971, later became the coalition's Deputy Whip in Parliament, and was elected UMNO Deputy President in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 在马哈迪·莫哈末担任首相期间，慕沙希淡担任其副手。
description.en: Musa Hitam served as deputy to Mahathir Mohamad during the latter's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 慕沙希淡接替马哈迪·莫哈末出任马来西亚副首相。
description.en: Musa Hitam succeeded Mahathir Mohamad as the Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 嘉化·峇峇接替慕沙希淡出任马来西亚副首相。
description.en: Ghafar Baba succeeded Musa Hitam as the Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 敦阿都拉萨是东姑阿都拉曼在巫统的接班人。
description.en: Tun Abdul Razak was Tunku Abdul Rahman's successor in UMNO.

description.zh-cn: 辛酉政变后，奕䜣成为议政王，与两宫太后共同执政，掌握了军政大权。
description.en: After the Xinyou Coup, Yixin became the Prince Regent, co-ruling with the two empress dowagers and holding military and political power.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣长期担任总理衙门首席大臣。
description.en: Yixin served as the chief minister of the Zongli Yamen for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 15岁时加入中国共产党，从事党的地下工作。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China at the age of 15 and engaged in underground party work.

description.zh-cn: 14岁时在川至中学参加学生运动。
description.en: Participated in the student movement at Chuanzhi Middle School at the age of 14.

description.zh-cn: 1938年参加牺盟会。
description.en: Joined the Sacrifice League in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 1948年任中共两郧地委副书记。
description.en: In 1948, he served as the Deputy Secretary of the CPC Liangyun Prefectural Committee.

description.zh-cn: 两郧地委隶属于陕南区党委。
description.en: The Liangyun Prefectural Committee was subordinate to the Shannan District Party Committee.

position.en: Director of the Allocation Department, Deputy Minister

description.zh-cn: 1960年任中共中央组织部调配处处长，1964年8月任副部长。
description.en: He served as the Director of the Allocation Department of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee in 1960, and was appointed Deputy Minister in August 1964.

description.zh-cn: 在“文化大革命”初期受迫害，下放“五七”干校劳动，直至1972年7月恢复工作。
description.en: He was persecuted at the beginning of the 'Cultural Revolution' and sent down to a 'May Seventh Cadre School' for labor until his work was restored in July 1972.

description.zh-cn: 他恢复工作后，先担任中共黑龙江省委书记（当时设有第一书记），从1972年7月至1981年。1981年，他转任中共黑龙江省委第二书记，直至1983年2月。随后，于1983年7月再次担任中共黑龙江省委书记，直至1985年10月。
description.en: After resuming work, he first served as Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee (when the position of First Secretary existed) from July 1972 to 1981. In 1981, he was appointed Second Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee, serving until February 1983. Subsequently, in July 1983, he again became the Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee, serving until October 1985.

description.zh-cn: 李力安接替杨易辰担任中共黑龙江省委书记。
description.en: Li Li'an succeeded Yang Yichen as the Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 孙维本接替李力安担任中共黑龙江省委书记。
description.en: Sun Weiben succeeded Li Li'an as the Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在李力安担任中共黑龙江省委书记期间，陈雷是其副手之一。
description.en: While Li Li'an was Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee, Chen Lei was one of his deputies.

description.zh-cn: 在李力安担任中共黑龙江省委书记期间，侯捷是其副手之一。
description.en: While Li Li'an was Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee, Hou Jie was one of his deputies.

description.zh-cn: 1987年当选为中顾委委员，并担任秘书长。
description.en: Elected as a member of the Central Advisory Commission in 1987 and served as its Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 1993年至2001年任当代中国研究所所长。
description.en: Served as Director of the Institute of Contemporary China Studies from 1993 to 2001.

description.zh-cn: 王钊接替李力安担任中共哈尔滨市委第一书记。
description.en: Wang Zhao succeeded Li Li'an as the First Secretary of the CPC Harbin Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李力安接替荣高棠担任中共中央顾问委员会秘书长。
description.en: Li Li'an succeeded Rong Gaotang as the Secretary-General of the CPC Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 朱佳木接替李力安担任当代中国研究所所长。
description.en: Zhu Jiamu succeeded Li Li'an as the Director of the Institute of Contemporary China Studies.

description.zh-cn: 李力安出生于山西省五台县东冶镇槐荫村。
description.en: Li Li'an was born in Huaiyin Village, Dongye Town, Wutai County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党新疆生产建设兵团委员会受中国共产党中央委员会领导，并定期向其报告工作。
description.en: The Communist Party Committee of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps is under the leadership of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and reports its work to it regularly.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党新疆生产建设兵团委员会受中国共产党新疆维吾尔自治区委员会领导，形成双重领导关系。
description.en: The Communist Party Committee of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps is under the leadership of the Communist Party Committee of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, forming a dual leadership relationship.

description.zh-cn: 《中国共产党章程》是中国共产党新疆生产建设兵团委员会的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the Communist Party of China is the legal source of authority for the Communist Party Committee of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党新疆生产建设兵团委员会是新疆生产建设兵团的领导机关。
description.en: The Communist Party Committee of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps is the leading body of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 2022年1月起任副书记、常委，并在6月换届后留任。
description.en: Appointed Deputy Secretary and Standing Committee Member in January 2022, and retained the positions after the election in June.

description.zh-cn: 在第七届委员会中担任常委，在第八届委员会中升任副书记、常委。
description.en: Served as a Standing Committee Member in the 7th committee, and was promoted to Deputy Secretary and Standing Committee Member in the 8th committee.

description.zh-cn: 习五一的家乡是湖北丹江口。
description.en: Xi Wuyi's native place is Danjiangkou, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 1981年于北京师范大学历史系获硕士学位。
description.en: Received a master's degree in history from Beijing Normal University in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 习五一是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Xi Wuyi is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1991年11月至1992年2月在日本冈山大学文学部担任客座研究员。
description.en: Served as a visiting researcher at the Faculty of Letters, Okayama University, from November 1991 to February 1992.

position.zh-cn: 宗教学理论研究室研究员
position.en: Researcher in the Theoretical Studies of Religion Section

description.zh-cn: 2002年至2010年在中国社会科学院世界宗教研究所任研究员。
description.en: Worked as a researcher at the Institute of World Religions, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, from 2002 to 2010.

description.zh-cn: 2010年调入中国社会科学院马克思主义研究院。
description.en: Transferred to the Academy of Marxism, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, in 2010.

position.zh-cn: 科学与无神论研究中心主任
position.en: Director of the Center for Science and Atheism

description.zh-cn: 担任中国社会科学院“科学与无神论研究中心”主任。
description.en: Serves as the Director of the 'Center for Science and Atheism' at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 习五一提出应坚持政教分离原则。
description.en: Xi Wuyi proposed that the principle of separation of church and state should be upheld.

description.zh-cn: 2017年2月，习五一指责中央电视台导演哈文修改传统民谣以迎合宗教禁忌的行为是“逆现代社会世俗化的历史潮流”。
description.en: In February 2017, Xi Wuyi criticized CCTV director Ha Wen's act of altering a traditional folk rhyme to accommodate religious taboos as 'going against the historical trend of secularization in modern society'.

description.zh-cn: 中央电视台导演哈文将传统民谣“二十六，炖猪肉”改为“二十六，炖牛肉”，此举被习五一批评为逆世俗化潮流。
description.en: CCTV director Ha Wen changed the traditional folk rhyme 'On the 26th, stew pork' to 'On the 26th, stew beef', an act criticized by Xi Wuyi as being against the trend of secularization.

description.zh-cn: 2017年5月，习五一质疑央视网直播标题“郭氏祖先是阿拉伯人后裔”违背历史学常识。
description.en: In May 2017, Xi Wuyi questioned a CCTV.com live broadcast title claiming 'The ancestors of the Guo clan are descendants of Arabs' for violating historical common sense.

description.zh-cn: 张德仁出生于广东海口（今属海南省）。
description.en: Zhang Deren was born in Haikou, Guangdong (now part of Hainan Province).

description.zh-cn: 张德仁曾任中共湖南省委常委。
description.en: Zhang Deren once served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Hunan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张德仁曾任中国人民解放军湖南省军区司令员。
description.en: Zhang Deren once served as the Commander of the PLA Hunan Military District.

description.zh-cn: 张德仁拥有中国人民解放军少将军衔。
description.en: Zhang Deren held the rank of Major General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，张德仁是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Zhang Deren is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学高等研究院是清华大学下属的研究实体。
description.en: The Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University is a research entity affiliated with Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 2012年2月，顾秉林担任清华大学高等研究院院长，同时也是该院教员。
description.en: In February 2012, Gu Binglin became the Dean of the Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University, and is also a faculty member.

position.zh-cn: 名誉主任, 名誉院长, 教员
position.en: Honorary Director, Honorary Dean, Faculty Member

description.zh-cn: 自1997年6月成立起，杨振宁担任清华大学高等研究院（原高等研究中心）的名誉主任/院长，同时也是该院教员。
description.en: Since its establishment in June 1997, Yang Chen-Ning has served as the Honorary Director/Dean of the Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University (formerly the Center for Advanced Study) and is also a faculty member.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学高等研究院的地址位于北京市海淀区清华大学科学馆。
description.en: The address of the Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University is at the Science Building, Tsinghua University, Haidian District, Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 清华大学高等研究院位于北京市。
description.en: The Institute for Advanced Study, Tsinghua University is located in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 赵家骧早年曾是吴佩孚招收的幼年兵，隶属于直系军队。
description.en: In his early years, Zhao Jiaxiang was a boy soldier recruited by Wu Peifu, belonging to the Zhili clique's army.

description.zh-cn: 邀请赵家骧进入第二军担任少将参谋长。
description.en: Invited Zhao Jiaxiang to join the Second Army as Major General Chief of Staff.

description.zh-cn: 两人是陆军大学同学。
description.en: They were classmates at the Army University.

description.zh-cn: 两人关系甚好。
description.en: They had a very good relationship.

description.zh-cn: 1945年，赵家骧随杜聿明出任东北保安司令部参谋长。
description.en: In 1945, Zhao Jiaxiang followed Du Yuming to serve as the Chief of Staff of the Northeast Security Command.

description.zh-cn: 赵家骧任金门防卫司令部副司令官时，胡琏是司令官。
description.en: When Zhao Jiaxiang was the Deputy Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, Hu Lian was the Commander.

description.zh-cn: 胡琏作为金门防卫司令官，是国防部长俞大维的下级。
description.en: As the Commander of the Kinmen Defense Command, Hu Lian was a subordinate of the Minister of National Defense, Yu Ta-wei.

description.zh-cn: 于右任是赵家骧的好友。
description.en: Yu Youren was a good friend of Zhao Jiaxiang.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党北京市委员会执行中国共产党中央委员会的指示，并定期向其报告工作。
description.en: The CPC Beijing Municipal Committee implements the directives of the CPC Central Committee and reports its work to it periodically.

description.zh-cn: 在平津战役期间，为准备接管北平市，中共中央和华北局决定组建中共北平市委。
description.en: During the Pingjin Campaign, in preparation for taking over Beiping City, the CPC Central Committee and the North China Bureau decided to establish the CPC Beiping Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1948年12月，中共中央决定组建中共北平市委。
description.en: In December 1948, the CPC Central Committee decided to establish the CPC Beiping Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1948年12月，中共中央华北局决定组建中共北平市委。
description.en: In December 1948, the North China Bureau of the CPC Central Committee decided to establish the CPC Beiping Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1967年4月，北京市委被撤销，由新成立的北京市革命委员会取代其职能。
description.en: In April 1967, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee was abolished, and its functions were taken over by the newly established Beijing Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1971年3月，中共北京市委员会恢复设立，北京市革命委员会的权力随之削弱并最终被取代。
description.en: In March 1971, the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee was re-established, and the power of the Beijing Revolutionary Committee was subsequently weakened and eventually replaced.

description.zh-cn: 2018年12月起任市委常委，2022年6月起任市委副书记。
description.en: Became a Standing Committee member in December 2018, and Deputy Secretary in June 2022.

description.zh-cn: 2021年10月起任市委常委，后任市委副书记。
description.en: Became a Standing Committee member in October 2021, and was later appointed Deputy Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 贾晓晔是周永康的第二任妻子，在周永康原配王淑华去世后与他结婚。
description.en: Jia Xiaoye is the second wife of Zhou Yongkang; they married after the death of Zhou's first wife, Wang Shuhua.

description.zh-cn: 贾晓晔出生于山西省大同市灵丘县。
description.en: Jia Xiaoye was born in Lingqiu County, Datong, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 1986年至1990年就读于中南工业大学，攻读管理工程专业财务管理方向。
description.en: From 1986 to 1990, she studied at Central South University of Technology, majoring in financial management in the management engineering program.

description.zh-cn: 约1995年进入央视经济频道（财经频道前身）工作，担任编辑和栏目编导。
description.en: Around 1995, she joined the CCTV Economics Channel (predecessor of the Finance Channel) and worked as an editor and program director.

description.zh-cn: 因犯受贿罪、利用影响力受贿罪，被湖北宜昌市中院一审判处九年有期徒刑。
description.en: She was sentenced to nine years in prison in the first instance by the Yichang Intermediate People's Court in Hubei for bribery and accepting bribes by using influence.

description.zh-cn: 周永康曾任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Zhou Yongkang once served as the Secretary of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周永康曾任中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: Zhou Yongkang was a member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周永康曾任中央政法委书记。
description.en: Zhou Yongkang once served as the Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中南工业大学与长沙铁道学院、湖南医科大学合并组建为中南大学。
description.en: Central South University of Technology merged with Changsha Railway University and Hunan Medical University to form Central South University.

description.zh-cn: 长沙铁道学院与中南工业大学、湖南医科大学合并组建为中南大学。
description.en: Changsha Railway University merged with Central South University of Technology and Hunan Medical University to form Central South University.

description.zh-cn: 湖南医科大学与中南工业大学、长沙铁道学院合并组建为中南大学。
description.en: Hunan Medical University merged with Central South University of Technology and Changsha Railway University to form Central South University.

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台财经频道是中国中央电视台下属的专业频道。
description.en: The CCTV Finance Channel is a specialized channel under China Central Television.

description.zh-cn: 1950年朝鲜战争爆发后，徐勤先因年龄不足被拒参军，为此咬破手指写血书要求参军才被接受。
description.en: After the Korean War broke out in 1950, Xu Qinxian was initially rejected for military service due to his age. He was only accepted after writing a pledge in his own blood.

description.zh-cn: 徐勤先是1984年华北大演习的指挥者之一。
description.en: Xu Qinxian was one of the commanders of the 1984 North China Military Exercise.

description.zh-cn: 徐勤先曾任第38集团军副军长，后升任军长。
description.en: Xu Qinxian served as Deputy Commander and was later promoted to Commander of the 38th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 1988年被授予少将军衔，1989年5月被开除军籍。
description.en: He was awarded the rank of Major General in 1988 and was expelled from the military in May 1989.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委下达了调兵进京执行戒严的命令。
description.en: The Central Military Commission issued the order to mobilize troops into Beijing to enforce martial law.

description.zh-cn: 时任北京军区副司令的李来柱向徐勤先宣布了中央军委调兵戒严的命令。
description.en: Li Laizhu, then Deputy Commander of the Beijing Military Region, announced the Central Military Commission's order to mobilize troops and enforce martial law to Xu Qinxian.

description.zh-cn: 徐勤先拒绝执行命令的理由是：军委第一副主席赵紫阳没有签署命令，军令不全、不合法，因此不能执行。
description.en: Xu Qinxian's reason for refusing the order was that Zhao Ziyang, the First Vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission, had not signed it, making the military order incomplete, illegal, and therefore unenforceable.

description.zh-cn: 因其在六四事件中的抗命行为，徐勤先被开除中国共产党党籍。
description.en: Xu Qinxian was expelled from the Communist Party of China for his insubordination during the Tiananmen Square events.

description.zh-cn: 因其在六四事件中的抗命行为，徐勤先被军事法院判处五年有期徒刑。
description.en: For his insubordination during the Tiananmen Square events, Xu Qinxian was sentenced to five years in prison by a military court.

description.zh-cn: 出狱后，徐勤先的待遇由正军级降为副军级，其档案显示职务为河北省军区副司令员。
description.en: After his release from prison, Xu Qinxian's status was demoted from full-corps level to deputy-corps level, and his official records list his position as Deputy Commander of the Hebei Military District.

description.zh-cn: 李锐与徐勤先有深交，并曾赋诗称赞其在六四事件中的行为是“一代豪雄硬脊梁”。
description.en: Li Rui had a deep friendship with Xu Qinxian and wrote a poem praising his actions during the Tiananmen Square events as being the 'strong backbone of a generation's hero'.

description.zh-cn: 徐勤先接替李际均，担任中国人民解放军陆军第三十八集团军军长。
description.en: Xu Qinxian succeeded Li Jijun as the commander of the PLA's 38th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 在徐勤先因抗命被撤职后，张美远接替其担任中国人民解放军陆军第三十八集团军军长。
description.en: After Xu Qinxian was dismissed for insubordination, Zhang Meiyuan succeeded him as the commander of the PLA's 38th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 在“蓝白合作”框架下，两党在选举、立法院议事、反罢免运动等多个政治领域进行策略性合作，以整合在野力量对抗执政的民主进步党。
description.en: Under the 'Blue-White Cooperation' framework, the two parties engaged in strategic collaboration in various political fields, including elections, legislative proceedings, and anti-recall movements, to consolidate opposition forces against the ruling Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 蓝白合作的核心目标是整合在野阵营资源、集中票源，以对抗并制衡执政的民主进步党。
description.en: The core objective of the Blue-White Cooperation is to integrate opposition resources and consolidate votes to counter and balance the ruling Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 在君悦会谈中，侯友宜公开念出他与柯文哲之间的私人简讯内容，此举引发了激烈争执，加剧了双方的不信任，是导致协商破裂的关键事件之一。
description.en: During the Grand Hyatt meeting, Hou Yu-ih publicly read out private text messages between him and Ko Wen-je, an act that sparked a heated dispute, deepened mutual distrust, and was one of the key events leading to the breakdown of negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 在中华民国第11届立法院院长选举的第二轮投票中，台湾民众党党团作出不参与投票的决定，使得国民党候选人韩国瑜得以凭借相对多数票当选。
description.en: In the second round of voting for the Speaker of the 11th Legislative Yuan, the Taiwan People's Party caucus decided not to participate, which allowed the KMT candidate Han Kuo-yu to be elected with a plurality of votes.

description.zh-cn: 面对罢免案，与台湾民众党合作，在全台各地举办活动，共同推动“反罢免”运动，呼吁支持者投下不同意票。
description.en: Facing the recall campaign, collaborated with the Taiwan People's Party to organize events across Taiwan, jointly promoting an 'anti-recall' movement and urging supporters to vote against it.

description.zh-cn: 作为国民党主席，号召支持者于4月26日举行“反绿共、战独裁”游行，以抗议检方对罢免案连署的调查行动。
description.en: As the chairman of the KMT, called on supporters to hold the 'Anti-Green-Communism, Fight Dictatorship' rally on April 26 to protest the prosecutor's investigation into the recall petition signatures.

description.zh-cn: 作为民众党主席，亲自出席国民党发起的“反绿共、战独裁”游行以示支持。
description.en: As the chairman of the TPP, personally attended the 'Anti-Green-Communism, Fight Dictatorship' rally initiated by the KMT to show support.

description.zh-cn: 新任国民党主席郑丽文在公开场合首次与民众党主席黄国昌同台，并表示将很快安排正式会面，商讨2026选举合作。
description.en: The newly elected KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun appeared on the same stage with TPP Chairman Huang Kuo-chang for the first time in public, stating that a formal meeting would be arranged soon to discuss cooperation for the 2026 elections.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年立委选举期间，时任国民党籍台中市长卢秀燕公开为民众党候选人蔡壁如站台并共挂看板，此举被视为“蓝白合示范区”。
description.en: During the 2024 legislative election campaign, the then-KMT Taichung Mayor Lu Hsiu-yen publicly endorsed TPP candidate Tsai Pi-ju and shared campaign billboards, an act regarded as a 'Blue-White Cooperation demonstration zone'.

description.zh-cn: 劝退原有意参选2024年基隆市立法委员的党籍成员谢立功，以促成在该选区对国民党候选人林沛祥的礼让。
description.en: Persuaded party member Hsieh Li-kung, who intended to run for the Keelung City legislator seat in 2024, to withdraw in order to yield the race to the KMT candidate Lin Pei-hsiang.

description.zh-cn: 在2024年基隆市立委选举中，民众党未提名候选人并劝退有意参选者，事实性礼让国民党候选人林沛祥，助其最终当选。
description.en: In the 2024 Keelung City legislator election, the TPP did not nominate a candidate and persuaded its potential candidate to withdraw, effectively yielding to the KMT candidate Lin Pei-hsiang and helping him win the election.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党黑龙江省委员会执行中国共产党中央委员会的指示。
description.en: The Heilongjiang Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China implements the instructions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，刘惠为现任副书记。根据第十三届省委名单，他于2022年12月成为常委，并将于2025年8月成为副书记。此关系记录了其现任副书记职务，起始时间基于其成为常委的时间。
description.en: According to the infobox, Liu Hui is the current Deputy Secretary. According to the 13th Provincial Committee list, he became a Standing Committee member in December 2022 and is slated to become Deputy Secretary in August 2025. This relationship records his current role as Deputy Secretary, with the start date based on when he joined the Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 蔡锷与唐继尧共同在云南发动重九起义和护国战争，是亲密的战友。
description.en: Cai E and Tang Jiyao jointly launched the Double Ninth Uprising and the National Protection War in Yunnan, and were close comrades-in-arms.

description.zh-cn: 蔡锷与蒋百里同庚，是莫逆之交。
description.en: Cai E and Jiang Baili were of the same age and were very close friends.

description.zh-cn: 重九起义中，时任云贵总督李经羲被逮捕。
description.en: During the Double Ninth Uprising, the incumbent Viceroy of Yungui, Li Jingxi, was arrested.

description.zh-cn: 1915年11月，在梁启超的帮助下，蔡锷得以从北京潜逃，为发动护国战争做准备。
description.en: In November 1915, with the help of Liang Qichao, Cai E successfully escaped from Beijing to prepare for the launch of the National Protection War.

description.zh-cn: 朱德晚年在回忆录中写到“蔡锷先生影响我整个前半生”。
description.en: In his later years, Zhu De wrote in his memoirs, 'Mr. Cai E influenced the entire first half of my life.'

description.zh-cn: 于1911年辑录曾国藩、胡林翼的治兵言论编成《曾胡治兵语录》。
description.en: In 1911, he compiled the sayings of Zeng Guofan and Hu Linyi on military management into the 'Zeng-Hu's Maxims on Military Affairs'.

description.zh-cn: 《曾胡治兵语录》辑录了曾国藩的治兵言论。
description.en: 'Zeng-Hu's Maxims on Military Affairs' compiles the sayings of Zeng Guofan on military management.

description.zh-cn: 《曾胡治兵语录》辑录了胡林翼的治兵言论。
description.en: 'Zeng-Hu's Maxims on Military Affairs' compiles the sayings of Hu Linyi on military management.

description.zh-cn: 为麻痹袁世凯的监视，蔡锷在北京期间假装与小凤仙过从甚密。
description.en: To mislead Yuan Shikai's surveillance, Cai E pretended to have a close relationship with Xiao Fengxian while in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡锷出任四川督军后因喉病复发，一切事务由罗佩金代行。
description.en: After Cai E became the Military Governor of Sichuan, his throat condition relapsed, and all his duties were carried out by Luo Peijin on his behalf.

description.zh-cn: 李根源与蔡锷、唐继尧等人在昆明发动起义，响应武昌起义。
description.en: Li Genyuan, along with Cai E and Tang Jiyao, launched an uprising in Kunming in response to the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 唐继尧与蔡锷、李根源等人在昆明发动起义，响应武昌起义。
