description.en: Tang Jiyao, along with Cai E and Li Genyuan, launched an uprising in Kunming in response to the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝五岁时，其母刘氏被其父明光宗下令杖杀。
description.en: When the Chongzhen Emperor was five years old, his mother, Lady Liu, was ordered to be beaten to death by his father, the Taichang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝朱由检是明熹宗的异母弟，二人自小感情甚好。
description.en: The Chongzhen Emperor, Zhu Youjian, was the half-brother of the Tianqi Emperor. They had a very good relationship since childhood.

description.zh-cn: 庄烈愍皇后周氏是崇祯帝的皇后。
description.en: Empress Zhuangliemin, née Zhou, was the empress consort of the Chongzhen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱慈烺是崇祯帝的嫡长子。
description.en: Zhu Cilang was the eldest legitimate son of the Chongzhen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱慈烺是庄烈愍皇后周氏所生。
description.en: Zhu Cilang was born to Empress Zhuangliemin, née Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 在生母刘氏被杖杀后，年幼的崇祯帝交由庶母西李（李康妃）抚养。
description.en: After his biological mother, Lady Liu, was beaten to death, the young Chongzhen Emperor was raised by his surrogate mother, West Li (Consort Kang).

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝后改由另一庶母东李（李庄妃）抚养至成人。
description.en: The Chongzhen Emperor was later raised to adulthood by another surrogate mother, East Li (Consort Zhuang).

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝是明朝的最后一位皇帝。
description.en: The Chongzhen Emperor was the last emperor of the Ming dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 后金军队绕道蒙古突破边关，入侵京畿地区，引发己巳之变。
description.en: Later Jin forces bypassed the frontier defenses via Mongolia and invaded the capital region, triggering the Jisi Incident.

description.zh-cn: 己巳之变中后金军队兵临城下，使京城百姓和大臣埋怨诽谤袁崇焕，最终导致崇祯帝在暴怒下受反间计煽动而处死袁崇焕。
description.en: During the Jisi Incident, the Later Jin army besieged the capital, causing citizens and officials to blame and slander Yuan Chonghuan, which ultimately led the enraged Chongzhen Emperor, incited by a disinformation plot, to execute him.

description.zh-cn: 在李自成攻破北京后，崇祯帝于煤山自缢殉国。
description.en: After Li Zicheng captured Beijing, the Chongzhen Emperor committed suicide by hanging himself at Meishan (Coal Hill).

description.zh-cn: 北京城破前夕，崇祯帝逼迫皇后周氏自杀。
description.en: On the eve of Beijing's fall, the Chongzhen Emperor forced Empress Zhou to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 北京城破前夕，崇祯帝挥剑砍伤长平公主，致其左臂被断。
description.en: On the eve of Beijing's fall, the Chongzhen Emperor swung his sword at Princess Changping, severing her left arm.

description.zh-cn: 北京城破前夕，崇祯帝亲手砍杀了昭仁公主。
description.en: On the eve of Beijing's fall, the Chongzhen Emperor personally killed Princess Zhaoren by hacking her with his sword.

description.zh-cn: 王承恩是陪伴崇祯帝在景山自缢的唯一随侍，随后亦自缢殉国。
description.en: Wang Cheng'en was the only attendant accompanying the Chongzhen Emperor when he committed suicide in Jingshan, and he subsequently hanged himself in loyalty.

description.zh-cn: 清朝顺治帝入关后，为崇祯帝发丧并营建思陵，给予其庙号和谥号。
description.en: After entering China proper, Emperor Shunzhi of the Qing dynasty held a state funeral for the Chongzhen Emperor, constructed the Siling Mausoleum for him, and granted him a temple name and posthumous titles.

description.zh-cn: 于永波于1931年9月出生于辽宁复县。
description.en: Yu Yongbo was born in Fu County, Liaoning in September 1931.

description.zh-cn: 1947年9月加入东北民主联军南满独立师。
description.en: Joined the South Manchuria Independent Division of the Northeast Democratic United Army in September 1947.

description.zh-cn: 于1948年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in September 1948.

position.zh-cn: 第四十二军一二四师三七零团政治处宣传股干事
position.en: Officer, Propaganda Section, Political Department, 370th Regiment, 124th Division, 42nd Army

description.zh-cn: 1950年12月作为中国人民志愿军第四十二军的一员参加朝鲜战争。
description.en: Participated in the Korean War in December 1950 as a member of the 42nd Army of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 于永波曾长期在第四十二军及其下属部队任职，历任宣传干事、科长、团政委、师政委等，并于1983年5月升任该军政治委员。
description.en: Yu Yongbo served for a long time in the 42nd Army and its subordinate units, holding positions such as propaganda officer, section chief, regiment political commissar, division political commissar, and was promoted to Army Political Commissar in May 1983.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月任中国人民解放军广州军区司令部办公室主任。
description.en: In December 1978, he was appointed Director of the Headquarters Office of the PLA Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1985年6月任中国人民解放军南京军区政治部主任。
description.en: In June 1985, he was appointed Director of the Political Department of the PLA Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 于1989年11月任总政治部副主任，1992年10月升任主任。
description.en: He became Deputy Director of the General Political Department in November 1989 and was promoted to Director in October 1992.

description.zh-cn: 1992年10月至2002年11月任中央军委委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the Central Military Commission from October 1992 to November 2002.

description.zh-cn: 作为东北民主联军、东北野战军、第四野战军成员参与了第二次国共内战。
description.en: Participated in the Second Chinese Civil War as a member of the Northeast Democratic United Army, Northeast Field Army, and Fourth Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国人民志愿军成员参与了朝鲜战争。
description.en: Participated in the Korean War as a member of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 参与处置1994年的建国门事件。
description.en: Participated in the handling of the 1994 Jianguomen incident.

description.zh-cn: 1985年6月，于永波接替魏金山出任中国人民解放军南京军区政治部主任。
description.en: In June 1985, Yu Yongbo succeeded Wei Jinshan as Director of the Political Department of the PLA Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1989年8月，兰保景接替于永波出任中国人民解放军南京军区政治部主任。
description.en: In August 1989, Lan Baojing succeeded Yu Yongbo as Director of the Political Department of the PLA Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1992年11月，于永波接替杨白冰出任中国人民解放军总政治部主任。
description.en: In November 1992, Yu Yongbo succeeded Yang Baibing as Director of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 2002年11月，徐才厚接替于永波出任中国人民解放军总政治部主任。
description.en: In November 2002, Xu Caihou succeeded Yu Yongbo as Director of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 陈永财是新加坡国立大学的现任校长。
description.en: Tan Eng Chye is the current president of the National University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 尚达曼是现任新加坡总统。
description.en: Tharman Shanmugaratnam is the current President of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡总统依惯例兼任新加坡国立大学校监。
description.en: The President of Singapore serves as the Chancellor of the National University of Singapore by convention.

description.zh-cn: 1962年，马来亚大学位于新加坡的校区独立为新加坡大学。
description.en: In 1962, the Singapore campus of the University of Malaya became independent as the University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 盖兹基金会曾向新加坡国立大学提供多项研究资助，涉及疫苗研发、水资源处理、医疗设备、虹膜识别、结核病及新冠疫情应对等多个领域。
description.en: The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation has provided multiple research grants to the National University of Singapore, covering areas such as vaccine development, water treatment, medical devices, iris recognition, tuberculosis, and COVID-19 response.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡国立大学与佐治亚理工学院合作成立了“亚太物流研究中心”，专注于物流领域的研究与教育。
description.en: The National University of Singapore collaborated with the Georgia Institute of Technology to establish 'The Logistics Institute – Asia Pacific', focusing on research and education in the field of logistics.

position.en: Dean of the University Scholars Programme

description.zh-cn: 王赓武教授曾任新加坡国立大学博学计划的院长。
description.en: Professor Wang Gungwu was the dean of the University Scholars Programme at the National University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: Tommy Koh教授曾任新加坡国立大学香灰莉木学院的院长。
description.en: Professor Tommy Koh was the rector of Tembusu College at the National University of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗的生母是唐睿宗的窦德妃，后追谥为昭成皇后。
description.en: Emperor Xuanzong's birth mother was Consort Dou of Emperor Ruizong, posthumously honored as Empress Zhaocheng.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗是武则天的孙子。
description.en: Emperor Xuanzong was the grandson of Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱中，太子李亨在灵武自行即位，遥尊玄宗为太上皇，实质上结束了玄宗的统治。
description.en: During the An-Shi Rebellion, Crown Prince Li Heng independently ascended the throne in Lingwu, respectfully making Xuanzong the Taishang Huang (Emperor Emeritus), which effectively ended Xuanzong's reign.

description.zh-cn: 李隆基出生于唐朝的东都洛阳。
description.en: Li Longji was born in Luoyang, the Eastern Capital of the Tang Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 李文全是孝定太后的哥哥。
description.en: Li Wenquan was the older brother of Empress Dowager Xiaoding.

description.zh-cn: 朱尧娥是孝定太后所生的女儿。
description.en: Zhu Yao'e was the daughter born to Empress Dowager Xiaoding.

description.zh-cn: 永宁公主是孝定太后所生的女儿。
description.en: Princess Yongning was the daughter born to Empress Dowager Xiaoding.

description.zh-cn: 朱翊镠是孝定太后所生的儿子。
description.en: Zhu Yiliu was the son born to Empress Dowager Xiaoding.

description.zh-cn: 瑞安公主是孝定太后所生的女儿。
description.en: Princess Rui'an was the daughter born to Empress Dowager Xiaoding.

description.zh-cn: 李铭诚是孝定太后的侄子。
description.en: Li Mingcheng was the nephew of Empress Dowager Xiaoding.

description.zh-cn: 1572年，明神宗即位，尊其母为慈圣皇太后。
description.en: In 1572, when the Wanli Emperor ascended the throne, his mother was honored as Empress Dowager Cishang.

description.zh-cn: 在万历初政期间，孝定太后作为摄政者，委任并支持张居正推行改革。
description.en: During the early Wanli period, Empress Dowager Xiaoding, as regent, appointed and supported Zhang Juzheng in implementing reforms.

description.zh-cn: 在万历初政期间，孝定太后重用太监冯保，与张居正形成政治同盟。
description.en: During the early Wanli period, Empress Dowager Xiaoding heavily relied on the eunuch Feng Bao, who formed a political alliance with Zhang Juzheng.

description.zh-cn: 为讨好李贵妃，冯保建议将其与陈皇后并尊为皇太后，提升了其地位。
description.en: To curry favor with Noble Consort Li, Feng Bao suggested honoring her as Empress Dowager alongside Empress Chen, thus elevating her status.

description.zh-cn: 张居正上议，将李贵妃与陈皇后并尊为皇太后，使嫡庶太后没有区别。
description.en: Zhang Juzheng proposed to honor Noble Consort Li as Empress Dowager alongside Empress Chen, eliminating the distinction between the principal and secondary empress dowagers.

description.zh-cn: 严格教导明神宗，曾因其不读书而罚其长跪。
description.en: She strictly educated the Wanli Emperor, once forcing him to kneel for a long time for not studying.

description.zh-cn: 以其子潞王为例，阻止了郑贵妃想让福王朱常洵留在京城为自己祝寿的企图。
description.en: Citing her own son, the Prince of Lu, as an example, she thwarted Noble Consort Zheng's attempt to keep the Prince of Fu, Zhu Changxun, in the capital to celebrate her birthday.

description.zh-cn: 为因建言而被判死罪的御史曹学程向皇帝求情，使其得以释放。
description.en: She interceded with the emperor for the censor Cao Xuecheng, who was sentenced to death for his remonstrance, securing his release.

description.zh-cn: 国本之争最终导致孝定太后所信赖的僧人德清下狱，佛教在宫廷的势力因此受到打击而削弱。
description.en: The dispute over succession ultimately led to the imprisonment of the monk Deqing, who was trusted by Empress Dowager Xiaoding, thereby weakening the influence of Buddhism in the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 笃信佛教，在京师内外兴建大量佛寺，其崇佛行为使佛教在万历年间达到兴盛。
description.en: As a devout Buddhist, she commissioned the construction of numerous temples in and around the capital, and her patronage led to the flourishing of Buddhism during the Wanli era.

description.zh-cn: 在国本之争后，因对母亲崇佛干政不满及郑贵妃等影响，明神宗转而支持道教。
description.en: After the succession dispute, dissatisfied with his mother's use of Buddhism to interfere in politics and influenced by figures like Noble Consort Zheng, the Wanli Emperor shifted his support to Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 孝定太后出生于北直隶顺天府通州漷县永乐店。
description.en: Empress Dowager Xiaoding was born in Yongledian, Kuoxian, Tongzhou, Shuntian Prefecture, Northern Zhili.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝是朱慈焕的父亲。
description.en: The Chongzhen Emperor was the father of Zhu Cihuan.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦于2012年3月11日与金建希结婚。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol married Kim Keon-hee on March 11, 2012.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦是尹起重的儿子。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol is the son of Yoon Ki-joong.

degree.en: Bachelor of Laws, Master of Laws

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦于1979年考入首尔大学法律系，后获得法学学士和硕士学位。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol entered the law department of Seoul National University in 1979 and later obtained bachelor's and master's degrees in law.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦于2021年7月加入国民力量党，并作为该党候选人赢得总统选举。他于2025年5月17日宣布退党。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol joined the People Power Party in July 2021 and won the presidential election as its candidate. He announced his departure from the party on May 17, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦于2022年5月10日就任韩国第20任总统，后因弹劾案于2024年12月14日被停职，2025年4月4日被罢免。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol was inaugurated as the 20th President of South Korea on May 10, 2022. He was suspended from office on December 14, 2024, due to impeachment, and was officially removed on April 4, 2025.

position.zh-cn: 第43任大韩民国检察总长

description.zh-cn: 在文在寅总统任内，尹锡悦被任命为第43任检察总长。
description.en: During President Moon Jae-in's administration, Yoon Suk Yeol was appointed as the 43rd Prosecutor General.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统文在寅任命尹锡悦出任检察总长。
description.en: Then-President Moon Jae-in appointed Yoon Suk Yeol as Prosecutor General.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年大韩民国总统选举中，尹锡悦以0.73%的微弱优势击败对手李在明。
description.en: In the 2022 South Korean presidential election, Yoon Suk Yeol defeated his opponent Lee Jae-myung by a narrow margin of 0.73%.

description.zh-cn: 在崔顺实干政丑闻调查中，时任调查组组长的尹锡悦完成了对前总统朴槿惠的拘留工作。
description.en: During the investigation of the Choi Soon-sil scandal, Yoon Suk Yeol, then head of the investigation team, carried out the detention of former President Park Geun-hye.

description.zh-cn: 在担任首尔中央地方检察厅检察长期间，尹锡悦完成了对前总统李明博的拘留起诉。
description.en: While serving as the chief of the Seoul Central District Prosecutors' Office, Yoon Suk Yeol completed the detention and prosecution of former President Lee Myung-bak.

description.zh-cn: 时任检察总长尹锡悦对卷入丑闻的法务部长曹国展开调查，导致曹国辞职。
description.en: Then-Prosecutor General Yoon Suk Yeol launched an investigation into Justice Minister Cho Kuk, who was embroiled in a scandal, leading to Cho's resignation.

description.zh-cn: 时任法务部长秋美爱因与尹锡悦在多项调查上存在矛盾，下令暂停其检察总长职务。
description.en: Then-Minister of Justice Choo Mi-ae suspended Yoon Suk Yeol from his duties as Prosecutor General due to conflicts over several investigations.

description.zh-cn: 韩国国会以204票赞成通过了针对总统尹锡悦的弹劾动议案。
description.en: The South Korean National Assembly passed the impeachment motion against President Yoon Suk Yeol with 204 votes in favor.

description.zh-cn: 弹劾案的通过导致尹锡悦被立即停职，并在宪法法院裁决后被正式罢免总统职位。
description.en: The passage of the impeachment motion led to Yoon Suk Yeol's immediate suspension from office, and he was formally removed from the presidency after the Constitutional Court's ruling.

description.zh-cn: 韩国宪法法院以8比0一致裁定弹劾成立，尹锡悦总统职务被解除。
description.en: The Constitutional Court of Korea unanimously ruled 8-0 to uphold the impeachment, removing Yoon Suk Yeol from the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 首尔中央地方法院因内乱案等相关调查，对尹锡悦发出了逮捕令。
description.en: The Seoul Central District Court issued an arrest warrant for Yoon Suk Yeol in connection with investigations into sedition and other matters.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦分别于2025年1月15日和7月10日被捕，成为韩国宪政史上首位在任期间及卸任后被多次逮捕的总统。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol was arrested on January 15 and July 10, 2025, becoming the first president in South Korean constitutional history to be arrested multiple times both during and after his term.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年总统选举前夕，安哲秀宣布退选，并与尹锡悦合推单一候选人，支持尹锡悦竞选总统。
description.en: On the eve of the 2022 presidential election, Ahn Cheol-soo announced his withdrawal from the race and formed a single candidacy with Yoon Suk Yeol, endorsing Yoon for president.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦在总统任期内积极推动改善韩日关系，将日本定位为共享普世价值的合作伙伴。
description.en: During his presidency, Yoon Suk Yeol actively promoted the improvement of South Korea-Japan relations, defining Japan as a partner sharing universal values.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦访问日本并与时任首相岸田文雄举行会谈，旨在改善双边关系。
description.en: Yoon Suk Yeol visited Japan and held a summit with then-Prime Minister Fumio Kishida to improve bilateral relations.

description.zh-cn: 尹锡悦在美国进行国事访问期间与美国总统乔·拜登会晤，并在美国国会发表演讲。
description.en: During his state visit to the United States, Yoon Suk Yeol met with US President Joe Biden and delivered a speech to the US Congress.

description.zh-cn: 新疆四·一二政变驱逐了金树仁，为盛世才上台夺取新疆最高权力创造了机会。
description.en: The April 12 Coup in Xinjiang ousted Jin Shuren, creating an opportunity for Sheng Shicai to seize supreme power in the region.

description.zh-cn: 新疆四·一二政变迫使时任新疆省主席金树仁逃离迪化，结束其在新疆的统治。
description.en: The April 12 Coup in Xinjiang forced the then-governor Jin Shuren to flee Dihua, ending his rule in the region.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，盛世才被保送至日本陆军大学公费留学深造，并于1927年毕业。
description.en: In 1923, Sheng Shicai was sent to study at the Army War College in Japan at public expense, graduating in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 在统治新疆前期，盛世才为巩固权力，采取亲苏政策，向苏联寻求军事和经济援助，并曾多次提出加入苏联共产党及将新疆并入苏联。
description.en: In the early period of his rule in Xinjiang, to consolidate power, Sheng Shicai adopted a pro-Soviet policy, seeking military and economic aid from the Soviet Union. He also repeatedly proposed joining the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and annexing Xinjiang to the USSR.

description.zh-cn: 1933年底，苏联出兵并提供武器援助，帮助盛世才击败了军事对手马仲英和张培元，巩固了其在新疆的统治。
description.en: In late 1933, the Soviet Union sent troops and provided arms to help Sheng Shicai defeat his military rivals Ma Zhongying and Zhang Peiyuan, thereby consolidating his rule in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 盛世才在新疆巩固权力的过程中，与军阀马仲英多次发生军事冲突，并在苏联的援助下最终将其击败。
description.en: In the process of consolidating his power in Xinjiang, Sheng Shicai had multiple military conflicts with the warlord Ma Zhongying and ultimately defeated him with Soviet assistance.

description.zh-cn: 张培元与马仲英结成反盛联盟，后被盛世才在苏联的援助下击败，张培元兵败自杀。
description.en: Zhang Peiyuan formed an anti-Sheng alliance with Ma Zhongying but was defeated by Sheng Shicai with Soviet aid, after which Zhang committed suicide.

description.zh-cn: 苏德战争爆发后，盛世才判断苏联即将灭亡，因此开始转向投靠蒋介石的国民政府，改变其亲苏亲共政策。
description.en: After the outbreak of the German-Soviet War, Sheng Shicai predicted the imminent collapse of the Soviet Union, which prompted him to switch allegiance to Chiang Kai-shek's Nationalist Government and abandon his pro-Soviet and pro-communist policies.

description.zh-cn: 在投靠国民政府后，盛世才开始实行反苏政策，驱逐苏联在新疆的人员和军队，并逮捕与苏联有关的人士。
description.en: After aligning with the Nationalist Government, Sheng Shicai implemented an anti-Soviet policy, expelling Soviet personnel and troops from Xinjiang and arresting individuals associated with the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 盛世才于1943年1月加入中国国民党，并出任国民党新疆省党部主任委员，正式归顺国民政府。
description.en: Sheng Shicai joined the Kuomintang in January 1943 and was appointed as the chairman of the KMT's Xinjiang provincial headquarters, formally submitting to the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 1944年国民政府在豫湘桂会战中的失利，使盛世才对其可靠性产生怀疑，从而试图再次投靠苏联以寻找退路。
description.en: The defeat of the Nationalist Government in the 1944 Operation Ichi-Go led Sheng Shicai to doubt its reliability, prompting him to attempt to defect back to the Soviet Union as an escape route.

description.zh-cn: 1944年，在盛世才试图再次投靠苏联时，斯大林拒绝了他的要求，并将其请求归顺的电报转交给蒋介石，直接导致盛世才政治生涯的终结。
description.en: In 1944, when Sheng Shicai attempted to defect back to the Soviet Union, Stalin rejected his request and forwarded the telegram to Chiang Kai-shek, directly leading to the end of Sheng's political career.

description.zh-cn: 在确认盛世才的不可靠后，蒋介石于1944年8月下令将其调离新疆，任命其为农林部长，从而结束了他在新疆的统治。
description.en: After confirming Sheng Shicai's unreliability, Chiang Kai-shek ordered his transfer from Xinjiang in August 1944, appointing him as the Minister of Agriculture and Forestry, thus ending his rule in the region.

description.zh-cn: 张海波的衔级为二级大法官。
description.en: Zhang Haibo holds the rank of Second Grand Justice.

description.zh-cn: 广东省高级人民法院是中华人民共和国最高人民法院的下级法院，业务上受其领导，并可向其上诉。
description.en: The Guangdong High People's Court is subordinate to the Supreme People's Court, receiving its professional guidance and serving as an appellate court to it.

description.zh-cn: 广东省高级人民法院的组织上级是广东省人民代表大会。
description.en: The organizational superior of the Guangdong High People's Court is the Guangdong Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 广东省高级人民法院的组织上级是广东省人民代表大会常务委员会。
description.en: The organizational superior of the Guangdong High People's Court is the Standing Committee of the Guangdong Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国宪法是广东省高级人民法院的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the authorizing legal source for the Guangdong High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国人民法院组织法是广东省高级人民法院的组织法规。
description.en: The Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China is the organizational law for the Guangdong High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 因红罐包装装潢案与加多宝发生法律诉讼。
description.en: Engaged in a legal dispute with JDB Group over the red can packaging and decoration case.

description.zh-cn: 广东高等法院是广东省高级人民法院的前身。
description.en: The Guangdong Higher Court was the predecessor of the Guangdong High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十大闭幕会上，孔绍逊在收到习近平的指示后，与另一名工作人员将胡锦涛带离会场。
description.en: At the closing session of the 20th CCP National Congress, Kong Shaoxun, along with another staff member, escorted Hu Jintao out of the venue after receiving instructions from Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十届一中全会上，胡春华没有入选新一届中央政治局委员，此举被外界视为对团派势力的清洗。
description.en: At the 1st Plenary Session of the 20th CCP Central Committee, Hu Chunhua was not elected to the new Politburo, a move widely seen as a purge of the Tuanpai faction.

description.zh-cn: 事件发生后，中国官方对相关信息进行了严格的审查，中国大陆媒体未对此事进行报道，社交平台上的讨论也遭到了封杀。
description.en: After the incident, Chinese authorities imposed strict censorship on related information. Mainland Chinese media did not report on the matter, and discussions on social media platforms were blocked.

description.zh-cn: 新华社通过其英文推特账号发布了官方解释，称胡锦涛离场是因“身体不适”，试图影响外界对此事件的看法。
description.en: Xinhua News Agency released the official explanation via its English Twitter account, stating that Hu Jintao left because he was 'not feeling well', in an attempt to influence external perceptions of the incident.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛到中国人民解放军总医院为逝世的前总书记江泽民送别，这是他在二十大事件后首次公开露面。
description.en: Hu Jintao went to the PLA General Hospital to pay his last respects to the deceased former General Secretary Jiang Zemin. This was his first public appearance after the incident at the 20th Party Congress.

description.zh-cn: 曾思玉接替陈再道担任武汉军区司令员。
description.en: Zeng Siyu succeeded Chen Zaidao as the commander of the Wuhan Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 因被指支持“百万雄师”冲击中央代表团，陈再道被免去武汉军区司令员职务并遭受批斗迫害。
description.en: Accused of supporting the "Million Heroes" in their assault on the central delegation, Chen Zaidao was dismissed from his post as commander of the Wuhan Military Region and was subsequently persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 因被指支持“百万雄师”，时任武汉军区政委的钟汉华与陈再道一同倒台并遭受迫害。
description.en: Accused of supporting the "Million Heroes," Zhong Hanhua, then political commissar of the Wuhan Military Region, was purged along with Chen Zaidao and persecuted.

description.zh-cn: 在七·二〇事件中，“百万雄师”群众组织围攻了中央代表团成员谢富治。
description.en: During the Wuhan Incident, the "Million Heroes" mass organization besieged Xie Fuzhi, a member of the central delegation.

description.zh-cn: 在七·二〇事件中，“百万雄师”群众组织围攻了中央代表团成员王力。
description.en: During the Wuhan Incident, the "Million Heroes" mass organization besieged Wang Li, a member of the central delegation.

description.zh-cn: 在七·二〇事件中，周恩来紧急搭救了被围困的谢富治。
description.en: During the Wuhan Incident, Zhou Enlai urgently rescued the besieged Xie Fuzhi.

description.zh-cn: 陈再道接替吴克华担任中国人民解放军铁道兵司令员。
description.en: Chen Zaidao succeeded Wu Kehua as the commander of the PLA Railway Corps.

description.zh-cn: 1940年初，陈再道率冀南军区部队围攻国军石友三部。
description.en: In early 1940, Chen Zaidao led troops from the Southern Hebei Military Region to besiege the KMT troops of Shi Yousan.

description.zh-cn: 与宋任穷共同率领冀南部队参加百团大战。
description.en: Jointly led troops from Southern Hebei to participate in the Hundred Regiments Offensive with Song Renqiong.

description.zh-cn: 在淮海战役中，陈再道率部参与堵截合围黄维兵团。
description.en: During the Huaihai Campaign, Chen Zaidao led his troops to intercept and encircle Huang Wei's army group.

description.zh-cn: 陈毅盛赞陈再道为“再道之勇”。
description.en: Chen Yi praised Chen Zaidao for his bravery.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，陈再道在六四事件中反对出动军队实行戒严镇压民众。
description.en: It is reported that Chen Zaidao opposed the use of troops and the imposition of martial law to suppress the populace during the June Fourth Incident.

description.zh-cn: 上海市人民政府和中国科学院共同举办、建设上海科技大学。
description.en: The Shanghai Municipal People's Government and the Chinese Academy of Sciences jointly established and built ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 中国科学院和上海市人民政府共同举办、建设上海科技大学。
description.en: The Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Shanghai Municipal People's Government jointly established and built ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 上海科技大学由上海市人民政府主管。
description.en: ShanghaiTech University is supervised by the Shanghai Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 教育部于2012年4月28日发函同意筹建上海科技大学，并于2013年9月30日批准同意正式建立。
description.en: The Ministry of Education issued a letter on April 28, 2012, agreeing to the preparatory establishment of ShanghaiTech University, and approved its formal establishment on September 30, 2013.

description.zh-cn: 江绵恒于2014年2月至2024年6月担任上海科技大学首任校长。
description.en: Jiang Mianheng served as the first President of ShanghaiTech University from February 2014 to June 2024.

description.zh-cn: 封东来于2024年6月起担任上海科技大学校长。
description.en: Feng Donglai has been serving as the President of ShanghaiTech University since June 2024.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央政治局委员、上海市委书记韩正赴上海科技大学调研。
description.en: Han Zheng, then a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Shanghai, inspected ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘延东考察了上海科技大学。
description.en: Liu Yandong, then a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, inspected ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席江泽民考察了上海科技大学。
description.en: Jiang Zemin, former General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, inspected ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局委员、上海市委书记李强一行调研上海科技大学。
description.en: Li Qiang, a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Party Secretary of Shanghai, inspected ShanghaiTech University.

description.zh-cn: 作为特邀嘉宾出席上海科技大学2018届毕业典礼并作主旨演讲。
description.en: Attended the 2018 graduation ceremony of ShanghaiTech University as a special guest and delivered a keynote speech.

description.zh-cn: 上海科技大学与芝加哥大学签署了合作协议与合作备忘录。
description.en: ShanghaiTech University has signed a cooperation agreement and a memorandum of understanding with the University of Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 上海科技大学与加州大学伯克利分校签署了合作协议。
description.en: ShanghaiTech University has signed a cooperation agreement with the University of California, Berkeley.

description.zh-cn: 上海科技大学与麻省理工学院开展本科生交换项目。
description.en: ShanghaiTech University conducts an undergraduate exchange program with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 巴音朝鲁接替白春礼担任全国人民代表大会民族委员会主任委员。
description.en: Bayanqolu succeeded Bai Chunli as Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，王志民是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Wang Zhimin was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，安兆庆是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, An Zhaoqing was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，肖开提·依明是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Shohrat Zakir was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，沙尔合提·阿汗是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Sarhat Ahan was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，白尚成是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Bai Shangcheng was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，黄俊华是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Huang Junhua was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，苻彩香是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Fu Caixiang was his deputy.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会民族委员会副主任委员
position.en: Vice Chairman of the Ethnic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大民族委员会主任委员期间，林锐是其副手。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Chairman of the NPC Ethnic Affairs Committee, Lin Rui was his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任全国人大环境与资源保护委员会副主任委员期间，高虎城是该委员会的主任委员。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Vice Chairman of the NPC Environment Protection and Resources Conservation Committee, Gao Hucheng was the Chairman of the committee.

description.zh-cn: 巴音朝鲁担任中共吉林省委书记期间，习近平是中共中央总书记。
description.en: While Bayanqolu served as Secretary of the CCP Jilin Provincial Committee, Xi Jinping was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 巴音朝鲁接替王儒林担任中共吉林省委书记、吉林省人民政府省长、吉林省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Bayanqolu succeeded Wang Rulin as CCP Jilin Provincial Committee Secretary, Governor of Jilin Provincial People's Government, and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jilin Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 景俊海接替巴音朝鲁担任中共吉林省委书记及吉林省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Jing Junhai succeeded Bayanqolu as Secretary of the CCP Jilin Provincial Committee and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jilin Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任中共吉林省委书记期间，蒋超良担任吉林省省长及省委副书记。
description.en: While Bayanqolu was the Party Secretary of Jilin, Jiang Chaoliang served as the Governor and Deputy Party Secretary of Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任中共吉林省委书记期间，刘国中担任吉林省省长及省委副书记。
description.en: While Bayanqolu was the Party Secretary of Jilin, Liu Guozhong served as the Governor and Deputy Party Secretary of Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任中共吉林省委书记期间，景俊海担任吉林省省长及省委副书记。
description.en: While Bayanqolu was the Party Secretary of Jilin, Jing Junhai served as the Governor and Deputy Party Secretary of Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 蒋超良接替巴音朝鲁担任吉林省人民政府省长。
description.en: Jiang Chaoliang succeeded Bayanqolu as Governor of the Jilin Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 在巴音朝鲁担任共青团中央书记处书记期间，李克强是团中央第一书记。
description.en: While Bayanqolu was a secretary in the Secretariat of the CYL Central Committee, Li Keqiang was the First Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴国是巴音朝鲁担任中共宁波市委书记时的前任。
description.en: Huang Xingguo was Bayanqolu's predecessor as the CCP Secretary of Ningbo.

description.zh-cn: 王辉忠接替巴音朝鲁担任中共宁波市委书记。
description.en: Wang Huizhong succeeded Bayanqolu as the CCP Secretary of Ningbo.

description.zh-cn: 王国发是巴音朝鲁担任吉林省政协主席时的前任。
description.en: Wang Guofa was Bayanqolu's predecessor as Chairman of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 黄燕明接替巴音朝鲁担任吉林省政协主席。
description.en: Huang Yanming succeeded Bayanqolu as Chairman of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 刘鹏是巴音朝鲁担任中华全国青年联合会主席时的前任。
description.en: Liu Peng was Bayanqolu's predecessor as Chairman of the All-China Youth Federation.

description.zh-cn: 孙金龙接替巴音朝鲁担任中华全国青年联合会主席。
description.en: Sun Jinlong succeeded Bayanqolu as Chairman of the All-China Youth Federation.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思是马克思主义理论的创始人。
description.en: Karl Marx is the founder of Marxist theory.

description.zh-cn: 恩格斯与卡尔·马克思共同创立了马克思主义。
description.en: Friedrich Engels co-founded Marxism with Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 现代共产主义运动以卡尔·马克思的理论为基础。
description.en: The modern communist movement is based on the theory of Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 十月革命被认为是二十世纪共产主义运动的序幕，触发了此后共产主义运动在全球范围的扩张。
description.en: The October Revolution is considered the prologue to the 20th-century communist movement, triggering its subsequent global expansion.

description.zh-cn: 根据毛泽东的说法，“十月革命一声炮响，为我们送来了马克思列宁主义”。
description.en: According to Mao Zedong, 'A gunshot from the October Revolution brought us Marxism-Leninism'.

description.zh-cn: 霍查主义是指恩维尔·霍查的思想和实践。
description.en: Hoxhaism refers to the thoughts and practices of Enver Hoxha.

description.zh-cn: 霍查强烈谴责毛泽东的“三个世界”理论是修正主义。
description.en: Hoxha strongly condemned Mao Zedong's 'Three Worlds Theory' as revisionism.

description.zh-cn: 霍查主义认为毛泽东思想是农民的民粹主义思想而非无产阶级革命思想。
description.en: Hoxhaism considers Mao Zedong Thought to be a peasant populist ideology rather than a proletarian revolutionary one.

description.zh-cn: 卢森堡主义是罗莎·卢森堡的马克思主义思想。
description.en: Luxemburgism is the Marxist thought of Rosa Luxemburg.

description.zh-cn: 卢森堡主义反对列宁主义的威权主义思想。
description.en: Luxemburgism opposes the authoritarian ideas of Leninism.

description.zh-cn: 大跃进运动对中国的发展造成严重破坏。
description.en: The Great Leap Forward movement caused severe damage to China's development.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放后，邓小平对毛泽东的许多政策及思想进行了修正。
description.en: After the Reform and Opening-up, Deng Xiaoping revised many of Mao Zedong's policies and ideas.

description.zh-cn: 《共产主义黑皮书》旨在记录并谴责共产主义政权下的人权侵犯行为，估计造成了八千五百万人至一亿人死亡。
description.en: The Black Book of Communism aims to document and condemn human rights violations under communist regimes, estimating between 85 and 100 million deaths.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普谴责称，几乎所有的社会主义或共产主义都导致了苦难、腐败和腐朽，世界上所有国家都应该抵制社会主义。
description.en: U.S. President Donald Trump condemned that nearly all socialism or communism has led to suffering, corruption, and decay, and that all nations of the world should resist socialism.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英于1990年创办壹传媒集团。
description.en: Jimmy Lai founded the Next Media group in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英曾两度担任壹传媒董事会主席。
description.en: Jimmy Lai served as the Chairman of the Board of Next Digital on two separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英是佐丹奴的创办人。
description.en: Jimmy Lai is the founder of Giordano.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英于1995年创办《苹果日报》。
description.en: Jimmy Lai founded Apple Daily in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英于1947年12月8日出生于中华民国广州市。
description.en: Jimmy Lai was born on December 8, 1947, in Guangzhou, Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 黎见恩是黎智英的长子。
description.en: Lai Kin-yan is the eldest son of Jimmy Lai.

description.zh-cn: 香港警方依据《港区国安法》以“勾结外国或者境外势力危害国家安全罪”等罪名拘捕黎智英。
description.en: The Hong Kong police arrested Jimmy Lai under the National Security Law on charges including 'collusion with a foreign country or with external elements to endanger national security'.

description.zh-cn: 中国官媒《人民日报》将黎智英称为“祸港四人帮”之首，对其进行严厉批评。
description.en: Chinese state media People's Daily labeled Jimmy Lai as the head of the 'Gang of Four who bring disaster to Hong Kong', severely criticizing him.

description.zh-cn: 被《人民日报》称为“祸港四人帮”之首。
description.en: Was labeled the head of the 'Gang of Four who bring disaster to Hong Kong' by People's Daily.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英于1994年7月在《壹周刊》刊登《给王八蛋李鹏的公开信》，严厉批评时任中国总理李鹏。
description.en: In July 1994, Jimmy Lai published 'An Open Letter to the Bastard Li Peng' in Next Magazine, sharply criticizing then-Chinese Premier Li Peng.

description.zh-cn: 在黎智英批评李鹏后，北京政府封杀了佐丹奴在中国内地的业务，迫使黎智英出售其股份。
description.en: After Jimmy Lai criticized Li Peng, the Beijing government shut down Giordano's business in mainland China, forcing Lai to sell his shares.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英公开批评中共中央总书记习近平是“毛泽东的化身”及“人类有史以来最极端的独裁者”。
description.en: Jimmy Lai publicly criticized CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping as 'the reincarnation of Mao Zedong' and 'the most extreme dictator in human history'.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英在2006至2010年间向香港民主党捐款超过1000万港元。
description.en: Jimmy Lai donated over HK$10 million to the Democratic Party in Hong Kong between 2006 and 2010.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英在2006至2010年间向香港公民党捐款超过1000万港元。
description.en: Jimmy Lai donated over HK$10 million to the Civic Party in Hong Kong between 2006 and 2010.

description.zh-cn: 在2010年“五区公投”期间，黎智英向社民连捐款100万港元。
description.en: During the 'Five Constituencies Referendum' in 2010, Jimmy Lai donated HK$1 million to the League of Social Democrats.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英曾向天主教香港教区荣休主教陈日君捐款2000万港元以推行教会工作。
description.en: Jimmy Lai donated HK$20 million to Joseph Zen, Bishop Emeritus of the Catholic Diocese of Hong Kong, to support church work.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英曾与台湾前倒扁红衫军总指挥施明德秘密开会，讨论如何执行占领中环运动。
description.en: Jimmy Lai held a secret meeting with former Taiwanese anti-government protest leader Shih Ming-teh to discuss how to execute the Occupy Central movement.

description.zh-cn: 2014年5月底，黎智英在香港与美国前副防长保罗·沃尔福威茨会面。
description.en: In late May 2014, Jimmy Lai met with former U.S. Deputy Secretary of Defense Paul Wolfowitz in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 2019年7月8日，黎智英在美国白宫与时任副总统迈克·彭斯会面，讨论香港情况。
description.en: On July 8, 2019, Jimmy Lai met with then-Vice President Mike Pence at the White House to discuss the situation in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 2019年7月，黎智英与时任美国国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥会面，讨论香港修订逃犯条例的发展。
description.en: In July 2019, Jimmy Lai met with then-U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo to discuss the developments of the proposed extradition bill in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月，黎智英在美国国会大厦与时任众议院议长南希·佩洛西会面。
description.en: In October 2019, Jimmy Lai met with then-Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi at the U.S. Capitol.

description.zh-cn: 2020年8月10日，香港警务处国家安全处以涉嫌违反《港区国安法》为由拘捕黎智英。
description.en: On August 10, 2020, the National Security Department of the Hong Kong Police Force arrested Jimmy Lai on suspicion of violating the National Security Law.

description.zh-cn: 时任香港保安局局长的李家超首次引用国安法冻结资产的权力，冻结了黎智英持有的公司股份及银行账户财产。
description.en: Then-Secretary for Security John Lee invoked the power under the National Security Law for the first time to freeze assets, targeting Jimmy Lai's company shares and bank account properties.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英因参与2019年10月1日的未经批准游行，被判监禁14个月。
description.en: Jimmy Lai was sentenced to 14 months in prison for participating in an unauthorized procession on October 1, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 黄伟强是壹传媒集团的行政总监，向黎智英汇报。两人一同在欺诈案中被定罪。
description.en: Wong Wai-keung was the Administrative Director of Next Media Group, reporting to Jimmy Lai. Both were convicted in the fraud case.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英于1996年取得英国国籍。
description.en: Jimmy Lai acquired British citizenship in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英出生时即为中华民国国民，后亦持有中华民国居留证。
description.en: Jimmy Lai has been a national of the Republic of China since birth and later also held a ROC residency permit.

description.zh-cn: 黎智英于1960年移居香港，具有中华人民共和国公民身份。香港及中国政府主张其中国公民身份，不承认其英国国籍带来的领事保护权。
description.en: Jimmy Lai moved to Hong Kong in 1960, holding the status of a citizen of the People's Republic of China. The Hong Kong and Chinese governments assert his Chinese citizenship and do not recognize consular protection rights from his British nationality.

description.zh-cn: 吴德于1933年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Wu De joined the Communist Party of China in 1933.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，吴德参与创建冀东抗日联军。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Wu De participated in the creation of the East Hebei Anti-Japanese United Army.

description.zh-cn: 1940年6月，吴德作为中共七大代表赴延安，向毛泽东等人汇报工作。
description.en: In June 1940, Wu De, as a delegate to the 7th National Congress of the CPC, went to Yan'an to report on his work to Mao Zedong and others.

description.zh-cn: 吴德担任中共中央敌后城市工作委员会秘书长时，康生是主持日常工作的副书记。
description.en: When Wu De served as Secretary-General of the CPC Central Committee's Work Committee in Enemy-Occupied Cities, Kang Sheng was the deputy secretary in charge of daily work.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东将彭真、罗瑞卿、陆定一、杨尚昆等人打成“彭、罗、陆、杨反党集团”。
description.en: Mao Zedong labeled Peng Zhen, Luo Ruiqing, Lu Dingyi, and Yang Shangkun as the 'Peng, Luo, Lu, Yang Anti-Party Clique'.

description.zh-cn: 文革开始后不久被任命为北京市革命委员会副主任，后于1973年至1978年担任主任。
description.en: Appointed Vice Chairman of the Beijing Revolutionary Committee shortly after the start of the Cultural Revolution, and later served as Chairman from 1973 to 1978.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山会议后的路线斗争中，吴德的表态深得毛泽东之心，并在处理林彪事件后获得毛泽东称赞。
description.en: During the line struggle after the Lushan Conference, Wu De's statement won Mao Zedong's favor, and he was praised by Mao after handling the Lin Biao incident.

description.zh-cn: 1973年，吴德参加批林批孔运动。
description.en: In 1973, Wu De participated in the Criticize Lin, Criticize Confucius campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在批林批孔运动期间，吴德作为“中央帮助总理认识错误小组”的成员，多次向周恩来发难。
description.en: During the Criticize Lin, Criticize Confucius campaign, as a member of the 'Central Group to Help the Premier Recognize His Mistakes', Wu De repeatedly challenged Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 在批林批孔运动中，吴德同李先念发生矛盾。
description.en: During the Criticize Lin, Criticize Confucius campaign, Wu De had conflicts with Li Xiannian.

description.zh-cn: 江青批评吴德混淆了批林批孔运动的方向。
description.en: Jiang Qing criticized Wu De for confusing the direction of the Criticize Lin, Criticize Confucius campaign.

description.zh-cn: 自批林批孔运动后，吴德同四人帮逐渐产生分歧。
description.en: Since the Criticize Lin, Criticize Confucius campaign, Wu De gradually diverged from the Gang of Four.

description.zh-cn: 吴德与汪东兴、纪登奎、陈锡联等人成为周恩来和四人帮之外的政治势力，有共同的政治立场。
description.en: Wu De, along with Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, and Chen Xilian, became a political force outside of Zhou Enlai and the Gang of Four, sharing a common political stance.

description.zh-cn: 吴德与汪东兴、纪登奎、陈锡联等人成为周恩来和四人帮之外的政治势力，有共同的政治立场。
description.en: Wu De, along with Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, and Chen Xilian, became a political force outside of Zhou Enlai and the Gang of Four, sharing a common political stance.

description.zh-cn: 吴德与汪东兴、纪登奎、陈锡联等人成为周恩来和四人帮之外的政治势力，有共同的政治立场。
description.en: Wu De, along with Wang Dongxing, Ji Dengkui, and Chen Xilian, became a political force outside of Zhou Enlai and the Gang of Four, sharing a common political stance.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，吴德参与发动了批邓、反击右倾翻案风运动。
description.en: In 1975, Wu De participated in launching the campaign to Criticize Deng and Counter the Right-Deviationist Wind to Reverse Verdicts.

description.zh-cn: 吴德在华国锋被确立为接班人后迅速投靠，成为其主要支持者之一。
description.en: After Hua Guofeng was established as the successor, Wu De quickly allied with him, becoming one of his main supporters.

description.zh-cn: 在1976年四五天安门事件时，吴德主张严厉镇压。
description.en: During the 1976 Tiananmen Incident, Wu De advocated for severe suppression.

description.zh-cn: 吴德积极参与了拘捕四人帮的全过程。
description.en: Wu De actively participated in the entire process of arresting the Gang of Four.

description.zh-cn: 吴德在中共十一届三中全会上受到批判，后被撤销政治局委员职务。
description.en: Wu De was criticized at the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CPC and was later removed from his position as a Politburo member.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，根据胡耀邦等人的提议，吴德被选为中共中央顾问委员会委员。
description.en: In 1982, upon the proposal of Hu Yaobang and others, Wu De was elected as a member of the Central Advisory Commission of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 吴德曾担任国家级副职领导人，是党和国家领导人之一。
description.en: Wu De served as a deputy national-level leader and was one of the party and state leaders.

description.zh-cn: 江油市境内的青莲镇据称是唐代诗人李白的故乡，尽管其出生地存在争议。
description.en: Qinglian Town in Jiangyou City is claimed to be the hometown of the Tang dynasty poet Li Bai, although his birthplace is disputed.

description.zh-cn: 小费迪南德·马科斯在2022年菲律宾总统选举中获胜，成为菲律宾总统。
description.en: Ferdinand Marcos Jr. won the 2022 Philippine presidential election and became the President of the Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 萨拉·杜特尔特在2022年选举中当选为菲律宾副总统。
description.en: Sara Duterte was elected Vice President of the Philippines in the 2022 election.

description.zh-cn: 萨拉·杜特尔特是罗德里戈·杜特尔特的女儿。
description.en: Sara Duterte is the daughter of Rodrigo Duterte.

description.zh-cn: 小费迪南德·马科斯是费迪南德·马科斯的儿子。
description.en: Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is the son of Ferdinand Marcos.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾的国名源于西班牙航海家鲁伊·洛佩斯·德比利亚洛沃斯以当时还是王储的费利佩二世的名字命名。
description.en: The name of the Philippines originated from Spanish explorer Ruy López de Villalobos, who named it after Philip II, who was then the Crown Prince of Spain.

description.zh-cn: 菲律宾革命旨在推翻西班牙的殖民统治。
description.en: The Philippine Revolution aimed to overthrow Spanish colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 在菲律宾革命之后，菲律宾于1898年6月12日宣告独立，建立了菲律宾第一共和国。
description.en: Following the Philippine Revolution, the Philippines declared independence on June 12, 1898, establishing the First Philippine Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在菲律宾革命期间，革命阵营内部发生分裂，埃米利奥·阿奎纳多篡夺了安德烈·滂尼发秀的领导权并将其杀害。
description.en: During the Philippine Revolution, a split occurred within the revolutionary camp, where Emilio Aguinaldo seized leadership from Andrés Bonifacio and had him executed.

description.zh-cn: 美国于1899年2月发动美菲战争入侵菲律宾，导致新生的菲律宾第一共和国瓦解。
description.en: The United States launched the Philippine-American War in February 1899, invading the Philippines and causing the collapse of the nascent First Philippine Republic.

description.zh-cn: 美菲战争导致新生的菲律宾第一共和国瓦解。
description.en: The Philippine-American War led to the collapse of the nascent First Philippine Republic.

description.zh-cn: 美西战争后，美国从西班牙手中获得菲律宾主权，开始对菲律宾进行殖民统治，直到1946年菲律宾完全独立。
description.en: After the Spanish-American War, the United States acquired sovereignty over the Philippines from Spain and began its colonial rule, which lasted until the Philippines gained full independence in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，日本占领菲律宾，中断了菲律宾自由邦的统治。
description.en: During World War II, Japan occupied the Philippines, interrupting the rule of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.

description.zh-cn: 日本占领菲律宾期间，于1943年10月建立了菲律宾第二共和国作为傀儡政权。
description.en: During its occupation of the Philippines, Japan established the Second Philippine Republic in October 1943 as a puppet state.

description.zh-cn: 根据《马尼拉条约》，菲律宾共和国于1946年7月4日完全独立并获得美国承认。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Manila, the Republic of the Philippines became fully independent on July 4, 1946, and was recognized by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 为延续其统治，费迪南德·马科斯于1972年下令实行戒严，开始其独裁统治。
description.en: To extend his rule, Ferdinand Marcos ordered the implementation of martial law in 1972, beginning his dictatorial regime.

description.zh-cn: 1986年的人民力量革命导致独裁者费迪南德·马科斯下台并流亡海外。
description.en: The 1986 People Power Revolution led to the ousting of dictator Ferdinand Marcos, who then went into exile.

description.zh-cn: 人民力量革命后，被刺杀的反对派领袖小贝尼格诺·阿基诺的遗孀柯拉蓉·艾奎诺继任总统。
description.en: After the People Power Revolution, Corazon Aquino, the widow of the assassinated opposition leader Benigno Aquino Jr., succeeded to the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 柯拉蓉·艾奎诺是小贝尼格诺·阿基诺的遗孀。
description.en: Corazon Aquino was the widow of Benigno Aquino Jr.

description.zh-cn: 贝尼格诺·阿基诺三世是柯拉蓉·艾奎诺的儿子。
description.en: Benigno Aquino III is the son of Corazon Aquino.

description.zh-cn: 贝尼格诺·阿基诺三世是小贝尼格诺·阿基诺的儿子。
description.en: Benigno Aquino III is the son of Benigno Aquino Jr.

description.zh-cn: 因面临腐败指控，约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达在2001年的人民力量革命中下台。
description.en: Facing corruption allegations, Joseph Estrada was ousted from office during the 2001 People Power Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达下台后，时任副总统的格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约接任总统职位。
description.en: After the ousting of Joseph Estrada, then-Vice President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo assumed the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 罗德里戈·杜特尔特总统上任后发起了大规模的打击贩毒产业的“毒品战争”。
description.en: Upon taking office, President Rodrigo Duterte launched a large-scale "war on drugs" to combat the narcotics industry.

description.zh-cn: 小费迪南德·马科斯在2022年菲律宾总统选举中胜选，成为总统。
description.en: Ferdinand Marcos Jr. won the 2022 Philippine presidential election, becoming president.

description.zh-cn: 萨拉·杜特尔特在2022年菲律宾总统选举中获选为副总统。
description.en: Sara Duterte was elected vice president in the 2022 Philippine presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 伊梅尔达·马科斯是费迪南德·马科斯的妻子。
description.en: Imelda Marcos is the wife of Ferdinand Marcos.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕称帝后，对曹植备加迫害，多次将其迁徙封地并削夺其权力。
description.en: After becoming emperor, Cao Pi severely persecuted Cao Zhi, frequently relocating his fiefdom and stripping him of power.

description.zh-cn: 陈群向曹丕建议并设计了九品中正制。
description.en: Chen Qun proposed and designed the Nine-rank system to Cao Pi.

description.zh-cn: 九品中正制的实行，使得士族的政治特权得到确立和巩固。
description.en: The implementation of the Nine-rank system established and consolidated the political privileges of the aristocratic clans.

description.zh-cn: 221年，孙权向曹丕称臣，被册封为吴王。后因拒绝送儿子入朝为人质而关系破裂。
description.en: In 221, Sun Quan submitted to Cao Pi as a vassal and was enfeoffed as the King of Wu. The relationship broke down after he refused to send his son to the Wei court as a hostage.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕发动了三次伐吴战争，意图征服孙吴。
description.en: Cao Pi launched three campaigns against Wu with the intention of conquering Sun Wu.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕于187年冬天出生于沛国谯县。
description.en: Cao Pi was born in Qiao County, Pei Principality, in the winter of 187.

description.zh-cn: 亚洲金融风暴期间，时任财政部长安华与首相马哈迪在经济应对策略上产生严重分歧，导致两人关系破裂并最终导致其被革职。
description.en: During the Asian financial crisis, then-Finance Minister Anwar had serious disagreements on economic response strategies with Prime Minister Mahathir, leading to the breakdown of their relationship and his eventual dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪革除安华职务的行为，直接引发了安华支持者上街示威，形成了“烈火莫熄”运动。
description.en: Mahathir's act of dismissing Anwar directly triggered street demonstrations by Anwar's supporters, forming the 'Reformasi' movement.

description.zh-cn: 安华两次因鸡奸罪名成立而被监禁。
description.en: Anwar was imprisoned twice on sodomy convictions.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚联邦法院推翻了安华的第一次鸡奸案罪名，使其无罪释放。
description.en: The Federal Court of Malaysia overturned Anwar's first sodomy conviction, leading to his acquittal and release.

description.zh-cn: 宣布辞去峇东埔国会议员职位，为丈夫安华重返国会让路。
description.en: Resigned as Member of Parliament for Permatang Pauh to pave the way for her husband Anwar to return to Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 此次政治危机导致希望联盟政府倒台，安华在随后的权力竞争中未能成为首相。
description.en: This political crisis led to the collapse of the Pakatan Harapan government, and Anwar failed to become Prime Minister in the subsequent power struggle.

description.zh-cn: 大选产生悬峙议会，经过数日政治博弈，安华最终获得足够支持，被任命为马来西亚第十任首相。
description.en: The general election resulted in a hung parliament. After several days of political maneuvering, Anwar secured enough support to be appointed as the 10th Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 任命其女儿努鲁依莎为首相经济和金融高级顾问，此举引发了关于裙带关系的争议。
description.en: Appointed his daughter Nurul Izzah as Senior Advisor on Economics and Finance to the Prime Minister, a move that sparked controversy regarding nepotism.

description.zh-cn: 新四军是在第二次国共合作的背景下，根据国共两党谈判达成的协议改编而成的军队。
description.en: The New Fourth Army was an army unit reorganized according to an agreement reached through negotiations between the KMT and the CPC under the context of the Second United Front.

description.zh-cn: 新四军由南方八省的红军和游击队整编而成。
description.en: The New Fourth Army was formed by reorganizing the Red Army and guerrilla units from the eight southern provinces.

description.zh-cn: 文本中明确指出新四军主要由项英创建。
description.en: The text explicitly states that the New Fourth Army was primarily founded by Xiang Ying.

description.zh-cn: 新四军由中共中央革命军事委员会领导。
description.en: The New Fourth Army was led by the Central Revolutionary Military Commission of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 新四军被编入第三战区战斗序列。
description.en: The New Fourth Army was incorporated into the order of battle of the Third War Area.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺被任命为新四军军长。
description.en: Ye Ting was appointed as the commander of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 项英被任命为新四军副军长。
description.en: Xiang Ying was appointed as the deputy commander of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 陈毅在皖南事变后被任命为新四军代军长。
description.en: Chen Yi was appointed as the acting commander of the New Fourth Army after the Southern Anhui Incident.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺因其与国民革命军第四军（“铁军”）的渊源，而选择“新四军”这一番号，意在继承其精神。
description.en: Due to his history with the National Revolutionary Army's Fourth Army (the 'Iron Army'), Ye Ting chose the designation 'New Fourth Army' to signify the inheritance of its spirit.

description.zh-cn: 在黄桥战役中，新四军击败了韩德勤率领的国民革命军部队。
description.en: In the Battle of Huangqiao, the New Fourth Army defeated the National Revolutionary Army troops led by Han Deqin.

description.zh-cn: 顾祝同指挥国民革命军部队包围和袭击了皖南的新四军军部。
description.en: Gu Zhutong commanded the National Revolutionary Army forces that encircled and attacked the New Fourth Army headquarters in Southern Anhui.

description.zh-cn: 皖南事变导致新四军军部遭受重大损失，约9000人的部队大部牺牲或被俘。
description.en: The Southern Anhui Incident caused heavy losses to the New Fourth Army headquarters, with most of its approximately 9,000 troops killed or captured.

description.zh-cn: 皖南事变后，蒋介石下令取消新四军番号。
description.en: After the Southern Anhui Incident, Chiang Kai-shek ordered the cancellation of the New Fourth Army's designation.

description.zh-cn: 新四军政治部主任袁国平在皖南事变中牺牲。
description.en: Yuan Guoping, Director of the Political Department of the New Fourth Army, was killed during the Southern Anhui Incident.

description.zh-cn: 项英在皖南事变突围后被其副官刘厚总杀害。
description.en: Xiang Ying was murdered by his adjutant Liu Houzong after breaking out from the Southern Anhui Incident.

description.zh-cn: 周子昆在皖南事变突围后被副官刘厚总杀害。
description.en: Zhou Zikun was murdered by adjutant Liu Houzong after breaking out from the Southern Anhui Incident.

description.zh-cn: 新四军番号撤销后，其主力部队与山东军区一部合编为华东野战军。
description.en: After the designation of the New Fourth Army was abolished, its main forces were combined with parts of the Shandong Military Region to form the East China Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文与张兆和于1933年9月9日结婚。
description.en: Shen Congwen and Zhang Zhaohe married on September 9, 1933.

description.zh-cn: 沈虎雏是沈从文的次子。
description.en: Shen Huchu is the second son of Shen Congwen.

description.zh-cn: 张元和是张兆和的姐姐。
description.en: Zhang Yuanhe is Zhang Zhaohe's elder sister.

description.zh-cn: 张允和是张兆和的姐姐。
description.en: Zhang Yunhe is Zhang Zhaohe's elder sister.

description.zh-cn: 张充和是张兆和的妹妹。
description.en: Zhang Chonghe is Zhang Zhaohe's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文与顾传玠为襟兄弟关系（妻子的姐妹的丈夫）。
description.en: Shen Congwen and Gu Chuanjie were brothers-in-law (husbands of sisters).

description.zh-cn: 沈从文与周有光为襟兄弟关系（妻子的姐妹的丈夫）。
description.en: Shen Congwen and Zhou Youguang were brothers-in-law (husbands of sisters).

description.zh-cn: 沈从文与傅汉思为襟兄弟关系（妻子的姐妹的丈夫）。
description.en: Shen Congwen and Hans Frankel were brothers-in-law (husbands of sisters).

description.zh-cn: 沈从文出生于清代湖南省凤凰直隶厅。
description.en: Shen Congwen was born in Fenghuang Direct-Controlled Subprefecture, Hunan Province, during the Qing Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1917年高小毕业后，沈从文进入陈渠珍的部队办理杂事，后任其书记。
description.en: After graduating from higher primary school in 1917, Shen Congwen joined Chen Quzhen's troops to handle various affairs and later became his secretary.

description.zh-cn: 1922年，在陈渠珍的支持下，沈从文离开湘西去北京发展。
description.en: In 1922, with the support of Chen Quzhen, Shen Congwen left Xiangxi to pursue his development in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，沈从文在北京大学作为旁听生学习并练习写作。
description.en: In 1923, Shen Congwen studied and practiced writing as an auditor at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 在沈从文初到北京穷困潦倒时，郁达夫给予了他经济上的帮助和支持。
description.en: When Shen Congwen was impoverished upon his arrival in Beijing, Yu Dafu provided him with financial assistance and support.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文与胡也频是共同创办出版社的友人。
description.en: Shen Congwen and Hu Yepin were friends who co-founded a publishing house.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文与丁玲早期是友人，共同创办出版社。
description.en: Shen Congwen and Ding Ling were friends in their early years and co-founded a publishing house.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，因沈从文出版《记丁玲》一书，丁玲与他不再友好。
description.en: In 1934, after Shen Congwen published the book 'The Biography of Ding Ling', their friendship ended.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文于1928年至1930年任教于上海中国公学。
description.en: Shen Congwen taught at the China National Institute in Shanghai from 1928 to 1930.

description.zh-cn: 在中国公学任校长期间，胡适调停了沈从文对女学生张兆和的追求，促成了他们的婚姻。
description.en: While serving as the president of the China National Institute, Hu Shih mediated Shen Congwen's pursuit of his student Zhang Zhaohe, which led to their marriage.

description.zh-cn: 在西南联大教务会议上，刘文典公开表示看不起沈从文，质疑其担任教授的资格。
description.en: At a faculty meeting of Southwest Associated University, Liu Wendian publicly expressed his disdain for Shen Congwen and questioned his qualifications to be a professor.

description.zh-cn: 查良铮认为引荐沈从文到西南联大任教是缺乏眼光的决定。
description.en: Zha Liangzheng believed that recommending Shen Congwen to teach at Southwest Associated University was a shortsighted decision.

description.zh-cn: 杨振声引荐沈从文到西南联大任教。
description.en: Yang Zhensheng recommended Shen Congwen for a teaching position at Southwest Associated University.

description.zh-cn: 1948年，郭沫若等人对沈从文的批判是导致其宣布封笔、中止文学创作的重要原因。
description.en: In 1948, criticism from Guo Moruo and others was a significant reason for Shen Congwen to announce his retirement from literary creation.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，沈从文受到冲击，其珍贵图书资料被烧毁，并曾被安排打扫女厕所。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Shen Congwen was persecuted, his precious books and materials were burned, and he was once assigned to clean women's toilets.

description.zh-cn: 在“破四旧”运动中，沈从文工作室里的几书架珍贵书籍被全部烧毁。
description.en: During the 'Destroy the Four Olds' movement, several shelves of precious books in Shen Congwen's studio were completely burned.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文于1950年至1978年在中国历史博物馆任文物研究员。
description.en: From 1950 to 1978, Shen Congwen worked as a cultural relics researcher at the National Museum of Chinese History.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文于1978年至1988年在中国社会科学院历史研究所任研究员。
description.en: From 1978 to 1988, Shen Congwen worked as a researcher at the Institute of History, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典汉学家、诺贝尔文学奖终审评委马悦然高度评价沈从文，认为他是1988年最有机会获得诺贝尔奖的候选人，并为此奔走。
description.en: Swedish sinologist and Nobel Prize judge Göran Malmqvist highly praised Shen Congwen, considering him the most likely candidate to win the Nobel Prize in 1988 and advocating for him.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文曾于1987年和1988年入围诺贝尔文学奖最后候选名单，非常接近获奖。
description.en: Shen Congwen was a finalist for the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1987 and 1988, coming very close to winning.

description.zh-cn: 文学评论家夏志清对沈从文的文学成就给予高度评价，肯定了其在中国文学史上的重要地位。
description.en: Literary critic Hsia Chih-tsing highly praised Shen Congwen's literary achievements, affirming his important status in the history of Chinese literature.

description.zh-cn: 沈从文撰写并出版了其重要的学术著作《中国古代服饰研究》。
description.en: Shen Congwen wrote and published his important academic work 'A Study of Ancient Chinese Costume'.

description.zh-cn: 国民党实行武力清党后，中国共产党发动了广州起义等一系列武装举事作为回应。
description.en: After the Kuomintang carried out a military purge, the Chinese Communist Party launched a series of armed uprisings, including the Guangzhou Uprising, in response.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际计划在广州发动暴动，其代表罗明纳兹、纽曼等人直接参与了暴动计划的制定与实施。
description.en: The Comintern planned to launch an uprising in Guangzhou, and its representatives such as Lominadze and Neumann were directly involved in the planning and implementation of the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 为反击托洛茨基的批评，斯大林指示中国共产党发动包括广州起义在内的一系列武装暴动。
description.en: To counter criticism from Trotsky, Stalin instructed the Chinese Communist Party to launch a series of armed uprisings, including the Guangzhou Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 张发奎发动的“张黄事变”导致主力部队离开广州，城防空虚，为共产党发动广州起义提供了有利时机。
description.en: The 'Zhang-Huang Incident' initiated by Zhang Fakui led to the main forces leaving Guangzhou, creating a defense vacuum that provided a favorable opportunity for the Communist Party to launch the Guangzhou Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 张发奎调动外围部队回援广州，经过激烈巷战后，于12月13日夺回广州，镇压了起义。
description.en: Zhang Fakui mobilized peripheral troops to return to Guangzhou and, after intense street fighting, recaptured the city on December 13, suppressing the uprising.

description.zh-cn: 广州起义总指挥张太雷在前往前线指挥战斗途中遭民团狙击身亡。
description.en: Zhang Tailei, the commander-in-chief of the Guangzhou Uprising, was killed in an ambush by a civilian militia while en route to command the battle on the front lines.

description.zh-cn: 起义失败后，张发奎被认为负有责任，被迫将广州交给桂系，暂时退出政治舞台。
description.en: After the failure of the uprising, Zhang Fakui was held responsible and forced to hand over Guangzhou to the Guangxi clique, temporarily withdrawing from the political stage.

description.zh-cn: 起义失败后，汪精卫受到压力，被迫出洋前往法国。
description.en: After the failure of the uprising, Wang Jingwei came under pressure and was forced to go abroad to France.

description.zh-cn: 因苏联参与策划广州起义，国民政府于1927年12月14日宣布与苏联断绝外交关系。
description.en: Due to the Soviet Union's involvement in planning the Guangzhou Uprising, the Nationalist Government announced the severance of diplomatic relations with the Soviet Union on December 14, 1927.

description.zh-cn: 托洛茨基严厉批评广州起义，称之为“斯大林派多数在中国造成一个胜利的假象”，是“不折不扣的犯罪”。
description.en: Trotsky severely criticized the Guangzhou Uprising, calling it 'a victorious fiction created by the Stalinist majority in China' and an 'out-and-out crime'.

description.zh-cn: 方之焯出生于浙江镇海。
description.en: Fang Zhizhuo was born in Zhenhai, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 方之焯毕业于复旦大学化学系分析化学专业。
description.en: Fang Zhizhuo graduated from the Department of Chemistry at Fudan University, majoring in Analytical Chemistry.

description.zh-cn: 方之焯是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Fang Zhizhuo is a member of the Communist Party of China.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中国共产党镇江市委员会

description.zh-cn: 方之焯于1994年10月至2001年1月期间担任中共镇江市委书记。
description.en: Fang Zhizhuo served as the Secretary of the CPC Zhenjiang Municipal Committee from October 1994 to January 2001.

description.zh-cn: 方之焯于2001年2月至2008年1月期间担任江苏省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: Fang Zhizhuo served as the Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress from February 2001 to January 2008.

description.zh-cn: 面对鄂图曼帝国的威胁，克罗地亚议会推选斐迪南一世为克罗地亚国王，克罗地亚联合哈布斯堡王朝。
description.en: Facing the threat from the Ottoman Empire, the Croatian Parliament elected Ferdinand I as the King of Croatia, uniting Croatia with the Habsburg dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 以共和国政体加盟南斯拉夫联邦。
description.en: Joined the Yugoslav Federation as a republic.

description.zh-cn: 轴心国入侵导致南斯拉夫王国被支解。
description.en: The Axis invasion led to the dismemberment of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国和义大利王国于当地扶持了傀儡政权——克罗埃西亚独立国。
description.en: Nazi Germany and the Kingdom of Italy established a puppet state, the Independent State of Croatia.

description.zh-cn: 安特·帕韦利奇建立了非法极端民族主义组织——克罗地亚护国军（后改名为“乌斯塔沙”）。
description.en: Ante Pavelić founded the illegal ultranationalist organization, the Croatian Home Guard (later renamed 'Ustaše').

description.zh-cn: 1945年5月8日，人民解放军开进独立国首都萨格勒布，宣布克罗地亚独立国灭亡。
description.en: On May 8, 1945, the People's Liberation Army entered Zagreb, the capital of the Independent State, and declared its demise.

description.zh-cn: 由克罗地亚人约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托所领导的共产党多民族反抗军。
description.en: The multi-ethnic communist resistance army led by the Croat Josip Broz Tito.

description.zh-cn: 克罗地亚军队发动“风暴作战”，迅速瓦解了“塞尔维亚克拉伊纳共和国”政权。
description.en: The Croatian army launched 'Operation Storm', which quickly dismantled the 'Republic of Serbian Krajina' regime.

description.zh-cn: 签订《代顿协议》结束了与联邦军在原南斯拉夫其他地区的战事。
description.en: The signing of the Dayton Agreement ended the hostilities with the federal army in other parts of the former Yugoslavia.

description.zh-cn: 英王爱德华三世主张拥有法兰西王位继承权，并以此为由向法国开战，引发了百年战争。
description.en: King Edward III of England claimed the right to the French throne and declared war on France on this pretext, triggering the Hundred Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 腓力六世宣布收回爱德华三世在法国的所有领地，成为英法两国全面开战的直接原因。
description.en: Philip VI's declaration to confiscate all of Edward III's territories in France was the direct cause for the full-scale war between England and France.

description.zh-cn: 黑太子爱德华指挥英军在普瓦捷战役中取得决定性胜利。
description.en: Edward the Black Prince commanded the English forces to a decisive victory in the Battle of Poitiers.

description.zh-cn: 英王亨利五世率领英军在阿金库尔战役中大败法军，取得了英军在百年战争中的第三次大捷。
description.en: King Henry V led the English army to a great victory over the French at the Battle of Agincourt, marking the third major English victory in the Hundred Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 1429年5月，圣女贞德率领法军成功解除了英军对奥尔良的包围，扭转了战争局势。
description.en: In May 1429, Joan of Arc led the French army to successfully lift the English siege of Orléans, turning the tide of the war.

description.zh-cn: 圣女贞德取得一系列军事胜利后，带领王太子查理前往兰斯完成加冕，使其成为合法的法兰西国王查理七世。
description.en: After a series of military victories, Joan of Arc led the Dauphin Charles to Reims for his coronation, making him the legitimate King of France, Charles VII.

description.zh-cn: 1430年5月，贞德在康白尼之围中被勃艮第派俘虏，后被转交给英格兰。
description.en: In May 1430, Joan of Arc was captured by Burgundian forces during the Siege of Compiègne and was subsequently handed over to the English.

description.zh-cn: 《特鲁瓦条约》剥夺了王太子查理（后来的查理七世）的法兰西王位继承权。
description.en: The Treaty of Troyes disinherited the Dauphin Charles (later Charles VII) from his right to the French throne.

description.zh-cn: 根据《特鲁瓦条约》，英王亨利五世被立为法兰西王位继承人。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Troyes, King Henry V of England was made the heir to the French throne.

description.zh-cn: 为了确保《特鲁瓦条约》的效力，亨利五世与法王查理六世的女儿凯瑟琳结婚。
description.en: To secure the Treaty of Troyes, Henry V married Catherine, the daughter of King Charles VI of France.

description.zh-cn: 1407年，勃艮第公爵无畏的约翰密谋刺杀了法王之弟奥尔良公爵路易。
description.en: In 1407, John the Fearless, Duke of Burgundy, orchestrated the assassination of Louis, Duke of Orléans, the king's brother.

description.zh-cn: 对奥尔良公爵路易的刺杀直接导致了法国内部阿马尼亚克派与勃艮第派的内战爆发。
description.en: The assassination of Louis, Duke of Orléans, directly led to the outbreak of the Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War within France.

description.zh-cn: 在阿金库尔战役后，勃艮第公国与英格兰组成同盟，共同对抗法国王太子查理的势力。这一同盟关系在1435年的阿拉斯会议后结束。
description.en: After the Battle of Agincourt, the Duchy of Burgundy formed an alliance with England against the forces of the Dauphin Charles. This alliance ended after the Congress of Arras in 1435.

description.zh-cn: 在查理五世的任命下，贝特朗·杜·盖克兰作为法军统帅，通过游击战术收复了大量失地。
description.en: Under the appointment of Charles V, Bertrand du Guesclin, as commander of the French army, recovered vast amounts of lost territory using guerrilla tactics.

description.zh-cn: 英军将领约翰·塔尔博特在卡斯蒂永战役中被法军的火炮击败并战死。
description.en: The English commander John Talbot was defeated by French artillery and killed at the Battle of Castillon.

description.zh-cn: 百年战争以英格兰的失败告终，导致其丧失了除加来以外的所有法国大陆领土。
description.en: The Hundred Years' War ended in an English defeat, leading to the loss of all its continental French territories except for Calais.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西王国在百年战争中取得最终胜利，强化了王权，并为国家的统一奠定了基础。
description.en: The Kingdom of France achieved final victory in the Hundred Years' War, which strengthened royal authority and laid the foundation for national unification.

description.zh-cn: 易耀彩是中国人民解放军的将领。
description.en: Yi Yaocai was a general in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，易耀彩被授予中国人民解放军少将军衔。
description.en: In 1955, Yi Yaocai was awarded the military rank of Major General of the People's Liberation Army.

position.zh-cn: 第5执行小组驻张家口中共代表
position.en: CCP Representative of the 5th Executive Group in Zhangjiakou

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战初期，易耀彩担任军事调处执行部第5执行小组驻张家口中共代表。
description.en: During the early stages of the Second Chinese Civil War, Yi Yaocai served as the CCP Representative of the 5th Executive Group of the Military Mediation Executive Department in Zhangjiakou.

description.zh-cn: 易耀彩于1969年8月至1972年1月期间担任北海舰队政治委员。
description.en: Yi Yaocai served as the Political Commissar of the North Sea Fleet from August 1969 to January 1972.

description.zh-cn: 易耀彩接替卢仁灿担任北海舰队政治委员。
description.en: Yi Yaocai succeeded Lu Rencan as the Political Commissar of the North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 郭炳坤接任易耀彩的北海舰队政治委员职务。
description.en: Guo Bingkun succeeded Yi Yaocai as the Political Commissar of the North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 行政长官公署卫兵向请愿民众开枪，造成多人死伤，使得民众的情绪更加愤怒，导致二二八事件演化成全岛性的反抗政府事件。
description.en: Guards at the Administrative Executive Office fired on petitioning civilians, causing multiple casualties, which further enraged the public and caused the February 28 Incident to evolve into an island-wide anti-government movement.

description.zh-cn: 缉私员傅学通为求脱身，向围观群众开枪示警，误击中在自家旁观看的市民陈文溪，致其次日死亡。
description.en: Agent Fu Xue-tong, attempting to escape, fired a warning shot into the crowd of onlookers, accidentally hitting citizen Chen Wen-xi who was watching from near his home, leading to his death the next day.

description.zh-cn: 以杀人罪判处傅学通死刑，褫夺公权终身。
description.en: Sentenced Fu Xue-tong to death for murder and deprived him of his civil rights for life.

description.zh-cn: 以伤害罪判处叶得根4年6个月有期徒刑。
description.en: Sentenced Ye De-gen to 4 years and 6 months in prison for assault.

description.zh-cn: 傅学通上诉后，最高法院将其死刑判决改判为十年有期徒刑定谳。
description.en: After Fu Xue-tong's appeal, the Supreme Court commuted his death sentence to a final verdict of ten years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 邱学强接替胡泽君，担任中华人民共和国最高人民检察院常务副检察长。
description.en: Qiu Xueqiang succeeded Hu Zejun as the Executive Deputy Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 童建明接替邱学强，担任中华人民共和国最高人民检察院常务副检察长。
description.en: Tong Jianming succeeded Qiu Xueqiang as the Executive Deputy Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 章宗祥在日本留学期间，获得明治大学法学士学位。
description.en: During his studies in Japan, Zhang Zongxiang obtained a Bachelor of Laws degree from Meiji University.

description.zh-cn: 章宗祥在日本留学期间，曾入东京帝国大学法科学习。
description.en: During his studies in Japan, Zhang Zongxiang attended the Faculty of Law at Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 章宗祥于1899年留学日本时与曹汝霖结识。1919年五四运动期间，章宗祥在曹汝霖家中访问时一同遭到学生冲击。
description.en: Zhang Zongxiang became acquainted with Cao Rulin while studying in Japan in 1899. During the May Fourth Movement in 1919, Zhang was visiting Cao's home when they were both targeted by students.

description.zh-cn: 在汪精卫行刺摄政王载沣被捕后，时任内城巡警厅丞的章宗祥建议案件由民政部而非刑部处理，最终使得汪精卫免于死刑，被判终身监禁。
description.en: After Wang Jingwei was arrested for attempting to assassinate the regent Zaifeng, Zhang Zongxiang, then head of the Inner City Police Department, suggested the case be handled by the Ministry of Civil Affairs instead of the Ministry of Justice. This ultimately saved Wang from the death penalty, and he was sentenced to life imprisonment instead.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯称帝期间，时任司法总长的章宗祥否定了旨在推动帝制的筹安会的违法性，从而在法律上支持了袁世凯的行动。
description.en: During Yuan Shikai's attempt to become emperor, Zhang Zongxiang, then Minister of Justice, denied the illegality of the Chouanhui (a society promoting the monarchy), thereby legally supporting Yuan's actions.

description.zh-cn: 在该事件中，正在曹汝霖家中的章宗祥被愤怒的学生殴打致脑震荡。
description.en: During this event, Zhang Zongxiang, who was at Cao Rulin's house, was beaten and suffered a concussion by angry students.

description.zh-cn: 章宗祥作为唐绍仪的随从，参加了辛亥革命后的南北议和。
description.en: Zhang Zongxiang participated in the North-South peace negotiations after the Xinhai Revolution as an attendant to Tang Shaoyi.

description.zh-cn: 章宗祥于1912年7月至1914年2月期间，担任中华民国大理院院长。
description.en: From July 1912 to February 1914, Zhang Zongxiang served as the President of the Supreme Court of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1942年3月，章宗祥应时任华北政务委员会委员长王揖唐之邀，出任该委员会的咨询委员。
description.en: In March 1942, at the invitation of Wang Yitang, then chairman of the North China Political Council, Zhang Zongxiang took up the post of advisory committee member of the council.

description.zh-cn: 1942年3月起，章宗祥在与大日本帝国合作的华北政务委员会中担任咨询委员。
description.en: Starting from March 1942, Zhang Zongxiang served as an advisory committee member in the North China Political Council, which collaborated with the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 1905年，章宗祥与董康共同翻译了日本的刑法，并共同提出了《刑律草案稿本》。
description.en: In 1905, Zhang Zongxiang and Dong Kang co-translated the Japanese criminal code and jointly proposed the 'Draft Criminal Code'.

description.zh-cn: 担任驻日公使期间，章宗祥与日方代表西原龟三进行交涉，缔结了西原借款。
description.en: While serving as Minister to Japan, Zhang Zongxiang negotiated with the Japanese representative Nishihara Kamezō to conclude the Nishihara Loans.

description.zh-cn: 章宗祥作为中方代表与日方代表西原龟三进行交涉，以缔结西原借款。
description.en: As the Chinese representative, Zhang Zongxiang negotiated with the Japanese representative Nishihara Kamezō to conclude the Nishihara Loans.

description.zh-cn: 在苏联共产党第二十次代表大会的秘密会议上发表了《关于个人崇拜及其后果》的报告。
description.en: Delivered the speech 'On the Cult of Personality and Its Consequences' at a secret session of the 20th Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 报告系统性地抨击了斯大林在位期间的严重错误和罪行。
description.en: The speech systematically attacked the grave errors and crimes of Joseph Stalin during his rule.

description.zh-cn: 报告的核心内容之一是批判对斯大林的个人崇拜。
description.en: One of the core themes of the speech was the criticism of the cult of personality surrounding Stalin.

description.zh-cn: 该报告是推动“赫鲁晓夫解冻”时期一系列社会和政治改革的关键事件。
description.en: The speech was a key event that propelled a series of social and political reforms during the 'Khrushchev Thaw'.

description.zh-cn: 报告在国际共产主义运动中引发了思想混乱和分裂，例如中苏交恶。
description.en: The speech caused ideological confusion and schisms within the international communist movement, such as the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 该报告是中国共产党与苏联共产党意识形态分歧的开端，是中苏交恶的重要诱因。
description.en: The speech marked the beginning of ideological divergence between the CCP and the CPSU and was a major cause of the Sino-Soviet split.

description.zh-cn: 时任波兰统一工人党第一书记贝鲁特在读到报告后，因遭受强烈刺激突发心脏病猝死。
description.en: Bolesław Bierut, then First Secretary of the Polish United Workers' Party, suffered a fatal heart attack after being severely shocked by reading the report.

description.zh-cn: 会议决定委托赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大上作关于个人崇拜的报告。
description.en: The Presidium decided to entrust Khrushchev with delivering a report on the cult of personality at the 20th Party Congress.

description.zh-cn: 作为专门委员会的负责人，向苏共中央主席团提交了秘密报告的初稿。
description.en: As head of a special commission, he submitted the initial draft of the Secret Speech to the Presidium of the CPSU Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 将从波兰华沙获得的秘密报告讲稿转送给美国中央情报局。
description.en: Transferred the text of the Secret Speech, obtained from Warsaw, Poland, to the Central Intelligence Agency.

description.zh-cn: 在时任总统艾森豪威尔批准下，将秘密报告讲稿披露给《纽约时报》。
description.en: With the approval of then-President Eisenhower, it disclosed the text of the Secret Speech to The New York Times.

description.zh-cn: 批准将秘密报告讲稿披露给媒体，最终由《纽约时报》发表。
description.en: Approved the disclosure of the Secret Speech manuscript to the media, which was ultimately published by The New York Times.

description.zh-cn: 首次在苏联境内将赫鲁晓夫秘密报告的全文公开发表。
description.en: Published the full text of Khrushchev's Secret Speech publicly within the Soviet Union for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜国内对“去斯大林化”的支持者展开了政治清洗。
description.en: Conducted a political purge in North Korea against supporters of de-Stalinization.

description.zh-cn: 参与了推翻赫鲁晓夫的政变。
description.en: Participated in the coup that overthrew Khrushchev.

description.zh-cn: 其代表大会通过决议，认定赫鲁晓夫关于斯大林个人崇拜的报告是错误的。
description.en: Its party congress passed a resolution deeming Khrushchev's report on Stalin's cult of personality to be erroneous.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武担任北京军区首任司令员，后由杨勇接任。
description.en: Yang Chengwu served as the first commander of the Beijing Military Region, succeeded by Yang Yong.

position.en: Acting Chief of the General Staff

description.zh-cn: 在罗瑞卿被打倒后代理总参谋长，后因杨余傅事件被免职，由黄永胜接任军委办事组组长。
description.en: Served as Acting Chief of the General Staff after Luo Ruiqing's downfall, and was later dismissed due to the Yang-Yu-Fu incident. Huang Yongsheng succeeded him as the head of the Military Commission's administrative group.

description.zh-cn: 聂荣臻曾誉杨成武为“模范团政治委员”。
description.en: Nie Rongzhen once praised Yang Chengwu as a 'model regimental political commissar'.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武率领作为先头团的红四团参与长征，参加了飞夺泸定桥等关键战斗。
description.en: Yang Chengwu led the Red 4th Regiment, an advance unit, during the Long March, participating in key battles such as the seizure of Luding Bridge.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武指挥了黄土岭战斗。
description.en: Yang Chengwu commanded the Battle of Huangtuling.

description.zh-cn: 在杨成武指挥的黄土岭战斗中，其所部击毙了日军中将阿部规秀。
description.en: During the Battle of Huangtuling commanded by Yang Chengwu, his troops killed Japanese Lieutenant General Abe Norihide.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武参与指挥了清风店战役。
description.en: Yang Chengwu participated in commanding the Qingfengdian Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 林彪推荐杨成武出任总参第一副总参谋长、中央军委副秘书长。
description.en: Lin Biao recommended Yang Chengwu for the positions of First Deputy Chief of the General Staff and Deputy Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武在罗瑞卿被打倒的过程中，积极参与了对罗瑞卿的揭发和批判。
description.en: During Luo Ruiqing's downfall, Yang Chengwu actively participated in denouncing and criticizing him.

description.zh-cn: 在“八·二五事件”中，毛泽东表明了对杨成武的支持，反对王尚荣、雷英夫等人对杨的批评。
description.en: During the 'August 25th Incident', Mao Zedong expressed his support for Yang Chengwu against criticism from individuals like Wang Shangrong and Lei Yingfu.

description.zh-cn: 在“八·二五事件”中，周恩来表明了对杨成武的支持。
description.en: During the 'August 25th Incident', Zhou Enlai expressed his support for Yang Chengwu.

description.zh-cn: 以杨成武为首的总参党委将副总参谋长张爱萍停职，并成立专案组审查其“罪行”。
description.en: The General Staff Party Committee, led by Yang Chengwu, suspended Deputy Chief of General Staff Zhang Aiping and set up a special task force to investigate his 'crimes'.

description.zh-cn: 据邱会作回忆，杨成武倒台的关键在于其倒向了江青，引起了林彪的不满。
description.en: According to Qiu Huizuo's memoirs, a key factor in Yang Chengwu's downfall was his alignment with Jiang Qing, which caused dissatisfaction from Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武在“杨余傅事件”中被撤销职务并受到看管。
description.en: Yang Chengwu was dismissed from his posts and placed under custody during the 'Yang-Yu-Fu incident'.

description.zh-cn: 林彪在九一三事件中死亡后，毛泽东开始反思杨余傅事件，为杨成武的复出创造了条件。
description.en: After Lin Biao's death in the Lin Biao incident, Mao Zedong began to reconsider the Yang-Yu-Fu incident, paving the way for Yang Chengwu's political rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 江青曾试图提拔复出后的杨成武担任总参谋长。
description.en: Jiang Qing attempted to promote the rehabilitated Yang Chengwu to the position of Chief of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央将杨余傅事件定为“冤案”，为杨成武彻底平反。
description.en: The CPC Central Committee designated the Yang-Yu-Fu incident as a 'wrongful case', completely exonerating Yang Chengwu.

description.zh-cn: 杨成武与杨得志、杨勇并称为中国人民解放军的“三杨”。
