description.en: Yang Chengwu, along with Yang Dezhi and Yang Yong, were known as the 'Three Yangs' of the PLA.

description.zh-cn: 杨东明娶秦基伟之女为妻。
description.en: Yang Dongming married Qin Jiwei's daughter.

description.zh-cn: 德国外交部于1917年1月17日发出了齐默尔曼电报。
description.en: The German Foreign Office issued the Zimmermann Telegram on January 17, 1917.

description.zh-cn: 阿图尔·齐默尔曼是齐默尔曼电报发出时的德国外交国务秘书。
description.en: Arthur Zimmermann was the German State Secretary for Foreign Affairs when the Zimmermann Telegram was sent.

description.zh-cn: 英国情报机关40号室截获并成功破译了齐默尔曼电报，使其秘密外交意图曝光。
description.en: The British intelligence agency Room 40 intercepted and successfully deciphered the Zimmermann Telegram, exposing its secret diplomatic intentions.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本“英国情报机关[[40号室]]”，40号室是英国的一个情报机构。
description.en: According to the text 'British intelligence agency [[Room 40]]', Room 40 was an intelligence agency of the United Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 电报内容被揭露后激怒了美国民众，尤其在齐默尔曼承认其真实性后，成为促使美国于1917年4月对德宣战的关键因素。
description.en: The revelation of the telegram's contents outraged the American public, especially after Zimmermann admitted its authenticity, becoming a key factor that prompted the U.S. to declare war on Germany in April 1917.

description.zh-cn: 在齐默尔曼电报事件等因素的推动下，美国于1917年4月6日向德意志帝国宣战。
description.en: Driven by factors including the Zimmermann Telegram affair, the United States declared war on the German Empire on April 6, 1917.

description.zh-cn: 时任墨西哥总统卡兰萨在评估后认为与德国结盟对抗美国不可行，并于1917年4月14日正式回绝了电报中的提议。
description.en: Then-President of Mexico, Carranza, after evaluation, deemed an alliance with Germany against the U.S. unfeasible and formally rejected the proposal in the telegram on April 14, 1917.

description.zh-cn: 墨西哥当时正陷入内战（墨西哥革命），政局不稳，这是其无法接受德国提议、最终拒绝结盟计划的一个重要原因。
description.en: Mexico was embroiled in a civil war (the Mexican Revolution) at the time, leading to political instability, which was a significant reason it could not accept Germany's proposal and ultimately rejected the alliance plan.

description.zh-cn: 英国皇家海军对大西洋航线的控制使得德国无法向墨西哥提供所承诺的武器和援助，这是墨西哥方面认为该提议不可行的原因之一，从而阻碍了计划的实现。
description.en: The Royal Navy's control over the Atlantic sea lanes made it impossible for Germany to provide the promised weapons and aid to Mexico, which was one of the reasons Mexico considered the proposal unfeasible, thus blocking the plan's implementation.

description.zh-cn: 德国计划于1917年2月1日开始实施无限制潜艇战，并预料到此举可能导致美国参战。齐默尔曼电报正是在此背景下发出，作为应对该情况的预案。
description.en: Germany planned to begin unrestricted submarine warfare on February 1, 1917, and anticipated that this could lead to U.S. entry into the war. The Zimmermann Telegram was sent in this context as a contingency plan.

description.zh-cn: 电报提议墨西哥与德意志帝国结成军事同盟，并承诺助其收复曾割让给美国的领土。
description.en: The telegram proposed a military alliance between Mexico and the German Empire, promising to help it reconquer territories previously ceded to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 日本代表松本烝治在宪法制定过程中，强烈反对一院制，要求实行两院制，促成了参议院的成立。
description.en: During the constitution-making process, Japanese representative Matsumoto Jōji strongly opposed a unicameral system and demanded a bicameral system, which led to the establishment of the House of Councillors.

description.zh-cn: 面对日本方面的反对，联合国军最高司令官总司令部（GHQ）以民选议员为前提，同意保留两院制，从而允许了参议院的成立。
description.en: Facing opposition from the Japanese side, the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (GHQ) agreed to maintain the bicameral system on the condition that its members be popularly elected, thus allowing the establishment of the House of Councillors.

description.zh-cn: 福山哲郎出身于立宪民主党，就任副议长后按惯例脱离党团。
description.en: Fukuyama Tetsurō is from the Constitutional Democratic Party; upon assuming the vice-speakership, he left the party caucus as is customary.

description.zh-cn: 日本天皇会在参议院全体会议大厅出席国会开幕式。
description.en: The Emperor of Japan attends the opening ceremony of the National Diet in the main hall of the House of Councillors.

description.zh-cn: 天津市住房公积金管理中心是天津市人民政府的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Tianjin Housing Provident Fund Management Center is a public institution directly under the Tianjin Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 天津市人民政府是中华人民共和国的一个直辖市级地方政府。
description.en: The Tianjin Municipal People's Government is a municipal-level local government of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 施国兴是江苏如东人。
description.en: Shi Guoxing is from Rudong, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 1960年毕业于扬州师范学院。
description.en: Graduated from Yangzhou Normal University in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 施国兴是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Shi Guoxing is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 任平是孟军的儿子，16岁前跟随母亲姓孟。
description.en: Ren Ping is the son of Meng Jun and used his mother's surname, Meng, until he was 16.

description.zh-cn: 任平是华为公司创始人兼总裁任正非的儿子。
description.en: Ren Ping is the son of Ren Zhengfei, the founder and president of Huawei.

description.zh-cn: 任平毕业于中国科学技术大学。
description.en: Ren Ping graduated from the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 任正非是华为公司的创始人。
description.en: Ren Zhengfei is the founder of Huawei.

description.zh-cn: 任正非担任华为公司的总裁。
description.en: Ren Zhengfei serves as the President of Huawei.

description.zh-cn: 任平1975年10月出生于四川成都。
description.en: Ren Ping was born in Chengdu, Sichuan in October 1975.

description.zh-cn: 任平的籍贯是浙江浦江县。
description.en: Ren Ping's ancestral home is Pujiang County, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 时传祥出生于山东省齐河县赵官镇大胡庄。
description.en: Shi Chuanxiang was born in Dahuzhuang, Zhaoguan Town, Qihe County, Shandong Province.

description.zh-cn: 时任国家主席刘少奇在人民大会堂接见并与时传祥握手，称赞其工作，表示“你掏大粪是人民勤务员，我当主席也是人民勤务员，这只是革命分工不同。”此次接见极大地提升了时传祥的社会地位和声望。
description.en: Then-State Chairman Liu Shaoqi met with and shook hands with Shi Chuanxiang at the Great Hall of the People, praising his work by saying, 'You are a servant of the people for collecting night soil, and I am a servant of the people as the chairman; it's just a different division of labor in the revolution.' This meeting greatly enhanced Shi Chuanxiang's social status and prestige.

description.zh-cn: 刊登了刘少奇与时传祥的合影，扩大了时传祥在全国的知名度。
description.en: Published a photo of Liu Shaoqi and Shi Chuanxiang, which increased Shi Chuanxiang's national fame.

description.zh-cn: 时任北京市副市长的万里到“时传祥班”参加劳动，并自称是时传祥的“第一大弟子”。
description.en: Wan Li, then Vice Mayor of Beijing, participated in labor with the 'Shi Chuanxiang Team' and called himself Shi Chuanxiang's 'first major disciple'.

description.zh-cn: 与时任北京市副市长万里一同到“时传祥班”参加劳动。
description.en: Participated in labor with the 'Shi Chuanxiang Team' along with then-Vice Mayor of Beijing, Wan Li.

description.zh-cn: 在1966年国庆观礼上，时传祥作为北京市观礼团副团长受到毛泽东的接见。
description.en: At the 1966 National Day ceremony, Shi Chuanxiang, as the deputy head of the Beijing delegation, was received by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在1966年国庆招待宴会上，周恩来向时传祥敬酒。
description.en: At the 1966 National Day reception banquet, Zhou Enlai toasted Shi Chuanxiang.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，因与刘少奇的联系，时传祥受到牵连，被打成“工贼”、“粪霸”，遭到揪斗，并于1971年被遣送回原籍，直到1973年8月才被平反。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, due to his connection with Liu Shaoqi, Shi Chuanxiang was implicated, labeled a 'scab' and 'manure tyrant,' subjected to struggle sessions, and sent back to his hometown in 1971. He was not politically rehabilitated until August 1973.

description.zh-cn: 得知时传祥的遭遇后，指示有关部门将其接回北京，并为其政治平反，恢复名誉。
description.en: After learning about Shi Chuanxiang's situation, he instructed relevant departments to bring him back to Beijing, politically rehabilitate him, and restore his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 得知时传祥的遭遇后，与毛泽东一同指示有关部门将其接回北京，并为其政治平反，恢复名誉。
description.en: After learning about Shi Chuanxiang's situation, along with Mao Zedong, he instructed relevant departments to bring him back to Beijing, politically rehabilitate him, and restore his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 倭寇在13至16世纪期间，持续侵扰中国沿海地区。
description.en: The Wokou continuously raided the coastal areas of China from the 13th to the 16th century.

description.zh-cn: 前期倭寇的主要攻击范围包括当时臣服于元朝的高丽。
description.en: The main targets of the early Wokou included Goryeo, which was then a tributary state of the Yuan Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝的海禁政策导致沿海民众不得从事海上经商，是后期倭寇（假倭）形成的重要起因。
description.en: The Ming Dynasty's Haijin policy, which banned private maritime trade, was a significant cause for the formation of the later Wokou ('Jiawo').

description.zh-cn: 隆庆开关使海上贸易合法化，减少了民众因走私而成为倭寇的动机，导致倭寇活动减少。
description.en: The Longqing Switch legalized maritime trade, reducing the incentive for people to become Wokou through smuggling and leading to a decrease in their activities.

description.zh-cn: 汪直是后期倭寇中一个庞大知名的海商集团的首领。
description.en: Wang Zhi was the leader of a large and well-known merchant-pirate group among the later Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 颜思齐是倭寇中较有名的人物之一。
description.en: Yan Siqi was one of the more famous figures among the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 林凤是倭寇中较有名的人物之一。
description.en: Lin Feng was one of the more famous figures among the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 郑芝龙是倭寇中较有名的人物之一。
description.en: Zheng Zhilong was one of the more famous figures among the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 部分倭寇队伍成为日本大名的海军佣兵。
description.en: Some Wokou groups served as naval mercenaries for Japanese daimyō.

description.zh-cn: 前期倭寇的活动目的之一是为了报复蒙朝联军（元日战争）对日本的侵略。
description.en: One of the motivations for the activities of the early Wokou was retaliation for the Mongol-Goryeo invasions of Japan (Yuan-Japan Wars).

description.zh-cn: 前期倭寇的活动目的之一是为了报复女真海盗的掳掠。
description.en: One of the motivations for the activities of the early Wokou was retaliation for the raids by Jurchen pirates.

description.zh-cn: 在元日战争时期，高丽臣服于元朝。
description.en: During the period of the Mongol invasions of Japan, Goryeo was a tributary state of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 日本进入南北朝分裂状态，政府管制力减弱，导致倭寇活动加剧。
description.en: Japan's entry into the divided Nanboku-chō period weakened government control, leading to an intensification of Wokou activities.

description.zh-cn: 怀良亲王因讨伐倭寇有功而受明朝册封。
description.en: Prince Kaneyoshi was enfeoffed by the Ming court for his merits in suppressing the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 怀良亲王是后醍醐天皇的儿子。
description.en: Prince Kaneyoshi was the son of Emperor Go-Daigo.

description.zh-cn: 室町幕府将军足利义满曾进行讨伐倭寇的行动。
description.en: The Ashikaga shogunate's shogun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu conducted campaigns to suppress the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 李成桂因讨伐倭寇有功而获得巨大声望和势力。
description.en: Yi Seong-gye gained great prestige and power for his merits in suppressing the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 李成桂在取代高丽王朝后建立了朝鲜王朝。
description.en: Yi Seong-gye founded the Joseon Dynasty after replacing the Goryeo Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明日贸易的盛行是导致前期倭寇逐渐式微的原因之一。
description.en: The prevalence of the Japan-Ming trade was one of the reasons for the gradual decline of the early Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 明太祖朱元璋实行了海禁政策。
description.en: The Hongwu Emperor, Zhu Yuanzhang, implemented the Haijin policy.

description.zh-cn: 宁波之乱发生后，明朝中断了一切贸易，加强了海禁政策。
description.en: After the Ningbo incident, the Ming court suspended all trade, strengthening the Haijin policy.

description.zh-cn: 据研究，大友宗麟是16世纪后期倭寇行动的实质总指挥，并为其提供物质和武器。
description.en: According to research, Ōtomo Sōrin was the de facto commander of Wokou activities in the late 16th century, providing them with materials and weapons.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗宪曾参与讨伐倭寇的军事行动。
description.en: Hu Zongxian participated in military campaigns to suppress the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 朱纨为杜绝倭寇祸本，主张并严格执行海禁。
description.en: In order to eliminate the root cause of the Wokou threat, Zhu Wan advocated for and strictly enforced the Haijin policy.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜王朝对作为倭寇根据地的对马岛发动了军事进攻，即应永外寇。
description.en: The Joseon Dynasty launched a military attack, the Ōei Invasion, against Tsushima Island, which served as a Wokou base.

description.zh-cn: 戚继光撰写了《纪效新书》。
description.en: Qi Jiguang authored the 'Jixiao Xinshu'.

description.zh-cn: 阿只拔都是知名的倭寇人物之一。
description.en: Ajibaldo was one of the known Wokou figures.

description.zh-cn: 松浦隆信是知名的倭寇人物之一。
description.en: Matsuura Takanobu was one of the known figures associated with the Wokou.

description.zh-cn: 李旦是知名的倭寇人物之一。
description.en: Li Dan was one of the known Wokou figures.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府在第二次国共内战中失利。
description.en: The government of the Republic of China was defeated in the second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府于1949年12月将其所在地迁至台湾，开启了两岸分治的格局。
description.en: The government of the Republic of China relocated to Taiwan in December 1949, initiating the era of cross-strait division.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党是中华人民共和国的创立者和唯一执政党。
description.en: The Communist Party of China is the founder and sole ruling party of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党是中华民国的创建政党，并在1949年后长期在台湾执政。在当代政治中，以其为首的泛蓝阵营坚持使用“中华民国”的正式国号。
description.en: The Kuomintang is the founding party of the Republic of China and was the long-term ruling party in Taiwan after 1949. In contemporary politics, the Pan-Blue Coalition, led by the KMT, insists on using the official name 'Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 该条例以法律形式明确定义了“台湾地区”的范围，包含台湾、澎湖、金门、马祖及政府统治权所及之其他地区。
description.en: This act legally defines the scope of the 'Taiwan Area' to include Taiwan, Penghu, Kinmen, Matsu, and other areas under the government's effective jurisdiction.

description.zh-cn: 该宪法增修条文将中华民国有效统治领土定义为“自由地区”，与“台湾地区”概念在法律上趋同，并与“大陆地区”相对应。
description.en: These constitutional amendments define the effective territory of the ROC as the 'Free Area', which legally converges with the concept of 'Taiwan Area' and is contrasted with the 'Mainland Area'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府提出并坚持“一个中国原则”作为其处理台湾问题的基本方针。
description.en: The government of the People's Republic of China proposes and adheres to the 'One China Principle' as its fundamental policy for handling the Taiwan issue.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的“一个中国原则”否认中华民国作为一个主权国家的地位。
description.en: The 'One China Principle' of the People's Republic of China denies the status of the Republic of China as a sovereign state.

description.zh-cn: 美国联邦政府依照《台湾关系法》来处理与台湾的非官方关系事务。
description.en: The U.S. federal government handles its unofficial relations with Taiwan in accordance with the Taiwan Relations Act.

description.zh-cn: 《中美三个联合公报》是构成美国对华及对台政策的重要基础文件。
description.en: The Three Joint Communiqués are important foundational documents that shape U.S. policy towards China and Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 《六项保证》是美国对台政策的重要准则之一。
description.en: The Six Assurances are one of the key guidelines for U.S. policy towards Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府承认中华人民共和国是代表“中国”的唯一合法政府。
description.en: The U.S. government recognizes the People's Republic of China as the sole legal government representing 'China'.

description.zh-cn: 日本国政府在《旧金山和约》中放弃对台湾及澎湖等岛屿的一切权利，此条约影响了其战后对台立场。
description.en: In the Treaty of San Francisco, the Government of Japan renounced all rights to Taiwan and the Pescadores, which has influenced its post-war stance on Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 日本国政府在《中日联合声明》中对中华人民共和国宣称台湾是其领土的立场表示理解和尊重。
description.en: In the Japan-China Joint Communiqué, the Government of Japan expressed its understanding and respect for the PRC's position that Taiwan is a territory of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 为抗议何祚庥的文章及天津警察抓人事件，逾万名法轮功学员自发前往北京国家信访局上访。
description.en: To protest He Zuoxiu's article and the arrest of practitioners by Tianjin police, over 10,000 Falun Gong practitioners spontaneously went to the National Public Complaints and Proposals Administration in Beijing to appeal.

description.zh-cn: 425上访事件的规模和组织性令江泽民感到震惊和威胁，成为其下定决心镇压法轮功的关键因素。
description.en: The scale and organization of the April 25 Appeal shocked and threatened Jiang Zemin, becoming a key factor in his decision to suppress Falun Gong.

description.zh-cn: 根据文中所引用的法轮功方面及部分国际组织的说法，天安门自焚事件是由中国共产党当局策划导演，旨在栽赃法轮功并为镇压制造舆论支持。
description.en: According to Falun Gong sources and some international organizations cited in the text, the Tiananmen Square self-immolation incident was staged and directed by the Chinese Communist Party authorities to frame Falun Gong and create public opinion support for the suppression.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府否认关于活摘法轮功学员器官的指控，并拒绝外国组织进行独立调查的请求。
description.en: The government of the People's Republic of China denies allegations of live organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners and has refused requests from foreign organizations for independent investigations.

description.zh-cn: 大卫·乔高是大卫·麦塔斯共同撰写了关于中国政府活摘法轮功学员器官的调查报告。
description.en: David Kilgour co-authored the investigative report on organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners by the Chinese government with David Matas.

description.zh-cn: 大卫·麦塔斯与大卫·乔高共同撰写了关于中国政府活摘法轮功学员器官的调查报告。
description.en: David Matas co-authored the investigative report on organ harvesting from Falun Gong practitioners by the Chinese government with David Kilgour.

description.zh-cn: 该调查报告指控中华人民共和国政府系统性地活体摘取法轮功学员的器官，对中国政府的国际形象造成负面影响。
description.en: This investigative report accuses the government of the People's Republic of China of systematically harvesting organs from living Falun Gong practitioners, negatively impacting the Chinese government's international image.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十一届全国政协委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年香港行政长官选举期间，刘梦熊是梁振英的头号支持者，为其积极拉票并公开攻击其对手唐英年。
description.en: During the 2012 Hong Kong Chief Executive election, Lew Mon-hung was a primary supporter of Leung Chun-ying, actively canvassing for him and publicly attacking his opponent Henry Tang.

description.zh-cn: 据刘梦熊指控，梁振英未兑现邀请其加入行政会议和推荐其担任全国政协常委的承诺，此事成为二人关系破裂的导火索。
description.en: According to Lew Mon-hung's accusations, Leung Chun-ying failed to fulfill his promises to invite him to the Executive Council and recommend him for the CPPCC Standing Committee, which became the catalyst for the breakdown of their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 因怀疑在东方明珠石油业务中涉嫌行贿受贿，廉政公署于2013年1月8日拘捕刘梦熊。
description.en: On January 8, 2013, the ICAC arrested Lew Mon-hung on suspicion of bribery in connection with the business of Pearl Oriental Oil.

description.zh-cn: 作为东方明珠石油主席，黄坤与刘梦熊一同被廉政公署拘捕。
description.en: As the chairman of Pearl Oriental Oil, Wong Kwan was arrested by the ICAC along with Lew Mon-hung.

description.zh-cn: 在东方明珠案调查期间，刘梦熊向时任廉政专员白韫六发信，要求其终止调查，此行为后被裁定为妨碍司法公正。
description.en: During the investigation of the Pearl Oriental case, Lew Mon-hung sent letters to the then ICAC Commissioner Simon Peh, demanding him to terminate the investigation, an act later ruled as perverting the course of justice.

description.zh-cn: 因妨碍司法公正罪成，刘梦熊于2010年获颁的铜紫荆星章被香港特区政府褫夺。
description.en: Due to his conviction for perverting the course of justice, the Bronze Bauhinia Star awarded to Lew Mon-hung in 2010 was revoked by the HKSAR Government.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年特首选举期间，于唐英年僭建事件曝光后，刘梦熊高调派发《敦促唐英年退选书》，对其选情造成打击。
description.en: During the 2012 Chief Executive election, after the unauthorized structure scandal of Henry Tang was exposed, Lew Mon-hung high-profilely distributed a 'Letter Urging Henry Tang to Withdraw', dealing a blow to his campaign.

description.zh-cn: 该饭局旨在为梁振英密会新界乡绅以争取选票支持，但因涉及江湖人物而引发黑金政治的争议。
description.en: The dinner was intended to secretly meet with New Territories rural leaders to canvass votes for Leung Chun-ying, but it sparked controversy over 'black gold politics' due to the involvement of a triad figure.

description.zh-cn: 2012年3月4日，时任中央政治局常委习近平在北京会见港区政协委员时，最先与刘梦熊握手。
description.en: On March 4, 2012, then-member of the Politburo Standing Committee Xi Jinping first shook hands with Lew Mon-hung when meeting with Hong Kong CPPCC members in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 在流浮山小桃园饭局中会面。
description.en: Met at the Lau Fau Shan Small Peach Garden dinner.

description.zh-cn: 公开声援和支持为三聚氰胺奶粉受害儿童维权的赵连海。
description.en: Publicly voiced solidarity with and supported Zhao Lianhai, who advocated for the victims of the melamine-tainted milk powder.

description.zh-cn: 就孔庆东发表辱骂港人言论一事，刘梦熊公开批评其言论违背北大精神及和谐社会理念。
description.en: Regarding Kong Qingdong's derogatory remarks about Hong Kong people, Lew Mon-hung publicly criticized his statements as contrary to the spirit of Peking University and the concept of a harmonious society.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第十四次全国代表大会选举产生了第十四届中央委员会。
description.en: The 14th National Congress of the CPC elected the 14th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中共十四届四中全会通过的《决定》指出，党的建设这项“新的伟大的工程”是由以邓小平为核心的第二代中央领导集体开创的。
description.en: The 'Decision' passed by the 4th Plenum of the 14th Central Committee pointed out that the 'new great engineering' of party building was initiated by the second-generation central leadership collective with Deng Xiaoping at its core.

description.zh-cn: 五中全会审议并通过了中央纪律检查委员会关于陈希同问题的审查报告，决定撤销其的中共中央政治局委员、中央委员职务。
description.en: The Fifth Plenary Session reviewed and passed the report from the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection on the Chen Xitong issue, deciding to remove him from his positions as a member of the Politburo and the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在五中全会上，中央候补委员耿全礼被递补为中央委员。
description.en: At the Fifth Plenary Session, alternate Central Committee member Geng Quanli was promoted to a full member.

description.zh-cn: 在五中全会上，中央候补委员马启智被递补为中央委员。
description.en: At the Fifth Plenary Session, alternate Central Committee member Ma Qizhi was promoted to a full member.

description.zh-cn: 在五中全会上，张万年被增补为中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: At the Fifth Plenary Session, Zhang Wannian was appointed as a Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在五中全会上，迟浩田被增补为中央军事委员会副主席。
description.en: At the Fifth Plenary Session, Chi Haotian was appointed as a Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在五中全会上，王克被增补为中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: At the Fifth Plenary Session, Wang Ke was appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在五中全会上，王瑞林被增补为中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: At the Fifth Plenary Session, Wang Ruilin was appointed as a member of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 根据“中国共产党党员”分类，钟书樵是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the category 'Communist Party of China members', Zhong Shuqiao is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾任湖北省政协副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 蒋方良于1935年3月15日与蒋经国结婚，直至1988年蒋经国逝世。
description.en: Jiang Fangliang married Chiang Ching-kuo on March 15, 1935, until his death on January 13, 1988.

description.zh-cn: 蒋方良接替刘期纯成为中华民国第一夫人。
description.en: Jiang Fangliang succeeded Liu Chi-chun as the First Lady of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋经国逝世后，蒋方良的第一夫人身份由李登辉总统的夫人曾文惠接续。
description.en: After the death of Chiang Ching-kuo, Jiang Fangliang's role as First Lady was succeeded by Tseng Wen-hui, wife of President Lee Teng-hui.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正是蒋方良的公公。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was Jiang Fangliang's father-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 宋美龄是蒋方良的婆婆。
description.en: Soong Mei-ling was Jiang Fangliang's mother-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 毛福梅是蒋方良的婆婆，蒋经国的生母，两人曾一同居住且相处良好。
description.en: Mao Fumei was Jiang Fangliang's mother-in-law and Chiang Ching-kuo's biological mother; they lived together and had a good relationship.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上，时任总统陈水扁亲自出席并颁发褒扬令以示崇念。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, then-President Chen Shui-bian attended in person and issued a commendation order in her memory.

description.zh-cn: 蒋方良逝世后获中华民国政府颁布褒扬令给予褒扬。
description.en: After her death, Jiang Fangliang was commended with a Presidential Commendation Order by the ROC government.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上，作为中国国民党四位副主席之一为蒋方良灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, as one of the four vice-chairmen of the Kuomintang, covered her coffin with the party flag.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上，作为中国国民党四位副主席之一为蒋方良灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, as one of the four vice-chairmen of the Kuomintang, covered her coffin with the party flag.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上，作为中国国民党四位副主席之一为蒋方良灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, as one of the four vice-chairmen of the Kuomintang, covered her coffin with the party flag.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上，作为中国国民党四位副主席之一为蒋方良灵柩覆盖党旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, as one of the four vice-chairmen of the Kuomintang, covered her coffin with the party flag.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上为蒋方良灵柩覆盖国旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, covered her coffin with the national flag.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上为蒋方良灵柩覆盖国旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, covered her coffin with the national flag.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋方良的告别式上为蒋方良灵柩覆盖国旗。
description.en: At Jiang Fangliang's funeral, covered her coffin with the national flag.

description.zh-cn: 出席蒋方良的告别式并到场致意。
description.en: Attended Jiang Fangliang's funeral to pay respects.

description.zh-cn: 出席蒋方良的告别式并到场致意。
description.en: Attended Jiang Fangliang's funeral to pay respects.

description.zh-cn: 出席蒋方良的告别式并到场致意。
description.en: Attended Jiang Fangliang's funeral to pay respects.

description.zh-cn: 出席蒋方良的告别式并到场致意。
description.en: Attended Jiang Fangliang's funeral to pay respects.

description.zh-cn: 俞扬和是蒋方良的女婿。
description.en: Yu Yang-ho is Jiang Fangliang's son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 刘松山是刘锦棠的叔父。
description.en: Liu Songshan was Liu Jintang's uncle.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦棠早年投效叔父刘松山所在的湘军部队。
description.en: In his early years, Liu Jintang joined the Xiang Army unit where his uncle Liu Songshan served.

description.zh-cn: 1884年新疆建省后，刘锦棠担任第一任甘肃新疆巡抚。
description.en: After Xinjiang was established as a province in 1884, Liu Jintang served as the first Governor of Gansu-Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦棠参与了平定太平天国的军事行动。
description.en: Liu Jintang participated in the military actions to suppress the Taiping Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦棠在平定太平天国后，继续参与剿灭捻军的军事行动。
description.en: After suppressing the Taiping Rebellion, Liu Jintang continued to participate in military actions to eliminate the Nian Army.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦棠曾参与平息陕甘回变。
description.en: Liu Jintang participated in suppressing the Dungan Revolt.

description.zh-cn: 在马化龙投降后，刘锦棠将其全家依律凌迟处死。
description.en: After Ma Hualong's surrender, Liu Jintang executed him and his entire family by lingchi according to the law.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦棠作为先锋主力参与了收复新疆之战，并率军攻克乌鲁木齐。
description.en: As a main vanguard force, Liu Jintang participated in the war to recover Xinjiang and led his troops to capture Ürümqi.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦棠率领湘军主力一举夺回了乌鲁木齐。
description.en: Liu Jintang led the main force of the Xiang Army to recapture Ürümqi.

description.zh-cn: 曾国藩赏识刘锦棠及其叔父刘松山。
description.en: Zeng Guofan appreciated Liu Jintang and his uncle Liu Songshan.

description.zh-cn: 左宗棠统帅清军发起了收复新疆之战。
description.en: Zuo Zongtang commanded the Qing forces to launch the war to recover Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 金顺作为先锋主力与刘锦棠一同参与收复新疆之战。
description.en: As a main vanguard force, Jin Shun participated in the war to recover Xinjiang alongside Liu Jintang.

description.zh-cn: 崇厚作为清朝钦差大臣与俄国签订了《伊犁条约》。
description.en: As the Qing imperial commissioner, Chonghou signed the Treaty of Livadia with Russia.

description.zh-cn: 清朝朝廷对《伊犁条约》的内容表示不满，未予批准，并另派曾纪泽重新谈判。
description.en: The Qing court expressed dissatisfaction with the content of the Treaty of Livadia, refused to ratify it, and dispatched Zeng Jize to renegotiate.

description.zh-cn: 奉命与俄国重新谈判，以争取更好的条约条件，从而阻止了原《伊犁条约》的生效。
description.en: He was ordered to renegotiate with Russia to secure better terms, thereby preventing the original Treaty of Livadia from taking effect.

description.zh-cn: 刘松山在金积战役中被马化龙所部的回将诈降所害而阵亡。
description.en: Liu Songshan was killed in the Battle of Jinji after being deceived by a feigned surrender from generals under Ma Hualong's command.

description.zh-cn: 保罗生来就拥有罗马公民权。
description.en: Paul was a Roman citizen by birth.

description.zh-cn: 保罗出身于以色列的便雅悯支派。
description.en: Paul was from the Israelite tribe of Benjamin.

description.zh-cn: 在归信基督之前，保罗是一名法利赛人，热衷于犹太律法。
description.en: Before his conversion to Christianity, Paul was a Pharisee, zealous for the Jewish law.

description.zh-cn: 保罗曾在耶路撒冷于著名的律法教师迦玛列门下学习。
description.en: Paul studied in Jerusalem under the renowned law teacher Gamaliel.

description.zh-cn: 在归信之前，保罗（时名扫罗）认为基督教是异端，并极力迫害基督徒。
description.en: Before his conversion, Paul (then named Saul) considered Christianity a heresy and actively persecuted Christians.

description.zh-cn: 在前往大马士革的路上，复活的耶稣向保罗显现并对他说话，直接导致了他的归信。
description.en: On the road to Damascus, the resurrected Jesus appeared and spoke to Paul, directly leading to his conversion.

description.zh-cn: 归信后，保罗成为基督教最主要的传教者之一，通过多次传教旅行，将福音传播到地中海各地，建立了许多教会。
description.en: After his conversion, Paul became one of Christianity's foremost missionaries, spreading the gospel throughout the Mediterranean world and establishing numerous churches through several missionary journeys.

description.zh-cn: 作为早期教会的领袖，彼得接纳并支持了归信后的保罗。
description.en: As a leader of the early church, Peter accepted and supported Paul after his conversion.

description.zh-cn: 作为耶路撒冷教会的柱石，雅各接纳并支持了归信后的保罗。
description.en: As a pillar of the Jerusalem church, James accepted and supported Paul after his conversion.

description.zh-cn: 巴拿巴到大数城邀请保罗协助安提阿的圣工，开启了他们最初的合作。
description.en: Barnabas went to Tarsus to invite Paul to assist with the ministry in Antioch, initiating their early collaboration.

description.zh-cn: 保罗撰写了多封书信，这些书信后来被收录于《新约圣经》中。
description.en: Paul authored numerous epistles, which were later included in the New Testament.

description.zh-cn: 教会传统追认保罗为第一位安提约基雅主教。
description.en: Church tradition recognizes Paul as the first Bishop of Antioch.

description.zh-cn: 根据基督教传统，罗马皇帝尼禄在位时下令将保罗斩首，使其殉道。
description.en: According to Christian tradition, Emperor Nero ordered the beheading of Paul, leading to his martyrdom.

description.zh-cn: 在塞浦路斯传教时，保罗斥责并暂时使法术师以吕马眼盲，因为后者试图阻挠总督信教。
description.en: While preaching in Cyprus, Paul rebuked and temporarily blinded the sorcerer Elymas, who was trying to prevent the proconsul from believing.

description.zh-cn: 城外圣保禄大殿是为了纪念保罗而建，并据信存放着他的骸骨。
description.en: The Basilica of Saint Paul Outside the Walls was built in memory of Paul and is believed to house his remains.

description.zh-cn: 中世纪反基督教犹太文献《耶稣一生》将保罗（以利亚的扫罗）描绘成与耶稣对抗的反对者。
description.en: The medieval anti-Christian Jewish text 'Toledot Yeshu' portrays Paul (Shaul Eliyahu) as an antagonist who worked against Jesus.

description.zh-cn: 范丞丞于2016年11月进入乐华娱乐成为练习生，后作为艺人活动至2023年。
description.en: Fan Chengcheng joined Yuehua Entertainment as a trainee in November 2016 and was active as an artist until 2023.

description.zh-cn: 范丞丞以练习生身份参加选秀节目《偶像练习生》，最终以第三名的成绩作为NINE PERCENT组合成员正式出道。
description.en: Fan Chengcheng participated in the survival show "Idol Producer" as a trainee and officially debuted as a member of the group NINE PERCENT after finishing in third place.

description.zh-cn: 范丞丞作为NINE PERCENT组合成员活动，直至2019年10月6日组合毕业。
description.en: Fan Chengcheng was active as a member of NINE PERCENT until the group's graduation on October 6, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 范丞丞随组合NEXT于2018年6月21日发布出道迷你专辑《THE FIRST》。
description.en: Fan Chengcheng, along with the group NEXT, released their debut mini-album "THE FIRST" on June 21, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 汪苏泷为范丞丞的单曲《秘密》进行创作并担任制作人。
description.en: Wang Sulong wrote and produced the single "Secret" for Fan Chengcheng.

description.zh-cn: 与马思唯合作发布歌曲《WE DON'T PLAY》。
description.en: Collaborated with Ma Siwei on the song "WE DON'T PLAY".

description.zh-cn: 与谢帝、马思唯合作发布歌曲《拿范儿》。
description.en: Collaborated with Xie Di and Ma Siwei on the song "Na Fan'er".

description.zh-cn: 与谢帝、范丞丞合作发布歌曲《拿范儿》。
description.en: Collaborated with Xie Di and Fan Chengcheng on the song "Na Fan'er".

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵出生于山西省昔阳县大寨。
description.en: Chen Yonggui was born in Dazhai, Xiyang County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平主导的拨乱反正和改革开放时期，陈永贵的政治路线被否定，并于1980年9月被迫辞去国务院副总理职务。
description.en: During the period of Boluan Fanzheng and Reform and Opening-up led by Deng Xiaoping, Chen Yonggui's political line was repudiated, and he was forced to resign from his position as Vice Premier of the State Council in September 1980.

description.zh-cn: 由于毛泽东支持陈永贵，与陈永贵有矛盾的谢振华被调离山西，其整治陈永贵的计划也因此落空。
description.en: Due to Mao Zedong's support for Chen Yonggui, Xie Zhenhua, who had conflicts with Chen, was transferred out of Shanxi, and his plans to persecute Chen were thwarted.

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵于1948年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Chen Yonggui joined the Communist Party of China in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵于中共十届和十一届期间担任中央政治局委员。
description.en: Chen Yonggui served as a member of the Politburo during the 10th and 11th Central Committees of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 陈永贵自1967年起担任山西省革命委员会副主任。
description.en: Chen Yonggui served as Vice Chairman of the Shanxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee starting in 1967.

position.en: Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 作为中央政治局委员，陈永贵在党内是时任中共中央主席毛泽东的下属。
description.en: As a member of the Politburo, Chen Yonggui was a subordinate of the then CPC Chairman Mao Zedong within the party.

position.en: Vice Premier of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 作为国务院副总理，陈永贵在政府体系中是时任总理周恩来的下属。
description.en: As Vice Premier of the State Council, Chen Yonggui was a subordinate of the then Premier Zhou Enlai in the government system.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理
position.en: Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Vice Premier of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 在华国锋担任国务院总理和中共中央主席期间，陈永贵是其在政府和党内的下属。
description.en: During Hua Guofeng's tenure as Premier of the State Council and Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, Chen Yonggui was his subordinate in both the government and the party.

position.en: Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 在胡耀邦担任中共中央主席期间，陈永贵作为政治局委员是其党内下属。
description.en: During Hu Yaobang's tenure as Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, Chen Yonggui, as a Politburo member, was his subordinate within the party.

description.zh-cn: 信息来源于页面分类“中国会计学会常务理事”。
description.en: Information from page category 'Standing Council Members of the Accounting Society of China'.

description.zh-cn: 信息来源于页面分类“中国共产党党员”。
description.en: Information from page category 'Chinese Communist Party members'.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年是高晓岚的儿子。
description.en: Chen Yannian is the son of Gao Xiaolan.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年是陈乔年的哥哥。
description.en: Chen Yannian is the elder brother of Chen Qiaonian.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年与陈玉莹是兄妹关系。
description.en: Chen Yannian and Chen Yuying are siblings.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年与陈松年是兄弟关系。
description.en: Chen Yannian and Chen Songnian are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 1917年考入震旦大学攻读法律。
description.en: Admitted to Aurora University in 1917 to study law.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年早期信奉无政府主义，后于1921年转向马克思主义。
description.en: Chen Yannian initially believed in anarchism before turning to Marxism in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年于1921年后从无政府主义转向信奉马克思主义。
description.en: After 1921, Chen Yannian shifted from anarchism to believing in Marxism.

description.zh-cn: 与赵世炎、周恩来等一同创建中国少年共产党。
description.en: Co-founded the Young Communist Party of China with Zhao Shiyan, Zhou Enlai, and others.

description.zh-cn: 与陈延年、周恩来等一同创建中国少年共产党。
description.en: Co-founded the Young Communist Party of China with Chen Yannian, Zhou Enlai, and others.

description.zh-cn: 与陈延年、赵世炎等一同创建中国少年共产党。
description.en: Co-founded the Young Communist Party of China with Chen Yannian, Zhao Shiyan, and others.

description.zh-cn: 由法国共产党转入中国共产党。
description.en: Transferred his membership from the French Communist Party to the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年参与组织了省港大罢工。
description.en: Chen Yannian participated in organizing the Canton–Hong Kong strike.

description.zh-cn: 在中共五大上，陈延年当选为中央政治局候补委员。
description.en: At the 5th National Congress of the CCP, Chen Yannian was elected as an alternate member of the Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 陈延年于1927年6月26日被国民政府逮捕，并于7月4日被处决。
description.en: Chen Yannian was arrested by the Nationalist Government on June 26, 1927, and executed on July 4.

description.zh-cn: 继陈延年之后，其弟陈乔年于1928年亦被国民政府杀害。
description.en: Following Chen Yannian, his younger brother Chen Qiaonian was also killed by the Nationalist Government in 1928.

description.zh-cn: 在陈延年担任中共中央政治局候补委员期间，其父陈独秀担任中共中央总书记。
description.en: While Chen Yannian served as an alternate member of the CCP Politburo, his father Chen Duxiu was the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党常宁市委员会是中国共产党设在常宁市的地方组织。
description.en: The Changning Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China is the local organization of the CPC established in Changning City.

description.zh-cn: 《中国共产党章程》是中国共产党常宁市委员会的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the Communist Party of China serves as the legal basis authorizing the Changning Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 陈茂艺是首任中共常宁县委书记。
description.en: Chen Maoyi was the first Party Secretary of the Changning County Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 德拉帕迪·慕尔穆是现任印度总统。
description.en: Droupadi Murmu is the current President of India.

description.zh-cn: 纳伦德拉·莫迪是第14任印度总理。
description.en: Narendra Modi is the 14th Prime Minister of India.

description.zh-cn: 联邦院是印度议会的上议院。
description.en: The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India.

description.zh-cn: 人民院是印度议会的下议院。
description.en: The Lok Sabha is the lower house of the Parliament of India.

description.zh-cn: 印度独立运动最终导致了英属印度的终结和1947年印度自治领的建立。
description.en: The Indian independence movement ultimately led to the end of British India and the establishment of the Dominion of India in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1947年的蒙巴顿方案提出了印巴分治，直接促成了印度的独立。
description.en: The Mountbatten Plan of 1947 proposed the partition of India and Pakistan, directly leading to the independence of India.

description.zh-cn: 1947年的蒙巴顿方案提出了印巴分治，直接促成了巴基斯坦的建立。
description.en: The Mountbatten Plan of 1947 proposed the partition of India and Pakistan, directly leading to the establishment of Pakistan.

description.zh-cn: 自1947年分治独立以来，印度和巴基斯坦因克什米尔领土争端等问题爆发了多次战争，两国关系长期紧张。
description.en: Since their partition and independence in 1947, India and Pakistan have fought several wars over issues including the Kashmir territorial dispute, and their relations have remained tense for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 1949年印度派兵进驻锡金，使其成为保护国，并最终于1975年正式将其吞并。
description.en: In 1949, India sent troops into Sikkim, making it a protectorate, and finally formally annexed it in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 根据1949年签订的《永久和平与友好条约》，不丹在对外关系上接受印度的“指导”。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Perpetual Peace and Friendship signed in 1949, Bhutan accepts India's 'guidance' in its foreign affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1959年西藏骚乱后，印度接纳了流亡的十四世达赖喇嘛。
description.en: After the 1959 Tibetan uprising, India granted asylum to the exiled 14th Dalai Lama.

description.zh-cn: 印度通过军事行动结束了葡萄牙对果阿的殖民统治。
description.en: India ended Portuguese colonial rule in Goa through military action.

description.zh-cn: 印度在1962年的中印边境战争中战败，其扩张态势受挫。
description.en: India was defeated in the 1962 Sino-Indian War, and its expansionist posture was thwarted.

description.zh-cn: 印度的军事介入和在1971年印巴战争中的胜利，直接促成了东巴基斯坦独立为孟加拉国。
description.en: India's military intervention and victory in the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 directly led to the independence of East Pakistan as Bangladesh.

description.zh-cn: 金庙事件后，时任印度总理英迪拉·甘地被其锡克教保镖刺杀身亡。
description.en: After Operation Blue Star, then-Prime Minister of India Indira Gandhi was assassinated by her Sikh bodyguards.

description.zh-cn: 在冷战时期，印度与苏联发展了密切关系，并得到了广泛的军事支持。
description.en: During the Cold War, India developed close relations with the Soviet Union and received extensive military support.

description.zh-cn: 四方安全对话被广泛视为一个旨在制衡中华人民共和国在印太地区日益增长的影响力的战略联盟。
description.en: The Quadrilateral Security Dialogue is widely seen as a strategic alliance aimed at countering the growing influence of the People's Republic of China in the Indo-Pacific region.

description.zh-cn: 印度武装部队是印度共和国的军事力量。
description.en: The Indian Armed Forces are the military forces of the Republic of India.

description.zh-cn: 印度陆军是印度武装部队的组成部分。
description.en: The Indian Army is a component of the Indian Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 印度海军是印度武装部队的组成部分。
description.en: The Indian Navy is a component of the Indian Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 印度空军是印度武装部队的组成部分。
description.en: The Indian Air Force is a component of the Indian Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 印度海岸警卫队由印度国防部指挥。
description.en: The Indian Coast Guard is commanded by the Indian Ministry of Defence.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于2004年提出“和谐社会”作为一种社会发展战略目标。
description.en: The Communist Party of China proposed the 'Harmonious Society' as a strategic goal for social development in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 在该次会议上，中国共产党首次正式提出了“构建社会主义和谐社会”的能力的概念。
description.en: At this meeting, the Communist Party of China formally proposed the concept of 'building a socialist harmonious society' for the first time.

description.zh-cn: “构建和谐社会”的主张被认为是以中国传统的儒家思想来治理中国社会的一个构想。
description.en: The proposal to 'build a harmonious society' is considered a concept for governing Chinese society based on traditional Confucian thought.

description.zh-cn: 孔子提出了一整套人文和社会思想，经过后来的发展，被称为儒家思想。
description.en: Confucius proposed a comprehensive set of humanistic and social ideas that, after later development, became known as Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 孔子生活在战乱频繁的春秋时期，这个时代背景影响了他提出旨在构建社会秩序的思想。
description.en: Confucius lived during the turbulent Spring and Autumn period, and this historical context influenced his formulation of ideas aimed at establishing social order.

description.zh-cn: “和谐社会”的提出旨在解决改革开放过程中产生的社会不公等问题。
description.en: The concept of 'Harmonious Society' was proposed to address issues such as social injustice that arose during the process of Reform and Opening-up.

description.zh-cn: “和谐社会”被认为是“小康社会”的继承和发展，在经济要求之外，对政治、文化、社会等方面提出了新的定义。
description.en: The 'Harmonious Society' is considered a continuation and development of the 'Moderately Prosperous Society', adding new definitions for political, cultural, and social aspects beyond economic requirements.

description.zh-cn: “和谐社会”概念的提出和相关网络审查的实施，导致中国大陆网民创造出“河蟹”（和谐的谐音）一词及其相关网络用语，用以讽刺言论审查。
description.en: The proposal of the 'Harmonious Society' concept and the implementation of related internet censorship led mainland Chinese netizens to create the term 'river crab' (a homophone for harmony) and related slang to satirize censorship.

description.zh-cn: 政府为了创造“和谐社会”而进行了整治互联网低俗之风专项行动。
description.en: The government launched the 'Special Campaign to Rectify Low-Taste Content on the Internet' in order to create a 'Harmonious Society'.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·麦金莱总统被刺杀身亡后，时任副总统的西奥多·罗斯福继任成为美国总统。
description.en: After President William McKinley was assassinated, Vice President Theodore Roosevelt succeeded him to become the President of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 里昂·乔戈什刺杀了时任美国总统威廉·麦金莱。
description.en: Leon Czolgosz assassinated the incumbent U.S. President William McKinley.

description.zh-cn: 在威廉·麦金莱的总统任期内担任副总统。
description.en: Served as Vice President during William McKinley's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 因成功调停日俄战争，西奥多·罗斯福获得1906年的诺贝尔和平奖。
description.en: For his successful mediation of the Russo-Japanese War, Theodore Roosevelt was awarded the 1906 Nobel Peace Prize.

description.zh-cn: 在总统任内竭力推动巴拿马运河的建设工程，并视其为自己最伟大的成就之一。
description.en: During his presidency, he vigorously promoted the construction of the Panama Canal, considering it one of his greatest achievements.

description.zh-cn: 1908年，罗斯福认为国防部长威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱是自己进步主义思想的衣钵传人，极力推举其成为总统候选人。
description.en: In 1908, Roosevelt strongly endorsed Secretary of War William Howard Taft as the presidential candidate, believing him to be the heir to his progressive ideology.

description.zh-cn: 1911年底，罗斯福最终与塔夫脱决裂，并在1912年总统大选中作为第三方候选人与其竞争。
description.en: At the end of 1911, Roosevelt broke with Taft and competed against him as a third-party candidate in the 1912 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在1912年无法获得共和党总统候选人提名后，罗斯福另起炉灶，成立了进步党以支持自己的竞选。
description.en: After failing to secure the Republican presidential nomination in 1912, Roosevelt formed the Progressive Party to support his own campaign.

description.zh-cn: 进步党的分裂了共和党选票，使得民主党候选人伍德罗·威尔逊在1912年总统选举中获胜。
description.en: The Progressive Party split the Republican vote, which enabled Democratic candidate Woodrow Wilson to win the 1912 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔弗雷德·马汉的海权理论强化了西奥多·罗斯福关于扩张海军力量以与欧洲列强平起平坐的信念。
description.en: Alfred Mahan's sea power theories reinforced Theodore Roosevelt's belief in expanding naval power to be on par with European powers.

description.zh-cn: 罗斯福在年度咨文中要求国会授权减免庚子赔款中超出实际损失的部分，并将多余部分用于资助中国的教育事业。
description.en: In his annual message, Roosevelt requested congressional authorization to remit the portion of the Boxer Indemnity that exceeded actual losses and to use the surplus to fund education in China.

description.zh-cn: 在美西战争爆发后，西奥多·罗斯福辞去海军部文职，组建了美国第一志愿骑兵团。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Spanish-American War, Theodore Roosevelt resigned his civilian post in the Navy Department and formed the 1st United States Volunteer Cavalry.

description.zh-cn: 罗斯福在第一次世界大战期间强烈批评伍德罗·威尔逊总统过于软弱的外交政策。
description.en: During World War I, Roosevelt strongly criticized President Woodrow Wilson's foreign policy as being too weak.

description.zh-cn: 与杨暗公等二十余人于成都秘密成立了中国青年共产党。
description.en: Secretly founded the Young Communist Party of China in Chengdu with Yang Angong and more than 20 others.

description.zh-cn: 与吴玉章等二十余人于其成都住处秘密成立了中国青年共产党。
description.en: Secretly founded the Young Communist Party of China at his residence in Chengdu with Wu Yuzhang and more than 20 others.

description.zh-cn: 1925年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 1925年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 在加入中国共产党后，吴玉章认为YC团已无必要继续存在，决定将其解散，并劝导北京YC团成员加入中共，促使其自行解体。
description.en: After joining the Chinese Communist Party, Wu Yuzhang believed the YC Group was no longer necessary and decided to dissolve it. He persuaded members of the Beijing YC Group to join the CCP, leading to its self-dissolution.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央是中国共产党的中央领导机构，直接隶属于中国共产党。
description.en: The Central Committee of the CCP is the central leading body of the Chinese Communist Party and is directly subordinate to it.

description.zh-cn: 任命吴三桂为平西伯，并命令其率军入卫京师。
description.en: Appointed Wu Sangui as the Earl who Pacifies the West and ordered him to lead his troops to defend the capital.

description.zh-cn: 向多尔衮“泣血求助”，请求清军入关共同对抗李自成的大顺军。
description.en: Sought help from Dorgon, pleading for Qing forces to enter Shanhai Pass to jointly fight against Li Zicheng's Shun army.

description.zh-cn: 将南明永历帝朱由榔献给吴三桂，为吴三桂处死永历帝创造了条件。
description.en: Handed over the Southern Ming Yongli Emperor, Zhu Youlang, to Wu Sangui, which enabled Wu to execute him.

description.zh-cn: 商议并决定撤藩，成为三藩之乱的直接导火索。
description.en: Discussed and decided to abolish the feudatories, which became the direct trigger for the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.

description.zh-cn: 吴世璠是吴三桂的太孙，在其死后继位。
description.en: Wu Shifan was the great-grandson of Wu Sangui, succeeding him after his death.

description.zh-cn: 因吴三桂发动三藩之乱，清廷将作为人质的吴应熊及其子吴世霖绞死。
description.en: Because Wu Sangui initiated the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, the Qing court executed Wu Yingxiong, who was a hostage, and his son Wu Shilin by strangulation.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来担任大型音乐舞蹈史诗《东方红》的总导演，并提议将其创作为国庆十五周年献礼节目。
description.en: Zhou Enlai served as the general director of the large-scale musical and dance epic 'The East Is Red' and proposed its creation as a tribute for the 15th anniversary of the National Day.

description.zh-cn: 《东方红》旨在歌颂中国人民在毛泽东领导下进行的革命斗争，展现毛泽东思想。
description.en: 'The East Is Red' aims to eulogize the revolutionary struggle of the Chinese people under the leadership of Mao Zedong and to showcase Mao Zedong Thought.

description.zh-cn: 根据毛泽东的意见，《东方红》的最后两场“祖国在前进”和“世界在前进”在后续演出及电影版中被删除。
description.en: Based on Mao Zedong's suggestion, the last two scenes of 'The East Is Red', 'The Motherland is Advancing' and 'The World is Advancing', were removed in subsequent performances and the film version.

description.zh-cn: 1964年，胡锦涛以清华大学学生身份参加了《东方红》的排练，并于同年10月在《人民日报》发表观后感。
description.en: In 1964, Hu Jintao participated in the rehearsals for 'The East Is Red' as a student at Tsinghua University and published his thoughts on it in the People's Daily in October of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》于1964年10月6日刊登了时为清华大学学生的胡锦涛撰写的《东方红》观后感。
description.en: On October 6, 1964, People's Daily published a review of 'The East Is Red' written by Hu Jintao, who was then a student at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 《东方红》的内容涵盖了从五四运动到中华人民共和国成立期间的中国革命斗争历史。
description.en: The content of 'The East Is Red' covers the history of the Chinese revolutionary struggle from the May Fourth Movement to the founding of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 王昆在《东方红》中担任歌曲《农友歌》的领唱。
description.en: Wang Kun served as the lead singer for the song 'Song of the Peasant Friends' in 'The East Is Red'.

description.zh-cn: 郭兰英在《东方红》中担任歌曲《南泥湾》的独唱。
description.en: Guo Lanying performed the solo for the song 'Nanniwan' in 'The East Is Red'.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山在南京宣誓就任中华民国临时大总统。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen was sworn in as the Provisional President of the Republic of China in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 在孙中山辞职后，袁世凯在北京就任第二任临时大总统。
description.en: After Sun Yat-sen's resignation, Yuan Shikai assumed office as the second Provisional President in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正于1927年4月12日发动清党（四一二事件），捕杀共产党员，导致第一次国共合作破裂。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek launched a party purge (April 12 Incident) on April 12, 1927, arresting and killing communists, which led to the breakdown of the First United Front.

description.zh-cn: 西安事变迫使国民党领导人蒋中正停止内战，与共产党合作共同抗日，促成了第二次国共合作。
description.en: The Xi'an Incident forced KMT leader Chiang Kai-shek to stop the civil war and cooperate with the Communist Party to resist Japan, leading to the Second United Front.

description.zh-cn: 苏联的干涉是导致外蒙古最终从中国独立的关键因素之一。
description.en: Soviet interference was one of the key factors that led to Outer Mongolia's eventual independence from China.

description.zh-cn: 何光𬀩是何长工之子。
description.en: He Guangwei is the son of He Changgong.

description.zh-cn: 何光𬀩1944年4月出生于湖南华容。
description.en: He Guangwei was born in Huarong, Hunan in April 1944.

description.zh-cn: 1981年8月，担任全国青年联合会副主席。
description.en: In August 1981, he served as Vice Chairman of the All-China Youth Federation.

description.zh-cn: 1986年担任国家旅游局副局长，1995年至2005年3月升任局长。
description.en: He served as Deputy Director of the National Tourism Administration in 1986, and was promoted to Director from 1995 to March 2005.

description.zh-cn: 2008年3月当选第十一届全国政协常务委员，2013年3月当选第十二届全国政协委员会常务委员。
description.en: In March 2008, he was elected as a Standing Committee member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC, and in March 2013, he was elected as a Standing Committee member of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 何刚是何光𬀩的儿子。
description.en: He Gang is the son of He Guangwei.

description.zh-cn: 高露是何刚的妻子（儿媳）。
description.en: Gao Lu is the wife of He Gang (daughter-in-law).

description.zh-cn: 高露因驾车进入故宫并发布照片而引发广泛争议。
description.en: Gao Lu caused widespread controversy by driving into the Forbidden City and posting photos.

description.zh-cn: 在1985年百万大裁军中，武汉军区被撤销。
description.en: During the one-million-man troop reduction in 1985, the Wuhan Military Region was disbanded.

description.zh-cn: 在1985年百万大裁军中，福州军区被撤销。
description.en: During the one-million-man troop reduction in 1985, the Fuzhou Military Region was disbanded.

description.zh-cn: 在1985年百万大裁军中，昆明军区被撤销。
description.en: During the one-million-man troop reduction in 1985, the Kunming Military Region was disbanded.

description.zh-cn: 1985年大裁军中，武汉军区并入广州军区。
description.en: In the 1985 military reduction, the Wuhan Military Region was merged into the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1985年大裁军中，福州军区并入南京军区。
description.en: In the 1985 military reduction, the Fuzhou Military Region was merged into the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 2016年2月1日，七大军区改组为五大战区，大军区编制被正式撤销。
description.en: On February 1, 2016, the seven military regions were reorganized into five theater commands, and the military region establishment was formally abolished.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英向毛泽东建议进行八大军区司令员对调。
description.en: Ye Jianying suggested to Mao Zedong to carry out the transfer of the commanders of the eight military regions.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东采纳了叶剑英的建议，安排了八大军区司令员对调。
description.en: Mao Zedong adopted Ye Jianying's suggestion and arranged the transfer of the commanders of the eight military regions.

description.zh-cn: 原晋察冀军区和晋冀鲁豫军区合并设立华北军区。
description.en: The former Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region and Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Military Region merged to establish the North China Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 原晋冀鲁豫军区和晋察冀军区合并设立华北军区。
description.en: The former Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Military Region and Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region merged to establish the North China Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1948年2月6日任陕甘宁晋绥联防军区司令员，该军区后于1949年2月1日改称西北军区。
description.en: Appointed commander of the Shaan-Gan-Ning-Jin-Sui Joint Defense Military Region on February 6, 1948, which was renamed the Northwest Military Region on February 1, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 1948年2月6日任陕甘宁晋绥联防军区政委，该军区后于1949年2月1日改称西北军区。
description.en: Appointed political commissar of the Shaan-Gan-Ning-Jin-Sui Joint Defense Military Region on February 6, 1948, which was renamed the Northwest Military Region on February 1, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 天津警备区隶属于北京军区。
description.en: The Tianjin Garrison was subordinate to the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 河北省军区隶属于北京军区。
description.en: The Hebei Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 山西省军区隶属于北京军区。
description.en: The Shanxi Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1967年5月，内蒙古军区降级为省级军区，编入北京军区。在此之前及之后，也隶属于北京军区管辖范围。
description.en: In May 1967, the Inner Mongolia Military Region was downgraded to a provincial military district and incorporated into the Beijing Military Region. Before and after this period, it was also under the jurisdiction of the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 辽宁省军区隶属于沈阳军区。
description.en: The Liaoning Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 吉林省军区隶属于沈阳军区。
description.en: The Jilin Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 黑龙江省军区隶属于沈阳军区。
description.en: The Heilongjiang Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 山东省军区隶属于济南军区。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Jinan Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 河南省军区隶属于济南军区。
description.en: The Henan Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Jinan Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 上海警备区隶属于南京军区。
description.en: The Shanghai Garrison was subordinate to the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省军区隶属于南京军区。
description.en: The Jiangsu Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省军区隶属于南京军区。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 福建省军区隶属于南京军区。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省军区隶属于南京军区。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 江西省军区隶属于南京军区。
description.en: The Jiangxi Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 广东省军区隶属于广州军区。
description.en: The Guangdong Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 广西军区隶属于广州军区。
description.en: The Guangxi Military District was subordinate to the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 湖北省军区隶属于广州军区。
description.en: The Hubei Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省军区隶属于广州军区。
description.en: The Hunan Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 海南省军区隶属于广州军区。
description.en: The Hainan Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 四川省军区隶属于成都军区。
description.en: The Sichuan Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1968年12月，西藏军区降级为省级军区，编入成都军区。
description.en: In December 1968, the Tibet Military Region was downgraded to a provincial military district and incorporated into the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 贵州省军区隶属于成都军区。
description.en: The Guizhou Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 云南省军区隶属于成都军区。
description.en: The Yunnan Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 重庆警备区隶属于成都军区。
description.en: The Chongqing Garrison was subordinate to the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 甘肃省军区隶属于兰州军区。
description.en: The Gansu Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 青海省军区隶属于兰州军区。
description.en: The Qinghai Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省军区隶属于兰州军区。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Military District was subordinate to the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 宁夏军区隶属于兰州军区。
description.en: The Ningxia Military District was subordinate to the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 新疆军区在1985年大裁军后隶属于兰州军区。
description.en: After the 1985 military reduction, the Xinjiang Military Region became subordinate to the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 李煜是南唐元宗李璟的第六子。
description.en: Li Yu was the sixth son of Emperor Yuanzong Li Jing of Southern Tang.

description.zh-cn: 李弘冀是李煜的长兄。
description.en: Li Hongji was Li Yu's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 李弘冀为人猜忌严刻，导致李煜感到惶恐，不敢参与政事。
description.en: Li Hongji was suspicious and harsh, which made Li Yu fearful and reluctant to get involved in political affairs.

description.zh-cn: 李仲寓是李煜的儿子。
description.en: Li Zhongyu was the son of Li Yu.

description.zh-cn: 李仲宣是李煜的儿子。
description.en: Li Zhongxuan was the son of Li Yu.

description.zh-cn: 971年，北宋军队消灭了南汉政权。
description.en: In 971, the Northern Song army conquered the Southern Han state.

description.zh-cn: 曹彬是宋太祖赵匡胤麾下的将领。
description.en: Cao Bin was a general under the command of Emperor Taizu Zhao Kuangyin.

description.zh-cn: 李煜死后被葬于洛阳北邙山，该地位于今孟津区。
description.en: After his death, Li Yu was buried at Mount Mang in Luoyang, which is located in modern-day Mengjin District.

description.zh-cn: 八月十日事件中的暴动呼吁结束君主制，最终导致了君主制的终结。
description.en: The insurrection on August 10 called for the end of the monarchy, ultimately leading to its demise.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会于1792年9月21日通过决议废除君主制，并于次日宣告法兰西第一共和国成立。
description.en: The National Convention passed a resolution to abolish the monarchy on September 21, 1792, and proclaimed the French First Republic the following day.

description.zh-cn: 法兰西第一帝国的成立取代并终结了法兰西第一共和国。
description.en: The establishment of the First French Empire replaced and ended the French First Republic.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑被拥为法兰西皇帝。
description.en: Napoleon was proclaimed Emperor of the French.

description.zh-cn: 罗伯斯庇尔曾担任国民公会主席。
description.en: Robespierre served as President of the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 保罗·巴拉斯是督政府时期的主要统治者。
description.en: Paul Barras was the dominant ruler during the Directory period.

description.zh-cn: 救国委员会制定并推行了恐怖政策，将共和国的敌人送上断头台。
description.en: The Committee of Public Safety devised and implemented a policy of terror, sending enemies of the Republic to the guillotine.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变结束了雅各宾专政，即恐怖统治。
description.en: The Thermidorian Reaction ended the Jacobin Dictatorship, also known as the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 督政府是依据《共和三年宪法》建立的。
description.en: The Directory was established according to the Constitution of the Year III.

description.zh-cn: 执政府始于雾月政变。
description.en: The Consulate began with the Coup of 18 Brumaire.

description.zh-cn: 《共和八年宪法》使执政府的统治合法化，并加强了行政权。
description.en: The Constitution of the Year VIII legitimized the rule of the Consulate and strengthened its executive power.

description.zh-cn: 《共和十二年宪法》将法兰西第一共和国政府交付给一位世袭的皇帝，从而建立了法兰西第一帝国。
description.en: The Constitution of the Year XII delivered the government of the French First Republic to a hereditary emperor, thus establishing the First French Empire.

description.zh-cn: 国民立法议会单方面地对神圣罗马帝国宣战。
description.en: The Legislative Assembly unilaterally declared war on the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 该宣言威胁如果法国王室受到伤害将摧毁巴黎，但这反而加剧了法国的政治动荡和对反革命国家的不满。
description.en: The manifesto threatened to destroy Paris if the French royal family were harmed, but it instead intensified political turmoil in France and increased animosity towards counter-revolutionary European states.

description.zh-cn: 法国王后玛丽·安托瓦内特在恐怖统治时期被审判并处决。
description.en: Queen Marie Antoinette was tried and executed during the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 随着罗伯斯庇尔的倒台，雅各宾俱乐部被解散。
description.en: Following the fall of Robespierre, the Jacobin Club was dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变后，吉伦特派的幸存者再次掌权。
description.en: After the Thermidorian Reaction, the surviving Girondins returned to power.

description.zh-cn: 在雾月政变后共同担任临时执政官。
description.en: Served together as provisional consuls after the Coup of 18 Brumaire.

description.zh-cn: 在雾月政变后共同担任临时执政官。
description.en: Served together as provisional consuls after the Coup of 18 Brumaire.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑与教宗庇护七世就《1801年教务专约》进行了谈判。
description.en: Napoleon negotiated the Concordat of 1801 with Pope Pius VII.

description.zh-cn: 该协议允许罗马天主教会自1802年起在法兰西共和国内重新出现。
description.en: This agreement allowed the Roman Catholic Church to re-emerge in the French Republic from 1802.

description.zh-cn: 通过参议院法令授予了拿破仑终身执政官的地位。
description.en: Granted Napoleon the status of Consul for Life via a Sénatus-consulte.

description.zh-cn: 《共和十年宪法》将法案评议委员会的人数从100人减少为50人。
description.en: The Constitution of the Year X reduced the number of members in the Tribunat from 100 to 50.

description.zh-cn: 《共和十年宪法》增加了参议院的立法权。
description.en: The Constitution of the Year X increased the legislative power of the Sénat conservateur.

description.zh-cn: 三鹿集团生产并销售了受三聚氰胺污染的婴幼儿奶粉，是引发该事件的直接源头。
description.en: Sanlu Group produced and sold infant formula contaminated with melamine, which was the direct source of the incident.

description.zh-cn: 三聚氰胺作为化工原料被违法添加到原奶中，是导致婴幼儿患病的直接原因。
description.en: Melamine, an industrial chemical, was illegally added to raw milk and was the direct cause of illness in infants.

description.zh-cn: 该事件导致三鹿集团信誉破产，最终于2009年2月12日被法院宣告破产。
description.en: The scandal led to the bankruptcy of Sanlu Group's reputation, and it was declared bankrupt by a court on February 12, 2009.

description.zh-cn: 因在该事件中犯生产、销售伪劣产品罪，田文华于2009年1月22日被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: For the crime of producing and selling substandard products in the scandal, Tian Wenhua was sentenced to life imprisonment on January 22, 2009.

description.zh-cn: 因对该事件负有领导责任，时任国家质检总局局长李长江于2008年9月22日引咎辞职。
description.en: For his leadership responsibility in the scandal, Li Changjiang, then-director of the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, resigned on September 22, 2008.

description.zh-cn: 事件重创了“中国制造”商品的国际信誉，导致多国禁止了中国乳制品进口。
description.en: The incident severely damaged the international reputation of "Made in China" goods, leading many countries to ban imports of Chinese dairy products.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，罗干受到冲击，被下放到“五七”干校劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Luo Gan was politically impacted and sent down to a 'May Seventh' Cadre School for manual labor.

description.zh-cn: 因陈俊生病重无法理事，罗干接替其国务院秘书长的职务。
description.en: Due to Chen Junsheng's serious illness and inability to perform his duties, Luo Gan succeeded him as the Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 罗干陪同时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳到天安门广场要求学生停止绝食活动。
description.en: Luo Gan accompanied then-General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee Zhao Ziyang to Tiananmen Square to ask students to stop their hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 罗干与时任中共中央办公厅主任温家宝陪同时任中共中央总书记赵紫阳到天安门广场要求学生停止绝食活动。
description.en: Luo Gan, along with then-Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee Wen Jiabao, accompanied then-General Secretary Zhao Ziyang to Tiananmen Square to ask students to stop their hunger strike.

description.zh-cn: 罗干接替任建新出任中共中央政法委员会书记。
description.en: Luo Gan succeeded Ren Jianxin as the Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 周永康接替罗干担任中共中央政治局常委和中央政法委书记的职务。
description.en: Zhou Yongkang succeeded Luo Gan as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 查尔斯三世作为英国君主，兼任新西兰君主，是新西兰的国家元首。
description.en: As the monarch of the United Kingdom, Charles III also serves as the Monarch of New Zealand, the country's head of state.

description.zh-cn: 辛迪·基罗是现任新西兰总督。
description.en: Cindy Kiro is the current Governor-General of New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 新西兰总督是新西兰君主在该国的代表。
description.en: The Governor-General of New Zealand is the representative of the Monarch of New Zealand in the country.

description.zh-cn: 克里斯托弗·卢克森是现任新西兰总理。
description.en: Christopher Luxon is the current Prime Minister of New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 《怀唐伊条约》的签订使新西兰成为英国的殖民地，是新西兰的建国文献。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Waitangi made New Zealand a British colony and is considered the nation's founding document.

description.zh-cn: 在1845年至1872年的新西兰土地战争中，英国殖民者与毛利人发生武装冲突。
description.en: During the New Zealand Wars from 1845 to 1872, British colonists and Māori people were engaged in armed conflict.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，海伦·克拉克成为新西兰第一位民主选举的女性总理。
description.en: In 1999, Helen Clark became New Zealand's first democratically elected female Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 1893年，新西兰成为世界上第一个给予妇女投票权的国家。
description.en: In 1893, New Zealand became the first country in the world to grant women the right to vote.

description.zh-cn: 2013年，新西兰成为亚太区第一个合法化同性婚姻的国家。
description.en: In 2013, New Zealand became the first country in the Asia-Pacific region to legalize same-sex marriage.

description.zh-cn: 哈卡舞是毛利人的传统表演艺术。
description.en: The Haka is a traditional performance art of the Māori people.

description.zh-cn: 纽西兰是新西兰王国的主体部分。
description.en: New Zealand is the main part of the Realm of New Zealand.

description.zh-cn: 王立平是河北乐亭人。
description.en: Wang Liping is from Leting, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 王立平是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Liping is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.zh-cn: 研究室副主任、主任，副秘书长兼研究室主任
position.en: Deputy Director and Director of the Research Office, Deputy Secretary-General and Director of the Research Office

description.zh-cn: 王立平曾先后担任吉林省政协研究室副主任、主任，以及吉林省政协副秘书长兼研究室主任。
description.en: Wang Liping successively served as Deputy Director and Director of the Research Office of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC, and Deputy Secretary-General and Director of the Research Office of the Jilin Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，王立平当选为第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Wang Liping was elected as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 因王立平在辽源市任职期间对辽河污染防治工作重视不够、推进不力，中华人民共和国生态环境部对其进行通报，此事导致其被免职。
description.en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported Wang Liping for his lack of attention and ineffective promotion of Liao River pollution prevention and control during his tenure in Liaoyuan, which led to his dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 因辽河污染问题，中共吉林省委于2018年11月免去王立平的中共辽源市委书记职务。
description.en: Due to the Liao River pollution issue, the CPC Jilin Provincial Committee removed Wang Liping from his position as Secretary of the CPC Liaoyuan Municipal Committee in November 2018.

description.zh-cn: 1988年10月，宋祖英被“金龙杯”全国歌手邀请赛评委金铁霖教授收为学生。
description.en: In October 1988, Song Zuying was accepted as a student by Professor Jin Tielin, a judge at the 'Golden Dragon Cup' National Singer Invitational Competition.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英自1990年起连续24年登上中央电视台春节联欢晚会的舞台进行表演。
description.en: Starting from 1990, Song Zuying performed on the CCTV Spring Festival Gala for 24 consecutive years.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英在2010年上海世博会开幕式上进行演唱表演。
description.en: Song Zuying performed at the opening ceremony of the Expo 2010 in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 宋祖英的国籍是中华人民共和国。
description.en: Song Zuying's nationality is the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 阿斯帕鲁克汗击败拜占庭后，建立了保加利亚第一帝国。
description.en: After defeating the Byzantines, Khan Asparuh founded the First Bulgarian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 680年，阿斯帕鲁克汗击败拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼二世，与之立约，正式获得多瑙河以南地区。
description.en: In 680, Khan Asparuh defeated the Byzantine Emperor Justinian II and made a treaty with him, formally acquiring the region south of the Danube.

description.zh-cn: 拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世在克柳赫击败保加利亚军队，并最终在1018年完全征服了保加利亚第一帝国。
description.en: The Byzantine Emperor Basil II defeated the Bulgarian army at Kleidion and eventually completed the conquest of the First Bulgarian Empire in 1018.

description.zh-cn: 伊凡·阿森一世与兄弟彼得四世领导保加利亚人起义，建立了保加利亚第二帝国。
description.en: Ivan Asen I and his brother Peter IV led a Bulgarian uprising and founded the Second Bulgarian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯曼帝国于1393年完成了对大部分保加利亚土地的征服，最终导致第二帝国于1396年灭亡。
description.en: The Ottoman Empire completed its conquest of most Bulgarian lands by 1393, leading to the fall of the Second Empire in 1396.

description.zh-cn: 《柏林条约》的签署使得保加利亚获得了自治地位，成立了半独立的保加利亚亲王国。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Berlin granted Bulgaria autonomous status, establishing the semi-independent Principality of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 在1877-1878年俄土战争后，俄罗斯等列强的支持促成了保加利亚亲王国的建立。
description.en: After the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878, support from Russia and other great powers led to the establishment of the Principality of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次巴尔干战争中，保加利亚王国作为巴尔干同盟的一员与奥斯曼帝国作战。
description.en: In the First Balkan War, the Kingdom of Bulgaria, as a member of the Balkan League, fought against the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 第二次巴尔干战争导致保加利亚战败，不仅失去了不少战利品，还将南多布罗加割给了罗马尼亚。
description.en: The Second Balkan War resulted in Bulgaria's defeat, causing it to lose not only many of its spoils of war but also to cede Southern Dobruja to Romania.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚王国于1915年加入同盟国集团，参与第一次世界大战。
description.en: The Kingdom of Bulgaria joined the Central Powers in 1915 to participate in World War I.

description.zh-cn: 作为战败国，保加利亚在第一次世界大战后失去了其在爱琴海的海岸线，军队也被解散。
description.en: As a defeated nation after World War I, Bulgaria lost its coastline on the Aegean Sea and its army was disbanded.

description.zh-cn: 1941年3月1日，保加利亚签署《三国同盟条约》，正式加入轴心国。1944年9月对德宣战，倒戈盟军。
description.en: On March 1, 1941, Bulgaria signed the Tripartite Pact, officially joining the Axis powers. It declared war on Germany in September 1944, switching to the Allied side.

description.zh-cn: 1944年9月9日的政变推翻了保加利亚王室，结束了保加利亚王国的统治。
description.en: The coup d'état on September 9, 1944, overthrew the Bulgarian royal family, ending the rule of the Kingdom of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 政变后共产党掌握了政权，为1946年成立保加利亚人民共和国铺平了道路。
description.en: After the coup, the Communist Party seized power, paving the way for the establishment of the People's Republic of Bulgaria in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 格奥尔基·季米特洛夫成为保加利亚人民共和国的首任领导人。
description.en: Georgi Dimitrov became the first leader of the People's Republic of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，保加利亚人民共和国被划入苏联的势力圈，成为其在东欧的重要盟友。
description.en: After World War II, the People's Republic of Bulgaria was drawn into the Soviet sphere of influence, becoming a key ally in Eastern Europe.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚于1955年成为华沙条约组织的成员。
description.en: Bulgaria became a member of the Warsaw Pact in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年民主运动的影响下，保加利亚的共产党政府于1989年11月10日垮台。
description.en: Under the influence of the Revolutions of 1989, the communist government of Bulgaria collapsed on November 10, 1989.

description.zh-cn: 1989年的民主运动促使保加利亚人民共和国解体，并向议会民主制的保加利亚共和国过渡。
description.en: The democratic movement of 1989 led to the dissolution of the People's Republic of Bulgaria and the transition to the parliamentary democracy of the Republic of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 鲁门·拉德夫是保加利亚共和国的总统。
description.en: Rumen Radev is the President of the Republic of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，罗森·热利亚兹科夫是保加利亚共和国的总理。
description.en: According to the text, Rosen Zhelyazkov is the Prime Minister of the Republic of Bulgaria.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚于2004年3月29日成为北约成员国。
description.en: Bulgaria became a member of NATO on March 29, 2004.

description.zh-cn: 保加利亚于2007年1月1日成为欧盟成员国。
description.en: Bulgaria became a member of the European Union on January 1, 2007.

description.zh-cn: 中央书记处是中央政治局和它的常务委员会的办事机构；成员由中央政治局常务委员会提名，中央委员会全体会议通过。
description.en: The Secretariat is the working body of the Political Bureau and its Standing Committee; its members are nominated by the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau and are subject to endorsement by the Central Committee in plenary session.

description.zh-cn: 党的中央纪律检查委员会在党的中央委员会领导下进行工作。
description.en: The Party's Central Commission for Discipline Inspection functions under the leadership of the Central Committee of the Party.

description.zh-cn: 民主集中制是中国共产党的根本组织原则。
description.en: Democratic centralism is the fundamental organizational principle of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 《中国共产党章程》是中共中央委员会的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the Communist Party of China is the legal source of authority for the Central Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 关东军因不满张作霖未能履行对日承诺，策划并执行了皇姑屯事件，将其暗杀。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Zhang Zuolin's failure to fulfill promises to Japan, the Kwantung Army planned and executed the Huanggutun Incident, assassinating him.

description.zh-cn: 吴俊升在皇姑屯事件中当场死亡。
description.en: Wu Junsheng was killed instantly in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 作为北洋政府的最高统治者，张作霖的奉军与国民革命军在北伐战争中是敌对关系。
description.en: As the supreme ruler of the Beiyang Government, Zhang Zuolin's Fengtian army was hostile to the National Revolutionary Army during the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖是奉系军阀的最高领袖。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin was the supreme leader of the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 1927年6月18日，张作霖在北京建立了安国军政府，并自任陆海军大元帅。
description.en: On June 18, 1927, Zhang Zuolin established the Anguojun Government in Beijing and appointed himself Grand Marshal of the Army and Navy.

description.zh-cn: 日本首相田中义一因处理皇姑屯事件的方式引起天皇不满，被认为是其最终辞职的原因之一。
description.en: Japanese Prime Minister Tanaka Giichi's handling of the Huanggutun Incident caused dissatisfaction with the Emperor, which is considered one of the reasons for his eventual resignation.

description.zh-cn: 在1946年开始的审判中，远东国际军事法庭将皇姑屯事件视为日本侵华战争的起点。
description.en: In the trials beginning in 1946, the International Military Tribunal for the Far East regarded the Huanggutun Incident as the starting point of Japan's war of aggression against China.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，中国人民解放军在攻取太原后，将河本大作作为日本战犯逮捕。
description.en: In 1949, after capturing Taiyuan, the Chinese People's Liberation Army arrested Daisaku Kōmoto as a Japanese war criminal.

description.zh-cn: 1945年日本投降后，河本大作投靠阎锡山并为其工作，直至1949年被俘。
description.en: After Japan's surrender in 1945, Daisaku Kōmoto took refuge with and worked for Yan Xishan until he was captured in 1949.

description.zh-cn: 与张作霖同乘一列专列，在皇姑屯事件中一同遇袭。
description.en: Traveled on the same special train as Zhang Zuolin and was attacked with him in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 与张作霖同乘一列专列，在皇姑屯事件中受伤。
description.en: Traveled on the same special train as Zhang Zuolin and was injured in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 与张作霖同乘一列专列，在皇姑屯事件中受伤。
description.en: Traveled on the same special train as Zhang Zuolin and was injured in the Huanggutun Incident.

description.zh-cn: 叶选廉是叶剑英的三子。
description.en: Ye Xuanlian is the third son of Ye Jianying.

description.zh-cn: 赵欣瑜于2014年1月宣布与叶选廉结束为期2年的婚姻关系。
description.en: Zhao Xinyu announced the end of her 2-year marriage to Ye Xuanlian in January 2014.

description.zh-cn: 叶文珊是叶选廉同父同母的妹妹。
description.en: Ye Wenshan is Ye Xuanlian's full sister.

description.zh-cn: 叶选平是叶选廉同父异母的哥哥。
description.en: Ye Xuanping is Ye Xuanlian's half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁是叶选廉同父异母的哥哥。
description.en: Ye Xuanning is Ye Xuanlian's half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 叶选廉是中国共产党员。
description.en: Ye Xuanlian is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1963年至1966年就读于北京十一学校甲一班小学。
description.en: Attended Beijing No. 11 School's Class A1 primary school from 1963 to 1966.

description.zh-cn: 叶选廉曾入伍在解放军总政治部担任飞行员。
description.en: Ye Xuanlian enlisted and served as a pilot in the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 经中华人民共和国国务院批准，设立国家互联网信息办公室。
description.en: The State Internet Information Office was established with the approval of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室是中央网络安全和信息化委员会的办事机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission serves as the working body for the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室是中共中央办事机构，列入中共中央直属机构序列。
description.en: The Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission is a working body of the CPC Central Committee, listed in the sequence of institutions directly under the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 国家互联网信息办公室是国务院办事机构，并经国务院授权负责互联网内容管理执法。
description.en: The Cyberspace Administration of China is an agency of the State Council and is authorized by the State Council to be responsible for internet content management and law enforcement.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，中央网络安全和信息化领导小组（委员会前身）成立，下设办事机构中央网络安全和信息化领导小组办公室，由国家互联网信息办公室承担具体职责。
description.en: In 2014, the Central Leading Group for Cyberspace Affairs (predecessor of the Commission) was established with a working body, the Office of the Central Leading Group for Cyberspace Affairs, whose duties were carried out by the Cyberspace Administration of China.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 根据该方案，中央网络安全和信息化领导小组改为中央网络安全和信息化委员会。
description.en: According to this plan, the Central Leading Group for Cyberspace Affairs was transformed into the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 该方案将国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心的管理关系由工业和信息化部调整为由中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室管理。
description.en: This plan adjusted the management of the National Computer Network and Information Security Management Center from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology to the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 自2018年3月起，国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心由中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室管理。
description.en: Since March 2018, the National Computer Network and Information Security Management Center has been managed by the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 兼任中央宣传部副部长。
description.en: Concurrently serves as Deputy Head of the Central Propaganda Department.

description.zh-cn: 兼任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
description.en: Concurrently served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 兼任国家网信办副主任时，任工业和信息化部副部长。
description.en: While concurrently serving as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China, he was Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 兼任国家互联网信息办公室副主任。
