description.en: Concurrently served as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China.

description.zh-cn: 兼任国家网信办副主任时，任公安部副部长。
description.en: While concurrently serving as Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China, he was Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允是维新三杰的成员之一。
description.en: Kido Takayoshi was one of the members of the Three Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 西乡隆盛是维新三杰的成员之一。
description.en: Saigō Takamori was one of the members of the Three Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 大久保利通是维新三杰的成员之一。
description.en: Ōkubo Toshimichi was one of the members of the Three Great Nobles of the Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 维新三杰是明治维新时期的三位核心代表人物，极大地推动了该运动。
description.en: The Three Great Nobles were the three core representative figures of the Meiji Restoration period and greatly promoted the movement.

description.zh-cn: 维新派以“尊皇攘夷”为口号，推动了旨在推翻幕府的明治维新运动。
description.en: The Restoration faction used the slogan 'Sonnō jōi' to promote the Meiji Restoration movement aimed at overthrowing the shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 明治维新运动推翻了日本的幕府统治。
description.en: The Meiji Restoration movement overthrew the shogunate rule in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允在执政期间实行了“废刀令”。
description.en: Kido Takayoshi implemented the 'Sword Abolition Edict' during his administration.

description.zh-cn: 木户孝允在执政期间实行了“废藩置县”。
description.en: Kido Takayoshi implemented the 'Abolition of the han system and establishment of prefectures' during his administration.

description.zh-cn: 岩仓使节团的出访为西乡隆盛成为留守政府的实质执政者创造了条件。
description.en: The departure of the Iwakura Mission created the conditions for Saigō Takamori to become the de facto ruler of the caretaker government.

description.zh-cn: 因“征韩论”引发的政变导致西乡隆盛下野，离开政府。
description.en: The political turmoil caused by the 'Seikanron' debate led to Saigō Takamori leaving the government.

description.zh-cn: 伊藤博文是长州五杰的成员之一。
description.en: Itō Hirobumi was one of the members of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 山尾庸三是长州五杰的成员之一。
description.en: Yamao Yōzō was one of the members of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 井上胜是长州五杰的成员之一。
description.en: Inoue Masaru was one of the members of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 井上馨是长州五杰的成员之一。
description.en: Inoue Kaoru was one of the members of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 远藤谨助是长州五杰的成员之一。
description.en: Endō Kinsuke was one of the members of the Chōshū Five.

description.zh-cn: 作为协约国领导人（“四大巨头”及“三大领袖”），共同主导第一次世界大战及战后巴黎和会。
description.en: As leaders of the Entente Powers (the 'Big Four' and 'Big Three'), they jointly led during World War I and at the subsequent Paris Peace Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为协约国领导人（“四大巨头”），共同主导第一次世界大战及战后巴黎和会。
description.en: As leaders of the Entente Powers (the 'Big Four'), they jointly led during World War I and at the subsequent Paris Peace Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为协约国领导人（“四大巨头”），共同主导第一次世界大战及战后巴黎和会。
description.en: As leaders of the Entente Powers (the 'Big Four'), they jointly led during World War I and at the subsequent Paris Peace Conference.

description.zh-cn: 作为协约国领导人（“四大巨头”），共同主导第一次世界大战及战后巴黎和会。
description.en: As leaders of the Entente Powers (the 'Big Four'), they jointly led during World War I and at the subsequent Paris Peace Conference.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国对大英帝国宣战。
description.en: The German Empire declared war on the British Empire.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国对俄罗斯帝国宣战。
description.en: The German Empire declared war on the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国入侵比利时。
description.en: The German Empire invaded Belgium.

description.zh-cn: 奥匈帝国对塞尔维亚王国宣战，引发第一次世界大战。
description.en: Austria-Hungary declared war on the Kingdom of Serbia, triggering World War I.

description.zh-cn: 李延年是孝武皇后（李夫人）的哥哥。
description.en: Li Yannian was the elder brother of Empress Li (Lady Li).

description.zh-cn: 李延年是李广利的哥哥。
description.en: Li Yannian was the elder brother of Li Guangli.

description.zh-cn: 李延年是李季的兄长。
description.en: Li Yannian was the elder brother of Li Ji.

description.zh-cn: 孝武皇后（李夫人）是汉武帝的宠妃。
description.en: Empress Li (Lady Li) was a favorite consort of Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 平阳公主向汉武帝推荐了李延年的妹妹，使其入宫成为李夫人。
description.en: Princess Pingyang recommended Li Yannian's sister to Emperor Wu, leading to her becoming Lady Li in the palace.

description.zh-cn: 因其妹李夫人受汉武帝宠幸，李延年得以获封协律都尉等职，备受荣宠。
description.en: Due to his sister Lady Li's favor with Emperor Wu, Li Yannian was appointed as the Commander of Music and enjoyed great honor.

description.zh-cn: 李夫人去世后，李家失宠，汉武帝最终将李延年与其弟李季处决并灭其族。
description.en: After Empress Li's death, the Li family fell from favor. Emperor Wu eventually had Li Yannian and his brother Li Ji executed and their clan exterminated.

description.zh-cn: 与兄李延年一同因罪被汉武帝灭族。
description.en: Was executed along with his brother Li Yannian by order of Emperor Wu.

description.zh-cn: 因李广利投降匈奴，汉武帝下令将其宗族诛灭。
description.en: Because Li Guangli surrendered to the Xiongnu, Emperor Wu ordered the extermination of his clan.

description.zh-cn: 李延年为西汉官员，负责管理皇宫乐器。
description.en: Li Yannian was an official in the Western Han, responsible for managing the musical instruments of the imperial palace.

description.zh-cn: 李广利为西汉贰师将军，后于征和三年（前90年）投降匈奴。
description.en: Li Guangli was the General of Ershi for the Western Han until he surrendered to the Xiongnu in 90 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 作为贰师将军奉命征伐大宛。
description.en: As the General of Ershi, he was ordered to lead a military campaign against Dayuan.

description.zh-cn: 征和三年（前90年），李广利兵败后投降匈奴。
description.en: In 90 BCE, Li Guangli surrendered to the Xiongnu after being defeated in battle.

description.zh-cn: 李延年曾因犯法而遭受腐刑。
description.en: Li Yannian was subjected to castration as punishment for a crime.

description.zh-cn: 1927年的国民党清党运动导致中共遭受重大打击，陈独秀因此被共产国际认为负有领导责任而被迫辞职。
description.en: The 1927 Kuomintang purge resulted in significant setbacks for the CCP, leading the Comintern to hold Chen Duxiu responsible and force his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 1931年，陈独秀联合中国各托派小组织，建立了统一的托派组织“中国共产党左派反对派”。
description.en: In 1931, Chen Duxiu united various small Trotskyist factions in China to establish the unified Trotskyist organization 'Left Opposition of the Chinese Communist Party'.

description.zh-cn: 在新文化运动时期，胡适与陈独秀是亲密的思想战友，共同推动了文学革命和思想启蒙。
description.en: During the New Culture Movement, Hu Shih and Chen Duxiu were close ideological allies, jointly promoting the literary revolution and intellectual enlightenment.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，共产国际代表维金斯基与陈独秀会面，向其介绍马克思列宁主义，并支持他组建共产主义组织，直接促成了中国共产党的诞生。
description.en: In 1920, Comintern representative Grigori Voitinsky met with Chen Duxiu, introduced him to Marxism-Leninism, and supported his efforts to form a communist organization, directly leading to the birth of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 1920年8月，陈独秀与李汉俊等人在上海建立了共产主义小组，这是中国共产党的前身。
description.en: In August 1920, Chen Duxiu, along with Li Hanjun and others, established the Shanghai Communist Group, a precursor to the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 1938年，王明与康生等人领导了对陈独秀的攻击运动，在共产党刊物上指控其为“日特汉奸”。
description.en: In 1938, Wang Ming, along with Kang Sheng and others, led a smear campaign against Chen Duxiu, accusing him of being a 'Japanese spy and traitor' in Communist publications.

description.zh-cn: 1938年，康生与王明等人领导了对陈独秀的攻击运动，在共产党刊物上指控其为“日特汉奸”。
description.en: In 1938, Kang Sheng, along with Wang Ming and others, led a smear campaign against Chen Duxiu, accusing him of being a 'Japanese spy and traitor' in Communist publications.

description.zh-cn: 1927年，陈延年被国民党政府逮捕并杀害。
description.en: In 1927, Chen Yannian was arrested and killed by the Kuomintang government.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，陈乔年被国民党政府处决。
description.en: In 1928, Chen Qiaonian was executed by the Kuomintang government.

description.zh-cn: 作为《新青年》的主编，陈独秀多次催促鲁迅进行小说创作，对其成为文学巨匠起到了重要的推动作用。
description.en: As the editor of 'New Youth', Chen Duxiu repeatedly urged Lu Xun to write fiction, playing a significant role in his emergence as a literary giant.

description.zh-cn: 1913年，陈独秀追随柏文蔚参加了反对袁世凯的“二次革命”。
description.en: In 1913, Chen Duxiu followed Bo Wenwei to participate in the 'Second Revolution' against Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 二次革命是国民党为反对袁世凯独裁而发动的军事行动。
description.en: The Second Revolution was a military campaign launched by the Kuomintang to oppose Yuan Shikai's dictatorship.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵将“黑五类”及其家属作为主要打击对象，进行了大规模的迫害、批斗甚至屠杀。
description.en: The Red Guards targeted the 'Five Black Categories' and their families for large-scale persecution, struggle sessions, and even massacres.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵内部派系林立，观点对立，内斗逐渐升级为大规模的暴力冲突，即武斗。
description.en: The Red Guard factions were numerous and had opposing views, and their infighting gradually escalated into large-scale violent conflicts, known as 'wudou'.

description.zh-cn: 因红卫兵武斗失控，毛泽东召见红卫兵“五大领袖”进行严厉批评，并决定派工宣队进驻学校，结束了红卫兵作为政治运动中心的历史。
description.en: Due to the out-of-control violent struggles among Red Guards, Mao Zedong summoned their 'Five Great Leaders' for severe criticism and decided to send workers' propaganda teams into schools, ending the Red Guards' history as the center of a political movement.

description.zh-cn: “红卫兵”这一名称来源于张承志的笔名，他因此对该组织的命名产生了直接影响。
description.en: The name 'Red Guard' originated from the pen name of Zhang Chengzhi, thus he directly influenced the organization's naming.

description.zh-cn: 江青提出了“文攻武卫”的口号，此口号公开发表后，全国武斗急剧升级。
description.en: Jiang Qing proposed the slogan 'Attack with reasoning, defend with force.' After this slogan was publicly published, violent struggles across the country escalated sharply.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东和林彪等人的号召下，红卫兵运动得以大规模展开。
description.en: Under the call of Mao Zedong, Lin Biao, and others, the Red Guard movement was launched on a large scale.

description.zh-cn: 造反派红卫兵与信奉“血统论”的老红卫兵对立，批判“血统论”。
description.en: The rebel faction of Red Guards opposed the Old Red Guards who believed in the 'bloodline theory' and criticized it.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石发表文告，谴责毛泽东组训“红卫兵”以保卫其个人独夫暴政。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek issued a proclamation condemning Mao Zedong for organizing the 'Red Guards' to protect his personal tyranny.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵的大串联导致大规模的人员流动，客观上引发并加剧了1966-67年的全国性流脑大流行。
description.en: The Red Guards' Great Link-up led to large-scale population movements, which objectively triggered and exacerbated the nationwide cerebrospinal meningitis pandemic of 1966-67.

description.zh-cn: 韦昌进出生于江苏省镇江市。
description.en: Wei Changjin was born in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 韦昌进于1983年10月加入中国人民解放军。
description.en: Wei Changjin joined the People's Liberation Army in October 1983.

description.zh-cn: 在1985年7月19日的一次战斗中，韦昌进被弹片击中，全身负伤22处，左眼失明。
description.en: In a battle on July 19, 1985, Wei Changjin was hit by shrapnel, sustaining 22 wounds over his body and losing sight in his left eye.

description.zh-cn: 韦昌进作为中国人民解放军士兵参加了与越南人民军的战斗。
description.en: As a PLA soldier, Wei Changjin participated in battles against the People's Army of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，中央军委授予韦昌进“战斗英雄”荣誉称号。
description.en: In 1986, the Central Military Commission awarded Wei Changjin the honorary title of 'Combat Hero'.

description.zh-cn: 不晚于2022年9月，韦昌进出任海南省军区政委。
description.en: No later than September 2022, Wei Changjin assumed the position of Political Commissar of the Hainan Provincial Military District.

description.zh-cn: 2020年7月，韦昌进晋升少将军衔。
description.en: In July 2020, Wei Changjin was promoted to the rank of Major General.

description.zh-cn: 2017年7月，中央军委主席习近平签署命令，决定首次颁授“八一勋章”。
description.en: In July 2017, Xi Jinping, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, signed an order to award the 'Order of August First' for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 韦昌进是首批“八一勋章”的10位获得者之一。
description.en: Wei Changjin was one of the 10 recipients of the inaugural 'Order of August First'.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年7月28日的授勋仪式上，习近平亲自向韦昌进颁授“八一勋章”和证书。
description.en: At the award ceremony on July 28, 2017, Xi Jinping personally presented the 'Order of August First' and its certificate to Wei Changjin.

description.zh-cn: 在改革开放四十周年大会上，中共中央决定授予100名人员“改革先锋”称号。
description.en: At the conference celebrating the 40th anniversary of the Reform and Opening-up, the CPC Central Committee decided to award the 'Reform Pioneer' title to 100 individuals.

description.zh-cn: 在改革开放四十周年大会上，国务院决定授予100名人员“改革先锋”称号。
description.en: At the conference celebrating the 40th anniversary of the Reform and Opening-up, the State Council decided to award the 'Reform Pioneer' title to 100 individuals.

description.zh-cn: 韦昌进因其贡献被授予“改革先锋”称号。
description.en: Wei Changjin was awarded the title 'Reform Pioneer' for his contributions.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成是梁启超的儿子。
description.en: Liang Sicheng is the son of Liang Qichao.

description.zh-cn: 梁从诫是梁思成的儿子。
description.en: Liang Congjie is the son of Liang Sicheng.

description.zh-cn: 梁再冰是梁思成的女儿。
description.en: Liang Zaibing is the daughter of Liang Sicheng.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成和梁思永是兄弟关系。
description.en: Liang Sicheng and Liang Siyong are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 1915年至1923年在清华学校读书，并于1923年毕业于高等科。
description.en: Studied at Tsinghua School from 1915 to 1923, and graduated from its advanced course in 1923.

position.en: Director of the Department of Architectural Regulations and Methods

description.zh-cn: 梁思成于1931年回到北平后，进入中国营造学社工作。
description.en: After returning to Beiping in 1931, Liang Sicheng joined the Society for Research in Chinese Architecture.

position.en: Head of the Department of Architecture

description.zh-cn: 1946年，梁思成出任清华大学建筑系主任。
description.en: In 1946, Liang Sicheng became the head of the Department of Architecture at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成与陈占祥共同提出《关于中央人民政府行政中心位置的建议》（梁陈方案），主张保护北京古城，但建议未被采纳。
description.en: Liang Sicheng, along with Chen Zhanxiang, proposed the 'Suggestions on the Location of the Administrative Center of the Central People's Government' (the Liang-Chen Proposal), advocating for the preservation of old Beijing, but the proposal was not adopted.

description.zh-cn: 陈占祥与梁思成共同提出《关于中央人民政府行政中心位置的建议》（梁陈方案）。
description.en: Chen Zhanxiang, along with Liang Sicheng, proposed the 'Suggestions on the Location of the Administrative Center of the Central People's Government' (the Liang-Chen Proposal).

description.zh-cn: 在戊戌变法失败后，慈禧太后迫害维新派人士，导致梁启超流亡海外。
description.en: After the failure of the Hundred Days' Reform, Empress Dowager Cixi persecuted reformers, causing Liang Qichao to flee into exile.

description.zh-cn: 1912年辛亥革命后，梁思成随父母从日本回国。
description.en: After the Xinhai Revolution in 1912, Liang Sicheng returned to China from Japan with his parents.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，梁思成为躲避战乱，携全家离开北平，前往西南地区。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Liang Sicheng left Beiping with his family and moved to Southwest China to escape the war.

description.zh-cn: 据称，在盟军对日本进行总攻击时，梁思成建议美军保护日本古都京都和奈良免于轰炸。然而，此说法尚存争议。
description.en: It is reported that during the Allied general attack on Japan, Liang Sicheng suggested that the US military protect the ancient Japanese capitals of Kyoto and Nara from bombing. However, this claim is still disputed.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，梁思成家中发现一把刻有“中正赠”的军刀，这成为他的一大罪状，加剧了对他的迫害。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, a military sword engraved with 'Gift of Zhongzheng (Chiang Kai-shek)' was found in Liang Sicheng's home, which became one of the major accusations against him and intensified his persecution.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成与刘敦桢曾在中国营造学社共事，并一同进行川康地区的古建筑调查。
description.en: Liang Sicheng and Liu Dunzhen worked together at the Society for Research in Chinese Architecture and jointly conducted investigations of ancient architecture in the Sichuan-Kangding area.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成于1959年1月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Liang Sicheng joined the Communist Party of China in January 1959.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成于1901年4月20日出生于日本东京。
description.en: Liang Sicheng was born in Tokyo, Japan on April 20, 1901.

description.zh-cn: 陈云与于若木于1938年3月结婚。
description.en: Chen Yun and Yu Ruomu married in March 1938.

description.zh-cn: 接替邓小平担任中国共产党中央顾问委员会主任。
description.en: Succeeded Deng Xiaoping as Chairman of the Central Advisory Commission of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月在中共十一届三中全会上当选为中央纪委第一书记。
description.en: Elected as the First Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection at the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CCP in December 1978.

description.zh-cn: 乔石接替陈云担任中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会书记。
description.en: Qiao Shi succeeded Chen Yun as the Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈云曾两度担任中共中央委员会副主席。
description.en: Chen Yun served twice as Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈云因提出“反冒进”而受到毛泽东批评，并在大跃进期间被迫做检讨。
description.en: Chen Yun was criticized by Mao Zedong for proposing 'anti-rash advance' and was forced to make self-criticisms during the Great Leap Forward.

description.zh-cn: 高岗试图联合陈云和邓小平排挤刘少奇和周恩来，但遭到陈云的反对。陈云在反对高岗、饶漱石的斗争中发挥了作用。
description.en: Gao Gang attempted to ally with Chen Yun and Deng Xiaoping to sideline Liu Shaoqi and Zhou Enlai, but was opposed by Chen Yun. Chen Yun played a role in the struggle against Gao Gang and Rao Shushi.

description.zh-cn: 与叶剑英商议对策，最终暗示采取非常手段，促成了对“四人帮”的粉碎。
description.en: Consulted with Ye Jianying on countermeasures, ultimately suggesting extraordinary measures, which contributed to the smashing of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 主持中共中央顾问委员会常委会议，主张采取以军事手段镇压学生运动。
description.en: Chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Central Advisory Commission, advocating for the use of military means to suppress the student movement.

description.zh-cn: 在“高岗饶漱石事件”中，陈云与邓小平站在了刘少奇一边。文革后，他领导中纪委复查并最终平反了刘少奇案。
description.en: During the 'Gao Gang-Rao Shushi Affair', Chen Yun and Deng Xiaoping sided with Liu Shaoqi. After the Cultural Revolution, he led the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection to review and eventually rehabilitate Liu Shaoqi's case.

description.zh-cn: 1871年的八瑶湾事件是日本在1874年发动牡丹社事件的直接借口。
description.en: The Bayao Bay Incident of 1871 was the direct pretext for Japan to launch the Mudan Incident in 1874.

description.zh-cn: 牡丹社头目阿禄古在石门战役中抵抗日军时战死。
description.en: Aruqu, the chief of the Mudan tribe, was killed in action while resisting the Japanese army during the Battle of Stone Gate.

description.zh-cn: 明治维新后大量武士（士族）失业造成社会问题，日本政府为安抚士族情绪，策划了出兵台湾的行动。
description.en: After the Meiji Restoration, widespread unemployment among samurai (shizoku) caused social problems. To placate the shizoku, the Japanese government planned the military expedition to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 清朝总理衙门大臣毛昶熙称台湾“生番”为“化外之民”，日本政府以此为借口，声称清朝对该地区无管辖权，从而为出兵台湾提供了理由。
description.en: The Qing Zongli Yamen minister Mao Changxi's statement that Taiwan's 'raw barbarians' were 'people beyond civilization' was used by the Japanese government as a pretext to claim the Qing had no jurisdiction, thereby justifying the expedition.

description.zh-cn: 为解决牡丹社事件引发的冲突，清日两国进行谈判，最终签订了《北京专约》。
description.en: To resolve the conflict arising from the Mudan Incident, Qing China and Japan entered into negotiations, which culminated in the signing of the Peking Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 牡丹社事件暴露了清朝对台湾后山地区控制的薄弱，促使清廷改变消极政策，推行“开山抚番”以加强对全台的实际统治。
description.en: The Mudan Incident exposed the weakness of Qing control over eastern Taiwan, prompting the Qing court to abandon its passive policy and implement the 'Open the Mountains and Pacify the Savages' policy to strengthen its actual rule over the entire island.

description.zh-cn: 牡丹社事件爆发后，清廷派遣船政大臣沈葆桢为钦差大臣，赴台处理海防及外交事务。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Mudan Incident, the Qing court dispatched Minister of Shipping Shen Baozhen as Imperial Commissioner to Taiwan to handle coastal defense and diplomatic affairs.

description.zh-cn: 为应对牡丹社事件所暴露出的海防弱点，沈葆桢奏请建造了包括二鲲鯓砲台（亿载金城）在内的一系列西式炮台。
description.en: To address the coastal defense vulnerabilities exposed by the Mudan Incident, Shen Baozhen proposed the construction of a series of Western-style forts, including the Erkunshen Fort (Eternal Golden Castle).

description.zh-cn: 在清日谈判陷入僵局时，英国公使威妥玛介入调停，促成了《北京专约》的签订。
description.en: When the Sino-Japanese negotiations reached a stalemate, British Minister Thomas Wade intervened as a mediator, facilitating the signing of the Peking Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 在牡丹社事件中担任日军侵台部队总指挥。
description.en: Served as the commander-in-chief of the Japanese expeditionary force to Taiwan during the Mudan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在牡丹社事件中被日本政府雇用，为出兵台湾提供建议和策划。
description.en: Was hired by the Japanese government during the Mudan Incident to provide advice and planning for the expedition to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹于1953年1月在广东省广州市出生。
description.en: Zhu Xiaodan was born in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province in January 1953.

description.zh-cn: 于1975年12月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Chinese Communist Party in December 1975.

description.zh-cn: 在中共中央党校中青年干部培训班学习。
description.en: Studied at the training program for young and middle-aged cadres at the Central Party School.

degree.zh-cn: 经济管理专业在职研究生

description.zh-cn: 在中共中央党校研究生院经济管理专业学习。
description.en: Studied in the Economic Management program at the Graduate School of the Central Party School.

description.zh-cn: 担任中共广东省委常委、广州市委书记。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the CCP Guangdong Provincial Committee and Secretary of the CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 担任广州市人大常委会主任。
description.en: Served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Guangzhou Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 当选为中国共产党第十七届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: Was elected as an alternate member of the 17th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 当选为中国共产党第十八届中央委员会委员。
description.en: Was elected as a member of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 出任全国人大财经委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Appointed as Vice Chairman of the Financial and Economic Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 当选为第十三届全国政协委员。
description.en: Elected as a member of the 13th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹在担任广东省省长期间，时任中共广东省委书记为汪洋，构成上下级关系。
description.en: While Zhu Xiaodan was Governor of Guangdong, Wang Yang was the Secretary of the CCP Guangdong Provincial Committee, establishing a subordinate relationship.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹在担任广东省省长期间，时任中共广东省委书记为胡春华，构成上下级关系。
description.en: While Zhu Xiaodan was Governor of Guangdong, Hu Chunhua was the Secretary of the CCP Guangdong Provincial Committee, establishing a subordinate relationship.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹接替黄华华出任中共广东省委副书记及广东省人民政府代省长。
description.en: Zhu Xiaodan succeeded Huang Huahua as Deputy Secretary of the CCP Guangdong Provincial Committee and Acting Governor of Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 马兴瑞接替朱小丹出任广东省人民政府省长。
description.en: Ma Xingrui succeeded Zhu Xiaodan as Governor of Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹接替林树森出任中共广州市委书记。
description.en: Zhu Xiaodan succeeded Lin Shusen as Secretary of the CCP Guangzhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹接替黄龙云出任广东省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Zhu Xiaodan succeeded Huang Longyun as Vice Governor of Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 朱小丹是广州队的忠实球迷，经常出现在主场赛事主席台上。
description.en: Zhu Xiaodan is a loyal fan of the Guangzhou team and often appears in the presidential box during home games.

description.zh-cn: 宋彬彬于1947年出生于北平市。
description.en: Song Binbin was born in Beiping in 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1960年至1966年就读于北京师范大学女附中。
description.en: Studied at the Girls' High School Attached to Beijing Normal University from 1960 to 1966.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间是北京师范大学女附中红卫兵领袖。
description.en: Was a Red Guard leader at the Girls' High School Attached to Beijing Normal University during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东首次接见红卫兵的活动中，宋彬彬因给毛泽东戴上袖章并与之交谈而闻名全国。
description.en: During Mao Zedong's first reception of the Red Guards, Song Binbin became famous nationwide for putting an armband on Mao and speaking with him.

description.zh-cn: 在工作组领导下，宋彬彬成为北京师大女附中革命师生代表会副主席之一。
description.en: Under the leadership of the work group, Song Binbin became one of the vice-chairpersons of the Revolutionary Teachers and Students' Representative Council at the Girls' High School Attached to Beijing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 陈春江自2023年10月起担任中共洛阳市委书记。
description.en: Chen Chunjiang has served as the Secretary of the CPC Luoyang Municipal Committee since October 2023.

description.zh-cn: 甘英奉班超之命出使大秦，为丝绸之路的开辟做出贡献。
description.en: Gan Ying, under Ban Chao's orders, embarked on a mission to Daqin, contributing to the establishment of the Silk Road.

description.zh-cn: 夏朝以斟𬩽（位于今洛阳市境内的二里头遗址）为都城。
description.en: The Xia dynasty established its capital at Zhenxun (the Erlitou site, located within modern Luoyang).

description.zh-cn: 东汉以雒阳（今洛阳市）为都城。
description.en: The Eastern Han dynasty established its capital at Luoyang.

description.zh-cn: 左思创作了文学名篇《三都赋》。
description.en: Zuo Si created the famous literary work 'Three Capitals Rhapsody'.

description.zh-cn: 684年9月，武则天将东都洛阳命名为“神都”。
description.en: In September 684, Wu Zetian named the eastern capital Luoyang 'Shendu' (Divine Capital).

description.zh-cn: 江敦涛出生于山东莱阳。
description.en: Jiang Duntao was born in Laiyang, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 江敦涛是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Jiang Duntao is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 2023年1月，江敦涛当选重庆市副市长，直至2025年10月落马。
description.en: In January 2023, Jiang Duntao was elected as Vice Mayor of Chongqing, a position he held until his downfall in October 2025.

description.zh-cn: 2025年10月25日，因涉嫌严重违纪违法，江敦涛接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
description.en: On October 25, 2025, Jiang Duntao was subjected to disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 2025年10月25日，因涉嫌严重违纪违法，江敦涛接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
description.en: On October 25, 2025, Jiang Duntao was subjected to disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 江敦涛接替齐家滨出任中共青岛市崂山区委员会书记。
description.en: Jiang Duntao succeeded Qi Jiabin as the Party Secretary of the CPC Qingdao Laoshan District Committee.

description.zh-cn: 江敦涛接替周连华出任中共淄博市委员会书记。
description.en: Jiang Duntao succeeded Zhou Lianhua as the Party Secretary of the CPC Zibo Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 马晓磊接替江敦涛出任中共淄博市委员会书记。
description.en: Ma Xiaolei succeeded Jiang Duntao as the Party Secretary of the CPC Zibo Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 江敦涛接替田庆盈出任中共潍坊市委员会书记。
description.en: Jiang Duntao succeeded Tian Qingying as the Party Secretary of the CPC Weifang Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军航空兵是中国人民解放军海军的航空兵部队。
description.en: The PLA Naval Air Force is the aviation branch of the PLA Navy.

description.zh-cn: 1952年1月8日，时任海军司令员萧劲光向中央军委上报请示报告，正式报请组建航空兵飞行部队。
description.en: On January 8, 1952, then-Navy Commander Xiao Jinguang submitted a report to the Central Military Commission officially requesting the establishment of naval aviation flight units.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月24日，周恩来总理批示同意海军提出的空军建设方针。
description.en: On August 24, 1952, Premier Zhou Enlai approved the guiding principles for the construction of the naval air force proposed by the Navy.

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月24日，毛泽东批示同意组建海军航空兵。
description.en: On August 24, 1952, Mao Zedong approved the establishment of the Naval Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军海军舰载航空兵部队是中国人民解放军海军航空兵的下属部队。
description.en: The PLA Navy Carrier-Borne Aviation Force is a subordinate unit of the PLA Naval Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 中华全国总工会是参加中国人民政治协商会议的人民团体之一。
description.en: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions is one of the people's organizations that participate in the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 1927年6月，中华全国总工会总部被中国国民党查封。
description.en: In June 1927, the headquarters of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions was shut down by the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 中华全国总工会曾经是世界工会联合会成员，在中苏交恶时退出，但至今仍保持“友好关系”。
description.en: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions was once a member of the World Federation of Trade Unions, withdrew during the Sino-Soviet split, but still maintains 'friendly relations'.

description.zh-cn: 担任全总常务副主席，主持总工会的工作。
description.en: Served as the Executive Vice Chairman of the ACFTU, presiding over the work of the federation.

description.zh-cn: 中国工人出版社是中华全国总工会的直属事业单位。
description.en: China Workers' Publishing House is a directly affiliated public institution of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 中国劳动关系学院是中华全国总工会直属的高等学校。
description.en: China University of Labor Relations is a higher education institution directly affiliated with the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 《工人日报》社是中华全国总工会的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Workers' Daily is a directly affiliated public institution of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 德仁出生于皇居内的宫内厅医院。
description.en: Naruhito was born at the Imperial Household Agency Hospital within the Imperial Palace.

description.zh-cn: 祖父昭和天皇为德仁命名为“浩宫德仁”。
description.en: His grandfather, Emperor Shōwa, named him 'Hironomiya Naruhito'.

description.zh-cn: 在学习院大学文学部史学科毕业，获得文学士学位。后于学习院大学院大学院人文研究科修完博士前期课程，获得人文科学硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of History, Faculty of Letters, Gakushuin University with a Bachelor of Letters degree. Later completed the first part of the doctoral program in humanities at the Graduate School of Gakushuin University, earning a Master of Humanities degree.

description.zh-cn: 进入牛津大学墨顿学院，研究泰晤士河水路运输史。
description.en: Studied at Merton College, Oxford, researching the history of water transport on the River Thames.

description.zh-cn: 牛津大学授予德仁名誉法学博士学位。
description.en: The University of Oxford awarded Naruhito an honorary Doctor of Laws degree.

description.zh-cn: 在皇太子时期担任日本赤十字社名誉副总裁。
description.en: Served as Honorary Vice-President of the Japanese Red Cross Society during his time as Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 与雅子皇后一同出席已故英国女王伊莉莎白二世的国葬。
description.en: Attended the state funeral of the late Queen Elizabeth II of the United Kingdom, alongside Empress Masako.

description.zh-cn: 会见到访的美国总统唐纳·川普。
description.en: Met with visiting U.S. President Donald Trump.

description.zh-cn: 因嫁入日本皇室，原为天主教徒的美智子改宗神道教。
description.en: Due to her marriage into the Imperial House of Japan, Michiko, who was originally a Catholic, converted to Shinto.

description.zh-cn: 吴佩孚是直系军阀的首领之一。
description.en: Wu Peifu was one of the leaders of the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 吴佩孚就任十四省讨贼联军总司令，发动反奉战争。
description.en: Wu Peifu assumed the post of commander-in-chief of the fourteen-province allied army and launched the Anti-Fengtian War.

description.zh-cn: 孙传芳在南京宣布成立五省联军，起兵响应反奉战争。
description.en: Sun Chuanfang announced the formation of the Five-Province Allied Army in Nanjing and joined the Anti-Fengtian War.

description.zh-cn: 吴佩孚在第二次直奉战争中被击败，率残部浮海遁走。
description.en: Wu Peifu was defeated in the Second Zhili-Fengtian War and fled by sea with his remaining troops.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥的甲子政变导致了直系军阀的迅速失败。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang's Beijing Coup led to the rapid defeat of the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥在甲子政变后，将其部队自立为国民军。
description.en: After the Beijing Coup, Feng Yuxiang established his troops as the Guominjun (Nationalist Army).

description.zh-cn: 第二次直奉战争后，张作霖与冯玉祥共同推举段祺瑞担任中华民国临时执政。
description.en: After the Second Zhili-Fengtian War, Zhang Zuolin and Feng Yuxiang jointly endorsed Duan Qirui to serve as the Provisional Chief Executive of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄的叛乱得到了冯玉祥的支持。
description.en: Guo Songling's rebellion was supported by Feng Yuxiang.

description.zh-cn: 日本方面决定不允许郭松龄的部队穿过南满铁路，阻碍了其军事行动。
description.en: The Japanese side decided not to allow Guo Songling's troops to cross the South Manchuria Railway, hindering his military actions.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖率部反攻，郭松龄兵败被捕，并于次日被杀害。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin launched a counterattack, leading to Guo Songling's defeat, capture, and execution the next day.

description.zh-cn: 在“讨赤”的背景下，吴佩孚与宿敌张作霖释嫌修好，联合对抗冯玉祥。
description.en: Under the banner of 'anti-Bolshevism', Wu Peifu reconciled with his old adversary Zhang Zuolin to jointly confront Feng Yuxiang.

description.zh-cn: 反奉战争期间，直系在华北投入精锐部队，导致湖北等中部省份兵力空虚，为国民革命军北伐创造了有利时机。
description.en: During the Anti-Fengtian War, the Zhili clique deployed its elite forces in North China, leaving a power vacuum in central provinces like Hubei, which created a favorable opportunity for the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖进入北京后，以“宣传赤化”为名查封《京报》并枪杀社长邵飘萍。
description.en: After entering Beijing, Zhang Zuolin shut down the 'Jingbao' newspaper and executed its president, Shao Piaoping, for 'propagating Bolshevism'.

description.zh-cn: 山东督办张宗昌以“赤化”罪名处死《社会日报》主笔林白水。
description.en: Zhang Zongchang, the military governor of Shandong, executed Lin Baishui, editor-in-chief of 'Social Daily', on charges of 'Bolshevization'.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄曾任张学良为司令的一三联军副司令。
description.en: Guo Songling served as the deputy commander of the 1st-3rd Combined Army, of which Zhang Xueliang was the commander.

description.zh-cn: 杜世成与女商人李薇有不正当关系，并伙同其收受财物。
description.en: Du Shicheng had an improper relationship with businesswoman Li Wei and colluded with her to accept bribes.

description.zh-cn: 杜世成于2000年10月至2001年2月任代理市长，2001年2月至2003年1月任市长。
description.en: Du Shicheng served as Acting Mayor from October 2000 to February 2001, and as Mayor from February 2001 to January 2003.

description.zh-cn: 在1997年4月至2002年6月期间，杜世成担任山东省副省长，而吴官正时任中共山东省委书记，杜世成为吴官正的下属。
description.en: From April 1997 to June 2002, Du Shicheng served as Vice Governor of Shandong Province, while Wu Guanzheng was the Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPC, making Du his subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 因严重违犯党纪，经中共中央批准，杜世成被免去所有职务。
description.en: Due to serious violations of party discipline, Du Shicheng was removed from all his posts with the approval of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 经中共中央纪委常委会议审议并报中共中央政治局决定，给予杜世成开除党籍、开除公职（双开）处分。
description.en: After deliberation by the Standing Committee of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and approval by the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee, Du Shicheng was expelled from the Party and removed from public office.

description.zh-cn: 以受贿罪作出一审判决，判处杜世成无期徒刑、剥夺政治权利终身、没收个人全部财产。
description.en: In the first-instance judgment, Du Shicheng was sentenced to life imprisonment, deprived of political rights for life, and had all his personal property confiscated for the crime of bribery.

description.zh-cn: 杜世成接替王家瑞，出任青岛市代理市长。
description.en: Du Shicheng succeeded Wang Jiarui as the acting mayor of Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 夏耕接替杜世成，出任青岛市市长。
description.en: Xia Geng succeeded Du Shicheng as the mayor of Qingdao.

description.zh-cn: 杜世成接替张惠来，出任中共青岛市委书记。
description.en: Du Shicheng succeeded Zhang Huilai as the Secretary of the CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在杜世成被免职后，阎启俊接任其青岛市委书记职务。
description.en: After Du Shicheng was removed from office, Yan Qijun succeeded him as the Secretary of the CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 庇护十二世在庇护十一世逝世后，继任为教宗。
description.en: Pius XII succeeded Pius XI as Pope after the latter's death.

description.zh-cn: 教宗庇护十一世于1929年12月16日将时任大使的派契利（后来的庇护十二世）擢升为枢机。
description.en: Pope Pius XI elevated then-Nuncio Pacelli (the future Pius XII) to the rank of cardinal on 16 December 1929.

description.zh-cn: 若望二十三世在庇护十二世逝世后，继任为教宗。
description.en: John XXIII succeeded Pius XII as Pope after the latter's death.

description.zh-cn: 维基文本中任期结束年份为1940年，但与其1930年开始担任国务枢机卿的记录冲突，故根据历史背景调整为1929年。
description.en: The end year in the Wikitext is 1940, which conflicts with his tenure as Cardinal Secretary of State starting in 1930. The date has been adjusted to 1929 based on historical context.

description.zh-cn: 庇护十二世的教宗任期与第二次世界大战重叠，这段时期的梵蒂冈政策备受关注和争议。
description.en: The pontificate of Pius XII coincided with World War II, and the Vatican's policies during this period are a subject of considerable attention and controversy.

description.zh-cn: 庇护十二学校以教宗庇护十二世的名字命名。
description.en: The Pius XII School was named after Pope Pius XII.

description.zh-cn: 白英奇主教于1953年1月25日为庇护十二学校奠基。
description.en: Bishop Lorenzo Bianchi laid the foundation stone for the Pius XII School on January 25, 1953.

description.zh-cn: 二战时期，苏联领导人斯大林在与丘吉尔的谈话中，曾以“教宗！他有几个师？”来嘲讽庇护十二世缺乏军事力量，体现了敌对和轻蔑的态度。
description.en: During World War II, Soviet leader Stalin, in a conversation with Churchill, mocked Pope Pius XII's lack of military power by asking, "The Pope! How many divisions has he got?", showing a hostile and dismissive attitude.

description.zh-cn: 庇护十二学校由玛利诺会士顾伦神父创办，并且与牛头角天主教小学同属玛利诺会创办的学校。
description.en: The Pius XII School was founded by Maryknoll priest John A. Curran and, like the Ngau Tau Kok Catholic Primary School, was founded by Maryknoll.

description.zh-cn: 文本提及，牛头角天主教小学和庇护十二学校同是由玛利诺会所创办。
description.en: The text mentions that Ngau Tau Kok Catholic Primary School and Pius XII School were both founded by Maryknoll.

description.zh-cn: 先后兼任第一政治委员、第二政治委员、第一政治委员。
description.en: Successively served as First Political Commissar, Second Political Commissar, and First Political Commissar, all concurrently.

description.zh-cn: 曹操是曹嵩的儿子。
description.en: Cao Cao is the son of Cao Song.

description.zh-cn: 曹植是曹操的儿子。
description.en: Cao Zhi is the son of Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 武宣卞皇后是曹操的继室。
description.en: Empress Bian was Cao Cao's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 曹操与袁绍在早年相处甚厚。
description.en: Cao Cao and Yuan Shao were very close in their early years.

description.zh-cn: 因父亲曹嵩被杀，曹操发兵征讨徐州牧陶谦。
description.en: Following the murder of his father Cao Song, Cao Cao launched a campaign against Tao Qian, the governor of Xu Province.

description.zh-cn: 曹操在名义上是东汉的臣子，官至丞相，爵至魏王。
description.en: Cao Cao was nominally a subject of the Eastern Han, holding the positions of Chancellor and King of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 曹操为曹魏政权奠定了基础。
description.en: Cao Cao laid the foundation for the state of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战的胜利极大地增强了曹操的实力，为其统一北方奠定了基础。
description.en: The victory in the Battle of Guandu greatly enhanced Cao Cao's power and laid the foundation for his unification of northern China.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍在官渡之战中惨败，其势力从此一蹶不振。
description.en: Yuan Shao suffered a devastating defeat in the Battle of Guandu, from which his power never recovered.

description.zh-cn: 郭嘉是曹操的谋士。
description.en: Guo Jia was an advisor to Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 桥玄很早就看出曹操的才能，认为他能安定天下，并鼓励他。
description.en: Qiao Xuan recognized Cao Cao's talent early on, believed he could bring stability to the world, and encouraged him.

description.zh-cn: 因伏皇后图谋铲除自己，曹操将其废黜并杀害。
description.en: Because Empress Fu plotted to eliminate him, Cao Cao had her deposed and executed.

description.zh-cn: 曹操因不能容忍孔融的言行而将其诛杀。
description.en: Unable to tolerate Kong Rong's words and actions, Cao Cao had him executed.

description.zh-cn: 曹操因杨修恃才放旷、干预世子之争而将其诛杀。
description.en: Cao Cao executed Yang Xiu for his arrogance and interference in the succession dispute.

description.zh-cn: 华佗因不肯为曹操专职治病而触怒曹操，被下狱拷问致死。
description.en: Hua Tuo angered Cao Cao by refusing to serve as his personal physician and was imprisoned, tortured, and killed.

description.zh-cn: 中美贸易战对中国经济造成压力，导致失业问题加剧，为“地摊经济”这类旨在促进灵活就业的政策提供了背景。
description.en: The Sino-US trade war put pressure on the Chinese economy, exacerbating unemployment and providing the context for policies like the 'stall economy' aimed at promoting flexible employment.

description.zh-cn: 清零政策带来的经济停滞和失业潮，使得政府需要寻找快速见效的就业渠道，“地摊经济”因此被提上议程。
description.en: The economic stagnation and wave of unemployment caused by the Zero-COVID policy necessitated the government's search for quick employment channels, leading to the 'stall economy' being put on the agenda.

description.zh-cn: 发布《关于应对新冠肺炎疫情影响强化稳就业举措的实施意见》，提出合理设定无固定经营场所摊贩管理模式，为地摊经济提供政策支持。
description.en: Issued the 'Implementation Opinions on Strengthening Measures to Stabilize Employment in Response to the Impact of the COVID-19 Pandemic,' proposing the reasonable establishment of management models for vendors without fixed business premises, providing policy support for the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 在全国两会上建议，因地制宜释放“地摊经济”的最大活力，并给予从业者合法地位。
description.en: Suggested at the National People's Congress's Two Sessions to unleash the full vitality of the 'stall economy' according to local conditions and grant legal status to its practitioners.

description.zh-cn: 明确在当年的全国文明城市测评指标中，不将占道经营、流动商贩等列为考核内容，为地摊经济的发展清除了一个重要障碍。
description.en: Clarified that indicators for the National Civilized City assessment that year would not include street vending and mobile vendors, removing a significant obstacle to the development of the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 清零政策及其伴随的封锁措施严重影响了中华人民共和国的经济发展，导致经济衰退和失业率上升。
description.en: The Zero-COVID policy and its accompanying lockdown measures severely impacted the economic development of the People's Republic of China, leading to economic recession and rising unemployment.

description.zh-cn: 在其担任北京市委书记期间，主导了对包括路边摊贩在内的“低端人口”和不符合城市秩序经营活动的清理整顿行动。
description.en: During his tenure as Beijing's Party Secretary, he led crackdowns and rectification campaigns against the 'low-end population' and business activities not conforming to urban order, including street vendors.

description.zh-cn: 发表社论《“地摊经济”不能一哄而起》，支持《北京日报》的观点，为正在升温的地摊经济舆论降温。
description.en: Published an editorial titled 'The Stall Economy Cannot Be Rushed Into', supporting the view of the Beijing Daily and cooling down the heating public opinion on the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 通过修订《上海市市容环境卫生管理条例》，容许摆地摊以应对清零政策对经济的冲击。
description.en: Promoted the stall economy by amending the 'Shanghai Municipal Regulations on City Appearance and Environmental Sanitation' to allow street stalls in response to the economic impact of the Zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 通过修订《深圳经济特区市容和环境卫生管理条例》，不再全面禁止“摆地摊”。
description.en: Promoted the stall economy by amending the 'Regulations of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone on City Appearance and Environmental Sanitation' to no longer completely ban 'street stalls'.

description.zh-cn: 推出“星星之火”地摊经济扶持计划，为从业者提供支持。
description.en: Launched the 'Spark' support program for the stall economy to provide assistance to practitioners.

description.zh-cn: 推出“全国小店烟火计划”，支持地摊经济。
description.en: Launched the 'National Small Store Fireworks Plan' to support the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 推出“春风行动”百万小店计划，支持地摊经济。
description.en: Launched the 'Spring Breeze Action' million small store plan to support the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 推出“夜逛合伙人”计划，支持地摊经济。
description.en: Launched the 'Night Market Partner' program to support the stall economy.

description.zh-cn: 旗下1688平台推出“地摊经济”帮扶计划。
description.en: Its 1688 platform launched a support plan for the 'stall economy'.

position.en: Section Leader of the 8th Engineer Battalion

description.zh-cn: 熊秉坤入湖北陆军第八镇工程第八营当兵，后升为正目（相当于班长）。
description.en: Xiong Bingkun joined the 8th Engineer Battalion of the Hubei Eighth Army Division as a soldier and was later promoted to Section Leader (equivalent to a squad leader).

description.zh-cn: 作为工程营革命军大队长，在起义中首先率部占领了楚望台军械库，是起义的主要领导人之一。
description.en: As the captain of the revolutionary forces in the engineering battalion, he was one of the main leaders of the uprising, leading his troops to capture the Chuwangtai Armory first.

description.zh-cn: 程正瀛在与长官冲突中开枪，直接点燃了武昌起义的导火索。
description.en: Cheng Zhengying's shooting during a conflict with his officer directly ignited the Wuchang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义爆发后，熊秉坤等人推举队官吴兆麟担任湖北革命军临时总指挥。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Wuchang Uprising, Xiong Bingkun and others acclaimed company officer Wu Zhaolin as the temporary commander-in-chief of the Hubei Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 熊秉坤参加了反对袁世凯的“二次革命”，并组织改进团，出任鄂中司令。
description.en: Xiong Bingkun participated in the 'Second Revolution' against Yuan Shikai, organized a reform group, and served as the commander of central Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 熊秉坤参加了旨在推翻袁世凯统治的二次革命。
description.en: Xiong Bingkun participated in the Second Revolution, which aimed to overthrow Yuan Shikai's rule.

description.zh-cn: 二次革命失败后，黎元洪悬赏通缉熊秉坤，导致其流亡日本。
description.en: After the failure of the Second Revolution, Li Yuanhong put a bounty on Xiong Bingkun, causing him to flee to Japan.

position.zh-cn: 广州大元帅府参军、高级副官、代参军长
position.en: Military Counselor, Senior Adjutant, and Acting Chief Military Counselor of the Guangzhou Grand Marshal's Mansion

description.zh-cn: 护法运动爆发后，熊秉坤在孙中山领导的广州大元帅府任职。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Constitutional Protection Movement, Xiong Bingkun served in the Guangzhou Grand Marshal's Mansion led by Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 二七大罢工期间，因中共原会议地点暴露，熊秉坤将自己家提供为临时会场，帮助会议得以继续召开。
description.en: During the February 7th Strike, after the original CCP meeting place was compromised, Xiong Bingkun provided his home as a temporary venue, helping the meeting to continue.

description.zh-cn: 1964年，熊秉坤作为全国政协委员在北京开会，在国宴上同周恩来交谈。
description.en: In 1964, as a member of the National Committee of the CPPCC, Xiong Bingkun attended a meeting in Beijing and talked with Zhou Enlai at a state banquet.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，红卫兵曾到熊秉坤家抄家。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Red Guards raided Xiong Bingkun's home.

description.zh-cn: 熊秉坤去世后，周恩来作出指示，要求湖北省革命委员会为熊秉坤操办丧事。
description.en: After Xiong Bingkun's death, Zhou Enlai gave instructions requesting the Hubei Provincial Revolutionary Committee to handle his funeral.

description.zh-cn: 陈启礼于1958年加入竹联帮，并在1968年被推举为总堂主，成为该帮派的领导核心和精神象征。
description.en: Chen Chi-li joined the Bamboo Union in 1958 and was elected Hall Master in 1968, becoming the gang's core leader and spiritual symbol.

description.zh-cn: 陈启礼毕业于淡江大学，获得工程学士学位。
description.en: Chen Chi-li graduated from Tamkang University with a Bachelor of Engineering degree.

description.zh-cn: 陈楚河是陈启礼的长子。
description.en: Chen Chu-he is the eldest son of Chen Chi-li.

description.zh-cn: 江南案后，陈启礼返台即被“一清专案”逮捕，并因江南案被判刑。
description.en: After the Henry Liu case, Chen Chi-li was arrested under "Operation Clean House" upon his return to Taiwan and was sentenced for his role in the assassination.

description.zh-cn: 因在“治平专案”中被列为通缉对象，陈启礼被迫逃亡至柬埔寨。
description.en: As a wanted target in "Operation Clean Sweep," Chen Chi-li was forced to flee to Cambodia.

description.zh-cn: 陈启礼被国防部情报局吸收，并接受训练，以执行刺杀刘宜良的任务。
description.en: Chen Chi-li was recruited by the Military Intelligence Bureau and received training to carry out the mission to assassinate Henry Liu.

description.zh-cn: 国防部情报局策划了江南案，并下达指令由竹联帮执行。
description.en: The Military Intelligence Bureau planned the Henry Liu case and issued orders for it to be carried out by the Bamboo Union.

description.zh-cn: 时任情报局局长汪希苓下达“制裁令”，派遣陈启礼等人赴美执行江南案。
description.en: Then Director of the Intelligence Bureau, Wang Hsi-ling, issued a "sanction order," dispatching Chen Chi-li and others to the U.S. to carry out the Henry Liu case.

description.zh-cn: 吴敦是江南案的共同执行者之一，参与了对刘宜良的刺杀行动。
description.en: Wu Tun was one of the co-executors of the Henry Liu case, participating in the assassination of Henry Liu.

description.zh-cn: 董桂森是江南案的共同执行者之一，参与了对刘宜良的刺杀行动。
description.en: Tung Kuei-sen was one of the co-executors of the Henry Liu case, participating in the assassination of Henry Liu.

description.zh-cn: 江南案曝光后，总统蒋经国下令逮捕情报局长汪希苓等涉案官员。
description.en: After the Henry Liu case was exposed, President Chiang Ching-kuo ordered the arrest of involved officials, including Intelligence Bureau Director Wang Hsi-ling.

description.zh-cn: 竹联帮在发展扩张时期，与四海帮为主要竞争对手，双方多次爆发严重冲突。
description.en: During its expansion period, the Bamboo Union and the Four Seas Gang were major rivals, leading to several serious conflicts between the two.

description.zh-cn: 1968年，竹联帮因地盘问题与台北中山区的牛埔帮爆发“香港西餐厅事件”械斗。
description.en: In 1968, the Bamboo Union clashed with the Niupu Gang of Taipei's Zhongshan District in the "Hong Kong Western Restaurant Incident" over territorial disputes.

description.zh-cn: 陈启礼在此事件中率领竹联帮以寡击众，使其声名大噪，奠定了他在帮中的领导地位。
description.en: In this incident, Chen Chi-li led the Bamboo Union to fight against overwhelming odds, which greatly enhanced his fame and solidified his leadership position within the gang.

description.zh-cn: 1995年，陈启礼亲自公开指定黄少岑担任竹联帮第二任帮主，完成权力交接。
description.en: In 1995, Chen Chi-li personally and publicly appointed Huang Shao-tsen as the second leader of the Bamboo Union, completing the transfer of power.

description.zh-cn: 1968年4月，张安乐主持阳明山会议，推举陈启礼为竹联帮“总堂主”，确立了其帮主地位。
description.en: In April 1968, Chang An-lo presided over the Yangmingshan meeting, which elected Chen Chi-li as the "Hall Master" of the Bamboo Union, establishing his position as the gang's leader.

description.zh-cn: 陈启礼于1958年由刘永吉引荐追随周榕加入竹联帮，周榕是其早期的老大。
description.en: In 1958, Chen Chi-li was introduced by Liu Yongji to follow Chou Jung and join the Bamboo Union, making Chou Jung his early leader.

description.zh-cn: 元武宗是答剌麻八剌的儿子。
description.en: Külüg Khan (Emperor Wuzong) was the son of Darmabala.

description.zh-cn: 在忽必烈去世后，支持其子铁穆耳（元成宗）即位。
description.en: After the death of Kublai Khan, she supported her son Temür (Emperor Chengzong) to ascend the throne.

description.zh-cn: 在忽必烈去世后，他支持其孙铁穆耳（元成宗）即位。铁穆耳最终于1294年5月10日，在顾命大臣伯颜等人的拥戴下继承皇位。
description.en: After the death of Kublai Khan, he supported his grandson Temür (Emperor Chengzong) to ascend the throne. Temür eventually ascended on May 10, 1294, with the support of regent ministers including Bayan.

description.zh-cn: 在忽必烈去世后，甘麻剌作为真金长子退让汗位继承权，使得其弟铁穆耳（元成宗）得以即位。
description.en: After the death of Kublai Khan, Gammala, as the eldest son of Zhenjin, relinquished his claim to the throne, allowing his younger brother Temür (Emperor Chengzong) to become emperor.

description.zh-cn: 元成宗在忽必烈去世后继承其皇位。
description.en: Emperor Chengzong succeeded to the throne after the death of Kublai Khan.

description.zh-cn: 元武宗在元成宗去世后继承其皇位。
description.en: Emperor Wuzong succeeded to the throne after the death of Emperor Chengzong.

description.zh-cn: 元成宗即位后停止了对日本的征伐。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Chengzong stopped the military campaigns against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 元成宗即位后停止了对安南（越南）的征伐。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Chengzong stopped the military campaigns against Annam (Vietnam).

description.zh-cn: 海都统治的窝阔台汗国长期与元朝对抗。
description.en: The Ögedei Khanate under Kaidu's rule was in long-term conflict with the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 都哇曾与海都结盟对抗元朝。
description.en: Duwa once allied with Kaidu against the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在海都去世后，都哇向元成宗表示臣服。
description.en: After Kaidu's death, Duwa submitted to Emperor Chengzong.

description.zh-cn: 钦察汗国正式承认元朝名义上的宗主地位。
description.en: The Golden Horde formally recognized the nominal suzerainty of the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 1309年，窝阔台汗国被元朝和察合台汗国瓜分而灭亡。
description.en: In 1309, the Ögedei Khanate was partitioned and destroyed by the Yuan dynasty and the Chagatai Khanate.

description.zh-cn: 1309年，窝阔台汗国被元朝和察合台汗国瓜分而灭亡。
description.en: In 1309, the Ögedei Khanate was partitioned and destroyed by the Yuan dynasty and the Chagatai Khanate.

description.zh-cn: 粟戎生于1942年出生于江苏扬州。
description.en: Su Rongsheng was born in Yangzhou, Jiangsu in 1942.

description.zh-cn: 粟戎生的籍贯地是湖南会同。
description.en: Su Rongsheng's ancestral home is Huitong, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 1961年从北京101中学毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Beijing 101 Middle School in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 60年代后期毕业于哈尔滨军事工程学院导弹控制专业。
description.en: Graduated from Harbin Military Engineering Institute with a major in Missile Control in the late 1960s.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，升任陆军第六十七集团军参谋长。
description.en: In 1985, he was promoted to Chief of Staff of the 67th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 以陆军第六十七集团军参谋长的身份参加两山战役。
description.en: Participated in the Battle of Laoshan and Zheyin as the Chief of Staff of the 67th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 曾担任陆军第二十四集团军军长。
description.en: Served as the Commander of the 24th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 曾担任北京军区副司令员。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Commander of the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，被授予中国人民解放军中将军衔。
description.en: In 1999, he was awarded the rank of Lieutenant General of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林出生于吉林磐石。
description.en: Du Qinglin was born in Panshi, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林于1966年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Du Qinglin joined the Communist Party of China in 1966.

position.zh-cn: 标准件分厂党委秘书、挤压车间主任、党支部书记、革委会副主任、副厂长、党委副书记
position.en: Party Committee Secretary of the Standard Parts Branch, Director of the Extrusion Workshop, Party Branch Secretary, Vice Chairman of the Revolutionary Committee, Deputy Factory Director, Deputy Party Secretary

description.zh-cn: 1968年至1978年，杜青林在长春第一汽车制造厂历任多个职务。
description.en: From 1968 to 1978, Du Qinglin held various positions at Changchun First Automobile Works.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任共青团吉林省委副书记、书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Deputy Secretary and Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中国共产党长春市委员会

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任中共长春市委副书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Changchun Municipal Committee.

position.zh-cn: 常委、组织部部长、副书记、政法委书记
position.en: Standing Committee Member, Head of the Organization Department, Deputy Secretary, Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission

description.zh-cn: 杜青林历任中共吉林省委常委、组织部部长、副书记、政法委书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin successively served as a Standing Committee Member, Head of the Organization Department, Deputy Secretary, and Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the CPC Jilin Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林在中共中央党校省部级干部进修班学习。
description.en: Du Qinglin studied in the advanced training class for provincial and ministerial level cadres at the Central Party School of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林在吉林大学法律系法律专业本科函授学习。
description.en: Du Qinglin completed undergraduate correspondence studies in law at the Law Department of Jilin University.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任中共海南省委副书记、书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Deputy Secretary and Secretary of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任海南省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任中华人民共和国农业部部长。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as the Minister of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛发布主席令，任命杜青林为农业部部长。
description.en: Then President of the People's Republic of China, Hu Jintao, issued a presidential decree appointing Du Qinglin as Minister of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Secretary of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任四川省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任第十一届、十二届全国政协副主席。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as Vice Chairman of the 11th and 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林曾任中共中央书记处书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin served as a Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林在中央书记处任职期间，向总书记习近平汇报工作。
description.en: During his tenure at the Central Secretariat, Du Qinglin reported to General Secretary Xi Jinping.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC

description.zh-cn: 杜青林担任全国政协副主席期间，贾庆林是全国政协主席。
description.en: While Du Qinglin served as Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, Jia Qinglin was the Chairman.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC

description.zh-cn: 杜青林担任全国政协副主席期间，俞正声是全国政协主席。
description.en: While Du Qinglin served as Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, Yu Zhengsheng was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林担任农业部部长期间，朱镕基是国务院总理。
description.en: While Du Qinglin served as Minister of Agriculture, Zhu Rongji was the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林担任农业部部长期间，温家宝是国务院总理。
description.en: While Du Qinglin served as Minister of Agriculture, Wen Jiabao was the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 令计划接替杜青林出任中共中央统战部部长。
description.en: Ling Jihua succeeded Du Qinglin as Head of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林接替张学忠出任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin succeeded Zhang Xuezhong as Secretary of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 刘奇葆接替杜青林出任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Liu Qibao succeeded Du Qinglin as Secretary of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林接替陈耀邦出任中华人民共和国农业部部长。
description.en: Du Qinglin succeeded Chen Yaobang as Minister of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 孙政才接替杜青林出任中华人民共和国农业部部长。
description.en: Sun Zhengcai succeeded Du Qinglin as Minister of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林接替阮崇武出任中共海南省委书记。
description.en: Du Qinglin succeeded Ruan Chongwu as Secretary of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 白克明接替杜青林出任中共海南省委书记。
description.en: Bai Keming succeeded Du Qinglin as Secretary of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杜青林接替邓鸿勋出任海南省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Du Qinglin succeeded Deng Hongxun as Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 张庆黎接替杜青林成为排名第一的全国政协副主席。
description.en: Zhang Qingli succeeded Du Qinglin as the first-ranking Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 彭真与张洁清于1939年在延安结婚，直至1997年彭真逝世。
description.en: Peng Zhen and Zhang Jieqing married in Yan'an in 1939 and remained so until Peng Zhen's death in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 刘朝兰是彭真的养女。
description.en: Liu Chaolan is the adopted daughter of Peng Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 1923年冬，经高君宇介绍，彭真加入中国共产党。
description.en: In the winter of 1923, Peng Zhen joined the Chinese Communist Party through the introduction of Gao Junyu.

description.zh-cn: 1925年5月，彭真参加并领导了反对阎锡山强征房屋估价税的斗争。
description.en: In May 1925, Peng Zhen participated in and led the struggle against the house valuation tax imposed by Yan Xishan.

description.zh-cn: 因在四平战役中的军事失败和与林彪等人的分歧，彭真于1946年6月16日被免去中共中央东北局书记职务，由林彪接任。
description.en: Due to military failures in the Siping Campaign and disagreements with Lin Biao and others, Peng Zhen was removed from his post as Secretary of the CCP Northeast Bureau on June 16, 1946, and was succeeded by Lin Biao.

description.zh-cn: 刘少奇主持中共中央政治局常委会会议，讨论通过了《二月提纲》。
description.en: Liu Shaoqi presided over a meeting of the Standing Committee of the CCP Politburo, which discussed and approved the 'February Outline'.

description.zh-cn: 《五一六通知》宣布撤销《二月提纲》。
description.en: The 'May 16 Notification' announced the withdrawal of the 'February Outline'.

description.zh-cn: 《五一六通知》点名批判彭真，随后其被停止中央书记处书记、撤销北京市委第一书记等职务。
description.en: The 'May 16 Notification' criticized Peng Zhen by name, and he was subsequently suspended from his post as Secretary of the Central Secretariat and removed as First Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 彭真任两案审判指导委员会主任，统一领导审判“林彪、江青反革命集团”的工作。
description.en: Peng Zhen served as the director of the trial steering committee, uniformly leading the work of trying the 'Lin Biao and Jiang Qing counter-revolutionary cliques'.

description.zh-cn: 彭真被视为邓小平主政时期的中共八大元老之一。
description.en: Peng Zhen is considered one of the Eight Great Elders of the CCP during Deng Xiaoping's era.

description.zh-cn: 彭真于1983年至1988年担任第六届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长。
description.en: Peng Zhen served as the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 6th National People's Congress from 1983 to 1988.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，彭真卸任全国人大常委会委员长，由万里接任。
description.en: In 1988, Peng Zhen stepped down as Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee and was succeeded by Wan Li.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，彭真接替叶剑英出任全国人大常委会委员长。
description.en: In 1983, Peng Zhen succeeded Ye Jianying as Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1980年，彭真担任恢复设立后的中央政法委员会首任书记。
description.en: In 1980, Peng Zhen became the first secretary of the re-established Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在林宅血案中身受重伤，是该案的唯一幸存者。
description.en: Was severely injured in the Lin family massacre, becoming the sole survivor of the incident.

description.zh-cn: 在2006年民进党主席补选中，公开反对游锡堃等高层参选，在游锡堃当选后，林义雄选择退出民进党。
description.en: In the 2006 DPP chairmanship by-election, he publicly opposed the candidacy of Yu Shyi-kun and other high-level officials. After Yu was elected, Lin Yi-hsiung chose to leave the DPP.

description.zh-cn: 为要求停建核四，发起无限期禁食行动。
description.en: Initiated an indefinite hunger strike to demand the cessation of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant construction.

description.zh-cn: 在林义雄禁食行动引发的社会压力下，马英九政府最终宣布核四一号机安检后封存、二号机停工。
description.en: Under public pressure sparked by Lin Yi-hsiung's hunger strike, the Ma Ying-jeou administration ultimately announced that Unit 1 of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant would be mothballed after safety checks and Unit 2 construction would be halted.

position.zh-cn: 将领 (左庶长、左更、国尉、大良造、上将军)
position.en: General (Zuo Shuzhang, Zuo Geng, Guowei, Da Liangzao, Shang Jiangjun)

description.zh-cn: 白起是秦国将领，为秦国效力三十余年。
description.en: Bai Qi was a general of the State of Qin, serving for over 30 years.

description.zh-cn: 白起在秦昭襄王麾下担任将领，为其效力三十余年。
description.en: Bai Qi served as a general under King Zhaoxiang of Qin for over 30 years.

description.zh-cn: 因范雎劝说秦王接受韩赵割地求和，错失灭赵良机，白起与范雎产生矛盾。
description.en: Bai Qi developed a conflict with Fan Sui because Fan Sui persuaded the King of Qin to accept a peace treaty with Han and Zhao in exchange for territory, thereby missing the opportunity to annihilate Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 在长平之战中，白起率秦军将赵括及其军队包围，最终射杀赵括，坑杀其降卒。
description.en: In the Battle of Changping, Bai Qi led the Qin army to surround Zhao Kuo and his forces, ultimately killing Zhao Kuo by arrow and burying his surrendered soldiers alive.

description.zh-cn: 司马靳是白起的副将，在杜邮与白起一同被赐死。
description.en: Sima Jin was Bai Qi's deputy commander and was forced to commit suicide along with Bai Qi at Duyou.

description.zh-cn: 秦昭襄王十四年，魏冉举荐白起，使其代替向寿领兵攻打韩、魏联军。
description.en: In the 14th year of King Zhaoxiang of Qin's reign, Wei Ran recommended Bai Qi to replace Xiang Shou in leading the army against the allied forces of Han and Wei.

description.zh-cn: 文本记载白起与秦昭襄王的舅舅穰侯魏冉关系密切。
description.en: The text states that Bai Qi had a close relationship with Wei Ran, Marquis Rang, who was the uncle of King Zhaoxiang of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 白起率领秦军在伊阙之战中击败韩魏联军，斩首二十四万。
description.en: Bai Qi led the Qin army to defeat the allied forces of Han and Wei in the Battle of Yique, beheading 240,000 enemy soldiers.

description.zh-cn: 白起率领秦军主力南下攻楚，先后攻陷鄢、郢，重创楚国。
description.en: Bai Qi led the main force of the Qin army south to attack Chu, successively capturing Yan and Ying and severely weakening the state of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 因在鄢郢之战中攻克楚国都城郢的战功，白起被封为武安君。
description.en: For his military achievement of capturing Ying, the capital of Chu, in the Battle of Yan-Ying, Bai Qi was enfeoffed as Lord Wu'an.

description.zh-cn: 在鄢郢之战中，白起率军攻陷楚国鄢城和都城郢，焚毁其王陵，迫使其迁都。
description.en: In the Battle of Yan-Ying, Bai Qi led his army to capture the Chu city of Yan and its capital Ying, burned down its royal tombs, and forced it to relocate its capital.

description.zh-cn: 在长平之战中，白起与廉颇作为秦赵两军的统帅相互对峙。
description.en: In the Battle of Changping, Bai Qi and Lian Po faced each other as the commanders of the Qin and Zhao armies, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 本·拉登是基地组织的首领。
description.en: Osama bin Laden was the leader of Al-Qaeda.

description.zh-cn: 哈立德·谢赫·穆罕默德是基地组织的高级成员，担任海外军事活动首领。
description.en: Khalid Sheikh Mohammed was a high-ranking member of Al-Qaeda, serving as the chief of its foreign military operations.

description.zh-cn: 为打击庇护基地组织的塔利班政权，美国领导联军于2001年10月7日对阿富汗发动了军事攻击。
description.en: To combat the Taliban regime which harbored Al-Qaeda, the United States led a coalition to launch a military attack on Afghanistan on October 7, 2001.

description.zh-cn: 因塔利班政权庇护基地组织，美国发动阿富汗战争对其进行军事打击，推翻了其政权。
description.en: Because the Taliban regime harbored Al-Qaeda, the United States launched the War in Afghanistan to militarily strike and overthrow its regime.

description.zh-cn: 1979年苏联入侵阿富汗后，本·拉登前往阿富汗参与抵抗运动，这成为其组织“阿富汗阿拉伯人”并最终建立基地组织的起点。
description.en: After the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan in 1979, Osama bin Laden went to Afghanistan to participate in the resistance, which became the starting point for him to organize the 'Afghan Arabs' and eventually establish Al-Qaeda.

description.zh-cn: 奥萨玛·宾·拉登在阿富汗组织了抵抗苏联的阿拉伯圣战者，这成为基地组织的前身和核心力量，他也是基地组织的创始人。
description.en: Osama bin Laden organized Arab mujahideen to resist the Soviets in Afghanistan, which became the precursor and core force of Al-Qaeda. He was also the founder of Al-Qaeda.

description.zh-cn: 本·拉登在自述中称，1982年以色列入侵黎巴嫩的战争及其画面直接震撼了他，使他产生了摧毁美国高楼以示惩罚的想法。
description.en: Bin Laden stated that the 1982 Israeli invasion of Lebanon and its imagery directly shocked him, leading him to the idea of destroying American tall buildings as a form of punishment.

description.zh-cn: 本·拉登将美国对以色列的长期外交和军事支持列为发动9·11袭击的核心动机之一。
description.en: Osama bin Laden cited the long-standing U.S. diplomatic and military support for Israel as one of the core motivations for launching the 9/11 attacks.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉是康熙帝的第十子。
description.en: Yun'e was the tenth son of the Kangxi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉的生母是温僖贵妃。
description.en: Yun'e's birth mother was Noble Consort Wenxi.

description.zh-cn: 因党附胤禩，允䄉被雍正帝革去爵位并圈禁。
description.en: Due to his alliance with Yinsi, Yun'e was stripped of his title and imprisoned by the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 为避其兄雍正帝胤禛的名讳，胤䄉改名为允䄉。
description.en: To avoid the naming taboo of his elder brother, the Yongzheng Emperor (Yinzhen), Yin'e changed his name to Yun'e.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉是康熙帝第十子，雍正帝是康熙帝第四子，二人为兄弟关系。
description.en: Yun'e was the tenth son of the Kangxi Emperor, and the Yongzheng Emperor was the fourth son; they were brothers.

description.zh-cn: 温僖贵妃是遏必隆之女。
description.en: Noble Consort Wenxi was the daughter of Ebilun.

description.zh-cn: 遏必隆是额亦都之子。
description.en: Ebilun was the son of Eidu.

description.zh-cn: 遏必隆是穆库什之子。
description.en: Ebilun was the son of Mukushen.

description.zh-cn: 穆库什是努尔哈赤之女。
description.en: Mukushen was the daughter of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 温僖贵妃是孝昭仁皇后的妹妹。
description.en: Noble Consort Wenxi was the younger sister of Empress Xiaozhaoren.

description.zh-cn: 孝昭仁皇后是康熙帝所册立的第二位皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaozhaoren was the second empress consort of the Kangxi Emperor.

position.en: Prince Dun of the First Rank

description.zh-cn: 康熙四十八年（1709年），允䄉晋封为多罗敦郡王。
description.en: In 1709 (the 48th year of the Kangxi reign), Yun'e was promoted to Prince Dun of the First Rank.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉与皇八子胤禩交好，并结成同盟参与了对皇位的争夺。
description.en: Yun'e was on good terms with the eighth prince Yinsi and formed an alliance with him to contend for the throne.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉与皇九子胤禟结成同盟参与了对皇位的争夺。
description.en: Yun'e formed an alliance with the ninth prince Yintang to contend for the throne.

description.zh-cn: 允䄉与皇十四子允禵结成同盟参与了对皇位的争夺。
description.en: Yun'e formed an alliance with the fourteenth prince Yunti to contend for the throne.

description.zh-cn: 康熙晚年，允䄉参与了九子夺嫡事件。
description.en: During the later years of the Kangxi reign, Yun'e participated in the succession struggle of the nine princes.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝即位后命人释放允䄉，并重新封其为辅国公。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Qianlong Emperor ordered the release of Yun'e and re-ennobled him as a Bulwark Duke.

description.zh-cn: 孝康章皇后是佟图赖之女。
description.en: Empress Xiaokangzhang was the daughter of Tulai.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武年轻时加入响马孙美瑶部。
description.en: Xu Jiwu joined the bandit forces of Sun Meiyao in his youth.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武年轻时加入响马孙美瑶部。
description.en: Xu Jiwu joined the bandit forces of Sun Meiyao in his youth.

description.zh-cn: 受北洋政府招安后，徐继武加入奉系军阀张宗昌、徐源泉部。
description.en: After being recruited by the Beiyang government, Xu Jiwu joined the Fengtian clique forces under Zhang Zongchang and Xu Yuanquan.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武在奉系军阀时期，属张宗昌部。
description.en: During his time with the Fengtian clique, Xu Jiwu served under Zhang Zongchang.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武长期在徐源泉部下任职，并受其提拔。
description.en: Xu Jiwu served under Xu Yuanquan for a long period and was promoted by him.

description.zh-cn: 因作战勇猛，徐继武获得其部队长徐源泉提拔。
description.en: Due to his bravery in combat, Xu Jiwu was promoted by his unit commander, Xu Yuanquan.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，徐继武随徐源泉部脱离奉系，加入国民革命军。
description.en: In 1928, Xu Jiwu, along with Xu Yuanquan's forces, left the Fengtian clique and joined the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武在南京保卫战期间，率领第48师参战，驻守栖霞山。
description.en: During the Defense of Nanking, Xu Jiwu led the 48th Division to participate in the battle, defending Qixia Mountain.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武在武汉会战期间，率领第48师守备大别山。
description.en: During the Battle of Wuhan, Xu Jiwu led the 48th Division to defend the Dabie Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 武汉会战后，徐继武因抗命与徐源泉一同被国民政府撤职。
description.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, Xu Jiwu, along with Xu Yuanquan, was dismissed from his post by the Nationalist Government for disobeying orders.

description.zh-cn: 1948年，时任江苏省主席的丁治磐邀请徐继武担任江苏省政府顾问。
description.en: In 1948, Ding Zhipan, then chairman of Jiangsu Province, invited Xu Jiwu to serve as an advisor to the Jiangsu Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武受中共派遣，前往舟山进行侦察与策反工作。
description.en: Xu Jiwu was dispatched by the Communist Party of China to Zhoushan to conduct reconnaissance and defection-inducement work.

description.zh-cn: 周景玉曾担任徐继武指挥的第48师旅部中校主任参谋。
description.en: Zhou Jingyu once served as a lieutenant colonel staff officer in the brigade headquarters of the 48th Division, commanded by Xu Jiwu.

description.zh-cn: 徐继武撤退到台湾后，作为老同事的丁治磐曾多次周济他。
description.en: After Xu Jiwu retreated to Taiwan, his old colleague Ding Zhipan provided him with financial assistance on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 周景玉原被拟判死刑，后经蒋介石裁定，改判为无期徒刑。
description.en: Zhou Jingyu was originally sentenced to death, but the sentence was commuted to life imprisonment by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国民政部于1999年5月18日追认徐继武为革命烈士。
description.en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China posthumously recognized Xu Jiwu as a revolutionary martyr on May 18, 1999.

description.zh-cn: 孙友宏担任东南大学校长。
description.en: Sun Youhong serves as the President of Southeast University.

description.zh-cn: 邬小撑担任东南大学党委书记。
description.en: Wu Xiaocheng serves as the Communist Party Secretary of Southeast University.

description.zh-cn: 东南大学是卓越大学联盟的成员高校。
description.en: Southeast University is a member of the Excellence 9 alliance.

description.zh-cn: 韦钰曾任东南大学校长。
description.en: Wei Yu formerly served as the President of Southeast University.

description.zh-cn: 原国立中央大学的工学院成为组建南京工学院（东南大学前身）的主体。
description.en: The Faculty of Engineering of the former National Central University became the main body for the establishment of the Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University).

description.zh-cn: 金陵大学的化学工程系和电机工程系并入组建南京工学院（东南大学前身）。
description.en: The Chemical Engineering and Electrical Engineering departments of the University of Nanking were merged into the Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University).

description.zh-cn: 私立江南大学的机械工程系、电机工程系和食品工业系并入组建南京工学院（东南大学前身）。
description.en: The Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Food Industry departments of Private Jiangnan University were merged into the Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University).

description.zh-cn: 南京工学院（东南大学前身）曾为华东航空学院（西北工业大学主体）提供办学场所、公共课教学和师资。
description.en: Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University) provided campus space, general education courses, and faculty for the East China Aeronautical Institute (the main body of Northwestern Polytechnical University).

description.zh-cn: 南京工学院（东南大学前身）曾为华东水利学院（河海大学前身）提供办学场所、公共课教学和师资。
description.en: Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University) provided campus space, general education courses, and faculty for the East China Technical University of Water Resources (predecessor of Hohai University).

description.zh-cn: 决定南京工学院（东南大学前身）无线电工程系主体停迁，得以保留在南京。
description.en: Decided that the main body of the Radio Engineering Department of Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University) should not be relocated, allowing it to remain in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 南京工学院（东南大学前身）化学工程系整建制划出，成立南京化工学院（南京工业大学主体）。
description.en: The entire Chemical Engineering Department of Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University) was spun off to establish the Nanjing Institute of Chemical Technology (the main body of Nanjing Tech University).

description.zh-cn: 南京工学院（东南大学前身）食品工业系整建制迁往无锡，成立无锡轻工学院（江南大学主体）。
description.en: The entire Food Industry Department of Nanjing Institute of Technology (predecessor of Southeast University) was relocated to Wuxi to establish the Wuxi Institute of Light Industry (the main body of Jiangnan University).

description.zh-cn: 东南大学培养了中国第一位交通学科博士王炜。
description.en: Southeast University educated Wang Wei, who became the first person in China to receive a Ph.D. in transportation.

description.zh-cn: 向东南大学捐资，用于建设李文正楼和李文正图书馆。
description.en: Donated funds to Southeast University for the construction of the Li Wenzheng Building and the Mochtar Riady Library.

description.zh-cn: 二级巡视员是综合管理类公务员职级，对应厅局级副职领导职务。
description.en: Inspector, Level II is a rank for comprehensive management civil servants, which corresponds to the leadership position of Deputy Director-General Level.

description.zh-cn: 1954年《中华人民共和国宪法》规定了全国人民代表大会决定大赦、中华人民共和国主席发布大赦令的制度。
description.en: The 1954 Constitution of the People's Republic of China established the system where the National People's Congress decides on amnesty and the President of the PRC issues the amnesty decree.

description.zh-cn: 1975年《中华人民共和国宪法》取消了大赦制度。
description.en: The 1975 Constitution of the People's Republic of China abolished the system of amnesty.

relationships.source: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 1949年《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》规定中央人民政府委员会有权颁布国家的大赦令。
description.en: The 1949 Organic Law of the Central People's Government stipulated that the Central People's Government Council had the authority to issue state amnesty decrees.

description.zh-cn: 根据1949年《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》，中央人民政府委员会有权颁布国家的大赦令。
description.en: According to the 1949 Organic Law of the Central People's Government, the Central People's Government Council had the authority to issue state amnesty decrees.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议制定了《中国人民政治协商会议共同纲领》。
description.en: The First Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference formulated the Common Program of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据1954年宪法，全国人民代表大会行使决定大赦的职权。
description.en: According to the 1954 Constitution, the National People's Congress exercised the power to decide on amnesty.

description.zh-cn: 根据1954年宪法，中华人民共和国主席根据全国人民代表大会的决定发布大赦令。
description.en: According to the 1954 Constitution, the President of the People's Republic of China issues amnesty decrees based on the decisions of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康是松平广忠的儿子。
description.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu is the son of Matsudaira Hirotada.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康是于大之方的儿子。
description.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu is the son of Odai no kata.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康早年作为人质侍奉今川义元，并接受其偏讳改名为松平元康。
description.en: In his early years, Tokugawa Ieyasu served Imagawa Yoshimoto as a hostage and adopted the name Matsudaira Motoyasu, receiving a character from Yoshimoto's name.

description.zh-cn: 织田信长在桶狭间之战中奇袭并击杀了今川义元。
description.en: Oda Nobunaga launched a surprise attack and killed Imagawa Yoshimoto in the Battle of Okehazama.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康与织田信长缔结了长达20年的清洲同盟，共同对抗敌人。
description.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu and Oda Nobunaga formed the 20-year Kiyosu Alliance to fight common enemies.

description.zh-cn: 织田信长在本能寺之变中身亡，导致清洲同盟瓦解。
description.en: The death of Oda Nobunaga in the Honnō-ji Incident led to the dissolution of the Kiyosu Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 明智光秀发动本能寺之变，背叛并导致了织田信长的死亡。
description.en: Akechi Mitsuhide launched the Honnō-ji Incident, betraying and causing the death of Oda Nobunaga.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康在关原合战中率领东军，与石田三成领导的西军作战并取得胜利。
description.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu led the Eastern Army to victory against the Western Army, led by Ishida Mitsunari, in the Battle of Sekigahara.

description.zh-cn: 石田三成在关原合战中战败，其势力被德川家康消灭。
description.en: Ishida Mitsunari was defeated in the Battle of Sekigahara, and his forces were eliminated by Tokugawa Ieyasu.

description.zh-cn: 后阳成天皇于1603年下诏，册封德川家康为征夷大将军。
description.en: In 1603, Emperor Go-Yōzei issued an edict appointing Tokugawa Ieyasu as Seii Taishōgun.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康为消灭丰臣氏残余势力，发动了大坂冬之阵与夏之阵。
description.en: To eliminate the remaining forces of the Toyotomi clan, Tokugawa Ieyasu initiated the Winter and Summer campaigns of the Siege of Osaka.

description.zh-cn: 大坂之役最终导致丰臣氏彻底灭亡。
description.en: The Siege of Osaka ultimately led to the complete destruction of the Toyotomi clan.

description.zh-cn: 丰臣秀赖在大坂夏之阵战败后自尽。
description.en: Toyotomi Hideyori committed suicide after being defeated in the Summer Campaign of the Siege of Osaka.

description.zh-cn: 后水尾天皇于1616年任命德川家康为太政大臣。
description.en: Emperor Go-Mizunoo appointed Tokugawa Ieyasu as Daijō-daijin in 1616.

description.zh-cn: 德川秀忠是德川家康的第三子。
description.en: Tokugawa Hidetada is the third son of Tokugawa Ieyasu.

description.zh-cn: 丰臣秀赖是丰臣秀吉的儿子。
description.en: Toyotomi Hideyori is the son of Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

description.zh-cn: 在总参三所从事情报翻译工作。
description.en: Worked as an intelligence translator at the Third Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 公开对三峡水电站的环境影响、移民政策等方面提出异议。
description.en: Publicly raised objections to the environmental impact and resettlement policies of the Three Gorges Dam project.

description.zh-cn: 在《光明日报》任记者期间，戴晴采访过方励之。
description.en: During her time as a journalist at Guangming Daily, Dai Qing interviewed Fang Lizhi.

description.zh-cn: 在《光明日报》任记者期间，戴晴采访过严家其。
description.en: During her time as a journalist at Guangming Daily, Dai Qing interviewed Yan Jiaqi.

description.zh-cn: 在《光明日报》任记者期间，戴晴采访过金观涛。
description.en: During her time as a journalist at Guangming Daily, Dai Qing interviewed Jin Guantao.

description.zh-cn: 戴晴参与了野夫在清迈发起的购房计划，共同生活于被称为“作家村”和“知交小聚落”的社区。
description.en: Dai Qing participated in a housing project initiated by Ye Fu in Chiang Mai, living together in a community known as a 'writer's village' and an 'intimate friends' settlement'.

description.zh-cn: 戴晴与李承鹏等人共同参与了在清迈的购房计划，生活于被称为“作家村”和“知交小聚落”的社区。
description.en: Dai Qing, along with Li Chengpeng and others, participated in a housing project in Chiang Mai, living in a community known as a 'writer's village' and an 'intimate friends' settlement'.

description.zh-cn: 国际报业联合会授予戴晴自由金笔奖。
description.en: The International Federation of Newspaper Publishers awarded Dai Qing the Golden Pen of Freedom Award.

description.zh-cn: 拥有副总警监警衔。
description.en: Holds the rank of Deputy Commissioner General.

description.zh-cn: 任爱荣接替孙新阳担任中央纪委国家监委驻公安部纪检监察组组长。
