description.en: Ren Airong succeeded Sun Xinyang as the head of the Discipline Inspection and Supervision Group of the CCDI and NSC in the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 香港基本法委员会是全国人民代表大会常务委员会下设的工作委员会。
description.en: The Hong Kong Basic Law Committee is a working committee under the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区基本法起草委员会提出设立全国人民代表大会常务委员会香港特别行政区基本法委员会的建议。
description.en: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Basic Law Drafting Committee proposed the establishment of the Committee for the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 第八届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十六次会议决定成立全国人民代表大会常务委员会香港特别行政区基本法委员会。
description.en: The 26th session of the Standing Committee of the Eighth National People's Congress decided to establish the Committee for the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 香港基本法委员会与澳门基本法委员会合设办公室和研究室。
description.en: The Hong Kong Basic Law Committee and the Macao Basic Law Committee jointly have an office and a research office.

description.zh-cn: 香港特别行政区行政长官与立法会主席、终审法院首席法官联合提名香港基本法委员会的香港委员人选。
description.en: The Chief Executive of the HKSAR, together with the President of the Legislative Council and the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal, jointly nominate Hong Kong members of the Hong Kong Basic Law Committee.

description.zh-cn: 香港立法会主席与香港特别行政区行政长官、终审法院首席法官联合提名香港基本法委员会的香港委员人选。
description.en: The President of the Legislative Council, together with the Chief Executive of the HKSAR and the Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal, jointly nominate Hong Kong members of the Hong Kong Basic Law Committee.

description.zh-cn: 香港终审法院首席法官与香港特别行政区行政长官、立法会主席联合提名香港基本法委员会的香港委员人选。
description.en: The Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal, together with the Chief Executive of the HKSAR and the President of the Legislative Council, jointly nominate Hong Kong members of the Hong Kong Basic Law Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中共江西省委执行中国共产党中央委员会的指示，并定期向其报告工作。
description.en: The Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CPC carries out the instructions of the CPC Central Committee and reports its work to it regularly.

description.zh-cn: 1938年6月重建的中共江西省委隶属于长江局。
description.en: The re-established Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CPC in June 1938 was subordinate to the Yangtze Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 1941年初，郭潜由江西省委书记调任中共南方工作委员会组织部长。
description.en: In early 1941, Guo Qian was transferred from his post as Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee to become the Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Southern Working Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2014年6月因严重违纪被免职。
description.en: Removed from office in June 2014 due to serious violations of discipline.

description.zh-cn: 卫子夫是卫媪的女儿。
description.en: Wei Zifu is the daughter of Wei Ao.

description.zh-cn: 诸邑公主是卫子夫的女儿。
description.en: Princess Zhuyi is the daughter of Wei Zifu.

description.zh-cn: 卫子夫是卫少儿的妹妹。
description.en: Wei Zifu is the younger sister of Wei Shao'er.

description.zh-cn: 霍去病是卫少儿的儿子。
description.en: Huo Qubing is the son of Wei Shao'er.

description.zh-cn: 汉宣帝是卫子夫的曾孙。
description.en: Emperor Xuan of Han is the great-grandson of Wei Zifu.

description.zh-cn: 卫子夫出生于平阳（今山西临汾）。
description.en: Wei Zifu was born in Pingyang (modern-day Linfen, Shanxi).

description.zh-cn: 平阳公主将卫子夫献给汉武帝，使其入宫并获得宠幸。
description.en: Princess Pingyang presented Wei Zifu to Emperor Wu of Han, which allowed her to enter the palace and gain his favor.

description.zh-cn: 在卫子夫入宫并怀孕后，时任皇后的陈氏对其十分妒恨。
description.en: After Wei Zifu entered the palace and became pregnant, Empress Chen, who held the title at the time, became extremely jealous of her.

description.zh-cn: 为报复卫子夫，陈皇后的母亲馆陶公主刘嫖企图绑架并杀害卫青。
description.en: To retaliate against Wei Zifu, Empress Chen's mother, Princess Guantao (Liu Piao), attempted to abduct and kill Wei Qing.

description.zh-cn: 在卫青被馆陶公主绑架后，公孙敖等人将其成功解救。
description.en: After Wei Qing was abducted by Princess Guantao, Gongsun Ao and others successfully rescued him.

description.zh-cn: 酷吏张汤负责查办陈皇后勾结巫女楚服行巫蛊之事，最终导致陈皇后被废黜。
description.en: The harsh official Zhang Tang was in charge of investigating Empress Chen's collusion with the witch Chu Fu to practice witchcraft, which ultimately led to the empress's deposition.

description.zh-cn: 陈皇后因勾结巫女楚服暗行巫蛊之事而被废黜。
description.en: Empress Chen was deposed for colluding with the witch Chu Fu to secretly practice witchcraft.

description.zh-cn: 陈皇后勾结巫女楚服暗行巫蛊之事。
description.en: Empress Chen colluded with the witch Chu Fu to secretly practice witchcraft.

description.zh-cn: 卫子夫生下汉武帝长子刘据后，被立为皇后。
description.en: After giving birth to Emperor Wu's eldest son, Liu Ju, Wei Zifu was made Empress.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝在巫蛊之祸中派遣官员收缴卫子夫的皇后印玺，意图废后，此举直接导致了卫子夫的自杀。
description.en: During the Witchcraft Rebellion, Emperor Wu of Han dispatched officials to confiscate Empress Wei Zifu's seal with the intention of deposing her, an act that directly led to her suicide.

description.zh-cn: 诸邑公主因受巫蛊牵连而被诛杀。
description.en: Princess Zhuyi was executed due to her involvement in the witchcraft allegations.

description.zh-cn: 在巫蛊之祸中，太子刘据起兵对抗汉武帝的军队。
description.en: During the Witchcraft Rebellion, Crown Prince Liu Ju raised troops to fight against the army of Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 汉宣帝即位后，为曾祖母卫子夫恢复名誉，追尊其谥号为“思后”。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Xuan of Han restored the reputation of his great-grandmother Wei Zifu and posthumously honored her with the title 'Empress Si'.

description.zh-cn: 史学家司马迁在其著作《史记》中称赞卫子夫品德良好。
description.en: The historian Sima Qian praised Wei Zifu for her good character in his work, 'Records of the Grand Historian'.

description.zh-cn: 国家疾病预防控制局由国家卫生健康委员会管理。
description.en: The National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention is managed by the National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 国家疾病预防控制局是中华人民共和国国务院下属的副部级国家局。
description.en: The National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention is a vice-ministerial-level national bureau under the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2021年4月28日，国务院任命国家疾病预防控制局领导人员；同年5月13日，国家疾病预防控制局正式挂牌成立。
description.en: On April 28, 2021, the State Council appointed the leadership of the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention; on May 13 of the same year, the Administration was officially inaugurated.

description.zh-cn: 沈洪兵兼任国家卫健委副主任。
description.en: Shen Hongbing concurrently serves as the Deputy Director of the National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在2021年4月被任命为国家疾病预防控制局副局长前，担任南京医科大学校长。
description.en: Before being appointed as the Deputy Director of the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention in April 2021, he served as the President of Nanjing Medical University.

description.zh-cn: 中国疾病预防控制中心是国家疾病预防控制局的直属事业单位。
description.en: The Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention is a public institution directly under the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention.

description.zh-cn: 中华预防医学会是国家疾病预防控制局主管的社会团体。
description.en: The Chinese Preventive Medicine Association is a social organization supervised by the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝临终托孤，任命霍光为大司马大将军，辅佐年幼的汉昭帝。
description.en: On his deathbed, Emperor Wu entrusted his young son to Huo Guang, appointing him Grand Marshal and regent to assist the young Emperor Zhao.

description.zh-cn: 江充与太子刘据结怨，利用追查巫蛊的机会诬告太子，是引发巫蛊之祸的关键人物。
description.en: Holding a grudge against Crown Prince Liu Ju, Jiang Chong used the investigation of witchcraft to frame the prince, becoming a key figure in triggering the catastrophe.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝晚年颁布《轮台诏》，对自己过去的穷兵黩武等政策进行反省，决定与民休息。
description.en: In his later years, Emperor Wu issued the 'Edict of Luntai', reflecting on his past policies of incessant warfare and deciding to allow the people to recuperate.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝采纳董仲舒的建议，创建了太学，作为培养和储备国家人才的最高学府。
description.en: Following Dong Zhongshu's advice, Emperor Wu founded the Imperial University (Taixue) as the highest institution for educating and reserving talent for the state.

description.zh-cn: 卫青作为汉武帝时期的大将军，是汉匈战争中的主要军事统帅。
description.en: As the Grand General under Emperor Wu, Wei Qing was the main military commander in the Han-Xiongnu Wars.

position.en: Grand Marshal and General of Cavalry

description.zh-cn: 霍去病是汉武帝时期杰出的将领，在汉匈战争中屡立奇功。
description.en: Huo Qubing was an outstanding general under Emperor Wu who achieved remarkable feats in the Han-Xiongnu Wars.

description.zh-cn: 张骞奉汉武帝之命出使西域。
description.en: Zhang Qian was dispatched to the Western Regions by order of Emperor Wu.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青点名批评过的中华人民共和国持不同政见者之一。
description.en: One of the PRC dissidents publicly criticized by Cao Changqing.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青曾撰文抨击马英九的元旦祝词“睁眼说瞎话”。
description.en: Cao Changqing wrote an article criticizing Ma Ying-jeou's New Year's address as 'blatant lies'.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青在2010年曾撰文称赞韩寒挑战中共政府。
description.en: In 2010, Cao Changqing wrote an article praising Han Han for challenging the CCP government.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青在2019年声称韩寒造假，以抨击政府的方式帮助中共洗脑。
description.en: In 2019, Cao Changqing claimed Han Han was a fraud, helping the CCP brainwash people by criticizing the government.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年美国总统大选前，曹长青多次撰文批评川普，将他与希特勒相提并论。
description.en: Before the 2016 US presidential election, Cao Changqing wrote multiple articles criticizing Trump, comparing him to Hitler.

description.zh-cn: 在川普当选后，曹长青转为他的狂热支持者。
description.en: After Trump was elected, Cao Changqing became his fervent supporter.

description.zh-cn: 曹长青斥骂民主党候选人拜登，并散播关于他选举舞弊的阴谋论。
description.en: Cao Changqing criticized Democratic candidate Biden and spread conspiracy theories about his election fraud.

description.zh-cn: 《台湾苹果日报》总主笔卜大中对曹长青给予正面评价，称其“进步神速”。
description.en: Bu Dazhong, chief writer for Taiwan's Apple Daily, gave a positive evaluation of Cao Changqing, praising his 'rapid progress'.

description.zh-cn: 美国司法部于2023年3月15日宣布逮捕郭文贵，指控其策划超过十亿美元的诈骗阴谋。
description.en: The U.S. Department of Justice announced the arrest of Guo Wengui on March 15, 2023, charging him with orchestrating a fraud conspiracy of over one billion dollars.

description.zh-cn: 美国证券交易委员会指控郭文贵参与未注册和欺诈性发行，骗取超过八亿五千万美元的资金。
description.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission charged Guo Wengui with participating in unregistered and fraudulent offerings, defrauding investors of over $850 million.

description.zh-cn: 1727年，富察氏被雍正帝指婚为皇四子弘历（后来的乾隆帝）的嫡福晋。二人婚后感情深厚，相敬如宾。
description.en: In 1727, Lady Fuca was designated by the Yongzheng Emperor as the primary consort for his fourth son, Hongli (the future Qianlong Emperor). They had a deep and respectful marital relationship.

description.zh-cn: 傅恒是孝贤纯皇后的弟弟。
description.en: Fuheng was the younger brother of Empress Xiaoxianchun.

description.zh-cn: 孝贤纯皇后属于满洲镶黄旗。
description.en: Empress Xiaoxianchun belonged to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

description.zh-cn: 1727年，雍正帝在八旗选秀中将富察氏指婚给皇四子弘历，为嫡福晋。
description.en: In 1727, during the Eight Banners selection, the Yongzheng Emperor arranged for Lady Fuca to marry his fourth son Hongli as his primary consort.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝因孝贤皇后的缘故，对傅恒格外恩宠和重用。乾隆曾言：“即大学士公傅恒之加恩，亦由于皇后”。
description.en: Due to his connection to Empress Xiaoxianchun, the Qianlong Emperor showed exceptional favor and trust towards Fuheng. Qianlong once stated, 'The favors bestowed upon Grand Secretary Fuheng are also because of the Empress'.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝将孝贤皇后的侄子福康安自幼接入宫中，亲自教养，视如己出。
description.en: The Qianlong Emperor brought his nephew-in-law, Fuk'anggan, into the palace at a young age, personally raising and educating him as if he were his own son.

description.zh-cn: 永琏是孝贤纯皇后所生的皇次子。
description.en: Yonglian was the second son of the Emperor, born to Empress Xiaoxianchun.

description.zh-cn: 永琏是乾隆帝的皇次子。
description.en: Yonglian was the second son of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 永琮是孝贤纯皇后所生的皇七子。
description.en: Yongcong was the seventh son of the Emperor, born to Empress Xiaoxianchun.

description.zh-cn: 永琮是乾隆帝的皇七子。
description.en: Yongcong was the seventh son of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 固伦和敬公主是孝贤纯皇后所生的皇三女。
description.en: Princess Gulun Hejing was the third daughter of the Emperor, born to Empress Xiaoxianchun.

description.zh-cn: 固伦和敬公主是乾隆帝的皇三女。
description.en: Princess Gulun Hejing was the third daughter of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆十二年（1747年）三月，固伦和敬公主嫁给科尔沁博尔济吉特氏辅国公色布腾巴尔珠尔。
description.en: In March of the 12th year of Qianlong's reign (1747), Princess Gulun Hejing married Septeng Baljur, a Duke of the Khorchin Borjigit clan.

description.zh-cn: 因在孝贤皇后丧仪上表现不够悲痛，乾隆帝严厉斥责皇长子永璜，并宣称其“断不可承续大统”，剥夺了他的继承资格。
description.en: For not displaying sufficient grief at Empress Xiaoxianchun's funeral, the Qianlong Emperor severely reprimanded his eldest son, Yonghuang, and declared that he 'absolutely cannot inherit the great lineage,' thus stripping him of his succession rights.

description.zh-cn: 因在孝贤皇后丧仪上表现不够悲痛，乾隆帝严厉斥责皇三子永璋，并剥夺了他的继承资格。
description.en: For not displaying sufficient grief at Empress Xiaoxianchun's funeral, the Qianlong Emperor severely reprimanded his third son, Yongzhang, and stripped him of his succession rights.

description.zh-cn: 因翰林院所制皇后册文的满文译文中将“皇妣”误译为“先太后”，时任刑部尚书阿克敦被乾隆帝勃然大怒，交刑部治罪，后拟斩监侯。
description.en: Because the Manchu translation of the Empress's ceremonial text prepared by the Hanlin Academy mistakenly translated 'Deceased Imperial Mother' as 'Former Empress Dowager,' the Qianlong Emperor became enraged and had the Minister of Justice, Akdun, arrested and tried, later sentencing him to death with a reprieve.

description.zh-cn: 因翰林院撰写皇后祭文时使用了“泉台”二字，乾隆帝认为不妥，作为审阅者的大学士张廷玉因“全不留心检点”被罚俸一年。
description.en: Because the Hanlin Academy used the term 'quan tai' (underworld springs) in the Empress's eulogy, which the Qianlong Emperor deemed inappropriate, Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu, as the reviewer, was fined one year's salary for 'complete inattention to detail'.

description.zh-cn: 因礼部在拟定皇后谥号仪式时未议定王公行礼之处，时任礼部尚书海望被降二级留任。
description.en: Because the Ministry of Rites failed to specify the protocol for princes and dukes during the Empress's posthumous title ceremony, the Minister of Rites, Haiwang, was demoted by two ranks but retained his post.

description.zh-cn: 内管领清泰因“迟误献供饽饽”于孝贤皇后的供桌，被销去官衔加级并处以杖刑。
description.en: The Imperial Household official Qingtai was stripped of his rank promotions and caned for 'delaying the presentation of sacrificial pastries' at Empress Xiaoxianchun's altar.

description.zh-cn: 因孝贤纯皇后在济南染病后去世，乾隆帝为避免触景伤情，此后数次南巡均过济南而不入城。
description.en: Because Empress Xiaoxianchun fell ill in Jinan and subsequently passed away, the Qianlong Emperor avoided entering the city on his later southern tours to prevent painful memories from being stirred.

description.zh-cn: 马齐是李荣保的兄长。
description.en: Macai was the elder brother of Li Rongbao.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆二年，保和殿大学士鄂尔泰作为正使，主持了册立富察氏为皇后的典礼。
description.en: In the second year of Qianlong's reign, Ortai, Grand Secretary of the Baohe Hall, presided over the ceremony to install Lady Fuca as Empress, acting as the chief envoy.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，黄宏生移居香港后创业，成立了创维数码。
description.en: In 1988, after moving to Hong Kong, Huang Hongsheng started his own business and founded Skyworth Digital.

description.zh-cn: 黄宏生是创维数码的创始人兼前主席。
description.en: Huang Hongsheng is the founder and former chairman of Skyworth Digital.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于无线电工程专业。
description.en: Graduated with a major in Radio Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 555年，萧詧在西魏支持下于江陵称帝，建立西梁政权。
description.en: In 555, Xiao Cha, with the support of the Western Wei, declared himself emperor in Jiangling, establishing the Western Liang regime.

description.zh-cn: 西魏支持梁宣帝（萧詧）在江陵称帝。
description.en: The Western Wei supported Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha) in declaring himself emperor in Jiangling.

description.zh-cn: 西梁开国皇帝萧詧向西魏称臣，使西梁成为西魏的附庸国。
description.en: The founding emperor of Western Liang, Xiao Cha, declared allegiance to the Western Wei, making Western Liang a vassal state.

description.zh-cn: 554年，西魏攻陷江陵，杀害了南梁皇帝梁元帝。
description.en: In 554, the Western Wei captured Jiangling and killed Emperor Yuan of the Southern Liang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 587年，隋朝遣军吞并西梁，西梁灭亡。
description.en: In 587, the Sui dynasty dispatched an army to annex the Western Liang, leading to its demise.

description.zh-cn: 梁明帝萧岿是梁宣帝萧詧的太子。
description.en: Emperor Ming (Xiao Kui) was the crown prince of Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha).

description.zh-cn: 萧琮是梁明帝萧岿的太子。
description.en: Xiao Cong was the crown prince of Emperor Ming (Xiao Kui).

description.zh-cn: 梁宣帝萧詧是南梁昭明太子萧统的儿子。
description.en: Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha) was the son of Crown Prince Zhaoming (Xiao Tong) of the Southern Liang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 萧铣是西梁开国皇帝梁宣帝（萧詧）的曾孙。
description.en: Xiao Xian was the great-grandson of the founding emperor of Western Liang, Emperor Xuan (Xiao Cha).

description.zh-cn: 558年，西梁一度攻占了由王琳控制的长沙郡、武陵郡、南平郡。
description.en: In 558, the Western Liang temporarily captured the commanderies of Changsha, Wuling, and Nanping, which were controlled by Wang Lin.

description.zh-cn: 西梁是南梁在梁元帝于江陵被杀后残存的政权。
description.en: Western Liang was the remnant state of the Southern Liang dynasty after Emperor Yuan was killed in Jiangling.

description.zh-cn: 普林斯顿大学是常春藤盟校的成员之一。
description.en: Princeton University is a member of the Ivy League.

description.zh-cn: 担任校长期间，引入了称为“precept”的小组导修课，对普林斯顿大学的本科教育模式进行了重要革新。
description.en: During his presidency, he introduced the preceptorial system, a significant innovation in Princeton's undergraduate educational model.

description.zh-cn: 于1995年向母校普林斯顿大学捐款一亿美元。
description.en: Donated $100 million to his alma mater, Princeton University, in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 杰夫·贝佐斯是亚马逊公司的创始人。
description.en: Jeff Bezos is the founder of Amazon.com.

description.zh-cn: 普林斯顿大学与临近的普林斯顿高等研究院关系密切。
description.en: Princeton University has a close relationship with the nearby Institute for Advanced Study.

description.zh-cn: 普林斯顿中国学社是在六四事件之后成立的，旨在收留流亡的中国学生和学者。
description.en: The Princeton China Initiative was established in the aftermath of the Tiananmen Square protests to support exiled Chinese students and scholars.

description.zh-cn: 艾伦·图灵于1938年获得普林斯顿大学博士学位。
description.en: Alan Turing received his Ph.D. from Princeton University in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略出生于湖南省湘乡县桂花乡高木冲。
description.en: Huang Gonglue was born in Gaomuchong, Guihua Township, Xiangxiang County, Hunan Province.

position.en: Clerk, Chinese language instructor, Platoon leader

description.zh-cn: 黄公略于1916年参加湘军，历任文书、国文教员、排长等职。
description.en: Huang Gonglue joined the Hunan Army in 1916 and successively served as a clerk, Chinese language instructor, and platoon leader.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略在湘军服役期间，与同连的李灿结为挚友。
description.en: During his service in the Hunan Army, Huang Gonglue became a close friend of Li Can, who was in the same company.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略于1922年考入湖南陆军讲武堂，次年结业。
description.en: Huang Gonglue was admitted to the Hunan Military Academy in 1922 and graduated the following year.

description.zh-cn: 1926年7月，黄公略所在的湘军部队改编为国民革命军第八军，他随之加入国民革命军并参加北伐战争。
description.en: In July 1926, the Hunan Army unit Huang Gonglue served in was reorganized into the Eighth Army of the National Revolutionary Army, and he subsequently joined the NRA and participated in the Northern Expedition.

description.zh-cn: 1927年1月，黄公略进入黄埔军校高级班学习。
description.en: In January 1927, Huang Gonglue entered the advanced class of the Whampoa Military Academy to study.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略在黄埔军校学习期间加入了中国共产党。
description.en: Huang Gonglue joined the Communist Party of China while studying at the Whampoa Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略率领其部队参与发动平江起义。
description.en: Huang Gonglue led his troops to participate in launching the Pingjiang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 平江起义后，起义部队组建为中国工农红军第五军。
description.en: After the Pingjiang Uprising, the insurgent troops were organized into the Fifth Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

position.en: Deputy Army Commander, Column Commander, Party Representative

description.zh-cn: 红五军成立后，黄公略历任党代表、纵队长、副军长等职。
description.en: After the establishment of the Red 5th Army, Huang Gonglue successively served as Party Representative, Column Commander, and Deputy Army Commander.

description.zh-cn: 1930年1月，黄公略调任红六军军长。
description.en: In January 1930, Huang Gonglue was transferred to be the commander of the Red 6th Army.

description.zh-cn: 1930年6月，黄公略任红三军军长。
description.en: In June 1930, Huang Gonglue was appointed commander of the Red 3rd Army.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略率领红三军参加了中央苏区第一次反围剿战争，并在龙冈战斗中担任主力。
description.en: Huang Gonglue led the Red 3rd Army in the First Encirclement Campaign against the Central Soviet Area and served as the main force in the Battle of Longgang.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略率部参加第三次反围剿战争，期间在一次空袭中牺牲。
description.en: Huang Gonglue led his troops in the Third Encirclement Campaign, during which he was killed in an air raid.

description.zh-cn: 1931年9月15日，在第三次反围剿战争期间，黄公略因国民革命军的空袭而重伤不治身亡。
description.en: On September 15, 1931, during the Third Encirclement Campaign, Huang Gonglue was mortally wounded in an air raid by the National Revolutionary Army and died.

description.zh-cn: 根据黄公略的意见，彭德怀下令处死了前来劝降的黄梅庄。
description.en: Following Huang Gonglue's opinion, Peng Dehuai ordered the execution of Huang Meizhuang, who had come to persuade them to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 黄梅庄是黄公略同父异母的哥哥。
description.en: Huang Meizhuang was Huang Gonglue's half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 刘玉英是黄公略的妻子。
description.en: Liu Yuying was the wife of Huang Gonglue.

description.zh-cn: 黄岁新是黄公略的女儿。
description.en: Huang Suixin is the daughter of Huang Gonglue.

description.zh-cn: 黄岁新是刘玉英的女儿。
description.en: Huang Suixin is the daughter of Liu Yuying.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在其词《蝶恋花·从汀州到长沙》中写道“偏师借重黄公略”，并为其亲写挽联，高度评价其功绩，提升了其历史地位。
description.en: In his poem "To the tune of Dielianhua: From Tingzhou to Changsha," Mao Zedong wrote "The detached force relies heavily on Huang Gonglue" and personally wrote a memorial couplet for him, highly praising his achievements and elevating his historical status.

description.zh-cn: 黄公略逝世后被中共中央军委认定为“中国人民解放军军事家”。
description.en: After his death, Huang Gonglue was recognized as a "Militarist of the Chinese People's Liberation Army" by the CCP Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 傅兆林是傅崐萁的父亲。
description.en: Fu Zhaolin is the father of Fu Kun-chi.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁出生于台中市。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi was born in Taichung City.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁毕业于淡江大学交通管理学系，后获得中国大陆研究所硕士在职专班学位。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi graduated from the Department of Transportation Management at Tamkang University and later obtained a master's degree from the Graduate Institute of China Studies.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁在担任立法委员期间，于广州暨南大学攻读国际关系学院法学博士学位。
description.en: While serving as a legislator, Fu Kun-chi pursued a Doctor of Law degree at the School of International Studies of Jinan University in Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁曾任第5-7届及第10届至今的立法委员。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi served as a member of the Legislative Yuan for the 5th-7th terms and from the 10th term to the present.

description.zh-cn: 傅崐萁于2024年2月1日起担任中国国民党立法院党团总召集人。
description.en: Fu Kun-chi has served as the convener of the KMT legislative caucus since February 1, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 在2020年立法委员选举中，傅崐萁以无党籍身份击败了寻求连任的民主进步党籍候选人萧美琴。
description.en: In the 2020 legislative election, Fu Kun-chi, running as an independent, defeated the incumbent Democratic Progressive Party candidate Hsiao Bi-khim.

description.zh-cn: 童子贤指控，在2018年花莲地震后，他欲直接捐助受灾国小重建时，受到时任县长傅崐萁领导的县政府施压，要求捐款必须通过县府统筹分配。
description.en: Tung Tzu-hsien alleged that after the 2018 Hualien earthquake, when he wanted to directly donate to a damaged elementary school for reconstruction, he was pressured by the county government under then-Magistrate Fu Kun-chi, which demanded that the donation must be centrally allocated by the government.

description.zh-cn: 针对童子贤关于捐款受县府施压的指控，傅崐萁与妻子徐榛蔚一同至花莲地检署提告童子贤加重诽谤及违反选罢法。
description.en: In response to Tung Tzu-hsien's allegations of being pressured by the county government over his donation, Fu Kun-chi and his wife Hsu Chen-wei filed a lawsuit against Tung at the Hualien District Prosecutors Office for aggravated defamation and violation of the Election and Recall Act.

description.zh-cn: 徐大彤接替王小宁担任中国共产党天津市武清区委员会书记。
description.en: Xu Datong succeeded Wang Xiaoning as Secretary of the CPC Tianjin Wuqing District Committee.

description.zh-cn: 徐大彤接替胡明朗担任陕西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Xu Datong succeeded Hu Minglang as Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 戴彬彬接替徐大彤担任陕西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Dai Binbin succeeded Xu Datong as Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框和“隶属”部分，香港电台自2007年7月1日起隶属于商务及经济发展局。
description.en: According to the infobox and the 'Affiliation' section, RTHK has been subordinate to the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau since July 1, 2007.

description.zh-cn: 香港电台是香港特别行政区政府辖下的一个部门。
description.en: Radio Television Hong Kong is a department under the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

position.zh-cn: 助理广播处长（电台及节目策划）

description.zh-cn: 李庆华是香港电台的助理广播处长，负责电台及节目策划。
description.en: Li Hing-wah is the Assistant Director of Broadcasting at RTHK, responsible for Radio & Programming.

description.zh-cn: 1951年至1954年间，香港电台的广播工作由政府新闻处（当时称政府公共关系处）接管。
description.en: From 1951 to 1954, broadcasting work at RTHK was managed by the Government Information Services Department (then known as the Government Public Relations Office).

description.zh-cn: 张敏仪于1986年至1999年担任广播处长，是首位华人兼女性广播处长。
description.en: Cheung Man-yee served as the Director of Broadcasting from 1986 to 1999, being the first Chinese and female director.

description.zh-cn: 在香港沦陷时期，香港电台的台号被更改为“香港放送局（JPHA）”，英语广播一度停顿并改由日语广播。
description.en: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, RTHK's call sign was changed to 'Hong Kong Broadcasting Station (JPHA)', and English broadcasting was suspended and replaced by Japanese broadcasting.

description.zh-cn: 因应中国国家广播电视总局的禁令，香港电台于2021年2月12日起停止转播“BBC World Service”频道及节目。
description.en: In response to a ban by the National Radio and Television Administration of China, RTHK ceased relaying the BBC World Service channel and programs from February 12, 2021.

description.zh-cn: 香港警务处于2020年8月中旬，结束与港台自1973年起联合制作的《警讯》节目。
description.en: In mid-August 2020, the Hong Kong Police Force ended the co-production of the program 'Police Report' with RTHK, which had been running since 1973.

description.zh-cn: 李百全于2021年3月1日接任广播处长后，成立编辑委员会，多次抽起或停播《铿锵集》、《议事论事》、《香港故事》等具争议性或批评声音的节目，并解雇多名主持人，严重削弱了港台的编辑自主。
description.en: After taking office as Director of Broadcasting on March 1, 2021, Patrick Li established an editorial committee and repeatedly pulled or suspended controversial or critical programs such as 'Hong Kong Connection', 'LegCo Review', and 'Hong Kong Stories'. He also dismissed several hosts, severely undermining RTHK's editorial independence.

description.zh-cn: 李百全于2021年3月1日至2022年6月30日期间担任广播处长。
description.en: Patrick Li served as the Director of Broadcasting from March 1, 2021, to June 30, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 2021年6月18日，香港电台解雇了节目主持人曾志豪。
description.en: On June 18, 2021, RTHK dismissed program host Tsang Chi-ho.

description.zh-cn: 2021年6月28日，香港电台将《自由风自由phone》节目主持人区家麟撤换。
description.en: On June 28, 2021, RTHK replaced Au Ka-lun as the host of the program 'Free Wind Free Phone'.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚于1930年6月13日出生于湖北汉口。
description.en: Li Zehou was born in Hankou, Hubei on June 13, 1930.

description.zh-cn: 1942年，李泽厚考入宁乡靳江中学（后称宁乡四中）。
description.en: In 1942, Li Zehou was admitted to Jinjiang Middle School in Ningxiang (later known as Ningxiang No. 4 High School).

description.zh-cn: 1945年秋，李泽厚考上湖南省立第一中学（现长沙市第一中学）。
description.en: In the autumn of 1945, Li Zehou was admitted to Hunan Provincial First Middle School (now Changsha No. 1 High School).

description.zh-cn: 由于经济原因，李泽厚于1945年转入有公费补助的湖南第一师范学院，并于1948年毕业。
description.en: Due to financial reasons, Li Zehou transferred to the publicly funded Hunan First Normal University in 1945 and graduated in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 1950年，李泽厚考入北京大学哲学系，1954年毕业。
description.en: In 1950, Li Zehou was admitted to the Department of Philosophy at Peking University, graduating in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚曾担任中国社会科学院研究员。
description.en: Li Zehou served as a researcher at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，李泽厚被分配至中国科学院哲学研究所工作。
description.en: In 1955, Li Zehou was assigned to work at the Institute of Philosophy, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

position.en: Deputy to the 7th National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚曾任第七届全国人大代表。
description.en: Li Zehou served as a deputy to the 7th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚曾任第七届全国人大教育科学文化卫生委员会委员。
description.en: Li Zehou served as a member of the 7th Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚移居美国后，曾任教于美国科罗拉多学院。
description.en: After moving to the United States, Li Zehou taught at Colorado College.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚在中学时期最爱读鲁迅的作品。
description.en: During his middle school years, Li Zehou loved reading Lu Xun's works the most.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚在中学时期最爱读冰心的作品。
description.en: During his middle school years, Li Zehou loved reading Bing Xin's works.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚在中学时期最喜爱辛弃疾的诗词。
description.en: During his middle school years, Li Zehou's favorite poetry was by Xin Qiji.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚在湖南第一师范学院就读期间接触了马克思主义。
description.en: Li Zehou came into contact with Marxism while studying at Hunan First Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚是当时最早公开支持朦胧诗的美学家，并于1981年发文为其辩护。
description.en: Li Zehou was one of the first aestheticians to publicly support the Misty Poets at the time, publishing an article in their defense in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚于1981年发表文章《画廊谈美》，为“星星画展”进行辩护。
description.en: In 1981, Li Zehou published the article 'Discussing Aesthetics in the Gallery', defending the 'Stars Art Exhibition'.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年六四事件期间，与刘再复等人共同发表《我们对今天局势的紧急呼吁》。后与刘再复合著《告别革命》。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, he, along with Liu Zaifu and others, jointly issued 'Our Urgent Appeal Regarding the Current Situation'. He later co-authored 'Farewell to Revolution' with Liu Zaifu.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年六四事件期间，与戴晴等人共同发表《我们对今天局势的紧急呼吁》。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, he, along with Dai Qing and others, jointly issued 'Our Urgent Appeal Regarding the Current Situation'.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年六四事件期间，与严家其等人共同发表《我们对今天局势的紧急呼吁》。
description.en: During the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests, he, along with Yan Jiaqi and others, jointly issued 'Our Urgent Appeal Regarding the Current Situation'.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，李泽厚的作品被禁，本人也受到批判，并被禁止离境。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, Li Zehou's works were banned, he was criticized, and he was forbidden from leaving the country.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，李泽厚受到中共和共产党人批判。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, Li Zehou was criticized by the Communist Party of China and its members.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚提出的“告别革命”说为1980年代的文化热划上了一个句号。
description.en: The 'Farewell to Revolution' theory proposed by Li Zehou brought an end to the 'Culture Fever' of the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 李泽厚与刘再复合著了对话录《告别革命：回望二十世纪中国》。
description.en: Li Zehou co-authored the dialogue record 'Farewell to Revolution: Looking Back at 20th-Century China' with Liu Zaifu.

description.zh-cn: 刘再复与李泽厚合著了对话录《告别革命：回望二十世纪中国》，并由刘再复执笔。
description.en: Liu Zaifu co-authored the dialogue record 'Farewell to Revolution: Looking Back at 20th-Century China' with Li Zehou, with Liu being the primary writer.

description.zh-cn: 于旭波是山东威海人。
description.en: Yu Xubo is a native of Weihai, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 1988年毕业于对外经济贸易大学国际贸易专业。
description.en: Graduated from the University of International Business and Economics in 1988 with a major in International Trade.

description.zh-cn: 于1988年5月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in May 1988.

position.zh-cn: 业务员、期货部经理、期货贸易部副总经理、总经理助理、董事、总经理、党组成员、党组副书记
position.en: Salesman, Manager of Futures Department, Deputy General Manager of Futures Trading Department, Assistant General Manager, Director, General Manager, Party Leadership Group Member, Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 曾在中国粮油食品进出口总公司任业务员、期货部经理、期货贸易部副总经理、总经理助理。自2007年4月至2020年6月，在中粮集团有限公司任董事、总经理、党组成员，并于2016年6月起兼任党组副书记。
description.en: Served successively as Salesman, Manager of the Futures Department, Deputy General Manager of the Futures Trading Department, and Assistant General Manager at China National Cereals, Oils and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corporation. From April 2007 to June 2020, he held positions as Director, General Manager, and Member of the Party Leadership Group at COFCO Group, additionally serving as Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group from June 2016.

position.en: Chairman, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 2020年6月，转任中国通用技术（集团）控股有限责任公司董事长、党组书记。
description.en: In June 2020, he was appointed Chairman and Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of China General Technology (Group) Holding Co., Ltd.

position.en: Deputy for the Inner Mongolia region

description.zh-cn: 2018年，当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会内蒙古地区代表。
description.en: In 2018, he was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress for the Inner Mongolia region.

description.zh-cn: 达赖喇嘛是藏传佛教格鲁派的领袖。
description.en: The Dalai Lama is the leader of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古土默特部首领俺答汗给予第三世达赖喇嘛索南嘉措“达赖喇嘛”的尊号。
description.en: Altan Khan, leader of the Tümed Mongols, gave the title 'Dalai Lama' to the 3rd Dalai Lama, Sonam Gyatso.

description.zh-cn: 根敦朱巴是格鲁派创始人宗喀巴的弟子。
description.en: Gendun Drup was a disciple of Tsongkhapa, the founder of the Gelug school.

description.zh-cn: 第四世达赖喇嘛云丹嘉措是俺答汗的孙子。
description.en: The 4th Dalai Lama, Yonten Gyatso, was the grandson of Altan Khan.

description.zh-cn: 从1642年（第五世达赖喇嘛）到1959年期间，达赖喇嘛在甘丹颇章主持西藏政府。
description.en: From 1642 (during the time of the 5th Dalai Lama) to 1959, the Dalai Lama presided over the Tibetan government at the Ganden Phodrang.

description.zh-cn: 1912年，西藏将清朝官兵驱逐出藏，结束了清朝在西藏的统治影响。
description.en: In 1912, Tibet expelled Qing officials and troops, ending the Qing's ruling influence in Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府声称丹增嘉措无权单方面决定其转世事宜，转世必须经过中央政府批准，以此干涉其宗教权力。
description.en: The government of the People's Republic of China claims that Tenzin Gyatso has no right to unilaterally decide on his reincarnation, stating that it must be approved by the central government, thereby interfering with his religious authority.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与和硕特汗国政府共同认定并册立阿旺伊西嘉措为第六世达赖喇嘛。
description.en: The Qing court and the Khoshut Khanate jointly recognized and enthroned Ngawang Yeshey Gyatso as the 6th Dalai Lama.

description.zh-cn: 清朝与和硕特汗国政府共同认定并册立阿旺伊西嘉措为第六世达赖喇嘛。
description.en: The Qing court and the Khoshut Khanate jointly recognized and enthroned Ngawang Yeshey Gyatso as the 6th Dalai Lama.

description.zh-cn: 由清朝与和硕特汗国政府认定并册立，与仓央嘉措并立。
description.en: Recognized and enthroned by the Qing court and the Khoshut Khanate, coexisting with Tsangyang Gyatso.

description.zh-cn: 河北雄安新区公安局是河北省公安厅的派出机构，在业务上受其领导。
description.en: The Hebei Xiong'an New Area Public Security Bureau is a dispatched agency of the Hebei Provincial Public Security Department and is under its operational leadership.

relationships.target: BAIDU:河北雄安新区管理委员会

description.zh-cn: 河北雄安新区公安局受河北雄安新区管委会管理，且以新区管理为主。
description.en: The Hebei Xiong'an New Area Public Security Bureau is managed by the Hebei Xiong'an New Area Management Committee, with the New Area's management being primary.

description.zh-cn: 河北省人民政府为河北雄安新区公安局制发印章。
description.en: The Hebei Provincial People's Government issues the official seal for the Hebei Xiong'an New Area Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 国内安全保卫支队是河北雄安新区公安局的内设机构。
description.en: The Domestic Security Detachment is an internal department of the Hebei Xiong'an New Area Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 郭兆贵是广西省北海市人。
description.en: Guo Zhaogui is from Beihai, Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 郭兆贵曾任湖南医学院教授、博士生导师。
description.en: Guo Zhaogui served as a professor and doctoral supervisor at Hunan Medical College.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，郭兆贵是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Guo Zhaogui is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，郭兆贵是湘雅医学院的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Guo Zhaogui is an alumnus of Xiangya School of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 教育系一年级本科生肄业。
description.en: Dropped out as a first-year undergraduate student in the Department of Education.

description.zh-cn: 1989年4月21日，吾尔开希宣布成立“北京市临学联”，该组织后于25日改名为“北京高校学生自治联合会”。
description.en: On April 21, 1989, Wu'erkaixi announced the establishment of the 'Beijing Provisional Students' Federation', which was renamed the 'Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation' on the 25th.

description.zh-cn: 因试图闯入位于东京的中国驻日大使馆而被日本警方逮捕，两日后获释。
description.en: He was arrested by Japanese police for attempting to break into the Chinese Embassy in Tokyo and was released two days later.

description.zh-cn: 在太阳花学运期间，批评时任总统马英九破坏民主。
description.en: During the Sunflower Student Movement, he criticized then-President Ma Ying-jeou for undermining democracy.

description.zh-cn: 就太阳花学运批评时任监察院院长王建煊，并要求其辞职。
description.en: Regarding the Sunflower Student Movement, he criticized then-President of the Control Yuan Wang Chien-shien and called for his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 电影台词中提及吾尔开希曾搭乘同一艘偷渡船到美国。
description.en: A line in the movie mentions that Wu'erkaixi took the same smuggling boat to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国民运人士和六四事件被通缉的学生领袖，持续反对中华人民共和国政府的政治体制，并多次尝试闯关回国向中共自首以表达抗议。
description.en: As a Chinese pro-democracy activist and a wanted student leader from the June 4th Incident, he has consistently opposed the political system of the People's Republic of China and has made multiple attempts to enter the country to surrender to the CCP as a form of protest.

description.zh-cn: 同为八九学运的学生领袖，共同参与运动的组织和发起。
description.en: Fellow student leaders of the 1989 student movement, they jointly participated in organizing and initiating the movement.

description.zh-cn: 曾批评时任总统陈水扁“宛如共产党”。
description.en: Once criticized then-President Chen Shui-bian as being 'just like the Communist Party'.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智于1990年3月至1998年3月担任第七届和第八届全国政协副主席。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi served as the Vice Chairman of the 7th and 8th National Committee of the CPPCC from March 1990 to March 1998.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 在李先念担任全国政协主席期间，洪学智担任副主席。
description.en: While Li Xiannian was the Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, Hong Xuezhi served as a Vice Chairman.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 在李瑞环担任全国政协主席期间，洪学智担任副主席。
description.en: While Li Ruihuan was the Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, Hong Xuezhi served as a Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智曾两次担任总后勤部部长（1957-1959, 1980-1987），并在第二次任职期间兼任政治委员。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi served as the Director of the General Logistics Department twice (1957-1959, 1980-1987), and also served as its Political Commissar during his second term.

description.zh-cn: 1980年1月，洪学智接替张震担任中国人民解放军总后勤部部长。
description.en: In January 1980, Hong Xuezhi succeeded Zhang Zhen as the Director of the PLA General Logistics Department.

description.zh-cn: 1987年11月，赵南起接替洪学智担任中国人民解放军总后勤部部长。
description.en: In November 1987, Zhao Nanqi succeeded Hong Xuezhi as the Director of the PLA General Logistics Department.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智出生于安徽省金寨县（原属河南省商城县）。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi was born in Jinzhai County, Anhui Province (formerly part of Shangcheng County, Henan Province).

description.zh-cn: 洪学智于1929年5月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi joined the Communist Party of China in May 1929.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，洪学智到达陕北后，入抗日军政大学学习。
description.en: In 1936, after arriving in northern Shaanxi, Hong Xuezhi enrolled in the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University.

position.zh-cn: 支队长、副大队长、副校长
position.en: Detachment Commander, Deputy Battalion Commander, Vice President

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，洪学智在抗大历任第三大队一支队支队长、第四大队副大队长及第五分校副校长等职。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Anti-Japanese War, Hong Xuezhi held various positions at the university, including Detachment Commander of the 1st Detachment of the 3rd Battalion, Deputy Battalion Commander of the 4th Battalion, and Vice President of the 5th Branch School.

position.zh-cn: 副司令员兼后方勤务司令部司令员
position.en: Deputy Commander and Commander of the Rear Services Command

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争期间，洪学智任中国人民志愿军副司令员，后兼任后方勤务司令部司令员，负责后勤工作。
description.en: During the Korean War, Hong Xuezhi served as the Deputy Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army and later concurrently as the Commander of the Rear Services Command, in charge of logistics.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智作为中国人民志愿军副司令员兼后勤司令员参与了朝鲜战争，其建立的“钢铁运输线”为战争胜利提供了关键保障。
description.en: As Deputy Commander and Logistics Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, Hong Xuezhi participated in the Korean War. The 'Iron and Steel Transportation Line' he established provided crucial support for the war's victory.

description.zh-cn: 因在1959年庐山会议上支持彭德怀，洪学智被划为“彭、黄、张、周”反党集团成员并被撤销总后勤部部长职务，下放地方工作。
description.en: For supporting Peng Dehuai at the 1959 Lushan Conference, Hong Xuezhi was labeled a member of the 'Peng, Huang, Zhang, Zhou' anti-Party clique, dismissed from his post as Director of the General Logistics Department, and sent down to a local post.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，洪学智遭受磨难和批斗，并被下放至农场进行劳动改造。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Hong Xuezhi suffered hardships and was subjected to struggle sessions, and was sent down to a farm for labor reform.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智曾任中共中央军委委员，并于1982年至1989年间担任副秘书长。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi served as a member of the CCP Central Military Commission and was its Deputy Secretary-General from 1982 to 1989.

description.zh-cn: 1937年，洪学智在抗日军政大学被诬陷入狱，后由毛泽东亲自为其平反。
description.en: In 1937, Hong Xuezhi was falsely accused and imprisoned at the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University, and was later exonerated by Mao Zedong himself.

description.zh-cn: 1947年1月，洪学智被时任东北民主联军总司令林彪调往前线，担任第六纵队司令员。
description.en: In January 1947, Hong Xuezhi was transferred to the front line by Lin Biao, then Commander-in-Chief of the Northeast Democratic United Army, to serve as the commander of the 6th Column.

description.zh-cn: 平津战役期间，洪学智指挥其所率的第四十三军参与围困北平，促使傅作义率部接受和平改编。
description.en: During the Pingjin Campaign, Hong Xuezhi commanded the 43rd Army to participate in the siege of Beiping, which contributed to Fu Zuoyi's decision to lead his troops to accept a peaceful reorganization.

description.zh-cn: 1948年3月，洪学智调任上干大队大队长，由黄永胜接任第六纵队司令员。
description.en: In March 1948, Hong Xuezhi was transferred to be the head of the Senior Cadre Training Group, and Huang Yongsheng succeeded him as the commander of the 6th Column.

position.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军副司令员
position.en: Deputy Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争期间，洪学智在中国人民志愿军司令员彭德怀的领导下担任副司令员。
description.en: During the Korean War, Hong Xuezhi served as Deputy Commander under the leadership of Peng Dehuai, the Commander of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智长子洪虎曾任吉林省省长。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi's eldest son, Hong Hu, once served as the Governor of Jilin Province.

description.zh-cn: 洪虎于2004年10月卸任吉林省省长后，成为全国人大法律委员会副主任委员。
description.en: After stepping down as Governor of Jilin in October 2004, Hong Hu became the Vice Chairman of the Law Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 洪学智次子洪豹曾任天津警备区副司令员。
description.en: Hong Xuezhi's second son, Hong Bao, once served as the Deputy Commander of the Tianjin Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 大日本帝国海军策划并执行了对美国珍珠港海军基地的偷袭行动。
description.en: The Imperial Japanese Navy planned and executed the surprise attack on the U.S. naval base at Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 作为联合舰队司令长官，山本五十六是偷袭珍珠港计划的核心策划者，他认为必须在战争初期就摧毁美国太平洋舰队。
description.en: As the Commander-in-Chief of the Combined Fleet, Isoroku Yamamoto was the mastermind behind the plan to attack Pearl Harbor, believing it was necessary to destroy the U.S. Pacific Fleet at the outset of the war.

description.zh-cn: 南云忠一中将指挥了执行偷袭任务的日本第一航空舰队。但他决定不发动第三波攻击，这被一些历史学家认为限制了对美军的战略打击。
description.en: Vice Admiral Chūichi Nagumo commanded the Japanese First Air Fleet that carried out the attack. His decision not to launch a third wave is considered by some historians to have limited the strategic damage to U.S. forces.

description.zh-cn: 袭击重创了美国太平洋舰队，击沉或损坏了8艘战舰及多艘其他舰船，摧毁了188架飞机。
description.en: The attack crippled the U.S. Pacific Fleet, sinking or damaging 8 battleships and numerous other vessels, and destroying 188 aircraft.

description.zh-cn: 在袭击中，亚利桑纳号战舰被一枚穿甲弹击中弹药库，引发剧烈爆炸后沉没，造成舰上1177人死亡。
description.en: During the attack, the USS Arizona was hit by an armor-piercing bomb that detonated its magazine, causing a massive explosion and sinking the ship with 1,177 crewmen killed.

description.zh-cn: 美国、英国、荷兰等国对日本实施的石油禁运（ABCD包围网）是促使日本决定发动战争并袭击珍珠港的直接原因。
description.en: The oil embargo imposed on Japan by the United States, Britain, the Netherlands, and others (the ABCD line) was the direct cause that pushed Japan to decide to go to war and attack Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 作为日本的盟友，纳粹德国在珍珠港事件后于1941年12月11日履行三国同盟条约，对美国宣战。
description.en: As an ally of Japan, Nazi Germany honored the Tripartite Pact and declared war on the United States on December 11, 1941, following the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 作为日本的盟友，意大利王国在珍珠港事件后于1941年12月11日履行三国同盟条约，对美国宣战。
description.en: As an ally of Japan, the Kingdom of Italy honored the Tripartite Pact and declared war on the United States on December 11, 1941, following the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 1941年12月11日，纳粹德国对美国宣战。
description.en: On December 11, 1941, Nazi Germany declared war on the United States.

description.zh-cn: 1941年12月11日，意大利王国对美国宣战。
description.en: On December 11, 1941, the Kingdom of Italy declared war on the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统罗斯福在珍珠港事件次日向国会发表了《国耻演说》。
description.en: U.S. President Roosevelt delivered the "Day of Infamy" speech to Congress the day after the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 由于未能预见并有效防御日本的袭击，时任太平洋舰队总司令的金梅尔上将被解除职务并被降阶。
description.en: Due to the failure to anticipate and effectively defend against the Japanese attack, Admiral Kimmel, then commander-in-chief of the Pacific Fleet, was relieved of his command and demoted.

description.zh-cn: 联合舰队是大日本帝国海军的主力作战部队。
description.en: The Combined Fleet was the main operational component of the Imperial Japanese Navy.

description.zh-cn: 山本五十六在偷袭珍珠港期间担任日本海军联合舰队司令长官。
description.en: Isoroku Yamamoto served as the Commander-in-Chief of the IJN's Combined Fleet during the attack on Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 珍珠港袭击事件在美国国内引发了对日裔美国人的普遍不信任和恐惧，是导致美国政府后续实施大规模强制拘留政策的直接原因。
description.en: The attack on Pearl Harbor triggered widespread distrust and fear of Japanese Americans within the U.S., becoming the direct cause for the subsequent implementation of the government's policy of mass forced internment.

description.zh-cn: 该行政命令授权美国军事部门划定军事区并对特定人群进行管制，为日裔美国人的大规模强制迁移和拘留提供了法律依据。
description.en: This executive order authorized the U.S. military to designate military areas and regulate certain populations, providing the legal basis for the mass forced relocation and internment of Japanese Americans.

description.zh-cn: 富兰克林·罗斯福总统签署了第9066号行政命令。
description.en: President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed Executive Order 9066.

description.zh-cn: 蔡奇于1955年12月5日出生于福建省永安县（今永安市）。
description.en: Cai Qi was born on December 5, 1955, in Yong'an County (modern-day Yong'an City), Fujian Province.

degree.zh-cn: 政治教育系学士、经济法律学院硕士、政治经济学博士
degree.en: Bachelor's in Political Education, Master's from the School of Economics and Law, PhD in Political Economy

description.zh-cn: 1975年作为工农兵学员进入福建师范大学政治教育系学习，后在该校获得硕士和博士学位。
description.en: Entered Fujian Normal University's Department of Political Education as a Worker-Peasant-Soldier student in 1975, and later obtained master's and doctoral degrees from the university.

description.zh-cn: 在茅临生任中共衢州市委书记期间，蔡奇担任衢州市市长。
description.en: While Mao Linsheng was Party Secretary of Quzhou, Cai Qi served as the city's Mayor.

description.zh-cn: 蔡奇在担任中共北京市委书记期间，兼任北京冬奥组委主席，主导并成功举办了2022年北京冬奥会。
description.en: During his tenure as Party Secretary of Beijing, Cai Qi concurrently served as President of the Beijing Winter Olympics Organizing Committee, leading and successfully hosting the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 尹力接替蔡奇担任中共北京市委书记。
description.en: Yin Li succeeded Cai Qi as Party Secretary of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡奇接替郭金龙担任中共北京市委书记。
description.en: Cai Qi succeeded Guo Jinlong as Party Secretary of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡奇接替王沪宁担任中共中央书记处排名第一的书记。
description.en: Cai Qi succeeded Wang Huning as the first-ranked Secretary of the CCP Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 蔡奇接替丁薛祥担任中共中央办公厅主任及中央和国家机关工委书记。
description.en: Cai Qi succeeded Ding Xuexiang as Director of the General Office of the CCP Central Committee and Secretary of the Central and State Organs Work Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王海是浙江舟山人。
description.en: Wang Hai is from Zhoushan, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 王海是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Hai is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王海曾在中国人民解放军海军服役。2015年7月至2017年1月，他担任海军副司令员。
description.en: Wang Hai served in the People's Liberation Army Navy. From July 2015 to January 2017, he served as Deputy Commander of the Navy.

description.zh-cn: 王海曾在海军南海舰队航空兵部队服役。
description.en: Wang Hai served in the naval aviation force of the South Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 1995年4月至1998年3月，王海任重庆号导弹驱逐舰舰长。
description.en: From April 1995 to March 1998, Wang Hai served as the captain of the destroyer Chongqing.

position.en: First Commander of the Carrier Battle Group

description.zh-cn: 2012年9月起，王海担任辽宁舰航母编队首任司令员。
description.en: Starting from September 2012, Wang Hai served as the first commander of the Liaoning carrier battle group.

description.zh-cn: 2014年1月，王海接替魏钢少将任中国人民解放军海军北海舰队参谋长。
description.en: In January 2014, Wang Hai succeeded Rear Admiral Wei Gang as Chief of Staff of the PLA Navy's North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 2015年4月，姜国平接替王海担任中国人民解放军海军北海舰队参谋长。
description.en: In April 2015, Jiang Guoping succeeded Wang Hai as Chief of Staff of the PLA Navy's North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 2014年1月至2015年4月，王海担任中国人民解放军海军北海舰队参谋长。
description.en: From January 2014 to April 2015, Wang Hai served as Chief of Staff of the PLA Navy's North Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 2016年7月，王海晋升为海军中将军衔。
description.en: In July 2016, Wang Hai was promoted to the rank of Vice Admiral.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月，王海接替沈金龙出任南海舰队司令员。
description.en: In January 2017, Wang Hai succeeded Shen Jinlong as Commander of the South Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月，王海任中国人民解放军南部战区副司令员。
description.en: In January 2017, Wang Hai was appointed Deputy Commander of the PLA Southern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月至2023年2月，王海担任南部战区海军司令员。
description.en: From January 2017 to February 2023, Wang Hai served as Commander of the Southern Theater Command Navy.

description.zh-cn: 2023年2月，王海卸任南部战区海军司令员，由鞠新春接任。
description.en: In February 2023, Wang Hai stepped down as commander of the Southern Theater Command Navy and was succeeded by Ju Xinchun.

description.zh-cn: 2017年10月，王海在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会上当选中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: In October 2017, Wang Hai was elected as an alternate member of the Central Committee at the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，王海当选为第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Wang Hai was elected as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1896年，时任山东按察使的毓贤奉命镇压了曹县、单县的大刀会起义。
description.en: In 1896, Yuxian, then the Judicial Commissioner of Shandong, was ordered to suppress the Big Swords Society uprising in Cao and Shan counties.

description.zh-cn: 毓贤在山东任职期间，对义和拳采取“剿抚兼施”的策略，提出“改拳勇为民团”，允许其建立旗帜，客观上助长了其声势。
description.en: During his tenure in Shandong, Yuxian adopted a strategy of both suppression and appeasement towards the Boxers, proposing to reorganize them into 'civilian militias' and allowing them to create banners, which objectively bolstered their influence.

description.zh-cn: 美国公使康格认为毓贤纵容义和团，向清政府施压，要求将其撤换，导致毓贤被调离山东。
description.en: U.S. Minister Edwin H. Conger believed Yuxian was condoning the Boxers and pressured the Qing government to replace him, leading to Yuxian's removal from Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 1899年底，袁世凯接替被撤职的毓贤，出任山东巡抚。
description.en: At the end of 1899, Yuan Shikai succeeded the dismissed Yuxian as the Governor of Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 在载漪等人的力荐下，慈禧太后重新起用毓贤，任命其为山西巡抚。
description.en: Following strong recommendations from Zaiyi and others, Empress Dowager Cixi reappointed Yuxian, making him the Governor of Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 时任山西巡抚的毓贤设计将全省传教士诱骗至省城太原，并于1900年7月9日在巡抚衙门前下令将他们全部处决。
description.en: Then Governor of Shanxi, Yuxian, deceived missionaries from across the province into gathering in the provincial capital, Taiyuan, and ordered their execution in front of the governor's yamen on July 9, 1900.

description.zh-cn: 在太原教案中，天主教山西北境教区主教艾士杰被毓贤亲手杀害。
description.en: During the Taiyuan Massacre, Gregorio Grassi, bishop of the Apostolic Vicariate of Northern Shansi, was personally killed by Yuxian.

description.zh-cn: 在庚子事变后的议和中，八国联军将毓贤列为“罪魁祸首”之一，强烈要求清政府将其严惩。
description.en: In the peace negotiations following the Gengzi incident, the Eight-Nation Alliance listed Yuxian as one of the 'chief culprits' and strongly demanded that the Qing government severely punish him.

description.zh-cn: 根据与八国联军的议和条件，清廷于1901年2月13日下诏将毓贤即行正法，并于22日在兰州将其斩首。
description.en: In accordance with the peace terms with the Eight-Nation Alliance, the Qing court issued an edict on February 13, 1901, for the immediate execution of Yuxian, who was beheaded in Lanzhou on February 22.

description.zh-cn: 作为对太原教案等排外事件的惩罚，辛丑条约附件八规定停止山西人士参加科举考试的资格若干年。
description.en: As a punishment for the Taiyuan Massacre and other xenophobic incidents, Annex 8 of the Boxer Protocol suspended the eligibility of people from Shanxi to participate in the imperial civil service examinations for several years.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本“辽宁昌图人”，丰晓敏的籍贯地为昌图县。
description.en: According to the text 'a person from Changtu, Liaoning', Feng Xiaomin's ancestral home is Changtu County.

description.zh-cn: 丰晓敏是汉族。
description.en: Feng Xiaomin is of Han ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 丰晓敏是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Feng Xiaomin is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，丰晓敏当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表，代表黑龙江地区。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Feng Xiaomin was elected as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress, representing the Heilongjiang region.

description.zh-cn: 丰晓敏担任全国人大代表。
description.en: Feng Xiaomin serves as a deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李长春于1965年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Li Changchun joined the Chinese Communist Party in September 1965.

description.zh-cn: 朱镕基不希望李长春作为其国务院总理的接班人，并借由2000年汕头地区的走私案件来阻止李长春接任总理。
description.en: Zhu Rongji did not want Li Changchun as his successor for Premier and used a smuggling case in the Shantou area in 2000 to prevent Li from taking over the position.

description.zh-cn: 李长春于2002年11月接替丁关根出任中央精神文明建设指导委员会主任。
description.en: In November 2002, Li Changchun succeeded Ding Guangen as the Director of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization.

description.zh-cn: 李长春于2013年1月18日卸任中央精神文明建设指导委员会主任，由刘云山接任。
description.en: Li Changchun stepped down as the Director of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization on January 18, 2013, and was succeeded by Liu Yunshan.

description.zh-cn: 据维基解密引述的美国外交密电，谷歌退出中国事件是由李长春和周永康一手主导的。
description.en: According to US diplomatic cables cited by WikiLeaks, the event of Google's withdrawal from China was directed by Li Changchun and Zhou Yongkang.

description.zh-cn: 据维基解密引述的美国外交密电，谷歌退出中国事件是由李长春和周永康一手主导的。
description.en: According to US diplomatic cables cited by WikiLeaks, the event of Google's withdrawal from China was directed by Li Changchun and Zhou Yongkang.

description.zh-cn: 据称，李长春因在谷歌搜索上发现对自己的批评链接，而决意打压其在中国的业务，并下令国营电信公司停止与谷歌的业务往来。
description.en: It is alleged that Li Changchun decided to suppress Google's business in China after finding critical links about himself on Google Search, and ordered state-owned telecommunications companies to cease business with Google.

description.zh-cn: 李长春主政河南期间，号召“要想奔小康，赶紧卖血浆”，其推行的“血浆经济”政策被认为是导致艾滋病疫情泛滥的主要原因。
description.en: During Li Changchun's tenure in Henan, he promoted the slogan 'To get rich, sell your blood plasma.' His 'plasma economy' policy is considered the main cause of the AIDS epidemic.

description.zh-cn: 原卫生部官员陈秉中发表公开信，指控李长春应对河南血祸负责。
description.en: Former Ministry of Health official Chen Bingzhong published an open letter accusing Li Changchun of being responsible for the Henan plasma economy disaster.

description.zh-cn: 李长春在广东执政期间，压制和清洗了叶剑英家族在当地的政治势力。
description.en: During his tenure in Guangdong, Li Changchun suppressed and purged the political influence of Ye Jianying's family in the region.

description.zh-cn: 中下游地区的围湖造田等行为减少了湖泊的蓄洪能力，被认为加剧了1998年洪水的严重程度。中国政府事后也承认土地的错误使用是导致洪灾的原因之一。
description.en: Practices such as reclaiming land from lakes in the middle and lower reaches of rivers reduced the flood storage capacity of lakes and were considered to have exacerbated the severity of the 1998 floods. The Chinese government later admitted that misuse of land was partly to blame for the disaster.

description.zh-cn: 1998年的特大洪水冲垮了许多质量低劣的水利工程，使得“豆腐渣工程”问题严重暴露，并引起了公众和高层的广泛关注。
description.en: The catastrophic floods of 1998 destroyed many poorly constructed water conservancy projects, severely exposing the issue of 'tofu-dreg projects' and drawing widespread attention from the public and top leadership.

description.zh-cn: 在1998年洪水视察期间，时任国务院总理朱镕基严厉斥责了在洪灾中暴露出的质量低劣的防洪工程为“豆腐渣工程”。
description.en: During his inspection tours related to the 1998 floods, then-Premier Zhu Rongji sternly denounced the poorly constructed flood control projects exposed by the disaster as 'tofu-dreg projects'.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务院副总理温家宝担任国家防汛抗旱总指挥部总指挥，领导和指挥了全国范围的抗洪抢险工作。
description.en: Then-Vice Premier Wen Jiabao served as the Commander-in-Chief of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters, leading and directing the nationwide flood fighting and rescue efforts.

description.zh-cn: 1998年洪水期间，温家宝担任国家防汛抗旱总指挥部总指挥。
description.en: During the 1998 floods, Wen Jiabao served as the Commander-in-Chief of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 大批中国人民解放军官兵参与了1998年的抗洪抢险，是中国官方宣传的“九八抗洪”行动中的主要力量。
description.en: A large number of PLA soldiers participated in the 1998 flood fighting and rescue efforts, serving as the main force in the officially promoted '98 flood fighting' campaign.

description.zh-cn: 大批中国人民武装警察部队官兵与解放军一同参与了1998年的抗洪抢险，是“九八抗洪”行动的重要组成部分。
description.en: A large number of People's Armed Police Force personnel, alongside the PLA, participated in the 1998 flood fighting and rescue, forming a crucial part of the '98 flood fighting' campaign.

description.zh-cn: 1998年8月5日，中华人民共和国国务院在水灾后发出通知，要求各地停止毁林开垦，并切实做好退耕还林工作，以改善生态环境和防治水土流失。
description.en: On August 5, 1998, following the floods, the State Council of the PRC issued a notice requiring all localities to stop deforestation for cultivation and to effectively implement the 'Grain for Green' policy to improve the ecological environment and prevent soil erosion.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任国家最高领导人，江泽民领导了全国的抗洪工作，并在此后将“98年的抗洪”视为其任内的主要政绩之一。
description.en: As the paramount leader at the time, Jiang Zemin led the national flood fighting efforts and subsequently regarded the '98 flood fighting' as one of the major achievements of his tenure.

description.zh-cn: 1998年水灾对中华人民共和国造成了严重破坏，导致4150人死亡，超过2.2亿人受灾，直接经济损失高达2551亿元人民币。
description.en: The 1998 floods caused severe devastation to the People's Republic of China, resulting in 4,150 deaths, affecting over 220 million people, and causing direct economic losses of 255.1 billion RMB.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉1944年10月出生在吉林省榆树县（今榆树市）。
description.en: Hui Liangyu was born in Yushu County (present-day Yushu City), Jilin Province in October 1944.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉于1944年10月出生于满洲国时期的吉林省榆树县。
description.en: Hui Liangyu was born in Yushu County, Jilin Province, during the Manchukuo period in October 1944.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉早年毕业于吉林省农业学校会统专业。
description.en: Hui Liangyu graduated from the accounting and statistics major at Jilin Provincial Agricultural School in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，回良玉曾被下放到五七干校劳动。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, Hui Liangyu was sent to a May Seventh Cadre School for labor.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉于1966年4月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Hui Liangyu joined the Chinese Communist Party in April 1966.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉接替傅锡寿担任安徽省人民政府省长。
description.en: Hui Liangyu succeeded Fu Xishou as Governor of the Anhui Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉卸任安徽省省长后，由王太华接任。
description.en: After Hui Liangyu stepped down as Governor of Anhui, Wang Taihua succeeded him.

description.zh-cn: 在回良玉担任中共安徽省委书记期间，王太华为副书记兼省长。
description.en: While Hui Liangyu served as Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee, Wang Taihua was the Deputy Secretary and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉接替卢荣景担任中共安徽省委书记。
description.en: Hui Liangyu succeeded Lu Rongjing as Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在回良玉担任中共江苏省委书记期间，季允石为副书记兼省长。
description.en: While Hui Liangyu served as Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee, Ji Yunshi was the Deputy Secretary and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉接替陈焕友担任中共江苏省委书记。
description.en: Hui Liangyu succeeded Chen Huanyou as Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉卸任中共江苏省委书记后，由李源潮接任。
description.en: After Hui Liangyu stepped down as Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee, Li Yuanchao succeeded him.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉是中共第十六届、十七届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Hui Liangyu was a member of the Politburo of the 16th and 17th CPC Central Committees.

position.en: Member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛担任中共中央总书记期间，回良玉是两届中央政治局委员。
description.en: During Hu Jintao's tenure as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Hui Liangyu was a member of the Politburo for two terms.

description.zh-cn: 根据国务院总理温家宝的提名，回良玉出任国务院副总理。
description.en: Based on the nomination of Premier Wen Jiabao, Hui Liangyu was appointed Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛发布主席令，任命回良玉为国务院副总理。
description.en: President of the People's Republic of China Hu Jintao issued a presidential decree appointing Hui Liangyu as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 根据第十届全国人民代表大会第一次会议的决定，回良玉被任命为国务院副总理。
description.en: According to the decision of the first session of the 10th National People's Congress, Hui Liangyu was appointed Vice Premier of the State Council.

position.en: Vice Premier of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 在温家宝担任国务院总理期间，回良玉是两届国务院副总理。
description.en: During Wen Jiabao's tenure as Premier of the State Council, Hui Liangyu served as Vice Premier for two terms.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉接替温家宝担任国家防汛抗旱总指挥部总指挥。
description.en: Hui Liangyu succeeded Wen Jiabao as Commander-in-chief of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉接替沈因洛担任湖北省政协主席。
description.en: Hui Liangyu succeeded Shen Yinluo as Chairman of the Hubei Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 回良玉卸任湖北省政协主席后，由钱运录接任。
description.en: After Hui Liangyu stepped down as Chairman of the Hubei Provincial CPPCC, Qian Yunlu succeeded him.

description.zh-cn: 在第十届国务院中与黄菊同为副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier alongside Huang Ju in the 10th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在第十届国务院中与吴仪同为副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier alongside Wu Yi in the 10th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在第十届国务院中与曾培炎同为副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier alongside Zeng Peiyan in the 10th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在第十一届国务院中与李克强同为副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier alongside Li Keqiang in the 11th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在第十一届国务院中与张德江同为副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier alongside Zhang Dejiang in the 11th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在第十一届国务院中与王岐山同为副总理。
description.en: Served as Vice Premier alongside Wang Qishan in the 11th State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在胡风反革命集团案中，胡风被打成反革命集团头目，遭到长期监禁和迫害。
description.en: In the Hu Feng counter-revolutionary clique case, Hu Feng was labeled the leader of a counter-revolutionary clique and subjected to long-term imprisonment and persecution.

description.zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院的上诉法院和业务上级是上海市高级人民法院。
description.en: The court of appeal and professional superior for the Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court is the Shanghai High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院在组织上受上海市人民代表大会领导。
description.en: The Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court is organizationally subordinate to the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院在组织上受上海市人民代表大会常务委员会领导。
description.en: The Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court is organizationally subordinate to the Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院经上海市人民代表大会常务委员会批准设立。
description.en: The Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court was established with the approval of the Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 上海市第一中级人民法院接受中国共产党上海市委员会的领导。
description.en: The Shanghai No. 1 Intermediate People's Court is subordinate to the leadership of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 对周正毅案作出一审判决，以操纵证券交易价格罪和虚报注册资本罪判处其有期徒刑三年。
description.en: Issued a first-instance verdict in the Zhou Zhengyi case, sentencing him to three years in prison for manipulating securities trading prices and fraudulent registration of capital.

description.zh-cn: 对力拓案作出一审判决，涉案人员因非国家工作人员受贿罪、侵犯商业秘密罪获刑。
description.en: Issued a first-instance verdict in the Rio Tinto case, sentencing the individuals involved for accepting bribes as non-state employees and infringing on commercial secrets.

description.zh-cn: 对原安徽省人民政府副省长杨振超案作出一审判决，以受贿罪、贪污罪、滥用职权罪数罪并罚，判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Issued a first-instance verdict in the case of Yang Zhenchao, former vice governor of Anhui Provincial People's Government, sentencing him to life imprisonment for bribery, embezzlement, and abuse of power.

description.zh-cn: 对上海市政府原副秘书长戴海波受贿、隐瞒境外存款案作出一审判决，决定执行有期徒刑九年。
description.en: Issued a first-instance verdict in the case of Dai Haibo, former deputy secretary-general of the Shanghai Municipal Government, for bribery and concealment of overseas deposits, sentencing him to nine years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 延安派是朝鲜劳动党成立初期的内部派系。
description.en: The Yan'an faction was an internal faction of the early Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 延安派成员组建了朝鲜独立同盟。
description.en: Members of the Yan'an faction formed the Korean Independence Alliance.

description.zh-cn: 延安派成员组建了朝鲜新民党。
description.en: Members of the Yan'an faction formed the New People's Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党曾想支持延安派成员武亭成为朝鲜最高领导人。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party once intended to support Mu Chong, a member of the Yan'an faction, to become the supreme leader of North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜领导人人选问题上，苏共最终获胜，使得金日成得以掌权。
description.en: On the issue of North Korea's leadership, the CPSU ultimately prevailed, allowing Kim Il-sung to take power.

description.zh-cn: 金日成是游击队派的首领。
description.en: Kim Il-sung was the leader of the Guerrilla faction.

description.zh-cn: 由金日成领导的游击队派在1950年代对延安派进行了清洗。
description.en: The Guerrilla faction, led by Kim Il-sung, purged the Yan'an faction in the 1950s.

description.zh-cn: 在八月宗派事件中，几乎所有延安派成员都被打倒。
description.en: During the August Faction Incident, almost all members of the Yan'an faction were purged.

description.zh-cn: 金日成提出主体思想以反对事大主义。
description.en: Kim Il-sung proposed the Juche idea to oppose Sadaejuui (flunkeyism).

description.zh-cn: 金日成利用主体思想打击延安派干部。
description.en: Kim Il-sung used the Juche idea to attack cadres of the Yan'an faction.

description.zh-cn: 金日成利用主体思想打击苏联派干部。
description.en: Kim Il-sung used the Juche idea to attack cadres of the Soviet faction.

position.zh-cn: 劳动党中央政治委员会委员
position.en: Member of the Politburo of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea

description.zh-cn: 被朝鲜方面罢免，因为被认为是“中国思想对劳动党影响的主要传播者”。
description.en: Dismissed by the North Korean authorities for being considered a 'main propagator of Chinese thought's influence on the Workers' Party'.

description.zh-cn: 中联部拒绝了徐辉等人提出的“组织力量进入朝鲜进行斗争”的要求。
description.en: The International Liaison Department rejected the request by So Hwi and others to 'organize forces to enter North Korea for struggle'.

description.zh-cn: 赵武灵王传位后自称“主父”。
赵武灵王传位给赵惠文王后，仍以“主父”身份主持军政要务。
秦庄襄王生前未称帝，其太上皇之号是秦始皇称帝后追尊的。
唐玄宗隔多代追尊老子之父李敬为“先天太上皇”。
安庆绪弑父后，谎称安禄山禅位给自己，并尊其为太上皇。
第一位在生前被尊为太上皇的是汉高祖刘邦之父刘太公。
刘仁恭是燕国皇帝刘守光的父亲。
刘仁恭因与儿子刘守光关系不睦，未被尊为太上皇。
北魏献文帝退位后，以自己并未放弃政事为由，定尊号为“太上皇帝”，而非“太上皇”。
唐睿宗第一次因敌不过母亲武则天而放弃皇位。
唐睿宗第二次因胞妹太平公主谗言而退位。
唐玄宗出逃之际，皇太子李亨（唐肃宗）于灵武即位并遥尊玄宗为太上皇。
西晋八王之乱中，赵王司马伦胁持晋惠帝后继位为帝，并尊晋惠帝为太上皇。
隋朝末年，李渊夺取长安后，立隋炀帝孙杨侑为帝。
李渊立杨侑为帝后，遥尊隋炀帝为太上皇，隋炀帝至死都不知道此事。
明英宗在土木之变中被瓦剌所俘。
明英宗因土木之变被俘，其弟被立为新帝，因此成为太上皇。
皇极天皇让位予其弟孝德天皇，但当时并无“太上天皇”的称号。
现行的《皇室典范》不允许天皇于生前禅位。
随着明仁天皇于2019年退位，日本200年来再度出现太上天皇。
明仁天皇退位后，经宫内厅研议，称其为“上皇”。
明仁退位后，皇后美智子成为“上皇后”。
1907年，大韩帝国皇帝李㷩因受到大日本帝国胁迫而退位，改称太上皇。
陈太宗于1258年逊位于陈圣宗，成为太上皇。
1278年，陈圣宗让位予陈仁宗。
陈圣宗成为太上皇后，于1282年指挥抵抗元军入侵，直至1291年驾崩。
陈朝后期，外戚胡季牦专权，逼迫陈顺宗让位给其子陈少帝，及后顺宗被杀。
胡汉苍是胡季牦的儿子。
胡季牦成为太上皇6年后，明朝进攻胡朝，胡季牦父子被俘，胡朝灭亡。
胡朝灭亡后，越南由明朝直接统治了21年。
在秦末民变初期，英布曾是张楚王陈胜的下属。
description.en: In the early stages of the rebellions at the end of the Qin dynasty, Ying Bu was a subordinate of Chen Sheng, the King of Zhangchu.

description.zh-cn: 陈胜败死后，英布归附项梁。
description.en: After Chen Sheng's defeat and death, Ying Bu became a subordinate of Xiang Liang.

description.zh-cn: 在随何的游说下，英布叛离项羽，归顺刘邦。
description.en: Persuaded by Sui He, Ying Bu defected from Xiang Yu and submitted to Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 英布年轻时因触犯秦朝法律而被处以黥刑。
description.en: In his youth, Ying Bu was sentenced to the punishment of tattooing on the face for violating the laws of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 因畏惧被清算，英布于前196年起兵反叛汉朝。
description.en: Fearing a purge, Ying Bu launched a rebellion against the Han dynasty in 196 BC.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦御驾亲征，击败了反叛的英布。
description.en: Liu Bang personally led the campaign and defeated the rebellious Ying Bu.

description.zh-cn: 英布的妻舅、长沙王吴臣设计诱捕并刺杀了兵败逃亡的英布。
description.en: Ying Bu's brother-in-law, Wu Chen, the King of Changsha, plotted to entrap and assassinate Ying Bu after his defeat and flight.

description.zh-cn: 与英布产生嫌隙后，贲赫逃往长安，向刘邦告发英布意图谋反，直接导致了英布的叛乱和败亡。
description.en: After a falling out with Ying Bu, Ben He fled to Chang'an and reported to Liu Bang that Ying Bu was plotting a rebellion, directly leading to Ying Bu's revolt and downfall.

description.zh-cn: 项羽分封十八路诸侯时，因英布战功卓著，立其为九江王。
description.en: When Xiang Yu enfeoffed the Eighteen Princes, he made Ying Bu the King of Jiujiang due to his outstanding military achievements.

description.zh-cn: 英布归汉后，刘邦于前203年七月封其为淮南王。
description.en: After Ying Bu surrendered to Han, Liu Bang enfeoffed him as the King of Huainan in the seventh month of 203 BC.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦派遣的说客随何成功游说英布，使其背叛项羽，归降汉朝。
description.en: Sui He, a lobbyist dispatched by Liu Bang, successfully persuaded Ying Bu to betray Xiang Yu and surrender to the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 项羽暗中命令英布等人截击并杀害了已被尊为义帝的楚怀王熊心。
description.en: Xiang Yu secretly ordered Ying Bu and others to intercept and assassinate Xiong Xin, the former King Huai of Chu, who had been honored as Emperor Yi.

description.zh-cn: 在北上救赵途中，项羽发动兵变，刺杀了上将军宋义，夺取了军队的控制权。
description.en: On the way north to rescue the state of Zhao, Xiang Yu staged a mutiny and assassinated the supreme general Song Yi, seizing control of the army.

description.zh-cn: 汉初，吕后等人先后诛杀韩信、彭越等异姓王，这使得英布深感恐惧，最终选择起兵反叛以求自保。
description.en: In the early Han dynasty, Empress Lü and others successively executed non-imperial kings like Han Xin and Peng Yue. This caused Ying Bu great fear, leading him to rebel in an attempt at self-preservation.

description.zh-cn: 在诛杀韩信同年，吕后又以谋反罪名处死了梁王彭越，并将其尸体施以醢刑。
description.en: In the same year as Han Xin's execution, Empress Lü also executed Peng Yue, the King of Liang, on charges of treason and had his body pickled.

description.zh-cn: 英布背叛西楚后，项羽派龙且、项声进攻淮南，并击败了英布的军队。
description.en: After Ying Bu betrayed Western Chu, Xiang Yu sent Long Qie and Xiang Sheng to attack Huainan, and they defeated Ying Bu's army.

description.zh-cn: 英布背叛西楚后，项羽派项声、龙且进攻淮南，并击败了英布的军队。
description.en: After Ying Bu betrayed Western Chu, Xiang Yu sent Xiang Sheng and Long Qie to attack Huainan, and they defeated Ying Bu's army.

description.zh-cn: 在垓下之战前，原楚国大司马周殷被刘贾和英布诱降，反叛楚国。
description.en: Before the Battle of Gaixia, Zhou Yin, the Grand Marshal of Chu, was persuaded by Liu Jia and Ying Bu to surrender and rebel against the state of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 英布率领其军队会合其他汉军，参与了对项羽的最终决战——垓下之战。
description.en: Ying Bu led his troops to join other Han forces and participated in the final decisive battle against Xiang Yu, the Battle of Gaixia.

description.zh-cn: 英布起兵反汉后，首先东击荆国，荆王刘贾不敌，在逃亡途中被英布军杀害。
description.en: After rebelling against Han, Ying Bu first attacked the state of Jing. The King of Jing, Liu Jia, was defeated and killed by Ying Bu's forces while fleeing.

description.zh-cn: 在刘邦与英布会战时，时任齐相国的曹参率领齐军赶到，对英布军进行了夹击，加速了其失败。
description.en: During the battle between Liu Bang and Ying Bu, Cao Shen, then Chancellor of Qi, arrived with the Qi army and launched a pincer attack on Ying Bu's forces, hastening his defeat.

description.zh-cn: 在英布反叛后，薛鉴为刘邦分析了英布可能采用的上、中、下三策，并准确预测英布会出下策，为刘邦决策提供了重要参考。
description.en: After Ying Bu's rebellion, Xue Jian analyzed the three potential strategies (best, middle, and worst) for Liu Bang and accurately predicted that Ying Bu would choose the worst one, providing a crucial reference for Liu Bang's decision-making.

description.zh-cn: 根据史书记载，英布是六县人。
description.en: According to historical records, Ying Bu was a native of Liu County.

description.zh-cn: 山东省地震局是在中国地震局和山东省人民政府双重领导下，以中国地震局为主的事业单位。
description.en: The Shandong Earthquake Administration is a public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the Shandong Provincial People's Government, with the China Earthquake Administration taking the primary role.

description.zh-cn: 山东省地震局是在中国地震局和山东省人民政府双重领导下的事业单位。
description.en: The Shandong Earthquake Administration is a public institution under the dual leadership of the China Earthquake Administration and the Shandong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 伊萨克·赫尔佐格担任以色列总统。
description.en: Isaac Herzog serves as the President of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡担任以色列总理。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu serves as the Prime Minister of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 《以色列独立宣言》的发布标志着以色列国的正式成立。
description.en: The issuance of the Israeli Declaration of Independence marked the formal establishment of the State of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·本-古里安宣告“犹太国家在以色列家园建立，称为以色列国”，宣读了《以色列独立宣言》。
description.en: David Ben-Gurion declared 'the establishment of a Jewish state in Eretz-Israel, to be known as the State of Israel' by reading the Declaration of Independence.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·本-古里安是以色列首任总理。
description.en: David Ben-Gurion was the first Prime Minister of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 锡安主义运动号召流散于全世界的犹太人回归以色列地故土，恢复本民族的生活方式，并最终促成了以色列国的建立。
description.en: The Zionist movement called on Jews dispersed throughout the world to return to their ancestral homeland in the Land of Israel, to restore their national way of life, and ultimately led to the establishment of the State of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会181号决议支持在巴勒斯坦托管地推行分治方案，成立一个犹太国家，为以色列的建立提供了国际法理支持。
description.en: UN General Assembly Resolution 181 supported the partition plan for Mandatory Palestine to create a Jewish state, providing international legal support for the establishment of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 联合国大会表决通过了181号决议。
description.en: The United Nations General Assembly voted to pass Resolution 181.

description.zh-cn: 阿拉伯国家联盟不承认联合国分治方案，并坚持反对以色列建国。
description.en: The Arab League did not recognize the UN partition plan and insisted on opposing the establishment of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 以色列建国次日，邻近的阿拉伯国家便集结军队发动第一次中东战争，试图阻止以色列建国。
description.en: The day after Israel's founding, neighboring Arab countries assembled their armies and launched the First Arab-Israeli War in an attempt to prevent the establishment of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 埃及参与了1948年、1956年、1967年和1973年对以色列的战争，直至1979年签署和平条约。
description.en: Egypt participated in wars against Israel in 1948, 1956, 1967, and 1973, until the signing of a peace treaty in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 约旦参与了1948年和1967年对以色列的战争，直至1994年签署和平条约。
description.en: Jordan participated in wars against Israel in 1948 and 1967, until the signing of a peace treaty in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚参与了1948年、1967年和1973年对以色列的战争，两国至今仍处于敌对状态。
description.en: Syria participated in wars against Israel in 1948, 1967, and 1973, and the two countries remain in a state of hostility.

description.zh-cn: 以色列在六日战争中获胜，并占领了约旦河西岸、加沙地带、戈兰高地和西奈半岛，极大地扩展了其实际控制领土。
description.en: Israel won the Six-Day War and occupied the West Bank, Gaza Strip, Golan Heights, and Sinai Peninsula, greatly expanding its de facto territory.

description.zh-cn: 自1967年第三次中东战争以来，以色列持续占领约旦河西岸。
description.en: Israel has occupied the West Bank since the Six-Day War in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 以色列在1967年第三次中东战争中占领加沙地带，并于2005年9月单方面撤军并撤离定居点。
description.en: Israel occupied the Gaza Strip in the 1967 Six-Day War and unilaterally disengaged by withdrawing its troops and dismantling settlements in September 2005.

description.zh-cn: 自1967年第三次中东战争以来，以色列持续占领戈兰高地。
description.en: Israel has occupied the Golan Heights since the Six-Day War in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 以色列在1967年第三次中东战争中占领西奈半岛，并根据1979年埃以和平条约于1982年将其归还给埃及。
description.en: Israel occupied the Sinai Peninsula in the 1967 Six-Day War and returned it to Egypt in 1982 as part of the 1979 Egypt-Israel peace treaty.

description.zh-cn: 在1973年第四次中东战争期间，美国向以色列提供了包括F-4战斗机在内的紧急军事援助，帮助其击退了阿拉伯国家的进攻。
description.en: During the 1973 Yom Kippur War, the United States provided emergency military aid to Israel, including F-4 fighter jets, helping it repel the attack by Arab states.

description.zh-cn: 该条约正式结束了以色列与埃及之间的战争状态，使以色列获得了其第一个阿拉伯邻国的承认。
description.en: This treaty formally ended the state of war between Israel and Egypt, leading to Israel's recognition by its first Arab neighbor.

description.zh-cn: 该条约使埃及收回了在1967年战争中失去的西奈半岛。
description.en: This treaty enabled Egypt to regain the Sinai Peninsula, which it had lost in the 1967 war.

description.zh-cn: 作为以色列总理，梅纳赫姆·贝京与埃及总统萨达特共同签署了《以色列-埃及和平条约》。
description.en: As Prime Minister of Israel, Menachem Begin co-signed the Egypt-Israel Peace Treaty with Egyptian President Anwar Sadat.

description.zh-cn: 作为埃及总统，萨达特与以色列总理贝京共同签署了《以色列-埃及和平条约》。
description.en: As President of Egypt, Anwar Sadat co-signed the Egypt-Israel Peace Treaty with Israeli Prime Minister Menachem Begin.

description.zh-cn: 《奥斯陆协议》使巴勒斯坦解放组织获得了以色列的承认，并得以在约旦河西岸和加沙地带部分地区建立有限的自治。
