description.en: The Oslo Accords led to the PLO being recognized by Israel and allowed for the establishment of limited self-governance in parts of the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

description.zh-cn: 作为以色列总理，伊扎克·拉宾领导了与巴勒斯坦解放组织的谈判并签署了《奥斯陆协议》。
description.en: As Prime Minister of Israel, Yitzhak Rabin led the negotiations with the PLO and signed the Oslo Accords.

description.zh-cn: 以色列极右翼激进分子伊盖尔·阿米尔因反对《奥斯陆协议》，在特拉维夫刺杀了时任总理伊扎克·拉宾。
description.en: Yigal Amir, an Israeli far-right extremist, assassinated Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin in Tel Aviv due to his opposition to the Oslo Accords.

description.zh-cn: 哈马斯对以色列发动了大规模袭击，引发了2023年加沙—以色列冲突。
description.en: Hamas launched a large-scale attack on Israel, triggering the 2023 Israel-Hamas war.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党组织并领导了京汉铁路总工会，并发动了此次大罢工。
description.en: The Communist Party of China organized and led the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union and launched this major strike.

description.zh-cn: 京汉铁路总工会是罢工的发起和领导组织。
description.en: The Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union was the initiator and leading organization of the strike.

description.zh-cn: 吴佩孚下令调动军队，对罢工工人进行武力镇压，导致罢工失败。
description.en: Wu Peifu ordered the mobilization of troops to violently suppress the striking workers, leading to the failure of the strike.

description.zh-cn: 曹锟作为直系军阀首领之一，参与了对罢工的干涉和镇压。
description.en: As one of the leaders of the Zhili clique, Cao Kun participated in the interference and suppression of the strike.

description.zh-cn: 直系军阀是镇压罢工的主要军事力量。
description.en: The Zhili clique was the main military force that suppressed the strike.

description.zh-cn: 时任京汉铁路局局长赵继贤配合吴佩孚对罢工进行镇压。
description.en: Zhao Jixian, the director of the Beijing-Hankou Railway Bureau at the time, cooperated with Wu Peifu in suppressing the strike.

description.zh-cn: 在吴佩孚的命令下，湖北督军萧耀南将已被捕的施洋在武昌杀害。
description.en: Under the orders of Wu Peifu, Hubei military governor Xiao Yaonan killed the arrested Shi Yang in Wuchang.

description.zh-cn: 林元成是林祥谦的弟弟。
description.en: Lin Yuancheng was Lin Xiangqian's younger brother.

position.en: Chairman of the Jiang'an Branch Union

description.zh-cn: 林祥谦是京汉铁路总工会江岸分工会的委员长。
description.en: Lin Xiangqian was the chairman of the Jiang'an branch of the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union.

description.zh-cn: 施洋受聘为京汉铁路总工会的法律顾问。
description.en: Shi Yang was hired as the legal advisor for the Beijing-Hankou Railway General Union.

description.zh-cn: 曹锟是北洋军阀直系的首领之一。
description.en: Cao Kun was one of the leaders of the Zhili clique of the Beiyang warlords.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省教育厅在业务上接受中华人民共和国教育部的指导。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Department of Education is professionally supervised by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省教育厅是陕西省人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Department of Education is a component department of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省教育厅主管陕西省的教育工作。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Department of Education is in charge of educational affairs in Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 在第四十次会议上决定设立中华人民共和国水产部。
description.en: Decided to establish the Ministry of Aquatic Products of the People's Republic of China at its 40th meeting.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，水产部的工作处于停滞状态。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the work of the Ministry of Aquatic Products was in a state of stagnation.

description.zh-cn: 因农业系统各部委合并成立中华人民共和国农林部，中华人民共和国水产部被撤销。
description.en: The Ministry of Aquatic Products was dissolved due to the merger of several ministries in the agricultural sector to form the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

description.zh-cn: 担任中华人民共和国水产部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of the Ministry of Aquatic Products of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 主持设计了中华人民共和国水产部使用的办公大楼。
description.en: Led the design of the office building used by the Ministry of Aquatic Products of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 参加平江起义。
description.en: Participated in the Pingjiang Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 参加了苏中七战七捷。
description.en: Participated in the Seven Battles and Seven Victories in Central Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 参加了孟良崮战役。
description.en: Participated in the Menglianggu Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 参加了渡江战役。
description.en: Participated in the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中，江渭清消极对待，其管辖的江苏省抓右派的比例较低。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, Jiang Weiqing adopted a passive approach, resulting in a lower proportion of rightists being identified in Jiangsu province under his administration.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东曾怀疑江渭清在反右运动中不积极，并戏称他“敢把皇帝拉下马”以评价其直言敢谏。
description.en: Mao Zedong once suspected Jiang Weiqing of not being active in the Anti-Rightist Campaign and nicknamed him 'one who dares to unhorse the emperor' for his outspokenness.

description.zh-cn: 在四清运动中与国家主席刘少奇发生争论。
description.en: Had a dispute with State President Liu Shaoqi during the Four Cleanups Movement.

description.zh-cn: “文化大革命”初期受到冲击。
description.en: Was attacked in the early stages of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 江渭清接替柯庆施担任中国共产党江苏省委员会第一书记及中国人民解放军江苏省军区政治委员。
description.en: Jiang Weiqing succeeded Ke Qingshi as the First Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee and the Political Commissar of the PLA Jiangsu Military District.

description.zh-cn: 江渭清接替程世清担任中国共产党江西省委员会第一书记。
description.en: Jiang Weiqing succeeded Cheng Shiqing as the First Secretary of the CPC Jiangxi Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 白栋材接替江渭清担任中国共产党江西省委员会第一书记及江西省革命委员会主任。
description.en: Bai Dongcai succeeded Jiang Weiqing as the First Secretary of the CPC Jiangxi Provincial Committee and Director of the Jiangxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 江渭清接替佘积德担任江西省革命委员会主任。
description.en: Jiang Weiqing succeeded She Jide as the Director of the Jiangxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 许家屯接替江渭清担任中国人民政治协商会议江苏省委员会主席。
description.en: Xu Jiatun succeeded Jiang Weiqing as the Chairman of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 梁辑卿接替江渭清担任中国人民解放军江苏省军区政治委员。
description.en: Liang Jiqing succeeded Jiang Weiqing as the Political Commissar of the PLA Jiangsu Military District.

description.zh-cn: 嘉庆帝发布上谕，同意设立长春厅作为官方行政机构。
description.en: The Jiaqing Emperor issued an imperial edict approving the establishment of Changchun Ting as an official administrative body.

description.zh-cn: 长春厅隶属于吉林将军管辖。
description.en: Changchun Ting was under the jurisdiction of the General of Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月，苏联红军攻入满洲国，导致其灭亡。
description.en: In August 1945, the Soviet Red Army invaded Manchukuo, leading to its collapse.

description.zh-cn: 周保中指挥东北民主联军吉林军区部队发起围攻长春战役。
description.en: Zhou Baozhong commanded the Jilin Military Region troops of the Northeast Democratic United Army to launch the offensive on Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 东北野战军萧劲光部包围长春，发起长春围困战。
description.en: Troops under the command of Xiao Jinguang from the Northeast Field Army besieged Changchun, initiating the Siege of Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 吉林省人民政府从吉林市迁至长春市，长春市自此成为吉林省省会。
description.en: The Jilin Provincial People's Government relocated from Jilin City to Changchun, making Changchun the provincial capital.

description.zh-cn: 国务院批复同意将原由四平市代管的公主岭市划归长春市代管。
description.en: The State Council approved the transfer of the administration of Gongzhuling from Siping to Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙是孙吴政权的重要将领。
description.en: Lü Meng was a key general of the Sun Wu regime.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙早年受到孙策赏识，成为其左右随从。
description.en: In his early years, Lü Meng was appreciated by Sun Ce and became one of his close attendants.

description.zh-cn: 孙策去世后，吕蒙继续效力于孙权，并成为其麾下核心将领。
description.en: After Sun Ce's death, Lü Meng continued to serve Sun Quan and became a core general under his command.

description.zh-cn: 孙权见吕蒙治军有方，为其增加兵员；并劝其读书学习，促使吕蒙由一员勇将成长为智勇兼备的统帅。
description.en: Sun Quan, seeing Lü Meng's skill in military discipline, increased his troops; he also persuaded him to study, which prompted Lü Meng's transformation from a brave warrior to a wise and valiant commander.

description.zh-cn: 在关羽败走麦城后，马忠在临沮擒获了关羽及其子关平。
description.en: After Guan Yu's defeat at Maicheng, Ma Zhong captured Guan Yu and his son Guan Ping at Linju.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙作为孙吴将领，多次参与并指挥了抵御曹操军队南侵的战役。
description.en: As a general of Sun Wu, Lü Meng participated in and commanded several battles to defend against Cao Cao's southern invasions.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙夺取荆州，斩杀关羽，严重打击了刘备的势力，并直接引发了后来的夷陵之战。
description.en: Lü Meng's seizure of Jing Province and execution of Guan Yu dealt a severe blow to Liu Bei's forces and directly triggered the subsequent Battle of Yiling.

description.zh-cn: 鲁肃最初轻视吕蒙，但在一次长谈后对其才略大为惊佩，发出了“非复吴下阿蒙”的感慨，并与吕蒙结为好友。
description.en: Lu Su initially looked down on Lü Meng, but after a long conversation, he was greatly impressed by his strategic acumen, exclaiming that he was 'no longer the Lü Meng of old from Wu,' and the two became close friends.

description.zh-cn: 在计划袭取荆州时，吕蒙为麻痹关羽，称病并推荐当时名声不显的陆逊接替自己的前线总指挥之位。
description.en: When planning the surprise attack on Jing Province, to lower Guan Yu's guard, Lü Meng feigned illness and recommended the then-unknown Lu Xun to replace him as the front-line commander.

description.zh-cn: 在赤壁之战及南郡之战等早期战役中，吕蒙在周瑜的指挥下作战。
description.en: In early campaigns such as the Battle of Red Cliffs and the Battle of Nan Commandery, Lü Meng fought under the command of Zhou Yu.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙在夺取荆南三郡时，通过传递假情报等计策，成功诱使固守零陵的太守郝普投降。
description.en: During his campaign to capture the three southern commanderies of Jing Province, Lü Meng used tactics such as spreading false information to successfully induce Hao Pu, the Grand Administrator defending Lingling, to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 在邓当去世后，张昭举荐吕蒙接替其职务。
description.en: After Deng Dang passed away, Zhang Zhao recommended Lü Meng to take over his post.

description.zh-cn: 在进攻夏口的战斗中，吕蒙率领前锋部队，亲手斩杀了黄祖的水军都督陈就，为孙权军的胜利打开了局面。
description.en: During the attack on Xiakou, Lü Meng led the vanguard and personally killed Chen Jiu, Huang Zu's naval commander, paving the way for Sun Quan's army's victory.

description.zh-cn: 临终前，当孙权询问接替人选时，吕蒙推荐了朱然，认为他“胆守有余”，可以担当重任。
description.en: On his deathbed, when Sun Quan asked for a successor, Lü Meng recommended Zhu Ran, stating he had 'more than enough courage and steadfastness' for the great responsibility.

description.zh-cn: 关羽发动的樊城之战导致其荆州后方兵力空虚，为吕蒙率军偷袭并成功夺取荆州创造了绝佳的机会。
description.en: The Battle of Fancheng, initiated by Guan Yu, left his rear base in Jing Province vulnerable, creating an excellent opportunity for Lü Meng to launch a surprise attack and successfully seize the province.

description.zh-cn: 吕蒙与蒋钦一同受孙权劝学而发奋读书，才能大进，两人常被孙权并列称赞为好学的典范。
description.en: Lü Meng and Jiang Qin, encouraged by Sun Quan, studied diligently and made great progress in their abilities. They were often praised together by Sun Quan as models of studiousness.

description.zh-cn: 两人曾因甘宁杀死吕蒙收留的仆役而发生严重冲突，但吕蒙最终以大局为重，主动和解。吕蒙也曾多次在孙权面前为性格粗暴的甘宁辩护，认为他是难得的猛将。
description.en: The two had a serious conflict after Gan Ning killed a servant whom Lü Meng had taken in. However, Lü Meng prioritized the greater good and initiated a reconciliation. Lü Meng also repeatedly defended the hot-tempered Gan Ning to Sun Quan, arguing that he was a rare and valuable warrior.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明出生于广东省惠州府海丰县。
description.en: Chen Jiongming was born in Haifeng County, Huizhou Prefecture, Guangdong Province.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明长期担任粤军总司令。
description.en: Chen Jiongming served as the Commander-in-Chief of the Guangdong Army for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明在第一次粤桂战争胜利后回粤就任广东省省长。
description.en: Chen Jiongming returned to Guangdong to assume the post of Governor of Guangdong Province after the victory in the First Guangdong-Guangxi War.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明被推举为中国致公党首任总理。
description.en: Chen Jiongming was elected as the first Premier of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明于1905年加入中国同盟会。
description.en: Chen Jiongming joined the Tongmenghui in 1905.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明于1906年入读广东法政学堂，1908年以“最优等生”成绩毕业。
description.en: Chen Jiongming enrolled in the Guangdong School of Law and Politics in 1906 and graduated in 1908 with the highest honors.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山及其领导的国民政府为消灭陈炯明势力而发动东征。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen and the Nationalist Government he led launched the Eastern Expedition to eliminate Chen Jiongming's forces.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正参与领导了国民革命军东征，讨伐陈炯明。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek participated in leading the National Revolutionary Army's Eastern Expedition to attack Chen Jiongming.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明在黄花岗起义中担任敢死队第四队队长。
description.en: Chen Jiongming served as the captain of the fourth commando team during the Yellow Flower Mound Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 在黄花岗起义期间，陈炯明企图行刺时任广东水师提督李准但未成功。
description.en: During the Yellow Flower Mound Uprising, Chen Jiongming attempted to assassinate Li Zhun, the then Admiral of the Guangdong Fleet, but failed.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命爆发后，陈炯明在海陆丰起兵响应，占领惠州。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Xinhai Revolution, Chen Jiongming raised troops in Haifeng and Lufeng in response and occupied Huizhou.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明宣布广东独立并自任讨袁军总司令，响应二次革命。
description.en: Chen Jiongming declared Guangdong's independence and appointed himself Commander-in-Chief of the anti-Yuan army in response to the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在二次革命中，袁世凯命令龙济光并收买陈炯明部下苏慎初，最终击败陈炯明。
description.en: During the Second Revolution, Yuan Shikai ordered Long Jiguang and bribed Chen Jiongming's subordinate Su Shenchu, ultimately defeating Chen.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴说服陈炯明起兵反抗袁世凯。
description.en: Huang Xing persuaded Chen Jiongming to take up arms against Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 原为陈炯明部下的苏慎初被袁世凯收买，倒戈炮击都督府，导致陈炯明兵败逃亡。
description.en: Su Shenchu, originally a subordinate of Chen Jiongming, was bribed by Yuan Shikai and turned against him by bombarding the governor's mansion, leading to Chen's defeat and flight.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明在护国战争期间整合广东反袁部队为讨逆共和军。
description.en: During the National Protection War, Chen Jiongming integrated anti-Yuan forces in Guangdong into the 'Republic Protection Punitive Army'.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明被护法军政府任命为第一军总司令，率援闽护法粤军进军福建。
description.en: Chen Jiongming was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the First Army by the Constitutional Protection Military Government and led the Guangdong Army to aid Fujian into Fujian province.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明率粤军进驻漳州后，建立了闽南护法区并在此施行新政。
description.en: After leading the Guangdong Army into Zhangzhou, Chen Jiongming established the Southern Fujian Constitutional Protection Area and implemented new policies there.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次粤桂战争中，陈炯明率粤军击败了旧桂系军队。
description.en: In the First Guangdong-Guangxi War, Chen Jiongming led the Guangdong Army to defeat the forces of the Old Guangxi clique.

description.zh-cn: 六一六事变迫使孙中山离开广东。
description.en: The June 16th Incident forced Sun Yat-sen to leave Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 在六一六事变后，蔡和森撰文评价陈炯明为叛徒与军阀。
description.en: After the June 16th Incident, Cai Hesen wrote an article evaluating Chen Jiongming as a traitor and a warlord.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀认为陈炯明在1922年驱逐孙文之后其行动被定性为“反革命”。
description.en: Chen Duxiu believed that after expelling Sun Yat-sen in 1922, Chen Jiongming's actions were characterized as 'counter-revolutionary'.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明与章太炎交情甚笃，章太炎赞誉其“清操绝于时人”。
description.en: Chen Jiongming had a very close friendship with Zhang Taiyan, who praised him for his 'integrity, unparalleled among his contemporaries'.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明在21岁时与黄云结婚。
description.en: Chen Jiongming married Huang Yun at the age of 21.

description.zh-cn: 罗文是罗志军的父亲。
description.en: Luo Wen is Luo Zhijun's father.

description.zh-cn: 罗志军于1969年4月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Luo Zhijun joined the Chinese Communist Party in April 1969.

description.zh-cn: 1995年在中国政法大学获得在职研究生学历和法学硕士学位。
description.en: In 1995, he obtained an in-service postgraduate degree and a Master of Laws degree from China University of Political Science and Law.

description.zh-cn: 1968年至1978年在北海舰队服役。
description.en: Served in the North Sea Fleet from 1968 to 1978.

position.zh-cn: 常委兼实业发展部部长
position.en: Standing Committee Member and Director of the Industry Development Department

description.zh-cn: 1993年起担任共青团中央常委兼实业发展部部长。
description.en: Starting from 1993, he served as a Standing Committee Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League and Director of the Industry Development Department.

description.zh-cn: 先后担任南京市副市长、代市长、市长。
description.en: Successively served as Deputy Mayor, Acting Mayor, and Mayor of Nanjing.

position.en: Standing Committee Member, Deputy Secretary, Secretary

description.zh-cn: 先后担任中共南京市委常委、副书记、书记。
description.en: Successively served as Standing Committee Member, Deputy Secretary, and Secretary of the Nanjing Municipal Committee of the CCP.

position.en: Standing Committee Member, Deputy Secretary, Secretary

description.zh-cn: 先后担任中共江苏省委常委、副书记、书记。
description.en: Successively served as Standing Committee Member, Deputy Secretary, and Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 担任江苏省人民政府省长。
description.en: Served as the Governor of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 担任江苏省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Served as the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 担任全国人大环境与资源保护委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Served as the Vice Chairman of the Environment Protection and Resources Conservation Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 担任第十三届全国政协农业和农村委员会主任。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Committee for Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 罗志军接替梁保华担任中共江苏省委书记、江苏省省长、江苏省人大常委会主任等职务。
description.en: Luo Zhijun succeeded Liang Baohua as Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP, Governor of Jiangsu, and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李强接替罗志军担任中共江苏省委书记及江苏省人大常委会主任职务。
description.en: Li Qiang succeeded Luo Zhijun as Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP and Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 罗志军接替李源潮担任中共南京市委书记职务。
description.en: Luo Zhijun succeeded Li Yuanchao as Secretary of the Nanjing Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 李学勇接替罗志军担任江苏省省长职务。
description.en: Li Xueyong succeeded Luo Zhijun as Governor of Jiangsu Province.

position.en: Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP

description.zh-cn: 罗志军担任中共江苏省委书记期间，中共中央总书记为习近平。
description.en: When Luo Zhijun served as Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP, the General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee was Xi Jinping.

position.zh-cn: 江苏省委副书记兼省长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of Jiangsu Provincial Committee and Governor

description.zh-cn: 罗志军任中共江苏省委书记期间，李学勇任省委副书记兼省长。
description.en: While Luo Zhijun was Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP, Li Xueyong served as Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Committee and Governor.

position.zh-cn: 江苏省委副书记兼省长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of Jiangsu Provincial Committee and Governor

description.zh-cn: 罗志军任中共江苏省委书记期间，石泰峰任省委副书记兼省长。
description.en: While Luo Zhijun was Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Committee of the CCP, Shi Taifeng served as Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Committee and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》在罗志军遗体送别仪式后报道，称其为“中国共产党的优秀党员”。
description.en: After the farewell ceremony for Luo Zhijun's remains, People's Daily reported and called him 'an outstanding member of the Communist Party of China'.

description.zh-cn: 中央通讯社声称罗志军是自杀身亡。
description.en: The Central News Agency claimed that Luo Zhijun died by suicide.

description.zh-cn: 星岛日报声称罗志军是自杀身亡。
description.en: Sing Tao Daily claimed that Luo Zhijun died by suicide.

description.zh-cn: 罗文于1935年参加东北军。
description.en: Luo Wen joined the Northeastern Army in 1935.

description.zh-cn: 西安事变后，罗文投向延安，参加了八路军和中国共产党。
description.en: After the Xi'an Incident, Luo Wen went to Yan'an and joined the Eighth Route Army and the Chinese Communist Party.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Equipment Department

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后官至解放军总后勤部装备部副部长。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, he rose to the position of Deputy Director of the Equipment Department of the PLA General Logistics Department.

description.zh-cn: 陈刚自2024年12月起担任中国共产党广西壮族自治区委员会书记。
description.en: Chen Gang has served as the Secretary of the Communist Party Committee of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since December 2024.

description.zh-cn: 陈刚自2025年1月起担任广西壮族自治区人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Chen Gang has served as the Director of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since January 2025.

description.zh-cn: 韦韬自2025年7月起担任广西壮族自治区人民政府主席。
description.en: Wei Tao has served as the Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region since July 2025.

description.zh-cn: 孙大伟自2021年1月起担任中国人民政治协商会议广西壮族自治区委员会主席。
description.en: Sun Dawei has served as the Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference Guangxi Committee since January 2021.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是百色起义的领导人之一。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was one of the leaders of the Baise Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 张云逸是百色起义的领导人之一。
description.en: Zhang Yunyi was one of the leaders of the Baise Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 陈豪人是百色起义的领导人之一。
description.en: Chen Haoren was one of the leaders of the Baise Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 1939年，日本支那派遣军发动桂南会战，攻占广西。
description.en: In 1939, the Japanese China Expeditionary Army launched the Battle of South Guangxi, occupying Guangxi.

description.zh-cn: 1949年，第四野战军发动广西战役。
description.en: In 1949, the Fourth Field Army launched the Guangxi Campaign.

position.zh-cn: 中共广东省委第一书记
position.en: First Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee

description.zh-cn: 时任广东省委第一书记的习仲勋向邓小平汇报并请求中央支持建立特区，邓小平表示支持并指示“你们自己去搞，杀出一条血路来”。
description.en: As the First Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, Xi Zhongxun reported to Deng Xiaoping and requested central support for establishing the special zone. Deng Xiaoping expressed his support and instructed them to 'carve out a path for yourselves'.

description.zh-cn: 在深圳经济特区建立40周年庆祝大会上出席并发表讲话，勉励深圳继续坚持改革开放。
description.en: Attended and delivered a speech at the celebration of the 40th anniversary of the establishment of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone, encouraging Shenzhen to continue its reform and opening-up.

description.zh-cn: 以受贿罪，判处原深圳市长许宗衡死刑，缓期两年执行。
description.en: Sentenced former Shenzhen mayor Xu Zongheng to death with a two-year reprieve for bribery.

description.zh-cn: 通报梁道行严重违纪并涉嫌犯罪，决定给予其开除党籍处分，并移送司法机关依法处理。
description.en: Announced that Liang Daoxing had committed serious disciplinary violations and was suspected of crimes, decided to expel him from the party, and transferred his case to judicial organs for handling according to the law.

description.zh-cn: 马化腾是腾讯公司的主要创办人之一。
description.en: Ma Huateng is one of the main founders of Tencent.

description.zh-cn: 王文全籍贯为湖北新洲。
description.en: Wang Wenquan's ancestral home is Xinzhou, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 2023年12月晋升上将军衔。
description.en: Promoted to the rank of General in December 2023.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，王文全被选为解放军和武警部队出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Wang Wenquan was elected as a delegate of the PLA and PAP to the 13th National People's Congress.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Political Department

description.zh-cn: 曾任第20集团军高炮旅政委、装甲旅政委，第20集团军政治部副主任。
description.en: Formerly served as Political Commissar of the Anti-Aircraft Artillery Brigade, Political Commissar of the Armored Brigade, and Deputy Director of the Political Department of the 20th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2013年7月任陆军第26集团军（后为第80集团军）政治部主任。
description.en: Appointed Director of the Political Department of the 26th Group Army (later the 80th Group Army) in July 2013.

description.zh-cn: 王文全接替徐忠波出任中国人民解放军联勤保障部队政治委员。
description.en: Wang Wenquan succeeded Xu Zhongbo as the Political Commissar of the PLA Joint Logistic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 高大光接替王文全出任中国人民解放军联勤保障部队政治委员。
description.en: Gao Daguang succeeded Wang Wenquan as the Political Commissar of the PLA Joint Logistic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 王文全接替王建武出任中国人民解放军南部战区政治委员。
description.en: Wang Wenquan succeeded Wang Jianwu as the Political Commissar of the PLA Southern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 黄宇诗是华娃的女儿。
黄沾与华娃于1967年结婚，1976年分居，育有二子一女。
黄沾于1995年与助手陈惠敏在美国注册结婚。
黄沾与林燕妮在1970年代中期相恋，关系维持十四年，于1990年分手。
黄沾与顾嘉𪸩是长期音乐合作伙伴，创作了大量经典影视歌曲，被称为“𪸩黄配”，并多次合办演唱会。
黄沾与金庸、倪匡、蔡澜并称“香港四大才子”，私交甚笃。
黄沾与蔡澜、金庸、倪匡并称“香港四大才子”，并共同主持节目《今夜不设防》。
黄沾与卢国沾、郑国江并列为香港粤语流行乐坛早期的三大填词人。
黄沾与郑国江、卢国沾并列为香港粤语流行乐坛早期的三大填词人。
“民主歌声献中华”是为声援八九学潮而举办的筹款演唱会。
在1996年香港特首选举中，黄沾担任李福善的公关和形象顾问以支持其参选。
黄沾于2001年确诊肺癌，并于2004年因末期肺癌引发的肺炎逝世。
彭珮云是王汉斌的夫人。
description.en: Peng Peiyun is the wife of Wang Hanbin.

description.zh-cn: 彭珮云出生于湖南浏阳。
description.en: Peng Peiyun was born in Liuyang, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 彭珮云于1946年5月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Peng Peiyun joined the Communist Party of China in May 1946.

description.zh-cn: 在“文化大革命”中，彭珮云受到迫害，后下放劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Peng Peiyun was persecuted and sent to do manual labor.

position.zh-cn: 副部长、国家教委副主任
position.en: Vice Minister, Vice Minister of the State Education Commission

description.zh-cn: 1982年至1985年任教育部副部长，1985年至1987年任国家教委副主任。
description.en: Served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Education from 1982 to 1985, and Vice Minister of the State Education Commission from 1985 to 1987.

description.zh-cn: 在第九届全国人大第一次会议上，她当选全国人民代表大会常务委员会副委员长。
description.en: At the first session of the 9th National People's Congress, she was elected Vice Chairperson of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 以中国红十字会会长的身份，率团访问台湾。
description.en: Led a delegation to visit Taiwan as the President of the Red Cross Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：彭珮云接替钱正英担任中国红十字会会长。
description.en: Succession of office: Peng Peiyun succeeded Qian Zhengying as President of the Red Cross Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：华建敏接替彭珮云担任中国红十字会会长。
description.en: Succession of office: Hua Jianmin succeeded Peng Peiyun as President of the Red Cross Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：彭珮云接替陈慕华担任中华全国妇女联合会主席。
description.en: Succession of office: Peng Peiyun succeeded Chen Muhua as President of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：顾秀莲接替彭珮云担任中华全国妇女联合会主席。
description.en: Succession of office: Gu Xiulian succeeded Peng Peiyun as President of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：彭珮云接替王伟担任中华人民共和国国家计划生育委员会主任。
description.en: Succession of office: Peng Peiyun succeeded Wang Wei as Minister of the State Family Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 职务接替：张维庆接替彭珮云担任中华人民共和国国家计划生育委员会主任。
description.en: Succession of office: Zhang Weiqing succeeded Peng Peiyun as Minister of the State Family Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 黄树槐是湖南宁远人。
description.en: Huang Shuhuai was a native of Ningyuan, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 1952年毕业于武汉大学机械系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Mechanical Engineering of Wuhan University in 1952.

position.zh-cn: 讲师、教授、机械工程一系主任、教务处处长
position.en: Lecturer, Professor, Head of the First Department of Mechanical Engineering, Director of the Academic Affairs Office

description.zh-cn: 自1952年起，历任华中工学院讲师、教授、机械工程一系主任、教务处处长。
description.en: Since 1952, he successively served as Lecturer, Professor, Head of the First Department of Mechanical Engineering, and Director of the Academic Affairs Office at Huazhong Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 在黄树槐的校长任期内，他主导了学校由单纯工科院校向文、理、工、管综合性大学的转变。
description.en: During his presidency, Huang Shuhuai led the university's transformation from a purely engineering-focused institution to a comprehensive university with disciplines in liberal arts, science, engineering, and management.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，黄树槐是国务院学位委员会第二届学科评议组成员。
description.en: According to the page category information, Huang Shuhuai was a member of the Second Subject Appraisal Group of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，黄树槐是华中科技大学校友。
description.en: According to the page category information, Huang Shuhuai is an alumnus of Huazhong University of Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，黄树槐是华中科技大学校长。
description.en: According to the page category information, Huang Shuhuai was the president of Huazhong University of Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 日本的全面侵华为第二次国共合作提供了直接背景和动力，两党建立抗日民族统一战线。
description.en: Japan's full-scale invasion of China provided the direct context and impetus for the Second KMT-CCP Cooperation, leading the two parties to establish a national united front against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在中国大陆建立了中华人民共和国政府。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party established the Government of the People's Republic of China in mainland China.

degree.zh-cn: 热工测量及自动控制专业本科及研究生
degree.en: Undergraduate and graduate in Thermal Engineering Measurement and Automatic Control

description.zh-cn: 1959年至1965年在清华大学动力系热工测量及自动控制专业学习，1965年至1968年为该专业研究生。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Power Engineering's Thermal Engineering Measurement and Automatic Control program from 1959 to 1965, and was a graduate student in the same program from 1965 to 1968.

description.zh-cn: 吴官正是中国共产党党员及高级领导人。
description.en: Wu Guanzheng is a member and senior leader of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 接替尉健行出任中共中央纪委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Wei Jianxing as the Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 接替吴官正出任中共中央纪委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Wu Guanzheng as the Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 在其中央纪委书记任上，查办了时任中共上海市委书记陈良宇。
description.en: During his tenure as Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, he investigated Chen Liangyu, who was then the Party Secretary of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在其中央纪委书记任上，查办了时任国家食品药品监督管理局局长郑筱萸。
description.en: During his tenure as Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, he investigated Zheng Xiaoyu, who was then the Director of the State Food and Drug Administration.

description.zh-cn: 吴少华是吴官正的次子。
description.en: Wu Shaohua is the second son of Wu Guanzheng.

description.zh-cn: 接替赵志浩出任中共山东省委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Zhao Zhihao as the Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 接替吴官正出任中共山东省委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Wu Guanzheng as the Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 接替毛致用出任中共江西省委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Mao Zhiyong as the Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 接替吴官正出任中共江西省委书记。
description.en: Succeeded Wu Guanzheng as the Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 接替倪献策出任江西省省长。
description.en: Succeeded Ni Xiance as the Governor of Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 接替吴官正出任江西省省长。
description.en: Succeeded Wu Guanzheng as the Governor of Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 李文宗与柯文哲为高中同学。
description.en: Li Wen-tsung and Ko Wen-je were high school classmates.

description.zh-cn: 李文娟是李文宗的胞妹。
description.en: Li Wen-chuan is Li Wen-tsung's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 因涉及柯文哲政治献金案，李文宗被羁押。
description.en: Li Wen-tsung was detained in connection with the Ko Wen-je political donation case.

description.zh-cn: 因涉及柯文哲政治献金案，朱亚虎被羁押。
description.en: Chu Ya-hu was detained in connection with the Ko Wen-je political donation case.

description.zh-cn: 台北地检署就柯文哲政治献金案声请羁押李文宗获准。
description.en: The Taipei District Prosecutors Office's request to detain Li Wen-tsung regarding the Ko Wen-je political donation case was approved.

description.zh-cn: 台北地方法院准予李文宗交保。
description.en: The Taipei District Court granted bail to Li Wen-tsung.

position.en: General Secretary of the Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 通伦·西苏里是现任老挝人民革命党中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Thongloun Sisoulith is the current General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party.

description.zh-cn: 通伦·西苏里是现任老挝人民民主共和国主席。
description.en: Thongloun Sisoulith is the current President of the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

description.zh-cn: 宋赛·西潘敦是现任老挝政府总理。
description.en: Sonexay Siphandone is the current Prime Minister of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 赛宋蓬·丰威汉是现任老挝国会主席。
description.en: Saysomphone Phomvihane is the current President of the National Assembly of Laos.

description.zh-cn: 1353年，孟苏瓦王子法昂统一老挝全境，建立澜沧王国。
description.en: In 1353, Prince Fa Ngum of Muang Sua unified the entire territory of Laos and founded the Kingdom of Lan Xang.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，由老挝人民革命党领导的巴特寮推翻了君主制政权。
description.en: In 1975, the Pathet Lao, led by the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, overthrew the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 1975年12月2日，老挝人民革命党在推翻君主制后建立了老挝人民民主共和国。
description.en: On December 2, 1975, the Lao People's Revolutionary Party established the Lao People's Democratic Republic after overthrowing the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 1575年，缅甸东吁王朝军队入侵并攻占首都，澜沧成为缅甸藩属，直到1591年重获独立。
description.en: In 1575, the army of the Toungoo dynasty of Burma invaded and captured the capital, making Lan Xang a vassal state of Burma until it regained independence in 1591.

description.zh-cn: 1779年，暹罗吞武里王朝将缅人逐出老挝后，琅勃拉邦王国沦为暹罗藩属。
description.en: In 1779, after the Thonburi Kingdom of Siam expelled the Burmese from Laos, the Kingdom of Luang Phrabang became a Siamese vassal.

description.zh-cn: 1779年，暹罗吞武里王朝将缅人逐出老挝后，万象王国沦为暹罗藩属。
description.en: In 1779, after the Thonburi Kingdom of Siam expelled the Burmese from Laos, the Kingdom of Vientiane became a Siamese vassal.

description.zh-cn: 1826年，万象国王昭阿努发动叛乱，反抗暹罗统治。
description.en: In 1826, King Anouvong of Vientiane launched a rebellion against Siamese rule.

description.zh-cn: 法暹战争后，法国于1893年10月正式成立了老挝保护国。
description.en: After the Franco-Siamese War, France officially established the French Protectorate of Laos in October 1893.

description.zh-cn: 在老挝内战期间，巴特寮组织获得了越南人民军的大力援助。
description.en: During the Laotian Civil War, the Pathet Lao organization received significant assistance from the People's Army of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 老挝人民民主共和国建立后，同越南关系紧密，并在1977年签署《老越友好合作条约》，建立“特殊团结友好关系”。
description.en: After its establishment, the Lao PDR maintained close relations with Vietnam, signing the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in 1977 to establish a "special solidarity and friendship".

description.zh-cn: 因柬越战争及中越战争，老挝站在越南一边，与中国关系恶化，直到1989年才实现关系正常化。
description.en: Due to the Cambodian-Vietnamese War and the Sino-Vietnamese War, Laos sided with Vietnam, leading to a deterioration in relations with China until normalization in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，在老挝人民革命党第四次全国代表大会上，时任总书记凯山·丰威汉提出进一步推进市场经济改革，开启了革新开放政策。
description.en: In 1986, at the 4th National Congress of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party, then-General Secretary Kaysone Phomvihane proposed further advancing market economy reforms, initiating the Chintanakan Mai policy.

description.zh-cn: 1997年7月，老挝正式加入东南亚国家联盟。
description.en: In July 1997, Laos officially joined the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.

description.zh-cn: 老挝于2013年加入世界贸易组织。
description.en: Laos joined the World Trade Organization in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 陈毅最终决定将该国的中文译名定为“老挝”。
description.en: Chen Yi made the final decision to set the country's Chinese translated name as '老挝' (Lǎowō).

description.zh-cn: 1955年，老挝（当时为老挝王国）加入联合国。1975年12月2日，会员国名称变更为老挝人民民主共和国。
description.en: In 1955, Laos (then the Kingdom of Laos) joined the United Nations. On December 2, 1975, the member state's name was changed to the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

description.zh-cn: 杨作林是甘肃天祝人。
description.en: Yang Zuolin is from Tianzhu, Gansu.

description.zh-cn: 杨作林是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Yang Zuolin is a politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨作林曾任甘肃省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: Yang Zuolin served as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，杨作林是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Yang Zuolin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在沛县反秦起义前，萧何任主吏，刘邦任亭长，是其下属。
description.en: Before the anti-Qin uprising in Pei County, Xiao He served as a chief clerk, and Liu Bang, as a Pavilion Chief, was his subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦在沛县任亭长期间，萧何多次利用职权袒护和包庇他。
description.en: During Liu Bang's tenure as Pavilion Chief in Pei County, Xiao He repeatedly used his authority to shield and cover for him.

description.zh-cn: 自刘邦被推举为沛县反抗军首领后，萧何便成为其重要部下。
description.en: After Liu Bang was chosen as the leader of the rebel army in Pei County, Xiao He became his important subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 萧何辅助刘邦建立汉朝。他接收了秦国府库的律令图书，掌握了全国户口、地理等重要信息，并在楚汉战争期间镇守关中，为刘邦提供稳固的后方和源源不断的兵员粮饷，对汉朝的建立起到了决定性作用。
description.en: Xiao He assisted Liu Bang in establishing the Han dynasty. He took control of the Qin government's legal codes and archives, mastering crucial information on national household registration and geography. During the Chu-Han Contention, he defended the Guanzhong region, providing a stable rear base and a continuous supply of troops and provisions for Liu Bang, playing a decisive role in the founding of the Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 汉高祖十二年，刘邦因猜忌萧何收买民心，以其为民请愿开放上林苑为由，将萧何下狱问罪。后经他人劝谏而释放。
description.en: In the twelfth year of Emperor Gaozu of Han's reign (195 BC), Liu Bang, suspicious that Xiao He was winning over the populace, imprisoned and charged him for petitioning to open the imperial Shanglin Park to the common people. Xiao He was later released after others interceded on his behalf.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦去世后，萧何作为相国辅佐汉惠帝。
description.en: After Liu Bang's death, Xiao He served as Chancellor of State, assisting Emperor Hui of Han.

description.zh-cn: 在病危时，萧何向汉惠帝推荐曹参继任相国之位。
description.en: On his deathbed, Xiao He recommended Cao Shen to Emperor Hui of Han as his successor to the position of Chancellor of State.

description.zh-cn: 在刘邦加封并派兵“保护”萧何时，召平提醒他此举意在监视，并劝其辞让封赏、捐出家产以自保，萧何听从了他的建议，使刘邦大悦。
description.en: When Liu Bang granted Xiao He a larger fief and sent troops to 'protect' him, Shao Ping warned him that this was a sign of surveillance. He advised Xiao He to refuse the rewards and donate his family fortune to protect himself. Xiao He followed this advice, which greatly pleased Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 萧何在秦朝法律基础上，主持制定了汉朝的根本大法《九章律》。
description.en: Xiao He presided over the creation of the 'Nine-Chapter Law', the fundamental law of the Han dynasty, based on the legal code of the Qin dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·米舒斯京是俄罗斯联邦的现任总理。
description.en: Mikhail Mishustin is the current Prime Minister of the Russian Federation.

description.zh-cn: 1917年的二月革命推翻了俄罗斯帝国，导致沙皇尼古拉二世退位。
description.en: The February Revolution of 1917 overthrew the Russian Empire, leading to the abdication of Tsar Nicholas II.

description.zh-cn: 由于2022年起全面入侵乌克兰，俄罗斯联邦失去了其在欧洲委员会的成员地位。
description.en: Due to the full-scale invasion of Ukraine starting in 2022, the Russian Federation lost its membership in the Council of Europe.

description.zh-cn: 因2014年吞并克里米亚，俄罗斯联邦被暂停其在八大工业国组织的成员身份。
description.en: Due to the annexation of Crimea in 2014, the Russian Federation's membership in the G8 was suspended.

description.zh-cn: 在13世纪的蒙古入侵中，基辅罗斯被蒙古人征服，最终导致其灭亡。
description.en: During the Mongol invasion in the 13th century, Kievan Rus' was conquered by the Mongols, which ultimately led to its demise.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙内战是在西班牙第二共和国的共和派与弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥领导的国民派之间进行的。
description.en: The Spanish Civil War was fought between the Republicans of the Second Spanish Republic and the Nationalists led by Francisco Franco.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥被选为国民军总指挥，成为该派系的最高领袖。
description.en: Francisco Franco was elected as the Commander-in-Chief of the Nationalist forces, becoming the supreme leader of the faction.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国向国民军提供了大量的财政与军事援助，包括派遣“兀鹰军团”直接参战。
description.en: Nazi Germany provided substantial financial and military aid to the Nationalists, including dispatching the 'Condor Legion' to participate directly in the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 意大利向国民军提供了大量军事援助，包括派遣飞机、坦克和数万名士兵组成的“志愿军团”。
description.en: Italy provided substantial military aid to the Nationalists, including aircraft, tanks, and tens of thousands of soldiers in the 'Corpo Truppe Volontarie'.

description.zh-cn: 苏联是共和政府主要的军事援助者，秘密提供了约806架飞机、362辆坦克和1555门大炮。
description.en: The Soviet Union was the main military supporter of the Republican government, secretly providing approximately 806 aircraft, 362 tanks, and 1,555 artillery pieces.

description.zh-cn: 国际纵队作为一支由外国志愿者组成的部队，为共和派作战，成为其倚重的主力之一。
description.en: The International Brigades, as a force of foreign volunteers, fought for the Republican faction and became one of its most reliable main forces.

description.zh-cn: 在内战爆发后，苏联共产国际组织全球50多个国家的志愿者，编为国际纵队。
description.en: After the outbreak of the civil war, the Soviet Comintern organized volunteers from over 50 countries into the International Brigades.

description.zh-cn: 国民军在西班牙内战中获得胜利，导致西班牙第二共和国解体。
description.en: The victory of the Nationalist forces in the Spanish Civil War led to the dissolution of the Second Spanish Republic.

description.zh-cn: 国民军的胜利确立了弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥的独裁统治，开启了佛朗哥时期。
description.en: The victory of the Nationalists established the dictatorship of Francisco Franco, beginning the Francoist period.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国的兀鹰军团对西班牙巴斯克地区城市格尔尼卡进行了地毯式轰炸。
description.en: Nazi Germany's Condor Legion carried out a carpet bombing of the Basque city of Guernica.

description.zh-cn: 希特勒决定军事介入西班牙内战，向佛朗哥的国民军提供军事援助。
description.en: Hitler decided to intervene militarily in the Spanish Civil War, providing military assistance to Franco's Nationalist forces.

description.zh-cn: 墨索里尼决定介入西班牙内战，向佛朗哥的国民军提供大量军事援助。
description.en: Mussolini decided to intervene in the Spanish Civil War, providing substantial military aid to Franco's Nationalist forces.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林领导的苏联秘密向共和派提供军事装备和顾问，成为其主要支持者。
description.en: The Soviet Union under Stalin secretly supplied military equipment and advisors to the Republicans, becoming their main supporter.

description.zh-cn: 西班牙内战被普遍认为是第二次世界大战的前奏，德、意、苏等国在此战场上测试了新的武器和战术。
description.en: The Spanish Civil War is widely considered a prelude to World War II, where countries like Germany, Italy, and the Soviet Union tested new weapons and tactics.

description.zh-cn: 英国推行不干涉政策，对交战双方实施武器禁运，阻止了共和政府从民主国家获得武器。
description.en: The United Kingdom pursued a non-intervention policy and imposed an arms embargo on both sides, preventing the Republican government from obtaining weapons from democratic countries.

description.zh-cn: 在英国的压力下，法国政府终止了对共和派的支援，并参与了不干涉协议。
description.en: Under pressure from the UK, the French government ceased its support for the Republicans and participated in the non-intervention agreement.

description.zh-cn: 孙金明曾任第二炮兵合同战术训练基地（即火箭军69基地）副司令员。
description.en: Sun Jinming served as Deputy Commander of the Second Artillery Corps Tactical Training Base (now Rocket Force Base 69).

description.zh-cn: 2015年，孙金明任第二炮兵52基地（即火箭军61基地）副司令员。
description.en: In 2015, Sun Jinming was appointed Deputy Commander of the Second Artillery Corps Base 52 (now Rocket Force Base 61).

description.zh-cn: 孙金明于2016年8月晋升为少将军衔。
description.en: Sun Jinming was promoted to the rank of major general in August 2016.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，孙金明任火箭军64基地司令员。
description.en: In 2018, Sun Jinming became the Commander of Rocket Force Base 64.

description.zh-cn: 2022年3月，孙金明升任火箭军参谋长。
description.en: In March 2022, Sun Jinming was promoted to Chief of Staff of the Rocket Force.

description.zh-cn: 孙金明于2022年3月晋升为中将军衔。
description.en: Sun Jinming was promoted to the rank of lieutenant general in March 2022.

description.zh-cn: 孙金明接替李玉超担任中国人民解放军火箭军参谋长职务。
description.en: Sun Jinming succeeded Li Yuchao as the Chief of Staff of the PLA Rocket Force.

description.zh-cn: 因严重违纪违法，孙金明被开除中国共产党党籍。
description.en: Sun Jinming was expelled from the Communist Party of China for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 孙金明曾为中国共产党党员，于2024年7月被开除党籍。
description.en: Sun Jinming was a member of the Communist Party of China and was expelled in July 2024.

description.zh-cn: 林彪集团的覆灭为邓小平的第三次复出创造了政治契机。
description.en: The downfall of the Lin Biao clique created a political opportunity for Deng Xiaoping's third political comeback.

description.zh-cn: 在长达13年的时间里，邓小平与刘伯承并肩作战，他们的部队被称为“刘邓大军”，共同开辟和领导了晋冀鲁豫根据地，并指挥了淮海战役和渡江战役等重大战役。
description.en: For 13 years, Deng Xiaoping and Liu Bocheng fought side by side, and their troops were known as the "Liu-Deng Army." They jointly established and led the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Base Area and commanded major campaigns such as the Huaihai Campaign and the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党于1925年第四次全国代表大会上设立了总书记职务。
description.en: The Communist Party of China established the post of General Secretary at its 4th National Congress in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 中共四大首次设立了中央委员会总书记职务。
description.en: The 4th National Congress of the CPC first established the post of General Secretary of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中共十二大决定恢复设立总书记为党的最高领导职务。
description.en: The 12th National Congress of the CPC decided to reinstate the General Secretary as the party's highest leadership post.

description.zh-cn: 中共十二大决定不再设立中央委员会主席和副主席的职务。
description.en: The 12th National Congress of the CPC decided to no longer set up the posts of Chairman and Vice-Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 陈独秀在1925年中共四大上当选为首任总书记。
description.en: Chen Duxiu was elected as the first General Secretary at the 4th National Congress of the CPC in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 1931年6月，向忠发被中国国民党逮捕后遭处决。
description.en: In June 1931, Xiang Zhongfa was arrested and subsequently executed by the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央总书记负责主持中央书记处的工作。
description.en: The General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee presides over the work of the Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央总书记负责召集中央政治局会议，且中央政治局委员需向总书记述职。
description.en: The General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee is responsible for convening Politburo meetings, and Politburo members must report their work to the General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央总书记负责召集中央政治局常务委员会会议，且常务委员需向总书记述职。
description.en: The General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee is responsible for convening Politburo Standing Committee meetings, and Standing Committee members must report their work to the General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 1927年7月12日陈独秀被停职后，实际主持中共中央工作的是临时中央政治局常委张国焘。
description.en: After Chen Duxiu was suspended on July 12, 1927, Zhang Guotao, a member of the Provisional Politburo Standing Committee, effectively presided over the work of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫于1988年12月8日在北京病逝。
description.en: Ulanhu passed away due to illness in Beijing on December 8, 1988.

description.zh-cn: 在北京蒙藏学校学习期间，乌兰夫在赵世炎等共产党人的帮助下，参加马克思主义研究小组，后加入革命组织。
description.en: During his studies at the Beijing Mongolian and Tibetan School, Ulanhu, with the help of communists like Zhao Shiyan, joined a Marxism study group and later revolutionary organizations.

description.zh-cn: 在北京蒙藏学校学习期间，乌兰夫在邓中夏等共产党人的帮助下，参加马克思主义研究小组，后加入革命组织。
description.en: During his studies at the Beijing Mongolian and Tibetan School, Ulanhu, with the help of communists like Deng Zhongxia, joined a Marxism study group and later revolutionary organizations.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫自1954年起，连续担任第一、二、三届国务院副总理。
description.en: Starting from 1954, Ulanhu served consecutively as Vice Premier of the State Council for the first, second, and third terms.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫是中共第八届中央政治局候补委员，第十一、十二届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Ulanhu was an alternate member of the Politburo of the 8th Central Committee, and a member of the Politburo of the 11th and 12th Central Committees.

description.zh-cn: 乌兰夫曾任第四、五、七届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: Ulanhu served as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 4th, 5th, and 7th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1984年8月毕业于太原机械学院（现中北大学）机械制造工艺与设备专业。
description.en: Graduated in August 1984 from Taiyuan Institute of Machinery (now North University of China) with a major in Mechanical Manufacturing Technology and Equipment.

description.zh-cn: 于1987年11月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in November 1987.

description.zh-cn: 曾在机械工业部和国家发展计划委员会担任时任部长、副主任包叙定的秘书。
description.en: Served as secretary to then-Minister and Vice Chairman Bao Xuding in the Ministry of Machine-Building Industry and the State Development Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 伴随包叙定从国家发展计划委员会调任重庆市，吴政隆也于1999年12月调任重庆市政府办公厅副主任。
description.en: Following Bao Xuding's transfer from the State Development Planning Commission to Chongqing, Wu Zhenglong was also transferred in December 1999 to serve as Deputy Director of the General Office of the Chongqing Municipal Government.

description.zh-cn: 在吴政隆担任中共太原市委书记期间，耿彦波任太原市市长。
description.en: While Wu Zhenglong was the Party Secretary of Taiyuan, Geng Yanbo served as the Mayor of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 在吴政隆担任中共南京市委书记期间，缪瑞林任南京市市长。
description.en: While Wu Zhenglong was the Party Secretary of Nanjing, Miu Ruilin served as the Mayor of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 在娄勤俭担任中共江苏省委书记期间，吴政隆任江苏省省长。
description.en: While Lou Qinjian was the Party Secretary of Jiangsu, Wu Zhenglong served as the Governor of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 在吴政隆担任中共江苏省委书记期间，许昆林任江苏省省长。
description.en: While Wu Zhenglong was the Party Secretary of Jiangsu, Xu Kunlin served as the Governor of Jiangsu.

position.en: Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee

description.zh-cn: 吴政隆担任中共江苏省委书记期间，向以习近平为总书记的党中央负责。
description.en: During his tenure as Secretary of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee, Wu Zhenglong was subordinate to the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping as General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 吴政隆接替落马的陈川平，出任中共太原市委书记。
description.en: Wu Zhenglong succeeded the disgraced Chen Chuanping as the Party Secretary of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 吴政隆接替黄莉新，出任中共南京市委书记。
description.en: Wu Zhenglong succeeded Huang Lixin as the Party Secretary of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 吴政隆被任命为江苏省代理省长，接替石泰峰。
description.en: Wu Zhenglong was appointed as the acting Governor of Jiangsu, succeeding Shi Taifeng.

description.zh-cn: 吴政隆升任中共江苏省委书记，接替娄勤俭。
description.en: Wu Zhenglong was promoted to the Party Secretary of Jiangsu, succeeding Lou Qinjian.

description.zh-cn: 信长星接替吴政隆，出任中共江苏省委书记。
description.en: Xin Changxing succeeded Wu Zhenglong as the Party Secretary of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军参谋本部高官川上操六曾担任成城学校校长。
description.en: Kawakami Sōroku, a high-ranking officer of the Japanese Army General Staff, served as the principal of Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军参谋本部高官儿玉源太郎曾担任成城学校校长。
description.en: Kodama Gentarō, a high-ranking officer of the Japanese Army General Staff, served as the principal of Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 在日本留学生与清朝公使馆发生冲突后，福岛安正出面斡旋，促成了专门接收中国留学生的东京振武学校的成立。
description.en: After a conflict arose between Chinese students in Japan and the Qing legation, Fukushima Yasumasa mediated, leading to the establishment of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō specifically for Chinese students.

description.zh-cn: 在日本留学生与清朝公使馆发生冲突后，东亚同文会出面斡旋，促成了专门接收中国留学生的东京振武学校的成立。
description.en: After a conflict arose between Chinese students in Japan and the Qing legation, the East Asian Common Culture Society mediated, leading to the establishment of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō specifically for Chinese students.

description.zh-cn: 1898年，湖广总督张之洞选送4名学生入成城学校学习军事。
description.en: In 1898, Zhang Zhidong, the Viceroy of Huguang, selected and sent four students to study military science at Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 1899年起，南洋大臣刘坤一开始选派留学生入成城学校学习。
description.en: Starting in 1899, Liu Kunyi, the Viceroy of Liangjiang, began to select and send students to study at Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 1899年起，四川总督岑春煊开始选派留学生入成城学校学习。
description.en: Starting in 1899, Cen Chunxuan, the Viceroy of Sichuan, began to select and send students to study at Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 1899年起，直隶总督袁世凯开始选派留学生入成城学校学习。
description.en: Starting in 1899, Yuan Shikai, the Viceroy of Zhili, began to select and send students to study at Seijō Gakkō.

description.zh-cn: 东京振武学校的毕业生可进入日本陆军士官学校留学生班就读。同时，成城学校旨在培训有志报考陆军士官学校的青年，其毕业生也可进入该校学习。
description.en: Graduates of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō were eligible to enroll in the international student class of the Imperial Japanese Army Academy. Additionally, Seijō Gakkō aimed to train young men aspiring to enter the Army Academy, and its graduates were also eligible for admission.

description.zh-cn: 东京振武学校的旧址现为东京女子医科大学的所在地。
description.en: The former site of the Tokyo Shinbu Gakkō is now the location of the Tokyo Women's Medical University.

description.zh-cn: 1948年12月1日，北海银行与华北银行、西北农民银行合并组建中国人民银行。
description.en: On December 1, 1948, the Beihai Bank merged with the North China Bank and the Northwest Farmers Bank to form the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行自成立起开始发行人民币作为国家的法定货币。
description.en: Since its establishment, the People's Bank of China has been issuing the Renminbi as the national legal tender.

description.zh-cn: 1983年9月，国务院决定成立中国工商银行，以承办原由中国人民银行承担的工商信贷和储蓄业务。
description.en: In September 1983, the State Council decided to establish the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China to take over the industrial and commercial credit and savings business previously handled by the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 国务院决定中国人民银行专门行使国家中央银行职能，不再承担工商信贷和储蓄业务，该部分业务由新成立的中国工商银行承办。
description.en: The State Council decided that the People's Bank of China would exclusively exercise the functions of a national central bank and no longer undertake industrial and commercial credit and savings business, which was transferred to the newly established Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，中国人民银行于1970年6月与财政部合并，后于1978年3月恢复分设。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the People's Bank of China was merged with the Ministry of Finance in June 1970 and was re-established as a separate entity in March 1978.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，中国人民银行对银行、金融资产管理公司、信托投资公司及其他存款类金融机构的监管职能被分离出来，并整合成立了中国银行业监督管理委员会。
description.en: In 2003, the regulatory functions of the People's Bank of China over banks, financial asset management companies, trust and investment corporations, and other deposit-taking financial institutions were spun off and integrated to form the China Banking Regulatory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2023年3月，第十四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议审议批准了《国务院机构改革方案》。
description.en: In March 2023, the First Session of the 14th National People's Congress reviewed and approved the 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan'.

description.zh-cn: 该方案规定将中国人民银行对金融控股公司等金融集团的日常监管职责、有关金融消费者保护职责划入新成立的国家金融监督管理总局。
description.en: The plan stipulated the transfer of the People's Bank of China's daily regulatory responsibilities for financial holding companies and other financial groups, as well as relevant financial consumer protection duties, to the newly established National Administration of Financial Regulation.

description.zh-cn: 根据2023年《党和国家机构改革方案》，不再保留国务院金融稳定发展委员会及其办事机构。
description.en: According to the 2023 'Party and State Institutional Reform Plan', the State Council's Financial Stability and Development Committee and its office were dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 根据2023年《党和国家机构改革方案》，将原国务院金融稳定发展委员会办公室职责划入中央金融委员会办公室。
description.en: According to the 2023 'Party and State Institutional Reform Plan', the responsibilities of the former Office of the State Council's Financial Stability and Development Committee were transferred to the Office of the Central Financial Commission.

description.zh-cn: “杜鲁门主义”的提出通常被认为是冷战的开始。
description.en: The pronouncement of the 'Truman Doctrine' is generally considered the starting point of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·凯南从莫斯科发回的“长电报”中阐述了围堵政策，成为之后美国对苏策略的基础。
description.en: George F. Kennan's 'Long Telegram' from Moscow articulated the policy of containment, which became the basis for subsequent US strategy towards the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林拒绝让苏联及旗下的铁幕国家接受马歇尔计划的援助，并提出了莫洛托夫计划作为对抗。
description.en: Stalin refused to allow the Soviet Union and its satellite states to accept aid from the Marshall Plan, proposing the Molotov Plan as a counterpart.

description.zh-cn: 斯大林下令封锁了通往西柏林的陆路交通，企图迫使西方盟国放弃对西柏林的控制。
description.en: Stalin ordered the blockade of all land routes to West Berlin in an attempt to force the Western Allies to relinquish their control over the city.

description.zh-cn: 苏联红军入侵匈牙利，镇压了寻求民主改革的十月事件。
description.en: The Soviet Red Army invaded Hungary to crush the October Revolution, which sought democratic reforms.

description.zh-cn: 苏联成功发射第一颗人造卫星史普尼克1号，标志着太空竞赛的正式开始。
description.en: The successful launch of Sputnik 1, the first artificial satellite, by the Soviet Union marked the official beginning of the Space Race.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫决定在古巴部署核导弹，直接引发了古巴导弹危机。
description.en: Khrushchev's decision to deploy nuclear missiles in Cuba directly triggered the Cuban Missile Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 苏联领导华沙条约组织军队入侵捷克斯洛伐克，终结了该国的政治自由化运动“布拉格之春”。
description.en: The Soviet Union led Warsaw Pact troops in an invasion of Czechoslovakia, ending the country's political liberalization movement known as the 'Prague Spring'.

description.zh-cn: 1979年12月，苏联军队入侵阿富汗以支持亲苏政权，标志着缓和政策的结束。
description.en: In December 1979, Soviet forces invaded Afghanistan to support the pro-Soviet government, marking the end of the détente era.

description.zh-cn: 波兰的团结工联运动严重挑战了苏联在东欧的统治，是导致共产主义阵营瓦解的重要因素之一。
description.en: The Solidarity movement in Poland seriously challenged Soviet dominance in Eastern Europe and was a key factor in the eventual collapse of the communist bloc.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫为应对苏联严重的经济停滞，于1987年宣布进行经济改革。
description.en: To address severe economic stagnation in the Soviet Union, Gorbachev announced the implementation of Perestroika in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫推行开放政策，旨在增加政府透明度，改善共产党高层的腐败现象。
description.en: Gorbachev introduced Glasnost to increase government transparency and combat corruption within the Communist Party's elite.

description.zh-cn: 雷根与戈尔巴乔夫举行了一系列峰会，讨论削减核武器和改善两国关系，最终促成了冷战的结束。
description.en: Reagan and Gorbachev held a series of summits to discuss nuclear arms reduction and improve relations, which ultimately contributed to the end of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 1989年的东欧剧变导致该地区所有共产主义政权垮台。作为其主要成员的东欧国家纷纷转型，华沙条约组织随之解散。
description.en: The Revolutions of 1989 led to the collapse of all communist regimes in the region. Subsequently, its main Eastern European member countries underwent transitions, leading to the dissolution of the Warsaw Pact.

description.zh-cn: 居伊·德波是情境主义国际的创始人。
description.en: Guy Debord was the founder of the Situationist International.

description.zh-cn: 情境主义国际是一个左翼国际组织。
description.en: The Situationist International was a left-wing international organization.

description.zh-cn: 情境主义国际的理论批判资本主义，并主张将指向资本主义经济和政治制度的阶级斗争转换为“日常生活的革命”。
description.en: The theories of the Situationist International criticized capitalism and advocated for transforming the class struggle aimed at the capitalist economic and political system into a 'revolution of everyday life'.

description.zh-cn: 情境主义国际将心理学意义上的观念“异轨”作为其核心的艺术和政治实践方法之一，用以扬弃异化和反对拜物教。
description.en: The Situationist International promoted the concept of 'Détournement' as one of its core artistic and political practices to sublate alienation and oppose fetishism.

description.zh-cn: 在1968年法国“五月风暴”中，情境主义作为一种批判的艺术观念成为新型“文化革命”的战斗旗帜。
description.en: In the May '68 events in France, Situationism, as a critical artistic concept, became the fighting banner of a new 'cultural revolution'.

description.zh-cn: 情境主义国际的思想深刻影响了让·鲍德里亚，成为其消费社会批判理论和后现代思潮的关键性学术资源。
description.en: The ideas of the Situationist International profoundly influenced Jean Baudrillard, becoming a key intellectual resource for his critical theory of consumer society and postmodern thought.

description.zh-cn: 居伊·德波是《景观社会》的作者。
description.en: Guy Debord is the author of 'The Society of the Spectacle'.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明出生于四川达县。
description.en: Zhang Canming was born in Da County, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明曾担任中华人民共和国外交部副部长。
description.en: Zhang Canming served as the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明曾担任中华人民共和国最高人民检察院副检察长。
description.en: Zhang Canming served as the Deputy Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1962年，张灿明的中华人民共和国驻锡兰大使职务由谢克西接任。
description.en: In 1962, Zhang Canming's position as Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Ceylon was succeeded by Xie Kexi.

description.zh-cn: 1963年，张灿明接替谢甫生担任中华人民共和国驻蒙古大使。
description.en: In 1963, Zhang Canming succeeded Xie Fusheng as the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明的中华人民共和国驻蒙古大使职务由许文益接任。
description.en: Zhang Canming's position as Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Mongolia was succeeded by Xu Wenyi.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明接替史梓铭担任中华人民共和国驻芬兰大使。
description.en: Zhang Canming succeeded Shi Ziming as the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Finland.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明的中华人民共和国驻芬兰大使职务由谢邦治接任。
description.en: Zhang Canming's position as Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to Finland was succeeded by Xie Bangzhi.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明接替王若杰担任中华人民共和国驻阿拉伯也门大使。
description.en: Zhang Canming succeeded Wang Ruojie as the Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to the Arab Republic of Yemen.

description.zh-cn: 张灿明的中华人民共和国驻阿拉伯也门大使职务由赵禁接任。
description.en: Zhang Canming's position as Ambassador of the People's Republic of China to the Arab Republic of Yemen was succeeded by Zhao Jin.

description.zh-cn: 桂西僮族自治州在1956年至1958年期间为副省级自治州，管辖地级百色专区。
description.en: From 1956 to 1958, the Guixi Zhuang Autonomous Prefecture was a sub-provincial autonomous prefecture and had jurisdiction over the prefecture-level Baise Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 桂西僮族自治州在1956年至1958年期间为副省级自治州，管辖地级宜山专区。
description.en: From 1956 to 1958, the Guixi Zhuang Autonomous Prefecture was a sub-provincial autonomous prefecture and had jurisdiction over the prefecture-level Yishan Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 1953年4月，中共中央批准了《新疆省民族区域自治实施计划草案》，该计划确定了建立伊犁哈萨克自治区的方针。
description.en: In April 1953, the CPC Central Committee approved the 'Draft Implementation Plan for Regional Ethnic Autonomy in Xinjiang Province,' which established the policy for creating the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 1953年12月，经政务院批准成立伊犁哈萨克自治区（后改为自治州）。
description.en: In December 1953, the Government Administration Council approved the establishment of the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Region (later renamed Autonomous Prefecture).

description.zh-cn: 伊犁哈萨克自治区（后改为自治州）成立后，属新疆省人民政府领导，直至1955年10月新疆维吾尔自治区成立。
description.en: After its establishment, the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Region (later Prefecture) was under the leadership of the Xinjiang Provincial People's Government until the establishment of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region in October 1955.

description.zh-cn: 1984年9月，国务院发文重申伊犁哈萨克自治州对伊犁、塔城、阿勒泰三个地区的管辖权。
description.en: In September 1984, the State Council issued a document reaffirming the jurisdiction of the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture over the three prefectures of Ili, Tacheng, and Altay.

description.zh-cn: 1987年经自治区党委和人民政府批准，伊犁州行政待遇调整，其人大常委会主任、州长享受副省级待遇。
description.en: In 1987, with the approval of the regional Party Committee and People's Government, the administrative treatment of Ili Prefecture was adjusted, with its People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman and Governor receiving sub-provincial level treatment.

description.zh-cn: 1987年经自治区党委和人民政府批准，伊犁州行政待遇调整，其人大常委会主任、州长享受副省级待遇。
description.en: In 1987, with the approval of the regional Party Committee and People's Government, the administrative treatment of Ili Prefecture was adjusted, with its People's Congress Standing Committee Chairman and Governor receiving sub-provincial level treatment.

description.zh-cn: 民政部在其行政区划统计中，将伊犁州列为地级行政区（自治州）。
description.en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs lists Ili Prefecture as a prefecture-level administrative region (autonomous prefecture) in its administrative division statistics.

position.en: Member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 2013年7月，时任伊犁州党委书记的李学军兼任自治区党委常委，升为副省部级干部。
description.en: In July 2013, Li Xuejun, then Party Secretary of Ili Prefecture, was appointed as a member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee, and was promoted to a sub-provincial and ministerial level cadre.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军陆军指挥学院隶属于中国人民解放军陆军。
description.en: The PLA Army Command College is subordinate to the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 为纪念在战斗中牺牲的校长彭雪枫，学校被命名为雪枫军政大学。
description.en: The school was named Xuefeng Military and Political University in memory of President Peng Xuefeng, who was killed in action.

description.zh-cn: 由华中雪枫大学、山东军区军政学校、东江纵队、淮南随营学校、山东军区通信学校等5个单位统一改编为华东军事政治大学。
description.en: Reorganized into the East China Military and Political University by merging five units: Huazhong Xuefeng University, Shandong Military Region Military and Political School, East River Column, Huainan Suijing School, and Shandong Military Region Communications School.

description.zh-cn: 为华东军大题词：“华东军政大学日进有功，培养大批国防建设人才。”
description.en: Wrote an inscription for the East China Military and Political University.

description.zh-cn: 为华东军大题词：“努力学习军事科学和革命理论，为建设近代化的强大国防军而奋斗。”
description.en: Wrote an inscription for the East China Military and Political University.

description.zh-cn: 总高级步兵学校并入中国人民解放军军事学院。
description.en: The General Senior Infantry School was merged into the PLA Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 南京军区决定筹建中国人民解放军南京军区军政干部学校。
description.en: The Nanjing Military Region decided to establish the PLA Nanjing Military Region Military and Political Cadre School.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，该校于2016年由中国人民解放军总参谋部转隶中国人民解放军陆军。2017年，南京陆军指挥学院更名为中国人民解放军陆军指挥学院。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the college was transferred from the PLA General Staff Department to the PLA Ground Force in 2016. In 2017, Nanjing Army Command College was renamed the PLA Army Command College.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴出生在广东省罗定州罗镜龙岩村。
description.en: Cai Tingkai was born in Longyan Village, Luojing, Luoding Prefecture, Guangdong Province.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴早年参加了同盟会。
description.en: Cai Tingkai joined the Tongmenghui in his early years.

position.zh-cn: 大本营补充团连长、营长
position.en: Company and Battalion Commander of the Headquarters Reinforcement Regiment

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴曾任孙中山大本营补充团连长、营长，并参加其领导的多次战役。
description.en: Cai Tingkai served as a company and battalion commander in Sun Yat-sen's headquarters reinforcement regiment and participated in several campaigns under his leadership.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴参加了孙中山领导的第一次北伐。
description.en: Cai Tingkai participated in the First Northern Expedition led by Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴参加了讨伐桂军沈鸿英的战役。
description.en: Cai Tingkai participated in the campaign against the Guangxi warlord Shen Hongying.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴参加了东征讨伐陈炯明的战役。
description.en: Cai Tingkai participated in the Eastern Expedition campaign against Chen Jiongming.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴在陈铭枢担任营长的肇军游击营中担任排长，并长期受其栽培。
description.en: Cai Tingkai served as a platoon leader in the Zhaojun Guerrilla Battalion where Chen Mingshu was the commander, and was mentored by him for a long time.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴在蒋光鼐担任团长的建国粤军第一师第一旅第二团中担任第一营营长。
description.en: Cai Tingkai served as the commander of the 1st Battalion in the 2nd Regiment of the 1st Brigade of the 1st Division of the National Pacification Army of Guangdong, where Jiang Guangnai was the regiment commander.

description.zh-cn: 在南昌起义前，蔡廷锴的部队归北伐名将张发奎指挥。
description.en: Before the Nanchang Uprising, Cai Tingkai's troops were under the command of the famous Northern Expedition general Zhang Fakui.

description.zh-cn: 在向南京进攻期间，蔡廷锴率领的第十师曾归叶挺指挥跟进。
description.en: During the attack on Nanjing, the 10th Division led by Cai Tingkai was placed under the command of Ye Ting to follow up.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴率领十九路军在上海对日军的进攻进行了坚决抵抗，是“一·二八事变”中中方的主要指挥官。
description.en: Cai Tingkai led the 19th Route Army in resolute resistance against the Japanese attack in Shanghai, serving as a main Chinese commander during the January 28 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴在一·二八事变和抗日战争期间，率领部队与日军作战。
description.en: Cai Tingkai led troops to fight against the Japanese army during the January 28 Incident and the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 因不满蒋介石的“攘外必先安内”政策，蔡廷锴发动福建事变，公开抗日反蒋。
description.en: Dissatisfied with Chiang Kai-shek's policy of 'internal pacification before external resistance,' Cai Tingkai launched the Fujian Incident, openly resisting Japan and opposing Chiang.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴与李济深、陈铭枢、蒋光鼐等人共同领导发起了福建事变。
description.en: Cai Tingkai, along with Li Jishen, Chen Mingshu, and Jiang Guangnai, co-led and launched the Fujian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 蔡廷锴是福建事变期间成立的中华共和国人民革命政府的创始人之一。
description.en: Cai Tingkai was one of the founders of the People's Revolutionary Government of the Republic of China, established during the Fujian Incident.

description.zh-cn: 抗战初期，蔡廷锴领导军队参加了昆仑关战役。
description.en: In the early stages of the War of Resistance, Cai Tingkai led troops to participate in the Battle of Kunlun Pass.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，蔡廷锴与李济深、何香凝等在广州组织中国国民党民主促进会。
description.en: In 1946, Cai Tingkai, along with Li Jishen, He Xiangning, and others, organized the China Kuomintang Democratic Promotion Association in Guangzhou.

description.zh-cn: 1948年1月，蔡廷锴与李济深等人在香港参与发起组织中国国民党革命委员会。
description.en: In January 1948, Cai Tingkai, along with Li Jishen and others, participated in initiating the organization of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，蔡廷锴任中央人民政府委员。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Cai Tingkai served as a member of the Central People's Government Council.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，蔡廷锴任国家体育运动委员会副主任。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Cai Tingkai served as Vice Director of the State Physical Culture and Sports Commission.

description.zh-cn: 1964年12月至1968年，蔡廷锴任政协全国委员会副主席。
description.en: From December 1964 to 1968, Cai Tingkai served as Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 1939年蔡廷锴与罗西欧结婚，罗西欧是其第二任妻子。
description.en: Cai Tingkai married Luo Xi'ou in 1939; she was his second wife.

description.zh-cn: 蔡绍芝是蔡廷锴的次女。
description.en: Cai Shaozhi is the second daughter of Cai Tingkai.

description.zh-cn: 区寿年是蔡廷锴的外甥。
description.en: Ou Shounian was Cai Tingkai's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 1940年，蔡廷锴因受蒋介石排挤而去职。
description.en: In 1940, Cai Tingkai was forced out of office due to being sidelined by Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: “文化大革命”期间，蔡廷锴作为周恩来运作保护的民主人士之一而未受冲击。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Cai Tingkai was one of the democratic figures protected by Zhou Enlai and thus avoided persecution.

description.zh-cn: 1948年7月1日的豫东战役中，区寿年被中国人民解放军所俘。
description.en: During the Yudong Campaign on July 1, 1948, Ou Shounian was captured by the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 五一口号由时任中共中央主席毛泽东领导的中共中央发布。
description.en: The May 1 Slogan was issued by the Central Committee of the CCP, led by then-chairman Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 面对叶挺等人发动的南昌起义，蔡廷锴决定坐视态势发展，消极参与。
description.en: Facing the Nanchang Uprising launched by Ye Ting and others, Cai Tingkai decided to adopt a wait-and-see attitude and participate passively.

description.zh-cn: 该纪录片是为纪念习仲勋诞辰100周年而制作的献礼作，旨在回顾并宣传其功勋卓著的奋斗历程。
description.en: This documentary was a tribute produced to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Xi Zhongxun's birth, aiming to review and publicize his distinguished and meritorious life journey.

description.zh-cn: 于2013年10月在黄金剧场播出了文献纪录片《习仲勋》。
description.en: Broadcast the documentary 'Xi Zhongxun' in its prime time slot in October 2013.

description.zh-cn: 于2013年10月播出了文献纪录片《习仲勋》。
description.en: Broadcast the documentary 'Xi Zhongxun' in October 2013.

description.zh-cn: 美国第七舰队进入台湾海峡，实施“台湾海峡中立化”，阻止了中国人民解放军渡海攻台的计划。
description.en: The entry of the U.S. Seventh Fleet into the Taiwan Strait, implementing the 'neutralization of the Taiwan Strait', thwarted the PLA's plan to invade Taiwan by sea.

description.zh-cn: 寿汉卿曾任中华人民共和国纺织工业部副部长。
description.en: Shou Hanqing served as the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Textile Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 寿汉卿是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Shou Hanqing was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨易辰在担任黑龙江省人民委员会副省长期间，韩光曾任省长，是其直接上级。
description.en: While Yang Yichen was Vice Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Committee, Han Guang served as Governor, his direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 杨易辰在担任黑龙江省人民委员会副省长期间，欧阳钦曾任省长，是其直接上级。
description.en: While Yang Yichen was Vice Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Committee, Ouyang Qin served as Governor, his direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 杨易辰在担任黑龙江省人民委员会副省长期间，李范五曾任省长，是其直接上级。
description.en: While Yang Yichen was Vice Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Committee, Li Fanwu served as Governor, his direct superior.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，杨易辰于1967年被中止黑龙江省人民委员会副省长职务。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Yang Yichen's tenure as Vice Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Committee was terminated in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 杨易辰于1983年3月接替黄火青担任最高人民检察院检察长。
description.en: In March 1983, Yang Yichen succeeded Huang Huoqing as the Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 刘复之于1988年4月接替杨易辰担任最高人民检察院检察长。
description.en: In April 1988, Liu Fuzhi succeeded Yang Yichen as the Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate.

description.zh-cn: 杨易辰于1977年12月接替刘光涛担任中国共产党黑龙江省委员会书记和黑龙江省革命委员会主任。
description.en: In December 1977, Yang Yichen succeeded Liu Guangtao as Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee and Director of the Heilongjiang Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 杨易辰于1977年12月接替欧阳钦担任中国人民政治协商会议黑龙江省委员会主席。
description.en: In December 1977, Yang Yichen succeeded Ouyang Qin as Chairman of the CPPCC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王一伦于1979年12月接替杨易辰担任中国人民政治协商会议黑龙江省委员会主席。
description.en: In December 1979, Wang Yilun succeeded Yang Yichen as Chairman of the CPPCC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1979年12月，黑龙江省革命委员会被撤销，由新成立的黑龙江省人民政府取代。
description.en: In December 1979, the Heilongjiang Provincial Revolutionary Committee was abolished and replaced by the newly established Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 作为主要倡议者之一，提议并参与创办中国科学技术大学。
description.en: As one of the main proponents, he proposed and participated in the founding of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 时任中国科学院副院长的张劲夫代表科学院向中央提出创办中国科学技术大学的申请。
description.en: Zhang Jinfu, then Vice President of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, submitted the application to the central government to establish the University of Science and Technology of China on behalf of the academy.

description.zh-cn: 郭沫若担任中国科学技术大学的首任校长。
description.en: Guo Moruo served as the first president of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 中苏交恶导致的战备疏散要求是中国科学技术大学被迫迁出北京的原因之一，这一搬迁对学校造成了巨大损失。
description.en: The requirement for strategic relocation due to the Sino-Soviet split was one of the reasons for the forced relocation of the University of Science and Technology of China from Beijing, a move that caused immense losses to the university.

description.zh-cn: 原合肥经济技术学院于1999年12月18日整建制并入中国科学技术大学。
description.en: The former Hefei College of Economics and Technology was fully merged into the University of Science and Technology of China on December 18, 1999.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时担任中国科学技术大学校长，任期长达10年，期间推动了学校的改革和发展。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi served as the president of the University of Science and Technology of China for 10 years, during which he promoted the university's reform and development.

description.zh-cn: 李政道于1978年主持创办了中国科学技术大学的少年班。
description.en: Tsung-Dao Lee presided over the establishment of the Special Class for the Gifted Young at the University of Science and Technology of China in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框内容，中国民主促进会吉林省委员会的上级机构是中国民主促进会中央委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior body of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy is the Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主促进会吉林省委员会是中国民主促进会在吉林省的地方组织。
description.en: The Jilin Provincial Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy is the local organization of the China Association for Promoting Democracy in Jilin Province.

description.zh-cn: 中国民主促进会中央委员会是中国民主促进会的中央领导机构。
description.en: The Central Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy is the central leading body of the China Association for Promoting Democracy.

description.zh-cn: 1868年，明治政府宣布将江户改名为东京。
description.en: In 1868, the Meiji government announced the renaming of Edo to Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 关东大地震后，时任内务大臣的后藤新平设立了帝都复兴院以主导重建工作。
description.en: After the Great Kantō earthquake, Gotō Shinpei, then Minister of Home Affairs, established the Imperial Capital Reconstruction Agency to lead the reconstruction efforts.

description.zh-cn: 由于中国抗日战争的持续，日本放弃了1940年夏季奥林匹克运动会的主办权。
description.en: Due to the ongoing Second Sino-Japanese War, Japan relinquished its right to host the 1940 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 夏目漱石出生在东京市牛込区马场下横町。
description.en: Natsume Sōseki was born in Babashita-yokocho, Ushigome-ku, Tokyo City.

description.zh-cn: 夏目漱石曾在东京帝国大学担任英文学讲师。
description.en: Natsume Sōseki once served as an English literature lecturer at Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 芥川龙之介毕业于东京帝国大学英文科。
description.en: Ryūnosuke Akutagawa graduated from the English Department of Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 川端康成毕业于东京帝国大学。
description.en: Yasunari Kawabata graduated from Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 佐藤荣作毕业于东京帝国大学。
description.en: Eisaku Satō graduated from Tokyo Imperial University.

description.zh-cn: 早稻田大学由大隈重信创建。
description.en: Waseda University was founded by Ōkuma Shigenobu.

description.zh-cn: 1941年7月4日，东京地下铁道与东京高速铁道合并，成立了帝都高速度交通营团。
description.en: On July 4, 1941, Tokyo Underground Railway and Tokyo Rapid Transit merged to form the Teito Rapid Transit Authority.

description.zh-cn: 董健是山东寿光人。
description.en: Dong Jian was a native of Shouguang, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 1956年考入北京俄语学院，1957年转学。
description.en: Admitted to the Beijing Russian Language Institute in 1956 and transferred in 1957.

description.zh-cn: 1957年至1962年在南京大学中国语言文学系完成本科学习，1962年至1965年攻读硕士研究生。
description.en: Completed his undergraduate studies at the Department of Chinese Language and Literature, Nanjing University from 1957 to 1962, and pursued postgraduate studies from 1962 to 1965.

description.zh-cn: 1965年毕业后留校任教，后曾任南京大学副校长，及人文社会科学荣誉资深教授。
description.en: After graduating in 1965, he stayed at the university to teach, and later served as vice president and honorary senior professor of humanities and social sciences.

description.zh-cn: 在南京大学攻读硕士研究生期间，师从陈中凡。
description.en: During his postgraduate studies at Nanjing University, he was a student of Chen Zhongfan.

description.zh-cn: 南京大学中国语言文学系是南京大学下属的院系。
description.en: The Department of Chinese Language and Literature is a department under Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 董健是中国作家协会会员。
