description.en: Dong Jian was a member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 董健是中国戏剧家协会会员。
description.en: Dong Jian was a member of the China Theatre Association.

description.zh-cn: 董健是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Dong Jian was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中部战区陆军是中国人民解放军陆军的组成部分。
description.en: The PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force is a component of the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军中部战区陆军隶属于中国人民解放军中部战区。
description.en: The PLA Central Theater Command Ground Force is subordinate to the PLA Central Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 作为中央军委主席，习近平在2016年2月1日向包括中部战区在内的五大战区授予军旗并发布训令，正式成立了战区及战区陆军。
description.en: As Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Xi Jinping presented flags and issued orders to the five major theater commands, including the Central Theater Command, on February 1, 2016, officially establishing the theater commands and their ground forces.

description.zh-cn: 在中国人民解放军2016年的改革中，原北京军区被撤销，其下属部分部队被划归新成立的中部战区陆军。
description.en: During the 2016 PLA reforms, the former Beijing Military Region was disbanded, and some of its subordinate units were reassigned to the newly formed Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 在中国人民解放军2016年的改革中，原济南军区被撤销，其下属部分部队被划归新成立的中部战区陆军。
description.en: During the 2016 PLA reforms, the former Jinan Military Region was disbanded, and some of its subordinate units were reassigned to the newly formed Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 陆军第八十一集团军隶属于中部战区陆军。
description.en: The 81st Group Army is subordinate to the Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 陆军第八十二集团军隶属于中部战区陆军。
description.en: The 82nd Group Army is subordinate to the Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 陆军第八十三集团军隶属于中部战区陆军。
description.en: The 83rd Group Army is subordinate to the Central Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 光荣革命导致玛丽二世的父亲詹姆斯二世被废黜，为玛丽与丈夫威廉共同登上王位铺平了道路。
description.en: The Glorious Revolution led to the deposition of Mary II's father, James II, paving the way for Mary and her husband William to jointly ascend the throne.

description.zh-cn: 该法案将王位授予玛丽与威廉，正式确立了她们的共治君主地位。
description.en: This act offered the throne to Mary and William, formally establishing them as joint sovereigns.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽二世因怀疑约翰·丘吉尔参与复辟其父詹姆斯二世的计划，下令撤销其职务并将其逮捕。
description.en: Mary II ordered the dismissal and arrest of John Churchill on suspicion of his involvement in a plot to restore her father, James II.

description.zh-cn: 因处理约翰·丘吉尔及其夫人萨拉·邱吉尔一事，玛丽与深受萨拉影响的妹妹安妮关系破裂，此后姐妹俩再未见面。
description.en: Due to her handling of John Churchill and his wife Sarah, Mary's relationship with her sister Anne, who was heavily influenced by Sarah, broke down. The sisters never met again.

description.zh-cn: 应“不朽七人”的邀请，威廉三世率领军队登陆英格兰，发动了光荣革命。
description.en: At the invitation of the 'Immortal Seven', William III led an army to land in England, initiating the Glorious Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰议会宣布詹姆斯二世自动退位，王位由玛丽与威廉共同继承。
description.en: The Parliament of England declared that James II had abdicated and that the throne was jointly inherited by Mary and William.

description.zh-cn: 苏格兰王国议会宣布詹姆斯不再是苏格兰国王，并承认威廉和玛丽为共治君主。
description.en: The Parliament of Scotland declared that James was no longer King of Scotland and recognized William and Mary as joint sovereigns.

description.zh-cn: 在光荣革命期间，时任詹姆斯二世军队主帅的约翰·丘吉尔倒戈投向威廉。
description.en: During the Glorious Revolution, John Churchill, then commander of James II's army, defected to William's side.

description.zh-cn: 王方庆在途经韶州时见到十三岁的张九龄的文章后，大为叹赏，认为他前途远大。
张说于703年途经曲江时与张九龄相识，并与之通族谱，结为宗亲，对他十分器重。
张说在担任宰相期间，于722年举荐张九龄为司勋员外郎，723年再荐其为中书舍人。
张九龄在唐玄宗朝廷中担任多个官职，是唐玄宗的臣子。
张说去世后，唐玄宗于731年召张九龄回朝，并逐步擢升其为宰相（中书令）。
因受李林甫、牛仙客等人影响，以及对张九龄举荐的周子谅不满，唐玄宗不再信任张九龄，于736年将其罢相，后于737年将其贬为荆州大都督府长史。
张九龄认为安禄山有反叛之心，曾上奏唐玄宗请求将其处死以绝后患，但未被采纳。
李林甫与牛仙客等人结党排挤张九龄，导致张九龄失去唐玄宗的信任并被罢相。
牛仙客与李林甫等人结党排挤张九龄，导致张九龄失去唐玄宗的信任并被罢相。
张九龄在主政期间提拔王维为右拾遗。
张九龄在主政期间提拔卢象为左补阙。
张九龄举荐周子谅为监察御史。
周子谅因触怒唐玄宗而被杀。
张九龄贬为荆州大都督府长史后，征召孟浩然进入其幕府。
谭氏是张九龄的元配夫人。
张拯是张九龄的长子。
张九皋是张九龄的弟弟。
张九章是张九龄的弟弟。
在唐玄宗生日时，上《千秋金鉴录》以作讽谏，玄宗对此表示嘉许。
张九龄是唐朝开元时期的重要官员，官至宰相。
张九龄是韶州曲江人。
曾担任驻义大利副武官、驻美国副武官。
description.en: Served as Deputy Military Attaché in Italy and Deputy Military Attaché in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 1980年任国防部情报局少将副局长。
description.en: In 1980, he served as Deputy Director of the Intelligence Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense with the rank of Rear Admiral.

description.zh-cn: 以中将衔被停职。
description.en: Was suspended from duty with the rank of Vice Admiral.

description.zh-cn: 担任驻义大利副武官时，向义大利民间船厂订购两艘SX-404级微型潜艇，开启了中华民国潜舰国造。
description.en: While serving as Deputy Military Attaché in Italy, he ordered two SX-404 class midget submarines from an Italian civilian shipyard, initiating the ROC's indigenous submarine program.

description.zh-cn: 担任驻美国副武官时，游说美国国会与政府，成功争取美国向中华民国海军出售两艘海狮级潜艇。
description.en: While serving as Deputy Military Attaché in the United States, he lobbied the U.S. Congress and government, successfully securing the sale of two Hai Shih-class submarines to the ROC Navy.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋经国执政期间担任情报首长，并听从其指示。
description.en: Served as the intelligence chief during Chiang Ching-kuo's administration and followed his instructions.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国是宋美龄的继子，在与宋美龄的函电中自称“儿”。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo was Soong Mei-ling's stepson and referred to himself as 'son' in his correspondence with her.

description.zh-cn: 作为情报局副处长，向局长汪希苓提交“锄奸计划”签呈。
description.en: As the deputy director of a department in the Intelligence Bureau, he submitted the 'Eliminate Traitors Plan' to Director Wang Hsi-ling.

description.zh-cn: 接受汪希苓的命令，前往美国执行暗杀刘宜良的任务。
description.en: Accepted orders from Wang Hsi-ling to go to the United States to carry out the assassination of Henry Liu.

description.zh-cn: 在江南案爆发后下令将陈虎门停职。
description.en: After the Henry Liu case broke out, he ordered Chen Hu-men to be suspended.

description.zh-cn: 在汪希苓被停职后，汪敬煦奉命兼代情报局局长职务。
description.en: After Wang Hsi-ling was suspended, Wang Ching-hsu was ordered to serve as the acting Director of the Intelligence Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 在斯皮罗·阿格纽辞职后，杰拉尔德·福特被尼克松提名为副总统。
description.en: Gerald Ford was nominated by Nixon to be Vice President after Spiro Agnew's resignation.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松在第二次世界大战期间于美国海军服役。
description.en: Nixon served in the U.S. Navy during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 作为众议院非美活动委员会成员，尼克松在调查阿尔杰·希斯间谍案中发挥了关键作用，最终导致希斯因伪证罪被定罪。
description.en: As a member of the House Un-American Activities Committee, Nixon played a key role in the investigation of the Alger Hiss spy case, which led to Hiss's conviction for perjury.

description.zh-cn: 在1960年美国总统选举中，尼克松以微弱劣势败给肯尼迪。
description.en: Nixon was narrowly defeated by Kennedy in the 1960 United States presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松于1972年对中华人民共和国进行历史性访问，开启了两国外交关系正常化的新篇章。
description.en: Nixon made a historic visit to the People's Republic of China in 1972, opening a new chapter in the normalization of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松实施“越南化”政策，逐步撤出美国军队，并最终在1973年签署《巴黎和平协约》，结束了美国的直接军事介入。
description.en: Nixon implemented the policy of "Vietnamization" to gradually withdraw U.S. troops and ultimately signed the Paris Peace Accords in 1973, ending direct U.S. military involvement.

description.zh-cn: 在1972年莫斯科峰会期间，尼克松与苏联领导人勃列日涅夫签署了《反弹道导弹条约》。
description.en: During the 1972 Moscow Summit, Nixon signed the Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty with Soviet leader Leonid Brezhnev.

description.zh-cn: 在1973年赎罪日战争期间，尼克松下令对以色列进行大规模空运军事援助，行动代号“五分钱救援行动”，这对于扭转战局至关重要。
description.en: During the 1973 Yom Kippur War, Nixon ordered a massive military airlift to Israel, codenamed Operation Nickel Grass, which was crucial in turning the tide of the war.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松总统于1970年宣布组建美国国家环境保护局。
description.en: President Nixon announced the formation of the Environmental Protection Agency in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 作为《华盛顿邮报》的记者，与鲍勃·伍德沃德的调查性报道揭露了水门事件，最终导致尼克松辞职。
description.en: As a Washington Post reporter, his investigative reporting with Bob Woodward uncovered the Watergate scandal, which ultimately led to Nixon's resignation.

description.zh-cn: 作为《华盛顿邮报》的记者，与卡尔·伯恩斯坦的调查性报道揭露了水门事件，最终导致尼克松辞职。
description.en: As a Washington Post reporter, his investigative reporting with Carl Bernstein uncovered the Watergate scandal, which ultimately led to Nixon's resignation.

description.zh-cn: 作为联邦调查局副局长，马克·费尔特是被称为“深喉”的线人，他向记者泄露了有关水门事件的关键信息。
description.en: As Associate Director of the FBI, Mark Felt was the informant known as "Deep Throat" who leaked critical information about the Watergate scandal to journalists.

description.zh-cn: 福特总统宣布给予尼克松“全面、自由且绝对的赦免”，使其免受因水门事件而可能面临的任何刑事起诉。
description.en: President Ford granted Nixon a "full, free, and absolute pardon," protecting him from any criminal prosecution for his actions in the Watergate scandal.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，尼克松应卡特总统邀请，在白宫参加接待时任中国国务院副总理邓小平的国宴，并与其私下会晤。
description.en: In 1979, at President Carter's invitation, Nixon attended a state dinner at the White House for visiting Chinese Vice Premier Deng Xiaoping and held a private meeting with him.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案删除了宪法中关于中华人民共和国主席“连续任职不得超过两届”的规定，取消了任期限制。
description.en: The amendment removed the provision in the constitution that the President of the People's Republic of China 'shall serve no more than two consecutive terms', thereby abolishing term limits for the office.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案将“习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想”写入宪法序言，确立了其国家指导思想的地位。
description.en: The amendment added 'Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era' to the preamble of the constitution, establishing its status as a national guiding ideology.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案在宪法中增设“监察委员会”一节，为设立国家监察委员会提供了宪法依据。
description.en: The amendment added a new section on 'Supervisory Commissions' to the constitution, providing the constitutional basis for the establishment of the National Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在宪法修正案提出后，安徽前检察官沈良庆因在社交媒体上批评取消任期限制的决定而遭到短暂拘留。
description.en: After the constitutional amendment was proposed, former Anhui prosecutor Shen Liangqing was briefly detained for criticizing the decision to remove term limits on social media.

description.zh-cn: 美国时任总统唐纳德·特朗普对习近平通过修宪巩固权力表示支持，称习近平为“终身主席”并表示“他很棒”。
description.en: Then-U.S. President Donald Trump expressed support for Xi Jinping's consolidation of power through the constitutional amendment, calling him 'president for life' and saying 'he's great'.

description.zh-cn: 马云是蚂蚁集团的创始人。
description.en: Ma Yun is the founder of Ant Group.

description.zh-cn: 蚂蚁集团起步于第三方支付平台“支付宝”。
description.en: Ant Group originated from the third-party payment platform 'Alipay'.

relationships.target: BAIDU:蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 支付宝是蚂蚁集团旗下的第三方支付平台。
description.en: Alipay is a third-party payment platform under Ant Group.

description.zh-cn: 2003年10月，淘宝网首次推出名为“支付宝”的担保交易服务。
description.en: In October 2003, Taobao first launched a guaranteed transaction service called 'Alipay'.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民银行联合其他金融管理部门对蚂蚁集团进行了多次监管约谈，并督促其进行整改。
description.en: The People's Bank of China, along with other financial regulatory authorities, conducted multiple regulatory talks with Ant Group and urged it to carry out rectification.

description.zh-cn: 中国银保监会联合其他金融管理部门对蚂蚁集团进行了多次监管约谈，并督促其进行整改。
description.en: The China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, along with other financial regulatory authorities, conducted multiple regulatory talks with Ant Group and urged it to carry out rectification.

description.en: The China Securities Regulatory Commission, along with other financial regulatory authorities, conducted multiple regulatory talks and rectification with Ant Group, and imposed a fine of 7.123 billion RMB on it on July 7, 2023.

relationships.target: BAIDU:蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局联合其他金融管理部门对蚂蚁集团进行了多次监管约谈，并督促其进行整改。
description.en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange, along with other financial regulatory authorities, conducted multiple regulatory talks with Ant Group and urged it to carry out rectification.

description.zh-cn: 江志成是江泽民的孙子。
description.en: Jiang Zhicheng is the grandson of Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 李伯潭是贾庆林的女婿。
description.en: Li Botan is the son-in-law of Jia Qinglin.

relationships.source: BAIDU:蚂蚁科技集团股份有限公司

description.zh-cn: 通过调整股东上层结构，蚂蚁集团宣布不再存在任何直接或间接股东单一或共同控制公司的情形，马云因此失去了对公司的实际控制权，投票权降至6.2%。
description.en: By adjusting its upper-level shareholder structure, Ant Group announced that no single or joint direct or indirect shareholder controls the company, resulting in Jack Ma losing actual control and his voting rights being reduced to 6.2%.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党在政策上淡化了民族自决观念，转而提倡民族区域自治。
description.en: The Chinese Communist Party de-emphasized the concept of national self-determination in its policy, promoting regional ethnic autonomy instead.

description.zh-cn: 为确定民族区域自治制度，毛泽东曾咨询主管民族工作的李维汉。
description.en: To establish the system of regional ethnic autonomy, Mao Zedong consulted with Li Weihan, who was in charge of ethnic affairs.

description.zh-cn: 《共同纲领》规定“各少数民族聚居的地区，应实行民族的区域自治”。
description.en: The 'Common Program' stipulated that 'in areas where ethnic minorities are concentrated, regional autonomy for the ethnic groups shall be implemented'.

description.zh-cn: 奥兰自治区是自1920年起在国际联盟的决议下成立的。
description.en: The autonomous region of Åland was established in 1920 under a resolution of the League of Nations.

description.zh-cn: 奥兰是芬兰的一个自治区。
description.en: Åland is an autonomous region of Finland.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政以战争威胁韩国，迫使韩王安派遣韩非出使秦国。
description.en: King Zheng of Qin used the threat of war against the state of Han to compel King An of Han to send Han Fei as an envoy to Qin.

description.zh-cn: 在派遣韩非出使秦国之前，韩王安一直不采纳韩非的政治主张。
description.en: Prior to dispatching Han Fei to Qin, King An of Han consistently did not adopt Han Fei's political proposals.

description.zh-cn: 韩非是韩国的宗室公子。
description.en: Han Fei was a prince of the royal clan of the state of Han.

description.zh-cn: 韩非反对儒家建构在私人情感联系上的治国理念，主张将人的自利本性作为社会秩序建立的前提。
description.en: Han Fei opposed the Confucian idea of governance based on personal emotional connections, arguing that the establishment of social order should be premised on human nature's self-interest.

description.zh-cn: 刘婴被王莽立为汉平帝的嗣君，接替其皇位。
description.en: Liu Ying was installed by Wang Mang as the heir to Emperor Ping, thus succeeding him to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 为便于掌控朝局，王莽在汉宣帝的玄孙中选择并拥立了年仅周岁的刘婴为皇太子，号“孺子”。
description.en: To facilitate his control over the court, Wang Mang selected and installed the one-year-old Liu Ying, a great-great-grandson of Emperor Xuan, as the Crown Prince with the title 'Ruzi'.

description.zh-cn: 以皇太子身份作为名义上的西汉君主。
description.en: Served as the nominal monarch of the Western Han dynasty with the title of Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 平陵人方望等人认为更始帝必败，而刘婴才是天子正统，便起兵将刘婴迎至临泾，拥立为天子。
description.en: Fang Wang and others from Pingling believed that the Gengshi Emperor was doomed to fail and that Liu Ying was the legitimate Son of Heaven, so they raised troops, welcomed Liu Ying to Linjing, and installed him as emperor.

description.zh-cn: 更始帝派遣丞相李松进攻临泾，最终杀害了被方望等人拥立为天子的刘婴。
description.en: The Gengshi Emperor dispatched Chancellor Li Song to attack Linjing, ultimately killing Liu Ying, who had been installed as emperor by Fang Wang and others.

description.zh-cn: 李达考入冯玉祥创办的西北军第二军官学校，并在其部队国民革命军第2集团军任职。
description.en: Li Da enrolled in the Northwest Military Second Officer School founded by Feng Yuxiang and served in his National Revolutionary Army 2nd Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 在红六军团期间，李达担任参谋长，随军团长萧克西征。
description.en: During his time in the Red Sixth Army Group, Li Da served as Chief of Staff, following Commander Xiao Ke on the western expedition.

description.zh-cn: 在红六军团期间，李达担任参谋长，随政委任弼时西征。
description.en: During his time in the Red Sixth Army Group, Li Da served as Chief of Staff, following Political Commissar Ren Bishi on the western expedition.

description.zh-cn: 李达调任红二军团参谋长，协助军团长贺龙指挥部队。
description.en: Li Da was transferred to be the Chief of Staff of the Red Second Army Group, assisting Commander He Long in commanding the troops.

description.zh-cn: 李达参与了长征。
description.en: Li Da participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后任129师参谋处长，1938年12月任师参谋长。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, he served as the Chief of the Operations Department of the 129th Division, and became the Chief of Staff of the division in December 1938.

description.zh-cn: 长期担任刘伯承的参谋长，在129师、晋冀鲁豫野战军、中原野战军、第二野战军等部队中协助其指挥作战。
description.en: Served as Liu Bocheng's chief of staff for a long time, assisting him in command in units such as the 129th Division, the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army, the Central Plains Field Army, and the Second Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 在129师、晋冀鲁豫野战军、中原野战军、第二野战军等部队中，作为参谋长协助政委邓小平。
description.en: As chief of staff, he assisted Political Commissar Deng Xiaoping in units such as the 129th Division, the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army, the Central Plains Field Army, and the Second Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 1938年1月，李达与邓小平、刘伯承、蔡树藩等129师领导人合影。
description.en: In January 1938, Li Da took a group photo with other leaders of the 129th Division, including Deng Xiaoping, Liu Bocheng, and Cai Shufan.

description.zh-cn: 作为129师参谋长，李达协助指挥了百团大战。
description.en: As Chief of Staff of the 129th Division, Li Da assisted in commanding the Hundred Regiments Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 在邯郸战役期间，李达参与促成高树勋率部易帜。
description.en: During the Handan Campaign, Li Da participated in persuading Gao Shuxun to lead his troops to switch allegiance.

description.zh-cn: 作为中原野战军参谋长，李达参与指挥了淮海战役。
description.en: As Chief of Staff of the Central Plains Field Army, Li Da participated in commanding the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 李达于1953年参加抗美援朝战争。
description.en: Li Da participated in the Korean War in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 李达在文化大革命中遭受迫害。
description.en: Li Da was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 为了避免混淆，人们称他们为“文李达”和“武李达”，两人也因此结下友谊。
description.en: To avoid confusion, people called them 'Civil Li Da' and 'Military Li Da', and the two became friends as a result.

description.zh-cn: 张阳担任新组建的中央军事委员会政治工作部首任主任。
description.en: Zhang Yang served as the first director of the newly established Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张阳担任中国人民解放军总政治部主任。
description.en: Zhang Yang served as the Director of the General Political Department of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 张阳曾任中国人民解放军广州军区政治委员。
description.en: Zhang Yang served as the Political Commissar of the Guangzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 张阳曾任中国人民解放军陆军第四十二集团军政治委员。
description.en: Zhang Yang served as the Political Commissar of the 42nd Group Army of the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 张阳曾任中国共产党和中华人民共和国中央军事委员会委员。
description.en: Zhang Yang served as a member of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of China and the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张阳于1969年5月加入中国共产党，2018年10月16日被开除党籍。
description.en: Zhang Yang joined the Communist Party of China in May 1969 and was expelled from the party on October 16, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 张阳于1991年10月进入中国人民解放军国防大学基本系学习，为期一年。
description.en: In October 1991, Zhang Yang began a one-year course of study in the Basic Department of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 张阳于1996年毕业于中共中央党校行政管理专业。
description.en: Zhang Yang graduated from the Central Party School with a major in Public Administration in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 张阳出生于河北省武强县。
description.en: Zhang Yang was born in Wuqiang County, Hebei Province.

description.zh-cn: 张阳因涉及徐才厚等案问题线索而被中央军委调查，最终导致其自杀身亡。
description.en: Zhang Yang was investigated by the Central Military Commission for his involvement in cases related to Xu Caihou, which ultimately led to his suicide.

description.zh-cn: 两人同为中央军委委员，于2017年8月几乎同时接受组织调查并从公众视线中消失。
description.en: Both were members of the Central Military Commission and disappeared from public view around the same time in August 2017 after being placed under investigation.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央批准对张阳进行组织谈话并调查，最终于2018年10月16日决定开除其党籍。
description.en: The Central Committee of the CPC approved the investigation into Zhang Yang, and ultimately decided to expel him from the party on October 16, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委决定对张阳进行组织谈话、调查核实其问题线索，并最终开除其军籍、取消其上将军衔。
description.en: The Central Military Commission decided to investigate Zhang Yang, which led to his expulsion from the military and the revocation of his general rank.

description.zh-cn: 王稼祥于1925年10月赴苏联，进入莫斯科中山大学学习。
description.en: In October 1925, Wang Jiaxiang went to the Soviet Union to study at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University.

description.zh-cn: 1951年1月，王稼祥负责组建中共中央对外联络部并出任首任部长。
description.en: In January 1951, Wang Jiaxiang was responsible for establishing the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee and became its first minister.

description.zh-cn: 王稼祥担任中共中央对外联络部部长。
description.en: Wang Jiaxiang served as the Minister of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王稼祥担任中华人民共和国第一任驻苏联大使。
description.en: Wang Jiaxiang served as the first ambassador of the People's Republic of China to the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 王稼祥在1932年宁都会议上支持毛泽东，此后在长征途中与毛泽东、张闻天结成同盟，并在遵义会议等关键时刻坚定支持毛泽东。两人的密切关系直到1962年因“三和一少”问题而破裂。
description.en: Wang Jiaxiang supported Mao Zedong at the Ningdu Conference in 1932. Later, during the Long March, he formed an alliance with Mao Zedong and Zhang Wentian, and firmly supported Mao at critical moments such as the Zunyi Conference. Their close relationship lasted until 1962 when it broke down over the 'Three Reconciliations and One Reduction' issue.

description.zh-cn: 在长征途中及遵义会议上，王稼祥与毛泽东、张闻天等人一同反对并抨击李德的军事指挥错误。
description.en: During the Long March and at the Zunyi Conference, Wang Jiaxiang, along with Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, and others, opposed and criticized Otto Braun's military command errors.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，王稼祥因早前提出的“三和一少”路线而被打倒，遭到康生等人长期批斗和审查，身心受到严重摧残。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Wang Jiaxiang was overthrown due to his earlier proposal of the 'Three Reconciliations and One Reduction' line. He was subjected to long-term denunciation and investigation by Kang Sheng and others, suffering severe physical and mental torment.

description.zh-cn: 王稼祥等人提出的“三和一少”外交路线建议遭到毛泽东批评，并成为他在文化大革命中受到迫害的主要罪名。
description.en: The 'Three Reconciliations and One Reduction' foreign policy proposal put forward by Wang Jiaxiang and others was criticized by Mao Zedong and became the main charge for his persecution during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东点名批评了王稼祥等人提出的“三和一少”对外援助建议。
description.en: Mao Zedong personally criticized the 'Three Reconciliations and One Reduction' foreign aid proposal put forward by Wang Jiaxiang and others.

description.zh-cn: 康生在文化大革命初期到中联部煽动批斗，喊出“打倒刘邓王”的口号，并升级批判王稼祥的“三和一少”为“三降一灭”，是迫害王稼祥的主要人物之一。
description.en: In the early stages of the Cultural Revolution, Kang Sheng went to the International Liaison Department to incite struggle sessions, shouting the slogan 'Down with Liu, Deng, and Wang.' He escalated the criticism of Wang Jiaxiang's 'Three Reconciliations and One Reduction' to 'Three Surrenders and One Extinction,' and was one of the main figures in Wang Jiaxiang's persecution.

description.zh-cn: 朱仲丽是王稼祥的第三任妻子。
description.en: Zhu Zhongli was Wang Jiaxiang's third wife.

description.zh-cn: 江青是批林批孔运动的主要发动者和领导者之一。
description.en: Jiang Qing was one of the main initiators and leaders of the Criticize Lin, Criticize Confucius campaign.

description.zh-cn: 2008年10月28日，十一届全国人大常委会第五次会议决定接受朱志刚辞去第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员职务的请求。
description.en: On October 28, 2008, the 5th session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress decided to accept Zhu Zhigang's resignation from his position as a member of the Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2009年12月26日，十一届全国人大常委会第十二次会议决定接受李东生辞去第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员职务的请求。
description.en: On December 26, 2009, the 12th session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress decided to accept Li Dongsheng's resignation from his position as a member of the Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2011年4月22日，第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十次会议免去其副秘书长职务。
description.en: On April 22, 2011, the 20th session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress removed him from the post of Deputy Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 2011年4月22日，第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十次会议免去其副秘书长职务。
description.en: On April 22, 2011, the 20th session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress removed him from the post of Deputy Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 2008年12月27日，第十一届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第六次会议免去其副秘书长职务。
description.en: On December 27, 2008, the 6th session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress removed him from the post of Deputy Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 四一二政变后，宋时轮因共产党嫌疑被捕入狱。
description.en: After the Shanghai massacre of 1927, Song Shilun was arrested and imprisoned on suspicion of being a Communist.

description.zh-cn: 宋时轮指挥的八路军第4纵队挺进冀东，配合并促成了冀东大暴动。
description.en: The 4th Column of the Eighth Route Army, commanded by Song Shilun, advanced into East Hebei, coordinating with and helping to bring about the East Hebei Insurrection.

description.zh-cn: 在淮海战役中，宋时轮参与指挥部队阻击国民党军对黄百韬兵团的增援，保障了围歼行动的胜利。
description.en: During the Huaihai Campaign, Song Shilun participated in commanding troops to block KMT reinforcements for Huang Baitao's army group, ensuring the victory of the encirclement and annihilation operation.

description.zh-cn: 宋时轮在朝鲜战争中指挥中国人民志愿军第九兵团参与长津湖战役。
description.en: During the Korean War, Song Shilun commanded the 9th Army Group of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army in the Battle of Chosin Reservoir.

description.zh-cn: 在长津湖战役中，宋时轮指挥的第九兵团与美国海军陆战队第1师等部队交战。
description.en: In the Battle of Chosin Reservoir, the 9th Army Group commanded by Song Shilun engaged in combat with the US 1st Marine Division and other units.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年军委扩大会议上，彭德怀批判了宋时轮。
description.en: At the 1958 enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission, Peng Dehuai criticized Song Shilun.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，宋时轮被造反派批判为“三反分子”。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Song Shilun was criticized by rebels as a "three-anti element".

position.zh-cn: 军事调处执行部中共方面执行处处长
position.en: Chief of the CPC Section of the Beiping Executive Headquarters

description.zh-cn: 在北平军事调处执行部，宋时轮协助中共代表叶剑英进行谈判。
description.en: At the Beiping Executive Headquarters, Song Shilun assisted CPC representative Ye Jianying in negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 1985年11月，郑文瀚接替宋时轮担任中国人民解放军军事科学院院长。
description.en: In November 1985, Zheng Wenhan succeeded Song Shilun as the President of the PLA Academy of Military Science.

position.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军副司令员
position.en: Deputy Commander of the People's Volunteer Army

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争期间，宋时轮担任中国人民志愿军副司令员，在司令员彭德怀领导下作战。
description.en: During the Korean War, Song Shilun served as the Deputy Commander of the People's Volunteer Army, fighting under the command of Commander Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 托马斯·R·马歇尔在威尔逊的两个总统任期内担任副总统。
description.en: Thomas R. Marshall served as Vice President during both of Wilson's presidential terms.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊总统支持并通过了《联邦储备法案》，建立了美国的中央银行系统。
description.en: President Wilson supported and passed the Federal Reserve Act, establishing the central banking system of the United States.

description.zh-cn: 《联邦储备法案》的通过直接促成了联邦储备系统的建立。
description.en: The passage of the Federal Reserve Act directly led to the establishment of the Federal Reserve System.

description.zh-cn: 威尔逊总统建立了联邦贸易委员会，以阻止不公平的交易行为并鼓励竞争。
description.en: President Wilson established the Federal Trade Commission to prevent unfair business practices and encourage competition.

description.zh-cn: 德国发动的无限制潜艇战以及发送旨在拉拢墨西哥的“齐默尔曼电报”，促使威尔逊总统请求国会对德宣战。
description.en: Germany's unrestricted submarine warfare and the "Zimmermann Telegram" aimed at recruiting Mexico as an ally prompted President Wilson to ask Congress to declare war.

description.zh-cn: 伍德罗·威尔逊于1917年4月向国会发表演说，成功说服国会对德宣战，使美国加入第一次世界大战。
description.en: Woodrow Wilson delivered a speech to Congress in April 1917, successfully persuading it to declare war on Germany and leading the United States into World War I.

description.zh-cn: “十四点和平原则”的第十四点明确提出建立一个国际联合机构，直接推动了国际联盟的创建。
description.en: The fourteenth point of the "Fourteen Points" explicitly called for the formation of an association of nations, directly pushing for the creation of the League of Nations.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩在威尔逊的第一任期内担任国务卿，后因在战争问题上与总统意见不合而辞职。
description.en: William Jennings Bryan served as Secretary of State during Wilson's first term, but resigned due to disagreements with the president over policy regarding the war.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于中国人民大学新闻系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Journalism, Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾任新华通讯社党组成员、副社长。
description.en: Formerly served as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Deputy Director of Xinhua News Agency.

description.zh-cn: 赵承接替王纲担任中国共产党浙江省委员会宣传部部长。
description.en: Zhao Cheng succeeded Wang Gang as Minister of the Propaganda Department of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 赵承接替张宿堂担任新华通讯社国内新闻编辑部主任。
description.en: Zhao Cheng succeeded Zhang Sutang as Director of the Domestic News Department of Xinhua News Agency.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民大学新闻学院是中国人民大学下属的学院。
description.en: The School of Journalism of Renmin University of China is a school under Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗于1100年至1126年间担任北宋皇帝。
description.en: Emperor Huizong reigned as the emperor of the Northern Song dynasty from 1100 to 1126.

description.zh-cn: 在金兵压境的危机下，宋徽宗禅位于其子钦宗。
description.en: Under the crisis of the impending Jin invasion, Emperor Huizong abdicated the throne to his son, Qinzong.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗禅位后，被其子宋钦宗软禁于龙德宫，并受到不敬对待。
description.en: After his abdication, Emperor Huizong was placed under house arrest in Longde Palace by his son, Emperor Qinzong, and was treated with disrespect.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗在位期间，重用蔡京为丞相。
description.en: During his reign, Emperor Huizong appointed and heavily relied on Cai Jing as his chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗在位期间，重用宦官童贯为将军。
description.en: During his reign, Emperor Huizong appointed and heavily relied on the eunuch Tong Guan as a general.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京与童贯等人的贪腐和滥权导致宋徽宗朝政治黑暗，民怨沸腾，激起了多次民变，严重削弱了北宋的国力。
description.en: The corruption and abuse of power by Cai Jing, Tong Guan, and others led to a politically dark era under Emperor Huizong, causing widespread public discontent and triggering multiple rebellions, which severely weakened the Northern Song state.

description.zh-cn: 蔡京与童贯等人的贪腐和滥权导致宋徽宗朝政治黑暗，民怨沸腾，激起了多次民变，严重削弱了北宋的国力。
description.en: The corruption and abuse of power by Cai Jing, Tong Guan, and others led to a politically dark era under Emperor Huizong, causing widespread public discontent and triggering multiple rebellions, which severely weakened the Northern Song state.

description.zh-cn: 宋江起义是宋徽宗统治时期爆发的多次民变之一，反映了当时严重的社会矛盾。
description.en: The Song Jiang rebellion was one of several popular uprisings during Emperor Huizong's reign, reflecting severe social conflicts at the time.

description.zh-cn: 金太宗于1125年十月派遣完颜杲、完颜宗望、完颜宗翰等人分两路南下入侵北宋，发动了靖康之变。
description.en: In October 1125, Emperor Taizong of Jin dispatched forces under commanders like Wanyan Gao, Wanyan Zongwang, and Wanyan Zonghan in a two-pronged invasion of the Northern Song, initiating the Jingkang Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在靖康之变中，宋徽宗被金军俘虏北上，并被金太宗下诏废为庶人。
description.en: During the Jingkang Incident, Emperor Huizong was captured by Jin forces and taken north. Emperor Taizong of Jin later issued an edict demoting him to a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗自创了“瘦金书”这一独特的书法字体。
description.en: Emperor Huizong personally created the unique calligraphy style known as 'Slender Gold'.

description.zh-cn: 绍兴和议的条款之一是送还被俘的宋高宗生母韦贤妃（显仁皇后）。
description.en: One of the terms of the Treaty of Shaoxing was the return of the captive mother of Emperor Gaozong, Consort Wei (Empress Xianren).

description.zh-cn: 国家安全会议是中华民国总统的直属机关。
description.en: The National Security Council is a direct subordinate agency to the President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家安全局是国家安全会议的附属机关。
description.en: The National Security Bureau is an affiliated agency of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 动员戡乱时期国家安全会议是现行国家安全会议的前身。
description.en: The National Security Council during the Period of Mobilization was the predecessor of the current National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 依据《动员戡乱时期临时条款》授权，总统蒋中正下令成立动员戡乱时期国家安全会议。
description.en: Authorized by the 'Temporary Provisions against the Communist Rebellion', President Chiang Kai-shek ordered the establishment of the National Security Council during the Period of Mobilization.

description.zh-cn: 1991年制定的《中华民国宪法增修条文》规定总统得设国家安全会议，为其法源依据之一。
description.en: The 'Additional Articles of the Constitution of the Republic of China' enacted in 1991 stipulated that the President may establish a National Security Council, providing one of its legal bases.

description.zh-cn: 第三国际（共产国际）是由苏联共产党主导的国际组织。
description.en: The Third International (Comintern) was an international organization dominated by the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，共产国际代表吴廷康（维经斯基）在北京与李大钊会面，商讨在中国组建共产党事宜。
description.en: In 1920, Comintern representative Grigori Voitinsky (Wu Tingkang) met with Li Dazhao in Beijing to discuss the formation of a communist party in China.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，共产国际代表吴廷康（维经斯基）在上海与陈独秀会面，共同商讨建党问题。
description.en: In 1920, Comintern representative Grigori Voitinsky (Wu Tingkang) met with Chen Duxiu in Shanghai to discuss the issue of party building.

description.zh-cn: 共产国际代表马林在与孙中山会谈后，向中共提议应与国民党合作，并得到共产国际的全力支持。
description.en: Comintern representative Maring, after talks with Sun Yat-sen, proposed to the CPC that it should cooperate with the Kuomintang, a proposal that received the full support of the Comintern.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山与苏联代表越飞发表《孙越宣言》，开始实行“联俄容共”策略，为第一次国共合作奠定了基础。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen and Soviet representative Adolph Joffe issued the Sun-Joffe Manifesto, beginning the implementation of the "Alliance with Russia, Acceptance of Communists" policy, which laid the foundation for the First United Front.

description.zh-cn: 1927年7月15日，汪精卫在武汉宣布停止与中国共产党的合作，标志着第一次国共合作全面破裂。
description.en: On July 15, 1927, Wang Jingwei announced the cessation of cooperation with the Communist Party of China in Wuhan, marking the complete rupture of the First United Front.

description.zh-cn: 1931年11月7日，中国共产党在苏联支援下于江西瑞金成立中华苏维埃共和国。
description.en: On November 7, 1931, the Communist Party of China, with the support of the Soviet Union, established the Chinese Soviet Republic in Ruijin, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 作为维也纳警察局局长，Johannes Schober发起了1923年的国际刑事警察大会，促成了国际刑事警察委员会（国际刑警组织的前身）的成立。
description.en: As the head of the Vienna police, Johannes Schober initiated the 1923 International Criminal Police Congress, which led to the founding of the International Criminal Police Commission, the predecessor to Interpol.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，国际刑警组织的运作几乎完全停滞，直到战争结束后才得以恢复。
description.en: During World War II, Interpol's operations became almost completely stagnant and were only restored after the war ended.

description.zh-cn: 孟宏伟在2016年当选为国际刑警组织主席，但在2018年因在中国被捕而辞职。
description.en: Meng Hongwei was elected President of Interpol in 2016, but resigned in 2018 following his arrest in China.

description.zh-cn: 时任国际刑警组织主席的孟宏伟在中国的一次行程中失踪，后被证实因涉嫌受贿而被中国当局逮捕。
description.en: Meng Hongwei, then President of Interpol, disappeared during a trip to China and was later confirmed to have been arrested by Chinese authorities on suspicion of bribery.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国于1984年申请并于1986年正式加入国际刑警组织。
description.en: The People's Republic of China applied in 1984 and officially joined Interpol in 1986.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国的加入取代了中华民国在国际刑警组织的席位。
description.en: The entry of the People's Republic of China replaced the seat of the Republic of China in Interpol.

description.zh-cn: 国际刑警组织《章程》第2条规定，该组织必须本着《世界人权宣言》的精神，确保并促进各刑事警察当局之间最广泛的相互协助。
description.en: Article 2 of Interpol's Constitution stipulates that the organization must ensure and promote the widest possible mutual assistance between all criminal police authorities, in the spirit of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

description.zh-cn: 应俄罗斯当局的要求，国际刑警组织对乌克兰民族主义领导人德米特罗·亚罗什发布了国际通缉令。
description.en: At the request of Russian authorities, Interpol issued an international wanted notice for Ukrainian nationalist leader Dmytro Yarosh.

description.zh-cn: 被指控通过提供巨额捐款来影响国际刑警组织，并成功使其内政部监察长艾哈迈德·纳赛尔·莱西当选为组织主席，引发了对其公正性的担忧。
description.en: Accused of influencing Interpol by providing large donations and successfully getting its Ministry of Interior Inspector General, Ahmed Naser Al-Raisi, elected as the organization's president, raising concerns about its impartiality.

description.zh-cn: 被指控将国际刑警组织的机制武器化，利用逮捕令和吊销护照等手段来骚扰和追捕合法的批评者、反对派人士和记者。
description.en: Accused of weaponizing Interpol's mechanisms, using arrest warrants and passport revocations to harass and pursue legitimate critics, opposition figures, and journalists.

description.zh-cn: 崖门海战是宋元战争的最后一场战役，标志着战争的结束。
description.en: The Battle of Yamen was the final battle of the Song-Yuan Wars, marking the end of the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 崖门海战的胜利使元朝彻底消灭了南宋的抵抗力量，完成了对中国的统一。
description.en: The victory in the Battle of Yamen allowed the Yuan dynasty to completely eliminate the Southern Song's resistance forces and complete the unification of China.

description.zh-cn: 张弘范在崖门海战中担任元军指挥官。
description.en: Zhang Hongfan served as the commander of the Yuan forces during the Battle of Yamen.

description.zh-cn: 李恒在崖门海战中率领元军加入战事。
description.en: Li Heng led Yuan troops to join the battle during the Battle of Yamen.

description.zh-cn: 张世杰在崖门海战中担任南宋军队的指挥官。
description.en: Zhang Shijie served as the commander of the Southern Song forces during the Battle of Yamen.

description.zh-cn: 蒲寿庚拒绝借船给张世杰率领的南宋行朝，导致行朝只能离开泉州。
description.en: Pu Shougeng refused to lend ships to the fleeing Southern Song court led by Zhang Shijie, forcing them to leave Quanzhou.

description.zh-cn: 在拒绝南宋行朝后，蒲寿庚投降元朝。
description.en: After refusing the Southern Song court, Pu Shougeng surrendered to the Yuan dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 襄樊之战的胜利为元军南下灭宋扫清了障碍。
description.en: The victory in the Battle of Xiangyang cleared the way for the Yuan army to advance south and conquer the Song dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 经济史学家的普遍看法是，大萧条以第二次世界大战的爆发而终结，战争相关的政府支出刺激了经济复苏。
description.en: The consensus among economic historians is that the Great Depression ended with the outbreak of World War II, as government spending related to the war stimulated economic recovery.

description.zh-cn: 大萧条对德国威玛共和国造成了毁灭性打击，失业率飙升，社会动荡，为纳粹党等极端主义势力崛起并最终上台创造了条件。
description.en: The Great Depression dealt a devastating blow to Germany's Weimar Republic, causing soaring unemployment and social unrest, which created the conditions for extremist forces like the Nazi Party to rise and eventually take power.

description.zh-cn: 阿道夫·希特勒是纳粹党的领袖。
description.en: Adolf Hitler was the leader of the Nazi Party.

description.zh-cn: 大萧条发生在其总统任内，由于他未能有效应对危机，其政治声望受到严重打击，并导致了民众的广泛不满。
description.en: The Great Depression began during his presidency, and his failure to effectively address the crisis severely damaged his political reputation and led to widespread public discontent.

description.zh-cn: 大萧条的发生及其对传统经济理论的挑战，催生了以政府干预为核心的凯恩斯主义经济学。
description.en: The occurrence of the Great Depression and its challenge to classical economic theories spurred the development of Keynesian economics, which centers on government intervention.

description.zh-cn: 对大萧条成因的分析和辩论，特别是对货币政策作用的重新审视，是货币主义理论发展的重要背景。
description.en: The analysis and debate over the causes of the Great Depression, especially the re-examination of the role of monetary policy, formed an important backdrop for the development of monetarist theory.

description.zh-cn: 高桥是清曾担任日本的大藏大臣（财政部长）。
description.en: Takahashi Korekiyo served as Japan's Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩被尊为将禅宗由印度传入中国的第一位祖师。
description.en: Bodhidharma is revered as the first patriarch who transmitted Zen from India to China.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩于刘宋时期抵达中国广州，开始传授禅法。
description.en: Bodhidharma arrived in Guangzhou, China, during the Liu Song dynasty and began teaching Zen.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩于东魏天平三年（536年）将禅法传授给慧可，慧可遂成为其弟子、继承人，并被尊为禅宗二祖。
description.en: In 536 (the third year of the Tianping era of the Eastern Wei), Bodhidharma transmitted the Zen Dharma to Huike, who became his disciple, successor, and is revered as the second patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 僧璨是慧可的弟子，被尊为禅宗三祖。
description.en: Sengcan was a disciple of Huike and is revered as the third patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 道信是僧璨的弟子，被尊为禅宗四祖。
description.en: Daoxin was a disciple of Sengcan and is revered as the fourth patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 弘忍是道信的弟子，被尊为禅宗五祖。
description.en: Hongren was a disciple of Daoxin and is revered as the fifth patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 惠能是弘忍的弟子，被其密传衣钵，成为禅宗六祖。
description.en: Huineng was a disciple of Hongren, who secretly transmitted the robe and bowl to him, making him the sixth patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 神秀是弘忍的弟子，为当时的上座，后成为北宗的创始人。
description.en: Shenxiu was a disciple of Hongren and the head monk at the time. He later became the founder of the Northern School.

description.zh-cn: 惠能的南宗顿悟与神秀的北宗渐悟形成对立，史称“南能北秀”，相互分庭抗礼。
description.en: Huineng's Southern School of sudden enlightenment and Shenxiu's Northern School of gradual enlightenment formed opposing factions, historically known as 'Huineng of the South, Shenxiu of the North', standing as rivals.

description.zh-cn: 早期禅宗以《楞伽经》为印心经典，因此也被称为楞伽宗。
description.en: Early Zen used the Laṅkāvatāra Sūtra as its key scripture for mind-to-mind transmission, and was thus also known as the Laṅkā school.

description.zh-cn: 临济义玄创立了临济宗，为禅宗五家之一。
description.en: Linji Yixuan founded the Linji school, one of the Five Houses of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 洞山良价与弟子曹山本寂共同创立了曹洞宗，为禅宗五家之一。
description.en: Dongshan Liangjie and his disciple Caoshan Benji co-founded the Caodong school, one of the Five Houses of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 牛头法融开创了牛头宗。
description.en: Niutou Farong founded the Niutou school.

description.zh-cn: 大慧宗杲大力提倡话头禅，使其成为宋代以后禅宗的主流修行方法。
description.en: Dahui Zonggao strongly advocated for huatou chan, making it the mainstream Zen practice method after the Song Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 大慧宗杲批评宏智正觉的默照禅为“默照邪禅”，认为其只教人静坐，不求妙悟。
description.en: Dahui Zonggao criticized Hongzhi Zhengjue's mozhao chan as 'silent illumination heresy,' arguing that it only taught people to sit quietly without seeking profound enlightenment.

description.zh-cn: 宏智正觉倡导以静坐为主的默照禅。
description.en: Hongzhi Zhengjue advocated for mozhao chan, which is centered on seated meditation.

description.zh-cn: 在西藏的“顿渐之争”辩论中，莲花戒代表的渐修派战胜了摩诃衍代表的顿悟派。
description.en: In the 'Samye Debate' in Tibet, the gradualist school represented by Kamalaśīla defeated the sudden enlightenment school represented by Moheyan.

description.zh-cn: “顿渐之争”事件最终导致摩诃衍被判为败方，其顿悟法门在西藏被禁止。
description.en: The 'Samye Debate' event resulted in Moheyan being declared the loser, and his sudden enlightenment teachings were banned in Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 作为辩论的主持者，吐蕃赞普赤松德赞在“顿渐之争”后下令禁止修习摩诃衍所传的顿门法。
description.en: As the presider of the debate, Tibetan Emperor Trisong Detsen ordered the prohibition of the 'sudden' teachings transmitted by Moheyan after the 'Samye Debate'.

description.zh-cn: 鉴于清末民初佛教的衰微，虚云大师极力复兴禅宗，被誉为近代禅宗中兴之祖。
description.en: In view of the decline of Buddhism in the late Qing and early Republican era, Master Xuyun worked tirelessly to revive Zen and is honored as the patriarch of its modern revival.

description.zh-cn: 铃木大拙在20世纪初将禅宗思想传播到西方，极大地推动了禅宗在世界范围内的影响。
description.en: In the early 20th century, D. T. Suzuki spread Zen thought to the West, greatly promoting Zen's influence worldwide.

description.zh-cn: 团派是中国共产党内部的一个政治派别。
description.en: The Tuanpai is a political faction within the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 团派主要由有中国共产主义青年团（共青团）职务背景的官员组成，共青团是该派系成员的摇篮。
description.en: The Tuanpai is primarily composed of officials with work backgrounds in the Communist Youth League of China (CYLC), which serves as the cradle for the faction's members.

description.zh-cn: 令计划是团派的核心人物之一。
description.en: Ling Jihua is one of the core figures of the Tuanpai.

description.zh-cn: 2017年7月11日，王三运因涉嫌严重违纪落马。
description.en: On July 11, 2017, Wang Sanyun was purged for suspected serious violations of discipline.

description.zh-cn: 2019年5月9日，秦光荣投案自首，接受调查。
description.en: On May 9, 2019, Qin Guangrong turned himself in and was placed under investigation.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十大上，胡春华未能连任中央政治局委员，彻底失去隔代接班人地位。
description.en: At the 20th CCP National Congress, Hu Chunhua failed to be re-elected as a member of the Politburo, completely losing his status as a potential successor.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛在中共二十大闭幕会上被带离会场，这一事件被广泛视为团派政治影响力终结的象征。
description.en: Hu Jintao being escorted out of the closing session of the 20th CCP National Congress was widely seen as a symbol of the end of the Tuanpai's political influence.

description.zh-cn: 团派通过组织内部选拔推荐的形式，以取代及对抗在中国共产党党内长期存在的太子党世袭体系。
description.en: The Tuanpai, through a system of internal organizational selection and recommendation, aimed to replace and counter the long-standing hereditary system of the Princelings within the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 孝端显皇后王氏是明神宗的原配皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoduanxian, née Wang, was the primary consort and empress of the Wanli Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 孝靖皇后王氏是明神宗的妃嫔，生育了皇长子朱常洛（后来的明光宗）。
description.en: Empress Xiaojing, née Wang, was a consort of the Wanli Emperor and gave birth to the eldest prince, Zhu Changluo (later the Taichang Emperor).

description.zh-cn: 郑贵妃是明神宗的宠妃，生育了皇三子朱常洵。
description.en: Noble Consort Zheng was the favored consort of the Wanli Emperor and gave birth to the third prince, Zhu Changxun.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗朱翊钧于1572年登基，在位48年，是明朝在位时间最长的皇帝。
description.en: The Wanli Emperor, Zhu Yijun, ascended the throne in 1572 and reigned for 48 years, the longest reign of any Ming Dynasty emperor.

description.zh-cn: 播州之役是明朝为平定播州土司杨应龙的叛乱而发动的战争，最终杨应龙兵败自杀。
description.en: The Bozhou Campaign was a war launched by the Ming Dynasty to suppress the rebellion of the Bozhou tusi Yang Yinglong, which ended with Yang's defeat and suicide.

description.zh-cn: 宁夏之役是明朝为平定将领哱拜在宁夏发动的叛乱而进行的战争，最终叛乱被平息。
description.en: The Ningxia Campaign was a war conducted by the Ming Dynasty to suppress the rebellion launched by General Bobai in Ningxia, which was ultimately quelled.

description.zh-cn: 明朝应朝鲜请求出兵，成功抵抗了日本丰臣秀吉对朝鲜的侵略。
description.en: At the request of Joseon, the Ming Dynasty sent troops and successfully resisted the invasion of Korea by Japan under Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

description.zh-cn: 明朝出兵援助朝鲜，帮助其抵抗日本侵略，保全了国家。
description.en: The Ming Dynasty sent troops to aid Joseon, helping it resist the Japanese invasion and preserving the nation.

description.zh-cn: 丁仲礼自2018年3月17日起担任第十三届、第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会副委员长。
description.en: Ding Zhongli has served as the Vice Chairperson of the 13th and 14th Standing Committee of the National People's Congress since March 17, 2018.

description.zh-cn: 在栗战书担任第十三届全国人大常委会委员长期间，丁仲礼任副委员长。
description.en: When Li Zhanshu was the Chairman of the 13th NPCSC, Ding Zhongli served as a Vice Chairperson.

description.zh-cn: 在赵乐际担任第十四届全国人大常委会委员长期间，丁仲礼任副委员长。
description.en: While Zhao Leji serves as the Chairman of the 14th NPCSC, Ding Zhongli is a Vice Chairperson.

description.zh-cn: 丁仲礼自2017年12月10日起担任中国民主同盟中央委员会主席。
description.en: Ding Zhongli has served as the Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League since December 10, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 丁仲礼接替张宝文担任中国民主同盟中央委员会主席。
description.en: Ding Zhongli succeeded Zhang Baowen as the Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 丁仲礼接替白春礼担任中国科学院大学校长。
description.en: Ding Zhongli succeeded Bai Chunli as the President of the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 李树深接替丁仲礼担任中国科学院大学校长。
description.en: Li Shushen succeeded Ding Zhongli as the President of the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 在路甬祥担任中国科学院院长期间，丁仲礼任副院长。
description.en: While Lu Yongxiang was President of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Ding Zhongli served as Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 在白春礼担任中国科学院院长期间，丁仲礼任副院长。
description.en: While Bai Chunli was President of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, Ding Zhongli served as Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 丁仲礼考取中国科学院硕士研究生，导师为刘东生。
description.en: Ding Zhongli was a master's student at the Chinese Academy of Sciences, supervised by Liu Dongsheng.

description.zh-cn: 因香港问题，美国国务院宣布对包括丁仲礼在内的全部14名第十三届全国人大常委会副委员长实施制裁。
description.en: Due to issues related to Hong Kong, the U.S. Department of State announced sanctions against all 14 vice chairpersons of the 13th NPCSC, including Ding Zhongli.

description.zh-cn: 穆林是吉林抚松人。
description.en: Mu Lin was a native of Fusong, Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 穆林曾任山东省人民委员会副省长。
description.en: Mu Lin served as the Vice Governor of the Shandong Provincial People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 穆林曾任山东省革命委员会副主任。
description.en: Mu Lin served as the Vice Chairman of the Shandong Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 穆林曾任吉林省革命委员会副主任。
description.en: Mu Lin served as the Vice Chairman of the Jilin Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 穆林曾任吉林省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Mu Lin served as the Vice Governor of the Jilin Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 穆林是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Mu Lin was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 穆林曾任中共吉林省委常委。
description.en: Mu Lin served as a Standing Committee Member of the CPC Jilin Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 穆林是第四届全国人大代表。
description.en: Mu Lin was a deputy to the 4th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及是宇文述的长子。
description.en: Yuwen Huaji was the eldest son of Yuwen Shu.

description.zh-cn: 宇文智及是宇文化及的同母弟。
description.en: Yuwen Zhiji was Yuwen Huaji's younger full brother.

description.zh-cn: 宇文士及是宇文化及的异母弟。
description.en: Yuwen Shiji was Yuwen Huaji's younger half-brother.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及被同谋推举为首领，领导了江都兵变。
description.en: Yuwen Huaji was nominated by his co-conspirators as the leader and led the Jiangdu coup.

description.zh-cn: 司马德戡是江都兵变的主要策划者之一。
description.en: Sima Dekan was one of the main planners of the Jiangdu coup.

description.zh-cn: 江都兵变导致隋炀帝被部下缢杀。
description.en: The Jiangdu coup led to the assassination of Emperor Yang of Sui by his subordinates.

description.zh-cn: 江都兵变后，宇文化及拥立杨浩为傀儡皇帝。
description.en: After the Jiangdu coup, Yuwen Huaji installed Yang Hao as a puppet emperor.

description.zh-cn: 江都兵变导致隋朝皇帝死亡和中央权力真空，加速了隋朝的灭亡。
description.en: The Jiangdu coup resulted in the death of the Sui emperor and a central power vacuum, accelerating the fall of the Sui dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及为了自己称帝，毒杀了其拥立的傀儡皇帝杨浩。
description.en: In order to proclaim himself emperor, Yuwen Huaji poisoned the puppet emperor Yang Hao whom he had installed.

description.zh-cn: 窦建德击败并俘虏了宇文化及，并将其斩首。
description.en: Dou Jiande defeated and captured Yuwen Huaji, and had him beheaded.

description.zh-cn: 窦建德在处死宇文化及的同时，也诛杀了宇文智及。
description.en: While executing Yuwen Huaji, Dou Jiande also executed Yuwen Zhiji.

description.zh-cn: 李密率军抵抗并击败了宇文化及的北上军队，阻止其西进。
description.en: Li Mi led his army to resist and defeat Yuwen Huaji's northbound forces, preventing them from advancing westward.

description.zh-cn: 唐将李神通奉命攻打宇文化及，并将其围困在聊城。
description.en: The Tang general Li Shentong was ordered to attack Yuwen Huaji and besieged him in Liaocheng.

description.zh-cn: 王薄假意与宇文化及共同守城，后打开城门放窦建德军进入，导致宇文化及被俘。
description.en: Wang Bo pretended to defend the city with Yuwen Huaji, but later opened the gates to let Dou Jiande's army in, leading to Yuwen Huaji's capture.

description.zh-cn: 沈法兴在隋炀帝死后，以讨伐宇文化及为名起兵。
description.en: After the death of Emperor Yang of Sui, Shen Faxing raised an army under the pretext of punishing Yuwen Huaji.

description.zh-cn: 宇文化及在发现司马德戡图谋反叛后，将其诱捕并处死。
description.en: After discovering Sima Dekan's plot to rebel, Yuwen Huaji lured him into a trap and executed him.

description.zh-cn: 宇文述曾帮助当时的晋王杨广夺取皇太子之位。
description.en: Yuwen Shu helped Yang Guang, then the Prince of Jin, to secure the position of crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 宇文述帮助杨广取代了杨勇的皇太子之位。
description.en: Yuwen Shu helped Yang Guang replace Yang Yong as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 因与宇文智及是朋友，杨浩在江都兵变中得以保全性命。
description.en: Due to his friendship with Yuwen Zhiji, Yang Hao's life was spared during the Jiangdu coup.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝是嘉庆帝的次子。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor was the second son of the Jiaqing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 孝淑睿皇后是嘉庆帝的皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoshurui was the empress of the Jiaqing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 孝全成皇后于道光十四年被立为皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoquancheng was installed as empress in the 14th year of the Daoguang era.

description.zh-cn: 孝穆成皇后是道光帝为皇子时的嫡福晋。
description.en: Empress Xiaomucheng was the primary consort of the Daoguang Emperor when he was a prince.

description.zh-cn: 孝慎成皇后在道光帝登基后被立为皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoshencheng was installed as empress after the Daoguang Emperor ascended the throne.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝在驾崩当日降下朱笔谕旨，立皇四子奕𬣞（咸丰帝）为皇太子，继承大统。
description.en: On the day of his death, the Daoguang Emperor issued an imperial edict in his own hand, establishing his fourth son Yizhu (the Xianfeng Emperor) as Crown Prince to succeed to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 天理教于嘉庆十八年发动了癸酉之变。
description.en: The Tianli Cult launched the Guiyou Uprising in the 18th year of the Jiaqing era.

description.zh-cn: 在癸酉之变中，尚为皇子的绵宁（道光帝）用鸟铳击毙两名攻入紫禁城的天理教徒。
description.en: During the Guiyou Uprising, Prince Mianning (the future Daoguang Emperor) shot and killed two Tianli Cult members who had stormed the Forbidden City.

description.zh-cn: 英国为报复虎门销烟和打开中国市场，发动了第一次鸦片战争。
description.en: Great Britain launched the First Opium War in retaliation for the destruction of opium at Humen and to open Chinese markets.

description.zh-cn: 清朝在第一次鸦片战争中战败，被迫签订《南京条约》。
description.en: The Qing dynasty was defeated in the First Opium War and was forced to sign the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝不承认琦善与义律私拟的《穿鼻草约》。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor refused to recognize the Convention of Chuanbi privately negotiated by Qishan and Charles Elliot.

description.zh-cn: 因英军占领香港岛及签订《穿鼻草约》事宜，道光帝于道光二十一年二月将琦善革职查办。
description.en: Due to the British occupation of Hong Kong Island and the signing of the Convention of Chuanbi, the Daoguang Emperor dismissed and investigated Qishan in the second month of the 21st year of the Daoguang era.

description.zh-cn: 历史学家孟森认为道光帝的庸暗是清朝入关以来所未有，其统治时期被视为“嘉道中衰”的一部分。
description.en: Historian Meng Sen considered the mediocrity and shortsightedness of the Daoguang Emperor to be unprecedented since the Qing entered the Shanhai Pass, and his reign is considered part of the 'Jiaqing-Daoguang decline'.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝出生于紫禁城内的撷芳殿。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor was born in Xiefang Hall within the Forbidden City.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝于1820年至1850年担任清朝皇帝。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor served as the Emperor of the Qing dynasty from 1820 to 1850.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝是乾隆帝的孙子。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor was the grandson of the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 孝敬宪皇后是内大臣费扬古的女儿。
description.en: Empress Xiaojingxian was the daughter of the minister Fiyanggū.

description.zh-cn: 根据考证，孝敬宪皇后为费扬古嫡妻多罗格格觉罗氏所生。
description.en: According to research, Empress Xiaojingxian was born to Fiyanggū's primary wife, Lady Gioro.

description.zh-cn: 弘晖是孝敬宪皇后所生的亲生儿子。
description.en: Honghui was the biological son of Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 弘晖是雍正帝的嫡长子。
description.en: Honghui was the eldest legitimate son of the Yongzheng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 胤禛的生母是孝恭仁皇后。
description.en: Yinzhen's birth mother was Empress Xiaogongren.

description.zh-cn: 1691年，乌拉那拉氏被册立为雍亲王胤禛的嫡福晋。
description.en: In 1691, Lady Ulanara was installed as the primary consort of Prince Yong, Yinzhen.

description.zh-cn: 1722年12月，雍正帝登基后，册立乌拉那拉氏为皇后。
description.en: In December 1722, after the Yongzheng Emperor ascended the throne, he instated Lady Ulanara as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝登基后，追封皇后之父费扬古为一等公，后于1730年加赠为一等承恩公。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Yongzheng Emperor posthumously honored his empress's father, Fiyanggū, as a Duke of the First Rank, and later in 1730, granted him the additional title of Duke Cheng'en of the First Rank.

description.zh-cn: 雍正十三年（1735年）十一月，乾隆帝为孝敬宪皇后增加谥号。
description.en: In November 1735, the Qianlong Emperor added to the posthumous title of Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 孝敬宪皇后出身于满洲正黄旗。
description.en: Empress Xiaojingxian was from the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

description.zh-cn: 和硕淑慎公主为孝敬宪皇后的养女。
description.en: Princess Shushen of the First Rank was an adopted daughter of Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 和硕端柔公主为孝敬宪皇后的养女。
description.en: Princess Duanrou of the First Rank was an adopted daughter of Empress Xiaojingxian.

description.zh-cn: 根据王世贞所引《革除遗事》的说法，明成祖为达妃之子。
description.en: According to 'Gechu Yishi' as cited by Wang Shizhen, Emperor Chengzu was the son of Consort Da.

description.zh-cn: 此为野史说法，认为明成祖是元顺帝的遗腹子。
description.en: This is a theory from unofficial histories, suggesting that Emperor Chengzu was the posthumous son of Emperor Shun of Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京太常寺志》的记载，李淑妃是懿文皇太子朱标、秦愍王朱樉、晋恭王朱㭎的生母。
description.en: According to the 'Records of the Nanjing Ministry of Rites', Consort Li Shu was the biological mother of Crown Prince Yiwen (Zhu Biao), Prince Min of Qin (Zhu Shang), and Prince Gong of Jin (Zhu Gang).

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京太常寺志》的记载，李淑妃是懿文皇太子朱标、秦愍王朱樉、晋恭王朱㭎的生母。
description.en: According to the 'Records of the Nanjing Ministry of Rites', Consort Li Shu was the biological mother of Crown Prince Yiwen (Zhu Biao), Prince Min of Qin (Zhu Shang), and Prince Gong of Jin (Zhu Gang).

description.zh-cn: 朱棣是朱标的弟弟。官方说法中他们是同母兄弟，均为马皇后所生。
description.en: Zhu Di was Zhu Biao's younger brother. According to the official account, they were full brothers, both born to Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 朱棣是朱橚的兄长。部分说法认为他们是同母兄弟，生母并非马皇后。
description.en: Zhu Di was Zhu Su's elder brother. Some theories suggest they were full brothers, and their mother was not Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 黄子澄向建文帝建议，应先削周王朱橚，因为他是燕王朱棣的同母弟弟，削周即是剪除燕王的手足。
description.en: Huang Zicheng advised the Jianwen Emperor to first target Zhu Su, the Prince of Zhou, because he was the full brother of Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan, and removing him would be like cutting off the Prince of Yan's limbs.

description.zh-cn: 洪武二十二年（1389年），高丽使臣权近在北平拜谒当时还是燕王的朱棣。
description.en: In 1389, Goryeo envoy Gwon Geun visited Zhu Di, who was then the Prince of Yan, in Beiping.

description.zh-cn: 朱希祖因傅斯年坚信朱棣生母为元顺帝妃的观点而表示不满，认为这是“诬辱之尤，淆乱种族”。
description.en: Zhu Xizu expressed dissatisfaction with Fu Sinian's firm belief that Zhu Di's mother was a consort of Emperor Shun of Yuan, considering it a 'grave insult and a confusion of ethnicity'.

description.zh-cn: 洪武三十一年（1398年），朱元璋赐死李淑妃，令其殉葬。
description.en: In 1398, Zhu Yuanzhang ordered Consort Li Shu to commit suicide and be buried with him as a sacrificial victim.

description.zh-cn: 陈伯达是林彪反党集团的主要成员之一。
description.en: Chen Boda was one of the main members of the Lin Biao anti-party clique.

description.zh-cn: 林立果是林彪反党集团的成员之一。
description.en: Lin Liguo was one of the members of the Lin Biao anti-party clique.

description.zh-cn: 林彪反党集团策划了旨在杀害毛泽东的《五七一工程纪要》计划。
description.en: The Lin Biao anti-party clique masterminded the 'Project 571 Outline' plan, which aimed to assassinate Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 九一三事件导致林彪集团核心成员死亡或被捕，集团被彻底粉碎。
description.en: The September 13 Incident led to the death or arrest of the core members of the Lin Biao clique, resulting in its complete dismantlement.

description.zh-cn: 根据官方定性，林彪反党集团试图推翻无产阶级专政、复辟资产阶级专政。
description.en: According to the official verdict, the Lin Biao anti-party clique attempted to overthrow the dictatorship of the proletariat and restore the dictatorship of the bourgeoisie.

description.zh-cn: 文革期间的评价认为，林彪反党集团代表了被打倒的资产阶级的利益。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, it was assessed that the Lin Biao anti-party clique represented the interests of the overthrown bourgeoisie.

description.zh-cn: 林彪反党集团是在文化大革命的政治背景下形成和活动的。
description.en: The Lin Biao anti-party clique was formed and active within the political context of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 该集团被中华人民共和国官方定性为“反党集团”和“反革命集团”。
description.en: The clique was officially designated as an 'anti-party clique' and 'counter-revolutionary clique' by the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 井上毅作为主要起草人之一，负责《大日本帝国宪法》草案的起草工作。
description.en: As one of the main authors, Inoue Kowashi was responsible for drafting the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 金子坚太郎作为主要起草人之一，参与了《大日本帝国宪法》的起草工作。
description.en: As one of the main authors, Kaneko Kentarō participated in the drafting of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 伊东巳代治作为主要起草人之一，参与了《大日本帝国宪法》的起草工作。
description.en: As one of the main authors, Itō Miyoji participated in the drafting of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 枢密院对伊藤博文等人起草的宪法草案进行了审议，并于1889年1月完成审议，为宪法的公布铺平了道路。
description.en: The Privy Council deliberated on the draft constitution prepared by Itō Hirobumi and others, completing its review in January 1889, paving the way for the constitution's promulgation.

description.zh-cn: 明治维新带来的国家体制根本性变化，是制定《大日本帝国宪法》的直接背景和动因。
description.en: The fundamental changes to the state system brought about by the Meiji Restoration served as the direct background and impetus for the creation of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 自由民权运动对藩阀政治的批判和对民选议院的呼吁，对政府制定宪法形成了政治压力。
description.en: The Freedom and People's Rights Movement's criticism of the domain-based government and its call for a popularly elected assembly created political pressure on the government to establish a constitution.

description.zh-cn: 《日本国宪法》于1947年5月3日施行，取代并废止了《大日本帝国宪法》。
description.en: The Constitution of Japan came into effect on May 3, 1947, replacing and repealing the Constitution of the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 联合国军最高司令官总司令部向日本政府提出修改宪法的要求，并提供了“麦克阿瑟草案”，主导了新宪法的制定。
description.en: The General Headquarters, the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers (GHQ/SCAP) demanded that the Japanese government revise the constitution and provided the 'MacArthur Draft', leading the process of creating the new constitution.

description.zh-cn: 日本接受《波茨坦宣言》后，根据其原则，导致了对《大日本帝国宪法》的全面修改，最终使其失效。
description.en: After Japan's acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration, its principles led to a complete revision of the Constitution of the Empire of Japan, ultimately rendering it obsolete.

description.zh-cn: 在大津事件中，时任大审院长的儿岛惟谦顶住政府压力，坚持司法独立，影响了案件的最终判决，确立了法治主义原则。
description.en: During the Ōtsu Incident, Kojima Korekata, then President of the Supreme Court of Judicature, resisted government pressure and upheld judicial independence, influencing the final verdict and establishing the principle of the rule of law.

description.zh-cn: 美浓部达吉是“天皇机关说”这一宪法学说的主导学者。
description.en: Minobe Tatsukichi was the leading scholar of the 'Emperor Organ Theory,' a constitutional doctrine.

description.zh-cn: 福泽谕吉在其主编的报纸上对新宪法发表评论，指出日本民众缺乏适应国会制度的精神独立，对此提出了忧虑。
description.en: In the newspaper he edited, Fukuzawa Yukichi published a commentary on the new constitution, expressing concern that the Japanese populace lacked the spiritual independence to adapt to the parliamentary system.

description.zh-cn: 中江兆民对民众未看到宪法实质就沉醉于其名称的现象表示叹息，批评了国民的盲目态度。
description.en: Nakae Chōmin lamented the public's infatuation with the constitution's name without seeing its substance, criticizing the people's blind attitude.

description.zh-cn: 在伊藤博文考察欧洲期间，鲁多尔夫·冯·格奈斯特向其提供了关于宪法必须立足于本国历史、传统和文化的建议。
description.en: During Itō Hirobumi's European tour, Rudolf von Gneist advised him that a constitution must be based on the country's own history, tradition, and culture.

description.zh-cn: 在伊藤博文考察欧洲期间，罗伦斯·冯·史坦向其提供了关于宪法必须立足于本国历史的建议。
description.en: During Itō Hirobumi's European tour, Lorenz von Stein advised him that a constitution must be based on the country's own history.

description.zh-cn: 全国大串连是文化大革命的社会动员措施之一。
description.en: The Great Networking was one of the social mobilization measures of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中央文化革命小组表态支持全国各地的学生到北京交流革命经验，也支持北京学生到各地去进行革命串联。
description.en: The Central Cultural Revolution Group expressed support for students from all over the country to come to Beijing to exchange revolutionary experiences and also supported Beijing students to go to other places for revolutionary networking.

description.zh-cn: 红卫兵是全国大串连活动的主体。
description.en: The Red Guards were the main participants of the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 聂元梓的大字报向全国播出后，受到压抑的外地造反者开始奔赴北京，成为大串连的缘起之一。
description.en: After Nie Yuanzi's big-character poster was broadcast nationwide, suppressed rebels from other regions began to flock to Beijing, becoming one of the triggers for the Great Networking.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党第八届中央委员会第十一次全体会议通过了“十六条”。
description.en: The Eleventh Plenary Session of the Eighth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China adopted the "Sixteen Points".

description.zh-cn: “十六条”的发表对大串连的兴起造成了强大的冲击波。
description.en: The publication of the "Sixteen Points" created a powerful shockwave that contributed to the rise of the Great Networking.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东接见红卫兵的活动吸引了各地青年学生源源不断涌向北京参与大串连。
description.en: Mao Zedong's reception of the Red Guards attracted a continuous stream of young students from all over the country to Beijing to participate in the Great Networking.

description.zh-cn: 在全国大串连期间，红卫兵在全国各地冲击党政机关，并进行“破四旧”活动。
description.en: During the Great Networking, Red Guards attacked party and government organs across the country and carried out "Destroy the Four Olds" activities.

description.zh-cn: 1967年8月，毛泽东号召“就地闹革命”，促使大串联活动基本结束。
description.en: In August 1967, Mao Zedong's call to "make revolution on the spot" led to the essential end of the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 1967年10月，中共中央发文要求“复课闹革命”，大串联活动随之基本结束。
description.en: In October 1967, the CCP Central Committee issued a document calling for "resuming classes to make revolution," which subsequently led to the essential end of the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 习近平曾参与全国大串连，并公开提及过此段经历。
description.en: Xi Jinping participated in the Great Networking and has publicly mentioned this experience.

description.zh-cn: 部分红卫兵在进行大串连时效仿了红军长征的形式，例如进行步行串连。
description.en: Some Red Guards emulated the form of the Long March when conducting the Great Networking, for example, by undertaking linking-up on foot.

description.zh-cn: 通过报道红卫兵步行串连事迹并发表社论《红卫兵不怕远征难》，对大串连活动起到了宣传和推动作用。
description.en: By reporting on the deeds of Red Guards' walking link-ups and publishing the editorial "Red Guards Fear Not the Trials of the Long March," it played a role in publicizing and promoting the Great Networking movement.

description.zh-cn: 造反派是全国大串连的积极参与者，在聂元梓大字报后奔赴北京取经。
description.en: The Rebel Faction were active participants in the Great Networking, flocking to Beijing to learn after Nie Yuanzi's big-character poster.

description.zh-cn: 金铁霖出生于当时的滨江省哈尔滨市。
description.en: Jin Tielin was born in Harbin, then part of Binjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 1960年考入中央音乐学院声乐系。
description.en: Enrolled in the Vocal Music Department of the Central Conservatory of Music in 1960.

description.zh-cn: 金铁霖在中央音乐学院师从男高音歌唱家、声乐教育家沈湘。
description.en: At the Central Conservatory of Music, Jin Tielin studied under the tenor singer and vocal educator Shen Xiang.

position.zh-cn: 男高音独唱演员、四重唱演员、合唱队男高音声部长
position.en: Tenor soloist, quartet singer, and tenor section leader of the choir

description.zh-cn: 毕业后被分配到中央乐团工作，直至1981年。
description.en: After graduation, he was assigned to work at the Central Philharmonic Orchestra until 1981.

description.zh-cn: 1981年，金铁霖受李凌之邀，到中国音乐学院任教，开启了其声乐教育生涯。
description.en: In 1981, at the invitation of Li Ling, Jin Tielin began teaching at the China Conservatory of Music, starting his career in vocal education.

description.zh-cn: 自1981年起在中国音乐学院任教，并于1996年至2009年间担任院长。
description.en: He taught at the China Conservatory of Music from 1981 and served as its president from 1996 to 2009.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国音乐家协会副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the Chinese Musicians' Association.

description.zh-cn: 曾任北京市文联主席。
description.en: Served as Chairman of the Beijing Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 金铁霖曾与李谷一结婚，后离婚。
description.en: Jin Tielin was once married to Li Guyi, they later divorced.

description.zh-cn: 1990年与马秋华结婚。
description.en: Married Ma Qiuhua in 1990.

description.zh-cn: 金圣权是金铁霖的儿子，于1993年出生。
description.en: Jin Shengquan is the son of Jin Tielin, born in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 金圣权是马秋华的儿子，于1993年出生。
description.en: Jin Shengquan is the son of Ma Qiuhua, born in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 李谷一是金铁霖的学生之一。
description.en: Li Guyi was one of Jin Tielin's students.

description.zh-cn: 穆斯林相信《古兰经》是安拉（真主）通过天使加百列向穆罕默德逐字逐句传达的启示。
description.en: Muslims believe the Quran is the literal word of Allah (God) as revealed to Muhammad through the angel Gabriel.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰教是以《古兰经》为根本基础的宗教。
description.en: Islam is a religion fundamentally based on the Quran.

description.zh-cn: 圣训是伊斯兰教教义、律例和礼仪的重要辅助渊源。
description.en: The Hadith serves as an important supplementary source for Islamic doctrine, law, and practice.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德作为最后一位先知，向人们传道，恳请他们崇拜唯一的真主，从而传播了伊斯兰教。
description.en: As the final prophet, Muhammad preached to people, urging them to worship the one God, thereby spreading Islam.

description.zh-cn: 奥斯曼帝国的扩张使伊斯兰教从麦加向大西洋及太平洋的方向扩散。
description.en: The expansion of the Ottoman Empire caused Islam to spread from Mecca towards the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.

description.zh-cn: 阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜在661年被哈瓦立及派刺杀。
description.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib was assassinated by the Kharijites in 661.

description.zh-cn: 在阿里被刺杀后，穆阿威叶一世掌权并创建了倭马亚王朝。
description.en: After Ali's assassination, Muawiyah I took power and founded the Umayyad dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 阿拔斯王朝在750年推翻了倭马亚王朝的统治。
description.en: The Abbasid Caliphate overthrew the Umayyad Caliphate in 750.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国在1258年攻陷巴格达，灭亡了阿拔斯王朝。
description.en: The Mongol Empire destroyed the Abbasid Caliphate by sacking Baghdad in 1258.

description.zh-cn: 穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜·瓦哈布推动了赛莱菲（瓦哈比）复兴运动。
description.en: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab promoted the Salafi (Wahhabi) revival movement.

description.zh-cn: 在中国文化大革命期间，许多清真寺被关闭，伊斯兰教的宗教活动被禁止。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution in China, many mosques were closed and Islamic religious activities were banned.

description.zh-cn: 红色高棉政权在其统治期间杀害了约15万占族穆斯林。
description.en: The Khmer Rouge regime killed approximately 150,000 Cham Muslims during its rule.

description.zh-cn: 九一一袭击事件导致了全球范围内伊斯兰恐惧症的弥漫和加剧。
description.en: The September 11 attacks led to the spread and intensification of Islamophobia worldwide.

description.zh-cn: 大马士革的圣约翰从神学角度批判伊斯兰教，认为其不合理且先知穆罕默德的声称是疯狂和胡言。
description.en: John of Damascus criticized Islam from a theological perspective, viewing it as irrational and the claims of the prophet Muhammad as madness and nonsense.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德形容穆斯林深信“《古兰经》的谎话连篇”。
description.en: Martin Luther described Muslims as deeply believing in the 'pack of lies in the Quran'.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次穆斯林内战期间，阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜与穆阿威叶一世是敌对势力的领导人。
description.en: During the First Fitna, Ali ibn Abi Talib and Muawiyah I were leaders of opposing forces.

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局是中华人民共和国国务院主管外汇和国际收支工作的机构。
description.en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange is an agency under the State Council of the People's Republic of China responsible for foreign exchange and balance of payments.

description.zh-cn: 成立初期，国家外汇管理局与中国银行合署办公，属于“一个机构两块牌子”，由中国银行同时承担外汇管理职能。
description.en: In its early days, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange shared offices with the Bank of China under the 'one institution, two names' model, with the Bank of China concurrently undertaking foreign exchange management functions.

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局在成立初期采用了“一个机构两块牌子”的组织形式，与中国银行合署办公。
description.en: In its early period, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange adopted the 'one institution, two names' organizational model, sharing offices with the Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家外汇管理局的行政级别是副部级。
description.en: The administrative rank of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange is vice-ministerial level.

description.zh-cn: 朱鹤新兼任中国人民银行副行长与国家外汇管理局局长。
description.en: Zhu Hexin concurrently serves as Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China and Director of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 尊严革命是广场起义抗议活动的最终阶段和高潮，导致了政权更迭。
description.en: The Revolution of Dignity was the final stage and climax of the Euromaidan protests, leading to a change of government.

description.zh-cn: 尊严革命期间，俄罗斯开始军事干预乌克兰，并最终导致了全面的俄乌战争。
description.en: During the Revolution of Dignity, Russia began its military intervention in Ukraine, which eventually led to the full-scale Russo-Ukrainian War.

description.zh-cn: 尊严革命的结果之一是前总理尤莉娅·季莫申科从监狱中获释。
description.en: One of the outcomes of the Revolution of Dignity was the release of former Prime Minister Yulia Tymoshenko from prison.

description.zh-cn: 2013年11月，总统亚努科维奇政府决定暂停与欧盟签署《联合协议》，此举是广场起义爆发的直接导火索。
description.en: In November 2013, President Yanukovych's government decided to suspend the signing of the Association Agreement with the EU, an act that directly triggered the Euromaidan protests.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯向乌克兰施加经济和政治压力，要求其拒绝与欧盟签署《联合协议》，转而与俄罗斯建立更紧密的关系。
description.en: Russia exerted economic and political pressure on Ukraine to reject the Association Agreement with the EU and instead build closer ties with Russia.

description.zh-cn: 2014年1月16日，乌克兰最高拉达通过了旨在压制抗议活动的“反示威法”，进一步激化了局势。
description.en: On January 16, 2014, the Verkhovna Rada passed the 'anti-protest laws' aimed at suppressing the protests, which further escalated the situation.

description.zh-cn: “反示威法”的通过激起了民众的强烈愤慨，导致抗议活动升级为更激烈的冲突。
description.en: The passing of the 'anti-protest laws' provoked strong public outrage, causing the protests to escalate into more violent clashes.

description.zh-cn: 在总统亚努科维奇逃离基辅后，乌克兰最高拉达于2014年2月22日以328票对0票通过弹劾案，罢免其总统职务。
description.en: After President Yanukovych fled Kyiv, the Verkhovna Rada voted 328-0 on February 22, 2014, to impeach him and remove him from the presidency.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯谴责乌克兰最高拉达罢免亚努科维奇的投票为一场“政变”，并拒绝承认新成立的临时政府。
description.en: Russia condemned the Verkhovna Rada's vote to oust Yanukovych as a 'coup' and refused to recognize the newly formed interim government.

description.zh-cn: 在尊严革命期间，俄罗斯总统普京决定军事干预乌克兰事务，派遣军队入侵乌克兰，从而引发了俄乌战争。
description.en: During the Revolution of Dignity, Russian President Vladimir Putin decided to militarily intervene in Ukrainian affairs, sending troops to invade Ukraine, thus triggering the Russo-Ukrainian War.

description.zh-cn: 彼得·波罗申科在2014年5月25日举行的总统选举中获胜，成为尊严革命后的新任乌克兰总统。
description.en: Petro Poroshenko won the presidential election held on May 25, 2014, becoming the new President of Ukraine after the Revolution of Dignity.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔法小组是乌克兰国家安全局下属的特种部队。
description.en: The Alpha Group is a special forces unit subordinate to the Security Service of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 亲俄武装宣布成立“顿涅茨克人民共和国”并占领政府大楼，与乌克兰中央政府爆发武装冲突，引发顿巴斯战争。
description.en: Pro-Russian forces declared the 'Donetsk People's Republic' and seized government buildings, leading to armed conflict with the central government of Ukraine and sparking the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 亲俄武装宣布成立“卢甘斯克人民共和国”并占领政府大楼，与乌克兰中央政府爆发武装冲突，引发顿巴斯战争。
description.en: Pro-Russian forces declared the 'Luhansk People's Republic' and seized government buildings, leading to armed conflict with the central government of Ukraine and sparking the War in Donbas.

description.zh-cn: 王晶垚于1945年毕业于燕京大学历史系。
description.en: Wang Jingyao graduated from the Department of History at Yenching University in 1945.

description.zh-cn: 王晶垚于1957年至1986年在中国科学院哲学社会科学部近代史研究所（后为中国社会科学院近代史研究所）担任副研究员。
description.en: From 1957 to 1986, Wang Jingyao worked as an associate researcher at the Institute of Modern History, Department of Philosophy and Social Sciences, Chinese Academy of Sciences (later the Institute of Modern History, Chinese Academy of Social Sciences).

description.zh-cn: 王晶垚出生于江苏淮安。
description.en: Wang Jingyao was born in Huai'an, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 卞仲耘在文化大革命初期，被其学校的红卫兵学生批斗殴打致死。
description.en: Bian Zhongyun was beaten to death by her Red Guard students during a struggle session at the beginning of the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据其维基百科页面分类，王晶垚是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to his Wikipedia page category, Wang Jingyao was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 萧衍迫使南齐和帝禅位，建立南梁，成为开国皇帝。
description.en: Xiao Yan forced Emperor He of Southern Qi to abdicate, established the Liang dynasty, and became its founding emperor.

description.zh-cn: 萧衍是萧顺之的儿子。
description.en: Xiao Yan was the son of Xiao Shunzhi.

description.zh-cn: 萧衍是张尚柔的儿子。
description.en: Xiao Yan was the son of Zhang Shangrou.

description.zh-cn: 萧衍年轻时是竟陵王萧子良门下的文学群体“竟陵八友”之一。
description.en: In his youth, Xiao Yan was one of the 'Eight Friends of Jingling', a literary group under Xiao Ziliang, the Prince of Jingling.

description.zh-cn: 萧衍出身于南齐宗室，并在南齐担任过建阳县男、建安郡公、梁公、梁王等职务。
description.en: Xiao Yan was from the imperial clan of Southern Qi and held positions such as Baron of Jianyang County, Duke of Jian'an Commandery, Duke of Liang, and Prince of Liang.

description.zh-cn: 萧衍迫使南齐和帝萧宝融禅位，并于次日将其赐死。
description.en: Xiao Yan forced Emperor He of Southern Qi, Xiao Baorong, to abdicate the throne and had him put to death the next day.

description.zh-cn: 在侯景之乱中，都城建康被围，梁武帝萧衍最终在饥渴交加中去世。
description.en: During the Hou Jing Rebellion, the capital Jiankang was besieged, and Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, eventually died of starvation and thirst.

description.zh-cn: 侯景起兵叛乱，围困建康，削减梁武帝的饮食，最终导致其死亡。
description.en: Hou Jing launched a rebellion, besieged Jiankang, and reduced Emperor Wu's food supplies, ultimately leading to his death.

description.zh-cn: 梁武帝同意东魏用萧渊明交换侯景的提议，导致侯景感到被出卖，遂起兵叛乱。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Liang agreed to Eastern Wei's proposal to exchange Hou Jing for Xiao Yuanming, which made Hou Jing feel betrayed and led him to launch a rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 永元二年（500年），萧懿被诬告谋反，遭东昏侯萧宝卷赐死。
description.en: In 500, Xiao Yi was falsely accused of treason and was ordered to commit suicide by Emperor Xiao Baojuan.

description.zh-cn: 在其兄萧懿被萧宝卷杀害后，萧衍积极招兵，举兵推翻萧宝卷的统治。
description.en: After his brother Xiao Yi was killed by Xiao Baojuan, Xiao Yan actively recruited soldiers and raised an army to overthrow Xiao Baojuan's rule.

description.zh-cn: 梁武帝与道士陶弘景关系极善，常就国家大事向其请教，陶弘景因此有“山中宰相”之称。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Liang had an excellent relationship with the Taoist Tao Hongjing, often consulting him on state affairs, which earned Tao the nickname 'Prime Minister in the Mountains'.

description.zh-cn: 萧懿是梁武帝萧衍的长兄。
description.en: Xiao Yi was the elder brother of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 郗徽是梁武帝萧衍的元配妻子。
description.en: Xi Hui was the first wife of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 阮令嬴是梁武帝萧衍的修容。
