description.en: Ruan Lingying was a consort (Xiurong) of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 萧统是梁武帝萧衍的长子。
description.en: Xiao Tong was the eldest son of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 萧统是丁令光所生。
description.en: Xiao Tong was the son of Ding Lingguang.

description.zh-cn: 萧纲是梁武帝萧衍的第三子。
description.en: Xiao Gang was the third son of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 萧纲是丁令光所生。
description.en: Xiao Gang was the son of Ding Lingguang.

description.zh-cn: 萧续是梁武帝萧衍的第五子。
description.en: Xiao Xu was the fifth son of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 萧续是丁令光所生。
description.en: Xiao Xu was the son of Ding Lingguang.

description.zh-cn: 萧绎是梁武帝萧衍的第七子。
description.en: Xiao Yi was the seventh son of Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan.

description.zh-cn: 萧绎是阮令嬴所生。
description.en: Xiao Yi was the son of Ruan Lingying.

description.zh-cn: 梅建华担任莱芜市人民政府市长。
description.en: Mei Jianhua served as the Mayor of the Laiwu Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 王茂祯担任莱芜市人民政府副市长。
description.en: Wang Maozhen served as a Vice Mayor of the Laiwu Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 武树华担任莱芜市人民政府副市长。
description.en: Wu Shuhua served as a Vice Mayor of the Laiwu Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 莱芜市人民政府在业务上隶属于山东省人民政府。
description.en: The Laiwu Municipal People's Government was administratively subordinate to the Shandong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁在美丽岛事件中担任辩护律师团成员，成为其投身政坛的契机。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian served as a member of the defense counsel during the Kaohsiung Incident, which served as the catalyst for his entry into politics.

description.zh-cn: 黄信介的政见演说启发了当时就读商学系的陈水扁，使其决定休学重考并转读法律系。
description.en: A political speech by Huang Hsin-chieh inspired Chen Shui-bian, then a business student, to drop out, retake the university entrance exam, and switch to studying law.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁为民主进步党创始党员之一，曾因弊案自行退党，后又重新入党。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian was a founding member of the DPP. He voluntarily withdrew from the party due to corruption scandals and later rejoined.

description.zh-cn: 在1998年台北市市长选举中，马英九击败寻求连任的陈水扁。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou defeated Chen Shui-bian, who was seeking re-election, in the 1998 Taipei mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁先后在台北市长、中华民国总统职位上，由马英九接任。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian was succeeded by Ma Ying-jeou as both Mayor of Taipei and President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2000年5月20日，李登辉卸任中华民国总统，将权力交接给新任总统陈水扁，完成了和平的政权转移。
description.en: On May 20, 2000, Lee Teng-hui stepped down as President of the Republic of China, handing over power to the newly inaugurated president, Chen Shui-bian, completing a peaceful transition of power.

description.zh-cn: 1998年陈水扁台北市长选举落败后，时任总统李登辉公开推荐《从摩西到约书亚》的文章给陈水扁，引发舆论对陈水扁可能成为其接班人的讨论。
description.en: After Chen Shui-bian lost the 1998 Taipei mayoral election, then-President Lee Teng-hui publicly recommended an article, 'From Moses to Joshua,' to him, sparking public discussion that Chen might be his successor.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁在其总统就职演说中提出“四不一没有”的两岸政策主张。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian proposed the 'Four Noes and One Without' cross-strait policy in his presidential inaugural address.

description.zh-cn: 该枪击案被认为影响了2004年总统大选的选情，助其以微弱优势连任。
description.en: The shooting incident is believed to have influenced the outcome of the 2004 presidential election, helping him win re-election by a narrow margin.

description.zh-cn: 在三一九枪击案中，吕秀莲的膝盖受到枪击受伤。
description.en: In the 319 shooting incident, Annette Lu was shot in the knee.

description.zh-cn: 因龙潭购地案，陈水扁被判刑入狱。
description.en: Chen Shui-bian was convicted and imprisoned for his involvement in the Longtan land deal case.

description.zh-cn: 唐飞是陈水扁总统任内首位行政院院长，但因在核四续建问题上与陈水扁政府意见不合而辞职。
description.en: Tang Fei was the first Premier under President Chen Shui-bian, but he resigned due to disagreements with the Chen administration over the continuation of the Fourth Nuclear Power Plant project.

description.zh-cn: 中选会依据《选罢法》认定陈水扁不符合参选2020年立法委员的资格，因其曾犯贪污罪且刑期未执行完毕。
description.en: The Central Election Commission disqualified Chen Shui-bian from running for legislator in 2020 under the 'Civil Servants Election and Recall Act', due to his prior conviction for corruption and uncompleted sentence.

description.zh-cn: 因其支持的一边一国行动党在2020年立法委员选举中政党票失利，陈水扁宣布退出政坛。
description.en: After the Taiwan Action Party Alliance, which he supported, failed to win enough party-list votes in the 2020 legislative election, Chen Shui-bian announced his withdrawal from politics.

description.zh-cn: 时任台北市长柯文哲在电视专访中表示，他认为陈水扁“一开始是装的，后来就变成真的病了”，此番言论引发争议。
description.en: Then-Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je stated in a TV interview that he believed Chen Shui-bian was 'initially feigning illness, but later it became a real illness,' a comment that sparked controversy.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国驻美利坚合众国大使馆是中华人民共和国外交部下属的驻外机构。
description.en: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the United States of America is a foreign mission subordinate to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国总统吉米·卡特宣布与中华人民共和国建立外交关系。
description.en: U.S. President Jimmy Carter announced the establishment of diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府承认中华人民共和国，并与中华民国断交，导致中华民国政府撤离其驻美大使馆。
description.en: The U.S. government recognized the People's Republic of China and severed diplomatic relations with the Republic of China, forcing the ROC government to vacate its embassy in the U.S.

description.zh-cn: 贝聿铭设计了中华人民共和国驻美国大使馆的新馆舍，该馆舍于2006年落成。
description.en: I. M. Pei designed the new building for the Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the United States, which was completed in 2006.

description.zh-cn: 命名“刘晓波路”的提案引起中华人民共和国外交部的不满，称其为“挑衅行为”。
description.en: The proposal to name 'Liu Xiaobo Road' drew dissatisfaction from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China, which called it a 'provocative act'.

description.zh-cn: 美国参议院通过了将中国驻美大使馆门前地址命名为“刘晓波广场”的提案。
description.en: The U.S. Senate passed a proposal to name the address in front of the Chinese Embassy in the U.S. as 'Liu Xiaobo Plaza'.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国总统奥巴马的政府表示将否决“刘晓波广场”决议案。
description.en: The administration of then-U.S. President Obama stated it would veto the 'Liu Xiaobo Plaza' resolution.

description.zh-cn: 根据其遗孀付雪洁的声明，李文亮是一名中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the statement by his widow Fu Xuejie, Li Wenliang was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府要求中国在72小时内关闭其驻休斯敦总领事馆。
description.en: The U.S. government ordered China to close its consulate in Houston within 72 hours.

description.zh-cn: 曾在红军大学第四分校学习。
description.en: Studied at the Fourth Branch of the Red Army University.

description.zh-cn: 1936年2月，余秋里所在部队在乌蒙山区与万耀煌指挥的国民党军队作战。
description.en: In February 1936, Yu Qiuli's unit fought against KMT troops commanded by Wan Yaohuang in the Wumeng Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里担任120师第3支队政治委员时，与时任支队长的贺炳炎搭档合作，率队开辟根据地。
description.en: When Yu Qiuli was the political commissar of the 3rd Detachment of the 120th Division, he partnered with commander He Bingyan to lead the troops in establishing a base area.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里参与了百团大战。
description.en: Yu Qiuli participated in the Hundred Regiments Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里在358旅开展的“诉苦三查”运动，是全军新式整军运动的开端。
description.en: The 'Speak Bitterness and Three Checks' campaign initiated by Yu Qiuli in the 358th Brigade was the beginning of the new-style army consolidation movement throughout the army.

position.zh-cn: 大庆石油会战指挥部工委书记
position.en: Secretary of the Party Working Committee of the Daqing Oil Field Campaign Headquarters

description.zh-cn: 作为石油工业部部长，余秋里直接领导和指挥了大庆油田的勘探与开发会战。
description.en: As Minister of Petroleum Industry, Yu Qiuli directly led and commanded the exploration and development campaign of the Daqing Oil Field.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里在大庆油田发起了学习“铁人”王进喜的活动，将其树立为全国的榜样。
description.en: Yu Qiuli initiated a campaign at the Daqing Oil Field to learn from 'Iron Man' Wang Jinxi, establishing him as a national role model.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，余秋里受到冲击和批斗，但由于毛泽东的保护未被解除职务。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Yu Qiuli was attacked and struggled against, but was not removed from his posts due to Mao Zedong's protection.

description.zh-cn: 1968年，当陈伯达试图在新闻稿中省略余秋里的名字时，毛泽东亲自过问并指示加上，从而在政治上保护了余秋里。
description.en: In 1968, when Chen Boda attempted to omit Yu Qiuli's name from a press release, Mao Zedong personally intervened and ordered it to be included, thus politically protecting Yu Qiuli.

description.zh-cn: 1968年，陈伯达在组织关于毛泽东接见领导人的新闻稿时，试图将余秋里的名字省略。
description.en: In 1968, while organizing a press release about Mao Zedong's meeting with leaders, Chen Boda attempted to omit Yu Qiuli's name.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里接替韦国清担任中国人民解放军总政治部主任。
description.en: Yu Qiuli succeeded Wei Guoqing as Director of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 杨白冰接替余秋里担任中国人民解放军总政治部主任。
description.en: Yang Baibing succeeded Yu Qiuli as Director of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 余秋里接替黄克诚担任中国人民解放军总后方勤务部政治委员。
description.en: Yu Qiuli succeeded Huang Kecheng as Political Commissar of the PLA General Rear Services Department.

description.zh-cn: 1958年2月，余秋里接替李聚奎担任中华人民共和国石油工业部部长。随后在3月，李聚奎接替余秋里担任中国人民解放军总后方勤务部政治委员。
description.en: In February 1958, Yu Qiuli succeeded Li Jukui as Minister of Petroleum Industry of the People's Republic of China. Subsequently, in March, Li Jukui succeeded Yu Qiuli as Political Commissar of the PLA General Rear Services Department.

description.zh-cn: 姚依林接替余秋里担任中华人民共和国国家计划委员会主任。
description.en: Yao Yilin succeeded Yu Qiuli as Director of the State Planning Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 欧阳毅作为军管会主任接管了余秋里卸任后的中华人民共和国石油工业部。
description.en: Ouyang Yi, as the director of the military control committee, took over the Ministry of Petroleum Industry after Yu Qiuli stepped down.

description.zh-cn: 在天降大雪时劝谏齐景公，使其下令向国人发放粮食。
description.en: He advised Duke Jing of Qi during a heavy snowfall, leading the duke to order the distribution of grain to the people.

description.zh-cn: 孔丘称赞晏婴，说他“善与人交，久而敬之”，“果君子也”。
description.en: Confucius praised Yan Ying, saying he was 'good at interacting with people and was respected over time' and was 'truly a gentleman'.

description.zh-cn: 齐景公采纳了晏婴的计策，通过赏赐两个桃子来引发三位大将的争斗，最终导致了他们的死亡。
description.en: Duke Jing of Qi adopted Yan Ying's plan, using two peaches as a reward to incite conflict among the three generals, which ultimately led to their deaths.

description.zh-cn: 晏婴出生于齐国莱地夷维，即今高密县。
description.en: Yan Ying was born in Yiwei, Lai region, State of Qi, which corresponds to modern-day Gaomi County.

description.zh-cn: 李慧镝是李长春的儿子。
description.en: Li Huidi is the son of Li Changchun.

description.zh-cn: 李长春是中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: Li Changchun was a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 李慧镝籍贯辽宁省大连市。
description.en: Li Huidi's ancestral home is Dalian, Liaoning Province.

description.zh-cn: 1996年获得美国纽约大学理工学院电气工程硕士学位。
description.en: Received a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering from the Tandon School of Engineering at New York University in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 2008年获得香港理工大学管理学博士学位。
description.en: Received a Doctor of Management degree from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 李慧镝曾任UT斯达康的副总裁。
description.en: Li Huidi previously served as the Vice President of UTStarcom.

position.zh-cn: 曾任副总裁，后升任副总经理
position.en: Formerly Vice President, later promoted to Deputy General Manager

description.zh-cn: 李慧镝于2008年7月调任中国移动集团公司总裁助理。2010年1月，他升任副总裁，负责TD-SCDMA相关业务。2012年2月22日，他被任命为中国移动集团公司副总经理。
description.en: Li Huidi was transferred to China Mobile Communications Corporation as Assistant President in July 2008. In January 2010, he was promoted to Vice President, responsible for TD-SCDMA related business. On February 22, 2012, he was appointed Deputy General Manager.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中国移动副总裁期间，李慧镝负责TD-SCDMA相关业务。
description.en: While serving as Vice President of China Mobile, Li Huidi was responsible for business related to TD-SCDMA.

description.zh-cn: 2010年7月2日，李慧镝成为北京邮电大学的兼职教授。
description.en: On July 2, 2010, Li Huidi became an adjunct professor at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications.

description.zh-cn: 罗一秀是毛岸青的嫡母。
description.en: Luo Yixiu was Mao Anqing's formal stepmother.

description.zh-cn: 贺子珍是毛岸青的继母。
description.en: He Zizhen was Mao Anqing's stepmother.

description.zh-cn: 江青是毛岸青的继母。
description.en: Jiang Qing was Mao Anqing's stepmother.

description.zh-cn: 1932年大同幼稚园解散后，董健吾将毛岸英、毛岸青兄弟接到家中抚养。
description.en: After the Datong Kindergarten was dissolved in 1932, Dong Jianwu took the brothers Mao Anying and Mao Anqing into his home to raise them.

description.zh-cn: 应董健吾请求，张学良帮助安排将毛岸英、毛岸青兄弟送往苏联学习。
description.en: At the request of Dong Jianwu, Zhang Xueliang helped arrange for the brothers Mao Anying and Mao Anqing to be sent to the Soviet Union to study.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，李杜带领毛岸英、毛岸青等人，经法国前往苏联。
description.en: In 1936, Li Du led Mao Anying, Mao Anqing and others to the Soviet Union via France.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸英、毛岸青兄弟在抵达巴黎后，见到了专程前来迎接的中共驻共产国际代表团副团长康生。
description.en: After arriving in Paris, the brothers Mao Anying and Mao Anqing met Kang Sheng, deputy head of the CCP delegation to the Comintern, who had come specifically to welcome them.

description.zh-cn: 在苏德战争中，毛岸青参加了挖战壕、运伤员等支前活动。
description.en: During the Soviet-German War, Mao Anqing participated in support activities such as digging trenches and transporting the wounded.

description.zh-cn: 1947年到1948年，毛岸青在黑龙江省克山县进行土改工作。
description.en: From 1947 to 1948, Mao Anqing carried out land reform work in Keshan County, Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 2008年12月21日，毛岸青的骨灰迁葬于杨开慧烈士陵园内。
description.en: On December 21, 2008, Mao Anqing's ashes were moved and buried in the Yang Kaihui Martyrs' Cemetery.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾的籍贯为义阳棘阳。
description.en: Deng Ai's ancestral home was Jiyang, Yiyang Commandery.

position.en: Grand Marshal, General Who Conquers the West, etc.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾是曹魏后期的重要将领和官员。
description.en: Deng Ai was a prominent general and official in the late period of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 司马懿赏识邓艾的才能，将其辟为太尉府掾属，并升任尚书郎。
description.en: Sima Yi appreciated Deng Ai's talent, appointing him as an aide in the Grand Marshal's office and promoting him to Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾多年在曹魏西线防御并进攻蜀汉，最终率军灭蜀。
description.en: For many years, Deng Ai defended against and attacked Shu Han on Cao Wei's western front, eventually leading the army that conquered Shu.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾与姜维是长期的军事对手，在多次战役中交锋。
description.en: Deng Ai and Jiang Wei were long-term military adversaries who clashed in multiple battles.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾作为伐蜀主将之一，率军偷渡阴平，是灭蜀的关键。
description.en: As one of the main commanders of the Shu invasion, Deng Ai's infiltration via Yinping was the key to the conquest.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾率军奇袭成都，逼使蜀汉皇帝刘禅投降。
description.en: Deng Ai led a surprise attack on Chengdu, forcing the Shu Han emperor Liu Shan to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 钟会与邓艾向来不睦，在灭蜀后诬陷邓艾谋反，导致其被收捕。
description.en: Zhong Hui, who had a poor relationship with Deng Ai, falsely accused him of rebellion after the conquest of Shu, leading to his arrest.

description.zh-cn: 卫瓘联合钟会诬陷邓艾，并在钟会死后，为求自保派田续追杀邓艾父子。
description.en: Wei Guan colluded with Zhong Hui to frame Deng Ai, and after Zhong Hui's death, he sent Tian Xu to kill Deng Ai and his son to protect himself.

description.zh-cn: 司马昭因对邓艾居功自傲产生疑忌，听信钟会诬告后下令收捕邓艾。
description.en: Sima Zhao became suspicious of Deng Ai's arrogance and, believing Zhong Hui's accusations, ordered Deng Ai's arrest.

description.zh-cn: 田续奉卫瓘之命，于绵阳西将邓艾杀害。
description.en: Under Wei Guan's orders, Tian Xu killed Deng Ai west of Mianyang.

description.zh-cn: 田续奉卫瓘之命，将邓忠与其父邓艾一同杀害。
description.en: Under Wei Guan's orders, Tian Xu killed Deng Zhong along with his father Deng Ai.

description.zh-cn: 邓艾的死是钟会之乱所引发的权力斗争的直接后果之一。
description.en: Deng Ai's death was one of the direct consequences of the power struggle triggered by Zhong Hui's rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 钟会在其发动的叛乱中被部下所杀。
description.en: Zhong Hui was killed by his own subordinates during the rebellion he initiated.

description.zh-cn: 邓忠是邓艾的儿子。
description.en: Deng Zhong was the son of Deng Ai.

description.zh-cn: 邓朗是邓艾的孙子。
description.en: Deng Lang was the grandson of Deng Ai.

description.zh-cn: 田续奉卫瓘之命杀害邓艾。
description.en: Tian Xu killed Deng Ai under the orders of Wei Guan.

description.zh-cn: 晋武帝追念邓艾功绩，下诏赦免其孙邓朗，并任命他为郎中，为邓艾家族平反。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Jin, commemorating Deng Ai's achievements, pardoned his grandson Deng Lang, appointed him as a Gentleman of the Interior, and rehabilitated the Deng family.

description.zh-cn: 段灼向晋武帝上疏为邓艾鸣冤，称其“心怀至忠”，促进了邓艾的平反。
description.en: Duan Zhuo submitted a memorial to Emperor Wu of Jin to plead for Deng Ai's innocence, stating he was 'utterly loyal,' which contributed to his rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 唐彬在伐蜀前向司马昭报告称邓艾在陇右大失人心，此举可能加深了司马昭对邓艾的猜忌。
description.en: Before the conquest of Shu, Tang Bin reported to Sima Zhao that Deng Ai was very unpopular in the Longyou region, an act that likely deepened Sima Zhao's suspicion of Deng Ai.

description.zh-cn: 在狄道之战中，邓艾与陈泰的军队会合，共同抗击蜀军。
description.en: During the Battle of Didao, Deng Ai's army rendezvoused with Chen Tai's to jointly resist the Shu forces.

description.zh-cn: 美国财政部依照《全球马格尼茨基人权问责法》相关行政命令对彭家瑞实施制裁。
description.en: The U.S. Department of the Treasury sanctioned Peng Jiarui in accordance with the executive order related to the Global Magnitsky Human Rights Accountability Act.

description.zh-cn: 因参与侵犯人权，加拿大外交部宣布对彭家瑞实施制裁。
description.en: Global Affairs Canada announced sanctions against Peng Jiarui for his involvement in human rights violations.

description.zh-cn: 彭家瑞接替刘新齐出任新疆生产建设兵团司令员。
description.en: Peng Jiarui succeeded Liu Xinqi as the commander of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 薛斌接替彭家瑞出任新疆生产建设兵团司令员。
description.en: Xue Bin succeeded Peng Jiarui as the commander of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps.

description.zh-cn: 李鹏新接替彭家瑞出任中共新疆维吾尔自治区委员会秘书长。
description.en: Li Pengxin succeeded Peng Jiarui as the Secretary-General of the CCP Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Regional Committee.

description.zh-cn: 与孙金龙一同被美国财政部制裁。
description.en: Was sanctioned by the U.S. Department of the Treasury along with Sun Jinlong.

description.zh-cn: 在中国人民政治协商会议新疆维吾尔自治区委员会中，彭家瑞担任副主席，努尔兰·阿不都满金为时任主席。
description.en: In the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Committee of the CPPCC, Peng Jiarui served as Vice Chairman while Nurlan Abelmanjin was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 在新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府中，彭家瑞担任副主席，雪克来提·扎克尔为时任主席。
description.en: In the People's Government of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, Peng Jiarui served as Vice Chairman while Shohrat Zakir was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 在新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府中，彭家瑞担任副主席，艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜为时任主席。
description.en: In the People's Government of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, Peng Jiarui served as Vice Chairman while Erkin Tuniyaz was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，张汉夫是陕西绥德人。
description.en: According to the text, Zhang Hanfu is from Suide, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 张汉夫曾担任中华人民共和国人事部副部长。
description.en: Zhang Hanfu served as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 张汉夫曾任第八届、第九届全国政协委员。
description.en: Zhang Hanfu was a member of the 8th and 9th National Committees of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，张汉夫是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the page's category information, Zhang Hanfu is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 16岁时受文化大革命影响，黄奇帆被迫辍学进入工厂当工人。
description.en: At the age of 16, affected by the Cultural Revolution, Huang Qifan was forced to drop out of school and become a factory worker.

description.zh-cn: 1974年被推荐到原上海机械学院仪器仪表系自动化仪表专业学习。
description.en: In 1974, he was recommended to study in the Automation Instrumentation major of the Instrumentation Department at the former Shanghai Institute of Mechanical Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央任命黄奇帆为中共重庆市委副书记，提名为重庆市市长候选人。
description.en: The CPC Central Committee appointed Huang Qifan as Deputy Secretary of the CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee and nominated him as a candidate for Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 黄奇帆在薄熙来担任中共重庆市委书记期间任重庆市市长。
description.en: Huang Qifan served as the Mayor of Chongqing while Bo Xilai was the Party Secretary of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 黄奇帆在张德江担任中共重庆市委书记期间任重庆市市长。
description.en: Huang Qifan served as the Mayor of Chongqing while Zhang Dejiang was the Party Secretary of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 黄奇帆在孙政才担任中共重庆市委书记期间任重庆市市长。
description.en: Huang Qifan served as the Mayor of Chongqing while Sun Zhengcai was the Party Secretary of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，在黄奇帆辞去市长职务时，其工作得到了时任市委书记孙政才的高度评价。
description.en: Reportedly, when Huang Qifan resigned as mayor, his work was highly praised by then-Party Secretary Sun Zhengcai.

description.zh-cn: 黄奇帆在上海任职期间，吴邦国是中共上海市委书记。
description.en: During Huang Qifan's tenure in Shanghai, Wu Bangguo was the Party Secretary of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 黄奇帆在上海任职期间，黄菊是中共上海市委书记。
description.en: During Huang Qifan's tenure in Shanghai, Huang Ju was the Party Secretary of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 黄奇帆接替王鸿举担任中共重庆市委副书记及重庆市市长职务。
description.en: Huang Qifan succeeded Wang Hongju as the Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 陪同中华人民共和国主席习近平访问美国。
description.en: Accompanied President of the People's Republic of China Xi Jinping on a visit to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省妇女联合会是中华全国妇女联合会的地方组织。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial Women's Federation is a local organization of the All-China Women's Federation.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省妇女联合会接受中国共产党安徽省委员会的领导。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial Women's Federation is under the leadership of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 安徽省妇女联合会是中华人民共和国安徽省妇女儿童工作者组成的人民团体。
description.en: The Anhui Provincial Women's Federation is a people's organization composed of women and children workers in Anhui Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 台湾高等法院在组织上直属司法院。
description.en: The Taiwan High Court is organizationally under the direct jurisdiction of the Judicial Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾高等法院的审级上诉法院为最高法院。
description.en: The appellate court for the Taiwan High Court is the Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战结束后，中华民国国民政府接收台湾。
description.en: After the end of World War II, the Nationalist Government of the Republic of China took over Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1945年接收台湾后，将台湾总督府高等法院改制并命名为台湾高等法院。
description.en: After taking over Taiwan in 1945, the Governor-General of Taiwan High Court was reorganized and renamed the Taiwan High Court.

description.zh-cn: 1945年，司法行政部派遣杨鹏为首任台湾高等法院院长，来台接收各级法院。
description.en: In 1945, the Ministry of Judicial Administration dispatched Yang Peng to be the first President of the Taiwan High Court to take over the courts in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 台湾基隆地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
台湾宜兰地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
台湾台北地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
台湾新北地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
台湾士林地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
台湾桃园地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
台湾新竹地方法院是台湾高等法院的辖区法院之一。
在梁振英担任行政长官期间，李家超任保安局副局长。
description.en: John Lee served as the Under Secretary for Security during Leung Chun-ying's tenure as Chief Executive.

description.zh-cn: 因在反对逃犯条例修订草案运动期间压制示威，美国财政部宣布对包括李家超在内的11名中港官员实施制裁。此制裁导致其竞选YouTube频道被停用。
description.en: Due to his role in suppressing protests during the anti-extradition bill movement, the U.S. Department of the Treasury announced sanctions against 11 Hong Kong and mainland officials, including John Lee. These sanctions led to the termination of his election campaign's YouTube channel.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府发布第13936号行政命令，授权对损害香港自治的中港官员进行制裁。
description.en: The U.S. government issued Executive Order 13936, authorizing sanctions against Hong Kong and mainland officials undermining Hong Kong's autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 因应美国的制裁令，Google公司旗下的YouTube平台停用了李家超的个人竞选频道。
description.en: In compliance with U.S. sanctions, Google's YouTube platform terminated John Lee's personal campaign channel.

description.zh-cn: 图赖是费英东的第七子。
description.en: Tulai was the seventh son of Fiongdon.

description.zh-cn: 费英东是后金开国五大臣之一。
description.en: Fiongdon was one of the Five Founding Ministers of Later Jin.

description.zh-cn: 费英东早年归附努尔哈赤，努尔哈赤授其为扎尔固齐，并将自己的孙女嫁给他。
description.en: Fiongdon submitted to Nurhaci early in his life. Nurhaci appointed him as a 'jarguci' (judge) and married his granddaughter to him.

description.zh-cn: 费英东曾征讨乌喇。
description.en: Fiongdon campaigned against the Ula tribe.

description.zh-cn: 费英东曾征讨叶赫。
description.en: Fiongdon campaigned against the Yehe tribe.

description.zh-cn: 图赖率军征福建，消灭了南明隆武政权。
description.en: Tulai led an army to conquer Fujian and destroyed the Southern Ming's Longwu regime.

description.zh-cn: 鳌拜在征锦州时屡次击败洪承畴所率领的明军。
description.en: During the campaign for Jinzhou, Oboi repeatedly defeated the Ming forces led by Hong Chengchou.

description.zh-cn: 鳌拜在征锦州时屡次击败吴三桂所率领的明军。
description.en: During the campaign for Jinzhou, Oboi repeatedly defeated the Ming forces led by Wu Sangui.

description.zh-cn: 鳌拜曾统兵平定姜瓖的叛乱。
description.en: Oboi once led troops to suppress the rebellion of Jiang Xiang.

description.zh-cn: 鳌拜在征讨大西军时阵斩其首领张献忠。
description.en: During the campaign against the Daxi army, Oboi killed its leader Zhang Xianzhong in battle.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝追念鳌拜功绩，恢复其一等公爵，并加封号为超武公。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor, in recognition of Oboi's merits, restored his title of First-Class Duke and bestowed upon him the title 'Chaowu Gong' (Duke of Transcendent Valor).

description.zh-cn: 演员关之琳是演员关山的女儿。
description.en: Actress Rosamund Kwan is the daughter of actor Guan Shan.

description.zh-cn: 蔡崇信是阿里巴巴集团的创始人之一。
description.en: Joseph Tsai is one of the co-founders of Alibaba Group.

description.zh-cn: 蔡崇信于2023年9月正式履新阿里巴巴集团董事局主席。
description.en: Joseph Tsai formally took office as the Chairman of the Board of Alibaba Group in September 2023.

description.zh-cn: 张勇接替马云担任阿里巴巴集团董事局主席。
description.en: Daniel Zhang succeeded Jack Ma as the Chairman of the Board of Alibaba Group.

description.zh-cn: 软银集团是阿里巴巴集团的早期主要投资者和长期大股东。
description.en: SoftBank Group is an early major investor and long-term large shareholder of Alibaba Group.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团于2003年5月投资1亿元人民币建立网上购物平台淘宝网。
description.en: Alibaba Group invested 100 million RMB in May 2003 to establish the online shopping platform Taobao.

description.zh-cn: 2011年6月，阿里巴巴集团将淘宝网分拆为三个独立公司，其中包括淘宝商城，后更名为天猫。
description.en: In June 2011, Alibaba Group split Taobao into three independent companies, including Taobao Mall, which was later renamed Tmall.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团于2013年3月宣布筹备成立阿里小微金融服务集团，后更名为蚂蚁集团。
description.en: Alibaba Group announced in March 2013 the preparation for the establishment of Ali Small and Micro Financial Services Group, which was later renamed Ant Group.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团于2009年9月成立子公司阿里云计算。
description.en: Alibaba Group established its subsidiary Alibaba Cloud Computing in September 2009.

description.zh-cn: 菜鸟网络于2013年由阿里巴巴集团牵头成立。
description.en: Cainiao Network was founded in 2013, led by Alibaba Group.

description.zh-cn: 因实施“二选一”等涉嫌垄断行为，国家市场监管总局对阿里巴巴集团进行立案调查，并于2021年4月处以182.28亿元人民币罚款。整改工作于2024年8月宣布完成。
description.en: Due to monopolistic behaviors such as 'choose one of two', the State Administration for Market Regulation launched an investigation into Alibaba Group, and imposed a fine of 18.228 billion RMB in April 2021. The rectification was announced as complete in August 2024.

description.zh-cn: 上海证券交易所发布决定，暂缓蚂蚁集团在科创板的上市。
description.en: The Shanghai Stock Exchange issued a decision to suspend Ant Group's listing on the STAR Market.

description.zh-cn: 香港交易所发表声明，暂缓蚂蚁集团H股上市。
description.en: The Hong Kong Stock Exchange issued a statement to suspend the H-share listing of Ant Group.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团于2014年9月19日在纽约证券交易所挂牌上市。
description.en: Alibaba Group was listed on the New York Stock Exchange on September 19, 2014.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团全资收购合一集团（原优酷土豆集团）。此前已于2014年4月入股。
description.en: Alibaba Group fully acquired HeYi Group (formerly Youku Tudou Group). It had previously invested in the company in April 2014.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团全面收购高德软件并将其私有化。此前已于2013年5月入股。
description.en: Alibaba Group fully acquired AutoNavi (Gaode Software) and privatized it. It had previously invested in the company in May 2013.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴联合蚂蚁金服以95亿美元全资收购饿了么。
description.en: Alibaba, together with Ant Financial, fully acquired Ele.me for US$9.5 billion.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团于2016年入股Lazada成为最大股东，并于2017年增持股份至83%。
description.en: Alibaba Group invested in Lazada in 2016 to become its largest shareholder and increased its stake to 83% in 2017.

description.zh-cn: 阿里巴巴集团收购南华早报集团的媒体资产。
description.en: Alibaba Group acquired the media assets of the South China Morning Post Group.

description.zh-cn: 禹元植当选为韩国第22届国会第1任议长。
在禹元植担任国会议长期间，李学永担任其副手。
在禹元植担任国会议长期间，朱豪英担任其副手。
禹元植接替金振杓成为韩国国会议长。

degree.zh-cn: 土木工程学士学位, 环境工程专业硕士学位

description.zh-cn: 禹元植于1997年获得延世大学学士学位，2009年获得硕士学位。
1981年，在全斗焕政权下，禹元植因参加抗议活动要求全斗焕辞职而被逮捕并判处三年刑事劳动。
在担任国会议员期间，禹元植提案废除国家保安法。
韩国大法院于2004年确认了国家保安法的持久性。
2017年，禹元植在共同民主党院内代表选举中击败洪永杓。
禹元植曾担任特别听证委员会的反对派管理员，负责审查任命黄教安为国务总理一事。
为抗议日本排放福岛核废水，禹元植于2023年7月进行了为期两周的绝食抗议。
反对国际原子能机构认为日本排放福岛核废水计划安全的裁决。
作为国会议长，禹元植主持通过了针对总统尹锡悦的弹劾议案。
禹元植裁定只需简单多数即可弹劾国务总理韩悳洙，为弹劾案通过铺平了道路。
禹元植访问中华人民共和国期间与中共中央总书记习近平会面。
禹元植访问中华人民共和国期间与全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际会面。
禹元植访问中国参加活动期间与朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩进行了简短对话。
阿布·穆萨布·扎卡维于1999年建立了“统一圣战组织”，该组织是伊斯兰国的前身。
description.en: Abu Musab al-Zarqawi founded 'Jama'at al-Tawhid wal-Jihad' in 1999, the predecessor organization to the Islamic State.

description.zh-cn: 阿布·穆萨布·扎卡维在2006年6月7日遭美军空袭炸死。
description.en: Abu Musab al-Zarqawi was killed in a US airstrike on June 7, 2006.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰国的前身“统一圣战组织”于2004年10月宣布效忠基地组织，成为其伊拉克分支。2014年2月，基地组织宣布与其断绝所有联系。
description.en: The Islamic State's predecessor, 'Jama'at al-Tawhid wal-Jihad', pledged allegiance to Al-Qaeda in October 2004, becoming its Iraqi branch. In February 2014, Al-Qaeda announced it was severing all ties with the group.

description.zh-cn: 2014年2月，基地组织因认为伊斯兰国过于极端、残忍，宣布与其切断所有联系，并谴责其恶行。
description.en: In February 2014, Al-Qaeda severed all ties with the Islamic State, deeming it too extreme and brutal, and condemned its actions.

description.zh-cn: 2010年4月18日，阿布·艾尤卜·穆哈吉尔被美国和伊拉克联军击毙。
description.en: On April 18, 2010, Abu Ayyub al-Masri was killed by joint US and Iraqi forces.

description.zh-cn: 2010年4月18日，阿布·艾尤卜·穆哈吉尔被美国和伊拉克联军击毙。
description.en: On April 18, 2010, Abu Ayyub al-Masri was killed by joint US and Iraqi forces.

description.zh-cn: 2013年4月，巴格达迪单方面宣布合并“伊拉克伊斯兰国”和“努斯拉阵线”，但遭到努斯拉阵线成员反对，两者最终决裂。
description.en: In April 2013, Baghdadi unilaterally announced the merger of the 'Islamic State of Iraq' and the 'Al-Nusra Front', but members of the Nusra Front opposed it, leading to a final split.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰国的领导人声称，2003年发动的伊拉克战争是他们发起对美国圣战的原因。
description.en: Leaders of the Islamic State claimed that the 2003 Iraq War was the reason for them to launch a jihad against the United States.

description.zh-cn: 沙特阿拉伯等海湾逊尼派国家被指对伊斯兰国提供了或明或暗的支持和资助，以对抗什叶派国家。
description.en: Gulf Sunni states like Saudi Arabia have been accused of providing overt or covert support and funding to the Islamic State to counter Shia nations.

description.zh-cn: 卡达等海湾逊尼派国家被指对伊斯兰国提供了或明或暗的支持和资助，以对抗什叶派国家。
description.en: Gulf Sunni states like Qatar have been accused of providing overt or covert support and funding to the Islamic State to counter Shia nations.

description.zh-cn: 2019年3月23日，叙利亚民主力量攻克了伊斯兰国在叙利亚的最后据点巴古斯村，终结了其有形领土的统治。
description.en: On March 23, 2019, the Syrian Democratic Forces captured the village of Baghuz, the last stronghold of the Islamic State in Syria, ending its territorial rule.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚民主力量是受美国支持的叙利亚反政府武装势力。
description.en: The Syrian Democratic Forces are a US-backed Syrian opposition armed force.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰国于2019年4月23日宣称对斯里兰卡发生的连环爆炸案负责。
description.en: The Islamic State claimed responsibility on April 23, 2019, for the series of bombings in Sri Lanka.

description.zh-cn: 在巴里沙突袭行动中，伊斯兰国领导人阿布·贝克尔·巴格达迪丧生。
description.en: In the Barisha raid, Islamic State leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi was killed.

description.zh-cn: 巴里沙突袭是美军于叙利亚伊德利卜地区发起的一次军事行动。
description.en: The Barisha raid was a military operation launched by US forces in Syria's Idlib region.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国总统唐纳德·川普宣布了巴里沙突袭行动的结果。
description.en: Then-U.S. President Donald Trump announced the results of the Barisha raid.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰国第二任哈里发阿布·易卜拉欣·哈希米·库拉希在美军发起的突袭行动中自杀身亡。
description.en: The second Caliph of the Islamic State, Abu Ibrahim al-Hashimi al-Qurashi, killed himself during a raid launched by US forces.

description.zh-cn: 2015年3月7日，尼日利亚恐怖组织博科圣地宣布效忠伊斯兰国。
description.en: On March 7, 2015, the Nigerian terrorist organization Boko Haram pledged allegiance to the Islamic State.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰国与塔利班相互敌视，巴格达迪曾辱骂塔利班领袖，塔利班则发布教令宣布伊斯兰国为非法组织，双方在阿富汗发生过武装冲突。
description.en: The Islamic State and the Taliban are hostile to each other. Baghdadi insulted the Taliban leader, and the Taliban issued a fatwa declaring the Islamic State an illegal organization. The two sides have engaged in armed conflict in Afghanistan.

description.zh-cn: 2015年1月，巴格达迪称塔利班领袖穆罕默德·奥马尔是“傻瓜和无知的军阀”。
description.en: In January 2015, Baghdadi called Taliban leader Mohammed Omar 'a fool and an ignorant warlord'.

description.zh-cn: 自2015年起，俄军针对伊斯兰国的石油设施及运输能力进行了大量空袭，导致其石油收入大减。
description.en: Since 2015, the Russian military has conducted extensive airstrikes against the Islamic State's oil facilities and transport capabilities, leading to a significant reduction in its oil revenue.

description.zh-cn: 2014年11月，美国对伊拉克的一次空袭打死了伊斯兰国组织的3名头目，其中包括二号人物阿布·穆斯利姆·图尔克马尼。
description.en: In November 2014, a US airstrike in Iraq killed three leaders of the Islamic State, including the second-in-command, Abu Muslim al-Turkmani.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰国将美国视为主要敌人，并因伊拉克战争而对其发起圣战。美国则领导多国联盟对伊斯兰国进行军事打击。
description.en: The Islamic State considers the United States a primary enemy and launched a jihad against it due to the Iraq War. The U.S. leads a multinational coalition conducting military strikes against the Islamic State.

description.zh-cn: 妇女保护部队是一个全女性的库尔德民兵组织，在叙利亚与伊斯兰国作战。
description.en: The Women's Protection Units (YPJ) is an all-female Kurdish militia that fights against the Islamic State in Syria.

description.zh-cn: 王洪斌于2007年1月至2013年3月期间担任平江县人民政府县长。
description.en: Wang Hongbin served as the County Magistrate of the Pingjiang County People's Government from January 2007 to March 2013.

description.zh-cn: 黄伟雄于2014年10月至2021年8月期间担任平江县人民政府县长。
description.en: Huang Weixiong served as the County Magistrate of the Pingjiang County People's Government from October 2014 to August 2021.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，平江县人民政府的业务上级机构是岳阳市人民政府。
description.en: According to the infobox, the operational superior of the Pingjiang County People's Government is the Yueyang Municipal People's Government.

position.en: Party Leadership Group Member, Vice Governor

description.zh-cn: 2022年5月27日至2022年7月3日，刘文玺担任河北省人民政府党组成员、副省长。
description.en: From May 27, 2022, to July 3, 2022, Liu Wenxi served as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Governor of the Hebei Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 2022年5月至2022年7月，刘文玺担任河北省公安厅党委书记、厅长、督察长。
description.en: From May 2022 to July 2022, Liu Wenxi served as Party Secretary, Director, and Inspector General of the Hebei Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 刘文玺曾担任公安部经济犯罪侦查局副局长。
description.en: Liu Wenxi once served as Deputy Director of the Economic Crime Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 2022年唐山烧烤店打人事件发生于刘文玺上任河北省公安厅厅长后不久，给他带来了巨大的工作压力。
description.en: The 2022 Tangshan barbecue restaurant assault occurred shortly after Liu Wenxi took office as the Director of the Hebei Provincial Public Security Department, bringing him immense work pressure.

description.zh-cn: 刘文玺接替刘凯担任河北省公安厅厅长职务。
description.en: Liu Wenxi succeeded Liu Kai as the Director of the Hebei Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 董晓宇在刘文玺去世后接任河北省公安厅厅长职务。
description.en: Dong Xiaoyu succeeded Liu Wenxi as the Director of the Hebei Provincial Public Security Department after Liu's death.

description.zh-cn: 韩芝俊是华国锋的妻子。
description.en: Han Zhijun is the wife of Hua Guofeng.

description.zh-cn: 王冶坪是江泽民的妻子。
description.en: Wang Yeping is the wife of Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 林佳楣是李先念的妻子。
description.en: Lin Jiamei is the wife of Li Xiannian.

description.zh-cn: 宋庆龄是孙中山的妻子。
description.en: Soong Ching-ling is the wife of Sun Yat-sen.

description.zh-cn: 在2013年习近平携彭丽媛出访期间，人民网等官方媒体以“中国第一夫人”称呼彭丽媛，引发了中国的“第一夫人热”，提升了其公众形象。
description.en: During Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan's state visits in 2013, official media outlets such as People's Daily Online referred to Peng Liyuan as 'China's First Lady', triggering a 'First Lady fever' in China and enhancing her public image.

description.zh-cn: 在2013年习近平携彭丽媛出访期间，《环球时报》等官方媒体以“中国第一夫人”称呼彭丽媛，引发了中国的“第一夫人热”，提升了其公众形象。
description.en: During Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan's state visits in 2013, official media outlets such as Global Times referred to Peng Liyuan as 'China's First Lady', triggering a 'First Lady fever' in China and enhancing her public image.

description.zh-cn: 崇德元年（1636年），皇太极创立了理藩院的前身“蒙古衙门”，以处理日益增多的归附蒙古部落事务。
description.en: In the first year of Chongde (1636), Hong Taiji established the Mongol Yamen, the predecessor of the Lifan Yuan, to handle the affairs of the increasing number of submitting Mongol tribes.

description.zh-cn: 在顺治年间，理藩院一度附属于礼部，其官员兼任礼部官衔，直至顺治十八年（1661年）才成为与六部平行的独立部门。
description.en: During the Shunzhi reign, the Lifan Yuan was subordinate to the Ministry of Rites, and its officials held concurrent titles from the Ministry of Rites until it became an independent department parallel to the Six Ministries in the eighteenth year of Shunzhi (1661).

description.zh-cn: 顺治元年（1644年），顺治帝将理藩院的长官名称由“承政”改为“尚书”，副长官由“参政”改为“侍郎”，对其组织架构进行了调整。
description.en: In the first year of Shunzhi (1644), the Shunzhi Emperor changed the title of the head of the Lifan Yuan from 'Chengzheng' to 'Shangshu' (Minister) and the deputy head from 'Canzheng' to 'Shilang' (Vice Minister), adjusting its organizational structure.

description.zh-cn: 在总理各国事务衙门成立前，理藩院负责管理与俄罗斯帝国的相关事务。
description.en: Before the establishment of the Zongli Yamen, the Lifan Yuan was responsible for managing affairs related to the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 作为清末新政官制改革的一部分，理藩院于光绪三十二年（1906年）七月被改组为理藩部，以适应新的行政需求。
description.en: As part of the government reform of the Late Qing Reforms, the Lifan Yuan was reorganized into the Lifan Bu in July of the thirty-second year of Guangxu (1906) to meet new administrative needs.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命导致清朝覆灭，理藩部随之被撤销。
description.en: The Xinhai Revolution led to the fall of the Qing dynasty, and the Lifan Bu was subsequently abolished.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国建立后，在五族共和的理念下，处理外藩事务的理藩部失去了存在的必要，最终被废除。
description.en: After the establishment of the Republic of China, under the concept of 'Five Races Under One Union', the Lifan Bu, which handled the affairs of outer feudatories, lost its reason for existence and was eventually abolished.

description.zh-cn: 光绪三十三年（1907年）九月，寿耆出任改名后的理藩部尚书。
description.en: In September of the thirty-third year of Guangxu (1907), Shouqi was appointed as the Minister (Shangshu) of the renamed Lifan Bu.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆二十六年（1761年），理藩院增设徕远清吏司，以掌管回部扎萨克及四川土司等事务，扩大了其组织架构。
description.en: In the twenty-sixth year of Qianlong (1761), the Lifan Yuan added the Laiyuan Qinglisi to manage the affairs of the Hui Zhasake and Sichuan Tusi, expanding its organizational structure.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院负责管理清代西藏地区的行政事务及对朝廷关系。
description.en: The Lifan Yuan was responsible for managing the administrative affairs of the Tibet region and its relationship with the imperial court during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院负责管理清代青海地区的蒙古族部落等事务。
description.en: The Lifan Yuan was responsible for managing the affairs of Mongol tribes in the Qinghai region during the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院是清朝管理新疆回部及其他少数民族事务的行政机关。
description.en: The Lifan Yuan was the administrative organ of the Qing dynasty for managing the affairs of the Muslim regions (Huibu) of Xinjiang and other ethnic minorities.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院执掌的“外藩”事务包括对南亚廓尔喀等朝贡国的管理。
description.en: The 'outer feudatory' affairs managed by the Lifan Yuan included the administration of tributary states such as the Gorkha Kingdom in South Asia.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院执掌的“外藩”事务包括对中亚哈萨克等汗国的管理。
description.en: The 'outer feudatory' affairs managed by the Lifan Yuan included the administration of Central Asian khanates such as the Kazakh Khanate.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院执掌的“外藩”事务包括对中亚浩罕等汗国的管理。
description.en: The 'outer feudatory' affairs managed by the Lifan Yuan included the administration of Central Asian khanates such as the Khanate of Kokand.

description.zh-cn: 蒙藏院是理藩部在中华民国时期的后继机关。
description.en: The Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Bureau was the successor institution to the Lifan Bu during the Republic of China era.

description.zh-cn: 蒙藏院于1928年改制为中华民国蒙藏委员会。
description.en: The Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Bureau was reorganized into the Mongolian and Tibetan Affairs Commission of the Republic of China in 1928.

description.zh-cn: 理藩院是清朝掌管外藩事务的中央政府机构。
description.en: The Lifan Yuan was a central government agency of the Qing Dynasty in charge of the affairs of the outer feudatories.

description.zh-cn: 现任台北市市长。
description.en: Current Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 蒋万安是中国国民党籍政治人物。
description.en: Chiang Wan-an is a politician of the Kuomintang (KMT).

description.zh-cn: 在1967年至1994年期间，台北市长由总统任命。
description.en: Between 1967 and 1994, the Mayor of Taipei was appointed by the President.

description.zh-cn: 在1994年以前，台北市长由行政院会议提名。
description.en: Before 1994, the Mayor of Taipei was nominated by the Executive Yuan Council.

description.zh-cn: 田健治郎曾任台湾总督。
description.en: Den Kenjirō served as the Governor-General of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 以律令第三号发布《台湾州制》。
description.en: Promulgated the 'Taiwan Prefecture System' as Ordinance No. 3.

description.zh-cn: 以律令第五号发布《台湾市制》。
description.en: Promulgated the 'Taiwan City System' as Ordinance No. 5.

description.zh-cn: 中川健藏曾任台湾总督。
description.en: Nakagawa Kenzō served as the Governor-General of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 以律令第三号发布《台湾市制》，确立台北市的法人地位。
description.en: Promulgated the 'Taiwan City System' as Ordinance No. 3, establishing the legal personality of Taipei City.

description.zh-cn: 首任州辖市时期台北市市尹。
description.en: First Shīin (mayor) of Taipei during the provincial city period under Japanese rule.

description.zh-cn: 就任台北市市尹前担任新竹厅厅长。
description.en: Served as the Administrator of Shinchiku Chō before becoming the Shīin of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 卸任台北市市尹后改任台湾总督府土木局局长。
description.en: After leaving the post of Taipei Shīin, he was appointed Director of the Civil Engineering Bureau of the Government-General of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 任内官制改正，市尹改称市长。
description.en: During his term, the official title was changed from Shīin to Mayor.

description.zh-cn: 任命黄朝琴兼任台北市市长。
description.en: Appointed Huang Chao-chin as the concurrent Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 首任省辖市市长。
description.en: First mayor of the provincial city.

description.zh-cn: 时任台湾省政府主席的吴国桢推荐吴三连担任台北市长。
description.en: Wu Kuo-chen, then Governor of Taiwan Provincial Government, recommended Wu San-lien for the mayorship of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 时任立法委员的蔡培火推荐吴三连担任台北市长。
description.en: Tsai Pei-huo, then a member of the Legislative Yuan, recommended Wu San-lien for the mayorship of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 官派省辖市市长，无党籍。
description.en: Appointed mayor of the provincial city, independent.

description.zh-cn: 民选省辖市市长，无党籍。
description.en: Elected mayor of the provincial city, independent.

description.zh-cn: 民选省辖市市长，任期因涉弊案而中断。
description.en: Elected mayor of the provincial city, his term was interrupted due to a corruption case.

description.zh-cn: 就任台北市长前为高雄市市长。
description.en: Served as Mayor of Kaohsiung before becoming Mayor of Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 先代理市长，后获市议会通过转正。
description.en: First served as acting mayor, then was officially confirmed by the city council.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲担任台北市第六、七届市长。第一任期为无党籍，与民主进步党整合；第二任期为无党籍，后加入台湾民众党。
description.en: Ko Wen-je served as the 6th and 7th-term Mayor of Taipei. In his first term, he was an independent aligned with the Democratic Progressive Party; in his second term, he was an independent and later joined the Taiwan People's Party.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲于第二届市长任期中创立并加入台湾民众党，并担任该党第一、二届党主席，后于2025年1月1日请辞。
description.en: Ko Wen-je founded and joined the Taiwan People's Party during his second term as mayor, serving as its first and second-term chairman. He resigned on January 1, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民于1946年4月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Jiang Zemin joined the Chinese Communist Party in April 1946.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民担任第十三届（四中全会起）、十四届、十五届中共中央总书记。
description.en: Jiang Zemin served as General Secretary of the 13th (from the 4th Plenary Session), 14th, and 15th Central Committees of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平的支持下，江泽民在中共十四大上解除了杨尚昆及其弟杨白冰的军职，巩固了对军队的控制，此事被称为“杨家将事件”。
description.en: With Deng Xiaoping's support, Jiang Zemin removed Yang Shangkun and his brother Yang Baibing from their military posts at the 14th Party Congress, consolidating his control over the army in what became known as the 'Yang Family Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平的支持下，江泽民在中共十四大上解除了杨白冰及其兄杨尚昆的军职，巩固了对军队的控制，此事被称为“杨家将事件”。
description.en: With Deng Xiaoping's support, Jiang Zemin removed Yang Baibing and his brother Yang Shangkun from their military posts at the 14th Party Congress, consolidating his control over the army in what became known as the 'Yang Family Incident'.

description.zh-cn: 江世俊是江泽民的生父。
description.en: Jiang Shijun was Jiang Zemin's biological father.

description.zh-cn: 王乐泉于1994年9月24日接替宋汉良，代理新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记一职。
description.en: Wang Lequan succeeded Song Hanliang on September 24, 1994, as the acting Party Committee Secretary of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region.

position.zh-cn: 党组副书记、常务副院长
position.en: Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group, Executive Vice President

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext，于泽荣曾任中央社会主义学院党组副书记、常务副院长。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Yu Zerong served as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Executive Vice President of the Central Institute of Socialism.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext，于泽荣曾任中华海外联谊会副秘书长。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Yu Zerong served as the Deputy Secretary-General of the China Overseas Friendship Association.

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext，于泽荣是第十届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Yu Zerong was a member of the 10th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国共产党党员”，于泽荣是中国共产党的成员。
description.en: According to the page category 'Members of the Communist Party of China', Yu Zerong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“北京大学附属中学校友”，于泽荣是北京大学附属中学的校友。
description.en: According to the page category 'Alumni of The High School Affiliated to Peking University', Yu Zerong is an alumnus of The High School Affiliated to Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“北京航空学院校友”，于泽荣是北京航空学院（现北京航空航天大学）的校友。
description.en: According to the page category 'Alumni of Beijing Institute of Aeronautics', Yu Zerong is an alumnus of Beijing Institute of Aeronautics (now Beihang University).

position.en: Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee, Vice President

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类，于泽荣曾担任北京航空航天大学党委副书记和副校长。
description.en: According to the page categories, Yu Zerong served as Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee and Vice President of Beihang University.

description.zh-cn: 担任台湾民主自治同盟浙江省第六届委员会主任委员。
description.en: Serves as the Chairperson of the 6th Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League.

description.zh-cn: 担任台湾民主自治同盟浙江省第六届委员会副主任委员。
description.en: Serves as a Vice Chairperson of the 6th Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民主自治同盟浙江省委员会是台湾民主自治同盟中央委员会的下级组织。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League is a subordinate organization to the Central Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民主自治同盟浙江省委员会是台湾民主自治同盟的地方组织。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League is a local organization of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League.

description.zh-cn: 台湾民主自治同盟浙江省委员会属于民主党派的地方组织。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Taiwan Democratic Self-Government League is a local organization belonging to the category of democratic parties.

description.zh-cn: 黑龙江省财政厅是黑龙江省人民政府的上级机构。
description.en: The Department of Finance of Heilongjiang Province is a subordinate agency of the People's Government of Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 刘振林担任黑龙江省财政厅副厅长。
description.en: Liu Zhenlin serves as the Deputy Director of the Department of Finance of Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 王宇担任黑龙江省财政厅副厅长。
description.en: Wang Yu serves as the Deputy Director of the Department of Finance of Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 李继纯于2001年12月至2010年4月期间担任黑龙江省财政厅厅长。
description.en: Li Jichun served as the Director of the Department of Finance of Heilongjiang Province from December 2001 to April 2010.

description.zh-cn: 王庆江于2010年4月至2016年10月期间担任黑龙江省财政厅厅长。
description.en: Wang Qingjiang served as the Director of the Department of Finance of Heilongjiang Province from April 2010 to October 2016.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学依据其创建人约翰斯·霍普金斯的遗嘱，使用其700万美元遗产的一半建立。
description.en: Johns Hopkins University was established with half of the $7 million estate bequeathed by its founder, Johns Hopkins.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯医院依据其创建人约翰斯·霍普金斯的遗嘱，使用其700万美元遗产的一半建立。
description.en: The Johns Hopkins Hospital was established with half of the $7 million estate bequeathed by its founder, Johns Hopkins.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学采用了德国海德堡大学的研究所概念，成为美国第一所研究型大学。
description.en: Johns Hopkins University adopted the research institute concept from Germany's Heidelberg University, becoming the first research university in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学在创建时仿照了以柏林洪堡大学为代表的德国大学模式。
description.en: At its founding, Johns Hopkins University was modeled after the German university system, as represented by Humboldt University of Berlin.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的理念和模式对后来的美国大学产生了巨大的影响，芝加哥大学是其中的典型例子。
description.en: The philosophy and model of Johns Hopkins University had a great influence on later American universities, with the University of Chicago being a typical example.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学是美洲大学协会的14所创始校之一。
description.en: Johns Hopkins University is one of the 14 founding members of the Association of American Universities.

description.zh-cn: 1917年，北京协和医学院以约翰斯·霍普金斯大学医学院为蓝本建立。
description.en: In 1917, Peking Union Medical College was established, modeled on the Johns Hopkins School of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·亨利·韦尔奇是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学医学院的首任院长。
description.en: William H. Welch was the first dean of the Johns Hopkins School of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·亨利·韦尔奇是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学公共卫生学院的首任院长。
description.en: William H. Welch was the first dean of the Johns Hopkins School of Public Health.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·亨利·韦尔奇出任协和医学院的创始院长。
description.en: William H. Welch served as the founding dean of Peking Union Medical College.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学公共卫生学院于2001年更名为布隆伯格公共卫生学院，以表彰其主要资助者麦克·彭博。
description.en: The Johns Hopkins School of Public Health was renamed the Bloomberg School of Public Health in 2001 to honor its major benefactor, Michael Bloomberg.

description.zh-cn: 麦克·彭博被列为约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的知名校友。
description.en: Michael Bloomberg is listed as a notable alumnus of Johns Hopkins University.

description.zh-cn: Daniel Gilman是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的首任校长。
description.en: Daniel Gilman was the first president of Johns Hopkins University.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国第14任副总统陈建仁是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的校友。
description.en: Chen Chien-jen, the 14th Vice President of the Republic of China, is an alumnus of Johns Hopkins University.

description.zh-cn: 台湾政治人物张博雅是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的校友。
description.en: Taiwanese politician Chang Po-ya is an alumna of Johns Hopkins University.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学与马里兰大学在曲棍球项目上是传统的老对手。
description.en: Johns Hopkins University and the University of Maryland are traditional rivals in lacrosse.

description.zh-cn: 国家科学基金会是约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的重要科研经费来源之一，该校连续31年被列为全美科研经费开支最高的大学。
description.en: The National Science Foundation is a significant source of research funding for Johns Hopkins University, which has been ranked number one in the U.S. for research and development spending for 31 consecutive years.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏接替陈宝生担任中华人民共和国教育部部长。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng succeeded Chen Baosheng as the Minister of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏在李克强担任国务院总理期间被任命为教育部部长。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng was appointed Minister of Education during Li Keqiang's tenure as Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在李强担任国务院总理期间，怀进鹏继续担任教育部部长。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng continued to serve as Minister of Education during Li Qiang's tenure as Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏接替尚勇担任中国科学技术协会党组书记。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng succeeded Shang Yong as the Party Group Secretary of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 张玉卓接替怀进鹏担任中国科学技术协会党组书记。
description.en: Zhang Yuzhuo succeeded Huai Jinpeng as the Party Group Secretary of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏担任中国科学技术协会党组书记期间，万钢担任会长。
description.en: While Huai Jinpeng served as the Party Group Secretary of the China Association for Science and Technology, Wan Gang was its President.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏在李鸿忠担任中共天津市委书记期间任专职副书记。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng served as the full-time Deputy Secretary while Li Hongzhong was the Secretary of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏接替王东峰担任中共天津市委专职副书记。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng succeeded Wang Dongfeng as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 阴和俊接替怀进鹏担任中共天津市委专职副书记。
description.en: Yin Hejun succeeded Huai Jinpeng as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏接替李未担任北京航空航天大学校长。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng succeeded Li Wei as the President of Beihang University.

description.zh-cn: 徐惠彬接替怀进鹏担任北京航空航天大学校长。
description.en: Xu Huibin succeeded Huai Jinpeng as the President of Beihang University.

description.zh-cn: 怀进鹏出生于黑龙江省哈尔滨市。
description.en: Huai Jinpeng was born in Harbin, Heilongjiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 于1986年1月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in January 1986.

description.zh-cn: 经第十三届全国人大常委会第三十次会议表决，任命怀进鹏为教育部部长。
description.en: Following a vote at the 30th session of the Standing Committee of the 13th National People's Congress, Huai Jinpeng was appointed as the Minister of Education.

description.zh-cn: 1941年4月3日，罗瑞卿与郝治平在辽县桐峪镇结婚。
description.en: On April 3, 1941, Luo Ruiqing and Hao Zhiping married in Tongyu Town, Liao County.

description.zh-cn: 罗箭是罗瑞卿的儿子。
description.en: Luo Jian is the son of Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 罗宇是罗瑞卿的儿子。
description.en: Luo Yu is the son of Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 1926年考入国共合作创办的武汉中央军事政治学校（即黄埔军校武汉分校）。
description.en: In 1926, he was admitted to the Wuhan Central Military and Political School (the Wuhan branch of the Whampoa Military Academy), which was jointly founded by the KMT and CCP.

description.zh-cn: 1928年10月，经任伯芳介绍在上海转为中国共产党党员。
description.en: In October 1928, through the introduction of Ren Bofang, he became a member of the Communist Party of China in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿任太原前线司令部副政治委员和总前委第一副书记，协助徐向前组织太原战役。
description.en: Luo Ruiqing served as Deputy Political Commissar of the Taiyuan Frontline Command and First Deputy Secretary of the General Front Committee, assisting Xu Xiangqian in organizing the Taiyuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿在太原战役期间协助徐向前指挥作战。
description.en: Luo Ruiqing assisted Xu Xiangqian in commanding operations during the Taiyuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，叶群作为林彪的同伙，参与了对罗瑞卿的政治攻击。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Ye Qun, as an accomplice of Lin Biao, participated in the political attacks against Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，吴法宪作为林彪的同伙，参与了对罗瑞卿的政治攻击。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Wu Faxian, as an accomplice of Lin Biao, participated in the political attacks against Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 在1965年12月的上海会议上，李作鹏作为林彪的同伙，参与了对罗瑞卿的政治攻击。
description.en: At the Shanghai Conference in December 1965, Li Zuopeng, as an accomplice of Lin Biao, participated in the political attacks against Luo Ruiqing.

description.zh-cn: 解放战争时期，罗瑞卿与聂荣臻在晋察冀军区共事。
description.en: During the Chinese Civil War, Luo Ruiqing worked with Nie Rongzhen in the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 金建华是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Jin Jianhua is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，金建华当选第十一届全国政协委员，代表经济界，分入第三十五组。
description.en: In 2008, Jin Jianhua was elected as a member of the 11th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, representing the economic sector in group 35.

position.zh-cn: 政治部宣传部部长、教育司副司长
position.en: Director of the Propaganda Department of the Political Department, Deputy Director of the Education Department

description.zh-cn: 1985年4月任政治部宣传部部长，1988年12月任教育司副司长。
description.en: Appointed Director of the Propaganda Department of the Political Department in April 1985, and Deputy Director of the Education Department in December 1988.

description.zh-cn: 王明方任中央第五巡视组组长对天津市进行巡视，巡视工作直接导致了原天津市公安局局长武长顺的落马。
description.en: As the head of the Fifth Central Inspection Team, Wang Mingfang led an inspection in Tianjin, which directly led to the downfall of Wu Changshun, the former police chief of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝的驾崩是辛酉政变的直接原因和导火索。
description.en: The death of the Xianfeng Emperor was the direct cause and trigger of the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 醇郡王奕𫍽是政变的参与者之一，并奉命前往密云逮捕了肃顺。
description.en: Prince Chun (Yixuan) was one of the participants in the coup and was ordered to Miyun to arrest Sushun.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古亲王僧格林沁在辛酉政变中支持慈禧太后和奕䜣一方。
description.en: The Mongol prince Sengge Rinchen supported the faction of Empress Dowager Cixi and Prince Gong during the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 军机大臣文祥在辛酉政变中支持慈禧太后和奕䜣一方。
description.en: Grand Councilor Wenxiang supported the faction of Empress Dowager Cixi and Prince Gong during the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 大学士贾桢在辛酉政变中支持慈禧太后和奕䜣一方。
description.en: Grand Secretary Jia Zhen supported the faction of Empress Dowager Cixi and Prince Gong during the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 握有京畿兵权的兵部侍郎胜保在辛酉政变中支持慈禧太后和奕䜣一方。
description.en: Sheng Bao, the Vice President of the Board of War who held military power in the capital region, supported the faction of Empress Dowager Cixi and Prince Gong during the Xinyou Coup.

description.zh-cn: 在辛酉政变中，顾命八大臣之一载垣被捕并被赐死。
description.en: During the Xinyou Coup, Zaiyuan, one of the Eight Regents, was arrested and ordered to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 在辛酉政变中，顾命八大臣之一端华被捕并被赐死。
description.en: During the Xinyou Coup, Duanhua, one of the Eight Regents, was arrested and ordered to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 咸丰帝在驾崩前下达遗诏，任命肃顺、载垣、端华等八人为赞襄政务大臣，辅佐年幼的同治帝。
description.en: Before his death, the Xianfeng Emperor issued an imperial edict appointing Sushun, Zaiyuan, Duanhua, and five others as the eight regents to assist the young Tongzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 顾命八大臣企图独揽大权，与同治帝生母慈禧太后严重不和，导致权力斗争。
description.en: The Eight Regents attempted to monopolize power, leading to a severe conflict and power struggle with Empress Dowager Cixi, the birth mother of the Tongzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 恭亲王奕䜣被顾命八大臣排斥在最高权力之外，因此心怀不满，并最终联合两宫太后发动政变。
description.en: Prince Gong (Yixin) was excluded from the highest echelons of power by the Eight Regents, which caused his dissatisfaction and ultimately led him to ally with the two empress dowagers to launch the coup.

description.zh-cn: 慈安太后是咸丰帝的正室皇后。
description.en: Empress Dowager Ci'an was the primary consort and empress of the Xianfeng Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 奕䜣和奕𫍽均为道光帝之子，是兄弟关系。
description.en: Yixin and Yixuan were both sons of the Daoguang Emperor, making them brothers.

description.zh-cn: 辛酉政变的成功，直接导致了慈安、慈禧两宫太后垂帘听政的政治格局。
description.en: The success of the Xinyou Coup directly led to the political situation of the two Empress Dowagers, Ci'an and Cixi, ruling from behind the curtain.

description.zh-cn: 辛酉政变的结果被认为是同光中兴的开端。
description.en: The result of the Xinyou Coup is considered the beginning of the Tong-Guang Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 山东道监察御史董元醇上奏，首次公开请求由两宫皇太后垂帘听政。
description.en: The Supervising Censor Dong Yuanchun submitted a memorial, making the first public request for the two empress dowagers to rule from behind the curtain.

description.zh-cn: 顾命八大臣以“向来无皇太后垂帘听政之礼”为由，严厉驳回了董元醇的奏请。
description.en: The Eight Regents sternly rejected Dong Yuanchun's memorial, citing that 'there is no precedent in our dynasty for an empress dowager to rule from behind the curtain'.

description.zh-cn: 政变成功后，由慈安和慈禧废除了顾命八大臣原拟的“祺祥”年号。
description.en: After the coup's success, Empress Dowagers Ci'an and Cixi abolished the 'Qixiang' reign title originally proposed by the Eight Regents.

description.zh-cn: 政变成功后，新年号被改为“同治”。
description.en: After the coup's success, the new reign title was changed to 'Tongzhi'.

description.zh-cn: 辛酉政变成功后，奕䜣奉命在军机处行走，参与核心决策。
description.en: After the success of the Xinyou Coup, Yixin was ordered to serve in the Grand Council, participating in core decision-making.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄与袁家骝于1942年5月30日结婚。
description.en: Chien-Shiung Wu and Luke Chia-Liu Yuan married on May 30, 1942.

description.zh-cn: 袁纬承是吴健雄的儿子。
description.en: Vincent Yuan is the son of Chien-Shiung Wu.

description.zh-cn: 袁纬承是袁家骝的儿子。
description.en: Vincent Yuan is the son of Luke Chia-Liu Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄于1912年5月31日出生于江苏省太仓县浏河镇。
description.en: Chien-Shiung Wu was born in Liuhe, Taicang, Jiangsu on May 31, 1912.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄于1930年至1934年就读于国立中央大学，主修物理。
description.en: Chien-Shiung Wu studied at National Central University from 1930 to 1934, majoring in physics.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄于1940年6月在加州大学伯克利分校获得哲学博士学位。
description.en: Chien-Shiung Wu received her Ph.D. from the University of California, Berkeley in June 1940.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄在加州大学伯克利分校攻读博士学位期间，师从欧内斯特·劳伦斯。
description.en: While pursuing her doctorate at the University of California, Berkeley, Chien-Shiung Wu studied under Ernest Lawrence.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄在国立中央大学求学期间，她的导师是施士元教授。
description.en: During her studies at National Central University, Chien-Shiung Wu's advisor was Professor Shi Shiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄在中央研究院的导师是顾静薇教授。
description.en: Chien-Shiung Wu's advisor at Academia Sinica was Professor Gu Jingwei.

position.zh-cn: 副研究员、副教授、正教授、米海洛·卜平物理学教授
position.en: Associate Research Scientist, Associate Professor, Professor, Michael I. Pupin Professor of Physics

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄自二战结束后一直在哥伦比亚大学任教，直至1981年退休。
description.en: Chien-Shiung Wu taught at Columbia University from the end of World War II until her retirement in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 通过吴氏实验在实验上首次验证了弱相互作用中的宇称不守恒。
description.en: Experimentally verified parity non-conservation in weak interactions for the first time through the Wu experiment.

description.zh-cn: 关于宇称不守恒的理论工作使李政道（与杨振宁）获得了1957年的诺贝尔物理学奖。
description.en: The theoretical work on parity non-conservation led to Tsung-Dao Lee (with Chen-Ning Yang) receiving the 1957 Nobel Prize in Physics.

description.zh-cn: 关于宇称不守恒的理论工作使杨振宁（与李政道）获得了1957年的诺贝尔物理学奖。
description.en: The theoretical work on parity non-conservation led to Chen-Ning Yang (with Tsung-Dao Lee) receiving the 1957 Nobel Prize in Physics.

description.zh-cn: 请求吴健雄对宇称不守恒理论进行实验验证。
description.en: Requested Chien-Shiung Wu to perform an experimental test of the parity non-conservation theory.

description.zh-cn: 1973年，吴健雄回国访问时受到周恩来接见，周恩来就其亲人在文革中的遭遇向她致歉。
description.en: In 1973, when Chien-Shiung Wu visited China, she was received by Zhou Enlai, who apologized for the persecution her relatives suffered during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 吴健雄在中国公学任教时，曾旁听时任校长胡适的课程。
description.en: While teaching at China Public School, Chien-Shiung Wu attended lectures by the school's president, Hu Shih.

description.zh-cn: 李朝卿担任南投县第15、16届县长，后因涉贪污案被停职。
description.en: Li Chao-ching served as the 15th and 16th Magistrate of Nantou County and was later suspended due to a corruption case.

description.zh-cn: 李朝卿担任南投市第6、7届市长。
description.en: Li Chao-ching served as the 6th and 7th Mayor of Nantou City.

description.zh-cn: 李朝卿曾任南投县议会第13届议员。
description.en: Li Chao-ching served as a member of the 13th Nantou County Council.

description.zh-cn: 李朝卿原为中国国民党籍，后于2017年9月6日因贪污案被开除党籍。
description.en: Li Chao-ching was originally a member of the Kuomintang but was expelled on September 6, 2017, due to his corruption case.

description.zh-cn: 因李朝卿贪污案二审被判刑，中国国民党中央常务委员会决议撤销其党籍。
description.en: Due to Li Chao-ching's conviction in the second instance of his corruption case, the Kuomintang's Central Standing Committee resolved to revoke his party membership.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，李朝卿夫妇与时任国民党秘书长吴敦义夫妇、中部角头大哥江钦良等人一同前往印尼峇里岛旅游，引发争议。
description.en: In 2008, Li Chao-ching and his wife traveled to Bali, Indonesia, with then-KMT Secretary-General Wu Den-yih and his wife, and gang leader Chiang Chin-liang, which sparked controversy.

description.zh-cn: 江钦良曾为李朝卿成立后援会助选。
description.en: Chiang Chin-liang once established a support group to assist in Li Chao-ching's election campaign.

description.zh-cn: 2002年，时任总统陈水扁特赦假释江钦良出狱。
description.en: In 2002, then-President Chen Shui-bian granted a special parole for the release of Chiang Chin-liang from prison.

description.zh-cn: 针对李朝卿涉嫌收取灾修工程回扣，依贪污罪嫌提起公诉。
description.en: Indicted Li Chao-ching on charges of corruption for allegedly taking kickbacks from disaster recovery projects.

description.zh-cn: 一审判决李朝卿30年有期徒刑，褫夺公权10年。
description.en: In the first-instance trial, Li Chao-ching was sentenced to 30 years in prison and deprived of civil rights for 10 years.

description.zh-cn: 二审改判处李朝卿22年有期徒刑，褫夺公权10年。
description.en: In the second-instance trial, the sentence was amended to 22 years in prison and deprivation of civil rights for 10 years.

description.zh-cn: 就李朝卿贪污案其中8项罪名驳回上诉，合计判刑98年确定，其余罪名发回更审。
description.en: Rejected the appeal for 8 of the corruption charges against Li Chao-ching, finalizing a total sentence of 98 years, and remanded the other charges for retrial.

description.zh-cn: 时任内政部长李鸿源宣布将李朝卿移送监察院调查，并依法继续予以停职。
description.en: Then-Minister of the Interior Lee Hong-yuan announced the referral of Li Chao-ching to the Control Yuan for investigation and his continued suspension from office in accordance with the law.

description.zh-cn: 声明若李朝卿在交保后复职回任县长，将号召人民到南投县政府前抗议。
description.en: Stated that if Li Chao-ching were reinstated as county magistrate after being released on bail, he would call on people to protest in front of the Nantou County Government.

description.zh-cn: 以11票对1票通过对李朝卿的弹劾案。
description.en: Passed the impeachment of Li Chao-ching with a vote of 11 to 1.

description.zh-cn: 李朝卿接替林宗男担任南投县县长。
description.en: Li Chao-ching succeeded Lin Tsung-nan as Magistrate of Nantou County.

description.zh-cn: 因李朝卿涉贪停职，时任副县长的陈志清代理其南投县县长职务。
description.en: Due to Li Chao-ching's suspension for corruption, then-Deputy Magistrate Chen Chih-ching served as the acting Magistrate of Nantou County.

description.zh-cn: 731部队是日本在第二次世界大战期间的生物战部队。
description.en: Unit 731 was a biological warfare unit of Japan during World War II.

description.zh-cn: 中央研究院为中华民国总统府的直属机构。
description.en: Academia Sinica is a direct institution under the Presidential Office of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在中国国民党中央政治会议上提出设立中央研究院案。
description.en: Proposed the establishment of Academia Sinica at a meeting of the KMT's Central Political Council.

description.zh-cn: 会议上决议通过设立中央研究院的提案。
description.en: Resolved to approve the proposal to establish Academia Sinica during a meeting.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国总统根据中央研究院评议会选举的候选人名单，遴选并任命廖俊智为院长。
description.en: The President of the Republic of China selected and appointed Liao Chun-chih as President from a list of candidates elected by the Council of Academia Sinica.

description.zh-cn: 创办中央研究院的主要成员是中国科学社社员，成立后也接收了其作为中国科学界官方代表的地位。
description.en: The main founders of Academia Sinica were members of the Science Society of China, and after its establishment, Academia Sinica took over its status as the official representative of the Chinese scientific community internationally.

description.zh-cn: 为中央研究院提供了拉丁文译名“Academia Sinica”。
description.en: Provided the Latin name 'Academia Sinica' for the institution.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，中央研究院被迫西迁至昆明、桂林、四川李庄等地。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Academia Sinica was forced to relocate westward to places like Kunming, Guilin, and Lizhuang in Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 纳莉台风带来的豪雨导致四分溪暴涨，侵袭了中央研究院七个研究所的地下楼层，造成重大损失。
description.en: Heavy rains from Typhoon Nari caused the Sifen Creek to overflow, flooding the basement levels of seven research institutes at Academia Sinica and causing significant damage.

description.zh-cn: 2020年3月发生院内群聚感染事件，2021年12月一名P3实验室研究助理因违反SOP而染疫。
description.en: A cluster infection occurred within the institution in March 2020, and in December 2021, a research assistant in a P3 laboratory was infected due to an SOP violation.

description.zh-cn: 因涉嫌对价利益输送，士林地检署将时任院长翁启惠列为《贪污治罪条例》被告，限制其出境，并于2017年1月提起公诉。
description.en: Due to suspicion of quid pro quo bribery, the Shilin District Prosecutors Office listed then-President Wong Chi-huey as a defendant under the Anti-Corruption Act, restricted him from leaving the country, and indicted him in January 2017.

description.zh-cn: 一审宣判翁启惠无罪，因检方未上诉而无罪定谳。
description.en: The court acquitted Wong Chi-huey in the first trial; the verdict became final as the prosecution did not appeal.

description.zh-cn: 自2019年起，高教工会揭露并抗议中央研究院内部存在的违法解雇、职场霸凌等劳动环境问题。
description.en: Starting in 2019, the Taiwan Higher Education Union exposed and protested against labor issues within Academia Sinica, including illegal dismissals and workplace bullying.

description.zh-cn: 历史唯物主义是马克思主义理论的基石之一。
description.en: Historical materialism is one of the cornerstones of Marxist theory.

description.zh-cn: 根据马克思主义分析，资本主义生产方式中的剥削关系必然导致资产阶级和无产阶级之间的阶级斗争。
description.en: According to Marxist analysis, the exploitative relations within the capitalist mode of production inevitably lead to class struggle between the bourgeoisie and the proletariat.

description.zh-cn: 在资本主义制度下，资产阶级通过占有生产工具来剥削无产阶级的剩余价值。
description.en: Under capitalism, the bourgeoisie exploits the surplus value of the proletariat by owning the means of production.

description.zh-cn: 马克思主义认为，无产阶级通过阶级斗争（革命）推翻资本主义，从而建立社会主义社会。
description.en: Marxism holds that the proletariat, through class struggle (revolution), overthrows capitalism to establish a socialist society.

description.zh-cn: 在马克思主义理论中，社会主义是向共产主义过渡的阶段。
description.en: In Marxist theory, socialism is the transitional stage towards communism.

description.zh-cn: 列宁是1917年俄国革命的主要领导人。
description.en: Lenin was the primary leader of the 1917 Russian Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·波普尔批判历史唯物主义，认为其缺乏可证伪性，是一种“历史定论主义”，而非科学。
description.en: Karl Popper criticized historical materialism, arguing it lacks falsifiability and is a form of 'historicism' rather than a science.

description.zh-cn: 博姆-巴维克进一步批判劳动价值理论，指出马克思对于价值和劳动的定义是自相矛盾的。
description.en: Böhm-Bawerk further criticized the labor theory of value, pointing out that Marx's definitions of value and labor were self-contradictory.

description.zh-cn: 根据“党指挥枪”的指导原则，中共中央军委主席成为中华人民共和国武装力量的实际最高统帅。
description.en: According to the guiding principle of "the Party commands the gun," the Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission became the de facto commander-in-chief of the armed forces of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会主席属于国家级正职职务。
description.en: The position of Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the CPC is classified as a State Leader level post.

description.zh-cn: 《中国共产党章程》设立了中国共产党中央军事委员会主席这一职务。
description.en: The Constitution of the Communist Party of China established the position of Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 1994年5月12日，第八届全国人大常委会通过了关于修改军官军衔条例的决定，规定中央军委主席不被授予军衔。
description.en: On May 12, 1994, the Standing Committee of the 8th National People's Congress passed a decision to amend the regulations on military ranks for officers, stipulating that the Chairman of the Central Military Commission would not be granted a military rank.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十一届六中全会上，邓小平取代华国锋担任中共中央军委主席。
description.en: At the Sixth Plenary Session of the 11th CPC Central Committee, Deng Xiaoping replaced Hua Guofeng as Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十六届四中全会上，胡锦涛接任江泽民的中共中央军委主席职务。
description.en: At the Fourth Plenary Session of the 16th CPC Central Committee, Hu Jintao succeeded Jiang Zemin as Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在中共十八届一中全会上，习近平接替胡锦涛担任中央军事委员会主席。
description.en: At the First Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee, Xi Jinping succeeded Hu Jintao as Chairman of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 自习近平开始，新任的中共中央总书记原则上同时接任中共中央军委主席，并相应接任中华人民共和国中央军事委员会主席。
description.en: Starting with Xi Jinping, the new General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, in principle, concurrently assumes the chairmanship of the CPC Central Military Commission and, accordingly, the chairmanship of the PRC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》汇集了先秦诸子百家的言论，是杂家的代表作。
description.en: The Lüshi Chunqiu is a compendium of the ideas of the Hundred Schools of Thought and is a representative work of the Syncretist school.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》的内容以道家黄老思想为主。
description.en: The content of the Lüshi Chunqiu is primarily based on the Huang-Lao school of Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》兼收儒家言论，并认同其仁义思想。
description.en: The Lüshi Chunqiu incorporates Confucian teachings and agrees with its ideas of benevolence and righteousness.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》兼收并评论了墨家思想。
description.en: The Lüshi Chunqiu incorporated and commented on Mohist thought.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》反对墨家的偃兵观，认为军队是必不可少的。
description.en: The Lüshi Chunqiu opposed the Mohist view of pacifism, arguing that military forces are indispensable.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》中关于“天道”的思想与老子所说的“不可捉摸”的道形成对比，显示了其思想受到老子理论的影响并有所发展。
description.en: The concept of the 'Way of Heaven' in Lüshi Chunqiu is contrasted with Laozi's idea of an 'elusive' Tao, showing that its philosophy was influenced by and developed from Laozi's theories.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》是杂家的代表作。
description.en: The Lüshi Chunqiu is the representative work of the Syncretist School.

description.zh-cn: 高诱评论指出，当时无人敢于修改《吕氏春秋》的一个字，是因为人们畏惧相国吕不韦的权势。
description.en: Gao You commented that no one at the time dared to alter a single word of the Lüshi Chunqiu because they feared the power and influence of Chancellor Lü Buwei.

description.zh-cn: 《四库全书总目》评价《吕氏春秋》的思想较诸子之言“独为醇正”。
description.en: The 'Siku Quanshu Zongmu' evaluated the Lüshi Chunqiu as being 'uniquely pure and proper' compared to the words of other philosophers.

description.zh-cn: 清代学者李慈铭评价《吕氏春秋》没有新思想，但其贡献在于保存了“殷周佚说”。
description.en: The Qing dynasty scholar Li Ciming commented that the Lüshi Chunqiu offered no new ideas but its contribution was in preserving 'lost sayings from the Yin and Zhou dynasties'.

description.zh-cn: 熊培云在其著作《自由在高处》中高度评价《吕氏春秋》，认为其蕴含丰富的现代性，从而在当代语境下推广了该书的思想。
description.en: In his book 'Freedom is on High', Xiong Peiyun highly praised the Lüshi Chunqiu, believing it contains rich modern values, thereby promoting its ideas in a contemporary context.

description.zh-cn: 《吕氏春秋》的编纂目的在于为秦统一天下、治理国家提供思想和理论参考，旨在影响当时的秦王政（后来的秦始皇）。
description.en: The purpose of compiling the Lüshi Chunqiu was to provide ideological and theoretical reference for Qin's unification and governance of the realm, aiming to influence the reigning King Zheng of Qin (later Qin Shi Huang).

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，陈得信是中国五矿集团公司的董事长。
description.en: According to the infobox, Chen Dexin is the Chairman of China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，翁祖亮是中国五矿集团公司的董事长。
description.en: According to the text, Weng Zuliang is the Chairman of China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 2015年12月8日，经国务院批准，中国冶金科工集团有限公司整体并入中国五矿集团公司，成为其全资子企业。
description.en: On December 8, 2015, with the approval of the State Council, China Metallurgical Group Corporation was wholly merged into China Minmetals Corporation, becoming its wholly-owned subsidiary.

description.zh-cn: 在并入中国五矿之前，中国中冶是国资委直接监管企业。合并后不再作为国资委直接监管企业。
description.en: Before merging into China Minmetals, MCC was directly supervised by SASAC. After the merger, it was no longer directly supervised by SASAC.

description.zh-cn: 五矿发展是中国五矿集团公司旗下的上市公司。
description.en: Minmetals Development is a listed company under China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中钨高新是中国五矿集团公司旗下的上市公司。
description.en: China Tungsten and Hightech Materials is a listed company under China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 株冶集团是中国五矿集团公司旗下的上市公司。
description.en: Zhuzhou Smelter Group is a listed company under China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 五矿资源是中国五矿集团公司旗下的上市公司。
description.en: MMG Limited is a listed company under China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 五矿地产是中国五矿集团公司旗下的上市公司。
description.en: Minmetals Land is a listed company under China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 1950年4月，中央人民政府政务院决定成立中国五矿集团公司的前身“中国矿产公司”。
description.en: In April 1950, the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government decided to establish 'China National Minerals Co., Ltd.', the predecessor of China Minmetals Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中国五矿集团公司的前身“中国矿产公司”成立时隶属于中央人民政府贸易部。
description.en: The predecessor of China Minmetals Corporation, 'China National Minerals Co., Ltd.', was subordinate to the Ministry of Trade of the Central People's Government upon its establishment.

description.zh-cn: 2004年1月，经国务院国资委审核批准，中国五金矿产进出口总公司更名为“中国五矿集团公司”。
description.en: In January 2004, with the approval of SASAC, China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corporation was renamed 'China Minmetals Corporation'.

description.zh-cn: 2004年1月，经国家工商行政管理总局审核批准，中国五金矿产进出口总公司更名为“中国五矿集团公司”。
description.en: In January 2004, with the approval of the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, China National Metals and Minerals Import and Export Corporation was renamed 'China Minmetals Corporation'.

description.zh-cn: 2009年至2011年，五矿集团获中央授权，以100%股份成为湖南有色集团控股股东。
description.en: From 2009 to 2011, Minmetals Group was authorized by the central government to become the controlling shareholder of Hunan Nonferrous Metals Holding Group with 100% of its shares.

description.zh-cn: 在收购OZ Minerals资产的交易中，澳大利亚政府以国家安全为由阻止了Prominent Hill矿的出售。
description.en: In the acquisition of OZ Minerals' assets, the Australian Government blocked the sale of the Prominent Hill mine on national security grounds.

description.zh-cn: 澳大利亚财政部是澳大利亚政府的部门之一。
description.en: The Department of the Treasury is a department of the Government of Australia.

description.zh-cn: 巴里克黄金公司对埃奎诺克斯矿业提出了比中国五矿高16%的收购价格，最终成功收购，从而阻止了中国五矿的收购企图。
