description.en: Barrick Gold made a 16% higher offer for Equinox Minerals than China Minmetals, eventually succeeding in the acquisition and thus blocking China Minmetals' attempt.

description.zh-cn: 张百庵出生于山西永济。
description.en: Zhang Bai'an was born in Yongji, Shanxi.

description.zh-cn: 张百庵曾任青海师范学院副院长。
description.en: Zhang Bai'an served as Vice President of Qinghai Normal College.

description.zh-cn: 张百庵曾任青海省政协副主席。
description.en: Zhang Bai'an served as Vice Chairman of the Qinghai Provincial Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 张百庵是国立北京大学的校友。
description.en: Zhang Bai'an is an alumnus of National Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 张百庵是中国民主同盟的盟员。
description.en: Zhang Bai'an was a member of the China Democratic League.

description.zh-cn: 张百庵是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: Zhang Bai'an was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东重视生产小队（即生产队）的地位和权力，认为这是调动农民积极性的关键。
description.en: Mao Zedong attached great importance to the status and power of the production team, believing it was key to mobilizing the enthusiasm of the peasants.

description.zh-cn: 主持了《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》的起草工作。
description.en: Presided over the drafting of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 辅助陶铸起草《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。
description.en: Assisted Tao Zhu in drafting the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 参与起草《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。
description.en: Participated in the drafting of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 参与起草《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。
description.en: Participated in the drafting of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 参与起草《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。
description.en: Participated in the drafting of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 参与修改《农村人民公社工作条例（草案）》。
description.en: Participated in the revision of the 'Draft Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes'.

description.zh-cn: 通过了被称为“第三个《六十条》”的《农村人民公社工作条例》修订版本。
description.en: Passed the revised version of the 'Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes', known as the 'Third Sixty Articles'.

description.zh-cn: 通过了被称为“第四个《六十条》”的《农村人民公社工作条例》修订版本。
description.en: Passed the revised version of the 'Regulations on the Work of Rural People's Communes', known as the 'Fourth Sixty Articles'.

description.zh-cn: 该条例确定了以生产队为基本核算单位的人民公社体制。
description.en: This regulation established the people's commune system with the production team as the basic accounting unit.

description.zh-cn: 该条例规定社员的私有财产“永远归社员所有，任何人不得侵犯”，并明确了家庭副业的经营范围，保障了农民的利益。
description.en: The regulation stipulated that the private property of commune members 'shall forever belong to the members and shall not be infringed upon by anyone,' and defined the scope of family sideline businesses, thus safeguarding the interests of the peasants.

description.zh-cn: 吴烈出生于江西省萍乡县。
description.en: Wu Lie was born in Pingxiang County, Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 吴烈是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wu Lie was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，吴烈进入中国人民抗日军政大学学习。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Wu Lie studied at the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University.

description.zh-cn: 1930年，吴烈加入中国工农红军第三军。
description.en: In 1930, Wu Lie joined the Third Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

position.en: Guard of the Central Security Force

description.zh-cn: 吴烈曾加入红军中央保卫部队，担负红军首脑和中共中央的警卫，并随中央红军长征。
description.en: Wu Lie joined the Central Security Force of the Red Army, responsible for guarding the leaders of the Red Army and the CPC Central Committee, and participated in the Long March with the Central Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，吴烈随中央红军参加长征。
description.en: In 1934, Wu Lie participated in the Long March with the Central Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战时期，吴烈指挥其所属师参加了东北地区的多场战役。
description.en: During the Chinese Civil War, Wu Lie commanded his division in several campaigns in the Northeast region.

description.zh-cn: 1968年3月至1970年3月，吴烈担任第二炮兵部队政治委员。
description.en: From March 1968 to March 1970, Wu Lie served as the Political Commissar of the Second Artillery Corps.

description.zh-cn: 1975年4月，吴烈担任武汉军区政治委员，随即降为副政委。
description.en: In April 1975, Wu Lie was appointed Political Commissar of the Wuhan Military Region and was subsequently demoted to Deputy Political Commissar.

description.zh-cn: 吴烈在担任北京卫戍区政治委员期间，兼任北京军区副政委。
description.en: While serving as the Political Commissar of the Beijing Garrison, Wu Lie concurrently held the position of Deputy Political Commissar of the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 吴烈接替刘福，出任中国人民解放军北京卫戍区司令员。
description.en: Wu Lie succeeded Liu Fu as the Commander of the PLA Beijing Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 曾美接替吴烈，出任中国人民解放军北京卫戍区司令员。
description.en: Zeng Mei succeeded Wu Lie as the Commander of the PLA Beijing Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 李进民接替吴烈，出任中国人民解放军北京卫戍区政治委员。
description.en: Li Jinmin succeeded Wu Lie as the Political Commissar of the PLA Beijing Garrison.

description.zh-cn: 1968年，第二炮兵政委李天焕离职，吴烈曾短暂出任政治委员。
description.en: In 1968, after the Second Artillery Corps Political Commissar Li Tianhuan left his post, Wu Lie briefly served as the Political Commissar.

description.zh-cn: 胡善祥被废后，孙氏被立为新后。张太后在宫廷宴会上将胡氏的座位安排在孙皇后之上，孙皇后对此怏怏不乐，显示了两人之间的紧张关系。
description.en: After Hu Shanxiang was deposed, Lady Sun was made the new empress. Empress Dowager Zhang placed Hu's seat above Empress Sun's at court banquets, which displeased Empress Sun, indicating the tense relationship between them.

description.zh-cn: 明英宗就是否应为胡善祥复位一事询问李贤，李贤给予了肯定的答复，推动了此事的最终决定。
description.en: When Emperor Yingzong inquired about whether to restore Hu Shanxiang's title, Li Xian gave an affirmative answer, pushing forward the final decision.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙出生于湖南浏阳。
description.en: Zhang Qilong was born in Liuyang, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙于1932年与李贞结婚，后于1930年代离异。
description.en: Zhang Qilong married Li Zhen in 1932 and they divorced in the 1930s.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙于1925年加入中国共产主义青年团。
description.en: Zhang Qilong joined the Communist Youth League of China in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙于1926年转入中国共产党，1933年被开除党籍，1936年恢复党籍直至逝世。
description.en: Zhang Qilong joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1926, was expelled in 1933, and had his membership restored in 1936 until his death.

description.zh-cn: 1933年，张启龙被开除党籍，并被撤销职务、罚做劳役。
description.en: In 1933, Zhang Qilong was expelled from the party, removed from his post, and sentenced to penal labor.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，红二方面军党务委员会恢复了张启龙的党籍。
description.en: In 1936, the Party Affairs Committee of the Second Front Army of the Red Army restored Zhang Qilong's party membership.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙早年参加了湘赣边秋收起义。
description.en: In his early years, Zhang Qilong participated in the Autumn Harvest Uprising on the Hunan-Jiangxi border.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙在秋收起义后曾随毛泽东转战赣南。
description.en: After the Autumn Harvest Uprising, Zhang Qilong followed Mao Zedong to fight in southern Jiangxi.

position.zh-cn: 供给部部长、党委常委兼统战部部长
position.en: Minister of the Supply Department, Standing Committee Member of the Party Committee and Minister of the United Front Work Department

description.zh-cn: 1934年，张启龙随红六军团西征，后担任供给部部长、党委常委兼统战部部长。
description.en: In 1934, Zhang Qilong went on the western expedition with the Sixth Army Corps of the Red Army and later served as Minister of the Supply Department, Standing Committee Member of the Party Committee and Minister of the United Front Work Department.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙于抗日战争初期抵达延安党校学习。
description.en: Zhang Qilong arrived at the Yan'an Party School to study in the early days of the Second Sino-Japanese War.

position.zh-cn: 党总支部书记、校管理委员会委员、第四部主任
position.en: Secretary of the General Party Branch, Member of the School Management Committee, Director of the Fourth Department

description.zh-cn: 张启龙曾任中共中央党校党总支部书记、校管理委员会委员及第四部主任。
description.en: Zhang Qilong served as Secretary of the General Party Branch, Member of the School Management Committee, and Director of the Fourth Department of the Central Party School.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙作为政委，与司令员文年生共同率领八路军南下第二支队到河南。
description.en: As political commissar, Zhang Qilong, together with commander Wen Niansheng, led the Second Southbound Detachment of the Eighth Route Army to Henan.

description.zh-cn: 1949年5月10日，张启龙调任新成立的黑龙江省委书记。
description.en: On May 10, 1949, Zhang Qilong was transferred to be the Secretary of the newly established Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1950年3月，张启龙担任中共辽东省委书记。
description.en: In March 1950, Zhang Qilong became the Secretary of the CPC Liaodong Provincial Committee.

position.zh-cn: 副主任、常务副主任、党组副书记
position.en: Deputy Director, Executive Deputy Director, Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 1952年8月，张启龙任中华全国供销合作总社副主任，后任常务副主任、党组副书记。
description.en: In August 1952, Zhang Qilong was appointed Deputy Director of the All-China Federation of Supply and Marketing Cooperatives, and later became Executive Deputy Director and Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group.

description.zh-cn: 1956年9月，张启龙被选为中国共产党第八届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: In September 1956, Zhang Qilong was elected as an alternate member of the 8th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1958年9月，张启龙任中共中央组织部副部长，后任常务副部长，直至1965年1月被撤职。
description.en: In September 1958, Zhang Qilong was appointed Deputy Minister of the Organization Department of the CCP Central Committee, and later became Executive Deputy Minister until he was dismissed in January 1965.

description.zh-cn: 1965年1月，因《浏阳县革命史》的问题，中共中央决定撤销张启龙中央组织部常务副部长的职务，并将其调离。
description.en: In January 1965, due to issues related to the 'Revolutionary History of Liuyang County', the Central Committee of the CCP decided to remove Zhang Qilong from his post as Executive Deputy Minister of the Central Organization Department and transfer him.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙被撤职后，到山东泰安县和山西太谷县“蹲点”参加四清运动。
description.en: After being dismissed, Zhang Qilong was sent to Taian County, Shandong, and Taigu County, Shanxi, to participate in the Four Cleanups Movement.

description.zh-cn: 1965年10月，张启龙被贬往南京市任副市长。
description.en: In October 1965, Zhang Qilong was demoted to Deputy Mayor of Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙在文化大革命中受到冲击，直至1972年9月获释。
description.en: Zhang Qilong was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution and was not released until September 1972.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月中共十一届三中全会任命张启龙为中共中央纪律检查委员会副书记。
description.en: In December 1978, the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CCP appointed Zhang Qilong as Deputy Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 1980年6月30日，中组部报请中央书记处批准，正式为张启龙平反。
description.en: On June 30, 1980, the Organization Department reported to the Central Secretariat for approval and officially rehabilitated Zhang Qilong.

description.zh-cn: 张启龙曾任中顾委委员，至1985年9月不再担任。
description.en: Zhang Qilong served as a member of the Central Advisory Commission until September 1985.

description.zh-cn: 路德维希·费尔巴哈是德国法学家保罗·约翰·安塞尔姆·冯·费尔巴哈的第四个儿子。
description.en: Ludwig Feuerbach was the fourth son of the German jurist Paul Johann Anselm von Feuerbach.

description.zh-cn: 费尔巴哈在海德堡大学学习神学。
description.en: Feuerbach studied theology at Heidelberg University.

description.zh-cn: 费尔巴哈到柏林跟随黑格尔学习哲学，历时两年。
description.en: Feuerbach went to Berlin to study philosophy under Hegel for two years.

description.zh-cn: 1828年，费尔巴哈到埃尔朗根学习了两年自然科学。
description.en: In 1828, Feuerbach went to Erlangen to study natural sciences for two years.

description.zh-cn: 在埃尔朗根学习期间，费尔巴哈曾任大学讲师，后因其激进思想被驱逐出大学讲坛。
description.en: While studying in Erlangen, Feuerbach worked as a university lecturer, but was later expelled from the university pulpit for his radical ideas.

description.zh-cn: 费尔巴哈拥护斯宾诺莎关于人死后会被自然重新吸收的哲学观点。
description.en: Feuerbach supported Spinoza's philosophical view that humans are reabsorbed by nature after death.

description.zh-cn: 1839年，费尔巴哈发表了《黑格尔哲学的批判》。
description.en: In 1839, Feuerbach published 'Critique of the Hegelian Philosophy'.

description.zh-cn: 1841年，费尔巴哈发表了《基督教的本质》。
description.en: In 1841, Feuerbach published 'The Essence of Christianity'.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思撰写了《关于费尔巴哈的提纲》。
description.en: Karl Marx wrote the 'Theses on Feuerbach'.

description.zh-cn: 项子明是史家余英时的表兄。
description.en: Xiang Ziming was the maternal cousin of historian Yu Yingshi.

description.zh-cn: 汪世铭是项子明（原名汪志天）的三叔。
description.en: Wang Shiming was the third uncle of Xiang Ziming (born Wang Zhitian).

description.zh-cn: 项子明曾考入北平师大附中就读。
description.en: Xiang Ziming was admitted to and studied at the High School Affiliated to Beijing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 1935年一二·九运动时，项子明曾参加游行。
description.en: During the December 9th Movement in 1935, Xiang Ziming participated in demonstrations.

description.zh-cn: 1938年5月，项子明到延安，在陕北公学分校学习。
description.en: In May 1938, Xiang Ziming arrived in Yan'an and studied at a branch of the Shaanbei Public School.

description.zh-cn: 1945年11月，项子明考入北京大学法律系。
description.en: In November 1945, Xiang Ziming was admitted to the Law Department of Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 作为华北局城市工作部大学工作委员会委员和北京大学地下党负责人，项子明兼管中法大学的地下党工作。
description.en: As a member of the University Work Committee of the Urban Work Department of the North China Bureau and the head of the underground party at Peking University, Xiang Ziming also oversaw the underground party work at the Institut Franco-Chinois de Chine.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，项子明被撤职，并被遣送至山西下放劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Xiang Ziming was dismissed from his post and sent to Shanxi for manual labor.

description.zh-cn: 成立时为文部省管辖的官立大学。
description.en: Upon its establishment, it was a government university under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education.

description.zh-cn: 在2004年4月改制为国立大学法人，并于2017年6月成为指定国立大学法人。
description.en: Reorganized into a National University Corporation in April 2004, and became a Designated National University Corporation in June 2017.

description.zh-cn: 受东大纷争影响，东京大学在1969年停止招生。
description.en: Due to the Todai Protests, the University of Tokyo suspended new student admissions in 1969.

description.zh-cn: 方孝复是方孝孺的堂兄。
description.en: Fang Xiaofu was the cousin of Fang Xiaoru.

description.zh-cn: 方孝孺出生于浙江宁海县。
description.en: Fang Xiaoru was born in Ninghai County, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 与杨枢共同举荐方孝孺，使其在洪武十五年获明太祖召见。
description.en: Jointly with Yang Shu, recommended Fang Xiaoru, leading to him being summoned by the Hongwu Emperor in the 15th year of the Hongwu era (1382).

description.zh-cn: 与吴沉共同举荐方孝孺，使其在洪武十五年获明太祖召见。
description.en: Jointly with Wu Chen, recommended Fang Xiaoru, leading to him being summoned by the Hongwu Emperor in the 15th year of the Hongwu era (1382).

description.zh-cn: 洪武十五年，因吴沉、杨枢举荐，明太祖朱元璋召见了方孝孺。
description.en: In the 15th year of the Hongwu era (1382), upon the recommendation of Wu Chen and Yang Shu, the Hongwu Emperor Zhu Yuanzhang summoned and met with Fang Xiaoru.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝即位后，即召方孝孺入京委以重任，处理国家大事也会征求他的意见。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Jianwen Emperor summoned Fang Xiaoru to the capital and entrusted him with important responsibilities, also consulting him on major state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 方孝孺在建文朝先后出任翰林侍讲及翰林学士。
description.en: During the Jianwen era, Fang Xiaoru successively served as Expositor-in-waiting and Academician at the Hanlin Academy.

description.zh-cn: 在靖难之役中，方孝孺为建文帝起草讨伐朱棣的诏书，并在城破后拒绝为其草拟即位诏书，最终被杀。
description.en: During the Jingnan campaign, Fang Xiaoru drafted edicts denouncing Zhu Di for the Jianwen Emperor, and after the capital fell, he refused to draft the accession edict for Zhu Di, which led to his execution.

description.zh-cn: 在靖难之役期间，为建文帝起草讨伐燕王朱棣的诏书檄文。
description.en: During the Jingnan campaign, he drafted imperial edicts and military proclamations against Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan, for the Jianwen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 与黄子澄共同向建文帝建议削藩，以加强中央集权。
description.en: Together with Huang Zicheng, advised the Jianwen Emperor to reduce the power of the princes to strengthen central authority.

description.zh-cn: 与齐泰共同向建文帝建议削藩，以加强中央集权。
description.en: Together with Qi Tai, advised the Jianwen Emperor to reduce the power of the princes to strengthen central authority.

description.zh-cn: 率领水师战舰投降燕军，使朱棣的军队得以顺利渡过长江，攻克南京。
description.en: Led his naval fleet to surrender to the Yan army, enabling Zhu Di's forces to cross the Yangtze River smoothly and capture Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 曾劝说朱棣不要杀死方孝孺，称“城下之日，彼必不降，幸勿杀之。杀孝孺，天下读书种子绝矣。”
description.en: Advised Zhu Di not to kill Fang Xiaoru, saying, 'On the day the city falls, he will certainly not surrender. Please do not kill him. To kill Fang Xiaoru would be to extinguish the 'seeds of scholarship' in the world.'

description.zh-cn: 即位后下诏宽待建文朝诸臣家属，方孝孺的堂兄方孝复因此获得赦免。
description.en: After ascending the throne, he issued an edict to treat the families of Jianwen court officials with leniency, resulting in the pardon of Fang Xiaoru's cousin, Fang Xiaofu.

description.zh-cn: 南明弘光帝追赠方孝孺为太师，谥号“文正”。
description.en: The Hongguang Emperor of the Southern Ming posthumously honored Fang Xiaoru with the title of Grand Preceptor and the posthumous name 'Wenzheng'.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环于1959年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Li Ruihuan joined the Communist Party of China in September 1959.

description.zh-cn: 李振智是李瑞环的长子。
description.en: Li Zhenzhi is Li Ruihuan's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环曾在北京建工业余学院工业与民用建筑专业学习。
description.en: Li Ruihuan studied Industrial and Civil Architecture at the Beijing Part-time Institute of Construction Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环于1982年至1989年间担任天津市市长。
description.en: Li Ruihuan served as the Mayor of Tianjin from 1982 to 1989.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环于1987年至1989年间担任中共天津市委书记。
description.en: Li Ruihuan served as the Secretary of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee from 1987 to 1989.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环于1987年当选为中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: Li Ruihuan was elected as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件后，李瑞环在中共十三届四中全会上被增补为中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, Li Ruihuan was elevated to the Politburo Standing Committee at the 4th Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环于1989年至2002年担任中共中央政治局常委。
description.en: Li Ruihuan served as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee of the CPC from 1989 to 2002.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件后，李瑞环和乔石在各自职权范围内合作，尽可能地保护了一些知识分子。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square incident, Li Ruihuan and Qiao Shi cooperated within their respective authorities to protect some intellectuals as much as possible.

description.zh-cn: 李瑞环卸任全国政协主席后，由贾庆林接任。
description.en: After Li Ruihuan stepped down as Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, he was succeeded by Jia Qinglin.

description.zh-cn: 在主政天津期间，李瑞环以务实精神为民众办实事，兴建了引滦入津等一系列民生工程，在民众中取得相当不错的声誉。
description.en: During his tenure governing Tianjin, Li Ruihuan implemented practical projects for the public, including the Luan River Diversion Project, earning a very good reputation among the citizens.

description.zh-cn: 李严早年任职于荆州牧刘表麾下。
description.en: In his early years, Li Yan served under Liu Biao, the governor of Jing Province.

position.en: Prefect of Chengdu, Protector of the Army

description.zh-cn: 曹操南下荆州后，李严入蜀，被刘璋任命为成都令，后于刘备伐蜀时任护军。
description.en: After Cao Cao's invasion of Jing Province, Li Yan entered Shu and was appointed Prefect of Chengdu by Liu Zhang. He later served as Protector of the Army during Liu Bei's invasion of Shu.

description.zh-cn: 李严在绵竹阵前倒戈，率众投降刘备，后成为蜀汉重臣。
description.en: Li Yan switched allegiance on the battlefield at Mianzhu, leading his troops to surrender to Liu Bei, and subsequently became a key minister of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 作为托孤大臣，李严与诸葛亮共同辅佐后主刘禅。
description.en: As a regent, Li Yan, along with Zhuge Liang, assisted the young emperor Liu Shan.

position.zh-cn: 尚书令、中都护、骠骑将军等
position.en: Head of the Secretariat, Central Protector, General of Cavalry, etc.

description.zh-cn: 李严在蜀汉担任多个高级军政职位，是蜀汉重臣。
description.en: Li Yan held several high-ranking military and civil positions in Shu Han, making him a key minister of the state.

description.zh-cn: 公元231年8月，诸葛亮上奏弹劾李严在第四次北伐中运粮失职、欺上瞒下等罪行，导致其被免官，贬为庶民。公元234年诸葛亮去世后，李严认为自己再无被起用的可能，悲愤而亡。
description.en: In August 231, Zhuge Liang impeached Li Yan for dereliction of duty in logistics and deception during the Fourth Northern Expedition, leading to Li Yan's dismissal and demotion to a commoner. In 234, after hearing of Zhuge Liang's death, Li Yan, believing there was no chance of reinstatement, died of grief and indignation.

description.zh-cn: 李严负责第四次北伐的粮草运输，因调度失利、运粮不继，并建议诸葛亮撤军，最终导致该次北伐失败。
description.en: Li Yan was in charge of logistics for the Fourth Northern Expedition. His failure to manage supplies and his subsequent advice for Zhuge Liang to retreat ultimately led to the failure of the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在第四次北伐撤军后，李严试图推卸责任并构陷诸葛亮，两人关系彻底破裂。
description.en: After the retreat from the Fourth Northern Expedition, Li Yan attempted to evade responsibility and frame Zhuge Liang, leading to a complete breakdown in their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮在五丈原之战中病逝。
description.en: Zhuge Liang died of illness during the Battle of Wuzhang Plains.

description.zh-cn: 李丰是李严的儿子。
description.en: Li Feng was the son of Li Yan.

description.zh-cn: 李严与比自己年轻二十余岁的费观如同辈般亲交。
description.en: Li Yan had a close, peer-like friendship with Fei Guan, who was more than 20 years his junior.

description.zh-cn: 陈震在出使东吴前，私下告诫诸葛亮，说李严“腹中有鳞甲”，暗示其心术不正，不可亲近。
description.en: Before his diplomatic mission to Eastern Wu, Chen Zhen privately warned Zhuge Liang that Li Yan had 'scales on his belly,' implying he was treacherous and should not be trusted.

description.zh-cn: 李严与诸葛亮、法正、伊籍、刘巴共同制定了《蜀科》，奠定了蜀汉的法律基础。
description.en: Li Yan, along with Zhuge Liang, Fa Zheng, Yi Ji, and Liu Ba, jointly drafted the 'Code of Shu', which laid the legal foundation for the state of Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 华中师范大学是中华人民共和国教育部直属的重点综合性大学。
description.en: Central China Normal University is a key comprehensive university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，邓小平为学校更名后的“华中师范大学”题写了校名。
description.en: In 1985, Deng Xiaoping inscribed the school name for the newly renamed "Central China Normal University".

description.zh-cn: 邓小平是中原大学的创始人之一。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping was one of the founders of Central University.

description.zh-cn: 华中师范大学的正式校史始于1903年文华书院增设的大学部，文华书院是其最早前身。
description.en: The official history of Central China Normal University began with the college department established by Boone College in 1903, which is its earliest predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 1949年12月，中原大学教育学院并入当时的公立华中大学。
description.en: In December 1949, the College of Education of Central University merged into the then-public Huazhong University.

description.zh-cn: 1952年全国高校院系调整时，私立中华大学并入组建华中高等师范学校（今华中师范大学）。
description.en: During the 1952 national higher education reorganization, the private Chunghua University was merged to form the Central China Higher Normal School (now Central China Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 1952年全国高校院系调整时，广西大学部分院系并入组建华中高等师范学校（今华中师范大学）。
description.en: During the 1952 national higher education reorganization, parts of Guangxi University were merged to form the Central China Higher Normal School (now Central China Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 1952年全国高校院系调整时，华南师范学院部分院系并入组建华中高等师范学校（今华中师范大学）。
description.en: During the 1952 national higher education reorganization, parts of South China Normal College were merged to form the Central China Higher Normal School (now Central China Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 1952年全国高校院系调整时，平原师范学院并入组建华中高等师范学校（今华中师范大学）。
description.en: During the 1952 national higher education reorganization, Pingyuan Normal College was merged to form the Central China Higher Normal School (now Central China Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 1962年，湖北大学的一部分并入华中师范学院（今华中师范大学）。
description.en: In 1962, a part of Hubei University was merged into Central China Normal College (now Central China Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 冯友兰是华中师范大学的著名校友。
description.en: Feng Youlan is a famous alumnus of Central China Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 宋教仁是华中师范大学的著名校友。
description.en: Song Jiaoren is a famous alumnus of Central China Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 恽代英是华中师范大学的著名校友。
description.en: Yun Daiying is a famous alumnus of Central China Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 章开沅于1983年12月至1991年3月间担任华中师范学院院长及华中师范大学校长。
description.en: Zhang Kaiyuan served as the Dean of Central China Normal College and President of Central China Normal University from December 1983 to March 1991.

position.zh-cn: 华中大学改制委员会主任
position.en: Chairman of Huazhong University Reorganization Committee

description.zh-cn: 潘梓年于1949年至1952年11月担任华中大学改制委员会主任。
description.en: Pan Zinian served as the Chairman of the Huazhong University Reorganization Committee from 1949 to November 1952.

description.zh-cn: 因未提前通知校方便出现在活动现场，范冰冰在华中师范大学遭到安保人员劝离。
description.en: Due to appearing at an event without prior notice to the university, Fan Bingbing was asked to leave by security personnel at Central China Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 李绳武是何晶的侄子。
description.en: Lee Shengwu is Ho Ching's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 何晶的职业生涯始于新加坡国防部的工程师。
description.en: Ho Ching began her career as an engineer at the Ministry of Defence of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 在何晶担任淡马锡控股首席执行长期间，林文兴为公司董事长。
description.en: During Ho Ching's tenure as CEO of Temasek Holdings, Lim Boon Heng was the company's chairman.

description.zh-cn: 李显扬公开指责何晶在未经遗嘱执行人同意的情况下，擅自从其父李光耀处取走个人文件，并称此行为等同偷窃。
description.en: Lee Hsien Yang publicly accused Ho Ching of taking personal items from his father, Lee Kuan Yew, without the consent of the estate's executors, describing the act as tantamount to theft.

description.zh-cn: 何晶在Facebook上转发了一篇批评习近平外交政策的文章，该文章将习近平的作风比作“黑帮老大”。
description.en: Ho Ching reposted an article on Facebook criticizing Xi Jinping's foreign policy, which likened his style to that of a 'mafia boss'.

description.zh-cn: 在香港逃犯条例争议期间，何晶在Facebook转发支持香港警察的帖文。
description.en: During the Hong Kong extradition bill protests, Ho Ching reposted a message on Facebook in support of the Hong Kong Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 何晶在Facebook转发台湾捐赠口罩给新加坡的新闻时，附上评论“Errrr……”，引发台湾民众不满，造成外交风波。
description.en: Ho Ching posted 'Errrr...' on Facebook while sharing news of Taiwan's mask donation to Singapore, sparking dissatisfaction among the Taiwanese public and causing a diplomatic incident.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋太郎是安倍晋三的父亲。
description.en: Shintaro Abe was Shinzo Abe's father.

description.zh-cn: 安倍洋子是安倍晋三的母亲。
description.en: Yoko Abe was Shinzo Abe's mother.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三与安倍昭惠于1987年结婚，婚姻关系直至安倍晋三去世。
description.en: Shinzo Abe and Akie Abe were married in 1987, and their marriage lasted until his death.

description.zh-cn: 岸信夫是安倍晋三的弟弟。
description.en: Nobuo Kishi is Shinzo Abe's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 安倍宽是安倍晋太郎的父亲，即安倍晋三的祖父。
description.en: Kan Abe was Shintaro Abe's father, making him Shinzo Abe's paternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 岸信介是安倍洋子的父亲，即安倍晋三的外祖父。
description.en: Nobusuke Kishi was Yoko Abe's father, making him Shinzo Abe's maternal grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 佐藤荣作是岸信介的弟弟，即安倍晋三的外叔祖父。
description.en: Eisaku Satō was Nobusuke Kishi's younger brother, making him Shinzo Abe's maternal granduncle.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三的童年深受外祖父岸信介的影响，他非常崇拜岸信介，并常表示自己继承了“岸信介的DNA”。
description.en: Shinzo Abe's childhood was greatly influenced by his maternal grandfather Nobusuke Kishi. He greatly admired Kishi and often stated that he inherited 'Kishi's DNA'.

degree.zh-cn: 法学部政治学系文学学士
degree.en: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science, Faculty of Law

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三于1977年3月毕业于成蹊大学。
description.en: Shinzo Abe graduated from Seikei University in March 1977.

position.zh-cn: 众议院议员、总裁、干事长等
position.en: Member of the House of Representatives, President, Secretary-General, etc.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三是日本自由民主党的成员，并曾两度担任该党总裁（党魁）。
description.en: Shinzo Abe was a member of the Liberal Democratic Party of Japan and served as its president on two separate occasions.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三是自由民主党最大派阀清和政策研究会的成员，并于2021年11月11日至2022年7月8日担任会长。
description.en: Shinzo Abe was a member of the LDP's largest faction, Seiwa Seisaku Kenkyūkai, and served as its chairman from November 11, 2021, to July 8, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三自1993年起担任日本众议院议员，直至在任内去世。
description.en: Shinzo Abe served as a member of the House of Representatives of Japan from 1993 until his death in office.

description.zh-cn: 小泉纯一郎任命安倍晋三为内阁官房长官，并推举其为接班人，为安倍首次担任首相铺平了道路。
description.en: Junichiro Koizumi appointed Shinzo Abe as Chief Cabinet Secretary and endorsed him as his successor, paving the way for Abe's first term as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三在其第二次首相任内推出了以“三支箭”为核心的“安倍经济学”改革政策。
description.en: During his second term as prime minister, Shinzo Abe launched the 'Abenomics' reform policy, centered on 'three arrows'.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三在其首相任内，将强化美日同盟作为其外交与安全政策的核心。
description.en: During his tenure as Prime Minister, Shinzo Abe made strengthening the U.S.-Japan alliance a core element of his foreign and security policy.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三与时任美国总统唐纳·川普建立了密切的个人信赖关系，两人通过高尔夫等活动频繁互动。
description.en: Shinzo Abe established a close personal relationship of trust with then-U.S. President Donald Trump, and the two interacted frequently through activities such as golf.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三与俄罗斯总统普丁多次会谈，两人情谊深厚，致力于解决两国间的领土争端。
description.en: Shinzo Abe and Russian President Vladimir Putin held numerous meetings, developing a strong rapport in their efforts to resolve the territorial dispute between their countries.

description.zh-cn: 山上彻也使用自制枪支枪杀了安倍晋三。
description.en: Tetsuya Yamagami assassinated Shinzo Abe using a homemade firearm.

description.zh-cn: 山上彻也表示，他因母亲向统一教大量捐款导致家庭破产而对该组织产生恨意。
description.en: Tetsuya Yamagami stated that he harbored hatred for the Unification Church because his mother's large donations to the organization led to his family's bankruptcy.

description.zh-cn: 红一军团是中国工农红军的组成部分。
description.en: The Red First Army Group was a component of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1930年8月23日，红一军团同红三军团合编为红一方面军。1934年1月，红一方面军被撤销，军团由中央直接指挥。1934年10月长征开始时，红一方面军编制恢复。
description.en: On August 23, 1930, the Red First and Third Army Groups merged to form the First Front Army of the Red Army. In January 1934, the First Front Army was dissolved, and the corps came under the direct command of the Central Committee. In October 1934, at the beginning of the Long March, the First Front Army was re-established.

description.zh-cn: 红四军是组建红一军团的初始部队之一。
description.en: The Fourth Red Army was one of the initial units that formed the Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 红三军是组建红一军团的初始部队之一，并在1932年后重新划入红一军团。
description.en: The Third Red Army was one of the initial units that formed the Red First Army Group and was reassigned to it after 1932.

description.zh-cn: 红十二军是组建红一军团的初始部队之一，于1933年1月改为方面军直辖。
description.en: The Twelfth Red Army was one of the initial units that formed the Red First Army Group, and in January 1933, it was placed under the direct command of the Front Army.

description.zh-cn: 遵义会议后，红一军团缩编为两个师。
description.en: After the Zunyi Conference, the Red First Army Group was downsized to two divisions.

description.zh-cn: 原由红一军团和红三军团改编的陕甘支队一、三纵队合编为新的红一军团。
description.en: The first and third columns of the Shaanxi-Gansu Detachment, which were originally reorganized from the First and Third Red Army Corps, were combined to form the new Red First Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 新组建的红一军团随即参加了直罗镇战役。
description.en: The newly formed Red First Army Group immediately participated in the Battle of Zhiluo Town.

description.zh-cn: 红一军团作为东征军一部分东渡黄河参与东征战役。
description.en: The Red First Army Group, as part of the Eastern Expeditionary Force, crossed the Yellow River to participate in the Eastern Expedition Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 343旅是115师的下辖部队。
description.en: The 343rd Brigade was a subordinate unit of the 115th Division.

description.zh-cn: 红一军团改编为343旅后投入中国抗日战争。
description.en: After being reorganized into the 343rd Brigade, the former Red First Army Group was deployed in the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 孝仪纯皇后生前为皇贵妃，是嘉庆帝的生母，乾隆帝禅位后追赠其为皇后。
description.en: Empress Xiaoyichun was an Imperial Noble Consort during her lifetime and the mother of the Jiaqing Emperor. She was posthumously honored as Empress after Qianlong's abdication.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝遗诏命鄂尔泰为辅政大臣，辅佐乾隆帝处理政务。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor's will appointed Ortai as a regent to assist the Qianlong Emperor in handling government affairs.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝遗诏命张廷玉为辅政大臣，辅佐乾隆帝处理政务。
description.en: The Yongzheng Emperor's will appointed Zhang Tingyu as a regent to assist the Qianlong Emperor in handling government affairs.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝的统治时期是“康雍乾盛世”的重要组成部分，将清朝的国力推向顶峰。
description.en: The reign of the Qianlong Emperor was a key component of the 'High Qing era', pushing the Qing dynasty's power to its peak.

description.zh-cn: 高适出身于渤海高氏。
description.en: Gao Shi was from the Gao clan of Bohai.

description.zh-cn: 731年，高适北上幽州，投奔时任朔方节度大使的李祎，并随他出征讨伐契丹。
description.en: In 731, Gao Shi traveled north to Youzhou to join Li Yi, then the military commissioner of Shuofang, and followed him on a campaign against the Khitans.

description.zh-cn: 731年，李祎率军出卢龙塞征讨契丹，并大破之。
description.en: In 731, Li Yi led his army out of Lulong Pass to campaign against the Khitans and defeated them decisively.

description.zh-cn: 735年，高适赴长安应试期间，结识了王昌龄、王之涣等人。他们后来并称为“边塞四诗人”。
description.en: In 735, while in Chang'an for an examination, Gao Shi became acquainted with Wang Changling and Wang Zhihuan. They, along with Cen Shen, later became known as the 'Four Frontier Poets'.

description.zh-cn: 735年，高适赴长安应试期间，结识了王昌龄、王之涣等人。他们后来并称为“边塞四诗人”。
description.en: In 735, while in Chang'an for an examination, Gao Shi became acquainted with Wang Changling and Wang Zhihuan. They, along with Cen Shen, later became known as the 'Four Frontier Poets'.

description.zh-cn: 744年秋，高适与李白、杜甫在单父同游，登琴台，怀古赋诗。此外，三人还在汴州、宋州一带交游。
description.en: In the autumn of 744, Gao Shi traveled with Li Bai and Du Fu in Shanfu, where they climbed the Qintai Terrace and composed poetry reminiscing about the past. Additionally, the three also associated in the regions of Bianzhou and Songzhou.

description.zh-cn: 744年与杜甫、李白同游。760年，高适入蜀任职后，曾作《人日寄杜二拾遗》诗，表达对杜甫的思念。
description.en: He traveled with Du Fu and Li Bai in 744. In 760, after taking office in Shu, Gao Shi wrote the poem 'To Du Fu on Renri', expressing his longing for his friend.

description.zh-cn: 749年，时任睢阳太守的张九皋举荐高适参加有道科考试，使其获得入仕机会。
description.en: In 749, Zhang Jiugao, then Prefect of Suiyang, recommended Gao Shi for the 'Youdao' examination, giving him an opportunity to enter official service.

description.zh-cn: 高适通过有道科考试后，掌权的李林甫仅以普通举子的规格对待他，任命其为封丘县尉，限制了其仕途的起点。
description.en: After Gao Shi passed the 'Youdao' examination, the powerful Chancellor Li Linfu treated him merely as an ordinary candidate and appointed him to the minor post of Fengqiu County Sheriff, thus limiting the start of his official career.

description.zh-cn: 753年，高适进入河西、陇右节度使哥舒翰的幕府，担任掌书记。755年安史之乱爆发后，又辅佐哥舒翰镇守潼关。
description.en: In 753, Gao Shi joined the staff of Geshu Han, the military governor of Hexi and Longyou, serving as his Chief Secretary. After the An Lushan Rebellion broke out in 755, he assisted Geshu Han in defending Tongguan Pass.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱的爆发成为高适人生的转折点。潼关失守后，他追随唐玄宗，因进言得当而开始受到重用，仕途从此亨通。
description.en: The outbreak of the An Lushan Rebellion became a turning point in Gao Shi's life. After the fall of Tongguan Pass, he followed Emperor Xuanzong and began to be heavily relied upon for his sound advice, marking the start of his prosperous official career.

description.zh-cn: 756年六月，潼关失守后，高适在河池郡追上出逃的唐玄宗，并向其陈述潼关失守的原因。
description.en: In June 756, after the fall of Tongguan Pass, Gao Shi caught up with the fleeing Emperor Xuanzong in Hechi Commandery and explained to him the reasons for the pass's fall.

description.zh-cn: 听取高适的陈事后，唐玄宗随即任命他为侍御史，后又升任谏议大夫。
description.en: After hearing Gao Shi's report, Emperor Xuanzong immediately appointed him as an Attendant Censor and later promoted him to Grand Master of Remonstrance.

description.zh-cn: 高适反对诸王分镇，并在李璘发动叛乱后，与来瑱、韦陟会盟誓师，共同讨伐李璘。
description.en: Gao Shi opposed the enfeoffment of princes with military power and, after Li Lin launched his rebellion, allied with Lai Tian and Wei Zhi to form an army to crusade against him.

description.zh-cn: 唐肃宗就李璘叛乱一事与高适商讨，采纳其计策，并任命高适为淮南节度使，主持讨伐事宜。
description.en: Emperor Suzong consulted with Gao Shi regarding Li Lin's rebellion, adopted his strategy, and appointed Gao Shi as the Military Governor of Huainan to lead the campaign.

description.zh-cn: 758年，高适因其正直敢言得罪了权宦李辅国，被排挤并贬为太子少詹事。
description.en: In 758, because of his uprightness and outspokenness, Gao Shi offended the powerful eunuch Li Fuguo and was marginalized and demoted to the post of Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 761年五月，时任彭州刺史的高适率兵跟随西川节度使崔光远平定梓州刺史段子璋的叛乱。
description.en: In May 761, Gao Shi, then Prefect of Pengzhou, led troops under the command of Xichuan Military Governor Cui Guangyuan to suppress the rebellion of Duan Zizhang, the Prefect of Zizhou.

description.zh-cn: 761年五月，西川节度使崔光远率军平定了梓州刺史段子璋的叛乱。
description.en: In May 761, Xichuan Military Governor Cui Guangyuan led his forces to suppress the rebellion of Duan Zizhang, the Prefect of Zizhou.

description.zh-cn: 762年，唐代宗征调严武入朝，任命高适接替其为剑南西川节度使、成都尹。
description.en: In 762, Emperor Daizong summoned Yan Wu to court and appointed Gao Shi to succeed him as the Military Governor of Jiannan Xichuan and Mayor of Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 763年，吐蕃进犯陇右，时任剑南节度使的高适率兵从南境出击，以牵制其兵力。
description.en: In 763, when the Tibetan Empire invaded Longyou, Gao Shi, then Military Governor of Jiannan, led his troops to attack from the southern border to divert their forces.

description.zh-cn: 763年十二月，吐蕃军队攻陷松、维、保三州，高适无法救援，导致剑南西山诸州也被吐蕃占领。
description.en: In December 763, Tibetan forces captured the prefectures of Song, Wei, and Bao. Gao Shi was unable to relieve them, which led to the occupation of all western mountain prefectures of Jiannan by the Tibetans.

description.zh-cn: 高适与岑参诗风相近，同为盛唐边塞诗的代表人物，并称为“高岑”。
description.en: Gao Shi and Cen Shen had similar poetic styles and were representative figures of High Tang frontier poetry, collectively known as 'Gao-Cen'.

description.zh-cn: 高适为琴师董庭兰（董大）写下了著名的送别诗《别董大》，其中“莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君”成为千古名句。
description.en: Gao Shi wrote the famous farewell poem 'A Farewell to Dong Da' for the zither master Dong Tinglan (Dong Da), in which the lines 'Don't worry about having no bosom friends on the road ahead, for who in the world does not know you?' became timelessly famous.

description.zh-cn: 李小林是李先念的女儿。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is the daughter of Li Xiannian.

description.zh-cn: 李小林是刘亚洲的妻子。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is the wife of Liu Yazhou.

description.zh-cn: 李小林出生于中华人民共和国湖北省红安县。
description.en: Li Xiaolin was born in Hong'an County, Hubei, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李小林毕业于北京景山学校。
description.en: Li Xiaolin is an alumna of Beijing Jingshan School.

description.zh-cn: 1972年4月到1975年9月，于武汉大学学习。
description.en: Studied at Wuhan University from April 1972 to September 1975.

description.zh-cn: 在美国加州大学洛杉矶分校学习美国历史，取得硕士学位。
description.en: Studied American History at the University of California, Los Angeles, and obtained a Master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 自1975年起，任中国人民对外友好协会美大处处长；并于2011年9月至2020年4月9日，担任该协会会长、党组书记。
description.en: Served as Chief of the Department of American and Oceanian Affairs of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries since 1975. From September 2011 to April 9, 2020, served as President and Party Group Secretary of the same association.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国人民政治协商会议第十二届全国委员会常务委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 12th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平执政时期曾经出任中国国家主席。
description.en: Served as the President of the People's Republic of China during Deng Xiaoping's administration.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平执政时期曾经出任全国政协主席。
description.en: Served as the Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference during Deng Xiaoping's administration.

description.zh-cn: 刘亚洲是中国人民解放军空军上将。
description.en: Liu Yazhou is a General in the People's Liberation Army Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 2015年9月，陪同中华人民共和国领导人习近平访问美国。
description.en: In September 2015, accompanied Chinese leader Xi Jinping on his visit to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 陈昊苏是李小林在中国人民对外友好协会会长职位上的前任，李小林于2011年9月接任该职务。
description.en: Chen Haosu was Li Xiaolin's predecessor as President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries, a position Li took over in September 2011.

description.zh-cn: 2020年4月9日，李小林卸任中国人民对外友好协会会长，由林松添接任。
description.en: On April 9, 2020, Li Xiaolin stepped down as President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries and was succeeded by Lin Songtian.

description.zh-cn: 苏联支持中国共产党建立中华苏维埃共和国。
description.en: The Soviet Union supported the Communist Party of China in establishing the Chinese Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 第三国际（共产国际）支持中国共产党建立中华苏维埃共和国。
description.en: The Third International (Comintern) supported the Communist Party of China in establishing the Chinese Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国旨在推翻中国国民党的统治。
description.en: The Chinese Soviet Republic aimed to overthrow the rule of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 1932年4月15日，中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府正式宣布对日作战。
description.en: On April 15, 1932, the Provisional Central Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic officially declared war on Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中共发表《共赴国难宣言》，宣告“取消现在的苏维埃政府”，导致中华苏维埃共和国灭亡。
description.en: The CPC issued the 'Declaration of Jointly Facing National Difficulties,' announcing the 'abolition of the current Soviet government,' which led to the demise of the Chinese Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 第五次反“围剿”战争的失败是红军进行长征的直接原因。
description.en: The failure of the Fifth Encirclement Campaign was the direct cause for the Red Army to undertake the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 由博古、李德和周恩来组成的“三人团”负责筹划了红军的战略转移（长征）。
description.en: The 'Trio' consisting of Bo Gu, Otto Braun (Li De), and Zhou Enlai was responsible for planning the strategic retreat (Long March) of the Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 西安事变后，中华民国与中华苏维埃共和国停战，为后续国共合作抗日奠定了基础。
description.en: After the Xi'an Incident, the Republic of China and the Chinese Soviet Republic ceased hostilities, laying the foundation for the subsequent KMT-CPC cooperation against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中华苏维埃共和国中央政府西北办事处改制为陕甘宁边区政府后，成为隶属于国民政府行政院直辖行政区域下的一个特别行政区政府。
description.en: After the Northwest Office of the Central Government of the Chinese Soviet Republic was reorganized into the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Border Region Government, it became a special administrative region government directly under the Executive Yuan of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 张国焘在长征途中另立中央，成立了中华苏维埃共和国西北联邦。
description.en: During the Long March, Zhang Guotao established a separate central committee and founded the Northwest Federation of the Chinese Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 法王腓力二世给予巴黎大学官方认可。
description.en: King Philip II granted official recognition to the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 教宗英诺森三世给予巴黎大学官方认可。
description.en: Pope Innocent III granted official recognition to the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 罗贝尔·德·索邦创立了索邦学院，作为巴黎大学的一部分。
description.en: Robert de Sorbon founded the Collège de Sorbonne as part of the University of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 罗贝尔·德·索邦是法国国王路易九世身旁的神父。
description.en: Robert de Sorbon was the chaplain to King Louis IX of France.

description.zh-cn: 索邦学院是巴黎大学的第一个学院机构，其名称“索邦”（Sorbonne）后来成为大学的代称。
description.en: The Collège de Sorbonne was the first college of the University of Paris, and its name 'Sorbonne' later became a metonym for the university.

description.zh-cn: 在法国大革命期间，巴黎大学于1793年被解散。
description.en: During the French Revolution, the University of Paris was dissolved in 1793.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑一世于1806年设立法兰西大学，以掌管全法国的教育。
description.en: Napoleon I established the University of France in 1806 to oversee all education in France.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎第四大学与巴黎第六大学合并，成立了索邦大学。
description.en: Paris-Sorbonne University merged with Pierre and Marie Curie University to form Sorbonne University.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎第五大学与巴黎第七大学合并，成立了巴黎大学（2019年成立）。
description.en: Paris Descartes University merged with Paris Diderot University to form the University of Paris (established 2019).

description.zh-cn: 巴黎大学（2019年成立）于2022年更名为巴黎西岱大学。
description.en: The University of Paris (established 2019) was renamed Université Paris Cité in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎第十一大学加入了大学与院校共同体巴黎-萨克雷大学。
description.en: Paris-Sud University joined the collegiate University of Paris-Saclay.

description.zh-cn: 教宗额我略九世于1231年颁布法令，授予巴黎大学包括司法自治权在内的多项特权。
description.en: Pope Gregory IX issued a papal bull in 1231, granting the University of Paris several privileges, including judicial autonomy.

description.zh-cn: 卢修一曾担任三届立法委员。
description.en: Lu Hsiu-yi served three terms as a legislator.

description.zh-cn: 卢毓骏创办了中国文化大学建筑及都市设计学系。
description.en: Lu Yu-jun founded the Department of Architecture and Urban Design at Chinese Culture University.

description.zh-cn: 奈良时代是天平文化发展的时期。
description.en: The Nara period was the era in which Tenpyō culture developed.

description.zh-cn: 从唐朝带来了各种文物，促进了融合唐文化的天平文化的形成。
description.en: Brought various cultural artifacts from the Tang dynasty, promoting the formation of Tenpyō culture which integrated elements of Tang culture.

description.zh-cn: 天平文化融合了唐文化的特色。
description.en: Tenpyō culture incorporated features of Tang culture.

description.zh-cn: 江户时代的幕府在奈良设立了奈良奉行这一官职。
description.en: The shogunate of the Edo period established the administrative post of Nara bugyō in Nara.

description.zh-cn: 于1998年将“古都奈良的文化财”登录为世界遗产项目。
description.en: In 1998, designated the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' as a World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 东大寺是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: Tōdai-ji is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 兴福寺是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: Kōfuku-ji is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 春日大社是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: Kasuga-taisha is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 春日山原始林是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: Kasugayama Primeval Forest is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 药师寺是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: Yakushi-ji is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 唐招提寺是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: Tōshōdai-ji is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 平城宫遗迹是“古都奈良的文化财”世界遗产的组成部分。
description.en: The Heijō Palace site is a component of the 'Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara' World Heritage Site.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝僧人鉴真建立了唐招提寺。
description.en: The Tang dynasty monk Jianzhen founded Tōshōdai-ji temple.

description.zh-cn: 在奈良时代，朝廷保护了被称为南都七大寺的七座寺庙。
description.en: During the Nara period, the Imperial Court protected the seven temples known as the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 东大寺是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: Tōdai-ji is one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 兴福寺是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: Kōfuku-ji is one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 元兴寺是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: Gangō-ji is one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 大安寺是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: Daian-ji is one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 西大寺是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: Saidai-ji is one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 药师寺是南都七大寺之一。
description.en: Yakushi-ji is one of the Nanto Shichi Daiji.

description.zh-cn: 日本政府于1880年规划设立了奈良公园。
description.en: The Japanese government planned and established Nara Park in 1880.

description.zh-cn: 根据《三国史记》记载，朴赫居世居西干于公元前57年创建了新罗。
description.en: According to the Samguk Sagi, Hyeokgeose of Silla founded Silla in 57 BCE.

description.zh-cn: 新罗始于辰韩十二部落之一的斯卢，是其前身。
description.en: Silla originated from Saro, one of the twelve tribes of the Jinhan confederacy, making Jinhan its predecessor.

description.zh-cn: 532年，新罗兼并了伽倻联盟。
description.en: In 532, Silla annexed the Gaya confederacy.

description.zh-cn: 551年，新罗与百济联合出兵，从高句丽手中夺回汉江流域。
description.en: In 551, Silla and Baekje formed an alliance and launched a joint military campaign to reclaim the Han River basin from Goguryeo.

description.zh-cn: 新罗攻占百济夺回的汉江下游地区后，两国结仇。
description.en: After Silla seized the lower Han River basin, which Baekje had reclaimed, the two kingdoms became enemies.

description.zh-cn: 为争夺朝鲜半岛的控制权，新罗与唐朝爆发了罗唐战争。
description.en: Silla and the Tang dynasty went to war (the Silla-Tang War) for control over the Korean Peninsula.

description.zh-cn: 罗唐战争结束后，新罗完全控制大同江以南地区，开启了统一新罗时代。
description.en: After the Silla-Tang War, Silla gained full control of the territory south of the Taedong River, marking the beginning of the Unified Silla period.

description.zh-cn: 公元935年，新罗向高丽投降，新罗灭亡。
description.en: In 935 CE, Silla surrendered to Goryeo, leading to the fall of Silla.

description.zh-cn: 法兴王统治期间，新罗建立起骨品制和以此为基础的官制。
description.en: During the reign of King Beopheung, Silla established the bone-rank system and its associated bureaucracy.

description.zh-cn: 682年，神文王设立了专门研究儒家思想的国学。
description.en: In 682, King Sinmun established the Gukhak, a national academy for the study of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 900年，甄萱在原百济故地建立后百济。
description.en: In 900, Gyeon Hwon founded Later Baekje in the former territory of Baekje.

description.zh-cn: 901年，弓裔在原高句丽故地建立后高句丽。
description.en: In 901, Gung Ye founded Later Goguryeo in the former territory of Goguryeo.

description.zh-cn: 918年，王建起兵反对弓裔，建立了高丽。
description.en: In 918, Wang Geon led a coup against Gung Ye and established Goryeo.

description.zh-cn: 王建推翻了弓裔的统治，取而代之建立了高丽。
description.en: Wang Geon overthrew the rule of Gung Ye and established Goryeo in its place.

description.zh-cn: 新罗末期分裂成后三国，标志着其统一政权的瓦解。
description.en: The division of late Silla into the Later Three Kingdoms marked the collapse of its unified rule.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝在新罗设置鸡林州都督府，作为对新罗进行羁縻统治的机构。
description.en: The Tang dynasty established the Area Command of Jilin in Silla as a mechanism for its 'loose-rein' rule.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝设置鸡林州都督府，名义上将新罗纳入其管辖体系，进行羁縻统治。
description.en: The Tang dynasty established the Area Command of Jilin, nominally incorporating Silla into its administrative system under a 'loose-rein' policy.

description.zh-cn: 异次顿为助法兴王弘法而殉教，促使佛教在新罗开始得到官方接受。
description.en: Ichadon's martyrdom to help King Beopheung promote Buddhism led to its official acceptance in Silla.

description.zh-cn: 黄维于1963年5月出生于河北唐山。
description.en: Huang Wei was born in Tangshan, Hebei in May 1963.

description.zh-cn: 黄维于1983年在北京大学获学士学位，1992年在北京大学获博士学位。
description.en: Huang Wei received his bachelor's degree from Peking University in 1983 and his doctoral degree from Peking University in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 黄维于2012年7月至2017年4月期间担任南京工业大学校长。
description.en: Huang Wei served as the President of Nanjing Tech University from July 2012 to April 2017.

description.zh-cn: 黄维于2017年4月至2020年12月期间任西北工业大学常务副校长。
description.en: Huang Wei served as the Executive Vice President of Northwestern Polytechnical University from April 2017 to December 2020.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维曾任南京邮电大学教授和副校长。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei has served as a professor and vice president of Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维是江苏省科学技术协会副主席。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei is the Vice Chairman of the Jiangsu Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维是中国化工学会会士。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei is a fellow of the Chemical Industry and Engineering Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维是中国光学学会会士。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei is a fellow of the Chinese Optical Society.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维是中国电子学会副理事长。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei is the Vice President of the Chinese Institute of Electronics.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，黄维是国务院学位委员会第七届学科评议组成员。
description.en: According to category information, Huang Wei is a member of the 7th Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council's Subject Appraisal Group.

position.en: Deputy Chief of the General Staff

description.zh-cn: 1954年10月至1962年2月，李克农担任中国人民解放军副总参谋长。
description.en: From October 1954 to February 1962, Li Kenong served as the Deputy Chief of the General Staff of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 在李克农担任副总参谋长期间，粟裕是其上级总参谋长。
description.en: During Li Kenong's tenure as Deputy Chief of the General Staff, Su Yu was his superior, the Chief of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 1955年6月至1962年2月，李克农担任第一任中共中央调查部部长。
description.en: From June 1955 to February 1962, Li Kenong served as the first Minister of the Central Investigation Department of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 孔原接替李克农担任中共中央调查部部长。
description.en: Kong Yuan succeeded Li Kenong as the Minister of the Central Investigation Department of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 李克农于1926年冬加入中国共产党。
description.en: Li Kenong joined the Chinese Communist Party in the winter of 1926.

description.zh-cn: 李克农与赵瑛于1917年结婚，赵瑛于1961年去世。
description.en: Li Kenong married Zhao Ying in 1917, and she passed away in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 李克农于1962年2月9日在北京病逝，后葬于北京八宝山革命公墓。
description.en: Li Kenong died of illness in Beijing on February 9, 1962, and was later buried in the Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing.

position.zh-cn: 芜湖县党部宣传部部长
position.en: Head of the Propaganda Department of the Wuhu County Party Headquarters

description.zh-cn: 1927年3月，任国民党芜湖县党部宣传部部长。
description.en: In March 1927, he served as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the Kuomintang's Wuhu County Party Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 1931年4月，时任中共中央政治局候补委员的顾顺章在武汉被捕后叛变，对中共中央的安全构成严重威胁。
description.en: In April 1931, Gu Shunzhang, then an alternate member of the CCP Politburo, defected after being arrested in Wuhan, posing a severe threat to the security of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 钱壮飞获取了顾顺章叛变的情报，并设法通知李克农，使得中共中央机关得以安全转移。
description.en: Qian Zhuangfei obtained intelligence about Gu Shunzhang's defection and managed to inform Li Kenong, enabling the safe evacuation of the CCP central organs.

position.en: Director of the Political Security Bureau

description.zh-cn: 1932年，李克农任中国工农红军第一方面军政治保卫局局长。
description.en: In 1932, Li Kenong was appointed Director of the Political Security Bureau of the First Front Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 1938年11月，李克农组建八路军驻桂林办事处并任处长。
description.en: In November 1938, Li Kenong established the Eighth Route Army Office in Guilin and served as its director.

description.zh-cn: 1962年，李克农出席了七千人大会。
description.en: In 1962, Li Kenong attended the 7000 Cadres Conference.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波出生于中华人民共和国吉林省长春市。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo was born in Changchun, Jilin Province, People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波于1977年考入吉林大学中文系，1982年毕业并获得文学学士学位。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo was admitted to the Chinese Department of Jilin University in 1977 and graduated in 1982 with a Bachelor of Arts degree.

degree.en: Master of Arts, PhD in Aesthetics

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波于1982年考入北京师范大学中文系攻读硕士，1984年获硕士学位；1986年成为该系博士研究生，1988年获博士学位。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo enrolled in the Chinese Department of Beijing Normal University for his master's degree in 1982, receiving it in 1984; he became a doctoral candidate in the same department in 1986 and received his PhD in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波获得博士学位后留校任教，后因参与六四事件于1989年9月被开除公职。
description.en: After receiving his doctorate, Liu Xiaobo remained at the university as a lecturer, but was dismissed from public office in September 1989 for his involvement in the June Fourth Incident.

description.zh-cn: 陶力是刘晓波的第一任妻子，两人于六四事件后离婚。
description.en: Tao Li was Liu Xiaobo's first wife; they divorced after the June Fourth Incident.

description.zh-cn: 刘霞是刘晓波的第二任妻子，两人于1996年11月结婚，婚姻关系持续至刘晓波逝世。
description.en: Liu Xia was Liu Xiaobo's second wife. They married in November 1996, and their marriage lasted until his death.

description.zh-cn: 刘陶是刘晓波的儿子。
description.en: Liu Tao is the son of Liu Xiaobo.

description.zh-cn: 刘陶是陶力的儿子。
description.en: Liu Tao is the son of Tao Li.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波是刘伶的儿子。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo is the son of Liu Ling.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波是张素勤的儿子。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo is the son of Zhang Suqin.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波积极参与八九学运，并与周舵、高新、侯德健共同发表《六·二绝食宣言》，在天安门广场绝食，被称为“天安门广场四君子”。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo actively participated in the 1989 student movement, co-authoring the 'June Second Hunger Strike Declaration' with Zhou Duo, Gao Xin, and Hou Dejian, and went on a hunger strike in Tiananmen Square, becoming known as one of the 'Four Gentlemen of Tiananmen Square'.

description.zh-cn: 刘晓波于2003年11月当选独立中文笔会第一届会长，并于2005年连任，直至2007年卸任。
description.en: Liu Xiaobo was elected the first president of the Independent Chinese PEN Center in November 2003, was re-elected in 2005, and served until 2007.

description.zh-cn: 与周舵、高新、侯德健共同发起“六二绝食宣言”，并一同在天安门广场绝食，被称为“天安门广场四君子”。
description.en: Co-initiated the 'June Second Hunger Strike Declaration' with Zhou Duo, Gao Xin, and Hou Dejian, and went on hunger strike together in Tiananmen Square, known as the 'Four Gentlemen of Tiananmen Square'.

description.zh-cn: 与周舵、高新、侯德健共同发起“六二绝食宣言”，并一同在天安门广场绝食，被称为“天安门广场四君子”。
description.en: Co-initiated the 'June Second Hunger Strike Declaration' with Zhou Duo, Gao Xin, and Hou Dejian, and went on hunger strike together in Tiananmen Square, known as the 'Four Gentlemen of Tiananmen Square'.

description.zh-cn: 与周舵、高新、侯德健共同发起“六二绝食宣言”，并一同在天安门广场绝食，被称为“天安门广场四君子”。
description.en: Co-initiated the 'June Second Hunger Strike Declaration' with Zhou Duo, Gao Xin, and Hou Dejian, and went on hunger strike together in Tiananmen Square, known as the 'Four Gentlemen of Tiananmen Square'.

description.zh-cn: 在社民党领袖格哈特·施罗德任职期间，朔尔茨担任该党总书记。
description.en: Scholz served as SPD General Secretary while Gerhard Schröder was the party leader.

position.zh-cn: 联邦劳动及社会事务部部长、联邦副总理兼财政部长
position.en: Minister of Labour and Social Affairs, Vice Chancellor and Minister of Finance

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨在默克尔总理领导的内阁中先后担任过两个不同时期的部长级职务。
description.en: Scholz held ministerial positions in two different periods under Chancellor Angela Merkel's cabinets.

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨领导社民党与绿党、自由民主党达成联合执政协议，组建了“红绿灯联盟”政府。
description.en: Scholz led the SPD to form a coalition agreement with the Greens and the FDP, creating the 'traffic light coalition' government.

description.zh-cn: 因2025年财政预算案存在分歧，朔尔茨解除了林德纳的财政部长职务。
description.en: Due to disagreements over the 2025 budget, Scholz dismissed Lindner from his position as Minister of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨解除财长林德纳职务的决定，直接触发了自由民主党退出执政联盟，导致联合政府解体。
description.en: Scholz's decision to dismiss Finance Minister Lindner directly triggered the FDP's withdrawal from the ruling coalition, causing the collapse of the government.

description.zh-cn: 弗里德里希·默茨于2025年5月6日接替朔尔茨成为德国总理。
description.en: Friedrich Merz succeeded Scholz as Chancellor of Germany on May 6, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵是朔尔茨发表“时代转折演讲”的直接原因，该演讲标志着德国国防和外交政策的重大转变。
description.en: Russia's invasion of Ukraine was the direct cause for Scholz's 'Zeitenwende speech', which marked a major shift in German defense and foreign policy.

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨在德国联邦议院发表了“时代转折”演讲，宣布增加国防开支并向乌克兰提供武器。
description.en: Scholz delivered the 'Zeitenwende speech' in the Bundestag, announcing increased defense spending and arms supplies to Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨应时任中国国务院总理李克强的邀请，对中国进行正式访问。
description.en: Scholz paid an official visit to China at the invitation of then-Premier of the State Council of China, Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨在担任总理期间两次访问中国，并与中国国家主席习近平举行会晤。
description.en: During his chancellorship, Scholz visited China twice and met with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 朔尔茨应中国国务院总理李强的邀请，于2024年4月对中国进行访问。
description.en: Scholz visited China in April 2024 at the invitation of Chinese Premier Li Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱担任国家安全会议秘书长期间，马英九为时任中华民国总统兼国家安全会议主席。
description.en: While Kao Hua-chu served as Secretary-General of the National Security Council, Ma Ying-jeou was the incumbent President of the Republic of China and Chairman of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 正37期步兵科毕业。
description.en: Graduated from the 37th class of the Infantry Division.

description.zh-cn: 毕业于陆军指参学院63年班和战争学院正71年班。
description.en: Graduated from the 63rd class of the Army Command and Staff College and the 71st class of the War College.

description.zh-cn: 因洪仲丘事件处理不当，高华柱请辞国防部长并获准，结束其部长任期。
description.en: Due to mismanagement of the Hung Chung-chiu incident, Kao Hua-chu's resignation as Minister of National Defense was accepted, ending his term.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱是此次空难的生还者之一，虽身负重伤但仍成功求援，此经历对其军旅生涯有重要影响。
description.en: Kao Hua-chu was one of the survivors of this air crash. Despite being seriously injured, he managed to seek help. This experience had a significant impact on his military career.

description.zh-cn: 在1974年昌平空难中，高华柱身受重伤仍奋不顾身向外求援，使得同机遇难的总司令于豪章得以保住性命。
description.en: In the 1974 Changping air crash, Kao Hua-chu, despite being seriously injured, disregarded his own safety to seek help, which saved the life of Commander-in-Chief Yu Hao-chang, who was on the same helicopter.

description.zh-cn: 在新加坡举行的“两岸领导人会面”（马习会）中，时任国安会秘书长的高华柱陪同马英九与习近平会面。
description.en: During the Ma-Xi meeting in Singapore, Kao Hua-chu, then Secretary-General of the National Security Council, accompanied Ma Ying-jeou to meet with Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 林毅夫投奔中国大陆前，曾于高华柱担任营长的单位服役。
description.en: Before defecting to mainland China, Justin Yifu Lin served in a unit where Kao Hua-chu was the battalion commander.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱接替金溥聪出任国家安全会议秘书长。
description.en: Kao Hua-chu succeeded King Pu-tsung as Secretary-General of the National Security Council.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱因洪仲丘事件请辞国防部长，由杨念祖接任。
description.en: Kao Hua-chu resigned as Minister of National Defense over the Hung Chung-chiu incident, and was succeeded by Andrew Yang.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱的国家安全会议秘书长职位由吴钊燮接任。
description.en: Kao Hua-chu's position as Secretary-General of the National Security Council was succeeded by Joseph Wu.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱接替陈肇敏出任国防部长。
description.en: Kao Hua-chu succeeded Chen Chao-min as Minister of National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 高华柱以国家安全会议秘书长身分陪同马英九总统参加两岸领导人会面，成为第一位以政府官员身份会见习近平的中华民国国军退役将领。
description.en: As Secretary-General of the National Security Council, Kao Hua-chu accompanied President Ma Ying-jeou to the cross-strait leaders' meeting, becoming the first retired ROC military general to meet Xi Jinping in an official government capacity.

description.zh-cn: 程砚秋是梅兰芳的门下弟子。
description.en: Cheng Yanqiu was a disciple of Mei Lanfang.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳是“四大名旦”之首。
description.en: Mei Lanfang was the leader of the 'Four Great Dan Roles'.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，梅兰芳当选第一届全国人大代表。
description.en: In 1954, Mei Lanfang was elected as a representative to the First National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1959年，梅兰芳加入中国共产党。
description.en: In 1959, Mei Lanfang joined the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳得到中共领导人毛泽东赏识，毛泽东甚至称呼他为“梅老板”。
description.en: Mei Lanfang was appreciated by the CCP leader Mao Zedong, who even called him 'Boss Mei'.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，齐如山介绍齐白石和梅兰芳相识。
description.en: In 1920, Qi Rushan introduced Qi Baishi and Mei Lanfang to each other.

description.zh-cn: 齐白石与梅兰芳建立了师友之谊。
description.en: Qi Baishi and Mei Lanfang established a friendship of teacher and student.

description.zh-cn: 梅兰芳拒绝为汪精卫国民政府演出，并蓄须明志。
description.en: Mei Lanfang refused to perform for the Wang Jingwei regime and grew a beard to show his determination.

description.zh-cn: 1924年，为给关东大地震赈灾，梅兰芳受邀赴日进行义演。
description.en: In 1924, Mei Lanfang was invited to Japan for a benefit performance to provide relief for the Great Kantō earthquake.

description.zh-cn: 1930年访美期间，南加州大学授予梅兰芳文学荣誉博士学位。
description.en: During his visit to the US in 1930, the University of Southern California awarded Mei Lanfang an honorary Doctor of Letters degree.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾海洋大学为中华民国教育部管辖的国立大学。
description.en: National Taiwan Ocean University is a national university under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾海洋大学是亚马逊网路服务系统AWS Academy成员。
description.en: National Taiwan Ocean University is a member of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Academy.

description.zh-cn: 2020年8月，国立基隆高级海事职业学校改隶为国立台湾海洋大学的附属学校。
description.en: In August 2020, the National Keelung Maritime Vocational High School became an affiliated school of National Taiwan Ocean University.

description.zh-cn: 教育部推动将国立基隆高级海事职业学校改隶为国立台湾海洋大学的附属学校。
description.en: The Ministry of Education promoted the affiliation of the National Keelung Maritime Vocational High School with National Taiwan Ocean University.

description.zh-cn: 桃园市政府与国立台湾海洋大学签署合作意向书，推动在观音区设立“观音校区”。
description.en: The Taoyuan City Government and National Taiwan Ocean University signed a letter of intent for cooperation to promote the establishment of the 'Guanyin Campus' in Guanyin District.

description.zh-cn: 《德苏互不侵犯条约》中的秘密协定瓜分了波兰，为德国和苏联的入侵行动消除了障碍并提供了合作基础。
description.en: The secret protocol of the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact, which partitioned Poland, removed obstacles and provided a basis for cooperation for the German and Soviet invasions.

description.zh-cn: 作为纳粹德国元首，阿道夫·希特勒于1939年4月3日批准了入侵波兰的军事计划《白色方案》，并最终下令执行。
description.en: As Führer of Nazi Germany, Adolf Hitler approved the military plan 'Case White' for the invasion of Poland on April 3, 1939, and ultimately ordered its execution.

description.zh-cn: 在波兰战役期间，纳粹德国与波兰第二共和国是主要交战方。
description.en: During the Invasion of Poland, Nazi Germany and the Second Polish Republic were the main belligerents.

description.zh-cn: 在波兰战役期间，苏联入侵并与波兰第二共和国交战。
description.en: During the Invasion of Poland, the Soviet Union invaded and engaged in combat with the Second Polish Republic.

description.zh-cn: 苏联从东面入侵，使波兰在东部腹地重组防线的最后希望破灭，对其最终战败起到了决定性作用。
description.en: The Soviet invasion from the east shattered Poland's last hope of reorganizing its defense in the eastern heartland, playing a decisive role in its final defeat.

description.zh-cn: 英法宣战后在西线按兵不动，导致波兰未能获得其盟友有效的军事援助，被迫独自抵抗。
description.en: After declaring war, Britain and France remained inactive on the Western Front, which meant Poland did not receive effective military assistance from its allies and was forced to resist alone.

description.zh-cn: 波军在布楚拉战役中的反击失败，其主力部队被德军包围歼灭，严重削弱了波兰的抵抗能力。
description.en: The failure of the Polish counter-attack in the Battle of the Bzura led to the encirclement and annihilation of its main forces by the German army, severely weakening Poland's ability to resist.

description.zh-cn: 瓦尔特·冯·布劳齐区作为德国陆军总司令，向作为国家元首和武装部队最高统帅的希特勒负责。
description.en: As Commander-in-Chief of the German Army, Walther von Brauchitsch was responsible to Hitler, the head of state and supreme commander of the armed forces.

description.zh-cn: 在波兰战役的指挥链中，南方集团军司令伦德施泰特隶属于陆军总司令布劳齐区。
description.en: In the chain of command for the Invasion of Poland, Gerd von Rundstedt, as commander of Army Group South, was subordinate to the Army Commander-in-Chief Walther von Brauchitsch.

description.zh-cn: 在波兰战役的指挥链中，北方集团军司令冯·博克隶属于陆军总司令布劳齐区。
description.en: In the chain of command for the Invasion of Poland, Fedor von Bock, as commander of Army Group North, was subordinate to the Army Commander-in-Chief Walther von Brauchitsch.

position.en: Chief of Staff of Army Group South

description.zh-cn: 埃里希·冯·曼施坦因在波兰战役期间担任南方集团军司令伦德施泰特的参谋长。
description.en: During the Invasion of Poland, Erich von Manstein served as Chief of Staff to Gerd von Rundstedt, the commander of Army Group South.

description.zh-cn: 法国是波兰的传统盟国，两国自1921年起便有同盟条约，并在1939年5月重申了军事互助承诺。
description.en: France was a traditional ally of Poland, with the two countries having a treaty of alliance since 1921 and reaffirming their mutual military assistance commitments in May 1939.

description.zh-cn: 1939年8月23日，德国外长里宾特洛甫与苏联外长莫洛托夫在莫斯科会面并共同签署了《德苏互不侵犯条约》。
description.en: On August 23, 1939, German Foreign Minister Ribbentrop and Soviet Foreign Minister Molotov met in Moscow and jointly signed the German-Soviet Non-Aggression Pact.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国海关总署广东分署是中华人民共和国海关总署的派出机构，由海关总署进行业务和组织领导。
description.en: The Guangdong Branch of the General Administration of Customs is a dispatched agency of the General Administration of Customs and is under its operational and organizational leadership.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国海关总署广东分署成立于1980年，是海关总署设立的派出机构。
description.en: The Guangdong Branch of the General Administration of Customs was established in 1980 as a dispatched agency set up by the General Administration of Customs.

description.zh-cn: 深圳海关在海关总署广东分署的管辖范围内。
description.en: Shenzhen Customs is within the jurisdiction of the Guangdong Branch of the General Administration of Customs.

description.zh-cn: 2004年9月，海关总署授权其广东分署负责协调和处理泛珠三角区域的合作工作。
description.en: In September 2004, the General Administration of Customs authorized its Guangdong Branch to coordinate and handle cooperation work in the Pan-Pearl River Delta region.

description.zh-cn: 2005年2月，海关总署广东分署公布了《海关积极参与和推动泛珠三角区域合作的十项措施》，启动了合作机制。
description.en: In February 2005, the Guangdong Branch of the General Administration of Customs announced the 'Ten Measures for Customs to Actively Participate in and Promote Pan-Pearl River Delta Regional Cooperation,' launching the cooperation mechanism.

description.zh-cn: 香港海关对泛珠三角区域海关合作机制予以支持和参与。
description.en: Hong Kong Customs supported and participated in the Pan-Pearl River Delta regional customs cooperation mechanism.

description.zh-cn: 澳门海关对泛珠三角区域海关合作机制予以支持和参与。
description.en: Macao Customs supported and participated in the Pan-Pearl River Delta regional customs cooperation mechanism.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，海关总署是国务院直属机构。
description.en: According to the infobox, the General Administration of Customs is an institution directly under the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 丽的呼声（香港）有限公司创办了丽的电视台，初名为“丽的映声”，是亚洲电视的前身。
description.en: Rediffusion (Hong Kong) Limited founded Rediffusion Television, initially named 'Lai Dik Ying Sing', which was the predecessor of Asia Television.

description.zh-cn: 邱德根于1982年6月取得丽的电视的控制权，并于同年9月将其易名为“亚洲电视”。
description.en: Deacon Chiu gained control of Rediffusion Television in June 1982 and renamed it 'Asia Television' in September of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 将丽的电视易名为亚洲电视。
description.en: Renamed Rediffusion Television to Asia Television.

description.zh-cn: 林百欣家族的丽新集团于1988年联手郑裕彤家族的新世界集团购入亚视股权，后成为主要股东。
description.en: Lim Por-yen's family-owned Lai Sun Group, along with Cheng Yu-tung's New World Group, acquired a stake in ATV in 1988, later becoming the major shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 郑裕彤家族的新世界集团于1988年联手林百欣家族的丽新集团购入亚视股权。
description.en: Cheng Yu-tung's family-owned New World Group, along with Lim Por-yen's Lai Sun Group, acquired a stake in ATV in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 旺旺集团董事长蔡衍明于2009年入股亚洲电视。
description.en: Tsai Eng-Meng, chairman of the Want Want Group, acquired a stake in ATV in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 中国大陆商人王征于2010年成为亚洲电视的主要投资者。
description.en: Mainland Chinese businessman Wang Zheng became the major investor in ATV in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 一系列财困、欠薪及股权争拗问题，最终导致亚洲电视的免费电视牌照不获续期，并于2016年4月2日终止广播。
description.en: A series of financial difficulties, wage arrears, and shareholding disputes ultimately led to the non-renewal of ATV's free-to-air television license, ceasing its broadcast on April 2, 2016.

description.zh-cn: 于2015年4月1日决定不再续牌予亚洲电视。
description.en: On April 1, 2015, decided not to renew the license for Asia Television.

description.zh-cn: 作为时任商务及经济发展局局长，宣布亚洲电视的免费电视牌照不获续期。
description.en: As the then Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development, announced the non-renewal of ATV's free-to-air television license.

description.zh-cn: 在得知政府建议不为亚视续牌后，拒绝注资，直接导致亚视面临财政危机和欠薪问题。
description.en: After learning about the government's recommendation not to renew ATV's license, he refused to inject further capital, directly leading to ATV's financial crisis and wage arrears.

description.zh-cn: 前身为协盛协丰的公司完成对亚视大多数股权的收购，成为其母公司，并推动其转型为网络电视。
description.en: The company, formerly known as Co-Prosperity Holdings, completed the acquisition of a majority stake in ATV, becoming its parent company and driving its transformation into an internet television provider.

description.zh-cn: 亚洲电视数码媒体是亚洲电视控股旗下的子公司，负责运营网络电视业务，后被清盘。
description.en: Asia Television Digital Media was a subsidiary of Asia Television Holdings, responsible for operating the internet TV business before being liquidated.

description.zh-cn: 高等法院于2022年9月7日向亚洲电视数码媒体有限公司发出清盘令。
description.en: The High Court issued a winding-up order against Asia Television Digital Media Limited on September 7, 2022.

description.zh-cn: 出任丽的电视总经理后，大胆起用新人，发掘并提拔了麦当雄。
description.en: After becoming the general manager of Rediffusion Television, he boldly promoted new talent, discovering and advancing Johnny Mak.

description.zh-cn: 自1967年启播以来，无线电视一直是丽的电视及后来的亚洲电视在香港免费电视市场上的主要和长期竞争对手。
description.en: Since its launch in 1967, TVB has been the main and long-term competitor to Rediffusion Television and its successor, Asia Television, in Hong Kong's free-to-air television market.

description.zh-cn: 作为临时清盘人，于2016年3月3日宣布遣散所有亚视员工，实质上终止了电视台的运作。
description.en: As provisional liquidator, Deloitte announced the dismissal of all ATV employees on March 3, 2016, effectively halting the station's operations.

description.zh-cn: 该剧集取得了高收视率，帮助丽的电视（亚视前身）在与无线电视的竞争中取得收视优势。
description.en: The series achieved high ratings, helping Rediffusion Television (ATV's predecessor) gain a viewership advantage in its competition with TVB.

description.zh-cn: 该剧集取得了高收视率，帮助丽的电视（亚视前身）突破收视弱势。
description.en: The series achieved high ratings, helping Rediffusion Television (ATV's predecessor) break its viewership slump.

description.zh-cn: 该剧集的高收视率迫使无线电视腰斩同时段的单元节目。
description.en: The high ratings of this series forced TVB to cancel its concurrently broadcast unit programs.

description.zh-cn: 该游戏节目取得了极高收视，一度击败竞争对手无线电视的王牌节目《香港小姐竞选决赛》，为亚视带来辉煌时刻。
description.en: This game show achieved extremely high ratings, once defeating rival TVB's flagship program 'Miss Hong Kong Pageant Final', bringing a moment of glory to ATV.

description.zh-cn: 《ATV焦点》节目对反国民教育人士的偏颇批评引发了破纪录的观众投诉，严重损害了亚洲电视的公众形象和信誉。
description.en: The biased criticism of anti-national education activists on the program 'ATV Focus' triggered a record number of viewer complaints, severely damaging ATV's public image and credibility.

description.zh-cn: 该事件严重损害了亚洲电视新闻部的公信力及其整体品牌形象。
description.en: This incident severely damaged the credibility of ATV's news department and its overall brand image.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国应急管理部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Emergency Management is a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据2018年《国务院机构改革方案》，整合多个部门的相关职责，组建了应急管理部。
description.en: According to the 2018 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan', the Ministry of Emergency Management was established by integrating the relevant responsibilities of multiple departments.

description.zh-cn: 根据2018年《国务院机构改革方案》，国家安全生产监督管理总局的职责被整合进应急管理部，该机构不再保留。
description.en: According to the 2018 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan', the responsibilities of the State Administration of Work Safety were integrated into the Ministry of Emergency Management, and the agency was no longer retained.

description.zh-cn: 国家矿山安全监察局由应急管理部管理。
description.en: The National Mine Safety Administration is administered by the Ministry of Emergency Management.

description.zh-cn: 国家消防救援局由应急管理部管理。
description.en: The National Fire and Rescue Administration is administered by the Ministry of Emergency Management.

description.zh-cn: 中国地震局由应急管理部管理。
description.en: The China Earthquake Administration is administered by the Ministry of Emergency Management.

description.zh-cn: 国家煤矿安全监察局于2020年更名为国家矿山安全监察局。
description.en: The State Administration of Coal Mine Safety was renamed the National Mine Safety Administration in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 王祥喜于2022年7月起任应急管理部党委书记，2022年9月起任部长。
description.en: Wang Xiangxi has served as Party Secretary of the Ministry of Emergency Management since July 2022, and as Minister since September 2022.

description.zh-cn: 王玉普是中华人民共和国应急管理部首任部长。
description.en: Wang Yupu was the first Minister of the Ministry of Emergency Management of the People's Republic of China.
Huang Ming served as Vice Minister (2018-2021), Minister (2021-2022), and Party Secretary (2020-2022) of the Ministry of Emergency Management.

description.zh-cn: 黄锦生自2023年5月起担任国家矿山安全监察局局长、党组书记。
description.en: Huang Jinsheng has served as the Director and Party Group Secretary of the National Mine Safety Administration since May 2023.

description.zh-cn: 黄锦生自2023年5月起担任应急管理部党委委员。
description.en: Huang Jinsheng has served as a member of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Emergency Management since May 2023.

description.zh-cn: 黑手会是策划萨拉热窝事件的幕后组织，刺客均为其成员或受其领导。
description.en: The Black Hand was the organization behind the planning of the Sarajevo incident, and the assassins were its members or led by them.

description.zh-cn: 加夫里洛·普林齐普是黑手会的骨干成员。
description.en: Gavrilo Princip was a core member of the Black Hand.

description.zh-cn: 加夫里洛·普林齐普的刺杀动机与青年波斯尼亚组织的目标一致。
description.en: Gavrilo Princip's motive for the assassination was consistent with the goals of the Young Bosnia organization.

description.zh-cn: 萨拉热窝事件后，奥匈帝国于1914年7月28日对塞尔维亚王国宣战。
description.en: Following the Sarajevo incident, Austria-Hungary declared war on the Kingdom of Serbia on July 28, 1914.

description.zh-cn: 霍恩贝格女公爵苏菲是弗朗茨·斐迪南大公的妻子。
description.en: Sophie, Duchess of Hohenberg was the wife of Archduke Franz Ferdinand.

description.zh-cn: 德意志帝国是奥匈帝国的盟友，在七月危机中坚定支持奥匈帝国。
description.en: The German Empire was an ally of Austria-Hungary and firmly supported it during the July Crisis.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南大公是奥皇弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世的皇位继承人，并奉其指示视察波斯尼亚。
description.en: Archduke Franz Ferdinand was the heir to Emperor Franz Joseph I and inspected Bosnia under his instructions.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨·斐迪南是联邦制的支持者，大致倾向于将奥匈帝国重组为大奥地利合众国。
description.en: Franz Ferdinand was a supporter of federalism and generally favored reorganizing Austria-Hungary into the United States of Greater Austria.

description.zh-cn: 法务部调查局隶属于法务部。
description.en: The Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau is subordinate to the Ministry of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党党员通讯局改隶中华民国内政部，并更名为内政部调查局。
description.en: The Party Members Communication Bureau of the Kuomintang was transferred to the Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of China and renamed the Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of the Interior.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党中央执行委员会调查统计局（中统）被撤销后，更名为中国国民党党员通讯局。
