description.en: After the Investigation and Statistics Bureau of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang (Zhongtong) was abolished, it was renamed the Party Members Communication Bureau of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党中央执行委员会决议撤销中统局。
description.en: The Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang resolved to abolish the Zhongtong Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，国防部保密局的保防侦查等业务拨归调查局。
description.en: In 1955, functions such as counter-intelligence and investigation from the Confidentiality Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense were transferred to the Investigation Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 沈之岳被称为“调查局之父”。
description.en: Shen Zhiyue is known as the 'Father of the Investigation Bureau'.

description.zh-cn: 卸任调查局长后，接任法务部部长。
description.en: After leaving the post of Director of the Investigation Bureau, he became the Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 卸任调查局长后，升任法务部部长。
description.en: After leaving the post of Director of the Investigation Bureau, he was promoted to Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 资安鉴识实验室设于法务部调查局资通安全处下。
description.en: The Information Security Forensic Laboratory is established under the Cyber Security Investigation Office of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 2006年12月26日，时任总统陈水扁为法务部调查局资安鉴识实验室揭牌启用。
description.en: On December 26, 2006, then-President Chen Shui-bian inaugurated the Information Security Forensic Laboratory of the Ministry of Justice Investigation Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义成功后，革命党人于1911年10月11日成立了中华民国军政府鄂军都督府。
description.en: After the success of the Wuchang Uprising, revolutionaries established the Wuchang Uprising Military Government of the Republic of China on October 11, 1911.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义是在中国同盟会等革命组织的领导下发动的。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising was launched under the leadership of revolutionary organizations such as the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 湖北军政府成立后，宣布废除清朝宣统年号，并发布檄文揭露清政府的罪状。
description.en: After its establishment, the Hubei Military Government announced the abolition of the Qing Dynasty's Xuantong era name and issued proclamations exposing the crimes of the Qing government.

description.zh-cn: 随着1912年1月1日中华民国临时政府在南京成立，湖北军政府作为代行中央政府的职责结束，并于同日解散。
description.en: With the establishment of the Provisional Government of the Republic of China in Nanjing on January 1, 1912, the Hubei Military Government's role as the acting central government ended, and it was dissolved on the same day.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后，被革命党人及立宪派共举为湖北军政府都督。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising, he was jointly elected as the Military Governor of the Hubei Military Government by revolutionaries and constitutionalists.

position.zh-cn: 民政总长、政事部长、编辑部长
position.en: Chief of Civil Affairs, Minister of Political Affairs, Minister of Editing

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府中担任多个要职，包括民政总长、政事部长和编辑部长。
description.en: Held several important positions in the Hubei Military Government, including Chief of Civil Affairs, Minister of Political Affairs, and Minister of Editing.

position.zh-cn: 军务部正长、军务部部长
position.en: Head of the Military Affairs Department, Minister of Military Affairs

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府中担任军务部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Military Affairs in the Hubei Military Government.

position.en: Deputy Head of the Military Affairs Department

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府原定计划中任军务部副长。
description.en: Was designated as the Deputy Head of the Military Affairs Department in the original plan for the Hubei Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府原定计划中任参议部正长。
description.en: Was designated as the Head of the Advisory Department in the original plan for the Hubei Military Government.

position.zh-cn: 理财部副长、军务部副部长
position.en: Deputy Head of the Finance Department, Deputy Minister of Military Affairs

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府中担任军务部副部长等职。
description.en: Served as Deputy Minister of Military Affairs and other roles in the Hubei Military Government.

position.zh-cn: 政事部副部长、司法部长
position.en: Deputy Minister of Political Affairs, Minister of Justice

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府中担任政事部副部长、司法部长。
description.en: Served as Deputy Minister of Political Affairs and Minister of Justice in the Hubei Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 在湖北军政府中担任实业部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Industry in the Hubei Military Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国军政府鄂军都督府设于原湖北省咨议局大楼旧址。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising Military Government of the Republic of China was established at the former site of the Hubei Provincial Consultative Assembly building.

description.zh-cn: 黎元洪原为清军协统，起初激烈反对革命，并曾手刃革命士兵。
description.en: Originally a brigade commander in the Qing army, Li Yuanhong fiercely opposed the revolution at first and had personally killed revolutionary soldiers.

description.zh-cn: 湖北军政府最先倡议组织临时政府，并通过组织各省代表会，为南京临时政府的建立作了思想舆论和组织上的准备。
description.en: The Hubei Military Government was the first to propose the organization of a provisional government and made ideological, public opinion, and organizational preparations for the establishment of the Nanjing Provisional Government by organizing the conference of provincial representatives.

description.zh-cn: 1911年12月29日，各省代表选举孙中山为中华民国第一任临时大总统。
description.en: On December 29, 1911, representatives from various provinces elected Sun Yat-sen as the first Provisional President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1912年1月3日，各省代表选举黎元洪为临时副总统。
description.en: On January 3, 1912, representatives from various provinces elected Li Yuanhong as the Provisional Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后，湖北军攻入城内对满人进行了血腥屠杀，据估计约有800人被杀。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising, the Hubei army entered the city and carried out a bloody massacre of the Manchus, with an estimated 800 people killed.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命武昌起义纪念馆设在中华民国军政府鄂军都督府的旧址。
description.en: The Museum of the Wuchang Uprising of 1911 Revolution is located at the former site of the Wuchang Uprising Military Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中央党的建设工作领导小组的上级机构是中国共产党中央委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior body of the Central Leading Group for Party Building is the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中央党的建设工作领导小组是中国共产党中央政治局领导的议事协调机构。
description.en: The Central Leading Group for Party Building is a deliberation and coordination body led by the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 现任组长由蔡奇兼任。
description.en: The current leader is concurrently held by Cai Qi.

description.zh-cn: 李希担任中央党的建设工作领导小组副组长。
description.en: Li Xi serves as a Deputy Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building.

description.zh-cn: 石泰峰担任中央党的建设工作领导小组副组长。
description.en: Shi Taifeng serves as a Deputy Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊是中央党的建设工作领导小组成员。
description.en: Li Shulei is a member of the Central Leading Group for Party Building.

description.zh-cn: 姜信治是中央党的建设工作领导小组成员。
description.en: Jiang Xinzhi is a member of the Central Leading Group for Party Building.

description.zh-cn: 乔石是中央党的建设工作领导小组首任组长。
description.en: Qiao Shi was the first Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛曾担任中央党的建设工作领导小组组长。
description.en: Hu Jintao once served as the Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building.

description.zh-cn: 习近平于2007年至2012年间兼任中央党的建设工作领导小组组长。
description.en: Xi Jinping concurrently served as the Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building from 2007 to 2012.

description.zh-cn: 贺国强于2007年至2012年间担任中央党的建设工作领导小组副组长。
description.en: He Guoqiang served as a Deputy Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building from 2007 to 2012.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮于2007年至2012年间担任中央党的建设工作领导小组副组长。
description.en: Li Yuanchao served as a Deputy Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building from 2007 to 2012.

description.zh-cn: 张春贤自2016年起担任中央党的建设工作领导小组副组长。
description.en: Zhang Chunxian has served as a Deputy Leader of the Central Leading Group for Party Building since 2016.

description.zh-cn: 春秋时期，鄂国被楚国吞并。
description.en: During the Spring and Autumn period, the State of E was annexed by the State of Chu.

description.zh-cn: 楚国的国都位于今湖北省荆州市。
description.en: The capital of the State of Chu was located in modern-day Jingzhou, Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 张之洞在湖北兴办洋务企业，创办了汉阳兵工厂。
description.en: Zhang Zhidong established Westernization enterprises in Hubei, founding the Hanyang Arsenal.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义促成了清朝的灭亡。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising led to the downfall of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义促成了中华民国的建立。
description.en: The Wuchang Uprising led to the establishment of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 由于2019冠状病毒病疫情扩散，湖北省各地自2020年1月起相继实施封城措施。
description.en: Due to the spread of the COVID-19 pandemic, various places in Hubei Province implemented lockdown measures starting in January 2020.

description.zh-cn: 武汉钢铁（集团）公司是中国宝武钢铁集团有限公司的子公司。
description.en: Wuhan Iron and Steel (Group) Corp. is a subsidiary of China Baowu Steel Group Corporation Limited.

description.zh-cn: 东风汽车公司总部位于武汉。
description.en: Dongfeng Motor Corporation is headquartered in Wuhan.

description.zh-cn: 现任中国共产党湖北省委员会书记。
description.en: Currently serves as the Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 现任湖北省人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Currently serves as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 现任湖北省人民政府省长。
description.en: Currently serves as the Governor of the Hubei Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 现任中国人民政治协商会议湖北省委员会主席。
description.en: Currently serves as the Chairman of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 2002年中共十六大报告首次提出了“实现中华民族伟大复兴”的口号。
description.en: The report of the 16th CCP National Congress in 2002 first proposed the slogan 'achieve the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation'.

description.zh-cn: 习近平就任中共中央总书记后，在“中华民族伟大复兴”的基础上提出了“中国梦”构想。
description.en: After becoming General Secretary of the CCP Central Committee, Xi Jinping proposed the 'Chinese Dream' concept based on the 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation'.

description.zh-cn: “中国梦”构想是在“中华民族伟大复兴”这一口号的基础上提出的，是其具体化的体现。
description.en: The 'Chinese Dream' concept was proposed on the basis of the 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation' slogan and is its concretization.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山提出了“振兴中华”的口号。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen proposed the slogan 'Rejuvenate China'.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山的“振兴中华”口号被视为“中华民族伟大复兴”概念的前身。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen's slogan 'Rejuvenate China' is considered a precursor to the concept of the 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation'.

description.zh-cn: 1997年中共十五大的报告提出“中华民族实现全面振兴”，为后来的“伟大复兴”口号奠定了基础。
description.en: The report of the 15th CCP National Congress in 1997 proposed 'achieving the comprehensive revitalization of the Chinese nation,' laying the foundation for the later 'great rejuvenation' slogan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民抗日战争的胜利被官方视为中华民族从近代以来陷入深重危机走向伟大复兴的历史转折点。
description.en: The victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression is regarded by officials as the historical turning point for the Chinese nation from a deep modern crisis towards great rejuvenation.

description.zh-cn: 中国官方论述认为，中国共产党在领导中国走向民族复兴的过程中发挥了核心作用。
description.en: Official Chinese discourse holds that the Chinese Communist Party has played a core role in leading China towards national rejuvenation.

description.zh-cn: 袁鹏是中国现代国际关系研究院的院长。
description.en: Yuan Peng is the President of the China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations.

description.zh-cn: 在2021年中美高层阿拉斯加会谈中，杨洁篪斥责美国代表“你们没有资格在中国的面前说，你们从实力的地位出发同中国谈话”。
description.en: During the 2021 Sino-American summit in Alaska, Yang Jiechi rebuked the U.S. representatives, stating, 'you are not qualified to say to China that you speak to China from a position of strength'.

description.zh-cn: 为提倡中华民族伟大复兴，中国官方对毛泽东的历史评价被进一步提升，并强调其对民族复兴的贡献。
description.en: In order to promote the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, the official historical evaluation of Mao Zedong has been further elevated, emphasizing his contributions to national rejuvenation.

description.zh-cn: 阿道夫·希特勒在纳粹德国时期使用了“元首”头衔及相关的“一个民族，一个帝国，一个元首”的政治口号。
description.en: Adolf Hitler used the title 'Führer' and the related political slogan 'One People, One Empire, One Leader' during the Nazi Germany era.

description.zh-cn: 有分析指出，习近平提倡的“中华民族伟大复兴”梦推动了中国的民族主义情绪。
description.en: Analyses indicate that the 'Great Rejuvenation of the Chinese Nation' dream promoted by Xi Jinping has fueled nationalist sentiments in China.

description.zh-cn: “一带一路”是中国为实现中华民族伟大复兴而提倡的多个策略之一。
description.en: 'The Belt and Road Initiative' is one of several strategies promoted by China to achieve the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

description.zh-cn: 中共十一届三中全会确立了邓小平的领导地位，实际上终结了华国锋作为最高领导人的时期。
description.en: The Third Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee established Deng Xiaoping's leadership, effectively ending Hua Guofeng's tenure as the paramount leader.

description.zh-cn: 大规模平反冤假错案是拨乱反正的重要组成部分，全国有数百万件案件得到纠正。
description.en: The large-scale rehabilitation of wrongful, false, and unjust cases was a crucial component of Boluan Fanzheng, with millions of cases being redressed nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 1980年，中共十一届五中全会为刘少奇全面平反，并恢复其作为党和国家领导人的一切名誉。
description.en: In 1980, the Fifth Plenary Session of the 11th CCP Central Committee fully rehabilitated Liu Shaoqi and restored all his honors as a leader of the Party and the state.

description.zh-cn: 元帅彭德怀在文革期间遭到残酷迫害，最终致死。
description.en: Marshal Peng Dehuai was brutally persecuted during the Cultural Revolution, which ultimately led to his death.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月，中共中央为彭德怀举行追悼会，为其平反并恢复名誉。
description.en: In December 1978, the CCP Central Committee held a memorial service for Peng Dehuai, posthumously rehabilitating him and restoring his reputation.

description.zh-cn: “两弹一星”元勋姚桐斌在文化大革命期间被红卫兵用钢棍毒打致死。
description.en: "Two Bombs, One Satellite" contributor Yao Tongbin was brutally beaten to death with steel bars by Red Guards during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在拨乱反正期间，中共中央为姚桐斌平反，并追认其为“烈士”。
description.en: During the Boluan Fanzheng period, the CCP Central Committee posthumously rehabilitated Yao Tongbin and recognized him as a "martyr."

description.zh-cn: “清除精神污染”运动批判了“新启蒙运动”中倡导的人道主义和自由主义思想。
description.en: The "Anti-Spiritual Pollution Campaign" criticized the humanistic and liberal ideas advocated in the "New Enlightenment" movement.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共中央总书记胡耀邦对“清除精神污染”运动的扩大化进行了干预，使其迅速结束。
description.en: Then CCP General Secretary Hu Yaobang intervened to curb the expansion of the "Anti-Spiritual Pollution Campaign," bringing it to a swift end.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共合作形成了抗日民族统一战线，确立了中国国民党和中国共产党共同抗击日本侵略者的战略态势。
description.en: The Second United Front formed the Anti-Japanese National United Front, establishing a strategic posture of joint resistance against Japanese invaders by the KMT and the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 台儿庄战役是中国军队取得的重大胜利，日军在此次战役中遭到重创并后撤，打破了其不可战胜的神话，振奋了全国军民的士气。
description.en: The Battle of Taierzhuang was a major victory for the Chinese army. The Japanese army was severely defeated and retreated, shattering the myth of its invincibility and boosting the morale of the entire nation.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月8日，苏联对日宣战，并出兵中国东北，迅速击溃了日本关东军，加速了日本的投降。
description.en: On August 8, 1945, the Soviet Union declared war on Japan and dispatched troops to Northeast China, quickly defeating the Kwantung Army and accelerating Japan's surrender.

description.zh-cn: 1945年9月9日，日本中国派遣军总司令官冈村宁次在南京向中国陆军总司令何应钦递交投降书，标志着中国战区抗日战争的正式结束。
description.en: On September 9, 1945, Yasuji Okamura, Commander-in-Chief of the Japanese China Expeditionary Army, presented the instrument of surrender to He Yingqin, Commander-in-Chief of the Chinese Army, in Nanjing, marking the official end of the Second Sino-Japanese War in the China Theatre.

description.zh-cn: 弘光帝朱由崧是朱常洵的长子。
description.en: The Hongguang Emperor, Zhu Yousong, was the eldest son of Zhu Changxun.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯十四年，李自成攻克洛阳，杀害了福王朱常洵。
description.en: In 1641, Li Zicheng captured Luoyang and killed the Prince of Fu, Zhu Changxun.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯十四年，李自成率领的大顺军攻克洛阳，杀害了福王朱常洵。
description.en: In 1641, the Dashun army led by Li Zicheng captured Luoyang and killed the Prince of Fu, Zhu Changxun.

description.zh-cn: 李自成攻克洛阳后，将前南京兵部尚书吕维祺与福王朱常洵一同杀害。
description.en: After capturing Luoyang, Li Zicheng killed former Minister of War in Nanjing, Lü Weiqi, along with the Prince of Fu, Zhu Changxun.

description.zh-cn: 在国本之争中，朱常洵与皇长子朱常洛争夺皇太子之位，二人成为政治上的对手。
description.en: During the Struggle for the Succession, Zhu Changxun competed with the emperor's eldest son, Zhu Changluo, for the position of crown prince, making them political rivals.

description.zh-cn: 在国本之争中，孝端显皇后支持立皇长子朱常洛为太子。
description.en: During the Struggle for the Succession, Empress Xiaoduanxian supported the establishment of the emperor's eldest son, Zhu Changluo, as crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 国本之争最终以朱常洵的失败告终，他未能被立为皇太子，而是被封为福王。
description.en: The Struggle for the Succession ended in failure for Zhu Changxun; he was not made crown prince but was instead enfeoffed as the Prince of Fu.

description.zh-cn: 国本之争最终以皇长子朱常洛被立为皇太子而告终。
description.en: The Struggle for the Succession concluded with the emperor's eldest son, Zhu Changluo, being established as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 根据《皇明祖训》中“立长”的原则，皇长子朱常洛的太子地位得到了大臣们的支持。
description.en: According to the principle of primogeniture in the 'Ancestral Injunctions of the Ming Emperor', the status of the emperor's eldest son, Zhu Changluo, as crown prince was supported by the ministers.

description.zh-cn: 万历廿九年，朱常洵被册封为福王。
description.en: In 1601, Zhu Changxun was enfeoffed as the Prince of Fu.

description.zh-cn: 马士英与卢九德等人在南京拥立朱由崧为皇帝，是为弘光帝。
description.en: Ma Shiying, along with Lu Jiude and others, enthroned Zhu Yousong as emperor in Nanjing, who became known as the Hongguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 卢九德与马士英等人在南京拥立朱由崧为皇帝，是为弘光帝。
description.en: Lu Jiude, along with Ma Shiying and others, enthroned Zhu Yousong as emperor in Nanjing, who became known as the Hongguang Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 1644年，朱由崧在南京即位，建立南明弘光政权。
description.en: In 1644, Zhu Yousong ascended the throne in Nanjing, establishing the Hongguang regime of the Southern Ming.

description.zh-cn: 弘光帝即位后，追谥其父朱常洵为孝皇帝。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Hongguang Emperor posthumously honored his father, Zhu Changxun, as Emperor Xiao.

description.zh-cn: 永历帝追封朱常洵庙号为恭宗。
description.en: The Yongli Emperor posthumously granted Zhu Changxun the temple name Gongzong.

description.zh-cn: 全国人大教科文卫委员会是全国人民代表大会下设的专门委员会，受其领导。
description.en: The NPC Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee is a special committee under the National People's Congress and is led by it.

description.zh-cn: 在全国人民代表大会闭会期间，全国人大教科文卫委员会受全国人民代表大会常务委员会领导。
description.en: During the recess of the National People's Congress, the NPC Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee is led by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1983年6月7日，第六届全国人民代表大会第一次会议表决设立了全国人民代表大会教育科学文化卫生委员会。
description.en: On June 7, 1983, the First Session of the 6th National People's Congress voted to establish the Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》第七十条规定全国人民代表大会设立专门委员会，为教科文卫委员会的设立提供了法律依据。
description.en: Article 70 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of China stipulates that the National People's Congress shall establish special committees, providing the legal basis for the establishment of the Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国全国人民代表大会组织法》第三十五条规定了专门委员会的设立，为教科文卫委员会的设立提供了法律依据。
description.en: Article 35 of the Organic Law of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China provides for the establishment of special committees, providing the legal basis for the establishment of the Education, Science, Culture and Public Health Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第六届、第七届主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 6th and 7th Committees.

description.zh-cn: 第八届主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 8th Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第九届主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 9th Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第十届主任委员。
description.en: Chairwoman of the 10th Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第十一届主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 11th Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第十二届主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 12th Committee.

description.zh-cn: 第十三届主任委员。
description.en: Chairman of the 13th Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张达原为张飞的部下。
description.en: Zhang Da was originally a subordinate of Zhang Fei.

description.zh-cn: 范彊原为张飞的部下。
description.en: Fan Qiang was originally a subordinate of Zhang Fei.

description.zh-cn: 因张飞刑罚过严，与范彊一同趁张飞醉酒酣睡时将其刺杀。
description.en: Due to Zhang Fei's excessive punishments, he and Fan Qiang assassinated Zhang Fei while he was drunk and asleep.

description.zh-cn: 因张飞刑罚过严，与张达一同趁张飞醉酒酣睡时将其刺杀。
description.en: Due to Zhang Fei's excessive punishments, he and Zhang Da assassinated Zhang Fei while he was drunk and asleep.

description.zh-cn: 刺杀张飞后，带着张飞的首级顺流而下投奔孙权。
description.en: After assassinating Zhang Fei, he took Zhang Fei's head and went downstream to defect to Sun Quan.

description.zh-cn: 刺杀张飞后，带着张飞的首级顺流而下投奔孙权。
description.en: After assassinating Zhang Fei, he took Zhang Fei's head and went downstream to defect to Sun Quan.

description.zh-cn: 章武元年（221年），为替关羽报仇，起兵讨伐东吴。
description.en: In the first year of Zhangwu (221 AD), he launched a punitive expedition against Eastern Wu to avenge Guan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 曾多次劝诫张飞，指出其刑罚过当、鞭打士卒后却将他们留在身边的行事方式是取祸之道。
description.en: He had repeatedly warned Zhang Fei that his practice of excessively punishing and flogging soldiers, yet keeping them by his side, was a path to disaster.

description.zh-cn: 根据《三国演义》的描述，张达被孙权送回蜀汉后，张苞将其万剐凌迟以为父报仇。
description.en: According to the 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', after Zhang Da was sent back to Shu Han by Sun Quan, Zhang Bao executed him by slow slicing to avenge his father.

description.zh-cn: 根据《三国演义》的描述，范彊被孙权送回蜀汉后，张苞将其万剐凌迟以为父报仇。
description.en: According to the 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', after Fan Qiang was sent back to Shu Han by Sun Quan, Zhang Bao executed him by slow slicing to avenge his father.

description.zh-cn: 朱允熙是朱标的第五子。
description.en: Zhu Yunxi is the fifth son of Zhu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 朱允熙的生母是吕太后。
description.en: Zhu Yunxi's biological mother is Empress Lü.

description.zh-cn: 吕氏是朱标的继妃。
description.en: Lady Lü was the secondary consort of Zhu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 朱允熙是建文帝的弟弟。
description.en: Zhu Yunxi is the younger brother of the Jianwen Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱允熙和朱允熥是兄弟关系。
description.en: Zhu Yunxi and Zhu Yunteng are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 朱允熙和朱允熞是兄弟关系。
description.en: Zhu Yunxi and Zhu Yunjian are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 建文帝失位后，明成祖将朱允熙降为敷惠王。
description.en: After the Jianwen Emperor lost his throne, the Yongle Emperor demoted Zhu Yunxi to Prince Fuhui.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖改封朱允熙为瓯宁王，以承奉其父朱标的祭祀。
description.en: The Yongle Emperor re-enfeoffed Zhu Yunxi as Prince of Ouning to continue the sacrificial rites for his father, Zhu Biao.

description.zh-cn: 明成祖将怀恩王朱允熞废为庶人。
description.en: The Yongle Emperor demoted Zhu Yunjian, Prince of Huai'en, to a commoner.

description.zh-cn: 吕太后是吕本的女儿。
description.en: Empress Lü is the daughter of Lü Ben.

description.zh-cn: 南明弘光帝追复朱允熙为徐王，并追谥为“哀”或“简”。
description.en: The Southern Ming Hongguang Emperor posthumously restored Zhu Yunxi as Prince of Xu and granted him the posthumous name 'Ai' or 'Jian'.

description.zh-cn: 工业革命带来的工业化是社会人群普遍化退休的背景条件，改变了以农业为主的经济结构和传统的养老方式。
description.en: The industrialization brought about by the Industrial Revolution was a prerequisite for widespread retirement, changing the agriculture-based economy and traditional ways of supporting the elderly.

description.zh-cn: 为了统一德意志组建德意志帝国而设计了现代退休制度，最初规定雇员在70岁退休。
description.en: Designed the modern retirement system in order to unify Germany and establish the German Empire, initially stipulating retirement for employees at the age of 70.

description.zh-cn: 出任陈州郡守时，以蔡黄裳年纪大为由，威胁并迫使其自请退休。
description.en: While serving as the prefect of Chenzhou, he threatened and forced Cai Huangshang to request retirement, citing his old age.

description.zh-cn: 香港政府于2000年起实施强制性公积金政策。
description.en: The Hong Kong government implemented the Mandatory Provident Fund policy starting from 2000.

description.zh-cn: 林维先出生于河南省商城县。
description.en: Lin Weixian was born in Shangcheng County, Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 林维先于1932年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Lin Weixian joined the Communist Party of China in 1932.

description.zh-cn: 林维先是中国人民解放军中将。
description.en: Lin Weixian was a Lieutenant General in the People's Liberation Army.

position.zh-cn: 第74师特务连指导员、第220团1营政治委员、团政治委员
position.en: Instructor of the Special Service Company of the 74th Division, Political Commissar of the 1st Battalion of the 220th Regiment, and Regiment Political Commissar

description.zh-cn: 林维先曾在红二十五军任职。
description.en: Lin Weixian held positions in the 25th Red Army.

position.en: Staff Officer of the Army Headquarters, Battalion Commander, Deputy Regiment Commander

description.zh-cn: 林维先曾在红二十八军任职。
description.en: Lin Weixian held positions in the 28th Red Army.

position.zh-cn: 副参谋长、沿江支队支队长兼中共地委书记，第19旅旅长
position.en: Deputy Chief of Staff, Commander of the Riverside Detachment and Secretary of the CPC Prefectural Committee, Commander of the 19th Brigade

description.zh-cn: 林维先曾在新四军第七师担任多个职务。
description.en: Lin Weixian held multiple positions in the 7th Division of the New Fourth Army.

position.en: Deputy Commander and Chief of Staff

description.zh-cn: 林维先曾任南京军区副司令员兼参谋长。
description.en: Lin Weixian served as the Deputy Commander and Chief of Staff of the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 林维先于1969年至1982年担任武汉军区副司令员。
description.en: Lin Weixian served as the Deputy Commander of the Wuhan Military Region from 1969 to 1982.

description.zh-cn: 林维先曾是中华人民共和国国防委员会委员。
description.en: Lin Weixian was a member of the National Defense Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，中华人民共和国授予林维先一级八一勋章、一级独立自由勋章、一级解放勋章，以表彰其在革命战争中的贡献。
description.en: In 1955, the People's Republic of China awarded Lin Weixian the First Class Medal of Bayi, the First Class Medal of Independence and Freedom, and the First Class Medal of Liberation in recognition of his contributions during the revolutionary wars.

description.zh-cn: 海伍德死亡案的复查揭示了谷开来的罪行，成为薄熙来案的重要背景和调查内容之一。
description.en: The re-investigation of the Neil Heywood death case revealed Gu Kailai's crime, becoming an important background and part of the investigation in the Bo Xilai case.

description.zh-cn: 周永康与薄熙来关系密切，据报道他曾抵制中央免去薄熙来职务的决定，并向薄泄露机密信息。
description.en: Zhou Yongkang had close ties to Bo Xilai; he reportedly resisted the central government's decision to remove Bo and leaked confidential information to him.

description.zh-cn: 前中共中央总书记江泽民支持免除薄熙来职务的决定，并称薄的问题已突破了人类文明的底线。
description.en: Former General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee Jiang Zemin supported the decision to remove Bo Xilai from his posts, stating that Bo's issues had broken the bottom line of human civilization.

description.zh-cn: 张德江接替薄熙来出任中共重庆市委书记。
description.en: Zhang Dejiang succeeded Bo Xilai as the Party Secretary of Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 受薄熙来案影响，其兄薄熙永（化名李学明）于2012年4月25日辞去中国光大集团执行董事兼副总经理职务。
description.en: Affected by the Bo Xilai case, his elder brother Bo Xiyong (alias Li Xueming) resigned from his positions as Executive Director and Deputy General Manager of China Everbright Group on April 25, 2012.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙永是薄熙来的兄长。
description.en: Bo Xiyong is Bo Xilai's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 中央巡视组批评孙政才主政的重庆清除“薄、王”遗毒不够彻底，这成为孙政才后来被查处的原因之一。
description.en: The Central Inspection Group criticized Chongqing under Sun Zhengcai's leadership for inadequately eliminating the 'pernicious influence' of Bo and Wang, which became one of the reasons for Sun's subsequent investigation.

description.zh-cn: 中央巡视组对重庆进行“回头看”后，对孙政才领导的市委提出严厉批评，为其后来被查处埋下伏笔。
description.en: After conducting a 'look back' inspection in Chongqing, the Central Inspection Group severely criticized the municipal party committee led by Sun Zhengcai, foreshadowing his eventual investigation.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波是第十四集团军的创建者之一。
description.en: Bo Yibo was one of the founders of the 14th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 薄熙来曾任中共中央政治局委员，直至2012年4月10日被停止职务。
description.en: Bo Xilai served as a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee until he was suspended from the position on April 10, 2012.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，越南出兵柬埔寨，推翻了红色高棉政权。
description.en: In 1979, Vietnam sent troops to Cambodia and overthrew the Khmer Rouge regime.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨人民共和国在柬越战争推翻红色高棉政权后成立。
description.en: The People's Republic of Kampuchea was established after the Khmer Rouge regime was overthrown in the Cambodian-Vietnamese War.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨人民共和国是在越南的协助下建立的。
description.en: The People's Republic of Kampuchea was established with the assistance of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨人民共和国是在苏联的协助下建立的。
description.en: The People's Republic of Kampuchea was established with the assistance of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨人民共和国由柬埔寨救国民族团结阵线主导成立。
description.en: The People's Republic of Kampuchea was established under the leadership of the Kampuchean United Front for National Salvation.

description.zh-cn: 在柬埔寨人民共和国存在期间，柬埔寨在联合国的席位由民主柬埔寨联合政府代表，阻碍了柬埔寨人民共和国获得国际承认。
description.en: During the existence of the People's Republic of Kampuchea, Cambodia's seat at the United Nations was held by the Coalition Government of Democratic Kampuchea, which hindered the PRK from gaining international recognition.

description.zh-cn: 1991年，柬埔寨人民革命党放弃了一党制。
description.en: In 1991, the Kampuchean People's Revolutionary Party abandoned the one-party system.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨人民革命武装力量是柬埔寨人民共和国的正规武装力量。
description.en: The Kampuchean People's Revolutionary Armed Forces was the regular armed force of the People's Republic of Kampuchea.

description.zh-cn: 1993年柬埔寨大选后，柬埔寨人民武装力量（柬埔寨人民革命武装力量的后续名称）与其他派别的部队合并，组建了柬埔寨王家军。
description.en: After the 1993 Cambodian general election, the Cambodian People's Armed Forces (the successor name to the KPRAF) was integrated with troops from other factions to form the Royal Cambodian Armed Forces.

description.zh-cn: 作为河内和金边之间的联络官，黎德寿干涉柬埔寨内政，对柬埔寨人民共和国政府施加了强大影响。
description.en: As the liaison officer between Hanoi and Phnom Penh, Lê Đức Thọ interfered in Cambodian internal affairs, exerting strong influence over the government of the People's Republic of Kampuchea.

description.zh-cn: 于2009年担任球员兼助理教练，2010年年中离队。
description.en: Served as a player-assistant coach in 2009 and left the team in mid-2010.

description.zh-cn: 2009年，黄勇在张效瑞执教的天津松江队担任球员兼助理教练。
description.en: In 2009, Huang Yong served as a player-assistant coach for Tianjin Songjiang, which was coached by Zhang Xiaorui.

description.zh-cn: 2011年7月，天津润宇隆易主并更名为沈阳沈北。
description.en: In July 2011, Tianjin Runyulong changed ownership and was renamed Shenyang Shenbei.

description.zh-cn: 2018-2019年担任主教练，2019年转为助理教练。
description.en: Served as head coach from 2018-2019, then became an assistant coach in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 黎笋在位期间采取亲近苏联的立场。
description.en: During his time in power, Lê Duẩn adopted a pro-Soviet stance.

description.zh-cn: 在黎笋的领导下，越南民主共和国（北越）统一了越南共和国（南越）。
description.en: Under the leadership of Lê Duẩn, the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam) unified the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam).

description.zh-cn: 奉系军阀是北洋军阀系统的一个主要派系。
description.en: The Fengtian clique was a major faction within the Beiyang warlord system.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖是奉系军阀的创始人。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin was the founder of the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 张学良在张作霖死后成为奉系军阀的首领。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang became the leader of the Fengtian clique after the death of Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 奉系与日本之间也存在冲突。
description.en: There were also conflicts between the Fengtian clique and Japan.

description.zh-cn: 奉系在第一次直奉战争中失败。
description.en: The Fengtian clique was defeated in the First Zhili-Fengtian War.

description.zh-cn: 奉系在第二次直奉战争中取得全胜。
description.en: The Fengtian clique achieved a complete victory in the Second Zhili-Fengtian War.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次直奉战争中，奉系以五十万大洋重赂冯玉祥，使其倒戈直系。
description.en: During the Second Zhili-Fengtian War, the Fengtian clique heavily bribed Feng Yuxiang with 500,000 silver dollars, causing him to defect from the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次直奉战争中，张学良指挥奉军包围吴佩孚主力，缴械纳降3万余人。
description.en: During the Second Zhili-Fengtian War, Zhang Xueliang commanded the Fengtian army to surround Wu Peifu's main force, disarming and accepting the surrender of over 30,000 troops.

description.zh-cn: 郭松龄作为奉系大学派的代表，后来反叛奉系。
description.en: Guo Songling, as a representative of the 'university faction' within the Fengtian clique, later rebelled against the clique.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖死后，张学良掌握兵权，宣布东北易帜，奉系改编为东北边防军（东北军）。
description.en: After Zhang Zuolin's death, Zhang Xueliang took control of the military, announced the Northeast Flag Replacement, and the Fengtian clique was reorganized into the Northeastern Border Defense Army (Northeastern Army).

description.zh-cn: 在中原大战中，东北军宣布支持蒋介石，派主力入关，从而结束了战争。
description.en: During the Central Plains War, the Northeastern Army announced its support for Chiang Kai-shek and sent its main forces into the Shanhai Pass, thus ending the war.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变中，因张学良的不抵抗政策，东北军主力不战而退，撤出东北。
description.en: During the Mukden Incident, due to Zhang Xueliang's non-resistance policy, the main force of the Northeastern Army retreated without a fight and withdrew from the Northeast.

description.zh-cn: 西安事变迫使蒋介石与中国共产党合作抗日。
description.en: The Xi'an Incident forced Chiang Kai-shek to cooperate with the Communist Party of China to resist Japan.

description.zh-cn: 西安事变后，东北军群龙无首，发生内讧（二二事件），并最终被南京政府整训、缩编，导致其作为一个独立军事政治实体的瓦解。
description.en: After the Xi'an Incident, the Northeastern Army was leaderless, experienced internal strife (the 'February 2nd Incident'), and was eventually reorganized and downsized by the Nanjing government, leading to its dissolution as an independent military and political entity.

description.zh-cn: 原东北军将领吕正操的部队被编入八路军。
description.en: The troops of former Northeastern Army general Lü Zhengcao were incorporated into the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 张学思早年即参加中国共产党。
description.en: Zhang Xuesi joined the Communist Party of China in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 公安部交通管理局是中华人民共和国公安部的正司局级内设机构。
description.en: The Traffic Management Bureau is a director-general level internal department of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据该页面的信息框，王强是公安部交通管理局的局长。
description.en: According to the infobox on this page, Wang Qiang is the director of the Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 在1983年至1986年以及1992年至1993年期间，公安部与交通部在道路交通管理的分工上存在分歧和矛盾，需国务院多次发文协调。
description.en: Between 1983-1986 and 1992-1993, the Ministry of Public Security and the Ministry of Transport had disagreements and conflicts over the division of labor in road traffic management, requiring multiple documents from the State Council to coordinate.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年12月召开的第一次全国公安交通管理工作会议上，时任公安部副部长俞雷作了报告，时任国务院秘书长罗干到会并作了重要讲话。
description.en: At the first National Public Security Traffic Management Work Conference in December 1989, then Vice Minister of Public Security Yu Lei gave a report, and then Secretary-General of the State Council Luo Gan attended and delivered an important speech.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年12月召开的第一次全国公安交通管理工作会议上，时任公安部交通管理局局长张正常在会议结束时讲了话，时任国务院秘书长罗干亦到会。
description.en: At the first National Public Security Traffic Management Work Conference in December 1989, then Director of the Traffic Management Bureau Zhang Zhengchang spoke at the end of the meeting, which was also attended by then Secretary-General of the State Council Luo Gan.

description.zh-cn: 1989年12月，张正常以公安部交通管理局局长身份在第一次全国公安交通管理工作会议上讲话。
description.en: In December 1989, Zhang Zhengchang spoke at the first National Public Security Traffic Management Work Conference as the Director of the Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 1989年12月，俞雷以公安部副部长身份在第一次全国公安交通管理工作会议上作报告。
description.en: In December 1989, Yu Lei delivered a report at the first National Public Security Traffic Management Work Conference as the Vice Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强是贵州六盘水人。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang is a native of Liupanshui, Guizhou.

description.zh-cn: 1982年9月至1985年6月，胡中强在六盘水师范专科学校（今六盘水师范学院）生物专业学习。
description.en: From September 1982 to June 1985, Hu Zhongqiang studied Biology at Liupanshui Teachers College (now Liupanshui Normal University).

description.zh-cn: 胡中强是中共党员。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强拥有中国人民解放军中将军衔。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang holds the rank of Lieutenant General in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强曾历任中国人民解放军成都军区445团团长、37师110团团长、37师参谋长、37师师长。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang successively served as Commander of the 445th Regiment, Commander of the 110th Regiment of the 37th Division, Chief of Staff of the 37th Division, and Commander of the 37th Division in the PLA Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强曾担任中国人民解放军第13集团军参谋长。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang served as the Chief of Staff of the PLA 13th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2016年6月至2017年3月，胡中强担任中国人民解放军第14集团军军长。
description.en: From June 2016 to March 2017, Hu Zhongqiang served as the Commander of the PLA 14th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2021年12月至2023年，胡中强担任中国人民武装警察部队副司令员。
description.en: From December 2021 to 2023, Hu Zhongqiang served as the Deputy Commander of the People's Armed Police Force.

description.zh-cn: 自2023年5月起，胡中强担任中国人民解放军南部战区副司令员。
description.en: Since May 2023, Hu Zhongqiang has served as the Deputy Commander of the PLA Southern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 自2023年5月起，胡中强兼任中国人民解放军南部战区陆军司令员。
description.en: Since May 2023, Hu Zhongqiang has concurrently served as the Commander of the PLA Southern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军南部战区陆军是南部战区的陆军组成部分，隶属于南部战区。
description.en: The Southern Theater Command Ground Force is the ground force component of the Southern Theater Command and is subordinate to it.

description.zh-cn: 胡中强接替张践，出任中国人民解放军南部战区陆军司令员。
description.en: Hu Zhongqiang succeeded Zhang Jian as the Commander of the PLA Southern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时出生于中华民国四川省成都市。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi was born in Chengdu, Sichuan, Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时是明太祖朱元璋的后裔。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi is a descendant of Zhu Yuanzhang, the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时是明太祖第十一子蜀王朱椿的第二十世子孙。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi is the 20th-generation descendant of Zhu Chun, the Prince of Shu, who was the 11th son of the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 朱椿是明太祖朱元璋的第十一子。
description.en: Zhu Chun was the 11th son of Zhu Yuanzhang, the Hongwu Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 1968年毕业于中国科学技术大学近代物理系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Modern Physics at the University of Science and Technology of China in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 1991年当选为中国科学院院士。
description.en: Elected as an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时是第三世界科学院院士。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi is a fellow of The World Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时于2009年至2014年担任南方科技大学首任校长。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi served as the first president of the Southern University of Science and Technology from 2009 to 2014.

description.zh-cn: 日本创价大学授予朱清时名誉博士学位。
description.en: Soka University in Japan awarded Zhu Qingshi an honorary doctorate degree.

description.zh-cn: 侯建国接替朱清时担任中国科学技术大学校长职务。
description.en: Hou Jianguo succeeded Zhu Qingshi as the president of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时接替汤洪高担任中国科学技术大学校长职务。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi succeeded Tang Honggao as the president of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 李铭在朱清时退休后代理南方科技大学校长职务。
description.en: Li Ming served as the acting president of the Southern University of Science and Technology after Zhu Qingshi's retirement.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时曾于2000年6月至2001年4月担任中国科学技术大学研究生院院长。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi served as the Dean of the Graduate School of the University of Science and Technology of China from June 2000 to April 2001.

description.zh-cn: 白春礼接替朱清时担任中国科学技术大学研究生院院长。
description.en: Bai Chunli succeeded Zhu Qingshi as the Dean of the Graduate School of the University of Science and Technology of China.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时是英国皇家化学学会会士。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi is a Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时担任中国化学会常务理事。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi serves as an Executive Council Member of the Chinese Chemical Society.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时担任中国科学技术史学会副理事长。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi serves as the Vice President of the Council of the Chinese Society for the History of Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时是第八届、第九届全国人大代表。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi was a deputy to the 8th and 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时是第十届全国政协委员。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi was a member of the 10th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时在担任南方科技大学校长期间，其理想是建立一所能够回答“钱学森之问”的大学。
description.en: During his tenure as the president of Southern University of Science and Technology, Zhu Qingshi's ideal was to build a university that could answer 'Qian Xuesen's question'.

description.zh-cn: 新语丝网站曾专门开设“朱清时迷信事件”专栏，批评其宣传佛教等观点。
description.en: The website New Threads created a special section titled 'Zhu Qingshi's Superstition Incident' to criticize his promotion of Buddhism and other views.

description.zh-cn: 朱清时发表《物理学步入禅境：缘起性空》的演讲，宣传其对佛教的理解，认为当代物理学理论与佛教观点相符。
description.en: Zhu Qingshi delivered a speech titled 'Physics Entering the Realm of Zen: Pratītyasamutpāda and Śūnyatā', promoting his understanding of Buddhism and arguing that contemporary physics theories align with Buddhist views.

position.en: Deputy Secretary-General, Director of the Research Office

description.zh-cn: 根据Wikitext，苗庆旺曾任中共中央纪委副秘书长，及中共中央纪委研究室主任。
description.en: According to the Wikitext, Miao Qingwang served as Deputy Secretary-General of the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and Director of its Research Office.

description.zh-cn: 曾任广西壮族自治区人民政府副主席。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 现任中共广西壮族自治区党委常委。
description.en: Currently serves as a Standing Committee Member of the CPC Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2024年7月，苗庆旺接替何文浩担任中共广西壮族自治区党委常委职务。
description.en: In July 2024, Miao Qingwang succeeded He Wenhao as a Standing Committee Member of the CPC Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2022年7月，苗庆旺与凌志峰一同被任命为广西壮族自治区人民政府副主席。
description.en: In July 2022, Miao Qingwang was appointed Vice Chairman of the People's Government of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region along with Ling Zhifeng.

position.zh-cn: 副主席, 副秘书长, 常务委员
position.en: Vice Chairman, Deputy Secretary-General, Standing Committee Member

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君担任中国人民政治协商会议第十四届全国委员会副主席。此前，他曾任第十一届、十二届、十三届全国政协常务委员，并在2007年至2023年间长期担任全国政协副秘书长。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun serves as a Vice Chairman of the 14th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. Prior to this, he served as a Standing Committee member of the 11th, 12th, and 13th CPPCC National Committees, and was the Deputy Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee from 2007 to 2023.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 在王沪宁担任全国政协主席期间，蒋作君担任副主席。
description.en: While Wang Huning serves as the Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, Jiang Zuojun serves as a Vice Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君于1993年10月加入中国致公党。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun joined the China Zhi Gong Party in October 1993.

position.zh-cn: 主席, 常务委员, 常务副主席
position.en: Chairman, Standing Committee Member, Executive Vice Chairman

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君曾担任致公党中央常委，并在1997年5月至2012年间任常务副主席。自2022年12月起，他担任中国致公党第十六届中央委员会主席。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun served as a Standing Committee member of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party, and was the Executive Vice Chairman from May 1997 to 2012. Since December 2022, he has served as the Chairman of the 16th Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 作为高级访问学者在纽约州立大学布法罗分校访学。
description.en: Served as a senior visiting scholar at the University at Buffalo.

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君接替万钢担任中国致公党中央委员会主席。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun succeeded Wan Gang as the Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君接替王钦敏担任中国致公党中央委员会常务副主席。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun succeeded Wang Qinmin as the Executive Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 张恩迪接替蒋作君担任中国致公党中央委员会常务副主席。
description.en: Zhang Endi succeeded Jiang Zuojun as the Executive Vice Chairman of the Central Committee of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君于2023年3月当选全国政协副主席，成为副国级党和国家领导人。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun was elected Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee in March 2023, becoming a national deputy-level Party and state leader.

description.zh-cn: 蒋作君是第九届（1998-2003）、第十届（2003-2008）全国人大代表。
description.en: Jiang Zuojun was a deputy to the 9th (1998-2003) and 10th (2003-2008) National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 马来亚联合邦与北婆罗洲（沙巴）、砂拉越和新加坡共同组成了马来西亚联邦。
description.en: The Federation of Malaya, together with North Borneo (Sabah), Sarawak, and Singapore, formed the Federation of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 马来亚联合邦是英国的殖民地，直到1957年8月31日获得独立。
description.en: The Federation of Malaya was a British colony until it gained independence on August 31, 1957.

description.zh-cn: 1965年，马来西亚国会全数通过议案将新加坡逐出马来西亚联邦，导致新加坡独立。
description.en: In 1965, the Malaysian Parliament unanimously passed a bill to expel Singapore from the Federation of Malaysia, leading to Singapore's independence.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚成立后，东姑阿都拉曼继续担任首相。
description.en: After the formation of Malaysia, Tunku Abdul Rahman continued to serve as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，日本发动了太平洋战争并占领了包括马来亚在内的东南亚地区。
description.en: During World War II, Japan launched the Pacific War and occupied Southeast Asia, including Malaya.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战期间，日本军队占领了英属马来亚，中断了英国的殖民统治。
description.en: During World War II, Japanese forces occupied British Malaya, interrupting British colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 因反对马来西亚成立，印度尼西亚与马来西亚爆发了为期三年的武装冲突，即“马印对抗”。
description.en: Due to its opposition to the formation of Malaysia, Indonesia engaged in a three-year armed conflict with Malaysia known as the "Konfrontasi".

description.zh-cn: 五一三事件后，时任副首相阿都拉萨领导的国家行动理事会掌权，并随后推行了新经济政策。
description.en: After the 13 May incident, the National Operations Council led by then-Deputy Prime Minister Abdul Razak took power, and he subsequently launched the New Economic Policy.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪·莫哈末曾两度担任马来西亚首相。
description.en: Mahathir Mohamad served as the Prime Minister of Malaysia on two occasions.

description.zh-cn: 1997年的亚洲金融危机使马来西亚的经济和政局受到严重挫折。
description.en: The 1997 Asian financial crisis caused a severe setback to Malaysia's economy and political situation.

description.zh-cn: 在2020年政治危机后，慕尤丁出任马来西亚第八任首相。
description.en: Following the 2020 political crisis, Muhyiddin Yassin became the 8th Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 1641年，荷兰联合柔佛攻下马六甲，结束了葡萄牙对该地的统治。
description.en: In 1641, the Dutch, in alliance with Johor, captured Malacca, ending Portuguese rule over the territory.

description.zh-cn: 中央外事工作委员会办公室是中共中央直属机构。
description.en: The Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission is an institution directly under the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在1998年8月至2018年3月期间，中央外事办公室是中央外事工作领导小组的办事机构。此后，中央外事工作委员会办公室作为中央外事工作委员会的办事机构。
description.en: From August 1998 to March 2018, the Central Foreign Affairs Office served as the working body for the Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs. Subsequently, the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission became the working body for the Central Foreign Affairs Commission.

position.zh-cn: 副主任；分管日常工作的副主任
position.en: Deputy Director; Deputy Director in charge of daily work

description.zh-cn: 2024年3月至2025年9月任副主任，2025年9月起任分管日常工作的副主任（正部长级）。
description.en: Served as Deputy Director from March 2024 to September 2025, and has been the Deputy Director in charge of daily work (Ministerial level) since September 2025.

description.zh-cn: 1958年3月6日，中共中央和国务院联合发文，决定设立国务院外事办公室。
description.en: On March 6, 1958, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council jointly issued a document deciding to establish the State Council Foreign Affairs Office.

description.zh-cn: 1958年3月6日，中共中央决定撤销中共中央国际活动指导委员会。
description.en: On March 6, 1958, the CPC Central Committee decided to abolish the International Activities Guidance Committee of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1970年6月，国务院精简机构，国务院外事办公室被撤销，业务并入外交部。
description.en: In June 1970, as part of the State Council's institutional streamlining, the State Council Foreign Affairs Office was abolished, and its functions were merged into the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1998年8月，中共中央、国务院决定，撤销“国务院外事办公室”，组建“中央外事办公室”。
description.en: In August 1998, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council decided to abolish the 'State Council Foreign Affairs Office' and establish the 'Central Foreign Affairs Office'.

description.zh-cn: 《深化党和国家机构改革方案》将中央外事工作领导小组改为中央外事工作委员会。
description.en: The 'Plan for Deepening Reform of Party and State Institutions' changed the Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs into the Central Foreign Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 《深化党和国家机构改革方案》规定不再设立中央维护海洋权益工作领导小组，有关职责交由中央外事工作委员会及其办公室承担。
description.en: The 'Plan for Deepening Reform of Party and State Institutions' stipulated that the Central Leading Group for Safeguarding Maritime Rights and Interests would no longer be established, and its relevant duties would be undertaken by the Central Foreign Affairs Commission and its office.

description.zh-cn: 中央维护海洋权益工作领导小组被撤销后，其职责交由中央外事工作委员会及其办公室承担。
description.en: After the Central Leading Group for Safeguarding Maritime Rights and Interests was abolished, its duties were transferred to the Central Foreign Affairs Commission and its office.

description.zh-cn: 1998年10月-2000年9月任中央外事办公室主任；2000年9月-2005年4月任中央外事工作领导小组办公室、中央国家安全工作领导小组办公室主任。
description.en: Served as Director of the Central Foreign Affairs Office from October 1998 to September 2000; served as Director of the Office of the Central Leading Group for Foreign Affairs and the Office of the Central Leading Group for National Security Affairs from September 2000 to April 2005.

description.zh-cn: 阮士怡出生于直隶省丰南县。
description.en: Ruan Shiyi was born in Fengnan County, Zhili Province.

description.zh-cn: 阮士怡是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Ruan Shiyi was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 阮士怡于1930年代考入北京大学工学院土木工程系，后因七七事变爆发而放弃学业。
description.en: Ruan Shiyi was admitted to the Department of Civil Engineering, College of Engineering, Peking University in the 1930s, but later abandoned his studies due to the outbreak of the Marco Polo Bridge Incident.

description.zh-cn: 阮士怡于1940年考入北京大学医学院，1944年毕业并继续研究生学业。
description.en: Ruan Shiyi was admitted to Peking University Medical College in 1940, graduated in 1944, and continued with his postgraduate studies.

description.zh-cn: 1937年七七事变爆发后，阮士怡被迫放弃了在北京大学工学院的学业。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Marco Polo Bridge Incident in 1937, Ruan Shiyi was forced to abandon his studies at the College of Engineering, Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 1946年，阮士怡在天津市第四中心医院担任内科住院医师。
description.en: In 1946, Ruan Shiyi worked as a resident physician in internal medicine at Tianjin Fourth Central Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 自1955年参与建院起，阮士怡长期在天津中医药大学第一附属医院工作，担任主任医师。
description.en: Since participating in its founding in 1955, Ruan Shiyi worked for a long time at the First Affiliated Hospital of Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, serving as a chief physician.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，阮士怡曾一度停止工作。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ruan Shiyi was forced to stop working for a period.

description.zh-cn: 阮士怡曾任中国中西医结合研究会（即中国中西医结合学会）理事。
description.en: Ruan Shiyi once served as a council member of the China Association of the Integration of Traditional and Western Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 2012年，天津市卫生局（现天津市卫生健康委员会）授予阮士怡“天津市名中医”称号。
description.en: In 2012, the Tianjin Municipal Health Bureau (now Tianjin Municipal Health Commission) awarded Ruan Shiyi the title of 'Tianjin Famous Doctor of Traditional Chinese Medicine'.

description.zh-cn: 2014年7月，阮士怡获第二届“国医大师”称号。
description.en: In July 2014, Ruan Shiyi was awarded the title of the second 'National Master of Chinese Medicine'.

description.zh-cn: 1942年9月，新疆省主席盛世才下令将年幼的毛远新与其母亲朱旦华一同羁押在监狱，直至1946年获释。
description.en: In September 1942, Sheng Shicai, the governor of Xinjiang Province, ordered the infant Mao Yuanxin and his mother Zhu Danhua to be imprisoned until their release in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，毛远新组织造反团，并担任辽宁省革命委员会副主任等要职，成为重要政治人物。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Mao Yuanxin organized rebel groups and held important positions such as vice-chairman of the Liaoning Provincial Revolutionary Committee, becoming a key political figure.

description.zh-cn: 江青扶助毛远新担任了辽宁省革命委员会副主任、沈阳军区政治部副主任、辽宁省军区政委等职务。
description.en: Jiang Qing supported Mao Yuanxin in assuming positions such as Vice-Chairman of the Liaoning Provincial Revolutionary Committee, Deputy Director of the Political Department of the Shenyang Military Region, and Political Commissar of the Liaoning Military District.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，毛远新被毛泽东指定为中央政治局联络员，代表毛泽东发表“最高指示”。
description.en: In 1975, Mao Yuanxin was appointed by Mao Zedong as the liaison for the Central Politburo, conveying Mao's 'supreme instructions'.

description.zh-cn: 1975年，毛远新向毛泽东报告称邓小平否定“文化大革命”，引发了“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动；1976年，毛远新在四五天安门事件后向毛泽东报告“邓小平是天安门事件的总后台”，导致邓小平被撤销一切职务。
description.en: In 1975, Mao Yuanxin reported to Mao Zedong that Deng Xiaoping was negating the 'Cultural Revolution', triggering the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist' movement; in 1976, after the Tiananmen Incident, Mao Yuanxin reported to Mao Zedong that 'Deng Xiaoping was the backstage supporter of the Tiananmen Incident', leading to Deng's dismissal from all posts.

description.zh-cn: 四人帮和毛远新联合起来对邓小平主持的“全面整顿”发难。
description.en: The Gang of Four, along with Mao Yuanxin, launched an attack on the 'comprehensive rectification' led by Deng Xiaoping.

description.zh-cn: 怀仁堂事变后，毛远新被中共中央宣布“保护审查”并遭拘捕。
description.en: After the Huirentang Incident, Mao Yuanxin was placed under 'protective custody' by the CPC Central Committee and arrested.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央批准将毛远新永远开除党籍，并撤销其党内外一切职务。
description.en: The CPC Central Committee approved the permanent expulsion of Mao Yuanxin from the party and the removal of all his positions inside and outside the party.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国务总理是中华民国国务院的首长。
description.en: The Premier of the State Council is the head of the State Council of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国务总理由中华民国大总统任命。
description.en: The Premier of the State Council was appointed by the President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1928年6月，国民政府于名义上统一中国。
description.en: In June 1928, the Nationalist Government nominally unified China.

description.zh-cn: 随着国民政府统一中国，国务总理一职被行政院院长取代。
description.en: With the unification of China by the Nationalist Government, the position of Premier of the State Council was replaced by the President of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国务总理是行政院院长职位的前身。
description.en: The Premier of the State Council was the predecessor to the position of President of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 根据《中华民国临时约法》，临时大总统需任命一个以总理为首的内阁。
description.en: According to the Provisional Constitution of the Republic of China, the Provisional President was required to appoint a cabinet headed by a premier.

description.zh-cn: 因任命王芝祥为直隶都督事与袁世凯总统不和而辞职。
description.en: Resigned due to a disagreement with President Yuan Shikai over the appointment of Wang Zhixiang as the Governor of Zhili.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞因奉命率军镇压二次革命而离任代理总理。
description.en: Duan Qirui left his post as Acting Premier to lead troops to suppress the Second Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 徐世昌因不满袁世凯实行帝制而请辞国务卿。
description.en: Xu Shichang resigned as Secretary of State due to his dissatisfaction with Yuan Shikai's implementation of a monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 李经羲因张勋复辟而解职。
description.en: Li Jingxi was dismissed from office due to the Zhang Xun Restoration.

description.zh-cn: 段祺瑞因与代总统冯国璋就“统一中国”方式政见不和而辞职。
description.en: Duan Qirui resigned due to political disagreements with Acting President Feng Guozhang over the method of 'unifying China'.

description.zh-cn: 因五四运动影响，钱能训内阁总辞。
description.en: The cabinet of Qian Nengxun resigned en masse due to the influence of the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 龚心湛因不堪直系吴佩孚电斥而请辞兼职。
description.en: Gong Xinzhan resigned from his concurrent post after being denounced by Wu Peifu of the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 靳云鹏因受安福系压迫而请辞。
description.en: Jin Yunpeng resigned due to pressure from the Anfu Club.

description.zh-cn: 梁士诒因直系将领反对，并于直奉战争失败后被免职。
description.en: Liang Shiyi was opposed by Zhili clique generals and was dismissed after their defeat in the Zhili-Fengtian War.

description.zh-cn: 孙宝琦与财长王克敏互相排挤，因总统曹锟偏袒王克敏而辞职。
description.en: Sun Baoqi and Minister of Finance Wang Kemin were rivals; Sun resigned because President Cao Kun sided with Wang.

description.zh-cn: 第二次直奉战争爆发，顾维钧内阁改组去职。
description.en: The Second Zhili-Fengtian War broke out, leading to the resignation of Gu Weijun's cabinet following a reshuffle.

description.zh-cn: 杜锡珪因奉系反对，于正式内阁会议后即行辞职。
description.en: Du Xigui resigned immediately after a formal cabinet meeting due to opposition from the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 潘复因张作霖在皇姑屯事件被杀而解职。
description.en: Pan Fu was dismissed from office because Zhang Zuolin was killed in the Huanggutun incident.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战导致的民生灾难是引发德国十一月革命的诱因之一。
description.en: The social and economic hardships caused by World War I were one of the triggers for the German November Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 基尔水兵的起义引发了一系列事件，最终演变为遍及全德国的十一月革命。
description.en: The mutiny of sailors in Kiel triggered a series of events that evolved into the nationwide November Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 与俄国二月革命类似，德国革命并非由一个政党领导，其起因也与战争造成的民生灾难有关。
description.en: Similar to the Russian February Revolution, the German Revolution was not led by a single party and its causes were also related to the social hardships caused by the war.

description.zh-cn: 十一月革命推翻了德意志帝国，促成了魏玛共和国的建立。
description.en: The November Revolution overthrew the German Empire and led to the establishment of the Weimar Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在十一月革命的压力下，德皇威廉二世于1918年11月9日被迫退位。
description.en: Under the pressure of the November Revolution, Kaiser Wilhelm II was forced to abdicate on November 9, 1918.

description.zh-cn: 十一月革命推翻了统治德意志帝国的霍亨索伦王朝。
description.en: The November Revolution overthrew the House of Hohenzollern, which had ruled the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 由于国内多个城市爆发革命，德国新政府被迫接受协约国严苛的条件，签署了停战协定。
description.en: Due to revolutions breaking out in multiple cities, the new German government was forced to accept the harsh terms of the Allies and sign the armistice.

description.zh-cn: 时任国防部长的古斯塔夫·诺斯克代表社会民主党政府，聘用自由军团镇压斯巴达克同盟等左翼起义。
description.en: As Minister of Defence, Gustav Noske, on behalf of the Social Democratic government, hired the Freikorps to suppress the Spartacist uprising and other left-wing revolts.

description.zh-cn: 自由军团受魏玛政府之命，以武力镇压了斯巴达克同盟起义。
description.en: Under the orders of the Weimar government, the Freikorps violently suppressed the Spartacist uprising.

description.zh-cn: 由社会民主党领导的魏玛共和国政府派兵镇压了巴伐利亚苏维埃共和国。
description.en: The Weimar Republic government, led by the Social Democratic Party, sent troops to suppress the Bavarian Soviet Republic.

description.zh-cn: 魏玛宪法的正式生效，标志着魏玛共和国的宪法日和正式成立。
description.en: The official entry into force of the Weimar Constitution marked the Constitution Day and formal establishment of the Weimar Republic.

description.zh-cn: 第一次世界大战战败后德国国内的复仇主义情绪被纳粹党利用，成为其崛起的重要推动力。
description.en: Revanchist sentiments in Germany after its defeat in World War I were exploited by the Nazi Party, becoming a major driving force for its rise.

description.zh-cn: 战后德国的狂热民族主义情绪为纳粹主义的极端意识形态传播提供了便利。
description.en: Fervent nationalism in post-war Germany facilitated the spread of Nazism's extremist ideology.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹主义的兴起及其领导人希特勒上台，最终导致了魏玛共和国民主制度的倒台。
description.en: The rise of Nazism and its leader Adolf Hitler coming to power ultimately led to the downfall of the Weimar Republic's democratic system.

description.zh-cn: 魏鹤龄是天津人。
description.en: Wei Heling was a native of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，中国电影表演艺术学会将魏鹤龄评为“中国电影百年百位优秀演员”之一。
description.en: In 2005, the China Film Performance Art Academy named Wei Heling as one of the '100 Excellent Actors in 100 Years of Chinese Cinema'.

position.zh-cn: 第一届全国委员会委员

description.zh-cn: 魏鹤龄是中华全国戏剧工作者协会第一届全国委员会的成员。
description.en: Wei Heling was a member of the first national committee of the All-China Association of Drama Workers.

description.zh-cn: 魏鹤龄是中国电影家协会会员。
description.en: Wei Heling was a member of the China Film Association.

description.zh-cn: 李在明于1991年与金惠景结婚。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung married Kim Hye-kyung in 1991.

description.zh-cn: 李在明出生于韩国庆尚北道安东市。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung was born in Andong, North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李在明于1986年进入中央大学学习，获得法学学位。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung entered Chung-Ang University in 1986 and obtained a law degree.

description.zh-cn: 李在明受到前总统卢武铉演讲的影响，决定成为一名人权和劳工律师。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung was influenced by the speeches of former president Roh Moo-hyun and decided to become a human rights and labor lawyer.

description.zh-cn: 李在明担任第19任城南市市长。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung served as the 19th Mayor of Seongnam.

description.zh-cn: 李在明通过补选当选为第21届国会议员，并连任第22届。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung was elected as a member of the 21st National Assembly through a by-election and was re-elected for the 22nd term.

description.zh-cn: 李在明当选为第21任大韩民国总统。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung was elected as the 21st President of the Republic of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 李在明多次担任共同民主党及其前身的党员和党代表。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung has been a member and leader of the Democratic Party and its predecessors multiple times.

description.zh-cn: 李在明在担任城南市长期间，因财政和福利政策与时任总统朴槿惠发生严重摩擦。在崔顺实事件后，李在明猛烈抨击朴槿惠，并主张对其进行弹劾。
description.en: During his term as Mayor of Seongnam, Lee Jae-myung had severe friction with then-President Park Geun-hye over fiscal and welfare policies. After the Choi Soon-sil scandal, Lee Jae-myung fiercely criticized Park and advocated for her impeachment.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统朴槿惠通过成立专案调查小组、提案罢免、提交限制地方财政的法案等手段，试图阻碍李在明的市政运作。
description.en: Then-President Park Geun-hye attempted to obstruct Lee Jae-myung's municipal operations by means such as forming a special investigation team, proposing his dismissal, and submitting bills to restrict local finances.

description.zh-cn: 李在明担任城南市长期间，为解决财政问题解散了市政府的短道速滑队，这在一定程度上导致了队员安贤洙（维克多·安）转籍至俄罗斯。
description.en: During his tenure as Mayor of Seongnam, Lee Jae-myung disbanded the city hall's short track speed skating team to solve financial issues, which partly contributed to team member Ahn Hyun-soo (Viktor An) changing his nationality to Russia.

description.zh-cn: 崔顺实事件曝光后，李在明因率先猛烈抨击朴槿惠政府而获得大量关注，其政治支持率迅速上升。
description.en: After the Choi Soon-sil scandal was exposed, Lee Jae-myung gained significant attention for being the first to fiercely criticize the Park Geun-hye administration, leading to a rapid rise in his political approval ratings.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年共同民主党总统候选人党内选举中，文在寅获胜，从而阻止了李在明成为该党候选人。
description.en: In the 2017 Democratic Party presidential primary, Moon Jae-in won, thereby preventing Lee Jae-myung from becoming the party's candidate.

description.zh-cn: 在尹锡悦宣布戒严后，李在明通过社交媒体直播翻墙进入国会，并呼吁民众共同抵抗，对成功阻止戒严起到了关键作用。
description.en: After Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law, Lee Jae-myung live-streamed himself climbing over the wall into the National Assembly and called on the public to resist, playing a key role in successfully thwarting the martial law.

description.zh-cn: 李在明在2025年总统选举中击败了国民力量党的候选人金文洙。
description.en: Lee Jae-myung defeated the People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo in the 2025 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 韩国检方以涉嫌贪腐、渎职、受贿等罪名多次对李在明提起诉讼并申请批捕。
description.en: South Korean prosecutors have repeatedly sued and sought arrest warrants for Lee Jae-myung on charges including corruption, dereliction of duty, and bribery.

description.zh-cn: 时任法务部长官韩东勋对李在明发出了逮捕令。
description.en: Then-Minister of Justice Han Dong-hoon issued an arrest warrant for Lee Jae-myung.

description.zh-cn: 李在明因其善用社交媒体、发表激烈言论以及煽动民粹主义的风格，被媒体与唐纳德·特朗普相比较，称为“韩国特朗普”。
description.en: Due to his adept use of social media, fiery rhetoric, and populist style, Lee Jae-myung has been compared by the media to Donald Trump and dubbed the 'Korean Trump'.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣是著名洋服裁缝张活海的儿子。
description.en: Leslie Cheung is the son of the famous tailor Zhang Huohai.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣是张绿萍的弟弟，在家中排行第十。
description.en: Leslie Cheung is the younger brother of Zhang Lüping, and he was the tenth child in the family.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣与唐鹤德是长达20年的同性伴侣。1997年，张国荣在演唱会上公开二人关系。唐鹤德被张国荣视为生命中最重要的人之一。
description.en: Leslie Cheung and Daffy Tong were same-sex partners for 20 years. In 1997, Cheung publicly acknowledged their relationship at a concert. Cheung regarded Tong as one of the most important people in his life.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣曾与毛舜筠短暂交往，并在22岁时向她求婚，但遭到拒绝。
description.en: Leslie Cheung briefly dated Teresa Mo and proposed to her at the age of 22, but was rejected.

description.zh-cn: 陈淑芬是张国荣的经纪人，在其职业生涯中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: Florence Chan was Leslie Cheung's manager and played a significant role in his career.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣曾考入利兹大学攻读纺织系，后因父亲中风而于大学一年级时辍学回港。
description.en: Leslie Cheung was admitted to the University of Leeds to study textile management but dropped out in his first year and returned to Hong Kong after his father suffered a stroke.

description.zh-cn: 主演电影《霸王别姬》使张国荣蜚声国际影坛，获得了包括法国戛纳影展最佳男主角提名和日本影评人协会最佳男主角奖在内的多项荣誉。
description.en: Starring in the film 'Farewell My Concubine' brought Leslie Cheung international acclaim, earning him numerous honors including a Best Actor nomination at the Cannes Film Festival and the Best Actor award from the Japan Film Critics Association.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣凭借在电影《阿飞正传》中的演出，获得第十届香港电影金像奖最佳男主角。
description.en: For his performance in the film 'Days of Being Wild', Leslie Cheung won the Best Actor award at the 10th Hong Kong Film Awards.

description.zh-cn: 据一种说法，在1987年拍摄《倩女幽魂》时，王祖贤在片场以“哥哥”称呼张国荣，此后这个称呼便流传开来。
description.en: According to one account, during the filming of 'A Chinese Ghost Story' in 1987, Joey Wong addressed Leslie Cheung as 'Gor Gor' (older brother) on set, and the nickname subsequently became widespread.

description.zh-cn: 据一种说法，在合作《白发魔女传》时，张国荣称赞林青霞“姐姐你好美！”，林青霞则回应“哥哥你也好美！”，从此张国荣多了“哥哥”的绰号。
description.en: According to one account, while working on 'The Bride with White Hair', Cheung complimented Brigitte Lin, saying 'Sister, you are so beautiful!', to which Lin replied, 'Brother, you are beautiful too!'. Thereafter, Cheung gained the nickname 'Gor Gor' (older brother).

description.zh-cn: 张国荣于1987年至1990年间签约新艺宝唱片。
description.en: Leslie Cheung was signed to Cinepoly Records from 1987 to 1990.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣于1995年复出后至1999年间签约滚石唱片。
description.en: Leslie Cheung was signed to Rock Records from his comeback in 1995 until 1999.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣于1999年至2003年去世前签约环球唱片。
description.en: Leslie Cheung was signed to Universal Music from 1999 until his death in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 张国荣与梅艳芳是圈中挚友。
description.en: Leslie Cheung and Anita Mui were close friends in the entertainment industry.

description.zh-cn: 吴宇森是张国荣的好友，张国荣曾在吴宇森经济拮据时资助过他。
description.en: John Woo was a friend of Leslie Cheung. Cheung had financially supported Woo when he was facing financial difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 国立台湾大学医学院附设医院是国立台湾大学医学院的附设教学医院。
description.en: National Taiwan University Hospital is the affiliated teaching hospital of the National Taiwan University College of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 1938年4月1日，医院成为“台北帝国大学医学部附属医院”。
description.en: On April 1, 1938, the hospital became the 'Taihoku Imperial University Faculty of Medicine Affiliated Hospital'.

description.zh-cn: 1898年，医院更名为“台湾总督府台北医院”，直属于台湾总督府。
description.en: In 1898, the hospital was renamed 'Governor-General of Taiwan Taipei Hospital' and was directly subordinate to the Governor-General of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1895年医院创建时名为“大日本台湾病院”，属陆军省军医部管辖。
description.en: When the hospital was founded in 1895 as 'Great Japan Taiwan Hospital', it was under the jurisdiction of the Army Medical Department of the Ministry of the Army.

description.zh-cn: 近藤十郎设计了1912年开始重建、1921年完工启用的台大医院西址建筑。
description.en: Kondo Juro designed the west wing building of NTU Hospital, which was rebuilt starting in 1912 and completed in 1921.

description.zh-cn: 1950年，时任台大校长傅斯年将医院名称从“附属医院”改为“附设医院”。
description.en: In 1950, then-NTU President Fu Ssu-nien changed the hospital's name from 'Affiliated Hospital' (Fushu Yiyuan) to 'Attached Hospital' (Fushe Yiyuan).

description.zh-cn: 郭台铭代表永龄健康基金会捐赠新台币二百二十亿元给台大，用于兴建台大癌医中心医院。
description.en: Terry Gou, on behalf of the YongLin Healthcare Foundation, donated NT$22 billion to National Taiwan University for the construction of the NTU Cancer Center Hospital.

description.zh-cn: 2011年7月1日，行政院卫生署新竹医院改隶台湾大学医学院附设医院，后整并为新竹台大分院。
description.en: On July 1, 2011, the Department of Health Hsinchu Hospital became affiliated with National Taiwan University Hospital and was later integrated into the NTU Hospital Hsin-Chu Branch.

description.zh-cn: 担任国立台湾大学医学院第一附属医院（台大医院前身）院长。
description.en: Served as the Superintendent of the First Affiliated Hospital of National Taiwan University College of Medicine (predecessor of NTUH).

description.zh-cn: 宋张骏是陕西西安人。
description.en: Song Zhangjun is from Xi'an, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 宋张骏是汉族。
description.en: Song Zhangjun is of Han ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 宋张骏是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Song Zhangjun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，宋张骏被选为陕西省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Song Zhangjun was elected as a deputy representing Shaanxi Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 石井四郎提议并领导建立了731部队及其前身，是该部队的核心人物。
description.en: Shirō Ishii proposed and led the establishment of Unit 731 and its predecessors, serving as the central figure of the unit.

description.zh-cn: 北野政次接替石井四郎，担任731部队（关东军防疫给水部）的第二任部长。
description.en: Masaji Kitano succeeded Shirō Ishii as the second commander of Unit 731 (Kwantung Army Epidemic Prevention and Water Purification Department).

description.zh-cn: 731部队使用大量中国人作为活体实验材料，导致数千人死亡。
description.en: Unit 731 used a large number of Chinese people as living subjects for experiments, resulting in thousands of deaths.

description.zh-cn: 内藤良一是731部队的军医中佐。
description.en: Ryōichi Naitō was a lieutenant colonel and military physician in Unit 731.

description.zh-cn: 海南岛战役导致中国人民解放军攻占海口。
description.en: The Landing Operation on Hainan Island led to the capture of Haikou by the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 1956年，中华人民共和国国务院将海口市划为广东省省辖市。
description.en: In 1956, the State Council of the People's Republic of China designated Haikou as a provincial-administered city under Guangdong Province.

description.zh-cn: 涂谨申是香港民主同盟的创党成员。
description.en: James To was a founding member of the United Democrats of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 1997年香港主权移交后，中央政府另组临时立法会，涂谨申与其他民主派立法局议员被迫离任。2004年，涂谨申试图进入深圳向港澳办官员表达政改诉求时，被中方人员阻止并拒绝入境。
description.en: After the handover of Hong Kong in 1997, the Central Government formed a Provisional Legislative Council, forcing James To and other pro-democracy Legislative Council members to step down. In 2004, James To attempted to enter Shenzhen to convey demands for political reform to officials of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office but was stopped and denied entry by mainland personnel.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年香港立法会选举中，涂谨申在区议会（第二）功能界别中以微弱优势击败了王国兴，成功连任。
description.en: In the 2016 Hong Kong Legislative Council election, James To narrowly defeated Wong Kwok-hing in the District Council (Second) functional constituency to secure his re-election.

description.zh-cn: 2003年8月，涂谨申与刘慧卿一同到台湾出席由群策会举办的「一国两制下的香港」研讨会。
description.en: In August 2003, James To and Emily Lau attended the 'Hong Kong under One Country, Two Systems' seminar in Taiwan, organized by the Taiwan Thinktank.

description.zh-cn: 在台湾出席研讨会后，涂谨申声明他支持中国统一，反对台独，与刘慧卿的立场划清界线。
description.en: After attending a seminar in Taiwan, James To stated that he supported the unification of China and opposed Taiwan independence, distancing himself from Emily Lau's position.

description.zh-cn: 涂谨申在台湾的研讨会上发表论文，认为基本法第二十三条立法会戕害香港的人权与自由。
description.en: At a seminar in Taiwan, James To presented a paper arguing that the legislation of Article 23 of the Basic Law would undermine human rights and freedom in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 2004年，何秀兰与涂谨申等人试图进入深圳向港澳办官员表达政改诉求时，被中方人员阻止并拒绝入境。
description.en: In 2004, when Cyd Ho, along with James To and others, attempted to enter Shenzhen to convey demands for political reform to officials of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office, she was stopped by mainland personnel and denied entry.

description.zh-cn: 陈云生曾就“汇标公司”事件向廉政公署报案，要求调查涂谨申。
description.en: Chan Wan-sang reported James To to the ICAC regarding the 'W汇标公司' incident, requesting an investigation.

description.zh-cn: 廉政公署在调查“汇标公司”事件后，确定事件为涂谨申的无心之失，未予起诉。
description.en: After investigating the 'W汇标公司' incident, the ICAC determined that it was an unintentional mistake by James To and did not press charges.

description.zh-cn: 2007年区议会选举后，李永达批评涂谨申在选举中甚少支援九龙西候选人，称其为“懒将军”。
description.en: After the 2007 District Council election, Lee Wing-tat criticized James To for his lack of support for candidates in Kowloon West during the election, calling him a 'lazy general'.

description.zh-cn: 时任教育局局长杨润雄要求教科书删除“三权分立”的论述，引发争议。涂谨申批评其挑起矛盾、改写历史。
description.en: Then-Secretary for Education Kevin Yeung sparked controversy by demanding the removal of discussions on the 'separation of powers' from textbooks. James To criticized him for instigating conflict and rewriting history.

description.zh-cn: 涂谨申因参与民主派初选，被指控涉嫌违反《香港国家安全法》而被捕。
description.en: James To was arrested on suspicion of violating the Hong Kong National Security Law for his participation in the pro-democracy primaries.

description.zh-cn: 2010年初，涂谨申带领民主党内的社区主任袁海文和刘俊业成立旺角太子工作团队。
description.en: In early 2010, James To led community officers within the Democratic Party, Ramon Yuen and Lau Chun-yip, to establish the Mong Kok and Prince Edward work team.

description.zh-cn: 2010年初，涂谨申带领民主党内的社区主任袁海文和刘俊业成立旺角太子工作团队。
description.en: In early 2010, James To led community officers within the Democratic Party, Ramon Yuen and Lau Chun-yip, to establish the Mong Kok and Prince Edward work team.

description.zh-cn: 涂谨申与杨润雄是中华基督教会基华小学时的同班同学。
description.en: James To and Kevin Yeung were classmates at CCC Kei Wa Primary School.

description.zh-cn: 时任民主党主席何俊仁担任了涂谨申2009年第二次婚礼的监礼人。
description.en: Then-Democratic Party Chairman Albert Ho served as the wedding solemnizer for James To's second marriage in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 黄贤模是福建福州人。
description.en: Huang Xianmo is from Fuzhou, Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 黄贤模是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Huang Xianmo is a politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 黄贤模曾担任中共三明市委书记。
description.en: Huang Xianmo once served as the Secretary of the CPC Sanming Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 黄贤模曾担任福建省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: Huang Xianmo once served as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Fujian Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据“中国共产党党员”分类，黄贤模是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: According to the category 'Chinese Communist Party members', Huang Xianmo is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 石守信在后周时期与赵匡胤结义为兄弟。
description.en: Shi Shouxin became a sworn brother of Zhao Kuangyin during the Later Zhou period.

description.zh-cn: 在后周及北宋初年，石守信是赵匡胤的部下将领。
description.en: During the Later Zhou and early Northern Song dynasties, Shi Shouxin was a subordinate general to Zhao Kuangyin.

description.zh-cn: 石守信于太平兴国四年（979年）随宋太宗征讨辽国。
description.en: In 979 (the 4th year of the Taiping Xingguo era), Shi Shouxin followed Emperor Taizong of Song on a campaign against the Liao dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在“杯酒释兵权”事件中被解除兵权。
description.en: Was relieved of his military command during the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' incident.

description.zh-cn: 在“杯酒释兵权”事件中被解除兵权。
description.en: Was relieved of his military command during the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' incident.

description.zh-cn: 在“杯酒释兵权”事件中被解除兵权。
description.en: Was relieved of his military command during the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' incident.

description.zh-cn: 在“杯酒释兵权”事件中被解除兵权。
description.en: Was relieved of his military command during the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' incident.

description.zh-cn: 在“杯酒释兵权”事件中被解除兵权。
description.en: Was relieved of his military command during the 'Dismantling military power with a cup of wine' incident.

description.zh-cn: 钱选的《宋太祖蹴鞠图》是摹仿苏汉臣的作品。
description.en: Qian Xuan's 'Emperor Taizu Playing Cuju' is an imitation of a work by Su Hanchen.

description.zh-cn: 学者邓小南认为石守信可能有粟特人血统，为沙陀族。
description.en: Scholar Deng Xiaonan believes that Shi Shouxin may have had Sogdian ancestry and belonged to the Shatuo people.

description.zh-cn: 倪匡为香港《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了《绝代双骄》的诞生。
description.en: Ni Kuang invited Gu Long to write for Hong Kong's Ming Pao, which led to the creation of 'Juedai Shuangjiao'.

description.zh-cn: 金庸称古龙为“相当熟的朋友”，并在自己封笔后亲自为旗下《明报》向古龙邀稿。
description.en: Jin Yong referred to Gu Long as a 'very good friend' and personally invited him to write for his newspaper, Ming Pao, after he had stopped writing.

description.zh-cn: 金庸封笔后亲自为旗下的《明报》向古龙邀稿，促成了《陆小凤》系列的发表。
description.en: After retiring from writing, Jin Yong personally invited Gu Long to contribute to his newspaper, Ming Pao, which led to the publication of 'The Legend of Lu Xiaofeng' series.

description.zh-cn: 古龙创作了武侠小说《多情剑客无情剑》。
description.en: Gu Long authored the wuxia novel 'Sentimental Swordsman, Ruthless Sword'.

description.zh-cn: 古龙创作了武侠小说《绝代双骄》。
description.en: Gu Long authored the wuxia novel 'Juedai Shuangjiao'.

description.zh-cn: 1954年秋考入成功中学，高二时因家庭变故弃学离家。
description.en: Enrolled in Chenggong High School in the autumn of 1954, but dropped out and left home during his second year due to family issues.

description.zh-cn: 导演楚原拍摄了多部古龙小说改编的电影，对古龙作品的影视化推广起到了关键作用。
description.en: Director Chor Yuen directed many film adaptations of Gu Long's novels, playing a key role in promoting his works in film and television.

description.zh-cn: 波兹南事件是发生在波兰人民共和国的一次大规模民众抗议活动。
