description.en: The Poznań protests of 1956 were a large-scale public protest that took place in the Polish People's Republic.

description.zh-cn: 波兰十月事件是发生在波兰人民共和国的一次重大政治变革。
description.en: The Polish October was a major political change that took place in the Polish People's Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1956年匈牙利革命是发生在匈牙利人民共和国的一次全国性革命。
description.en: The Hungarian Revolution of 1956 was a nationwide revolution that took place in the Hungarian People's Republic.

description.zh-cn: 关羽是刘备的重要亲信，自早期组建军队起便追随刘备，情同手足，为其镇守荆州，是蜀汉集团的核心将领。
description.en: Guan Yu was a key confidant of Liu Bei, following him since the early days of forming his army. They shared a brotherly bond, and Guan Yu defended Jing Province for him, serving as a core general of the Shu Han faction.

description.zh-cn: 在白马之战中，关羽单骑冲入袁绍军阵中，于万军之中斩杀其大将颜良，解了白马之围。
description.en: During the Battle of Boma, Guan Yu charged alone into Yuan Shao's army, slew his general Yan Liang amidst thousands of soldiers, and lifted the siege of Boma.

description.zh-cn: 在樊城之战中，曹将庞德被俘后拒不投降，被关羽所杀。
description.en: During the Battle of Fancheng, the Cao general Pang De was captured and, after refusing to surrender, was executed by Guan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 在樊城之战中，关羽利用汉水暴涨之机水淹七军，于禁所率军队全军覆没，被迫投降，被关羽俘虏。
description.en: During the Battle of Fancheng, Guan Yu took advantage of the flooding Han River to annihilate the seven armies. The forces led by Yu Jin were completely wiped out, forcing him to surrender and be captured by Guan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 219年七月，在刘备称汉中王后，时任前将军的关羽率军从荆州北上，主动进攻曹仁镇守的樊城，发起了襄樊战役。
description.en: In the seventh month of 219, after Liu Bei declared himself King of Hanzhong, Guan Yu, then General of the Front, led his army north from Jing Province to initiate an attack on Fancheng, which was defended by Cao Ren, thus starting the Battle of Xiangyang-Fancheng.

description.zh-cn: 在关羽进攻樊城时，东吴趁其后方空虚，由吕蒙、陆逊率军背盟偷袭荆州，断绝关羽后路，最终导致关羽败走麦城，兵败身亡。
description.en: While Guan Yu was attacking Fancheng, Eastern Wu took advantage of his unguarded rear, with Lü Meng and Lu Xun leading troops to break the alliance and launch a surprise attack on Jing Province. This cut off Guan Yu's retreat and ultimately led to his defeat at Maicheng and his death.

description.zh-cn: 因与关羽素有嫌隙，在吕蒙偷袭荆州时，时任公安守将的士仁不战而降，导致蜀汉防线崩溃。
description.en: Due to a long-standing grudge against Guan Yu, Shi Ren, then commander of Gong'an, surrendered without a fight when Lü Meng launched his surprise attack on Jing Province, leading to the collapse of the Shu Han defensive line.

description.zh-cn: 因与关羽素有嫌隙，在吕蒙偷袭荆州时，时任南郡太守、镇守江陵的麋芳不战而降，导致关羽后方基地失守。
description.en: Due to a long-standing grudge against Guan Yu, Mi Fang, then Administrator of Nanjun and defender of Jiangling, surrendered without a fight when Lü Meng launched his surprise attack on Jing Province, causing Guan Yu to lose his rear base.

description.zh-cn: 219年七月，刘备称汉中王后，拜关羽为前将军、假节钺，总督荆州事。
description.en: In the seventh month of 219, after Liu Bei declared himself King of Hanzhong, he appointed Guan Yu as General of the Front, granted him the authority of 'Jieyue', and put him in overall command of Jing Province affairs.

description.zh-cn: 樊城之战最终因东吴偷袭荆州、关羽腹背受敌而失败，关羽在撤退途中败走麦城被杀，此战成为其人生的终点。
description.en: The Battle of Fancheng ultimately failed due to Eastern Wu's surprise attack on Jing Province, which left Guan Yu caught between two fronts. He was defeated and killed at Maicheng during his retreat, marking the end of his life.

description.zh-cn: 彼得·乔治·彼得森于1985年与苏世民共同创建了黑石集团。
description.en: Peter G. Peterson co-founded The Blackstone Group with Stephen A. Schwarzman in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 苏世民于1985年与彼得·乔治·彼得森共同创建了黑石集团。
description.en: Stephen A. Schwarzman co-founded The Blackstone Group with Peter G. Peterson in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 苏世民担任黑石集团的董事长兼首席执行官。
description.en: Stephen A. Schwarzman serves as the Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of The Blackstone Group.

description.zh-cn: 布拉格抛窗事件是波希米亚叛乱的直接导火索和开端。
description.en: The Defenestration of Prague was the direct trigger and beginning of the Bohemian Revolt.

description.zh-cn: 波希米亚叛乱是三十年战争的开端和第一阶段。
description.en: The Bohemian Revolt was the beginning and the first phase of the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 斐迪南二世成为波希米亚国王后，其残酷的禁止和迫害新教的政策引发了波希米亚起义。
description.en: After Ferdinand II became King of Bohemia, his cruel policies of prohibiting and persecuting Protestantism triggered the Bohemian Revolt.

description.zh-cn: 法国为削弱其主要竞争对手哈布斯堡王朝，在三十年战争中支持并直接参与了反哈布斯堡阵营的军事行动。
description.en: To weaken its main rival, the House of Habsburg, France supported and directly participated in the military actions of the anti-Habsburg camp during the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典为争夺波罗的海霸权并支持新教，于1630年介入三十年战争，成为反哈布斯堡阵营的主力。
description.en: Sweden intervened in the Thirty Years' War in 1630 to contend for Baltic supremacy and support Protestantism, becoming the main force of the anti-Habsburg camp.

description.zh-cn: 同属哈布斯堡王朝统治，西班牙帝国在三十年战争中是神圣罗马帝国最主要的盟友。
description.en: Both ruled by the House of Habsburg, the Spanish Empire was the most important ally of the Holy Roman Empire during the Thirty Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 黎塞留作为法国首席大臣，主导了法国在三十年战争期间的政策，即联合新教国家对抗哈布斯堡王朝。
description.en: As Chief Minister of France, Richelieu directed France's policy during the Thirty Years' War, which was to ally with Protestant states against the House of Habsburg.

description.zh-cn: 在黎塞留主导下，法国向瑞典提供资金援助，支持其出兵德意志对抗神圣罗马帝国。
description.en: Under Richelieu's direction, France provided financial aid to Sweden to support its military intervention in Germany against the Holy Roman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫率军在德意志境内多次击败帝国军队，扭转了战局。
description.en: King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden led his army to defeat the Imperial forces multiple times within Germany, turning the tide of the war.

description.zh-cn: 瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫在吕岑会战中阵亡。
description.en: King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden was killed in action at the Battle of Lützen.

description.zh-cn: 在白山战役中，由蒂利伯爵率领的天主教同盟军决定性地击败了波希米亚起义军。
description.en: At the Battle of White Mountain, the Catholic League army, led by Count Tilly, decisively defeated the Bohemian rebels.

description.zh-cn: 因猜忌华伦斯坦的权势和意图，神圣罗马帝国皇帝斐迪南二世下令将其逮捕，最终导致华伦斯坦在海布被其部下刺杀。
description.en: Suspicious of Wallenstein's power and intentions, Holy Roman Emperor Ferdinand II ordered his arrest, which ultimately led to Wallenstein's assassination by his own officers in Eger.

description.zh-cn: 三十年战争削弱了哈布斯堡王朝的势力，使得法国成为欧洲大陆的主导强权。
description.en: The Thirty Years' War weakened the power of the House of Habsburg, allowing France to become the dominant power on the European continent.

description.zh-cn: 丹麦国王克里斯蒂安四世于1625年率军介入冲突，开启了战争的“丹麦阶段”。
description.en: King Christian IV of Denmark intervened in the conflict with his army in 1625, initiating the 'Danish Phase' of the war.

description.zh-cn: 波希米亚议会于1619年8月选出信奉新教的普法尔茨选帝侯腓特烈五世为波希米亚国王。
description.en: In August 1619, the Bohemian Diet elected the Protestant Elector Palatine Frederick V as the King of Bohemia.

description.zh-cn: 在白山战役战败后，腓特烈五世被迫逃亡荷兰，其波希米亚国王的统治结束。
description.en: After being defeated at the Battle of White Mountain, Frederick V was forced to flee to the Netherlands, ending his reign as King of Bohemia.

description.zh-cn: 张鹏于2019年6月11日正式注册成立北京智谱华章科技有限公司。
description.en: Zhang Peng officially registered and established Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology Co., Ltd. on June 11, 2019.

description.zh-cn: 张鹏自公司成立起担任CEO职务。
description.en: Zhang Peng has served as the CEO since the company's establishment.

description.zh-cn: 张鹏于2002年本科毕业于清华大学。
description.en: Zhang Peng graduated from Tsinghua University with a bachelor's degree in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 张鹏本科毕业后进入清华大学计算机系知识工程实验室（KEG实验室）攻读硕士研究生。
description.en: After graduating with a bachelor's degree, Zhang Peng entered the Knowledge Engineering Group (KEG) Laboratory of the Department of Computer Science at Tsinghua University to pursue a master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 美国商务部工业和安全局于2025年1月宣布将智谱公司列入实体清单，对其施加贸易限制。
description.en: In January 2025, the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security announced the addition of Zhipu AI to the Entity List, imposing trade restrictions on it.

description.zh-cn: 根据美国商务部的说法，智谱公司通过开发和整合先进的人工智能研究，推动了中华人民共和国的军事现代化。
description.en: According to the U.S. Department of Commerce, Zhipu AI has promoted the military modernization of the People's Republic of China by developing and integrating advanced artificial intelligence research.

description.zh-cn: 美团是北京智谱华章科技有限公司的投资方之一。
description.en: Meituan is one of the investors in Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology Co., Ltd.

description.en: Visual China Group disclosed its partnership with Zhipu AI.

description.zh-cn: 鲁哀公是鲁国第二十六任君主，在位27年。
description.en: Duke Ai of Lu was the 26th monarch of the State of Lu, reigning for 27 years.

description.zh-cn: 鲁哀公在位时，鲁国大权被三桓把持。鲁哀公试图恢复君主权力，但与三桓冲突加剧，最终导致其流亡国外。
description.en: During the reign of Duke Ai, the power of the State of Lu was held by the Three Huan. Duke Ai attempted to restore monarchical authority, but this intensified the conflict with the Three Huan, eventually leading to his exile.

description.zh-cn: 因与三桓的权力斗争失败，鲁哀公流亡至越国。
description.en: Due to losing the power struggle against the Three Huan, Duke Ai of Lu went into exile in the State of Yue.

description.zh-cn: 鲁哀公在流亡越国的途中经过了邾国。
description.en: Duke Ai of Lu passed through the State of Zhu on his way to exile in the State of Yue.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁哀公时期担任鲁国执政士大夫。
description.en: Served as a governing minister of the State of Lu during the period of Duke Ai.

description.zh-cn: 自1927年国民政府宣布“剿匪”后，长期将中国共产党及其成员称为“共匪”或“赤匪”，并采取军事和政治上的敌对政策。
description.en: Since the Nationalist Government declared the 'Bandit Suppression Campaign' in 1927, it has long referred to the Chinese Communist Party and its members as 'Communist bandits' or 'Red bandits' and adopted hostile military and political policies.

description.zh-cn: 香港本土派使用“土共”、“支共”等贬称来称呼中国共产党党员及其支持者。
description.en: The Hong Kong localist camp uses derogatory terms like 'Local Commies' and 'Chinazi Commies' to refer to members and supporters of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 在1994年千岛湖事件后，时任中华民国总统李登辉公开批评中共是“土匪政权”。
description.en: After the 1994 Qiandao Lake incident, then-President of the Republic of China Lee Teng-hui publicly criticized the CCP as a 'bandit regime'.

description.zh-cn: 千岛湖事件的发生及其后续处理引发了台湾社会强烈不满，促使时任总统李登辉对中共发表严厉批评。
description.en: The occurrence of the Qiandao Lake incident and its subsequent handling triggered strong dissatisfaction in Taiwanese society, pushing then-President Lee Teng-hui to issue harsh criticism against the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，时任总统蒋经国首次在官方文告中以“中共”取代“共匪”，推动了中华民国政府官方用语的转变。
description.en: In 1983, then-President Chiang Ching-kuo first used 'CCP' instead of 'Communist bandits' in an official proclamation, pushing a shift in the official terminology of the ROC government.

description.zh-cn: 该条款为中华民国政府将中共定义为“匪谍”和“匪区”等提供了法律依据，并推动了戒严时期的反共政策。
description.en: This provision provided the legal basis for the ROC government to define the CCP with terms like 'bandit spies' and 'bandit area', and it pushed the anti-communist policies of the martial law era.

description.zh-cn: 辛灏年提出“驱除马列，恢复中华”的口号，旨在反对中国共产党的马克思主义意识形态和统治。
description.en: Xin Haonian proposed the slogan 'Expel Marxism-Leninism, Restore China', aiming to oppose the Marxist ideology and rule of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 辛灏年提出的口号“驱除马列，恢复中华”在形式上类同于孙中山的“驱逐鞑虏，恢复中华”，受到了其思想的影响。
description.en: The slogan proposed by Xin Haonian, 'Expel Marxism-Leninism, Restore China', is structurally similar to Sun Yat-sen's 'Expel the Tartars, Restore China', and was influenced by his ideas.

description.zh-cn: 辛灏年的主张延续了蒋中正的反共复国思想。
description.en: Xin Haonian's advocacy continues the anti-communist and national restoration ideology of Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 与贺龙、朱德等人在井冈山建立独立的武装，即后来的中国工农红军。
description.en: Together with He Long, Zhu De, and others, established an independent armed force in the Jinggangshan Mountains, which later became the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

description.zh-cn: 在福建武备学堂学习期间共同创建了革命团体“福建学生会”。
description.en: They co-founded the revolutionary group 'Fujian Student Association' during their time at the Fujian Military Academy.

position.zh-cn: 队官、三营管带、二营管带
position.en: Company officer, 3rd Battalion Commander, 2nd Battalion Commander

description.zh-cn: 毕业后进入南洋新军第九镇任职，后担任管带。
description.en: After graduation, he joined the Ninth Division of the Nanyang New Army and later served as a battalion commander.

description.zh-cn: 在标统赵声的影响下，林述庆倾向革命党。
description.en: Under the influence of Regiment Commander Zhao Sheng, Lin Shuqing leaned towards the revolutionary party.

description.zh-cn: 率部起义，攻占镇江，响应辛亥革命。
description.en: Led his troops in an uprising, capturing Zhenjiang in response to the Xinhai Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在宋教仁斡旋下，程德全接替林述庆出任江宁临时都督。
description.en: Through Song Jiaoren's mediation, Cheng Dequan succeeded Lin Shuqing as the provisional military governor of Jiangning.

description.zh-cn: 因反对袁世凯而被迫下野，后因在宋教仁遇刺案后扬言起兵复仇，为袁所忌并据信被其毒杀。
description.en: He was forced to step down due to his opposition to Yuan Shikai. Later, after vowing to raise troops for revenge following Song Jiaoren's assassination, he was feared by Yuan and is believed to have been poisoned by him.

description.zh-cn: 据信，梁士诒在自己举办的家宴中执行了袁世凯的命令，毒杀了林述庆。
description.en: It is believed that Liang Shiyi carried out Yuan Shikai's orders and poisoned Lin Shuqing at a private banquet he hosted.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命后，溥仪在出宫前把钓鱼台内的“养源斋”赐给了陈宝琛。
description.en: After the Xinhai Revolution and before leaving the Forbidden City, Puyi gifted the 'Yangyuan Zhai' (Studio of Nourishing Origins) within Diaoyutai to Chen Baochen.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期，钓鱼台国宾馆成为中央文化革命小组的办公和生活驻地，是当时的政治权力核心所在地。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse became the office and residence of the Central Cultural Revolution Group, serving as the core of political power at the time.

description.zh-cn: 九大之后，钓鱼台国宾馆成为“四人帮”成员集中的居住和办公处所。
description.en: After the 9th National Congress of the CCP, the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse became the concentrated residence and office for the members of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东逝世后，江青才从钓鱼台国宾馆搬到中南海居住。
description.en: Only after Mao Zedong's death did Jiang Qing move from the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse to live in Zhongnanhai.

description.zh-cn: 曾居住于钓鱼台国宾馆十二号楼。
description.en: Once resided in Villa No. 12 of the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse.

description.zh-cn: 访问中国时曾下榻于钓鱼台国宾馆十二号楼。
description.en: Stayed at Villa No. 12 of the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse during his visit to China.

description.zh-cn: 访问中国时曾下榻于钓鱼台国宾馆十二号楼。
description.en: Stayed at Villa No. 12 of the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse during her visit to China.

description.zh-cn: 于2023年10月访问中国时入住钓鱼台国宾馆，并在此召开记者会。
description.en: Stayed at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse and held a press conference there during his visit to China in October 2023.

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战造成中国共产党在中国大陆建立中华人民共和国，中华民国政府迁往台湾，从而引发了关于台湾主权和政权归属的台湾问题。
description.en: The Second Chinese Civil War led to the establishment of the People's Republic of China on the mainland by the CCP and the retreat of the ROC government to Taiwan, thereby giving rise to the Taiwan issue concerning Taiwan's sovereignty and governing authority.

description.zh-cn: 《旧金山和约》中日本仅声明放弃对台湾的主权，但未明确将其移交给任何国家，这一模糊性成为“台湾地位未定论”的主要法理依据。
description.en: In the Treaty of San Francisco, Japan only renounced its sovereignty over Taiwan without explicitly transferring it to any country. This ambiguity became the main legal basis for the 'Theory of the Undetermined Status of Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 1950年6月27日，美国总统杜鲁门命令第七舰队进驻台湾海峡，以阻止任何对台湾的进攻，并确保台湾中立化。
description.en: On June 27, 1950, U.S. President Truman ordered the Seventh Fleet into the Taiwan Strait to prevent any attack on Taiwan and to ensure its neutralization.

description.zh-cn: 为反对和遏制“台独”分裂势力，中华人民共和国第十届全国人民代表大会通过了《反分裂国家法》。
description.en: To oppose and curb 'Taiwan independence' secessionist forces, the 10th National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China passed the Anti-Secession Law.

description.zh-cn: 该法旨在从法律层面遏制台湾独立运动，并为采取非和平方式解决台湾问题提供了法律依据。
description.en: This law aims to legally curb the Taiwan independence movement and provides a legal basis for using non-peaceful means to resolve the Taiwan issue.

description.zh-cn: 根据《马关条约》，清朝将台湾全岛、澎湖列岛割让给日本，开启了日本对台湾的殖民统治时期。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Shimonoseki, the Qing dynasty ceded the entire island of Taiwan and the Pescadores to Japan, beginning the period of Japanese colonial rule over Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 赖清德在总统就职典礼上发表了台湾与中华人民共和国互不隶属的观点，延续并明确了其政府的两岸关系立场。
description.en: In his presidential inauguration speech, Lai Ching-te stated the view that Taiwan and the People's Republic of China are not subordinate to each other, continuing and clarifying his administration's stance on cross-strait relations.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文在总统任内不承认九二共识，并转为强调“海峡两岸互不隶属”的立场。
description.en: During her presidency, Tsai Ing-wen did not recognize the 1992 Consensus and shifted to emphasizing the stance that 'neither side of the Taiwan Strait is subordinate to the other'.

description.zh-cn: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克领导了土耳其独立战争，并于1923年10月29日宣告成立土耳其共和国，成为其首任总统。
description.en: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk led the Turkish War of Independence and on October 29, 1923, proclaimed the Republic of Turkey, becoming its first president.

description.zh-cn: 《洛桑条约》的签署使新成立的土耳其共和国获得国际承认，确立了其作为奥斯曼帝国合法继承国的地位。
description.en: The signing of the Treaty of Lausanne granted international recognition to the newly established Republic of Turkey, confirming its status as the legal successor to the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其大国民议会正式废除苏丹国，终结了奥斯曼帝国623年的君主统治。
description.en: The Grand National Assembly of Turkey officially abolished the Sultanate, ending 623 years of monarchical rule by the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 土耳其独立战争旨在挑战和反抗旨在瓜分奥斯曼帝国的《色佛尔条约》条款。
description.en: The Turkish War of Independence was aimed at challenging and resisting the terms of the Treaty of Sèvres, which sought to partition the Ottoman Empire.

description.zh-cn: 作为首任总统，穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克推行了一系列激进的凯末尔改革，旨在建立一个现代化的世俗共和国。
description.en: As the first president, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk implemented a series of radical reforms, known as Atatürk's Reforms, to create a modern, secular republic.

description.zh-cn: 为遏制苏联在地中海的扩张，土耳其于1952年加入北大西洋公约组织。
description.en: To curb Soviet expansion in the Mediterranean, Turkey joined the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in 1952.

description.zh-cn: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安是土耳其共和国的现任总统。
description.en: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan is the current President of the Republic of Turkey.

description.zh-cn: 自1984年起，库尔德工人党开始针对土耳其政府发动叛乱，至今已造成超过4万人死亡。
description.en: Since 1984, the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) has been waging an insurgency against the Turkish government, resulting in over 40,000 deaths.

description.zh-cn: 2016年7月15日，土耳其军方部分派系发动政变，企图推翻总统埃尔多安，但最终失败。
description.en: On July 15, 2016, a faction within the Turkish military launched a coup attempt to overthrow President Erdoğan, which ultimately failed.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月，土耳其宣布进行“和平之泉”军事行动，以打击叙利亚当地的库尔德民兵。
description.en: In October 2019, Turkey announced Operation Peace Spring to target Kurdish militias in Syria.

description.zh-cn: “和平之泉”军事行动旨在打击土耳其视为威胁的叙利亚库尔德民兵组织。
description.en: Operation Peace Spring was aimed at combating Syrian Kurdish militia groups, which Turkey considers a threat.

description.zh-cn: 埃尔多安政府采取积极接收叙利亚内战难民的政策，使土耳其成为全球最大的难民接收国。
description.en: The Erdoğan government has actively pursued a policy of accepting refugees from the Syrian Civil War, making Turkey the world's largest refugee-hosting country.

description.zh-cn: 在2023年土耳其大选中，时任反对派领导人凯末尔·克勒奇达尔奥卢承诺，一旦当选总统将遣返所有难民。
description.en: During the 2023 Turkish general election, then-opposition leader Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu pledged to repatriate all refugees if elected president.

description.zh-cn: 凯末尔·克勒奇达尔奥卢是2023年土耳其大选中雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安的主要政治对手。
description.en: Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu was the main political rival of Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in the 2023 Turkish general election.

description.zh-cn: 2015年11月24日，土耳其军方击落了一架俄罗斯战斗机。
description.en: On November 24, 2015, the Turkish military shot down a Russian fighter jet.

description.zh-cn: 该事件导致俄罗斯一架战斗机被摧毁，并引发了土耳其与俄罗斯之间的外交危机。
description.en: The incident resulted in the destruction of a Russian fighter jet and sparked a diplomatic crisis between Turkey and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 建州女真是明代女真族三大部之一。
description.en: The Jianzhou Jurchens were one of the three major divisions of the Jurchen people during the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 海西女真是明代女真族三大部之一。
description.en: The Haixi Jurchens were one of the three major divisions of the Jurchen people during the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 野人女真是明代女真族三大部之一。
description.en: The Yeren Jurchens were one of the three major divisions of the Jurchen people during the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在辽金时代，五国部是完颜部的附庸。
description.en: During the Liao and Jin dynasties, the Wuguobu was a vassal of the Wanyan tribe.

description.zh-cn: 元朝于五国部旧地设立斡朵里女真万户府。
description.en: The Yuan Dynasty established the Odoli Jurchen Myriarchy in the former territory of the Wuguobu.

description.zh-cn: 元朝于五国部旧地设立胡里改女真万户府。
description.en: The Yuan Dynasty established the Huligai Jurchen Myriarchy in the former territory of the Wuguobu.

description.zh-cn: 元代的斡朵里万户府隶属辽阳行省管辖。
description.en: The Odoli Myriarchy of the Yuan Dynasty was under the jurisdiction of the Liaoyang province.

description.zh-cn: 元代的胡里改万户府隶属辽阳行省管辖。
description.en: The Huligai Myriarchy of the Yuan Dynasty was under the jurisdiction of the Liaoyang province.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初，胡里改部在酋长阿哈出带领下向东南迁移归附明朝。
description.en: In the late Yuan and early Ming period, the Huligai tribe, led by chieftain Ahacu, migrated southeast and submitted to the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 元末明初，斡朵里部在酋长猛哥帖木儿带领下向东南迁移归附明朝。
description.en: In the late Yuan and early Ming period, the Odoli tribe, led by chieftain Möngke Temür, migrated southeast and submitted to the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 明朝以胡里改部为中心建立了建州卫。
description.en: The Ming Dynasty established the Jianzhou Guard with the Huligai tribe as its center.

description.zh-cn: 1588年，努尔哈赤攻克完颜城，消灭了其在建州女真的最后一个强大对手完颜部。
description.en: In 1588, Nurhaci conquered Wanyan city, eliminating his last powerful opponent among the Jianzhou Jurchens, the Wanyan tribe.

description.zh-cn: 阿哈出为完颜氏。
description.en: Ahacu was of the Wanyan clan.

description.zh-cn: 猛哥帖木儿是爱新觉罗氏的先祖。
description.en: Möngke Temür is an ancestor of the Aisin Gioro clan.

description.zh-cn: 李铭是孝懿庄皇后的父亲。
description.en: Li Ming was the father of Empress Xiaoyizhuang.

description.zh-cn: 朱翊𫟸是孝懿庄皇后的长子。
description.en: Zhu Yijun was the eldest son of Empress Xiaoyizhuang.

description.zh-cn: 朱翊𫟸是明穆宗朱载坖的长子。
description.en: Zhu Yijun was the eldest son of Emperor Muzong of Ming (Zhu Zaiji).

description.zh-cn: 朱翊铃是孝懿庄皇后的次子。
description.en: Zhu Yiling was the second son of Empress Xiaoyizhuang.

description.zh-cn: 朱翊铃是明穆宗朱载坖的次子。
description.en: Zhu Yiling was the second son of Emperor Muzong of Ming (Zhu Zaiji).

description.zh-cn: 蓬莱公主是孝懿庄皇后的长女。
description.en: Princess Penglai was the eldest daughter of Empress Xiaoyizhuang.

description.zh-cn: 蓬莱公主是明穆宗朱载坖的长女。
description.en: Princess Penglai was the eldest daughter of Emperor Muzong of Ming (Zhu Zaiji).

description.zh-cn: 朱载坖即位后，追谥李氏为孝懿皇后。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Muzong (Zhu Zaiji) posthumously honored Lady Li with the title Empress Xiaoyi.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗即位后，追尊其嫡母孝懿庄皇后，加上谥号“贞惠顺哲恭仁俪天襄圣”。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Wanli Emperor further honored his legal mother, Empress Xiaoyizhuang, with the additional posthumous title 'Zhenhui Shun-zhe Gongren Litian Xiangsheng'.

description.zh-cn: 朱载坖是孝恪皇后的儿子。
description.en: Zhu Zaiji was the son of Empress Xiaoke.

description.zh-cn: 郑南榕与叶菊兰于1972年2月公证结婚，两人育有一女郑竹梅。
description.en: Cheng Nan-jung and Yeh Chu-lan were married in a civil ceremony in February 1972. They have one daughter, Cheng Chu-mei.

description.zh-cn: 郑南榕于1947年9月12日出生于台北市城中区。
description.en: Cheng Nan-jung was born in Chengzhong District, Taipei City on September 12, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 郑南榕曾就读于国立成功大学工程科学系，后休学。
description.en: Cheng Nan-jung studied in the Department of Engineering Science at National Cheng Kung University before dropping out.

description.zh-cn: 郑南榕曾就读于天主教辅仁大学哲学系，后转学至台湾大学。
description.en: Cheng Nan-jung studied in the Department of Philosophy at Fu Jen Catholic University before transferring to National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 郑南榕曾就读于国立台湾大学哲学系，因拒绝修读必修课程《国父思想》而未能毕业。
description.en: Cheng Nan-jung studied in the Department of Philosophy at National Taiwan University but did not graduate because he refused to take the mandatory course 'Sun Yat-sen's Thought'.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东毕业于湖南第一师范学院。
description.en: Mao Zedong graduated from Hunan First Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东曾在北京大学担任图书馆助理员。
description.en: Mao Zedong worked as an assistant librarian at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 二战后，苏联占领了中国东北，并秘密地将其移交给中国共产党，为毛泽东的军队提供了重要支持。
description.en: After World War II, the Soviet Union occupied northeastern China and secretly gave it to the Chinese communists, providing significant support to Mao's forces.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》由上海报业集团拥有和出版。
description.en: Wenhui Bao is owned and published by the Shanghai United Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 严宝礼等人集资创办了《文汇报》。
description.en: Yan Baoli and others raised funds to found Wenhui Bao.

description.zh-cn: 汪精卫政权强制《文汇报》停刊。
description.en: The Wang Jingwei regime forced Wenhui Bao to cease publication.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府以“意图颠覆政府”等罪名勒令《文汇报》停刊。
description.en: The Nationalist Government ordered Wenhui Bao to cease publication on charges such as 'intending to subvert the government'.

description.zh-cn: 上海《文汇报》停刊后，报社主体赴香港创办了香港《文汇报》。
description.en: After the Shanghai Wenhui Bao was shut down, its main staff went to Hong Kong to found the Hong Kong Wen Wei Po.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中共接收上海后，《文汇报》得以复刊。1956年，经中共中央决定，《文汇报》迁回上海复刊。
description.en: After the CPC took over Shanghai in 1949, Wenhui Bao was allowed to resume publication. In 1956, by a decision of the CPC Central Committee, Wenhui Bao moved back to Shanghai and resumed publication.

description.zh-cn: 1949年《文汇报》复刊后，徐铸成任社长兼总编辑。
description.en: After Wenhui Bao resumed publication in 1949, Xu Zhucheng served as its president and editor-in-chief.

description.zh-cn: 1953年，《文汇报》实行公私合营。
description.en: In 1953, Wenhui Bao became a public-private partnership.

description.zh-cn: 在康生的介绍下，徐铸成与毛泽东会面。
description.en: Xu Zhucheng met with Mao Zedong through an introduction by Kang Sheng.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中，《文汇报》受到批判。
description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, Wenhui Bao was criticized.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发后，《文汇报》被“造反派”夺权，成为“林彪、江青反革命集团”的一个宣传渠道。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, Wenhui Bao was seized by 'rebel factions' and became a propaganda channel for the 'Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-revolutionary Cliques'.

description.zh-cn: “造反派”夺取了《文汇报》的控制权。
description.en: The 'rebel faction' seized control of Wenhui Bao.

description.zh-cn: 文革结束后，《文汇报》被“拨乱反正”，纠正了文革期间的错误宣传。
description.en: After the Cultural Revolution, Wenhui Bao underwent 'Boluan Fanzheng' to correct the erroneous propaganda of the period.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》的报头一度改用华国锋的题字。
description.en: The masthead of Wenhui Bao was temporarily changed to calligraphy by Hua Guofeng.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》最先对上演的话剧《于无声处》进行报道，形成了全国影响。
description.en: Wenhui Bao was the first to report on the play 'In a Land of Silence', creating a nationwide impact.

description.zh-cn: 1985年5月，《文汇报》设立了文汇出版社。
description.en: In May 1985, Wenhui Bao established Wenhui Publishing House.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇读书周报》并入《文汇报》，成为其专版。
description.en: Wenhui Reading Weekly was merged into Wenhui Bao, becoming one of its special sections.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》所属的文汇网、文汇客户端等新媒体平台并入上观新闻。
description.en: New media platforms affiliated with Wenhui Bao, such as its website and mobile app, were merged into Shanghai Observer.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》发表了文章《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》。
description.en: Wenhui Bao published the article 'On the New Historical Play Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》在报道中遗漏周恩来题词等行为，引发了南京学生和工人的揭露，最终导致了四五运动。
description.en: Wenhui Bao's omission of Zhou Enlai's inscription in its reports was exposed by students and workers in Nanjing, which eventually led to the Tiananmen Incident of 1976.

description.zh-cn: 《文汇报》通过刊发对经济学家刘国光的访谈，在中国大陆报纸中首次采用了“社会主义市场经济”的概念。
description.en: Through publishing an interview with economist Liu Guoguang, Wenhui Bao was the first newspaper in mainland China to use the concept of 'socialist market economy'.

degree.zh-cn: 演唱专业学士、音乐学硕士
degree.en: Bachelor's degree in Vocal Performance, Master's degree in Musicology

description.zh-cn: 王琳于1995年考入安徽师范大学音乐学院，1999年毕业，并于2005年获得音乐学硕士学位。
description.en: Wang Lin was admitted to the School of Music at Anhui Normal University in 1995, graduated in 1999, and received a Master's degree in Musicology in 2005.

position.zh-cn: 教授、硕士研究生导师、音乐表演专业负责人
position.en: Professor, Master's Supervisor, Head of Music Performance Major

description.zh-cn: 自1999年毕业后，王琳留校任教，现任安徽师范大学音乐学院教授。
description.en: After graduating in 1999, Wang Lin stayed at the university to teach and is currently a professor at the School of Music, Anhui Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 王琳是中国音乐家协会会员。
description.en: Wang Lin is a member of the Chinese Musicians Association.

description.zh-cn: 王琳是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wang Lin is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 2004年，王琳在第十一届全国青年歌手电视大奖赛中获得民族唱法铜奖，此奖项提升了她的专业声誉。
description.en: In 2004, Wang Lin won the bronze prize in the ethnic singing category at the 11th National Young Singer TV Grand Prix, which enhanced her professional reputation.

description.zh-cn: 王琳曾获第六届中国音乐金钟奖声乐比赛安徽赛区一等奖。
description.en: Wang Lin won the first prize in the Anhui division of the 6th Chinese Golden Bell Award for Music vocal competition.

description.zh-cn: 王琳曾应邀参加中央电视台“心连心”艺术团的演出活动。
description.en: Wang Lin was invited to participate in the performance activities of the CCTV "Heart to Heart" Art Troupe.

description.zh-cn: “心连心”艺术团是中国中央电视台下属的艺术表演团体。
description.en: The "Heart to Heart" Art Troupe is an artistic performance troupe affiliated with China Central Television.

description.zh-cn: 王琳曾应邀参加天津电视台的演出活动。
description.en: Wang Lin was invited to participate in performance activities for Tianjin Television.

description.zh-cn: 王琳曾应邀参加安徽电视台“正月正”元宵晚会等演出活动。
description.en: Wang Lin was invited to participate in performance activities such as the "Zhengyue Zheng" Lantern Festival Gala for Anhui Television.

description.zh-cn: 董昭早期曾事奉袁绍，被任命为参军、巨鹿太守、魏郡太守。
description.en: In his early career, Dong Zhao served Yuan Shao and was appointed as Adjutant, Administrator of Julu, and Administrator of Wei.

description.zh-cn: 后因袁绍听信谗言欲加罪于董昭，逼使其逃离。
description.en: Later, because Yuan Shao listened to slander and intended to punish Dong Zhao, Dong Zhao was forced to flee.

description.zh-cn: 离开袁绍后，董昭被河内太守张杨挽留，并被任命为骑都尉。
description.en: After leaving Yuan Shao, Dong Zhao was retained by Zhang Yang, the Administrator of Henei, and appointed as Captain of Cavalry.

description.zh-cn: 董昭在曹操手下长期担任谋臣，历任议郎、冀州牧、徐州牧、司空军祭酒等职，为其出谋划策，深受信赖。
description.en: Dong Zhao served as a long-term advisor under Cao Cao, holding various positions such as Gentleman-consultant, Governor of Ji Province, Governor of Xu Province, and Libationer of the Minister of Works' Army. He provided strategies and was deeply trusted.

description.zh-cn: 曹丕称帝后，董昭继续在曹魏任职，官至将作大匠、大鸿胪、侍中、太常、太仆等。
description.en: After Cao Pi became emperor, Dong Zhao continued to serve in Cao Wei, holding positions such as Grand Master of Works, Grand Herald, Palace Attendant, Grand Master of Ceremonies, and Grand Coachman.

description.zh-cn: 曹叡即位后，董昭进爵乐平侯，历任卫尉，并于232年升任司徒。
description.en: After Cao Rui ascended the throne, Dong Zhao was promoted to Marquis of Leping, served as Commandant of the Guards, and was appointed Minister over the Masses (Situ) in 232.

description.zh-cn: 董昭出生于济阴定陶。
description.en: Dong Zhao was born in Dingtao, Jiyin.

description.zh-cn: 董昭在担任瘿陶县长时，曾接待新任冀州刺史贾琮。
description.en: When Dong Zhao was the Magistrate of Yintao County, he received Jia Cong, the new Inspector of Ji Province.

description.zh-cn: 献计曹操，通过诱骗杨奉，成功将汉献帝迎至许昌。
description.en: He proposed a plan to Cao Cao to trick Yang Feng, successfully welcoming Emperor Xian of Han to Xuchang.

description.zh-cn: 在樊城之战中，建议曹操将与孙权结盟的消息用箭射入城中，以振奋被关羽围困的曹仁守军的士气。
description.en: During the Battle of Fancheng, he suggested that Cao Cao shoot arrows carrying the news of the alliance with Sun Quan into the besieged city to boost the morale of Cao Ren's troops, who were surrounded by Guan Yu.

description.zh-cn: 通过分析判断曹休的部将不会全力作战，其观点影响了曹休进攻江南的计划，使其未能如愿。
description.en: By analyzing that Cao Xiu's subordinate generals would not fight with all their might, his opinion influenced Cao Xiu's plan to attack Jiangnan, preventing it from succeeding as wished.

description.zh-cn: 上书陈述流末之弊，导致诸葛诞、邓飏等人被罢免。
description.en: He submitted a memorial discussing the flaws of focusing on trivial matters, which led to the dismissal of Zhuge Dan, Deng Yang, and others.

description.zh-cn: 上书陈述流末之弊，导致诸葛诞、邓飏等人被罢免。
description.en: He submitted a memorial discussing the flaws of focusing on trivial matters, which led to the dismissal of Zhuge Dan, Deng Yang, and others.

description.zh-cn: 文中提及张邈与袁绍不和。
description.en: The text mentions that Zhang Miao was on bad terms with Yuan Shao.

description.zh-cn: 关羽率军围困了曹仁驻守的樊城。
description.en: Guan Yu led his forces to besiege Cao Ren, who was defending Fancheng.

description.zh-cn: 孙权与曹操结盟，同意从后方袭击关羽的根据地江陵。
description.en: Sun Quan formed an alliance with Cao Cao, agreeing to attack Guan Yu's base in Jiangling from the rear.

description.zh-cn: 苏则与董昭同任侍中时，曾推开枕在其腿上的董昭，并说：“我苏则之膝，不是佞人的枕头。”，表达了对其品行的不屑。
description.en: When Su Ze and Dong Zhao were both Palace Attendants, Su Ze pushed away Dong Zhao who was resting his head on his lap, saying, 'The lap of I, Su Ze, is not a pillow for a sycophant,' expressing his disdain for Dong Zhao's character.

description.zh-cn: 同乡吴质曾向董昭抱怨不被乡人看好，显示了二人之间较为亲近的关系。
description.en: Wu Zhi, who was from the same hometown, once complained to Dong Zhao about not being well-regarded by their fellow townspeople, indicating a relatively close relationship between the two.

description.zh-cn: 司马芝的妻子是董昭的侄女，因此司马芝是董昭的侄女婿。
description.en: Sima Zhi's wife was Dong Zhao's niece, making Sima Zhi his nephew-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 1998年9月，与细川护熙、拉莫斯共同倡议成立一个类似“世界经济论坛”的“亚洲论坛”。
description.en: In September 1998, along with Morihiro Hosokawa and Fidel Ramos, proposed the establishment of an 'Asian Forum' similar to the 'World Economic Forum'.

description.zh-cn: 1998年9月，与霍克、拉莫斯共同倡议成立一个类似“世界经济论坛”的“亚洲论坛”。
description.en: In September 1998, along with Bob Hawke and Fidel Ramos, proposed the establishment of an 'Asian Forum' similar to the 'World Economic Forum'.

description.zh-cn: 1998年9月，与霍克、细川护熙共同倡议成立一个类似“世界经济论坛”的“亚洲论坛”。
description.en: In September 1998, along with Bob Hawke and Morihiro Hosokawa, proposed the establishment of an 'Asian Forum' similar to the 'World Economic Forum'.

description.zh-cn: 与拉莫斯和霍克在北京议定亚洲论坛的筹设。
description.en: Agreed upon the establishment plan for the Asian Forum with Ramos and Hawke in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 博鳌亚洲论坛是参照达沃斯世界经济论坛的模式而成立的。
description.en: The Boao Forum for Asia was established based on the model of the World Economic Forum in Davos.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第一届秘书长。
description.en: Served as the first Secretary-General of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第一届理事长。
description.en: Served as the first Chairman of the Board of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第二届秘书长。
description.en: Served as the second Secretary-General of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第二届理事长。
description.en: Served as the second Chairman of the Board of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第三届秘书长。
description.en: Served as the third Secretary-General of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第三届理事长。
description.en: Served as the third Chairman of the Board of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 担任博鳌亚洲论坛第四届秘书长。
description.en: Serving as the fourth Secretary-General of the Boao Forum for Asia.

description.zh-cn: 受疫情影响，博鳌亚洲论坛2020年年会于4月30日宣布停办。
description.en: Due to the pandemic, the cancellation of the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2020 was announced on April 30, 2020.

description.zh-cn: 在博鳌亚洲论坛2014年年会上，时任中国国务院总理李克强指出中方正争取早日正式成立亚洲基础设施投资银行。
description.en: At the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2014, then-Chinese Premier Li Keqiang stated that China was striving for the early official establishment of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.

description.zh-cn: 在博鳌亚洲论坛2015年年会期间，中国国务院授权发布了《推动共建丝绸之路经济带和21世纪海上丝绸之路的愿景与行动》文件。
description.en: During the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2015, the State Council of China authorized the release of the document 'Vision and Actions on Jointly Building Silk Road Economic Belt and 21st-Century Maritime Silk Road'.

description.zh-cn: 共同出席博鳌亚洲论坛成立大会。
description.en: Attended the inaugural conference of the Boao Forum for Asia together.

description.zh-cn: 共同出席博鳌亚洲论坛2018年年会。
description.en: Attended the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2018 together.

description.zh-cn: 共同出席博鳌亚洲论坛2023年年会。
description.en: Attended the Boao Forum for Asia Annual Conference 2023 together.

郝龙斌是郝柏村的长子。
description.en: Hau Lung-pin is the eldest son of Hau Pei-tsun.

description.zh-cn: 郝柏村于1935年考入中央陆军军官学校第12期砲兵科，1938年提前毕业。
description.en: Hau Pei-tsun was admitted to the 12th class of the artillery branch at the Central Military Academy in 1935 and graduated early in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 郝柏村于1965年至1970年间担任总统蒋中正的侍卫长。
description.en: Hau Pei-tsun served as Aide-de-camp General to President Chiang Kai-shek from 1965 to 1970.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统蒋经国晋任郝柏村为国防部参谋总长，并晋升其为一级上将。
description.en: Then-President Chiang Ching-kuo appointed Hau Pei-tsun as Chief of the General Staff of the Ministry of National Defense and promoted him to General of the Army.

description.zh-cn: 总统李登辉任命时任国防部长的郝柏村转任行政院院长，此举被外界解读为意在剥夺其军权。
description.en: President Lee Teng-hui appointed then-Minister of National Defense Hau Pei-tsun as Premier of the Executive Yuan, a move interpreted by outsiders as intended to strip him of his military power.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政院长郝柏村强烈反对并拒绝副署总统李登辉对总统府参军长蒋仲苓的一级上将晋升案，导致该任命案最终搁置。
description.en: Then-Premier Hau Pei-tsun strongly opposed and refused to countersign President Lee Teng-hui's proposed promotion of Aide-de-camp General Chiang Chung-ling to General of the Army, causing the appointment to be shelved.

description.zh-cn: 1992年立法院改选后，总统李登辉以“建立行政院向立法院负责”为名，要求并最终迫使郝柏村辞去行政院长职务。
description.en: After the 1992 Legislative Yuan election, President Lee Teng-hui, under the rationale of "establishing the Executive Yuan's accountability to the Legislative Yuan," demanded and ultimately forced Hau Pei-tsun to resign from his position as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 郝柏村作为副总统候选人，与总统候选人林洋港搭档参与了1996年的选举。
description.en: Hau Pei-tsun participated in the 1996 election as the vice-presidential candidate, running with presidential candidate Lin Yang-kang.

description.zh-cn: 郝柏村因年事已高造成多重器官衰竭，于2020年3月30日在三军总医院离世。
description.en: Hau Pei-tsun passed away at the Tri-Service General Hospital on March 30, 2020, due to multiple organ failure caused by old age.

description.zh-cn: 万毅在第三、第四方面军任张学良的副官，后又在南京任其临时副官。
description.en: Wan Yi served as Zhang Xueliang's aide-de-camp in the 3rd and 4th Army Groups, and later as his temporary aide-de-camp in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 刘澜波在东北军进行统战工作时结识万毅，使其开始同情中共革命主张。
description.en: Liu Lanbo met Wan Yi during his united front work in the Northeastern Army, which made Wan Yi sympathetic to the CCP's revolutionary cause.

description.zh-cn: 缪澄流因怀疑万毅是共产党员而将其关押。
description.en: Miao Chengliu imprisoned Wan Yi on suspicion of being a Communist Party member.

description.zh-cn: 因缪澄流与日军达成密约，万毅发动“九二二锄奸”行动，试图将其扣押，但缪澄流逃脱。
description.en: Because Miao Chengliu made a secret pact with the Japanese army, Wan Yi launched the 'September 22nd Elimination of Traitors' operation to detain him, but Miao escaped.

description.zh-cn: 经刘澜波介绍，与谷牧一起介绍万毅加入中国共产党。
description.en: After being introduced by Liu Lanbo, he and Gu Mu introduced Wan Yi to join the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 经刘澜波介绍，与张文海一起介绍万毅加入中国共产党。
description.en: After being introduced by Liu Lanbo, he and Zhang Wenhai introduced Wan Yi to join the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 与常恩多共同发动“九二二锄奸”行动。
description.en: Co-launched the 'September 22nd Elimination of Traitors' operation with Chang Enduo.

description.zh-cn: 在“九二二锄奸”行动中扣押了朴炳珊。
description.en: Detained Piao Bingshan during the 'September 22nd Elimination of Traitors' operation.

description.zh-cn: 在万毅被关押期间，密令将其处决。
description.en: While Wan Yi was imprisoned, he secretly ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 派遣万毅去领导和改造投奔共产党的东北军111师。
description.en: Dispatched Wan Yi to lead and reform the Northeastern Army's 111th Division, which had defected to the Communists.

description.zh-cn: 在东北军111师改编后，郭维城在代理师长万毅手下任副师长。
description.en: After the reorganization of the Northeastern Army's 111th Division, Guo Weicheng served as deputy division commander under acting commander Wan Yi.

description.zh-cn: 万毅在中共七大上当选为候补中央委员。
description.en: Wan Yi was elected as an alternate member of the Central Committee at the 7th National Congress of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 率领东北野战军第五纵队参加辽沈战役。
description.en: Led the 5th Column of the Northeast Field Army to participate in the Liaoshen Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山会议上发言支持彭德怀的意见书。
description.en: Spoke in support of Peng Dehuai's letter of opinion at the Lushan Conference.

description.zh-cn: 因在庐山会议期间支持彭德怀而受到株连，被撤销了几乎所有职务。
description.en: Was implicated for supporting Peng Dehuai during the Lushan Conference and was dismissed from almost all his posts.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中受到迫害，被关押六年。
description.en: Was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution and imprisoned for six years.

description.zh-cn: 率领其团参加南京保卫战，但全团战没。
description.en: Led his regiment to participate in the Battle of Nanjing, but the entire regiment was wiped out.

description.zh-cn: 在东北1947年夏季战役中，与司令员李天佑共同指挥第一纵队。
description.en: During the 1947 Summer Offensive in Northeast China, he co-commanded the 1st Column with commander Li Tianyou.

description.zh-cn: 王生明上校担任国军一江山地区司令，负责岛屿的防守。
description.en: Colonel Wang Shengming served as the commander of the ROC forces in the Yijiangshan area, responsible for the island's defense.

description.zh-cn: 解放军攻占一江山岛后，大陈岛的防御门户洞开，直接导致国军决定并实施大陈岛撤退。
description.en: After the PLA captured the Yijiangshan Islands, the defensive gateway to the Dachen Islands was breached, directly leading to the ROC's decision and implementation of the evacuation of Dachen.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在1953年底提出解决台湾问题，并于1954年指示准备攻打大陈，先解决浙江沿海岛屿，从而推动了一江山岛战役的筹备与发动。
description.en: At the end of 1953, Mao Zedong proposed to solve the Taiwan issue and in 1954 instructed to prepare for an attack on Dachen, starting with the coastal islands of Zhejiang, thus promoting the preparation and launch of the Battle of Yijiangshan Islands.

description.zh-cn: 在一江山岛战役前夕，解放军海军鱼雷艇部队击沉了国军海军的太平号护航驱逐舰。
description.en: On the eve of the Battle of Yijiangshan Islands, PLA Navy torpedo boat units sank the ROC Navy's destroyer escort Tai Ping.

description.zh-cn: 一江山岛的失陷促使美国国会迅速通过了《福尔摩沙决议案》，以明确美国协防台湾的决心。
description.en: The fall of the Yijiangshan Islands prompted the U.S. Congress to quickly pass the Formosa Resolution to clarify America's determination to assist in the defense of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 美国国会于1955年1月29日通过了《福尔摩沙决议案》。
description.en: The U.S. Congress passed the Formosa Resolution on January 29, 1955.

description.en: The National Cultural Heritage Administration and the Ministry of Finance jointly designated and released the list of national-level museums jointly built by central and local governments, launching the program.

description.zh-cn: 1986年毕业于华东理工大学，获颁工学硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from East China University of Science and Technology in 1986 with a Master of Engineering degree.

description.zh-cn: 高迎欣于2004年7月至2005年2月期间，担任中银国际控股有限公司总裁兼首席运营官。
description.en: From July 2004 to February 2005, Gao Yingxin served as the President and Chief Operating Officer of BOC International Holdings Limited.

description.zh-cn: 高迎欣于2015年2月至2018年1月期间，担任中国银行副行长。
description.en: From February 2015 to January 2018, Gao Yingxin served as the Vice President of Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 高迎欣自2020年5月起任中国民生银行党委书记，同年7月任董事长。
description.en: Gao Yingxin was appointed Party Secretary of China Minsheng Bank in May 2020, and became Chairman in July of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 高迎欣是第十三届全国政协委员。
description.en: Gao Yingxin is a member of the 13th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 高迎欣是中国共产党党员，信息来源于维基百科分类。
description.en: Gao Yingxin is a member of the Communist Party of China, based on Wikipedia category information.

description.zh-cn: 郑国作为水利工程师，为秦王政主持修建郑国渠工程。
description.en: As a hydraulic engineer, Zheng Guo supervised the construction of the Zheng Guo Canal for King Zheng of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 郑国原为韩国派往秦国的间谍，任务是劝说秦国兴修水利以消耗其国力。
description.en: Zheng Guo was originally a spy sent by the State of Han to Qin, tasked with persuading Qin to undertake a major hydraulic project to deplete its resources.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝采纳了白公的建议，下令修建白渠。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Han adopted Bai Gong's proposal and ordered the construction of the Bai Canal.

description.zh-cn: 白公向汉武帝提议修建白渠。
description.en: Bai Gong proposed the construction of the Bai Canal to Emperor Wu of Han.

description.zh-cn: 北京市人民代表大会常务委员会是北京市人民代表大会的常设机关，对北京市人民代表大会负责并报告工作。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress is the standing body of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress, to which it is responsible and reports its work.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党北京市委员会是北京市人民代表大会常务委员会的中共上级单位。
description.en: The Beijing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China is the superior CCP unit of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 1979年7月，第五届全国人民代表大会第二次会议通过决议，规定县级以上地方人大设立常务委员会，促成了北京市人大常委会的建立。
description.en: In July 1979, the Second Session of the Fifth National People's Congress passed a resolution stipulating that local people's congresses at and above the county level should establish standing committees, which led to the establishment of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国地方各级人民代表大会和地方各级人民政府组织法》是北京市人民代表大会常务委员会的组织法规。
description.en: The Organic Law of the Local People's Congresses and Local People's Governments of the People's Republic of China is the organizational statute for the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党永州市委员会是中国共产党的地方组织。
description.en: The Yongzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China is a local organization of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 政变后，作为景泰帝的忠臣，王文以谋逆罪被处死。
description.en: After the coup, as a loyal minister to the Jingtai Emperor, Wang Wen was executed on charges of treason.

description.zh-cn: 朱祁镇在夺门之变复辟后，改景泰八年为天顺元年。
description.en: After Zhu Qizhen was restored to power in the Duomen Incident, he changed the eighth year of the Jingtai era to the first year of the Tianshun era.

description.zh-cn: 夺门之变的功臣曹吉祥和石亨等人因政变获得巨大权力，为后来的曹石之变埋下伏笔。
description.en: The功臣 of the Duomen Incident, such as Cao Jixiang and Shi Heng, gained immense power from the coup, setting the stage for the later Cao-Shi Rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 景泰三年，景泰帝立自己的独子朱见济为新太子。
description.en: In the third year of the Jingtai era (1452), the Jingtai Emperor installed his own son, Zhu Jianji, as the new crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 朱见济是朱祁钰的独子。
description.en: Zhu Jianji is the only son of Zhu Qiyu.

description.zh-cn: 与石亨共同策划并发动了旨在刺杀明英宗的曹石之变。
description.en: Together with Shi Heng, he planned and launched the Cao-Shi Rebellion, which aimed to assassinate Emperor Yingzong of Ming.

description.zh-cn: 与曹吉祥共同策划并发动了旨在刺杀明英宗的曹石之变。
description.en: Together with Cao Jixiang, he planned and launched the Cao-Shi Rebellion, which aimed to assassinate Emperor Yingzong of Ming.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂是石破二朗的儿子。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba is the son of Jirō Ishiba.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂于1957年2月4日出生于东京都千代田区。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba was born in Chiyoda, Tokyo on February 4, 1957.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂于1979年毕业于庆应义塾大学法学部法学科。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba graduated from the Faculty of Law, Department of Law at Keio University in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂在1979年至1983年期间于三井银行工作。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba worked at Mitsui Bank from 1979 to 1983.

description.zh-cn: 在石破二朗于1981年去世后，其朋友田中角荣劝说石破茂继承父亲遗志，踏入政界。
description.en: After Jirō Ishiba's death in 1981, his friend Kakuei Tanaka persuaded Shigeru Ishiba to follow his father's will and enter politics.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂于1986年作为自民党成员首次当选国会议员，1993年退党，并于1997年回归自民党。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba was first elected to the Diet as a member of the LDP in 1986, left the party in 1993, and returned in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂在1993年退出自民党后曾加入新进党，直到1997年回归自民党。
description.en: After leaving the LDP in 1993, Shigeru Ishiba joined the New Frontier Party until he returned to the LDP in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 由于对新进党的党首小泽一郎感到失望，石破茂于1997年回归自民党。
description.en: Due to his disappointment with Ichirō Ozawa, the leader of the New Frontier Party, Shigeru Ishiba returned to the LDP in 1997.

position.en: Director General of the Defense Agency

description.zh-cn: 石破茂在小泉纯一郎内阁中担任防卫厅长官。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba served as Director General of the Defense Agency in the cabinet of Junichiro Koizumi.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂在福田康夫内阁中担任防卫大臣。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba served as Minister of Defense in the cabinet of Yasuo Fukuda.

description.zh-cn: 在2008年9月的自民党总裁选举中，石破茂败于麻生太郎。
description.en: In the LDP presidential election of September 2008, Shigeru Ishiba was defeated by Tarō Asō.

position.en: Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries

description.zh-cn: 石破茂在麻生太郎内阁中担任农林水产大臣。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba served as Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries in the cabinet of Tarō Asō.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年总裁选举后，安倍晋三邀请石破茂出任自由民主党干事长。
description.en: After the 2012 presidential election, Shinzo Abe invited Shigeru Ishiba to serve as Secretary-General of the Liberal Democratic Party.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂在2024年自民党总裁选举中胜出，为其就任内阁总理大臣铺平了道路。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba won the 2024 LDP presidential election, paving the way for him to become Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂与高市早苗是2024年自民党总裁选举第二轮的主要竞争对手。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba and Sanae Takaichi were the main competitors in the second round of the 2024 LDP presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 石破茂接替岸田文雄出任第102任内阁总理大臣。
description.en: Shigeru Ishiba succeeded Fumio Kishida as the 102nd Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 高市早苗接替石破茂出任内阁总理大臣。
description.en: Sanae Takaichi succeeded Shigeru Ishiba as Prime Minister.

position.en: Vice President of the Liberal Democratic Party

description.zh-cn: 在石破茂担任自民党总裁期间，菅义伟担任副总裁。
description.en: While Shigeru Ishiba was President of the LDP, Yoshihide Suga served as Vice President.

position.en: Secretary-General of the Liberal Democratic Party

description.zh-cn: 在石破茂担任自民党总裁期间，森山裕担任干事长。
description.en: While Shigeru Ishiba was President of the LDP, Hiroshi Moriyama served as Secretary-General.

description.zh-cn: 2007年11月8日，时任防卫大臣的石破茂与时任美国国防部长罗伯特·盖茨举行会面。
description.en: On November 8, 2007, Shigeru Ishiba, then Minister of Defense, met with Robert Gates, then United States Secretary of Defense.

description.zh-cn: 1980年2月10日，卢拉与一些工会领袖、学者和知识分子共同创立了劳工党。
description.en: On February 10, 1980, Lula, along with other trade union leaders, academics, and intellectuals, co-founded the Workers' Party.

description.zh-cn: 卢拉作为劳工党的创始成员，曾先后担任该党第1任和第4任全国主席。
description.en: As a founding member of the Workers' Party, Lula served as its 1st and 4th National President.

description.zh-cn: 卢拉曾担任巴西第35任（2003-2011）和第39任（2023至今）总统。
description.en: Lula has served as the 35th (2003-2011) and 39th (2023-present) President of Brazil.

description.zh-cn: 在“洗车行动”调查的背景下，卢拉于2017年被判犯有洗钱和贪污罪并入狱，直至2021年相关判决被宣告无效。
description.en: In the context of the 'Operation Car Wash' investigation, Lula was convicted of money laundering and corruption in 2017 and imprisoned, until the convictions were annulled in 2021.

description.zh-cn: 联邦法官塞尔吉奥·莫罗在“洗车行动”调查中审判并判处卢拉九年半监禁。
description.en: Federal Judge Sérgio Moro tried and sentenced Lula to nine and a half years in prison during the 'Operation Car Wash' investigation.

description.zh-cn: 巴西最高法院法官于2021年3月裁定原审法院不具审理权限，宣告对卢拉的判决无效，恢复了其政治权利。
description.en: In March 2021, a Brazilian Supreme Federal Court justice ruled that the original trial court lacked jurisdiction, thereby annulling Lula's convictions and restoring his political rights.

description.zh-cn: 联合国人权事务委员会认定，对巴西前总统卢拉的起诉侵犯了他获得公平审判的权利、隐私权和政治权利。
description.en: The UN Human Rights Committee found that the prosecution of former Brazilian President Lula violated his right to a fair trial, his right to privacy, and his political rights.

description.zh-cn: 卢拉在2022年巴西总统选举中获胜，开启了他的第三个总统任期。
description.en: Lula won the 2022 Brazilian presidential election, beginning his third term as president.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗在2022年巴西总统选举中被卢拉击败，未能成功连任。
description.en: Incumbent President Jair Bolsonaro was defeated by Lula in the 2022 Brazilian presidential election, failing to secure a second term.

position.zh-cn: 民政院首席部长（幕僚长）
position.en: Chief of Staff of the Presidency

description.zh-cn: 迪尔玛·罗塞夫在卢拉的总统任期内曾担任其幕僚长。
description.en: Dilma Rousseff served as Lula's Chief of Staff during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 巴西前总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫于2023年出任新开发银行行长。
description.en: Former Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff became the President of the New Development Bank in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 2023年2月，卢拉在白宫与美国总统乔·拜登会面。
description.en: In February 2023, Lula met with U.S. President Joe Biden at the White House.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，卢拉在日本举行的八国集团会议上与时任美国总统乔治·沃克·布什会面。
description.en: In 2008, Lula met with then-U.S. President George W. Bush at the G8 summit in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 作为港督，决定对新界采用间接管治方针，维持其原有的土地财产制度和民间风俗习惯。
description.en: As Governor, he decided on a policy of indirect rule for the New Territories, maintaining its original land ownership system and local customs.

description.zh-cn: 时任港督麦理浩于1972年提出十年建屋计划，以解决房屋问题。
description.en: Then-Governor Crawford Murray MacLehose proposed the Ten-year Housing Programme in 1972 to solve the housing problem.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，吴广才升任吉林省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: In 1994, Wu Guangcai was promoted to Secretary-General of the Jilin Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 2001年，吴广才升任中共吉林省委副书记。
description.en: In 2001, Wu Guangcai was promoted to Deputy Secretary of the Jilin Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 吴广才接替王云坤担任吉林市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wu Guangcai succeeded Wang Yunkun as Mayor of Jilin Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 吴广才的吉林市人民政府市长职务由魏敏学接任。
description.en: Wu Guangcai was succeeded by Wei Minxue as Mayor of Jilin Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 吴广才接替方建宇担任中国共产党吉林市委员会书记。
description.en: Wu Guangcai succeeded Fang Jianyu as Secretary of the Jilin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 吴广才的中国共产党吉林市委员会书记职务由赵家治接任。
description.en: Wu Guangcai was succeeded by Zhao Jiazhi as Secretary of the Jilin Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军信息支援部队由中央军事委员会直接领导。
description.en: The PLA Information Support Force is directly led by the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 毕毅于2024年4月起担任中国人民解放军信息支援部队司令员。
description.en: Bi Yi has served as the Commander of the PLA Information Support Force since April 2024.

description.zh-cn: 李伟于2024年4月起担任中国人民解放军信息支援部队政治委员。
description.en: Li Wei has served as the Political Commissar of the PLA Information Support Force since April 2024.

description.zh-cn: 2024年4月19日，中央军委决定撤销中国人民解放军战略支援部队番号。
description.en: On April 19, 2024, the Central Military Commission decided to disband the PLA Strategic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 信息支援部队是以原战略支援部队机关及其信息通信保障力量为基础创设的。
description.en: The Information Support Force was created based on the former headquarters and information and communication support elements of the Strategic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军信息支援部队将在纪念中国人民抗日战争暨世界反法西斯战争胜利80周年大会上首次公开亮相。
description.en: The PLA Information Support Force will make its first public appearance at the commemoration of the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War.

description.zh-cn: 1965年12月，杨成武主持总参谋部工作后，指示研究筹组雷达部，并于1974年回到总参后再次推动加强电子对抗力量建设。
description.en: In December 1965, after taking charge of the General Staff Department, Yang Chengwu instructed to study the formation of a radar department, and after returning to the General Staff in 1974, he again promoted the strengthening of electronic warfare capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 由于受到文化大革命的干扰，总参雷达部的筹组工作被迫中断。
description.en: Due to the interference of the Cultural Revolution, the preparatory work for the General Staff's Radar Department was forced to be suspended.

description.zh-cn: 1975年12月18日，叶剑英向中央和毛泽东呈交报告，建议成立总参四部（即后来的电子对抗、雷达部）。
description.en: On December 18, 1975, Ye Jianying submitted a report to the Central Committee and Mao Zedong, proposing the establishment of the Fourth Department of the General Staff (later the Electronic Countermeasure and Radar Department).

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东收到了叶剑英关于成立总参四部的报告，该报告建议加强电子对抗工作。
description.en: Mao Zedong received Ye Jianying's report on the establishment of the Fourth Department of the General Staff, which proposed strengthening electronic warfare work.

description.zh-cn: 1977年4月，王诤被任命兼任总参四部部长，直至1978年病逝。
description.en: In April 1977, Wang Zheng was concurrently appointed as the Head of the Fourth Department of the General Staff, a position he held until his death in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 1978年10月，李光被任命为总参四部政委。
description.en: In October 1978, Li Guang was appointed Political Commissar of the Fourth Department of the General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 1985年8月，靳庆丰被任命为总参电子对抗雷达部部长。
description.en: In August 1985, Jin Qingfeng was appointed Head of the General Staff's Electronic Countermeasure and Radar Department.

description.zh-cn: 1985年8月，张有才被任命为总参电子对抗雷达部副部长。
description.en: In August 1985, Zhang Youcai was appointed Deputy Head of the General Staff's Electronic Countermeasure and Radar Department.

description.zh-cn: 总参四部是2016年军队改革中成立的战略支援部队的前身组成部分之一。
description.en: The Fourth Department of the General Staff was one of the predecessor components of the Strategic Support Force established during the 2016 military reform.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军信息支援部队工程大学是隶属于信息支援部队的院校。
description.en: The PLA Information Support Force Engineering University is an academy subordinate to the Information Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 2025年5月，中央军委决定组建中国人民解放军信息支援部队工程大学。
description.en: In May 2025, the Central Military Commission decided to establish the PLA Information Support Force Engineering University.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方于1908年10月24日出生于江苏无锡。
description.en: Sun Yefang was born in Wuxi, Jiangsu on October 24, 1908.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方于1924年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Sun Yefang joined the Communist Party of China in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方于1925年被选派到莫斯科中山大学学习。
description.en: Sun Yefang was selected to study at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方毕业后留校任政治经济学讲课翻译。
description.en: After graduation, Sun Yefang stayed at the university as a translator for political economy lectures.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方与邓小平在莫斯科中山大学是同学。
description.en: Sun Yefang and Deng Xiaoping were classmates at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方与叶剑英在莫斯科中山大学是同学。
description.en: Sun Yefang and Ye Jianying were classmates at Moscow Sun Yat-sen University.

description.zh-cn: 因王明的宗派主义和肃反扩大化错误，孙冶方被给予“最后警告处分”。
description.en: Due to Wang Ming's factionalism and the expansion of purges, Sun Yefang was given a 'final warning'.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方在陈翰笙的指导下掌握了经济研究和调查的方法。
description.en: Under the guidance of Chen Hansheng, Sun Yefang mastered the methods of economic research and investigation.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方曾任上海财经学院院长。
description.en: Sun Yefang served as the President of Shanghai College of Finance and Economics.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方曾任中国国家统计局副局长。
description.en: Sun Yefang served as the Deputy Director of the National Bureau of Statistics of China.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方曾任中国科学院经济研究所所长，后任中国社会科学院经济研究所名誉所长。
description.en: Sun Yefang served as Director of the Institute of Economics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and later as Honorary Director of the Institute of Economics of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方曾任中共中央顾问委员会委员。
description.en: Sun Yefang served as a member of the Central Advisory Commission of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方曾任国务院学位委员会评议组成员。
description.en: Sun Yefang served as a member of the review group of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，孙冶方蒙冤入秦城监狱7年。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Sun Yefang was wrongfully imprisoned in Qincheng Prison for 7 years.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方逝世前任中国社会科学院顾问。
description.en: Before his death, Sun Yefang served as a consultant to the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 薛明剑是孙冶方的兄长。
description.en: Xue Mingjian was Sun Yefang's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 薛暮桥是孙冶方的叔伯兄弟。
description.en: Xue Muqiao was Sun Yefang's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方是对斯大林《苏联社会主义经济问题》提出系统质疑的中国经济界第一人。
description.en: Sun Yefang was the first person in Chinese economic circles to systematically question Stalin's 'Economic Problems of Socialism in the USSR'.

description.zh-cn: 孙冶方力主实行社会主义市场经济体制。
description.en: Sun Yefang strongly advocated for the implementation of a socialist market economic system.

description.zh-cn: 于光远力主实行社会主义市场经济体制。
description.en: Yu Guangyuan strongly advocated for the implementation of a socialist market economic system.

description.zh-cn: 薛暮桥力主实行社会主义市场经济体制。
description.en: Xue Muqiao strongly advocated for the implementation of a socialist market economic system.

description.zh-cn: 马洪力主实行社会主义市场经济体制。
description.en: Ma Hong strongly advocated for the implementation of a socialist market economic system.

description.zh-cn: 211年，刘备入川，益州牧刘璋在涪县（今绵阳市）富乐山为其接风。
description.en: In 211, when Liu Bei entered Sichuan, Liu Zhang, the Governor of Yi Province, hosted a reception for him at Fule Mountain in Fuxian County (modern-day Mianyang).

description.zh-cn: 邓艾偷渡阴平后，诸葛瞻为国携子战死于绵阳，未能成功阻击邓艾军队。
description.en: After Deng Ai secretly crossed Yinping, Zhuge Zhan fought and died with his son for their country in Mianyang, failing to halt Deng Ai's army.

description.zh-cn: 中国抗日战争爆发后，东北大学内迁至四川省三台县。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, Northeastern University relocated to Santai County, Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 作为“三线建设”的一部分，中国工程物理研究院在绵阳地区布点建设。
description.en: As part of the 'Third Front' construction, the China Academy of Engineering Physics was established in the Mianyang area.

description.zh-cn: 西南科技大学是位于绵阳市的一所主要高等教育机构。
description.en: Southwest University of Science and Technology is a major higher education institution located in Mianyang.

description.zh-cn: 长虹集团是总部位于绵阳市的大型企业，对当地经济有重要影响。
description.en: Changhong Group is a large enterprise headquartered in Mianyang, with significant influence on the local economy.

description.zh-cn: 庄子的思想对后世道教的形成和发展产生了影响。在道教中，庄子被尊为南华仙人。
description.en: Zhuangzi's thought influenced the formation and development of later Taoism. In Taoism, Zhuangzi is revered as the Immortal of Southern Hua.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗于天宝初年（约公元742年）下诏，册封庄子为“南华真人”。
description.en: In the early Tianbao era (around 742 AD), Emperor Xuanzong of Tang issued an edict ennobling Zhuangzi as the 'True Man of Southern Hua'.

description.zh-cn: 唐玄宗于天宝初年（约公元742年）将庄子的著作《庄子》命名为《南华经》。
description.en: In the early Tianbao era (around 742 AD), Emperor Xuanzong of Tang named Zhuangzi's work 'Zhuangzi' as the 'Nanhua Jing' (Nanhua Scripture).

description.zh-cn: 宋徽宗追封庄子为“微妙元通真君”。
description.en: Emperor Huizong of Song posthumously ennobled Zhuangzi as the 'Subtle and Pervasive True Lord'.

description.zh-cn: 庄子批评儒家“以仁义撄人之心”，认为这会违背人性，导致天下大乱。
description.en: Zhuangzi criticized Confucianism for 'binding people's hearts with benevolence and righteousness', believing it went against human nature and would lead to great chaos in the world.

description.zh-cn: 庄子借盗跖之口批评孔子为“鲁之巧伪人”。
description.en: Zhuangzi, speaking through the character of Robber Zhi, criticized Confucius as a 'cunning and hypocritical man of Lu'.

description.zh-cn: 田和（田成子）杀害齐国君主并篡夺了其政权。
description.en: Tian He (Tian Chengzi) killed the ruler of the State of Qi and usurped his political power.

description.zh-cn: “道”是庄子哲学的核心与本体，庄子的思想围绕对“道”的体悟而展开。
description.en: The 'Tao' is the core and ontological basis of Zhuangzi's philosophy; his thought revolves around the comprehension of the 'Tao'.

description.zh-cn: 《独立宣言》的发表标志着越南民主共和国的正式成立。
description.en: The proclamation of the Declaration of Independence marked the official establishment of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 由胡志明领导的越南独立同盟会发动八月革命，建立了越南民主共和国。
description.en: The Việt Minh, led by Hồ Chí Minh, launched the August Revolution and established the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次印度支那战争期间，越南民主共和国与试图维持殖民统治的法国进行了武装斗争。
description.en: During the First Indochina War, the Democratic Republic of Vietnam engaged in armed conflict with France, which was attempting to maintain its colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 1951年，在印度支那共产党分裂后，越盟中的共产主义者改组成立了越南劳动党。
description.en: In 1951, after the dissolution of the Indochinese Communist Party, communists within the Việt Minh reorganized to form the Workers' Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南南方民族解放阵线是在南越进行活动的武装组织，受北越控制和指导。
description.en: The National Liberation Front of South Vietnam was an armed organization operating in South Vietnam under the control and direction of North Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 北部湾事件是美国全面军事介入越南战争的直接导火索，导致战争全面升级。
description.en: The Gulf of Tonkin incident was the direct trigger for full-scale U.S. military intervention in the Vietnam War, leading to its massive escalation.

description.zh-cn: 在越南共和国灭亡后，越南民主共和国主导在南方成立了越南南方共和国作为过渡政权。
description.en: After the fall of the Republic of Vietnam, the Democratic Republic of Vietnam orchestrated the establishment of the Republic of South Vietnam as a transitional government.

description.zh-cn: 随着越南的统一，越南民主共和国作为一个独立的国家实体不复存在。
description.en: With the reunification of Vietnam, the Democratic Republic of Vietnam ceased to exist as a separate state entity.

description.zh-cn: 随着越南的统一，越南南方共和国作为一个独立的国家实体不复存在。
description.en: With the reunification of Vietnam, the Republic of South Vietnam ceased to exist as a separate state entity.

description.zh-cn: 法国扶植保大帝担任新成立的越南国的国家元首。
description.en: France installed Bảo Đại as the Head of State of the newly formed State of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统杨文明代表越南共和国向北越军队投降，导致越南共和国灭亡。
description.en: Then-President Dương Văn Minh surrendered on behalf of the Republic of Vietnam to North Vietnamese forces, leading to the dissolution of the Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 1974年入伍，在成都军区第13军149师446团服役。历任团长（1991年）、副师长（1995年）、师长（1999年）。2003年12月起任参谋长，2006年卸任。同年，升任军长，至2007年6月卸任。
description.en: Enlisted in 1974, serving as a soldier in the 446th Regiment, 149th Division, 13th Army of the Chengdu Military Region. Progressed through roles including Regiment Commander (1991), Deputy Division Commander (1995), and Division Commander (1999). From December 2003, served as Chief of Staff until stepping down in 2006. Subsequently, became Corps Commander in 2006, serving until June 2007.

description.zh-cn: 许林平接替王西欣出任中国人民解放军陆军第三十八集团军军长。
description.en: Xu Linping succeeded Wang Xixin as commander of the 38th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 石正露接替王西欣出任中国人民解放军北部战区参谋长。
description.en: Shi Zhenglu succeeded Wang Xixin as Chief of Staff of the PLA Northern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 王西欣接替王晓军出任中国人民解放军沈阳军区副司令员。
description.en: Wang Xixin succeeded Wang Xiaojun as Deputy Commander of the PLA Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 王西欣接替任海泉出任中国人民解放军国防大学副校长。
description.en: Wang Xixin succeeded Ren Haiquan as Vice President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 毕京京接替王西欣出任中国人民解放军国防大学副校长。
description.en: Bi Jingjing succeeded Wang Xixin as Vice President of the PLA National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 王西欣接替李少军出任中国人民解放军陆军第三十八集团军军长。
description.en: Wang Xixin succeeded Li Shaojun as commander of the 38th Group Army of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 第十三集团军（现第七十七集团军）曾隶属于成都军区。
description.en: The 13th Group Army (now the 77th Group Army) was formerly subordinate to the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 肖贵玉是湖北孝感人。
description.en: Xiao Guiyu is from Xiaogan, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 肖贵玉曾任上海市人民政府办公厅主任、党组书记，该职务于2018年2月由汤志平接任。
description.en: Xiao Guiyu served as Director and Party Group Secretary of the General Office of the Shanghai Municipal People's Government, a position taken over by Tang Zhiping in February 2018.

description.zh-cn: 肖贵玉曾兼任上海市孙中山宋庆龄文物管理委员会主任。
description.en: Xiao Guiyu concurrently served as Director of the Shanghai Sun Yat-sen and Soong Ching Ling Cultural Relics Management Committee.

description.zh-cn: 肖贵玉在卸任上海市政府办公厅主任后，转任上海市人大常委会副主任。
description.en: After leaving his position as Director of the General Office of the Shanghai Municipal Government, Xiao Guiyu was appointed Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2023年1月，肖贵玉出任中国人民政治协商会议上海市委员会副主席。
description.en: In January 2023, Xiao Guiyu was appointed Vice Chairman of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 根据其任职经历和页面分类，肖贵玉是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Based on his official career and page categorization, Xiao Guiyu is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 为报复清军虐待并杀害英法外交人员，额尔金下令英军焚烧圆明园。
description.en: In retaliation for the torture and murder of British and French envoys by Qing forces, Elgin ordered the British troops to burn the Yuanmingyuan.

description.zh-cn: 为了处理战后与西方列强的外交事务，清政府于1861年设立了总理各国事务衙门。
description.en: To handle post-war diplomatic affairs with Western powers, the Qing government established the Zongli Yamen in 1861.

description.zh-cn: 因工作出色被推选为全国劳动模范。
description.en: Selected as a National Model Worker for her outstanding work.

description.zh-cn: 作为全国劳动模范，李素文受到了毛泽东的亲自接见。
description.en: As a National Model Worker, Li Suwen was personally received by Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命中，因为劳动模范的出身，李素文被推上了政治舞台。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Li Suwen was pushed onto the political stage due to her background as a model worker.

description.zh-cn: 在文革后期，李素文受“四人帮”的利用。
description.en: In the later stages of the Cultural Revolution, Li Suwen was used by the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 李素文成为“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动的先锋。
description.en: Li Suwen became a vanguard of the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' movement.

description.zh-cn: 因在“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动中扮演先锋角色，李素文于1978年被审查，政治生涯终结。
description.en: Due to her role as a vanguard in the 'Criticize Deng, Counterattack the Right-Deviationist Reversal-of-Verdicts Trend' movement, Li Suwen was investigated in 1978, ending her political career.

description.zh-cn: 山东省人民政府是中华人民共和国国务院的业务下级机构。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial People's Government is professionally subordinate to the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 山东省人民政府是山东省人民代表大会的组织下级机构。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial People's Government is organizationally subordinate to the Shandong Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 山东省人民政府是山东省人民代表大会常务委员会的组织下级机构。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial People's Government is organizationally subordinate to the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 山东省人民政府是中华人民共和国山东省的省级地方行政机关。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial People's Government is the provincial local administrative organ of Shandong Province of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1979年12月，山东省革命委员会被撤销，复设山东省人民政府。
description.en: In December 1979, the Shandong Provincial Revolutionary Committee was abolished, and the Shandong Provincial People's Government was re-established.

description.zh-cn: 王桂英是致公党党员。
description.en: Wang Guiying is a member of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 1939年，罗荣桓与陈光率八路军115师师部和主力一部进入山东，其部队成为组建山东军区的基础。
description.en: In 1939, Luo Ronghuan and Chen Guang led the headquarters and main force of the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army into Shandong, and its troops became the foundation for establishing the Shandong Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争时期，罗荣桓是山东军区的主要组建者和领导者，担任司令员兼政治委员，直至1945年9月率主力部队进入东北。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Luo Ronghuan was the main founder and leader of the Shandong Military Region, serving as its commander and political commissar until he led the main forces into the Northeast in September 1945.

description.zh-cn: 1945年9至10月间，山东军区6个师共计6万余人，在罗荣桓率领下进入东北，成为组建东北人民自治军的核心力量。
description.en: Between September and October 1945, six divisions from the Shandong Military Region, totaling over 60,000 personnel, entered the Northeast under the leadership of Luo Ronghuan and became the core force in the formation of the Northeast People's Autonomous Army.

description.zh-cn: 抗战胜利后，黄克诚率领新四军第三师3.5万余人进入东北，与山东军区部队共同组建东北人民自治军。
description.en: After the victory of the Anti-Japanese War, Huang Kecheng led over 35,000 personnel from the 3rd Division of the New Fourth Army into the Northeast, where they co-founded the Northeast People's Autonomous Army with troops from the Shandong Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1946年1月新四军军部与山东军区合并后，兼任山东军区司令员。
description.en: After the merger of the New Fourth Army Headquarters and the Shandong Military Region in January 1946, he concurrently served as the commander of the Shandong Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1946年1月新四军军部与山东军区合并后，担任山东军区政治委员。
description.en: After the merger of the New Fourth Army Headquarters and the Shandong Military Region in January 1946, he served as the political commissar of the Shandong Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 张云逸于1947年1月鲁南战役期间担任山东军区副司令员。1949年2月军区重建后，他担任首任司令员。
description.en: Zhang Yunyi served as Deputy Commander of the Shandong Military Region during the Lunan Campaign in January 1947. After the military region was re-established in February 1949, he became its first Commander.

description.zh-cn: 1949年2月山东军区重建后，先担任副司令员，后接替张云逸担任司令员。
description.en: After the re-establishment of the Shandong Military Region in February 1949, he first served as deputy commander and later succeeded Zhang Yunyi as commander.

description.zh-cn: 1949年2月山东军区重建后，担任政治委员。
description.en: After the re-establishment of the Shandong Military Region in February 1949, he served as its political commissar.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，山东军区改编为济南军区。
description.en: In 1955, the Shandong Military Region was reorganized into the Jinan Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 罗荣桓在山东的工作对第二次国共内战的全局起到了巨大的推动作用。毛泽东曾在1962年评价道：“山东只换上一个罗荣桓，全局的棋就下活了。山东的棋下活了，全国的棋也就活了。”
description.en: Luo Ronghuan's work in Shandong had a tremendous impact on the overall situation of the second Chinese Civil War. Mao Zedong commented in 1962: 'Just by placing Luo Ronghuan in Shandong, the entire strategic game came to life. Once the game in Shandong was alive, the national game became alive as well.'

description.zh-cn: 张起翔曾任中共哈尔滨市委副书记。
description.en: Zhang Qixiang previously served as the Deputy Secretary of the Harbin Municipal Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 张起翔于2022年4月至2024年5月期间担任哈尔滨市人民政府市长。
description.en: Zhang Qixiang served as the Mayor of the Harbin Municipal People's Government from April 2022 to May 2024.

description.zh-cn: 张起翔自2024年5月起出任黑龙江省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Zhang Qixiang has been serving as the Vice Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government since May 2024.

description.zh-cn: 张起翔接替孙喆出任哈尔滨市人民政府市长。
description.en: Zhang Qixiang succeeded Sun Zhe as the Mayor of the Harbin Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 王合生接替张起翔出任哈尔滨市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wang Hesheng succeeded Zhang Qixiang as the Mayor of the Harbin Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 张起翔是东北林业大学的校友。
description.en: Zhang Qixiang is an alumnus of Northeast Forestry University.

description.zh-cn: 张起翔是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhang Qixiang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据2018年国务院机构改革方案，国家中医药管理局由新组建的国家卫生健康委员会管理。
description.en: According to the 2018 State Council institutional reform plan, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine is managed by the newly established National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 国家中医药管理局是中华人民共和国国务院下属的国家局。
description.en: The National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a state administration under the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1986年，国务院决定创立国家中医药管理局。
description.en: In 1986, the State Council decided to establish the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 1988年起，国家中医药管理局由卫生部归口管理。此关系持续至2013年卫生部改组为止。
description.en: Since 1988, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine was placed under the management of the Ministry of Health. This relationship continued until the ministry's reorganization in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 该方案规定组建国家卫生健康委员会。
description.en: The plan stipulated the formation of the National Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 该方案规定不再保留国家卫生和计划生育委员会。
description.en: The plan stipulated the dissolution of the National Health and Family Planning Commission.

description.zh-cn: 该方案规定不再设立国务院深化医药卫生体制改革领导小组办公室。
description.en: The plan stipulated the abolition of the Office of the State Council Leading Group for Deepening Medical and Health System Reform.

description.zh-cn: 发布“清肺排毒汤”处方，作为应对2019冠状病毒病的治疗措施。
description.en: Published the formula for 'Qingfei Paidu Tang' as a treatment measure for COVID-19.

description.zh-cn: 中国中医科学院是国家中医药管理局的直属事业单位。
description.en: The China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences is a directly affiliated public institution of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 中国中医科学院西苑医院是国家中医药管理局管理的医院。
description.en: Xiyuan Hospital of China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences is a hospital managed by the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 中国中医科学院广安门医院是国家中医药管理局管理的医院。
description.en: Guang'anmen Hospital of China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences is a hospital managed by the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 北京中医药大学东方医院是国家中医药管理局管理的医院。
