description.en: Dongfang Hospital, Beijing University of Chinese Medicine is a hospital managed by the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 西藏自治区外事侨务办公室是西藏自治区人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Foreign and Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the Tibet Autonomous Region is a component department of the People's Government of the Tibet Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 1952年9月6日，中华人民共和国中央人民政府在拉萨成立了西藏自治区外事侨务办公室的前身“中央人民政府驻西藏代表外事帮办办公室”。
description.en: On September 6, 1952, the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China established the predecessor of the office, the 'Office of the Foreign Affairs Assistant Commissioner of the CPG Representative in Tibet', in Lhasa.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府驻西藏代表外事帮办办公室在中央人民政府外交部的领导下办理西藏的一切涉外事宜。
description.en: The Office of the Foreign Affairs Assistant Commissioner of the CPG Representative in Tibet handled all foreign affairs of Tibet under the leadership of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 杨公素于1952年9月任中央人民政府驻西藏代表外事帮办办公室帮办，1956年4月任西藏外事处处长，直至1963年初调离。
description.en: Yang Gongsu served as the Assistant Commissioner of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Assistant Commissioner of the CPG Representative in Tibet from September 1952, and became Director of the Tibet Foreign Affairs Office in April 1956, until his transfer in early 1963.

description.zh-cn: 第十四世达赖喇嘛将他的姐夫达拉·平措扎西派到外事帮办办公室工作。
description.en: The 14th Dalai Lama sent his brother-in-law, Tala Phuntsok Tashi, to work at the Office of the Foreign Affairs Assistant Commissioner.

description.zh-cn: 第十四世达赖喇嘛将他的姐夫达拉·平措扎西派到外事帮办办公室工作，以表明他对外事工作的重视。
description.en: The 14th Dalai Lama sent his brother-in-law, Tala Phuntsok Tashi, to work at the Office of the Foreign Affairs Assistant Commissioner to show the importance he attached to foreign affairs.

description.zh-cn: 《十七条协议》第十四条规定由中央人民政府统一处理西藏地区的一切涉外事宜，结束了噶厦直接与外国交往的状况。
description.en: Article 14 of the Seventeen Point Agreement stipulated that the Central People's Government would handle all external affairs of the Tibet region, ending the situation where the Kashag directly engaged with foreign countries.

description.zh-cn: 1956年4月西藏自治区筹备委员会成立后，外事帮办办公室改为西藏外事处，编制上成为其下属单位。
description.en: After the Preparatory Committee for the Tibet Autonomous Region was established in April 1956, the Office of the Foreign Affairs Assistant Commissioner was renamed the Tibet Foreign Affairs Office and became its subordinate unit.

description.zh-cn: 西藏自治区筹备委员会成立后，达赖喇嘛任主任，杨公素成为达赖的下属。
description.en: After the establishment of the Preparatory Committee for the Tibet Autonomous Region, the Dalai Lama served as its director, and Yang Gongsu became his subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 两人为圣三一堂幼稚园1956年同届毕业生。
description.en: They were classmates in the 1956 graduating class of Holy Trinity Church Kindergarten.

description.zh-cn: 施南生早年在九龙太子道成长。
description.en: Nansun Shi grew up on Prince Edward Road in Kowloon during her early years.

description.zh-cn: 因郑经翰封咪风波，施南生接替其主持《风波里的茶杯》节目。
description.en: Following a controversy involving Albert Cheng, Nansun Shi took over his role as the host of 'Teacup in a Storm'.

description.zh-cn: 多尔衮是努尔哈赤的第十四子。
description.en: Dorgon was the fourteenth son of Nurhaci.

description.zh-cn: 多尔衮是努尔哈赤大妃阿巴亥的儿子。
description.en: Dorgon was the son of Nurhaci's primary consort, Abahai.

description.zh-cn: 多尔衮是皇太极的异母弟。
description.en: Dorgon was the younger half-brother of Hong Taiji.

description.zh-cn: 多尔衮是阿济格的同母弟。
description.en: Dorgon was the younger full brother of Ajige.

description.zh-cn: 多尔衮是多铎的同母兄。
description.en: Dorgon was the older full brother of Dodo.

description.zh-cn: 多尔博是多铎之子，过继给多尔衮为嗣子。
description.en: Dorbo was the son of Dodo, adopted by Dorgon as his heir.

description.zh-cn: 敬孝义皇后是多尔衮的嫡福晋。
description.en: Empress Jingxiaoyi was Dorgon's primary consort.

description.zh-cn: 皇太极继位被认为是取代了努尔哈赤原意传位的多尔衮，多尔衮摄政时也宣称皇太极“即位原系夺立”，二人存在皇位继承上的矛盾。
description.en: Hong Taiji's succession was seen as supplanting Dorgon, who was allegedly Nurhaci's intended heir. Dorgon himself later claimed that Hong Taiji's enthronement was a usurpation, indicating a conflict over the succession.

description.zh-cn: 在皇太极死后的皇位争夺中，多尔衮阻止了豪格继位，并在之后迫害豪格致死。
description.en: In the struggle for the throne after Hong Taiji's death, Dorgon prevented Hooge from succeeding and later persecuted him to death.

description.zh-cn: 与济尔哈朗共同辅政，辅佐年幼的顺治帝。
description.en: Served as co-regent with Jirgalang, assisting the young Shunzhi Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 作为摄政王，多尔衮是清军入关、入主中原的最高决策者和领导者，对奠定清朝统治起了关键作用。
description.en: As Prince Regent, Dorgon was the supreme decision-maker and leader of the Qing forces' entry into and conquest of central China, playing a critical role in establishing Qing rule.

description.zh-cn: 在丙子战争中，多尔衮奉皇太极之命追击朝鲜王室，迫使朝鲜投降。
description.en: During the Qing invasion of Joseon, Dorgon, under Hong Taiji's orders, pursued the Joseon royal family, forcing their surrender.

description.zh-cn: 作为清军指挥官，率部追击并接受了朝鲜仁祖的投降。
description.en: As a Qing commander, he led the pursuit and accepted the surrender of King Injo of Joseon.

description.zh-cn: 在崇德三年的南征中，多尔衮率领的左翼军击杀了明朝总兵卢象升。
description.en: During the southern expedition in 1638, the left-wing army led by Dorgon defeated and killed the Ming general Lu Xiansheng.

description.zh-cn: 多尔衮是松锦之战中清军的初期主要指挥官之一。
description.en: Dorgon was one of the initial primary commanders of the Qing forces in the Battle of Songjin.

description.zh-cn: 松锦之战后，总兵祖大寿举锦州城投降。
description.en: After the Battle of Songjin, General Zu Dashou surrendered the city of Jinzhou.

description.zh-cn: 作为清初实际最高统治者，推行了剃发易服、圈地、投充、逃人法等一系列政策，后世合称为“清初六大弊政”。
description.en: As the de facto ruler of the early Qing, he implemented a series of policies including the queue order, land enclosure, forced servitude, and fugitive slave laws, later collectively known as the 'Six Major Detrimental Policies of the Early Qing'.

description.zh-cn: 在多尔衮死后两个月，顺治帝宣布其罪状，剥夺其所有封号，并下令掘墓毁尸。
description.en: Two months after Dorgon's death, the Shunzhi Emperor stripped him of all his titles, announced his crimes, and ordered his tomb to be exhumed and his corpse mutilated.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆四十三年，乾隆帝下诏为多尔衮平反，恢复其睿亲王封号，并追谥为“忠”。
description.en: In 1778, the Qianlong Emperor officially rehabilitated Dorgon, restoring his title of Prince Rui and granting him the posthumous name 'Zhong' (Loyal).

description.zh-cn: 《日本国宪法》第八章规定设立最高裁判所作为日本的最高司法机关。
description.en: Chapter VIII of the Constitution of Japan provides for the establishment of the Supreme Court as the highest judicial body of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 《裁判所法》规定了最高裁判所的具体组织和运行方式。
description.en: The Court Act specifies the detailed organization and operation of the Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 随着《日本国宪法》与《裁判所法》的施行，废除了大审院。
description.en: With the enforcement of the Constitution of Japan and the Court Act, the Supreme Court of Judicature was abolished.

position.en: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court

description.zh-cn: 今崎幸彦是现任最高裁判所长官。
description.en: Yukihiko Imasaki is the current Chief Justice of the Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 最高裁判所判事由内阁任命。
description.en: Justices of the Supreme Court are appointed by the Cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 天皇对内阁任命的最高裁判所判事进行确认。
description.en: The Emperor attests the appointment of Justices of the Supreme Court by the Cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 最高裁判所判事（包括长官）在任命后需要接受国民审查，此后每十年审查一次。
description.en: Justices of the Supreme Court (including the Chief Justice) are subject to a national review after their appointment and every ten years thereafter.

description.zh-cn: 大谷直人毕业于东京大学法学部。
description.en: Naoto Otani graduated from the Faculty of Law at the University of Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 张正德在第二次国共内战期间担任热河省乌丹县县长。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde served as the magistrate of Wudan County, Rehe Province, during the Second Chinese Civil War.

position.zh-cn: 热河省民政厅厅长；热河省政府副主席兼副省长
position.en: Director of the Civil Affairs Department of Rehe Province; Vice Chairman and Vice Governor of Rehe Provincial Government

description.zh-cn: 张正德在第二次国共内战期间担任热河省民政厅厅长。中华人民共和国成立后，他历任热河省政府副主席兼副省长。
description.en: Zhang Zhengde served as Director of the Civil Affairs Department of Rehe Province during the Second Chinese Civil War. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, he later served as Vice Chairman and Vice Governor of the Rehe Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中国国民党革命委员会浙江省委员会的上级机构是中国国民党革命委员会中央委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior body of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang is the Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党革命委员会浙江省委员会是中国国民党革命委员会在浙江省的地方组织。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang is the local organization of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang in Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中国国民党革命委员会浙江省委员会的机构类型属于民主党派。
description.en: According to the infobox, the institutional type of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang is a democratic party.

description.zh-cn: 1933年与萧红同居，1938年在西安分手。
description.en: Lived together with Xiao Hong from 1933 and broke up in Xi'an in 1938.

description.zh-cn: 1929年考入东北陆军讲武堂第九期，后被开除。
description.en: Enrolled in the ninth class of the Northeast Military Academy in 1929, but was later expelled.

description.zh-cn: 东北陆军讲武堂由张作霖在沈阳主办。
description.en: The Northeast Military Academy was founded and hosted by Zhang Zuolin in Shenyang.

description.zh-cn: 1934年11月到上海后，得到鲁迅亲自指导，可视为师徒关系。
description.en: After arriving in Shanghai in November 1934, he received personal guidance from Lu Xun, which can be considered a mentor-student relationship.

description.zh-cn: 由于和民族革命大学校长阎锡山的矛盾，萧军离职。
description.en: Xiao Jun resigned due to conflicts with Yan Xishan, the president of the National Revolution University.

description.zh-cn: 1938年前往西安途中经过延安时，受到毛泽东接见。
description.en: Was received by Mao Zedong in 1938 while passing through Yan'an on his way to Xi'an.

description.zh-cn: 1938年前往西安途中经过延安时，受到周恩来接见。
description.en: Was received by Zhou Enlai in 1938 while passing through Yan'an on his way to Xi'an.

description.zh-cn: 因萧军赞成周扬主张的国防文学，而遭到鲁迅的批评。
description.en: Xiao Jun was criticized by Lu Xun for his support of the National Defense Literature advocated by Zhou Yang.

description.zh-cn: 九一八事变爆发后，萧军参与组织抗日义勇军。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, Xiao Jun participated in organizing the Anti-Japanese Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 与萧红合著了小说、散文合集《跋涉》。
description.en: Co-authored the collection of short stories and essays 'Bumping' with Xiao Hong.

description.zh-cn: 萧军赞成周扬等左翼作家主张的国防文学。
description.en: Xiao Jun supported the National Defense Literature advocated by left-wing writers like Zhou Yang.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁迅逝世六周年纪念大会上，萧军为王实味说话。
description.en: At the meeting commemorating the sixth anniversary of Lu Xun's death, Xiao Jun spoke up for Wang Shiwei.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅对周扬等人提出的“国防文学”口号持批评态度。
description.en: Lu Xun was critical of the 'National Defense Literature' slogan proposed by Zhou Yang and others.

description.zh-cn: 萧军在文化大革命中受到了迫害。
description.en: Xiao Jun was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于1942年12月21日出生于江苏省泰县（现泰州市）。
description.en: Hu Jintao was born in Tai County (now Taizhou), Jiangsu province, on 21 December 1942.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于1964年毕业于清华大学水利工程系。
description.en: Hu Jintao graduated from the Water Conservancy Engineering Department at Tsinghua University in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于1964年4月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Hu Jintao joined the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) in April 1964.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于2002年至2012年担任中国共产党中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Hu Jintao served as General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party from 2002 to 2012.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于2004年至2012年担任中共中央军事委员会主席，并于2005年至2013年担任国家中央军事委员会主席。
description.en: Hu Jintao served as Chairman of the CCP Central Military Commission from 2004 to 2012, and as Chairman of the State Central Military Commission from 2005 to 2013.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛于1998年至2003年担任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Hu Jintao served as Vice President of the People's Republic of China from 1998 to 2003.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛被认为是2002年至2012年期间中国的最高领导人。
description.en: Hu Jintao was considered the paramount leader of China from 2002 to 2012.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛被认为是江泽民的指定接班人。
description.en: Hu Jintao was considered the heir apparent to Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，胡锦涛的父亲遭到批斗，这一事件对胡锦涛产生了深刻影响。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Hu Jintao's father was denounced, an event that had a deep effect upon Hu.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十大闭幕会上，胡锦涛被工作人员从座位上带离会场，未能参加后续的投票。
description.en: At the closing ceremony of the 20th CCP National Congress, Hu Jintao was escorted out of the hall from his seat and was absent from the subsequent votes.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛执政初期，面临持亲独立场的时任台湾总统陈水扁，双方关系紧张，胡锦涛政府对其采取了不接触政策并通过了《反分裂国家法》。
description.en: Early in his leadership, Hu Jintao faced the pro-independence ROC president Chen Shui-bian. Relations were tense, and Hu's government adopted a no-contact policy and passed the Anti-Secession Law.

description.zh-cn: 马英九于2008年当选台湾总统后，胡锦涛采取了更为柔和的外交策略，开启了两岸关系的解冻，并最终签署了《海峡两岸经济合作框架协议》。
description.en: After Ma Ying-jeou won the presidency in Taiwan in 2008, Hu Jintao turned to a more 'soft' diplomatic approach, opening the way to a thaw in relations and eventually signing the Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA).

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛与温家宝共同领导了“胡温体制”时期的中国政府，胡锦涛担任国家主席，温家宝担任国务院总理。
description.en: Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao co-led the Chinese government during the 'Hu-Wen Administration', with Hu as President and Wen as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛的任期内，两岸关系缓和，最终促成了2010年《海峡两岸经济合作框架协议》的签署。
description.en: During Hu Jintao's tenure, relations between the two sides of the strait became more cordial, culminating in the signing of the Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 马公将女儿马氏交托郭子兴抚养，马氏认郭子兴为义父。
description.en: Ma Gong entrusted his daughter, the future Empress Ma, to the care of Guo Zixing, and she regarded him as her adoptive father.

description.zh-cn: 郭子兴与马公是莫逆之交。
description.en: Guo Zixing and Ma Gong were very close friends.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋于洪武元年正月初四登基当日，册封结发之妻马氏为皇后。
description.en: On the day of his accession, the fourth day of the first month of the first year of Hongwu (January 23, 1368), Zhu Yuanzhang created his wife, Lady Ma, as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 孝慈高皇后马氏于洪武十五年九月葬于孝陵。
description.en: Empress Ma was buried in the Ming Xiaoling Mausoleum in the ninth month of the 15th year of the Hongwu era (September 1382).

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京太常寺志》等记载，其生母为李淑妃，而非马皇后。
description.en: According to records such as the 'Nanjing Taichang Si Zhi', his birth mother was Consort Li, not Empress Ma.

description.zh-cn: 作为台湾民众党中央委员，蔡壁如在党内职位上低于党主席黄国昌。
description.en: As a Central Committee Member of the Taiwan People's Party, Tsai Pi-ru is subordinate to the party chairman Huang Kuo-chang.

description.zh-cn: 蔡壁如于2024年2月至12月期间担任台中市政府有给职顾问。
description.en: Tsai Pi-ru served as a paid consultant for the Taichung City Government from February to December 2024.

position.en: Consultant, Director of the Mayor's Office

description.zh-cn: 蔡壁如曾在柯文哲担任台北市长期间，任市府顾问及市长办公室主任。
description.en: Tsai Pi-ru served as a consultant and Director of the Mayor's Office in the Taipei City Government during Ko Wen-je's tenure as mayor.

description.zh-cn: 蔡壁如毕业于美和护理专科学校（现美和科技大学）护理助产科。
description.en: Tsai Pi-ru graduated from the Department of Nursing and Midwifery at Meiho Junior College of Nursing (now Meiho University).

description.zh-cn: 蔡壁如在2020年立法委员选举中，作为台湾民众党不分区名单成员成功当选。
description.en: In the 2020 legislative election, Tsai Pi-ru was successfully elected as a legislator from the Taiwan People's Party's party-list.

description.zh-cn: 蔡壁如在台中市第一选举区的参选是蓝白合作的一个实例。
description.en: Tsai Pi-ru's candidacy in Taichung's 1st constituency was an instance of Blue-White cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 蔡壁如在2024年立法委员选举中竞选台中市第一选举区席位失利。
description.en: Tsai Pi-ru was unsuccessful in her bid for the Taichung City 1st constituency seat in the 2024 legislative election.

description.zh-cn: 时任台南市长黄伟哲反驳了蔡壁如关于台南黄金海岸名称来源的说法。
description.en: Then-Tainan Mayor Huang Wei-cher refuted Tsai Pi-ru's claims about the origin of the name of Tainan's Golden Coast.

description.zh-cn: 金日成是金万日的父亲。
description.en: Kim Il-sung was Kim Man-il's father.

description.zh-cn: 金正淑是金万日的母亲。
description.en: Kim Jong-suk was Kim Man-il's mother.

description.zh-cn: 金正日是金万日的兄长。
description.en: Kim Jong-il was Kim Man-il's older brother.

description.zh-cn: 金庆喜是金万日的妹妹。
description.en: Kim Kyong-hui was Kim Man-il's younger sister.

description.zh-cn: 金万日于1944年出生于苏联哈巴罗夫斯克的维亚茨科耶村。
description.en: Kim Man-il was born in 1944 in the village of Vyatskoye, Khabarovsk, Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 国家新闻出版广电总局是中华人民共和国国务院的直属机构。
description.en: The State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television was a directly affiliated agency of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家新闻出版广电总局接受中共中央宣传部的业务领导。
description.en: The State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television was under the professional leadership of the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 国家新闻出版广电总局成立后，原国家新闻出版总署不再保留。
description.en: After the establishment of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, the former General Administration of Press and Publication was dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 国家新闻出版广电总局成立后，原国家广播电影电视总局不再保留。
description.en: After the establishment of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, the former State Administration of Radio, Film, and Television was dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过《国务院机构改革方案》，决定撤销国家新闻出版广电总局。
description.en: The session passed the 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan', deciding to dissolve the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 该方案将原国家新闻出版广电总局的职责拆分并划归至新机构，标志着其正式终结。
description.en: This plan split the responsibilities of the former State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television and reassigned them to new institutions, marking its official end.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过《国务院机构改革方案》，决定在国家新闻出版广电总局广播电视管理职责的基础上组建国家广播电视总局。
description.en: The session passed the 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan', deciding to form the National Radio and Television Administration based on the radio and television management responsibilities of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 该方案决定将新闻出版管理职责划归中宣部，并由其加挂国家新闻出版署牌子。
description.en: This plan decided to transfer press and publication management responsibilities to the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee, which would also carry the nameplate of the National Press and Publication Administration.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 该方案决定将电影管理职责划归中宣部，并由其加挂国家电影局牌子。
description.en: This plan decided to transfer film management responsibilities to the Propaganda Department of the CCP Central Committee, which would also carry the nameplate of the China Film Administration.

description.zh-cn: 机构改革后，国家新闻出版署加挂国家版权局牌子。
description.en: After the institutional reform, the National Press and Publication Administration also carries the nameplate of the National Copyright Administration.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民广播电台由国家新闻出版广电总局领导。
description.en: China National Radio was led by the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

description.zh-cn: 中国国际广播电台由国家新闻出版广电总局领导。
description.en: China Radio International was led by the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台由国家新闻出版广电总局领导。
description.en: China Central Television was led by the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

description.zh-cn: 蔡赴朝担任国家新闻出版广电总局首任局长，兼任国家版权局局长。
description.en: Cai Fuchao served as the first Director of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, and concurrently as Director of the National Copyright Administration.

description.zh-cn: 聂辰席接替蔡赴朝担任国家新闻出版广电总局局长，兼任国家版权局局长。
description.en: Nie Chenxi succeeded Cai Fuchao as Director of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, and concurrently as Director of the National Copyright Administration.

description.zh-cn: 蒋建国担任国家新闻出版广电总局副局长。
description.en: Jiang Jianguo served as Deputy Director of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

description.zh-cn: 田进担任国家新闻出版广电总局副局长、党组成员。
description.en: Tian Jin served as Deputy Director and a member of the Party Group of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television.

description.zh-cn: 慎海雄在国家新闻出版广电总局被撤销前夕短暂担任副局长。
description.en: Shen Haixiong briefly served as Deputy Director of the State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television shortly before its dissolution.

description.zh-cn: 深化国防和军队改革中，原有的七大军区被重组并改制为五大战区，以配合“军委管总、战区主战、军种主建”的主轴思想。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the original seven military regions were reorganized into five theater commands to align with the core principle of 'the CMC manages overall, theater commands focus on combat, and services are responsible for development'.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委联合作战指挥中心是中央军事委员会的战略指挥机关。
description.en: The Joint Operations Command Center of the CMC is a strategic command organ of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 各战区在中央军委联合作战指挥中心的战略全局统领下拥有具体战略和战役的指挥权。
description.en: Each theater command has command authority over specific strategies and campaigns under the overall strategic direction of the CMC Joint Operations Command Center.

description.zh-cn: 各战区在中央军委联合作战指挥中心的战略全局统领下拥有具体战略和战役的指挥权。
description.en: Each theater command has command authority over specific strategies and campaigns under the overall strategic direction of the CMC Joint Operations Command Center.

description.zh-cn: 各战区在中央军委联合作战指挥中心的战略全局统领下拥有具体战略和战役的指挥权。
description.en: Each theater command has command authority over specific strategies and campaigns under the overall strategic direction of the CMC Joint Operations Command Center.

description.zh-cn: 各战区在中央军委联合作战指挥中心的战略全局统领下拥有具体战略和战役的指挥权。
description.en: Each theater command has command authority over specific strategies and campaigns under the overall strategic direction of the CMC Joint Operations Command Center.

description.zh-cn: 各战区在中央军委联合作战指挥中心的战略全局统领下拥有具体战略和战役的指挥权。
description.en: Each theater command has command authority over specific strategies and campaigns under the overall strategic direction of the CMC Joint Operations Command Center.

description.zh-cn: 晋冀鲁豫野战军（刘邓大军）于1947年6月30日发起鲁西南战役。
description.en: The Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Field Army (Liu-Deng Army) launched the Southwestern Shandong Campaign on June 30, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 鲁西南战役的胜利，标志着中国人民解放军由战略防御转入战略进攻，改变了国共内战的战略态势。
description.en: The victory in the Southwestern Shandong Campaign marked the PLA's transition from strategic defense to strategic offense, changing the strategic situation of the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 鲁西南战役的胜利为刘邓大军挺进中原，实施“千里跃进大别山”的战略行动打开了突破口。
description.en: The victory of the Southwestern Shandong Campaign opened a breakthrough for the Liu-Deng Army to advance into the Central Plains and implement the strategic action of 'a thousand-li leap to the Dabie Mountains'.

description.zh-cn: 在孟良崮战役中，华东野战军全歼国民革命军整编第七十四师。
description.en: During the Menglianggu Campaign, the East China Field Army completely annihilated the National Revolutionary Army's Reorganized 74th Division.

description.zh-cn: 孟良崮战役的胜利，使中共中央军委认为战略反攻时机已到，从而筹划了鲁西南战役及后续的千里跃进大别山行动。
description.en: The victory of the Menglianggu Campaign led the CCP Central Military Commission to believe that the time for a strategic counter-offensive had come, thus planning the Southwestern Shandong Campaign and the subsequent 'thousand-li leap to the Dabie Mountains' operation.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石制定并推行了对中共山东和陕北解放区的“重点进攻”战略。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek formulated and implemented the 'keypoint offense' strategy against the CCP's liberated areas in Shandong and Northern Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 鲁西南战役的胜利从根本上打乱了国军的重点进攻战略部署，粉碎了其计划。
description.en: The victory in the Southwestern Shandong Campaign fundamentally disrupted the strategic deployment of the Nationalist army's 'keypoint offense' and shattered its plan.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁西南战役第二阶段的六营集战斗中，晋冀鲁豫野战军全歼国民革命军整编第七十师。
description.en: In the Battle of Liuyingji during the second phase of the Southwestern Shandong Campaign, the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Field Army completely annihilated the National Revolutionary Army's Reorganized 70th Division.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁西南战役第三阶段的羊山集战斗中，晋冀鲁豫野战军全歼国民革命军精锐部队整编第六十六师。
description.en: In the Battle of Yangshanji during the third phase of the Southwestern Shandong Campaign, the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu Field Army completely annihilated the elite National Revolutionary Army's Reorganized 66th Division.

description.zh-cn: 顾祝同指派王敬久担任增援鲁西南的国民党军兵团司令。
description.en: Gu Zhutong appointed Wang Jingjiu as the commander of the KMT army corps to reinforce Southwestern Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 王敬久作为前线兵团司令，接受陆军总司令顾祝同的指挥。
description.en: As the frontline corps commander, Wang Jingjiu was under the command of the Army Commander-in-Chief, Gu Zhutong.

description.zh-cn: 鲁西南战役失败后，国民党军兵团司令王敬久被撤职查办。
description.en: After the defeat in the Southwestern Shandong Campaign, KMT corps commander Wang Jingjiu was dismissed and investigated.

description.zh-cn: 鲁西南战役后，国民党军将领王仲廉被撤职查办。
description.en: After the Southwestern Shandong Campaign, KMT general Wang Zhonglian was dismissed and investigated.

description.zh-cn: 在羊山集战斗的关键时刻，刘伯承当面命令纵队司令员陈再道调整部署，坚决歼敌。
description.en: At a critical moment in the Battle of Yangshanji, Liu Bocheng personally ordered column commander Chen Zaidao to adjust deployments and resolutely annihilate the enemy.

description.zh-cn: 在羊山集战斗的关键时刻，刘伯承当面命令纵队司令员陈锡联调整部署，坚决歼敌。
description.en: At a critical moment in the Battle of Yangshanji, Liu Bocheng personally ordered column commander Chen Xilian to adjust deployments and resolutely annihilate the enemy.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社是中国国民党内部的一个组织。
description.en: The Revival Society of the Chinese Nation was an organization within the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正亲自担任中华民族复兴社社长。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek personally served as the president of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社推行对领袖蒋中正的个人崇拜。
description.en: The Revival Society of the Chinese Nation promoted a personality cult around its leader Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 1929年的中东路事件发生后，民族主义在中国青年学生中加速传播，促使中国国民党决定成立复兴社以组织和引导青年。
description.en: After the Sino-Soviet conflict of 1929, nationalism spread rapidly among Chinese youth, prompting the Kuomintang to decide to establish the Revival Society to organize and guide them.

description.zh-cn: 1931年的九一八事变发生后，民族主义在中国青年学生中加速传播，促使中国国民党决定成立复兴社以组织和引导青年。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident in 1931, nationalism spread rapidly among Chinese youth, prompting the Kuomintang to decide to establish the Revival Society to organize and guide them.

position.zh-cn: 干事会成员、政训系统负责人
position.en: Board Member, Head of the Political Training System

description.zh-cn: 贺衷寒是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一），并负责其政训系统。
description.en: He Zhonghan was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao") and was in charge of its political training system.

description.zh-cn: 桂永清是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一）。
description.en: Gui Yongqing was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao").

description.zh-cn: 萧赞育是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一）。
description.en: Xiao Zanyu was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao").

description.zh-cn: 滕杰是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一）。
description.en: Teng Jie was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao").

position.zh-cn: 干事会成员、别动总队负责人
position.en: Board Member, Head of the Special Action Main Squad

description.zh-cn: 康泽是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一），并负责其行动组织“别动总队”。
description.en: Kang Ze was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao") and was in charge of its action organization, the "Special Action Main Squad."

position.zh-cn: 干事会成员、特务培训班负责人、特务处负责人
position.en: Board Member, Head of Secret Agent Training Classes, Head of the Secret Service Department

description.zh-cn: 戴笠是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一），负责特务培训班和特务处。
description.en: Dai Li was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao"), responsible for the secret agent training classes and the Secret Service Department.

position.zh-cn: 干事会成员、特务培训班负责人
position.en: Board Member, Head of Secret Agent Training Classes

description.zh-cn: 郑介民是复兴社干事会主要成员（“十三太保”之一），并与戴笠共同负责特务培训班。
description.en: Zheng Jiemin was a main member of the Revival Society's board of directors (one of the "Thirteen Taibao") and was jointly responsible for the secret agent training classes with Dai Li.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社的核心人物多毕业于黄埔军校，贺衷寒是其核心成员之一。
description.en: The core figures of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation were mostly graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, and He Zhonghan was one of its core members.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社的核心人物多毕业于黄埔军校，桂永清是其核心成员之一。
description.en: The core figures of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation were mostly graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, and Gui Yongqing was one of its core members.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社的核心人物多毕业于黄埔军校，萧赞育是其核心成员之一。
description.en: The core figures of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation were mostly graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, and Xiao Zanyu was one of its core members.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社的核心人物多毕业于黄埔军校，滕杰是其核心成员之一。
description.en: The core figures of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation were mostly graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, and Teng Jie was one of its core members.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社的核心人物多毕业于黄埔军校，戴笠是其核心成员之一。
description.en: The core figures of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation were mostly graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, and Dai Li was one of its core members.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社的核心人物多毕业于黄埔军校，郑介民是其核心成员之一。
description.en: The core figures of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation were mostly graduates of the Whampoa Military Academy, and Zheng Jiemin was one of its core members.

description.zh-cn: 1932年，复兴社的核心成员贺衷寒等人建立了内部组织三民主义力行社。
description.en: In 1932, core members of the Revival Society, including He Zhonghan, established the internal organization Three Principles of the People Vigorous Practice Society.

description.zh-cn: 三民主义力行社是中华民族复兴社的内部组织。
description.en: The Three Principles of the People Vigorous Practice Society was an internal organization of the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation.

description.zh-cn: 中华民族复兴社出版了《中国革命》杂志。
description.en: The Revival Society of the Chinese Nation published the magazine 'Chinese Revolution'.

description.zh-cn: 复兴社成立后不久，便与CC派发生矛盾。
description.en: Shortly after its establishment, the Revival Society came into conflict with the CC Clique.

description.zh-cn: 由于与CC派的矛盾，复兴社被迫退出文化教育领域。
description.en: Due to conflicts with the CC Clique, the Revival Society was forced to withdraw from the cultural and educational fields.

description.zh-cn: 1938年，中华民族复兴社宣布解散，其成员大部加入新成立的三民主义青年团。
description.en: In 1938, the Revival Society of the Chinese Nation announced its dissolution, and the majority of its members joined the newly established Three Principles of the People Youth Corps.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇是李鹏的次子。
description.en: Li Xiaoyong is the second son of Li Peng.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇是朱琳的儿子。
description.en: Li Xiaoyong is the son of Zhu Lin.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇是李小鹏的弟弟。
description.en: Li Xiaoyong is the younger brother of Li Xiaopeng.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇是李小琳的弟弟。
description.en: Li Xiaoyong is the younger brother of Li Xiaolin.

description.zh-cn: 叶小燕是叶挺将军的孙女。
description.en: Ye Xiaoyan is the granddaughter of General Ye Ting.

description.zh-cn: 叶小燕是叶正明的女儿。
description.en: Ye Xiaoyan is the daughter of Ye Zhengming.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇于1963年9月6日出生于沈阳市中国医科大学第四医院。
description.en: Li Xiaoyong was born on September 6, 1963, at The Fourth Affiliated Hospital of China Medical University in Shenyang.

description.zh-cn: 李小勇曾拥有上校军衔。
description.en: Li Xiaoyong once held the rank of Colonel.

description.zh-cn: 因卷入新国大诈骗案，李小勇全家投资移民新加坡，后归化为新加坡公民。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the New Guoda fraud case, Li Xiaoyong's entire family immigrated to Singapore as investors and he later became a naturalized Singaporean citizen.

description.zh-cn: 金日成在苏联的支持下建立了朝鲜民主主义人民共和国。
description.en: Kim Il-sung founded the Democratic People's Republic of Korea with the support of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 金日成是朝鲜人民军的主要建立者之一。
description.en: Kim Il-sung was one of the main founders of the Korean People's Army.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东同意了金日成的战争计划，并在战局不利时派遣中国人民志愿军支援朝鲜。
description.en: Mao Zedong agreed to Kim Il-sung's war plan and sent the Chinese People's Volunteer Army to support North Korea when the war situation turned unfavorable.

description.zh-cn: 在中国同意出兵援朝后，中国人民志愿军入朝参战，与朝鲜人民军组成联军对抗联合国军。
description.en: After China agreed to send troops to aid North Korea, the Chinese People's Volunteer Army entered the war and formed a joint force with the Korean People's Army to fight against the UN forces.

description.zh-cn: 金日成清洗了以金斗奉为代表的亲华派（延安派）力量。
description.en: Kim Il-sung purged the pro-China (Yan'an) faction represented by Kim Tu-bong.

description.zh-cn: 金日成于1931年至1945年间为中国共产党党员。
description.en: Kim Il-sung was a member of the Chinese Communist Party from 1931 to 1945.

position.zh-cn: 师长、方面军指挥、支队长
position.en: Division Commander, Front Commander, Detachment Leader

description.zh-cn: 金日成在东北抗日联军中历任多个指挥职务，领导抗日游击战。
description.en: Kim Il-sung held several command positions in the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, leading anti-Japanese guerrilla warfare.

description.zh-cn: 金正日是金日成与金正淑的长子。
description.en: Kim Jong-il is the eldest son of Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-suk.

description.zh-cn: 金圣爱是金日成的第三任妻子。
description.en: Kim Song-ae was Kim Il-sung's third wife.

description.zh-cn: 金正淑是金日成的第二任妻子。
description.en: Kim Jong-suk was Kim Il-sung's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐担任法兰西第五共和国的第一任总统。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle served as the first President of the French Fifth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在夏尔·戴高乐担任总统期间，米歇尔·德勃雷是其任命的总理。
description.en: Michel Debré was the appointed Prime Minister during Charles de Gaulle's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在夏尔·戴高乐担任总统期间，乔治·蓬皮杜是其任命的总理。
description.en: Georges Pompidou was the appointed Prime Minister during Charles de Gaulle's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在夏尔·戴高乐担任总统期间，莫里斯·顾夫·德姆维尔是其任命的总理。
description.en: Maurice Couve de Murville was the appointed Prime Minister during Charles de Gaulle's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐接替勒内·科蒂成为法国总统。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle succeeded René Coty as President of France.

description.zh-cn: 乔治·蓬皮杜在夏尔·戴高乐辞职后接任法国总统。
description.en: Georges Pompidou succeeded Charles de Gaulle as President of France after his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐担任法兰西第四共和国最后一任总理。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle served as the last Prime Minister of the French Fourth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 在勒内·科蒂担任总统期间，夏尔·戴高乐是其任命的总理。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle was the appointed Prime Minister during René Coty's presidency.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐接替皮埃尔·弗林姆兰成为法国总理。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle succeeded Pierre Pflimlin as Prime Minister of France.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐是自由法国运动的领导人。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle was the leader of the Free French movement.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐担任法兰西共和国临时政府主席。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle served as the President of the Provisional Government of the French Republic.

description.zh-cn: 由于以法国共产党为首的左派反对他加强总统权力的宪法，夏尔·戴高乐被迫辞去临时政府总理职务。
description.en: Due to opposition from the left-wing, led by the French Communist Party, to his constitution aimed at strengthening presidential power, Charles de Gaulle was forced to resign as Prime Minister of the provisional government.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔及利亚战争导致法兰西第四共和国陷入危机，促使夏尔·戴高乐重返政坛。
description.en: The Algerian War plunged the French Fourth Republic into crisis, prompting Charles de Gaulle's return to politics.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐委托制定了法兰西第五共和国的新宪法。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle commissioned the drafting of the new constitution for the French Fifth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐支持法国发展独立的核武器力量。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle supported France's development of an independent nuclear weapons force.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐反对英国加入欧洲经济共同体，并努力减少英国在欧洲的影响。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle opposed the United Kingdom's entry into the European Economic Community and worked to reduce British influence in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐的思想和政策被称为戴高乐主义。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle's ideas and policies are known as Gaullism.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐于1909年考入圣西尔军校，1912年毕业。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle was admitted to the Saint-Cyr military academy in 1909 and graduated in 1912.

description.zh-cn: 在战俘营期间，夏尔·戴高乐教米哈伊尔·图哈切夫斯基法语。
description.en: During his time as a prisoner of war, Charles de Gaulle taught French to Mikhail Tukhachevsky.

description.zh-cn: 菲利普·贝当委任夏尔·戴高乐为其幕僚，提携了他。
description.en: Philippe Pétain appointed Charles de Gaulle to his staff, mentoring him.

description.zh-cn: 因《法国与她的军队》一书的署名问题，菲利普·贝当与夏尔·戴高乐的关系迅速恶化。
description.en: Due to authorship issues with the book 'France and Her Army', the relationship between Philippe Pétain and Charles de Gaulle deteriorated rapidly.

description.zh-cn: 《慕尼黑协定》的签订令夏尔·戴高乐对法国政府的表现十分失望。
description.en: The signing of the Munich Agreement left Charles de Gaulle very disappointed with the French government's performance.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐拒绝接受与德国的停战协定，并组织自由法国运动以对抗维希法国傀儡政权。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle refused to accept the armistice with Germany and organized the Free French movement to oppose the Vichy France puppet regime.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐在伦敦通过英国广播公司发表了《6月18日呼吁》。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle delivered the 'Appeal of 18 June' from London via the BBC.

description.zh-cn: 英国广播公司播出了夏尔·戴高乐的《6月18日呼吁》。
description.en: The BBC broadcast Charles de Gaulle's 'Appeal of 18 June'.

description.zh-cn: 美国支持亨利·吉罗将军。
description.en: The United States supported General Henri Giraud.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐在权力斗争中迫使亨利·吉罗专任军事职务，最终将其彻底清除出法兰西民族解放委员会。
description.en: In a power struggle, Charles de Gaulle forced Henri Giraud to focus solely on military duties, eventually removing him completely from the French Committee of National Liberation.

description.zh-cn: 菲利浦·勒克莱尔将军在夏尔·戴高乐的领导下指挥部队解放巴黎。
description.en: General Philippe Leclerc commanded troops to liberate Paris under the leadership of Charles de Gaulle.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐领导下的盟军解放了巴黎。
description.en: Allied forces under the leadership of Charles de Gaulle liberated Paris.

description.zh-cn: 1958年5月的政治危机导致国民议会授予夏尔·戴高乐全权，使其重新上台。
description.en: The political crisis of May 1958 led the National Assembly to grant full powers to Charles de Gaulle, bringing him back to power.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐担任法兰西第四共和国最后一任总理，随后建立了法兰西第五共和国，结束了第四共和国。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle served as the last Prime Minister of the French Fourth Republic and subsequently established the French Fifth Republic, ending the Fourth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 贝志高向蒋中正总统说明法国将与中华人民共和国建交。
description.en: Béatrix de Toulouse-Lautrec explained to President Chiang Kai-shek that France would establish diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐决定承认中华人民共和国为中国代表，并与之建交。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle decided to recognize the People's Republic of China as the representative of China and establish diplomatic relations.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐决定停止承认中华民国为中国的代表政府。
description.en: Charles de Gaulle decided to cease recognizing the Republic of China as the representative government of China.

description.zh-cn: 夏尔·戴高乐在访问加拿大期间公开发表“自由魁北克万岁”的演讲，被视为支持魁北克独立。
description.en: During his visit to Canada, Charles de Gaulle publicly gave a speech saying 'Vive le Québec libre!', which was seen as support for Quebec independence.

description.zh-cn: 戴高乐关于魁北克独立的言论导致法加关系陷入低谷，他本人也被加拿大政府列为不受欢迎人士。
description.en: De Gaulle's remarks on Quebec independence caused a downturn in France-Canada relations, and he was declared persona non grata by the Canadian government.

description.zh-cn: 五月风暴虽然未能直接推翻戴高乐政府，但暴露了深刻的社会矛盾，动摇了其统治基础，并间接导致了他次年的辞职。
description.en: Although May 68 did not directly overthrow the de Gaulle government, it exposed deep social conflicts, shook the foundations of his rule, and indirectly led to his resignation the following year.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英在2017年3月13日获增选为全国政协副主席。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying was elected as a Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC on March 13, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英接替曾荫权成为香港特别行政区行政长官。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying succeeded Donald Tsang as the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 林郑月娥接替梁振英成为香港特别行政区行政长官。
description.en: Carrie Lam succeeded Leung Chun-ying as the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英与董建华一同担任香港再出发大联盟的总召集人。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying serves as the Secretary General of the Hong Kong Coalition, alongside Tung Chee-hwa.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英与董建华一同担任香港再出发大联盟的总召集人。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying serves as the Secretary General of the Hong Kong Coalition, alongside Tung Chee-hwa.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英曾担任香港特别行政区行政会议非官守议员召集人。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying served as the Convener of the Non-official Members of the Executive Council of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英政府实施“零双非”政策，使所有公立及私立医院均停止接收非本地孕妇在香港分娩，大幅减少了双非婴儿的数量。
description.en: The Leung Chun-ying administration implemented the 'zero-shuangfei' policy, stopping all public and private hospitals from accepting non-local pregnant women for delivery in Hong Kong, which significantly reduced the number of 'shuangfei' infants.

description.zh-cn: 澳洲传媒揭发梁振英收取澳洲公司UGL约5,000万港元款项而未作申报，事件引发巨大争议，损害其声誉。
description.en: Australian media revealed that Leung Chun-ying received approximately HK$50 million from the Australian company UGL without declaration, sparking significant controversy and damaging his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 2019年反修例运动期间，梁振英牵头成立803基金。
description.en: During the 2019 anti-extradition bill movement, Leung Chun-ying took the lead in establishing the 803 Fund.

description.zh-cn: 1989年六四事件发生后，梁振英在报章刊登声明，强烈谴责中共当权者血腥屠杀中国人民。
description.en: After the 1989 Tiananmen Square massacre, Leung Chun-ying published a statement in newspapers strongly condemning the CCP authorities for the bloody massacre of the Chinese people.

description.zh-cn: 李柱铭曾公然指梁振英是共产党人。
description.en: Martin Lee publicly stated that Leung Chun-ying is a communist.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，时任上海市委副书记的朱镕基，找梁振英协助上海进行第一次卖地。
description.en: In 1988, Zhu Rongji, then Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, sought Leung Chun-ying's assistance for Shanghai's first land sale.

description.zh-cn: 梁振英提出解决主权移交后界限街以北土地续约问题的建议，后来成为《中英联合声明》附件三的主要内容。
description.en: Leung Chun-ying proposed a solution for the land lease extension issue north of Boundary Street after the handover, which later became the main content of Annex III of the Sino-British Joint Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 2003年，梁振英代表时任行政长官董建华与中央人民政府商讨自由行政策。
description.en: In 2003, on behalf of then-Chief Executive Tung Chee-hwa, Leung Chun-ying negotiated the Individual Visit Scheme policy with the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇于1942年11月出生于江苏省武进县。
description.en: Liu Qi was born in Wujin County, Jiangsu Province in November 1942.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇于1959年从北京101中学毕业。
description.en: Liu Qi graduated from Beijing 101 Middle School in 1959.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇1959年考入北京钢铁学院（现北京科技大学），1964年本科毕业后继续攻读研究生，并于1968年获研究生学历。
description.en: Liu Qi was admitted to the Beijing Institute of Iron and Steel Technology (now University of Science and Technology Beijing) in 1959, continued postgraduate studies after graduating in 1964, and obtained his postgraduate degree in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇于1975年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Liu Qi joined the Communist Party of China in September 1975.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇自1968年起在武汉钢铁公司工作，于1990年至1993年担任公司经理。
description.en: Liu Qi worked at Wuhan Iron and Steel Corporation from 1968, serving as its manager from 1990 to 1993.

description.zh-cn: 1993年3月至1998年3月，刘淇担任中华人民共和国冶金工业部部长。
description.en: From March 1993 to March 1998, Liu Qi served as the Minister of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1999年2月10日至2003年1月19日，刘淇担任北京市市长。
description.en: From February 10, 1999, to January 19, 2003, Liu Qi served as the Mayor of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 2002年10月22日至2012年7月3日，刘淇担任中共北京市委书记。
description.en: From October 22, 2002, to July 3, 2012, Liu Qi served as the Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇是中共第十六届、十七届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Liu Qi was a member of the 16th and 17th Politburo of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2001年12月至2009年8月，刘淇担任北京奥运会组委会主席。
description.en: From December 2001 to August 2009, Liu Qi served as the President of the Beijing Organising Committee for the Olympic Games.

description.zh-cn: 2012年7月起，刘淇担任中央文明委副主任，直至2013年1月。
description.en: Starting from July 2012, Liu Qi served as the Vice Chairman of the Central Guidance Commission on Building Spiritual Civilization until January 2013.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇接替戚元靖出任中华人民共和国冶金工业部部长。
description.en: Liu Qi succeeded Qi Yuanjing as the Minister of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘淇接替贾庆林出任北京市市长。
description.en: Liu Qi succeeded Jia Qinglin as the Mayor of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 孟学农接替刘淇出任北京市市长。
description.en: Meng Xuenong succeeded Liu Qi as the Mayor of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 郭金龙接替刘淇出任中共北京市委书记。
description.en: Guo Jinlong succeeded Liu Qi as the Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，时任国务院总理朱镕基主持了国务院机构改革。
description.en: In 1998, then-Premier Zhu Rongji presided over the institutional reform of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在1998年的国务院机构改革中，冶金工业部被撤销。
description.en: The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry was abolished during the 1998 institutional reform of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 作为北京奥运会组委会主席，刘淇领导了2008年夏季奥林匹克运动会的筹备与举办工作。
description.en: As the President of the Beijing Organising Committee for the Olympic Games, Liu Qi led the preparation and hosting of the 2008 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 北京奥运会组委会负责2008年夏季奥林匹克运动会的组织和举办。
description.en: The Beijing Organising Committee for the Olympic Games was responsible for organizing and hosting the 2008 Summer Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 2008年8月25日，国际奥委会主席雅克·罗格向刘淇颁授奥林匹克金质勋章。
description.en: On August 25, 2008, IOC President Jacques Rogge awarded the Olympic Order in Gold to Liu Qi.

description.zh-cn: 2009年，刘淇主持了首都各界庆祝中华人民共和国成立60周年大会。
description.en: In 2009, Liu Qi presided over the celebrations for the 60th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China in the capital.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国国王及汉诺威选帝侯，乔治二世决定在哥廷根创办一所大学。
description.en: As King of Great Britain and Elector of Hanover, George II decided to found a university in Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 哥廷根大学的创建旨在弘扬欧洲启蒙时代学术自由的理念。
description.en: The University of Göttingen was founded with the aim of promoting the Enlightenment ideal of academic freedom.

description.zh-cn: 由于纳粹德国的迫害，马克斯·波恩被迫离开哥廷根大学。
description.en: Due to persecution by Nazi Germany, Max Born was forced to leave the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 由于纳粹德国的迫害，詹姆斯·弗兰克被迫离开哥廷根大学。
description.en: Due to persecution by Nazi Germany, James Franck was forced to leave the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 由于纳粹德国对犹太学者的迫害，罗伯特·奥本海默离开哥廷根。
description.en: Due to Nazi Germany's persecution of Jewish scholars, J. Robert Oppenheimer left Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，数学家大卫·希尔伯特与时任纳粹教育部长伯恩哈德·鲁斯特共进晚餐时，表示在犹太学者被驱逐后，“哥廷根已经没有数学了”。
description.en: In 1934, mathematician David Hilbert, during a dinner with then-Nazi Education Minister Bernhard Rust, stated that after the expulsion of Jewish scholars, 'Göttingen has no mathematics anymore.'

description.zh-cn: 哥廷根大学同哥廷根科学院一直保持着合作关系。
description.en: The University of Göttingen has always maintained a cooperative relationship with the Göttingen Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 哥廷根市设有5家马克斯·普朗克研究所，均同哥廷根大学具有学科上的紧密合作关系。
description.en: There are five Max Planck Institutes in the city of Göttingen, all of which have close disciplinary collaborations with the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑曾在哥廷根大学研习法律。
description.en: Napoleon studied law at the University of Göttingen.

description.zh-cn: 登大游在筑波大学攻读硕士学位期间，其论文研究主题促成了SoftEther VPN的开发。
description.en: During his master's degree studies at the University of Tsukuba, Daiyuu Nobori's thesis research topic led to the development of SoftEther VPN.

description.zh-cn: SoftEther VPN被设计用来穿透防火墙，其VPN Gate插件旨在简化高强度网络审查地区用户的突破网络封锁操作。
description.en: SoftEther VPN is designed to penetrate firewalls, and its VPN Gate plugin aims to simplify circumvention operations for users in areas with high-intensity network censorship.

description.zh-cn: 自2019年1月21日起，SoftEther VPN的授权协议从GPLv2转变为Apache License 2.0。
description.en: Since January 21, 2019, SoftEther VPN's license was switched from GPLv2 to Apache License 2.0.

description.zh-cn: VPN Gate项目由日本筑波大学赞助。
description.en: The VPN Gate project is sponsored by the University of Tsukuba, Japan.

description.zh-cn: SoftEther VPN使用C语言进行编程开发。
description.en: SoftEther VPN is developed using the C programming language.

description.zh-cn: SoftEther VPN使用C++语言进行编程开发。
description.en: SoftEther VPN is developed using the C++ programming language.

description.zh-cn: SoftEther VPN服务器支持并提供L2TP协议服务。
description.en: The SoftEther VPN server supports and provides services for the L2TP protocol.

description.zh-cn: SoftEther VPN服务器支持并提供IPsec协议服务。
description.en: The SoftEther VPN server supports and provides services for the IPsec protocol.

description.zh-cn: SoftEther VPN服务器支持并提供OpenVPN协议服务。
description.en: The SoftEther VPN server supports and provides services for the OpenVPN protocol.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦于1996年6月1日与萨曼莎·谢菲尔德结婚。
description.en: David Cameron married Samantha Sheffield on June 1, 1996.

description.zh-cn: 伊恩·卡梅伦是戴维·卡梅伦的父亲。
description.en: Ian Cameron is David Cameron's father.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦于1966年10月9日出生于伦敦马里波恩。
description.en: David Cameron was born in Marylebone, London on October 9, 1966.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦从13岁起就读于伊顿公学。
description.en: David Cameron attended Eton College from the age of 13.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦于1985年至1988年在牛津大学布雷齐诺斯学院修读哲学、政治学及经济学，并以一级荣誉毕业。
description.en: David Cameron studied Philosophy, Politics and Economics at Brasenose College, Oxford from 1985 to 1988, graduating with a first-class honours degree.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦与鲍里斯·约翰逊是牛津大学的同学，并且同为布灵登俱乐部成员。
description.en: David Cameron and Boris Johnson were contemporaries at Oxford University and were both members of the Bullingdon Club.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年英国脱欧公投期间，戴维·卡梅伦领导留欧阵营，而鲍里斯·约翰逊是脱欧阵营的领军人物，两人是政治对手。
description.en: During the 2016 UK Brexit referendum, David Cameron led the Remain campaign, while Boris Johnson was a leading figure in the Leave campaign, making them political opponents.

description.zh-cn: 1991年，戴维·卡梅伦被借调到唐宁街10号，为时任首相约翰·梅杰工作。
description.en: In 1991, David Cameron was seconded to 10 Downing Street to work for then Prime Minister John Major.

description.zh-cn: 1992年英国大选后，戴维·卡梅伦被任命为财政大臣诺曼·拉蒙特的特别顾问。
description.en: After the 1992 general election, David Cameron was appointed as a Special Adviser to the Chancellor of the Exchequer, Norman Lamont.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，戴维·卡梅伦离开政府部门，加入卡尔顿传播公司担任公共关系部门主管。
description.en: In 1994, David Cameron left government service to join Carlton Communications as Director of Corporate Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦于2001年当选为威特尼选区的国会议员，并于2016年辞去该职位。
description.en: David Cameron was elected Member of Parliament for Witney in 2001 and resigned from the position in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦在2005年当选为保守党党魁，并于2016年辞职。
description.en: David Cameron was elected Leader of the Conservative Party in 2005 and resigned in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 2010年大选后，保守党与自由民主党组成联合政府，共同执政至2015年。
description.en: After the 2010 general election, the Conservative Party formed a coalition government with the Liberal Democrats, governing together until 2015.

description.zh-cn: 白高敦于2010年5月11日辞去首相职务，戴维·卡梅伦接替他成为英国首相。
description.en: Gordon Brown resigned as Prime Minister on 11 May 2010, and was succeeded by David Cameron.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦于2010年至2016年担任英国首相。
description.en: David Cameron served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 2010 to 2016.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦于2016年7月13日辞去首相职务，由文翠珊接任。
description.en: David Cameron resigned as Prime Minister on 13 July 2016 and was succeeded by Theresa May.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦领导的保守党在2015年大选中获胜，使他得以连任首相并组建多数党政府。
description.en: The Conservative Party led by David Cameron won the 2015 general election, allowing him to continue as Prime Minister and form a majority government.

description.zh-cn: 作为2015年大选的竞选承诺，戴维·卡梅伦推动并举行了关于英国是否脱离欧盟的公投。
description.en: As a campaign promise in the 2015 general election, David Cameron initiated and held the referendum on the UK's membership of the European Union.

description.zh-cn: 由于脱欧公投的结果是英国退出欧盟，与他支持留欧的立场相悖，戴维·卡梅伦宣布辞去首相职务。
description.en: As the result of the Brexit referendum was for the UK to leave the EU, contrary to his pro-Remain stance, David Cameron announced his resignation as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 利雅华在2016年保守党党魁选举中退选，使得文翠珊成为唯一候选人并自动当选，从而接替戴维·卡梅伦。
description.en: Andrea Leadsom's withdrawal from the 2016 Conservative Party leadership contest left Theresa May as the sole candidate, leading to her automatic election to succeed David Cameron.

description.zh-cn: 2023年11月13日，首相里希·苏纳克任命戴维·卡梅伦为外交、联邦及发展事务大臣。
description.en: On November 13, 2023, Prime Minister Rishi Sunak appointed David Cameron as Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs.

position.en: Member of the House of Lords

description.zh-cn: 为便于出任内阁大臣，戴维·卡梅伦于2023年11月被册封为终身贵族，进入上议院。
description.en: To facilitate his appointment to the cabinet, David Cameron was created a life peer in November 2023, becoming a member of the House of Lords.

position.zh-cn: 外交、联邦及发展事务大臣
position.en: Secretary of State for Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Affairs

description.zh-cn: 在里希·苏纳克内阁中，戴维·卡梅伦担任外交大臣。
description.en: David Cameron served as Foreign Secretary in Rishi Sunak's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 印度外交部长苏杰生是戴维·卡梅伦就任外交大臣后会晤的首位外国政要。
description.en: Indian Minister of External Affairs S. Jaishankar was the first foreign dignitary to meet David Cameron after his appointment as Foreign Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 保守党在2024年大选中失败，导致政府更迭，戴维·卡梅伦随之卸任外交大臣。
description.en: The Conservative Party's defeat in the 2024 general election led to a change of government, and David Cameron subsequently left his post as Foreign Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在保守党与自由民主党的联合政府中，尼克·克莱格担任副首相，是首相戴维·卡梅伦的副手。
description.en: In the Conservative-Liberal Democrat coalition government, Nick Clegg served as Deputy Prime Minister, second to Prime Minister David Cameron.

description.zh-cn: 作为首相，戴维·卡梅伦推动并支持了英格兰和威尔士同性婚姻合法化的法案。
description.en: As Prime Minister, David Cameron pushed for and supported the bill to legalize same-sex marriage in England and Wales.

description.zh-cn: 2011年，时任法国总统萨科齐曾就欧元区问题公开批评和喝令戴维·卡梅伦，显示出两人之间的紧张关系。
description.en: In 2011, then-French President Sarkozy publicly criticized and rebuked David Cameron over Eurozone issues, indicating a tense relationship between the two.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦是英国国王威廉四世与其情妇桃乐西·乔丹的直系后裔。
description.en: David Cameron is a direct descendant of King William IV of the United Kingdom and his mistress, Dorothea Jordan.

description.zh-cn: 戴维·卡梅伦是英女王伊丽莎白二世的第五代表兄弟。
description.en: David Cameron is a fifth cousin, twice removed, of Queen Elizabeth II.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚是“和平崛起”理论的提出者。
description.en: Zheng Bijian is the proposer of the "Peaceful Rise" theory.

description.zh-cn: 1951年，赴广西参加土地改革运动。
description.en: In 1951, he went to Guangxi to participate in the Land Reform Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，郑必坚受到冲击，被下放五七干校劳动改造。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zheng Bijian was purged and sent to a May Seventh Cadre School for labor reform.

description.zh-cn: 与龚育之共同起草了一篇题为《学好文件抓好纲》的社论，正式提出“两个凡是”的理论。
description.en: Co-authored an editorial with Gong Yuzhi titled 'Study the Documents Well and Grasp the Key Link', which formally proposed the "Two Whatevers" theory.

description.zh-cn: 与龚育之共同起草社论，正式提出“两个凡是”的理论。
description.en: Co-authored the editorial with Gong Yuzhi that officially proposed the "Two Whatevers" theory.

description.zh-cn: 与郑必坚共同起草社论，正式提出“两个凡是”的理论。
description.en: Co-authored the editorial with Zheng Bijian that officially proposed the "Two Whatevers" theory.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚在中共中央书记处研究室工作期间，受到邓力群的赏识。
description.en: Zheng Bijian was appreciated by Deng Liqun while working at the Research Office of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 日本政府授予郑必坚旭日大绶章。
description.en: The Government of Japan awarded Zheng Bijian the Grand Cordon of the Order of the Rising Sun.

description.zh-cn: 汪家镠卸任中共中央党校常务副校长，由郑必坚接任。
description.en: Wang Jialiu stepped down as Executive Vice President of the Central Party School, and was succeeded by Zheng Bijian.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚卸任中共中央党校常务副校长，由虞云耀接任。
description.en: Zheng Bijian stepped down as Executive Vice President of the Central Party School, and was succeeded by Yu Yunyao.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚卸任中共中央宣传部常务副部长，由刘云山接任。
description.en: Zheng Bijian stepped down as Executive Deputy Head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, and was succeeded by Liu Yunshan.

description.zh-cn: 杨振亚卸任中日友好21世纪委员会中方首席委员，由郑必坚接任。
description.en: Yang Zhenya stepped down as the Chinese chief member of the 21st Century Committee for China-Japan Friendship, and was succeeded by Zheng Bijian.

description.zh-cn: 郑必坚卸任中日友好21世纪委员会中方首席委员，由唐家璇接任。
description.en: Zheng Bijian stepped down as the Chinese chief member of the 21st Century Committee for China-Japan Friendship, and was succeeded by Tang Jiaxuan.

description.zh-cn: 在南斯拉夫总统约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托等领导人的倡议下，不结盟运动于1961年在贝尔格莱德正式成立。
description.en: Under the initiative of leaders including Yugoslav President Josip Broz Tito, the Non-Aligned Movement was formally established in Belgrade in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 在印度总理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁等领导人的倡议下，不结盟运动于1961年在贝尔格莱德正式成立。
description.en: Under the initiative of leaders including Indian Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru, the Non-Aligned Movement was formally established in Belgrade in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 在埃及总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜-纳赛尔等领导人的倡议下，不结盟运动于1961年在贝尔格莱德正式成立。
description.en: Under the initiative of leaders including Egyptian President Gamal Abdel Nasser, the Non-Aligned Movement was formally established in Belgrade in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 在加纳总统夸梅·恩克鲁玛等领导人的倡议下，不结盟运动于1961年在贝尔格莱德正式成立。
description.en: Under the initiative of leaders including Ghanaian President Kwame Nkrumah, the Non-Aligned Movement was formally established in Belgrade in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 在印度尼西亚总统苏加诺等领导人的倡议下，不结盟运动于1961年在贝尔格莱德正式成立。
description.en: Under the initiative of leaders including Indonesian President Sukarno, the Non-Aligned Movement was formally established in Belgrade in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 不结盟运动的成立是为了在冷战的东西方集团对抗背景下，为发展中国家提供一个独立自主的平台。
description.en: The Non-Aligned Movement was established to provide an independent platform for developing countries amidst the East-West confrontation of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 1955年万隆会议商定的原则为不结盟运动的成立奠定了基础。
description.en: The principles agreed upon at the 1955 Bandung Conference laid the foundation for the establishment of the Non-Aligned Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在冷战期间，由苏联领导的东方集团与由美国领导的西方集团处于敌对状态。
description.en: During the Cold War, the Eastern Bloc, led by the Soviet Union, was in a state of hostility with the Western Bloc, led by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 苏联是东方集团的组建者和领导者。
description.en: The Soviet Union was the founder and leader of the Eastern Bloc.

description.zh-cn: 美国是西方集团的组建者和领导者。
description.en: The United States was the founder and leader of the Western Bloc.

description.zh-cn: 不结盟运动的宗旨之一是反对帝国主义。
description.en: One of the tenets of the Non-Aligned Movement is to oppose imperialism.

description.zh-cn: 不结盟运动的宗旨之一是反对殖民主义。
description.en: One of the tenets of the Non-Aligned Movement is to oppose colonialism.

description.zh-cn: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗在1979年的《哈瓦那宣言》中总结了不结盟运动的宗旨。
description.en: Fidel Castro summarized the purposes of the Non-Aligned Movement in the 1979 Havana Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 尼赫鲁在1954年与周恩来的会谈中共同倡导了和平共处五项原则。
description.en: Nehru co-advocated the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence during talks with Zhou Enlai in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 苏联入侵阿富汗事件在不结盟运动内部造成了严重分歧。
description.en: The Soviet invasion of Afghanistan caused serious divisions within the Non-Aligned Movement.

description.zh-cn: 创始成员国南斯拉夫的解体影响了不结盟运动，并导致其成员资格于1992年被暂停。
description.en: The breakup of founding member Yugoslavia affected the Non-Aligned Movement, leading to the suspension of its membership in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 不结盟运动倡导联合国安理会改革，以提高发展中国家的代表性和权力。
description.en: The Non-Aligned Movement advocates for the reform of the UN Security Council to enhance the representation and power of developing countries.

description.zh-cn: 不结盟运动批评美国的外交政策，认为其企图践踏小国主权。
description.en: The Non-Aligned Movement criticizes US foreign policy, viewing it as an attempt to undermine the sovereignty of smaller nations.

description.zh-cn: 益州之战是刘备实现《隆中对》中“跨有荆、益”战略规划的关键步骤。
description.en: The Battle of Yizhou was a crucial step for Liu Bei to realize the strategic plan of "controlling both Jing and Yi provinces" as outlined in the Longzhong Dui.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋因受到盘踞汉中的张鲁势力的威胁，才决定邀请刘备入蜀以求自保。
description.en: Threatened by Zhang Lu's forces in Hanzhong, Liu Zhang decided to invite Liu Bei into Shu for self-preservation.

description.zh-cn: 作为刘璋的属下，法正与张松合谋，主动向刘备献策，帮助其夺取益州。
description.en: As a subordinate of Liu Zhang, Fa Zheng conspired with Zhang Song and took the initiative to offer strategies to Liu Bei to help him seize Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋邀请刘备入蜀对抗张鲁，初期双方关系良好。
description.en: Liu Zhang invited Liu Bei into Shu to counter Zhang Lu, and their relationship was initially good.

description.zh-cn: 庞统是刘备的重要谋士，在益州之战中为其献策。
description.en: Pang Tong was an important advisor to Liu Bei and offered him strategies during the Battle of Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 在围攻雒城时，庞统率众攻城，被流矢射中而阵亡。
description.en: During the siege of Luocheng, Pang Tong was leading the assault when he was struck by a stray arrow and died.

description.zh-cn: 张肃是张松的兄长。
description.en: Zhang Su was the elder brother of Zhang Song.

description.zh-cn: 张肃发现弟弟张松的叛变意图后，向刘璋告发，导致张松被杀。
description.en: After discovering his younger brother Zhang Song's rebellious intentions, Zhang Su reported him to Liu Zhang, leading to Zhang Song's execution.

description.zh-cn: 在得知张松的密谋后，刘璋下令将其处死。
description.en: After learning of Zhang Song's conspiracy, Liu Zhang ordered his execution.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在与刘璋决裂后，设计斩杀了刘璋的将领杨怀，吞并了其军队。
description.en: After breaking with Liu Zhang, Liu Bei plotted and executed Liu Zhang's general Yang Huai, annexing his troops.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在与刘璋决裂后，设计斩杀了刘璋的将领高沛，吞并了其军队。
description.en: After breaking with Liu Zhang, Liu Bei plotted and executed Liu Zhang's general Gao Pei, annexing his troops.

description.zh-cn: 刘备在金雁桥击败并俘虏了张任，因其坚决不降而下令将其处死。
description.en: Liu Bei defeated and captured Zhang Ren at Jinyan Bridge, and ordered his execution due to his resolute refusal to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 刘循是刘璋的儿子。
description.en: Liu Xun was the son of Liu Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 刘璋是刘焉的儿子，继承其益州牧的职位。
description.en: Liu Zhang was the son of Liu Yan and inherited his position as the governor of Yizhou.

description.zh-cn: 在益州之战末期，原属张鲁麾下的马超投靠刘备，并领兵进驻成都城北，加速了刘璋的投降。
description.en: In the late stages of the Battle of Yizhou, Ma Chao, who was under Zhang Lu, defected to Liu Bei and stationed his troops north of Chengdu, accelerating Liu Zhang's surrender.

description.zh-cn: 原为刘璋将领，后在绵竹率众向刘备投降。
description.en: Originally a general under Liu Zhang, he later surrendered to Liu Bei with his troops at Mianzhu.

description.zh-cn: 刘备夺取益州后，曹操于次年（215年）占领汉中，直接威胁蜀地安全，从而引发了刘备为争夺汉中而发动的汉中之战。
description.en: After Liu Bei seized Yizhou, Cao Cao occupied Hanzhong the following year (215), directly threatening the security of the Shu region, which led to the Hanzhong Campaign launched by Liu Bei to contest control of Hanzhong.

description.zh-cn: 在成都城被围后，刘璋开城向刘备投降。
description.en: After the city of Chengdu was besieged, Liu Zhang opened the gates and surrendered to Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席是中国共产党中央军事委员会的副职负责人。
description.en: The Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission is the deputy head of the CPC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席的地位仅次于中共中央军委主席。
description.en: The position of the Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission is second only to the Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席属于国家级副职领导人。
description.en: The Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission is a deputy national-level leader.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席属于党和国家领导人。
description.en: The Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission is one of the Party and state leaders.

description.zh-cn: 自1983年国家中央军事委员会成立开始，中国共产党中央军事委员会副主席均兼任中华人民共和国中央军事委员会副主席的职务。
description.en: Since the establishment of the State Central Military Commission in 1983, the Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission has concurrently served as the Vice Chairman of the PRC Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 被开除党籍、开除军籍，剥夺上将军衔，判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Expelled from the party, expelled from the military, stripped of the rank of general, and sentenced to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 被开除党籍、开除军籍，剥夺上将军衔。
description.en: Expelled from the party, expelled from the military, and stripped of the rank of general.

description.zh-cn: 陈丕显于1929年9月加入中国共产主义青年团，并担任过少共南阳区儿童团总团长等职务。
description.en: Chen Pixian joined the Communist Youth League of China in September 1929 and served in positions such as the head of the Children's Corps in the Nanyang area.

description.zh-cn: 在三年游击战争期间，陈丕显随项英、陈毅等人一起行动，并在其领导下工作。
description.en: During the Three Years' Guerrilla War, Chen Pixian acted with Xiang Ying and Chen Yi and worked under their leadership.

description.zh-cn: 在三年游击战争期间，陈丕显随项英、陈毅等人一起行动，并在其领导下工作。
description.en: During the Three Years' Guerrilla War, Chen Pixian acted with Xiang Ying and Chen Yi and worked under their leadership.

description.zh-cn: 陈丕显在粟裕指挥的苏中战役中担负支前任务，为战斗取得“七战七捷”作出了贡献。
description.en: In the Central Jiangsu Campaign commanded by Su Yu, Chen Pixian undertook front-line support tasks and contributed to the "seven victories in seven battles".

description.zh-cn: 1952年左右，毛泽东称赞陈丕显完成土地改革和镇压反革命任务出色。1974年9月17日，毛泽东批示对在文革中被关押的陈丕显“似可作人民内部问题处理”，促使其复出。
description.en: Around 1952, Mao Zedong praised Chen Pixian for his outstanding completion of land reform and the suppression of counter-revolutionaries. On September 17, 1974, Mao instructed that Chen Pixian, who was imprisoned during the Cultural Revolution, could be 'handled as an issue among the people,' which facilitated his comeback.

description.zh-cn: 因陈丕显罹患鼻癌治疗休养，由曹荻秋代理上海市委第一书记。
description.en: Due to Chen Pixian's medical leave for nasopharyngeal cancer treatment, Cao Diqiu served as the acting First Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命爆发后，陈丕显在“一月风暴”中被夺权，此后被长期关押和隔离审查。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, Chen Pixian's power was seized during the 'January Storm,' and he was subsequently imprisoned and held in solitary confinement for investigation for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东对陈丕显的信件作出批示后，张春桥等人对陈丕显的复出进行了阻挠。
description.en: After Mao Zedong gave instructions on Chen Pixian's letter, Zhang Chunqiao and others obstructed his rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在复出后，收到陈丕显的求助信，并向毛泽东提议恢复陈丕显的组织生活和工资，并最终促成其调离上海到北京工作。
description.en: After his own rehabilitation, Deng Xiaoping received a letter from Chen Pixian asking for help. Deng then proposed to Mao Zedong to restore Chen's party membership and salary, and eventually facilitated his transfer from Shanghai to Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 陈丕显卸任中央政法委员会书记职务，由乔石接替。
description.en: Chen Pixian stepped down as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, and was succeeded by Qiao Shi.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省人民政府在业务上接受中华人民共和国国务院的直接领导。
description.en: The People's Government of Shaanxi Province is under the direct leadership of the State Council of the People's Republic of China in terms of business operations.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省人民政府是陕西省人民代表大会的执行机关，由其选举产生并向其负责。
description.en: The People's Government of Shaanxi Province is the executive organ of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Congress, elected by and responsible to it.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省人民政府在党务上接受中共陕西省委的领导。
description.en: The People's Government of Shaanxi Province accepts the leadership of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee in party affairs.

description.zh-cn: 根据中央人民政府的命令，陕西省人民政府于1950年1月10日成立，并任命了其主要领导。
description.en: On the order of the Central People's Government, the People's Government of Shaanxi Province was established on January 10, 1950, and its main leaders were appointed.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，陕西省革命委员会成立以取代原省政府。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Shaanxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee was established to replace the original provincial government.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省革命委员会在1968年至1979年间取代了陕西省人民政府的职能。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Revolutionary Committee replaced the functions of the People's Government of Shaanxi Province from 1968 to 1979.

description.zh-cn: 被中央人民政府任命为陕西省人民政府首任主席。
description.en: Appointed by the Central People's Government as the first Chairman of the People's Government of Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 兼任陕西省公安厅厅长。
description.en: Concurrently serves as the Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省公安厅是陕西省人民政府的组成部门，在组织上接受其领导。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Department of Public Security is a component department of the Shaanxi Provincial People's Government and is organizationally subordinate to it.

description.zh-cn: 西安市人民政府是陕西省人民政府下属的地方政府。
description.en: The Xi'an Municipal People's Government is a local government subordinate to the Shaanxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 胡福明是南京大学哲学系的教师。
description.en: Hu Fuming was a professor in the Department of Philosophy at Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦在1978年审定《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》时，担任中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: Hu Yaobang served as the Minister of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee in 1978 when he approved 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth'.

description.zh-cn: 《理论动态》于1978年5月10日在其第60期上首次发表（内部刊物）了《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》。
description.en: 'Theoretical Trends' first published (internally) 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth' in its 60th issue on May 10, 1978.

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》于1978年5月12日转载了《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》。
description.en: The People's Daily reprinted 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth' on May 12, 1978.

description.zh-cn: 《解放军报》于1978年5月12日转载了《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》。
description.en: The PLA Daily reprinted 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth' on May 12, 1978.

description.zh-cn: 新华社于1978年5月11日转发了《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》。
description.en: Xinhua News Agency forwarded 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth' on May 11, 1978.

description.zh-cn: 胡福明撰写《实践是检验真理的标准》一文旨在反驳“两个凡是”的观点。
description.en: Hu Fuming wrote the article 'Practice is the Criterion for Testing Truth' with the aim of refuting the 'Two Whatevers' viewpoint.

description.zh-cn: 该文的发表及其引发的讨论，从理论上动摇了“两个凡是”的执政基础。
description.en: The publication of this article and the ensuing discussion theoretically undermined the governing basis of the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 该文动摇了华国锋执政的理论基础，即“两个凡是”。
description.en: This article undermined the theoretical basis of Hua Guofeng's rule, namely the 'Two Whatevers'.

description.zh-cn: 文中引用了马克思关于“人应该在实践中证明自己思维的真理性”的论述。
description.en: The article quotes Marx's statement that 'Man must prove the truth...of his thinking in practice'.

description.zh-cn: 该文的核心观点与实用主义（实验主义）中“实验是真理的唯一试金石”的观点相似，但此联系在当时被中共官方批判和否认。
description.en: The core idea of the article is similar to the pragmatist (experimentalist) view that 'experiment is the only touchstone of truth,' but this connection was criticized and denied by CPC officials at the time.

description.zh-cn: 2019年，中华人民共和国教育部将《实践是检验真理的唯一标准》全文收录进普通高中语文教科书。
description.en: In 2019, the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China included the full text of 'Practice is the Sole Criterion for Testing Truth' in the national high school Chinese language textbook.

position.zh-cn: 漠南汉地军国庶事总领
position.en: Administrator of military and state affairs in North China

description.zh-cn: 1251年元宪宗即位后，任命忽必烈总领漠南汉地军国庶事。
description.en: After ascending to the throne in 1251, Möngke Khan appointed Kublai Khan to oversee military and state affairs in the Monan Han lands (North China).

description.zh-cn: 拖雷家族内战导致蒙古帝国各大汗国纷纷自立，帝国走向实质性分裂，结束了彼此间紧密的合作关系。
description.en: The Toluid Civil War led to the various khanates of the Mongol Empire becoming independent, pushing the empire towards de facto division and ending their close cooperative relationship.

description.zh-cn: 窝阔台汗国的海都一直和忽必烈敌对，企图确立自己为大汗之位的继承人，终忽必烈一朝，双方征战不休。
description.en: Kaidu of the Ögedei Khanate was consistently hostile towards Kublai, aiming to establish himself as the successor to the Great Khan. Throughout Kublai's reign, the two sides were engaged in continuous warfare.

description.zh-cn: 河海大学是中华人民共和国教育部直属高校。
河海大学是实施国家“211工程”重点建设的高校之一。
河海大学是实施国家“985工程优势学科创新平台”重点建设的高校之一。
担任河海专门学校筹备主任。
1924年，东南大学工科与河海工程专门学校合并，成立河海工科大学。
1952年由南京大学水利系等合并成立华东水利学院。
1952年由交通大学水利系等合并成立华东水利学院。
1952年由同济大学土木系水利组等合并成立华东水利学院。
1952年由浙江大学土木系水利组等合并成立华东水利学院。
1960年，其前身华东水利学院被中共中央认定为全国重点大学。
为河海大学亲笔题写校名。
为河海大学题词：“面向未来，开拓进取，进一步发展水利教育事业”。
为河海大学80周年校庆题词。
为河海大学80周年校庆题词。
为河海大学80周年校庆题词。
视察河海大学并发表讲话，提出“献身，求实，负责”六字要求。
与江苏省共建河海大学。
与教育部合作共建河海大学。
2017年9月，河海大学入选国家首批“双一流”世界一流学科建设高校名单。
为河海历史上的校歌作词。
1917年考入河海工程专门学校。
1916年考入河海工程专门学校。
1950年考入南京大学水利系，1952年并入华东水利学院，1953年7月毕业。
1985年毕业于华东水利学院港口及航道工程专业。
农田水利工程专业学生。
1989年毕业于河海大学水力学与河流动力学专业，获得工学博士学位。
北魏孝文帝为安顿印度僧人跋陀，在嵩山少室山下令修建了少林寺。
description.en: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei ordered the construction of the Shaolin Temple at Mount Song to accommodate the Indian monk Batuo.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩来到少林寺传授禅修，使少林寺逐渐成为禅宗祖庭。
description.en: Bodhidharma came to the Shaolin Temple to teach Zen meditation, gradually establishing it as the ancestral temple of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 在北周武帝发动的“建德毁佛”运动中，少林寺遭到了严重毁坏。
description.en: During the 'Jiande Persecution of Buddhism' launched by Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, the Shaolin Temple was severely damaged.

description.zh-cn: 北周武帝下令禁止佛教传播，发起了“建德毁佛”运动。
description.en: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou ordered the proscription of Buddhism, launching the 'Jiande Persecution of Buddhism' campaign.

description.zh-cn: 隋文帝恢复了少林寺的名称，并赐予其大量土地和财产，支持了其发展。
description.en: Emperor Wen of Sui restored the name of the Shaolin Temple and supported its development by granting it large amounts of land and property.

description.zh-cn: 唐朝初年，少林寺十三名武僧因帮助李世民（后来的唐太宗）立下战功而闻名。
description.en: In the early Tang dynasty, thirteen warrior monks from the Shaolin Temple became famous for their military service in helping Li Shimin (later Emperor Taizong).

description.zh-cn: 因少林寺僧人助唐有功，唐太宗对少林寺大加封赏，赐予田地，并允许其拥有僧兵。
description.en: Due to the monks' contribution to the Tang cause, Emperor Taizong greatly rewarded the Shaolin Temple with land grants and permitted it to maintain a force of monk soldiers.

description.zh-cn: 元世祖任命禅师福裕住持少林寺，并统领嵩山一带所有禅寺。
description.en: Kublai Khan appointed Zen master Fuyu as the abbot of the Shaolin Temple, giving him authority over all Zen monasteries in the Mount Song area.

description.zh-cn: 元代初，福裕被元世祖任命为少林寺住持，开启了少林寺的一个辉煌时代。
description.en: In the early Yuan dynasty, Fuyu was appointed by Kublai Khan as the abbot of the Shaolin Temple, ushering in a glorious era for the monastery.

description.zh-cn: 明朝嘉靖年间，戚继光召集少林僧人等武术家共同研究拳法及棍法以对抗倭寇。
description.en: During the Jiajing reign of the Ming dynasty, Qi Jiguang gathered Shaolin monks and other martial artists to collaboratively develop fist and staff techniques to fight Wokou pirates.

description.zh-cn: 明朝嘉靖年间，少林僧人因抗击倭寇有功而受到政府表彰。
description.en: During the Jiajing reign of the Ming dynasty, Shaolin monks were commended by the government for their meritorious service in fighting against Wokou pirates.

description.zh-cn: 雍正帝于1735年批准了少林寺的规划图，并下令重建山门、重修千佛殿。
description.en: In 1735, the Yongzheng Emperor approved the architectural plans for the Shaolin Temple and ordered the rebuilding of its mountain gate and the renovation of the Thousand Buddha Hall.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆帝于1750年亲临少林寺，夜宿方丈室，并写下众多诗词与匾额。
description.en: In 1750, the Qianlong Emperor personally visited the Shaolin Temple, stayed overnight in the abbot's quarters, and composed numerous poems and calligraphic plaques.

description.zh-cn: 民国时期，释妙兴带领少林寺保卫团投奔了直系军阀吴佩孚。
description.en: During the Republican era, Shi Miaoxing led the Shaolin Temple's defense corps to join the warlord Wu Peifu.

description.zh-cn: 1928年3月，石友三纵火焚烧少林寺，导致寺内众多殿宇和珍贵文物被毁。
description.en: In March 1928, Shi Yousan set fire to the Shaolin Temple, resulting in the destruction of many halls and precious cultural relics within the monastery.

description.zh-cn: 石友三是冯玉祥的部下。
description.en: Shi Yousan was a subordinate of Feng Yuxiang.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，少林寺遭到严重破坏，僧人被逼还俗，佛像被毁，殿宇坍塌。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the Shaolin Temple was severely damaged; monks were forced to return to secular life, statues were destroyed, and temple halls collapsed.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，上百名红卫兵冲进少林寺，毁坏佛像和寺庙建筑。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, over a hundred Red Guards stormed the Shaolin Temple, destroying Buddhist statues and temple buildings.

description.zh-cn: 2005年5月13日，美国前国务卿基辛格拜访少林寺。
description.en: On May 13, 2005, former U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger visited the Shaolin Temple.

description.zh-cn: 释印乐是少林寺的现任住持。
description.en: Shi Yinle is the current abbot of the Shaolin Temple.

description.zh-cn: 少林寺是少林功夫的发源地，其历代武僧潜心研创和不断发展了这一武术体系。
description.en: The Shaolin Temple is the birthplace of Shaolin Kung Fu; its warrior monks have dedicatedly created and continuously developed this martial arts system through generations.

description.zh-cn: 王澜明是陕西扶风人。
description.en: Wang Lanming is from Fufeng, Shaanxi.

position.zh-cn: 法规室主任、常务副局长、局长
