position.en: Director of the Regulations Office, Executive Deputy Director, Director

description.zh-cn: 1987年至2001年，王澜明在中共中央办公厅秘书局工作，历任法规室主任、秘书局常务副局长、局长等职。
description.en: From 1987 to 2001, Wang Lanming worked at the Secretariat of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, successively serving as Director of the Regulations Office, Executive Deputy Director of the Secretariat, and Director.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央机构编制委员会办公室副主任期间及卸任后，王澜明兼任中国行政管理学会会长。
description.en: During his tenure as Deputy Director of the State Commission Office for Public Sector Reform and after leaving the post, Wang Lanming served concurrently as President of the Chinese Public Administration Society.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉于1949年与曾文惠结婚，婚姻关系直至其2020年逝世。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui married Tseng Wen-hui in 1949, and their marriage lasted until his death in 2020.

description.zh-cn: 李金龙是李登辉的父亲。
description.en: Li Chin-lung was Lee Teng-hui's father.

description.zh-cn: 李登钦是李登辉的兄长。
description.en: Li Teng-chin was Lee Teng-hui's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国提拔李登辉担任行政院政务委员，并一路擢升其为台北市长、台湾省主席、副总统，将其视为接班人培养。
description.en: Chiang Ching-kuo promoted Lee Teng-hui to Minister without Portfolio, and continued to elevate him to Mayor of Taipei, Governor of Taiwan Province, and Vice President, grooming him as a successor.

description.zh-cn: 蒋经国逝世后，时任副总统的李登辉依法继任总统职位。
description.en: Following the death of Chiang Ching-kuo, then-Vice President Lee Teng-hui succeeded to the presidency in accordance with the law.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉继任并连任中华民国第7至9任总统。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui succeeded and was re-elected as the 7th to 9th President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉于1988年至2000年担任中国国民党主席。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui served as the Chairman of the Kuomintang from 1988 to 2000.

description.zh-cn: 根据多方资料，李登辉曾两度加入中国共产党，但很快便因理念不合而退出。
description.en: According to various sources, Lee Teng-hui joined the Chinese Communist Party twice but quickly withdrew due to ideological differences.

description.zh-cn: 据吴克泰所述，他于1946年9月引荐李登辉首次加入中国共产党。
description.en: According to Wu Ke-tai, he introduced Lee Teng-hui to join the Chinese Communist Party for the first time in September 1946.

description.zh-cn: 就读于农学部农林经济科，因二战中断学业。
description.en: Studied in the Department of Agricultural and Forestry Economics, but his studies were interrupted by World War II.

description.zh-cn: 时任农复会主委的沈宗瀚将李登辉以农业问题专家的身份介绍给蒋经国。
description.en: Shen Tsung-han, then chairman of the JCRR, introduced Lee Teng-hui to Chiang Ching-kuo as an expert on agricultural issues.

description.zh-cn: 王作荣向蒋经国推荐李登辉，并说服李登辉加入国民党，成为其入党介绍人。
description.en: Wang Tso-jung recommended Lee Teng-hui to Chiang Ching-kuo and persuaded Lee to join the Kuomintang, serving as his sponsor for party membership.

description.zh-cn: 警备总部曾于1950年和1970年两度拘捕并讯问李登辉。
description.en: The Taiwan Garrison Command arrested and interrogated Lee Teng-hui on two occasions, in 1950 and 1970.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉在其总统任内主导了一系列不流血的政治改革，包括终止动员戡乱、国会全面改选与总统直选，实现台湾的民主化。
description.en: During his presidency, Lee Teng-hui led a series of bloodless political reforms, including ending the Period of Mobilization, holding full parliamentary re-elections, and establishing direct presidential elections, thereby achieving Taiwan's democratization.

description.zh-cn: 野百合学运的学生提出了国会全面改选等民主改革诉求，促使李登辉召开国是会议，加速了民主化进程。
description.en: The Wild Lily student movement's demands for democratic reforms, such as the full re-election of the parliament, prompted Lee Teng-hui to convene the National Affairs Conference, accelerating the process of democratization.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉通过召开国是会议和修宪，解决了第一届资深中央民意代表的退职问题，结束了“万年国会”现象。
description.en: By convening the National Affairs Conference and amending the constitution, Lee Teng-hui resolved the retirement issue of the senior first-term central public representatives, ending the phenomenon of the 'Ten Thousand Year Parliament'.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉在访问美国康乃尔大学发表演说时，首次提出“中华民国在台湾”的国家定位。
description.en: During his speech at Cornell University in the US, Lee Teng-hui first proposed the national positioning of the 'Republic of China on Taiwan'.

description.zh-cn: 在2000年总统选举中，时任国民党主席的李登辉强行推举时任副总统连战为总统候选人。
description.en: In the 2000 presidential election, then-KMT Chairman Lee Teng-hui strongly endorsed then-Vice President Lien Chan as the presidential candidate.

description.zh-cn: 因未获国民党提名，宋楚瑜以无党籍身份参选2000年总统，分流了大量泛蓝选票，导致国民党候选人连战落选。
description.en: After failing to secure the KMT nomination, James Soong ran for president in 2000 as an independent, splitting a significant portion of the pan-blue vote and leading to the defeat of KMT candidate Lien Chan.

description.zh-cn: 由于泛蓝阵营分裂，民进党候选人陈水扁以相对多数当选，实现了中华民国首次政党轮替。
description.en: Due to the split in the pan-blue camp, DPP candidate Chen Shui-bian was elected with a plurality, marking the first transfer of power between political parties in the ROC.

description.zh-cn: 由于李登辉为台湾团结联盟的候选人站台，国民党考纪会决议撤销其党籍。
description.en: The Kuomintang's Discipline Committee decided to revoke Lee Teng-hui's party membership because he campaigned for candidates of the Taiwan Solidarity Union.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉卸任后成为新建政党台湾团结联盟的“精神领袖”。
description.en: After leaving office, Lee Teng-hui became the 'spiritual leader' of the newly formed political party, the Taiwan Solidarity Union.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉在2012年和2016年中华民国总统选举中公开表态支持民进党候选人蔡英文。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui publicly endorsed DPP candidate Tsai Ing-wen in the 2012 and 2016 ROC presidential elections.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉公开表示中共试射的飞弹是“空包弹”，此言论被认为间接导致向台湾提供此情报的解放军将领刘连昆身份暴露并被处决。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui publicly stated that the missiles test-fired by the CCP were 'duds.' This statement is believed to have indirectly led to the exposure and subsequent execution of PLA General Liu Liankun, who had provided this intelligence to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉公开表示中共试射的飞弹是“空包弹”，此言论被认为间接导致向台湾提供此情报的解放军大校邵正宗身份暴露并被处决。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui publicly stated that the missiles test-fired by the CCP were 'duds.' This statement is believed to have indirectly led to the exposure and subsequent execution of PLA Senior Colonel Shao Zhengzong, who had provided this intelligence to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉接受日本作家司马辽太郎的访问，访谈中提出了“生为台湾人的悲哀”和“国民党也是外来政权”等观点。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui was interviewed by Japanese author Ryōtarō Shiba, during which he expressed views such as 'the sorrow of being Taiwanese' and that the 'KMT is also an outside regime'.

description.zh-cn: 在李登辉计划将郝柏村调离参谋总长职位时，宋美龄出面要求李登辉不要更换郝柏村，但李登辉未听从。
description.en: When Lee Teng-hui planned to remove Hau Pei-tsun from the position of Chief of the General Staff, Soong Mei-ling intervened and asked Lee not to replace Hau, but Lee did not comply.

description.zh-cn: 郝柏村在李登辉总统任内曾担任行政院长。
description.en: Hau Pei-tsun served as Premier during President Lee Teng-hui's tenure.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府公安部在政务院政治法律委员会的指导下展开工作。
description.en: The Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government operated under the guidance of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Government Administration Council.

relationships.source: BAIDU:中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府公安部根据《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》第十八条的规定设置。
description.en: The Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government was established in accordance with Article 18 of the 'Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 1949年10月19日，中央人民政府委员会第三次会议任命罗瑞卿为公安部部长。
description.en: On October 19, 1949, the third meeting of the Central People's Government Council appointed Luo Ruiqing as the Minister of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿担任中央人民政府公安部首任部长。
description.en: Luo Ruiqing served as the first Minister of the Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 罗瑞卿兼任北京市公安局局长。
description.en: Luo Ruiqing concurrently served as the Director of the Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 第一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过了《中华人民共和国宪法》。
description.en: The first session of the 1st National People's Congress passed the 'Constitution of the People's Republic of China'.

relationships.target: BAIDU:中华人民共和国国务院组织法

description.zh-cn: 第一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过了《中华人民共和国国务院组织法》。
description.en: The first session of the 1st National People's Congress passed the 'Organic Law of the State Council of the People's Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月第一届全国人民代表大会召开后，通过了新的宪法和国务院组织法，中央人民政府及其所属机构（包括公安部）随之结束。
description.en: After the 1st National People's Congress convened in September 1954 and passed a new constitution and the Organic Law of the State Council, the Central People's Government and its subordinate agencies (including the Ministry of Public Security) were terminated.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月第一届全国人民代表大会召开后，原中央人民政府公安部改组为中华人民共和国公安部，成为新成立的国务院的组成部门。
description.en: After the 1st National People's Congress convened in September 1954, the former Ministry of Public Security of the Central People's Government was reorganized into the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China, becoming a constituent department of the newly established State Council.

description.zh-cn: 雷荣天由中国人民解放军第十四军政委调任至公安部。
description.en: Lei Rongtian was transferred from the position of Political Commissar of the 14th Army of the PLA to the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 卓雄由中国人民解放军第四十军政委调任至公安部。
description.en: Zhuo Xiong was transferred from the position of Political Commissar of the 40th Army of the PLA to the Ministry of Public Security.

position.en: Deputy Political Commissar and Director of the Political Department

description.zh-cn: 蔡顺礼由中国人民解放军第六十五军副政委兼政治部主任调任至公安部。
description.en: Cai Shunli was transferred from the position of Deputy Political Commissar and Director of the Political Department of the 65th Army of the PLA to the Ministry of Public Security.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟于1992年12月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei joined the Communist Party of China in December 1992.

description.zh-cn: 1978年9月考入西北工业大学飞机系学习，后于1985年9月回到该校攻读硕士学位，1988年3月毕业。
description.en: He was admitted to the Aircraft Department of Northwestern Polytechnical University in September 1978, returned to the university in September 1985 to pursue a master's degree, and graduated in March 1988.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟在北京航空航天大学获得管理科学与工程专业在职研究生学历及管理学博士学位。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei obtained an on-the-job postgraduate education in Management Science and Engineering and a Doctor of Management degree from Beihang University.

description.zh-cn: 1988年3月进入该研究院工作，后于1996年8月出任副院长。
description.en: He began working at the academy in March 1988 and was appointed Deputy Director in August 1996.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟曾参与“飞豹”歼击轰炸机的研发工作，并担任工程组组长。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei participated in the development of the 'Flying Leopard' fighter-bomber and served as the leader of the engineering group.

description.zh-cn: 1999年7月任副总经理，2001年11月升任总经理。
description.en: Appointed Deputy General Manager in July 1999, and promoted to General Manager in November 2001.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国载人航天工程副总指挥，负责统筹神舟五号的发射任务。
description.en: As Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the China Manned Space Program, he was responsible for coordinating the launch of Shenzhou 5.

description.zh-cn: 作为中国载人航天工程副总指挥，负责统筹神舟六号的发射任务。
description.en: As Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the China Manned Space Program, he was responsible for coordinating the launch of Shenzhou 6.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟于2011年8月任代省长，2012年1月正式当选省长。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei became acting governor in August 2011 and was officially elected governor in January 2012.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟是中共第十六届至第二十届中央委员。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei is a member of the 16th to 20th Central Committees of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟在担任省级党委书记期间，习近平是其直接上级（中共中央总书记）。
description.en: During Zhang Qingwei's tenure as a provincial party secretary, Xi Jinping was his direct superior (General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee).

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟担任全国人大常委会副委员长，直接向委员长赵乐际负责。
description.en: As Vice Chairperson of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, Zhang Qingwei reports directly to Chairman Zhao Leji.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟担任国防科工委主任期间，向时任国务院总理温家宝汇报工作。
description.en: During his tenure as Director of COSTIND, Zhang Qingwei reported to then-Premier Wen Jiabao.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟接替许达哲，出任中共湖南省委书记。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei succeeded Xu Dazhe as Secretary of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 沈晓明接替张庆伟，出任中共湖南省委书记。
description.en: Shen Xiaoming succeeded Zhang Qingwei as Secretary of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟接替王宪魁，出任中共黑龙江省委书记。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei succeeded Wang Xiankui as Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 许勤先后接替张庆伟的河北省省长和中共黑龙江省委书记职务。
description.en: Xu Qin successively succeeded Zhang Qingwei as Governor of Hebei and Secretary of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟接替陈全国，出任河北省代省长。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei succeeded Chen Quanguo as acting Governor of Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 张庆伟接替张云川，出任国防科学技术工业委员会主任。
description.en: Zhang Qingwei succeeded Zhang Yunchuan as Director of the Commission for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民公安大学是中华人民共和国公安部直属高校。
description.en: People's Public Security University of China is a university directly under the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1950年1月11日，华北公安干部学校改名为中央公安干部学校，并与公安部高级警官学院、中国人民公安大学合署办公。1953年1月，该校又改建为中央人民公安学院。1984年1月，国务院批准将中央人民公安学院改建为中国人民公安大学。
description.en: On January 11, 1950, the North China Public Security Cadre School was renamed the Central Public Security Cadre School, and co-located with the Senior Police Officer College of the Ministry of Public Security and the People's Public Security University of China. In January 1953, the school was further reorganized into the Central People's Public Security College. Then, in January 1984, the State Council approved the reorganization of the Central People's Public Security College into the People's Public Security University of China.

description.zh-cn: 1998年2月24日，中国人民公安大学与中国人民警官大学合并组建成新的中国人民公安大学。
description.en: On February 24, 1998, the People's Public Security University of China and the Chinese People's Police Officer University merged to form the new People's Public Security University of China.

description.zh-cn: 为中国人民公安大学书写校名。
description.en: Wrote the name for the People's Public Security University of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾对学校建设做出批示。
description.en: Gave instructions on the construction of the university.

description.zh-cn: 曾对学校建设做出批示。
description.en: Gave instructions on the construction of the university.

description.zh-cn: 经中央人民政府政务院周恩来总理批准，华北公安干部学校于1950年1月11日改名为中央公安干部学校。1953年1月28日，周恩来总理再次批复同意将中央公安干部学校改组并命名为“人民公安学院”。
description.en: With the approval of Premier Zhou Enlai of the Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government, the North China Public Security Cadre School was renamed the Central Public Security Cadre School on January 11, 1950. Subsequently, on January 28, 1953, Premier Zhou Enlai again approved the reorganization of the Central Public Security Cadre School and its naming as 'People's Public Security College'.

description.zh-cn: 于1973年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in September 1973.

description.zh-cn: 曾任中共济南市委副书记。
description.en: Served as Deputy Secretary of the Jinan Municipal Committee of the CPC.

position.zh-cn: 市长, 市政府党组书记
position.en: Mayor, Secretary of the Municipal Government's Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 曾任济南市市长、市政府党组书记。
description.en: Served as Mayor of Jinan and Secretary of the Municipal Government's Party Leadership Group.

description.zh-cn: 张建国是山东沾化人。
description.en: Zhang Jianguo is from Zhanhua, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋是中国共产党的一位政治人物。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun was a political figure of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋是邓小平主政时期的重要政治人物和盟友，是中共八大元老之一。
description.en: Xi Zhongxun was an important political figure and ally during Deng Xiaoping's leadership, and was one of the Eight Great Eminent Officials of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 习近平是中共第五代领导集体的核心。
description.en: Xi Jinping is the core of the fifth generation of CPC leadership.

description.zh-cn: 习近平自2012年成为中国共产党第五代领导集体的最高领导人。
description.en: Xi Jinping became the paramount leader of the fifth generation of the CPC leadership collective in 2012.

description.zh-cn: 习仲勋陵园内有一座石碑，上刻毛泽东的话：『党的利益在第一位』。
description.en: There is a stone stele in the Xi Zhongxun Mausoleum inscribed with Mao Zedong's words: 'The interests of the Party come first'.

description.zh-cn: 在梁思成推荐下，高庄规范并简化了国徽的几何设计图稿，完成了最终定型。
description.en: Upon Liang Sicheng's recommendation, Gao Zhuang standardized and simplified the geometric design of the national emblem, completing its final version.

description.zh-cn: 其第二次会议通过决议，同意采用清华大学设计组的国徽方案。
description.en: Its second session passed a resolution to adopt the national emblem design proposed by the Tsinghua University design group.

description.zh-cn: 其第八次会议正式通过了中华人民共和国国徽图案。
description.en: Its eighth meeting officially adopted the design of the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 以中央人民政府主席的名义发布命令，正式公布了中华人民共和国国徽。
description.en: As Chairman of the Central People's Government, issued an order to officially promulgate the National Emblem of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来邀约并说服梁思成，要求其组织的国徽设计工作中必须包含天安门图案。
description.en: Zhou Enlai met with and persuaded Liang Sicheng, insisting that the national emblem design he was organizing must include the Tiananmen motif.

description.zh-cn: 国徽中的天安门图案象征着五四运动这一新民主主义革命的发源地。
description.en: The Tiananmen motif in the national emblem symbolizes the May Fourth Movement as the origin of the New Democratic Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华人民共和国的缔造者和执政党，主导了包括国徽在内的国家象征的创立。国徽的设计亦体现了其领导地位。
description.en: As the founder and ruling party of the PRC, it led the creation of national symbols, including the national emblem. The emblem's design also reflects its leadership role.

description.zh-cn: 其第十八次会议通过了《中华人民共和国国徽法》。
description.en: Its 18th session passed the 'Law of the People's Republic of China on the National Emblem'.

description.zh-cn: 该法律以立法的形式规范了国徽的使用，并确认了其法律地位。
description.en: This law legislatively standardizes the use of the national emblem and confirms its legal status.

description.zh-cn: 《宪法》规定了国徽的图案内容，并确认了其作为国家象征的法律地位。
description.en: The Constitution specifies the content of the national emblem's design and confirms its legal status as a national symbol.

description.zh-cn: RBMK反应堆的设计缺陷，特别是其正空泡系数和控制棒的“尖端效应”，在低功率运行时极不稳定，是导致功率剧增并引发爆炸的关键技术原因。
description.en: The design flaws of the RBMK reactor, particularly its positive void coefficient and the 'tip effect' of its control rods, made it extremely unstable at low power levels. This was a key technical reason for the power surge that caused the explosion.

description.zh-cn: 在爆炸后，阿基莫夫为试图恢复反应堆冷却而暴露在致命剂量的辐射下，于两周后因急性放射病去世。
description.en: After the explosion, Akimov was exposed to a lethal dose of radiation while trying to restore reactor cooling and died two weeks later from acute radiation syndrome.

description.zh-cn: 作为第一批到达现场的消防员，普拉维克在扑灭反应堆厂房屋顶大火时受到致命辐射，于1986年5月11日去世。
description.en: As one of the first firefighters to arrive, Pravik received a fatal dose of radiation while extinguishing the fire on the roof of the reactor building and died on May 11, 1986.

description.zh-cn: 为控制事故后果，苏联政府组织了大规模的清理行动，并在1986年12月前建成了“石棺”，用于封闭被摧毁的4号反应堆。
description.en: To control the consequences of the accident, the Soviet government organized a massive cleanup operation and built the 'Sarcophagus' by December 1986 to enclose the destroyed Reactor 4.

description.zh-cn: 事故导致普里皮亚季市的全部居民被紧急疏散，城市被完全废弃，成为核禁区的一部分。
description.en: The accident led to the emergency evacuation of the entire population of Pripyat, causing the city to be completely abandoned and become part of the nuclear exclusion zone.

description.zh-cn: 第四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议选举产生了第四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会。
description.en: The First Session of the 4th National People's Congress elected the Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 朱德在第四届全国人大常委会担任委员长，直至1976年7月6日逝世。
description.en: Zhu De served as the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress until his death on July 6, 1976.

description.zh-cn: 董必武在第四届全国人大常委会担任副委员长，直至1975年4月2日逝世。
description.en: Dong Biwu served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress until his death on April 2, 1975.

description.zh-cn: 康生在第四届全国人大常委会担任副委员长，直至1975年12月16日逝世。
description.en: Kang Sheng served as a Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress until his death on December 16, 1975.

description.zh-cn: 邓颖超于1975年1月17日担任委员。1976年12月2日，她在第四届全国人大常委会第三次会议上被补选为副委员长，直至1978年3月。
description.en: Deng Yingchao served as a Member from January 17, 1975. On December 2, 1976, she was by-elected as a Vice Chairwoman at the Third Session of the Standing Committee of the 4th National People's Congress, serving until March 1978.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世是路易七世的儿子。
description.en: Philip II was the son of Louis VII.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世是香槟的阿黛勒的儿子。
description.en: Philip II was the son of Adela of Champagne.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世于1180年4月28日与埃诺的伊莎贝尔结婚。
description.en: Philip II married Isabella of Hainault on April 28, 1180.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世于1193年与丹麦的英格堡结婚。
description.en: Philip II married Ingeborg of Denmark in 1193.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世于1196年与梅拉涅的阿格尼丝结婚。
description.en: Philip II married Agnes of Merania in 1196.

description.zh-cn: 路易八世是腓力二世的儿子。
description.en: Louis VIII was the son of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 路易八世是埃诺的伊莎贝尔的儿子。
description.en: Louis VIII was the son of Isabella of Hainault.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世出生于戈内斯。
description.en: Philip II was born in Gonesse.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世是卡佩王朝的国王。
description.en: Philip II was a king of the House of Capet.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世即位时继承的头衔是“法兰克国王”。
description.en: The title Philip II inherited upon his accession was "King of the Franks".

description.zh-cn: 从1190年起，腓力二世开始使用“法兰西国王”的头衔。
description.en: From 1190 onwards, Philip II began to use the title "King of France".

description.zh-cn: 路易八世在腓力二世去世后继承了法兰西王位。
description.en: Louis VIII succeeded to the throne of France after the death of Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世在路易七世去世后成为法兰西唯一的国王。
description.en: Philip II became the sole king of France after the death of Louis VII.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世与统治英格兰的金雀花王朝进行了长期的战争。
description.en: Philip II engaged in a long war with the Plantagenet dynasty, which ruled England.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世与理查一世在第三次十字军东征期间矛盾明显，之后腓力二世积极策划打击理查。
description.en: The conflict between Philip II and Richard I was evident during the Third Crusade, and afterwards, Philip actively plotted against Richard.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世反对约翰国王，并最终夺取了金雀花王朝在法国的大部分领地。
description.en: Philip II opposed King John and eventually seized most of the Plantagenet territories in France.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世在其统治初期致力于摆脱包括其舅父香槟伯爵亨利一世在内的摄政的束缚，后者也联合他人发起反对腓力二世的战争。
description.en: In his early reign, Philip II worked to free himself from the control of his regents, including his uncle Henry I, Count of Champagne, who also allied with others to wage war against Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 佛兰德伯爵阿尔萨斯的菲利普曾与香槟家族联合，发起一场反对腓力二世的战争。
description.en: Philip, Count of Flanders, allied with the House of Champagne to wage a war against Philip II.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世支持理查和约翰在亨利二世晚年发动的叛乱。
description.en: Philip II supported the rebellions of Richard and John during the later years of Henry II's reign.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世支持理查和约翰在亨利二世晚年发动的叛乱。
description.en: Philip II supported the rebellions of Richard and John during the later years of Henry II's reign.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世是第三次十字军东征的领袖之一，于1191年返回法兰西。
description.en: Philip II was one of the leaders of the Third Crusade, returning to France in 1191.

description.zh-cn: 理查一世是第三次十字军东征的领袖之一。
description.en: Richard I was one of the leaders of the Third Crusade.

description.zh-cn: 腓特烈一世是第三次十字军东征的领袖之一。
description.en: Frederick I was one of the leaders of the Third Crusade.

description.zh-cn: 布汶战役的胜利让法国一跃成为欧洲第一强国。
description.en: The victory at the Battle of Bouvines made France the foremost power in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 布汶战役标志着法兰西取代神圣罗马帝国成为欧洲大陆上最主要的国家。
description.en: The Battle of Bouvines marked France's replacement of the Holy Roman Empire as the most dominant power on the European continent.

description.zh-cn: 约翰于1203年俘虏了其侄子阿尔蒂尔一世，并据信下令将其杀害。
description.en: John captured his nephew Arthur I in 1203 and is believed to have ordered his murder.

description.zh-cn: 约翰与神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托四世结盟，约定从东西夹击腓力二世的法兰西王国。
description.en: John allied with Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV, agreeing to attack Philip II's Kingdom of France from the east and west.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利六世是腓力二世的重要盟友，他们在反对理查一世的问题上意见一致。
description.en: Holy Roman Emperor Henry VI was an important ally of Philip II, as they were in agreement on their opposition to Richard I.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利公爵利奥波德五世在理查一世从十字军东征返回途中将其俘虏。
description.en: Leopold V, Duke of Austria, captured Richard I on his way back from the Crusade.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利公爵利奥波德五世是神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利六世的封臣。
description.en: Leopold V, Duke of Austria, was a vassal of the Holy Roman Emperor Henry VI.

description.zh-cn: 神圣罗马帝国皇帝奥托四世受到教宗英诺森三世的孤立。
description.en: The Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV was isolated by Pope Innocent III.

description.zh-cn: 约在1200年，腓力二世在巴黎建立了一座方形城堡，这座城堡后来成为卢浮宫的前身。
description.en: Around 1200, Philip II built a square castle in Paris, which later became the precursor to the Louvre Palace.

description.zh-cn: 腓力二世于1200年正式批准了巴黎大学的成立。
description.en: Philip II formally approved the establishment of the University of Paris in 1200.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德是哈菲兹·阿萨德的次子。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad is the second son of Hafez al-Assad.

description.zh-cn: 在其长子巴塞勒·阿萨德于1994年去世后，哈菲兹·阿萨德决定培养其次子巴沙尔作为其政治接班人。
description.en: After the death of his eldest son Bassel al-Assad in 1994, Hafez al-Assad decided to groom his second son Bashar as his political successor.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德是巴塞勒·阿萨德的弟弟。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad is the younger brother of Bassel al-Assad.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德于2000年12月与阿斯玛·阿萨德结婚。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad married Asma al-Assad in December 2000.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德于1965年9月11日出生于大马士革。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad was born in Damascus on September 11, 1965.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德在大马士革大学学习医学，并于1988年毕业。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad studied medicine at Damascus University and graduated in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 在被确定为接班人后，巴沙尔·阿萨德进入霍姆斯军事学院学习。
description.en: After being designated as successor, Bashar al-Assad entered the Homs Military Academy to study.

description.zh-cn: 长年的叙利亚内战最终导致巴沙尔·阿萨德的政权被推翻。
description.en: The long-running Syrian Civil War ultimately led to the overthrow of Bashar al-Assad's regime.

description.zh-cn: 在阿萨德政权垮台后，俄罗斯政府为巴沙尔·阿萨德及其家人提供了政治庇护。
description.en: After the fall of the Assad regime, the Russian government granted political asylum to Bashar al-Assad and his family.

description.zh-cn: 2000年哈菲兹·阿萨德去世后，叙利亚议会立即将宪法规定的总统年龄下限从40岁调低到34岁，以便巴沙尔能顺利当选总统。
description.en: After Hafez al-Assad's death in 2000, the Syrian parliament immediately lowered the constitutional minimum age for the president from 40 to 34, allowing Bashar to be elected president smoothly.

description.zh-cn: 叙利亚占多数的逊尼派民众对由少数阿拉维派主导的阿萨德政权抱有深深的怨恨。
description.en: The Sunni majority in Syria harbored deep resentment towards the Assad regime, which was dominated by the Alawite minority.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德坚决反对美国在2003年发动的伊拉克战争。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad firmly opposed the 2003 Iraq War launched by the United States.

description.zh-cn: 美国对叙利亚政府军空军基地的导弹袭击是对阿萨德政权涉嫌使用化学武器的惩罚性打击。
description.en: The U.S. missile strike on a Syrian government airbase was a punitive action against the Assad regime for its alleged use of chemical weapons.

description.zh-cn: 法国法院就2012年霍姆斯市爆炸案向巴沙尔·阿萨德发出逮捕令。
description.en: A French court issued an arrest warrant for Bashar al-Assad in connection with the 2012 bombing of the city of Homs.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德于2010年与时任俄罗斯总统梅德韦杰夫会面。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad met with then-Russian President Dmitry Medvedev in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德于2010年与时任巴西总统卢拉会面。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad met with then-Brazilian President Lula in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德是阿萨德家族的核心成员。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad is a core member of the Assad family.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德于2000年7月17日至2024年12月8日担任叙利亚总统。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad served as the President of Syria from July 17, 2000, to December 8, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 巴沙尔·阿萨德于2000年6月18日至2024年12月8日担任阿拉伯复兴社会党－叙利亚地区总书记。
description.en: Bashar al-Assad served as the General Secretary of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region from June 18, 2000, to December 8, 2024.

position.zh-cn: 共和国卫队及第四装甲部队指挥官
position.en: Commander of the Republican Guard and 4th Armoured Division

description.zh-cn: 马赫尔·阿萨德领导的精锐部队是其兄长巴沙尔·阿萨德政权的重要军事支柱。
description.en: The elite forces led by Maher al-Assad were a key military pillar of his brother Bashar al-Assad's regime.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布是囊日论赞的儿子。
description.en: Songtsen Gampo was the son of Namri Songtsen.

description.zh-cn: 共日共赞是松赞干布的儿子。
description.en: Gungri Gungtsen was the son of Songtsen Gampo.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布迎娶了泥婆罗的尺尊公主为妻。
description.en: Songtsen Gampo married Princess Bhrikuti of Licchavi.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布是吐蕃帝国的建立者。
description.en: Songtsen Gampo was the founder of the Tibetan Empire.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布于629年至650年担任吐蕃赞普。
description.en: Songtsen Gampo served as the Tsenpo of Tibet from 629 to 650.

description.zh-cn: 娘·芒布杰尚囊是松赞干布时期的大臣和辅政者。
description.en: Nyang Mangpoje Shangnang was a minister and regent for Songtsen Gampo.

description.zh-cn: 琼波·邦色因嫉妒而向松赞干布诬告娘·芒布杰尚囊怀有二心。
description.en: Out of jealousy, Khyungpo Pungse falsely accused Nyang Mangpoje Shangnang of disloyalty to Songtsen Gampo.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布听信谗言，派兵包围并杀死了娘·芒布杰尚囊。
description.en: Believing the slander, Songtsen Gampo dispatched troops to surround and kill Nyang Mangpoje Shangnang.

description.zh-cn: 琼波·邦色在被松赞干布削去实权后，设宴图谋杀害赞普。
description.en: After being stripped of his real power by Songtsen Gampo, Khyungpo Pungse plotted to assassinate the Tsenpo at a banquet.

description.zh-cn: 禄东赞识破了琼波·邦色谋害松赞干布的阴谋，并将其报告给赞普，导致阴谋败露。
description.en: Gar Tongtsen saw through Khyungpo Pungse's plot to assassinate Songtsen Gampo and reported it to the Tsenpo, causing the conspiracy to fail.

description.zh-cn: 638年，松赞干布以吐谷浑阻碍其与唐朝和亲为由，出兵大破吐谷浑。
description.en: In 638, on the pretext that Tuyuhun was obstructing his marriage alliance with the Tang Dynasty, Songtsen Gampo dispatched troops and decisively defeated them.

description.zh-cn: 松州之战让唐朝认识到吐蕃的军事实力，从而推动唐太宗同意了和亲请求。
description.en: The Battle of Songzhou made the Tang Dynasty recognize the military strength of the Tibetan Empire, which pushed Emperor Taizong to agree to the marriage alliance.

description.zh-cn: 在松州之战中，唐将牛进达率领先锋部队击败了吐蕃军。
description.en: During the Battle of Songzhou, Tang general Niu Jinda led the vanguard force and defeated the Tibetan army.

description.zh-cn: 文成公主入藏后，吐蕃与唐朝成为盟国，在松赞干布在位期间和平共处。
description.en: After Princess Wencheng's arrival in Tibet, the Tibetan Empire and the Tang Dynasty became allies and coexisted peacefully for the remainder of Songtsen Gampo's reign.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布以其妹在象雄失宠为由，于642年亲率大兵攻灭了象雄。
description.en: Using his sister's mistreatment in Zhangzhung as a pretext, Songtsen Gampo personally led a large army and conquered Zhangzhung in 642.

description.zh-cn: 647年，在唐使王玄策遭天竺篡位者袭击后，松赞干布借给他精兵1200人及属国士兵7000余人用于讨伐。
description.en: In 647, after the Tang envoy Wang Xuance was attacked by a usurper in India, Songtsen Gampo lent him 1,200 elite soldiers and over 7,000 soldiers from vassal states for a punitive expedition.

description.zh-cn: 王玄策率领从吐蕃和泥婆罗借来的军队击败并生擒了阿罗那顺。
description.en: Wang Xuance led the troops borrowed from Tibet and Licchavi to defeat and capture Arunasva alive.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布派遣大臣吞弥桑布札前往天竺学习，以创制藏文。
description.en: Songtsen Gampo dispatched his minister Thonmi Sambhota to India to study in order to create a Tibetan script.

description.zh-cn: 吞弥桑布札参照梵文创制了藏文书写系统。
description.en: Thonmi Sambhota created the Tibetan writing system based on Sanskrit.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布通过与信奉佛教的邻国联姻，并将佛教引入吐蕃，还兴建了大昭寺、小昭寺等寺院，推动了佛教在吐蕃的传播。
description.en: Through marriage alliances with neighboring Buddhist countries, Songtsen Gampo introduced Buddhism to Tibet and built monasteries such as the Jokhang and Ramoche Temples, promoting the spread of Buddhism in Tibet.

description.zh-cn: 据苯教典籍记载，松赞干布曾压抑苯教，导致其寿命缩短。
description.en: According to Bon scriptures, Songtsen Gampo suppressed the Bon religion, which led to a shortening of his life.

description.zh-cn: 根据一种说法，松赞干布是被仇视佛教的苯教教徒暗杀而死的。
description.en: According to one account, Songtsen Gampo was assassinated by Bon followers who were hostile to Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 松赞干布将吐蕃的政治中心从琼结迁至拉萨，并将其定为首都。
description.en: Songtsen Gampo moved the political center of the Tibetan Empire from Chongye to Lhasa and established it as the capital.

description.zh-cn: 马凯毕业于中国人民大学政治经济学系政治经济学专业。
description.en: Ma Kai graduated from the Department of Political Economy, specializing in Political Economy, at Renmin University of China.

description.zh-cn: 在习近平担任总书记期间，马凯任中央政治局委员。
description.en: Ma Kai served as a member of the Politburo while Xi Jinping was the General Secretary.

position.en: Vice Premier of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 在李克强担任总理期间，马凯任国务院副总理。
description.en: Ma Kai served as Vice Premier of the State Council during Li Keqiang's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 国务院总理李克强提名为马凯为国务院副总理。
description.en: Premier Li Keqiang nominated Ma Kai as Vice Premier of the State Council.

position.zh-cn: 国家发改委主任、国务委员兼国务院秘书长
position.en: Director of the NDRC, State Councilor and Secretary-General of the State Council

description.zh-cn: 在温家宝担任总理期间，马凯先后担任国家发改委主任、国务委员和国务院秘书长。
description.en: During Wen Jiabao's premiership, Ma Kai successively served as Director of the NDRC, State Councilor, and Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国家主席胡锦涛发布主席令，任命马凯为国家发改委主任。
description.en: President Hu Jintao issued a presidential order appointing Ma Kai as the Director of the NDRC.

description.zh-cn: 刘鹤接替马凯出任国务院金融稳定发展委员会主任及国务院副总理。
description.en: Liu He succeeded Ma Kai as Director of the State Council Financial Stability and Development Committee and as Vice Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 马凯接替华建敏出任国务院秘书长。
description.en: Ma Kai succeeded Hua Jianmin as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 杨晶接替马凯出任国务院秘书长。
description.en: Yang Jing succeeded Ma Kai as Secretary-General of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 马凯接替曾培炎（原国家发展计划委员会主任）的职务，出任新组建的国家发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: Ma Kai succeeded Zeng Peiyan (former Director of the State Development Planning Commission) to become the director of the newly formed National Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张平接替马凯出任国家发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: Zhang Ping succeeded Ma Kai as Director of the National Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 马凯在文化大革命期间受冲击，被下放到五七干校劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ma Kai was impacted and sent to a May Seventh Cadre School to perform manual labor.

description.zh-cn: 中共十九届一中全会后，71岁的马凯卸任中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: After the First Plenary Session of the 19th CPC Central Committee, 71-year-old Ma Kai stepped down as a member of the CPC Central Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 立法院副院长是立法院的副首长。
description.en: The Vice President of the Legislative Yuan is the deputy head of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 《立法委员互选院长副院长办法》规定了立法院副院长的产生方式。
description.en: The 'Rules for the Election of the President and Vice President of the Legislative Yuan' stipulates the method for electing the Vice President of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 江启臣是现任立法院副院长。
description.en: Johnny Chiang is the current Vice President of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 林森为行宪前首任立法院副院长。
description.en: Lin Sen was the first Vice President of the Legislative Yuan before the constitution.

description.zh-cn: 陈立夫为行宪后首任立法院副院长。
description.en: Chen Lifu was the first Vice President of the Legislative Yuan after the constitution.

description.zh-cn: 1355年（龙凤元年），胡惟庸在和州投奔朱元璋，成为其下属。
description.en: In 1355, Hu Weiyong joined Zhu Yuanzhang in Hezhou, becoming his subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸被指控的谋反行为是胡惟庸案爆发的直接原因。
description.en: Hu Weiyong's alleged rebellion was the direct cause of the Hu Weiyong case.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案发生后，明太祖朱元璋废除了中书省。
description.en: After the Hu Weiyong case, Emperor Taizu of Ming (Zhu Yuanzhang) abolished the Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸案的直接政治后果是明太祖朱元璋决定永久废除丞相职位。
description.en: The direct political consequence of the Hu Weiyong case was Emperor Taizu's decision to permanently abolish the position of Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 刘基曾向朱元璋指出胡惟庸的缺点，认为任用他好比用劣马驾车，必然会坏事。
description.en: Liu Ji had pointed out Hu Weiyong's shortcomings to Emperor Taizu, comparing his appointment to harnessing a poor horse that would surely wreck the cart.

description.zh-cn: 刘基病重期间，胡惟庸奉命带医生探视，刘基服药后不久去世，时人因此怀疑胡惟庸下毒害死了刘基。
description.en: During Liu Ji's severe illness, Hu Weiyong was ordered to bring a doctor to see him. Liu Ji died shortly after taking the medicine, leading to suspicion that Hu Weiyong had poisoned him.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸与李善长为同乡，并结成姻亲，胡惟庸在谋反时曾积极拉拢李善长。
description.en: Hu Weiyong and Li Shanchang were from the same hometown and became relatives by marriage. Hu Weiyong actively tried to win over Li Shanchang for his rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 学士吴伯宗曾弹劾胡惟庸，但差点因此招来杀身之祸。
description.en: The scholar Wu Bozong once impeached Hu Weiyong, but nearly brought disaster upon himself as a result.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸派明州卫指挥林贤出海，联络日本，请求其出兵作为谋反的外应。
description.en: Hu Weiyong sent Mingzhou Guard commander Lin Xian to sea to contact Japan and request troops as external support for his rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 胡惟庸派元朝旧臣封绩向北元称臣，请求其出兵作为谋反的外应。
description.en: Hu Weiyong sent former Yuan official Feng Ji to pledge allegiance to the Northern Yuan and request troops as external support for his rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 周慧敏与倪震于2009年1月5日在香港注册结婚。
description.en: Vivian Chow and Joe Nieh registered their marriage in Hong Kong on January 5, 2009.

description.zh-cn: 倪震是作家倪匡的儿子。
description.en: Joe Nieh is the son of writer Ni Kuang.

description.zh-cn: 陈韵晴是古巨基的妻子。
description.en: Lorraine Chan is the wife of Leo Ku.

description.zh-cn: 自2013年起，陈韵晴接任周慧敏的经纪人一职。
description.en: Since 2013, Lorraine Chan has served as Vivian Chow's manager.

description.zh-cn: 周慧敏在香港电台期间曾与黄凯芹合作主持节目《二人世界》，并多次合唱歌曲，如《情未了》。周慧敏曾出席黄凯芹的演唱会并合唱，黄凯芹也曾担任周慧敏演唱会的嘉宾。
description.en: During her time at RTHK, Vivian Chow co-hosted the program 'A World for Two' with Christopher Wong and collaborated on several songs, such as 'Love Ends Not'. Chow has attended Wong's concerts as a guest performer, and he has also been a guest at her concerts.

description.zh-cn: 1991年，周慧敏听从郑丹瑞的建议，放弃唱片骑师的职务，专注于乐坛事业。
description.en: In 1991, Vivian Chow followed Lawrence Cheng's advice to give up her job as a disc jockey and focus on her music career.

description.zh-cn: 周慧敏与李克勤是香港电台唱片骑师训练班的同期同学，之后有过多次音乐合作，包括合唱歌曲《万千宠爱在一身》及作为演唱会嘉宾。
description.en: Vivian Chow and Hacken Lee were classmates in the RTHK DJ training class and subsequently collaborated on music multiple times, including the duet 'All the Love in One' and appearing as concert guests for each other.

description.zh-cn: 2018年1月，盛茂林接替臧献甫出任中国人民政治协商会议天津市委员会主席。
description.en: In January 2018, Sheng Maolin succeeded Zang Xianfu as Chairman of the CPPCC Tianjin Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2023年1月14日，盛茂林卸任中国人民政治协商会议天津市委员会主席，由王常松接任。
description.en: On January 14, 2023, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Chairman of the CPPCC Tianjin Municipal Committee, and was succeeded by Wang Changsong.

description.zh-cn: 2017年3月，盛茂林接替尹德明出任中共天津市委组织部部长。
description.en: In March 2017, Sheng Maolin succeeded Yin Deming as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，盛茂林卸任中共天津市委组织部部长，由喻云林接任。
description.en: In March 2018, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee, and was succeeded by Yu Yunlin.

description.zh-cn: 2014年9月，盛茂林接替汤涛出任中共山西省委组织部部长。
description.en: In September 2014, Sheng Maolin succeeded Tang Tao as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2017年4月，盛茂林卸任中共山西省委组织部部长，由吴汉圣接任。
description.en: In April 2017, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Director of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanxi Provincial Committee, and was succeeded by Wu Hansheng.

description.zh-cn: 2007年4月，盛茂林卸任中共邵阳市委书记，由黄天锡接任。
description.en: In April 2007, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Secretary of the CPC Shaoyang Municipal Committee, and was succeeded by Huang Tianxi.

description.zh-cn: 2000年4月，盛茂林卸任中共资兴市委书记，由戴道晋接任。2012年3月，盛茂林卸任湖南省人民政府秘书长，同样由戴道晋接任。
description.en: In April 2000, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Secretary of the CPC Zixing Municipal Committee, and was succeeded by Dai Daojin. In March 2012, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Secretary-General of the Hunan Provincial People's Government, and was also succeeded by Dai Daojin.

description.zh-cn: 2010年3月，盛茂林接替武吉海出任湖南省人民政府秘书长。
description.en: In March 2010, Sheng Maolin succeeded Wu Jihai as Secretary-General of the Hunan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 2004年5月，盛茂林卸任湖南省人口和计划生育委员会主任，由李万郴接任。
description.en: In May 2004, Sheng Maolin stepped down as Director of the Hunan Provincial Population and Family Planning Commission, and was succeeded by Li Wanchen.

description.zh-cn: 斯坦福·莱佛士爵士于1823年6月5日创办了莱佛士书院。
description.en: Sir Stamford Raffles founded Raffles Institution on June 5, 1823.

description.zh-cn: 李光耀是莱佛士书院的校友，后来成为新加坡的首任总理。
description.en: Lee Kuan Yew was an alumnus of Raffles Institution and later became the first Prime Minister of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 吴作栋是莱佛士书院的校友，后来成为新加坡的第二任总理。
description.en: Goh Chok Tong was an alumnus of Raffles Institution and later became the second Prime Minister of Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡教育部于2008年10月3日批准了莱佛士书院与莱佛士初级学院的合并请求，合并于2009年1月1日生效。
description.en: On October 3, 2008, the Singapore Ministry of Education approved the merger proposal of Raffles Institution and Raffles Junior College, which took effect on January 1, 2009.

description.zh-cn: 1942年新加坡被日军占领后，莱佛士书院被征用为日本军营，导致学校无法正常运作。
description.en: After the Japanese occupation of Singapore in 1942, Raffles Institution was commandeered as a military barracks, preventing the school from operating normally.

description.zh-cn: 莱佛士书院由英国人创办，并仿照英国公学模式办学。
description.en: Raffles Institution was founded by a Briton and was modeled after British public schools.

description.zh-cn: 莱佛士书院是新加坡教育部管辖下的一所政府中学。
description.en: Raffles Institution is a government secondary school under the jurisdiction of the Singapore Ministry of Education.

description.zh-cn: 1992年，新加坡《海峡时报》将莱佛士书院评为新加坡最好的中学。
description.en: In 1992, Singapore's 'The Straits Times' named Raffles Institution the best secondary school in Singapore.

description.zh-cn: 新加坡国家图书馆起源于莱佛士书院的图书馆。
description.en: The National Library of Singapore originated from the library of Raffles Institution.

description.zh-cn: 于1923年，莱佛士书院百年校庆之际，与宋旺相爵士共同建成了学校图书馆。
description.en: In 1923, during the school's centennial, he co-established the school library with Sir Song Ong Siang.

description.zh-cn: 于1923年，莱佛士书院百年校庆之际，与林文庆先生共同建成了学校图书馆。
description.en: In 1923, during the school's centennial, he co-established the school library with Mr. Lim Boon Keng.

description.zh-cn: 莱佛士书院与莱佛士女子中学、莱佛士初级学院共同开设直通车课程（莱佛士课程）。
description.en: Raffles Institution, along with Raffles Girls' School and Raffles Junior College, offers the Integrated Programme (Raffles Programme).

description.zh-cn: 于1994年3月25日为莱佛士书院宿舍综合体奠基。
description.en: Laid the foundation stone for the Raffles Institution boarding complex on March 25, 1994.

position.zh-cn: 马来亚联合邦首席部长
position.en: Chief Minister of the Federation of Malaya

description.zh-cn: 在马来亚独立前，作为首席部长向英国女王（国家元首）负责。
description.en: As Chief Minister before Malayan independence, he was responsible to the British Monarch (Head of State).

description.zh-cn: 在东姑阿都拉曼担任首相期间，敦阿都拉萨是其副手。
description.en: Tun Abdul Razak was the deputy to Tunku Abdul Rahman during his tenure as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 领导马来亚联合邦取得独立。
description.en: Led the Federation of Malaya to achieve independence.

description.zh-cn: 于1961年提出成立马来西亚联邦的计划，并于1963年实现。
description.en: Proposed the plan to form the Federation of Malaysia in 1961, which was realized in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 1969年的五一三事件导致东姑阿都拉曼面临各方压力，最终于1970年辞去首相职务。
description.en: The 13 May incident in 1969 led to pressure from various parties, causing Tunku Abdul Rahman to resign as Prime Minister in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 由于与新加坡的政治分歧，东姑阿都拉曼在马来西亚国会推动新加坡退出联邦，最终促成其独立。
description.en: Due to political disagreements with Singapore, Tunku Abdul Rahman pushed for Singapore's withdrawal from the federation in the Malaysian Parliament, ultimately leading to its independence.

description.zh-cn: 在吉打华玲举行的“华玲会谈”中会面，试图结束马来亚紧急状态。
description.en: Met during the 'Baling Talks' in Baling, Kedah, in an attempt to end the Malayan Emergency.

description.zh-cn: 在吉打华玲举行的“华玲会谈”中会面，试图结束马来亚紧急状态。
description.en: Met during the 'Baling Talks' in Baling, Kedah, in an attempt to end the Malayan Emergency.

description.zh-cn: 1968年，东姑阿都拉曼与时任印度总理英迪拉·甘地会面。
description.en: In 1968, Tunku Abdul Rahman met with the then Prime Minister of India, Indira Gandhi.

description.zh-cn: 东姑阿都拉曼于1951年8月接替翁惹化成为巫统主席，构成职务接替关系。
description.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman succeeded Onn Ja'afar as the president of UMNO in August 1951, constituting a succession relationship.

description.zh-cn: 马哈迪·莫哈末在1991年国庆日前夕赞扬东姑阿都拉曼成功团结三大民族争取独立。
description.en: On the eve of National Day in 1991, Mahathir Mohamad praised Tunku Abdul Rahman for successfully uniting the three major ethnic groups to fight for independence.

description.zh-cn: 宫慕久在设立上海英租界时担任上海道台。
description.en: Gong Muju served as the Daotai of Shanghai at the time of the establishment of the Shanghai British Concession.

description.zh-cn: 巴富尔是英国派驻上海的首任领事。
description.en: George Balfour was the first consul appointed by the United Kingdom to Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 为应对租界日渐复杂的形势，英国领事阿礼国于1853年6月首次建议在沪的英法美三国建立统一行政机构，即后来的工部局。
description.en: To cope with the increasingly complex situation in the concession, British Consul Rutherford Alcock first suggested in June 1853 that the British, French, and American communities in Shanghai establish a unified administrative body, which later became the Municipal Council.

description.zh-cn: 法国公使布尔布隆要求法国政府不要批准《土地章程》，导致法国最终未能加入由工部局管理的统一租界体系。
description.en: French Minister Alphonse de Bourboulon requested that the French government not approve the Land Regulations, which led to France ultimately not joining the unified concession system managed by the Municipal Council.

description.zh-cn: 因性骚扰指控而辞去总监职务。
description.en: Resigned from the position of General Director due to sexual harassment allegations.

description.zh-cn: 普拉西多·多明哥在墨西哥确诊感染SARS-CoV-2病毒，并入院接受治疗。
description.en: Plácido Domingo tested positive for the SARS-CoV-2 virus in Mexico and was hospitalized for treatment.

description.zh-cn: 作为“三大男高音”的成员共同举办演唱会。
description.en: Performed together as members of 'The Three Tenors'.

description.zh-cn: 作为“三大男高音”的成员共同举办演唱会。
description.en: Performed together as members of 'The Three Tenors'.

description.zh-cn: 首场三大男高音演唱会于1990年世界杯期间在罗马举行。
description.en: The first Three Tenors concert was held in Rome during the 1990 FIFA World Cup.

description.zh-cn: 为歌剧《秦始皇》作曲。
description.en: Composed the opera 'The First Emperor'.

description.zh-cn: 2002年11月在台湾演出时，邀请江蕙合唱歌曲《雨夜花》。
description.en: Invited Jody Chiang to sing a duet of the song 'Rainy Night Flower' during his performance in Taiwan in November 2002.

description.zh-cn: 是皇家马德里的铁杆粉丝，并为其演唱过队歌。
description.en: Is a staunch fan of Real Madrid and has sung the club's anthem.

description.zh-cn: 在苏共二十大期间，尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫担任苏联共产党中央委员会第一书记。
description.en: During the 20th Congress of the CPSU, Nikita Khrushchev served as the First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union.

position.en: First Secretary of the Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 博莱斯瓦夫·贝鲁特是波兰统一工人党中央第一书记。
description.en: Bolesław Bierut was the First Secretary of the Central Committee of the Polish United Workers' Party.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫在苏共二十大的总结报告上，针对当时的国际形势，提出了“三和路线”。
description.en: In his concluding report at the 20th Congress of the CPSU, Khrushchev proposed the "Three Peacefuls" line in response to the international situation at the time.

description.zh-cn: 苏共二十大对斯大林的批判直接引发了在其故乡格鲁吉亚的大规模抗议示威。
description.en: The criticism of Stalin at the 20th Congress of the CPSU directly triggered large-scale protest demonstrations in his homeland of Georgia.

description.zh-cn: 苏共二十大对斯大林的批判和对个人崇拜的否定，正式开启了“赫鲁晓夫解冻”时期。
description.en: The criticism of Stalin and the rejection of the cult of personality at the 20th Congress of the CPSU officially initiated the period of the "Khrushchev Thaw".

description.zh-cn: 苏联当局动用军队镇压了因批判斯大林而引发的格鲁吉亚示威，造成人员伤亡。
description.en: Soviet authorities used the armed forces to suppress the demonstrations in Georgia, which were triggered by the criticism of Stalin, resulting in casualties.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔巴尼亚劳动党在苏共二十大后立即开始了反对赫鲁晓夫领导层修正主义观点的斗争。
description.en: Immediately after the 20th Congress of the CPSU, the Party of Labour of Albania began its struggle against the revisionist views of Khrushchev's leadership.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平认为苏共二十大的一个重要功绩是“告诉我们，把个人神化会引发多么严重的后果”，影响了他的政治思想。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping believed that a significant merit of the 20th Congress of the CPSU was that it "told us what serious consequences can be brought about by the deification of an individual," which influenced his political thought.

description.zh-cn: 苏共二十大后，匈牙利领导人拉科西·马加什因对去斯大林化阳奉阴违，在苏共压力下被迫下台。
description.en: After the 20th Congress of the CPSU, Hungarian leader Mátyás Rákosi was forced to step down under Soviet pressure for his passive resistance to de-Stalinization.

description.zh-cn: 苏共二十大后的去斯大林化运动以及在匈牙利造成的人事变动，是引发1956年匈牙利革命的重要因素。
description.en: The de-Stalinization movement following the 20th Congress of the CPSU and the resulting personnel changes in Hungary were important factors that triggered the Hungarian Revolution of 1956.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫与美国总统约翰·肯尼迪于1961年在维也纳会面，并有电文往来，讨论美苏合作。
description.en: Khrushchev met with US President John F. Kennedy in Vienna in 1961 and exchanged messages to discuss US-Soviet cooperation.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年是唐翔千的儿子。
description.en: Henry Tang is the son of Tang Hsiang-chien.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年的父亲唐翔千与江泽民甚有渊源，二人称兄道弟。
description.en: Henry Tang's father, Tang Hsiang-chien, had a deep connection with Jiang Zemin, and they referred to each other as brothers.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年承认自己年轻时曾多次与江泽民见面，两人关系甚佳。
description.en: Henry Tang admitted to having met Jiang Zemin multiple times in his youth, stating they had a very good relationship.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年于2007年至2011年期间担任香港特别行政区政务司司长。
description.en: Henry Tang served as the Chief Secretary for Administration of the HKSAR from 2007 to 2011.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年于2003年至2007年期间担任香港特别行政区财政司司长。
description.en: Henry Tang served as the Financial Secretary of the HKSAR from 2003 to 2007.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年于2002年至2003年期间担任工商及科技局局长。
description.en: Henry Tang served as the Secretary for Commerce, Industry and Technology from 2002 to 2003.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年曾两度出任西九文化区管理局董事局主席，第一任期为2010年至2011年，第二任期自2017年开始，预计至2025年结束。
description.en: Henry Tang has twice served as the Chairman of the Board of the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority, with his first term from 2010 to 2011 and his second term starting in 2017, expected to end in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年自2013年起担任全国政协常务委员。
description.en: Henry Tang has served as a Standing Committee Member of the CPPCC National Committee since 2013.

description.zh-cn: 唐英年在1993年至2002年期间为自由党成员，后因加入政府而退党。
description.en: Henry Tang was a member of the Liberal Party from 1993 to 2002, leaving the party to join the government.

description.zh-cn: 在董建华担任行政长官期间，唐英年先后出任工商及科技局局长（2002-2003）和财政司司长（2003-2005）。
description.en: During Tung Chee-hwa's tenure as Chief Executive, Henry Tang served as Secretary for Commerce, Industry and Technology (2002-2003) and subsequently as Financial Secretary (2003-2005).

description.zh-cn: 在曾荫权担任行政长官期间，唐英年先后出任财政司司长（2005-2007）和政务司司长（2007-2011）。
description.en: During Donald Tsang's tenure as Chief Executive, Henry Tang served as Financial Secretary (2005-2007) and subsequently as Chief Secretary for Administration (2007-2011).

description.zh-cn: 因维港巨星汇事件，时任投资推广署署长卢维思被裁定失职。他随后提出司法覆核，并揭发唐英年试图修改会议纪录以推卸责任，最终卢维思胜诉。
description.en: Following the Harbour Fest event, Mike Rowse, then Director-General of Investment Promotion, was found guilty of misconduct. He later filed for a judicial review, revealing that Henry Tang had attempted to alter meeting minutes to evade responsibility. Rowse ultimately won the case.

description.zh-cn: 时任行政长官林郑月娥于2017年9月18日委任唐英年出任西九文化区管理局董事局主席。
description.en: On September 18, 2017, then-Chief Executive Carrie Lam appointed Henry Tang as the Chairman of the Board of the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority.

description.zh-cn: 行政长官李家超于2023年再度委任唐英年为西九文化区管理局主席，任期至2025年。
description.en: In 2023, Chief Executive John Lee re-appointed Henry Tang as the Chairman of the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority for a term extending to 2025.

description.zh-cn: 在处理新界村屋僭建问题上，唐英年主张“以和为贵”，与时任发展局局长林郑月娥严厉执法的立场产生冲突。
description.en: Regarding the issue of unauthorized building works in New Territories village houses, Henry Tang advocated for a conciliatory approach, clashing with the strict enforcement stance of then-Secretary for Development Carrie Lam.

description.zh-cn: 娜塔莎·皮尔茨·穆萨尔是斯洛文尼亚的现任总统。
description.en: Nataša Pirc Musar is the current President of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 罗伯特·戈洛布是斯洛文尼亚的现任总理。
description.en: Robert Golob is the current Prime Minister of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 国民议会是斯洛文尼亚议会的下议院。
description.en: The National Assembly is the lower house of the Slovenian Parliament.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人国与塞尔维亚王国合并，成立了塞尔维亚人、克罗埃西亚人和斯洛维尼亚人王国（后更名为南斯拉夫王国）。
description.en: The State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs merged with the Kingdom of Serbia to form the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes (later renamed the Kingdom of Yugoslavia).

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，纳粹德国兼并了斯洛文尼亚的中、西和东部。
description.en: During World War II, Nazi Germany annexed the central, western, and eastern parts of Slovenia.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，义大利王国兼并了斯洛文尼亚，首都卢比安纳及西部被并入义大利。
description.en: During World War II, the Kingdom of Italy annexed Slovenia, incorporating the capital Ljubljana and western parts into Italy.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战期间，匈牙利王国兼并了斯洛文尼亚的部分领土。
description.en: During World War II, the Kingdom of Hungary annexed parts of Slovenian territory.

description.zh-cn: 南斯拉夫领导人铁托在世时维持了联邦的统一；其于1980年逝世后，斯洛文尼亚政府开始进行一系列寻求更大自主权的政治经济改革，最终导向独立。
description.en: Yugoslav leader Tito maintained the unity of the federation during his lifetime; after his death in 1980, the Slovenian government began a series of political and economic reforms seeking greater autonomy, which eventually led to independence.

description.zh-cn: 斯洛文尼亚在十日战争中成功抵抗了南斯拉夫军队，确保了国家的独立。
description.en: Slovenia successfully resisted the Yugoslav army in the Ten-Day War, securing the country's independence.

description.zh-cn: 在斯洛文尼亚宣布独立后，南斯拉夫派兵宣战，试图阻止其独立，引发了十日战争。
description.en: After Slovenia declared independence, Yugoslavia sent troops and declared war in an attempt to prevent its secession, triggering the Ten-Day War.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲共同体于1992年承认斯洛文尼亚为独立国家。
description.en: The European Community recognized Slovenia as an independent state in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 清朝迁都北京后，将沈阳（盛京）设为陪都。
description.en: After the Qing dynasty moved its capital to Beijing, it established Shenyang (Shengjing) as a secondary capital.

description.zh-cn: 张学良将奉天市改名为沈阳市。
description.en: Zhang Xueliang renamed Fengtian City to Shenyang City.

description.zh-cn: 满洲国政权将沈阳市改回奉天市的旧称。
description.en: The Manchukuo regime reverted the name of Shenyang City to its former name, Fengtian.

description.zh-cn: 辽沈战役的胜利使中国人民解放军控制了沈阳及东北全境。
description.en: The victory in the Liaoshen Campaign allowed the People's Liberation Army to control Shenyang and the entire Northeast.

description.zh-cn: 辽沈战役导致中华民国国军在东北战场的失败。
description.en: The Liaoshen Campaign resulted in the defeat of the National Revolutionary Army in the Northeast theater.

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛和温家宝的推动下，国务院成立了东北振兴办公室，实施振兴东北战略。
description.en: Under the promotion of Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao, the State Council established the Northeast Revitalization Office to implement the strategy of revitalizing the Northeast.

description.zh-cn: 在胡锦涛和温家宝的推动下，国务院成立了东北振兴办公室，实施振兴东北战略。
description.en: Under the promotion of Hu Jintao and Wen Jiabao, the State Council established the Northeast Revitalization Office to implement the strategy of revitalizing the Northeast.

description.zh-cn: 1932年洛杉矶奥运会前，中国奥运第一人刘长春是东北大学的学生。
description.en: Before the 1932 Los Angeles Olympics, Liu Changchun, the first Chinese Olympian, was a student at Northeastern University.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇是刘岱的弟弟。
description.en: Liu Yao is the younger brother of Liu Dai.

description.zh-cn: 刘宠是刘繇的伯父。
description.en: Liu Chong is Liu Yao's paternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 刘基是刘繇的儿子。
description.en: Liu Ji is the son of Liu Yao.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇因畏惧袁术及孙氏势力的扩张，驱逐了袁术的部下吴景和孙贲，导致双方关系破裂，袁术随后派兵攻打刘繇的部将。
description.en: Fearing the expansion of Yuan Shu and the Sun clan's power, Liu Yao expelled Yuan Shu's subordinates Wu Jing and Sun Ben, causing their relationship to rupture. Yuan Shu subsequently dispatched troops to attack Liu Yao's generals.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇因忌惮孙氏和袁术的势力而将吴景驱逐出曲阿。
description.en: Due to his fear of the influence of the Sun clan and Yuan Shu, Liu Yao expelled Wu Jing from Qu'a.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇因忌惮孙氏和袁术的势力而将孙贲驱逐出曲阿。
description.en: Due to his fear of the influence of the Sun clan and Yuan Shu, Liu Yao expelled Sun Ben from Qu'a.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇兵败于孙策后，采纳许劭的建议退守豫章，并与荆州牧刘表联合对抗袁术。
description.en: After being defeated by Sun Ce, Liu Yao took Xu Shao's advice to retreat to Yuzhang and allied with Liu Biao, the Governor of Jing Province, to resist Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇不识太史慈的能力，只派他做侦查工作，未能善用其才。
description.en: Liu Yao did not recognize Taishi Ci's abilities and only assigned him to reconnaissance duties, failing to make good use of his talents.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇出兵协助朝廷任命的豫章太守朱皓，将袁术任命的太守诸葛玄赶走。
description.en: Liu Yao dispatched troops to assist Zhu Hao, the Grand Administrator of Yuzhang appointed by the Han court, and drove out Zhuge Xuan, who was appointed by Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 刘繇出兵协助朱皓，对抗诸葛玄以争夺豫章太守之位。
description.en: Liu Yao sent troops to assist Zhu Hao in fighting against Zhuge Xuan for the position of Grand Administrator of Yuzhang.

description.zh-cn: 笮融奉刘繇之命增援朱皓，却趁机诱杀了朱皓，夺取了豫章郡。
description.en: Under Liu Yao's orders, Ze Rong went to reinforce Zhu Hao, but instead, he lured and killed Zhu Hao, seizing control of Yuzhang Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 在笮融杀害朱皓后，刘繇起兵讨伐笮融，最终将其击败。
description.en: After Ze Rong killed Zhu Hao, Liu Yao raised an army to attack Ze Rong and eventually defeated him.

description.zh-cn: 诸葛亮在《后出师表》中以刘繇等人为例，劝谏刘禅要吸取历史教训，避免重蹈覆辙。
description.en: In the 'Later Memorial on Dispatching the Troops', Zhuge Liang used Liu Yao and others as examples to advise Liu Shan to learn from historical lessons and avoid repeating past mistakes.

description.zh-cn: 吸收安学林加入中共在台组织。
description.en: Recruited An Xuelin to join the CCP organization in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 与陈顺福、余熙同属一个活动小组。
description.en: Belonged to the same activity small group with Chen Shunfu and Yu Xi.

description.zh-cn: 与余熙、陈顺福同属一个活动小组。
description.en: Belonged to the same activity small group with Yu Xi and Chen Shunfu.

description.zh-cn: 因参与中共在台情报活动，判处安学林死刑并予以枪决。
description.en: Sentenced An Xuelin to death and executed him for participating in CCP intelligence activities in Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 派遣朱芳春（于非）赴台发展情报组织。
description.en: Dispatched Zhu Fangchun (Yu Fei) to Taiwan to develop an intelligence organization.

description.zh-cn: 派遣萧明华赴台发展情报组织。
description.en: Dispatched Xiao Minghua to Taiwan to develop an intelligence organization.

description.zh-cn: 派遣周一粟赴台发展情报组织。
description.en: Dispatched Zhou Yisu to Taiwan to develop an intelligence organization.

description.zh-cn: 在朱芳春（于非）领导下负责军事情报搜集工作。
description.en: Was responsible for military intelligence gathering under the leadership of Zhu Fangchun (Yu Fei).

description.zh-cn: 被中共国家安全部追认为中华人民共和国烈士。
description.en: Was posthumously recognized as a Martyr of the People's Republic of China by the Ministry of State Security of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 追认安学林为烈士。
description.en: Posthumously recognized An Xuelin as a martyr.

description.zh-cn: 判处死刑并予以枪决。
description.en: Sentenced to death and executed by firing squad.

description.zh-cn: 卢志强现任中国民间商会副会长。
description.en: Lu Zhiqiang currently serves as the Vice Chairman of the China Chamber of Commerce for the Private Sector.

description.zh-cn: 卢志强担任中国泛海控股集团董事长兼总裁。
description.en: Lu Zhiqiang serves as the Chairman and President of China Oceanwide Holdings Group.

description.zh-cn: 卢志强于1952年出生于山东威海。
description.en: Lu Zhiqiang was born in Weihai, Shandong in 1952.

description.zh-cn: 卢志强毕业于复旦大学经济学系。
description.en: Lu Zhiqiang graduated from the Department of Economics at Fudan University.

description.zh-cn: 卢志强是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Lu Zhiqiang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，卢志强当选第十一届全国政协常务委员，代表中华全国工商业联合会。
description.en: In 2008, Lu Zhiqiang was elected as a Standing Committee Member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC, representing the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce.

description.zh-cn: 卢志强曾担任全国政协经济委员会专委。
description.en: Lu Zhiqiang served as a special committee member of the Economic Committee of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2024年1月26日，深圳证券交易所决定终止泛海控股股份有限公司的股票上市。
description.en: On January 26, 2024, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange decided to terminate the listing of the shares of China Oceanwide Holdings Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，卢志强是第九届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Lu Zhiqiang was a member of the 9th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，卢志强是第十届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Lu Zhiqiang was a member of the 10th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，卢志强是第十二届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Lu Zhiqiang was a member of the 12th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: Chuck Robbins担任思科系统的首席执行官兼董事长。
description.en: Chuck Robbins serves as the CEO & Chairman of Cisco Systems.

description.zh-cn: 思科于2003年3月收购了Linksys，使其成为旗下子公司，后于2013年1月将其出售。
description.en: Cisco acquired Linksys in March 2003, making it a subsidiary, and later sold it in January 2013.

description.zh-cn: 思科于2023年9月以280亿美元收购了资安公司Splunk。
description.en: Cisco acquired the cybersecurity company Splunk for $28 billion in September 2023.

description.zh-cn: 思科被批评参与了中华人民共和国的互联网审查机制，向中国政府提供了具有流量监控和过滤功能的互联网设备。
description.en: Cisco has been criticized for participating in the People's Republic of China's internet censorship mechanism by providing the Chinese government with internet equipment featuring traffic monitoring and filtering capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 一份泄露的思科机密文档显示，思科和中国政府在金盾工程上具有商业性质的合作。
description.en: A leaked confidential Cisco document revealed that Cisco and the Chinese government had commercial cooperation on the Golden Shield Project.

description.zh-cn: 爱德华·史诺登于2013年6月向媒体泄露了棱镜计划的机密信息，从而揭露了该计划的存在。
description.en: Edward Snowden leaked classified information about the PRISM program to the media in June 2013, thereby exposing its existence.

description.zh-cn: 2015年11月，思科与安谋、戴尔、英特尔、微软和普林斯顿大学共同成立了OpenFog Consortium，以促进雾计算的发展。
description.en: In November 2015, Cisco, along with Arm, Dell, Intel, Microsoft, and Princeton University, co-founded the OpenFog Consortium to promote the development of fog computing.

description.zh-cn: 荣德生是荣宗敬的胞弟。
description.en: Rong Desheng is the younger brother of Rong Zongjing.

description.zh-cn: 荣毅仁是荣德生的儿子。
description.en: Rong Yiren is the son of Rong Desheng.

description.zh-cn: 荣德生出生于江苏省无锡县。
description.en: Rong Desheng was born in Wuxi County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 1941年，荣德生严词拒绝了汪精卫政权提出的、要求其将名下纱厂卖给日本厂商的要求。
description.en: In 1941, Rong Desheng sternly rejected the demand from the Wang Jingwei regime to sell his yarn mills to Japanese manufacturers.

description.zh-cn: 1946年4月25日，时任淞沪警备司令部警卫队长的黄锦堂参与绑架了荣德生，直至5月28日荣德生被释放。
description.en: On April 25, 1946, Huang Jintang, then captain of the guard at the Songhu Garrison Command, participated in the kidnapping of Rong Desheng, who was released on May 28.

description.zh-cn: 荣德生被绑架后，蒋介石严令限期破案，推动了荣德生的最终获释。
description.en: After Rong Desheng was kidnapped, Chiang Kai-shek ordered a deadline for solving the case, which pushed for Rong's eventual release.

description.zh-cn: 时任淞沪警备司令部第二处处长毛森通过侦查最终破获绑架案，促成了荣德生的获救。
description.en: Mao Sen, then director of the Second Division of the Songhu Garrison Command, solved the kidnapping case through investigation, contributing to the rescue of Rong Desheng.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，荣德生历任中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会委员。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Rong Desheng served as a member of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，荣德生历任华东军政委员会副主任。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Rong Desheng served as Vice Chairman of the East China Military and Political Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，荣德生历任苏南行政公署副主任。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Rong Desheng served as Vice Director of the Sunan Administrative Office.

description.zh-cn: 荣鸿仁是荣德生的儿子。
description.en: Rong Hongren is the son of Rong Desheng.

description.zh-cn: 荣智健是荣毅仁的儿子。
description.en: Rong Zhijian is the son of Rong Yiren.

description.zh-cn: 2001年9月至2004年8月，在同济大学经济与管理学院管理科学与工程专业在职研究生学习，获管理学博士学位。
description.en: From September 2001 to August 2004, he pursued on-the-job postgraduate studies in Management Science and Engineering at the School of Economics and Management, Tongji University, and obtained a Doctor of Management degree.

description.zh-cn: 1973年9月加入中国共产党，2017年1月4日被开除党籍。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in September 1973, and was expelled from the party on January 4, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 2016年12月25日，其第十二届全国人民代表大会代表的职务被罢免。
description.en: On December 25, 2016, he was dismissed from his position as a deputy to the 12th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在张高丽担任中共天津市委书记期间，黄兴国担任天津市市长。
description.en: While Zhang Gaoli was the Communist Party Secretary of Tianjin, Huang Xingguo served as the Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 在孙春兰担任中共天津市委书记期间，黄兴国担任天津市市长。
description.en: While Sun Chunlan was the Communist Party Secretary of Tianjin, Huang Xingguo served as the Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 接替调往中央的孙春兰，代理中共天津市委书记职务。
description.en: Succeeded Sun Chunlan, who was transferred to the central government, as the acting Communist Party Secretary of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 接替落马的黄兴国，出任中共天津市委书记。
description.en: Succeeded the disgraced Huang Xingguo as the Communist Party Secretary of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 接替戴相龙，出任天津市代市长。
description.en: Succeeded Dai Xianglong as the acting Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 在黄兴国被免职后，王东峰继任天津市市长。
description.en: After Huang Xingguo was dismissed, Wang Dongfeng succeeded him as the Mayor of Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 宣布黄兴国因涉嫌严重违纪，正在接受组织调查。
description.en: Announced that Huang Xingguo was under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary violations.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴国是中共十八大以来首位落马的直辖市党政一把手。
description.en: Huang Xingguo was the first sitting party-government head of a direct-controlled municipality to be investigated since the 18th CPC National Congress.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴国作为时任天津市市长，表示要对该事故负起主要责任，此事对其政治生涯造成负面影响。
description.en: As the mayor of Tianjin at the time, Huang Xingguo stated he would take primary responsibility for the accident, which negatively impacted his political career.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴国在天津市委常委会议上强调“坚决维护习近平总书记这个核心”，主动“向习总书记看齐”。
description.en: At a meeting of the Tianjin Municipal Party Committee's Standing Committee, Huang Xingguo emphasized 'firmly upholding General Secretary Xi Jinping as the core' and proactively 'aligning with General Secretary Xi'.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，时任中共中央总书记胡耀邦考察象山，黄兴国全程陪同。
description.en: In 1985, then-General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee Hu Yaobang inspected Xiangshan, and Huang Xingguo accompanied him throughout the visit.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，时任中央办公厅副主任温家宝陪同胡耀邦考察象山，黄兴国亦在场陪同。
description.en: In 1985, Wen Jiabao, then Deputy Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee, accompanied Hu Yaobang to inspect Xiangshan, and Huang Xingguo was also present to accompany them.

description.zh-cn: 1985年，时任浙江省委书记王芳陪同胡耀邦考察象山，黄兴国亦在场陪同。
description.en: In 1985, Wang Fang, then Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, accompanied Hu Yaobang to inspect Xiangshan, and Huang Xingguo was also present to accompany them.

description.zh-cn: 2012年7月率团访台期间，与时任国民党荣誉主席连战会面。
description.en: During his visit to Taiwan in July 2012, he met with then-Honorary Chairman of the Kuomintang, Lien Chan.

description.zh-cn: 2012年7月率团访台期间，受到吴伯雄接待。
description.en: During his visit to Taiwan in July 2012, he was received by Wu Po-hsiung.

description.zh-cn: 在被查前一天下午接见了时任中国国民党副主席胡志强。
description.en: He met with then-KMT Vice Chairman Jason Hu on the afternoon before he was investigated.

description.zh-cn: 在被查前一天下午接见了大甲镇澜宫董事长颜清标。
description.en: He met with Yen Ching-piao, Chairman of the Dajia Jenn Lann Temple, on the afternoon before he was investigated.

description.zh-cn: 主政台州时，力排众议，将台州市政府驻地从临海市搬迁至椒江区。
description.en: When he was in charge of Taizhou, he overcame opposition to move the seat of the Taizhou city government from Linhai to Jiaojiang District.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖将东北地区的保安部队和新军等力量整合，创立了奉军，即东北军的前身。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin integrated local security forces and new army units in Northeast China to found the Fengtian Army, the predecessor of the Northeastern Army.

description.zh-cn: 东北军是奉系军阀的武装力量。
description.en: The Northeastern Army was the military force of the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 东北易帜后，东北军被改编为国民革命军东北边防军，纳入国民政府管辖。
description.en: After the Northeast Flag Replacement, the Northeastern Army was reorganized into the North-Eastern Border Defence Army and placed under the jurisdiction of the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 东北军（奉系）与直系军阀在1922年和1924年爆发了两次直奉战争。
description.en: The Northeastern Army (Fengtian clique) and the Zhili clique fought two major wars in 1922 and 1924.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，东北军被蒋介石、李宗仁、冯玉祥、阎锡山的北伐联军打败，退回东北。
description.en: In 1928, the Northeastern Army was defeated by the allied Northern Expeditionary Army of Chiang Kai-shek, Li Zongren, Feng Yuxiang, and Yan Xishan, forcing it to retreat to Manchuria.

description.zh-cn: 1935年，被调至陕甘剿共的东北军在劳山、榆林桥、直罗镇三次战役中被红军重创，损失近三个师。
description.en: In 1935, the Northeastern Army, which had been transferred to Shaanxi and Gansu to suppress the communists, was severely defeated by the Red Army in three battles at Laoshan, Yulinqiao, and Zhiluo, losing nearly three divisions.

description.zh-cn: 在西安事变中，蒋介石被张学良和杨虎城的部队扣押，被迫同意停止内战，联合抗日。
description.en: During the Xi'an Incident, Chiang Kai-shek was detained by the troops of Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng, and was forced to agree to stop the civil war and unite to resist Japan.

description.zh-cn: 在西安事变后的“二二事件”中，东北军少壮派军官杀害了元老派将领王以哲。
description.en: During the 'February 2nd Incident' after the Xi'an Incident, young officers of the Northeastern Army assassinated the veteran general Wang Yizhe.

description.zh-cn: 西安事变后，南京政府对东调的东北军进行了整训和缩编，将其由甲种军缩编为乙种军，削弱了其实力并加强了控制。
description.en: After the Xi'an Incident, the Nanjing Government reorganized and downsized the transferred Northeastern Army, reducing its corps from Type A to Type B, thereby weakening its strength and tightening control.

description.zh-cn: 1936年，中国共产党成立东北军工作委员会，并派遣刘鼎等人对张学良及东北军开展统战工作，对其转向联合抗日起到重要作用。
description.en: In 1936, the Communist Party of China established the Northeastern Army Work Committee and dispatched representatives like Liu Ding to conduct united front work with Zhang Xueliang and the Northeastern Army, playing a significant role in its shift towards a united anti-Japanese stance.

description.zh-cn: 因秦非子善于养马，周孝王将其封于“秦邑”，作为周朝的附庸，并赐号“秦嬴”。
description.en: Due to Feizi's skill in horse breeding, King Xiao of Zhou enfeoffed him at 'Qin Yi' as a vassal of the Zhou dynasty and granted him the title 'Qin Ying'.

description.zh-cn: 秦非子被周孝王封于秦地，标志着秦国的开端。
description.en: Feizi was enfeoffed in the land of Qin by King Xiao of Zhou, marking the beginning of the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 为表彰秦襄公护送东迁的功劳，周平王将其封为伯爵，使秦国正式成为诸侯国。
description.en: To reward Duke Xiang of Qin for escorting the eastward move, King Ping of Zhou enfeoffed him as a Count, formally making Qin a feudal state.

description.zh-cn: 秦襄公率军护送周平王东迁，是该事件成功的关键之一。
description.en: Duke Xiang of Qin's escort of King Ping of Zhou was a key factor in the success of the eastward move.

description.zh-cn: 秦国在发展早期与西戎进行了长期而残酷的斗争。
description.en: In its early development, the state of Qin engaged in a long and brutal struggle with the Xirong tribes.

description.zh-cn: 秦穆公时期，秦国降服了西戎八国，称霸西戎。
description.en: During the reign of Duke Mu of Qin, the state of Qin subjugated eight Xirong states and became the hegemon of the western regions.

description.zh-cn: 秦孝公任命商鞅为左庶长，支持其在秦国进行变法。
description.en: Duke Xiao of Qin appointed Shang Yang as Left Shuzhang and supported his implementation of reforms in the state of Qin.

description.zh-cn: 前350年，秦孝公将秦国都城迁至咸阳。
description.en: In 350 BC, Duke Xiao of Qin moved the capital of the Qin state to Xianyang.

description.zh-cn: 秦王政亲自主导并完成了消灭山东六国的统一战争。
description.en: King Zheng of Qin personally led and completed the wars of unification that conquered the six eastern states.

description.zh-cn: 通过秦灭六国之战，秦国消灭了所有东方的主要对手。
description.en: Through the wars of unification, the state of Qin eliminated all its major rivals in the east.

description.zh-cn: 刘邦率军攻入关中，秦王子婴开城献降。
description.en: Liu Bang led his army into the Guanzhong region, and Prince Ziying of Qin surrendered the city.

description.zh-cn: 周初三监之乱平定后，周成王在商奄诛杀了逃亡至此的蜚廉。
description.en: After suppressing the Rebellion of the Three Guards in the early Zhou dynasty, King Cheng of Zhou executed Fei Lian, who had fled to Shangyan.

description.zh-cn: 公元前822年，秦仲在与西戎的战争中战死。
description.en: In 822 BC, Zhong of Qin was killed in a battle against the Xirong.

description.zh-cn: 公元前824年，周宣王任命秦仲为大夫，命令他率军讨伐西戎。
description.en: In 824 BC, King Xuan of Zhou appointed Zhong of Qin as a grand master and ordered him to lead an army to attack the Xirong.

description.zh-cn: 晋襄公在殽之战中指挥晋军伏击并大败秦军，导致秦军全军覆没。
description.en: Duke Xiang of Jin commanded the Jin forces to ambush and decisively defeat the Qin army at the Battle of Yao, resulting in the annihilation of the Qin forces.

description.zh-cn: 宣太后设计诱杀了与其私通的义渠戎王，并趁机发兵攻灭了义渠国。
description.en: Queen Dowager Xuan devised a plot to lure and kill the Yiqu Rong king, with whom she had an affair, and then took the opportunity to send troops to conquer the Yiqu state.

description.zh-cn: 因晋惠公背信弃义，秦穆公大怒伐晋，在韩原之战中俘虏了晋惠公。
description.en: Angered by Duke Hui of Jin's breach of faith, Duke Mu of Qin attacked Jin and captured Duke Hui at the Battle of Hanyuan.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡是本锡安·内塔尼亚胡的儿子。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu is the son of Benzion Netanyahu.

description.zh-cn: 约纳坦·内塔尼亚胡在恩德培行动中阵亡。
description.en: Yonatan Netanyahu was killed in action during Operation Entebbe.

degree.zh-cn: 建筑学学士、管理学硕士
degree.en: Bachelor of Science in Architecture, Master of Science in Management

description.zh-cn: 1971年获得建筑学学士学位，1973年在斯隆管理学院获得管理学硕士学位。
description.en: He received a BS in architecture in 1971 and an MS in management from the Sloan School of Management in 1973.

description.zh-cn: 曾在哈佛大学学习政治学。
description.en: Studied political science at Harvard University.

description.zh-cn: 1967年至1973年间在以色列国防军服役，官至上尉。
description.en: Served in the Israel Defense Forces from 1967 to 1973, reaching the rank of captain.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡曾三度担任以色列总理。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu has served three tenures as Prime Minister of Israel.

description.zh-cn: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡曾两度担任利库德集团主席。
description.en: Benjamin Netanyahu has twice served as the chairman of the Likud party.

description.zh-cn: 在1996年以色列总理直选中，内塔尼亚胡作为挑战者击败了时任总理希蒙·佩雷斯。
description.en: In the 1996 Israeli general election for Prime Minister, Netanyahu challenged and defeated the incumbent Prime Minister Shimon Peres.

description.zh-cn: 在1999年大选中，埃胡德·巴拉克击败了内塔尼亚胡。
description.en: In the 1999 election, Ehud Barak defeated Netanyahu.

description.zh-cn: 纳夫塔利·贝内特成为新任总理，结束了内塔尼亚胡长达12年的执政。
description.en: Naftali Bennett became the new prime minister, ending Netanyahu's 12-year rule.

description.zh-cn: 全国性的示威活动旨在反对并阻止司法改革方案的通过。
description.en: The nationwide demonstrations aimed to oppose and block the passage of the judicial reform plan.

description.zh-cn: 国际刑事法院于2024年11月21日对内塔尼亚胡签发逮捕令，指控其涉嫌战争罪和危害人类罪。
description.en: The International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu on November 21, 2024, for alleged war crimes and crimes against humanity.

description.zh-cn: 国际刑事法院检察官卡里姆·艾哈迈德汗于2024年5月20日申请对内塔尼亚胡的逮捕令。
description.en: ICC Prosecutor Karim Ahmad Khan applied for an arrest warrant for Netanyahu on May 20, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党新疆维吾尔自治区委员会是新疆再教育营的主要运营者。
description.en: The Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Committee of the Communist Party of China is a primary operator of the Xinjiang re-education camps.

description.zh-cn: 新疆维吾尔自治区人民政府是新疆再教育营的主要运营者。
description.en: The People's Government of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region is a primary operator of the Xinjiang re-education camps.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中共中央总书记期间，习近平指示并发起“反恐人民战争”，不断强化治疆政策，在其路线下新疆再教育营得以建立并扩大规模。泄露的“新疆公安文件”显示，公安部长赵克志称习近平直接下令扩大拘留设施容量。
description.en: During his tenure as General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Xi Jinping instructed and launched the 'People's War on Terror,' continuously strengthening policies for governing Xinjiang, under which the re-education camps were established and expanded. Leaked 'Xinjiang Police Files' reveal that Minister of Public Security Zhao Kezhi stated Xi directly ordered the expansion of detention facility capacity.

description.zh-cn: 在习近平的指示下，当局于2014年在新疆发起“反恐人民战争”（严厉打击暴力恐怖活动专项行动）。
description.en: Under Xi Jinping's direction, authorities launched the 'People's War on Terror' (Strike Hard Campaign Against Violent Terrorism) in Xinjiang in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 2014年昆明火车站暴力恐怖袭击事件是促使中国当局在新疆发起“反恐人民战争”的系列暴力事件之一。
