description.en: The 2014 Kunming railway station attack was one of a series of violent incidents that prompted Chinese authorities to launch the 'People's War on Terror' in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 2014年乌鲁木齐火车南站暴力恐怖袭击案件是促使中国当局在新疆发起“反恐人民战争”的系列暴力事件之一。
description.en: The 2014 Ürümqi railway station attack was one of a series of violent incidents that prompted Chinese authorities to launch the 'People's War on Terror' in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 新疆再教育营是“严厉打击暴力恐怖活动专项行动”的一部分。
description.en: The Xinjiang re-education camps are part of the 'Strike Hard Campaign Against Violent Terrorism'.

description.zh-cn: 2016年8月调任新疆自治区党委书记后，陈全国将“再教育营”正式纳入新疆政策，并推动了其规模化扩建。
description.en: After being appointed as Xinjiang's Party Secretary in August 2016, Chen Quanguo formally integrated the 're-education camps' into Xinjiang's policy and pushed for their large-scale expansion.

description.zh-cn: 在新疆被恐怖组织伊斯兰国点名为圣战对象后，再教育营的建设规模迅速扩大，成为新疆当局以反恐名义加强控制的契机。
description.en: After Xinjiang was named as a target for jihad by the terrorist group ISIS, the scale of re-education camp construction rapidly expanded, serving as an opportunity for Xinjiang authorities to strengthen control in the name of counter-terrorism.

description.zh-cn: 王勇智因释放再教育营人员等行为被认为“严重违背党中央治疆方略”，于2018年3月被开除党籍和公职。
description.en: Wang Yongzhi was deemed to have 'gravely contravened the Party Central Committee's strategy for governing Xinjiang' for actions including releasing re-education camp detainees, and was expelled from the Party and public office in March 2018.

description.zh-cn: 维吾尔族足球运动员叶尔凡·叶孜木江据报于2018年被送入再教育营，并于2019年2月获释。
description.en: Uyghur football player Erfan Hezim was reportedly sent to a re-education camp in 2018 and was released in February 2019.

description.zh-cn: 新疆大学教授热依拉·达吾提于2017年底被拘留，据信被关入再教育营，此后杳无音信。
description.en: Xinjiang University professor Rahile Dawut was detained in late 2017 and is believed to have been sent to a re-education camp, with no information about her since.

description.zh-cn: 联合国人权高专办发布的报告指出，中国政府在新疆的行为可能构成危害人类罪，并发生了“严重的侵犯人权行为”，对中国政府的政策提出严厉批评。
description.en: The report by the UN OHCHR stated that the Chinese government's actions in Xinjiang may constitute crimes against humanity and that 'serious human rights violations' have occurred, severely criticizing the government's policies.

description.zh-cn: 时任联合国人权事务高级专员的米歇尔·巴切莱特在其任期最后一天发布了《联合国新疆人权报告》。
description.en: Then-UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Michelle Bachelet, released the 'UN Xinjiang Human Rights Report' on the last day of her term.

description.zh-cn: 在《联合国新疆人权报告》发布后，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯要求中国立即释放被关押的维吾尔族人，直接对中国政府的政策提出反对。
description.en: Following the release of the 'UN Xinjiang Human Rights Report', UN Secretary-General António Guterres called on China to immediately release detained Uyghurs, directly opposing the Chinese government's policy.

description.zh-cn: 《纽约时报》于2019年11月16日曝光了403页的中国政府内部文件，揭示了新疆大规模拘禁的组织方式和高层指令，对中国政府的官方说法构成挑战。
description.en: On November 16, 2019, The New York Times exposed 403 pages of internal Chinese government documents, revealing the organization and high-level directives behind the mass detentions in Xinjiang, challenging the Chinese government's official narrative.

description.zh-cn: 国际调查记者同盟与合作媒体共同公布了《中国电文》。
description.en: The International Consortium of Investigative Journalists, along with its media partners, published the 'China Cables'.

description.zh-cn: 《中国电文》的泄露详细揭示了新疆再教育营的运作手册和安保措施，反驳了中国政府关于这些是普通学校的说法。
description.en: The leak of the 'China Cables' detailed the operational manuals and security measures of the Xinjiang re-education camps, refuting the Chinese government's claim that they are ordinary schools.

description.zh-cn: 《墨玉名单》的曝光揭示了将维吾尔人送入再教育营的具体原因，包括宗教行为和海外联系等，挑战了中国政府关于学员是受极端思想影响的说法。
description.en: The exposure of the 'Karakax List' revealed specific reasons for sending Uyghurs to re-education camps, including religious practices and overseas contacts, challenging the Chinese government's narrative that the trainees were influenced by extremist ideology.

description.zh-cn: “新疆公安文件”的泄露提供了大量关于再教育营内部运作、安保协议以及包括习近平在内的高层领导人指令的直接证据，严重冲击了中国政府的官方叙事。
description.en: The leak of the 'Xinjiang Police Files' provided extensive direct evidence of the internal operations of the re-education camps, security protocols, and directives from high-level leaders including Xi Jinping, severely undermining the Chinese government's official narrative.

description.zh-cn: 德国学者阿德里安·曾兹接收、鉴定并向媒体披露了“新疆公安文件”。
description.en: German scholar Adrian Zenz received, authenticated, and disclosed the 'Xinjiang Police Files' to the media.

description.zh-cn: 时任公安部长赵克志在一场内部讲话中，将扩大拘留设施容量的命令归于总书记习近平，体现了其在治疆政策上的下属和执行者角色。
description.en: Then-Minister of Public Security Zhao Kezhi, in an internal speech, attributed the order to expand detention facility capacity to General Secretary Xi Jinping, reflecting his role as a subordinate and implementer of the Xinjiang policy.

description.zh-cn: 德国外长贝伯克与中国外长王毅就“新疆公安文件”举行视讯通话。
description.en: German Foreign Minister Baerbock held a video call with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi regarding the 'Xinjiang Police Files'.

description.zh-cn: 英国多次在联合国联合其他国家发表声明，谴责中国在新疆的政策和人权状况。
description.en: The United Kingdom has repeatedly joined other countries at the United Nations to issue statements condemning China's policies and human rights situation in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯在联合国联合其他国家发表声明，支持中国在新疆的政策。
description.en: Russia has joined other countries at the United Nations to issue statements supporting China's policies in Xinjiang.

description.zh-cn: 杨度师从王闿运，学习帝王之术，深受其喜爱和影响。
description.en: Yang Du studied under Wang Kaiyun, learning the 'arts of emperors,' and was deeply favored and influenced by him.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后，杨度成为袁世凯的幕僚。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising, Yang Du became an advisor to Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 杨度撰写《君宪救国论》，并组织筹安会，为袁世凯称帝进行理论鼓吹和组织策划。
description.en: Yang Du wrote "On Constitutional Monarchy to Save the Nation" and organized the Chou'anhui, providing theoretical advocacy and organizational planning for Yuan Shikai's enthronement.

description.zh-cn: 继任总统后，发布命令惩办帝制祸首，杨度名列第一，被通缉。
description.en: After succeeding as president, he issued an order to punish the masterminds of the monarchy movement, with Yang Du being the first on the wanted list.

description.zh-cn: 1922年，在孙中山的引荐下，杨度加入中国国民党。
description.en: In 1922, under the recommendation of Sun Yat-sen, Yang Du joined the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 接纳杨度加入中国国民党，并特电全党表示信任。
description.en: He accepted Yang Du into the Kuomintang and sent a special telegram to the entire party expressing his trust.

description.zh-cn: 1929年秋，杨度在白色恐怖时期秘密加入中国共产党，由潘汉年介绍，周恩来批准。
description.en: In the autumn of 1929, during the White Terror, Yang Du secretly joined the Communist Party of China, introduced by Pan Hannian and approved by Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 介绍杨度加入中国共产党。
description.en: Introduced Yang Du to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 入党后，由周恩来单线联系和直接领导。
description.en: After joining the party, he was in direct contact with and led by Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 入读东京弘文学院师范速成班。
description.en: Enrolled in the teacher training crash course at Kobun Gakuin in Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 因杨度策动洪宪帝制，梁启超与其决裂并公开抨击，成为帝制失败的关键反对者之一。
description.en: Because Yang Du orchestrated the Hongxian Monarchy, Liang Qichao broke with him and publicly criticized him, becoming one of the key opponents who contributed to the monarchy's failure.

description.zh-cn: 杨度将黄兴介绍给孙中山，促成了孙黄合作及中国同盟会的成立。
description.en: Yang Du introduced Huang Xing to Sun Yat-sen, which facilitated the cooperation between Sun and Huang and the establishment of the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 杨度将黄兴介绍给孙中山，促成了孙黄合作及中国同盟会的成立。
description.en: Yang Du introduced Huang Xing to Sun Yat-sen, which facilitated the cooperation between Sun and Huang and the establishment of the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 在北京设法营救李大钊，并在其被害后倾财救助其家人。
description.en: He attempted to rescue Li Dazhao in Beijing and, after Li's execution, provided financial assistance to his family.

description.zh-cn: 与张之洞联合保荐杨度出任宪政编查馆提调。
description.en: Jointly recommended Yang Du with Zhang Zhidong to serve as an officer in the Constitutional Compilation and Investigation Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 与袁世凯联合保荐杨度出任宪政编查馆提调。
description.en: Jointly recommended Yang Du with Yuan Shikai to serve as an officer in the Constitutional Compilation and Investigation Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 当摄政王载沣要杀袁世凯时，杨度冒死论救，成功保全了袁世凯。
description.en: When Regent Zaifeng intended to execute Yuan Shikai, Yang Du risked his life to argue for Yuan's case, successfully saving him.

description.zh-cn: 杨度早期是君主立宪的坚定倡导者，创办《中国新报》，发表《金铁主义》等文章宣传其主张。
description.en: In his early years, Yang Du was a staunch advocate of constitutional monarchy, founding the 'China New Journal' and publishing articles like 'Jintie Zhuyi' (Gold and Iron Doctrine) to promote his views.

description.zh-cn: 留学日本期间，蔡锷与杨度关系最善。蔡锷在遗嘱中还为杨度求情。
description.en: During their studies in Japan, Cai E had the best relationship with Yang Du. In his will, Cai E even pleaded for leniency for Yang Du.

description.zh-cn: 李文瑞是胡锦涛的母亲。
description.en: Li Wenrui is the mother of Hu Jintao.

description.zh-cn: 1956年至1959年，胡锦涛在江苏省泰州中学读高中。
description.en: From 1956 to 1959, Hu Jintao attended Jiangsu Taizhou High School.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛政府在2003年果断处置非典疫情，并撤换了相关瞒报疫情的官员。
description.en: The Hu Jintao administration decisively handled the SARS outbreak in 2003 and dismissed officials responsible for concealing the epidemic.

description.zh-cn: 在中共二十大闭幕会上，胡锦涛被工作人员带离会场，引发外界广泛关注。
description.en: At the closing session of the 20th CCP National Congress, Hu Jintao was escorted out of the venue by staff, drawing widespread international attention.

description.zh-cn: 谢长廷于1946年5月18日出生于台北市大同区。
description.en: Hsieh Chang-ting was born in Datong District, Taipei City on May 18, 1946.

description.zh-cn: 在美丽岛事件发生后，谢长廷加入辩护律师团，此事成为他进入政坛的契机。
description.en: After the Kaohsiung Incident, Hsieh Chang-ting joined the defense legal team, which became his opportunity to enter politics.

description.zh-cn: 周清玉拜托谢长廷担任其丈夫姚嘉文在美丽岛事件中的辩护律师。
description.en: Chou Ching-yu requested Hsieh Chang-ting to be the defense lawyer for her husband, Yao Chia-wen, in the Kaohsiung Incident.

description.zh-cn: 谢长廷是民主进步党创党十人小组成员之一，也是党名的命名者和党纲的起草人。
description.en: Hsieh Chang-ting was one of the ten founding members of the Democratic Progressive Party, as well as the person who named the party and drafted its platform.

description.zh-cn: 在陈水扁担任总统期间，谢长廷被任命为行政院院长。
description.en: During Chen Shui-bian's presidency, Hsieh Chang-ting was appointed as the Premier of the Executive Yuan.

position.en: Vice Premier of the Executive Yuan

description.zh-cn: 在谢长廷担任行政院院长期间，吴荣义担任其副手。
description.en: While Hsieh Chang-ting was the Premier of the Executive Yuan, Wu Rong-i served as his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 谢长廷结合姚嘉文、尤清、施明德等人，成立民进党派系“福利国连线”。
description.en: Hsieh Chang-ting, along with Yao Chia-wen, You Ching, and Shih Ming-teh, founded the DPP faction 'Welfare State Alliance'.

description.zh-cn: 谢长廷与彭明敏搭档参选1996年总统选举，最终落败。
description.en: Hsieh Chang-ting ran as the vice-presidential candidate with Peng Ming-min in the 1996 presidential election and was defeated.

description.zh-cn: 以副总统候选人身份与彭明敏搭档参选1996年总统选举。
description.en: Ran as the vice-presidential candidate with Peng Ming-min in the 1996 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 在2006年台北市市长选举中，郝龙斌击败谢长廷。
description.en: Hau Lung-pin defeated Hsieh Chang-ting in the 2006 Taipei mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 在2008年总统选举中，马英九击败谢长廷。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou defeated Hsieh Chang-ting in the 2008 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 2006年，苏贞昌接替谢长廷担任行政院院长。2008年，二人搭档参选总统选举。
description.en: In 2006, Su Tseng-chang succeeded Hsieh Chang-ting as Premier of the Executive Yuan. In 2008, they ran as running mates in the presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 作为民主进步党创始人和核心人物，长期与中国国民党在政治上竞争和对立，并在多次选举中与其候选人对决。
description.en: As a founder and core figure of the Democratic Progressive Party, he has long been in political competition and opposition with the Kuomintang, and has competed against its candidates in numerous elections.

description.zh-cn: 谢长廷曾为宋七力的信徒，公开表明相信其分身概念，并为其拍摄宣传广告。
description.en: Hsieh Chang-ting was a follower of Sung Chi-li, publicly stating his belief in Sung's concept of omnipresence and appeared in his promotional advertisements.

position.zh-cn: 台北市政府市政顾问副总召集人
position.en: Deputy Convener of the Municipal Advisors of Taipei City Government

description.zh-cn: 受时任台北市市长柯文哲聘任为市政顾问副总召集人。
description.en: Appointed as the Deputy Convener of the Municipal Advisors by then-Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je.

description.zh-cn: 2012年访问中国大陆期间，会见了时任国务委员戴秉国。
description.en: During his visit to mainland China in October 2012, he met with then-State Councilor Dai Bingguo.

description.zh-cn: 与陈水扁、林正杰同时进入台北市议会，被称为“党外三剑客”。
description.en: Entered the Taipei City Council at the same time as Chen Shui-bian and Lin Cheng-chieh, and they were known as the 'Three Musketeers of the Tangwai movement'.

description.zh-cn: 在1945年6月19日举行的中共七届一中全会上，正式设立了中国共产党中央委员会主席的职务。
description.en: At the First Plenary Session of the 7th CPC Central Committee held on June 19, 1945, the position of Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China was formally established.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东是中国共产党首任中央委员会主席，自1945年当选直至逝世。
description.en: Mao Zedong was the first Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, serving from his election in 1945 until his death.

description.zh-cn: 华国锋是继毛泽东之后的第二任中共中央主席。
description.en: Hua Guofeng was the second Chairman of the CPC Central Committee, succeeding Mao Zedong.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央主席领导中共中央政治局的工作。
description.en: The Chairman of the CPC Central Committee led the work of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央主席领导中共中央书记处的工作。
description.en: The Chairman of the CPC Central Committee led the work of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1945年6月19日，中共中央举行七届一中全会，毛泽东在会上被选为中国共产党中央委员会主席。
description.en: On June 19, 1945, the CPC Central Committee held the First Plenary Session of the 7th Central Committee, where Mao Zedong was elected Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命时期，中共中央主席的权力进一步扩大，对国家大小事务拥有最终决定权。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the power of the CPC Central Committee Chairman was further expanded, granting the holder final decision-making authority over all state affairs.

description.zh-cn: 根据《七五宪法》和《七八宪法》，全国武装力量由中国共产党中央委员会主席统率。
description.en: According to the 1975 and 1978 Constitutions, the nation's armed forces were commanded by the Chairman of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 为了完善集体领导制度，中共十二大决定废除中央委员会主席职务。
description.en: In order to improve the system of collective leadership, the 12th National Congress of the CPC decided to abolish the position of Chairman of the Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央委员会副主席的地位仅次于党主席。
description.en: The position of Vice Chairman of the CPC Central Committee was second in rank only to the Party Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 谢安出生于陈郡阳夏（今河南省太康县）。
description.en: Xie An was born in Yangxia, Chen Commandery (modern-day Taikang County, Henan Province).

description.zh-cn: 谢安是谢裒的儿子。
description.en: Xie An was the son of Xie Pou.

description.zh-cn: 谢奕是谢安的长兄。
description.en: Xie Yi was Xie An's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 谢万是谢安的四弟。
description.en: Xie Wan was Xie An's fourth younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 谢瑶是谢安的儿子。
description.en: Xie Yao was the son of Xie An.

description.zh-cn: 谢琰是谢安的儿子。
description.en: Xie Yan was the son of Xie An.

description.zh-cn: 谢玄是谢安长兄谢奕的儿子，即谢安的侄子。
description.en: Xie Xuan was the son of Xie An's eldest brother, Xie Yi, making him Xie An's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 升平四年（360年），谢安结束隐居生活，出仕进入桓温的幕府担任司马。
description.en: In 360 AD, Xie An ended his seclusion and entered public service, joining Huan Wen's staff as a Sima (Major).

description.zh-cn: 在桓温独揽大权并意图篡位期间，谢安与其在政治上对立，联合其他士族力量与之周旋，并最终挫败了其图谋。
description.en: During Huan Wen's period of absolute power and usurpation attempt, Xie An politically opposed him, allied with other aristocratic clans to maneuver against him, and ultimately foiled his plans.

description.zh-cn: 在对抗权臣桓温篡位图谋时，谢安与王坦之等人结成政治同盟，共同维护东晋政权。
description.en: When resisting the usurpation plot of the powerful minister Huan Wen, Xie An formed a political alliance with Wang Tanzhi and others to jointly defend the Eastern Jin regime.

description.zh-cn: 作为东晋方的总指挥，谢安临危受命，运筹帷幄，统筹全局，是取得淝水之战胜利的关键人物。
description.en: As the supreme commander of the Eastern Jin forces, Xie An was appointed at a critical moment and played a pivotal role in achieving victory in the Battle of Fei River through his strategic planning and overall command.

description.zh-cn: 在淝水之战中，由谢安领导的东晋军队以少胜多，决定性地击败了前秦的入侵，阻止了其统一中国的进程。
description.en: In the Battle of Fei River, the Eastern Jin army, led by Xie An, decisively defeated the Former Qin invasion with a much smaller force, halting its process of unifying China.

description.zh-cn: 太元二年（377年），谢安力排众议，举荐侄子谢玄出任兖州刺史，镇守广陵，为组建北府兵和应对前秦威胁做出了关键部署。
description.en: In 377 AD, Xie An, against the opinions of others, recommended his nephew Xie Xuan to be the governor of Yan Province and defend Guangling. This was a crucial deployment for the formation of the Beifu Army and for countering the threat from the Former Qin.

description.zh-cn: 谢玄受命镇守广陵后，招募和训练骁勇善战的流民，组建了著名的北府兵，成为东晋的精锐军事力量。
description.en: After being appointed to defend Guangling, Xie Xuan recruited and trained brave refugees, forming the renowned Beifu Army, which became an elite military force for the Eastern Jin.

description.zh-cn: 南朝陈时期，陈宣帝次子陈叔陵为了安葬其母，竟挖掘了谢安的坟墓，并抛弃了其棺椁，使其死后不得安宁。
description.en: During the Chen dynasty of the Southern Dynasties, Chen Shuling, the second son of Emperor Xuan of Chen, desecrated Xie An's tomb, discarding his coffin to bury his own mother, thus disturbing Xie An's eternal rest.

description.zh-cn: 谢安曾向当时的书法大家王羲之学习行书，其书法水平也因此备受赞誉。
description.en: Xie An studied running script calligraphy under the great master Wang Xizhi, and his own calligraphy skills were highly praised as a result.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国铁道部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Railways of the People's Republic of China was a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 国家铁路局由交通运输部管理。
description.en: The National Railway Administration is managed by the Ministry of Transport.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月第一届全国人大一次会议后，中央人民政府铁道部结束，其职能由新成立的中华人民共和国铁道部接替。
description.en: After the First Session of the 1st National People's Congress in September 1954, the Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was concluded, and its functions were taken over by the newly established Ministry of Railways of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月第一届全国人大一次会议后，原中央人民政府铁道部改组为中华人民共和国铁道部。
description.en: After the First Session of the 1st National People's Congress in September 1954, the former Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was reorganized into the Ministry of Railways of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据1949年9月中国人民政治协商会议第一届全体会议通过的《中华人民共和国中央人民政府组织法》，设置了中央人民政府铁道部。
description.en: The Ministry of Railways of the Central People's Government was established in accordance with the 'Organic Law of the Central People's Government of the People's Republic of China' passed by the First Plenary Session of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference in September 1949.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，铁路事业受到重创，中共中央和国务院于1967年对铁道部实行军事管制。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the railway industry was severely damaged, and the CPC Central Committee and the State Council imposed military control over the Ministry of Railways in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 事故发生后，铁道部在调查和处理中的方法备受社会质疑及谴责，要求撤销铁道部的呼声再次出现，对其存续构成阻碍。
description.en: After the accident, the Ministry of Railways' investigation and handling methods were widely questioned and condemned by society, and calls for its abolition resurfaced, posing an obstacle to its continued existence.

description.zh-cn: 哈尔滨铁路局是原铁道部直属的铁路局之一。
description.en: Harbin Railway Bureau was one of the railway bureaus directly under the former Ministry of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 沈阳铁路局是原铁道部直属的铁路局之一。
description.en: Shenyang Railway Bureau was one of the railway bureaus directly under the former Ministry of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 北京铁路局是原铁道部直属的铁路局之一。
description.en: Beijing Railway Bureau was one of the railway bureaus directly under the former Ministry of Railways.

description.zh-cn: 1951年2月中共中央发出《关于加强铁道政治部工作的指示》，推动了铁路系统自上而下建立政治部。
description.en: In February 1951, the CPC Central Committee issued the 'Instruction on Strengthening the Work of Railway Political Departments', promoting the establishment of political departments from top to bottom within the railway system.

description.zh-cn: 美国第44任总统贝拉克·奥巴马于1961年在檀香山出生。
description.en: The 44th U.S. President Barack Obama was born in Honolulu in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 孙文于1894年11月24日在檀香山成立了兴中会。
description.en: Sun Yat-sen founded the Revive China Society in Honolulu on November 24, 1894.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党视兴中会为其奠基，并以其成立日为建党日。
description.en: The Kuomintang considers the Revive China Society as its foundation and adopted its founding date as the party's establishment date.

description.zh-cn: 根据孙文自述，他出生于檀香山伊娃区。
description.en: According to Sun Yat-sen's own account, he was born in the Ewa District of Honolulu.

description.zh-cn: 歌手布鲁诺·马尔斯出生于檀香山。
description.en: Singer Bruno Mars was born in Honolulu.

description.zh-cn: 韩国男团成员休宁凯出生于檀香山。
description.en: South Korean boy band member Huening Kai was born in Honolulu.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·拉塞尔于1832年创立了骷髅会。
description.en: William Russell founded Skull and Bones in 1832.

description.zh-cn: 骷髅会创始人在德国游学时受当地秘密组织启发，并将骷髅会视为德国某组织的第二个分支机构。
description.en: The founder of Skull and Bones was inspired by a local secret society while studying in Germany, and considered Skull and Bones to be the second branch of a German organization.

description.zh-cn: 洛克菲勒家族有多名成员加入了骷髅会，关系密切。
description.en: Multiple members of the Rockefeller family joined Skull and Bones, indicating a close relationship.

description.zh-cn: 亨利·卢斯是《时代》杂志的共同创办人。
description.en: Henry Luce was a co-founder of Time magazine.

description.zh-cn: 据称，《时代》杂志的创办想法源于其创办人卢斯和哈登在一次骷髅会的聚会上的讨论。
description.en: It is said that the idea to found Time magazine originated from a discussion between its founders, Luce and Hadden, during a Skull and Bones meeting.

description.zh-cn: 骷髅会的总部设在耶鲁大学，其成员在耶鲁大学的教职员工和领导层中长期占据极高比例。
description.en: The headquarters of Skull and Bones is located at Yale University, and its members have long constituted a very high proportion of the university's faculty and leadership.
Member of the class of 1878.
Member of the class of 1920.
Member of the class of 1948.
Member of the class of 1959.
Member of the class of 1966.
Member of the class of 1968.

description.zh-cn: 亨利·卢斯是《生活》杂志的创办人。
description.en: Henry Luce was the founder of Life magazine.

description.zh-cn: 李彦宏与徐勇于2000年1月1日在北京中关村共同创立了百度公司。
description.en: Robin Li and Eric Xu co-founded Baidu in Zhongguancun, Beijing on January 1, 2000.

description.zh-cn: 徐勇与李彦宏于2000年1月1日在北京中关村共同创立了百度公司。
description.en: Eric Xu and Robin Li co-founded Baidu in Zhongguancun, Beijing on January 1, 2000.

description.zh-cn: 李彦宏担任百度公司的董事长兼首席执行官。
description.en: Robin Li serves as the Chairman and CEO of Baidu.

description.zh-cn: 谷歌退出中国大陆后，百度在中国搜索引擎市场占据了主导地位。
description.en: After Google withdrew from mainland China, Baidu came to dominate the Chinese search engine market.

description.zh-cn: 中国中央电视台于2008年11月15日曝光百度竞价排名黑幕，导致百度股价遭受重挫。
description.en: On November 15, 2008, China Central Television exposed scandals related to Baidu's paid search ranking system, causing a sharp decline in Baidu's stock price.

description.zh-cn: 此次黑客攻击事件导致百度网站长达6小时无法访问，预估损失达700万元人民币。
description.en: This hacking incident caused Baidu's website to be inaccessible for six hours, with estimated losses of 7 million RMB.

description.zh-cn: 百度以3.06亿美元投资去哪儿网，成为其第一大机构股东。
description.en: Baidu invested US$306 million in Qunar.com, becoming its largest institutional shareholder.

description.zh-cn: 去哪儿网与携程网以换股方式合并。
description.en: Qunar.com merged with Ctrip through a share swap.

description.zh-cn: 百度宣布组建智能汽车公司，并与吉利控股集团合作。
description.en: Baidu announced the formation of a smart car company in partnership with Geely Holding Group.

description.zh-cn: 在习近平和巴西总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫的见证下，百度董事长兼CEO李彦宏宣告巴西葡语搜索引擎正式上线。
description.en: In the presence of Xi Jinping and Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff, Baidu Chairman and CEO Robin Li announced the official launch of Baidu's Portuguese search engine in Brazil.

description.zh-cn: 在习近平和巴西总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫的见证下，百度董事长兼CEO李彦宏宣告巴西葡语搜索引擎正式上线。
description.en: In the presence of Xi Jinping and Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff, Baidu Chairman and CEO Robin Li announced the official launch of Baidu's Portuguese search engine in Brazil.

description.zh-cn: 韩寒就百度文库侵权一事起诉百度，法院判决百度败诉，赔偿韩寒近10万元。
description.en: Han Han sued Baidu for copyright infringement on Baidu Wenku; the court ruled in favor of Han Han, ordering Baidu to pay nearly 100,000 RMB in compensation.

description.zh-cn: 在璩静事件发酵后，李彦宏在小范围员工沟通会上对事件进行点评，随后璩静离职。
description.en: After the controversy surrounding Qu Jing escalated, Li Yanhong commented on the incident in a small-scale employee meeting, and Qu Jing subsequently resigned.

description.zh-cn: 百度空间于2015年4月21日正式关闭。
description.en: Baidu Space was officially shut down on April 21, 2015.

description.zh-cn: 在百度诉360搜索抄袭一案中，法院一审驳回了百度的诉讼请求，百度败诉。
description.en: In the case of Baidu suing Qihoo 360 for plagiarism, the court rejected Baidu's claims in the first instance, resulting in a loss for Baidu.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，罗鹏是长沙人。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Luo Peng is from Changsha.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，罗鹏是汉族。
description.en: According to the infobox, Luo Peng is of Han ethnicity.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框和维基百科分类，罗鹏是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the infobox and Wikipedia categories, Luo Peng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，罗鹏被选为贵州省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Luo Peng was elected as a deputy from Guizhou Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 罗鹏担任第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: Luo Peng served as a deputy to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 严复十岁时，其父邀请名儒黄宗彝到家中教读，黄宗彝成为严复的老师。
description.en: When Yan Fu was ten years old, his father invited the famous Confucian scholar Huang Zongyi to their home to teach him, making Huang Zongyi his teacher.

description.zh-cn: 严复于1867年入福州船政学堂学习驾驶，1871年作为第一届毕业生毕业。
description.en: Yan Fu entered the Fuzhou Naval College in 1867 to study navigation and graduated in 1871 as part of the first class.

description.zh-cn: 严复于1877年赴英国皇家海军学院学习海军，1879年毕业。
description.en: Yan Fu went to the Royal Naval College, Greenwich in the UK to study naval science in 1877 and graduated in 1879.

description.zh-cn: 严复在英国留学时与时任出使英国大臣郭嵩焘结为忘年交。
description.en: During his studies in the UK, Yan Fu formed a close friendship with Guo Songtao, who was the minister to Britain at the time.

position.en: Chief Instructor of Western Languages, Co-administrator, Superintendent

description.zh-cn: 严复自1880年起在天津北洋水师学堂任教，后升为会办、总办。
description.en: Starting in 1880, Yan Fu taught at the Beiyang Naval Academy in Tianjin, and was later promoted to co-administrator and then superintendent.

description.zh-cn: 中日甲午战争的失败深刻刺激了严复，战后他在天津《直报》接连发表《论世变之亟》、《原强》等文，主张变法维新。
description.en: The defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War profoundly stimulated Yan Fu. After the war, he published a series of articles in the Tianjin 'Zhi Bao', such as 'On the Urgency of the World's Changes', advocating for reform and modernization.

description.zh-cn: 1897年，严复和王修植、夏曾佑等在天津创办《国闻报》，宣传变法维新。
description.en: In 1897, Yan Fu, along with Wang Xiuzhi and Xia Zengyou, founded the 'Guowen Bao' in Tianjin to promote ideas of reform and modernization.

description.zh-cn: 严复翻译了赫胥黎的著作并定名《天演论》，于1897年在《国闻报》上连续发表，向中国介绍了“物竞天择，适者生存”的进化论思想。
description.en: Yan Fu translated Huxley's work, titling it 'Tian Yan Lun', and published it serially in the 'Guowen Bao' in 1897, introducing the evolutionary ideas of 'survival of the fittest' to China.

description.zh-cn: 严复深受赫胥黎的进化论思想影响，并将其翻译介绍到中国。
description.en: Yan Fu was deeply influenced by Thomas Henry Huxley's theory of evolution and translated his work to introduce it to China.

description.zh-cn: 1905年，孙中山到达英国，特意去拜访严复，二人进行了长时间的会谈。
description.en: In 1905, upon arriving in the United Kingdom, Sun Yat-sen made a special visit to Yan Fu, and the two had a long conversation.

description.zh-cn: 严复曾任复旦公学（复旦大学前身）第二任校长。
description.en: Yan Fu served as the second president of Fudan Public School (the predecessor of Fudan University).

description.zh-cn: 1912年京师大学堂更名为北京大学校，严复任首任校长。
description.en: In 1912, the Imperial University of Peking was renamed Peking University, and Yan Fu became its first president.

description.zh-cn: 严复名列于杨度等人发起的筹安会，该会旨在倡导更改国体，支持袁世凯称帝。
description.en: Yan Fu was listed among the initiators of the Chouanhui, founded by Yang Du and others, which advocated for a change in the form of government to support Yuan Shikai's enthronement.

description.zh-cn: 严复加入筹安会，支援袁世凯复辟帝制。
description.en: Yan Fu joined the Chouanhui to support Yuan Shikai's restoration of the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯死后，大总统黎元洪下令惩办帝制祸首，虽然严复未被通缉，但他也因此前往天津避祸。
description.en: After Yuan Shikai's death, President Li Yuanhong ordered the punishment of the chief culprits of the monarchy scheme. Although Yan Fu was not wanted, he fled to Tianjin to avoid trouble.

description.zh-cn: 严复对1917年的张勋复辟表示同情。
description.en: Yan Fu expressed sympathy for the Zhang Xun Restoration in 1917.

description.zh-cn: 严复批评蔡元培在五四运动中支持学生的行为是“不识时务”。
description.en: Yan Fu criticized Cai Yuanpei for supporting students during the May Fourth Movement, calling his actions 'ignorant of the times'.

description.zh-cn: 根据1980年国务院决定，厦门海关改为直属中华人民共和国海关总署领导。
description.en: According to the State Council's decision in 1980, Xiamen Customs was placed under the direct leadership of the General Administration of Customs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 厦门战役后，厦门关由厦门市军事管制委员会接管，为中华人民共和国厦门海关的成立奠定了基础。
description.en: After the Battle of Xiamen, the Xiamen Customs was taken over by the Xiamen Military Control Committee, laying the foundation for the establishment of the Xiamen Customs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1949年10月厦门战役后，厦门关由厦门市军事管制委员会接管。
description.en: After the Battle of Xiamen in October 1949, Xiamen Customs was taken over by the Xiamen Military Control Committee.

description.zh-cn: 厦门海关在不同时期分别接受厦门市人民政府（及其前身厦门市人民委员会、厦门市革命委员会）的指导或领导。
description.en: Xiamen Customs received guidance or leadership from the Xiamen Municipal People's Government (and its predecessors, the Xiamen Municipal People's Committee and the Xiamen Municipal Revolutionary Committee) during different periods.

description.zh-cn: 自1955年恢复独立建制起，厦门海关长期归属对外贸易部海关总署领导。
description.en: Since resuming its independent status in 1955, Xiamen Customs was under the leadership of the General Administration of Customs of the Ministry of Foreign Trade for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 厦门海关在两个不同时期接受福建省人民政府（及其前身福建省人民委员会）的双重领导或监督指导。
description.en: Xiamen Customs was under the dual leadership or supervision and guidance of the Fujian Provincial People's Government (and its predecessor, the Fujian Provincial People's Committee) during two different periods.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命开始后，厦门海关自1967年8月1日起被施行军管，正常的组织运作和领导关系中断。
description.en: After the start of the Cultural Revolution, Xiamen Customs was placed under military control from August 1, 1967, interrupting its normal organizational operations and leadership structure.

description.zh-cn: 1948年毕业于国立台湾大学政治系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Political Science at National Taiwan University in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 1953年获得麦吉尔大学国际航空法硕士学位。
description.en: Obtained a master's degree in International Air Law from McGill University in 1953.

description.zh-cn: 1954年获得巴黎大学法学博士学位。
description.en: Obtained a Doctor of Law degree from the University of Paris in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 曾就读于东京帝国大学法学部政治科，1945年肄业。
description.en: Studied in the Political Science Division of the Faculty of Law at Tokyo Imperial University, leaving in 1945.

position.en: Chair of the Department of Political Science

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏曾在国立台湾大学任教，并于1961年出任政治学系系主任。
description.en: Peng Ming-min taught at National Taiwan University and became the Chair of the Department of Political Science in 1961.

description.zh-cn: 在陈水扁总统任内，彭明敏于2000年至2008年担任总统府资政。
description.en: During President Chen Shui-bian's tenure, Peng Ming-min served as a Senior Advisor to the Office of the President from 2000 to 2008.

description.zh-cn: 2000年，新任总统陈水扁邀请彭明敏出任总统府资政。
description.en: In 2000, newly elected President Chen Shui-bian invited Peng Ming-min to serve as a Senior Advisor to the Office of the President.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏于1995年加入民主进步党，并代表该党参选总统，后于1997年退党。
description.en: Peng Ming-min joined the Democratic Progressive Party in 1995 and represented it in the presidential election, before leaving the party in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 1964年，彭明敏与谢聪敏、魏廷朝共同起草《台湾自救运动宣言》。
description.en: In 1964, Peng Ming-min, along with Hsieh Tsung-min and Wei Ting-chao, drafted the 'Declaration of Formosan Self-Salvation'.

description.zh-cn: 1964年，谢聪敏与彭明敏、魏廷朝共同起草《台湾自救运动宣言》。
description.en: In 1964, Hsieh Tsung-min, along with Peng Ming-min and Wei Ting-chao, drafted the 'Declaration of Formosan Self-Salvation'.

description.zh-cn: 1964年，魏廷朝与彭明敏、谢聪敏共同起草《台湾自救运动宣言》。
description.en: In 1964, Wei Ting-chao, along with Peng Ming-min and Hsieh Tsung-min, drafted the 'Declaration of Formosan Self-Salvation'.

description.zh-cn: 因发表《台湾自救运动宣言》，彭明敏于1964年9月20日被中国国民党政府逮捕，后被判刑八年，直到1965年11月3日获特赦出狱。
description.en: For publishing the 'Declaration of Formosan Self-Salvation', Peng Ming-min was arrested by the Kuomintang government on September 20, 1964, and sentenced to eight years in prison. He was released under a special pardon on November 3, 1965.

description.zh-cn: 1965年11月3日，时任总统蒋介石特赦了彭明敏。
description.en: On November 3, 1965, then-President Chiang Kai-shek granted a special pardon to Peng Ming-min.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏与李登辉在国立台湾大学时期成为密友。
description.en: Peng Ming-min and Lee Teng-hui became close friends during their time at National Taiwan University.

description.zh-cn: 在1996年中华民国总统选举中，彭明敏与李登辉是主要的竞争对手。
description.en: In the 1996 Republic of China presidential election, Peng Ming-min and Lee Teng-hui were major political rivals.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏与作家李敖相识，在彭明敏被特赦后受到特务监视期间，李敖是少数仍敢与他来往的朋友。
description.en: Peng Ming-min was acquainted with writer Li Ao. After Peng's pardon, while under surveillance by secret agents, Li Ao was one of the few friends who dared to maintain contact with him.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏是台湾独立运动最具代表性的领袖之一，其思想与行动深刻影响了该运动。
description.en: Peng Ming-min is one of the most representative leaders of the Taiwan independence movement; his ideas and actions profoundly influenced the movement.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏是彭清靠的儿子。
description.en: Peng Ming-min is the son of Peng Ching-kao.

description.zh-cn: 日本台独运动人士宗像隆幸为彭明敏制作了假护照，帮助他成功逃离台湾。
description.en: Japanese Taiwan independence activist Munakata Takayuki created a fake passport for Peng Ming-min, helping him to successfully escape from Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 前中研院院长胡适支持彭明敏，并帮助他获得了在麦吉尔大学第二年的奖学金。
description.en: Former Academia Sinica President Hu Shih supported Peng Ming-min and helped him secure a scholarship for his second year at McGill University.

description.zh-cn: 2019年1月3日，彭明敏与吴澧培、李远哲、高俊明联名发表公开信，建请时任总统蔡英文放弃竞选连任。
description.en: On January 3, 2019, Peng Ming-min, along with Wu Li-pei, Lee Yuan-tseh, and Kao Chun-ming, published an open letter urging then-President Tsai Ing-wen not to seek re-election.

description.zh-cn: 2019年1月3日，吴澧培与彭明敏、李远哲、高俊明联名发表公开信，建请时任总统蔡英文放弃竞选连任。
description.en: On January 3, 2019, Wu Li-pei, along with Peng Ming-min, Lee Yuan-tseh, and Kao Chun-ming, published an open letter urging then-President Tsai Ing-wen not to seek re-election.

description.zh-cn: 2019年1月3日，李远哲与彭明敏、吴澧培、高俊明联名发表公开信，建请时任总统蔡英文放弃竞选连任。
description.en: On January 3, 2019, Lee Yuan-tseh, along with Peng Ming-min, Wu Li-pei, and Kao Chun-ming, published an open letter urging then-President Tsai Ing-wen not to seek re-election.

description.zh-cn: 2019年1月3日，高俊明与彭明敏、吴澧培、李远哲联名发表公开信，建请时任总统蔡英文放弃竞选连任。
description.en: On January 3, 2019, Kao Chun-ming, along with Peng Ming-min, Wu Li-pei, and Lee Yuan-tseh, published an open letter urging then-President Tsai Ing-wen not to seek re-election.

description.zh-cn: 彭明敏于1923年8月15日出生于台中大甲。
description.en: Peng Ming-min was born in Dajia, Taichung on August 15, 1923.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦通过发现青蒿素，为对抗疟疾做出了卓越贡献。
description.en: Tu Youyou made outstanding contributions to the fight against malaria through her discovery of artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 2015年10月5日，屠呦呦因在研制青蒿素等抗疟药方面的卓越贡献，被授予诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: On October 5, 2015, Tu Youyou was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for her outstanding contributions to the development of antimalarial drugs such as artemisinin.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦的名字源自《诗经》中的诗句“呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿”。
description.en: Tu Youyou's name comes from the line 'Youyou the deer cry, eating the artemisia of the wild' in the Classic of Poetry.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦与威廉·C·坎贝尔、大村智共同获得2015年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: Tu Youyou shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell and Satoshi Ōmura.

description.zh-cn: 屠呦呦与威廉·C·坎贝尔、大村智共同获得2015年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。
description.en: Tu Youyou shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell and Satoshi Ōmura.

description.zh-cn: 徐亦尤退休后，撰写了超过20万字的政论文章，旨在批判否定中国特色社会主义的舆论，以维护该理论体系。
description.en: After his retirement, Xu Yiyou wrote over 200,000 words of political commentary aimed at criticizing opinions that negated Socialism with Chinese characteristics, in order to defend the theoretical system.

description.zh-cn: 徐亦尤是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Xu Yiyou was a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 与中央汇金投资有限责任公司共同发起设立国家开发银行，并作为其主要股东（持股36.54%）。
description.en: Co-founded China Development Bank with Central Huijin Investment Co., Ltd., and serves as one of its major shareholders (holding 36.54%).

description.zh-cn: 与中华人民共和国财政部共同发起设立国家开发银行，并作为其主要股东（持股34.68%）。
description.en: Co-founded China Development Bank with the Ministry of Finance of the PRC, and serves as one of its major shareholders (holding 34.68%).

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行是直属国务院领导的政策性金融机构。
description.en: China Development Bank is a policy financial institution directly under the leadership of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行在金融业务上接受中国人民银行的指导和监督。
description.en: China Development Bank is subject to the guidance and supervision of the People's Bank of China in its financial operations.

description.zh-cn: 1999年3月18日，国家开发银行将原中国投资银行的资产与债务转让予中国光大银行。
description.en: On March 18, 1999, China Development Bank transferred the assets and liabilities of the former China Investment Bank to China Everbright Bank.

description.zh-cn: 向国家开发银行授予银行牌照，允许其在香港开展业务。
description.en: Granted a banking license to China Development Bank, allowing it to operate in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 批准国家开发银行香港代表处升格为首家境外分行——香港分行。
description.en: Approved the upgrade of China Development Bank's Hong Kong representative office to its first overseas branch, the Hong Kong Branch.

description.zh-cn: 向国家开发银行投资200亿元人民币入股。
description.en: Invested 20 billion RMB in China Development Bank for shares.

description.zh-cn: 批复国家开发银行深化改革方案，明确其开发性金融机构定位。
description.en: Approved the plan for deepening the reform of China Development Bank, clarifying its positioning as a development finance institution.

description.zh-cn: 向国家开发银行注资480亿美元。
description.en: Injected US$48 billion into China Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行控股的金融租赁公司，持股比例为64.4%。
description.en: A financial leasing company controlled by China Development Bank, with a 64.4% stake.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行是“一带一路”倡议的主要融资支持机构之一。
description.en: China Development Bank is one of the main financial supporters of the Belt and Road Initiative.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行向西部大开发相关的重大建设项目和基础产业提供了大量投资。
description.en: China Development Bank has provided substantial investment for major construction projects and basic industries related to the Western Development.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行向振兴东北相关的重大建设项目和基础产业提供了大量投资。
description.en: China Development Bank has provided substantial investment for major construction projects and basic industries related to the revitalization of Northeast China.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行向新农村建设提供了大量投资。
description.en: China Development Bank has provided substantial investment for the New Socialist Countryside program.

description.zh-cn: 国家开发银行向三峡水利枢纽等国家重大建设项目提供了大量投资。
description.en: China Development Bank has provided substantial investment to major national projects such as the Three Gorges Dam.

description.zh-cn: 彭智勇是重庆大足人。
description.en: Peng Zhiyong is from Dazu, Chongqing.

description.zh-cn: 1988年毕业于西南师范学院数学系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Mathematics at Southwest Normal College in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 1988年毕业后任教于重庆巴蜀中学，1994年11月起担任该校常务副校长。
description.en: After graduating in 1988, he taught at Chongqing Bashu Middle School, and became the executive vice principal in November 1994.

description.zh-cn: 自2006年起担任重庆市教育委员会主任，至2010年时仍担任此职。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Chongqing Municipal Education Commission since 2006, and was still holding this position in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 因重庆官场不雅照事件，彭智勇被免去九龙坡区委书记职务。
description.en: Peng Zhiyong was dismissed from his post as Secretary of the Jiulongpo District Party Committee due to the Chongqing official sex tape scandal.

description.zh-cn: 中共重庆市委于2013年1月免去了彭智勇的九龙坡区委书记职务。
description.en: The CPC Chongqing Municipal Committee dismissed Peng Zhiyong from his post as Secretary of the Jiulongpo District Party Committee in January 2013.

description.zh-cn: 彭智勇是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Peng Zhiyong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 国务院法制办公室是国务院办事机构。
description.en: The State Council Legislative Affairs Office was an agency directly under the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 《国务院机构改革方案》规定，不再保留国务院法制办公室。
description.en: The 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan' stipulated that the State Council Legislative Affairs Office would no longer be retained.

description.zh-cn: 《国务院机构改革方案》规定，将司法部和国务院法制办公室的职责整合，重新组建司法部。
description.en: The 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan' stipulated the reorganization of the Ministry of Justice by integrating the functions of the Ministry of Justice and the State Council Legislative Affairs Office.

description.zh-cn: 经第一届全国人大常委会第二次会议批准，国务院设立国务院法制局。
description.en: With the approval of the 2nd session of the Standing Committee of the 1st National People's Congress, the State Council established the State Council Bureau of Legislative Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 根据第二届全国人大常委会第四次会议《关于批准国务院调整直属机构的决议》，国务院撤销国务院法制局。
description.en: According to the 'Resolution on Approving the Adjustment of Agencies Directly under the State Council' of the 4th session of the Standing Committee of the 2nd National People's Congress, the State Council abolished the Bureau of Legislative Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1966年“文革”爆发后，国务院的法制机构（当时设于国务院秘书厅内）于1966年底被取消。
description.en: After the outbreak of the 'Cultural Revolution' in 1966, the State Council's legislative affairs body (then located within the State Council Secretariat) was abolished at the end of 1966.

description.zh-cn: 1989年7月经批准成立中国法制出版社。
description.en: In July 1989, the establishment of the China Legal Publishing House was approved.

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府法制委员会受政务院的领导。
description.en: The Legal System Committee of the Central People's Government was under the leadership of the Government Administration Council.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济出生于湖南省长沙府长沙县。
description.en: Yang Changji was born in Changsha County, Changsha Prefecture, Hunan Province.

description.zh-cn: 1898年，杨昌济就读于岳麓书院。
description.en: In 1898, Yang Changji studied at Yuelu Academy.

description.zh-cn: 1903年，杨昌济赴日留学，入弘文学院学习。
description.en: In 1903, Yang Changji went to study in Japan and enrolled in Kōbun Gakuin.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济在弘文学院结业后，考入东京高等师范学校。
description.en: After completing his studies at Kōbun Gakuin, Yang Changji was admitted to the Tokyo Higher Normal School.

description.zh-cn: 1909年，杨昌济赴英国阿伯丁大学攻读哲学、伦理学。
description.en: In 1909, Yang Changji went to the University of Aberdeen in the UK to study philosophy and ethics.

description.zh-cn: 1910年至1912年，杨昌济在爱丁堡大学学习文学并毕业。
description.en: From 1910 to 1912, Yang Changji studied literature and graduated from the University of Edinburgh.

description.zh-cn: 1898年在岳麓书院就读期间，杨昌济加入了进步团体南学会。
description.en: In 1898, while studying at Yuelu Academy, Yang Changji joined the progressive group Nan Xue Hui.

description.zh-cn: 1913年至1918年，杨昌济在湖南省立第一师范任教。
description.en: From 1913 to 1918, Yang Changji taught at Hunan Provincial First Normal School.

description.zh-cn: 杨开智是杨昌济的儿子。
description.en: Yang Kaizhi is the son of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在湖南省立第一师范就读时是杨昌济的学生。
description.en: Mao Zedong was a student of Yang Changji while studying at the Hunan Provincial First Normal School.

description.zh-cn: 蔡和森是杨昌济的学生。
description.en: Cai Hesen was a student of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 邓中夏是杨昌济的学生。
description.en: Deng Zhongxia was a student of Yang Changji.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济与章士钊是好友，临终前曾致信章士钊推荐人才。
description.en: Yang Changji and Zhang Shizhao were good friends. Before his death, Yang wrote to Zhang to recommend talented individuals.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济与密友杨守仁经常讨论国事。
description.en: Yang Changji frequently discussed national affairs with his close friend Yang Shouren.

description.zh-cn: 据毛泽东本人所述，杨昌济在北京时是其真诚的朋友。
description.en: According to Mao Zedong himself, Yang Changji was his sincere friend in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济在南学会活动期间，多次聆听谭嗣同讲演，并赞同其“以民为主”的政治思想。
description.en: During his activities with the Nan Xue Hui, Yang Changji attended Tan Sitong's lectures multiple times and agreed with his political idea of 'the people as the foundation'.

description.zh-cn: 杨毓麟于1909年推荐杨昌济赴英国阿伯丁大学留学。
description.en: In 1909, Yang Yulin recommended Yang Changji to study at the University of Aberdeen in the UK.

description.zh-cn: 章士钊于1909年推荐杨昌济赴英国阿伯丁大学留学。
description.en: In 1909, Zhang Shizhao recommended Yang Changji to study at the University of Aberdeen in the UK.

description.zh-cn: 蔡元培于1918年邀请杨昌济担任北京大学伦理学教授。
description.en: In 1918, Cai Yuanpei invited Yang Changji to serve as a professor of ethics at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济曾推荐毛泽东到北京大学图书馆工作，并在1920年临终前向章士钊举荐毛泽东，称其为“海内人才”。
description.en: Yang Changji recommended Mao Zedong for a job at the Peking University Library and, before his death in 1920, recommended Mao to Zhang Shizhao, calling him a 'talent of the nation'.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济于1920年临终前向章士钊举荐蔡和森，称其为“海内人才”。
description.en: Before his death in January 1920, Yang Changji recommended Cai Hesen to Zhang Shizhao, calling him a 'talent of the nation'.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济曾为赴法勤工俭学的学生筹措经费，支持该运动。
description.en: Yang Changji raised funds for students participating in the Work-Study Program in France, supporting the movement.

description.zh-cn: 新民学会由杨昌济的学生们于1918年建立，其思想和教导对学会的成立和发展有重要影响。
description.en: The Xinmin Society was founded in 1918 by students of Yang Changji, whose ideas and teachings had a significant influence on the society's establishment and development.

description.zh-cn: 在1919年五四运动期间，杨昌济发表《告学生》一文，表达对学生的热切期望，以此支持学生运动。
description.en: During the May Fourth Movement in 1919, Yang Changji published an article titled 'To the Students,' expressing his ardent hopes for them and thereby supporting the student movement.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国工业和信息化部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology is a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 第十一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过《第十一届全国人民代表大会第一次会议关于国务院机构改革方案的决定》，批准了《国务院机构改革方案》。
description.en: The First Session of the 11th National People's Congress passed the 'Decision on the Institutional Reform Plan of the State Council', approving the 'Institutional Reform Plan of the State Council'.

description.zh-cn: 2008年的国务院机构改革方案决定组建工业和信息化部，整合了原信息产业部、国防科工委、国家发改委的工业行业管理职责以及国务院信息化工作办公室的职责。
description.en: The 2008 State Council institutional reform plan decided to establish the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, integrating the responsibilities of the former Ministry of Information Industry, COSTIND, the industrial management functions of the NDRC, and the State Council Informatization Office.

description.zh-cn: 根据2008年国务院机构改革方案，信息产业部被撤销，其职责整合进新组建的工业和信息化部。
description.en: According to the 2008 State Council institutional reform plan, the Ministry of Information Industry was abolished, and its responsibilities were integrated into the newly formed Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 根据2008年国务院机构改革方案，国防科学技术工业委员会被撤销，其职责（核电管理除外）整合进新组建的工业和信息化部。
description.en: According to the 2008 State Council institutional reform plan, the Commission of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense was abolished, and its responsibilities (except for nuclear power management) were integrated into the newly formed Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 国家国防科技工业局由工业和信息化部管理。
description.en: The State Administration for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense is managed by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

relationships.source: BAIDU:深化党和国家机构改革方案

description.zh-cn: 该方案决定将国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心由工业和信息化部管理调整为由中央网络安全和信息化委员会办公室管理。
description.en: This plan decided to transfer the management of the National Computer Network and Information Security Management Center from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology to the Office of the Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月前，国家计算机网络与信息安全管理中心由工业和信息化部管理。
description.en: Before March 2018, the National Computer Network and Information Security Management Center was managed by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 国家卫生健康委员会接替工业和信息化部，成为牵头《烟草控制框架公约》履约的部门。
description.en: The National Health Commission took over from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology to become the lead department for implementing the Framework Convention on Tobacco Control.

description.zh-cn: 2020年8月31日，中国互联网协会与工业和信息化部分离，不再设置业务主管单位。
description.en: On August 31, 2020, the Internet Society of China was decoupled from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and no longer has a professional supervisory unit.

description.zh-cn: 会议批准的《国务院机构改革方案》将科学技术部的组织拟订高新技术发展及产业化规划和政策等职责划入工业和信息化部。
description.en: The 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan' approved at the meeting transferred responsibilities such as organizing and drafting high-tech development and industrialization plans and policies from the Ministry of Science and Technology to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 北京理工大学是工业和信息化部直属高等学校。
description.en: Beijing Institute of Technology is a university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 西北工业大学是工业和信息化部直属高等学校。
description.en: Northwestern Polytechnical University is a university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 南京航空航天大学是工业和信息化部直属高等学校。
description.en: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 南京理工大学是工业和信息化部直属高等学校。
description.en: Nanjing University of Science and Technology is a university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 哈尔滨工程大学是工业和信息化部直属高等学校。
description.en: Harbin Engineering University is a university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

description.zh-cn: 万良适是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wan Liangshi is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 万良适接替杨崇春出任太原市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wan Liangshi succeeded Yang Chongchun as Mayor of Taiyuan Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 万良适卸任太原市人民政府市长后，由孟立正接任。
description.en: After Wan Liangshi stepped down as Mayor of Taiyuan Municipal People's Government, he was succeeded by Meng Lizheng.

description.zh-cn: 在武汉地质学院地质系地质管理专业学习。
description.en: Studied geological management at the Department of Geology, Wuhan College of Geology.

description.zh-cn: 在南开大学经济系政治经济学专业在职研究生毕业。
description.en: Graduated from Nankai University's Department of Economics with a postgraduate degree in political economy while in service.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺在周永康主掌国土资源部时担任其下属。
description.en: Wang Anshun was a subordinate of Zhou Yongkang when Zhou was in charge of the Ministry of Land and Resources.

description.zh-cn: 因曾是周永康的下属，王安顺的仕途被认为受到影响而变得黯淡。
description.en: Due to his past as a subordinate of Zhou Yongkang, Wang Anshun's political career was considered to be adversely affected and dimmed.

description.zh-cn: 在王安顺担任北京市长期间，北京市成功获得第二十四届冬季奥林匹克运动会主办权。
description.en: During Wang Anshun's tenure as Mayor of Beijing, the city successfully won the bid to host the 24th Winter Olympic Games.

description.zh-cn: 在王安顺担任北京市长期间，北京市成功举办2015年世界田径锦标赛。
description.en: During Wang Anshun's tenure as Mayor of Beijing, the city successfully hosted the 2015 World Championships in Athletics.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺接替郭金龙出任北京市代理市长。
description.en: Wang Anshun succeeded Guo Jinlong as the Acting Mayor of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 蔡奇接替王安顺出任北京市市长职务。
description.en: Cai Qi succeeded Wang Anshun as the Mayor of Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺接替刘鹤出任国务院发展研究中心党组书记。
description.en: Wang Anshun succeeded Liu He as the Party Group Secretary of the Development Research Center of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 马建堂接替王安顺出任国务院发展研究中心党组书记。
description.en: Ma Jiantang succeeded Wang Anshun as the Party Group Secretary of the Development Research Center of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺接替阳安江，先后于2007年3月出任中共北京市委专职副书记，并于2011年1月19日出任北京市政协主席。
description.en: Wang Anshun succeeded Yang Anjiang, first as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee in March 2007, and then as the Chairman of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPPCC on January 19, 2011.

description.zh-cn: 吉林于2012年7月接替王安顺出任中共北京市委专职副书记。随后在2013年1月25日，再次接替王安顺，出任北京市政协主席。
description.en: Ji Lin succeeded Wang Anshun as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee in July 2012. He then succeeded Wang Anshun again on January 25, 2013, to become the Chairman of the Beijing Municipal Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺接替韩正出任中共上海市委专职副书记。
description.en: Wang Anshun succeeded Han Zheng as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 殷一璀接替王安顺出任中共上海市委专职副书记。
description.en: Yin Yicui succeeded Wang Anshun as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺接替罗世谦出任中共上海市委组织部部长。
description.en: Wang Anshun succeeded Luo Shiqian as the Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 姜斯宪接替王安顺出任中共上海市委组织部部长。
description.en: Jiang Sixian succeeded Wang Anshun as the Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 王安顺接替杨利民出任中共甘肃省委组织部部长。
description.en: Wang Anshun succeeded Yang Limin as the Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Gansu Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 徐守盛接替王安顺出任中共甘肃省委组织部部长。
description.en: Xu Shousheng succeeded Wang Anshun as the Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Gansu Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1970年9月加入中国共产党，2007年7月5日因严重违纪违法问题被开除党籍。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in September 1970, and was expelled from the party on July 5, 2007, for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 对宋平顺的严重违纪违法问题进行了调查。
description.en: Investigated Song Pingshun for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 批准开除宋平顺的中国共产党党籍。
description.en: Approved the expulsion of Song Pingshun from the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋平顺包养情妇徐敏，并生有一子。
description.en: Song Pingshun had a mistress, Xu Min, with whom he had a son.

description.zh-cn: 滥用手中权力，为情妇徐敏谋取巨额不正当利益，授意其成立公司承包政府项目。
description.en: Abused his power to obtain huge illicit benefits for his mistress Xu Min, instructing her to set up companies to contract government projects.

description.zh-cn: 20世纪90年代初轰动一时的“永基非法集资案”丑闻与宋平顺有关。
description.en: The sensational 'Yongji Illegal Fundraising Case' scandal in the early 1990s was related to Song Pingshun.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共天津市委书记张高丽向外界通报，宋平顺被查出涉及权钱交易及包养情妇等问题。
description.en: Zhang Gaoli, then Secretary of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee, announced that Song Pingshun was found to be involved in issues such as power-for-money deals and keeping a mistress.

description.zh-cn: 房凤友是宋平顺在中国人民政治协商会议天津市委员会主席职位上的前任。
description.en: Fang Fengyou was Song Pingshun's predecessor as Chairman of the CPPCC Tianjin Committee.

description.zh-cn: 邢元敏接替宋平顺担任中国人民政治协商会议天津市委员会主席。
description.en: Xing Yuanmin succeeded Song Pingshun as Chairman of the CPPCC Tianjin Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在宋平顺担任中共天津市委政法委书记等职务期间，武长顺为其下属，二人被指默契配合，分享寻租空间。
description.en: While Song Pingshun served as Secretary of the Tianjin Political and Legal Affairs Commission and other roles, Wu Changshun was his subordinate. The two were reported to have cooperated tacitly to share rent-seeking opportunities.

description.zh-cn: 2006年5月，李大伦接受湖南省纪委查处。
description.en: In May 2006, Li Dalun was investigated by the Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 2008年11月20日，长沙市中级人民法院一审判处李大伦死刑，缓期两年执行。
description.en: On November 20, 2008, the Changsha Intermediate People's Court sentenced Li Dalun to death with a two-year reprieve in the first instance.

description.zh-cn: 2020年6月，谭本仲因涉嫌“严重违纪违法”接受湖南省纪委纪律审查和监察调查。
description.en: In June 2020, Tan Benzhong was subjected to disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection for suspected 'serious violations of discipline and law'.

description.zh-cn: 2020年6月，谭本仲因涉嫌“严重违纪违法”接受湖南省监察委员会监察调查。
description.en: In June 2020, Tan Benzhong was subjected to supervisory investigation by the Hunan Provincial Supervisory Commission for suspected 'serious violations of discipline and law'.

description.zh-cn: 2020年11月30日，谭本仲遭到开除党籍、开除公职（双开）处分。
description.en: On November 30, 2020, Tan Benzhong was subjected to the disciplinary action of 'double expulsion' (expulsion from the Party and removal from public office).

description.zh-cn: 2022年12月，中央纪委公开通报了谭本仲案，其最终被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: In December 2022, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection publicly reported on Tan Benzhong's case, who was ultimately sentenced to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 2022年12月，国家监委公开通报了谭本仲案，其最终被判处无期徒刑。
description.en: In December 2022, the National Supervisory Commission publicly reported on Tan Benzhong's case, who was ultimately sentenced to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 李登瀛出生于陕西神木。
description.en: Li Dengying was born in Shenmu, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 李登瀛是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Dengying was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 早年担任中国工农红军红二十六军经理处处长等职务。
description.en: In his early years, he served as the Director of the Management Office of the 26th Army of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army.

position.zh-cn: 五地委书记兼军分区政委
position.en: Secretary of the Fifth Prefectural Committee and Political Commissar of the Military Sub-district

description.zh-cn: 1939年，任中共右山怀县委书记、朔县县委书记，后改任晋察冀边区五地委书记兼军分区政委。
description.en: In 1939, he served as Secretary of the Youshanhuai County Committee and Shuo County Committee of the CPC, and was later reassigned as Secretary of the Fifth Prefectural Committee and Political Commissar of the Military Sub-district of the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region.

description.zh-cn: 1979年兼任甘肃省人大常委会副主任，1983年担任第六届甘肃省人大常委会主任。
description.en: In 1979, he concurrently served as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Gansu Provincial People's Congress, and in 1983, he became the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Sixth Gansu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李登瀛接替冯纪新出任甘肃省人民政府省长。
description.en: Li Dengying succeeded Feng Jixin as the Governor of the Gansu Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 李登瀛的甘肃省人民政府省长职务由陈光毅接任。
description.en: Chen Guangyi succeeded Li Dengying as the Governor of the Gansu Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 李登瀛曾担任第二届、第三届、第四届全国政协委员。
description.en: Li Dengying served as a member of the Second, Third, and Fourth National Committees of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 李登瀛是第六届全国人大代表。
description.en: Li Dengying was a deputy to the Sixth National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 沈辛荪是江苏常熟人。
description.en: Shen Xinsun is a native of Changshu, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 沈辛荪是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Shen Xinsun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1965年至1984年间，沈辛荪于七机部任职。
description.en: From 1965 to 1984, Shen Xinsun worked at the Seventh Ministry of Machine Building.

description.zh-cn: 1984年后，沈辛荪先后担任中华人民共和国航空航天工业部第一研究院党委书记和院长。
description.en: After 1984, Shen Xinsun successively served as the Party Secretary and President of the First Academy of the Ministry of Aerospace Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 沈辛荪是第八届全国人大代表。
description.en: Shen Xinsun was a delegate to the 8th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 沈辛荪曾担任第八届和第九届全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员。
description.en: Shen Xinsun served as a member of the Standing Committee of the 8th and 9th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类和模板信息，沈辛荪曾任中国宇航学会第三届理事会常务理事。
description.en: According to category and template information, Shen Xinsun served as a Standing Director of the 3rd Council of the Chinese Society of Astronautics.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼于1984年6月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi joined the Communist Party of China in June 1984.

description.zh-cn: 1984年7月，周祖翼毕业于浙江大学地质学系，获理学学士学位。
description.en: In July 1984, Zhou Zuyi graduated from the Department of Geology at Zhejiang University with a Bachelor of Science degree.

description.zh-cn: 1989年10月，周祖翼在同济大学海洋地质与地球物理系获理学博士学位。
description.en: In October 1989, Zhou Zuyi obtained a Doctor of Science degree from the Department of Marine Geology and Geophysics at Tongji University.

description.zh-cn: 朱夏是周祖翼在同济大学攻读博士学位期间的导师。
description.en: Zhu Xia was Zhou Zuyi's advisor during his doctoral studies at Tongji University.

position.zh-cn: 上海市委组织部副部长
position.en: Deputy Head of the Organization Department of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼担任上海市委组织部副部长期间，沈红光是时任部长。
description.en: While Zhou Zuyi served as Deputy Head of the Organization Department of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, Shen Hongguang was the Head of the department.

position.zh-cn: 上海市委组织部副部长
position.en: Deputy Head of the Organization Department of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼担任上海市委组织部副部长期间，李希是时任部长。
description.en: While Zhou Zuyi served as Deputy Head of the Organization Department of the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee, Li Xi was the Head of the department.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼接替周家伦出任同济大学党委书记。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi succeeded Zhou Jialun as the Party Secretary of Tongji University.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼离任同济大学党委书记，由杨贤金接任。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi left his position as Party Secretary of Tongji University, and was succeeded by Yang Xianjin.

position.zh-cn: 部务委员兼干部二局局长、副部长
position.en: Member of the Ministerial Affairs Committee and Director of the Second Bureau for Cadres, Vice Minister

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼于2014年8月任中共中央组织部部务委员兼干部二局局长，2016年10月升任副部长。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi was appointed as a member of the Ministerial Affairs Committee and Director of the Second Bureau for Cadres of the Central Organization Department in August 2014, and was promoted to Vice Minister in October 2016.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼调任中组部后，进入中央巡视工作领导小组。
description.en: After being transferred to the Central Organization Department, Zhou Zuyi became a member of the Central Leading Group for Inspection Work.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼于2019年5月23日接替张纪南出任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任，并于2022年6月24日接替张纪南出任中华人民共和国人力资源和社会保障部部长。
description.en: On May 23, 2019, Zhou Zuyi succeeded Zhang Jinan as Director of the State Commission Office for Public Sector Reform. On June 24, 2022, he again succeeded Zhang Jinan, this time as Minister of Human Resources and Social Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼离任中央机构编制委员会办公室主任，由李小新接任。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi left his position as Director of the State Commission Office for Public Sector Reform, and was succeeded by Li Xiaoxin.

position.zh-cn: 人力资源和社会保障部部长
position.en: Minister of Human Resources and Social Security

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼担任人力资源和社会保障部部长期间，李克强是时任国务院总理。
description.en: While Zhou Zuyi served as Minister of Human Resources and Social Security, Li Keqiang was the Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼离任人力资源和社会保障部部长，由王晓萍接任。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi left his position as Minister of Human Resources and Social Security, and was succeeded by Wang Xiaoping.

position.en: Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼担任福建省委书记，向以习近平为总书记的党中央负责。
description.en: As Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, Zhou Zuyi is responsible to the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping as General Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼接替尹力出任中共福建省委书记。
description.en: Zhou Zuyi succeeded Yin Li as Secretary of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周祖翼担任福建省委书记期间，赵龙担任福建省省长，两人为同事。
description.en: While Zhou Zuyi served as Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, Zhao Long served as Governor of Fujian Province; they were colleagues.

description.zh-cn: 尹家绪自2013年5月起任中国兵器工业集团公司董事长，后于2021年被查处。
description.en: Yin Jiaxu served as the Chairman of China North Industries Group Corporation since May 2013 and was investigated in 2021.

description.zh-cn: 焦开河自2013年5月起任中国兵器工业集团公司总经理、董事。
description.en: Jiao Kaihe has served as General Manager and Director of China North Industries Group Corporation since May 2013.

description.zh-cn: 2021年10月25日，中国最高人民检察院宣布，因涉嫌严重违纪违法，已正式逮捕中国兵器工业集团有限公司前党组书记兼董事长尹家绪。
description.en: On October 25, 2021, the Supreme People's Procuratorate of China announced the formal arrest of Yin Jiaxu, former Party Secretary and Chairman of China North Industries Group Corporation Limited, on suspicion of serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府吊销了钱学森的机密工作许可，并将其拘留和软禁长达五年，阻止其回国。
description.en: The U.S. government revoked Qian Xuesen's security clearance, detained and placed him under house arrest for five years, preventing his return to China.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，赵九章因受迫害而服安眠药自杀。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhao Jiuzhang committed suicide by taking sleeping pills due to persecution.

description.zh-cn: 何毅亭于1983年3月加入中国共产党。
description.en: He Yiting joined the Communist Party of China in March 1983.

description.zh-cn: 何毅亭于1968年12月初中毕业于汉中中学。
description.en: He Yiting graduated from Hanzhong High School (junior high) in December 1968.

description.zh-cn: 何毅亭于1979年9月至1986年7月在北京师范大学学习，先后获得历史学学士和硕士学位。
description.en: He Yiting studied at Beijing Normal University from September 1979 to July 1986, obtaining bachelor's and master's degrees in history.

position.en: Principal Staff Member, Deputy Division Chief

description.zh-cn: 何毅亭于1986年7月至1989年9月在中共中央办公厅办公室工作。
description.en: He Yiting worked in the General Office of the CPC Central Committee from July 1986 to September 1989.

position.zh-cn: 处长，党建组副组长、组长，副主任，常务副主任
position.en: Division Chief, Deputy Head and Head of the Party Building Group, Deputy Director, Executive Deputy Director

description.zh-cn: 何毅亭自1989年9月起在中央政策研究室工作，历任多个职位，并于2009年4月至2013年9月担任常务副主任。
description.en: He Yiting worked at the Central Policy Research Office from September 1989, holding various positions, and served as Executive Deputy Director from April 2009 to September 2013.

description.zh-cn: 在中央政策研究室任职期间，何毅亭多次陪同习近平外出调研，并被外界视为习近平的嫡系亲信和文胆之一。
description.en: During his tenure at the Central Policy Research Office, He Yiting accompanied Xi Jinping on numerous inspection tours and is widely regarded as one of Xi's trusted confidants and key advisors.

description.zh-cn: 于2020年6月15日发表文章，称习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想是“21世纪的马克思主义”。
description.en: Published an article on June 15, 2020, claiming that Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era is 'Marxism of the 21st century'.

description.zh-cn: 与王沪宁、江金权并称为习近平的文胆。
description.en: Known as one of Xi Jinping's key advisors, along with Wang Huning and Jiang Jinquan.

description.zh-cn: 与王沪宁、江金权并称为习近平的文胆。
description.en: Known as one of Xi Jinping's key advisors, along with Wang Huning and Jiang Jinquan.

description.zh-cn: 据政治评论家陈破空称，何毅亭曾在文章中罕见地反思并否定文化大革命，称其“不好”、“不对”。
description.en: According to political commentator Chen Pokong, He Yiting unusually reflected upon and criticized the Cultural Revolution in an article, calling it 'not good' and 'not right'.

description.zh-cn: 于2013年9月接替李景田担任中共中央党校常务副校长。
description.en: Succeeded Li Jingtian as the Executive Vice President of the Central Party School in September 2013.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年接替何毅亭曾担任的中共中央政策研究室常务副主任职务。
description.en: Succeeded to the position of Executive Deputy Director of the Central Policy Research Office in 2017, a role previously held by He Yiting.

description.zh-cn: 于2018年4月接替马建堂担任国家行政学院常务副院长。
description.en: Succeeded Ma Jiantang as the Executive Vice President of the National Academy of Governance in April 2018.

description.zh-cn: 郭富城与方媛于2017年4月18日在香港半岛酒店举行婚宴。
description.en: Aaron Kwok and Moka Fang held their wedding banquet at The Peninsula Hong Kong on April 18, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 郭富城是郭志的儿子。
description.en: Aaron Kwok is the son of Kwok Chi.

description.zh-cn: 郭富城与熊黛林曾有过一段长达七年的恋情。
description.en: Aaron Kwok and Lynn Hung were in a relationship for seven years.

description.zh-cn: 据称郭富城与Beyond乐队的黄家驹是好友，并曾为参加其告别式而取消演唱会。
description.en: Aaron Kwok was reportedly a good friend of Wong Ka Kui from the band Beyond and cancelled a concert to attend his funeral.

description.zh-cn: 时任无线电视艺人经理的冯美基将郭富城介绍至1987年的艺员训练班。
description.en: As the artist manager at TVB, Fung Mei-kei introduced Aaron Kwok to the artist training class in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 1992年，郭富城与张学友、刘德华、黎明一同被香港电台晋封为“四大天王”。
description.en: In 1992, Aaron Kwok, along with Jacky Cheung, Andy Lau, and Leon Lai, was named one of the 'Four Heavenly Kings' by Radio Television Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 郭富城与珍妮·杰克逊于1999年合作拍摄百事可乐广告宣传片。
description.en: Aaron Kwok collaborated with Janet Jackson in 1999 to film a promotional commercial for Pepsi.

description.zh-cn: 时任总统蔡英文任命萧美琴为国家安全会议咨询委员，后又指派其为驻美代表。
description.en: Then-President Tsai Ing-wen appointed Hsiao Bi-khim as an advisor to the National Security Council and later as the Representative to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 在担任驻美代表期间，萧美琴向时任外交部长吴钊燮汇报。
description.en: During her tenure as Representative to the U.S., Hsiao Bi-khim reported to then-Minister of Foreign Affairs Joseph Wu.

description.zh-cn: 萧美琴曾担任四届中华民国立法委员。
description.en: Hsiao Bi-khim served four terms as a member of the Legislative Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 萧美琴在此次选举中当选为中华民国副总统。
description.en: Hsiao Bi-khim was elected Vice President of the Republic of China in this election.

description.zh-cn: 萧美琴担任赖清德总统任内的副总统。
description.en: Hsiao Bi-khim serves as Vice President under President Lai Ching-te.

description.zh-cn: 王廷升与萧美琴在2010年及2016年的花莲县立法委员选举中互为竞争对手，互有胜负。
description.en: Wang Ting-sheng and Hsiao Bi-khim were political rivals in the 2010 and 2016 Hualien County legislative elections, with each winning one election.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年裴洛西访问台湾后，中共中央台办点名抨击萧美琴，并将其列入“台独”顽固分子清单进行制裁。
description.en: After Nancy Pelosi's visit to Taiwan in 2022, the Taiwan Affairs Office of the CPC Central Committee publicly criticized Hsiao Bi-khim and placed her on the "'Taiwan independence' diehard elements" list for sanctions.

description.zh-cn: 在蔡英文与麦卡锡会面后，中国共产党当局宣布对萧美琴实施进一步制裁。
description.en: Following the meeting between Tsai Ing-wen and Kevin McCarthy, the Communist Party of China authorities announced further sanctions against Hsiao Bi-khim.

description.zh-cn: 萧美琴访问捷克期间，其车队遭到中国驻捷克大使馆人员驾车尾随，险酿车祸。
description.en: During Hsiao Bi-khim's visit to the Czech Republic, her convoy was followed by a vehicle driven by personnel from the Chinese embassy, nearly causing an accident.

description.zh-cn: 时任驻美代表的萧美琴在双橡园会晤了前美国国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥。
description.en: Then-Representative to the U.S. Hsiao Bi-khim met with former U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo at Twin Oaks.

description.zh-cn: 萧美琴陪同立法院长游锡堃拜会了时任美国众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡。
description.en: Hsiao Bi-khim accompanied Legislative Yuan President You Si-kun to visit then-U.S. House Speaker Kevin McCarthy.

description.zh-cn: 德川家康在关原之战中取得胜利，为其建立江户幕府奠定了决定性基础。
description.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu's victory in the Battle of Sekigahara provided the decisive foundation for him to establish the Edo shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 在明治维新期间，江户被更名为东京。
description.en: During the Meiji Restoration, Edo was renamed Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 随着明治维新及迁都东京，京都失去了作为日本首都的地位。
description.en: With the Meiji Restoration and the relocation of the capital to Tokyo, Kyoto lost its status as the capital of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战是东京大轰炸发生的背景。
description.en: World War II was the context in which the Bombing of Tokyo occurred.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党中央军事委员会纪律检查委员会是中央军事委员会机关第一级职能部门。
description.en: The Discipline Inspection Commission of the CPC Central Military Commission is a first-level functional department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委纪委一般在中央纪委指导下工作。其前身解放军监察委员会在中共中央监察委领导下工作。
description.en: The CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection generally works under the guidance of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. Its predecessor, the PLA Supervisory Commission, worked under the leadership of the CPC Central Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 根据中国共产党全国代表大会的决定，在解放军团以上单位成立了监察委员会。
description.en: According to the decision of the National Congress of the Communist Party of China, supervisory committees were established in PLA units at and above the regiment level.

description.zh-cn: 经中共中央批准，中国共产党中国人民解放军监察委员会于1955年成立；后经中共中央批准，中国人民解放军纪律检查委员会于1980年1月成立。
description.en: With the approval of the CPC Central Committee, the Supervisory Commission of the Chinese People's Liberation Army of the CPC was established in 1955; later, with the approval of the CPC Central Committee, the Discipline Inspection Commission of the Chinese People's Liberation Army was established in January 1980.

description.zh-cn: 在“文化大革命”期间，解放军监察委的工作随即停止。
description.en: During the "Cultural Revolution", the work of the PLA Supervisory Commission was suspended.

description.zh-cn: 中共“九大”通过决议，取消了党的监察机构，解放军监察委亦随之取消。
description.en: The 9th National Congress of the CPC passed a resolution to abolish the party's supervisory bodies, and the PLA Supervisory Commission was consequently abolished.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，军委机关调整组建，成立了新的中央军委纪律检查委员会。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the CMC organs were restructured, and a new CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection was established.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国监察法》的通过，正式设立了各级国家监察机关，之后中央军委纪律检查委员会加挂中央军委监察委员会牌子。
description.en: The passage of the Supervision Law of the People's Republic of China formally established state supervisory organs at all levels, after which the CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection also became the CMC Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总政治部纪律检查部是中国共产党中央军事委员会纪律检查委员会的办事机关。
description.en: The Discipline Inspection Department of the PLA General Political Department was the working body of the CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 王守业被中央军纪委“双规”。
description.en: Wang Shouye was subjected to "shuanggui" by the CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委纪委与中央纪委联合办案，调查谷俊山案。
description.en: The CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection and the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection jointly handled the investigation into Gu Junshan's case.

description.zh-cn: 中央纪委参与调查了谷俊山案。
description.en: The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection participated in the investigation of the Gu Junshan case.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委纪委参与了对徐才厚的调查。
description.en: The CMC Commission for Discipline Inspection participated in the investigation of Xu Caihou.

description.zh-cn: 中央纪委参与了对徐才厚的调查过程。
description.en: The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection participated in the investigation process of Xu Caihou.

description.zh-cn: 历时三年的朝鲜战争最终以签署《朝鲜停战协定》而告终。
description.en: The three-year Korean War concluded with the signing of the Korean Armistice Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 在2018年4月的朝韩首脑会晤上，双方签署了《板门店宣言》。
description.en: The Panmunjom Declaration was signed during the inter-Korean summit in April 2018.

description.zh-cn: 为了报复韩国脱北者放飞传单一事，朝鲜人民军总参谋部警告会再次在非军事区内驻军，与《板门店宣言》的目标相悖。
description.en: In retaliation for North Korean defectors in South Korea sending leaflets, the KPA General Staff Department warned it would re-garrison troops in the DMZ, contradicting the goals of the Panmunjom Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜派遣特种部队人员发动了旨在暗杀韩国总统朴正熙的青瓦台事件。
description.en: North Korea dispatched special forces commandos to carry out the Blue House raid, an attempt to assassinate South Korean President Park Chung-hee.

description.zh-cn: 青瓦台事件是一次针对时任韩国总统朴正熙的未遂暗杀行动。
description.en: The Blue House raid was a failed assassination attempt against the then-President of South Korea, Park Chung-hee.

description.zh-cn: 美军士兵特拉维斯·金闯入朝鲜境内后，被朝鲜当局拘留。
description.en: After U.S. soldier Travis King crossed into North Korea, he was detained by North Korean authorities.

description.zh-cn: 梁光烈担任中华人民共和国国防部部长。
description.en: Liang Guanglie served as the Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曹刚川是梁光烈的前任中华人民共和国国防部部长。
description.en: Cao Gangchuan was Liang Guanglie's predecessor as Minister of National Defense of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 梁光烈担任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Liang Guanglie served as the Chief of the General Staff of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有是梁光烈的前任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Fu Quanyou was Liang Guanglie's predecessor as Chief of the General Staff of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 陈炳德曾是梁光烈在中国人民解放军南京军区司令员一职上的前任，后又继任梁光烈为中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Chen Bingde was Liang Guanglie's predecessor as Commander of the Nanjing Military Region, and later succeeded him as Chief of the General Staff of the Chinese People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 在中越战争期间，作为武汉军区作战部副部长，协助昆明军区司令员杨得志指挥作战。
