description.en: During the Sino-Vietnamese War, as Deputy Director of the Operations Department of the Wuhan Military Region, he assisted Yang Dezhi, Commander of the Kunming Military Region, in commanding operations.

position.zh-cn: 武汉军区作战部副部长
position.en: Deputy Director of the Operations Department of the Wuhan Military Region

description.zh-cn: 梁光烈在中越战争期间，协助昆明军区司令员杨得志指挥作战。
description.en: During the Sino-Vietnamese War, Liang Guanglie assisted Yang Dezhi, Commander of the Kunming Military Region, in commanding operations.

description.zh-cn: 受中共中央委托，前往八宝山革命公墓为梁光烈送别。
description.en: Entrusted by the CPC Central Committee, went to Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery to bid farewell to Liang Guanglie.

description.zh-cn: 受中共中央委托，前往八宝山革命公墓为梁光烈送别。
description.en: Entrusted by the CPC Central Committee, went to Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery to bid farewell to Liang Guanglie.

description.zh-cn: 受中共中央委托，前往八宝山革命公墓为梁光烈送别。
description.en: Entrusted by the CPC Central Committee, went to Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery to bid farewell to Liang Guanglie.

description.zh-cn: 朱文泉是梁光烈的继任中国人民解放军南京军区司令员。
description.en: Zhu Wenquan was Liang Guanglie's successor as Commander of the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 李新良是梁光烈的前任中国人民解放军沈阳军区司令员。
description.en: Li Xinliang was Liang Guanglie's predecessor as Commander of the Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 钱国梁是梁光烈的继任中国人民解放军沈阳军区司令员。
description.en: Qian Guoliang was Liang Guanglie's successor as Commander of the Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 黄云桥是梁光烈的前任中国人民解放军北京军区参谋长。
description.en: Huang Yunqiao was Liang Guanglie's predecessor as Chief of Staff of the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 黄信生是梁光烈的继任中国人民解放军北京军区参谋长。
description.en: Huang Xinsheng was Liang Guanglie's successor as Chief of Staff of the Beijing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 张祥林是梁光烈的继任中国人民解放军陆军第五十四集团军军长。
description.en: Zhang Xianglin was Liang Guanglie's successor as Commander of the 54th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 杨石毅是梁光烈的前任中国人民解放军陆军第二十集团军军长。
description.en: Yang Shiyi was Liang Guanglie's predecessor as Commander of the 20th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 丁寿岳是梁光烈的继任中国人民解放军陆军第二十集团军军长。
description.en: Ding Shouyue was Liang Guanglie's successor as Commander of the 20th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 江绵康是江泽民的次子。
description.en: Jiang Miankang is the second son of Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 江绵康是王冶坪的次子。
description.en: Jiang Miankang is the second son of Wang Yeping.

description.zh-cn: 江绵康是江苏省扬州市人。
description.en: Jiang Miankang is from Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 江绵康于1985年毕业于上海第二工业大学。
description.en: Jiang Miankang graduated from Shanghai Second Polytechnic University in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 江绵康于1999年至2006年在华东师范大学获得博士学位。
description.en: Jiang Miankang obtained a PhD from East China Normal University between 1999 and 2006.

description.zh-cn: 杨秀珠声称，在她担任温州市主管城建的副市长时，因屡次回绝江绵康索要500亩土地的不合规要求而得罪了他。
description.en: Yang Xiuzhu claimed that when she was the vice mayor of Wenzhou in charge of urban construction, she offended Jiang Miankang by repeatedly rejecting his non-compliant requests for 500 mu of land.

description.zh-cn: 杨秀珠声称，她开始被调查主要是因为她得罪了江泽民。
description.en: Yang Xiuzhu claimed that the investigation against her began mainly because she had offended Jiang Zemin.

description.zh-cn: 冯军自2021年9月起担任山西省高级人民法院院长。
description.en: Feng Jun has been serving as the President of the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court since September 2021.

position.en: Grand Justice of the second rank

description.zh-cn: 冯军持有二级大法官的衔级。
description.en: Feng Jun holds the rank of a Grand Justice of the second rank.

description.zh-cn: 左世忠于2007年2月至2017年1月期间担任山西省高级人民法院院长。
description.en: Zuo Shizhong served as the President of the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court from February 2007 to January 2017.

description.zh-cn: 邱水平于2017年1月至2018年10月期间担任山西省高级人民法院院长。
description.en: Qiu Shuiping served as the President of the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court from January 2017 to October 2018.

description.zh-cn: 孙洪山于2018年11月至2021年6月期间担任山西省高级人民法院院长。
description.en: Sun Hongshan served as the President of the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court from November 2018 to June 2021.

description.zh-cn: 山西省高级人民法院是中华人民共和国最高人民法院的业务下级和上诉法院。
description.en: The Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court is the professional subordinate and appellate court to the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 山西省高级人民法院对山西省人民代表大会负责并报告工作。
description.en: The Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court is responsible to and reports to the Shanxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 在山西省人民代表大会闭会期间，山西省高级人民法院对山西省人民代表大会常务委员会负责并报告工作。
description.en: When the Shanxi Provincial People's Congress is not in session, the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court is responsible to and reports to its Standing Committee.

description.zh-cn: 山西省高级人民法院接受中国共产党山西省委员会的领导。
description.en: The Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court is under the leadership of the Shanxi Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月《中华人民共和国宪法》颁布后，山西省人民法院改称为山西省高级人民法院。
description.en: After the promulgation of the Constitution of the People's Republic of China in September 1954, the Shanxi Provincial People's Court was renamed the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国人民法院组织法》颁布后，山西省人民法院改称为山西省高级人民法院。
description.en: Following the promulgation of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, the Shanxi Provincial People's Court was renamed the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 山西省高级人民法院对赵黎平案进行了二审审理。
description.en: The Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court conducted the second-instance trial of the Zhao Liping case.

description.zh-cn: 是山西省高级人民法院的下级法院。
description.en: Is a subordinate court to the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court.

relationships.source: BAIDU:山西省晋中市中级人民法院

description.zh-cn: 是山西省高级人民法院的下级法院。
description.en: Is a subordinate court to the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 是山西省高级人民法院的下级法院。
description.en: Is a subordinate court to the Shanxi Provincial Higher People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 香港警方以筹办或参与2020年民主派初选为由，发动大规模拘捕行动，引发了香港47人案。
description.en: The Hong Kong police launched a large-scale arrest operation on the grounds of organizing or participating in the 2020 pro-democracy primaries, which triggered the Hong Kong 47 case.

description.zh-cn: 香港警务处国家安全处策划并执行了针对民主派初选参与者的拘捕行动。
description.en: The National Security Department of the Hong Kong Police Force planned and executed the arrest operation targeting participants of the pro-democracy primaries.

description.zh-cn: 律政司以“串谋颠覆国家政权”罪名正式起诉47名民主派人士。
description.en: The Department of Justice formally prosecuted 47 pro-democracy figures on charges of 'conspiracy to commit subversion'.

description.zh-cn: 戴耀廷是民主派初选的主要倡议者和组织者之一。他于2020年4月28日在《苹果日报》发表文章，提出“揽炒十步曲”方针。
description.en: Benny Tai was one of the main proponents and organizers of the pro-democracy primaries. On April 28, 2020, he published an article in Apple Daily proposing the 'Ten steps to mutual destruction' strategy.

description.zh-cn: 区诺轩在案件审讯中担任控方证人。
description.en: Au Nok-hin served as a prosecution witness during the case trial.

description.zh-cn: 赵家贤在案件审讯中担任控方证人。
description.en: Andrew Chiu served as a prosecution witness during the case trial.

description.zh-cn: 钟锦麟在案件审讯中担任控方证人。
description.en: Chung Kam-lun served as a prosecution witness during the case trial.

description.zh-cn: 林景楠在案件审讯中担任控方证人。
description.en: Mike Lam served as a prosecution witness during the case trial.

description.zh-cn: 戴耀廷在香港47人案中被拘捕、起诉，并最终被判处10年监禁。
description.en: Benny Tai was arrested, prosecuted, and ultimately sentenced to 10 years in prison in the Hong Kong 47 case.

description.zh-cn: 刘伟聪在香港47人案中被拘捕、起诉，但经审讯后被裁定罪名不成立。
description.en: Lawrence Lau was arrested and prosecuted in the Hong Kong 47 case, but was acquitted after trial.

description.zh-cn: 李予信在香港47人案中被拘捕、起诉，但经审讯后被裁定罪名不成立。律政司未对其裁决提出上诉，案件正式结束。
description.en: Lee Yue-shun was arrested and prosecuted in the Hong Kong 47 case, but was acquitted after trial. The Department of Justice did not appeal his acquittal, formally concluding the case.

description.zh-cn: 何桂蓝在香港47人案中被拘捕、起诉，并最终被判处7年监禁。
description.en: Gwyneth Ho was arrested, prosecuted, and ultimately sentenced to 7 years in prison in the Hong Kong 47 case.

description.zh-cn: 谭文豪在审讯期间宣布退出公民党。
description.en: Jeremy Tam announced his withdrawal from the Civic Party during the trial.

description.zh-cn: 郭家麒在审讯期间宣布退出公民党。
description.en: Kwok Ka-ki announced his withdrawal from the Civic Party during the trial.

description.zh-cn: 李予信在审讯期间宣布退出公民党。
description.en: Lee Yue-shun announced his withdrawal from the Civic Party during the trial.

description.zh-cn: 时任保安局局长李家超形容初选是“歹毒的计划”，并表示警方的拘捕行动是必要和必需的，以维护国家安全。
description.en: Then-Secretary for Security John Lee described the primaries as a 'vicious plot' and stated that the police's arrest operation was necessary and essential to safeguard national security.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交部表示支持香港警方依法履职，并反对外部势力干涉。
description.en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China expressed support for the Hong Kong police in performing their duties according to the law and opposed interference by external forces.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国国务卿蓬佩奥对拘捕行动表示愤慨，并考虑对相关人员实施制裁。
description.en: Then-U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo expressed outrage at the arrests and stated that the U.S. was considering sanctions against those involved.

description.zh-cn: 时任英国外交大臣蓝韬文谴责该拘捕行动是对香港人权和自由的沉重打击。
description.en: Then-UK Foreign Secretary Dominic Raab condemned the arrest operation as a grievous blow to the rights and freedoms of the people of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 时任中华民国总统蔡英文谴责大搜捕，并呼吁全世界民主阵营伙伴声援香港。
description.en: Then-President of the Republic of China Tsai Ing-wen condemned the mass arrests and called on democratic partners worldwide to support Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 出狱后，薄一波被派往太原，与山西地方军阀阎锡山达成从事抗日救亡工作的协议。
description.en: After being released from prison, Bo Yibo was sent to Taiyuan and reached an agreement with the local Shanxi warlord Yan Xishan to engage in anti-Japanese national salvation work.

description.zh-cn: 在逼迫胡耀邦下台的“党内生活会”上，习仲勋斥责薄一波等元老们动用文革式手段，是违反党的原则的。
description.en: At the "Party life meeting" that forced Hu Yaobang to step down, Xi Zhongxun rebuked elders like Bo Yibo for using Cultural Revolution-style methods, which violated Party principles.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年六四天安门事件前夕，薄一波向邓小平提出要采取果断措施，并支持对北京实施戒严以恢复社会秩序。
description.en: On the eve of the 1989 Tiananmen Square incident, Bo Yibo proposed to Deng Xiaoping that decisive measures should be taken and supported the implementation of martial law in Beijing to restore social order.

description.zh-cn: 薄一波是薄昌福的儿子。
description.en: Bo Yibo is the son of Bo Changfu.

description.zh-cn: 李君是四川苍溪人。
description.en: Li Jun is from Cangxi, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 李君是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Li Jun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，李君当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会四川地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Li Jun was elected as a delegate representing the Sichuan region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李君的国籍是中华人民共和国。
description.en: Li Jun's nationality is the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 谢有法于1936年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xie Youfa joined the Communist Party of China in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 谢有法出生于江西省兴国县。
description.en: Xie Youfa was born in Xingguo County, Jiangxi.

position.en: Political Commissar of the 232nd Regiment, 78th Division

description.zh-cn: 曾任红15军团第78师232团政治委员。
description.en: Served as the Political Commissar of the 232nd Regiment, 78th Division of the 15th Army Group of the Red Army.

position.en: Director of the Organization Department of the Political Department

description.zh-cn: 曾任山东纵队政治部组织部部长。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Organization Department of the Political Department of the Shandong Column.

position.zh-cn: 兼山东军区政治部组织部部长
position.en: Concurrent Director of the Organization Department of the Political Department of the Shandong Military Region

description.zh-cn: 曾任新四军兼山东军区政治部组织部副部长，后升任部长。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Director of the Organization Department of the Political Department of the New Fourth Army and Shandong Military Region, later promoted to Director.

position.en: Director of the Political Department of the Eastern Front Corps

description.zh-cn: 曾任华东野战军东线兵团政治部主任。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Political Department of the Eastern Front Corps of the East China Field Army.

position.en: Director of the Political Department of the 9th Army Group

description.zh-cn: 曾任第三野战军9兵团政治部主任。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Political Department of the 9th Army Group of the Third Field Army.

position.en: Director of the Political Department of the 9th Army Group

description.zh-cn: 曾任中国人民志愿军第9兵团政治部主任。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Political Department of the 9th Army Group of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Organization Department

description.zh-cn: 曾任人民解放军总政治部组织部副部长。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Director of the Organization Department of the PLA General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 曾任哈尔滨军事工程学院政治委员。
description.en: Served as the Political Commissar of the PLA Military Institute of Engineering (Harbin Military Engineering Institute).

description.zh-cn: 曾任国家基本建设委员会政治部主任。
description.en: Served as the Director of the Political Department of the State Capital Construction Commission.

description.zh-cn: 曾任沈阳军区副政治委员。
description.en: Served as the Deputy Political Commissar of the Shenyang Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 曾任政治学院政治委员。
description.en: Served as the Political Commissar of the Political College.

description.zh-cn: 谢有法是中国人民解放军中将。
description.en: Xie Youfa was a lieutenant general in the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 文强在担任重庆市公安局副局长任上，负责侦破并成功抓获了张君及其犯罪团伙。
description.en: While serving as the Deputy Director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, Wen Qiang was responsible for investigating and successfully apprehending Zhang Jun and his criminal gang.

description.zh-cn: 在陈邦国担任重庆市公安局局长期间，文强是其下属副局长。
description.en: During Chen Bangguo's tenure as Director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, Wen Qiang was his subordinate Deputy Director.

description.zh-cn: 在朱明国担任重庆市公安局局长期间，文强是其下属副局长、常务副局长。
description.en: During Zhu Mingguo's tenure as Director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, Wen Qiang was his subordinate Deputy Director and Executive Deputy Director.

description.zh-cn: 在刘光磊担任重庆市公安局局长期间，文强是其下属常务副局长。
description.en: During Liu Guanglei's tenure as Director of the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau, Wen Qiang was his subordinate Executive Deputy Director.

description.zh-cn: 文强在重庆打黑除恶专项行动中案发并被查处。
description.en: Wen Qiang's case was exposed and he was investigated during the Chongqing Gang Crackdown.

position.en: Deputy Chief of the Public Order Corps

description.zh-cn: 陈涛曾是文强在重庆市公安局的下属，后一同受审。
description.en: Chen Tao was formerly Wen Qiang's subordinate at the Chongqing Municipal Public Security Bureau and was later tried in the same case.

description.zh-cn: 二审驳回文强上诉，维持死刑原判。
description.en: In the second-instance trial, rejected Wen Qiang's appeal and upheld the original death sentence.

description.zh-cn: 核准并执行了文强的死刑。
description.en: Approved and carried out Wen Qiang's death sentence.

description.zh-cn: 梁广出生于湖南浏阳。
description.en: Liang Guang was born in Liuyang, Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 梁广是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Liang Guang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2002年毕业于北京化工大学应用化学系精细化工专业，获得学士学位。
description.en: Graduated in 2002 from the Department of Applied Chemistry, majoring in Fine Chemicals, at Beijing University of Chemical Technology with a bachelor's degree.

description.zh-cn: 2007年获得南京理工大学化工学院生物化学专业博士学位。
description.en: Obtained a PhD in Biochemistry from the School of Chemical Engineering at Nanjing University of Science and Technology in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 梁广在温州医学院任职期间，师从时任药学院院长的李校堃。
description.en: During his tenure at Wenzhou Medical College, Liang Guang was mentored by Li Xiaokun, who was then the Dean of the School of Pharmacy.

position.zh-cn: 药学院副院长、院长，研究生院院长
position.en: Deputy Dean and Dean of the School of Pharmacy, Dean of the Graduate School

description.zh-cn: 梁广在中国工作后，首先在温州医学院任职，历任药学院副院长、院长，研究生院院长。
description.en: After returning to China to work, Liang Guang first held positions at Wenzhou Medical College, successively serving as Deputy Dean and Dean of the School of Pharmacy, and Dean of the Graduate School.

position.en: Vice President, Member of the Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 2020年8月，梁广调任杭州医学院副院长、党委委员。
description.en: In August 2020, Liang Guang was transferred to Hangzhou Medical College as Vice President and a member of the Party Committee.

description.zh-cn: 梁广曾获得国家“万人计划”科技创新领军人才荣誉。
description.en: Liang Guang was honored as a leading talent in scientific and technological innovation under the national 'Ten Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 梁广担任中国药理学会第十一届理事会理事。
description.en: Liang Guang serves as a council member of the 11th Council of the Chinese Pharmacological Society.

description.zh-cn: 作为中华人民共和国权力金字塔的顶端，中央政治局控制着军队（中央军事委员会）。
description.en: As the apex of the power structure in the People's Republic of China, the Politburo controls the military (Central Military Commission).

description.zh-cn: 于中共二十届一中全会当选为中央政治局委员。
description.en: Elected as a member of the Politburo at the 1st Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 于中共二十届一中全会当选为中央政治局常委。
description.en: Elected as a member of the Politburo Standing Committee at the 1st Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2017年9月，孙政才被开除党籍，其政治局委员职务自然撤销。
description.en: In September 2017, Sun Zhengcai was expelled from the Party, and his position as a Politburo member was automatically revoked.

description.zh-cn: 1972年至1975年在武汉大学外语系英文专业学习。
description.en: Studied in the English Department of Wuhan University from 1972 to 1975.

description.zh-cn: 刘亚洲于1986年5月至1987年担任斯坦福大学访问学者。
description.en: Liu Yazhou was a visiting scholar at Stanford University from May 1986 to 1987.

description.zh-cn: 1970年11月加入中国共产党，2023年被开除党籍。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in November 1970 and was expelled in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 2023年，刘亚洲被开除中国共产党党籍。
description.en: In 2023, Liu Yazhou was expelled from the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 于2023年春节前后完成对刘亚洲的调查，将其双开并移交军队司法系统处理。
description.en: Completed the investigation of Liu Yazhou around the Spring Festival of 2023, resulting in his double expulsion (from the Party and military) and transfer to the military judicial system for prosecution.

description.zh-cn: 刊登署名文章，批评刘亚洲为“典型的野心家和阴谋家”。
description.en: Published signed articles criticizing Liu Yazhou as 'a typical careerist and conspirator'.

description.zh-cn: 因鼓吹西方文明的“人道、人权、人性、民主、自由”等普世价值观而受到批判。
description.en: Was criticized for advocating universal values of Western civilization such as 'humanity, human rights, human nature, democracy, and freedom'.

description.zh-cn: 孔原于1933年与张越霞结婚，1934年11月张越霞被捕后关系中断。
description.en: Kong Yuan married Zhang Yuexia in 1933. The relationship was interrupted after Zhang Yuexia was arrested in November 1934.

description.zh-cn: 孔原于1939年9月与许明在延安结婚，直至1966年许明去世。
description.en: Kong Yuan married Xu Ming in Yan'an in September 1939, until her death in 1966.

description.zh-cn: 孔丹是孔原与许明的次子。
description.en: Kong Dan is the second son of Kong Yuan and Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 孔丹是孔原与许明的次子。
description.en: Kong Dan is the second son of Kong Yuan and Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 孔栋是孔原与许明的三子。
description.en: Kong Dong is the third son of Kong Yuan and Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 孔栋是孔原与许明的三子。
description.en: Kong Dong is the third son of Kong Yuan and Xu Ming.

description.zh-cn: 1935年5月，孔原派朱理治前往陕北指导工作，并为其撰写了详细的指示信。
description.en: In May 1935, Kong Yuan dispatched Zhu Lizhi to Northern Shaanxi to guide the work and wrote detailed instructions for him.

description.zh-cn: 孔原在苏联期间，因与王明发生分歧而被审查，1937年被给予严重警告、开除学籍的处分。
description.en: During his time in the Soviet Union, Kong Yuan was investigated due to disagreements with Wang Ming and was given a severe warning and expelled from school in 1937.

description.zh-cn: 在延安整风运动期间，孔原被指为叛徒、特务，后被周恩来和叶剑英保下。
description.en: During the Yan'an Rectification Movement, Kong Yuan was accused of being a traitor and spy, but was later protected by Zhou Enlai and Ye Jianying.

description.zh-cn: 在延安整风运动期间，孔原被指为叛徒、特务，后被周恩来和叶剑英保下。
description.en: During the Yan'an Rectification Movement, Kong Yuan was accused of being a traitor and spy, but was later protected by Zhou Enlai and Ye Jianying.

description.zh-cn: 1966年文化大革命爆发后，孔原被江青点名批评并被隔离审查，罪名是“叛徒、特务头子、里通外国”。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution in 1966, Kong Yuan was publicly criticized by Jiang Qing and placed under isolated investigation on charges of being a 'traitor, spy chief, and colluding with foreign countries'.

description.zh-cn: 1966年文化大革命期间，许明与丈夫孔原一同被江青点名批评，随后于12月21日服用安眠药自杀。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution in 1966, Xu Ming and her husband Kong Yuan were publicly criticized by Jiang Qing. She subsequently committed suicide by taking sleeping pills on December 21.

description.zh-cn: 1966年12月18日，江青在大会上点名批评孔原和其妻许明是红卫兵组织“西纠”的“黑后台”，导致孔原被审查。
description.en: On December 18, 1966, Jiang Qing publicly criticized Kong Yuan and his wife Xu Ming at a rally as the 'black backstage supporters' of the Red Guard organization 'Xijiu', leading to Kong Yuan's investigation.

description.zh-cn: 孔原于1962年11月起任中共中央调查部部长。
description.en: Kong Yuan served as the Minister of the Central Investigation Department of the CPC starting from November 1962.

description.zh-cn: 湖南大学的办学起源于岳麓书院，继承了其院产和办学传统。岳麓书院于1903年改制并与湖南高等学堂合并，成为湖南大学的直接前身。
description.en: Hunan University originated from Yuelu Academy, inheriting its property and educational traditions. In 1903, Yuelu Academy was reorganized and merged with Hunan Higher School, becoming a direct predecessor of Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 1926年，湖南公立工业专门学校与湖南公立商业专门学校、湖南公立法政专门学校合并，正式成立省立湖南大学。
description.en: In 1926, Hunan Public Industrial Specialized School merged with Hunan Public Commercial Specialized School and Hunan Public Law and Politics Specialized School to officially establish Provincial Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 1926年，湖南公立商业专门学校与湖南公立工业专门学校、湖南公立法政专门学校合并，正式成立省立湖南大学。
description.en: In 1926, Hunan Public Commercial Specialized School merged with Hunan Public Industrial Specialized School and Hunan Public Law and Politics Specialized School to officially establish Provincial Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 1926年，湖南公立法政专门学校与湖南公立工业专门学校、湖南公立商业专门学校合并，正式成立省立湖南大学。
description.en: In 1926, Hunan Public Law and Politics Specialized School merged with Hunan Public Industrial Specialized School and Hunan Public Commercial Specialized School to officially establish Provincial Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 湖南大学是中华人民共和国教育部直属大学。
description.en: Hunan University is a university directly affiliated with the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 公元976年，时任潭州太守的朱洞正式建立岳麓书院。
description.en: In 976 AD, Zhu Dong, then the prefect of Tanzhou, officially established Yuelu Academy.

description.zh-cn: 杨昌济于1917年向湖南省政府呈文，倡议筹办湖南大学。
description.en: In 1917, Yang Changji submitted a proposal to the Hunan provincial government, advocating for the establishment of Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 1953年院系调整时，湖南大学的土木系等师生被调入新成立的中南土木建筑学院，该学院在原湖南大学校址上建立。
description.en: During the 1953 reorganization, the faculty and students of Hunan University's Civil Engineering Department were transferred to the newly established Central South Institute of Civil Engineering and Architecture, which was founded on the original site of Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 在1952-1953年的院系调整中，原湖南大学的化工系、土木结构组、电机组等师生调往华南工学院（今华南理工大学）。
description.en: During the 1952-1953 reorganization, faculty and students from the former Hunan University's Chemical Engineering Department, Civil Structure Group, and Electrical Machinery Group were transferred to the South China Institute of Technology (now South China University of Technology).

description.zh-cn: 1938年，因日军逼近湖南，湖南大学被迫从长沙西迁至辰溪，校园也遭到日军飞机轰炸。
description.en: In 1938, due to the advancing Japanese army in Hunan, Hunan University was forced to relocate westward from Changsha to Chenxi, and its campus was bombed by Japanese aircraft.

description.zh-cn: 有学者认为，毛泽东曾寄居于岳麓书院，书院内悬挂的“实事求是”匾对其思想产生了影响。
description.en: Some scholars believe that Mao Zedong's stay at Yuelu Academy and the 'Seeking Truth from Facts' plaque displayed there influenced his ideology.

description.zh-cn: 新中国成立后，中共一大代表、教育家李达就任湖南大学校长。
description.en: After the founding of the PRC, Li Da, a delegate to the First National Congress of the CPC and an educator, became the president of Hunan University.

description.zh-cn: 三度出任湖南大学校长。
description.en: Served as the president of Hunan University three times.

description.zh-cn: 为湖南大学校歌作词。
description.en: Wrote the lyrics for the Hunan University anthem.

description.zh-cn: 为湖南大学校歌谱曲。
description.en: Composed the music for the Hunan University anthem.

position.en: Lecturer in the Civil Engineering Department

description.zh-cn: 曾任湖南大学土木系讲师，并为学校设计建筑。
description.en: Served as a lecturer in the Civil Engineering Department at Hunan University and designed buildings for the campus.

description.zh-cn: 赵匡胤是昭宪太后的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Kuangyin was the son of Empress Dowager Du.

description.zh-cn: 赵光义是昭宪太后的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Guangyi was the son of Empress Dowager Du.

description.zh-cn: 赵廷美是昭宪太后的儿子。
description.en: Zhao Tingmei was the son of Empress Dowager Du.

description.zh-cn: 赵光义与赵廷美是兄弟关系。
description.en: Zhao Guangyi and Zhao Tingmei were brothers.

description.zh-cn: 赵德昭是宋太祖赵匡胤的长子。
description.en: Zhao Dezhao was the eldest son of Emperor Taizu, Zhao Kuangyin.

description.zh-cn: 赵德芳是宋太祖赵匡胤的次子。
description.en: Zhao Defang was the second son of Emperor Taizu, Zhao Kuangyin.

description.zh-cn: 昭宪太后认为后周因皇帝年幼而亡国，这一看法促使她提出皇位应由年长君主继承的主张。
description.en: Empress Dowager Du believed that the Later Zhou dynasty fell because its emperor was too young, which prompted her to advocate for the throne to be inherited by an adult ruler.

description.zh-cn: “烛影斧声”这一历史疑案使士大夫普遍怀疑宋太宗赵光义即位的正当性。
description.en: The historical mystery of the 'Shadow of the Candle and the Sound of the Axe' made scholar-officials widely doubt the legitimacy of Emperor Taizong's (Zhao Guangyi) ascension to the throne.

description.zh-cn: 根据王立群的观点，卢多逊曾迫害赵普及其家人，是赵普的政敌。
description.en: According to Wang Liqun's view, Lu Duoxun persecuted Zhao Pu and his family, and was his political enemy.

description.zh-cn: 总统陈水扁涉及的国务机要费案是引发百万人民反贪倒扁运动的主要原因。
description.en: The state affairs fund case involving President Chen Shui-bian was the main reason for triggering the Million People Against Corruption, President Chen Must Go movement.

description.zh-cn: 2005年爆发的高雄捷运外劳弊案是导致反贪倒扁运动发生的背景事件之一。
description.en: The Kaohsiung MRT foreign labor scandal that broke out in 2005 was one of the background events that led to the anti-corruption movement.

description.zh-cn: 陈水扁女婿赵建铭涉及的内线交易案是引发反贪倒扁运动的弊案之一。
description.en: The insider trading case involving Chen Shui-bian's son-in-law, Chao Chien-ming, was one of the scandals that triggered the anti-corruption movement.

description.zh-cn: 总统罢免案在立法院未能通过，促使施明德发起体制外的街头运动。
description.en: The failure of the presidential recall motion in the Legislative Yuan prompted Shih Ming-teh to launch an extra-institutional street movement.

description.zh-cn: 吴淑珍是陈水扁的妻子。
description.en: Wu Shu-chen is the wife of Chen Shui-bian.

description.zh-cn: 赵建铭是陈水扁的女婿。
description.en: Chao Chien-ming is Chen Shui-bian's son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 丁守中是2006年总统罢免案的提案人之一。
description.en: Ting Shou-chung was one of the proposers of the 2006 presidential recall motion.

description.zh-cn: 吕学樟是2006年总统罢免案的提案人之一。
description.en: Lu Hsueh-chang was one of the proposers of the 2006 presidential recall motion.

description.zh-cn: 民进党党团限制党籍立委不进场投票，导致罢免案因未达门槛而失败。
description.en: The DPP caucus restricted its legislators from entering the chamber to vote, causing the recall motion to fail due to not meeting the threshold.

description.zh-cn: 台联动员集体投废票，导致罢免案因未达门槛而失败。
description.en: The TSU mobilized its members to cast invalid ballots, causing the recall motion to fail due to not meeting the threshold.

description.zh-cn: 王世坚爆料质疑施明德发动倒扁的正当性。
description.en: Wang Shih-chien made allegations questioning the legitimacy of Shih Ming-teh's anti-Chen campaign.

description.zh-cn: 林国庆爆料质疑施明德发动倒扁的正当性。
description.en: Lin Kuo-ching made allegations questioning the legitimacy of Shih Ming-teh's anti-Chen campaign.

description.zh-cn: 时任台北市长的马英九数度前往静坐现场赠送早餐以表达支持。
description.en: Then-Taipei Mayor Ma Ying-jeou visited the protest site several times to deliver breakfast and express his support.

description.zh-cn: 时任国民党台北市长参选人郝龙斌数度前往静坐现场表达支持。
description.en: Then-KMT Taipei mayoral candidate Hau Lung-pin visited the protest site several times to express his support.

description.zh-cn: 民进党立委指出马英九的市长特别费问题，被视为对倒扁运动的反制。
description.en: DPP legislators pointed out issues with Ma Ying-jeou's mayoral special allowance, which was seen as a countermeasure to the anti-Chen movement.

description.zh-cn: 检察官侯宽仁就特别费案传讯了马英九。
description.en: Prosecutor Hou Kuan-jen summoned Ma Ying-jeou for questioning in the special allowance case.

description.zh-cn: 台北地检署因“天下围攻”事件将施明德等16人依违反集会游行法提起公诉。
description.en: The Taipei District Prosecutors Office indicted Shih Ming-teh and 15 others for violating the Assembly and Parade Act in relation to the 'Besiege from All Sides' event.

description.zh-cn: 时任美国在台协会处长杨苏棣对倒扁运动部分行为提出批判。
description.en: Then-Director of the American Institute in Taiwan, Stephen M. Young, criticized certain actions of the anti-Chen movement.

description.zh-cn: 苏贞昌在陈水扁担任总统期间任行政院长。
description.en: Su Tseng-chang served as the Premier during Chen Shui-bian's presidency.

description.zh-cn: Alphabet于2019年11月宣布以21亿美元收购可穿戴设备公司Fitbit。
description.en: In November 2019, Alphabet announced the acquisition of wearable device company Fitbit for $2.1 billion.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府的网络审查制度是导致谷歌退出中国事件的主要原因。
description.en: The internet censorship policies of the People's Republic of China were the primary cause of Google's withdrawal from China.

description.zh-cn: 该事件的最终结果是Google停止在中国大陆的搜索服务，将google.cn重定向至google.com.hk。
description.en: The ultimate result of this event was Google ceasing its search services in mainland China and redirecting google.cn to google.com.hk.

description.zh-cn: Google与三星合作开发并发布了Android XR操作系统。
description.en: Google co-developed and released the Android XR operating system with Samsung.

description.zh-cn: 三星与Google合作开发并发布了Android XR操作系统。
description.en: Samsung co-developed and released the Android XR operating system with Google.

description.zh-cn: 崔永元是崔汝贤的儿子。
description.en: Cui Yongyuan is the son of Cui Ruxian.

description.zh-cn: 崔永元于1981年考入北京广播学院（现中国传媒大学）新闻系，1985年毕业。
description.en: Cui Yongyuan was admitted to the Department of Journalism at Beijing Broadcasting Institute (now Communication University of China) in 1981 and graduated in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 崔永元于2013年12月从央视离职，转入中国传媒大学任教。
description.en: Cui Yongyuan resigned from CCTV in December 2013 and transferred to the Communication University of China to teach.

description.zh-cn: 1985年毕业后，崔永元进入中央人民广播电台工作，后担任记者。
description.en: After graduating in 1985, Cui Yongyuan joined the China National Radio, later working as a journalist.

position.zh-cn: 节目策划、主持人、制片人

description.zh-cn: 崔永元于1993年开始参与中央电视台《东方时空》的策划，后成为《实话实说》等节目的主持人和制片人，直至2013年离职。
description.en: Cui Yongyuan began participating in the planning of CCTV's "Oriental Horizon" in 1993, later becoming the host and producer of programs like "Tell It Like It Is" until his resignation in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 2015年，崔永元在东方卫视主持新闻解读节目《东方眼》，但该节目于同年3月暂停播出。
description.en: In 2015, Cui Yongyuan hosted the news analysis program "The Oriental Eye" on Dragon TV, but the program was suspended in March of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，在听过崔永元关于大兴安岭火灾的报道后，邓颖超委托秘书打电话表示感谢，并请其将稿子转载到《人民政协报》。
description.en: In 1988, after listening to Cui Yongyuan's report on the Great Khingan Fire, Deng Yingchao asked her secretary to call and express her gratitude, and requested that the article be reprinted in the "CPPCC Daily".

description.zh-cn: 崔永元自2013年起公开反对转基因食品的商业化，通过自费调查、演讲和创办公司等方式，成为该社会争议中的主要反对者之一。
description.en: Since 2013, Cui Yongyuan has publicly opposed the commercialization of genetically modified foods, becoming one of the main opponents in this social controversy through self-funded investigations, lectures, and founding a company.

description.zh-cn: 2017年3月，崔永元创立了专门售卖非转基因食品的公司“璞谷塘”。
description.en: In March 2017, Cui Yongyuan founded "Pugutang," a company specializing in selling non-genetically modified foods.

description.zh-cn: 崔永元曝光了涉及范冰冰的“阴阳合同”，直接导致其被国家税务总局调查并处以巨额罚款，演艺事业陷入停滞。
description.en: Cui Yongyuan exposed the "yin-yang contracts" involving Fan Bingbing, which directly led to her being investigated by the State Taxation Administration, fined heavily, and her acting career stagnated.

description.zh-cn: 崔永元对“陕西千亿矿权案”卷宗丢失的爆料引发巨大舆论，促使最高人民法院发布情况通报并启动调查程序。
description.en: Cui Yongyuan's revelation about the missing files in the "Shaanxi hundred-billion-yuan mining rights case" caused a huge public outcry, prompting the Supreme People's Court to issue a statement and launch an investigation.

description.zh-cn: 作为“陕西千亿矿权案”的承办法官，王林清向崔永元提供了该案的卷宗材料，促使崔永元向公众爆料此事。
description.en: As the presiding judge of the "Shaanxi hundred-billion-yuan mining rights case," Wang Linqing provided the case files to Cui Yongyuan, which prompted Cui to expose the matter to the public.

description.zh-cn: 官方联合调查组公布调查结果，认定卷宗丢失系王林清故意所为。此后崔永元在社交媒体上消失了一段时间，并于2019年5月10日发布手写道歉信，承认自己“轻信未经仔细证实的资料”。
description.en: The official joint investigation team announced its findings, concluding that the missing files were intentionally taken by Wang Linqing. Afterward, Cui Yongyuan disappeared from social media for a period and issued a handwritten apology on May 10, 2019, admitting to have "readily believed in unverified materials."

description.zh-cn: 始于1937年的中日战争是太平洋战争的前奏和重要组成部分。
description.en: The Sino-Japanese War, which began in 1937, was a prelude to and an integral part of the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 太平洋战争中盟军的胜利最终导致了日本的无条件投降。
description.en: The Allied victory in the Pacific War ultimately led to the unconditional surrender of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本签署投降书，标志着第二次世界大战的结束。
description.en: Japan's signing of the instrument of surrender marked the end of World War II.

description.zh-cn: 日本的投降导致了其殖民帝国的灭亡。
description.en: The surrender of Japan led to the demise of its colonial empire.

description.zh-cn: 太平洋战争重创了欧洲在亚洲的殖民势力，加速了亚洲的非殖民化进程。
description.en: The Pacific War dealt a heavy blow to European colonial powers in Asia, accelerating the process of decolonization in the region.

description.zh-cn: 苏联对日宣战并入侵满洲，是促使日本决定投降的一个重要因素。
description.en: The Soviet declaration of war and invasion of Manchuria was a significant factor in Japan's decision to surrender.

position.en: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

description.zh-cn: 温斯顿·邱吉尔在太平洋战争期间担任英国首相。
description.en: Winston Churchill served as the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom during the Pacific War.

description.zh-cn: 原子弹的使用被认为是避免实施伤亡惨重的日本本土入侵计划“没落行动”的一种手段。
description.en: The use of atomic bombs is considered a means to avoid implementing Operation Downfall, the costly planned invasion of the Japanese home islands.

description.zh-cn: 作为盟军最高司令，道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟在密苏里号战列舰上接受了日本的正式投降。
description.en: As Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, Douglas MacArthur accepted the formal surrender of Japan aboard the USS Missouri.

description.zh-cn: 大桥武夫是滨口雄幸的女婿。
description.en: Ōhashi Takeo was the son-in-law of Hamaguchi Osachi.

description.zh-cn: 滨口雄幸于1915年加入立宪同志会。
description.en: Hamaguchi Osachi joined the Rikken Dōshikai in 1915.

description.zh-cn: 滨口雄幸在若槻礼次郎内阁中先后担任大藏大臣和内务大臣。
description.en: Hamaguchi Osachi served successively as Minister of Finance and Home Minister in the cabinet of Wakatsuki Reijirō.

description.zh-cn: 滨口雄幸在加藤高明内阁中担任大藏大臣。
description.en: Hamaguchi Osachi served as Minister of Finance in the cabinet of Katō Takaaki.

description.zh-cn: 滨口雄幸接替因张作霖暗杀事件而下台的田中义一出任首相。
description.en: Hamaguchi Osachi succeeded Tanaka Giichi as Prime Minister after Tanaka's cabinet resigned over the assassination of Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 滨口雄幸内阁不顾右翼势力与军方的反对，强行推动恢复金本位政策。
description.en: The Hamaguchi cabinet pushed through the policy of returning to the gold standard, despite opposition from right-wing groups and the military.

description.zh-cn: 滨口雄幸内阁签署了旨在限制海军军备的《伦敦海军条约》。
description.en: The Hamaguchi cabinet signed the London Naval Treaty, which aimed to limit naval armaments.

description.zh-cn: 日本右翼团体因不满滨口雄幸的经济及裁军政策，而对其产生敌意。
description.en: Japanese right-wing groups became hostile towards Hamaguchi Osachi due to dissatisfaction with his economic and disarmament policies.

description.zh-cn: 在滨口雄幸遇刺受伤后，在野党政友会成员鸠山一郎等人要求其拖着病身前往众议院接受质询，此举加重了滨口雄幸的身体负担。
description.en: After Hamaguchi Osachi was wounded, Hatoyama Ichirō, a member of the opposition party Seiyūkai, demanded that he attend the House of Representatives for questioning despite his injuries, which worsened his physical condition.

description.zh-cn: 雾社事件发生于滨口雄幸首相任内，事件引发国际与日本国会强烈谴责，导致其多名阁员引咎辞职，对滨口内阁造成了严重冲击。
description.en: The Musha Incident occurred during Hamaguchi Osachi's premiership. The event drew strong condemnation from the international community and the Japanese Diet, leading to the resignation of several cabinet members and severely impacting the Hamaguchi cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 陆军省与台湾总督府联合派兵使用生化武器镇压台湾原住民，引发雾社事件。
description.en: The Ministry of the Army, in conjunction with the Governor-General of Taiwan, dispatched troops and used chemical weapons to suppress the indigenous people of Taiwan, triggering the Musha Incident.

description.zh-cn: 台湾总督府与陆军省联合派兵使用生化武器镇压台湾原住民，引发雾社事件。
description.en: The Governor-General of Taiwan, in conjunction with the Ministry of the Army, dispatched troops and used chemical weapons to suppress the indigenous people of Taiwan, triggering the Musha Incident.

description.zh-cn: 刘昭仪是罗文嘉的妻子。
description.en: Liu Zhao-yi is the wife of Luo Wen-jia.

description.zh-cn: 罗文嘉出生于桃园县新屋乡（今桃园市新屋区）。
description.en: Luo Wen-jia was born in Xinyu Township, Taoyuan County (now Xinwu District, Taoyuan City).

position.zh-cn: 国会助理、国会办公室主任、台北市政府新闻处处长
position.en: Parliamentary Assistant, Director of Congressional Office, Director of Taipei City Government's Department of Information

description.zh-cn: 罗文嘉在陈水扁担任立法委员及台北市市长期间，长期担任其核心幕僚与助理，被称为其“文胆”。
description.en: During Chen Shui-bian's tenure as a legislator and Mayor of Taipei, Luo Wen-jia served as his core aide and assistant for a long time, known as his 'literary confidant'.

position.en: Secretary-General of the Democratic Progressive Party

description.zh-cn: 罗文嘉在卓荣泰担任党主席期间，出任党秘书长。
description.en: Luo Wen-jia served as the party's Secretary-General during Cho Jung-tai's chairmanship.

description.zh-cn: 因该事件，时任台北市政府新闻处长的罗文嘉引咎辞职。
description.en: Due to this incident, Luo Wen-jia, then Director of the Taipei City Government's Department of Information, resigned to take responsibility.

description.zh-cn: 在2005年台北县县长选举中，国民党籍的周锡玮击败了民进党籍的罗文嘉。
description.en: In the 2005 Taipei County magistrate election, Chou Hsi-wei of the Kuomintang defeated Luo Wen-jia of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 罗文嘉公开批评陈水扁在国务机要费案中的抗辩策略“很糟糕”，引发挺扁人士的强烈抨击。
description.en: Luo Wen-jia publicly criticized Chen Shui-bian's defense strategy in the state affairs fund case as 'very terrible', drawing strong criticism from Chen's supporters.

description.zh-cn: 因罗文嘉批评陈水扁，高志鹏批评罗文嘉“全世界的人都可对阿扁划清界限，只有罗文嘉不行”。
description.en: Because Luo Wen-jia criticized Chen Shui-bian, Kao Chih-peng criticized Luo, stating, 'Anyone in the world can draw a line with A-Bian, except for Luo Wen-jia'.

description.zh-cn: 罗文嘉认为现阶段推动台湾正名修宪或制宪，恐加剧台湾社会分裂，引发陈水扁及独派不满。
description.en: Luo Wen-jia believed that promoting name rectification, constitutional amendment, or new constitution at the current stage could intensify social division in Taiwan, causing dissatisfaction from Chen Shui-bian and pro-independence groups.

description.zh-cn: 王定宇因不满罗文嘉主导的党中央人事任命是“小圈圈任命”，宣布辞去中常委以示抗议。
description.en: Dissatisfied with what he called 'coterie appointments' in the party's central leadership orchestrated by Luo Wen-jia, Wang Ting-yu announced his resignation from the Central Standing Committee in protest.

description.zh-cn: 洪山川指控罗文嘉强租天主教宜兰教区土地，双方发生公开争执。
description.en: Hung Shan-chuan accused Luo Wen-jia of forcibly leasing land from the Catholic Diocese of Yilan, leading to a public dispute between the two.

description.zh-cn: 因罗文嘉在立委补选中不支持民进党候选人，段宜康对此提出强烈抨击。
description.en: Duan Yi-kang strongly criticized Luo Wen-jia for not supporting the DPP candidate in a legislative by-election.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业农村部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门之一。
description.en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs is one of the constituent departments of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2023年国务院机构改革后，原单设的国家乡村振兴局职责划入农业农村部，在农业农村部加挂国家乡村振兴局牌子，成为其管理的国家局。
description.en: After the 2023 State Council institutional reform, the functions of the formerly separate National Rural Revitalization Administration were integrated into the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, which now also holds the nameplate of the National Rural Revitalization Administration, making it a national administration managed by the ministry.

description.zh-cn: 会议通过《国务院机构改革方案》，决定不再保留农业部。
description.en: The session passed the 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan', deciding to abolish the Ministry of Agriculture.

description.zh-cn: 时任国务院副总理胡春华为新组建的农业农村部正式揭牌成立。
description.en: Then-Vice Premier of the State Council Hu Chunhua officially unveiled the newly established Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 会议批准《国务院机构改革方案》，决定将国家乡村振兴局的职责划入农业农村部，不再保留单设的国家乡村振兴局。
description.en: The session approved the 'State Council Institutional Reform Plan', deciding to integrate the functions of the National Rural Revitalization Administration into the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and abolish it as a separate entity.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，中央人民政府农业部改名为中华人民共和国农业部。
description.en: In 1954, the Ministry of Agriculture of the Central People's Government was renamed the Ministry of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 决定将农业部、林业部和水产部合并，设立农林部。
description.en: Decided to merge the Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Forestry, and Ministry of Fisheries to establish the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

description.zh-cn: 决定撤销农林部，并分设农业部和林业部。
description.en: Decided to dissolve the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry and re-establish the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Forestry.

description.zh-cn: 在国务院机构改革中，将农业部、农垦部、国家水产总局合并设立农牧渔业部。
description.en: During the State Council institutional reform, the Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Land Reclamation, and State Administration of Aquatic Products were merged to establish the Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Fishery.

description.zh-cn: 根据国务院机构改革方案，撤销农牧渔业部，设立农业部。
description.en: According to the State Council institutional reform plan, the Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Husbandry and Fishery was dissolved, and the Ministry of Agriculture was established.

description.zh-cn: “一月风暴”开启了全国范围的夺权运动，各群众组织间的权力争斗迅速激化，并演变为大规模武斗。
description.en: The 'January Storm' initiated a nationwide power seizure movement, during which power struggles among mass organizations rapidly intensified and evolved into large-scale violent struggles.

description.zh-cn: 柬埔寨的红色高棉革命在思想和实践上受到了中国文化大革命的显著影响。
description.en: The Khmer Rouge revolution in Cambodia was significantly influenced by the Chinese Cultural Revolution in both ideology and practice.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议广西壮族自治区委员会是中国人民政治协商会议全国委员会的地方组织。
description.en: The CPPCC Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee is a local organization of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民政治协商会议广西壮族自治区委员会接受中国共产党广西壮族自治区委员会的领导。
description.en: The CPPCC Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee is under the leadership of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙于1934年10月15日出生于北平市。
description.en: Wang Meng was born in Beiping on October 15, 1934.

description.zh-cn: 作为王蒙父亲的朋友，何其芳根据法国小说《茶花女》中的主人公阿芒为王蒙建议了名字。
description.en: As a friend of Wang Meng's father, He Qifang suggested the name 'Meng' for Wang Meng, inspired by the protagonist Armand from the French novel 'La Dame aux Camélias'.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙曾就读于北京四中。
description.en: Wang Meng attended Beijing No. 4 High School.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙在中学时期接触了共产主义思想。
description.en: Wang Meng was exposed to communist ideas during his middle school years.

description.zh-cn: 1948年，王蒙在中学时期加入中国共产党。
description.en: In 1948, Wang Meng joined the Chinese Communist Party while in middle school.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙在1949年前曾组织反对国民党政府的学生运动。
description.en: Before 1949, Wang Meng organized student movements against the Kuomintang government.

description.zh-cn: 1957年，因小说《组织部新来的青年人》引起轰动，王蒙在反右运动中被划为“右派”。
description.en: In 1957, due to the sensation caused by his novel 'The Young Newcomer in the Organization Department', Wang Meng was classified as a 'rightist' during the Anti-Rightist Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙于1986年至1989年期间担任中华人民共和国文化部部长。
description.en: Wang Meng served as the Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China from 1986 to 1989.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙接替朱穆之担任中华人民共和国文化部部长。
description.en: Wang Meng succeeded Zhu Muzhi as the Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 贺敬之接替王蒙担任中华人民共和国文化部（代理）部长。
description.en: He Jingzhi succeeded Wang Meng as the (acting) Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，时任文化部长的王蒙“因病请假”，成为唯一没有参与慰问戒严官兵的部长，此举一度让外界担忧其仕途。
description.en: After the June 4th Incident, Wang Meng, then Minister of Culture, took 'sick leave' and became the only minister who did not participate in consoling the martial law troops, a move that once caused external concern for his political career.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，王蒙被任命为全国政协文史和学习委员会主任。
description.en: In 2005, Wang Meng was appointed Director of the Committee for Learning and Cultural and Historical Data of the CPPCC National Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2007年，王蒙推荐作家郭敬明加入中国作家协会，此事引发了争议。
description.en: In 2007, Wang Meng recommended writer Guo Jingming to join the China Writers Association, which sparked controversy.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙潜心研究《红楼梦》，并撰写了多部关于该小说的点评与分析作品。
description.en: Wang Meng devoted himself to the study of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' and wrote several works of commentary and analysis on the novel.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙曾与作家金庸就《红楼梦》进行对谈。
description.en: Wang Meng once had a dialogue with writer Jin Yong about 'Dream of the Red Chamber'.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙曾与日本作家池田大作就《红楼梦》等话题进行对谈。
description.en: Wang Meng once had a dialogue with Japanese writer Daisaku Ikeda on topics including 'Dream of the Red Chamber'.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙对唐代诗人李商隐有深入研究，并著有专门分析其诗词的作品。
description.en: Wang Meng has conducted in-depth research on the Tang dynasty poet Li Shangyin and has written works specifically analyzing his poetry.

description.zh-cn: 2015年，王蒙的长篇小说《这边风景》获得第九届茅盾文学奖。
description.en: In 2015, Wang Meng's novel 'The Scenery Here' won the 9th Mao Dun Literature Prize.

description.zh-cn: 2019年9月16日，王蒙被授予“人民艺术家”国家荣誉称号。
description.en: On September 16, 2019, Wang Meng was awarded the national honorary title of 'People's Artist'.

position.en: Dean of the College of Liberal Arts

description.zh-cn: 王蒙担任中国海洋大学文学院院长。
description.en: Wang Meng serves as the Dean of the College of Liberal Arts at the Ocean University of China.

description.zh-cn: 王蒙曾任中国作家协会副主席等职。
description.en: Wang Meng served as Vice Chairman of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 封从德出生于中国四川省。
description.en: Feng Congde was born in Sichuan Province, China.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件期间当选为北京高校学生自治联合会（北高联）主席。
description.en: During the Tiananmen Square protests, he was elected as the chairman of the Beijing Students' Autonomous Federation.

description.zh-cn: 在六四事件期间担任保卫天安门广场总指挥部副总指挥。
description.en: He served as the deputy commander-in-chief of the Headquarters for Defending Tiananmen Square during the Tiananmen Square protests.

description.zh-cn: 1997年，封从德在莱顿大学研究儒家学说。
description.en: In 1997, Feng Congde researched Confucianism at Leiden University.

description.zh-cn: 2011年，封从德创办了网络“孙文学校”。
description.en: In 2011, Feng Congde founded the online 'Sun Yat-sen School'.

position.zh-cn: 复校筹备组成员、主持者

description.zh-cn: 2013年，封从德成为天安门民主大学复校筹备组成员之一，并主持该项目。
description.en: In 2013, Feng Congde became a member of the preparatory group for the re-establishment of the Tiananmen University of Democracy and presides over the project.

description.zh-cn: 2019年6月2日，封从德准备由日本赴香港出席六四事件三十周年悼念晚会时，被香港特别行政区政府拒绝入境。
description.en: On June 2, 2019, when Feng Congde was preparing to travel from Japan to Hong Kong to attend the 30th anniversary memorial of the Tiananmen Square protests, he was denied entry by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government.

description.zh-cn: 1989年5月，封从德获得波士顿大学提供的五年博士学位奖学金。
description.en: In May 1989, Feng Congde was awarded a five-year Ph.D. scholarship by Boston University.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚自年少便与曹丕往来友好，才智为其所赏识，深受其信赖。
description.en: Since his youth, Xiahou Shang had a friendly relationship with Cao Pi, whose intelligence was appreciated by the latter, and he was deeply trusted.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚曾任曹丕的五官将文学，成为其麾下部属。曹丕称帝后，夏侯尚被委以重任，先后担任征南将军、征南大将军、荆州牧等职。
description.en: Xiahou Shang served as Cao Pi's 'Wuguanjiang Wenxue', becoming his subordinate. After Cao Pi became emperor, Xiahou Shang was entrusted with important responsibilities, successively holding positions such as General Who Attacks the South, Grand General Who Attacks the South, and Governor of Jing Province.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚是夏侯渊的侄子。
description.en: Xiahou Shang was the nephew of Xiahou Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 在曹操平定冀州时，夏侯尚以军司马之职随军四处征战。
description.en: When Cao Cao conquered Ji Province, Xiahou Shang served as a Military Sima and campaigned with the army.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚曾以参军身份跟随曹彰出兵平定代郡乌桓的叛乱并建功。
description.en: Xiahou Shang once served as an Army Advisor, following Cao Zhang on a campaign to suppress the Wuhuan rebellion in Dai Commandery and achieving merit.

description.zh-cn: 作为曹魏将领，夏侯尚负责荆北防线，与蜀汉对峙，并攻取其领地上庸。
description.en: As a general of Cao Wei, Xiahou Shang was responsible for the northern Jing Province defense line, confronting Shu Han and capturing its territory of Shangyong.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚与降将孟达共同领兵击败刘封，攻克蜀汉的上庸。
description.en: Xiahou Shang and the defected general Meng Da jointly led troops to defeat Liu Feng and conquer Shangyong from Shu Han.

description.zh-cn: 与孟达联手击败时任蜀汉上庸太守的刘封，攻克上庸。
description.en: In alliance with Meng Da, he defeated Liu Feng, then the Shu Han administrator of Shangyong, and conquered the commandery.

description.zh-cn: 作为曹魏荆州都督，夏侯尚负责防备并与孙吴军队交战。
description.en: As the Cao Wei commander of Jing Province, Xiahou Shang was responsible for defending against and engaging with the forces of Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚与曹真奉曹丕之命，率军共同围攻东吴的江陵。
description.en: Under Cao Pi's orders, Xiahou Shang and Cao Zhen led an army to jointly besiege Jiangling, which was controlled by Eastern Wu.

description.zh-cn: 在江陵之战中，夏侯尚于夜间使用火攻策略，成功大败东吴将领诸葛瑾的军队。
description.en: During the Battle of Jiangling, Xiahou Shang used a night fire attack strategy to successfully defeat the army of the Eastern Wu general Zhuge Jin.

description.zh-cn: 蒋济认为曹丕对夏侯尚恩宠过度，赐予‘作威作福，杀人活人’之权不妥，并成功劝止了曹丕。
description.en: Jiang Ji believed that Cao Pi's favor towards Xiahou Shang was excessive, and that granting him the power 'to act with arbitrary authority, to kill or to grant life' was inappropriate, and successfully persuaded Cao Pi to rescind it.

description.zh-cn: 杜袭早年即鄙视夏侯尚，称其‘非有益之友’。后来曹丕在夏侯尚为亡妾失态后也认为杜袭的看法有道理。
description.en: Du Xi looked down on Xiahou Shang from early on, calling him 'not a beneficial friend'. Later, after Xiahou Shang's inappropriate behavior over his deceased concubine, Cao Pi came to believe that Du Xi's view had merit.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯儒是夏侯尚的堂弟。
description.en: Xiahou Ru was the younger male cousin of Xiahou Shang.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯玄是夏侯尚的儿子。
description.en: Xiahou Xuan was the son of Xiahou Shang.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯玄是德阳乡主的儿子。
description.en: Xiahou Xuan was the son of Princess Deyang.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯徽是夏侯尚的女儿。
description.en: Xiahou Hui was the daughter of Xiahou Shang.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯徽是夏侯玄的姐妹。
description.en: Xiahou Hui was the sister of Xiahou Xuan.

description.zh-cn: 夏侯尚的一个女儿嫁给了和逌，二人为翁婿关系。
description.en: One of Xiahou Shang's daughters married He You, making them father-in-law and son-in-law.

description.zh-cn: 《党建文汇》由《共产党员》杂志社主办。
description.en: 'Dangjian Wenhui' is hosted by the 'Communist Party Member' magazine agency.

description.zh-cn: 《共产党员》杂志社是中共辽宁省委旗下的机构。
description.en: The 'Communist Party Member' magazine agency is an institution under the Liaoning Provincial Committee of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 《党建文汇》是一本宣传中国共产党“党的建设”理论的刊物。
description.en: 'Dangjian Wenhui' is a publication that promotes the 'party building' theory of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 《党建文汇》发表过研究毛泽东的文章，以推广其相关研究。
description.en: 'Dangjian Wenhui' has published articles studying Mao Zedong to promote related research.

description.zh-cn: 《党建文汇》发表过研究邓小平的文章，以推广其相关研究。
description.en: 'Dangjian Wenhui' has published articles studying Deng Xiaoping to promote related research.

description.zh-cn: 卢秀燕是中国国民党籍政治人物。
description.en: Lu Shiow-yen is a politician affiliated with the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 胡志强是中国国民党籍政治人物。
description.en: Jason Hu is a politician affiliated with the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 林佳龙是民主进步党籍政治人物。
description.en: Lin Chia-lung is a politician affiliated with the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: “台中”之称始于日治时期设立的台中县。
description.en: The name 'Taichung' originated from the Taichung Prefecture established during the Japanese rule period.

description.zh-cn: 台湾建省首任巡抚刘铭传，曾将台湾省城选在台中市建设。
description.en: Liu Ming-chuan, the first governor of Taiwan Province, chose to build the provincial capital in Taichung.

description.zh-cn: 中部科学园区的设立带动了台中市的产业由轻工业为主转向高科技产业发展。
description.en: The establishment of the Central Taiwan Science Park drove the industrial transformation of Taichung City from being dominated by light industry to high-tech industry.

description.zh-cn: 辜显荣为筹设创立台中一中的中部地区士绅之一。
description.en: Koo Hsien-jung was one of the central Taiwan gentry who helped establish Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 林烈堂为筹设创立台中一中的中部地区士绅之一。
description.en: Lin Lie-tang was one of the central Taiwan gentry who helped establish Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 林熊征为筹设创立台中一中的中部地区士绅之一。
description.en: Lin Hsiung-cheng was one of the central Taiwan gentry who helped establish Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 林献堂为筹设创立台中一中的中部地区士绅之一。
description.en: Lin Hsien-tang was one of the central Taiwan gentry who helped establish Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 蔡莲舫为筹设创立台中一中的中部地区士绅之一。
description.en: Tsai Lien-fang was one of the central Taiwan gentry who helped establish Taichung First Senior High School.

description.zh-cn: 因台中自2006年接连举办多次国际性棒球赛事，国际棒球总会于2013年颁发世界首座「世界棒球之都」荣誉予台中市。
description.en: Due to Taichung hosting multiple international baseball tournaments since 2006, the International Baseball Federation awarded the city the world's first 'World's Baseball Capital' honor in 2013.

description.zh-cn: 国际园艺家协会认证授权台中市举办2018年世界花卉博览会。
description.en: The International Association of Horticultural Producers accredited Taichung City to host the 2018 World Flora Exposition.

description.zh-cn: 国际展览局认证授权台中市举办2018年世界花卉博览会。
description.en: The Bureau International des Expositions accredited Taichung City to host the 2018 World Flora Exposition.

description.zh-cn: 东亚运动会总会于2018年7月经投票决定，取消原定由台中市主办的2019年东亚青年运动会。
description.en: In July 2018, the East Asian Games Association voted to cancel the 2019 East Asian Youth Games, which was originally to be hosted by Taichung City.

description.zh-cn: 精省政策虚级化了台湾省政府的职能。
description.en: The provincial streamlining policy effectively stripped the Taiwan Provincial Government of its administrative functions.

description.zh-cn: 为庆祝中国共产党建党九十周年而制作了电影《建党伟业》作为献礼影片。
description.en: Produced the film 'Beginning of the Great Revival' as a tribute to celebrate the 90th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 电影《建党伟业》是为庆祝中国共产党建党九十周年而制作。
description.en: The film 'Beginning of the Great Revival' was made to celebrate the 90th anniversary of the founding of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 担任电影《建党伟业》的导演。
description.en: Served as a director for the film 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 担任电影《建党伟业》的导演。
description.en: Served as a director for the film 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 担任电影《建党伟业》的领衔出品方。
description.en: Served as the leading producer for the film 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 执导《建党伟业》的海外部分。
description.en: Directed the overseas segments of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 执导《建党伟业》的五四时期部分。
description.en: Directed the May Fourth Movement segments of 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 担任《建党伟业》的顾问。
description.en: Served as a consultant for 'Beginning of the Great Revival'.

description.zh-cn: 电影《建党伟业》的叙事从辛亥革命开始，暗示其作为中国共产党建党的历史背景和原因之一。
description.en: The narrative of the film 'Beginning of the Great Revival' starts from the Xinhai Revolution, suggesting it as part of the historical background and a reason for the founding of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 公开认为《建党伟业》中关于陶毅是毛泽东恋人的内容失实。
description.en: Publicly stated that the portrayal of Tao Yi as Mao Zedong's lover in 'Beginning of the Great Revival' was factually incorrect.

description.zh-cn: 向北洋政府提出“二十一条”无理要求，以掠取中国利益。
description.en: Presented the unreasonable 'Twenty-One Demands' to the Beiyang government to seize Chinese interests.

description.zh-cn: 据“项城袁氏家族联谊会”称，北洋政府据理力争，没有签署“二十一条”。
description.en: According to the 'Xiangcheng Yuan Family Association', the Beiyang government resisted and did not sign the 'Twenty-One Demands'.

description.zh-cn: 汤唯在《建党伟业》中饰演陶毅的镜头被确认删除。
description.en: Tang Wei's scenes as Tao Yi in 'Beginning of the Great Revival' were confirmed to be deleted.

description.zh-cn: 蔡和森是毛泽东青年时代的学友和战友。
description.en: Cai Hesen was a schoolmate and comrade-in-arms of Mao Zedong in his youth.

description.zh-cn: 王会悟是李达的夫人。
description.en: Wang Huiwu was the wife of Li Da.

description.zh-cn: 李励庄是陈公博的夫人。
description.en: Li Lizhuang was the wife of Chen Gongbo.

description.zh-cn: 蔡畅是李富春的夫人。
description.en: Cai Chang was the wife of Li Fuchun.

description.zh-cn: 演员冯巩是冯国璋的曾孙。
description.en: Actor Feng Gong is the great-grandson of Feng Guozhang.

description.zh-cn: 协助蔡锷讨伐袁世凯。
description.en: Assisted Cai E in his campaign against Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 协助蔡锷讨伐袁世凯。
description.en: Assisted Cai E in his campaign against Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 陆小曼是徐志摩的第二任夫人。
description.en: Lu Xiaoman was the second wife of Xu Zhimo.

description.zh-cn: 是五四运动天安门集会和会后游行的主要组织者之一。
description.en: Was one of the main organizers of the Tiananmen Square rally and subsequent parade during the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 杨开智是杨开慧的哥哥。
description.en: Yang Kaizhi was the brother of Yang Kaihui.

description.zh-cn: 通过了《租借法案》，使其于1941年3月11日生效。
description.en: Passed the Lend-Lease Act, which became effective on March 11, 1941.

description.zh-cn: 作为总统积极推动并最终签署了《租借法案》，使其成为法律。
description.en: As president, he actively promoted and ultimately signed the Lend-Lease Act into law.

description.zh-cn: 在1940年12月的“炉边谈话”中提出“民主兵工厂”的概念，为《租借法案》提供了理论基础。
description.en: Promoted the concept of the "Arsenal of Democracy" in his December 1940 "fireside chat," providing the ideological foundation for the Lend-Lease Act.

description.zh-cn: 使得美国能够成为“民主兵工厂”，大规模向同盟国提供战争物资。
description.en: Enabled the United States to become the "Arsenal of Democracy," supplying vast quantities of war materials to the Allied nations.

description.zh-cn: 在《租借法案》通过后，任命小爱德华·斯特蒂纽斯成立并管理租借法案管理办公室。
description.en: After the passage of the Lend-Lease Act, he appointed Edward Stettinius Jr. to establish and head the office administering the program.

description.zh-cn: 作为《租借法案》的主要受益国，英国获得了大量战争物资援助。
description.en: As the main beneficiary of the Lend-Lease Act, the United Kingdom received a vast amount of war material aid.

description.zh-cn: 自1941年4月起，中华民国被纳入《租借法案》适用范围，获得了美国援助。
description.en: Beginning in April 1941, the Republic of China was included under the Lend-Lease Act and received aid from the United States.

description.zh-cn: 自1941年10月起，苏联通过《租借法案》从美国获得大量战争物资。
description.en: Beginning in October 1941, the Soviet Union received large quantities of war materials from the United States through the Lend-Lease Act.

description.zh-cn: 该法案的严格限制条款（如“现购自运”）阻碍了美国在二战初期向盟国提供援助。
description.en: The act's strict provisions (such as "cash and carry") hindered the United States from providing aid to Allied nations in the early stages of World War II.

description.zh-cn: 该条约的存在使日本无法对通过太平洋航线向苏联运输美国租借物资的苏联籍船只进行实质性盘查或拦截。
description.en: The existence of this pact prevented Japan from substantially inspecting or intercepting Soviet-flagged vessels transporting U.S. Lend-Lease materials to the Soviet Union via the Pacific Route.

description.zh-cn: 《乌克兰民主防卫租借法案》是1941年《租借法案》的更新版本，借鉴了其框架和理念。
description.en: The Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act is an updated version of the 1941 Lend-Lease Act, drawing on its framework and principles.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯对乌克兰的入侵是促使美国制定并通过《乌克兰民主防卫租借法案》的直接原因。
description.en: The Russian invasion of Ukraine was the direct cause for the United States to create and pass the Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act.

description.zh-cn: 蒋军成为南京工业大学的现任校长。
description.en: Jiang Juncheng is the current president of Nanjing Tech University.

description.zh-cn: 1952年，南京大学工学院参与组建南京工学院。
description.en: In 1952, the College of Engineering of Nanjing University participated in the formation of Nanjing Institute of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 国立中央大学后更名为国立南京大学，最终定名为南京大学。
description.en: National Central University was later renamed National Nanjing University and finally named Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 周佛海是中国共产党早期成员，1921年加入，1924年退党。
description.en: Zhou Fohai was an early member of the Chinese Communist Party, joining in 1921 and leaving the party in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 作为中共早期党员，周佛海接受陈独秀的领导和指派。
description.en: As an early CCP member, Zhou Fohai accepted the leadership and assignments of Chen Duxiu.

description.zh-cn: 周佛海与施存统在1920年代初共同在日本从事共产主义活动，并互相推荐对方出席中共一大。
description.en: In the early 1920s, Zhou Fohai and Shi Cuntong engaged in communist activities together in Japan and mutually recommended each other to attend the First National Congress of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 周佛海毕业于日本京都大学经济系。
description.en: Zhou Fohai graduated from the Department of Economics at Kyoto University in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 周佛海于1924年加入中国国民党，1940年因投靠汪精卫政权被开除党籍。
description.en: Zhou Fohai joined the Kuomintang in 1924 and was expelled in 1940 for defecting to the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 1924年，周佛海回国后担任中国国民党中央宣传部秘书。
description.en: In 1924, after returning to China, Zhou Fohai served as a secretary in the Central Propaganda Department of the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 在1927年蒋介石清党后，周佛海投靠蒋介石，并在其领导下的国民政府中担任多个职务，直至1938年投靠汪精卫。
description.en: After Chiang Kai-shek's party purge in 1927, Zhou Fohai switched his allegiance to Chiang and held several positions in the Nationalist Government under his leadership until defecting to Wang Jingwei in 1938.

position.zh-cn: 行政院副院长、财政部长、中央政治委员会秘书长、中央储备银行总裁、上海市长等
position.en: Vice Premier of the Executive Yuan, Minister of Finance, Secretary-General of the Central Political Committee, Governor of the Central Reserve Bank, Mayor of Shanghai, etc.

description.zh-cn: 周佛海在汪精卫政权中担任了多个核心职务。
description.en: Zhou Fohai held multiple core positions in the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 1943年，戴笠吸收周佛海进入军统，使其成为国民党政府在汪精卫政权中的卧底。
description.en: In 1943, Dai Li recruited Zhou Fohai into the Juntong, making him a spy for the Nationalist Government within the Wang Jingwei regime.

description.zh-cn: 1943年，周佛海被戴笠吸收，秘密成为军统的卧底。
description.en: In 1943, Zhou Fohai was recruited by Dai Li and secretly became an undercover agent for Juntong.

description.zh-cn: 1948年，蒋介石签署命令，将周佛海的死刑减为无期徒刑。
description.en: In 1948, Chiang Kai-shek signed an order commuting Zhou Fohai's death sentence to life imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 1921年，周佛海与杨淑慧私奔至日本结婚，是其第二位妻子。
description.en: In 1921, Zhou Fohai eloped with Yang Shuhui to Japan to get married; she was his second wife.

description.zh-cn: 王健林出生于四川省绵阳专区第二人民医院。
description.en: Wang Jianlin was born in the Second People's Hospital of Mianyang Special Region, Sichuan Province.

description.zh-cn: 王健林在一次演讲中发表了将万达与海尔进行对比的言论，称万达坚持诚信经营“比海尔家砸几个冰箱，不知伟大到哪里去了”，引发海尔官方微博的回应和网络热议。
description.en: In a speech, Wang Jianlin made a comment comparing Wanda with Haier, stating that Wanda's commitment to integrity was 'immeasurably greater than Haier smashing a few refrigerators,' which triggered a response from Haier's official Weibo account and a heated public discussion.

description.zh-cn: 烛影斧声疑案与宋太祖的突然死亡直接相关，标志着其统治的终结。
description.en: The 'Shadow of the candle and sound of the axe' incident is directly related to the sudden death of Emperor Taizu, marking the end of his reign.

description.zh-cn: 太平兴国三年（978年），宋太宗迫使吴越国纳土归降。
description.en: In 978, Emperor Taizong forced the Wuyue Kingdom to surrender its territory.

description.zh-cn: 在高粱河之战中，宋军大败，宋太宗中箭乘驴车逃走，收复燕云十六州的计划失败。
description.en: In the Battle of Gaoliang River, the Song army was defeated, and Emperor Taizong was wounded by an arrow and fled on a donkey cart, failing the plan to recover the Sixteen Prefectures.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗去世后，吕端挫败了宦官王继恩等企图另立新帝的图谋。
description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, Lü Duan thwarted the plot by the eunuch Wang Ji'en and others to enthrone a different emperor.

description.zh-cn: 宋太宗去世后，李皇后与宦官王继恩企图拥立太宗长子赵元佐为帝。
description.en: After Emperor Taizong's death, Empress Li and the eunuch Wang Ji'en attempted to enthrone Emperor Taizong's eldest son, Zhao Yuanzuo.

description.zh-cn: 唐才常是自立军起义的主要发起人和总指挥。
description.en: Tang Caichang was the main initiator and commander-in-chief of the Self-Support Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 八国联军入侵华北，导致清廷权力真空和统治危机，为自立军起义创造了时机。
description.en: The invasion of North China by the Eight-Nation Alliance created a power vacuum and a crisis of governance for the Qing court, providing an opportunity for the Self-Support Army Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 起义的目标是推翻慈禧的统治。
description.en: The uprising aimed to overthrow the rule of Empress Dowager Cixi.

description.zh-cn: 起义的目标是营救光绪皇帝，并建立君主立宪政府。
description.en: The uprising aimed to rescue the Guangxu Emperor and establish a constitutional monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 自立军起义的失败激发了维新党人同情革命，使许多人放弃改良幻想，是革命历史的转捩点之一。
description.en: The failure of the Self-Support Army Uprising inspired sympathy for the revolution among reformists, causing many to abandon illusions of gradual reform, making it a turning point in revolutionary history.

description.zh-cn: 唐才常是张之洞的门生，曾就读于张之洞创办的两湖书院。
description.en: Tang Caichang was a protégé (mensheng) of Zhang Zhidong and had studied at the Liang-Hu Academy founded by Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 唐才常是谭嗣同的生前挚友。
description.en: Tang Caichang was a close friend of Tan Sitong.

description.zh-cn: 东亚同文会支持唐才常秘密组织“正气会”（后改名自立会）。
description.en: The East Asian Common Culture Society supported Tang Caichang in secretly organizing the 'Zhengqi Hui' (later renamed the Self-Support Society).

description.zh-cn: 在上海愚园召开的中国议会决定以自立会为基础成立自立军，并发动起义。
description.en: The China Congress, held at Yu Garden in Shanghai, decided to establish the Self-Support Army based on the Self-Support Society and launch an uprising.

description.zh-cn: 容闳在上海中国议会上被投票选为议长。
description.en: Yung Wing was elected as the chairman at the China Congress in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 刘学询设局陷害宫崎滔天，向新加坡当局放出假消息，导致宫崎滔天被捕入狱。
description.en: Liu Xuexun framed Miyazaki Tōten by spreading false information to the Singapore authorities, leading to Miyazaki's arrest and imprisonment.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯将维新派捕杀慈禧的计划告知荣禄，导致戊戌政变发生，维新派失败。
description.en: Yuan Shikai revealed the reformists' plan to capture Cixi to Ronglu, leading to the Wuxu Coup and the failure of the reformists.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役是第二次国共内战期间的一场重要战役。
description.en: The Lunan Campaign was a major battle during the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁南战役中，中国人民解放军与国民革命军为敌对双方。
description.en: In the Lunan Campaign, the People's Liberation Army and the National Revolutionary Army were the opposing sides.

description.zh-cn: 宿北战役后，解放军为了进一步摆脱被动局面，筹划并发起了鲁南战役。
description.en: After the North Su Campaign, the People's Liberation Army planned and launched the Lunan Campaign to further break away from a passive situation.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕筹划并发起了鲁南战役。
description.en: Su Yu planned and launched the Lunan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 马励武在鲁南战役中被俘。
description.en: Ma Liwu was captured during the Lunan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役后，陈毅与华中军区司令员张鼎丞等在缴获的坦克前合影。
description.en: After the Lunan Campaign, Chen Yi took a photo with Zhang Dingcheng, commander of the Central China Military Region, and others in front of a captured tank.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役后，陈毅与山东军区副司令员张云逸等在缴获的坦克前合影。
description.en: After the Lunan Campaign, Chen Yi took a photo with Zhang Yunyi, deputy commander of the Shandong Military Region, and others in front of a captured tank.

description.zh-cn: 在鲁南战役期间，张鼎丞担任华中军区司令员。
description.en: During the Lunan Campaign, Zhang Dingcheng served as the commander of the Central China Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役的胜利为后续的莱芜战役等打下了基础。
description.en: The victory in the Lunan Campaign laid the foundation for subsequent campaigns such as the Laiwu Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役的胜利为后续的孟良崮战役等打下了基础。
description.en: The victory in the Lunan Campaign laid the foundation for subsequent campaigns such as the Menglianggu Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役的胜利为后续的豫东战役等打下了基础。
description.en: The victory in the Lunan Campaign laid the foundation for subsequent campaigns such as the East Henan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役的胜利为后续的济南战役等打下了基础。
description.en: The victory in the Lunan Campaign laid the foundation for subsequent campaigns such as the Jinan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 鲁南战役的胜利为后续的淮海战役等打下了基础。
description.en: The victory in the Lunan Campaign laid the foundation for subsequent campaigns such as the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 明武宗驾崩且无子嗣，导致其堂弟朱厚熜（明世宗）作为旁支宗室得以入继大统。
description.en: The death of Emperor Wuzong without an heir led to his cousin Zhu Houcong (Emperor Shizong) succeeding to the throne as a member of a collateral branch of the imperial family.

description.zh-cn: 在“大礼议”事件中，明世宗因追尊生父问题与杨廷和等朝臣爆发严重冲突，最终迫使杨廷和退休。
description.en: During the 'Great Rites Controversy', Emperor Shizong had a severe conflict with Yang Tinghe and other court officials over the posthumous honoring of his biological father, eventually forcing Yang Tinghe to retire.

description.zh-cn: 因在大礼议中反对皇帝，杨慎等人被处以廷杖并被流放。
description.en: For opposing the emperor during the Great Rites Controversy, Yang Shen and others were caned at court and exiled.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗笃信道教，为追求长生不老之术，每年不断修设斋醮，迷信方士，造成巨大靡费。
description.en: Emperor Shizong was a devout follower of Taoism. In his pursuit of immortality, he continuously held religious ceremonies and trusted alchemists, resulting in enormous state expenditure.

description.zh-cn: 壬寅宫变发生后，曹端妃被处决。
description.en: After the Renyin Palace Incident, Consort Cao Duan was executed.

description.zh-cn: 严嵩专权期间，残害忠良，杨继盛等朝臣惨遭杀害。
description.en: During his time in power, Yan Song persecuted loyal officials, and court officials like Yang Jisheng were brutally murdered.

description.zh-cn: 严嵩专权期间，残害忠良，沈炼等朝臣惨遭杀害。
description.en: During his time in power, Yan Song persecuted loyal officials, and court officials like Shen Lian were brutally murdered.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗即位后，革除先朝蠹政，将前朝奸臣钱宁处以寸斩。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Shizong eliminated the corrupt practices of the previous reign and executed the treacherous official Qian Ning by slow slicing.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗即位后，革除先朝蠹政，将前朝奸臣江彬处死。
description.en: After ascending the throne, Emperor Shizong eliminated the corrupt practices of the previous reign and executed the treacherous official Jiang Bin.

description.zh-cn: 明世宗是明孝宗的侄子。
description.en: Emperor Shizong was the nephew of Emperor Xiaozong.

description.zh-cn: 嘉靖九年，明世宗将孔子的尊号由“大成至圣文宣王”改为“至圣先师”。
description.en: In the 9th year of the Jiajing era (1530), Emperor Shizong changed the honorific title of Confucius from 'Greatly Accomplished, Ultimate Sage, King of Culture' to 'Ultimate Sage, First Teacher'.

description.zh-cn: 将案件逐级层报至最高人民检察院，请求对三名未成年嫌疑人核准追诉。
description.en: Reported the case up through the hierarchy to the Supreme People's Procuratorate, requesting approval to prosecute the three minor suspects.

description.zh-cn: 审查并决定对三名未成年犯罪嫌疑人核准追诉，使案件得以进入刑事司法程序。
description.en: Reviewed and decided to approve the prosecution of the three minor suspects, allowing the case to proceed to the criminal justice system.

description.zh-cn: 该修正案下调了最低刑事责任年龄，为最高检核准追诉本案三名未满14周岁的嫌疑人提供了法律依据。
description.en: This amendment lowered the minimum age of criminal responsibility, providing the legal basis for the Supreme People's Procuratorate to approve the prosecution of the three suspects under 14 in this case.

description.zh-cn: 该案件引发了中国社会关于是否应进一步调整未成年人刑事责任年龄的广泛而激烈的讨论。
description.en: This case triggered a widespread and intense discussion in Chinese society about whether the age of criminal responsibility for minors should be further adjusted.

description.zh-cn: 应勇在案发时担任最高人民检察院党组书记、检察长。
description.en: Ying Yong was serving as the Party Secretary and Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate at the time of the case.

description.zh-cn: 在案发后公开强调，对未成年人实施的严重犯罪，符合核准追诉条件的，要依法追究刑事责任，表达了对依法适用刑事责任年龄规定的支持。
description.en: Publicly emphasized after the case that for serious crimes committed by minors, if the conditions for prosecution are met, criminal responsibility must be pursued in accordance with the law, expressing support for the legal application of the age of criminal responsibility regulations.

description.zh-cn: 张太雷于1915年考入天津北洋大学法科，并于1920年毕业。
description.en: Zhang Tailei was admitted to the Department of Law at Peiyang University in Tianjin in 1915 and graduated in 1920.

description.zh-cn: 1920年10月，张太雷加入李大钊发起成立的北京的中国共产党早期组织，成为中国共产党最早的党员之一。
description.en: In October 1920, Zhang Tailei joined the early CPC organization in Beijing, initiated by Li Dazhao, becoming one of the first members of the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Secretary of the China Section of the Far Eastern Bureau

description.zh-cn: 1921年春，张太雷被派往苏俄伊尔库茨克，任共产国际东方局中国科书记。
description.en: In the spring of 1921, Zhang Tailei was sent to Irkutsk, Soviet Russia, to serve as the Secretary of the China Section of the Far Eastern Bureau of the Comintern.

description.zh-cn: 1921年6月，张太雷陪同共产国际代表马林和赤色职工国际代表尼克尔斯基来中国，筹备召开中共一大。
description.en: In June 1921, Zhang Tailei accompanied Comintern representative Maring and Profintern representative Nikolski to China to prepare for the 1st National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 在出席共产国际三大期间，张太雷介绍瞿秋白加入中国共产党。
description.en: While attending the 3rd World Congress of the Comintern, Zhang Tailei introduced Qu Qiubai to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1924年，张太雷任中国社会主义青年团中央书记。
description.en: In 1924, Zhang Tailei served as the Central Secretary of the Chinese Socialist Youth League.

description.zh-cn: 在1927年的八七会议上，张太雷同陈独秀的路线进行了斗争。
description.en: At the 7 August Conference in 1927, Zhang Tailei struggled against Chen Duxiu's political line.

description.zh-cn: 张太雷是广州起义的主要策划者和领导人。
description.en: Zhang Tailei was the main planner and leader of the Guangzhou Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 张太雷于1925年与王一知结婚。
description.en: Zhang Tailei married Wang Yizhi in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 王一知原为施存统的夫人，后与其离婚。
description.en: Wang Yizhi was originally the wife of Shi Cuntong, whom she later divorced.

description.zh-cn: 张太雷曾担任共产国际代表鲍罗廷的翻译。
description.en: Zhang Tailei served as the translator for Comintern representative Mikhail Borodin.

description.zh-cn: 1923年8月，张太雷随蒋中正考察苏联。
description.en: In August 1923, Zhang Tailei accompanied Chiang Kai-shek on an inspection tour of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 刘冰等人的联名信旨在揭发清华大学党委书记迟群的严重问题。
description.en: The joint letter from Liu Bing and others was intended to expose the serious problems of Chi Qun, the Party Secretary of Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 刘冰等人的联名信旨在揭发谢静宜的严重问题。
description.en: The joint letter from Liu Bing and others was intended to expose the serious problems of Xie Jingyi.

description.zh-cn: 刘冰上书事件引发了毛泽东在全国发动“批邓、反击右倾翻案风”运动。
description.en: The Liu Bing Letter Incident triggered Mao Zedong to launch the nationwide 'Criticize Deng, Counter the Right-Deviationist Verdict-Reversing Wind' campaign.

description.zh-cn: 田农是黑龙江肇东人。
description.en: Tian Nong is from Zhaodong, Heilongjiang.

description.zh-cn: 田农曾任中央歌舞团演员，并担任东方歌舞团编导。
description.en: Tian Nong once served as an actor in the Central Song and Dance Troupe and also worked as a choreographer in the Oriental Song and Dance Troupe.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，田农是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia page category, Tian Nong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 李小棠是巴金的儿子。
description.en: Li Xiaotang is the son of Ba Jin.

description.zh-cn: 巴金自1983年起连续五次当选全国政协副主席，直至去世。
description.en: Starting in 1983, Ba Jin was elected Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC for five consecutive terms, a position he held until his death.

description.zh-cn: 巴金于1984年12月当选中国作家协会主席，任职直至逝世。
description.en: Ba Jin was elected Chairman of the China Writers Association in December 1984, a position he held until his death.

description.zh-cn: 巴金自1919年接触到无政府主义思想后，长期信仰并宣传之。
description.en: After being introduced to anarchist ideas in 1919, Ba Jin became a long-time believer and promoter of them.

description.zh-cn: 巴金于1923年夏考入南京国立东南大学附中，1925年毕业。
description.en: In the summer of 1923, Ba Jin was admitted to the Attached High School of National Southeastern University in Nanjing, from which he graduated in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 1957年7月，巴金和靳以共同创办了大型文学刊物《收获》。
description.en: In July 1957, Ba Jin and Jin Yi co-founded the major literary magazine 'Harvest'.

description.zh-cn: 1957年7月，靳以和巴金共同创办了大型文学刊物《收获》。
description.en: In July 1957, Jin Yi and Ba Jin co-founded the major literary magazine 'Harvest'.

description.zh-cn: 巴金于1904年11月25日出生在四川成都府。
