description.en: Ba Jin was born on November 25, 1904, in Chengdu Prefecture, Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 巴金因担任全国政协副主席，成为中华人民共和国的党和国家领导人之一。
description.en: By serving as the Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, Ba Jin became one of the party and state leaders of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1983年毕业于湖北财经学院基建财务信用系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Infrastructure Finance and Credit of Hubei College of Finance and Economics in 1983.

position.zh-cn: 行长助理; 党委书记、董事长
position.en: Assistant to the President; Party Secretary, Chairman

description.zh-cn: 该人物于1983年至1999年在中国建设银行工作，期间曾任行长助理。后于2017年7月31日重返建行，担任党委书记，并于同年10月9日获任命为董事长。
description.en: This individual worked at China Construction Bank from 1983 to 1999, serving as Assistant to the President. They returned to the bank on July 31, 2017, as Party Secretary, and were appointed Chairman on October 9 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 2004年至2010年12月任中国信达资产管理公司总裁。
description.en: Served as President of China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd. from 2004 to December 2010.

description.zh-cn: 2010年12月至2013年5月任中信集团公司副董事长及总经理。
description.en: Served as Vice Chairman and General Manager of CITIC Group from December 2010 to May 2013.

description.zh-cn: 2011年5月至2013年5月任中信银行董事长。
description.en: Served as Chairman of China CITIC Bank from May 2011 to May 2013.

description.zh-cn: 2013年5月至2017年7月任中国银行董事长。
description.en: Served as Chairman of Bank of China from May 2013 to July 2017.

description.zh-cn: 2015年6月15日，被任命为央行货币政策委员会委员。
description.en: On June 15, 2015, he was appointed as a member of the Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会上当选为中国共产党第十九届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: Was elected as an alternate member of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China at the 19th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 兼任中国银行业协会会长。
description.en: Concurrently serves as President of the China Banking Association.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世是黑森-达姆施塔特的玛丽的儿子。
description.en: Alexander III was the son of Marie of Hesse and by Rhine.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世是皇储尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇的弟弟，在其兄去世后成为皇储。
description.en: Alexander III was the younger brother of Tsarevich Nicholas Alexandrovich and became the heir apparent after his brother's death.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世与丹麦的达格玛公主于1866年结婚。
description.en: Alexander III married Princess Dagmar of Denmark in 1866.

description.zh-cn: 尼古拉二世是亚历山大三世的长子和继承人。
description.en: Nicholas II was the eldest son and successor of Alexander III.

description.zh-cn: 在父亲亚历山大二世被刺杀后，亚历山大三世继位为俄罗斯帝国皇帝。
description.en: After the assassination of his father Alexander II, Alexander III ascended the throne as the Emperor of the Russian Empire.

description.zh-cn: 在其丹麦妻子玛丽亚·费奥多罗芙娜的影响下，亚历山大三世对德意志帝国及其领导人产生反感。
description.en: Under the influence of his Danish wife, Maria Feodorovna, Alexander III developed an aversion to the German Empire and its leaders.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世对德意志帝国产生反感。
description.en: Alexander III developed an aversion to the German Empire.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世对德国总理俾斯麦产生反感。
description.en: Alexander III developed an aversion to the German Chancellor Bismarck.

description.zh-cn: 1880年代末，因与德国关系恶化，亚历山大三世领导下的俄罗斯帝国开始亲近法国。
description.en: In the late 1880s, due to deteriorating relations with Germany, the Russian Empire under Alexander III began to align with France.

description.zh-cn: 民意党人曾计划于1887年3月1日行刺亚历山大三世，但计划败露，所有刺客均被逮捕。
description.en: Members of Narodnaya Volya planned to assassinate Alexander III on March 1, 1887, but the plot was uncovered and all assassins were arrested.

description.zh-cn: 作为对参与刺杀沙皇计划的惩罚，包括亚历山大·乌里扬诺夫在内的五名拒绝忏悔的民意党人被判处绞刑。
description.en: As punishment for participating in the assassination plot, five unrepentant members of Narodnaya Volya, including Aleksandr Ulyanov, were sentenced to be hanged.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大·乌里扬诺夫是弗拉基米尔·伊里奇·列宁（原名弗拉基米尔·乌里扬诺夫）的胞兄。
description.en: Aleksandr Ulyanov was the elder brother of Vladimir Lenin (born Vladimir Ulyanov).

description.zh-cn: 1888年的波尔基铁路事故给亚历山大三世造成了心理和生理创伤，被认为是导致其健康恶化并最终因肾炎去世的诱因。
description.en: The Borki train disaster in 1888 caused psychological and physical trauma to Alexander III, and is considered a contributing factor to his deteriorating health and eventual death from nephritis.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎的亚历山大三世桥是为了纪念法国和俄罗斯缔结法俄同盟而修建的。
description.en: The Pont Alexandre III in Paris was built to commemorate the conclusion of the Franco-Russian Alliance between France and Russia.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大三世于1845年3月10日出生于圣彼得堡冬宫。
description.en: Alexander III was born on March 10, 1845, in the Winter Palace in Saint Petersburg.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁于1938年10月出生于英属香港。
description.en: Ye Xuaning was born in British Hong Kong in October 1938.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁是曾宪植的儿子。
description.en: Ye Xuaning is the son of Zeng Xianzhi.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁的外高祖父是曾国荃。
description.en: Ye Xuaning's maternal great-great-grandfather was Zeng Guoquan.

description.zh-cn: 叶选平是叶选宁的哥哥。
description.en: Ye Xuanping is Ye Xuaning's older brother.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁于1984年参军，1988年被授予少将军衔，1997年退役。
description.en: Ye Xuaning joined the army in 1984, was awarded the rank of Major General in 1988, and retired in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 1976年四人帮被逮捕后，叶剑英派叶选宁看望胡耀邦，叶选宁向叶剑英和华国锋转达了胡耀邦的“三句话”建议。
description.en: In 1976, after the arrest of the Gang of Four, Ye Jianying sent Ye Xuaning to visit Hu Yaobang. Ye Xuaning then relayed Hu Yaobang's 'three sentences' of advice to Ye Jianying and Hua Guofeng.

description.zh-cn: 1984年任副部长，1990年6月升任部长。
description.en: Appointed Deputy Director in 1984, promoted to Director in June 1990.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁是第八届全国政协委员、第九届全国政协常务委员。
description.en: Ye Xuaning was a member of the 8th National Committee and a Standing Committee member of the 9th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 叶选宁于1990年6月接替金黎担任中国人民解放军总政治部联络部部长。
description.en: Ye Xuaning succeeded Jin Li as the Director of the Liaison Department of the PLA General Political Department in June 1990.

description.zh-cn: “罢黜百家，独尊儒术”的政策确立了儒家思想在中国古代的官方正统地位。
description.en: The policy of 'dismissing the hundred schools of thought and exclusively honoring Confucianism' established Confucianism as the official orthodoxy in ancient China.

description.zh-cn: 《论语》是儒家学派的核心经典。
description.en: The Analects is the core classic of the Confucian school.

description.zh-cn: 被朱熹列为“四书”之一，极大地提高了《论语》在儒家经典中的地位。
description.en: Being included as one of the 'Four Books' by Zhu Xi greatly elevated the status of the Analects among Confucian classics.

description.zh-cn: 在东汉末年以《张侯论》为底本，参考其他版本，作《论语注》，最终定下了《论语》的今本。
description.en: In the late Eastern Han, he used the 'Marquis Zhang's Analects' as a basis, referenced other versions, and wrote the 'Commentary on the Analects', which established the modern text of the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 在三国时期编撰了《论语集解》，是《论语》的重要注本。
description.en: During the Three Kingdoms period, he compiled the 'Collected Explanations of the Analects', an important commentary on the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 在南北朝时期编撰了《论语义疏》，是《论语》的重要注本。
description.en: During the Southern and Northern Dynasties period, he compiled the 'Subcommentary on the Meaning of the Analects', an important commentary on the Analects.

description.zh-cn: 于公元5世纪初将《论语》注疏传入日本。
description.en: Introduced the commentaries on the Analects to Japan in the early 5th century.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄是唐朝初年的开国功臣和名相。
description.en: Fang Xuanling was a founding father and prominent chancellor of the early Tang dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄参与策划了玄武门之变，并与杜如晦、长孙无忌、尉迟敬德、侯君集五人并功第一。
description.en: Fang Xuanling participated in planning the Xuanwu Gate Incident and was ranked first in merit along with Du Ruhui, Zhangsun Wuji, Yuchi Jingde, and Hou Junji.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄与杜如晦同为唐太宗的得力助手，房玄龄善于谋划，杜如晦善于决断，二人并称“房谋杜断”，后世将他们视为良相的典范。
description.en: Fang Xuanling and Du Ruhui were both key assistants to Emperor Taizong. Fang was skilled in planning while Du excelled at making decisions. They were known as 'Fang's schemes and Du's judgment' and are regarded by later generations as model chancellors.

description.zh-cn: 在玄武门之变中，房玄龄与长孙无忌、杜如晦等人并功第一。
description.en: In the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Fang Xuanling, along with Zhangsun Wuji, Du Ruhui, and others, was ranked first in merit.

description.zh-cn: 在玄武门之变中，房玄龄与尉迟敬德、杜如晦等人并功第一。
description.en: In the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Fang Xuanling, along with Yuchi Jingde, Du Ruhui, and others, was ranked first in merit.

description.zh-cn: 在玄武门之变中，房玄龄与侯君集、杜如晦等人并功第一。
description.en: In the Xuanwu Gate Incident, Fang Xuanling, along with Hou Junji, Du Ruhui, and others, was ranked first in merit.

description.zh-cn: 房彦谦是房玄龄的父亲。
description.en: Fang Yanqian was the father of Fang Xuanling.

description.zh-cn: 房遗爱是房玄龄的次子。
description.en: Fang Yiai was the second son of Fang Xuanling.

description.zh-cn: 房遗直是房玄龄的嗣子。
description.en: Fang Yizhi was the heir of Fang Xuanling.

description.zh-cn: 房遗爱与高阳公主为夫妻。
description.en: Fang Yiai and Princess Gaoyang were husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 卢氏是房玄龄的妻子。
description.en: Lady Lu was Fang Xuanling's wife.

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄奉唐太宗之命，监修了《晋书》。
description.en: Under the order of Emperor Taizong of Tang, Fang Xuanling supervised the compilation of the Book of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗欲赐美人给房玄龄，遭其妻卢氏坚决反对。太宗以毒酒试探，卢氏一饮而尽，太宗因而感慨“我尚畏见，何况于玄龄！”
description.en: Emperor Taizong wanted to gift concubines to Fang Xuanling, but his wife Lady Lu strongly opposed it. The emperor tested her with 'poisoned wine', which she drank without hesitation, leading the emperor to exclaim, 'Even I am afraid of her, let alone Xuanling!'

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗为赐房玄龄美人一事，让长孙皇后召见卢氏进行劝说。
description.en: Regarding the matter of gifting concubines to Fang Xuanling, Emperor Taizong had Empress Zhangsun summon Lady Lu to persuade her.

description.zh-cn: 唐太宗李世民即位后，房玄龄出任中书令。
description.en: After Emperor Taizong of Tang ascended the throne, Fang Xuanling was appointed as Zhongshu Ling (Head of the Central Secretariat).

description.zh-cn: 贞观三年（629年），房玄龄迁任尚书左仆射。
description.en: In the third year of Zhenguan (629), Fang Xuanling was transferred to the position of Shangshu Zuo Puye (Left Executive of the Department of State Affairs).

description.zh-cn: 贞观十六年（642年），房玄龄进位司空。
description.en: In the sixteenth year of Zhenguan (642), Fang Xuanling was promoted to the position of Sikong (Minister of Works).

description.zh-cn: 房玄龄名列凌烟阁二十四功臣之一。
description.en: Fang Xuanling was listed as one of the Twenty-four meritorious officials of Lingyan Pavilion.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密在格拉斯哥大学时，在法兰西斯·哈奇森的教导下研读道德哲学，并深受其启发。
description.en: At the University of Glasgow, Adam Smith studied moral philosophy under the tutelage of Francis Hutcheson and was deeply inspired by him.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密在牛津大学期间阅读了大卫·休谟的《人性论》，并因此受到训斥。
description.en: Adam Smith read David Hume's 'A Treatise of Human Nature' during his time at Oxford and was reprimanded for it.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密在巴黎结识了重农主义学派的领导人弗朗索瓦·魁奈，并极为尊重他的理论。
description.en: In Paris, Adam Smith met François Quesnay, the leader of the Physiocratic school, and held his theories in high regard.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密于1773年正式入选为英国皇家学会的院士。
description.en: Adam Smith was formally elected a Fellow of the Royal Society in 1773.

description.zh-cn: 经济学家约瑟夫·熊彼特将亚当·斯密两部主要著作之间看似的矛盾命名为“亚当·斯密问题”。
description.en: Economist Joseph Schumpeter named the apparent contradiction between Adam Smith's two major works 'das Adam Smith-Problem'.

description.zh-cn: 1764年，亚当·斯密辞去格拉斯哥大学教授职位，由托马斯·里德接替。
description.en: In 1764, Adam Smith resigned from his professorship at the University of Glasgow, and was succeeded by Thomas Reid.

description.zh-cn: 亚当·斯密的经济和哲学思想影响了美国开国先驱，并对美国革命的理念基础产生了影响。
description.en: Adam Smith's economic and philosophical ideas influenced the American Founding Fathers and had an impact on the ideological foundations of the American Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 托马斯·罗伯特·马尔萨斯等后来的经济学家将斯密的理论整合为古典经济学。
description.en: Later economists such as Thomas Robert Malthus integrated Smith's theories into what is now known as classical economics.

description.zh-cn: 大卫·李嘉图等后来的经济学家将斯密的理论整合为古典经济学。
description.en: Later economists such as David Ricardo integrated Smith's theories into what is now known as classical economics.

description.zh-cn: 一些人主张《国富论》的内容曾被修改以符合大卫·休谟等思想家的理论。
description.en: Some argue that the content of 'The Wealth of Nations' was altered to align with the theories of thinkers like David Hume.

description.zh-cn: 一些人主张《国富论》的内容曾被修改以符合孟德斯鸠等思想家的理论。
description.en: Some argue that the content of 'The Wealth of Nations' was altered to align with the theories of thinkers like Montesquieu.

description.zh-cn: 八月十日事件推翻了君主制，国民立法议会因此颁布法令，召开国民公会以起草新宪法。
description.en: The Insurrection of 10 August 1792 overthrew the monarchy, leading the Legislative Assembly to decree the convening of the National Convention to draft a new constitution.

description.zh-cn: 八月十日事件后，国民立法议会颁布法令召开了作为其继承者的国民公会。
description.en: After the Insurrection of 10 August 1792, the Legislative Assembly decreed the convening of the National Convention as its successor.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会下令于1793年1月21日处决路易十六。
description.en: The National Convention ordered the execution of Louis XVI on January 21, 1793.

description.zh-cn: 山岳派是国民公会中的激进左翼派别。
description.en: The Montagnards were the radical left-wing faction within the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 吉伦特派是国民公会中的右翼派别。
description.en: The Girondins were the right-wing faction within the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 平原派是国民公会中的中间派别。
description.en: The Plain was the centrist faction within the National Convention.

description.zh-cn: 山岳派与吉伦特派在国民公会中是激烈的政治对手，冲突不断，最终山岳派通过武装暴动清除了吉伦特派。
description.en: The Montagnards and Girondins were fierce political rivals in the National Convention, with constant conflict, which culminated in the Montagnards purging the Girondins through an armed insurrection.

description.zh-cn: 无套裤汉是山岳派的紧密政治盟友，为其提供了来自巴黎基层的群众支持。
description.en: The sans-culottes were close political allies of the Montagnards, providing them with popular support from the common people of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 这次暴动导致29名吉伦特派领袖被逮捕，吉伦特派的政治力量就此终结。
description.en: This insurrection led to the arrest of 29 Girondin leaders, terminating the political power of the Girondins.

description.zh-cn: 约8万名武装的无套裤汉包围了国民公会，迫使其逮捕吉伦特派领袖。
description.en: Approximately 80,000 armed sans-culottes surrounded the National Convention, forcing it to arrest the Girondin leaders.

description.zh-cn: 巴黎公社呼吁并组织各区力量，成立了叛乱起义委员会，策划并发动了此次暴动。
description.en: The Paris Commune called for and organized forces from the sections, formed an insurrectionary committee, and planned and launched this insurrection.

description.zh-cn: 夏绿蒂·科黛于1793年7月13日谋杀了让-保尔·马拉。
description.en: Charlotte Corday assassinated Jean-Paul Marat on July 13, 1793.

description.zh-cn: 在清除了吉伦特派后，山岳派主导的国民公会建立了一系列机构和法令，开启了雅各宾专政（或称恐怖统治）。
description.en: After purging the Girondins, the Montagnard-dominated National Convention established a series of institutions and decrees, initiating the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 救国委员会是国民公会设立的下属委员会，名义上向公会负责，但在雅各宾专政时期实际掌控了行政权力。
description.en: The Committee of Public Safety was a subordinate committee established by the National Convention and was nominally responsible to it, but it effectively controlled executive power during the Reign of Terror.

description.zh-cn: 治安委员会是国民公会设立的下属委员会，负责警察和监视职能。
description.en: The Committee of General Security was a subordinate committee established by the National Convention, responsible for police and surveillance functions.

description.zh-cn: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔于1793年7月27日加入救国委员会，并成为其核心领导人物。
description.en: Maximilien Robespierre joined the Committee of Public Safety on July 27, 1793, and became its central leading figure.

description.zh-cn: 安东万·路易·德·圣茹斯特于1793年7月加入救国委员会，是罗伯斯庇尔的亲密盟友。
description.en: Louis Antoine de Saint-Just joined the Committee of Public Safety in July 1793 and was a close ally of Robespierre.

description.zh-cn: 救国委员会决定清除极左的埃贝尔派，并于1794年3月24日将其主要成员处决。
description.en: The Committee of Public Safety decided to purge the far-left Hébertists and executed their main members on March 24, 1794.

description.zh-cn: 在清除了埃贝尔派后，救国委员会转向打击以丹东为首的右翼（温和派），并于1794年4月5日将其处决。
description.en: After purging the Hébertists, the Committee of Public Safety turned against the right-wing (moderate) faction led by Danton and executed him on April 5, 1794.

description.zh-cn: 作为丹东派的核心成员，卡米尔·德穆兰与丹东一同于1794年4月5日被救国委员会处决。
description.en: As a core member of the Dantonists, Camille Desmoulins was executed along with Danton by the Committee of Public Safety on April 5, 1794.

description.zh-cn: 热月政变后，国民公会制定并通过了共和三年宪法，建立了督政府体制。
description.en: After the Thermidorian Reaction, the National Convention drafted and passed the Constitution of the Year III, which established the Directory regime.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑·波拿巴受国民公会任命，指挥军队成功镇压了保皇党人的叛乱。
description.en: Appointed by the National Convention, Napoleon Bonaparte commanded the army and successfully suppressed the royalist rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会于1795年10月26日解散，其行政权力由新成立的督政府继承。
description.en: The National Convention was dissolved on October 26, 1795, and its executive power was inherited by the newly formed Directory.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会于1795年10月26日解散，其立法权力由元老院和五百人院继承。
description.en: The National Convention was dissolved on October 26, 1795, and its legislative power was inherited by the Council of Ancients and the Council of Five Hundred.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会于1795年10月26日解散，其立法权力由元老院和五百人院继承。
description.en: The National Convention was dissolved on October 26, 1795, and its legislative power was inherited by the Council of Ancients and the Council of Five Hundred.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会于1794年创办了巴黎综合理工学院，作为其建立公共教育系统的一部分。
description.en: The National Convention founded the École Polytechnique in 1794 as part of its efforts to establish a public education system.

description.zh-cn: 国民公会于1794年创办了巴黎高等师范学校。
description.en: The National Convention founded the École normale supérieure in 1794.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在广州的禁烟行动引发了与英国的冲突，成为第一次鸦片战争的导火索。
description.en: Lin Zexu's anti-opium campaign in Guangzhou triggered conflict with the United Kingdom, becoming the catalyst for the First Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝钦差大臣，代表清政府签署了《南京条约》。
description.en: As the Imperial Commissioner of the Qing dynasty, he signed the Treaty of Nanking on behalf of the Qing government.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝乍浦副都统，代表清政府签署了《南京条约》。
description.en: As the Deputy Lieutenant-General of Zhapu of the Qing dynasty, he signed the Treaty of Nanking on behalf of the Qing government.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国驻华全权代表，代表英国政府签订《南京条约》。
description.en: As the British Plenipotentiary in China, he signed the Treaty of Nanking on behalf of the British government.

description.zh-cn: 作为清朝皇帝，批准了《南京条约》使其生效。
description.en: As the Emperor of the Qing dynasty, he approved the Treaty of Nanking, putting it into effect.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国君主，批准了《南京条约》使其生效。
description.en: As the British Monarch, she approved the Treaty of Nanking, putting it into effect.

description.zh-cn: 《南京条约》第二条规定，清政府需向英国开放广州、福州、厦门、宁波、上海五处港口进行贸易。
description.en: Article 2 of the Treaty of Nanking stipulated that the Qing government must open the five ports of Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo, and Shanghai to Great Britain for trade.

description.zh-cn: 《虎门条约》是作为《南京条约》的补充和善后条款而签订的。
description.en: The Treaty of the Bogue was signed as a supplement and follow-up to the Treaty of Nanking.

description.zh-cn: 因《南京条约》执行过程中的翻译分歧和拒外情绪等争端，成为引发第二次鸦片战争的远因之一。
description.en: Disputes arising from the implementation of the Treaty of Nanking, such as translation discrepancies and anti-foreign sentiment, became one of the long-term causes of the Second Opium War.

description.zh-cn: 璞鼎查违背了英国外交大臣阿伯丁伯爵撤回割地要求的训令，在谈判中坚持并最终促成了香港的割让。
description.en: Henry Pottinger defied the instructions of British Foreign Secretary Lord Aberdeen to withdraw the demand for territorial cession, insisting on and ultimately securing the cession of Hong Kong during negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 作为英国外交大臣，曾于1841年向璞鼎查发出新训令，撤回割地要求，但此举未能阻止香港最终被割让。
description.en: As British Foreign Secretary, he issued new instructions to Henry Pottinger in 1841 to withdraw the demand for territorial cession, but this action failed to prevent the eventual cession of Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 耆英是道光帝派遣的钦差大臣，负责与英方谈判。
description.en: Keying was the Imperial Commissioner dispatched by the Daoguang Emperor to negotiate with the British.

description.zh-cn: 1943年签订的《中英平等新约》废除了英国在中国享有的领事裁判权（治外法权）。
description.en: The Sino-British New Equal Treaty signed in 1943 abolished the extraterritorial rights enjoyed by the United Kingdom in China.

description.zh-cn: 根据《南京条约》，上海成为五个通商口岸之一，此后迅速崛起为中国最大的贸易港口。
description.en: Under the Treaty of Nanking, Shanghai became one of the five treaty ports, and subsequently rose rapidly to become China's largest trading port.

description.zh-cn: 耆英与璞鼎查在江宁就《南京条约》的内容进行了谈判。
description.en: Keying and Henry Pottinger negotiated the terms of the Treaty of Nanking in Jiangning.

description.zh-cn: 时任两江总督牛鉴曾应璞鼎查之邀登上英舰，并在英军兵临城下时向其乞和。
description.en: Niu Jian, then Viceroy of Liangjiang, accepted Pottinger's invitation to board a British warship and pleaded for peace when British forces were at the city's gates.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国国民政府于1943年与英国政府签订了《中英平等新约》。
description.en: The Nationalist Government of the Republic of China signed the Sino-British New Equal Treaty with the British government in 1943.

description.zh-cn: 山东省司法厅是山东省人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial Department of Justice is a constituent department of the Shandong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 山东省司法厅受中华人民共和国司法部的业务指导。
description.en: The Shandong Provincial Department of Justice receives professional guidance from the Ministry of Justice of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1945年8月13日，中共山东省政府成立，并将山东省司法处更名为山东省司法厅。
description.en: On August 13, 1945, the CPC's Shandong Provincial Government was established and renamed the Shandong Provincial Judicial Office to the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 兼任厅长。
description.en: Served concurrently as Director.

description.zh-cn: 1958年起与山东省司法厅合署办公，1959年12月山东省司法厅被撤销后，其司法行政工作由山东省高级人民法院办理。
description.en: Starting in 1958, it shared office space with the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice. After the department was abolished in December 1959, its judicial administrative work was handled by the Shandong Provincial High People's Court.

description.zh-cn: 1959年12月，山东省人民委员会决定撤销山东省司法厅，该决定于1960年1月17日正式生效。
description.en: In December 1959, the Shandong Provincial People's Committee decided to abolish the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice, and the decision officially took effect on January 17, 1960.

description.zh-cn: 1979年12月23日，中共山东省委决定重新建立山东省司法厅。
description.en: On December 23, 1979, the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee decided to re-establish the Shandong Provincial Department of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 欧洲航海家詹姆斯·库克于1776年首次发现夏威夷群岛。
description.en: European navigator James Cook first discovered the Hawaiian Islands in 1776.

description.zh-cn: 1795年，卡美哈梅哈统一了夏威夷群岛，并建立了夏威夷王国。
description.en: In 1795, Kamehameha unified the Hawaiian Islands and founded the Kingdom of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 1893年的政变推翻了利留卡拉尼女王的统治，迫使其退位。
description.en: The 1893 coup overthrew the rule of Queen Liliʻuokalani, forcing her to abdicate.

description.zh-cn: 1893年的政变终结了夏威夷王国的存在。
description.en: The 1893 coup ended the existence of the Kingdom of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 夏威夷王国的覆灭为夏威夷共和国的成立创造了条件。
description.en: The fall of the Kingdom of Hawaii paved the way for the establishment of the Republic of Hawaii.

description.zh-cn: 桑福德·多尔于1894年成为夏威夷共和国临时政府的首任总统。
description.en: Sanford B. Dole became the first president of the provisional government of the Republic of Hawaii in 1894.

description.zh-cn: 1941年12月7日，日本海军航空兵袭击了珍珠港。
description.en: On December 7, 1941, the Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service attacked Pearl Harbor.

description.zh-cn: 庄建球是郑州市人民政府的现任市长。
description.en: Zhuang Jianqiu is the current mayor of the Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 王鸿勋是郑州市人民政府的现任副市长。
description.en: Wang Hongxun is a current deputy mayor of the Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 王滔是郑州市人民政府的现任副市长。
description.en: Wang Tao is a current deputy mayor of the Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 郑州市人民政府是河南省人民政府的业务上级机构。
description.en: The Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government is organizationally subordinate to the Henan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是郑州市人民政府的授权法源。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is the legal source of authority for the Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 郑州市人民政府的印章由中华人民共和国国务院制发。
description.en: The official seal of the Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government is manufactured and issued by the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 郑州市人民政府是郑州市的市级行政管理机关。
description.en: The Zhengzhou Municipal People's Government is the municipal-level administrative body for Zhengzhou City.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料，杨宇霆于1885年8月29日出生于奉天省法库县。
description.en: According to records, Yang Yuting was born on August 29, 1885, in Faku County, Fengtian Province.

description.zh-cn: 高纪毅作为张学良的警务处长，执行了处决杨宇霆和常荫槐的命令。
description.en: As Zhang Xueliang's Chief of Police Affairs, Gao Jiyi carried out the order to execute Yang Yuting and Chang Yinhuai.

description.zh-cn: 孙传芳在江苏对杨宇霆领导的奉军发起武装袭击，导致后者战败撤退。
description.en: Sun Chuanfang launched an armed attack on the Fengtian army led by Yang Yuting in Jiangsu, leading to the latter's defeat and retreat.

description.zh-cn: 陈调元与孙传芳联手在江苏对杨宇霆领导的奉军发起武装袭击。
description.en: Chen Diaoyuan, in alliance with Sun Chuanfang, launched an armed attack on the Fengtian army led by Yang Yuting in Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 张作霖对杨宇霆亲近徐树铮的行为表示不满，暗示了杨与徐之间存在友好的政治关系。
description.en: Zhang Zuolin's dissatisfaction with Yang Yuting's closeness to Xu Shuzheng suggests a friendly political relationship between Yang and Xu.

description.zh-cn: 美国众议院是美国国会的下议院。
description.en: The U.S. House of Representatives is the lower house of the U.S. Congress.

description.zh-cn: 美国参议院是美国国会的上议院。
description.en: The U.S. Senate is the upper house of the U.S. Congress.

description.zh-cn: 迈克·约翰逊于2023年10月25日当选为美国众议院议长。
description.en: Mike Johnson was elected Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives on October 25, 2023.

description.zh-cn: 迈克·约翰逊是共和党成员。
description.en: Mike Johnson is a member of the Republican Party.

description.zh-cn: 史蒂夫·斯卡利斯是共和党成员，并担任众议院多数党领袖。
description.en: Steve Scalise is a member of the Republican Party and serves as the House Majority Leader.

description.zh-cn: 哈基姆·杰弗里斯是民主党成员，并担任众议院少数党领袖。
description.en: Hakeem Jeffries is a member of the Democratic Party and serves as the House Minority Leader.

description.zh-cn: 《美国宪法》设立了由参议院和众议院组成的两院制国会。
description.en: The U.S. Constitution established a bicameral Congress consisting of the Senate and the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 1787年召开的大陆会议旨在解决《邦联条例》的缺陷，并最终起草了《美国宪法》。
description.en: The Continental Congress convened in 1787 to address the deficiencies of the Articles of Confederation, which led to the drafting of the U.S. Constitution.

description.zh-cn: 康涅狄格妥协案确立了美国国会的两院制结构，解决了大小州之间的代表权争议。
description.en: The Connecticut Compromise established the bicameral structure of the U.S. Congress, resolving the representation dispute between large and small states.

description.zh-cn: 在内战后的重建时期，共和党长期在国会取得多数席位。
description.en: During the Reconstruction era following the Civil War, the Republican Party held a long-term majority in Congress.

description.zh-cn: 富兰克林·罗斯福的上台开启了民主党自1933年起长期支配众议院的时代。
description.en: Franklin D. Roosevelt's rise to power began an era of long-term Democratic dominance in the House of Representatives starting in 1933.

description.zh-cn: 纽特·金瑞契领导了1994年的“共和党革命”，使共和党重夺众议院控制权。
description.en: Newt Gingrich led the "Republican Revolution" of 1994, which returned control of the House to the Republican Party.

description.zh-cn: 美国众议院在1998年通过了对比尔·克林顿总统的弹劾条款。
description.en: The U.S. House of Representatives passed articles of impeachment against President Bill Clinton in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 克林顿弹劾案对总统比尔·克林顿的执政构成了严重挑战。
description.en: The impeachment of Bill Clinton posed a significant challenge to his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 1965年的《选举法案》禁止州政府基于降低少数民族表决权之目的而将选区划分为不规则状（杰利蝾螈）。
description.en: The Voting Rights Act of 1965 prohibits states from gerrymandering districts with the purpose of diminishing the voting power of minorities.

description.zh-cn: 在1800年总统选举出现选举人团僵局后，众议院根据宪法第十二修正案投票选举托马斯·杰斐逊为总统。
description.en: Following an Electoral College tie in the 1800 presidential election, the House of Representatives voted to elect Thomas Jefferson as president under the provisions of the Twelfth Amendment.

description.zh-cn: 在1800年总统选举僵局中，阿龙·伯尔在众议院的权变选举中输给了托马斯·杰斐逊。
description.en: In the contingent election of 1800, Aaron Burr was defeated by Thomas Jefferson in the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 在1824年总统选举出现选举人团僵局后，众议院投票选举约翰·昆西·亚当斯为总统。
description.en: Following an Electoral College tie in the 1824 presidential election, the House of Representatives voted to elect John Quincy Adams as president.

description.zh-cn: 尽管安德鲁·杰克森在1824年总统选举中获得普选票和选举人票的多数，但在众议院的权变选举中输给了约翰·昆西·亚当斯。
description.en: Despite winning a plurality of the popular and electoral votes in the 1824 presidential election, Andrew Jackson was defeated by John Quincy Adams in the contingent election held in the House of Representatives.

description.zh-cn: 冷战的爆发以及对苏联在欧洲扩张的担忧是第二次红色恐慌的主要背景。
description.en: The outbreak of the Cold War and fears of Soviet expansion in Europe were the primary context for the Second Red Scare.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中国共产党在中国大陆的胜利加剧了美国对共产主义威胁的恐惧。
description.en: The victory of the Chinese Communist Party in mainland China in 1949 intensified fears of a communist threat in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 1950年朝鲜战争的爆发进一步提升了对共产主义势力扩张的恐惧。
description.en: The outbreak of the Korean War in 1950 further elevated fears of communist expansion.

description.zh-cn: 约瑟夫·麦卡锡是麦卡锡主义的代表人物，他通过一系列指控和调查，推动了这场反共运动。
description.en: Joseph McCarthy was the figurehead of McCarthyism, driving the anti-communist movement through a series of accusations and investigations.

description.zh-cn: 众议院非美活动调查委员会是麦卡锡时代进行反共调查的主要政府机构之一。
description.en: The House Un-American Activities Committee was one of the main government bodies conducting anti-communist investigations during the McCarthy era.

description.zh-cn: 作为FBI局长，约翰·埃德加·胡佛设计了联邦政府的忠诚审查计划，并利用FBI的权力广泛进行反共调查，是麦卡锡主义的重要推动者。
description.en: As Director of the FBI, J. Edgar Hoover designed the federal government's loyalty review program and used the Bureau's power to conduct extensive anti-communist investigations, making him a key driver of McCarthyism.

description.zh-cn: 作为“好莱坞十君子”之一，道尔顿·特兰波被列入好莱坞黑名单，导致其在多年内无法以自己的名义工作。
description.en: As one of the 'Hollywood Ten', Dalton Trumbo was placed on the Hollywood blacklist, preventing him from working under his own name for many years.

description.zh-cn: 沃伦法院作出了一系列重要判决，如“耶茨诉美国案”和“沃特金斯诉美国案”，限制了政府以共产主义关联为由进行迫害的权力，从而协助终结了麦卡锡主义。
description.en: The Warren Court made a series of key decisions, such as Yates v. United States and Watkins v. United States, which limited the government's power to persecute based on communist affiliation, thereby helping to end McCarthyism.

description.zh-cn: 爱德华·默罗在其电视节目《See It Now》中播出了直接批评约瑟夫·麦卡锡的报道，严重损害了麦卡锡的公众形象，被认为是麦卡锡主义终结的关键一章。
description.en: Edward R. Murrow broadcast a report directly criticizing Joseph McCarthy on his television program 'See It Now', which severely damaged McCarthy's public image and is considered a key chapter in the end of McCarthyism.

description.zh-cn: 美国参议院以65票对22票通过了对约瑟夫·麦卡锡的谴责案，实质上终结了其作为反共势力主力的政治生涯。
description.en: The U.S. Senate voted 65 to 22 to censure Joseph McCarthy, effectively ending his political career as a leading anti-communist force.

description.zh-cn: 在第四轮投票中将普雷沃斯特枢机选举为教宗。
description.en: Elected Cardinal Prevost as Pope in the fourth round of voting.

description.zh-cn: 接替方济各成为天主教会第267任教宗。
description.en: Succeeded Pope Francis as the 267th Pope of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 良十四世选择“良”作为教宗名号，是受先教宗良十三世及其社会思想的启发。
description.en: Leo XIV's choice of the pontifical name 'Leo' was inspired by his predecessor Pope Leo XIII and his social teachings.

description.zh-cn: 良十三世于1891年发表的《新事》通谕开启了天主教社会思想。
description.en: The 1891 encyclical 'Rerum novarum' by Pope Leo XIII initiated Catholic social teaching.

description.zh-cn: 良十四世选择其教宗名号意在致敬开启天主教社会思想的良十三世，并关注当代社会议题。
description.en: Leo XIV's choice of papal name was a tribute to Leo XIII, who initiated Catholic social teaching, and reflects a focus on contemporary social issues.

description.zh-cn: 在担任主教期间及当选教宗后，多次谴责俄罗斯的入侵行径，称其为“真正的帝国主义式的入侵”，并呼吁公正持久的和平。
description.en: Both as a bishop and after his election as Pope, he repeatedly condemned Russia's invasion, calling it a 'truly imperialist invasion' and urging for a just and lasting peace.

description.zh-cn: 与乌克兰总统泽连斯基通话，这是他当选教宗后首次与世俗国家领导人通话。
description.en: Spoke with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy by phone, marking his first conversation with a secular head of state since his election.

description.zh-cn: 周守仁枢机透露，良十四世曾表示希望访问中国，并且是首位就任前曾到访中国内地的教宗。
description.en: Cardinal Stephen Chow revealed that Pope Leo XIV had expressed a desire to visit China and was the first pope to have visited mainland China before his pontificate.

description.zh-cn: 批评特朗普领导下的美国移民政策。
description.en: Criticized the US immigration policies under the leadership of Donald Trump.

description.zh-cn: 批评万斯领导下的美国移民政策。
description.en: Criticized the US immigration policies under the leadership of JD Vance.

description.zh-cn: 傅勇是傅全有的儿子。
description.en: Fu Yong is the son of Fu Quanyou.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有于1946年10月参加中国人民解放军，2003年3月离休。
description.en: Fu Quanyou joined the People's Liberation Army in October 1946 and retired in March 2003.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有于1947年8月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Fu Quanyou joined the Communist Party of China in August 1947.

description.zh-cn: 1948年，傅全有在第一野战军担任副连长。
description.en: In 1948, Fu Quanyou served as a Deputy Company Commander in the First Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有作为中国人民解放军的一员参与了第二次国共内战。
description.en: As a member of the People's Liberation Army, Fu Quanyou participated in the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有随部队于1953年2月入朝参加朝鲜战争。
description.en: Fu Quanyou entered Korea with his unit in February 1953 to participate in the Korean War.

position.en: Battalion Chief of Staff, Deputy Battalion Commander, Battalion Commander

description.zh-cn: 傅全有在朝鲜战争期间担任中国人民志愿军的营参谋长、副营长、营长等职务。
description.en: During the Korean War, Fu Quanyou served as Battalion Chief of Staff, Deputy Battalion Commander, and Battalion Commander in the Chinese People's Volunteer Army.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有于1960年毕业于中国人民解放军高等军事学院，获大专学历。
description.en: Fu Quanyou graduated from the PLA Higher Military Academy in 1960 with a junior college diploma.

description.zh-cn: 1985年6月至1990年5月，傅全有担任成都军区司令员。
description.en: From June 1985 to May 1990, Fu Quanyou served as the Commander of the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1990年5月至1992年10月，傅全有担任兰州军区司令员。
description.en: From May 1990 to October 1992, Fu Quanyou served as the Commander of the Lanzhou Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 1992年10月至2003年3月，傅全有担任中央军委委员。
description.en: From October 1992 to March 2003, Fu Quanyou served as a member of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 1992年10月至1995年9月，傅全有担任中国人民解放军总后勤部部长。
description.en: From October 1992 to September 1995, Fu Quanyou served as the Director of the PLA General Logistics Department.

description.zh-cn: 1995年9月至2002年11月，傅全有担任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: From September 1995 to November 2002, Fu Quanyou served as the Chief of the PLA General Staff.

description.zh-cn: 傅全有出生于山西省崞县。
description.en: Fu Quanyou was born in Guo County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 傅勇曾任第1集团军某摩步旅旅长、集团军副参谋长，并于2010年升任该集团军副军长。
description.en: Fu Yong served as a motorized infantry brigade commander and deputy chief of staff of the 1st Group Army, and was promoted to Deputy Corps Commander in 2010.

description.zh-cn: 2011年，傅勇挂职担任海军东海舰队副参谋长。
description.en: In 2011, Fu Yong held a temporary post as Deputy Chief of Staff of the Navy's East Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 2014年，傅勇升任中国人民解放军南京军区副参谋长。
description.en: In 2014, Fu Yong was promoted to Deputy Chief of Staff of the PLA Nanjing Military Region.

position.en: Deputy Commander of the Ground Force

description.zh-cn: 2016年1月，傅勇出任新成立的中国人民解放军东部战区陆军副司令员。
description.en: In January 2016, Fu Yong became the Deputy Commander of the Ground Force of the newly established PLA Eastern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 伊藤博文于1885年12月22日就任首任内阁总理大臣。
description.en: Itō Hirobumi took office as the first Prime Minister of Japan on December 22, 1885.

description.zh-cn: 片山哲是首位依据《日本国宪法》于1947年5月24日就任的内阁总理大臣。
description.en: Tetsu Katayama was the first Prime Minister to take office under the Constitution of Japan, on May 24, 1947.

description.zh-cn: 安倍晋三是日本宪政史上在任时间最长的内阁总理大臣。
description.en: Shinzo Abe was the longest-serving Prime Minister in the history of constitutional government in Japan.

description.zh-cn: 日本内阁总理大臣的职位是在1885年明治维新期间随着内阁制度的创立而设立的。
description.en: The position of Prime Minister of Japan was established in 1885 during the Meiji Restoration with the creation of the cabinet system.

description.zh-cn: 现行《日本国宪法》将内阁总理大臣的职务正式列入宪法，并赋予其包括任免国务大臣在内的实质性行政权力，使其成为真正的国家行政首长。
description.en: The current Constitution of Japan formally incorporated the office of Prime Minister, granting it substantial executive powers, including the appointment and dismissal of Ministers of State, making it the true head of the nation's administration.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后，在盟军占领日本期间，由驻日盟军总司令部指导制定了新的《日本国宪法》。
description.en: After World War II, during the Allied occupation of Japan, the new Constitution of Japan was drafted under the guidance of the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.

description.zh-cn: 内阁总理大臣由国会全体议员在国会议员中选举产生。
description.en: The Prime Minister is elected by all members of the National Diet from among the Diet members.

description.zh-cn: 内阁总理大臣经国会选出后，由天皇进行象征性的任命。
description.en: After being elected by the National Diet, the Prime Minister is ceremonially appointed by the Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 在职位设立初期及大正民主之前，内阁总理大臣通常由元老向天皇荐举产生。
description.en: In the early days of the office and before the Taishō Democracy, the Prime Minister was typically chosen through recommendations made to the Emperor by the genrō.

description.zh-cn: 军部大臣现役武官制增强了军部的政治影响力，使其可以通过控制陆海军大臣的任命来干预甚至推翻内阁。
description.en: The system of active-duty military ministers enhanced the political influence of the military, allowing it to interfere with or even topple cabinets by controlling the appointment of Army and Navy ministers.

description.zh-cn: 内阁总理大臣是自卫队的最高领导，执掌最高指挥监督权。
description.en: The Prime Minister is the commander-in-chief of the Japan Self-Defense Forces and holds the highest command and supervision authority over them.

description.zh-cn: 内阁总理大臣的主要职责是领导日本内阁。
description.en: The primary responsibility of the Prime Minister is to lead the Cabinet of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 在内阁总理大臣临时代理的指定者中顺位第一。
description.en: First in the order of succession to act as Prime Minister temporarily.

description.zh-cn: 在内阁总理大臣临时代理的指定者中顺位第二。
description.en: Second in the order of succession to act as Prime Minister temporarily.

position.en: Minister for Internal Affairs and Communications

description.zh-cn: 在内阁总理大臣临时代理的指定者中顺位第三。
description.en: Third in the order of succession to act as Prime Minister temporarily.

position.en: Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism

description.zh-cn: 在内阁总理大臣临时代理的指定者中顺位第四。
description.en: Fourth in the order of succession to act as Prime Minister temporarily.

position.en: Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry

description.zh-cn: 在内阁总理大臣临时代理的指定者中顺位第五。
description.en: Fifth in the order of succession to act as Prime Minister temporarily.

description.zh-cn: 高建进是李源潮的夫人。
description.en: Gao Jianjin is the wife of Li Yuanchao.

description.zh-cn: 李海进是高建进的儿子。
description.en: Li Haijin is the son of Gao Jianjin.

description.zh-cn: 高建进于1967年毕业于上海市南洋模范中学。
description.en: Gao Jianjin graduated from Shanghai Nanyang Model High School in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 高建进于1979年毕业于上海音乐学院音乐研究室西方音乐史专业。
description.en: Gao Jianjin graduated from the Western Music History program at the Music Research Department of the Shanghai Conservatory of Music in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 高建进于1979年毕业后留校任教。
description.en: After graduating in 1979, Gao Jianjin stayed at the Shanghai Conservatory of Music to teach.

position.zh-cn: 音乐学系音乐教育教研组长
position.en: Head of the Music Education Teaching and Research Group of the Musicology Department

description.zh-cn: 高建进于1998年出任中央音乐学院音乐学系音乐教育教研组长。
description.en: In 1998, Gao Jianjin became the Head of the Music Education Teaching and Research Group of the Musicology Department at the Central Conservatory of Music.

description.zh-cn: 高建进是南京师范大学特聘教授。
description.en: Gao Jianjin is a distinguished professor at Nanjing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮曾任中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: Li Yuanchao formerly served as a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮曾任中华人民共和国副主席。
description.en: Li Yuanchao formerly served as the Vice President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 黄郛领导的摄政内阁公布修正《清室优待条件》，并将溥仪驱逐出宫。
description.en: The regency cabinet led by Huang Fu announced the revision of the 'Articles of Favorable Treatment for the Qing Imperial House' and expelled Puyi from the palace.

description.zh-cn: 清室善后委员会制定了“故宫博物院临时组织大纲”，直接促成了故宫博物院于1925年10月10日的正式成立。
description.en: The Committee for the Disposition of the Qing Imperial Possessions drafted the 'Temporary Organizational Outline of the Palace Museum,' which directly led to the formal establishment of the museum on October 10, 1925.

description.zh-cn: 为躲避日本侵略，故宫博物院于1933年开始将大批文物南迁，此后又因战事西迁，导致藏品长期流离在外。
description.en: To evade the Japanese invasion, the Palace Museum began relocating a large number of artifacts southward in 1933, and later westward due to the war, causing the collection to be displaced for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 于1948至1949年间，将2972箱南迁文物精品转运至台湾，并最终在台北建立国立故宫博物院。
description.en: Between 1948 and 1949, it transported 2,972 crates of selected artifacts from the southern relocation to Taiwan, eventually establishing the National Palace Museum in Taipei.

description.zh-cn: 在国民政府下令将留平文物菁华运往南京时，时任院长马衡以各种理由推延装箱，使这批文物最终未被运走。
description.en: When the Nationalist government ordered the shipment of selected artifacts remaining in Beiping to Nanjing, then-director Ma Heng used various reasons to delay the packing, resulting in these items not being transported.

description.zh-cn: 于1928年提案废除故宫博物院，并提议变卖其馆藏文物，但该提案最终未能成功。
description.en: In 1928, he proposed to abolish the Palace Museum and sell off its collection, but the proposal was ultimately unsuccessful.

description.zh-cn: 作为古物保管委员会委员长，他坚决反对经亨颐废除故宫的提案，成功保全了故宫博物院。
description.en: As the chairman of the Antiquities Preservation Committee, he strongly opposed Jing Hengyi's proposal to abolish the Palace Museum, thus successfully preserving it.

description.zh-cn: 因文化大革命，中央命令故宫于1966年至1971年闭馆，以保护其免受破坏。
description.en: Due to the Cultural Revolution, the central government ordered the Palace Museum to close from 1966 to 1971 to protect it from destruction.

description.zh-cn: 易培基担任故宫博物院首任院长。
description.en: Yi Peiji served as the first director of the Palace Museum.

description.zh-cn: 马衡长期担任故宫博物院院长，经历了文物南迁和政权更迭等重要时期。
description.en: Ma Heng served as the director of the Palace Museum for a long period, experiencing important events such as the southern relocation of artifacts and the change of government.

description.zh-cn: 王旭东于2019年4月起担任故宫博物院院长。
description.en: Wang Xudong has been the director of the Palace Museum since April 2019.

description.zh-cn: 1950年毕业于路易大帝中学。
description.en: Graduated from Lycée Louis-le-Grand in 1950.

description.zh-cn: 早期曾是法国共产党的支持者，直到1962年。
description.en: Was an early supporter of the French Communist Party until 1962.

description.zh-cn: 在瓦莱里·吉斯卡尔·德斯坦担任总统期间，希拉克首次出任总理。
description.en: Chirac served his first term as Prime Minister during the presidency of Valéry Giscard d'Estaing.

description.zh-cn: 在弗朗索瓦·密特朗担任总统期间，希拉克第二次出任总理，形成了“左右共治”局面。
description.en: Chirac served his second term as Prime Minister during the presidency of François Mitterrand, creating a 'cohabitation'.

description.zh-cn: 在1988年法国总统选举中，希拉克在第二轮投票中败给密特朗。
description.en: In the 1988 French presidential election, Chirac lost to Mitterrand in the second round.

description.zh-cn: 在希拉克担任总统期间，阿兰·朱佩是其任命的第一位总理。
description.en: Alain Juppé was the first Prime Minister appointed by Chirac during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 在希拉克担任总统期间，利昂内尔·若斯潘作为社会党人出任总理，形成“左右共治”。
description.en: During Chirac's presidency, Lionel Jospin, a socialist, served as Prime Minister, leading to a 'cohabitation'.

description.zh-cn: 在希拉克第二任总统期间，让-皮埃尔·拉法兰被任命为总理。
description.en: Jean-Pierre Raffarin was appointed Prime Minister during Chirac's second presidential term.

description.zh-cn: 在希拉克第二任总统期间，多米尼克·德维尔潘被任命为总理。
description.en: Dominique de Villepin was appointed Prime Minister during Chirac's second presidential term.

description.zh-cn: 希拉克是戴高乐主义的追随者，其政治生涯深受戴高乐主义影响。
description.en: Chirac was a follower of Gaullism, and his political career was heavily influenced by it.

description.zh-cn: 希拉克在2003年明确反对美国发动伊拉克战争。
description.en: Chirac explicitly opposed the United States' invasion of Iraq in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 马来西亚首相马哈迪·莫哈末高度评价希拉克，认为他是唯一与第三世界领导人保持密切联系并试图与大国讲道理的第一世界领导人。
description.en: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad paid high tribute to Chirac, considering him the only First World leader who maintained close contact with Third World leaders and tried to reason with major powers.

description.zh-cn: 为展示反对伊拉克战争的团结，希拉克出访马来西亚并会见了时任首相马哈迪·莫哈末。
description.en: To demonstrate solidarity against the Iraq War, Chirac visited Malaysia and met with then-Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad.

description.zh-cn: 美国前总统小布希在其自传中评价希拉克是“喜欢对别国领导人进行说教的人”，反映了两人在伊拉克战争等问题上的紧张关系。
description.en: Former U.S. President George W. Bush described Chirac in his autobiography as someone who "enjoyed lecturing other leaders," reflecting their tense relationship over issues like the Iraq War.

description.zh-cn: 文本中的图片显示希拉克在1999年与时任美国总统比尔·柯林顿会面。
description.en: A picture in the text shows Chirac meeting with then-U.S. President Bill Clinton in 1999.

description.zh-cn: 因在担任巴黎市长期间挪用公款和损害公信力，希拉克于2011年12月15日被法国法院判处两年有期徒刑、缓期执行。
description.en: On December 15, 2011, Chirac was convicted by a French court and given a two-year suspended prison sentence for misuse of public funds and abuse of trust during his time as mayor of Paris.

description.zh-cn: 希拉克在1992年关于《马斯特里赫特条约》的全民公投中投了赞成票。
description.en: Chirac voted in favor of the Maastricht Treaty in the 1992 referendum.

description.zh-cn: 1995年下令执行法国最后一批核试验后，希拉克于1996年推动法国加入《全面禁止核试验条约》。
description.en: After ordering France's final series of nuclear tests in 1995, Chirac led France to join the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王于1930年2月4日与德川庆喜的孙女喜久子结婚。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito married Kikuko, the granddaughter of Tokugawa Yoshinobu, on February 4, 1930.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王是贞明皇后的第三皇子。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito was the third son of Empress Teimei.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王是昭和天皇的弟弟。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito was the younger brother of Emperor Shōwa.

description.zh-cn: 宣仁亲王妃喜久子是德川庆喜的孙女。
description.en: Princess Kikuko was the granddaughter of Tokugawa Yoshinobu.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王于1905年1月3日出生于青山东宫御所。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito was born on January 3, 1905, at the Aoyama Tōgū Palace.

description.zh-cn: 有鉴于有栖川宫威仁亲王等人的功绩，大正天皇于1913年册封其三皇子宣仁亲王为高松宫，以继承有栖川宫的祭祀。
description.en: In recognition of the merits of Prince Arisugawa Takehito and others, Emperor Taishō created the Takamatsu-no-miya for his third son, Prince Nobuhito, in 1913, to succeed the rites of the Arisugawa-no-miya.

description.zh-cn: 宣仁亲王于1913年被赐立为高松宫，成为该宫家的第一代当主。
description.en: Prince Nobuhito was established as the Prince Takamatsu in 1913, becoming the first head of this princely house.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王曾加入大日本帝国海军，最高军阶为海军大佐。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito joined the Imperial Japanese Navy, reaching the highest rank of Captain.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王于1920年进入海军兵学校预科，1924年毕业。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito entered the preparatory course of the Imperial Japanese Naval Academy in 1920 and graduated in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王于1934年进入海军大学校，1936年毕业。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito entered the Naval War College in 1934 and graduated in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王于1945年7月至1948年7月担任日本红十字会会长。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito served as the president of the Japanese Red Cross Society from July 1945 to July 1948.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王反对东条英机推动战争的政策，甚至一度考虑与亲信合作刺杀他。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito opposed Hideki Tojo's policy of promoting war and even considered assassinating him with his confidants.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王反对时任海军大臣嶋田繁太郎的主战立场，并频密主张其辞职。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito opposed the pro-war stance of then-Navy Minister Shigetarō Shimada and frequently advocated for his resignation.

description.zh-cn: 1944年夏前后，因在战争政策上公然唱反调，高松宫宣仁亲王与长兄昭和天皇意见持续相左，导致二人关系恶化。
description.en: Around the summer of 1944, due to his public opposition to war policies, Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito had ongoing disagreements with his elder brother, Emperor Shōwa, leading to a deterioration in their relationship.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王与同为皇族和平派的东久迩宫稔彦王等人组成反对扩大战争联盟。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito, along with fellow imperial peace faction member Prince Higashikuni Naruhiko and others, formed an alliance to oppose the expansion of the war.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王与弟弟、同为皇族和平派的三笠宫崇仁亲王等人组成反对扩大战争联盟。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito, along with his younger brother and fellow imperial peace faction member Prince Mikasa Takahito and others, formed an alliance to oppose the expansion of the war.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王与前首相米内光政等海军左派人物组成反对扩大战争联盟。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito, along with former Prime Minister Mitsumasa Yonai and other leftist figures in the navy, formed an alliance to oppose the expansion of the war.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王与前首相近卫文麿等爱好和平的政治人物组成反对扩大战争联盟。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito, along with former Prime Minister Fumimaro Konoe and other peace-loving politicians, formed an alliance to oppose the expansion of the war.

description.zh-cn: 高松宫宣仁亲王与战后担任首相的吉田茂等爱好和平的政治人物组成反对扩大战争联盟。
description.en: Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito, along with Shigeru Yoshida, who later became prime minister, and other peace-loving politicians, formed an alliance to oppose the expansion of the war.

description.zh-cn: 在中途岛战役战败后，高松宫宣仁亲王开始更加积极地努力结束战争。
description.en: After the defeat in the Battle of Midway, Prince Takamatsu Nobuhito began to work more actively to end the war.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国冶金工业部是中华人民共和国国务院的上级机构为国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry was a constituent department under its superior body, the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国冶金工业部是国务院的组成部门之一。
description.en: The Ministry of Metallurgical Industry was one of the constituent departments of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 1998年3月，第九届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过《关于国务院机构改革方案的决定》，撤销了冶金工业部。
description.en: In March 1998, the First Session of the 9th National People's Congress passed the 'Decision on the Plan for the Restructuring of the State Council', abolishing the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1993年4月19日，国家黄金管理局并入冶金工业部，成为其内设职能局。
description.en: On April 19, 1993, the State Gold Administration Bureau was merged into the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry, becoming its internal functional bureau.

description.zh-cn: 1983年，冶金工业部的有色金属局改制为直属国务院的中国有色金属工业总公司。
description.en: In 1983, the Nonferrous Metals Bureau of the Ministry of Metallurgical Industry was reorganized into the China National Non-ferrous Metals Industry Corporation, directly under the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 埃马纽埃尔·马克龙于2017年5月14日就任法兰西共和国总统。
description.en: Emmanuel Macron took office as President of the French Republic on May 14, 2017.

description.zh-cn: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼是法兰西共和国总理。
description.en: Sébastien Lecornu is the Prime Minister of the French Republic.

description.zh-cn: 热拉尔·拉尔谢担任法国参议院议长。
description.en: Gérard Larcher serves as the President of the French Senate.

description.zh-cn: 路易十四撕毁《南特敕令》，取消了雨格诺派的信仰自由。
description.en: Louis XIV revoked the Edict of Nantes, abolishing the religious freedom of the Huguenots.

description.zh-cn: 法国大革命推翻了旧制度。
description.en: The French Revolution overthrew the Ancien Régime.

description.zh-cn: 拿破仑战争结束后，法兰西第一帝国解体。
description.en: After the Napoleonic Wars, the First French Empire was dissolved.

description.zh-cn: 尽管法国在第一次世界大战中战胜，但战争损耗极为惨重。
description.en: Although France was victorious in World War I, the war resulted in extremely heavy losses.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次世界大战中，法国于1940年被轴心国占领。
description.en: During World War II, France was occupied by the Axis powers in 1940.

description.zh-cn: 盟军在诺曼底登陆，开启了解放法国的进程。
description.en: The Allied landings in Normandy initiated the process of liberating France.

description.zh-cn: 自由法国发动的龙骑兵行动解放了法国南部。
description.en: Operation Dragoon, launched by the Free French forces, liberated the south of France.

description.zh-cn: 法国解放后，戴高乐成立法兰西共和国临时政府接管法国本土。
description.en: After the liberation of France, de Gaulle established the Provisional Government of the French Republic to take control of mainland France.

description.zh-cn: 法国在第一次印度支那战争中失利，动摇了其殖民统治。
description.en: France's defeat in the First Indochina War shook its colonial rule.

description.zh-cn: 因阿尔及利亚战争导致的政局动荡，戴高乐得以重返政坛并建立法兰西第五共和国。
description.en: The political instability caused by the Algerian War allowed de Gaulle to return to power and establish the French Fifth Republic.

description.zh-cn: 通过1963年签署的《爱丽舍条约》，法国与西德建立了紧密的友好合作关系，推动了法德和解。
description.en: Through the Élysée Treaty signed in 1963, France and West Germany established a close friendly and cooperative relationship, promoting Franco-German reconciliation.

description.zh-cn: 为激励和保护法国人的科学研究精神，路易十四设立法国科学院。
description.en: To encourage and protect the spirit of French scientific research, Louis XIV established the French Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 卢米埃兄弟对电影的发明与发展有着重大的贡献，被视为电影之父。
description.en: The Lumière brothers made significant contributions to the invention and development of cinema and are considered the fathers of film.

description.zh-cn: 《社会契约论》中主张的主权在民思想是现代议会共和制民主制度的基石。
description.en: The idea of popular sovereignty advocated in 'The Social Contract' is the cornerstone of modern parliamentary republican democratic systems.

description.zh-cn: 法国是联合国的创始会员国之一。
description.en: France is one of the founding members of the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 日本提出的《二十一条》及其部分被北洋政府接受，被视为国耻，在中国民众中积累了强烈的反日和反政府情绪，为五四运动的爆发提供了社会基础。
description.en: Japan's 'Twenty-One Demands' and their partial acceptance by the Beiyang government were seen as a national humiliation, accumulating strong anti-Japanese and anti-government sentiment among the Chinese public, which provided the social foundation for the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 作为巴黎和会中国代表团顾问，梁启超从巴黎致电林长民等人，通报外交失败的消息，此举对点燃五四运动起了关键作用。
description.en: As an advisor to the Chinese delegation at the Paris Peace Conference, Liang Qichao sent a telegram from Paris to Lin Changmin and others, reporting the diplomatic failure. This act played a key role in igniting the May Fourth Movement.

description.zh-cn: 胡适认为五四运动将一个单纯的文化运动转变为政治运动，是一项“历史性的政治干扰”，阻碍了为中国建立非政治文化和思想基础的努力。
description.en: Hu Shih believed that the May Fourth Movement transformed a purely cultural movement into a political one, which he described as a 'historical political interference' that hindered efforts to build a non-political cultural and intellectual foundation for China.

description.zh-cn: 王雁南的丈夫是王志华。
description.en: Wang Yannan's husband is Wang Zhihua.

description.zh-cn: 王雁南于1954年出生于广州。
description.en: Wang Yannan was born in Guangzhou in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 1977年毕业于广州外语学院（现广东外语外贸大学）英语系。
description.en: Graduated from the English Department of Guangzhou Institute of Foreign Languages (now Guangdong University of Foreign Studies) in 1977.

description.zh-cn: 1977年至1981年，在国防部外事局（现中央军事委员会国际军事合作办公室）担任英文翻译。
description.en: From 1977 to 1981, she worked as an English translator at the Foreign Affairs Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense (now the Office for International Military Cooperation of the Central Military Commission).

description.zh-cn: 1981年至1983年，在美国杨百翰大学夏威夷分校就读酒店管理专业。
description.en: From 1981 to 1983, she studied Hotel Management at Brigham Young University–Hawaii in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 1983年回国后，在北京长城饭店工作9年，并被提升为副总经理。
description.en: After returning to China in 1983, she worked at the Great Wall Hotel in Beijing for 9 years and was promoted to Deputy General Manager.

description.zh-cn: 1993年，与陈东升合伙成立了中国嘉德国际拍卖有限公司。
description.en: In 1993, she co-founded China Guardian Auctions Co., Ltd. with Chen Dongsheng.

description.zh-cn: 1993年，与王雁南合伙成立了中国嘉德国际拍卖有限公司。
description.en: In 1993, he co-founded China Guardian Auctions Co., Ltd. with Wang Yannan.

description.zh-cn: 王雁南曾担任中国嘉德国际拍卖有限公司的董事长。
description.en: Wang Yannan served as the chairperson of China Guardian Auctions Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 王雁南与陈东升于1993年合伙成立了中国嘉德国际拍卖有限公司。
description.en: Wang Yannan and Chen Dongsheng partnered in 1993 to establish China Guardian Auctions Co., Ltd.

description.zh-cn: 高更是高瑛的曾祖父。
description.en: Gao Geng is Gao Ying's great-grandfather.

description.zh-cn: 高侃是高瑛的兄长。
description.en: Gao Kan is Gao Ying's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 高琦是高瑛的兄长。
description.en: Gao Qi is Gao Ying's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 高瑛的籍贯为浙江台州府黄岩县。
description.en: Gao Ying's ancestral home was Huangyan County, Taizhou Prefecture, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 高瑛为国子生出身。
description.en: Gao Ying was a student of the Guozijian (Imperial College).

description.zh-cn: 高瑛是明朝的一位政治人物。
description.en: Gao Ying was a political figure in the Ming Dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 高瑛于1448年进士及第后授南京刑部主事，后于1458年升署员外郎，1462年实授郎中。
description.en: After passing the imperial examination in 1448, Gao Ying was appointed Secretary of the Ministry of Justice in Nanjing. He was promoted to acting Assistant Director in 1458 and officially appointed Director in 1462.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党于1927年5月20日创立中央党务学校，后于1929年更名为中央政治学校，旨在培养党务与政治干部。
description.en: The Kuomintang founded the Central Party Affairs School on May 20, 1927, which was later renamed the Central Political School in 1929, with the aim of training party and political cadres.

description.zh-cn: 三民主义青年团于1944年创立中央干部学校，以培养青年干部。
description.en: The Three Principles of the People Youth Corps founded the Central Cadre School in 1944 to train youth cadres.

description.zh-cn: 1944年中央干部学校成立时，蒋经国担任教育长。
description.en: When the Central Cadre School was established in 1944, Chiang Ching-kuo served as its Dean of Education.

description.zh-cn: 1947年学校改组为国立政治大学后，改隶中华民国教育部。
description.en: After its reorganization into National Chengchi University in 1947, the university came under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 因第二次国共内战，国立政治大学于1949年在大陆停止办学。
description.en: Due to the Chinese Civil War, National Chengchi University ceased its operations on the mainland in 1949.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国政府迁台后，推动了国立政治大学于1954年在台湾复校。
description.en: After the government of the Republic of China retreated to Taiwan, it facilitated the re-establishment of National Chengchi University in Taiwan in 1954.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉曾于国立政治大学任教。
description.en: Lee Teng-hui once taught at National Chengchi University.

description.zh-cn: 马英九曾于国立政治大学任教。
description.en: Ma Ying-jeou once taught at National Chengchi University.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文曾于国立政治大学任教。
description.en: Tsai Ing-wen once taught at National Chengchi University.

description.zh-cn: 李元簇为国立政治大学校友。
description.en: Li Yuan-tsu is an alumnus of National Chengchi University.

description.zh-cn: 李元簇于1973年至1977年担任国立政治大学校长。
description.en: Li Yuan-tsu served as the President of National Chengchi University from 1973 to 1977.

description.zh-cn: 萧万长为国立政治大学校友。
description.en: Vincent Siew is an alumnus of National Chengchi University.

description.zh-cn: 顾毓琇于1947年至1949年担任国立政治大学在大陆时期的首任专任校长。
description.en: Y. H. Ku served as the first full-time president of National Chengchi University during its mainland period from 1947 to 1949.

description.zh-cn: 陈大齐于1955年至1959年担任国立政治大学在台复校后的首任校长。
description.en: Chen Daqi served as the first president of National Chengchi University after its re-establishment in Taiwan, from 1955 to 1959.

description.zh-cn: 2021年，国立政治大学成为台湾联合大学系统成员校。
description.en: In 2021, National Chengchi University became a member of the University System of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1943年，中央政治学校与美国哥伦比亚大学普利策新闻学院合办中央政治学校新闻学院。
description.en: In 1943, the Central Political School collaborated with Columbia University's Pulitzer School of Journalism to establish the Central Political School's Journalism College.

description.zh-cn: 海军省于1872年2月与陆军省一同从兵部省独立出来，导致兵部省被分拆和废除。
description.en: The Ministry of the Navy, along with the Ministry of the Army, was established in February 1872 as an independent entity from the Ministry of War, leading to the latter's division and abolition.

description.zh-cn: 第一复员省与第二复员省合并为复员厅。
description.en: The First Demobilization Ministry merged with the Second Demobilization Ministry to form the Demobilization Agency.

description.zh-cn: 第二复员省与第一复员省合并为复员厅。
description.en: The Second Demobilization Ministry merged with the First Demobilization Ministry to form the Demobilization Agency.

description.zh-cn: 因二个师团增设问题，时任陆军大臣上原勇作单独辞职，导致第二次西园寺内阁总辞职。
description.en: Over the issue of adding two army divisions, Minister of the Army Uehara Yūsaku resigned, leading to the collapse of the Second Saionji Cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 时任陆军大臣畑俊六以“陆军总意”为由单独辞职，并拒绝推荐继任者，导致米内内阁总辞职。
description.en: Minister of the Army Hata Shunroku resigned citing the 'consensus of the Army' and refused to recommend a successor, causing the collapse of the Yonai Cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 在终战诏书发布后，时任陆军大臣阿南惟几于1945年8月15日凌晨自杀。
description.en: Following the issuance of the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, Minister of the Army Anami Korechika committed suicide in the early morning of August 15, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 时任陆军大臣川岛义之负责处理二二六事件。
description.en: As the Minister of the Army at the time, Kawashima Yoshiyuki was responsible for handling the February 26 Incident.

description.zh-cn: 慧可于487年出生于北魏的虎牢。
description.en: Huike was born in Hulao, Northern Wei, in 487.

description.zh-cn: 菩提达摩将心法传给慧可，立其为禅宗二祖。
description.en: Bodhidharma transmitted the mind-dharma to Huike, establishing him as the second patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 慧可与同为达摩弟子的昙林友谊深厚。
description.en: Huike had a deep friendship with Tanlin, who was also a disciple of Bodhidharma.

description.zh-cn: 在昙林遇贼被砍断一臂后，慧可救护了他。
description.en: After Tanlin was attacked by bandits and had an arm severed, Huike came to his rescue.

description.zh-cn: 因北周武帝毁佛，慧可被迫中断在邺都的传法，隐居于舒州皖公山。
description.en: Due to the persecution of Buddhism by Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, Huike was forced to suspend his teachings in Yedu and went into seclusion on Mount Wangong in Shuzhou.

description.zh-cn: 慧可于577年在皖公山剃度僧璨出家，并传以心法，立其为禅宗三祖。
description.en: In 577, at Mount Wangong, Huike ordained Sengcan as a monk, transmitted the mind-dharma to him, and established him as the third patriarch of Zen.

description.zh-cn: 北周宣帝于579年即位后复兴佛法，结束了建德毁佛运动。
description.en: After ascending the throne in 579, Emperor Xuan of Northern Zhou revived Buddhism, ending the Jiande Persecution.

description.zh-cn: 唐德宗追谥慧可为“大弘禅师”。
description.en: Emperor Dezong of Tang posthumously honored Huike with the title 'Grand Master Dahong'.

description.zh-cn: 北宋画家石恪绘制了慧可的肖像画，促进了其形象的流传。
description.en: The Northern Song painter Shi Ke created a portrait of Huike, which helped to popularize his image.

description.zh-cn: 慧可被尊为中国禅宗的第二代祖师。
description.en: Huike is revered as the second patriarch of Chinese Zen Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 查尔斯三世在2024年大选后正式任命基尔·斯塔默为英国首相。
description.en: Charles III formally appointed Keir Starmer as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom following the 2024 general election.

position.zh-cn: 影子脱离欧洲联盟事务大臣
position.en: Shadow Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union

description.zh-cn: 在杰瑞米·柯宾领导的影子内阁中担任影子脱欧事务大臣。
description.en: Served as the Shadow Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union in Jeremy Corbyn's shadow cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 作为反对党领袖，斯塔默对约翰逊政府提出批评，并在2022年7月的政府危机期间提出不信任投票。
description.en: As Leader of the Opposition, Starmer criticized the Johnson government and tabled a no-confidence motion during the July 2022 government crisis.

description.zh-cn: 作为反对党领袖，斯塔默对特拉斯政府的迷你预算案等政策提出批评。
description.en: As Leader of the Opposition, Starmer criticized the Truss government's policies, including the mini-budget.

description.zh-cn: 作为首相，斯塔默谴责骚乱为“极右翼暴行”，并下令组建特别职务警队以应对。
description.en: As Prime Minister, Starmer condemned the riots as 'far-right thuggery' and ordered the formation of a specialist police force to counter them.

description.zh-cn: 基尔·斯塔默的双亲是工党支持者，并以工党第一任党魁凯尔·哈第的名字为他命名。
description.en: Keir Starmer's parents were Labour supporters and named him after Keir Hardie, the first leader of the party.

description.zh-cn: 1992年9月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in September 1992.

description.zh-cn: 在1992年9月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Public Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in September 1992.

description.zh-cn: 1992年9月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in September 1992.

description.zh-cn: 在1992年9月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部常务副部长（正部长级）。
description.en: Served as the Executive Vice Minister of Public Security (ministerial level) at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in September 1992.

description.zh-cn: 1992年9月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in September 1992.

description.zh-cn: 在1992年9月授予总警监警衔时，担任国家安全部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of State Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in September 1992.

description.zh-cn: 1998年3月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in March 1998.

description.zh-cn: 在1998年3月授予总警监警衔时，担任国家安全部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of State Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in March 1998.

description.zh-cn: 2002年12月被授予总警监警衔，后因违纪违法被处理。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in December 2002, and was later disciplined for violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 在2002年12月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Public Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in December 2002.

description.zh-cn: 2014年12月，周永康因严重违纪违法被开除党籍，其政治生涯终结。
description.en: In December 2014, Zhou Yongkang was expelled from the party for serious violations of discipline and law, ending his political career.

description.zh-cn: 2007年10月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in October 2007.

description.zh-cn: 在2007年10月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Public Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in October 2007.

description.zh-cn: 2008年晋升为总警监警衔。
description.en: Was promoted to the rank of Commissioner General in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 在2008年晋升总警监警衔时，担任国家安全部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of State Security at the time of being promoted to the rank of Commissioner General in 2008.

description.zh-cn: 2012年12月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in December 2012.

description.zh-cn: 在2012年12月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Public Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in December 2012.

description.zh-cn: 2016年11月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in November 2016.

description.zh-cn: 2017年11月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in November 2017.

description.zh-cn: 在2017年11月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Public Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in November 2017.

description.zh-cn: 2022年6月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in June 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年6月授予总警监警衔时，担任公安部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of Public Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in June 2022.

description.zh-cn: 2022年10月被授予总警监警衔。
description.en: Was awarded the rank of Commissioner General in October 2022.

description.zh-cn: 在2022年10月授予总警监警衔时，担任国家安全部部长。
description.en: Served as the Minister of State Security at the time of being awarded the rank of Commissioner General in October 2022.

description.zh-cn: 多次合作表演春节联欢晚会小品，如《卖拐》三部曲。
description.en: Collaborated multiple times on Spring Festival Gala sketches, such as the 'Selling Crutches' trilogy.

description.zh-cn: 事件发生后，赵本山与薄熙来、王立军等涉事官员的合照被大量曝光，引发外界对其政治关系的猜测，导致其事业受到负面影响。
description.en: After the incident, photos of Zhao Benshan with involved officials like Bo Xilai and Wang Lijun were widely circulated, sparking speculation about his political connections and negatively impacting his career.

description.zh-cn: 杨永信是临沂市第四人民医院的副院长，并在该院工作超过30年。
description.en: Yang Yongxin was the vice president of Linyi Fourth People's Hospital and worked there for over 30 years.

description.zh-cn: 杨永信是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Yang Yongxin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨永信后获得济宁医学院本科学历及学士学位。
description.en: Yang Yongxin later obtained a bachelor's degree from Jining Medical University.

description.zh-cn: 杨永信出生于山东省临沂市。
description.en: Yang Yongxin was born in Linyi, Shandong.

description.zh-cn: 2008年2月，山东省卫生厅授予杨永信首届“感动山东健康卫士”称号并记其二等功。
description.en: In February 2008, the Shandong Provincial Health Department awarded Yang Yongxin the title of 'Touching Shandong Health Guardian' and a second-class merit.

description.zh-cn: 2009年2月，杨永信成为享受国务院政府特殊津贴的专家。
description.en: In February 2009, Yang Yongxin became an expert who enjoys the State Council Special Allowance.

description.zh-cn: 该频道《第一线》栏目于2008年7月2日播出《战网魔》，以赞扬的口吻报道杨永信，使其声名大噪。
description.en: On July 2, 2008, the channel's program 'The Front Line' aired 'War on Internet Demons', which reported on Yang Yongxin in a laudatory tone, making him famous.

description.zh-cn: 2009年7月13日，卫生部发文，因安全性、有效性尚不确切，叫停将电刺激（或电休克）治疗用于“网瘾”的临床应用。
description.en: On July 13, 2009, the Ministry of Health issued a notice to halt the clinical application of electrostimulation (or electroconvulsive) therapy for 'internet addiction' due to uncertain safety and efficacy.

description.zh-cn: 卫生部叫停电击疗法，直接禁止了杨永信网戒中心的核心治疗手段，对其运作造成重大打击。
description.en: The Ministry of Health's ban on electroshock therapy directly prohibited the core treatment method of Yang Yongxin's center, dealing a significant blow to his operations.

description.zh-cn: 方舟子发文指出，杨永信使用的电击疗法损害记忆和认知功能，并非国际医学界的推荐方法。
description.en: Fang Zhouzi published an article stating that the electroshock therapy used by Yang Yongxin damages memory and cognitive functions and is not a recommended method by the international medical community.

description.zh-cn: 该报于2009年5月刊文《比网瘾更可怕的是什么》，质疑杨永信的治疗目的并非戒网瘾，而是戒除“不听话”。
description.en: In May 2009, the newspaper published an article titled 'What's Scarier Than Internet Addiction', questioning whether Yang Yongxin's goal was to treat 'disobedience' rather than internet addiction.

description.zh-cn: 杨永信是使用电击法治疗网络成瘾症最知名的实践者和推广者，他将其称为“醒脑治疗”。
description.en: Yang Yongxin was the most well-known practitioner and promoter of using electroconvulsive therapy for internet addiction, which he called 'brain-awakening therapy'.

description.zh-cn: 德国总理是德国内阁的成员和领导者。
description.en: The German Chancellor is a member and leader of the Cabinet of Germany.

description.zh-cn: 德国总理通常是德国联邦议院的成员。
description.en: The German Chancellor is usually a member of the Bundestag.

description.zh-cn: 德国总理由德国联邦议院选举产生。
description.en: The German Chancellor is elected by the Bundestag.

description.zh-cn: 德国总统根据德国联邦议院的投票结果任命总理。
description.en: The President of Germany appoints the Chancellor based on the vote of the Bundestag.

description.zh-cn: 德国副总理是总理的副手。
description.en: The Vice Chancellor of Germany is the deputy to the Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 《德意志联邦共和国基本法》作为宪法文件，确立了联邦总理的职位。
description.en: The Basic Law for the Federal Republic of Germany, as the constitutional document, established the office of the Federal Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 时任魏玛共和国总统的保罗·冯·兴登堡任命阿道夫·希特勒为帝国总理。
description.en: Paul von Hindenburg, then President of the Weimar Republic, appointed Adolf Hitler as Reich Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 根据希特勒的政治遗嘱，约瑟夫·戈培尔被指定为其帝国总理的继任者。
description.en: According to Hitler's political testament, Joseph Goebbels was designated as his successor for the office of Reich Chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 根据希特勒的政治遗嘱，卡尔·邓尼茨被指定为其帝国总统的继任者。
description.en: According to Hitler's political testament, Karl Dönitz was designated as his successor for the office of Reich President.

description.zh-cn: 在戈培尔自杀后，总统卡尔·邓尼茨任命科洛希克出任临时政府（弗伦斯堡政府）的总理。
description.en: After Goebbels' suicide, President Karl Dönitz appointed Krosigk as the Chancellor of the provisional government (Flensburg Government).

description.zh-cn: 中央人民政府于1949年12月任命中南军政委员会主席、副主席和委员。
description.en: The Central People's Government appointed the chairman, vice-chairmen, and members of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee in December 1949.

description.zh-cn: 中南军政委员会成立后，经中央人民政府委员会批准，撤销了中原临时人民政府。
description.en: After the establishment of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee, the Central Plains Provisional People's Government was abolished with the approval of the Central People's Government Council.

description.zh-cn: 中南军政委员会是中央人民政府在中华人民共和国成立初期设立的大行政区军政委员会之一。
description.en: The Central and Southern Military and Political Committee was one of the military and political committees of the greater administrative areas established by the Central People's Government in the early days of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中南军政委员会接受中国共产党中央中南局的领导。
description.en: The Central and Southern Military and Political Committee was under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee's Central and Southern Bureau.

description.zh-cn: 自1950年8月起，因林彪病赴北京，邓子恢任中南军政委员会代主席。
description.en: Since August 1950, Deng Zihui served as the Acting Chairman of the Central and Southern Military and Political Committee after Lin Biao went to Beijing due to illness.

description.zh-cn: 2000年5月起，杭州电子科技大学（时称杭州电子工业学院）实行省部共建、以省管为主的管理体制。
description.en: Since May 2000, Hangzhou Dianzi University (then Hangzhou Institute of Electronic Engineering) has been under a management system of joint construction by the province and the ministry, with the province taking the primary role.

description.zh-cn: 杭州电子科技大学是浙江省人民政府与国家国防科技工业局共建高校。
description.en: Hangzhou Dianzi University is jointly constructed by the Zhejiang Provincial People's Government and the State Administration for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defence.

description.zh-cn: 杭州电子科技大学信息工程学院是杭州电子科技大学举办的独立学院。
description.en: Information Engineering School of Hangzhou Dianzi University is an independent college run by Hangzhou Dianzi University.

description.zh-cn: 中国西昌卫星发射中心隶属于中国人民解放军军事航天部队。
description.en: The Xichang Satellite Launch Center is subordinate to the People's Liberation Army Aerospace Force.

description.zh-cn: 2015年底，在深化国防和军队改革中，西昌卫星发射中心由中国人民解放军总装备部转隶新组建的中国人民解放军战略支援部队。
description.en: At the end of 2015, during the reform of national defense and the military, the Xichang Satellite Launch Center was transferred from the PLA General Armaments Department to the newly formed PLA Strategic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 在2015年军队改革前，西昌卫星发射中心隶属于中国人民解放军总装备部。
description.en: Before the 2015 military reform, the Xichang Satellite Launch Center was subordinate to the PLA General Armaments Department.

description.zh-cn: 中国文昌航天发射场由西昌卫星发射中心负责建设、管理和使用。
description.en: The Wenchang Space Launch Site is constructed, managed, and used by the Xichang Satellite Launch Center.

description.zh-cn: 西昌卫星发射中心最初是为了“曙光一号”载人航天计划（714工程）而选址建设的。
description.en: The Xichang Satellite Launch Center was originally selected and built for the Shuguang manned space program (Project 714).

description.zh-cn: 考虑到日益恶化的中苏关系，中国决定在内陆三线地区选址建设航天发射场，促成了西昌卫星发射中心的建立。
description.en: Considering the deteriorating Sino-Soviet relations, China decided to select a site for a space launch center in the inland 'Third Front' region, which led to the establishment of the Xichang Satellite Launch Center.

description.zh-cn: 1970年6月，时任第二十训练基地司令员李福泽带领工作人员踏勘选定冕宁县为西昌卫星发射中心的场址。
description.en: In June 1970, Li Fuze, then commander of the 20th Training Base, led a team to survey and select Mianning County as the site for the Xichang Satellite Launch Center.

description.zh-cn: 为准备嫦娥探月工程的发射任务，西昌卫星发射中心的三号发射塔于2006年8月开始被重建。
description.en: In preparation for the launch missions of the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program, the No. 3 launch tower at the Xichang Satellite Launch Center was rebuilt starting in August 2006.

description.zh-cn: 黄圣依与杨子于2007年结婚，并于2025年证实离婚。
description.en: Huang Shengyi married Yang Zi in 2007 and their divorce was confirmed in 2025.

description.zh-cn: 杨子与前妻陶虹于2004年离婚。
description.en: Yang Zi divorced his ex-wife Tao Hong in 2004.

description.zh-cn: 周星驰在电影《功夫》中启用黄圣依为女主角，使其一举成名。
description.en: Stephen Chow cast Huang Shengyi as the female lead in 'Kung Fu Hustle', which catapulted her to fame.

description.zh-cn: 黄圣依因出演《功夫》签约星辉公司，后于2005年开始解约官司，2007年正式解约。
description.en: Huang Shengyi signed with Star Overseas after starring in 'Kung Fu Hustle', started legal proceedings to terminate the contract in 2005, and officially left in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 因私下为《男人装》杂志拍摄性感封面，黄圣依遭公司雪藏，随后她单方面宣布解约，双方矛盾激化并对簿公堂。
description.en: After she posed for a sexy photoshoot for 'For Him Magazine' without permission, the company shelved her. She then unilaterally announced the termination of her contract, leading to an escalated conflict and lawsuits.

description.zh-cn: 在与黄圣依发生合约纠纷后，星辉公司对其采取了封杀措施。
description.en: After the contract dispute with Huang Shengyi arose, Star Overseas Ltd. took measures to blacklist her.

description.zh-cn: 参演《功夫》使黄圣依一炮而红，成为万众瞩目的“星女郎”。
description.en: Starring in 'Kung Fu Hustle' made Huang Shengyi an instant star, becoming a famous 'Sing Girl'.

description.zh-cn: 在黄圣依与星辉公司解约期间，杨子为其提供支持和策划，并在之后与其展开全面商业合作。
description.en: During Huang Shengyi's contract dispute with Star Overseas, Yang Zi provided support and strategy, and later launched a full-scale business partnership with her.
