description.zh-cn: 腾讯网于2009年4月发起“80后新生代娱乐大明星”评选，评选出新“四小花旦”。
description.en: In April 2009, Tencent launched a poll for 'Post-80s New Generation Entertainment Superstars', which selected the new 'Four Dan Actresses'.

description.zh-cn: 因2003年非典疫情，黄圣依从北京回到上海，从而偶然获得了参加《功夫》演员甄选的机会。
description.en: Due to the 2003 SARS outbreak, Huang Shengyi returned to Shanghai from Beijing, which led to her serendipitous opportunity to audition for 'Kung Fu Hustle'.

description.zh-cn: 王镇恒是浙江温州人。
description.en: Wang Zhenheng was from Wenzhou, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 曾任安徽农学院党委书记、教授。
description.en: Served as Party Secretary and professor at Anhui Agricultural College.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“中国共产党党员”可知其党员身份。
description.en: Identified as a party member based on the Wikipedia category 'Communist Party of China members'.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“复旦大学校友”可知其校友身份。
description.en: Identified as an alumnus based on the Wikipedia category 'Fudan University alumni'.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类“国务院学位委员会第二届学科评议组成员”可知其成员身份。
description.en: Identified as a member based on the Wikipedia category 'Members of the 2nd Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council'.

degree.en: Bachelor of Medicine, Master of Pharmacology

description.zh-cn: 1986年于山东医科大学获医学学士学位，1989年获药理学硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from Shandong Medical University with a bachelor's degree in medicine in 1986 and a master's degree in pharmacology in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 1997年毕业于日本东京大学药学部，获药学博士学位。
description.en: Graduated from the Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences at the University of Tokyo, Japan, with a Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences in 1997.

description.zh-cn: 耿美玉的团队声称成功研发了治疗阿尔茨海默症的新药“九期一”。
description.en: Geng Meiyu's team claimed to have successfully developed 'GV-971', a new drug for Alzheimer's disease.

description.zh-cn: PubPeer网站对耿美玉课题组发表的4篇论文发出质疑，认为存在图片不当裁剪、一图多用等问题。
description.en: The PubPeer website raised questions about four papers published by Geng Meiyu's research group, suggesting issues such as improper image cropping and reusing images.

description.zh-cn: 2019年11月29日，饶毅实名举报耿美玉等人论文造假，称其文章“不造假是不可能的”。
description.en: On November 29, 2019, Rao Yi publicly reported Geng Meiyu and others for academic fraud, stating that it was 'impossible for her papers not to be fraudulent'.

description.zh-cn: 2019年11月29日，饶毅实名举报李红良、裴钢、耿美玉造假。
description.en: On November 29, 2019, Rao Yi publicly reported Li Hongliang, Pei Gang, and Geng Meiyu for fraud.

description.zh-cn: 2019年11月29日，饶毅实名举报李红良、裴钢、耿美玉造假。
description.en: On November 29, 2019, Rao Yi publicly reported Li Hongliang, Pei Gang, and Geng Meiyu for fraud.

description.zh-cn: 2021年1月21日，中华人民共和国科技部发布调查结论，称耿美玉的论文未发现有造假，但存在“图片误用”。此结论为耿美玉澄清了最严重的造假指控。
description.en: On January 21, 2021, the Ministry of Science and Technology of the People's Republic of China released its investigation findings, stating that no fraud was found in Geng Meiyu's papers, but there was 'image misuse'. This conclusion cleared Geng Meiyu of the most serious allegations of fraud.

description.zh-cn: 耿美玉是“曹雪涛等人论文调查事件”中被调查的核心人物之一，该事件对其学术声誉造成了负面影响。
description.en: Geng Meiyu was one of the key figures investigated in the 'Investigation into academic misconduct allegations against Cao Xuetao and others', and the event had a negative impact on her academic reputation.

description.zh-cn: 刘琦自2021年10月起担任临湘市人民政府市长。
description.en: Liu Qi has served as the Mayor of the Linxiang Municipal People's Government since October 2021.

description.zh-cn: 龚卫国于2011年12月至2015年4月期间担任临湘市人民政府市长。
description.en: Gong Weiguo served as the Mayor of the Linxiang Municipal People's Government from December 2011 to April 2015.

description.zh-cn: 根据Infobox信息，临湘市人民政府的业务上级机构是岳阳市人民政府。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior business authority of the Linxiang Municipal People's Government is the Yueyang Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 在湖滨中学相识。
description.en: Met at Lakeside School.

description.zh-cn: 比尔·盖茨辞去微软董事长后，作为技术顾问协助新任首席执行官萨帝亚·纳德拉。
description.en: After stepping down as Microsoft's chairman, Bill Gates served as a technology advisor to assist the new CEO Satya Nadella.

description.zh-cn: 史蒂夫·巴尔默接替比尔·盖茨成为微软首席执行官。二人也曾在哈佛大学相识。
description.en: Steve Ballmer succeeded Bill Gates as CEO of Microsoft. The two had also met at Harvard University.

description.zh-cn: IBM选择与微软合作为其个人电脑开发操作系统，这对微软的早期成功至关重要。
description.en: IBM chose to partner with Microsoft to develop the operating system for its personal computer, which was crucial for Microsoft's early success.

description.zh-cn: 苹果电脑就Windows 2.03和3.0的用户界面起诉微软侵犯其版权，但最终败诉。
description.en: Apple Computer sued Microsoft for copyright infringement over the user interface of Windows 2.03 and 3.0, but ultimately lost the case.

description.zh-cn: 美国政府指控微软公司在操作系统和网络浏览器销售中存在垄断行为。
description.en: The U.S. government accused Microsoft Corporation of monopolistic practices in the sale of its operating system and web browser.

description.zh-cn: 作为微软的领导者，盖茨的声誉因美国政府一系列控告微软垄断的案件而受损。
description.en: As the leader of Microsoft, Gates's reputation was damaged by a series of antitrust lawsuits filed by the U.S. government.

description.zh-cn: 泰拉能源与中国核工业集团探讨关于第四代反应堆行波反应堆的建设合作。
description.en: TerraPower explored construction cooperation with China National Nuclear Corporation on fourth-generation traveling-wave reactors.

description.zh-cn: 在2019冠状病毒病疫情期间，盖茨基金会捐助500万美元紧急款项支持中国政府的防疫工作。
description.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, the Gates Foundation donated $5 million in emergency funds to support the Chinese government's epidemic prevention efforts.

description.zh-cn: 比尔·盖茨就新冠疫情致信习近平表达支持，习近平回信感谢。习近平在之后的会面中称盖茨为“老朋友”。
description.en: Bill Gates wrote to Xi Jinping to express support regarding the COVID-19 pandemic, and Xi replied with thanks. Xi referred to Gates as an 'old friend' in a subsequent meeting.

description.zh-cn: 2019冠状病毒病疫情促使盖茨基金会捐款支持中国的防疫工作。
description.en: The COVID-19 pandemic prompted the Gates Foundation to donate funds to support China's epidemic prevention efforts.

description.zh-cn: 刘允真是刘少奇的儿子。
description.en: Liu Yunzhen is the son of Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 刘允真是王前的儿子。
description.en: Liu Yunzhen is the son of Wang Qian.

description.zh-cn: 王前是刘少奇的第四任妻子。
description.en: Wang Qian was the fourth wife of Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 刘允真于1946年7月生于延安。
description.en: Liu Yunzhen was born in Yan'an in July 1946.

description.zh-cn: 1962年毕业于北京101中学。
description.en: Graduated from Beijing 101 Middle School in 1962.

description.zh-cn: 刘允真是刘涛的弟弟。
description.en: Liu Yunzhen is the younger brother of Liu Tao.

description.zh-cn: 1967年，和姐姐刘涛一同书写大字报《造刘少奇的反，跟着毛主席干一辈子革命》和《看！刘少奇的丑恶灵魂》，揭发刘少奇。
description.en: In 1967, along with his sister Liu Tao, he wrote big-character posters titled 'Rebel against Liu Shaoqi, Follow Chairman Mao for a Lifetime of Revolution' and 'Look! Liu Shaoqi's Vile Soul' to denounce Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 1967年，和弟弟刘允真一同书写大字报《造刘少奇的反，跟着毛主席干一辈子革命》和《看！刘少奇的丑恶灵魂》，揭发刘少奇。
description.en: In 1967, along with her brother Liu Yunzhen, she wrote big-character posters titled 'Rebel against Liu Shaoqi, Follow Chairman Mao for a Lifetime of Revolution' and 'Look! Liu Shaoqi's Vile Soul' to denounce Liu Shaoqi.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命结束后在北京国家科学技术协会工作。
description.en: Worked at the China Association for Science and Technology in Beijing after the Cultural Revolution ended.

description.zh-cn: 改革开放政策为刘允真提供了到广西等地从事经济管理工作的机会。
description.en: The Reform and Opening-up policy provided Liu Yunzhen with the opportunity to engage in economic management work in Guangxi and other places.

position.en: Vice President of North District Sub-branch

description.zh-cn: 1996年至2006年，担任湖南省长沙市商业银行北区支行副行长。
description.en: From 1996 to 2006, he served as the Vice President of the North District Sub-branch of Changsha Commercial Bank in Hunan Province.

description.zh-cn: 因英军北上直逼天津，道光帝认为林则徐在广东禁烟“节外生枝”，将其革职。
description.en: After the British fleet sailed north and threatened Tianjin, the Daoguang Emperor blamed Lin Zexu for provoking trouble with his anti-opium campaign in Guangdong and dismissed him from his post.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝任命时任直隶总督琦善为钦差大臣，赴广东与英军谈判。
description.en: The Daoguang Emperor appointed Qishan, then Governor-General of Zhili, as Imperial Commissioner to negotiate with the British forces in Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 因得知琦善擅自与英国签订《穿鼻草约》割让香港，道光帝将其革职锁拿进京。
description.en: Upon learning that Qishan had signed the Convention of Chuanbi and ceded Hong Kong without authorization, the Daoguang Emperor dismissed him and had him arrested and sent to Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 琦善与义律拟定了《穿鼻草约》，同意割让香港并赔款。
description.en: Qishan and Charles Elliot drafted the Convention of Chuanbi, agreeing to cede Hong Kong and pay an indemnity.

description.zh-cn: 义律与琦善拟定了《穿鼻草约》，要求割让香港并赔款。
description.en: Charles Elliot and Qishan drafted the Convention of Chuanbi, demanding the cession of Hong Kong and an indemnity.

description.zh-cn: 广东水师提督关天培在虎门之战中战死。
description.en: Guan Tianpei, the admiral of the Guangdong naval forces, was killed in action during the Battle of Humen.

description.zh-cn: 奕山在第二次广州之战战败后，授权广州知府与义律签订《广州和约》，支付赎城费。
description.en: After being defeated in the Second Battle of Canton, Yishan authorized the prefect of Guangzhou to sign the 'Ransom of Canton' with Elliot, agreeing to pay for the city.

description.zh-cn: 镇江失守切断了京杭大运河漕运，直接促使道光帝下定决心求和。
description.en: The fall of Zhenjiang cut off the Grand Canal's grain transport, directly compelling the Daoguang Emperor to sue for peace.

description.zh-cn: 林则徐在戍边前将自己主持翻译的《四洲志》等资料交给魏源，嘱其编撰一部介绍世界的著作。
description.en: Before his exile, Lin Zexu gave his translated work 'Gazetteer of the Four Continents' and other materials to Wei Yuan, entrusting him to compile a book about the world.

description.zh-cn: 鸦片战争后签订的《南京条约》开放五个通商口岸，结束了清朝“一口通商”的贸易政策。
description.en: The Treaty of Nanking, signed after the Opium War, opened five treaty ports, ending the Qing dynasty's 'Canton System' trade policy.

description.zh-cn: 清朝江南提督陈化成在吴淞战役中阵亡。
description.en: Chen Huacheng, the Jiangnan Admiral of the Qing dynasty, was killed in action during the Battle of Wusong.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军总政治部是中央军事委员会下属的四大总部之一。
description.en: The PLA General Political Department was one of the four general headquarters under the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，中国人民解放军总政治部被撤销。
description.en: During the deepening of national defense and military reform, the PLA General Political Department was abolished.

description.zh-cn: 作为改革的一部分，中央军事委员会政治工作部被组建，以承接原总政治部的部分职责。
description.en: As part of the reform, the Political Work Department of the Central Military Commission was established to take over some of the responsibilities of the former General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 作为改革的一部分，中央军事委员会政法委员会被组建，以承接原总政治部的军事保卫、审判、检察职责。
description.en: As part of the reform, the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Central Military Commission was established to take over the military security, judicial, and procuratorial responsibilities of the former General Political Department.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，总政治部受到严重破坏，领导干部被批斗，机关陷于瘫痪，直至1969年12月才恢复办公。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, the General Political Department was severely damaged, its leaders were persecuted, and its functions were paralyzed until it resumed operations in December 1969.

description.zh-cn: 江青与林彪等人提出“彻底砸烂总政阎王殿”的口号，导致总政治部机关及其领导受到严重冲击。
description.en: Jiang Qing, along with Lin Biao and others, put forward the slogan 'thoroughly smash the General Political Department, the Palace of the King of Hell,' which led to severe attacks on the department and its leadership.

description.zh-cn: 中共十一届三中全会以后，总政治部的工作得到了恢复和发展。
description.en: After the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee of the CPC, the work of the General Political Department was restored and developed.

description.zh-cn: 吴石作为中共地下党员，向中国共产党泄漏了大量军事情报。
description.en: As an underground member of the CCP, Wu Shi leaked a large amount of military intelligence to the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 吴石在台湾白色恐怖时期被视为“匪谍”而遭逮捕并被处决，是该时期的著名受难者之一。
description.en: Wu Shi was arrested and executed as a 'communist spy' during the White Terror period in Taiwan, becoming one of the prominent victims of that era.

description.zh-cn: 干预并推动了中华人民共和国追认吴石为革命烈士一事。
description.en: Intervened and promoted the posthumous recognition of Wu Shi as a revolutionary martyr by the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 吴石响应武昌起义，报名参加了福州北伐学生军。
description.en: In response to the Wuchang Uprising, Wu Shi signed up for the Fuzhou Northern Expedition Student Army.

description.zh-cn: 1947年在上海首次会面商谈，1949年8月在台北再次联系，何遂说服吴石继续为中共工作。
description.en: First met in Shanghai in 1947 for discussions, and reconnected in Taipei in August 1949, where He Sui persuaded Wu Shi to continue working for the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 在台北与吴石会面，影响并说服他继续为中国共产党工作。
description.en: Met with Wu Shi in Taipei, influencing and persuading him to continue working for the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 帮助吴仲禧取得《淮海战场形势图》等重要情报。
description.en: Helped Wu Zhongxi obtain crucial intelligence such as the 'Huaihai Battlefield Situation Map'.

description.zh-cn: 将从吴石处获得的《淮海战场形势图》转交给潘汉年。
description.en: Transferred the 'Huaihai Battlefield Situation Map' obtained from Wu Shi to Pan Hannian.

description.zh-cn: 给予吴石“密使一号”的代号。
description.en: Gave Wu Shi the codename '密使一号' (Secret Envoy No. 1).

description.zh-cn: 作为审判官，负责审判吴石并导致其被判死刑。
description.en: As a judge, he was responsible for the trial of Wu Shi, which led to his death sentence.

description.zh-cn: 针对吴石案的审判违失对国防部提出纠正。
description.en: Issued a corrective measure against the Ministry of National Defense for procedural flaws in the trial of the Wu Shi case.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲的祖父柯世元在228事件清乡期间被捕并遭殴打，返家后卧床三年多后病逝。
description.en: Ko Wen-je's grandfather, Ko Shih-yuan, was arrested and beaten during the cleanup campaign of the 228 Incident. After returning home, he was bedridden for over three years before passing away.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲受其师朱树勋影响选择外科，并在其指派下建立台大器官移植小组。
description.en: Influenced by his mentor Chu Shu-hsun, Ko Wen-je chose surgery and established the organ transplant team at NTUH under his direction.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲是叶克膜技术在台湾的推手之一，显著提高了病患存活率。
description.en: Ko Wen-je was one of the pioneers of ECMO technology in Taiwan, significantly improving patient survival rates.

description.zh-cn: 在邵晓铃因车祸重伤昏迷后，柯文哲建议并指派团队为其安装叶克膜，最终使其康复。
description.en: After Shao Hsiao-ling was severely injured and in a coma from a car accident, Ko Wen-je suggested and dispatched a team to install ECMO, leading to her recovery.

description.zh-cn: 在连胜文枪击案中，柯文哲参与的台大医院医疗团队成功抢救了连胜文。
description.en: In the Sean Lien shooting incident, the medical team at NTUH, including Ko Wen-je, successfully saved his life.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲与连胜文在2014年台北市长选举中为主要竞争对手。
description.en: Ko Wen-je and Sean Lien were the main competitors in the 2014 Taipei mayoral election.

description.zh-cn: 美国作家伊森·葛特曼指控柯文哲在中国器官移植事件中担任中间人，并称其为骗子。
description.en: American author Ethan Gutmann accused Ko Wen-je of acting as a middleman in China's organ transplant affairs and called him a liar.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲就美河市案评论时任基隆立委候选人郝龙斌，称“如果郝龙斌对美河市案什么都不知道的话，可以去死一死”，引发争议。
description.en: Commenting on the MeHAS City case, Ko Wen-je stated that if KMT Keelung legislative candidate Hau Lung-pin 'knew nothing about the MeHAS City case, he could go die,' causing controversy.

description.zh-cn: 柯文哲请辞台湾民众党主席后，由黄国昌接任代理主席。
description.en: After Ko Wen-je resigned as chairman of the Taiwan People's Party, Huang Kuo-chang took over as acting chairman.

description.zh-cn: 2000年后，柯文哲至中国大陆参加多次医学会议，将叶克膜技术传入中国大陆。
description.en: After 2000, Ko Wen-je attended multiple medical conferences in mainland China and introduced ECMO technology to the region.

position.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国代理主席
position.en: Acting President of the People's Republic of China

description.zh-cn: 在刘少奇被罢免后，董必武作为副主席先与宋庆龄共同代行主席职权，后以代理主席名义行使职权。
description.en: After Liu Shaoqi's removal, Dong Biwu, as Vice President, initially exercised presidential powers jointly with Song Qingling, and later acted as Acting President.

description.zh-cn: 在毛泽东担任最高领导人期间，宋庆龄作为副主席与董必武共同代行国家主席职权。
description.en: Song Qingling, as Vice President, jointly exercised presidential powers with Dong Biwu while Mao Zedong was the paramount leader.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会委员长
position.en: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 国家主席职务被废除后，全国人大常委会集体担任国家元首，朱德作为委员长是其代表。
description.en: After the presidency was abolished, the NPC Standing Committee collectively served as the head of state, with Chairman Zhu De as its representative.

position.zh-cn: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会代理委员长
position.en: Acting Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

description.zh-cn: 朱德逝世后，宋庆龄以副委员长身份代理委员长，代行国家元首职权。
description.en: After Zhu De's death, Song Qingling, as Vice Chairwoman, acted as Chairwoman and exercised the functions of the head of state.

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平担任最高领导人期间，叶剑英担任全国人大常委会委员长。
description.en: Ye Jianying served as Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee while Deng Xiaoping was the paramount leader.

description.zh-cn: 由于中苏交恶和苏联的严重威胁，中国提出了“一条线、一大片”外交战略以应对。
description.en: Due to the Sino-Soviet split and the serious threat from the Soviet Union, China proposed the 'One Line, One Large Area' diplomatic strategy in response.

description.zh-cn: 1969年中苏爆发珍宝岛武装冲突，两国面临全面战争的威胁，这促使中国调整外交战略，最终形成了“一条线、一大片”战略。
description.en: The Zhenbao Island armed conflict between China and the Soviet Union in 1969 brought the two countries to the brink of all-out war, prompting China to adjust its diplomatic strategy, which eventually led to the formation of the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy.

description.zh-cn: 1973年，毛泽东会见时任美国总统特使基辛格，并向他提出了“一条线”的外交战略。
description.en: In 1973, Mao Zedong met with then-U.S. Presidential Envoy Henry Kissinger and proposed the 'one line' diplomatic strategy to him.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松访华促成了中美关系的缓和，为中国实施“亲美反苏”的“一条线、一大片”战略创造了条件。
description.en: Nixon's visit to China led to a thaw in Sino-US relations, creating the conditions for China to implement the 'pro-US, anti-Soviet' 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy.

description.zh-cn: 1974年，毛泽东在北京会见时任日本外务大臣大平正芳，并提出了“一大片”的外交构想。
description.en: In 1974, Mao Zedong met with then-Japanese Foreign Minister Masayoshi Ōhira in Beijing and proposed the 'one large area' diplomatic concept.

description.zh-cn: 美国因深陷越南战争，开始重新评估其对华政策，这为中美关系缓和及“一条线、一大片”战略的形成创造了外部条件。
description.en: Bogged down in the Vietnam War, the United States began to re-evaluate its China policy, which created external conditions for a Sino-US rapprochement and the formation of the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy.

description.zh-cn: “一条线、一大片”战略指导了中国的外交，有效地遏制了苏联的威胁，并帮助中国摆脱了在国际上的孤立地位。
description.en: The 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy guided China's diplomacy, effectively containing the Soviet threat and helping China break free from its international isolation.

description.zh-cn: 1982年中共召开十二大，正式确立新的“独立自主的和平外交政策”，从而终结了“一条线、一大片”战略。
description.en: The 12th National Congress of the CPC in 1982 formally established the new 'Independent Foreign Policy of Peace,' thereby ending the 'One Line, One Large Area' strategy.

description.zh-cn: 公视基金会与中华电视公司共同组成台湾公广集团。
description.en: The Public Television Service Foundation and the Chinese Television System jointly formed the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 中华电视公司与公视基金会共同组成台湾公广集团。
description.en: The Chinese Television System and the Public Television Service Foundation jointly formed the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 依据《无线电视事业公股处理条例》，客家电视台于2007年1月1日加入公广集团。
description.en: According to the 'Act for the Disposition of Government Shareholdings in Terrestrial Television Industry', Hakka TV joined the Taiwan Broadcasting System on January 1, 2007.

description.zh-cn: 依据《无线电视事业公股处理条例》加入公广集团，后于2014年改由原住民族文化事业基金会经营而退出。
description.en: Joined the Taiwan Broadcasting System according to the 'Act for the Disposition of Government Shareholdings in Terrestrial Television Industry', and later withdrew in 2014 when its operation was transferred to the Indigenous Peoples Cultural Foundation.

description.zh-cn: 依据《无线电视事业公股处理条例》加入公广集团，于2018年停止营运。
description.en: Joined the Taiwan Broadcasting System according to the 'Act for the Disposition of Government Shareholdings in Terrestrial Television Industry', and ceased operations in 2018.

description.zh-cn: Taiwan+ 电视频道于2022年10月3日正式开播，为公广集团成员。
description.en: The Taiwan+ television channel officially launched on October 3, 2022, as a member of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 发起“媒体要改革，公民来连署——让我们催生公共广播电视集团”连署行动，以催生公广集团。
description.en: Launched the 'Media Reform, Citizens' Petition - Let's Bring a Public Broadcasting Group into Being' signature campaign to advocate for the creation of the group.

description.zh-cn: 时任华视总经理小野在公听会上批评公视基金会处处干预华视、强迫华视照公视的方式走，导致华视成为“非公非商”的“四不像”。
description.en: Then CTS General Manager Ono criticized the PTS Foundation at a public hearing for constantly interfering with CTS and forcing it to follow PTS's model, turning CTS into a 'neither fish nor fowl' entity.

description.zh-cn: 时任董事长陈郁秀主导的华视董事会，以七大罪状为由无预警解除总经理郭建宏的职务。
description.en: The CTS board of directors, led by then-chairperson Tchen Yu-chiou, abruptly dismissed General Manager Kuo Chien-hung, citing seven major accusations.

description.zh-cn: 因行政院新闻局裁撤，文化部于2012年5月20日成立并接手管理公广集团。
description.en: Following the dissolution of the Government Information Office, the Ministry of Culture was established on May 20, 2012, and took over the management of the Taiwan Broadcasting System.

description.zh-cn: 1952年1月成为陆军士官军校第11期学员，1955年9月毕业。
description.en: Became a cadet of the 11th class of the Military Academy in January 1952 and graduated in September 1955.

description.zh-cn: 全斗焕在五一六军事政变时积极支持朴正熙。
description.en: Chun Doo-hwan actively supported Park Chung-hee during the May 16 coup.

description.zh-cn: 朴正熙将全斗焕视为亲信，在其执政期间多次提拔全斗焕担任要职。
description.en: Park Chung-hee regarded Chun Doo-hwan as a confidant and promoted him to key positions multiple times during his rule.

description.zh-cn: 与卢泰愚等人共同成立秘密组织“一心会”（后称新军部），并担任会长。
description.en: Co-founded the secret organization 'Hana-hoe' (later known as the New Military Group) with Roh Tae-woo and others, and served as its leader.

description.zh-cn: 与全斗焕等人共同成立秘密组织“一心会”（后称新军部）。
description.en: Co-founded the secret organization 'Hana-hoe' (later known as the New Military Group) with Chun Doo-hwan and others.

description.zh-cn: 身为国军保安司令的全斗焕发动双十二政变，全面掌握军政大权。
description.en: As the Commander of the Defense Security Command, Chun Doo-hwan launched the Coup d'état of December Twelfth, seizing full military and political power.

description.zh-cn: 政变期间，陆军参谋总长郑升和被逮捕。
description.en: During the coup, Army Chief of Staff Jeong Seung-hwa was arrested.

description.zh-cn: 在5·17紧急戒严后，金大中等民主人士被拘捕入狱。
description.en: After the May 17 Emergency Martial Law, pro-democracy figures like Kim Dae-jung were arrested and imprisoned.

description.zh-cn: 在5·17紧急戒严后，金泳三等民主人士被软禁。
description.en: After the May 17 Emergency Martial Law, pro-democracy figures like Kim Young-sam were placed under house arrest.

description.zh-cn: 以全斗焕为首的新军部势力通过国家保卫非常对策委员会完全控制政局，迫使时任总统崔圭夏辞职。
description.en: The New Military Group, led by Chun Doo-hwan, took complete control of the political situation through the Special Committee for National Security Measures, forcing then-President Choi Kyu-hah to resign.

description.zh-cn: 里根政府宣布取消撤出驻韩美军的计划，并承诺继续帮助韩军实现军事现代化，加强了对全斗焕政府的支持。
description.en: The Reagan administration announced the cancellation of plans to withdraw U.S. troops from South Korea and promised to continue assisting in the modernization of the South Korean military, thereby strengthening its support for the Chun Doo-hwan government.

description.zh-cn: 中曾根康弘作为首位访韩的日本首相，决定向韩国提供40亿美元贷款援助，改善了双边关系。
description.en: As the first Japanese Prime Minister to visit South Korea, Yasuhiro Nakasone decided to provide $4 billion in loan assistance to South Korea, improving bilateral relations.

description.zh-cn: 韩国方面认为朝鲜是仰光爆炸事件的主谋，该事件是一起针对全斗焕的暗杀行动。
description.en: The South Korean side believes North Korea masterminded the Rangoon bombing, which was an assassination attempt against Chun Doo-hwan.

description.zh-cn: 六月民主运动的巨大压力迫使全斗焕放弃通过间接选举维持统治的计划。
description.en: The immense pressure from the June Democratic Struggle forced Chun Doo-hwan to abandon his plan to maintain power through an indirect election.

description.zh-cn: 作为全斗焕的接班人，卢泰愚发表了同意总统直选的六二九宣言。
description.en: As Chun Doo-hwan's successor, Roh Tae-woo issued the June 29 Declaration, agreeing to direct presidential elections.

description.zh-cn: 全斗焕接受了卢泰愚提出的六二九宣言。
description.en: Chun Doo-hwan accepted the June 29 Declaration proposed by Roh Tae-woo.

description.zh-cn: 一审以军事叛乱和内乱罪、谋杀上司未遂罪及受贿罪，判处全斗焕死刑。
description.en: In the first trial, Chun Doo-hwan was sentenced to death for military rebellion, insurrection, attempted murder of a superior, and bribery.

description.zh-cn: 终审以军事叛乱、内乱罪和贪污受贿罪，改判全斗焕无期徒刑。
description.en: In the final appeal, Chun Doo-hwan's sentence was commuted to life imprisonment for military rebellion, insurrection, and bribery.

description.zh-cn: 金泳三在征得候任总统金大中的同意后，赦免了全斗焕。
description.en: Kim Young-sam pardoned Chun Doo-hwan after obtaining the consent of president-elect Kim Dae-jung.

description.zh-cn: 赵婕妤是汉武帝刘彻的宠妃。
description.en: Zhao Jieyu was a favored consort of Emperor Wu, Liu Che.

description.zh-cn: 赵氏被汉武帝封为婕妤，居住在钩弋宫。
description.en: Lady Zhao was granted the rank of Jieyu by Emperor Wu and resided in the Gouyi Palace.

description.zh-cn: 其子汉昭帝即位后，追封赵氏为皇太后。
description.en: After her son, Emperor Zhao, ascended the throne, Lady Zhao was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝以吕后专权的历史为鉴，担忧女主专权，这成为他决定处死钩弋夫人的一个重要动机。
description.en: Drawing a lesson from the history of Empress Lü's usurpation of power, Emperor Wu feared the concentration of power in the hands of an empress dowager, which became a significant motive for his decision to execute Lady Gouyi.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝处死钩弋夫人的做法，为后来的北魏王朝所效仿，形成了“子贵母死”的制度。
description.en: Emperor Wu's execution of Lady Gouyi was emulated by the later Northern Wei dynasty, establishing the 'Heir Apparent's Mother is Executed' system.

description.zh-cn: 汉武帝杀钩弋夫人的做法被后来的北魏所援引和效仿，并制度化为“子贵母死”。
description.en: The act of Emperor Wu killing Lady Gouyi was cited and emulated by the later Northern Wei dynasty, and was institutionalized as the 'Heir Apparent's Mother is Executed' practice.

description.zh-cn: 汉昭帝刘弗陵与戾太子刘据是同父异母的兄弟，父亲均为汉武帝刘彻。
description.en: Emperor Zhao, Liu Fuling, and Crown Prince Li, Liu Ju, were half-brothers, both sons of Emperor Wu, Liu Che.

description.zh-cn: 李天然是李白的儿子。
description.en: Li Tianran was Li Bai's son.

description.zh-cn: 738年秋，李白曾在玉真公主于终南山的别馆做门客。
description.en: In the autumn of 738, Li Bai served as a guest-retainer at Princess Yuzhen's villa in the Zhongnan Mountains.

description.zh-cn: 744年秋，李白在汴州、宋州一带与杜甫、高适交游，一同游览、畅谈痛饮。
description.en: In the autumn of 744, Li Bai associated with Du Fu and Gao Shi in the regions of Bianzhou and Songzhou, traveling, talking, and drinking together.

description.zh-cn: 李白因永王李璘案被囚于寻阳狱中时，曾向时任淮南节度使的故友高适求救，但未获援手。
description.en: When Li Bai was imprisoned in Xunyang for his involvement in the Prince of Yong's case, he sought help from his old friend Gao Shi, who was then the military governor of Huainan, but received no assistance.

description.zh-cn: 李白结交孟浩然并深受其敬慕，受其启发后诗风为之一变，变得清新奔放。
description.en: Li Bai befriended and deeply admired Meng Haoran; inspired by him, his poetic style changed, becoming fresher and more unrestrained.

description.zh-cn: 安史之乱爆发后，李白南奔避乱，后因加入永王李璘阵营，在李璘兵败后被牵连获罪，流放夜郎，人生遭遇重大挫折。
description.en: After the An Lushan Rebellion broke out, Li Bai fled south to escape the chaos. He later joined the Prince of Yong's camp and was implicated, convicted, and exiled to Yelang after the prince's defeat, marking a major setback in his life.

description.zh-cn: 李白晚年病重时，前往当涂投靠族叔李阳冰，得到其照顾。去世后，李阳冰将李白的诗文编成《草堂集》。
description.en: In his later years, when he was seriously ill, Li Bai went to Dangtu to seek refuge with his clan uncle Li Yangbing, who took care of him. After his death, Li Yangbing compiled his poems into the 'Caotang Ji' (Grass Hut Collection).

description.zh-cn: 李白笃信道教，热切向往神仙不死，并曾在齐州从道士高如贵处领受道箓，正式成为道教徒。
description.en: Li Bai was a devout follower of Daoism, fervently yearning for immortality. He formally became a Daoist practitioner after receiving ordination from the priest Gao Rugui in Qizhou.

description.zh-cn: 李白对佛教有精深造诣，能纯熟掌握其思想，自称“青莲居士”，作品中也常体现佛教影响。
description.en: Li Bai had a profound understanding of Buddhism and mastered its concepts. He called himself the 'Blue Lotus Layman,' and Buddhist influences are often reflected in his works.

description.zh-cn: 元丹丘是李白毕生的挚友，两人常一同游历、隐居、访道。
description.en: Yuan Danqiu was a lifelong close friend of Li Bai; they often traveled, lived in seclusion, and sought the Dao together.

description.zh-cn: 陈其迈在2020年高雄市市长补选中当选，并于2022年连任。
description.en: Chen Chi-mai was elected in the 2020 Kaohsiung mayoral by-election and was re-elected in 2022.

description.zh-cn: 1920年，台湾总督府正式公布将原名“打狗”改名为“高雄”。
description.en: In 1920, the Governor-General of Taiwan officially announced the renaming of 'Takau' (打狗) to 'Kaohsiung' (高雄).

description.zh-cn: 郑经是郑成功的儿子。
description.en: Zheng Jing was the son of Koxinga.

description.zh-cn: 施琅率领清军征讨台湾，迫使明郑末代君主郑克塽投降。
description.en: Shi Lang led the Qing forces to conquer Taiwan, forcing Zheng Keshuang, the last ruler of the Kingdom of Tungning, to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 以《美丽岛》杂志社成员为核心的党外人士组织群众游行，引发了美丽岛事件。
description.en: Tangwai activists, centered around the members of Formosa Magazine, organized a mass protest that triggered the Kaohsiung Incident.

description.zh-cn: 当时的国民党政府派遣军警全面镇压美丽岛事件的示威群众。
description.en: The Kuomintang government at the time dispatched military and police forces to suppress the protesters of the Kaohsiung Incident.

description.zh-cn: 韩国瑜因罢免案通过而被解除高雄市市长职务。
description.en: Han Kuo-yu was removed from his position as Mayor of Kaohsiung after the recall vote passed.

description.zh-cn: 释星云于1967年创办佛光山。
description.en: Hsing Yun founded Fo Guang Shan in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚是河南固始人。
description.en: Huo Jian'gang is a native of Gushi, Henan.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚曾任济南军区司令部办公室主任。
description.en: Huo Jian'gang once served as the Director of the Headquarters Office of the Jinan Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚任济南军区司令部办公室主任时，时任司令员为范长龙。
description.en: When Huo Jian'gang was the Director of the Headquarters Office of the Jinan Military Region, Fan Changlong was the commander.

description.zh-cn: 2015年，霍建刚任陆军第五十四集团军第127师师长。
description.en: In 2015, Huo Jian'gang served as the commander of the 127th Division of the 54th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚曾任陆军第四十七集团军副军长。
description.en: Huo Jian'gang once served as the Deputy Commander of the 47th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2017年3月，霍建刚任陆军第七十七集团军副军长。
description.en: In March 2017, Huo Jian'gang was appointed Deputy Commander of the 77th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2019年4月，霍建刚升任第七十九集团军军长。
description.en: In April 2019, Huo Jian'gang was promoted to Commander of the 79th Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2021年，霍建刚改任国防大学联合作战学院院长。
description.en: In 2021, Huo Jian'gang was reassigned as the President of the Joint Operations College of the National Defense University.

description.zh-cn: 2022年6月，霍建刚升任中部战区副司令员。
description.en: In June 2022, Huo Jian'gang was promoted to Deputy Commander of the Central Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚于2017年7月晋升少将军衔，2023年由中将降为少将军衔。
description.en: Huo Jian'gang was promoted to the rank of Major General in July 2017, and was demoted from Lieutenant General back to Major General in 2023.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚于2022年6月晋升中将军衔。
description.en: Huo Jian'gang was promoted to the rank of Lieutenant General in June 2022.

description.zh-cn: 霍建刚接替徐起零出任中国人民解放军陆军第七十九集团军军长。
description.en: Huo Jian'gang succeeded Xu Qiling as the commander of the 79th Group Army of the PLA Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴于1874年10月25日出生于湖南省长沙府善化县。
description.en: Huang Xing was born in Shanhua County, Changsha Prefecture, Hunan Province on October 25, 1874.

description.zh-cn: 黄兴于1916年10月31日在上海病逝。由于规则没有定义DEATH_IN关系，使用INFLUENCED表示其逝世地点。
description.en: Huang Xing passed away in Shanghai on October 31, 1916. As there is no DEATH_IN relationship defined in the rules, INFLUENCED is used to denote his place of death.

description.zh-cn: 1898年，黄兴入武昌两湖书院读书。
description.en: In 1898, Huang Xing entered the Lianghu Academy in Wuchang to study.

description.zh-cn: 1902年，黄兴赴日本留学，入东京弘文学院师范科学习。
description.en: In 1902, Huang Xing went to study in Japan and enrolled in the teacher training course at Kōbun Gakuin in Tokyo.

description.zh-cn: 1905年，孙中山所建立的兴中会与黄兴建立的华兴会等团体合并成立中国同盟会。
description.en: In 1905, the Xingzhonghui, founded by Sun Yat-sen, merged with the Huaxing Society, founded by Huang Xing, and other groups to form the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 1905年，黄兴所建立的华兴会与孙中山建立的兴中会等团体合并成立中国同盟会。
description.en: In 1905, the Huaxing Society, founded by Huang Xing, merged with the Xingzhonghui, founded by Sun Yat-sen, and other groups to form the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 光复会是1905年合并成立中国同盟会的革命团体之一。
description.en: The Guangfuhui was one of the revolutionary groups that merged to form the Tongmenghui in 1905.

description.zh-cn: 1907年，因潮州起义失败，光复会成员要求罢免孙中山，最终光复会退出了中国同盟会。
description.en: In 1907, following the failure of the Chaozhou Uprising, members of the Guangfuhui demanded the removal of Sun Yat-sen, which ultimately led to the withdrawal of the Guangfuhui from the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后，黄兴抵达汉口，被推为中华民国军政府战时总司令。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising, Huang Xing arrived in Hankou and was appointed as the Wartime Commander-in-Chief of the Military Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 王茂设因涉嫌严重违法违纪被有关部门带走调查。
description.en: Wang Maoshe was taken away by relevant departments for investigation on suspicion of serious violations of law and discipline.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，王茂设与令政策关系交好。
description.en: It is reported that Wang Maoshe had a good relationship with Ling Zhengce.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，王茂设与杜善学关系交好。
description.en: It is reported that Wang Maoshe had a good relationship with Du Shanxue.

description.zh-cn: 王茂全因牵涉其弟王茂设的腐败案被开除党籍。
description.en: Wang Maoquan was expelled from the Communist Party of China for his involvement in his brother Wang Maoshe's corruption case.

description.zh-cn: 王茂设接替白云担任中共运城市委书记。
description.en: Wang Maoshe succeeded Bai Yun as Secretary of the Yuncheng Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 王宇燕接替王茂设担任中共运城市委书记。
description.en: Wang Yuyan succeeded Wang Maoshe as Secretary of the Yuncheng Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 王安庞接替王茂设担任中共朔州市委书记。
description.en: Wang Anpang succeeded Wang Maoshe as Secretary of the Shuozhou Municipal Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 王茂设接替夏振贵担任晋城市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wang Maoshe succeeded Xia Zhengui as Mayor of the Jincheng Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 王清宪接替王茂设担任晋城市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wang Qingxian succeeded Wang Maoshe as Mayor of the Jincheng Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国轻工业部是中华人民共和国国务院下设的一个部。
description.en: The Ministry of Light Industry of the People's Republic of China was a ministry under the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 1949年11月，政务院成立轻工业部。
description.en: In November 1949, the Government Administration Council established the Ministry of Light Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1970年4月，第二轻工业部与第一轻工业部、纺织工业部合并，组建为中华人民共和国轻工业部。
description.en: In April 1970, the Second Ministry of Light Industry merged with the First Ministry of Light Industry and the Ministry of Textile Industry to form the Ministry of Light Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 第二轻工业部同中华全国手工业合作总社合署办公。
description.en: The Second Ministry of Light Industry and the All-China Federation of Handicrafts Cooperatives worked in the same office.

description.zh-cn: 陕西科技大学曾是轻工业部的部属事业单位。
description.en: Shaanxi University of Science & Technology was once a public institution subordinate to the Ministry of Light Industry.

description.zh-cn: 江南大学曾是轻工业部的部属事业单位。
description.en: Jiangnan University was once a public institution subordinate to the Ministry of Light Industry.

description.zh-cn: 郑州轻工业大学曾是轻工业部的部属事业单位。
description.en: Zhengzhou University of Light Industry was once a public institution subordinate to the Ministry of Light Industry.

description.zh-cn: 天津科技大学曾是轻工业部的部属事业单位。
description.en: Tianjin University of Science & Technology was once a public institution subordinate to the Ministry of Light Industry.

description.zh-cn: 福建理工大学曾是轻工业部的部属事业单位。
description.en: Fujian University of Technology was once a public institution subordinate to the Ministry of Light Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1988年，杜五安进入省委，任山西省人民政府副秘书长。
description.en: In 1988, Du Wu'an joined the provincial committee and served as Deputy Secretary-General of the Shanxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 2003年1月，杜五安任山西省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: In January 2003, Du Wu'an was appointed Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Shanxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 杜五安卸任中国共产党临汾地区委员会书记职务后，由王民接任。
description.en: After Du Wu'an stepped down as Secretary of the CPC Linfen Prefectural Committee, he was succeeded by Wang Min.

description.zh-cn: 永璂是弘历（乾隆帝）的第十二子。
description.en: Yongqi was the 12th son of Hongli (the Qianlong Emperor).

description.zh-cn: 永璂是清高宗继皇后辉发那拉氏的亲生儿子。
description.en: Yongqi was the biological son of Empress Hoifa-Nara, the Step Empress to the Qianlong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 1765年南巡期间，因其母继皇后那拉氏剪发触怒乾隆帝，永璂受到牵连而失宠。
description.en: During the southern tour in 1765, Yongqi fell out of favor as he was implicated by his mother, Empress Nara, who angered the Qianlong Emperor by cutting her hair.

description.zh-cn: 在1765年南巡期间，继皇后那拉氏因剪发触怒乾隆帝，被收回皇后宝册并禁足。
description.en: During the southern tour in 1765, Empress Nara angered the Qianlong Emperor by cutting her hair, leading to the confiscation of her imperial titles and her confinement.

description.zh-cn: 永璂于乾隆三十五年四月与嫡福晋博尔济吉特氏成婚。
description.en: Yongqi married his primary consort, Lady Borjigit, in April 1770.

description.zh-cn: 永璂是乾隆帝第十二子，永瑆是第十一子，二人是异母兄弟。
description.en: Yongqi was the 12th son of the Qianlong Emperor, and Yongxing was the 11th son; they were half-brothers.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆三十八年，钱大昕被任命为皇十二子师傅，为永璂讲学。
description.en: In 1773, Qian Daxin was appointed as the tutor to the 12th Prince, Yongqi.

description.zh-cn: 永璂是爱新觉罗氏宗族成员。
description.en: Yongqi was a member of the Aisin-Gioro clan.

description.zh-cn: 永璂在生前未获封爵，身份为闲散宗室。
description.en: During his lifetime, Yongqi was not granted a noble title and held the status of an imperial clansman without title.

description.zh-cn: 永璂于嘉庆四年（1799年）三月被追封为多罗贝勒。
description.en: Yongqi was posthumously granted the title of Doro Beile in March 1799.

description.zh-cn: 蔡碧仲的配偶是黄淑英。
description.en: Tsai Pi-chung's spouse is Huang Shu-ying.

description.zh-cn: 在担任法务部政务次长期间，向时任部长蔡清祥汇报。
description.en: Reported to then-Minister Tsai Ching-hsiang while serving as Political Deputy Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 在担任法务部政务次长期间，向时任部长邱太三汇报。
description.en: Reported to then-Minister Chiu Tai-san while serving as Political Deputy Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 蔡碧仲代理花莲县县长任期届满，由徐榛蔚接任正任县长。
description.en: Tsai Pi-chung's term as acting magistrate of Hualien County ended, and Hsu Chen-wei took over as the duly elected magistrate.

description.zh-cn: 在法务部担任政务次长期间，与陈明堂为同事。
description.en: Was a colleague of Chen Ming-tang while serving as Political Deputy Minister of Justice.

description.zh-cn: 在脸书公开贴文，表态支持时为立法委员候选人的萧美琴。
description.en: Publicly posted on Facebook to endorse Hsiao Bi-khim, who was then a legislative candidate.

description.zh-cn: 因蔡碧仲在脸书公开支持特定候选人引发争议，时任法务部长蔡清祥当面劝说其“谨言慎行”，随后蔡碧仲删除该贴文。
description.en: After Tsai Pi-chung's public endorsement of a specific candidate on Facebook caused controversy, then-Minister of Justice Tsai Ching-hsiang advised him in person to "be prudent in his words and actions," after which Tsai Pi-chung deleted the post.

description.zh-cn: 1990年，时任国家总统德克勒克宣布解除对反种族隔离组织的禁令，并开始废除种族隔离立法，最终结束了该制度。
description.en: In 1990, then-State President de Klerk announced the unbanning of anti-apartheid organizations and began repealing apartheid legislation, ultimately ending the system.

description.zh-cn: 在首次不分种族的选举中，纳尔逊·曼德拉领导的非洲人国民大会获胜，曼德拉随后成为南非首位黑人总统。
description.en: In the first non-racial election, the African National Congress led by Nelson Mandela won, and Mandela subsequently became South Africa's first black president.

description.zh-cn: 扬·范里贝克代表荷兰东印度公司在好望角建立了补给站。
description.en: Jan van Riebeeck established a supply station at the Cape of Good Hope on behalf of the Dutch East India Company.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次布尔战争期间，大英帝国与德兰士瓦共和国是敌对双方。
description.en: During the Second Boer War, the British Empire and the Transvaal Republic were opposing sides.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次布尔战争期间，大英帝国与奥兰治自由邦是敌对双方。
description.en: During the Second Boer War, the British Empire and the Orange Free State were opposing sides.

description.zh-cn: 1994年，民族之矛的成员被整合进新成立的南非国防军。
description.en: In 1994, members of Umkhonto we Sizwe were integrated into the newly formed South African National Defence Force.

degree.en: Graduated from the Faculty of Law

description.zh-cn: 1914年，董必武东渡日本学习法律，毕业于日本大学。
description.en: In 1914, Dong Biwu went to Japan to study law and graduated from Nihon University.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，董必武赴莫斯科中山大学学习。
description.en: In 1928, Dong Biwu went to Moscow Sun Yat-sen University to study.

description.zh-cn: 1928年，董必武赴莫斯科，在国际列宁学校学习。
description.en: In 1928, Dong Biwu went to Moscow and studied at the International Lenin School.

description.zh-cn: 董必武作为武汉小组代表，出席了中国共产党第一次全国代表大会，是党的创始人之一。
description.en: As a delegate from the Wuhan group, Dong Biwu attended the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China and was one of the party's founders.

description.zh-cn: 1945年，董必武作为中国共产党解放区代表参加旧金山联合国制宪会议，在《联合国宪章》上签字，是联合国的创始人之一。
description.en: In 1945, Dong Biwu, as a representative of the Liberated Areas of the Communist Party of China, participated in the United Nations Conference on International Organization in San Francisco, signed the UN Charter, and is considered one of the founders of the United Nations.

description.zh-cn: 1958年，中央政法小组组长彭真指令召开第四届全国司法工作会议，对董必武的司法路线进行了不点名批判。
description.en: In 1958, Peng Zhen, head of the Central Political and Legal Group, directed the convening of the Fourth National Judicial Work Conference, which conducted an unnamed criticism of Dong Biwu's judicial line.

description.zh-cn: 1975年1月，第四届全国人民代表大会通过新宪法，正式废除国家主席和副主席职务，董必武的代理主席任期随之结束。
description.en: In January 1975, the Fourth National People's Congress passed a new constitution, officially abolishing the posts of President and Vice President, which ended Dong Biwu's term as acting president.

description.zh-cn: 董必武与林伯渠、徐特立、谢觉哉、吴玉章在延安被尊称为“延安五老”。
description.en: In Yan'an, Dong Biwu, along with Lin Boqu, Xu Teli, Xie Juezai, and Wu Yuzhang, were respectfully referred to as the 'Five Elders of Yan'an'.

description.zh-cn: Gmail在推出时提供1GB的巨大储存空间，迫使包括雅虎邮箱在内的竞争对手大幅增加其邮箱容量。
description.en: Gmail's launch with a large 1GB storage capacity forced competitors, including Yahoo! Mail, to significantly increase their mailbox storage.

description.zh-cn: Gmail在推出时提供1GB的巨大储存空间，迫使包括Hotmail在内的竞争对手大幅增加其邮箱容量。
description.en: Gmail's launch with a large 1GB storage capacity forced competitors, including Hotmail, to significantly increase their mailbox storage.

description.zh-cn: Gmail与Google云端硬盘整合，使用户能够发送高达10GB的附件，增强了Gmail的功能。
description.en: Gmail integrated with Google Drive, enabling users to send attachments up to 10GB, which enhanced Gmail's functionality.

description.zh-cn: Gmail与Google文件整合，允许用户直接在Gmail中打开.doc、.xls等附件，增强了其功能。
description.en: Gmail's integration with Google Docs allows users to directly open attachments like .doc and .xls within Gmail, enhancing its functionality.

description.zh-cn: Gmail运用AJAX技术，创建了比传统Webmail速度更快、用户体验更好的界面。
description.en: Gmail utilized AJAX technology to create a faster and more user-friendly interface than traditional Webmail.

description.zh-cn: 通过浏览器插件，Gmail可以使用Google Voice的功能，提供IP电话服务。
description.en: Through a browser plugin, Gmail can utilize Google Voice features to provide IP telephony services.

description.zh-cn: Inbox by Gmail是由Gmail团队（隶属于Google）推出的另一款电子邮件应用。
description.en: Inbox by Gmail was another email application launched by the Gmail team (part of Google).

description.zh-cn: 2010年2月11日，伊朗政府宣布将永久阻挡Gmail服务，声称其被反对派用作联络工具。
description.en: On February 11, 2010, the Iranian government announced it would permanently block Gmail, claiming it was used as a communication tool by opposition activists.

description.zh-cn: 自2011年3月起，中国当局开始对Gmail进行间歇性干扰，并逐步升级封锁措施，至2014年底导致Gmail在中国大陆几乎完全无法使用。
description.en: Starting in March 2011, Chinese authorities began intermittently disrupting Gmail and gradually escalated blocking measures, leading to the service becoming almost completely inaccessible in mainland China by the end of 2014.

description.zh-cn: 中国政府对Google服务（包括Gmail）的攻击和审查，是导致Google最终决定将其搜索服务撤出中国大陆的关键因素。
description.en: The Chinese government's attacks and censorship on Google services, including Gmail, were key factors that led to Google's decision to withdraw its search services from mainland China.

description.zh-cn: Gmail的15GB免费存储空间与Google云端硬盘共享。
description.en: Gmail's 15GB of free storage is shared with Google Drive.

description.zh-cn: Gmail的付费存储空间与Google相册共享。
description.en: Gmail's paid storage space is shared with Google Photos.

description.zh-cn: Gmail的付费存储空间与Google文件共享。
description.en: Gmail's paid storage space is shared with Google Docs.

description.zh-cn: 姜占春出生于直隶平山县（今河北省平山县）。
description.en: Jiang Zhanchun was born in Pingshan County, Zhili (modern-day Pingshan County, Hebei).

description.zh-cn: 姜占春曾担任河北省政协副主席。
description.en: Jiang Zhanchun served as the Vice Chairman of the Hebei Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 根据“中国共产党党员”分类，姜占春是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Based on the category 'Communist Party of China members', Jiang Zhanchun was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 曹德淦是曹德旺的哥哥。
description.en: Cao Degan is the older brother of Cao Dewang.

description.zh-cn: 曹德淦是福建福清人。
description.en: Cao Degan is from Fuqing, Fujian.

description.zh-cn: 曹德淦是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Cao Degan is a politician of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曹德淦曾担任中共漳州市委书记。
description.en: Cao Degan served as the Secretary of the CPC Zhangzhou Municipal Committee.

description.zh-cn: 曹德淦曾担任福建省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Cao Degan served as the Vice Governor of the Fujian Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 曹德淦曾担任福建省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: Cao Degan served as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Fujian Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 曹德旺是福耀集团的董事局主席。
description.en: Cao Dewang is the Chairman of the Board of Fuyao Group.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，曹德淦是厦门大学的校友。
description.en: According to Wikipedia page categories, Cao Degan is an alumnus of Xiamen University.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科页面分类，曹德淦是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia page categories, Cao Degan is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党南京市委员会是中共江苏省委的下级组织。
中国共产党南京市委员会是中国共产党的地方组织。
中国共产党南京市委员会领导南京市人民政府的工作。
中国共产党南京市委员会领导南京市中级人民法院的工作。
中国共产党南京市委员会领导南京市人民检察院的工作。
中国共产党南京市委员会领导中国人民政治协商会议南京市委员会的工作。
1937年12月，因侵华日军占领南京，中共南京市委停止活动。
文化大革命期间，中共南京市委于1967年1月一度被造反派夺权，直至1971年恢复。
文化大革命期间，于1968年3月成立了南京市革命委员会以取代原市委的权力。
渡江战役解放南京之后，于1949年5月成立了新的中共南京市委员会。
邬宝恒是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Wu Baoheng is a political figure of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1934年8月2日兴登堡去世后，希特勒将总理和总统职权合一，成为纳粹德国的独裁者，头衔为“元首及帝国总理”。
description.en: After Hindenburg's death on 2 August 1934, Hitler merged the offices of Chancellor and President to become the dictator of Nazi Germany, with the title 'Führer and Reich Chancellor'.

description.zh-cn: 同盟国在第二次世界大战中与纳粹德国作战，并最终将其击败。
description.en: The Allied Powers fought against and ultimately defeated Nazi Germany in World War II.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹党宣称国会纵火案是共产党举事的前兆，并以此为由清除政治反对力量，巩固其权力。
description.en: The Nazi Party claimed the Reichstag fire was a precursor to a communist uprising and used it as a pretext to eliminate political opposition and consolidate its power.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹党利用其在国会的多数地位以及对反对派的镇压，通过了《授权法》。
description.en: The Nazi Party used its majority in the Reichstag and suppression of opposition to pass the Enabling Act.

description.zh-cn: 《授权法》允许希特勒及其政府能够不需要国会同意而通过任何法案，有效地赋予其独裁权力。
description.en: The Enabling Act allowed Hitler and his government to pass any law without the consent of the Reichstag, effectively granting him dictatorial powers.

description.zh-cn: 希特勒下令执行“长刀之夜”行动，以清除冲锋队领导层及其他政敌。
description.en: Hitler ordered the 'Night of the Long Knives' to eliminate the leadership of the SA and other political opponents.

description.zh-cn: 冲锋队领导人恩斯特·罗姆在“长刀之夜”中被处决。
description.en: SA leader Ernst Röhm was executed during the Night of the Long Knives.

description.zh-cn: 在“长刀之夜”清洗之后，冲锋队失去了其政治地位和影响力。
description.en: After the purge of the Night of the Long Knives, the SA lost its political status and influence.

description.zh-cn: 德奥合并导致奥地利联邦国被吞并，成为纳粹德国的一部分。
description.en: The Anschluss led to the annexation of the Federal State of Austria, which became part of Nazi Germany.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国通过战争威胁，促成了《慕尼黑协定》的签署。
description.en: Nazi Germany, through the threat of war, pushed for the signing of the Munich Agreement.

description.zh-cn: 纳粹德国与苏联签署了《苏德互不侵犯条约》，以确保在入侵波兰时苏联不会干预。
description.en: Nazi Germany signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact with the Soviet Union to ensure Soviet non-intervention in the invasion of Poland.

description.zh-cn: 苏联与纳粹德国签署了《苏德互不侵犯条约》，其中秘密议定书划分了双方在东欧的势力范围。
description.en: The Soviet Union signed the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact with Nazi Germany, which included a secret protocol dividing Eastern Europe into spheres of influence.

description.zh-cn: 1941年6月22日，纳粹德国发动“巴巴罗萨行动”，入侵苏联。
description.en: On 22 June 1941, Nazi Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, the invasion of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 德国发动“巴巴罗萨行动”入侵苏联，撕毁了《苏德互不侵犯条约》。
description.en: Germany's launch of Operation Barbarossa, invading the Soviet Union, broke the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact.

description.zh-cn: 德国在斯大林格勒战役中战败是东线战场的转折点，苏联开始向西部推进。
description.en: The German defeat at the Battle of Stalingrad was the turning point on the Eastern Front, after which the Soviet Union began its advance westward.

description.zh-cn: 1944年6月6日，同盟国军队在诺曼底登陆，开辟了欧洲西线战场。
description.en: On June 6, 1944, Allied forces landed in Normandy, opening a Western Front in Europe.

description.zh-cn: 约有六百万犹太人在大屠杀中被杀害。
description.en: Approximately six million Jews were murdered in the Holocaust.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战后，同盟国组织了纽伦堡审判，以审判纳粹领导人的战争罪行。
description.en: After World War II, the Allied powers organized the Nuremberg trials to prosecute Nazi leaders for war crimes.

description.zh-cn: 纽伦堡审判对纳粹党的多名高级官员进行了审判并判处其罪名成立，同时宣布纳粹党为犯罪组织。
description.en: The Nuremberg trials prosecuted and convicted many high-ranking officials of the Nazi Party, which was declared a criminal organization.

description.zh-cn: 自1929年起，海因里希·希姆莱担任党卫队全国领袖。
description.en: From 1929, Heinrich Himmler served as Reichsführer-SS, the commander of the Schutzstaffel.

description.zh-cn: 党卫队是执行犹太人大屠杀的主要组织，负责管理集中营和灭绝营，并组织别动队进行大规模屠杀。
description.en: The SS was the primary organization responsible for carrying out the Holocaust, managing concentration and extermination camps, and organizing the Einsatzgruppen for mass killings.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，胡凡夫是浙江镇海人。
description.en: According to the text, Hu Fanfu is a native of Zhenhai, Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 胡凡夫曾任北京图书馆副馆长。
description.en: Hu Fanfu once served as the Deputy Director of the Beijing Library.

description.zh-cn: 胡凡夫曾任中国科学院系统科学研究所党委书记、副所长。
description.en: Hu Fanfu once served as the Party Secretary and Deputy Director of the Institute of Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 胡凡夫曾任中国数学会常务理事。
description.en: Hu Fanfu once served as a standing council member of the Chinese Mathematical Society.

description.zh-cn: 胡凡夫曾任中国系统工程学会常务理事。
description.en: Hu Fanfu once served as a standing council member of the Systems Engineering Society of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类“中国共产党党员”推断，胡凡夫是中国共产党的党员。
description.en: Inferred from the page category 'Communist Party of China members', Hu Fanfu is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市卫生健康委员会是深圳市人民政府的组成部门。
description.en: The Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission is a component department of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government.

position.zh-cn: 市委卫生工委书记、主任
position.en: Secretary of the Health Work Committee of the Municipal CPC Committee and Director

description.zh-cn: 吴红艳担任深圳市卫生健康委员会的主要领导职务。
description.en: Wu Hongyan holds the main leadership position at the Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2023年5月，深圳市疾病预防控制局挂牌成立，由深圳市卫生健康委员会加挂牌子。
description.en: In May 2023, the Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Disease Prevention and Control was officially established, with its nameplate additionally displayed by the Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 深圳市卫健委公众号模仿《平安经》文体发布《健康经》一文，以蹭热点的方式进行健康科普，引发网络关注。
description.en: The WeChat official account of the Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission imitated the style of 'Ping An Jing' to publish an article titled 'Health Sutra', using the trending topic for health education, which attracted online attention.

description.zh-cn: 作为市属医院，深圳市人民医院在行政和业务上接受深圳市卫生健康委员会的管理和指导。
description.en: As a municipal hospital, Shenzhen People's Hospital is under the administrative and professional management and guidance of the Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 作为市属医院，香港大学深圳医院在行政和业务上接受深圳市卫生健康委员会的管理和指导。
description.en: As a municipal hospital, The University of Hong Kong-Shenzhen Hospital is under the administrative and professional management and guidance of the Shenzhen Municipal Health Commission.

description.zh-cn: 徐明出生于辽宁省大连市庄河市吴炉镇光华村。
description.en: Xu Ming was born in Guanghua Village, Wulu Town, Zhuanghe City, Dalian, Liaoning Province.

degree.en: Adult Education Class in International Trade

description.zh-cn: 徐明毕业于沈阳航空工业学院（现沈阳航空航天大学）国际贸易专业成教班。
description.en: Xu Ming graduated from the adult education program in International Trade at Shenyang Institute of Aeronautical Engineering (now Shenyang Aerospace University).

description.zh-cn: 徐明毕业于东北财经大学，获得商业经济硕士学位。
description.en: Xu Ming graduated from Dongbei University of Finance and Economics with a Master's degree in Commercial Economics.

description.zh-cn: 徐明是中国致公党党员。
description.en: Xu Ming was a member of the China Zhi Gong Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据资料，徐明于2006年至2015年间与田海蓉为夫妻关系。
description.en: According to records, Xu Ming was married to Tian Hairong from 2006 to 2015.

description.zh-cn: 徐斌是徐明的胞兄。
description.en: Xu Bin is Xu Ming's elder brother.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，徐明通过受让股份全面控制了公司，并将其发展为实德集团。
description.en: In 1999, Xu Ming gained full control of the company through a share transfer and developed it into the Shide Group.

description.zh-cn: 自1992年起，徐明与时任大连市长的薄熙来及其家庭往来密切。
description.en: Starting in 1992, Xu Ming had a close relationship with Bo Xilai, then mayor of Dalian, and his family.

description.zh-cn: 徐明在薄熙来案庭审中被指控多年来向薄熙来行贿两千多万元人民币。
description.en: During the trial of Bo Xilai's case, Xu Ming was accused of bribing Bo Xilai with over 20 million RMB over many years.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，徐明出资陪同谷开来和薄瓜瓜赴英国考察学校。
description.en: In 1998, Xu Ming funded and accompanied Gu Kailai and Bo Guagua on a trip to the UK to inspect schools.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，徐明出资陪同谷开来和薄瓜瓜赴英国考察学校。
description.en: In 1998, Xu Ming funded and accompanied Gu Kailai and Bo Guagua on a trip to the UK to inspect schools.

description.zh-cn: 徐明曾赠送王立军直系亲属两套位于北京的房产，价值285万元人民币。
description.en: Xu Ming gifted two properties in Beijing, valued at 2.85 million RMB, to Wang Lijun's immediate family members.

description.zh-cn: 因涉及薄熙来案，徐明于2012年被调查，后被判刑入狱，并最终在狱中去世。
description.en: Due to his involvement in the Bo Xilai case, Xu Ming was investigated in 2012, subsequently sentenced to prison, and ultimately died while incarcerated.

description.zh-cn: 2015年12月4日，徐明据报因急性心肌梗死在武汉狱中去世。
description.en: On December 4, 2015, Xu Ming reportedly died of an acute myocardial infarction in a Wuhan prison.

description.zh-cn: 1999年，实德集团从万达集团手中全面接手大连万达队，并更名为大连实德足球俱乐部。
description.en: In 1999, Shide Group took over the Dalian Wanda team from Wanda Group and renamed it Dalian Shide Football Club.

description.zh-cn: 徐明在中国足坛中一手打造了通过控股或关联关系拥有多个足球俱乐部的“实德系”。
description.en: Xu Ming single-handedly created the 'Shide system' in Chinese football, which owned multiple football clubs through holding or affiliated relationships.

description.zh-cn: 叶刘淑仪提议增加赛马会足球博彩收入税，赛马会对此表示反对，认为此举将“摧毁”其商业模式。
description.en: Regina Ip proposed to increase the tax on the Jockey Club's football betting revenue, which the Club opposed, stating it would 'destroy' its business model.

description.zh-cn: 作为财政司司长，陈茂波增加了对香港赛马会的足球博彩税。
description.en: As Financial Secretary, Paul Chan increased the football betting tax levied on the Hong Kong Jockey Club.

description.zh-cn: 在香港日占时期，香港赛马会被占领地总督部正式改名为“香港竞马会”。
description.en: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, the Hong Kong Jockey Club was officially renamed the 'Hong Kong Race Club' by the occupation administration.

description.zh-cn: 1960年代末发生的毒马案促使香港赛马会推行职业赛马制度。
description.en: The horse poisoning scandal in the late 1960s prompted the Hong Kong Jockey Club to professionalize horse racing.

description.zh-cn: 黄至刚于1996年成为香港赛马会首位华人行政总裁。
description.en: Larry Wong became the first Chinese Chief Executive Officer of the Hong Kong Jockey Club in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会协办了2008年北京奥运会的马术比赛项目。
description.en: The Hong Kong Jockey Club co-organized the equestrian events for the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 香港赛马会慈善信托基金于2018年向香港城市大学捐款五亿港元，资助其动物医学及生命科学院。
description.en: In 2018, The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust donated HK$500 million to the City University of Hong Kong to support its College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 为答谢香港赛马会的捐款，香港城市大学将其动物医学及生命科学院更名为“赛马会动物医学及生命科学院”。
description.en: In gratitude for the donation from the Hong Kong Jockey Club, the City University of Hong Kong renamed its College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences to the 'Jockey Club College of Veterinary Medicine and Life Sciences'.

description.zh-cn: 1796年，爱德华·詹纳证实了牛痘能有效预防天花，他将此物质命名为“疫苗”，从而开创了现代免疫预防法。
description.en: In 1796, Edward Jenner demonstrated that cowpox could effectively prevent smallpox, naming the substance 'vaccine' and thus pioneering modern methods of immunization.

description.zh-cn: 古埃及法老拉美西斯五世的木乃伊身上有明显的脓疱痕迹，被认为是史上已知最早的天花病人之一。
description.en: The mummy of ancient Egyptian pharaoh Ramesses V has distinct pockmarks, leading him to be considered one of the earliest known smallpox patients in history.

description.zh-cn: 清朝顺治皇帝因感染天花而死亡。
description.en: The Shunzhi Emperor of the Qing dynasty died from a smallpox infection.

description.zh-cn: 据记载，天花是由东汉军队南征越南时，由俘虏传入中国，当时被称为“虏疮”。
description.en: According to records, smallpox was introduced to China by captives during the southern campaign of the Eastern Han army in Vietnam, and was known at the time as 'luc chuang' (captive's sore).

description.zh-cn: 天花的传播严重削弱了印加帝国，加速了其被西班牙人征服的过程。
description.en: The spread of smallpox severely weakened the Inca Empire, accelerating its conquest by the Spanish.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中央纪律检查委员会国家监察委员会国际合作局是中央纪律检查委员会的内设机构。
description.en: According to the infobox, the International Cooperation Bureau of the CCDI and NSC is an internal department of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中央纪律检查委员会国家监察委员会国际合作局是国家监察委员会的内设机构。
description.en: According to the infobox, the International Cooperation Bureau of the CCDI and NSC is an internal department of the National Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 蔡为担任中央纪委国家监委国际合作局局长。
description.en: Cai Wei serves as the Director of the International Cooperation Bureau of the CCDI and NSC.

description.zh-cn: 第十届全国人大常委会第十八次会议批准了《联合国反腐败公约》。
description.en: The 18th session of the Standing Committee of the 10th National People's Congress ratified the United Nations Convention against Corruption.

description.zh-cn: 2007年9月6日，国家预防腐败局成立，马𫘜被任命为局长。
description.en: On September 6, 2007, the National Bureau of Corruption Prevention was established, and Ma Wen was appointed as its Director.

description.zh-cn: 根据2018年国务院机构改革方案，监察部并入新组建的国家监察委员会，不再保留。
description.en: According to the 2018 State Council Institutional Reform Plan, the Ministry of Supervision was merged into the newly formed National Supervisory Commission and was no longer retained.

description.zh-cn: 根据2018年国务院机构改革方案，国家预防腐败局并入新组建的国家监察委员会，不再保留。
description.en: According to the 2018 State Council Institutional Reform Plan, the National Bureau of Corruption Prevention was merged into the newly formed National Supervisory Commission and was no longer retained.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月改革后，中央纪委国家监委组建了中央纪律检查委员会国家监察委员会国际合作局。
description.en: After the reform in March 2018, the CCDI and NSC established the International Cooperation Bureau of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月改革后，中央纪委国家监委组建了中央纪律检查委员会国家监察委员会国际合作局。
description.en: After the reform in March 2018, the CCDI and NSC established the International Cooperation Bureau of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 腊翊凡曾任中央纪委国家监委国际合作局局长。
description.en: La Yifan served as the Director of the International Cooperation Bureau of the CCDI and NSC.

description.zh-cn: 黄树贤是中央反腐败协调小组国际追逃追赃工作办公室首任负责人。
description.en: Huang Shuxian was the first head of the International Fugitive Repatriation and Asset Recovery Office of the Central Anti-Corruption Coordination Group.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊曾任中央反腐败协调小组国际追逃追赃工作办公室主任。
description.en: Li Shulei served as the Director of the International Fugitive Repatriation and Asset Recovery Office of the Central Anti-Corruption Coordination Group.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊在担任办公室主任期间，兼任中央纪委副书记。
description.en: While serving as the Director of the office, Li Shulei also held the position of Deputy Secretary of the CCDI.

description.zh-cn: 1978年考入湖南财经学院。
description.en: Enrolled in Hunan College of Finance and Economics in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 于2025年10月27日因严重违纪违法被开除党籍。
description.en: Was expelled from the Party on October 27, 2025, for serious violations of discipline and law.

description.zh-cn: 在农行工作期间受到时任副行长戴相龙的赏识，后在戴相龙出任央行行长后，蒋超良也调入央行并成为其助手。
description.en: He was appreciated by then-Vice President Dai Xianglong while working at the Agricultural Bank. After Dai became the Governor of the People's Bank of China, Jiang was also transferred to the central bank and became his assistant.

description.zh-cn: 亚洲金融危机爆发后，蒋超良被派往人民银行深圳和广州分行担任行长，负责处置问题金融机构风险，这段经历成为其职业生涯中的重要一笔。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Asian financial crisis, Jiang Chaoliang was sent to serve as the head of the Shenzhen and Guangzhou branches of the People's Bank of China to handle the risks of troubled financial institutions, which became a significant part of his career.

description.zh-cn: 在广东处置亚洲金融危机后的问题金融机构风险时，协助时任中共广东省委常委、副省长王岐山。
description.en: While handling the risks of troubled financial institutions in Guangdong after the Asian financial crisis, he assisted Wang Qishan, who was then a member of the Standing Committee of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee and Vice Governor.

description.zh-cn: 蒋超良接替项俊波，担任中国农业银行董事长。
description.en: Jiang Chaoliang succeeded Xiang Junbo as Chairman of the Agricultural Bank of China.

description.zh-cn: 2014年9月至10月任代省长，2014年10月起正式担任省长。
description.en: Served as Acting Governor from September to October 2014, and officially became Governor in October 2014.

description.zh-cn: 刘国中接替蒋超良担任吉林省省长职务。
description.en: Liu Guozhong succeeded Jiang Chaoliang as the Governor of Jilin Province.

description.zh-cn: 蒋超良接替李鸿忠担任中共湖北省委书记职务。
description.en: Jiang Chaoliang succeeded Li Hongzhong as the Party Secretary of Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 应勇接替蒋超良担任中共湖北省委书记职务。
description.en: Ying Yong succeeded Jiang Chaoliang as the Party Secretary of Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 蒋超良担任中共湖北省委书记期间，王晓东为副书记兼省长。
description.en: While Jiang Chaoliang served as Party Secretary of Hubei, Wang Xiaodong was the Deputy Secretary and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 作为地方党委负责人，蒋超良向以习近平为核心的党中央负责。
description.en: As the head of a local party committee, Jiang Chaoliang was responsible to the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core.

description.zh-cn: 因在疫情初期防疫不力等问题，蒋超良被免去中共湖北省委书记职务。
description.en: Due to issues including ineffective epidemic prevention in the early stages of the outbreak, Jiang Chaoliang was removed from his position as Party Secretary of Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 因涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委的纪律审查和监察调查，并最终于2025年10月27日被开除党籍和公职。
description.en: He was subjected to disciplinary review and supervisory investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, and was ultimately expelled from the Party and public office on October 27, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 赵大春是江苏泰州人。
description.en: Zhao Dachun is a native of Taizhou, Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 赵大春是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhao Dachun is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1989年至1993年在东南大学学习，取得工学学士学位。
description.en: From 1989 to 1993, he studied at Southeast University and obtained a Bachelor of Engineering degree.

description.zh-cn: 在江苏移动任职期间，在南京大学学习并获得工商管理专业硕士学位。
description.en: While working at China Mobile Jiangsu, he studied at Nanjing University and obtained a Master of Business Administration degree.

position.en: Member of the Party Leadership Group, Deputy General Manager

description.zh-cn: 自1993年大学毕业后即进入中国移动工作，曾历任江苏、陕西、四川分公司及集团总部的多个领导职务，最终于2019年1月升任集团党组成员、副总经理，直至2023年10月调离。
description.en: After graduating from university in 1993, he joined China Mobile and held various leadership positions in Jiangsu, Shaanxi, and Sichuan branches, as well as at the group headquarters. He was eventually promoted to Member of the Party Leadership Group and Deputy General Manager in January 2019, a position he held until his transfer in October 2023.

description.zh-cn: 在陕西移动任职期间，当选为政协陕西省第十一届委员会委员。
description.en: During his tenure at China Mobile Shaanxi, he was elected as a member of the 11th Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，赵大春当选为四川省第十三届全国人大代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Zhao Dachun was elected as a delegate from Sichuan Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

position.en: Member of the Party Leadership Group, Vice Governor

description.zh-cn: 2023年10月，赵大春调任河北省人民政府，担任党组成员、副省长。
description.en: In October 2023, Zhao Dachun was transferred to the Hebei Provincial People's Government, serving as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice Governor.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋于1950年4月2日出生于中国陕西省西安市。
description.en: Zhang Yimou was born in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, China on April 2, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋与第一任妻子肖华于1978年结婚，1988年离婚。
description.en: Zhang Yimou married his first wife, Xiao Hua, in 1978 and they divorced in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 张末是张艺谋与前妻肖华的女儿。
description.en: Zhang Mo is the daughter of Zhang Yimou and his ex-wife Xiao Hua.

description.zh-cn: 张末是肖华与前夫张艺谋的女儿。
description.en: Zhang Mo is the daughter of Xiao Hua and her ex-husband Zhang Yimou.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋于1988年导演了电影《红高粱》，该片使他在国际上声名大噪。
description.en: Zhang Yimou directed the film 'Red Sorghum' in 1988, which brought him international fame.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间，张艺谋高中毕业后被迫中断正常的人生轨迹，到陕西农村“上山下乡”进行劳动。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, after graduating from high school, Zhang Yimou was forced to interrupt his normal life path and was sent to the countryside in Shaanxi for manual labor under the 'Up to the Mountains and Down to the Countryside Movement'.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋担任2008年北京奥运会开闭幕式的总导演，获得了极高的声誉。
description.en: Zhang Yimou served as the chief director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2008 Beijing Olympics, earning immense prestige.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋担任2022年北京冬奥会和冬残奥会开闭幕式总导演，成为世界首位“双奥”总导演。
description.en: Zhang Yimou served as the chief director for the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics, becoming the world's first 'Dual Olympic' chief director.

description.zh-cn: 张艺谋导演的电影《活着》因其内容涉及历次政治运动，至今未在中国大陆获准公映。
description.en: The film 'To Live', directed by Zhang Yimou, has not been approved for public release in mainland China to this day due to its content involving various political movements.

description.zh-cn: 因怀疑蓝玉谋反，明太祖下令将其处死，并夷其三族。
description.en: Suspecting Lan Yu of rebellion, Emperor Taizu ordered his execution and the extermination of his three closest kin groups.

description.zh-cn: 锦衣卫指挥使蒋𤩽向明太祖告发蓝玉意图谋反，直接引发了蓝玉案。
description.en: Jinyiwei commander Jiang Lü reported to Emperor Taizu that Lan Yu was plotting a rebellion, directly triggering the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 在接到蓝玉谋反的指控后，明太祖下令彻查并展开大规模清洗，是蓝玉案的最高决策者和执行者。
description.en: After receiving the accusation of Lan Yu's rebellion, Emperor Taizu ordered a thorough investigation and launched a large-scale purge, acting as the ultimate decision-maker and executor of the Lan Yu case.

description.zh-cn: 蓝玉在此案中被以“谋反罪”处死。
description.en: Lan Yu was executed on charges of rebellion in this case.

description.zh-cn: 蓝玉早年隶属于其姐夫常遇春的麾下，开始其军事生涯。
description.en: In his early years, Lan Yu began his military career under the command of his brother-in-law, Chang Yuchun.

description.zh-cn: 常遇春因蓝玉“临战勇敢，所向多捷”，多次在朱元璋面前称赞并举荐他。
description.en: Because Lan Yu was 'brave in battle and victorious wherever he went,' Chang Yuchun praised and recommended him to Zhu Yuanzhang on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 蓝玉因是太子朱标的姻亲，两人经常友好往来。
description.en: As a relative-in-law of Crown Prince Zhu Biao, Lan Yu frequently maintained a friendly relationship with him.

description.zh-cn: 在太子朱标死后，朱棣向明太祖进言，称“在朝公侯，纵恣不法，将来恐尾大不掉”，暗示应及早处置蓝玉等将领，推动了清洗的发生。
description.en: After the death of Crown Prince Zhu Biao, Zhu Di advised Emperor Taizu, stating that the dukes and marquises at court were 'unruly and lawless, and might become too powerful to control in the future,' suggesting that generals like Lan Yu should be dealt with promptly, thus promoting the purge.

description.zh-cn: 蓝玉多次率领明军征讨北元，并在捕鱼儿海战役中给予其主力毁灭性打击。
description.en: Lan Yu led the Ming army on several expeditions against the Northern Yuan and dealt a devastating blow to its main force at the Battle of Buir Lake.

description.zh-cn: 洪武二十一年（1388年），蓝玉率军征伐北元皇帝脱古思帖木儿，在捕鱼儿海大破其主力。
description.en: In 1388, Lan Yu led an army to campaign against the Northern Yuan Emperor Tögüs Temür, decisively defeating his main force at Buir Lake.

description.zh-cn: 蓝玉曾两次在傅友德麾下作战，分别是在洪武四年（1371年）进攻四川和洪武十四年（1381年）作为征南左副将军进攻云南。
description.en: Lan Yu fought under Fu Youde's command on two occasions: during the attack on Sichuan in 1371, and as the Left Deputy General for the Southern Conquest during the attack on Yunnan in 1381.

description.zh-cn: 洪武五年（1372年），蓝玉跟随大将军徐达征讨北元。
description.en: In 1372, Lan Yu followed Grand General Xu Da on an expedition against the Northern Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 洪武二十年（1387年），蓝玉作为右副将军，跟随征虏大将军冯胜北征纳哈出。
description.en: In 1387, as the Right Deputy General, Lan Yu followed the Grand General Who Conquers Barbarians, Feng Sheng, on a northern expedition against Nahacu.

description.zh-cn: 在蓝玉案发生后不久，颍国公傅友德亦被迫自尽。
description.en: Shortly after the Lan Yu case, Fu Youde, the Duke of Ying, was also forced to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 在蓝玉案发生后不久，宋国公冯胜亦被杀。
description.en: Shortly after the Lan Yu case, Feng Sheng, the Duke of Song, was also killed.

description.zh-cn: 在蓝玉案发生后不久，定远侯王弼亦被迫自尽。
description.en: Shortly after the Lan Yu case, Wang Bi, the Marquis of Dingyuan, was also forced to commit suicide.

description.zh-cn: 景川侯曹震在蓝玉案中被指为同党，并被诛杀。
description.en: Cao Zhen, the Marquis of Jingchuan, was accused of being an accomplice in the Lan Yu case and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 鹤庆侯张翼在蓝玉案中被指为同党，并被诛杀。
description.en: Zhang Yi, the Marquis of Heqing, was accused of being an accomplice in the Lan Yu case and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 夏世厚早年参加中国工农红军。
description.en: Xia Shihou joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in his early years.

position.zh-cn: 第七十三师营政治委员、交通队队长
position.en: Battalion Political Commissar of the 73rd Division, Captain of the Traffic Team

description.zh-cn: 夏世厚曾任红二十五军第七十三师营政治委员、红二十五军交通队队长。
description.en: Xia Shihou served as the Battalion Political Commissar of the 73rd Division of the Red 25th Army and the Captain of the Traffic Team of the Red 25th Army.

description.zh-cn: 夏世厚参加了长征。
description.en: Xia Shihou participated in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，夏世厚担任八路军129师686团1营营长。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Xia Shihou served as the commander of the 1st Battalion, 686th Regiment, 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，夏世厚担任新四军豫鄂挺进纵队第二团一营营长。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Xia Shihou served as the commander of the 1st Battalion, 2nd Regiment of the New Fourth Army's Henan-Hubei Advance Column.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，夏世厚担任新四军第五师第13旅第37团团长。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Xia Shihou served as the commander of the 37th Regiment, 13th Brigade, 5th Division of the New Fourth Army.

position.en: Commander of the 37th Regiment, 13th Brigade, 2nd Column

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，夏世厚担任中原军区二纵第13旅第37团团长。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, Xia Shihou served as the commander of the 37th Regiment, 13th Brigade, 2nd Column of the Central Plains Military Region.

position.en: Deputy Commander of the 34th Brigade, 12th Column

description.zh-cn: 第二次国共内战期间，夏世厚担任晋冀鲁豫野战军十二纵第34旅副旅长。
description.en: During the Second Chinese Civil War, Xia Shihou served as the Deputy Commander of the 34th Brigade, 12th Column of the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army.

position.en: Commander of the Daye Military Sub-district

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国成立后，夏世厚担任湖北军区大冶军分区司令员。
description.en: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, Xia Shihou served as the Commander of the Daye Military Sub-district of the Hubei Military District.

description.zh-cn: 1962年，夏世厚升任湖北省副省长。
description.en: In 1962, Xia Shihou was promoted to Vice Governor of Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 1973年，夏世厚任湖北省革命委员会副主任。
description.en: In 1973, Xia Shihou served as the Vice Chairman of the Hubei Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1980年，夏世厚改任湖北省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: In 1980, Xia Shihou was reassigned as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 夏世厚后选任中顾委委员。
description.en: Xia Shihou was later elected as a member of the Central Advisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业机械部是中华人民共和国国务院的一个组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Agricultural Machinery was a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 陈正人担任中华人民共和国农业机械部部长。
description.en: Chen Zhengren served as the Minister of the Ministry of Agricultural Machinery of the People's Republic of China.

position.en: Director of the Military Control Committee

description.zh-cn: 周特夫担任中华人民共和国农业机械部军管会主任。
description.en: Zhou Tefu served as the Director of the Military Control Committee of the Ministry of Agricultural Machinery of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国农业机械部自1963年起在北河沿大街（当时称东安门北街）147号办公。
description.en: The Ministry of Agricultural Machinery of the People's Republic of China had its offices at No. 147 Beiheyan Street (then called Dong'anmen North Street) starting from 1963.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，中央人民广播电台建制撤销，并入新组建的中央广播电视总台。
description.en: In March 2018, the establishment of China National Radio was abolished, and it was merged into the newly formed China Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 2018年3月，中国国际广播电台建制撤销，并入新组建的中央广播电视总台。
description.en: In March 2018, the establishment of China Radio International was abolished, and it was merged into the newly formed China Media Group.

description.zh-cn: 2002年，经国家广播电影电视总局批准，中央人民广播电台的英文名称由“China People's Broadcasting Station”改为“China National Radio”。
description.en: In 2002, with the approval of the State Administration of Radio, Film, and Television, the English name of China National Radio was changed from 'China People's Broadcasting Station' to 'China National Radio'.

description.zh-cn: 国家应急广播中心于2013年12月3日在北京揭牌成立，设在中央人民广播电台。
description.en: The National Emergency Broadcasting Center was unveiled and established in Beijing on December 3, 2013, and is located at China National Radio.

position.en: Vice Chairman, Member of the Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 刘兴中曾担任宁夏回族自治区人大常委会副主任、党组成员。
description.en: Liu Xingzhong served as the Vice Chairman and a member of the Party Leadership Group of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，刘兴中是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to Wikipedia categories, Liu Xingzhong is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 刘兴中是宁夏银川人。
description.en: Liu Xingzhong is from Yinchuan, Ningxia.

description.zh-cn: 周恩来视察大庆油田时，肯定了工农结合、城乡结合的建设方式，推动了后来安达特区（大庆市前身）的建立。
description.en: During his inspection of the Daqing Oil Field, Zhou Enlai affirmed the construction method integrating workers and peasants, and town and country, which promoted the later establishment of the Anda Special District (predecessor of Daqing City).

description.zh-cn: 安达特区（大庆市前身）成立后，受石油工业部与黑龙江省的双重领导。
description.en: After its establishment, Anda Special District (predecessor of Daqing City) was under the dual leadership of the Ministry of Petroleum Industry and Heilongjiang Province.

position.en: Party Secretary of Anda Special District

description.zh-cn: 徐今强在担任石油部副部长、大庆会战指挥部指挥的同时，兼任安达特区工委书记。
description.en: While serving as Vice Minister of the Ministry of Petroleum Industry and Commander of the Daqing Battle Command, Xu Jinqiang also served as the Party Secretary of Anda Special District.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在中央工作会议上指出要采取紧急措施加快攀枝花工业基地的建设，直接推动了攀枝花特区的设立。
description.en: At a Central Work Conference, Mao Zedong pointed out the need for urgent measures to accelerate the construction of the Panzhihua industrial base, which directly promoted the establishment of the Panzhihua Special District.

description.zh-cn: 中共中央西南局向中央提交了《关于成立攀枝花工业区政府的请示》，建议成立工业区人民政府。
description.en: The Southwest Bureau of the CPC Central Committee submitted a "Request on the Establishment of the Panzhihua Industrial Zone Government" to the Central Committee, proposing the establishment of an industrial zone people's government.

description.zh-cn: 在讨论“三五”计划的中央工作会议上，毛泽东对时任国家计委主任的李富春谈话，强调西南三线建设要抓紧。
