description.en: During a Central Work Conference discussing the Third Five-Year Plan, Mao Zedong spoke with Li Fuchun, then Director of the State Planning Commission, emphasizing the need to press ahead with the Third Front construction in the southwest.

description.zh-cn: 原郎岱县并入六枝特区。
description.en: The former Langdai County was merged into Liuzhi Special District.

description.zh-cn: 胡传志出生于安徽省庐江县。
description.en: Hu Chuanzhi was born in Lujiang County, Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 胡传志是中华人民共和国国籍。
description.en: Hu Chuanzhi is a citizen of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 胡传志是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Hu Chuanzhi is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1985年毕业于安徽师范大学中文系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Chinese at Anhui Normal University in 1985.

description.zh-cn: 1988年于四川大学获硕士学位。
description.en: Received a master's degree from Sichuan University in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 1993年于南京大学获博士学位。
description.en: Received a doctoral degree from Nanjing University in 1993.

description.zh-cn: 1988年起任教于安徽师范大学。
description.en: Began teaching at Anhui Normal University in 1988.

description.zh-cn: 享受国务院政府特殊津贴专家。
description.en: An expert who enjoys the special government allowances of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 范瑾是俞强声的母亲。
description.en: Fan Jin is the mother of Yu Qiangsheng.

description.zh-cn: 俞敏声是俞强声的弟弟。
description.en: Yu Minsheng is the younger brother of Yu Qiangsheng.

description.zh-cn: 俞慈声是俞强声的妹妹。
description.en: Yu Cisheng is the younger sister of Yu Qiangsheng.

description.zh-cn: 俞强声毕业于北京国际关系学院。
description.en: Yu Qiangsheng graduated from the Institute of International Relations in Beijing.

position.zh-cn: 北美情报司司长、外事局主任
position.en: Director of North American Intelligence Bureau, Director of Foreign Affairs Bureau

description.zh-cn: 改革开放后，俞强声在中华人民共和国国家安全部任北美情报司司长、外事局主任。
description.en: After the Reform and Opening Up, Yu Qiangsheng served as the Director of the North American Intelligence Bureau and Director of the Foreign Affairs Bureau at the Ministry of State Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 俞强声叛逃后为美国提供情报。
description.en: After his defection, Yu Qiangsheng provided intelligence to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 在一打三反运动期间，俞强声担任了处理张郎郎案的专案组组长。
description.en: During the One Strike-Three Anti Campaign, Yu Qiangsheng served as the head of the special case group handling the Zhang Langlang case.

description.zh-cn: 俞大纯是俞启威的父亲。
description.en: Yu Dachun is the father of Yu Qiwei.

description.zh-cn: 俞明震是俞大纯的父亲。
description.en: Yu Mingzhen is the father of Yu Dachun.

description.zh-cn: 俞文葆是俞明震的父亲。
description.en: Yu Wenbao is the father of Yu Mingzhen.

description.zh-cn: 俞扬和与蒋孝章是夫妻关系。
description.en: Yu Yanghe and Jiang Xiaozhang were husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 俞慈声曾将微软踢出中国市场。
description.en: Yu Cisheng once kicked Microsoft out of the Chinese market.

description.zh-cn: 文本描述倪光南为柳传志的“死对头”。
description.en: The text describes Ni Guangnan as the 'nemesis' of Liu Chuanzhi.

description.zh-cn: 倪光南与多名学者上书朱镕基声援俞慈声。
description.en: Ni Guangnan, along with several other scholars, submitted a letter to Zhu Rongji to support Yu Cisheng.

description.zh-cn: 作为主管单位，推动实施“千人计划”。
description.en: As the supervising authority, it promoted the implementation of the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 作为主管单位，推动实施“千人计划”。
description.en: As the supervising authority, it promoted the implementation of the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 在担任中央组织部部长等职务期间，负责推动实施“千人计划”。
description.en: While serving as the head of the Central Organization Department and other positions, he was responsible for promoting the implementation of the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 屏蔽了“千人计划”相关的搜索结果。
description.en: Blocked search results related to the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.en: Blocked content related to the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 陈锟山于2014年入选“千人计划”。
description.en: Chen Kun-shan was selected for the 'Thousand Talents Program' in 2014.

description.zh-cn: 曾任国立中央大学教授，于2013年8月离职。
description.en: Formerly a professor at National Central University, he resigned in August 2013.

description.zh-cn: 自2014年3月起任职于中国科学院遥感与数字地球研究所。
description.en: He has been working at the Institute of Remote Sensing and Digital Earth, Chinese Academy of Sciences since March 2014.

description.zh-cn: 北京大学生命科学学院是北京大学的下属学院。
description.en: The School of Life Sciences is a subordinate school of Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 美国检方起诉查尔斯·利伯，控其收受武汉理工大学的资金并隐瞒与“千人计划”的关系。
description.en: U.S. prosecutors indicted Charles Lieber, accusing him of receiving funds from Wuhan University of Technology and concealing his relationship with the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 向查尔斯·利伯提供每月最多5万美元的工资、每年15万美元的生活费以及150万美元的科研经费。
description.en: Provided Charles Lieber with a salary of up to $50,000 per month, $150,000 in annual living expenses, and $1.5 million in research funding.

description.zh-cn: 因未披露与“千人计划”的关系而被捕。
description.en: Arrested for failing to disclose his relationship with the 'Thousand Talents Program'.

description.zh-cn: 联邦检察官驳回了针对王擎的案件。
description.en: Federal prosecutors dismissed the case against Wang Qing.

description.zh-cn: 生产资料所有制的社会主义改造是过渡时期总路线所包含的核心内容之一。
description.en: The socialist transformation of the ownership of the means of production was one of the core components included in the General Line for the Transition Period.

description.zh-cn: 生产资料所有制的社会主义改造在中华人民共和国境内进行，并深刻改变了其经济基础。
description.en: The socialist transformation of the ownership of the means of production was carried out within the People's Republic of China and profoundly changed its economic foundation.

description.zh-cn: 1956年底三大改造基本完成，标志着社会主义制度（经济方面）在中国基本建立。
description.en: The basic completion of the Three Great Transformations by the end of 1956 marked the fundamental establishment of the socialist system (in its economic aspect) in China.

description.zh-cn: 社会主义制度在中国的基本建立，标志着中国进入社会主义初级阶段。
description.en: The fundamental establishment of the socialist system in China marked the country's entry into the primary stage of socialism.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平在1981年的《关于建国以来党的若干历史问题的决议》中第一次明确提出了“社会主义初级阶段”的概念。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping first clearly proposed the concept of the 'primary stage of socialism' in the 1981 'Resolution on Certain Questions in the History of Our Party Since the Founding of the People's Republic of China'.

description.zh-cn: 该决议第一次明确提出了“社会主义初级阶段”的概念。
description.en: This resolution was the first to clearly propose the concept of the 'primary stage of socialism'.

description.zh-cn: 关于社会主义初级阶段的论述被总结为邓小平理论的重要组成部分。
description.en: The discourse on the primary stage of socialism was summarized as an important component of Deng Xiaoping Theory.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南于1924年进入黄埔军校第一期学习。
description.en: Hu Zongnan enrolled in the first class of the Whampoa Military Academy in 1924.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南是中国国民党党员，并曾担任第五届中央督察委员、第六届中央执行委员、第七及第八届中央评议委员等职务。
description.en: Hu Zongnan was a member of the Kuomintang and served in positions such as member of the 5th Central Supervisory Committee, member of the 6th Central Executive Committee, and member of the 7th and 8th Central Review Committees.

description.zh-cn: 熊向晖长期潜伏在胡宗南身边，担任其侍从副官和机要秘书。
description.en: Xiong Xianghui was deeply embedded in Hu Zongnan's circle for a long time, serving as his aide-de-camp and confidential secretary.

description.zh-cn: 熊向晖是周恩来领导下的中共情报人员之一。
description.en: Xiong Xianghui was one of the CCP intelligence agents under the leadership of Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 在东征和北伐期间，胡宗南在何应钦指挥的部队中任职，并因战功获得赏识。
description.en: During the Eastern and Northern Expeditions, Hu Zongnan served in the troops commanded by He Yingqin and gained recognition for his military achievements.

description.zh-cn: 宜川战役是胡宗南在西北战场上的一次重大军事失利。
description.en: The Yichuan Campaign was a major military defeat for Hu Zongnan on the Northwest battlefield.

description.zh-cn: 胡宗南于1945年7月31日被任命为第一战区司令长官。
description.en: Hu Zongnan was appointed as the Commanding Officer of the First War Area on July 31, 1945.

description.zh-cn: 在1883年至1885年间，法兰西第三共和国与清朝因越南主权问题爆发了中法战争。
description.en: From 1883 to 1885, the French Third Republic and the Qing dynasty were engaged in the Sino-French War over the issue of sovereignty in Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 在中法战争期间，黑旗军在越南协助清军抵抗法军。
description.en: During the Sino-French War, the Black Flag Army assisted the Qing army in Vietnam in resisting the French forces.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争以法国胜利告终，清朝被迫签订《中法新约》，丧失了对越南的宗主权。
description.en: The Sino-French War ended in a French victory, forcing the Qing dynasty to sign the Treaty of Tientsin and relinquish its suzerainty over Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 法国为扩大在越南的殖民势力而发动了中法战争，并最终取得胜利。
description.en: France initiated the Sino-French War to expand its colonial influence in Vietnam and ultimately emerged victorious.

description.zh-cn: 在镇南关之役中，冯子材率领清军大败法军，取得了中法战争中清军最主要的陆战胜利。
description.en: In the Battle of Zhennan Pass, Feng Zicai led the Qing army to a major victory over the French forces, achieving the most significant land victory for the Qing in the Sino-French War.

description.zh-cn: 镇南关战败的消息传到巴黎后，法国总理茹费理的内阁因此引咎辞职。
description.en: After the news of the defeat at Zhennan Pass reached Paris, the cabinet of French Prime Minister Jules Ferry resigned.

description.zh-cn: 在马江之役中，法国远东舰队司令孤拔率舰全歼了清朝福建水师。
description.en: In the Battle of Fuzhou, the commander of the French Far East Squadron, Amédée Courbet, led his fleet to annihilate the Qing dynasty's Fujian Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 在纸桥之役中，刘永福领导的黑旗军伏击法军，击毙了法军指挥官李威利。
description.en: In the Battle of Paper Bridge, the Black Flag Army led by Liu Yongfu ambushed the French forces, killing their commander, Henri Rivière.

description.zh-cn: 在中法战争期间，刘铭传率军在台湾成功抵御了法军的进攻。
description.en: During the Sino-French War, Liu Mingchuan led troops to successfully defend Taiwan against French attacks.

description.zh-cn: 因战争初期在越南战场的接连失利，慈禧太后罢免了恭亲王奕䜣的首席军机大臣等职务。
description.en: Due to successive defeats on the Vietnamese battlefield in the early stages of the war, Empress Dowager Cixi dismissed Prince Gong (Yixin) from his posts, including that of chief Grand Councilor.

description.zh-cn: 李鸿章作为清朝全权代表，与法国公使儒勒·巴德诺在天津会谈并签订了《中法新约》。
description.en: As the plenipotentiary representative of the Qing dynasty, Li Hongzhang met with French minister Jules Patenôtre in Tianjin to negotiate and sign the Treaty of Tientsin.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争后，清政府为加强海防，决定在台湾建省，设立福建台湾省。
description.en: After the Sino-French War, the Qing government decided to establish a province in Taiwan, creating Fujian-Taiwan Province, to strengthen coastal defense.

description.zh-cn: 日本通过观察中法战争，认识到清朝军政体制的弱点，为其后发动甲午战争提供了判断依据。
description.en: By observing the Sino-French War, Japan recognized the weaknesses of the Qing military and political systems, which provided a basis for its decision to launch the First Sino-Japanese War later.

description.zh-cn: 中法战争的爆发，引发了香港华人的爱国情绪，从而发动了反法大罢工以支持清廷。
description.en: The outbreak of the Sino-French War ignited patriotic sentiments among the Chinese population in Hong Kong, leading to the anti-French strike in support of the Qing court.

description.zh-cn: 李力果出生于陕西米脂。
description.en: Li Liguo was born in Mizhi, Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 李力果是李鼎铭的次子。
description.en: Li Liguo is the second son of Li Dingming.

description.zh-cn: 1923年，在陕西榆林中学读书。
description.en: In 1923, he studied at Yulin Middle School in Shaanxi.

description.zh-cn: 李力果受到父亲李鼎铭影响，参加学生运动。
description.en: Influenced by his father Li Dingming, Li Liguo participated in the student movement.

description.zh-cn: 李力果与刘志丹等一起发动了反对军阀井岳秀的罢课斗争。
description.en: Li Liguo, along with Liu Zhidan and others, initiated a strike against the warlord Jing Yuexiu.

description.zh-cn: 李力果与刘志丹等一起发动了反对军阀井岳秀的罢课斗争。
description.en: Li Liguo, along with Liu Zhidan and others, initiated a strike against the warlord Jing Yuexiu.

description.zh-cn: 1926年加入中国共产主义青年团。
description.en: Joined the Communist Youth League of China in 1926.

description.zh-cn: 1927年随第十九军高桂滋部参加北伐。
description.en: In 1927, he participated in the Northern Expedition with the 19th Army under Gao Guizi.

description.zh-cn: 1927年在安徽太和县转为中共党员。
description.en: Became a CCP member in Taihe County, Anhui in 1927.

description.zh-cn: 魏野畴是李力果加入中国共产党的介绍人之一。
description.en: Wei Yechou was one of the sponsors for Li Liguo to join the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 张友清是李力果加入中国共产党的介绍人之一。
description.en: Zhang Youqing was one of the sponsors for Li Liguo to join the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 阜阳暴动失败后，奉中共组织指示抵达北平，进入北京大学。
description.en: After the failure of the Fuyang Uprising, he was instructed by the CCP organization to go to Beiping and enter Peking University.

position.zh-cn: 委员、常务委员、宣传部部长
position.en: Committee Member, Standing Committee Member, Head of Propaganda Department

description.zh-cn: 1930年任中共北平市委委员、常务委员，下半年至11月任宣传部部长。
description.en: In 1930, he served as a member and standing committee member of the CCP Beiping Municipal Committee, and as the head of the Propaganda Department from the second half of the year to November.

description.zh-cn: 1936年冬，经中共北方局地下党营救出狱。
description.en: In the winter of 1936, he was rescued from prison by the underground party of the CCP Northern Bureau.

position.zh-cn: 组织训练委员会负责人、组织部部长
position.en: Head of the Organization and Training Committee, Head of the Organization Department

description.zh-cn: 1937年初任山西省牺牲救国同盟会组织训练委员会负责人，11月后任组织部部长。
description.en: In early 1937, he served as the head of the Organization and Training Committee of the Shanxi Sacrifice National Salvation League, and became the head of the Organization Department after November.

description.zh-cn: 在十二月事变中，参与第四纵队与晋绥军的作战。
description.en: During the December Incident, he participated in the combat of the 4th Column against the Jin-Sui Army.

description.zh-cn: 李力果参加了1942年开始的延安整风运动。
description.en: Li Liguo participated in the Yan'an Rectification Movement that began in 1942.

description.zh-cn: 作为晋绥代表团成员出席中共七大。
description.en: Attended the 7th National Congress of the CCP as a member of the Jin-Sui delegation.

position.zh-cn: 委员、秘书长、民族部部长、常委
position.en: Committee Member, Secretary-General, Head of Nationalities Department, Standing Committee Member

description.zh-cn: 1946年1月至12月任中共辽东省委委员、秘书长兼省委民族部部长。5月至12月任常委。
description.en: From January to December 1946, he served as a member, secretary-general, and head of the nationalities department of the CCP Liaodong Provincial Committee. From May to December, he served as a standing committee member.

description.zh-cn: 1956年10月至1959年5月，任国务院第一机械工业部副部长。
description.en: From October 1956 to May 1959, he served as the Vice Minister of the First Ministry of Machine Building of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命初期，已逝世的李力果被诬陷为叛徒，其墓碑被损毁。
description.en: During the early stage of the Cultural Revolution, the deceased Li Liguo was falsely accused of being a traitor, and his tombstone was destroyed.

description.zh-cn: 1978年12月，中共中央为李力果平反并恢复其名誉。
description.en: In December 1978, the Central Committee of the CCP posthumously rehabilitated Li Liguo and restored his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 贾庭三是河北唐县人。
description.en: Jia Tingsan was a native of Tang County, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 贾庭三曾担任中共中央顾问委员会委员。
description.en: Jia Tingsan served as a member of the Central Advisory Commission.

position.en: Deputy Director of the Enterprise Bureau

description.zh-cn: 贾庭三早年曾担任北平市人民政府企业局副局长。
description.en: In his early years, Jia Tingsan served as the Deputy Director of the Enterprise Bureau of the Beiping Municipal People's Government.

position.en: Secretary of the Secretariat; Third Secretary

description.zh-cn: 贾庭三于1964年兼任北京市委书记处书记，1979年任北京市委第三书记。
description.en: Jia Tingsan concurrently served as Secretary of the Secretariat of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee in 1964, and became the Third Secretary of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee in 1979.

description.zh-cn: 贾庭三于1971年任贵州省委副书记，1977年升任贵州省委书记。
description.en: Jia Tingsan became the Deputy Secretary of the CPC Guizhou Provincial Committee in 1971 and was promoted to Secretary in 1977.

description.zh-cn: 1979年，贾庭三任北京市人大常委会主任。
description.en: In 1979, Jia Tingsan became the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东在1959年4月上海会议上提倡学习海瑞精神，促使吴晗创作了《海瑞罢官》。
description.en: Mao Zedong advocated learning from the spirit of Hai Rui at the Shanghai Conference in April 1959, which prompted Wu Han to create 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 吴晗于1959年4月开始构思并写作京剧《海瑞罢官》。
description.en: Wu Han began to conceive and write the Beijing opera 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office' in April 1959.

description.zh-cn: 姚文元的文章斥责《海瑞罢官》是反党反社会主义的“毒草”，并指其影射了“彭德怀事件”。
description.en: Yao Wenyuan's article condemned 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office' as an anti-Party and anti-socialist 'poisonous weed' and alleged that it alluded to the 'Peng Dehuai incident'.

description.zh-cn: 作为《海瑞罢官》的作者，吴晗因该批判文章而受到攻击和政治迫害。
description.en: As the author of 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office', Wu Han was attacked and politically persecuted due to this critical article.

description.zh-cn: 彭真是刘少奇的坚定支持者，两人共同掌控着被毛泽东视为“针插不进，水泼不进”的北京市委。
description.en: Peng Zhen was a staunch supporter of Liu Shaoqi, and together they controlled the Beijing Municipal Committee, which Mao Zedong described as 'impermeable'.

description.zh-cn: 1960年，北京京剧团（北京京剧院前身）的马连良邀请吴晗创作京剧剧本《海瑞罢官》。
description.en: In 1960, Ma Lianliang of the Beijing Opera Troupe (predecessor of the Beijing Opera Theatre) invited Wu Han to write the script for the opera 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office'.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共上海市委第一书记柯庆施安排张春桥与姚文元协助江青在上海组织对《海瑞罢官》的批判。
description.en: Ke Qingshi, then First Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, arranged for Zhang Chunqiao and Yao Wenyuan to assist Jiang Qing in organizing the criticism of 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office' in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在柯庆施的安排下，姚文元与张春桥一同协助江青在上海的工作，最终撰写了批判文章。
description.en: Under Ke Qingshi's arrangement, Yao Wenyuan, along with Zhang Chunqiao, assisted Jiang Qing's work in Shanghai, ultimately writing the critical article.

description.zh-cn: 在柯庆施的安排下，张春桥与姚文元一同协助江青在上海的工作。
description.en: Under Ke Qingshi's arrangement, Zhang Chunqiao, along with Yao Wenyuan, assisted Jiang Qing's work in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 1965年11月10日，《文汇报》首次发表了姚文元的文章《评新编历史剧〈海瑞罢官〉》。
description.en: On November 10, 1965, 'Wenhui Bao' first published Yao Wenyuan's article 'On the New Historical Drama 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office''.

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》于1965年11月30日转载了姚文元的文章，使其在全国范围内产生影响。
description.en: The 'People's Daily' reprinted Yao Wenyuan's article on November 30, 1965, giving it nationwide influence.

description.zh-cn: 因创作了与《海瑞罢官》题材类似的戏曲《海瑞上疏》，周信芳在文化大革命期间受到迫害。
description.en: For creating the opera 'Hai Rui Submits a Memorial', which had a similar theme to 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office', Zhou Xinfang was persecuted during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 京剧表演艺术家马连良主演了《海瑞罢官》，饰演主角海瑞。
description.en: The Beijing opera performing artist Ma Lianliang starred in 'Hai Rui Dismissed from Office', playing the main character Hai Rui.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔·普京先后两次提名米哈伊尔·米舒斯京担任俄罗斯总理。
description.en: Vladimir Putin nominated Mikhail Mishustin for the position of Prime Minister on two occasions.

description.zh-cn: 自2020年1月16日起担任俄罗斯总理，接替辞职的德米特里·梅德韦杰夫。
description.en: Became the Prime Minister of Russia on January 16, 2020, succeeding the resigned Dmitry Medvedev.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄罗斯总理，米哈伊尔·米舒斯京向总统弗拉基米尔·普京负责。
description.en: As Prime Minister of Russia, Mikhail Mishustin is subordinate to President Vladimir Putin.

description.zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·米舒斯京接替德米特里·梅德韦杰夫出任俄罗斯总理。
description.en: Mikhail Mishustin succeeded Dmitry Medvedev as Prime Minister of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯国家杜马先后两次通过了对米哈伊尔·米舒斯京的总理提名。
description.en: The Russian State Duma approved the nomination of Mikhail Mishustin as Prime Minister on two occasions.

degree.zh-cn: 计算机辅助设计专业；研究生

description.zh-cn: 1989年进入莫斯科机床工具学院（现莫斯科国立技术大学）就读，1992年完成研究生课程。
description.en: Entered the Moscow Machine Tool Institute (now Moscow State Technological University) in 1989 and completed his postgraduate studies in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 1998年，米哈伊尔·米舒斯京成为公务员，担任联邦税务局局长鲍里斯·费奥多罗夫的助手。
description.en: In 1998, Mikhail Mishustin became a civil servant, serving as an assistant to Boris Fyodorov, the head of the Federal Tax Service.

description.zh-cn: 在2019冠状病毒病疫情期间，米舒斯京确诊感染，被迫隔离并暂停履职，由第一副总理安德烈·别洛乌索夫代行其职责。
description.en: During the COVID-19 pandemic, Mishustin tested positive for the virus, forcing him to isolate and temporarily step down from his duties, which were assumed by First Deputy Prime Minister Andrey Belousov.

description.zh-cn: 在米哈伊尔·米舒斯京因感染新冠病毒隔离期间，安德烈·别洛乌索夫暂时代行总理职责。
description.en: While Mikhail Mishustin was in quarantine due to a COVID-19 infection, Andrey Belousov temporarily served as Acting Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党主席是中国国民党的最高领导人职位。
description.en: The Chairman of the Kuomintang is the highest leadership position within the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 兴中会与华兴会于日本东京合流并改组为中国同盟会。
description.en: The Revive China Society and the China Arise Society merged and reorganized into the Tongmenghui in Tokyo, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 华兴会与兴中会于日本东京合流并改组为中国同盟会。
description.en: The China Arise Society and the Revive China Society merged and reorganized into the Tongmenghui in Tokyo, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 中国同盟会改组为国民党。
description.en: The Tongmenghui was reorganized into the Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 因孙中山兼任全国铁道督办，实际党务由宋教仁代行。
description.en: As Sun Yat-sen was concurrently the Director of National Railways, Song Jiaoren handled the party's practical affairs.

description.zh-cn: 任内病逝，追赠总理为永久职。
description.en: Died in office; the title 'Premier' was posthumously made a permanent position in his honor.

position.zh-cn: 中央委员会主席, 主席
position.en: Chairman of the Central Committee, Chairman

description.en: Served as Chairman of the Central Committee from 1975-04-28 to 1976-11-16, and then as Chairman from 1976-11-16 until his death on 1988-01-13.

description.zh-cn: 因2000年总统选举国民党败选，李登辉宣布辞去党主席职务。
description.en: Due to the KMT's defeat in the 2000 presidential election, Lee Teng-hui announced his resignation as party chairman.

description.zh-cn: 于2007年2月13日至3月14日任代理主席，后辞职参选并在2007年4月11日当选主席。
description.en: Served as acting chairman from Feb 13 to Mar 14, 2007, then resigned to run for election and was elected chairman on Apr 11, 2007.

description.zh-cn: 因国民党败选而宣布辞职。
description.en: Announced resignation due to the KMT's defeat in the election.

description.zh-cn: 因国民党败选而宣布辞职。
description.en: Announced resignation due to the KMT's defeat in the election.

description.zh-cn: 江启臣在党主席选举中竞选连任失利。
description.en: Johnny Chiang failed in his re-election bid in the party chairmanship election.

description.zh-cn: 郑丽文曾为民主进步党党员。
description.en: Cheng Li-wen was formerly a member of the Democratic Progressive Party.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华出生于湖北省黄冈专区大冶县茗山乡彭晚村。
description.en: Peng Qinghua was born in Pengwan Village, Mingshan Township, Daye County, Huanggang Prefecture, Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于1976年6月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Peng Qinghua joined the Communist Party of China in June 1976.

description.zh-cn: 1979年至1983年，彭清华在北京大学哲学系学习。
description.en: From 1979 to 1983, Peng Qinghua studied in the Department of Philosophy at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 1993年至1996年，彭清华在湖南大学工业外贸专业在职研究生学习，获工学硕士学位。
description.en: From 1993 to 1996, Peng Qinghua pursued postgraduate studies in Industrial and Foreign Trade at Hunan University on an in-service basis, obtaining a Master's degree in Engineering.

position.zh-cn: 干事、副处长、秘书、党建研究所副所长、研究室主任、政策法规局局长、部务委员兼干部一局局长
position.en: Official, Deputy Division Chief, Secretary, Deputy Director of the Party Building Research Institute, Director of the Research Office, Director of the Policy and Regulation Bureau, Member of the Departmental Affairs Committee and Director of the First Cadre Bureau

description.zh-cn: 彭清华自1983年从北京大学毕业后被分配到中共中央组织部工作，直至2003年调任香港中联办。
description.en: After graduating from Peking University in 1983, Peng Qinghua was assigned to work at the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee until he was transferred to the Hong Kong Liaison Office in 2003.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华曾担任时任中共中央组织部部长宋平的秘书。
description.en: Peng Qinghua served as the secretary to Song Ping, who was then the head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华曾担任时任中共中央组织部部长吕枫的秘书。
description.en: Peng Qinghua served as the secretary to Lü Feng, who was then the head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

position.zh-cn: 副主任、正部长级副主任、主任
position.en: Deputy Director, Deputy Director at Ministerial Level, Director

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于2003年12月调任香港中联办副主任，后升任主任。
description.en: Peng Qinghua was transferred to the Hong Kong Liaison Office as Deputy Director in December 2003 and was later promoted to Director.

description.zh-cn: 2007年7月，彭清华接替高祀仁担任中央香港工作委员会书记。
description.en: In July 2007, Peng Qinghua succeeded Gao Siren as Secretary of the Central Hong Kong Work Committee.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华接替高祀仁的中央香港工作委员会书记职务，并在2009年5月接替其香港中联办主任职务。
description.en: Peng Qinghua succeeded Gao Siren as Secretary of the Central Hong Kong Work Committee in July 2007 and as Director of the Hong Kong Liaison Office in May 2009.

description.zh-cn: 张晓明接替彭清华的香港中联办主任职务。
description.en: Zhang Xiaoming succeeded Peng Qinghua as Director of the Hong Kong Liaison Office.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于2012年12月至2018年3月担任中共广西壮族自治区党委书记。
description.en: Peng Qinghua served as the Party Secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region from December 2012 to March 2018.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华接替郭声琨的中共广西壮族自治区党委书记职务。
description.en: Peng Qinghua succeeded Guo Shengkun as the Party Secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于2013年1月当选为广西壮族自治区人大常委会主任。
description.en: Peng Qinghua was elected Director of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region in January 2013.

position.en: First Secretary of the Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于2013年5月起担任广西军区党委第一书记。
description.en: Peng Qinghua has served as the First Secretary of the Party Committee of the Guangxi Military District since May 2013.

position.en: Deputy Secretary and Chairman of the Government

description.zh-cn: 在彭清华担任中共广西壮族自治区党委书记期间，陈武是其副手，担任副书记兼政府主席。
description.en: During Peng Qinghua's tenure as Party Secretary of Guangxi, Chen Wu was his deputy, serving as Deputy Secretary and Chairman of the Government.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于2018年3月至2022年4月担任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Peng Qinghua served as the Party Secretary of Sichuan from March 2018 to April 2022.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华接替王东明转任中共四川省委书记。
description.en: Peng Qinghua succeeded Wang Dongming as the Party Secretary of Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 王晓晖接替彭清华的中共四川省委书记职务。
description.en: Wang Xiaohui succeeded Peng Qinghua as the Party Secretary of Sichuan.

description.zh-cn: 鹿心社接替彭清华的中共广西壮族自治区党委书记职务。
description.en: Lu Xinshe succeeded Peng Qinghua as Party Secretary of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 彭清华于2019年1月当选为四川省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Peng Qinghua was elected Director of the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People's Congress in January 2019.

description.zh-cn: 2021年7月，时任四川省委书记彭清华在成都会见班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布。
description.en: In July 2021, Peng Qinghua, then Party Secretary of Sichuan, met with Bainqen Erdini Qoigyijab in Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 2021年7月，时任四川省委书记彭清华与四川省政协主席柯尊平一同会见班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布。
description.en: In July 2021, Peng Qinghua, then Party Secretary of Sichuan, and Ke Zunping, Chairman of the Sichuan Provincial CPPCC, jointly met with Bainqen Erdini Qoigyijab.

description.zh-cn: 2022年6月24日，彭清华被任命为全国人大农业与农村委员会副主任委员。
description.en: On June 24, 2022, Peng Qinghua was appointed Vice Chairperson of the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee of the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 2023年3月10日，彭清华当选为第十四届全国人大常委会副委员长。
description.en: On March 10, 2023, Peng Qinghua was elected as a Vice Chairperson of the 14th National People's Congress Standing Committee.

position.zh-cn: 全国人大常委会副委员长
position.en: Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee

description.zh-cn: 彭清华担任全国人大常委会副委员长，直接向委员长赵乐际负责。
description.en: As a Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, Peng Qinghua reports directly to Chairman Zhao Leji.

description.zh-cn: 巴西是金砖国家的创始成员国。
description.en: Brazil is a founding member of BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 俄罗斯是金砖国家的创始成员国。
description.en: Russia is a founding member of BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 印度是金砖国家的创始成员国。
description.en: India is a founding member of BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 南非于2010年受邀，并于2011年1月1日正式加入金砖国家。
description.en: South Africa was invited in 2010 and officially joined BRICS on January 1, 2011.

description.zh-cn: 埃及在2023年峰会受邀后，于2024年1月1日正式成为金砖国家成员。
description.en: After being invited at the 2023 summit, Egypt officially became a member of BRICS on January 1, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗在2023年峰会受邀后，于2024年1月1日正式成为金砖国家成员。
description.en: After being invited at the 2023 summit, Iran officially became a member of BRICS on January 1, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 阿联酋在2023年峰会受邀后，于2024年1月1日正式成为金砖国家成员。
description.en: After being invited at the 2023 summit, the UAE officially became a member of BRICS on January 1, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 印度尼西亚于2025年1月6日正式成为金砖国家成员。
description.en: Indonesia officially became a member of BRICS on January 6, 2025.

description.zh-cn: 作为阿根廷外长候选人，戴安娜·蒙迪诺在2023年11月公开表示阿根廷将不会加入金砖国家。
description.en: As a candidate for Argentina's foreign minister, Diana Mondino publicly stated in November 2023 that Argentina would not join BRICS.

description.zh-cn: 新开发银行的总部设立于中国上海市。
description.en: The headquarters of the New Development Bank is located in Shanghai, China.

description.zh-cn: 新教的形成源于对天主教会教义和实践的抗议与改革，其核心教义否定了天主教的教皇制和圣传等权威。
description.en: The formation of Protestantism stemmed from protest and reform against the doctrines and practices of the Catholic Church, with its core tenets rejecting authorities such as the papacy and sacred tradition.

description.zh-cn: 查理五世在第二次施派尔会议上镇压宗教改革势力。
description.en: Charles V suppressed the forces of the Reformation at the Second Diet of Speyer.

description.zh-cn: 萨克森选侯腓特烈三世在沃木斯议会后安排马丁·路德在瓦尔特堡的城堡中避难，对其提供了关键保护。
description.en: Frederick III, Elector of Saxony, provided crucial protection to Martin Luther by arranging for him to take refuge in Wartburg Castle after the Diet of Worms.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德在约1515年教授《圣经》时，从钻研《罗马书》中领会到“因信称义”的教义，这成为宗教改革的核心思想。
description.en: Around 1515, while teaching the Bible, Martin Luther came to understand the doctrine of 'justification by faith' from his study of the Epistle to the Romans, which became a core idea of the Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 英国国王亨利八世于1534年领导当地教会脱离天主教会，发起了英格兰宗教改革。
description.en: King Henry VIII of England led the local church to break away from the Catholic Church in 1534, initiating the English Reformation.

description.zh-cn: 英格兰宗教改革导致了英格兰教会（即后来的圣公会）从罗马教廷独立出来。
description.en: The English Reformation led to the independence of the Church of England (later the Anglican Communion) from the See of Rome.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德于1505年进入修道院，曾是天主教会的神父，直到1521年被开除教籍。
description.en: Martin Luther entered a monastery in 1505 and was a Catholic priest until he was excommunicated in 1521.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德曾在威登堡大学担任教授，讲授圣经。
description.en: Martin Luther served as a professor at the University of Wittenberg, teaching the Bible.

description.zh-cn: 马丁·路德在沃木斯议会中受审，因拒绝撤回其宗教改革主张而被定罪。
description.en: Martin Luther was tried at the Diet of Worms and condemned for refusing to recant his Reformation views.

description.zh-cn: 其作品《老鼠看下棋》获此奖项。
description.en: His work 'The Mouse Watching a Chess Game' won this award.

description.zh-cn: 其作品《老鼠看下棋》获中国作家协会第一届全国优秀儿童文学奖。
description.en: His work 'The Mouse Watching a Chess Game' won the first National Outstanding Children's Literature Award from the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 其作品《虎牛》获该杂志1985年度优秀作品奖。
description.en: His work 'Tiger and Ox' won the magazine's 1985 annual outstanding work award.

description.zh-cn: 云山战斗是朝鲜战争期间发生的一场战斗。
description.en: The Battle of Unsan was a battle that took place during the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 云山战斗以中国人民志愿军获胜告终，这次胜利缓解了中国领导层对干预朝鲜战争的担忧，并为后续战役提供了经验。
description.en: The Battle of Unsan ended in a victory for the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, which eased the Chinese leadership's concerns about intervening in the war and provided experience for subsequent campaigns.

description.zh-cn: 在云山战斗中，联合国军，特别是美军第8骑兵团，遭受了毁灭性的损失。
description.en: During the Battle of Unsan, the UN forces, particularly the U.S. 8th Cavalry Regiment, suffered devastating losses.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军是云山战斗的发起方和主要参战方之一。
description.en: The Chinese People's Volunteer Army was an initiator and one of the main combatants in the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 联合国军是云山战斗的主要参战方之一。
description.en: The United Nations Command was one of the main combatants in the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 吴信泉在云山战斗期间担任第39军军长。
description.en: Wu Xinquan served as the commander of the 39th Corps during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 温玉成在云山战斗期间担任第40军军长。
description.en: Wen Yucheng served as the commander of the 40th Corps during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 白善烨在云山战斗期间担任韩国第1步兵师师长。
description.en: Paik Sun-yup served as the commander of the ROK 1st Infantry Division during the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民志愿军第39军是参与云山战斗的主力部队。
description.en: The PVA 39th Corps was the main force participating in the Battle of Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 115师是中国人民解放军第39军的下属部队。
description.en: The 115th Division was a subordinate unit of the PLA 39th Corps.

description.zh-cn: 120师原隶属于中国人民解放军第40军。
description.en: The 120th Division was originally subordinate to the PLA 40th Corps.

description.zh-cn: 在云山战斗期间，原属40军的120师归39军指挥。
description.en: During the Battle of Unsan, the 120th Division, originally from the 40th Corps, was placed under the command of the 39th Corps.

description.zh-cn: 1950年10月25日，中国人民志愿军在云山附近开始攻击韩国第1步兵师。
description.en: On October 25, 1950, the Chinese People's Volunteer Army began attacking the ROK 1st Infantry Division near Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 美国第8军团司令沃尔顿·沃克命令美军第1骑兵师辖下的第8骑兵团去替换韩国第12团。
description.en: Eighth Army commander Walton Walker ordered the 8th Cavalry Regiment of the U.S. 1st Cavalry Division to relieve the ROK 12th Regiment.

description.zh-cn: 1950年11月1日，中国人民志愿军司令彭德怀下令第39军继续前进以消灭在云山的驻军。
description.en: On November 1, 1950, PVA commander Peng Dehuai ordered the 39th Corps to advance and destroy the garrison at Unsan.

description.zh-cn: 河西走廊成为“丝绸之路”的必经要道。
汉武帝在现在甘肃一带将黄河以西分置四郡（河西四郡）。
1261年，忽必烈在甘肃立西夏中兴行省。
1286年，西夏中兴行省正式改名为甘肃行中书省。
王亚樵出生于安徽省合肥磨店乡。
description.en: Wang Yaqiao was born in Modian Township, Hefei, Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵早年参加了同盟会。
description.en: Wang Yaqiao joined the Tongmenghui in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵领导的斧头帮曾与黄金荣的势力在上海互争地盘。
description.en: The Axe Gang, led by Wang Yaqiao, competed for territory with Huang Jinrong's forces in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵领导的斧头帮曾与杜月笙的势力在上海互争地盘。
description.en: The Axe Gang, led by Wang Yaqiao, competed for territory with Du Yuesheng's forces in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 在江浙军阀斗争中，王亚樵与江苏军阀齐燮元对立。
description.en: During the conflict between Jiangsu and Zhejiang warlords, Wang Yaqiao opposed Jiangsu warlord Qi Xieyuan.

description.zh-cn: 1923年11月12日，王亚樵组织手下刺杀了由齐燮元任命的淞沪上海警察厅厅长徐国梁。
description.en: On November 12, 1923, Wang Yaqiao organized his men to assassinate Xu Guoliang, the chief of the Shanghai-Songhu Police Department appointed by Qi Xieyuan.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵策划的徐国梁刺杀案成为甲子兵灾（江浙战争）的导火索之一。
description.en: The assassination of Xu Guoliang, planned by Wang Yaqiao, became one of the triggers for the Jiazi War (Jiangsu-Zhejiang War).

description.zh-cn: 1923年，戴笠曾在王亚樵手下担任中队长。
description.en: In 1923, Dai Li served as a squadron leader under Wang Yaqiao.

description.zh-cn: 国军将领胡宗南早年是王亚樵的门生。
description.en: KMT General Hu Zongnan was a protégé of Wang Yaqiao in his early years.

description.zh-cn: 孙传芳与齐燮元联手击败了卢永祥。
description.en: Sun Chuanfang, together with Qi Xieyuan, defeated Lu Yongxiang.

description.zh-cn: 四·一二事件后，王亚樵对蒋介石非常不满，并多次策划刺杀蒋介石。
description.en: After the April 12 Incident, Wang Yaqiao became extremely dissatisfied with Chiang Kai-shek and planned multiple assassination attempts against him.

description.zh-cn: 1931年，王亚樵组织了“铁血锄奸团”。
description.en: In 1931, Wang Yaqiao organized the 'Iron and Blood锄奸団'.

description.zh-cn: 1931年7月23日，王亚樵领导的铁血锄奸团在上海北火车站刺杀宋子文，但未成功。
description.en: On July 23, 1931, the Iron and Blood锄奸団, led by Wang Yaqiao, attempted to assassinate T. V. Soong at the Shanghai North Railway Station, but failed.

description.zh-cn: 在淞沪抗战期间，王亚樵积极配合十九路军抵抗日军。
description.en: During the Shanghai War of 1932, Wang Yaqiao actively cooperated with the 19th Route Army to resist the Japanese forces.

description.zh-cn: 淞沪抗战期间，王亚樵派水手用水雷炸伤了日本海军的“出云”号旗舰。
description.en: During the Shanghai War of 1932, Wang Yaqiao dispatched sailors to damage the Japanese flagship, cruiser Izumo, with naval mines.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵与流亡上海的大韩民国临时政府合作，共同策划了虹口公园爆炸案。
description.en: Wang Yaqiao collaborated with the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, exiled in Shanghai, to jointly plan the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵为虹口公园爆炸案制定了周密计划，并提供了资金和武器。
description.en: Wang Yaqiao formulated a detailed plan for the Hongkou Park bombing and provided funds and weapons.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜志士尹奉吉与王亚樵合作，在虹口公园爆炸案中负责执行投弹任务。
description.en: Korean patriot Yun Bong-gil collaborated with Wang Yaqiao and was responsible for carrying out the bombing mission in the Hongkou Park incident.

description.zh-cn: 日本驻沪居民团行政委员长河端贞次在虹口公园爆炸案中当场被炸死。
description.en: Kawabata Sadaji, the administrative chairman of the Japanese Residents' Association in Shanghai, was killed instantly in the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 日本上海派遣军司令白川义则大将在虹口公园爆炸案中重伤，后不治身亡。
description.en: General Yoshinori Shirakawa, commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, was severely wounded in the Hongkou Park bombing and later died from his injuries.

description.zh-cn: 日本陆军中将植田谦吉在虹口公园爆炸案中被炸断一条腿。
description.en: Lieutenant General Kenkichi Ueda of the Japanese Army lost a leg in the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 日本驻华公使重光葵在虹口公园爆炸案中被炸断一条腿。
description.en: Japanese Minister to China, Mamoru Shigemitsu, lost a leg in the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 日本海军中将野村吉三郎在虹口公园爆炸案中被炸瞎一只眼。
description.en: Vice Admiral Kichisaburō Nomura of the Japanese Navy was blinded in one eye in the Hongkou Park bombing.

description.zh-cn: 王亚樵于1933年赴福州参加了李济深等人发动的福建事变。
description.en: In 1933, Wang Yaqiao went to Fuzhou to participate in the Fujian Incident launched by Li Jishen and others.

description.zh-cn: 福建事变失败后，王亚樵再次筹划刺杀行动，于1935年11月1日策划了针对汪精卫的刺杀，致其重伤。
description.en: After the failure of the Fujian Incident, Wang Yaqiao planned another assassination, targeting Wang Jingwei on November 1, 1935, which left him severely injured.

description.zh-cn: 在汪精卫遇刺后，蒋介石震怒，要求军统缉拿王亚樵。
description.en: After the assassination attempt on Wang Jingwei, a furious Chiang Kai-shek ordered the Juntong to hunt down Wang Yaqiao.

description.zh-cn: 在戴笠的指挥下，军统特务通过收买王亚樵部下之妻设下陷阱，于1936年10月20日在广西梧州将王亚樵枪杀。
description.en: Under the command of Dai Li, Juntong agents set a trap by bribing the wife of one of Wang Yaqiao's subordinates, and assassinated Wang Yaqiao in Wuzhou, Guangxi, on October 20, 1936.

description.zh-cn: 余立奎是王亚樵的部下之一。
description.en: Yu Likui was one of Wang Yaqiao's subordinates.

description.zh-cn: 在追捕王亚樵的过程中，军统逮捕了其部下余立奎。
description.en: In the pursuit of Wang Yaqiao, the Juntong arrested his subordinate Yu Likui.

description.zh-cn: 为躲避军统追杀，王亚樵逃往广西投奔李济深，并获得其庇护。
description.en: To escape the Juntong's pursuit, Wang Yaqiao fled to Guangxi to seek refuge with Li Jishen, who provided him with shelter.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争常被看作是奥地利王位继承战争的延续，奥地利意图收复在该战争中失去的西里西亚。
description.en: The Seven Years' War is often considered a continuation of the War of the Austrian Succession, as Austria sought to recover Silesia, which it had lost in the previous conflict.

description.zh-cn: 外交革命导致欧洲列强结成新的敌对同盟（英普同盟与法奥同盟），成为七年战争爆发的催化剂。
description.en: The Diplomatic Revolution led to the formation of new rival alliances (the Anglo-Prussian Alliance and the Franco-Austrian Alliance), which acted as a catalyst for the outbreak of the Seven Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 作为先发制人的行动，率军入侵萨克森，从而引发了七年战争的欧洲战事。
description.en: As a pre-emptive action, he led his army to invade Saxony, thereby initiating the European theater of the Seven Years' War.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽亚·特蕾西娅将腓特烈二世视为宿敌，其外交和军事行动的主要目标就是遏制普鲁士的扩张并夺回西里西亚。
description.en: Maria Theresa viewed Frederick II as her nemesis, and her primary diplomatic and military goal was to contain Prussian expansion and reclaim Silesia.

description.zh-cn: 伊丽莎白女皇领导俄国加入反普同盟，决心削弱普鲁士的力量。
description.en: Empress Elizabeth led Russia to join the anti-Prussian coalition, determined to weaken Prussia's power.

description.zh-cn: 彼得三世是腓特烈和普鲁士文化的狂热崇拜者，一即位就立即与普鲁士媾和并结盟。
description.en: Peter III was an ardent admirer of Frederick and Prussian culture, and immediately upon his accession, he made peace and allied with Prussia.

description.zh-cn: 彼得三世即位后，俄国从普鲁士的敌人转为盟友，这一戏剧性转变被称为勃兰登堡王室的奇迹。
description.en: After Peter III's accession, Russia turned from an enemy of Prussia into an ally, a dramatic shift known as the Miracle of the House of Brandenburg.

description.zh-cn: 俄国的倒戈使普鲁士从濒临崩溃的绝境中得以起死回生，能够集中力量对抗奥地利。
description.en: Russia's change of sides allowed Prussia to recover from the brink of collapse and concentrate its forces against Austria.

description.zh-cn: 通过宫廷政变废黜并随后谋杀了其丈夫彼得三世，自己登基为女皇。
description.en: Deposed and subsequently murdered her husband Peter III in a palace coup, ascending to the throne as Empress.

description.zh-cn: 七年战争的结束促成了《巴黎条约》的签订，以解决英国、法国和西班牙之间的冲突。
description.en: The end of the Seven Years' War led to the signing of the Treaty of Paris to resolve the conflicts between Great Britain, France, and Spain.

description.zh-cn: 英国通过条约获得了法国在北美和印度的大片殖民地，成为世界霸主。
description.en: Through the treaty, Great Britain acquired vast French colonies in North America and India, becoming the dominant world power.

description.zh-cn: 法国被迫割让大量海外殖民地给英国，失去了世界第一强国的地位。
description.en: France was forced to cede vast overseas colonies to Great Britain, losing its status as the world's foremost power.

description.zh-cn: 条约确认了普鲁士对西里西亚的统治权，使其崛起为公认的中欧强权。
description.en: The treaty confirmed Prussia's sovereignty over Silesia, allowing it to rise as an acknowledged Central European power.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利在条约中正式放弃对西里西亚的主权要求，未能实现其核心战争目标。
description.en: In the treaty, Austria officially renounced its claim to Silesia, failing to achieve its core war objective.

description.zh-cn: 英国为支付七年战争的巨额费用而向北美殖民地征收重税，成为引发美国独立战争的重要导火索。
description.en: Britain's imposition of heavy taxes on its North American colonies to pay for the enormous costs of the Seven Years' War became a major catalyst for the American Revolutionary War.

description.zh-cn: 金城战役主要针对李承晚领导的韩国军队，是朝鲜战争的最后一次大规模战役。
description.en: The Battle of Kumsong primarily targeted the South Korean army led by Syngman Rhee and was the last major battle of the Korean War.

description.zh-cn: 毛岸英在1950年11月25日的一次美军空袭中牺牲。
description.en: Mao Anying was killed in a US air raid on November 25, 1950.

description.zh-cn: 黄继光在上甘岭战役中用身体堵住联合国军的机枪眼而阵亡。
description.en: Huang Jiguang was killed during the Battle of Triangle Hill when he used his body to block a UN machine gun emplacement.

description.zh-cn: 在执行战斗任务中，邱少云被联合国军发射的燃烧弹引燃了衣服，为保证行动不被暴露，被活活烧死。
description.en: During a combat mission, Qiu Shaoyun's clothing was ignited by an incendiary bomb fired by the UN Command. To ensure the mission was not compromised, he remained motionless and was burned to death.

description.zh-cn: 2022年10月，黄坤明接替李希出任中共广东省委书记。
description.en: In October 2022, Huang Kunming succeeded Li Xi as the Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明接替李希担任中共广东省委书记，构成职务接替关系。
description.en: Huang Kunming succeeded Li Xi as the Secretary of the CPC Guangdong Provincial Committee, constituting a successor-predecessor relationship.

description.zh-cn: 自2017年10月中共十九届一中全会起，黄坤明连续当选为第十九届、第二十届中央政治局委员。
description.en: Starting from the First Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the CCP in October 2017, Huang Kunming was successively elected as a member of the 19th and 20th Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明于2010年1月至2013年10月担任中共杭州市委书记。
description.en: Huang Kunming served as the Secretary of the CPC Hangzhou Municipal Committee from January 2010 to October 2013.

description.zh-cn: 黄坤明长期在福建、浙江与习近平有共事经历，被广泛认为是习近平派系“闽江新军”的主要成员和习的重要亲信之一。
description.en: Huang Kunming has a long history of working with Xi Jinping in Fujian and Zhejiang and is widely regarded as a key member of the Xi Jinping faction 'Minjiang New Army' and one of Xi's important confidants.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕于1954年10月被任命为中国人民解放军总参谋长，1958年8月被免职。
description.en: Su Yu was appointed Chief of the General Staff of the People's Liberation Army in October 1954 and was dismissed from the post in August 1958.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕与楚青于1941年12月26日结婚。
description.en: Su Yu and Chu Qing married on December 26, 1941.

description.zh-cn: 粟寒生是粟裕的次子。
description.en: Su Hansheng is the second son of Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 粟惠宁是粟裕的女儿。
description.en: Su Huining is the daughter of Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕之女粟惠宁于1975年与陈毅之子陈小鲁结婚。
description.en: Su Huining, daughter of Su Yu, married Chen Xiaolu, son of Chen Yi, in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕参加了南昌起义，担任前敌委员会的警卫队班长。
description.en: Su Yu participated in the Nanchang Uprising, serving as a squad leader in the guard unit of the Front Committee.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕与陈毅在井冈山时期相识，并在第二次国共内战期间长期共同指挥华东野战军（第三野战军）。
description.en: Su Yu and Chen Yi met during the Jinggangshan period and co-commanded the East China Field Army (Third Field Army) for a long time during the Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕在华东野战军组建后担任副司令员，负责战役指挥。
description.en: After the formation of the East China Field Army, Su Yu served as deputy commander, responsible for campaign command.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕指挥华东野战军发起孟良崮战役，全歼国民党军精锐整编第七十四师。
description.en: Su Yu commanded the East China Field Army to launch the Menglianggu Campaign, completely annihilating the elite KMT Reorganized 74th Division.

description.zh-cn: 国民党军整编第七十四师师长张灵甫在孟良崮战役中阵亡。
description.en: Zhang Lingfu, commander of the KMT Reorganized 74th Division, was killed in the Menglianggu Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 国民党军第七兵团司令官黄百韬在淮海战役碾庄战斗中兵败阵亡。
description.en: Huang Baitao, commander of the KMT 7th Army Group, was defeated and killed in the Battle of Nianzhuang during the Huaihai Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年的军委扩大会议上，彭德怀等人对粟裕进行了批判。
description.en: At the 1958 enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission, Peng Dehuai and others criticized Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年的军委扩大会议上，林彪等人对粟裕进行了批判。
description.en: At the 1958 enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission, Lin Biao and others criticized Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 在1958年的军委扩大会议上，聂荣臻等人对粟裕进行了批判。
description.en: At the 1958 enlarged meeting of the Central Military Commission, Nie Rongzhen and others criticized Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平主持了批判粟裕的元帅会议。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping presided over the meeting of marshals that criticized Su Yu.

description.zh-cn: 在粟裕提出申诉后，叶剑英于1979年批示要求总政治部研究处理1958年对粟裕的错误批判，开启了为粟裕平反的进程。
description.en: After Su Yu submitted his appeal, Ye Jianying instructed in 1979 that the General Political Department should investigate and handle the wrongful criticism of Su Yu in 1958, initiating the process of his rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 刘华清与张震联名发表经江泽民批发的文章《追忆粟裕同志》，正式为粟裕在1958年受到的错误批判平反，并代表中央军委表明了意见。
description.en: Liu Huaqing and Zhang Zhen jointly published the article 'Recalling Comrade Su Yu', approved by Jiang Zemin, which officially rehabilitated Su Yu from the wrongful criticism he received in 1958 and expressed the opinion of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张震与刘华清联名发表经江泽民批发的文章《追忆粟裕同志》，正式为粟裕在1958年受到的错误批判平反，并代表中央军委表明了意见。
description.en: Zhang Zhen and Liu Huaqing jointly published the article 'Recalling Comrade Su Yu', approved by Jiang Zemin, which officially rehabilitated Su Yu from the wrongful criticism he received in 1958 and expressed the opinion of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民作为时任中央军委主席，批准发表了为粟裕平反的文章《追忆粟裕同志》，最终完成了对粟裕的平反。
description.en: As the then Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Jiang Zemin approved the publication of the article 'Recalling Comrade Su Yu', which rehabilitated Su Yu, thus finalizing his rehabilitation.

description.zh-cn: 黄克诚接替粟裕担任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Huang Kecheng succeeded Su Yu as the Chief of the General Staff of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 粟裕接替聂荣臻（代总参谋长）担任中国人民解放军总参谋长。
description.en: Su Yu succeeded Nie Rongzhen (acting Chief of the General Staff) as the Chief of the General Staff of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁现任中华人民共和国国家发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie currently serves as the Director of the National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China.

position.zh-cn: 国家发展和改革委员会主任
position.en: Director of the National Development and Reform Commission

description.zh-cn: 作为国家发改委主任，郑栅洁是国务院总理李强的下属。
description.en: As the Director of the National Development and Reform Commission, Zheng Shanjie is a subordinate of Premier Li Qiang.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任中国共产党安徽省委员会书记。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie previously served as the Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在郑栅洁担任安徽省委书记期间，王清宪是其副手，担任副书记兼省长。
description.en: While Zheng Shanjie served as the Party Secretary of Anhui Province, Wang Qingxian was his deputy, serving as Deputy Secretary and Governor.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任浙江省人民政府省长。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie previously served as the Governor of the People's Government of Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁担任浙江省省长时，时任省委书记为袁家军。
description.en: When Zheng Shanjie was the Governor of Zhejiang Province, the Provincial Party Secretary was Yuan Jiajun.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁出生于福建省漳州市。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie was born in Zhangzhou, Fujian Province.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁于1985年6月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie joined the Communist Party of China in June 1985.

degree.zh-cn: 化工设备腐蚀与防护专业

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁于1982年毕业于南京化工学院（现南京工业大学）。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie graduated from Nanjing Institute of Chemical Technology (now Nanjing Tech University) in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁是中国共产党第二十届中央委员会委员。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie is a member of the 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁被外界广泛认为是习近平派系“闽江新军”成员之一。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie is widely considered by outsiders to be a member of the Xi Jinping faction, known as the 'Minjiang New Army'.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾在企业工作15年，从机修工起步，后升任厦门鱼肝油厂副厂长，并于1991年1月升任厂长。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie worked in enterprises for 15 years, starting as a mechanic, later becoming Deputy Director of the Xiamen Cod Liver Oil Factory, and was promoted to Director in January 1991.

position.en: Deputy Secretary-General, Director of the General Office

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任厦门市人民政府副秘书长、办公厅主任。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie served as Deputy Secretary-General and Director of the General Office of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government.

position.zh-cn: 厦门市发展和改革委员会主任
position.en: Director of Xiamen Development and Reform Commission

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁在厦门工作时，何立峰是其领导上司。2005年至2008年间，郑栅洁担任厦门市发改委主任，时任厦门市委书记为何立峰。
description.en: When Zheng Shanjie worked in Xiamen, He Lifeng was his superior. From 2005 to 2008, Zheng Shanjie served as the Director of the Xiamen Development and Reform Commission, while He Lifeng was the Party Secretary of Xiamen.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁历任福建省发改委副主任（2008年4月起）和主任（2010年5月起）。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie served successively as Deputy Director (from April 2008) and Director (from May 2010) of the Fujian Provincial Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任福建省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie served as Vice Governor of the People's Government of Fujian Province.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任国家能源局副局长。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie served as Deputy Director of the National Energy Administration.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任中共中央台湾工作办公室副主任。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie served as Deputy Director of the Taiwan Work Office of the CPC Central Committee.

position.en: Standing Committee Member, full-time Deputy Secretary

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁曾任中共浙江省委常委，并于2018年5月起任省委专职副书记。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie served as a Standing Committee Member of the Zhejiang Provincial CPC Committee, and from May 2018, as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在第十四届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上，郑栅洁获提名出任国家发改委主任。
description.en: At the first session of the 14th National People's Congress, Zheng Shanjie was nominated to be the Director of the National Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁接替何立峰出任中华人民共和国国家发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie succeeded He Lifeng as the Director of the National Development and Reform Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁接替李锦斌出任中国共产党安徽省委员会书记。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie succeeded Li Jinbin as the Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 韩俊接替郑栅洁出任中国共产党安徽省委员会书记。
description.en: Han Jun succeeded Zheng Shanjie as the Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁接替袁家军出任浙江省人民政府省长。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie succeeded Yuan Jiajun as the Governor of the People's Government of Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 王浩接替郑栅洁出任浙江省人民政府省长。
description.en: Wang Hao succeeded Zheng Shanjie as the Governor of the People's Government of Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁接替张志南出任福建省发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie succeeded Zhang Zhinan as the Director of the Fujian Provincial Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 魏克良接替郑栅洁出任福建省发展和改革委员会主任。
description.en: Wei Keliang succeeded Zheng Shanjie as the Director of the Fujian Provincial Development and Reform Commission.

description.zh-cn: 郑栅洁接替唐一军出任中国共产党浙江省委员会专职副书记和中国共产党宁波市委员会书记。
description.en: Zheng Shanjie succeeded Tang Yijun as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial CPC Committee and as the Secretary of the Ningbo Municipal CPC Committee.

description.zh-cn: 黄建发接替郑栅洁出任中国共产党浙江省委员会专职副书记。
description.en: Huang Jianfa succeeded Zheng Shanjie as the full-time Deputy Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial CPC Committee.

description.zh-cn: 彭佳学接替郑栅洁出任中国共产党宁波市委员会书记。
description.en: Peng Jiaxue succeeded Zheng Shanjie as the Secretary of the Ningbo Municipal CPC Committee.

description.zh-cn: 公元前126年，司马迁游览庐山，并在其著作《史记》中首次以文字记录“庐山”之名，确立了其历史地位。
description.en: In 126 BC, Sima Qian visited Mount Lu and recorded its name in writing for the first time in his work 'Records of the Grand Historian', establishing its historical name.

description.zh-cn: 405年，陶渊明于庐山隐居，创作了大量田园诗，深刻地塑造了庐山的文化形象。
description.en: In 405, Tao Yuanming lived in seclusion on Mount Lu, creating a large body of pastoral poetry that profoundly shaped the cultural image of the mountain.

description.zh-cn: 高僧慧远在庐山东林寺首创净土宗，开创了中国化佛教，代表了佛教“中国化”的大趋势。
description.en: The eminent monk Huiyuan founded the Pure Land school at Donglin Temple on Mount Lu, initiating Chinese Buddhism and representing the major trend of the 'Sinicization' of Buddhism.

description.zh-cn: 1179年，时任南康军的朱熹重建并主持白鹿洞书院，制定学规，亲自讲学，使其成为宋明理学的重要传播中心。
description.en: In 1179, Zhu Xi, then prefect of Nankang, rebuilt and presided over the White Deer Grotto Academy, establishing its regulations and teaching personally, making it an important center for the dissemination of Neo-Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 国民政府定都南京后将庐山设为“夏都”，使其在夏季成为中国的政治中心之一。
description.en: After establishing its capital in Nanjing, the Nationalist Government designated Mount Lu as the 'Summer Capital', making it one of China's political centers during the summer.

description.zh-cn: 1937年6月，周恩来代表中国共产党上庐山与蒋介石进行谈判，商讨国共合作共同抗日事宜。
description.en: In June 1937, Zhou Enlai, representing the Communist Party of China, went to Mount Lu to negotiate with Chiang Kai-shek regarding Kuomintang-Communist cooperation for resisting Japan.

description.zh-cn: 1937年7月，蒋介石在庐山发表“对卢沟桥事件之表示”演讲，宣告中国进入全面抗战时期。
description.en: In July 1937, Chiang Kai-shek delivered a speech on the Marco Polo Bridge Incident at Lushan, declaring the beginning of China's full-scale War of Resistance against Japan.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东曾三次在庐山主持中共中央的重要会议（1959年八届八中全会、1961年中央工作会议、1970年九届二中全会），对中国政治走向产生深远影响。
description.en: Mao Zedong presided over three important CPC Central Committee meetings on Mount Lu (the 8th Plenary Session of the 8th Central Committee in 1959, the Central Work Conference in 1961, and the 2nd Plenary Session of the 9th Central Committee in 1970), which had a profound impact on China's political direction.

description.zh-cn: 1931年6月，王亚樵策划并派人在庐山行刺蒋介石，但行动失败。
description.en: In June 1931, Wang Yaqiao planned and dispatched agents to assassinate Chiang Kai-shek on Mount Lu, but the attempt failed.

description.zh-cn: 冈村宁次作为日军司令官，调集重兵指挥了对庐山的进攻。
description.en: As a Japanese army commander, Yasuji Okamura mobilized substantial forces to direct the attack on Mount Lu.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山保卫战期间，国民革命军留守部队与进攻的日军进行了长达九个月的激烈战斗。
description.en: During the Defense of Lushan, the garrison troops of the National Revolutionary Army engaged in intense fighting with the invading Japanese forces for nine months.

description.zh-cn: 根据宋代绘画《虎溪三笑图》所描绘的文化传说，佛教大师慧远、道教大师陆修静与文学家陶渊明曾在庐山相会，象征儒、释、道三家的和谐交流。
description.en: According to the cultural legend depicted in the Song dynasty painting 'Three Laughers of the Tiger Stream', the Buddhist master Huiyuan, the Taoist master Lu Xiujing, and the writer Tao Yuanming met on Mount Lu, symbolizing the harmonious exchange between Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 根据宋代绘画《虎溪三笑图》所描绘的文化传说，佛教大师慧远、道教大师陆修静与文学家陶渊明曾在庐山相会，象征儒、释、道三家的和谐交流。
description.en: According to the cultural legend depicted in the Song dynasty painting 'Three Laughers of the Tiger Stream', the Buddhist master Huiyuan, the Taoist master Lu Xiujing, and the writer Tao Yuanming met on Mount Lu, symbolizing the harmonious exchange between Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，植物学家胡先骕与秦仁昌、陈封怀共同创建了庐山植物园。
description.en: In 1934, botanist Hu Xiansu, along with Qin Renchang and Chen Fenghuai, co-founded the Lushan Botanical Garden.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，植物学家秦仁昌与胡先骕、陈封怀共同创建了庐山植物园。
description.en: In 1934, botanist Qin Renchang, along with Hu Xiansu and Chen Fenghuai, co-founded the Lushan Botanical Garden.

description.zh-cn: 1934年，植物学家陈封怀与胡先骕、秦仁昌共同创建了庐山植物园。
description.en: In 1934, botanist Chen Fenghuai, along with Hu Xiansu and Qin Renchang, co-founded the Lushan Botanical Garden.

description.zh-cn: 1961年，毛泽东的诗句“天生一个仙人洞”使得仙人洞的知名度大增。
description.en: In 1961, Mao Zedong's poetic line 'Nature has superbly created an immortal's cave' greatly increased the fame of the Xianren Cave.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇的生母是中山庆子。
description.en: Emperor Meiji's birth mother was Nakayama Yoshiko.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇是日本第122代天皇。
description.en: Emperor Meiji was the 122nd Emperor of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 根据《大日本帝国宪法》，明治天皇是名义上的陆海军大元帅。
description.en: According to the Constitution of the Empire of Japan, Emperor Meiji was the nominal Grand Marshal of the Army and Navy.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇出生于京都其外祖父中山忠能的宅邸。
description.en: Emperor Meiji was born in Kyoto at the residence of his maternal grandfather, Nakayama Tadayasu.

description.zh-cn: 德川庆喜将政权交还给天皇，结束了持续265年的江户幕府时代。
description.en: Tokugawa Yoshinobu returned political power to the Emperor, ending the 265-year-long Edo Shogunate.

description.zh-cn: 戊辰战争的结果是江户幕府被推翻，明治新政府得以建立。
description.en: The Boshin War resulted in the overthrow of the Edo Shogunate and the establishment of the new Meiji government.

description.zh-cn: 明治天皇是戊辰战争期间帝国军队名义上的领袖。
description.en: Emperor Meiji was the nominal leader of the Imperial forces during the Boshin War.

description.zh-cn: 根据《马关条约》，台湾的主权被割让给大日本帝国。
description.en: According to the Treaty of Shimonoseki, the sovereignty of Taiwan was ceded to the Empire of Japan.

description.zh-cn: 甲午战争后，明治天皇成为台湾的最高统治者。
description.en: After the First Sino-Japanese War, Emperor Meiji became the supreme ruler of Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 《日韩合并条约》的签订标志着朝鲜日治时期的开始。
description.en: The signing of the Japan-Korea Treaty of 1910 marked the beginning of the period of Korea under Japanese rule.

description.zh-cn: 郑轲于2021年6月至2024年10月期间担任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: Zheng Ke served as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China from June 2021 to October 2024.

description.zh-cn: 鲁毅于2016年3月至2021年5月期间担任中国共产党佛山市委员会书记。
description.en: Lu Yi served as the Secretary of the Foshan Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China from March 2016 to May 2021.

description.zh-cn: 鲁毅于2014年5月至2016年3月期间担任佛山市人民政府市长。
description.en: Lu Yi served as the Mayor of the Foshan Municipal People's Government from May 2014 to March 2016.

description.zh-cn: 在镇压黄萧养起义后，明朝朝廷封梁广等人为“忠义官”。
description.en: After suppressing the Huang Xiaoyang uprising, the Ming court ennobled Liang Guang and others as 'Zhongyi Guan' (Loyal and Righteous Officials).

description.zh-cn: 为表彰本地乡绅的贡献，明朝朝廷封佛山为“忠义乡”。
description.en: To commend the contributions of local gentry, the Ming court granted Foshan the title of 'Zhongyi Xiang' (Loyal and Righteous Township).

description.zh-cn: 1913年，韫颖生于北京紫禁城。
description.en: In 1913, Yunying was born in the Forbidden City in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 金韫颖是载沣的第三个女儿。
description.en: Jin Yunying is the third daughter of Zaifeng.

description.zh-cn: 金韫颖19岁时由溥仪指定与润麒订亲，婚礼在满洲国新京举行。
description.en: At the age of 19, Jin Yunying was engaged to Runqi by Puyi's arrangement, and their wedding was held in Xinjing, Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 载涛是金韫颖的七叔。
description.en: Zaitao is Jin Yunying's seventh paternal uncle.

description.zh-cn: 金韫颖是爱新觉罗氏的成员。
description.en: Jin Yunying is a member of the Aisin-Gioro clan.

description.zh-cn: 溥仪为金韫颖指定了与润麒的婚事。
description.en: Puyi arranged the marriage between Jin Yunying and Runqi.

description.zh-cn: 溥仪派润麒赴日本学习军事。
description.en: Puyi sent Runqi to Japan to study military affairs.

description.zh-cn: 溥仪派溥杰和润麒赴日本学习军事。
description.en: Puyi sent Pujie and Runqi to Japan to study military affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1931年，溥仪在日本军警保护下潜赴中国东北。1932年3月，日本在此地扶植建立傀儡政权满洲国，溥仪出任其国家元首。
description.en: In 1931, Puyi secretly went to Northeast China under the protection of Japanese military police. In March 1932, Japan established the puppet state of Manchukuo in the region, with Puyi as its head.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，章士钊将金韫颖的自述呈送毛泽东，促成其生活状况的改善。
description.en: In 1954, Zhang Shizhao presented Jin Yunying's autobiography to Mao Zedong, which led to the improvement of her living conditions.

description.zh-cn: 在阅读金韫颖的自述后，毛泽东批示改善其生活，并安排其为北京市东城区政协委员。1956年，他又批准金韫颖探望溥仪。
description.en: After reading Jin Yunying's autobiography, Mao Zedong instructed to improve her life and arranged for her to become a member of the Dongcheng District CPPCC Committee in Beijing. In 1956, he also approved her visit to Puyi.

description.zh-cn: 1956年，经毛泽东批准，金韫颖赴抚顺战犯管理所看望了溥仪。
description.en: In 1956, with Mao Zedong's approval, Jin Yunying visited Puyi at the Fushun War Criminals Management Center.

description.zh-cn: 1956年，载涛与金韫颖一同赴抚顺战犯管理所看望了溥仪。
description.en: In 1956, Zaitao, along with Jin Yunying, visited Puyi at the Fushun War Criminals Management Center.

description.zh-cn: 庄士敦为金韫颖题赠了英文名“Lily”。
description.en: Reginald Johnston gave Jin Yunying the English name 'Lily'.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省公安厅在业务上接受中华人民共和国公安部的领导。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Department of Public Security is operationally subordinate to the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 陕西省公安厅接受中国共产党陕西省委员会的领导。
description.en: The Shaanxi Provincial Department of Public Security is subordinate to the Shaanxi Provincial Committee of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 宋春雳是河北昌黎人。
description.en: Song Chunli is from Changli, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 宋春雳的国籍是中华人民共和国。
description.en: Song Chunli's nationality is the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 宋春雳是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Song Chunli is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，宋春雳被选为第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Song Chunli was elected as a delegate to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕是拿鹤的孙子、他拉的儿子。
description.en: Abraham was the grandson of Nahor and the son of Terah.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕是拿鹤的孙子、他拉的儿子。
description.en: Abraham was the grandson of Nahor and the son of Terah.

description.zh-cn: 哈兰是他拉的儿子，亚伯拉罕的兄弟。
description.en: Haran was the son of Terah and the brother of Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 哈兰死在乌尔，留下一个儿子罗得。
description.en: Haran died in Ur, leaving a son, Lot.

description.zh-cn: 耶和华（上主）拣选亚伯拉罕，召唤他前往迦南，与他立约，并应许其后裔繁多，成为大国。耶和华也通过命其献祭以撒来考验他的信心。
description.en: Yahweh (the Lord) chose Abraham, called him to go to Canaan, made a covenant with him, and promised that his descendants would be numerous and become a great nation. Yahweh also tested his faith by commanding him to sacrifice Isaac.

description.zh-cn: 因法老将撒拉带入后宫，耶和华降灾于法老和他的全家。
description.en: Because the Pharaoh took Sarah into his harem, Yahweh sent plagues upon the Pharaoh and his entire household.

description.zh-cn: 基大老玛及其盟友在与迦南五王的战争中获胜，并掳走了居住在所多玛的罗得。
description.en: Chedorlaomer and his allies were victorious in the war against the five Canaanite kings and captured Lot, who was living in Sodom.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕为救回侄子罗得，率领家丁追击并击败了基大老玛的军队。
description.en: To rescue his nephew Lot, Abraham led his household servants, pursued, and defeated the forces of Chedorlaomer.

description.zh-cn: 在亚伯拉罕击败基大老玛后，撒冷王麦基洗德为他祝福。
description.en: After Abraham defeated Chedorlaomer, Melchizedek, the king of Salem, blessed him.

description.zh-cn: 亚伯拉罕因其在犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教中的重要地位，这些宗教被统称为亚伯拉罕诸教。
description.en: Due to his significant position in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, these religions are collectively known as the Abrahamic religions.

description.zh-cn: 根据基督教圣经记载，耶稣在肉身上是亚伯拉罕的后裔。
description.en: According to the Christian Bible, Jesus is a descendant of Abraham in his physical lineage.

description.zh-cn: 根据伊斯兰教传统，穆罕默德是亚伯拉罕之子以实玛利的后裔。
description.en: According to Islamic tradition, Muhammad is a descendant of Abraham's son, Ishmael.

description.zh-cn: 古尔邦节是为了纪念亚伯拉罕（易卜拉欣）愿意献祭其子以服从真主命令的事件而设立的。
description.en: Eid al-Adha was established to commemorate the event of Abraham's (Ibrahim's) willingness to sacrifice his son in obedience to God's command.

description.zh-cn: 巴哈伊信仰的创始人巴哈欧拉声称是亚伯拉罕的后裔。
description.en: Baháʼu'lláh, the founder of the Baháʼí Faith, claimed to be a descendant of Abraham.

description.zh-cn: 《史记》对秦始皇陵地宫的详细描述，如“以水银为百川江河大海”，深刻塑造了后世对这座陵墓的认知，并得到现代考古勘探的部分证实。
description.en: The detailed description of the Qin Mausoleum's underground palace in the 'Records of the Grand Historian,' such as 'using mercury to represent the hundred rivers and the great sea,' profoundly shaped posterity's understanding of the tomb and has been partially confirmed by modern archaeological surveys.

description.zh-cn: 作为秦始皇陵考古队前队长，段清波通过考古学研究，对陵墓的实际建造时间、布局及是否被盗等关键问题提出了重要的学术见解，修正了部分传统看法。
description.en: As the former head of the Qin Mausoleum archaeological team, Duan Qingbo provided significant academic insights into key issues such as the actual construction time, layout, and whether the tomb was robbed, correcting some traditional views through archaeological research.

description.zh-cn: 2019年，中国中央电视台播出的系列专题节目采访了段清波教授，使其关于秦陵从未被盗等考古见解获得了更广泛的传播。
description.en: In 2019, a series of special programs broadcast by CCTV featured an interview with Professor Duan Qingbo, allowing his archaeological findings, such as the conclusion that the Qin Mausoleum was never successfully robbed, to reach a wider audience.

description.zh-cn: 唐代诗人李白在其作品《古风·秦王扫六合》中提及“刑徒七十万，起土骊山隈”，描述了修建秦始皇陵的浩大工程，反映并影响了后世对该工程的认知。
description.en: The Tang dynasty poet Li Bai mentioned the vast construction of the Qin Mausoleum in his work 'Ancient Airs: The King of Qin Sweeps the Six States,' describing '700,000 convicts raising earth at the foot of Mount Li,' which reflected and influenced later perceptions of the project.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国外交部办公厅是由中华人民共和国外交部直接领导的工作机关。
description.en: The General Office of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs is a working body under the direct leadership of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 部长助理兼任。
description.en: Concurrently served as Assistant Minister.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中国国民党革命委员会安徽省委员会的上级机构是中国国民党革命委员会中央委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior body of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang is the Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，中国国民党革命委员会安徽省委员会的机构类型为民主党派。
description.en: According to the infobox, the organization type of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang is a democratic party.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党革命委员会中央委员会是中国国民党革命委员会的中央领导机构。
description.en: The Central Committee of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang is the central leading body of the Revolutionary Committee of the Chinese Kuomintang.

description.zh-cn: 张作相长期在张作霖麾下任职，是奉系军阀的核心人物之一。
description.en: Zhang Zuoxiang served under Zhang Zuolin for a long time and was one of the core figures of the Fengtian clique.

description.zh-cn: 1902年被招安前，与张作霖一同投身绿林，组织“保险队”。
description.en: Before being recruited by the government in 1902, he joined the Green Forest bandits with Zhang Zuolin and organized a 'protection squad'.

description.zh-cn: 在担任东三省总督期间创设了奉天讲武堂。
description.en: He founded the Fengtian Military Academy while serving as the Governor-General of the Three Northeastern Provinces.

description.zh-cn: 曾为奉天讲武堂第一期学生。
description.en: Was a student in the first class of the Fengtian Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 1917年，与孙烈臣共同镇压了宗社党的清朝复辟起义。
description.en: In 1917, along with Sun Liechen, he suppressed the Qing restoration uprising by the Royalist Party.

description.zh-cn: 阻止了冯德麟、汤玉麟的反张作霖阴谋。
description.en: He thwarted the anti-Zhang Zuolin conspiracy of Feng Delin and Tang Yulin.

description.zh-cn: 阻止了冯德麟、汤玉麟的反张作霖阴谋。
description.en: He thwarted the anti-Zhang Zuolin conspiracy of Feng Delin and Tang Yulin.

description.zh-cn: 在任驻关内奉军总司令期间，提拔了自己在东北讲武堂培养起来的张学良。
description.en: During his tenure as the commander-in-chief of the Fengtian army stationed inside the Great Wall, he promoted Zhang Xueliang, whom he had trained at the Northeast Military Academy.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次直奉战争中，率东路军支援被直系击败的、领导西路的张景惠。
description.en: During the First Zhili-Fengtian War, he led the eastern route army to support Zhang Jinghui, the commander of the western route army, who had been defeated by the Zhili clique.

description.zh-cn: 在郭松龄叛乱后，张作相主张宽大处理叛乱士卒，与主张严惩的吴俊升、杨宇霆意见相左。
description.en: After Guo Songling's rebellion, Zhang Zuoxiang advocated for lenient treatment of the rebellious soldiers, opposing Wu Junsheng and Yang Yuting who called for severe punishment.

description.zh-cn: 在郭松龄叛乱后，张作相主张宽大处理叛乱士卒，与主张严惩的吴俊升、杨宇霆意见相左。
description.en: After Guo Songling's rebellion, Zhang Zuoxiang advocated for lenient treatment of the rebellious soldiers, opposing Wu Junsheng and Yang Yuting who called for severe punishment.

description.zh-cn: 皇姑屯事件导致张作霖身亡，其子张学良得以继位。
description.en: The Huanggutun Incident led to the death of Zhang Zuolin, allowing his son Zhang Xueliang to succeed him.

description.zh-cn: 皇姑屯事件后，拥立张学良继位，并担任其东北边防军副司令长官。
description.en: After the Huanggutun Incident, he supported Zhang Xueliang as the successor and served as his Deputy Commander of the Northeast Border Defense Army.

description.zh-cn: 拥立张学良后，推动东北易帜，名义上归顺国民政府。
description.en: After supporting Zhang Xueliang's succession, he promoted the Northeast Flag Replacement, nominally aligning with the Nationalist Government.

description.zh-cn: 在担任吉林省政府主席期间创办了吉林省立大学，并任首任校长。
description.en: While serving as Chairman of the Jilin Provincial Government, he founded Jilin Provincial University and served as its first president.

description.zh-cn: 拒绝了日本方面邀请其出任“满洲国”要职的请求。
description.en: He refused the Japanese invitation to serve in a key position in Manchukuo.

description.zh-cn: 在解放军于锦州俘获张作相后，共产党方面决定将其释放并礼送到天津。
description.en: After Zhang Zuoxiang was captured by the PLA in Jinzhou, the Communist Party decided to release him and escort him to Tianjin.

description.zh-cn: 张作相接替病逝的孙烈臣出任吉林督军。
description.en: Zhang Zuoxiang succeeded the deceased Sun Liechen as the Military Governor of Jilin.

description.zh-cn: 丁超接替张作相出任吉林省政府主席。
description.en: Ding Chao succeeded Zhang Zuoxiang as the Chairman of the Jilin Provincial Government.

description.zh-cn: 张作相是奉系军阀的核心人物之一，先后在清末新军和北洋陆军中任职。
description.en: Zhang Zuoxiang was a core figure of the Fengtian clique, serving in the New Army of the late Qing Dynasty and the Beiyang Army.

description.zh-cn: 武汉大学官方将自强学堂作为其办学源头。
description.en: Wuhan University officially considers the Ziqiang Institute as its origin.

description.zh-cn: 国立武昌高等师范学校是武汉大学较为明确的始源，其成立被视为武汉大学历史上的一个重要节点。
description.en: National Wuchang Higher Normal School is a more definitive origin of Wuhan University, and its establishment is considered an important milestone in the university's history.

description.zh-cn: 2000年8月2日，湖北医科大学并入武汉大学，成为其医学部。
description.en: On August 2, 2000, Hubei Medical University merged into Wuhan University, becoming its Faculty of Medicine.

description.zh-cn: 王世杰是国立武汉大学首位正式校长，提出了将学校办成六大学院万人大学的宏伟目标。
description.en: Wang Shijie was the first formal president of National Wuhan University and proposed the ambitious goal of developing the university into a large-scale institution with six colleges and ten thousand students.

description.zh-cn: 受抗日战争影响，国立武汉大学于1938年被迫西迁至四川乐山继续办学，直到1946年迁回武昌珞珈山。
description.en: Affected by the Second Sino-Japanese War, National Wuhan University was forced to relocate to Leshan, Sichuan in 1938 to continue its operations, returning to Luojia Hill in Wuchang in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 国立武汉大学在抗日战争期间西迁至乐山办学八年。
description.en: National Wuhan University relocated to Leshan for eight years during the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 在1950年代的院系调整中，武汉大学的工科、农科、医科被拆分，独立或并入其他高校，使其变为一所文理科综合大学。
description.en: During the higher education reorganization in the 1950s, Wuhan University's engineering, agriculture, and medical schools were separated to become independent or merge with other institutions, transforming it into a comprehensive university of arts and sciences.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，武汉大学大批学者受到迫害，校长李达被迫害致死，导致学校在1966年至1980年间长期没有正式校长。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, many scholars at Wuhan University were persecuted, and President Li Da was persecuted to death, leaving the university without a formal president for a long period from 1966 to 1980.

description.zh-cn: 担任校长期间，刘道玉在校内推行一系列教学和管理体制改革措施，使武大迎来了1949年后的第一个快速发展期。
description.en: During his presidency, Liu Daoyu implemented a series of reforms in teaching and management systems, ushering in the first rapid development period for Wuhan University after 1949.

description.zh-cn: 在武汉大学130周年校庆之际，校友雷军向母校捐赠13亿元人民币，创下中国高校单笔个人捐赠纪录。
description.en: On the occasion of Wuhan University's 130th anniversary, alumnus Lei Jun donated 1.3 billion RMB to his alma mater, setting a record for the largest single personal donation to a Chinese university.

description.zh-cn: 武汉大学是中华人民共和国教育部直属高等学校。
description.en: Wuhan University is a higher education institution directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华民国前总统马英九访问武汉大学并与师生进行交流座谈。
description.en: Former President of the Republic of China, Ma Ying-jeou, visited Wuhan University and held a discussion with faculty and students.

description.zh-cn: 东方电机厂是中国东方电气集团公司的前身。
description.en: Dongfang Electric Machinery Plant is the predecessor of DongFang Electric Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 1993年，东方电机厂改制成东方电机股份有限公司（东方电气股份有限公司前身）。
description.en: In 1993, Dongfang Electric Machinery Plant was restructured into Dongfang Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. (the predecessor of Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited).

description.zh-cn: 其H股于1994年在香港交易所上市。
description.en: Its H-shares were listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战是东汉末年群雄割据时期的一场重要战役。
description.en: The Battle of Guandu was a major battle during the period of warlord contention at the end of the Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 曹操采纳荀攸声东击西之计，成功突袭白马，解白马之围。
description.en: Cao Cao adopted Xun You's strategy of feinting east and attacking west, successfully launching a surprise attack on Boma and lifting its siege.

description.zh-cn: 文丑在延津之战中被曹操军击杀。
description.en: Wen Chou was killed by Cao Cao's forces during the Battle of Yanjin.

description.zh-cn: 许攸从袁绍阵营投奔曹操，并献上奇袭袁军粮仓乌巢之计，成为官渡之战的转折点。
description.en: Xu You defected from Yuan Shao's camp to Cao Cao and proposed a plan for a surprise attack on the Yuan army's supply depot at Wuchao, which became the turning point of the Battle of Guandu.

description.zh-cn: 曹操采纳许攸之计，亲自率领五千精兵夜袭乌巢，发动了乌巢之战。
description.en: Adopting Xu You's plan, Cao Cao personally led 5,000 elite troops on a night raid of Wuchao, launching the Battle of Wuchao.

description.zh-cn: 淳于琼在乌巢之战中被曹操军击败并斩杀。
description.en: Chunyu Qiong was defeated and killed by Cao Cao's forces during the Battle of Wuchao.

description.zh-cn: 根据《三国志·乐进传》记载，乐进在乌巢之战中斩杀了淳于琼。
description.en: According to the Records of the Three Kingdoms, Biography of Yue Jin, Yue Jin killed Chunyu Qiong during the Battle of Wuchao.

description.zh-cn: 乌巢失守后，郭图为推卸责任而向袁绍进谗言陷害高览，导致高览与张郃一同投降曹操。
description.en: After the fall of Wuchao, Guo Tu slandered Gao Lan to Yuan Shao to shift blame, causing Gao Lan to defect to Cao Cao along with Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 在官渡之战中，张郃因受郭图谗言所害，遂率部投降曹操。
description.en: During the Battle of Guandu, Zhang He, having been slandered by Guo Tu, led his troops to surrender to Cao Cao.

description.zh-cn: 在官渡之战中，高览因受郭图谗言所害，与张郃一同投降曹操。
description.en: During the Battle of Guandu, Gao Lan, having been slandered by Guo Tu, surrendered to Cao Cao along with Zhang He.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战后，袁绍后悔不听田丰之言，但逢纪借机诋毁田丰，导致田丰被袁绍杀害。
description.en: After the Battle of Guandu, Yuan Shao regretted not listening to Tian Feng's advice, but Feng Ji took the opportunity to slander Tian Feng, which led to Yuan Shao executing him.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍在官渡之战失败后，听信逢纪谗言，将田丰杀害。
description.en: After his defeat at the Battle of Guandu, Yuan Shao listened to Feng Ji's slander and executed Tian Feng.

description.zh-cn: 官渡之战后，沮授被曹操俘虏，因其拒绝投降并企图逃回袁绍处而被曹操所杀。
description.en: After the Battle of Guandu, Ju Shou was captured by Cao Cao. He was executed after refusing to surrender and attempting to escape back to Yuan Shao.

description.zh-cn: 袁绍死后，袁谭与袁尚为争夺继承权而互相攻击。
description.en: After Yuan Shao's death, Yuan Tan and Yuan Shang fought each other for succession.

description.zh-cn: 袁尚兵败后投奔辽东，被太守公孙康杀害。
