description.en: After his defeat, Yuan Shang fled to Liaodong, where he was killed by the administrator Gongsun Kang.

description.zh-cn: 孔子曾向老子问礼。
description.en: Confucius once inquired with Laozi about the rites.

description.zh-cn: 孔子向师襄子学习弹琴。
description.en: Confucius learned to play the guqin from Master Xiang.

description.zh-cn: 孔子拜郯子为师，向其学习。
description.en: Confucius regarded Duke Tan as a teacher and learned from him.

description.zh-cn: 齐景公问政于孔子。
description.en: Duke Jing of Qi consulted Confucius on matters of governance.

description.zh-cn: 相传孔子依据鲁国史料编修了《春秋》。
description.en: It is said that Confucius compiled the Spring and Autumn Annals based on the historical records of the State of Lu.

description.zh-cn: 澹台灭明是孔子的弟子。
description.en: Tantai Mieming was a disciple of Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 澹台灭明的成就使孔子认识到自己“以貌取人”的错误，并对此进行了反思。
description.en: The achievements of Tantai Mieming made Confucius realize his mistake of 'judging a person by appearance' and reflect upon it.

description.zh-cn: 谈哲敏自2023年4月起担任南京大学校长。
description.en: Tan Zhemin has been the president of Nanjing University since April 2023.

description.zh-cn: 谭铁牛担任南京大学党委书记。
description.en: Tan Tieniu serves as the Party Committee Secretary of Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 1949年中华人民共和国成立前夕，国立中央大学更名为国立南京大学。
description.en: On the eve of the founding of the People's Republic of China in 1949, National Central University was renamed National Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 国立中央大学的学生是五二零运动的主体之一。
description.en: Students from National Central University were one of the main groups in the May 20th Movement.

description.zh-cn: 金陵大学的学生是五二零运动的主体之一。
description.en: Students from the University of Nanking were one of the main groups in the May 20th Movement.

description.zh-cn: 江谦是南京高等师范学校首任校长。
description.en: Jiang Qian was the first president of Nanjing Higher Normal School.

description.zh-cn: 南京大学授予德国前总理默克尔名誉博士学位。
description.en: Nanjing University conferred an honorary doctorate upon former German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民被列为南京大学校友。
description.en: Jiang Zemin is listed as an alumnus of Nanjing University.

description.zh-cn: 南京大学与约翰斯·霍普金斯大学于20世纪80年代共同创办了中美文化研究中心。
description.en: Nanjing University and Johns Hopkins University jointly founded the HNC Center for Chinese and American Studies in the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学与南京大学于20世纪80年代共同创办了中美文化研究中心。
description.en: Johns Hopkins University and Nanjing University jointly founded the HNC Center for Chinese and American Studies in the 1980s.

description.zh-cn: 南京大学与约翰斯·霍普金斯大学是长期合作伙伴，共同创办了中美文化研究中心。
description.en: Nanjing University and Johns Hopkins University are long-term partners, having jointly established the HNC Center for Chinese and American Studies.

description.zh-cn: 南京大学是中华人民共和国教育部直属大学。
description.en: Nanjing University is a university directly under the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军东部战区陆军由中国人民解放军陆军领导机构领导。
description.en: The PLA Eastern Theater Command Ground Force is led by the PLA Ground Force headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军东部战区陆军是中国人民解放军东部战区的组成部分。
description.en: The PLA Eastern Theater Command Ground Force is a component of the PLA Eastern Theater Command.

description.zh-cn: 在2016年2月1日的战区成立大会上，习近平向东部战区等五大战区授予军旗并发布训令，标志其正式成立。
description.en: At the theater command establishment ceremony on February 1, 2016, Xi Jinping presented flags and gave instructions to the five major theater commands, including the Eastern Theater Command, marking their official establishment.

description.zh-cn: 陆军第七十一集团军隶属于东部战区陆军。
description.en: The 71st Group Army is subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 陆军第七十二集团军隶属于东部战区陆军。
description.en: The 72nd Group Army is subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 该基地为东部战区陆军直属单位。
description.en: This base is a unit directly subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 该基地为东部战区陆军直属单位。
description.en: This base is a unit directly subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 该基地为东部战区陆军直属单位。
description.en: This base is a unit directly subordinate to the Eastern Theater Command Ground Force.

description.zh-cn: 通过单晶X射线衍射得到了青蒿素的相对构型，并于1979年最终肯定了其绝对构型，为阐明青蒿素结构作出关键贡献。
description.en: Obtained the relative configuration of artemisinin through single-crystal X-ray diffraction and confirmed its absolute configuration in 1979, making a crucial contribution to elucidating its structure.

description.zh-cn: 任建新出生于山西省汾城县。
description.en: Ren Jianxin was born in Fencheng County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 任建新于2024年9月21日在北京逝世。
description.en: Ren Jianxin passed away in Beijing on September 21, 2024.

description.zh-cn: 任建新于1948年6月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Ren Jianxin joined the Chinese Communist Party in June 1948.

degree.zh-cn: 工学院化学工程系肄业
degree.en: Studied in the Department of Chemical Engineering, College of Engineering (did not graduate)

description.zh-cn: 任建新曾就读于北京大学工学院化学工程系，于1948年肄业。
description.en: Ren Jianxin studied at the Department of Chemical Engineering, College of Engineering, Peking University, leaving without graduating in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 1948年起，任建新在华北人民政府担任秘书工作。
description.en: Starting from 1948, Ren Jianxin worked as a secretary in the North China People's Government.

position.zh-cn: 法律部处长、法律部部长、副主任
position.en: Division Chief of Law Department, Minister of Law Department, Deputy Director

description.zh-cn: 1959年调入，历任法律部处长、部长，后升至副主任。
description.en: Transferred in 1959, served successively as Division Chief and Minister of the Law Department, and was later promoted to Deputy Director.

description.zh-cn: 在“文化大革命”中，任建新‘靠边站’，后下放“五七干校”劳动。
description.en: During the 'Cultural Revolution', Ren Jianxin was 'sidelined' and later sent to a 'May Seventh Cadre School' for labor.

description.zh-cn: 任建新接替郑天翔，出任中华人民共和国最高人民法院院长。
description.en: Ren Jianxin succeeded Zheng Tianxiang as President of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 肖扬接替任建新，出任中华人民共和国最高人民法院院长。
description.en: Xiao Yang succeeded Ren Jianxin as President of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 任建新接替乔石，出任中共中央政法委员会书记。
description.en: Ren Jianxin succeeded Qiao Shi as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

description.zh-cn: 罗干接替任建新，出任中共中央政法委员会书记。
description.en: Luo Gan succeeded Ren Jianxin as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission.

position.zh-cn: 中共中央政法委员会书记
position.en: Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

description.zh-cn: 任建新担任中共中央政法委书记期间，江泽民为中共中央总书记。
description.en: While Ren Jianxin served as Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Jiang Zemin was the General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 任建新曾任中央社会治安综合治理委员会副主任，后于1992年起担任主任。
description.en: Ren Jianxin served as Vice Director of the Central Comprehensive Governance Commission for Public Security, and became Director in 1992.

description.zh-cn: 任建新担任第九届全国政协副主席。
description.en: Ren Jianxin served as the Vice Chairman of the 9th National Committee of the CPPCC.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 任建新担任第九届全国政协副主席期间，李瑞环为全国政协主席。
description.en: While Ren Jianxin served as Vice Chairman of the 9th CPPCC National Committee, Li Ruihuan was the Chairman.

description.zh-cn: 任建新逝世后，习近平等党和国家领导人出席了他的遗体告别仪式。
description.en: After Ren Jianxin's death, Xi Jinping and other party and state leaders attended his farewell ceremony.

description.zh-cn: 任建新是原国家级副职领导人。
description.en: Ren Jianxin was a former state-level vice-leader.

description.zh-cn: 任建新是原党和国家领导人。
description.en: Ren Jianxin was a former Party and state leader.

description.zh-cn: 伊力扎提·艾合买提江是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Ilzat Exmetjan is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 伊力扎提·艾合买提江毕业于中国人民大学人力资源管理专业。
description.en: Ilzat Exmetjan graduated from Renmin University of China with a degree in Human Resource Management.

description.zh-cn: 伊力扎提·艾合买提江拥有中欧国际工商学院工商管理硕士学位。
description.en: Ilzat Exmetjan holds an EMBA from the China Europe International Business School.

description.zh-cn: 伊力扎提·艾合买提江接替祖木热提·吾布力担任中共新疆维吾尔自治区党委统战部部长职务。
description.en: Ilzat Exmetjan succeeded Zumret Obul as the Minister of the United Front Work Department of the CPC Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Regional Committee.

description.zh-cn: 伊力扎提·艾合买提江接替沙尔合提·阿汗担任新疆维吾尔自治区总工会主席职务。
description.en: Ilzat Exmetjan succeeded Sharhat Ahan as the Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 木合亚提·加尔木哈买提接替伊力扎提·艾合买提江担任新疆维吾尔自治区总工会主席职务。
description.en: Muheyat Jarmuhammat succeeded Ilzat Exmetjan as the Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Federation of Trade Unions.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，伊力扎提·艾合买提江是第十四届全国政协委员。
description.en: According to page category information, Ilzat Exmetjan is a member of the 14th National Committee of the CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 张镇麟效力于CBA的辽宁男篮俱乐部。
description.en: Zhang Zhenlin plays for the Liaoning Flying Leopards club in the CBA.

description.zh-cn: 清太宗皇太极仿明建制时于亲王前加号“和硕”，以示尊崇。
description.en: The Hong Taiji Emperor, imitating the Ming system, added the title 'Hošoi' before 'Cin Wang' (Prince) to signify high honor.

description.zh-cn: 冯玉祥发动北京政变，终结了清室优待条件。
description.en: Feng Yuxiang launched the Beijing Coup and terminated the Articles of Favorable Treatment for the Qing Imperial House.

description.zh-cn: 1924年清室优待条件被终结，标志着和硕亲王这一爵位制度的正式结束。
description.en: The termination of the Articles of Favorable Treatment in 1924 marked the official end of the 'Hošoi cin wang' peerage system.

description.zh-cn: 乾隆四十三年（1778年），乾隆帝下旨允许淳颖承袭世袭罔替的睿亲王爵位。
description.en: In the 43rd year of the Qianlong era (1778), the Qianlong Emperor decreed that Chunying could inherit the hereditary Prince Rui title.

description.zh-cn: 代善是皇太极的二哥。
description.en: Daišan was Hong Taiji's second older brother.

description.zh-cn: 多铎是皇太极的十五弟。
description.en: Dodo was Hong Taiji's fifteenth younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 豪格是皇太极的长子。
description.en: Hooge was Hong Taiji's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 济尔哈朗是皇太极的侄儿。
description.en: Jirgalang was Hong Taiji's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 硕塞是皇太极的五子。
description.en: Šose was Hong Taiji's fifth son.

description.zh-cn: 奕劻是乾隆帝的曾孙。
description.en: Yikuang was the Qianlong Emperor's great-grandson.

description.zh-cn: 西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛人民武装部受海南省军区与中共西南中沙工委双重领导。
description.en: The People's Armed Forces Department of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands was under the dual leadership of the Hainan Provincial Military District and the CPC Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands Working Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1959年3月，海南军区派出军事工作队设立了西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛人民武装部。
description.en: In March 1959, the Hainan Military District dispatched a military work team to establish the People's Armed Forces Department of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands.

description.zh-cn: 1959年3月1日成立的“广东省西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛办事处”是广东省人民政府的派出机构。
description.en: The 'Guangdong Province Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands Office', established on March 1, 1959, was a dispatched agency of the People's Government of Guangdong Province.

description.zh-cn: 西南中沙群岛办事处成立后，委托海南行政区领导。
description.en: After its establishment, the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands Office was placed under the leadership of the Hainan Administrative Region.

description.zh-cn: 尼克松访华改善了中美关系，美国表示不插手西沙问题，这促使毛泽东指示加强西沙设防，随后西南中沙人武部于1972年8月组建了多个基干武装民兵连，加强了其军事力量。
description.en: Nixon's visit to China improved Sino-US relations, with the US indicating it would not intervene in the Xisha issue. This prompted Mao Zedong to order the strengthening of Xisha's defenses, leading the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Armed Forces Department to form several core armed militia companies in August 1972, enhancing its military strength.

description.zh-cn: 在尼克松访华后指示开展西沙设防工程，直接促使了西南中沙人武部在1972年8月进行扩编和战备升级。
description.en: After Nixon's visit to China, Mao Zedong instructed to carry out fortification projects in Xisha, directly prompting the expansion and combat readiness upgrade of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Armed Forces Department in August 1972.

description.zh-cn: 在西沙海战期间，西南中沙人武部所属的武装民兵排直接参与了在永乐群岛的战斗，对战事发展起到了重要作用。
description.en: During the Battle of the Paracel Islands, the armed militia platoon of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Armed Forces Department directly participated in the fighting in the Yongle Islands, playing an important role in the development of the conflict.

description.zh-cn: 命令西南中沙人武部组织武装民兵排参与西沙海战。
description.en: Ordered the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Armed Forces Department to organize an armed militia platoon to participate in the Battle of the Paracel Islands.

description.zh-cn: 于1974年6月决定将西沙群岛的所有守岛任务划归海军西沙巡防区领导，此举使西南中沙人武部不再担负军事守备任务。
description.en: In June 1974, decided to transfer all island defense duties in the Xisha Islands to the leadership of the Xisha Naval Patrol Area, which resulted in the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Armed Forces Department no longer undertaking military defense tasks.

description.zh-cn: 2012年7月19日，西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛人民武装部被撤销，并在其基础上组建了三沙警备区。
description.en: On July 19, 2012, the People's Armed Forces Department of the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands was abolished, and the Sansha Garrison was established on its foundation.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山于1949年至1950年间担任中华民国行政院院长。
description.en: Yan Xishan served as the Premier of the Republic of China from 1949 to 1950.

description.zh-cn: 在李宗仁代理中华民国总统期间，阎锡山担任行政院院长。
description.en: Yan Xishan served as Premier while Li Zongren was the acting President of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在蒋中正复行视事后，阎锡山短暂担任其下的行政院院长，随后辞职。
description.en: After Chiang Kai-shek resumed his duties as President, Yan Xishan briefly served as his Premier before resigning.

description.zh-cn: 朱家骅在阎锡山内阁中担任行政院副院长。
description.en: Zhu Jiahua served as Vice Premier in Yan Xishan's cabinet.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山与赵戴文是好友，曾一同携带炸弹回国参与革命。
description.en: Yan Xishan and Zhao Daiwen were close friends who returned to China together with bombs to participate in the revolution.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山领导的太原起义中，时任山西巡抚陆钟琦被枪杀。
description.en: During the Taiyuan Uprising led by Yan Xishan, the then-governor of Shanxi, Lu Zhongqi, was shot and killed.

description.zh-cn: 在计划组建的燕晋联军中，阎锡山任副都督，吴禄贞为大都督。
description.en: In the planned Yan-Jin Allied Army, Yan Xishan was to be the Vice Commander-in-Chief under Commander-in-Chief Wu Luzhen.

description.zh-cn: 辛亥革命后，曹锟奉袁世凯之命率军进攻阎锡山统治的山西。
description.en: After the Xinhai Revolution, Cao Kun, under Yuan Shikai's orders, led troops to attack Shanxi, which was controlled by Yan Xishan.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山通电征讨张勋，反对其复辟帝制。
description.en: Yan Xishan sent a telegram to denounce Zhang Xun, opposing his attempt to restore the monarchy.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山奉段祺瑞之命派兵前往湖南，参与镇压护法运动。
description.en: Under Duan Qirui's orders, Yan Xishan dispatched troops to Hunan to participate in the suppression of the Constitutional Protection Movement.

description.zh-cn: 在北伐期间，蒋介石提请任命阎锡山为国民革命军北路总司令。
description.en: During the Northern Expedition, Chiang Kai-shek proposed appointing Yan Xishan as the Commander-in-Chief of the Northern Route of the National Revolutionary Army.

description.zh-cn: 在北伐战争中，阎锡山率领的国民革命军第三集团军与张作霖的奉系军队作战。
description.en: During the Northern Expedition, the Third Group Army of the National Revolutionary Army led by Yan Xishan fought against the Fengtian clique army of Zhang Zuolin.

description.zh-cn: 北伐期间，因冯玉祥拒绝支援并撤军导致晋军陷入险境，二人结怨。后在中原大战中联合反蒋，但关系复杂。
description.en: During the Northern Expedition, the two became rivals after Feng Yuxiang refused to provide support and withdrew his troops, putting Yan's army in danger. They later allied against Chiang Kai-shek in the Central Plains War, but their relationship remained complex.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山联合冯玉祥等人发动中原大战，公开讨伐蒋介石。
description.en: Yan Xishan, in alliance with Feng Yuxiang and others, launched the Central Plains War to openly oppose Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山命令其麾下晋绥军对日伪军进行反击，取得了百灵庙战役的胜利。
description.en: Yan Xishan ordered his Jin-Sui Army to counter-attack Japanese and puppet forces, achieving victory in the Battle of Bailingmiao.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争期间，阎锡山作为第二战区司令长官，指挥了太原会战。
description.en: During the Second Sino-Japanese War, Yan Xishan, as the commander of the Second War Zone, commanded the Battle of Taiyuan.

description.zh-cn: 阎锡山试图收回由共产党控制的山西新军的权力，引发了新军的公开叛变，即晋西事变。
description.en: Yan Xishan's attempt to regain control over the Communist-influenced Shanxi New Army triggered an open mutiny, known as the Jinxi Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战期间，中国人民解放军与阎锡山部在山西持续作战，并最终在太原战役中将其彻底击败。
description.en: During the second Chinese Civil War, the People's Liberation Army continuously fought against Yan Xishan's forces in Shanxi and ultimately defeated them in the Taiyuan Campaign.

description.zh-cn: 崔永辉自2021年10月起担任中国共产党厦门市委员会书记。
description.en: Cui Yonghui has served as the Secretary of the CPC Xiamen Municipal Committee since October 2021.

description.zh-cn: 杨国豪自2022年1月起担任厦门市人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Yang Guohao has served as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Xiamen Municipal People's Congress since January 2022.

description.zh-cn: 伍斌自2024年9月起担任厦门市人民政府市长。
description.en: Wu Bin has served as the Mayor of the Xiamen Municipal People's Government since September 2024.

description.zh-cn: 张国旺自2025年1月起担任中国人民政治协商会议厦门市委员会主席。
description.en: Zhang Guowang has served as the Chairman of the Xiamen Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference since January 2025.

description.zh-cn: 为防备倭寇，周德兴于1387年在嘉禾屿（今厦门岛）设立中左守御千户所。
description.en: To defend against Wokou pirates, Zhou Dexing established the Zhongzuo Shouyu Qianhusuo on Jiahe Islet (present-day Xiamen Island) in 1387.

description.zh-cn: 中左守御千户所的设立是为了防备倭寇的侵扰。
description.en: The Zhongzuo Shouyu Qianhusuo was established to defend against the raids of the Wokou pirates.

description.zh-cn: 1655年，郑成功将中左守御千户所改名为思明州。
description.en: In 1655, Koxinga renamed the Zhongzuo Shouyu Qianhusuo to Siming Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 1661年，郑成功以思明州为基地，率领部队征服台湾。
description.en: In 1661, Koxinga used Siming Prefecture as a base to lead his troops to conquer Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 1853年，黄德美与黄威率领小刀会在厦门发动起义。
description.en: In 1853, Huang Demei and Huang Wei led the Small Swords Society in an uprising in Xiamen.

description.zh-cn: 1853年，黄威与黄德美率领小刀会在厦门发动起义。
description.en: In 1853, Huang Wei and Huang Demei led the Small Swords Society in an uprising in Xiamen.

description.zh-cn: 1900年，日本方面制造厦门事件，意图侵占厦门。
description.en: In 1900, Japan orchestrated the Amoy Incident with the intention of occupying Xiamen.

description.zh-cn: 厦门事件最终导致了鼓浪屿公共租界的产生。
description.en: The Amoy Incident ultimately led to the establishment of the Kulangsu International Settlement.

description.zh-cn: 1938年5月13日，日军发动厦门战斗并占据厦门全岛。
description.en: On May 13, 1938, the Japanese army launched the Battle of Amoy and occupied the entire island.

description.zh-cn: 1949年10月17日，中国人民解放军发动厦门战役并攻克厦门。
description.en: On October 17, 1949, the People's Liberation Army launched the Battle of Xiamen and captured the city.

description.zh-cn: 厦门战役后，厦门市人民政府于1949年10月21日成立。
description.en: After the Battle of Xiamen, the Xiamen Municipal People's Government was established on October 21, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 厦门爱乐乐团由指挥家郑小瑛于1998年创办。
description.en: The Xiamen Philharmonic Orchestra was founded by conductor Zheng Xiaoying in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 陈嘉庚出生并成长于厦门地区。
description.en: Tan Kah Kee was born and grew up in the Xiamen area.

description.zh-cn: 林巧雅出生并成长于厦门地区。
description.en: Lin Qiaoya was born and grew up in the Xiamen area.

description.zh-cn: 朱熹曾寓居同安（今属厦门市），并于1153年主持扩建同安孔庙。
description.en: Zhu Xi once resided in Tong'an (now part of Xiamen) and presided over the expansion of the Tong'an Confucius Temple in 1153.

description.zh-cn: 鲁迅曾经在厦门地区工作。
description.en: Lu Xun once worked in the Xiamen area.

description.zh-cn: 习近平曾经在厦门地区工作。
description.en: Xi Jinping once worked in the Xiamen area.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，秦城监狱被军管，囚犯待遇恶化，并加盖了新的监舍以关押大量增加的囚犯。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Qincheng Prison was placed under military control, prisoner treatment deteriorated, and new cell blocks were built to accommodate a large influx of inmates.

description.zh-cn: 就刘建章妻子反映的监狱虐待问题批示周恩来，要求废除“法西斯式的审查方式”。
description.en: Instructed Zhou Enlai regarding the prison abuse issue raised by Liu Jianzhang's wife, demanding the abolition of 'fascist-style interrogation methods'.

description.zh-cn: 昭慈圣献皇后孟氏是宋哲宗的第一位皇后，于绍圣三年（1096年）被废。
description.en: Empress Zhaoci Shengxian (Meng) was the first empress of Emperor Zhezong, and was deposed in the third year of the Shaosheng era (1096).

description.zh-cn: 昭怀皇后刘氏是宋哲宗的第二位皇后，在孟皇后被废后受册立。
description.en: Empress Zhaohuai (Liu) was the second empress of Emperor Zhezong, instated after Empress Meng was deposed.

description.zh-cn: 赵茂是宋哲宗的独子。
description.en: Zhao Mao was the only son of Emperor Zhezong.

description.zh-cn: 赵茂的母亲是昭怀皇后刘氏。
description.en: Zhao Mao's mother was Empress Zhaohuai (Liu).

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗于1085年至1100年间担任北宋皇帝。
description.en: Emperor Zhezong served as the emperor of the Northern Song Dynasty from 1085 to 1100.

description.zh-cn: 高太皇太后执政后，任用保守派大臣司马光为宰相。
description.en: After assuming power as regent, Grand Empress Dowager Gao appointed the conservative minister Sima Guang as chancellor.

description.zh-cn: 宋哲宗对高太皇太后执政期间尽罢新法的做法感到不满。
description.en: Emperor Zhezong was dissatisfied with Grand Empress Dowager Gao's complete abolition of the New Policies during her regency.

description.zh-cn: 宋神宗病重时，宰相王珪建议立赵煦（即后来的宋哲宗）为储君。
description.en: When Emperor Shenzong was critically ill, Chancellor Wang Gui suggested establishing Zhao Xu (the future Emperor Zhezong) as the crown prince.

description.zh-cn: 哲宗亲政后，表明绍述神宗事业，恢复王安石变法中的保甲法、免役法、青苗法等。
description.en: After assuming personal rule, Emperor Zhezong declared his intention to continue the work of Emperor Shenzong and restored aspects of the Wang Anshi Reforms, such as the Baojia system, the Hired Service Law, and the Green Sprouts Law.

description.zh-cn: 哲宗亲政后，为报复元祐旧党，追贬已故的司马光。
description.en: After assuming personal rule, Emperor Zhezong posthumously demoted the deceased Sima Guang as part of his retaliation against the Yuanyou conservative faction.

description.zh-cn: 哲宗亲政后，将旧党党人苏轼贬谪于岭南。
description.en: After assuming personal rule, Emperor Zhezong exiled the conservative faction member Su Shi to Lingnan.

description.zh-cn: 哲宗亲政后，将旧党党人苏辙贬谪于岭南。
description.en: After assuming personal rule, Emperor Zhezong exiled the conservative faction member Su Zhe to Lingnan.

description.zh-cn: 哲宗亲政后，重用革新派章惇为宰相以恢复新法。
description.en: After assuming personal rule, Emperor Zhezong heavily relied on the reformer Zhang Dun as chancellor to revive the New Policies.

description.zh-cn: 绍圣三年（1096年），章惇以巫蛊诅咒的罪名，要求宋哲宗废黜孟皇后。宋哲宗因此感叹“章惇坏我名节！”
description.en: In the third year of the Shaosheng era (1096), Zhang Dun accused Empress Meng of witchcraft and demanded that Emperor Zhezong depose her, causing the emperor to lament, 'Zhang Dun has ruined my reputation!'

description.zh-cn: 哲宗亲政后，停止与西夏谈判，多次出兵讨伐，迫使西夏向宋朝乞和。
description.en: After assuming personal rule, Emperor Zhezong ceased negotiations with the Western Xia, launched multiple military campaigns against them, and forced them to sue for peace with the Song court.

description.zh-cn: 项羽是楚国名将项燕之孙。
description.en: Xiang Yu was the grandson of the famous Chu general Xiang Yan.

description.zh-cn: 在起兵初期，项羽担任其叔父项梁的裨将。
description.en: In the early stages of the rebellion, Xiang Yu served as a subordinate general to his uncle Xiang Liang.

description.zh-cn: 项羽领导起义军反抗秦朝统治，并在巨鹿之战中歼灭秦军主力，最终导致秦朝灭亡。
description.en: Xiang Yu led rebel forces against the Qin dynasty, annihilating its main army at the Battle of Julu, which ultimately led to the dynasty's collapse.

description.zh-cn: 项羽进入咸阳后，杀死了已向刘邦投降的秦朝末代君主子婴。
description.en: After entering Xianyang, Xiang Yu executed Ziying, the last ruler of the Qin dynasty, who had already surrendered to Liu Bang.

description.zh-cn: 在彭城之战中，项羽亲率三万精兵，大破刘邦五十六万联军。
description.en: At the Battle of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu personally led 30,000 elite troops to crush Liu Bang's coalition army of 560,000.

description.zh-cn: 三明市人民政府的业务上级是福建省人民政府。
description.en: The operational superior of the Sanming Municipal People's Government is the Fujian Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 越南国于1949年7月2日正式成立，取代了此前的越南临时中央政府。
description.en: The State of Vietnam was formally established on July 2, 1949, replacing the previous Provisional Central Government of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 1955年的公民投票导致越南国被改组为越南共和国。
description.en: The 1955 referendum led to the State of Vietnam being reorganized into the Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南国在1949年至1954年间是法兰西联盟的构成国。
description.en: The State of Vietnam was a constituent state of the French Union from 1949 to 1954.

description.zh-cn: 为削弱胡志明在越南的影响力，法国支持逊帝保大出山建立越南国，作为本地的替代政府。
description.en: To weaken the influence of Hồ Chí Minh in Vietnam, France supported the abdicated emperor Bảo Đại in establishing the State of Vietnam as an alternative local government.

description.zh-cn: 在由吴廷琰主导的公民投票中，保大帝被废黜，结束了其国长身份。
description.en: In the referendum led by Ngô Đình Diệm, Bảo Đại was deposed, ending his status as Chief of State.

description.zh-cn: 吴廷琰于1954年出任越南国总理，是该政权的末任总理。
description.en: Ngô Đình Diệm became the Prime Minister of the State of Vietnam in 1954, serving as the last prime minister of the regime.

description.zh-cn: 吴廷琰在1955年公民投票后，宣告成立越南共和国，并成为其第一任总统。
description.en: After the 1955 referendum, Ngô Đình Diệm proclaimed the establishment of the Republic of Vietnam and became its first president.

description.zh-cn: 该次公民投票的结果直接促成了越南共和国的成立。
description.en: The result of this referendum directly led to the establishment of the Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次印度支那战争期间，越南国作为法国支持的政权，与共产党领导的越盟进行军事对抗以争夺越南的合法统治权。
description.en: During the First Indochina War, the State of Vietnam, as a French-backed regime, militarily confronted the communist-led Việt Minh for the legitimate rule of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 日内瓦会议决定以北纬17度线为界将越南分裂，导致越南国的统治范围被限定在南方。
description.en: The Geneva Conference decided to divide Vietnam at the 17th parallel, which restricted the State of Vietnam's rule to the south.

description.zh-cn: 日内瓦会议的成果之一是越南国从法兰西联盟获得完全独立。
description.en: One outcome of the Geneva Conference was the State of Vietnam gaining full independence from the French Union.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次印度支那战争期间，法兰西第四共和国是越南国的主要支持者。
description.en: During the First Indochina War, the French Fourth Republic was the main supporter of the State of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 美国在1950年至1954年间向越南国提供支持，以对抗共产主义势力在东南亚的扩张。
description.en: The United States provided support to the State of Vietnam between 1950 and 1954 to counter the expansion of communist forces in Southeast Asia.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次印度支那战争中，中华人民共和国是胡志明领导的越盟的后援。
description.en: During the First Indochina War, the People's Republic of China was a supporter of the Việt Minh led by Hồ Chí Minh.

description.zh-cn: 在第一次印度支那战争中，苏联向胡志明领导的越盟提供了少量支持。
description.en: During the First Indochina War, the Soviet Union provided some support to the Việt Minh led by Hồ Chí Minh.

description.zh-cn: 1949年签署的《爱丽舍协定》允许保大帝建立越南国军作为其国防力量。
description.en: The Élysée Accords signed in 1949 allowed Bảo Đại to establish the Vietnamese National Army as his defense force.

description.zh-cn: 保大帝根据《爱丽舍协定》建立了越南国军。
description.en: Bảo Đại established the Vietnamese National Army based on the Élysée Accords.

description.zh-cn: 越南国军是越南国的国防力量，效忠于该政权。
description.en: The Vietnamese National Army was the defense force of the State of Vietnam and was loyal to the regime.

description.zh-cn: 阮文馨将军是越南国军的指挥官。
description.en: General Nguyễn Văn Hinh was the commander of the Vietnamese National Army.

description.zh-cn: 阮文春是越南临时中央政府的总理。
description.en: Nguyễn Văn Xuân was the Prime Minister of the Provisional Central Government of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 在1955年公民投票期间，吴廷瑈与勤劳党共同组织和监督选举，支持其兄吴廷琰，并策划了贬损保大声誉的宣传活动。
description.en: During the 1955 referendum, Ngô Đình Nhu, along with the Can Lao Party, organized and supervised the election in support of his brother Ngô Đình Diệm, and orchestrated a propaganda campaign to discredit Bảo Đại.

description.zh-cn: 保大帝设立了皇朝疆土这一特殊行政区，由其直接管辖。
description.en: Bảo Đại established the Domaine de la Couronne as a special administrative area under his direct rule.

description.zh-cn: 皇朝疆土于1955年3月11日被废除，时任总理为吴廷琰。
description.en: The Domaine de la Couronne was abolished on March 11, 1955, when Ngô Đình Diệm was Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 黄长烨将金日成的思想综合成思想体系，对主体思想进行了体系化。
description.en: Hwang Jang-yop synthesized Kim Il-sung's ideas into a coherent ideological system, thereby systematizing the Juche Idea.

description.zh-cn: 金正日在1970年代后进一步发展了主体思想，并出版了《关于主体思想》一书，完成了其理论核心。
description.en: After the 1970s, Kim Jong-il further developed the Juche Idea and published the book 'On the Juche Idea', completing its theoretical core.

description.zh-cn: 主体思想最初被认为是马克思列宁主义的一种创造性应用，金日成在朝鲜革命的实践中对其进行了修改和运用。
description.en: The Juche Idea was initially considered a creative application of Marxism-Leninism, which Kim Il-sung modified and applied in the practice of the Korean revolution.

description.zh-cn: 赫鲁晓夫的秘密报告引发了反对个人崇拜的思潮，成为金日成提出主体思想以清除党内反对派并巩固权力的关键因素。
description.en: Khrushchev's Secret Speech triggered a wave of opposition to personality cults, becoming a key factor for Kim Il-sung to propose the Juche Idea to purge internal opponents and consolidate power.

description.zh-cn: 苏共二十大上反对个人崇拜的立场，促使金日成在朝鲜劳动党内确立“主体”，以应对外部压力和内部挑战。
description.en: The anti-personality cult stance at the 20th Congress of the CPSU prompted Kim Il-sung to establish "Juche" within the Workers' Party of Korea to counter external pressures and internal challenges.

description.zh-cn: 中国文化大革命期间对金日成的批判和对朝鲜施加的压力，成为诱发主体思想正式诞生和系统化的关键外部因素。
description.en: The criticism of Kim Il-sung and pressure on North Korea during China's Cultural Revolution became a key external factor that induced the formal birth and systematization of the Juche Idea.

description.zh-cn: 黄长烨曾担任金日成综合大学校长。
description.en: Hwang Jang-yop served as the president of Kim Il-sung University.

description.zh-cn: 1972年修订的《朝鲜民主主义人民共和国宪法》首次将主体思想规定为国家的官方指导思想。
description.en: The revised 1972 Constitution of the DPRK first established the Juche Idea as the official guiding ideology of the state.

description.zh-cn: 东欧共产主义政权的垮台使朝鲜领导层产生危机感，从而进一步强化了主体思想作为维护其社会主义制度的思想武器。
description.en: The collapse of communist regimes in Eastern Europe created a sense of crisis among the North Korean leadership, leading to the further strengthening of the Juche Idea as an ideological weapon to safeguard its socialist system.

description.zh-cn: 曾经在韩国传播主体思想的金永焕后来转变为该思想的批评者，认为其只是斯大林主义和民族主义的混合物，被用于政治统治。
description.en: Kim Young-hwan, who once disseminated the Juche Idea in South Korea, later became a critic, arguing it was merely a mixture of Stalinism and nationalism used for political domination.

description.zh-cn: 文本提及金日成与东德领导人昂纳克私交甚密。
description.en: The text mentions that Kim Il-sung had a close personal relationship with East German leader Erich Honecker.

description.zh-cn: 文本提及金日成与罗马尼亚领导人齐奥塞斯库私交甚密。
description.en: The text mentions that Kim Il-sung had a close personal relationship with Romanian leader Nicolae Ceaușescu.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜官方将千里马运动视为第一次运用主体思想的实践。
description.en: North Korean officials regard the Chollima Movement as the first practical application of the Juche Idea.

description.zh-cn: 苏联于1990年9月30日与韩国建立外交关系。
description.en: The Soviet Union established diplomatic relations with South Korea on September 30, 1990.

description.zh-cn: “九二共识”这一政治术语源于1992年海协会与海基会在香港的会谈，尽管当时并未形成名为“九二共识”的正式文件，但会谈及其后的函电往来构成了其历史基础。
description.en: The political term '1992 Consensus' originates from the 1992 talks in Hong Kong between ARATS and SEF. Although no formal document named '1992 Consensus' was produced at the time, the talks and subsequent correspondence form its historical basis.

description.zh-cn: 时任陆委会主委的苏起为重新包装“一个中国，各自表述”的概念，于2000年4月28日首次提出“九二共识”这一名词。
description.en: On April 28, 2000, Su Chi, then Chairman of the Mainland Affairs Council, first proposed the term '1992 Consensus' to repackage the concept of 'One China, respective interpretations'.

description.zh-cn: 中国国民党将“九二共识”列入党纲，并将其作为与中国大陆进行交流与对话的政治基础，其核心诠释为“一个中国，各自表述”。
description.en: The Kuomintang included the '1992 Consensus' in its party platform and uses it as the political foundation for exchanges and dialogue with mainland China, with its core interpretation being 'One China, respective interpretations'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国方面始终反对“一个中国，各自表述”的说法，认为其不符合“一个中国原则”，并强调“九二共识”中只有“一中”没有“各表”。
description.en: The People's Republic of China has consistently opposed the 'One China, respective interpretations' formulation, believing it does not conform to the 'One-China Principle' and emphasizing that the '1992 Consensus' only contains 'One China' without 'respective interpretations'.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国方面将“九二共识”定义为双方均坚持“一个中国原则”并共同谋求国家统一，以此作为两岸对话协商的政治基础。
description.en: The People's Republic of China defines the '1992 Consensus' as both sides adhering to the 'One-China Principle' and jointly seeking national unification, using this as the political foundation for cross-strait dialogue and negotiation.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉提出的“两国论”被中华人民共和国方面视为对“一个中国”原则的破坏，导致两岸交流管道中断，破坏了当时基于“九二谅解”的互动基础。
description.en: The 'Two-states theory' proposed by Lee Teng-hui was viewed by the PRC as a violation of the 'One-China Principle', leading to the suspension of cross-strait communication channels and undermining the basis for interaction that existed under the '1992 Understanding'.

description.zh-cn: 李登辉在卸任中华民国总统后，多次公开否认存在“九二共识”。
description.en: After leaving office as President of the Republic of China, Lee Teng-hui publicly denied the existence of the '1992 Consensus' on multiple occasions.

description.zh-cn: 蔡英文于2011年提出“台湾共识”，意图以此取代“九二共识”作为两岸谈判的基础。
description.en: In 2011, Tsai Ing-wen proposed the 'Taiwan Consensus' with the intention of replacing the '1992 Consensus' as the basis for cross-strait negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 在此次访问中，国民党主席连战与中共中央总书记胡锦涛达成推动“九二共识”的承诺，此后“九二共识”首次出现在中华人民共和国的官方文件中。
description.en: During this visit, KMT Chairman Lien Chan and CCP General Secretary Hu Jintao reached a commitment to promote the '1992 Consensus', after which the term appeared in official PRC documents for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 此次马英九与习近平的会面是在“九二共识”的政治基础上进行的，双方在会面中再次肯定了“九二共识”作为两岸共同政治基础的地位。
description.en: The meeting between Ma Ying-jeou and Xi Jinping was conducted on the political foundation of the '1992 Consensus', and both sides reaffirmed its status as a common political basis for cross-strait relations during the meeting.

description.zh-cn: 习近平在《告台湾同胞书》发表40周年纪念会上，将“九二共识”的内涵明确为“海峡两岸同属一个中国，共同努力谋求国家统一”，并阐述了“一国两制”的台湾方案。
description.en: At the 40th anniversary of the 'Message to Compatriots in Taiwan', Xi Jinping defined the substance of the '1992 Consensus' as 'both sides of the Taiwan Strait belong to one China and jointly work to seek national unification', and elaborated on the 'one country, two systems' proposal for Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，宁夏回族自治区工商业联合会的上级机构是中华全国工商业联合会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior organization of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Federation of Industry and Commerce is the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，宁夏回族自治区工商业联合会的中共上级机构是中国共产党宁夏回族自治区委员会。
description.en: According to the infobox, the superior CCP organization of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Federation of Industry and Commerce is the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Regional Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区工商业联合会被定义为一种人民团体。
description.en: The Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Federation of Industry and Commerce is defined as a type of people's organization.

description.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区工商业联合会被定义为一种商会组织。
description.en: The Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Federation of Industry and Commerce is defined as a type of chamber of commerce organization.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省监察委员会与中国共产党江苏省纪律检查委员会合署办公。
description.en: The Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission works jointly with the Jiangsu Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省监察委员会是中华人民共和国国家监察委员会的业务下级单位。
description.en: The Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission is operationally subordinate to the National Supervisory Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省监察委员会是江苏省人民代表大会的组织下级单位。
description.en: The Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission is organizationally subordinate to the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省监察委员会是江苏省人民代表大会常务委员会的组织下级单位。
description.en: The Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission is organizationally subordinate to the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 江苏省监察委员会是中国共产党中央纪律检查委员会的中共下级单位。
description.en: The Jiangsu Provincial Supervisory Commission is subordinate to the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection within the Communist Party of China's hierarchy.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲出生于江西省南昌市。
description.en: Xu Dazhe was born in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲于1978年入学哈尔滨工业大学机械系机械制造专业，先后完成本科和硕士研究生学习。
description.en: Xu Dazhe enrolled in the Mechanical Manufacturing program of the Department of Mechanics at Harbin Institute of Technology in 1978, completing both his undergraduate and master's studies there.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲于1982年1月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Xu Dazhe joined the Communist Party of China in January 1982.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲自1984年研究生毕业后在此工作，历任设计员、组长、副所长等职，最终升任院长、党委副书记。
description.en: After graduating in 1984, Xu Dazhe worked here, holding positions such as designer, team leader, and deputy director, eventually rising to become President and Deputy Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲曾先后担任中国航天科技集团公司副总经理、党组成员（2001-2007）和董事长、党组书记（2013）。
description.en: Xu Dazhe served successively as Deputy General Manager and Party Leadership Group Member (2001-2007) and Chairman and Party Leadership Group Secretary (2013) of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲于2007年至2013年担任中国航天科工集团公司总经理、党组书记。
description.en: Xu Dazhe served as General Manager and Party Secretary of China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation from 2007 to 2013.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲参与了神舟系列飞船十次飞天的工作。
description.en: Xu Dazhe participated in the work of ten missions of the Shenzhou program.

description.zh-cn: 在神舟五号飞船发射时，许达哲亲任首次载人飞行试验大队的大队长。
description.en: During the launch of the Shenzhou 5 spacecraft, Xu Dazhe personally served as the commander of the first manned flight test team.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲是中国共产党第十七届中纪委委员。
description.en: Xu Dazhe was a member of the 17th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲在中共十八大上当选为第十八届中央委员。
description.en: Xu Dazhe was elected as a member of the 18th Central Committee at the 18th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲是第十九届中央委员。
description.en: Xu Dazhe was a member of the 19th Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲先后接替马兴瑞担任中国航天科技集团公司董事长和工业和信息化部副部长等职务。
description.en: Xu Dazhe successively succeeded Ma Xingrui as Chairman of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation and as Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, among other roles.

position.en: Secretary of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee

description.zh-cn: 作为地方党委负责人，许达哲向中共中央总书记习近平负责。
description.en: As the head of a provincial party committee, Xu Dazhe was subordinate to CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping.

description.zh-cn: 毛伟明接替许达哲担任湖南省人民政府省长。
description.en: Mao Weiming succeeded Xu Dazhe as Governor of the Hunan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 习近平委托许达哲专程看望袁隆平的家属，转达悼念和问候。
description.en: Xi Jinping entrusted Xu Dazhe to make a special trip to visit Yuan Longping's family to convey condolences and greetings.

description.zh-cn: 湖南省人大常委会决定罢免许达哲的第十四届全国人民代表大会代表职务。
description.en: The Standing Committee of the Hunan Provincial People's Congress decided to recall Xu Dazhe from his post as a delegate to the 14th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 许达哲卸任工信部副部长等职务后，由唐登杰等人接任。
description.en: After Xu Dazhe left his posts including Vice Minister of MIIT, Tang Dengjie and others took over.

description.zh-cn: 雷凡培接替许达哲担任中国航天科技集团公司董事长。
description.en: Lei Fanpei succeeded Xu Dazhe as Chairman of China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 高红卫接替许达哲担任中国航天科工集团公司总经理。
description.en: Gao Hongwei succeeded Xu Dazhe as General Manager of China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国政府在1992年着手设计、1993年准备并颁布、1994年实施了分税制改革。
description.en: The Government of the People's Republic of China began designing the tax-sharing system reform in 1992, prepared and promulgated it in 1993, and implemented it in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 分税制改革标志着中国的财政体制由计划经济向市场经济的改革迈出了实质性的一步。
description.en: The tax-sharing system reform marked a substantial step in the reform of China's fiscal system from a planned economy to a market economy.

description.zh-cn: 分税制改革标志着中国的财政体制由计划经济向市场经济的改革迈出了实质性的一步，从而削弱了计划经济体制。
description.en: The tax-sharing system reform marked a substantial step in the reform of China's fiscal system from a planned economy to a market economy, thereby weakening the planned economy system.

description.zh-cn: 分税制改革被认为是催生了严重的土地财政的关键因素，因为它加重了地方政府的财政负担，迫使它们寻求预算外收入。
description.en: The tax-sharing system reform is considered a key factor that gave rise to severe land finance, as it increased the financial burden on local governments, forcing them to seek extra-budgetary revenue.

description.zh-cn: 分税制改革带来的财政收入高速增长，为1998年起严禁军队、武警、政法机构和党政机关经商奠定了物质基础。
description.en: The rapid growth in fiscal revenue brought about by the tax-sharing system reform laid the material foundation for the prohibition of business activities by the military, armed police, judicial and law enforcement agencies, and party-state organs starting in 1998.

description.zh-cn: 分税制改革将大量事权下放给地方，但财权上收中央，加重了地方政府的财政负担，影响了其有效运转。
description.en: The tax-sharing system reform delegated a large number of administrative responsibilities to local governments while centralizing fiscal power, which increased the financial burden on local governments and affected their effective operation.

description.zh-cn: 分税制改革使中央财政收入快速增长，中央财政贫弱的局面得到改观，增强了中央的宏观调控能力。
description.en: The tax-sharing system reform led to rapid growth in central government revenue, improved the weak financial situation of the central government, and enhanced its macroeconomic control capabilities.

description.zh-cn: 1998年住房市场化改革后，土地财政与高房价的联系变得更为紧密，地方政府更加依赖土地出让收入。
description.en: After the 1998 housing market reform, the link between land finance and high housing prices became closer, and local governments became more reliant on revenue from land sales.

description.zh-cn: 吴敬琏认为分税制改革中，中央政府只分财权不分事权，把财政分权的方法变成了财政集权的手段，对此持批评态度。
description.en: Wu Jinglian believes that in the tax-sharing system reform, the central government only divided fiscal power without dividing administrative responsibilities, turning a method of fiscal decentralization into a means of fiscal centralization, and he is critical of this.

description.zh-cn: 楼继伟在2016年全国两会期间以财政部部长身份表示要研究中央和地方事权和支出责任的改革。
description.en: During the 2016 National People's Congress and Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Lou Jiwei, in his capacity as Minister of Finance, stated the need to study the reform of powers and expenditure responsibilities between the central and local governments.

description.zh-cn: 留里克建立了留里克王朝。
description.en: Rurik founded the Rurik dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 留里克占据诺夫哥罗德后建立了罗斯汗国。
description.en: Rurik founded the Rus' Khaganate after taking control of Novgorod.

description.zh-cn: 奥列格在留里克于879年去世后接替其王公之位。
description.en: Oleg succeeded Rurik as prince after Rurik's death in 879.

description.zh-cn: 奥列格于882年迁都基辅，正式建立了基辅罗斯公国。
description.en: Oleg moved the capital to Kyiv in 882, formally establishing the principality of Kievan Rus'.

description.zh-cn: 拔都领导了蒙古帝国对基辅罗斯的征服。
description.en: Batu Khan led the Mongol Empire's invasion of Kievan Rus'.

description.zh-cn: 蒙古帝国发动了对基辅罗斯的征服战争。
description.en: The Mongol Empire launched the invasion of Kievan Rus'.

description.zh-cn: 弗拉基米尔大帝开启了罗斯的基督教化进程，将东正教定为国教。
description.en: Vladimir the Great initiated the Christianization of Rus', establishing Orthodox Christianity as the state religion.

description.zh-cn: 智者雅罗斯拉夫在位时创立了东斯拉夫法典（罗斯法典）。
description.en: Yaroslav the Wise established the East Slavic law code (Russkaya Pravda) during his reign.

description.zh-cn: 雅罗斯拉夫是弗拉基米尔一世的儿子。
description.en: Yaroslav was the son of Vladimir I.

description.zh-cn: 在迦勒迦河之战中，罗斯诸公与钦察人的联军被蒙古军队彻底击败。
description.en: At the Battle of the Kalka River, the allied forces of Rus' principalities and the Cumans were decisively defeated by the Mongol army.

description.zh-cn: 速不台是成吉思汗手下的大将。
description.en: Subutai was a general under Genghis Khan.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯灭亡后，雅罗斯拉夫二世被拔都控制为傀儡统治者。
description.en: After the fall of Kievan Rus', Yaroslav II was controlled by Batu Khan as a puppet ruler.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大·涅夫斯基在涅瓦河之战中击败了瑞典军队。
description.en: Alexander Nevsky defeated the Swedish army at the Battle of the Neva.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大·涅夫斯基在楚德湖战役中大败条顿骑士团。
description.en: Alexander Nevsky decisively defeated the Teutonic Knights at the Battle on the Ice.

description.zh-cn: 亚历山大·涅夫斯基是诺夫哥罗德的大公，并率领其军队作战。
description.en: Alexander Nevsky was the Grand Prince of Novgorod and led its armies.

description.zh-cn: 波兰的波列斯瓦夫大帝曾入侵基辅罗斯。
description.en: Bolesław I the Brave of Poland invaded Kievan Rus'.

description.zh-cn: 斯维亚托波尔克一世是波列斯瓦夫大帝的女婿。
description.en: Sviatopolk I was the son-in-law of Bolesław I the Brave.

description.zh-cn: 智者雅罗斯拉夫联合神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利二世东西夹击波兰。
description.en: Yaroslav the Wise allied with Holy Roman Emperor Henry II for a pincer attack on Poland.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯是现代乌克兰国家的前身。
description.en: Kievan Rus' is a predecessor to the modern state of Ukraine.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯是现代俄罗斯国家的前身。
description.en: Kievan Rus' is a predecessor to the modern state of Russia.

description.zh-cn: 基辅罗斯是现代白俄罗斯国家的前身。
description.en: Kievan Rus' is a predecessor to the modern state of Belarus.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美于1898年6月14日生于山东莒县北杏村。
description.en: Wang Jinmei was born in Beixing Village, Ju County, Shandong on June 14, 1898.

description.zh-cn: 1918年夏，王尽美考入济南山东省立第一师范学校预科班。
description.en: In the summer of 1918, Wang Jinmei was admitted to the preparatory class of Shandong Provincial No. 1 Normal School in Jinan.

description.zh-cn: 1920年3月，王尽美成为北京大学马克思学说研究会的外埠会员。
description.en: In March 1920, Wang Jinmei became a non-local member of the Peking University Marxist Theory Research Society.

description.zh-cn: 1921年春，王尽美与邓恩铭发起创建济南共产主义小组。
description.en: In the spring of 1921, Wang Jinmei and Deng Enming initiated the creation of the Jinan Communist Group.

description.zh-cn: 1921年春，邓恩铭与王尽美发起创建济南共产主义小组。
description.en: In the spring of 1921, Deng Enming and Wang Jinmei initiated the creation of the Jinan Communist Group.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美作为创始人之一，出席了1921年7月的中国共产党第一次全国代表大会。
description.en: As one of the founders, Wang Jinmei attended the First National Congress of the Communist Party of China in July 1921.

description.zh-cn: 中共一大后，王尽美任中国劳动组合书记部山东分部主任。
description.en: After the First National Congress of the CCP, Wang Jinmei served as the Director of the Shandong Branch of the China Labour Union Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 1922年1月，王尽美在莫斯科参加远东各国共产党和民族革命团体第一次代表大会期间，受到列宁的接见。
description.en: In January 1922, during his attendance at the First Congress of the Toilers of the Far East in Moscow, Wang Jinmei was received by Lenin.

description.zh-cn: 中共二大后，王尽美与邓中夏一起负责中国劳动组合书记部的领导工作。
description.en: After the Second National Congress of the CCP, Wang Jinmei and Deng Zhongxia were jointly responsible for the leadership of the China Labour Union Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 1923年10月，王尽美以个人身份加入中国国民党。
description.en: In October 1923, Wang Jinmei joined the Kuomintang in his individual capacity.

description.zh-cn: 1924年11月，王尽美任中共山东地方执行委员会书记。
description.en: In November 1924, Wang Jinmei served as the secretary of the CCP Shandong Local Executive Committee.

description.zh-cn: 孙中山约见王尽美后，以个人名义委派他为国民会议宣传员特派员。
description.en: After meeting with Wang Jinmei, Sun Yat-sen personally appointed him as a special commissioner for promoting the National Assembly.

description.zh-cn: 王尽美因肺结核病情恶化，于1925年8月19日在青岛病逝。
description.en: Due to the worsening of his tuberculosis, Wang Jinmei passed away in Qingdao on August 19, 1925.

description.zh-cn: 王乃征是王尽美的长子。
description.en: Wang Naizheng is the eldest son of Wang Jinmei.

description.zh-cn: 王乃恩是王尽美的次子。
description.en: Wang Nai'en is the second son of Wang Jinmei.

description.zh-cn: 王乃征和王乃恩是兄弟关系。
description.en: Wang Naizheng and Wang Nai'en are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 1938年初，董昆一和赵志刚介绍王乃征加入中国共产党。
description.en: In early 1938, Dong Kunyi and Zhao Zhigang introduced Wang Naizheng to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1938年初，赵志刚和董昆一介绍王乃征加入中国共产党。
description.en: In early 1938, Zhao Zhigang and Dong Kunyi introduced Wang Naizheng to join the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 王乃征曾任吉林省军区副司令员。
description.en: Wang Naizheng served as the deputy commander of the Jilin Provincial Military District.

description.zh-cn: 王军是王乃征的儿子。
description.en: Wang Jun is the son of Wang Naizheng.

description.zh-cn: 王毅是王乃征的儿子。
description.en: Wang Yi is the son of Wang Naizheng.

description.zh-cn: 王枫是王乃征的女儿。
description.en: Wang Feng is the daughter of Wang Naizheng.

description.zh-cn: 王军和王毅是兄弟关系。
description.en: Wang Jun and Wang Yi are brothers.

description.zh-cn: 王军和王枫是兄妹关系。
description.en: Wang Jun and Wang Feng are siblings.

description.zh-cn: 王毅和王枫是兄妹关系。
description.en: Wang Yi and Wang Feng are siblings.

description.zh-cn: 王建华是王乃恩的子女。
description.en: Wang Jianhua is the child of Wang Nai'en.

description.zh-cn: 王爱华是王乃恩的女儿。
description.en: Wang Aihua is the daughter of Wang Nai'en.

description.zh-cn: 王建华和王爱华是兄弟姐妹关系。
description.en: Wang Jianhua and Wang Aihua are siblings.

description.zh-cn: 慕绥新于1943年10月出生于陕西省绥德县。
description.en: Mu Suixin was born in Suide County, Shaanxi Province in October 1943.

degree.zh-cn: 电子工程系电机制造专业
degree.en: Motor Manufacturing, Department of Electrical Engineering

description.zh-cn: 慕绥新于1970年毕业于清华大学电子工程系电机制造专业。
description.en: Mu Suixin graduated from Tsinghua University in 1970, majoring in Motor Manufacturing in the Department of Electrical Engineering.

description.zh-cn: 慕绥新于1978年加入中国共产党，后因贪腐问题被开除党籍。
description.en: Mu Suixin joined the Communist Party of China in 1978 and was later expelled due to corruption issues.

description.zh-cn: 自1988年起在辽宁省人民政府任职，历任省体改委副主任、劳动局副局长、劳动局局长、建设厅厅长、省长助理，并于1996年升任副省长。
description.en: Starting in 1988, he held various positions in the Liaoning Provincial People's Government, including Deputy Director of the Provincial Commission for Restructuring the Economic System, Deputy Director and Director of the Labor Bureau, Director of the Construction Department, and Assistant to the Governor, before being promoted to Vice Governor in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 慕绥新于1997年2月至2000年12月担任沈阳市市长。
description.en: Mu Suixin served as Mayor of Shenyang from February 1997 to December 2000.

description.zh-cn: 于2001年10月10日一审以受贿罪和巨额财产来源不明罪判处慕绥新死刑，缓期二年执行。
description.en: On October 10, 2001, the court sentenced Mu Suixin to death with a two-year reprieve in the first instance for the crimes of bribery and holding a huge amount of property with unidentified sources.

description.zh-cn: 李琦是慕绥新长女慕洋的公公。
description.en: Li Qi is the father-in-law of Mu Suixin's eldest daughter, Mu Yang.

description.zh-cn: 2002年9月25日，公安部在浙江省金华市将因转移赃款被通缉的李琦抓获。
description.en: On September 25, 2002, the Ministry of Public Security captured Li Qi, who was wanted for transferring illicit funds, in Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 1997年2月，慕绥新接替张荣茂担任沈阳市市长。
description.en: In February 1997, Mu Suixin succeeded Zhang Rongmao as Mayor of Shenyang.

description.zh-cn: 2000年12月，陈政高接替慕绥新担任沈阳市市长。
description.en: In December 2000, Chen Zhenggao succeeded Mu Suixin as Mayor of Shenyang.

description.zh-cn: 1944年，圣芭芭拉州立学院加入加州大学系统，成为其第三个成员。
description.en: In 1944, Santa Barbara State College joined the University of California system, becoming its third member.

description.zh-cn: 1995年，加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校被美国大学协会认可。
description.en: In 1995, UC Santa Barbara was admitted to the Association of American Universities.

description.zh-cn: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校被认为是公立常春藤之一。
description.en: UC Santa Barbara is considered one of the Public Ivies.

description.zh-cn: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校是环太平洋大学联盟的成员。
description.en: UC Santa Barbara is a member of the Association of Pacific Rim Universities.

description.zh-cn: 文理学院是加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的五个学院之一。
description.en: The College of Letters and Science is one of the five colleges at UC Santa Barbara.

description.zh-cn: 樊畿退休前长期在此执教。
description.en: Ky Fan taught here for a long time before his retirement.

description.zh-cn: 曾就读于该校。
description.en: Formerly studied at the university.

description.zh-cn: 金正男是金正日的长子。
description.en: Kim Jong-nam is the eldest son of Kim Jong-il.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1966年与第一任妻子洪一天结婚，1970年离异。
description.en: Kim Jong-il married his first wife, Hong Il-chon, in 1966 and they divorced in 1970.

description.zh-cn: 自1968年起，金正日与被视为其第二任妻子的成蕙琳同居，直至其2002年逝世。她是金正男的母亲。
description.en: Starting in 1968, Kim Jong-il cohabited with Song Hye-rim, considered his second wife, until her death in 2002. She was the mother of Kim Jong-nam.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1974年与金英淑结婚。
description.en: Kim Jong-il married Kim Young-sook in 1974.

description.zh-cn: 金正日在高容姬去世后，与金玉结婚。
description.en: After the death of Ko Yong-hui, Kim Jong-il married Kim Ok.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于1960年至1964年在金日成综合大学经济系政治经济学专业学习。
description.en: From 1960 to 1964, Kim Jong-il studied Political Economy in the Department of Economics at Kim Il-sung University.

description.zh-cn: 金正日自1991年起担任朝鲜人民军最高司令官，直至逝世。
description.en: Kim Jong-il served as the Supreme Commander of the Korean People's Army from 1991 until his death.

description.zh-cn: 2000年朝韩首脑会晤是金正日作为朝鲜最高领导人与韩国总统的首次会晤，缓和了南北关系。
description.en: The 2000 inter-Korean summit was the first meeting between Kim Jong-il as the supreme leader of North Korea and a South Korean president, easing inter-Korean relations.

description.zh-cn: 金正日与小泉纯一郎共同签署了《日朝平壤宣言》。
description.en: Kim Jong-il, along with Junichiro Koizumi, signed the Japan-North Korea Pyongyang Declaration.

description.zh-cn: 根据脱北者说法，金正日策划或指挥了朝鲜绑架日本人事件。他本人也在2002年向日本首相小泉纯一郎承认并道歉。
description.en: According to defectors, Kim Jong-il planned or directed the North Korean abductions of Japanese citizens. He himself admitted to and apologized for it to Japanese Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi in 2002.

description.zh-cn: 根据脱北者说法，金正日授意绑架了韩国女演员崔银姬。
description.en: According to defectors, Kim Jong-il ordered the kidnapping of South Korean actress Choi Eun-hee.

description.zh-cn: 金正日于2011年12月17日去世。
description.en: Kim Jong-il died on December 17, 2011.

description.zh-cn: 金正日去世后，其子金正恩接替他成为朝鲜最高领导人。
description.en: After Kim Jong-il's death, his son Kim Jong-un succeeded him as the supreme leader of North Korea.

description.zh-cn: 长子金正男因2001年持假护照试图进入日本而失宠，丧失了继承朝鲜最高领袖的可能性，并长期流亡海外。
description.en: His eldest son, Kim Jong-nam, fell out of favor after attempting to enter Japan on a fake passport in 2001, lost the possibility of succeeding as the supreme leader of North Korea, and lived in exile for many years.

description.zh-cn: 李强出生于浙江省温州专区瑞安县。
description.en: Li Qiang was born in Ruian County, Wenzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang Province.

description.zh-cn: 李强在浙江农业大学宁波分校（现浙江万里学院）农业机械系农业机械化专业学习。
description.en: Li Qiang studied Agricultural Mechanization in the Department of Agricultural Machinery at Zhejiang Agricultural University, Ningbo Branch (now Zhejiang Wanli University).

description.zh-cn: 李强于2001至2002年在中共中央党校一年制中青年干部培训班学习，并于2001至2004年在中共中央党校在职研究生班世界经济专业学习。
description.en: Li Qiang studied at the one-year training program for young and middle-aged cadres at the Central Party School from 2001 to 2002, and also studied World Economy in the in-service postgraduate program at the Central Party School from 2001 to 2004.

degree.zh-cn: 高级管理人员工商管理硕士

description.zh-cn: 李强在香港理工大学管理学院工商管理专业学习并获得高级管理人员工商管理硕士学位。
description.en: Li Qiang studied Business Administration at the Faculty of Business of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and obtained an Executive Master of Business Administration degree.

description.zh-cn: 李强于1983年4月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Li Qiang joined the Communist Party of China in April 1983.

position.en: Secretary-General of the Provincial Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 李强担任中共浙江省委秘书长期间，直接辅佐时任省委书记习近平，被外界视为习近平“之江新军”的主要人物。
description.en: While serving as the Secretary-General of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, Li Qiang directly assisted the then-Provincial Party Secretary Xi Jinping, and is considered a key figure in Xi Jinping's 'Zhi Jiang New Army'.

position.en: Secretary-General of the Provincial Party Committee

description.zh-cn: 李强在习近平调离浙江后，继续担任省委秘书长，辅佐新任省委书记赵洪祝。
description.en: After Xi Jinping was transferred from Zhejiang, Li Qiang continued to serve as the Secretary-General of the Provincial Party Committee, assisting the new Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Hongzhu.

description.zh-cn: 李强担任浙江省省长期间，夏宝龙为省委书记。
description.en: While Li Qiang was the Governor of Zhejiang Province, Xia Baolong served as the Provincial Party Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 担任浙江省长期间，李强主导创立了浙江政务服务网，成为全国“互联网+政务服务”的样本。
description.en: During his tenure as Governor of Zhejiang, Li Qiang led the creation of the Zhejiang Government Service Network, which became a national model for 'Internet + Government Services'.

description.zh-cn: 在浙江政务服务网的基础上形成了浙江“最多跑一次”改革。
description.en: The 'Run at Most Once' reform in Zhejiang was formed on the basis of the Zhejiang Government Service Network.

description.zh-cn: 在2018年上海第一届中国国际进口博览会上，习近平表态支持长江三角洲区域一体化发展上升为国家战略。
description.en: At the first China International Import Expo in Shanghai in 2018, Xi Jinping expressed support for elevating the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta to a national strategy.

description.zh-cn: 在担任上海市委书记期间，李强推动了长三角区域一体化发展。
description.en: During his tenure as Party Secretary of Shanghai, Li Qiang promoted the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta region.

description.zh-cn: 担任上海市委书记期间，李强为特斯拉公司扫清道路，使其能够在2019年迅速启动上海超级工厂的建设。
description.en: During his tenure as Party Secretary of Shanghai, Li Qiang cleared the way for Tesla, Inc., enabling the company to quickly start the construction of its Shanghai Gigafactory in 2019.

description.zh-cn: 李强因在2022年上海新冠疫情封城期间出现的物资供应匮乏等各种乱象而遭到市民批评，其声誉受到负面影响。
description.en: Li Qiang was criticized by citizens for various chaotic situations, such as scarce material supplies, during the Shanghai COVID-19 lockdown in 2022, which negatively affected his reputation.

description.zh-cn: 据报道，2022年上海执行的严格封城措施是代表中共中央进驻上海的国务院副总理孙春兰的意见，她推动了更严格的封控。
description.en: It was reported that the strict lockdown measures implemented in Shanghai in 2022 were the opinion of Vice Premier Sun Chunlan, who, representing the CPC Central Committee in Shanghai, pushed for stricter controls.

description.zh-cn: 在升任中共中央政治局常委后，李强顶住压力，推动比预期更早地启动重新开放计划，并最终在2022年底事实上结束了清零政策。
description.en: After his promotion to the Politburo Standing Committee, Li Qiang resisted pressure and pushed for an earlier-than-expected reopening plan, effectively ending the zero-COVID policy by the end of 2022.

description.zh-cn: 时任中央应对疫情工作领导小组组长的李克强与李强共同决定比预期更早地启动重新开放计划，以应对疫情和经济困境。
description.en: As the then-head of the central leading group for COVID-19 response, Li Keqiang, along with Li Qiang, decided to launch the reopening plan earlier than expected to address the pandemic and economic difficulties.

description.zh-cn: 在李强等领导人推动下，中国政府发布了防疫“新十条”，正式结束了动态清零政策。
description.en: Under the promotion of leaders including Li Qiang, the Chinese government released the 'New Ten Measures' for epidemic prevention, officially ending the dynamic zero-COVID policy.

description.zh-cn: 李强接替韩正出任中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Li Qiang succeeded Han Zheng as the Party Secretary of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 陈吉宁接替李强出任中共上海市委书记。
description.en: Chen Jining succeeded Li Qiang as the Party Secretary of Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 李强接替罗志军出任中共江苏省委书记。
description.en: Li Qiang succeeded Luo Zhijun as the Party Secretary of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 娄勤俭接替李强出任中共江苏省委书记。
description.en: Lou Qinjian succeeded Li Qiang as the Party Secretary of Jiangsu.

description.zh-cn: 越南共产党是越南社会主义共和国的唯一执政党。
description.en: The Communist Party of Vietnam is the sole ruling party of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

position.en: General Secretary of the CPV Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 苏林担任越南共产党中央委员会总书记。
description.en: Tô Lâm serves as the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

position.en: Secretary of the Central Military Commission

description.zh-cn: 苏林兼任越南共产党中央军事委员会书记。
description.en: Tô Lâm concurrently serves as the Secretary of the Central Military Commission of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 梁强担任越南社会主义共和国主席。
description.en: Lương Cường serves as the President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 范明正担任越南政府总理。
description.en: Phạm Minh Chính serves as the Prime Minister of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 陈青敏担任越南国会主席。
description.en: Trần Thanh Mẫn serves as the Chairman of the National Assembly of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 陈锦秀担任越共中央书记处常务书记。
description.en: Trần Cẩm Tú serves as the Standing Member of the Secretariat of the Communist Party of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 1954年日内瓦会议规定以北纬17度线划分南北，北方成立越南民主共和国（北越）。
description.en: The 1954 Geneva Conference stipulated the division of Vietnam along the 17th parallel north, leading to the formation of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam).

description.zh-cn: 1954年日内瓦会议规定以北纬17度线划分南北，为南方越南共和国的成立创造了条件。
description.en: The 1954 Geneva Conference stipulated the division of Vietnam along the 17th parallel north, creating the conditions for the establishment of the Republic of Vietnam in the south.

description.zh-cn: 1950年1月，中华人民共和国成为第一个承认越南民主共和国并与之建交的国家。
description.en: In January 1950, the People's Republic of China became the first country to recognize and establish diplomatic relations with the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.

description.zh-cn: 越南于1977年9月20日加入联合国。
description.en: Vietnam joined the United Nations on September 20, 1977.

description.zh-cn: 越南于1995年加入东南亚国家联盟。
description.en: Vietnam joined the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 越南于2007年正式加入世界贸易组织。
description.en: Vietnam officially joined the World Trade Organization in 2007.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框及正文，中央军委国防动员部办公厅是中央军事委员会国防动员部的下属机构。
description.en: According to the infobox and main text, the General Office of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission is a subordinate body of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，于2016年1月组建了中央军委国防动员部。
description.en: The National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission was established in January 2016 as part of the deepening national defense and military reform.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委国防动员部组建后，新设了中央军委国防动员部办公厅。
description.en: After the establishment of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission, the General Office of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission was newly established.

description.zh-cn: 曲松于2016年出任中央军委国防动员部办公厅第一任主任，于同年9月卸任。
description.en: Qu Song became the first Director of the General Office of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission in 2016 and left the post in September of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 周河自2017年起担任中央军委国防动员部办公厅主任。
description.en: Zhou He has served as the Director of the General Office of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission since 2017.

description.zh-cn: 宋海巍于2016年至2017年4月期间担任中央军委国防动员部办公厅副主任。
description.en: Song Haiwei served as the Deputy Director of the General Office of the National Defence Mobilization Department of the Central Military Commission from 2016 to April 2017.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委人民武装委员会的日常工作由中国人民解放军总参谋部动员部承办。
description.en: The daily affairs of the People's Armed Forces Committee of the Central Military Commission were handled by the Mobilization Department of the General Staff Department of the People's Liberation Army.

description.zh-cn: 谢觉哉担任中央人民政府内务部部长。
description.en: Xie Juezai served as the Minister of Internal Affairs of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 谢觉哉担任中华人民共和国内务部部长。
description.en: Xie Juezai served as the Minister of Internal Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 钱瑛担任中华人民共和国内务部部长。
description.en: Qian Ying served as the Minister of Internal Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 曾山担任中华人民共和国内务部部长。
description.en: Zeng Shan served as the Minister of Internal Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国内务部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Internal Affairs of the People's Republic of China was a constituent department of the State Council of the PRC.

description.zh-cn: 1954年9月第一届全国人民代表大会召开后，原中央人民政府内务部改组为中华人民共和国内务部。
description.en: After the first National People's Congress was held in September 1954, the former Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Central People's Government was reorganized into the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命的背景下，中共中央于1968年12月批准撤销内务部，该部最终于1970年6月被正式撤销。
description.en: In the context of the Cultural Revolution, the CPC Central Committee approved the abolition of the Ministry of Internal Affairs in December 1968, and the ministry was formally abolished in June 1970.

description.zh-cn: 内务部被撤销后，其部分职能由1978年新成立的民政部承接。
description.en: After the Ministry of Internal Affairs was abolished, some of its functions were taken over by the newly established Ministry of Civil Affairs in 1978.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，内务部的户政工作划归中华人民共和国公安部管理。内务部撤销后，其行政区划工作于1972年3月也交由公安部负责。
description.en: In 1955, the household registration work of the Ministry of Internal Affairs was transferred to the Ministry of Public Security. After the Ministry of Internal Affairs was abolished, its administrative division work was also transferred to the Ministry of Public Security in March 1972.

description.zh-cn: 1956年5月，原由农业部主管的国内移民工作交由内务部管理。
description.en: In May 1956, the responsibility for domestic migration, previously managed by the Ministry of Agriculture, was transferred to the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 1958年3月24日，内务部主管的国内移民工作划归中华人民共和国农垦部管理。
description.en: On March 24, 1958, the responsibility for domestic migration, managed by the Ministry of Internal Affairs, was transferred to the Ministry of State Farms and Land Reclamation.

description.zh-cn: 1972年3月，原属内务部负责的优抚、救济工作交由财政部负责。
description.en: In March 1972, the work of providing benefits to entitled groups and relief, previously under the Ministry of Internal Affairs, was transferred to the Ministry of Finance.

description.zh-cn: 郑和出生于上海市。
description.en: Zheng He was born in Shanghai.

description.zh-cn: 2019年7月晋升上将军衔。
description.en: Promoted to the rank of general in July 2019.

description.zh-cn: 郑和是中国共产党第十九届中央委员会委员。
description.en: Zheng He was a member of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 郑和毕业于俄罗斯联邦军队综合军事学院战役战术专业，获军事学硕士学位。
description.en: Zheng He graduated from the Combined Arms Academy of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, majoring in operational-tactical studies, and obtained a Master's degree in Military Science.

description.zh-cn: 2008年6月，任陆军第三十一集团军参谋长。
description.en: In June 2008, he was appointed Chief of Staff of the 31st Group Army.

description.zh-cn: 2011年2月，任南京军区副参谋长。
description.en: In February 2011, he was appointed Deputy Chief of Staff of the Nanjing Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 他于2013年2月至2016年担任中国人民解放军总参谋部军训部部长；此后，于2016年2月至2017年1月，任中央军事委员会训练管理部部长。
description.en: From February 2013 to 2016, he served as the Minister of the Military Training Department of the PLA General Staff Department; subsequently, from February 2016 to January 2017, he served as the Minister of the Training and Administration Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2015年7月，任成都军区副司令员。
description.en: In July 2015, he was appointed Deputy Commander of the Chengdu Military Region.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月至2017年6月，任中国人民解放军军事科学院院长。
description.en: From January 2017 to June 2017, he served as the President of the PLA Academy of Military Science.

description.zh-cn: 2013年2月，郑和接替陈照海担任中国人民解放军总参谋部军训部部长。
description.en: In February 2013, Zheng He succeeded Chen Zhaohai as the Minister of the Military Training Department of the PLA General Staff Department.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月，郑和接替蔡英挺升任中国人民解放军军事科学院院长。
description.en: In January 2017, Zheng He succeeded Cai Yingting and was promoted to President of the PLA Academy of Military Science.

description.zh-cn: 2021年8月，郑和接替吴杰明出任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员。
description.en: In August 2021, Zheng He succeeded Wu Jieming as the Political Commissar of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 2024年6月，钟绍军接替郑和出任中国人民解放军国防大学政治委员。
description.en: In June 2024, Zhong Shaojun succeeded Zheng He as the Political Commissar of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 2017年6月，郑和接替张仕波出任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: In June 2017, Zheng He succeeded Zhang Shibo as the President of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 2021年8月，许学强接替郑和出任中国人民解放军国防大学校长。
description.en: In August 2021, Xu Xueqiang succeeded Zheng He as the President of the PLA National Defence University.

description.zh-cn: 2017年6月，杨学军接替郑和出任中国人民解放军军事科学院院长。
description.en: In June 2017, Yang Xuejun succeeded Zheng He as the President of the PLA Academy of Military Science.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月，黎火辉接替郑和出任中央军事委员会训练管理部部长。
description.en: In January 2017, Li Huohui succeeded Zheng He as the Minister of the Training and Administration Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山是拜上帝会的始创人之一，与洪秀全共同创立该组织。
description.en: Feng Yunshan was one of the founders of the God Worshipping Society, co-founding the organization with Hong Xiuquan.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山与洪秀全共同创立太平天国，并制定了其初期的官制、礼制和军制。
description.en: Feng Yunshan co-founded the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom with Hong Xiuquan and established its initial official, ritual, and military systems.

description.zh-cn: 1851年金田起义后，洪秀全封冯云山为南王、前导副军师、后军主将。
description.en: After the Jintian Uprising in 1851, Hong Xiuquan enfeoffed Feng Yunshan as the South King, Vice-General of the Vanguard, and Commander of the Rearguard.

description.zh-cn: 1852年6月，江忠源率领的清军在全州蓑衣渡伏击太平军，其炮火命中冯云山，致其伤重身亡。
description.en: In June 1852, Qing forces led by Jiang Zhongyuan ambushed the Taiping army at Suoyi Ferry in Quanzhou. Their cannon fire struck Feng Yunshan, leading to his death from severe injuries.

description.zh-cn: 有记载称冯云山曾加入由传教士郭士立在香港创立的福汉会。
description.en: It is recorded that Feng Yunshan once joined the Chinese Union, an organization founded by missionary Karl Gützlaff in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 在香港创立了基督教会组织福汉会。
description.en: Founded the Christian organization, the Chinese Union, in Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山在广西传教期间，发展烧炭工杨秀清加入拜上帝会，并提拔他成为核心领导之一。
description.en: During his missionary work in Guangxi, Feng Yunshan recruited charcoal burner Yang Xiuqing into the God Worshipping Society and promoted him to be one of the core leaders.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山在广西传教期间，发展萧朝贵加入拜上帝会，并提拔他成为核心领导之一。
description.en: During his missionary work in Guangxi, Feng Yunshan recruited Xiao Chaogui into the God Worshipping Society and promoted him to be one of the core leaders.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山在广西传教期间，发展矿工秦日纲加入拜上帝会。
description.en: During his missionary work in Guangxi, Feng Yunshan recruited miner Qin Rigang into the God Worshipping Society.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山一手引入并提拔韦昌辉成为太平天国核心领导之一。
description.en: Feng Yunshan single-handedly introduced and promoted Wei Changhui to become one of the core leaders of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山一手引入并提拔石达开成为太平天国核心领导之一。
description.en: Feng Yunshan single-handedly introduced and promoted Shi Dakai to become one of the core leaders of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 冯云山一手引入并提拔胡以晃成为太平天国核心领导之一。
description.en: Feng Yunshan single-handedly introduced and promoted Hu Yihuang to become one of the core leaders of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

description.zh-cn: 《李秀成自述》中提到：“谋立创国者出南王之谋，前做事者皆南王也。”，高度评价了冯云山的贡献。
description.en: In 'Li Xiucheng's Autograph', it is mentioned: 'The strategies for establishing the kingdom came from the South King; all the early work was done by the South King,' highly praising Feng Yunshan's contributions.

description.zh-cn: 林文增担任中国歌剧舞剧院院长、党委副书记。
description.en: Lin Wenzeng served as the President and Deputy Party Secretary of the China National Opera and Dance Drama Theater.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，林文增当选第十一届全国政协委员，代表文化艺术界，分入第二十七组。
description.en: In 2008, Lin Wenzeng was elected as a member of the 11th National Committee of the CPPCC, representing the Culture and Arts sector in Group 27.

description.zh-cn: 林文增是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Lin Wenzeng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 林文增是中国音乐家协会会员。
description.en: Lin Wenzeng is a member of the Chinese Musicians Association.

description.zh-cn: 林文增是上海音乐学院的校友。
description.en: Lin Wenzeng is an alumnus of the Shanghai Conservatory of Music.

description.zh-cn: 林文增是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Lin Wenzeng is a political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 周惠是惠浴宇的弟弟。
description.en: Zhou Hui is the younger brother of Hui Yuyu.

description.zh-cn: 在庐山会议上，因坚持支持彭德怀，周惠被停职批评。
description.en: At the Lushan Conference, Zhou Hui was suspended from his duties and criticized for his steadfast support of Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 在1959年庐山会议上，周惠与时任湖南省委第一书记周小舟一同坚持支持彭德怀。
description.en: At the 1959 Lushan Conference, Zhou Hui, along with then Hunan Provincial Party First Secretary Zhou Xiaozhou, jointly insisted on supporting Peng Dehuai.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东将周惠从“彭黄张周周”反党集团名单中划掉，使其免于被划为反党集团成员。
description.en: Mao Zedong removed Zhou Hui's name from the list of the 'Peng-Huang-Zhang-Zhou-Zhou' anti-Party clique, thus sparing him from being labeled a member of the anti-Party clique.

description.zh-cn: 周惠在担任中共内蒙古自治区党委第一书记期间提出的一些政策，引发了1981年内蒙古学生运动。
description.en: Some policies proposed by Zhou Hui during his tenure as First Secretary of the CPC Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee triggered the 1981 Inner Mongolia student movement.

description.zh-cn: 周惠在内蒙古主政期间提出“外省区人口盲流流入内蒙古不要堵，要妥善安置”的政策，促进了外省人口流入内蒙古。
description.en: During his administration in Inner Mongolia, Zhou Hui proposed the policy that "the blind flow of population from other provinces into Inner Mongolia should not be blocked, but should be properly settled," which promoted the influx of population from other provinces into Inner Mongolia.

description.zh-cn: 周惠在中共湖南省委第一书记（代理）的职务由张平化接任。
description.en: Zhou Hui was succeeded by Zhang Pinghua as the First Secretary (Acting) of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周惠接替尤太忠担任中共内蒙古自治区党委第一书记。
description.en: Zhou Hui succeeded You Taizhong as the First Secretary of the CPC Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee.

description.zh-cn: 周惠在中共内蒙古自治区党委第一书记的职务由张曙光接任。
description.en: Zhou Hui was succeeded by Zhang Shuguang as the First Secretary of the CPC Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee.

description.zh-cn: 1956年毕业于北京钢铁学院（现北京科技大学）采矿系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Mining Engineering at Beijing Institute of Iron and Steel Technology (now University of Science and Technology Beijing) in 1956.

description.zh-cn: 1963年获莫斯科矿业学院技术科学副博士学位。
description.en: Received a Candidate of Technical Sciences degree from the Moscow Mining Institute in 1963.

description.zh-cn: 1994年当选为中国工程院能源与矿业工程学部院士。
description.en: Elected as an academician of the Division of Energy and Mining Engineering of the Chinese Academy of Engineering in 1994.

description.zh-cn: 曾任第二届、第三届、第四届全国科学技术名词审定委员会委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th China National Committee for Terms in Sciences and Technologies.

description.zh-cn: 曾任第八届、第九届全国政协委员。
description.en: Served as a member of the 8th and 9th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.

description.zh-cn: 董卓死后，贾诩向李傕献策“奉国家以正天下”，劝其反攻长安。
description.en: After Dong Zhuo's death, Jia Xu advised Li Jue to 'uphold the state to rectify the world', persuading him to counter-attack Chang'an.

description.zh-cn: 贾诩在李傕军中任职，后李傕请贾诩为宣义将军，辅佐自己。建安二年（197年），贾诩离开李傕。
description.en: Jia Xu served in Li Jue's army, and Li Jue later appointed him as General of Proclaimed Righteousness to assist him. In 197 AD, Jia Xu left Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 与同僚郭汜合作攻进长安，共同把持朝政。
description.en: Collaborated with his colleague Guo Si to attack Chang'an and jointly controlled the imperial court.

description.zh-cn: 在中牟与朱俊交战，并将其击破。
description.en: Fought against and defeated Zhu Jun at Zhongmu.

description.zh-cn: 李傕率军攻打长安时，在新丰击败了前来迎击的徐荣，徐荣战死。
description.en: When Li Jue led his army to attack Chang'an, he defeated the defending general Xu Rong at Xinfeng, leading to Xu Rong's death in battle.

description.zh-cn: 在新丰迎击李傕军时，率部投降。
description.en: While resisting Li Jue's army at Xinfeng, he led his troops to surrender.

description.zh-cn: 派郭汜、樊稠等人与马腾、韩遂的联军在长平观大战，并将其击败。
description.en: Dispatched Guo Si, Fan Chou, and others to fight the allied forces of Ma Teng and Han Sui at Changpingguan, defeating them.

description.zh-cn: 派郭汜、樊稠等人与马腾、韩遂的联军在长平观大战，并将其击败。
description.en: Dispatched Guo Si, Fan Chou, and others to fight the allied forces of Ma Teng and Han Sui at Changpingguan, defeating them.

description.zh-cn: 奉曹操之命，与梁兴、段煨等关中诸将一同讨伐并击败斩杀李傕。
description.en: Under Cao Cao's orders, campaigned against and killed Li Jue along with other Guanzhong generals such as Liang Xing and Duan Wei.

description.zh-cn: 奉曹操之命，与梁兴、张横等关中诸将一同讨伐并击败李傕。后将其全家老少押解许都。
description.en: Under Cao Cao's orders, campaigned against and defeated Li Jue along with other Guanzhong generals such as Liang Xing and Zhang Heng. He later escorted Li Jue's entire family to Xuchang.

description.zh-cn: 胡封是李傕的外甥。
description.en: Hu Feng is Li Jue's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 李傕军吏宋果曾密谋杀害李傕，事败后领兵叛逃。
description.en: Song Guo, an officer in Li Jue's army, conspired to assassinate Li Jue. After the plot failed, he led his troops in rebellion.

description.zh-cn: 李傕中郎将张苞曾与郭汜密谋诛杀李傕。
description.en: Zhang Bao, a Commandant in Li Jue's army, conspired with Guo Si to assassinate Li Jue.

description.zh-cn: 李傕是北地郡人。
description.en: Li Jue was from Beidi Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊出生于河南省原阳县。
description.en: Li Shulei was born in Yuanyang County, Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊于1986年9月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Li Shulei joined the Communist Party of China in September 1986.
