position.en: Member of the Standing Committee, Head of the Propaganda Department

description.zh-cn: 2014年1月，任中共福建省委常委、宣传部部长。
description.en: In January 2014, he was appointed a member of the Standing Committee and Head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee.

position.en: Member of the Standing Committee, Secretary of the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection

description.zh-cn: 2015年12月，转任中共北京市委常委、纪委书记。
description.en: In December 2015, he was transferred to serve as a member of the Standing Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee.

position.en: Member of the Standing Committee, Deputy Secretary

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月，在十八届中央纪委七次全会被增选为常委、副书记。
description.en: In January 2017, he was co-opted as a member of the Standing Committee and Deputy Secretary at the Seventh Plenary Session of the 18th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 2017年11月至2019年3月，兼任中国纪检监察学院院长。
description.en: From November 2017 to March 2019, he concurrently served as the President of the China Academy of Discipline Inspection and Supervision.

description.zh-cn: 2022年10月，在中共二十届一中全会上当选中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: In October 2022, he was elected a member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee at the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2022年10月，在中共二十届一中全会上当选中央书记处书记。
description.en: In October 2022, he was elected a secretary of the Central Secretariat at the First Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2022年10月晋升为副国级党和国家领导人。
description.en: In October 2022, he was promoted to a vice-national level Party and state leader.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊卸任中共福建省委宣传部部长，由高翔接任。
description.en: Li Shulei stepped down as the Head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee, and was succeeded by Gao Xiang.

description.zh-cn: 李书磊卸任中共中央宣传部常务副部长，由胡和平接任。
description.en: Li Shulei stepped down as the Executive Deputy Head of the Propaganda Department of the CPC Central Committee, and was succeeded by Hu Heping.

description.zh-cn: 郭伯权是郭伯雄的胞弟。
description.en: Guo Boquan is the younger brother of Guo Boxiong.

description.zh-cn: 郭正钢是郭伯雄的儿子。
description.en: Guo Zhenggang is the son of Guo Boxiong.

description.zh-cn: 郭正钢是郭伯权的侄子。
description.en: Guo Zhenggang is the nephew of Guo Boquan.

description.zh-cn: 郭伯权出生于陕西省礼泉县。
description.en: Guo Boquan was born in Liquan County, Shaanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 郭伯权于1987年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Guo Boquan joined the Communist Party of China in 1987.

description.zh-cn: 2015年5月，陕西省委巡视组在对郭伯权任职的陕西省民政厅进行巡视时，发现其存在挪用资金、国有资产损失严重等问题，最终导致郭伯权于同年9月被免去民政厅厅长职务。
description.en: In May 2015, during an inspection of the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Civil Affairs where Guo Boquan was serving, the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee's inspection team discovered issues such as misappropriation of funds and severe loss of state-owned assets, which ultimately led to Guo Boquan's dismissal as director in September of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 中纪委机关报《中国纪检监察报》于2015年5月29日刊文，指出挪用救灾资金的行为构成挪用特定款物罪，须给予严惩，对郭伯权案的处理施加了舆论压力并推动了其被免职的进程。
description.en: On May 29, 2015, the official newspaper of the CCDI published an article pointing out that the misappropriation of disaster relief funds constitutes a specific crime and must be severely punished, applying public pressure and pushing forward the process of Guo Boquan's dismissal.

description.zh-cn: 郭伯权接替曹莉莉担任陕西省民政厅厅长。
description.en: Guo Boquan succeeded Cao Lili as the Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Civil Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 赵政才接替郭伯权担任陕西省民政厅厅长。
description.en: Zhao Zhengcai succeeded Guo Boquan as the Director of the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Civil Affairs.

description.zh-cn: 张燕南是北京人。
description.en: Zhang Yannan is from Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 张燕南是习仲勋的外孙女。
description.en: Zhang Yannan is the granddaughter of Xi Zhongxun.

description.zh-cn: 张燕南是齐心的外孙女。
description.en: Zhang Yannan is the granddaughter of Qi Xin.

description.zh-cn: 张楚是齐桥桥的前夫。
description.en: Zhang Chu is the ex-husband of Qi Qiaoqiao.

description.zh-cn: 刘锦成和齐桥桥曾就读于清华大学同一个EMBA班。
description.en: Liu Jincheng and Qi Qiaoqiao were classmates in the same EMBA program at Tsinghua University.

description.zh-cn: 张燕南于2004年在香港浅水湾以2048万港币购入一个自住公寓，并于2009年以一次性付款1.5亿港币购入一栋三层楼别墅。
description.en: Zhang Yannan purchased a residential apartment in Repulse Bay, Hong Kong for 20.48 million HKD in 2004, and a three-story villa for 150 million HKD in a single payment in 2009.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国煤炭工业部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Coal Industry of the People's Republic of China was a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1955年7月，第一届全国人民代表大会第二次会议决定撤销燃料工业部。
description.en: In July 1955, the Second Session of the First National People's Congress decided to abolish the Ministry of Fuel Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1955年7月，第一届全国人民代表大会第二次会议决定设立煤炭工业部。
description.en: In July 1955, the Second Session of the First National People's Congress decided to establish the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1993年3月，第八届全国人民代表大会第一次会议决定撤销中国统配煤矿总公司。
description.en: In March 1993, the First Session of the Eighth National People's Congress decided to abolish the China National Unified Distribution Coal Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 1993年3月，第八届全国人民代表大会第一次会议决定再次组建煤炭工业部。
description.en: In March 1993, the First Session of the Eighth National People's Congress decided to re-establish the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 1998年3月，第九届全国人大第一次会议批准国务院机构改革方案，决定不再保留中华人民共和国煤炭工业部。
description.en: In March 1998, the First Session of the Ninth National People's Congress approved the State Council's institutional reform plan and decided not to retain the Ministry of Coal Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1998年3月，第九届全国人大第一次会议决定，在国家经贸委下设主管煤炭行业的国家煤炭工业局。
description.en: In March 1998, the First Session of the Ninth National People's Congress decided to establish the State Administration of Coal Industry under the State Economic and Trade Commission to oversee the coal sector.

description.zh-cn: 老白洞矿难发生后，国家副主席董必武与煤炭工业部部长张霖之共同亲临现场视察指导。
description.en: After the Laobaidong mine disaster, Vice President Dong Biwu and Minister of Coal Industry Zhang Linzhi visited the site to inspect and guide the work.

description.zh-cn: “三线建设”时期，在西南地区进行了渡口煤炭基地建设。
description.en: During the 'Third Front' construction period, the Dukou coal base was developed in the southwest region.

description.zh-cn: 中国矿业大学曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: China University of Mining and Technology was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 辽宁工程技术大学（原阜新矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Liaoning Technical University (formerly Fuxin Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 山东科技大学（原山东矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Shandong University of Science and Technology (formerly Shandong Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 西安科技大学（原西安矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Xi'an University of Science and Technology (formerly Xi'an Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 河南理工大学（原焦作矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Henan Polytechnic University (formerly Jiaozuo Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 山西矿业学院曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Shanxi Mining Institute was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 安徽理工大学（原淮南矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Anhui University of Science and Technology (formerly Huainan Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 华北煤炭医学院曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: North China Coal Medical University was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 河北工程大学（原河北煤炭建筑工程学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Hebei University of Engineering (formerly Hebei Institute of Coal Civil Engineering) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 山东工商学院（原中国煤炭经济学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Shandong Technology and Business University (formerly China Institute of Coal Economics) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 湖南科技大学（原湘潭矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Hunan University of Science and Technology (formerly Xiangtan Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 黑龙江科技大学（原黑龙江矿业学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Heilongjiang University of Science and Technology (formerly Heilongjiang Mining Institute) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 淮北师范大学（原淮北煤炭师范学院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Huaibei Normal University (formerly Huaibei Coal Industry Teachers College) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 北京煤炭管理干部学院分院曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: The branch of Beijing Coal Management Cadre College was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 应急总医院（原煤炭总医院）曾是煤炭工业部的直属事业单位。
description.en: Emergency General Hospital (formerly General Coal Hospital) was once a public institution directly under the Ministry of Coal Industry.

description.zh-cn: 孝全成皇后去世后，年仅十岁的奕𬣞由静贵妃（孝静成皇后）抚养。
description.en: After the death of Empress Xiaoquancheng, the ten-year-old Yizhu was raised by Noble Consort Jing (Empress Xiaojingcheng).

description.zh-cn: 于道光十四年（1834年）被册封为皇后，直至1840年去世。
description.en: She was enthroned as Empress in the 14th year of Daoguang (1834) and held the title until her death in 1840.

description.zh-cn: 道光帝在面对鸦片战争的巨大压力时，仍然坚持为孝全成皇后举办了盛大的葬礼。
description.en: Despite being under great pressure from the Opium War, the Daoguang Emperor insisted on holding a grand funeral for Empress Xiaoquancheng.

description.zh-cn: 根据籍贯信息，谭斌是广东佛山人。
description.en: According to ancestral home information, Tan Bin is from Foshan, Guangdong.

description.zh-cn: 谭斌是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Tan Bin is a member of the Communist Party of China.

position.en: Deputy from Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 2018年，谭斌被选为广西壮族自治区出席第十三届全国人民代表大会代表。
description.en: In 2018, Tan Bin was elected as a deputy from the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 黄璜出生于江苏省涟水县。
description.en: Huang Huang was born in Lianshui County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 黄璜是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Huang Huang is a member of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 1984年12月至1986年4月，黄璜担任中共安徽省委书记（当时设有第一书记）。
description.en: From December 1984 to April 1986, Huang Huang served as Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Committee of the CCP (at that time, the position of First Secretary also existed).

description.zh-cn: 1987年，黄璜担任江西省人民政府副省长。
description.en: In 1987, Huang Huang served as Vice Governor of Jiangxi Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1989年12月至1997年8月，黄璜担任中共宁夏回族自治区党委书记。
description.en: From December 1989 to August 1997, Huang Huang served as Secretary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Regional Committee of the CCP.

position.zh-cn: 宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席
position.en: Chairman of the People's Government of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region

description.zh-cn: 在黄璜担任中共宁夏回族自治区党委书记期间，白立忱担任宁夏回族自治区人民政府主席，是黄璜的副职。
description.en: While Huang Huang was the Party Secretary of Ningxia, Bai Lichen was the Chairman of the regional government, serving as Huang's deputy.

description.zh-cn: 职务交接关系：黄璜接替沈达人担任中共宁夏回族自治区党委书记。
description.en: Job succession relationship: Huang Huang succeeded Shen Daren as the Party Secretary of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 职务交接关系：毛如柏接替黄璜担任中共宁夏回族自治区党委书记。
description.en: Job succession relationship: Mao Rubai succeeded Huang Huang as the Party Secretary of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 职务交接关系：黄璜接替周子健担任中共安徽省委书记。
description.en: Job succession relationship: Huang Huang succeeded Zhou Zijian as the Party Secretary of Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 职务交接关系：李贵鲜接替黄璜担任中共安徽省委书记。
description.en: Job succession relationship: Li Guixian succeeded Huang Huang as the Party Secretary of Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 于禁最初响应鲍信的招募而入伍，隶属于其麾下。
description.en: Yu Jin initially joined the army in response to Bao Xin's recruitment and served under his command.

description.zh-cn: 鲍信战死后，于禁及其部下隶属于将军王朗。
description.en: After Bao Xin was killed in battle, Yu Jin and his troops were placed under the command of General Wang Lang.

description.zh-cn: 经王朗推荐，于禁开始为曹操效力，成为其麾下重要将领，直至樊城之战被俘。
description.en: Following Wang Lang's recommendation, Yu Jin began to serve Cao Cao and became one of his key generals, until his capture at the Battle of Fancheng.

description.zh-cn: 昌豨与于禁是旧友。
description.en: Chang Xi and Yu Jin were old friends.

description.zh-cn: 昌豨反叛后向于禁投降，但于禁为执行军法，不顾旧交情谊，流泪将昌豨斩杀。
description.en: After rebelling, Chang Xi surrendered to Yu Jin, but to uphold military law, Yu Jin executed him in tears, disregarding their old friendship.

description.zh-cn: 于禁在樊城之战中因汉水暴涨，所率七军被淹没，导致其兵败被俘，这是其人生的重要转折点。
description.en: During the Battle of Fancheng, the seven armies led by Yu Jin were flooded due to the overflowing Han River, leading to his defeat and capture, which became a major turning point in his life.

description.zh-cn: 在樊城之战中，于禁与庞德同为援军。战败后，于禁投降，而庞德宁死不屈被杀。
description.en: During the Battle of Fancheng, Yu Jin and Pang De were both part of the reinforcement army. After being defeated, Yu Jin surrendered, while Pang De chose death over submission and was executed.

description.zh-cn: 于禁在东吴为俘虏期间，多次受到虞翻的呵斥和羞辱。
description.en: While a captive in Eastern Wu, Yu Jin was repeatedly berated and humiliated by Yu Fan.

description.zh-cn: 于禁归魏后，曹丕命人在曹操陵墓的屋壁上画上关羽战克、庞德愤怒、于禁乞降的壁画来羞辱他，导致于禁羞愤病逝。
description.en: After Yu Jin's return to Wei, Cao Pi ordered a mural to be painted on the wall of Cao Cao's tomb depicting Guan Yu's victory, Pang De's fury, and Yu Jin's surrender, which caused Yu Jin to die from shame and illness.

description.zh-cn: 曹操曾派于禁前往朱灵营中夺其兵权，朱灵及其部下慑于于禁的威严而不敢反抗，此后朱灵成为于禁的部下。
description.en: Cao Cao once dispatched Yu Jin to strip Zhu Ling of his command. Intimidated by Yu Jin's authority, Zhu Ling and his troops did not dare to resist, and Zhu Ling subsequently became Yu Jin's subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 于禁是曹魏的“五子良将”之一。
description.en: Yu Jin was one of the "Five Elite Generals" of Cao Wei.

description.zh-cn: 于禁被孙权遣返后，归属魏文帝曹丕，被任命为安远将军。
description.en: After being sent back by Sun Quan, Yu Jin served under Emperor Wen of Wei, Cao Pi, and was appointed General Who Pacifies the Distant.

description.zh-cn: 《人民日报》海外版在1991年3月20日的第二版上刊登了《七律·元宵》这首嵌字诗，导致其广泛传播。此事后被定性为“工作失误”。
description.en: The overseas edition of the People's Daily published the acrostic poem 'Qilu·Yuanxiao' on its second page on March 20, 1991, leading to its wide circulation. The incident was later classified as a 'work error'.

description.zh-cn: 对李鹏在六四天安门事件中采取强硬立场的不满，是这首诗被创作的直接动机。
description.en: Dissatisfaction with Li Peng's hardline stance during the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989 was the direct motivation for the creation of this poem.

description.zh-cn: 在《李鹏下台嵌字诗》发表时，李鹏正担任中华人民共和国国务院总理职务。
description.en: At the time of the publication of the 'Li Peng step down acrostic poem', Li Peng was serving as the Premier of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2014年5月，中华人民共和国教育部批准在辽宁警官高等专科学校基础上建立辽宁警察学院。
description.en: In May 2014, the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China approved the establishment of Liaoning Police College on the basis of the former Liaoning Police Officer College.

description.zh-cn: 辽宁警察学院隶属于辽宁省公安厅。
description.en: Liaoning Police College is affiliated with the Liaoning Provincial Public Security Department.

description.zh-cn: 辽宁警察学院由辽宁省人民政府举办。
description.en: Liaoning Police College is run by the Liaoning Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是金正日的次子。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is the second son of Kim Jong-il.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是高容姬的儿子。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is the son of Ko Yong-hui.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是金与正的同母兄长。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is the full elder brother of Kim Yo-jong.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是金正恩的同母兄长。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is the full elder brother of Kim Jong-un.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是金正男的异母弟弟。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is the younger half-brother of Kim Jong-nam.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是金雪松的异母弟弟。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is the younger half-brother of Kim Sol-song.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲出生于平壤市。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul was born in Pyongyang.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是朝鲜劳动党党员。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is a member of the Workers' Party of Korea.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲担任烽火组首长。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul serves as the head of the Ponghwasan Group.

description.zh-cn: 金正恩最终取代了金正哲，成为金正日的接班人。
description.en: Kim Jong-un ultimately replaced Kim Jong-chul to become the successor to Kim Jong-il.

description.zh-cn: 高容姬是金正日的妻子。
description.en: Ko Yong-hui was the wife of Kim Jong-il.

description.zh-cn: 成惠琳是金正日的妻子，金正男的母亲。
description.en: Song Hye-rim was the wife of Kim Jong-il and the mother of Kim Jong-nam.

description.zh-cn: 高容姬出生于日本大阪市。
description.en: Ko Yong-hui was born in Osaka, Japan.

description.zh-cn: 金正男是成惠琳的儿子。
description.en: Kim Jong-nam was the son of Song Hye-rim.

description.zh-cn: 金正哲是埃里克·克莱普顿的歌迷，曾多次专程前往德国、新加坡和英国观看其演唱会。
description.en: Kim Jong-chul is a fan of Eric Clapton and has specifically traveled to Germany, Singapore, and the United Kingdom to attend his concerts.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯于1948年10月6日出生于吉林省敦化县。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai was born in Dunhua County, Jilin Province on October 6, 1948.

description.zh-cn: 1962年至1968年在长沙市第一中学就读。
description.en: Studied at Changsha No. 1 High School from 1962 to 1968.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯是文革期间“极左派”红卫兵的代表人物。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai was a representative figure of the 'ultra-left' Red Guards during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯因反对血统论而参加了造反派。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai joined the Rebel Faction because he opposed the 'bloodline theory'.

description.zh-cn: 于1968年1月撰写并发表了《中国向何处去》。
description.en: Authored and published 'Where is China Going?' in January 1968.

description.zh-cn: 《中国向何处去》一文批判了当时陆续建立的革命委员会，认为其大多是旧官僚专政。
description.en: The article 'Where is China Going?' criticized the revolutionary committees being established at the time, viewing them mostly as dictatorships of the old bureaucracy.

description.zh-cn: 因撰写《中国向何处去》，杨小凯被定为“现行反革命罪”，并被判刑十年。
description.en: For writing 'Where is China Going?', Yang Xiaokai was convicted of 'active counter-revolutionary crimes' and sentenced to ten years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 将杨小凯及其文章《中国向何处去》点名为“反革命”。
description.en: Labeled Yang Xiaokai and his article 'Where is China Going?' as 'counter-revolutionary'.

description.zh-cn: 将杨小凯及其文章《中国向何处去》点名为“反革命”。
description.en: Labeled Yang Xiaokai and his article 'Where is China Going?' as 'counter-revolutionary'.

description.zh-cn: 将杨小凯及其文章《中国向何处去》点名为“反革命”。
description.en: Labeled Yang Xiaokai and his article 'Where is China Going?' as 'counter-revolutionary'.

description.zh-cn: 于1968年1月24日称“省无联”为反革命组织。
description.en: On January 24, 1968, he declared the 'Shengwulian' a counter-revolutionary organization.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯在文革期间因言获罪，服刑十年。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Yang Xiaokai was imprisoned for ten years for his writings.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯的父亲杨第甫在文革期间被关在“毛泽东思想学习班”。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai's father, Yang Difu, was imprisoned in a 'Mao Zedong Thought study class' during the Cultural Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯的母亲陈素在文革期间被多次批斗后悬梁自缢。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai's mother, Chen Su, was subjected to multiple struggle sessions during the Cultural Revolution and subsequently committed suicide by hanging.

description.zh-cn: 向于光远保荐杨小凯，促成其进入中国社会科学院。
description.en: Recommended Yang Xiaokai to Yu Guangyuan, which facilitated his admission to the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 与其父李锐一同向于光远保荐杨小凯。
description.en: Together with her father Li Rui, she recommended Yang Xiaokai to Yu Guangyuan.

description.zh-cn: 李南央是李锐的女儿。
description.en: Li Nanyang is the daughter of Li Rui.

description.zh-cn: 破格推荐杨小凯考入中国社会科学院经济研究所。
description.en: Made an exception to recommend Yang Xiaokai for admission to the Institute of Economics at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.

description.zh-cn: 1982年毕业于中国社会科学院经济研究所，获硕士学位。
description.en: Graduated from the Institute of Economics at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences in 1982 with a Master's degree.

description.zh-cn: 赏识并推荐杨小凯赴美国普林斯顿大学学习。
description.en: Recognized Yang Xiaokai's talent and recommended him to study at Princeton University in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯提出了新兴古典经济学理论。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai proposed the theory of new classical economics.

description.zh-cn: 高度评价杨小凯的研究，认为当时全世界最重要的经济研究在蒙纳士大学，由杨小凯所做。
description.en: Highly praised Yang Xiaokai's research, stating that the most important economic research in the world at the time was being done by Yang Xiaokai at Monash University.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯是杨第甫的儿子。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai is the son of Yang Difu.

description.zh-cn: 杨小凯是陈素的儿子。
description.en: Yang Xiaokai is the son of Chen Su.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军国防科技大学外国语学院隶属于中国人民解放军国防科技大学。
description.en: The College of Foreign Languages of the PLA National University of Defense Technology is subordinate to the PLA National University of Defense Technology.

description.zh-cn: 王鑫于2023年8月至2024年4月担任国防科技大学国际关系学院院长，此后自2024年4月起担任中国人民解放军国防科技大学外国语学院院长。
description.en: Wang Xin served as the President of the College of International Relations, National University of Defense Technology from August 2023 to April 2024, and subsequently became the President of the College of Foreign Languages of the PLA National University of Defense Technology from April 2024.

description.zh-cn: 王学军担任中国人民解放军国防科技大学外国语学院政治委员。
description.en: Wang Xuejun serves as the Political Commissar of the College of Foreign Languages of the PLA National University of Defense Technology.

description.zh-cn: 根据中央军事委员会命令，中国人民解放军战略支援部队信息工程大学外国语学院于2023年8月整体移交至中国人民解放军国防科技大学国际关系学院，成为其洛阳教学区。2024年4月2日，国防科技大学国际关系学院与此前移交的信息工程大学原洛阳校区主体调整组建为国防科技大学外国语学院。
description.en: According to the Central Military Commission's order, the College of Foreign Languages of the PLA Strategic Support Force Information Engineering University was wholly transferred to the College of International Relations of the National University of Defense Technology in August 2023, becoming its Luoyang teaching area. On April 2, 2024, the College of International Relations of NUDT and the main body of the former Luoyang campus of Information Engineering University were then reorganized to form the College of Foreign Languages of NUDT.

description.zh-cn: 在深化国防和军队改革中，中国人民解放军国际关系学院等院校合并组建为新的国防科技大学，原国际关系学院改制为国防科技大学国际关系学院。
description.en: During the reform of national defense and the military, the PLA Institute of International Relations and other institutions were merged to form the new National University of Defense Technology. The former Institute of International Relations was restructured into the College of International Relations of the National University of Defense Technology.

description.zh-cn: 2016年1月，在深化国防和军队改革中，中国人民解放军国际关系学院由原总参谋部转隶新组建的中央军事委员会训练管理部。
description.en: In January 2016, during the reform of national defense and the military, the PLA Institute of International Relations was transferred from the former General Staff Department to the newly established Training and Administration Department of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 2016年，在深化国防和军队改革中，解放军外国语学院由总参谋部第三部转隶中国人民解放军战略支援部队。
description.en: In 2016, during the reform of national defense and the military, the PLA Foreign Language Institute was transferred from the Third Department of the General Staff Department to the PLA Strategic Support Force.

description.zh-cn: 经宋庆龄介绍，斯诺访问了陕甘宁边区。
description.en: Through Soong Ching-ling's introduction, Snow visited the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region.

description.zh-cn: 斯诺是第一位采访毛泽东的西方记者，并于1936年6月至10月期间在陕甘宁边区进行了深入采访。他最后一次会见毛泽东是在1970年12月18日。
description.en: Snow was the first Western journalist to interview Mao Zedong, conducting extensive interviews in the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region between June and October 1936. His last meeting with Mao was on December 18, 1970.

description.zh-cn: 1936年访问陕甘宁边区期间采访了彭德怀。
description.en: Interviewed Peng Dehuai during his visit to the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 1936年访问陕甘宁边区期间采访了徐海东。
description.en: Interviewed Xu Haidong during his visit to the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 1936年访问陕甘宁边区期间采访了左权。
description.en: Interviewed Zuo Quan during his visit to the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 1936年访问陕甘宁边区期间采访了聂荣臻。
description.en: Interviewed Nie Rongzhen during his visit to the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 1936年访问陕甘宁边区期间采访了程子华。
description.en: Interviewed Cheng Zihua during his visit to the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 斯诺在北京写成了《红星照耀中国》（又名《西行漫记》）。
description.en: Snow wrote 'Red Star Over China' in Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 斯诺向宋庆龄介绍了中国工合运动的计划，并说服宋子文为其提供贷款，促进了工合运动的发展。
description.en: Snow introduced the plan for the Chinese Industrial Cooperatives movement to Soong Ching-ling, persuaded T.V. Soong to provide loans, and promoted the development of the movement.

description.zh-cn: 在皖南事变中，国民党军队突袭了新四军。
description.en: During the New Fourth Army Incident, Kuomintang forces ambushed the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 时任新四军驻香港办事处主任的廖承志与宋庆龄一同将皖南事变的消息告知斯诺。
description.en: Liao Chengzhi, then head of the New Fourth Army's Hong Kong office, along with Soong Ching-ling, informed Snow about the New Fourth Army Incident.

description.zh-cn: 因报道皖南事变，国民党重庆政府取缔了斯诺的记者采访权，迫使其离开中国。
description.en: Due to his reporting on the New Fourth Army Incident, the Kuomintang government in Chongqing revoked Snow's press credentials, forcing him to leave China.

description.zh-cn: 在麦卡锡主义时期，联邦调查局因斯诺与共产党的关系而对其进行质询。
description.en: During the McCarthy era, the FBI questioned Snow about his relationship with the communists.

description.zh-cn: 斯诺在1970年访华期间，被告知中国欢迎美国总统尼克松访华，他随后将此信息传递给了美国。
description.en: During his visit to China in 1970, Snow was told that US President Nixon would be welcome to visit, a message he subsequently relayed to the United States.

description.zh-cn: 埃德加·斯诺因胰腺癌病逝。
description.en: Edgar Snow died of pancreatic cancer.

description.zh-cn: 洛伊斯·惠勒·斯诺谴责中国政府在1989年暴力镇压天安门抗议者。
description.en: Lois Wheeler Snow condemned the Chinese government for its violent suppression of the Tiananmen Square protesters in 1989.

description.zh-cn: 洛伊斯·惠勒·斯诺曾写信给邓小平，呼吁关注受六四事件影响的家庭。
description.en: Lois Wheeler Snow wrote a letter to Deng Xiaoping, calling for attention to the families affected by the Tiananmen Square incident.

description.zh-cn: 斯诺与安娜·路易丝·斯特朗、艾格尼丝·史沫特莱被并称为“3S”，均是报道中国革命的著名美国记者。
description.en: Snow, along with Anna Louise Strong and Agnes Smedley, were known as the '3S', all famous American journalists who reported on the Chinese revolution.

description.zh-cn: 斯诺与安娜·路易丝·斯特朗、艾格尼丝·史沫特莱被并称为“3S”，均是报道中国革命的著名美国记者。
description.en: Snow, along with Anna Louise Strong and Agnes Smedley, were known as the '3S', all famous American journalists who reported on the Chinese revolution.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国邮电部发行了一套《中国人民之友》纪念邮票，其中一枚上的人物是埃德加·斯诺，以纪念其贡献。
description.en: The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications of the PRC issued a set of commemorative stamps titled 'Friends of the Chinese People', one of which featured Edgar Snow to commemorate his contributions.

description.zh-cn: 埃德加·斯诺被描述为亲中共的美国记者，并通过其著作向西方世界介绍了中国共产党。
description.en: Edgar Snow was described as a pro-CPC American journalist and introduced the Communist Party of China to the Western world through his writings.

description.zh-cn: 广州市人民政府在业务上由广东省人民政府领导。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal People's Government is operationally led by the Guangdong Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 广州市人民政府由广州市人民代表大会产生，对其负责并受其监督。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal People's Government is formed by, responsible to, and supervised by the Guangzhou Municipal People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党广州市委员会是广州市人民政府的中共上级组织。
description.en: The Guangzhou Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China is the superior CPC organization to the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1949年10月14日，中国人民解放军第四野战军进驻广州后，于10月21日成立了中国人民解放军广州市军事管制委员会。
description.en: After the Fourth Field Army of the PLA entered Guangzhou on October 14, 1949, it established the Guangzhou Military Control Commission of the Chinese People's Liberation Army on October 21.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军广州市军事管制委员会接管了原中华民国广州市政府。
description.en: The Guangzhou Military Control Commission of the Chinese People's Liberation Army took over the former Guangzhou Municipal Government of the Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在军事管制委员会成立后，于1949年10月28日正式成立广州市人民政府。
description.en: After the establishment of the Military Control Commission, the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government was formally established on October 28, 1949.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发后，于1968年2月成立了广州市革命委员会。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, the Guangzhou Revolutionary Committee was established in February 1968.

description.zh-cn: 广州市革命委员会成立后，行使原中共广州市委、市人大、市人委的职权，直至1981年恢复广州市人民政府。
description.en: After its establishment, the Guangzhou Revolutionary Committee exercised the powers of the former Municipal Party Committee, Municipal People's Congress, and Municipal People's Committee (then name for the government), until the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government was restored in 1981.

description.zh-cn: 在广州市人民政府改称为广州市人民委员会期间任市长。
description.en: Served as mayor during the period when the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government was renamed the Guangzhou Municipal People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 在广州市人民政府改称为广州市人民委员会期间任市长。
description.en: Served as mayor during the period when the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government was renamed the Guangzhou Municipal People's Committee.

description.zh-cn: 吴晓光是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Wu Xiaoguang is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2017年10月，吴晓光在中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会上当选中国共产党第十九届中央委员会候补委员。
description.en: In October 2017, Wu Xiaoguang was elected as an alternate member of the 19th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China at the 19th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 1982年本科毕业于华中工学院船舶设计与制造专业。
description.en: Graduated with a bachelor's degree in Ship Design and Manufacturing from Huazhong Institute of Technology in 1982.

description.zh-cn: 2008年在职获得华中科技大学船舶与海洋结构物设计及制造专业博士学位。
description.en: Obtained a Ph.D. in Ship and Marine Structure Design and Manufacturing from Huazhong University of Science and Technology in 2008 while in service.

description.zh-cn: 自1982年起在该研究所工作，历任助理工程师、工程师、总体科副科长、副主任、主任、副所长等职，并于2004年3月至2018年9月担任所长。
description.en: He worked at the institute since 1982, serving in various roles including assistant engineer, engineer, deputy section chief, deputy director, director, and deputy director, and served as the director from March 2004 to September 2018.

position.en: Deputy General Manager, Member of the Party Leadership Group

description.zh-cn: 2018年9月，吴晓光任中国船舶重工集团有限公司副总经理、党组成员，直至2019年10月公司合并。
description.en: In September 2018, Wu Xiaoguang was appointed as Deputy General Manager and a member of the Party Leadership Group of China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, until the company's merger in October 2019.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月中国船舶工业集团与中国船舶重工集团合并后，吴晓光继续担任新成立的中国船舶集团有限公司副总经理职务。
description.en: After the merger of China State Shipbuilding Industry Corporation and China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation in October 2019, Wu Xiaoguang continued to serve as the Deputy General Manager of the newly formed China State Shipbuilding Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 作为国家航母工程副总设计师，吴晓光参与了辽宁舰的设计建造工作，对该舰的建成起到了推动作用。
description.en: As the Deputy Chief Designer of the National Aircraft Carrier Project, Wu Xiaoguang participated in the design and construction of the Liaoning aircraft carrier, playing a role in its completion.

description.zh-cn: 吴晓光于2004年3月接替朱英富担任中国舰船研究设计中心所长职务。
description.en: Wu Xiaoguang succeeded Zhu Yingfu as the director of the China Ship Research & Design Center in March 2004.

description.zh-cn: 2019年10月，中国船舶重工集团有限公司与中国船舶工业集团有限公司合并，组建中国船舶集团。
description.en: In October 2019, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation merged with China State Shipbuilding Industry Corporation to form China State Shipbuilding Corporation.

description.zh-cn: 清军于1681年攻克昆明，平定了持续八年的三藩之乱。
三藩之乱一度动摇清廷在中原的统治根基，使清朝接连丢失华南六省。
清朝与吴三桂建立的吴周政权在三藩之乱中是主要交战方。
耿精忠于1674年3月占据福建，起兵响应吴三桂。
尚之信囚禁其父尚可喜，接受吴三桂册封，起兵反清。
王辅臣于1674年12月策动兵变，起兵响应吴三桂。
郑经领导的明郑势力出兵响应吴三桂，参与了三藩之乱。
察哈尔亲王布尔尼于1675年起兵，从后方威胁清廷以呼应吴三桂。
1681年，清军攻克昆明，吴世璠兵败自缢。
图海率军大破察哈尔军，布尔尼兵败逃亡后被杀，察哈尔叛乱被平定。
康亲王杰书率清军击破耿精忠的北伐大军，导致耿精忠于1676年投降清廷。
图海率军在平凉击败王辅臣，切断其与吴三桂的联系，迫使其再度降清。
吴三桂得知孙延龄意图降清，派遣其从孙吴世琮进入广西将孙延龄刺杀。
王辅臣策动兵变，在混乱中杀死了与其不和的陕西经略莫洛。
耿精忠起兵时囚禁了福建总督范承谟，后在降清前将其杀害灭口。
尚之信是平南王尚可喜的长子。
尚之信趁乱派兵囚禁其父尚可喜于府中，夺取了兵权。
郑经与耿精忠交恶，出兵攻打福建，导致耿精忠腹背受敌。
1676年，在清军的军事压力下，耿精忠投降清廷。
1677年6月，尚之信再度降清。
荀子曾在稷下学宫研习，后三度被任命为祭酒，负责主持典礼。
description.en: Xunzi studied at the Jixia Academy and was later appointed three times as its libationer, responsible for presiding over ceremonies.

description.zh-cn: 荀子被春申君任命为楚国兰陵令。
description.en: Xunzi was appointed as the Magistrate of Lanling in the State of Chu by Lord Chunshen.

description.zh-cn: 荀子祖述孔子，自视为孔子的真正继承人。
description.en: Xunzi followed the teachings of Confucius and considered himself the true successor to Confucius.

description.zh-cn: 荀子在学术思想上承继自子弓，并称赞其为儒学正宗传人。
description.en: Xunzi intellectually inherited from Zigong and praised him as the orthodox successor of Confucianism.

description.zh-cn: 浮丘伯是荀子的弟子，被认为最能传承其学问。
description.en: Fuqiubo was a disciple of Xunzi and was considered the best at carrying on his teachings.

description.zh-cn: 张苍是荀子的弟子。
description.en: Zhang Cang was a disciple of Xunzi.

description.zh-cn: 荀子批评孟子，视其为“瞀儒”，并反对其性善论。
description.en: Xunzi criticized Mencius, viewing him as a 'muddled Confucian' and opposing his theory of the goodness of human nature.

description.zh-cn: 荀子批评子思，并将其与孟子归为一类，视为“瞀儒”。
description.en: Xunzi criticized Zisi, lumping him together with Mencius and viewing him as a 'muddled Confucian'.

description.zh-cn: 荀子批评墨家学说，指责其只知严格节俭，却忽略了礼的作用。
description.en: Xunzi criticized Mohist doctrines, accusing them of only knowing strict frugality while ignoring the function of rites.

description.zh-cn: 性恶论是荀子提出的核心哲学思想。
description.en: The theory that human nature is evil is a core philosophical idea proposed by Xunzi.

description.zh-cn: 春申君任命荀子为兰陵令。
description.en: Lord Chunshen appointed Xunzi as the Magistrate of Lanling.

description.zh-cn: 春申君逝世，导致荀子被解除兰陵令的职务。
description.en: The death of Lord Chunshen led to Xunzi's dismissal from his post as Magistrate of Lanling.

description.zh-cn: 荀子提出的性恶论与孟子主张的性善论根本对立。
description.en: The theory of evil nature proposed by Xunzi is fundamentally opposed to the theory of good nature advocated by Mencius.

description.zh-cn: 刘向收集并编辑了荀子的著作，整理出32篇并合称为《孙卿书》。
description.en: Liu Xiang collected and edited the writings of Xunzi, compiling 32 chapters into a work titled 'Sun Qing Shu'.

description.zh-cn: 杨倞校勘与注解了《孙卿书》，并将其重新命名为《荀子》。
description.en: Yang Liang collated and annotated the 'Sun Qing Shu' and renamed it 'Xunzi'.

description.zh-cn: 荀子被一些学者认为是法家的先驱，其弟子韩非、李斯是法家代表人物，其思想可能促进了法家的发展。
description.en: Xunzi is considered by some scholars to be a forerunner of Legalism; his disciples Han Fei and Li Si were representative figures of Legalism, and his thought may have promoted its development.

description.zh-cn: 宋代理学家朱熹严厉批评荀子，几乎否认其儒家身份。
description.en: The Song Dynasty Neo-Confucian Zhu Xi severely criticized Xunzi, almost denying his status as a Confucian.

description.zh-cn: 宋代理学家程颐批评荀子的性恶说，并认为圣人之道因荀子而失传。
description.en: The Song Dynasty Neo-Confucian Cheng Yi criticized Xunzi's theory of evil nature and believed that the Way of the Sages was lost because of him.

description.zh-cn: 清末思想家谭嗣同批评荀子，将其学说归咎为中国两千年专制君权的源头。
description.en: The late Qing thinker Tan Sitong criticized Xunzi, blaming his teachings as the source of two millennia of autocratic monarchy in China.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命期间的“批孔扬秦”运动中，荀子因其法家弟子韩非、李斯而受到赞扬。
description.en: During the 'Criticize Confucius, Praise Qin' campaign of the Cultural Revolution, Xunzi was praised because of his Legalist disciples, Han Fei and Li Si.

description.zh-cn: 自由市场的核心定义是政府不介入控制经济活动。
description.en: The core definition of a free market is the absence of government intervention in economic activities.

description.zh-cn: 市场经济是以市场机制作为主导原则的经济体系。
description.en: A market economy is an economic system based on the guiding principle of market mechanisms.

description.zh-cn: 自由市场是古典自由主义意识形态中的一个核心经济理念。
description.en: The free market is a core economic concept within the ideology of classical liberalism.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔是新古典经济学派的创始人之一。
description.en: Alfred Marshall is one of the founders of the neoclassical school of economics.

description.zh-cn: 供求关系理论是在边际革命中被系统性地发展起来的。
description.en: The theory of supply and demand was systematically developed during the Marginal Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔在边际革命期间对供求关系理论做出了重要贡献和发展。
description.en: Alfred Marshall made important contributions to and developed the theory of supply and demand during the Marginal Revolution.

description.zh-cn: 在自由市场中，价格由供求关系决定，而非由外力强迫。
description.en: In a free market, prices are determined by supply and demand, not by external coercion.

description.zh-cn: 政府干预被认为是修补市场失灵的一种手段。
description.en: Government intervention is considered a means to correct market failures.

description.zh-cn: 自由市场经济与自由放任主义经济学理论紧密相关，后者为其提供了理论基础。
description.en: The market economy is closely related to the theory of laissez-faire economics, which provides its theoretical foundation.

description.zh-cn: 无政府资本主义是主张用市场完全替代国家功能的极端自由市场理念。
description.en: Anarcho-capitalism is an extreme free-market ideology that advocates for the complete replacement of state functions with the market.

description.zh-cn: 雷根主义通过减税和放松管制等政策来推动自由市场。
description.en: Reaganism promoted the free market through policies such as tax cuts and deregulation.

description.zh-cn: 新古典经济学派是现代西方经济学中主张自由市场的主要学派。
description.en: The neoclassical school is a major school in modern Western economics that advocates for the free market.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利经济学派主张一种极端的、不受干预的自由市场。
description.en: The Austrian School advocates for an extreme, non-interventionist form of the free market.

description.zh-cn: 芝加哥经济学派是亲市场的经济学派之一，认可市场机制和市场调节。
description.en: The Chicago school of economics is one of the pro-market schools, recognizing market mechanisms and regulation.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利经济学派以欧陆哲学而非数理逻辑为框架来构建其经济学理论。
description.en: The Austrian School builds its economic framework based on Continental philosophy rather than mathematical logic.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利经济学派以形而上学为框架来构建其经济学理论。
description.en: The Austrian School uses metaphysics as a framework to construct its economic theory.

description.zh-cn: 政府干预被认为有助于打击卡特尔，以维护市场竞争。
description.en: Government intervention is considered helpful in combating cartels to maintain market competition.

description.zh-cn: 政府干预被认为有助于打击对本国经济不利的资本外逃。
description.en: Government intervention is considered helpful in combating capital flight that is detrimental to the domestic economy.

description.zh-cn: 一种观点认为，政府通过打击卡特尔和资本外逃等行为的干预，有助于自由市场更好地运行其机制。
description.en: One viewpoint holds that government intervention, by combating cartels and capital flight, helps the free market mechanism to function better.

description.zh-cn: 混合经济是介于计划经济和市场经济之间，并包含两者特征的一种经济形式。
description.en: A mixed economy is a form of economy between a planned economy and a market economy, incorporating features of both.

description.zh-cn: 混合经济是介于计划经济和市场经济之间，并包含两者特征的一种经济形式。
description.en: A mixed economy is a form of economy between a planned economy and a market economy, incorporating features of both.

description.zh-cn: 对市场原教旨主义的常见抨击认为，它会导致严重的贫富差距问题。
description.en: A common criticism of market fundamentalism is that it leads to severe wealth inequality.

description.zh-cn: 杜威在其演讲中批评了主张国家放任的个人主义（自由放任主义），指出其忽视了社会中势力不平等的问题。
description.en: In his speech, John Dewey criticized individualism that advocates for state non-intervention (laissez-faire), pointing out its failure to address power inequality in society.

description.zh-cn: 一种对无政府资本主义的抨击意见认为，它可能会导致成功的企业形成垄断。
description.en: A criticism of anarcho-capitalism is that it could lead to successful enterprises forming monopolies.

description.zh-cn: 林亭翰是林隆璇的儿子。
description.en: Lin Ting-han is the son of Kevin Lin.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇出生于台湾台中县丰原镇（今台中市丰原区）。
description.en: Kevin Lin was born in Fengyuan Township, Taichung County, Taiwan (now Fengyuan District, Taichung City).

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇毕业于政治大学，获得教育系博士学位。
description.en: Kevin Lin graduated from National Chengchi University with a PhD from the Department of Education.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇于1986年至1987年期间为飞碟唱片公司旗下歌手。
description.en: Kevin Lin was an artist under UFO Records from 1986 to 1987.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇于1988年至1990年期间为巨石音乐公司旗下歌手。
description.en: Kevin Lin was an artist under Rock Records from 1988 to 1990.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇在多个时期为福茂唱片公司旗下歌手。
description.en: Kevin Lin was an artist under Linfair Records during multiple periods.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇于2002年至2004年期间为阿尔发音乐公司旗下歌手。
description.en: Kevin Lin was an artist under Alfa Music from 2002 to 2004.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇于2009年至2012年期间为金牌大风公司旗下歌手。
description.en: Kevin Lin was an artist under Gold Typhoon from 2009 to 2012.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇在台南应用科技大学担任副教授兼系主任。
description.en: Kevin Lin serves as an Associate Professor and Department Head at Tainan University of Technology.

description.zh-cn: 林隆璇担任台北市中山堂“2021广场音乐节”的策展人。
description.en: Kevin Lin served as the curator for the '2021 Plaza Music Festival' at Zhongshan Hall in Taipei.

position.en: Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee

description.zh-cn: 马天水担任中共上海市委书记，而张春桥在其之上担任第一书记。
description.en: Ma Tianshui served as the Secretary of the CPC Shanghai Municipal Committee, while Zhang Chunqiao served above him as the First Secretary.

description.zh-cn: 在该次大会的政治报告中，马天水被宣布为“四人帮”的死党。
description.en: In the political report of this congress, Ma Tianshui was declared a die-hard follower of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 被官方认定为“四人帮”的死党。
description.en: Officially identified as a die-hard follower of the 'Gang of Four'.

description.zh-cn: 开除马天水的中国共产党党籍。
description.en: Expelled Ma Tianshui from the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 刘勋是琅邪郡人。
description.en: Liu Xun was from Langya Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 王宋是刘勋的原配妻子，结婚二十余年后因无子被刘勋休弃。
description.en: Wang Song was Liu Xun's first wife; she was divorced by him after more than twenty years of marriage because she had not borne a son.

description.zh-cn: 袁术在孙策攻下庐江后，没有遵守承诺将太守之位授予孙策，而是任命其旧部刘勋为庐江太守。
description.en: After Sun Ce conquered Lujiang, Yuan Shu did not honor his promise to grant the position of Grand Administrator to Sun Ce, instead appointing his former subordinate Liu Xun to the post.

description.zh-cn: 刘勋曾为袁术的部下，并被其任命为庐江太守。袁术败亡后，此关系结束。
description.en: Liu Xun was a subordinate of Yuan Shu and was appointed by him as the Grand Administrator of Lujiang. This relationship ended after Yuan Shu's defeat and death.

description.zh-cn: 194年，袁术派孙策攻打时任庐江太守的陆康。
description.en: In 194, Yuan Shu dispatched Sun Ce to attack Lu Kang, who was then the Grand Administrator of Lujiang.

description.zh-cn: 袁术败亡后，其从弟袁胤率领部曲和袁术的家眷前往皖城投奔刘勋。
description.en: After Yuan Shu's defeat and death, his younger cousin Yuan Yin led his troops and Yuan Shu's family to Wancheng to seek refuge with Liu Xun.

description.zh-cn: 杨弘是袁术麾下的长史。
description.en: Yang Hong was the Chief Clerk under Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 张勋是袁术麾下的大将军。
description.en: Zhang Xun was the Grand General under Yuan Shu.

description.zh-cn: 杨弘在袁术败亡后，意欲率部投奔孙策，但在途中被刘勋截击并俘虏。
description.en: After Yuan Shu's defeat, Yang Hong intended to lead his troops to join Sun Ce but was intercepted and captured by Liu Xun along the way.

description.zh-cn: 张勋在袁术败亡后，意欲率部投奔孙策，但在途中被刘勋截击并俘虏。
description.en: After Yuan Shu's defeat, Zhang Xun intended to lead his troops to join Sun Ce but was intercepted and captured by Liu Xun along the way.

description.zh-cn: 孙策忌惮吞并了袁术余部的刘勋，于是设计诱其出兵，乘虚攻占了庐江。
description.en: Sun Ce grew wary of Liu Xun after he absorbed the remnants of Yuan Shu's forces, so he devised a plan to lure him away and seize Lujiang in his absence.

description.zh-cn: 孙策策划并领导了对刘勋的庐江之战。
description.en: Sun Ce planned and led the battle against Liu Xun for control of Lujiang.

description.zh-cn: 在孙策攻刘勋卢江之战中，刘勋中计被击败，丧失了庐江郡。
description.en: In the battle for Lujiang, Liu Xun fell into Sun Ce's trap, was defeated, and lost control of Lujiang Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 在孙策诱使刘勋攻打上缭时，刘晔曾劝谏刘勋不要出兵，但刘勋不听其建议。
description.en: When Sun Ce tried to lure Liu Xun into attacking Shangliao, Liu Ye advised Liu Xun against dispatching troops, but Liu Xun did not heed his advice.

description.zh-cn: 在孙策攻取庐江前，刘晔在刘勋帐下任职。
description.en: Before Sun Ce's conquest of Lujiang, Liu Ye served under Liu Xun.

description.zh-cn: 刘勋在被孙策击败后，于建安四年（199年）与弟弟一同投奔旧交曹操。
description.en: After being defeated by Sun Ce, Liu Xun, along with his younger brother, went to seek refuge with his old acquaintance Cao Cao in the fourth year of Jian'an (199 AD).

description.zh-cn: 司马芝任广平县令时，不畏惧受曹操宠信的刘勋，依法处理其宾客子弟的犯法行为，不与其同流合污。
description.en: When Sima Zhi was the magistrate of Guangping County, he was not intimidated by Liu Xun, who was favored by Cao Cao. He handled the illegal activities of Liu Xun's associates according to the law and refused to collude with him.

description.zh-cn: 杨沛任邺县令时，执法严明，不畏豪强，刘勋因此畏惧他并告诫其子弟不得犯法。
description.en: When Yang Pei was the magistrate of Ye County, he enforced the law strictly and was not afraid of the powerful. Liu Xun consequently feared him and warned his children and followers not to break the law.

description.zh-cn: 刘威是刘勋的侄子。
description.en: Liu Wei was Liu Xun's nephew.

description.zh-cn: 刘勋被处决后，其侄子刘威也受到牵连而被免官。
description.en: After Liu Xun was executed, his nephew Liu Wei was also implicated and dismissed from his official post.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石因被认定为“高饶反党联盟”主犯，而受到批判、解职、逮捕和判刑。
description.en: Rao Shushi was criticized, dismissed, arrested, and sentenced for being identified as a principal offender in the 'Gao-Rao Anti-Party Alliance'.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石与陆璀是夫妻关系。
description.en: Rao Shushi and Lu Cui were husband and wife.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石是饶思诚的儿子。
description.en: Rao Shushi is the son of Rao Sicheng.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石于1922年入读上海大学。
description.en: Rao Shushi enrolled at Shanghai University in 1922.

description.zh-cn: 因高岗饶漱石事件，饶漱石于1955年3月被开除出党。
description.en: Rao Shushi was expelled from the party in March 1955 due to the Gao Gang-Rao Shushi affair.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石于1952年至1954年担任中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: Rao Shushi served as the Head of the CCP Central Organization Department from 1952 to 1954.

description.zh-cn: 在皖南事变紧急关头，因项英擅自离队，饶漱石向中共中央提议撤销其职务。
description.en: At a critical moment during the Wannan Incident, as Xiang Ying had left his post without authorization, Rao Shushi proposed to the CCP Central Committee to remove him from his position.

description.zh-cn: 康生与饶漱石一起鼓励粟裕向中央军委“斗胆直呈”，改变了内战南线战场的战略计划。
description.en: Kang Sheng, together with Rao Shushi, encouraged Su Yu to 'boldly present directly' to the Central Military Commission, which changed the strategic plan for the southern front of the civil war.

description.zh-cn: 1965年8月，最高人民法院判处饶漱石有期徒刑14年。
description.en: In August 1965, the Supreme People's Court sentenced Rao Shushi to 14 years in prison.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发后，已被假释出狱的饶漱石于1967年被重新收监。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, Rao Shushi, who had been released on parole, was re-imprisoned in 1967.

description.zh-cn: 在对饶漱石的判决中，他被指控包庇了“中统特务分子”胡均鹤。
description.en: In the verdict against Rao Shushi, he was accused of sheltering Hu Junhe, an alleged 'Central Statistics Bureau agent'.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石与潘汉年、扬帆被一同认定为“饶潘扬反革命集团”的成员。
description.en: Rao Shushi, along with Pan Hannian and Yang Fan, was identified as a member of the 'Rao-Pan-Yang Counter-revolutionary Clique'.

description.zh-cn: 饶漱石与潘汉年、扬帆被一同认定为“饶潘扬反革命集团”的成员。
description.en: Rao Shushi, along with Pan Hannian and Yang Fan, was identified as a member of the 'Rao-Pan-Yang Counter-revolutionary Clique'.

description.zh-cn: 因市长高虹安遭停职，由副市长邱臣远代理市长职务。
description.en: Due to the suspension of Mayor Kao Hung-an, Deputy Mayor Chiu Chen-yuan serves as the acting mayor.

description.zh-cn: 邱臣远是台湾民众党党员。
description.en: Chiu Chen-yuan is a member of the Taiwan People's Party.

description.zh-cn: 担任第11届新竹市市长，后因案停职。
description.en: Served as the 11th Mayor of Hsinchu City, later suspended due to a legal case.

description.zh-cn: 高虹安是台湾民众党党员。
description.en: Kao Hung-an is a member of the Taiwan People's Party.

description.zh-cn: 因市长林智坚辞职，由秘书长陈章贤代理市长职务。
description.en: Following the resignation of Mayor Lin Chih-chien, Secretary-General Chen Chang-hsien served as the acting mayor.

description.zh-cn: 担任第9、10届新竹市市长。
description.en: Served as the 9th and 10th Mayor of Hsinchu City.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽亚·特蕾西娅是神圣罗马皇帝查理六世的长女。
description.en: Maria Theresa was the eldest daughter of the Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI.

description.zh-cn: 玛丽亚·特蕾西娅与洛林公爵弗朗茨结婚，他们的后代开创了哈布斯堡-洛林王朝。
description.en: Maria Theresa married Francis, Duke of Lorraine, and their descendants founded the House of Habsburg-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 作为哈布斯堡家族的继承人，玛丽亚·特蕾西娅与丈夫弗朗茨一世被视为哈布斯堡-洛林王朝的创始人。
description.en: As the heir to the House of Habsburg, Maria Theresa, along with her husband Francis I, is considered a founder of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 弗朗茨一世通过与玛丽亚·特蕾西娅的婚姻以及当选为神圣罗马皇帝，共同开创了哈布斯堡-洛林王朝。
description.en: Through his marriage to Maria Theresa and his election as Holy Roman Emperor, Francis I co-founded the House of Habsburg-Lorraine.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利王位继承战争是由于欧洲多国拒绝承认玛丽亚·特蕾西娅的继承权而爆发的，挑战了她的统治。
description.en: The War of the Austrian Succession broke out because several European powers refused to recognize Maria Theresa's right of succession, challenging her rule.

description.zh-cn: 奥地利在普奥战争中战败，被迫解散德意志邦联，并丧失了在德意志地区的领导地位，国力大为削弱。
description.en: Austria's defeat in the Austro-Prussian War forced it to dissolve the German Confederation and lose its leading role in German affairs, significantly weakening its power.

description.zh-cn: 普奥战争的失败暴露了奥地利帝国的内部危机，迫使弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世与匈牙利贵族妥协，促成了1867年奥匈帝国的建立。
description.en: The defeat in the Austro-Prussian War exposed the internal crises of the Austrian Empire, compelling Franz Joseph I to compromise with the Hungarian nobility, which led to the establishment of Austria-Hungary in 1867.

description.zh-cn: 作为奥地利皇帝，弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世与匈牙利方面达成《奥匈折衷方案》，建立了奥匈二元帝国。
description.en: As Emperor of Austria, Franz Joseph I reached the Austro-Hungarian Compromise with the Hungarian side, establishing the dual monarchy of Austria-Hungary.

description.zh-cn: 斐迪南大公遇刺的“萨拉热窝事件”是第一次世界大战的直接导火索。
description.en: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand, known as the Sarajevo incident, was the direct trigger of World War I.

description.zh-cn: 由于在第一次世界大战中战败，奥匈帝国末代皇帝卡尔一世于1918年11月11日被迫退位。
description.en: Due to the defeat in World War I, Charles I, the last emperor of Austria-Hungary, was forced to abdicate on November 11, 1918.

description.zh-cn: 作为家族首领，奥托·冯·哈布斯堡于1961年正式宣布放弃对奥地利帝位的要求，此举被视为对王朝政治诉求的终结。
description.en: As head of the family, Otto von Habsburg formally renounced his claim to the Austrian throne in 1961, an act seen as the end of the dynasty's political aspirations.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈是东汉末年的人物。
description.en: Taishi Ci was a figure from the late Eastern Han dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈是孙吴势力的重要将领。
description.en: Taishi Ci was an important general of the Eastern Wu forces.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈早期曾是孔融的客将。
description.en: In his early career, Taishi Ci served as a guest general under Kong Rong.

description.zh-cn: 在孔融被黄巾军围困时，太史慈为了报恩，单骑突围向刘备求援，帮助孔融解围。
description.en: When Kong Rong was besieged by the Yellow Turban Army, Taishi Ci, to repay a debt of gratitude, broke through the siege alone to seek reinforcements from Liu Bei, helping to lift the siege on Kong Rong.

description.zh-cn: 太史慈在南下后投靠了同乡的扬州刺史刘繇，但未受重用，仅负责前线侦察。
description.en: After heading south, Taishi Ci joined his fellow townsman Liu Yao, the Inspector of Yang Province, but was not given significant responsibilities, only being tasked with front-line reconnaissance.

description.zh-cn: 孙策去世后，太史慈继续效力于孙权，并受其委托管理南方要务。
description.en: After Sun Ce's death, Taishi Ci continued to serve Sun Quan and was entrusted with managing affairs in the southern regions.

description.zh-cn: 黄巾军将领管亥率军围困了驻扎在都昌的孔融。
description.en: The Yellow Turban Army general Guan Hai led his forces to besiege Kong Rong, who was stationed in Duchang.

description.zh-cn: 1992年8月28日，中国人民银行以银复（1992）350号文批准设立上海浦东发展银行。
description.en: On August 28, 1992, the People's Bank of China approved the establishment of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank with document Yin Fu (1992) No. 350.

description.zh-cn: 截至2022年12月31日，上海国际集团有限公司为浦发银行最大股东，持股比例21.57%。
description.en: As of December 31, 2022, Shanghai International Group Co., Ltd. was the largest shareholder of SPD Bank, holding a 21.57% stake.

description.zh-cn: 1999年11月10日，上海浦东发展银行在上海证券交易所挂牌上市。
description.en: On November 10, 1999, Shanghai Pudong Development Bank was listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

description.zh-cn: 2018年1月19日，中国银监会就上海浦东发展银行成都分行违规发放贷款案件，对该分行处以4.62亿元人民币罚款。
description.en: On January 19, 2018, the China Banking Regulatory Commission fined the Chengdu branch of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank RMB 462 million for a case of illicit lending.

description.zh-cn: 因成都分行违规发放贷款案，王兵被中国银监会处以警告、罚款50万元并终身不得从事银行业工作的处罚。
description.en: Due to the illicit lending case at the Chengdu branch, Wang Bing was warned, fined RMB 500,000, and banned from the banking industry for life by the China Banking Regulatory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 因成都分行违规发放贷款案，高波被中国银监会处以警告、罚款50万元并终身不得从事银行业工作的处罚。
description.en: Due to the illicit lending case at the Chengdu branch, Gao Bo was warned, fined RMB 500,000, and banned from the banking industry for life by the China Banking Regulatory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 上海浦东发展银行信用卡中心发布了一张涉及四川木里森林火灾牺牲烈士的海报广告，引发公众争议，并于次日道歉。
description.en: The credit card center of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank released a poster ad involving the martyrs of the Sichuan Muli forest fire, which sparked public controversy and led to an apology the next day.

description.zh-cn: 上海科创银行是上海浦东发展银行持股100%的全资子公司。
description.en: Shanghai STC Bank is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank with 100% shareholding.

description.zh-cn: 上海国际集团有限公司是上海市国有资产监督管理委员会监管的上海市属国有独资企业。
description.en: Shanghai International Group Co., Ltd. is a state-owned sole proprietorship under the supervision of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of Shanghai Municipal Government.

description.zh-cn: 截至2022年12月31日，香港中央结算有限公司持有上海浦东发展银行2.24%的股份。
description.en: As of December 31, 2022, HKSCC Nominees Limited held a 2.24% stake in Shanghai Pudong Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 截至2022年12月31日，中央汇金资产管理有限责任公司持有上海浦东发展银行1.32%的股份。
description.en: As of December 31, 2022, Central Huijin Asset Management Ltd. held a 1.32% stake in Shanghai Pudong Development Bank.

description.zh-cn: 常宁市人民政府的业务上级机构是衡阳市人民政府。
李自成是大顺政权的第一任皇帝。
description.en: Li Zicheng was the first emperor of the Dashun regime.

description.zh-cn: 李自成自1629年起兵反明，直至1644年攻入北京导致明朝灭亡。
description.en: Li Zicheng rebelled against the Ming from 1629 until he captured Beijing in 1644, leading to the dynasty's collapse.

description.zh-cn: 甲申之变标志着明朝作为统一政权的灭亡。
description.en: The Jiashen Incident marked the end of the Ming dynasty as a unified regime.

description.zh-cn: 李自成在山海关一片石战役中被吴三桂与清军联军击败，从此由盛转衰。
description.en: Li Zicheng was defeated by the allied forces of Wu Sangui and the Qing army at the Battle of Shanhai Pass (Yipianshi), marking a turning point from his ascendancy to decline.

description.zh-cn: 清朝摄政王多尔衮接受吴三桂投降，并指挥清军与吴三桂联军在一片石战役中击败李自成。
description.en: Qing regent Dorgon accepted Wu Sangui's surrender and commanded the joint Qing-Wu forces to defeat Li Zicheng at the Battle of Yipianshi.

description.zh-cn: 李自成早年曾在明朝驿站担任负责照看马匹的驿卒。
description.en: In his early years, Li Zicheng worked as a staff member responsible for tending horses at a Ming dynasty post station.

description.zh-cn: 李自成因妻子韩金儿与人通奸而杀死了她。
description.en: Li Zicheng killed his wife, Han Jin'er, for committing adultery.

description.zh-cn: 1643年10月，李自成攻破潼关，杀死了明朝督师孙传庭。
description.en: In October 1643, Li Zicheng broke through Tongguan Pass and killed the Ming Grand Coordinator Sun Chuanting.

description.zh-cn: 洪承畴作为明朝三边总督，曾多次率军围剿包括李自成在内的农民起义军。
description.en: As the Ming Viceroy of the Three Borders, Hong Chengchou led multiple campaigns to suppress peasant rebel armies, including Li Zicheng's forces.

description.zh-cn: 李过是李自成的侄子，也是其麾下重要将领，被封为滋侯。
description.en: Li Guo was Li Zicheng's nephew and an important general under his command, enfeoffed as the Marquis of Zi.

description.zh-cn: 在李自成死后，李过推举李自成的三弟李自敬为大顺军首领。
description.en: After Li Zicheng's death, Li Guo supported the proclamation of Li Zicheng's third younger brother, Li Zijing, as the leader of the Dashun army.

description.zh-cn: 清朝入关后，阿济格率领一路大军负责追击李自成，并多次击败大顺军。
description.en: After the Qing forces entered through the pass, Ajige led one of the main armies to pursue Li Zicheng and defeated the Dashun forces multiple times.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威于1964年从马来亚大学获得伊斯兰研究的学士学位。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi graduated from the University of Malaya in 1964 with a bachelor's degree in Islamic Studies.

description.zh-cn: 恩顿·玛末是阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的第一任妻子。
description.en: Endon Mahmood was the first wife of Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 凯里·嘉马鲁丁是阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的女婿。
description.en: Khairy Jamaluddin is the son-in-law of Abdullah Ahmad Badawi.

description.zh-cn: 时任首相马哈迪·莫哈末委任阿都拉·阿末·巴达威担任副首相。
description.en: Then-Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad appointed Abdullah Ahmad Badawi as Deputy Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 在马哈迪·莫哈末担任首相期间，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威担任副首相。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi served as Deputy Prime Minister during Mahathir Mohamad's premiership.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威从马哈迪·莫哈末手中接任，成为马来西亚第五任首相。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi took over from Mahathir Mohamad to become the fifth Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威接替安华·伊布拉欣，担任马来西亚第八任副首相。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi succeeded Anwar Ibrahim as the eighth Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 在阿都拉·阿末·巴达威担任首相期间，纳吉·阿都拉萨担任其副手。
description.en: During Abdullah Ahmad Badawi's premiership, Najib Razak served as his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威领导的国民阵线在2004年大选中取得压倒性胜利，巩固了其首相地位。
description.en: The Barisan Nasional coalition led by Abdullah Ahmad Badawi won a landslide victory in the 2004 general election, consolidating his position as Prime Minister.

description.zh-cn: 国民阵线在2008年大选中首次失去国会三分之二多数优势，导致阿都拉·阿末·巴达威面临巫统内部压力，并提早卸任。
description.en: In the 2008 general election, the Barisan Nasional lost its two-thirds parliamentary supermajority for the first time, leading to Abdullah Ahmad Badawi facing internal pressure from UMNO and resigning early.

description.zh-cn: 2008年大选后，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威面对来自巫统内部的长期施压逼宫，最终于2009年4月宣布卸任。
description.en: After the 2008 general election, Abdullah Ahmad Badawi faced long-term pressure from within UMNO to step down, eventually announcing his resignation in April 2009.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威曾担任巫统主席（2003-2009）、署理主席（1999-2003）及副主席。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi served as President of UMNO (2003-2009), Deputy President (1999-2003), and Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 阿都拉·阿末·巴达威参与挑战马哈迪的B队，虽成功保住副主席职位，但其国防部长职位随后被撤除。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi joined 'Team B' to challenge Mahathir, and although he retained his Vice President post, his position as Minister of Defence was subsequently revoked.

description.zh-cn: 在1987年巫统党选中，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威因与马哈迪对立，其国防部长职位被撤除。
description.en: After the 1987 UMNO party election, Abdullah Ahmad Badawi's position as Minister of Defence was revoked due to his opposition to Mahathir.

description.zh-cn: 在1987年巫统党选中，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威与慕沙希淡同属B队，共同挑战马哈迪。
description.en: In the 1987 UMNO party election, Abdullah Ahmad Badawi was allied with Musa Hitam in 'Team B' to challenge Mahathir.

description.zh-cn: 在端姑赛西拉祖丁担任马来西亚最高元首期间，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威担任首相。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi served as Prime Minister during the reign of Tuanku Syed Sirajuddin as the Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 在端姑米占·再纳·阿比丁担任马来西亚最高元首期间，阿都拉·阿末·巴达威担任首相。
description.en: Abdullah Ahmad Badawi served as Prime Minister during the reign of Tuanku Mizan Zainal Abidin as the Yang di-Pertuan Agong of Malaysia.

description.zh-cn: 净选盟在2007年成功号召万人大集会，导致时任首相阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的支持率在2007年第四季度跌至历史新低61%。
description.en: Bersih successfully organized a mass rally in 2007, which caused the approval rating of then-Prime Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi to drop to a historic low of 61% in the fourth quarter of 2007.

description.zh-cn: 兴权会在2007年成功号召万人大集会，导致时任首相阿都拉·阿末·巴达威的支持率在2007年第四季度跌至历史新低61%。
description.en: HINDRAF successfully organized a mass rally in 2007, which caused the approval rating of then-Prime Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi to drop to a historic low of 61% in the fourth quarter of 2007.

description.zh-cn: 伊斯兰党主席哈迪阿旺评价阿都拉·阿末·巴达威是一名“弱势首相”。
description.en: PAS President Abdul Hadi Awang described Abdullah Ahmad Badawi as a 'weak Prime Minister'.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一1922年入上海南洋大学电机工程科学习并毕业。
description.en: Lu Dingyi entered the Electrical Engineering Department of Nanyang University in Shanghai in 1922 and graduated from there.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一于1925年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Lu Dingyi joined the Communist Party of China in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一长期担任中共中央宣传部部长。
description.en: Lu Dingyi served as the Head of the CCP Central Propaganda Department for a long period.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一兼任中华人民共和国文化部部长。
description.en: Lu Dingyi concurrently served as the Minister of Culture of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一在平反后当选为全国政协副主席。
description.en: After his rehabilitation, Lu Dingyi was elected Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee.

position.zh-cn: 国务院副总理、文化部部长

description.zh-cn: 在周恩来担任国务院总理期间，陆定一担任副总理及文化部部长，是其下属。
description.en: While Zhou Enlai was the Premier of the State Council, Lu Dingyi served as Vice Premier and Minister of Culture, making him a subordinate.

description.zh-cn: 唐义贞是陆定一的第一任妻子。
description.en: Tang Yizhen was Lu Dingyi's first wife.

description.zh-cn: 严慰冰是陆定一的第二任妻子。
description.en: Yan Weibing was Lu Dingyi's second wife.

description.zh-cn: 陆德是陆定一的儿子。
description.en: Lu De is the son of Lu Dingyi.

description.zh-cn: 陆德是严慰冰的儿子。
description.en: Lu De is the son of Yan Weibing.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一参与组织了百团大战。
description.en: Lu Dingyi participated in organizing the Hundred Regiments Offensive.

description.zh-cn: 1956年5月，陆定一代表中共中央作了题为《百花齐放，百家争鸣》的报告，推动了该运动。
description.en: In May 1956, Lu Dingyi delivered a report titled 'Let a Hundred Flowers Bloom, Let a Hundred Schools of Thought Contend' on behalf of the CCP Central Committee, promoting the movement.

description.zh-cn: 在1962年的广州会议上，陆定一明确反对陈毅等人为知识分子脱去“资产阶级”帽子的提议。
description.en: At the Guangzhou Conference in 1962, Lu Dingyi explicitly opposed the proposal by Chen Yi and others to remove the 'bourgeois' label from intellectuals.

description.zh-cn: 在1962年广州会议上，毛泽东采纳了陆定一关于不应为知识分子摘掉“资产阶级知识分子”帽子的意见。
description.en: At the 1962 Guangzhou Conference, Mao Zedong adopted Lu Dingyi's opinion that the 'bourgeois intellectual' label should not be removed from intellectuals.

description.zh-cn: 陆定一担任文化革命五人小组的副组长。
description.en: Lu Dingyi served as the deputy leader of the Group of Five.

position.zh-cn: 文化革命五人小组副组长
position.en: Deputy Leader of the Group of Five

description.zh-cn: 在文化革命五人小组中，陆定一是副组长，组长为彭真。
description.en: In the Group of Five, Lu Dingyi was the deputy leader under the leader Peng Zhen.

description.zh-cn: 文化革命五人小组拟定并上报了《二月提纲》。
description.en: The Group of Five drafted and submitted the 'February Outline'.

description.zh-cn: 作为《二月提纲》的主要负责人之一和文化革命五人小组的副组长，陆定一因《五一六通知》的发布而被打倒。
description.en: As one of the main persons in charge of the 'February Outline' and the deputy leader of the Group of Five, Lu Dingyi was purged following the issuance of the 'May 16 Notification'.

description.zh-cn: 在1960年至1966年间，严慰冰持续给叶群写匿名信，造谣其私生活，对其进行骚扰和攻击。
description.en: Between 1960 and 1966, Yan Weibing continuously sent anonymous letters to Ye Qun, spreading rumors about her private life, harassing and attacking her.

description.zh-cn: 因其妻子严慰冰写匿名信攻击叶群，林彪对陆定一进行政治报复，是导致陆定一被打倒的直接原因之一。
description.en: Due to his wife Yan Weibing's anonymous letters attacking Ye Qun, Lin Biao took political revenge on Lu Dingyi, which was one of the direct causes of Lu's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 1979年6月8日，中共中央为陆定一平反，恢复其名誉和党籍。
description.en: On June 8, 1979, the CCP Central Committee rehabilitated Lu Dingyi, restoring his reputation and party membership.

position.en: Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee

description.zh-cn: 在邓小平担任全国政协主席期间，陆定一是其副手。
description.en: While Deng Xiaoping served as Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, Lu Dingyi was his deputy.

description.zh-cn: 解云清曾担任黑龙江省革命委员会副主任。
description.en: Xie Yunqing once served as the Deputy Director of the Heilongjiang Provincial Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 解云清曾担任黑龙江省人民政府副省长。
description.en: Xie Yunqing once served as the Vice Governor of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 根据维基百科分类，解云清是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the Wikipedia category, Xie Yunqing was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 解云清出生于直隶（今河北）清苑。
description.en: Xie Yunqing was born in Qingyuan, Zhili (modern-day Hebei).

description.zh-cn: 王瑞生是河北南宫人。
description.en: Wang Ruisheng was from Nangong, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 王瑞生曾任中共湖北省委常委。
description.en: Wang Ruisheng served as a member of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Provincial Committee of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 王瑞生曾任湖北省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: Wang Ruisheng served as the Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Hubei Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，王瑞生曾任湖北省人民政府副省长。
description.en: According to category information, Wang Ruisheng served as the Vice Governor of the Hubei Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，王瑞生是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Wang Ruisheng was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 李济深是中国国民党革命委员会的主要创始人之一，并被推举为首任主席。
何香凝是中国国民党革命委员会的主要创始人之一。
冯玉祥是中国国民党革命委员会的主要创始人之一。
中国国民党革命委员会由国民党左派人士创建并以其为骨干。
1949年11月，三民主义同志联合会与民革等组织整合为统一的中国国民党革命委员会。
1949年11月，中国国民党民主促进会与民革等组织整合为统一的中国国民党革命委员会。
中国国民党革命委员会由从中国国民党分裂出的左派人士组成，在政治上与当时由右派主导的中国国民党对立。
在中国国民党革命委员会成立时被推举为名誉主席，但宋庆龄本人从未正式加入该党。
根据中华人民共和国的政治制度，中国国民党革命委员会接受中国共产党的政治领导。
中国国民党革命委员会将孙中山尊为精神领袖，并在重要场合悬挂其画像。
李沛瑶是李济深之子。
何鲁丽是何思源之女。
叶利钦是俄罗斯历史上首位民选国家元首，于1991年当选，并于1996年连任。
description.en: Yeltsin was the first popularly elected head of state in Russian history, elected in 1991 and re-elected in 1996.

description.zh-cn: 1961年加入苏联共产党，1990年7月在苏共二十八大后宣布退党。
description.en: Joined the CPSU in 1961 and announced his withdrawal from the party in July 1990 after the 28th Congress of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫亲自提拔叶利钦接替格里申，成为苏共莫斯科市委第一书记。
description.en: Gorbachev personally promoted Yeltsin to replace Grishin as the First Secretary of the Moscow City Committee of the CPSU.

description.zh-cn: 因叶利钦在政治局会议上严厉批评戈尔巴乔夫的政策，先后被免除莫斯科党委第一书记职务和中央政治局候补委员职务。
description.en: After Yeltsin severely criticized Gorbachev's policies at a Politburo meeting, he was dismissed first as First Secretary of the Moscow Party Committee and then as a candidate member of the Central Politburo.

description.zh-cn: 叶利钦在1991年12月与其他加盟国领导人共同促成了苏联解体。
description.en: In December 1991, Yeltsin, along with leaders of other union republics, facilitated the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 叶利钦与白俄罗斯的舒什克维奇、乌克兰的克拉夫丘克在明斯克签约，成立独立国家联合体以取代苏联。
description.en: Yeltsin, along with Shushkevich of Belarus and Kravchuk of Ukraine, signed an agreement in Minsk to establish the Commonwealth of Independent States to replace the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 舒什克维奇与俄罗斯的叶利钦、乌克兰的克拉夫丘克在明斯克签约，成立独立国家联合体以取代苏联。
description.en: Shushkevich, along with Yeltsin of Russia and Kravchuk of Ukraine, signed an agreement in Minsk to establish the Commonwealth of Independent States to replace the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 克拉夫丘克与俄罗斯的叶利钦、白俄罗斯的舒什克维奇在明斯克签约，成立独立国家联合体以取代苏联。
description.en: Kravchuk, along with Yeltsin of Russia and Shushkevich of Belarus, signed an agreement in Minsk to establish the Commonwealth of Independent States to replace the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 叶利钦下令军队包围并进攻议会大厦，以武力解决了与议会的政治对峙。
description.en: Yeltsin ordered the military to surround and attack the parliament building, resolving the political standoff with the parliament by force.

description.zh-cn: 在1993年俄罗斯宪政危机中，叶利钦与时任国会议长的哈斯布拉托夫存在严重政治分歧并最终发生武力冲突，哈斯布拉托夫等人被捕。
description.en: During the 1993 Russian constitutional crisis, Yeltsin had severe political disagreements with then-parliamentary speaker Khasbulatov, which ultimately led to armed conflict and the arrest of Khasbulatov and his supporters.

description.zh-cn: 在1993年俄罗斯宪政危机中，叶利钦与时任副总统的鲁茨科伊存在严重政治分歧，叶利钦下令解除其职务，鲁茨科伊被议会宣布接替总统职务，最终被捕。
description.en: During the 1993 Russian constitutional crisis, Yeltsin had severe political disagreements with then-Vice President Rutskoy. Yeltsin ordered his dismissal, while the parliament declared Rutskoy as acting president, leading to his eventual arrest.

description.zh-cn: 叶利钦遴选普京为政府总理和自己的继承人，并于1999年12月31日辞职，由普京接任临时总统。
description.en: Yeltsin selected Putin as Prime Minister and his successor, and resigned on December 31, 1999, allowing Putin to become acting president.

description.zh-cn: 为应对车臣的分离主义，叶利钦在其任内发动了第一次车臣战争。
description.en: In response to Chechen separatism, Yeltsin launched the First Chechen War during his presidency.

description.zh-cn: 车臣战争的悬而未决，大大地损害了叶利钦在国民心中的地位。
description.en: The unresolved Chechen War significantly damaged Yeltsin's standing among the Russian public.

description.zh-cn: 1950年入读乌拉尔工学院（现乌拉尔国立技术大学）建筑系并于1955年毕业。
description.en: Enrolled in the Faculty of Architecture at the Ural Polytechnic Institute (now Ural State Technical University) in 1950 and graduated in 1955.

description.zh-cn: 中国外交部表示，叶利钦为中俄关系发展作出了突出贡献，中国人民失去了一位挚友。
description.en: The Chinese Foreign Ministry stated that Yeltsin made outstanding contributions to the development of Sino-Russian relations and that the Chinese people lost a dear friend.

description.zh-cn: 1913年8月，俄罗斯帝国政府藉齐齐哈尔巡警检查俄籍朝鲜人之故，对中华民国北京政府施压，胁迫宋小濂辞去黑龙江省都督及民政长职务。
description.en: In August 1913, the government of the Russian Empire pressured the Beiyang Government, forcing Song Xiaolian to resign from his posts as Military Governor and Civil Governor of Heilongjiang Province, using the incident of Qiqihar police inspecting Russian-Korean nationals as a pretext.

description.zh-cn: 宋小濂接替周树模担任黑龙江巡抚。
description.en: Song Xiaolian succeeded Zhou Shumo as the Governor of Heilongjiang.

description.zh-cn: 毕桂芳接替宋小濂担任黑龙江都督。
description.en: Bi Guifang succeeded Song Xiaolian as the Military Governor of Heilongjiang.

description.zh-cn: 刘瑁是刘焉之子。
description.en: Liu Mao was the son of Liu Yan.

description.zh-cn: 刘瑁与刘璋是兄弟关系。
description.en: Liu Mao and Liu Zhang were brothers.

description.zh-cn: 刘备于建安十九年（214年）从刘璋手中夺取益州。
description.en: In 214, Liu Bei seized Yi Province from Liu Zhang.

description.zh-cn: 法正是刘备的谋士。
description.en: Fa Zheng was an advisor to Liu Bei.

description.zh-cn: 糜夫人是刘备的妻子之一。
description.en: Lady Mi was one of Liu Bei's wives.

description.zh-cn: 敬哀皇后是后主刘禅的第一位皇后。
description.en: Empress Jing'ai was the first empress of the second emperor Liu Shan.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋怀疑郭桓等人舞弊，下令调查，从而引发了郭桓案，并借此案大规模整肃全国官吏。
description.en: Zhu Yuanzhang suspected Guo Huan and others of fraud, ordered an investigation, thus triggering the Guo Huan Case, and used it to conduct a large-scale purge of officials nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 御史余敏与丁廷举告发郭桓贪污，直接引发了郭桓案的调查。
description.en: Imperial Censor Yu Min, along with Ding Tingju, accused Guo Huan of corruption, directly triggering the investigation of the Guo Huan Case.

description.zh-cn: 作为案件主犯，郭桓被处死。
description.en: As the main culprit in the case, Guo Huan was executed.

description.zh-cn: 郭桓案牵连甚广，导致六部自左右侍郎以下的众多官员被处死，严重冲击了中央政府的运作。
description.en: The Guo Huan Case had widespread implications, leading to the execution of numerous officials from the Six Ministries, from Vice Ministers downwards, severely disrupting the operations of the central government.

description.zh-cn: 最初告发郭桓的御史余敏，后因被认为“追赃扰民”和“妄指平民”，也被朱元璋处死。
description.en: Yu Min, the censor who initially reported Guo Huan, was later executed by Zhu Yuanzhang for being deemed to have 'disturbed the populace while recovering stolen goods' and 'falsely accusing commoners'.

description.zh-cn: 郭桓案暴露了财务记录易于篡改的问题，促进了大写数字在官方财务文书中的广泛应用以防范贪污。
description.en: The Guo Huan Case exposed the vulnerability of financial records to tampering, promoting the widespread use of formal Chinese numerals in official financial documents to prevent corruption.

description.zh-cn: 郭桓于洪武十七年（1384年）四月任户部右侍郎，五月署理户部尚书，次年案发被处死。
description.en: Guo Huan was appointed Right Vice Minister of Revenue in the fourth month of the 17th year of Hongwu (1384), became Acting Minister in the fifth month, and was executed when the case broke out the following year.

description.zh-cn: 彭家珍在良弼家门口向其投掷炸弹，将其刺杀。
description.en: Peng Jiazhen threw a bomb at Liangbi at his doorstep, assassinating him.

description.zh-cn: 彭家珍是同盟会京津分会成员，并执行了刺杀良弼的任务。
description.en: Peng Jiazhen was a member of the Beijing-Tianjin branch of the Tongmenghui and carried out the mission to assassinate Liangbi.

description.zh-cn: 派遣成员彭家珍刺杀了被视为满族保皇派代表人物的良弼。
description.en: Dispatched member Peng Jiazhen to assassinate Liangbi, who was considered a representative figure of the Manchu royalists.

description.zh-cn: 良弼与溥伟、铁良等人共同组织了宗社党，以反对南北议和与清帝逊位。
description.en: Liangbi, along with Puwei and Tieliang, co-founded the Royalist Party to oppose the North-South peace negotiations and the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 溥伟与良弼、铁良等人共同组织了宗社党。
description.en: Puwei co-founded the Royalist Party with Liangbi and Tieliang.

description.zh-cn: 铁良与溥伟、良弼等人共同组织了宗社党。
description.en: Tieliang co-founded the Royalist Party with Puwei and Liangbi.

description.zh-cn: 良弼反对革命，主张“以立宪弥革命”，并组织宗社党反对南北议和与清帝逊位。
description.en: Liangbi opposed the revolution, advocating to 'use constitutionalism to quell revolution,' and organized the Royalist Party to oppose the North-South peace negotiations and the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 良弼组织宗社党，明确表示反对南北议和。
description.en: Liangbi organized the Royalist Party and explicitly opposed the North-South peace negotiations.

description.zh-cn: 良弼组织宗社党，明确表示反对清帝逊位。
description.en: Liangbi organized the Royalist Party and explicitly opposed the abdication of the Qing emperor.

description.zh-cn: 良弼前往湖北，拜于时任湖广总督张之洞门下，成为其门生。
description.en: Liangbi traveled to Hubei and became a protégé of Zhang Zhidong, who was then the Viceroy of Huguang.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯延揽良弼担任其麾下陆军第二镇的陆军第八标统带官。
description.en: Yuan Shikai recruited Liangbi to serve as the commander of the 8th Army Regiment within the 2nd Army Division under his command.

description.zh-cn: 袁世凯出任内阁总理大臣后，调冯国璋任禁卫军统制，夺去了良弼对禁卫军的实际控制权。
description.en: After becoming Prime Minister of the Imperial Cabinet, Yuan Shikai appointed Feng Guozhang as the commander of the Imperial Guards, thereby stripping Liangbi of his actual control over the unit.

description.zh-cn: 武昌起义后，良弼反对起用袁世凯。
description.en: After the Wuchang Uprising, Liangbi opposed the appointment of Yuan Shikai.

description.zh-cn: 两人在日本留学期间结识，成为一生的莫逆之交。
description.en: The two met while studying in Japan and became lifelong close friends.

description.zh-cn: 与铁良等人共同组织宗社党，并被称为清季干将。
description.en: Co-founded the Royalist Party with Tieliang and others, and they were known as capable generals of the late Qing period.

description.zh-cn: 军谘大臣载涛不谙军事，凡事皆以良弼为“谋主”（首席参谋）。
description.en: The Minister of the Army Advisory Council, Zaitao, was not well-versed in military affairs and relied on Liangbi as his 'chief strategist'.

description.zh-cn: 良弼是清末立宪派大臣，主张“以立宪弥革命”，并在遗折中叮嘱“尊重信条，实行宪政”。
description.en: Liangbi was a constitutionalist minister in the late Qing dynasty who advocated 'using constitutionalism to quell revolution' and urged in his last testament to 'respect the articles and implement constitutional government'.

description.zh-cn: 留学期间，革命派指其“专司侦察革命党”，显示了敌对关系。
description.en: During his studies abroad, revolutionaries accused him of 'specializing in spying on the revolutionary party,' indicating an adversarial relationship.

description.zh-cn: 时任两江总督的端方上奏称赞良弼“才猷敏练，学术精深”，并推荐其为武学顾问之选。
description.en: Duanfang, then Viceroy of Liangjiang, submitted a memorial praising Liangbi for his 'sharp talent and profound knowledge' and recommended him as a candidate for military advisor.

description.zh-cn: 日本驻清朝公使伊集院彦吉授予良弼三等旭日勋章。
description.en: The Japanese Minister to the Qing Dynasty, Ijūin Hikokichi, awarded Liangbi the Order of the Rising Sun, 3rd Class.

description.zh-cn: 马塞洛·雷贝洛·德索萨于2016年就任葡萄牙总统。
description.en: Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa took office as President of Portugal in 2016.

description.zh-cn: 1910年10月5日革命推翻了君主制，建立了葡萄牙共和国。
description.en: The 5 October 1910 revolution overthrew the monarchy and established the Portuguese Republic.

description.zh-cn: 1910年10月5日革命推翻了葡萄牙王国。
description.en: The 5 October 1910 revolution overthrew the Kingdom of Portugal.

description.zh-cn: 康乃馨革命推翻了极右政权，开启了葡萄牙的民主化进程。
description.en: The Carnation Revolution overthrew the far-right regime and began the process of democratization in Portugal.

description.zh-cn: 康乃馨革命推翻了持续42年的“新国家”极右政权。
description.en: The Carnation Revolution overthrew the 42-year-long 'Estado Novo' far-right regime.

description.zh-cn: 葡萄牙于1986年1月1日加入欧洲共同体。
description.en: Portugal joined the European Communities on January 1, 1986.

description.zh-cn: 葡萄牙是北大西洋公约组织的创始成员国之一。
description.en: Portugal is one of the founding members of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization.

description.zh-cn: 澳门主权移交中华人民共和国，结束了葡萄牙作为殖民国家的历史。
description.en: The handover of Macau's sovereignty to the People's Republic of China ended Portugal's history as a colonial power.

description.zh-cn: 通过澳门回归，中华人民共和国恢复对澳门行使主权。
description.en: Through the handover of Macau, the People's Republic of China resumed the exercise of sovereignty over Macau.

description.zh-cn: 1822年，随着最大殖民地巴西的独立，葡萄牙的国势逐渐衰落。
