description.en: In 1822, with the independence of its largest colony, Brazil, Portugal's national power gradually declined.

description.zh-cn: 1926年5月的军事政变后，卡尔莫纳元帅上台。
description.en: After the military coup in May 1926, Marshal Carmona came to power.

description.zh-cn: 财政部长安东尼奥·萨拉查于1930年就任总理，后成为独裁者，建立了“新国家”政权。
description.en: Minister of Finance António de Oliveira Salazar became Prime Minister in 1930 and later a dictator, establishing the 'Estado Novo' regime.

description.zh-cn: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多是葡萄牙国家足球队的队长和杰出球员。
description.en: Cristiano Ronaldo is the captain and a prominent player for the Portugal national football team.

description.zh-cn: 葡萄牙国家足球队在2016年欧洲足球锦标赛中夺得冠军。
description.en: The Portugal national football team won the championship at UEFA Euro 2016.

description.zh-cn: 第七届全国人民代表大会第一次会议通过决议，撤销广东省海南行政区，以其行政区域设立海南省。
description.en: The First Session of the 7th National People's Congress passed a resolution to abolish the Hainan Administrative Region of Guangdong Province and establish Hainan Province in its administrative area.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，中共中央决定支持海南全岛建设自由贸易试验区，逐步探索、稳步推进中国特色自由贸易港建设。
description.en: In 2018, the CPC Central Committee decided to support the construction of a pilot free trade zone on the entire island of Hainan, and to gradually explore and steadily promote the construction of a free trade port with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 在庆祝海南建省办经济特区30周年大会上，中共中央总书记习近平宣布，中共中央决定支持海南逐步探索、稳步推进中国特色自由贸易港建设。
description.en: At the conference celebrating the 30th anniversary of Hainan's establishment as a province and special economic zone, CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping announced that the CPC Central Committee had decided to support Hainan in gradually exploring and steadily advancing the construction of a free trade port with Chinese characteristics.

description.zh-cn: 公元前110年，汉武帝在海南岛设置儋耳郡。
description.en: In 110 BC, Emperor Wu of Han established Dan'er Commandery on Hainan Island.

description.zh-cn: 公元前82年，汉昭帝将儋耳郡并入珠崖郡。
description.en: In 82 BC, Emperor Zhao of Han merged Dan'er Commandery into Zhuyai Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 西汉末年，朝廷罢弃了珠崖郡。
description.en: At the end of the Western Han dynasty, the imperial court abolished Zhuyai Commandery.

description.zh-cn: 胡汉民曾提议设立琼崖特别区（即后来的海南特别行政区）。
description.en: Hu Hanmin proposed the establishment of the Qiongyai Special District (later the Hainan Special Administrative Region).

description.zh-cn: 孙科曾提议设立琼崖特别区（即后来的海南特别行政区）。
description.en: Sun Fo proposed the establishment of the Qiongyai Special District (later the Hainan Special Administrative Region).

description.zh-cn: 1931年12月7日，国民政府国务会议决议划广东省琼崖全属为特别行政区。
description.en: On December 7, 1931, the State Council of the Nationalist Government resolved to designate the entire Qiongyai area of Guangdong Province as a special administrative region.

description.zh-cn: 1931年12月国民政府任命伍朝枢为琼崖特别区行政长官，他于1932年3月1日就任。
description.en: In December 1931, the Nationalist Government appointed Wu Chaoshu as the Administrative Chief of the Qiongyai Special District, and he took office on March 1, 1932.

description.zh-cn: 因陈济棠的暗中阻挠，海南特别行政区的改建事宜未能实施。
description.en: Due to Chen Jitang's covert obstruction, the reorganization of the Hainan Special Administrative Region could not be implemented.

description.zh-cn: 1939年，日军占领海南岛，海南岛进入日占时期。
description.en: In 1939, the Japanese army occupied Hainan Island, marking the beginning of the Japanese occupation period.

description.zh-cn: 日占时期，致力于缅甸独立的志士昂山等人在海南岛上进行了军事训练。
description.en: During the Japanese occupation, patriots dedicated to Burmese independence, such as Aung San, conducted military training on Hainan Island.

description.zh-cn: 1950年3月至5月间，中国共产党领导的中国人民解放军发动海南岛战役，旨在夺取海南岛的控制权。
description.en: From March to May 1950, the Chinese People's Liberation Army, led by the Communist Party of China, launched the Landing Operation on Hainan Island to seize control of the island.

description.zh-cn: 1959年3月24日，中华人民共和国国务院设立了西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛办事处。
description.en: On March 24, 1959, the State Council of the People's Republic of China established the Office for the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands.

description.zh-cn: 2012年6月21日，国务院撤销西沙群岛、南沙群岛、中沙群岛办事处，并在其基础上设立地级三沙市。
description.en: On June 21, 2012, the State Council abolished the Office for the Xisha, Nansha, and Zhongsha Islands and established the prefecture-level city of Sansha on its basis.

description.zh-cn: 由浙江省第十四届人民代表大会选举产生。
description.en: Elected by the 14th Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省监察委员会首届主任，由浙江省第十二届人民代表大会选举产生。
description.en: The first Director of the Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission, elected by the 12th Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》是设立浙江省监察委员会的法律依据之一。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China is one of the legal bases for the establishment of the Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国监察法》是设立浙江省监察委员会的法律依据之一。
description.en: The Supervision Law of the People's Republic of China is one of the legal bases for the establishment of the Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省监察委员会业务上接受中华人民共和国国家监察委员会的领导。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission is professionally led by the National Supervisory Commission of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省监察委员会由浙江省人民代表大会产生，并对其负责。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission is created by and responsible to the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 浙江省监察委员会对浙江省人民代表大会常务委员会负责。
description.en: The Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission is responsible to the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 中共浙江省纪委是中共中央纪委的下级单位。
description.en: The CPC Zhejiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection is a subordinate unit of the CPC Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

description.zh-cn: 中国共产党浙江省纪律检查委员会是中国共产党浙江省委员会的纪律检查机构。
description.en: The CPC Zhejiang Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection is the discipline inspection body of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 2017年1月20日，浙江省十二届人大五次会议选举任泽民为浙江省监察委员会主任。
description.en: On January 20, 2017, the 5th Session of the 12th Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress elected Ren Zemin as the Director of the Zhejiang Provincial Supervisory Commission.

description.zh-cn: 来自英国的清教徒移民于1630年创建了波士顿。
description.en: Puritan immigrants from England founded Boston in 1630.

description.zh-cn: 清教徒于1635年创立了美国第一所公立学校波士顿拉丁学校。
description.en: The Puritans founded Boston Latin School, the first public school in the United States, in 1635.

description.zh-cn: 清教徒于1636年创立了美国第一所大学哈佛大学。
description.en: The Puritans founded Harvard University, the first university in the United States, in 1636.

description.zh-cn: 波士顿是美国革命期间多个重要事件的发生地，包括波士顿大屠杀和波士顿茶叶事件，这些事件推动了革命的进程。
description.en: Boston was the site of several key events during the American Revolution, including the Boston Massacre and the Boston Tea Party, which propelled the revolutionary cause.

description.zh-cn: 美国革命导致北美十三州脱离大不列颠王国独立。
description.en: The American Revolution led to the independence of the Thirteen Colonies from the Kingdom of Great Britain.

description.zh-cn: 肯尼迪家族作为杰出的爱尔兰裔代表，在波士顿政治中扮演了重要角色。
description.en: As prominent Irish-American representatives, the Kennedy family played a significant role in Boston politics.

description.zh-cn: 吉列公司由宝洁公司拥有。
description.en: Gillette is owned by Procter & Gamble.

description.zh-cn: 吉列公司的总部位于波士顿。
description.en: Gillette is headquartered in Boston.

description.zh-cn: 波士顿红袜队是位于波士顿的美国职业棒球大联盟球队。
description.en: The Boston Red Sox are a Major League Baseball team based in Boston.

description.zh-cn: 腓特烈一世和他的弟弟威廉二世于1409年创建了莱比锡大学。
description.en: Frederick I and his brother William II founded the University of Leipzig in 1409.

description.zh-cn: 1409年查理大学发生分裂，许多在布拉格的德国师生因此返回故乡，促成了莱比锡大学的建立。
description.en: A division at Charles University in 1409 caused many German teachers and students in Prague to return to their homeland, which led to the founding of the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 莱比锡大学的成立获得了时任教宗历山五世的认可。
description.en: The establishment of the University of Leipzig was recognized by the then-Pope Alexander V.

description.zh-cn: 历山五世是天主教会的教宗。
description.en: Alexander V was the Pope of the Catholic Church.

description.zh-cn: 第二次世界大战爆发后，莱比锡大学是被德意志第三帝国允许继续授课的四所大学之一。
description.en: After the outbreak of World War II, the University of Leipzig was one of four universities permitted by the Third Reich to continue teaching.

description.zh-cn: 二战结束时，莱比锡大学60%的建筑和70%的藏书在空袭中化为灰烬。
description.en: By the end of World War II, 60% of the University of Leipzig's buildings and 70% of its book collection had been destroyed in air raids.

description.zh-cn: 在1953年至1991年间，莱比锡大学曾以卡尔·马克思的名字命名为“莱比锡卡尔·马克思大学”。
description.en: Between 1953 and 1991, the University of Leipzig was named 'Karl Marx University, Leipzig' after Karl Marx.

description.zh-cn: 威廉·冯特自1875年起任莱比锡大学哲学教授，并于1879年在该校建立了全世界第一个心理学研究所。
description.en: Wilhelm Wundt served as a professor of philosophy at the University of Leipzig from 1875 and established the world's first psychology laboratory at the university in 1879.

description.zh-cn: 1973年至1978年就读物理学专业。
description.en: Studied physics from 1973 to 1978.

description.zh-cn: 1765年至1768年就读法学和诗歌学专业。
description.en: Studied law and poetics from 1765 to 1768.

description.zh-cn: 1865年至1869年就读古典语言学专业。
description.en: Studied classical philology from 1865 to 1869.

description.zh-cn: 1661年至1663年就读哲学专业。
description.en: Studied philosophy from 1661 to 1663.

description.zh-cn: 1927年至1942年任理论物理学教授。
description.en: Served as a professor of theoretical physics from 1927 to 1942.

description.zh-cn: 1877年就读土木工程专业。
description.en: Studied civil engineering in 1877.

description.zh-cn: 1921年至1922年就读语言学，获博士学位。
description.en: Studied linguistics from 1921 to 1922 and received a doctorate.

description.zh-cn: 1928年秋赴德，在莱比锡大学海森堡教授领导下工作。
description.en: Went to Germany in the autumn of 1928 to work under the leadership of Professor Heisenberg at the University of Leipzig.

description.zh-cn: 周培源在莱比锡大学期间，在海森堡教授的领导下工作。
description.en: During his time at the University of Leipzig, Zhou Peiyuan worked under the leadership of Professor Heisenberg.

description.zh-cn: 1954年至1955年就读德语。
description.en: Studied German from 1954 to 1955.

description.zh-cn: 1953年至1956年就读德语。
description.en: Studied German from 1953 to 1956.

description.zh-cn: 1936年获莱比锡大学数学博士学位。
description.en: Received a PhD in Mathematics from the University of Leipzig in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 1888年任威廉·奥斯特瓦尔德助教。
description.en: Served as an assistant to Wilhelm Ostwald in 1888.

description.zh-cn: 1888年任威廉·奥斯特瓦尔德助教。
description.en: Served as an assistant to Wilhelm Ostwald in 1888.

description.zh-cn: 1887年至1906年任物理化学教授。
description.en: Served as a professor of physical chemistry from 1887 to 1906.

description.zh-cn: 东欧各国采用的计划经济体制导致经济僵化和生活水平低下，成为东欧剧变的重要内因。
description.en: The planned economy system adopted by Eastern European countries led to economic stagnation and low living standards, becoming a key internal cause of the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 西方国家对社会主义阵营推行的和平演变政策是东欧剧变的重要外因。
description.en: The policy of Peaceful Evolution promoted by Western countries against the socialist bloc was a significant external cause of the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫推行的“民主社会主义”纲领和“辛纳屈主义”减少了苏联对东欧国家的控制，推动了东欧剧变的发生。
description.en: Mikhail Gorbachev's policies of 'democratic socialism' and the 'Sinatra Doctrine' reduced Soviet control over Eastern European countries, thereby promoting the Revolutions of 1989.

description.zh-cn: 东欧剧变一般被认为是冷战结束的标志。
description.en: The Revolutions of 1989 are generally considered to mark the end of the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 东欧剧变是导致南斯拉夫解体的外部因素之一。
description.en: The Revolutions of 1989 were one of the external factors leading to the breakup of Yugoslavia.

description.zh-cn: 六四清场使得六四事件的民众运动被迫中止并失败。
description.en: The June Fourth Crackdown forced the popular movement of the Tiananmen Square protests to end in failure.

description.zh-cn: 中国六四清场的流血事件广泛传播，使得东欧各国的军队在民意压力下无力继续镇压，促成了东欧的和平演变。
description.en: The widespread reports of bloodshed from the June Fourth Crackdown in China made Eastern European armies reluctant to use force under public pressure, which facilitated the peaceful evolution in Eastern Europe.

description.zh-cn: 莱赫·瓦文萨是团结工会的主要创始人和领导人。
description.en: Lech Wałęsa was the main founder and leader of the Solidarity trade union.

description.zh-cn: 在1989年6月4日的议会选举中，团结工会以压倒性优势击败了执政的波兰统一工人党，结束了其统治。
description.en: In the parliamentary elections on June 4, 1989, Solidarity defeated the ruling Polish United Workers' Party by a landslide, ending its rule.

description.zh-cn: 1989年，匈牙利开始拆除其部分边境设防，导致大量东德居民经由该国流入西德，加剧了东德内部的不稳定情绪，最终促成柏林墙倒塌。
description.en: In 1989, Hungary began dismantling parts of its border fortifications, leading to a large influx of East German residents into West Germany, which exacerbated internal instability in East Germany and ultimately contributed to the fall of the Berlin Wall.

description.zh-cn: 随着两德统一，德意志民主共和国（东德）作为一个主权国家不复存在，并入了联邦德国。
description.en: With German reunification, the German Democratic Republic (East Germany) ceased to exist as a sovereign state and was incorporated into the Federal Republic of Germany.

description.zh-cn: 在东欧剧变的浪潮和国内大规模示威的压力下，东德领导人埃里希·昂纳克于1989年10月18日宣布辞职。
description.en: Under the pressure of the Revolutions of 1989 and large-scale domestic demonstrations, East German leader Erich Honecker announced his resignation on October 18, 1989.

description.zh-cn: 天鹅绒革命后，瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔当选为捷克斯洛伐克新总统。
description.en: After the Velvet Revolution, Václav Havel was elected as the new president of Czechoslovakia.

description.zh-cn: 1989年罗马尼亚革命推翻了尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库的独裁统治，并于12月25日将其处决。
description.en: The 1989 Romanian Revolution overthrew the dictatorial rule of Nicolae Ceaușescu, and he was executed on December 25.

description.zh-cn: 1989年罗马尼亚革命导致罗马尼亚共产党的政权正式消亡。
description.en: The 1989 Romanian Revolution led to the official demise of the Romanian Communist Party's regime.

description.zh-cn: 南斯拉夫的解体过程伴随着各共和国之间的武装冲突，最终演变为长期的南斯拉夫内战。
description.en: The process of Yugoslavia's breakup was accompanied by armed conflicts between its republics, eventually evolving into the protracted Yugoslav Wars.

description.zh-cn: 郭锡兰曾担任西藏自治区革命委员会副主任。
description.en: Guo Xilan served as the Vice Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh-cn: 郭锡兰曾担任西藏自治区人民政府第一副主席。
description.en: Guo Xilan served as the First Vice Chairman of the People's Government of the Tibet Autonomous Region.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，郭锡兰是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Guo Xilan was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张世超是辽宁海城人。
description.en: Zhang Shichao is from Haicheng, Liaoning.

description.zh-cn: 张世超是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Zhang Shichao is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年2月24日，张世超当选为第十三届全国人民代表大会辽宁地区代表。
description.en: On February 24, 2018, Zhang Shichao was elected as a delegate representing the Liaoning region to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 溥杰的生母是嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏。
description.en: Pujie's biological mother was the primary consort, Lady Gūwalgiya.

description.zh-cn: 在宣统年间，载沣作为监国摄政王与隆裕太后同为清朝实际上的最高统治者，遇有重大事件需请太后懿旨。
description.en: During the Xuantong era, Zaifeng, as Prince-Regent, and Empress Dowager Longyu were the de facto supreme rulers of the Qing dynasty; major events required the Empress Dowager's edict.

description.zh-cn: 慈禧太后拒绝了张之洞等人径立载沣为帝的建议，而是选择立其子溥仪为帝，由载沣摄政。
description.en: Empress Dowager Cixi rejected the proposal from Zhang Zhidong and others to directly enthrone Zaifeng, choosing instead to make his son Puyi the emperor with Zaifeng as regent.

description.zh-cn: 日本方面将溥仪安排为满洲国的国家元首（初为执政，后为皇帝）。
description.en: The Japanese installed Puyi as the head of state of Manchukuo (initially as Chief Executive, later as Emperor).

description.zh-cn: 载沣曾反对其子溥仪前往东北就任日本傀儡政权满洲国的元首，但未能阻止。
description.en: Zaifeng opposed his son Puyi's decision to go to Northeast China to become the head of the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo, but was unable to stop him.

description.zh-cn: 载沣的嫡福晋瓜尔佳氏因受到端康太妃的训斥，而服毒自尽。
description.en: Zaifeng's primary consort, Lady Gūwalgiya, committed suicide by taking poison after being reprimanded by Imperial Noble Consort Duankang.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮出生于江苏省涟水县。
description.en: Li Yuanchao was born in Lianshui County, Jiangsu Province.

description.zh-cn: 由于李源潮出生时朝鲜战争爆发，他的父母为其取名“援朝”，后改为“源潮”。
description.en: Because Li Yuanchao was born at the outbreak of the Korean War, his parents named him 'Yuanchao' (aid Korea), which was later changed to 'Yuanchao' (source tide).

description.zh-cn: 胡耀邦接受陈丕显的举荐，任命李源潮为共青团上海市委副书记。
description.en: Hu Yaobang accepted Chen Pixian's recommendation and appointed Li Yuanchao as Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Youth League.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮卸任中华人民共和国副主席，由王岐山接任。
description.en: Li Yuanchao stepped down as Vice President of the People's Republic of China and was succeeded by Wang Qishan.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮接替贺国强出任中共中央组织部部长。
description.en: Li Yuanchao succeeded He Guoqiang as Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮卸任中共中央组织部部长，由赵乐际接任。
description.en: Li Yuanchao stepped down as Head of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and was succeeded by Zhao Leji.

description.zh-cn: 在江苏任职期间，李源潮处理了2007年太湖蓝藻污染事件，表示“只要能把太湖治理好，哪怕GDP下降15%”，并推动了相关环保措施。
description.en: During his tenure in Jiangsu, Li Yuanchao handled the 2007 Lake Taihu algae bloom crisis, stating, 'As long as we can manage Lake Tai, even if GDP drops by 15%,' and promoted relevant environmental protection measures.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共江苏省委书记李源潮在南京会见时任中国国民党主席连战。
description.en: Li Yuanchao, then Party Secretary of Jiangsu, met with Lien Chan, then Chairman of the Kuomintang, in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共江苏省委书记李源潮在南京会见时任亲民党主席宋楚瑜。
description.en: Li Yuanchao, then Party Secretary of Jiangsu, met with James Soong, then Chairman of the People First Party, in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 时任中共江苏省委书记李源潮在南京会见时任新党主席郁慕明。
description.en: Li Yuanchao, then Party Secretary of Jiangsu, met with Yok Mu-ming, then Chairman of the New Party, in Nanjing.

description.zh-cn: 李源潮与厉以宁、孟晓苏、李克强合著《走向繁荣的战略选择》。
description.en: Li Yuanchao co-authored 'The Strategic Choice for China’s Prosperity' with Li Yining, Meng Xiaosu, and Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 厉以宁与李源潮、孟晓苏、李克强合著《走向繁荣的战略选择》。
description.en: Li Yining co-authored 'The Strategic Choice for China’s Prosperity' with Li Yuanchao, Meng Xiaosu, and Li Keqiang.

description.zh-cn: 李克强与厉以宁、孟晓苏、李源潮合著《走向繁荣的战略选择》。
description.en: Li Keqiang co-authored 'The Strategic Choice for China’s Prosperity' with Li Yining, Meng Xiaosu, and Li Yuanchao.

description.zh-cn: 黎明是A Music的创始人之一，并作为旗下艺人。
description.en: Leon Lai is one of the founders of A Music and is also an artist under the label.

description.zh-cn: 委任黎明为全球首个华人国际爱心大使，后于1995年晋升为国际青年特使。
description.en: Appointed Leon Lai as the first-ever Chinese International Goodwill Ambassador, and he was promoted to International Young Envoy in 1995.

description.zh-cn: 因生病、迟到等缘故，黎明被指工作态度欠佳而遭到无线电视雪藏。
description.en: Due to illness and lateness, Leon Lai was accused of having a poor work attitude and was subsequently put on hold by TVB.

description.zh-cn: 这部电影使黎明的演技获得观众和影评人的广泛认同，被视为其演艺事业的重要分水岭，并让他首次获得香港电影金像奖最佳男主角提名。
description.en: This film earned Leon Lai widespread recognition from audiences and critics for his acting, is considered a major turning point in his career, and garnered him his first nomination for Best Actor at the Hong Kong Film Awards.

description.zh-cn: 黎明凭借在此片中的演出，获得了第39届金马奖最佳男主角。
description.en: For his performance in this film, Leon Lai won the Best Leading Actor award at the 39th Golden Horse Awards.

description.zh-cn: 前韩国总统卢武铉在清华大学的演讲中提及黎明是在韩国家喻户晓的艺人，这反映了黎明在韩国的文化影响力。
description.en: Former South Korean President Roh Moo-hyun mentioned in a speech at Tsinghua University that Leon Lai was a household name in South Korea, reflecting Lai's cultural influence in the country.

description.zh-cn: 黎明首次执导电影《抢红》，并参与剧本创作、演员选角等幕后工作。
description.en: Leon Lai directed the film 'Wine War' for the first time, and was also involved in behind-the-scenes work such as screenwriting and casting.

description.zh-cn: 王近山于1932年加入中国共产党。1964年因离婚问题被开除党籍，1968年恢复党籍。
description.en: Wang Jinshan joined the Communist Party of China in 1932. He was expelled from the party in 1964 over his divorce and his membership was restored in 1968.

description.zh-cn: 王近山出生于湖北省黄安县。
description.en: Wang Jinshan was born in Huang'an County, Hubei Province.

description.zh-cn: 王近山是小说《亮剑》中主角李云龙的人物原型之一。
description.en: Wang Jinshan is one of the real-life prototypes for Li Yunlong, the protagonist in the novel 'Drawing Sword'.

description.zh-cn: 1930年3月参加中国工农红军。
description.en: Joined the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army in March 1930.

description.zh-cn: 曾历任红四军第十师的班长、排长、连长、营长、团长，至1935年9月升任副师长。
description.en: Served successively as squad leader, platoon leader, company commander, battalion commander, and regiment commander in the 10th Division of the Fourth Red Army, rising to Deputy Division Commander by September 1935.

description.zh-cn: 抗日战争爆发后，在八路军一二九师任职，至1942年5月升任三八六旅旅长。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Second Sino-Japanese War, he served in the 129th Division of the Eighth Route Army, becoming commander of the 386th Brigade in May 1942.

description.zh-cn: 国共内战期间，他先后担任晋冀鲁豫野战军和中原野战军第六纵队司令员，后任第三兵团副司令员。
description.en: During the Chinese Civil War, he successively served as commander of the 6th Column in both the Shanxi-Hebei-Shandong-Henan Field Army and the Central Plains Field Army, later becoming Deputy Commander of the 3rd Army Group.

description.zh-cn: 在上甘岭战役中，第十二军由王近山指挥。
description.en: During the Battle of Triangle Hill, the 12th Army was under the command of Wang Jinshan.

description.zh-cn: 在上甘岭战役中，第十五军由王近山指挥。
description.en: During the Battle of Triangle Hill, the 15th Army was under the command of Wang Jinshan.

description.zh-cn: 由于离婚事件被作为典型处理，王近山于1964年被撤销职务，降为大校，并被开除党籍，下放到农场。
description.en: As his divorce case was treated as a negative example, Wang Jinshan was dismissed from his posts, demoted to senior colonel, expelled from the Party, and sent down to a farm in 1964.

description.zh-cn: 在王近山写信承认错误后，毛泽东批示使其恢复副兵团级待遇并重新任职。
description.en: After Wang Jinshan wrote a letter admitting his mistakes, Mao Zedong approved his rehabilitation, restoring his deputy army group commander-level treatment and appointing him to a new post.

description.zh-cn: 1948年夏，作为中原野战军领导人一同合影。
description.en: In the summer of 1948, they were photographed together as leaders of the Central Plains Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 1948年夏，作为中原野战军领导人一同合影。
description.en: In the summer of 1948, they were photographed together as leaders of the Central Plains Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1916年11月19日出生于当时的河北省南乐县。
description.en: Tie Ying was born in Nanle County, then part of Hebei Province, on November 19, 1916.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1937年12月加入中国共产党。
description.en: Tie Ying joined the Communist Party of China in December 1937.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1979年12月至1983年4月担任浙江省人民代表大会常务委员会主任。
description.en: Tie Ying served as the Director of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress from December 1979 to April 1983.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1977年12月至1979年12月担任中国人民政治协商会议浙江省委员会主席。
description.en: Tie Ying served as the Chairman of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference from December 1977 to December 1979.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1977年2月至1983年3月担任中共浙江省委书记（后为第一书记）。
description.en: Tie Ying served as the Secretary (later First Secretary) of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee from February 1977 to March 1983.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1977年2月至1979年12月担任浙江省省长（时称浙江省革命委员会主任）。
description.en: Tie Ying served as the Governor of Zhejiang Province (then titled Director of the Zhejiang Provincial Revolutionary Committee) from February 1977 to December 1979.

description.zh-cn: 自1972年起，铁瑛担任浙江省军区第一政委。
description.en: Since 1972, Tie Ying served as the First Political Commissar of the Zhejiang Military District.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛曾任抗日军政大学一分校一大队组织干事。
description.en: Tie Ying served as an Organization Officer in the First Brigade of the First Branch of the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University.

position.zh-cn: 组织股长兼党分总支书记
position.en: Organization Section Chief and concurrent Party Branch Secretary

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛曾任八路军山东纵队一支队二团组织股长兼党分总支书记。
description.en: Tie Ying served as the Organization Section Chief and concurrent Party Branch Secretary of the Second Regiment, First Detachment, Shandong Column of the Eighth Route Army.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛在中共十三大上当选为中顾委委员。
description.en: Tie Ying was elected as a member of the Central Advisory Commission at the 13th National Congress of the CPC.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛于1937年10月参加革命工作，参与了中国抗日战争。
description.en: Tie Ying joined the revolutionary work in October 1937 and participated in the Second Sino-Japanese War.

description.zh-cn: 铁瑛参与了第二次国共内战。
description.en: Tie Ying participated in the Second Chinese Civil War.

description.zh-cn: 谭启龙是铁瑛的前任中共浙江省委书记和浙江省省长。
description.en: Tan Qilong was Tie Ying's predecessor as both Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang.

description.zh-cn: 李丰平是铁瑛的继任浙江省省长和浙江省人大常委会主任。
description.en: Li Fengping was Tie Ying's successor as both Governor of Zhejiang and Director of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 江华是铁瑛的前任浙江省政协主席。
description.en: Jiang Hua was Tie Ying's predecessor as Chairman of the Zhejiang Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 毛齐华是铁瑛的继任浙江省政协主席。
description.en: Mao Qihua was Tie Ying's successor as Chairman of the Zhejiang Provincial CPPCC.

description.zh-cn: 王芳是铁瑛的继任中共浙江省委书记。
description.en: Wang Fang was Tie Ying's successor as Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee.

description.zh-cn: 根据信息框，娄底市人民政府的业务上级是湖南省人民政府。
description.en: According to the infobox, the operational superior of the Loudi Municipal People's Government is the Hunan Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 1982年12月11日，涟源地区更名为娄底地区。
description.en: On December 11, 1982, Lianyuan Prefecture was renamed to Loudi Prefecture.

description.zh-cn: 1980年7月15日，中华人民共和国国务院批准恢复娄底市（县级）建制，同年11月27日成立娄底市人民政府。
description.en: On July 15, 1980, the State Council of the People's Republic of China approved the re-establishment of the county-level Loudi City, and the Loudi Municipal People's Government was established on November 27 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 1983年7月13日，国务院决定恢复娄底地区及其行政公署。
description.en: On July 13, 1983, the State Council decided to restore Loudi Prefecture and its administrative office.

description.zh-cn: 福建省生态环境厅受中华人民共和国环境保护部的业务指导。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment receives professional guidance from the Ministry of Environmental Protection of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 福建省生态环境厅是福建省人民政府的组织下级机构。
description.en: The Fujian Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment is an organizational subordinate of the Fujian Provincial People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 朱文祥自2017年起担任中国人民武装警察部队第一机动总队司令员。
description.en: Zhu Wenxiang has served as the Commander of the PAP First Mobile Corps since 2017.

description.zh-cn: 2017年，原武警第六十三师、第八十一师、第一一四师、第一一七师、第一二〇师、第一二八师和第一八七师在武警部队调整改革中，被调整组建为中国人民武装警察部队第一机动总队的一部分。
description.en: In 2017, during the reform of the PAP, the former PAP 63rd Division, 81st Division, 114th Division, 117th Division, 120th Division, 128th Division, and 187th Division were reorganized as part of the PAP First Mobile Corps.

description.zh-cn: 2017年，原武警交通部队在武警部队调整改革中被撤销，其人员与机动师等一同调整组建为中国人民武装警察部队第一机动总队。
description.en: In 2017, during the reform of the PAP, the former PAP Transportation Force was disbanded, and its personnel were reorganized along with mobile divisions into the PAP First Mobile Corps.

description.zh-cn: 乌鲁木齐七五事件发生后，武警第一八七师作为第一支援疆的外援部队，被紧急空运至新疆协助维持治安，以平息骚乱。
description.en: After the July 2009 Ürümqi riots, the PAP 187th Division, as the first external support unit, was urgently airlifted to Xinjiang to help maintain public order and quell the unrest.

description.zh-cn: 2014年4月23日，南方电视台与南方广播影视传媒集团、广东人民广播电台等机构整合组建为广东广播电视台。
description.en: On April 23, 2014, Southern Television was integrated with Southern Media Corporation, Guangdong People's Radio, and other institutions to form Guangdong Radio and Television.

description.zh-cn: 广东广播电视台是广东省人民政府直属事业单位。
description.en: Guangdong Radio and Television is a public institution directly under The People's Government of Guangdong Province.

description.zh-cn: 于2013年12月25日批复了《关于广东广播电视台组建方案》的报告，推动了其成立。
description.en: On December 25, 2013, it approved the report on the formation plan of Guangdong Radio and Television, promoting its establishment.

description.zh-cn: 2001年7月1日，广东经济电视台与广东有线广播电视台重整为南方电视台。
description.en: On July 1, 2001, Guangdong Economic Television and Guangdong Cable Radio and Television were reorganized to form Southern Television.

description.zh-cn: 2001年7月1日，广东有线广播电视台与广东经济电视台重整为南方电视台。
description.en: On July 1, 2001, Guangdong Cable Radio and Television and Guangdong Economic Television were reorganized to form Southern Television.

description.zh-cn: 经济科教频道的运营由南方财经全媒体集团管辖。
description.en: The operation of the Economy, Science & Education Channel is under the jurisdiction of Southern Finance Omnimedia Corp.

description.zh-cn: 为与香港电视竞争，广东电视台于1988年2月14日开始进行节目改革。
description.en: In order to compete with Hong Kong television, Guangdong Television began program reforms on February 14, 1988.

description.zh-cn: 广州电视台在筹建时行政上隶属于广东电台，直至1981年7月独立建制。
description.en: During its preparatory phase, Guangzhou Television was administratively subordinate to Guangdong Radio until it became an independent entity in July 1981.

description.zh-cn: 广州电视台于1979年1月1日改呼号为广东电视台。
description.en: Guangzhou Television changed its call sign to Guangdong Television on January 1, 1979.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家男子篮球队是代表中华人民共和国出战各项国际赛事的篮球队。
description.en: The China men's national basketball team represents the People's Republic of China in various international competitions.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家男子篮球队由中国篮球协会管理。
description.en: The China men's national basketball team is managed by the Chinese Basketball Association.

description.zh-cn: 中国国家男子篮球队于1974年加入亚洲篮球协会。
description.en: The China men's national basketball team joined FIBA Asia in 1974.

description.zh-cn: 郭士强曾担任中国国家男子篮球队主教练，是现任教练。
description.en: Guo Shiqiang previously served as and is the current head coach of the China men's national basketball team.

description.zh-cn: 姚明是中国男篮巅峰时期的核心球员，直到2011年7月宣布退役。
description.en: Yao Ming was a core player for the Chinese national team during its peak period until he announced his retirement in July 2011.

description.zh-cn: 王治郅因与中国篮协的矛盾，在2002年至2006年期间没有参加国家队的比赛。
description.en: Due to conflicts with the Chinese Basketball Association, Wang Zhizhi did not play for the national team from 2002 to 2006.

description.zh-cn: 2018年9月26日，李楠被聘任为中国男篮主教练，备战2019年世界杯和2020年东京奥运会。
description.en: On September 26, 2018, Li Nan was appointed as the head coach of the Chinese men's national basketball team to prepare for the 2019 World Cup and the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

description.zh-cn: 2017年，杜锋执教国家男篮拆分后的蓝队。
description.en: In 2017, Du Feng coached the Blue Team after the national team was split.

description.zh-cn: 在2019年世界杯对阵波兰的比赛中，周琦的致命传球失误导致中国队输掉比赛，葬送了领先优势。
description.en: In the 2019 World Cup match against Poland, Zhou Qi's fatal turnover led to China's defeat, squandering their lead.

description.zh-cn: 中国队在2019年世界杯中表现不佳，排位赛成绩落后于伊朗队，首次无法直接晋级奥运会。
description.en: China's poor performance in the 2019 World Cup, finishing behind Iran in the classification round, resulted in their failure to directly qualify for the Olympics for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 中国队在2023年世界杯中错失2024年巴黎奥运会男篮比赛资格。
description.en: The Chinese team failed to qualify for the 2024 Paris Olympics men's basketball tournament at the 2023 World Cup.

description.zh-cn: 韩国队是中国男篮在亚洲赛场上的主要竞争对手，曾在1997年亚锦赛和2002年亚运会击败中国队。
description.en: The South Korean team is a major rival of the Chinese team in Asian competitions, having defeated China in the 1997 Asian Championship and the 2002 Asian Games.

description.zh-cn: 伊朗队在2009年亚锦赛决赛中惨败中国队，成为中国队在西亚的强有力挑战者。
description.en: Iran defeated China heavily in the 2009 FIBA Asia Championship final, becoming a strong challenger to China in West Asia.

description.zh-cn: 在2013年菲律宾男篮亚锦赛四分之一决赛中，中国男篮首次负于中华台北队，创下自1975年以来的最差战绩。
description.en: In the quarterfinals of the 2013 FIBA Asia Championship in the Philippines, the Chinese men's team lost to Chinese Taipei for the first time, marking their worst record since 1975.

description.zh-cn: 在2019年世界杯小组赛中，波兰队在加时赛中击败中国队。
description.en: In the 2019 World Cup group stage, Poland defeated China in overtime.

description.zh-cn: 2019年世界杯后，中国中央电视台罕见点名批评周琦等人不具备与世界强队掰手腕的能力。
description.en: After the 2019 World Cup, China Central Television unusually singled out Zhou Qi and others for criticism, stating they lacked the ability to compete with world-class teams.

description.zh-cn: 2019年世界杯后，中国中央电视台罕见点名批评郭艾伦等人不具备与世界强队掰手腕的能力。
description.en: After the 2019 World Cup, China Central Television unusually singled out Guo Ailun and others for criticism, stating they lacked the ability to compete with world-class teams.

description.zh-cn: 2019年世界杯后，中国中央电视台罕见点名批评王哲林等人不具备与世界强队掰手腕的能力。
description.en: After the 2019 World Cup, China Central Television unusually singled out Wang Zhelin and others for criticism, stating they lacked the ability to compete with world-class teams.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思于1847年撰写并出版了《哲学的贫困》。
description.en: Karl Marx wrote and published 'The Poverty of Philosophy' in 1847.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思撰写《哲学的贫困》以批判皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东的观点，标志着两人思想上的对立。
description.en: Karl Marx wrote 'The Poverty of Philosophy' to criticize Pierre-Joseph Proudhon's views, marking their ideological opposition.

description.zh-cn: 文本描述皮埃尔-约瑟夫·蒲鲁东为法国无政府主义者。
description.en: The text describes Pierre-Joseph Proudhon as a French anarchist.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思在1843年至1849年流亡期间，曾居住于巴黎。
description.en: Karl Marx lived in Paris during his exile period from 1843 to 1849.

description.zh-cn: 卡尔·马克思在1843年至1849年流亡期间，曾居住于布鲁塞尔。
description.en: Karl Marx lived in Brussels during his exile period from 1843 to 1849.

description.zh-cn: 王文章毕业于山东大学中文系。
description.en: Wang Wenzhang graduated from the Chinese Department of Shandong University.

position.zh-cn: 第十一届全国委员会委员

description.zh-cn: 代表文化艺术界，分入第二十八组。
description.en: Representing the cultural and art circles, assigned to the 28th group.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类信息，王文章是中国戏剧家协会会员。
description.en: According to page category information, Wang Wenzhang is a member of the China Theatre Association.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一是朱四九的长子。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi was the eldest son of Zhu Sijiu.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一是恒皇后侯氏之子。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi was the son of Empress Heng (née Hou).

description.zh-cn: 朱初一的配偶是王氏，后被追尊为裕皇后。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi's spouse was Lady Wang, who was posthumously honored as Empress Yu.

description.zh-cn: 朱五一是朱初一的长子。
description.en: Zhu Wuyi was the eldest son of Zhu Chuyi.

description.zh-cn: 朱世珍是朱初一的第四子。
description.en: Zhu Shizhen was the fourth son of Zhu Chuyi.

description.zh-cn: 朱元璋是朱世珍之子。
description.en: Zhu Yuanzhang was the son of Zhu Shizhen.

description.zh-cn: 1363年，韩林儿政权追赠朱初一为光禄大夫、江南等处行中书省平章政事、柱国、司空、吴国公。
description.en: In 1363, the regime of Han Lin'er posthumously honored Zhu Chuyi with the titles of Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, Manager of Governmental Affairs of the Branch Secretariat for Jiangnan and other areas, Pillar of State, Minister of Works, and Duke of Wu.

description.zh-cn: 1368年朱元璋建立明朝后，追尊其祖父朱初一为裕皇帝，庙号熙祖。
description.en: After founding the Ming Dynasty in 1368, Zhu Yuanzhang posthumously honored his grandfather Zhu Chuyi as Emperor Yu with the temple name Xizu.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一于1256年出生于句容。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi was born in Jurong in 1256.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一迁居至泗州。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi moved his residence to Sizhou.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一迁居至盱眙。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi moved his residence to Xuyi.

description.zh-cn: 朱初一的陵墓是明祖陵。
description.en: Zhu Chuyi's mausoleum is the Ming Zuling.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗临终前召见信王朱由检，传位于他。
description.en: Before his death, the Tianqi Emperor summoned Prince Xin (Zhu Youjian) and designated him as his successor.

description.zh-cn: 崇祯帝即位后，亲自将明熹宗的谥号由“哲皇帝”改为“悊皇帝”。
description.en: After ascending the throne, the Chongzhen Emperor personally changed the Tianqi Emperor's posthumous title from 'Zhe Huangdi' to 'Zhé Huangdi'.

description.zh-cn: 客氏是明熹宗的乳母，因“青宫旧劳”而极得熹宗宠信，对熹宗有极大的影响力。
description.en: Madam Ke was the Tianqi Emperor's wet nurse. Due to her 'old service in the crown prince's palace,' she was deeply trusted and had immense influence over the emperor.

description.zh-cn: 魏忠贤与客氏结交，两人狼狈为奸，共同把持朝政，迫害异己。
description.en: Wei Zhongxian and Madam Ke colluded, working together to control the court and persecute their opponents.

description.zh-cn: 在杨涟等人弹劾后，魏忠贤痛恨东林党人，并利用权势对东林党人进行大规模的残酷迫害和镇压。
description.en: After being impeached by Yang Lian and others, Wei Zhongxian developed a deep hatred for the Donglin Party and used his power to carry out large-scale, brutal persecution and suppression against them.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗在位早期任用东林党人主政，形成了“众正盈朝”的局面。
description.en: In the early part of his reign, the Tianqi Emperor appointed Donglin Party members to lead the government, creating a situation where 'the court was filled with upright officials'.

description.zh-cn: 在移宫案中，左光斗与杨涟等东林党人一起，坚决反对李选侍（李康妃）干预朝政，迫使其移出乾清宫。
description.en: During the Palace Removal Case, Zuo Guangdou, along with Yang Lian and other Donglin Party members, resolutely opposed Consort Li's interference in politics, forcing her to move out of the Qianqing Palace.

description.zh-cn: 辽东经略熊廷弼与巡抚王化贞互相倾轧，“经抚不和”，导致军机失宜，最终引发广宁兵败。
description.en: Liaodong Military Commissioner Xiong Tingbi and Governor Wang Huazhen were in constant conflict, leading to strategic errors and ultimately the defeat at Guangning.

description.zh-cn: 在广宁兵败后，明熹宗采纳东林党人建议，提拔自己的老师孙承宗为兵部尚书，督师辽东。
description.en: After the defeat at Guangning, the Tianqi Emperor took the advice of Donglin Party members and promoted his tutor Sun Chengzong to Minister of War to supervise the Liaodong military.

description.zh-cn: 王恭厂大爆炸被视为天怒人怨的征兆，明熹宗为此下了罪己诏，并拨发内帑一万两赈灾。
description.en: The Wang Gongchang Explosion was seen as a sign of divine wrath and popular discontent, prompting the Tianqi Emperor to issue an edict of self-blame and allocate 10,000 taels of silver from his private treasury for disaster relief.

description.zh-cn: 王恭厂大爆炸在“天人感应”思想下使阉党承受了巨大的政治压力，并诱发了其内部分裂。
description.en: Under the belief of 'interaction between heaven and humanity', the Wang Gongchang Explosion placed immense political pressure on the Eunuch Faction and triggered internal divisions.

description.zh-cn: 明熹宗的献怀太子朱慈炅在王恭厂大爆炸中受到惊吓而死。
description.en: The Tianqi Emperor's son, Crown Prince Xianhuai Zhu Cijiong, died from shock during the Wang Gongchang Explosion.

description.zh-cn: 在明熹宗病重时，尚书霍维华向其进献“灵露饮”，熹宗服用后病情加剧，浑身浮肿。
description.en: When the Tianqi Emperor was critically ill, Minister Huo Weihua presented him with the 'Immortal Dew Drink'. After consuming it, the emperor's condition worsened, and his body became swollen.

description.zh-cn: 胤礽于雍正二年病逝后，雍正帝追封其为和硕理密亲王。
description.en: After Yunreng died of illness in the second year of the Yongzheng reign, the Yongzheng Emperor posthumously granted him the title of Prince Limi of the First Rank.

description.zh-cn: 胤礽六岁时，康熙帝令名儒张英担任其师傅。
description.en: When Yunreng was six years old, the Kangxi Emperor appointed the renowned scholar Zhang Ying as his tutor.

description.zh-cn: 胤礽六岁时，康熙帝令名儒李光地担任其师傅。
description.en: When Yunreng was six years old, the Kangxi Emperor appointed the renowned scholar Li Guangdi as his tutor.

description.zh-cn: 康熙帝令熊赐履为胤礽教授理学诸书。
description.en: The Kangxi Emperor ordered Xiong Cili to teach Yunreng various Neo-Confucian texts.

description.zh-cn: 康熙二十五年，康熙帝任命理学家汤斌为詹事，教导太子胤礽。
description.en: In 1686, the Kangxi Emperor appointed the Neo-Confucian scholar Tang Bin as Expositor to educate Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 康熙二十五年，康熙帝任命耿介为少詹事，教导太子胤礽。
description.en: In 1686, the Kangxi Emperor appointed Geng Jie as Junior Expositor to educate Crown Prince Yunreng.

description.zh-cn: 法国传教士白晋在其著作《中国皇帝康熙传》中称赞时年23岁的胤礽是一个十全完美的皇太子，并相信他未来能成为像其父一样的伟大皇帝。
description.en: In his work 'Portrait historique de l'empereur de la Chine', the French missionary Joachim Bouvet praised the 23-year-old Yunreng as a flawless crown prince, believing he would one day become a great emperor like his father.

description.zh-cn: 胤礽曾两度被立为清朝皇太子。
description.en: Yunreng was twice installed as the Crown Prince of the Qing dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 胤礽出生于北京紫禁城。
description.en: Yunreng was born in the Forbidden City, Beijing.

description.zh-cn: 俞百巍是俞应麓之子。
description.en: Yu Baiwei is the son of Yu Yinglu.

description.zh-cn: 俞百巍是江西广丰人。
description.en: Yu Baiwei was from Guangfeng, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 1944年毕业于福建协和大学西洋文学系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Western Literature at Fukien Christian University in 1944.

description.zh-cn: 1948年毕业于香港达德学院文哲系。
description.en: Graduated from the Department of Literature and Philosophy at Hong Kong Tat Tak College in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 1948年加入中国共产党。
description.en: Joined the Communist Party of China in 1948.

description.zh-cn: 根据页面分类，俞百巍是中国戏剧家协会会员。
description.en: According to the page category, Yu Baiwei was a member of the China Theatre Association.

description.zh-cn: 俞百巍为主改编、创作了黔剧剧目《奢香夫人》。
description.en: Yu Baiwei was the main adapter and creator of the Qian opera play 'Madame Shexiang'.

description.zh-cn: 定武军是张勋发动的复辟政变的军事主力。
宗社党是支持清室的政治团体，是张勋复辟的策划和支持力量。
铁良作为宗社党的重要成员，与张勋共同策划了复辟政变。
张勋发动复辟政变，推翻了黎元洪的中华民国大总统职位，导致其倒台并前往日本使馆寻求庇护。
在府院之争的困局下，大总统黎元洪电令张勋入京调停，此举为张勋率兵进入北京发动政变提供了直接机会。
冯国璋在南京通电全国，反对复辟，并于7月6日就任代理总统，与讨逆军形成南北夹击之势。
孙中山在广州发表《讨逆宣言》，号召革命党人起兵讨伐张勋。
张勋复辟失败后，段祺瑞以“再造共和”为名，拒绝恢复《中华民国临时约法》和国会，这一行为直接引发了孙中山等人的护法运动。
在张勋复辟期间，溥仪短暂恢复了清朝皇帝的身份。
段祺瑞是皖系军阀的领导者。
皖系军阀是组织和构成讨逆军的核心力量。
以冯国璋为首的直系军阀参与了讨伐张勋的军事联盟。
根据苏锡麟等人的证言，段祺瑞派心腹徐树铮等人劝说并假意支持张勋入京复辟，目的是借张勋之手推翻总统黎元洪，以便自己重掌大权，显示出段祺瑞在此事件中存在幕后操纵行为。
根据苏锡麟等人的证言，冯国璋派心腹胡嗣瑗前往徐州，与其他督军代表一同假意同意张勋的复辟计划，以利用张勋达到推翻黎元洪的政治目的。

position.en: Governor of Fengtian, Viceroy of the Three Northeast Provinces

description.zh-cn: 张作霖在复辟期间被清廷授予奉天巡抚和东三省总督的职位。
黄名鑫是江西广昌人。
description.en: Huang Mingxin was a native of Guangchang, Jiangxi.

description.zh-cn: 黄名鑫曾任中共江西省纪委副书记。
description.en: Huang Mingxin served as Deputy Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the CCP.

description.zh-cn: 黄名鑫曾任江西省人大常委会副主任。
description.en: Huang Mingxin served as Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 黄名鑫是江西冶金学院（现江西理工大学）的校友。
description.en: Huang Mingxin was an alumnus of Jiangxi Institute of Metallurgy (now Jiangxi University of Science and Technology).

description.zh-cn: 黄名鑫是中国共产党党员。
description.en: Huang Mingxin was a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫是苏联唯一一任总统，于1991年12月25日宣布辞职。
description.en: Mikhail Gorbachev was the one and only President of the Soviet Union, and he announced his resignation on December 25, 1991.

position.en: General Secretary of the Central Committee

description.zh-cn: 在八一九事件失败后，戈尔巴乔夫于1991年8月24日辞去苏共中央总书记职务。
description.en: After the failure of the August Coup, Gorbachev resigned from his position as General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee on August 24, 1991.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫上台后，推行了以“新思维”为代表的改革政策。
description.en: After coming to power, Gorbachev implemented reform policies represented by 'New Thinking'.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫的改革带来了意想不到的后果，随着中央权力的下放和“公开化”的深入，各加盟共和国寻求更大的自主权并最终独立，加速了苏联解体。
description.en: Gorbachev's reforms led to unintended consequences. As central power was devolved and 'Glasnost' deepened, constituent republics sought greater autonomy and eventual independence, accelerating the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

description.zh-cn: 时任苏联副总统根纳季·亚纳耶夫是发动八一九事件的苏共保守派领导人之一。
description.en: Then-Vice President of the Soviet Union Gennady Yanayev was one of the leaders of the CPSU hardliners who launched the August Coup.

description.zh-cn: 作为俄罗斯民选总统，叶利钦与苏联总统戈尔巴乔夫在权力上形成竞争和对抗关系。在苏联解体的最后阶段，叶利钦通过抵制政变和主导独联体成立，最终取代了戈尔巴乔夫的权力地位。
description.en: As the elected president of Russia, Yeltsin was in a competitive and confrontational power relationship with Soviet President Gorbachev. In the final stages of the Soviet dissolution, Yeltsin ultimately superseded Gorbachev's authority by resisting the coup and leading the establishment of the CIS.

description.zh-cn: 戈尔巴乔夫宣布辞去苏联总统职务，并将国家权力及核按钮移交给俄罗斯总统叶利钦。
description.en: Gorbachev announced his resignation as President of the Soviet Union and transferred state power and the nuclear briefcase to Russian President Yeltsin.

description.zh-cn: 苏联的解体标志着两极格局的结束，从而终结了持续近半个世纪的冷战。
description.en: The dissolution of the Soviet Union marked the end of the bipolar world order, thus ending the Cold War that had lasted for nearly half a century.

description.zh-cn: 随着苏联的解体，美国成为世界上唯一的超级大国。
description.en: With the dissolution of the Soviet Union, the United States became the world's sole superpower.

description.zh-cn: 切尔诺贝利核事故造成了巨大的经济负担，并严重动摇了民众对苏联政府的信任，从而对苏联的国家稳定和存续构成了打击。
description.en: The Chernobyl disaster caused a huge economic burden and severely eroded public trust in the Soviet government, thereby dealing a blow to the stability and existence of the Soviet state.

description.zh-cn: 立陶宛于1990年3月11日率先宣布独立，开启了各加盟共和国脱离苏联的“主权游行”，对苏联的最终解体起到了重要的推动作用。
description.en: Lithuania was the first to declare independence on March 11, 1990, initiating the 'Parade of Sovereignties' where other constituent republics broke away from the Soviet Union, playing a significant role in pushing forward its final dissolution.

description.zh-cn: 苏联最高苏维埃于1991年12月26日通过决议，宣布苏联停止存在，从法律上终结了苏联。
description.en: On December 26, 1991, the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union passed a resolution declaring the cessation of the Soviet Union's existence, legally terminating the USSR.

description.zh-cn: 北京航空学院组建时并入了四川大学的相关专业。
description.en: Related departments from Sichuan University were merged into the Beijing Institute of Aeronautics upon its establishment.

description.zh-cn: 北京航空学院组建时并入了北京工业学院的相关专业，并在其旧礼堂举行了成立大会。
description.en: Related departments from the Beijing Institute of Technology were merged into the Beijing Institute of Aeronautics upon its establishment, and its founding ceremony was held in the former's auditorium.

description.zh-cn: 时任副总理李富春在讨论航空工业建设的会议上提出“急需办一所航空大学”的建议，得到周恩来同意。
description.en: Then-Vice Premier Li Fuchun proposed the 'urgent need to establish an aeronautical university' during a meeting on the development of the aviation industry, which was approved by Zhou Enlai.

description.zh-cn: 1988年4月，经国家教委批准，北京航空学院改名为北京航空航天大学。
description.en: In April 1988, with the approval of the State Education Commission, the Beijing Institute of Aeronautics was renamed Beihang University.

description.zh-cn: 李未在任校长期间，因推动改校名和卷入广西招生丑闻等事件引发争议，对学校声誉造成负面影响。
description.en: During his tenure as president, Li Wei caused controversy over his push to change the university's name and his involvement in the Guangxi admissions scandal, which negatively impacted the university's reputation.

description.zh-cn: 九一一袭击事件促使乔治·沃克·布什政府发动了全球性的反恐战争。
description.en: The September 11 attacks prompted the George W. Bush administration to launch a global War on Terror.

description.zh-cn: 在2004年美国总统选举中击败民主党候选人约翰·克里，成功连任。
description.en: Defeated Democratic candidate John Kerry in the 2004 U.S. presidential election to win re-election.

description.zh-cn: 美国最高法院在“布什诉戈尔案”中的判决，停止了佛罗里达州的重新计票，使得布什赢得了2000年总统选举。
description.en: The U.S. Supreme Court's decision in Bush v. Gore stopped the Florida recount, resulting in George W. Bush winning the 2000 presidential election.

description.zh-cn: 布什上任后积极筹措并签署了“不让任何孩子落后”教育法案。
description.en: After taking office, Bush actively prepared and signed the No Child Left Behind education act.

description.zh-cn: 布什政府撤回了美国对《京都议定书》的支持，并拒绝签署该协议。
description.en: The Bush administration withdrew U.S. support for the Kyoto Protocol and refused to sign it.

description.zh-cn: 2008年12月14日，在伊拉克的一场记者会上，扎伊迪向布什扔掷鞋子以示抗议。
description.en: On December 14, 2008, during a press conference in Iraq, al-Zaidi threw his shoes at Bush in protest.

description.zh-cn: 提名约翰·罗伯茨担任美国最高法院首席大法官。
description.en: Nominated John Roberts to be Chief Justice of the United States Supreme Court.

description.zh-cn: 韩芝俊出生于山西省五台县。
description.en: Han Zhijun was born in Wutai County, Shanxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 韩芝俊是中国共产党党员，曾担任湖南湘潭地委干部。
description.en: Han Zhijun is a member of the Communist Party of China and served as a cadre of the Xiangtan Prefectural Committee in Hunan.

description.zh-cn: 长子
description.en: Eldest son

description.zh-cn: 长子
description.en: Eldest son

description.zh-cn: 长女
description.en: Eldest daughter

description.zh-cn: 长女
description.en: Eldest daughter

description.zh-cn: 次女
description.en: Second daughter

description.zh-cn: 次女
description.en: Second daughter

description.zh-cn: 贞观八年（634年），李大亮举荐李义府补门下省典仪。
description.en: In 634, Li Daliang recommended Li Yifu for the position of Usher in the Chancellery.

description.zh-cn: 刘洎曾极力荐举李义府，使其得以任监察御史。
description.en: Liu Ji strongly recommended Li Yifu, which led to his appointment as an Investigating Censor.

description.zh-cn: 马周曾极力荐举李义府，使其得以任监察御史。
description.en: Ma Zhou strongly recommended Li Yifu, which led to his appointment as an Investigating Censor.

description.zh-cn: 李义府曾奉太子之命参与预撰《晋书》。
description.en: Li Yifu was ordered by the Crown Prince to participate in the compilation of the Book of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 永徽六年（655年），李义府被太尉长孙无忌厌恶。
description.en: In 655, Li Yifu was disliked by the Grand Marshal Zhangsun Wuji.

description.zh-cn: 永徽六年（655年），长孙无忌上疏建言将李义府贬为壁州司马。
description.en: In 655, Zhangsun Wuji submitted a memorial recommending the demotion of Li Yifu to be the Sima of Bizhou.

description.zh-cn: 为求自救，李义府率先支持废王皇后立武则天为皇后。
description.en: In order to save himself, Li Yifu took the lead in supporting the deposition of Empress Wang and the installation of Wu Zetian as empress.

description.zh-cn: 李义府支持废黜王皇后，以武则天取而代之。
description.en: Li Yifu supported the deposition of Empress Wang to be replaced by Wu Zetian.

description.zh-cn: 李义府因支持立武则天为后而得到唐高宗的重视和提拔。
description.en: Because he supported making Wu Zetian the empress, Li Yifu gained the favor and promotion of Emperor Gaozong.

description.zh-cn: 御史王义方因李义府勾结毕正义、私纳情妇一事而上书弹劾他。
description.en: Censor Wang Yifang submitted a memorial to impeach Li Yifu for colluding with Bi Zhengyi and taking a mistress.

description.zh-cn: 由于李义府权势过大，司空李𪟝负责监审其案。
description.en: Due to Li Yifu's great power, Minister of Works Li Ji supervised the trial of his case.

description.zh-cn: 龙朔三年（663年）底，唐高宗下令将李义府全家长流巂州。干封元年（666年），高宗大赦天下，但特别下令长流人不得返还，导致李义府忧愤而死。
description.en: At the end of 663, Emperor Gaozong ordered the exile of Li Yifu's entire family to Cuizhou. In 666, Gaozong granted a general amnesty but specifically excluded those in long-term exile from returning, causing Li Yifu to die of grief and indignation.

description.zh-cn: 武则天以李义府在永徽年间有辅佐之功为由，于692年追赠其扬州大都督，并于701年赐其后裔实封。
description.en: Citing Li Yifu's contributions during the Yonghui era, Wu Zetian posthumously awarded him the title of Grand Area Commander of Yangzhou in 692 and granted his descendants a fief in 701.

description.zh-cn: 李义府在任太子舍人期间，其文名与时任太子司议郎的来济齐名。
description.en: During his tenure as an Attendant to the Crown Prince, Li Yifu's literary reputation was on par with that of Lai Ji, who was then the Remonstrator for the Crown Prince.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国航空工业部是中华人民共和国国务院的组成部门。
description.en: The Ministry of Aviation Industry was a constituent department of the State Council of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中华人民共和国航空工业部的机构类型为国务院组成部门。
description.en: The institutional type of the Ministry of Aviation Industry was a Constituent Department of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 1960年，由第一机械工业部分出成立了负责军事工业等的第三机械工业部。
description.en: In 1960, the Third Ministry of Machine Building, responsible for military industries, was established by being spun off from the First Ministry of Machine Building.

description.zh-cn: 1963年，原第三机械工业部拆分，在其负责航空工业的第四局基础上组建了新的第三机械工业部。
description.en: In 1963, the original Third Ministry of Machine Building was split up, and a new Third Ministry of Machine Building was formed based on its Fourth Bureau, which was responsible for the aviation industry.

description.zh-cn: 1982年，第三机械工业部改名为中华人民共和国航空工业部。
description.en: In 1982, the Third Ministry of Machine Building was renamed the Ministry of Aviation Industry of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 1988年4月，中华人民共和国航空工业部并入新组建的中华人民共和国航空航天工业部。
description.en: In April 1988, the Ministry of Aviation Industry was merged into the newly established Ministry of Aerospace Industry.

description.zh-cn: 2008年，中国航空工业第二集团公司与第一集团公司合并重组为中国航空工业集团公司。
description.en: In 2008, China Aviation Industry Corporation II and I merged and restructured to form the Aviation Industry Corporation of China.

description.zh-cn: 莫文祥是第三机械工业部改名为航空工业部后的首任部长。
description.en: Mo Wenxiang was the first minister after the Third Ministry of Machine Building was renamed the Ministry of Aviation Industry.

description.zh-cn: 李际泰在担任第三机械工业部部长期间，曾兼任北京军区空军司令员。
description.en: While serving as Minister of the Third Ministry of Machine Building, Li Jitai concurrently held the position of Commander of the Beijing Military Region Air Force.

description.zh-cn: 李际泰因被认为与四人帮有牵连而在1977年12月被免职并接受隔离审查。
description.en: In December 1977, Li Jitai was dismissed from his post and placed under isolated investigation due to his alleged connections to the Gang of Four.

description.zh-cn: 陈其美是蒋中正早期的革命导师和盟友，介绍蒋加入了中国同盟会。
description.en: Chen Qimei was an early revolutionary mentor and ally to Chiang Kai-shek, introducing him to the Tongmenghui.

description.zh-cn: 1908年由陈其美介绍加入中国同盟会。
description.en: Joined the Tongmenghui in 1908, introduced by Chen Qimei.

description.zh-cn: 1908年春至1910年底，在东京振武学校学习军事。
description.en: From spring 1908 to the end of 1910, he studied military science at the Tokyo Shimbun Gakko.

description.zh-cn: 陈炯明发动武装政变，炮轰总统府，导致孙中山避往永丰舰。
description.en: Chen Jiongming launched an armed coup, bombarding the Presidential Palace, forcing Sun Yat-sen to take refuge on the warship Yongfeng.

description.zh-cn: 在陈炯明事件中，蒋中正赶赴永丰舰协助孙中山，赢得了孙的绝对信任和重用。
description.en: During the Chen Jiongming Incident, Chiang Kai-shek rushed to the Yongfeng warship to assist Sun Yat-sen, winning Sun's absolute trust and reliance.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正利用中山舰事件，打击了中国共产党和国民党左派，巩固了个人在党内的军事和政治权力。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek used the Zhongshan Warship Incident to suppress the Communist Party and the KMT left-wing, consolidating his military and political power within the party.

description.zh-cn: 在九一八事变后，蒋中正制定并推行“攘外必先安内”的国策，优先清剿国内的共产党势力。
description.en: After the Mukden Incident, Chiang Kai-shek formulated and implemented the national policy of 'first internal pacification, then external resistance,' prioritizing the suppression of domestic Communist forces.

description.zh-cn: 与张学良共同发动西安事变，扣押了蒋中正。
description.en: Along with Zhang Xueliang, launched the Xi'an Incident, detaining Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 在第二次国共内战中，蒋中正领导的国民党军队最终战败，导致其领导的中华民国政府退守台湾。
description.en: In the Second Chinese Civil War, the Nationalist forces led by Chiang Kai-shek were ultimately defeated, forcing the Republic of China government under his leadership to retreat to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正迁台后，为巩固统治，实行长期戒严，主导了对政治异见者的大规模镇压，即“白色恐怖”时期。
description.en: After retreating to Taiwan, Chiang Kai-shek imposed long-term martial law to consolidate his rule, leading the large-scale suppression of political dissidents known as the 'White Terror' period.

description.zh-cn: 朝鲜战争爆发后，美国出于冷战战略需要，派遣第七舰队协防台湾，使蒋中正在台湾的政权得以免受军事攻击并获得美援，从而得以稳固。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Korean War, the United States, for Cold War strategic reasons, dispatched the Seventh Fleet to help defend Taiwan. This protected Chiang Kai-shek's regime from military attack and secured US aid, thus stabilizing it.

description.zh-cn: 在朝鲜战争爆发后，蒋中正政府与美国建立军事同盟关系，并签订《中美共同防御条约》，在冷战期间获得美国的大力支持。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Korean War, Chiang Kai-shek's government established a military alliance with the United States, signing the Sino-American Mutual Defense Treaty and receiving significant US support during the Cold War.

description.zh-cn: 蒋中正于1948年当选为中华民国第一任总统，后因国共内战失利下野。1950年在台湾复职，并连任四届，直至1975年去世。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek was elected the first President of the Republic of China in 1948, but stepped down after setbacks in the Chinese Civil War. He resumed office in Taiwan in 1950 and was re-elected for four consecutive terms until his death in 1975.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王是周考王之子。
description.en: King Weilie of Zhou was the son of King Kao of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 周安王是周威烈王之子。
description.en: King An of Zhou was the son of King Weilie of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 周考王是周贞定王之子。
description.en: King Kao of Zhou was the son of King Zhending of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 周贞定王是周元王之子。
description.en: King Zhending of Zhou was the son of King Yuan of Zhou.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王于公元前425年至公元前402年在位，是东周第二十代国王。
description.en: King Weilie of Zhou reigned from 425 BC to 402 BC as the 20th king of the Eastern Zhou dynasty.

description.zh-cn: 在三家分晋前，韩虔是晋国的大夫。
description.en: Before the Partition of Jin, Han Qian was a Grand Master of the State of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 在三家分晋前，赵籍是晋国的大夫。
description.en: Before the Partition of Jin, Zhao Ji was a Grand Master of the State of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 在三家分晋前，魏斯是晋国的大夫。
description.en: Before the Partition of Jin, Wei Si was a Grand Master of the State of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 韩虔与赵籍、魏斯联合击败了晋国执政大臣智伯。
description.en: Han Qian, along with Zhao Ji and Wei Si, jointly defeated Zhi Bo, the ruling minister of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 魏斯与韩虔、赵籍联合击败了晋国执政大臣智伯。
description.en: Wei Si, along with Han Qian and Zhao Ji, jointly defeated Zhi Bo, the ruling minister of Jin.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王二十三年（公元前403年），册封晋国大夫韩虔为韩侯，正式承认其诸侯地位。
description.en: In the 23rd year of his reign (403 BC), King Weilie of Zhou enfeoffed Han Qian, a grand master of Jin, as Marquess of Han, officially recognizing his status as a feudal lord.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王二十三年（公元前403年），册封晋国大夫赵籍为赵侯，正式承认其诸侯地位。
description.en: In the 23rd year of his reign (403 BC), King Weilie of Zhou enfeoffed Zhao Ji, a grand master of Jin, as Marquess of Zhao, officially recognizing his status as a feudal lord.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王二十三年（公元前403年），册封晋国大夫魏斯为魏侯，正式承认其诸侯地位。
description.en: In the 23rd year of his reign (403 BC), King Weilie of Zhou enfeoffed Wei Si, a grand master of Jin, as Marquess of Wei, officially recognizing his status as a feudal lord.

description.zh-cn: 三家分晋事件标志着春秋时代的结束。
description.en: The Partition of Jin marks the end of the Spring and Autumn period.

description.zh-cn: 三家分晋事件标志着战国时代的来临。
description.en: The Partition of Jin marks the beginning of the Warring States period.

description.zh-cn: 司马光的《资治通鉴》以三家分晋（公元前403年）作为其历史记述的起点。
description.en: Sima Guang's Zizhi Tongjian begins its historical narrative with the Partition of Jin (403 BC).

description.zh-cn: 司马光在《资治通鉴》的开篇就三家分晋事件发表了长篇的评论。
description.en: Sima Guang offered a lengthy commentary on the Partition of Jin at the beginning of his Zizhi Tongjian.

description.zh-cn: 周威烈王于公元前402年逝世，安葬于今河南省洛阳市。
description.en: King Weilie of Zhou died in 402 BC and was buried in what is now Luoyang City, Henan Province.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏出生于江西省弋阳县漆工镇湖塘村。
description.en: Fang Zhimin was born in Hutang Village, Qigong Town, Yiyang County, Jiangxi Province.

description.zh-cn: 方志纯是方志敏的堂弟。
description.en: Fang Zhichun was Fang Zhimin's paternal cousin.

description.zh-cn: 时任国民政府江西省政府主席的朱培德将方志敏“礼送”出境。
description.en: Zhu Peide, then Chairman of the Jiangxi Provincial Government of the Nationalist Government, exiled Fang Zhimin.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏担任弋横暴动的总指挥。
description.en: Fang Zhimin served as the commander-in-chief of the Yiyang-Hengfeng Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 黄道与方志敏等人共同领导了弋横暴动。
description.en: Huang Dao, along with Fang Zhimin and others, co-led the Yiyang-Hengfeng Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 邵式平与方志敏等人共同领导了弋横暴动。
description.en: Shao Shiping, along with Fang Zhimin and others, co-led the Yiyang-Hengfeng Uprising.

description.zh-cn: 红十军攻占景德镇时，瓷上肖像画创始人邓碧珊被杀。
description.en: When the Red Tenth Army captured Jingdezhen, Deng Bishan, the founder of porcelain portrait painting, was killed.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏对曾洪易的左倾方针进行了抵制。
description.en: Fang Zhimin resisted the leftist policies of Zeng Hongyi.

description.zh-cn: 红七军团与红十军合编为红十军团。
description.en: The Red Seventh Army Corps merged with the Red Tenth Army to form the Red Tenth Army Corps.

description.zh-cn: 红七军团与红十军合编为红十军团。
description.en: The Red Seventh Army Corps merged with the Red Tenth Army to form the Red Tenth Army Corps.

description.zh-cn: 由于军团长刘畴西的优柔寡断，红十军团一再错失突围良机，最终导致被围。
description.en: Due to the indecisiveness of commander Liu Chouxi, the Red Tenth Army Corps repeatedly missed opportunities to break out, ultimately leading to its encirclement.

description.zh-cn: 在怀玉山之战失败后，方志敏于1935年1月29日被俘。
description.en: After the defeat in the Battle of Huaiyu Mountain, Fang Zhimin was captured on January 29, 1935.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏于1935年1月被国民政府军俘虏，并于同年8月6日被处决。
description.en: Fang Zhimin was captured by the Nationalist Government's army in January 1935 and executed on August 6 of the same year.

description.zh-cn: 红十军团军团长刘畴西被国民政府军俘虏，并与方志敏一同被处决。
description.en: Liu Chouxi, commander of the Red Tenth Army Corps, was captured by the Nationalist Government's army and executed along with Fang Zhimin.

description.zh-cn: 根据电文记录，顾祝同遵令将方志敏秘密处死。
description.en: According to telegraph records, Gu Zhutong followed orders to secretly execute Fang Zhimin.

description.zh-cn: 方志敏在狱中创作了《可爱的中国》等文稿。
description.en: Fang Zhimin wrote manuscripts such as 'Lovely China' while in prison.

description.zh-cn: 毛泽东称赞方志敏是“以身殉志，不亦伟乎”的“人民英雄”。
description.en: Mao Zedong praised Fang Zhimin as a 'people's hero' who was 'great in sacrificing his life for his ideals'.

description.zh-cn: 叶剑英赋诗将方志敏比作文天祥之后的又一位民族英雄。
description.en: Ye Jianying wrote a poem comparing Fang Zhimin to another national hero after Wen Tianxiang.

description.zh-cn: 在纪念方志敏同志诞辰一百周年座谈会上，胡锦涛称赞方志敏的崇高品格和浩然正气是党的宝贵精神财富。
description.en: At a symposium commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Fang Zhimin's birth, Hu Jintao praised Fang Zhimin's noble character and integrity as a precious spiritual asset of the Party.

description.zh-cn: 根据官网信息，陈勇是广东省科学技术协会的主席。
description.en: According to the official website, Chen Yong is the Chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 广东省科学技术协会是中国科学技术协会的地方组织。
description.en: The Guangdong Provincial Association for Science and Technology is a local organization of the China Association for Science and Technology.

description.zh-cn: 广东省科学技术协会受中国共产党广东省委员会的领导。
description.en: The Guangdong Provincial Association for Science and Technology is led by the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 张晓军作为谷家的勤务人员，协助谷开来按倒海伍德并强行灌入氰化物，共同实施了谋杀。
description.en: As a household employee, Zhang Xiaojun assisted Gu Kailai by restraining Heywood and forcing him to ingest cyanide, thereby participating in the murder.

description.zh-cn: 王立军作为重庆市副市长，是时任市长黄奇帆的下属。
description.en: As Vice Mayor of Chongqing, Wang Lijun was a subordinate of Mayor Huang Qifan.

description.zh-cn: 在王立军汇报谷开来涉嫌杀人后，薄熙来掌掴王立军，并随后调整其分工，免去其公安局长职务，这些行为使王立军感到人身安全受威胁。
description.en: After Wang Lijun reported Gu Kailai's alleged involvement in the murder, Bo Xilai slapped him and subsequently removed him from his post as Public Security Chief, which made Wang fear for his personal safety.

description.zh-cn: 郭维国与他人共同作出海伍德系酒后猝死的结论，掩盖了谋杀真相，从而妨碍了案件的正常调查。
description.en: Guo Weiguo, along with others, concluded that Heywood died of sudden cardiac arrest due to excessive drinking, covering up the murder and obstructing the proper investigation of the case.

description.zh-cn: 李阳与他人共同作出海伍德系酒后猝死的结论，掩盖了谋杀真相，从而妨碍了案件的正常调查。
description.en: Li Yang, along with others, concluded that Heywood died of sudden cardiac arrest due to excessive drinking, covering up the murder and obstructing the proper investigation of the case.

description.zh-cn: 王鹏飞与他人共同作出海伍德系酒后猝死的结论，掩盖了谋杀真相，从而妨碍了案件的正常调查。
description.en: Wang Pengfei, along with others, concluded that Heywood died of sudden cardiac arrest due to excessive drinking, covering up the murder and obstructing the proper investigation of the case.

description.zh-cn: 王智与他人共同作出海伍德系酒后猝死的结论，掩盖了谋杀真相，从而妨碍了案件的正常调查。
description.en: Wang Zhi, along with others, concluded that Heywood died of sudden cardiac arrest due to excessive drinking, covering up the murder and obstructing the proper investigation of the case.

description.zh-cn: 王鹏飞为王立军提供了前往美国驻成都总领事馆时所驾驶的车辆。
description.en: Wang Pengfei provided the vehicle that Wang Lijun drove to the U.S. Consulate General in Chengdu.

description.zh-cn: 中纪委于2011年10月启动了对王立军涉及辽宁省铁岭市腐败问题的调查。
description.en: The CCDI launched an investigation into Wang Lijun in October 2011 concerning corruption issues in Tieling, Liaoning Province.

description.zh-cn: 王立军曾向中纪委举报谷开来向海外转移巨额款项。
description.en: Wang Lijun reported to the CCDI that Gu Kailai was transferring large sums of money overseas.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，许方盛是湖北汉川人。
description.en: According to the text, Xu Fangsheng is from Hanchuan, Hubei.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，许方盛是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to the text, Xu Fangsheng is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 许方盛是中华人民共和国的政治人物。
description.en: Xu Fangsheng is a political figure in the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 2018年，许方盛被选为湖北省出席第十三届全国人民代表大会的代表。
description.en: In 2018, Xu Fangsheng was elected as a delegate from Hubei Province to the 13th National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 许方盛的头衔是全国人大代表。
description.en: Xu Fangsheng's title is Deputy to the National People's Congress.

description.zh-cn: 李诫奉命编著了《营造法式》。
description.en: Li Jie was ordered to compile the 'Yingzao Fashi'.

description.zh-cn: 北宋朝廷于崇宁二年（1103年）将《营造法式》作为官方标准颁发施行。
description.en: The Northern Song imperial court issued and implemented 'Yingzao Fashi' as the official standard in 1103.

description.zh-cn: 李诫在编著《营造法式》时担任将作监少监。
description.en: Li Jie served as the Vice Director of the Directorate for Palace Buildings when he compiled the 'Yingzao Fashi'.

description.zh-cn: 《营造法式》是在《元祐法式》的基础上重新编著的，后者因未规定模数制而被取代。
description.en: 'Yingzao Fashi' was re-compiled based on 'Yuanyou Fashi', which was replaced for lacking a modular system.

description.zh-cn: 朱启钤于1919年发现了《营造法式》的重要抄本，并推动了其在现代的出版与研究。
description.en: In 1919, Zhu Qiqian discovered an important manuscript of 'Yingzao Fashi' and promoted its modern publication and research.

description.zh-cn: 陶湘于1925年整理校勘并刻板刊行了仿宋本《营造法式》，世称“陶湘本”，对该书的传播和研究影响深远。
description.en: In 1925, Tao Xiang collated, proofread, and published a facsimile Song edition of 'Yingzao Fashi', known as the 'Tao Xiang edition', which had a profound impact on the book's dissemination and study.

description.zh-cn: 阚铎曾任中国营造学社第一任文献部主任。
description.en: Kan Duo served as the first Director of the Documentation Department of the Society for the Study of Chinese Architecture.

description.zh-cn: 1930年，阚铎受朱启钤委托，将陶湘本《营造法式》与其它版本进行校对。
description.en: In 1930, Kan Duo was commissioned by Zhu Qiqian to collate Tao Xiang's edition of 'Yingzao Fashi' with other versions.

description.zh-cn: 清朝于1734年颁布的《清工部工程做法则例》中的“斗口制”代替了《营造法式》中以“材”为模数的做法。
description.en: The 'doukou' system in the 'Qing Ministry of Works Engineering Practices', promulgated in 1734, replaced the 'cai' modular system of the 'Yingzao Fashi'.

description.zh-cn: 商务印书馆于1920年发行了《营造法式》丁丙八千楼抄本的影印本，并在此后多次重版。
description.en: In 1920, The Commercial Press published a photolithographic copy of the Ding Bing Baqianlou manuscript of 'Yingzao Fashi', and subsequently reprinted it multiple times.

description.zh-cn: 《四库全书》收录了《营造法式》，是其得以流传至今的重要载体。
description.en: The 'Siku Quanshu' included the 'Yingzao Fashi', serving as an important vehicle for its transmission to the present day.

description.zh-cn: 梁思成对《营造法式》进行了系统的注解和研究，其成果《营造法式注释》是该领域的重要学术著作。
description.en: Liang Sicheng systematically annotated and researched 'Yingzao Fashi'. His work, 'Annotations on Yingzao Fashi', is a significant academic achievement in the field.

description.zh-cn: 杨白冰被认为是邓小平“改革开放”政策的军方坚定支持者。
description.en: Yang Baibing was considered a staunch supporter of Deng Xiaoping's 'Reform and Opening-Up' policy from within the military.

description.zh-cn: 因1961年的窃听器事件，杨尚昆于1965年被免去中共中央办公厅主任职务，改任广东省委书记处书记。
description.en: Due to the 1961 bugging incident, Yang Shangkun was removed from his post as Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee in 1965 and reassigned as a secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Committee Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 1945年10月，任弼时提议由杨尚昆接替李富春担任中央副秘书长、中央书记处办公厅主任职务。
description.en: In October 1945, Ren Bishi proposed that Yang Shangkun take over from Li Fuchun as Deputy Secretary-General of the Central Committee and Director of the General Office of the Central Secretariat.

description.zh-cn: 1945年12月，叶剑英为杨尚昆要来了一张毛泽东亲笔签名的中央军委秘书长的“委任状”，正式任命了该职务。
description.en: In December 1945, Ye Jianying obtained a 'letter of appointment' for the position of Secretary-General of the Central Military Commission, personally signed by Mao Zedong, for Yang Shangkun, formally appointing him to the post.

description.zh-cn: 江泽民接替杨尚昆出任中华人民共和国主席。
description.en: Jiang Zemin succeeded Yang Shangkun as President of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 杨尚昆作为红三军团政治委员，与彭德怀共同率领部队参加了长征。
description.en: As the political commissar of the Third Red Army Group, Yang Shangkun, along with Peng Dehuai, led the troops to participate in the Long March.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗在明世宗驾崩后继承皇位。
description.en: The Muzong Emperor succeeded to the throne after the death of the Jiajing Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明神宗在明穆宗驾崩后继承皇位。
description.en: The Wanli Emperor succeeded to the throne after the death of the Muzong Emperor.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗重用内阁首辅徐阶。
description.en: The Muzong Emperor heavily relied on Grand Secretary Xu Jie.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗重用高拱，并任命其为顾命大臣。
description.en: The Muzong Emperor heavily relied on Gao Gong and appointed him as a regent.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗重用张居正，并任命其为顾命大臣。
description.en: The Muzong Emperor heavily relied on Zhang Juzheng and appointed him as a regent.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗临终前任命高仪为顾命大臣。
description.en: Before his death, the Muzong Emperor appointed Gao Yi as a regent.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗宣布废除海禁，允许民间私人进行海外贸易。
description.en: The Muzong Emperor announced the lifting of the sea ban, allowing private maritime trade.

description.zh-cn: 与蒙古俺答议和，结束长达二百年的战争。
description.en: Made peace with Altan Khan of the Mongols, ending two centuries of warfare.

description.zh-cn: 明穆宗去世后葬于明昭陵。
description.en: After his death, the Muzong Emperor was buried in the Zhaoling Mausoleum.

description.zh-cn: 林立果是叶群的次子。
description.en: Lin Liguo is the second son of Ye Qun.

description.zh-cn: 叶群出生于京兆地方。
description.en: Ye Qun was born in Jingzhao.

description.zh-cn: 1935年，叶群在北京师范大学附属中学读书。
description.en: In 1935, Ye Qun was studying at The High School Affiliated to Beijing Normal University.

description.zh-cn: 叶群在北平师范大学附属中学读书时参加了“一二·九”学生运动。
description.en: While studying at The High School Affiliated to Beijing Normal University, Ye Qun participated in the 'December 9th' student movement.

description.zh-cn: 叶群于1935年加入中国共产主义青年团，并于1936年转入中国共产党。
description.en: Ye Qun joined the Communist Youth League of China in 1935 and transferred to the Chinese Communist Party in 1936.

description.zh-cn: 叶群于1936年加入中国共产党，后于1973年8月20日被中共中央永远开除党籍。
description.en: Ye Qun joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1936 and was permanently expelled from the party by the CCP Central Committee on August 20, 1973.

description.zh-cn: 叶群在延安整风运动期间受到过冲击。
description.en: Ye Qun was criticized during the Yan'an Rectification Movement.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命为叶群提供了政治机遇，使其担任了全军文革小组副组长、中央军委办事组成员、中共中央政治局委员等要职。
description.en: The Cultural Revolution provided political opportunities for Ye Qun, allowing her to hold key positions such as deputy leader of the All-Army Cultural Revolution Group, member of the Administrative Group of the Central Military Commission, and member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，叶群担任了全军文革小组的成员和副组长。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ye Qun served as a member and deputy leader of the All-Army Cultural Revolution Group.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，叶群担任了中央军委办事组成员。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Ye Qun served as a member of the Administrative Group of the Central Military Commission.

description.zh-cn: 1969年，叶群在中国共产党第九次全国代表大会上当选为中共中央政治局委员。
description.en: In 1969, Ye Qun was elected as a member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee at the 9th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party.

description.zh-cn: 叶群自1969年起担任中共中央政治局委员，直至其在1971年去世。
description.en: Ye Qun served as a member of the Politburo of the CCP Central Committee from 1969 until her death in 1971.

description.zh-cn: 1973年8月20日，中共中央决定永远开除叶群的党籍，并撤销其党内的一切职务。
description.en: On August 20, 1973, the CCP Central Committee decided to permanently expel Ye Qun from the party and remove all her posts within the party.

description.zh-cn: 1981年1月25日，中华人民共和国最高人民法院特别法庭确认叶群为林彪、江青反革命集团案的主犯，但鉴于其已死亡，不予追究刑事责任。
description.en: On January 25, 1981, the Special Court of the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China confirmed Ye Qun as a principal culprit in the Case of the Lin Biao and Jiang Qing Counter-Revolutionary Cliques, but given that she was already deceased, no criminal responsibility was pursued.

description.zh-cn: 余未人于1942年出生于云南昆明。
description.en: Yu Weiren was born in Kunming, Yunnan in 1942.

description.zh-cn: 根据文本，余未人曾担任中国民间文艺家协会副主席，并是该协会第六、七、八、九届理事会成员。分类信息显示她还担任过顾问。
description.en: According to the text, Yu Weiren served as the Vice Chairman of the China Folk Literature and Art Association and was a member of its 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th councils. Category information indicates she also served as an advisor.

description.zh-cn: 余未人曾担任贵州省文学艺术界联合会副主席。
description.en: Yu Weiren formerly served as the Vice Chairman of the Guizhou Provincial Federation of Literary and Art Circles.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，余未人是贵州大学的校友。
description.en: According to category information, Yu Weiren is an alumna of Guizhou University.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，余未人是中国共产党党员。
description.en: According to category information, Yu Weiren is a member of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 根据分类信息，余未人是中国作家协会会员。
description.en: According to category information, Yu Weiren is a member of the China Writers Association.

description.zh-cn: 陶勇出生于安徽省霍邱县。
description.en: Tao Yong was born in Huoqiu County, Anhui Province.

description.zh-cn: 1937年西路军失败后，陶勇进入抗日军政大学学习。
description.en: After the defeat of the Western Route Army in 1937, Tao Yong entered the Counter-Japanese Military and Political University for study.

description.zh-cn: 陈毅为原名张道庸的陶勇改名为“陶勇”。
description.en: Chen Yi changed Tao Yong's original name from Zhang Daoyong to 'Tao Yong'.

description.zh-cn: 在文化大革命爆发后，陶勇遭到迫害，并于1967年1月21日非正常死亡。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, Tao Yong was persecuted and died under mysterious circumstances on January 21, 1967.

description.zh-cn: 陶勇自1955年10月起担任东海舰队司令员，直至去世。
description.en: Tao Yong served as the Commander of the East Sea Fleet from October 1955 until his death.

description.zh-cn: 陶勇曾担任中国人民解放军海军副司令员。
description.en: Tao Yong served as the Deputy Commander of the PLA Navy.

description.zh-cn: 陶勇自1963年11月起兼任南京军区副司令员。
description.en: Tao Yong concurrently served as the Deputy Commander of the Nanjing Military Region starting from November 1963.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命爆发后，陶勇公然对抗林彪集团。
description.en: After the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, Tao Yong openly confronted the Lin Biao clique.

description.zh-cn: 1966年底，叶剑英通过陈丕显转告陶勇，提醒他警惕政治风向的变化。
description.en: At the end of 1966, Ye Jianying, through Chen Pixian, advised Tao Yong to be wary of the changing political winds.

description.zh-cn: 1967年初，许世友出于关心，要陶勇去南京养病以躲避政治风波。
description.en: In early 1967, out of concern, Xu Shiyou asked Tao Yong to go to Nanjing to recuperate and avoid the political turmoil.

description.zh-cn: 在去世当天上午，陶勇与廖政国谈论营救当时已被打倒的陈丕显。
description.en: On the morning of his death, Tao Yong discussed with Liao Zhengguo the rescue of Chen Pixian, who had already been overthrown.

description.zh-cn: 1967年1月21日上午，陶勇与时任上海警备区司令员廖政国会面，谈论营救陈丕显事宜。
description.en: On the morning of January 21, 1967, Tao Yong met with Liao Zhengguo, then commander of the Shanghai Garrison, to discuss the rescue of Chen Pixian.

description.zh-cn: 在陶勇死后，时任东海舰队政委刘浩天立即宣布其为“畏罪自杀，抗拒运动”。
description.en: After Tao Yong's death, Liu Haotian, then Political Commissar of the East Sea Fleet, immediately declared his death a 'suicide to escape punishment and resist the movement'.

description.zh-cn: 时任海军政委李作鹏将陶勇的死定性为“畏罪自杀”。
description.en: Li Zuopeng, then the Political Commissar of the Navy, characterized Tao Yong's death as a 'suicide to escape punishment'.

description.zh-cn: 1977年，中央军委为陶勇及其妻朱岚平反昭雪。
description.en: In 1977, the Central Military Commission posthumously exonerated Tao Yong and his wife Zhu Lan.

description.zh-cn: 在渡江战役期间，陶勇指挥部队炮击了闯入长江的英国皇家海军“紫石英”号，引发了紫石英号事件。
description.en: During the Yangtze River Crossing Campaign, Tao Yong commanded troops to shell the British Royal Navy's HMS Amethyst, which had entered the Yangtze River, triggering the Amethyst Incident.

description.zh-cn: 在淮海战役中，陶勇所在的华东野战军参与围攻杜聿明集团，并最终将其生擒。
description.en: During the Huaihai Campaign, the East China Field Army, in which Tao Yong served, participated in the siege of the Du Yuming clique and eventually captured him alive.

description.zh-cn: 在紫石英号事件中，陶勇指挥的解放军部队与英国皇家海军发生军事冲突。
description.en: During the Amethyst Incident, PLA forces under Tao Yong's command engaged in a military conflict with the British Royal Navy.

description.zh-cn: 1955年，陶勇接替袁也烈，担任东海舰队司令员。
description.en: In 1955, Tao Yong succeeded Yuan Yelie as the commander of the East Sea Fleet.

description.zh-cn: 1947年1月起，陶勇任华东野战军第4纵队司令员。
description.en: From January 1947, Tao Yong served as the Commander of the 4th Column of the East China Field Army.

description.zh-cn: 方励之于1955年入党，1957年反右运动中被第一次开除党籍，十一届三中全会后恢复党籍，1987年因八六学潮被第二次开除党籍。
description.en: Fang Lizhi joined the party in 1955, was expelled for the first time during the 1957 Anti-Rightist Campaign, had his membership restored after the 3rd Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, and was expelled for the second time in 1987 due to the 1986 student protests.

description.zh-cn: 在反右运动中被打成“内定右派”，并被第一次开除党籍。
