description.en: During the Anti-Rightist Campaign, he was labeled an "internally designated rightist" and expelled from the Communist Party for the first time.

description.zh-cn: 方励之在中国科学技术大学担任第一副校长期间，管惟炎是校长。
description.en: When Fang Lizhi served as the First Vice President of the University of Science and Technology of China, Guan Weiyan was the President.

description.zh-cn: 以上海同济大学研究生会名义，编辑并传播《方励之姚蜀平演讲集》，使方励之的观点在全国高校迅速传播。
description.en: Under the name of the Tongji University Graduate Student Union, he edited and disseminated the "Collection of Speeches by Fang Lizhi and Yao Shuping," rapidly spreading Fang's views across universities nationwide.

description.zh-cn: 共同发起召开《反右运动三十年历史学术讨论会》。
description.en: Jointly initiated the 'Academic Symposium on the Thirtieth Anniversary of the Anti-Rightist Movement'.

description.zh-cn: 共同发起召开《反右运动三十年历史学术讨论会》。
description.en: Jointly initiated the 'Academic Symposium on the Thirtieth Anniversary of the Anti-Rightist Movement'.

description.zh-cn: 在就八六学潮问题与中央负责同志的谈话中，点名要求开除方励之、刘宾雁、王若望的党籍。
description.en: In a talk with central leaders regarding the 1986 student protests, he specifically named Fang Lizhi, Liu Binyan, and Wang Ruowang for expulsion from the party.

description.zh-cn: 向邓小平发表公开信，建议释放民运人士魏京生等。
description.en: Published an open letter to Deng Xiaoping, suggesting the release of dissident Wei Jingsheng and others.

description.zh-cn: 王丹等人将方励之撰写的《中国的希望和失望》以大字报形式在北大张贴。
description.en: Wang Dan and others posted Fang Lizhi's article 'China's Disappointment and Hope' as a big-character poster at Peking University.

description.zh-cn: 因在六四事件中支持学生诉求，事件后被迫进入美国驻华大使馆寻求庇护，并被通缉，最终流亡美国。
description.en: Due to his support for student demands during the Tiananmen Square protests, he was forced to seek refuge in the U.S. Embassy after the incident, was placed on a wanted list, and ultimately went into exile in the United States.

description.zh-cn: 向方励之夫妇提供庇护长达一年。
description.en: Provided asylum to Fang Lizhi and his wife for a year.

description.zh-cn: 因反革命宣传煽动罪通缉方励之。
description.en: Issued a warrant for the arrest of Fang Lizhi on charges of counter-revolutionary propaganda and incitement.

description.zh-cn: 允许方励之入境并最终归化为美国公民，为其提供了流亡后的居所和工作机会。
description.en: Allowed Fang Lizhi to enter the country and eventually become a naturalized U.S. citizen, providing him with a place of residence and work opportunities after his exile.

description.zh-cn: 邓铿在陆军小学堂任教官时介绍陈济棠加入同盟会，后将其招揽入粤军第一师。
description.en: As an instructor at the Army Primary School, Deng Keng introduced Chen Jitang to the Tongmenghui and later recruited him into the First Division of the Guangdong Army.

description.zh-cn: 1907年由邓铿介绍加入同盟会。
description.en: Joined the Tongmenghui in 1907, introduced by Deng Keng.

position.en: Commander of the 11th Division of the NRA

description.zh-cn: 陈济棠在李济深担任军长的国民革命军第四军中任第11师师长。
description.en: Chen Jitang served as the commander of the 11th Division under Li Jishen, who was the commander of the NRA's Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 在陈济棠回国后，向李济深力荐使其复任师长职务；后在蒋桂战争期间，向蒋介石推荐陈济棠掌握广东军权。
description.en: After Chen Jitang returned to China, Gu Yingfen strongly recommended him to Li Jishen for reappointment as division commander; later, during the Chiang-Gui War, he recommended Chen to Chiang Kai-shek to take control of Guangdong's military power.

description.zh-cn: 1927年10月，率部在丰顺阻击并击败了由叶挺、贺龙率领的南昌起义南下部队，史称“汤坑之役”。
description.en: In October 1927, he led his troops to intercept and defeat the forces of the Nanchang Uprising led by Ye Ting and He Long in Fengshun, known as the 'Battle of Tangkeng'.

description.zh-cn: 在“张黄事变”后，陈济棠拥护李济深，率部参与对张发奎部队的作战。
description.en: After the 'Zhang-Huang Incident', Chen Jitang supported Li Jishen and led his troops to fight against Zhang Fakui's forces.

description.zh-cn: 蒋桂战争爆发，李济深被蒋介石扣押，陈济棠乘机宣布服从蒋介石，接收了桂系在广东的势力，成为广东的军权执掌者。
description.en: The Chiang-Gui War broke out, and Li Jishen was detained by Chiang Kai-shek. Chen Jitang seized the opportunity to declare allegiance to Chiang, took over the Guangxi clique's influence in Guangdong, and became the military ruler of the province.

description.zh-cn: 因蒋介石软禁胡汉民而反蒋，导致宁粤分裂；后于1936年联合新桂系发动两广事变再次反蒋。
description.en: Opposed Chiang Kai-shek due to the house arrest of Hu Hanmin, leading to the Nanjing-Guangzhou Split; later, in 1936, he allied with the New Guangxi Clique to launch the Liangguang Incident, again opposing Chiang.

description.zh-cn: 主政广东期间，在经济、文化和市政建设方面颇有建树，该时期被称为广州的黄金时代。
description.en: During his governance of Guangdong, he made significant achievements in economy, culture, and municipal construction, a period known as Guangzhou's golden age.

description.zh-cn: 战后于广州创建珠海书院。
description.en: Founded Chu Hai College in Guangzhou after the war.

description.zh-cn: 与新桂系联合发动“两广事变”反蒋。
description.en: Allied with the New Guangxi Clique to launch the 'Liangguang Incident' against Chiang Kai-shek.

description.zh-cn: 事变中，其部下余汉谋、黄光锐等人通电服从中央并率部投奔南京，导致陈济棠众叛亲离，被迫下野出走香港。
description.en: During the incident, his subordinates Yu Hanmou and Huang Guangrui declared allegiance to the central government and defected to Nanjing, leaving Chen isolated and forced to resign and flee to Hong Kong.

description.zh-cn: 在两广事变中通电表示服从中央政府，是导致陈济棠下野的关键因素之一。
description.en: His declaration of allegiance to the central government during the Liangguang Incident was a key factor in Chen Jitang's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 在两广事变中率领空军飞机投奔南京中央政府，是导致陈济棠下野的关键因素之一。
description.en: During the Liangguang Incident, he led the air force to defect to the Nanjing central government, which was a key factor in Chen Jitang's downfall.

description.zh-cn: 在接见陈济棠之子陈树柏时，评价陈济棠“治粤8年，确有建树，有些老一辈的广东人还在怀念他。”
description.en: When meeting with Chen Jitang's son Chen Shubai, he commented that Chen Jitang's 'eight-year governance of Guangdong was indeed constructive, and some of the older generation in Guangdong still remember him fondly.'

description.zh-cn: 在中国共产党第十七次全国代表大会上，通过决议将科学发展观写入《中国共产党章程》。
description.en: At the 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, a resolution was passed to write the Scientific Outlook on Development into the Constitution of the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 在2018年3月11日的第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上，科学发展观被写入《中华人民共和国宪法》。
description.en: On March 11, 2018, at the First Session of the 13th National People's Congress, the Scientific Outlook on Development was written into the Constitution of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 在2018年3月11日的第十三届全国人民代表大会第一次会议上，习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想与科学发展观一同被写入《中华人民共和国宪法》。
description.en: On March 11, 2018, at the First Session of the 13th National People's Congress, Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era was written into the Constitution of the People's Republic of China along with the Scientific Outlook on Development.

description.zh-cn: 胡锦涛在全国防治非典的工作会议上首次比较完整地提出了科学发展观，该事件为科学发展观的提出提供了背景和契机。
description.en: Hu Jintao first presented the Scientific Outlook on Development in a relatively complete form at the National Work Conference on SARS Prevention and Control, and this event provided the context and opportunity for its proposal.

description.zh-cn: 2003年4月15日，胡锦涛在广东视察时首次提出“要坚持全面的发展观”，这是科学发展观的雏形。
description.en: On April 15, 2003, during his inspection tour in Guangdong, Hu Jintao first proposed the need to 'adhere to a comprehensive view of development,' which was the prototype of the Scientific Outlook on Development.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺与李秀文于1925年结婚。
description.en: Ye Ting and Li Xiuwen married in 1925.

description.zh-cn: 叶辅平是叶挺的弟弟。
description.en: Ye Fuping was Ye Ting's younger brother.

description.zh-cn: 叶正大是叶挺的长子。
description.en: Ye Zhengda was Ye Ting's eldest son.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺于1918年从保定陆军军官学校毕业。
description.en: Ye Ting graduated from the Baoding Military Academy in 1918.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺于1924年加入中国共产党，1928年脱党。1946年获释后重新入党。
description.en: Ye Ting joined the Communist Party of China in 1924 and left the party in 1928. He rejoined the party after his release in 1946.

description.zh-cn: 1919年，叶挺追随孙中山革命，在其麾下任职，包括建国陆海军大元帅府警卫团营长。
description.en: In 1919, Ye Ting followed Sun Yat-sen's revolution and served under his command, including as a battalion commander in the Guards Regiment of the Generalissimo's Headquarters.

description.zh-cn: 1924年12月，经王若飞和王一飞介绍，叶挺被中共旅莫支部接受为候补党员。
description.en: In December 1924, through the introduction of Wang Ruofei and Wang Yifei, Ye Ting was accepted as a probationary member of the CCP by its Moscow branch.

description.zh-cn: 1937年9月28日，国民政府军事委员会任命叶挺为新四军军长。
description.en: On September 28, 1937, the Military Affairs Commission of the Nationalist Government appointed Ye Ting as the commander of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 蒋介石命令第三战区部队向新四军发起总攻，并强令“彻底加以肃清”，直接导致了皖南事变的爆发。
description.en: Chiang Kai-shek ordered the troops of the Third War Area to launch a general offensive against the New Fourth Army with the order to "thoroughly eliminate" them, which directly led to the Wannan Incident.

description.zh-cn: 叶挺与周恩来在南昌起义、广州起义等事件中共同领导，并在叶挺流亡和统率新四军期间多次会面。
description.en: Ye Ting and Zhou Enlai co-led events such as the Nanchang and Guangzhou Uprisings, and met multiple times during Ye Ting's exile and his command of the New Fourth Army.

description.zh-cn: 连战于1965年9月5日与连方瑀（原名方瑀）在美国芝加哥大学庞德教堂结婚。
description.en: Lien Chan married Lien Fang-yu (née Fang Yu) on September 5, 1965, at the Bond Chapel of the University of Chicago in the United States.

degree.en: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science

description.zh-cn: 1953年自陆军官校转学至国立台湾大学政治系，1957年毕业。
description.en: Transferred from the Military Academy to the Department of Political Science at National Taiwan University in 1953, and graduated in 1957.

degree.zh-cn: 国际公法与外交学硕士、政治学博士
degree.en: Master of Arts in International Public Law and Diplomacy, Doctor of Philosophy in Political Science

description.zh-cn: 连战于1961年和1965年分别在芝加哥大学获得硕士和博士学位。
description.en: Lien Chan received his master's and doctoral degrees from the University of Chicago in 1961 and 1965, respectively.

description.zh-cn: 邹谠是连战在芝加哥大学的博士学位指导教授。
description.en: Tang Tsou was Lien Chan's doctoral advisor at the University of Chicago.

description.zh-cn: 连战在李登辉担任总统期间，先后出任其任命的行政院院长及搭档竞选的副总统。
description.en: During Lee Teng-hui's presidency, Lien Chan served first as the Premier appointed by him, and later as his running mate and Vice President.

description.zh-cn: 在2000年总统大选中，国民党支持者认为时任党主席的李登辉暗助陈水扁，导致连战败选。
description.en: In the 2000 presidential election, KMT supporters believed that then-Chairman Lee Teng-hui secretly supported Chen Shui-bian, leading to Lien Chan's defeat.

description.zh-cn: 此事件发生在2004年总统选举前一天，被泛蓝阵营认为严重影响选情，导致连战以微弱差距败选。
description.en: This incident occurred the day before the 2004 presidential election and was considered by the Pan-Blue Coalition to have seriously affected the election, leading to Lien Chan's narrow defeat.

description.zh-cn: 全民健康保险制度在连战担任行政院院长任内规划并正式开办。
description.en: The National Health Insurance system was planned and officially launched during Lien Chan's tenure as Premier of the Executive Yuan.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事法院在审判工作上受中华人民共和国最高人民法院监督。
description.en: The judicial work of the PLA Military Court is supervised by the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China.

description.zh-cn: 中国人民解放军军事法院业务上受中央军委政法委员会领导，组织上是其直属单位。
description.en: The PLA Military Court is operationally led by the Political and Legal Affairs Commission of the Central Military Commission and is organizationally its direct subordinate unit.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国宪法》为中国人民解放军军事法院的设立提供了法律授权和依据。
description.en: The Constitution of the People's Republic of China provides the legal authorization and basis for the establishment of the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 《中华人民共和国人民法院组织法》是中国人民解放军军事法院的组织法规。
description.en: The Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China serves as the organizational regulation for the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 1954年宪法规定设置专门人民法院，为中国人民解放军军事法庭更名为中国人民解放军军事法院提供了法律依据。
description.en: The 1954 Constitution provided for the establishment of specialized people's courts, offering a legal basis for renaming the PLA Military Tribunal to the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 1969年底，在文化大革命期间，中国人民解放军军事法院和全军各级军事法院先后被撤销。
description.en: At the end of 1969, during the Cultural Revolution, the PLA Military Court and military courts at all levels throughout the army were successively abolished.

description.zh-cn: 1978年1月，中共中央军委决定重建中国人民解放军军事法院。
description.en: In January 1978, the Central Military Commission of the CCP decided to re-establish the PLA Military Court.

description.zh-cn: 陈奇涵自1954年11月起担任中国人民解放军军事法院首任院长。
description.en: Chen Qihan served as the first President of the PLA Military Court starting in November 1954.

description.zh-cn: 郝苏于1978年9月被任命为重建后的中国人民解放军军事法院院长。
description.en: Hao Su was appointed President of the re-established PLA Military Court in September 1978.

description.zh-cn: 徐勤先拒绝执行六四清场的命令。
description.en: Xu Qinxian refused to execute the order for the Tiananmen Square clearance.

description.zh-cn: 原总后勤部军械部部长刘连昆因向台湾提供情报间谍案，被军事法院判处注射死刑。
description.en: Liu Liankun, former director of the Ordnance Department of the General Logistics Department, was sentenced to death by lethal injection by the military court for espionage involving providing intelligence to Taiwan.

description.zh-cn: 中央军委原副主席郭伯雄因受贿案被军事法院判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Guo Boxiong, former Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission, was sentenced to life imprisonment by the military court for bribery.

description.zh-cn: 原中央军委联合参谋部参谋长房峰辉因受贿、行贿、巨额财产来源不明案被军事法院判处无期徒刑。
description.en: Fang Fenghui, former Chief of the Joint Staff Department of the Central Military Commission, was sentenced to life imprisonment by the military court for bribery, offering bribes, and possessing a huge amount of property from unidentified sources.

description.zh-cn: 根据《中华人民共和国宪法》，国务院是最高国家权力机关全国人民代表大会的执行机关。
description.en: According to the Constitution of the People's Republic of China, the State Council is the executive organ of the National People's Congress, the highest organ of state power.

description.zh-cn: 1954年宪法规定设立国务院，取代了原中央人民政府政务院的行政职能。
description.en: The 1954 Constitution stipulated the establishment of the State Council, which replaced the administrative functions of the former Government Administration Council of the Central People's Government.

description.zh-cn: 在周恩来病逝后，接任国务院代总理，后为总理。
description.en: After Zhou Enlai's death, he took over as Acting Premier of the State Council, and later as Premier.

description.zh-cn: 接替辞职的华国锋出任国务院总理。
description.en: Succeeded Hua Guofeng, who resigned, as Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 在赵紫阳辞职后，出任国务院代总理。
description.en: After Zhao Ziyang's resignation, he became Acting Premier of the State Council.

description.zh-cn: 于2018年2月被撤职。
description.en: Was removed from office in February 2018.

description.zh-cn: 于2023年10月被免职。
description.en: Was removed from office in October 2023.

description.zh-cn: 于2023年10月被免职。
description.en: Was removed from office in October 2023.

description.zh-cn: 张百发出生于河北香河的一个贫苦农民家庭。
description.en: Zhang Bafa was born into a poor peasant family in Xianghe, Hebei.

description.zh-cn: 1954年，张百发加入中国共产党。
description.en: In 1954, Zhang Bafa joined the Communist Party of China.

description.zh-cn: 1959年，张百发在全国群英会上受到党和国家领导人接见。
description.en: In 1959, Zhang Bafa was received by Party and state leaders at the National Conference of Heroes.

description.zh-cn: 画家蒋兆和曾为张百发画像。
description.en: The painter Jiang Zhaohe once created a portrait of Zhang Bafa.

description.zh-cn: 邓拓在蒋兆和为张百发所作的画像上题词：“百尺竿头多面手，人民英雄张百发。”
description.en: Deng Tuo inscribed on the portrait of Zhang Bafa painted by Jiang Zhaohe: 'A versatile hand at the top of the pole, a hero of the people, Zhang Bafa.'

description.zh-cn: 时任北京市副市长的万里主管城市建设，张百发是其手下得力干将，其成长得到了万里的关心。
description.en: Wan Li, then Vice Mayor of Beijing in charge of urban construction, considered Zhang Bafa one of his most capable subordinates and cared about his development.

description.zh-cn: 时任北京市副市长的万里主管城市建设，李瑞环是其手下得力干将，其成长得到了万里的关心。
description.en: Wan Li, then Vice Mayor of Beijing in charge of urban construction, considered Li Ruihuan one of his most capable subordinates and cared about his development.

description.zh-cn: 文化大革命期间，张百发在批斗万里的大会上被揪去作为陪斗。
description.en: During the Cultural Revolution, Zhang Bafa was forced to be a 'secondary target' at a struggle session against Wan Li.

description.zh-cn: 张百发曾历任国家建委副局长、副主任。
description.en: Zhang Bafa successively served as Deputy Director and Vice Minister of the State Construction Commission.

description.zh-cn: 张百发于1983年3月至1997年9月期间担任北京市人民政府副市长。
description.en: Zhang Bafa served as Vice Mayor of the Beijing Municipal People's Government from March 1983 to September 1997.

description.zh-cn: 张百发在49岁时进入中国人民大学函授学院学习并获得文凭。
description.en: At the age of 49, Zhang Bafa enrolled in the correspondence school of Renmin University of China and obtained a diploma.

position.zh-cn: 北京亚运工程总指挥、亚运会组委会常务副主席

description.zh-cn: 张百发担任北京亚运工程总指挥，指挥建设了1990年北京亚运会的比赛场馆及亚运村，对亚运会的成功举办起到了关键作用。
description.en: Zhang Bafa served as the commander-in-chief of the Beijing Asian Games projects, directing the construction of the venues and the Asian Games Village, playing a crucial role in the successful hosting of the event.

description.zh-cn: 六四事件后，发达国家的制裁及外资撤退给1990年北京亚运会的筹备工作带来了很大困难。
description.en: After the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, sanctions from developed countries and the withdrawal of foreign investment caused significant difficulties for the preparations of the 1990 Beijing Asian Games.

description.zh-cn: 邓小平曾于1958年接见青年突击队长张百发。1990年和1993年，张百发两次陪同邓小平视察北京的城市建设。
description.en: Deng Xiaoping met with youth shock brigade leader Zhang Bafa in 1958. In 1990 and 1993, Zhang Bafa accompanied Deng Xiaoping on two inspections of Beijing's urban construction.

description.zh-cn: 在处理拆迁户上访事件时，时任北京市长的陈希同指示副市长张百发出面解决问题。
description.en: When dealing with a petition from displaced residents, then-Mayor of Beijing Chen Xitong instructed Vice Mayor Zhang Bafa to resolve the issue.

description.zh-cn: 张百发与李瑞环同为青年突击队长出身，在工作中接触很多，曾一同被提拔，并在文革期间一同被陪斗，之后还曾一同探望万里。
description.en: Zhang Bafa and Li Ruihuan both started as youth shock brigade leaders, had extensive contact through their work, were promoted together, were forced to be 'secondary targets' together during the Cultural Revolution, and later visited Wan Li together.

description.zh-cn: 经过长达七年的法律诉讼，阿尔贝二世于2020年1月承认德尔菲娜为其女儿。
description.en: After a seven-year legal battle, Albert II acknowledged Delphine as his daughter in January 2020.

description.zh-cn: 通过法律诉讼，迫使阿尔贝二世进行亲子鉴定并承认其为私生女，最终获得公主身份。
description.en: Forced Albert II to undergo a paternity test and acknowledge her as his illegitimate daughter through legal proceedings, ultimately gaining the title of princess.

description.zh-cn: 博杜安是阿尔贝二世的前任比利时国王。阿尔贝二世在其兄长博杜安驾崩后于1993年继承王位。
description.en: Baudouin was the predecessor to Albert II as King of the Belgians. Albert II succeeded to the throne in 1993 following the death of his older brother, Baudouin.

description.zh-cn: 在2010-2011年比利时政府难产期间，阿尔贝二世在化解政治僵局、推动新政府成立的过程中发挥了重大作用。
description.en: During the 2010–2011 Belgian government formation crisis, Albert II played a major role in resolving the political deadlock and pushing for the formation of a new government.

description.zh-cn: 2005年，阿尔贝二世与时任美国总统乔治·W·布什会面并合影。
description.en: In 2005, Albert II met with then-U.S. President George W. Bush.
